chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 147: Welcome Banquet
chapters.content:
[Thanks to Open dagger for becoming a member and Aethergrey314, 10 bonus chapters]
The last piece of mysterious knowledge Hobert acquired was: "Sequence 5, Advancement Ritual of the Astronomer: Riding on the back of the colorful star-eyed beast and drinking the potion under the midnight sky."
He immediately felt that the explosion in his head just now was worthwhile, as it enabled him to grasp the potion formula for the Mystery Pryer pathway in the continuous sequence, as well as the formula for the starting pathway of the "Savant."
So far, Hobert had mastered four consecutive potion formulas, all ranging from Sequence 6 to Sequence 9. Although these accumulations were for relatively higher sequences, they would surely be of great use someday.
Selling these potion formulas was their smallest value.
Then, Hobert thought of the scene he saw with the black eyeball just now. The eyes in the wilderness didn't seem to be from the "Hidden Sage"—could they be from the "Knowledge Moor"?
He remembered that the "Hidden Sage" seemed to be the unique activated form of the "Hermit" pathway. Now, does the "Knowledge Moor" also have its own consciousness?
Moreover, one could already project their power through some rituals?
The ceremony of Old Neil was told to him by the "Hidden Sage." Could this be the effort made by the "Hidden Sage" in search of the "Knowledge Moor"?
It seems that the seal of the Western Continent has indeed loosened.
Afterwards, Hobert thought again about the strange gains he had made coming to Tingen City, apart from the eye he obtained today, there were also two golden deer antlers.
They both looked quite exquisite, but he dared not use them in reality; once used, it would either lead to death or madness. Moreover, they were difficult to liquidate.
They could only be temporarily stored in the "Nation of Disorder" to see if they would be useful in the future.
With signs of spiritual exhaustion already appearing, Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder." The aftermath of his head "bursting open" just now brought into reality. He had a splitting headache for more than ten minutes, and only then did his spirituality begin to recover, with the headache gradually disappearing.
Today's near-death experience made him just want to lie in bed and not move at all.
Suddenly, he saw the towering giant palace, and a mysterious and majestic figure sitting on a high-backed chair said, "Cancel the gathering next week."
Hobert sat up abruptly, then slowly lay back down. It seemed that "Mr. Fool" had already sensed something.
In the evening, the steward reminded Hobert that Mr. Ulysses's invited guests had arrived.
Having lazily spent half a day, Hobert washed his face, adjusted his condition, and changed into the formal wear he had brought before heading to the living room.
The first to arrive was Mr. Dominic and his family, his wife, who was Mr. Ulysses's sister, a baroness, expressed gratitude to Hobert.
Although Elizabeth had forgotten the details of Hobert's battle with Achille, when she saw Hobert, she immediately felt an unprecedented sense of security.
She sat beside Hobert. "Mr. Hobert, I heard that you don't need to handle the lawsuit anymore?"
"Yes," Hobert said, "Mr. Claude has already sent himself to prison."
He found that this cute girl seemed a bit too close, but it would be impolite to move aside, so he moved forward to ease the embarrassment.
Elizabeth also followed suit. "Then are you going back in a few days?"
"In two more days," Hobert smiled, "I really can't bear to leave the fresh air of Tingen City."
Dominic and his wife exchanged glances, and of course, they noticed that their daughter was a bit unusual. But Elizabeth did not behave excessively. She seemed satisfied just sitting next to Hobert.
"Then let's go shopping together this weekend," Elizabeth said, "I want to give you a gift to express my gratitude."
"No need to be so polite, and I may have something to do this weekend."
"What's up?"
"Participating in the operation to save Tingen City."
The family of three thought Hobert was joking and laughed along, flattering.
At this point, the real owner of the villa, Ulysses, entered. "I heard that someone dared to kidnap our little princess?"
In front of Elizabeth, Ulysses finally showed a genuine smile, not so stiff, showing that he loved his nephew and niece.
"Yes, Uncle," Elizabeth greeted him. "But the ransom letter of the kidnappers wasn't even finished, and Mr. Hobert rescued me."
Hobert smiled. "This shows that the kidnappers are really uncultured. They probably need a dictionary even to write a ransom letter, and they'd be frustrated by grammar issues."
Everyone immediately had the image in their minds of the kidnappers looking up words in the dictionary while frowning as they wrote the ransom letter, which made everyone burst into laughter.
Then the guests arrived one after another, all dressed in military uniforms, shouting as soon as they entered, "Where's Commander Christian's son?"
"Huh? Commander Christian's son? Why does he look a bit like Commander Rex?"
"Nonsense! How could Commander Christian's son... Wait, don't say it, he really does look like him."
"Haha, tomorrow I'll write a letter to Commander Christian, reporting your faces to him."
Someone else asked, "Hobert, right? Do you have a girlfriend? Do you want Uncle to introduce you to one?"
"If Commander Christian gives instructions, I guess the kids will have them!"
They didn't care about Hobert's answer at all. Even if Hobert didn't say a word, they probably could keep chatting.
Amidst laughter and joy, the banquet began. Hobert strongly suspected that they hadn't gathered for a long time, welcoming him to Tingen City's banquet, just as the reason for their gathering.
After all, Hobert had been here for several days and was almost ready to leave.
At the dinner table, there were only Hobert and Elizabeth, the two juniors who had some common topics, occasionally chatting, which made Hobert, the "protagonist" of the banquet, not too awkward.
After ten o'clock in the evening, the guests began to leave one after another.
Having drunk a lot of wine, Ulysses patted Hobert on the shoulder. "If you have any plans, go ahead and do it. Don't let down the expectations of both commanders. As long as Commander Christian speaks, we can still accompany him into battle."
Hobert smiled helplessly. "Okay, it's late now. You should go rest."
Watching Ulysses leave, Hobert's smile gradually disappeared. He almost asked Ulysses for external support just now.
Fortunately, he endured it because Ulysses was polite to him, out of respect for Commander Christian. His relationship with Ulysses had not yet reached that point.
The final preparations began, and Hobert didn't go anywhere on Friday, staying in the villa to conserve his energy and adjust the negative effects of sealed artifacts and mystical items.
On Saturday morning, Hobert took a carriage to the Blackthorn Security Company. He told the coachman, "You can go back first. Come pick me up around... hmm, four or five in the afternoon."
Seeing off the coachman, Hobert glanced at the somewhat cloudy sky, stepping into the lobby of the security company step by step.
In the lobby, Leonard looked somewhat unnatural as he chatted with a woman wearing a broad-brimmed hat and loose skirt.
"Hobert!" Leonard exclaimed. "You, you've come..."
He didn't know whether to say it was the right time for Hobert to arrive, or if it wasn't the right time.

chapters.title: Chapter 148 - 148: Hobert's Plan
chapters.content:
Upon seeing Megose with the offspring of an evil god, Hobert's mind exploded with thoughts. He recalled everything about "0-08" and the overall outline of his plan.
Firstly, his plan wasn't overly complicated because in the face of "0-08," the more complex the plan, the greater the chance of failure.
Last week, Hobert intended to prepare early in Tingen City, but after much consideration, he realized that no matter what preparations he made, "0-08" would sense something amiss beforehand.
Therefore, Hobert's plan was to gain basic trust from Dunn and the others before Ince Zangwill acted.
Afterwards, things weren't so complicated. Megose coming to Blackthorn Security Company was inevitable, and only after this could they deal with Ince.
Otherwise, Ince would continue to wait for the right moment, and the situation would completely spiral out of Hobert's control, losing his advantage of seeing things from a god's perspective.
The proposition was already there. How to stall Megose without harm until reinforcements from headquarters arrived?
Hobert's answer was to follow the original storyline's development. He must protect Leonard during Megose's initial onslaught.
The old man within Leonard and the sealed artifact he held could effectively stall Megose.
In the ensuing battle, they must prevent Dunn from going all out. If necessary, they could even throw "Saint Selena's ashes" onto the streets outside for anyone who wanted them.
As for Klein, they could completely ignore whether he lived or died.
Another principle for those participating in this operation was to do their best without risking their lives. Hobert didn't have Klein's ability to resurrect.
Standing at Blackthorn Security Company, Hobert's thoughts churned for a moment. He quickly put on a smile and said to Leonard, "I came today to bid farewell, but it seems I've come at the wrong time."
Leonard sighed bitterly. "I still have guests here. Captain and Klein are in the back."
Hobert nodded. "Alright, you go ahead."
"My baby in my belly says he seems to have seen this gentleman somewhere," Megose suddenly said.
Hobert smiled. "Maybe we were good friends in our last life."
"No, he said you spied on his 'order'!" Megose said. "But he didn't expect you to be so weak."
Hobert recalled that a few days ago, when he got hold of that black rib, he seemed to have seen another world, probably the realm of the "True Creator."
Thinking about this, Hobert smiled. "Madam, rest assured. The child's words are often contradictory."
Megose smiled gently. "No, my child is very smart. He says you're weak, so you really are weak."
Hobert twitched his mouth. The "True Creator" wouldn't change his pathway to become a "hunter," would he?
After nodding slightly to Megose, Hobert turned to the reception hall behind him. Dunn and Klein were already waiting here, one holding an ash box emitting a sense of tranquility, and the other holding a pale and thick blood vessel.
Klein smiled bitterly. "Hobert, you've come at a really bad time."
"No, I think it's just the right time," Hobert said seriously. "When I was in Backlund, I heard that Tingen City seemed to be brewing a huge disaster. Now I know what that disaster is."
He asked, "Have there been a lot of coincidences recently?"
Dunn and Klein's expressions both froze. They had just discussed the coincidences that had been happening recently.
Hobert said, "Please report to the headquarters that '0-08' is planning a ritual for the descent of an evil god and ask them to send saintly support."
Mentioning "0-08," Dunn and Klein immediately thought of the defector Ince Zangwill. They each had their own suspicions and probably understood what was going on.
Dunn held the ash box and said, "I'll report immediately. Don't act rashly until I come back."
Hobert glanced outside. "Don't worry, there's still time."
Klein said, "You seem very calm."
"Of course," Hobert smiled. "The more this time, the more you need to be calm."
...
In a bar outside Blackthorn Security Company, one-eyed Ince Zangwill ordered a beer and held a feather pen to write on its own: "Hobert Jeffrey's arrival was not part of Ince Zangwill's plan. Will he affect the entire plan?"
Ince took a sip of beer and gripped the feather pen tightly, writing on its own: "No, after all, he's just a Sequence 8."
Then he let his wrist relax and let the feather pen write on its own again: "Hobert Jeffrey has a lot of unexpected knowledge. He has already guessed that Megose's arrival is Ince Zangwill's plan. Will he affect the entire plan?"
Ince's single-eyed pupil contracted, Klein was annoying enough. Why did Hobert come again?
He wrote: "No, after all, he's just a Sequence 8!"
Then he wrote again: "The Nighthawks' plea for help telegram was too brief, and did not attract enough attention from headquarters, so the minimum assistance from headquarters can only arrive half an hour later."
The premise of this statement was that "the plea for help telegram was too brief," so the consequence was "not enough attention from headquarters." This was still within "0-08's" ability.
But when Ince let go of the pen, the feather pen wrote on its own again: "The first plea for help telegram was indeed too brief, but the second plea for help telegram was very detailed."
Ince's gaze contracted again. Another plea for help telegram?
He looked towards Blackthorn Security Company. For today, he had been shut up in a rented house writing for a long time, and he didn't know when he would have the same opportunity again.
Most importantly, if this failed, headquarters would definitely guess his purpose and might return "Saint Selena's ashes" to headquarters, which would be a total loss of opportunity.
Ince finally made up his mind. No matter what, today he had to take a gamble!
...
After sending the telegram again, Dunn smiled, "Let's reintroduce ourselves, Nighthawks, Dunn Smith."
"Hello, Captain Dunn," Hobert smiled. "Let me introduce this sealed artifact I have, called the 'Teleportation Statue,' with the ability to..."
"And my cane, a one-time mystical item, its ability is..."
Klein said, "Hobert, with your help, we can hold off the other party for a longer time."
Hobert smiled. "I also suggest whether we can try to lure Megose underground, preferably into Chanis Gate before taking action?"

chapters.title: Chapter 149 - 149: Battle with the Evil God' Spawn (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
Backland, Headquarters of the Nighthawks.
Daly had been on duty in the dispatch room for many days. Today, she finally couldn't hold on anymore. After receiving a telegram from Tingen City, she collapsed into a chair for a rest.
When the administrative staff received the first telegram, they felt the situation wasn't urgent enough and Daly was sound asleep. So, they first delivered the telegram to Captain Thomas and planned to inform Daly later.
However, when the administrative staff received the second telegram with just the phrase "The Evil God Descends," they felt the urgency of the situation.
They quickly woke Daly up. After reading the message, Daly immediately went to Thomas's office. "I need to see the Archbishop!"
Only the Archbishop had the means to support Tingen City within minutes!
…
Tingen City, within the Blackthorn Security Company.
Upon hearing Hobert's suggestion, Dunn shook his head. "The influence of Megose's child is high; she wouldn't submit so easily."
Hobert said, "I can try. Even if it doesn't succeed, we won't lose much."
Dunn considered for a moment and nodded.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. Although Dunn wasn't in the right state today, he hadn't lost his sanity.
He returned to the reception hall of the security company. Megose looked somewhat agitated by now, scratching her head and pulling out a handful of hair, naturally tossing it into the trash.
Leonard's expression had stiffened. He silently swore to himself never to flirt with ladies randomly again.
Hobert smiled, "A few days ago, we got something good. It's two golden deer antlers that grew on the head of a bull."
Megose first showed a twisted smile and then said, "My child says that the horns of the Golden Horned Demon are very delicious."
With Hobert's relay, Leonard relaxed, following Hobert's nod towards the back of the reception hall.
"We've placed the two golden deer antlers in the basement." Just standing opposite Megose, Hobert felt immense spiritual pressure.
He resisted this pressure with all his might. "If your child wants to eat them, please follow me to the basement, and I'll give them to him."
"Thank you, kind sir." Megose smiled gently. "Today, my child seems to lack energy and needs some nutrition."
Saying this, she got up and followed Hobert towards the underground entrance of the Blackthorn Security Company.
Hobert casually asked as they walked, "He's lacking energy today?"
"Yes, usually, he's quite active." Megose said. "But this morning, he said today was a crucial day, and he only speaks to me occasionally."
Hobert took a deep breath and wiped the sweat from his forehead. "He's a good boy."
"Yes." Megose smiled warmly. "For example, right now, my child tells me there's danger underground, and you're taking me down to harm us."
Hobert froze in place, feeling as though he was being stared at by the Grim Reaper.
"Is that true, sir?" Megose asked calmly, her tone unchanged.
"How could that be?" Hobert laughed. "Your child is as humorous as his father!"
Megose seemed like a melting wax figure. Some thick liquid began to flow down her head, her smile becoming unusually terrifying. "Sorry, sir, I can't go down with you, so you'll have to die!"
Although Hobert was prepared early, he rolled forward immediately, but he couldn't dodge in time and was scratched deeply on his back by Megose's suddenly long nails.
Relying on the sturdy physique of a "Barbarian," he rolled down from the stairs.
When he looked back, Megose had already left the intersection of the underground passage.
Ignoring the wound on his back, Hobert picked up his cane and charged forward.
Thump-thump~
He took three or four steps in one go. Suddenly, he felt that his "Barbarian" potion had digested quite a bit at this critical moment.
He immediately understood. If Megose didn't enter the Chanis Gate, the Evil God would arrive early in the reception hall, a script written by "0-08."
As long as he participated in this matter, he had to follow the script of "0-08." Hobert's recent actions were obviously disrupting this script and not following the rules of "0-08."
So Hobert's "Barbarian" potion was digested.
But now wasn't the time to think about this. Just as he returned to the first floor, he heard Megose screaming and questioning, "I won't let you hurt my child!"
Dunn had already appeared in the reception hall holding an urn of ashes, blocking Megose's way out. Klein and Leonard were hiding in a nearby room, ready to strike at any moment.
Despite Megose's shocking scream, Hobert rushed into the reception hall, planting his cane on the ground. "Order!"
Looking at the "Tree of Order" rapidly growing, he laughed loudly. "You're weak, your whole family is weak!"
The reception hall became unusually quiet. The order under the canopy became advantageous to dark forces, thieves' powers, and sunlight powers, suppressing the powers of filth and corruption.
With a loud voice, Hobert focused Megose's attention on him. By now, her entire face had "melted," revealing bones, looking hideous and terrifying. She raised her hand and reached for Hobert.
But at this moment, Hobert had already picked up the "Teleportation Statue." He wanted to move Megose away, but he immediately discovered that the ability of the "Teleportation Statue" couldn't move Megose, only slowing her down.
No wonder the Nighthawks defined it as a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, it turns out its effect was limited when facing high-level enemies.
Since he couldn't move Megose, Hobert quickly retreated. His goal just now was to attract Megose's attention and create an opportunity for Dunn.
Now that his goal was achieved, he acted like a "Barbarian" and withdrew.
After the battle began, with the "Teleportation Statue" in hand, he assisted Dunn and the others to "blink."
Seizing this opportunity, Dunn opened the "Saint Selena's Ashes." Inside the urn was an intense darkness, and within the darkness were bright strands.
The reception hall suddenly darkened, countless black, cold filaments surged towards Megose, instantly wrapping her up.
Megose suddenly shouted in a hoarse voice, "You must die!"
In the instant she opened her mouth, as the holder of the "Tree of Order," Hobert redirected her extraordinary attack onto a wall.
However, the "Tree of Order" couldn't redirect all of Megose's attacks. Just as she finished speaking, Hobert felt a tremendous impact on both his physical and spirit bodies. Blood flowed from the corners of his eyes and mouth.
This should be the highest-level opponent he had encountered since crossing over.
He wiped the blood from his eyes, but it was still much better than when it was just Dunn and the others, at least Dunn wasn't injured right away.
Klein and Leonard took advantage of this opportunity to rush out. Leonard reached out and stole Megose's upcoming "Profanity," while Klein threw out one of the "Flaring Sun Charms."
The high "Tree of Order" made way for the sunlight, opening a small gap, and a ball of light fell from the sky, slamming heavily on Megose.
After the bright light flashed, Hobert knew Megose hadn't been dealt with yet. "Give it another shot!"
Klein hadn't yet understood what Hobert meant, but the four of them saw a black baby hanging between Megose's legs.
The baby was very small, looking like it weighed only five or six pounds. He was sucking on something with the umbilical cord in his mouth, making gurgling sounds.
Upon seeing the baby, all four of them showed signs of losing control to varying degrees!
Dunn, who wasn't in a good state, was the most affected. Hobert quickly adjusted the "Tree of Order," making the order under the canopy more favorable for resisting madness and losing control.
In the few seconds they fought against the loss of control, Megose, who had already been dried out by the light ball, stretched out her withered hand and touched the baby's head. "Child, my child."
Then Megose collapsed to the ground, flesh and blood turning to dust, leaving only a pile of bones.
Because the baby absorbed all of its mother's nutrients, it quickly grew to the size of a four or five-year-old. His skin was gray all over, as if there were no blood flowing, his appearance was ferocious, his eyes fierce, without a trace of the innocence and cuteness that a child should have.
This was the birth of the Evil God' Spawn, not the descent of the Evil God. If it were the descent of the Evil God, Hobert and the others would already be dead.
The Evil God' Spawn intended to kill everyone before him because it was these presumptuous people who forced him to descend early, so he had only a small fraction of the power of the "True Creator".
He needed to hold the corresponding ceremony, sacrificing many living beings, to help him establish a broader connection with the "True Creator," so that the "True Creator" could utilize him to descend upon the mortal world.
The moment he descended, Tingen City would no longer have any living beings; this city would become a part of his Divine Kingdom.
Even with only a tiny fraction of the True Creator's power, it gave the Evil God' Spawn an ability comparable to the Pathway Sequence 4 of the "Secret Supplicant"! His birth also filled the entire reception hall with the power of filth and corruption!
Moreover, he was the "Evil God' Spawn," a near-complete mythical creature with a status much higher than Sequence 4, causing signs of loss of control just from being seen by Hobert and the others.
Hobert was the first to recover. He turned his head away, not needing to look to deeply feel the malice from the Evil God' Spawn.
"This... this doesn't quite match the original description!"
However, now wasn't the time to be bewildered. Run! With just Megose's words, they could delay her for a while, but facing a genuine Evil God' Spawn was a completely different level of opponent!
As soon as this thought crossed his mind, he suddenly realized that his shadow had come alive, standing up and attempting to snatch the "Teleportation Statue" from his hand!
The shadows of the other three people also came to life. Dunn's shadow didn't try to grab the "Saint Selena's Ashes" but instead twisted its own head, aligning it parallel with its shoulders. Dunn's neck also suffered a heavy blow, unable to support itself any longer, falling to the ground against the wall.
Leonard struggled to free himself from his shadow's entanglement while raising the hand holding the Blood Vessel Thief: "Blaspheme Curse...!" This was the ability he had just stolen!
"Hahaha~"
But just as Leonard opened his mouth, a sharp childlike laughter interrupted his "curse," causing all four people to feel as if a sledgehammer had struck their chests simultaneously, each spitting out fresh blood.
Dunn used his strong willpower to continue using "Saint Selena's Ashes," but this time the tentacles seemed uncontrollable, not daring to approach the Evil God' Spawn.
At the same time, Dunn's shadow arm turned into spikes, piercing through his chest, blood immediately spreading across Dunn's front.
Then the Evil God' Spawn seemed to change targets: "Die!"
Leonard seemed to have been struck by a tremendous force and was sent flying into the wall.
However, in the nick of time, Hobert moved him next to himself, but Leonard was already pale and fainted.
They were completely outmatched!
This couldn't go on like this!
Hobert retreated to the corner: "Buy me a few seconds!"
Dunn caught the blood flowing from his chest with the ash box. The tentacles "boldly" entangled the Evil God' Spawn.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Klein shouted, "Light!" He threw out the second "Flaring Sun Charm."
The Evil God' Spawn suddenly said, "Light, shine upon the earth!"
Just as it seemed the fireballs in the sky were about to fall, the light ball flashed a few times and exploded in mid-air, truly shining upon the earth.
The Evil God' Spawn easily broke free from the tentacles and attempted to counterattack using his ability to "Blasphemy Curse," but now it was completely ineffective against Hobert.
The Evil God' Spawn was more agile than a monkey, which caused Hobert's two attacks to miss.
It was quite embarrassing to think about it. He, the magnificent "Creator," currently only had these two types of presentable powers, and their attack range wasn't very large.
Also, because Hobert had to spend one or two seconds gathering strength for each attack, his attack speed wasn't fast.
After a moment's thought, Hobert had an idea. He reached out and summoned the black eye that had been trapped in the stone box: "Take a look at this good thing for you!"
Using his spiritual energy, he activated the power of the black eye in front of him and directed its power toward the Evil God' Spawn.
This was equivalent to creating a path to the "Knowledge Moor" and placing it in front of the Evil God' Spawn. This time, he couldn't dodge it, standing there immediately, deep black pupils reflecting a giant eye composed of flames.
Hobert used the maximum extent of his "Power of Disorder" that he could mobilize to envelop the Spawn of the Evil God.
Crack!
The Evil God' Spawn exploded like a shattered tomato.
Hobert swept around with his "True Vision" and found no lingering souls or anything like that. The Evil God' Spawn was completely dead.
This not only made him sigh: indeed, a status that overwhelmed everything else; without the "Nation of Disorder," he would have had no chance against the Evil God' Spawn.

chapters.title: Chapter 150 - 150: Unexpected Enemies (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
The figure of the "Creator" vanished, and Klein faintly heard Hobert say, "Praise be to the 'Creator.'"
Klein breathed a sigh of relief; things were finally resolved.
Turning to check on the other teammates, Hobert seemed to be in the best condition, having not suffered severe injuries. Leonard appeared to have merely fainted, but Captain Dunn's condition was dire; blood continued to flow from his chest, pooling beneath him.
Dunn Smith turned his head towards Klein, a gentle and relaxed smile on his pale face. "Tingen City is saved!"
Klein was about to struggle to his feet to use ceremonial magic to heal the Captain when a pale hand pierced through his chest.
Not even Hobert had noticed when the one-eyed Ince Zangwill appeared.
As Klein stared at the pale hand, consciousness slipping away, he collapsed to the ground. From there, he saw Hobert holding a statue, moving Captain Dunn and "Saint Selena's Ashes" to his side. "Ince Zangwill!"
As Klein's vision darkened, he lost all consciousness.
Ince paused briefly, surprised that this Sequence 8 actually recognized him. "One troublemaker down, one more to go."
Though he had failed to advance, he could still use the abilities of Sequence 5, "Gatekeeper."
Hobert felt a chilling sensation creeping in. He immediately activated his spirit vision and indeed saw a towering spirit next to Ince, with another hovering in mid-air.
Hobert noticed Dunn's eyes losing their sparkle and swiftly made a decision. He tossed "Saint Selena's Ashes" to Ince. "Take it and go."
Without hesitation, Ince picked up the ashes and left.
It wasn't fear of Hobert that drove him, but the potential arrival of support from headquarters could happen at any moment. He didn't even have time now to settle his score with Hobert.
"Ince Zangwill!"
Upon hearing the voice, Ince shuddered all over, as if recalling his most terrifying memory. He had arrived too late.
Following the voice, Hobert looked towards the door where a clean-cut, deep-eyed old man stood. He was the support rushing from Backlund's St. Samuel's Cathedral, Archbishop Anthony Stevenson.
If Daly hadn't insisted on seeing the Archbishop, Anthony might have just received the plea for help from Tingen City.
Hobert, seeing this elderly figure who was likely a saint, finally relaxed a bit. He bowed slightly to the Archbishop and hurried to prepare the ritual to save Captain Dunn.
Ince stood there, with no intention to flee. He knew he couldn't escape from Anthony's grasp.
At that moment, Ins's quill, tucked at his waist, suddenly leapt out and rapidly wrote on the floor: "Just as Ince Zangwill was trembling in fear, a 'Frenzied Mage' passing through the reception hall was drawn to the large tree."
"0-08" was even less willing than Ince to be caught by the Church of Evernight. Its desire to escape surpassed Ince's, and crucially, it wasn't intimidated by the fear emanating from Anthony. So it wrote swiftly, completing the sentence before Anthony could react.
A force of sleep and horror emanated from Anthony as he prepared to seal "0-08" with his own abilities.
However, at that moment, an enormous pressure suddenly descended from outside, forcing him to temporarily halt. A section of the reception hall's wall had collapsed, and through the breach walked a gray-haired gentleman who appeared weather-beaten, as if he had been traveling.
He knew of Anthony's presence but stood at the breach, seemingly observing yet also waiting for an opportunity.
Hobert's hands trembled violently as he felt a deep-seated tremor from within. It was no ordinary shaking. The "story" written by "0-08" had been fulfilled once again. This gray-haired elder was a Sequence 3 "Frenzied Mage" of the Pathway of the "Lawyer" approach!
"The Black Emperor's" suppression was not as potent as the "Death" pathway, but saints could easily overwhelm "low sequences," and angels could easily overwhelm "mid sequences."
This "Lawyer" pathway saint stood there, rendering Hobert powerless.
Inside the reception hall, the intimidating aura of fear and the maddening aura clashed and tugged. The mental pressure on Hobert was immense.
He glanced at the corner of the "Frenzied Mage's" eye, struggling against his body's shivering. "If, if you've come for this tree, then, then please take it away."
The standoff continued, but "Horror Bishop" Anthony stepped back, clearly indicating, "Take it if you want."
For him, sealing "0-08" and capturing Ince Zangwill were now the top priorities.
As for this tree, he could sense that while its approach wasn't low, its power was dissipating rapidly. It could likely only be used once, or a few times, as a mystical item.
Hobert's words provided a way out for both Sequence 3 individuals, neither of whom wanted to engage in combat.
The "Frenzied Mage" remained wary of Anthony while approaching the tree. His hand touched the tree, causing it to immediately shrink into an ordinary black sandalwood.
He could feel the order power filled within the sandalwood and its high rank.
The "Frenzied Mage," now with the black sandalwood, bowed slightly to Anthony in thanks, then turned and left. In one step, he was on the street outside; in two steps, he was on the main road; in three steps, he had vanished.
Anthony gave Hobert a deep look before chasing after Ince, who had taken advantage of the chaos to escape.
Hobert's spirit and astral bodies had been repeatedly squeezed and pulled today, leaving him exhausted. His wounds continued to bleed, soaking his clothes with blood, leaving bloody footprints wherever he walked.
But now was not the time to rest. He mustered his strength and continued preparing the ritual.
Suddenly, he seemed to sense something and hurried to check on Dunn. Dunn's pupils were dilated.
With a gentle smile on his face, Dunn faced outside the reception hall, as if he had just scrutinized Tingen City under the sunlight.
Hobert finally couldn't bear it any longer. "Ince, Quill, 'Frenzied Mage'! Damn you all!"
He had just been about to slam the floor forcefully when he suddenly remembered, "The Black Emperor" could find even the loopholes in death!
Hobert's eyes widened suddenly. He still had a way!
Continuing to set up the altar, he changed the central symbol to represent the "Creator" in the shadows of order.
As he was about to sacrifice himself, he saw the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Spawn" not far away, grabbed it, endured the whispers and corruption it brought, and placed it before the altar.
Looking at Dunn with a gentle smile again, Hobert said, "O Creator in the Shadow of Order..."
