chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 170: Become a "Briber"
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Christian added, "The Tudor family has three surviving bloodlines, and we are one of them. Before the War of the Four Emperors, our branch had been consuming the 'Arbitrator' pathway's potion.
"So, after hiding our tracks for a while and reappearing in public, no one suspected our connection to the Blood Emperor."
The combination of Christian and Rex made Hobert feel strange: "I heard that the Trusnsoest family and the Tudor family don't have a good relationship."
During the United Empire era, Tudor and Trusnsoest, the Sequence 1s of the 'Black Emperor' pathway, both faced the pressure of Solomon's resurrection. Trusnsoest obtained the support of the Six Gods and was promoted to the True God Justiciar of the adjacent pathway.
This led to the immediate collapse of the joint government, and Tudor had no choice but to be promoted to the 'Red Priest' of the non-adjacent pathway.
In theory, the two should be opponents.
"That was a long time ago," Christian said with a helpless smile. "Now, both emperors have fallen for over a thousand years, and our primary goal now is survival. In the face of survival, some past grievances can be completely abandoned.
"Just like back then, for the sake of survival and family interests, two Sequence 1s of the same pathway could actually carry out joint governance."
Hobert didn't continue the topic: "The problem I'm facing now is finding the source of the family curse and solving the curse. Mr. Rex's method may not be useful."
Christian nodded: "That's right."
Hobert pondered for a moment and then asked: "What about Mr. Rex's remaining Beyonder characteristics?"
According to Christian's meaning, Rex was a Sequence 3 during his lifetime. If he had his remaining Beyonder characteristics, it would save Hobert a lot of effort after he became a demigod.
"Can't find them."
"Can't find them?"
"Yes," Christian said. "At that time, Rex went to solve the family curse alone. When we found him, he was already dead, and the characteristics were gone."
"Could it be that someone murdered Mr. Rex?"
"No," Christian said. "Although there were traces of fighting at the scene, no trace of any enemy was left behind. This is the result I have repeatedly confirmed. It's like, it's like Rex was fighting with himself."
Hobert frowned and said, "That's strange, where could the characteristics go?"
"According to your ancestors' records," Christian said, "before, when Sequence 3s wanted to solve the family curse, their characteristics disappeared without exception."
"This..." Hobert scratched his head, this is really strange.
Christian sighed: "Now you know your father's good intentions, right? There are still too many mysteries about your family's curse."
Hobert nodded, but didn't take it too seriously.
He now has the "Nation of Disorder" in his control, and he believes that even if he doesn't take the initiative to solve these mysteries, these mysteries are likely to come to him directly.
"I still insist on my choice," Hobert took out the Beyonder characteristics of "Briber" and auxiliary materials: "Father, do you have red wine here?"
The auxiliary materials require 80 milliliters of red wine.
"Yes," Christian rummaged through the wine cabinet and found a bottle of red wine and handed it to Hobert.
Then he took out tools such as measuring cylinders, balances, and beakers to supervise Hobert's preparation of the potion.
Hobert compared the potion recipe, first put in 5 drops each of golden mandala and black mandala juice, then dripped in 4 drops of colored psychedelic grass essential oil, and poured in 80 milliliters of red wine.
Because there was psychedelic grass essential oil, only after putting in the auxiliary materials, a little bit of magical mist appeared in the beaker.
Then Hobert put in the characteristic of "Briber", the mist immediately became larger, and quickly disappeared after a few seconds, leaving only a brown jelly-like potion.
Pouring the potion into the cup without leaving a drop, Hobert seemed to vaguely hear a very tempting voice from the potion.
Gathering his courage, he drank it all in one gulp.
The moment the potion fell into his stomach, Hobert immediately felt his mind seem to fly away from his body.
He seemed to see the night sky full of stars that seemed to be blinking.
Hobert quickly gathered his spirit. The previous role-playing played a role at this time. His spiritual body and astral body were highly consistent with the etheric body representing the body, allowing him to quickly regain control of his body.
Immediately afterwards, he felt the potion transforming his astral body and spiritual body. He didn't feel much pain, but his spirit was very heavy.
If he hadn't fully digested the potion before, it would be very dangerous to advance to Sequence 7, and his spiritual body and astral body might be overwhelmed.
This wonderful process lasted about a minute, and Hobert gradually regained consciousness. He immediately felt that his spiritual body and body had undergone different degrees of change.
"Smoother than expected," Christian smiled and said, "Feel the new abilities of 'Briber'!"
Hobert radiated his spirituality and quickly realized that he now possesses the ability "Bribe"!
The process of "Bribe" is to give the opponent something, regardless of whether the opponent is willing to accept it, and even the thing given does not need to touch the opponent to complete the "Bribe" process.
As long as you "Bribe" once, you can continuously use Beyonder abilities on the opponent.
If the opponent willingly accepts the "Bribe", then the effect of the "Bribe" will be strengthened.
Sequence 7's "Bribe" has four uses: weaken, charm, arrogance, and connect.
"Weaken" is the most widely used. Whether it is physical attack, Beyonder ability attack, or mental attack, as well as the opponent's defense, speed, etc., it will cause a substantial weakening.
It can be said to be a "universal skill".
"Charm" is to make the target have a strong liking for Hobert, making it difficult to have hostile intentions. If the conditions are right, the charmed target has a very small probability of attacking their companions.
If it is a strange enemy, this ability will have unexpected effects. If it is an enemy who already knows each other well, it will be difficult to use this ability to influence the other party.
In addition, Hobert's personal charm has increased a lot, and his remarks will be easier to convince people and easier to gain people's support.
"Arrogance" is to make the enemy proud, arrogant, and reduce the other party's mind, causing the other party to make misjudgments.
"Connect" is to allow Hobert to establish a connection and association with others or opponents. If used in hostile situations, the effect is similar to "Charm".
If used in ordinary times, it will make the other party feel that they have a great relationship with Hobert, it is easy to find common ground, and it is easy to become good friends.

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 171: The Help of “The Nation of Disorder”
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Besides "Bribe", "Distortion" has been enhanced and can distort the language and actions of enemies, which can now be used as an offensive ability.
Physical fitness has also been strengthened, and the berserk state can now last for more than an hour.
Most importantly, spirituality has greatly increased. Now, Hobert can fully exert the power of the "Psychological Spoon".
And there is no need to save the "Spirit Necklace". It is estimated that spirituality will not be exhausted even after ten or eight consecutive psychic sessions.
It can be seen that spirituality has been qualitatively improved from Sequence 8 to Sequence 7.
However, the ability to find loopholes and summarize laws has not been significantly enhanced.
After understanding his new abilities, Hobert left the study and returned to his room.
It was still early, so he didn't go to sleep immediately, but sat on the chair and considered how to act as a "Briber."
The new abilities that appeared gave him a lot of inspiration. The purpose of bribery is to make more friends and fewer enemies.
And because the ability to find loopholes and summarize laws has not been significantly enhanced, does it mean that the process of bribery is to actively create loopholes and actively change the rules?
Does this indicate that the acting of "Bribers" should be more proactive and more active?
Hobert also thought of his thoughts on how to act as a "Barbarian". His thinking at the time was very successful. It was because he followed the acting rule of "not obeying the order of civilization is a barbarian" that his potion was digested so quickly.
And Hobert has realized that the core content of the entire "Lawyer" pathway is inseparable from order and rules.
After association, Hobert realized that the acting elements of "Bribers" are likely to be: actively making rules appear as loopholes that are beneficial to oneself.
Hobert decided to take the initiative to act according to this rule when he has the opportunity to see if the potion will loosen.
Then he locked the door and entered the "Nation of Disorder" to see what changes have taken place in the "Nation of Disorder" after becoming Sequence 7.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert first saw the blurry figure trapped by him in the pool, which became clearer, and he could already see the face shape: it was a handsome young man.
Hobert strengthened the seal of the pool on this figure. The power of this figure has indeed been strengthened, but the "Nation of Disorder" is Hobert's home field, and he can still easily seal it.
Then Hobert began to seriously consider this question, whose projection is this blurry figure?
Could it be a projection of the "Night Emperor"?
Thinking of this, Hobert shook his head, feeling that it was unlikely to be the "Night Emperor", because the reasoning didn't make sense: if it was the "Night Emperor", why would he use curses to torment his descendants?
Hobert also felt that he couldn't be so arbitrary, because there might be some operations contained in it that he didn't know at all, such as whether this would be a backhand for the "Night Emperor's" resurrection?
After becoming a True God, it becomes very difficult to kill, because they are already the order itself in some aspects, or existences outside the order in some aspects.
"Life and death" are concepts that only humans have, and these concepts may not be able to encompass gods that already have abstract meaning.
After entering the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert found that he had some memories about the "Night Emperor" in his mind. In these memories, the "Night Emperor's" experience was similar to Christian's description.
What Christian did not describe was the part about how to become a "Great Old One". After the fall of the resurrected Solomon, the "Night Emperor" probably obtained the uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway and at least one Sequence 1 characteristic.
The "Night Emperor" was already a "Justiciar", and with the uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" and a Sequence 1, he only needed the "Sefirah" to become a "Great Old One".
So, did the fall of the "Night Emperor" have a direct relationship with his efforts to become a "Great Old One"?
For example, the six gods at the time were unwilling to see an existence stronger than them, such as the "Night Emperor" being corrupted when searching for the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert suddenly thought that he had a close connection with the "Nation of Disorder" as soon as he crossed over. Was it because the original owner was surnamed Trunsoest?
He also recalled that the uniqueness of the "Judges" pathway, the "Trunsoest Brass Book", was contaminated by the "Nation of Disorder".
But the problem lies here. If it is said that the "Trunsoest Brass Book" was contaminated by an Outer God, or contaminated by the "Sefirah Castle" or the "Chaos Sea", it makes perfect sense.
Why was it contaminated by the "Nation of Disorder"? The "Nation of Disorder" is also the "Sefirah" of the "Justiciar" pathway. What kind of contamination can it cause to the uniqueness of the "Judges" pathway?
Or is there another hidden story in it? For example, the "Night Emperor" was caught in some trap of the "Uncertain Mist"? So the "Night Emperor" was contaminated, and the six gods had to kill the "Night Emperor"?
If it is a head-on confrontation, the "Uncertain Mist" may not be the opponent of the "Night Emperor", but His position as a "Great Old One" is there, and it is very easy to plot against the "Night Emperor", and the "Night Emperor" is difficult to resist such a plot.
Thinking of these, Hobert patted his forehead. These questions are not something that he, a Sequence 7, can understand. Let's wait for new clues in the future before thinking about it.
Hobert sat on the "Iron Throne" and radiated his spirituality. First of all, he felt that he had the ability to "Distort" in the "Nation of Disorder". The level of this ability is very high, and it can distort some natural laws, such as distorting a small area of midsummer into severe winter.
As for "distorting" the intentions and wishes of enemies, etc., that is even easier.
Like the other two abilities, "order" and "chaos", "distortion" has a time limit. It does not mean that after "distorting" the midsummer of a place into a severe winter, it will always become a severe winter. After a few minutes, the power of distortion will gradually disappear.
However, the consequences caused by "distortion" cannot be restored. For example, after it becomes severe winter, many plants are frozen to death, that is really frozen to death.
Then Hobert immediately felt that the area he could control had become much larger, and the lakes, forests, and grasslands at the foot of the mountain were within his control.
And he found that in his controlled area, there were some special black rocks, and the composition of these stones was similar to that of the "Teleportation Statue".
Hobert got up from the "Iron Throne", took a step, and came to the location of the black rock at the foot of the mountain. Picking up a stone, Hobert immediately felt the ability of the rock: distortion.
And it is a very high-ranking distortion that can even distort Beyonder characteristics.
The effective attack range is three meters, which can "distort" natural laws such as temperature and mechanics within these three meters, and even cause the enemy to show signs of losing control by distorting the Beyonder characteristics of the enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 172: The Fork with Healing Technique
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert decided to name these black rocks "Disorder Stones" because he felt that the best ability of these rocks was to distort the Beyonder characteristics of enemies, causing them to lose control to varying degrees.
As for the power of the "Disorder Stones," it is directly linked to Hobert's sequence. For example, if he is currently Sequence 7, then if used against Sequence 8, the opponent has a 30% probability of immediately losing control. Even if they don't immediately lose control, they will basically lose their combat effectiveness.
If used against Sequence 9, there is a 40% probability of causing them to immediately lose control.
If Hobert advances to Sequence 6, then when used against Sequence 7, the enemy will have a 30% probability of immediately losing control, and Sequence 8 will have a 40% probability of immediately losing control, and so on.
When used against enemies of the same sequence, unless they are individuals from a pathway that was prone to losing control, there is only a small probability of causing the enemy to lose control. The main effect is to increase the pressure on the enemy's spiritual body and astral body, making them very weak, and even halving the power of their Beyonder powers.
When used against enemies of a higher sequence than Hobert, it can also put enormous pressure on the enemy. If the opponent is not in a good state, there is a high probability that they will make misjudgments or become mentally confused, creating more opportunities for Hobert.
The method of using the "Disorder Stones" is very simple, similar to using charms. Set the incantation in advance, infuse spirituality, and then throw the "Disorder Stone" within a three-meter radius of the enemy to immediately distort their Beyonder characteristics.
If there are multiple enemies within a three-meter radius, it can attack multiple targets simultaneously, making it Hobert's first "group attack skill."
Moreover, Hobert can control the number of times each "Disorder Stone" is used, ranging from one to eight times.
For Hobert, this is a very practical weapon, equivalent to having an extra Beyonder ability that is difficult to defend against.
However, he felt that he should change the appearance of the "Disorder Stones." Throwing stones at enemies during a fight seems like something only children would do.
It should be packaged as a hidden weapon to look more like something.
The first thing Hobert thought of was Tarot cards, but square hidden weapons are not as easy to use as round ones, except for bricks, of course.
But if the "Disorder Stones" were really made into the shape of bricks, firstly, he wouldn't be able to carry many, and secondly, only hooligans and ruffians would use them in fights.
It would be inappropriate to use bricks after being promoted to Baron or Earl.
Therefore, Hobert finally decided to make the "Disorder Stones" round, about the size of his palm. Originally, he wanted to add a symbol representing the "Creator," but he was worried that it would expose his connection with the "Creator."
But a plain round pebble looked very tasteless.
After thinking for a while, Hobert decided to engrave the Emperor's pattern from the Tarot cards on the pebble in relief. Even if someone picked it up in the future, they would only associate it with the mysterious organization "Tarot Club," and "Mr. Fool" would take the blame.
As for the number of uses, considering the issue of recycling, Hobert felt that it would be most convenient to use them as charms, so he could carry several on his person.
Back on the "Iron Throne," Hobert suddenly thought that the next time he entered the "Nation of Disorder," he should bring the "Psychological Spoon" with him to give himself enough psychological cues that information about the Outer Gods could only be recalled in the "Nation of Disorder."
The same should be done with information about Adam. The protection of the "Nation of Disorder" for Hobert is more like a "mechanical" protection.
Information about the Outer Gods would cause Hobert's pollution, so the "Nation of Disorder" would automatically help Hobert block it.
However, Adam is still only the "King of Angels," and the "Nation of Disorder" only blocks partial information about Adam.
Logically speaking, the more one knows about Adam, the more Adam will know about Hobert.
The information that the "Nation of Disorder" does not block may allow Adam to know of Hobert's existence, but Hobert was only a Sequence 8 before, so Adam probably wouldn't take him seriously.
For safety's sake, it's safer to "leave" most of the memories about Adam in the "Nation of Disorder," especially as Hobert's sequence increases, it will attract Adam's attention.
But this operation cannot be done at home, lest Christian notice it again.
Finally, Hobert finished building the hall that he had "built" halfway before. From the outside, it was a hall with a clear Qin and Han style, dignified and domineering.
Back in the real world, a little tired, Hobert meditated to gather his spirituality and gradually fell asleep.
The next morning, after Hobert had breakfast and picked up his cane to go out, he immediately felt something: because he had advanced to Sequence 7, the power of the "Tree of Order" had increased by half.
Originally, it could grow into a tree with a crown diameter of more than ten meters, but now it can grow to more than twenty meters, and all the Beyonder powers of the "Tree of Order" have also been enhanced.
"Hobert, let's take a carriage to work," Christian said from behind.
Hobert came back to his senses: "Okay."
After getting into the carriage, Christian took out a fork from his bag. The shape of this fork is exactly the same as an ordinary fork on the dining table.
He said: "Your biological mother left you two things in total, one is that spoon, and the other is this fork.
"Before, your spirituality was not enough to use two 'mid-sequence' extraordinary items at the same time, so I only gave you that spoon. After becoming Sequence 7, your spirituality has greatly increased, so I'm giving you the fork today."
Hobert quickly took it and cursed in his heart that it was still tableware. He injected spirituality into the fork and immediately felt the ability of this fork: healing and stitching.
Also two very practical abilities, Hobert judged that the Beyonder characteristics of the fork are likely to come from a "Druid" of the "Planter" pathway.
Because "healing" is the signature skill of the "Druid", and "stitching" is the signature skill of the "Doctor" of the "Harvester" pathway.
"Stitching" can stitch severed limbs and large areas of external wounds, making the severed limbs as flexible as before, and healing large areas of external wounds in a short time.
The use of "healing" is even more extensive, external injuries, internal injuries, diseases, and even psychological trauma and astral body trauma can be treated!
Christian said: "The negative effect of this magical item is that nails and hair grow very fast!"
Hobert sighed again: Is this also called a negative effect?
The two magical items left by the original owner's mother are definitely good things! Compared to those life-threatening negative effects, this negative effect is almost negligible.
Christian continued: "Your biological mother said at the time that she originally wanted to create a magical item with 'travel' abilities for you, but 'Travelers' are too difficult to catch."
Hobert almost exclaimed, "My mother knows me best!" He now wanted to get a magical item with "travel" abilities.
But this fork is also good, and it also plays a life-saving role.
Since it has the ability of "healing", Hobert named the fork "Fork of Healing" in his heart.
Then he asked: "Mr. Rex, uh, I mean, didn't my biological father leave me anything?"
"He did," Christian said with a smile: "But according to his will, I can't give it to you now."

Hobert still sat in the law firm for more than ten minutes before asking Barton for leave, and would come back to work next Tuesday.
Barton thought Hobert was a little tired from handling the previous case, so he approved his leave slip.
Leaving the firm, Hobert first returned to 192 Blanka Street to complete the deal reached at the previous "Justice League" gathering.
Xio and Fors were both there. As soon as he entered the door, Xio told Hobert that Sheriff Rotol, who had previously brought people to break down the door, had sent 12 pounds in cash.
Hobert didn't make things difficult for the sheriff and threw the IOU into the fireplace.
Xio had already found someone to repair the door, which only cost 3 Soli.
So Hobert divided the compensation he received from Rotol into four parts, three parts of 30 pounds each, one for Hobert, Xio, and Fors.
Hobert gave the remaining 9 pounds and 17 Soli to Fors, asking her to use the money to improve everyone's food.
Then, Hobert went upstairs to retrieve the Beyonder characteristics, returned to his bedroom, and first used the method of sacrificing himself to bring the "Psychological Spoon" into the "Nation of Disorder", sealing most of the memories about "Adam".
Then, he used the method of praying to himself to bring the Beyonder characteristics of "Sheriff", "Trickmaster", and "Arbiter" from the "Nation of Disorder" to the real world.
Back downstairs, Hobert gave Xio and Fors a considerable discount, selling each Beyonder characteristic to them for 550 pounds, two Beyonder characteristics earned Hobert 1100 pounds.
Xio and Fors had already prepared the auxiliary materials, and the two of them successively prepared potions and took them.
Xio's process of taking the potion went smoothly, but Fors's process of taking the potion was a bit thrilling. As soon as she took the potion, it seemed that there were poisonous snakes crawling around under her skin, making her look completely different.
It took Fors three or four minutes to basically control the signs of losing control.
She usually rarely acts as an Apprentice, so the "Apprentice" potion was not completely digested.
This was something Hobert didn't expect and didn't have time to remind her.
Fortunately, she only took a Sequence 8 potion. Even if the Sequence 9 potion is not completely digested, it will only increase the mental burden, or it will lay hidden dangers for future loss of control.
If you can make good use of meditation and other methods, you can gradually control the power of the potion, but if you suddenly encounter a major mental blow, or suffer too serious injuries, it will still be easy to lose control.
Hobert poured a glass of wine for Fors, who was quite frightened: "Before you completely master the power of 'Trickmaster', don't continue to advance."
Fors wiped the fine sweat from her forehead and took two gulps of wine before saying with some lingering fear: "I have been an 'Apprentice' for so long, why is it so dangerous to take a higher sequence potion?"
"No," Hobert said meaningfully: "You haven't been an Apprentice for a day!"
Fors sat on the chair and thought, she seemed to understand what Hobert meant, but she also seemed to understand nothing.
Hobert simply made it clearer: "I suggest you find a restaurant, learn cooking for a while, or learn something else, in short, really be an Apprentice."
Xio, who was always slow to react, understood before Fors: "Hobert, do you mean that the name of the potion is a trick to better master Beyonder abilities?"
She immediately thought that she had been doing "Arbiter", so she had no resistance when she took the Sequence 8 potion.
Hobert nodded: "Accurately speaking, it is the key to avoiding loss of control!"
He said seriously: "This is very advanced knowledge. You can communicate with each other, and you can ask me if you don't understand, but you are not allowed to spread it."
Xio and Fors nodded immediately, indicating that they understood.
After Fors recovered, the three of them took a taxi carriage to Viscount Glaint's mansion, handed the potion formula and the main material of "Arbiter" to Carl, and completed the last transaction at the "Justice League" gathering.
This transaction earned Hobert 320 pounds and Xio 300 pounds.
Hobert told Xio and Fors that he was going on a business trip and would be back tomorrow, and then left in a taxi carriage first.
Xio and Fors watched Hobert's carriage go away, and Fors sighed: "What should I do? We owe Hobert more and more."
Xio smiled helplessly: "Maybe Hobert doesn't care too much about these."
"He can not care, but we can't pretend not to know." Fors secretly made up her mind that if Hobert asked her for help one day, she would do her best to help!
...
Hobert didn't go to the train station immediately, but went to the bank first. His current savings have reached 2834 pounds and 7 Soli!
Hobert didn't feel safe keeping this money on him or storing it somewhere, so it was better to deposit it in the bank.
After depositing 2800 pounds into the bank, Hobert had 34 pounds and 7 Soli in cash on him.
If it didn't involve large transactions such as buying a house or a car, 34 pounds in cash would be enough for him to spend for a while.
On the train to Tingen, Hobert was still sighing: It's not easy to make money.
His goal is to save enough 12,000 pounds. With this money, he will have the opportunity to buy it when he encounters items with "travel" abilities.
He also thought that Audrey and Alger still owed him a sum of money, and he must remember to collect the debt at the next "Tarot Gathering".
And the reason he went to Tingen today was to help "Mr. Fool", he had been resting for so long, it was time to get up.
...
Whoosh~
On the train to Winter County, a young man with black hair, green eyes, and a poetic aura was seriously reading the headline of today's newspaper.
After a while, he put down the newspaper, looked at the snow-capped mountains gradually becoming clearer outside the window, as if he was talking to himself, and as if he was saying to the snow-capped mountains: "No wonder I couldn't even attend the funerals of Captain and Klein, it turns out you have more important things."
He put the newspaper on the chair, and the headline was the news that Hobert had won the "Work Injury Compensation Case".
And this young man reading the newspaper was Leonard, who was going to the Holy Cathedral for training. He looked at the sky, as if recalling the scene when he and Hobert faced the offspring of the evil god together.
Then he looked at the snow-capped mountains in front of him, as if feeling the long road ahead for the first time.
...
At about two o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert arrived in Tingen. Seeing that it was still early, he went to visit Ulysses.
Nothing happened, just chatted for a while and gave some small gifts.
Hobert has completely adapted to the way of doing things in this world and is actively building his own network of relationships.
Hobert's visit made Ulysses very happy and prepared to hold another dinner for Hobert. Hobert quickly said that he was just passing by and would leave in a while.
When parting, Ulysses said: "Elizabeth has always wanted to communicate with you, but she feels a little abrupt. Write her a letter when you have time. Her friend's relatives recently passed away, which makes her a little sad. Help me to enlighten her."
Hobert was slightly startled: "Okay."
He asked for Elizabeth's mailing address before leaving, and then went straight to the cemetery.
He had previously learned the general location of Dunn and Klein's graves from correspondence with Leonard.
After finding Klein's tombstone, Hobert quietly waited for the arrival of night.

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 174 Klein is Resurrected in Full Blood (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Dusk descended, draping the cemetery in twilight.
Hobart placed two bouquets of flowers in front of the tombstones of Dunn and Klein respectively, these two bouquets were purely for cover.
If he didn't bring flowers, people would definitely wonder why this young man was coming to the cemetery.
Hobart couldn't very well say, "I'm waiting for a friend, he'll come out after dark."
Waiting for what friend?
Saying such things in a cemetery was just asking for a beating.
Hobart looked at Klein's tombstone, but was thinking about other things in his heart.
After tonight, he and Klein could be considered friends who knew "all" of each other's secrets.
Klein "knew" that Hobart was a believer of the "Creator", and Hobart "knew" Klein's secret of resurrection.
Hobart was working hard for some future plans, waiting for "The Fool" to develop in the future, Hobart would still need him to first acknowledge and support the new "Black Emperor".
Although that step was still very, very far away, some things had to be prepared in advance.
Just as he was thinking this, Hobart suddenly felt as if some unknown change had occurred around him, when he turned around to check, a middle-aged man appeared on the road not far behind him.
The middle-aged man wore a silk top hat, a black formal suit, was of medium build, with bronze skin and soft features.
Hobart's first reaction was, when did he appear? Why didn't his spirituality detect it at all?
Hobart's second reaction was, could this be Mr. Azik?
Looking more closely, bronze skin, vicissitudes in his eyes, and there was indeed a black mole below his right ear, that's right.
Hobart nodded slightly towards Mr. Azik, at this time rushing up to call out "Mr. Azik" would likely complicate things.
Azik gently tipped his hat as a return greeting, he placed the flowers in his hand in front of Klein's grave, and then asked Hobart: "Are you also a friend of Klein's?"
Hobart replied: "A colleague."
Azik seemed to understand something: "He was a very good young man."
"He was also a very good colleague." Hobart sighed: "He wasn't married yet, hadn't enjoyed a good life yet."
After Klein crawled out of the grave, he completely said goodbye to the life of an ordinary person.
Buried here, is Klein's life as an ordinary person.
Azik also sighed: "Death is the most helpless magic, it is in front of people from the moment they are born, but we have no choice but to approach it step by step, touch it."
He glanced at Klein's tombstone: "If only I was in Tingen at the time. It was only a few minutes late, and a living life became a cold stone monument."
There was silence in front of the stone tablet for a while, Azik then said to the tombstone: "I'm leaving Tingen City, I'll come back to see you when I have time."
He reminded Hobart: "Young man, it's getting late."
Hobart nodded: "I know, I'll stay a little longer before leaving."
Azik "hmm"ed, and quickly left, soon disappearing into the twilight.
Hobart was not in a hurry to establish contact with Azik, he was only Sequence 7 now, knowing too much would be problematic instead.
First get acquainted, and it won't be too late to establish a more solid connection when there is a chance to meet in the future.
The waiting time was always long, the twilight gradually disappeared, and stars appeared in the sky.
There were no longer any people offering sacrifices in the cemetery, only the calls of a few night insects.
Hobart wasn't worried about encountering zombies or ghosts here, because the people buried here had already been purified by priests.
It was just a bit cold, it was already autumn, Tingen City was in the north of Backlund, and the temperature was colder after nightfall than in Backlund.
Hobart looked at his pocket watch again and again, the time finally came to be past ten o'clock in the evening.
Dong dong~
There was movement behind the tombstone.
Pfft~
A pale hand stretched out from the dirt.
Hobart didn't care about the dirt on Klein's hand, he grabbed the hand and pulled Klein out of the coffin.
Fortunately, the customs of the Loen Kingdom did not have the procedure of building a grave mound, otherwise it would have taken Klein a lot of effort to climb out of the coffin.
Klein sat in the coffin somewhat dazed, he first saw Hobart under the starlight: "Spawn of the Evil God..."
His memory was still at the moment when he had just killed the spawn of the Evil God.
"Already dead." Hobart said.
"I," Klein suddenly thought: "I'm also dead..."
"In the middle of the night, and in a cemetery, don't say such things!"
Klein quickly pulled open his clothes, and only after seeing that the wound on his chest had healed did he realize that he had been resurrected again, but this time the resurrection took longer than the last time.
Suddenly, Klein looked at Hobart in shock.
"Don't look at me like that, I also thought you were dead at the time." Hobart said.
"Then you, why are you here?"
"Guess."
Klein immediately understood, it was the "Creator", it must have been the "Creator" who told Hobart that he could be resurrected.
Seeing that Klein "guessed correctly", Hobart then said: "Get up, say goodbye to Dunn, we should all embark on new journeys."
"Captain..." Klein looked at the tombstone not far away, a strong grief filled his heart.
He came out of the coffin, standing in front of Dunn's tombstone as if talking to himself, and also as if talking to Dunn's tombstone: "Captain, that day you said you 'brought' Kenley into the dream, and also said that you couldn't bear to sacrifice your teammates, so you hoped to see them often in the dream..."
Klein paused, shook his head and sighed: "I don't even know what I am now, maybe just an evil spirit crawling out of hell, wanting revenge."
As he spoke, he suddenly couldn't continue, tears streamed down his face, and finally, he choked out: "Captain, we also can't bear to part with you."
Hobart patted Klein on the shoulder, saying meaningfully: "This is a world full of mystery, anything is possible."
Klein didn't quite hear what Hobart said, but he knew that now was not the time to stand here and cry.
"Let's go." Hobart said: "We'd better leave here a few blocks before taking a taxi carriage, otherwise it might scare the coachman."
The two of them left the cemetery one after the other in silence.
After walking out two blocks, they found a taxi carriage.
Arriving at a nearby hotel, Hobart asked for two rooms, after going upstairs, Hobart first came to Klein's room, locked the door, and the two sat down face to face.
Hobart took out two 5-pound banknotes from his wallet and said: "I have to go back to Backlund early tomorrow morning, I think you should need some cash now?"
"No need." Klein immediately declined. There were still 300 pounds of anonymous deposits lying in the bank, which he could withdraw tomorrow morning, and he felt that he owed Hobart enough, and didn't want to owe him any more favors.
Hobart didn't insist, took back the banknotes, and then wrote down the address of the law firm: "If you need help, write a letter to this address."
Klein put away the address: "Thank you, thank you for your help tonight."
Otherwise he might have to sleep on the street.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 175 Hobert's Rumored Girlfriend (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The next morning, Hobert bid farewell to Klein and left Tingen City on the first train to Backlund.
He arrived back in Backlund at half past ten in the morning, and it took him another half an hour to return to Blanca Street by taxi carriage.
Xio and Fors were not at home. There was a note on the table for Hobert, saying they would both be back at noon.
After waiting for about ten minutes, Fors returned first. She had found a job as a chef's apprentice in a restaurant on the next street.
To be honest, this writer Miss does have some initiative, as long as she can overcome the temptation of the armchair.
Today, Fors was making fried squid, a dish she had just learned. She cut the squid, washed it clean, mixed it with seasonings, and then fried it in hot oil. The aroma could be smelled in the street.
Xio returned with bread just as the squid was almost done frying.
She tidied up the dining room nimbly and then sat there like a good baby, waiting for dinner.
After busying herself for a few more minutes, Fors brought the squid to the table.
None of the three had a habit of praying, so they started eating immediately.
Hobert took a bite and found it delicious. The freshness of the squid was brought out by the hot oil, and the seasonings removed the fishy taste, leaving only the smooth and fresh flavor.
However, why bread again?
Hobert decided that he must make some pancakes for dinner, or go out and buy some rice to cook.
Thinking of this, Hobert felt a little strange. Logically speaking, since there are 'Farmers' in this world, why haven't they cultivated 'hybrid rice' yet?
This makes the price of rice much higher than that of flour and beans. Even the middle class can't afford to eat rice every meal.
Lost in thought, Hobert quickly used his knife and fork to grab another piece of squid, or Xio would eat it all.
This girl's figure has remained in her teenage years, and her appetite seems to have remained in her growing-up stage.
After eating his fill, Hobert got up and said, "I went to bed a little late last night, and I'm still a little tired. I'm going to catch up on some sleep. No need to buy bread for dinner. I'll make some, uh, I'll make some different staple foods."
Xio and Fors agreed. The two chatted while cleaning the table.
After Fors washed the dishes, Xio had already made tea. One shared her experiences as an apprentice, and the other talked about the tasks she had received today.
Just then, there was a knock on the door.
Xio looked out the window at the door. Outside was a girl with naturally curly golden hair and a boy with short golden hair.
The girl wore a dress with blue lace and a blue ribbon, while the boy wore a well-made shirt and jacket. Xio could feel the youthful energy even through the door.
"Who are you looking for?" Xio didn't open the door immediately but asked from inside.
The girl and boy were taken aback, and then the girl said apologetically, "Sorry, we have the wrong place."
"It's okay," Xio said with a smile. Judging by their appearance and hair, they should be siblings. This reminded Xio of her own brother, so she took a few more glances.
The girl and boy returned to the entrance and carefully looked at the door number, then their faces filled with disbelief.
Xio probably understood. She opened the door and asked, "Are you here to see Hobert?"
"Yes, yes," The girl and boy were Donna and Tyron, siblings. They had mentioned during dinner at home that they would come to see Hobert.
But Hobert was too busy this week and forgot.
Donna looked at Xio with surprise. Xio's attire was not that of a maid. Could it be that she was Hobert's girlfriend? But she looked like she was still in grammar school! She should be six or seven years younger than Hobert!
"Who is it?" Fors also came to the door to ask.
Donna nodded. This lady was about the same age as Hobert, and both her looks and temperament were very good. If Hobert's aesthetic was still normal, this should be his girlfriend.
Then Donna smiled: No wonder Hobert wanted to move out, it turned out he had a girlfriend.
Tyron, on the other hand, had already honestly introduced himself and Donna.
When Fors and Xio heard that they were Hobert's younger sister and brother, they warmly welcomed them in.
Donna asked, "Where's Hobert?"
Xio poured tea for them while casually saying, "He's resting upstairs!"
Donna was stunned: "He doesn't have the habit of taking naps."
Xio rummaged through the cabinets for snacks while casually saying, "He was a little tired last night, so he's resting at noon."
Donna seemed to realize something: "How do you know he was tired last night?"
"He said it himself!" Xio breathed a sigh of relief, finally finding a box of snacks she hadn't eaten.
Donna sized up Xio: "So you are, you are... you and Hobert, have already, already... sister-in-law!"
Xio was stunned: "Huh?"
"Who's here?" Hobert asked as he came downstairs, yawning.
Donna rushed over: "Hobert! What did you say before? Telling me not to date in school, but you're so fast to find a girlfriend!
"And, and, she's still in grammar school, how can you..."
Hobert looked at his sister with disbelief: "Donna, did you leave your brain at home when you went out today?"
A few minutes later.
Amid Hobert's laughter, Donna blushed and kept apologizing to Xio: "I'm sorry, Miss Xio, I misunderstood you."
Xio waved her hand helplessly: "It's nothing. But there's one thing I must explain, I graduated from grammar school a long time ago."
Fors turned her face to the other side, trying hard not to laugh.
Hobert laughed even louder: "Donna, you, you should learn to write novels from Fors, your inner thoughts are too much, I admire you!"
"Don't laugh!" Donna finally became angry: "How could you forget that we were coming today? What kind of brother are you?"
Hobert did stop laughing: "It is indeed my fault, but tell me the truth, do you think every pretty lady who has contact with me is your sister-in-law!"
After saying that, Hobert laughed again: "Brother wants to thank you! You have more ideas than your brother! I'll let you be the brother in the next life!"
Just as he was about to make Donna cry, Hobert finally tried hard to stop laughing, then introduced them to each other and asked Tyron to help him make pancakes in the kitchen.
Donna was a very cheerful girl. She quickly forgot about what happened just now, asking Xio about bounty hunter issues, and asking Fors where the inspiration for 'Wuthering Heights' came from.
In the evening, Tyron brought the hot scallion pancakes to the table. Hobert cut some Loen pickles, and Fors made a salad.
Everyone praised Hobert's 'invention' of scallion pancakes, never expecting that pancakes could be so delicious with just scallions and oil.
And the Loen people basically eat pies and pizzas. Although they each have their own flavor, both pizza and pie making are too cumbersome and greasy.
Hobert sighed in his heart, fortunately, Roselle left a way out for later generations. In terms of cuisine, his 'inventions' are not many.
After eating his fill, Hobert sent Donna and Tyron to their family's carriage. In the carriage, Tyron suddenly said, "Hobert is very happy now."
"Yes," Donna unconsciously showed a smile: "He is much happier than before, maybe he has found the life he wants."

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 176 A Shortcut to Digesting the Potion (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert returned to his bedroom, rubbing his slightly sore stomach. Donna, that lively treasure, always made him laugh heartily. Tonight, he laughed so much his stomach ached a bit.
Just as Hobert was preparing to rest, he suddenly heard a prayer from the 'Nation of Disorder'.
After becoming a Sequence 7, the prayers were clearer, and he could now discern the source of the voice—it was Elliot.
After all, only three people knew the honorific name of 'The Creator', and of those, only Elliot was a 'devout believer'. The other two were a 'king of double agents' and someone who had simply disappeared.
Hobert shook his head and smiled wryly as he locked the door and entered the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Sitting on the 'Iron Throne', sure enough, the star representing Elliot was flashing incessantly. Hobert spread his spirituality over and heard Elliot's voice:
"Great 'Creator', Elder Calvin told me that from Sequence 7 onwards, the digestion of the potion would gradually slow down. At the same time, he taught me a shortcut to digest the 'Briber' potion and allowed me to read some of the family's precious records.
"In the ancient documents left by the family, I learned a shocking secret: our surname is not Balk, but Trunsoest, said to be descendants of the 'Night Emperor'.
"Who is the 'Night Emperor'? Is he related to the family's curse? We have been in 'Nonexistent Town' for too long, and much of the historical information about the supernatural has been lost.
"Also, my ancestor mentioned in the documents that bribing a god is a shortcut to digesting the 'Briber' potion."
Elliot's tone suddenly became sorrowful as he said, "More than a decade ago, my sister gave me the family's Beyonder characteristics. Tormented by the family curse, she completely went mad.
"Can I pray to you to restore my sister's sanity and offer sacrifices, and then ask you to fulfill my request?"
Hobert's first reaction was: It can be done like this? This is indeed a way to fully exploit loopholes!
Then he began to consider whether he could fulfill Elliot's prayer. If it were before, he wouldn't have been sure, but with the 'Healing Fork', Elliot's request wasn't that difficult.
After deducing it in his heart, Hobert said in a supreme voice: "The 'Night Emperor' is one of the 'Four Emperors' of the Fourth Epoch and is related to your family's curse."
He paused and added, "Tomorrow morning, prepare the altar, sacrifices, auxiliary materials for the 'Lawyer' potion, and bring your sister to the altar, then make your prayer."
He also hoped to verify whether this method was useful. If it was, hehehe, he could try to bribe 'Mr. Fool'.
Hobert's situation was similar to Klein's. If Elliot bribing him, this empty shell 'Creator', was effective, then theoretically, he could definitely bribe the empty shell of 'The Fool'.
If Elliot's bribery of the 'Creator' was unsuccessful, it wouldn't matter. When the 'Creator' healed Elliot's sister, demonstrating the 'Creator's' power, even if there were no signs of Elliot's potion being digested, it would be because Elliot wasn't pious enough and didn't offer enough sacrifices. Anyway, it wouldn't be the 'Creator's' fault.
Without the 'Creator' needing to remind him, Elliot would probably go to reflect on his mistakes himself.
Thinking of this, Hobert was about to leave the 'Nation of Disorder' when the corner of his eye caught sight of the star representing Rafter, still entwined with a red line.
Recalling that it had been a while since he had observed Rafter, Hobert spread his spirituality over. Like Christian, this was also a descendant of Tudor.
Rafter was sitting opposite two young women, but judging by their attire, these two women weren't streetwalkers.
Especially the short-haired woman on the left, who was holding a weapon that looked like a warhammer. Who holds a warhammer while soliciting customers?
The woman sitting opposite Rafter had long golden hair, somewhat naturally curly, thin, and with handsome features, but at this moment, she was furrowing her thick eyebrows: "Don't come looking for me again!"
Hobert was stunned; he seemed to smell the scent of a melodramatic soap opera.
The golden-haired woman said: "I am just the daughter of a bastard and have no interest in the thoughts of you lords."
Rafter said: "The Pound family once…"
The silver-haired woman with the warhammer "gently" hammered the table, interrupting Rafter: "Isn't Jessica making herself clear enough?"
"Listen to me, Jessica," Rafter said, "I have found hope for the revival of the Pond family. As long as we cooperate, the Pond family will definitely regain its past glory.
"I won't let you help for nothing. How about the 'Barbarian' potion formula? As long as you help, I'll give you the 'Barbarian' potion formula."
Jessica was clearly a little tempted.
However, the silver-haired woman reminded her: "Would you be so generous? You definitely have bad intentions!"
Jessica also calmed down: "That's right, I don't want your formula, and I don't want to see you again."
The two women became more and more agitated, and Rafter had no choice but to leave temporarily.
Hobert withdrew his spirituality and shrugged. Unexpectedly, he watched a family ethics drama.
…
South Continent, Nonexistent Town.
After receiving the 'Creator's' reply, Elliot paced excitedly, circling the room several times before he gradually calmed down, carefully savoring the 'Creator's' answer.
So the 'Night Emperor' is one of the 'Four Emperors'. He had heard of the 'Four Emperors', but he didn't know exactly which 'Four Emperors' they were.
It should be a powerhouse of the Fourth Epoch! It seems there are still many questions to ask the 'Creator' for answers.
Then Elliot went out, preparing to discuss with Calvin what sacrifices to offer to the 'Creator'.
…
Backlund, North Borough, a bachelor apartment.
Daly sat by the window, looking at the gray night scene outside. On the table next to her was the newspaper that had been delivered yesterday.
She had been very busy these past few days. Only by putting all her energy into her work could she avoid overthinking.
So she only saw yesterday's newspaper today. In the most conspicuous position was a report about Hobert's victory.
Daly glanced at the newspaper again: "And you said you had no sense of justice."
…
Tingen City, Elizabeth and Selena watched Melissa return home before they took a carriage home together.
To alleviate their friend's sadness, they had been frequently accompanying Melissa shopping until late at night recently.
Selena asked Elizabeth: "Did you see yesterday's newspaper?"
Elizabeth was stunned and shook her head.
Selena took out a copy of the 'Loen Daily' from her bag: "I knew you hadn't seen it. Lawyer Hobert won a widely watched lawsuit in Backlund. It is said that the impact of this victory is far-reaching."
Elizabeth immediately took the newspaper and started reading it under the street lamp.
Selena continued from the side: "Lawyer Hobert is the most amazing person I have ever met. He is handsome, has a sense of justice, and knows so much about mysticism.
"Do you think he would agree if I asked him to be my mysticism teacher?"

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 177 Bribing the "Creator" (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
On the Backlund train.
Klein opened the local newspaper he had just bought and was quickly drawn to an article in it.
After reading the report on Hobert's victory, he was silent for a long time, not expecting Hobert to have such a side.
This increased Klein's trust in Hobert. The "believers" of the "Creator" often represent the intentions of the "Creator".
Since Hobert is willing to defend the workers in a weak position, it can be said from the side that the "Creator" is not an evil god like the "True Creator".
However, Klein still didn't plan to contact Hobert, who was also in Backlund, immediately. He needed to calm down and think carefully about how to proceed.
...
Waking up, Hobert saw the pattering rain hitting the window.
It seemed to be the first autumn rain, and people on the street were already wearing coats and jackets.
After going downstairs to eat the breakfast Fors had left for him and cleaning up the tableware, Hobert had just returned to his bedroom when he heard Elliot's prayer.
He smiled wryly. Today was Hobert's day off, but the "Creator" had to be open for business as usual.
Arriving at the "Nation of Disorder", it was indeed Elliot who was praying, and he was already prepared.
Hobert spread his spirituality over and saw the altar Elliot had prepared, as well as a young woman with disheveled hair and somewhat sloppy clothes sitting in front of the altar.
Seeing the madness expressed in the young woman's expression and eyes, it was likely Elliot's sister.
After Elliot finished praying, he went to coax his sister, asking her to sit obediently in the chair.
Hobert first brought the "Psychological Spoon" and "Healing Fork" to the "Nation of Disorder" by offering them to himself, and then said to Elliot, "Begin."
Elliot heard Hobert's instructions and comforted his sister a few more times before focusing on praying in front of the altar: "O Creator in the Shadow of Order..."
After reciting the honorable name, he continued: "Your faithful servant begs for your favor;"
"I beg you to help my sister Moira, who is in front of the altar, get rid of her madness."
After listening to the prayer, Hobert threw a portion of the "Lawyer" and a portion of the "Barbarian" characteristics, which had been crushed and re-aggregated in the initial experiment on the stone platform next to him, into the gap in the bronze door.
Then Hobert said to Elliot, "Prepare the 'Lawyer' potion. You only have ten minutes!"
Elliot in the real world was slightly stunned. In Moira's current state, she would not be able to control the power of the potion at all, and she might lose control the moment she drank it.
However, out of trust in the Creator, he immediately went to prepare the potion.
While Elliot was preparing the potion, Hobert first gave Moira a "psychological cue" with the "Psychological Spoon": Ignore the crazy whispers in your ears.
Although such a psychological cue may only last for a dozen minutes, it is completely sufficient.
Then Hobert "hypnotized" Moira to reduce the madness of her "spirit body" and "astral body". If he had the ability to "appease", the effect would be better. "Hypnosis" is not quite right for the symptoms, and the effect can only last for a while.
Fortunately, Hobert now has the " Healing Fork". After laying the groundwork, a "healing spell" went down, and Moira's "spirit body" began to recover.
Another "healing spell" went down, and Moira's "spiril body" became completely normal.
Theoretically, the cursed whispers would immediately appear in Moira's ears at this time, but because of the previous "hypnosis" and "psychological cue", Moira would be awake for a dozen minutes.
Using this time, she drinks the "Lawyer" potion, and she will not be troubled by the curse for half a year.
Moreover, Hobert generously gave Elliot the extraordinary characteristics of the "Barbarian", so Moira will not hear the crazy whispers from the curse for a whole year.
This year is enough for her "spirit body" and "astral body" to completely relax and completely recover.
Finally, Hobert collected the sacrifices on the altar into the "Nation of Disorder" and continued to observe Elliot's digestion of the potion.
...
While Elliot was preparing the potion, he felt waves of power descending.
This relieved him. He knew that the "Creator" would not allow Moira to take the potion in such a state.
"Little Ellie~"
The potion was finally prepared. Elliot was just about to examine his sister's condition when this voice entered his ears.
"Little Ellie" is Elliot's nickname, and no one has called him that since his father passed away.
Elliot looked at Moira in disbelief. Her face was smiling, and her eyes were full of clarity: "Is that really you? Little Ellie?"
The potion in his hand almost fell to the ground. Elliot steadied his mind and said, "Yes, it's me, Moira."
"Little Ellie has grown up!" Moira reached out to Elliot.
Elliot then reacted and quickly came to his sister's side.
"Why are you crying?" Moira stroked her brother's cheek.
"I, I'm not crying." Elliot didn't even realize that tears were already streaming down his face.
"Still as crybaby and liar like when you were a kid."
"Drink the potion quickly, Moira!" Elliot finally remembered the important thing: "Take advantage of your clarity and control the power of the potion."
Although Moira didn't understand what was going on, she quickly decided to listen to her brother and drank the potion in one gulp.
It took a minute or two for Moira to control the power of the potion.
Elliot finally breathed a sigh of relief, at least Moira could be awake for half a year, no, a year!
Elliot also saw the black cherry-like "Barbarian" potion. After a year, Moira will be able to use Beyonder power to resist the family's curse.
Moira put down the cup in her hand: "Little Ellie, why did I suddenly wake up?"
She said: "I seem to have had a very long, long dream, as if I would never see the end of the dream.
"Fortunately, I saw you. I saw you after I woke up, which let me know that the previous dream was over."
"A great being has come to save our family." Elliot's joy and disbelief gradually faded away, and he gradually became a little excited!
My sister is not crazy! My sister's illness is cured!
Elliot quickly pulled Moira to the altar and thanked the "Creator" piously.
At this time, Elliot heard that supreme voice again: "You can spread my name! But only within your family."
Elliot shed tears of joy again. The "Creator" finally accepted the Balk family!
Although Elliot felt that he had too much to say to Moira, now was not the time to chat. Several elders of the family were still waiting in the living room outside.
The Balk family attached great importance to Elliot's "bribe" this time!

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 178 Two Sacrifices (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:

Calvin and the other six elders immediately gathered around upon hearing the door open.
They knew from Moira's expression that Elliot's "bribe" had succeeded.
Elder Bowen said, "It's unbelievable!"
When Elliot planned to "bribe" the 'Creator' to restore Moira to her normal state, Bowen thought Elliot's request was too difficult and the 'Creator' might not agree.
Last night, Bowen learned that the 'Creator' had granted Elliot's request, and he remained skeptical.
In fact, Bowen had always been somewhat doubtful of the 'Creator's' attitude, but after seeing Moira's recovery, Bowen's attitude towards the 'Creator' completely changed.
In Nonexistent Town, which family doesn't have a crazy relative?
Moira's awakening also gave all the elders hope of lifting the curse.
After everyone congratulated Elliot, Calvin asked, "Is there any sign of digestion of the 'Briber' potion?"
Elliot's emotions had been too volatile just now, and he was reminded by Calvin. He radiated his spirituality to sense the state of the potion, and after a while, he exclaimed with joy, "Half of it has been digested at once!"
Everyone was filled with envy. They had all experienced Sequence 7 and knew that from 'Briber' onwards, potion digestion required more time and acting.
And Elliot had digested half of it almost effortlessly!
...
Hobert carefully scrutinized Elliot. Judging from the other party's reaction, this shortcut was feasible.
Moreover, as long as he bribed "God" twice, he could basically digest the potion. With some acting in normal times, he could achieve a high degree of compatibility between the potion, astral body, and ether body, completing the thorough digestion process.
Then, Hobert looked at the sacrifice before him, a "specialty" from the Southern Continent: a characteristic of a "Werewolf" and a sealed artifact from the "Death" pathway.
Hobert's cost was a characteristic of a "Barbarian" and a "Lawyer", making this deal a huge profit!
He first held the "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristic in his palm. He remembered that if he used a Beyonder characteristic from the "Prisoner" pathway to perform divination, it would attract the attention of the "Mother Tree of Desire" and be contaminated without realizing it.
He wondered if shattering the "Werewolf" characteristic would attract the attention of the "Mother Tree of Desire".
After a little thought, Hobert felt it wouldn't. First of all, the "Nation of Disorder" could isolate most of the attention.
Secondly, he was using the power of "Chaos" to shatter the characteristic, which theoretically could isolate all mystical powers.
With two layers of isolation, the "Mother Tree of Desire" should not be able to sense the shattering of this "Werewolf" characteristic.
Even if the "Mother Tree of Desire" noticed it here, Hobert had enough home-field advantage in the "Nation of Disorder".
So Hobert immediately tried it, first wrapping the "Werewolf" characteristic with the "Power of Chaos" and then trying to shatter it.
Suddenly, a huge tree appeared before Hobert's eyes. It was full of vitality, constantly growing, flowering, and bearing fruit.
This tree floated in the dark universe, nurturing life on planet after planet.
On many planets, stones, magma, and even entire planets had life.
They intertwined and collided, constantly giving birth to new life and constantly destroying old life.
Hobert was startled. This should be the main body of the "Mother Tree of Desire"! Just as he was about to end his operation, the picture suddenly disappeared.
The "Werewolf" characteristic had been divided into three parts and began the process of re-condensing.
Hobert then realized that it was not the gaze of the "Mother Tree of Desire", but the influence of the "Mother Tree of Desire" on this characteristic. Before it was destroyed, it established some kind of connection with Hobert, allowing Hobert to see the past or present body of the "Mother Tree of Desire".
Seeing the past "Mother Tree of Desire" was more likely because Hobert did not feel the other party's "looking back". It was likely the state of the "Mother Tree of Desire" when it influenced this Beyonder characteristic.
Looking at the Beyonder characteristic divided into three, Hobert seemed to see three stacks of gold pounds.
Then he summoned the sealed artifact to his hand and quickly understood the ability of this sealed artifact using the authority of the "Nation of Disorder":
"It can hide in the spirit world for 60 seconds, temporarily avoiding enemy attacks; it can make the holder very agile; wearing this sealed artifact makes it easy to encounter ancient ruins or tombs."
The negative effects are: "You must not move when hiding in the spirit world, or you will be completely lost in the spirit world; you are easily hated by undead creatures; the wearer will increasingly like to tell ghost stories, and the plots in the ghost stories are likely to happen to the wearer."
Hobert first thought that this sealed artifact was probably comparable to a Grade 3 sealed artifact.
He threw the sealed artifact onto the stone platform. This sealed artifact was not very useful to Hobert. Perhaps its greatest use was that it "easily encountered ancient ruins or tombs." And there were considerable risks. He should put it in the "Nation of Disorder" first and take it out when it was useful.
Back in the real world, Hobert stretched and looked at the drizzle hitting the window, quietly enjoying the state of emptying his brain and body.
At noon, after Hobert had lunch with Fors, he returned to his bedroom and read a novel for a while. At about 2:50, he locked the door, closed the curtains, and prepared for the "Tarot Club Meeting".
At three o'clock sharp, Hobert's vision was occupied by gray fog, and the giant palace appeared in his vision. A new round of the "Tarot Club Meeting" began.
Klein, who had activated his spiritual vision, immediately noticed the change in "Emperor", which greatly surprised Klein: Emperor was already Sequence 7?
"Justice" Audrey, "Hanged Man" Alger, and "Sun" Derrick did not immediately notice the change in Hobert.
Audrey was about to greet him happily, but Alger preempted her and said, "Mr. Fool, I have collected a total of 19 pages of Roselle's diary this time.
"Here, I must thank you for sending your attendant to help us eliminate Qilangos. These diary entries are the reward I should pay."
Klein smiled faintly, "This is in line with the principle of equivalent exchange."
Alger's attitude was somewhat humble, "My current memory limit is six pages, please allow me to give them to you in installments."
Klein, shrouded in thick gray fog, nodded slightly, "No problem."
Then came the "expression" process, and the part where Klein began to read the diary.
Audrey, sitting opposite Alger, was already very excited: Qilangos was really eliminated by Mr. Fool's believer. Mr. Hanged Man's attitude became humble, probably because he had seen Mr. Fool's powerful believer.
Then she looked at "Sun": Mr. Sun was not surprised at all, after all, he was in the "Forsaken Land". Mr. Emperor was a little surprised, but his surprise seemed a little fake.
Wait, something was wrong with "Emperor's" state. Could he have advanced again?!

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 179 Intercepting each other (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Bodybags87 for becoming a member, +5 bonus chapters on top of bonus chp for my bday]
Audrey recalled that when "The Emperor" joined the Tarot Club, he was just an ordinary person, but now he was already Sequence 7!
At that time, Audrey was already Sequence 9, and she is still Sequence 9 now.
Audrey clenched her fist: No, I must advance quickly too. I really want to ask Mr. Hanged Man now if he has obtained the complete pituitary gland of an adult Rainbow Salamander. No, no, it's Mr. Fool's reading time now, I have to wait.
Unlike Audrey's torment, Alger and Derrick also saw Hobert's differences. While they were surprised by Hobert's speed of advancement, they felt that it seemed acceptable.

Only after Klein took the "Psychological Spoon" from the altar did Hobert exclaim: There is no momentum of the "Creator's" sacrifice door, but it is full of mystery and illusory feeling.
At this time, he heard the voice of "The Fool" constantly echoing: "Well done."
Hobert bowed to the altar: "Praise the Fool!"
...
In the middle of the turbulent waves of the Berserk Sea, the "Blue Avenger" was like a leaf, sometimes thrown high, sometimes rolled down, but without the slightest sign of capsizing.
Alger was in the captain's room, pacing back and forth with his back to the shelves filled with red and white wine.
Finally, he gritted his teeth, returned to the desk with a serious expression, took away the brass sextant, found paper and a steel pen, and leaned over to depict the complex and mysterious symbolic symbol that "The Fool" gave him.
After lighting the candle, setting up the altar, and building the wall of spirituality, Alger instinctively took a breath, lowered his head and chanted in Hermes: "The Fool who does not belong to this era..."
After reciting the incantation, Alger also saw the illusory door, he immediately lowered his head, holding the complete pituitary gland above his head with both hands, and offered the sacrifice in his hand.
A mysterious suction appeared on the altar, sucking away the complete pituitary gland.
Alger felt his hands become lighter, but he still didn't dare to look up until he heard the voice of "The Fool": "Well done."
"It's my honor," Alger replied without hesitation.
After extinguishing the candle according to the normal procedure and ending the ritual, Alger sat down with a complex expression, guessing the state of "The Fool": "At the beginning, he could only pull people into the world above the gray fog, after a while, he could listen to prayers and respond, and now he can accept sacrifices and bestow them. Mr. 'Fool' is getting out of trouble step by step!"
This guess and conclusion made Alger feel both afraid and worried, and a little bit of rejoicing expectation: At least I am a member of the Tarot Club, the earliest member.
Alger took a deep breath and got up to check the sea chart. In any case, he must improve his strength as soon as possible. Strength is always his confidence.
The "Blue Avenger" is now approaching the first location marked in the Elven ruins.
...
In the magnificent palace above the gray fog, Klein was looking at the "Psychological Spoon" and the pituitary gland in front of him.
Picking up the "Psychological Spoon", he once again exclaimed the benefits of being a platform, pouring spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon", he immediately noticed that he had three new abilities: "Hypnosis", "Frenzy", and "Psychological Cue".
And the negative effects are just crying or laughing.
This is a good thing!

Klein, who had more contact with the Nighthawks, had more contact with sealed items that could kill the holder at any time, and rarely came into contact with items with negative effects within an acceptable range.
Even so, it didn't affect his judgment of the "Psychological Spoon."
After using "Hypnosis" to deal with the memory of 0-08, and "setting" it to be forgotten in the real world, and then "recalling" it in the space above this gray fog, Klein notified Audrey to start the ceremony of bestowing: "The attempt has been successful."
He said in a supreme voice: "When are you going to perform the bestowing ceremony? Provided that there are no other Beyonders around you."
...
Audrey was a little excited when she heard Mr. Fool's notification: It really succeeded!
Then she felt a little guilty: Does a dog count?
Thinking of this, she once again asked Susie to help her stand guard at the door, and then recited the honorable name of "The Fool": "Mr. Fool, now is fine."
This was the first time to conduct the ceremony of bestowal, Audrey could not help being cautious and repeatedly compared.
The moment the illusory door of bestowal appeared, Audrey breathed a sigh of relief and curiously looked at the door full of mystery.
It was not until the pituitary gland of the Rainbow Salamander and the "Psychological Spoon" appeared on the altar that Audrey came back to her senses.
After praising Mr. Fool again, Audrey ended the ceremony and thought triumphantly: "Our Tarot Club is at a higher level than all secret organizations."
She first picked up the "Psychological Spoon" and used the method taught by "Emperor" before to spread her spirituality to this seemingly ordinary spoon.
Through spiritual perception, she immediately realized that she could use three new abilities: hypnosis, frenzy, and psychological cue.
Is this a magical item? That's great! I really want to have it, I wonder if "Emperor" will sell it.
Uh, it seems a little impolite to ask directly, I'll inquire about it from the side at the next gathering.
Audrey first completed the hypnosis on herself, which was similar to Klein's operation. She also forgot all the information about 0-08 in the real world, and when she returned to the gray fog, she regained the memory of 0-08.
In theory, as a Sequence Nine, it should be difficult to exert the full effect of the "Psychological Spoon", but Audrey is a "Spectator", and has a very high degree of compatibility with the "Psychological Spoon", and the hypnotic effect is actually very good.
Audrey reluctantly put down the "Psychological Spoon", and then sacrificed it to Mr. Fool with the prepared gold pounds, asking Him to help give it to the "Emperor".
"This month's pocket money is all spent." Audrey sighed, it was not difficult for her to take out more than two thousand pounds at one time.
After completing the sacrifice, Audrey picked up the soft thing that was constantly changing color and covered with hills.
Also because of the same sequence relationship, without verifying the authenticity, Audrey's spirituality knew that this was the pituitary gland of the Rainbow Salamander.
She had already prepared other materials, so a few minutes later, she had a bottle of liquid that was constantly changing its luster in her hand.
Audrey drank the potion and successfully passed the characteristic integration stage and was promoted to Sequence 8.
After using meditation to restrain the divergent spirituality, Audrey opened the door and let Susie in.
"Audrey, something seems to have changed about you." Susie's mouth opened and closed.
Audrey smiled slightly: "Is there?"
Finally one sequence higher than Susie, otherwise Audrey sometimes didn't know how to face Susie.
If you meet other Beyonders, how should you introduce yourself and Susie: I am a "Spectator", and my dog is also an "Spectator"!
It's embarrassing to think about it.
Audrey sat on the soft stool and changed the subject: "Susie, how do you think I should tell Xio and Fors in a concealed way without revealing my identity, and make them interested?"
As soon as she finished speaking, Audrey also seriously thought about the task assigned by Mr. Fool.
Then she looked at Susie, Susie looked at her, and finally Susie broke the silence: "Audrey, I'm just a dog."
...
Hobert praised the Fool when he saw the gold pounds and the "Psychological Spoon" appearing on the altar, and then picked up the money to count.
A total of 2060 pounds, no more, no less.
Looking at the cloudy sky outside, Hobert finally overcame his laziness and deposited 2,000 pounds into the bank.
Now Hobert's savings have reached 4,800 pounds, and Hobert also has 91 pounds and 7 soli in cash in his wallet.
Hobert sighed after leaving the bank. He was obviously so rich, but he was still living a poor life. Sure enough, "Once you enter the world of Beyonders, you are as deep as the sea, and from then on, the rich become poor."
Even so, Hobert still bought some barbecue to reward himself, and also to share his joy with Xio and Fors.
The atmosphere at dinner was good. Fors shared her recent experience as an apprentice and the interesting stories in the back kitchen. In the past, in her impression, chefs were grumpy and rude people.
After this period of contact, Fors realized the delicate and focused side of the chefs.
Because she has been focusing on being an apprentice, Fors feels that her spirit is not so tense anymore.
Xio has recently set her sights on two robbers with bounties on their heads. As long as she determines their strength, she will decide to take action to capture them.
The total bounty for the two people is only 20 pounds. Judging from the amount of the bounty, they are unlikely to be extraordinary people.
In the evening, Hobert had a good night's sleep. Early the next morning, after breakfast, Hobert went to the law firm to prepare to return to work.
As soon as he arrived at the office, Hobert was a little dazed, because his desk was full of letters, as many as thirty or forty!
The colleague next to him smiled and said: "Hobert, you are a famous lawyer now."
Hobert piled the letters together: "I don't know if I'm famous or not, but I'll be busy these days anyway."
He immediately entered a working state, first making a simple distinction between the letters. Most of them were consultations or entrustments, and some were letters from newspapers or magazines, hoping to interview Hobert or do a special interview for him.
In addition, there was a letter from Ikanser, the captain of "Machinery Hivemind", and a letter from Loretta, a member of the "Nighthawks."
Loretta asked him to meet at the "Obsidian Bar" tomorrow afternoon. The letter was sent yesterday, which means that the meeting time is actually this afternoon.
While Hobert was sorting and looking through the letters, a formal lawyer from the office next door brought in a woman in her twenties: "Everyone, let me introduce to you, this is our new colleague, Miss Jessica."
Hobert was stunned and looked up, and sure enough, he saw a woman with golden hair with natural curls, one of the two women he had seen in Rafter's Star.

chapters.content:
