chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 195: Encirclement and Suppression of Aurora Order Members (Bonus 22)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[It shows 53 new chp/week rn]
From the moment Hobert kicked the door open to when the 'Shadow Ascetic' was riddled with bullets, it took no more than a minute, and the capture operation concluded successfully.
Borgia asked Hobert, "Shall we go together to support the other teams? Should we leave Loretta to clean up the battlefield herself?"
When he first met Hobert, Hobert was just a Sequence 9, and a wild Beyonder at that, naturally short-tempered.
But now Hobert could single-handedly deal with a Sequence 7. Borgia had the insight to see this. His and Loretta's final shots were just for a sense of participation. Even without their shots, Hobert would have been fully capable of taking down the enemy.
Borgia's politeness to Hobert was, in fact, an acknowledgment of Hobert's strength.
Hobert nodded. "Okay, which team is closest to us?"
"The team capturing Heyman," Borgia replied.
As soon as Hobert heard Heyman's name, he immediately said to Loretta, "Leave this to you, let's go."
Just as Hobert and Borgia got into the carriage, many people who had been awakened by the gunshots began to poke their heads out to investigate.
Loretta held up her badge. "Police business!"
Everyone was frightened and quickly retracted their heads.
On the other side, in the carriage, Borgia was explaining the plan to capture Heyman: "According to our analysis, Heyman should be a 'Swindler', a very cunning and agile Sequence.
"Therefore, we have deployed a Sequence 8 and two Sequence 9s to capture him, and we are carrying a Grade 3 Sealed Artifact."
Hobert nodded. Thomas was indeed an experienced Nighthawk, knowing where to deploy 'heavy troops'.
Although 'Swindlers' don't have many bizarre Beyonder abilities, underestimating them would definitely lead to a great loss.
The carriage sped along the deserted streets. Even if there were pedestrians on the road, they quickly made way.
The Southern Bridge District mainly consisted of residential areas, without many bustling streets, so the streets were very quiet at night.
Hobert and Borgia, who were chatting idly in the carriage, suddenly sensed danger with their spirituality.
Before they could react, a huge black shadow crashed into the horses pulling the carriage. While knocking the horses away, the shadow raised its long, sharp claws and tore one of the horses in half, scattering horse blood, intestines, and internal organs all over the ground.
The out-of-control carriage crashed into a building on the side of the street. Fortunately, Hobert acted quickly and "Teleported" himself, Borgia, and the coachman to the side of the street one after another.
Bang~
The wooden carriage crashed into the wall, suffering severe damage.
Using the light from the gas street lamps, Hobert and the others saw a humanoid monster covered in black. It was tall, at least three and a half meters, with long limbs and long, sharp claws.
Its head was very peculiar, composed of individual eyeballs and a clump of hair, without any other organs. The entire head was like those eyeballs were bundled together with hair.
Just making eye contact with any one of the eyeballs would make one feel as if the madness deep within the soul was being released, and reason would gradually be lost.
Hobert and Borgia both looked away.
At the same time, they were a little surprised. This was Backlund, after all. Why would such an aggressive monster appear here?
The monster seemed to enjoy killing. With another swipe of its claws, it tore off the head of the other horse.
Then, it set its sights on the coachman behind Hobert and Borgia.
The coachman was an employee of the Blackthorn Security Company and had basic professional qualities. He didn't panic at all and immediately fled in the opposite direction.
Hobert "Teleported" the cane from the carriage into his hand while summarizing the monster's behavior: bloodthirsty; and targeting weaker lives; its intelligence doesn't seem to be very high.
While thinking, he and Borgia drew out their canes from the left and right.
Smack~
The cane clearly struck the monster's thigh, but it felt like hitting an iron pillar.
Borgia's cane was directly broken, and the other half in his hand flew out. The hand holding the cane was even shaken to the point of bleeding between his thumb and forefinger.
Hobert's cane was made of special materials, so it only numbed his hand without breaking.
The two men's strikes were not without effect. The monster's two long, thin legs were broken, and the monster fell to the ground, its eyeballs scattered everywhere.
Hobert was still wondering: Did we just take it down?
Judging from the monster's appearance, it didn't seem like it would be so easily dealt with.
At this time, two Nighthawks chased over, shouting as they ran, "Don't let the eyeballs get close to any flesh and blood!"
But their warning was already too late. Several eyeballs had already rolled to the corpses of the two horses.
The flesh and blood of the corpses, upon touching the horse blood, were like clay being sculpted by some force. Almost instantly, they turned into two humanoid monsters with slender limbs and hairy bodies.
The heads of the two new monsters were composed of long hair and eyes. Four huge horse eyes also joined the ranks of the "eyes".
The eyeballs on the ground regrouped towards the first monster that appeared. When they reunited on that tall, slender body more than three meters high, the monster's broken legs suddenly changed. A joint actually grew out of the broken bone, and such a serious injury was actually "healed" by itself!
During this scene, Hobert did not blindly take any action, but carefully observed the monster's changes.
At this time, the coachman had already gone far away. The three monsters simultaneously charged towards the Sequence 9 among the pursuers.
Hobert took action, using the "Teleportation Statue" to move and change the positions of the three monsters, preventing them from attacking the Sequence 9.
Taking advantage of this gap, the Nighthawk who had come to chase quickly said: "This is a monster summoned by Heyman using some method, and it has already killed many people."
Two of the eyeballs, like they had transformed the corpses of the two horses, transformed the corpse of a victim, entangling three Nighthawks. The monster's main body therefore escaped the control of the Nighthawks.
The three Nighthawks, with one companion seriously injured, managed to deal with the transformed monster and then quickly chased over.
The three monsters were temporarily controlled by Hobert using the "Teleportation Statue" within a range of a dozen meters. Just as they were about to run out of the "Teleportation Statue's" control range, Hobert "Teleported" them back to their original positions. If they kept running like this, they would never be able to escape.
Hobert said to Borgia, who had good marksmanship, "Shoot those eyeballs!"
Obviously, those eyes were the key.
Borgia raised his gun, but his hand trembled violently: "No, I can't make eye contact with those eyes."
At this time, the monsters seemed to have sensed the existence of the "Teleportation Statue", knowing that they were trapped here, all because of that stone.
So, they changed their habits and began to charge towards Hobert, the strongest here.
Hobert didn't dodge, but instead threw the pen he carried with him towards the monster's "main body", completing the process of "bribery": "Weaken!"
He had already found a way to deal with this monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 196: Hobert the Healer (Bonus 23)
chapters.content:
[Bonus +1 for new free member Big Mike]
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
This "multi-eyed monster" possesses extremely high attack power and Beyonder abilities similar to "flesh magic," along with tenacious vitality, making it difficult to subdue.
Its only weakness is its low intelligence.
The "teleporting statue" in Hobert's hand happens to be quite effective against this type of enemy, so while Borgia and the other two night watchmen were helpless against the "multi-eyed monster," Hobert was able to control the situation relatively easily.
With Hobert's current attack power, he doesn't have a direct way to eliminate the monster in front of him, so he began to carefully observe the monster's every move, trying to find a solution.
Just as the "multi-eyed monster" attacked Hobert, Hobert thought of a way.
After "weakening" the monster, Hobert immediately poured his spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon": "Hypnotize! Close your eyes!"
That's right, it's "close your eyes." Since the "multi-eyed monster's" eyeballs are the key, why not just make its eyes close!
Although the "multi-eyed monster's" strength is very strong, its level of strength definitely does not exceed Sequence 6. After Hobert weakened it, the "Psychological Spoon" can completely complete the "hypnosis" on it.
Those eyeballs have no eyelids, so they can't close at all, but all the eyeballs seem to have lost their luster, and Hobert and others can look directly at them.
The movements of the three monster bodies immediately slowed down, and their movements lost their purpose.
"Open fire!" Hobert took out his pistol: "Target, those eyeballs! Eliminate the two smaller monsters first!"
Bang bang bang bang~
The four people fired together, and one eyeball after another was hit, broken, and flowed out with some foul-smelling gray liquid.
The "multi-eyed monsters" "transformed" from two horses were the first to be eliminated. Their flesh and blood collapsed and quickly turned into lumps of wriggling horse meat.
However, the main body of the "multi-eyed monster" was awakening from the "hypnosis" because some of its eyeballs were continuously damaged.
Clang clang~
Shells landed!
Everyone ejected the shells from their revolvers and were reloading bullets as quickly as possible.
Hobert reloads the fastest. He only needs to eject the shells and then "teleport" the bullets into the revolver of the pistol.
If it weren't for the structure of the rotating shaft, which requires the ejection of the shells before firing again, then his reloading speed would be even faster.
But it was still too late. Hobert, who held the "Psychological Spoon," had already noticed that the "multi-eyed monster" had basically awakened, and it had begun to attack Hobert and others by instinct.
"Charm!"
While the opponent's "weakened" state was still in effect, Hobert immediately used another signature skill of the "Briber."
In an instant, Hobert became extremely charming. The "multi-eyed monster," which was not very intelligent, became unwilling to attack Hobert and his companions under the blessing of the "weakening" and "hypnosis" states.
While the "multi-eyed monster" hesitated, everyone had completed reloading and started a new round of shooting again.
Bang bang bang bang~
In this round of shooting, the four people tacitly fired one after another. After repeated shooting, the eyeballs of the "multi-eyed monster" were basically blown out.
However, the main body of the "multi-eyed monster" showed no signs of collapsing. Hobert noticed the clump of hair in the eyeballs. He just wanted to take advantage of the "multi-eyed monster" not being completely awake to grab the clump of hair.
After looking at it twice, Hobert felt that the hair in the broken eyeballs was disgusting, so he said to Borgia: "Take advantage of the opponent's slow movement and grab that clump of hair!"
Then Hobert used "hypnosis" again. As he expected, this "hypnosis" did not have the same effect as last time, only making the other party reluctant to move.
Borgia, who had just reloaded, put away his gun and, with his agile skills, avoided the "multi-eyed monster's" instinctive attack, jumped up and grabbed the clump of hair.
With a pull outward, the hair brought two eyeballs, which Borgia completely tore off.
After losing the hair and the two eyeballs, the main body of the "multi-eyed monster" collapsed with a crash and immediately turned into pieces of foul-smelling rotten meat.
The moment Borgia clenched the hair in his hand, it was as if maddening whispers sounded in his ears. He quickly threw the hair to the distant street.
After confirming that all three monsters had lost their aggressiveness, everyone went to look at the clump of hair and eyeballs.
The two eyeballs seemed to be growing on the hair. Even though Borgia threw them so far away, they were still connected. The two eyeballs were still turning around, as if staring at Hobert and others. Looking at the eyeballs will immediately be affected by it, and the heart will become chaotic.
And the hair that Borgia had just pulled apart turned back into a clump, looking like a brain made of hair.
Hobert said: "This looks like a sealed item! It probably comes from a runaway 'Rose Bishop.'"
Maybe Heyman didn't summon this monster at all, but used the sealed item to "create" this monster.
As he spoke, he took off his windbreaker, first covered the hair and eyeballs, and then used the windbreaker as a net bag to hold the sealed item in the windbreaker.
As long as you don't look at the eyeballs, there will be no feeling of madness in your heart.
Hobert handed the windbreaker to Borgia: "Don't hold the windbreaker in your hand, lest the hair inside spread out and touch your skin. To the sealed item, you are just a lump of healthy flesh and blood."
Borgia nodded and put Hobert's windbreaker on the corner of the street.
Hobert said to the other two night watchmen: "Take me to your capture location, I'll see if I can find any clues about Hyman."
Hobert glanced at Borgia, who understood: "I'll guard the scene here."
Pretty clever!
Hobert followed the two night watchmen to the scene quickly. From quite a distance away, he heard crying.
Some of the windows of the houses on both sides of the street were broken, and some of the doors were missing. The "multi-eyed monster" had broken into many residents' homes and carried out a massacre. Many residents' families were killed.
The two night watchmen looked at each other and smiled bitterly. Captain Thomas also told them that one of the goals of the operation was not to harm innocent people, but they failed to do so.
Arriving at the capture location, the severely injured night watchman was lying on the street. A doctor living nearby, wearing pajamas, was trying hard to cover the wound on the night watchman's stomach.
When the doctor saw the night watchman's companion coming, he sighed and said, "He's dying."
Brian, the squad leader of the operation to capture Heyman, squeezed out a smile: "Thank you, doctor. Let us say a few last words to him, you go and rescue the others."
This is to prevent the team members from losing control before death.
After the doctor left, Brian held the hand of his teammate lying on the ground: "Will, do you have anything to say?"
"Tell Mary, I love her," said Will, the dying night watchman.
Brian nodded repeatedly: "Okay, I'll tell her."
"Brian, I ask for your forgiveness, your swallowtail coat was actually accidentally torn by me, causing you to be embarrassed at the engagement ceremony."
Brian was stunned for a moment, then became a little annoyed, but seeing his teammate's current appearance, he sighed: "Go in peace, I forgive you."
Hobert suddenly asked: "Have you finished giving your last words?"
Will nodded slowly.
"I'll 'sew up' his wound."
"It's useless," Will said: "I can feel that my life is..."
Hobert didn't waste time talking to him, took out the needle and thread for sewing up wounds that he had asked "Former Doctor" Fors to get for him, first stuffed the other party's internal organs back in, and then quickly "sewed up" the wound.
Brian immediately discovered: "The bleeding has stopped!"
Then Hobert cast a "healing spell," and he immediately lost his dying state.
He was first filled with joy, then he exchanged glances with Brian, and both of them had complex expressions in their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 197 The Harvest of Action (Bonus 24)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Bonus +1 for free member Emanuele Palumbo]
"Now is not the time for flirting," Hobert interrupted the eye contact between the two Night Watch members. "Will lost too much blood just now. Although his life isn't in danger, he's still very weak. You rest here, and the rest of you come with me to search Heyman's residence."
Brian nodded and immediately led Hobert the way.
After the team members left, Will finally felt the wonder of the mystical world. He had almost died, but he was still alive.
Just then, the doctor who had rescued him passed by. "You, you're not dead?"
Will quickly and unsteadily got up and said, "Doctor, thank you for taking care of me just now. Yes, well, I, one of my teammates is a skilled surgeon."
"Lord of Storms! I must be dreaming!" The doctor said incredulously, "Only in dreams would there be a surgeon who can heal wounds instantly."
...
Hobert and the other two arrived at Heyman's residence, which was a two-room apartment on the second floor.
Now both rooms were in a mess, filled with the smell of rotting flesh.
Hobert noticed several large pottery jars on the floor that had been broken. The foul smell was coming from the fragments of the pottery jars.
And on the table over there, there was also a smaller pottery jar. The lid of the pottery jar had an iron buckle that could firmly fasten the jar and the lid.
Hobert said, "That small jar should be what Heyman used to store sealed items, and these broken large jars must have contained a lot of rotten flesh. The main body of the 'Multi-Eyed Monster' should be pieced together from these rotten flesh."
He suddenly belatedly realized that although his ability to "discover loopholes" and "summarize rules" had not become stronger, his observation ability had become much stronger, and he could quickly find the clues he wanted.
For example, the pipe on the ground should be something Heyman left behind, but Hobert did not immediately remind the other Night Watch members.
He said to the Sequence 9 member, "Take this pottery jar to Borgia and have him store the sealed item.
"Wait, there should be something else, ah, found it, take it to Borgia together."
What Hobert found was a wooden clip that was dropped on the ground. Using it to clamp the sealed item would prevent him from being affected by the sealed item.
After the Sequence 9 member left, Hobert said to Brian, "Go to the room inside and see if there is any of Heyman's hair or his discarded personal belongings."
Brian had seen Hobert's strength in the previous battle, so he was willing to obey Hobert's orders.
When only Hobert was left in the room, he picked up the pipe that was half-covered by a tile and put it in his pocket.
If it were before, he would definitely give this clue to the Night Watch, because he had no divination pathway, and having clues was useless.
But now that Mr. K has come to Backlund and he has a divination pathway, he plans to keep this clue.
Maybe he can find a few more of Heyman's dens? The last den had more than 3,000 pounds in cash and property!
If he could find one or two more of these, wouldn't he be rich!
Hobert had previously obtained Heyman's pipe, but at that time Hobert was only Sequence 9, and because it involved the Aurora Order, Hobert did not dare to keep such clues.
Now it's different. Hobert is already Sequence 7, and he is the kind of Sequence 7 that can fight other Sequence 7s head-on, and he knows that Heyman is determined to leave the Aurora Order.
The former makes Hobert not worry that Heyman will trace back along the clues, and the latter makes Hobert not worry that the lunatics of the Aurora Order will trace back along this clue.
A few minutes later, Brian said, "I've searched, Heyman is very careful and didn't leave any clues."
Hobert nodded, "We'll go to the street to wait for follow-up support. Go around and ask if there are any people with severed limbs or large wounds. Bring them over and I'll stitch them up."
Brian immediately went downstairs, feeling very grateful to Hobert. Being able to save a person would lighten the punishment their team received.
Hobert carried a chair and sat down next to Will.
While resting, Hobert sorted out his feelings from the previous battle in his mind. At the moment of defeating the 'Multi-Eyed Monster', Hobert felt the liveliness of his spirituality and the loosening of the potion.
At that time, he realized that the process of defeating the 'Multi-Eyed Monster' must be able to summarize important information about digesting the 'Briber' potion, or about his own sequence.
Hobert first simply reviewed the previous battle: he found the weakness of the 'Multi-Eyed Monster' and dealt with it flexibly.
After a little thought, Hobert immediately understood that this combat process conformed to the characteristics of bribery.
Bribery is originally the process of finding the other party's weaknesses and then using these weaknesses to complete the bribe.
For example, if the administrative officer of a certain county is lecherous, then this is his weakness. Bribery is a further action taken against the weaknesses of others.
That is to say, in battle, or in court, or even on the field, as long as you find the other party's weaknesses and use that weakness to achieve your goal, you are also playing the role of a 'Briber'.
Then Hobert's thinking became more and more open, and he finally completely understood the description of the 'Briber' on the 'Black Emperor' card: "The real briber has understood the true meaning of 'loopholes'."
The opponent's weaknesses are the loopholes in him, and the reason why the Sequence 7 potion is called 'Briber' actually emphasizes the first half of the 'bribery process': finding channels for bribery.
This is a process of finding weaknesses and loopholes.
Hobert finally understood why the word "loopholes" was in quotation marks in the description. It refers to the concept of loopholes, not just loopholes in order or rules.
Having figured this out, Hobert felt the liveliness of his spirituality again, and he completely understood the meaning contained in the name of the 'Briber' potion.
At this time, Brian came over with several seriously injured residents. Hobert came back to his senses and began to use "stitching" to treat the injured residents.
More than half an hour later, police support arrived, and the follow-up work was handed over to them. Hobert and several Nighthawks members returned to the Blackthorn Security Company one after another.
Because the other teams had not returned yet, except for the 'Sleepless', everyone else was arranged to rest in the lounge.
Hobert lay on the sofa and slept for two or three hours before being woken up by Borgia.
All the Night Watch members have returned.
More than a dozen team members held a meeting in the conference room on the second floor to report on their respective results.
The actions of the six teams were not smooth in the capture of Hillman and Heyman. Hillman had foreseen the capture plan in advance and used mystical means to summon a Sequence 5 to help. Even with the use of 2-365 (the black gloves seized from the Tamara family), Hillman still escaped.
However, Hillman was also severely injured as a result, and it may take a long time to recover, or he may never recover to his best state and may lose hope of advancing.
After learning about the results of the other teams' actions, Thomas said, "There is no doubt that Hobert played an important role in this operation."
It is not necessary to mention that Hobert almost killed the "Shadow Ascetic" alone, which has exceeded the set task that Thomas gave him. Hobert's support and interception later were the main reasons Thomas praised him.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 198 The True Face of the Berserk Sea
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
At the meeting, Thomas informed everyone that the police would be launching a series of operations to arrest the involved cultists.
During the previous surveillance, the Nighthawks discovered many ordinary people who believed in evil gods, but this was not within the Nighthawks' jurisdiction.
After the Nighthawks' meeting, Hobert was called into Thomas's office alone.
Thomas said, "Without your timely support, many more people would have died in the Southern Bridge District tonight."
"Such a contribution is enough for me to apply for some rewards for you. Considering that we don't need to provide you with the main materials for promotion, as well as corresponding professional training, you have two choices in terms of rewards."
"The first choice is 500 pounds in cash, and the second choice is one-fifth of a 'Judge' Beyonder characteristic."
Generally speaking, it is difficult to hire a Sequence 7 to participate in a battle as dangerous as tonight's for 500 pounds, but Hobert is a member of the Nighthawks team, receives a salary, can do things under the banner of the Nighthawks, and is protected by the Evernight Goddess.
So these 500 pounds are just a reward for him, not a fee for hiring him to fight.
Hobert would of course choose the latter: "I choose the 'Judge' Beyonder characteristic."
Adding his previous merit accumulation, plus this one-fifth, he already has four-fifths of the "Judge" Beyonder characteristic.
In the eyes of official Beyonders, that is just a Sequence 6 Beyonder characteristic, worth about 2,500 pounds (in wild Beyonder gatherings, it will be priced at 3,200 to 3,500 pounds).
But in Hobert's eyes, that will be another four stacks of gold pounds!
Thomas nodded: "Okay, I will report your merits and register your accumulation."
Hobert asked: "Captain, can I use my channels to issue a reward for Heyman and Hillman? And issue a task to capture them?"
Thomas was taken aback: "Yes."
He pondered for a moment and then said: "Heyman's reward can be set at 600 pounds, and Hillman's reward can be set at 1,500 pounds, dead or alive. If the Nighthawks team catches these two people in advance, remember to withdraw the reward and task."
Usually, the reward for Sequence 8 is between 400 pounds and 500 pounds, but because Heyman is a "Swindler" and very cunning, the reward is exceptionally raised to 600 pounds.
And the reward for a Sequence 6 is generally between 1,800 pounds and 2,000 pounds, and there are even exceptions like Qilangos, with rewards as high as 10,000 pounds.
But because Hillman was severely injured, the reward is only 1,500 pounds.
Thomas can make the decision on this kind of thing, and he only needs to submit a report to the Archbishop later.
Hobert liked the phrase "dead or alive" the most, which means that he can receive a reward of 600 pounds from the Nighthawks team with Heyman's body, and he can also get his Beyonder characteristic and sell it for 600, no, 900 pounds.
After "settling" the merits, Hobert wrote a written report on this operation.
Borgia, who was on duty in the reception hall, said to Hobert, who was about to leave: "I'll have the coachman send you back."
Hobert was stunned for a moment, and then he seemed to realize something and looked at the clothes on his body. Because he had rescued many ordinary people who had been scratched by the "multi-eyed monster", there were many blood stains on his shirt and trouser legs.
If he took a taxi carriage like this, the coachman would probably send him directly to the police station.
When he left the Blackthorn Security Company, it was already dawn. This time of day is when the fog in Backlund is the thickest. Although the lights were on in front, the coachman did not dare to go too fast.
In the carriage, Hobert saw the figures who needed to get up early to work through the thick fog. He suddenly had a sense of accomplishment in protecting the city.
"Maybe this is why many official Beyonders are willing to protect a city with their lives," Hobert thought.
Back at 192 Blanca Street, Hobert changed his clothes, took a shower, and then began to catch up on sleep.
He got up just in time for Fors's lunch.
In a casual chat, Hobert learned that Fors would take Audrey to a Beyonder gathering this afternoon, which was suspected to have clues to the "Psychological Alchemists."
Hobert recalled that Audrey seemed to have established contact with the "Psychological Alchemists" from this gathering.
After lunch, Hobert, full of energy, walked to work. On the way to work, he suddenly thought: "Oops, I forgot to ask Thomas to reimburse me for the windbreaker."
But then he shook his head. Now he has thousands of pounds in his hand. Why would he care about this small amount of money?
He soon realized that it might be because he participated in the Tarot Club and was affected by the "God of Poverty."
...
On the Berserk Sea, Alger ordered the Blue Avenger to sail into the waters outside the channel, preparing to take the opportunity to get rid of the two three-masted sailing ships that had been tracking them for two days and two nights.
In theory, the speed of the pursuers was far lower than that of the Blue Avenger, but these pursuers were followers of the Sea God Kalvetua. Alger believed that there must be attendants of the Sea God on those two ships!
The sea breeze always blows their sails, and the waves always push them forward.
When they first sailed into the unknown sea, the sky was clear and the sea breeze was gentle, which looked similar to the sea in the channel.
More than ten minutes later, a cloud floated from the horizon. It looked like an ordinary white cloud, but when the distance was close enough, the white cloud began to turn black. In one or two minutes, the sky was covered with dark clouds.
Strong winds blew on the sea, and the waves were several meters high.
This is the unknown sea of the Berserk Sea. Such drastic changes only took one or two minutes.
Alger held the crystal scepter, closely watching the dark clouds ahead.
Several sailors on the ghost ship were trying hard to steer and struggling to take up the sails.
They didn't know how they had provoked those pursuers, and they didn't know why the captain would go crazy and order them to sail into the unknown sea.
Drip~
A hailstone the size of a bean fell not far from Alger, followed by the sound of "drip, drip" one after another. Suddenly, it started to hail. These hailstones were small, the size of beans, but most of them were the size of apples, and some were the size of watermelons.
The crew members were desperate. Hailstones the size of apples could kill people, and hailstones the size of watermelons could even sink the entire ship!
Alger held the scepter tightly, and a storm swept over, taking away all the hail in the sky above the Blue Avenger.
This storm lasted for a long time and has been protecting this ghost ship.
Alger breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, he obtained the crystal sapphire scepter in his hand during the previous exploration, otherwise he would not be able to get rid of the pursuers at all and would be caught up by them sooner or later.
In fact, Alger could also go ashore and seek help from the Punishers on a certain island, but in that case, he would have to expose the first location marked in the ruins.
Storms also blew over the two sailing ships behind, but they were only attendants of the Sea God, which was not comparable to Alger, an attendant of the Lord of the Storms.
Soon, the two sailing ships were sunk by hail, and the cold and ruthless waves devoured lives one by one.
Alger smiled slightly and began to direct the ship to sail away from the unknown sea. When they were safe, the crew members cast admiring glances, and of course, there were also questioning glances.
"Did you think I would take you to find death?" Alger had already found an excuse for himself: "When you went to the island to have fun before, I got a high-level storm charm!"
The questioning glances disappeared.
"I'm going to take a rest. Don't disturb me for the next period of time!" Alger entered the captain's room and glanced at the six pages of diary and the pattern copied from the ruins.
As soon as three o'clock arrived, Alger's vision was shrouded in gray fog. This week's Tarot Gathering has begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 199 The commission of the assassination of the ambassador
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Seeing the mysterious Mr. Fool and the Emperor with his amazing knowledge reserves, Alger finally breathed a sigh of relief. He smiled slightly, knowing that no matter what dangers he encountered at sea, the Tarot Club was his greatest support.
"Justice" Audrey noticed the expression of "Hanged Man" Alger, but she chose to greet everyone first, and then asked, "Mr. Hanged Man, you seem to have encountered some major changes?"
"Indeed, but now is not the time to talk about this," Alger said with a slight smile. "I will submit this week's six pages of diary first."
After the diary materialized, Alger complimented, "Mr. Fool, I also inquired about a piece of information regarding the Secret Order."
On the vast oceans, news is not blocked, just not timely. Those great pirates also value intelligence.
"Very good," "The Fool" Klein nodded slightly, signaling "Hanged Man" to tell the story.
Alger said, "Many pirates claim that they have killed members of the Secret Order. Without exception, those members are all Sequence 6. They are preparing to hire pirate ships to go deep into the Sonia Sea, and some are also inquiring about the whereabouts of mermaids."
Speaking of this, Alger glanced at "The Emperor": "According to Mr. Emperor's description last week, it can be speculated that mermaids are an indispensable part of the Secret Order's promotion ceremony, and there should be mermaids deep in the Sonia Sea."
For Klein, this was very important information. He had also heard that a ritual was required when Sequence 6 was promoted to Sequence 5.
And Alger provided two important pieces of information: mermaids and the Sonia Sea.
"Very good, you have also paid off your debts," Klein said in a supreme voice.
"Thank you for your generosity." Alger certainly knew that his information was far less comprehensive than "The Emperor's" knowledge.
This time, Klein did not rush to read the diary, but tapped the edge of the ancient long table with his fingers: "I am going to issue a mission."
Here it comes, Hobert thought to himself, the "5 pounds to assassinate the ambassador" plot is here. Ian, who commissioned Sherlock Holmes to investigate his employer, probably never dreamed that his 5 pounds commission fee would lead to the death of an ambassador.
This is a genuine "famous scene".
Mission? Audrey's ears twitched, her eyes widened, both surprised, expectant, and uneasy.
She clearly remembered that this was the first time Mr. Fool had officially issued a mission!
At the same time, she keenly noticed that "Hanged Man" seemed to have not changed, but was actually unusually nervous.
Even "The Emperor", who had always maintained his composure, seemed a little excited. Hey? That's not right, why are "The Emperor's" body movements and expressions so much like the reaction when watching an exciting part of a drama or opera?
Because of the limited time, Audrey did not delve into this issue, she looked at "The Sun" again, the entire gathering only "The Sun" was ignorant, treating this as a very normal thing.
"You can choose to accept it or not," Klein said in a relaxed tone. "My other Blessed has arrived in Backlund. He wants to complete something, but it is inconvenient for him to come forward."
Another Blessed? Alger nodded as if in contemplation, not at all surprised by this.
In his eyes, it was a default fact that a powerful being like Mr. Fool possessed multiple Blessed.
Audrey felt a little guilty. She still felt that she owed Mr. Fool's Blessed a generous reward. After all, she had received the rewards from three countries for Qilangos, totaling about 30,000 pounds. In theory, she should at least give half to Mr. Fool's Blessed.
Hobert complained in his heart: What the hell is "another Blessed"? Is that Blessed named Sherlock Moriarty? And this Blessed looks very similar to your other Blessed Klein Moretti. It is very likely that the two are twins, yes, long-lost twin brothers.
Seeing that everyone was silent, Klein issued the mission: "The thing he wants to accomplish is to assassinate the Intis Republic's ambassador to the Loen Kingdom, Bakerland Jean Madan."
"Assassinate the Intis Republic's ambassador?" Audrey couldn't control her expression and asked in astonishment.
This is an act that will cause disputes between the two countries, and even spark war! As a noble lady, she first thought of international relations.
As for the question of why Mr. Fool did not do it himself, she felt it was a matter of course: How can there be a big shot who always helps his subordinates?
Alger was only slightly surprised by this mission, his focus was on another part: Mr. Fool is still unable to deeply interfere with the real world! My guess is correct.
Derrick, "The Sun", listened with a blank look: What is the Intis Republic? What is an ambassador? This pieced-together giant language is very strange!
Hobert suddenly diverged his thinking: "With my current strength, if I fight one-on-one, I am quite confident to complete this commission. After all, the ambassador is not a military attache, and most of his energy will be focused on diplomacy and politics, and he will not have much combat experience.
But there will be no such opportunity. After all, that is an ambassador. There are extraordinary people around him to protect him. To assassinate him, you first need to break into or sneak into the embassy. Some Sequence 6s with strange abilities or powerful sealed artifacts can do this. If it is Sequence 5, then there will be absolute certainty."
Klein looked around, maintaining his relaxed attitude just now: "Who of you is willing to accept this mission? What reward do you want to get?"
Audrey, who wanted to raise her hand, hesitated: I can't convince myself to kill an innocent person for no reason.
Hobert smiled and said, "I think this ambassador will also be the intelligence chief of the Intis Republic at the same time."
He spread his hands: "I have not been in contact with him, and I don't know the specific situation, but I know that the ambassador of the Feynapotter Kingdom once supported a cult organization in South Wales County of the Loen Kingdom.
"These cult organizations are inhumane, and even require believers to sacrifice babies! However, the Feynapotter ambassador has been providing them with funds. After the organization was dissolved, he also sheltered many cadres who fled to the Southern Continent and the Feynapotter Kingdom."
Audrey was slightly stunned. She did not expect that Ambassador Tim, who looked gentle and had a very soft voice, would have such a side: "Mr. Emperor, why are you so clear about this?"
"Because I had the honor to participate in the operation to encircle and kill these cult cadres. If we had not encircled and killed two of the cadres that night, they would have been sent to the Southern Continent by the Feynapotter ambassador."
Hobert dared to say this because if anyone wanted to investigate, they would only find the mercenary team that broke through the headquarters of the cult organization.
As for the fact that Hobert and Xio and others encircled and killed the two cult cadres and that they were to be arranged to go to the Southern Continent, Hobert did not tell anyone.
So even if he revealed so much information, he would not worry about others finding out about him.
Audrey said: "I salute you, Mr. Emperor, your actions are the best interpretation of justice."

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 200 See Elf Culture Elements Again
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hearing Audrey's praise, Hobert smiled slightly: "I'm just using what I know as an example. I don't think the Intis Republic ambassador is any better."
Alger also seemed to see Audrey's hesitation: "Whether the two countries will go to war only depends on whether the upper echelons of both sides want to fight, and has nothing to do with the life or death of a diplomat."
He added: "I'm not sure if this ambassador is a Beyonder, but many clues indicate that he probably is.
"In addition, there must be many Beyonders around him, Beyonders belonging to the Intis intelligence agency. This department has long been influenced by the original royal family, the Sauron family, and controls part of the 'Hunter' pathway."
Hearing the information provided by "Emperor" and "Hanged Man", Audrey's hesitation disappeared immediately. After pondering for a few seconds, Audrey looked at the head of the long bronze table with some guilt: "Mr. Fool, I can try to complete this task, but I may not succeed."
"I also accept this task." Alger explained with a smile: "Although I am not in Backlund, it does not mean that I have no way to assassinate Ambassador Bakerland."
In order not to show his specialness, Hobert also said: "Me too, but like Miss Justice, I'm not very confident."
Only Derrick had not been able to integrate into this topic.
Klein didn't expect two Sequence 7s and one Sequence 8 to succeed: "What rewards do you want to get?"
Alger and Hobert both said that they would talk about it after it became a task, only Audrey blurted out: "The 'Psychologist' formula!"
Then she added hesitantly: "This can be discussed after the task is completed. If it can be successful, I will bear the cost. I, I still owe your Blessed a bounty."
Bounty? So Qilangos' bounty was given to Miss Justice. Klein replied in a normal tone: "Okay."
Then, Klein began to read Roselle's diary.
Audrey breathed a sigh of relief, finally saying it. Although this would make her a little embarrassed for the next period of time, there would be no more burden in her heart.
When Klein finished reading the diary, everyone turned their attention to "Hanged Man".
Alger hesitated for a moment and still said: "I, I am being hunted by the Blessed of the 'Sea God', Kalvetua."
He smiled and said: "Fortunately, I still have the protection of Mr. Fool. Mr. Fool, if the situation is urgent, can I pray for your help? I will pay you."
Klein suddenly felt a chill down his spine. Even if he didn't know what kind of god the "Sea God" was, he knew what a real "God's Blessed" represented. His evil god was just an empty shell, and now he could only accept sacrifices and bestow things.
He thought to himself: Why don't you try to sacrifice the "Sea God" to me? Uh, if that's the case, the "Sea God" might be the one holding the Tarot Gathering in the future!
But he couldn't show timidity at this time. Klein said: "Okay!"
However, the right to decide whether to help depends on Mr. Fool.
After receiving Mr. Fool's reply, Alger continued to narrate: "After returning to the sea from Backlund, I continued my previous exploration and came to the first location marked by the Elf ruins.
"That location is in the northwest of Blue Mountain Island, near a small island called Met Island. I rested there for one night before starting the exploration of the first location.
"That morning, taking advantage of the calm sea, I found an excuse to drop anchor in the designated sea area, and sneaked underwater while the crew was resting.
"As soon as I entered the water, I found many sea monsters wandering in this sea area. You may not know what this means. The sea area where a certain sea monster often wanders often has ships missing.
"The strange thing is that so many sea monsters are in the same sea area, but there are no rumors of ships missing near Met Island."
Alger paused and glanced at "Emperor". In fact, Alger probably guessed that these sea monsters might have been attracted by that "high sequence" Beyonder characteristic, but he lacked enough high-level Beyonder knowledge and was not sure of his guess.
Hobert saw Alger's gaze, but he had no intention of answering now: "And then?"
"Then I carefully used a magical item of mine to avoid those sea monsters." Alger continued: "When I continued to dive, I saw light at the bottom of the water.
"After carefully observing and confirming that those lights were my destination, I continued to move forward and soon came to a structure that looked like a huge bubble.
"There was actually a dry space at the bottom of the sea! And the light was emitted by a kind of coral that I had never seen before!"
Audrey listened with fascination. She had always hoped for this kind of adventure in unknown seas or regions. Following "Hanged Man's" narration, she also fantasized about exploring the seabed with Susie.
Wait, why bring Susie?
Derrick listened carefully to "Hanged Man's" description of the ocean. He had only seen descriptions of the ocean in textbooks, and they were very concise.
Hobert also listened very carefully. For him, this was a brand new experience under his guidance.
Alger's narration continued: "I entered that area. There was oxygen inside, and the air was very fresh.
"In the dim light, I saw a hall with an architectural style that was very different from the current North and South continents, and the architectural style of the hall was very similar to the Elf architecture depicted in the previous murals.
"After slowly approaching the hall, I actually found people living inside, and their clothes looked very much like clergy.
"After observing for a while, I felt that the risk of sneaking into the hall was very high, so I circled around the hall and found some collapsed ruins and debris, and found some patterns in the ruins.
"Mr. Fool, can you help me materialize those patterns?"
After receiving "Fool's" approval, Alger materialized the patterns he saw.
Hobert immediately recognized that those patterns were a bit like "taotie patterns". He estimated that "Mr. Fool", as a keyboard warrior, would not recognize this, because it was rare in his life before time-traveling. Hobert only came into contact with these patterns because of his work in the AD era, otherwise he wouldn't know.
The shape of the taotie pattern is a solemn beast face outlined with simple and elegant lines, also called the beast face pattern.
Or a pattern that looks a bit like a bird face and a gecko body. It should actually be a human face and a sheep body, but the appearance outlined with lines looks very much like a bird face and a beast body.
The patterns provided by Alger have obviously been "modified", but the essence of the beast face pattern, or taotie pattern, is still there.
Hobert said: "These patterns also conform to the cultural characteristics of the elves. It is said that they depict a very gluttonous beast in ancient times. This pattern is often seen in sacrificial occasions or carved on ritual objects."
Alger frowned: "I thought this would be the image representing the 'Sea God', because the clothes of the 'Sea God's' Blessed are embroidered with similar patterns."

chapters.content:

Hearing Hobert's detailed description, Alger guessed, "Could it be that a devotee of the 'God of the Sea' is 'borrowing' the symbols of the Elven race? Or, is it..."
Alger suddenly had a bold guess, but because it was somewhat blasphemous, and because he was in front of The Fool, he didn't know how to say it for a moment.
Hobert already roughly understood what was going on, and he said, "Continue speaking, we'll discuss this issue later."
Alger nodded and continued to narrate: "At the time, I was preparing to first collect some information before conducting further exploration, but after I left that sea area, I discovered that I seemed to be targeted by the followers of the 'Sea God'.
"Previously, I had contact with some followers of the 'Sea God'. Although what they did was somewhat insane, as long as you didn't offend them, they were willing to have some exchanges and trades with me.
"I didn't have any actions that would offend them, but the followers of the Sea God on Met Island all cast hostile gazes at me.
"Realizing that something was wrong, I immediately left, and soon the devotees of the 'Sea God' caught up with me. No matter what methods I used to evade them, they were always able to find me. I spent two days and two nights maneuvering around them before finding an opportunity to eliminate them.
"However, I'm certain that new devotees will catch up soon. Therefore, I'm seeking help from everyone at the Tarot Gathering. How should I resolve the problem before me?"
Audrey raised her hand: "Mr. Hanged Man, I would like to ask a question first, what kind of god is the God of the Sea? I haven't heard of it."
"The Sea God is a deity worshiped on some colonial islands," Alger explained. "It is said that He is capricious and fond of blood sacrifices.
"Some believers who pray for the calming of the waves will receive an accurate response from the God of the Sea; some believers who pray for the God of the Sea to calm the waves find that the God of the Sea makes the waves even bigger.
"I have heard more than once that the followers of the God of the Sea pleased their god with blood sacrifices, allowing them to obtain many storm domain charms. Of course, sometimes it would turn all the participating believers into monsters."
Audrey was somewhat surprised: "There's such a god? This should be..."
She was about to say that this should be an evil god, but considering that Mr. Fool was not an orthodox deity either, such existences were also called evil gods in the orthodox churches.
Therefore, she couldn't continue speaking halfway through.
Just as Audrey hesitated whether or not to apologize to Mr. Fool, Hobert suddenly spoke, resolving the awkwardness: "Comparing Mr. Fool with this kind of wild god is disrespectful to Mr. Fool!"
Only then did Audrey naturally apologize to Mr. Fool: "Sorry, Mr. Fool, I shouldn't have said that."
At the same time, she was grateful to "Emperor" for helping her out of the predicament.
Klein smiled slightly, without making any response, as if this was something not worth his attention.
He appeared calm on the surface, but he was a little bit guilty inside, because he didn't even know what kind of god the God of the Sea was.
He was really a little afraid that "Hanged Man" or "Justice" would ask him about the information of the God of the Sea. With "Emperor's" words, Klein was slightly relieved. It didn't matter if he couldn't answer, after all, the level of the God of the Sea was too low.
Thinking of this, Klein became even more guilty.
Hobert smiled and said, "Let's first solve the problem facing Mr. Hanged Man."
Alger asked, "What reward do you want?"
"I believe that as a member of the Tarot Club, helping other members solve difficulties doesn't require any reward," Hobert followed up with, "I roughly understand what happened to you, and I can try to help you solve the difficulties, but if you need me to provide an explanation, you need to pay me some reward, because it involves some advanced knowledge."
Alger nodded: "Thank you for your generosity."
Hobert asked, "Did you bring anything out of the ruins?"
"I brought out a small piece of luminous coral, and a piece of jade engraved with elven patterns from the ruins," Alger said. "But when I discovered that the devotees of the God of the Sea seemed to know my whereabouts, I threw all these things into the sea."
Hobert asked again, "Are there any items that suddenly appeared on your ship? Or any crew members who suddenly became abnormal?"
"I checked carefully, and I didn't find such a situation."
As an old sea dog, Alger still had this vigilance.
After eliminating these possibilities, there was only one place left. Hobert asked again, "Have you checked the bottom of the ship?"
"I, I haven't checked," Alger said. "I'll check the bottom of the ship immediately after the gathering ends."
It wasn't that Alger wasn't careful enough, but a blind spot, or a loophole, was something that people who spent time at sea were more likely to overlook.
Hobert was now very good at finding such loopholes, and he said, "Driving underwater creatures to serve oneself is one of the abilities of the God of the Sea. If the problem really lies at the bottom of the ship, it shouldn't be difficult to find.
"If the problem isn't at the bottom of the ship, you can pray to The Fool, and I'll help you think about other possibilities."
The more Alger thought about it, the more he felt that the problem should be at the bottom of the ship: "Thank you for your help."
Hobert smiled and said, "As for why you have such an encounter, let me ask you a few questions.
"Are the followers of 'God of the Sea' Kalvetua only in some sea areas?"
Alger was stunned, then nodded: "Yes."
"Among the followers of the God of the Sea, are there some elven patterns or cultural elements circulating?"
Alger recalled: "Yes!"
"Are you guessing that the God of the Sea is actually a surviving powerhouse of the Elven race? But you don't understand how he possesses some of the abilities that only gods have?"
Alger trembled: "Yes!"
"Wait," Audrey suddenly said, "Mr. Emperor, are you saying that the God of the Sea is an ordinary person, no, I mean a Beyonder is acting as? Or an elf is acting as?"
This, such an idea is too blasphemous.
Klein behind the gray fog finally understood why "Emperor" called the God of the Sea a "wild god", it turned out that he was just a "High-Sequence" Beyonder.
"This is the content that needs to be paid for next," Hobert said, "Everyone, do you want to know the principles behind this?"
I want to know too much! Audrey clenched her fists, but she should be very financially strapped next, and she didn't know if she could afford this information fee.
Derrick, who hadn't spoken all along, also showed enough interest.
Alger simply asked, "What reward do you want?"
The three questions of "Emperor" just now had aroused all his curiosity. If the reward was not too high, he would be happy to get the answer.
"800 pounds!" Hobert said: "When the transaction is completed, you will find that it is absolutely worth the money."
Alger nodded, still within an acceptable range.
He was about to initiate the transaction, when he only heard Hobert say again: "You all seem to want to know, how about this, as a member of the Tarot Club, I'll give you a discount.
"If only one person wants to know the answer, they need to pay me 800 pounds. If two people want to know the answer, they only need to pay me 500 pounds each. If three people want to trade with me, they only need to pay me 400 pounds each."
Klein behind the gray fog suppressed the urge to cover his face: Do you think this is Pinduoduo here? Why are you doing group buying?

As the daughter of a banker, Audrey immediately realized that the "Emperor's" trading method, while seemingly benefiting the buyer, actually benefited both the seller and the buyer.
She couldn't help but marvel inwardly, "The Emperor" is truly a business genius, turning an 800 pound deal into 1200 pounds.
Alger was happy to accept, of course, since he could spend half the money.
Only Derrick said, "Mr. Emperor, what if I don't have your pounds?"
"You can pay with extraordinary materials," Hobert had already thought it out for him, "I'll give you a rough conversion, a Sequence 8 main material is worth about 300 pounds.
"You can ask Mr. Fool or Mr. Hanged Man, I'm giving you a low price, although there will be a premium, there is also a certain probability that you won't be able to sell it for 300 pounds.
"So we will trade according to the low price, um, the value of the materials you give should be a little higher than 400 pounds, because I still have to find channels to sell them."
"No need to ask," Derrick said, "Mr. Emperor, I believe you."
Hobert sighed: Little Sun is still too young!
This reminded Hobert of his university days, even though he had been hurt by this society and people, he was always full of trust in the people around him.
As his thoughts swirled, Hobert asked, "Is everyone trading with me?"
Audrey said, "Yes!" As long as she saved a little, it wouldn't be difficult to come up with 400 pounds.
Alger and Derrick also nodded one after another.
Hobert said, "Okay, Mr. Hanged Man, you now owe me a total of 1400 pounds, Miss Justice and Mr. Sun can pay me in a few days."
Alger nodded: "I also need a few days to give it to you, with Mr. Fool as a witness, I won't go back on my word."
He didn't have so much cash on hand now and needed to handle some items on the island to clear his debts.
Hobert nodded: "No problem. Then, with Mr. Fool as a witness, the transaction begins!"
He said: "Mr. Hanged Man's guess is correct, the palace he saw at the bottom of the sea is indeed the 'Temple' of the Sea God Kalvetua.
"And Kalvetua is not a strong elf who survived in the world, I have this judgment based on two clues.
"The first clue is Mr. Hanged Man's discovery in the previous ruins. At that time, the mixed-blood in the ruins described it very clearly. The three locations he marked were all the locations where the strong had fallen.
"They should have sent people to search the three locations more than once. If there were any surviving elf powerhouses, then they must have gone to seek refuge with this powerhouse.
"The second clue is that after the Sea God began to have believers, the Storm Church should have begun to pay attention to him. If he were an elf remnant, then the Sea God must have existed for more than a thousand years.
"The Storm Church could not have failed to locate the Sea God's position in such a long time, so the Sea God's believers should have only appeared in the last one or two hundred years, or even a shorter time.
"Based on the above clues, I have this guess."
Alger nodded: "Indeed, the belief in the Sea God has only appeared in the last few decades."
Hobert continued: "So I guess, the Sea God should be someone, or even a sea monster, who swallowed the high-level Beyonder characteristics left by the elves."
"Sea monster?" Alger asked in surprise.
Klein, who was getting a free ride behind the gray fog, felt that this was really possible. If it was a sea monster with Beyonder characteristics of the "Sailor" pathway in its body, then its huge size would likely dilute the burden of Beyonder characteristics, and there was a small probability that it could successfully take the potion out of sequence and become a "High Sequence" in one fell swoop.
Audrey was already having a hard time keeping up with Hobert's thinking and could only listen carefully first and think about it after the transaction was completed.
Derrick also felt that Hobert's statement was very fresh, and he thought: I wonder if the monsters we encounter during patrols will advance by swallowing other monsters?
Alger's knowledge was enough for him to understand this, but he was a little surprised when he first heard Hobert say this, and then he accepted Hobert's guess.
"That's right, it's a sea monster," Hobert said, "It is because the Sea God is a sea monster that he is bloodthirsty and likes blood sacrifices so much.
"Another reason that supports my guess is that if a person successfully advances to Sequence 3, the most likely situation is that there are now five 'Kings' at sea.
"He would never wait in one place for the Storm Church to find him.
"From this, I can also guess that the Sea God's condition is not very good. He must not have had the assistance of a ritual when he swallowed that characteristic.
"So the Sea God's believers are so crazy, because their God is in a semi-mad state. Even the Sea God himself may not be able to leave the elven ruins."
Alger nodded, feeling that the "Emperor's" guess should be very accurate.
Audrey and Derrick admired the "Emperor" for guessing so many things based on the limited clues after listening to the "Hanged Man's" description.
Klein couldn't help but sigh: The "Emperor's" analysis is reasonable and logical, as if he knows the answer to the question.
Klein was right this time, Hobert certainly knew the answer to this question, which was like solving a math problem, knowing the conditions and the answer, all that was needed was to "write out" the calculation process.
"Another important piece of information is that, as far as I know, after becoming Sequence 3, you can design a name of honor that points to yourself," Hobert continued: "It's just that Sequence 3 can only respond to believers' prayers within a certain range.
"A common Sequence 3 honorific, one section of which is someone's something, such as 'Servant of the Fool' or 'Favored by the Fool'.
"Because the Sea God is not a saint of a certain church, he may not have a section with this structure, but there will definitely be a description of the region, such as something of Backlund, or something of a certain sea area."
Alger immediately understood why the "Emperor" could guess that the Sea God's followers were only within a certain range, because the Sea God could only respond to prayers within a certain range.
At the same time, he recalled some names of honor that he had heard. Like the "Emperor's" description, some names of honor circulated in the church had sections such as "Something of the Lord of Storms". And one section of the Sea God Kalvetua's honorific was: "Protector of the Rorsted Archipelago".
Then Alger became a little excited, imagining the scene where he could design his own name of honor and respond to his believers after he became Sequence 3.
Audrey sighed that the 400 pounds was really worth it, and she actually heard such advanced knowledge.
Derrick was a little sad: Silver City does not have Sequence 3, so we do not know this knowledge, or there are corresponding descriptions in some ancient books in the library, but they have long been forgotten by us.
Finally, Hobert smiled and said: "Everyone, this is the Sea God."

The transaction ended, and Audrey, still feeling unsatisfied, initiated a transaction with Derrick regarding information about the 'Dragon of Imagination'. Originally, Audrey wanted to trade with 'The Emperor', after all, 'The Emperor' might have more comprehensive knowledge, but the price should also be more expensive.
Audrey, who had never worried about money, began to calculate carefully, feeling that she could temporarily get a general idea from 'The Sun' first, and ask 'The Emperor' about things she didn't understand when she had money.
And Derrick hoped to obtain the Sequence 8 potion formula for the 'Bard' pathway.
So Klein initiated a three-way transaction, with him first paying Derrick's reward, providing the potion formula for 'Light Supplicant', while the reward Audrey needed to pay would be transferred to The Fool.
As for what the reward was, Klein only said, "There's no need to rush. Perhaps my blessed will need help with something in the future."
Hobert, sitting at the lower position, immediately complained in his heart: Shameless, how dare he use 'they'! Your only blessed is yourself! Speaking of which, I have at least two followers, and I'm too embarrassed to say that.
Then Derrick began to describe the dragons in their textbooks, and mentioned the 'Dragon of Imagination' Ankewelt, and his son, the 'Nightmare Dragon' Alzuhod.
This immediately reminded Audrey and Klein of 'The Emperor's' previous description of 0-08. This sealed artifact was the extraordinary characteristic condensed after Alzuhod's death. They seemed to have a thorough understanding of the 'characters' of the ancient era.
At Audrey's request, Mr. Fool removed the sensory blockade on Hobert.
Audrey asked Hobert, "Emperor, is 'Dragon of Imagination' Ankewelt one of the eight ancient gods you mentioned before?"
Hobert nodded, "Yes."
Audrey asked again, "Could it be that these ancient gods are all leaders of races like dragons and giants?"
Hobert only gave simple yes or no answers. He nodded and said vaguely, "You could say that."
In fact, humanoid Beyonder creatures such as giants and elves are all mutations of humans.
"Thank you for your answer," Audrey said. "This gives me a systematic understanding of some ancient history."
Hobert smiled and said nothing.
After chatting for a few more words, Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.
...
In the safe sea lane of the Berserk Sea, Alger recalled the exchanges at the Tarot Gathering. He immediately got up and opened the door of the captain's room, preparing to dive under the ship immediately to take a look.
But as soon as he opened the door, he saw two sailors waiting outside.
One of the sailors said, "Captain! Another ship is catching up!"
They had knocked on the door hard just now, but had not received any response, because this was a ghost ship, and without the captain's permission, the sailors could not open the door of the captain's room at all. Even if they rammed the door, it would be difficult to open the cabin door.
"I know!" Alger said casually with a livid face, "I just took a nap."
He now had two choices. One choice was to report the location of the God of the Sea's 'Temple' to the Church. As long as the Church killed the God of the Sea, Alger would definitely receive a generous reward.
The second choice was to hide the report and wait until he became a demigod in the future to replace the God of the Sea.
In the end, Alger chose the second option. At worst, he would no longer trade with the followers of the God of the Sea in the future, but Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 3 were not so easy to encounter.
Having figured this out, Alger's pace became more forceful. When he came to replace the God of the Sea, it would mean that there would be another king on the sea.
Alger came to the deck, took a steel javelin for dealing with sea monsters, and then dived into the water, searching along the bottom of the ship.
The bottom of the ship looked old and dilapidated, and was covered with barnacles. Alger sighed: It's time to find a dock to clean up these annoying things again.
When he reached the stern of the ship, Alger saw a colorful chiton attached to the bottom of the ship: That's it!
The chiton is called a chiton because its shape resembles a stone, not because it always moves in places with rocks.
Different from ordinary chitons, the colorful chiton has a much larger size than ordinary chitons. Its single eye and scales are relatively common mysticism materials.
The chiton in front of Alger was as long as a forearm, and its shape was a regular ellipse. The single eye had four colors: black, gray, green, and blue.
At this time, the single eye of the colorful chiton also saw Alger. Some of its shell plates stood up and shot towards Alger.
Alger manipulated the water flow, changing the trajectory of those shell plates, causing them to hit elsewhere.
Then Alger held a steel javelin and pried the chiton off the bottom of the ship. The chiton immediately waved its scales and fled quickly, but it was too late.
Alger was more agile underwater than on land. A layer of magical scales appeared on his body, which made him faster than a fish underwater.
Aiming at the opportunity, Alger pierced the colorful chiton's softest abdomen with the javelin, piercing it directly through.
Then Alger quickly swam to the surface, while the sea water seemed to have life, trying to hold Alger up.
The moment he swam out of the water, Alger jumped up, jumping onto the boat like a flying fish.
Alger held up the colorful chiton that was still trying to shake its scales: "This is the mark that the pursuers quietly placed on our ship!"
As he spoke, he threw the colorful chiton on the deck, stepped on it with his foot, and used one hand to dig out its colorful eyeballs.
The entire colorful chiton twitched a few times and then stopped moving.
"As long as we solve the pursuers behind us, we will be safe," Alger said. "Go to Leaking Island!"
The sailors smiled evilly: "Aye, Captain."
Leaking Island was a deserted island they accidentally discovered. There was a steep high mountain on the island, with many fruit trees, which could replenish the fruits needed during the voyage.
In addition, the high mountain of the island blocked several large whirlpools behind the island. When you turn past the island and see those whirlpools, it is too late to turn the rudder.
And the "Blue Avenger" is a ghost ship, which can flexibly shuttle between the whirlpools according to the captain's will.
Alger and others have used this advantage to bury three batches of enemies on Leaking Island.
After the sailors went to work, Alger was processing the scales of the colorful chiton with a dagger while feeling in his heart: This is the only gain from this exploration, and these materials can only be sold for 200 pounds together.
The consequence is that it will be difficult to have dealings with the followers of the God of the Sea again, and they are also constantly on guard against their pursuit.
Then Alger realized that many times, exploration may not be able to achieve one's desired purpose, perhaps this is the true meaning of navigation.
He immediately felt the digestion of the potion, which made Alger realize again that his thoughts just now were one of the important rules of playing the role of a navigator.

Backlund, Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
Audrey sat on a soft stool, considering how to complete Mr. Fool's commission. Soon, she thought of two ways: one was to ask Xio and Fors, and commission Mr. A, whom she had met before.
Although Mr. A's gaze was annoying, he should be a very powerful Beyonder.

Of course, with Hobert's strength, it seemed that he could not complete the assassination commission, but he was the eldest son of General Christian, and he had extensive connections in Backlund's Beyonder world. He should have certain channels to re-delegate the task, and at worst, pay some intermediary fees.
After a little hesitation, Audrey prepared to take the path of Xio and Fors first. Just as she was about to write letters to the two ladies, she realized a very crucial problem: she knew very little about Intis Ambassador Bakerland. In this case, it was easy to misjudge the difficulty of the task, and then entrust it to an inappropriate person.
After pondering for a moment, Audrey turned to the maid Annie and said, "I accept Countess Caliari's invitation and will attend the ball she is holding tonight on time."
Caliari is the Countess of Wolfe. Her upcoming ball will invite ambassadors from various countries stationed in Loen, including Intis Ambassador Bakerland.
Originally, Audrey had refused the invitation, but out of politeness, she would inform the ball organizer a few hours before the ball that she could not come because she had something to do.
According to convention, the servants have not yet informed the Countess of Wolfe of this news.
Audrey decided to observe Ambassador Bakerland first, collect enough information, and then meet with Xio and Fors.

15 Minsk Street. Klein, who had returned to the real world from the 'Sefirah Castle', opened the curtains and sat at his desk, thinking about his current situation.
First of all, from the information provided by 'Emperor' last week, and from this week's diary, it was determined that the Secret Order had close cooperation with the Intis Republic, and it was also understood that the iron-black nematode that sneaked into his room last night to check the information he left on the desk was the work of a 'Seer' pathway Beyonder.
The task of assassinating the ambassador has also been commissioned. I just don't know if it will be successful. In short, he has done everything possible to deal with it. Whether he can survive this crisis can only depend on fate.
Klein looked at the fog outside the window that had finally dissipated, and decided to go to the 'Bravehearts Bar' again tonight to see if he could meet other Beyonders and lay the foundation for choosing a bodyguard.
After confirming his thoughts, Klein read the newspaper and waited for the sky to darken.
...
Forsaken Land of the Gods, City of Silver
Derrick returned to his dim room and stared blankly at the lightning in the sky outside for a while.
He tried to imagine what the sea looked like, and tried to imagine the feeling of swimming in the sea.
Thinking about it, a burst of sadness appeared in his heart again.
If he didn't know the outside world, he wouldn't be so sad, but the problem is, he knows it, but he can't touch it.
"Lord! Please send down your light to guide your devout believers!"
Derrick's 'praise' immediately filled the room with light, and he seemed to gain courage from the light: With Mr. Fool's guidance, and with the help of Mr. Emperor and the others, I am closer to hope than other people in City of Silver.
So he tidied up his clothes and prepared to go to the training ground to train first, and strive to pass the instructor's assessment. As long as he passed the assessment, he could be assigned to the patrol team.
As long as he starts serving City of Silver, he can earn merits and exchange merits for extraordinary materials to repay the Emperor's debts.
After training, he also planned to go to the library to find more descriptions about Sequence 3 Saints.
Derrick tried to put on a smile: Hahaha, life is full of hope again.
...
Backlund, 192 Blanca Street.
Hobert returned to his room. The weather was not very good today. It seemed like it was going to rain.
Hobert put on another piece of clothing for himself and prepared to return to the law firm to work until he got off work.
Over the past few days, the work of their team has gradually become regular, and there are no more backlogged letters.

Blanca Street, Hobert, who was sleeping soundly, suddenly sneezed, which woke him up, and it took a long time to fall asleep again.

Hobert had a busy morning, winning both lawsuits, which was a good start for their team.
During lunch, Hobert reviewed the recent defenses with Jessica and Rasga, pointing out several mistakes they made during the arguments.
The newcomer Jessica listened and took notes, forgetting to eat her meal.
Rasga also listened attentively and was glad that he made the right choice by joining Hobert's new team. For him, this was a good opportunity to increase his experience.
Especially Hobert's approach of reviewing their performance was a rare learning opportunity that was hard to come by when working as an assistant to other lawyers.
After lunch, Hobert asked Jessica and Rasga to go back first, as he had to visit a "client."
Following the address given by Harvey Hayden, Hobert arrived at 1899 Nikola Row.
Just as he got out of the carriage, he sensed something and looked at a delicate and spacious private carriage. The window was open, and he saw an old man and a middle-aged man sitting opposite each other inside.
The middle-aged man had long hair and looked a bit greasy. He was the person in charge of the Tamara family that he saw when giving the Tamara family member a spirit medium consultation before.
In front of the old man, the middle-aged man looked somewhat flattering, not even smoking a cigar.
The battle had been over for so long that Hobert was no longer afraid of seeing people from the Tamara family. He remembered the old man's appearance and then looked at the sign for number 1899: Keen Machinery Firm.
At this moment, the old man and the long-haired Alva in the carriage also seemed to sense something and looked at Hobert. However, Hobert was already looking at the "Keen Machinery" sign, so he did not attract their attention.
The two didn't pay attention and continued on their way.
This old man was one of the people sent by the Tamara family to investigate why the team clearing out the traitors was destroyed. He was responsible for the overt investigation, but after investigating for more than ten days, he had not found any results. He could only accept Alva's statement in the report: the action team was killed by the Loen royal family.
Today was the old man's departure day, and Alva was preparing to personally send him to the train station.
On the other side, Hobert entered the hall of the business house without panic, and asked the front desk to see Mr. Digos, and asked the front desk to tell him that he was Hobert Jeffrey.
He was already accustomed to the "Nation of Disorder's" attraction to Beyonders of the same sequence. Other Beyonders could not yet feel the connection between him and the "Nationof Disorder," so he was so calm.
The front desk was originally going to reject Hobert's request, but when she heard Hobert report his name, she knew that he might be a friend of Mr. Digos, so she asked Hobert to wait on the sofa for a while while she went upstairs to report.
However, this trip took half an hour. Half an hour later, the little girl came back panting: "Mr. Dico invites you to meet at the steam water pump factory."
Hobert followed the little girl and saw the huge factory area behind the business house. From the hall of the business house, Hobert could see that Digos's business was very large, but he did not expect it to be so large.
These factories were all workshops for producing large machinery, such as steam cranes, steam textile machines, steam sugar presses, steam mining machines, steam machine tools, and even steam train heads.
It took a full ten minutes to reach the steam water pump factory.
Entering through the small door of the factory, Hobert saw more than a dozen steam water pumps being assembled in the wide factory building.
Because Emperor Roselle had not popularized the concept of "production line," the dozen or so steam engines were being assembled at the same time. Although it was time-consuming and labor-intensive, the scene was very spectacular.
The entire workshop was filled with the sounds of clanging and shouting.
Some parts were too large and required complex pulley structures or several people to lift them together to complete the installation.
This was a labor scene that Hobert had never seen before. There was no assembly line speed, but it made people feel very simple.
The steam water pump was the earliest use of steam machinery, mainly used to supply water to high places and to pump out accumulated water from mines.
These machines were as big as carriages, and the big ones were as big as two train heads, which was really a behemoth.
In front of a steam water pump that was about to be assembled, Hobert saw a gentleman in his forties, not very tall, leaning on a crutch, smiling at him: "The last time I saw you, you were only two years old, smiling at me in your mother's arms. That smile melted people's hearts."
Hobert stepped forward to say hello: "Hello, Mr. Digo."
Digos leaned on his crutch and limped towards Hobert: "Officer Rex had instructed me not to take the initiative to find you. How did you find me?"
"I took a task with Mr. Harvey Hayden once," Hobert tried not to look at the other's leg. "He told me that I could find you here."
"So it's that kid. I heard that he's doing well in the mercenary world." Digos smiled and pointed to his injured leg: "This was an injury I sustained in the Southern Continent. Fortunately, your father's timely support saved my life."
He invited Hobert to sit down in the reception room in the workshop. The clanging sounds outside always attracted Hobert's attention.
"No man doesn't like machinery." Digos lifted his injured leg with his hand, found a more comfortable position to sit down: "What you see is the second-generation water pump. The first generation was a piston water pump, which was prone to leaks.
"What you see now is a centrifugal pump water pump. You may not have heard of the term centrifugal pump. This is a new invention that requires a higher speed of the steam engine. Of course, the efficiency of the second-generation water pump has also been greatly improved."
