chapters.content:

Digos talked about some knowledge about steam engines, and Hobert felt that he also liked these big guys.
After chatting for a few more words, Hobert said the purpose of this visit: "My adoptive father, Mr. Christian, told me a lot about Mr. Rex, who is my biological father.
"But he never told me anything about my biological father's deeds after returning to Backlund. Now that I have taken over Mr. Rex's burden and want to investigate the family's curse, I really want to know Mr. Rex's actions after he came to Backlund and left the army."
He spread his hands: "I once talked to Christian about this topic, but when I saw his sad expression, I couldn't bear to continue talking to him."
"Of course, Commander Christian is unwilling to say," Digos said, "That was the darkest period of the two commanders."
He sighed, as if he had fallen into memories. After a few minutes, he said, "We have made too many contributions in the Southern Continent, and Commander Rex and Commander Christian are both very good strategists. Under their layout, the situation in half of East Balam has been eased.
"Of course, this will be feared by the Loen royal family. It is inevitable that they will be transferred back to Backlund on the grounds of promotion.
"In order to prevent accidents in Backlund, Commander Rex took the potion and became a demigod on the way back to Backlund.
"As Commander Rex expected, they were treated unfairly as soon as they were transferred back to Backlund. This was a demonstration by the Loen royal family.
"Commander Rex, who had long been uninterested in continuing his service, took this opportunity to leave the army and began to explore some Fourth Epoch ruins or monuments."
Hobert nodded, which was similar to his previous guess about Rex's whereabouts.
"I don't know exactly which ruins Commander Rex explored," Digos patted his injured leg and said, "Because of my injured leg, I can no longer follow Commander Rex to adventure. I had to come back to take over my father's business.
"But I remember that in a conversation between Commander Rex and Commander Christian, he mentioned that he put the exploration notes in a place where only his descendants could get them."
Hobert was stunned: "Is there such a place? Why don't I know?"
Digos smiled and said, "Young man, don't worry, Commander Rex has made many arrangements for you.
"When he made his will, I was by his side. He gave most of his property and knowledge to Commander Christian for safekeeping, and he made a simple plan for when to give you what."
Digos sighed: "These two commanders are really rare close friends."
Hobert nodded: "Okay."
Digos' implication was that he would not reveal too much information about Rex either. Hobert had questions now because it was not yet time for him to know that information.
So the two people's topic returned to the steam engine. Digoa was surprised to find that Hobert's understanding of mechanics was far beyond his imagination.
In this era, knowledge of mechanics is still cutting-edge knowledge that can only be learned in universities, and it is generally not open to international students.
In the AD era, there was a systematic description of mechanics in junior high school physics.
Especially for Hobert, who had seen internal combustion engines, the mechanical structure of steam engines was not too difficult to understand.
In a blink of an eye, the two of them chatted for more than an hour. Although they still had some unfinished business, it was time for Hobert to say goodbye.
When leaving, Hobert pointed to a water pump about the size of a locomotive outside and asked: "What is the approximate price of this model of water pump?"
"About 800 pounds." Digos smiled and said, "If you trade with merchants from other countries, you may sell it for 1300 to 1500 pounds.
"And we will also add an anti-disassembly structure, welding the outer shell of the important structure and adding a mechanism inside. As long as there is a forced demolition, the important structure will be destroyed."
Hobert thought to himself, this structure is advanced, but can it prevent apprentices?
Hehe, this is the mystical world, the main thing is to be caught off guard.
"Since you know I'm here, come and chat with me often." Digos said, "Next time I'll take you to visit the new crane."
Hobert nodded and smiled: "Okay."
At this time, a water pump was assembled and started to test the machine. When steam "hissed" from the mechanical structure, and when the huge wheel "buzzed", Hobert deeply felt the charm of this era.
On the way back, Hobert roughly estimated that the cost of a locomotive-sized water pump was at most two or three hundred pounds!
What a profit, it can be sold for 800 pounds, and if it is exported, the price will double.
Hobert seemed to see the shadow of technological monopoly. In fact, the application of steam engines has been very popular throughout the Northern Continent, but Digos produces the most cutting-edge steam engines, which represent the most cutting-edge production level of the Loen Kingdom.
These cutting-edge applications have obvious differences in mechanical structure compared with common steam engines on ships or trains. According to Hobert's understanding, it is similar to the difference between second-generation fighters and fifth-generation fighters.
Back at the office, Hobert just got off the carriage and paid the fare. Before he could enter the door, a maid-dressed girl came over and said: "Mr. Hobert! I am Annie, Miss Audrey's maid. Miss Audrey has an urgent matter and requests your help. Please come with me to Viscount Glaint's residence."
Hobert was slightly stunned. After recalling, the girl in front of him was indeed Audrey's personal maid.
So he got into the luxurious carriage with the Hall family crest and came to Viscount Glaint's residence.
As soon as he entered the study, Hobert saw the four people in the study breathe a sigh of relief together.
Hobert took off his windbreaker: "I heard Annie say that you have been waiting for me since morning?"
In an era without mobile phones or telephones, it is still quite inconvenient to find someone in Backlund.
Audrey said: "Yes, I initiated an emergency meeting of the 'Justice League'."
Everyone took their seats around the desk according to their previous seats.
Hobert took a sip of tea and asked curiously: "What difficulties has our beautiful Miss Audrey encountered?"
Audrey said: "I have a task to announce at the party: to assassinate Intis's ambassador to Loen, Backlund."
"Cough cough cough" Hobert, who was thirsty and had been drinking water after sitting down, choked on the tea.
When Audrey and others saw this scene, they found it both funny and disappointing. They found it funny because it was the first time they saw Hobert lose his composure. They felt disappointed because even Hobert was so surprised that he might not have a channel to complete this task.
It's just that they were all wrong. What surprised Hobert was actually: Mr. A did not accept the commission to assassinate Backlund?
Suddenly, he recalled that at the Nighthawks team meeting last week, Thomas informed everyone that Hillman had secretly invited a Sequence 5 helper.
Although the two senior members of the Aurora Order had escaped, they were also severely injured by 2-365.
Hobert knew the power of that glove. Even Sequence 5 spirits would be traumatized and difficult to recover for a while. Especially for the Beyonders of the "Secrets Supplicant" pathway, a severely damaged spirit would be a greater blow to them.
At that time, Hobert was still wondering if that helper was Mr. A? Now it seems that it is indeed Mr. A. He is in a very bad state now, so he rejected this commission.
Hobert thought for a while and then said: "I have a channel to complete this task."

Coming to Christian's office, Hobert explained his intention: "I want to entrust Mr. Dophis with a somewhat difficult task."

It was not until dusk that Hobert, who had been in the carriage for more than two hours, arrived at the excavation site of Jacob's team.
After Jacob heard the report from his subordinates, he quickly greeted him personally: "Mr. Hobert, the lawsuit you won for Darren's friend was really wonderful."
"I also knew from that time that driving a steamship while drunk is not drunk driving."

He promised: "I will definitely be at the scene during the final excavation."
Then Hobert said the purpose of his trip: "I'm here to find Mr. Dophis, where is he?"
"Mr. Dophis is resting," Jacob said, "His tent is over here, please come with me."
Arriving at Dophis's tent, Jacob left very knowingly.
Dophis was still the same, looking pale, with a cold expression, and taciturn.
Hobert went straight to the point: "Mr. Dophis, I have a secret matter to discuss, should we go outside the camp?"
"No need," Dophis's pupils suddenly became deep, and he made a gesture of opening a door at the position of his chest. The tent suddenly became cold.
Hobert felt the spiritual fluctuations around him. He opened his spiritual vision and saw a phantom door on Dophis's body.
A spirit that looked like a blown-up balloon came out of the door and quickly became as big as a normal person, slowly floating to the top of the tent.
"Okay," Dophis said, "No one will hear our conversation."

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 209 Meet Mr. Azik again (Bonus 8)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Xenon for becoming a member, +5 bonus]
Seeing Dophis's ability just now, Hobert was sure that he was a Sequence 5 "Gatekeeper."
He was also a little puzzled. Did Christian have such great charm that she could make a Sequence 5 willing to disguise himself as his male servant? Or was there some unknown secret in it?
Hobert simply stopped thinking about this question and began to describe the mission to assassinate Bakerland.
After listening, Dophis was silent for a few seconds before asking, "Is this assassination mission important to you?"
Hobert told the truth, "It concerns the life and death of a friend of mine."
Dophis was silent for a few more seconds, then asked, "How much is the other party planning to pay?"
"10,000 pounds."
Dophis said in a voice that was impossible to discern whether he was happy or angry, "Slightly less."
Then he said, "I'll take on this commission, but I have an additional condition."
"Speak."
Dophis said, "Help me find clues to the Sequence 4 'Undying' characteristics, or the main materials, of the 'Death' pathway. If the clues are true, I will let you choose a mystical item from my body, or settle it with gold pounds."
Hobert was stunned, and the idea of "Strongest Male Servant" appeared in his mind. Christian's personal male servant was preparing to be promoted to a demigod. How terrifying.
Hobert cleared his throat and said, "No problem."
He remembered that there seemed to be a demigod from the Numinous Episcopate's Artificial Death faction in Backlund. He forgot the specific name, but Hobert remembered that he was a merchant on the surface, and seemed to be running a clothing factory.
To Hobert, that was a walking "Undying". However, that demigod was a byproduct of the artificial death plan. He wondered if taking his characteristic as a potion would be contaminated by the artificial death?
Then Dophis began to ask for some detailed information about the mission: "Do you have more detailed information about the Sequence 5 assistant next to Bakerland?"
"He is a Sequence 5 'Marionettist' of the 'Seer' pathway. As far as I know, he has been busy competing for a valuable piece of information these past few days and is rarely by Bakerland's side."
"Can it be confirmed that Bakerland is a 'Conspirer' of the 'Hunter' pathway?"
"It can be confirmed."
"..."
After asking a few questions, Dophis said, "I will observe Bakerland for two days first, and then act in at most three or four days."
Hobert nodded: "No problem."
Dophis was not a talkative person. After the mission was explained, the two really had nothing to talk about.
So Hobert talked like he was doing a stand-up comedy for a while, then got up to say goodbye.
Leaving the tent, Hobert went to bid farewell to Jacob, who enthusiastically sent him out.
In the dim light, Hobert saw something hanging in the center of the camp, so he asked about it.
Jacob said, "Those are wild rabbits that Mr. Dophis caught from the ruins. Hanging them there is to attract the wild rabbits' companions to come and rescue them."
Hobert was stunned: "This is the first time I've heard that wild rabbits will rescue their companions?"
"These rabbits are very intelligent." Jacob said, "And they are very large. As long as you look at them, your spirit body is very likely to be injured."
He whispered, "Mr. Dophis said that these wild rabbits have been contaminated by the sealed items underground. They are actually monsters now, but there are no signs of them being out of control."
Hobert nodded, and looked at the wild rabbits hanging there, but it was too dark to see clearly.
Then he belatedly realized that Dophis hadn't even mentioned this to me just now. Uh, how much does he hate socializing and chatting!
The carriage that brought Hobert was still waiting outside the camp. It didn't matter to the coachman to wait a while, after all, it was charged by the hour.
On the way back to Backlund, Hobert began to recall information about the Backlund Artificial Death faction's demigod. At this moment, there was a sudden neighing of horses in front, and the coachman seemed to have spent a lot of effort to control the carriage.
Then he heard the coachman's scolding: "You, this gentleman, although this is the suburbs, you can't suddenly rush into the middle of the road!"
"Sorry, I was just, just distracted."
Hobert in the carriage was stunned. It was Mr. Azik's voice.
He opened the car door and looked forward: "Mr. Azik, it's really you! It's already dark, let me give you a ride!"
"I didn't expect to meet you here again." Azik smiled slightly: "No need, I want to walk by myself."
The coachman saw that Azik's attire didn't look like someone who lived in the countryside, so he said, "This gentleman, believe me, if you walk back to Backlund, you will have to walk until the second half of the night."
Hobert thought: That won't happen, it's estimated that he'll be back in a minute or two.
Then Hobert seemed to think of something: "Mr. Azik, let's go together, we've met again, don't you think it's a bit of a coincidence?"
Azik took a deep look at Hobert and nodded slightly to get into the carriage.
The carriage started moving again.
In the carriage, Hobert smiled slightly: "Mr. Azik, you should be able to see that I am a person with magical abilities, and I can also feel your uniqueness."
Azik nodded slowly: "You are right."
"As I said just now, according to some knowledge I know, if two people always meet by chance, it must mean something. Maybe you can give me some help, maybe I can provide you with some clues."
Azik frowned: "What can I help you with? Or what clues can you provide for me?"
Hobert spread his hands: "I don't know either, this is only our third meeting after all."
He smiled helplessly: "Fate is always unpredictable, maybe we will know after a while why we always meet these days."
This was Hobert's sincere thought. The two were Beyonders of different pathways, and they shouldn't meet frequently due to the "Law of Beyonder Characteristic Convergence."
There must be some other reason that makes them meet frequently, but even Azik has not noticed that reason, let alone Hobert, a Sequence 7.
Hobert said, "I think it is necessary for us to exchange contact addresses, so that we can find each other in a short time if there is an emergency."
Azik smiled slightly: "You seem to know a lot."
Then he said, "Yes, if there is an emergency, you can write a letter and put it in the mailbox at 16 Wanbo Avenue, Hillston Borough."
Hobert took out a pen and paper to write down the address, and wrote down the address of the law firm and gave it to Azik.
After chatting for a few words, Azik got out of the car and left. The coachman wanted to persuade him again, but Hobert had to tell the coachman that this gentleman lived nearby.
The coachman saw that the surrounding area was full of desolate mountains and ridges, and couldn't help but shiver.
It was already past eight o'clock in the evening when I returned to Backlund.
Arriving at the Hall Earl's mansion in the Empress Borough, Hobert got out of the car and soon saw Susie who was taking a walk.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 210 The commission of the girl standing in the street (Bonus 9)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In Earl Hall's villa, Audrey saw Hobert's letter and breathed a sigh of relief: Mr. Fool's mission was finally entrusted. Based on Hobert's usual reliability, the strength of the Beyonder he found should be no problem.
She read the short letter again: I didn't expect it to cost so much money to assassinate an ambassador! Also, the additional conditions proposed by the other party are a bit difficult!
"Audrey, the person who gave me the letter seems to know I can talk," Susie said suddenly.
Audrey was a little surprised at first, then shook her head and smiled: "Impossible, Mr. Hobert has only been here twice, he couldn't possibly know that you have taken the potion."
"Theoretically, yes."
Audrey felt a little dizzy. Heavens, Susie is starting to talk about theory!
Susie's big mouth opened and closed: "But according to my observation, when he was putting down the letter, he seemed to want to talk to me several times, but the words came to his lips and turned into some irrelevant words."
Audrey frowned. Of course, she believed in Susie's observation ability.
But it didn't make sense at all. Hobert hadn't even met Susie a few times.
…
Riding in the carriage to Blanca Street, Hobert touched his rumbling stomach and thought to himself that it was a close call.
Several times he almost asked Susie to bring a message, reminding Audrey to pay attention to confidentiality.
Hobert recalled Susie's image and found that it was really a good seed for a "Daydream Dog". In front of it, people always easily let down their guard.
Back in the rented house, Xio was already resting. Fors was still reading a magazine, obviously waiting for Hobert, and had even left him a dinner.
Hobert praised Fors's thoughtfulness while gobbling it down.
After Hobert finished eating, Fors came over to ask about the result. After learning that Hobert had successfully entrusted the task, Fors also breathed a sigh of relief.
Although she and Xio failed to entrust the task today, Audrey still gave them a commission fee of 500 pounds.
This money made Fors and Xio feel ashamed, but Audrey insisted on giving it at the time, and they did take some risks. But after getting the money, they felt a little guilty, after all, they didn't complete Audrey's commission.
Knowing that the matter had been entrusted, Fors could feel a little more at ease.
Hobert instructed: "Pay attention to confidentiality. Don't talk about this matter outside with Xio."
"We know," Fors worried: "But I don't know about Mr. A…"
Hobert smiled: "These lunatics can't wait for Backlund to be more chaotic."
Moreover, he is now trying to recover and has no time to care about this kind of thing.
After the task of assassinating the ambassador was entrusted, all that was left was waiting.
And life had to go on.
On Wednesday morning, Hobert appeared in court. Many reporters and citizens who learned the news rushed to the scene, wanting to see Hobert's debating prowess.
Who knew that the first thing the defendant did after being brought to court was to seek an out-of-court settlement with Hobert.
It turned out that after learning that the plaintiff's lawyer was Hobert, the defendant had visited many law firms in the past week, but no lawyer was willing to defend him.
Even Great Lawyer Hugo had lost. Ordinary lawyers knew they couldn't win against Hobert, so they simply refused to avoid humiliating themselves, while the great lawyers cherished their feathers and were unwilling to appear in court.
You know, due to the great influence of the "Workers' Compensation Case", Great Lawyer Hugo's business volume has plummeted. No one is willing to follow in Hugo's footsteps.
Hobert didn't expect that the case he had prepared for a week, and which was obviously a bit difficult, would be solved so easily!
The reporters were also disappointed and made a wasted trip.
Hobert instructed Cody, who came with him: "Don't be careless, your case is not so easy to solve."
Cody smiled bitterly: "I know."
Of course, he knew that he didn't have Hobert's reputation and prestige.
At ten o'clock, the case Cody was responsible for opened. This case was also a bit difficult. After repeated back-and-forth negotiations between the two lawyers, a settlement plan was finally reached.
During lunch, Hobert routinely helped Cody summarize the mistakes and lessons of this round of defense, which also benefited Cody a lot.
After accompanying the three subordinates to court one after another, Hobert had a basic understanding of their abilities, and he knew what to do when assigning cases in the future.
As soon as he returned to the firm, Jessica reported to Hobert: "There is a special client who has been waiting here since morning. I don't know if I should accept her commission."
Hobert asked while taking off his windbreaker: "What's so special about her?"
"Well, she is a street prostitute."
"Jessica, I know you have some unique abilities, so you will never be reduced to this step," Hobert said: "In my opinion, street prostitutes are like those workers and farmers who cannot protect their rights. It is a tragedy of this era. I hope you will not look at any client differently."
Hobert's obvious reproach made Jessica a little blush: "I know, but I…"
"Afraid it will affect my reputation?"
Jessica didn't say anything, but she did think so.
Hobert smiled: "It will only affect my reputation if the lawsuit is lost."
Then he became serious: "Haven't you noticed? The clients who come to us basically regard us as their last hope.
"'The hope of the bottom people of Backlund' sounds good. Many years later, we may even be the hope of this era."
Jessica looked at Hobert excitedly. Who doesn't want to leave their mark on an era?
"Please ask her to come to my office," Hobert smiled at Jessica who was walking out. She was still too young and easily filled up by the leader's pie.
The client's name was Emma, in her twenties, wearing the most fashionable dress in Backlund, with light makeup, and a charming look between her eyebrows.
To avoid suspicion, Jessica also sat aside to listen.
Hobert quickly made a judgment. Emma was a "senior" street prostitute, the kind who regarded street prostitution as a job.
Not a part-timer, nor a woman sold to the red-light district by traffickers. The former would not dress so beautifully, and the latter would not have much personal freedom.
After seeing Hobert, Emma smiled charmingly: "If Lawyer Hobert ever visits our small shop, I will definitely give you a discount."
If they had the power to choose clients, of course they would be willing to choose young, handsome, and gentle gentlemen.
Hobert smiled slightly: "I don't have such needs for the time being."
After chatting for a few words, under Hobert's guidance, Emma began to tell the story of the case.
It turned out that recently there was a rogue named Wendell in the red-light district who specialized in patronizing Emma's "small shop", which was jointly run by several street prostitutes, and refused to pay after sex.
Because such small shops couldn't afford thugs, many small shops had already been successful by him, and he had even threatened: "If you have the ability, go sue me!"
Emma said: "A colleague really sued him, but lost the case."

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 211 Assassination of Ambassador Bakerland (Bonus 10)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert asked, "Which lawyer did your colleague hire for the defense?"
"No lawyer was hired." Emma said, "The person who sued Wendell used to be a paralegal, but the law firm suddenly went bankrupt, so..."
At this point, Emma made a "you should understand" expression.
Hobert nodded: "What's the general defense plan?"
"Although I went to grammar school for a few years, I'm unfamiliar with the law and don't understand any defense plans." Emma said, "I only know that she lost the case because the money from prostitution is illegal income and is not protected by law."
She smiled: "The judge's original words seemed to be that Wendell's behavior can only be morally sanctioned, but it is difficult to sanction it legally."
"Hehe, when the judges come to our neighborhood to spend money, I haven't seen them say that this is an illegal transaction."
Hobert pondered for a moment: "There is a problem with this defense direction!"
He said: "I'll take this case. I'll submit the materials to the court in a while. I believe Wendell will receive the summons no later than the day after tomorrow."
Emma was stunned for a moment, then showed a grateful smile: "Thank you for taking this case. I didn't have any hope originally."
After Emma left, Jessica reminded Hobert: "According to relevant laws, um, prostitution money is indeed illegal income. It will be difficult to establish a case if the other party is accused of provoking trouble or debt issues. It doesn't seem appropriate to accuse them of stealing or robbing other people's property either."
Hobert smiled and said, "I have said more than once that if a defense direction is difficult to achieve our goals, then try a different direction."
He said: "Especially for you, you must be good at finding the other party's loopholes, as well as loopholes in laws and regulations."
"Um, you participate in this case too, learn and see more."
Jessica nodded happily: "Okay."
... Time came to Friday, in the evening, the staff of the Intis Embassy in the West Borough of Backlund were busy coming in and out.
Tonight is the most critical time to seize the manuscript of the great scientist Turani von Helmosuin. In order to show his frankness, Intis Republic Ambassador Bakerland, while instructing his assistant Rosago to mobilize all forces to participate in the operation, held a dance.
To show that he was busy with other things and had nothing to do with the manuscript snatching operation.
He walked around the ballroom. Seeing that there were no omissions, he took advantage of the fact that the guests had not yet arrived and took his personal servant to the backyard.
As soon as he arrived in the backyard, he felt that something was wrong. He looked around carefully. The first thing he saw was the respectful servant, then the military attache on guard in the backyard, and several servants moving wine from the warehouse to the front.
Bakerland shook his head. There were more than a dozen military attaches from the Intis Republic in the embassy, and they were all Beyonders.
For Bakerland, this place was safe.
Continuing forward, he came to a small, independent bungalow. He stood in front of the door, frowning: "Go ahead and open the door! Idiot!"
The personal servant trembled obviously in fright and quickly stepped forward to open the door.
Arriving in the small bungalow, that feeling of something being wrong appeared again.
He frowned, then he smiled. If someone was really here to harm him, then they were really courting death.
There was only a table and a cabinet in the small bungalow. He lit three candles on the table and then drew an abstract symbol of a throne in the middle.
Then he took out extraordinary materials from the small cabinet, put them on the candles and burned them, emitting wisps of illusory white smoke, exuding a peculiar fragrance.
Just as Bakerland was about to lower his head to pray, suddenly a strange, cold voice in the room said, "I guessed right."
He immediately became alert. At this time, two feet appeared not far in front of him at the table, followed by legs, all the way up, and a pale-faced, cold-looking man appeared.
This man was of course Dophis, who had come to assassinate him.
Bakerland took a step back and deliberately asked loudly, "How did you get in?"
"It's useless." Dophis pointed to the top: "No one can hear the sound in this room, including the object you are praying to."
At some point, the spirit that looked like a balloon had floated above the heads of the two people.
Bakerland suddenly had the illusion that he was completely seen through: "Impossible!"
He almost shouted: "Great King of War; Guardian of Intis; Master of Weather and Fog; Symbol of Chaos and Will!"
Sure enough, there was no response at all.
Dophis smiled: "This is the honorific name of that former king of Intis, right? I knew that an angel would not be so easily killed by Roselle."
He pointed to the balloon above his head: "This natural spirit is very special. It can cut off the connection with the spirit world within a certain range. Not only will the sound not reach the outside, but it will also cut off all channels for your prayer to reach the prayer object."
Bakerland did not hesitate and immediately retreated to escape from the door. Just as he was about to act, his personal servant suddenly had a dagger in his hand and stabbed forward at Bakerland 's retreating body.
Before this, he had no defense against his personal servant and was easily successful.
Pfft~
The dagger pierced his lower back.
At this moment, he reacted and kicked the servant away, only causing him minor injuries.
And his servant suddenly flipped over in mid-air, avoiding the window and directly hitting the wall.
Dong~
The entire bungalow trembled, and the servant's brains burst.
But the servant didn't seem to notice that his head was smashed and calmly got up, holding a dagger and posing an attack towards his master.
He did not continue to escape. As a hunter, he knew that when a fierce beast was eyeing him, blindly escaping would only expose his most vulnerable side to the beast. At this time, he had to stare at the beast and look for opportunities to escape.
After he was attacked by his servant and failed to kick the servant out of the window, he knew that if he continued to escape, he would only die faster. At this time, he had to stare at the beast and look for opportunities to escape.
"Didn't you notice? Your servant has been dead for more than half an hour." Dophis, who usually didn't talk much, suddenly became a bit talkative:
"These days, I have been observing you through the natural spirits of the embassy and also asked these natural spirits about your living habits."
"I discovered a very interesting phenomenon. You often appear in this small room at this time in the afternoon and don't allow anyone to disturb you."
"Unfortunately, there are no natural spirits in this small room, and I have no way to know the answer directly."
"What are you doing in here?"
"I thought for several hours before I realized that Backlund is so far away from the Intis Republic. If there is urgent and confidential information that needs to be transmitted, how do you contact each other? Relatively speaking, the confidentiality of telegrams is too poor."
"The answer is almost obvious. You pray to the angel of the Intis Republic, report the situation here, or recite the angel's honorific name and let Him give you instructions."

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 212 Sequence 5 Gift Pack (Bonus 11)
chapters.content:

Bakerland stared coldly at Dophis, guessing which force had sent this assassin.
Dophis said leisurely, "After saying so much, you should understand, right? You are doomed to die today."
Bakerland sneered, "That's hard to say."
Dophis revealed an icy smile: "Do you think the dagger in your male servant's hand is an ordinary dagger?"
Bakerland was shocked and immediately reached out to check his wound. As soon as he moved, he realized that he had become stiff all over, starting from who knows when.
His spirituality immediately made him realize that it was not his physical body that had a problem, but his spirit body that had been damaged.
Looking at the dagger in the male servant's hand again, it was dark and shiny, making it terrifying.
Dophis smiled and said, "You are still quite clever. If you had continued to escape just now, you would only have died faster.
"Oh, right, I also replaced the materials you often burn. The replaced materials not only can't help you establish contact with the object of your prayer, but also accelerate the collapse of your spirit body."
Bakerland was shocked and quickly continued to move towards the door, but his movements were already very stiff at this time, and it took him a long time to take only one step.
"Are you wondering why I'm okay in the same room?" Dophis asked and answered himself: "Because I am an undead, and undead don't need to breathe."
The male servant stepped forward again, and in Bakerland's unwilling gaze, easily slit the throat of this Intis ambassador.
Bakerland felt the blood spurting from his neck, which was the rapid loss of life.
Dophis stretched out his hand, and the male servant respectfully handed the dagger to Dophis. Then he fell to the ground and became a real corpse.
After confirming that Bakerland was completely dead, Dophis reached out and grabbed Bakerland's spirituality, crushed it, and completely cut off the path for the military attachés to communicate with spirits.
Then Dophis opened the illusory door on his body, grabbed a cloud-like spirit, and then stuffed the spirit in the shape of a rooftop balloon back into the illusory door.
The bottom of the cloud-like spirit was a bloody mouth. Dophis glared at it, and the cloud immediately put away its countless fangs, and then opened its big mouth to devour Dophis.
This cloud can be invisible and can pass through obstacles. Dophis was in its belly, leisurely commanding it to leave the embassy among the patrolling military attachés and busy servants.
...
Two hours later, 15 Minsk Street.
Klein, who had just sent Ian away, had just sat down on the sofa and hadn't had time to review Ian's account of the whole thing when the doorbell rang "ding ding dong dong" again.
Who?
Klein's expression tightened instantly. He put his hands in his pockets, touching the Tarot cards and the "Words of Blasphemy" charm respectively.
Then he looked at the windows and mirrors, but unfortunately he didn't find the shadow of the bodyguard Miss.
But he knew that the bodyguard Miss must be in this room.
Klein slowly walked to the door, using the Clown's ability to foresee the scene he would see after opening the door:
Under the crimson moon, a sheriff in a black and white checkered uniform with three V's on his epaulettes was impatiently waiting at the door. It was Sheriff Fasin, whom Klein had met before.
Klein quickly made a divination to confirm that this was the real Sheriff Fasin, but he immediately thought that the other party was also a "Seer" and should be able to interfere with his divination.
At this time, the doorbell rang again, and Klein had no choice but to pull the door open vigilantly.
Sheriff Fasin outside said with a serious face: "The people above sent me to tell you to pay attention to safety tonight and tomorrow and be careful of strangers."
"Okay." Klein nodded solemnly.
Sheriff Fasin touched his short hair and said, "There are also some arrangements, I will explain them to you in detail, and you make your own decision."
Klein invited Sheriff Fasin into the room and closed the door smoothly.
As the solid wooden door closed, Minsk Street under the crimson moon returned to a peaceful scene.
But two or three minutes later, there seemed to be a quarrel inside the wooden door of 15 Minsk Street, but soon all the discordant sounds disappeared.
More than ten minutes later, Sheriff Fasin opened the door with some stiff movements.
He avoided the light of the street lamps and quickly walked towards the Tussok River. If any unlucky person saw his face clearly, he would be scared out of his wits.
...
Saturday morning, Blanca Street.
When eating breakfast, Hobert always looked out the window at the street outside. Just as breakfast was coming to an end, he finally heard the voice of the newsboy: "Extra! Extra! Intis Ambassador to Loen, Bakerland, died in a fight with his male servant in the backyard last night!"
Xio and Fors looked at Hobert with surprise in their eyes, and Hobert had already gotten up: "Bring me a newspaper!"
After buying the newspaper, the three of them couldn't care about eating and squeezed together to read the contents of the newspaper.
Unfortunately, there were few details about Bakerland's death. The reporter wrote: "...The military attachés have closed the embassy. Surprisingly, the ambassador's assistant, Mr. Rosago, has not appeared either. The entire embassy looks like a mess.
The writer learned from the servants that Ambassador Bakerland often treated the servants rudely and barbarously, especially his male servant. It is reported that this is likely the cause of the conflict between the master and servant..."
The three people who knew that Bakerland was an Beyonder being knew that the content of the newspaper was nonsense.
Xio said incredulously: "Bakerland is dead!"
Fors asked in a low voice: "Did we succeed?"
"It should be." Hobert put down the newspaper: "Even if an ordinary person launches a sneak attack, it is impossible to kill an Beyonder of Sequence 6."
He was sure that it must be Dophis's work, and it was done very cleanly, leaving no traces at the scene. Even the people at the Intis Embassy didn't know which direction to investigate.
This was in line with Dophis's low-key personality. Only lunatics like the Aurora Order would make the matter of killing Bakerland known to everyone.
Hobert could almost imagine that Dophis must have acted after having full confidence, and all his actions must be calm and unhurried.
When he took action, Rosago was not at the embassy. Bakerland was not Dophis's opponent at all. A Sequence 5 had many ways to kill a Sequence 6 silently.
Especially this kind of assassination, Bakerland was caught off guard, and may not even have had the opportunity to use his mystical items.
Hobert also thought: Since Rosago has not appeared, it seems that the Sequence 5 gift package has been delivered to Klein's hands.
At this time, Miss Audrey's maid came to deliver a letter again. Opening the envelope, it was a check for 10,000 pounds.
Xio and Fors swallowed their saliva shamelessly after seeing the check.
Hobert put away the check: "I'm not going to work today. I'm going to deliver the reward."
Xio and Fors also wanted to go together to admire the strong man who killed Bakerland, but they also knew that it was impossible.
After finishing the remaining breakfast, Hobert took a taxi carriage to the suburbs.
Yesterday, Jacob had already sent someone to send a letter to Hobert, and today the final excavation of the ruins will be carried out. Of course, Hobert, who wants to get a share of the pie, must be present.
At around ten o'clock, Hobert arrived at the camp and was directly led to the ruins by the person waiting at the entrance of the camp.
Coming to the noble courtyard in the ruins again, the entrance to the huge underground structure was already surrounded by people. They were chatting while smoking cigarettes or pipes, and the overall atmosphere was relatively cheerful.
Mr. Dophis was out of place among them. He was unwilling to chat with others, and others did not dare to chat with him.
After Hobert arrived, Dophis whispered: "There is a sealed artifact of the 'Death' pathway with a very high level sealed underground."

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 213 The reason for encountering Azik was found (Bonus 12)
chapters.content:

Hobert was stunned, and immediately retorted: "How high is the level?"
Dophis said lightly: "At least a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact!"
Hobert's first reaction was that Jacob's team had struck it rich this time!
On the way from the camp to the ruins, Hobert learned from the person who led him that the underground structure was composed of many rooms, each containing some antiques.
These antiques might have been very ordinary things more than a thousand years ago, but because they are well preserved, they have become very good antiques today.
Although the value is not very high, the quantity is large.
Dophis ordered Jacob to replace some modern objects while moving out those antiques.
Hearing this, Hobert understood that the entire underground structure might have been designed to seal a certain Sealed Artifact.
And Dophis should have squeezed the Sealed Artifact's range of activity little by little by replacing the objects in the room, until now, only two rooms remained unopened.
Theoretically, the Sealed Artifact must be in these two rooms.
It was precisely because there were too many rooms that it took more than a month to excavate.
The antiques that were moved out were stored in the camp, and it is said that they have filled several tents.
They will be sold together after the excavation is completely over, so as not to let people know that there are few things dug out here. The workers who work here have not returned home for more than a month, and they are not allowed to leave even if they are sick.
After these things are sold, at least seven or eight members of Jacob's team will be able to become real rich people in Backlund.
Christian, who provided protection, can also get a considerable amount of cash.
And now, a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact can be dug up, which is something whose specific value is difficult to estimate. If sold, it would be at least a price of 100,000 pounds.
However, Hobert estimates that the likely scenario is that, after negotiation, Christian will take this Grade 1 Sealed Artifact as a bonus for providing protection for this operation.
It is no exaggeration to say that with this level of Sealed Artifact, the prototype of a Beyonder family is established.
The reason why there are so many adventurers and mercenaries in this era is because this is a legitimate way for ordinary people to get rich quickly.
In Backlund, if it is not a family that originally had property, or whose ancestors were nobles, the best result of an ordinary person's lifelong business is to leave some savings for future generations.
Most people may not be able to leave any savings in their entire business life, so there are many people who go bankrupt.
Only very few people seize the opportunity and completely change their own and their descendants' destiny.
That's why everyone is so enthusiastic about adventure, because the probability of getting rich in this way is greater, but the probability of losing their lives is also greater.
Just as Hobert's thoughts were tumbling, Dophis said again: "Remember Chief Rex's reminder, if you feel danger, close your eyes immediately, don't open them even if you die!"
Hobert nodded repeatedly, and then he suddenly thought, could Mr. Azik be attracted by this Sealed Artifact?
The two encounters were both because Hobert could come into contact with that Sealed Artifact?
It's very possible!
At this time, Jacob gave an inspiring speech and made a promise that after the last two rooms were excavated, everyone would be paid three times their salary this week!
For a time, cheers and applause resounded throughout the ruins deep under the soil.
And how the members of their team share the bonus should have been decided before this.
At the end of the speech, Jacob emphasized discipline, only a small number of people went down, and most of them waited here to prepare to transport the antiques out.
Moreover, after going down, all actions will be arranged by Mr. Dophis.
After the speech, Dophis went down first, followed by Hobert and Jacob and others.
Coming to the underground part of the noble courtyard again, Hobert saw that there were already many signs of human activity in the corridor, and there was no longer the last time's desolation and gloom.
The underground passage is very long. Hobert simply counted. There are at least dozens of rooms in one passage, and there are eight such passages! That is to say, there are at least five or six hundred rooms!
No wonder it took more than a month to move the things inside! Even if there is only one chamber pot in one room, if you want to fill them with urine... cough cough, if you want to collect them, it will take a lot of effort.
Finally, they came to the last two rooms.
When there was still a distance, Dophis raised his hand: "You wait here!"
He stepped forward alone, took a defensive posture, and slowly pushed open one of the doors.
The doors of these rooms are all stone doors. Under normal circumstances, it takes two or three people to push them open together, but Dophis opened the door with one hand.
First, he opened a small crack, and he looked inside vigilantly, then he completely opened it: "Move the things inside out!"
Jacob was prepared. After hearing Dophis's order, he waved his hand, and immediately seven or eight people stepped forward to move things, and another seven or eight people carried some bottles and cans and put them back into the room.
After a busy time, everyone re-distanced themselves from the last door.
The Sealed Artifact must be in the last room. Dophis perked up and slowly pushed open the stone door, and looked inside: "Huh?"
Jacob quickly asked: "What's wrong!"
Dophis said with a cold face: "It's not in here either."
Jacob opened his mouth: "That's strange, we've checked all the other rooms."
Dophis and Hobert didn't say anything. They thought of the same thing: the Sealed Artifact should have some kind of living characteristic!
After a little thought, Dophis said: "Replace the things in the last room, let the people above come down, and open all the doors!"
Logically speaking, he has already set up a small trap in each of the other rooms. As long as the Sealed Artifact enters those rooms, he should be able to detect it.
Just as Dophis thought of this, in the depths of the underground corridor, there were suddenly many red lights.
"Ah~"
Many people screamed in pain after seeing these red lights, or knelt on the ground, or lay on the ground.
These screams were particularly alarming in the dim underground, and their painful expressions and body movements were even more frightening.
Hobert only glanced at it and quickly looked away. Even so, he still felt frightened.
Jacob shouted: "Lower your head, don't look around! You ungrateful fools! Those are the eyes of wild rabbits!"
Dophis said: "They may know where that thing is!"
He walked forward quickly with a cold face: "Even if I can't find that thing today, I will eliminate these wild rabbits!"
When passing by Hobert, he did not forget to remind: "You stay here."
Hobert nodded: "Okay."
Jacob and others knew that the eyes of these wild rabbits were all Beyonder materials. Before, the wild rabbits were fighting on their own and it was difficult to catch them. Now that they are gathered together, Jacob and others are of course unwilling to miss this opportunity to harvest materials.
So most of the members of the mercenary team followed Dophis to chase the wild rabbits.
At this time, Hobert realized that staying here seemed more dangerous.

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 214 Whoever sees who burps
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Around Hobert, only two mercenary team members remained, both Sequence 9, and not skilled in combat.
Knowing they would struggle to catch the hare and might become a burden, the two simply didn't pursue.
The remaining twenty-odd people were commoners hired by Jacob, with over a dozen replacing items in the last room under the command of the two mercenary members.
Several lay on the ground, commoners who had met the rabbit's gaze, now ignored by everyone.
While directing the crowd, the two mercenary members discussed the marvels of the sealed artifact, careful to avoid the term "sealed artifact" in front of the commoners, using "that thing" instead.
Hobert found such concealment pointless; without memory cleansing, the common laborers would piece together the existence of a high-level sealed artifact from their whispers once the excavation concluded.
Especially when Jacob sold a large quantity of antiques in Backlund, people would immediately realize a vast treasure was buried here.
Some might even return after Jacob's dig and Christian's protection ended, hoping to find treasures Jacob's team missed.
Just then, Hobert heard a stone door open behind him, which struck him as odd, as there was no stone door behind him!
As he turned to investigate, his intuition stopped him:
Don't look!
Looking will be fatal!
Immediately, immense pressure and dread washed over him, sending shivers down his spine: "Close your eyes!"
But it was too late; Hobert saw cold, clear light flowing from behind him. The two mercenary team members opposite him widened their eyes, unable to react before collapsing.
Hobert, unable to watch the others, quickly shut his eyes and sought cover, guided by memory.
He stumbled twice into the wall in his haste, tearing his clothes, but this was no time to worry. The constant thud of bodies falling reminded him of the approaching danger.
Some commoners, heeding Hobert's warning, closed their eyes: "What's happening? What's happening?"
"Why has the breathing stopped around me?"
Hobert yelled, "Close your eyes and run!"
Thud.
Thud.
Hobert heard slow, heavy footsteps behind him.
He quickened his pace, using the wall for guidance, hearing someone behind him shout: "Who's there? Who's there?"
"Who's beside me? Why are you so furry? Ah!"
A scream sent shivers down Hobert's spine.
The subsequent sounds crashed against Hobert's nerves: "Help! It's right behind me!"
"It's coming to get me! It's coming to get me!"
Then came the sounds of bodies falling, the voices fading.
Extreme fear gripped Hobert's heart. Fortunately, his resistance to mental attacks had increased since becoming a "Barbarian." Despite his trembling hands and legs, he pressed on.
With the last scream, all sounds ceased, save for the slow, heavy "thud... thud..." of footsteps.
The footsteps were slow, as if the creature had trouble moving.
Hobert, hurrying away, finally found a turn. As he entered the next passage, the footsteps faded.
Just as Hobert caught his breath, the "thud... thud..." returned, clear as before, right in front of him!
He was shocked. Did it have "teleportation"?
Or was this an illusion, tempting him to open his eyes?
Remembering Rex's warning, Hobert used "Psychological Cue" on himself: Open your eyes only after escaping.
Then came the question of which way to go: forward or back?
Logically, with the heavy footsteps ahead, he should turn back, but what if that was a trick?
What if its goal was to make him turn around?
"Thud... thud..." grew closer.
Hobert's breathing became heavy. He simply hid on the side of the underground passage, ready to react if it attacked.
Thud.
Just as Hobert decided to wait and see, the sound stopped not far ahead.
Hobert's intuition told him it was standing there, motionless.
"What the f*ck!" Hobert cursed inwardly. What is this sealed artifact? This is inhumane!
After a few seconds of eerie silence, Hobert felt immense pressure from his spirituality: He couldn't hold out much longer!
Hobert's mind raced. The sealed artifact hadn't attacked him in all this time, suggesting it wasn't very alive.
Hobert realized that the others' cries of "It's coming to get me!" were likely illusions born of extreme fear.
Keep moving forward!
Hobert resolved, touching the stone wall as he moved forward.
Most people would turn back, but the risk of turning back was as great as going forward, while forward had only two outcomes: passing by or running into it.
Back might offer escape, but it was more likely to lead to new, unknown dangers.
So Hobert chose forward, where the outcomes were known, and in the world of the extraordinary, the unknown often meant danger.
He could feel a powerful presence right in front of him, watching him.
Hobert suddenly laughed, bolstering his courage, one step, two steps, safely passing the powerful presence, the unsettling gaze vanishing.
Hobert exhaled. Sure enough, as long as he kept his eyes closed, it wouldn't attack.
As he thought this, Hobert turned another corner, unconsciously quickening his pace.
He hadn't gone far when he tripped over something: Strange, the passage was empty before!
He bent down and touched it!
Immediately, cold sweat poured down him!
It was a skeleton!
There was no skeleton in the passage before!
Hobert belatedly realized that he had turned a corner after passing the sealed artifact, how could he turn again so quickly?
The only answer was that Hobert had entered an open stone door.
The only open stone door was likely in the room with the sealed artifact.
Thinking this, Hobert's legs turned to jelly.
But misfortunes never come singly. Hobert's intuition felt the gaze and pressure from behind again. The sealed artifact was turning back, returning to the stone chamber.
Get out of here!
With that thought, Hobert got up and tried to avoid it, but as he stepped out, he tripped over something hard and fell forward.
However, as a Sequence 7, Hobert twisted his body and immediately stood, avoiding the fall.
But because of this turn, his hand left the wall, causing him to lose all sense of direction.
Quickly moving to the right to find the wall again, Hobert suddenly touched a layer of hard feathers.

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 215 Grade 0?
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The moment Hobert touched the feather, he felt a spiritual impact, as if he saw a towering, pale stone pillar.
Just a stone pillar had brought such a huge impact to Hobert's spirit!
Hobert quickly withdrew his hand, realizing that the owner of the feather was of a higher level than the unseen thing outside.
But it seemed to be dormant, or rather, it seemed to be dead?
So Hobert touched it, and only his spirit was impacted, instead of turning into a pool of collapsed flesh and blood.
But now was not the time to consider these things. Hobert crouched down and reached in the opposite direction of the feather's owner. When he touched the skull on the ground again, Hobert felt a sense of familiarity.
Using the position of the skull, Hobert found the stone wall again, and holding onto the wall, he hurried out.
He brushed past the creature or sealed object that made the dull footsteps again.
Before long, Hobert heard the sound of the stone door closing behind him. The fear that lingered in his heart disappeared, and Hobert almost collapsed to the ground.
He struggled to walk forward step by step, and the sense of crisis from his spirituality gradually disappeared.
For the sake of safety, Hobert walked forward for another ten minutes before confirming that he was out of danger.
Slumping to the ground to rest, Hobert felt like he had watched horror movies for a whole day. The fear even made him unwilling to recall the experience just now.
Now he could open his eyes. In fact, he could have opened his eyes earlier, but for the sake of safety, Hobert had kept his eyes tightly closed.
Hobert's eyes gradually adapted to the dark corridor. This was an unfamiliar place.
But the underground structure was not complicated. Hobert estimated that he could find a familiar path after turning a few corners.
Only then did Hobert belatedly realize why he hadn't used the "Teleportation Statue" just now? If he had held the "Teleportation Statue" in his hand, he could have had a general understanding of the surrounding things.
But then Hobert thought that it was because the repressive force of the sealed object was too strong. Fear filled his entire mind, leaving him with no energy to think about these things.
This was a real mental attack, or rather, a negative state. Fortunately, his ability to resist mental pressure was good. Ordinary people could easily collapse under such mental pressure.
When the heart is full of fear, only one thought remains: run!
Nothing else would be thought of.
Hobert also thought that maybe his spirituality had prevented him from using the "Teleportation Statue". Perhaps using this sealed object would bring disastrous consequences?
After all, he had used the "Psychological Spoon", which showed that although he was embarrassed at the time, and eager to escape, he still had basic rationality.
Thinking of the stone door that might have teleportation ability, or the sealed object with teleportation ability, Hobert increasingly felt that it should be his spirituality that prevented him from using the idea of the "Teleportation Statue".
As for the reason, Hobert certainly didn't know now, and could only temporarily ignore the problem.
After resting for a while, Hobert felt much better and continued to get up and walk forward.
As he expected, after turning two corners, he found the road he had taken when entering the underground structure.
After walking for another ten minutes, he returned to the noble courtyard in the ruins.
There were still many people outside. They didn't know what had happened inside and were still chatting and laughing while smoking.
The two mercenary team members who stayed outside saw that Hobert's expression was not right, and quickly surrounded him and asked, "What's wrong? What happened?"
Hobert found a stone pier to sit down on: "I'll talk about it later, give me a cigarette."
In the Common Era, he had a habit of smoking, but he stopped smoking after transmigrating.
He had already planned to quit completely, but now he urgently needed a cigarette to calm down.
After taking only two puffs, there was movement again at the entrance of the underground structure.
Dophis took the lead and came out. He breathed a sigh of relief when he saw Hobert sitting on the stone pier smoking.
Jacob followed behind, his face paler than Dophis, his eyes were dull, and he was carrying a huge wild rabbit in his hand.
The people behind Jacob looked like they had lost their souls one by one.
At this time, someone asked, "Where are the others?"
"They're all dead!" Jacob trembled, but he still didn't let go of the wild rabbit in his hand: "They're all dead!"
"All dead?"
"How did they die?"
No matter how chaotic the surroundings were, Dophis's panicked expression quickly disappeared and became expressionless again.
He was a little flustered just now because he was worried about Hobert's safety. Seeing that Hobert was fine, he made an opening gesture on himself while saying, "That may be a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact."
Hobert opened his mouth, marveling at his good fortune to be able to walk around in front of this level of Sealed Item and still be alive and kicking, praise...
Who should he praise?
While thinking wildly, Hobert felt something. He opened his spiritual vision and saw Dophis pulling a skeleton with a pair of wings out of that illusory door. The pair of wings was composed of dense small bones, which looked quite artistic.
The skeleton flew up and circled over everyone's heads.
Hobert's eyelids immediately became heavy. Dophis put one hand on Hobert's shoulder, and the strong sleepiness disappeared.
The people around were still asking, still questioning, and still panicking, falling down one after another.
Hobert opened his mouth, but still did not speak to stop him. A Grade 0 Sealed Artifact was enough for Dophis to start a massacre!
Rather than worrying about the people who fell down, Hobert might as well worry about his own safety. Who knew if Dophis would simply kill him to silence him in order to embezzle the Sealed Artifact?
At this time, Dophis explained coldly: "It's also unreasonable for them to all die. This flying spirit can rewrite everyone's memories in their dreams.
"Well, let me think, it can be disguised as them having internal strife over wealth, so many people died."
Hobert, who was already considering whether to beg for mercy, breathed a sigh of relief, so he wouldn't have to die.
Dophis began to get busy. He walked around in the noble courtyard and even the ruins. Before long, corpses lined up and came out from underground.
Hobert, who was quietly watching the show, understood that Dophis's distance to control the corpses was limited. He walked around to appear directly above the corpses, so that those corpses were within his controllable range.
The corpses that came out from underground included ordinary people and Beyonders. Each corpse held its own Beyonder characteristics.
Dophis first manipulated the corpses to block the entrance to the underground, and then he borrowed the power of the underworld and did a seal in the field of mysticism.
"Unless a demigod comes to check it out in person, it is difficult to find this entrance," Dophis said confidently.
And if the outside world doesn't know that there is a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact here, it is impossible for a demigod to come to this excavated ruin when they have nothing to do.
Then Dophis acted like a director, designing the standing positions of Jacob's team members, letting the corpses kill themselves again with sharp weapons, and cutting wounds on Jacob and others to disguise the traces of fighting.
When everything was designed, the skeleton with wings appeared again and flew around in the sky above everyone.
Everyone sat up one after another. There had just been a fierce firefight. They were too tired, so they lay on the ground to rest.

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 216 Plan to seize the "Red Priest" card
chapters.content:

Riding in the carriage back to Backlund, Hobert looked at the sun in the sky, feeling a sense of unreality about everything that had happened underground.
Currently, he and Dophis are the only ones who know that there is a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact inside, and it was not until now that Hobert was sure that Dophis had no intention of killing him to silence him.
In addition to telling him to keep it secret, Dophis also said that he would tell Christian about the Sealed Artifact.
This made Hobert speculate again about Christian and Dophis. What did they experience together to establish such a solid relationship?
That's a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact!
With such a thing, it would be no problem to establish a mysterious organization with a inheritance of hundreds or thousands of years.
Dophis can withstand such temptation?
Hobert has thought about this question three times, but he still can't figure it out.
However, he guessed that Dophis's actions were nothing more than based on two starting points: first, he has his own persistence, or he knows that his ability is limited and he cannot seal that Sealed Artifact; second, he has higher ideals.
Hobert is biased towards the former. Dophis has always looked like he is indifferent to fame and fortune. He didn't have much reaction when he got the 10,000 pound check just now.
In addition, the fact proves that Dophis did not find a sealing method, and he has no confidence in sealing it at present, otherwise he would not have spent so much effort on disguise, it would be better to just take the Sealed Artifact away.
The second situation is not impossible, because Dophis has a higher ideal than a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, so he doesn't care about such external things at all.
Hobert shook his head and stopped thinking about this issue.
Then he thought of another thing, should he tell Mr. Azik about this?
Hobert is also greedy for that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, but he also knows that it will be difficult for him to take charge of this Sealed Artifact in the short term.
Of course, the most important thing is that Hobert has something to ask of Mr. Azik.
These days, when Hobert has free time, he has been planning the second "bribe" to The Fool.
His plan is to take this opportunity to offer a "Blasphemy Card" to The Fool.
In order to prevent Klein from failing to save Little "Sun" in the future because he took the "Black Emperor" card, or leading to the change of ownership of the "Sefirah Castle".
In Backlund, Hobert only knew about the "Red Priest" card in the hands of Medici and the others. When he first thought about this issue, Hobert just thought about it and gave up the plan.
Because according to Hobert's analysis, later Medici's evil spirit possessed Ince Zangwill, and he (She?) had not been able to completely control Ince.
However, later Medici completely turned a "Gatekeeper" into his own puppet.
So Hobert probably guessed that at this time, Medici's evil spirit should have about Sequence 4 strength. He, a Sequence 7, is looking for death if he goes to a Sequence 4 to extort the "Red Priest" card.
Even if he can use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to scare Medici, Hobert is also afraid of attracting George III again.
He has brushed shoulders with this King twice, because he is only Sequence 7 so he only brushed shoulders with him.
If he uses the power of the "Nation of Disorder" too frequently in Backlund, it will attract the attention of George III sooner or later.
So Hobert just thought about it and decided to give up.
But after meeting Mr. Azik, Hobert had a new idea. He could ask Mr. Azik to hold Medici down, and he would search for the "Red Priest" card.
Mr. Azik is not only higher in position than the current Medici, but he is also the nemesis of ghost-like creatures. It is estimated that the three of Medici would have trembling legs just seeing Azik.
The only thing to be careful about may be to beware of Adam's gaze.
After all, Adam rubbed Medici and the other three into an evil spirit. Later, during Ince's long journey to send 0-08 to Adam, Medici's evil spirit played a role in making Ince have to go to the Southern Continent to seek exorcism help.
Maybe the current Medici is also in Adam's story.
However, just taking a card from Medici's hand does not affect Adam's story, and Adam should not take action.
After having this plan, Hobert was considering how to get Mr. Azik to help. Hobert even thought about directly telling Azik about his life experience.
But how to package this information has become a problem again. After all, he is just a Sequence 7, and it is dangerous to know too much.
Then the clue to this Grade 0 Sealed Artifact can be completely used as a reward for asking Azik to take action.
It's just that this deal is a bit uneconomical. A Grade 0 Sealed Artifact is exchanged for a "Blasphemy Card"?
Thinking of this, Hobert shook his head: No, no!
He entered that stone room. If you think about it carefully, there are actually two Sealed Artifacts in that stone room. One is the owner of the feather, and the other is a Sealed Artifact that has a certain degree of activity and kills whoever looks at it.
It is very likely that Dophis misjudged. Those are two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, or one Grade 0 and one Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, or a combination of one Grade 1 and a special existence.
Hobert is more inclined to believe that there is a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact and a special existence in the stone room.
That special existence of the "Death" pathway may be very important to Azik, so it attracted Azik to appear around the ruins.
You can negotiate with Azik that they both have the opportunity to choose the spoils obtained from this exploration.
With Azik's character, you don't have to worry about him killing people to silence them. Hobert believes that as long as he participates in the action, he should be able to get one of the Sealed Artifacts.
Having made up his mind, Hobert plans to go to Azik next week to start his plan to seize the "Blasphemy Card".
With these plans, Hobert looked at the sun in the sky again. He felt like he had a psychological shadow about the ancient ruins!
At this time, he suddenly thought of the Harvest Church and Bishop Utravsky. Although that church is not big, it gives people the feeling that it can not only smooth the wounds of the soul, but also relax the whole person's spirit.
Hobert decided to visit Bishop Utravsky when he has time recently. After all, he has not finished reading "The Bible of Life".
Back on Blanca Street, Hobert changed his clothes and lay on the bed, not wanting to get up.
The long-term high mental tension today made him very tired. He fell asleep after lying down and had some messy dreams.
After resting for a night, Hobert felt that his spirituality had been well restored and his mental state was very good. He then used his own way of praying to himself to send the Beyonder characteristics of "Prisoner" from the "Nation of Disorder" to the real world.
It has been two or three weeks since he attended the mercenary club party. He plans to start turning the Beyonder characteristics in his hand into cash today.
After thinking for a long time, he decided to sell the Beyonder characteristics of "Prisoner", "Lunatic" and "Werewolf" in three times respectively.
These Beyonder characteristics came from Elliot's sacrifice before. At that time, he sacrificed a copy of the "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristics, and Hobert used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to shatter this Beyonder characteristics, so he had the above three main materials.
It was still morning when he arrived at the mercenary club. Hobert first went to the information wall on the third floor to take a look. No one has completed the task of finding the mastermind behind the thief that Simon Vincent released.
Although Hobert has clues in his hand, he is not interested in this task.
Hobert was not interested in any of the other tasks, so he asked the waiter to release the task of finding and capturing Hillman in the mercenary club.
As for the task of finding Heyman, because he has clues in his hand, he plans to do it himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 217 Economic plundering strategy with Beyonder characteristics
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert had already prepared the detailed information about Hillman that he had obtained from the Nighthawks team.
After giving the information to the waiter, Hobert went to look at other information on the information wall.
Among the publicly available information, Hobert found a very valuable piece of information.
He remembered that the first time he came to the mercenary club, he saw people forming teams to rob the Intis Republic of gold in its colonial plundered lands.
Now, the sequel to this operation has arrived. Although many people died, they were very successful.
However, even though they had exhausted all means, they could not take away all the gold there.
After the Intis reinforcements arrived in the colony, more than 100,000 pounds of gold were protected by them.
The Intis Republic knew that the location of their hidden gold had been exposed, and fearing that other forces would also covet it, they simply transported the batch of gold, along with a large amount of silver and gems, back to the Intis Republic.
The wealth that the team of mercenaries had seized was enough for them to live the life of a wealthy man for the rest of their lives, so they simply sent people to monitor when the Intis Republic's ship would set sail and which route it would take.
They published this information, hoping that their colleagues would also have a chance to make a fortune.
However, they also warned their colleagues not to take risks if they were not strong enough, because the escort for this batch of goods was a commodore of the Intis Republic, a very famous powerhouse in West Balam.
Hobert estimated that the information the other party wanted to reveal was: that he was a Sequence 5!
At the same time, he believed that the other party was likely to possess at least a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact.
This level of opponent was already difficult to deal with, and it would be even more difficult to deal with at sea.
First of all, you had to have a ship, experienced sailors, and enough strong people in the action team.
Hobert was about to look at the next piece of information when he suddenly thought that he could sell this news to "The Hanged Man"!
Of course, not to let "The Hanged Man" rob this batch of gold, which would be like asking him to die.
He could let "The Hanged Man" resell this news, with "The Hanged Man" earning an information fee, and Hobert earning an information intermediary fee.
So Hobert noted the details in this information before he started to look at the next piece of information.
Looking at each item one by one, the other information was not very important to Hobert.
Soon it was lunchtime, Hobert went to the restaurant for a meal, and met an acquaintance in the restaurant: the masked man who gave Xio the task.
It's just that he wasn't wearing a mask today. He was in his thirties, and his appearance looked very ordinary, the kind that would be difficult to find again if thrown into a crowd.
After Hobert accompanied Xio to meet the masked man at Mr. A's party, he specifically inquired about it. The masked man was called Byron, but no one knew which department Byron was an officer in.
They both came to participate in the party, and at the same time, they didn't know anyone else, so the two of them chatted idly.
After the party started, the two of them entered the underground theater together and sat together.
The party here was still the same as before. First, there was the team formation session. Someone recruited teammates to rob the Intis Republic's ship loaded with gold, someone recruited teammates to explore a newly discovered deserted island, someone recruited teammates to complete an assassination mission in the Feynapotter Kingdom, and someone recruited teammates to find the treasure of an ancient Beyonder family.
Although many people were recruiting teammates, there were no major operations during this period.
Then came the trading session, which started from the front row in order of selling or buying.
Because there were no major operations recently, there was nothing good to sell.
However, there were still Beyonder Characteristic transactions. Hobert, who had participated in other Beyonder gatherings, realized at this time that only the Mercenary Club openly bought and sold Beyonder characteristics.
In other gatherings, the transactions of Beyonder characteristics were generally carried out behind the scenes.
Hobert only thought of this question today, why is the transaction volume of Beyonder characteristics so large at the Mercenary Club's gatherings?
Just when it was almost Hobert's turn, he took out the wooden box containing the main material of "Prisoner" in advance. Before he could shout, Byron next to him asked, "Are you selling an Beyonder Characteristic again?"
Hobert nodded, anyway, he would have to shout it out in a while, there was nothing to hide.
The other party didn't ask what path the Beyonder Characteristic was from, and directly whispered, "I want it!"
Hobert was stunned before saying, "Prisoner."
"290 pounds!"
"I sold it for 300 pounds last time!"
"Then 300 pounds. After the party, we will trade in the lounge."
Hobert nodded and put the wooden box away again.
More than half an hour later, the party ended, and Hobert and Byron agreed to come to a small lounge.
After Byron inspected the goods, he paid the money very happily.
Hobert counted it again and confirmed that it was correct.
Byron smiled and said, "If you have any Beyonder characteristics to sell in the future, you can contact me directly, especially when you are in a hurry for money, you can cash it out without waiting for the party."
Hobert asked, "Don't ask about the origin of the Beyonder characteristics?"
"Don't ask."
"Do you accept Beyonder characteristics from any path?"
"I accept them all." Byron took out paper and pen and wrote an address: "If you have Beyonder characteristics to sell, send a letter to this address. The content of the letter is 'The goods have arrived'.
"After I receive the letter, I will come to the Mercenary Club for transaction at 9:00 to 10:00 the next morning. If I don't arrive at 10:00, it means there is something temporary, and the transaction will be carried out at the same time the next day."
Hobert put away the address and asked, "What do you do with these Beyonder characteristics after you collect them? Do you make them all into magical items?"
"Used to preserve value! Used to plunder the gold of the Southern Continent!" Byron smiled and said, "Beyonder characteristics are more valuable than gold. No matter whether the currency depreciates or not, it will not depreciate.
"At the same time, it also has strategic significance. For example, the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Prisoner' path, we will let the Rose School use a lot of gold every year to exchange for the Beyonder characteristics of related paths in our hands.
"Then we will continue to crack down on the Rose School, seize new Beyonder characteristics, and then let them exchange them with gold."
Hobert didn't expect this kind of operation: "What if they don't exchange?"
"Then increase the crackdown." Byron said: "Until the main material of 'Prisoner' soars, at this time, as long as we are a little cheaper than the market price, it will be snapped up by the local Beyonder people."
Hobert finally knew why some evil Beyonder organizations are always very poor. When it comes to playing with people, you still have to look at the gentlemen of the Loen Kingdom.
He asked again: "We also have to lose Beyonder people to crack down on the Rose School. How to make up for this loophole?"
"This is the benefit of official Beyonder people." Byron said: "Most of the time, we can calmly recover the Beyonder characteristics."
Hobert nodded, that is to say, he completely regarded the low-sequence military Beyonder people without backing and background as cannon fodder.
