chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 218 "The Fool's Alt" is online
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters. Become a free member and you can get a shoutout and a free bonus chapter at zero cost
---
The Southern Continent does not have small towns.
Elliot brewed tea and brought it to the living room for the guests.
These guests were all residents of the Nonexistent Town, and they were all here to inquire about the recovery of Elliot's sister, Moira.
In this town, every family has a crazy relative.
Elliot told them about the greatness of the 'Creator,' and at the end of his description, he said, "This is an opportunity to save the entire town and the entire family."
However, he was met with silence from the guests, who all possessed some knowledge of mysticism and held a cautious attitude towards the 'Creator,' whom they had never heard of.
Elliot smiled and finished his tea: "It's noon, so I won't keep you for lunch."
He was already used to this attitude, knowing that these family members were still watching.
After seeing off the guests, Moira, who was cleaning up the teacups, said, "Little Elliot, Elder Calvin has already come to you twice. You can't stay at home anymore."
"But..." Elliot looked at his sister.
"I know, I know." Moira smiled and said, "I know you want to stay at home and spend more time with me. I'm already well, and we'll have plenty of time to be together in the future. But the family's opportunity for external assignment is only this once."
Elliot said, "If I go to the copper mine, I might not be able to come home for two or three months."
Moira smiled and said, "Usually, I can tell the relatives about the greatness of the 'Creator' at home. If I miss you, I can come and see you, my silly brother!"
...
Forsaken Land, City of Silver.
Derrick, who had already passed the instructor's assessment, couldn't hide his joy. Starting tomorrow, he would begin patrolling in and around City of Silver.
These places were all within the safe zone. During patrols, he wouldn't encounter overly powerful monsters. In fact, most of the monsters were ordinary monsters, and killing them wouldn't yield mystical materials.
However, each patrol would earn Derrick a certain amount of merit.
Merit could be exchanged for extraordinary materials, Beyonder potions, Beyonder weapons, sealed items, potion formulas for the 'Giant' and 'Dragon' pathways, and more. Food, daily necessities, and some mystical materials or unsequenced magic potion formulas could also be bought on the black market.
Merit could be seen as City of Silver's legal currency.
Derrick planned to accumulate some merit, first pay off Mr. 'Emperor's' debt, and then buy a weapon from the black market.
After passing the second round of assessment, he could go to patrol further places, earning more merit with each patrol, and even ask teammates for help to harvest some extraordinary materials.
While planning for the future, Derrick returned to his room.
"Prepare for the gathering!"
Derrick heard that supreme voice in his ear. He took a deep breath, calmed his mood, and began counting heartbeats.
However, Derrick still couldn't hide his excitement, and his heart beat too fast. This time, he counted over a thousand beats before the gray mist covered his vision.
Derrick reappeared in the Giant Palace. The new Tarot Gathering was about to begin.
Huh? There's a new member!
The others also looked at the new member. 'Justice' Audrey greeted everyone as usual, but kept sizing up the new member in the black robe sitting at the lower seat.
"Hanged Man" Alger then began to guess the new member's identity: Was he from a special region? Or did he possess special abilities?
"Emperor" Hobert smiled and thought: Mr. Fool's alt account is online.
"Mr. Fool" Klein seemed calm, but was trying hard to adapt to the state of having two perspectives at once.
After Audrey finished greeting, Klein leaned back in his chair and said, "This is the new member, Mr. 'World'!"
"Hello." The very polite Audrey was the first to greet the new member.
Alger and Derrick followed closely behind. When it came to Hobert's turn, he greeted him and then smiled mischievously, "You look familiar, a person from Loen? Have we met somewhere before?"
Audrey curiously sized up Mr. World, then turned her head to size up Mr. Emperor: Unless it was a new member developed by the "Emperor", there would be a very small probability of meeting an acquaintance at the Tarot Gathering, right?
Alger didn't react much. He guessed that this might be the "Emperor" trying to get information.
Derrick was a little envious: How nice, to be able to meet someone you know at the Tarot Gathering.
Klein scratched his head behind the gray mist: It can't be such a coincidence, that the person he randomly created looks so much like an acquaintance of the "Emperor". He manipulated "World" to say to "Emperor": "You must have mistaken me for someone else. I don't remember meeting you anywhere."
"Although the gray mist covers your face, I recognized you at a glance." Hobert continued, "You don't have to pay back the money you owe me. So, you dare to acknowledge me now?"
At this time, Klein behind the gray mist had already used his spiritual vision to discover that Hobert was lying. He was immediately a little dumbfounded: What a sly dog! To joke with the new member like that, aren't you afraid that the new member will quit the Tarot Gathering?
Klein manipulated "World" to say, "You really have mistaken me for someone else!"
It's over, it's over, the aloof persona has already collapsed.
"Alright, alright, you two." Audrey said with a smile, trying to smooth things over, "Let's start the gathering!"
She had already understood that the Emperor was joking, but she didn't understand why the Emperor, who always seemed so serious, would suddenly joke with the new member?
Perhaps they really knew each other?
Hahaha, to encounter a creditor at such a secret Tarot Gathering! Mr. World is really unlucky.
Alger couldn't help but curl the corners of his mouth, watching the new member being embarrassed.
Derrick hesitated whether to advise Mr. World to pay back the money? After all, owing debts and not paying them back was still a very bad thing to do.
At this time, the "Fool" said to "Justice", "The two candidates you suggested are still under consideration.
"I'll give you a simple task, which you will entrust to them in your name. This is part of the assessment."
As soon as these words came out, the farce from just now was considered over.
Audrey thought: It should be this strict!
So, the "Fool" handed the task of finding Leonard to Audrey.
Then, Alger once again offered six pages of diary to Mr. Fool. After Mr. Fool finished this week's reading time, he said to "Justice", "Miss Justice, you did a great job, you solved Bakerland in less than a week."
Audrey raised her chin slightly, feeling a little proud. She quickly warned herself: Audrey, don't be proud, this matter was completed so smoothly thanks to Mr. Hobert.
At the same time, she saw the surprised expression of the "Hanged Man", and "World" asking, "Did you send someone to kill Bakerland?"
This made Audrey feel a burst of comfort in her heart, and she couldn't help but raise her chin again.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 219 Cooperation between the "Emperor" and the "Hanged Man" (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
Join p atreon.com /KeyofStars for 90+ advance chapters. Becoming a free member also gets you a bonus chapter!
[Thanks to Crispycougar for becoming a free member]
As for the Emperor not being surprised, Audrey wasn't surprised by that.
After her investigation, she felt she was close to identifying the Emperor's identity. "The Emperor" was also in Backlund, so he definitely knew about Bakerland's murder.
Bakerland's matter had come to an end, which made Alger sigh at the growing power of the Tarot Club. An ambassador was killed just like that.
Then "The World" used a hoarse voice to initiate a new transaction: "I want to obtain the true rhizomes of the Mist Treant, at least 60 milliliters of the corresponding sap, as well as the medullary crystals of the Elven Spring, and all the spinal fluid of the Evil-patterned Black Panther.
"Who can provide these, or have corresponding clues? What do you want me to exchange for them?"
Hobert immediately realized the wonderful use of the "alt account". If Mr. Fool were to seek these Sequence 7 materials, he would be suspected by the members of the Tarot Club.
Using an "alt account" to seek them was reasonable. Hobert thought that if the "Creator" found it inconvenient to come forward in the future, he could also "register" an alt account.
Hobert had channels to obtain all these materials, but he didn't plan to participate in the transaction. In his opinion, reselling extraordinary materials was too slow to make money and involved certain risks, which wasn't worth it.
Derrick indicated that he could obtain the true rhizomes and sap of the Mist Treant, and he hoped to get a weapon suitable for him.
"But I'll have to wait a while before I can get these materials," Derrick said. He needed to complete the second round of assessment before he could join the farther patrol team and encounter the Mist Treant.
Audrey and Alger also agreed to help Mr. World look out for relevant clues.
Then Alger said to "The Emperor": "When I went ashore a few days ago, I heard a clue about a sealed artifact with 'Traveling' abilities. I'll help you inquire about it this week."
Hobert smiled: "Finally, there's news. If the transaction is completed, I'll pay you a commission."
He said: "Also, I have information here that can be sold for a high price. You can also look for buyers at sea. How about we split the profits?"
Alger was stunned: "I must confirm its value."
"A ship full of gold and jewels!" Hobert smiled. "To be honest, if I had the ability to 'Travel' now, I'd want to cooperate with you to rob this ship of treasure."
"Such news is indeed very valuable," Alger said. "Provided that not many people know about this news."
Hobert recalled the information: "No one at sea should know about it yet, but it will be hard to say in a week or two, because as far as I know, some people have already started recruiting teammates in Backlund, preparing to make a big splash at sea.
"When this group of people goes to sea, I don't think it will be long before this news is no longer so secret."
Alger considered it: "We can cooperate to sell this news, but the method of distributing the profits must be changed. I want 70% of the profits because I will be taking a great risk."
"Alright then." Hobert looked reluctant, but this was already higher than he had expected. He originally just wanted to earn a commission.
Audrey joined the topic and asked: "Mr. Hanged Man, don't you plan to use this news to rob that ship of wealth? That's an adventure on the sea. It's exciting just thinking about it, but the premise is that those riches are some illegal income."
Before Alger could say anything, Hobert smiled: "Adventure isn't about courting death. As far as I know, there should be a Sequence 5 powerhouse escorting the ship, and he most likely possesses a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact."
Audrey covered her mouth: "So strong?"
"Yes, the riches on the ship are gold and jewels plundered by the Intis Republic from its colonies. If you have the ability, you can rob them to your heart's content. There is no such thing as illegal or legal on the sea." Hobert thought that if Audrey were to be the captain, she would have to consider whether it was legal or illegal to rob a loaf of bread, and the entire crew would probably starve to death.
Alger asked: "What is the value of the riches on the ship?"
"At least 100,000 pounds of gold!" Hobert said. "There are also a lot of silver and many jewels. The specific value is at least 200,000 pounds or more."
Alger was somewhat surprised: "No wonder there is a Sequence 5 powerhouse escorting it."
Then he said: "Generally speaking, the sailing information of this kind of ship should be confidential."
Hobert smiled: "Just like I knew before that the Loen Kingdom didn't plan to retaliate against the Feysac Empire, I happened to have a channel to know this news."
Alger asked again: "What is the specific route, and when did it depart from which port?"
"They plan to take the Western Route, and they departed from Caesarea Port about ten days ago."
When Roselle opened up the New World, he found two relatively safe routes in the Berserk Sea. One was the Western Route through Midseashire, and the other was the Eastern Route through Tiana Isle and the Rorsted Archipelago.
There was also a route through the Gargas Archipelago and the White Whale Sea, which could also reach the Southern Continent, but it had to detour through the Sonia Sea, which was a longer voyage and was known as the Sonia Route, basically the exclusive route of the northernmost Feysac Empire.
Alger roughly estimated where the other party's ship was: "At least we have to sell this news to the Seven Admirals, oh no, one of the Six Admirals. Ordinary pirates won't go courting death."
He paused and then said: "It's hard to say how much this news can sell for specifically, but I think this news can sell for at least 2,000 pounds. If the robbery process goes smoothly, you might even get double or double the reward."
Hobert nodded: "You decide on the specific operation."
He then said to Audrey: "If it's convenient, please give me the 400 pounds you owe, and the Hanged Man owes 1,400."
Hobert spread his hands: "You've also heard that I've found a clue to a sealed artifact with 'Travel' abilities, and I need to raise funds as soon as possible."
Audrey and Alger both agreed to clear their debts by offering sacrifices to Mr. Fool after the gathering.
Derrick quickly said: "Sorry, Mr. Emperor, I just passed the assessment and have a way to earn merits. I may have to wait until the next gathering to pay you the previous reward."
"It's okay, don't be too anxious." Hobert smiled. "Congratulations, Little Sun, congratulations on passing the assessment."
"Thank you!" Derrick was very moved. Mr. Emperor was the third person to congratulate him. The first two were the instructor and a good friend. The instructor's congratulations were a bit perfunctory, and the friend's congratulations seemed a bit bitter, only Mr. Emperor's congratulations were from the bottom of his heart.
After collecting the debts, Hobert said to the head of the long table: "Mr. Fool, I digested half of the potion by bribing you before. Please forgive my rashness. I hope to bribe you again."

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 220 Tarot Club’s rental business (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:

[Thanks to Arash for becoming a free member, +1 bonus chapter]
Alger had wanted to ask if "The Emperor's" bribe had been successful for a while, but he was afraid that Mr. Fool would think he was questioning His status, so he never dared to ask.
Since it was successful, that means Mr. Fool is truly a god!
Thinking of this, Alger shook his head and smiled wryly, wasn't this obvious!
Audrey smiled and said, "Congratulations, Mr. Emperor, I didn't expect there to be a channel for quickly digesting potions."
"Yes, I didn't expect the effect to be so good either," Hobert said with a smile.
Derrick was also happy for "The Emperor": "The Emperor" is really amazing, he knows so much.
Klein deliberately made "The World" show a surprised expression to fit the persona of a new member.
Then he used the image of "The Fool" and said: "Currently, I don't need any sacrifices. The sacrifices I need are not something you can come into contact with at your level."
Hobert thought to himself: Hehe, I'll sacrifice a main ingredient of a 'Magician' and see if you want it.
He thought so in his heart, but said with a smile, "Mr. Fool, please forgive my offense. I may be able to collect something that you will be interested in soon. If that thing can impress you, I will sacrifice it to you to complete the bribery process. If not, I will continue to collect things that you might be interested in."
Klein nodded: "Okay."
To be honest, he didn't even know what he wanted. It was just because he was afraid that "The Emperor's" sacrifice would be too low-level, and Mr. "Fool" would treat it as a treasure, so he said that the things he needed were not something the Emperor could come into contact with.
Since "The Emperor" is so confident, he can take a look at what good things "The Emperor" can collect first, and then decide whether to let him sacrifice to himself.
Anyway, the final interpretation right is in the hands of "The Fool".
Audrey smiled and said, "I'm really looking forward to it!"
She still remembered that last time when "The Emperor" bribed Mr. Fool, they heard a lot of advanced knowledge, which can be said to have broadened their horizons.
Audrey was looking forward to "The Emperor's" second bribe, so that she, as an Spectator, could gain a lot of new advanced knowledge.
At this time, she recalled the Emperor's very useful magical item: "Mr. Emperor, may I ask where you bought that 'Spectator' pathway magical item? You know, I have been looking for clues about the Psychology Alchemists."
Hobert said, "That was given to me by my elder."
Klein and Alger were very envious. At the same time, they both thought in unison: "The Emperor" really comes from a Beyonder family.
Klein also thought: And it is a Beyonder family with a certain foundation, otherwise, such a high-quality product with such small negative effects could not be given to the younger generation so generously.
Audrey asked again: "May I ask again, does your elder have any more 'Spectator' pathway magical items?"
"You want to buy it?" Hobert smiled and said, "There is no need. Take the 'Psychological Spoon' as an example. You are already Sequence 8 now. After you advance again, you will gain the Beyonder power of 'Hypnosis'. When you advance to Sequence 6, you will have all the abilities of the 'Psychological Spoon'.
"Finding clues about the Psychology Alchemists, you should be able to advance to Sequence 7 soon. At that time, your own Beyonder abilities will highly overlap with the abilities of the 'Psychological Spoon'.
"So, an important principle for purchasing magical items is: to obtain abilities that you do not have now or in the future."
After hearing what Hobert said, Audrey immediately understood this point: "I understand, thank you for your reminder."
Hobert smiled: "But if you need it, you can rent the 'Psychological Spoon' again."
He said: "It is impossible for businesses like renting magical items to appear in other gatherings.
"But the Tarot Club is different. With the witness of Mr. Fool, we don't have to worry about other members defaulting on renting our magical items."
Everyone's eyes lit up. "The Emperor" is indeed very business-minded. However, Klein and Alger smiled helplessly. They didn't have any impressive magical items in their hands.
The gathering entered the final information exchange session. After everyone spoke one by one, Klein ended this Tarot Club meeting.
...
The Berserk Sea, on the Blue Avenger.
Alger returned to the captain's cabin, first recalled the information mentioned by "The Emperor" that could be sold for a high price, and then he sacrificed the 1,400 pounds of cash he gave to "The Emperor" to The Fool.
Then he thought about who to sell this information to? He could contact three Sea Generals, of course, not directly with these three powerhouses, but he knew the people they had arranged on the Rorsted Archipelago to collect information.
He didn't plan to report to the Storm Church for the time being. That way, he could only accumulate certain merits and not get too many benefits.
Because unless the Storm Church is desperately poor, they would rob the ships escorted by commodores of other countries, which is likely to trigger a series of diplomatic events, which would outweigh the gains for the higher-ups.
In the end, he decided to sell this information to "Hell Admiral" Ludwell. First of all, "Hell Admiral" has the ability to plunder the "Golden Ship", and secondly, "Hell Admiral's" liaison officer, Esther, knows that Alger has a background in the Storm Church.
Of course, Esther doesn't know that Alger is a member of the Storm Church, but only thinks he is an outer member of the Storm Church.
Alger deliberately revealed this information to Esther. At that time, Alger wanted to make a deal with Esther. Doing so would prevent Esther from backstabbing him.
For the same reason, this transaction can also prevent Esther from backstabbing him.
But even so, this transaction still has huge risks.
But Alger also thought that even if this information could only be sold for 2,000 pounds, it could greatly alleviate his current financial pressure.
Alger, who was preparing to advance secretly, had a common problem with other wild Beyonders: no money.
After hesitating for more than half a minute, Alger made up his mind: Do it! Even if Esther wants to go back on his word, I have the Sapphire Staff, so it's easy to escape from him.
So Alger removed the sundries on the table and re-planned the route on the sea chart.
...
The Forsaken Land of the Gods, City of Silver.
Derrick returned to his room and stayed for a while: I still owe Mr. Emperor a debt. The main material for my "Prayer of Light" has not yet been settled, and now I have promised Mr. World to help him obtain the real roots and sap of the Mist Tree Man.
Merits are not enough at all!
No, I have to think of other ways, Derrick thought: I heard that helping to make daily necessities in the workshop can also get some merits, I can go there and see!
Derrick felt that he had to take action immediately. He thought: I didn't expect that being in debt could make me so motivated.
After drinking a few mouthfuls of water, Derrick, who was originally planning to rest for an afternoon, tidied up his clothes and went out again.
...
Backlund, 192 Blanca Street.
Hobert obtained a total of 1,800 pounds of debt from Alger and Audrey through the method of obtaining a gift.
In addition to the "Prisoner" Beyonder characteristics that he had just dealt with yesterday, Hobert's total savings are now close to 7,000 pounds!
Hobert deposited another 2,000 pounds in the bank, so he still has close to 200 pounds in cash, as well as income from the Nighthawks and law firms, which is enough for his daily expenses.
Then, according to the previous plan, Hobert went to the Harvest Church to visit Bishop Utravsky.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 221 The beginning of Emlyn's change of fate (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
100 powerstones bonus chapter
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Rose Street, the Harvest Church remains as it was, with candles lit and the tall, imposing Bishop sitting in the front row. Otherwise, there were few worshippers.
Upon entering the church, Hobert smiled and said, "Father, yesterday I suddenly remembered that I hadn't finished reading 'The Holy Book of Life'.
"And I just experienced something very terrible and wanted to find a place to unburden my heart, so I thought of this place and came here."
"The great Earth Mother will not reject anyone in need of help," Bishop Utravsky said in a calm tone. "Come."
He pushed 'The Holy Book of Life' in front of Hobert.
Hobert sat next to Utravsky and buried his head in reading.
The church returned to silence, and everything seemed very harmonious.
Unconsciously, Hobert read for more than an hour, and he felt the fear remaining in his spiritual body was disappearing little by little.
This made him think that the 'Bible' in the orthodox church, which seems to describe stories about gods and saints, should have the effect of making the spirit and spiritual body more peaceful.
There should be some occult operations in it, just like 'Spiritual Realm Anecdotes'. Even chapters written in Loen language can make people feel uneasy.
Just as Hobert was about to discuss the contents of 'The Holy Book of Life' with Utravsky, the wall next to the two suddenly became illusory.
Then a handsome young man in his late twenties walked out of the illusion. He had black hair and red eyes, and his hair was combed back diagonally, with a bit of dashingness in his seriousness.
Hobert was stunned. Isn't this the vampire Emlyn White?
Then he almost laughed, never expecting to witness Emlyn's arrest.
Emlyn was also a little dazed when he saw Utravsky and Hobert, and then he smiled politely: "Sorry, I got lost and came to the wrong place."
Hobert smiled and said, "No, no, you didn't come to the wrong place. It must be the Earth Mother who brought you to us."
Emlyn also recognized Hobert: "I remember you, you were..."
Then he realized: "What Earth Mother?"
Hobert pointed to the emblem of life in the church.
Emlyn was shocked when he saw the emblem and turned to leave.
Utravsky got up and stopped Emlyn: "Your coming here must be the guidance of the Earth Mother. Praise the Mother, believe in the Mother!"
"Go to your great..." Emlyn originally wanted to say "Go to your Earth Mother", but when he saw Utravsky's instantly terrifying face, he immediately changed his words: "Great... great big head!"
Hobert watched the show with his arms folded: What a sensible vampire.
Emlyn was agile and wanted to bypass Utravsky to leave the church.
But Utravsky had already swung his iron fan-like palm, which was accurate and ruthless, hitting Emlyn's face directly and knocking him to the ground.
Emlyn sat on the ground for a full two seconds. Hobert believed that he was completely stunned. Vampires have always been known for their agility and strong self-healing abilities.
Emlyn may have received this kind of iron fan-like slap for the first time in his life!
After the young vampire reacted, he immediately transformed into a group of bats emitting black mist, flying over Utravsky's head.
Utravsky then exuded the light of dawn, grabbed two bats, and the black mist on the bats disappeared, and the shape of the bats turned into ankles.
The "Giant" Bishop grabbed the ankles, swung them up, and slammed the group of bats to the ground. The bats turned back into Emlyn the moment they touched the ground.
This time, Emlyn hit the ground solidly. Even if he wasn't knocked unconscious, he was completely stunned.
Utravsky pinched the back of Emlyn's neck, like carrying a chick, and took Emlyn to the backyard of the church.
Emlyn reacted when he was about to leave the church and shouted at Hobert: "If you can save me, I will repay you handsomely!"
Hobert smiled and said, "Sorry, I can't beat this priest."
In Emlyn's unwilling shouts, he was locked in the dungeon.
Utravsky returned and explained: "It is the responsibility of every bishop to convert these vampires."
Hobert smiled and said, "I know."
He got up to say goodbye: "Thank you 'The Holy Book of Life' for letting me unburden my heart. It's getting late, I have to leave."
Utravsky said: "It is the great Mother who makes your heart peaceful, of course, provided that you are willing to open your heart to the Earth Mother."
Hobert smiled, just picked up his cane, and then seemed to suddenly remember something: "Oh, by the way, a gentleman has come to Backlund who can solve your troubles. I think the Earth Mother will definitely guide him here. Of course, I will also play a negligible role in this."
He didn't plan to do anything, because even if he didn't do anything, Klein would come by himself after a while.
"Praise the Mother," Utravsky said, "and thank you for your help.
"You may be followed when you go back, but as long as you act normal enough, you won't arouse the other party's vigilance."
Hobert was stunned: "Who would follow me?"
"The companions of those we killed before," Utravsky said. "They have been watching the church recently, as if they have discovered something."
Hobert recalled the person in charge of the Tamara family in Backlund that he had seen on Nikola Street before.
There was also a strange old man beside him at the time, and the fat man with long hair looked very respectful to the old man.
Hobert guessed that the old man might have been sent by the Tamara family to investigate the annihilation of the previous team.
"Thank you for your reminder," Hobert said, and then he thought that the other party might have found some clues, but they must not have found him yet, so he had to act like nothing had happened.
If he is promoted to Sequence 6 in the near future, he can also organize people for a counter-kill.
After leaving the church, Hobert radiated his spirituality, but did not notice that he was being watched.
He got into a rental carriage and still didn't notice being followed.
But Hobert believed Utravsky's judgment that the other party might have used some magical item or sealed artifact to conceal their malice.
In the carriage, Hobert diverged his thoughts, wondering what kind of clues the other party would get?
It is estimated that after careful investigation of dreams or psychological aspects, they sorted out all the strangers who came to Rose Street on the afternoon when the "Judge" and his team had an accident.
Then they will be able to find clues by tracking and investigating these strangers.
Hobert realized that he was just one of the strangers at the time, and he would be followed, but he would not attract too much attention.
All the way back to Blanca Street, Hobert did not feel that he was being followed. He returned to his bedroom, prayed to himself, and then entered the "Nation of Disorder" and used "True Vision" to observe his surroundings.
Sure enough, he found three or four young people staring at the gate of No. 192 on the street!

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 222 Fors's Concerns
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After Hobert became a Sequence 7, the "True Vision" of the "Nation of Disorder" could extend beyond a dozen meters.
He had thought before that such a wide field of vision would be very useful for counter-surveillance.
Hobert sat on the "Iron Throne," remembering the faces of those young people.
To escape the surveillance of a Sequence 7's spiritual alertness, they must have used magical items or some mystical method.
Then he began to think about how to deal with the opponent's surveillance. He estimated that the other party would continue to monitor him for a few days, and since so many people had come, should he take the initiative to counterattack?
After thinking about it, Hobert dismissed the idea. If the other party didn't focus their main surveillance on him, he would have to ask people everywhere to complete the counterattack. Hobert estimated that his ranking for selecting spoils would be difficult to be at the top.
The key is that it would be tantamount to admitting it without being forced to.
If he wasn't in danger, it would be better to wait until he became a Sequence 6, put on a mask, and launch a counterattack. This could divert the opponent's attention and also harvest some spoils.
Having made up his mind, Hobert prepared to pay attention to the situation outside tonight. If the other party didn't launch any action, it would mean that they only listed him as an ordinary surveillance target.
If the other party launched any action, then he wouldn't panic either, and could use the "Creator" to repel them.
With the "Black Emperor" card, Hobert had many more options in the "Nation of Disorder." Even if he couldn't cause much damage to the opponent, he could scare them away.
After observing the surrounding situation, Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder" and came to the first floor.
At this time, Fors had returned and was cooking in the kitchen.
Hobert rolled up his sleeves to help. Today, Fors was preparing a seafood soup and a stewed mutton.
With the 10 pounds of meal expenses "provided" by the sheriff who kicked the door before, Hobert and their diet had improved a lot. They had meat almost every meal and could eat seafood every day.
Hobert helped cook the seafood and peel it for Fors to use.
Fors was marinating the mutton. While she was cutting a piece of fresh mutton into small pieces, she hesitated and said, "Hobert, I have something I need your help with, but please don't tell Xio."
Hobert nodded: "Speak."
"I, I have felt the connection between potion, spirit, and spiritual body through this period of apprenticeship in the back kitchen, and I am already a 'Trickmaster'. According to my previous idea, I shouldn't hear the whispers of the blood moon anymore."
Now Fors completely trusted Hobert and would no longer use "a friend of mine" to describe what happened to her.
She said, "But, what I didn't expect is that whenever the blood moon appears, I can still hear that maddening whisper, and it's getting worse and worse recently. To be honest, I don't know if I can survive the next blood moon."
Hobert considered it. He now had the ability to temporarily alleviate these symptoms for Fors with the "Nation of Disorder."
But in that case, Fors might miss the opportunity to join the Tarot Club.
Of course, he could also alleviate the symptoms for Fors first, and then recommend Fors to Mr. Fool in the future.
But if that were the case, it would feel a bit extraneous.
After considering it for a few seconds, Hobert decided to follow the original trajectory: "Do you remember what I said before, that your encounter actually contains an opportunity to change your destiny?"
The main reason was that the "Nation of Disorder" could not pull people in like the "Sefirah Castle", it could only reduce Fors's symptoms, but it could not completely isolate "Mr. Door's" "voice" like the "Sefirah Castle".
Fors recalled slightly and nodded.
"I didn't just say that casually, but I know what the Abraham family's curse represents. Let me tell you more clearly." Hobert said, "The whispers you hear in your ear are from a 'High Sequence' of your pathway, um, a stronger powerhouse than ordinary 'High Sequence'.
"Some hidden existences, such as those interested in that powerhouse, would be very happy to study those whispers. In this process, you can be rescued and also get the opportunity to improve yourself."
Hobert smiled and said, "Frankly speaking, I can help you alleviate the symptoms, but that might make you miss a huge opportunity."
Fors stopped grabbing the wrong mutton: "Hidden existence, then, then, I, I..."
"Don't worry," Hobert comforted, "Hidden existences are not completely equated with evil gods. I also know that there is a hidden existence who likes to help out-of-control Beyonders regain their sanity.
"But this doesn't mean you can easily trust some hidden existences. I'm just saying that some hidden existences don't represent evil gods.
"For example, those that have been verified, or those whose honorific names have been recited once without causing disaster or madness."
Fors first thought of the honorific name of "The Fool" that she saw in a book from Viscount Glaint. Xio had recited it once, and was still alive and kicking.
Hobert said, "Sometimes it's okay to be bolder with the object of your request for help, but at the same time, you still have to ensure sufficient vigilance in this regard. Well, I will also pay close attention to your situation during the blood moon. If you really need help, I will take action."
With Hobert's guarantee, Fors breathed a long sigh of relief. She decided to go back and look for the honorific name of "The Fool" and use it when she couldn't hold on anymore.
As soon as the two of them finished this topic, Xio came in from outside, smiling: "The Masked Man's mission is finally over! Today I must have a big meal and a glass of wine to celebrate!"
Fors glanced at her friend: "Having a big meal is no problem, but you can't drink!"
Hobert was stunned: "Why?"
"She once drank alcohol in a bar, and as a result, she advised the drunkards to quit drinking one by one, those who were unwilling to quit..."
Xio quickly interrupted her friend: "Hahaha, okay, then I won't drink."
At night, Hobert got up to monitor the outside twice. In the second half of the night, all the young people monitoring outside left, and they didn't appear one after another until the morning. It can be seen that the Tamara family has not regarded Hobert as the main target for the time being.
...
Southern Continent, Sebayron, in the mountainous area of the middle reaches of the Hodis River.
Elliott's carriage was traveling on a somewhat muddy mountain road. Some sections of the road were very steep, with the rushing Hodis River on one side and steep mountains on the other.
The road was very narrow, only allowing one carriage to pass. Many times, Elliott's carriage had to give way to carriages loaded with copper ore in spacious places.
The things these carriages were carrying were too heavy, and the brakes didn't have much effect at all. It was normal for one or two coachmen to die every month.
But whenever the mine went outside to recruit coachmen, these Sebayron people would still sharpen their heads and enter the copper mine to work, because there were not many ways to earn a salary in Sebayron.
In the night, Elliott finally arrived at the few wooden houses built by the copper mine.
This place has been taken over by the Balk family, and Elliott, as the director of the copper mine, was actually a bit late. Moreover, there was a Sequence 6 among the people who came in the early stage, and everyone had long had a lot of opinions about this "Master Elliott".

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 223 The need for a water pump
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Although the few Beyonders sent by the Balk family had some opinions about the late Elliot, they were outwardly very welcoming to Elliot.
After a welcome banquet that evening, the next morning, the family members who had arrived earlier took Elliot to visit the copper mine.
The Feysac Empire's colonists had been mining this copper mine for seven or eight years, and the residential facilities were relatively complete.
There were places for managers like Elliot to live, places for local foremen and coachmen to live, and shacks for slaves and horses.
While visiting, the group chatted, and Elliot found that these family members had vaguely gathered around the Sequence 6 Zachary, showing enthusiasm but not much respect for Elliot, the actual leader.
Elliot certainly knew that he had the opportunity to get this position because he was a loyal believer of the "Creator"; in the family's other copper mine and a forest farm, both were managed by a Sequence 6.
Elliot was only a Sequence 7, and so far, he had not made any significant contributions to the family.
I have to find a chance to regain power, Elliot thought.
After visiting the residence and carriages, the group arrived at the entrance of the copper mine.
Elliot saw at the entrance of the mine, there was an old-looking steam engine, seemingly struggling to turn the reel and working hard, each movement making a " chi chi chi" sound.
On the other side of the steam engine, hundreds of slaves were squatting there, and local foremen with brown skin were patrolling back and forth with whips, maintaining the order of the slaves.
When the foremen saw Elliot and others, they immediately showed flattering smiles.
Elliot asked: "Are these slaves waiting for their shift?"
"No," Zachary replied: "There was a small-scale water inrush in the mine yesterday. Before the pump drains the water from the mine, it's useless for them to go down."
Another Beyonder following behind said: "This pump was left by the Feysac people. It is said that when it was transported here, it was an old guy that had been used for more than 20 years. The piston often leaks. It is estimated that it will take another day and night to pump."
Another Beyonder said to Elliot: "Mine manager, can you apply to the council to replace it with a new pump?"
Others also said: "Yes, if it is a new pump, it is estimated that the dozen or so slaves would not have drowned yesterday. Now slaves are getting more and more expensive, these are all costs on the copper mine."
"It is best to buy a pump produced in Lun, I heard in Crowlier City that the quality of Lun pumps is the best."
"I've also heard that if there is a Lun pump, the output of the copper mine will be at least doubled."
Elliot nodded: "I'll think of a way."
How could he not hear that they were giving him a problem.
Zachary then smoothed things over: "You guys give up on this idea, I've also heard of Lun pumps, but they are all hot commodities in their colonies, and you can't buy them anywhere else in the Southern Continent.
"Even if you want to buy it, you have to go through the Feysac Empire, and I don't know how much the premium will be."
Everyone looked at Elliot with a smile.
Elliot didn't say anything, just watched the steam engine running, as if to avoid embarrassment.
...
The Hobert team was busier than previously imagined, now they have to hold court twice a day on average, and the four of them simply can't handle it.
So Hobert asked Barton for two more people and an office.
Tuesday was another busy day. He was originally going to send a letter to Mr. Azik this afternoon, but because of the arrival of the newcomers, it was necessary to redefine the scope of work. Hobert really couldn't get away, so he had to wait until tomorrow.
Close to getting off work, Hobert heard the prayers from the "Nation of Disorder", needless to say, it must be Elliot, other people who know the name of "Creator" generally do not pray to the "Creator".
Coming to the washroom, Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder", and sure enough, Elliot was praying.
Spreading his spirituality to the star representing Elliot, he immediately heard Elliot's voice: "Great Creator, I am making a daily report to you, I was arranged by the council to manage a copper mine..."
After briefly talking about the situation of the copper mine, he finally said: "There is a small matter that needs to beg for your help. The facilities here are too dilapidated, especially the pump is so old that it is out of shape. I wonder if there are any relevant channels among your devotees, to buy a pump produced in the Kingdom of Lun?"
In Elliot's cognition, a big man like "Creator" would of course have many devotees.
Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne", had the urge to cover his face: Friend, my devotees is you!
Hobert also thought that he really had a channel for the pump. Didn't Mr. Digos make the most advanced pump in the world?
However, the "Creator" certainly couldn't be interested in such a trivial matter. He didn't reply to Elliot immediately, but after get off work, he returned to the rental house on Blanca Street, and he prayed to himself: "Respected 'Creator', I have a channel to buy Lun pumps, and it is the most advanced centrifugal pump, the price of one is about 1200 pounds, about 320 ounces of gold."
320 ounces is about 9 kilograms.
Then Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder", put a mosaic on the picture of his prayer, and threw it into Elliot's star.
This is a kind of use of "small account", Mr. Fool said it is good!
...
Elliot was having dinner when suddenly the "Creator" on the "Iron Throne" appeared in his mind first. The "Creator" was more majestic and oppressive than before. It was like the description of the "Black Emperor" in the family records!
While being oppressed and unable to breathe, Elliot was also a little excited: The great "Creator" has become more powerful!
Then he saw a man whose appearance and figure could not be seen praying: "Great 'Creator', I have..."
After the picture ended, the scene in Elliot's mind disappeared, and he saw the dining table in front of him, as well as other members of the family.
Elliot's first thought was: "Creator" really has other devotees.
320 ounces of gold is not expensive for Elliot, because there are usually gold ore in the copper mine. It is not easy for them to get 1200 pounds of Lun currency. Maybe 1000 ounces of gold may not be able to exchange for 1200 pounds of paper money.
But gold is just inventory piled up in the warehouse for them.
Elliot looked at the people on the dining table and smiled: I'll let you see the power of the great "Creator"!
Such a large transaction must be reported to the top. Elliot was summoned by the patriarch when he left Nonexistent Town. The way to report to the top is to pray to the patriarch!

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 224: Plan to resell the pump (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to bodeeson cheangpong for becoming a free member, +1` bonus]
After the night was quiet, Elliott prepared a simple altar in his own room, and then recited the honorable name:
"The mentor of authority and chaos;"
"The protector of the Balk family;"
"The ruler of the Hodis River Basin;"
"The embodiment of distortion;"
"The great Lawrence Balk."
Elliott burned the relevant occult herbs to establish a channel to the object of prayer.
The flame of the candle suddenly became huge, and Elliott saw a tall figure in the fire.
He bowed humbly and said: "Respectable patriarch, I have reached the Hodis Copper Mine. Although it is operating normally, the equipment used is very old. May I use the channel of the 'Creator' devotee to purchase a latest-style water pump produced by the Loen Kingdom?"
The tall figure in the candlelight seemed to be thinking. After a few seconds, Patriarch Lawrence said: "Buy two! Tomorrow you will build an altar and use extraordinary materials to establish a channel with me. I will give you an sealed artifact, and you will take this opportunity to complete the second round of bribery."
Elliott bowed again: "Thank you for your concern!"
...
On Wednesday afternoon, Hobert finally had time to visit Mr. Digos on Nicklow Street.
This time, Mr. Digos took Hobert to visit the crane. Hobert did not expect that the tall crane on the dock existed in this era. Although it was not as flexible as Hobert remembered, it could lift about ten tons of cargo at a time, which greatly saved manpower and improved efficiency.
When Hobert was about to leave, he said his purpose: "A friend of mine wants to buy two new-style water pumps. I just thought that I know a steam tycoon, so I came to consult for my friend."
Digos smiled and said, "It's a good thing to introduce business to me, but the other party must have a registered company in the Loen Kingdom. Don't worry, I can give him the price of a general distributor."
"Okay, I will tell him." Hobert asked again: "Will it be very troublesome to ship to other countries?"
"Of course it's very troublesome. It costs a lot of money to get customs clearance, and the tax rate is very high." Digos asked, "Is your friend a foreign businessman?"
"No, I'm just curious, so I asked." Hobert smiled.
"What model of water pump does he need?"
"Just the one we saw that day, the one that is about the size of a locomotive, which can be used in mines."
Digos nodded: "SL550, there are still parts in the warehouse, and it can be produced immediately after the order is placed."
Hobert said: "Okay, I will tell my friend."
In the carriage of the taxi on the way back, Hobert was a little embarrassed. It would be very difficult to transport it abroad, and it would be even more difficult to transport it to the Southern Continent.
It seems that I have to use "Creator Express" to help transport it. Hobert smiled in his heart. The members of the Tarot Club only know that "Fool Express" is easy to use, but they don't know that there is also "Creator Express" in this world.
Hobert's only worry is that the gap in his sacrificial gate is too small to grab a locomotive-sized water pump.
A large water pump must weigh at least several tons. It is still unknown whether the "Creator" can grab such a large weight of objects that do not contain Beyonder materials.
Hobert decided to do an experiment first, find a heavy object to grab and try, and then think of other methods if it doesn't work.
But I have to find a way to drive away the people who are tailing from the Tamara family, otherwise it would be a big trouble if they see the image of the "Creator".
Soon Hobert had an idea. Tomorrow he can go to the Steam Church to seek the help of "Machinery Hivemind" so that the Tamara family will not dare to follow him recently.
The reason for asking "Machinery Hivemind" for help instead of the more familiar Nighthawks is because Nighthawks did participate in the previous actions against the Tamara family.
If Hobert has contact with the Nighthawks, he can also scare the other party away, but it is likely to make the other party pay more attention to him.
But what Hobert didn't expect was that plans could not keep up with changes. That night, Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" to routinely observe the situation outside, but found that the four people outside were fighting!
But it can be seen that they all seem to have concerns, and they did not fight each other, but rather seemed to be testing each other.
This...
Could it be that someone bought a dinner that didn't suit everyone's taste, so they fought?
Hobert shook his head with a smile, and then he realized that he might have made a preconceived mistake. The four people outside were not in the same group!
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this was the case. Last night he thought that if the Tamara family sent four people to monitor him, it should be a prelude to some action against him, otherwise they would not send four people just to tail him.
If these four people are two groups, or even three groups, it makes sense. They are all routinely tailing.
As for who sent the other tailing people, Hobert also had some guesses: the Feynapotter Ambassador or Arnold's people.
When he accidentally killed the Feynapotter spy before, Hobert guessed that they might send someone to tail him, so he asked Xio and Fors to continue living on Blanca Street for a while.
Recently, Hobert and the other two have been paying attention to the situation on the street, but they have not noticed anyone tailing them. Now that I think about it, the other party must have used some method to deceive the spirituality of the three of them so that they did not notice anyone tailing them.
Then Hobert realized that this was an opportunity to get rid of all the "eyes".
He quickly returned to the "Nation of Disorder", first opened the window and looked at it. They were all hiding in the dark, and they did not make too much noise during the fight, so they could not see or hear their fight from upstairs.
Hobert jumped down from upstairs and walked quickly to the opposite alley according to the position seen in the "True Sight".
The four people who were testing each other in the alley noticed this change. They separated into two groups with great tacit understanding, backed against different walls, and were ready to leave at any time.
Hobert said: "I don't know where you Beyonders came from, but you are so stupid that people can't stand it. This is Backlund! If you have any conflicts, go to the suburbs to solve them! Don't cause trouble for others!"
The four were stunned!
"Don't get out of here!" Hobert said: "I'm telling you, I know Captain Ikanser of the 'Machinery Hivemind', be careful I report you!"
The four seemed to have discussed it, and stood there for a full one or two seconds before walking quickly out of the alley and leaving in two different directions.
Hobert pursed his lips and smiled, saying to himself: One of my words just now was right, these four people are indeed very stupid.
...
Among the four people who left, two of them repeatedly confirmed that they were not being followed before entering a residential house on Rose Street.
In the living room of the house, a middle-aged man in his thirties asked: "Why did you come back so early today?"
"Some accidents happened," one of the young men who was tailing said, "but I think I can basically rule out the lawyer's suspicion."

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 225: Haunted Freight Train Station
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
That middle-aged man in his thirties had a pair of large ears, which looked a bit comical. He was a young man whom the Tamara family had focused on cultivating in recent decades, and he was already a Sequence 5 at just over thirty years old.
His name was Bennett Tamara, and he was also the person in charge of the secret investigation into the disappearance of the entire team in Backlund.
The two subordinates who were tailing spoke one after another, recounting their experiences just now.
In fact, they had discovered yesterday that someone seemed to be watching them. Tonight, they finally confirmed it. Their first reaction was that this was a helper brought by Hobert, and they had been exposed.
But what happened next completely changed their view.
Bennett asked, "That lawyer said he wanted to report you?"
"Yes," one subordinate said.
"In other words, the other two people were also tailing us?"
"That's what we think."
Bennett pinched his chin and thought: "Who could have sent them?"
"We checked yesterday, that lawyer is a 'well-known lawyer' who has just offended many dignitaries. Could it be someone they sent?"
"That's possible." Bennett then said, "Are you sure he said he was going to report you to 'Machinery Hivemind', rather than 'Nighthawks'?"
"Sure."
Bennett said: "It seems we can rule him out. Since he is a 'well-known lawyer', he will be watched by many 'eyes', making it difficult to carry out some actions secretly."
Most importantly, Bennett analyzed that the Nighthawks must have also participated in the operation to destroy the Tamara family team, so the suspect they were looking for must have a close connection with the Nighthawks.
However, out of caution, Bennett still instructed: "Take some time to investigate the lawyer's beliefs."
But this investigation was not important, and he added: "Today, we discovered another stranger who appeared on Rose Street on the day of the incident. Follow him tomorrow."
...
The other two people who were tailing took a carriage to the West Borough.
The experienced coachman circled around a building several times, and after confirming that no one was following them, he sent the two into a luxurious villa.
The owner of the villa was a Backlund merchant who often did business in the Feynapotter Kingdom. Because he often relied on the Feynapotter government, he would often provide some convenience to the people of the Feynapotter Embassy under the communication of his business partners in the Feynapotter Kingdom.
Today, the Feynapotter Ambassador happened to be a guest at the villa, so he personally listened to the reports of the two subordinates in a reception room. After listening to the course of events, Ambassador Tim said: "I see. You don't need to follow Hobert anymore."
According to the clues Tim had previously obtained, Hobert was a member of the mercenary club and had access to bounty channels for two cultists.
And for a long time recently, Hobert had not shown any abnormalities, and it could be completely determined that he did not know that the third person who died in the textile factory at that time was a Feynapotter merchant, or rather, an intelligence officer.
However, after Ambassador Tim returned to the banquet, he suddenly thought that a detail was very wrong. According to the intelligence, Hobert seemed to be closer to the Nighthawks, but why would he go to the 'Mechanical Hivemind' to report them?
Also, as a wild Beyonder, shouldn't he try to avoid being affected by the battles of other Beyonders? Why did he take the initiative to come forward?
Ambassador Tim realized that this matter could not be concluded, and he had to find an opportunity to test this young lawyer.
"Ambassador?"
The villa owner's words brought Tim back to his senses: "Hmm?"
"Should we enjoy some violin or piano pieces?" the villa owner asked politely?
Tim smiled and stood up and said: "It is a pleasant thing to digest the food in your stomach with music."
"The Ambassador's taste always leaves us far behind."
...
Hobert overlooked one thing. Although the four people who were tailing him were very stupid, the people behind them were all shrewd.
His seemingly very wise move so far had actually left some flaws.
However, neither Bennett nor Tim took a Sequence 7 too seriously, so they did not pay too much attention to this matter after they had some doubts.
Anyway, Hobert is still very safe now.
After using 'True Sight' to confirm that no one was tailing him, Hobert immediately took a carriage to the freight train station in the suburbs.
Watching the coachman drive the carriage away, Hobert climbed into the train station.
...
Grov was a guard at the freight train station. The freight train station stopped operating to the public after six o'clock in the afternoon. After that, there would still be trains departing or arriving, but no more business would be accepted.
There were several large cargo warehouses in the train station, as well as many tracks, and idle or spare trains and carriages.
The entire train station was very large. In order to prevent some thieves from sneaking in at night, in addition to the fixed guards at the cargo warehouses, there would also be guards like Grov who would patrol around the train station every hour at night.
Grov smoked a seemingly old pipe, carried an oil lamp, and tightened his obviously ill-fitting coat.
The nights in Backlund in late autumn were already a bit cold, especially in the second half of the night when it was foggy. After a patrol, his hair would be full of dew. If he didn't wipe it off quickly, he would easily get sick.
Today, he patrolled as usual, following his usual route.
Suddenly, Grov saw a light in front of him. He knocked the ash off his pipe on a nearby carriage: "You little brats, don't let me catch you!"
Many homeless children would climb into the carriages of the train station to spend the night in order to avoid the police and the cold.
Generally, Grov would turn a blind eye, but if someone was making a fire in the carriage, he would have to stop them.
Woo~
Grov had just taken two steps forward when suddenly an evil wind blew through the air. The lamp in his hand was almost blown away, and the surrounding carriages were also blown, making a "creaking" sound.
"That's really weird!" Grov said. He hesitated whether to continue forward.
Woo~
Another gust of evil wind blew from the front. While Grov tightened his coat, he saw a discarded small train head slowly rising in the midst of the gale.
Grov opened his mouth wide, thinking he had seen it wrong. He rubbed his eyes and raised his lamp. The small train head had risen to more than one person's height, but it suddenly stopped there, as if it couldn't "fly" up, and slowly fell again.
Woo~
Another gust of wind, and the small train head slowly rose again, this time rising even higher, until it stopped at about thirty feet (more than 9 meters), and then slowly fell again.
At this time, Grov seemed to realize something. He raised his lamp and looked into the air. He couldn't see anything in the dark night sky, but he always felt that something terrifying was "lying" in the air.
That terrifying thing, it seemed, seemed to want to devour the small train head in front of him?
Suddenly, the oppressive feeling disappeared, and the firelight in front also disappeared.
Everything returned to normal, the small train head lay there quietly, and the surrounding carriages remained motionless.
Grov stood there until his legs were stiff before muttering: "That's really evil!"
Saying this, he backed away, not daring to turn his back to the small train head. He didn't dare to come out to patrol again tonight.
The next day, rumors of hauntings spread from the freight train station in the suburbs.

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 226 Azik's appearance
chapters.content:

Late at night, Hobert, after exiting the train station, walked two or three blocks before hailing a cab.
He had just tried using the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to grab the small train head, but found it impossible.
According to his estimation, the small train head should be slightly heavier than the water pump, which is why he used it for the experiment.
If he held the "Black Emperor" card, the small train head could be lifted a little, but only a little.
During the third experiment, Hobert, while holding the "Black Emperor" card, twisted the weight of the small train head and managed to grab it near the "Gate of Sacrifice", but couldn't lift it over the last few meters no matter what.
With these three experiments, Hobert believed that he could complete this operation after becoming Sequence 6.
Looking at the streets outside, which were starting to get foggy, Hobert decided that as soon as he completely digested the "Briber" potion, he would immediately drink the "Baron of Corruption" potion.
After becoming Sequence 6, Hobert planned to digest the potion in Backlund first. If that didn't work, he would go to the Southern Continent and, with the help of the Burke family, find a territory to try acting.
In addition, Hobert had already used the "Nation of Disorder" to shatter the Beyonder characteristics of the "Baron of Corruption". He didn't plan to consume too many Beyonder characteristics.
The reason was simple: with the "Order Wood" and "Disorder Stone" in hand, his strength in the "Black Emperor" pathway was already very strong, and there was no need to consume more Beyonder characteristics.
Consuming more Beyonder characteristics would put too much burden on his spirit, and he would have to spend energy to re-digest the excess potion, which would not be worth the effort.
...
Bayam, late at night, in a narrow alley.
Alger, wearing a hood and constantly holding a crystal scepter in his pocket, entered the depths of the alley with high alert.
"I heard you were looking for me?" A hoarse voice sounded from the darkness deep in the alley, it was Byron, the intelligence officer of the "Admiral Hell".
"Yes, I have a message to sell you," Alger said coldly.
"A message? Have you reported to your master?"
Alger sneered: "I believe that after hearing this message, you will immediately report to your master, no, your owner."
Byron snorted coldly in the dark: "Speak."
"There is a ship full of gold, silver, and jewels, secretly setting sail from the Southern Continent."
"Be specific!"
Alger didn't fall for it: "It is said that the valuables on the ship are worth more than 200,000 pounds! Tell me what price you can give me first."
"1000 pounds!"
"Too little, I want 10% of your harvest."
Byron sneered: "Are you kidding me?"
"Are you kidding me?" Alger also sneered: "I have other channels to sell it. Even if I report it to the Storm Church, they won't give me only 1000 pounds as a reward."
Byron snorted coldly: "Is the news accurate?"
"Absolutely accurate."
"Go to the bar ahead for a drink, and I'll give you an answer later."
Alger knew that the other party was going to report to the "Admiral Hell", so he nodded and came to the bar.
Although it was late at night, there were still many reveling pirates and thugs in the bar, chatting loudly, and their voices could be heard on the next street, but there were also many such bars and such loud voices on the next street.
These two bar streets seemed to be more lively than the vegetable market.
Alger ordered a glass of local Blue Mountain Island fruit wine and waited for about half an hour before a young man dressed as a local politely invited Alger back to the previous alley.
Byron was still hiding in the darkness, but his tone was much kinder: "Alger, you're in luck, the captain is willing to give you a 3000 pound reward."
Alger reluctantly said: "Okay, just consider it as me doing you a favor. If it were someone else, I wouldn't sell this information for such a low price."
He noticed that two people had come behind him.
Besides increasing his vigilance, he didn't make any excessive moves.
"It's been a long time, how about I treat you to a meal? I'll also cover your accommodation. If you want girls, just ask," Byron said with a smile: "But please don't leave the room I prepared for you."
"I know the rules," Alger also said with a smile: "There's no need to explain it so clearly with such a disgusting tone."
By confining Alger, on the one hand, they were afraid that the news was wrong, and on the other hand, they wanted to prevent this kid from selling the same news to others.
...
Thursday, Backlund, Blanca Street.
Hobert, who had returned late last night, didn't get up until after eight in the morning.
After eating the breakfast Fors left behind, Hobert came to the "Nation of Disorder" again and used "True Vision" to make sure no one was tailing him.
Then he put on his windbreaker, picked up his cane, hailed a carriage, and first went to the Loen Kingdom Army Staff Headquarters to tell Christian that he knew a demigod of the "Death" pathway with good character and wanted to take that demigod to explore the ruins.
Hobert completely trusted Christian, so he decided to give him a heads-up in advance.
Sure enough, Christian just told him to pay attention to safety. He didn't even ask about the ownership of the sealed items, leaving it entirely to Hobert to handle.
Then Hobert found another cab and, after an hour's drive, arrived at 16 Wanbo Avenue in the Hillston Borough.
Wanbo Avenue is a major avenue on the edge of the entire city of Backlund. There are many self-built villas here, which are concentrated in an area where wealthy people who are almost at the millionaire stage, but still a little short of it, live.
However, 16 Wanbo Avenue is special. It can be seen from a distance that this villa has been abandoned for a long time, and the vegetation is about to swallow the entire courtyard.
After a brief inquiry, Hobert learned that this villa was very evil. People who lived in it easily died inexplicably. No one dared to live there a long time ago, and priests of the Evernight Goddess had come to exorcise demons, but still no one dared to buy it.
In other words, this is a haunted house!
Living here would be in line with the identity of a descendant of death.
As for the priests of the Evernight Goddess, they were probably the Nighthawks. Even if there was something evil inside, it had been dealt with before.
But it's hard to say now. After all, Mr. Azik used this place as one of his strongholds. It would be a shame if no ghost stories happened, given his identity.
Hobert wrote in advance the general exploration process of the ruins, as well as his guess that it was attracting Mr. Azik, and, according to Mr. Azik's instructions, put it in the mailbox at 16 Wanbo Avenue.
He didn't intend to explore this villa. In the mystical world, you have to listen to advice. If you're told to put it in the mailbox, just put it in the mailbox.
Then Hobert took a cab again to leave, preparing to return to the law firm to wait for news.
Who knew that just a dozen minutes after the carriage left, the space next to Hobert suddenly became illusory. Just as he was surprised, Azik walked out of the illusion: "Take me to that ruin."
Hobert smiled. The last time they met, the two of them had admitted their extraordinary identities to each other.
So Azik was no longer hiding his Beyonder powers at all.
Hobert said: "Of course, but I hope I can also get some Beyonder items from the ruins."
Although it was hurtful to talk about conditions right away, it was reasonable to say some things at the beginning, after all, in Azik's eyes, it was only their third meeting.
If there was no profit motive, Azik would instead suspect Hobert's purpose.
"I'm only interested in the hard feathers you mentioned," Azik said: "Everything else can be given to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 227 The Image of the God of Death (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
[Thanks to Stavros Theodosiadis for becoming a free member]
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Azik grabbed Hobert's shoulder: "Recall the location of the ruins in your mind."
"Wait a moment!" Hobert took out a 2 soli banknote and placed it on the carriage seat, then said to the coachman, "I want to get off."
Otherwise, the taxi driver would definitely think he had seen a ghost! A perfectly fine passenger just disappeared.
After hearing Hobert's voice, the coachman immediately stopped the carriage by the side of the street. He waited for a long time but the passenger didn't get out: "Sir, sir?"
He came to the back to take a look, but the carriage was empty.
Fortunately, there was a 2 soli fare in the carriage, which made him think that he hadn't noticed when the passenger got off, and he didn't think otherwise.
At this time, the coachman's passenger, Mr. Hobert, was being held by Azik's shoulder, traveling in the spirit world.
In the spirit world, there were gorgeous colored mists and all kinds of spirit world creatures. What made Hobert feel most novel was that his feet were not on the ground. He and Azik were in mid-air.
To be precise, the spirit world does not have the concept of "ground". There is no concept of up, down, left, and right here, and even no concept of distance. Although they seemed to be standing still, Hobert knew that if they left the spirit world at this time, they would have long been far away from the position when they entered the spirit world.
Before entering the spirit world, Azik told Hobert not to look directly at the creatures of the spirit world.
Hobert lowered his head slightly, only using the corner of his eye to observe everything around him.
Suddenly, Hobert saw an ancient black coffin in a cloud of black mist.
It stood there, seemingly noticing Hobert. Although there were no eyes on the coffin, Hobert realized that the other party was staring at him.
Hobert withdrew his gaze, not daring to "look directly" at the other party.
At this moment, everything around seemed to be splashed with oil paint, and began to become abstract and unreal.
These abstract and unreal colors gradually "solidified", and Hobert saw them turn into trees and rocks, weeds and mounds.
At this time, they were already on a hillside outside Bakerland, from where they could see the camp at the foot of the mountain.
That was the camp of Jacob's mercenary group. At this time, they had already transported away the valuable antiques, but there were still more than a dozen people finishing up.
They first filled in the entrance to the ruins, and then dismantled the camp.
Azik asked, "Is it here?"
"Yes." Hobert said, "Probably directly below."
Then Hobert felt a blur in front of his eyes, and his vision was quickly covered by darkness. They had already arrived in the ruins.
Hobert smiled wryly: Do these big shots like to be lazy so much? They'd rather walk the spirit world than take the right path.
Hobert had prepared in advance, turned on the flashlight, and led the way.
Yes, at this moment in Backlund , there were already flashlights. The reason why it was called a "flashlight" instead of a flashlight was because the shape of the flashlight was a bit like a table lamp carried in the hand.
Its main structure was a large battery, in the middle was a round light that shone forward, and on top was a handle. The overall structure was a rectangle, so it couldn't be called a flashlight "tube".
Now there is no civilian version of the flashlight. Hobert bought the military version from the mercenary club. It is very heavy and can be used not only for lighting but also as a weapon. At least it is better than a brick.
For Hobert, this "high-tech" product has two flaws. The first flaw is that he has to change the light bulb frequently. Light bulbs have also been invented, but the quality is very poor. Most light bulbs can only work for hundreds of hours, so they have to be changed frequently.
The second flaw is that it costs money, because light bulbs are not only of poor quality but also very expensive.
However, Hobert still bought one when he saw the flashlight, uh, no, one unit.
Because the flashlight provides a much better field of vision in the dark than an oil lamp, and it is windproof, rainproof, and can also be used for self-defense. It has many more uses than an oil lamp.
Of course, Hobert thought that after he became a high sequence, his body would undergo qualitative changes, and he would be able to see things clearly in the dark without lamps. That is another story.
Carrying the flashlight he bought on impulse, Hobert came to the noble courtyard in the ruins and pointed out the entrance to the underground structure to Azik.
"This seal is very exquisite." Azik smiled, and as he spoke, he raised his hand and lightly tapped to break the seal that Dophis had spent a lot of effort to create.
Then the two lifted the stone slab, Azik in front and Hobert behind, and entered the underground structure of the ruins.
Azik instructed, "When I tell you to close your eyes later, close them immediately."
The terrifying memory that made Hobert feel terrified was awakened again. He swallowed: "Okay!"
After walking along the underground corridor for more than twenty minutes, Azik suddenly stopped and said, "I know what's going on. This door hides itself most of the time and is constantly changing its position."
Saying this, he took out a small dagger, cut his finger, squeezed out one or two drops of blood, and smeared it evenly on the stone wall.
The stone wall immediately became illusory, and the shape of a door appeared, emitting a light that made people feel cold all over.
Azik said, "Close your eyes!"
Hobert immediately closed his eyes, and the feeling of fear and oppression that swept through his body reappeared.
But the huge sense of oppression only lasted for ten seconds, and Mr. Azik said, "Okay, you can open your eyes now."
That's it?
Although he had doubts in his heart, Hobert still trusted Mr. Azik. He opened his eyes and first saw a bizarre door in front of him.
Standing inside the door was a creature more than one person tall with the head of a dog and the body of a human. It closed its eyes tightly, its body was covered with black hair, and the expression on its face was very kind and reassuring.
Just seeing this face can calm people's minds.
This image is very similar to the image of the Egyptian god Anubis in Hobert's memory.
"This is the Black Hound Spirit Beast," Azik explained, "Seeing it reminds me of some knowledge. It is said to be the guardian of the ancient death god, and its heart is one of the main materials for Sequence 3 of the 'Death' pathway."
"But the state of this Black Hound Spirit Beast is very strange. First of all, it has the Beyonder characteristics of the complete Sequence 3 'Ferryman' in its body, and it is already dead."
"Well, or rather, no one can completely kill it, because it is already dead."
Azik paused and then said, "But I can use the power of the underworld to extract the Beyonder characteristics from it. It will no longer have terrifying power, only retaining the state of not rotting in this state of death and moving slowly and freely."
"But my spirituality tells me that if I borrow a large amount of power from the underworld here, it will cause very terrible consequences."
Hobert asked, "Is this a zombie or an undead?"
"A different state. It will not rot until the end of time." Azik said, "I suspect it has been blessed by the ancient death god."
