chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 228 The Corpse of God
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Azik waved his hand again, as if dismissing a servant, and the black hound spirit beast with its eyes tightly closed moved away from the doorway.
Hobert saw the scene inside the door. The stone chamber was much larger than he had imagined, with a giant bird lying inside.
His spirituality immediately made him realize that this giant bird was unusual. Although it had its eyes tightly closed and no signs of life, it still impacted Hobert's spirit.
However, this impact was not enough to collapse Hobert's spiritual body and astral body.
Its appearance was somewhat in line with Hobert's feeling of a phoenix, but instead of gorgeous and colorful feathers, it was covered in seemingly pale flame-like feathers.
Then Hobert noticed that the gorgeous illusory colors at the door had turned gray and white after entering the stone chamber. Even the light from the flashlight seemed to be covered with a thin layer of black gauze, turning gray and white.
Sadness, Hobert felt the sadness brought by death.
Finally, Hobert's heart was shocked. Yes, shocked! How could there be such a wonderful creature in the world?
Azik strode forward and placed his hand on the giant bird's corpse. He closed his eyes and felt for more than ten seconds, then pinched his forehead in pain and said, "I, I remember a lot of things."
Azik opened his eyes: "This is the corpse of the ancient death god! Well, more precisely, it is the indestructible part of Her corpse. This is not a complete mythical creature form, so we will not die immediately after seeing it, but will only be impacted."
Hobert's sense of shock still existed: "Why is Her corpse here?"
"I remembered one thing, during the Four Emperors War..." Azik smiled: "Heh, you can think that I saw relevant literature."
No, I know that was what you experienced, Hobert said in his heart.
Azik continued: "In the early stage of the Four Emperors War, the Night Emperor and the Underworld Emperor each gained advantages, so the Night Emperor turned his attention to the Underworld Emperor."
"For this reason, he found the corpse of Gregrace, who had inextricable connections with the underworld, and wanted to use it to design a trap for the Underworld Emperor."
"Unfortunately, before the Underworld Emperor stepped into the trap, the Night Emperor had fallen."
"The Underworld Emperor once secretly sent people to look for it, but they never found Gregrace's corpse. I didn't expect that the Trunsoest family hid the corpse here."
Hobert finally understood why his spirituality prevented him from using the "Teleportation Statue" when exploring the ruins before, because the ancient death god not only accommodated the uniqueness of the "Death" pathway, but also accommodated some of the Beyonder characteristics of the "Door" pathway.
Therefore, the door of this stone chamber was not overlapping with a certain stone chamber as Dophis guessed, but could randomly appear anywhere in the underground structure.
It is estimated that the entire stone chamber was a space created by the ancient death god using the Beyonder power of the "Door" pathway.
As for why the stone chamber had been circling in this underground structure, Hobert didn't understand. He guessed that this underground structure should be some kind of seal designed for the stone chamber.
In the previous exploration, if Hobert had used the "Teleportation Statue", it was very likely that he would always be "teleported" into the stone chamber, or to the entrance of the stone chamber.
Hobert asked: "Can the ancient death god be resurrected by this corpse?"
Azik shook his head: "No, but this is a symbol of the ancient death god's immortality. As long as the corpse exists, She still has the possibility of resurrection. Even if a new death god appears, She still has the possibility of resurrection."
"Then can't this corpse be destroyed?"
"No, even gods can't destroy it." Azik said: "Just like that black hound spirit beast, it is already dead, how can you kill it again?"
Hobert was silent, and for the first time he felt the great shock brought by this mysterious world.
Before, he always felt that he knew everything about this mysterious world, but it was not until today that he realized that he only knew it, but did not have this kind of cognition and knowledge.
Only by seeing the most mysterious and high-end parts of this world can one have one's own cognition.
The two stood in front of Gregrace's corpse for a long time before they went to check the other structures of the stone chamber.
There were three corpses in the stone chamber, all in a skeletal state. The clothes of one of the corpses had rotted, but the skeleton was still quite well preserved.
This should be related to the environment here, or being next to the corpse of the ancient death god.
Of the three corpses, only one corpse had Beyonder characteristics emitting a cold brilliance.
In addition, not far from the corpse, there were two black iron-like cylinders, one of which also had two notebooks or books.
Hobert immediately realized that something was wrong: "The corpse of the ancient death god only attracted one Beyonder of the 'Death' pathway? It also attracted two ordinary people."
Azik shook his head: "No, for more than a thousand years, it should have attracted many Beyonders of the 'Death' pathway, but some can restrain their curiosity and desire, while others cannot."
"Those who fantasized about studying the corpse of the ancient death god died here, while those who could restrain themselves picked up their Beyonder characteristics."
"And the corpse with Beyonder characteristics has relatively undamaged clothes. He should have died here in the recent decades or even ten years, and his Beyonder characteristics have not been picked up."
Hobert nodded and looked at the two black iron-like cylinders again. He remembered that when he entered this room before, he was tripped by something hard, probably one of these two cylinders.
Azik glanced at it and said, "You can take these two cylinders back to make two weapons. Well, this is part of the stone pillar that the ancient death god often stepped on."
"At first, it was just a stone, but later, under the influence of divinity, it already had the characteristics of steel. I believe that the weapons made with them can have the ability to harm the enemy's soul."
Good stuff, good stuff! Hobert smiled and said, "Thank you for your generosity."
Azik picked up the notebook on the cylinder. He opened it and glanced at it, then looked at Hobert and asked, "Is your father called Rex?"
Hobert was stunned: "How do you know?"
Azik smiled and handed the notebook in his hand to Hobert: "This is the notebook your father left for you."
Hobert suddenly thought that he had learned from Mr. Digos that Rex had placed a notebook in a place that only his descendants could get.
He never dreamed that it would be here!
Hobert took the notebook and, by the light, saw a few lines of dragon-flying and phoenix-dancing sentences written on the title page of the notebook: "The stick from the Zaratul family said that my descendants will come here and loot this place, so I left the notebook here."
Below this sentence is another handwriting: "I am the stick from the Zaratul family, little friend, I have not touched anything here, I will leave it all to you as a meeting gift from my uncle."
Hobert thought: Then I, grandpa, will accept it.
Then he thought that Rex actually had contact with members of the Zaratul family, and it seemed that they had a good relationship. These people are so dangerous...
No, Hobert found that he thought the people of the Zaratul family were dangerous, which was a bit preconceived.
Klein would think they are dangerous and hostile to them.
But for the Beyonders of the "Black Emperor" pathway, there can be a good relationship.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 229 New "Blasphemy Card"
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Now is not the time to examine the notes closely. Hobert only glanced at the title page before closing the notebook again: "I heard from my elders before that my father placed some information about our family in a place only I could access. I didn't expect it to be here."
Azek smiled and said, "Sometimes fate is so wonderful."
Putting the notebook back where it was, Hobert began to search the skeleton's body. The skeleton carried a small bag, which contained another notebook, a map, and some paper money, surprisingly gold pounds.
It seemed that the other party had not been dead for long, because these gold pounds had not yet turned yellow.
In addition, there were several charms in the bag, but after such a long time, they no longer had effects.
Hobert also found a classical pocket watch on the skeleton. Originally, Hobert thought it was an ordinary pocket watch, but just as he was about to put it back on the skeleton, he felt the extraordinary nature of the pocket watch. He felt that his spirituality seemed to be absorbed by the pocket watch.
Hobert injected spirituality into the pocket watch and found that he could use a new skill: Steal.
It can steal Beyonder abilities; it can steal other people's ideals and dreams; it can steal other people's thoughts.
This, this is a mystical item at the Sequence 5 level of the "Error" pathway!
Hobert also put the pocket watch aside. Although it was difficult for him to grasp the negative effects of this pocket watch with his current Sequence, in terms of ability, this thing was definitely as good as the "Healing Fork"!
Continuing the search, Hobert also found a ring. After putting on the ring, Hobert felt that his brain became particularly agile and lively. He possessed amazing calculation abilities and precise control abilities.
Taking off the ring, Hobert sighed inwardly: To be able to carry two magical items on his body shows that this "Death" pathway Beyonder lived a good life before his death.
In addition, the other party should have a Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristic, so this harvest is really not small.
Finally, Hobert searched the shirt worn inside the other party's coat and found that there was a small pocket sewn inside the shirt, which contained only a thin card.
Hobert felt something, he took out the card, and sure enough, he saw an image of Roselle with no life in his eyes: This is a "Blasphemy Card", an unopened "Blasphemy Card".
Hobert, who had experience touching the "Black Emperor" card, could confirm that this was a genuine "Blasphemy Card".
Even Azik, who was dazed beside the ancient Death's corpse, couldn't help but glance over here, but after seeing that it was an "ordinary" card, he continued to look at the ancient Death's corpse.
A "Blasphemy Card", a pocket watch with the Beyonder power of the "Error" pathway, a Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristic, and a ring that may have the Sequence 8 ability of the "Wheel of Fortune" pathway.
It was really the right decision to ask Azik to help explore this time! Even if only two of these four items can be taken, it is still a great harvest.
Plus the notebook and "Black Iron" pillars that Azik has already promised him, it's a huge profit.
Azek was still dazed in front of the ancient Death's corpse, and Hobert stood aside quietly waiting.
About half an hour later, Azik seemed to suddenly come back to his senses. He smiled and said, "Sorry, I've kept you waiting."
"It's nothing, I have plenty of time today." Hobert pointed to the things he had just searched out: "You choose first."
Azek smiled and said, "Your father and uncle left everything here for you, how can I compete with you? Put them away, they are all yours."
"How can I be so embarrassed?" Hobert said, while his hands honestly put the things he had searched out into the prepared small bag.
Then he repeated his old trick, took off his trench coat, and wrapped the two "Black Iron" pillars.
The two pieces of "Black Iron" were heavier than expected, and the trench coat made a slight groan, as if it would be crushed at any time.
It was only because Hobert was very strong now that he could move them away at all.
Azik looked at the ancient Death's corpse again, and then said to Hobert, "Thank you for bringing me here, this reminds me of many things, although those memories are more like dreams."
"I also want to thank you for your generosity, which has allowed me to gain a lot." Hobert said, "You can seal this place again, so as not to be discovered by others."
Azik nodded: "That makes sense." He also planned to study it again when he had time in the future.
As they spoke, the two left the stone chamber, and the illusory door disappeared.
Back in the noble courtyard in the ruins, Azik re-sealed it, and then took Hobert through the spirit world back to Backlund.
But strangely, the coffin in the black mist appeared again on their way back, this time closer to the two, but it seemed to be afraid of Azik, so it could only stare from the side.
Since it was a coffin, Hobert estimated that it was a spirit of the "Death" pathway, possibly attracted by the descendants of Death or the "Blasphemy Card", Hobert didn't care.
Back in Backlund, the two appeared in a deserted alley.
Azik said: "If you need anything in the future, you can put the letter in the mailbox at 16 Wanbo Avenue, where I have arranged a spirit to forward the letters to me."
Hobert agreed, and saw Azik step into the illusion and re-enter the spirit world.
He could feel that after this action, Azik's trust in him had increased a lot.
Carrying the simple bag made of trench coat, Hobert walked out of the alley, he found that he was actually near the law firm.
Hobert sighed: "Mr. Azik is really considerate."
Without having to find a rental carriage, Hobert simply walked back to Blanca Street.
Because Azik took Hobert through the spirit world back and forth, saving time and effort, after going back and forth, and staying in the ruins for so long, it was not even noon yet.
This made Hobert even more eager to get a magical item with the "Travel" ability, it was too convenient, before he went to the ruins, it would take four or five hours to take a carriage back and forth.
Back in his room, Hobert put the harvest on the table, and the more he looked at it, the happier he became.
Then he set up the altar and sacrificed to himself, sacrificing the harvested things except for notebooks, gold pounds, etc. to the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert sat on the "Iron Throne" and re-arranged the harvest in front of him one by one.
First, starting with the two cylinders of "Black Iron", Hobert put his hand on them, and with the blessing of the "Nation of Disorder", he immediately felt the "Black Iron" constantly depriving the surrounding "life" breath.
As Mr. Azek said, if it is made into a weapon, it must have the characteristic of hurting the opponent's spiritual body.
But who should I ask to make the weapon?
Ask Ikanser for help?
But it's not easy to explain to him where such good materials came from, and Hobert doesn't want these things to be known by official Beyonders.
Hobert thought of Jessica's friend, she seemed to be a "Artisan", he could entrust her to make a handy weapon for himself.
Then, Hobert picked up the "Blasphemy Card" again.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 230 "Death" Card
chapters.content:
[3ch/day from now on, same as Douluo: My Soul Skills Made Tang San Cry, p atreon is 6 ch/day]
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Bernadette!" Hobert chanted the incantation. The card in his hand immediately radiated a bright light, and Roselle's image became three-dimensional.
[T/N: Every incantation is just Bernadette?]
Roselle was wearing clothes with Southern Continent characteristics, sitting on a pale stone chair, holding a golden bird with Southern Continent carving characteristics. He was lifeless and exuded a necromantic aura.
It really is the "Death" card!
Hobert smiled: The ever-changing Roselle, I wonder what image he has on the "Demoness" card?
Then Hobert examined the contents of the "Blasphemy Card":
"Sequence 9: Corpse Collector
"The Beyonders of this sequence possess certain corpse characteristics. They appear quite gloomy and have a low body temperature, thus avoiding attacks from mindless undead. At the same time, they have also gained improvements in physical fitness, able to withstand the erosion of decay, cold, and death aura. They naturally possess spiritual vision, can directly see some evil spirits, and understand the characteristics and weaknesses of many undead creatures."
"Main materials: Dried adult black-spotted frog, spiritual dust of resentful spirits."
"Supplementary materials: 80ml of pure water, one black cadaverous flower, one dried corpse worm, 12 grams of dragon blood grass powder."
Hobert smacked his lips. This potion looked disgusting.
Looking down the list, Hobert stopped at Sequence 4.
"Sequence 4: Undying
"Main materials: Scarlet eyes of the Skull Lord, spiritual crystal of the gray curled moth."
"Supplementary materials: 20 grams of bone powder of the Skull Lord, a pair of antennae of the gray curled moth, one undead tricolor flower, 30ml of zombie brain fluid."
"Ritual: Become a dead person."
Hobert opened his mouth. He had heard of becoming a poet, becoming a philosopher, but this was the first time he saw the requirement to become a dead person!
Is this a path to suicide? Become a dead person?
But then he thought, it might mean a dead person in the sense of mysticism.
In this world full of extraordinary powers, there are two definitions of a dead person: one is death in the ordinary sense, which is the loss of all life signs;
The other is a dead person in the mystical sense: the spirit world spontaneously accepts someone's Spirit Body.
The spirit bodies of normal people have countless connections with the spirit world, but these spirit bodies ultimately belong to the real world. When they lose their life signs, their spirit bodies will be accepted by the spirit world and become a part of the spirit world.
That is to say, as long as the spirit body of a Beyonder of the "Death" pathway is accepted by the spirit world, this ritual should be able to be completed.
Hobert recalled Dophis's state. He had always been pale, taciturn, and rarely had emotional fluctuations. He stood there motionless and really looked like a dead person.
Then Hobert thought that Dophis was looking for the main material of "Undying", which meant that he already had the potion formula for "Undying".
Before, Hobert had always thought that Dophis's corpse-like state was because he was a Beyonder of the "Death" pathway. Now it seems that he was preparing for the ritual in advance.
He also thought that the qualitative change at the "Undying" level seemed to be an exchange of the importance of the spirit body and the physical body.
For ordinary people in the real world, of course, the physical body is important. If the physical body loses its life signs, the person dies.
People also see each other's physical bodies, not their spirit bodies. Although both are equally important, it seems that the spirit body is an appendage of the physical body.
After becoming "Undying", the Beyonder's physical body is in a state of neither alive nor dead, and the spirit body becomes the more important part, and the physical body seems to become an appendage.
Then Hobert thought of the former chief of City of Silver, so he continued to look down:
"Sequence 3: Ferryman
"Main materials: Heart of the black dog spirit beast, a complete withered broad-winged wax cicada."
"Supplementary materials:…
"Ritual: Build a mausoleum, drink the potion in the mausoleum, open the space of the mausoleum to the underworld (or the spirit world), and walk out of the mausoleum and return to the human world in the constant scouring and baptism of the underworld."
Hobert nodded: Sure enough, he had to build a mausoleum, but the former chief obviously did not withstand the scouring of the underworld and did not complete the process of walking out of the mausoleum himself.
There should be some skills in this, but the former chief had no channel to obtain these skills and could only try it himself at risk.
It seems that the former chief was also affected by the "artificial death", and the reason for the failure was quite complicated.
As for the "or the spirit world" marked in the ritual, it is not difficult to understand, after all, the underworld is an area opened up by the ancient death god from the spirit world.
The underworld symbolizes the realm of death, and its baptism and scouring should be a transformation of the spirit body and the physical body, while the spirit world is slightly different. In addition to a large number of undead, there are also many spirit world creatures living in the spirit world. Its scouring should also allow the "Ferryman" to possess some of the power or characteristics of the spirit world creatures.
Then Hobert thought that the ritual of "Undying" was to become a dead person, and the ritual of "Ferryman" was to build a mausoleum. This seems to be the process of a funeral!
First die, then send it to the mausoleum. I don't know if it needs a "grand funeral". If it does, this is also a very expensive sequence!
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled knowingly and continued to look down. After reading the entire contents of the "Blasphemy Card", he put it next to the "Black Emperor" card.
The greatest effect of this "Blasphemy Card" on Hobert is that he knows the potion formula of the complete sequence of the "Death" pathway. From today onwards, the great "Creator" has another complete sequence of potion formulas. As for the other effects of this card, they completely overlap with the "Black Emperor" card.
Relatively speaking, Hobert is more willing to appear as the "Black Emperor".
Next Monday, Hobert plans to dedicate it to The Fool, complete the second bribe, and be promoted as soon as possible.
As for the "Red Priest" card, if there is a chance, he will extort it from Medici. If there is no chance, he will wait and try to avoid getting involved with Adam's "story".
Hobert waved to the extraordinary characteristic again. Holding the extraordinary characteristic, he used the position of "Nation of Disorder" to determine that this was a Beyonder characteristic of Sequence 5 "Gatekeeper", which could be sold for a lot of money.
Putting the Beyonder characteristic on the stone platform over there, Hobert held the ring in his hand again. Similarly, using the high position of "Nation of Disorder", Hobert felt the negative effects of the ring:
"After wearing it, the wearer's brain will be in a state of high-speed operation, and can only think about one thing, and it is easy to ignore information other than the thing being thought about. Long-term wearing will increase the burden on the brain and cause a certain degree of damage."
The negative effects are not significant, but it is not suitable for use in combat. In combat, you must maintain a high degree of vigilance, and it is dangerous to easily ignore information.
It is very suitable for thinking about problems and making plans.
Finally, there is the classic pocket watch. Hobert held it in his hand and also knew its negative effects:
"From the moment it is worn, it begins to steal the wearer's spirituality; wearing it for more than ten minutes, it will begin to steal the wearer's vitality; wearing it for more than twenty minutes, it will begin to steal the wearer's luck. After being away from it for half an hour, the time will start to accumulate again."
Hobert pinched his chin. Compared with the "Healing Fork", the negative effects are quite large. If you don't want to cause damage, it is best to control the wearing time within ten minutes each time.
Thinking of this, Hobert summoned the "Power of Order" to wrap the pocket watch and tried to seal it.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 231 One person took on everything
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Although Hobert's control over the "Nation of Disorder" is still very limited, as long as it is a sealed item or magical item below the level of a demigod, his seal can basically greatly reduce the negative effects.
This pocket watch has certain living characteristics, so after being wrapped in the "Power of Order", it immediately showed obvious tremors.
After being ravaged by the "Power of Order", Hobert held the pocket watch in his hand again, and the negative effects were indeed greatly reduced:
"There will be no negative effects within two hours of wearing it. During this period, it will steal the spirituality of people around the wearer, including the spirituality of the wearer's opponents. After wearing it for more than two hours, it will begin to steal the wearer's vitality and luck, and there is a certain probability of stealing the vitality and luck of the wearer's opponents. Take it off for an hour, and then re-accumulate the wearing time."
Hobert nodded in satisfaction: That's more like it!
He put the pocket watch on the stone platform over there. He doesn't plan to wear it usually, and plans to use it as his trump card.
Hobert looked at the colorful Beyonder characteristics on the stone platform, as well as the sealed items and magical items, and suddenly felt a sense of accomplishment.
His current accumulation is already as much as a small Beyonder organization, and the title of evil god is gradually becoming a reality.
Just as Hobert was about to leave the "Nation of Disorder", he realized that the star representing Elliot suddenly lit up.
It seems that the matter of purchasing the water pump has been finalized.
Spreading his spirituality to the star belonging to Elliot, Hobert heard the other party's prayer: "...Great 'Creator', the patriarch hopes to purchase two new water pumps at once, and gave me a sealed item that seems to be of a high level, hoping that I can use it to complete the second bribe."
Hobert pondered for a while, he would accept Elliot's "bribe" without hesitation, and he could earn more from two water pumps, but he would have to wait until he became the "Baron of Corruption".
He's not far from that step, so he can agree first, but he still has to use the "alt account".
Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder", and then prayed to himself: "...Great 'Creator', please ask your devotee to prepare the gold, I will place the order now, the production cycle is about a week to ten days. After the water pump is assembled, we will trade."
Then Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" again, first using the image and tone of the "Creator" to reply to Elliot: "Okay!"
At the same time, he put mosaics on the picture of his prayer and threw it into Elliot's star.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert thought that he had to set up a company, which was so troublesome.
At this time, he thought of the missing devotee: Upton.
Didn't this kid want to be a businessman? Give him a chance.
However, the "Creator" can't say this, alas, he has to use the "small account" again.
Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder" again somewhat helplessly, and prayed to himself: "...Great 'Creator', please help me contact Upton, I have something to entrust to him, the reward is part of the main material of the 'Briber'. Meet at 16 Wanbo Avenue at 10 pm two days later."
After the prayer, Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" again, and the protruding part of the "Iron Throne" was almost worn smooth because he went in and out.
After putting mosaics on his prayer just now, Hobert threw it into the star representing Upton.
At this time, the star representing Elliot lit up, it was Elliot's thanks, Hobert listened to it once, and in order to maintain the identity of the "Creator", he did not reply again.
The pool returned to its former calm, Hobert complained: My operation just now seems like a very large company, but the manager is myself, the employees are myself, and the huge company is supported by me alone.
He shook his head with a smile and left the "Nation of Disorder".
...
Loen Kingdom, Desi County, Conant City.
This is the most famous tourist city in the world, with beautiful beaches, pleasant sea breeze, cheap subtropical fruits and seafood.
There are unique hotels everywhere, restaurants with unique flavors, and bars with different decoration styles.
Of course, there is also a special product here: the gangs!
Because most of the shops here are service industries, the gangs have the space to collect protection fees.
They also have their own bars, their own industries, and the establishment of gangs is also to protect their own interests, because the efficiency of the local government is very poor, and many times it is impossible to solve their problems and realize their demands through formal channels.
Also, because these gangs have their own industries in the local area, they never extort tourists, they just make money from tourists, but sometimes they rip them off.
It is precisely because of their "professional ethics" that they have never damaged the image of this city, and the tourism industry here has always been very prosperous.
In the private room of the "Coast Bar", several gang members of the Coast Gang were sitting around their boss, praising the boss's power and celebrating the victory yesterday.
In a gang conflict yesterday, their boss Upton once again used his terrifying power to drive away more than a dozen members of the Black Fish Gang, once again defending the interests of the Coast Gang.
Now this most prosperous coastal street is basically their world.
The rise of the Coast Gang has been in the past month. Before that, they were unknown, just a small gang running a bar.
Just a month ago, a gang raided the "Coast Bar". Mr. Upton, who was traveling from Backlund, happened to pass by, drove away the raiding gang, and protected the "Coast Bar".
Their former boss, who was dying from the beating, handed over the Coast Gang to Upton and died.
From that moment on, Upton led them to fight back against other gangs, bribe local officials, and in just one month, the Coast Gang became one of the largest gangs in Conant City.
While the atmosphere was warm, their boss Upton suddenly froze, then seemed a little scared, and then seemed relieved. In short, the expression on the boss's face was very complicated.
Upton, who originally liked to wear shirts, black pants, and dress like a young master, is now wearing local silk clothes, which looks like a gangster.
Everyone in the room didn't dare to breathe. After a minute or two, Upton said, "I'm going back to Backlund."
No matter how everyone cried and tried to persuade him to stay, Boss Upton seemed to have made up his mind to go. He said, "I'm not going to die, why are you crying like this? I'll be back in a while."
...
Backlund, Blanca Street.
Hobert opened Rex's notes and flipped through them. After reading a few pages, Hobert discovered that it roughly recorded Rex's movements after returning to Backlund.
The main content is the record of the seven ancient ruins he discovered in Backlund, four of which had already fallen into the hands of the Loen royal family.
Rex discovered that the royal family seemed to be making some modifications to those four ruins.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 232: Emperor Solomon's Abnormality
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In Rex's notes, there were many speculations about the actions of the Loen royal family, guessing sometimes that they were building a royal shelter, and sometimes suspecting that it was a ritual requirement for a certain sequence of the "Justiciar" pathway.
Hobert, of course, knew that these modifications were likely to turn the ruins into mausoleums, or that the ruins were originally mausoleums left by Solomon.
It seems that Rex didn't know about the "Black Emperor's" apotheosis ritual. Well, even for Beyonders of the "High Sequence", the apotheosis ritual is an unattainable piece of information.
The key is the lack of access channels. The orthodox gods' churches unanimously and vigorously block such information.
For families like the Trunsoest family that have produced true gods, the apotheosis ritual is only known to a very few direct descendants, and they basically don't actively leave relevant written records.
Not everyone can have the experience of a Tarot Club member, knowing the secrets of apotheosis during the "Mid Sequence" or even the "Low Sequence".
So Rex didn't know what the Loen royal family was doing, but that didn't stop him from complaining in his notes that the royal family was a bunch of locusts. They cleaned up the ruins they had excavated very thoroughly, without leaving even an ordinary antique.
And there was a special note, saying that the information of these four ruins was useless, and telling his children not to go to these places, lest they be caught by the royal family.
Judging from the ink, this warning should have been written later.
Rex probably never imagined that this information would be very important to Hobert. It was equivalent to marking four of George III's nine mausoleums!
Moreover, Rex left mystical "backdoors" in these four ruins. If these "backdoors" were not discovered by the royal family, Hobert could still enter silently.
Hobert seemed to feel the arrangement of fate. This was obviously the key to destroying George III's advancement!
When the time comes, tell the Castiya family of the Feynapotter Kingdom royal family about these entrances, hehehe~
Klein didn't have a better way at the time and could only forcefully attack one of the mausoleums. Rex's information could allow Hobert to solve the problem with a leisurely attitude.
The Loen royal family is not without enemies. Sometimes, making good use of the enemy's enemies will find you great help.
In addition to the four ruins that were excavated in advance by the Loen royal family, one of the other three had been discovered by other Beyonders, and the extraordinary items inside were swept away and turned upside down.
Only two are relatively well preserved, one of which is the ruin where the notes are hidden.
Rex also described the sealed item in this ruin. In the notes, he said that he and his good friend Arthur groped in the stone room with their eyes closed for several days, and basically determined that it should be the corpse of a certain Death.
As for the black hound spirit beast, these two guys chased it and touched it, and determined that it was a black hound spirit beast in a rather strange state. As long as you don't look at it, it's not dangerous for Beyonders of Sequence 4 and above.
If it is below Sequence 4, even if you don't look at this black hound spirit beast, your spirit will be crushed if you stay by its side for a long time, and going crazy is the best ending.
Hobert could imagine the black hound spirit beast's face full of helplessness. The key is that it can't walk fast and can only let these two rascals who don't know where they came from touch it.
These two are really brave! Hobert exclaimed.
As for the method of entering that stone room, it only requires the blood of Beyonders of Sequence 6 or above of the "Death" pathway or the "Door" pathway to open it.
Hobert thought of Azik's way of opening the door. At that time, he thought it had to be the blood of a descendant of Death.
In that case, even if Mr. Azik is not present, he can find that stone room.
Rex explored the entire underground structure at that time, and discovered the sealing method of that stone room. As long as you arrange more than 500 rooms around it, that stone room will get "lost" and will always "wander" around there.
In addition, Rex found many valuable documents in the noble courtyard, including records that this courtyard belonged to Duke Servia of the Trunsoest Empire, who was a direct descendant of the Night Emperor.
As Azik said, the Night Emperor at that time was preparing to use the body of an ancient Death to design a trap against the Underworld Emperor.
Through the documents found, Rex discovered some potentially useful information.
At that time, together with Rex's notes, there was also a very old paper notebook, which was the most important document left by Duke Servia.
A large part of Rex's notes is a "reading experience" of this document.
First of all, Rex discovered that this Duke Servia was deeply trusted by the Night Emperor. Servia served as the captain of Trunsoest's guard before the joint ruling period, so he knew many secret histories about the Night Emperor.
And this guy likes to take notes, so Rex and Hobert also know the secret history of the Night Emperor.
Fortunately, Servia didn't reveal any scandals, but just depicted some scenes of the Night Emperor's life before becoming a god, or rather, the human side of the Night Emperor.
In the information provided by Duke Servia, Tudor and Trunsoest (later the Blood Emperor and the Night Emperor) often sat together and chatted before becoming Sequence 1. The content of the chat was all-encompassing, which benefited Servia, who was on duty beside them.
Rex wrote in his notes: "The relationship between the Blood Emperor and the Night Emperor is deeper than imagined."
Reading this, Hobert also thought that after all, these two people had been Solomon's subordinates for a long time. At that time, the two should have established a deep friendship, which was the basis for them to jointly plot to kill their old boss.
However, after becoming Sequence 1, due to the law of Beyonder characteristics, the two still turned against each other and eventually broke out a war between the two empires.
While sighing about the ancients, Hobert continued to read.
In Servia's information, a description caught Rex's attention.
When Tudor and Trunsoest mentioned Solomon once, they both discovered that after Solomon became the "Black Emperor", many changes had taken place in him.
It was not just the divine changes that occurred after becoming a true god, but that he seemed to be affected by some force, and often said some incomprehensible ramblings.
At first, Tudor thought that Solomon was affected by the "True Creator", at that time the church of the "True Creator" was the orthodox church of the Solomon Empire, and the two true gods had a close cooperative relationship.
Tudor and Trunsoest had complained more than once that this "True Creator" always said some incomprehensible ramblings, which made them very annoyed.
These complaints are recorded in other places.
In the conversation realizing that Solomon seemed to be a little wrong, Tudor and Trunsoest also discovered through the exchange of information that Solomon had issued orders to them to find a genie, and whenever he mentioned that genie, some incomprehensible ramblings would appear in Solomon's mouth.
So the two guessed that Solomon might not be affected by the "True Creator", but by an unknown force.
Hobert's eyes narrowed when he saw this: Genie!
For safety's sake, he simply performed a sacrificial ritual, sacrificing two notebooks from different eras to the "Nation of Disorder".
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert looked at Rex's annotation on this description again: "This reminds me of the description in the family documents. After the ancestor Trunsoest became the Night Emperor, he also looked for a special genie, and he finally found this genie. It is said that the genie contains the secret to obtaining power stronger than true gods."

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 233 The Night Emperor's Back-up Plan
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters, become a free ($0) member for a bonud chapter and shoutout. Did I mention it was free? Close to 200 powerstones!
---
My guess was right!
Hobert thought that he had previously guessed that the Night Emperor's sudden fall was likely due to the influence of the "Outer Deities," and his condition had become very wrong.
It's just that Hobert guessed at the time that the "Uncertain Mist" had affected the Night Emperor. Now it seems that the Night Emperor may have been affected by the "Son of Chaos"?
That's why the Six Gods took action to kill the Night Emperor. However, Hobert thought of another question at the time: Even the half-mad Blood Emperor was not jointly eliminated by the Six Gods. Even if the Night Emperor's problem is more serious, could it be more harmful than being half-mad?
Now it seems that it may really be more harmful than being half-mad. Hobert vaguely remembers such a description of the "Lamp Genie": The "Lamp Genie" has never been obtained by the orthodox church; once a true god wanted to destroy it, but failed.
The true god who wanted to destroy the "Lamp Genie" may be the Night Emperor. Destroying the "Lamp Genie" was to release the "Son of Chaos" inside.
The "Son of Chaos" is from the Cosmos. After the fall of the Ancient Sun God, the Six Gods certainly did not want an existence with a higher status than themselves on Earth, and the key is that this existence is an Outer God.
What if He opens the Earth's shield and lets other "Outer Deities" waiting in the starry sky come in?
This should be the reason for the Night Emperor's fall. He not only threatened the status of the Six Gods, but also threatened their safety, so the Night Emperor was cleaned up.
But a new problem arises: the "Son of Chaos" was sealed by the "Celestial Worthy." In this state, can He still affect the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar" pathways? What about the curse of the Trunsoest family?
The "Celestial Worthy's" seal should be trustworthy. In theory, it is difficult for the "Son of Chaos" to have an impact on the outside world. However, the fact is that, starting from the "Black Emperor" Solomon, it seems that he has been affected by the "Son of Chaos," and the "Justiciar" Night Emperor has also been affected by the "Son of Chaos."
So Hobert thought of another "Outer Deity": the Uncertain Mist.
Part of the power of the "Uncertain Mist" comes from the "Son of Chaos." Could it be that He used the power of the "Son of Chaos" to affect Solomon and Trunsoest?
But why did the Black Emperor and the Night Emperor go to find the "Lamp Genie"? What does the curse of the Trunsoest family have to do with them?
Hobert looked at the notes again. Both Servia and Rex's descriptions ended here. Obviously, they didn't have any further information.
I still can't see the whole picture, Hobert sighed. I really want to borrow the "Lamp Genie" from Bernadette now and ask her carefully.
Hobert rubbed his forehead. This question can only be thought of here for the time being. After finding further information, continue to think about it.
Continuing to read, Rex's notes also recorded some history of the Trunsoest family. For example, Rex's ancestors and Eliot's ancestors parted ways about six hundred years ago.
Although there are still many of Eliot's people, they can basically only survive. They had a period of displacement when they first arrived in the Southern Continent. They only found a suitable place to settle down in the last one or two hundred years.
Rex's family has gradually become thin under the double blow of curses and orthodox churches, but many strong people have emerged. Almost every twenty or thirty years, a strong person will challenge the family's curse, but they have all failed without exception.
The strange thing is that after they died, the Beyonder characteristics disappeared.
The last part of the notes is Rex's record of his changes after becoming a "Frenzied Mage."
First of all, he probably heard the crazy murmur clearly, as if he was shouting: "I put the entrance to the 'Nation of Disorder' in the family's bloodline..."
Hobert was stunned and looked at the blurry figure in the pool: Is this guy really the Night Emperor? Are you sick? You have been torturing your descendants for more than a thousand years!
Then Hobert thought that he was not only shouting "Nation of Disorder," but was shouting such a complicated sentence.
Thinking of the "Trunsoest Brass Book" contaminated by the "Nation of Disorder," it is obvious that Trunsoest found the "Nation of Disorder" at that time.
But I don't know why, he failed to become a "Great Old One."
Could it be that He was killed by the Six Gods when He was about to become a "Great Old One"? At that time, the Night Emperor had already established contact with the "Nation of Disorder." In order to make it easier for future generations to become "Great Old Ones," He left the entrance in the bloodline of the Trunsoest family?
Along with the entrance to the "Nation of Disorder," there was also the Night Emperor's explanation, but for the contaminated god, the ordinary explanation sounded like crazy murmurs to future generations.
Hobert smiled. This guess seems reasonable, but it also seems unreasonable.
If this is the case, then the Trunsoest family is as tragic as the Abraham family. Uh, it's slightly better than the Abraham family. After all, the Trunsoest family can still produce "Saints."
Hobert continued to flip through Rex's notes. The following is Rex's search for information about the "Nation of Disorder." When he learned that the "Nation of Disorder" was the "Sefirah," he also made a similar guess to Hobert's.
Rex didn't hear all of those murmurs. He believed that if he heard them all, he could find a way to lift the curse.
But if he wanted to hear them all, he had to continue to advance. He might repeat the mistakes of his ancestors, and Hobert was born not long ago at this time, and he wanted to spend more time with his children.
But then he thought that Hobert would also suffer from crazy murmurs in the future, and he also thought that Hobert might face the same choices as himself in the future.
So he decided to try to advance and challenge the family's curse while he was still in good condition.
But before that, he made some preparations for Hobert, including the choices he provided for Hobert before.
The notes ended here. Although they were all recording the process of events, Hobert could still feel the strong paternal love.
This made Hobert think of the old man in the AD era again. I wonder how they are doing after I left the AD era?
Thinking about it, Hobert turned to the last page of the notes.
Hobert thought Rex would write a few mushy words, but there was only a line of flamboyant words: Since you have chosen to take this path, walk down it with your head held high!
Hobert smiled knowingly and put the two notebooks on the stone platform over there.
After leaving the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert sat by the window looking at the people coming and going outside for a long time.
He was both digesting the information he had obtained today and remembering his relatives.
It wasn't until the sun was setting in the west that Hobert put away his sentimental emotions and looked at the notebook and map he had searched from the skeleton on the table.
After looking at a few pages with his legs crossed, Hobert gradually put away his contempt and seriously started reading with his legs uncrossed.
The dead Beyonder had found a Skeleton Lord before his death.

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 234 Clues to the Skeleton Lord
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In Hobert's notebook, there was a signature of its previous owner: Valentine Victor.
More than a notebook, it was like a collection of clumsy ghost stories.
The content of the stories was very interesting to Hobert, such as something that happened in the deep mountains of Sivellaus County in the Kingdom of Loen.
In the deep mountains, there was a hunter who was very good at setting traps. Suddenly, from one day on, the prey he caught in the traps was always gnawed by some kind of beast.
But strangely, this experienced hunter couldn't tell from the bite marks what kind of beast had gnawed on his prey.
A few days later, when the hunter went to check the traps again, he found that his prey had just been gnawed not long ago, and he quickly locked onto the trail of the culprit along the bloodstains.
After chasing for about an hour or two, the hunter chased to the edge of a forest, and at this time the sky was gradually darkening.
In the deep mountains, the sun sets very quickly. As soon as the sun sets behind the mountaintop, the surroundings are like being covered with a layer of black gauze.
The hunter didn't intend to let the culprit go like this, and chased all the way in.
The moment he stepped into the forest, the hunter felt that the mountain wind inside was particularly cold, as if countless eyes were staring at him.
Just as the hunter was about to turn back, he found a towering tree with branches growing horizontally, and the canopy covered a large area.
The tree was hung with corpses, all of whom had been hanged. As the mountain wind blew, the corpses swayed in the wind.
The hunter was so frightened that he sat down on the ground. Just then, the corpses on the tree began to move. They raised their hands in unison, took off the nooses that had hanged them, and climbed down the tree nimbly, rushing towards the hunter.
Especially a skeleton, which moved very quickly, chasing in the front.
The hunter's desire to survive was ignited, and he ran until late at night before he could escape.
When Hobert was reading the contents of the notebook, he thought: If Fors saw this story, after her processing and rendering of the atmosphere, it would be a very good ghost story.
However, Valentine's wording and description were very bland, as if he was saying that he was having barbecue tonight, so the content was very interesting, but it was portrayed very clumsily by the owner of the notebook.
The key is that there was Valentine's exploration later. He didn't say a word about the exploration process, only leaving one sentence: Suspected sacrifice to a demon, multiple corpses reanimated, no Skeleton Lord found.
This immediately reminded Hobert of Dophis. Perhaps the "Gatekeeper" is like that, without any emotional fluctuations about everything around him when preparing for advancement.
There were as many as seven or eight similar ghost stories, and Valentine's footprints almost covered the entire Northern Continent.
Finally, in Colson County in the southeastern part of the Feynapotter Kingdom, Valentine discovered the real Skeleton Lord. He tried twice, but failed to kill the Skeleton Lord. The second time, he almost fell into the Skeleton Lord's ambush.
So Valentine returned to the Kingdom of Loen, wanting to ask his teacher for help.
The notebook ended here. Hobert could imagine that Valentine was attracted by the corpse of the Ancient Death God on his way back to Backlund, and eventually died in the stone chamber.
Hobert opened the map again. The map marked the location of the Skeleton Lord, but it didn't look like a Loen map. He put on his trench coat and went to a bookstore on the street to buy a map of the Feynapotter Kingdom, and compared it when he got back.
Sure enough, the map left by Valentine was a map of Colson County in the Feynapotter Kingdom.
Colson County is located between the Feynapotter capital, Feynapotter City, and the port city of Sivellaus, bordering the small country of Masin. The entire county is basically a continuous mountainous area.
Hobert nodded. In this kind of deep mountain and old forest, it is indeed easy for extraordinary creatures with territorial awareness, or undead creatures, like the Skeleton Lord to appear.
After confirming the location of the Skeleton Lord, Hobert folded the map, clipped it in the notebook, picked up his cane, and left a note for Fors and Xio, telling them not to leave dinner for him.
Then he jumped into a rental carriage and returned to his home in Empress Borough.
In the carriage, Hobert sighed, today's experience was really wonderful.
Just as he was thinking about this, his stomach grumbled twice. He then remembered that he was so busy looking at the spoils at noon, and then attracted by Rex's notebook, that he had forgotten to eat lunch.
When he returned home, he arrived just in time for the Christian family to have dinner. After Hobert sat down, he began to gobble it up.
Donna suspected: "Hobert, are you so poor now that you can't even afford to eat?"
Hobert took a sip of wine, and while using a fork to skewer a chicken wing for himself, he asked: "Why do you think so?"
"I heard that you offended all the gentlemen in Backlund in the last case, so..."
"So you think no one will come to me for lawsuits anymore?"
Donna nodded, and Tyron also stared at Hobert nervously, but Christian smiled and shook his head.
"That's not true. The people who come to me for lawsuits now are lined up until next month."
Hobert smiled and said: "I am now a 'well-known lawyer'! My savings are so much that it would scare you to death if I told you!"
"Tch~ Liar, your savings can't possibly reach 1,000 pounds."
Hobert almost got stabbed by the chicken wing bone: "Donna, can you be a little more ambitious? 1,000 pounds can scare you?"
Donna said seriously: "Of course it can, you must have robbed a bank, otherwise how could you have so much money?"
Hobert suddenly realized that mixing in the Beyonder circle is more profitable than robbing a bank! No wonder the official Beyonders have to catch the wild Beyonders when they see them.
Of course, the premise is that you have a "helper" like the "Nation of Disorder", otherwise it is easy to become someone else's wealth.
While arguing with his sister, Hobert finished dinner, and then followed Christian into the study.
Hobert asked Dophis to come in together. After closing the door of the study, he began to recount the process of exploring the ruins today.
Of course, Hobert didn't explain some of Mr. Azik's words and deeds.
After hearing that there was the corpse of the Ancient Death God inside, Dophis's eyes lit up, making it difficult to maintain the state of a "dead person".
Christian said: "In that case, the person who explored the ruins with you should be at least a Sequence 3!"
To be able to suppress the Black Hound Spirit Beast so easily, he must be at least a Sequence 3.
In fact, Hobert still made some "processing". If Christian knew that Azik treated the Black Hound Spirit Beast like a servant, Christian would definitely think that the angel had some ulterior motives. Otherwise, if the other party was an angel, he might not even look at a Sequence 7, so how could he get to know Hobert?
Hobert pretended to be confused and said: "He told me that he is only a Sequence 4."
Christian shook his head. Knowing such a "saint" was Hobert's opportunity, and he didn't intend to interfere too much.
Finally, Hobert revealed the clues about the Skeleton Lord, but he found that when he mentioned that the Skeleton Lord was in the Feynapotter Kingdom, Christian and Dophis's faces changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 235: The freeloading case goes to trial
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After Hobert obtained the clue about the Skeleton Lord from Valentine's notes, he immediately decided to inform Dophis of this clue.
Firstly, because of the previous agreement when assassinating Bakerland, and secondly, after Dophis became a demigod, Hobert estimated that he could also benefit from it.
However, Hobert found that when he said the location of the Skeleton Lord, Christian and Dophis's expressions were a little strange.
Hobert asked, "Is there any problem with the content of the notes?"
Christian asked instead, "Are you sure that the 'Saint' who went to explore the ruins with you didn't tamper with this notebook?"
Hobert was stunned: "I'm sure!"
Christian was silent for a full three seconds before smiling: "Dophis, this is your chance to advance, but now is not the time to deal with the Skeleton Lord."
Dophis nodded: "I know."
Seeing that Hobert still had a puzzled look, Christian smiled and said, "Your clue is somewhat coincidental with something we are planning."
Hobert said "Oh", so they suspected that Azik knew their plan.
He didn't have anything to worry about, because he knew that even if Azik knew their plan, as long as it wasn't heinous, Azik wouldn't bother to care.
This topic ended here, Christian talked about the geography and culture of Colson County in the Feynapotter Kingdom: "Don't look at this county which is all mountainous, there used to be a very prosperous waterway there, but more than fifty years ago, that waterway was suddenly interrupted.
"There are various opinions on the reason for the interruption. Some say that an earthquake occurred and the river changed its course.
"Some say that the worship of evil gods appeared, causing the Feynapotter Kingdom and the Earth Mother Church to abandon it.
"I heard a reliable piece of news, which should be closest to the truth: there was indeed an earthquake and the river changed its course, but many strange things also happened. In order to reopen the waterway, a demigod of the Feynapotter Kingdom died in Colson County. The royal family and the church both believed that reopening the waterway would cost a huge price, which was not worthwhile, so this area was basically abandoned.
"Now Colson County is a place where the Feynapotter Kingdom exiles prisoners and gives fiefs to some 'nominal' viscounts and barons.
"For example, if someone has made a contribution and the royal family wants to make him a baron, but they don't want to give him a fief, they will enfeoff him in Colson County. The baron who is enfeoffed in Colson County knows that it is not a good place, and will not go to his fief, but hangs a title in Feynapotter City.
"It is said that in the past few decades, Colson County has become a lawless place."
In this era, there is no internet, and there is no way to obtain information about a place's culture, so Hobert listens very carefully every time he hears this kind of information.
After chatting for a few more words, Hobert said goodbye and returned to his bedroom to rest.
In the study, Dophis asked Christian: "When are you going to tell Hobert?"
"Wait a little longer," Christian said, "Whether to participate or not, let him choose for himself."
...
Perhaps because he saw the corpse of the Ancient Death God, Hobert's astral body and spiritual body were greatly shaken, which caused him to have nightmares all night again.
Sometimes he dreamed of being chased by black hound spirit beasts, sometimes he dreamed of being chased by the corpse of the Ancient Death God, and the Skeleton Lord, the coffin he encountered in the spirit world, and some of the people he killed also joined in the fun.
Hobert didn't sleep peacefully until dawn.
But he needs to get up early today. After a simple breakfast, Hobert yawned and arrived at the law firm early.
Jessica had been holding the information and waiting in front of Hobert's office door. When she saw Hobert, she finally breathed a sigh of relief: "Lawyer Hobert, this is the information you wanted."
Hobert didn't come yesterday, and she was afraid that Hobert would be late today.
Hobert glanced at it: "Very good, let's go, come with me to court."
Today is the day of the court hearing for the case of Emma, the street girl.
Jessica said with some worry: "Your condition..."
This case has also received media attention. After all, many newspapers like this kind of scandalous news. Although Jessica knows that Hobert has no contact with those street girls at all, it does not affect the media's speculation and compilation in this regard.
Hobert smiled: "It doesn't matter, isn't the defendant not hiring a lawyer?"
In Jessica's worry, the two came to the magistrate's court together.
Originally, the magistrate's court didn't take this case too seriously and arranged a court at random.
But on the day of the trial, a large number of gorgeously dressed, charming women, and many reporters came to request to attend the hearing.
Those women found several clients who worked in the court, so this case was tried in the largest magistrate's court in Backlund.
It can accommodate two or three hundred people to attend the hearing, but the seats for the hearing are still not enough, and many people are standing in the corridor, at the door, and outside the window to attend the hearing.
When Hobert and Jessica arrived at the court, the main entrance was already blocked. Fortunately, the two were agile and climbed into the court through the window, almost missing the opening time.
The plaintiff Emma and the defendant Wendell had arrived. Emma greeted Hobert with a smile and asked him to sit next to her.
On the other side, the defendant Wendell couldn't get enough of looking at the room full of flamboyant girls.
Soon, the judge took his seat. After confirming that Wendell did not need a lawyer, the judge announced the opening of the court.
Hobert first stated Wendell's charges. Although it was just a simple statement, it aroused public outrage, and everyone began to scold Wendell.
The judge knocked on the gavel for a long time before maintaining order, and then it was Wendell's turn to speak.
This middle-aged man in his thirties was very arrogant: "More than once someone has sued me, but without exception, they have all failed.
"I'll say it again, prostitution money is not considered legal income and is not protected by law. You can't convict me at all!
"The previous lawyer's assistant with a very good taste couldn't win the case. You, Hobert, no matter how famous you are, unless you can amend the laws of the Loen Kingdom, you can't win either."
These words aroused a new round of scolding from everyone. As a Loenese, Hobert couldn't even understand what some of the street girls were scolding.
This made him sigh at the diversity of languages.
The judge's gavel was almost broken, but he still couldn't silence everyone.
Under the loud persuasion of Hobert and Jessica, everyone calmed down.
The magistrate's court rarely has anyone attending the hearing. The judge, who saw this scene for the first time, wiped the sweat from his forehead and said to Hobert: "Plaintiff's lawyer, the defendant is right, I really can't convict him."
Hobert smiled and said: "Your Honor, we might as well change our thinking, I will accuse the defendant of fraud!"
Whether it was the people in the Spectator, or the plaintiff Emma and the defendant Wendell, they didn't understand what it meant, but the judge's eyes lit up.
Jessica's eyes almost glowed, she muttered: "Learned, learned, there can still be such an operation."

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 236 The Sorrow of the Times
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
On the defendant's seat, Wendell chuckled, "Fraud? You, haha, you're really joking. What does this have to do with fraud?"
Hobert asked the audience, "Ladies and gentlemen, isn't it common sense that guests pay after you provide them with services?"
Regardless of whether they understood Hobert's intention, everyone answered together, "Yes!"
Hobert picked up his folder, "I have here a proof of income of the defendant, which is sufficient to show that the defendant has the financial means to pay for the services provided by Ms. Emma.
"But the other party did not pay, which violates the basic common sense and meets the legal definition of fraud!"
Wendell laughed and said, "So what? You still can't change the fact that prostitution is illegal income."
"Don't think you are qualified to play with the law. My team will sue you until you are bankrupt in the next period of time!" Hobert said coldly, "Relevant legal provisions stipulate that there are no requirements for the source of income for economic losses resulting from fraud!"
Some people already understood Hobert's meaning.
Amidst the applause from the audience, Hobert continued to shout loudly, "So, Mr. Wendell, I accuse you of defrauding my client, and you must compensate her for all losses, including my attorney's fees!"
The applause from the audience grew louder and louder, and some people even cheered!
Wendell's face was ashen. He now regretted not hiring a lawyer, because he had no way of judging the truth of Hobert's words.
After finally restoring order in the court, the judge almost immediately pronounced the verdict: "The defendant is guilty of fraud, and shall compensate the plaintiff for all economic losses, lost work expenses, attorney's fees, etc., totaling 12 pounds, and shall be fined 5 pounds! Sentenced to 6 months in prison."
Wendell was stunned: "Also sentenced to prison?"
The judge glanced at him. He previously thought he was proficient in law, but now it seems that he is just a legal ignoramus who has been carefree for so long just by finding a loophole in the law.
He regretted a bit. If he had known that the other party was at this level, he would have given a heavier sentence.
"I want to appeal!" Wendell said quickly.
Hobert immediately said, "Your Honor, I suggest enforcing the other party's economic compensation first!"
The judge immediately said, "Agreed."
Then he said to Wendell, "Defendant, you have the right to appeal, but you must first pay the fine and economic compensation. According to the relevant regulations of the Loen Kingdom, this court has the power to enforce economic penalties against you."
"I, I'll pay now!" Wendell no longer had the arrogance he had just now and immediately went to take out his wallet.
This result once again caused a burst of cheers from the audience.
Hobert got up and waved to everyone, and everyone immediately stopped cheering.
He smiled and said, "Ladies, as long as he consumes at your place within three years and doesn't pay, or if there are similar cases, you can come to my team for entrustment!"
Several people really came over to entrust similar cases, and Hobert asked Jessica to arrange a time to discuss the cases with them. He planned to have Jessica handle all such cases.
The economic compensation and fines were settled in court, and Wendell was temporarily taken into custody.
Emma shook hands with Hobert: "Thank you for helping me get justice. Whenever you visit my place, it's all free!"
Someone shouted from the defendant's seat: "Lawyer Hobert, my place is also free!"
"Mine too!"
Hobert smiled and said, "If it's just to dance and sing, I'll go!"
"We have such services there!"
"Even if we don't have it now, we'll have it in the future!"
On the way out of the courtroom, everyone scrambled to shake hands with Hobert.
Hobert shook hands with everyone as he walked out. Suddenly, he saw the reporters who were writing furiously.
Hobert, who had always been very "media-conscious," realized that he had to say something at this time to sublimate the case.
So he stopped and said to everyone, "Ladies, don't care about the secular views. Your current choices and circumstances are the tragedy of this era! Who doesn't want to support themselves by labor that is not discriminated against? But this era does not give you such opportunities!
"Don't look down on yourselves because of the tragedy of this era. Ladies, raise your noble heads! Your choices are already many times better than those of robbers, thieves, and villains!"
The atmosphere in the courtroom reached a climax. Some people cheered loudly, and some covered their mouths and cried. Before this, no one had ever cared about their interests, no one had ever understood their difficulties, never.
But today is different. They felt respected for the first time, respected like a person.
Although Hobert had left, the ladies on the scene were still immersed in the emotions just now and could not extricate themselves for a long time.
The reporters squeezed out, and Hobert's words were enough to be the headline of tomorrow.
In the carriage back, Jessica's eyes were shining: "Lawyer Hobert, we will definitely become the brightest color of this era!"
She was also deeply infected by Hobert's words.
Hobert smiled and said, "Our journey is still very long."
He originally wanted to talk to Jessica about asking her friend to help him build weapons, but the current atmosphere is really not suitable for talking about this.
...
Saturday morning, 15 Minsk Street.
Klein went out to buy a pie as his breakfast. He ate breakfast and read the newspaper as usual. After the meal, he planned to go to the dockers' union to confirm the information provided by Miss Xio.
"Huh!" Klein saw that the headline of the newspaper was about Hobert's news.
This was the second time he had seen Hobert's news in the newspaper. He read it carefully word by word.
When he saw the description of Emma's case, Klein sighed: "He really dares to take this kind of case!"
Having been in this world for so long, Klein certainly knew the demands of public opinion on gentlemen in this era. Hobert's approach was like a fighter.
He had just offended the nobles of Backlund, and now he was speaking out for the street girls.
Especially when he saw Hobert's last speech, Klein put down the newspaper and stared at the pie in front of him in a daze. He had been in this world for so long, and this was the first time he had seen a speech that fit his values so well.
Recalling his previous conversations with those gentlemen, there were almost no thoughts about understanding and respecting the people at the bottom. They either simply didn't understand the poverty of the people at the bottom, or they were glad that they had not fallen to that point.
Then Klein thought that he also wanted to bring some changes to this world before, but every time he thought of this, he would make excuses for himself: this is an extraordinary world, and ordinary people have no chance to turn over.
But Hobert, as a Loen person, is fighting for the interests of ordinary people in this world. Isn't this changing the world!

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 237 Elizabeth's Questions
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Backlund, Empress Borough.
A copy of the "Backlund Daily" lay open on a soft stool.
Next to the stool, a golden retriever was lying on the carpet, reading a book, turning the pages with its paw from time to time.
A beautiful young woman stood in front of the French window, staring at the flowers, as if lost in thought. The girl, the flowers, and the French window formed a perfect composition.
After a while, Audrey suddenly said, "Susie, he lied."
Susie, the golden retriever, folded a corner of the page and closed the book: "Who are you talking about? Audrey."
Audrey pointed to the newspaper: "Mr. Hobert."
"He deceived your feelings?"
Audrey smiled helplessly: "Susie, watch less romance novels. Well, you can read some poetry, or the psychology textbooks I've collected."
Susie put a paw on the romance novel in front of her: "Okay."
"I remember when I first met Mr. Hobert, he said he didn't represent justice," Audrey said, "but he has been doing justice."
Susie picked up the newspaper from the soft stool and spread it out on the carpet to read: "Oh, my God, he's in the newspaper again, another very challenging case!"
"Yes, his reputation will definitely suffer because of this," Audrey said, "I plan to start a 'Justice League' gathering next week to see if I can help this justice-minded gentleman."
"That's a good idea, Audrey," Susie asked, "Can I participate too?"
"Uh, not for now, Susie." Seeing Susie's disappointment, Audrey quickly added: "If there is a chance in the future, I will introduce you to the association."
...
192 Blanca Street.
"Hobert!" Xio waved the newspaper in his hand at the dining table: "We actually had to read the newspaper to find out you did something big again!"
Hobert smiled and said, "I didn't expect this case to have such a big impact!"
That was the truth.
Fors, however, worried: "Hobert, although your speech in court was very inspiring, the gentlemen and ladies of Backlund should be more concerned that you are defending a street girl."
Xio also said: "Yes, some people will definitely criticize your motives behind your back."
Hobert poured the heated milk into three cups: "Ladies, sometimes we care about the opinions of some unimportant people, which is completely flattering them."
Xio and Fors thought Hobert's idea was very novel, so they got up and came over to take the milk, listening carefully.
Hobert smiled and said: "I've recently figured it out, there's no need to care so much about the opinions of people who are not important in our lives.
"But Miss Emma, the party concerned on the other side, regards me as her last hope. If I don't take action, the defendant's bad behavior will not be stopped.
"Honestly, it feels good to be a hero."
The three people ate toasted bread and drank hot milk.
Xio sighed: "Justice never goes out of style."
Hobert smiled: "I just did what I thought was right, it has nothing to do with justice. Well, I'm not a person who advocates justice."
As he said, he got up and put on his windbreaker: "I'm going to be late again, I'm afraid I'll have to trouble you to clean up the dishes."
"No problem," Fors waved the toasted bread in her hand: "After all, we enjoyed your toasted bread and hot milk."
Picking up his cane, Hobert quickly came to the law firm. When he arrived at the entrance of the firm, he slowed down and entered his office in a leisurely manner.
Around ten o'clock in the office, Jessica came to his office to report: "Lawyer Hobert, so far, I have received four cases similar to Ms. Emma's."
Hobert nodded: "I'll let you handle them all. If there is any problem that cannot be solved, come to me to discuss it."
Jessica agreed, and was about to turn around when Hobert stopped her again: "I have a private matter to ask you for help."
Jessica closed the office door and sat opposite Hobert: "Please speak."
"From what I've observed, your friend Carrie should be an 'Artisan', right?"
Jessica was stunned for a moment, and then thought of the key ring she had sent to Lawyer Hobert before, and then she nodded: "That's right."
"I want to entrust her to build a weapon for me," Hobert said straightforwardly: "I hope you can help me facilitate this transaction."
"It just so happens that she may also want to entrust you with something," Jessica said, "How about we find a restaurant tonight? We can talk while eating."
"Not tonight, I have an appointment," Hobert said, "And the restaurant is not a good place to talk. Let's come to the office to talk tomorrow. If you are not at ease, you can find a quiet place where you can talk with confidence, and I will go to you."
"Then come to the office."
Hobert smiled and nodded, and Jessica said goodbye and left.
In the busyness, time flies quickly.
In the afternoon, Hobert was about to take a break when Jessica handed over replies from Elizabeth and Selena.
Opening Elizabeth's letter, after a few greetings, she said that she had been having the same nightmare from time to time, dreaming of a bull-headed monster with golden antlers.
She had similar experiences before, and with the help of a friend, she escaped from that continuous nightmare, but now that friend is gone.
Elizabeth went to the "Divination Club" to find other diviners for help, but the suggestions they gave were not effective.
Then Elizabeth discussed the topic of diviners in the letter, saying that she had known a gentleman who really understood mysticism before, which gave her a new understanding of mysticism.
After contacting the diviners during this period, she found that there seemed to be two types of diviners. One type divined very accurately and rarely made symbolic interpretations. One type was always making symbolic interpretations, which became more and more confusing.
She asked Hobert how to distinguish between these two types of diviners? And asked Hobert if there was a way to solve this problem?
Finally, she talked about Melissa. She invited Melissa to Backlund for relaxation, but Melissa did not agree.
Hobert thought in his heart while holding the letter: "Elizabeth's spirituality seems to be slightly higher than normal people's. By observing, she can vaguely perceive the difference between a real 'Seer' and an ordinary Seer.
"It may be because her spirituality is a little higher that she unconsciously recalls some memories hidden by the 'Psychological Spoon' during her sleep."
Then Hobert thought again: "The gentleman who she said really understands mysticism should be Klein!"
He remembered that Mr. Klein had helped Elizabeth solve a case of evil spirits haunting her.
After thinking about it for a while, Hobert wrote back to Elizabeth, telling her that he could solve the nightmare problem she encountered, but it must be solved in person.
He suggested that Elizabeth should not go to diviners for interpretation casually, because it is difficult to meet real "experts" in daily life.
Finally, he talked about Melissa, and he invited Melissa's brother to come to Backlund as a guest to see the "Bell of Order" and the Roselle Memorial Exhibition.
