chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 238: Benefits of the Followers
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert opened Selena's letter again. This little girl was quite clever. Seeing that Hobert hadn't refused her request to be her occultism mentor, she began to ask Hobert about occult knowledge.
However, all her questions were about how Brown Stars operate and what they represent, how Red Stars operate, and how to interpret them.
Hobert smiled helplessly: This mentor doesn't know these things either!
In fact, occultism is divided into two types: ordinary occultism and Beyonder occultism.
"Ordinary occultism" is basically occultism in the eyes of ordinary people. Ordinary people's spirituality can actually feel the existence of the mystical world, but their feelings are very vague and they can only observe the superficial phenomena of occult phenomena.
Take rituals as an example. Ordinary people who burn the correct herbs and recite the correct spells also have a certain probability of receiving a response from the gods.
They would think that the response was entirely due to the herbs and spells, and would think that those herbs had the function of pleasing the gods.
Beyonder occultism, on the other hand, can explain the principles behind rituals. Herbs can only help establish a channel to the gate of the kingdom of God. The main thing is the spirituality of the petitioner and the spell, which establish the correct channel.
When there is a mystical connection with the gate of the kingdom of God, the gods will hear the prayer and respond using the established channel.
What Selena had learned before was obviously just some ordinary occult knowledge, and Hobert didn't know much about it. He was better at extraordinary occultism.
After thinking for a while, Hobert replied to Selena, telling her that these were all superficial aspects of occultism, and inviting her to visit Backlund.
After replying to the letter, Hobert rested for a while, went home for dinner, and then picked up his cane again and took a carriage to 16 Wanbo Avenue.
After nightfall, there were few people on this street, but fierce dogs were kept in the courtyards. The carriage passed by, startling a series of dog barks.
Hobert put on his mask in the carriage. After getting off the car, he found that Upton had already arrived.
Upton's hair, which had been burned off in the previous battle, had grown back. His whole temperament had also changed a bit. He no longer looked like a playboy, but looked much more mature.
Hobert stepped forward and asked, "Why didn't you go in first?"
Upton smiled: "I inquired about it in the afternoon. This is a haunted house."
Sure enough, he has made a lot of progress. He even knows to inquire about the meeting place in advance.
"Let's go, there is only one messenger here." Hobert opened the door and entered as if he were back in his own yard.
Messenger?
Upton pondered Hobert's words and quickly followed.
Arriving at the dilapidated hall of the house, neither of them used electric lights or lit candles.
In the darkness, they could see each other's outlines and approximate expressions.
Hobert asked Upton about his recent experiences. He didn't expect that Upton would play the "Barbarian" by becoming a gang leader.
However, according to Upton's feelings, he also received feedback on the digestion of the potion, but compared to Hobert's approach of antagonizing a class, the digestion speed was slower.
"The knowledge to help you stay away from losing control is a benefit only available to the favored ones of the 'Creator'." Hobert said: "Don't publicize it everywhere."
"I understand." Upton breathed a sigh of relief. He was considered a favored one of the "Creator", so there should be no danger.
After talking about this topic, Hobert said: "I need you to set up a company and use that company's name to buy two steam pumps.
"As for the reward, I mentioned it before: part of the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Briber'."
He paused and then said: "There are two forms of reward. One is that you pay for the two pumps, which is about 1,000 pounds. The reward you can get is two-thirds of the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Briber'.
"Generally speaking, the Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 7 are worth 1,200 pounds, but most of the time, they will be priced up to 1,500 to 1,800 pounds during transactions.
"As a favored one of the 'Creator', you can also enjoy the benefit of the Beyonder characteristics at the lowest price, provided that I have the Beyonder characteristics you need here."
Upton nodded: "Praise the Creator!"
This kid finally has a bit of consciousness as a believer.
Hobert continued: "Two-thirds of the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Briber' is equivalent to 800 pounds, but you can also get the qualification of general distributor of 'Keen Mechanical Firm', which is a channel that cannot be bought for 200 pounds.
"The second form is that I will pay the cost of 1,000 pounds, just use your name to register a company, and after buying the two pumps I need, the commission will end.
"However, you can only get one-eighth of the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Briber', and your company will not get the qualification of general distributor. Well, as far as I know, there are only five general distributors of this company in the world.
"You can think about how to choose the reward."
Upton asked: "The 'Keen Mechanical Firm' you mentioned, is it the large steam engine company on Nikola Street?"
"Yes."
"You actually have such a channel?"
Hobert smiled, deliberately not making his words too clear: "It's not necessarily that I have such a channel."
Upton nodded: "I understand, it may also be the channel of other favored ones."
Hobert thought to himself: It's good that you understand.
These days, it's not only tiring to play the role of an evil god, but also to play the role of a favored one of an evil god.
"I choose the first commission mode." When Upton had the idea of doing business before, he had done some research. He had heard of "Keen Mechanical Firm" and also knew the weight of this general distribution.
Hobert smiled: "A wise choice. If I hadn't heard that you wanted to do business, I wouldn't have given you this commission."
He said: "After the commission is over, I will accumulate your rewards and distribute them to you after you accept my commission again in the future and earn another one-third of the Beyonder characteristics.
"Or, if you are in a hurry to advance, you can also use 400 pounds to make up the difference, and you can also get the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Briber' from me."
Upton nodded: "Although my condition is much better now, I still need to be a 'Barbarian' for a while before I have the confidence to advance."
Hobert "hmm"ed and then said: "After the company is established, contact me by praying to the 'Creator' and pick up the goods according to my instructions.
"Then find a secluded warehouse and sacrifice the water pump to the 'Creator'."
Upton was stunned: "The, the Creator, sacrifice to the Creator?"
Does the god still need a water pump?
"The Loen Customs checks this kind of machinery very strictly. I can only ask the 'Creator' to give it to other favored ones tens of thousands of miles away in the form of a gift." Hobert mentioned this matter now to make an explanation and maintain the image of the "Creator".
Then he reminded: "The sacrifice is paid by the buyer, you just need to sacrifice it."
Upton nodded, and his vigilance against the "Creator" was greatly reduced. Even if sacrifices were needed, the "Creator" was willing to help the favored ones with such small favors. He was a kind evil, uh, god.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 239: Make an Elven weapon
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert then said to Upton, "After completing this commission, you can go back to being your boss, and also sell 'Keen Mechanical Firm' products.
"I think, you only need to put an advertisement in the newspaper, and customers will come to you."
After all, the products of 'Keen Mechanical Firm' are high-tech products of this era, and also hot commodities.
Hobert added: "If there is a new commission, I will ask 'The Creator' to contact you again. Future commissions will be in this form, so I won't explain further.
"Except for individual commissions that you must complete, you have the right to refuse most commissions, and I won't let you suffer losses on any single commission."
The last stone in Upton's heart also fell: "I like this kind of commission method."
This not only gave him enough freedom, but also gave him a "powerful" Beyonder organization to rely on. He was very satisfied with this loose organizational method.
After Hobert finished explaining the task and made corresponding explanations, in order to maintain the atmosphere of the "mysterious organization", there was no other excessive communication. He and Upton left the abandoned villa one after another.
In the carriage on the way back, Hobert took off his mask and suddenly realized that he hadn't spent a penny on this transaction, and he could actually benefit both ways.
The cost was paid by Upton, and the Beyonder characteristic of "Briber" as a reward was the one Upton gave Hobert before. On the other side, Elliot's payment would not be a penny less.
Hobert's only input was favor and channels, but everyone benefited each other and got corresponding interests or benefits.
Thinking of this, he smiled, sighing that he had already established his network in this world. Of course, this was thanks to the original owner's biological father and adoptive father, who provided a lot of help for the network Hobert established.
The next morning, Hobert didn't get up until after nine o'clock. Like all gentlemen in Backlund, he read the newspaper while eating breakfast.
A piece of information caught Hobert's attention: "...A plague suddenly broke out in the dockworkers' union. It is said to be extremely contagious. Relevant departments have sealed off the office building and dormitory building of the dockworkers' union, and urgently summoned other employees for unified treatment.
"According to insiders, this plague should be overcome soon, allowing the dock area to restore order..."
Hobert then realized that Klein had killed Lanevus, and this was the official Beyonder cleanup.
He had been so busy lately that he had almost forgotten about Klein, and didn't have time to participate in this action.
However, this action didn't have any risks. Letting Klein avenge himself would make him feel better.
Putting down the newspaper, he finished breakfast.
Hobert used the method he bestowed upon himself to bring a piece of "black iron" that the Ancient Death frequently stepped on from the "Nation of Disorder" to the real world.
[T/N: Feet!]
He packed it in a prepared cloth bag, and Hobert carried the bag to the law firm.
It was Sunday, and only a few lawyers were working overtime or on duty. The entire office building was very deserted.
Jessica and Carrie had arrived early. Hobert greeted them and thanked Carrie for the return gift.
He opened the door to his office and invited Jessica and Carrie in.
After Jessica, who was at the back, closed the door, Hobert put the cloth bag on the desk, revealing the "black iron" inside.
Carrie was immediately attracted by the "black iron": "I, this is my first time seeing such a high-level material."
Jessica also felt the unusualness of the material in front of her, staring at it intently.
After the two of them watched for two or three minutes, Carrie asked, "What kind of weapon do you want to forge?"
Such good materials can definitely create a weapon with very good extraordinary effects.
"I have drawn the blueprints." Hobert took out the blueprints he had drawn in advance. It was a straight-backed knife of equal width, which looked a bit like a sword, but with a blade on one side and a blade structure at the tip of the knife, which was obviously different from the tip of a sword.
Today was the first time Carrie doubted her knowledge: "I, I have never seen this kind of knife before, what is it called?"
"Tang Dao (Tang Sword)." Hobert replied.
"What a strange pronunciation."
"This is a word in Elvish." Hobert casually explained: "It is an ancient weapon."
Hobert had carefully considered the weapon he wanted to forge. According to the characteristics of the "Black Emperor" pathway, using a knife or two-handed sword that could charge straight ahead was the most suitable.
He also consulted relevant information and found that the weapons of various countries in the Northern Continent did not have styles suitable for him.
Either they were too big and inconvenient to carry, or they lacked momentum.
So he decided to simply forge a "Tang Dao" that he had seen in the Common Era. A two-handed sword was also possible, with great power and a ferocious look.
However, it was too long and inconvenient to carry.
Hobert remembered that in the novels he had read in the Modern Era, transmigrators generally forged katanas for themselves. Hobert, who had knowledge in this area, knew that the prototype of the Japanese sword was the Tang Dao.
Later, the little devils "improved" the blade into a curved one. They said it was more in line with the mechanical structure or something, but in fact it was because they were too short, and it was easy to not be able to pull out a straight knife.
In ancient Japan, if two warriors competed without using Japanese swords, they might have to leave time for each other to draw their swords, and maybe even ask their opponents or the audience to help hold the scabbard and draw the sword. The picture is very beautiful to think about.
For Hobert, in terms of the momentum and beauty of weapons, the Tang Dao was the first choice, and it could be disguised as a longer cane for easy carrying.
Carrie had a feeling of gaining knowledge when she heard Hobert's explanation: "This material should be able to make three Tang Dao, should we use them all?"
Hobert was stunned, able to make so many. He immediately said: "No, make me another long sword, but I want to make some modifications to the sword body and hilt."
Carrie was familiar with long swords. She drew a sketch of a long sword and asked Hobert where he needed to make changes.
After discussing the design issues of the Tang Dao and two-handed sword, Hobert asked: "What kind of reward do you hope to get?"
Carrie said: "Jessica often tells me about your deeds, especially the case the day before yesterday, which is enough to prove that you are a reliable gentleman.
"And the materials on the table can also prove that you are an Beyonder with good strength."
Hobert smiled and said: "Don't compliment me so much. If it is within my ability, I will definitely help."
"It's like this," Carrie said: "As you know, wild 'Artisans' are rare, so a mysterious Beyonder organization approached me, hoping we would join them.
"Although the conditions offered by the other party are very generous, I don't like the atmosphere of Beyonder organizations. I prefer to maintain the status quo.
"But my pathway doesn't have many Beyonder abilities that can be used in battle so far, and Jessica's strength is a bit weak, so I have always been afraid to directly refuse the other party.
"I want to ask you to protect me so that I have the confidence to refuse."

chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Lord Of the Mysteries for becoming a member, +5 bonus chapters]
Because Hobert had a Brigadier General father, he had the confidence to cooperate with official Beyonders.
Most wild Beyonders do not have such opportunities because the official Beyonders' attitude towards wild Beyonders is to catch them whenever they see one.
So, if you want to cooperate with them, you must first prove your usefulness to the official Beyonders while hiding your identity as a wild Beyonder. Only in this way can you become their informant or external staff.
There are also some Beyonders like Carrie whose purpose in becoming Beyonders may be to escape this secular society, so they don't even plan to cooperate with official Beyonders.
Such a life is indeed free, but as Carrie encountered, they don't even have the confidence and power to refuse the recruitment of some unofficial Beyonder organizations.
Because besides being Beyonders, they are also "walking Beyonder characteristics". If they refuse too simply and are resented by those Beyonder organizations, they are likely to become Beyonder characteristics.
It can be said that the law of Beyonder characteristics makes the entire Beyonder world so cruel.
Hobert asked, "What is the strength of the other party?"
Carrie said, "They are a team. According to my observation, there is one Sequence 6, one Sequence 7, and two Sequence 8s."
"What pathway are the Beyonders from?"
"The Sequence 7 looks like a 'Death' pathway Beyonder, one of the two Sequence 8s is a 'Provoker', and the others remain to be confirmed."
Hobert was stunned. It sounded like a "ragtag" team!
For him, as long as they weren't Beyonders from the "Black Emperor" or "Justiciar" pathways, because that was likely someone from the Tamara family.
Hobert asked again, "What organization is the other party from?"
Carrie shook her head: "I don't know. I only heard that they have developed many members in Desi County and Southville County in recent years, but I haven't found out the name of their organization. I had a transaction with their members before, so they targeted me."
"Does the opponent have any Sealed Artifacts?"
"No!" Carrie's answer was firm.
Hobert pondered for a moment: "If they only have these four members, I probably don't even need to find helpers."
This wasn't Hobert being arrogant. With so many magical items in his hand, a Sequence 6 might not be his opponent, let alone a Sequence 7.
Once equipped with a knife, his weakness in close combat would be gone, and he even had the confidence to withstand a Sequence 6 and a Sequence 7 at the same time.
Hobert didn't believe that Carrie and Jessica couldn't deal with the remaining two Sequence 8s.
But the premise was that they didn't have any powerful Sealed Artifacts. Like the Tamara family's team, equipped with "Black Gloves" that could completely change the battle, Hobert was still not an opponent.
However, Hobert believed Carrie's judgment, because the Sequence 7 of the "Savant" pathway was called "Appraiser". As long as the opponent had a Sealed Artifact, she could discover it immediately.
And as long as she wore it once, she could basically know the approximate ability and negative effects of the Sealed Artifact.
Of course, "Appraisers" also make mistakes, such as when the opponent has a Grade 1 or Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, but Hobert had been a fake god for so long and hadn't even obtained a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. It was impossible for a Sequence 6 in a Beyonder organization to carry a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact around.
Hearing Hobert's answer, Carrie and Jessica looked at each other. They had realized before that Hobert was a pretty good Beyonder, but they didn't expect him to be so strong.
Generally speaking, among wild Beyonders, Sequence 6 was already a master. And a Sequence 5, if he was willing, had the appeal to organize his own Beyonder organization.
Hobert added: "No matter what the outcome of the negotiation is, you have to prepare to move."
Carrie said: "We have been prepared for this."
Moving was an old skill for all wild Beyonders.
Hobert "hmm"ed and said, "Then make weapons for me as soon as possible. After I get the weapons, I will accompany you to negotiate with them."
The transaction was thus reached. The three chatted for a few more words and then left the law firm separately.
After returning to his residence, Hobert took a good nap and then went to Gar's Herbal Shop.
As he expected, by Sequence 6, auxiliary materials were already rare.
The "Baron of Corruption" potion required the blood of a dark-blooded behemoth, the sap of the Qiandali Elf Tree, dragon tooth grass powder, and aged white wine. Gar didn't have the blood of a dark-blooded behemoth in stock, and he wouldn't be able to give it to Hobert until tomorrow.
And the total cost of the blood and sap auxiliary materials alone would require about 400 pounds. Hobert immediately paid a 200-pound deposit and agreed to pick up the goods tomorrow.
Dragon tooth grass was relatively common. As for the aged white wine, Hobert returned to his home in Queens and took a bottle of Christian's vintage from the cellar.
...
Berserk Sea, Bayam.
Alger had been in this small room for three days. Of course, he didn't stand on ceremony with Byron, and he demanded good wine and food for every meal.
Finally, on Sunday afternoon, Byron appeared at the door.
Alger knew that the "Admiral Hell's" operation was over. He clenched the crystal cane in his pocket to prevent Byron from double-crossing him.
In fact, on the first day Alger came to this house, if the other party hadn't prepared to kill him, the probability of double-crossing would have been relatively small, but of course Alger wouldn't relax his vigilance.
"The operation is over," Byron said. "It seems you know what's good for you. The information was accurate, so the general decided to pay you according to the originally agreed price."
With that, he threw a small package to Alger, which contained bundles of 10-pound banknotes.
Alger glanced at it roughly, it should be enough for 3,000 pounds: "Was the operation process smooth?"
Byron asked with a sneer, "How much money are you planning to spend to buy this information?"
Alger simply asked, "Can I leave?"
Byron made a gesture of invitation at the door.
Alger remained vigilant until he returned to his ship, when he realized that the transaction was finally over.
Then he sent crew members to inquire about the news and quickly learned about the "Hell Admiral's" operation process.
...
The next day was Monday. Hobert worked all morning and, after having lunch at the office, first went to the bank to withdraw 300 pounds in cash, and then went to Gar's Herbal Shop to pick up the auxiliary materials he had ordered yesterday.
On the way back, Hobert also bought a set of beakers.
Around 2:30, Hobert returned to 192 Blanca Street, took the "Death" card from the "Nation of Disorder", and with everything ready, waited for the Tarot Gathering to begin.
Having participated in so many Tarot Gatherings, this was the first time Hobert was so excited.
But time was like that, the more urgent things were, the slower it passed.
Finally, at three o'clock, Hobert's eyes were covered by gray fog. He breathed a sigh of relief, and the urgency just now quietly dissipated.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 241 Bribing the Fool for the Second Time (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:

The "Tarot Club" begins. This time, "Justice" Audrey didn't greet everyone as usual, but looked directly at the head of the table: "Mr. Fool, the 'simple' task you entrusted has been completed."
She deliberately emphasized the word "simple."
"The Fool" Klein smiled blandly: "I already know."
Then he sighed: "In such an era, in such a Backlund, in such an East Borough, dock area, and factory district, it is truly a breeding ground for the descent of evil gods."
"Hanged Man" was stunned, wondering if he had heard correctly. Why would a simple task be linked to a breeding ground for the descent of evil gods?
At this moment, the gloomy and reserved "Mr. World" chuckled softly: "Yes, whenever I see and hear about large numbers of child laborers in their teens dying young, most workers rarely living past thirty due to extreme fatigue and harsh environments, and the elderly barely surviving the previous trials but becoming unemployed due to old age, lacking security, and only able to wander the streets, dying of hunger and cold…"
"I don't doubt the existence of evil gods at all. They are on earth, in the East Borough, dock area, and factory district…"
"The World" spoke eloquently about the current situation of the people at the bottom of the East Borough. After seeing Hobert's actions, Klein also hoped to use his power to bring some change to this world.
But he sadly realized that he was still an "unregistered person" and had to be careful not to expose his whereabouts, so he couldn't do anything at all.
After thinking for a while, he realized that the only thing he could do might be to tell Miss Justice about these things and let her use the power of the nobility to support some laws to protect the lives of the people at the bottom.
Especially when he talked about how the people in the East Borough would not have a third generation, Audrey was greatly shocked and could hardly imagine that this was happening in Backlund.
After "The World" finished speaking, Audrey fell into deep shock and remained silent for a long time.
"The Emperor" Hobert was about to echo, "This is a world that eats people." Indeed, this is more tragic and desperate than the world in Lu Xun's writings.
It was because this world was so tragic and desperate that Hobert was shocked when he went to the East Borough for the first time.
But when the words came to his lips, he felt that this sentence might expose himself, so he smiled and said: "What's even more ironic is that every time the superiors pay attention to the misery of these bottom-level people, it is because of evil gods. If you ask me, the number of times evil gods try to descend is too small, not enough to make the superiors determined to improve the living environment of the people in the East Borough."
Audrey looked at "The Emperor" with surprise: "Mr. Emperor, are you serious? That, that is an evil god."
Hobert smiled: "Believe me, Miss Justice, if you go and take a look, you will find that sometimes becoming a sacrifice to an evil god is not the most tragic thing in this world."
Audrey was silent for a few more seconds before saying: "I will, I will go and take a look."
She paused and then sincerely thanked: "Thank you, Mr. Fool, thank you for saving Backlund. Your sigh also made me understand the root of the problem."
"And thank you, Mr. Emperor and Mr. World, you have let me know many things I didn't understand before."
Hobert smiled meaningfully: "I hope justice will not become your burden."
Audrey nodded thoughtfully.
The Sun, Derrick, seemed to be in an "offline" state all the time. His motionless appearance was not a still picture, but he was listening carefully.
Saved Backlund? Alger was surprised again. How big of a deal was this?
At this time, Alger felt the Fool's gaze. He immediately understood and quickly materialized the last page of the Roselle diary he owed.
Next was Mr. Fool's reading time. He turned his attention to the diary in his hand: "January 16th, the taste of a witch is really good!"
Klein's mouth twitched. He simply didn't know what expression to use to face it: Emperor, I underestimated you too much before…
Taking advantage of Mr. Fool's reading time, Audrey calmed her mood and returned to the state of a spectator.
Then she found that whether it was Mr. Emperor, Mr. Hanged Man, or Mr. Sun, they all seemed to have something to say. Obviously, some stories had happened to them in the past week.
I really look forward to the extraordinary life of freedom like them, Audrey thought divergently.
"You can start communicating," Mr. Fool's reading time ended.
Hobert said first: "Honorable Mr. Fool, I have collected an item that I think you will definitely be interested in."
Klein asked in a flat tone: "What have you collected?"
"Please allow me to materialize some information about it," Hobert smiled and deliberately said misleadingly: "I think one of the purposes of collecting Emperor Roselle's diary is for it."
Audrey was surprised again, and almost couldn't maintain the state of the Spectator: What amazing thing did Mr. Emperor collect?
Alger also showed enough surprise: "The Emperor" can actually collect something that Mr. Fool is interested in? What would a god be interested in?
Derrick finally got out of the "offline" state. He was very curious about what Mr. Emperor had collected, and didn't know if there was such a thing in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods"? If there was, he would have a way to please "The Fool".
After obtaining Klein's consent, Hobert materialized the "Death" card.
When Klein took the "Death" card in his hand, he couldn't help but show a surprised expression, not because he was frightened by the lifeless Roselle image on the "Blasphemy Card", but because one of the diaries he read today was Roselle saying that he was going to make a set of "Blasphemy Cards containing the mysteries of the gods."
Unexpectedly, just after reading the diary, he saw the "Death" card among them.
Under his gaze, the Death card became three-dimensional, showing some content:
"Sequence 9: Corpse Collector…"
He turned the pages one by one, and stopped abruptly when he saw Sequence 6.
Although Audrey couldn't see Mr. Fool's surprised expression under the cover of the gray fog, she still felt the solemnity shown by Mr. Fool from his body movements.
Audrey was a little shocked: Mr. Fool is really interested in that small card!
Alger didn't dare to look at Mr. Fool, not even with the corner of his eye, but the fact that Mr. Fool was silent for a few seconds after getting the card already explained everything: "The Emperor" really spent a lot of money to digest the potion! He was willing to sacrifice something that even the gods would be silent about.
Derrick was a little disappointed. Although he couldn't see what Mr. Emperor had found, he knew that there was no such thing in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods".
Klein was silent for about six or seven seconds before speaking to Hobert: "You can make the second bribe."
Although they had already guessed the result, Alger and Audrey couldn't help but be a little surprised: Mr. Fool is very satisfied with the offering collected by the "Emperor".

chapters.content:

Hobert smiled and said, "Okay, Mr. Fool, I will bribe immediately after the gathering."
"What do you want from me?" Klein asked.
Hobert said, "Still some Beyonder knowledge."
He knew that Klein could not come up with anything but knowledge now.
Hobert smiled and said, "But this time, only I can hear those knowledge."
Audrey quickly raised her hand: "Honorable Mr. Fool, is it possible? Let's take a break in the middle, and continue the Tarot Club meeting after Mr. Emperor completes the sacrifice."
In that case, she could also listen to the extraordinary knowledge that Mr. Fool told in response to Mr. Emperor's bribe.
Alger said nothing, but judging from his appearance, he also agreed with Audrey's idea.
Derrick looked at Mr. Fool eagerly, his thoughts were self-evident.
Hobert smiled: "Can we have a break in the middle?"
"Of course," Audrey said seriously: "Important meetings usually have a break in the middle."
"Okay," Hobert said: "Mr. Fool, please make the final decision. I don't mind other members listening in."
In order to maintain the identity of "The Fool", Klein was going to refuse, but seeing the eyes of "Justice", "Hanged Man", and "Sun", Klein decided to sing a duet.
He controlled "The World" and said: "Your thoughts are extremely disrespectful to Mr. Fool."
"Justice" and others, who had been a little uneasy, were about to get up and apologize immediately, but Klein took the lead and said in the identity of "The Fool": "It doesn't matter, since this is everyone's expectation, let's take a break in the middle."
"The World" said: "Your generosity is far beyond my imagination."
Audrey and Alger also praised Mr. Fool's generosity one after another, and promised that there would be no next time.
Hobert almost covered his face, why is he flattering himself?
Then he sighed, if Klein knew in the future that some members of the Tarot Club knew that "The World" was "The Fool's" alt account, would he be embarrassed to dig out another giant palace?
After agreeing to continue the meeting in two minutes, the Tarot Club entered its first mid-term break in history.
Hobert returned to his bedroom, lit the prepared candles, drew the symbol representing the Fool, and quickly arranged the altar.
Then he began to recite the sacrificial words: "The Fool who does not belong to this era... I offer you a 'Death' card, and pray that you will tell us some extraordinary knowledge."
A majestic palace appeared in front of Hobert's eyes. In the depths of the palace, a stalwart figure said: "Yes."
The flame of the candle representing "The Fool" suddenly became bigger and taller, until a phantom door appeared. A strong wind suddenly blew in the room, and the "Death" card was swept into the phantom door.
The strong wind disappeared, the flame returned to normal, and the sacrificial ceremony ended.
Hobert waited quietly to be pulled back above the gray fog. At this moment, he actually felt the digestion of the potion.
Crash~
There seemed to be a broken sound in the void, and the "Briber" potion had actually been digested!
Hobert suddenly realized that as long as the object of the sacrifice agreed to his prayer, the process of "bribing" was completed.
At this time, his vision was covered by the gray fog, and he returned to the Sefirah Castle.
Audrey, Alger, and Derrick also returned together. They all saw the card emitting a cold light on the corner of the table in front of Mr. Fool.
They couldn't see the face of the card clearly, but they just felt the extraordinaryness of the card.
At this time, Klein said: "Since 'Emperor' sacrificed a 'Blasphemy Card', then let me talk about the 'Blasphemy Slate' and the 'Blasphemy Cards'."
Audrey said: "That's really what we, I, I think is the knowledge that Mr. Emperor wants to hear."
She looked at the Emperor a little unconfidently.
"Yes," Hobert said again deliberately confusingly: "I also know today that it was originally called 'Blasphemy Card'. I only called it 'Roselle's Card' before."
Everyone quieted down, waiting for the Fool's next speech.
I only heard "The Fool" say: "You all know the 'Blasphemy Slate', but you don't know that there are two pieces in total, and you don't know the content on it."
Alger felt that all the pores on his body were opened: Mr. Fool is going to explain the content of the "Blasphemy Slate", could it be that, could it be that He has seen the "Blasphemy Slate"?
Then he answered himself: He must have seen it! This is an ancient god, and in the long years, he must have seen many things that ordinary people can hardly imagine.
Derrick listened very carefully. Their textbooks mentioned the "Blasphemy Slate". He knew what the "Blasphemy Slate" meant. But he was not surprised. In his opinion, it was normal for "The Fool" to know this knowledge.
Audrey also knew that the "Blasphemy Slate" represented the "extraordinary beginning", but she didn't know the meaning of the "Blasphemy Slate", so she was just curious, but not as excited as the "Hanged Man".
As for the reactions of Hobert and "The World", they can be ignored.
Klein said in a flat tone: "The content on the 'Blasphemy Slate' is the complete sequence potion formulas and rituals of each pathway."
He said with a smile: "It can also be called the path to becoming a god!"
It was as if a loud thunder sounded in the Sefirah Castle, and all the members were in a state of shock. Of course, Hobert and "The World" can also be ignored, because if you look closely, there are problems with their shocked states.
Alger integrated many previous insights: No wonder it is called "Blasphemy Slate", it turns out that it blasphemes God!
Then he was even more excited than before: The path to becoming a god! How yearning! It's a pity that my pathway already has the Lord of Storms, but it doesn't matter, it would be great if I could reach the level of an angel. It is said that it is a god from God, and it is also a god.
"What?" Audrey's brain is now full of this word: The path to becoming a god? Haven't gods always existed? Why, why is there a path to becoming a god?
After calming down a little, Audrey quickly accepted this fact. In fact, she had thought about it for a long time. Where is the end of extraordinary people who continue to be promoted? Before, she had many ideas, but because it was too blasphemous to the gods, she didn't dare to think in that direction.
Now with the explanation of "The Fool", she knows: The end of the Beyonder path is the level of the gods! This is even more blasphemous than the most blasphemous idea before!
Derrick was sitting on the seat, trembling all over: Impossible! How could the omniscient and omnipotent God, how could it be possible...
If someone else had said these words, he would have rushed up to fight the other party desperately, but these words came from Mr. Fool, another great god, which caused a violent shock in Derrick's heart.
He seemed to realize something, and wanted to cry: God was once an ordinary being, so would he also have the possibility of falling?

chapters.content:

Klein gave everyone time to recover from their shock. Before they could catch their breath, he added, "Roselle saw the second 'Blasphemy Slate', so he created a set of 'Blasphemy Cards'."
The sudden appearance of a well-known figure made Audrey and the others feel like they were back in the real world. The previous information had been too shocking, filled with a sense of unreality.
Alger wasn't as excited as before, only thinking: Emperor Roselle hides many unimaginable secrets. He actually saw the 'Blasphemy Slate'. For the first time, I feel that things like the 'Blasphemy Slate' from myths and legends are so close to me, almost within reach.
This made him once again marvel at the high level of the Tarot Club: no Beyonder gathering could possess such knowledge, unless it was a Divine Meeting within the Church. Divine Meeting? That's right, isn't the Tarot Club a Divine Meeting? And I am a member of the Divine Meeting.
Derrick recovered from the shock and grief just now: I don't know who Roselle is, but if there really is a path to becoming a god, I want to become the sun in the sky! Let the sunlight shine again on the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'!
He also thought: The omniscient and omnipotent God will definitely bless and help me. That's right, He cannot have fallen. Even if He was once an ordinary being, He is different after becoming a God. Gods cannot fall!
This time it was Audrey's turn to be surprised: "So, so that card is, is…"
Klein slowly said: "A complete pathway."
Only then did Alger understand: This is indeed something that gods would be interested in. Even if a god possesses a complete pathway, they would definitely be interested in another complete pathway. But I wonder which path it is?
Derrick also thought: If it were the 'Sun' pathway, that would be great!
Audrey simply asked: "Mr. Fool, is it the complete sequence of 'The Spectator'?"
Klein said: "No."
He said: "It's not your pathway."
Several people thought in unison: What a pity!
Hobert stood up and bowed slightly to Klein: "The knowledge you have revealed exceeds my expectations and is more valuable than the offering I presented."
He only said this as a form of mutual flattery. If this knowledge were taken out separately and compared to the 'Death' card, it would be difficult to say which was more valuable.
But for Klein, the 'Death' card would definitely be more valuable, because he could use it as a medium to leverage more power from the 'Sefirah Castle' in advance, completing many operations that only gods could do.
Klein smiled slightly, as if it were a trivial matter.
Audrey smiled at 'The Emperor': "Congratulations, Mr. Emperor, after this bribe, your potion will be completely digested."
"My potion was already digested before the Tarot Club restarted," Hobert said with a smile. "When Mr. Fool accepted my offering and agreed to my request, the digestion process had already begun."
Audrey sincerely said: "That's really great. I didn't expect this method to have such a magical effect."
Then she couldn't help but think: I wonder if there is a way to quickly digest a potion from a certain sequence of the 'Spectator' pathway?
Alger's expression was a little unnatural. He was Sequence 7 when Hobert joined the Tarot Club, and now, he is still Sequence 7.
Then he sighed in his heart: It's different to have the support of an extraordinary family.
Derrick didn't think so much, just sincerely congratulating 'The Emperor'.
At this time, 'The World', sitting at the lower seat, suddenly asked: "'Mr. Emperor', how do you know about the existence of the 'Blasphemy Cards'? Could it be that you can understand Emperor Roselle's diary?"
This was the thing that Klein was most interested in, or rather, most worried about.
Theoretically speaking, no one but him, the transmigrator, could understand the 'mysterious symbols' 'invented' by Roselle, but he couldn't rule out the possibility that someone in this world had really deciphered the writing.
Regarding this, Hobert had already prepared his explanation: "A friend of one of my elders knew Emperor Roselle. He mentioned the 'Blasphemy Cards'.
"Of course, he didn't know they were 'Blasphemy Cards', he only knew there was something similar, and I happened to find one by chance."
Even if this statement of Hobert's were used for divination, there wouldn't be any loopholes.
Rex's charlatan friend should be a high-sequence 'Zaratul', and the Zaratul family had deep cooperation with Roselle at the time, so he must have known Roselle.
As for Hobert's later words, they might cause some fluctuations in the divination.
But it doesn't matter, it can be understood that his 'elder's friend' was only guessing, so it was full of uncertainty, belonging to the lack of divination conditions.
The reactions of the other members varied. Audrey's surprise was at the point: "Knew Emperor Roselle?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, I remember Mr. Fool saying at the last few gatherings that the lives of high-sequence Beyonders are very long."
In addition to being surprised, Audrey also marveled at the wonder of the Beyonder world.
Alger sighed: "It's so good to be born into a Beyonder family! There are so many resources to use, and the key is that your knowledge and channels for obtaining information are unmatched by others."
Klein also felt the same way.
Hobert smiled and said: "Everyone, have you forgotten the curse on me? As far as I know, it is difficult for members of my family to live past thirty if they want to stay sane.
"If you want to live a little longer, you can only accept the fate of being a madman for the rest of your life.
"Yes, you may envy my resources, but you easily overlook the unavoidable harm that this family brings me."
Behind the gray fog, Klein sighed: This is what is called "Blessings bring misfortune".
Alger also felt 'The Emperor's' sorrow: "Thirty years old" will definitely be like a mountain pressing down on people, and 'The Emperor' looks to be in his twenties already. Emperor Roselle was right: fate always has two sides, happiness and disaster always depend on each other.
Derrick felt a sense of sympathy, their city seemed to be cursed, and 'The Emperor's' family was also cursed.
Audrey said: "Sorry, Mr. Emperor, for reminding you of unpleasant things."
Hobert shook his head: "No need to apologize, this curse instead spurs me on to move forward, otherwise I would most likely stay at Sequence 7 or Sequence 6, this stage that has many methods and not too high a risk of losing control."
Alger, who had started this topic just now, changed the subject. He said to 'The Emperor': "The information from the last gathering was sold by me, for a total of 3,000 pounds. The person who bought it was 'Admiral Hell' Ludwell."
He said: "According to the agreement, you will receive a 900-pound share."
This sum of money greatly alleviated Alger's financial pressure, allowing him to still have the ability to purchase the Sequence 6 'Wind Blessed' potion formula.
"Pleasure to work with you," Hobert asked with a smile, "Were the valuables on the ship all robbed by 'Admiral Hell'?"
"No," Alger said. "I inquired, and it seems that he did not have too intense a conflict with the target ship."

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 244 Business Opportunities in the City of Silver (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Alger continued to explain, "I heard that 'Admiral Hell' led the fleet to intercept them. Some say they only had a minor skirmish, while others claim they fought fiercely.
"But regardless, no pirates have seen a ship from the Intis Republic on that route since."
Audrey frowned and asked, "Mr. Hanged Man, why are there so many conflicting reports in the information you've received?"
"This is normal," Alger explained. "Generally, the information obtained is this chaotic. I need to use my knowledge to make reasonable guesses and deductions.
"Take this news for example. The reason it seems so chaotic is because none of it comes from the crew of 'Admiral Hell.' Many people are just repeating hearsay or saw the scene from afar.
"So, this kind of information obtained from different sources needs to be sorted out by myself."
Alger paused and continued, "In my opinion, two pieces of information are useful: 'Admiral Hell' led the fleet to intercept, and no one has seen a ship from the Intis Republic since.
"Then, it's about making reasonable guesses to fill in the gaps.
"It is said that 'Admiral Hell' is a powerful Sequence 5. It's impossible for him to silently eliminate the Intis ship, because there was also a Sequence 5 on that ship.
"After a series of deductions, I ultimately believe that the two sides should have negotiated. The Intis ship left behind some gold, and 'Admiral Hell' helped them escape that sea area or helped them hide their tracks to avoid being attacked by other pirate ships."
That's why Byron said, "The general decided to pay you the price we originally agreed upon." When Alger sold this information, he was selling the intelligence about the treasure on the entire Intis ship. Obviously, Luther Weill didn't get the treasure from the entire ship, otherwise he wouldn't have emphasized "the price we originally agreed upon."
Alger's analysis opened Audrey's eyes: "Very reasonable guess. I didn't expect collecting intelligence to be such a test of wisdom."
Then she expressed her doubts: "Another thing I didn't expect is that pirates actually negotiate?"
"This is a very normal thing," Alger said. "The higher the level of pirates, the more they rely on negotiation when solving problems.
"Just like the annual Pirate Conference. For most pirates, it is a grand event for exchanging information and conducting transactions, but for a few high-level pirates, it is a bargaining meeting to delineate looting areas or prepare to deal with a certain enemy together."
Audrey tried hard to imagine the scene of the Pirate Conference, but for some reason, she suddenly thought of the noble's ball. Whether it was the purpose or the process, the two seemed very similar.
At this time, Hobert echoed, "I also think Mr. Hanged Man's guess basically restores the truth. After reaching Sequence 5, it is difficult to kill an opponent one-on-one without help."
"Obviously this is our common understanding," Alger added. "It is estimated that in a few days, 'Admiral Hell' will participate, or his first mate and second mate will participate in the Pirate Conference, and then there should be accurate news about this matter."
Hobert smiled and said, "But those news are not important to us anymore."
"That's right, we've got the money we should get," Alger echoed. "After the Tarot Meeting ends, I will use the method of offering sacrifices to the Fool to pay you that 900 pounds of bonus.
"In addition, because I was trading this intelligence last week, I couldn't help you inquire about the sealed artifact with 'travel' ability. I am also going to participate in the Pirate Conference, and I will help you inquire about the seller then."
"Okay, I look forward to your good news." Hobert immediately roughly calculated his assets, which might not be enough.
Then Alger asked, "Has anyone helped me find clues to the 'Wind Blessed' potion?"
No one spoke.
Alger sighed. Now he has enough money, but the potion formula is difficult to buy for the time being.
After Alger finished speaking, Derrick said to "The World", "Mr. World, I will be able to get the real roots and juice of the Mist Treant in the next few days. Please prepare the weapon for me."
Everyone was stunned. Hobert asked, "Didn't you just pass the first round of assessment? You can go out to hunt monsters so soon."
Derrick smiled shyly: "I'm going to help at the workshop. While chatting with other people, someone happened to have the real roots and juice of the Mist Treant.
"I'll go help for a few more days, and he promised to give me these materials first, and then I will continue to help in the next month."
The people in the workshop like the sunlight he provides very much. It can be said that no one in City of Silver doesn't like sunlight, even the weak sunlight that Derrick prays for through chanting.
Derrick doesn't need to do physical labor in the workshop. He only needs to pray for sunlight from time to time, and the efficiency of the workshop can be greatly improved.
The atmosphere in the workshop is usually very dull. Unless there is a need for work, no one wants to speak, but after having sunlight, laughter can often be heard in the workshop.
In fact, not only the workshop, but the entire City of Silver has this atmosphere.
Derrick likes this job very much. His original intention of being the "Sun" was to hope that City of Silver could get out of misfortune, and he wanted to find new hope for City of Silver. Whenever he heard everyone's laughter, he seemed to have seen the hope of City of Silver.
"The World" said, "I will try to find a suitable weapon for you this week."
Derrick nodded.
Hobert smiled and said, "Your work income is very high. You can exchange for a Sequence 7 level main material in just over a month?"
Derrick was stunned: "This is normal, because those materials are of no use to us."
This time it was everyone's turn to be stunned. City of Silver only has a few pathways, and there are indeed many Beyonder materials that they cannot use.
Especially materials of Sequence 7 and below. The main materials of Sequence 6 level or above potions can barely be used as a sealed artifact, but the materials of Sequence 7 and below have no practical effects and can only be thrown in the warehouse to collect dust.
Many materials that are worth six or seven hundred pounds in Backlund may only be worth a dozen or even a few pounds in their eyes.
Hobert said, "It's a pity that gold pounds cannot be used in your place, otherwise I would definitely use all my savings to buy all the materials in your place, and then I would be a rich man."
Alger and others had the same idea.
Hobert thought for a while and asked, "What are the things that you generally need or can often use in your place? I know that daily necessities are very needed in your place, but they cannot be used for trading, because it will immediately expose your identity.
"Is there anything else? Um, something that can be used in the Beyonder world and will not expose your identity."
Derrick thought for a while before saying, "Weapons! We lack weapons."
There are two sources for the weapons used in City of Silver, one is from the workshop and the other is from monster hunts.
The weapons in the workshop are just simple weapons and have no mystical effects. There is a very small probability that the weapons seized will have mystical effects.
It is precisely because such weapons are rare that Derrick decided to find a suitable weapon for himself at the Tarot Meeting.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 245 The various parties in the Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert's first thought was to establish a long-term cooperative relationship with Cattleya on this side, and with "Little Sun" on the City of Silver side.
Using weapons with extraordinary effects to exchange for the "low sequence" materials gathering dust in their warehouse.
With such a turnaround, he could earn at least several times the price difference!
Now he only lacked a stable channel for selling Beyonder materials, and Hobert immediately thought of two options: Gar's Herbal Shop; entrusting Upton to establish relevant channels in Conant City.
Hobert said to "The Sun": "I will occasionally provide you with a weapon and regularly exchange some materials that you don't need from you.
"As long as you don't need it there and the cost is low, otherwise this deal won't be worthwhile, because even on our side, weapons with mystical effects are relatively sought-after."
"I understand." Derrick said: "I also hope that City of Silver can obtain more Beyonder weapons."
Hobert smiled and said, "Then I wish us a pleasant cooperation in advance."
At this time, Alger also said: "And me, I also hope to join this cooperation."
Audrey joked: "Mr. Sun will be the largest transit merchant of the Tarot Club in the future."
Everyone laughed together, but Little Sun didn't quite understand what a transit merchant meant, but the atmosphere reached this point and he laughed along.
After reaching these transactions, Alger promised "The World": "If you want the marrow crystal of the Elf Spring and all the spinal fluid of the Evil-patterned Black Panther, they should be available at the Pirate Gathering. Prepare gold pounds, and I will pray to Mr. Fool after I have news."
Klein sighed, after killing Lanevus, things seemed to suddenly become smoother, and the Sequence 7 materials might be collected within a week.
But a new problem arose. He only had enough money to buy one main material.
But he still manipulated "The World" to say in a hoarse voice: "Okay."
After the Tarot Club is over, I will focus on making money.
Finally, it came to the information exchange session. Audrey talked about the recent serial murders in Backlund. "Little Sun" Derrick said that it was very similar to the promotion ritual from Sequence 6 to Sequence 5 of the "Demon" pathway.
This information benefited Klein and Audrey, who were in Backlund. Hobert, who was also in Backlund, was a little dazed. He was a little busy after he had his own legal team. He only heard Xio and Fors talk about it, and he didn't have time to pay attention to this case at all.
Everyone chatted for a few more words, and Klein ended the gathering.
...
On the Berserk sea, the sea was rarely sunny and breezy.
Alger sat on the captain's seat, staring at the white clouds outside in a daze, his mind was full of "Blasphemy Slate" and "Blasphemy Cards". As he thought about it, his thoughts turned to another direction: "He will soon be Sequence 6!"
Hobert's promotion put a lot of pressure on Alger. Originally, he was the highest-sequence member of the Tarot Club besides "The Fool", but now he was about to become the second.
And "The World" who just joined was also about to become Sequence 7. Alger took a deep breath, he had to work harder too.
In addition to asking the members of the Tarot Club to find the "Wind Blessed" potion formula, he planned to prepare to explore the second location he discovered in the ruins after attending the Pirate Gathering.
However, this exploration must be more cautious and more fully prepared.
...
Forsaken Land of the Gods, City of Silver.
Derrick looked at the dark ceiling, recalling the explosive information of "The Path to Becoming a God". He shook his head and didn't want to continue thinking about it, and instead began to think about the transaction proposed by Mr. Emperor.
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that Mr. Emperor really had a talent for business, because City of Silver really needed Beyonder weapons, and the Beyonder materials of many people had been left there for decades without much use.
There were even more such materials in the public warehouse of City of Silver.
Derrick's family used to have some of these materials, but he sold them on the black market to exchange for the main material of "Bard".
If these useless materials could be exchanged for some Beyonder weapons, every resident of City of Silver would think it was a worthwhile deal.
Then Derrick began to convert the difference in materials between the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" and the outside. He still didn't have much concept of gold pounds. When he traded with the Emperor before, he also felt that a Sequence 8 and a Sequence 9 main material were worth 400 pounds, and it seemed that gold pounds couldn't buy much.
But later, his transaction with "The World", a Sequence 7 main material could be exchanged for a Beyonder weapon. At that time, he also felt that "The World" was at a disadvantage. Fortunately, with the reminder of Miss Justice and Mr. Hanged Man, he did not promise to exchange two main materials for one weapon.
Through the comparison of these two transactions, Derrick realized that the value of Beyonder materials outside was much higher than in City of Silver.
He unconsciously converted it into merits. The "Warrior" pathway requires 110 merits, and the main material of the "Bard" he needs only requires about 50 merits. The Sequence 8 main materials other than the "Warrior" pathway require 10 to 90 merits.
The reason why the price difference is so large is because the Sequence 8 main materials of the continuous sequence potion formula in City of Silver will generally be worth eighty or ninety merits.
And everyone doesn't know what to do with the Sequence 8 main materials, and no one wants even 10 merits.
Mr. Emperor said that the Sequence 8 main materials outside can be sold for 300 pounds, which means that the comparison between the two sides is between 1:30 and 1:3.
What Mr. Emperor wanted were those 1:30 materials.
Derrick can earn 5 merits for patrolling around City of Silver once, and 10 merits for patrolling farther!
His merits are now enough to repay Mr. Emperor's debt. Before, he also felt that he should give the Emperor materials worth at least forty or fifty merits so that the Emperor would not suffer.
Now Derrick realized that the reason why many materials in City of Silver were useless and worthless was just because they couldn't use them.
And these materials are as valuable as the main materials of the "Warrior" pathway in the outside world.
After figuring this out, Derrick had a basic understanding of the transactions that might be reached in the future.
He didn't think about how to trade specifically. Mr. Emperor said that he would not let him suffer, and he would definitely not let him suffer.
Derrick got up from the bed, tidied up his clothes and went out. He had to go to the workshop to help this afternoon.
...
Backlund, 15 Minsk Street.
Klein looked at the slightly foggy street outside and fell into deep thought. Where should he go to buy weapons for "Little Sun"? Where should he go to make money?
He thought of a lady at the "Eye of Wisdom" old gentleman's gathering who seemed to have a cooperation with an "Artisan". He could consult her at the next gathering to see if she had any weapons suitable for use in City of Silver.
However, the weapons sold by that lady seem to prioritize exchanging for the "Barbarian" potion formula. Klein sighed: If the "Emperor" had sacrificed the "Blasphemy Card" of the "Lawyer" pathway to me, that would be great.
As for making money, he had to sell the potion formula. He originally had the continuous potion formula of the "Sun" pathway in his hand, and now he had the entire potion formula of the "Death" pathway in his hand. He could pick one of the Sequence 9 and Sequence 8 of the sequence to sell, and he could basically collect enough money for a main material.
Thinking of this, he immediately went downstairs to look for newspapers. Unfortunately, there was no "Eye of Wisdom" gathering tonight.
However, Klein saw news about the Roselle Memorial Exhibition in the newspaper. After reading his diaries for so many days, he still didn't know what Emperor Roselle looked like.
He decided to wait for the "Eye of Wisdom" gathering while taking the time to see the Roselle Memorial Exhibition, just to relax.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 246 Becoming a Baron of Corruption
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Backlund, the Earl Hall's villa in the Empress Borough.
Susie felt that the time was almost up, stood up and opened the door with her paws, and sure enough, Audrey was already sitting next to the easel: "Audrey, you look a little sad."
Audrey was holding a pencil, but didn't make a single stroke: "Susie, I only realized today that I don't know the overall picture of this world, I don't even know the overall picture of Backlund."
"No one knows, Audrey." Susie comforted, "I've seen some descriptions in books, this world is too big! So big that it's beyond our imagination."
Audrey smiled: "That's not what I meant, Susie, I just, I just suddenly realized that some of the information I've learned seems to have been filtered."
A surprised expression appeared on Susie's dog face: "Do you mean someone has been observing us in secret, manipulating the information we know, and even controlling what books we read and what delicacies we eat through recommendations?"
"It's not that serious, Susie." Audrey said helplessly, "Don't read those sensational magazines anymore, many articles are deliberately written so exaggerated in order to attract attention."
Susie stretched out her dog paw and scratched her head: "Okay, Audrey, but those poetry collections are really boring to read."
Audrey smiled helplessly. Raising a dog who likes to read is really a headache.
But soon, her eyes became firm: "Susie, I'm going to the East Borough recently, um, it can be arranged after the 'Justice League' gathering. At the gathering, I can ask Mr. Hobert what to pay attention to when going to the East Borough?"
...
Backlund, 192 Blanca Street.
Hobert waited for a few minutes and received Alger's 900-pound bonus, which brought his savings close to 7,500 pounds.
In a few days, he may get a quote for the sealed artifact with the "Travel" ability. 7,500 pounds is still a bit insufficient. Hobert plans to sell the Beyonder characteristics of "Lunatic" and "Werewolf" in his hands.
At the same time, if Klein doesn't come to him, Hobert plans to go to Klein this week to do the task of finding Heyman. Even if the reward for the task is split equally between the two, he can still earn hundreds of pounds.
Hobert waited for a while to avoid Klein from making a surprise attack, and to calm down his mood.
Then, in the way he bestowed upon himself, he took out the main material of "Baron of Corruption" stored in the "Nation of Disorder".
He placed the set of beakers he had bought back on the desk, took out all the auxiliary materials, took a deep breath, and began to prepare the potion.
First is the blood of the Dark Blooded Behemoth. The thick blood is a bit like strawberry jam, but its fishy smell will make people lose all appetite.
Then add the juice of the Elf Tree. These juices look a bit like milk. After adding them to the blood of the Dark Blooded Behemoth, the two immediately reacted. Without stirring, they merged together by themselves, turning into a drink like milk tea.
After that, add dragon tooth grass powder and aged white wine. After adding the auxiliary materials, thin black mist emerged from the beaker. Without heating, the liquid in the beaker bubbled "gurglingly".
Hobert sighed. As expected of a Sequence 6 potion, just adding the auxiliary materials makes it feel like a Sequence 9 potion.
Finally, it was the Beyonder characteristic of the "Baron of Corruption", or rather, the thing formed by the fusion of the two main materials.
It was like a piece of decayed black jade, surrounded by a layer of black mist, looking a bit magical and a bit unreal.
When put into the beaker, a violent change immediately occurred. While more black mist spewed out, the Beyonder characteristic quickly melted, and the materials in the beaker seemed to boil, with larger bubbles popping up "gurglingly".
Soon, the boiling state disappeared, and the bubbles disappeared as well. The potion gradually solidified, turning into a jelly-like substance.
Pour the jelly-like potion into a cup. There was no residue inside the beaker, and it was softer than real jelly. After pouring it into the cup, it immediately changed its shape and landed on the bottom of the cup.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert drank the potion in one gulp. The potion seemed to have life, and it burrowed into his stomach as soon as it entered his mouth.
Boom~
Hobert's thoughts suddenly exploded, and all the dirty deals he knew from his two lives emerged from the depths of his mind.
Hobert tried to restrain his mind and finally controlled the rolling thoughts. At this time, he found that his consciousness had left his body.
At this time, his body was covered with a thin layer of black mist, his skin was turning gray-black inch by inch, and an insidious and greedy expression was gradually appearing on his face, becoming so twisted that Hobert didn't even recognize himself.
Hobert quickly made his consciousness sink, trying to control the changes in his body. At the same time, vicious thoughts appeared in his mind:
"Reveal her father's rebellion in a public place in front of Xio and ridicule her height."
"Take advantage of Fors's weakness after the red moon, strip her clothes off, and ravage her from night to dawn..."
Hobert quickly shook his head, trying to drive away these thoughts, but more thoughts appeared:
"Kidnap Tyron and force Christian to hand over all the inheritance left by Rex."
"Marry Donna, kill Tyron, and seize all of Christian's property..."
Hobert gasped for breath. For a moment, he was intoxicated in this idea of ​​doing whatever he wanted, but in the end, he regained his sanity, but some thoughts continued to appear in his mind:
"Kidnap Audrey while she is traveling alone and imprison her in a dungeon to make her a slave."
"Subdue Klein, find a way to steal 'Sefirah Castle', and become a combination of 'Fool' and 'Creator'."
"Kill Upton and seize his property."
"Let Elliott offer more sacrifices..."
As Hobert gradually regained control of his body, these thoughts gradually became less vicious and less greedy.
Finally, the black mist around him was all absorbed by his pores, and Hobert also regained control of his expression.
Gradually, Hobert seemed to be reacquainting himself with his body, and the side effects of the potion gradually disappeared.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. Now he is a "Baron of Corruption".
Recalling the feeling just now, he was a little scared: No wonder the assistance of a ritual is required when advancing to Sequence 5. Now I am only advancing to Sequence 6, and even if the potion is completely digested, there is still such a high risk.
If you directly advance to Sequence 5 without a ritual, failure to advance is the best result.
Then he sighed: The first element of a Baron of Corruption is not to be "corrupted" himself, and to always be vigilant not to become vicious and insidious.
Finally, he radiated his spirituality and began to feel his new abilities.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 247 Order Crystal
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert unleashed his spirituality, sensing the changes brought about by the "Baron of Corruption" potion.
First, the four applications of "Bribery" have been greatly improved, roughly by about 30%. It is estimated that after completely digesting the "Baron of Corruption" potion, it will increase by 50%!
Then there's a new skill: Corrosion!
This is the core skill of the "Baron of Corruption."
It can make the minds of people within a ten-meter radius gradually become dark and greedy, making them prone to irrational choices. It can also launch Beyonder attacks against individual enemies or multiple enemies within the range.
Hobert sighed, another "group attack skill." The previous "group attack skill" was the "Disorder Stone" but there had been no place to use its "group attack" attribute, because he had been avoiding fighting multiple enemies at the same time.
In addition, "Distortion" has also been greatly improved and can now be used as an Beyonder power. It can now distort the target's language, actions, intentions, and meanings, while constructing an order more favorable to oneself.
It can also distort the target's direction and goal, which is equivalent to achieving the effect brought by the "Wood of Order" without using it.
Hobert suddenly thought: The "Distortion" authority of the "Baron of Corruption," or rather the "Black Emperor," is a bit like the "Grafting" ability of "The Fool."
However, the "Black Emperor" directly "distorts" from the front, and the opponent can wake up after the battle. "Grafting" may happen unconsciously, and even after the battle, the opponent is very likely not to notice the changes in themselves.
Therefore, "The Fool" is "mysterious," but the image of the "Black Emperor" is armored, obviously more inclined to fight the opponent head-on.
And this path of finding loopholes and using them is also a bit like the fighting style of the "Error" path.
The difference is that the "Black Emperor" will distort or amplify loopholes, so that the rules become more favorable to oneself. "Error," on the other hand, directly steals a certain order and uses its advantage of rarely being restricted by order to make the opponent lose its advantage or be at a disadvantage at all times.
Hobert wrote down these insights, he must not go in the wrong direction, and he must not gradually move closer to "The Fool" and "Error" because he knows their authorities.
Continuing to examine his abilities, Hobert found that his ability to find loopholes in enemies or the environment had been strengthened.
At the same time, his physique has also been greatly improved. Although it is not as strong in defense and attack as the "Warrior" path, in terms of physical strength alone, it should be similar to an ordinary "Dawn Paladin."
But it's just an ordinary "Dawn Paladin," and can't be compared with Utravsky, a "Warrior" with "talent."
Then Hobert was very proud of his foresight. With this physique, the Tang blade and the two-handed sword are very good weapons.
The only thing to pay attention to may be that he doesn't have the defensive means of a "Dawn Paladin." He has to be careful when charging.
Although there are no defensive means, he can "distort" the enemy's attack target to avoid injury.
After knowing all his current abilities, Hobert sighed, reaching Sequence 6 has improved his strength in all aspects by a whole level compared to Sequence 7.
Take the "Baron of Corruption" as an example. To sneak attack, there is "Corrosion"; to fight Beyonder abilities with the opponent, there are "Bribery" and "Distortion"; to fight in close combat, there is a strong physique.
And the "Lawyer" path has always been known for its mental defense, and the previous shortcomings have been basically covered up by the advantages.
Hobert recalled the ambush war against the Feysac Empire's extraordinary people that he had seen through Elliott. No wonder the Sequence 5s who participated in the battle were at the forefront, because their power was the strongest in the team, enough to disrupt the formation of the carriage.
After a short rest, Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" to see the changes in the "Nation of Disorder."
After sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert first saw the blurry figure in the pool struggling to climb out of the pool.
Hobert has become stronger, and the blurry figure has also become clearer. In addition to being able to see the face clearly, it is a handsome young man, and it can be seen that he is about twenty years old.
This time, Hobert discovered that his goal was the "Iron Throne" under his butt. The pool was too close to the Iron Throne. Hobert felt the range he could control, and there was a small lake in the range.
Hobert simply threw the blurry figure into the lake at the foot of the mountain and used that lake to seal the blurry figure separately.
Next time he takes the potion, he must enter the "Nation of Disorder" as soon as possible, Hobert thought, otherwise he may never be able to enter.
Hobert did not think further about the identity of this blurry figure. He basically identified it as Trunsoest.
Sitting back on the "Iron Throne," Hobert felt that the range he could control had become much larger, and the power of the "Nation of Disorder" that he could mobilize had also increased several times.
By holding the "Black Emperor" card, there is no problem in grabbing a water pump into the "Nation of Disorder."
Hobert's consciousness turned around in his controllable territory. Suddenly, a crystal on the mountainside of another mountain attracted his attention.
Hobert got up from the "Iron Throne" and took a step to come to the crystal.
This crystal is the size of a desktop, and it is warm and moist in the dark, as beautiful as black jade, but its edges and corners are distinct, and it is indeed a black crystal.
Hobert put his hand on the crystal and immediately knew its ability: "It can make Beyonders less prone to losing control and less prone to being bewitched; without seeing the mythical creature form of the other party, they can directly face the whispers of angels; it can build a 'Wall of Order' to block some attacks from the spiritual or mental aspects; it has a strong anti-divination effect; it can build a closed cage to seal all the Beyonder things in the cage."
This... Hobert glanced at the black crystal again, this is a good thing! It already has the quality of Sequence 5, or even a demigod! Especially the ability of "not easy to lose control" is simply something that the Beyonder world dreams of!
And its ability to "not be easily bewitched" is like it was designed for the "Baron of Corruption."
Hobert estimated that after becoming the "Baron of Corruption," some vicious thoughts would often appear in his heart, and he was ready to fight those thoughts for a long time.
But with this black crystal, fighting these thoughts will no longer be a problem.
It is because the ability of the black crystal is very powerful, so it also has negative effects: "If it is held for more than twelve hours in total, the holder will inevitably become 'ordered'. The holder will lose all emotions, and even Beyonder powers will be blocked. The holder will become like a newborn baby. After resting for six hours, it can be held again."
Hobert smiled: "Restore factory settings?"
However, these negative effects will not have any effect on Hobert, the owner of the "Nation of Disorder," and Hobert can also use the black crystal as a medium to borrow the power of the "Nation of Disorder" in the real world in small amounts.
Although it can only be borrowed in small amounts, the high position of the power of the "Nation of Disorder" is completely Hobert's life-saving trump card.
