chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 248: Hobert becomes stronger
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert immediately decided that he must carry some of these black crystals with him.
Before deciding how to use them, the first step was to name them. After a moment's thought, Hobert named them "Order Crystals."
Then Hobert tried to deform and separate it, as he couldn't possibly carry a "Order Crystal" the size of a table around the world.
As Hobert expected, he could control the size, volume, and shape of this crystal.
So Hobert decided to use "Order Crystals" to make the hilts of the two weapons he was about to obtain.
Hobert separated two palm-sized "Order Crystals", preparing to take them out later.
In addition, Hobert also planned to make it into a small personal item. Soon Hobert had an idea: gentlemen in Backlund generally regarded top hats, formal attire, canes, and pocket watches as the "gentleman's quartet."
Besides this "quartet", there were two other small items that were symbols of a gentleman: a sealing wax stamp and a pocket watch key.
When sealing a letter or signing an agreement, sealing wax was usually dripped, and a stamp was placed on it while the wax was still hot. This stamp was called a sealing wax stamp.
Some people designed sealing wax stamps as rings or necklaces, but most gentlemen used the shape of a stamp and wore it with them.
The function of a pocket watch key was not to open the pocket watch, but to wind it. It was shaped like a ring about the thickness of a pencil, with a metal strip about the thickness of a wire, three or four centimeters long, below the ring.
The metal strip could be extended into the pocket watch, and then turning the ring would complete the winding process.
This was also one of the symbols of a gentleman. The key ring with the mystical effect of the Sun pathway that Carrie gave Hobert as a gift was not for hanging house keys, but for hanging pocket watch keys.
Generally, gentlemen would string the sealing wax stamp and pocket watch key together on a key ring and hang it on their waist.
Only classic pocket watches had pocket watch keys. Hobert's pocket watch belonged to a lower-end category, with the winding key on the side of the watch, without a dedicated pocket watch key, which is why he had never used that key ring.
But this did not prevent him from using "Order Crystals" to create a key for himself and hang it on his waist.
So Hobert "deducted" two more small pieces of "Order Crystal" and transformed them into the shape of a sealing wax stamp and a pocket watch key.
Next, Hobert thought of a new use for "Order Crystals": they could be used to hold sealed artifacts or magical items with negative effects.
As long as the sealed artifacts and magical items were sealed in "Order Crystals", it would not be considered a state of wearing them. They could be taken out for use when needed.
Even long-term wearing would not matter, because Hobert did not need to worry about the negative effects of "Order Crystals".
So Hobert "deducted" two more "Order Crystals", turning them into two small black boxes, and placed the "Teleportation Statue" and the "Error" pathway pocket watch in the small boxes respectively.
By the way, Hobert named the pocket watch "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch."
After doing all this, less than a tenth of the "Order Crystal" had been used. Hobert casually made a few masks, carving the symbol representing the "Creator" on the forehead of the masks.
He decided that the next time he saw Upton, he would wear a mask made of "Order Crystal", which would greatly enhance his image.
After playing with the "Order Crystal", Hobert turned his attention to the "Order Tree" not far away. He immediately felt that the ability of the "Order Tree" had been strengthened again.
As long as he was under the canopy of the "Order Tree", the power of Hobert's "Distortion" ability would be doubled, and there would be a high probability of "distorting" the actions and goals of a Sequence 5.
The "Uncontrollable Stone had also been strengthened accordingly, with the attack range varying from 3 meters to 8 meters. Hobert could adjust the attack range himself.
Because Hobert could now use "Order Crystals" as a medium to borrow the power of the "Nation of Disorder", he could freely change the shape of the "Order Tree" and the "Uncontrollable Stone" even in the outside world.
Hobert reached out and broke off another branch of the "Order Tree" for later use.
Even without using the "Teleportation Statue" and other magical items, relying solely on the "Order Tree", "Stone of Insanity", and "Order Crystal", Hobert felt that he could walk sideways among Sequence 6s.
After understanding his new abilities after promotion, Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder" and brought everything he could use to the real world in the way he bestowed upon himself.
Returning to his room, Hobert first found the key ring Carrie gave him, then strung the sealing wax stamp and pocket watch key made of "Order Crystal" on the key ring and hung it on his waist.
Hobert opened his pocket watch and looked at it. The Tarot Gathering and promotion had kept him busy all afternoon. It was already past five in the afternoon.
He went to the first floor and saw that Fors had indeed returned. The two chatted while making dinner.
Suddenly, Hobert thought of the idea he had during the promotion. He couldn't help but shake his head and smile. Could that be the thought suppressed deep in my heart?
Hobert inconspicuously sized up Fors. Her figure was indeed quite something, but then Hobert restrained the thought of continuing to think about it.
Because he knew that this was the idea that the "corrosion" ability brought by the potion made him have. He recalled his true thoughts. The family's curse put so much pressure on him that he really didn't have much mind and energy to fall in love.
But he didn't rule out contact with beautiful women, after all, beautiful things always pleased the mind and body.
Hobert sighed again: when corrupting other people's minds, one must first avoid one's own mind being corrupted.
At seven o'clock in the evening, Xio, who had been out early and returned late, also came back. The three of them sat around the dining table, and Hobert took out three VIP tickets for the Roselle Memorial Exhibition: "A friend gave me these. Let's go to the memorial exhibition together tomorrow?"
He had been a little busy last week, and Hobert hadn't had time to show his magnanimity to the "Machinery Hivemind". His team was now on track, so starting this week, Hobert had some time of his own.
Fors took the ticket: "Oh my god, they are VIP tickets! Thank you, Hobert. I have long wanted to see that man full of poetry."
Hobert didn't know what expression to use for a moment: Okay, okay, copied poetry is also poetry.
Xio also said that there were no urgent tasks recently and that she could go out for a walk.
After dinner, Hobert took the "Order Tree" and "Order Crystal" he had prepared earlier and took a carriage to Jessica and Carrie's residence.
According to the previous agreement, the Tang sword and the two-handed sword would be finished today.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 249: Winning over the Artisan
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Carrie and Jessica lived in the factory district. They rented a small workshop, with the two of them living on the second floor and Carrie's studio on the first floor.
The first floor was divided into two rooms, a smaller one in the front for reception, and Carrie worked in the larger room in the back.
The reception room was relatively tidy, obviously Jessica often tidied it up. As for the studio in the back, Hobert only glanced at it before pulling his head back.
Messy! Too messy. Hobert estimated that even if a careless thief patronized this place, they would give up the idea of stealing because there was really no place to stand.
Carrie was still working away, and Jessica received Hobert. She smiled apologetically and said, "Sorry, Carrie tends to ignore everything around her when she's working."
Hobert nodded, no wonder the two of them teamed up.
Jessica is currently only Sequence 9, too weak, and has no way to make a living in the Beyonder world.
And Carrie is obviously a person who is devoted to her inner world. Such people easily become artists or have extremely high achievements in a certain aspect, but at the same time, such people are often terrible in terms of life.
So the two of them complemented each other's strengths and became friends who depended on each other.
As Jessica spoke, she took out two boxes, one long and one short, from under the long table and placed them on the table and opened them.
The black Tang sword and two-handed sword lay quietly in the boxes. Even without holding them, Hobert could feel the chilling aura of the two weapons and the trembling fear that they constantly exuded.
Jessica introduced, "Carrie has praised more than once that this is the best material she has ever encountered. She also said that these two weapons are her most satisfying works so far."
She picked up the knife and handed it to Hobert: "Since the two weapons are made of the same material, their effects are similar.
"First of all, this Tang sword, it will constantly make the enemy involuntarily fear. The spirit body of the person who is cut by it will also be damaged. If spiritual treatment is not done, even if it is just a small cut, the spiritual body will gradually weaken, be damaged, and die within three days of the injury. The more severe the opponent's injury, the faster the spirit body weakens.
"It can also block weapons manifested by Beyonder abilities, and it can easily cause damage to armor or other defensive means composed of Beyonder abilities. This seems to be more restrained against the Beyonders of the 'Warrior' pathway. Most importantly, these abilities are permanent."
Hobert took the Tang sword in his hand. It was about 1.2 meters long, black, and exuded a cold light, seemingly indestructible.
He suddenly waved the Tang sword, the blade cut through the air, producing a sword sound, which sounded very pleasant.
Hobert smiled and nodded, putting down the Tang sword: "Feels good."
Jessica picked up the two-handed sword with both hands: "The two-handed sword has a very terrifying ability on the basis of the Tang sword: death!"
Hobert was stunned: "Death?"
"Yes, specifically, it has a very small probability of directly sending the opponent's spirit body into the underworld, which is equivalent to letting the opponent die directly. Even if a relatively powerful Beyonder encounters the attack of the 'death' ability, the spirit body will also be greatly damaged."
Hobert took the two-handed sword, which was more than twice as heavy as the Tang sword and had to be held with both hands.
Although there is only a very small probability, this Beyonder power is extreme!
He recalled the two-handed sword usage videos he had watched in the Common Era, holding the sword with both hands and stabbing and slashing forward, also making a dull sword sound.
With the blessing of the "Fighting Ring", he easily mastered the use of the two-handed sword.
Jessica on the side said, "This is the first time I've seen you use this kind of long sword, but it looks very mighty."
Hobert smiled. He was quite satisfied with both weapons: "Can you help me remove the hilt and the handle?"
Jessica was slightly stunned before saying, "Yes."
As she spoke, she closed the wooden box and took it to the studio inside.
The ping-pong sounds stopped, and Hobert heard the voices of two people communicating. Before long, the hilt and handle were removed.
Carrie, wearing a leather apron, also came out. Her cheeks were flushed, she was covered in sweat, and her hair was casually styled. She looked even more rough than a young man: "Are you not satisfied with my hilt?"
"No," Hobert said with a smile, "I just found a better hilt."
He didn't avoid Carrie and Jessica, took out the two "Order Crystals", and with a casual pinch, the Tang sword and the two-handed sword successively changed to new hilts and handles.
Then Hobert picked up the Tang sword, put the cane on the Tang sword, and Hobert used the fire lacquer seal made of "Order Crystal" as a medium to use the power of "Nation of Disorder" to deform the cane. The wooden cane was like It's like having life, wrapping the blade, and then the crystal-like handle also changed shape.
The overall appearance became a long cane with a black crystal head.
A normal cane is about one meter long, and the cane in Hobert's hand has reached about one meter and three, which looks a bit long, but not very abrupt.
Then he repeated his old trick, turning the "Order Wood" just taken out of the "Nation of Disorder" into a scabbard for the two-handed sword.
Carrie and Jessica's eyes had long been straight, and Carrie sighed: "The materials in your hand are so advanced that they are completely beyond my imagination."
Hobert smiled and said, "I can introduce Jessica to a Beyonder gathering, where it is possible to trade for very good materials, but that gathering needs to be kept secret, and the participants and some content cannot be revealed."
The reason why he showed the "Order Wood" and "Order Crystal" so generously was to win over Carrie.
As Carrie herself said, wild "artisans" are rare. Everyone treats them like treasures, and Hobert is naturally no exception.
Jessica immediately agreed: "I can also sell Carrie's weapons at that gathering."
By the way, she asked for the potion formula of the "Barbarian" she needed.
Hobert asked casually: "Do you have any other weapons in your hands?"
"Yes." Jessica took out another wooden box from under the long table: "Hurricane Axe."
She opened the box: "Because we are moving, we only have two weapons left in our hands."
Hobert saw a double-sided axe. It was iron black, thick and strong, with sharp blades. Hobert could feel the spirituality emanating from the axe all the time.
Isn't this the weapon of "Little Sun"! Oh, it seems that it hasn't been bought by Klein yet.
Jessica introduced: "It can increase the user's movement frequency and running speed, and has a 15% chance of causing a certain degree of paralysis to the enemy, and a 5% chance of creating a lightning bolt. If used in a thunderstorm, the frequency of lightning appearance can be increased to 50%."
Hobert sighed in his heart, this is completely a weapon made for "Little Sun".
Then Jessica introduced another weapon called "Slow Whip". Hobert shook his head and had no desire to buy it. As for the "Hurricane Axe", let's leave it to Klein and let him complete the transaction with "Little Sun".
Hobert asked: "When will you negotiate with those people?"
"Tomorrow," Carrie said, "Tomorrow night in an abandoned workshop in the suburbs."
Hobert nodded: "I see."
Then he asked the question that had been hidden in his heart for a long time: "Beyonder weapons, what is the difference between them and the magical items that are made?"

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 250: Rich Hobert
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert knew that, generally speaking, mystical items were divided into two types: those formed "naturally" and those crafted by "Artisans."
The so-called "natural" formation is basically the product of Beyonders losing control. This process is very likely to create sealed items with significant negative effects, and only a small probability of obtaining mystical items with less negative effects.
Currently, most "mystical items" in the Beyonder world come from the hands of "Artisans," which is why wild "Artisans" are so sought after.
However, Hobert had always been somewhat unclear about the positioning of Beyonder weapons.
The three of them sat on the sofa, drinking tea, and discussing this topic.
Mainly, it was Carrie who was speaking: "The simplest distinction between Beyonder weapons and mystical items is that Beyonder weapons are made by adding spiritual materials or Beyonder materials, while mystical items are made using Beyonder characteristics.
"Another significant difference is that Beyonder weapons generally have a limited lifespan because, over time, the spirituality attached to the materials will gradually dissipate, whereas mystical items do not have such limitations."
She organized her thoughts and continued, "Additionally, the crafting methods differ. Beyonder weapons involve adding materials sequentially during the forging process.
"The crafting method for mystical items is called 'embedding.' It involves using spiritual materials to fuse the abilities of Beyonder characteristics with items like rings or necklaces, allowing users to use the abilities of Beyonder characteristics by simply channeling spirituality into them."
Hobert nodded and asked, "Then, is there a fixed order when adding spiritual materials during the creation of these weapons?"
"You can think of a Beyonder weapon as a continuously usable talisman," Carrie further explained. "The process of adding materials certainly has a certain order, but there is no fixed 'formula.' It is directly related to the artisan's knowledge, experience, the characteristics of spirituality, and so on. It can be said to vary from person to person."
Without Hobert asking further, Carrie herself lamented, "Generally, only the Church of Steam and Machinery has the strength to cultivate 'artisans' skilled in making mystical items. Even if 'artisans' without crafting experience listen to a lot of theory, the negative effects of their first few works will definitely be terrifyingly high.
"For wild Beyonders, the cost is too high. Even a Sequence 9 Beyonder characteristic costs three to four hundred pounds. If the negative effects are too high, it's better to sell the Beyonder characteristic.
"However, 'artisans' like us without a church background also have our own way of survival. The price of spiritual materials is much lower than the price of Beyonder materials or Beyonder characteristics.
"It just requires some experimentation to give the weapon extraordinary effects, and this trial-and-error process is also a cost."
Hobert curiously asked, "Since it's a continuously usable talisman, do you need to pray to relevant deities for power during the crafting process?"
"No need," Carrie said. "You only need to use materials from the relevant domain. I am a follower of the God of Steam and Machinery, so even if I pray to other deities for power, I won't receive a response."
She paused and added, "My personal understanding is that although deities have corresponding authority, corresponding spirituality and power also remain relatively free in the natural world.
"As long as you use the right spiritual materials and the timing of using the materials is just right, you can obtain the corresponding power from the natural world."
This answer made Hobert realize that although deities have corresponding authority over a certain domain, they can only control the corresponding power within a certain area and cannot constantly hold the corresponding power of the entire universe or even the entire earth in their hands.
Hobert finally asked, "Can Beyonder materials also be used to make Beyonder weapons?"
Spiritual materials include "Summer Leaf Grass" and "Sleepless Flower," "Moon Flower" and "Deep Sleep Grass." All four are spiritual materials of the "Darkness" pathway.
The difference is that the former two have extremely high spirituality and are generally only used in important rituals, making them difficult to buy in ordinary herbal shops.
The latter two are ordinary spiritual herbs. Gar's herbal shop mainly deals in these types of materials, and ordinary people can easily buy them.
Beyonder materials refer to the main materials for preparing potions, as well as most auxiliary materials. Sequences below Sequence 6 and many auxiliary materials are spiritual materials, such as various colors of mandrake flowers and juices, dragon blood grass powder, and so on.
"Yes," Carrie replied. "Beyonder materials make it more likely for weapons to gain mystical effects, and the general extraordinary effects are also stronger, but the cost is also higher, and it's not something I can afford.
"There is also a material like the 'Black Iron' you gave me. This is the material most loved by 'artisans' because it inherently possesses extraordinary effects. No matter what weapon it is forged into, it will possess corresponding extraordinary power."
Hobert considered for a few seconds before saying, "If I provide you with some Beyonder materials, can you help me forge a few Beyonder weapons?"
"It's possible, but I can't guarantee the probability of success."
"It doesn't matter. The cost is on me. If it succeeds, I will also pay you a labor fee."
Carrie was slightly stunned. "For me, this is a good opportunity to accumulate experience. Of course, I will agree.
"But I still have to remind you that I can't guarantee the probability of success. Perhaps it will take two identical Sequence 8 materials to test and make mistakes before a weapon worth about 1,000 pounds can be produced on the third forging.
"The cost of three materials will require 1,000 pounds, or even more, and corresponding spiritual materials and so on are also needed. Even if you don't pay me a labor fee, you will lose money."
Hobert smiled and said, "You don't have to worry about this. Since you are willing, we will establish a long-term cooperative relationship in the future."
Having established the cooperative relationship between the two parties, Hobert drank all the tea in front of him, picked up the wooden box containing the two-handed sword, and got up to say goodbye.
When he reached the door, Hobert remembered to inform Jessica that he would take half a day off tomorrow.
Hobert did not immediately return to Blanca Street but instead asked the carriage to go to the freight train station on the edge of the city.
In the carriage, Hobert was in a good mood. In addition to establishing a cooperative relationship with Carrie, he also learned about the process of "artisans" making Beyonder weapons and mystical items.
Theoretically speaking, every Beyonder can use their own spirituality and related materials to create mystical items or extraordinary weapons.
It's just that the probability of success for Beyonders who are not on the "Artisan" pathway is very low, and the negative effects of the mystical items they create may be equivalent to sealed items, making it better to directly use Beyonder characteristics.
In Hobert's random thoughts, he came to the freight train station again.
...
Grov, the night watchman at the train station, became a laughing stock in the eyes of his colleagues. His colleagues believed that he must have seen it wrong. How could a locomotive weighing about ten tons fly up for no reason?
Fortunately, however, Grov's report attracted the attention of the train station manager, who believed that someone was using some unknown method to steal the locomotive, so he assigned Grov a partner to patrol the night together.
That night, when they patrolled to the location of the small locomotive again, Grov immediately stood there motionless when he saw the scene in front of him because he saw the familiar firelight again.
Woo ~
It was that familiar gale again.
The two night watchmen saw the small locomotive slowly rising.

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 251 Meeting Klein by Chance (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[100 powerstone chapter]
Having had a similar experience before, Grov wasn't as scared as last time. He glanced at his companion, as if to say: Now do you believe me?
Grov's companion, however, was completely dumbfounded, watching the little train engine "float" into the air, and finally disappear.
A dozen seconds later, his companion finally reacted: "Quick, quick, go get someone..."
The train engine was really stolen!
Grov didn't expect this time, how did the train engine disappear? Last time, it just "floated" in the air for a while before falling back down.
The two hurriedly went back to get people, and soon brought seven or eight guards.
But everyone found that the little train engine was right there, perfectly fine! Where did it float into the air? Where did it disappear to?
Just as the other guards were about to accuse Grov and his companion, one of the guards discovered: "Why is the train engine outside the tracks?"
Everyone took a closer look, and indeed, the train engine, which was originally parked on the tracks, had its wheels shifted slightly to the side, causing the little train engine to derail.
If it had been moved back and forth, it might have been pushed by Grov and his companion, but moving it left and right was a different story! Even if the two of them were strong, they couldn't have moved the train engine horizontally off the tracks.
The guards looked at each other, one of them said: "I'll report to the manager!"
The others also reacted, quickly left the little train engine, they felt a chill down their spines, and walked faster and faster, finally breaking into a run!
So the next day, the haunting of the freight train station was confirmed, and the "Machinery Hivemind" even sent two members to investigate.
...
Tuesday morning, Hobert, Fors and Xio were chatting and laughing while eating breakfast. Going to work after breakfast is a completely different mood than going out for a walk after breakfast.
The three had changed their clothes and were about to go out when Audrey's personal maid came to deliver a letter.
They got into the carriage and opened their letters. The content was similar. Audrey hoped to organize a "Justice League" gathering on Friday, and she mentioned in the letter that she would introduce a new member to the group.
Hobert thought, could it be that she's going to introduce Susie? Just imagining Susie sitting behind Audrey and speaking, there's a strange sense of comedy.
The three of them arrived at the Roselle Memorial Exhibition Hall together, and Hobert even greeted a member of the "Machinery Hivemind" he knew.
This member quickly reported the matter to Captain Ikanser, the Steam and Machinery Church's investigation into Emperor Roselle's "Creative Manuscript" is still ongoing.
Hobert, who had been there that morning, was of course also a suspect of the "Machinery Hivemind", but he was far behind in the list of suspects. Holamick and Ikanser didn't focus their attention on him, just checked as a matter of routine.
Ikanser heard that Hobert had visited the exhibition hall again, and didn't take it too seriously. After all, Hobert had said before that he was very interested in the set of mysterious symbols invented by Emperor Roselle.
However, subconsciously, Ikanser had basically ruled out Hobert's suspicion.
Hobert in the exhibition hall didn't know that his purpose had been achieved, he was still considering when to come again next time, he had to use up all the free tickets.
While absentmindedly listening to the commentator's explanation, Hobert was making plans in his mind, when suddenly he saw a familiar figure in the study area.
Although he deliberately grew a beard and wore glasses, Hobert recognized him at a glance.
It was Klein, who was carefully studying the exhibits in the study area. He had just thought, could Roselle have placed a "Blasphemy Card" openly in his study?
Just looking for it, Klein's spirituality sensed something, turned his head and saw Hobert smiling at him.
Hobert hadn't changed, he still liked to wear windbreakers, although it didn't look gentlemanly enough, it suited Hobert's temperament.
Another change was that Hobert's cane seemed to be longer.
Klein remembered very clearly that Hobert's cane could turn into an "Order Tree"!
Since they met here, Hobert said to Fors and Xio: "I met an acquaintance, I'll go say hello."
The two ladies who were concentrating on listening to the commentator's explanation, one said "Oh", and the other waved her hand to indicate that she knew.
Hobert and Klein came to a corner of the exhibition hall with tacit understanding. Today is a working day, and the memorial exhibition has been open for a while, so there are not many tourists.
There were also a few other gentlemen or ladies who met acquaintances, chatting aside like Hobert and Klein, their actions were not conspicuous.
Hobert asked with a smile: "Are you used to life in Backlund?"
"It's okay." Klein smiled: "Except for seeing the sun for only five minutes every day, and the feeling of dampness and cold, there's nothing else I'm not used to."
"This sarcastic tone is very much like a Backlund gentleman." Hobert smiled: "I was just trying to find a way to find you, I didn't expect to meet you here."
That's the truth, he planned to complete the commission this week, earn the bounty, and buy a sealed artifact with "Travel" abilities, hoping that Heyman hadn't left Loen.
Hobert whispered: "I have a commission here, to capture a member of an extremist organization, the bounty is 800 pounds, the strength is 8, but I think it might be 7 now.
"Of course, I think he will definitely resist arrest, so I will simply kill him, so I can earn more income, how about it? Are you interested in completing this commission with me?"
Although he made a small disguise in his words, Klein could completely understand.
Klein, who was also worried about money, agreed after a little thought. First of all, he knew that Hobert was already Sequence 7. A Sequence 7 plus a Sequence 8, if it was a sneak attack, it was not dangerous to deal with a Sequence 7 at all, unless the target of the capture had helpers.
Secondly, in Klein's view, Hobert was a relatively trustworthy person. After all, they had fought together, and he had also seen his deeds in the newspaper.
Seeing Klein agree, Hobert nodded and said: "Okay, then how about we meet here again tomorrow morning? I have an item he often uses, and you will be responsible for finding him then.
"After finding him, I'll charge and you'll cover. I'll take 50 pounds of the mission's income as an information fee, and we'll split the rest."
Klein nodded and said: "No problem."
Then he asked: "Do you have a channel to get mystical weapons? Weapons for men."
Hobert was stunned, then smiled and said: "I just saw a weapon last night, called 'Hurricane Axe'."
He thought to himself, this can't be blamed on me, you asked yourself.
Then Hobert briefly described the effect of the "Hurricane Axe".
Klein's thoughts were similar to Hobert's, the "Forsaken Land" was the best destination for the "Hurricane Axe", he asked again: "How much is it?"
Hobert recalled: "Within 600 pounds, I should be able to get a 10% discount with my name."

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 252 Bernadette's Outfit
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After finishing the serious business, Hobert and Klein bid farewell to each other like other gentlemen.
Continuing the tour, Hobert passed by the living area when leaving, and a woman with long chestnut hair and a perfect figure attracted Hobert's attention.
Her eyebrows were very distinctive, always stretched to the end, adding some majesty to her temperament, making her look very capable, like a leader of a large department.
In addition to her beautiful appearance and outstanding temperament, it was also because her clothes were out of tune with the surroundings. She was wearing beige trousers that were easy to move around in, and a pair of long black leather boots, with a light brown knee-length skirt on her upper body, which was very different from the conservative dressing style of the Kingdom of Loen.
Even Xio sighed that such a combination of trousers and boots should be very convenient to move around in.
In Backlund, women with middle and upper incomes basically wear various skirts, and the only relatively lightweight clothing is the knight's uniform that Xio wears.
Hobert remembered that Xio had many similar knight's uniforms, not because she liked them so much, but because only this kind of clothing was convenient to move around in Backlund.
Ladies think that trousers are not ladylike enough, so there is no market for ladies' trousers in the entire Loen.
The woman with outstanding temperament and dress seemed to feel the gazes of Hobert and others.
She only glanced at Hobert and others with her peripheral vision, and then continued to look at the building blocks in the living area.
After leaving the exhibition hall, Hobert belatedly realized that it wouldn't be "Huang Beibei", would it?
It's not that Hobert was slow to react, but in his concept, Bernadette was the daughter of "Huang Tao", and her "Uncle Zhou" looked only twenty-four or five years old even with a beard.
So in Hobert's subconscious, Bernadette should be about the same age as Donna, or even younger than Donna.
After all, Hobert is also an "uncle", he is only 23 years old this year. When he thinks of Bernadette, he always feels that she is only about twenty years old.
When he saw the twenty-seven or eight-year-old lady in the living area with a mature temperament, he didn't think of Bernadette at all.
But thinking back, chestnut hair, a perfect figure, and avant-garde and unique dress, who else could it be but Bernadette?
"Hobert, we're leaving first!" Xio, who stepped onto the public carriage, said to Hobert, who was obviously a little dazed.
Hobert came back to his senses: "See you tonight, oh, no, I have a social engagement tonight, no need to prepare my dinner. See you tomorrow!"
Watching the public carriage leave, Hobert shook his head with a smile.
Even if he recognizes Bernadette, going up to strike up a conversation now is likely to be beaten up as a rogue.
Bernadette definitely has such strength.
Hobert thought, even if he racked his brains to successfully strike up a conversation with Bernadette, it is impossible to borrow the "Genie" immediately.
[T/N: Genie recognizes his own Sefirah, bad idea]
Let's wait for a chance in the future to have a more natural interaction with her, Hobert thought: lest Bernadette have a bad impression of him, which will affect the process of borrowing the "Genie" later.
After watching a commemorative exhibition at noon, Hobert returned to the law firm to continue working in the afternoon.
At three or four o'clock, Hobert received a reply from Elizabeth, saying that she and Selena, as well as Melissa and Benson, would come to Backlund together this weekend.
The letter did not mention other content, so Hobert unfolded the letter paper and wrote a short reply. It roughly said that he knew, and asked Elizabeth to send him a telegram after purchasing the tickets, so that he could go to the station to pick them up.
After get off work, Hobert took a carriage with Jessica to her and Carrie's residence.
Carrie was packing her things in the studio. Jessica went to the restaurant to buy three simple meals. After the three finished eating, they found a taxi carriage to go to the suburbs.
While still on the road, it was already dark. When they arrived at the agreed abandoned workshop, a layer of thin mist had already appeared in the cold air of early winter.
The other party had already arrived first. As Carrie described, there were four of them, and they were all Beyonders.
The four people's eyes almost all looked at Hobert at the same time. Obviously, they did not expect Carrie to bring other people.
The workshop was very empty, with some waste piled in the corners. There was only a table in the middle and an oil lamp. The four of them were already sitting on the inner side.
Jessica, who was walking at the end, closed the door smoothly. Hobert and the other two sat on the side near the door. Hobert deliberately sat on the left, giving the middle position to Carrie.
"I didn't expect you to bring other people. This is against the rules," the other party's leader, John, said.
On the carriage, Carrie introduced Hobert. The other party's leader was called John, Sequence 7 was called Alex, and Carrie didn't know what the two Sequence 8s were called.
As for names like John and Alex, they sound like fake names.
"You have four people, and we only have two," Jessica explained for Carrie: "With one more person, we can feel more at ease."
"Okay." John, who was in his forties and tall and strong, said with a fake smile: "I hope this friend can keep it a secret."
Only dead people can truly keep secrets. No, in the mystical world, dead people may not be able to keep secrets. You have to remember to dispose of the corpse.
John had already made up his mind that no matter whether Carrie was willing or not, he would turn her into a member of the organization today.
And Carrie came to refuse to join their organization, so the conversation stalled from the beginning.
John quickly lost his patience. He sneered at Carrie and said, "You don't think that you have the confidence to refuse us just because you found a gigolo, do you?"
Hobert finally opened his mouth and said, "Theoretically speaking, yes."
John shook his head with a smile: "Okay, okay, say whatever you want."
He no longer concealed it: "Today Carrie must join us. As for you two, you can also join us. If you don't join, hehe~"
John had already done his research. Although Carrie has Sequence 6, she is not good at fighting, and Jessica only has Sequence 9.
As for the helpers they found, they are likely to be Sequence 7, at most Sequence 6.
Among the wild Beyonders, Sequence 6 helpers are hard to find. Of course, "Artisans" are an exception. After all, when they encounter difficulties, everyone wants to help, and with friendship, it will be easier to entrust "Artisan" to build weapons for themselves in the future.
But even if this helper is Sequence 6, John is not afraid. They have four people and are experienced in combat.
Even if they are not sure of killing this helper, they are fully confident of defeating or driving the opponent away. By the time this helper finds more helpers, they will have already taken Carrie away from Backlund.
Hobert asked, "Is there no room for negotiation?"
"No!" John said decisively.
Hobert smiled and said, "That's easy. It just so happens that I'm short of money recently. You've come to my door. I want to thank you!"
Before John had time to say anything, he heard the "Provoker" among the two Sequence 8s say to the other Sequence 8, "Mary was blind to fall in love with a fool like you. I'm going to rescue her from your hands!"
The other Sequence 8 also refused to be outdone and said, "I've wanted to dig out your eyes for a long time. Did you think I didn't notice your disgusting eyes when you faced Mary?"
For half a second, John wanted to reprimand his two subordinates, not to see what time it was, wouldn't you be afraid of being ashamed of your little things?
But then he reacted, quickly jumped away from the table, this "gigolo's" offensive had already begun!

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 253: Knife Testing
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert used "Corrosion" for the first time, lacking experience, so he used it on two Sequence 8s.
It took effect in about four or five seconds. He successfully made the two people gradually become gloomy and greedy, and they couldn't bear it anymore, erupting on the spot.
As John reacted, Hobert ejected the "Disorder Stone" he had been holding in his hand: "Distortion!"
An invisible "Force of Distortion" exploded within a 3-meter radius in front of him. Even though John jumped away in time, he was still within the attack range of the "Disorder Stone."
One of the two Sequence 8s began to lose control on the spot, while the muscles of the other swelled, already on the verge of losing control.
Sequence 7, Alex, rolled and crawled, trying to keep himself away from the "Disorder Stone," while John's face was also ashen, and a dawn-like light immediately appeared on his body, which made his complexion much better.
This was a Sequence 6 "Dawn Paladin" of the "Warrior" pathway.
Throwing out the "Disorder Stone" was also equivalent to completing the bribery process: "Weaken!"
The dawn light on John's body dimmed, and the "Sword of Dawn" that was about to condense disappeared like a firework that suddenly fizzled out.
However, his "Armor of Dawn" had already condensed, and the light of dawn greatly offset the "Weakened" state.
After shouting "Weaken," Hobert kicked the table, originally wanting to chase Alex, but although this guy's posture of running away was ugly, he ran very fast and was about to crawl to John's feet.
So Hobert quickly made a choice, rushed forward a few steps, and first solved the Sequence 8 who had begun to lose control with one strike.
He made this choice because although John's current state was very bad, it would be difficult to deal with him for a while.
And these Sequence 8s who had begun to lose control, if they completely lost control and turned into monsters, would indiscriminately attack everyone in the room.
Judging from Carrie's posture, it was obvious that she hadn't fought much. By then, she and Jessica might not be able to kill the out-of-control monster.
So Hobert chose to solve the Sequence 8 who had just begun to lose control, leaving the other Sequence 8, whose condition was already very bad, for Carrie and Jessica to deal with.
"Good blade!" Hobert exclaimed.
With this strike, Hobert chopped off half of the opponent's head along with a shoulder, and he didn't feel much resistance!
Hobert aimed accurately and threw another "Disorder Stone" at John and Alex: "Distortion!"
John finally condensed a seemingly thin "Sword of Dawn." Although the negative state on his body was still very serious, he still reacted quickly, stepped forward, and used the "Sword of Dawn" to swat the "Disorder Stone" back.
Hobert's eyes narrowed, and he quickly used the fire-lacquered seal on his waist as a medium to mobilize the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to retrieve the power contained in this "Disorder Stone."
Even so, Hobert was still not at ease and used the Tang blade to knock the "Disorder Stone" into a corner of the abandoned factory.
Hobert's tactical error allowed John to regain some initiative. He stepped forward again and slashed at Hobert with the "Sword of Dawn."
Although the opponent's "Sword of Dawn" was relatively thin, a body of flesh and blood could not withstand such a slash.
"Distortion!" This time, it was Hobert's Beyonder power, "Distortion."
Because John's condition was not very good, Hobert successfully "Distorted" the opponent's attack target, and then stabbed forward, preparing to pierce John's "Armor of Dawn."
But what Hobert didn't expect was that the opponent's reaction speed was extremely fast, and he dodged Hobert's offensive very easily.
Hobert attacked continuously, but the opponent's reaction was very agile, completely unlike a 1.9-meter-tall strong man.
This made Hobert sigh in his heart: I said before that I could fight head-on with a "Dawn Knight," but now that I think about it, it was really boastful. Fighting a "Warrior" in close combat is simply courting death!
Hobert believed that if John was in his prime, he might have been forced into a corner by him.
So Hobert immediately changed his tactics: "Madness!"
John opened his mouth wide, his face full of surprise, and the madness in his heart surged out like a spring, causing him to temporarily lose his mind!
Good opportunity!
Hobert swept his blade horizontally, preparing to break through the opponent's "Armor of Dawn."
At this moment, his spirituality suddenly sensed danger coming from his side. At the same time, Hobert felt that his legs could not move.
He opened his spiritual vision and saw a pale-faced undead tightly hugging his legs.
Whoosh ~
The ground on one side suddenly became illusory, and three skeletons with golden skeletons drilled out from inside.
These three skeletons, one wielding a war hammer, one wielding a battle axe, and one wielding a two-handed greatsword, charged towards Hobert.
Looking at Alex again, he didn't know when, but the whites of his eyes had all turned black, and there was no life in his pupils, like a dead person, standing there blankly.
Alex was the only one who had a chance to catch his breath just now. He had now recovered some of his strength, so he quickly summoned some undead to fight for him.
Usually, when Alex fights, the limit is summoning four ordinary undead, or two ordinary natural spirits, but he wouldn't dare to move like this.
Today, it was because his condition was very poor, so he didn't dare to move, fearing that if he moved, he would interrupt the connection with the underworld, causing the skeletons and undead to lose their source of power.
The skeleton wielding the battle axe stood in front of Carrie, fighting back and forth with Carrie.
Jessica behind Carrie took out a soft whip from the pocket on her waist. Every time she waved it, she wrapped a thin thread around the skeleton's body. After waving it more than a dozen times, the skeleton's movements had slowed down a lot.
On the other side, Hobert had broken free. The Tang blade in his hand was made of top-quality materials from the "Death" pathway. With a casual slash, under the suppression of the position, the bones of the two golden skeletons trembled all over, and their attacks also turned into slow motion.
Hobert raised his blade and stabbed downwards, and the undead hugging his legs immediately fled back to the underworld.
Although Sequence 7 "Spirit Medium" can summon undead to fight for them, the undead, when they feel fatal, oh, no, they are already dead… …
But the undead, when they feel danger, will not hesitate to disobey the "Spirit Medium's" orders.
Hobert swung his blade at the two golden skeletons again. Because the skeletons had no intelligence, they had been executing the "Spirit Medium's" orders.
As a result, one skeleton directly fell apart in trembling, and the skeleton wielding the two-handed greatsword tried hard to withstand Hobert's Tang blade, but the sword in its hand quickly turned black and turned directly into dust.
Hobert kicked over and kicked the skeleton apart as well.
Alex fell to the ground with a pale face and covered in sweat. He felt the suppression of the blade in the "pretty boy's" hand on him.
Fortunately, his desperate struggle just now allowed John to recover from the "Madness" state.
The expression on John's face was still a bit distorted, but after the recovery just now, the "Sword of Dawn" in his hand was more solid, and he raised the "Sword of Dawn" and rushed towards Hobert.
Hobert simply stuck the blade in the ground, quickly opened the black small box in his coat pocket, and a classic pocket watch fell into his hand. His other hand grabbed forward.
The "Sword of Dawn" in John's hand suddenly disappeared and appeared in Hobert's hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 254 This is Sequence 6
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
John hadn't fully regained his senses. He suddenly swung forward, as if slamming a ball of air in front of Hobert.
Hobert's "Sword of Dawn" disappeared quickly because it lacked a power source, but John couldn't re-summon it for the next ten minutes.
At the same time, Hobert also sensed a limitation of the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch." In combat, its success rate for stealing an enemy's Beyonder power the first time was very high, but the probability of stealing the same enemy's ability a second time dropped sharply.
This wasn't exactly a negative effect, but more of a limitation. Hobert estimated that a true Sequence 5 "Dream Stealer" should have a similar restriction, except perhaps with a high probability of "stealing" from the same target two or three times, after which the probability would decrease significantly.
Otherwise, if there were no restrictions, they would definitely steal all of their enemies' abilities from the start, and they would have become invincible long ago.
If he couldn't steal Beyonder abilities, it didn't matter; he could still steal John's thoughts.
When John realized his hands were empty, Hobert seized the opportunity to steal his thoughts. John, who hadn't completely recovered his senses, stood there stunned, his mind suddenly blank.
Hobert seized the opportunity, drew his blade, and finally broke through John's "Armor of Dawn."
At the same time, John reacted and quickly jumped back, trying to re-summon the "Sword of Dawn," but he couldn't manage it.
Similarly, stealing thoughts had a similar limitation to stealing abilities, so Hobert injected his spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon" again: "Madness!"
In fact, "Madness" couldn't be used continuously; it had to be spaced two or three seconds apart to use it a second time.
Hobert's own abilities, "Bribery" and "Distortion," were the same. There had to be a few seconds between uses, and after using "Weakening" on a target, he couldn't use "Weakening" on them again until the effect disappeared.
However, two "Barons of Corruption" could "weaken" the same enemy simultaneously.
After reaching Sequence 6, as Hobert's own Beyonder power types increased, he could completely avoid the "cooldown time" by adjusting the order in which he used his abilities.
When John heard the word "Madness" again, the light of dawn on his body became very bright. This ability blocked any Beyonder abilities.
So this time, "Madness" was far less effective than last time. John still retained some sanity. He retreated while re-summoning his "Armor of Dawn."
Hobert pursued him closely, successfully cutting John's chest.
At the same time, John re-summoned his "Armor of Dawn," and he had basically escaped the state of "Madness."
At this point, the effects of "Weakening" and the "Disorder Stone" were almost over, and John's condition was getting better and better. His "Armor of Dawn" was as solid as it had been in its prime, but he still couldn't use the "Sword of Dawn."
So he gave Alex a look: Run!
Alex summoned a undead, lunged at Hobert, and then the two of them smashed through windows in different directions and fled.
Whoosh~
They jumped onto the open ground outside almost simultaneously. Just as they were about to run, their vision blurred, and they were back inside the abandoned workshop, and back in front of "Pretty Boy."
Both of them noticed that "Pretty Boy" was holding a black stone in his hand.
John said with a mournful face: "How many miraculous items does this damn kid have?"
The black stone in Hobert's hand was of course the "Teleportation Statue." He was also glad that after becoming stronger, he hadn't been too careless and had brought the "Teleportation Statue" with him in advance.
After scaring away Alex's undead with his knife, he quickly took out the "Teleportation Statue" from the box on his waist.
After "teleporting" the opponent back, Hobert stabbed Alex with his knife, while Carrie, who had just sent the golden skeleton back to the underworld with a hammer, came to help and raised her warhammer at John.
Alex dodged again, rolling and crawling. He took Hobert's knife on his back, preparing to escape with his injury, but after taking only two steps, he felt cold all over, and his spiritual body seemed to shrink together.
The knife in Hobert's hand was like his nemesis. Alex was suppressed in all aspects.
Hobert stepped forward and stabbed again, killing this "Spirit Medium" who called himself Alex.
On the other side, John also took a hammer from Carrie. Using the force of this hammer, he jumped out of the window again.
Carrie's hammer only made John's "Armor of Dawn" shake a little.
Hobert immediately used the "Teleportation Statue" to "teleport" the opponent back again. At this time, John was still able to deal with it calmly. The moment he returned to the abandoned workshop for the second time, he rushed towards Hobert. Although he couldn't use the "Sword of Dawn" anymore, his strength and agility were still there, and he could beat Hobert to death with his bare hands.
Even if Hobert had a knife in his hand, he wouldn't necessarily be a match for the "Dawn Knight."
Fortunately, Hobert had been guarding against the opponent's counterattack and didn't fight him head-on. He just circled around John.
If he couldn't dodge John's attack, he would use the "Teleportation Statue" to move the opponent back, causing the opponent's attack to miss. Or he would use the Beyonder power "Distortion" to cause John's movements to deviate.
Theoretically, the "Teleportation Statue" could allow Hobert to avoid any physical attacks, but because John was "wearing" the light of dawn, his fists were also considered Beyonder attacks and were not within the "Teleportation Statue's" avoidance range.
Carrie wanted to come over to help several times, but Hobert stopped her.
John no longer ran away, and his fists smashed at Hobert like a storm.
If he kept fighting like this, he wouldn't feel tired even after fighting for another twenty minutes, and his spirituality told him that he would be able to re-summon the "Sword of Dawn" in a while.
As long as the "Sword of Dawn" was in hand, it wasn't impossible to counterattack.
At the same time, he felt that the "Pretty Boy" in front of him had been using the ability of "Corrosion" on him, but he didn't take it to heart, because the light of dawn could help him block most of these extraordinary attacks.
After fighting for more than half a minute, the negative effects on John's body had basically completely disappeared. John, who had completely regained his senses, suddenly thought: This "Pretty Boy" isn't stupid either. Why doesn't he think of other ways and just wait for me to re-summon the "Sword of Dawn"?
Not good, John suddenly thought: He's also stalling for time!
When he thought of this, John felt cold all over. The wound that had just been cut open by the Tang sword was getting more and more painful.
John looked down and saw that the area around the wound was purplish, as if poisoned, and thick blood was flowing out.
This was the opportunity that Hobert had been waiting for: "Corrosion!"
For the past minute or so, he had been laying the groundwork. Taking advantage of the fact that John, who had been cut by the Tang sword, had obviously suffered damage to his spirit body, the Beyonder power "Corrosion" rushed through John's "Dawn Defense" like a surging tide, directly hitting John's heart.
The sanity in John's eyes was gradually disappearing, and his eyes were full of greed: "As long as I kill you, all the miraculous items on your body will be mine!"
Then he tried to re-summon the "Sword of Dawn" again, but of course he still couldn't summon it.
This was completely a tactical error, allowing Hobert to seize the opportunity and cut through his "Armor of Dawn" again.
John's remaining sanity made him try to suppress the greed in his heart and choose to escape again.
But it was too late. While the opponent's "Armor of Dawn" had not recovered, Hobert pierced John's chest with his knife.
John immediately felt his spiritual body shrink into a ball. He felt cold all over, and his heart was filled with greed and fear, but he still managed to pull out the Tang sword and turn to flee.
Hobert struck again, cutting off half of John's head. His body ran out a few steps before finally falling to the ground, gradually losing its vitality.
Hobert shook the blood off his knife and sighed: "A Sequence 6 is really hard to kill."

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 255 Beyonder Organization "Judgment"
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Being able to kill all four enemies was completely beyond Carrie's expectations.
This way, she and Jessica could completely relax. Backlund was so big, and with the cover of more than five million people, it would be difficult for the two of them to be found by John's organization again.
As for completely making enemies with their organization, there was no other way. The conflict between them had already reached a point where there was no room for negotiation.
The Beyonder characteristics of the two Sequence 8s had already been extracted, and Alex's Beyonder characteristic was being extracted.
Hobert first retrieved the two "Disorder Stone" he had thrown out, and then used the "Teleportation Statue" to sense if there were any other enemies around.
Since the other party came from an organization, it was likely that there were four people on the surface and one hidden in the dark.
However, John and the others seemed to be so confident that they didn't hide anything. There were no other enemies around, so they could calmly communicate with the spirit world.
So Hobert said to Carrie and Jessica, "Search their bodies, and I'll see what organization they're from."
After saying that, he came to John's side, and his eyes suddenly became like Alex's just now, without any whites.
Hobert used the "Spirit Necklace" to grab John's dissipating spirituality to communicate with the spirit world, and once again came to the world covered by gray fog. He looked at John, who was staring blankly in front of him: "The name of your organization."
"The name of your organization."
"..."
After silently reciting it seven times, the gray fog began to roll, outlining a scene. It was a narrow room without windows, seemingly underground.
In front of him was a wooden table with a lamp on it. Sitting opposite him was a middle-aged man in a robe. He took off his hood, revealing his face. In the center of this face was a horizontal scar, from his left ear, across his nose, all the way to his right ear.
The scarred man smiled and said, "Welcome to the 'Judgment Group'. We will judge humanity and the tyranny of the Kingdom of Loen."
The scene ended there, and Hobert, whose eyes were once again filled with gray fog, thought to himself: What big words, judging humanity! And judging the "tyranny of the Kingdom of Loen" in the Kingdom of Loen, is this because you think you've lived too long?
Then Hobert silently recited in his heart: "The core members of the 'Judgment Group'."
"The core members of the 'Judgment Group'."
"..."
After silently reciting it seven times, a new scene appeared in the gray fog. It seemed to be in a carriage, and the scarred man was still sitting opposite him. He said: "Our 'Judgment Group' has one leader and five deputy leaders. I am your superior, one of the deputy leaders."
Then the scene changed, and they were in the wilderness. The scarred man was walking with a graceful and beautiful young woman. The two seemed to be talking about something, but John was too far away to hear their words.
The scene changed again, and an old man with gloomy eyes appeared in front of him. He asked coldly, "You are the helper sent by Gale?"
Having had plenty of experience communicating with the spirit world, Hobert quickly skipped to the next scene in order to save time.
This scene was very blurry, and he could only roughly see that it was in a spacious and gorgeous room, decorated in a style that was obviously not from Loen. John stood behind the scarred man, Gale, and saw an old man in luxurious clothes sitting behind a luxurious desk.
This old man exuded an oppressive aura that made it difficult to breathe, but his face and physical characteristics could not be seen clearly.
Gale immediately bowed and ordered John to quickly kneel on one knee. At the same time, he explained with a smile: "It's his first time seeing the leader, so he's inevitably a little nervous."
Then the scene churned like boiling water and quickly turned into rolling gray fog.
Hobert sorted out the information he had just obtained. The majestic old man who appeared last was the leader, but he didn't get any valuable information from it. He couldn't even see what style of clothes the old man was wearing.
There were two possibilities for this situation. The first was that the old man's level was very high, and the "Spirit Necklace" could not show his appearance.
The second possibility was that the old man had a high-level Sealed Artifact that hindered Hobert's communication with the spirit world.
Hobert was inclined to the latter. At least a Sequence 3 level was required to have the strength to obscure some key information about himself during the communication process.
And if that old man was Sequence 3, the "Judgment Group" would not be unknown.
In addition, John's superior Gale, as well as that beautiful young woman and gloomy old man, were three of the "Judgment Group's" deputy leaders. There were also two deputy leaders that John should not have met, so there were no related memories.
John was a Sequence 6, and seemed to be deeply trusted by Gale. That's right, among wild Beyonders, Sequence 6 was already a master. Gale only had two or three Sequence 6s under his command, who else would Gale trust if not them?
According to the levels, John was Sequence 6, the deputy leaders should be Sequence 5, and the leader was most likely Sequence 4.
This was already a considerable Beyonder organization, but for official Beyonders, such strength could only be used to cause trouble in secret.
At this time, John's spirit body had faded a lot. Hobert thought for a while and then silently recited: "Potion formula."
"Potion formula."
"..."
In fact, the greatest use of communication with the spirit world was that it could harvest potion formulas, whether they were useful now or not.
This was the accumulation of an Beyonder, and also an important asset.
The gray fog rolled again, presenting a scene of a pile of sundries. These were all John's father's relics. Among some mystical materials, John noticed his first potion formula in his life:
"Sequence 9: Warrior
"Main materials: A complete ape grass, the horn of a berserk rhino.
"Auxiliary materials: 80 milliliters of pure water, 9 milliliters of juice from the golden cloak grass, a golden dandelion flower, 5 black nightshade fruits."
Then the scene changed, and John was in a spacious living room, with twenty or thirty people wearing hoods. This was an Beyonder gathering.
John was lucky enough to buy the Sequence 8 potion formula from this gathering:
"Sequence 8: Pugilist
"Main materials: Crystal of the berserk shy grass, the complete brain of a Dutz cave lion.
"Auxiliary materials:..."
After Hobert saw the potion formula clearly, the scene changed again. John's process of obtaining the potion was almost a brief introduction to his Beyonder life.
In a fierce battle, John defeated his opponent and seized the Sequence 7 "Weapon Master" potion formula from him.
After that, John met a "Dawn Paladin" and wanted to use all his property, about 1,500 pounds, to buy the "Dawn Paladin" potion formula.
But he was rejected by the "Dawn Paladin", who also set his sights on John's property.
So John used the 1,500 pounds of property to hire a Sequence 6 to help him, and used the "Dawn Paladin's" family as a threat to force the other party to hand over the "Dawn Paladin" potion formula.
After becoming a Sequence 6, John joined the "Judgment Group" and made many contributions to this Beyonder organization, so the leader rewarded him with the Sequence 5 potion formula:
"Sequence 5: Guardian
"Main materials: A mutated fire rose spider, crystal of the wisteria lord.
"Auxiliary materials: All the venom of the mutated fire rose spider, 16 milliliters of juice from the wisteria lord, 15 milliliters of blood from the emperor white rhino, three flowers of the common spring grass.
"Ritual: In a balanced team battle, play a decisive role and drink the potion after winning the victory."
Hobert suddenly thought, I wonder if Bishop Utravsky already has the Sequence 5 potion formula?

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 256 Unexpected Gains
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Truth be told, this "Dawn Paladin" who called himself John had a life that could already be considered legendary among wild Beyonders.
Most wild Beyonders are only able to stay at Sequence 8 for their entire lives. The potion formulas and main ingredients for Sequence 7 are rare, and without knowing the "Acting Method," the risk of advancing to Sequence 7 is also relatively high.
If John became a Sequence 6 before the age of forty, then he would have a small chance of becoming a demigod.
The Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 potions would make many modifications to the Beyonder's body. After becoming Sequence 5, most Beyonders of that pathway could live to be around one hundred years old without any accidents.
This gave wild Beyonders time to find demigod potion formulas and corresponding main ingredients, but the hope was still slim. For example, John's "Warrior" pathway, the potion formulas below the demigod level might be encountered in the Beyonder world with luck.
As for the demigod-level potion formulas, they must be firmly controlled by the God of Combat Church. Even if there are corresponding clues, they are very likely to be traps set by the God of Combat Church.
So, generally speaking, the demigods among wild Beyonders will have some background with the church or ancient Beyonder organizations, or their ancestors were prominent.
Almost instantly, a jumble of thoughts popped into Hobert's mind.
At this time, John's spirit body was already very faint, and he could only ask two or three not-so-complicated questions at most.
Hobert thought of the "Skeleton Lord" clue he found next to the ancient Death's corpse. With a try-it-and-see attitude, he silently recited in his heart: "The 'Guardian' potion's main ingredient clue."
"The 'Guardian' potion's main ingredient clue."
"…"
After reciting it seven times, a clear scene appeared in the gray mist. In a room that looked like a bomb had exploded, John pierced an old man's chest with the "Sword of Dawn" and found a key on the old man's body.
John easily found a small secret room among the furniture and walls that had been almost destroyed by the battle, and found a safe in the secret room.
Using the key he had just found, he opened the safe. There were some gold and Beyonder materials in the safe. After looting everything, John's spirituality seemed to sense something and discovered a hidden compartment in the safe, and found a delicate wooden box from the hidden compartment.
Opening the wooden box, inside was a crystal clear spider emitting a faint twilight-like light.
This made Hobert, who was "watching," couldn't help but be stunned. This John's luck was really good. He had done so many murders and robberies and hardly ever failed, and he could always "drop" potion formulas or main ingredients of the same pathway from his enemies.
The spider in the box, which looked like a crystal lamp in the shape of a spider to Hobert, should be one of the main ingredients of the "Guardian": the mutated Fire Rose Spider.
Then the scene changed, and Hobert saw a street sign in front of him: Bostan Cemetery, Conant City.
John killed a tramp, pretended that a friend had passed away, bought a plot in Bostan Cemetery, and even asked a priest to help the tramp's soul rest in peace.
But when the priest left, John pulled the corpse out of the coffin, put the wooden box containing the mutated Fire Rose Spider in the coffin, and then covered the coffin, filled it with soil, pretending to be an ordinary grave.
Hobert saw that the name on the tombstone was John, maybe it was the tramp's name, or maybe it was a name that the "Dawn Paladin" made up casually.
This shows that the "Dawn Paladin's" real name is not John. Explaining it with mysticism, the "Dawn Paladin" should not have used the name "John" in this operation. It may be that this name, which has a inexplicable connection with the "Dawn Paladin," made his luck very bad and he ran into Hobert.
The gray mist covered Hobert's eyes again. He seized the time and asked: "Does anyone know that you hid the mutated Fire Rose Spider?"
"Does anyone know that you hid the mutated Fire Rose Spider?"
"…"
The gray mist materialized a scene again. In front of him was a full-length mirror, and the "Dawn Paladin" was tidying up his clothes in front of the mirror.
Then the scene in front of him disappeared and turned into gray mist again.
Hobert understood, that is to say, this secret was only known to the "Dawn Paladin" himself.
Seeing that there was still a chance, he quickly asked: "The way to contact your superior, Gale."
"The way to contact your superior, Gale."
"…"
The gray mist rolled a bit, outlining a blurry figure that looked like Gale who had appeared before.
Because the "Dawn Paladin's" spirit body had become very weak, he could no longer see Gale's expression and clothes clearly. He only heard Gale say: "I will come to you when there is a need. Don't take the initiative to find me."
This scene ended here, and the "Dawn Paladin's" spirit body completely dissipated. Hobert automatically exited the psychic state.
He smiled: Others only ask a few key questions when they use psychic powers, but I usually ask the enemy until their "soul flies away and scatters."
However, the harvest of this psychic session was not small. Just that mutated Fire Rose Spider is worth at least 3,000 pounds.
The Beyonder characteristics of the "Dawn Paladin" had also been extracted. Over there, Carrie and Jessica had also completed the body search.
As expected, they didn't have any magical items on them, only some gold pounds and spiritual materials.
This made Hobert couldn't help but sigh: Poverty is the norm for wild Beyonders!
Carrie piled the four corpses together, took out a metal bottle, and poured the liquid in the bottle on the corpses.
In the "sizzling" sound, the four corpses were quickly melted by the liquid.
Jessica, who had already fetched a bucket of water, washed it away, and the four corpses were cleaned up just like that.
Then, under Hobert's instructions, Carrie and Jessica carefully looked for any hair that they had accidentally dropped, and then the three of them left the abandoned workshop in single file.
The sealing wax made of "Order Crystal" on Hobert's body has the use of anti-divination, and he didn't leave any clues at all, so he wasn't afraid of the "Tribunal" people coming to find the murderer.
In the carriage back, Carrie suddenly said: "Alex once commissioned me to build a Beyonder weapon for him, but I didn't find it on him. It seems that he built it for someone else, or it was a task for their organization."
Hobert nodded: "Their organization is called the 'Judgement Group,' and it has some of the characteristics of a terrorist organization. They don't dare to act openly. As long as you hide yourself well, you won't be discovered by them."
Back at Carrie and Jessica's place, they put all the spoils on the table. The most valuable were the four Beyonder characteristics, as well as 62 pounds in cash and some spiritual materials.
Hobert took away the Beyonder characteristics of the "Dawn Paladin" and the "Spirit Medium": "The rest is yours."
Carrie handed the "Provoker's" Beyonder characteristic to Hobert: "We didn't play too much of a role in the battle just now, so give this Beyonder characteristic to you too."
Hobert hesitated for a moment, but didn't stand on ceremony with them and took away the "Provoker's" Beyonder characteristic.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 257 Hobert's Reflection
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Carrie and Jessica were moving tonight, so after the spoils were divided and he got a discount, Hobert immediately left after spending 480 pounds to buy the "Hurricane Axe."
Hobert brought this up after the battle, not before, to avoid Carrie and Jessica misunderstanding that he was asking for benefits in advance.
He certainly knew that sometimes, even if he didn't mean it that way, when others thought he did, no amount of explanation would help.
In the carriage back to Blanca Street, Hobert re-examined his actions tonight, making sure there were no omissions and that no one was following him, before he finally relaxed.
Then he began to reflect on the battle. During the fight, Hobert realized that he had made many mistakes in his first Sequence 6 battle.
Now that the battle was over, Hobert began his habitual post-battle review.
First, he realized his first mistake was that he shouldn't have used the "Disorder Stone" a second time.
This one-time magical item had unexpected effects when used the first time, and it also conveniently completed the process of "bribery."
But when used a second time, the opponent was prepared, making it difficult to achieve the desired effect, and it might even cause him to lose the tactical initiative.
The second mistake was that Hobert realized he was somewhat underestimating the enemy tonight. He should have used the "Order Wood" at the beginning of the battle to create an environment favorable to his abilities.
Recently, Hobert hadn't participated in any intense extraordinary battles, but his own strength had qualitatively improved, which made him somewhat complacent.
If Hobert didn't have enough magical items, tonight would have certainly had a different ending.
Hobert firmly kept these two mistakes in mind, and he planned to re-examine them before every battle in the future.
Next was to review the experience gained from this battle. First, Hobert had the experience of "corroding" other people's minds. It only took one or two seconds to complete the "corrosion" process on ordinary people.
It took about four or five seconds to take effect on "low sequence" Beyonders.
It might take six or seven seconds to affect a Sequence 7 opponent, and there was a high probability of being discovered by the opponent.
At the same level of Sequence 6, it might take more than ten seconds to take effect, and it would almost certainly be discovered by the opponent. However, Hobert was satisfied that he could use "corrosion" while fighting, and it didn't matter even if the opponent discovered it.
The second lesson was the use of the Beyonder power of "distortion." Sequence 6's "distortion" was more useful than Hobert imagined. If used well, it could even make enemies attack their own people.
He thought it could be used in conjunction with "corrosion" to cause infighting among the enemies or make them distrust their teammates.
Thinking of this, Hobert found that the abilities of the "Baron of Corruption" seemed to be used to manipulate people's hearts.
In addition, in order to distinguish the incantation of the "Disorder Stone" from the Beyonder power of "distortion," Hobert decided to change the incantation of the "Disorder Stone" to "Madness!"
He continued to think. This battle also made him discover the limit of the "Teleportation Statue." When John wore the "Armor of Dawn," the "Teleportation Statue" was not so comfortable for his movement.
Hobert estimated that if he encountered a Sequence 5 "Guardian" of the Warrior pathway, it might be difficult to complete the "teleport" on him, or the "teleport" distance might not reach his expectations.
Recalling the battle with the offspring of the Evil God, Hobert estimated that when facing a Sequence 4 opponent, the "Teleportation Statue" could at most slow down the opponent's movements, and the "teleport" ability might even be used by the opponent.
Hobert sighed that he would lose his greatest help and trump card at that time.
Of course, it's not excluded that there will be other trump cards at that time.
Continuing to think, Hobert summed up a lesson: Don't fight warriors in close combat.
Or rather, try to highlight your strengths during the battle, and don't compete with Sequence 6 Beyonders in their strengths.
If most Sequence 7s are the real Beyonders, then generally Sequence 6s have the characteristics of their pathway and specific enough advantages of Beyonder abilities, and these advantages can largely cover up the Beyonder's weaknesses.
When Hobert was Sequence 7, killing an enemy of the same level didn't seem that difficult, but after reaching Sequence 6, killing another Sequence 6 became very difficult.
This is precisely because Sequence 6 already has enough advantages, and Hobert didn't realize this at all in his previous battles. Only after fighting a Sequence 6 did he know that they were really difficult to kill.
The post-battle review ended, and Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. Overall, he didn't make any major mistakes, and he also gained many valuable experiences and lessons from this battle.
Then Hobert thought of the gains from this battle, in addition to the spoils he received, there were also the potion formulas for the Warrior pathway from Sequence 9 to Sequence 5, and the mutated Fire Rose Spider.
It can be said that the harvest was abundant.
Although he learned the whereabouts of the mutated Fire Rose Spider through spirit channeling and knew that no one except the "Dawn Paladin" knew the hiding place.
But Hobert still didn't plan to take the mutated Fire Rose Spider himself. This matter could wait for a while, anyway, Beyonder materials don't expire.
Returning to Blanca Street, it was already 10:30 in the evening. Fors was still awake and lying in an easy chair reading a magazine.
Hobert asked, "Still awake? Don't you have to go to work tomorrow?"
Fors seemed a little anxious: "I feel like I don't need to be an apprentice anymore, so I just quit."
Hobert "oh"ed, knowing that this writer lady wouldn't work a day more.
Having experienced a Beyonder battle, Hobert was a little tired. He drank some water and went upstairs to rest.
Just about to change into his pajamas, Hobert suddenly thought of something. He quickly came to the window. The "Crimson Moon" in the sky became redder than usual. Today was indeed the day when the "Blood Moon" would appear.
Hobert quickly sacrificed to himself, bringing the "Psychological Spoon" and the "Fork of Healing" to the "Nation of Disorder," and observed Fors downstairs through the star representing himself, using "True Sight."
As the Blood Moon gradually descended, Fors's nails and hair grew at a speed visible to the naked eye, and she became more and more anxious, constantly chanting the names of the Seven Gods.
Then it seemed like poisonous snakes were drilling around under Fors's skin, and her expression became gloomy and terrifying.
Hobert grabbed a handful of "Power of Order" and prepared to strike at any time. Finally, Fors, with a painful expression, opened a thick book and began to recite the name of "The Fool" intermittently.
Seeing that everything was going smoothly, Hobert quickly withdrew his "True Sight," otherwise he might "collide views" with Klein soon.
Now that Klein, who is gradually becoming "following the inner choice" and more cautious, may choose to stand by after feeling other views.
Hobert left the Nation of Disorder, dispersed his spirituality, and did not feel any strong fluctuations in spirituality. Obviously, Fors's loss of control did not continue.
After waiting for more than ten minutes, Hobert, who had changed into his pajamas, went downstairs: "Sorry, I just remembered that today is the day when the 'Blood Moon' appears."
After speaking, he indiscriminately poured spirituality into the "Fork of Healing" and used "Healing" to heal Fors.
A "Healing" spell made Fors feel comfortable all over. She hesitated, and then seemed to think of something: "Thank you, Hobert, thank you for the advice you gave me before."
