chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 258 The Baronet Who Endured Humiliation (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Knight Wolf for becoming a free member]
Fors just subtly mentioned her recent experience, as she had promised Mr. Fool not to reveal any secrets about Him, so she couldn't explain it too clearly.
While chatting with Hobert, Fors trimmed her nails and tidied her hair.
While tidying her hair, Fors realized that she really considered Hobert a good friend. After growing up, she had never groomed herself in front of anyone except Xio.
To celebrate her finally being liberated, Fors prepared to pour a glass of wine.
"Wait a moment." Hobert seemed to suddenly remember something. After going upstairs, he brought down a bottle of white wine: "This is a good wine my father 'gave' me. I couldn't bear to drink it, but let's finish it today to celebrate for you."
This bottle of white wine was the aged wine left over from concocting the 'Baron of Corruption' potion.
Fors assumed that Hobert understood her subtle description and took out two wine glasses with a smile.
While pouring the wine, Hobert said in his heart, "Congratulations, Miss Magician."
Just as she was about to take a glass, Xio, dusty from a busy evening, came in from outside: "It's so late, are you guys still not asleep yet?"
She sniffed: "Very good white wine, why are you drinking so late at night?"
Hobert took another glass, poured wine, and said, "Fors said she noticed you've grown a few centimeters recently, and we're celebrating."
Fors smiled and didn't explain anything.
Xio first glared at her friend, then her shoulders slumped: "Okay, I have to admit, I've been putting insoles in my shoes these past few days."
Hobert and Fors were both stunned. Both of them were very strange, why didn't they notice this?
But both of them tried to hide their surprised expressions and tried not to stare at Xio, because doing so would be too hurtful.
To ease the awkwardness, Hobert raised his glass and said, "To a beautiful new life!"
Fors echoed, "To a beautiful tomorrow!"
Xio also raised her glass: "I hope I can find extraordinary medicine that allows adults to grow taller."
Hobert thought: Beyonder medicine that might allow adults to develop again would be more suitable.
Amidst the laughter of Hobert and Fors, the three of them clinked glasses and drank it all in one gulp.
...
Backlund, 29 Sivellaus Street, Empress Borough.
Rafter Pound stood in front of the window, watching the moon outside becoming increasingly red. The "Blood Moon" had arrived as scheduled, and that sealed artifact could be used.
He opened the safe, which contained, besides a thin stack of cash, two exquisite stone boxes.
He carefully took out one of them and opened it.
Inside was a mirror-like object with a handle. Rafter picked up the "mirror", but it had no reflective surface or back, and each side had an eye in the middle.
At this time, one eye was open and one eye was closed.
Rafter held the mirror and walked into the blood-red moonlight, allowing the crimson moonlight to shine on the mirror. The eye that was open just now slowly closed.
This was a sealed artifact that could determine whether one was under surveillance. The normal state of the sealed artifact was one eye open and one eye closed.
Placing it in the moonlight of the "Blood Moon", if the open eye did not close, it meant that the holder was under secret surveillance.
If both eyes were closed, it meant that the holder was not being monitored.
If both eyes were open, then run quickly, if there was still time.
The result Rafter got was: both eyes were closed.
He couldn't help but sneer: "The royal family and the Church of Steam and Machinery really have no patience at all."
Of course, this was inseparable from his superb acting skills, for which he also paid a certain price, because he was missing a front tooth, and now he leaked air when he spoke.
He put the "mirror" with the eyes back into the stone box, in the absence of light.
Rafter then took out another stone box and took out a crystal ball with a bewitching blue color.
These were the only two sealed artifacts left in the Pound family. The other sealed artifacts had been sold by Rafter, leaving only these two sealed artifacts with effects roughly equivalent to Level 3.
Seemingly, Rafter was extremely prodigal, but in fact, these were the sealed artifacts he had deliberately left behind. For a baronet who was once under constant royal surveillance, these two sealed artifacts, although not very offensive, were what he needed most.
He placed the crystal ball on the desk, and Rafter began to stroke the crystal ball, trying to "recall" what he had done at the Roselle Memorial Exhibition before.
Because at that time, Hobert only used the "Psychological Spoon" to seal part of his memory, and did not have time to use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to interfere.
Rafter also used his spirituality as a medium to recall his experience, so he quickly "recalled" many details of the memorial exhibition at that time.
Most importantly, he recalled that honorific name!
Even the Arrodes magic mirror failed to "hear" the honorific name of the "Creator", but Rafter, relying on his special connection with the "Nation of Disorder", actually "recalled" that honorific name.
Rafter's eyes narrowed, and he exclaimed, "The Creator of Human Order!"
This reminded him of the description he had seen in the family's notes before, one of the characteristics of the "Black Emperor" was: creating a unique order that is widely popularized in the human world!
Then Rafter fell into silence. He thought of his wasted first half of his life, and the fact that he was only Sequence 8 in middle age.
He thought of the last words of his grandfather, the patriarch, and the former glory of his ancestors.
Finally, he made up his mind, put the blue crystal ball back into the box, and then sorted out his emotions before chanting: "The Creator of Human Order;
"You are the master of the Nation of Disorder;
"You are the master of the Clock of Order.
"Your faithful servant Rafter Pound, begs for your attention and help, begs you to point out a path for the lost lamb to restore the glory of the family."
Then, Rafter waited for a response with trepidation.
...
Hobert was about to fall asleep when he heard a prayer, which didn't sound like Elliot's voice.
He had no choice but to leave the warm bed and come to the "Nation of Disorder".
As soon as he sat on the "Iron Throne", Hobert saw the star representing Rafter expanding and flickering.
Hobert's eyes narrowed, as if he had received a call from a friend who had died a long time ago.
That's right, in his opinion, Rafter was already a discarded piece. Why would he take the initiative to pray to himself?
Did George III follow Rafter's line?
Or did the Church of Steam and Machinery use some method to obtain the honorific name of the "Creator"?
After hesitating for a full half minute, Hobert spread his spirituality to the star representing Rafter.
Since the other party had directly pointed to the "Nation of Disorder" and the "Creator", the most dangerous choice at this time was to ignore it.
After hearing Rafter's prayer and using "True Vision" to look around, confirming that Rafter's behavior was personal and not influenced by anything, Hobert put his heart back in his stomach.
Now the only strange thing was, where did Rafter get the honorific name of the "Creator"?
After sitting on the "Iron Throne" and thinking for a while, Hobert decided not to reply. As long as Rafter saw that his prayer was not answered, he should not continue to pray.
Leaving and returning to the real world, Hobert was already covered in goosebumps from the cold, and the quilt had become icy cold.
The cold winter in Backlund had arrived, and he decided to buy a cloak tomorrow. If he needed to go to the "Nation of Disorder" in the middle of the night in the future, he could put on the cloak to avoid being frozen and sleepless.

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 259 Klein is good at finding people (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
[Thanks to TapliTap Top for becoming a member, +5 bonus chapters]
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After getting up, Hobert first wrote a letter to the masked man, Byron. According to their prior agreement, the letter contained only the phrase "The goods have arrived."
After affixing the stamp and sealing it with sealing wax, Hobert took the letter downstairs.
Fors, now that she wasn't an apprentice, didn't get up early either, clearly planning to sleep in.
Hobert didn't disturb them. He toasted two slices of bread for himself, spread jam on them, and ate breakfast alone.
After finishing breakfast, he began preparing for his mission that morning. First, he broke off another "Order Wood" from the "Nation of Disorder", made it very small, and put it in his pocket for later use.
Then, Hobert took the pipe he had picked up from Heyman's hiding place, put on his windbreaker, picked up his cane and the wooden box containing the "Hurricane Axe", took a taxi carriage to mail the letter first, and then came to the outside of the Roselle Memorial Exhibition Hall as agreed.
Klein had just arrived. Hobert beckoned him to get into the carriage and told the coachman to wait by the side of the street.
Taxi carriages were charged by the hour, and the coachman couldn't wait for them to chat in the carriage for a while longer.
Hobert handed the wooden box to Klein: "'Hurricane Axe'. The seller originally asked for 580 pounds, but I bargained it down to 510 pounds.
"You can either pay me in cash now, or wait until the mission is over and deduct it from your earnings."
Hobert didn't overcharge. This "Hurricane Axe" was indeed worth 580 pounds, but Hobert got a considerable discount.
"I'll give you the cash now," Klein said. For him, this transaction was also very cost-effective, equivalent to trading for a Sequence 7 main material for 510 pounds.
One person counted the cash, and the other checked the "Hurricane Axe", and the transaction was completed quickly.
It was of course very inconvenient to look for someone with the "Hurricane Axe", so Klein temporarily stored the "Hurricane Axe" in the Quelaag Club.
It was already ten o'clock in the morning when the two officially started looking for Heyman.
Hobert took out his pipe, briefly explained its origin, and finally asked, "Before looking for someone, you can first divine to see if the owner of the pipe is still in Backlund?"
If he wasn't, this task would be troublesome.
Klein nodded, closed his eyes and began to divine. After more than ten seconds, he opened his eyes and looked at the crystal pendant hanging on his wrist.
The pendant was rotating clockwise. "The owner of the pipe is still in Backlund," Klein said, and then he began to use the dowsing rod to divine and direct the coachman.
Hobert couldn't help but sigh in his heart, diviners are really convenient for finding people!
If he had to do this commission himself, it would be too troublesome!
The carriage crossed most of Backlund and came to the factory district.
The coachman was the happiest. He didn't expect to have such a big job at noon, and the entire morning was spent being charged.
Close to noon, the carriage circled around an enamel factory, indicating that Heyman was in this enamel factory.
Hobert got out of the car and paid the fare. After the carriage left, he smiled and said, "The fare is considered our joint cost. After the mission is completed, half of the fare will be deducted from your earnings."
Klein was obviously stunned: "You, didn't I hear that lawyers, especially well-known lawyers, have high incomes?"
"The news you heard is correct, but for some reason, after I met you, I always wanted to settle these small accounts clearly."
Klein muttered, "I'm not the 'God of Accounting'. Why calculate so clearly?"
But in the end, he did not refuse to pay the other half of the fare.
The two first found a coffee shop, ate a simple meal, and then Hobert first used the documents issued to him by the police to check the details of the enamel factory with the local police station and the industry and commerce department.
But Hobert was still a little worried, so he went to the bar near the enamel factory to inquire about news.
Combining information from all parties, Hobert and Klein believed that this should be an ordinary factory. Heyman might be hiding among the workers, or there might be a secret room in the factory.
After all, the factory building was so large that it would be difficult to notice an extra room.
It wasn't until dark that the two people who had been investigating for an afternoon came to the gate of the enamel factory.
Hobert took out two masks made of "Order Crystal" and gave one to Klein: "It has the effect of anti-divination."
Klein glanced at the mask and asked, "How do we get in?"
There were still so many workers in the factory. They couldn't just climb in, could they? Besides, after they put on the masks, they would be more easily noticed.
"Just go in like this." Hobert, wearing the mask, walked in front.
Klein was stunned at first, then he realized that Hobert was an extra member of the "Nighthawks" and had relevant documents from the police department.
It's really good to have an official identity, Klein couldn't help but sigh, while recalling the time when he also had an official identity.
But what he didn't expect was that Hobert didn't show his documents, he really just went in like that.
Several gatekeepers seemed to be very familiar with Hobert, greeted him with a smile, and even wanted to hand Hobert a cigarette.
Klein wouldn't believe it if you told him that Hobert knew them, but he suddenly remembered that the information he saw earlier said that "lawyers" were good at distorting their thoughts, and he didn't expect it to be used like this.
In fact, Hobert used the ability of the "Psychological Spoon" to hypnotize everyone he met: I am the manager of this factory.
Whether they knew him or not, everyone had to be polite to him, and they completely ignored the black mask on Hobert's face.
Klein continued to use the dowsing rod to divine and find people. Hobert followed behind and glanced at the workshop illuminated by the gas lamps.
Although it was still the steam age, some processes in the workshop had already been mechanized.
For example, in the plastic shaping step, the worker took a piece of metal, which Hobert didn't know what it was, and put it on a mold slot.
The "hissing" sound of steam was endless, and a huge machine pressed down, and a basin was formed.
Of course, the edge of the basin had to be manually repaired.
The next step was to apply enamel. The worker used tools to clamp the repaired metal basin and rolled it in a pool full of enamel, and an enamel basin was formed.
One corner of the large workshop was already full of enamel basins, and in another workshop, workers were grinding the dried enamel basins on grinding wheels.
Dust flew in the grinding workshop, like a layer of white mist. Hobert felt a little uncomfortable in his respiratory tract even from such a distance, and the workers walked in the dust to work without any protective gear.
Dang dang dang~
A dull bell suddenly rang in the factory. This was the signal to get off work. The workers poured out of the workshop like a tide.
Hobert and Klein hid aside, paying close attention to the crowd, lest Heyman slip away before their eyes.
More than ten minutes later, the workers had all left, and the machines were also "hissing" and venting.
The surrounding factories probably got off work at the same time, and the noisy production sound quickly disappeared.
Klein continued to divine, Heyman was still in the factory.
He led the way in front, turned a corner, and came to the side of the workshop. His cane stood still on the ground.
Hobert and Klein were both stunned, and then the two looked at the ground together.
"Manager, what are you doing here?" a voice asked.
Looking in the direction of the voice, in a corner of the factory, under the not-so-bright gas lamp, there was a large piece of scrapped equipment, and two people dressed as workers were guarding the equipment with their arms folded.
Hobert had just seen them, so he continued to use the "Psychological Spoon" to hypnotize them, making them think that he was their manager.
Hobert smiled: "I heard that the grass at the base of the wall here needs to be pulled, so I came over to take a look."
"You don't need to worry about it, hurry back!" said one of the people dressed as workers.
"Okay, okay." Hobert said with a smile.
Those two workers definitely had a problem! How dare they be so rude to the manager!
And Heyman was likely hiding underground, and the entrance should be around the abandoned equipment.
Hobert continued to use the "Psychological Spoon" to hypnotize the two workers over there, but the content of the hypnosis changed: ignore the abnormality in front of you.
After the two put on their masks, Hobert slowly drew out his knife and inserted the scabbard directly above Heyman's head: "Order!"
Klein was slightly stunned when he saw the Tang sword in Hobert's hand. It always felt familiar, but he didn't know much about cold weapons and didn't know much about Tang swords.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 260 This is the Swindler (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The towering Tree of Order immediately rose from the ground. Now, the canopy of the "Order Wood" could cover more than thirty meters, enveloping half the workshop.
The two guards by the abandoned machinery stared blankly at everything before them. Watching a towering tree obscure the crimson moon in the mist, they felt something was off, but couldn't quite pinpoint what.
Although the "Order Wood" grew large, it had no roots, so there was no need to worry about being discovered by those underground.
However, the moment it grew, its immense spirituality could easily be detected by Beyonders.
Hobert was prepared. While planting his sword into the ground, he held the "Teleportation Statue" in his other hand, planning to "teleport" the people underground directly to the surface.
Klein drew his gun and retreated, ready to support his teammate at any time.
The moment he held the "Teleportation Statue," Hobert immediately sensed an underground structure beneath his feet, and within that structure were two people.
Hobert warned, "The enemy has helpers!"
Two against two, their chances of winning were still good, and they had the element of surprise.
When "teleporting" one of the people, Hobert immediately realized something was wrong. The person he was "teleporting" was a Sequence 6!
He had developed a certain "feel" for using the "Teleportation Statue," and could immediately distinguish between Sequence 6 and Sequence 7.
So Hobert simply moved the person's head to the surface, only to find that he had only moved up a shadow!
This was a "Rose Bishop"!
Hobert immediately made his judgment!
Strange, wasn't Heyman always trying to escape the Aurora Order? How could he have a "Rose Bishop" by his side? Could it be that he was captured by the Aurora Order?
Although he had questions, Hobert still threw out the "Disorder Stone" he had prepared long ago: "Madness!"
The shadow "flowing" on the ground immediately let out a scream, and chunks of flesh emerged from the "shadow," teetering on the brink of losing control.
His flesh collapsed while he desperately controlled it, turning it into a shadow to evade Hobert's subsequent attacks and Klein's bullets.
The "Disorder Stone" was not so powerful when dealing with Sequence 6, even for the "Secrets Supplicant" pathway.
Hobert realized that the other party's condition was not good to begin with!
Having completed the "bribe" process, Hobert did not continue to use "Weaken," but as the holder of the "Order Wood," he "distorted" the environment under the canopy, making the spirituality more abundant.
The "Rose Bishop," who was already very sensitive to spirituality, could more easily hear some maddening whispers in a more spiritually abundant environment.
Klein, after discovering that ordinary bullets could not harm the "flowing" shadows on the ground, retreated two more steps to avoid affecting Hobert's performance.
Although Hobert's Tang Dao could stab the opponent, he tried not to engage in close combat with this enemy who was about to lose control, as there was still an enemy underground.
So he poured his spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon": "Madness!"
The shadow screamed in pain again. He could no longer suppress the collapse of his flesh and was rapidly turning into a monster.
Only then did Hobert immediately step forward, preparing to finish him off with a single strike.
But the sword he raised seemed to be wrapped in a circle of shadow, as if Hobert had slashed into a ball of cotton.
A mass of viscous flesh was coming towards them from the side of the abandoned machinery. As it passed the two worker-dressed guards, the mass of flesh "devoured" one of the guards and immediately sprayed a cloud of flesh towards Hobert and Klein.
Hobert immediately used "Distortion" to change the direction of the flesh's attack. The moment his Beyonder ability "touched" the flesh, it triggered a series of explosions!
Another "Rose Bishop"!
There was no Heyman here at all, so why did the divination point to this place?
Soon, Hobert had the answer in his heart: that pipe was not Heyman's item at all!
How could someone who didn't even leave his own hair behind leave his used pipe in a hiding place?
Heyman had been trying to escape the Aurora Order. The pipe was likely an item used by Hillman. He would find a chance to switch pipes with Hillman, then deliberately expose himself and leave the pipe for other Beyonders.
When Hobert was still a Sequence 9, he and Xio had chased Heyman and obtained a pipe, which should have been Hillman's pipe.
And the mass of flesh that had begun to lose control should be Hillman. He was severely injured by "2-365" a few weeks ago and had not recovered, and couldn't even use the Beyonder abilities of a "Rose Bishop."
That's why he completely lost control under Hobert's series of attacks.
Hobert suddenly exclaimed: This is the "Swindler"!
Clearly only Sequence 8, but through tricks, he killed a Sequence 6.
Ignoring the out-of-control Hillman, Hobert kicked a small stone towards the rapidly moving mass of flesh, completing the "bribe" process: "Weaken!"
First, give the opponent a negative effect!
Seeing that the speed of the mass of flesh had slowed down, Hobert had time to wink at Klein, signaling him to hide. That was a "Rose Bishop" in good condition, and the aftermath of the battle could injure Klein, who was only Sequence 8.
But when he turned his head, he found that Klein had already hidden far away.
Roar~
Hillman completely lost control. His face was connected to his chest, one eye drooped to the position of his leg, his mouth had become a grotesque maw filled with bone spurs like fangs, and he seemed to be carrying a huge fleshy tumor on his back, with his arms and internal organs inside the tumor.
Hobert felt a little uncomfortable seeing the other party's appearance: The appearance of a "Rose Bishop" after losing control was truly disgusting.
But this was exactly what he wanted. He simply moved the monster between himself and the "Rose Bishop," and used "Distortion" to twist the monster's indiscriminate attacks towards the "Rose Bishop."
This was equivalent to having a monster helper.
The "Rose Bishop" immediately launched a wave of "flesh bombs" at the monster, and the monster roared, its tumor on its back split open, and it also launched some flesh at the "Rose Bishop."
Just as they were bombarding each other with flesh, Hobert put away the "Teleportation Statue," replaced it with the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch," and reached out to steal the Beyonder ability of the "Rose Bishop" to transform into a mass of flesh.
The "Rose Bishop," in surprise, turned into a human figure with the appearance of a man in his thirties, holding a mass of flesh in his arms, which was the guard he had "devoured" earlier.
Hobert felt a little regretful that he couldn't steal "Flesh Bomb," but the speed of the "Rose Bishop" who couldn't turn into a flesh state was greatly reduced.
The monster took the opportunity to open its maw full of bone spurs and sharp teeth and pounced towards the "Rose Bishop."
The "Rose Bishop" calmly threw the guard's head into the monster's mouth, and after the monster swallowed it, he immediately detonated it, blasting the monster open from the inside, blowing it to pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 261 Establishing Order on the Battlefield (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hiding behind the monster, Hobert channeled his spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon" while dodging the monster's fragmented flesh and blood: "Madness!"
From the moment he used the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" until now, the whole attack flowed smoothly, and it just so happened to "hit" the "Rose Bishop's" weakness.
Without the Beyonder power of "Flesh Transformation," the "Rose Bishop" not only lost his speed advantage, but also his ability to defend against extraordinary attacks. He was hit by "Madness," and the rationality in his heart was covered by madness, causing him to wave his hands randomly, as if countless bees were stinging him around him.
Hobert still didn't step forward, throwing out a Disorder Stone: "Disorder!"
The "Rose Bishop's" flesh and blood began to collapse, and he was on the verge of losing control. Fortunately, he gradually began to regain his sanity in just one or two seconds, and the process of losing control was temporarily suppressed.
Only then did Hobert raise his sword and take a few steps forward, preparing to deliver the final blow to the "Rose Bishop," who was in very bad shape.
But the "Rose Bishop" suddenly had a grim smile on his face. The collapsing flesh and blood on his body immediately became normal. At the same time, he raised his hand, and the flesh and blood around Hobert's body seemed to be blown up by an invisible wind, smashing towards Hobert.
When he couldn't enter the "Flesh Transformation" state, he began to feign weakness, with the purpose of luring Hobert over to enter the area filled with flesh and blood. This was the area where he could exert his advantages.
The appearance of his flesh and blood collapsing just now was mostly a disguise he made with "Flesh Magic."
But Hobert also smiled. He suddenly became shorter, like a melted candle, turning into a pool of flesh and blood.
Hobert could skillfully use most of the skills stolen by the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" for ten minutes, but there were some skills he couldn't use. For example, the "Sword of Dawn" stolen from the "Dawn Paladin" before, Hobert couldn't provide the power of dawn to the "Sword of Dawn," so the "Sword of Dawn" quickly disappeared from his hand.
Hobert felt his speed more than doubled. From Klein's perspective, he only saw a black sword standing in a pool of flesh and blood, quickly approaching the "Rose Bishop."
The "Rose Bishop" quickly ordered the flesh and blood under his control to smash towards the black sword, but strangely, the flesh and blood suddenly became uncontrollable and fell to the ground.
To the "Rose Bishop's" surprise, Hobert, in the state of flesh and blood, stretched out a hand holding a sword and chopped off one of the "Rose Bishop's" legs.
For the "Rose Bishop," such an injury was nothing at all. He used "Flesh Magic" to make the surrounding flesh and blood fly towards him, intending to reattach his leg.
But he soon realized that his control over the surrounding flesh and blood was decreasing, and although the leg was reattached, he couldn't control the muscles and bones of that leg, as if his leg hadn't grown back at all!
If the "Rose Bishop" had a leg chopped off by an ordinary sword, it wouldn't be a big problem for him.
But the sword in Hobert's hand was special, it could directly injure the "Rose Bishop's" spirit body. If it was chopped off, it was chopped off. Even if the leg was reattached, it would only be like growing a fleshy tumor without nerves.
And the fact that he was gradually losing control over the surrounding flesh and blood was because Hobert had been using the power of "Distortion" to distort the spirituality contained in the surrounding flesh and blood.
This was Hobert's first attempt to construct order on the battlefield: to gradually weaken the spirituality in the surrounding flesh and blood.
This fighting style was a lesson Hobert learned from reflection after the last battle. This was the fighting style that the "Baron of Corruption" was good at.
With the blessing of the "Order Tree," the surrounding order quickly became unfavorable to the enemy.
Hobert, in the state of flesh and blood, experienced such a fast speed for the first time. Taking advantage of the "Rose Bishop's" daze, he turned around and stabbed the "Rose Bishop" again.
The "Rose Bishop" felt that his heart seemed to be filled with fear. "Run!" This was his only thought now.
As soon as he limped a few steps, Hobert in the flesh and blood state returned to his human form: "Corrosion!"
In the previous battle, Hobert had been "corroding" the opponent's mind. Finally, at this moment, the power of "corrosion" burst out like a tide, filling the "Rose Bishop's" eyes with greed. He wanted to take away Hillman's Beyonder characteristics, and he wanted to seize the "Masked Man's" black sword (Hobert was wearing a mask at this time).
Seeing the "Rose Bishop" limping back again, Hobert slashed over with a wide-open sword.
The "Rose Bishop" immediately "commanded" the surrounding flesh and blood to smash towards Hobert, but the surrounding flesh and blood only moved, rolled twice, and then stopped moving.
Hobert's sword began to fall. The "Rose Bishop's" remaining rationality made him form a thick bone shield with the bones of his whole body and hold it in front of him.
But how sharp was the sword in Hobert's hand? With one sword, he easily broke through the bone shield and cut the "Rose Bishop" in half from the middle.
Even though the two halves of the "Rose Bishop" were not dead yet, the flesh and blood on his body were trying hard to re-fuse, but no matter how they fused, the cut-open area was completely disconnected and could never be fused again.
Hobert stepped forward to make up for the sword, and slashed horizontally on the "Rose Bishop's" head. The "Rose Bishop's" spirit body suffered extremely serious damage, and only then did he die completely.
This battle lasted only a few minutes, and it was not very intense, but it was very beneficial to Hobert. The fighting style he had summarized before was well applied and achieved very good results.
Tonight's battle was much easier than last night's battle, which once again confirmed that Hobert's idea was correct.
Klein, who had been watching the show the whole time, had a new understanding of Hobert's strength. Compared with the time when he fought against the offspring of the evil god, Hobert's strength had increased by a whole level!
But now was not the time to be amazed. Since their opponent had been wrong from the beginning, this place was likely to be a stronghold of the Aurora Order, and they had to quickly pick up the spoils and leave.
Hobert first recovered the Disorder Stone that he had thrown out, and then searched for the monster's Beyonder characteristics with Klein.
The monster that was blown to pieces by the "Rose Bishop" just now did not die because of this. Its flesh and blood had been wriggling, trying to re-condense.
But the surrounding environment greatly reduced the spirituality in the flesh and blood, so its re-condensation speed was very slow.
Finally, Hobert looked at the wriggling fleshy tumor. He endured the nausea and used the Tang sword to cut open the fleshy tumor, and sure enough, he found a throbbing blood-red heart inside. This was the sealed item formed by Hillman after losing control.
Hobert, who had been prepared for a long time, took out a wooden box, and then used the back of the Tang sword to put the heart into the wooden box.
Both of them were very experienced in checking whether there were any fallen hairs. During this process, the Beyonder characteristics of the "Rose Bishop" had been extracted.
After Hobert put away the Beyonder characteristics, he also recovered the "Order Tree" which had turned back into an ordinary wooden stick, and the two quickly left.
Seven or eight minutes later, a person walked out of the darkness. It was Mr. A. He examined the battlefield for a few seconds before frowning and said: "I have to redeploy manpower from other cities to Backlund again. It's really troublesome."
During this period of time, the Aurora Order organization in Backlund was really unlucky!
It had just been attacked by the "Nighthawks," and lost several middle-level cadres and many believers. Now they encountered an unknown enemy again, killing two of Mr. A's capable assistants.
But Mr. A didn't seem to care about these. He just thought the procedure for transferring people was more troublesome.

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 262 Selling stolen goods and collecting rewards (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the carriage on the way back, Klein examined the black mask in his hand, the black opaque crystal, imprinted with the symbol representing the "Creator."
The material of the mask was definitely good stuff, making him somewhat fond of it.
Hobert, who was next to him, smiled and said, "If you become a devotee of that one, you can also get such a mask."
Klein smiled: "I will make efforts for this."
In his heart, he was thinking: I am already a "devotee" of the "Fool", if I become a devotee of the "Creator" again, wouldn't I be a devotee of two evil gods?
What Klein didn't know was that he was actually also a devotee of the Evernight Goddess.
Saying this, Klein returned the mask to Hobert: "What if we didn't catch the target we were looking for?"
Although they killed two Sequence 6 enemies, they wouldn't dare to use their Beyonder characteristics and the formed sealed artifact in Backlund recently, otherwise Mr. A would easily find them based on the clues and come to collect the tolls.
Hobert smiled and said, "The owner of the sealed artifact also has a reward, and the bounty is 1500 pounds!"
As he spoke, he was very grateful that he became a Sequence 6 before carrying out this mission. If he had come to catch Heyman when he was Sequence 7, he could only guarantee that he could escape.
"With such a high bounty, it's not too much for me to charge 100 pounds for information, right?" Hobert asked with a smile.
Klein immediately replied, "Not at all!"
Although he found the person, and Hobert's information was wrong, Klein didn't encounter too much danger because of the misinformation.
Just as Hobert had promised before, he charged forward and Klein covered him, so Klein was very satisfied with what he got.
Hobert nodded: "Okay, I'll take 800 pounds of the bounty, and you take 700 pounds.
"As for that sealed artifact, we'll split it equally. If you want it, I'll give it to you, and you can make up the corresponding price difference. If you don't want it, I'll ask the Nighthawks team if they want it."
Klein was stunned: "This bounty mission wasn't issued by the Nighthawks team, was it?"
"You guessed it right." Hobert smiled and said, "I know you don't want to interact with them, so I'll come forward to collect and sell the bounty and the sealed artifact.
"As for the Beyonder characteristics of this 'Rose Bishop', although I have a channel to sell Beyonder characteristics, I think it's best to wait a while before selling it.
"In addition, I basically eliminated this enemy. How about I give you an extra 300 pounds and the Beyonder characteristics belong to me?"
The nature of Beyonder characteristics is different from that of sealed artifacts. Hillman, the owner of the sealed artifact, was found by Hobert, so he has the right to split it equally with Hobert, but Klein didn't contribute much to the battle against the "Rose Bishop."
Klein hummed: "The price you gave is very fair." To him, the 300 pounds was like free money.
Roughly calculated, he would earn more than 2,000 pounds from this not-so-dangerous commission, which was much higher than he had expected.
With these 2,000 pounds, he could consider buying the main materials for Sequence 6 in advance.
This made Klein couldn't help but sigh at the benefits of having an official background, being able to know in advance about some commissions with generous bounties and controllable danger levels.
"Okay, that's settled." Hobert paused: "How should I notify you to collect the money after I get the bounty?"
"You can send the letter to the Quelaag Club." Then Klein gave Hobert the address of the club.
Hobert said, "If you want to find me, still send the letter to the law firm."
After the two agreed on the contact address, Klein got off the carriage early.
Hobert looked at his pocket watch, it was only a little after nine in the evening, so he instructed the coachman to go to the Blackthorn Security Company in the Northern District.
At around ten thirty, Hobert glanced at the night sky obscured by the mist and knocked on the door of the Blackthorn Security Company.
Today, Borgia was on duty in the reception hall, receiving police officers who might come to seek help at any time.
Hobert told him that he was here to collect the bounty, and Borgia led him to the captain's office.
Captain Thomas, as a "Sleepless" pathway Beyonder, has not yet formed a family, and basically spends 20 hours a day in the Blackthorn Security Company.
Hearing Hobert's intention, Thomas's first reaction was: "You caught Heyman?"
"No, I killed Hillman."
Thomas looked Hobert up and down.
Hobert explained, "Hillman was in a very bad state, and couldn't even use many of the 'Rose Bishop's' abilities, and I also had a companion."
Thomas nodded, which made sense.
He knew that Hobert had advanced to Sequence 7, but he also knew that from Sequence 7 onwards, a large amount of acting would be required to digest the potion. He didn't think Hobert could be promoted to Sequence 6 so quickly.
Hobert took out the wooden box, and the heart inside was still beating, as if it still had a strong vitality.
"I think you should be able to confirm through divination that this is the sealed artifact left by Hillman. In addition to the bounty, how much are you planning to give for this sealed artifact?" Hobert simply didn't even look at the ability of this sealed artifact, it was too disgusting, he didn't want it.
Thomas asked with a smile, "What price are you planning to ask for? Well, I must remind you that you are a formal member of the Nighthawks team, and it is your duty to eliminate such extremists."
Hobert thought: Not bad, you're very skilled at using moral kidnapping!
But he was prepared: "You're right, Captain Thomas. If I killed Hillman myself, I would definitely hand over the sealed artifact to you free of charge, and I wouldn't even take the bounty.
"But as I said just now, I have a teammate. Hillman's whereabouts were all found by that teammate, who played a huge role in this commission.
"Precisely because I am a formal member, I thought of selling the sealed artifact to the Nighthawks at the first time, but if the price is too low, my teammate also has the right to change a buyer."
Hobert looked embarrassed: "This is the disadvantage of earning a bounty with someone!"
Thomas twitched the corner of his mouth: If I believed a single word of yours, I would have been a captain for so many years for nothing.
He waved his hand: "Alright, alright, name your price."
"One-fifth of a 'Judge's' Beyonder characteristics and 2,000 pounds in cash." Hobert had already thought about it.
Thomas nodded: "Okay."
To him, this price was very fair, the Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 6 were probably worth 2,500 pounds.
He added: "But this amount of money is too large, I need to report it to the Archbishop. Come and collect it at eight o'clock tomorrow morning."
Archbishop Anthony was even more dedicated than Thomas, spending 22 hours a day in his office. If everything went smoothly, the approval of this payment could be completed in the second half of the night.
Coming out of the Blackthorn Security Company, Hobert saw that the fog outside had become very thick. At this time, the entire Backlund seemed to have fallen into sleep, and only some homeless people were still wandering on the streets.
They didn't make any sound, just walking aimlessly, as if the streets under their feet would never end.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 263: Unstable Factors in Loen (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Waking up in the morning, Hobert stared at the ceiling for a while, and after a long time, he finally gritted his teeth and completed the first major task of the day: getting out of bed.
Because he woke up a little late, there was no time to make breakfast himself, so Hobert bought a pie and took a rented carriage to the North District while eating.
Arriving at the Blackthorn Security Company, he greeted Loretta, who was still clearly sleepy, and arrived at Thomas's office at eight o'clock sharp.
Thomas was reading the newspaper: "You're very punctual."
He put down the newspaper and pointed to the box and a small cloth bag on the table: "We have confirmed that it is indeed the sealed artifact left by Hillman, and the reward has been issued.
"In addition, your previous merits have accumulated four-fifths of the 'Judge' Beyonder characteristic. With this one-fifth accumulation, you can receive this Beyonder characteristic."
Hobert closed the door, first opened the wooden box, and saw a white cube that looked like crystal. It seemed to have life and gave people a sense of majesty. It was indeed the Beyonder characteristic of 'Judge'.
Hobert then briefly counted the banknotes and, after confirming that they were correct, chatted briefly with Captain Thomas and left.
He had another transaction to conduct today. At a little after nine o'clock, Hobert arrived at the Mercenary Club and waited for the masked man Byron while drinking a cup of tea.
The two came to a small reception room. Hobert took out the 'Madman' and 'Werewolf' Beyonder characteristics from the 'Werewolf' Beyonder characteristic that Elliot had sacrificed before.
Byron asked curiously: "Are there so many 'Rose School' Beyonders in Backlund?"
"A friend of mine learned that I have a channel for selling Beyonder characteristics, so he asked me to help resell them," Hobert casually made up a reason. "Didn't you say you wouldn't ask about the source? If you ask about the source, you have to pay more."
The extra money was for the mental effort of making up reasons.
"Sorry, I'm just a little curious." Byron smiled. "Okay, this isn't our first time cooperating. How about 600 pounds for the 'Madman' and 1200 pounds for the 'Werewolf'?"
"You definitely won't be able to sell it for this price anywhere else."
Hobert nodded: "Deal!"
As Byron said, he was already offering a very good price.
There wasn't much demand for the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Prisoner' pathway in Backlund. It wasn't worth it to make a trip to the Southern Continent to sell them, and it was very dangerous. Therefore, even if the Beyonder characteristics of this pathway reached Sequence 7, it was very likely that they wouldn't sell for the basic price.
After settling the financial matters, Hobert asked again: "I have some information about the 'Judgement Group' here. Are you interested?"
Byron smiled: "Should I call you the Scourge of Evil? You not only have so many Beyonder characteristics of the 'Rose School' in your hands, but you're also starting to go against the 'Judgement Group'."
Hobert's expression was a little unnatural. Last night, he had just killed two members of the Aurora Order. If Byron knew, his title of "Scourge of Evil" would really be confirmed.
After Byron made a joke, he continued to ask: "What type of information?"
"Information on the three vice-captains."
"Do you have portraits or names?"
"I have portraits."
Byron thought for a moment: "600 pounds."
He paused and explained: "Your information may overlap with the information we already have."
"Okay, but I have one more condition. I can ask one question about the 'Judgement Group'."
Byron said: "As long as it doesn't involve too much confidential information, uh, even if it involves some confidential information, I will tell you at my discretion."
He said with a smile: "I look forward to the day when you can kill a vice-captain of the 'Judgement Group'."
"It is the duty of every citizen of the Loen Kingdom to deal with such evil forces," Hobert said nonsense while taking out the three portraits he had prepared from his briefcase.
These three portraits were drawn by Hobert using his own divination. They were lifelike, and in the lower right corner were information such as hair color and pupil color.
Byron was very satisfied with this information. They only knew some basic information about the beautiful young woman and the sinister old man before, but they didn't know their appearances. After Byron got the portraits, he compared them with the previous basic information and knew who they were.
However, when he saw Gale's portrait, Byron frowned and asked: "Are you sure this is a vice-captain of the 'Judgement Group'?"
Hobert replied very certainly: "I'm sure!"
"That shouldn't be!" Byron said: "He should be a senior cadre of the 'Intersea Mutual Aid Society'! How is he also a vice-captain of the 'Judgement Group'?"
Hobert followed Byron's words and asked: "What kind of organization is the 'Intersea Mutual Aid Society'?"
"It is an Beyonder organization secretly supported by the Feysac Empire, mainly active in the Intersea County and the Winter County." Byron did not hide anything and answered Hobert's question casually.
This answer also made Hobert a little confused. Terrorist organizations are not scientific research institutions. Do they also pay attention to affiliation and mutual learning?
Byron shook his head and did not continue to think about this question. He pointed to the portrait of the sinister old man to Hobert and said: "You should be very familiar with this old man."
Hobert was stunned: "Why would I be familiar with him?"
"Is this the question you want to ask in the condition you just proposed?"
"Yes." In fact, Hobert wanted to ask if the 'Judgement Group' had the background of the Feysac Empire? However, Byron's previous words had already given Hobert the answer to this question.
Regardless of what Gale's dual identity meant, his channel in the 'Intersea Mutual Aid Society' might be able to obtain the potion formula for the Sequence 5 'Guardian' of the 'Warrior' pathway.
Byron put away the three portraits while answering: "I heard from my colleagues that you completed the commission to eliminate two cultist cadres some time ago.
"Those two cultist cadres came from a cult organization called the 'Spiritual Cultivation Society'. They have been looking for ways to seize the spirituality of others and make themselves stronger, so they have done many cruel experiments."
Hobert thought: Is their president called 'Old Monster Star Constellation' Ding Chunqiu?
Byron continued: "The president of the 'Spiritual Cultivation Society' is called Steven, the old man you drew. We also learned from the mercenaries who captured the headquarters of the 'Spiritual Cultivation Society' that Steven is a vice-captain of the 'Judgement Group'!"
Suddenly, a line connected many clues in Hobert's mind: The 'Spiritual Cultivation Society' is a cult secretly supported by the Feynapotter Kingdom, and the founder of this cult is one of the core members of the 'Judgement Group'.
Then, the 'Judgement Group' must also have the secret support of the Feynapotter Kingdom, and even the captain whose appearance cannot be seen may be a nobleman of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
If this guess is true, it is not surprising that the captain has a high-level sealed artifact that makes the information obtained by spiritualism very vague.
As for Gale's identity as a 'domestic servant (两性家奴?),' it is easy to understand. In the current international situation in the Northern Continent, the Feynapotter Kingdom and the Feysac Empire, two countries that do not share borders, are allies.
Then, the organizations they each support, which undermine the stability of the Loen Kingdom, must have some 'business dealings' or cooperation. Gale should be the 'liaison officer' of these two organizations.

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 264 Trading Day (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In that moment, Hobert understood many things, but he didn't plan to tell Byron this information.
It wasn't a good thing for a wild Beyonder with an official background to know too much intelligence about countries sabotaging each other.
"Luckily, I brought extra money." Byron counted out another 600 pounds and handed it to Hobert.
After the intelligence transaction, the two finished their tea, shook hands, and left.
Now, the pounds Hobert carried were bulging the briefcase.
The intelligence transaction just now, plus the Beyonder characteristic transactions of "Lunatic" and "Werewolf", earned Hobert a total of 2400 pounds.
Including the bounty he received from Thomas and the proceeds from selling the Sealed Artifact, he had a total of 3500 pounds.
Adding the two together, this was already a huge sum.
Hobert went to the bank again, withdrew the approximately 7000 in cash he had saved, plus the 510 he had previously used to resell the "Hurricane Axe", and the nearly 100 in pocket money Hobert carried.
When he placed all the pounds on the desk in his bedroom, Hobert couldn't help but swallow. The huge sum of over 13,000 pounds in front of him was equivalent to about 40 million in the AD era.
This was indeed a huge sum that Hobert had never seen before. He admired it for a few minutes before finally looking away, using the method of sacrificing to himself to put 11,000 pounds in cash and the Beyonder characteristic of "Judge" into the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert took out 300 pounds of the remaining 2500 pounds and put it in his wallet, then packed the remaining 2200 pounds in a paper bag and put it in his briefcase.
Coming to the first floor, Hobert first wrote a letter, notifying Klein to come and collect the bounty before 5:00 PM today, or after 8:00 AM tomorrow.
Then he simply hired a taxi carriage to send the letter to the Quelaag Club, so that the letter could be delivered in about an hour.
At noon, Hobert treated Fors to a delicious barbecue. In the afternoon, he went to the office to work, while Fors continued to go back to "conceive a new book".
As soon as he arrived at the office, Jessica sent a letter from Mr. Digos, stating that the two water pumps had been completed and were ready to be traded at any time.
Hobert sighed, today was really a trading day, the amount of transactions he completed in one day had reached thousands of pounds!
He locked the office door and prayed to himself: "...Great 'Creator', please notify Upton to go to the Keen Machinery Firm to pick up the goods, store them in the warehouse, and make a sacrifice tomorrow morning."
Hobert had already greeted Digos in advance. The Keen Machinery Firm would not reveal any information about Hobert, so there was no need to worry about Upton learning Hobert's specific information during the transaction.
Entering the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert couldn't help but admire the pounds on the stone platform for a few seconds, before throwing his mosaic prayer screen into Upton's star.
Then Hobert notified Elliot to prepare for the sacrifice tomorrow morning.
When he was about to leave the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert saw that the star representing Rafter was lit up again. This baronet was really persistent, and he was praying to the "Creator" again.
Hobert ignored the prayer and left the "Nation of Disorder".
Back in the real world, Hobert had just withdrawn his thoughts from the pile of pounds and put them on work when Klein arrived.
Hobert estimated that Klein should have been waiting at the Quelaag Club. After receiving the news, he rushed over immediately.
Jessica poured a cup of black tea for the guest, and then closed the office door under Hobert's gaze.
Hobert took out the paper bag from the briefcase and said, "You can get 700 pounds for this mission.
"The Sealed Artifact was sold for 2500 pounds, but because it used my channel, a 100 pound commission will be charged, and you can get 1200 pounds.
"Plus the previously agreed upon 300 pounds for the Beyonder characteristic of 'Rose Bishop', you can get a total of 2200 pounds."
After speaking, Hobert pushed the paper bag to Klein.
After hearing this number, Klein, who had already guessed it, was still a little surprised.
He thought to himself: No wonder in my divination, my hope is in Backlund. Now it seems that the 'City of Hope' really has many ways to make money quickly.
After Klein counted the money, he took out 200 pounds and pushed it towards Hobert: "I didn't play any role in last night's battle. It would be very unfair to only take 300 pounds."
Hobert smiled and pushed the money back: "If it weren't for your divination, I wouldn't have made this money at all. This 300 pounds is for your divination fee."
Unlike the conflict with the members of the "Judgement Group" the day before yesterday, in Carrie's commission, she and Jessica didn't play much of a role in the battle either.
But in yesterday's commission, Klein found the location of the target. This was a very important role, and his contribution was worth 300 pounds.
Of course, Hobert, who had become Sequence 6, could have swallowed the Beyonder characteristic of "Rose Bishop" alone, and Klein wouldn't dare to have any objections, but that would be boring, and it would be difficult to cooperate in the future.
It's better to be generous and give a divination fee that even Klein would be soft-handed, and when Klein becomes a "High Sequence", today's generosity will become a favor.
After distributing the bounty, Hobert said again: "Your sister and brother will come to Backlund this week to relax. I plan to take them to the Roselle Memorial Exhibition on Sunday."
Klein's eyes narrowed.
"It's not what you think." Hobert smiled slightly: "You are just a Sequence 8, not enough for me to threaten you with your family."
He said: "I actually went to Tingen City before to help Elizabeth's father with a lawsuit, that is, your sister's good friend Elizabeth.
"Later, we kept in touch by letter, and I learned about the recent situation of your family, so I asked them to come to Backlund with Elizabeth.
"If you want to see them, you can go to the exhibition hall on Sunday morning."
"Forget it." Klein took a deep breath: "Forget it."
Hobert spread his hands: "The choice is yours."
After sending Klein away, Hobert dealt with a few urgent tasks before having time to review last night's battle.
Overall, Hobert was quite satisfied with his performance last night. He also had his own ideas and tactics for battles between Sequence 6s.
Then he began to think about how to play the "Baron of Corruption". Until today, he didn't have a good idea.
The description of the "Baron of Corruption" on the "Black Emperor" card is: The people around the "Baron of Corruption" will always become greedy and dark, and the "Baron" will use their greed and darkness to firmly control them. At the same time, the "Barons" will carefully manage their territory or industry.
Through this description, the key points of Hobert's acting are: constantly eroding the hearts of the people around him; carefully managing the territory or industry.
Hobert believes that the title of "Baron" in "Baron of Corruption" should have been in the Fourth Epoch. This is to remind the Beyonder that they must have their own territory when they reach Sequence 6 of the "Black Emperor".
This is crucial for the digestion of the potion and future promotion.
Of course, according to the description, it doesn't have to be a territory, it can also be owning your own industry, but there must be a place where you have the final say.
Hobert sighed. Whether it was eroding the hearts of the people around him or owning a territory or industry, it was difficult to do in Backlund.
It's not that he is unwilling to do so, but the practice of "eroding the mind" is too conspicuous in this metropolis, and it is easy to cause him a lot of trouble.
It seems that it's time to leave Backlund and go to the South Continent with "Creator" believers to develop. Hobert sighed inwardly.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 265 The Second Bribe to the "Creator"
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Friday morning, Backlund, factory district, 16 Howells Avenue.
Upton looked at the sky, which seemed to be covered with dark clouds. It would take until after nine o'clock for the sunlight to break through the mist and let the people of Backlund know that today was actually a sunny day.
He missed the beaches of Conant City a little. There, he could see the sky no matter when he looked up, and even the starry sky at night.
Thinking, Upton entered the yard of a warehouse.
Howells Avenue is a famous "Warehouse Avenue". Both sides of this avenue are basically all kinds of warehouses.
Some goods are temporarily stored here and transported from here to the dock area on the next street, and some goods are transported from the dock area to here for temporary storage.
Upton's company is registered here. At present, his company only has two necessary clerks and a coachman. When he needs to move goods, he will hire some temporary labor.
The clerks' office is not here. Upton looked around to make sure that no one was following or noticing him. Then he opened the warehouse door and went in, and immediately closed the door.
The warehouse was very empty, with only two water pumps.
This is also what the employees cannot understand. Theoretically, with the current business volume of the company, the best choice is to rent a warehouse with other companies, instead of renting such a large warehouse with only two water pumps.
Of course, they don't know Upton's intentions.
Upton came to the two water pumps and began to set up the altar and build the wall of spirituality. This step took him a lot of time, after all, the water pumps were so big that he had to wrap them all in the wall of spirituality.
When everything was ready, Upton took a deep breath and began the ritual: "The Creator of human order... Your loyal servant begs for your attention;
"Begging you to accept his offering;
"Begging you to open the door of the kingdom."
After chanting, Upton burned the spiritual materials with candlelight, and waited for the "Creator" to respond with trepidation.
The "Creator" did not keep him waiting for too long. After more than ten seconds, the tall figure sitting in the middle of the sword throne appeared.
He became taller and more majestic.
Upton immediately lowered his head, and couldn't help trembling. This was a suppression of status.
With a dull sound of opening the door, the two bronze giant doors appeared, opening a not small gap.
A hurricane echoed in the wall of spirituality in front of the altar. Upton, who was lowering his head, saw the two water pumps leaving the ground together. His eyes condensed. Those were steam water pumps that required more than a dozen people to lift!
Then he smiled: I'm so stupid! I actually use the strength of ordinary people to measure the power of God!
Soon, the water pumps floated out of Upton's sight. He still lowered his head deeply until he heard the dull sound of closing the door.
"Very good!" A solemn voice said from above.
Upton quickly said: "It is my honor to serve you."
The huge pressure disappeared, and Upton dared to raise his head. The two water pumps had disappeared, as if they had never existed in the warehouse.
The simple altar on the ground proved that the sacrifice just now was not a dream.
Upton wiped the sweat from his forehead: "Praise the Creator!"
He was about to make the corresponding gesture, but found that he didn't seem to know the gesture representing the "Creator".
Upton was a little panicked, feeling that he was not pious enough. He must ask the masked man about the gesture representing the "Creator" next time he meets him.
Then he was a little excited: Listening to the "Creator"'s tone just now, it seems that he is very satisfied with my sacrifice! That is the response from God. Most Beyonders in this world have never received any reply from God in their entire lives.
While cleaning up the altar, he felt that he had made the right bet when he asked the masked man for help.
...
Southern Continent, Hodis Copper Mine.
On the open ground in front of the copper mine, a simple but solemn altar was set up. In front of the altar were two huge wooden carts. Elliott was holding a leather whip and personally directing the slaves to wipe the altar for the final time.
Zachary and several other family members were smoking and laughing while watching Elliott in the morning light beside the altar.
They were the first people to take over the copper mine and did not know that Elliott's sister Moira had recovered.
One of the family members asked: "What is he thinking? He actually said that he wanted to ask the gods to bestow two water pumps. Do the gods have water pumps?"
Everyone laughed, thinking that this was the most absurd farce in the history of the Balk family.
"It's probably because you squeezed him so hard that he didn't know what to do," Zachary laughed. "We'll accompany him in a play later. Since we can't get a response from the gods, don't mention the water pump.
"At the same time, we must also appease our mine manager and say that we know that everything he has done is for the Hodis Copper Mine, but unfortunately the gods are unwilling to pay attention here."
At that time, Elliott would have no prestige at all.
When the morning light sprinkled on the altar, Elliott drove the slaves down.
He threw away the leather whip in his hand, tidied up his clothes, and walked solemnly to the altar about one meter high, lit the candles, and drew the pattern.
Zachary and the others watched with their arms folded, waiting for Elliott to make a fool of himself.
The slaves were asked to squat in the distance of the altar, and the foremen stood among them. They were all attracted by the solemnity of the mine manager and stared closely at the direction of the altar.
After the altar was set up, Elliott put the gold as a sacrifice, and took out a wooden box from his arms and opened it. In the wooden box was a section of sleeve, with some brown blood on it.
These brown blood seemed to have life, constantly flowing on the sleeve. But no matter how the blood flowed, it would not flow beyond the sleeve. Even if the blood touched the wooden box, it would not leave a trace on the wooden box.
After checking the sacrifices again, Elliott began to pray: "The Creator of human order... Your loyal servant needs your help, needs two of the latest water pumps in the Kingdom of Loen, for which I am willing to offer all the sacrifices on the altar!"
After the prayer, Elliott knelt piously in front of the altar.
A family member not far away laughed: "It's quite like it."
Zachary's expression became serious, because he had just heard the complete honorific name of the "Creator".
A few seconds later, that tall figure appeared in Elliott's mind: "Yes!"
"Praise the Creator." Elliott began to sacrifice, chanting in a solemn voice: "The Creator of human order... Your loyal servant prays for your attention;
"I pray for you to open the door of the kingdom;
"I pray for you to grant two water pumps."
Although the sacrificial words contained "water pump", which sounded a bit ridiculous, Zachary and the others couldn't laugh anymore. They felt that the altar was connected to a mysterious kingdom, and they felt a terrifying force was coming.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 266 The Creator's Request
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
As the two bronze giant doors appeared, Zachary and the others couldn't help but kneel and lower their heads.
Although the foremen and slaves couldn't see the existence of the bronze door, they could feel the powerful pressure, which made them prostrate on the ground, not daring to move.
In mid-air, a water pump weighing several tons slowly fell from the giant door in mid-air and landed on one of the large wooden carts. Then came another water pump.
Elliot looked at the two brand-new water pumps in front of the altar, and he said loudly, "Thank you for your generous gift."
He said this to Zachary and the others.
A strong wind blew up on the altar, engulfing the gold and wooden boxes on the altar into the bronze door.
The strong wind disappeared, and the bronze door disappeared with it.
Then that tall and stalwart figure among the swords appeared in mid-air. For Zachary and the others, the pressure brought by this figure was even greater. They trembled involuntarily on the ground, their hearts completely filled with fear and surprise:
"The gods have really descended! Everything they have witnessed today only appears in legends, only in fragmentary records. I didn't expect the power of the gods to be so powerful! I didn't expect the gods to be omnipotent, there really are water pumps!"
That stalwart figure said in a solemn voice: "Treat them as human beings!"
Then the huge pressure disappeared. If it weren't for the two brand-new water pumps, Zachary and the others, as well as the foremen and slaves, would have thought that the experience just now was a dream.
Zachary and the others' eyes were full of solemnity, and they no longer dared to show any disrespect to Elliot.
The foremen kowtowed to Elliot repeatedly, shouting some respectful words in the local dialect.
The slaves looked at Elliot as if they saw infinite holiness and power.
At this time, Elliot was ecstatic in his heart. First of all, he felt that the "Briber" potion had been completely digested.
In addition, just now was the first time the "Creator" had given instructions, and he fully understood that the "Creator"'s so-called "they" referred to those slaves.
But then he felt a little strange: Why should slaves be treated as human beings?
It's not that Elliot doesn't have the concept of human rights, but in this colonial era, in this era of brutal and bloody plundering of the Southern Continent by the Northern Continent, slaves cannot be equated with humans.
Whether it's because of becoming prisoners of war or being caught by human traffickers, in short, the moment a person becomes a slave, he is no longer a person, but a livestock with two legs, like horses, cattle, and sheep.
In this world without enlightened philosophers, the boundaries of many concepts are very blurred.
The moment Elliot asked that question in his heart, he almost slapped himself: How could he question the "Creator"'s instructions? Regardless of whether he understands it or not, just execute it.
Then he recalled seeing in ancient books that the "Black Emperor" would generally propose some concepts that were contrary to common sense and gradually let these concepts that were contrary to common sense penetrate people's hearts.
Today, the "Creator"'s instructions are likely to be doing something similar!
Elliot only felt his blood surging: Because I have gained the trust of the "Creator", I am qualified to spread the "Creator"'s ideas!
Thinking of this, Elliot got up in excitement and saw Zachary and the others beside the altar bowing slightly to him, their faces full of respect.
He once again praised the "Creator" in his heart, and then said to them: "This is the water pump you want."
One of the family members asked: "Why is the style of these two water pumps so strange?"
Everyone's eyes turned to him, and the family member quickly explained: "I, I didn't mean anything else, I'm just curious."
"Because this is the latest type of water pump," Elliot said kindly.
A new problem arose: No one would use the new type of water pump.
Fortunately, the water pump also came with instructions, but when opened, it was a Ruenese instruction manual.
Since decades ago, General Anthony's territory has been a colony of the Feysac Empire. Here, Feysac is the official language.
Only the family member who had previously proposed buying a water pump from Loen understood Loenese, so Elliot assigned him the task of debugging and using the water pump. He also ordered another family member to escort another water pump to another copper mine.
After explaining these things, Elliot looked around the altar and then pointed to an open space not far away and said: "Starting tomorrow, build houses there. Design two rows of bunk beds in the houses so that all the slaves can live in the houses."
Everyone was stunned, not understanding what Elliot was going to do.
Elliot then pointed to the slaves being punished in the distance and continued: "Put down the slaves hanging on those poles!"
In the horse pen and slave pen, there were several high wooden poles with several slaves tied by their arms and being punished.
Generally, they would be hung for three days and three nights. If they died, they died. If they didn't die, they would continue to work.
They would be punished like this, often for making some minor mistakes, such as making eye contact with the foremen, speaking without being told, and so on.
Elliot said: "From now on, you can punish slaves, but you can't kill slaves at will. Whether it's the foremen or you, if anyone kills slaves for pleasure again, I will severely punish him!"
"The food standard for slaves must also be improved accordingly. Give them coarse grains, and don't give them stale grains or wheat bran from a few years ago. Let them eat meat and refined grains once a week."
Zachary quickly reminded: "In this case, our costs will be much higher."
Elliot glanced at him coldly, and Zachary lowered his head: "I'll do it right away."
Elliot hummed and sighed in his heart: The taste of power is really wonderful!
...
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" stared blankly at the gold in front of him for a while. Just now, he saw the slaves hanging on the high poles and the slaves in the distance of the altar with only tattered rags covering their bodies, and he felt moved to let Elliot treat them as human beings.
Hobert didn't continue to think about this issue. He only has so much ability now and won't do things beyond his ability.
There's nothing to see in gold. As for the weight, I believe Elliot wouldn't dare to make small moves on this.
Hobert focused his attention on the wooden box. Using the position of "Nation of Disorder", he knew that this was a sealed item left by Sequence 6 "Zombie" of the "Prisoner" pathway.
Holding this sleeve stained with brown blood in his palm, Hobert learned of its ability: "The wearer's body will become as hard as steel; can resist some magical attacks; movement will become very fast; can use some frost spells."
Hobert was stunned. This sealed item can just make up for his weakness of not being strong in defense!
It's a pity that its negative effects are a bit big.

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 267 The Blessing of the "Mother Tree of Desire"
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne", looked at the sealed artifact in his palm.
Its negative effects were: "The holder will be cursed after wearing it for a cumulative hour, turning into a werewolf during the full moon, losing all reason, and attacking every human encountered. After wearing it continuously for ten minutes, the holder will unconsciously believe in the 'Mother Tree of Desire'. Even without wearing it continuously for ten minutes, accumulating ten wears will lead to involuntary belief in the 'Mother Tree of Desire'."
Hiss~
Hobert took a deep breath. The ability of this sealed artifact was wonderful and exactly what he needed most right now, but the negative effects were quite terrifying!
Whether it was turning into a werewolf or believing in the 'Mother Tree of Desire', both were unacceptable to Hobert.
So, he waved his hand and gathered surging "Power of Order", enveloping the sealed artifact.
The brown bloodstains on his sleeves immediately trembled, accelerating their flow as if trying to escape the surging power of order.
After being sealed by the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert looked at the negative effects of the sealed artifact again. The original curse after wearing it for a cumulative hour, turning into a werewolf during the full moon, now became: "Wearing it for more than two hours will result in a curse, turning into a werewolf during the full moon."
This was completely different. If the wearing time did not exceed two hours each time, he would not be cursed.
However, to Hobert's surprise, there were no changes regarding the negative effects concerning the "Mother Tree of Desire".
Hobert frowned. He might need to become a demigod or even an angel before he could use the "Nation of Disorder" to seal the relevant negative effects of the Outer Deity, the "Mother Tree of Desire".
This was different from shattering the Beyonder characteristics of the "Werewolf" before. That time, at most, the "Mother Tree of Desire" had exerted influence on the Beyonder characteristics, while this time it concerned the negative effects related to the "Mother Tree of Desire".
The difference between the two was like a cup of diluted sugar water and a piece of rock candy. Hobert could use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to shatter the influence of the "Mother Tree of Desire" on the Beyonder characteristics, but that was completely different from the negative effects directly pointing to the "Mother Tree of Desire".
There was no choice but to shatter this sealed artifact into Beyonder characteristics. At least, it could be sold for money if it became Beyonder characteristics. If it remained in the state of a sealed artifact, it would be difficult to sell.
However, Hobert planned to keep the re-condensed Beyonder characteristics for a while to see if he could find an "Artisan" skilled at making magical items. For him now, the ability of "Zombie" could make up for his shortcomings.
Of course, turning the Beyonder characteristics of the "Dawn Paladin" that he had seized some time ago into a magical item should also yield good abilities.
But it was highly unlikely that he could obtain the "Sword of Dawn" and the "Armor of Dawn" together. What Hobert needed now was defense, so the ability retained when the Beyonder characteristics of "Zombie" were made into a magical item could better meet Hobert's needs.
Hobert reached out and summoned a surge of "Power of Disorder". The sleeve shook violently and soon turned into fragments, leaving only a mass of brown blood. Then the blood also began to dilute.
Huh!
Hobert suddenly discovered that there seemed to be something in the blood that was difficult to be shattered by the "Power of Disorder". It felt like grains of sand in rice or bone fragments in meat.
He casually summoned a rock from the "Nation of Disorder". It was a granite, looking like it was composed of grains of colorful sand.
Although it came from the "Nation of Disorder", it was just an ordinary stone with no extraordinary effects.
Hobert "picked" out the "hard" thing from the brown blood and attached it to the stone.
The stone immediately turned into a red and green mottled color, and its texture also changed significantly, becoming a piece of jade with red and green twisted together.
Using the high sequence of the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert immediately felt: as long as he held this jade, he could "bestow blessings" on enemies, making them sincerely believe in the "Mother Tree of Desire". It can be used twice.
Bestow blessings? Hobert thought: This is the most vicious curse!
He decided that he would only use the ability of this jade on vicious enemies, which would be a more severe punishment than directly killing them.
Then Hobert named the thing in his hand "Cursed Jade" and placed it on the stone table next to the umbilical cord of the evil god's offspring.
At this time, the mass of brown blood had almost turned into a ball of light. Hobert used the "Power of Order" to wrap them, accelerating the speed of condensation.
Because he planned to make it into a magical item, Hobert did not let this Beyonder characteristic split, but gathered them together, which would eventually form an Beyonder characteristic, but it contained the power of the "Prisoner" pathway from Sequence 9 to Sequence 6.
After Hobert became Sequence 6, the speed of shattering and condensing Beyonder characteristics became much faster. Under the package of the "Power of Order", this Beyonder characteristic could be re-condensed in about one or two hours.
And before, it would take at least twenty hours to do this process.
Back in the real world, Hobert stood by the window, staring at the scene on the street in a daze for a while: Elliot completed the second bribe. After his story with the "Creator" spread in the family, the Balk family would be an extraordinary family with enough goodwill towards the "Creator".
Wait a little longer, Hobert thought: when Elliot has other things to ask of him, then propose that he has a "Favored One" who wants to go to the Southern Continent to gain experience, and let the Balk family pick him up.
Hobert took a deep breath, picked up the prepared brand-new cotton cloth, and carefully wiped the Tang sword.
He used it to chop such disgusting things the night before yesterday, and he hasn't had time to wipe it properly.
Again, using the "Order Wood" to wrap the Tang sword, disguising it as the shape of a cane, Hobert put on his coat, called a rental carriage, went to the office to pick up Jessica, and the two came to Viscount Glaint's mansion to attend the "Justice League" gathering.
As Audrey said in her letter, she also introduced a new member: Earl Wolfe's youngest daughter, Corati.
A very dignified and generous lady, with a good appearance, figure, and dress, but she can only be a "green leaf" beside Audrey.
Like when Earl Vincent's youngest son, Karl, joined last time, in an undisturbed room, Hobert used the "Psychological Spoon" to give Jessica and Corati psychological cues, making them keep the secrets of the "Justice League".
After the "joining ceremony", Corati sat behind Audrey, and Jessica sat behind Hobert.
When all the members were present, Hobert glanced at Karl, whose cheeks were swollen high, "Let's begin!"
