chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 268 Audrey discovers a big secret
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
A minute before Hobert announced the start of the gathering, Audrey whispered to her good friend, Corati, "Do you remember what Hobert the lawyer said to you in the room?"
"I don't remember," Corati said. "I only remember the intoxicating smell of burning herbs, and then I became dizzy. When I came to my senses, Mr. Hobert said it was okay."
Audrey smiled slightly, curious about what Hobert had done. Did it really work?
Then, as an "Spectator member," she began to examine the other members.
After becoming a "Telepathist," Audrey's observational skills had greatly improved. She could now glean a lot of information from other people's expressions and the details of their clothing or movements.
She saw that Viscount Glaint seemed troubled, as if he was preparing to make some inquiries at the gathering later.
She saw fear in Karl's eyes, and he didn't dare to look at Hobert. There were also injuries on his face. Had Hobert beaten him like this?
She saw that Fors's smile was more confident than before, but her lazy temperament remained unchanged.
She saw Xio talking to Hobert. The subtle expressions and movements Xio revealed showed that she trusted Hobert very much, and even had a slight dependence on him.
She saw that the new member Hobert brought seemed to admire Hobert. This was evident in her eyes, but the new member was very wary of the others.
Audrey was very satisfied with the improvement in her observational skills. Finally, she looked at Hobert, who was sitting at the head of the table. He still liked to wear trench coats, his smile was still infectious, and his movements and posture all showed his confidence. Wait...
Audrey suddenly realized, why were some of Hobert's habitual movements so similar to Mr. Emperor?
Although Mr. Emperor preferred to wear shirts and gave people a more rigorous feeling than Hobert, Audrey recalled that the first time she met Hobert, he was also wearing a shirt.
At that time, the feeling he gave people was very similar to Mr. Emperor!
The more Audrey thought about it, the more she thought of the similarities between Hobert and Mr. Emperor, such as their erudition and the reliable feeling they both gave.
Audrey overlapped the figures of the two people, and they were simply one person!
Audrey was somewhat surprised by her own idea, and almost couldn't maintain her Spectator state!
At this time, Audrey was quite certain that Hobert was Mr. Emperor!
She also thought that Hobert was the eldest son of General Christian, and of course he could also join the mercenary club and master the relevant channels and information. Then the previous investigation direction was all wrong.
Audrey quickly calmed down. She didn't intend to reveal this, because that would also expose that she was "Justice."
But she was very excited in her heart: those who can join the Tarot Club are indeed very good and full of justice.
"Let's begin!" Hobert said at this time. He glanced at Audrey and found that she seemed a little strange, but he didn't think too much about it.
Hobert had also imagined that the disguise he had been using all along might be seen through by Audrey, after all, this was the field that Spectator was best at.
But what he didn't expect was that it would be seen through now.
Hobert smiled and said, "I reiterate once again that the secrets of the 'Justice League' must be kept. As for the consequences of not keeping them, I think you can consult Mr. Karl."
Everyone was stunned. The participating members had long been curious about the injuries on Karl's face, but this might involve privacy, and it was not easy to ask.
Hearing Hobert say this, everyone looked at Karl.
"I swear, I didn't have the idea of actively leaking secrets," Karl quickly explained. "After I got the potion formula and the main ingredients, I went to my father to verify it."
He smiled bitterly: "My father asked me where the formula and main ingredients came from? I was just about to speak, but I don't know why, I raised my hand and started slapping myself, and I couldn't stop."
Hobert smiled and said, "You must have wanted to answer 'Justice League,' right?"
Karl smiled unnaturally: "My father has always been very dignified, and it is difficult to lie in front of him."
This made the new members Jessica and Corati both surprised and worried, but Audrey nodded with a sense of security: this is what a mysterious organization should be like.
Glaint wondered, "Didn't you take the potion a long time ago? Why are the injuries on your face still there?"
Karl's smile just now pulled at the injury, and he covered his cheek and replied: "When I was going out, my elder brother asked me where I was going, so..."
He sighed: "My elder brother is also very dignified, and it is also difficult to lie in front of him."
Fors was even more curious: "Did you tell him that you were here to attend the 'Justice League' gathering?"
Karl shook his head: "No, the slaps were very heavy, I couldn't speak at all."
Everyone wanted to laugh, but they were embarrassed to laugh.
Fors asked again: "Didn't your elder brother come with you, or send someone to follow you?"
Karl honestly replied: "He was going to come with me, but my father stopped him, and my father also told me to seize the opportunity before me."
Hobert glanced at Glaint, and the young viscount immediately understood Hobert's meaning, opened his pocket watch and looked at it, then shook his head. The gathering was not being monitored at the moment.
In other words, Karl's father regarded Karl's current encounter as a child's adventure. After all, in the Loen Kingdom, even an earl would have difficulty obtaining the main ingredients for the "Arbiter" pathway.
And the secret gatherings of Beyonders in Backlund, if not 100, then 80. Before Karl encountered a life-threatening danger, Earl Vincent obviously did not intend to interfere.
Hobert said to Karl, "Fortunately, you didn't intend to actively betray the 'Justice League', otherwise you would definitely regret this decision."
Karl quickly said: "Of course I won't betray everyone."
Jessica, who was sitting behind Hobert, asked: "We will inevitably mention the 'Justice League' to our friends. How can we avoid the same experience as this gentleman?"
Hobert evaluated in his heart: very promising. Through Karl's description, she discovered that there were certain loopholes that could be used to circumvent the same experience as Karl.
"Just use 'that organization' or 'that gathering' to replace it," Hobert said. "But if you want to leak information about the members of the 'Justice League', or the secrets discussed at the gathering, you will also have the same experience as Mr. Karl.
"Let me give you an example. You tell your friend: something was traded from 'that gathering'. This is okay.
"But if you say it in more detail, such as who it was traded with, even if you only describe the appearance, it won't work."
Jessica asked again: "What if it's someone we already know? Like us, I've known Hobert the lawyer for a long time. Do I have to avoid mentioning Hobert the lawyer's name in the future?"
Hobert was very satisfied with Jessica's question. This indirectly showed that she already possessed a keen "sense of order", which was very important for Beyonders on the "Black Emperor" pathway.
"As long as what you want to express is not 'Hobert on the Justice League', but 'Hobert the lawyer' you encounter in your daily work, it's okay," Hobert further explained:
"Your own thoughts are very important. As long as you have the idea of leaking secrets, you will be punished. If you don't have such an idea, then it's okay."
Jessica nodded: "I understand."
In this way, it will not have a great impact on normal life.
Karl covered his cheek and sighed: "It can still be like this?"
Hobert thought to himself: I hope that the higher sequence potion of the "Arbiter" pathway can make this kid smarter in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 269 Hobert's Sales Channel
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert said, "Now we enter the trading phase. Who wants to start?"
Corati, sitting behind Audrey, raised her hand and said, "Audrey told me that I can trade for a potion formula here and become a true Beyonder being?"
"That's right," Hobert said with a smile. "What pathway do you want to become an Beyonder being of?"
He said, "At this gathering, you can trade for the initial formulas of many pathways."
Corati asked curiously, "What are they?"
"Let me start with what I have here," Hobert said. "There's a potion that can grant excellent eloquence and the ability to distort others' thoughts at certain times.
"There's a potion that can see the dead and enhance physical fitness."
"There's a potion that grants excellent memory and enhances learning ability."
"There's a potion that grants a wealth of mystical knowledge, increases spirituality, and allows for various magical rituals.
"Oh, right, there's also a potion that grants a strong physique and proficiency in combat."
Fors and Xio were both stunned, not expecting Hobert to possess so many initial potion formulas for Beyonder pathways.
Based on their knowledge, they roughly understood that Hobert was referring to the initial formulas for "Lawyer", "Corpse Collector", "Savant", "Secrets Suppliant", and "Warrior."
Hobert probably also knew the potion formulas for "Arbitor" and "Apprentice", but he didn't mention them.
Xio felt Hobert looking at her and understood Hobert's meaning: "I have a potion here that can enhance personal charm and make one more convincing."
Karl across from them explained, "A potion pathway possessed by the royal family."
Then, Fors said, "I have a potion here that allows one to walk through walls."
Glaint said, "I have a potion here that imparts knowledge for concocting various potions and poisons."
Audrey really wanted to describe the Spectator potion as well, but she was currently claiming to be searching for clues to the "Psychological Alchemists", so she had to hold back for now.
Then, she belatedly realized: Adding my Spectator potion, the "Justice League" actually possesses the potion formulas for nine initial pathways!
Of course, this was thanks to Hobert, who alone possessed the initial formulas for five pathways.
This also surprised Jessica, who was sitting behind Hobert. The most important thing she wanted to do at the gathering today was to trade with Hobert for the "Barbarian" potion.
Through the previous battle, she had naturally guessed that Hobert was in the same pathway as her.
However, meeting at the company usually and the work environment weren't suitable for Beyonder transactions, so she wanted to take advantage of this gathering to complete the transaction and, by the way, peddle her friend's products.
As for the other members, she had been maintaining a high degree of vigilance. She could tell that the few sitting to Hobert's right were all aristocratic children, and she had hated arrogant nobles since she was a child.
After the members of the gathering were all present, Jessica only regarded this as a mystical gathering among nobles, but what she never expected was that this gathering actually had such "background."
Corati was also surprised that she had so many choices and was having difficulty deciding for a moment, so she asked Hobert, who looked very reliable, "Mr. Hobert, do you have any recommendations?"
Hobert asked, "What is your purpose in becoming an Beyonder being? Or does your family have any requirements in that regard?"
"I just want to have some Beyonder abilities, Beyonder abilities that make me feel safe," Corati's expression was a little dim. "My mother's background isn't very good, so the family doesn't have any requirements for me."
Audrey said, "But Corati is a very kind and gentle lady, and also a loyal friend and reliable partner."
"Thank you, Audrey," Corati's face regained its smile.
Hobert nodded, trusting Audrey's "judgment" very much: "My suggestion is Miss Fors's pathway, or Glaint's choice.
"The former will grant you unexpected escape skills, while the latter can give you and your family a healthy body.
"Of course, if you want to have a position in the family, choose Miss Xio or me. Our two choices have more opportunities to serve the royal family."
Corati considered for a moment: "Miss Fors and Viscount Glaint, can you describe your Beyonder abilities in more detail?"
"I might as well demonstrate it," Fors stood up and made a door-opening gesture on the wall. An illusory door immediately appeared on the wall, and Fors walked through the wall. A few seconds later, she walked back through the wall.
She smiled and said, "After taking the potion of this pathway, there is no place that can trap you anymore.
"Subsequent potions will grant you some minor spells, and if used well, they will have very good effects."
Fors still remembered that in the battle initiated by Hobert that she participated in before, the enemy's "Astrologer" only used a "stumble spell" to leave Upton covered in injuries.
Corati was already quite tempted.
Gleint smiled and said, "My Beyonder abilities are difficult to demonstrate here. Let me show you the potions I concocted.
He opened his coat, and everyone saw that the inside of his coat had many small pockets, containing various glass or metal vials: "This is for quickly stopping bleeding, this is for quickly treating colds, this is for quickly treating diarrhea, this is for quickly treating coughs, this is a special tranquilizer, this is for temporarily enhancing one's own spirituality.
"Oh, and there are these colorful potions. That's right, they are some poisons. I won't describe the specific effects and uses."
It must be said that Fors's demonstration was very useful. Corati finally chose to become an "Apprentice."
Fors had seen the "Apprentice" potion formula in Old Lady Aulisa's belongings, and she immediately sold it to Corati for 280 pounds.
Corati had money with her, and the transaction was completed quickly.
However, after she got the potion formula, she was still a little at a loss.
Hobert smiled and said, "You can go to Gar's Herb Shop at 51 Henry Street to purchase the auxiliary materials for the formula. The owner of the herb shop, Gar is my friend. You can tell him that Lawyer Hobert sent you.
"As for the main material, I have it here. I can sell it to you if you need it.
"Audrey has a wealth of mystical knowledge, and after you have purchased all the materials, you can concoct the potion under her guidance."
Hobert's "Apprentice" main material was obtained by decomposing the Beyonder characteristics of the Tamara family's "Astrologer" and had been gathering dust in the "Nation of Disorder". Now he finally found an opportunity to sell it.
Audrey nodded reservedly: "Happy to help."
Corati breathed a sigh of relief: "As Audrey said, you are a considerate and reliable gentleman.
"I am willing to buy your main material. How much money do you need?"
Hobert said: "Base price, 300 pounds. But I don't have it with me. I'll have to bring it to you tomorrow."
This price was within Corati's acceptable range: "Deal."
After Corati's transaction ended, Xio said: "I hope to get the potion formula for 'Interrogator'."
"I have it here," Hobert said. "Also the base price, 800 pounds, and I also have the main material for 'Interrogator'.
"But I suggest you wait a bit before buying it, perhaps you have other channels to obtain a cheaper potion formula. At that time, you may only need the main material, or you may have obtained the main material and only need the formula."
Xio nodded, understanding what Hobert meant. The so-called "other channels" of course referred to the Masked Man.
Fors then said: "I need the potion formula for 'Astrologer', or related clues."
"I have it here," Hobert said.
Everyone looked at Hobert together: How many potion formulas and main materials does he actually have?
Hobert smiled helplessly. The original intention of forming the "Justice League" was to obtain noble channels, but he didn't expect it to become a place for him to sell stolen goods.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 270: The Role of Glaint
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert currently has quite a few Beyonder characteristics in his possession, and he dismantles them whenever he has time, preparing to sell them separately for money.
Currently, the only ones he hasn't dismantled are the "Gatekeeper" Beyonder characteristic obtained from beside the corpse of an ancient death god, and the "Zombie" Beyonder characteristic, which may have already been condensed.
Although he has Byron's sales channels, some Beyonder characteristics cannot be sold through Byron, such as the "Judge" Beyonder characteristic he just obtained from the Nighthawks.
Even if Thomas could vouch for Hobert, or even provide documents proving that the "Judge" Beyonder characteristic came from the Nighthawks, Byron would still have to ask Thomas to explain where the Nighthawks got this Beyonder characteristic.
"Judge" is already a Sequence 6 Beyonder characteristic, and the royal family's hounds would never allow it to be bought and sold on the market, and would investigate to the end to find the source of the Beyonder characteristic.
Not only the Beyonder characteristics of the "Justiciar" pathway, but also the Beyonder characteristics of the "Black Emperor" pathway are not suitable for sale through Byron.
In addition, Hobert knows that Byron is a member of MI9, so he doesn't dare to ask him to sell the "Rose Bishop" Beyonder characteristic seized from the Aurora Order.
After all, the Aurora Order is now cooperating with the royal family and the military serving the royal family. Who knows if there is any connection between Byron and the Aurora Order?
He could sell the spoils obtained from the "Judgement Group" to Byron, but Hobert also plans to wait for a while before doing so, and he must carry out the transaction in batches.
Although Hobert can be a bit reckless in battle, he is usually more cautious. It's always right to be careful.
What Hobert didn't expect was that some Beyonder characteristics that were not suitable for sale at Byron's could be sold here at the "Justice League".
Moreover, he can sell them with confidence, because neither the Aurora Order, the Judgement Group, nor the Tamara family can effectively monitor nobles with Beyonder bodyguards, or who are Beyonder themselves.
Of course, Hobert's bottom line is that he will not peddle Beyonder characteristics of the "Seer" and "Prisoner" pathways to members.
But anyway, Hobert has discovered that the "Justice League" will be a good channel for selling stolen goods, especially when the members are all Beyonder. They will also participate in some other gatherings, or the needs of family members, and the channels for selling stolen goods will become wider.
Hobert smiled and said to Fors, "Like Xio, I suggest you stay as a 'Trickmaster' for a while longer. I have the potion formula and main materials for 'Astrologer' here. If you need them, we can complete the transaction soon."
Fors smiled and nodded, "Okay."
Everyone else looked at Hobert differently, feeling like there was an organization behind him that specialized in providing potion formulas and main materials.
Hobert understood everyone's eyes: "Don't look at me like that. I haven't been able to get the potion formula and main materials that Miss Audrey needs.
"But I can give Miss Audrey a definite message. There are members of the 'Psychology Alchemists' at the Beyonder gathering held at the medical school."
Audrey's eyes lit up: "Thank you for your generous gift."
Hobert smiled: "Okay, let's continue."
At this time, Jessica, who was sitting behind him, said, "I want to trade the 'Barbarian' potion formula with Lawyer Hobert."
Everyone stared at Hobert, as if his words "I have it here" were heavenly music.
Then Xio, Fors, Audrey and other initiators suddenly laughed. They seemed to have forgotten for a moment that Hobert was originally an Beyonder of the "Lawyer" pathway. Of course, he would have the "Barbarian" potion formula. No wonder this newcomer chose to trade directly with Hobert.
Hobert was slightly stunned: "I forgot about that."
Jessica thought Hobert meant: I forgot that you are also a "Lawyer", and I didn't even mention the potion formula transaction to you before.
But Hobert meant: In my impression, you should be trading the "Barbarian" potion formula with Klein. I forgot that the "Black Emperor" card that originally belonged to Klein is now in my hands.
Hobert smiled and said, "No problem, it's also the base price, 500 pounds for the potion formula, 600 pounds for the Beyonder characteristic."
"Uh, I'll buy the potion formula first." Jessica said, "I'll bring enough money tomorrow and trade the Beyonder characteristic with you."
"No problem." Hobert took out paper and pen from his briefcase and wrote down the "Barbarian" potion formula.
After becoming a "Lawyer", Hobert found that his mental power had been enhanced, especially after becoming a "Briber". Both his learning ability and memory had become stronger.
Hobert can now write out all the potion formulas he has seen since he transmigrated.
He guessed that this may not be a unique advantage of the "Lawyer" pathway, but a symbol of the transformation of the body and mind after becoming an Beyonder.
Jessica put away the potion formula and counted out 500 pounds for Hobert.
Then she began to peddle "Slow Whip" and a ring that could increase running speed.
Xio and Fors were obviously very interested in "Slow Whip", and they could afford it with their current funds, but it was too expensive for them, so they eventually gave up the idea of trading.
However, Xio spent 60 pounds to buy the ring that could increase running speed.
Audrey and Glaint also showed some interest in "Slow Whip", but they thought that they didn't need to fight with others at all, and they didn't need "Slow Whip", so they didn't initiate a transaction.
However, they all probably understood why Hobert would introduce Jessica to the association. Even if they had just entered the Beyonder world, they knew the scarcity of "Artisan".
Obviously, there is an Artisan behind Jessica.
Karl, who was sitting behind Glaint, was very interested in "Slow Whip", and finally completed the transaction for 480 pounds.
This made Jessica have to sigh: It's still easy to make money from nobles, they don't bargain at all.
After counting the money, Jessica asked Viscount Glaint, "Can you make 'Corpse Dissolving Water'?"
Hobert recalled the potion that Carrie used to dispose of corpses before.
Glaint was slightly stunned before saying, "I know the formula for 'Corpse Dissolving Water', but I haven't made it before, and I don't know how effective it is."
Jessica nodded: "I would like to order some 'Corpse Dissolving Water'."
Viscount Glaint didn't expect there to be a transaction about him, he quickly said: "No problem, I can make some in two days at the latest."
"Make some for me too." Hobert said, "I also want a few bottles of poison, poison that is also effective against Beyonder.
"After you make them, write me a letter and I'll come and get them, or you can send someone to the law firm.
"Um, about how much will it cost?"
Glaint smiled awkwardly: "I'll tell you the specific price after I make them. Don't worry, as a member of the 'Justice League', I will only charge you the cost price."
The key is that he doesn't even know the specific cost now.
Jessica also said: "I also want a batch of potions that can quickly restore spirituality, please sell them to me as well!"
This is the potion that Carrie often uses when making weapons.
"No problem." Facing his first business deal, Glaint showed great enthusiasm: "Where should I send the potion?"
Jessica thought for a while and said, "You can send it to Lawyer Hobert together."
After this transaction was over, Glaint asked, "Does anyone have a way to eliminate the whispers in your ears?"

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 271: There is a brain, but it is not big (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
[Thanks to Gamer Type for becoming a member, +5 bonus!]
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Glaint smiled wryly and said, "Especially at night, I always hear whispers in my ears, which has greatly affected my sleep and made me a little irritable."
"Does anyone have a solution to this problem?"
Karl, standing behind him, added, "I have similar troubles. Although my father taught me meditation, it has limited effect and cannot eradicate the problem."
Audrey really wanted to popularize the "Acting Method" to them, but she also thought that she was the only "ordinary person" among the five founders, and it was unreasonable for her to know these things.
She sighed again: No, I have to "expose" my Beyonder identity as soon as possible, otherwise I will be marginalized in the "Justice League."
Hobert, sitting at the head of the table, said, "As one of the founders of the 'Justice League,' I will provide you with some knowledge for free.
"But don't think that this knowledge is worthless just because it's free. On the contrary, many wild Beyonders don't know this knowledge all their lives, so they have to live with madness and loss of control at all times.
"Just take it as a benefit of the 'Justice League.'"
Xio and Fors watched Hobert with smiles, as they were already direct beneficiaries of this knowledge.
Audrey was not surprised that Hobert knew the "Acting Method," which had already been proven at the previous Tarot Gathering.
Wait ~
She suddenly thought that Hobert's elder's friend knew Emperor Roselle, and he had just sacrificed a complete Beyonder pathway to Mr. Fool…
At that time, Audrey was very surprised by the Emperor's abilities and channels. Now, she suddenly has a feeling of "a master is by my side."
Glaint and Karl looked at Hobert, listening carefully to his every word.
"Take Viscount Glaint as an example, you must be a true Apothecary," Hobert reminded.
Glaint was stunned: "What do you mean?"
"In the process of being an Apothecary, you can appreciate some of the true meaning of 'Apothecary.' When you understand the core of it and form some of your own guidelines, and act according to these guidelines, the whispers will naturally disappear."
Glaint seemed to understand something: "Is the name of the potion the key?"
"I prefer to call it the key to reconciliation with the Beyonder characteristics in the body," Hobert said with a smile.
"I understand," Glaint smiled easily, "I will open a clinic and be a true Apothecary."
Karl then asked, "Then, what about me? Do I also need a clinic?"
Hobert thought to himself: You'd better get your brain back first, it might have been blown away by yourself this morning.
He said, "Regarding this point, you should consult Miss Xio."
He reminded Glaint again: "If you show too much medical skill, the official Beyonders may arrest you as a wild Beyonder. Well, since you are a believer of the Goddess, I will help you introduce a Beyonder from the Church of the Night, and you can register there."
Glaint nodded: "Okay, thank you for your explanation and introduction. Well, if you have any needs for potions in the future, they will all be free."
Hobert thought to himself: Then first give me a few tons of potions that can quickly stop bleeding. Viscount, you don't understand the lower limit of human nature very well.
He said, "If I use it myself, it's free. If I have other needs for batch use, you can give me a discount."
Glaint said "Oh": "Okay."
Karl looked at Xio with a thirst for knowledge.
Xio smiled and said, "I think this information is worth at least 100 pounds."
She doesn't have as many channels and as much strength as Hobert, and of course, she can't imitate his generosity.
Karl immediately counted the money.
The smile on Xio's face froze: Why do I have the feeling that when I go out to buy something, I bargained fiercely, ready to haggle with the other party for three hundred rounds, but the other party agreed directly?
After receiving Karl's money, Xio cleared her throat: "Try to make fair and just judgments. If any party does not respect your judgment, you can consider physical persuasion."
Karl was stunned: "Is it that simple?"
Xio asked back, "Do you think making a fair judgment is a simple matter?"
Perhaps seeing that this noble son has intelligence, but not much, Xio explained again: "Don't try to judge the conflicts of the strong, that's quite dangerous for you."
Only then did Karl think and say, "Thank you for your answer."
Hobert reminded: "This also belongs to the secrets of the 'Justice League,' don't try to share it with your family."
Karl said "Oh."
Seeing that the popularization of the "Acting Method" was over, Audrey said, "Everyone, I have two things. The first thing is about Lawyer Hobert."
Hobert was stunned: "What's the matter?"
"Everyone should have read the newspaper," Audrey said slowly, "Last week, Lawyer Hobert won justice for some ladies in Backlund, but many newspapers took the opportunity to smear Mr. Hobert.
"So I am issuing a proposal that we each use our own channels to establish Mr. Hobert's image of justice.
"We don't need to argue with them, just tell them from the side that Mr. Hobert's actions are just, and tell them that they have been deceived by some ulterior media."
Karl and others first recalled the information they saw in the newspaper. Today, after contacting him face-to-face, they all felt that Hobert was not as unbearable as the newspaper described.
Jessica had a great affection for this beautiful lady.
Hobert thought to himself: She is very good at applying what she has learned!
He remembered that when he was dealing with the Bob case, he had taught Audrey how to avoid major conflicts and achieve her goals from the side.
"This is a very noble act," Hobert said with a smile, "Thank you very much for your proposal, Miss Audrey. I have to say that you are the spokesperson for 'justice.'"
Audrey smiled reservedly: "Thank you for your compliment."
Hobert's comment made her very happy, because she could see that Hobert praised herself from the bottom of his heart.
Several noble children also responded to Audrey's proposal and said that they would clear Hobert's name at some dances.
Audrey then said, "The second thing is that I am going to the East Borough recently. Does anyone have any suggestions?"
Hobert blurted out almost without thinking: "Don't take your family's carriage, it is recommended to rent an ordinary carriage; don't wear noble clothes, it is recommended to wear knight clothes; find a good guide and bodyguard, I recommend Miss Xio, she knows the East Borough better."
Xio said, "Be sure to wear a veil or bonnet, otherwise you will definitely encounter a lot of trouble; don't wear perfume; don't wear jewelry."
Audrey wrote them down one by one: "Then Miss Xio, would you be willing to protect me to the East Borough? As for the remuneration, how about 30 pounds? If you think it's too little, we can talk about it again."
"Glad to be of service," Xio added a sentence: "Don't bring money with you. If there is a place to spend money, I can pay for it first."
The task of monitoring Rafter that she received before only earned her 32 pounds because she completed it excellently.
Audrey often has no concept of money, and spending money lavishly in the East Borough will be a disaster.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 272: Ten Thousand Pound Transaction (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the carriage back to the law firm, Hobert suggested, "Generally speaking, nobles rarely participate in battles themselves. Before the next gathering, Carrie can try to create some gadgets that nobles can use. They will definitely sell well."
Jessica nodded, "I'll talk to Carrie about it when I get back."
After returning to the firm and having lunch, Hobert dealt with the backlog of affairs. He was just about to pick up the newspaper to take a look when suddenly his vision was occupied by gray fog.
In the gray fog, a mysterious figure sat in a high-backed chair. It was 'The Fool'!
Then, before Hobert's eyes, the scene changed to Alger, 'The Hanged Man,' praying: "…Mr. Fool, please inform 'The Emperor' that I have inquired about the price of the 'Travel' ability Sealed Artifact.
"The other party is asking for 10,000 pounds. I helped him bargain down to 8,800 pounds, but because I undertook a considerable risk, I need to charge a 400-pound intermediary fee, making a total of 9,200 pounds to be paid to me.
"I must remind 'The Emperor' that the negative effects of this Sealed Artifact are quite serious: As long as the Sealed Artifact is worn, it is easy to be located by evil existences in the spirit world and attacked; each time the Sealed Artifact is used, the holder will completely lose their memory for three minutes; there is a chance of failure when using the Sealed Artifact. Failure does not mean that one cannot traverse the spirit world, but rather that it will bring the holder to the side of some evil existences."
The prayer scene ended, and Hobert frowned tightly: This isn't just a negative effect; it's practically a death wish!
If the use of the Sealed Artifact fails and brings oneself to the side of some evil existence, and one also loses their memory for three minutes, by the time memory is restored… there probably won't be a chance to restore memory.
No wonder the other party would accept a price of 8,800 pounds. This is clearly being sold as an Beyonder characteristic.
Ordinary Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristics usually sell for five or six thousand pounds, but the 'Door' pathway's Beyonder characteristics are different. They are just too difficult to obtain. An extra two or three thousand pounds is normal.
Soon, Hobert decided to buy it, shatter the Sealed Artifact, let it re-condense into an Beyonder characteristic, and then find someone to create a magical item.
As for who to ask to help create the Beyonder item, Hobert thought of three paths. First, ask Carrie if she knows any 'Artisans' skilled at creating magical items.
Second, find Ikanser for help.
Third, find Christian for help. Since the original owner's birth mother knew a 'Artisan' with very good skills, Christian most likely also knows that 'Artisan'.
After entering the Beyonder world, Hobert rarely sought Christian's help because he also had some secrets of his own. He believes that if Christian has access to relevant channels, he would not refuse.
Then Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. During this period, he had been saving money according to 12,000 pounds because that price was for a magical item with the 'Travel' ability.
Now that he was finally about to save enough money, he discovered that he didn't need that much.
But who would complain about having too much money?
Hobert returned to his rented house, entered the 'Nation of Disorder,' and used the method he bestowed upon himself to bring out 8,500 pounds from the 'Nation of Disorder.' He originally had about 300 pounds on him, and he obtained another 500 pounds from the transaction with Jessica, enough to pay Alger's asking price.
Then he chanted 'The Fool's' honorific name and said, "…Mr. Fool, please tell Mr. Hanged Man that I am willing to buy that Sealed Artifact. I will pay Mr. Hanged Man the pounds I use by offering them to you."
…
Above the gray fog, Klein looked at the 9,200 pounds offered by 'The Emperor' and was stunned for a while. Having been in this world for so long, it was the first time he had seen so much money.
This is the Tarot Club's first ten-thousand-pound transaction!
While stroking the pounds, Klein thought: The negative effects of the Sealed Artifact are so serious that 'The Emperor' cannot be joking with his own life.
In other words, 'The Emperor' has a way to shatter the Sealed Artifact and let the Beyonder characteristic re-condense!
Klein's gaze turned to a corner of the bronze long table, to the Beyonder characteristic contaminated by the 'True Creator,' considering whether to ask the Emperor to help shatter it and then re-condense it into an Beyonder characteristic.
…
On the Berserk Sea, in the forest of a nameless island.
Alger didn't expect 'The Emperor' to actually be willing to buy this Sealed Artifact, but he quickly understood: 'The Emperor' has channels to access Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts!
He had heard the bishops of the church talk about using certain Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts to eliminate the contamination of Beyonder characteristics or to turn Sealed Artifacts back into Beyonder characteristics.
He wasn't too clear on the specific steps, but he knew such things were possible.
But given the channels and background that 'The Emperor' has shown, having the opportunity to use Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts didn't seem too unacceptable.
It's just that in Alger's eyes, 'The Emperor's' image has become even more mysterious and powerful. Those are Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts.
A dozen seconds later, he came back to his senses and began to set up the altar, asking Mr. Fool to bestow the pounds used for the transaction.
…
Backlund, Blanca Street.
Hobert stared blankly at the silver bracelet in his hand, stained with blood. So much money, just to exchange for such a broken toy?
Hobert suddenly felt like a spendthrift. Thinking of so many pounds leaving him, he felt a sense of being emptied.
He can't think about it anymore, or his heart will bleed!
Hobert quickly used the method of offering to himself to bring the bracelet into the 'Nation of Disorder'.
After confirming that the negative effects Alger spoke of were true, and that even with the sealing of the 'Nation of Disorder', the negative effects were still somewhat serious, Hobert simply shattered the bracelet, allowing the Beyonder characteristic within to re-condense.
Back in the real world, Hobert heard voices downstairs.
Going downstairs to take a look, Donna and Tyron were here. Fors was entertaining the siblings.
Hobert asked with a straight face, "If I remember correctly, today is Friday. Shouldn't you be at school? Why are you here?"
Donna retorted, "Aren't you not at work either?"
"I came back because I had something to do. Now I have to go back to work."
"We also took leave because we had something to do."
"What is it?"
"Not telling you, hehehe~"
Hobert thought Donna was lying, so he asked Tyron, "Why did you skip school?"
"Father gave us leave."
Hobert was stunned: "Leave?"
"Yes." Tyron said: "Father asked us to tell you to come home for dinner tonight."
Hobert smelled something unusual: "Coincidentally, I also have something I need Father's help with."
He said, "You guys go back first. I'll go home after work."
Donna said, "No, I want to discuss the aesthetics of modern Backlund women with Miss Fors."
"Aesthetics my butt! Do you even know what aesthetics means?" Hobert said, "Besides, Fors still has to 'conceive a new book'."
"The new book can be 'conceived' tomorrow," Fors smiled. "You go to work quickly. I'll chat with Miss Donna for a while."
"Alright." Hobert picked up his cane and returned to the law firm, but he was a little restless all afternoon.
Finally, after getting off work, Hobert immediately took a carriage home. A sumptuous dinner had already been set on the table in the dining room.
Christian, Mona, Dophis, and others all looked normal. Hobert had just breathed a sigh of relief when he suddenly felt that it shouldn't be like this.
[T/N: I forgor the mother's name, shes Mona from now on, okay?]
Sure enough, after everyone was seated, Christian said to Hobert, "Your mother wants to take Donna and Tyron to the Rorsted Archipelago for a trip. Do you want to go together?
"No need to answer now. Think about it carefully, think about it well, and then make a careful choice."
Hobert suddenly remembered the content of a conversation Christian had with him about two months ago, asking him to make his own choice carefully at a certain time.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 273: Prepare to leave Backlund (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert remembered that Christian's original words seemed to be: he had made an important choice before, and now it was time to pay for that choice.
Christian's choice would obviously affect Hobert's current life.
Hobert was indeed not in a hurry to make a choice, because he had too little information in his hands now and didn't know how to choose for a while.
The atmosphere of the dinner was generally very active, mainly thanks to Donna, the little girl couldn't wait to leave since she knew she was going on a trip.
Hobert realized that if he made the choice not to go with Donna and Tyron, he might not see them for a long time.
So Hobert invited her and Tyron to entertain Elizabeth and them tomorrow, and invited them to visit the Emperor Roselle Exhibition on Sunday.
Donna of course immediately agreed, and Tyron listened to his sister.
At about eight o'clock, the dinner ended in a pleasant atmosphere.
Hobert was about to follow Christian to the study, but Mona suddenly grabbed Hobert's arm: "In my eyes, you are still a child and should not participate in the affairs of adults."
Hobert was slightly stunned before smiling: "Mother, thank you for your reminder, but we have been growing up, whether we want to or not."
Mona sighed: "Yes, as a mother, I shouldn't stop you from growing up."
"I can feel your reluctance." Hobert said, "But I don't seem to understand it very well now, after all, I don't have children yet."
Mona smiled and let go of Hobert's arm: "Go ahead."
Hobert said "Okay", bowed slightly to Mona, and quickly came to the study.
After closing the door of the study, only Christian, Dophis and Hobert were left inside.
Christian sat behind the desk and lit a cigarette: "I know what you want to ask, but I can't say it too clearly now.
"I can only tell you that I am doing a big thing, which is related to my future life and the pattern of the Northern Continent for a period of time in the future."
Hobert was stunned, related to the pattern of the Northern Continent for a period of time in the future?
He immediately dismissed the idea of inquiring: "I didn't expect you to be so old and still working so hard."
Christian took a puff of cigarette and smiled: "If you don't work hard, you won't get what you want. Also, I'm only in my forties this year, how am I old already?"
Hobert sat opposite Christian: "I hope to have more references on how to make a choice."
"If you go on a trip with your mother, you will be very safe for a period of time in the future, and you will also be monitored by a pair of hidden eyes." Christian said while smoking:
"If you choose to stay, first of all, you will face certain risks, and you have to be prepared to completely tie your future to me, and you have to be prepared to leave Backlund at any time."
Hobert almost didn't even think about it: "I choose to stay."
Hobert absolutely couldn't accept being monitored by a pair of hidden eyes. First of all, he had to attend the Tarot Club every week, and he himself was a pretender god in the early stage of his business, and it was easy for people to find the secrets hidden in him.
Christian reminded him: "You should think about it carefully before giving me an answer."
"There's nothing to consider." Hobert smiled and said, "Being able to catch your ride is a shortcut to life. With such a shortcut in front of me, why refuse it?"
Christian smiled: "It's rare for you to have such awareness."
Hobert added: "After leaving Backlund, I want to venture into the Southern Continent alone for a period of time to find an opportunity to digest the potion."
Christian seemed to understand something: "Are you already Sequence 6?"
Hobert did not hide it and nodded.
Christian sighed: "You are better than Rex, he took five or six months to digest the 'Briber' potion."
He put out the cigarette: "Then I don't have to worry about your safety. I think you should be able to take care of yourself."
Christian didn't ask Hobert how he digested the Sequence 7 potion so quickly, just let out a long breath, as if he was caught in memories.
Hobert waited for more than ten seconds before asking: "Father, I hope to create a few magical items, do you have any related channels?"
"Yes." Christian came back to his senses: "And he is a 'craftsman' with considerable skills. Well, your mother, I mean your biological mother, gave you two magical items, which came from him."
That's great!
"I have three Beyonder characteristics in my hand, namely 'Gatekeeper', 'Traveler', and 'Zombie'." Hobert said:
"I hope to turn them all into magical items. The 'Gatekeeper' must retain the ability of 'spirit channeling', the 'Traveler' must retain the ability of 'travel', and the 'Zombie' must retain the ability of steel-like skin."
Christian and Dophis were a little surprised, how could a Sequence 6 get two Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristics? Especially since there is actually the Beyonder characteristic of 'Traveler'!
Hobert explained: "The 'Gatekeeper' was obtained from the ruins, the 'Traveler' was traded at a high price, and the 'Zombie' was the spoils of war obtained from a battle jointly participated in with a friend."
This was the rhetoric he had thought of in advance. Although there was truth and falsehood, it sounded reasonable.
Christian said: "I will pass your request to the 'Artisan'. If you give me the three Beyonder characteristics tomorrow, it should take four or five days to a week to complete the magical items you want."
Then he smiled: "The Beyonder characteristic of 'Traveler' cost you a lot of money, right?"
"Yes!" Hobert sighed: "I still feel heartache now!"
Christian smiled and said, "If you have this kind of demand in the future, you can come to me for help first."
Hobert was stunned, Christian might have the Beyonder characteristic of 'Traveler' in his hand!
Careless, Hobert always thought that Christian was a general who received a fixed salary and occasionally earned some extra money, but he didn't expect that he had a lot of good things in his hand.
He suddenly thought: "I heard someone asking for the 'Wind Blessed' potion formula at a party, but I didn't think to ask you if you have it?"
He paused and then said, "Also, what kind of reward is needed to create magical items?"
"You don't have to worry about the reward." Christian got up and walked to the safe: "I know what that old guy likes."
While entering the password of the safe, Christian smiled and said, "We also mixed in the sea for a while back then. I remember seizing the 'Wind Favored' potion formula, but I have to find it. That was more than twenty years ago."
Hobert asked: "How much are you going to sell it for?"
"Take it and play with it." Christian waved his hand: "I only have the 'Folk of Rage' and 'Wind Blessed' potion formulas here, which are not coherent, so it's useless to keep them."

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 274 The severely neglected thigh (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert returned to his room, his mood unable to calm down for a long time.
Only today did he realize that he had seriously underestimated Christian's strength and accumulation.
In Backlund, Christian seemed to be restricted everywhere, but he seemed to have a wealth of experience in the Southern Continent, and he knew many extraordinary friends with Rex, and his channels were wider than he thought.
When Christian gave Hobert the "Wind Blessed" formula, it was as casual as giving Hobert and Tyron marbles to play with when they were kids.
Moreover, Christian also let Hobert copy down the "Berserker" potion formula, without planning to ask him for a penny.
Of course, one aspect was that Christian regarded Hobert as his own child, and the other aspect was that Christian really didn't care.
Hobert had just seen that Christian's safe was actually a magical item, and entering different passwords could open different spaces.
During the search for the formula, Christian opened the safe several times, and each space was different. Some spaces contained various extraordinary materials, some contained various Beyonder characteristics, some contained sealed items or magical items, some contained gold, and some contained some documents.
Hobert guessed that some of these accumulations should come from the inheritance of the Tudor family, and some from Christian's spoils of war.
In short, although Christian is only a Sequence 5, his accumulation should be enough for him to form one, no, three Beyonder organizations like the "Judgement Group".
This made Hobert have to sigh that Christian was a big shot he had overlooked.
At the same time, he was very curious about whether the inheritance Rex left him was so rich? What conditions did he have to meet to get those inheritances?
Then Hobert considered what Christian and Dophis were planning. What kind of plan could determine the pattern of the Northern Continent for a period of time in the future?
After thinking for a long time without any clues, Hobert began to imagine another question: preparing to leave Backlund.
While there is time, of course, preparations must be made.
First of all, it is necessary to clarify a question. Leaving Backlund this time does not mean that he will not come back. With "Traveling", he can come back at any time.
But he can't come back openly, he has to come back secretly.
The work of the law firm must be abandoned. Some arrangements can be made in advance to strive for his team to continue to fight for the interests of some people at the bottom.
Some things that I had concerns about before, I can now boldly do, such as attracting the hidden sentries of the Tamara family on Rose Street, finding the right opportunity to beat them up severely, and enrich my accumulation.
Another thing is that you can boldly sell some Beyonder characteristics to raise some pounds to provide security for the development of the Southern Continent.
In the Southern Continent, gold pounds are also very strong.
The gold in the "Nation of Disorder" can be temporarily kept, after all, this thing is more widely circulated than gold pounds.
Thinking about it, Hobert fell asleep.
The next morning at six o'clock, Hobert woke up under the reminder of spirituality.
He is very busy today! He didn't even have time for breakfast, so he went out to find a rental carriage and started a busy day.
Hobert first returned to Blanca Street, and used his own method of bestowing to bring the Beyonder characteristics of "Gatekeeper", "Traveler", "Zombie", "Barbarian", and "Apprentice" into the real world.
In his home in the Empress Borough, he didn't dare to make such a big move, for fear of attracting Christian's attention.
According to the distance from Blanca Street, Hobert first went to the law firm to complete the transaction of the "Barbarian" Beyonder characteristic with Jessica, and then went to the Glaint mansion to complete the transaction of the "Apprentice" Beyonder characteristic with Corati.
These two transactions earned Hobert 900 pounds, and his funds returned to about 3,500 pounds.
Then Hobert handed the Beyonder characteristics such as "Traveler" to Christian, and asked the kitchen to prepare a late breakfast for him. After eating and drinking, at about ten o'clock, Hobert took Donna and Tyron to the train station together.
Hobert sighed again: If only he had the ability to "Travel", the time spent this morning was basically spent on the road.
When Hobert has the ability to "Travel", it also means that the rental carriage industry in Backlund has lost a big customer.
At eleven o'clock, Hobert brought Donna and Tyron to the platform. After waiting for about ten minutes, Hobert saw Elizabeth, who had some cute baby fat, and Selena, who had wine-red hair, as well as Melissa and a man he had never seen before walking behind.
Seeing the man's hairline, Hobert could be sure that it was Benson.
"Elizabeth!" Hobert shouted.
Elizabeth also saw Hobert: "Mr. Hobert."
Selena also quickly stepped forward: "Teacher!"
Hobert did not agree, nor did he refuse: "You are a clever girl."
"Lawyer Hobert, thank you for your invitation." Benson handed the cane to his left hand and shook hands with Hobert: "I also followed the three girls to Backlund to take a look."
Hobert smiled while shaking hands: "Now the reputation of 'Hobert the Lawyer' is not very good."
"Those media always like to make something out of nothing." Benson spread his hands: "They must be jealous of your talent."
Elizabeth was also a little worried: "Mr. Hobert, my parents and uncle are very worried about your situation, that lady is really..."
Hobert said sternly: "Yes, she is a street girl, but in my opinion, she also has the right to protect her interests."
Benson echoed: "That's right, we can't live by our fists like curly-haired baboons, we have a complex society."
Hobert did not continue this topic, but first introduced the four guests to Donna and Tyron, and then introduced Donna and Tyron to Elizabeth and the others.
Tyron inherited many excellent genes from Mona and Christian, and is a handsome young man, but he is a little shy because he is often under Donna's lead
Elizabeth and Selena couldn't help but take a few more glances at Tyron, which made Tyron a little shy and blushed.
There were seven people in total, and a rental carriage could not fit.
Benson suggested: "How about the girls and the young man sit together, and the two of us adults sit together?"
Everyone had no objection. Hobert told Donna and Tyron to treat the guests well, and then got into a carriage with Benson.
In the carriage, Benson looked at the street scene outside, and then looked at Hobert: "Please allow me to thank you again for your invitation. I also plan to develop in Backlund, so I can use this opportunity to investigate."
Hobert smiled: "You are too polite, this is not something to be too grateful for."
"I really want to know, why did you invite me and Melissa?" The smile on Benson's face disappeared: "In my opinion, you don't need to invite us to come together at all."
Hobert was slightly taken aback before saying: "I know Klein!"

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 275: Meeting Bernadette Again (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for 135 advance chapters and a bunch more. I translate 140 chapters a week total minimum. This week has a lot more, surpassing 1 ch/hour.
---
Hobert's answer stunned Benson, who unconsciously touched his pocket watch.
"Sorry, I might have reminded you of something sad." Hobert smiled apologetically, "But only by telling you the truth can you immediately understand why I invited you here as well. Going out for a walk might change your mood."
Benson was silent for a long while before saying, "He, he..."
"He saved Tingen," Hobert said, "I was by his side at the time."
Benson fell silent again.
Hobert added, "The deceased are gone, and the living must live well."
"Although I've had some issues recently, I still have some connections in Backlund. If you need help in Backlund, you can write to me or send a telegram."
As he spoke, he wrote down the address of the law firm. Even if he left Backlund in the future, he planned to use Jessica to establish a base for himself in the firm.
Therefore, the recipient Hobert left was Jessica.
Benson put away the address. After a long while, he began to talk to Hobert about the scenery of Backlund.
As Benson said, they were both adults, and some emotions and words didn't need to be expressed. It was enough to understand in their hearts.
They first found a place for lunch and then began their Backlund tour.
The first stop was Order Square, the large square in front of the Bell of Order. In addition to the statue of "Protector" William I and the tall Bell of Order, the most famous thing here is that the pigeons here are not afraid of people.
After seeing the statue, hearing the chimes, and feeding the pigeons, Hobert took them to the second stop: the Loen Kingdom Museum.
It is said that this museum has a long history of more than a thousand years, and it also houses exhibits such as the flags and medals of the "War of Broken Oath."
Honestly, these exhibits were nothing special to look at. It wasn't until they entered the colonial era exhibition area that things became interesting.
The museum has too many cultural relics and archaeological discoveries from the Rorsted Archipelago and East Balam, as well as items representing the customs and habits of these places.
Especially the exhibits from East Balam, with cultures and styles completely different from those of the Northern Continent, broadened Elizabeth's and others' horizons.
By the time they came out of the museum, it was already past five in the afternoon. Hobert arranged everyone's meals and asked everyone for suggestions.
Donna suggested, "Let's go to the Intis restaurant. It is said that the catering style there is very special, and you can also taste some dishes invented by Emperor Roselle."
Hobert thought: A big question mark should be placed on the word 'invented'!
Donna and Tyron had long wanted to have a meal at the Intis restaurant, but Hobert had never had time to take them.
Today, Hobert was generous and took them to the Intis restaurant.
This restaurant is considered a mid-to-high-end restaurant in Backlund. The decoration here is basically gold, full of exotic atmosphere.
Hobert thought it was a bit tacky, like a nouveau riche, as if eager for others to know how much gold they had.
As for the dishes, Hobert was quite satisfied. Although some dishes had obviously been modified, some of Roselle's "invented" dishes still had some flavor of "home cooking."
While everyone was commenting on these exotic dishes, Hobert saw that chestnut hair again. It was Bernadette.
Today, she was wearing an olive-green dress, which looked less dignified than the last time they met and more girlish.
What a coincidence, running into her here again.
Actually, it's not a coincidence. This might be her property. Even if it isn't, her taste should be more inclined to the Intis style, so it's normal to come here to eat.
Bernadette also noticed Hobert's gaze and looked over at Hobert.
Hobert smiled slightly at her. Bernadette seemed to remember where she had seen Hobert and nodded politely at Hobert.
Just as he was about to continue eating, Hobert suddenly thought that it didn't seem so abrupt to say hello to Bernadette now.
Although it had the suspicion of hitting on her, Bernadette, who was born in the open Republic of Intis, shouldn't mind.
If he said a few words to her this time, he could chat a few more words next time they met. Wouldn't they become familiar after meeting a few times?
At this time, Hobert realized, why would Uncle Hobert have so many concerns about getting to know a junior?
But then he felt a little discouraged. Why else would he be asking Bernadette for something, wanting to borrow her "Genie"? Otherwise, he could completely pretend not to know her, just like "Uncle Zhou."
Thinking of this, Hobert said to Elizabeth and the others, "I've met an acquaintance. I'll go over and say a few words."
He picked up his wine glass and walked towards Bernadette, who was almost at the other end of the restaurant: "Beautiful lady, we meet again."
"It seems that the news published in the newspaper is not true enough." Bernadette didn't seem surprised by Hobert's arrival: "Lawyer Hobert can't possibly have anything to do with those street prostitutes, because your way of hitting on ladies is very old-fashioned."
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth and was actually ridiculed by this little girl: "How do you know who I am?"
"I just know." Bernadette smiled mysteriously.
Hobert thought that saying a few words would be enough: "It seems that the lady doesn't welcome men with no experience in hitting on her, so I'll take my leave. I wish you a pleasant meal."
"I'm occasionally interested in inexperienced men." Bernadette smiled, "Please sit down, let's chat for a while."
Why did he feel like he was being teased by this little girl?
But Hobert still sat down opposite her: "To be honest, your style of dress is very unconventional."
"Thank you."
Hobert: I'm not complimenting you.
Bernadette took a sip of tea: "I know that you are a person with some magical powers, and I also have some magical powers. I don't think we need to hide anything in this regard."
Hobert nodded, realizing that she might be looking for him for something.
"One of my abilities is that I can hear some secret information through some secret channels or existences." Bernadette looked at Hobert: "I heard that a secret existence called 'The Creator of Human Order' is awakening."
Hobert immediately felt a chill all over his body: It's over, I've been exposed!
This was the first time Hobert had felt such a strong sense of crisis in his heart. In fact, if it weren't for borrowing the "Genie", he wouldn't be willing to have any contact with Bernadette.
Because Hobert and Roselle were both Beyonders of the "Black Emperor" pathway, there might be unavoidable conflicts in the future, and he would probably be an enemy of Bernadette.
But he never expected that his hidden identity would be revealed by Bernadette like this!
Bernadette saw Hobert's expression and smiled slightly: "After meeting you last time, I realized that there seemed to be some mysterious connection between you and 'The Creator'. Now it seems that my insight and interpretation of your destiny is correct."
Damn! You scared me.
Hobert realized that Bernadette had at most discovered a secret connection between his destiny and "The Creator", and it was impossible for her to know that he was "The Creator".

chapters.content:

Hobert"s mind raced. His first thought was that when he met Bernadette before, it was just a brief encounter. Bernadette couldn"t have gleaned much information about him.
She must have learned about the "Creator" from another source.
Hobert immediately had a related idea: the "Hidden Sage" and the "Knowledge Moor" likely both know about the "Creator".
This goes back to rescuing Old Neil when he went to Tingen. At that time, the ritual Old Neil performed was likely a way for the "Hidden Sage" to find or probe the "Knowledge Moor".
Hobert remembered that the "Hidden Sage" seemed to be a mystical entity formed by the activation of the "Hermit" pathway"s Uniqueness. And according to Hobert"s observation, the "Knowledge Moor" is different from other Source materials, and seems to have a certain intelligence.
Yes, intelligence. Hobert felt this term was very appropriate, similar to the feeling given by artificial intelligence.
The "Creator" appeared in Old Neil"s ritual and disrupted the process. The "Hidden Sage" should have been able to "hear" Klein reciting the "Creator"s" honorific name.
In addition, the "Hidden Sage" has a habit of instilling knowledge into Beyonders of the same sequence. Bernadette is now Sequence 3, and has some ways to avoid "Knowledge Beguiling," or the knowledge instilled by the "Hidden Sage" is unlikely to have much impact on her.
Hobert guessed that Bernadette might even have a habit of actively listening, after all, the knowledge instilled by the "Hidden Sage" is a lot of very cutting-edge mystical knowledge.
It is possible that Bernadette inadvertently heard information about the "Creator".
It is also possible that the source of her information came from the "Knowledge Moor".
Hobert inadvertently peeked into the "Knowledge Moor" with that eye. Although the "Knowledge Moor" could not reverse-track Hobert, it should be able to "find" many clues, including information about the "Creator".
Afterwards, Bernadette learned this news from the "Knowledge Moor" in a secret way.
Regardless of which channel Bernadette learned about the existence of the "Creator" from, the information she knows is extremely limited.
Thinking of these things, Hobert"s mentality gradually stabilized: "Yes, I do know that hidden existence."
This time it was Bernadette"s turn to be stunned. She probably didn"t expect Hobert to admit it so frankly.
Hobert spread his hands: "And then? Report me to the official Beyonders? Compared to a hidden existence with almost no presence, they should be more interested in you, right?
"Queen Mystic" Bernadette!"
This time it was Bernadette"s turn to be slightly surprised: "How do you know who I am?"
Hobert smiled and said, "I just know."
Bernadette"s expression became serious, and after a few seconds of silence, she said, "You"re thinking too much. I won"t be like those rascals who go to the official Beyonders to report secrets when they have no ability."
Hobert thought: Uh, your Uncle Zhou really wants to chat with you about this issue.
Bernadette: "I just want you to help me say hello to the "Creator". Since you know who I am, then please tell Him: Bernadette says hello to Him."
Your greetings have been received by the "Creator", Hobert thought.
He said: "No problem."
Hobert raised his glass: "Let"s have a toast to this thrilling conversation, and I hope there won"t be similar experiences in the future."
Without waiting for Bernadette to respond, Hobert drank the wine in his glass, then bowed slightly very gentlemanly and got up to leave.
Bernadette smiled slightly because of Hobert"s last words, and watched Hobert leave.
After leaving the table where Bernadette was, Hobert realized: Bernadette wouldn"t think that the "Creator" is her father Roselle resurrected, would she?
The more he thought about it, the more he felt that this should be the case.
Should he pretend to be Roselle and trick the "Lamp God" from Bernadette?
Hobert shook his head slightly, denying his idea. Bernadette is not a three-year-old child. It is estimated that she will be exposed after a few casual chats, and everyone will be very embarrassed at that time.
He could pretend to have amnesia and say that he had forgotten many things in the past, in order to avoid Bernadette"s probing. But in that case, Bernadette would not easily give the "Lamp God" to the "Creator".
Let"s make natural contact and talk about it when there is a chance in the future.
Hobert returned to his table, and Donna asked with a smile: "Hobert, why do you know so many beautiful ladies?"
Hobert thought: Because I am a sunny and handsome big boy.
He explained casually: "Don"t think too much, they are just acquaintances?"
Donna: "Really? Why did you look so nervous just now? And then that lady looked very nervous?"
The two tables were far apart, and Donna couldn"t hear Hobert and Bernadette"s conversation.
Elizabeth and Serena were also very curious, and their gossiping hearts were overflowing, only Melissa had a polite smile, as if she was not interested in these things.
Hobert told the truth: "Because we were exposing each other"s shortcomings just now, um, that"s right, exposing each other"s shortcomings."
Originally, he wanted to say "I am a competitor with her father", but when he thought that Bernadette might hear the conversation here, or have a way to know their conversation, Hobert simply changed his words.
Donna continued to ask: "Why expose each other"s shortcomings? Are you competitors?"
"You can think so." Hobert said vaguely: "Where were we just now? Oh, right, about Backlund"s smog.
"Many gentlemen and ladies are very strange, why are there so many sunny days in the weather forecast in the newspaper? You know, they can"t see the sun for several days throughout the year.
Some people even have to go to the suburbs to see the sun, otherwise they will forget what the sun looks like."
This was not the first smog joke at the dinner table, but everyone still smiled knowingly.
Benson smiled and said: "Sure enough, humor is a compulsory course for every gentleman."
The dinner ended in a cheerful atmosphere. Hobert arranged for them to stay at the hotel, and borrowed the hotel"s small reception room, planning to talk to Elizabeth and Serena alone.
Benson on the side smiled and said: "As the only man in the Tingen trip, I can"t let the two ladies leave my sight. Sorry, I don"t mean to distrust you, but to live up to the entrustment of their parents."
A very responsible big brother.
Hobert was not angry at all: "It doesn"t matter, but I suggest you wait outside the reception room, otherwise Miss Elizabeth will have come for nothing."
Benson was stunned: "Why?"
"Unless you also call me teacher." Hobert smiled slightly.
Benson thought of Serena, who was obsessed with mysticism, and had to nod: "Okay."
Hobert asked the waiter to bring a chair and let Benson sit at the door.
Closing the door of the reception room, Hobert first built a "spiritual wall", so that their conversation would not be heard by Benson.
While taking out candles and other things from his briefcase, Hobert asked Elizabeth: "Are you still having the same nightmares recently?"
Elizabeth was a little nervous: "Yes, and it seems to be getting more and more frequent."
Serena stared at Hobert without blinking, as if she was carefully recording every step in front of her.
Hobert lit the candle, opened "Amantha" hydrosol, and dripped a few drops on the burning candle.
The air was immediately filled with a peaceful and serene smell, and Elizabeth and Serena fell into a daze.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 277 Extraordinary Mentor (Bonus 7)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert used the "Psychological Spoon" again to hypnotize Elizabeth, making her forget everything about the "Golden Horned Evil Creature."
With the assistance of "Amantha" essence, this kind of hypnosis was almost as reliable as that of a "Spectator" pathway Beyonder.
Snap~
Hobert snapped his fingers and blew out the candle.
Elizabeth and Serena woke up at the same time.
Serena exclaimed, "That's great, that feeling was amazing! This is what mysticism is!"
Hobert smiled and asked Elizabeth, "Do you still remember the nightmare you had?"
Elizabeth was stunned for two or three seconds: "It's amazing, I still remember having a nightmare, but I can't remember the content of the nightmare at all."
Hobert nodded: "You shouldn't have similar nightmares again in the future."
Serena looked admiring: "It's amazing! Teacher, will I be able to learn this skill in the future?"
"It's not impossible." Hobert smiled.
Serena asked again: "Teacher, can you make Melissa forget the sadness of her brother's death?"
"This is not the same thing," Hobert replied: "Elizabeth's nightmare originated from some psychological shadows. If those shadows are not removed, it will affect her physical and mental health.
"And Melissa's sadness for her brother just shows her love for her brother. Such emotions should not be forgotten, nor should they be interfered with. You must not have similar thoughts in the future!"
Serena nodded repeatedly: "I remember, teacher!"
Hobert added: "Miss Elizabeth, I want to talk to Serena alone."
Elizabeth got up and nodded: "Okay."
When the door was closed again, Serena seemed to have forgotten Hobert's not-so-strict reprimand just now. She looked at Hobert excitedly: "Teacher, was that hypnosis just now? Do you need any spells and drugs?"
"No need." Hobert explained: "The essence of mysticism is not in spells or drugs, but in ability."
"Ability?" Serena's expression was as if she had discovered a new world.
"You must not tell anyone about our next conversation, not even your parents and classmates. Because if you reveal these secrets, you may be caught by the Church and interrogated about the origin of these conversations, and your family and friends will also be implicated."
Serena was not afraid at all, but rather a little happy from the bottom of her heart. She nodded repeatedly: "I swear, I will not reveal it to others!"
Hobert "hmm"ed: "Beyonders are real, they have all kinds of Beyonder abilities, they form an extraordinary world under the surface world..."
Hobert briefly told Serena some basic knowledge about Beyonders and the extraordinary world. She was so happy that she exclaimed that she only knew what mysticism was today.
At the end, Serena asked: "Teacher, can I become a Beyonder in the future?"
"This is what I want to warn you next." Hobert said: "The extraordinary world has an attractive magical color, but it is also very dangerous and very dark.
"Losing control or turning into a monster is a frequent occurrence. Getting injured in extraordinary battles or losing your life in battles is also a frequent occurrence.
"So if you want to become a Beyonder, you must completely bid farewell to your family and completely bid farewell to everything before.
"Because if you still live with them, you may bring danger to them at any time, and they will also become your burden and weakness.
"Can you do this?"
Serena hesitated. Although she was obsessed with mysticism, it was difficult for her to accept completely saying goodbye to her family because of this.
"Don't rush to make a decision." Hobert smiled: "You can often write to me in the future, and I will also answer some questions about the extraordinary world.
"Also, so many teachers today can't let you call for nothing."
While talking, Hobert unfastened the key ring around his waist and put away the fire lacquer seal and pocket watch key: "This key ring is for you as a gift from the teacher to the student."
"Thank you, teacher." Serena recovered her smile. Of course, she understood that Hobert meant that he was willing to be her mysticism teacher.
She stroked the key ring, and didn't feel the coldness of the metal texture at all. Instead, it made people feel a trace of warmth: "This, this key ring..."
Hobert smiled and said: "That's right, it's a little thing with certain effects. If you carry it with you, ordinary wraiths will try to stay away from you."
Serena quickly put it away and thanked her again: "Thank you, teacher."
After ending the hypnosis of Elizabeth and the conversation with Serena, Hobert bid farewell to them and took Donna and Tyron home.
The next morning, after breakfast, Hobert, Donna, and Tyron came to the hotel again to take them to visit the Roselle Memorial Exhibition.
Hobert still greeted the "Machinery Hivemind" members he knew. This time, the "Machinery Hivemind" members didn't even report it.
It had been made clear during the previous meeting that Hobert's suspicion had been ruled out.
During the visit, without any surprise, Hobert saw Klein who was disguised.
Hobert had guessed that although he said he would forget it, he would still come and take a look.
At noon, in order to catch the train, the group didn't have time to have lunch in the restaurant. Hobert bought them simple meals and carefully bought small gifts for their family members.
Around twelve o'clock, Hobert watched Elizabeth and others get on the train.
Elizabeth solved the problems she encountered and no longer had the anxiety and concerns she had when she got off the train.
Serena was obviously a little reluctant. She wanted to find a chance to ask some questions about mysticism.
Melissa has also changed a little. Her smile looks more sincere and is no longer always such a polite smile.
The only thing that remains unchanged is Benson. A single trip is difficult to soothe the pain deep in his heart.
Watching the train leave, Hobert took Donna and Tyron to have lunch.
These two days, Donna and Tyron had no parental restraint and had a great time. Now that they are going home, they are still a little reluctant.
On the carriage back, Donna asked: "Hobert, are you really not going on a trip with us? I heard from my mother that this trip will take more than three months. Will we have to wait a long time before we can meet again?"
Hobert smiled: "I'm learning a magic trick these days, even if we are thousands of miles apart, I can quickly appear by your side."
Donna curled her lips: "Bragging."
Hobert touched Donna's head: "After growing up, you are really not cute at all."
Donna dodged Hobert's hand and stuck her tongue out at him.
While talking and laughing, they arrived at Empress Borough. When he saw the Mercenary Club, Hobert suddenly thought that he still had time to attend a party.
