chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 278 The Tomb of Antigonus’ Descendants (Bonus 8)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert hurried to the underground theater, just in time for the start of the Beyonder Gathering.
He didn't have any particular purpose for coming this time, just wanted to pass the afternoon.
The gathering still started with team formation. The mercenary team that was previously looking for the treasure of a certain Beyonder family came to form a team again: "We learned the approximate location of an ancient tomb through the clues we found, but we have been searching for a long time and haven't found that ancient tomb.
"We now need friends who are good at divination or good at finding ancient tombs to join our team."
The speaker was a big fat man, wearing casual clothes. Hobert was very worried that the buttons on his stomach would be stretched open by his belly.
The fat man continued: "As long as the ancient tomb is found and the subsequent exploration is completed, he can get 10% of the loot."
When Jacob formed a team to explore the ruins before, Hobert's strength was not good enough, so he didn't plan to get involved.
Now that he was Sequence 6, Hobert was very interested in this kind of ruin exploration. He asked: "What type of ancient tomb is it? What is the degree of danger?"
He had planned to ask about it the last time the fat man came to form a team, but at that time, the ruins that Jacob and the others had excavated had just given Hobert a not small psychological impact, so he didn't ask.
Later, under the protection of Mr. Azik, Hobert gained a lot in the ruins of Trunsoest, and he became more interested in Beyonder ruins.
The fat man said: "If you are interested, we can go to the reception room to talk privately after the gathering. Specific information is not convenient to disclose."
Hobert nodded: "I see."
He planned to go and find out first. As long as it doesn't conflict with Christian's plan, he will go to the scene to take a look.
After the fat man's team invitation ended, the team that explored the newly discovered uninhabited island at the previous gathering also happened to invite new teammates: "What we didn't expect is that on that small island, we actually found some Beyonder creatures and some strange buildings.
"According to our preliminary judgment, those buildings have the style of the Fourth Epoch, but I don't know why, those buildings were abandoned before they were completed.
"In addition, there seems to be a powerful and strange Beyonder creature on the island. We have failed to encircle and suppress it many times.
"Because of the appearance of a group of pirates, we had to retreat temporarily and come back to find more helpers to thoroughly investigate that small island and, by the way, crack down on those pirates.
"Friends of the 'Hunter' pathway can consider joining us. The specific gains are distributed according to work, and there is a guarantee from the Mercenary Club, so don't worry about our credibility."
Maybe because they were going to the Berserk Sea, no one responded to this team invitation.
None of the subsequent team invitations interested Hobert, and there were no items in the trading session that attracted Hobert's attention.
After the gathering, Hobert came to the reception room mentioned by the fat man. Including Hobert, there were five people who wanted to accept the fat man's team invitation.
But the fat man only needed two people now, so he turned around and wanted to interview the five people.
The fat man glanced at everyone, and then said to Hobert: "Young man, let's talk first."
Obviously, he didn't participate in the Beyonder Gathering of the Mercenary Club very much, and didn't know Hobert.
After arriving at the reception room and sitting down, the fat man said: "I must remind you that our adventure may cost you your life at any time. You'd better think about whether you want to continue our conversation?"
Hobert then understood that this fat man saw that he was too young and might not have much experience, so he called him in first, preparing to persuade to quit.
Hobert smiled slightly: "I have experience in exploring Beyonder ruins."
"If the sequence is too low, it is also very dangerous."
"I am a Sequence 6."
The fat man looked Hobert up and down: "Okay, we can have the next conversation. Are you good at divination?"
"I have a Sealed Artifact that is easy to navigate ancient tombs," Hobert said, "I also know a friend who is good at divination. What kind of cooperation method do you choose?"
The fat man was stunned for a second or two, obviously re-evaluating Hobert's strength: "Congratulations, you will be a member of our team for a period of time in the future."
"Wait a minute." Hobert smiled slightly: "I have to evaluate the risk of this exploration before deciding whether to join you.
"Please answer the questions I asked at the gathering. What type of ancient tomb is it? Or rather, which pathway's Beyonder is buried inside?"
The fat man no longer concealed it: "It is said that the owner of the ancient tomb is a descendant of Antigonus. According to the clues we found, there may be some accumulation of the Antigonus family in his tomb."
Hobert immediately had the idea of rejecting it. Although there was no evidence, he always felt that the ancient tomb of this pathway's Beyonder was likely a trap.
The reason is also very simple. The Beyonders of this pathway and the adjacent pathways are generally old cunning people.
The fat man may have seen Hobert's concerns: "The danger level of the ancient tomb should not be high. After all, according to reliable records, the tomb owner was Sequence 5 when he died."
"Is the news reliable?"
"It is impossible for us to joke about our own lives!"
Hobert nodded, then he could consider it. If it was Sequence 3 or higher, that ancient tomb might be a part of the tomb owner's advancement ritual.
He said: "If I find danger, I will warn you. But if you don't listen, I have the right to leave directly, and you can't stop me."
The fat man said: "It is a matter of course."
Hobert added: "As for dividing the spoils, I have the right of first refusal."
The fat man thought for a while before saying: "You can only choose once."
Hobert nodded: "Deal."
At this time, the fat man introduced himself: "You can call me Austin. Our new round of exploration will depart next Thursday morning, gathering at Order Square."
Hobert nodded: "No problem."
When leaving the reception room, Hobert realized that this would be the first time he had actively participated in a Mercenary Club mission.
...
The new week began, and Hobert took a taxi carriage from his home on Empress Borough to the law firm for work.
As soon as he arrived at the firm, Viscount Glaint's personal valet came to visit Hobert with a briefcase containing several potions that Hobert had previously ordered from Viscount Glaint.
Viscount Glaint listed a bill. The "Corpse Dissolving Potion" and poison that Hobert needed were naturally free, and Jessica's reserved potion cost a total of 26 pounds.
Jessica came over to pay, and after the valet left, she smiled: "I didn't expect it to really be at cost."
This was much cheaper than the potions at other gatherings, but she didn't know how effective it would be?
After the afternoon, Hobert returned to Blanca Street as usual on the pretext.
At three o'clock, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog.
When he arrived in the Giant's Hall, he immediately discovered that there was a new member opposite him: Miss Magician is online!

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 279 New Member: Miss Magician (Bonus 9)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Justice" Audrey didn't greet all the members as usual. She observed the new member's attire, posture, height – well, mainly height – and confirmed that the new member was Miss Fors, not Miss Xio.
She was filled with joy, as this new member was introduced through her!
"The Fool" Klein said, "This is the new member, Miss Magician."
Everyone greeted the new member. Klein then introduced "The Magician" Fors: "This is Miss Justice, that is Mr. Hanged Man, Mr. Emperor, Mr. Sun, and Mr. World, who sits at the lower seat."
Fors greeted them politely one by one, while also observing the state of the other members: Miss Justice was dressed in the attire of a Loen noble, she was likely a noble from Backlund.
Mr. Hanged Man looked somewhat rugged, "The Sun" seemed not very old, why did "The World" look so gloomy?
And also, why did Mr. Emperor give people a familiar feeling?
Fors, with her rich experience in Beyonder gatherings, behaved very steadily, not as green as "Little Sun" when he first joined the Tarot Club.
Amidst everyone's mutual observation, Klein announced the official start of the gathering.
Because no member provided Roselle's diary this week, "The Hanged Man" Alger asked after the gathering began: "Mr. Emperor, I am very curious, do you really intend to frequently use that sealed artifact?"
"Not really." Hobert replied: "I have already crushed it into Beyonder characteristics, and I plan to find an 'Artisan' skilled in making magical items to re-manufacture a magical item with less severe negative effects."
This was not something worth concealing.
Klein and Alger behind the gray fog almost simultaneously thought in their hearts: As expected!
Fors instantly lost her composure, her steady mindset turned into an urge to scratch her head: What are they talking about? Why do I seem to understand, but don't understand what they mean?
At this moment, she even doubted the knowledge she had accumulated over the years of attending gatherings.
Audrey asked curiously: "There can be such an operation?"
Hobert smiled: "Yes, remember the laws of Beyonder characteristics we talked about before? This is an application of those laws."
Laws? Fors noticed this word, but: why is the modern word "law" used in mysticism?
Audrey pondered for a moment, and using the "Law of Beyonder characteristics Conservation", she roughly understood the principle of this operation.
Alger interjected: "I heard that at least a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact is required to crush Beyonder characteristics?"
"The Sun" Derrick also echoed: "Perhaps our names are different, I also heard that God-level Sealed Artifacts can do this, and it is said that only some intelligent God-level Sealed Artifacts can do it."
Hobert affirmed: "That's right."
Alger, Derrick, and several others exchanged glances: Alright, alright, now it's clear, "The Emperor" does have the opportunity to use Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts. In terms of such strength, the family behind "The Emperor" should be an extraordinary family with a long history.
Fors weakly raised her hand: "That, the Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts that everyone is talking about, are they the kind of Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts that the Church defines?"
Audrey smiled and said: "Of course, in the extraordinary world, there is only that one standard."
Fors was stunned for a second or two before muttering: "It is said that it is something that can destroy a country!"
Her heart was already like a gale, raining heavily: I heard the concept of Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts at a certain gathering before, and I thought it was a legend or a story, who knew… what kind of gathering did I join? There is actually a member who can use Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts? And why are everyone's reactions so calm?
Audrey asked curiously again: "Compared to this, I want to know more, what was the final transaction price of that Sealed Artifact containing the 'Traveler' Beyonder characteristics?"
Alger glanced at "The Emperor" and, seeing that the other party didn't mean to stop him, said: "9200 pounds."
Audrey exclaimed: "Mr. Emperor, you are really rich."
She had put in some effort to take out 10,000 pounds at once before, and of course she knew how difficult it was to raise this level of funds.
Fors almost slipped under the long table. The transaction amount of those gatherings she had participated in before was at most thousands of pounds.
In fact, transactions of several hundred pounds are usually carried out secretly, otherwise it is easy to be targeted by some malicious Beyonders.
9200 pounds! Thinking of the more than a thousand pounds of savings she was proud of before participating in the gathering, she suddenly felt so pitiful.
And, why? Why are everyone's reactions so calm?
Hobert sighed: "The money I saved during this period has been emptied all at once."
Alger joked: "Maybe we should ask you to give us a lecture on how to earn 10,000 pounds in a month or two!"
Then he said: "Mr. Emperor, I remember you mentioned before that you know why the Berserk Sea is berserk, right?"
Fors even had the urge to bite her nails: What does "why the Berserk Sea is berserk" mean? Isn't it always berserk? What's the point of calling it the Berserk Sea if it's not berserk?
"Yes." Hobert said: "I remember I also said that this information is probably worth 2000 pounds, this price is only available in the Tarot Club, other Beyonder gatherings, I think you can't get such high-end information even if you spend several times the price.
"Another point is that I will only sell such information in the Tarot Club. If I sell such high-level information in the real world, it will definitely bring me a lot of trouble."
Alger nodded: "According to your hint, I have found out some information: At the end of the Fourth Epoch, the Underworld Emperor, who failed to attack the Northern Continent, was seriously injured under the siege of the six gods.
"After He escaped from the battlefield, He stirred up raging waves, creating insurmountable obstacles, blocking His enemies. Since then, the sea between the continents has become unpredictable, turning into the current disaster-prone Berserk Sea.
"I have also learned about some legends of the Southern Continent. The Underworld Emperor seems to have failed to return to the Southern Continent. Is the formation of the Berserk Sea related to His fall?"
"That's right, that's roughly the case." Hobert smiled: "But your guess only depicts the appearance of the Berserk Sea's formation. The internal reason and principle of its formation is a very high-end knowledge, and it is far more complicated than you think.
"What? Do you want to trade information about the formation of the Berserk Sea?"
Alger hesitated for a moment before saying: "Yes, the second target I am looking for is in the unexplored area of the Berserk Sea."
Then he asked: "How can I avoid the bad weather of the Berserk Sea?"
Hobert thought for a while: "As far as I know, there is a way."
Alger subconsciously asked: "What way?"
Hobert smiled: "Only when you understand the principle of the Berserk Sea's formation will you understand the method I am talking about. Of course, you can also just buy the method from me, and I will also provide you with corresponding props. I think 500 is a very suitable price."
Alger finally made up his mind: "I will trade with you for the reason for the formation of the Berserk Sea!"
He felt a little heartache: "Is it 2000 pounds?"
There can be no sloppiness in the preparation work before the exploration.
"I think I can give another discount on this transaction. Keep your money first, it will be useful later." Hobert said: "If one person trades with me, they have to pay 2000 pounds of reward.
"Two people only need 1000 pounds, three people who want to know the answer to this question only need to pay 700 pounds each, if four people want to trade with me, they only need to spend 600 pounds."
Fors opened her mouth, there was such a big discount!
But she quickly understood: No, Mr. Emperor didn't earn a penny less! Instead, he earned more and more!

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 280 The Only True God (Bonus 10)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
From the beginning of the gathering until now, Fors has been in a daze. Her inner world has been stormy: "Why is this exchange so high-end? Heavens, Underworld Emperor? That's an ancient figure I saw in history textbooks.
"Judging from their tone, the Underworld Emperor is actually a high-level Beyonder? No, The Hanged Man used 'He' and 'fallen'. Could it be that the Underworld Emperor is a being like a god?
"But, but what does this have to do with the Berserk sea?
"Also, also, Mr. Emperor's trading method is really novel. Not only can he earn more money from it, but he also gives buyers benefits.
"Such high-level information only costs six or seven hundred pounds, which makes me want to join their trade."
But Fors thought that she only had more than a thousand pounds in savings, and she would have to buy the "Astrologer" potion formula and main materials in the future.
Reason told her that her money could not be spent in this place. At the moment, she didn't dare to say a word, or even breathe loudly, and honestly listened to the other members' transactions.
Audrey raised her hand first and said, "I want to join this transaction!"
"The Sun" Derrick also said, "I also hope to join. Can the reward still be paid with Beyonder materials?"
"Yes." Hobert smiled and said, "Only three people, right? Then each person needs to pay 700 pounds. 'The Sun' needs at least three Sequence 8 main materials."
Alger breathed a sigh of relief and thanked Mr. Emperor again for inventing this trading method. It was really cost-effective to learn such high-end news for 700 pounds.
After everyone had no objection to the reward for this transaction, Hobert said to Klein, "Mr. Fool, please block Miss Magician's, oh, and Mr. World's hearing and vision."
Although it felt a bit like burying one's head in the sand, "World" still had to be included.
Klein slowly nodded, letting the mist envelop "The World" and Fors.
Hobert then began to say, "The information that The Hanged Man inquired about is the legend that is now widely circulated.
"The characters that appear in this legend are correct, and The Hanged Man's guess is also very reasonable. But has everyone thought about such a question? Which god represents the power over the ocean?"
Alger did not speak, and Audrey responded, "Of course it is the 'Lord of Storms'!"
"That's right, if the Underworld Emperor stirred up raging waves and created a barrier on the sea, why didn't the 'Lord of Storms' calm the Berserk sea? Causing the North and South continents to be separated for more than a thousand years!" Hobert asked with a smile.
Klein, who was hiding behind the gray fog and getting a free ride, sighed: I'm really afraid that "The Emperor" will be struck by lightning when he goes out. He knows too much, and he has no respect for the gods at all.
Alger thought of the answer, but because it was too blasphemous to the gods, he still didn't speak.
Audrey simply didn't think of the answer, like a student encountering a difficult problem in class, racking her brains.
Derrick didn't quite understand the authority of the "Lord of Storms", and didn't know how to answer Mr. Emperor's question.
Hobert answered himself: "Obviously because the 'Lord of Storms' also could not calm the Berserk sea!"
Alger breathed a sigh of relief: Sure enough.
Audrey couldn't quite maintain her state as an Spectator, but then she calmed down again. She had just heard about the "Blasphemy Slate" last week, and she already had some "antibodies" to this kind of blasphemous information.
"This is one of the most valuable parts of this information," Hobert continued with a smile: "The fall of the Underworld Emperor caused the entire space of the Berserk sea to be distorted.
"Because of the particularity of his pathway, the Underworld and the Spirit World, which overlap with the real world, collapsed and merged due to the distortion of space.
"The reason why the climate there is raging is because of the Underworld and the Spirit World!"
The knowledgeable Klein and Alger immediately understood many things. Alger smiled and said, "No wonder the climate of the Berserk sea has not changed for more than a thousand years."
Audrey asked, "What is the difference between the Underworld and the Spirit World?"
This was not very valuable information, so Hobert casually explained: "The Underworld is a special area opened up by the ancient Death in the Spirit World. For Beyonders of the 'Death' pathway, they can borrow power from the Underworld more easily than from the Spirit World.
"At the same time, that is also the 'Death's' domain in the Spirit World, a part of his undead empire."
Audrey smiled and said, "Thank you for your generosity."
Derrick immediately asked, "Mr. Emperor, is the ancient Death God you mentioned 'Undying Bird' Gregrace?"
"Yes."
"So, the Underworld Emperor was the Death God that once existed in your world?"
"Yes!" Hobert said, "Not only the Death God, but he was also trying to open up a new path."
Whether it was Klein behind the gray fog or the "old fritter" Alger, they both keenly noticed: a new path?
Unfortunately, Hobert did not continue to discuss this topic, but returned to the question of the raging sea: "Why could the fall of the Underworld Emperor cause such great power?"
Hobert answered himself: "Because when the Underworld Emperor joined forces with the 'Primordial Demoness' to attack the Northern Continent, his state was distorted, half-mad!"
Klein suddenly thought of a sentence in Roselle's diary: The Underworld Emperor is crazy, but also stronger.
Alger frowned, not quite understanding what it meant. The Underworld Emperor did not forcibly jump to a non-adjacent pathway like the Blood Emperor, why was he also half-mad?
Audrey directly asked, "Mr. Emperor, I'm sorry, I have another question: Why was the Underworld Emperor in a half-mad state?"
Hobert smiled and replied, "That's another question, you have to add money."
Audrey sighed helplessly. Her financial situation has not been very optimistic in recent months. 700 pounds is already her limit now.
Hobert returned to the previous topic: "Because of the special state of the Underworld Emperor, the two Uniquenesses that fell from him were not sealed and properly handled in time. This is the root power that made the raging sea raging in the beginning.
"It was those two Uniquenesses that reacted violently with the power emitted by the fall of the Underworld Emperor, breaking the balance between the real world and the Spirit World and the Underworld, causing the entire sea to be distorted, and allowing the power of the Underworld and the Spirit World to continue to affect the real world.
"Even the 'Lord of Storms' has no way to change the impact on reality.
"This is the reason and principle why the raging sea is raging."
The atmosphere in the Great Hall has become solemn. Mr. Emperor's words just now contained too much important information!
Alger asked, "Mr. Emperor, what is 'Uniqueness'?"
Hobert smiled: "This is the second valuable part of this information: A True God is unique! He is the foundation of uniqueness, which is the Uniqueness of that pathway!
"You can understand it as the authority of the gods, the abstract source of power of the gods."

chapters.content:

"Justice", "Hanged Man", and "Sun" looked at each other, and all saw surprise in each other's body language.
If Klein hadn't had excellent control over himself due to being "The Fool", he would have shown enough surprise as well: Seriously, if "Emperor" said he got struck by lightning one day, I definitely wouldn't be surprised at all.
Audrey thought to herself: The Tarot Club might as well be renamed "The Offend Gods Gathering", why do we have to offend or blaspheme against the gods every time we meet?
Alger thought: So, the gods not only have high positions, but also have their unique aspects, and their authority is actually "visible".
Derrick felt that his brain couldn't handle it: What Mr. Emperor just said is equivalent to analyzing the source of the gods' power. If he spread this kind of speech in City of Silver, he would definitely be burned to death! No wonder he said that he wouldn't conduct this kind of transaction outside the Tarot Club.
Hobert smiled and said, "I remember there is a treasure legend circulating at sea called 'The Key of Death', this legend's description is very appropriate, the place where the Underworld Emperor fell does indeed have the key to becoming the God of Death, that key is 'The Uniqueness of the Death pathway'!"
Alger discovered a problem with a detail: "Mr. Emperor, you just said that the Underworld Emperor has two Uniquenesses, besides the Uniqueness of the Death pathway, what pathway is the other Uniqueness from? And why can the Underworld Emperor absorb, no, accommodate the Uniquenesses of two pathways?"
Klein almost applauded Alger, this was also what he didn't understand.
"That's another question." Hobert smiled: "It costs extra, and the value of this question is higher than the value of the question I just answered for you."
Alger smiled wryly: "Let's trade again when we have the opportunity in the future."
Klein thought to himself: "Emperor" is a commercial genius! This money-making information is linked one after another.
Audrey felt like she was watching a wonderful novel, but when she saw the most exciting part, the author suddenly stopped writing! It's really hateful, annoying, and there's nothing she can do about it.
Derrick was still digesting the information about "Uniqueness".
Alger quickly asked again: "Then what can I do to avoid the bad weather in the Berserk Sea?"
Although the principle is known, it doesn't seem to solve the problem. That is the consequence of the "authority of the True God". What can a Sequence 7 do to solve it?
"Of course, travel through the Spirit World!" Hobert had long thought of this loophole: "The solution is a gift!
"Although the Spirit World in the Berserk Sea area is also very distorted and chaotic, compared to the real world, the Spirit World is simply a smooth road.
"After the miraculous item with the "Traveler" Beyonder characteristic is made, I can rent it to you, or we can simply join forces to explore that ruin."
Alger breathed a sigh of relief: "I'll consider it and give you an answer."
Audrey smiled slightly: As expected, there is no problem that Mr. Emperor can't solve.
The transaction about the Berserk Sea ended, and Klein restored Fors's hearing and vision. She immediately felt that the atmosphere of the gathering had become much heavier, which made her even more curious about the transaction just now.
Hobert said to Alger again: "I want to initiate two transactions with you."
Alger was stunned: "Please speak."
"The first transaction is, I heard that an island was just discovered in the Berserk Sea, and some Beyonder animals and some unfinished ruins were found on the island. Have you heard of this?"
"I've heard of it!" Alger said: "I heard that many pirates went to the island to explore, do you want to see it too?"
Hobert smiled and said, "With the ability of 'Travel', I can go to many places in a short time, but before that, I want to know the relevant information about that island."
Alger pondered: "150 pounds, I'll tell you all the information I know."
Hobert nodded: "Deal! These 150 pounds can be deducted from the reward for the previous transaction."
Alger certainly had no objection: "Do you want one person to listen, or everyone to listen together?"
"Let everyone listen together." Hobert smiled: "There is no need to keep these messages secret."
Moreover, even if other members hear it, it is impossible for them to explore that island.
Alger obviously knew the location of that island, but if he wanted to go, he would have gone long ago.
Klein, Audrey, and Fors will not leave Backlund in the near future, and "Little Sun" is even less likely to become a competitor to explore the unknown island. If he could go, City of Silver would have been liberated long ago.
As for "The World", if he can go to that island alone, then Hobert would not dare to participate in the Tarot Club in the future!
Alger organized his words: "That island was discovered three months ago, at the end of the West Route, southwest of Serra Island.
"Its location is on the edge of the safe passage, so it was recently discovered by a ship that was sheltering from the storm.
"That was a ship of the Loen Kingdom, and the captain sold this information for a good price. It is said that a Loen mercenary has been exploring that island for a long time.
"In the past month, the pirates have successively received the news and started exploration operations.
"As far as I know, the 'Merlin Pirate Group' and the 'Black Whale Pirate Group' have successively arrived on that island.
"The former is a pirate group that has been active at sea for more than ten years, and the latter has news that it has taken refuge in 'King of the Five Seas' Nast Solomon.
"It is said that 'Vice Admiral Iceberg's' 'Golden Dream' has also appeared near that island.
"The other pirate groups are not worth mentioning.
"As for what specific Beyonder creatures are on the island, there is no definite news yet, but I heard that there are Beyonder creatures at Sequence 6 level."
Hobert was very satisfied with this information. Only at sea can he get such comprehensive news.
After having the "Travel" ability, Hobert plans to join in the fun.
Audrey and Fors have already begun to imagine the adventurous life at sea. One imagines exploring with Susie and fighting pirates to maintain justice on the island.
One imagines encountering a handsome and humorous gentleman during the adventure, the two of them embark on an adventure together, and finally get the hidden treasure.
Then he said, "The second transaction is, I found the potion formula of 'Wind Blessed' for you."
Even the mature and prudent Alger was a little excited: "This is really good news, name your price."
Hobert: "Base price, 1500 pounds."
Audrey on the opposite side smiled slightly. Just a few days ago, she had heard the word "base price" several times.
But then, a surprising thought appeared in her mind.

chapters.content:

Audrey suddenly realized that she had been immersed in the smugness of seeing through "The Emperor's" identity, but she hadn't considered that she was even more conspicuous: "First of all, my clothes and accent would easily allow the opposite Hobert to judge that I am a noble from Backlund.
"The key is that after attending so many gatherings, I have never adjusted my timbre. Just based on my voice, Hobert can easily associate 'Justice' with Audrey."
In the end, Audrey came to the conclusion: Hobert probably already knew that "Justice" was Audrey! Fortunately, I also know that "The Emperor" is Hobert! We're even.
Thinking of this, Audrey finally breathed a long sigh of relief and decided to maintain the status quo for now, and reveal her identity when there was an opportunity or need.
On the other side, Alger breathed a sigh of relief and said almost immediately after Hobert made his offer: "Deal."
Having reached Sequence 6, both the potion formula and the main materials would have a lot of premium, and the price given by "The Emperor" was very fair.
Fors heard that the two were trading something like a Sequence 6 potion formula, and she finally felt a little bit back to reality.
Although she had attended so many extraordinary gatherings, she had never encountered anyone trading a Sequence 6 potion formula, because this level of potion formula rarely appeared, and the premium was frighteningly high.
But compared to their trading of the principles of the formation of the Berserk Sea, this was already very close to life.
With the help of Mr. Fool, Hobert manifested the "Wind Blessed" potion formula and handed it to Alger.
Alger glanced at the formula: "Wind Blessed"
"Main materials: Six crystalline feathers of the Blue Shadow Falcon, a pair of eyeballs of the Dragon Eye Sea Eagle.
"Auxiliary materials: ..."
Then he said to everyone: "Please help me pay attention to the eyeballs of the Dragon Eye Sea Eagle."
Alger knew that there was a mysterious island where Blue Shadow Falcons lived, and he could find a chance to hunt one.
After everyone agreed to help Alger pay attention, "The Sun" Derrick said again: "Mr. Emperor, before attending the gathering, I had already prepared the materials to repay my previous debts.
"Because I have incurred new debts, can I give you four Sequence 8 level main materials and one Sequence 9 level main material together tomorrow."
His merits were enough to exchange for three Sequence 8 level materials from the inventory.
Hobert nodded: "Yes, well, by the way, if possible, the four Sequence 8 level main materials should preferably be the same material."
This was to leave a certain amount of room for trial and error for Carrie.
"No problem!" For Derrick, the City of Silver's inventory had many of the same materials, and the Emperor's request was not difficult to achieve.
Fors hesitated for a moment, and still reminded: "Mr. Sun, if you don't have gold pounds in your hand, you can go to the bank to exchange some gold pounds from the Kingdom of Loen to pay Mr. Emperor's remuneration."
She said it more euphemistically. The value of the three Sequence 8 level main materials had far exceeded 700 pounds.
The reason why she reminded this was because she thought that "The Sun" was not from the Kingdom of Loen, and that he used this method to pay remuneration because he didn't have gold pounds.
The value of Beyonder materials is generally more stable than gold. Even if the currency used to purchase the materials is different, the specific value will not vary too much.
If people from other countries go to the bank to exchange gold pounds, even if there is a handling fee, it is more cost-effective.
Derrick was slightly stunned: "Thank you for your reminder, the city I am in cannot exchange for gold pounds."
He added: "The price offered by Mr. Emperor is actually very considerate to me."
Derrick was telling the truth. After he figured out part of the price difference between materials in City of Silver and the outside world, the Emperor was still willing to use three extraordinary materials to top the value of 700 pounds, which was obviously a kind of discount for him.
In his opinion, the Emperor was so smart, and he also proposed to exchange weapons for extraordinary materials. He must have also figured out the price difference.
What Derrick regretted was that his merits were not enough, otherwise he would have been more willing to trade five or six Sequence 8 level main materials with the Emperor.
Hearing "The Sun's" words, Fors was stunned: Is this really taking care of him? Or is he saying the opposite? He doesn't look like it. Also, if the city where he is located cannot exchange for gold pounds, he can go to a larger city. The capital always has banks with foreign exchange business!
Audrey smiled: "Miss Magician, your reminder is a very noble act, but if you know the region where Mr. Sun is located, you would not have such a reminder."
Fors guessed: So that's how it is. "The Sun" may be in the Southern Continent, where transportation is inconvenient, and exchanging gold pounds is even more inconvenient.
Hearing "Justice's" words, Derrick became more and more yearning for life in the North and South continents, so he initiated a transaction that he had long wanted to initiate: "I want to trade information about the Seven Gods you mentioned, and the reward is that I can answer some of your questions, but the premise is that I know the answers to the questions."
He said: "Everyone can write down what they know about the Seven Gods, and then I will answer your questions one by one. Is there anyone willing to trade with me?"
Fors thought she had misheard. In any corner of this world, you can find information about the Seven Gods in any village church, right? Why is there still a need for trading? Also? Why is everyone's reaction still so flat?
Audrey, Alger, and "The World" were all willing to trade with Derrick. Hobert smiled: "I won't participate. The information I know, you may not be able to give an equal answer."
Klein and Derrick both felt it was a pity. Klein felt that the information provided by Hobert might be valuable to those who were familiar with the Seven Gods. Derrick felt that the information provided by the Emperor should be the most comprehensive and credible.
After this transaction ended, "The World" conducted a transaction with Derrick regarding the "Demon" pathway, in order to further determine the murderer in the serial murder case.
Subsequently, the transaction session ended and the exchange session began.
Hobert asked: "Does anyone know the progress of the Backlund serial murder case?"
Alger on the side asked: "Are you not in Backlund?"
"No, I have been busy with other things." Hobert explained: "If I hadn't just heard the transaction between Mr. 'World' and 'Sun', I would have almost forgotten that there is a demon in Backlund who is seeking an opportunity to advance."
Fors, who was also in Backlund, listened very carefully: What does that mean? The murderer is a Beyonder, that is, the "Demon" pathway they just mentioned? Oh my god, I didn't expect there to be such an evil pathway.
"The World" said in a hoarse voice: "Official Beyonders are fully investigating, and it is estimated that they will soon determine the murderer."
Audrey said: "I hope they can catch the murderer as soon as possible."
Fors echoed: "The atmosphere in Backlund is becoming very depressing because of the serial murder case."
Hobert jumped to the next topic: "In the Kingdom of Loen, there is an extraordinary organization called 'Judgement Group'. It is a terrorist organization supported by other countries. Members in the Kingdom of Loen must be vigilant against this organization. If you accidentally learn of their news, please notify me by praying to Mr. Fool, and I will give him a certain amount of spoils."

chapters.content:

On the violent sea, the "Blue Avenger" sailed steadily through the storm and raging waves.
In the captain's cabin, unanchored tables and cabinets moved slowly with the rocking of the ship.
Alger, sitting in his chair, could feel the gentle swaying of the ship, but he was long accustomed to it. In fact, he would feel disoriented at first upon returning to land.
Alger first used a sacrificial ritual to pay "The Emperor" a total of 2050 pounds for the "Wind Blessed" potion formula and information about the origin of the Berserk Sea.
Then, he recalled "The Emperor's" words and fell into deep thought: "Although I didn't ask, 'The Emperor' must already be Sequence 6. After becoming Sequence 6, he has become more proactive, even preparing to hunt members of Beyonder organizations.
"Once he has the ability of 'Travel,' no one will be able to kill him easily, and a metropolis like Backlund will no longer be able to confine him.
"He is likely to come to the sea to explore that small island and stir up a bloody storm.
"After killing people, he can simply leave and return to Backlund to continue being a gentleman."
Thinking about it, Alger also coveted the ability of "Travel." He believed that he could use this ability to create several different identities at sea, making himself mysterious and unpredictable, which would be the safest.
Unfortunately, it's too expensive!
Alger shook his head. The "Traveler" Beyonder characteristic was beyond his current means.
Then he began to consider: "Should I ask 'The Emperor' to explore the second target found in the ruins with me?
"If 'The Emperor' joins the adventure, this operation is destined to be very stable, but I will definitely have to share the spoils with 'The Emperor,' and he will most likely get to choose first.
"If I explore alone, what if I encounter a similar situation as last time?
Now, Alger still felt lingering fear when he recalled his previous exploration experience. Fortunately, he was cautious enough at the time, otherwise the Sea God could have killed him more easily than crushing an ant.
After thinking for a long time, Alger decided to look for safer routes in the surrounding waters.
If he really couldn't find a safe route, he would ask "The Emperor" to explore with him.
As for "The Emperor's" proposal to rent the magical items in his possession, Alger felt that if he couldn't find the target, even if he had the ability of "Travel," the exploration would only be slightly more convenient, but it wouldn't become much safer.
It would be better to simply ask the Emperor to take action, which would be more reliable.
...
Backlund, Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's villa.
Audrey first used a sacrificial ritual to pay Hobert the 700 pounds reward.
Then she recalled Hobert's words: "Spoils? Hobert directly regards members of terrorist organizations as spoils!"
She remembered that Hobert wasn't so flamboyant before: "Is it because his confidence has swelled after becoming Sequence 6?
"Also, also, I've inquired, General Christian has no siblings, but quite a few comrades-in-arms, but they all seem to have been deliberately transferred to various military regions.
"In everyone's eyes, he is just an ordinary General, but it's unimaginable that General Christian would have a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
"Perhaps Hobert has other channels to obtain the right to use Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts?"
Audrey had also met General Christian, and he didn't seem like someone who controlled a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
Although she didn't have a clear concept of Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, she knew that if Christian controlled a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, he would definitely not be just a General.
"So contradictory," Audrey thought. "If I can meet General Christian at the ball, I can try to talk to him and see if I can get more information."
At this moment, Susie ran in from outside to report: "Thank goodness, Audrey, you're finally 'awake.' Annie has returned from your mother's place and is already at the corner of the corridor."
"Great, Susie!" Audrey opened the drawer with a smile and rewarded Susie with a few pet biscuits.
...
Forsaken Land of the Gods, City of Silver.
Derrick, like at the end of the previous gatherings, stared at the dim roof for a while.
Then he turned over and got out of bed, tidied up his clothes, and went out.
He had been very busy recently. Besides paying off Mr. Emperor's debts, the merits he earned were also used to exchange for the main materials for "Light Supplicant."
Working in the workshop was like playing the role of "Bard" every day, and the potion had been basically digested.
After the gathering, in addition to continuing to work in the workshop, he also had to help Mr. Emperor exchange for three identical main materials.
Derrick thought: I can go to the black market first to see if I can exchange for them. If I can't, I'll go to the City of Silver warehouse, or exchange for two at the black market and one at the warehouse. Otherwise, exchanging for three materials that are useless in everyone's eyes in a row may attract some attention.
...
Backlund, 15 Minsk Street.
Klein looked at the weather outside. It was rare to see that it was still sunny, and he could even see the outline of the sun!
"Sequence 6!" Klein, who had just become Sequence 7, imagined what abilities he would gain after becoming Sequence 6.
He didn't immediately seek "The Emperor's" help at today's gathering to shatter the Beyonder characteristic contaminated by the "True Creator." Anyway, there was no rush to use it now, and he could wait for a while.
Today, Klein planned to go to the Harvest Church after attending the Tarot Gathering. He had heard from the old gentleman at the "Eye of Wisdom" gathering that he could get the "Apothecary" potion formula there.
Klein wanted to cultivate an "Apothecary" assistant, or sell the formula when he was short of money.
Wearing his top hat and taking his cane, Klein waited on the street for a while and took a rental carriage to Rose Street. After walking for another seven or eight minutes, he found the Harvest Church, which looked a bit out of place on this street.
Entering the church, Klein first exclaimed inwardly at Bishop Utravsky's height, and then said, "I heard that I can get the 'Apothecary' potion formula here?"
"Yes," Bishop Utravsky stopped praying: "But the prerequisite is to complete a task."
"What task?"
"Kill the past me," Utravsky explained: "I have a magical item here that can enter the depths of dreams. The past me is hiding there.
"But I must remind you, I am a 'Dawn Paladin.' To be honest, the past me was quite strong. Your strength does not seem to be enough to defeat the past me."
Klein was very interested in Utravsky's magical item: "As long as I can know the abilities of the 'Dawn Paladin' in advance, it is not impossible."
Utravsky suddenly asked: "Do you know Hobert?"
Klein was stunned and immediately became vigilant: "I know him."
Utravsky nodded almost imperceptibly: "It seems that you are the person arranged by the Mother Goddess to save me. If you can succeed, I will not only give you the 'Apothecary' potion formula, but also give you a magical item.
"Okay, now I will explain the abilities of the 'Dawn Paladin' to you..."
Just now, Klein was surprised why the "Giant Bishop" knew that he knew Hobert? He thought that this "Giant Bishop" had a conflict with Hobert.
But why did the "Giant Bishop" become so amiable after learning that he knew Hobert, even so amiable that it made people feel a little creepy.
Klein's heart was in turmoil: Why, because I know Hobert, did I become the person "arranged by the Goddess" to save him?

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 284 All Good Things Must Come to an End
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Backlund, 19 Blanca Street.
Fors took half a minute to regain her senses in the bedroom: "What a wonderful gathering!"
Immediately afterward, the unbelievable events at the gathering flooded in like a tide: "Mr. Emperor has access to sealed artifacts?
"Why did 'The Sun' speak so strangely? It seems he doesn't live in the Northern or Southern continents, or the archipelago? Where exactly is he?
"A serial murder case, actually committed by a demon?"
The questions in Fors's mind sprouted one after another, like bamboo shoots in spring.
The pressure of this gathering was too intense, and she was too embarrassed to ask her questions during the final exchange.
Then she thought: "So, the Berserk Sea wasn't always raging? Its current state is related to the Underworld Emperor in the history books?
"What to do? I really want to know the answers! I wonder if I can trade with Mr. Emperor again and pay him 600 pounds to tell me the answers?"
Thinking of this, she sighed, lamenting why her life was so poor.
Logically, a deposit of over a thousand pounds would be enough for her to live a middle-class life in Backlund, but at this moment, those savings seemed so pale and powerless.
No, I can't delay any longer, I must write the beginning of the new book as soon as possible!
As long as I write the beginning, the rest will be easier.
After much effort, she finally sat up from the bed: I need to take it easy; getting up too quickly is bad for my health. Of course, I should also use the time to relax, like, reading a magazine or newspaper?
In another bedroom on the second floor, Hobert received the rewards that Alger and Audrey paid him, a total of 2750 pounds, through bestowal.
Among them, the "Wind Blessed" potion formula was 1500 pounds, and the information about the cause of the Berserk Sea's formation was 1250 pounds.
This income brought Hobert's funds to over 6000 pounds, making him a "rich man" again.
He felt that he could completely use this money as start-up capital to develop in the Southern Continent.
As for the gold and Beyonder characteristics of the "Nation of Disorder", he could keep them for a while. In case he went to a place where gold pounds were not used, both gold and Beyonder characteristics were hard currency.
Even if gold pounds could be used, he could use "Travel" to return and cash them out at the Beyonder gatherings in Backlund, but he would have to find a new channel to cash them out.
Thinking of this, Hobert sacrificed the newly obtained 2600 pounds to the "Nation of Disorder". Seeing the piles of gold pounds become full again, Hobert's mood immediately improved a lot.
Just as he was about to leave the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert discovered that there were two stars twinkling in the pool in front of him.
One of them was Rafter, who was praying to the "Creator" again.
Hobert sighed, this guy's perseverance is not bad.
The other star was actually Upton. Hobert spread his spirituality over and heard Upton's voice: "...Great 'Creator', I have returned to Conant and am preparing to open a showroom for selling steam engines here. If any of your blessed ones need my help, they can come to me. The address of the showroom is 66 White Rose Street."
Retracting his spirituality, Hobert nodded: Very good! He even knows to actively report his movements.
Now there are not only blessed ones of the "Creator" in the Southern Continent, but also in Desi County. Congratulations, there are finally two blessed ones.
Hobert smiled self-deprecatingly, and then he thought that the "Dawn Paladin" who called himself John had hidden the "Mutated Fire Rose Spider" in the Conant cemetery. Should he let Upton take a look?
But he quickly shook his head. The risk of this action was not small. Upton would be useful in the future. If he was targeted by the people of the "Judgment Group", it would not be worth it.
Thinking about it, Hobert looked at the star representing Rafter: This can't be blamed on me, he asked for it! Although I used him to get the "Black Emperor" card, I also dispelled the evil spirit possessing him, which is equivalent to saving his life. We are even! But he insisted on coming to my door to let me trick him, what can I do?
However, Hobert did not act immediately. He planned to wait and see. If Rafter prayed to the "Creator" again, then don't blame the "Creator" for using him as a pawn again.
Leaving the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert thought of Fors, who had just joined the Tarot Club: I can't continue to live with Xio and Fors, it will harm them.
[T/N: Noooo]
After a little thought, Hobert put on his coat, picked up his cane, went to the restaurant outside to order a rich dinner, and bought two bottles of wine.
A little after five in the afternoon, Fors, who was preparing to come down to make dinner, and Xio, who had just entered the door after a busy day, were both surprised to see the rich dinner prepared by Hobert.
Fors smiled: "The 10-pound meal fee hasn't been spent yet."
Xio smiled: "Let's just assume you're treating us because you made money."
At the previous "Justice League" gathering, Hobert sold two potion formulas and a Sequence 8 main material, earning over a thousand pounds.
Hobert set out the wine glasses: "I have something important to discuss with you."
As he spoke, he opened the red wine: "Please sit down."
Fors and Xio exchanged glances, their expressions becoming serious.
Hobert smiled: "There's no need to be so serious, but this matter must be told to you in advance.
"In order to seek better development, I may have to leave Backlund at any time, so I want you to be prepared to look for a new rental house, because before leaving Backlund, I will terminate the lease and get back part of the rent."
Of course, he wouldn't tell them the truth.
Xio looked at Hobert: "Are you in some kind of trouble?"
"No." Hobert smiled: "It's really to seek better development. Although Backlund has various and convenient Beyonder channels, it's not suitable for me to continue developing. This is determined by the potion."
Fors nodded, seeming to understand: "Will you ever come back to Backlund in the future?"
"Of course, I will come back." Hobert said: "And I will come back often to conduct some transactions. As long as I can be notified in advance, I will attend the 'Justice League' gatherings without fail."
The only problem is, how to get notified in time?
Xio looked a little depressed: "I've already gotten used to the lively restaurants here and the spacious bedroom."
"I've gotten used to it too." Hobert smiled reluctantly: "But, banquets always come to an end. Don't be sad at this time, because the next banquet will always come."
Fors raised her glass: "Okay, I wish you better development. Xio and I both owe you a favor and can only repay you later."
"That's too polite." Hobert smiled: "If you want to find me, you can write to the law firm, and my colleagues will forward it to me."

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 285: Recycling and Reuse of Abandoned Pieces
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The next day, Tuesday, Hobert was woken up early by "The Fool". It turned out that "Little Sun" had gathered all the Beyonder materials and used The Fool's sacrifice to pay Mr. Emperor.
There were a total of four identical Sequence 8 level main materials, and one Sequence 9 level main material.
Hobert didn't recognize them, so he simply sacrificed them all to the "Nation of Disorder".
In the afternoon, Hobert accompanied Christian to see off her adoptive mother, Mona, as well as Donna and Tyron.
Mona's expression was calm, as if she had been prepared for a long time.
Donna's emotions were extremely rich, with longing for the trip, as well as reluctance towards her father and Hobert.
Tyron's reluctance was greater than his longing, wiping away tears several times, his eyes were red.
Watching the train go away, Christian and Hobert each took a carriage home.
When getting into the carriage, Christian said to Hobert, "Move back in these few days."
Hobert agreed, he returned to Blanca Street with complicated feelings, seeing the empty armchair, it seemed that the whole house had become deserted.
Fors and Xio hadn't canceled the lease for their previous rental house. They moved out before to avoid Qilangos, now the grass on Qilangos' grave is very tall, so he can just move back.
Hobert sat on the sofa, poured himself a glass of wine and slowly drank it. Successive farewells made him feel not so good.
He wasn't in the mood to cook dinner himself, so he went to the nearby Desi Flavor Restaurant to settle it.
After eating and drinking enough, he returned to his bedroom and entered the "Nation of Disorder". Now only gold pounds and those pleasing magical items and Beyonder characteristics could soothe his mind.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", he glanced at the stacks of gold pounds, Hobert saw that the star representing Rafter was expanding again, he thought: Since this is the case, then don't blame me!
Spreading his spirituality to the star representing Rafter, Rafter's prayers were similar to usual, all praying for the "Creator's" attention, praying for the "Creator" to help him point out the way to restore the family's glory.
Hobert used "True Sight" to confirm again, at least no one was watching within a range of ten meters, and Rafter's condition was also normal.
He pondered for a while before projecting his power and image to the star: "Praying for my attention comes at a price!"
...
Backlund, 29 Severus Street, Empress Borough.
During this period, in order not to miss the attention of that mysterious existence, and in order not to leave a bad impression on that mysterious existence, Rafter had been staying at home, not even going to the casino, nor calling street girls to his door.
This night, he was drinking red wine somewhat discouraged, feeling that his recent prayers were like a fool performing.
Maybe that honorific title wouldn't point to any existence at all, maybe that mysterious existence would never reply to his prayers, even if he replied, there was a high probability that he would become out of control and become a mindless monster.
While Rafter was thinking wildly, he saw a mighty figure sitting among the sharp swords, and heard an incomparably solemn voice: "Praying for my attention comes at a price!"
Pa~
The wine glass fell to the ground, Rafter felt an unprecedented sense of oppression, excitement and fear intertwined in his heart.
It took a full two seconds before he reacted, immediately lowered his head and knelt on one knee: "Respected great existence, please forgive my rudeness just now, please tell me what price I should pay to continue to receive your attention."
"I have already served you once at the Roselle Memorial Exhibition, please accept the service of your humble servant Rafter Pound, please help your humble servant guide the way to restore the family's glory."
That mighty voice did not answer, which made Rafter feel uneasy.
But soon, a picture appeared in Rafter's mind: he was running on the streets of Backlund, under the light of the gas street lamps, vaguely seeing a phantom lying on his back.
Rafter gasped, he had already recalled that it was the scene when he returned from digging the relics in his family's industry: that illusory figure... damn, I was possessed by an evil spirit from underground!
Fortunately, another picture appeared in his mind, it was himself at the gambling table, the illusory figure was still there, and it had become more solid.
Suddenly, the shadow seemed to see something terrible, a mysterious force pulled the shadow off Rafter's body, and the shadow was crushed by that mysterious force.
Then Rafter found himself as if he was possessed, and went to the Roselle Memorial Exhibition.
The second picture ended, Rafter regained his thoughts, he immediately recalled that for a period of time he always felt easily tired, and no amount of rest would help.
The two pictures that the mysterious existence showed him made him understand the truth: when digging the tunnel, I was possessed by an evil spirit from underground, it was that mysterious existence who took action to eliminate the evil spirit, but the price I paid was that I was controlled by the mysterious existence for a period of time, and did some actions at the Roselle Memorial Exhibition that went against my original intentions.
But in his heart, new doubts appeared: "Respected great existence, thank you for allowing me to avoid the misfortune of being killed by the evil spirit, please forgive my recklessness, so it turns out that I was not serving you at that time, but paying the price."
"But I have a question, why did you notice that I was possessed by an evil spirit?"
In theory, this powerful existence should not pay attention to a "low sequence" Beyonder.
Only the solemn voice said: "Because of your bloodline."
Rafter was stunned, the Pound family's bloodline? No no no, in order not to incur the royal family's jealousy, the Pound family only had two Sequence 5s at its most glorious time.
This great existence must be referring to the blood emperor Tudor's bloodline.
It is very likely that this existence is a big figure from the Fourth Epoch, perhaps in that war of the four emperors that swept across the North and South continents, there was also this great existence.
He immediately thought: Since I haven't immediately turned into a monster or a madman, then this great existence may be a strong person in the blood emperor's camp. Even if he isn't, he has no malice towards the blood emperor and the Tudor family.
Rafter said in the most respectful tone: "Please, what price should I pay to often receive your attention and guidance?"
"Prove your reliability and loyalty."
Rafter immediately knelt down on both knees: "Please accept my loy..."
"I don't need this kind of knightly loyalty."
"Then you..." At this time, two more pictures appeared in Rafter's mind, the first picture was a road sign: Conant Cemetery.
The second picture was a tombstone engraved with the name "John".
That solemn voice said: "Give you a small task, prove your reliability: there is a little thing in the coffin, sacrifice it to me!"
Rafter quickly said: "Thank you for your favor."
That huge oppressive force disappeared, if it wasn't for the wine glass on the floor and the spilled red wine, Rafter felt as if he had had a dream.
He knelt on the ground and muttered: "That grave, that coffin, uh, in Conant City, should I go?" He had a premonition that this "small" task might not be so simple.
While thinking, Rafter got up, at this time he realized that he was soaked in sweat.
At this time, a trace of madness flashed in Rafter's eyes: "This is an opportunity, I must seize it, even if there is danger, my situation will not be worse than it is now."

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 286 Invitation from the Loen Council
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert retrieved his spirituality: now it depends on whether Rafter is willing to go. As long as he is willing and wholeheartedly loyal to the "Creator," he can provide some assistance in the future.
After admiring the gold pounds and Beyonder characteristics on the stone platform not far away, Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder" and returned to the real world to rest.
On Wednesday morning, Hobert first directed the servants sent by Christian to move, but there was nothing much to move, only some clothes and daily necessities.
In fact, Hobert didn't plan to cancel the lease. Sacrificing to or being granted by his "Nation of Disorder" self still required him to come here, and attending the Tarot Gathering also needed an undisturbed space.
Around ten o'clock, Hobert arrived at the law firm for work, and his assistant Jessica immediately brought him an official letter, which turned out to be an invitation from the parliament.
Hobert opened it and saw that the parliament had recently established a "Labor Compensation Law" group and invited Hobert to join it.
Jessica congratulated Hobert: "This is a good thing! It shows that our work is gaining attention from the Parliament of the Kingdom of Loen."
That was the parliament. In Loen, a constitutional monarchy, the law was theoretically greater than royal power.
And the parliament, which held legislative power, was the well-deserved highest authority.
It's just that no one would really use the law to sanction the direct members of the royal family. The king only lost the legislative power.
The ruling power was still in the hands of the royal family. After all, the prime minister was appointed by the king. Although the prime minister would not consult the king on the daily operations of the country, no law could restrict his power if the king wanted to intervene in something.
Hobert smiled and said, "The upper house of parliament is basically hereditary seats for nobles, and the members of the lower house are mostly big bankers and the wealthiest people in the kingdom.
"They are indeed paying attention to our work, but the focus should not be what you think."
Jessica was stunned: "Aren't they going to protect the rights and interests of workers?"
Hobert asked, "How many workers have our team helped to get work-related injury compensation since its establishment?"
"So far, we have handled 28 cases. Thanks to you for setting a good precedent, it is now becoming increasingly easier to claim work-related injury compensation."
Hobert nodded: "According to the relevant laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Loen, cases without clear and applicable legal provisions in the law should be judged with reference to previous cases.
"Because there are no relevant regulations specifying the specific standards for labor compensation, there was only a conventional standard before Bob's case.
"After Bob's case, judges began to use Bob's case as a reference, so we basically won all 28 cases.
"This trend is unacceptable to the rich, so they might as well legislate as soon as possible to stipulate a standard for work-related injury compensation.
"As long as there are relevant laws and regulations, they will have loopholes to exploit again, and the rich who can afford lawyers will once again take the initiative in the compensation process."
Jessica opened her mouth: "They, they are too evil! They are even more evil than demons!"
Hobert smiled and said, "Demons only appear occasionally, but the demons catalyzed by wealth can openly harm others and become models and examples of the times.
"Although they invited me, it is estimated that they will just put on a show, only let me listen, but will not adopt any of my opinions."
Jessica sat in the chair opposite Hobert, feeling a sense of powerlessness. This was a unique sense of powerlessness in Backlund and this era, and she often felt this way before: "Then, then are you still going?"
"Of course, I have to go." Hobert smiled and said, "We are the last hope of Backlund, how can we not fight for it?
"Let me see, the first meeting starts next Monday. You write to the reporters who interviewed us before and tell them that the issue of labor compensation is about to be legislated. Come with me to the meeting next Monday."
Jessica's eyes lit up: "I understand, I'll go write the letter now."
Hobert smiled slightly and began to deal with his work.
But after a while, Jessica came in again: "Lawyer Hobert, a butler has come to visit. This is the business card of the butler's master."
Jessica handed the business card very solemnly. Hobert took the business card and looked at it. It turned out to be the business card of Tim, the Ambassador of Feynapotter.
"I haven't had any dealings with him before." Hobert's expression was a bit puzzled, but he had already thought of the two groups of stalkers he had driven away before in his heart.
One of the groups was likely sent by Tim. Hobert originally thought that this matter was over, but he didn't expect Tim to send a butler again.
"Please, invite him in." Hobert said, since the other party came to visit openly, he was not afraid that they would assassinate him.
The butler was a man in his fifties, dressed very appropriately and rigorously, with his hair combed meticulously: "Lawyer Hobert, hello, my master hopes to invite you to the Feynapotter Embassy. He wants to consult you on some issues."
Hobert stood opposite the butler: "Are you mistaken? I am not good at "International Law", and I don't know much about the laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Feynapotter. Why would the ambassador think of consulting me?"
"Of course, there is no mistake." The butler said with a somewhat rigid smile: "The ambassador indeed invites you to come."
Hobert joked: "Could it be because your country didn't pay the ambassador's salary, and the ambassador asked me to collect it? I am good at this kind of case."
The butler maintained his smile and said nothing, nor did he react to Hobert's joke.
Hobert smiled awkwardly: "Okay, okay, I'll go with you."
As he spoke, he picked up his cane and told Jessica a few words, then left in the embassy's carriage.
Because the other party came to invite him in a proper manner, Hobert was not worried that the Feynapotter ambassador would assassinate him. Even if the other party wanted to attack him in the embassy, he had enough confidence to escape the siege of the military attachés.
Arriving at the Feynapotter Embassy in the West District by carriage, the butler asked Hobert to wait in the reception room.
While the butler went to inform Ambassador Tim, Hobert admired the decorating style of the Kingdom of Feynapotter.
The decorating style of this kingdom still follows the principle of exaggeration and asymmetry. This is a style that was formed in the Solomon era. The main decorating elements are bats, roses, and crows, which look a bit gloomy, which is significantly different from the Loen decorating style that likes Panlian flowers and azaleas.
At this moment, Ambassador Tim, with his toothbrush mustache, pushed the door in. He had a harmonious smile on his face: "Lawyer Hobert, hello, thank you for accepting my invitation."
Hobert took a step forward, about to shake hands with Tim, but suddenly felt a burning sensation from the "Psychological Spoon."
He thought to himself, this ambassador's invitation was indeed not that simple.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 287: Ambassador Feynapotter's Interrogation (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to truckKunFan for becoming a free member]
The "Psychological Spoon" on Hobert had a passive skill that could block attacks from the mental level. Each time it blocked an attack, the "Psychological Spoon" would heat up.
Hobert had also done some research. Blocking mental attacks around Sequence 7 would only make the "Psychological Spoon" slightly warm. Sequence 6 attacks would make it hot.
Hobert couldn't simulate Sequence 5 mental attacks, so he didn't know the specific reaction. But according to the increasing reaction, the "Psychological Spoon" should become very hot when facing Sequence 5 mental attacks.
As for the mental attacks of a demigod, the "Psychological Spoon" might not be able to block them at all.
After seeing Tim, the "Psychological Spoon" was hot, indicating a Sequence 6 level mental attack.
Hobert couldn't immediately determine whether Tim was a Beyonder of the Spectator pathway, or if he had a magical item of that pathway on him.
At the moment, he pretended to be a little dazed: "G-Good day, Ambassador, I, I, I'm sorry, I suddenly feel a little, a little uncomfortable."
He didn't pretend to be immediately affected by Tim's hypnosis, because Beyonders of the "Lawyer" pathway not only had resistance to mental attacks, but also had some resistance to attacks on the mental level.
Hobert's disguise was perfect. Tim asked with a gentle smile, "Are you a 'Barbarian' or a 'Briber'?"
Hobert's expression was as if he was resisting something, but he still "told the truth": "Briber."
Tim nodded, which was similar to the information he knew.
No one would have thought that Hobert would become a Sequence 6 so quickly.
"No wonder," Tim said, "You will completely forget the discomfort you feel now. Okay, please sit down."
Through the reaction of the "Psychological Spoon," Hobert knew that the other party's mental attack was continuing. He had "resisted" until now, and it was almost time. So he showed a gradually relaxed expression, his eyes became blank, and he sat down according to Tim's instructions.
Tim added: "Drink tea!"
Hobert picked up the teacup and started drinking, finishing all the tea in the cup without putting it down.
Tim nodded with satisfaction: "Put down the teacup."
Hobert put down the teacup with a blank look, and couldn't help but admire his acting skills in his heart.
Seeing that the "hypnosis" had taken effect, Tim began to ask: "What clues did you get from the two 'Spiritual Cultivation Society' executives who were killed by you before?"
The "Spiritual Cultivation Society" was a cult organization established by a vice-leader of the "Judgment Group." Its headquarters had been captured by a mercenary team before, and two executives had escaped to Backlund.
Military Intelligence Section 9 learned of this information, but after sending out informants to search without success, they posted a task for mercenaries.
Hobert turned this task over to Xio. Under Xio's plan, they killed two cultists in the dormitory of a textile factory.
There was also a dead person at the time. Through spirit channeling, Hobert learned that the dead person was actually a spy sent by Ambassador Tim.
It was also through that spirit channeling that Hobert learned that the Feynapotter Kingdom had been supporting the actions of the "Spiritual Cultivation Society."
Later, when Hobert helped Carrie escape the recruitment of the "Judgment Group" and gave the information of the "Judgment Group" to Military Intelligence Section 9, he connected all the clues through some information given by Byron.
Hobert answered: "They must have accomplices in Backlund, otherwise they couldn't have hidden so well."
He felt a little strange in his heart: This ambassador with a mustache is too cautious. They were just two abandoned pawns, did he need to take such a big risk to call me over to ask?
Tim: "Why didn't you follow this clue to investigate further?"
"We were only interested in the bounty for those two cultists, there was no need to investigate further."
"Where did you receive the task from?"
"The Mercenary Club."
Tim nodded, these all matched his guesses and investigations. Then he asked, "Did you kill Bolton?"
Hobert showed genuine doubt: "Who is Bolton?"
Tim took out a pre-prepared portrait, which was exactly the "Dawn Paladin" who called himself "John."
Hobert's mind raced: No wonder he risked calling me over, it turned out he suspected that I killed those four members of the "Judgment Group." Your suspicion is right, but the investigation methods are not very good.
Then he thought: Where did the mistake occur? Or was I followed by Tim's informant at the time, so he suspected me?
Hobert carefully replied, "I've seen him."
Tim followed up and asked, "Where did you see him?"
"In the studio of a wild 'Artisan'."
Tim pondered for a moment, and asked again: "Did you kill Bolton?"
Hobert thought to himself: It seems he's not sure if I killed those people.
So he answered: "No."
"On the evening of Tuesday last week, did you accompany your assistant to negotiate with Bolton and the others?"
"Yes, but when we arrived at the agreed location, we didn't see them, we only found some traces of fighting." Hobert felt a little uneasy. This answer was a bit risky, but it was the best answer he could think of in an instant.
Tim's expression was obviously a little confused: "What else did you find?"
"There seemed to be some water on the ground." Hobert breathed a sigh of relief, it seemed Tim didn't know much.
Tim asked again: "Did you tell anyone else about this negotiation?"
"No." Hobert told the truth.
"Did you prepare to find other helpers to kill Bolton and the others?"
"No." This was still the truth, because Hobert alone was enough.
Tim pondered for a while before saying: "Okay, our conversation is over, you will completely forget our conversation just now. When I count to 3, you will wake up on your own, 1, 2, 3!"
Hobert seemed to suddenly come back to his senses, his eyes regained their brilliance, and then he smiled: "Sorry, Ambassador, I, I seem to have been distracted just now."
"It's okay." Tim smiled: "I called you here today because I wanted to ask for some legal advice..."
More than half an hour later, Tim personally sent Hobert away from the embassy. Watching the carriage leave, the warm smile on Ambassador Tim's face gradually disappeared: "It seems we were looking in the wrong direction. Do you think he is still a suspect?"
The butler following Tim replied: "From my observation, his reaction was normal. I only found traces of Hobert and his assistant outside the scene. And judging from the windows at the scene, at least two people should have escaped successfully, but they were still caught up or surrounded and killed, indicating that the other party had set a trap long ago and had a large number of people. It doesn't seem like an action that Hobert and others could complete.
"There must be an organization behind them. Hobert said no, it may be that the relevant memories have been erased."
He suggested: "We can track Hobert and his assistant for a period of time, and we will definitely find new clues?"
"No." Tim said, "This is Backlund, our tracking is exposed in the sight of Military Intelligence Section 9. It was already very risky to call Hobert to the embassy this time."
He turned around, walking into the house while saying: "And we have bigger plans related to Hobert recently, don't ruin our plan because of four insignificant people."
The butler followed closely: "I understand, I will inform the 'Judgment Group' that we have taken a series of investigations at great risk and can rule out the suspicion of Hobert and others. After all, he is only a Sequence 7, it is impossible to kill Bolton and others silently. Didn't Gale say that he left a trap? Then let them continue to investigate."
Tim nodded almost imperceptibly.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 288: Magic Car and Puppet Show (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
