chapters.title: Chapter 308 - 308 The Magical Uses of “Travel”
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
About five minutes after Rafter left Boston Cemetery, several figures rushed over.
Seeing that there was no one here, their leader ordered, "Search separately."
If the target had left the cemetery, the two people responsible for tracking and monitoring would have left a mark.
However, his subordinates quickly discovered the sword dropped on the ground and the empty coffin with nothing inside.
The leader took out a pendant, which was a sealed artifact with the function of divination.
After the leader's divination, the two subordinates responsible for stalking were already dead, but he could not divine who the murderer was, nor could he divine the target's whereabouts.
He frowned: "Again, I can't divine any clues."
This was exactly the same as the situation when investigating the cause of death of the others.
The leader asked one of his subordinates, "Didn't you say that the target didn't seem to be of a high sequence?"
"Yes, judging from his physical strength when digging the soil, he doesn't seem like a Beyonder of a very high sequence."
The leader almost gnashed his teeth: "Then why can't I divine his whereabouts?"
…
Backlund, Blanca Street.
Hobert carefully examined the mutated Fire Rose Spider in his hand. Something at Sequence 5 is indeed different. It's so lovable just looking at it.
As for why the enemy hadn't taken the mutated Fire Rose Spider from the coffin, Hobert guessed that they probably only knew that there was something crucial to the "Dawn Paladin" in the coffin, but they didn't know exactly what it was.
Moreover, after the "Dawn Paladin" died, rashly digging up the grave might attract the attention of the murderers who killed the "Dawn Paladin" and others, and would also leave traces of digging in the cemetery, making the murderers immediately realize that it was a trap.
The "Judgement Group" still attached considerable importance to this trap, and there was at least one Sequence 7 and two Sequence 8 or Sequence 9 Beyonders responsible for stalking.
For wild Beyonders, using such a lineup for stalking was already a "luxury lineup," after all, Sequence 7 was already a backbone force for them.
Even for official Beyonders, this was using a captain-level Beyonder for stalking.
In general, there was nothing wrong with such an arrangement.
However, when encountering Hobert, encountering the "Creator," "common sense" seemed a bit pale.
Before going to Boston Cemetery, Hobert used "True Sight" to clearly see the positions of the two Beyonders. The key was that he suddenly appeared with Rafter as the coordinate, and also used the "Blink" ability to attack suddenly. The two stalking Beyonders didn't have time to make an effective response at all.
Thinking of this, Hobert sacrificed the mutated Fire Rose Spider and two Beyonder characteristics to the "Nation of Disorder."
At Boston Cemetery, Hobert used the ability of the "Spirit Wine Glass" to manipulate the corpse. Because it was his first time manipulating it, he was still a little unskilled, so the person who ran out of the woods looked like he was hopping and jumping.
Then he tried to manipulate the corpse to accelerate the condensation of the Beyonder characteristics. This ability was better than he imagined. The Beyonder characteristics condensed out in just a few seconds.
Hobert planned to wear a mask in a few days to "visit" Bishop Utravsky, and by the way, kill some people to see if there was a chance to get the Sequence 5 "potion."
He guessed that the person in charge of the Tamara family in Backlund, the fat man who looked a little greasy and liked to smoke cigars, was likely a Sequence 5 "Mentor of Disorder."
While planning, Hobert used "Travel" to return to his home in the Empress Borough, described yesterday's exploration in detail to Christian, and told him that the oil painting had been entrusted to the Nighthawks for sealing.
…
Saturday morning, Backlund West Borough, Feynapotter Kingdom Embassy.
A well-dressed butler reported to Ambassador Tim, who was having breakfast: "Gale has once again requested that we investigate Hobert's whereabouts yesterday."
Tim frowned: "Doesn't he have ears? Or does he not understand our investigation results?"
"It is said that the trap Gale set up yesterday was seen through, and all the people responsible for monitoring were killed, and again, no information about the murderer can be divined."
"Idiot!" Tim rudely cut the fried egg in front of him with a knife: "Such an important matter, and he actually used ordinary people to monitor?"
"No, it was an 'Interrogator' and a 'Warrior'." The butler reported.
Tim stopped the hand holding the fried egg and was stunned for a few seconds before asking: "After Gale got the news, didn't he immediately go to support?"
"It is said that he went immediately." The butler said: "Conant City is an important stronghold of the 'Judgement Group', and there are many people. In order to make the trap play its ideal effect, Gale has even lived in the suburbs of Conant City during this time."
"The person who reported the news took about ten minutes to see Gale. After getting the news, Gale gathered people in just seven or eight minutes, and then arrived at the cemetery in just eight or nine minutes."
"Only half an hour had passed, and the other party dug open the tomb, killed the stalkers, and left calmly."
Tim put the cold fried egg into his mouth: "It seems that the murderer had already seen through Gale's trap and gathered enough helpers, instead giving Gale a blow."
"Or, or the murderer is a Sequence 5, no, a demigod! If it's Sequence 5, it would be difficult to kill them silently."
But if the other party is a demigod, why are they still so secretive?
Tim wiped his mouth with a napkin and threw the napkin on the table: "Find someone to inquire about Hobert's whereabouts yesterday, so that I can have full confidence in the next plan."
"Yes." The butler responded and left the restaurant.
It only took an hour or two for the butler to report to Tim's office: "I've inquired. Yesterday, Hobert worked at the law firm until after five o'clock, then had dinner at a restaurant on Blanca Street, and returned to the rented house at six o'clock."
"When Gale's subordinates were attacked, Hobert's room was lit, and this morning Hobert came out of the rented house on Blanca Street to go to work."
Tim nodded: "Tell Gale the investigation results, it can completely rule out Hobert's suspicion, and let him not affect my plan."
…
At this time, Hobert was meeting Loretta in his office.
Loretta sat opposite Hobert and asked, "What's the matter for asking me here?"
"I've gotten into some trouble. I'm trying not to move around on the streets outside, so I called you over." Then Hobert began to talk about his previous experience of digging up graves.
However, his description was quite different from reality. He only said that he went with a mercenary team to dig up an ancient tomb, but as a result, they encountered a double-cross. Fortunately, the captain was strong enough and eventually killed three enemies and drove the enemies away.
And the captain of the mercenary team knew those enemies, who turned out to be from the "Intersea Mutual Aid Society", so Hobert was "afraid of revenge" and didn't dare to go out on the street recently.
Finally, he asked, "We seized a Beyonder characteristic of a 'Spirit Medium'. I wonder if the Nighthawks are willing to buy it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - 309 Lorotta's Commission
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
That Beyonder characteristic of "Spirit Medium" was of course not from Lena, the mole of the "Intersea Mutual Aid Society", but from when Hobert killed the "Dawn Paladin" before.
Lena's Beyonder characteristic should have been taken away by her teammates in advance.
At that time, the "Dawn Paladin" had a "Spirit Medium" assistant. After Hobert obtained his Beyonder characteristic, he just habitually crushed it into three Beyonder characteristics and never used them.
Hobert had also carefully considered which channel to sell the Beyonder characteristic of "Spirit Medium" through.
So far, the members of the "Justice League" do not have Beyonders of the "Death" pathway, so it is not suitable to sell it there.
Selling it to Byron would be troublesome if the Nighthawks found out in the future.
After thinking for a long time, Hobert decided that selling it to the Nighthawks was the most appropriate.
This is what the Nighthawks need, and with this tomb robbery experience, the source of the Beyonder characteristic can be easily explained. Otherwise, the grass on the "Dawn Paladin's" grave would be a foot high, and Hobert would sell the spoils to the Nighthawks. This is obviously distrusting the Nighthawks and fearing that the Nighthawks would leak the secret.
Hobert certainly knew that once this kind of rift appeared, it would be difficult to repair. Therefore, he did not ask the Nighthawks to sell the Beyonder characteristic when he killed the "Dawn Paladin". He planned to wait for a suitable opportunity to sell it.
Lina's death gave him a suitable opportunity.
After Lorotta heard Hobert's transaction request, she said, "I can't make the decision. I can only ask for you, but I guess the captain should accept it, but the price..."
She smiled and said, "You are now a formal member of the Nighthawks. If you hand it in, you will definitely get a lot of merit."
Hobert sighed and said "embarrassedly", "But I don't have the ownership of this Beyonder characteristic. If I can't sell it for a good price, the other members of the mercenary team will probably find other buyers.
"It is my duty to sell it to the Nighthawks as soon as possible."
If Thomas were here, he would definitely find this sentence very familiar.
Lorotta gave a thumbs up: "This reason is really good, I don't think the captain will say anything, and I will give you an answer by tomorrow morning at the latest."
Hobert nodded: "Thank you."
Lorotta did not leave immediately, but looked at Hobert with a smile: "You seem to have become stronger again."
Hobert smiled: "We are all getting stronger every moment."
"I had a colleague before who was as talented as you." Lorotta said, "Unfortunately, he died in a mission, and we have not been able to avenge him."
Hobert was stunned: "Are you reminding me that my sharpness is too dazzling?"
But the tone didn't sound like it.
"No." Lorotta took out a wanted order: "I just hope that if you have the opportunity in the future, you can avenge that colleague."
Hobert opened the wanted order and finally understood why Lorotta, backed by the Church of the Evernight Goddess, could not take revenge.
This wanted order came from the sea. It was the wanted order for "Admiral Dusk" Bulatov Ioan. The power of the Church of the Evernight Goddess at sea was relatively weak. Even if Archbishop Anthony of Backlund was sent, it would be difficult to find and kill a pirate general in the vast sea.
Hobert looked at the bounty for "Admiral Dusk" again: as high as 36,000 pounds, how many berries would this be converted into? Cough cough, in terms of this bounty, the other party should be very strong.
And Hobert knew from the other party's name that "Admiral Dusk" should be from the Feysac Empire, and was likely to be the spokesperson for this empire's interests at sea.
It's hard to kill.
However, Hobert saw Lorotta's expression and believed that the dead colleague was definitely not just a "colleague" in Lorotta's eyes.
"If there is a chance, I will eliminate this enemy of the church!" Hobert did not refuse, nor did he say too much.
Lorotta nodded: "The Church has issued a notice a long time ago. If someone kills him, we will help collect the bounties from various countries, and will receive some help and rewards from the Church.
"I asked a few days ago, and the content of the announcement is still valid."
After speaking, she got up: "Leave the wanted order with you."
"Okay." Hobert put away the wanted order and sent Lorotta away.
Returning to the office again, Hobert took out the wanted order and glanced at it again. Since the other party was called "Admiral Dusk", then he was likely to be an Beyonder of the "Warrior" pathway.
If it is a "Admiral", then it is at least a Sequence 5.
Recalling the "Guardian" he had just fought, and the difficult to break "Dawn Barrier", Hobert felt a little toothache.
He put away the wanted order. As he said, this entrustment was very difficult, and he would talk about it when he had the opportunity to go to sea.
Although Hobert is not an adventurer at sea, he still prefers to help Lorotta take revenge if he has the opportunity.
This feeling is a bit like a colleague who gets along well asks for something, and there is no reason to refuse it outright, and help out if it is convenient.
Of course, the key is that there is a lot of money to be made. There are currently three countries offering rewards for "Admiral Dusk", namely the Loen Kingdom, the Feysac Empire, and the Intis Republic.
It is estimated that the Feysac Empire's reward is a bit of a suspicion of clearing the relationship: "Admiral Dusk" is indeed an Beyonder of the "Warrior" pathway, we have indeed been helping him sell stolen goods, he has indeed explored a lot of information for us, and even completed some battles that are beneficial to us, but! We have nothing to do with him!
Hobert just laughed at the Feysac Empire's approach.
Except that the Feysac Empire's bounty is difficult to collect, the bounties of the other two countries add up to 70,000 pounds!
Hobert smiled—don't dream about it before Sequence 5.
The official business was quickly dealt with. Hobert wrote four letters, and then called Jessica over: "Keep these four letters for me first."
Jessica took the letter and saw that the envelopes were written with: Jessica, Barton, Xio, Sherlock.
The envelopes of Xio and Sherlock also have addresses written on them.
Hobert instructed: "If one day I suddenly don't come to work, and someone comes to investigate me.
"Then you open the letter with your name on it, and give the letter with 'Barton' to Barton, and send the other two letters to the address for me.
"When sending the letter, go through the firm's route, just like sending a letter to a client."
Jessica nodded: "Okay."
Then she asked: "Are you..."
Hobert waved his hand: "Don't ask, I don't know anything if you ask."
This is the truth.
He took out a wooden box again: "I won't go out recently, help me give this to Carrie. It contains four identical Beyonder materials, enough to make an mystical weapon."
Jessica nodded again: "I will tell you."
She was still a little worried about Hobert, but since Hobert didn't say anything, it meant that he couldn't help with the problems he encountered, so he had to keep his worries in his stomach.
In the afternoon, Lorotta and Thomas came to the office together. Thomas, who knew more extraordinary knowledge, would of course not hesitate to buy the Beyonder characteristic of "Spirit Medium".

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - 310 Advice to Rafter (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Cr0w for becoming a member, +5 bonus! I figured out how to name the tiers now lol, Reader tier, Arrodes tier, and Hermit tier, gets you about 100-150 ch advance across 4 fanfics.]
Thomas offered a generous price, 1400 pounds!
He said to Hobert, "If you obtain any Beyonder characteristics or sealed artifacts during your future adventures, you can come to me to cash them out. Generally, I will give you the base price.
"This money is legal and tax-free, so you don't have to worry about being cheated.
"Especially for the 'Corpse Collector' and 'Warrior' pathways' Beyonder characteristics, I will even help you negotiate a premium."
Hobert asked, "Do you also collect 'Arbiter' pathway's Beyonder characteristics?"
"Yes, we do," Thomas said with a smile. "However, according to some treaties, we will resell them to the royal family. Rest assured, we will hide your information."
This is another good way to "fence stolen goods."
After seeing Thomas and the others off, Hobert returned to his office, feeling that the preparations for leaving Backlund were almost complete.
Now, all that's left is to find time to put on the mask and visit the "Giant Bishop", and then cause a stir in Backlund.
However, now that he has the "Travel" ability, it would be even more exciting to leave Backlund and then come back to cause a stir.
After getting off work, Hobert deliberately took a taxi carriage back to his home in the Queen's district.
For the past two days, he had been returning to 192 Blanca Street after work, then using "Travel" to return to the Empress Borough, and using "Travel" again the next morning to return to Blanca Street and go to work from there.
With one hour less of travel time each way, Hobert felt like he had a lot more time.
However, he couldn't use this method all the time, or the servants in the Empress Borough would find out that young master Hobert seemed to have lost his job, returning to his room after breakfast and only coming out for dinner in the afternoon.
And over time, the neighbors on Blanca Street would also wonder why Hobert the lawyer hadn't been buying groceries or eating out lately.
Hobert had originally planned to sleep in on Sunday, but he was woken up early in the morning by Dophis and, after having breakfast with Christian, they left in the family carriage.
As for where they were going, Christian said they were going to a manor in the suburbs.
After the carriage arrived in the suburbs, the air gradually became fresher, and Hobert began to admire the scenery outside.
Christian, sitting opposite Hobert, suddenly said, "Do you see that mountain with a large pine tree? Be natural, don't stare at it."
Hobert saw a not-so-small pine tree on a hill not far away, and its size could be felt even on the road at the foot of the hill.
After confirming the target, Hobert nodded almost imperceptibly.
Christian added, "If we get separated, we'll meet under the big pine tree."
Hobert nodded lightly again without any change in expression.
"After leaving Backlund, don't trust anyone except me and Dophis!" After Christian finished this sentence, he changed to another topic.
Hobert also pretended not to have heard the previous words and chatted with Christian about other topics.
Going to the manor in the suburbs was just a pretense. The group stayed at the manor until the afternoon, then took a few barrels of vintage wine and some game hunted by the servants in the manor, and returned to Backlund together.
Back in his room, Hobert was still wondering what Christian and Dophis were up to.
He had to admit, they were doing a really good job of keeping it a secret. So far, Hobert didn't have any clue.
The more he couldn't guess, the more excited Hobert became. He felt that Christian must be planning something big!
He completely trusted Christian. Since he was willing to let him stay, then he must have a certain degree of confidence in their actions.
Hobert believed that he only needed to play it by ear and that there shouldn't be too much danger.
That night, Hobert received a prayer from Rafter, who said that he had returned to Backlund. As expected, he had not encountered any enemies blocking him along the way, and he had not aroused the suspicion of the royal family after his return.
So Hobert first used "True Sight" to confirm that Rafter was not being monitored, then he put on his windbreaker, put on the mask again, and used "Travel" to come to Rafter's residence on Sivellaus Street.
Rafter was kneeling on one knee, waiting for the "Creator's" reply, when Hobert twisted the doorknob, opened the door, and came in, as relaxed as if he had returned to his own living room.
Hobert's sudden appearance startled Rafter.
However, Rafter immediately adjusted his emotions. He stood up and bowed slightly, saying, "Thank you for your help. This is your mystical item. It really helped me get rid of all the pursuers."
On the way back, Rafter had fully used his imagination to imagine the battle initiated by the cemetery. He believed that it was only the beginning, and if he didn't have the black crystal in his hand, he would have been chased by enemies all the way.
Hobert took the "Order Crystal" and was about to use "Blink" to leave the room first when Rafter quickly asked, "God, Mr. Blessed…"
He believed that the masked man in front of him was handling some mundane affairs for the "Creator" and should be the legendary "Blessed".
Rafter smiled ingratiatingly, "I want to become stronger. Do you have any suggestions?"
Hobert coldly scrutinized Rafter, and after two or three seconds, he said, "Leave Backlund, leave the Loen Kingdom."
After saying that, he left using "Travel". He had been here for a minute and could use "Travel" again.
Rafter was slightly stunned. This was indeed a good way. As long as he was in Backlund, as long as he was in Loen, he had to be careful, and he didn't even dare to advance to Sequence 7, because doing so might arouse the suspicion of the royal family.
But, but…
If he left Backlund, it would be difficult to fulfill the instructions of his grandfather, the patriarch. In that secret ruin, there was a huge extraordinary fortune waiting for him to discover.
Then he hesitated, should he ask the "Creator" for help?
If he asked the "Creator" for help, he would only be able to get a very small part of that fortune, but if he didn't ask the "Creator" for help, that fortune might be buried forever in the underground of Backlund.
…
Back in his bedroom, Hobert seriously thought about the whole thing and found that he had not left any traces in his contact with Rafter.
In the future, he could consider helping Rafter a little, such as if he wanted to develop in the Southern Continent, he could use "Travel" to help him get rid of the royal family's surveillance.
But that was all. Hobert felt an ambition in him that was not commensurate with his abilities. Such people easily mess things up.
On Monday morning, Hobert did not go to the law firm to work, but took a taxi carriage to the Parliament Building. Today, he was going to attend the meeting to formulate the "Labor Law".
As soon as he got out of the carriage, Hobert found that Jessica and several reporters who had made an appointment earlier had already arrived.
Hobert shook hands with them and exchanged a few pleasantries before leading them in together and, under the guidance of the waiter, came to the designated meeting room.
At the entrance of the meeting room, the waiter stopped the reporters: "I'm sorry, gentlemen, only Lawyer Hobert can attend this meeting."
Hobert smiled and said, "What's your name?"
"Quincy, sir."
Hobert said: "Today's 'Backlund Evening News', tomorrow's 'Observer', 'The Kingdom under the Rule of Law' and other newspapers and magazines will publish such news:
"Mr. Quincy of the Parliament Hall, under orders, blocked the reporters who were concerned about the 'Labor Law'. Is there any inside story in this meeting that cannot be known to the citizens of Loen? Is there any transaction that cannot be made public?"

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - 311: Battle of Wisdom and Courage in Parliament (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The attendant Quincy was sweating on his forehead. Of course, he knew that Hobert was not threatening him, but the councilors and representatives from all walks of life in the conference room.
"Please wait a moment." Quincy entered the conference room and reported to the councilors inside.
The chief person in charge of formulating the relevant legal clauses was Count Wolfe, a member of the Upper House, along with two members of the Lower House, five law professors, and eight representatives from all walks of life.
According to the constitution, the person in charge, Count Wolfe, was only responsible for coordinating relevant resources, urging the legislative process, and supervising the legislative process, and had no power to participate in the formulation of specific legal clauses.
After a law is formulated, the House of Representatives and the Upper House jointly vote to decide whether the bill is passed and takes effect.
Throughout the entire process, the royal family, the government, and the military have no right to interfere.
Count Wolfe had just sat down when he heard the attendant's report and still smiled gently: "Lawyer Hobert is quite different."
"Your Excellency, this is not in accordance with the rules!" said Gusta, the president of the Backlund Chamber of Commerce.
He was one of the eight "representatives from all walks of life."
Other representatives also stated that specific regulations should not be made public during the formulation of laws and regulations.
Wolfe waited for everyone to finish speaking before saying: "Have you not noticed? Hobert is very good at using the power of public opinion."
Barth, a member of the Lower House and a major banker, said: "It's just a few reporters. I'll meet with the presidents of the 'Backlund Daily' and the 'Loen Citizen's Newspaper' later. They won't dare to write nonsense."
Barth also invested in two newspapers at the same time, and had a great influence in the press.
"You don't understand Hobert's intention at all," Count Wolfe said: "Hobert is protesting the way we are formulating the 'Labor Law'."
In fact, a rough draft of the bill had already been formed before this, and inviting Hobert at this time was indeed just to go through the motions.
What Hobert was protesting was precisely this way of asking him to go through the motions.
Gusta said: "Your Excellency, I think this is the parliament, not the court. We can no longer indulge such pests to harm the order of Backlund!"
The social representatives echoed one after another.
Wolf still smiled and said to Quincy: "Okay, then insist on only letting Hobert in."
However, there was already a hint of playfulness in his smile. As a good friend of Earl Hall, he had occasionally heard Hall mention Hobert. Count Wolfe knew Hobert better than anyone else.
Even if he had not confronted Hobert head-on like Gusta, Count Wolfe's experience allowed him to have a deeper understanding of Hobert than Gusta.
Sure enough, two minutes later, Quincy came in again, wiping sweat: "Dear councilors, gentlemen, Lawyer Hobert said that he has met Archbishop Anthony and Archbishop Horamick.
"If reporters are not allowed in, he is prepared to invite the two archbishops to participate in the meeting to ensure the rights and interests of the believers of the Church of the Evernight Goddess and the Church of Steam and Machinery!"
Gusta said again: "This is not in accordance with the rules!"
But compared to the previous "This is not in accordance with the rules," it was obviously less imposing.
In this world where divine power and political power coexist, the influence of religious figures is very great. At least Archbishop Anthony's influence is greater than that of a councilor.
Although they have no right to interfere in the formulation of laws, they can organize believers to protest against new bills. In that case, the status and influence of all of you present who participated in the formulation of laws will be greatly affected, and even someone may be pushed to the forefront as a scapegoat to quell public anger.
Of course, more importantly, everyone present more or less needs the protection of one of the three churches of the Loen Kingdom, or to provide them with honorary guarantees, expand their network, etc., so everyone is unwilling to be in opposition to the archbishops.
The room was silent for two or three seconds, and everyone looked at the three councilors.
"Let them all in," Barth sneered: "Then show Hobert the bill we have discussed. If he glances at it, even if he just opens the cover, we will accuse him and those reporters of leaking unpublished legal documents. I remember this is a confidential document, enough to keep them in prison for a few years."
Count Wolfe did not expect that the seemingly boring work of formulating the "Labor Law" would be so interesting.
He had this mentality of watching the show because his interests were not directly in conflict with the content of the bill.
As a visionary aristocrat, he also made investments, but only in stocks, and did not participate in specific management.
Also, because he was born into an aristocratic family, the rich and the workers were almost the same in his eyes, so he was not very concerned about the interests of the rich like Gusta, nor was he very concerned about the interests of the workers.
For him, his only purpose was to expand his influence and improve his position in the political arena.
After Quincy received clear orders, he went out again and invited Hobert and others in.
Jessica, who followed in, felt that she had learned a trick. She also knew that Lawyer Hobert had asked her to come today to broaden her horizons, so after entering the door, she honestly found a corner to sit down and prepared to continue learning how Hobert dealt with these so-called upper-class figures.
Several reporters were a little flattered. They had only come today with a try-it-and-see attitude, but they did not expect that they could actually enter the parliament building and enter the conference room where laws were made.
Even if they could only listen in the corner, it would be enough for them to brag about for half their lives when they went back.
After Hobert entered the door, he greeted everyone politely, as if he was not the one who had been blocking the door just now.
In particular, one of the law professors was Hobert's former university teacher. The two exchanged compliments, which eased the atmosphere for a while.
After Hobert sat down, Count Wolfe even asked him: "Coffee or black tea?"
Everyone was stunned. This seemed to be Wolfe's subtle way of expressing his appreciation for Hobert, and also warning everyone not to go too far.
Quincy, who had no political savvy, thought that this was his dereliction of duty, and that he had actually troubled the Count to ask Hobert what he wanted to drink, so he was a little apprehensive when he served the tea.
After the meeting officially started, Barth winked at Gusta. Since Wolf had expressed his opinion, they couldn't go too far, but they still had to put Hobert in his place.
Gusta nodded slightly and threw a document to Hobert: "This is the outline of the bill we drafted. You can take a look at it first, or you can show it to your reporter friends."
Hobert didn't even touch it: "Sorry, I don't think this outline is appropriate."
Gusta said: "How do you know it's not appropriate if you don't look at it?"
"According to normal procedures, the 'social representatives' participating in the formulation of laws and regulations should include people from all levels that the law may involve," Hobert said: "However, it seems that there are only businessmen among the eight people present, but no other subject: workers.
"So I think this legal outline is not appropriate and does not comply with relevant regulations.
"That's why I invited reporter friends to supervise. This is a question of the legal formulation process, not a question of specific clauses, so it doesn't count as leaking secrets."
Count Wolfe changed his sitting position to hide his smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 312 It’s Tarot Time Again (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Gusta felt that sense of frustration again. He simply stopped talking, feeling that his eloquence was far inferior to Hobert's. Speaking more would only lead to more mistakes and self-humiliation.
Mainly, Lower House Member Basil argued with Hobert for a while, but he was quickly defeated.
As the law professors present successively acknowledged that this was Hobert's legal right, the previously drafted bill was completely overturned.
With everyone's votes, whether supportive or unwilling, the meeting decided that four of the current eight "representatives from all walks of life" would lose their qualifications to participate, and four workers would replace them.
After the meeting, Count Wolfe specifically came over and patted Hobert on the shoulder: "Young man, very good!"
Hobert smiled and said, "Thank you for your support and affirmation."
Wolf was very satisfied with this answer, which showed that Hobert understood his support in the dark.
After the Count left, Hobert's teacher came over and said with emotion: "I didn't expect that in just a few months, you have become so brave, even braver than we old guys were back then and are now."
Another professor also praised: "You are a ray of light shining into this foggy city. I hope you can dispel more of the mist."
Hobert thanked them for their praise and left with the reporters at the end.
When parting, Hobert instructed the reporters: "Please only write the results, not the process, and don't highlight my role too much."
Most of the reporters also planned to do so, as they were unwilling to offend those congressmen and wealthy individuals.
Only the reporter from the magazine "Kingdom Under the Rule of Law" asked: "Why?"
Hobert casually found a reason: "Because that would be suspected of leaking secrets, which may affect the publication of your manuscripts. If you want to write about today's experience, you can write a series of reports or behind-the-scenes reports after the 'Labor Law' is promulgated."
In fact, he was afraid that he might accidentally do something big with Christian recently, which would affect the impression of the "Labor Law" in people's minds.
Back at the firm, Hobert wrote two letters, one to Captain Ikanser of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery, and one to Captain Thomas.
The content was similar, describing the legislative process of the "Labor Law" and the difficulties it now faced, and asking them each to recommend two workers to the parliament to participate in the formulation of the bill.
Hobert was about to ask Jessica to help send the letters when he received an unexpected guest: Leonard Mitchell.
This Nighthawk with black hair and green eyes, who, like Hobert, liked to wear trench coats, was still a bit unkempt and still looked so poetic, but of course, he still hadn't created a single poem.
Hobert warmly invited him in: "You've come to Backlund? Jessica, pour the guest a cup of black tea. Try my black tea; it's from home, very good."
Leonard took a light sip: "The taste is indeed quite good."
He could certainly feel Hobert's enthusiasm, which made him smile involuntarily: "Yes, I've been transferred to Backlund. I just arrived the day before yesterday. I heard from Ms. Daly that you work here, so I came to see you."
As they chatted, the two of them talked about the battle that had happened in Tingen City before, which inevitably brought another wave of sighs.
Leonard sighed: "Before I came to Backlund, I also attended the funeral of another colleague, Old Neil."
Hobert was stunned: "Old Neil, he, he... I remember him. What did he die of?"
"A disease," Leonard said. "He almost lost control once before, but it was discovered in time and he was saved, but it caused great damage to his body. After the winter, his body deteriorated day by day.
"Finally, during a cold, his internal organ functions rapidly failed, making his body extremely weak, and even the treatment ceremony couldn't play a big role."
Hobert sighed: "I didn't expect..."
In fact, it was twice that he almost lost control. Hobert didn't expect that he still couldn't save Old Neil, and then a strong sense of fate filled his heart.
Leonard smiled wryly: "This reminds me of a sentence from Captain Dunn: We are guardians, but also a bunch of miserable wretches who are constantly fighting against threats and madness."
Hobert said: "That's a very apt summary."
He raised his teacup: "To Captain Dunn."
Even though it had been a long time, Leonard was still a little choked up: "To the Captain."
After chatting for more than half an hour and drinking two cups of tea, Leonard got up to leave.
Hobert simply asked Leonard to hand over the letter to Thomas.
Leonard smiled as he put on his hat: "By the way, I haven't congratulated you yet on becoming a full member of the Nighthawks."
"Thank you." Hobert watched Leonard leave and sat back in his chair for a long time.
He didn't react until it was almost lunchtime. He went to Jessica to get back the letter to "Sherlock", opened it, and added the news that he had seen Leonard and that Old Neil had passed away.
Then Hobert re-sealed it in an envelope and gave it back to Jessica.
In the afternoon, Hobert returned to Blanca Street as usual. He drew the curtains early, pretending to be taking a nap.
At three o'clock, his eyes were covered by gray fog, and he reappeared in the giant hall that seemed to have remained unchanged forever.
"Justice" Audrey greeted everyone one by one as usual, and then she submitted a few pages of Russell's diary. Just last week, she visited the Roselle Memorial Exhibition, but "The Fool" Klein had also read these pages of the diary, but he still pretended to read them carefully to avoid being suspected.
A few minutes later, Klein said, "You can begin."
Audrey asked Hobert: "Mr. Emperor, your mood seems a little low."
"I just heard some bad news before attending the gathering," Hobert smiled. "News that made me completely abandon some illusions."
Old Neil's death also had a huge impact on Hobert. He had always thought that he was also the "chosen one" of this era, and that everything was possible if he operated properly.
But today, Hobert realized how ridiculous these ideas were.
In this world where gods exist, everything seems so small and fragile. Only by becoming a god, only after becoming a god, can one avoid being reduced to the "straw dog" of this world!
Audrey said: "I hope you can properly solve the problems you encounter. If you have any difficulties, you can ask friends for help."
Whether through the Tarot Club or the Justice League, as long as Hobert made a request, as long as it was within her ability, she would be happy to help.
"Thank you for your suggestion," Hobert smiled. "I will handle this problem well."
The trading session officially began. "Hanged Man" Alger first said: "Mr. Emperor, I hope to invite you to explore the second Elven ruins I discovered with me."
Hobert said: "I am also very interested in this, but I may not have time in the next week or two."
"Magician" Fors put her hand on her forehead: They are discussing exploring the ruins of the elves! Oh my god, I always thought the elves were a race in mythology.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 313 The Deceitful Little Sun (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Alger was slightly stunned by Hobert's answer before saying, "No problem. Are we going to discuss how to divide the spoils later? Or should we determine this issue now under Mr. Fool's witness?"
He had searched for another week and still couldn't find a safe sea route, so he had to ask Hobert for help.
"Of course, the spoils are divided equally, and I have the right of first refusal," Hobert said. "However, I can promise that if I obtain something you need, I can give it to you and give me other compensation as appropriate."
Alger breathed a sigh of relief. This way of dividing the spoils, especially with the "Emperor's" promise, was fair to him.
The reason why Alger wanted to discuss how to divide the spoils at the Tarot Gathering was mainly because this exploration would definitely be led by the "Emperor". If they didn't discuss it in advance, it would easily lead to conflicts when dividing the spoils.
For example, if the "Emperor" was not satisfied with the spoils he received and left with "Travel", leaving him in the ruins, he would have no place to cry.
And at the Tarot Gathering, with Mr. Fool's witness, it was equivalent to providing notarization for this transaction, which could give the "Emperor" some constraints.
Alger smiled and said, "Thank you for your generosity. I will go and take care of other things first, and we will go explore when you have time."
"Okay." Hobert then asked, "Regarding the island I mentioned at the last gathering, is there any new news?"
Alger replied, "I haven't landed yet, but I heard during the resupply that 'Vice Admiral Iceberg's' second mate, Orpheus, appeared on the island. It is said that 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' is very interested in the buildings on that island."
Hobert pinched his chin and nodded slowly.
At this time, Fors mustered up her courage and asked, "Mr. Emperor, Mr. Hanged Man, did the Elves and Giants really live on the North and South Continents?"
Hobert replied, "That's right. We discussed this matter before. According to 'The Sun's' description, the territory of the Elves may be in the sea and islands between the current North and South Continents."
This can only be regarded as some anecdotes, not mystical knowledge, so Hobert chatted a few more words: "As far as I know, there were still some Giants and Elves on the North and South Continents during the Fourth Epoch.
"According to legend, some of the Giants once took a large ship to sea to find their homeland, the 'Giant King's Court'. And some of the Elves went to sea to find their homeland."
"The Sun" Derrick quickly asked, "Did they succeed? I mean the Giants who went to sea."
Hobert said, "If they had succeeded, you would have found a sea route to leave the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' long ago."
"Forsaken Land of the Gods..." Fors thought she had misheard: "Does that also exist?"
Hobert said with a smile, "This world is much more exciting than you think."
Fors nodded blankly, then suddenly looked at Mr. Fool at the head of the table. Mr. Fool was more powerful than she had imagined, and could even pull "The Sun" from the "Forsaken Land of the Gods".
But then she felt that staring at Mr. Fool like this was very impolite, so she quickly withdrew her gaze.
Audrey watched all this with a smile, and suddenly sighed at the changes the Tarot Gathering had brought her. If she hadn't participated in the Tarot Gathering, she felt that she would be as "ignorant" as Fors.
Then Fors asked, "Where is the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'? Why haven't we discovered it all this time?"
"We also discussed this before," Hobert said. "It's probably in the east of the Sonia Sea, but don't think that you can find it just because you have a direction. As far as I know, it is full of twisted and crazy power, which is very dangerous.
"As for why we haven't discovered it? This information is worth 20,000 pounds, yes, a friendship price of 20,000 pounds!"
"Twenty..." Fors thought of her meager savings again: "Is this still a friendship price?"
Audrey recalled the information they had obtained last week that was worth 2,000 pounds: "I can testify to this. Mr. Emperor's information is definitely worth more than its price!"
"Oh, thank you." Fors felt a little unreal. What kind of information is worth 20,000 pounds? And it's still a friendship price? And it's worth more than its price?
At this time, Derrick said, "Mr. Emperor, I want to know what happened to those Giants who sailed from your world later? What reward do I need to pay?"
"No reward is needed," Hobert said. "Because the answer is already very clear, they are obviously not proficient in sailing, so they failed. It is said that they also carried the key to open the 'Giant King's Court', which also sank into the sea."
Derrick leaned back in his chair, a little lonely: "Thank you, Mr. Emperor, I understand."
Hobert comforted him: "I also have a prophecy about that key here, which I can also give to you: Under the arrangement of fate, the key to the 'Giant King's Court' will eventually reappear in the world, and the door to the 'Giant King's Court' will be reopened."
Derrick immediately sat up straight: "Really?"
Hobert spread his hands: "That's what I heard in the prophecy, but I don't know the specific time when it will reappear in the world and when the door will be reopened."
Derrick nodded heavily. Even if there is no specific time, as long as there is such a prophecy, there is hope.
He recalled the location of the Giant King's Court: "Could it be that the 'Giant King's Court' can lead to the outside world? Mr. Emperor, how should I report this guess to the Chief?"
"Don't report it!"
"Ah?"
"If you suddenly know so much information, you will definitely be suspected by your Chief," Hobert said. "The most important thing is that he won't believe you anyway.
"It's better to just wait until you become stronger, deliberately explore in the direction of the 'Giant King's Court', and lie that you found clues there. At that time, your Chief will definitely value this matter very much.
"You seem to be a 'Light Supplicant' now, right? You have taken a solid step closer to finding out the truth."
"Yes, I am already a Light Supplicant and can participate in more distant patrol missions." Derrick felt that Mr. Emperor's words seemed to make sense, but something seemed wrong.
Fors could be sure that "The Sun" was not very old, which could be seen from the fact that his emotional changes were undisguisedly displayed in front of everyone. Relatively speaking, Mr. Emperor seemed very mature and scheming, and "The Sun's" emotions were completely under his control.
Audrey smiled and watched everything in front of her. Of course, she could feel that although Hobert had a suspicion of deceiving, it was to protect "Little Sun".
Klein behind the gray mist had a sense of seeing the "Emperor" drawing a big cake. He remembered that he seemed to be so easy to deceive when he was young.
Derrick paused and said, "Everyone still remembers that I mentioned before that we discovered the ruins of a 'Fallen Creator' temple?
"We are preparing to explore there for the second time. It is expected that my ability will play a significant role, so I just passed the second round of assessment and was arranged into this mission.
"Does anyone have any suggestions for this?"
Alger said, "My suggestion is, absolutely don't go."

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 314: Overthrow of the Political Commissar is now officially open (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Derrick was somewhat surprised by "The Hanged Man's" suggestion: "No, don't go?"
Alger nodded: "I remember the last time the 'Fallen Creator' failed to descend in Backlund. You mentioned the ruins, didn't you? There was a statue of the 'Fallen Creator' there?"
Derrick nodded: "Yes!"
Fors weakly raised her hand and asked: "Um, are the 'Fallen Creator' you're all talking about the same as the 'True Creator'?"
This was her second time attending the gathering, and she found that the other members were quite friendly, but the topics they discussed were too advanced, and she felt a little overwhelmed.
However, through her experience just now, she also discovered that as long as she dared to ask, and as long as it didn't involve too confidential information, the other members were willing to answer her questions.
Audrey replied: "Yes. In addition, I've learned from my subordinates recently that some people are worshipping the 'True Creator' in the docks and the East Borough."
She had just visited the East Borough and the ports with Xio a few days ago, and it was shocking to her. At the same time, she learned from Xio's informants that some people were worshipping for the "True Creator."
But in order to prevent Fors from realizing how she obtained this information, Audrey used "I learned from my subordinates" to confuse Fors.
Fors had also heard Xio mention this: "The 'True Creator' once tried to descend in Backlund?"
"Yes," Audrey said. "But it was stopped by the Fool's Blessed."
Fors gasped: I didn't even know these things!
Hobert smiled and said: "This reminds me of something the Fool once said: This era, this Backlund, this East Borough, ports, and factory district, is truly a hotbed for evil god descents."
Fors felt the urge to cover her face: I'm just a Sequence 8, yet I'm discussing the issue of 'evil god descents' with everyone. It's like a dream!
Fors asked again: "Why is the 'True Creator', no, the 'Fallen Creator' also proselytizing in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
Hobert glanced at Derrick: "Perhaps the people there are more desperate. As long as a god responds to them, they will believe in it.
"But this also highlights the preciousness of City of Silver. For thousands of years, they have still adhered to their beliefs and are still searching for hope.
"But the problem is with the god, what does it have to do with them? It's not like they made a mistake, why should they endure such suffering?"
Derrick's emotions were like a roller coaster. When he heard the "Emperor's" first sentence, he was in despair.
But when he heard the second sentence, he felt proud again.
But when he heard the third sentence, he was first angry and wanted to refute the "Emperor," but he didn't know how to argue, and in the end, he could only hang his head and sit there quietly.
Klein thought to himself: If I had abilities like "Lightning Strike," I would definitely strike the "Emperor." It's not the first or second time he's blasphemed the gods. Has he considered the "Fool's" feelings?
Alger simply pretended he didn't hear anything.
Audrey thought to herself: It's time for the "blasphemy" segment of each gathering again.
But she still reminded: "Mr. Emperor, some topics are not for us to discuss."
Hobert just smiled: "I have always been very respectful of the Fool, after all, He is helping the people of the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' regain their light and giving them hope.
"Such a benevolent god is worthy of our faith and worthy of our trust!"
Derrick stared blankly at Mr. Emperor. He suddenly realized that after attending so many Tarot Gatherings, he seemed to no longer trust the "Omniscient and Omnipotent God" so much.
Klein nodded slightly: This flattery is not bad. Okay, the magnanimous Fool forgives you.
The giant hall was quiet for two or three seconds before Alger said: "Returning to the previous topic, since there is a statue of the 'Fallen Creator' in the ruins, it means that the people of that city-state once trusted this evil god.
"Even if the city-state has been destroyed, the evil god may still have some power left. For you, that is still fatal. The most important thing is that it is easy to bring some corruption back to City of Silver."
Derrick opened his mouth: "It's so dangerous!"
Alger said: "You can describe the city-state in more detail so we can jointly assess the degree of danger."
Derrick recalled for a moment before saying: "Besides the statue, there are also many incomplete murals and terrifying wraiths wandering around, but these have been cleared by the previous exploration team.
"I didn't see those murals with my own eyes. It is said that they record prophecies of the coming of the end and the 'Fallen Creator' saving believers, as well as corresponding bloody sacrificial rituals.
"In a certain mural, there are strange characters derived from Jotun. After roughly deciphering them, they mean: Rose Redemption."
Alger said: "With a statue, murals, and writing, I think the level of danger is very high. You shouldn't take the risk."
Derrick looked at the "Emperor" and saw that Mr. Emperor didn't speak, obviously agreeing with Mr. Hanged Man's opinion.
"Then what should I do?" Derrick was a little embarrassed: "The task must be accepted."
Alger smiled: "Nothing is mandatory.
"Before this task, will you participate in patrols? Find an opportunity to deliberately get injured by a monster. You can refer to past examples in City of Silver for the specific extent."
Audrey, Derrick, and Fors almost simultaneously thought in their hearts: This is also possible?
After a brief surprise and confusion, Derrick said: "But, but I don't have any patrol tasks recently."
Alger "Heh"ed: "Aren't you just becoming a 'Light Suppicant'? You can pretend that you haven't controlled the potion's power yet and are in danger of losing control.
"In this case, I think the higher-ups in City of Silver will definitely not take a 'dangerous item' that could explode at any time to explore, right?"
He carefully said: "There is a trick to this. As long as you keep your spirituality in a relatively dry state for two consecutive days, you can experience auditory hallucinations and symptoms of losing control. If you don't continue to squeeze your spirituality afterwards, the situation will improve within a week and you won't actually lose control.
"Of course, considering that City of Silver definitely has ways and measures to treat those with loss-of-control precursory symptoms, recovery should be faster, so you have to estimate the time well, preferably starting two or three days before departure."
Derrick listened dumbfounded, and after a long time, he seemed to mutter to himself: "Yes, yes, people with signs of losing control will be controlled and isolated at the bottom of the Round Tower to receive treatment."
Klein at the head of the bronze table sighed in his heart: Alas, a good, honest, and sincere child has been poisoned by an old fox.
Audrey was also stunned and felt that she had learned a good lesson.
Hobert thought to himself: "Commissar Dao's" level is really not to be underestimated.

Bruno's eyes darted around, and finally he simply turned his head away, not looking at Christian and Hobert.
Camilla suddenly showed a faint smile: "This is your eldest son, right? Has no one told you that he doesn't look like you, but like Commander Rex?"

"It is because of your strong opposition that the Church of the Earth Mother had to send a non-'Planter' pathway bishop to Backlund. However, you have the wrong target. The person who defeated you is not a Beyonder from the Church of the Earth Mother."
Camilla's face suddenly turned cold again.
Hobert reacted. Could this princess be the original owner's father's pursuer! Christian's means of rubbing salt in other people's wounds are really cruel!
Bruno and the other four brigadier generals probably knew about this before, and they all pretended not to have heard anything at this time.
Camilla said coldly: "I know that you have always had grievances about Commander Rex being convicted, but I gave him a chance..."
"What chance? Marrying you and becoming a royal plaything?" Christian sneered: "He is a fierce tiger, but you treat him as a hound."
"So, you have come to this point. Are you going to betray your kingdom and betray your oath?" Camilla was also angry: "Don't you know the face of this world? How have you become like a complaining woman now? All you know is to complain!"
Christian smiled: "I know that this world has never been fair, and I have never complained, but the things that the Loen royal family owes me, I will always take them back. In a way that you would never expect."

But the current situation completely exceeded control, Christian was also a demigod!
"It's too late!" Christian said: "What were those fools in the royal family doing long ago?"
Hobert smiled, if the royal family couldn't immediately dispatch angels, then there would be no problem escaping from Backlund.
Christian should also be aware of this problem, he stood up and said: "If we can part peacefully, we are still good comrades, if you insist on fighting, then I'm sorry."
After speaking, Christian turned around and walked out.
Hobert took the first step, and he felt relieved only after he held the cane in his hand.
"Wait!" Camilla said: "You can state your conditions."
Now the nature of the matter has changed, any force will try its best to win over a demigod-level figure.
But Christian continued to walk out as if he hadn't heard.
Camilla had no choice but to say: "Do it!"
Christian was prepared, and turned around and said to the Brigadier General named Abel: "Exile!"
Abel's body quickly faded. "Exile" is an enhanced version of "Banishment", which can throw the target into the void and exile them outside the real world.
Whether he can come back and when he will come back all depends on luck.
Camilla stretched out her hand: "Exile is forbidden here!"
Abel's figure became solid again.
This is how the battle between the "Judges" pathways is, always a lose-lose situation, so Camilla can't use "Exile" and "Banishment" either.
As soon as the battle started, Hobert immediately grabbed in the direction of Bruno, and this time he was lucky enough to steal the opponent's "Prohibition" ability.
Hobert immediately said: "Breathing is prohibited here!"
Everyone was stunned. Of the seven people in the room, four of them often used the "Prohibition" ability, and it was the first time they had heard of "Prohibiting Breathing"!
While speaking, several Sequence 5s on the other side chased over, and their skills such as "Whipping" and "Imprisonment" all smashed towards Hobert.
The reason is very simple, these abilities of theirs have little effect on Christian, but they must be very effective on Hobert!
At the same time, the Brigadier General named Chipman threw a vase towards Hobert to complete the bribery process.
Who knew that Hobert didn't dodge or avoid at all, "Imprisonment" did imprison Hobert, and there seemed to be a layer of transparent shield around him, making him only able to stand in place and unable to move freely.
But "Whipping" seemed to have no effect, the illusory whip opened Hobert's clothes, but failed to hurt his skin at all.
"Weaken!" Chipman's "Bribery" was completed, and he immediately used the signature skill of the "Black Emperor" pathway.
On the other side, Christian and Camilla were already fighting together. The Beyonders of the "Judge" pathway are known for their strong physique and skill in fighting.
When Beyonder abilities can't help the opponent, they usually choose close combat.
However, Christian quickly gained the upper hand. In addition to fighting Camilla, he could also attack Chipman: "Deprive!"
Just as Chipman's "Weaken" was about to take effect, a layer of illusory black barrier suddenly appeared around Hobert, which actually blocked Chipman's "Weaken" effect! At the same time, the previous "Imprisonment" effect also disappeared!
And Christian's "Deprive" really deprived Chipman of his ability to "Distort", at least three minutes later he could use this ability again.
After a round of intensive confrontation, except for Benedict who was always ready to support Camilla, the other three Sequence 5s had rushed to Hobert's front.
At this time, they found that their attacks had not had any negative effects on Hobert!
On their way here, Hobert was completely not within their plan, they even thought that the guards outside the villa could deal with Hobert.
As "Disciplinary Paladins", as "Imperative Mages", their Beyonder abilities include distinguishing whether the person being judged is lying, and distinguishing whether the enemy is strong or weak.
Hobert obviously looks so weak, but why isn't he being completely played by them as they imagined?
Since they can't tell the difference in Beyonder abilities, they have to carry out "physical attacks".
Hobert had already pulled out his knife in advance, and kicked a pot of flowers towards the three enemies: "Weaken!"
The three Sequence 5s felt different degrees of weakening: Are you still reasonable? Why don't our abilities work? His abilities work so well?
Although they were "weakened", the strength of Sequence 5 is here, Abel, who was rushing in the front, dodged the blade that Hobert slashed out, and kicked him away.
Abel was stunned for a moment, he seemed to have kicked a piece of steel.
Looking at Hobert again, he hit the wall hard, making a muffled sound, and spider-web-like cracks appeared on the wall.
But Hobert got up and patted the dust off his body as if nothing had happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 320: Defection from Backlund
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Under the siege of three Sequence 5s, Hobert could only take a beating, kicked back and forth like a leather ball.
However, he quickly realized that none of the three were trying to kill him; it seemed they only intended to capture him.
At first, Hobert thought they wanted to use him to threaten Christian, but then he thought again that he might still be receiving "favors" from Rex. They used to be Rex's subordinates and weren't planning to kill him for the sake of their old superior.
Chipman landed a punch, and with the blessing of the "Zombie Spoon" almost knocked Hobert's saliva out: "Okay, they may not really want to kill me, but they're planning to cripple me!"
This passive beating continued for more than a minute, and Bruno, Chipman, and Abel's attacks began to slow down.
They gasped for breath, but still couldn't inhale any air. Even for Beyonders at the Sequence 5 level, a minute of continuous strenuous exercise and holding their breath left their faces flushed.
Hobert's previous "rule" of "prohibiting breathing" finally took effect, but his "prohibition" was only at the Sequence 5 level. Christian and Camilla were still lively and barely affected.
Hobert finally had a chance to catch his breath and cast a "healing spell" on himself to cure the discomfort caused by oxygen deprivation.
With the blessing of the "healing spell," he felt he could last another two minutes.
At that moment, in the middle of the living room, two bronze doors engraved with mystical patterns appeared.
The doors opened, and Dophis appeared in the illusory space within the door: "Go!"
Hobert knew that Christian hadn't been in a hurry to break out of the door, and he must have had his reasons.
Moreover, Dophis had "disappeared" after calling him down. They must have planned their escape route long ago, so even if Hobert was kicked into the kitchen or punched into the dining room, he would return to the living room and Christian's side as soon as possible.
Christian forced Camilla back and reached out to Bruno and the others: "Confinement!"
Under the cover of "Confinement," Hobert managed to escape into the bronze door.
Camilla immediately said, "Teleportation is prohibited here!"
Christian also entered the bronze door.
Only then did Camilla realize that her "prohibition" was flawed. This was not "teleportation" at all, but rather walking in the "Spirit World."
"Prohibition here..." Before she could say the new "prohibition," the bronze door had closed.
Bruno and the others quickly went out through the windows and doors, gasping for breath in the yard.
The guards in the yard were wondering: Who farted in the house? Or who took off their shoes?
Then Camilla came to the door with a dark face: "Lock down the entire city!"
She jumped up from the ground, her legs like super springs, jumping to the street in one leap, and then to dozens of meters away in another leap.
She had to hurry to the Soderak Palace to report that the situation had changed. They had actually forced an "Imperative Mage" to flee!
...
Hobert and the other two quickly emerged from the Spirit World. Dophis was using a sealed artifact to walk briefly in the Spirit World. With two people, their time in the Spirit World would be even shorter.
Although they only "walked" in the Spirit World for a few seconds, they had already left Empress Borough.
Christian said, "Split up and meet at the agreed place!"
The three quickly separated. Hobert used "Blink" to enter a clothing store on the street, replaced his windbreaker, which had been ruined by "whipping," and his pants, which had been torn by furniture while being used as a "leather ball," with a new windbreaker and new pants.
Then he used "Travel" to come to 16 Wanbo Avenue, first changed his appearance with the "Faceless Man Necklace" in the abandoned villa, and then found a rental carriage here, asking the coachman to take him to the suburbs.
It wasn't even seven o'clock in the evening, and the coachman was of course willing to take this "big job."
A few minutes later, the alarm in Backlund was sounded, and the military began to block all exits from Backlund.
About a dozen minutes later, the military, with a pre-planned plan, completed the blockade. Airships appeared in the sky, searching the city for suspects. Everyone leaving the city had to be inspected, and even after the inspection, they were not allowed to leave.
At this time, Hobert had already arrived in the suburbs. Wanbo Avenue was originally on the edge of the city, and it only took a few minutes to leave Backlund.
Although he had successfully escaped, Hobert was still a little worried. He used the divination ability of the "Faceless Necklace" to divine whether he would be safe in the next hour.
The result was "unsafe." Hobert's heart sank, and he immediately jumped from the carriage into the roadside grass and stayed as far away from the avenue as possible.
After identifying the direction, Hobert began to run wildly in the fields.
Soon he felt a gaze from the direction of Backlund, as if someone was staring at him from behind. He quickly used "Blink" to hide in a farmhouse.
Fortunately, the gaze was mainly "looking" at the situation on the roads outside Backlund and did not notice Hobert, who had quickly hidden.
Hobert thought, "I wonder if that was a gaze from an angel? Or a gaze from a sealed artifact? It should be a sealed artifact. Angels can't be ready to clean up the royal family's mess at any time. Rashly asking for help from an angel will definitely require some reaction time.
"Fortunately, I have already left Backlund. If I were still in Backlund, I should have been discovered soon. I wonder about Christian...
"Forget it, I'd better take care of myself first. They can't be caught.
"The rental carriage that I rented will definitely be noticed and will definitely be stopped and questioned by the approaching Beyonders or cavalry.
"I must go to the meeting place immediately, otherwise the pursuers will quickly determine my whereabouts."
He glanced at the farmer's family, who were having dinner and were stunned by his sudden appearance: "Sorry, I startled you."
Hobert bowed politely, while channeling his spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon": "You will forget that I have ever been here. Eat quickly, rest early, tomorrow will be another day full of hope!"
Then he used another "Blink" and disappeared from the farmhouse.
The few people sitting around the dining table were stunned for a second or two before the husband said, "What are you dazing for? Eat quickly."
The wife said, "Rest early!"
The son said, "Tomorrow will be another day full of hope!"
The husband slapped him: "Full of hope? Where did you learn this kind of curse word?"
...
Hobert noticed that the terrifying gaze had seemed to start looking elsewhere. He immediately used "Travel" again to come to the foot of the mountain at the meeting point.
The reason he didn't go directly to the big pine tree was that he was afraid that the royal family and the military had ambushed there in advance. After all, Christian's good friend Bruno seemed to be a "snitch," and there was a risk that Christian's plan had been leaked.
Quickly climbing up the mountain, by the moonlight, Hobert saw that Christian was already standing under the pine tree, and there was another person under the tree.
That person was wearing a white robe and a mask, not Dophis.
Christian noticed the inquiry in Hobert's eyes, and he said, "This is Mr. Allen, who is here to meet us."
Hobert didn't know what the other party's background was, he just politely said, "Hello."
The other party also politely replied, "Hello."
The voice seemed a little familiar.
At this time, two bronze doors with complex mystical patterns appeared under the big pine tree, and Dophis came out of the door: "Prepare to fight! Someone followed me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 321: Letter of Submission
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The three people under the big tree were all stunned. After the bronze door summoned by Dophis disappeared, two more bronze doors of the same "style" appeared not far from them.
Seven or eight people came out of it, including Camilla and Bruno, as well as a young man in the formal attire of the Loen Kingdom.
The young man came out of the door and first squatted aside and vomited: "I would rather walk back than go back from the spirit world."
The two groups of people under the big pine tree had already begun to confront each other. Among the pursuers this time were two demigods, including Camilla, and the others were Sequence 5 or Sequence 6. This group of enemies was very strong.
Camilla said: "Just surrender! In two or three minutes at most, Duke Southville will be here. No, it's the former Duke Southville. You will never be his match."
The young man in formal attire finally recovered. He straightened his clothes and said: "I am Earl Cain, representing King George, promising Christian the rank of lieutenant general and the title of viscount.
"The King also said: Even if you go to other countries, they will at most give you a title, but they will not let you continue to serve in the military. Come back, child, your King pardons all your previous crimes and promises you..."
"Wait a minute." Christian interrupted his long speech: "Are you the youngest son of George III?"
Earl Cain puffed out his chest: "Yes, I am serving by my father's side. The merciful King..."
"That's great!" The masked man who called himself "Mr. Allen" said coldly.
Christian also smiled: "I'm just worried about not having a gift for my new monarch!"
As he spoke, he took out a small box from his pocket. Hobert estimated that Christian's pocket was like his briefcase, probably an entrance to a certain space.
Hobert also immediately recognized the small box in Christian's hand. It was the box that Mr. Ulysses of Tingen City had asked Hobert to bring to Christian.
The box opened, and inside was a delicate crossbow the length of a forearm.
Compared to the crossbows on the battlefield, this looked more like a toy crossbow, but the entire crossbow body was made of refined iron, and it could give people a strong sense of oppression.
Camilla said in surprise: "Why is 'Absolute Kill' with you?"
Christian smiled and said: "This was originally my weapon, but I lent it to Ulysses for a 'period of time'."
"Protect Earl Cain!" Camilla reacted and shouted to Christian: "If you kill His Majesty's son, you will..."
Christian had already unhurriedly placed a refined iron arrow on the crossbow.
The people beside Camilla immediately rushed towards Christian. Hobert and Dophis immediately stood in front to buy time for Christian.
At this moment, a word suddenly appeared in Hobert's mind: "Proof of loyalty". George III's son was the best proof of loyalty!
Camilla had just shouted halfway when the crossbow arrow in Christian's hand had already been fired. Camilla quickly stood in front of Earl Cain.
But the arrow seemed to have eyes, and it turned in front of Camilla and hit Earl Cain's head, who was already frightened.
Bang~
With a muffled sound, Earl Cain's head shattered like a crushed tomato, and brains splattered all over the ground.
Most of the people on the mountain were stunned. That was the King's son. He was killed just like that. It seemed that Christian was determined to betray the Loen Kingdom!
Camilla sighed: "The entire kingdom will regard you as enemies in the future!"
"Hahahaha!" Christian laughed loudly: "Thank the King for me. He is indeed a good king who considers others!"
At this time, the people on the mountain felt the pressure from Backlund. The former Duke Southville, the Sequence 2 "Balancer" Dlink Augustus, was about to arrive.
[T/N: Dlink :skull:]
"Retreat." Camilla said: "Don't hinder the Duke."
In her opinion, the four people opposite could not escape under the gaze of an angel.
Christian said: "One day you will understand that my departure is the Loen Kingdom's greatest loss! Goodbye, everyone."
After speaking, he turned his head towards Hobert, signaling him to follow, and then jumped onto the tree that still had dense pine needles in winter.
Hobert also jumped up, and under the cover of the pine needles, the crown of the tree actually hid a door with magical colors.
Christian was the first to enter the door. Hobert sighed about how long Christian had prepared for today, and then entered the door.
His vision was occupied by colorful lights, and then he saw the familiar scene of the spirit world.
Under Christian's leadership, when the four people returned to the real world again, they were already within the territory of the Feysac Kingdom.
Here, the lights were bright, and a middle-aged man dressed in the noble attire of the Feysac Kingdom smiled and said: "Welcome to you."
...
"Extra! Extra! Brigadier General Christian and his son have betrayed the country! His son Hobert has a bounty of 10,000 pounds. The King vows to let Christian experience the pain of losing a son!"
Tuesday morning, Cherwood District, Xio, who was about to go out, heard this shocking news: "A newspaper, please!"
After paying the money, Xio took the newspaper from the newsboy and immediately returned home.
Just as he entered the door, Fors, with sleepy eyes, came out of her bedroom: "Did I just doze off? Why did I hear someone shouting that Hobert had betrayed the country?"
"You're not dreaming!" Xio shook the newspaper in his hand: "Brigadier General Christian and Hobert have betrayed the country!"
"What?"
Fors always felt that she had not woken up yet.
Xio had already started reading the newspaper: "Oh my god, they also killed the King's son. Hobert has a bounty of 10,000 pounds! King George vows to make Christian also taste the pain of losing a son!
"Oh my god, the same bounty as Qilangos!"
But Qilangos has his own crew to support him, his own fleet, and can hide in some inconspicuous corner of the sea at any time!
But what does Hobert have? He doesn't even have a personal servant!
Fors took the newspaper and quickly read it, then she smiled and shook her head: "I must be dreaming!"
Xio was helpless, took two steps forward, and twisted his friend's thigh hard.
"Ah, okay, okay, I know, I'm not dreaming." Fors said while dodging: "But, but it doesn't make sense! Hobert is only in his twenties and is already a well-known lawyer in Backlund. He has a bright future. Why would he betray the country?"
Xio's mind turned quickly today: "The key figure may be Christian."
Fors also reacted: "This, this won't involve a struggle in the high levels of Backlund, right?"
"Very likely."
The two looked at each other for two seconds, and almost in unison: "Miss Audrey!"
Fors went back to her bedroom while saying: "Wait for me five, no, three minutes, we'll go to Viscount Glaint to contact Miss Audrey."

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 322: Hobert's Treason
chapters.content:
