Backlund, Empress Borough.
Audrey quickly arrived outside Earl Hall's study. She took a deep breath to calm herself and knocked on the door.
"Please come in."
Audrey opened the door: "Sorry, Father, did I disturb you? Is it true what the newspaper says? General... Christian has defected?"
In the study, besides Earl Hall, there were also Audrey's elder brother Hibbert, and Earl Hall's good friend Earl Wolfe.
Earl Hall knew that his daughter was friends with Hobert, so he smiled and said, "Dear, please come in. We are also talking about this matter."
From everyone's expressions, Audrey already understood that this matter was true! Hobert had really defected!
He said at the Tarot Gathering yesterday that he was busy recently. Was he busy defecting?
Audrey sat on the soft seat behind her father, only to hear Earl Wolfe say, "I said long ago that some people are too harsh on Christian."
"That's right." Earl Hall said, "Back then, it was he and Rex who stabilized the situation in East Balam, thus laying the foundation for our hegemonic advantage in the Southern Continent."
"But Christian, who has a high prestige in the army, has not been promoted for more than ten years, which has already aroused dissatisfaction among many people."
Hibbert asked: "Father, who is Rex?"
Earl Hall smoothed his hair with his hand: "That was someone from our era. If... alas, there is no 'if'."
"Maybe Christian has other plans? Or other plots?" Earl Wolfe suddenly said: "Otherwise, Christian would not take his eldest son to take risks together. I have met that young man. His future achievements may surpass his father."
Earl Hall smiled and said: "With Christian's mind, I don't think he would do anything stupid."
"No matter what, they killed the prince," Hibbert said. "They can forget about returning to the Loen Kingdom in this lifetime."
Earl Hall took the opportunity to educate his son: "Don't rush to make judgments. Nothing is absolute.
"Especially when you don't know much about Christian, you should be more cautious in expressing your opinions. Of course, private conversations like ours can be more casual."
Audrey observed everyone's expressions. Her father and Earl Wolfe didn't seem surprised by this defection, and they seemed to have some intention of blaming the royal family.
When the conversation ended, Audrey realized that she should leave. Earl Hall and Earl Wolfe seemed to have other things to talk about.
After leaving her father's study, Audrey realized that the protagonist of this defection should be Brigadier General Christian, and Hobert may have just been affected.
The reason for Christian's defection was because he encountered unfair treatment. Everyone seemed to know about this.
No, I have to find a way to confirm it again.
Audrey thought of Xio and Fors, and she quickly told the maid Annie: "Go and ask for leave for me at the studio, just say that I have urgent matters today and don't have time for art class."
She said to another maid: "Go and prepare the carriage. I'm going to the Viscount's residence."
...
"Extra! Extra! Sir Brigadier General Christian defects with his son! His son Hobert is wanted for 10,000 pounds! The King vows to make Christian lose his son!"
Wood District. Jessica, who had just gotten off the public carriage, heard the newsboy's voice.
She quickly went over and bought a newspaper, opening it to read on the street.
"Steam above! They actually killed a prince!"
Even Jessica, who hated nobles, knew the weight of a prince in the Loen Kingdom.
Defected, Lawyer Hobert defected!
Jessica spent about half a minute accepting this fact.
Immediately afterward, she immediately thought that Lawyer Hobert had several letters at her place. She was about to quicken her pace, but she forcibly suppressed her thoughts: With such a major defection case, the royal family will definitely launch a series of investigations. Maybe, maybe I am being monitored.
So Jessica tried to endure, maintaining her usual speed, and arrived at the law firm.
As soon as she entered, Rasga and several other lawyers rushed over and asked: "Jessica, Lawyer Hobert... is that true?"
Jessica said: "I don't know the specific situation, just like you!"
She said seriously: "But I want to remind you that no matter what Lawyer Hobert has done, his contribution to the legal profession and the contribution to the people at the bottom of Backlund are indelible!
"Go back to work! Wait for the next arrangement."
Entering her office, closing and locking the door, Jessica showed her panic.
She rushed to her desk in three steps and two strides, found the letter Hobert left her, and when she used a knife to open the letter, the knife fell on the ground because she was a little flustered.
Picking up the knife and trying again, she opened the letter. Jessica quickly read it.
"Jessica:
"When you see this letter, I should have left Backlund. Don't worry about me. I was planning to leave Backlund and seek new development.
"Give the letter with 'Lawyer Barton' written on it to Barton. In that letter, I will ask Barton to keep our team. I think he should agree.
"I hope you can continue to fight for the interests of the people at the bottom and vulnerable groups in Backlund, and be the light of this era!
"I may implicate you in the investigation, but it should only be surveillance and investigation, because you really don't know anything.
"There are other documents in the envelope, proving that you will replace me in the formulation meeting of the 'Labor Law'.
"No law stipulates that the invitation of the parliament will be terminated due to force majeure and other factors, so no matter what earth-shattering things I have done, it will not affect the legality of you replacing me to participate in the meeting.
"There must be someone to explain those complicated clauses to the workers, of course, you will also accept more severe investigations, and may even cause you to be imprisoned, so the right to choose this matter is up to you.
"Send the other two letters to the address above. I will not repeat the specific precautions.
"If someone sends me a letter or looks for me, please continue to register it. I will occasionally return to Backlund and return to my office.
"If you have something urgent to find me, summon my messenger. The spell is: I,
"Summon in my name:
"A spirit wandering in falsehood, a friendly creature that can be driven, a messenger that belongs only to Hobert Jeffrey."
"Use the norms of the binary ritual, the spell is in Hermes language or other occult language."
"Prepare three donuts before each summon, that is the reward for sending the letter."
"Burn after reading."
The signature is Hobert.
Jessica breathed a sigh of relief. Hobert had already made arrangements. It seemed that he had been planning this for a long time.
Then she burned the letter in her hand, put stamps on the letters with "Xio" and "Sherlock" written on them, and sent them out with the letters to the customers.
The letters from the law firm are all express letters, and I believe they will receive them by the afternoon.
Then Jessica took the letter to Barton and went to Barton's office.

Backlund, North Borough, in a classical office building not far from the Church of the Evernight Goddess, Daly stopped Leonard, who was holding a newspaper and about to go downstairs: "Where are you going?"
"I'm going to the security company to ask what happened to Thomas?" Leonard shook the newspaper in his hand: "We chatted last Saturday, and he didn't seem to have any troubles, but how could he suddenly defect?"
Daly smiled and said: "Don't worry, has the church commented on this matter?"

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 323 Feynapotter's Breakfast
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Daly's words made Leonard suddenly stunned. Theoretically speaking, with such a major treason case, Hobert's close relationship with the Church was not a secret, and the Church should have reacted immediately.
But it was already past ten o'clock, and the Church still hadn't made a statement.
Leonard suddenly realized: "In other words, although Hobert has betrayed the Kingdom of Loen, he is still a member of the Nighthawks team, right?"
Daly smiled without saying a word.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Golfito County, "Sapphire Resort Villa".
The villa is located in the mountainside. It is said that in clear weather, you can overlook the Desi County of the Kingdom of Loen and the sentry posts between the two countries from the top of the mountain.
Hobert didn't get up until after nine o'clock for breakfast. Winter is the off-season for this villa. Now the guests here, apart from Count Bianca of the Feynapotter Kingdom and his guards and entourage, are only Hobert, Christian, and Dophis.
Christian had already finished breakfast and was reading the newspaper: "Today I discovered that Feynapotter writing and Loen writing have many similarities in writing and spelling. It seems that they both evolved from ancient Feysac."
Hobert sat down, and the waiter began to serve him breakfast. The staple food was a Feynapotter specialty: croissants.
He ate while saying: "This is good news. I think this should help me learn Feynapotter."
In Hobert's concept, the writing and languages of the four countries in the Northern Continent today evolved from ancient Feysac, just like the languages and writings of various countries during the Spring and Autumn and Warring Era periods. There are obvious differences, but there are also commonalities.
Especially the languages of different countries, which are like distinctive dialects. They seem difficult to understand, but as long as you carefully compare them, they are not difficult to understand.
Having been used to eating Loen's toast, Hobert felt that the taste was quite good when he suddenly started eating croissants.
Just as Hobert finished breakfast and was drinking the local specialty coffee, Count Bianca came to the restaurant: "Guests, how was your rest yesterday?"
Bianca spoke Loenese very well, and also had a Backlund accent. At the dinner last night, he stated that he had studied in Backlund for a period of time when he was young.
The clothing of the Feynapotter Kingdom is very different from that of the Kingdom of Loen. Their hats come in two types, one is a tricorn hat, and the other is a round hat with a scarf.
The prototype of the tricorn hat popular among pirate captains on the violent seas today comes from Feynapotter.
However, the tricorn hat worn by Count Bianca looks more gorgeous, with embroidery, bright feathers, jewelry, metal accessories, embroidered balls, etc. In short, it looks quite heavy.
Another significant difference is that Feynapotter's cloaks are very distinctive, with only the right arm exposed and the left arm covered by the cloak.
Hobert even believes that their right arms are exposed, perhaps to facilitate waist-pinching.
As for other clothing, it is similar to the style of Loen, and it is no longer as cumbersome as classical clothing.
"I rested well." Christian smiled: "However, there are some things we need to talk about again."
"Of course!" Bianca smiled: "I just received a notice that you are actually a demigod, so the previously negotiated treatment is certainly not appropriate."
A demigod defecting from the Kingdom of Loen to the Kingdom of Feynapotter is completely different in nature from a Sequence 5 defecting.
Christian was stunned: "You already knew, that saves me the explanation."
He got up and said: "I think it's best to talk in the study or reception room, which can better reflect respect for the other party."
After the two left, Hobert became idle again. He suddenly remembered that there was a book placed in the coffin by the tomb owner among the spoils of tomb raiding before.
That's a good thing to pass the time, but it's in the "Nation of Disorder", surrounded by Count Bianca's guards, so I have to find a chance to take it out and read it.
...
Backlund, Hillston District.
Klein, who had been playing cards at the Quelaag Club for an afternoon on a rare day off, suddenly heard the next table talking about Hobert.
Some people said that Hobert was burdened with such a high bounty at a young age, and he would have to spend his next life like a canary, under strict protection.
Some people said that the Feynapotter Kingdom will definitely protect Hobert well. As long as he is alive, he can shame the king.
Klein didn't read the newspaper this morning. Hearing everyone discussing Hobert, he finally couldn't help but ask: "Excuse me, which Hobert are you talking about?"
"Which Hobert else could it be?" One of the card players picked up the newspaper on the table and handed it to Klein.
After Klein apologized to the other three card players, he took the newspaper to the sofa area to read, and the waiter thoughtfully brought him black tea.
Klein spat it out after taking a sip: "Treason?"
The newspaper also had Hobert's portrait and detailed descriptions of his pupils and hair. Klein could confirm that it was the Hobert he knew.
Reading further, he also killed a prince, which was enough to anger the patriots of the entire Kingdom of Loen, and may even trigger a war between the Kingdom of Loen and the Kingdom of Feynapotter.
While Klein was thinking wildly, the waiter came over and said: "Mr. Sherlock, you have received a letter."
Klein was stunned, and suddenly realized that he had only left Hobert the address of the Quelaag Club, and his spirituality also told him that this letter should be from Hobert.
He looked around to make sure no one was there before opening the letter.
The first half was the "contact information" left by Hobert: the spell to summon his messenger.
This reminded Klein of Ms. Daly's messenger.
As for why Hobert betrayed the country, the letter did not mention it at all.
What he didn't know was that when Hobert wrote this letter, he didn't know that in the near future, he would leave Backlund in this way.
Continuing to read, Klein didn't expect Leonard to be transferred to Backlund. Then he would have to be more careful in the future and try to avoid running into acquaintances.
Seeing the end, Klein folded the letter and stared blankly out the window: "Old Neil..."
...
Backlund, Cherwood District.
Xio and Fors, who had spent half a day at Viscount Glaint's place, took a public carriage back to the street where their residence was located.
They learned from Miss Audrey that the upper class of Backlund was not surprised by this rebellion, because they knew the unfair treatment Christian had suffered for a long time.
Moreover, this rebellion, even in the case of the death of a prince, would not cause a war between the two countries. Even the Loen royal family would only summon the Feynapotter ambassador to protest.
Audrey's reason was that the entire Kingdom of Loen hated war now, and if this rebellion would cause drastic consequences, her father would not be chatting peacefully with friends at home.
When entering the door, Xio looked at the mailbox and found a letter lying inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 324: Hobert Becomes Famous
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Feynapotter Kingdom, Golfito County, "Sapphire Resort Villa."
Hobert finally got the chance to retrieve the big book from the "Nation of Disorder" in the washroom.
But before he could read two pages, Christian called him out.
The villa is surrounded by majestic mountains. Although most of the trees have lost their green leaves, and most of the flowers and plants have withered, the scenery of the mountains here is still quite beautiful.
Christian and Hobert strolled along the mountain paths around the villa, with Bianchi's guards following at a distance.
At first, they just chatted about the local food and clothing. After walking for a while, Christian smiled and asked, "You don't blame me for not revealing any information to you before, do you?"
"No," Hobert said, "Since I chose to join your plan, I was prepared to trust you completely. You didn't tell me your plan, it's just that the time hasn't come yet."
"That's good." Christian looked ahead and continued forward: "I am very pleased to have your trust."
He said: "My suggestion is that you follow me to Feynapotter City and accept the king's knighthood.
"Bianchi has already conveyed my request. You will be knighted as a Baron, and with a fief. Don't expect the fief to be very good, but it will definitely exist."
Hobert smiled: "No problem, I was planning to find my own territory when I went to the Southern Continent anyway, but now that I have one, there's no need to go to the Southern Continent."
Christian "hmm"ed: "Do you have any other questions?"
"The timing of Earl Cain's appearance is really perfect!"
Hobert used a statement, but he had already expressed his question: Is this too coincidental?
"That's right, the timing was just right, we wouldn't have had a chance to kill him if it was any later."
That's right, your suspicion is correct.
Hobert continued: "Your treasonous plan doesn't seem to affect the situation in the Northern Continent."
Christian laughed: "What are you thinking? How could a Sequence 4's treason affect the international situation in the Northern Continent?"
Hobert nodded, his guess was correct, treason was just the beginning of Christian's plan.
...
Backlund, in a rented house on Rose Street.
Bennett Tamara, who had a pair of large ears, ate dinner while reading the newspaper.
Hehe, someone has committed treason. This Hobert, who has a bounty of 10,000 pounds, looks a little familiar.
After a moment's thought, Bennett recalled that he had sent someone to follow him before, so he asked his subordinates: "Have you investigated Hobert's faith?"
Bennett was dispatched by the "Council" of the Tamara family to secretly investigate the team that was wiped out on Rose Street.
Hobert once used "Machinery Hivemind" to scare away the Tamara family's sentries when he drove them away before.
Bennett didn't think much about it at the time, he only planned to investigate Hobert's faith. If he believed in the God of Steam and Machinery, then his suspicion could be completely ruled out. If not, the investigation would have to be intensified.
The subordinates who were eating together looked at each other, and after thinking for a while, they remembered who Hobert was.
Seeing his subordinates' expressions, Bennett knew that they hadn't investigated: "Check it out tomorrow, and give me the results by the end of the week at the latest."
As he spoke, he cut out the report about Hobert and clipped it into a book beside him, preparing to hunt Hobert after the Backlund matter was over.
Bennett had learned before that Hobert was only Sequence 7, and at most Sequence 6 now. As long as there was no expert protection, he was very confident that he could turn the other party into a bounty.
...
The time came to December 1st, Wednesday, Tingen City.
Selena jumped out of the carriage in a hurry and met Melissa at the school gate. Elizabeth, who was studying at the Grammar School, was also there.
She ran over quickly: "Have you seen yesterday's newspaper? Hobert..."
Elizabeth put her index finger to her lips.
Selena understood that it was time for school, and there were many students around.
The three of them came to the street corner, and Selena lowered her voice and said, "I don't believe that Teacher Hobert would commit treason!"
"But the newspaper wrote it very clearly." The most calm Melissa said: "Benson said that this may involve many scandals of the upper class in Backlund, and what we see may only be the appearance."
Elizabeth said: "My father has similar guesses."
"No, I have to write a letter to the teacher and ask..."
Melissa quickly said: "Don't! The royal family must be investigating Mr. Hobert. Writing a letter at this time will bring you a lot of trouble!"
Selena was slightly stunned: "But I just wrote a letter to the teacher on Monday, what should I do now?"
Elizabeth and Melissa looked at each other, how would they know what to do?
...
Just as the Northern Continent entered the cold winter season, on this day of December 1st.
The news of Christian's treason with his son, and King George's anger, spread throughout the entire Loen Kingdom.
Some people cursed loudly, some people wondered why they would commit treason, but most people chose to watch coldly.
Some people also issued exclamations like: "10,000 pounds, hehehe~".
Hobert was completely famous in Loen, even more famous than all the lawsuits he had fought before combined!
...
At the same time, Hobert also became famous in the Feynapotter Kingdom.
The major newspapers and magazines of the Feynapotter Kingdom vigorously promoted the news of Christian's "uprising". Here, Christian and Hobert are heroes who resist tyranny and injustice, and spokespersons for upholding justice.
In addition to the propaganda for Christian, there are also many tabloids and gossip magazines that fabricate a tragic love story for Hobert.
He fell in love with a princess, and the two even prepared to elope, but George III separated them.
Earl Cain, who was killed by Christian, played the role of an informant in this story, so Hobert would risk killing him when he led the guards to chase after him.
When Hobert saw these reports, he was already on his way to Feynapotter City.
The Feynapotter Kingdom's welcome to them was very high. Although Christian had not yet been granted a title, the etiquette and specifications for receiving him were equivalent to those of an Earl.
Hobert also benefited from this, riding in a spacious four-wheeled carriage alone.
When he had nothing to do in the carriage, he would stumble and read the Feynapotter newspapers he bought when passing through cities, and ask the surrounding guards about the pronunciation of some Feynapotter words, and learn to read and write Feynapotter language.
With the blessing of the extraordinary physique, Hobert's learning ability was very strong. In just two or three days, he could already communicate with the guards in simple terms.
In addition to learning, Hobert would also read the book he got from the tomb in the carriage.
This book was all handwritten, and Hobert named it "Colin Antigonus's Notes".
The content inside is a bit complicated, but the knowledge involved is very high-end.
Of course, that is relative to other Beyonders. For Hobert, the most valuable content is some records about the Antigonus family.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 325: Corruption from the Past
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Colin Antigonus was the name of the tomb's owner, and he lived before the "Twenty Year War," roughly 800 to 900 years ago.
At that time, Colin's family had become a viscount in the Kingdom of Loen after generations of effort.
Viscounts back then had fiefdoms, subjects, and even their own armies, making them essentially "local emperors" of their regions.
Therefore, Colin had the energy to organize the knowledge mentioned in his family's records and trace the origins of his family.
The knowledge contained in the "Notes" was very high-end for other Beyonders, but Hobert was basically familiar with it. Even if he wasn't, he could understand the principles with a glance.
Hobert knew more about the origins of the Antigonus family than Colin did, because Colin's records started from the Fourth Epoch.
At that time, the Antigonus family had already begun to support the "Blood Emperor," and it was during this period that the Antigonus family had some descendants.
After the fall of the Blood Emperor and the disappearance of Antigonus, the family members scattered and hid in various countries of the Northern Continent.
Colin's branch concealed their identity and did help the Loen royal family solve some problems, which allowed them to become nobles again.
The last part of the "Notes" was about the extraordinary history of Colin's branch, and there were several descriptions that Hobert found very interesting.
One of them was that Colin's ancestors included three demigods who seemed to often hear whispers from their ancestors.
So they believed that their ancestor Antigonus was still alive, but they didn't know where he was sealed.
One of Colin's demigod ancestors went to search for the legendary "Land of Night," said to be the mysterious country where their ancestor came from. Finally, he found a clear clue, believing that the "Nation of Evernight" should be in the Hornacis Mountains.
After making sufficient preparations, he went to the Hornacis Mountains to search, but he never returned.
Hobert smiled. Of course, he never returned. Even if he found Antigonus's sleeping palace, one glance would have caused him to lose control on the spot. Even a demigod wouldn't be able to handle it.
Continuing to read, Colin's ancestors also tried to find the whereabouts of their ancestor Antigonus through sacrifices and prayers.
As a result, they actually received a response, but everyone in that ritual lost control or turned into lunatics.
Hobert was stunned for a few seconds when he saw this. The more he read this "Notes," the more it seemed like "The Antigonus Family's Memoir of Seeking Death."
Theoretically, Antigonus had the Uniqueness of the "Fool" pathway. If the sacrificial ritual was correct, it should point to Antigonus.
It's just that Antigonus's state... heh, in short, another demigod was written off.
Continuing to read, after many failures, Colin's ancestors gave up the idea of finding their ancestor.
The only remaining demigod was originally a "Scholar of Yore." He accidentally obtained an Beyonder characteristic of the adjacent pathway, "Planeswalker."
With the help of a hidden existence, he became an angel of the "Door" pathway.
Colin's ancestors, who became an "angel family" again, were prominent for a while, and this branch became viscounts from that time on.
Of course, according to the status of an angel, if they sincerely supported the Loen royal family, becoming a duke would be as easy as pie.
But they didn't want to have too much contact with the Loen royal family. After all, the two sides had been equal in status, but now they had become subordinates of the Augustus family, and they inevitably felt unbalanced.
Colin said in the "Notes" that he had seen that angel when he was a child.
He only saw that one side before he later learned that the angel had felt some kind of summoning and was going on a long journey. That time, he gathered all the descendants of the family, and the angel divined the future heir of the family.
After becoming the heir of this branch, Colin learned that the "Planeswalker" was called Spike Antigonus, and the mysterious existence that had helped him before seemed to be constantly calling him.
According to Spike, that existence had a very high status, like a god of the "Door" pathway, but not quite.
That hidden existence said that Antigonus's ancestor was sealed in the same place as Him. He could project power into the real world and hear his call because of the special nature of the pathway, but Antigonus could not do this.
In addition, the information given by this mysterious existence was contradictory, sometimes telling Spike to look for Him, and sometimes telling Spike not to go.
Hobert's eyes narrowed when he saw this. He seemed to understand what was going on, but he didn't seem to understand.
He knew that this might be related to the memory he had sealed in the "Nation of Disorder."
In other words, what he was seeing now might be quite dangerous!
Hobert opened the car window and looked outside, seeing that it was difficult for the guards to see the situation in the carriage, so he glanced at the next few pages, but he didn't have time to read and understand them at all.
Then, he entered the "Nation of Disorder" by squatting and walking backwards. Even from the outside, he looked like he was sitting in the carriage reading a book.
Arriving in the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert picked up the ring that was gathering dust on the stone platform and put it on. This ring, from the "Monster" pathway Sequence 8 "Robot," allowed the brain to operate at high speed after being worn.
Hobert used this ring to "recall" the content of the few pages of "Notes" that he had glanced at earlier.
Looking at Spike's self-description again, Hobert immediately understood that the mysterious existence was "Mr. Door." Before becoming an angel of the "Door" pathway, Spike may have been targeted by "Mr. Door," or rather, by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
Letting Spike become an angel was the beginning of the trap of "Mr. Door" and the "Mother Goddess."
Perhaps the "Planeswalker" named Spike heard not only the voice of "Mr. Door" but also the call of the "Mother Goddess."
According to the records in the "Notes," Spike responded to the call and entered the starry sky.
Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne," shook his head, knowing that he would definitely never return.
Who knew that when he "recalled" the content of the next page, he was surprised to find that Spike actually returned three years later!
Not only did Spike return, but he also said that he had seen an existence greater than the gods and had become a devotee of that existence. He had returned to spread the gospel of the Lord!
Hobert stopped "recollecting," his eyes full of disbelief: He saw the "Mother Goddess" and was able to return? Aren't they all meat buns thrown to the dogs... Amitabha, forgive me, forgive me.
Continuing to "recall" the subsequent content, it was all Spike's self-described journey. He followed that call and came to a strange planet.
There seemed to be traces of human activity there, with huge temples and large-scale cities.
But now only wilderness remained. Following the sound of the call, Spike came to a deserted temple.
In that temple, there were tall stone pillars and exquisite sculptures.
At the end of the temple were magical, overlapping doors.
Through that door, you could see a beautiful full moon, which seemed to be the moon hanging in the sky, but it looked so beautiful that you couldn't take your eyes off it.
Then Spike heard that sacred voice, and he willingly knelt on one knee, pledging allegiance to that voice, to the moon in front of him.
Hobert already understood that this angel named Spike had been corrupted by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
But the corruption seemed very skillful. Hundreds of years had passed, and the Seven Gods had not noticed the existence of this "source of corruption."
Moreover, he did not lose his wisdom but hid himself very well.
In short, there exists in this world an angel corrupted by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity"!

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 326: Speculations about the Two Outer Gods (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Little Demon for becoming a member, +5]
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert fell into deep thought. The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" had never ceased Her attacks on this world, but so far, Her power had difficulty projecting directly onto Earth.
She could only "lure out" the Beyonders on Earth, corrupt them, and then help Her accomplish certain things on Earth.
The corruption of Spike happened before the corruption of Roselle, and the methods seemed similar, possibly making the corruption of Spike just an attempt.
After Spike returned to Earth, he didn't realize he had been corrupted; he only knew that he had become a devotee of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
Hobert suddenly thought of the Tomb Owner's curse. Now it seemed that the existence of this book was the Tomb Owner's curse.
If someone read this book without any protection, they would inevitably suffer corruption unknowingly. For a Sequence 6, that would be a catastrophe!
And Colin, the Tomb Owner, was also corrupted after learning about Spike's experience. However, the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" corruption of Spike seemed very restrained. Spike didn't lose his mind, so Colin, who was corrupted by Spike, didn't immediately go insane.
But it was certain that Colin and his family members had all become loyal believers of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
Continuing to "recall," according to Spike's own account, that great existence gave him two tasks in total.
Spike gave one of the tasks to Colin and his family members: to go to the Southern Continent to confirm the status of the "Bound God" and the status of "Dark Side of the Universe" Farbauti.
This… Hobert found it a bit strange. Why would the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" be interested in these two pathways?
Theoretically, the "Chained God" corresponds to the Angel King of the "Prisoner" pathway, with the "Rose School of Thought" as its main force.
"Dark Side of the Universe" corresponds to the True God of the "Abyss" pathway, with the Blood Sect as its main force.
This should be the "territory" of the "Mother Tree of Desire."
But then he thought, is there some cooperation between the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and the "Mother Tree"?
Hobert remembered that it was the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" who corrupted Lilith, and Lilith tricked the "Mutant King" in a battle at the end of the Second Epoch.
This led to the fall of the True God of the "Chained" pathway, which is the "Prisoner" pathway.
The later "Chained God" was only a King of Angels, probably because he didn't have the protection of a True God's position, making him so easily corrupted by the "Mother Tree of Desire."
Then the "Mother Tree of Desire" basically controlled the "Rose School of Thought," with only "Miss Messenger," "Miss Bodyguard," and others not affected by the "Mother Tree of Desire."
This whole operation looked like a conspiracy between the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and the "Mother Tree of Desire." The former obtained a portion of the "Moon" pathway's power, and the latter obtained the opportunity to corrupt the "Chained" pathway.
This is also why Klein initially thought they were an Outer God (or a Great Old One). However, based on the later situation, they should be two different Outer Gods.
It is very likely that they had some cooperation before, or the "Mother Tree of Desire" simply took advantage of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" arrangements, since the "Mother Tree of Desire's" position is half a grade lower than the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," and it can only influence the situation on Earth when there is an opportunity.
But why would the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" be so interested in the two pathways of the "Mother Tree of Desire" in the Fifth Epoch?
Hobert thought for a moment and seemed to have found the answer. The "Mother Tree of Desire" seemed to have a portion of the "Moon" and "Mother" authority in her hands.
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" was likely conducting some peripheral investigations for those authorities.
In other words, the relationship between Outer Gods is similar to that between True Gods. There is cooperation, but they will also be affected by the three laws of "Beyonder characteristics," leading to hostile, or even mortal enemy, relationships.
Hobert thought seriously. Even if the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and the "Mother Tree of Desire" were not mortal enemies, unless the "Mother Tree of Desire" returned the authority of the "Moon" and "Mother" pathways in her hands to the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," they should still be in an adversarial relationship.
Unless it involved a transaction regarding authority, Hobert estimated that the "Mother Tree of Desire" would not voluntarily return the corresponding authority.
Thinking of these things, Hobert continued to "recall."
After Colin inherited the title of Viscount, he ventured to the Southern Continent five times to inquire about information.
It was truly 'venturing," because there were no safe passages at that time. Fortunately, with Spike's help, they could use the Beyonder abilities of the "Door" pathway to go to the Southern Continent.
At that time, the Southern Continent had just regained some order, and the Paz Kingdom and the Highland Kingdom were often at war.
These wars could be seen as the descendants of Death and the "Rose School of Thought" vying for control of the Southern Continent.
Hobert's "recall" came to an abrupt end. He paused for a moment before realizing that he had only seen this far with his previous glance.
So Hobert returned to the real world, flipped through a few more pages of the book with a casual glance, and then entered the "Nation of Disorder" again, starting to recall again.
The subsequent content was basically Colin's observations and experiences on the Southern Continent, including the customs there and information about the main extraordinary pathways, etc.
If a scholar studying the history of the Southern Continent obtained this information, they would definitely cherish it, but Hobert wasn't very interested.
Using the method of entering and exiting the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert spent a long time before finding the source of that "oil painting."
It turned out that the oil painting with high-sequence dream abilities in Colin's tomb passage came from the Southern Continent. It was said to have come from a member of the Blood Sect and was an important basis for Colin's search for "Dark Side of the Universe" Farbauti.
Unfortunately, Colin didn't get any definite news about Farbauti until the last moment of his life.
Colin believed that his divination had gone wrong. This oil painting didn't point to Farbauti but should point to other high-level members of the Blood Sect, so he brought the oil painting to the tomb.
Hobert thought of the scene in the church in the oil painting, the murals around the throne in the sea of flowers, all depicting demons.
Perhaps, as Colin guessed, it was the dream of a high-level member of the Blood Sect.
"Dark Side of the Universe" Farbauti is an ancient god of the Second Epoch. Hobert remembered that this Demon God's proposition was: to subvert all order and pollute all living beings.
His dream must be twisted and full of corruption.
However, Hobert saw that the dream in the oil painting was orderly. Although the murals and flower bushes had a unique aesthetic, they were not twisted. At least Hobert wasn't polluted by it.
After reading all of "Colin Antigonus's Notes," Hobert returned to the real world. The first thing he did was to tear off and burn all the descriptions about Spike.
Then Hobert used a healing spell on himself, hoping that he hadn't been affected by the corresponding corruption.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 327 Hobert is still slightly contaminated (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The convoy welcoming Hobert and the others arrived at Ganaliar, a major city in the southeastern part of the Feynapotter Kingdom. This is a border town. Passing through a plain from here, one can attack the Desi County of the Loen Kingdom.
At the same time, the Loen Kingdom can easily attack from that plain.
Six or seven out of ten wars between Loen and Feynapotter have broken out here.
The direction of the "Sapphire Resort Villa" where Hobert was previously located is mostly mountains and hills, with complex terrain, which is not suitable for large-scale troop operations.
Ganaliar is a large city with walls, mainly divided into the inner city and the outer city.
Outside the city walls, there are also many people living, but whether it is residential houses, shops, or factories, there is a distance of twenty to thirty meters from the outer city walls.
The two city walls seem to be two layers of artificially constructed social barriers. Outside the city walls are slums and the residences of the lower-class people. Once a war breaks out, their houses will become obstacles for the enemy to attack Ganaliar. If the food stored in the city is not enough, they will be immediately abandoned by the garrison and the garrison commander.
Hobert in the carriage sighed, although the people here dress differently and speak different languages, there are also poor people here, and children who are so hungry and skinny that they are still playing.
The people living inside the city walls are the "recognized" citizens.
Only in the inner city can you see the flags of the Feynapotter Kingdom and the characteristic costumes of this country.
The formal attire of the Feynapotter Kingdom is similar to that of the Loen Kingdom, but people here like to wear high-top boots, not necessarily leather boots, but cloth shoes also have high-top styles.
The clothing of people on the streets is not as rigorous as in the Loen Kingdom. Only a few people wear formal attire, and most people wear comfortable round-neck tops and loose pants, or double-breasted coats with local characteristics.
Entering the inner city, the garrison commander here held a welcome ceremony for Hobert and others. Hobert could only see gorgeous formal attire and the characteristic cloaks of the Feynapotter Kingdom at formal ceremonies.
Most of the high-level people here are from the military, and they are very enthusiastic about Christian.
During the dinner, Hobert understood that their enthusiasm was for a reason: they hoped to get some information about Loen's military affairs from Christian.
Of course, Christian knew the value of the information in his hands, so he would not talk nonsense, but it seemed that in order to respond to everyone's warm hospitality, he also revealed some things.
The garrison commander and others were quite satisfied with this information, but after thinking about it, they seemed to know something, but the key to the information was not clear.
This made more than one person sigh: Christian is definitely an intelligence expert!
The accommodation arranged by the garrison commander for Hobert and others was very spacious. The decoration style of the Feynapotter Kingdom is not as rigorous as that of the Loen Kingdom. Their royal family likes rose red, but outside the royal family, they like the three colors of red, yellow, and blue, and the decoration colors are brighter.
Before returning to the room, Bianchi said to everyone: "Everyone, tomorrow we can transfer to the train, and we will arrive at Feynapotter City by noon the day after tomorrow, please be prepared."
For long-distance travel, the train is much faster than the carriage. If you continue to take the carriage, it may take about a week to reach Feynapotter City.
Because Hobert spent too much time in the "Nation of Disorder" today, his spirituality was greatly consumed, so he quickly fell asleep.
He dreamed that he had returned to Colin's tomb, and Colin's remains, which were only skeletons, suddenly sat up from the coffin and said gloomily: "You are back!"
Hobert's scalp was numb, and he suddenly woke up from his sleep.
He found himself camping by a small lake, surrounded by the mercenary team leader Auston and others, who were sitting around the campfire chatting.
Hobert looked around, and finally turned his gaze to the tent where Lena, the internal agent of the "Intersea Mutual Aid Society", committed suicide. Driven by curiosity, he opened the tent and saw Lina sitting in a pool of blood, her eyes wide open.
At this time, the entire dream shook. Hobert looked at the shaking stars in the sky and suddenly realized that this was a dream.
"You are back!" Lena, who had already committed suicide, suddenly stood up and said in a gloomy voice.
This time Hobert didn't feel his scalp numb, but smiled and asked: "Are you still Lena?"
Lena was obviously stunned, but then a very eerie smile appeared on her face: "I am you!"
Hobert shook his head: "It was a huge mistake not to burn your body."
At that time, he really didn't expect that this tomb robbery would involve outer gods.
This made Hobert sigh: the mystical world is so fond of giving people surprises!
After Hobert finished saying this, the dream suddenly shattered, and he appeared in the middle of a huge canyon, standing on a suspension bridge in the canyon that could only accommodate one person.
Underneath his feet was an abyss, and at the bottom of the abyss was a rushing river.
There was something terrible chasing him from behind. He was about to turn around, but reason stopped Hobert from doing so. He didn't know what was chasing him, he only knew that he had to cross this suspension bridge as soon as possible.
Taking a step forward, Hobert realized that he had a black cane in his hand. This black cane seemed to give Hobert endless power.
The wooden boards under his feet had been in disrepair for a long time, and every step forward made Hobert tremble with fear.
Suddenly, the wooden board under Hobert's feet broke, and he quickly jumped to the wooden board in front. Unexpectedly, the wooden board in front also broke, and Hobert fell into the abyss.
He felt the gravity, felt the feeling of falling rapidly, and his spirituality told him that if he fell or died here, his spiritual body would also suffer huge damage.
He had to find a way as soon as possible!
Suddenly, Hobert looked at the cane in his hand. Seeing that he was about to fall to the bottom of the abyss, he immediately gripped the cane tightly.
The next second, Hobert's eyes blurred, and he had turned the bottom of the abyss into a life-saving mat with patterns of rivers and stone beaches. The life-saving mat was as soft and glutinous as jelly. Hobert sank into it, and then was gently bounced up, unloading most of the falling force.
At this time, a roar came from above the abyss, a roar containing anger and unwillingness.
The dream shattered, and Hobert came to a new dream. He was driving a steam car that looked like a tank.
Hobert quickly regained his consciousness, knowing that he was still in the dream world.
He was observing the steam car's dashboard when suddenly, the car broke down. Immediately afterwards, Hobert was tied to the car seat by ropes from nowhere.
Woo~
A steam train was speeding towards here. It turned out that the car was parked right on the train tracks.
At this time, the black cane appeared again on the passenger seat.

Hobert struggled to grab the black cane, but he was tied so tightly by the rope that no matter how hard he tried, he was always just a little short of reaching it.
The steam train was getting closer and closer, and it was even accelerating. It might crash into him in just two or three seconds.
Hobert forced himself to calm down, and he tried to visualize the "Zombie Spoon." This magical item, which he had been carrying with him recently, appeared almost instantly in his left hand.
With the blessing of the "Zombie Spoon," Hobert's strength increased greatly, and his hand was finally able to extend just a bit further, grasping the black cane.
Hobert closed his eyes, and the steam car he was in turned into a cardboard cutout with a car pattern, and the ropes binding him turned into thin threads.
He suddenly leaped forward, finally breaking free from his restraints.
Just as he left the tracks, the train sped past, the cardboard was crushed by the wheels, and the train roared past Hobert's back.
Woo~ ah~
The train's whistle once again turned into an unwilling roar.
Hobert gripped the cane tightly with both hands and began to meditate.
When he opened his eyes again, he was sleeping in a luxurious room in the inner city of Ganaliar. He was twisting his body, sleeping in an uncomfortable position, with one hand grasping the sealing wax stamp made of "Order Crystal" and the watch key on the bedside table.
Hobert adjusted his lying position to relieve the soreness in his body. He thought, "Fortunately, the sealing wax stamp was placed on the bedside table."
"The power of the 'Nation of Disorder' helped me become conscious in the dream world, giving me the power to change the rules of the dream."
As for why he would grab the sealing wax stamp in his sleep, he believed it was his own spirituality trying to save himself.
Recalling the scene in the dream, Hobert quickly realized that he had been contaminated by some of the content in "Colin Antigonus's Notes" during the day.
Even just glancing at it in the real world, without understanding it, he was still contaminated!
The process of contamination was very secretive, and it had not reached an irreversible level.
Hobert recalled Lena's words after "coming back to life." He believed that the contamination was ongoing, and the part of his astral body that was contaminated in his sleep was seizing control of his subjective consciousness.
Those dreams were just a manifestation of this process. If Hobert had been injured or even killed in the following two dreams, then his subjective consciousness might also have been contaminated or directly fallen.
Hobert rejoiced again, "How close! Fortunately, I have the protection of the 'Nation of Disorder,' otherwise I would definitely follow in the footsteps of Spike and Colin."
Then Hobert realized a very serious problem: the contamination still existed in his astral body, and it was still expanding.
Regarding how to solve this problem, Hobert immediately had two ideas: one was to enter the "Nation of Disorder" to see if there was a way to solve it, and the other was to ask "The Fool" for help.
Currently, "The Fool" is best at solving various contaminations.
After a little thought, Hobert decided to enter the "Nation of Disorder" first to try it out. Although the "Nation of Disorder" does not have much operability on spirit bodies and astral projections, its position is there, and there may be some ways.
Coming to the washroom, Hobert made sure that no one was monitoring him, and then he entered the "Nation of Disorder" by walking backwards.
[T/N: Another Lord of the Bathrooms?]
As soon as he sat on the "Iron Throne," Hobert heard a voice from his body: "I didn't expect you to have so many secrets!"
Hobert saw a mouth appear on his abdomen, and it was this mouth that was speaking just now.
Immediately afterwards, eyes and a nose appeared above the mouth, and those eyes were looking at everything around with greedy eyes: "If I offer these to the Mother Goddess, She will definitely reward me!"
Hobert frowned: this face is another me, the corrupted me.
Dong~
Just as Hobert was preparing to try using the "Power of Order" to see if it would work, a muffled and melodious bell suddenly appeared in the "Nation of Disorder."
This bell was very heavy, so heavy that it tore a gap in the palace that Hobert had "built."
Hobert felt something and saw the bell tower in the air of the "Nation of Disorder" through the torn gap.
The melodious bell came from there.
"Ugh ah~" The face on Hobert's stomach let out a scream. The face was like a melted candle, gradually melting, and finally Hobert's stomach had no abnormalities.
Hobert looked again at the bell tower "hanging upside down" in the air: "This is the real 'Bell of Order'!"
A Outer God, a corruption of the Above the Sequences, was instantly dissolved in the bell!
Hobert did not mend the gap in the main hall. He wanted to be able to see the "Bell of Order" whenever he looked up!
Then Hobert used a piece of "Order Crystal" to transform it into a black bracelet. He planned to wear this bracelet even when he was sleeping, so that he could use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" in his dreams.
Returning to the real world, Hobert was no longer sleepy. He lit a candle and made sure that those dangerous descriptions were torn off before he dared to continue carrying the "Notes" with him.
Hobert also found some books from the Feynapotter Kingdom and continued to learn to read and write the Feynapotter language, and he did not feel sleepy until dawn.
The next morning, after breakfast, Hobert and others, in the farewell of the Ganaliar dignitaries, boarded a special train and embarked on a journey to Feynapotter City.
On the train, Hobert, who had learned English in the AD era, always tried to communicate with Count Bianchi in the Feynapotter language. He knew that the best way to learn a new language is to listen and practice more.
It took several years to learn a foreign language in the AD era, but in this world, Hobert was able to communicate in the Feynapotter language with stumbles in just four days.
Of course, this is related to the fact that the languages of the countries in the Northern Continent all originate from ancient Feysac.
This railway that leads to the capital is basically built along the edge of the plain. On the left, there are many places where there is not even a hill, and you can't see the other side of the plain even if you try your best.
On the right side of the railway are continuous mountains. At first, it belonged to Golfito County, and later the mountainous area belonged to Colson County.
Hobert still remembered that Christian had talked about the situation in Colson County. There is a small river flowing through the mountains. There used to be a prosperous waterway, but the waterway is now interrupted due to unknown factors.
Goods imported and exported from Seville, the largest port in the Feynapotter Kingdom, can only be transported to the capital Feynapotter City by rail or by taking a large detour from the Yawi River in the west.
Both freight and travel are very inconvenient.
After taking the train north for a day and a half, the shadow of Feynapotter City finally appeared in everyone's sight.
Hobert smiled and said, "At least there is no smog here."

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 329 Sequence 1 Attracted by Hobert (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The royal palace of the Feynapotter Kingdom is called the Alhambra Palace, which in ancient Feysac means "Red Castle."
It is said that the palace was originally built with red bricks, hence the name "Red Castle."
Hobert guessed that the brick-making technology at that time must have been limited, unable to produce bricks of other colors, so they could only use the most easily processed red bricks to build walls and houses.
Later, after the founding of the Feynapotter Kingdom and its capital being established here, more and more people settled in this area, and the brick-making technology became more advanced, leading to the creation of yellow and blue bricks.
Now, there are not many red buildings left in the Alhambra Palace.
He felt that this small place was only called a "royal palace," and they must be embarrassed to call it an imperial palace.
Christian was also a man of the world, and the father and son remained calm and composed as they were led by the protocol officer into the core area of the royal palace.
King Ferdinand II of Feynapotter received and praised Christian and Hobert in the Great Hall, where grand court meetings were held, and promised to grant them the titles of Earl and Baron, respectively, the following day.
At this moment, Hobert finally had the feeling that "I have really betrayed my country." If it were in the Loen Kingdom, it seemed that it would cost hundreds of thousands of pounds to become a baronet.
With that amount of money, Hobert would rather go to the Southern Continent to form a mercenary group and conquer a territory recognized by the native kings and colonists of the Southern Continent.
Even bribing the colonists to obtain a piece of land of his own wouldn't cost hundreds of thousands of pounds!
The next morning, Hobert and Christian, dressed in traditional aristocratic attire of the Feynapotter Kingdom, arrived early at a side hall of the royal palace to wait.
The traditional aristocratic attire of the Feynapotter Kingdom mainly consists of ornate robes, leather belts, and long boots. The sleeves of the robes are a major feature, divided into inner and outer sleeves, with the inner sleeves longer than the outer sleeves, looking a bit like short sleeves worn over long sleeves.
The belts and long boots are made of leather, which is the "military attire" of the Feynapotter Kingdom's nobles. According to tradition, the king only bestows titles on meritorious officials after winning a battle, so they usually wear military attire when receiving a title.
While waiting, Hobert chatted with Christian about the traditional attire of the Loen Kingdom.
"You must not like wearing those clothes," Christian said with a smile. "I have had the honor of seeing them. They look like a dozen layers of clothes, making it difficult to walk. Thank goodness those clothes have been abolished."
As they were talking, the smiles suddenly disappeared from their faces, and their spirituality sensed a huge sense of oppression coming from outside.
So they both looked towards the door, where a middle-aged man, also dressed in traditional aristocratic attire of the Feynapotter Kingdom, appeared.
He looked to be in his forties, with black hair and a black beard, and a full beard. He wore a black felt hat and looked very easy-going.
Hobert's heart sank. When he came to the palace today, he had seen a statue of this person in the square in front of the palace! He was Philip I, the "founder" of the Feynapotter Kingdom! A figure who had once been loyal to the "Black Emperor" Solomon in the Fourth Epoch!
Later, he became loyal to the "Night Emperor" Trunsoest, and after the Night Emperor fell, he founded the country with the support of the Six Gods.
This "ancient person" is very likely to be a Sequence 1!
The sense of oppression just now must have come from him, but after seeing him, that sense of oppression disappeared.
Immediately afterward, the bronze book in Philip I's hand attracted Hobert's attention, because Hobert actually felt the power of the "Nation of Disorder" in the bronze book.
As the current owner of the "Nation of Disorder," this was easy to distinguish.
However, that power was very weak, giving Hobert the feeling that the bronze book was marked with the power of the "Nation of Disorder."
Then Hobert realized that the bronze book was very attracted to both him and Christian, and was definitely not an ordinary bronze book.
The protocol officers on the side were dumbfounded. They were also responsible for the royal family's sacrificial activities, so of course they knew who this easy-going middle-aged man was!
Christian was also knowledgeable. After seeing the other party's appearance clearly, he immediately realized something, so he used the court etiquette he had just learned to salute the middle-aged man and addressed him as "King."
Hobert also reacted and quickly followed suit.
While saluting, he noticed that Philip I was staring at his wrist.
Hobert's heart trembled slightly: Crap! He was attracted by the power of the "Nation of Disorder"! What to do?
At this moment, Philip I opened his mouth and said in a magnetic voice, "I just came to see the guests from Loen."
Hobert's mind raced, and he quickly took off the bracelet and held it out to Philip I with both hands, saying in fairly standard Feynapotter language, "This is a crystal bracelet that I accidentally obtained. It seems to have some special uses. I am willing to offer the bracelet to His Majesty. It will be my honor."
As he spoke, he withdrew the power of the "Nation of Disorder" from the bracelet, but the material of the bracelet was, after all, from the "Nation of Disorder," and it still possessed extraordinary charm.
Christian was slightly stunned, looked at the bracelet, and then glanced at Philip I. He had originally thought that Ferdinand II was giving him a show of strength, but Philip I seemed genuinely interested in the bracelet.
He was a little strange why such a great figure would notice such a crystal bracelet?
"Child, I cannot accept your offering for nothing." As he spoke, Philip I casually took off a ring from his hand, placed it in Hobert's palm, and took the bracelet from Hobert's palm: "I almost forgot its use. Take this little thing and play with it."
To Him, the ring now only had the function of an ornament.
The moment Philip I's fingertips touched Hobert, Hobert could feel the "Bell of Order" in the "Nation of Disorder" ringing again, and at the same time, the entire "Nation of Disorder" experienced a certain tremor, as if the lakes and pools were boiling.
Hobert used what looked like an agitated trembling to hide his discomfort: "Thank you for your reward."
However, it was not Philip I who caused the reaction in the "Nation of Disorder," but the bronze book!
It was as if it had a life of its own and wanted to open itself.
Philip I was also stunned. He pressed the bronze book that was about to open with his other hand and looked at the bracelet he was holding.
He could feel the extraordinary nature of the bracelet's material. He thought it was the bracelet that caused the bronze book to react in this way.
After all, the young man kneeling in front of him was only a Sequence 6, and not even on the "Arbiter" pathway, so it was impossible for him to cause the bronze book to react.
As an angel of the "Arbiter" pathway, he could not only see the strength of others, but also directly see what sequence they were and what pathway they were on.
Holding the bracelet in one hand and pressing on the bronze book with the other, Philip I left step by step.
The protocol officer immediately came over and said with a smile, "Congratulations to both of you! To be able to see such a great figure and have him accept your contribution is simply incredible luck!"
Christian echoed with a smile, while looking at Hobert with an inquiring gaze.
Hobert shook his head slightly: Now is not the time to talk about this.
He could feel that the boiling in the "Nation of Disorder" was still continuing, but he didn't dare to go in at all right now.
Fortunately, the conferment ceremony finally began.

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 330 Becoming Baron Hobert (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:

Around nine o'clock, back in the Grand Auditorium, the investiture ceremony officially began.
Ferdinand II, in the prime of his life, wore a classical-style robe, a crown studded with countless jewels, and held a scepter, exuding authority without anger.
The nobles who came to observe were mostly dressed in modern attire.
Nowadays, the formal wear in the Northern Continent is quite similar, resembling tailcoats with variations in length, generally accompanied by bow ties or badges.
There were also some bishops from the Church of the Earth Mother attending, mostly wearing bishop's robes embroidered with symbols of the Earth Mother.
First was the investiture of Christian. He walked to the king and knelt on one knee, first taking an oath, then receiving rewards from the king, who declared him a noble Earl and encouraged him to uphold the noble morals and conduct of the aristocracy.
Next was the investiture of Hobert, who strode solemnly to Ferdinand II and knelt on one knee.
Prompted by the master of ceremonies, Hobert began to swear an oath, the content of which was roughly to pledge eternal loyalty to the king and to comply with the obligations of paying tribute and military service.
Then came the awarding ceremony. As a Baron, the king would bestow soil and branches representing land and resources. Christian's rewards also included a sword. In ancient times, an Earl had the power to declare war on other nobles in the vicinity, and the sword bestowed by the king represented this power.
However, in modern times, new nobles are basically titular, without any fiefdoms at all, and the awarded sword is purely symbolic.
When it comes to Dukes, the king will also bestow a set of silver and copper coins and a copy of the "Constitution," representing the Duke's power to mint coins and collect taxes, and the power to enact laws within his territory, provided they do not violate the "Constitution."
Now that the countries of the Northern Continent have strengthened centralism, Dukes have long lost these powers.
After Hobert received a leafy branch and a bag of soil, he immediately expressed his gratitude.
Ferdinand II said in a solemn voice: "Your territory is in the central Colson County, east of Full Moon Lake, where there are fertile paddy fields, dense forests, and half of Full Moon Lake is your territory!"
Hobert thought: As expected, it wouldn't be a great territory.
He remembered Christian mentioning Colson County before, saying that the mountainous areas there were basically lawless lands. The king would grant the land there to nobles, but it was equivalent to a nominal grant, because most nobles would not go to their territories.
Because it is inconvenient to travel there, information is blocked, and there are no famous specialties or minerals. The income there cannot even maintain a noble's normal expenses, and the key is that it is very dangerous.
Although he was complaining in his heart, Hobert said, "Thank you for the king's grace."
For him, a lawless land may not be a bad place. He estimated that if he could establish a new rule there, the potion would be digested almost completely.
At the end of the ceremony, the king announced to everyone that this young man in front of him was from now on Baron Hobert, and his territory from today onwards was the Jeffery Territory, or in the current term, Jeffery Town.
With that, the investiture ceremony ended. The king also gave Christian the post of Deputy Chief of Staff of the Capital Garrison District, and also rewarded him with an Earl's mansion and carriage, but did not grant him a seat in the Upper House.
Hobert only got the Baron's mansion and carriage, and no official position was given to him.
After thanking him again, today's ceremony officially ended. Under the guidance of the master of ceremonies, Hobert received his carriage and the keys to the Baron's mansion.
Driven by the royal coachman, Hobert rode in the carriage bestowed by the king back to the bestowed mansion.
After arriving at his destination, the royal coachman bid farewell, and Hobert realized that he didn't even have a coachman.
Opening the Baron's mansion, it was dusty and overgrown with weeds, as if no one had lived there for a long time.
Hobert led the carriage into the yard, considering whether to hire a few servants to clean it up?
But now there is something more urgent than finding servants.
Hobert came to a room that looked fairly luxurious, but obviously lacked people, and quickly entered the "Nation of Disorder."
If he used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" in Feynapotter City, it would easily attract Philip I, or some "Old Mummy" again.
But just entering the "Nation of Disorder," or simply offering sacrifices or bestowing gifts, would not be noticed by the high-sequence of the same pathway in this city.
As soon as he sat on the "Iron Throne," Hobert saw the pool in front of him churning, and he seemed to hear the echo of the "Bell of Order" ringing in his ears.
Especially the vague figure that Hobert sealed in the pool at the foot of the mountain, its power seemed to have suddenly increased a lot, and it was stepping up the mountain step by step.
The water in the pool at the foot of the mountain turned into water-column ropes the thickness of arms. These "ropes" were still wrapped around the vague figure, pulling it and binding it, making every step the figure took very difficult.
Hobert sighed, fortunately, he sealed this figure in the pool at the foot of the mountain before. If it was still in the pool in front of him, he believed that the "Nation of Disorder" would have changed hands.
Hobert mobilized more power from the "Nation of Disorder" to strengthen the seal on the pool. The figure opened its mouth, as if making a silent roar, but was eventually dragged back into the pool at the foot of the mountain by the ropes formed by the water column.
Hobert, who had been quietly witnessing all this, frowned. It was not a good idea to keep this guy in the "Nation of Disorder" all the time. If he was not careful one day and let him sit on the "Iron Throne," he might really lose the "Nation of Disorder."
But this vague figure represents the family's curse. If he takes it out, he may often hear those crazy whispers afterwards.
Hobert didn't want to hear those uncomfortable whispers even once more.
If it were ordinary people, listening to those whispers would at most make them crazy, but after becoming a Beyonder, if they were not careful, they might lose control like Elliot.
The key is, what method should he use to send him out?
After all, Hobert's spirituality can feel that this figure has countless connections with his spiritual body. What kind of carrier should he use to "hold" him?
Hobert sighed and added some roadblocks on the way up the mountain. That's all he could do for now.
He planned to wait until he became a demigod and his spirit body was stronger before he could find a way to separate this figure.
Then Hobert calmed the boiling pool in front of him. He found that in addition to the stars representing Elliot, Upton, Rafter, and Klein, there were actually two more swollen stars in the pool.
Hobert did not expect that the number of stars could increase. Originally, he thought that after having two "Initial Stars," he would have to rely on his own efforts to develop believers.
He spread his spirituality to one of the stars. Suddenly, he saw a young woman wearing the royal clothes of the Loen Kingdom, chatting with several noble ladies in a huge garden.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 331 That is the Trunsoest Brass Book
chapters.content:

Hobert had learned some knowledge of court costumes these past two days, and he could easily distinguish the costumes of the Loen royal family.
First of all, those whose clothes are embroidered with the Augustus family crest, or who wear the family badge, represent members of the royal family.
The direct members of the royal family will have some metal ornaments on their clothes that are cast with scepters, thrones, or crowns, and the king will also hold a scepter, or usually wear a simple crown.
Hobert could tell from the clothes of the young woman in her twenties that she was a direct member of the current royal family, and most likely a daughter or niece of George III.
From the small talk of several people, Hobert learned that her name was Alice, and they were discussing the preparation of a court ball.
Hobert thought to himself: The nobles of Backlund are really thick-skinned, a prince just died, and they are going to have a ball again?
Alice has a beautiful face and a noble temperament. Of course, in terms of beauty, she is still far from Audrey, but in Hobert's impression, she is already a very beautiful girl he has ever seen in this world.
Especially her confidence when she moved, which made her seem very special.
Hobert withdrew his spirituality: Why did he suddenly have the stars of the Loen royal family members?
He looked at another star and spread his spirituality over it. He saw a horse farm. A young woman in a Feynapotter military uniform was riding a horse and galloping on the grass.
This woman is only twenty-four or five years old, and she also has a good appearance, with some freckles on her face.
Her heroic appearance and the smile on her face while riding made a deep impression on Hobert.
Since coming to this world, most of the people he has seen are conservative Loen women. Most of those noble ladies can also ride horses, but they don't like galloping like the women in the stars.
Looking at her epaulettes again, Hobert's eyes narrowed, she is a high ranking officer!
This must also be a member of the Feynapotter royal family, otherwise it would be impossible to be a general at this age! And she is a woman.
After riding a horse for a while, the female general in the stars jumped off the horse and told the servants and entourage to take care of the horse. She talked to several men who were waiting there in military uniforms.
From their conversation, Hobert learned that her name was Ethel, and she is now in the northern theater of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
Hobert withdrew his spirituality and probably had some ideas: 'What Old Mummy Philip I is holding in his arms, wouldn't it be the 'Trunsoest Brass Book'?
That's not right, isn't the Brass Book in the Church of the God of Combat, and it has been corrupted by the 'Nation of Disorder'?
He recalled that he could be sure that although the Brass Book had the power of the 'Nation of Disorder', it was not considered corrupted.
It can only be regarded as marking the Brass Book, and because there is the power of the 'Nation of Disorder' in the Brass Book, it must be difficult to accommodate this Uniqueness if it is not the owner of the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Hobert also recalled that in his memory, the Brass Book appeared after the end of the war that swept the Northern Continent. In fact, he didn't know where the Brass Book was before that?
It's just because he knew that it was corrupted by the 'Nation of Disorder' that Hobert guessed that it was after the fall of Night Emperor Trunsoest.
It was also because of this Brass Book that Hobert guessed that Trunsoest had found the 'Nation of Disorder', but it seemed that the 'opening method' was wrong, or he had been corrupted by the Outer Gods before finding the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Now Hobert has a different view. What Philip I is holding in his arms should be the 'Trunsoest Brass Book' without a doubt. It is precisely because of indirect contact with the Uniqueness of the 'Justiciar' that the 'Nation of Disorder' will have such a strong reaction, and two more stars of the 'Justiciar' pathway will appear in the pool!
As for why the Brass Book is not in the Church of the God of Combat, but in the hands of Philip I, Hobert is not clear.
Then Hobert realized another serious problem: If Philip I is Sequence 1, then as long as he accommodates the Brass Book, wouldn't he be the King of Angels of the 'Justiciar' pathway!
Then the Loen royal family will be weaker than the Feynapotter royal family in the future.
Thinking of this, Hobert shook his head. He is just a Sequence 6. He can't control these things even if he wants to. Let the Loen royal family worry about it.
After confirming again that the state of the 'Nation of Disorder' had recovered, Hobert returned to the real world.
Standing in the somewhat dilapidated courtyard and looking around, Hobert simply went out and called a rental carriage to Christian's Mansion.
With Dophis around, Hobert estimated that he had already hired servants for Christian.
The rental carriages in Feynapotter are very different from the rental carriages in Loen. First of all, there is a luggage rack on the top, and the luggage rack on public carriages is even bigger!
Secondly, there is a design similar to a bumper at the rear of the carriage, and the main body of the carriage is also very different. The lines of the Feynapotter carriage are more beautiful, and the styles are different. It is not as square and uniform as the rental carriages in Loen.
After getting in the car, Hobert remembered that there were only gold pounds in his wallet, and no coins from the Feynapotter Kingdom, so he asked the driver to go to a bank that has foreign currency exchange business first.
When he arrived at the bank, Hobert consulted the bank manager and learned about the currency of Feynapotter.
The legal currency of the kingdom is the Gold Lire, and according to the current exchange rate, 1 gold pound can be exchanged for 1.2 Gold Lire. The banknotes have four denominations of 1, 2, 5, and 10.
The monetary system of the Feynapotter Kingdom is the most 'normal' monetary system Hobert has ever seen.
1 Gold Lire is equal to 10 Silver Lire. The paper money of Silver Lire has denominations of 2 and 5, and a large number of 1 Silver Lire coins are issued.
1 Silver Lire can be exchanged for about 1.7 Solas. This denomination of coin is the most circulated currency, referred to as Silver Solas.
1 Silver Solas is equal to 10 Copper Lire. The banknotes also have denominations of 2 and 5, and a large number of 1 Copper Lire copper coins are also issued. 1 Copper Lire is roughly equivalent to 2 pence.
Below Copper Lire, there are also coins cast from common metals such as iron or aluminum. 1 Copper Lire is equal to 10 Lire.
Only coins are available in the Lire unit. The 5 Lire coins are made quite decently, but the 2 Lire or 1 Lire coins are relatively rough in workmanship, but because the value is too low, there are few counterfeit coins at this level.
In Hobert's view, the design of 1, 2, and 5 Lire coins is more reasonable than half a penny or a quarter of a penny.
Even a quarter of a penny has to be matched with other things to buy some small items.
For example, a brush for washing pots, a quarter of a penny can buy two or three, and if you can't use them all, they are likely to be eaten by insects.
So you have to buy other items, such as salt or sauce, and use the remaining value of the penny to buy a brush by the way.
And the 1 Lire coin basically minimizes the value of the currency, so you don't have to buy it with other things.
If you take 1 Lire, you can probably buy a small item like a brush, which is more convenient.
