chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 332 Nobles and Fiefdoms
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert exchanged 100 gold pounds for 120 gold Lire at the bank, first exchanging for 10 banknotes each of 1, 2, and 5 gold Lire denominations, and then exchanging for some silver Lire banknotes and coins, as well as copper Lire banknotes and coins.
In Backlund, the coin compartment in Hobert's wallet had been empty for a long time, but now he filled it up.
Currently, the currency of the North Continent, the Loen gold pound, is strong, which is largely due to Loen's industrial output being almost the sum of the other three countries.
Therefore, the handling fee for exchanging gold pounds for gold Lire is only 0.02%, while exchanging gold Lire for gold pounds has a handling fee of 0.5%.
Taking a rental carriage again, he arrived at the Christian Earl's manor. Hobert then realized that Christian's manor was not far from his own in a straight line.
Their mansions were located in the Huanna District, which is like Backlund's Empress Borough. The nobles of Feynapotter City basically lived here.
With Dophis in charge, things were indeed different. At Christian's mansion, more than a dozen male and female servants were already cleaning inside and out.
Several chefs and assistant chefs, as well as two gardeners and two coachmen, also began to work, while Dophis changed into butler attire and became the butler of the Earl's mansion.
After chatting with Dophis, who was supervising the work, he said that he had also hired a butler for Hobert, three male servants and three female servants, as well as a chef, an assistant chef, a coachman, and a gardener.
Finally, Dophis said, "If you have any other needs, you can let your butler hire more.
"The standard for barons in Feynapotter is no more than 20 servants. I suggest you hire a few more carpenters and bricklayers. I heard that your mansion needs some repairs."
Originally, Hobert wanted to borrow Christian's servants to clean up his own mansion for a while, but after hearing what Dophis said, he seemed to belatedly realize that he was now a noble, and under the financially permissible conditions, he could no longer use the servants at home to help clean the rental house like before.
Thinking of this, Hobert recalled that he still had more than half a year's rent for Blanca Street that had not been refunded, which was more than one hundred silver Lire.
Thinking about it, Hobert wanted to slap himself again. He kept telling himself in his heart: "I am a noble now, I am a noble now." He would no longer think about the one hundred silver Lire.
Originally, Hobert wanted to complain that once he joined the "Tarot Club", he would become a believer of the "God of Poverty", the most direct manifestation of which was being stingy.
But on second thought, Hobert realized that it was not his stinginess, but the education he received from childhood in the AD era, which was to live frugally.
And the life of a nobleman is all about luxury and waste. Hobert found that he actually disliked and looked down on these nobles who did not have the correct moral standards.
In the main hall of the Earl's mansion, Hobert saw Christian sitting on the sofa drinking tea.
The main hall had already been cleaned up, and now only here were no servants busy.
The father and son sat opposite each other, and Christian's new personal male servant poured Hobert a cup of tea.
Hobert took the initiative to say, "The crystal of that bracelet was traded at a party. I felt that it was a bit different at the time, and it was not too expensive, so I bought it, but after studying it for a long time, I didn't find out what it was for, so I made it into a bracelet.
"At the same time, I also used the scraps to carve a wax seal and make a pocket watch key."
Of course, he had to lie about this matter. "The Nation of Disorder" was his biggest secret at the moment, a secret that he could not tell anyone.
Christian slowly nodded: "Maybe it just doesn't work in our hands."
He instructed: "Keep the wax seal and pocket watch key safe. I have a hunch that they may be of great use in the future."
Even the demigod Christian could not see anything special about the wax seal, so Hobert believed that so far, only angels or above could perceive the special nature of the "Order Crystal".
But these "Order Crystals" still have a considerable effect on Hobert, and they cannot be hidden in the "Nation of Disorder", which would be a huge waste of resources.
Christian asked, "What are your plans?"
"I plan to return to my territory tomorrow." Hobert now increasingly felt that the territory should be the key to digesting the potion. To have new improvements, he must go to the territory as soon as possible to try to digest the potion.
Christian gave an "hmm" sound: "I will help you invite the Deputy Director of the Ministry of Land and Resources to dinner tonight, so we can learn more about your territory."
Hobert was slightly stunned: "I didn't expect this."
Although Christian was a "traitor", the position of Deputy Chief of Staff given to him by the King was a genuine high-ranking official, and he had enough face to invite Roderick, the Deputy Director of the Ministry of Land and Resources, to dinner.
At the dinner, the host and guests had a pleasant conversation, and Roderick told Hobert a lot of information about his territory.
Of course, this was inseparable from the gift that Christian gave to Roderick, which made him quite satisfied.
Through the conversation at the dinner, Hobert learned that his territory was considered the most fertile territory in Colson County. It previously belonged to a viscount who was native to Colson County.
But six years ago, the viscount's family died inexplicably in their mansion, and the officials sent to investigate did not find any problems.
Later, the royal family learned from Viscount Teuton, west of Full Moon Lake, that the viscount had actually died at the hands of bandits in his own territory.
The King seemed too lazy to care about this and divided the viscount's territory into two. Previously, one-half had been enfeoffed to Baron Ronald, but Baron Ronald had never dared to go to his territory.
After Roderick heard that Hobert was preparing to go to his fief, his eyes were full of disbelief. He suggested that Hobert hire more bodyguards, and even hiring a team of mercenaries would not be too much.
After the dinner, after seeing Roderick off, Christian suggested that Hobert go to his territory alone, and take public transportation, and inquire about the situation of that territory along the way.
Roderick only mentioned the general situation, as well as who the surrounding territories belonged to, and whether there was any background, etc. For the details, Hobert had to find out for himself.
Hobert also had this idea, and he could not easily expose the secret of his "travel" ability.
Returning to his baronial mansion, the butler and servants hired by Dophis were already waiting in the courtyard. This afternoon, under the supervision of the butler, the servants had cleaned up the mansion, at least Hobert's master bedroom was no problem to move into.
Hobert called the butler into the room, informed him that he would go to his territory tomorrow, and gave the butler 50 gold Lire to maintain the daily expenses of the baronial mansion, but he had to report the accounts to Mr. Dophis, the butler of Earl Christian, every week.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 333 Heading to the Fiefdom
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the blink of an eye, it was Sunday. Hobert woke up early and stared blankly at the unfamiliar ceiling for a while.
Even now, Hobert still felt that the week's experience was quite magical. He had gone from being a lawyer to a baron, from a financially sound Backlund millionaire to a noble who would spend 50 gold Lire a month even if he didn't eat, drink, or do anything.
Hobert sighed, struggling to get out of bed. He was quite busy today. After breakfast, he took a carriage to the palace. He had submitted a request to the King yesterday to return to his territory, and he expected to receive a reply this morning.
Nobles returning to their fiefdoms must report to the King. If they also hold official positions, they must also report their work to the King and the Prime Minister in person, and they can only leave with the consent of both.
Hobert didn't hold any position, so he could leave immediately as long as the King agreed.
If he wanted to return to the capital, he had to submit an application to the King in advance and could only return with the King's consent, or if the King summoned him back.
However, these etiquette are now basically just formalities. Many nobles are almost at the capital before they have their servants submit an application, and the King's court earl can usually approve it the next day.
Arriving at the palace to inquire, it was indeed approved. The King doesn't care about such trivial matters; it should be the court earl handling these official duties.
Then, Hobert took his baronial-grade carriage to Christian's residence to bid farewell to Christian and Dophis.
Christian instructed, "When you go to your territory, you have to rely on yourself for everything. Think carefully before you do anything."
"But there are no powerful enemies there. Just be careful of mercenaries who want to earn the bounty. Also, if you can't solve the problem, run!"
According to the information Roderick provided yesterday, the Beyonders in the Colson County mountains are basically local nobles and knights.
Even Viscount Teuton, who is like the leader of the nobles in that area, is only a Sequence 7.
With Hobert's Sequence, he should have no enemies in that mountainous area.
Dophis then took Hobert to a vacant room in the backyard: "This room is prepared for you. If you plan to return suddenly, you can use this room."
Hobert nodded to thank him. Having a "transfer" place made it much easier to return to Feynapotter.
After the three of them had lunch together, Hobert returned to the baronial mansion, dropped off the carriage, instructed the butler to repair the mansion, and take care of the horses and carriages bestowed by the King.
Then, he changed into a double-breasted coat with Feynapotter characteristics, put on an ordinary cotton hat, and embarked on his journey to his territory.
He took a public carriage southeast for an afternoon. Because it was still quite far from Colson County, Hobert didn't gain anything from the idle chat on the carriage.
After six o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert arrived at the hotel and spent 6 copper Lire for a room.
Don't expect too much from this room, which is roughly equivalent to 12 pence. At least it should be clean and tidy.
It's not that Hobert is overly frugal, but according to his experience in the AD era, appearing too wealthy when traveling outside would attract some unnecessary trouble.
Especially in this era when law and order becomes very poor outside the city, it's even more important to avoid being too ostentatious.
Hobert asked the front desk for a few candles and sacrificed the "Colin Antigonus Notes" and the ring given by Philip I to the "Nation of Disorder".
Philip I's sudden appearance earlier had really startled Hobert, so he hadn't performed any sacrifices while in Feynapotter.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert first placed the "Notes" on the stone platform there, and then picked up the ring given by Philip I. Using the authority of the "Nation of Disorder", he immediately sensed the ring's abilities and negative effects.
The abilities were: "It can summon a magnificent and pure pillar of light to envelop the enemy, causing the enemy to evaporate, which is very effective against undead creatures and creatures with tainted aura; it can summon a circle of light that spreads outward, bringing light to the earth and giving teammates courage and warmth; it can summon a beam of light to stay on an object for a long time; it can create holy water."
The negative effects were: "Wearing it continuously for 3 hours will cause the spirit to be invaded by the ring, becoming overly fair and righteous, and it is easy to start a fight with someone because a passerby spits on the ground or says a dirty word. Being invaded by the ring more than 5 times will result in losing all reason and only praising the sun."
Hobert realized that this was a mystical item from the "Bard" pathway, probably equivalent to the Sequence 5 "Priest of Light" level, and the negative effects were also easy to avoid.
The old mummy's stuff is indeed good stuff. Such a seemingly ordinary ring is worth seven or eight thousand pounds, uh, or eight or nine thousand gold Lire.
Hobert was about to use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to re-seal it, but after a moment's hesitation, he didn't do so.
In case Philip I suddenly remembered his ring in the future and wanted it back, and then saw that it had been re-sealed, and the sealing power was not low, it would be difficult to explain.
Of course, it is unlikely that a big figure like Philip I would want it back, but what if someone else wanted to admire it and noticed the "Nation of Disorder's" seal? That would also be a problem.
It's better to just put it in a small box made of "Order Crystal" and put it together with the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch", and take it out when needed.
Back in the real world, Hobert sat on the edge of the bed for a while, suddenly feeling a little bored.
He took out his pocket watch and looked at it. It was only 6:30 in the evening, and the place he was staying in today was a small town with no entertainment venues at all.
There seemed to be only one bar outside, but Hobert wasn't interested in drinking.
He lay on the bed and stared blankly for a while, then took out his pocket watch and looked at it again. It was only 6:40: time was passing so slowly! If he were in Backlund... or should he go back to Backlund?
Hobert suddenly sat up. Since he was idle anyway, he could go back to Backlund and have a look.
Not only could he have a look, but he could also kill and set fires, and do some things that were not convenient to do in Backlund before!
For example, stroll around the Rose Street wearing a mask.
But he didn't know what the situation was in Backlund now?
After a moment's thought, Hobert had an idea. He prayed to himself in the way he prayed to himself: "...Great 'Creator', I need to go to Backlund recently to deal with some matters you have instructed, but I just heard that the previous treason case has put Backlund under martial law. I don't know what the situation is now?
"Please, great 'Creator', convey my question to the believers in Backlund and ask them to answer my question."
Then, Hobert came to the "Nation of Disorder" again, mosaicked the scene of his prayer just now, and threw it into the star representing Rafter.
The so-called Backlund believers "are" actually only Rafter.
Soon, Rafter gave a response.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 334: Expressing Goodwill to the Church of Mother Earth
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Rafter responded, "...The great 'Creator,' I can provide relevant information. Backlund was indeed under martial law for two days a few days ago.
"But soon, as the media of the Feynapotter Kingdom reported and confirmed that the father and son had arrived in the territory of the Feynapotter Kingdom, the martial law was also lifted. The current Backlund is the same as usual."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert retracted his spirituality. The situation was similar to what he had guessed, especially since he and Christian had been ennobled. Backlund would show some anger, but it must be undefended.
This is a bit of a "blind spot" situation. After all, no one would have thought that Hobert would return to Backlund at this time.
Of course, Hobert would not go back with his own face, which would only make his bounty even higher.
He brought the mask made of "Mutated Fire Rose Spider" and "Order Crystal" from the "Nation of Disorder" to the real world, and then changed his appearance into a middle-aged man with a vicissitudes of face.
He also used the ability of the "Faceless Necklace" to disguise himself as still lying in bed with paper figures and illusions.
Hobert did not go directly to Rose Street, but first used "Travel" to go to a corner of a commercial street, and bought a set of Loen-style clothes in a clothing store.
His previous double-breasted coat had obvious Feynapotter style, so he pretended to be a Feynapotter person with a somewhat stiff Loen language to shop, which did not attract the attention of the clerk.
After changing into Loen-style clothes, he was less conspicuous when walking on the street.
Hobert came to a dark corner on the street again, and then used "Travel" to come to a corner of Rose Street. After confirming that no one noticed him, he walked out of the corner and entered the Harvest Church openly.
There were still no believers in the church, and the atmosphere was relatively deserted. Bishop Utravsky was still sitting in the front row, not knowing whether he was praying or repenting.
The only difference was that there was an additional vampire servant who was carefully wiping the seats.
Emlyn White noticed that the middle-aged man who came in seemed a little strange. He looked up and saw the middle-aged man's face, which had just entered the church, become flat like melting wax.
Alarm bells rang in Emlyn's heart. He dropped the rag and became vigilant.
But then he thought: This person must be here to make trouble for the "Giant Bishop". Why am I nervous? Maybe I can take the opportunity to escape.
Thinking of this, Emlyn put on a smile, and the idea of watching a good show was revealed on his handsome face.
He saw that the flat face of the visitor was reshaping his facial features. Finally, he shaped a face that looked a little familiar.
Emlyn suddenly thought: This, isn't this the traitor published in the newspaper!
Hobert ignored Emlyn and sat next to Bishop Utravsky with his original face: "Father!"
"You're here," Utravsky said in a flat voice.
"Yes, I accidentally obtained the potion formula of 'Guardian'. I don't know if you need it?"
Utravsky opened his eyes and glanced at Hobert: "The Mother Goddess has already bestowed upon me the formula of 'Guardian.'"
Hobert took out the "Mutated Fire Rose Spider": "Then do you need this main ingredient?"
Utravsky glanced at the wooden box in Hobert's hand again: "I am collecting the main ingredients of 'Guardian.'"
He asked, "What kind of help do you need? I remember I still owe you a debt of 1,800 pounds."
The debt that the "Giant Bishop" said was the debt of the "Nightmare Candle". At that time, Hobert falsely reported the cost of buying this magical item.
Hobert had already paid off the debt of 2,000 pounds when he asked Utravsky to take action against the members of the Tamara family last time. There was indeed a debt of 1,800 pounds.
However, Hobert had long regarded Utravsky as having paid off all the debts.
Emlyn stretched his ears to eavesdrop on their conversation. He shook his head and thought in his heart: "Unexpectedly, unexpectedly, this 'Big Guy' looks honest and honest, but he actually owes such a large sum of money!
"That spider that flickers with light is obviously a Beyonder ingredient of a high level. Is being a lawyer so profitable? Or did treason make him rich?"
"I said before that those debts have been paid off," Hobert said, "I have a friend who was 'seriously injured' in an action to stop the descent of an evil god.
"I heard that your church's 'Classical Alchemist' can refine a realistic body, so I want to ask your church for help so that my friend can move freely again."
Bishop Utravsky stared at Hobert for a few seconds: "Many people have asked the church's archbishop to resurrect their friends and relatives, but resurrecting a life is a matter that violates the order of the world's operation. Even the Pope can't do it, and even if he could, he wouldn't do it."
Hobert was stunned: "Could it be that the information I got is biased?"
"Yes," Utravsky said, "The bodies refined by the 'Classical Alchemist' are just some puppets. If your friend's spirit body enters the puppet, he will gradually lose his human emotions and eventually become a walking corpse."
Hobert then realized that his idea seemed to belong to "black magic", or something that evil Beyonders would study.
In short, serious churches don't do this kind of thing at all. It sounds like there are huge negative effects or backlashes.
Hobert pushed the wooden box containing the "Mutated Fire Rose Spider" towards Bishop Utravsky: "Just consider it my expression of goodwill to the Church of the Earth Mother, and I also need the Church of the Earth Mother's goodwill towards me."
Utravsky said, "The debt of 1,800 pounds and the process of you helping me solve the problem are enough for the church to feel your goodwill."
"No, I need greater goodwill," Hobert said, "I am going to my fief, and I heard that there is not even a Church of the Earth Mother in my fief.
"After arriving at the fief, I can build a church of the Earth Mother, but I still lack a bishop and several servants."
In the Feynapotter Kingdom, the help of the Church of the Earth Mother is of course very much needed.
Bishop Utravsky then accepted the "Mutated Fire Rose Spider": "I will convey your thoughts to the church."
Hobert nodded and stood up: "If you want to contact me, you can continue to send letters to the law firm, but the recipient should be changed to Jessica."
After speaking, he took off his hat, bowed slightly towards the emblem of life, and then quickly left the church.
Utravsky closed the wooden box containing the "Mutated Fire Rose Spider" and continued to close his eyes to repent.
Emlyn walked over and smiled: "Big Guy, I didn't expect you to have dealings with traitors. If I reveal this news to the police, what consequences do you think it will lead to?"
If you don't want this to happen, let me go quickly.
Utravsky still kept his eyes closed: "Will the official extraordinary believe a vampire's words?"
Emlyn twitched the corner of his mouth: "The Sanguine Clan, is the noble Sanguine Clan!"
As he spoke, he picked up the rag and continued to wipe the seats.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 335 Backlund's Night
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Bennett, with his large ears, was listening to his subordinate's report: "Are you saying the Hobert family's faith is in the Evernight Goddess?"
The subordinate nodded and said, "Yes, yes, because the newspapers have been frequently publishing news about the Hobert family recently, and information about their family is easy to find out."
Bennett stood up from his chair and paced back and forth in front of several subordinates: "He has big problems! He has big problems! How could a believer of the Evernight Goddess think of asking 'Machinery Hivemind' for help in the first place?
"For more than two months, we have been monitoring and tracking on this street. Almost everyone in the South of the Bridge has been monitored by us, but we still haven't found any clues!
"I knew it, we must have missed something before, it must be so!
"Now we are clear, the problem lies with Hobert!"
He said to everyone, "Let everyone come back, tomorrow we will go to Feynapotter!"
Before several subordinates could go out to deliver the order, a person in charge of surveillance ran back to report: "Captain! The masked man has appeared?"
In the dreams of the residents of Rose Street, someone had seen a masked man appear on Rose Street on the day of the incident.
At that time, Bennett suspected that the masked man must be an important suspect, but since they started monitoring, the masked man has not appeared again.
(Because of the particularity of the church, it is difficult for them to see Hobert and others entering and leaving the church even in their dreams, so they have not suspected Bishop Utravsky until now.)
Everyone in the room was stunned, and then they all looked at Barnett.
Bennett slowly sat back in his chair: "Maybe, maybe there is some discrepancy with my previous guess?
"The people who attacked our compatriots are not local forces in Backlund at all! They left immediately after they succeeded?"
A subordinate asked, "Then, Hobert's side..."
"Keep an eye on the masked man first!" Bennett said, "But only two people should follow! Don't all of you follow!"
The subordinate was a little puzzled: "Aren't we going to catch him?
Bennett said, "Why did he suddenly appear in Backlund? Maybe this is a trap?"
...
Bennett was right, this was indeed a trap set by Hobert.
Wearing the original middle-aged man's face, he left the Harvest Church. After leaving Rose Street, he found a corner to change to another face and put on a mask made of "Order Crystal".
Hobert wandered around Rose Street and deliberately stopped in front of the house Apton had rented.
But when he took a taxi carriage to the factory area, he found that only one carriage was following him.
The taxi carriage stopped in front of an abandoned factory. This factory was where Hobert, when he was still Sequence 9, worked with Xio to eliminate an outer member of the "Aurora Society".
After waiting in the factory for half an hour, Hobert was a little disappointed. There were still only two people in the corner!
It seems that the leader of the other party is very calm! Hobert took out his pocket watch and glanced at it. It was almost eight o'clock. He couldn't wait any longer, so he had to change his plan.
So he started to act, quickly walked out of the factory. Before the two people who were staking out could react, Hobert had already used "Blink" to come to them, and the Tang sword that had already been drawn pierced the heart of one enemy.
The other enemy ran away quickly, but Hobert reached out and grabbed him, using the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" to steal his idea of ​​running away. After only a few steps, the enemy stood on the street with a confused expression.
Hobert took a step forward and stabbed again, and the two Sequence 8s who were in charge of staking out were killed in this way.
Hobert used the ability of the "Spirit Wine Glass" to accelerate the precipitation of the Beyonder characteristics on the two people.
After collecting the two Beyonder characteristics, Hobert saw that the other party still did not take action, so he returned to the abandoned factory and used "Travel" to Nikola Street in the workshop that blocked the outside view.
...
At this time, Bennett and others were actually hiding nearby. He believed that the masked man led his group to the sparsely populated abandoned factory, and there must be an ambush.
When the two subordinates were killed, Bennett was about to order a rush to rescue, but before the subordinates could regroup, the masked man took away even the Beyonder characteristics.
Bennett still did not rush to order to rush over. The masked man's actions almost confirmed his guess. He felt that the masked man's accomplices must be ambushing nearby. Now it was time to compare patience. Whoever exposed the existence of the main force first would become passive.
As for the masked man's abilities, they were too far away to see clearly, but it seemed that he was extremely good at close combat, otherwise it would be impossible to solve two Sequence 8s in such a short period of time.
Watching the masked man enter the factory, Barnett's spirituality felt something, and the sense of danger just now disappeared.
He was slightly stunned, and then seemed to realize something, and quickly led people to rush over, searched around the factory, where was the masked man's trace?
Everyone looked at Bennett again. Usually, the captain's decisions were always very wise, and his words and deeds were always very intelligent, but tonight, how come his wisdom and brilliance did not seem to be brought into play?
Bennett frowned, and suddenly he shouted: "Damn! Go to Nikola Shipyard!"
While speaking, he took out a sealed artifact in the shape of a pen, put one hand on the shoulder of a helper, and the figures of the two gradually disappeared into the spirit world.
...
Time returned to more than ten minutes ago, Hobert used "Travel" to come to Nikola Street.
This street was already empty, only the office buildings or dormitory buildings in the factory were still lit.
Hobert quickly came to No. 1668. Seeing that the office building of "Nikola Shipyard" was still lit, he simply used "Blink" to enter the bathroom inside the office building while no one was around.
Hobert heard that the hall outside was noisy, as if a lot of people were gathered.
What he didn't know was that Bennett had just sent a message, asking Alva, the greasy-looking Backlund person in charge who liked to smoke cigars, to gather people to support the factory area.
Alva only learned tonight that the council had sent a team to secretly investigate the killing of family members.
He did not dare to neglect, and quickly gathered people. Because he had not notified in advance, only half of his subordinates had gathered at this time.
Hobert in the bathroom did not know these inside stories, but he also guessed that these people might be preparing to support the factory area.
So Hobert took out the "Teleportation Statue" from the box made of "Order Crystal", and used the statue to sense that the people outside were basically Sequence 8 and Sequence 9, with only three Sequence 7s and one Sequence 6.
The person in charge of the Tamara family in Backlund may not be outside at all.
Hobert also injected spirituality into the "Traveler's Knife". The "Travel" ability had already recovered. If he couldn't beat them, he could escape at any time.
So he opened the door generously and walked out openly, all the way to the vicinity of the Tamara family's dozen Beyonders. Some Beyonders reacted: "You are..."
What greeted him was a knife with a black light.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 336: A Massacre in Backlund
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Ah!"
A scream brought the Beyonders in the hall back to their senses. Their long, comfortable lives in Backlund had made them never dream that enemies would come to their stronghold so openly.
"Order!"
Hobert thrust his cane into the ground, and the "Order Wood" rapidly began to grow, covering the entire hall under its canopy.
The canopy continued to grow, breaking through the glass, and encompassing dozens of meters around it.
Hobert charged forward and killed another person.
That Sequence 6 finally reacted: "I came, I saw, I recorded!"
A phantom, slowly turning book appeared in his eyes: "Imprisonment!"
A layer of transparent, amber-like walls appeared around Hobert, imprisoning him in place.
This Sequence 6 "Scribe," Boris, Alva's assistant, shouted: "Don't panic, he's just one person!"
Hobert deliberately didn't immediately break free from "Imprisonment," hoping that they would surround him under their leader's command.
When everyone had gathered around, a layer of illusory black barriers appeared around Hobert, shattering Boris's "Imprisonment" ability.
He threw out the "Disorder Stone" he had prepared long ago: "Madness!"
This time, Hobert threw the "Disorder Stone" not far from himself, so that it could include all the enemies, and because he had the protection of the "Order Crystal," he would not be affected by the "Disorder Stone."
Almost simultaneously, several Sequence 9s lost control on the spot, and half of the Sequence 8s also lost control, while the other half stood there struggling to resist the loss of control.
The three Sequence 7s also turned pale, their attacks were hindered, and they dared not use their Beyonder abilities again.
Boris took a few steps back, and was only barely able to continue using his Beyonder abilities.
Hobert sighed: Sure enough, "group attack" is the correct way to use the "Disorder Stone."
"Weaken!" Hobert, who had simultaneously completed the "Bribe" process with the "Disorder Stone," immediately used this "combo move."
The next ten seconds were almost Hobert's one-sided massacre time.
He specifically targeted the Sequence 7s and Sequence 8s who had temporarily lost their ability to resist. Boris's Beyonder ability attacks were directly "Distorted" by Hobert onto the monsters around him that had begun to attack indiscriminately.
In ten seconds, he killed seven people, two Sequence 7s and five Sequence 8s.
Except for the out-of-control Sequence 8s, there were no "low-sequence" enemies left in the hall at this time, only Boris and a Sequence 7 "Briber."
It wasn't until Alva and another "Scribe" appeared that this situation changed.
It wasn't that Alva was slow to react, but because he was in the manager's office on the fourth floor. When he heard the chaos in the hall and came out of the office, his vision was already occupied by the canopy with its surging oppressive feeling.
Although the "Order Wood" did not destroy the overall building of the office building, it extended more than ten meters out of the window.
Alva and the gray-haired "Scribe," Bayerd, both had their spirituality warning them that terrible things would happen if they jumped onto the canopy.
And Alva's physique was not enough to allow him to jump more than ten meters.
The two found a rope in the utility room, quickly went to the roof, tied one end of the rope to Bayerd's waist, and Alva swung him around, throwing the old man out like a meteor hammer.
Poor Bayerd was already old and had to suffer this crime. After he was thrown onto the roof of the nearby factory, Alva pulled the other end of the rope, ran and jumped out, "Distorting" the distance in front of him, allowing him to jump four or five meters further. At the same time, Bayerd quickly pulled the rope, pulling him out, and finally jumped outside the canopy.
"Disorder!" As soon as Alva entered the hall, he used his strongest skill.
Hobert, who could have killed that "Briber" with one strike, suddenly stopped, opened his arms as if he was embracing the sun: "Holy Light!"
A magnificent and sacred pillar of scorching light descended from the sky, encompassing the three monsters that had already lost control.
In the screams of the monsters, they were melted by the pillar of light, leaving only three piles of ashes and three Beyonder characteristics on the ground.
The other monsters, out of instinctive fear of the blazing sun, fled one after another.
The pillar of light disappeared, and Hobert came back to his senses, glanced at the still alive and kicking "Briber": This is the ability of "Disorder"! It always makes the target make the wrong choice.
The opponent's main force had arrived, and Hobert dared not be careless. He once again injected his spiritual power into the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch," grabbed in Alva's direction, and stole his "Bribe" ability.
Then Hobert grabbed at the gray-haired Bayerd and stole his "Opening Door" ability.
Hobert grabbed at Boris again and stole his "Record" ability.
Taking advantage of the three "Stealing" efforts, Alva and Bayerd had already rushed to the front.
"Corrosion!" Alva discovered that "Bribe" could not be used. Without "Bribe," the ability of "Weaken" would be greatly reduced, so it was better not to use it.
The Sequence 5 level of "Corrosion" immediately gave Hobert a greedy thought in his heart. Originally, he planned to continue attacking, but the greedy thought made him choose to pick up the Beyonder characteristics not far from him.
Alva rushed over and kicked Hobert in the back of the head. If it weren't for the blessing of the "Zombie Spoon," this kick would have been enough to make Hobert faint briefly.
Even if he didn't faint, Hobert flew out and slammed heavily into the wall, creating a spiderweb-like mark.
Then, Alva and several companions chose to attack with revolvers.
Because Hobert had opened a certain distance between them at this time, they were not afraid of accidentally injuring their companions.
The bullets fired by Alva and the other two were ordinary bullets, but the bullets fired by Bayerd's revolver, after hitting the enemy, would make the enemy hear crazy whispers and pollute the enemy's spirituality.
Hobert originally wanted to withstand the bullets and fight back, but after being hit by the bullets with crazy whispers, his head ached so much that he quickly used the "Opening Door" skill he had just stolen to open a phantom door in the wall, avoiding the subsequent "Whisper Bullets."
Outside the wall, Hobert used a "Healing Spell" on himself. As long as it was not a spiritual or spiritual corruption above the demigod level, it could be directly cured with a "Healing Spell."
Then Hobert used "Blink" to return to Boris's side, opened his arms, as if embracing the sun: "Holy Light!"
The magnificent and sacred pillar of scorching light descended again. Because Hobert had just left the hall, the attention of the four enemies present was outside, and Hobert easily succeeded. Several people were bathed in the sacred light.
After the light, the "Bribe" who had not fully recovered, was ignited by the scorching pillar of light. Even though he was burning all over, he still opened his arms to the sky: "Praise the Sun!"
The other three were not much better.

Hobert gripped the "Order Crystal" hilt tightly, and the illusory black barrier reappeared as he stabbed again at Boris lying on the ground.
Alva, who was rushing to support his teammate, used his Beyonder power again: "Disorder!"
However, this time his extraordinary attack was blocked by the black barrier and failed to affect Hobert.

This "Flame Spear" accurately pierced Hobert, who was constantly moving. Hobert felt that he could not dodge, so he simply didn't.
Thus, the "Flame Spear" accurately pierced Hobert.
Whoosh~
Hobert turned into a paper doll, which was ignited by the Flame Spear and quickly burned to ashes.

The real Hobert, however, used "Blink" to appear in front of Bayerd and slashed out with his knife.
"Dawn Light!" Bayerd suddenly emitted bursts of dawn light. Although it couldn't compare to the "Dawn Light" of a true "Dawn Paladin," it could make this old man very agile and strong for a certain period.
Hobert slashed down, and Bayerd dodged dangerously, his clothes torn, but fortunately he was not injured.
Alva immediately rushed to support, but his legs were suddenly firmly held by a corpse on the ground.
After struggling a few times without breaking free, Alva simply tore off one arm of the corpse.
Then two more corpses pounced, trying to entangle Alva.
Not far away, two more corpses strangled the neck of Boris, who was still somewhat weakened.

At this time, Hobert, who was chasing Bayerd, sighed: Perhaps they had been in Backlund for too long; their cooperation was far worse than that of the "Intersea Mutual Aid Society" team.
Seeing that the black knife was about to strike him, Bayerd quickly used "Flash," which he had recorded long ago but had been hiding.
But Hobert also used "Blink" to follow closely. Just as he was about to kill Bayerd with a single blow, suddenly, the space around Bayerd shattered, and a delicate fine iron longsword blocked Hobert's Tang blade.
Bennett and his assistant, a "Baron of Corruption," had finally arrived.
They immediately joined the battle. Bennett used his longsword to save Bayerd, and the "Baron of Corruption" was about to kick a piece of broken furniture on the ground at Hobert to complete the bribery process.
Hobert suddenly recited a spell in ancient Hermes language: "Knight!"
The space around him became colorful, and an undead wearing a neat and tidy knight's uniform, holding a white longsword, appeared.
It was Hant, who had signed a contract with Hobert.
He thrust forward with his sword, interrupting the "Baron of Corruption's" attack, and then swept his sword horizontally, forcing Bennett to take a step back.
Hobert said, "Entangle them, preferably eliminate one of the enemies!"
Since using "Holy Light" twice, Hobert had been using the "Order Wood" to create an environment that enhanced the power of undead creatures.
The blessing of the environment caused Hant to flicker with a faint pale light after appearing, suppressing Bennett and the "Baron of Corruption" so much that they retreated repeatedly and didn't even have a chance to use their Beyonder abilities.
Hobert went after Bayerd again. At this time, Bayerd was already in a very miserable state, and one blow would solve him.
But at this moment, Alva broke free: "Distort!"
Hobert's knife deviated from the target again. He "Blinked" in front of Bayerd: "I came, I saw, I record!"
He refused to believe that he couldn't kill this "Scribe!"
The newly arrived Bennett and the "Baron of Corruption" didn't feel anything, but after Alva heard Hobert shout the words that only a "Scribe" would say, he already had the idea of running away: Is this donkey-daying a "Shepherd"? Why is he so all-rounded?
"Death!" Hobert said in a solemn voice, as if announcing Bayerd's death sentence.
This skill was the ability that Hobert had just recorded from Christian yesterday using the "Traveler's Knife." At that time, he recorded one demigod-level and three Sequence 5-level abilities from Christian.
"Death" is one of the Sequence 5 abilities. Although it could not exert the full power of this ability, the "prisoner" Bayerd could not avoid it, and Alva's "Distort" could not distort it.
Hobert punched Bayerd, and the gray-haired "Scribe" fell to the ground, his physical body and astral body severely damaged, temporarily losing the ability to fight and escape.
Hobert keenly realized that Alva's attack was not as aggressive as before, and he immediately injected spirituality into the "Spirit Wine Glass": "Gate of the Underworld!"
Two bronze gates with complex occult patterns appeared, and indescribable eyes looked out from the gates, completely detonating everyone's inner fears.
Especially Boris, who had just fought with several living corpses, screamed, covered the wound on his shoulder, and fell to the ground, trembling violently.

Pale arms reached out from the bronze gate, grabbing Alva.

This caused the "Baron of Corruption" to make frequent mistakes, and he had already been stabbed twice by Hant.
Thick black blood flowed from the stab wounds, clearly not injuries inflicted by ordinary weapons.
Bennett also realized the strength of the enemy at this time, using his sword to block Hant's offensive, retreating a few steps, and stretching out his gloved hand.
Suddenly, his figure seemed to become much taller, and his aura became much more majestic, making people afraid to look directly at him: "Undead creatures are forbidden here!"
Hant's attack stagnated, and the color of the bronze gate dimmed a lot.
If Hobert hadn't created an order to enhance the power of the undead in advance, Hant and the bronze gate would have had to return to the underworld.
Hobert suddenly looked at the glove in Bennett's hand. Why did this glove look so familiar?
In fact, this black glove is the same as the black glove that Hobert and the others seized from the Tamara family before.
Or rather, it came from the same out-of-control "imperative Mage". The "Imperative Mage" was wearing a sealed black glove when he lost control.
In the moment of losing control, most of the Beyonder characteristics of the "Imperative Mage" merged with the glove in Bennett's hand.
Only a small part of the power mixed with the "Imperative Mage's" unwillingness, turning an ordinary glove into a Sealed Artifact.
This situation is rare, mainly because the powerful enemy faced by the "Imperative Mage" created an extremely distorted environment, and Beyonder characteristics merged and split in this state.
This is also the reason why the board of directors asked Bennett to secretly investigate this matter, because he had obtained the approval of this Sealed Artifact, and the Sealed Artifact in his hand was closely related to the Sealed Artifact already named "2-356" by the Nighthawks.
The black glove in Bennett's hand is a genuine Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, and Hobert immediately felt the pressure from this glove.
He was too familiar with this kind of pressure. Christian and Camilla, whom he had seen before, both had this oppressive feeling.
He had to find a way as soon as possible, otherwise this "Mentor of Disorder" could completely crush him in all aspects with this glove.
Hobert reached out to Bennett, hoping to steal a demigod-level ability.
But Bennett reached out and pushed forward: "Deprivation!"
It actually deprived the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" of its ability to steal Beyonder abilities! This ability cannot be used again for an hour.
At the same time, Hobert also found the loophole in this Sealed Artifact: although the glove has the level of a demigod, the person using the Sealed Artifact is indeed a Sequence 5!
Hobert immediately said to Hant, who could move slowly: "Buy me some time!"
The pale light on Hant's sword shone brightly, and he was actually recovering bit by bit!
Not only was Bennett stunned, but Hobert was also stunned: "What kind of guy did I sign a contract with? He can actually withstand a demigod-level 'Prohibition'!"
Hant thrust his sword at Bennett again.
Bennett pushed forward again with his gloved hand: "Exile!"
The white light on Hant's sword flashed again, and he slashed out with his sword. The skill "Exile" was actually broken by him!
Unfortunately, Hant doesn't seem to have any offensive Beyonder abilities other than the sword in his hand, so no matter how sharp his swordsmanship is, he can only hold Bennett back.
Taking this opportunity, Hobert once again poured his spirituality into the "Traveler's Knife": "I came, I saw, I record!"
Suddenly, his figure also became as majestic as Bennett: "Exile!"
It was also "Exile", and it was also a demigod-level skill.
Hobert also recorded this skill from Christian yesterday afternoon, and it took more than a dozen recordings to succeed.
Bennett looked at Hobert in disbelief. He could be sure that Hobert was not a demigod. Before this, Bennett felt that with the black glove in his hand, there were few enemies below the demigod level.
But today he encountered an enemy that he and a Sequence 5 could not deal with.
Bennett's figure slowly faded, and he quickly said: "'Exile' is forbidden here!"
But his prohibition didn't work, because he was already in a state of "Exile", and the influence of him and the Sealed Artifact in his hand on the real world was rapidly decreasing.
If other teammates "prohibited" it, it would be effective, but it would have to be at least a Sequence 5 level prohibition to work, but unfortunately his teammates were overwhelmed and did not have the ability to "prohibit".
The loophole that Hobert found was very accurate, no matter what level the Sealed Artifact in his hand was, he was ultimately only a Sequence 5.
With Bennett being exiled, there was no suspense in the battle situation. Alva took advantage of the "Underworld Gate" not being so solid, got rid of the pale arms, and chose to flee the battlefield immediately.
Hobert tried to pursue with "Blink", but Alva kept "distorting" the distance, and his speed was not slower than "Blink".
This made Hobert sigh: A Sequence 5 is really hard to kill!
Then he was slightly stunned. It seemed that he had just sighed that Sequence 6 was really hard to kill some time ago, but tonight he could kill three Sequence 6s!
Hobert smiled and had to come back and besiege and kill the "Baron of Corruption" with Hant.
This "Baron of Corruption" was also unlucky enough. He died tonight without using a single Beyonder power.
Hobert ended the summoning of the "Underworld Gate", and as the "Underworld Gate" gradually disappeared, Hobert stepped forward to finish the job, killing Bayerd and Boris one after another.
He really killed three Sequence 6s.
Hobert used the "Spirit Wine Glass" to extract all the Beyonder characteristics in advance, and also found the revolver with Beyonder effects from Byrd.
He also found a set of Tarot cards from him, it seems that he often used the ability of "Astrologer" to help people divination.
Hant made a great contribution in the battle just now, so Hobert said to Hant: "You choose first."
Hant chose a "Scribe", a "Briber" and two Sequence 8 Beyonder characteristics.
He put away his sword, bowed slightly to Hobert, and disappeared from the real world.
Hobert quickly collected the other spoils, and used the fire lacquer seal as a medium to control the "Order Wood" to return to the shape of the scabbard, and finally recovered the used "Disorder Stone".
Just as he was about to leave with "Travel", he saw the Tarot cards he had thrown on the ground.
This gave him a sudden idea of mischief. He picked up the Tarot cards, found the "Emperor" card and threw it in the pile of corpses, and threw the other cards far away.
Only then did Hobert pour his spirituality into the "Traveler's Knife". As his figure gradually disappeared, he smiled and said: "'Emperor' @'The Fool'."
His figure completely disappeared, as if he had never been here.

The gunshots from the battle had attracted the attention of the police, and the officers patrolling Nikola Street immediately rushed over.
But before them, someone had already arrived at the battlefield.
About half a minute after Hobert left the Nikola Shipyard, a figure appeared at the entrance of the shipyard. The next second, this figure was already in the lobby of the office building.
He was an old man with white hair and beard, with a unique sense of vicissitude, as if he had been traveling all his life.
This was Ryan Solomon, the leader of the current Solomon family members.
He was the one who had previously obtained the 'Order Wood' that could still be used for a few minutes in Tingen City, and he was also the one who had inquired about the recent situation of Henry's family in the suburbs of Backlund.
And tonight, Ryan felt that surging 'Power of Order' again.
Unfortunately, he was one step late. Only corpses remained on the battlefield, and even the Beyonder characteristics had been taken away.
In other places in the factory, there were still a few monsters attacking living people, but Ryan was not interested in them.
Just as he was about to leave, he saw a Tarot card in the pile of corpses—the 'Emperor' card!
Suddenly, he looked up at the second floor. A woman in her thirties walked out of the office on the second floor. She was elegantly dressed, wearing a veiled hat, and her face was not clear.
She had also just arrived. Ryan had not noticed her presence when he entered the lobby.
Ryan's eyes narrowed. In her hand, she held a wooden cane, which felt very similar to the wood in his hand that was full of the 'Power of Order,' except that the wood seemed to have no power anymore.
The two did not know each other, but they both realized that the other was a Beyonder on the same level as themselves.
So they nodded slightly to each other as a greeting, and then they both looked at the 'Emperor' card!
It wasn't until the sound of police footsteps came from outside that they each left.
…
Feynapotter Kingdom, Canter Town in the southeastern part of the capital.
Hobert suddenly appeared in the room. The illusion he had used before had long since Invalidation, and at this time, only a paper figure was covered under the quilt.
The reason for doing this disguise was to avoid being noticed by the people the king might have sent that he had suddenly 'disappeared'.
Hobert guessed that although he had been ennobled as a Baron, the king or the Feynapotter Kingdom's intelligence agencies should still send people to monitor him and Christian for a period of time.
It's just that their surveillance would be very careful, possibly just watching from a distance.
Hobert's previous use of illusion to disguise himself was a cautious approach. Even if the illusion failed, Hobert was not worried, unless the person monitoring him had corresponding sealed artifacts, otherwise they would not have noticed that he had just 'disappeared'.
Sitting on the edge of the bed and waiting quietly for more than ten minutes, Hobert confirmed that there was nothing unusual.
Then he took out the spoils of tonight, a revolver with the ability to whisper, an exquisite fine iron sword, and several Beyonder characteristics.
The sword belonged to the unlucky 'Baron of Corruption.' It had no special effects, but it was exquisitely crafted and relatively sharp. Hobert, based on the principle of never wasting anything, picked it up as well.
Taking off his mask, Hobert relit the candle and sacrificed all the spoils of tonight to the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Sitting on the Iron Throne, Hobert first picked up the revolver. Using the authority of the 'Nation of Disorder,' he immediately understood the revolver's ability:
"The gun will automatically enchant the bullets. The enchanted bullets have two effects. One effect is to allow the target to hear whispers that can pollute spirituality, making it difficult for the other party to concentrate. This corruption will last for a period of time. If the Beyonder is in good condition, the corruption will gradually disappear. If the condition is very bad, at some point in the future, the corruption may become the source of losing control."
"The second enchanting effect is to cause certain damage to the enemy's spirit body, causing the enemy to experience very intense pain, thereby making it impossible to concentrate. In severe cases, it will cause the enemy to faint briefly. The damage to the spirit body will disappear over time."
The negative effect is: "It is easy to hear mysterious whispers, and it is impossible to distinguish whether these whispers are benevolent or malicious. Perhaps you can grow according to the descriptions in those whispers, or perhaps you will be stared at by some evil existences because of the descriptions in those whispers, and die miserably."
Hobert put the gun on the stone platform. The negative effects of this gun were not difficult to avoid, as long as he didn't believe any of the content of the whispers.
However, he couldn't keep the gun with him for a long time. These whispers must be full of temptation, and there will always be some descriptions that make people's hearts flutter.
Another reason for not keeping it with him was that this gun was probably benchmarked against Sequence 7, and its Beyonder power was likely derived from a 'Shadow Ascetic' Beyonder characteristic.
For the current Hobert, he really couldn't look down on Beyonder items of this level.
Moreover, since having the Tang Blade, Hobert's other hand has become very busy, having to use the 'Order Wood,' be ready to throw out the 'Disorder Stone,' and then hold the 'Dream Stealing Pocket Watch' in his hand, looking for opportunities to use it.
Relatively speaking, the 'Dream Stealing Pocket Watch' is easier to use than this revolver. The bullets fired can be 'distorted' and may be dodged, but the ability of the 'Dream Stealing Pocket Watch' is something that at least demigods and below have no way to avoid.
Because he had the Tang Blade, Hobert also stored the sword next to the stone platform after checking that there were no highly recognizable patterns carved on the sword, as well as things that could be easily divined.
Next were the Beyonder characteristics. Although there were already many Beyonder characteristics on the stone platform, Hobert's love for these magical little things remained undiminished.
These things are wealth that will never depreciate in the mystical world!
Hobert reached out and summoned the Beyonder characteristics, identifying them one by one.
Among them were the Beyonder characteristics of a 'Baron of Corruption' and a 'Scribe', and the Beyonder characteristics of an 'Astrologer' and a 'Briber'.
The others were all Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 8 and Sequence 9 levels, including three 'Barbarian' and four 'Sheriff' Beyonder characteristics, as well as two 'Trickmaster' Beyonder characteristics.
The Sequence 9 Beyonder characteristics were one 'Lawyer' and two 'Apprentice' Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert roughly calculated that the harvest from this operation was worth about 13,000 pounds just for the Beyonder characteristics, which was about 15,000 gold Lire.
In one go, he earned back the cost of the 'Traveler' Beyonder characteristic.
It's just that this kind of 'business' can't happen every day. This time, he was able to have such a fruitful harvest because of the previous channeling and advance investigation, which is difficult to replicate.
Hobert habitually decomposed the Beyonder characteristics. The income he had roughly calculated just now was only the 'initial income'. After decomposing these Beyonder characteristics, he could at least double it again.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 340 The "Emperor Card" left at the scene (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Backlund, factory district, Nikola Shipyard.
Last night, this place was sealed off by the police, with not only police carriages but also a carriage bearing the Dark Sacred Emblem.
Because the legal representative of the shipyard is a believer of the Evernight Goddess, this case was transferred to the "Nighthawks" team.
Early morning is when the winter smog is at its thickest, but reporters are still waiting outside, waiting for the police to announce the latest information.
With a horse's neigh, another carriage with the Dark Sacred Emblem entered the shipyard. Leonard got out of the carriage and looked at the first floor of the factory office building.
The doors and windows on the first floor seemed to have been crushed by a surge of great force. All the glass was broken, and the door was directly squeezed down. The entrance looked empty.
Leonard quickly arrived at the scene, where two colleagues, Lorotta and Borgia, were already present.
"Any leads?" he asked.
At this time, the bodies at the scene had been cleared, leaving only the Tarot card on the ground. Leonard glanced at it; it was the "Emperor" card.
Loretto glanced at Leonard: "This case doesn't seem to have been assigned to the 'Red Gloves', right?"
"I heard that a Tarot card was found at the scene, which is similar to the previous case, so Captain Soest asked me to see if there are any related clues."
Loretto said "Oh": "According to our investigation, the deceased were all members of the Tamara family."
"Through a search of the hall and office, we suspect that several homicides in the past two years are related to them. We have not been able to find their den before. Unexpectedly, they used such a large shipyard as a cover."
"Unfortunately, their spirituality has basically dissipated when we arrived, and there is no way to divine the clues of the murderer. Otherwise, we will definitely find the murderer, give him an award, and send him behind the Chanis Gate by the way."
Leonard asked: "There seem to be many employee dormitories around, right? Are there any eyewitnesses?"
"Yes." Borgia replied: "But the eyewitnesses said that when they heard the fighting, they saw the first floor of the office building was shrouded in a layer of black fog, and they couldn't see the situation inside."
As Hobert can borrow the power of "Nation of Disorder" in the real world, the appearance of "Tree of Order" has also changed.
Only near the "Tree of Order", or using special items in the distance, can you see its crown clearly.
Because the light is distorted by the "Tree of Order", ordinary people can't see the appearance of the crown at all from a distance.
Leonard glanced at the Tarot card on the ground again. The last time a Tarot card appeared in a case was when someone reported the discovery of Lanevus.
Someone appeared in time on the only way for Lanevus to escape and killed this hateful "swindler".
At that time, Tarot cards were scattered all over the scene, but today's crime scene only has one "Emperor" card. Could it be that the last time was a crime of passion? And this time it was a premeditated crime?
But what is the connection between the two? Could it be that Lanevus has something to do with the members of the Tamara family? What does the "Emperor" card represent?
On the way back, when only Leonard was left in the carriage, he whispered, "Old man, what do you think?"
"Is this the way you should address an elder when asking for advice?"
Leonard smiled: "It seems you haven't found any clues either."
"That card is the clue!" Pallez, who was parasitizing Leonard, said: "The main sequence mastered by the Tamara family includes the 'Black Emperor' pathway."
Leonard understood: "This is a battle for Beyonder characteristics, but... but what does it have to do with Tarot cards? Could it be that a mysterious organization with Tarot cards as codenames has appeared? The murderer yesterday was a member holding the 'Emperor' card."
Pallez: "That's something the church should worry about, it has nothing to do with me."
...
Backlund, 15 Minsk Street.
Klein was stunned when he saw today's morning paper: Tarot cards? Why did Tarot cards appear at the scene of this murder case?
He touched his back, as if there was a huge scapegoat added.
According to the report in the newspaper: A major burglary occurred on Nikola Street last night. The brutal murderer killed several security personnel in the office building and robbed all the finances in the safe, reportedly including a large amount of gold and no less than 1,000 pounds in cash. It is worth mentioning that a Tarot card was found at the scene, which the police said may be a directional clue left by the murderer.
Klein's first thought was copycat crime, because Tarot cards were found at the scene of Lanevus's murder, so someone followed him to learn and shift...
He suddenly realized that this might be a supernatural case, not a burglary as the newspaper said.
Because the Lanevus case was a supernatural case, ordinary people simply do not know the inside story.
Unfortunately, the newspaper did not publish what card it was, otherwise that would be a clue.
Klein concluded that the murderer must be diverting the attention of the official Beyonders.
With this conclusion, he also divined that this matter would not bring danger to himself, and Klein breathed a sigh of relief, otherwise he would always have the illusion that his old secrets were being revealed.
...
Backlund, Empress Borough.
At Earl Hall's breakfast table, Audrey glanced at the newspaper next to her father's hand: "Dear Earl Hall~, what's new today?"
In fact, she had already seen the report. She was also shocked by the appearance of Tarot cards at the crime scene: Could this be another action related to the Tarot Club and Mr. Fool?
But why did this action kill so many innocent people? And rob those properties? What is the difference between this and a robber?
"A criminal gang's den has been destroyed, and a Tarot card was also found at the scene." Earl Hall had already obtained more detailed information from the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
But the fact that it was the den of a Beyonder family could not be discussed at the dining table at home.
In the eyes of official Beyonders, all unofficial Beyonders are criminals, and all unofficial Beyonder organizations are criminal gangs. Earl Hall's statement is not wrong.
Audrey's eyes lit up. She determined from the details of her father's expression that the case her father was talking about was the burglary case published in the newspaper: I knew it, Mr. Fool's believers would not be robbers!
She showed enough curiosity: "Criminal gang? Why leave Tarot cards? What card is it?"
Earl Hall casually said while drinking morning tea: "As far as I know, it's an 'Emperor' card."
The bacon on Audrey's fork almost reached her nose: Emperor card! Is it Hobert?
Fortunately, Audrey's control over her expression is now very superb, and she did not show too obvious shock.
She thought: Is it really Hobert? Isn't he in the Feynapotter Kingdom? Right, he has a magical item with "travel" ability, maybe he really came back! Goddess! Hasn't he betrayed the country? Why would he still eradicate criminal gangs in Backlund?
Hu~

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 341 There is only one Amon in the world (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Feynapotter Kingdom, Canter Town.
Hobert got up early and started a new journey today.
There are two routes from Feynapotter City to Colson County. One is to start from Feynapotter City and follow the Taidi River by water, but now because there is no direct passenger ship to Bugas City, the capital of Colson County, it takes a lot of time to wait for the passenger ship, and the whole journey becomes about three days.
The other route is the land route that Hobert is taking now. Because there is no direct train to Colson County, he can only take a carriage to the train station in Kant Town and take a six-and-a-half-hour train to reach Bugas City.
Generally, people go to Colson County by train and return by boat.
On the train, Hobert learned more information about Colson County. Only the southern mountainous area of Colson County was regarded by the king as a fief for the nobles, and the northern part was still ruled by the county government.
However, after the freight of the Taidi River was blocked, Bugas City was also marginalized.
This is the reason why this capital city does not have a direct train to the capital. In recent decades, the entire Northern Continent has started a wave of large-scale railway construction.
And Bugas City lost its importance five or sixty years ago, and did not catch up with this wave of "development".
There is no railway or shipping from Bugas City to the south. You may have to ride a horse or walk along the Taidi River to reach Hobert's fief. The passengers on the train are not sure how many days it will take.
I just heard that there are many bandits along the way, so be careful.
Hobert arrived in Bugas City at about 1:30 in the afternoon. After getting off the train, he first saw the small train station and the somewhat dilapidated urban area.
The decline of a waterway has a huge impact on the cities along the way!
Hobert also felt it was very strange, why didn't the Feynapotter Kingdom try to re-dredge the waterway?
Of course, now is not the time to think about this question. Hobert found a hotel that looked fairly clean, asked for a room, and closed the curtains as if preparing for a nap, but was actually waiting for the Tarot Club time to arrive.
Although he had asked about the leave process before, he had never asked for leave, which meant that he could attend the party normally.
At three o'clock, the gray mist drowned Hobert's sight, and he reappeared in the magnificent Great Hall, sitting at the ancient bronze long table.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool..." With "Justice" Audrey's crisp greeting, this week's gathering officially began.
Although Audrey had too many questions to ask Hobert, she still insisted on greeting all the members first. During the greeting process, she found that "The Sun" had obvious anxiety.
So Audrey asked, "What are you worried about?"
"The Sun" Derrick did not hide it, and immediately told the whole story of his successful "pretending to be sick" and being sent to the bottom of the round tower for isolation and treatment.
Finally, he asked: "Honorable Mr. Fool, it is said that there is a god-level sealed item at the bottom of the round tower that can close and isolate the bottom of the round tower. Will that sealed item discover that I am participating in the Tarot Club?"
"The Fool" Klein replied: "Normally, it won't be able to find out."
In fact, he didn't know either, but he didn't find any power trying to invade this gray mist, so he answered like this.
However, Klein did not say anything definitive. He continued: "But some magical items have unique effects."
Hobert felt that he had learned again: What is the highest level of "beating around the bush"? It seems like he said something important, but it seems like he didn't say anything.
The naive Derrick was relieved when he saw that Mr. Fool gave a positive answer: "I don't know what kind of unique effect it has. This is one of the highest secrets of City of Silver."
Speaking of this, he suddenly remembered the "neighbor" at the bottom of the round tower, and blurted out: "Have you heard of a person named Amon?"
Hobert now wants to send "Little Sun" an Amon card: You don't know how difficult a guy you have provoked.
"Hanged Man" Alger asked: "Why did you suddenly ask this question?"
Derrick briefly described the conversation with the search team leader in the next room: Forty-two years ago, a search team encountered a person who claimed to be Amon in the depths of darkness. They invited Amon to City of Silver, and Amon agreed. But on the way back, Amon disappeared. The members of that exploration team returned to City of Silver and went crazy or lost control one after another, leaving only the captain alone, who was locked in the room next to Derrick.
Everyone looked at "Emperor" and "Hanged Man". It seems that only these two members can understand this kind of weird thing and problem.
Alger saw that "Emperor" had no intention of answering, so he said: "In the Fourth Epoch, um, more than 1,500 years ago in our country, or even longer, there used to be a family that possessed strange powers. They belonged to the Tudor Dynasty, and their surname was Amon.
"Even in that era when there were many high-sequence powerhouses, this family's surname was a taboo."
"Why?" Audrey asked this question before Derrick had time to ask.
Alger said: "According to the information I have learned, the Amon family is a blasphemer family. It is said that they have mastered the secret of stealing the power of gods! Also, the Amon family claims to be descendants of the ancient sun god."
Derrick was confused. There is no ancient sun god in his knowledge of mythology.
So he looked at Mr. Fool with a doubtful look.
Klein thought: I don't know either!
Of course, he can't show the Fool's ignorance, he can only pretend to be uninterested in this topic.
Derrick saw that Mr. Fool was "not interested", and looked at "Emperor" again.
Hobert thought for a while and said: "The answer to this question is also very valuable, but considering that you are facing great danger and will not have the opportunity to pay the reward recently, I might as well reveal some information to you."
"Very dangerous? Mr. Emperor, do you think so too?" Derrick asked in surprise.
The elders of the Six-Member Council also think so!
Hobert was slightly stunned and did not react for a while: Is it because I have read the original work, so I "sound the alarm" when I hear Amon?
Alger took a breath and said helplessly: "If you don't think so, you are not normal.
"The fact that he is the only one alive in the entire exploration team is enough to show that he has a big problem."
Hobert nodded. He still underestimated the simplicity of "Little Sun".
Derrick had a feeling of sudden enlightenment: "I understand. Thank you, Mr. Hanged Man."
Fors, who was listening with great interest, resisted the urge to reach out and cover his face: There are not many teenagers as simple as this now.
Then everyone looked at "Emperor", waiting for him to reveal more information.
"Emperor" did not disappoint them. Hobert said: "The ancient sun god we are talking about is the omniscient and omnipotent god you are talking about.
"Also, there is only one Amon in this world!"

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - 342: Mr. Fool's Path (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The giant hall in the mist fell silent immediately.
Klein had some guesses about the Ancient Sun God, so he wasn't surprised to hear "Emperor" say that, but he was surprised by the description after "Emperor": There is only one Amon in the world! So we must cherish Amon? This sentence is very strange.
Alger, who also had rich knowledge of mysticism, had similar questions: "Does "Mr. Emperor" mean that the Amon family now has only one member left? And that member is now in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods"?"
Audrey, through observation, found that Hobert's expression was very serious when he said the latter sentence, and he seemed hesitant to speak: "There is a huge secret hidden behind this sentence, but Hobert doesn't seem to intend to make that secret public now?"
Fors, who heard this relatively high-end information in the extraordinary world for the first time, seemed to have a new definition of the high-end nature of the Tarot Club: This "Emperor" seems to know a lot of information about gods? This, this is too blasphemous!
She thought of the "high-end transactions" that everyone had with "Emperor" in the previous two gatherings. Could those be information about the gods? If that's the case, this might as well be called the "Blasphemer Gathering".
The most shocked was "Little Sun": The Ancient Sun God is the all-knowing and omnipotent God? Then…
He was the first to react and ask: "Mr. Emperor, that all-knowing and omnipotent God, I mean, I mean the Ancient Sun is now…"
Hobert glanced at Little Sun before saying: "You can think that He has fallen."
Derrick immediately felt a sourness in his nose and almost cried. He had made such guesses more than once before, but when he got the accurate answer, the grief and despair in his heart were still indescribable.
He would not doubt the accuracy of the news from Mr. Emperor, because Mr. Emperor's performance has always shown that he knows the process of the Ancient Sun God's fall, but the knowledge value involved in this information is too high, so Mr. Emperor said it is worth 20,000 pounds.
At this time, "The World" asked "The Emperor" in a hoarse voice: "Is the formation of the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" related to the fall of the Ancient Sun God?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes."
Derrick stabilized his emotions: "Mr. Emperor, what should we do? What should the City of Silver do?"
"Where are you now?"
Derrick was slightly stunned before honestly returning: "I, I am of course in Mr. Fool's Divine Kingdom."
"Who is the deity at the head of the bronze long table?"
"The Fool, Mr. Fool."
"Aren't the Tarot Club members around you your partners? Haven't they provided you with help?"
Derrick seemed to gradually regain hope: "Thank you, Mr. Emperor, I understand, the old hope is gone, but we have ushered in new hope!"
"I also thank everyone for their help all the time, especially Mr. Emperor and Mr. Hanged Man. I have learned a lot of knowledge and ways of dealing with things from you."
Audrey was also a little moved. At this moment, she felt that the members of the Tarot Club were a loving family.
Klein and Alger weren't so excited, because the other members had always had a transactional relationship with "Little Sun". Although they had taken care of "Sun", those helps were not selfless.
It's just that "Emperor" has created the atmosphere here, and they can't say these too straightforward things.
Fors, who had been watching, also had a feeling of "unity is strength", but she joined the association late and didn't have a strong sense of ownership of the Tarot Club.
Alger asked again: "Mr. Emperor, what do you mean by saying that there is only one Amon in the world?"
Hobert pondered for a while before saying: "I can't tell you the details until Miss Justice becomes a psychiatrist."
Alger understood and asked: "Why?"
Hobert said to himself: "Next, I will popularize the abilities of the "Marauder" pathway demigod. To be honest, this information is also very valuable, but to solve the problems encountered by "Sun", everyone must know this information."
Alger realized something, recalled the relevant information of "0-08", and did not continue to ask.
Hobert said: Sequence 4 of "Marauder" is called "Parasite", which can parasitize in the bodies of other Beyonders or ordinary people, and it is difficult to be detected.
The World asked: "Was the captain of the City of Silver "parasitized"?"
"Theoretically, yes." Hobert said: "This can also explain the encounter of that team. They met Amon. Amon parasitized into the body of one of the team members, so Amon disappeared."
Everyone sighed in their hearts: "There is such an ability!"
Audrey then sighed: Where did Hobert learn so much mysterious knowledge? Could it be that his father is a scholar? I haven't heard that Brigadier General Christian was born in a powerful Beyonder family.
Fors also sighed: The weird event that sounds so weird was actually explained clearly by "Emperor"! Is this the real face of the extraordinary world? It looks mysterious and weird, but there are actually some operating principles hidden behind it?
Derrick asked again: :Mr. Emperor, why are the other team members crazy? Also, is Amon really a descendant of the all-knowing and omnipotent God?:
"Who said that the Amon they met must be a demigod?" Hobert smiled: "Let me talk about some of the abilities of the high sequence of the "Marauder" pathway."
"High sequence Beyonders can steal other people's fate, and can perceive whether the person in front of them is related to them by observing other people's fate."
Hobert put emphasis on the word "relationship".
Klein immediately understood: That is to say, if I know too much information about Amon, then when Amon sees me, he will be able to perceive that I know him very well!
No wonder we have to wait until Miss Justice becomes a psychiatrist before we can tell everyone more detailed information. Like "0-08" before, even if we know too much information about Amon in the Tarot Club, we can ask Miss Justice to hypnotize us and forget these information after leaving the Tarot Club.
Alger: So that's how it is. This is as weird as the high sequence of the Spectator pathway!
Derrick pondered for a few seconds, and gradually understood the reason why Mr. Emperor did not answer his question directly: "Then, then what should I do?"
Amon's ability is too weird, Derrick feels that he has no way to solve this problem at all.
Of course, pray to Mr. Fool. Hobert smiled: Mr. Fool should be very interested in Amon.
Klein behind the gray fog tried his best to deny in his heart: Don't talk nonsense, I'm not interested at all!
But he still manipulated "World" and asked: Why do you say that?
Hobert said: As far as I know, "Marauder", "Apprentice", and "Seer" are adjacent pathways.
Except for Fors and Klein, the other members suddenly realized: Mr. Fool is one of the gods of these three pathways!
