chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 343 The Emperor is Hobert (Bonus 7)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters, almost reached ch 500
For the members of the Tarot Club, the question of what pathway Mr. Fool belonged to was bordering on blasphemy. The education they had received since childhood made them not even dare to think about it.
However, "Emperor" seemed to already know which pathway the deity Mr. Fool belonged to.
And Klein, sitting at the head of the table, felt an increasingly strong urge to strike "Emperor" with lightning.
But sadly, "The Fool" did not have such authority. He could only mobilize the power of the "Sefirah Castle" to exude sufficient pressure and glare at "Emperor".
Everyone felt that chilling power and lowered their heads, not daring to speculate any further.
Audrey even thought to herself: If Hobert continues like this, he might be punished by Mr. Fool one day.
After all, this was Klein's territory. Hobert, who knew when to yield and when to stand firm, quickly said: "Apologies, Mr. Fool. I gleaned some information from offering sacrifices to you and receiving your blessings. I have never actively speculated about you."
Alger was stunned: What clues could be obtained from the sacrificial and blessing rituals?
Others had the same question, including Klein: If I had known, I wouldn't have scared "Emperor". Otherwise, I could have manipulated "The World" to ask him what he saw in the ritual. But now the atmosphere is so tense that it's not good to ask again.
Then Klein said in a deep voice: "This is the last time!"
Hobert quickly replied: "Yes, yes, yes."
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Audrey's question broke the silence: "Mr. Emperor, what do you mean by a 'stealing fate' Beyonder power?"
Hobert replied: "It refers to stealing the fate of the target. For example, a high-sequence being of that pathway steals the fate of a member of the Tarot Club, then he can replace that member to attend the meeting, and none of us will notice."
Everyone felt a chill down their spines. This ability was too bizarre.
Then, everyone turned their attention to "Little Sun", suspecting whether he was the original "Sun".
Hobert added: "I was just making an analogy. The master of this gray fog space, Mr. Fool, can definitely discern such methods."
Only then did everyone breathe a sigh of relief, including Klein.
Klein thought: I didn't even know I had such methods. As expected of the adjacent pathway to the Seer, the main focus is also on mystery.
Fors asked curiously: "Then if he steals the fate of a husband, wouldn't the wife and children at home also treat him as their husband or father? Where did the original husband go?"
"Theoretically, that's how it is," Hobert said. "The person whose fate is stolen will become a stranger in the eyes of his former acquaintances and relatives. Because he has no fate, his connection with reality will gradually weaken, and eventually disappear into the void.
"If, during this process, the fate is returned, he can exist in this world again."
Fors sighed: "What a terrifying ability!"
The existence of such beings makes one dare not believe whether the people around them are still the same as before.
Hobert smiled and said: "Fortunately, there are very, very few people with this ability."
Fors felt that she was not comforted at all.
"Little Sun" asked: "Then after the meeting, should I immediately pray to Mr. Fool?"
"It's best not to," Hobert said. "Since he has been sealed at the bottom of the round tower, it means that your superiors are also aware of his problem, but it is not clear what the specific problem is."
He also followed up: "At this time, you should pretend that you don't know anything. When a real danger occurs, don't rush to ask Mr. Fool for help, but first ask the superiors of City of Silver for help. If you encounter a life-threatening danger, then consider asking Mr. Fool for help."
Hobert nodded, as expected of the "Political Commissar Dao", impeccable in terms of details.
Derrick nodded seriously, carefully noting the instructions of Mr. Emperor and Mr. Hanged Man: "Mr. Emperor, of course I know how advanced the information you revealed today is. For this, I am willing to pay you three Sequence 8-level main materials as a reward after this incident is over."
Hobert was slightly stunned and nodded, thinking to himself: "Little Sun" is still conscientious.
With Derrick taking the lead, Audrey also said: "I also heard this information and asked questions. I will use 'giving you certain help in the future' as a reward for this information."
Alger also had to make a statement: "I will also provide help within my ability in the future as a reward."
Although his reward was similar to "Justice's", adding "within the scope of my ability" made it different, only indicating that helping with a small favor was no problem.
Fors also followed "Hanged Man's" example in expressing her position. Although "The World" was a little unwilling, he also stated that if "Emperor" needed anything, he would lend a hand.
After this issue was discussed, Audrey remembered to offer Roselle's diary to Mr. Fool.
After Mr. Fool's reading time ended, Audrey said again: "Mr. Emperor, I have a question I want to discuss with you separately. Mr. Fool, I request to communicate with Mr. Emperor separately."
Hobert was slightly stunned and nodded.
Klein isolated the hearing and vision of the others.
Audrey asked straight to the point: "You are currently in the Feynapotter Kingdom, right?"
Hobert smiled: "You guessed my identity in the real world after all."
"Didn't you also guess my identity?"
Klein behind the gray fog was stunned, not expecting "Emperor" and "Justice" to know each other.
Then Audrey asked: "Why did you betray your country?"
Klein's "What the heck" almost blurted out: "Mr. Emperor" is Hobert! Hobert is a bandit…Cough, Hobert is "The Emperor"! No wonder when I first met Hobert, I felt his aura was so familiar.
Hobert glanced at "The Fool" with the corner of his eye: Audrey thought that "The Fool", who was like a god, must know the identity of every member of the Tarot Club, but in fact, he didn't know!
He smiled bitterly and thought: Knowing is knowing. There is not much loss in Klein knowing that "Emperor is Hobert", and some problems don't need to be concealed anymore.
"To be honest, I don't know the specific reason," Hobert replied.
Audrey was slightly surprised. Of course, she could observe that Hobert was telling the truth: Could there be some unknown secrets inside?
But she didn't care too much about what those secrets were, and asked again: "You were implicated by Sir Christian and had no choice but to betray your country, right?"
Hobert smiled: "You can understand it that way."
He knew that Audrey had a near-obsessive sense of justice, so he didn't explain further.
Hearing this answer, Audrey felt much more comfortable in her heart: "Did you rob the Nikola Shipyard last night?"
Klein: I…! Alas, I was careless in recruiting people!

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 344 A Private Communication with Audrey (Bonus 8)
chapters.content:
[Thanks to Forze for advancing to Sequence 9: Reader! +5]
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Although Klein sighed about "recklessly pulling people in," he had no malice towards "Emperor" or Hobert. On the contrary, he hoped to gain more high-end knowledge from "Emperor."
Therefore, even with such a sigh, Klein didn't intend to "kick Hobert out of the group chat."
Immediately afterward, Klein understood the source of "Emperor's" knowledge: it might not all come from his family, but also from a hidden organization. After all, Hobert had the "Creator" backing him.
But since Hobert was a devotee or believer of the "Creator," why didn't he seek help from the "Creator" when faced with the madness brought by the curse?
Klein gave several answers in his mind: for example, the "Creator" was not very good at solving curse problems, so Hobert prayed to me. Another example was that Hobert had also sought help from the "Creator" while asking me for help. It was probably from that time that Hobert began to receive the "Creator's" attention.
But only thinking to this point, Klein didn't intend to seek further confirmation, because he had indeed received help from the "Creator" before. Now that he showed no signs of losing control, it meant that it was not an evil god.
And through his contact with Hobert, Klein could also perceive that he was a lawyer with a sense of justice, a trustworthy teammate. As for whether he was a traitor, Klein didn't care too much.
Since that was the case, Klein was also willing to be a trustworthy teammate to Hobert.
Almost in an instant, Klein's mind wandered a lot, and then he continued to listen to the conversation between "Justice" and "Emperor."
Hobert answered Audrey's question: "What robbery? Yesterday, I was planning to kill a 'Mentor of Disorder' from a Beyonder family, but I failed."
Audrey was taken aback: "Then you're not injured, are you?"
"Not really. After all, I now have the ability to 'Travel'. If I can't beat them, I can still run away." Hobert didn't want to reveal too many details of last night's battle.
Audrey said "Oh" and then said: "The newspaper said you robbed all the cash and gold in the safe."
Hobert was stunned: "How could I forget the safe!"
This was a loss that "The Fool" had suffered. Back then, no, it was at some point in the future, when he impersonated "The Hero Bandit" to kill the human trafficker Capim, he regretted not searching the safe.
Hobert asked: "Did the newspaper say how much wealth was in the safe?"
"It said there were a lot of gold and no less than 1,000 pounds of cash."
Hobert smiled and shook his head: "There was a fierce battle at the time. I really didn't have time to take care of it."
Audrey covered her mouth and chuckled: "It seems the reporters don't understand the inside story either."
Then she asked: "Why did you kill that 'Mentor of Disorder'? What is the origin of the family that is hostile to you? Are they all vicious criminals?"
"If I advance again, I will be promoted to 'Mentor of Disorder'." Hobert said, "The people I killed were all members of the Tamara family. This family and the Amon family we just mentioned are both nobles of the Tudor Empire."
"This family controls the 'Lawyer', 'Arbiter', and 'Apprentice' pathways. If you hear any news about them, you can choose to tell me. I will return to Backlund to start hunting again."
"As for their character, they certainly used their strongholds in Backlund to do a lot of bad things. Although they are not as bad as the 'Aurora Order', they are not good people either."
Hobert certainly knew that Audrey paid special attention to moral issues. In her opinion, it was necessary to determine that the other party was of bad character before killing them.
Such a view cannot be said to be naive or simple, but only because she has experienced too little to have such persistence.
A noble girl under twenty years old, who has been well protected by her family since she was a child, has not yet fully come into contact with society. It can only be said that she still lives in her own world.
At the same time, based on his life experience in the Common Era, Hobert knew that such a concept could not be persuaded by persuasion, but only by letting her experience it and think for herself.
Hobert remembered that Miss Justice gradually became less naive after working at a charity.
At the moment, Hobert was unwilling to have ideological contradictions with Audrey over such trivial matters, so he said that the Tamara family was "not good people."
Audrey smiled: "I knew it. You must have known that they were not good people before you took action!"
She said in her heart: "These reporters are really too bad. They actually portrayed Hobert as a cruel robber!"
Hobert cleared his throat: "As a friend, I have something to remind you of."
Audrey was taken aback: "Tell me."
"I said some laws of Beyonder characteristics before. You should be able to understand that Beyonders of the same pathway and adjacent pathways are very likely to be enemies unless they belong to the same organization."
Audrey nodded slowly, as if she understood what Hobert meant.
Hobert continued: "As a person with Beyonder abilities, I will not randomly harm an ordinary person, but I don't mind punishing some people or things that I don't like."
"It's like an adult who won't randomly beat or scold a child, but if the child is too naughty, they have to teach them a lesson for their parents."
Klein behind the gray fog felt that "Emperor's" values were too much to his liking.
Audrey nodded: "I understand. This is a very correct concept."
Hobert waved his hand: "Continue to listen to me, but when we face Beyonders, it's different."
"Whether you wants to or not, once you become an Beyonder, you have to accept the fact that Beyonders of adjacent pathways are enemies, and you have to accept the fact that other Beyonders may regard you as an Beyonder characteristic, or a wealth, at any time."
"Do you understand what I'm saying? In the mystical world, besides wonder and mystery, there are also darkness and haze."
Audrey nodded seriously: "Emperor first... No, Mr. Hobert, I understand what you mean."
She sincerely said: "Thank you very much for your reminder. I will carefully contact every Beyonder. Every Beyonder may be a potential enemy."
She smiled brightly again: "Fortunately, I met like-minded Beyonders in the Tarot Club, Beyonders who can be trusted enough."
Hobert smiled slightly and did not continue this topic: "If you have any urgent matters to contact me, Xio has my emergency contact information. You can..."
Speaking of this, Hobert suddenly realized that the atmosphere was a little wrong.
The smile on Audrey's face seemed to disappear.
Hobert immediately understood where the problem was: "At that time, I was being monitored by the royal family. Contacting Xio would not attract their attention, but if I contact you, it will definitely affect your father's political career.
"For the sake of you and your family, of course I can't contact you."
The smile on Audrey's face reappeared: "I knew it. You will make the most stable choice at any time."

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 345 The various parties of the Tarot Club (Bonus 9)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Audrey's smile returned, relieving Hobert.
Behind the gray mist, Klein marveled at Hobert's quick reaction. Before he could fully understand why Miss Justice was unhappy, Hobert had already responded.
Audrey then asked Hobert, "Why did you think of leaving an 'Emperor' card at the scene at the time?"
Hobert spread his hands: "Because I am the 'Emperor' of the Tarot Club."
Then, as if realizing it belatedly, he said to Klein, who was seated at the head of the table, "Sorry, Mr. Fool, the situation was urgent at the time, and I didn't have time to pray for your instructions.
"At that time, I simply thought that since I am a member of the Tarot Club, of course I should use what I am doing to expand the reputation of our Tarot Club."
Klein behind the gray mist: I believe you!
He said in a solemn voice: "Remember to pray for instructions in the future."
Hobert quickly said: "Definitely, definitely."
Audrey smiled and said: "Fortunately, Mr. Fool is a merciful god, otherwise you would have been punished by Him long ago."
Klein sighed: It's getting harder and harder to lead the team.
He was already considering whether to let The World spout nonsense at the Tarot Club, and then easily crush him to set an example, and then create a new account.
After the separate exchanges ended, the Tarot Club continued.
This week, apart from Hobert and "Little Sun", no one else had too rich experiences.
Alger made an appointment with Hobert to explore the ruins of the elves around the weekend this week, and then came to the information exchange session.
Fors took a deep breath and said, "Before attending the gathering, I saw a report in an early newspaper saying that a brutal robbery occurred in Backlund, and the murderer left a tarot card at the scene."
Audrey glanced at Hobert, who pretended not to see it.
Alger asked: "Are you sure that was the news from the early newspaper?"
Since it was the news from the early newspaper, why did she only see it at noon?
Fors was too embarrassed to say that she didn't get up until noon. She sighed in her heart: It's not that I'm lazy, but the bed in winter is too lovely.
Hobert generously admitted: "I did it.
"But the report is not true. I was fighting a Beyonder opponent. The dead were all his subordinates, and no ordinary people were involved, nor did I rob their safe."
Fors was stunned. She had suspected that a member of the Tarot Club had done it, but she didn't expect the "Emperor" to admit it so readily.
Then she realized that the "Emperor" seemed to be quite strong, killing several Beyonders in Backlund without being caught or tracked.
Alger was already guessing in his heart whether this was an action authorized by Mr. Fool?
After a few more exchanges, this Tarot Club ended.
...
On the Berserk Sea, in a small port on Oravi Island, the "Blue Avenger", which was recently in a state of repair, was parked at this unofficial port.
In the port, there is a small hotel, which is a resting place specially for pirates who are not convenient to show up in the cities on the island.
Alger, with blue hair, sat up from the bed in one of the rooms, pulled open the curtains, as if he had just finished a nap.
He sat by the window, looking at the azure sea outside and the occasional seagulls flying by.
Alger couldn't help but think: "Which pathway does Mr. Fool belong to? His pathway is not as obvious as those of the orthodox gods such as the Lord of Storms and the Evernight Goddess.
"Fortunately, Mr. Fool has been popularizing information such as 'Pathways to Godhood' to us, otherwise, he would have died miserably with just the three pathways listed by the 'Emperor'.
"Mr. Fool is doing this to disintegrate the foundation of the gods' beliefs, which seems very obvious.
"So the 'Emperor' has repeatedly blasphemed the gods, and not only has Mr. Fool not punished him, but he seems to be supporting him. After all, Mr. Fool has also revealed the information of the 'Blasphemy Slate'."
Alger sighed in his heart: "Because of the influence of the 'Emperor', I can now speculate about the gods so casually. This may be the result Mr. Fool wants.
"This way, there will not be too much psychological pressure when betraying the Storm Church in the future."
Then he returned to the original question he was thinking about: "First of all, the 'Marauder' pathway can be basically ruled out, which seems to be a pathway mastered by the Amon family.
"If it is a high-sequence Beyonder of the same pathway, Mr. Fool must be more interested in Amon.
"Then there are only the 'Seer' and 'Apprentice' pathways left..."
Alger knew some of the abilities in these two pathways, but he found that he knew too little about the abilities above the demigod, and he couldn't make an effective judgment at all.
"Should I ask him for advice when exploring the ruins with the 'Emperor'?"
Thinking of this, Alger shook his head: "I can't let others know about my thinking about this question and my interest in this question."
...
"Forsaken Land of the Gods", City of Silver, bottom of the Round Tower.
After the Tarot Club, Derrick returned to the real world.
He sat there cautiously for several seconds, and after finding no abnormal changes, he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, an old voice suddenly came from behind Derrick: "Where have you been just now?"
It's the leader of the exploration team who lives next door to him!
Derrick froze suddenly, his muscles tensed, and his hair stood on end.
How is he behind me?
How did he appear in my room?
What about the seal?
What about the effect of that sealed item?
Derrick did not look back, but immediately raised his hands to his jaw, as if praying.
The narrow room suddenly became bright, and pure beams of light entwined with flames fell from the roof, hitting the place where the sound came from.
Derrick, who turned back to observe the strike effect of his ability, saw that the "Sacred Beam" he prayed for suddenly became thicker and brighter, so dazzling that he couldn't open his eyes.
A "light man" separated from the beam of light and pounced on the exploration team leader in the corner.
The exploration team leader quickly disintegrated and melted away in the burning and shining of the "light man".
Just as he was about to disappear completely, a strange phantom suddenly appeared behind him. The phantom was wearing a black classical robe, a pointed soft hat, a wide forehead, a thin face, and a monocle made of crystal.
When Derrick regained his sight, he found that the "Chief" Colin Iliad, with gray hair and deep nasolabial folds, appeared beside him at some point.
Derrick was stunned for a moment, and then opened his mouth with some surprise: "Your Excellency 'Chief'!"
Colin nodded slightly: "We have always known that there is a problem with him, but in order to find out what the purpose of that person named Amon is, we deliberately did not directly eliminate him.
"Unfortunately, until today, he was very normal, but, too normal.
"Why do you think he suddenly mutated and suddenly tried to penetrate the seal? What do you think is the difference between you and others?"

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 346: Mr. Fool Shows His Power (Bonus 10)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
If it were old hands like Alger, Hobert, or Klein, they would realize upon hearing the word "Chief" and his question that it was definitely a death trap for someone with secrets like themselves.
But Derrick, after all, was inexperienced in the world, and actually seriously considered it: "Perhaps because of my pathway?"
He had just received information from "The Hanged Man" today that Amon claimed to be a descendant of the ancient Sun God, which is why he mutated?
Colin listened expressionlessly, sizing Derrick up and down for a few seconds: "What were you doing in the room just now?"
Derrick was still thinking about the relationship between the "Sun" pathway and the descendants of the ancient Sun God, and didn't immediately realize what the "Chief" was asking.
After understanding, he realized that he had just attended the Tarot Gathering! Could this be the reason?
He recalled Mr. Emperor's words: "Mr. Fool should be very interested in Amon; as far as I know, 'Marauder', 'Apprentice', and 'Seer' are adjacent pathways."
Similarly, Amon should also be "very interested" in Mr. Fool!
But of course, these thoughts could not be told to the "Chief". Derrick replied: "I was trying to practice some Beyonder abilities just now."
Derrick was just short of saying directly: "Chief", please think about my pathway! If you think carefully and seriously, you won't care what I was doing just now.
Colin quietly looked into Derrick's eyes, and after a dozen seconds, he said: "Unfortunately, what appeared just now was not Amon's main body.
"Before he appeared in your room, did you notice anything unusual?"
"No!" Derrick shook his head firmly.
For the next dozen seconds, Colin quietly looked at Derrick again, making Derrick feel hairy all over.
Just as Derrick was about to say something, the "Chief" said: "Your condition is stable, you can go back."
"Okay." Derrick breathed a sigh of relief, walked along the aisle, and left the bottom of the round tower.
After closing the door, Derrick carefully observed his surroundings for a while, sat on the edge of the bed and began to report the experience just now to "The Fool".
After the report, he felt a lot more at ease, and a wave of drowsiness came over him, so he lay down and soon fell asleep.
Not knowing if he was talking in his sleep, Derrick suddenly said in his sleep: "'The Fool'? Interesting."
...
Backlund, 15 Minsk Street.
After the Tarot Gathering, Klein first took a nap.
After waking up, he began to consider how to deal with the "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristic in his hand. This Beyonder characteristic was the trophy he obtained last week for helping "Miss Bodyguard" defeat the enemy.
Klein didn't plan to sell it immediately at the Tarot Gathering, so as not to attract the attention of the "Rose School" to the members of the Tarot Gathering.
He didn't know if he could sell it at the Tarot Gathering. After all, the Beyonder characteristics of the "Prisoner" pathway were not very useful, and it was obviously difficult to get rid of them.
At this moment, he heard a prayer from above the "Gray Fog".
Returning to the "Gray Fog", Klein saw that the star representing "The Sun" was expanding, spreading its spirituality, and he heard the prayer of Little Sun, learning about what happened at the bottom of the round tower.
Klein also had a similar guess to "The Sun", that it was likely that the other party had noticed the Tarot Gathering, noticed "The Fool" pulling people in a secretive way, and suddenly became abnormal.
This made Klein couldn't help but gasp. It was the first time he had encountered someone who could detect the aura of the gray fog, and he also felt the horror of Amon.
Klein believed that Amon would never be so easily eliminated. He spread his spirituality to the star of "The Sun", wanting to see if there were any abnormalities in "Little Sun".
With just one glance, Klein's eyes froze.
A transparent and illusory figure was wrapped around "The Sun". He had hands and feet, but twisted around "The Sun" like a python.
In the hazy picture, one could vaguely see that the illusory figure was wearing a black classical robe, a black pointed soft hat, and a monocle made of crystal on his face.
"The Sun" was completely unaware of all this.
Even Klein, who had seen many strange events, was taken aback by the other party's strange methods, and vaguely understood the other party's purpose: to "reside" in "The Sun's" spiritual body, waiting for the next Tarot Gathering, and sneak into the "Gray Fog" without anyone knowing. At that time, my control over this mysterious space might be stripped away!
Then Klein realized that he had to respond, either find a way to completely eliminate Amon from "The Sun's" body, or temporarily exclude "The Sun" from the Tarot Gathering.
Having already read "The Book of Secrets", Klein quickly thought of a way: Prying the power of this gray mist should be able to solve Amon.
He needed Little Sun to cooperate in the "Secret Rite", and he also needed a tool to pry the gray mist.
Klein's eyes turned to the "Blasphemy Card" that Hobert had "bribed" him with. According to his previous research, although the "Blasphemy Card" had no mystical effects, its rank was quite high and it could be used as a tool to control the gray fog.
He deduced it several times in his mind, and after confirming that there were no mistakes, he responded to "Little Sun": "I know.
"I have something for you to do, to test whether this ritual is effective."
Klein simply waited on the gray mist. Soon, the ritual on "Little Sun's" side began, and Klein immediately felt that this gray mist had established a closer connection with "Little Sun".
Immediately afterwards, the entire mysterious space trembled slightly, and the static gray-white mist showed obvious flow. The crimson star corresponding to "The Sun" shone brightly.
Without spreading his spirituality, Klein could see "The Sun" closing his eyes and praying.
The transparent figure on "The Sun" raised his head back and looked upwards, the crystal monocle flashing slightly.
He stretched out a hand, slowly grabbing towards the edge of the red star, even though his hand was rapidly withering, it did not affect his determination to grab the edge of the star.
Klein's eyes narrowed. In his opinion, it was like Sadako crawling from a blood-red well to the gray mist!
He quickly carried out the next plan, took the "Death Card" to suppress the power of this mysterious space being pried, and at that moment, he felt the surging power above the gray mist begin to submit to his own spirituality.
But there was still a lack of guidance. After a little thought, Klein immediately had a way. He conjured a paper doll and used the "Death Card" to surround the surging power around the paper doll.
Suddenly, a tall figure with a pale white light appeared in front of Klein. A pair of wings grew out of the figure's back, a full twelve pairs!
The tall figure became sacred and full of the aura of death. The figure moved forward and overlapped with the red star of "The Sun".
Suddenly, the illusory figure on "The Sun" quickly lost its vitality, his skin turned pale and festered with muscles, and soon only a skeleton composed of white bones remained.
But he still did not yield, still staring upwards with his protruding eyeballs.
Until the bones of the skeleton broke, collapsed in the illusion, until the monocle shattered and disappeared into the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - 347 The Curse of the Nighthawk (Bonus 11)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Derrick seemed to see a tall figure, filled with the aura of death and shimmering with a ghastly white light that could turn everything in the world to ash, appearing beside Mr. Fool.
Behind Him were pairs of enormous wings, twelve pairs in all!
An Archangel!
Derrick recalled the relevant lessons, the colors shimmering on this Archangel were very similar to those possessed by powerful undead, a terrifying radiance that robbed one of all joy. Could this be an Archangel of the "Death" pathway?
Indeed, beside the Fool, there were angels serving Him.
The tall angelic figure stepped forward, as if disappearing into the void.
Derrick immediately realized that he now possessed many of the weaknesses of undead creatures, as well as knowledge of undead magic.
There was also some knowledge he couldn't understand, such as towering, hidden pyramid-shaped tombs.
Just as he was savoring this knowledge, an image appeared in his mind.
Although the image was somewhat blurry, Derrick could still make out that the person in the picture was himself.
His gaze sharpened: What is that blurry figure wrapped around me? How did I not notice it? A black classical robe and pointed hat, and a monocle made of crystal! It's Amon, or rather, an Avatar of Amon!
Immediately afterward, a tall angelic figure exuding an aura of death pounced on Amon's phantom. Amon's illusory figure rapidly lost its vitality, its flesh began to rot, and finally, even its bones seemed to crumble weakly, leaving nothing behind.
"That Amon didn't die! He evaded the sealed artifact at the bottom of the Round Tower and the attention of 'Chief' and parasitized my spirit body!" Derrick's eyes suddenly widened:
"Mr. Fool discovered it and eliminated him!"
Derrick's heart, which had been hanging in suspense, finally landed: "Praise you, great Mr. Fool!"
Then, his throat felt a little uncomfortable. He drank a few sips of water, but it didn't help. The discomfort continued to increase, and he began to cough violently, coughing as if his internal organs were about to rupture.
Derrick couldn't stand up from the coughing and bent over until his throat tickled, and he coughed up a translucent little worm.
It was the length of a thumb, with rings nested within rings, dividing itself into many segments.
Derrick stared at the little worm in his hand for a while. He looked around to see if anything was amiss, then hid the little worm, planning to ask the other members about this little worm at the next gathering.
...
Above the gray fog, Klein, seeing that "Little Sun" was fine, returned to the real world with peace of mind.
Klein first recalled the "Mystical Ritual" just now, and then thought about how just an Avatar of Amon had stirred up the City of Silver and the Tarot Club, causing chaos. If it were the main body, how powerful would it be?
As he thought, he began to consider the "Magician"'s acting principles, spending a fulfilling afternoon in constant thought and deduction.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Bugas City.
While Klein was saving Little Sun, Hobert asked for scissors and paper from the front desk, preparing to cut out a few more paper figures.
In yesterday's battle, he used "Paper Substitute" for the first time.
To be honest, he was a little envious of Klein. This ability was really useful!
Although the "Faceless Necklace"'s "Paper Substitute" ability could not be used continuously, Hobert still planned to keep a few paper figures on his body for emergencies.
The two paper figures he carried with him were made by Jessica when he was in Backlund. Although they were a bit abstract, it didn't affect normal use.
A dozen minutes later, Hobert looked at the "paper figure" in front of him: What the heck am I cutting? I was even embarrassed to laugh at Jessica before. At least the paper figure she cut out looked like a "person", but what I cut out...
He suddenly thought of a "curse": Nighthawks are all bad at crafts.
"Am I, an outsider, so deeply affected by this curse?"
Forget it. Hobert thought: When I get to my fief, I'll have servants to help me cut them. If I use the paper figures I cut out, it might even affect the effect of "Paper Substitute", after all, as a "substitute", it doesn't look like a paper "person" at all.
When returning the scissors to the front desk, Hobert chatted with the landlady.
After learning that the hotel also provided paid meals, Hobert generously ordered a dinner for 6 copper Lire and a breakfast for 1 copper Lire the next day.
The landlady's attitude towards Hobert immediately became three points more enthusiastic. At this time, it was much easier for Hobert to inquire about the situation in the southern mountainous area of ​​Colson County.
According to the landlady, many nobles in the southern mountainous area were not in their own fiefs. The bandits there were more like the rulers of those territories. They did all kinds of evil, vying for territory and often engaging in large-scale armed fights.
In addition, the southern mountainous area was not cut off from Bugas City. Some small steamships were still running on this route, transporting some goods to the mountainous area.
A steamship captain had just checked into the hotel this afternoon. The landlady suggested that Hobert ask the captain if he was willing to take a guest into the mountainous area, which would be faster than walking and riding a horse.
Hobert took out a silver Lire with a beautiful luster and asked the landlady to introduce him. The landlady immediately agreed.
Perhaps because of this 1 silver Lire, the landlady, who was in her forties and still had charm, mysteriously said: "There is another piece of news that I only tell you, don't tell others.
"There are many monsters living in Full Moon Lake in the mountainous area. I heard that when the full moon comes, the monsters come out of the lake to snatch the livestock of the residents on the shore. It is said that they also like human flesh and blood. If you go to the mountainous area, you must stay away from Full Moon Lake."
Hobert was slightly stunned: My fief is on one side of Full Moon Lake, how can I stay away?
Originally, he was about to believe that there were monsters in Full Moon Lake, but thinking that the landlady said "I only tell you" when she opened her mouth, this news seemed a bit hearsay.
When Hobert went to the restaurant for dinner at the designated time, he saw Wayne Vernal, the captain of a small steamship with a messy beard.
After the landlady's introduction, Wayne knew Hobert's purpose and spread out five fingers: "5 silver Lire, you have your own cabin, but it's not very big."
Hobert nodded: "No problem, I'll pay before I disembark."
After agreeing on the price, the two chatted. Coincidentally, Wayne was a resident of Jeffery Town, but now it's still called Wright Town. Wright was the surname of the previous Viscount.
However, Wayne was unwilling to say more about the internal situation of the mountainous area. He only said: "The area around Full Moon Lake is a hell! City people like you may not be able to stay for even a minute."
This made Hobert even more curious about what kind of place his territory was.
The next morning, after Hobert had dinner, he followed Wayne to the port and saw the small steamship "Hippopotamus".
The hull was only the size of two locomotives, which was indeed not very big for a steamship.

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 348 The Unrestrained Kindness of the Church of Mother Earth (Bonus 12)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Wayne led Hobert down the narrow aisle to the door of a cabin.
Hobert heard the sounds of a man and woman having sex inside. Wayne rudely hammered on the door with his fist: "How many times have I told you not to bring women into the guest rooms?"
"Sorry, Uncle, I, I'll be done right away."
The young man inside kept his word and finished quickly.
The cabin door opened, and a charming woman in bright clothes and light makeup walked out, adjusting her skirt.
She was not shy about the two men standing at the door. Instead, she solicited business, especially from Hobert, who looked fair-skinned and handsome, saying she would give Hobert a discount.
She only left when Wayne waved his hand impatiently.
Then a young man came out, fastening his belt and wearing a flattering smile. Wayne introduced him as his nephew, Seel, who worked as a helper on the ship.
Seeing that there was a guest on this return trip, Seel immediately said, "I'll change the sheets for you right away."
Hobert had originally wanted to go back to the deck to avoid this temporarily, but then he thought that this was the life of the lower class in this era, and there was nothing to avoid.
The so-called guest cabin was just a small cabin with only enough room for a bed and a chair. Fortunately, there was a window, so the cabin didn't feel stuffy.
However, this window was just slightly above the water surface, giving people a feeling of suffocation.
Although Seel changed the sheets, the room still had a musty smell.
Hobert didn't have any psychological barriers, but he wasn't willing to sit on the bed right away.
Wayne instructed: "No matter who asks you along the way, you say you are a crew member on the ship. Remember, if you let it slip, you will have to pay for the extra money."
Hobert nodded first, then asked, "Why do you say that?"
"You'll know when you get into the mountains."
Wayne turned around and began to busy himself with firing up the boiler, oiling the steam engine, and preparing to set sail.
Hobert sat in the chair, listening to the voices of the uncle and nephew as they worked and talked.
Wayne asked: "Didn't you say that the slut was asking for a high price? Why did you still go to her?"
"But she's good-looking, and that moaning sound, by the Earth Mother, I feel like my legs are still shaking."
"You're useless. Next time I'll take you into the city and go to the 'House of Pleasure' so you can see what a real woman is."
"..."
Hobert thought: As an uncle, shouldn't you be stopping your nephew from this kind of behavior? Why are you taking him?
Then he realized that he had been in this world for so long, but his values were still somewhat out of sync with the people of this world.
Hobert had mainly been in contact with conservative Loen gentlemen before. After leaving Backlund, he felt that he was seeing the true face of this world.
At about nine o'clock, with a dull whistle, the "Hippo" officially set sail.
On the not-so-spacious deck of the "Hippo", there were many goods that had been fixed yesterday. Behind the ship, a raft-like structure was connected with iron chains, and it was also neatly filled with goods.
In addition, a live goat was tied to the raft, bleating. Hobert didn't know if it was food or some local custom for boatmen.
Seel worked hard in the cabin to add coal to the boiler. Wayne in the driver's cab above carefully steered away from the port, cursing almost every other sentence, not knowing whether he was cursing the other ships or Seel.
Hobert sighed. He didn't expect his first boat trip to begin with some swear words that he couldn't quite understand with his current Highlander language level, as well as Seel adding coal and the steam engine turning.
Because it was downstream, the ship quickly accelerated. After more than two hours of sailing, there were some hills on both sides of the river, which soon turned into continuous mountains. They officially entered the mountains.
Hobert occasionally went to the deck for some fresh air, but the deck was too narrow, and the river surface in winter was very cold. He stayed in the cabin most of the time.
The boiler was also in the cabin under the deck, so there was no need to worry about heating. Hobert was even sweating a little.
The steamboat continued to sail until dusk, when the boat actually began to dock.
Hobert came to the driver's cab and asked, "Have we reached our destination?"
Wayne said with a cold face, "We have to pay taxes to those bastards!"
He glanced at Hobert: "Remember, just say you are a helper on the ship."
Hobert was stunned. Although he had seen houses on both sides of the river, he didn't expect that there were county government officials collecting taxes here.
Soon, the steamboat approached a simple port. At this time, many people were already standing on the wooden dock. Hobert first saw a person in a bishop's robe standing proudly on the dock, while the others on the dock were either kneeling or bowing.
Hobert was stunned again: Is this the custom here? Just collecting taxes, and they are kneeling and bowing, is it necessary to be so polite?
"Mother Goddess be praised, Seel, am I seeing things right? Is that a bishop?" Wayne asked in surprise.
"Yes, Uncle." Seel was even a little surprised: "A bishop has appeared in Southern Coulson (the local name for the southern part of Coulson County). The light of the Lord has returned."
Hobert then realized that the people on the dock were paying their respects to the bishop of the Earth Mother Church.
As soon as the ship docked, Wayne and Seel almost immediately jumped onto the dock, repeatedly asking the bishop for blessings.
The bishop was a middle-aged man who looked very amiable. He smiled and blessed the uncle and nephew, then asked Hobert on the ship, "Are you Baron Hobert?"
Wayne was surprised. He didn't expect that this passenger, who looked well-dressed, was actually a nobleman! But where was his honor guard? Why wasn't he wearing noble attire?
Hobert nodded: "May I ask who you are?"
"I finally caught up with you. I didn't expect you to travel by water." The bishop smiled and introduced himself: "I am Bishop Simpson. We have received the goodwill you conveyed through Bishop Utravsky. Can we go ashore and talk as we walk?"
"Of course." Hobert jumped ashore, not expecting the Earth Mother Church to react so quickly, and even send a bishop to extend goodwill to him.
The people on the dock watched Bishop Simpson and the young Baron leave, then began to discuss why the Bishop was here.
The people who were originally standing on the dock, as if afraid that Wayne and his nephew would run away, grabbed them and asked questions.
On the other side, Hobert walked along the riverbank with Bishop Simpson.
Simpson said: "I heard that you want to build a church on the side of Full Moon Lake in your territory, and you hope that we can send a bishop?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, you have also seen the enthusiasm of the locals. I think the church should continue to spread the light of the Earth Mother here."
Bishop Simpson suddenly smiled bitterly: "We withdrew from the mountains because we would be polluted here."

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 349: Corruption of the High Level (Bonus 13)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Cr0w for gifting a membership! Someone will advance to Sequence 9: Reader soon, +5 bonus]
Hobert paused for a few seconds before reacting: "Are you saying that Full Moon Lake, or rather, South Colson, has contamination affecting Beyonders?"
"No, only we are easily contaminated!" Bishop Simpson said, "Even ordinary Mother Goddess missionaries, if they stay near Full Moon Lake for too long, their faith will become strange."
"Currently, Beyonders of other pathways won't be contaminated as long as they don't get close to the center of Full Moon Lake."
Hobert guessed: "Could there be a sealed artifact of the 'Planter' pathway in the lake?"
Bishop Simpson glanced at Hobert: "It seems you have extensive knowledge of mysticism, which saves me some explanation."
He sighed and added: "The Church has sensed your goodwill, but we also have our difficulties. The Archbishop has approved me to tell you this secret, hoping you can understand our difficulties in withdrawing from here."
Hobert nodded slightly, listening attentively.
Bishop Simpson organized his words: "The whole thing started 58 years ago, on a summer night. According to the locals, the red moon that day seemed particularly crimson.
"Around midnight, a meteorite fell from the sky and crashed into Full Moon Lake. Initially, there were not many casualties, only a lot of crops were flooded.
"But the next day after the disaster, the clergy in southern Colson County, to be precise, the Church's Beyonders, lost control one after another.
"An Archbishop who was sent to solve this problem was also contaminated. To this day, this Archbishop still dares not leave the 'Fountain of Life'.
"If it hadn't caught up with you here, I wouldn't have continued forward. We will send another missionary to contact you."
"Fountain of Life", like "Chasm of Storms" and "Tenebrous Heaven", is the headquarters of the Earth Mother Church, and also the divine kingdom of the Earth Mother when the gods were still on land.
The power of this contamination exceeded Hobert's imagination. He didn't expect that even a Saint would be contaminated.
Simpson continued: "Soon, some fish-like monsters appeared in Full Moon Lake, attacking merchant ships and cargo ships passing by. Moreover, those ships that passed through the center of Full Moon Lake also experienced various strange things in their subsequent journeys.
"For example, some crew members would profess their love to the beer barrels or the boxes containing goods on the cargo ship, hoping to do something beyond friendship.
"For example, some crew members suddenly grew wheat ears on their heads, and the wound would bleed non-stop after cutting them off."
Hobert's first thought was that this seemed to belong to the authority of "Moon" and "Mother".
Bishop Simpson continued: "In short, these bizarre events seriously affected shipping. The Feynapotter royal family sent three groups of people one after another to try to solve this problem, but without exception, they were contaminated after investigating the central location of Full Moon Lake.
"One of the 'Law Enforcers' was also contaminated and lost control as a result, causing huge losses to the royal family.
"Later, Duke Oliver Latin of the royal family and our Pope decided to join forces to solve this matter, but they also failed!"
Hobert couldn't hide his surprise: "They both failed!"
The Pope must be an angel, and the royal duke is likely to be an angel like Duke Southville of the Loen Kingdom.
Two angels failed to solve this matter.
"Yes." Simpson smiled wryly again: "The Pope's investigation result of Full Moon Lake is: It's not difficult to solve, but it can't be solved."
Hobert chewed on this sentence: "Not difficult to solve" means they can completely solve it, but why "can't it be solved"?
"So we can only abandon the mountainous area of Coelson County." Bishop Simpson continued to explain: "Both the Church and the royal family made a planned withdrawal.
"Since then, the royal family has ordered the blockade of this convenient waterway, and instead used the Yawy River in the west to transport goods and passengers from the port to the capital."
Hobert asked: "What about the residents here?"
The Bishop replied: "Ordinary people will not be contaminated by Full Moon Lake."
Hobert was stunned: "I have read the 'Holy Book of Life' at Bishop Utravsky's place. I remember the 'Bible' depicts that all life is equal, right?"
Bishop Simpson smiled: "That's right, this is the essence of the 'Holy Book of Life'. It seems you have read the 'Bible' carefully."
Hobert thought to himself: I'm not discussing academic issues with you.
Immediately, he realized that, for the Church and the royal family, they had no legal responsibility or guilt for abandoning the believers and people here and withdrawing.
Hobert finally understood: This is the "way to govern the world" in this world. The Church and the royal family seem to think that we have tried our best, but we have not solved the problem. Sorry, we have to withdraw. We have fulfilled our responsibilities. As for what impact this decision has on the people, it is not within our scope of responsibility. You can completely follow us, but you don't go together, what can we do?
Hobert smiled. Although he had never tasted the bitterness of leaving his hometown, just thinking about it made Hobert feel Bewildered and insecure. Especially in this era of relying on one's own small plot of land for survival, how big a disaster would leaving one's hometown be?
However, Hobert did not continue to discuss this issue with Bishop Simpson, but asked: "In other words, only after the contamination of Full Moon Lake is resolved will you send a bishop here?"
Bishop Simpson nodded: "Yes, but I don't have any hope for this.
"Therefore, I also brought some information about Colson County to show our sincerity."
Hobert nodded: "Please speak."
"Many of the bandit gangs here are peripheral organizations of the Theosophy Order. It is said that the Theosophy Order has a considerable stronghold in the mountainous area," Simpson said:
"In addition, according to reliable news, traces of the Blood Sanctify Sect have appeared in the mountainous area, seemingly members of the Andariel family.
"It is said that the Aurora Order also has a small stronghold here, but its power is not as strong as the Theosophy Order and the Blood Sanctify Sect.
"Currently, there are a total of four Barons and one Viscount still in their fiefdoms in the mountainous area. They have various backgrounds. Some are the last symbol of the royal family's influence on this land, some are our partners, and some are said to have already joined those secret organizations."
Hobert had the urge to cover his face: The situation in this mountainous area is too complicated! After the royal family and the Church withdrew, this place has completely become a place to hide dirt and filth!
Simpson finally said: "However, they are all secret organizations. As long as you don't actively provoke them, they won't cause you trouble."
Hobert smiled: "I am not comforted."
He paused and said: "I have my own messenger. If I have any questions I want to ask you, can I write to you?"
"Of course." Bishop Simpson left a mailbox address: "I will also reply to you with my messenger."

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 350: God's Favored One Hobert (Bonus 14)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After unloading some cargo, the "Hippopotamus" set sail again.
After it was completely dark, Wayne stopped Seel from adding more coal. By about nine o'clock in the evening, the steamboat was basically gliding forward.
Wayne and his nephew were noticeably more respectful to Hobert, perhaps because they knew he was a nobleman, perhaps because the Bishop had taken the initiative to invite Hobert for a conversation, or perhaps both.
Although there were no churches of the Earth Mother in the mountains, the people here seemed to have an even more devout belief in the Earth Mother.
The people on the dock who were preparing to collect taxes were not actually tax collectors from the county government, but local bandits.
They clearly knew that Hobert was a passenger, but they did not collect any extra fees. According to Wayne, normally each passenger would have to pay 5 silver Solas as "tax."
In Hobert's view, this was simply robbery.
Now, when Hobert asked about the situation in Jeffrey Town, Wayne would answer honestly.
Firstly, Hobert knew that although it was now the middle of winter, the vegetation on both sides of Full Moon Lake was still full of vitality. Flowers bloomed and fruits ripened in all seasons there, and the crops grew much faster than in other places, and the crops even grew in winter.
Secondly, there really were monsters with fish heads and limbs in Full Moon Lake. Now, no one dared to live on the shores of the lake anymore. People had to guard the shore every day, and as soon as a monster appeared, they would ring the alarm bell. The knight would lead the villagers to fight the monsters, and many fertile farmlands on both sides of Full Moon Lake had been abandoned as a result.
People were often injured or bitten to death in the fighting. Seel's father died of his injuries after being scratched by a monster.
For the past six years, the residents of Jeffrey Town had truly lived a hellish life. After being exploited by the two knights in the territory, they had to be exploited again by the "lord" in the mountains.
The entire South Colson knew that the harvest around Full Moon Lake was abundant, but very little of it actually ended up in the hands of the people. Many people even lived in hunger and cold.
And the so-called "lord" was the bandits who killed Viscount Wright six years ago. They had never been punished, but instead had become the rulers of this area.
As the saying goes, "If the upper beam is not straight, the lower beam will be crooked." The rulers of this area had obtained their power through immoral and illegal means, and the people under their rule had gradually become immoral as well.
At the end of the conversation, Seel's eyes sparkled: "Noble Lord, are you a chosen one of the Earth Mother? Are you here to end the dark age here?"
Hobert was slightly stunned, then smiled and said, "Although I have not received direct guidance from the Mother, perhaps my coming here is truly the Mother's arrangement, just like the stories of those saints in the 'Holy Bible of Life'."
He tried to "do as the Romans do." Even if some decisions were his own initiative, he could claim that they were God's arrangement.
Hobert smiled in his heart: Heh heh, this way I can shift a lot of responsibility to God. Sure enough, shirking responsibility can make people happy.
After ending this conversation, Hobert returned to the so-called cabin, lay on the bed, and looked at the dark ceiling, thinking about his conversation with Bishop Simpson in the evening.
He first thought of that "Imperative Mage" who had been corrupted and had caused some losses to the royal family.
Hobert remembered that Christian had mentioned this information in Backlund, but he had only heard of this level of information and did not know that the royal family had also sent angels to try to solve this problem.
Then the sentence "It's not difficult to solve, but it can't be solved" appeared in Hobert's mind again.
After thinking for a while, he still had no clue.
When Hobert went to the deck to relieve his bloating, he glanced at the crimson moon above his head and suddenly thought of another description from Simpson: "...According to the locals, the red moon that day seemed particularly crimson."
Hobert suddenly felt something. He understood what the problem was.
Sure enough, when he returned to the cabin, locked the door, and entered the "Nation of Disorder," the knowledge that he had "left behind" here immediately made him understand what was going on:
The meteorite that fell into Full Moon Lake was very likely an Outer God, and there was a good chance that it was an invasion of Earth by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity"
For unknown reasons, the "shield" above South Colson that day seemed to have a certain loophole, so the crimson moon looked particularly crimson.
The "Mother Goddess" took advantage of this opportunity to project some power to the ground with a meteorite.
Logically speaking, it should not be difficult to seal these powers, but because this was an Outer God, or rather, a Pillar's corruption, its status was extremely high, causing the two angels to fail.
Perhaps only a True God could seal it, but now the seven True Gods were all in the Astral World, and the Earth Mother simply had no time to take care of this.
Even if the Earth Mother had time, She might hide far away, after all, Lilith had already been burned by the "Mother Goddess" once, and would definitely not give the "Mother Goddess" another chance to corrupt Her.
Hobert could be so sure that it was the "Mother Goddess's" corruption, in addition to Bishop Simpson's description of the crimson moon, also because the Beyonders of the "Planter" pathway in South Colson were more likely to be corrupted.
Even ordinary missionaries of the Earth Mother Church would gradually change from worshiping the "Earth Mother" to worshiping the "Mother Goddess" if they stayed here for too long.
After understanding this problem, Hobert suddenly realized that he might have a way to solve the problem in Full Moon Lake!
The two angels had said that the problem was not difficult to solve, but they lacked the Sequence.
And what Hobert lacked the least was a high Sequence!
Even if he was corrupted, he only needed to enter the "Nation of Disorder" once and listen to the sound of the "Bell of Order" to easily solve it.
However, before solving this problem, he still needed to be cautious, observe for a period of time, and find a more stable method before taking action.
Returning to the real world, Hobert fell asleep in the sound of water and the gently rocking cabin.
The next journey was very peaceful. The "Hippopotamus" docked three more times and paid taxes three times.
The cargo on the deck and rafts gradually decreased, and finally began to head to the last stop, Jeffrey Town, which was also Wright Town in Wayne and his nephew's words.
Hobert paid the fare, but Wayne resolutely refused to accept it.
Hobert took back 2 silver Solas and pushed the remaining 3 silver Solas to Wayne: "Help me find a butler."
Wayne then accepted the 3 silver Solas. He thought for a while before saying: "York and Philip are both more suitable.
"York is a well-known clever fellow in town, and Philip used to work in the Wright Viscount's mansion."
Hobert nodded: "Notify York to come and find me in a while."
Wayne nodded repeatedly: "As soon as the boat docks, I'll have Seel notify him. Lord, look, Full Moon Lake is here."
The scene in front suddenly opened up, and a relatively regular circular lake appeared in front of Hobert.
As Wayne had said before, even though it was winter, there was still a pleasing green color on both sides of the lake.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 351: About Hobert's "Miracle" (Bonus 15)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After entering Full Moon Lake, Wayne immediately turned the rudder and sailed along the shallows by the lake, saying that if he went through the center of the lake, something terrible would happen.
And walking on the shallows requires caution, as you can easily "run aground" if you're not careful.
Wayne slowed down the boat and, while carefully steering, shouted to Seel, "Go get the sheep!"
Hobert took the opportunity to ask the question in his heart: "Why bring a live sheep on the boat?"
Wayne stared ahead, not taking his eyes off the front, and said, "If we encounter a monster in the lake in the shallows, it may crash or capsize the boat. As soon as you see a monster, throw the sheep into the lake, so they will be busy eating the sheep and won't bother us."
Hobert nodded, it sounded like running a boat here was more dangerous than on the high seas.
"Mon, mon, monster!" Seel shouted, pointing to the center of the lake.
Wayne roared, "We're not blind! You son of a bitch... kill the sheep quickly!"
There were a few swear words in the middle, which once again exceeded Hobert's understanding.
He looked towards the center of the lake, and on the slightly rippling surface, there was indeed a behemoth rushing towards them.
The monster looked like a large crocodile, but it had a head similar in shape to a carp, with scales on its body, and it seemed to have strong limbs.
Seel's hand holding the knife trembled so badly that he couldn't find the large blood vessel in the goat's neck after trying twice, which made the goat want to cry.
"What are you trembling about!" Wayne rushed out of the cockpit and was about to snatch the knife to kill the sheep himself.
At this moment, Hobert, who had been standing on the deck, suddenly said, "No need to kill it, the monster is swimming away."
He concluded in his mind: Monsters have very low intelligence and it is easy to distort their goals and intentions.
Clang~
The knife for killing the sheep fell to the ground, and Wayne knelt on the ground: "Your Excellency, you are truly a devotee of the Earth Mother! Even monsters avoid you."
He had encountered monsters many times in the lake, but he had never encountered a situation where a monster suddenly left during a hunt.
Wayne grabbed Seel from the side and made him kneel down as well: "You should still be missing a manservant. My nephew is quite clever and diligent. Let him be your manservant."
The well-informed Wayne knew that he had met a noble, but unfortunately he only had two daughters. If he had a son, he would immediately let him be a manservant to this noble.
Hobert asked Seel, who was kneeling on the ground belatedly, "Are you willing to be my servant?"
"The Goddess's blessed! I am willing, I am willing to follow you forever, to serve you forever," Seel said excitedly.
Hobert nodded: "The first two months are a trial period. During the trial period, it's 3 silver Solas per week. After that, I will increase your salary depending on your performance. Also, call me Your Excellency or Lord."
This salary is only about 5.5 Solas per week, but in this remote place, there is nowhere to spend money. 3 silver Solas is the salary Seel receives for helping on Wayne's boat, which is said to be the highest salary in Wright Town.
Wayne was happy to see that His Excellency had accepted Seel, so he hurried back to drive the boat.
After landing on the dilapidated dock, Hobert looked around and saw that many of the fertile fields by the river were indeed overgrown with reeds.
Seel packed up a bit and helped Hobert carry his bag to the Viscount's residence.
After passing through a reed field, they gradually encountered some town residents working in the fields. When everyone saw a well-dressed stranger, they gathered around to ask Seel who that was.
The residents' accents had some local dialects, and Hobert had to listen carefully to understand what they were saying.
Seel puffed out his chest and said, "This is our new Lord, a devotee of the gods. From now on, this place will be renamed Jeffrey Town!"
Everyone was a little surprised. Like the surrounding territories, once there was no Lord, they never welcomed a new Lord again. Some places had not had a Lord for more than fifty years.
Hobert did not reject Seel calling him "The Goddess's Blessed." He learned from Seel that when Viscount Wright was alive, there was still a school in the town, but now, the school had been abandoned for several years.
In such a territory, the title "Goddess's Blessed" was far more useful than "Lord."
Seel was a little regretful that he had to follow closely behind His Excellency, otherwise he would have boasted about the "miracle" he encountered in the lake just now.
Since the Wright family was killed, there had been no owner there. When Hobert opened the door and entered, it felt like entering a haunted house.
Facing the weed-filled house, Hobert ordered, "Clean up a room, I want to stay tonight."
Seel put down Hobert's bag and immediately found a room with doors and windows. The furniture inside was long gone. Seel drew a few buckets of water from the well in the backyard and cleaned the room first.
Then he came out and asked, "Your Excellency, the old carpenter Ted in town sells furniture. Would you like to buy some furniture for you?"
Hobert nodded: "A bed, a desk, a chair. Let him deliver them and I will pay him later."
Seel was quick and soon returned with a few people carrying several pieces of furniture, and he also bought new quilts, pillows and other necessities on credit for Hobert.
At the same time, a man in his thirties who looked very shrewd came with him.
The man was dressed decently. He took off his somewhat old but clean top hat and said respectfully, "Your Excellency, I am York. I heard from Seel that you intend to hire me as your butler?"
"That's right." Hobert was very satisfied with this manservant, Seel: "Two months of probation, with a weekly salary of 5 silver Solas during the probation period. After two months, a new weekly salary will be determined based on your ability."
York was overjoyed: "Your Excellency, I am happy to serve you."
Hobert threw him a purse: "From now on, you are the butler. There are 80 silver Solas in here. Go pay the bills first. You will be responsible for the expenses of the mansion in the future. Bring me the accounts every week."
When he exchanged gold Lires before, he exchanged two bags of 1 silver Solas coins. After these few days of travel, he found that silver Soles were indeed the most used currency.
The people around, including York, were stunned for a second or two. In this remote place, 80 silver Solas was a huge sum of money.
While everyone was sighing at the new Lord's wealth, they quickly went about their business.
York suggested to Hobert that he hire two or three more manservants tomorrow, hire a cook, and then prepare to repair the mansion.
Hobert nodded and agreed to each of them.
In the evening, Hobert asked Seel to buy some food in the town, and had a casual dinner.
York and Seel had nowhere to live in the "Lord's Mansion", so after Seel boiled water for Hobert to wash his feet, the two left the Lord's Mansion and returned to their homes.
After nightfall, there were no lights in the town. After confirming that there was no one outside, York left his yard with a bag on his back and went straight to the dock.
When he arrived at the wooden dock, he found that Wayne's boat was still lit, which was great!
Jumping onto the boat, York pulled out a dagger and pointed it at Wayne, who was busy in the cabin: "Take me to Bugas City, quickly! Otherwise, I'll kill you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 352: Hobert Establishes His Authority (Bonus 16)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Wayne, who was stoking the furnace in the cabin, was startled to see York: "You, you really came?"
York was taken aback: "What do you mean?"
As he spoke, he touched the money bag hidden on his waist, and he immediately felt confident.
A weekly salary of 5 silver Solas is indeed a generous job, but who knows how long this lord can live? In a few days, the "lord" living in the mountains will come to collect taxes. How can a lord alone be a match for those people?
I'm afraid I'll only get a week's salary. If I don't leave here, this bag of money will only benefit the "lord" in the mountains.
However, York could understand Wayne's surprise, but what did Wayne's words mean?
Wayne glanced at the position of the passenger cabin, and then smiled: "Sorry, my boat won't leave until the day after tomorrow."
York shook the dagger in his hand: "Then don't blame me for being rude."
Wayne picked up the fire hook: "Others may be afraid of you, but I'm not."
York found it strange, why was Wayne so tough tonight?
Just as he was about to rush up and teach Wayne a lesson, the door of the passenger cabin opened, and Hobert, wearing a noble's cloak, walked out step by step: "Steward York, where are you going with these public funds so late at night?"
Seel tactfully moved a chair out for Hobert to sit on.
York looked at Hobert sitting unhurriedly on the chair, and an invisible pressure made him take a few steps back.
But the money bag on his waist gave him new courage. He sneered: "My uncle used to be a guard in the Viscount's mansion. I learned fighting from him. The three of you are no match for me..."
Wayne and Seel only saw the lord get up, and then a black light flashed. York's arm holding the dagger had already flown to the boiler.
Looking at the lord again, he only had a cane in his hand that looked a little longer and thicker.
"Ah!" York screamed and fell to the ground, clutching his severed arm.
Hobert winked at Seel, who went over and searched York's waist for the money bag, and handed it to the lord with both hands.
At this time, the young man was extremely excited: just like his uncle said, following such a lord, I will have a future.
Hobert took the money bag, counted out 10 silver Solas, and threw them to York, who was rolling on the floor of the cabin in pain: "You're fired, these 10 silver Solas are your severance pay!"
He threw another 1 silver Solas to Wayne: "Clean up the cabin yourself."
Blood gushed from York's arm, spilling everywhere.
Then, Hobert quickly left the cabin, quickly left the dock, and disappeared into the night.
At this time, the uncle and nephew in the cabin looked at York, who was lying on the ground screaming.
Seel said: "Let's throw him into the lake. The smell of blood will attract monsters and they will eat him."
York endured the severe pain: "No, don't..."
The knowledgeable Wayne said: "The lord didn't kill him, why would you kill him?"
"I also find it strange, why didn't the lord kill him."
"Idiot, you have to be smarter when you follow the lord in the future. The lord is using this dog to promote his martial virtue!" As Wayne spoke, he took out the branding iron that had been burning red in the furnace:
"Originally, I was wondering why the lord wanted me to light the furnace, and why he wanted to heat the branding iron red."
As he spoke, he stepped on York's shoulder with one foot and placed the branding iron on York's severed arm.
In the sizzling sound, in York's hoarse screams, Wayne said to himself: "So that's what it's for."
The red-hot branding iron burned the blood vessels at the severed arm, causing them to contract and shrivel, and the bleeding finally stopped.
...
Hobert returned to the Lord's Mansion and glanced at the dilapidated mansion from the roof.
The area is not small, with a front yard, a side yard, and a garden.
Building a house on such a large flat ground in the mountains is already a luxury.
Hobert returned to the somewhat cold room, took off his cloak, and after arriving at the fief, he felt that the potion showed signs of loosening.
This made Hobert once again determined that the "Baron" in "Baron of Corruption" does not refer to a fixed title, but refers to having one's own territory or domain.
Hobert remembered that the Sequence 8 "Sheriff" of the "Arbiter" pathway, the Beyonder has a certain connection with his own domain.
As for the "Black Emperor" pathway, it was not until Sequence 6 that there was a corresponding connection.
But it was just a connection. Hobert believed that even in his own territory, the "Baron of Corruption's" abilities would not be strengthened accordingly.
Lying on the bed, Hobert began to think about how to digest the potion.
Coming to the territory is the first step, and establishing one's own rule here is the second step.
Tonight's interception of York was Hobert's action to open up the situation in Jeffrey Town.
The 80 silver Solas given to York was prepared by him long ago, just to give him a test.
When York left the "Lord's Mansion" at night, Hobert knew from his expression that York had not withstood the test, so Hobert called Seel to wait for York on the boat.
And deliberately not killing York, as Wayne said, York's existence is a deterrent to the people.
In this place that has been in a state of lawlessness for six years, don't expect to use some great principles to make the people submit, you must use some means.
And Hobert's work in the AD era made him read "Records of the Grand Historian" and "Zizhi Tongjian", and he does not lack such means.
Many books read or ideas generated in the AD era were useless in that era, but they have a use in this world.
In addition to these methods, Hobert also decided to renovate the "Lord's Mansion" on a large scale, preferably making it known to everyone!
In addition, he wanted to "organize local braves" and completely control the land use rights in the territory.
Thinking about it, Hobert fell asleep.
The next morning, he looked at the dilapidated roof and once again made up his mind to repair it as soon as possible.
When he got up, Hobert was surprised to find that the potion had already shown signs of digestion!
Hobert was a little strange and began to seriously summarize what caused the potion to start digesting, but he did not summarize anything after a long time.
Until he saw Seel with two dark circles under his eyes: "Didn't sleep well yesterday?"
"Yes." Seel smiled and said: "Yesterday night when we carried York back, many people heard York's screams and came out to ask what was going on.
"Then my uncle and I started talking about the 'miracle' on the shoal yesterday, and how you expected York to defect and how you punished York several times.
"In the morning, the people in the town basically knew the lord's martial virtue!"
Seel learned the word "martial virtue" from his uncle last night. After speaking, Seel was somewhat proud. This morning, when he walked on the street, many residents of the town became respectful to him.
Hobert nodded: I see.
This is the reason why the potion is digested.
