chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 353 The Second Housekeeper Selection (Bonus 17)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Keep sending powerstones, close to 200!]
Hobert understood that letting the people in his territory know of the lord's existence was a way of digesting the "Baron" aspect of the "Baron of Corruption".
In other words, if the people in the territory acknowledged Hobert as their lord, Hobert's potion would be digested accordingly.
This method of digestion wasn't necessarily limited to his own territory. If a "Baron of Corruption" opened a factory, as long as the workers acknowledged him as the boss, his potion would be digested accordingly.
In fact, opening a factory was an easier way to digest the potion than managing a territory. After all, the workers were paid and would definitely acknowledge the boss's position.
However, the "Baron of Corruption" wasn't just about people's acknowledgment of a leader; there was also the "Corruption" aspect. "Corrupting" the minds of those around him should also be another way to digest the potion.
Or rather, "Corruption" and "Baron" had to be present simultaneously for the potion to be digested effectively.
In any case, Hobert woke up in a great mood today. He took out a copper riso from his pocket and flicked it to Seel: "A reward for you!"
Seel caught the coin: "Thank you, great Baron!"
He thought to himself: My uncle was right. The Baron really wants us to spread his fame. If something similar happens in the future, we must let everyone know!
Hobert then said to Seel: "Buy breakfast, then notify Phillip to come for an interview, and make preparations. I'm going to inspect the territory today."
Seel agreed and was about to leave when both master and servant noticed a middle-aged man peeking in at the door.
Seel smiled: "Baron, that's Phillip."
"Let him in."
Phillip had a proper appearance and was neither servile nor overbearing. He seemed to have learned etiquette, as he bowed to Hobert in a formal manner.
Hobert asked: "Who told you to come?"
Phillip lowered his head and replied: "I heard that a new Baron had arrived, so I wanted to ask if you needed a servant?
"Our family has served the Barons for three generations. Even my name was given to me by the old Viscount Wright. If you have any needs in this regard, I am at your service."
Hobert nodded. He had heard before that nobility was hereditary, and positions like butlers and senior manservants in noble families were also "hereditary".
"I was just about to have Seel look for you." Hobert smiled: "I would like to hire you as my butler."
Phillip was sincerely apprehensive: "Baron, I was only a senior manservant before. My abilities may not be sufficient to fulfill the duties of a butler."
"It doesn't matter." Hobert smiled: "You should know the responsibilities of a butler, right?"
"I do."
"That's fine then. Your probationary period is two months, with a weekly salary of 5 silver Solas during the trial period." Hobert then took out his money bag: "There are 80 silver Solas inside. You will be in charge of the manor's finances from now on, and you will submit the accounts to me for review every Monday."
Phillip declined once more before respectfully accepting the money bag.
After breakfast, Hobert took Seel to inspect his territory.
...
Backlund City Hall, 8:30 AM.
At the instruction of Earl Wolfe, the servant Quincy invited Miss Jessica into the meeting hall.
Jessica took a deep breath, preparing to face the meeting in her best condition.
As expected, as soon as she entered the venue, Gusta and the other four representatives of the Chamber of Commerce questioned Jessica's legitimacy, citing Hobert's treason.
Jessica, who had seen a lot of the world with Hobert during this time, was neither servile nor overbearing: "As far as I know, none of the laws and regulations of the Loen Kingdom stipulate that the seat that Lawyer Hobert gave me is illegal.
"Although he has been deprived of all political power in the Loen Kingdom, I have not!"
At this time, Hobert's teachers and several law professors also said: "This young lady is right!"
"We can't just let the young people be at the forefront."
"We old bones all believe that her seat is legitimate."
Jessica was very touched. She certainly knew that this was Hobert's previous persistence, which had earned the support and affirmation of the legal community for what Hobert was doing.
Gusta said to Jessica in a sinister tone: "Then be prepared to accept the investigation. I believe you are an accomplice of the traitor!"
"Whether I am an accomplice or not is not up to you to decide," Jessica retorted coldly.
In fact, she had been questioned twice last week, once by the police in a normal interrogation, and once by the other party using Beyonder powers.
Because Jessica really didn't know anything, and with the bail of Lawyer Barton, Jessica was quickly released.
But today, Jessica knew that just by appearing here, she would be confirming that she was Hobert's accomplice, and she was ready to face the coming imprisonment.
Especially after seeing the four worker representatives, she felt that what she was doing was definitely worth it.
As Jessica expected, after the meeting began, the four worker representatives couldn't understand the convoluted and grammatically complex legal clauses at all.
These were still workers with a certain level of education that the Church had found.
Without Jessica's explanation, it would be meaningless for them to come or not.
It was thanks to Jessica's explanation that the law professors listened to the workers' views and realized that many legal clauses were not applicable at all.
For example, the original compensation period was within three months, but they learned from the workers that if compensation was not received within a month after a work-related injury, the worker might starve to death. Or the worker's family would be broken, and then the worker would starve to death on the street.
In this way, the compensation would lose its payment object and would no longer need to be paid.
So the law professors withstood the enormous pressure and changed the three-month compensation period to three weeks.
The meeting lasted from morning to afternoon, and the previous bills were almost unrecognizable.
After the meeting, Jessica saw the police waiting outside. Gusta had already called the police during the meeting break. If it weren't for Earl Wolfe's obstruction, the police would have probably taken Jessica away at noon.
Faced with these police officers, who were obviously from special departments, Jessica was relieved. Just as she was about to be arrested, a man with a scar on his face, wearing a suit, stepped forward and showed his credentials to the police:
"I am Borgia of the Special Operations Department! I am under orders from my superiors to protect Lawyer Jessica. She can accept your questioning, but I must be present."
Another gentleman, wearing glasses and looking like a university professor, also showed his credentials, stating that he had received the same order.
Their credentials, in addition to the police badge, also had the emblems of the Church of the Evernight Goddess and the Church of Steam and Machinery respectively.
The following experience was more magical for Jessica.
The police, or rather the people from MI9, did question her, but the scarred face and the university professor sat beside her. The MI9 people were very polite, so polite that Jessica felt it was a bit unreal.

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 354 Jessica summons Hobert's messenger (Bonus 18)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Open Dagger for continue to act as a Sequence 9: Reader]
Jessica couldn't believe that she had been released after being questioned!
Moreover, when getting off the carriage, Scarface and the university professor each made a promise that if she encountered similar problems again, she could seek help from the Church of the Evernight Goddess or the Church of Steam and Machinery.
Jessica didn't expect that she, a wild Beyonder, would gain recognition from official Beyonders in this way!
As soon as she returned to the law firm, a colleague told Jessica that someone was looking for her.
Arriving at the reception room, Jessica saw a middle-aged man. He was wearing a scarf, obscuring his face, and she only knew that he was a large, fat man.
Jessica had a slight impression of him. She remembered that one day this fat man and several companions had waited for Lawyer Hobert at the firm.
His name seemed to be Austin.
Jessica remembered correctly. This was Austin. Upon seeing Jessica, he stood up and whispered, "If you can still contact Hobert, please warn him to be careful. Three mercenary groups have gone to the Feynapotter Kingdom to take his head for the bounty."
Before Jessica could react, Austin pushed open the door and left.
Jessica was first worried about Hobert's current situation, and then she decided to summon Hobert's messenger tonight to relay this warning.
Even if there were people from MI9 monitoring, she would still summon it, because this was a very urgent matter.
When Jessica arrived at her office, she found a letter lying on her desk.
The letter wasn't there when she left.
Picking up the letter, the envelope read: "Find a way to get this letter to him."
The "him" referred to Hobert, of course.
Holding the letter, Jessica sighed: Although Lawyer Hobert had left Backlund, his friends still cared about him.
Then she thought that the people from the Church of the Evernight Goddess and the Church of Steam and Machinery today might have protected her out of consideration for Hobert's reputation.
Jessica remembered that she had helped Hobert send letters to the two churches before.
After work, Jessica bought three discounted donuts on the way back and then went all the way to the Empress Borough, to their new residence.
The protector of the new residence was also the reason she dared to summon the messenger. Even if someone was monitoring, they would only dare to observe from a distance.
Carrie rested early today and was already recording her work insights and some inspiration.
Jessica was afraid that Carrie would worry about her, so she didn't tell Carrie about her great adventure today in advance. Now that the matter was over, Jessica told Carrie about her experiences today and her plan to summon the messenger later while eating dinner.
Carrie exclaimed, "Fortunately, you came back safely, otherwise I wouldn't know where to find you. The Church of Steam and Machinery didn't disappoint in this matter."
Carrie and Jessica were both believers of the God of Steam and Machinery.
After dinner, the two prepared the altar. After Jessica confirmed the ritual procedures with Carrie again and again, Jessica chanted the incantation in Hermes:
"I,
"In my name, I summon:
"The spirit wandering in the void, a friendly creature that can be driven, the messenger belonging solely to Hobert Jeffrey."
As soon as the incantation was finished, a gust of wind suddenly blew around the altar, the candlelight turned pale green, and the atmosphere in the entire room became strange.
Suddenly, the candlelight of one of the candles became higher and thicker, as if a phantom door opened from the candlelight, and a coffin floated out of the candlelight and stood upright in front of Jessica and Carrie.
This coffin gave the two people enormous mental pressure.
Creak~
A crack opened in the coffin, and a fair hand stretched out.
Jessica then reacted and put the letter in that hand.
But the fair hand did not retract, and after a second or two, it reminded, "Donuts."
Jessica, who was performing a similar ritual for the first time, reacted: "Oh, sorry."
She also put the donuts in that hand.
The fair hand retracted, the coffin returned to the spirit world, and the candlelight became normal.
After a long while, Carrie said, "This messenger's level is definitely very high."
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffrey Town, time returned to the morning.
Seel took Hobert to stroll around the town just below the "Lord's Manor" first. Although it was called a town, it only had three streets, one horizontal and two vertical.
Some residential houses were scattered among them. Looking down from the "Lord's Manor", the town seemed to have some scale, but when Hobert actually arrived in the town, he found that many houses were abandoned.
Nine and a half out of ten shops were closed. There was basically no activity in the town during the day.
The shop owners saluted Hobert after seeing him and confirming with Seel, and some people cursed York's betrayal and praised the Lord's fairness.
Hobert was quite satisfied with this effect.
However, after leaving the town, no one knew Hobert, and even no one knew Seel.
According to Seel's introduction, in addition to Jeffrey Town, Hobert's territory also included more than a dozen villages and the fiefs of two knights.
The villages were isolated, and after learning that there was a new lord, the villagers were respectful to Hobert, but they all showed a sense of alienation.
Hobert was not a "Spectator", but he could also see the subtext of their expressions and eyes: I hope this Lord can last a few more days.
At lunchtime, Hobert asked Seel, "Is Viscount Wright a very respected lord in everyone's eyes?"
Siel pondered for a moment before answering, "Many people miss the era of Viscount Wright's rule."
Hobert nodded. In that case, this Viscount Wright was at least a qualified lord, and any lord's rule was better than the current chaotic era, so everyone would of course miss him.
In the afternoon, they arrived at the territory of Knight Grov Duke. In this remote place, the knight's territory was just a slightly larger village.
As soon as they entered the territory, two squires with cold weapons came up to question them. After hearing that Hobert was the new lord, the two squires were full of disbelief, but one of the squires immediately went to report to the knight.
After a while, a knight in his fifties came out on a white horse. He did not dismount, but asked coldly, "Are you the one who claims to be the new lord?"
"Dismount!" Hobert said coldly.
Knight Grov Duke's first reaction was to obey the order of the young man in front of him, but he resisted the urge to dismount and said, "I have not received the relevant documents."
Hobert took two steps forward, jumped up, grabbed Grov's collar, and threw him to the ground: "This is the document you want!"
The squires immediately raised their weapons at Hobert. Hobert glanced at them and fully activated his "Corrosion" ability. The surrounding squires immediately cursed each other, and some even wrestled together.
Hobert glanced at the white horse: "Knight Duke, after this Lord arrived at the fief, not only did you not greet me, but you were also rude to this Lord. Now I will fine you one white horse as an example."
Grov struggled to get up, already wearing a smile: "Yes, yes, the white horse is yours."
Hobert rode the white horse, and Seel led it proudly. The master and servant left triumphantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - 355 The Courier Lady's Request (Bonus 19)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert had memories of riding horses in his mind, but they were a little rusty because he "hadn't ridden in a long time". However, as long as he didn't gallop, riding slowly wouldn't be a problem.
Leading the horse, Seel excitedly said, "I didn't expect that the Knight Lord, who could fight a monster alone, would be thrown to the ground by the Baron!"
"Baron, if I have the opportunity to receive your grace in the future, and you teach me combat skills, can I become as powerful as you?"
Hobert smiled: "It's possible, but you have to be mentally prepared. If there's a chance, I'll test your psychological endurance. If you have talent in this area, I'll make you my captain of the guard in the future!"
Seel was so excited that he gesticulated wildly. He tried hard to restrain himself to appear more composed, but he still couldn't help but chuckle.
Hobert's territory was divided by a small mountain range. On this side of the mountain were Jeffery Town, eight villages, and the territory of Knight Duke.
On the other side of the mountain were five villages and the territory of Knight Louis.
In addition, the middle mountain range was relatively gentle, and there was a flat area on the top of the mountain, where there were also three villages.
"Baron, it's getting late. Let's go to the top of the mountain and the other side tomorrow." Seel hesitated and said, "Going to the other side of the mountain requires... requires passing the original church."
Hobert nodded: "The murderer who killed Viscount Wright, the so-called ' lord' lives there, right?"
Seel: "Yes, they are a group of robbers. They not only don't care about our lives, but also desperately levy taxes from us."
Hobert said "Hmm" : "We'll leave early tomorrow and pay them a visit."
"Yes."
When they returned to the " Lord's Mansion", it was already dusk.
As soon as he entered the door, Hobert felt that the mansion had changed greatly. The weeds in the yard were gone, and an old man and a young man he didn't recognize were trimming the flowers and plants in the yard.
The original stone slabs and floor tiles on the ground were all highlighted, and although it still looked a little dilapidated, it already had a bit of the feeling of a noble mansion.
When Phillip saw Hobert returning, he quickly greeted him: "Baron, today I hired a dozen people to clean up the yard and rooms, and also found the original gardener and his son to help you trim the flowers and plants."
"I also found a few carpenters and masons to come and repair the Lord's Mansion starting tomorrow."
Hobert nodded: "You can arrange it."
Dinner was still bought back from the town by Seel. Hobert moved into a larger room. Phillip said that the Wright family had died in the main hall, and none of the rooms were stained with even a drop of blood.
After dinner, Hobert called all the servants over and warned them that no one should go to the courtyard where he lived between 10 pm and 8 am the next day.
To the surprise of Seel and others, Hobert returned to his bedroom alone and took out the oil painting and the two-handed sword that he had never used, using the method of bestowal.
Hobert planned to use the oil painting to "stand guard" for himself in the future. The oil painting would be activated from 10 pm to 8 am the next day.
After being sealed, the oil painting would not be affected by negative effects within ten hours of use.
As the owner of the oil painting, Hobert would not be affected by the curse of the oil painting and the invasion of dreams, but if a stranger broke in, he would definitely be cursed by the oil painting.
As for the two-handed sword, it had no use in Backlund.
Now Hobert had the final say in the surrounding dozens of miles. Not to mention a two-handed sword, no one would care if he carried a steam rifle on the street.
Before Hobert could activate the oil painting, he felt something and saw a wall suddenly become illusory, and a coffin floated out of the illusion and stood in front of Hobert.
It was the messenger!
A letter flew out of the crack in the coffin and landed in Hobert's hand.
Hobert glanced at the envelope. It was Jessica's letter.
He noticed that the messenger didn't disappear immediately, so he asked: "Didn't Jessica pay you?"
This remote place, where would he go to find doughnuts?
"No." There was a crisp female voice from the coffin: "Tell your friend, if she uses doughnuts that are about to go bad as payment again, I will kidnap her to the spirit world and have her make doughnuts for me for three months."
Hobert smiled: "I will definitely warn her in my reply! That's outrageous. How can she use doughnuts that are about to go bad as payment?"
The coffin then disappeared into the spirit world.
Hobert opened the letter in the candlelight. There were two more letters and several folded pieces of paper in the envelope.
The pages were Jessica's letter to Hobert. She briefly described that after she sent out the letters Hobert had asked her to send last Tuesday, she and her colleagues were interrogated by the police and MI9.
She spent three days in the detention center and paid a large bail before being released.
As Hobert had expected, Barton retained Hobert's team, and Jessica is now the senior lawyer of this team.
Jessica also talked about what happened in the parliament today, and the church's help to her.
Finally, she mentioned Austin's warning, telling Hobert to be careful and guard against.
Hobert glanced at the oil painting hanging on the wall. He hung the oil painting to guard against those mercenary teams who wanted to earn bounty.
He couldn't help but sigh in his heart: Originally, I was a member of the mercenary club, but I didn't expect to become the target pursued by the club's mercenaries.
In addition to lamenting, Hobert went to read the other two letters. One of them was Selena's letter, which was similar to the previous letters, all asking for some mystical knowledge.
However, the knowledge she asked for this time was much more professional and was already approaching mystical knowledge.
After opening the other letter, he realized that it was Harvey Hayden's letter.
At the " Sapphire Resort", Christian had mentioned Harvey Hayden, who was indeed a soldier brought out by him and Rex.
Hobert had only caught a few petty thieves with Harvey Hayden. It was during that operation that Hobert ran into George III's travel.
Harvey Hayden was also reminding Hobert to be careful of the three mercenary teams, and listed the strength of the three mercenary teams.
The captains of the " Cold Night Squad" and " Prairie Wolf Squad" were both Sequence 5, and although the captain of the " Blizzard Squad" was Sequence 6, there were also two Sequence 6 members in the team, so their strength should not be underestimated.
In addition, Harvey Hayden also heard that MI9 had also organized people to assassinate Hobert. He told Hobert to be vigilant.
After carefully reading the letter, Hobert began to reply. He briefly instructed Jessica a few words and told her that the doughnuts used as payment in the future must be fresh.
Then Hobert wrote back to Selena and Harvey Hayden, respectively. Hobert had previously exchanged mailing addresses with Harvey Hayden.
After writing the letter, he was stunned. He didn't have any doughnuts!
There was no way but to go to Feynapotter City.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - 356: Hobert Begins His Operation (Bonus 20)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert could have also used "Travel" to deliver the letter directly to Backlund, but after all, he had just caused a scene in Backlund some time ago, and it would be troublesome if the official Beyonders were prepared.
Putting on his cloak again, Hobert used the ability of "Travel" to arrive at the room prepared for him in the Christian mansion.
This room was relatively secluded. Hobert observed that there was no one outside, then jumped onto the roof to avoid the servants' sight and came to Dophis's room door.
He knocked on the door, and a voice came from inside: "Come in."
Hobert entered and quickly closed the door: "Good evening, Mr. Dophis."
Dophis's expression was still so stern that it was impossible to tell his mood: "You've arrived at the fief?"
He paused and then said: "The Earl is not at home. He went to a banquet today."
"Yes, I've arrived at the fief." Hobert briefly recounted his journey to the fief, and then took out the 700 pounds in cash that he had prepared in advance:
"Please, Mr. Dophis, help me exchange this money for Resso tomorrow. I want more silver Lire coins. Just exchange some gold Resso coins for me, either coins or 1 or 2 gold Lire denomination banknotes."
In Jeffery Town, you basically don't need to spend gold Lires.
Dophis nodded and took the money, counting it in front of him.
Then he also briefly talked about Christian's recent situation. Christian showed off his talent slightly and was highly valued by Ferdinand II. Now he is leading a reform in military logistics.
Hobert probably understood that Christian's current situation was very similar to that of a "lone minister." The king was using his lack of background to carry out some reforms that would definitely offend people.
This was one of the reasons why Christian was valued. Another reason was that Christian did have talent and wisdom. While being used by the king, he could also ensure that he would not be killed by the king to quell the anger brought about by the reforms.
At the end of the conversation, Hobert asked: "Where can I buy donuts nearby?"
"There are some in the back kitchen."
"Are they fresh?"
"As far as I know, they just came out of the oven around 5:23 this afternoon." After saying that, Dophis got up and went out. A few minutes later, he brought back seven or eight donuts.
After chatting for a few more words, Hobert really couldn't chat with Dophis anymore, so he got up to say goodbye, took the donuts, and left directly using "Travel."
Back in Jeffery Town, Hobert set up the altar and summoned the messenger to send the letter out.
Hobert ate two donuts, feeling that the taste was not bad, and then he turned on the oil painting and quickly fell asleep.
The next morning, Hobert closed the oil painting and came to the front yard.
Philip, who lived in the Lord's Manor, had already gotten up early and was instructing the gardener and his son which flowers and plants to prune today and where to plant some flowers, etc.
Hobert nodded. Philip had withstood the test and could be trusted to serve as the butler.
After breakfast, Hobert called Philip over: "It's time to find a chef and a kitchen helper. We can't just buy food for every meal.
"In addition, regarding the renovation of the mansion, I have a new idea. Build a large stove in that room. The stove must be built underground, and then open each floor, leaving a one-brick-high space under the floor, seal it well, and then lay the floor.
"Finally, use sealed passages to connect the large stove to the space under the floor of each room. Remember that the position of the fire should be lower than the position of the passage, and you must also find a leeward place to emit smoke…"
Hobert explained his idea to Philip with both words and drawings, so that Philip roughly understood it.
Philip exclaimed: "A very unique design. This can make all the rooms warm, right? What is it called?"
"Yes, it's called Fire Dragon!" Hobert added: "As for the craftsmen to repair the mansion, in addition to finding craftsmen in the town, we must also recruit people from various villages, two people from each village!"
Philip was stunned: "It seems, it seems that we don't need so many people."
Hobert smiled and explained: "This is to let them know that they have a new lord."
Philip nodded: "Yes."
Hobert asked again: "Do you have any sons?"
"Yes, I have two."
"Let one of them come to work." Hobert said: "Come over now. I will continue to inspect the territory in a while. It looks more decent to have two servants.
"Also, you can notify the servants of the original Lord's Manor that whoever wants to come back to work can come back after negotiating the salary."
Philip hesitated and said: "They, they all have some concerns."
Hobert glanced at the buildings on the mountain: "I understand. Organize a group of people in a while to clean up the warehouse first, and wait for your son to come back to report the news."
Philip was slightly stunned, but did not ask why.
Soon Philip's eldest son, Roy, arrived. Seel had fed the horse and re-saddled it.
After everyone was ready, Seel led the way in front with Hobert's two-handed sword on his back, Hobert rode in the middle, and Roy followed behind.
It took more than an hour for the three of them to climb the relatively gentle hillside.
Looking down from here, the Full Moon Lake was full of water vapor, setting off the two banks like a fairyland.
The scenery was really good, but the messy vegetation on the mountain affected the landscape.
Hobert was thinking that if a railway track was laid here and a small train was set up, it would be much better than some scenic spots in his impression.
There were several mountain-top fields on the mountain, which looked quite fertile. Although it was winter, they were still green, and the crops were growing quite well.
According to Seel, since more than fifty years ago, the land around Full Moon Lake has been able to harvest four crops of grain every year, and the yield has been doubled. Unfortunately, what people get now is not as much as when they harvested two crops before.
As soon as they arrived at the top of the mountain, seven people came forward to greet them. They claimed to be subordinates of the "Great Lord" and looked quite arrogant.
There was also a large building complex on the mountain. Previously, this was the church of the Earth Mother, but now it has become the "Lord's Mansion" of the "Great Lord" and the "Second Lord."
Hobert sneered and said to the arrogant people in front of him: "Just running errands, what's so great about it? Get in front and lead the way!"
Several people were about to draw their swords, but they still endured their anger and led the way in front.
Although the church on the mountain was not as large as Hobert's "Lord's Mansion," the buildings looked very solemn. It was just that the decorations symbolizing harvest had been removed, which looked a bit nondescript.
The church also had a large courtyard. A man in his thirties with a thick beard, who looked very rough, stood at the gate of the courtyard to greet him: "Welcome, Lord. I didn't expect that after six years, a new Lord would come to this land."
This man was the "Great Lord." As soon as Hobert arrived, he heard that a new Lord had arrived, but he didn't pay any attention to it at all. He planned to go and scare this kid when he collected taxes in a few days.
Maybe this young master from the big city would be scared away, but last night he learned from Knight Duke that the new Lord was an Beyonder.
The "Great Lord" had not yet inquired about the background of this kid, so he looked particularly polite today.
Hobert nodded pretentiously: "It's good that you know who I am. You guys move out of here yourselves. I want to turn this place back into a church."

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - 357: One Step, One Kill (Bonus 21)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The twenty-plus people at the entrance, including the so-called "Great Lords," were dumbfounded, and so was Seel who came along.
Hobert spoke so casually, as if he were just deciding what to have for dinner.
However, each of these people had more than one blood debt on their hands, how could they obediently move away?
Yesterday, Seel had even discussed today's itinerary with his uncle Wayne. Wayne believed that Sir Hobert had no helpers in the territory and would first promise some benefits to the "Great Lords" to gain some ruling power, and then slowly squeeze them out after having some helpers.
But Seel didn't expect that the Sir would immediately ask the "Great Lords" to move.
Everyone was silent for a full four or five seconds before the twenty-something "Second Lord" smiled and said, "We will of course carry out the Sir's orders, but you have to give us time to find a new place to live."
He smiled and said, "We have prepared a table of wine and food, please come inside, Sir, and we can talk while we eat."
Hobert nodded, handed the horse to Roy, and then took Seel into the house with him.
The room where Hobert was invited was the place where the church used to hold worship services, but the holy emblem of life in the church had long been removed, and the seats on the ground had also been removed. Now there is only a large solid wood table with tableware already set on it.
Hobert only had himself and Seel, one sitting and one standing, while behind the two "Lords" opposite him stood twenty or thirty people!
Seel swallowed nervously, and despite being in the mountains in winter, he broke out in a cold sweat.
After the three people sat down, just as the "Second Lord" was about to order the dishes, Hobert coldly asked, "Did you kill Viscount Wright?"
The "Second Lord" finally couldn't bear it any longer: "This is our lord's mansion, not Bugas City, nor Feynapotter City!"
"How dare you be unreasonable to a nobleman!" Hobert drew his two-handed sword and slashed at the "Second Lord." He had already observed that only these two lords were Beyonders, and only of the "Low Sequence."
So Hobert didn't intend to waste words with them at all. Anyway, none of the people in this room were good people, so he would just start a massacre.
Although Hobert's sword was sharp, it was dodged by the "Second Lord." His movements were very agile, and every action seemed very light.
The others drew their cold weapons and rushed towards Hobert.
Hobert sneered, slightly sideways and rushed forward. The four people in front of him felt like a train had hit them, directly knocking them away.
While still in mid-air, blood spurted from their mouths, and they didn't land until they hit the wall. At this time, the necks of the people who were knocked away tilted, and they died directly.
When the "Great Lord" and "Second Lord" saw that the new Sir was so fierce, they turned around and left without thinking.
Hobert went after the "Second Lord" first, because he noticed that the "Second Lord's" Sequence seemed to be higher than the "Great Lord's."
Seeing that he couldn't escape, the "Second Lord" shouted as he fled, "I am, I am a Theosophy…"
Hobert reached out and grabbed, stealing the "Second Lord's" thought of escaping, and went up with a sword to cut him in two: "I don't care what you are!"
After speaking, he turned to chase the "Great Lord."
The "Great Lord" didn't know why, but he didn't run towards the door! As a result, he was blocked by Hobert.
In fact, he was affected by Hobert's "Corruption" and made the wrong choice.
Looking at the "Great Lord's" subordinates again, some wanted to escape, and some cursed those who were escaping as cowards, and they even started fighting among themselves.
Seel in the crowd hugged the scabbard of his two-handed sword, shivering, not daring to move, feeling the warmth coming from his crotch.
Hobert sighed in his heart: This is the correct way to use "Corruption."
Seeing that he couldn't escape, the "Great Lord" quickly explained while retreating: "I was not prepared to kill the Wright family at all, it was, it was Amos! It was the 'Second Lord' who kept encouraging me to kill!
"I don't know what happened that day, but I actually killed a viscount! I swear! That was not my intention!"
Hobert probably understood. Of course, he knew that the "Second Lord" named Amos was trying to tell him that he was a member of the "Theosophy Order."
Hobert remembered that the "Theosophy Order" was actually a vest of the "Demoness Sect," so Amos was likely a "Instigator!"
And before the "Instigator" was the "Assassin," so Amos's movements were so light.
At this moment, the "Great Lord" retreated to the wall. His panicked expression suddenly turned into a pursed smile. The wall behind him became illusory. He used the ability of "Opening Doors" to pass through the wall.
Hobert nodded. He remembered that the "Theosophy Order" had many Beyonders of the "Door" pathway in addition to the "Witch" pathway.
The "Great Lord's" ability matched this information.
Hobert used a "Blink" to chase out, and in the "Great Lord's" horror, he also cut him in two.
Returning to the room with the huge solid wood table again, Hobert held the sword in both hands and slashed at the crowd.
He seemed to be practicing swordsmanship, and he seemed to be cutting melons and vegetables. Every sword he struck reaped one or two lives.
The bandits in the other courtyards heard the screams coming from the main hall. They rushed over to support with weapons, but because the people inside were screaming so desperately, they didn't dare to go in and check.
Soon Hobert ended the lives of more than twenty people, took off his blood-stained cloak, and threw it on the table over there.
There was still a bandit who was seriously injured, struggling to crawl out.
Hobert handed the hilt of the sword to Seel: "This is the first test, kill him!"
Hobert was pointing to the bandit who was crawling out.
Seel took a deep breath, took the somewhat heavy two-handed sword, and quickly chased after him, but when he got close, like when he killed the sheep last time, his hands trembled violently.
Hobert didn't urge him, just watched quietly.
Just as the bandit was about to crawl out of the room, Seel, who had been shivering for a long time, finally gritted his teeth and stabbed forward.
"Ah!" Stabbed in the bandit's leg.
Seel quickly retracted his sword and stabbed again.
"Ah!" Stabbed in the bandit's butt.
This was not the end. Seel stabbed the bandit's lower back and shoulders one after another. Just when Hobert couldn't stand it anymore, Seel stabbed the bandit in the back of the heart, finally ending this round of torture.
Hobert saw a look of fear and excitement twisted together on Seel's face, and saw the light flashing in his eyes. Hobert was quite satisfied with the effect of this "Corruption."
But there were no obvious signs of digestion of the potion.
Hobert wondered if something was wrong? Did he have to use the ability of "Corruption" to make his subordinates dark and greedy?
Was Seel's mental state not twisted enough now? Was it not enough to digest the potion? Or was the direction wrong?

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - 358 Hobert's Successful Harvest (Bonus 22)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert stepped out and glanced at the bandits outside the door.
One of the bandits with a gun immediately shot Hobert, hitting him in the chest.
Just as everyone was about to cheer, they saw the Baron calmly patting away the smoke and dust from the bullet hole, then kicking up a stone, hitting the head of the gunman.
This stone was like a shrapnel, smashing a hole in the bandit's head, killing him on the spot.
The momentum of the stone diminished slightly, hitting the shoulder of a person behind him, knocking him to the ground with a scream.
Only then did everyone react and turn to flee in a swarm.
Hobert casually picked up a few stones and threw them out as if at random, and several more corpses appeared in the yard, but a few bandits still escaped.
This group of people had been scared out of their wits, and they dropped their weapons on the ground, not worth worrying about at all.
Hobert did not chase these small fries, he needed their mouths to spread his prestige.
Without Hobert saying anything more, Seel came out of the house, killed the bandit in the yard with a sword, and then respectfully returned the two-handed sword to Hobert.
Hobert put away his sword and said to Roy, who was already dumbfounded, "Go back to the manor and have your father bring the gathered manpower over. I estimate that these bandits have accumulated a lot, and the three of us can't move it all."
Roy first spun around like a headless fly, and then quickly ran down the mountain, shouting as he ran, "The two 'lords' on the mountain are dead, and this territory has changed hands!"
Hobert nodded, very satisfied with Roy's reaction.
He asked Seel to move a chair for him and sat in the sun, and asked Seel to collect the weapons in the yard and house, and see if there were any other people, and find the bandits' warehouse.
Seel first collected the weapons, and then, holding a knife, went to the back to search.
Hobert estimated that the time was about right, picked up the two Beyonder characteristics, and packed them in a box made of "Order Crystal".
Just as he went back to sit down, Seel drove out several gorgeously dressed beautiful women from the backyard, who had been kidnapped to the mountain by the two "lords" for pleasure.
Hobert let them go back, but these women refused. They used to be the "lords'" women, and now they were nothing after going back, and had to continue farming and doing rough work.
This made Hobert once again lament the moral corruption of this territory. He said coldly, "Either go with your lord, or get out of here."
One woman asked, "Where is the lord?"
Hobert: "He's lying there resting."
When they saw the lord with his internal organs spilling all over the ground, they screamed and left, some vomited a few times, and also screamed and left.
Watching their departing figures, Hobert suddenly sighed, "The ability of 'corruption' is not to make people's hearts dark and greedy, but that everyone has a morally corrupt side, and 'corruption' is just a catalyst."
Seel sighed, "What a pity."
It was a pity to let these women go, as beautiful as they were.
Hobert said coldly, "Your performance today was good, but in the future, as my subordinate, if you can't control what's in your pants, I'll castrate you!"
Seel was so frightened that he quickly pleaded guilty, and then went to find the bandits' warehouse.
More than twenty minutes later, Seel returned and took Hobert to the bandits' warehouse. The backyard of this church had been used by the bandits as a place to raise pigs, cattle, sheep, chickens, ducks and geese, and there were also two horses.
As for the bandits' warehouse, it was mainly grain. Hobert did not expect that such a small fief could accumulate so much grain!
It can be seen that the land here is indeed very fertile, but it is a waste to just pile these grains in the warehouse.
In addition, there are many dried fruits. For agricultural products, dried fruits are very valuable.
But there were not many valuables. Seel only found some gold Solas and silver Solas in the rooms of the two "lords", all of which were coins, adding up to only more than 50 gold Solas.
Although this was already a huge sum in the mountains, if they only accumulated so little wealth in six years, then the nobles would have gone bankrupt long ago.
Moreover, it is said that six years ago, they robbed all the savings of Viscount Wright, but now there is not a single noble's object in the entire church.
Even if Hobert did not use telepathy, he knew that most of their wealth and harvests must have been handed over.
Because the "Theosophy Order" did not have much demand for grain and dried fruits, they were piled up here.
Soon, Philip came up with dozens of men, and many of them vomited when they saw the corpses in the church, but when they saw the accumulation in the warehouse, they sighed how could these dozens of bandits eat so much grain?
Hobert called Philip over and ordered, "Move everything in the church to the manor's warehouse, especially the weapons and valuables. You must supervise it well, and don't let anything be lost."
Only then did Philip completely understand that this land had indeed changed hands.
He said, "Baron, the manor's warehouse may not be able to hold so much grain."
"Then build a few temporary warehouses." Hobert continued, "If there are not enough people, find more, and don't worry about spending money."
Philip nodded repeatedly: "Yes, yes, yes!"
Hobert continued, "Call a few people to find two young adults from each village, and build a large pile of wood outside the church, and let those young adults carry the bodies out and burn them.
"Burn them at night, the fire must be big enough, and everyone in the entire territory must see it, preferably Viscount Teuton across the lake can see it.
"When burning the corpses, you must tell them that I have avenged the Wright family, and now I am their Viscount."
Only by establishing a new rule in a rough way can there be a chance to correct the people's moral values here.
Philip may have recalled his old master, and tears flashed in his eyes: "I will definitely explain it to them clearly."
Hobert added: "Also, find the graves of Viscount Wright and his family, and after the manor is repaired, I will rebury them according to the specifications of the Baron."
This is an implication of spiritual succession: aren't you missing Viscount Wright? I will bury him carefully, burying him according to the specifications of the Baron, which is equivalent to saying that I will inherit the Baron's governance strategy, and you can rest assured to support me.
Hobert has a lot of operations like this in his mind.
Philip knelt on the ground while shedding tears: "Six years ago, I buried the Baron's family with a few male servants, and I know where they were buried."
Hobert helped Philip up: "Everything is in the past."
Philip stared blankly at the Baron in front of him, feeling like he was in a dream.
Hobert waited until after lunch, but did not wait for a response from the "Gnostic Society", so he continued to ride his horse and inspect the territory with two servants.
When he inspected the territory of Knight Louis, Louis, who had already received news from all sides, greeted him from afar with a very respectful attitude.
Hobert said that his servants did not have mounts, and Louis immediately offered two donkeys.
Hobert nodded, and the inspection of the territory ended successfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - 359 Loyalty and Recognition Are the Key (Bonus 23)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[200 powerstone chapter]
In the lord's manor, located roughly halfway up the mountain, Hobert saw the great fire on the mountainside.
The fire was indeed large enough to turn Full Moon Lake red, as if burning away the sins and miseries of this fiefdom.
Hobert estimated that not only could Baron Teuton across the lake see it, but so could half of Southern Colson.
The bigger the fire, the better the effect!
Then Hobert began to consider his next actions. The 'Theosophy Order' had been silent, which made Hobert cautious and vigilant.
To this end, he took out the 'Cursed Jade Stone' blessed by the 'Mother Tree of Desire' from the 'Nation of Disorder'. If the 'Theosophy Order' wanted to play rough, he wouldn't mind giving them a 'blessing'.
At the same time, with the lord's power firmly in his hands, the next step was to implement his rule.
However, Hobert had not been able to find any household registration or population records for the lord's manor. Upon inquiry, he learned that in this mountainous area, there was no custom of registering households.
So the next step was definitely to register households. Only by knowing how many people were in the territory, how the population was distributed, and the age ratios could Hobert carry out the next stage of governance, and in future projects, he could always keep the utilization of human resources within controllable limits.
He 'activated' the oil painting, and Hobert fell asleep while pondering.
...
In the Teuton baronet's mansion across the lake, the thirty-something, prime-of-life Baron Teuton watched the great fire across the lake without saying a word.
Finally, a sweat-drenched subordinate ran in to report: "My Lord, I've found out that the new Baron on the other side killed the original two lords. It is said that he even killed more than twenty bandits with his bare hands. This fire is burning the bandits' corpses."
Baron Teuton asked, "Bare hands?"
The scout hesitated for a moment before saying, "I heard it from the new Baron's manservant, so it may not be entirely accurate."
The manservant's original words were even more exaggerated than "bare hands," something about a "favored one of the gods" who had received the blessing of the Earth Goddess, and that even a mouthful of saliva could kill a bandit. Something about the "Great Lord" begging for mercy, but the Baron still announced his crimes and executed him.
Baron Teuton did not continue to dwell on these details. He looked across the lake and said, "This Baron has some tricks up his sleeve. This isn't just a fire; it's a complete declaration of his sovereignty."
Then he smiled and said, "I hope he can still have a proper response when the people from the 'Theosophy Order' come knocking."
Baron Teuton thought to himself: But there are only two paths in front of that Baron. One is to get out or lose his life here, and the other is to be a dog of the 'Theosophy Order'.
...
On a mountain dozens of miles away from Jeffrey Town, a stunningly beautiful lady stood there, watching the distant firelight and smiling, "His name is Hobert, right?"
A lady behind her, equally beautiful, replied, "Yes."
"His strength should not be weak. Go talk to him tomorrow and see if you can become his Baroness."
"Wouldn't it be more convenient for us to just kill him?"
The stunningly beautiful lady smiled and said, "I just learned some new information from the outside world a few days ago. You can't kill him, and it's best not to kill him. Cooperation is the best option."
"Yes."
...
Waking up from his dream, Hobert stared at the roof for a while, sighing that life as a Baron was truly fulfilling. In the blink of an eye, it was Saturday.
He "closed" the oil painting, and Hobert suddenly realized that the effect of yesterday's fire exceeded Hobert's imagination, and it had digested nearly a third of the potion in one fell swoop!
Hobert felt that something was wrong. If it was just to make the people recognize his identity as lord, the potion could not have been digested so quickly.
This was a Sequence 6 potion! It was inherently difficult to digest.
With questions in his mind, Hobert still prayed to 'The Fool', hoping to arrange with 'Hanged Man' to explore the elven ruins tomorrow.
He quickly received a reply from 'Hanged Man': "No problem."
Arriving in the front yard, the renovation of the lord's manor had already begun. At this time, forty or fifty people were busy inside the manor.
Hobert saw submission and... fear in their eyes!
Yes, that look was undoubtedly fear! Some people were even trembling with fright.
This made Hobert reflect on whether he had gone too far yesterday?
But he soon felt that this was also a good thing, as it could establish his rule in the fastest possible way.
While eating breakfast, Hobert suddenly understood why he had digested a third of the potion so quickly!
It was precisely because of the fear of the people!
He finally understood the inherent meanings of "Corruption" and "Baron."
First of all, he had already figured out "Baron" before, which was that the people in the fiefdom recognized his identity as lord.
This recognition was not a one-time thing. For example, Hobert's punishment of York could make the people recognize his identity as lord, and the fire could make the people recognize his identity as lord again.
Hobert showed the authority of the lord time and time again, and the people recognized his identity as lord time and time again. This was the process of acting.
And "Corruption" does not simply refer to "corroding" the hearts of those around him. Hobert believes that it is the loyalty shown to him by the people of the territory because of fear, which is the essence of "Corruption."
"Baron" is just a title, and "Corruption" is just a process. The ultimate goal is to constantly make the people recognize Hobert's identity as lord, and to constantly make the people show loyalty to Hobert, even loyalty generated out of fear.
No matter what the purpose, whether it's buying people's hearts or making the people fear, as long as they can show a certain degree of loyalty, the acting of the lord, or rather the "Baron of Corruption", is completed in another aspect.
And the reason why it is called "Baron of Corruption" is because after Sequence 6, there is the ability to "corrode", so "corrupting" the hearts of those around him, making them greedy and dark, and then using their desires to control them and make subordinates show enough loyalty is the simplest process.
So the potion name is "Baron of Corruption", not "Loyal Baron".
Hobert smiled and sighed: This pathway is really the "Shadow of Order", and so many loopholes can be found in the name and digestion method of the potion.
Then he breathed a sigh of relief. He had tried it yesterday and found that he was really not the material to "corrupt" others.
Obviously, if Seel indulged in women, he would be more likely to achieve the goal of corrupting the other party's heart, but Hobert still reminded him, because he believed that his subordinates could not be lechers, which seemed to be the most basic moral requirement for subordinates.
After finishing breakfast, Hobert was about to call Philip to give new instructions.
Philip came himself: "My Lord, there is a beautiful lady outside the door requesting to meet with you."
Since it was a "pretty lady," she was probably from the "Theosophy Order"!
Hobert said, "Please invite her in."
After a while, a tall lady, although not gorgeously dressed, but very beautiful, entered the door.
Seel's eyes immediately went straight.
Hobert cleared his throat.
Seel suddenly felt a chill in his crotch, quickly turned his face away, and dared not look again.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 360 Cooperation, not confrontation
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The beautiful lady introduced herself with a smile, "My lord, you can call me Helen."
Every glance and smile of hers exuded a captivating charm and beauty. Even Hobert had to silently remind himself, "She used to be a man, she used to be a man," to maintain his composure.
Seer, the ordinary man beside him, was breathing heavily.
Hobert said to him, "You go out first. I'll have a private conversation with Miss Helen."
"Yes, sir." Seel felt like he was escaping. Only after he got outside did he breathe a sigh of relief: Uncle was right, my knowledge is still too shallow. This is a real woman! Those women at the docks who solicit business are, well, just so-so.
Then, he wondered how the lord would "talk" with the beauty inside.
The scene inside the room was far from as sordid as Seel imagined. Hobert remained seated in his chair. "You shouldn't use Beyonder abilities on my servant."
"I wasn't using it on him, I was using it on you," Helen said with a charming smile.
"It might be impolite to say this, but I must tell you, I've met a lady who is more beautiful and has a better temperament, so my standards for beauty are relatively high," Hobert said with a smile.
"You can withdraw your ability, and we can talk about some practical matters."
"Oh?" Helen's eyes flickered. No wonder Ms. Monica said this baron was cooperative. Did he sleep with a member from somewhere else? That certainly makes it easier to establish a cooperative relationship.
Helen indeed stopped using her Beyonder abilities, but her every move still attracted the attention of the opposite sex.
Hobert asked, "May I ask what brings you to me?"
"I heard you didn't bring your wife?"
"I don't have any plans to get married yet."
Helen smiled, "I didn't say I wanted to marry you. I just want to be your mistress."
Hobert reached into his pocket and took out a wooden box. "Can I take your words just now as a willingness to cooperate? Then this is my sincerity for cooperation."
As he said this, he pushed the wooden box towards Helen.
Helen was slightly stunned. She opened the wooden box and looked. There were two Beyonder characteristics, one "Instigator" and one "Apprentice," which should be the Beyonder characteristics of those two idiots who were killed yesterday.
"But if you want to cooperate with me, you must cooperate with me personally, and you can't bypass me to cooperate with others in my territory," Hobert said seriously.
"From now on, in my territory, only I have the final say."
Although Hobert would try to restrain himself and would not cooperate with the "Theosophy Order" in bed, he would not completely refuse cooperation in other fields, as long as it did not harm the people in the territory or his own interests.
Hobert had thought about it last night. Before the Earth Mother Church sent people, this was a necessary compromise.
It was impossible for him, a Sequence 6, to challenge the "Theosophy Order," the "Blood Sanctify Sect," and the "Aurora Order" at the same time. And Hobert would never cooperate with the "Aurora Order" and the "Blood Sanctify Sect."
The former were a bunch of lunatics, and cooperating with them was courting death.
The latter regarded human life as worthless, and their cruelty and bloodiness had far exceeded Hobert's bottom line.
After thinking about it, establishing some cooperation with the "Theosophy Order" was still acceptable, but Hobert also understood that such cooperation could not exceed his bottom line.
One of Hobert's bottom lines was not to engage in bed activities with witches, otherwise it would be easy to become addicted, and before he could "corrupt" others, he would fall first.
Growing up reading "Eastern Classics," Hobert had a particularly thorough understanding of human nature. He knew that he was not a "saint," so he simply rejected everything that might make him "degenerate," at least he could barely be a "gentleman."
Helen was silent for a few seconds. Hobert's reaction was a situation she had never considered before coming. After a few more seconds, she said, "You seem to know us very well?"
Hobert answered irrelevantly, "My father has some power in Feynapotter City."
Helen nodded, "I understand."
Hobert thought: That's what you understand yourself. I didn't say anything.
He said, "I have my purpose in coming here, but my purpose is not you. Don't try to infiltrate my territory anymore. I don't care what you do here.
"On this basis, we can have some mutually beneficial exchanges. This is what I think is a feasible cooperation framework."
Helen thought for a while and then said, "I will come again tomorrow and give you an answer."
Hobert smiled slightly, "I look forward to your reply."
After seeing Helen off, Hobert called Philip again, "I heard that there used to be a school in town?"
"Yes, sir, but without the lord's mansion's salary, the school has been disbanded."
"What about the school teachers?"
"Some teachers have left here, and some local teachers have stayed."
Hobert "hmm"ed and said, "Call those teachers here."
Philip thought that the lord was preparing to restore the school and quickly sent two male servants with quick legs to call people.
Soon, one woman and two men, the only three remaining teachers here, came. They were all locals who had tried to venture out, but without exception, they all failed and returned to farming.
Decades ago, compulsory education began to be popularized throughout the Northern Continent. Although nearly half of the people in the Feynapotter Kingdom were still illiterate, the other half who had school experience would be qualified workers or servants.
They had sufficient learning ability and comprehension ability to make them competent for this industrial age position.
However, in this remote area, at least 80% of the people were illiterate. This was still the result of the efforts of Hobert's predecessor, Viscount Wright.
In those territories that had not had a lord for decades, the illiteracy rate was close to one hundred percent.
"I'm going to restore the school," Hobert said straightforwardly. "Your salaries and benefits will be the same as before. The lord's mansion will pay you every week, starting from today."
The three teachers were all pleasantly surprised. Being a teacher was certainly better than farming. The work was easy, and they were generally respected.
They immediately bowed to Hobert and expressed their praise for the lord.
"But I have to have someone repair the school first," Hobert said with a smile. "So before the school is repaired, you will come to the lord's mansion to work first.
"The specific work content will be designated by me personally."
The three people nodded repeatedly, expressing their willingness to follow Hobert's arrangements.
Hobert instructed, "Your task for the next two days is to find fifteen people who can read and write and teach them how to fill out this form.
"Next, I need them to do a statistic. Their weekly salary is two-thirds of yours."
The three people were all stunned, feeling that the lord's instructions were strange, but they were still very focused on learning the form given by the lord.
They were unfamiliar with the highly efficient form. Hobert explained it to them for more than an hour before finally explaining the role and usage of the household registration popularization form.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 361 Landing on the Mysterious Island
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
On Saturday night, Hobert once again used "Travel" to arrive at Feynapotter City. In the room prepared for him, there were already two large bags full of silver Sol, as well as a small bag of gold Lire coins and banknotes.
Hobert once again went to Dophis and asked him to help purchase a large quantity of paper, pens, ink, stationery, etc., because Hobert had only learned at noon that the paper in his territory was relatively scarce.
The next morning, Hobert was sleeping soundly when his spirituality woke him up. Someone was gently fiddling with the latch.
Hobert was stunned. A thief?
He looked out the window. It was almost dawn. If it were for work, he would be late, right?
At this time, Hobert smelled a faint fragrance, and he roughly understood who was outside.
He extended his spirituality to the oil painting, confirmed that the "oil painting" hanging on the wall was still open, and quietly waited for the other party to walk into the trap.
After two or three attempts, the latch was opened by the other party. Sure enough, Helen walked in with a smile: "Your Excellency, wake up... What a wonderful scenery."
The monster with eyes on its chest appeared from the "oil painting" and unceremoniously sent Helen a curse.
Helen looked surprised and retreated repeatedly.
Clatter~
A piece of glass on the window shattered, and Helen used "Mirror Substitute" to avoid the damage of the curse.
She didn't know when she had a short sword made of ice in her hand, and while agilely dodging the monster's claws, she pierced the monster's heart.
The monster disappeared into the void just like that.
"What are you here for?" Hobert asked.
Helen immediately put on a bright smile: "I'm here to see you!"
"If I were you, I wouldn't be in the mood to use 'Charm' on the person in front of me."
"This oil painting is a very strange Sealed Artifact. As its owner, I will not suffer most of its damage and negative effects, but it has already marked you and will try to kill you when you are most vulnerable or asleep."
Helen was shocked: "What should I do then?"
Hobert shook his head: "I don't have any good solutions. I think you'd better ask your elders or superiors for help as soon as possible."
In fact, he didn't want to completely solve Helen's problem, but wanted to give her enough deterrence.
Of course, Helen would not doubt Hobert's warning. She withdrew her "Charm" ability: "I'm here to tell you that the elders have agreed to your cooperation plan, but I have to stay in your lord's mansion as our liaison for cooperation."
"Okay, I won't give you any orders, but you have to abide by the rules I give you." Hobert said: "The first rule is, don't enter my bedroom without my permission in the future. It's very dangerous for you."
Helen nodded and left quickly without having time to bargain with Hobert.
Hobert still got up at his usual time. After "closing" the oil painting, he came to the front yard for breakfast.
He first inquired about the progress of the lord's mansion renovation and the work progress of the three teachers. Then, Hobert told Phillip that he was going out today.
After rejecting the servants' requests to follow, Hobert found a deserted corner and used "Travel" to first reach a corner of a cemetery in Conant City, Desi County, which was exactly the cemetery where Hobert had previously killed two "Judgement Group" sentries.
In the cemetery's forest, Hobert put on a mask and once again used "Travel" to enter the Spirit World, reaching Olavi Port in the northeastern part of the Berserk Sea and the southwestern part of the White Whale Sea in one breath.
This place is far from the center of the colony. This port city of considerable size is a paradise for pirates and adventurers.
Of course, official Beyonders are also stationed here. Pirates can squander money here at will, but if the bounty is too high, or they have committed overly cruel or bloody crimes, they will also be arrested by official Beyonders.
On this island, there are still many small private ports, providing hiding places for some pirates.
The place where "Hanged Man" Alger and Hobert met was a forest outside a private port.
Alger also made some disguises, such as sticking on a beard and changing into local clothes, but he didn't directly wear a mask like Hobert.
After meeting, Hobert asked as soon as he opened his mouth: "Are you ready?"
Alger was stunned before saying: "Ready."
He was puzzled. Didn't they need to confirm each other's identities? He had prepared a few obscure passwords.
Hobert grabbed Alger's shoulder: "Please keep repeating the general location of that ruin in your mind."
Alger couldn't help but ask: "Aren't we going to confirm each other's identities?"
"We're going on an adventure, not to the 'Red Theater'." Hobert smiled and said: "If I find out you have a problem during the adventure, I have plenty of ways to make you die without knowing why."
Alger nodded, that was indeed the case, so he began to constantly repeat the location of the ruins in his mind as "Emperor" said.
Suddenly, the scenery in front of him became colorful, and the trees and flowers seemed to be splashed with a layer of oil paint. Passing through this bizarre scene, the two came to the Spirit World.
Hobert instructed: "Don't make eye contact with the creatures of the Spirit World!"
Alger quickly lowered his head and continued to locate this "Travel."
Hobert noticed that the surrounding Spirit World space was gradually distorted. Some places seemed to be boiling, and whether it was mist, strangely shaped Spirit World creatures, or things like rocks and castles, they were constantly tumbling.
Hobert speculated that they should have entered the Spirit World outside the safe sea lanes of the Berserk Sea, just as he said: The Spirit World is completely a smooth road compared to the Berserk Sea in the real world.
The "Journey" was relatively smooth. When the space in front of the two became bizarre again, they left the Spirit World and were standing on a beach of an unfamiliar island.
The scenery around the island made the two of them gape.
Thick, dark rain clouds were almost connected to the sea surface. They were like iron barrels, surrounding the island tightly.
At the top of the rain clouds, there was a patch of clear sky.
This gave Hobert the feeling of being in a deep well. Directly above the island was a round clear sky like a well opening, and all around were impenetrable well walls.
On the "well walls," strong winds raged and lightning flashed, and the rain clouds could be seen moving rapidly.
Hobert even suspected that he was in the eye of a huge hurricane?
Alger also sighed: "I've seen a lot of maritime wonders, but this is the first time I've seen such a sight."
Then the two looked towards the island, and Alger immediately recognized several Beyonder creatures, including "Storm Green-Winged Eagle," "Blue Shadow Falcon," and "Dragon Eye Sea Eagle."
In the sea, there were also "Agate Jellyfish," "Blue-Eyed Electric Eel," and so on.
The main materials formed by these Beyonder creatures were what he was going to use, or had used before.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 362 Hunting and Two-Dimensional Space
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert and Alger looked again at the interior of the island. Except for a few mountains in the middle, the rest of the island was relatively flat.
One side of the mountain was obscured by a thick fog, and the sunlight could not penetrate it, making it impossible to see the scene beneath.
In the areas without fog, although the trees on the high mountains could be seen clearly, there seemed to be several large mirrors placed haphazardly on the island, as if reflecting scenes from different angles out of nowhere.
Hobert pondered for a moment and said, "This island is located within the Berserk Sea. Although it looks relatively normal, the space here should have some integration with the spirit world, so some spaces should be in a distorted state."
"Also, because this island has the Beyonder characteristics of a 'Sailor' pathway Saint, the harsh weather has been driven away from the island, forming the scene we see now."
Alger nodded, which was similar to his guess: "There are many extraordinary creatures of the 'Sailor' pathway here. If you can help me hunt the Blue Shadow Falcon and the Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle, I will give up a chance to choose spoils."
"Okay," Hobert said. "What does the Blue Shadow Falcon look like?"
"That one is..."
Before Alger could finish speaking, Hobert opened his arms as if embracing the sun: "Sacred Light!"
The Blue Shadow Falcon, which was flying well in the sky, was immediately submerged in the thick holy light.
A few seconds later, the Blue Shadow Falcon, burned into a roasted chicken, fell from the sky.
The sudden sacred light startled the birds in the sky and the extraordinary creatures on the ground, all flying away or fleeing the beach.
Hobert asked, "Which one is the Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle?"
Somewhat surprised, Alger quickly pointed: "That one!"
He originally wanted to use the "Sapphire Scepter" to summon a hurricane to fly himself into the sky to hunt, asking "Emperor" to cover him, but before he could react, "Emperor" had already completed the hunt for the Blue Shadow Falcon.
Hobert locked onto the target: "Distortion!"
The Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle, which was about to escape, had its intention "distorted" by Hobert and suddenly turned its head and flew back.
Two or three seconds later, the Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle seemed to suddenly realize that its direction was wrong. It quickly increased its altitude, hoping to stay away from the two terrible humans on the beach.
But after two or three seconds of brewing, Hobert solemnly said: "Corrosion!"
The rationality in the Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle's eyes disappeared. For some reason, it just wanted to peck to death these two hateful humans in front of it!
Hobert held the Tang knife and waited on the beach. When he felt the height was right, he decisively drew his knife and chopped off the Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle's head.
Thump~
The Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle, split in two, fell on the beach, its headless body twitching.
Alger was surprised by the strength of "Emperor" and quickly went to collect extraordinary materials.
Only to hear Hobert, who had sheathed his knife, say, "I didn't expect the creatures of the 'Sailor' pathway to be so irritable."
Alger's movements paused slightly, thinking: You have the nerve to say that, you are more like a "Folk of Rage". Before even exploring the island, you used such a powerful "Sacred Light". What if it awakens some existence on the island?
But soon he continued to dig out the Dragon-Eyed Sea Eagle's eyeballs, and although the feathers of the Blue Shadow Falcon had been basically burned off, it was still alive.
After Alger killed it with a dagger, the Beyonder characteristics quickly began to converge on the few feathers that had not been burned by the "Sacred Light", and soon those feathers turned into crystals.
He couldn't quite believe that the main materials he had been waiting for for so long had been collected in this way.
For Alger, just after landing, this adventure had a satisfactory gain for him.
After he collected the main materials, he found that "Emperor" had been observing the situation on the island. He suddenly understood that "Emperor" using "Sacred Light" as soon as he came up was not because he was reckless.
It was more like a test, testing the island's reaction.
The two observed for a full minute, and the island did not change in any way.
Hobert said, "We'd better get closer. If we encounter an accident, use 'Travel' to leave immediately."
Alger nodded, and then very consciously took out a machete to chop the vegetation in front of him, clearing the way for the two.
There was no trace of humans on this island, but many mystical creatures or plants settled here.
The two walked forward, hunting mystical creatures and plants. They successively obtained a Sequence 7 and two Sequence 8 main materials.
The blood of these creatures and the juice and fruits of the plants were also very good materials. Because it was still morning, the exploration action today was not urgent, so the two patiently collected these materials as well.
Until they encountered an area where the light was obviously different from the surrounding area.
The two stopped warily to observe. This was the mirror-like scene they had seen on the beach.
In front of them was also a jungle, and they could see the mountains not far away, but the light and colors were very different from the surroundings, and every time a gust of wind blew, these places with different colors would be blown back and forth.
In other places, the wind only caused the leaves or the canopy to shake, but in those places where the colors were different, the entire tree, even the entire space, was shaking, as if the scene in front had become a curtain painted with realistic paintings, and the entire "curtain" shook when the wind blew.
Hobert picked up a stone from his feet and threw it in. After the stone entered the area with different colors, it also changed color, but the stone still landed, rolled a few times, and remained motionless on the ground, becoming part of the "curtain".
Then Hobert began to do the second experiment, breaking off a branch and extending the front half of the branch into the "curtain". When he took it back, the front half of the branch had become a thin layer.
This was a very wonderful sight. Below was a normal branch, and the branches and leaves above looked normal, but they had no thickness.
Especially the circular branch, which looked circular from the front, but only had the thickness of a piece of paper from the side.
This scene once again amazed Alger: "This, this is..."
Hobert seemed to understand something: "Could this be two-dimensional space?"
"Ah?" Alger heard this term for the first time.
Hobert said to himself, "I forgot where I saw it. The spirit world is actually a four-dimensional space to some extent, so theoretically, two-dimensional space must also exist."
Seeing Alger's confused face, he threw the branch in his hand directly into the two-dimensional space and found a leaf to face Alger: "If you only look at one side, there are only two dimensions, length and width."
Then he laid the leaf flat: "Looking at it this way, the leaf has thickness, and thickness is the third dimension."
Alger was also a smart man and immediately understood what Hobert meant: "Then what is the fourth dimension?"
Hobert spread his hands: "I don't know. An old man with a messy head of gray hair once said it was 'time', but it doesn't seem to be, at least not in this world of mysticism."
