chapters.title: Chapter 373 - 373 Amon's "Worm of Time" (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"The Sun" Derrick said admiringly: "Yes, just as you said, the 'Chief' appeared in time and used the sealed artifact to solve the out-of-control person."
"The Hanged Man" Alger frowned slightly: "Not long after you went back from the Tarot Gathering last time, the former captain of that exploration team lost control?"
Derrick nodded seriously, and then continued to tell the story.
When he talked about praying to Mr. Fool as soon as he got home, Alger interrupted his description: "Wait a minute, you said you just experienced such a weird and terrible thing, and the 'Chief' let you go home?
"And when you got home, you didn't do anything else, and you started praying to Mr. Fool?"
"Yes." Derrick replied blankly.
Alger sighed: "You have had contact with that strange Amon. Do you think the 'Chief' will be completely relieved after just checking you once?
"In my experience, the 'Chief' will definitely send someone to monitor you in secret, and you have undoubtedly exposed your specialness.
"Don't doubt this. If even the 'Chief' is not cautious, your City of Silver will not be able to continue to this day in such a harsh environment!"
"This..." Derrick's eyes gradually widened, and he increasingly felt that Mr. Hanged Man was knowledgeable and made sense.
Then he panicked a little and said: "I, what should I do? I went out of the city for patrol normally last week, and I also used my merits to exchange extraordinary materials owed to Mr. Emperor everywhere. Will this deepen the suspicion of me?"
Alger smiled: "You don't have to worry too much. The 'Chief' should just suspect that you are parasitized, and will not think about the Tarot Gathering. You can slowly find a way to solve this problem."
Derrick calmed down a little and honestly said: "I was indeed parasitized by Amon at that time."
"What?" Alger blurted out, almost leaving his seat and posing in a fighting stance.
Audrey and Fors's emotions also became tense.
Derrick quickly added: "This was discovered by Mr. Fool!"
He obtained Mr. Fool's consent and manifested the scene of himself being parasitized by Amon, and the scene of Mr. Fool sending the angel and destroying Amon.
The extremely oppressive angel with 12 pairs of wings made everyone feel dazzling.
Especially the lifeless and very sacred temperament, especially the brilliance emitted from the angel's feathers, even the picture manifested by Derrick made people feel fear from the bottom of their hearts.
Then everyone was shocked by the scene of Amon being "melted". Although it was just an avatar, it was the avatar of Amon, known as the "Blasphemer"! It was so easily destroyed!
In addition to being shocked, Alger recalled the scene of Qilangos's death: What else is there to question? Qilangos was clearly killed by an Beyonder of the "Death" pathway of high sequence. It is very likely that the person who killed Qilangos was this angel of the "Death" pathway! In this case, everything corresponds.
After being shocked, Audrey turned to excitement and couldn't help but fantasize: Although this is taken for granted, and I had expected it, it is still exciting: Only gods can drive angels!
Fors recalled what happened before. She clearly just asked Mr. Fool to help interfere with the divination, but she saw a 12-winged archangel descending, covering her spirit body with its wings.
She said in her heart: It is indeed an angel, and this is indeed Mr. Fool's routine operation, casually dispatching angels to help members of the gathering to get rid of the crisis.
Klein, who was sitting in the "Fool" position, slowly looked around and clearly noticed Miss Justice's respect and enthusiasm, and noticed Mr. Hanged Man's shock and excitement: "Didn't you always regard me as a god before? Why do you still have this expression when you hear about angels? It seems that the deterrent effect of indirect proof is always not as good as direct display!
"...Maybe it's also because the 'Emperor' always blasphemes gods at the Tarot Gathering, which makes Mr. Fool's position in everyone's mind decrease little by little. Suddenly, they feel enough shock. This is also good. At least Mr. Fool's position has been raised a lot at once, so as to avoid members wanting to challenge Mr. Fool's majesty."
Hobert thought of another thing from this: Although the members of the Balk family have heard of the "Creator" and the deeds of Eliot, no one still believes in the "Creator". It is very likely that the "Creator" has not directly shown their powerful power in front of them.
Hobert recalled the umbilical cord of the evil god's offspring, and the completely black eyeballs: He could completely find an opportunity to show the power of the "Creator's" "servants"! Sure enough, crossing the river by feeling the "Fool", he will definitely be able to play the role of the evil god well.
Derrick couldn't quite understand the reactions of the other members. In his opinion, isn't it normal for a god, a great existence, to have angels serving?
He waited for a few seconds before saying: "After Amon's avatar was purified, I coughed up a small worm. Do you know what it is?"
With the help of "The Fool", Derrick manifested the translucent worm, with twelve transparent rings on it.
Audrey and Fors looked over curiously, and shook their heads at the same time, indicating that they had never seen it.
Klein and Alger had some guesses, but one had to maintain the image of "The Fool", and the other was not confident in his relevant knowledge, so they did not speak.
Finally, everyone's eyes turned to the "Emperor".
"This is a 'Worm of Time'." Hobert said affirmatively: "It is the carrier for Amon to create avatars."
Alger, who had some doubts about this, quickly asked: "Regarding 'Worm of Time', many people suspect that it is actually the name of a Sequence potion."
Hobert smiled and said: "This is not a conflict."
Alger immediately understood what the "Emperor" meant: "Only by reaching a certain Sequence can one use a 'Worm of Time'."
"Yes." Hobert said: "However, you can use 'Worm of Time' after reaching a high sequence, but the sequence's potion..."
Because this information is still somewhat valuable, and it will not bring danger to "Little Sun" if it is not clearly stated, Hobert did not make further explanations.
However, everyone basically understood the concept of "Worm of Time". They were all grateful that the "Emperor" was there, otherwise Mr. Fool would not be interested in this kind of "small matter" and would not make an explanation, and they could only guess randomly.
Derrick asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, what can it be used for? I mean the dead 'Worm of Time'."
"Before the spirituality disappears, it can be used as the main material for certain rituals, and the main material for certain advanced spells." Hobert smiled and said: "But you shouldn't need it for the time being, unless you want to pray to Amon for power."
Alger, who has rich knowledge, asked: "Can't you pray to other existences for power?"
"In theory, you can." Hobert said: "For example, Mr. Fool, or the legendary Mr. 'Door', but I think it's best to wait for a while before making similar prayers to Mr. Fool."
Klein's eyes narrowed: Mr. 'Door'?
Alger originally wanted to ask why, but seemed to understand what the "Emperor" meant.

Although Alger guessed the answer, the others didn't quite understand the meaning of "Emperor."
Before Derrick could ask, Audrey, with her insatiable curiosity, preemptively inquired, "Mr. Emperor, why can't we make similar requests to Mr. Fool now?"
Klein was also very curious about this, because with the experience from the last gathering, "The Fool" didn't rush to "flare up."

Audrey naturally heard the implication in Mr. Emperor's words. Associating it with the previous attempts made under Mr. Fool's instructions, she immediately understood: Mr. Fool's power to influence reality is not yet sufficient to make such responses.
She recalled: From the initial attempt to pull people in, to the later attempts with honorific names, and then to the attempts with sacrifices and bestowals, Mr. Fool is gradually deepening his influence on the real world! If Mr. Fool asks Little Sun to cooperate in making talismans one day, it will indicate that Mr. Fool's power has further recovered.
Finally, Audrey was puzzled: How did Hobert perceive these pieces of information, as well as the previous speculation about Mr. Fool's pathway?
Fors and Derrick both sensed that the "Emperor's" words seemed to have hidden meanings, but Fors didn't immediately understand the "Emperor's" hints because she had joined the Tarot Club for a relatively short time.
And although Derrick had made some progress during this period, he had only progressed to the point where he could hear that Mr. "Emperor" had hidden meanings, and it was difficult for him to immediately understand what the "Emperor" was specifically referring to.
Klein smiled: So I will have such abilities in the future. I wouldn't even know if others didn't tell me.
Observing that Mr. Fool didn't express his opinion on this, Alger confirmed his previous guess: Without a doubt, Mr. Fool is gradually escaping his predicament. Judging from how he tolerates the "Emperor" expressing these remarks, he doesn't mind other members of the Tarot Club guessing this information. Perhaps Mr. Fool needs the "Emperor" to explain it!
Alger then sighed inwardly: This can prove that the "Emperor" really knows how to deal with gods. This is an advantage that other members don't have.
"Thank you, Mr. Emperor," Derrick said with a slight bow.
Hobert waved his hand, indicating that it was nothing.
Then Derrick spoke of the matter that had been making him anxious: "The exploration team led by Elder Lovia of the 'Shepherd' has returned."
"They have completed the exploration of the half-destroyed temple of the 'Fallen Creator.' And I have noticed that the personalities of several team members I am familiar with have undergone certain changes."
Alger said with an assertive tone: "They have been contaminated by the 'True Creator.'"
"Then what should I do?" Derrick asked anxiously. "I have already reported to the 'Chief,' but the 'Chief' doesn't seem to believe me very much."
Even Fors, who was adhering to the principle of speaking less and listening more, couldn't help but remind him, "That's because your 'Chief' suspects that you have been possessed by Amon and are plotting something detrimental to City of Silver."
This made Derrick even more anxious.
Alger pondered for two seconds and then said, "Actually, your 'Chief' should also be starting to pay attention to the 'Shepherd' and the members of that exploration team at this time."
"The reason why your City of Silver has been able to continue to this day is that the higher-ups still have the most basic vigilance. They won't let go of every possible threat. The only problem is that they don't pay enough attention."
He paused and then carefully considered his words, "Perhaps you can use this matter to clear your suspicion."
"Find an opportunity to make a certain exploration team member show enough abnormality and have a conflict with him. In this way, your 'Council of Six' will be able to notice something is wrong and increase their attention."
"And at the same time, you hand over the 'Worm of Time,' saying that during the conflict, you suddenly became dazed and didn't know what happened. You only vaguely heard someone shouting 'True Creator.'"
"When you came to your senses, you had already coughed up that worm."
"Involving evil gods, many methods and abilities cannot be used. Your 'Chief' will logically guess that Amon's clone had a conflict with the mental corruption left by the 'True Creator' and eventually perished into a dead worm."
"The surveillance on you will definitely be reduced a lot because of this. If you behave yourself for a while, the suspicion will be completely gone."
Audrey opened her mouth slightly and thought: Why does Mr. Hanged Man seem so skilled in this area?
Hobert once again sighed inwardly: "This is the true level of the 'Political Commissar'. Yesterday, when I went on an adventure with him, he couldn't even fart for half a day. I even doubted if this was really the 'Original Second-in-Command' of the Tarot Club?
"Thinking about it now, I showed enough strength and toughness from the beginning of the exploration. His caution and silence were the smartest way to handle it. Smart people know when to shut up."
Derrick's eyes lit up as he listened. He felt that Mr. Hanged Man was indeed trustworthy and had come up with such a good idea!
Then he asked, "Then how should I make the members of the exploration team show a sufficiently abnormal state?"
The always taciturn World said, "I have an item here that has been mentally contaminated by the 'Fallen Creator.' I can lend it to you, but its value is very high. If you lose it, you will have to make certain compensation."
Next, Alger finalized the plan for "Little Sun." Derrick prepared to look for an opportunity after returning and prepare for this operation.
At the same time, he knew that he would not be able to sacrifice to Mr. Fool for a while, so he planned to sacrifice the 7 Sequence 8 main materials that he had already exchanged for before the operation to repay Mr. Emperor's previous debt. The remaining 2 main materials would have to wait for a while to repay.
After the "Sun's" matter was resolved, the "World" asked in a somber voice, "Mr. Emperor, do you know any information about Mr. 'Door'?"
Alger was stunned. He had also heard the "Emperor's" description of Mr. "Door" just now. Since he could compare Mr. "Door" with Mr. Fool, does it mean that he is also an ancient god?
Hobert nodded: "In an exploration, I learned some information about Mr. 'Door.' Later, I learned some related information through other channels. I think I have a relatively comprehensive understanding of Mr. 'Door's' intelligence."
The "World" said, "I want to know the relevant information. What reward do you need?"

"The World" added, "I also learned some information about Mr. 'Door', but it is not comprehensive."

Hobert nodded: "Yes, is there any problem?"
Of course, he knew why Fors exclaimed, but he didn't want Fors to know that the "Emperor" was Hobert yet. Even if he talked to Fors about the "Contract Wife", he planned to directly ask the messenger to send a letter and talk to Xio and Fors separately.
Fors quickly said: "No, there is no problem."
She felt that the Emperor's current answer was worth 170 pounds! At the same time, she believed that she was the biggest beneficiary of this transaction, because for her, she needed to know these answers more than other members.
Hobert continued: "During the Fourth Epoch, Mr. 'Door' supported the Blood Emperor and the Tudor Empire. In a battle, He was exiled by the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms."
Klein behind the gray fog: Exiled by two true gods together? I previously thought that Mr. 'Door' was just an angel-level existence, but now it seems that His position is higher than I previously imagined!
Audrey was a little surprised: Exiled by two true gods! In this case, this Mr. "Door" is very powerful. Could it be that he is an ancient god like Mr. Fool? Or is it that as long as the ancient gods with the title of "Mr." are more powerful?
Alger sighed in his heart: This is the second piece of information I have learned about the Lord of Storms in the past two days. Before participating in the Tarot meeting, for me, the information about Him was only recorded in "The Book of Storms".
"Little Sun" Derrick had previously traded information about the seven gods with other members. He knew the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms: Sure enough, the Emperor's information often involves the struggle between the true gods.
The most surprised was Fors, who participated in this transaction for the first time: Night… Evernight Goddess and Lord of Storms? This, this is a battle between gods! Is the ancestor of the Abraham family so powerful? It takes two gods to join forces to exile him? Also, why aren't you surprised? This is a battle between gods! This is the first time I know that gods have some connection with their real-world selves!
After calming down a little, Fors gradually understood: The previous transactions they conducted, the 2000-pound level transactions that the Emperor said, all involved the information of the gods! Oh my god, what kind of gathering am I participating in?
Audrey asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, why did the Goddess and the Lord of Storms exile Mr. 'Door'?"
Hobert smiled and said: "The answer to this question is a gift: because they both supported the Trunsoest Empire of the Night Emperor at that time."
Fors realized that this was actually the relevant content of the "Four Emperors" in the history textbook: Could it be that the war between the Four Emperors involved a war of gods? Hey, why don't you look surprised again? Do you also know these things?
She seemed to recall her experience of not being able to keep up with her classmates' learning progress because she had taken sick leave when she was in school.
Audrey then asked: "The Night Emperor has the support of the gods, why didn't he win the final victory?"
"The value of this question is very high," Hobert smiled and said, "I dare say that I am definitely an expert in this area. Let me think about it, based on the information I have learned, this information is worth at least 5,000 pounds!"
Audrey and Alger were both stunned. This is a whole level higher than the 2,000-pound information! It seems that the Night Emperor's failure is a very critical piece of history in the Fourth Epoch!
Klein: The history of the Fourth Epoch is much more complicated than I imagined!
Hobert then said: "The second piece of information is: Mr. 'Door's current state. Does anyone want to withdraw?"
Fors originally planned to only listen to one piece of information, but now she changed her mind.
Klein was thinking about whether to let "The World" withdraw from the transaction, after all, even if "The World's" senses were closed, the "Fool" could still hear the following transaction.
But thinking about how long he had been getting free information, Klein was really embarrassed to play this kind of trick. The key is that the information given by the "Emperor" is worth the price, making him feel that it is worth paying a certain price.
No other members wanted to withdraw, so Hobert continued: "It is said that Mr. 'Door' liked to roam the stars before becoming an angel. During that process, He was contaminated to a certain extent. After He became the 'King of Angels', He was sealed and exiled in a battle."

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - 376 King of Angels
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"World" asked: "King of Angels?"
Alger then asked: "By whom was he corrupted?"
Audrey also belatedly realized: Such a powerful existence was actually corrupted!
Fors thought of the information she had learned from Mr. Fool and Hobert, and she thought: "Could it be that the corruption of Mr. 'Door' triggered the Abraham family's curse?
"But if that's the case, the Abraham family should know where the curse came from. But the truth is that the Abraham family doesn't seem to know the root of the curse either."
She found that the information she had obtained was not enough for her to make an accurate judgment, so she followed up with: "Is the corruption of Mr. 'Door' related to the Abraham family's curse?"
Alger suddenly looked at "The Magician": Before she joined the Tarot Club, we did discuss the Abraham family's curse, but since then, we have never discussed this issue. Why does she know about the Abraham family's curse? Could it be that Miss "Magician" is a member of that family?
Audrey had a similar guess, and she looked at Fors: She seems very concerned about the answer to this question, is she being troubled by this curse? Why haven't I heard Fors mention anything about the Abraham family?
Fors was a little confused: Why are they looking at me like that... Oops, I exposed my relationship with the Abraham family, but thankfully, it won't cause too serious consequences.
Hobert smiled and said: "I will answer your questions one by one. The most core value of the second piece of information lies in the concept of 'King of Angels'.
"Do you remember the Uniqueness I mentioned before? Well, Miss Magician, and, oh, right, Mr. World, if you want to understand the concept of Uniqueness, you can trade with me or other members.
"I think this information is a very favorable price at 600 pounds, and again, you can't get such high-level information in other gatherings even if you spend 6,000 pounds.
"Okay, let's get back to the topic of 'King of Angels'. A Sequence 1 who accommodates the Uniqueness of that pathway, or accommodates another Sequence 1 Uniqueness, is the 'King of Angels'.
"At first, this seemed like just a title, but later, it gradually evolved into a level between Sequence 1 and a True God."
Klein used his "Clown" ability to control his expression and body movements: So that's how it is, which means that after accommodating Uniqueness, there will be a qualitative change, but it hasn't completely reached the level of a True God.
Alger was a little excited: The Seven Gods should have all experienced this stage, I wonder what kind of opportunity they waited for to complete the process of becoming a god!
Audrey shook her head and smiled: Here we go again, once a week, this is another blasphemy against the gods. If Hobert's blasphemous remarks are put together, it would be a shocking paper for the entire extraordinary world. The title of the paper could be "How to Become a God".
Derrick memorized it carefully. Of course, he knew that this was very, very high-end information, so high-end that the entire City of Silver would not have any records of it.
Fors was stunned for a moment before she understood: Sequence 1... True God, the end of the potion sequence is the path to becoming a god! Oh, my god, this, this is really a blasphemous idea! Why do you all still look so matter-of-fact? What did I miss before? And this, this is a description of the process of becoming a god! It's only worth 170 pounds, don't you find it strange? Is the Tarot Club too high-end, or am I too ignorant?
Soon she had the answer: I am too ignorant!
Hobert continued: "It's not that Mr. Hanged Man didn't ask the key question, but I can't tell you about the existence that corrupted Mr. 'Door' right now.
"Because in this giant hall, we are protected by Mr. Fool, so it's okay. When we leave this hall, it doesn't matter if we only know Her name, but if we know any detailed information about Her, we will be corrupted severely!"
Having the relevant information about Adam and Amon before, Klein wasn't too surprised by this: There seem to be some unknown existences in the astral world? It's more dangerous than I thought! Hiss~ Then Roselle communicated with Mr. 'Door' so many times, wouldn't he also be corrupted?
Alger: There are existences in the Cosmos that can corrupt Beyonders?
Fors: So terrifying! Then it's better not to know.
"As for Miss Magician's question," Hobert said again: "This involves the third topic I want to talk about, does anyone want to withdraw from the transaction?
"Since not, let's continue."
He paused and said again: "In an exploration of a ruin, um, yes, it was an exploration of a ruin, I found a document similar to a notebook.
"It records a saint being bewitched by Mr. 'Door', successfully advancing to Sequence 2, and then being bewitched to go to the astral world and being corrupted in the process.
"I won't go into details about how he was corrupted. Everyone just needs to know that the angel later returned to the real world, and He may still be active in the real world to this day!
"If anyone has a channel, they can report this to the church. His name is: Spike Antigonus."
Audrey said in surprise: "He, He is definitely an envoy of an evil god!"
Klein was surprised at first: That angel is named Antigonus! His experience is so similar to Roselle's!
But then he breathed a sigh of relief: Fortunately, Roselle still had at least some caution, and was not bewitched to release "Door", nor did he try to find Mr. "Door". Wait, it's just that as far as I know, he was not bewitched and did not try to find Mr. "Door". Emperor ended up in such a miserable situation, could it be related to Mr. "Door"?
Alger didn't have any surprises. He has always been in the sea, of course he knows how vast this world is. Of course, a corrupted angel has his hiding place.
Fors: This world is so dangerous! I'm just a Sequence 8, why do you want to let me know these things?
Hobert finally said: "Now I will answer Miss Magician's question. The time of the blood moon is when Mr. 'Door' is awake, and he is trying to communicate with the members of the Abraham family."
Fors thought of Mr. Fool's previous answer to similar questions: He doesn't necessarily want to hurt you, he's just asking you for help!
She smiled wryly: What a deadly rescue!
Fors then said: "Thank you for your answer."
"You're welcome." Hobert smiled, if you agree to be my "contract wife", we would be "a couple", no need to be so polite.

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - 377 Normal Transaction Process
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After finishing the deal about "Mr. Door", Fors belatedly realized that she had spent a full 510 pounds today! This was close to half of all her savings!
She sighed inwardly, 'Fortunately, I'm not in a hurry to advance yet, otherwise my remaining savings won't be enough to buy the Sequence 7 potion formula from Hobert.'
Although Xio had a way to summon Hobert's messenger, and they were very eager to know Hobert's recent situation, they were afraid of being monitored, so they had not dared to write to Hobert.
Seemingly the more active "World" in this gathering said again: "I want to sell an 'Werewolf' Beyonder characteristic, who wants it? How much are you willing to offer?"
Besides Hobert and Alger, the others didn't even know which pathway the "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristic belonged to, but Alger wasn't interested in it.
Although Hobert knew where this Beyonder characteristic came from, he still asked: "Did you kill a 'Rose School' Beyonder? When did you kill them?"
Except for "Little Sun", everyone else had heard of the secret organization "Rose School", but only Alger and Klein knew the main pathways of the "Rose School" members.
"Yes." "World" smiled with a hoarse voice: "You seem to know them very well."
"Well, I witnessed a large-scale battle against them." Hobert answered vaguely.
Audrey was curious: When did Hobert witness this battle, how come I never heard him mention it?
Klein also sighed: "Emperor's" experience is really rich!
The others didn't know Hobert, so they didn't feel anything about it.
"I eliminated this 'Werewolf' more than half a month ago." "World" replied.
Hobert pretended to think for a moment: "1100 pounds! If you agree, we'll trade."
He explained: "Although a normal Sequence 7 Beyonder characteristic is worth about 1200 pounds, I have to wait for a while before I can sell it, and I have to bear certain risks.
"Also, you know, the Beyonder characteristics of this pathway are not 'popular' throughout the entire Northern Continent."
Purchasing Beyonder characteristics above Sequence 9 was a surefire profit for Hobert, but he had lost two sales channels from the Military Intelligence 9 and the Church of the Evernight Goddess, and he needed to find new channels before he could sell them.
"World" immediately nodded and said: "Deal!"
He certainly knew that this was already a very good price, and he knew that "Emperor" was currently in Feynapotter, so even if he sold it immediately, it would be difficult for the "Rose School" to suspect him.
After they finished the transaction, Audrey curiously asked: "Gentlemen, which pathway does the 'Werewolf' extraordinary belong to?"
Hobert said: "'Prisoner'."
Audrey nodded: I've learned about another new pathway.
Fors asked: "Does Beyonder characteristic refer to the substance that condenses on the body after a Beyonder dies? Why is there an Beyonder characteristic?"
She had seen transactions of Beyonder characteristics in her previous actions with Hobert, and knew that it was equivalent to the value of the sum of the main materials of that sequence.
When she and Xio discussed it privately, they seemed to vaguely understand the principle of the generation of Beyonder characteristics, but they didn't know enough about it.
Everyone looked at "Emperor", after all, this was the information that Emperor had peddled at the Tarot Gathering before.
Hobert said: "This is very important information in the mystical world, you seem to know a part of it, I want to know what you already know before I can price this transaction.
"If you are worried about this, you can ask Mr. Fool to witness."
If it was at another gathering, or before today's transaction, Fors would have suspected that this was "Emperor" trying to get information out of her, but not now.
How could the Emperor, who knows so much high-end knowledge, try to get information out of her in this regard?
"Mr. Emperor, I trust you completely." Fors said: "I know that Beyonder characteristics are things that condense sometime after an extraordinary dies, it is equivalent to the value of the corresponding main materials, although it is a bit disgusting, it can also be used as the main material.
"I and a friend guessed that it might be the potion that the Beyonder had taken before, but I don't know why it would re-condense after the Beyonder died?"
Hobert nodded: "You only know the principle, but you don't know the specific laws.
"I think, completing the remaining related laws should be worth about 200 pounds."
"2..." Fors thought about her remaining savings of only 600 pounds: "Um, Mr. Emperor, can I use a chapter of "Spirit World Encounters" in exchange for relevant information?"
Hobert smiled and shook his head: "Sorry, I am not interested in the relevant chapters, if other members are interested in "Spirit World Encounters", they can trade with Miss Magician.
"That is also your knowledge, I don't care."
Alger and Klein had no intention of trading, and "Little Sun" was not very interested in "Spirit World Encounters" either.
Only Audrey was interested in "Spirit World Encounters", and through observing Hobert's body language and tone, she knew that Hobert really didn't care, and seemed to be encouraging everyone to conduct this transaction.
After a little thought, Audrey immediately understood: Hobert should have recognized that Magician is Fors, so he hopes to take care of a friend. But to complete the remaining laws of Beyonder characteristic immortality, it is indeed worth this price, if the price is set too low, it is disrespectful to me, after all, I spent hundreds of pounds before to find out the answer.
So Audrey initiated a transaction with Fors, and after hearing the answer, Fors had a feeling of enlightenment, and understood many things at once.
After this transaction, "World" said again: "Help me pay attention to the mutated pituitary gland of the Faceless Hunter, and the hair of the Deep Sea Naga."
The digestion speed of the Sequence 7 potion was faster than Klein had expected, he estimated that he would have a chance to advance to Sequence 6 before the New Year, so he had to quickly prepare another main material, as well as auxiliary materials that were not common on the market.
Alger said: "I know where to sell Deep Sea Naga's hair, how many strands do you want? The transaction can be completed tomorrow."
Klein needed three strands, but he asked for five, which cost him a total of 500 pounds.
Audrey, who had successfully joined the "Psychology Alchemists", also promised to use her channels to help Mr. "World" pay attention.
The transaction session ended here, and the exchange session began, Audrey said with a shallow smile: "Last week, an interesting case happened in Backlund, two Tarot cards 'Death' and 'Judgment' appeared at the scene.
"The protagonist of this case is called 'Messenger of Death', it is said that he represents the judgment from Death."

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - 378 The Great Adventure of the Emperor and the Hanged Man
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert was stunned, "Messenger of Death"? It doesn't sound as good as "Hero Bandit" Black Emperor, but "Death" should make the spirit body more solid, which in theory should be more practical for Klein.
The other members first looked at Mr. Fool together. After all, everyone just learned today that Mr. Fool has an angel who serves the "Death" pathway, and Tarot cards were left at the scene. This seems to be another case related to the Tarot Club.
Of course, everyone didn't dare to look at Mr. Fool, so everyone turned their attention to "Emperor" again.
Hobert spread his hands: "If I did it, I would only leave the 'Emperor' card."
Everyone looked at each other. Is there a Beyonder of the "Death" pathway here? So everyone thought of that angel of the "Death" pathway again.
Even if the angel wouldn't care about such trivial matters, it must have something to do with that angel.
Audrey had no choice but to continue: "The victim is the wealthy Capim. Many rumors point to him as the largest human trafficker in Backlund... According to witnesses, a gentleman exuding the aura of death and pale white light was seen at the scene. People suspect that he is a messenger sent by the God of Death to judge Capim..."
After Audrey simply recounted the news she saw in the newspaper, Klein behind the gray fog chuckled: "My attendant made a humble contribution to this matter."
Sure enough! Audrey cheered in her heart!
Fors, who had been very concerned about this, thought: This is the second Tarot Club-related thing I have encountered in reality! The Tarot Club members "commit crimes" very frequently.
"Political Commissar" then began to center on the two elements of "Capim" and "human trafficker" to start related brain supplementation.
"Little Sun" was not interested in this, and Hobert smiled: Klein's potion is almost digested!
Klein added leisurely: "He has gained two Beyonder characteristics left over from this incident, and hopes to sell them as soon as possible. The two Beyonder characteristics correspond to Sequence 8 'Sheriff' and Sequence 7 'Interrogator' respectively."
Everyone suddenly realized that this was the Beyonder pathway controlled by the Loen royal family, so everyone started their own associations again.
And Klein was a little disappointed that Miss Magician was not interested in this. He originally thought that Miss Magician would immediately ask for the price, after all, she has a friend of this pathway.
To Klein's surprise, "Emperor" asked again: "Mr. Fool, how much is your attendant going to sell these two Beyonder characteristics for?"
Klein was slightly stunned: "600 pounds and 1200 pounds."
"I want them!" Hobert said almost without thinking.
His next "package of plans to revitalize the territory's economy" requires a large number of Beyonder characteristics. These lovely Beyonder characteristics that can be "reprocessed" by him are never too many.
Even Audrey marveled at Hobert's wealth. He has continuously "acquired" three Beyonder characteristics today, with a total value of 2,900 pounds!
Klein also sighed: Is it true that 'treason makes people rich'?
But then he thought of the reward that "Emperor" earned today: "Emperor" is so rich, it also has something to do with his sufficient knowledge reserves.
After exchanging information about the "Messenger of Death", Audrey asked again: "Mr. Emperor, Mr. Hanged Man, what have you gained from your exploration?"
Hobert smiled: "There are many gains, but also enough thrills."
He began to talk about the adventure experience that happened yesterday. Regarding their hunting operation when they first landed on the island, Hobert described it lightly, as if the two extraordinary creatures known for their agility were as easy to kill as two hens.
Alger added: "The hunting of these two extraordinary creatures was so easily completed thanks to Mr. Emperor's ability."
Klein glanced at the two of them: Before this, "Hanged Man" has been maintaining his position as "second in the Tarot Club". After this adventure, "Hanged Man" recognized "Emperor's" strength and now has the performance of willingly becoming "third".
Audrey also noticed that "Hanged Man" seemed to be taking care of Hobert's feelings.
Hobert continued to talk about it. When he talked about the two-dimensional space, he felt the scrutiny from "Fool", but he had already prepared for this.
At this time, Audrey's curiosity made his previous preparations more natural.
Audrey asked almost immediately: "Two-dimensional space? What a fresh theory."
Hobert smiled: "When I was studying at Backlund University, I established a good friendship with a physics professor because of a trivial matter. Once when chatting, he talked about this theory.
"It is said that the prototype of this theory came from Emperor Roselle, but many professors also believe that this theory is just the emperor's fantasy.
"Because there is a lot of controversy, professors will not talk about these things in class, and generally will not use them in their papers or books."
His statement was well thought out. Alger and "Little Sun" did not go to university and could not distinguish the truth of these words.
Fors studied at a medical school, and Audrey's courses were conducted at home, and they could not verify it either.
Klein is a serious university graduate, but he is a history student, which is a world apart from the physics department! Besides, how can the university in the county compare with the top universities in Loen?
So other members have no way to verify the truth of these words.
Even Klein said in his heart after hearing the name of Emperor Roselle: "Sure enough!"
Hobert felt that the gaze from "Fool" gradually disappeared, and he knew that his rhetoric was successful.
At this time, Fors sent another assist: "I seem to have heard a science fiction writer also mention a similar theory."
Hobert was not surprised. The ideas of some science fiction writers are indeed advanced, because they only care about thinking and don't need to prove it, while some scholars will be cautious enough before they are sure of a certain theory.
He didn't plan to "recognize" Klein now, otherwise he wouldn't know how to get along. It's better to talk about it when he needs to gain Klein's absolute trust.
Hobert continued to talk about it. When he heard the part about fighting wits with the evil god, everyone sweated for "Emperor" and "Hanged Man".
Fortunately, "Emperor" was alert enough and did not let the evil god succeed, and everyone couldn't help but breathe a long sigh of relief.
Then he talked about the experience in the mist. Hearing that even "ghosts" were tricked by Hobert, not only Klein, but other members also exclaimed: Can there be such an operation?
Then Audrey asked first: "Mr. Emperor, is that stranded ship the legendary ghost ship?"
Hobert said: "I don't think it is a ghost ship in the purely mystical sense."

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - 379 The various parties of the Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Even in the Beyonder world, exploration experiences like those of "The Emperor" and "The Hanged Man" are relatively rare.
Hearing that "The Emperor" was going to express his opinion on that ship, everyone turned curious gazes towards him.
Hobert explained, "As far as I know, there is a kind of ghost ship on the sea that has the ability to self-repair, and even the ability to self-drive, requiring only a few crew members to operate it.
"It is said that as long as it does not suffer a 'fatal' blow, it will never sink..."
Alger was stunned; his ship was such a ghost ship.
"There is also a kind of ghost ship that can only be seen under certain conditions," Hobert said. "I've heard of some ghost ships that constantly wander in a certain sea area, and people can only see them in the mist or in extremely bad weather.
"The light on it, on the eerie sea, is as terrifying as will-o'-the-wisps.
"Even if you ignore it, bypass it, and sail for a while, it will reappear in the same way on the path ahead.
"Some people have tried to board such ghost ships to investigate, and they saw circles drawn on the sea chart in the captain's cabin, indicating that it was constantly circling in a fixed sea area.
"Of course, more people who board such ghost ships never return."
The atmosphere in the Great Hall instantly turned cold, and everyone had the feeling that they were listening to Hobert telling a ghost story.
Hobert paused and then said, "I think such a ghost ship can already be considered a creature of the underworld or the spirit world.
"It probably became a resentful spirit-like existence for some reason.
"The existence of resentful spirits is because they have enough obsession. A ship that sailors have poured too much emotion into may also, under certain coincidental circumstances, generate something similar to obsession, allowing it to wander between the spirit world and the real world."
Everyone felt that "The Emperor's" statement was novel, but also very interesting, and theoretically valid.
Finally, Hobert said, "Like the stranded ship we encountered, the sailors and the ship itself may not have realized that they are dead and sunk.
"I don't know if the saint on board is in the same state as the ship and the sailors, but they should be in a very strange state:
"They think they are not dead yet, so they are 'still alive' in the place where the spirit world and the real world meet, still repeating the same work every day. If no one disturbs them, this state may last for a long time."
According to common sense, a saint should not be so confused that they don't even know if they are dead or not.
However, the situation at the time was special. Hobert estimated that when the Underworld Emperor fell, the impact on the "Death" pathway "High-Sequence" Beyonders was very great.
Perhaps that saint lost control because of this and turned into a monster, which made the state of that ship so strange.
After Hobert finished speaking, Fors exclaimed, "Mr. Emperor, your logic is really too strong. Although these are all your guesses, they are convincing."
Hobert nodded slightly: "Thank you for your compliment."
Klein also finally understood why "The Hanged Man" would "willingly give way". The calmness, rationality, and extremely strong logic that "The Emperor" showed in the exploration process were indeed admirable.
He couldn't help but think: Is this the characteristic of the "Lawyer" pathway? Cold-blooded, highly intelligent, with extremely strong logic.
After everyone's praise, they talked a few more words, and this Tarot Gathering ended.
...
Hobert returned to the real world and spaced out as usual.
Then he went out and ordered the chef to make some donuts. The two chefs in the kitchen were both chefs of Viscount Leiter before, one of whom was good at making various desserts.
It was the first time that Sir Hobert had given an order, which made the chef put in his best effort and use his best skills to deal with it.
Hobert returned to his bedroom to write a letter to Fors.
The content of the letter was very simple: I will go to Backlund tonight at eight o'clock to meet with you and Xio. Please be sure to be at home, and there should be no one else at home.
The signature was Hobert.
When the donuts were ready, Hobert tasted one, and the taste was pretty good, so he summoned the messenger.
...
Forsaken Land of the Gods, City of Silver.
Derrick, who already knew he was being monitored, simply sacrificed to "The Fool" without concealment and requested "The Fool's" gift.
After obtaining the item full of "True Creator's" spiritual corruption that Mr. "World" had mentioned, he began to ponder how to find an opportunity to clash with the members of the exploration team.
Just as he was thinking about this, a member of the exploration team actually came to his door!
Derrick immediately realized that while he was suspicious of Elder Lovia the "Shepherd", she was also suspicious of him. This team member should have come to test him.
Fortunately, with the guidance of Mr. Hanged Man, Derrick remained calm in the face of danger. After confirming that there was a watcher sent by the "Chief" in the corner of the room, he began his performance.
He invited the team member into the house and chatted with him. For a moment, Derrick was almost tempted to eat the food that the other party brought.
Fortunately, he knew that this member must have a problem, resisted his appetite, and looked for an opportunity to let the other party come into contact with items with spiritual corruption.
Just as Mr. Emperor and Mr. Hanged Man had guessed, the other party instantly lost control.
In the ensuing fight, Derrick's acting skills were always online. After killing his opponent, he still had the energy to re-sacrifice Mr. "World's" things to "The Fool".
Then he began to cough violently until he "coughed" out the "Worm of Time" and, according to the guidance of Mr. Hanged Man, said that he was mentally trance-like, said that he heard the "True Creator", and then handed in the "Worm of Time".
After the "Chief" heard the report from his subordinate and Derrick's lies, he was indeed fooled, thus clearing Derrick of most of the suspicion.
...
Backlund, Cherwood Borough.
After Fors returned to the real world, she sat alone on the edge of the bed, savoring the information she had obtained from "The Emperor".
Although she felt very sorry for her expense of 510 pounds, she had to say that the information was really worth the price!
As "The Emperor" himself said, only the Tarot Gathering had this high-end information.
Throughout the afternoon, Fors was thinking about the Abraham family and fantasizing about the adventures of "The Emperor" and "The Hanged Man".
Until the atmosphere in the room suddenly turned cold, as if something with great mental pressure had suddenly appeared in the air.
Just as Fors was about to open her spiritual vision, a letter suddenly flew towards her.
She instinctively reached out and caught it, and the huge mental pressure immediately disappeared.
Fors then reacted and threw the letter on the bed. She jumped up, ready to escape outside.
Suddenly, Fors thought of the messenger that Hobert had mentioned. She then mustered up her courage to open the envelope. Sure enough, it was Hobert's letter!
He, he is going to sneak back to Backlund tonight?
Fors realized that this was a big deal, and she quickly went out to find Xio to discuss it.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Town.
Hobert was preparing to complete the sacrifice to "The Fool" before going to meet with Xio and Fors.

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 380 Hobert's Fiancee
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert also came back to his senses after attending the Tarot Gathering: I painstakingly wasted so much effort, and I still have to "pay back" 860 pounds to Klein!
The income regarding Mr. Door's information was a total of 2550 pounds, but 510 pounds of it from "Little Sun" were paid with two Sequence 8-level main materials.
And now "Little Sun" is still "under review" and will be difficult to pay for a while.
So Hobert's "immediate income" is only 2040 pounds, and Hobert spent a total of 2900 pounds at this Tarot Gathering, so he has to sacrifice another 860 pounds to "The Fool."
However, when he saw the three Beyonder characteristics and the seven Sequence 8-level main materials from "Little Sun," Hobert forgot about the 860 pounds.
Hobert recognized three of these seven main materials, which were "Raging Grass," one of the main materials for "Barbarian."
He waited patiently for a while before sacrificing these Beyonder characteristics and extraordinary materials to the "Nation of Disorder" and used the "Power of Chaos" to crush the Beyonder characteristics, allowing them to separate and re-coagulate.
Hobert prepared a little, and at 7:55, he used "Travel" to go to Backlund.
Xio and Fors, who had been sitting in the living room waiting, suddenly saw the space in front of them become illusory, and a familiar figure walked out of the illusion: "Good evening, ladies!"
Xio covered her mouth: "Oh my god, Hobert, what, what was that ability just now?"
Hobert smiled and said, "An ability that Fors will have in the future. It only takes about two minutes to travel from the Feynapotter Kingdom to Backlund!"
Fors shook her head: "It made us worry for nothing. We thought you were going to sneak into Backlund to carry out some sabotage activities. We even prepared to hide in the East Borough for a while after being targeted by the MI9 people."
"There's no need for that." Hobert said, "You moved out of the rental house early, and the MI9 people will only do a simple investigation at most, and will not monitor you.
"And the ability of 'Travel' is very hidden, it is difficult for them to find my trace."
The three people sat around the dining table, and Fors poured a cup of tea for Hobert: "Why did you betray the country?"
If it were ordinary friends, Fors would not ask this question, but with her understanding of Hobert, Hobert would not be angry because of such a question.
"This involves high-level power struggles and unfair treatment of my father by the military." Hobert took a sip of tea: "As for me, I followed along in a daze."
Fors and Xio nodded, which was similar to what they had learned.
Xio asked again: "How is the Feynapotter Kingdom? Is their government department really as inefficient as the rumors say?"
Hobert was stunned: "I don't know much about this. I was made a baron and am now in my own fief."
Fors: "We saw it in the newspaper. I remember you said that your current potion name is 'Baron of Corruption'. Being made a baron should be what you call 'seeking new development,' right?"
"Thank you for paying so much attention to my movements." Hobert paused and said, "This time I came back because I encountered a trouble and needed a very trusted friend to help, so I thought of you two."
This made Xio and Fors very happy. Of course, they would be happy to be trusted by friends.
Fors immediately said: "If there is anything you need help with, just say it, we will definitely do our best to help you solve your troubles."
They had secretly made up their minds that they owed Hobert so many favors before, they must help Hobert with this favor.
Before Xio could express her opinion, Hobert clapped his hands and said, "That's great, in fact, that favor is also very simple for you."
Fors nodded: "You say."
"Be my baroness."
The room was quiet for three seconds, and then Xio and Fors blushed together.
Xio said: "Ho, Hobert, this is too sudden, I mean, you are not even engaged, and you have not even met each other's parents, and your wedding room should..."
"Xio, that's not the point." Fors looked at Hobert: "This joke is not funny at all."
Hobert smiled: "This is not a joke. A secret organization sent a lady to monitor me. I need a baroness to deal with her.
"Maybe it's because I'm too handsome and capable. Many nobles in Feynapotter want to stuff their daughters to me.
"At this time, I realized that I needed the assistance of a trustworthy baroness, so I thought of you, Miss Fors."
"But, but..." Fors "but" for a long time, and didn't know how to describe her current feelings.
Xio didn't know whether to say "congratulations" at this time, or to carefully ask Hobert's views on marriage?
Hobert smiled when he saw Fors's embarrassment: "It's not really becoming my baroness, it's more like a 'contract couple'. You can think of the baroness as a profession.
"Well, I plan to spend 2,000 pounds a year as a reward for hiring you.
"I can lend you a magical item with 'Travel', you can freely travel between Feynapotter and Backlund.
"We declare to the outside world that we are husband and wife, but in reality, we are still good friends, and nothing beyond friendship has happened."
Fors breathed a long sigh of relief, and at the same time, she found that she felt a little lost in her heart.
Hobert drank the tea in the cup: "Sorry, I just scared you, I had no other way but to ask you for help."
Fors thought of her confident look just now, and suddenly felt a little blushing: "Contract couple", this seems to be the beginning of a standard romance novel.
She also saw Hobert's sincere expression, thought of her trust in Hobert, and the idea of repaying Hobert's favor a long time ago.
Fors considered for about five or six seconds, nodded and said: "Hobert, I am willing to help you, but, please follow your promise just now."
Hobert immediately said: "Don't worry, I will pay you 1,000 pounds as a deposit tomorrow morning!"
Fors's cheeks turned red again: "I'm talking about 'contract couple'!"
Hobert smiled: "No problem, since you agreed to help, then I will pick you up in the living room tomorrow morning and go to the fief to adapt to the environment there first.
"Oh, by the way, remember to prepare a suitcase, like you came to my fief from afar."
He got up and said, "Well, you two, I won't disturb your rest."
After speaking, Hobert used "Travel" to leave.
The living room was quiet for a while, and Xio smiled: "Congratulations, Baroness."
Fors glanced at her: "I still lack a maid, why don't you pretend to be one?"
...
The next morning, at eight o'clock, Hobert appeared in the living room again in the costume of a Feynapotter noble.
Fors came out of her room. She was obviously slightly dressed up. The yellow dress set off her slender waist and long legs, and her unique lazy temperament became particularly charming.
Hobert's eyes swept over Fors's figure, and it was no problem to suppress Helen.
He stretched out his hand: "Please, my fiancee, Miss Fors."

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 381 The Mistress of This Territory (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Welcome, Responsible Sloth, to the Church of MissRaven. Here's a bonus chapter]
Leaving the Spirit World, Hobert said to Fors, "You don't need to be so nervous. Look how beautiful the scenery is here. Just think of it as a vacation."
Fors took a deep breath. "This is the first time I've been in such close contact with a man. How can I not be nervous?"
By "close contact," she meant holding Hobert's arm.
Hobert thought for a moment that a girl would naturally be nervous coming to an unfamiliar environment. There was no need to demand too much composure from her.
On the way back to the mansion, everyone respectfully saluted Hobert, calling him "Lord" and secretly sizing up the beautiful lady holding his arm.
Only then did Fors truly feel that she had arrived in Hobert's territory.
Reaching the entrance of the Lord's manor, Hobert loudly announced to the busy people, "This is Miss Fors, my fiancée! She has just arrived from afar!"
"From today on, Miss Fors is the mistress of this territory!"
The people who were repairing the mansion stopped their work and paid their respects to Fors.
Philip breathed a sigh of relief. Although this lady's attire didn't look local, her clothing and grooming showed she had good upbringing.
He just hoped the Lord wouldn't be blinded by beauty. He was truly afraid that one day the Lord would openly marry that seductive woman he kept in the courtyard into the baronial manor.
Helen, who came out to watch the excitement, curled her lips and said, "Holding arms? What's there to be shy about?"
After the two made an appearance at the door, Philip stepped forward to invite Fors to the room prepared for her.
The room prepared for Fors had been cleaned up overnight. It was in the same courtyard as Hobert's room, separated by a study.
Hobert's residence and the main hall had already been repaired, and most of the Lord's manor's renovation was complete.
As soon as she entered the room, Fors felt a wave of heat engulf her. She didn't see a fireplace, but the room was very warm.
The room's decor wasn't very luxurious, but it was very elegant. All the furniture and supplies were new. There were no complicated etiquette or the need to maintain her composure at all times, which made Fors feel much better.
After letting Philip leave, Hobert took out a paper bag. "This is the deposit I promised you yesterday."
Fors smiled and said, "To be honest, I just planned to come and help. Besides, it feels weird to take your money."
"No, this money represents my respect for you," Hobert said seriously. "I know how much determination it takes for an unmarried lady to offer this kind of help."
"It represents both my respect and our friendship. You must accept it, or I'll feel bad."
Fors then accepted the paper bag. "Then, what do you need me to do?"
"Rest first," Hobert said with a smile. "What I need you to do has already been done, which is to make an appearance in front of everyone. I think by tomorrow at the latest, everyone in town will know that the Lord's fiancée has arrived."
"Oh, right, Helen will still be dining with us at the same table for lunch."
"That's your first test. Don't give her a friendly face. You have to show some of the presence of a… the Baroness."
"Don't worry, I'll help suppress her. Don't be nervous."
Fors took a deep breath. "Okay, I'll work up the emotion."
Then, Hobert let Fors rest. He first looked at the progress of the forms and then called Philip to start working on serious matters. "Hire another forty or fifty people. Starting tomorrow, build a tomb for the Wright family."
Philip said, "Lord, we don't need that many people. Twenty or thirty people can finish it in three or four days."
Hobert was stunned and, after inquiring, learned that the nobles of the Feynapotter Kingdom, or rather the nobles of the entire Northern Continent, did not have the tradition of elaborate burials.
The tombs they built weren't very luxurious or spacious, only a few times larger than ordinary people's graves, with a stone tablet and a thicker coffin.
At most, they would bury some of the deceased's favorite toys, jewelry, utensils, etc., or whatever the deceased requested to be buried with them.
Hobert recalled his previous tomb raiding experience. The tomb of that Viscount of the Antigonus family was indeed not large. If it weren't for those traps, the tomb passage wouldn't have been so long.
Moreover, there weren't many treasures in the tomb, and many of the things buried were of little value at the time.
It's just that these things are now antiques after being dug up.
"Then find thirty people and start building a tomb for the Wright family tomorrow," Hobert said. "Have your son Roy help out. You still need to keep an eye on the Lord's manor here."
Philip nodded. "Yes!"
Hobert then said to Seel, "Find some helpers and notify everyone in town to come to the Lord's manor tomorrow to register their household."
"Tell them that after registering, each person will receive 10 nea of grain."
Nega was a common unit of measurement in the Feynapotter Kingdom. Hobert had tested it by hand and found that 1 nea was not much different from his impression of 1 jin (approximately 0.5 kg) in weight.
Currently, Feynapotter only had two units of measurement: 1000 neg was 1 fanea.
Philip estimated that the grain seized from the bandits was at least several hundred fanea.
Hobert certainly wouldn't let this grain sit in the warehouse and rot. In addition to being food for the workers of the Lord's manor, it had a greater use for Hobert.
He instructed Seel, "I don't care what method you use, make sure everyone in town registers tomorrow. You can scare them by saying that if they don't register at the Lord's manor, they'll be considered unregistered and will be taxed double in the future."
"Go to the steward to get the fees for hiring helpers!"
This was the first time the Lord had given him a task, and Seel took it very seriously. "Don't worry, Lord, I will definitely get it done for you!"
Hobert nodded. "Tomorrow, go to the surrounding villages to notify them, dividing them into two groups, and have them come to register the day after tomorrow and the day after the day after tomorrow. In short, the household registration must be completed within three days. You decide how to divide them."
Then he instructed Philip, "Tomorrow, prepare fifteen tables in the front yard. In addition to the repair workers, have all the male servants, gardeners, and grooms put down their work and maintain order in the front yard."
"Prepare enough grain to distribute, and have trusted people distribute it, don't be shortchanging. Also, only give grain to those who have seen in person and have completed registration."
Finally, Hobert instructed, "Find two younger maids to help the future Baroness clean up the room every day, but unless the Baroness allows it, it's best not to have the maids follow her around. You can have the maids take the Baroness to tour the territory."
Hobert increasingly found that the lazy Fors was very suitable for the "job" of Baroness. He had heard Xio say that Fors could go a month without cleaning her room.

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 382 Meeting the Parents (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Welcome, lambda, to the Church of MissRaven. Here's a bonus chapter]
After giving instructions to his subordinates, Hobert returned to his study and took a sip of tea.
The study in the lord's manor had been renovated yesterday, and Hobert finally didn't have to handle everything in the bedroom.
He used "Travel" to once again arrive at Christian's mansion in Feynapotter City. Coincidentally, Christian was home today.
After meeting him, Hobert quickly told him, "I've found a lady to help, and she has agreed to be my wife. You can announce to the public that I will be married soon."
Christian smiled slightly, "It's good to be young, to be able to encounter love at first sight."
Then he asked, "Where is she from? How old is she? What do her parents do?"
"She's from Backlund," Hobert didn't plan to hide anything, "A year or two older than me. Her father is a military officer, currently in the Southern Continent. Her mother has passed away."
Christian instructed Dophis, "Have the kitchen prepare a table of Backlund specialties for lunch."
He further instructed, "Invite that lady over for lunch. The three of us will dine together."
Hobert was stunned, "She, she's in Backlund, quite far away."
"Don't you have 'Travel'?" Christian said with a smile.
"Alright, alright, I'll go ask her." Hobert had originally come to ask Dophis for help, but Christian's interruption completely made him forget his purpose.
Using "Travel" again to return to the lord's manor, he knocked on the door and entered Fors's room.
Fors was still pondering what attitude to take when facing the "witch" Hobert had mentioned.
Hobert smiled and said, "The 'exam question' has changed. You have to come with me to see my father."
"Ah?" Fors jumped up from the armchair, "This, this is too sudden!"
"You don't need to be so nervous. Meeting my father is easier than fighting wits with a witch."
"You, you don't understand," Fors said with a wry smile. This was meeting the parents. Even as a 'contract wife,' meeting the parents was a hundred times more nerve-wracking than meeting a woman who was seducing her man.
But since she had agreed to help, this was a test she would have to face sooner or later.
Fors dressed up carefully again, tidying her clothes meticulously, "Alright, let's go!"
Hobert laughed, "It's not like you're going to your death, relax a bit."
He extended his arm, and Fors naturally took it. The moment she took Hobert's arm, Fors felt as if strength was being transmitted to her from Hobert, making her less nervous and lost.
Taking a deep breath, Fors followed Hobert into the spirit world.
At noon, only Helen was left at the dining table in the lord's manor. She said unhappily, "What's so good about eating outside? Where can it compare to the food in the lord's manor?"
...
Arriving at the count's mansion living room, Fors smiled and said, "Hello, Sir!"
"Hello, hello!" Christian was very satisfied with the young lady's appearance, dress, and demeanor. Hobert rarely saw his adoptive father smile so happily.
Lunch was already prepared. In the huge dining room, there were only the three of them.
Fors was initially a little unaccustomed to being served by servants, but after a few dishes, she got used to it.
The atmosphere at the dining table was very harmonious. Fors breathed a sigh of relief. Christian wasn't as fierce as rumored. On the contrary, he was a gentle and refined gentleman.
Sure enough, some newspaper reports can't be trusted.
The conversation during the meal made Christian very satisfied with Fors's conversation and knowledge. In his opinion, Miss Fors was more suitable to be Hobert's wife than those flashy noble ladies.
After lunch, the three of them returned to the living room, but there was an extra wooden door in the middle of the living room, with Dophis guarding the door.
Christian introduced, "Miss Fors, this is my gift to you."
Saying this, he twisted the doorknob and opened the door. Behind the door was not the scene of the living room, but a scene of rich and colorful illusion.
He smiled and said, "This is a 'Traveler's Door.' By establishing a mystical connection, it can be linked to another door in the Northern Continent.
"I heard Hobert mention that you used to live in Backlund. If you miss home, you can go back through this door at any time."
Fors was stunned, "This, this..."
Hobert thought to himself: Christian really has a Sealed Artifact corresponding to the "Traveler" here.
Christian continued to explain, "I'll tell Hobert the specific way to establish the connection later.
"You can set an opening incantation. Recite the incantation and then open the door. If you don't recite the incantation, even if you open it, it's just an ordinary door."
"This is too precious!" Fors quickly declined, "Uncle, I can't accept it."
Hobert smiled and said, "If he gives it to you, just take it."
"But, but..." Fors glanced at Hobert: But we are a 'contract couple.' The reward you gave me is 2,000 pounds, and just listening to the function of this door, it must be worth, worth thousands of pounds!
Hobert met Fors's eyes: Don't worry, it's okay.
He simply laughed and said, "It's okay, I'll help you accept it."
After chatting for a while, Hobert asked Dophis to hire a railway surveying and railway design engineering team from Feynapotter City. He wanted to build a small railway in the territory. Then he hired a design team. He wanted to build a villa for the nobles to relax.
After speaking, he handed the 1,000 pounds he had prepared to Dophis as a deposit and related expenses. If there was any surplus, it would be placed with Dophis as a reserve fund for the Baron's mansion in the capital.
Fors was secretly surprised. Hobert spent 2,000 pounds in one day. She knew Hobert was rich, but she didn't expect him to be so rich.
In fact, Hobert also felt a little heartache, but some money had to be spent.
Even if Hobert didn't want to digest the potion, he planned to build the territory, which meant he would have a base of his own, which meant more income.
After chatting for a while, Hobert carried the wooden door and took Fors back to the lord's manor.
Hobert first asked the craftsmen to remove the door from Fors's room to the study and replace it with the wooden door he carried back.
Without injecting spirituality while holding the doorknob, this is an ordinary wooden door.
While changing the door, Hobert returned to his room and used "Travel" to go to Backlund.
After working for more than an hour, Hobert shattered the void and appeared in Fors's room: "Okay, you can try it."
The wooden door on the lord's manor side had already been replaced and cleaned.
Hobert reminded, "The incantation you recite when you first inject spirituality will be its future opening incantation."
Fors had already thought about the incantation. She held the doorknob and injected spirituality: "Backlund!"
After the wooden door opened, it was a colorful illusion. Fors stepped into it and only felt a daze before seeing her friend Xio's smiling face.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - 383: The Show of Operations Reappears
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
At the dinner table, Fors was able to handle Helen's attempts to pry information out of her with ease.
She wasn't a naive young girl like Audrey; she knew what to say and what not to say.
As a bestselling author, she had already fabricated a background and identity for herself that morning, and she deliberately let Helen see that she was lying in order to disrupt the other party's judgment.
If Hobert hadn't reiterated before the meal that Beyonder abilities were not allowed at the table, Helen would have used "Charm" to make Miss Fors fall in love with her and reveal her true feelings.
However, Helen could hear that Hobert's words were more of a warning than a reiteration.
Violating his intentions could lead to a breakdown in their cooperative relationship.
At the end of the dinner, Fors wiped the corner of her mouth with a napkin: "Hobert told me you are a guest.
"Since you are my fiancé's guest, I will give you enough respect, but you need to know that I am the mistress of this territory!"
Helen looked at Fors in surprise, who had been very amiable all along. This was a very clear warning: I can tolerate you only because you are a guest, but you also need to know who the mistress here is.
She suddenly smiled: Is this what nobility is like? No matter how kind they seem on the surface, they have a strong sense of 'territory' in their bones.
After saying this, Fors threw the napkin on the table, got up, and left.
Although Hobert knew that this was Fors's performance, he was still captivated by Fors at this moment.
Helen said pitifully, "Your fiancée doesn't welcome me."
Hobert smiled and said, "If there was a man with ulterior motives around Fors, I would have castrated him long ago."
With that, he got up and left.
Helen looked at Hobert's back and muttered, "You two are in cahoots!"
Hobert led two maids to the gate of the courtyard and told them to wait there.
As Hobert expected, Fors was already waiting in the study: "How was it? How was it? Did she suspect me?"
Hobert smiled and said, "You were composed, your acting was superb, I was even frightened by you, of course she was also shocked by you."
After saying that, he opened the door and beckoned the two maids to come in: "The housekeeper found them to serve you. They will live in the servant's room next to yours. I have told them that unless you actively call them, they will not actively go to your room.
"There's nothing to do for the next few days, you can do whatever you want, you can go out for a walk, or you can read magazines in the room or something."
Fors nodded, understanding Hobert's hint that he could return to Backlund in the next few days if he wanted to.
However, thinking of the coldness of Backlund in winter, Fors still preferred the spring-like warmth of the lord's mansion. She was even preparing to let Xio experience the warmth brought by the "Fire Dragon", which was simply one of humanity's greatest inventions. She was very curious as to why houses in Backlund didn't have such a structure?
After Hobert went back, Fors took a comfortable bath in the bathroom. When she came out of the warm bathroom, two seventeen or eighteen-year-old maids were already waiting outside with new clothes.
Fors didn't even have to move, and the maids dried the water droplets on her body.
Then she returned to the warm bed, comfortably read magazines for a while, and before going to sleep, she couldn't help but sigh: This is the life I want.
The next day, the noise outside woke Fors up. She looked at the clock outside, it was already past nine in the morning. If it weren't for the noise outside, Fors felt that she could sleep longer.
Just a shake of the bell would bring the maids to deliver breakfast.
While eating breakfast, Fors warned herself in her heart: I can't be too indulgent, I will be very uncomfortable if I am not the Baroness one day!
So she planned to go outside after breakfast and take a walk around Hobert's territory, continuing to play the role of the Baroness.
At this moment, Fors noticed that her "Trickmaster" potion actually showed signs of digestion!
She thought about it carefully and understood what was going on: "The key to the 'Trickmaster' is 'performance'. I am now playing the role of the Baroness in the identity of Fors, so this is a constant performance for me.
"Another essence of the 'Trickmaster' should be not letting the 'audience' discover their 'techniques', and my performance has deceived many people, including the people in the territory, including that charming witch, so my potion has actually begun to merge with my spirituality!"
For Fors, this was definitely a pleasant surprise. Originally, she had planned to find a circus and be a magician for a while.
With this kind of feedback, Fors's enthusiasm for playing the Baroness has increased a lot.
After dinner, led by two maids, Fors came to the front yard, where she finally found the source of the noise.
The front yard was crowded with people. In the center of the yard, there were more than a dozen tables lined up. Behind each table sat a clerk, and in front of the tables were fifteen long queues, as if they were registering something.
After the registration was completed, someone immediately distributed food on the side.
Some families with large populations received a large bag of food, which made them so happy that they couldn't close their mouths. Some immediately bowed and thanked the lord, who sat imposingly on the inner side of the front yard.
A small front yard gathered at least two or three hundred people, with people constantly leaving and constantly coming in, looking very lively, and the overall atmosphere was relatively cheerful.
Fors asked Hobert, who was sitting there as a decoration, "What are they registering?"
"You can't imagine," Hobert replied, "there isn't even the most basic household registration here. I don't even know how many people are in my territory."
Fors understood, she smiled and said, "A very good way, I mean using food distribution to attract everyone to register voluntarily."
She had listened to Hobert's defenses more than once, and had never doubted Hobert's intelligence.
However, this move stunned Helen, who had been woken up early in the morning, and it took her a long time to understand what was going on.
At the same time, she realized a very serious problem. One of the columns in the household registration was "belief", and many people said that they believed in "spirituality and knowledge", which is actually the belief of the "Theosophy Order", another image of the "Primordial Demoness".
The reason why the "Theosophy Order" has a huge investment here is because there are no churches of orthodox gods here, and they can preach openly.
If it were in other places, the members of the "Theosophy Order" would certainly not easily state their beliefs, but it is different here, because in recent decades, many believers of the "Theosophy Order" have been developed, and there has been no crackdown, so the believers have no intention of hiding their awareness.
The key is that no one would have thought that someone would come to do population registration!
No! Helen immediately realized the seriousness of the problem, she thought she should report it immediately.
