chapters.title: Chapter 384 - 384 Aroused the Witch's Interest
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Demoness of Affliction" Monica listened to Helen's report and asked, "Does Hobert know about this?"
"He already knows," Helen said. "When I left, he even said to me: The Theosophy Order really has a lot of followers."
If Hobert hadn't been smiling at the time, Helen would have thought he was questioning her.
Monica asked again, "Did he say anything else?"
Helen shook her head: "He didn't say anything else."
"Not a big problem," Monica said seriously, "I think tonight, at the latest tomorrow, Hobert will draw a bottom line for us, and you must report it to me immediately."
"Understood."
Watching Helen's departing figure, Monica smiled and said, "What an interesting young man. If I were younger, I would be willing to chat with you all night long."
...
Fors, who arrived near the abandoned church, saw Helen riding her horse back to the Lord's mansion.
But she was immediately attracted by the scenery in front of her: "I didn't expect Full Moon Lake to be so beautiful! What a pity!"
It was a pity that it was in such a remote and poor place, a place that was deserted and supposedly didn't even have shipping.
Fors thought: If the transportation was convenient, this would definitely be a popular scenic spot.
After admiring the scenery, she came to the church.
The maid began to tell Fors about the Baron's deeds of killing the two "Lords" before, but Fors, who was learning Feynapotter, could only understand a rough idea.
Fortunately, she could only understand a rough idea. If she heard the story that had been "re-created" several times, it would definitely make her laugh until her stomach hurt.
From near the church, you could see the entire territory of Hobert. It was said that half of Full Moon Lake belonged to Hobert, as well as so much fertile land by the lake, a small town that looked quite large, and this relatively gentle mountain range, and the valley on the other side of the mountain.
Fors took a deep breath: I am the mistress of this land, uh, the nominal mistress. No wonder Hobert is so concerned about the affairs of the territory. After seeing this territory, I have the urge to build it well.
At the dinner table in the evening, Helen seemed very honest, almost only echoing Hobert and Fors' topics.
This made Fors feel alert, a little abnormal.
It wasn't until the end of the dinner that Hobert said to Helen, "I really didn't expect that nearly a quarter of the people in the town are actually your believers."
Helen became serious, but she admired Ms. Monica very much in her heart. Ms. Monica had predicted this in the morning.
Hobert continued, "I only have four requirements. First, I heard that there are some extremists in the Theosophy Order who believe that the flesh is the prison of the spirit and aim to eliminate the flesh of others. There must be no such extremists in my territory.
"Second, no stupid blood sacrifices are allowed.
"Third, no one can be forced to believe in religion.
"Fourth, believers must not be organized to fight against the Lord's Mansion.
"If I find that you have violated any of these points, then I'm sorry, you will become my enemy.
"Don't question my determination, and don't question my strength, or rather, the strength of my family."
Helen was a little incredulous after hearing this: "Baron, what is your belief?"
You must know that the "Theosophy Order" is a secret organization that has long been on the blacklist of the orthodox church. If someone else went to the church to inform, Helen would not be worried.
However, with the composure and way of doing things that Hobert showed, he was obviously not an ordinary nobleman. Helen was very worried that Hobert, who had some influence in Feynapotter City, would inform the high-level officials of the Earth Mother Church about everything here.
At that time, the church may send people to investigate and encircle and suppress the believers here.
(Helen didn't know that this place easily caused the Beyonders of the "Planter" pathway to lose control.)
Helen thought that this might be an irreconcilable contradiction between the two sides.
However, the four requirements that Hobert said just now seemed to be expressing one meaning: maintain the status quo.
Hobert smiled: "Of course it's the Earth Mother, haven't you heard? I am the Mother's favored one!"
Helen was a little dumbfounded: "Then, then how could you..."
Since he is a believer of the orthodox church, why is he so tolerant of heretics, or simply put, heretics in the eyes of the orthodox church?
Hobert continued to smile: "You can also convey my next words to your superior verbatim:
"For me, faith is just a tool that can strengthen the degree of rule. As long as it is not a faith that harms the spirit and body of my subjects, as long as it is not a faith that destroys my rule, theoretically I can accept it."
Helen realized that she was completely attracted by Hobert at this moment. She had to admit that this was the most charming and thoughtful man she had ever seen.
It was a pity that this man did not fall under the ability of "Charm."
After dinner, Helen rushed to report to Ms. Monica overnight.
After hearing Helen's words, Monica was silent for a full two or three seconds before saying: "Help me communicate, I want to meet Baron Hobert."
Helen was slightly taken aback, but then said: "Yes!"
When she returned to the Lord's Mansion, it was already late at night, so she had to stand in the yard and shouted Hobert's name twice.
After Hobert, who was obviously awakened from his sleep, replied impatiently, Helen quickly stated her purpose.
There was a silence in the room for a second or two before saying: "Let that lady come at lunch or dinner tomorrow, at other times I have to continue to preside over the household registration."
The next day, the household registration statistics of the Lord's Mansion continued. The news that the Baron was distributing food had spread, and some villagers spontaneously came to the Lord's Mansion to register.
When they saw the tall and newly gorgeous Lord's Mansion, when they saw the Baron sitting in the courtyard, when they really received the food, they felt again that the new Lord had arrived!
The new order was established in such a subtle way.
When Monica arrived at the Lord's Mansion in a carriage with her servants, the registration work had just entered the lunch break, and the clerks had gone to eat.
Hobert and Fors greeted them in the yard. Monica looked at Fors: "What a beautiful little girl."
Fors was slightly taken aback: This lady doesn't look even thirty years old... Hobert said she is a Sequence 5, maybe some potions in the middle sequence can make people live longer.
After the dishes were served, Monica smiled and said: "I'm very curious, what kind of young man can say such inclusive words."
"These are just some truths." Of course, Hobert knew what the other party was referring to: "For me, what I care about most is actually rule.
"If it is in a big city, the ruler has to take into account the power of the church. They only dare to think so, but they don't dare to say so."
Monica said: "No, I can feel that you are an inclusive ruler, and you don't regard me as a member of an evil organization."
"Maybe it's because I have a set of governing concepts that they can't imagine." Hobert said: "I think that 'Witches' can actually have another side. For example, 'Demonesses of Affliction' don't necessarily bring pain to ordinary people. Isn't bringing pain to some villains also the act of 'Demonesses of Affliction'?"

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - 385 Persuading Her to Become a Good Wife
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert knew that the "Demoness of Affliction" before him was intelligent enough to understand his words.
He continued: "You should also realize that the Church's power comes from the supernatural, but the Church's strength and potential depend on the number of believers.
"With enough believers, there will be enough fresh blood. Even if the Beyonders suffer huge losses, they can be replenished to a certain extent in the shortest possible time.
"In addition, the power generated by faith, as well as the acquisition of information, the acquisition of wealth, and the establishment of channels, will be a matter of course.
"Although many religious people are unwilling to admit it and don't want to think about it, the fact is that ordinary people are the key to the Church!
"What the Church should be fighting for, or has been fighting for, is the power of ordinary people's faith."
Monica listened very carefully. The high-level members of the Theosophy Order had already had similar concepts, otherwise they would not have tried every means to develop believers.
But before that, none of them had such a clear idea.
Fors and Helen felt that they had heard a brand new theory, so they felt very novel.
Hobert continued: "So the key to the problem is, since it is a struggle for the faith of ordinary people, the image of the Church or clergy among the people will be very critical.
"If you always think about bringing pain, despair, and disaster to the people, of course they will not believe in your teachings.
"If you bring pain to villains, it is an image of despair for evil and a disaster for outlaws, your image will be greatly changed, and people will spontaneously become believers of the Theosophy Order."
Helen quickly asked, "What about joy?"
Hobert smiled and said, "Isn't it joy to make the people you love happy every day?"
As he spoke, he thought to himself: But if you do this, it seems both refreshing and cruel.
Hobert continued: "If countless people come to beg for joy, but are rejected by you, your image will be greatly changed!
"Also, who said that joy only refers to joy in bed? When you recall being in love, wouldn't every move and every look of your lover affect your emotions!"
Helen opened her mouth, this remark seemed to open up a new way of thinking for her.
Monica took a long breath and smiled bitterly: "But the existence we believe in is the terminator of everything. Our core concept is to bring the end and doomsday to this world."
The fact that she could tell Hobert about their beliefs shows Monica's frankness in this conversation.
Hobert still maintained his smile: "Haven't you noticed? Today's orthodox churches, the gods are the gods, and the churches are the churches.
"It's not to say that the churches have no loyalty to the gods, but after the gods have gone to the astral world, it is impossible to manage the churches in every detail. After more than a thousand years, the churches must have developed corresponding independence.
"For us, this is a good thing. Perhaps you have heard such a sentence: Believe in the power of the gods, but do not believe in their mercy.
"Why don't you cut yourselves off in terms of function and concept? The gods are the gods, the churches are the churches, and the Theosophy Order is the Theosophy Order.
"Leave the matter of ending the world to the gods and the Demoness Sect, you just need to do what a church should do."
Monica was stunned for a full ten seconds before saying: "Your idea is very bold, but it is also very pertinent. I will go back and think about it carefully."
After speaking, this "Demoness of Affliction" didn't eat a bite of food, immediately got up and left, she needed time to digest the ideas she had just heard as soon as possible.
In the carriage on the way back, she told Helen: "Don't leak today's conversation for the time being.
"Pay attention to Hobert's words and deeds, this may be a huge change in thinking for you."
...
In the lord's mansion restaurant, the chef was still serving dishes non-stop.
Hobert was holding chopsticks and sighing: The conversation just now always had the sense of persuading a street girl to become a good woman.
Those theories were some ideas that had existed in his heart for a long time, just like the "Rose School", such a path full of curses and malice, can't it still be divided into "Temperate Faction" and "Indulgence Faction"!
In Hobert's view, this extraordinary world, under the influence of the initial gods and the distortion of the Beyonder characteristics, has formed some black-and-white values.
Believing in the "Evernight Goddess" cannot mean believing in the "Lord of Storms", and believing in the "Earth Mother" cannot mean believing in the "God of Wisdom and Knowledge".
Hobert has seen too many people who worship Sakyamuni and also Guan Yu. Of course, more people worship Guanyin, but also paste the statue of the Kitchen God, and paste door gods on the door.
However, such worship is indeed only suitable for a world where "God is in the spiritual realm". In this world where God can influence reality, it is indeed not suitable to believe in several gods at the same time.
But in Hobert's view, as long as witches have positive and upward channels to digest potions, it is no problem to establish a church that can be generally accepted by the people.
Just like the title of "God of Combat" still has descriptions such as "Twilight of All Things", the obedience of the "Lord of Storms" also has descriptions of "Lord of the Calamity", and the "Evernight Goddess" also has descriptions of "Empress of Misfortune and Horror".
Hobert deeply felt that some Beyonders were just stubborn, always thinking about finding the easiest and most labor-saving way to face the distortion brought about by the potion.
It's okay for high-sequence people with divinity, but the key is that some Beyonders who have normal human reason and free thoughts will indulge themselves and gradually lower their moral standards.
If they could put in more effort, their image and their situation would be completely different.
Hobert's words just now were actually expressing his inner thoughts. Although he had only become the lord not long ago, he already had many new ideas.
In his view, any force that is beneficial to him and beneficial to his subjects can be used.
Hobert believes that in the future, there cannot be only one belief in "Earth Mother" in his territory, which will make it difficult to control the power of the church.
While thinking, Hobert filled his stomach. After finishing lunch, he realized that a lot of food was left over today.
So Hobert called Philip over: "Let the people waiting...distribute the excess food to the villagers waiting outside who have not eaten."
He originally wanted to let the villagers waiting outside come in to eat, but the steward and the villagers might find it difficult to accept, so he changed his approach.
Philip bowed and said: "I thank you for your kindness on behalf of the villagers."
Hobert waved his hand, chatted with Fors for a few more words, then sat back on the chair in the yard and began his afternoon "work".
On this afternoon, Hobert noticed that the eyes and clothes of two villagers were not quite right, but he did not immediately investigate, but continued to sit there, acting as a mascot.
After the registration work ended in the afternoon, Hobert called Philip over: "Give the workers a day off, and tell them that the day after tomorrow is the funeral of the Wright Viscount family, and let them all come to attend the day after tomorrow."
Philip felt that the lord's order was meaningful. Although he didn't understand the lord's intention, he still respectfully agreed.
The household registration work continued until Friday morning, and basically ended.
In the afternoon, Hobert only left three tables, which was enough to deal with the sparse people who came to register.
Everyone else began to count and sort out the household registration.
Hobert was feeling the digestion of the potion.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - 386: Household Knight
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert noticed that after three consecutive days of household registration, he had used both kindness and power, but he had only digested one-sixth to one-fifth of the potion.
This was even after every subject had seen him and received food from him in person.
Hobert sighed inwardly: Bestowing favors is indeed not the best way to establish rule. Most of the time, this approach only adds icing to the cake.
Only by demonstrating one's power can a rule that is acknowledged by the people be most easily established.
Of course, this is not to say that bestowing favors is useless. It is not a good thing if "martial virtue" goes too far, but there is no need to bestow favors frequently. Occasional favors can highlight the lord's benevolence.
Thinking of this, Hobert suddenly smiled: If it were someone else, they would have to go through constant trial and error to master how to be a lord without guidance. But I am different. I only need to combine the actual situation with the actions of past emperors, and I can often find a reference.
After 4 PM, under the guidance of three teachers, the clerks finished their statistics.
Hobert sat in his study, reading very carefully. The three teachers who came to submit the statistics stood nervously in front of Hobert's desk, like students who had failed an exam.
Hobert turned the pages one by one. Although the final statistical report was a bit messy, the information he needed was clearly presented to him.
Currently, there are a total of 3367 people in the territory, which is seven or eight hundred more than Hobert expected.
On the last day, some clerks registered at the front, and some clerks made forms in the room, so that the forms were always enough.
Among them, there are more than a thousand young adults. Hobert roughly estimated that during non-farming seasons, his limit is to mobilize 1200 young adults for labor and 300 women to provide logistical support.
The manpower that can be mobilized has far exceeded Hobert's expectations.
Then the preliminary preparations can begin. As soon as the design drawings are out, construction will begin immediately!
Hobert said to the three teachers: "Basically, it has met my requirements."
The three teachers finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Hobert said to the male teacher who had been the most active and contributed the most in the past week or so: "Your name is Conrad, right? Would you like to stay and work in the Lord's Manor? I am going to set up a 'Household Registration Knight' position to manage household registration matters for me.
"In the future, all newborns and household registration changes will be under the jurisdiction of the Household Registration Knight, who will enjoy the relevant treatment of a knight, but without a fief. He will only receive a salary from the Lord's Manor and will be equipped with four subordinates.
"In the future, if any project needs to be carried out in the territory, the Household Registration Knight will have to mobilize the young adults in the town and villages."
Conrad immediately agreed excitedly. Even without a fief, this was considered entering politics and directly serving the lord.
Although another male teacher was a little unconvinced, he did not dare to show it in front of the lord. Moreover, Conrad did do more and was more responsible than him.
Then, Hobert appointed the female teacher as the principal, which made the male teacher even more unconvinced, but he found that he did not dare to object under the Duke's gaze.
Not only that, Hobert also reprimanded the male teacher who was procrastinating and had an extremely improper attitude.
The male teacher was sweating profusely and quickly knelt down to beg for mercy.
However, Hobert did not punish him, only told him to calm down and be a teacher. When there was a need for clerks in the future, he would be asked to come to the Lord's Manor again. As long as he performed well, he would also be given a errand.
After a combination of kindness and power, Hobert ended his work for the day.
During dinner, Hobert said at the table: "There may be some guests coming tonight, you'd better not go out."
Starting on Thursday afternoon, Hobert had discovered three villagers who had disguised themselves to register.
They thought they were hiding very well, even smearing their faces and wearing ragged clothes, but Hobert still noticed that their necks were relatively clean, and they were obviously not used to the local Feynapotter attire.
Helen was slightly stunned, carefully chewing on Hobert's words.
Fors, on the other hand, frowned, wondering why guests would come at night. Then she understood that this "guest" was an adjective, meant for Helen to hear.
Fors asked: "Do you need me to find helpers to help?"
She could call Xio to help.
Hobert shook his head: "I can handle it myself."
Helen was stunned: She can summon helpers?
Hobert also told Philip and Seel: "No matter what sounds you hear, don't go to my yard."
After dinner, Hobert returned to his study and said to Fors: "I estimate that the mercenaries from Backlund have arrived. You'd better go back to Backlund temporarily to avoid them."
Fors smiled: "This may also be one of the tests for me."
Hobert knew that this would be the result. He handed Fors a revolver: "Its ability is to fire bullets that make it difficult for opponents to concentrate. The negative effect is that it is easy to hear some maddening whispers.
"Be careful."
He knew that the mercenaries' main target was himself, and even if Fors stayed, there would not be too much danger.
Fors took the pistol and nodded seriously.
At night, Hobert turned off the lights as usual, but he did not sleep. Instead, he held the Tang knife and sat cross-legged on the bed to wait.
In the second half of the night, his spirituality sensed someone climbing into the yard.
Thump~
Almost as soon as Hobert noticed, the door was immediately kicked open, and two people wearing Loen-style knight uniforms immediately raised their guns towards Hobert's bed.
The entire tactical action from entering the yard to entering the door to attacking was very clean and neat.
But the moment they raised their guns, they were attracted by the murals on the wall. They almost simultaneously exclaimed: "What a beautiful scenery!"
The monster immediately appeared and sent out a curse.
The mercenary who came in first immediately said: "Distort!"
He twisted the curse onto the chair next to him, and the chair immediately shattered.
Hobert judged that this should be a "Baron of Corruption."
The two men fired repeatedly, killing the monster, but they had completely lost their previous advantage.
The monster disappeared, and Hobert's knife was also close.
Fortunately, the two people who served as the vanguard were very skilled and immediately separated to avoid Hobert's attack.
But Hobert reached out and grabbed at the same time as he attacked. The second mercenary who entered the door immediately stayed there, as if he had forgotten to dodge.
"Distort..." Before the "Baron of Corruption" could use "Distortion", Hobert had cleanly cut off the mercenary's head.
The "Baron of Corruption" was secretly shocked. His comrade was a Sequence 7! He was killed just like that! Hobert was much more powerful than the information they had gathered.

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - 387: Don’t Let Him “Prohibit”
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert did not continue to attack the "Baron of Corruption", but broke through the window and took the initiative to attack.
As he jumped out, a "Disorder Stone" had already been thrown towards the crowded place: "Disorder!"
Boom~
A muffled gunshot actually hit the "Disorder Stone" in the dark night, and knocked the "Disorder Stone" into the sky.
Only one mercenary within the range was affected, and no uncontrolled situation occurred. It was just that in the next few tens of seconds, it was difficult to recover combat power due to the influence of the "Disorder Stone".
Hobert glanced and already knew that there were five enemies in the yard.
Fors's door was also kicked open, and there seemed to be figures flashing inside.
There were a total of 8 enemies, 1 had been killed, and 7 were left.
"Weaken!"
Although the "Disorder Stone" did not achieve the intended effect, Hobert still used his combo.
The 5 enemies in the yard were weakened to varying degrees.
At the same time, a solemn voice said: "Corrosion is forbidden here!"
The other party certainly knew that "Corrosion" was a group attack skill. They had several people, while Hobert only had one person. This skill was extremely beneficial to Hobert.
The other mercenaries also took out their pistols and aimed at Hobert.
Hobert had a basic understanding of his enemies. The captain was a "Disciplinary Knight", and the vice-captain should be the "Baron of Corruption" who had just come out of the house.
The one with the accurate marksmanship just now should be an "Pyromaniac". This is the main combat force of the mercenary team. The other three members should all be Sequence 8, and their main method is to use revolvers for auxiliary attacks.
At the same time as the "Disciplinary Knight" issued the "Prohibition", Hobert already had an understanding of the enemies in this battle. At the same time, he opened his arms, like embracing the sun: "Holy Light!"
A huge beam of light fell, surrounding the "Pyromaniac" and two Sequence 8s. After a burst of dazzling light, the "Pyromaniac" retreated somewhat embarrassedly behind the "Baron of Corruption".
The hair and clothes of the two Sequence 8s were ignited by the high temperature. Their pistols fell to the ground. They were stunned for a full two seconds before they seemed to remember to roll on the ground to put out the flames on their bodies.
The "Disciplinary Knight" and the "Baron of Corruption" looked at each other: not easy to deal with.
Helen, who was hiding on the roof in the distance watching the excitement, was taken aback: Is Hobert a Beyonder of the "Sun" pathway? Doesn't seem like it!
She didn't plan to help immediately, but planned to wait and see before deciding whether to help.
The "Disciplinary Knight" quickly said: "This place is forbidden..."
Hobert stretched out his hand and grabbed him. The "Disciplinary Knight" forgot what he wanted to "prohibit".
Then Hobert attacked the two Sequence 8s who were rolling on the ground, forcing the "Baron of Corruption" and the "Pyromaniac" to come to rescue.
The "Baron of Corruption" used the gap just now to complete the process of bribery: "Weaken!"
A layer of black barrier appeared around Hobert's body, blocking the "Weaken" and the "Pyromaniac's" "Fireball". He was about to kill a Sequence 8 with a knife when the "Disciplinary Knight", covered in the light of dawn, rushed over at an extremely fast speed.
The "Baron of Corruption" and the "Pyromaniac" breathed a sigh of relief. According to their idea, the impact of the "Disciplinary Knight" was comparable to a fast-moving steam train. Hobert would definitely avoid it, and the Sequence 8 would be saved.
But what was unexpected was that Hobert had no intention of avoiding it at all. After stabbing the heart of the Sequence 8 on the ground with a knife, he was knocked away by the "Disciplinary Knight".
He directly knocked down a courtyard wall, and bricks and stones flew in an instant.
As the three were about to continue to besiege, Hobert appeared strangely among the three of them and dropped a stone: "Disorder!"
Hobert used "Flash" again, leaving the attack range of the "Disorder Stone".
Circles of invisible black ripples rippled out. The "Pyromaniac" and the "Baron of Corruption" tried hard to resist the loss of control. The "Disciplinary Knight" was affected by the dual effects of "Weakness" and "Disorder", and did not dare to use Beyonder abilities within two or three seconds.
Hobert "Blinked" in front of the Sequence 8 who was affected by the "Disorder Stone" at the beginning, and solved the opponent with a wave of his knife.
Then he took advantage of this gap to grab the "Disciplinary Knight" and stole the ability of "Exile".
He grabbed the "Baron of Corruption" and stole the ability of "Distortion".
He grabbed the "Pyromaniac" and stole the ability of "Wall of Fire".
Then Hobert still attacked the weakened enemy, summoning "Lightning Strike" to attack the "Pyromaniac". The "Baron of Corruption" stretched out his hand and realized that his "Distortion" could not be used.
"Imprisonment!"
A layer of amber-like liquid appeared around the "Lightning Strike" that fell from the sky. The "Disciplinary Knight" was "imprisoning" the lightning strike.
About half of the "Lightning Strike" was "imprisoned", and the remaining half hit the "Pyromaniac" who was in a state of "Weakness" and "Disorder", causing him to basically lose his combat effectiveness in a short period of time.
Helen, who was watching the battle on the roof, muttered in her heart: The second...no, it's the third magical item. Carrying so many magical items, aren't you afraid of the negative effects stacking up?
Hobert then summoned wind blades to attack the "Baron of Corruption" fiercely, and the "Baron of Corruption" dodged in embarrassment.
The "Disciplinary Knight" took advantage of this opportunity: "This place is forbidden..."
Hobert: "Exile!"
The "Disciplinary Knight" retreated uncontrollably outside the yard.
The Sequence 5 level "Exile" once again interrupted the "Disciplinary Knight's" "Prohibition".
Hobert sneered, feeling that his move was really timely. The remaining two trash were not his opponents at all. He turned his head and used the ability of the "Spirit Wine Glass" to accelerate the extraction of the Beyonder characteristics of the killed Sequence 8.
This idea only lasted for two or three seconds, and Hobert immediately realized: Was my brain kicked by a donkey?
The "Disciplinary Knight" covered in the light of dawn had already taken advantage of this opportunity to kick over. This time his strength was even greater, and Hobert flew out spinning.
Even with the blessing of the steel skin of the "Zombie Spoon" and the strong physique of the "Baron of Corruption", Hobert broke a rib.
Flying in mid-air, Hobert suddenly understood that it was the ability of "Arrogance" in "Bribery" that made him produce an arrogant mentality and made the most wrong choice.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, the "Disciplinary Knight" said: "This place is forbidden..."
But Hobert used "Blink" again and appeared in front of the "Disciplinary Knight". The strength of the "Disciplinary Knight's" kick just now was not small. Hobert, who was originally hitting the wall, turned into hitting the "Punishment Knight".
The "Disciplinary Knight" seized the opportunity, grabbed Hobert's arm, and slammed him to the ground.
Puff~
Only a paper figurine was left in front of the "Disciplinary Knight". Hobert used "Paper Figurine Substitute" to break free, and also interrupted the "Disciplinary Knight's" "Prohibition" again.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 388 Cautious Enemy
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
While the battle in the yard was full of twists and turns, gunshots also rang out in Fors's room.
Hobert wasn't worried about the battle there. At most, the enemy would only send a Sequence 7 to deal with Fors. She and Xio had the enchanted revolver, so there wouldn't be much danger.
At this moment, the "Disciplinary Knight" realized that in the previous battle, they had three opportunities to kill Hobert, but Hobert had reversed the situation each time.
It was certain that Hobert had many magical items on him, making it difficult to kill him for a while.
The "Disciplinary Knight" decisively said, "Withdraw!"
It wasn't that he didn't have the determination to defeat Hobert, but they had lost the advantage of surprise. The most important thing was that Hobert himself was much stronger than the intelligence suggested. Entanglement at this time was not the best choice.
The "Disciplinary Knight" noticed that the "Baron of Corruption" was not in good condition. If they continued to entangle, the "Baron of Corruption" would definitely be injured.
After figuring out Hobert's details, it would be safer to find an opportunity to attack again.
These mercenaries had all been on Beyonder battlefields, and they couldn't be compared with the Beyonders of the Tamara family in Backlund who were used to bullying the weak and fearing the strong.
After the "Disciplinary Knight" ordered the retreat, the "Baron of Corruption" grabbed the "Pyromaniac" lying on the ground with one hand and carried the Sequence 8 on his back, whose flames had been extinguished but whose mind had not fully recovered.
Hobert immediately made the posture of embracing the sun: "Sacred..."
At the same time, the "Disciplinary Knight" punched out: "Death!"
This punch was unavoidable, and Hobert simply poured his spirituality into the "Traveler's Blade": "Death!"
He wanted to exchange injuries with the "Disciplinary Knight".
The two of them hit each other's heart. The "Disciplinary Knight" had a rib broken and took two steps back.
Hobert was knocked away again, and a piece of his chest collapsed: the "death" "recorded" was still quite different from real "death".
Under the cover of the "Disciplinary Knight", the "Baron of Corruption" jumped out of the yard with two teammates.
Whoosh~
Hobert's injuries prevented him from using "Blink" in time, and he knocked down a courtyard wall again.
When he stood up from the pile of bricks, the enemy had already escaped a distance.
"Heal!"
The injury on Hobert's chest recovered at a speed visible to the naked eye, and then he rose into the air and chased the enemy in a low-flying posture.
The "Disciplinary Knight's" retreat exceeded Hobert's expectations. In his opinion, the "Disciplinary Knight's" advantage had not been lost. His retreat was enough to show his caution. Such an enemy was the most difficult to deal with. Hobert planned to leave as many of the "Disciplinary Knight's" helpers as possible.
Seeing the four people running away, Hobert immediately said, "Lightning Strike!"
At the same time, the "Disciplinary Knight" also discovered Hobert chasing after him: "Flying is forbidden here!"
As the lightning strike fell, Hobert also fell from mid-air. He saw the "Disciplinary Knight" quickly unfold a scroll, and a bright halo appeared in mid-air, helping the "Baron of Corruption" block the "Lightning Strike".
Hobert sighed: a mercenary squad leader cannot be without magical items.
He didn't use it before, just because he judged that it was not the best time to use it.
Hobert, who had gained nothing, quickly returned to the yard. He came to Fors's room and saw two figures, one tall and one short, and a corpse lying on the ground.
The short figure smiled and said, "I didn't expect Feynapotter to be so dangerous."
Hobert smiled, "The king has offered such a high reward, I am their hunting target before I become a demigod.
Um, I suddenly had a good idea: secretly become a demigod and wait for them to come to my door."
While Hobert was talking, he used the ability of the "Spirituality Wine Glass" to gather the corpses at the door and speed up the precipitation of Beyonder characteristics.
The Beyonder killed by Fors and Xio precipitated a Beyonder characteristic of a "Barbarian".
Hobert collected all the Beyonder characteristics and handed the "Barbarian" Beyonder characteristic to Xio and Fors: "This is your trophy, but you don't need it. I am willing to spend 600 pounds to buy it."
Hobert looked at Xio: "It can also be converted into one-half of the Beyonder characteristic of an 'Interrogator'."
Fors was slightly taken aback: "Can't it be converted into the Beyonder characteristic of an 'Astrologer'?"
Hobert thought to himself: "Wait a little longer, and your teacher will bring the materials to your door."
He said, "It's also possible. I just noticed that Xio's potion seems to be digested soon."
"It has been digested." Xio smiled. "Okay, help me convert it into Beyonder ingredients for the 'Interrogator'. After I prepare for a few more days, I will pay you the other 600 pounds, as well as Fors's 300 pounds."
Fors shook her head. "You killed the enemy mainly just now, this trophy should belong to you."
Xio didn't continue this topic. She already had a plan to give Fors at least 200 pounds!
She said, "The greatest contribution was made by this pistol."
Xio handed it to Hobert reluctantly. "If, I mean if I want to buy it..."
"1400 pounds," Hobert directly quoted a very favorable price.
Generally speaking, magical items at the Sequence 7 level have a premium of 300 to 600 pounds. The price Hobert gave was only a premium of 200 pounds. The key is that after the seal of the "Nation of Disorder", the negative effects of the revolver are not very strong.
Xio nodded and began to calculate her savings. She got the Sequence 7 potion formula from the Masked Man and didn't need to buy it again.
Adding the harvest tonight, even after the promotion, she still had hundreds of pounds of savings. She could consider saving money or borrowing Fors's money to buy this pistol.
At this time, there was a noisy footstep outside the yard, and Xio immediately used the "Traveler's Gate" to leave.
Hobert came to the yard. It was Philip and Seel who brought the male servants, holding sticks or kitchen knives to support the Baron.
After seeing the "scarred" yard, they were surprised at what had happened here just now.
"Bury these four corpses," Hobert ordered. "Repair the courtyard wall again tomorrow, and repair the windows in my room. I will live in Miss Fors's place today."
Helen, who was outside the courtyard gate, rolled her eyes and thought, "Tch, still in the mood to be intimate."
Seeing that the battle was over, she turned and left.
Helen saw Hobert's strength just now. She knew why Ms. Monica said she couldn't kill Hobert. It was true that she couldn't kill him. Even Ms. Monica might not be able to kill this kid!
After the male servants took the corpses away to bury them, the yard fell silent again.
Fors in the room reluctantly said, "I'm going back to Backlund."
Her room in Backlund was so gloomy that she really didn't want to go back.
Hobert smiled, "The bed is big enough, it's no problem for two people to sleep on it."

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - 389 Hobert's Tears (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Powerstone 100]
Hobert lay in bed, unable to fall asleep for a long time. The battle just now was too fast and intense, and the main force of the enemy had escaped, which would definitely be a hidden danger in the future.
He recalled the information provided by Harvey Hayden. The ones who attacked him tonight should be the "Cold Night Squad", and the other two mercenary squads should have arrived as well.
The level of these battle-hardened mercenary squads should be similar. As long as the sneak attack or assassination fails, they will immediately retreat and wait for an opportunity.
In fact, this is not just waiting for a new opportunity, but also putting great psychological pressure on the target, causing the target to consume energy while constantly defending.
Hobert believed that he should take the initiative to attack. Even if he couldn't find their foothold, he couldn't let them live too comfortably.
As for the tactical problems of facing the mercenaries' attacks later, Hobert was not worried, because today, in order to integrate the "Ocean Pendant" into his tactics, he did not use the "Order Wood" from the beginning, nor did he use the ability of the "Spirit Wine Glass", which consumes a lot of spirituality.
So Hobert's strength was not fully exposed. When the "Cold Night Squad" attacked him again, they would find that the tactics they had studied for a long time could not effectively harm Hobert.
Thinking about it, Hobert finally felt sleepy.
Unfortunately, Fors eventually returned to Backlund. Between Hobert's half-sleep and half-wakefulness, he smelled the faint fragrance left on the quilt and fell into a deep sleep.
"Get up!" Fors returned to the Lord's Mansion early in the morning. After living here for a few days, she felt that Backlund was an ice cellar.
Hobert yawned, stunned for a few seconds, and it took him a long time to come back to his senses. He didn't expect that he would be woken up by the lazy Fors one day.
He really had to get up early today. Hobert returned to his room and changed his clothes.
As the winter sun just rose, he took Fors and walked heavily towards the Wright family's cemetery.
On the way, they met many people who came to attend the funeral. Some were residents of the town, some set off from the village before dawn, and some were not even people from Hobert's territory.
Previously, Philip and others had only hastily buried the Viscount's family. Yesterday, they had dug up the bones and re-coffined them into newly made coffins.
The cemetery was already surrounded by layers of people, but the scene was relatively solemn. No one was shouting loudly. Everyone quietly watched the new lord and lady walk slowly with heavy steps.
When Hobert and Fors arrived, the funeral officially began.
Because there was no bishop or priest from the Church of the Earth Mother, Philip presided over the funeral, and the new lord Hobert delivered a eulogy.
Hobert first expressed his respect for the Wright Viscount family, and then recounted how difficult the residents of the territory had lived in the six years since they lost the protection of the lord.
Speaking of this, Hobert choked up several times, which made the surrounding people cry. The previous six years were indeed like living in hell.
They worked tirelessly, but the harvest from the fields was still not enough to pay taxes, so they could only use the poultry and fields at home to offset the taxes, and life became more and more poor.
Helen, who was watching from a distance, didn't know what expression to use to face such a scene. She almost couldn't recognize that the person with red eyes and two tears was Hobert?
Helen thought: He definitely has schizophrenia. He was so fierce last night, but today he is acting so convincingly, it's like two different people!
At this time, Hobert changed the subject and talked about his revenge for the Wright Viscount family, talked about the benevolent government he implemented, and painted a beautiful blueprint for the future.
Hobert promised: As the successor of the Wright Viscount, he will inherit the virtues of the Wright Viscount, make this territory better, and make people's lives happier. The Wright Viscount can rest in peace.
Driven by Hobert's words, the people who came to attend the funeral seemed to see hope, and they all sighed that all the misfortune had passed.
After Hobert's speech, the coffins of the Wright Viscount family were carried into the tomb one after another, and finally the tomb was closed. Everyone offered flowers and mourned together for a few minutes before the funeral ended.
On the way back to the Lord's Mansion, Hobert felt that everyone's attitude towards him had changed significantly.
From the original simple fear to the current respect.
Hobert also felt that the potion in his body had digested a lot again, and even more than the household registration process.
This made him sigh in his heart: "In fact, the Wright Viscount was not a very wise lord, otherwise he would not have died so miserably, but the previous six years were too hard, so everyone had a deep nostalgia for the days of the Wright Viscount era, and then the Wright Viscount became a wise lord.
"Fortunately, I have the concept of 'inheriting the orthodoxy'. Using this funeral, and taking advantage of everyone's nostalgia for the Wright Viscount, I transferred the orthodox rule to me. In this way, whether in law or in people's minds, I am the unshakable lord of this territory."
Life must continue, but the people in this territory feel more confident than before, because they have a new lord to rule, and they are no longer ruled by a group of unreasonable robbers. Both production and life are more at ease than before.
Soon, Helen also felt this. While she was surprised by the effect of Hobert's two tears, she planned to immediately report Hobert's words and deeds to Ms. Monica.
For Helen, who doesn't have a high level of political literacy, this is like using Beyonder abilities to hypnotize people.
Fors, who was following Hobert, also decided that she would write a book about how a baron built a poor territory into a beautiful and rich one.
There was no way, Hobert kept providing her with material, so she didn't have to worry about not having a subject for her new book.
After hearing Fors's idea, Hobert decided to sponsor the "Baroness's" career: "As long as you can write it, I can't help you in the Loen area, but here in Feynapotter, I will definitely contact the largest publisher in the country to publish your new book."
He was worried about how to promote his territory in the future, but he forgot about the writer lady next to him.
"From now on, you will follow me and understand all my policies." Hobert instructed: "The speed of the new book must be fast. It is best that everything in the territory is just built up, and the new book is completed."
Fors scratched her head and smiled. In fact, she only had this plan. The previous book about a lawyer with Hobert as the prototype was only one-third written. The new book would be written "when there is a chance".
But looking at Hobert's happy appearance, she was embarrassed to tell the truth, so she could only agree first, and was pulled by Hobert to the main hall to observe him handling government affairs and accumulate material.
After the main hall of the Lord's Mansion was repaired, Hobert handled official business in the main hall. He first called Philip: "The next step is to repair the church on the top of the mountain.
"Don't stop, keep building!"

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 390 Hobert's New Order (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Congratulations to Tshepang Letsoele for advancing to Sequence 9: Reader, +5 bonus]
Hobert had mature political and economic ideas, and investment and construction could not be stopped for a moment.
Since it was difficult for this backwater to get foreign investment, the lord would have to keep investing.
Hobert planned to spend the more than nine thousand pounds he had saved up, equivalent to more than eleven thousand gold Lire, first!
If that wasn't enough, he still had gold and so many Beyonder characteristics, so he had to keep investing and improve the economic situation of the territory at the same time.
Through observation during this period, Hobert discovered that the corruption from the lake was similar to that described by Bishop Simpson, and now that he had the "Ocean Pendant", he planned to explore the lake in the next day or two.
Phillip reminded him: "There are not many building materials left in the territory, and they need to be bought from other places."
Hobert nodded: "Go and call Wayne!"
While summoning Wayne, Hobert stayed in the study for a few minutes, and then returned with a delicate sword in his hand.
He handed the sword to Seel: "You did a good job, this is a reward for you."
Hobert was referring to the fact that Seel had done a good job in calling people to the lord's mansion during the household registration.
Seel happily took the sword with both hands: "Thank you for your reward, Lord."
Hobert added: "From now on, you will be my captain of the guard. Go and organize seven or eight helpers, and take turns guarding in front of the lord's mansion."
Seel quickly knelt down to express his loyalty.
"Get up." Hobert smiled: "The first task as the captain of the guard is to go around the town and villages and warn the people that bandits have recently infiltrated. If you see any unfamiliar faces, report them to the lord's mansion immediately.
"If it is determined that they are bandits, the lord's mansion will give the reporter a reward of no less than 10 silver Solas."
After all, this was Hobert's territory. As long as the people in the territory were mobilized, the three mercenary teams would not dare to act openly.
Then, if they wanted to launch an attack again, they would have to travel at least twenty or thirty miles to reach the lord's mansion.
"Yes!" Seel, who received the order, left the main hall with a proud look on his face, holding the sword.
Soon Wayne came to the main hall, and Hobert said: "I have some dried fruits that need to be sold, and some building materials need to be purchased in the territory. I need someone to help me run errands. Are you willing to accept this errand?
"You can continue to run the boat. As long as it doesn't delay the lord's mansion's expenses, you can come to the lord's mansion every week to receive a salary."
Wayne quickly said: "It is my honor to serve you."
Hobert nodded: "I will send you an assistant and a clerk.
"The assistant will help you drive the steamship, and the clerk will be responsible for bookkeeping. Set off after the manpower is sent out."
Watching Wayne leave, Hobert asked Roy, who was standing at the door of the main hall, to ask Phillip to arrange manpower for Wayne, and call the "Household Registration Knight" who had just been conferred yesterday.
Conrad was now working in the lord's mansion, and came to the main hall in just a minute or two.
Hobert said: "Although the household registration work is over, your work has just begun.
"Don't dismiss the clerks who made the records before. There will be places where they will be used next. They will all be under your command for the time being.
"Your first job is to count the shops in the town. If they have already closed down, buy them in my name. Roy will follow behind you to pay. If you can't find the shop owner, confiscate them.
"If they are still in business, make a record on the corresponding household registration to confirm the property rights."
He paused and said: "Then you have to count the houses in the town and register them on the relevant household registration. All ownerless houses will be confiscated.
"After completing these tasks, you have to measure the land around the town and villages and register the corresponding fields.
"At the same time, you have to explain one thing to the town residents and villagers: from now on, if there is a transaction of fields, you must report to the lord's mansion to have legal effect, otherwise I will not recognize the transaction as valid."
While Hobert spoke, Conrad took notes. Although he didn't quite understand the purpose of what the lord was doing, he just had to do it.
After issuing several decrees in a row, Hobert drank a cup of tea to rest.
Fors, who was taking shorthand on the side, took this opportunity to ask: "What is the purpose of registering field transactions in the lord's mansion?"
She always felt that Hobert had a big plan in this matter, but she didn't quite understand what he was planning.
"Of course, it is to indirectly obtain the ownership of all the fields in the territory!" Hobert smiled: "From a legal point of view, all the arable land in the territory is my private property, and it is only lent to the people for cultivation, so the people have to pay taxes.
"But this kind of legal principle cannot be put on the surface, it can only indirectly make the people realize this."
Fors frowned: "These legal principles seem, seem a little inhumane."
"Sometimes maintaining rule is to be inhumane." Hobert said seriously: "This is the only way to concentrate power to the greatest extent and do things that individuals cannot achieve.
"And if it is a mess, relying only on individual strength to carry out infrastructure construction, it is impossible to complete."
"Okay." Fors smiled: "It seems I am not suitable for politics."
She asked again: "What are you going to do with so many shops? I went to the town the day before yesterday, and the town residents have been exploited for six years and have no money to buy things at all."
"That's why I want to acquire shops, and that's why I want to keep building." Hobert smiled: "When everyone has money in their hands, they will have the idea of spending.
"I will reopen the shops I acquired before, and control the prices, or rent them to individuals at low prices, and the market will soon prosper.
"But I plan to make large-scale renovations, transforming them into hotels and inns, restaurants. After the town prospers, tourists will definitely flock here."
Fors said in her heart: This is difficult.
At least Fors didn't see any hope, but she didn't want to dampen Hobert's enthusiasm, so she didn't tell the truth.
She also planned to do her best to help Hobert achieve this goal, and it didn't matter if it couldn't be achieved, they had worked hard.
...
Southern Continent, Hodis Copper Mine.
Elliot and other family members waited by the roadside early today to welcome the family elder who came to inspect.
At about nine o'clock, they finally saw the convoy consisting of three carriages.
The convoy drove slowly to the front and stopped in front of Elliot and others.
Elder Calvin got out of the middle carriage: "My God, how can there be so many wooden houses in the Hodis Copper Mine!"
"That's where the slaves live," Elliot explained: "Living in wooden houses helps them maintain their physical strength."
Although everyone knew that Elliot was a believer of the "Creator", after all, the copper mine was a family property, and the "Creator's" instructions still had to be concealed.
Elder Calvin came to inspect the operation of the copper mine this time. After a simple greeting, the inspection process officially began.
After visiting all morning, everyone had lunch together.
In the afternoon, Calvin called Elliot to the room prepared for him for a private conversation.
Calvin went straight to the point: "We now need the help of the 'Creator'."

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 391 New Business Arrives (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Calvin said: "The 'Rose School' is retaliating for our previous ambush by sending many forces to Crowley City to investigate us. If this continues, our cooperation with the Feysac people will be exposed sooner or later.
"So the elders plan to ambush the 'Rose School' again, but this ambush will definitely not be as smooth as the last one.
"We guess that they may be able to invite a 'Disciple of Silence' or even angels to Crowley City at any time, so we want to ask for the help of the 'Creator'."
Elliot was slightly taken aback: "Wait a moment, I will go back and pray to the 'Creator'."
...
After dealing with official business, Hobert returned to his study to catch up on sleep, and Fors returned to her room to sort out her new book ideas.
In a daze, Hobert heard someone praying in the "Nation of Disorder". He yawned, locked the door, and entered the "Nation of Disorder".
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert saw the star representing Elliot was expanding.
What happened at the copper mine again?
Hobert spread his spirituality over and heard Elliot relay what Calvin had just said.
Angels!
Hobert's first reaction was to be a little scared, but then he thought that he could summon two angel-level monsters, and he felt that this was an opportunity to show the power of the "Creator".
It's just that those monsters don't listen to his commands and will attack indiscriminately.
He had to choose a good battlefield, otherwise many innocent ordinary people would die.
Thinking that the patriarch of the Balk family would not allow the "Rose School's" angels to descend on the city, there was quite some room for manipulation, at least there was no problem in entangling the other party's angels.
There was no problem in terms of strength, the problem was that the other party's way of inviting was too disrespectful to the "Creator".
So Hobert said to Elliot: "I will only help my Blessed and believers."
...
Southern Continent, Hodis Copper Mine.
After hearing the "Creator's" reply, Elliot was first excited: I am the "Creator's" Blessed, so He is willing to help me.
But then, Elliot was a little helpless. Although he already knew that the family's curse had nothing to do with the "Rose School", the two sides had been killing each other for so many years, and hatred had already been created.
So in fact, Elliot was expecting the "Creator" to provide some help, but then he thought about it, Calvin's invitation was indeed a bit hasty.
Thinking about the "Creator's" reply just now, Elliot understood the "Creator's" meaning, and he immediately went back to tell Calvin the "Creator's" reply.
Calvin obviously expected it: "The patriarch promised that we can offer all the spoils of war as a reward."
Elliot smiled and said: "Would the 'Creator' be interested in these things? Don't forget, the 'Creator' was willing to accept sacrifices before just because I am His Blessed."
Calvin was a little embarrassed: "Then what should we do?"
"Of course, it is to devoutly believe in the 'Creator'." Elliot said: "Even if you don't believe in the 'Creator', it is basic politeness for the patriarch to ask the 'Creator' for help."
Calvin thought for a while: "I will tell the patriarch."
Then he asked: "Haven't you digested the 'Bribers' potion? Why haven't you been promoted yet?"
"No potion."
"Ask the 'Creator' to bestow it!"
Elliot smiled bitterly: "I am really embarrassed to trouble the 'Creator' with these trivial matters."
Calvin smiled: "Of course it is not to trouble the 'Creator'. Doesn't the 'Creator' also have other Blessed? Or do other Blessed have corresponding main materials that are about to be sold?"
Elliot thought about it, that's indeed the case, just like the gold that was sacrificed to the "Creator" before, the "Creator" doesn't need gold, it must be needed by the "Creator's" Blessed.
"I can try to pray to the 'Creator'." He said: "If other Blessed have corresponding potions, can I buy them with the gold from the copper mine?"
As the person in charge of this copper mine, Elliot's income is very considerable, but he has not yet reached the accumulation to buy Sequence 6 potions.
Calvin sighed: "Of the family's three industries, only the Hordiss Copper Mine is in a profitable state.
"In a few days, the family will send a group of young disciples to learn your management experience. As a reward for you, you can use the copper mine's funds to purchase the main materials or Beyonder characteristics of the 'Baron of Corruption' potion."
The Balk family used to do killing business, where would they have any mining management experience? The other copper mine and forest farm have basically been in a state of shutdown.
Elliot asked and found out that they were too harsh on the slaves, resulting in an outbreak of plague and a large area of death among the slaves, and new slaves could not be replenished immediately, so they had to stop work.
This made Elliot rejoice that he had the "Creator's" reminder, otherwise the performance of the Hodis Copper Mine would not be so outstanding.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffrey Town.
After spending a morning, the windows in Hobert's bedroom were finally replaced, which gave him a place to take a comfortable nap.
After waking up, he heard someone praying in the "Nation of Disorder" again.
Coming to the "Nation of Disorder" again, he found that the person praying was Elliot again.
Hobert spread his spirituality over: "...Great 'Creator', Elder Calvin has left, thank you for your reminder, the slaves eat coarse grains and live in wooden houses, maintaining enough physical strength and resistance, so there has been no plague and a large number of deaths.
"There is also a small matter to trouble you, thanks to your help, my 'Bribers' potion has been digested, I don't know if your other Blessed have 'Baron of Corruption' potions or Beyonder characteristics for sale?
"I will pay the relevant remuneration in the form of gold."
Retracting his spirituality, Hobert looked at the stone platform emitting a radiant glow, he really had an Beyonder characteristic of the "Baron of Corruption", this Beyonder characteristic came from the "contribution" of the Tamara family.
This Beyonder characteristic is currently useless, but it can be sold to Elliot through a "small account", but it has to wait until the evening, after all, the "Creator" will not pay too much attention to this level of transaction, it must be to help the Blessed convey it by the way.
Hobert found that recently, by observing Mr. "Fool's" actions, it has been of great help in how to be a good evil god.
After dinner, Hobert used the way he prayed to himself to indicate that he had the Beyonder characteristic of the "Baron of Corruption", asking price is 800 ounces of gold, worth about 3000 pounds.
Who knew that just after entering the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert first saw the star representing Rafter expanding.
Spreading his spirituality over, he only heard Rafter say: "...Great 'Creator', I offer you a treasure, a treasure buried deep under Backlund.
"My family declined because of this treasure."

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 392: Treasure for the Founder (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The treasure Rafter was talking about was, of course, the ruins where Medici lingered.
In his prayer, Rafter concluded, "...Your humble servant only hopes to obtain the Beyonder characteristics of 'Baron of Corruption' and 'Mentor of Disorder' from within.
"These Beyonder characteristics are the legacy of my family, and the evil spirit inside must be guarding even more valuable treasures.
"If you are interested, I will take you near that treasure, and I will dedicate everything there to you!"
Withdrawing his spirituality, Hobert smiled. He was almost embarrassed to use Rafter as a "pawn" anymore. How could Rafter deliver himself into his hands?
If Rafter was willing to "explore," he could consider harvesting the Beyonder characteristics there.
Although Medici's evil spirit could be related to Adam, Hobert remembered that when Medici left Backlund, he didn't take the Beyonder characteristics from the ruins.
In other words, even if Medici was crucial to Adam's story, Adam didn't need those Beyonder characteristics.
But those Beyonder characteristics were a considerable wealth for the "Pseudo-Evil God" Hobert. Even if he took those Beyonder characteristics, it wouldn't attract too much attention from Adam.
However, this action had two difficulties. The first was to use enough power to deter Medici. Considering that Medici should have power close to a demigod, it would be necessary to use the image and power of the "Creator" to deter him.
This led to the second problem: if he used the "Creator's" ability in Backlund, it would easily attract George III and the attention of some demigods.
Therefore, it was impossible for Hobert to go to the ruins himself and then summon his own power, as George III could easily corner him in the ruins.
But if he didn't use the "Creator's" power, it would be difficult to deter Medici. Those three angel kings and angels who had lived for thousands of years couldn't be fooled without real strength.
If Hobert went alone, it would be equivalent to being a "transport captain," delivering Beyonder characteristics and mystical items to Medici.
Therefore, Hobert had long had the idea of meeting Medici, but he had never gone to those ruins, preferring to wait until Medici left and before the Church destroyed the place to harvest those Beyonder characteristics.
Now that he had Rafter as a "vanguard," this plan could be implemented, and who knew, he might even get a "Blasphemy Card."
Medici now only had his Sequence, but even if his Sequence was high, could it be higher than the "Nation of Disorder?"
And Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne," even had a good chance of killing Medici, but that would be a losing proposition.
Even if there was danger, it was Rafter who was in danger. Hobert could completely minimize the risk.
After thinking for a while, Hobert felt it was feasible. After considering the specific plan, Hobert said to Rafter, "Tell me the details of that evil spirit."
...
When Rafter decided to dedicate the treasure to the "Creator," he had the idea of making a desperate gamble.
His gambling experiences over the years had made him accustomed to seizing opportunities and making all-or-nothing bets.
But during the waiting period, Rafter was still a little nervous, a little excited, and a little scared.
Nervous about whether the "Creator" would agree? Excited that if he agreed, he could take those two Beyonder characteristics and leave Backlund, giving him a chance to restore his family's honor.
As for fear, it was entirely due to fear of the unknown and powerful "Creator."
Fortunately, the "Creator" didn't make him wait too long: "Tell me the details of that evil spirit."
Rafter breathed a sigh of relief, then perked up and began to tell him what he knew about the evil spirit.
"So it's Him!" the "Creator" said.
In fact, no matter what Rafter said, Hobert would say this, which meant: I care about that evil spirit, I don't care about the treasure at all.
Rafter's eyes narrowed as expected: The "Creator" knew that evil spirit! It seemed that the family's records were true, that the evil spirit was originally a powerful ancient figure.
"I'm starting to get interested in that treasure," Hobert said in a relaxed tone. "Prepare an altar..."
Rafter prepared an altar as instructed and recited the relevant incantations. The two bronze doors suddenly appeared and quickly disappeared.
But there was one more thing on the altar. Rafter was very familiar with that thing. It was the black crystal mask that the "Creator's" Blessed had lent him before.
The simple but heavy-looking crystal seemed to have streamers flashing under the light. On the forehead of the mask was the mystical symbol representing the "Creator," giving the mask a bewitching and sacred beauty.
The "Creator's" voice reappeared in Rafter's mind: "Lead the way!"
"Yes." Rafter put on the mask, checked the tightly bound clothes on his body, jumped out of the window, and ran wildly in the night.
Hobert used this time to sacrifice some mystical items to the "Nation of Disorder" in the way he sacrificed to himself.
Returning to the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert waved his hand and placed the skull of the "Woolly Golden Horned Evil Creature" next to the "Iron Throne" for later use.
To deal with the current Medici, at most he could use "Bull Demon King."
The other two angel-level monsters could show the Sequence of the "Creator," but they were difficult to control, and it was likely to cause a bigger joke.
Of course, Hobert also knew that he should avoid using "Bull Demon King" if he could, otherwise it would be too degrading for the dignified "Creator" to have only a demigod serving him.
Soon, Rafter came to an abandoned small church, and he prayed again: "...Great Creator, the treasure is below, I have dug several times before, but I have not been able to dig through."
At this time, his eyes suddenly blurred, and when he came back to his senses, it was dark in front of him. He quickly lit the prepared lantern.
Under the light, Rafter found that he had come to an ancient ruin.
In the surrounding passage, there were metal round rods hanging from the height, and its low end was a candlestick carved into different creatures.
"Inverted candlestick!" Rafter said excitedly. Over the years, he had read many related books and knew that inverted candlesticks were a symbol of Fourth Epoch architecture.
He realized that he had come to the ruins.
Rafter could only describe the means by which the "Creator" sent him down as a miracle.
This was actually Hobert using the "Teleportation Statue" to send him down.
Walking forward, Rafter saw two parallel black thrones, the two thrones were high, overlooking the entire hall.
Behind the throne was a row of stone doors. Rafter seemed to be attracted by something and immediately saw the two bloody double doors.
With the gaze of the "Creator," Rafter boldly came to the door. Just as he was about to push the door open, he suddenly felt as if the surroundings had darkened, as if a black shadow was approaching rapidly.
An unprecedented sense of fear filled Rafter's heart.
At this time, Hobert said in a solemn voice, "Medici, it really is you!"
The black shadow stopped abruptly.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 393: Battle of Wits with the Red Angel (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Rafter wanted to laugh out loud. First, he wanted to laugh at the evil spirit in front of him!
The notes left by his grandfather the patriarch had warned him to be careful and not try to use force against the evil spirit, as previous family members had suffered for it.
He was to treat the evil spirit in the ruins with the same respect as a king, because the Pound family no longer had the strength to deal with the evil spirit, nor any other way, and could only gamble that the evil spirit would cooperate.
Rafter was very young when he received this notebook and didn't quite understand what it meant. Later, as he grew older, he realized how terrifying the evil spirit's power was.
Two Sequence 5s, three Sequence 6s, and two Sequence 7s, in three waves, explored and attempted to eliminate the evil spirit. The third wave even held a Level 1 Sealed Artifact, but they were still annihilated by the evil spirit.
This experience was recorded in detail in the notes. The evil spirit was very cunning. The main force of the first wave of family members to explore was a Sequence 6 and a Sequence 7.
After exploring for a while, the Sequence 7 returned to report: there is an evil spirit underground, but it is not difficult to deal with.
So the best in the family, a Sequence 5, led a Sequence 6 and a Sequence 7 to try to eliminate the evil spirit.
Before long, the Sequence 6 returned to report: the evil spirit is about to be eliminated, but we need support.
Only then did the current patriarch feel relieved and let the family heir, with a Level 1 Sealed Artifact, lead another Sequence 6 to support them. But a day and a night passed, and no one returned.
The patriarch then realized that he had been tricked. His guess was written in the notes: Rotol (the Sequence 7 who returned to report the first time) was likely possessed by the evil spirit, luring more family members into the ruins. Amida (the Sequence 6 who returned to report the second time) was likely deceived by the evil spirit.
The patriarch's notes also speculated: this evil spirit has extremely high intelligence, at least at the level of a demigod.
At this time, Rafter could feel the surprise shown by the evil spirit, and he couldn't help but sigh: this is the strength of the 'Creator'.
Rafter also wanted to laugh at himself. Why had he hesitated for so long? He should have dedicated this treasure to the 'Creator' long ago! Those Beyonder characteristics and sealed artifacts were too low-level for the 'Creator' and of little use.
As long as he served the 'Creator' well, the 'Creator' would very likely reward him with those sealed artifacts and Beyonder characteristics belonging to the Pound family.
While Rafter was thinking of laughing, Hobert used the star representing Rafter to project his image into the underground ruins.
Rafter felt a surge of power descending. In mid-air, a throne that looked like it was cast from sharp swords appeared, and a tall black figure sat on the throne.
The figure's face could not be seen clearly, but it looked very solid, emitting a black and holy light. Even in the dark ruins, the black halo could still be seen.
It was more like a powdery solid than a light.
Hobert realized that he had not descended power through the stars for some time. Now, in addition to being able to descend more power, his image seemed to be much more solid than before. This should be due to his advancement.
The evil spirit of the ruins was also deterred by Hobert and paused for a few seconds inside the stone gate before coming out.
It looked like a black and solid wraith, and the area around the wraith was particularly cold.
The wraith bowed to the 'Creator', and then Rafter heard a sinister voice say: "I told you, He is not Solomon."
Then another voice said: "Shut up! Idiot! Now we have to show enough respect, otherwise we are likely to die, including you!"
The sinister voice just now said: "You're the idiot! Have you forgotten? We're already dead!"
Rafter felt the coldness brought by the wraith and was surprised that this wraith could make two seemingly contradictory voices? He quickly took a few steps back. He knew very well that he was just a foil next.
The 'Creator' laughed twice in a booming voice: "Your spiritual residue has actually merged with someone else?"
He was pretending not to know, after all, few people knew that Medici and the three of them had died together.
At this time, a third voice appeared in the wraith: "You should know us!"
The 'Creator' paused deliberately for two seconds: "Einhorn and Sauron?"
Medici and the three were stunned. It was Einhorn who spoke just now. His words were like a statement, but in fact, it was a test.
Medici was also a big figure in the Fourth Epoch. The fact that this mysterious being only knew Him did not mean anything.
The fact that this mysterious being also knew the other two was enough to show that the other party was an existence with a long life, and whose strength was very powerful and knowledgeable long ago.
If the strength is not strong, you can't live to the present, if you are not knowledgeable, you can't guess who the other two are.
But the three of them 'used their brains' and couldn't guess who this terrifyingly powerful being in front of them was.
Even if the 'Red Priest' is good at discovering weaknesses, with the obstruction of the 'Nation of Disorder', they can't completely see through the reality of the 'Creator'.
They will not doubt the power of the 'Creator' because of this, because this is enough to show the power of the 'Creator'.
Medici asked in a very polite tone: "May I ask who you are...?"
"You don't need to know."
Even Einhorn and Sauron, who liked to sing the opposite tune, did not laugh at Medici.
Being confronted by a god-like existence, what's the big deal? Some people want to be confronted like this but don't have the chance.
Einhorn also asked in a very polite tone: "What should we call you?"
Rafter immediately cleared his throat: "This is the great 'Creator'!"
Creator?
Medici and the three were silent, they had never heard of it!
But they could guess that it was this 'Creator' who had eliminated their avatars before!
It was also reasonable for the 'Creator' to protect this Tudor descendant who looked like an idiot, after all, they could feel that the 'Creator' should be the 'Black Emperor' or 'Apprentice' pathway.
But they only knew a few angels of the 'Black Emperor' and 'Apprentice' pathways, and even knew an Outer God, but none of them could be associated with the 'Creator' in front of them.
At this time, they all thought of an existence they knew from Rafter. Sauron tried to ask: "Are you Emperor Roselle?"
The 'Creator' snorted coldly, and suddenly a surge of 'Distortion Power' descended, and actually twisted this evil spirit into three smaller evil spirits!
Of course, there were shadows connecting them, but they did feel that they had been truly separated for the first time in over a thousand years.
The 'Creator' asked: "Who asked the question just now?"
Two evil spirits answered in unison: "Sauron!"
