chapters.title: Chapter 394 - 394 Red Priest Card (Two in One) (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[T/N: This 2 in 1 is 2400 words, but the later chapters rage from 3-6k]
"Sauron!"
Immediately afterward, their surging "Power of Disorder" descended.
"Ugh, ah-!"
As an evil spirit, Sauron, who had long lost the sensation of pain, let out a miserable scream.
Medici and Einhorn could also feel Sauron's pain and fear from their connection. Indeed, it was a force that could extinguish them at any moment.
They had thought that their "evil spirit life" of over a thousand years had made them forget fear, but now they knew that they had not forgotten, it was just that there had been nothing to scare them for over a thousand years.
Now they really wanted to congratulate each other on rediscovering the feeling of being flesh and blood.
If it were other demigod-level Beyonders, Hobert could defeat them with the high Sequence of "Nation of Disorder", but it wouldn't be so easy to form such an obvious phenomenon of the upper level suppressing the lower level.
The reason for the current phenomenon is that Medici's power as an evil spirit is actually greater than their power as Beyonders. They have extremely high Sequence, and today they are still the "Angel of War".
Similar to Hobert's situation, although their strength does not reach the demigod level, their Sequence makes up for the lack of strength, which allows them to remain fearless in the face of opponents at the demigod level who have undergone qualitative changes.
However, this also has a huge drawback. As long as they encounter an opponent who has a greater advantage in Sequence, all their advantages will be lost.
Therefore, Hobert can even use the already abstract "Distortion" to completely "flatten" them like kneading plasticine, without any resistance.
Three or four seconds later, the pain that Sauron felt finally disappeared, but it still took him more than ten seconds to recover a little: "Th, thank you for your mercy."
The three smaller evil spirits involuntarily bowed slightly to the "Creator", which reminded them of the feeling of facing Solomon, and a sentence appeared in their minds at the same time:
You must not test God!
Even the former King of Angels and angels cannot violate such admonitions!
That's right, following Einhorn's test, Sauron's question just now was actually another test.
If the "Creator" admitted that he was Emperor Roselle, then they would understand the identity of the person in front of them.
If the "Creator" said another name, regardless of whether they had heard the name or not, it would indicate that the "Creator" was guilty. Only guilt would lead to "self-reporting".
That would mean that the "Creator" might be bound or sealed by various shackles, just like them.
If either of these two situations occurred, they would have contemptuous thoughts.
And the "Creator's" reaction was the reaction that a deity should have: capricious.
Medici asked respectfully: "Honorable 'Creator', can you completely 'separate' us?"
"Yes, but that would make you disappear completely."
In fact, Hobert wasn't sure if he could do this.
Medici asked again: "Can you let us leave here? We are willing to offer sacrifices that you might be interested in."
As he said this, they each stretched out a hand. Their will on this matter was surprisingly consistent, so no quarrel occurred with this action. A card appeared in the palms of the three people.
Of course, Hobert knew that it was a "Blasphemy Card", and he also knew that it was the "Red Priest" card.
"Your fate has already been written," Hobert said. "However, I can distort the 'Quill of Alzuhod' to bring someone you can easily possess as soon as possible."
If Medici had a face, it would definitely be full of shock at this time: The Creator knows Adam's plan! How, how does he know?
Einhorn: The Creator can distort 'Alzuhod's Quill'! That's right, his 'Distortion' has become abstract, and he can twist everything.
If these three small ghosts had eyes, they would definitely look at each other and see disbelief in each other's eyes.
In fact, Medici's request was a test he was conducting. How could the dignified King of Angels and angels give up testing because of pain?
The sudden appearance of the "Creator" made the three mortal enemies work together to deal with an enemy for the first time.
It's just that Medici's test was more skillful, more like making a request than testing.
At this time, the three ghosts were completely convinced and dared not have any more testing thoughts.
The fact that the "Creator" could say this meant that he agreed to help. They tactfully handed the "Blasphemy Card" in their hands to Rafter.
It's just that if they knew that even if they didn't do anything, "Alzuhod's Quill" would still send that "one-eyed dragon" over, they would definitely have the urge to chop off their hands.
Einhorn asked: "Great 'Creator', what is our future fate?"
Adam couldn't possibly run over and tell them how he would write their fate.
They could only sense through their high Sequence that their fate seemed to have entered Adam's story, but they didn't know what story had been arranged for them, whether it was a tragedy or a comedy.
The "Creator" paused for a few seconds, as if he was looking down on their fate. In fact, the "Great Creator" was recalling their later situation.
A few seconds later, the "Creator" said in a solemn voice: "Discover humanity; Amon; Sequence 1!"
Then the "Creator" smiled and said: "In view of Medici's loyalty to the 'Ancient Sun God', Adam, hehe, you can now think of it as Adam, will not treat you badly."
The "Creator's" words made Medici and the others even more complimentary, and they didn't even think about why a deity of the "Black Emperor" pathway would have authority over fate.
Because the information given by the "Creator" was shocking enough to them, "Finding humanity" was easy to understand. After being evil spirits for so long, they had long psychologically stopped thinking of themselves as individuals or Beyonders.
Being able to regain humanity meant that they had a chance to change their current state.
"Amon" was the first point that surprised them. Why would their future fate be related to this troublesome "God of Mischief"? This was clearly the beginning of a tragedy!
They didn't know what the "Sequence 1" referred to yet, but it should also be a key node.
What surprised Medici even more was, how could the "Creator" be so clear about his experience? Had he always been loyal to the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God"? After the fall of this "Ancient Sun God", Medici still chose to continue to be loyal to the "True Creator", and was a rare "loyalist".
But then he thought again, this didn't seem too shocking. As long as the other party had a long enough lifespan, as long as the other party knew the object he had always been loyal to, it wouldn't be difficult to guess his experience.
Adam was the son of the "Ancient Sun God", and he would give his father's subordinates a chance, which they could understand.
But why did the "Creator" say "You can now think of it as Adam"?
There was obviously a huge amount of information in this sentence, but they didn't quite understand it yet.
Even Klein, who already had rich experience in pretending to be an evil god, would find it difficult to fool these three troublesome guys.
But Hobert was different, he knew enough, even the "Angel of War" with extraordinary intelligence and a love for planning conspiracies was completely deceived.
The "Creator" said again in a solemn voice: "Alright, your matter has been resolved, just wait patiently."
Without waiting for Medici and the others to thank him, the "Creator" said to Rafter again: "Go and take back your family's things."
Although Medici and the other three had a bloody feud with the Tudor family, they showed enough restraint at this time. After all, they had killed many descendants of the Tudor family (Pound family) more than thirty years ago.
Rafter quickly put away the card with a bone-chilling coldness and entered the double stone door that had been pushed open a long time ago.
The ground and walls of the stone chamber were covered with fresh blood, which seemed to have just been poured on, as if it could flow down from the walls and drip from the roof at any time.
In the depths of the stone chamber were three black stone chairs with their backs to each other. Each stone chair was occupied by a skeleton, and one of the skeletons had long red hair on its head.
Even though the skeletons were sitting there motionless, even though they had long lost their vitality, the skeletons still made Rafter feel a strong aggressiveness, as if they could stand up at any time and eliminate the intruders who entered the stone chamber.
Rafter quickly shifted his gaze to look at the skeletons lying scattered on the ground. Those skeletons were the real skeletons, scattered all over the stone chamber, and had long lost any aggressiveness.
Next to the skeletons were some Beyonder characteristics with magical colors, as well as many seemingly unusual accessories on the skeletons, which were sealed items or extraordinary items.
Rafter took out the cloth bag he had prepared long ago, which contained small compartments. He carefully and meticulously picked up the Beyonder characteristics one by one. At this time, he had the feeling of picking up gold bricks: "One, two, three... eight, nine..."
Wait, how did a few more come out? Never mind, I'll pick them up first.
Next were sealed items and magical items, a total of five items, and the cloth bags he prepared were full.
Finally, he searched around the stone chamber and did not find the treasure he had imagined. Rafter was a little nervous, wondering if the "Creator" would blame him, after all, he had said that there was a big treasure inside in order to impress the "Creator".
This wasn't Rafter lying, but the notes given to him by his grandfather the clan leader had such speculation.
But there really wasn't any treasure here. Could it be that he had to carry the skeletons on the stone chairs out and tell the "Creator" that that was the treasure?
Rafter seemed to see the scene of himself being pinched into three pieces and dying miserably in the ruins.
Let's be honest, Rafter sighed, he could only hope for the "Creator's" mercy.
After taking all the Beyonder characteristics away, Rafter bowed slightly to the evil spirits outside the stone door that had been reunited, which was politeness.
Then he straightened his chest and left, which was the pride of having a backer like the "Creator".
After Rafter left, the ruins fell into darkness again, and Sauron asked: "What to do?"
Einhorn coldly asked back: "What what to do?"
Sauron rarely didn't sarcastically say: "We just gave away the only thing we could offer."
"Idiot!" Medici sneered: "You should be glad that we can still question each other here and have received the revelation of fate. Our contribution also expressed goodwill to the Creator. Isn't that enough?"
Sauron also coldly said: "Heh, are you going to recognize a new master again?"
"..."
The argument that lasted for several hours began from this.
...
"Nation of Disorder", on the "Iron Throne", Hobert watched Rafter leave the ruins and waited for the other party's sacrifice.
During this period, he projected the mosaic-covered image of himself praying to himself onto Elliot's stars.
Hobert had just seen that Rafter had picked up three Beyonder characteristics of the "Baron of Corruption" in the stone chamber. It would be enough to give one of them to Rafter, and he could continue to sell the Beyonder characteristics he had originally prepared to sell to Elliot.
Hobert first received Elliot's reply, and he couldn't hide the excitement in his heart: "...Great Creator, please tell that blessed one that I am willing to buy that Beyonder characteristic and can accept the price offered by the other party, and I can sacrifice gold to you tomorrow."
It was only a premium of a few hundred pounds. For Elliot, this was simply too cheap. Even with 5,000 pounds, he might not be able to collect the "Baron of Corruption" potion in the Southern Continent.
In the extraordinary world, extraordinary materials of Sequence 6 become scarce, and the premium also increases.
By 9:30 in the evening, he finally waited for Rafter's somewhat worried and fearful prayer: "...Great Creator, it's entirely because our family's information misled me, and made me think that there was a treasure in the ruins. It's not that I deliberately deceived you. Your servant, with the most pious attitude, begs for your forgiveness."
Hobert on the "Iron Throne" was stunned: He's actually worried about this! The card you put on the altar is the biggest treasure!
When Hobert's gaze swept across the altar, he saw that there seemed to be a black line wrapped around those Beyonder characteristics.
This black line was not in the ruins, and he had not heard Rafter's relevant report, indicating that only through "True Vision" could these black lines be seen.
After a little thought, Hobert understood that this was a curse, a curse from a high-level evil spirit. It had not been shown in the ruins, and the curse appeared after leaving the ruins.
The reason why Medici didn't make a reminder was because, in their view, the "Creator" should be able to easily notice this and solve this level of curse.
These curses were indeed not difficult to solve for Hobert.
As for Rafter's worries, Hobert pondered for a while and suddenly thought of another place where this "trump card" could be used: I really didn't plan to use you as a pawn, but you forced me to!
So he responded in a supreme voice: "Do something for me to atone for your sins! Sacrifice all the gains to me, and prepare for the granting ceremony tomorrow morning."
Then Hobert projected the image of the Beyonder characteristics with black lines onto Rafter's stars, letting him experience it himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 395 The First Grade 1 Sealed Artifact
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Backlund, 29 Sivellas Street, Empress Borough.
Rafter, filled with trepidation, finally received a response from the "Creator": "Atone for me! Consecrate all your gains to me, and prepare a bestowal ritual by tomorrow morning."
He breathed a sigh of relief and quickly said: "Praise the Creator! Your mercy is brighter than the crimson moon!"
Rafter understood that his punishment might include sacrificing all his gains, but what he couldn't understand was why he needed to prepare a bestowal ritual by tomorrow morning.
Just then, a scene suddenly appeared in Rafter's mind: it was the altar he had set up, with black lines wrapped around each Beyonder characteristic!
Rafter looked at the altar in surprise, unconsciously taking two steps back, and did not see anything wrong with the Beyonder characteristics.
Then he understood: the "Creator" had discovered that these Beyonder characteristics were not right, and asked me to sacrifice them to remove those black lines. As for asking me to prepare a bestowal ritual, it was to give me those two Beyonder characteristics!
Thinking of this, Rafter was first overjoyed, then praised the "Creator" again, and quickly performed the sacrifice ritual, dedicating all his gains tonight to the "Creator."
...
In the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert looked at the dazzling array of gains in front of him, feeling somewhat emotional: it turns out that fraud can really make people rich quickly. Look at today's gains, they are more than what he earned by risking his life to find the Tamara family in Backlund some time ago! The level of the spoils is even higher.
Hobert first used the "Power of Order" to "cleanse" all the Beyonder characteristics, and the curses quickly disappeared without a trace.
He couldn't wait to check these most pleasing Beyonder characteristics, and there were actually four Sequence 5 level characteristics, namely two "Mentor of Disorder" and two "Reaper" Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert immediately used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to crush one of the "Mentor of Disorder" Beyonder characteristics, and then used the loophole in Beyonder characteristic aggregation to divide them into five parts with the "Power of Order".
At the latest by the second half of the night, they will be aggregated into five Beyonder characteristics from "Lawyer" to "Mentor of Disorder".
As for the two Beyonder characteristics bestowed to Rafter, just directly use the "Baron of Corruption" and "Mentor of Disorder" Beyonder characteristics, and the rest is Hobert's gain from this operation.
This once again made Hobert sigh: fraud is really a lucrative industry, if he does a few more of these, he will have to worry about his money getting moldy, and he will have to take it out to the yard to dry it often.
Of course, Hobert wanted to use the other "Mentor of Disorder" Beyonder characteristic himself, which is why he risked going to commit fraud... to deceive Medici and the others.
Although the previous action in Backlund caught the Tamara family off guard, it did not achieve Hobert's ultimate goal: to obtain the "Mentor of Disorder" Beyonder characteristic.
Since becoming an Beyonder, Hobert has not worried about the Beyonder characteristics used for promotion.
And now, the digestion speed of the "Baron of Corruption" potion is far beyond Hobert's expectations, and it has digested nearly two-thirds.
Regarding this point, Hobert has to thank King Feynapotter for "selecting" his fiefdom for him. If it were an ordinary or prosperous baronial fiefdom, his potion would never have digested so quickly.
Establishing a relationship of rule and gradually becoming the ruler of a region is the shortcut to digesting potions.
Now it's good, he has the Beyonder characteristics used for promotion, so he can continue to digest the potion with peace of mind, and he doesn't have to find a way to find the main material for the Sequence 5 potion.
As for the two "Reaper" Beyonder characteristics, it is estimated that they were attracted by Medici and the others, just like the corpse of the ancient death god discovered before, which also attracted many Beyonders, as well as a "Blasphemy Card".
In addition to the Sequence 5 level Beyonder characteristics, there are also six Sequence 6 level Beyonder characteristics, namely three "Baron of Corruption" and three "Conspirer".
In addition, there are two "Briber" Beyonder characteristics, which should come from Rafter's family members.
After putting away the Beyonder characteristics, Hobert turned his attention to the "Blasphemy Card".
With a wave of his hand, the "Blasphemy Card" came to Hobert's hand. He first saw Roselle wearing a red classical priest's robe inside his armor.
This "Blasphemy Card" has been opened, but it is not known whether it was opened by "Medici" and the others, or whether it was opened before it fell into Medici's hands.
Like other "Blasphemy Cards", Roselle's image is more three-dimensional. The corners of his mouth are slightly raised, as if he is arrogant and unreasonable. He does not have the expression a "Priest" should have. Instead, he looks a bit like a dictator who holds military power and may launch a war at any time!
Because this was a sacrifice to the "Creator", Rafter did not dare to study it carefully, so he did not understand the mystery of this thing that looked like a card.
Hobert glanced at it briefly and felt that it was like a "manual" for the Beyonder characteristics of the "Red Priest" pathway that he had just obtained.
With this "Blasphemy Card", I believe these Beyonder characteristics can play a greater role.
Finally, Hobert's gaze stopped on the last page of the "Blasphemy Card":
Sequence 0: Red Priest
Main materials: Three Beyonder characteristics of "Conqueror".
Ritual: Launch a war that sweeps the continent and achieve enough victories.
Hobert smiled, he had another complete pathway of potion formulas. The richness of this potion formula is almost catching up with the orthodox god churches.
He put the "Red Priest" card next to the "Black Emperor" card. From now on, the Creator has another image to use to pretend to be cool.
Finally, Hobert's gaze fell on the five sealed items and magical items. The first thing that caught Hobert's attention was a black iron scepter.
This scepter looks very simple, and there are no gems or other decorations on it, but Hobert used the position of the "Nation of Disorder" to know that this is actually a Sequence 4 level sealed item!
Its abilities are: "It can amplify the holder's own abilities, it can amplify the influence of certain rules; it can use some seemingly ordinary rules to obtain unexpected results in battle; it can make some existing rules chaotic, and make order become disorder."
Hobert guessed that this sealed item should come from a "Earl of the Fallen". He remembered that "amplify" and "use" seemed to be the signature skills of the "Earl of the Fallen".
But the negative effects of the scepter are also not small: "The holder's thinking is easily distorted, and the intention to attack will turn into defense; the holder will become extremely greedy, and any wealth can attract his attention; the holder will become fond of laughing, and sometimes the laughter will interrupt the use of his own Beyonder abilities."
Hobert smiled, this scepter not only attacks others, but also attacks the holder.
He was about to try to reseal the scepter, but his spirituality told him that he could not do it now.
Hobert realized something, he might have to wait until Sequence 5 to carry out effective sealing.
After taking another look at the other sealed items, Hobert decided to leave the "Nation of Disorder" temporarily. He had stayed in the "Nation of Disorder" for too long this time, and he was a little worried.
This time Hobert's spiritual perception was very accurate. A few minutes after he returned to the real world, he heard the sound of gongs and drums by the lake, and the shouts of the town residents: "The monster in the lake is ashore!"

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 396: The Second Attack of the Mercenaries
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"The monster in the lake is ashore!"
Looking down from the mountain, the lights in the lakeside town gradually lit up, as if the town was slowly awakening.
The monster in the lake often comes ashore to forage for food. The residents of the town wouldn't say they are terrified, but they are always worried and fearful each time.
Before, although there were 'Great Lord' and 'Second Lord' in this territory, they only knew how to collect taxes and did not care about the lives of the residents in the town.
On the contrary, they would take pleasure in the residents of the town being chased and eaten on the mountains where the monsters would not go.
And if they were not driven away by force, the monsters would continue to wander around the town.
Therefore, the residents of the town could only ask the knight for help. Only after scraping together enough wealth would the knight bring his retinue to help drive away the monsters.
But now it's different. As soon as Hobert heard the sound of the gong, he immediately called Philip, Conrad, and Seel to the study: "Seel! Immediately get the residents of the town to evacuate to the vicinity of the Lord's Mansion.
"Philip, lead the male servants to be responsible for receiving and preparing the evacuation space! Conrad, lead your subordinates to maintain order!
"After the elderly, children, and women have all retreated to the mountain, organize the young and strong to try to surround and kill the monster!"
While Hobert was giving out tasks, Fors was also awakened and came to the study. Seeing Hobert putting on his cloak while speaking, she stepped forward to help Hobert tidy his cloak: "Be careful!"
Hobert nodded and said to Philip and the others: "Go quickly!"
Philip was still a little worried: "Lord…"
Seel, who had witnessed Hobert's power, laughed and said: "Don't worry, even if the monster bites us all to death, the Lord will be fine."
Hobert smiled at Fors, raised his two-handed sword, and quickly went out. He had seen a monster when he first arrived in the territory. Although it was quite strong, it didn't seem very intelligent. This kind of monster is easy to kill.
Hobert glanced at the sky. The clouds covered the moon, the cold wind howled, and it was pitch black outside.
Hobert didn't feel cold at all, but rather felt a little excited.
As soon as he stepped out of the Lord's Mansion, he heard several people shouting outside: "By order of the Lord, evacuate to the Lord's Mansion!"
It was Seel and the others. They shouted as they walked down the mountain.
Hobert smiled slightly. Seel's cleverness was finally being used in the right place.
Suddenly, Hobert seemed to have thought of something. He raised the long sword in his hand, and a light suddenly emitted from the tip of the sword.
This was the utilization of the 'Light Ring' ability, but as Hobert injected more and more spirituality into the ring, his long sword became brighter and brighter, until it illuminated Hobert and the entire Lord's Mansion.
Especially in the dark night, this light was enough for the people of the entire town to see.
And the first batch of town residents who came to evacuate saw Lord Hobert, who was surrounded by holy light. This scene was imprinted in their minds, making it unforgettable for the rest of their lives!
The Lord is truly a 'Favored of the Gods'! He is just like the story about the Favored in the 'Holy Bible of Life': bright, sacred, and wise!
In fact, Hobert did this only in the hope that he could become a 'lighthouse', guiding the people who were evacuating, and incidentally strengthening the directionality as the Lord: run towards the light emitted by the Lord, and you will reach the place of refuge.
Hobert also didn't expect that so many people would kneel down to him, and even more people were stunned in place, seemingly murmuring something, not knowing what they were saying.
When Hobert saw that the lights and torches in the town were all approaching him, the light on the tip of his sword gradually extinguished.
Everyone around was dazed by the light just now, and it seemed that the lights and torches were not very useful anymore. When everyone adapted to the dark environment, they realized that the Lord had long since disappeared.
At this time, Hobert was strolling on the streets of the town. The land around the town was very fertile, so even though monsters often attacked, there were still many residents in the town.
It's just that many residents have been killed by monsters in the past few years, so there are many ownerless houses in the town. Now those ownerless houses belong to the Lord's Mansion, or to be more specific, they all belong to Hobert.
"Help!"
Hobert immediately followed the sound and rushed into a courtyard. A young couple was blocked at the door of their house by a monster.
The wife was holding a child, looking at the monster in front of her with a look of horror.
The husband was holding an axe, trying to appear calm as he confronted the monster.
And that monster was a bit like a fish in Hobert's memory, the kind of fish that first evolved limbs in the ocean.
Its head had most of the characteristics of a fish, its body was covered with scales, it had short but powerful limbs, and a thick tail with fins.
The way the monster exerted force was very similar to a crocodile. After its limbs gathered strength, it found the right time and pounced on the young man holding the axe.
The young man was so frightened that he dodged and swung his axe wildly, but he didn't hit anything after hacking for a long time. Looking towards the door again, the monster's tail was stepped on by a person wearing a cloak.
The monster, which was more than three meters long, was like a fish that had just been caught. No matter how it jumped, how it twisted, it couldn't escape.
Only then did the monster remember to turn its head back to bite, but a black shadow flashed past, and the monster was already separated from its body.
At this time, the young man recognized him: "Lord!"
Hobert grabbed the young man who was about to kneel down to thank him: "Go to the Lord's Mansion!"
"Yes, yes, yes!" The family had been sleeping too soundly just now and didn't hear the sound of the gong. Seel and the others' shouting woke them up, but it was already too late at this time.
Watching them leave the town in a hurry, Hobert jumped onto the town's somewhat dilapidated bell tower.
This was the tallest building in the town. Hobert could use his spirit vision to roughly see the situation in the entire town.
Everyone should have evacuated, and the monsters had begun their attack.
Hobert quietly stared at them and soon discovered that these monsters were clearly organized, divided into three groups and rushing into the town from three different directions.
The poultry and livestock that had not been taken away, as well as the watchdogs left in the yards, all suffered.
And Hobert was thinking in his heart that if he had a hundred soldiers with advanced rifles in his hand, he could easily stop the monsters' charge.
Unfortunately, he didn't have them and could only lead the charge himself as the Lord.
Aiming at the place where the monsters were attacking most fiercely, Hobert flew over with the ability of the 'Ocean Pendant': "Corrosion!"
Without even needing to 'charge up', the 'Corrosion' ability immediately corroded the monsters' minds. The dozen or so monsters at the front immediately began to tear each other apart.
Hobert summoned 'Wind Blades' again, and three monsters were instantly cut with extremely deep wounds by the sharp 'Wind Blades', and blood splattered far away.
There was no one else here. Hobert began to use the thirty or forty monsters with the most intense momentum as targets, trying to familiarize himself with the abilities of the 'Ocean Pendant' as much as possible.
Under the 'Lightning Strike', one monster was bound to be burned into charcoal, and the surrounding monsters were paralyzed by the electricity, making it difficult to move for a while.
The "Wind Blade's" attack area was larger, but the monsters were thick-skinned. Although the "Wind Blade" could make them bleed profusely, it was difficult to inflict fatal wounds.
Just as Hobert was pondering the use of the "Ocean Pendant," his spirituality suddenly sensed a sense of crisis.
Hobert quickly left the monsters and took off his cloak, which was already covered in blood.
Suddenly, a loud voice rang out: "The use of sealed items and magical items is prohibited here!"
It was the voice of the "Disciplinary Knight" who had fled from here a few days ago.
Hobert sneered. They really knew how to pick their time! Or was this monster attack related to them?
But now was not the time to ponder this. The enemy's attack came as soon as it was said. The "Baron of Corruption" and the "Pyromaniac," who had recovered their states, charged towards Hobert from both sides.
The "Baron of Corruption" kicked over a monster's severed limb, completing the "bribe" process: "Weaken!"
Hobert once again used the "Order Crystal's" "shield" ability to block the opponent's "weakening."
The "Disciplinary Knight" immediately felt the enhancement of his own power. He sneered in his heart: This kid is so powerful because he's piled up magical items!
The "prohibition" at the "Disciplinary Knight" level does not mean that Hobert can't use magical items after "prohibiting the use of magical items."
Hobert can still use them, but every time he uses one, the "Disciplinary Knight's" power will increase by one point, and when the "Disciplinary Knight" punishes Hobert for violating the "prohibition," Hobert usually finds it difficult to avoid and is in a state of being weakened by the opponent.
This is the so-called "punishment!"
The "Pyromaniac," rushing in front, used the "Wall of Fire" to trap Hobert, creating an opportunity for the "Disciplinary Knight's" next "punishment."
The "Baron of Corruption" then distanced himself, ready to block Hobert at any time.
This was a tactic they had discussed long ago. If it were any other Beyonder, with the "Cold Night Squad" having an absolute first-mover advantage, they might die here tonight.
But Hobert was of course different. He still had many strengths that had not been exposed.
The "Disciplinary Knight" was about to start the punishment according to the tactic. He felt his power increase again, and he sneered: "Die..."
Suddenly, two bronze doors with complex mystological patterns appeared beside the "Disciplinary Knight." Countless indescribable eyes looked out from the doors. The members of the "Cold Night Squad" suddenly felt as if they were being targeted by some terrifying thing.
Those monsters who were about to pounce on Hobert also scattered immediately out of fear, as if making way for everyone on the battlefield.
"Death... demise!"
The "Disciplinary Knight" used his Beyonder power, but he was grabbed by pale hands Reach out from the bronze door. He had no choice but to use "death" on these arms.
But the effect was not great, after all, the owners of those arms were already dead.
Miserable screams came from inside the bronze door. The sense of fear in the hearts of the "Disciplinary Knight" and others was detonated, making it difficult to concentrate for a while.
Hobert's counterattack began. He once again entered a low-flying state, like a swooping eagle, rushing towards the "Pyromaniac" who was trying to condense flames and prepare to burn the "Underworld Gate." At the same time, he used "Lightning Strike" to attack the "Baron of Corruption."
Although the "Disciplinary Knight's" strength continued to increase, he still found it difficult to break free from the "Underworld Gate" within a few seconds.
The "Baron of Corruption" was also trying his best to dodge the "Lightning Strike," but this skill had a certain tracking effect. Unless he used other abilities of the same level to resist, it would be difficult to escape the fate of being struck.
Hobert had experience in previous adventures. Even if he "distorted" the landing point of the lightning strike, even if he was not directly struck by the "Lightning Strike," he would be affected by the accompanying paralysis effect, and his movements would be slow for two or three seconds.
So Hobert created an excellent opportunity for himself to attack the "Pyromaniac." During the flight, a "Disorder Stone" had already been thrown over: "Disorder!"
The "Pyromaniac's" eyes narrowed. Having had previous experience, he of course knew the power of the "Disorder Stone," so he quickly raised his pistol and accurately hit the "Disorder Stone" in the night again, and quickly dodged.
For Hobert, it didn't matter if the "Disorder Stone" didn't achieve the desired effect. Anyway, he completed the "bribe" process along the way: "Weaken!"
The "Pyromaniac" felt that his agility and strength were weakened, and he could only barely dodge the long sword in Hobert's hand, and was quickly cut with a wound by the long sword.
Fortunately, the wound was not deep, and the "Pyromaniac" didn't take it too seriously.
"Exile!"
Hobert felt a huge thrust that pushed him more than ten meters away.
It turned out that the "Disciplinary Knight" had broken free. A pile of lava appeared in front of the "Underworld Gate," burning off many of the pale arms.
This made Hobert immediately end the summoning of the "Netherworld Gate," which consumed a huge amount of spirituality, and the two bronze doors then disappeared.
Hobert didn't know what ability the "Disciplinary Knight" used to break free so quickly.
The "Disciplinary Knight" and the other two hardly stopped at all. After Hobert was pushed away, they chose to retreat again.
This time Hobert did not pursue, because he had already decided to launch a surprise attack on the other party as well.
As for how to find the other party, Hobert glanced at the two-handed sword in his hand and showed a faint smile.
He had just noticed that the "Baron of Corruption" already had severe dark circles under his eyes. Although there was no problem with fighting now, his combat effectiveness would definitely be affected after tonight.
The reason why they launched the second attack so eagerly should have a lot to do with the "Baron of Corruption" being unable to help but fall asleep.
And the "Pyromaniac" was cut, hehehe~
Hobert suddenly discovered that he had quite a few "dirty tricks." The "Cold Night Squad's" surprise attack did not bring any psychological pressure to Hobert. On the contrary, it gave the "Cold Night Squad" a huge pressure.
At this time, a mindless monster rushed out of the street. Hobert straightened his long sword and entered a new battle.
Soon Hobert discovered that these monsters seemed to be probing him in an organized manner, and their attacks actually had certain tactics.
This made Hobert leave the battle and return to the top of the clock tower again, quietly observing these monsters.
Soon he discovered that the monsters were communicating in harsh voices, and he found a human figure among the monsters.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 397: Lord Hobert, a Man of Martial Virtue
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
More than an hour later, Seel and Philip led over a hundred young adults, armed with spears and hunting rifles, to provide support.
Before Hobert arrived, the residents of the town had little cohesion, so each time they drove away monsters, they could only ask the knights, who had a certain degree of organization, to take action.
Now it was different, thanks to Hobert's previous actions, as well as the beam of light tonight, and the couple who finally retreated to the lord's mansion, vividly recounting the events.
Under the call of Seel and Philip, as long as they were young adults who were not injured during the retreat, they were willing to support the lord.
Soon they saw the streets still flowing with blood, and some monsters that only had their last breath left.
Seel led the people at the front, using spears to stab the two monsters that were not completely dead, and at the same time, everyone was surprised by the number of monsters killed.
Generally speaking, if four or five monsters were killed, the monsters would retreat back to Full Moon Lake.
But according to the corpses they saw, more than a dozen monsters had died at the hands of the lord.
At this time, someone found a cloak on the ground: "This is the Lord's cloak, could it be that he..."
Every time the monsters attacked, someone was swallowed by the monsters, and the bodies could not be found, only some of their bloody clothes could be found.
"Don't talk nonsense!" Seel said: "Maybe the blood on the cloak made the Lord take it off.
"I remember when we were in the church on the top of the mountain, the Lord also threw away the bloody cloak."
Although he said so, he was actually not sure in his heart.
These monsters are different from the bandits on the top of the mountain. If you get bitten, you will be disabled even if you don't die.
Even the knights have to use traps and the monsters' most hated flames to drive them away. If they fight head-on, the knights can only deal with one monster alone.
"There are more monster corpses there!"
After someone discovered a new corpse, Seel and Philip breathed a sigh of relief, followed the corpse and chased out of the town.
The number of monster corpses surprised everyone again, and someone kept counting: "Thirty-eight! The Lord has killed thirty-eight monsters!"
This was too incredible. Everyone thought that there would be a fierce battle tonight, and everyone would eventually overcome the monster's offensive under the Lord's wise command.
But now the most dangerous thing everyone is doing is to be careful to avoid being splashed by the blood spurting out during the finishing touches.
The remaining thing is to count the corpses.
Following the corpses left on the ground, everyone chased to the reed marshes that they usually tried to avoid.
This used to be fertile land, but after there were monsters in the lake, people did not dare to cultivate by the lake, and gradually the good fields became reed marshes.
This time, relying on the large number of people, everyone dared to chase into the reed marshes.
In the reed marshes, another battlefield where fierce battles had taken place was found. A dozen monster corpses were found around it, as well as the Lord's coat that had been soaked in blood.
And a huge hole was seen in the coat. People who had seen people bitten by monsters immediately recognized that it was a trace bitten by a monster.
Seel and Philip looked at each other. If they were right, the monster ambushed the Lord here, and a monster bit the Lord between the chest and abdomen.
The two felt heavy in their hearts. Could it be that the Lord was really bitten to death by the monster and eaten?
Fortunately, more monster corpses were found ahead.
However, the monster corpses in the reed marshes were not as dense as the monster corpses outside the town. There was a corpse every other distance, and without exception, they were all killed from behind.
Hula hula~
Seel led the people at the front to separate the reeds, while closely watching the surroundings, for fear of a monster suddenly rushing out.
It was not until they walked to the lake that they saw a figure sitting on the stone by the water.
At this time, the dark clouds in the sky dispersed, and the bright moonlight returned to the earth.
Everyone quickly recognized that it was the Lord.
The Lord carried a long sword on his shoulder, his upper body clothes were torn open, revealing his chest, and he was staring at the lake in a daze.
Not far from the stone, there was also a smaller monster.
The monster's hind limbs were very long. If it didn't have a long tail, it would look more like a person with scales and nothing on.
"You are here!" Hobert said: "This reed marsh should also be drawn into the lord's mansion. This will be the lord's reserved land, and I will hire people to plant some things I need."
Everyone recovered from the shock, not surprised that the Lord included the reed marsh into the lord's mansion, but surprised that there were no wounds in the Lord's torn clothes.
Seeing Hobert safe and sound, Seel was completely relieved. He had just tasted the taste of power, but he didn't want to lose it so quickly.
Only Seel and Philip knew some of the Lord's temperament, and the others stood aside very surprised, not even daring to breathe.
Seel curiously pointed to the corpse next to the stone and asked: "Lord, is this also a monster?"
"This is the leader of the monsters!" Hobert said: "The monsters that attacked the town this time all listened to his command. His wisdom is quite high. He even designed an ambush and arranged a 'daredevil' to bite me to death.
"Of course, it may also be that other monsters can execute his orders without discount. He is more difficult to kill. In fact, his combat power is average."
Hobert glanced at Full Moon Lake again: "There seem to be one or two more monsters with more human-like appearances in the lake, but it was too dark just now and I didn't chase after them."
After explaining a few words, Hobert said in a commanding tone: "Gather all the monster corpses together, and don't burn them for the time being. I have some other uses for them."
Beyonder materials had condensed on the monster leader's body. Hobert believed that ordinary monster corpses might also have extraordinary effects in some parts, so he asked them to keep the corpses.
While talking, Hobert jumped off the stone, carried his sword and walked back: "You can go home. In the past one or two months, the monsters in the lake will not dare to attack the town again!"
After entering the reed marsh, Hobert saw that everyone was still in shock and did not immediately follow.
So he simply used "Travel" to return to the lord's mansion, his own yard.
Fors was still waiting in the study. Seeing Hobert return safely, she went back to rest with peace of mind.
But before leaving, she glanced at Hobert's chest and left with a slightly red face.
Hobert returned to his room, changed his clothes, took a bath and fell into a deep sleep.
At about four o'clock in the morning, Hobert suddenly opened his eyes. He planned to raid the "Cold Night Squad" tonight. This was a decision he made when he saw the "Disciplinary Knight" and others leave.
Hobert didn't know if this was considered an overnight feud? They fought last night, and now it is early the next morning.
In any case, Hobert felt that doing so was quite exciting.
As for how to find the "Cold Night Squad", Hobert had already thought about it. He held his two-handed sword and then used the ability of the "Faceless Necklace": "The current whereabouts of the person who was cut by it."

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 398: "Cold Night Team" is wiped out
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Through the divination ability of the "Faceless Necklace", Hobert saw several people lying or standing in a dilapidated house.
Hobert saw that the knife wound on the "Pyromaniac" had begun to flare up. His face was pale, and he was curled up under the blanket, shivering.
The "Baron of Corruption", on the other hand, leaned against the wall, obviously so sleepy that he couldn't keep his eyes open, but he didn't dare to fall asleep.
A young man with all his hair burned off was changing the towel for the "Pyromaniac" and washing the "Baron of Corruption's" face with cold water.
This should be the young man who was hit by the "Holy Light" in the previous battle and was rescued.
As for the captain of the "Cold Night Squad", the "Disciplinary Knight" was standing with his arms folded, frowning as if he was thinking of a solution.
The divination image ended here, and Hobert withdrew from the "Dream Divination". He sighed again: The ability of divination is really useful!
This made him a little envious of Klein's pathway again.
However, he was just thinking about it. Overall, he still preferred to charge into battle and didn't like putting all his "skill points" on "intelligence".
Hobert unhurriedly put on his clothes, but he only brought two cloaks, and there were no new cloaks to wear.
Over this period of time, Hobert had gradually come to like the Feynapotter-style cloak, which looked really more mighty.
He planned to have the tailor in town make him a few when it dawned, just to stimulate domestic demand.
Then Hobert took off the "oil painting" from the wall, held the "Faceless Necklace" in his other hand to locate, and at the same time, he injected his spirituality into the "Traveler's Knife" and used the "Travel" ability.
The space in front of Hobert suddenly became illusory. He stepped into the spirit world, and under the guidance of the "Faceless Man Necklace", he quickly came out of the spirit world again and arrived in front of a somewhat dilapidated house.
Hobert didn't give the people inside a chance to react. He held the oil painting in front of him and used "Blink" to suddenly appear in the house.
The positions of the four people were similar to those in the divination image, except that the spirituality of the "Disciplinary Knight" and the "Baron of Corruption" had realized the danger, and they had already made defensive postures.
But all this was too late. As Hobert had designed, the "Disciplinary Knight" happened to see the "oil painting" that Hobert was holding in front of him.
He said with a reluctant expression, even a bit distorted: "What a wonderful landscape!"
Although the function of the "oil painting" was very simple, its level was not low. At least the Sequence 5 "Disciplinary Knight" could hardly avoid its influence.
Seeing this oil painting again, the "Baron of Corruption" showed a terrified expression, obviously having been tortured badly in the past few days.
The monster with eyes growing on its chest appeared again and sent curses to the four members of the "Cold Night Squad".
"Distort!"
"Baron of Corruption" "distorted" the target of the curse again.
"Exile!"
The "Disciplinary Knight" exiled Hobert. In his opinion, that monster posed no threat to them at all.
A huge force pushed Hobert out of the house. During the process of being "exiled", Hobert threw the "oil painting" into the yard. After the "exile" process ended, he also came to the yard and immediately opened his arms to embrace the sun: "Holy Light".
A huge pillar of light pierced through the roof, filling the entire room with holy light.
After the "Holy Light" ended, Hobert saw in the devastated room that the monster had already been purified by the "Holy Light".
The Sequence 8, after being hit by the "Holy Light" again, was kneeling on the ground, burning all over: "Praise the sun!"
The "Pyromaniac" was convulsing all over, looking like he was not far from death. If it were some rituals of the Sun pathway, it could heal the knife wound on his body, but "Holy Light" was an attack-type Beyonder power. Although the knife wound was reduced, the "Pyromaniac's" life was also coming to an end.
The "Baron of Corruption" seemed to have avoided most of the "Holy Light" attack, but he hadn't dared to fall asleep in the past few days, and his condition was already very poor. After being attacked by the "Holy Light" in his spirit, he directly began to lose control.
And the "Disciplinary Knight" had already escaped. He really didn't have the energy or the way to take care of his teammates now.
Hobert didn't chase, but killed the "delirious" "Baron of Corruption" and the "Pyromaniac" who only had one breath left.
The Sequence 8 had already been burned to death. Even after being burned to death, he still maintained the posture of praising the sun.
Using the "Spirit Wine Glass" to accelerate the extraction of Beyonder characteristics, after collecting the Beyonder characteristics, the surrounding villagers were awakened by the sound just now and were rushing over to check.
Before they arrived, Hobert picked up the "oil painting" and manipulated the corpses of the "Baron of Corruption" and the "Pyromaniac" to carry away the charred corpse.
He kept manipulating them into the river not far away before Hobert used a low-flying form to observe the surroundings by the light of dawn.
Not far away was Full Moon Lake, which was not far from Hobert's territory.
After identifying the direction, Hobert used "Travel" again to return to the lord's mansion.
Back in his bedroom, Hobert looked at his pocket watch. The entire operation only took less than eight minutes, most of which was spent manipulating the corpses into the river. The time used for the battle was only less than twenty seconds.
This was the power of a surprise attack. The "Baron of Corruption" and "Pyromaniac", who were not in good condition, could hardly play a role in such a battle.
Hobert smiled: This is called using one's own methods to treat one's own person!
Since the "Cold Night Squad" liked sneak attacks so much, Hobert would sneak attack back, and not just once!
Hobert sacrificed the three Beyonder characteristics to the "Nation of Disorder". After returning to the real world, he immediately lay down and used meditation to fall asleep as soon as possible.
When it was more than six o'clock in the morning, after dawn, Hobert woke up again. He took off the oil painting and performed divination again: "The current location of the 'Disciplinary Knight' marked by the oil painting this morning."
"The current location of the 'Disciplinary Knight' marked by the oil painting this morning."
"..."
The reason why Hobert said the divination words so detailed was because he was afraid that the oil painting had marked other "Punishment Knights" before.
But the two-handed sword was different. Hobert had only used it to chop people before, and those people were dead, so it couldn't be called a cut, so the divination words could be simpler.
After reciting the divination words seven times, Hobert used meditation to enter a half-sleeping and half-awake state again.
He saw the "Disciplinary Knight" sitting in a clump of dry grass, closing his eyes to rest.
Hobert expected correctly, this moment was the most tired time for a person, especially for someone who had been running around all night and had hardly closed his eyes. Even an Beyonder would not be able to resist finding a place to rest.
But the "Disciplinary Knight", having learned the lesson from the "Baron of Corruption" before, didn't dare to sleep, so he could only close his eyes to rest.
Although the result of the divination may not be immediate, Hobert also added the word "now" in the divination words, which meant that it should be something that had just happened. Even if there were changes, it shouldn't be too big.
Hobert pondered for a while, and then used the method of bestowal to take out the revolver that he had put in the "Nation of Disorder" before.
Among the spoils of the "Cold Night Squad", there were some pistol bullets.
Hobert immediately loaded the bullets into the cylinder and opened the safety.
Then he held the gun in one hand, hung the "Faceless Necklace" on his wrist, held the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" in his hand, and used "Travel" again to step into the spirit world.
Under the guidance of the "Faceless Necklace", Hobert quickly left the spirit world again.
When the colors in front of him became colorful, Hobert was ready for battle.
As soon as he left the spirit world, Hobert saw that there was still obvious fatigue on the "Disciplinary Knight's" face, but the reminder of spirituality, he had already stood up, but he hadn't had time to put on a fighting stance.
Obviously, the "Disciplinary Knight" didn't expect that Hobert could still chase after him.
Hobert first reached out and grabbed to steal the "Disciplinary Knight's" thoughts for the next second, and then he immediately fired, firing continuously, firing all six bullets.
The "Disciplinary Knight" immediately dodged after regaining consciousness, but he was still hit by four bullets one after another.
The bullets themselves would certainly not cause much serious damage to the "Disciplinary Knight", but the effects of "murmurs" and "pain" attached to the bullets made the "Disciplinary Knight's" expression distorted, making it difficult to carry out effective counterattacks for a while.
Hobert first summoned "Lightning Strike". Although the "Disciplinary Knight" tried his best to dodge, he was still struck by "Lightning Strike", and his whole body became charred.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert opened "Holy Light" on both arms!
A huge pillar of light fell, and the "Disciplinary Knight" was completely swallowed by the pillar of light.
After the pillar of light, Hobert saw that the "Disciplinary Knight" had a scroll burning in his hand, obviously he had used some ability to avoid most of the "Holy Light's" attack just now.
Even so, the "Disciplinary Knight" was already very embarrassed now, his clothes and hair were burned a lot, and the paralyzing effect of "Lightning Strike" obviously hadn't completely passed.
Seeing that this didn't seriously injure the "Disciplinary Knight", Hobert quickly poured spirituality into the "Spirit Wine Glass": "Underworld Gate!"
The simple and terrifying gaze of the "Disciplinary Knight" last night reappeared, and he was immediately grabbed by strips of pale arms, and his ears were filled with chilling screams.
The "Disciplinary Knight" was immediately impressed by these negative effects. He looked very weak, breathing heavily, and trying to reach into his pocket, as if to take out some magical item.
Taking advantage of the opponent's weakness, Hobert drew his knife and stabbed it into the "Disciplinary Knight's" chest and abdomen.
The "Disciplinary Knight" immediately showed a surprised expression, obviously unable to defend against Hobert's attack.
But when Hobert walked up to him, the "Disciplinary Knight's" outstretched hand seemed to suddenly become strong, and he took out another scroll from his pocket and threw it at Hobert: "Blazing White Spear!"
The scroll suddenly ignited a huge flame, forming the appearance of a spear. The "Disciplinary Knight" sent it forward and stabbed it into Hobert's chest.
Pfft~
All that was left in front of the "Disciplinary Knight" was a paper doll.
Hoo~
The paper doll was immediately burned by the "Blazing White Spear". Hobert appeared a few meters away. He saw the smile on the "Disciplinary Knight's" face and knew that he had been tricked just now.
A Sequence 5 with rich combat experience was still not too weak after being hit by consecutive Sequence 5 level abilities. Not only that, but he still had the mind to plot against Hobert.
Immediately afterwards, the "Disciplinary Knight" threw the "Blazing White Spear" in his hand towards Hobert, and he could easily hit the target without aiming.
Hobert quickly used consecutive "Blinks" to avoid the "Blazing White Spear".
At this time, the "Disciplinary Knight" took out another scroll, and countless magma spewed out from the scroll, melting and burning the pale arms again.
After escaping, the "Disciplinary Knight" immediately fled!
Hobert chased after him in a low-flying manner.
"Flying is prohibited here!"
Hobert fell from the low altitude. If he were to compete in speed alone, he would not be able to catch up with the "Disciplinary Knight" at all.
However, Hobert didn't intend to chase after him relentlessly. At the same time as the "Disciplinary Knight" escaped, his advantage of surprise attack was also lost, and he might fall into a hard battle next.
So after trying to chase without success, Hobert used "Travel" again to return to his room.
He found the last bottle of potion he bought from Viscount Glarint that could speed up the recovery of spirituality and drank it in one gulp.
From last night to now, he had used "Underworld Gate" twice, "Holy Light" twice, and "Lightning Strike" several times. These abilities with great attack power consumed a lot of his spirituality.
At this time, Hobert felt that his spirituality was only one-third left, making it difficult to carry out a third surprise attack.
But the time for the third surprise attack couldn't be too far apart. If he gave the "Disciplinary Knight" time to set up traps or find reinforcements, then this war of attrition might continue.
After drinking the potion, Hobert also asked the kitchen to prepare breakfast for him in advance.
While waiting for breakfast, he used the method of meditation to sleep again, which helped to restore spirituality.
After sleeping for only more than thirty minutes, Hobert was awakened by Roy and went to the restaurant to have breakfast.
After eating unhurriedly and drinking a sip of tea, Hobert felt that his spirituality had recovered most of it. He looked at the time. It was not yet seven o'clock, and only fifty minutes had passed since the last surprise attack.
But if he were to compare the state, he thought his state was much better than the "Disciplinary Knight's".
So Hobert divined the location of the "Disciplinary Knight" again. He was still running, his face was full of fatigue, and even simple running could make a Sequence 5 sweat profusely.
And the direction the other party was running was the village where Hobert first attacked them.
Hobert seemed to understand something. After checking his magical items, he used "Travel" again to appear in front of the "Disciplinary Knight".
The "Disciplinary Knight" showed a terrified expression at this time. Of course, he could see that Hobert's state had recovered a lot.
He gasped for breath: "Exi..."
Before "Exile" could be shouted out, Hobert had already reached out and grabbed to steal his thoughts. Immediately afterwards, Hobert's image suddenly became tall: "Death!"
He punched out, hitting the target when the "Disciplinary Knight" had just regained his senses, knocking the opponent away.
Following Hobert with a "Blink", he stabbed the Tang knife into the "Disciplinary Knight's" heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - 399: The tragic news of the group's annihilation spreads back to Backlund
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert laughed loudly twice. He had finally killed a Sequence 5!
But now was not the time to be happy. He saw some "villagers" in the village coming towards him.
In fact, when Hobert learned that the 'Disciplinary Knight' was running back, he had already guessed that there should be at least one mercenary squad in this village.
The first surprise attack, the 'Disciplinary Knight' would choose to flee immediately because he did not feel a life-threatening threat.
And he was also a Sequence 5. Looking at the entire Northern Continent, there are definitely no more than twenty mercenary squads with Sequence 5 as their captain.
Hobert guessed that it was his self-esteem that prevented him from asking his peers for help.
Hobert's second sneak attack injured the 'Disciplinary Knight', making him realize that he might die in Feynapotter.
So he rushed back, first to save his life, and second to design a trap with his peers to hunt down Hobert, who might launch a third surprise attack.
The 'Disciplinary Knight' is a hunter, and at the same time he is also prey. Hunters and prey always switch positions inadvertently.
Hobert had already guessed that he might set up a trap, so after his condition recovered slightly, he immediately launched a third attack, and finally succeeded at the last moment.
Hobert used the ability of the 'Spirit Wine Glass' to accelerate the analysis of Beyonder characteristics.
After obtaining the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Disciplinary Knight', Hobert noticed that the other party's bracelet was a bit special. When he took it in his hand, he felt that it should be a magical item.
Just after getting the spoils, the 'villagers' were only a few dozen meters away from Hobert.
Hobert smiled and waved to them, disappearing into the void.
The 'villagers' first looked around in surprise for a while. Seeing that Hobert had completely left, they came to the battlefield. One of them said, "It's Elvin! He...he's dead!"
The speaker was Terrence, the vice-captain of the 'Blizzard Squad'.
Their captain, Victor, looked at Elvin's body for a second or two and said, "Leave here immediately! Hobert killed Elvin just now, and Hobert also attacked the 'Cold Night Squad' in the early morning."
"Our information is wrong. Hobert is more powerful than we thought!"
...
Hobert returned to the Lord's Mansion, ordered Philip to find a tailor to make him a few cloaks, and then went back to catch up on sleep. He had originally planned to explore Full Moon Lake today.
But plans can't keep up with changes. He plans to have a good rest today and talk about it tomorrow.
Around the Lord's Mansion, there are still a large number of residents of the town.
When the strong young men of the town returned with excitement and told their families everything they saw last night, the residents did not believe it.
According to past experience, they had to stay halfway up the mountain for several days until the lord drove the monsters away with flames and traps before they could return home.
But the people who went out to support the Lord yesterday told them that the monsters in the town were all killed! The Lord even killed a monster leader!
This is unbelievable.
But when they saw the monster corpses placed outside the town like fish caught, they had to believe what the young and middle-aged men said.
At this time, some people remembered the Lord who was bathed in the holy light yesterday. Many people knelt and bowed in front of the Lord's Mansion before going down the mountain and returning to the town.
At noon, Hobert finally slept enough. He got up refreshed and found that his potion was almost completely digested.
Obviously, yesterday he became a 'lighthouse' and killed so many monsters, once again making the residents of the town recognize his identity as the lord and support him even more.
Leaving his bedroom, Hobert knocked on Fors's door, but there was no response. He originally thought that Fors had returned to Backlund, but he learned at lunch that she had not. Fors had gone to the town to see the monsters.
Just after taking a few bites, Fors also came back. It turned out that she had gone to draw the shapes of the monsters, preparing to use them as illustrations for her new book in the future.
Hobert glanced at Fors's paintings, which were quite vivid.
Then Hobert remembered who to ask about what these monsters were? Are there any spiritual materials on them?
Soon he thought of two people, one was Christian, and the other was Emlyn, the vampire from Backlund.
The former has the corresponding knowledge, while the latter is very familiar with drugs and should have a lot of knowledge about spiritual drugs and spiritual materials.
After thinking about it again, Hobert thought of a third person: Bishop Simpson.
In the end, Hobert decided to write a letter to Bishop Simpson. Although he had only met him once, he could use him to accumulate relationships and connections with the Church of the Earth Mother and the Kingdom of Feynapotter.
Since they are not familiar, then contact them more often and they will become familiar.
...
Backlund, Empress Borough.
Harvey Hayden followed in the footsteps of the crowd to the underground theater to attend the party held here.
At 1:30 in the afternoon, the party officially began.
As usual, the first part is the team formation session. A middle-aged woman in the front row stood up and said, "The captain of the Blizzard Squad sent a telegram this morning, saying that the 'Cold Night Squad' was destroyed by Hobert, he wants..."
Buzz~
The sound of discussion in the theater immediately drowned out the voice of the middle-aged woman.
But soon, everyone was shocked by a huge pressure, and no one dared to continue speaking.
The source of the pressure was the old man sitting on the stage wearing a golden mask.
After order was restored, the pressure gradually disappeared. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. After another ten seconds of silence, someone asked, "Is Elvin also dead?"
"Yes." The middle-aged woman said.
Harvey Hayden finally recovered from the shock, and then asked: "Was he killed by Hobert? Or was he killed by his father?"
"Hobert!" The middle-aged woman said in an affirmative tone: "Victor saw Hobert kill Elvin with his own eyes.
"Our information is wrong. Hobert is much more powerful than the information we have, so Victor hopes that I can help him find the contact information of the 'Prairie Wolf Squad'.
"Victor plans to divide the bounty with Steven (the captain of the Prairie Wolf Squad)."
A few chuckles immediately appeared in the theater.
In the mercenary world, there is a clear hierarchy for the level of tasks.
For tasks like the 10,000-pound level, only powerful mercenary squads like the 'Cold Night Squad' are qualified to take them.
Because Hobert's bounty was too high and his strength was too weak, he was targeted by three very strong mercenary squads at the same time. Before they set off, they discussed in this theater which squad would launch the first round of attack.
The 'Cold Night Squad' fought for a long time, and Elvin did not hesitate to use some favors to get the opportunity to launch the first round of attack.
In everyone's opinion, whoever gets the opportunity to launch the first round of attack is equivalent to getting the 10,000-pound reward.
Unexpectedly, it was wiped out like this. While everyone was surprised, they also found it a little funny, so some people laughed.
Harvey Hayden finally breathed a sigh of relief: It seems that I was worried for nothing. After all, he is the son of Sir Christian, and maybe he also inherited the genes to create miracles.
