chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 400: Create your own Beyonder force and military strength
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
After finishing lunch, Hobert went to the "Nation of Disorder", first completing the transaction with Elliot, and then trading for a large amount of gold.
Then, he gave the Beyonder characteristics of the already aggregated "Baron of Corruption" and "Mentor of Disorder" to Rafter in the form of bestowal, and asked him not to leave Backlund for the time being, and be ready to be summoned at any time.
The original scheduled time for the transaction and bestowal was in the morning, but Hobert slept too soundly in the morning, making Rafter and the others wait for a long time.
This is actually nothing, after all, he is a god, it is impossible to go to work on time.
After finishing all this, Hobert called Fors again to the main hall of the Lord's Mansion.
The servants and guards of the Lord's Mansion had already noticed that when Hobert and Fors appeared in the main hall again, it meant that the Lord was going to deal with official business again.
Hobert called Philip, Conrad, and Seel: "Everyone performed very well yesterday. This week, you will receive three times your salary, and those who participated in guiding and maintaining order yesterday will receive double their salary."
The three thanked the Lord for the reward. Except for Philip who was more calm, the other two were very happy.
Hobert said to Conrad: "From your subordinates, transfer three patient and eloquent subordinates to Philip."
He said to Philip again: "Yesterday I noticed that there are not many poultry and livestock in the town residents' homes. The town residents are still like this, the villagers must have even less, but the Lord's Mansion has too many poultry and livestock."
Philip said: "This is because in the previous six years, all the livestock and poultry in the entire territory were used to offset taxes and were taken away by bandits. In addition, a large number of poultry and livestock are eaten every time monsters attack the town."
Hobert smiled: "No matter what the reason, the fact is so.
"So I plan to establish a 'Poultry and Livestock Management Office'. This department will use Conrad's three subordinates as the main members and will be temporarily managed by Philip.
"The department has three responsibilities: First, provide the people in the territory with experience and methods for raising poultry and livestock for free.
"You can find a few serfs who understand this technology and let them work in this department. The manpower provided by Conrad is only responsible for clerical work.
"Second, if the people in the territory have the intention to raise poultry and livestock, they can come to the Lord's Mansion to receive one male and one female or one male and one female, and no fees will be charged within three years, but the serfs must compensate for poultry and livestock that die accidentally during this period.
"A certain 'interest' will be charged every year after three years, such as two chicks, or one-half of a lamb. The specific interest to be charged will be finalized after the people who understand breeding are in place.
"The third responsibility is to sell poultry and livestock, or the cubs of poultry and livestock. The price must be fair, and there must be no forced buying or selling!"
Philip and Conrad were both surprised by the Lord's idea. Although they didn't know how he came up with such a good method, they could foresee that after the establishment of this management office, many people would come to receive poultry and livestock.
At most three years, no, a large number of poultry and livestock cubs will be born next year, and the number of poultry and livestock in the territory will definitely increase several times or even more than ten times at the latest the year after next!
Because the Lord's ideas were too novel for them, Philip now habitually takes a notebook and takes notes while listening.
When they understood their tasks, Hobert asked them to prepare quickly. It would be best to build this management office in the next few days, clarify the rules and regulations, and start operating normally next week.
Hobert asked Philip again: "Is the Lord's Mansion about to be repaired?"
"The repair will be completed tomorrow."
Hobert nodded: "Settle their wages, give them a day off, but don't let them idle, go near the big pier and renovate a medium-sized hotel and a restaurant.
"Conrad, prepare twenty or thirty people to be ready to repair the big pier at any time."
Decades ago, when shipping was prosperous here, there used to be a large pier that could dock large ships.
Since the shipping was interrupted, the big pier has gradually been abandoned, and only the small pier where small boats can dock is still in use.
After the next construction task was explained, Philip and Conrad left.
Hobert left Seel behind: "You have performed very well recently, but as my captain of the guard, your strength is still too weak. Now I will give you a chance. Do you want to have the strength of the two knights in the territory?"
The two knights in the territory were both native nobles. Hobert had observed before that one was a Sequence 9 and the other should have a Level 3 Sealed Artifact.
And Viscount Wright was once a Sequence 8. Although the "Low Sequence" seems to have power far beyond ordinary people, they are also afraid of group fights. Viscount Wright was killed by a Sequence 9 with his subordinates.
"Of course I want to!" Seel was excited at first, but soon his eyes dimmed: "But I heard that the knights are born so strong, I may not be able to in this lifetime..."
"You can also have corresponding strength through acquired 'efforts', and even stronger strength than that," Hobert said with a smile.
Seel was overjoyed. He immediately knelt down on one knee and swore allegiance to Hobert again.
After Seel swore and got up, Hobert said: "I have two pathways of potions suitable for you. One pathway can give you good fighting skills and increase your own charm. What you say will be easier to convince people.
"The second pathway is that you will have agile skills, your intelligence will also be improved, and you will have the ability to control flames in the future.
"I personally suggest that you choose the second pathway, so that you can go further in the future, and you can continue to leverage the advantages of your cleverness."
Hobert had just obtained the "Red Priest" card. If Seel chooses the "Hunter" pathway, his future will be bright.
The reason why he didn't mention the "Black Emperor" pathway potion is because there is no opportunity to digest the potion in the territory at all, and Seel's promotion will be very slow at that time.
Seel quickly said: "I believe in your choice."
Hobert smiled: "Rest well tonight, calm down tomorrow morning, and come to the Lord's Mansion to take the potion."
Although Seel didn't understand what a potion was, he guessed that it should be something that could give him Beyonder abilities.
Hobert added: "Prepare yourself and recruit 50 young people in the town and villages to prepare for military training. Note that don't just look for young people in the town, but recruit more people from the villages according to the population ratio.
"After a while, I will buy a batch of rifles and invite a few instructors to train the recruited young people."
Seel was stunned at first, but soon he became excited. The Lord was going to build his own army!
He didn't expect that this matter would be handled by himself. He felt that when the army was built, he should also be a figure like a knight.
Finally, Hobert instructed: "Go and collect some animal offal and blood, I need it tomorrow."
If the weather is good tomorrow, he also plans to make a preliminary exploration of Full Moon Lake. Before that, it is best to hunt a batch of monsters to avoid encountering their attacks underwater.
After Seel also left with excitement, Fors asked: "I have always been curious, why are there so many monsters in Full Moon Lake?"
Logically speaking, Full Moon Lake is not too big a lake. It is difficult for Fors to imagine how there is space in the lake to hide so many monsters?
Hobert explained simply: "I suspect that there is a Sealed Artifact of a not low level in the lake, which has polluted the fish in the lake, so ordinary fish have become monsters.
"If there is a chance tomorrow, I will explore the lake to see if there is a way to reseal the Sealed Artifact."
Fors nodded: "Then be careful."
Then she smiled and said: "I didn't expect that I am going to witness the creation of an army. I must follow Seel to witness the whole process. This is something that I can never see or even think of in Backlund. I can even imagine the amazed expressions of the readers when they see this plot!"
Hobert said: "You should be more amazed by Seel becoming an Beyonder.
Fors was stunned: "Isn't that your reward to your subordinates?"
"It counts," Hobert said: "But have you ever thought about when and on what basis the official Beyonder of the Loen Kingdom was established."
Fors stood up suddenly: "Oh my god, this is actually the prototype of the official Beyonder! I, a wild Beyonder, am witnessing the prototype of an official Beyonder organization!
"Hobert, this is simply subverting my cognition!"
Hobert pursed his lips and smiled: "There will only be more things that subvert your cognition in the future. After we come here, this territory will have countless possibilities!
"If the problem of Full Moon Lake is solved, this place will definitely develop rapidly!"
In just a few words, Fors's passion was also aroused. She decided to start writing the beginning of a new book the day after tomorrow, no, tomorrow! We must complete this work as soon as possible to promote Jeffery Territory.
After dealing with official business, at about three o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert received a reply from Bishop Simpson in the study. His messenger was a spiritual world creature that looked like a big dog.
After delivering the letter, it didn't leave. It stuck out its tongue and wagged its tail, sitting there watching Hobert.
Hobert was slightly stunned: "What is the reward for delivering the letter?"
It stretched out its tongue again and wagged its tail.
There was no way to communicate effectively, so Hobert opened the letter. He believed that Bishop Simpson should mention it in the letter:
"Respected Baron Hobert:
I am very happy to receive your letter. First of all, congratulations on your victory last night. Jeffery Territory is very lucky to have a lord like you..."
Hobert skipped the continuous paragraphs of pleasantries and jumped directly to the useful content behind:
"...According to the monster image you sent, I think it is a Fish-Headed Crocodile Beast. Its pancreas is rich in spirituality and is the main material for treating heart and blood vessel disease potions.
Its pancreas is very rare. We can only use other spiritual materials to replace it now. I didn't expect that there would be a group of Fish-Headed Crocodile Beasts in Jeffery Territory.
Its intestines are an excellent material for making strong 'sleeping pills'. The meat on its back can enhance physical strength and strength after eating, and is the best tonic for weak patients.
If you have no other use for these materials, I am willing to purchase the pancreas, intestines, and back meat of the Fish-Headed Crocodile Beast.
The purchase prices are 30 gold Lire, 8 gold Lire, and 6 silver Lire respectively.
In addition, according to the information I have read, there must be two to three 'Mutated Fish-Headed Crocodile Beasts' in such a group. Its pancreas is one of the main materials of the 'Potion Professor'.
Its heart can make 'Berserk Potion', its lungs can make 'Diving Potion', its eyes can treat myopia, and its blood is an auxiliary material for 'Transformation Potion'.
If you get the above materials, I am also willing to purchase them. The prices are: pancreas 1500 gold Lire, heart 50 gold Lire, lungs 50 gold Lire, eyes 10 gold Lire, blood 3 gold Lire per Nega.
As for the plan to explore Full Moon Lake that you mentioned in the letter, please be sure to be careful and do not take risks. If you need anything, you can write to me.
Finally, my messenger likes to eat meat very much. You can give it a piece of raw meat of 5 Nega or more, otherwise it will stay with you for several days and may even rob your food."
The letter was signed with Bishop Simpson's fire lacquer seal.
Hobert sighed in his heart: As expected of the Earth Mother Church, whether it is an Beyonder creature or a spiritually rich creature, they are all arranged clearly.
And he didn't expect that hunting monsters would be a very profitable business!
Then Hobert glanced at the big dog in front of him and asked Roy outside the door to bring a piece of raw meat from the kitchen.
The messenger picked up the raw meat and returned to the spiritual world happily.
Hobert said to Roy outside the door again: "I'll give you an errand!"
Roy immediately said: "Yes, sir!"
Seel, who was also a servant of the lord, is now the captain of the guard. He knows that the lord has a lot to do now, and he has many opportunities.
Hobert said: "Go and organize some manpower to cut off the pancreas, intestines, and back meat of the monster and store them separately.
"Then collect the heart, lungs, and eyes of the monster leader. After collecting what I want, send them all to my study."
"Yes!" Roy immediately went to organize manpower.
At four or five o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert felt that his spirituality had basically recovered, so he sacrificed the Beyonder characteristics of the "Disciplinary Knight" and the bracelet to the "Nation of Disorder".
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert picked up the bracelet and used the authority of the "Nation of Disorder" to quickly learn the ability of the bracelet: "You can use spiritual materials to create scrolls with freezing, paralysis, and other effects. There is a 10% probability of creating scrolls with Beyonder abilities through corresponding materials; the wearer's spirituality will be greatly increased."
The negative effects are not significant: "You will be very eager to obtain knowledge of mysticism; unless the wearer prays for power from the 'Hidden Sage', all ritual magic will end in failure."
Hobert was slightly stunned. He suspected that the Beyonder characteristics that provided power for this bracelet were marked by the "Hidden Sage"? Or was the owner of this Beyonder characteristic killed when the "Hidden Sage" instilled knowledge in him?
However, this bracelet is quite suitable for Beyonder of the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar" pathways, after all, they rarely use ritual magic.
Hobert looked at the other four magical items sacrificed by Rafter yesterday. One was a magical item of the "Hunter" pathway, two were extraordinary items of the "Black Emperor" pathway, and the other was an Beyonder item of the "Warrior" pathway.
Corresponding to the Sequence 5 to Sequence 7 levels, Hobert doesn't need it now, so he simply put it in the "Nation of Disorder."
Just as he was about to leave, Hobert suddenly remembered that he hadn't observed the owners of the two newly appeared stars for so long.
He happened to have time today, and it wasn't night, so he could observe them.

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 401 Hobert's Charisma
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert first extended his spirituality to the star of that Loen royal family member named Alice. She was chatting with a handsome young man named Edessak, who called Alice his sister.
Hobert initially found the young man somewhat familiar. After pondering for a moment, he realized that his appearance was very similar to the figures printed on the 10-pound and 5-pound banknotes.
Then he found the name somewhat familiar as well. After pondering again, Hobert recalled that this was the prince who had fallen in love with Triss, no, Trissy!
He only heard Edessak say: "...I really feel the taste of love and I am even willing to give her everything I have!"
Alice, with a somewhat doting expression and gaze, said: "Bring your sweetheart to see me another day. I hope you are not being bewitched by her sweet words."
"How is that possible." Edessak smiled slightly: "She has always been very considerate of me and has never even made many requests. I really hope she likes things like manors and stocks.
"That way, at least I know a way to make her happy."
Hobert on the "Iron Throne" covered his face: It's over, this guy is beyond saving.
Alice frowned: "Then I need to see her even more! Edessak, I must remind you that you are a noble prince, do not do things that do not match your identity."
Edessak seemed to listen to his sister very much: "Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."
...
After listening for a while, Hobert could tell that the relationship between the siblings was very good. The content of their conversation was all private topics, and they even talked about Hobert.
However, it was just a mention. Alice said: "...Hobert's treason is shameful, but he finally did one right thing, and that is killing that annoying Kenen..."
In the following chat between the siblings, Hobert learned that the mother of Earl Kenen, who was killed by Christian, Princess Blanche, was the daughter of a merchant. Although she was very rich, she always did things that Alice and Edessak despised, and she was not liked by other princes and Empress Borough either.
Seeing that they were talking about trivial matters of the Loen royal family, which were meaningless, Hobert spread his spirituality to the star of the female Vice Admiral named Ethel.
Hobert saw Ethel wearing casual clothes, walking in the mountains with several subordinates.
They seemed to be on a mission, without any idle chat, and were hurrying on their way.
After watching for a long time, Hobert only heard one instruction from Ethel: "Rest in place!"
It seemed that Ethel's subordinates were all elites in the army, well-trained, and did not say a word of nonsense when performing tasks, and they all seemed to be Beyonders.
Hobert was a little puzzled, what kind of task would require a Rear Admiral to personally take action?
Since observing Ethel was not interesting, and it was almost dinner time, Hobert withdrew his spirituality from the stars and left the "Nation of Disorder".
He is no longer as novel as he was when he first mastered the "Nation of Disorder". If two new stars had appeared at that time, he would have gone to the "Nation of Disorder" to observe them every day.
However, since it is in the Feynapotter Kingdom, Hobert still plans to observe Ethel frequently to learn about some news from the high-level officials of the Feynapotter Kingdom, and it is likely that he will find some opportunities from it.
During dinner, Hobert remembered to entrust Fors to return to Backlund to purchase auxiliary materials for the "Hunter" potion, and to order another batch of potions to restore spirituality from Viscount Glaint.
At the same time, Hobert also planned to ask Bishop Simpson for some potions to restore spirituality and restore strength when replying to his letter, believing that the Church of the Earth Mother would not lack such potions.
After a good night's rest, Hobert had breakfast early on Monday morning and first concocted a "Hunter" potion in front of Seel.
After confirming that Seel's current psychological state was still good, under the witness of Hobert and Fors, Seel took the potion and quickly ended the adaptation phase of the potion.
Hobert first taught him meditation, and after restraining his spirituality, he let him try the newly acquired power.
Seel was surprised to find that his speed and strength had obviously increased. He had never practiced fighting, but now he was proficient in fighting skills.
In addition, he had a lot of knowledge about plants and animals in his mind, as well as knowledge of setting traps, and his senses had also been significantly enhanced.
He then realized: This is the power of the knights! Without the help of the Lord, my physique would never have reached this level in my life!
At the same time, he realized: So what I lack between me and the knights is not strength, but knowledge.
Then, Hobert told Seel some common sense knowledge of the extraordinary world, such as the dangers of losing control, and some precautions for Beyonder abilities, and so on.
Seel wrote them all down carefully.
After letting Seel rest for more than twenty minutes, Hobert set off with his guards to the shore of Full Moon Lake.
Fors hesitated for a while, and finally overcame her attachment to the warm indoors, and asked the maid to bring her easel and drawing paper to keep up with Hobert and his party.
In the town, many residents had heard that the lord was going to take the initiative to lure out some monsters. At this time, the streets on both sides of the town were already full of people.
Some of them were holding sticks, some were holding spears and shotguns. After respectfully greeting the Lord, they joined Seel's team and followed Hobert through the streets, through the farmland, and through the reeds that they were still trying to avoid getting close to yesterday.
This team became larger and larger, and finally there were more than a hundred people!
Fors, who was following behind, felt an invisible force, organizing the residents of the town to follow, and constantly giving them courage.
"This should be the leadership charisma mentioned in the book!" Fors exclaimed in her heart, and at the same time, she enjoyed the emotional resonance in the crowd, which made her inspiration explode and she couldn't wait to write this scene on paper immediately.
There was also a section of land similar to a river beach between the lake and the reeds. Hobert asked people to stop on the river beach, and everyone consciously lined up.
Without Hobert's order, Seel had already ordered his subordinates to pour the collected animal entrails and blood into the lake.
The bloody smell quickly attracted several fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts. The residents of the town were still a little frightened and disturbed when they saw these monsters.
However, Hobert's back gave them strength again, and none of them ran away.
Hobert began to hunt the monsters, throwing one to the shore after killing one. Seel quickly ordered the followers to carry the corpses to the place where the monster corpses had been placed before.
After carrying away three or four corpses, everyone praised the lord's bravery and was no longer afraid of the monsters in front of them.
When Hobert threw another corpse, they all scrambled to carry it.
After killing eight monsters intermittently, Hobert waited for more than half an hour, but no other monster fish were attracted.
So Hobert put away his knife and stepped into the lake step by step.

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 402: The First Exploration of Full Moon Lake
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
On the hillside opposite Jeffery Town, there was also a lord's manor.
That was the residence of Viscount Teuton.
At this moment, Teuton was standing in the warm pavilion outside the manor, looking at the lakeside opposite with a telescope.
He had heard yesterday that Baron Hobert on the opposite side had killed many fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts.
Teuton never expected that the baron on the opposite side would be actively luring and killing those monsters today!
Most importantly, Teuton also saw Helen in the crowd. He had met Helen before and knew that she was a member of the "Theosophy Order".
Judging from Helen's appearance, she didn't seem to be looking for trouble. Could it be that she had already slept with that young baron? Is she Hobert's fiancée?
No, no, people clearly respected another woman on the beach more. Judging from her appearance and temperament, she must be Hobert's fiancée.
Teuton looked back and forth between the two women and couldn't help but sigh: "This kid is really blessed."
"Wait, is that Hobert who went into the water?
"This is too rash. Even if he is a Beyonder, he will definitely be contaminated!
"Hehe, this is going to be a good show."
… …
With the Beyonder power provided by the "Ocean Pendant", Hobert couldn't feel the coldness of the lake water at all, and instead felt a sense of intimacy with the lake water.
If there weren't so many people watching on the beach, Hobert would have simply used the "Flight" ability to fly to the center of the lake.
Gradually, the lake water passed over Hobert's head. Although the people on the shore were a little worried, the bravery shown by the lord just now had exceeded everyone's imagination, so they also felt that perhaps the lord could really solve the problem of Full Moon Lake. In that case, the waterway would gradually prosper again.
They didn't really know the specific problem. In the minds of many people, there should be a huge monster in the lake that would attack passing ships, which is why the waterway was interrupted.
Only Fors and Helen knew that there was unknown contamination in the lake.
However, Fors knew Hobert better and knew that he would not take action without being sure.
Helen, on the other hand, positioned herself as just an audience member, curious about how the situation would develop, but not so concerned about Hobert's safety.
Suddenly, everyone saw that the lake surface seemed to light up. Many people thought that the battle had begun, so they came to the lake and stretched their heads to look into the lake, but they couldn't see anything clearly.
In fact, this was just because Hobert felt that it was too dark around him, so he lit up his cane.
As Hobert moved forward along the bottom of the lake, the seaweed gradually increased. It was full of fish, river shrimp, and river mussels, the big ones being the length of a forearm, and the small ones being only the size of a finger.
Hobert had eaten most of the fish and river delicacies… cough cough, seen them, but some of the fish looked very strange. Some looked like baby fish, some had several sharp thorns on their foreheads, and some looked very much like the Anomalocaris in Hobert's memory.
Anomalocaris was once the overlord of the ancient ocean. Hobert had only seen pictures of it, but he didn't expect to encounter a similar creature here.
Going further, Hobert saw a forest composed of huge underwater plants. He never expected that there would be such tall aquatic plants at the bottom of the deep lake!
They were not like seaweed, which only looked tall in the water, and would shrink significantly after being taken out.
These plants were like coral, hard, but at the same time, they were full of vitality, like aquatic plants, and like trees with large leaves that had just been submerged by floods.
There were many creatures of considerable size in this forest. Hobert only recognized the fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts swimming towards him. The other creatures were not very aggressive. They all hid when they saw Hobert and did not actively swim out to explore.
After Hobert easily killed the fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast, the other fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts also realized the danger of the person in front of them and hid one after another, only occasionally poking their heads out to observe Hobert's movements.
Because this underwater forest exuded a strange aura, Hobert did not enter to explore, but continued to explore forward from the top of the underwater forest.
Hobert made the light of his cane brighter. This underwater forest was boundless, and he didn't know if it would continue to grow to the shallow water area? Or simply grow to the shore?
At this time, Hobert felt the twisting of the water flow, as if the light on his hand had attracted something huge.
But Hobert did not weaken the light on his cane, but instead made the light even bigger, and carefully observed all the changes in the "forest".
Large leaves in the underwater forest swayed. In the dim underwater world, the visual impact brought by large creatures was particularly able to arouse fear in people's hearts.
Hobert floated upwards again, but suddenly found that his feet were entangled by the vegetation of the underwater forest at some point.
This surprised Hobert, because he was at least a few meters away from the underwater forest.
Looking down, he didn't know when several "big trees" in the underwater forest had suddenly grown wildly, and had actually grown to Hobert's feet, and their branches and leaves were rapidly entwining Hobert's legs.
Hobert quickly used "Blink" to dodge to a higher water level. As soon as he left, a bloody mouth stretched out from the underwater forest and bit down hard, stirring up the lake water.
Under the light of the cane, Hobert saw a giant mouth that was three meters long, followed by a head and a body like a giant lizard.
Hobert noticed that the other party's eyes were staring at him, and it was a cold stare with emotions!
This made Hobert realize that this behemoth had high intelligence.
Coupled with the rapid growth of the underwater plants just now, Hobert believed that it also had certain Beyonder abilities.
The giant beast failed to strike and immediately returned to the underwater forest, quickly disappearing without a trace.
This once again proved that it was intelligent.
Hobert estimated that, like the fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts, this should also be an extraordinary creature attracted by the sealed artifact, and its level was not low.
The exploration that followed was indeed very monotonous, with an endless underwater forest in front of him, but Hobert was much more careful, constantly paying attention to the changes in the underwater forest.
After being careful for more than half an hour, the underwater forest in front of him suddenly stopped abruptly, and a very regular circle appeared.
In this circular space, there was no vegetation, no creatures, only clear lake water.
Hobert turned up his cane again. In the middle of the circular area, he saw a bubble-like structure. There seemed to be a crystal clear gemstone in the bubble, flashing strange colors under the illumination of the light.
Suddenly, Hobert's head throbbed. He seemed to see a desolate land with the image of a woman wandering.
He couldn't see the other party's appearance clearly, but he knew that she must be a woman.
Beneath her feet, either vegetation sprouted rapidly and withered just as quickly, or the existing plants mutated, becoming lively, with noses and eyes.
Hobert quickly averted his gaze, but the throbbing in his head intensified, as if many new things had appeared in his mind.
He hurried towards the surface, and at that moment, Hobert felt himself surrounded by a strange power. His entire body rapidly turned black, and it felt like countless tiny snakes were swimming in his blood vessels, wriggling under his skin.
Hobert often used the "Disorder Stone," so he naturally knew he was showing signs of losing control!
At the same time, he felt a sharp pain in his hand. He raised it to look and was shocked to see a new finger slowly growing!
This prompted him to quickly use the "Order Crystal" to borrow the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to suppress his loss of control and accelerate his ascent.
The water surged again, and the underwater behemoth, hidden in the shadows, launched another swift attack.
Hobert used "Blink" three times in a row before finally escaping the monster's jaws.
The closer this beast got, the more severe Hobert felt his loss of control and mutation becoming.
Fortunately, he had more than one "Order Crystal," making it difficult for him to lose control, and the signs of mutation were somewhat restrained.
Fortunately, he had the "Ocean Pendant" and the "Traveler's Knife," making him as agile as a swimming fish, and combined with constant "Blink" usage, he managed to escape the monster's jaws.
If it were an ordinary Beyonder, they would have already become food for that beast.
Whoosh!
Hobert shot out of the water like a leaping fish, the beast's gaping maw close behind, less than a meter away.
Hobert immediately used the "Ocean Pendant" to fly low in the air. The beast didn't give up, leaping out of the water more than ten meters to snap at Hobert, its long tail rising completely out of the water.
This was far beyond common sense. Ordinary beasts would only extend their jaws out of the water, at most half their body. No one had ever seen an entire body leap out of the water.
If it were a palm-sized fish, it wouldn't be so strange, but it was nearly ten meters long, with a powerful mouth resembling a crocodile's, a body somewhat like a dolphin's, and four powerful fins on its belly, like a turtle's limbs.
Although its leap out of the water was terrifying, its enormous body ultimately fell back into the water under the force of gravity, creating layers of giant waves.
The people on the shore were already dumbfounded. It turned out there really was a giant beast at the bottom of the lake!
It wasn't until the giant waves crashed, wetting their clothes, that they came back to their senses.
Looking again at the center of the lake, the giant beast had disappeared, leaving only the Baron flying back in mid-air.
At this point, Hobert's ability to "fly" wasn't so hard for everyone to accept.
Hobert endured the discomfort in his body and landed by the lake: "The monster in the lake is unusually ferocious!"
Hobert said, "I need to prepare thoroughly before I can find a way to kill it!"
These words immediately elicited cheers from the crowd. The Lord was confident in solving the monster in the lake, and they finally had a chance to establish close ties with the outside world.
Hobert waved to everyone in acknowledgment and instructed Seel to prevent everyone from staying by the lake for too long. Then, he quickly left.
Fors noticed that Hobert's expression was a little off. She followed closely, and after entering the reeds, taking advantage of the fact that no one was following behind, Hobert suddenly reached out his hand to Fors.
Fors was slightly stunned, realizing that Hobert's expression was even worse. She quickly stepped forward and took his hand.
Hobert used "Travel," and the two of them appeared together in the Lord's manor, in the courtyard where their bedroom was located.
Hobert tightly gripped Fors's hand: "Don't let anyone in!"
After speaking, he immediately entered the study.
Fors also realized the seriousness of the problem and stood guard at the door with a worried heart.
Inside the study, Hobert locked the door and immediately entered the "Nation of Disorder."
As soon as he entered, the "Bell of Order" rang again, and Hobert immediately felt his body and mind cleansed.
This indicated that although the previous exploration had caused some corruption, the degree of corruption was not high, at least not enough to immediately cause loss of control and mutation.
Then, the signs of loss of control and mutation that Hobert had just experienced must have been the ability of that giant beast!
Immediately afterward, Hobert understood the reason for the throbbing in his head. It turned out that many pieces of knowledge had appeared in his mind.
This knowledge was all the "knowledge itself" that had inadvertently entered his mind when he had previously glimpsed the "Knowledge Moor."
At the time, Hobert didn't know what kind of knowledge it was, and he hadn't used it since. It wasn't until he saw the giant "gem" in the central area of the "Underwater Forest" that those "knowledge itself" became information that Hobert could understand.
Because this process consumed a lot of mental energy, he felt a throbbing in his head.
According to that knowledge, Hobert learned that the giant gem in the center of the lake was an attempt by an Outer God to project power into the atmosphere. That's right, Hobert had encountered a very familiar term, but one he had never heard of in this era: the atmosphere.
It was an attempt by the Outer God to project its power into the atmosphere, using meteorites falling through the atmosphere and weak points in the atmosphere. Similar events had occurred more than a dozen times in the past thousand years.
Near the meteorites' impact sites, crystal formations similar to gems would form.
They often brought about significant corruption related to their respective pathways, causing corresponding changes in the surrounding areas.
There were precedents for turning them into Sealed Artifacts, but that required at least a "Balancer" to use the power of order to seal the corruption.
Hobert could even understand that he would need to reach at least the level of a demigod to have the power to create a corresponding seal.
This was the benefit of "knowledge itself." Once understood, it could immediately become Hobert's knowledge and experience, even like innate common sense.
If there was no "Balancer" to help, it was still possible to perform an effective seal and significantly reduce its corruption and impact.
The method was to use the blood of Beyonder beings from the corresponding pathway, no lower than Sequence 7, to write a sealing formation. The sealing formation was also very clearly imprinted in Hobert's mind.
In addition, a high-level Sealed Artifact or mystical item with the power of "Order" had to be placed in the center of the sealing formation.
Hobert smiled slightly. The second method could be done now. Both the "Order Wood" and the "Order Crystal" symbolized "Order" and were mystical items of extremely high level!
As for the blood of Beyonder beings from the corresponding pathway, that would be even easier to handle. He could write a letter asking for help from Bishop Simpson.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 403: The Donut Messenger
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After getting a closer look, Hobert was certain that the gem in the center of the lake was an attempt to project power by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity".
Otherwise, it wouldn't have attracted the fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast, which could serve as the main material for the "Apothecary" pathway, Sequence 6 "Potions Professor".
And the giant beast Hobert encountered today had the ability to make plants grow rapidly, cause biological mutations, and make Beyonders more prone to losing control.
This was clearly a more advanced ability of the "Planter" pathway.
The corresponding pathways of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" were these two pathways above.
It was estimated that everyone contaminated in Full Moon Lake would begin to believe in the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" without exception.
Since the Earth Mother Church had the habit of raising... ahem, developing vampires as believers, if they needed the blood of Beyonders in the 'middle sequence" of these two pathways, they could completely ask Bishop Simpson for help.
With this thought in mind, Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder" and returned to the real world, he found that his left hand had become a 'six-finger".
The signs of loss of control and mutation on the spiritual body could be cured by entering the "Nation of Disorder", but the physical mutation was still there.
Hobert pondered for a moment, gritted his teeth, pulled out his knife and cut off the extra finger, and used a "Healing Spell" on himself. After the wound healed quickly, his left hand completely returned to normal.
Fors walked out of the study and visibly breathed a sigh of relief: "Are you alright?"
"I'm fine."
"That's good." Fors looked around to make sure no one was there, and then said, "I'm going back to Backlund this afternoon."
She was going back to attend the Tarot Gathering.
After saying hello to Fors, Hobert asked the kitchen to make donuts, and he returned to the study to write a letter to Bishop Simpson.
Just as he started writing, Roy came to the yard with a few people, carrying several wooden boxes: "Your Excellency, the monster's internal organs you wanted have all been divided."
That's good, Hobert said: "Bring them in!"
Roy had people bring the wooden boxes in. The pancreas, intestines, and back meat of the fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast were placed in different boxes.
Opening the wooden boxes, there were also small square wooden boxes for holding internal organs separately, and rectangular wooden boxes for holding back meat.
The heart, lungs, and eyes of the mutated fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast were stored in more exquisite wooden boxes, while the blood was stored in a glass jar and had already been weighed.
Hobert smiled, very satisfied with Roy's work. He first praised him verbally for a few words, and then called Philip over: "Your son's ability is not bad, let him preside over the decoration of the hotel and the tour, and find me another male servant."
Philip suppressed the excitement in his heart: "Thank you for your kindness, Your Excellency. I will find you a competent male servant by tomorrow at the latest."
After Philip left, Hobert locked the door and continued writing the letter.
He first briefly mentioned his exploration process and gains this morning, and then said that he had seen a sealing method to deal with this situation in a family's ancient book.
And after consulting his father, Earl Christian, he was very confident in sealing the elements that caused the mutation and loss of control at the bottom of the lake, but he needed the blood of "Biologist" and "Potion Professor" as a medium.
He needed to ask Bishop Simpson to provide 3 internal organs of blood from each, which can come from different Beyonders, and it doesn't matter if they are mixed together.
Then Hobert proposed to buy potions to restore spirituality and strength. Finally, he wrote:
"I have divided the relevant materials of the mutated fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast and the fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast. I will list a list of materials:
Pancreas 63 of the fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast; Intestines 63; Back meat 63.
Pancreas 1 of the mutated fish-headed crocodile-bodied beast; Heart 1; Lungs 1; A pair of eyeballs; Blood 8 internal organs.
According to the price you quoted before, the total value of these materials is 4065.8 gold Lire. After you verify the quantity, you can complete this transaction."
After stamping the sealing wax at the end, he waited for a while, and the chef brought the donuts.
Hobert then summoned the messenger, gave the letter and three donuts to the other party, and then pointed to the three large wooden boxes: "These are the things that need to be sent together."
The coffin hesitated obviously: "How do you think I should take them away?"
Hobert looked at the bare coffin lid, which he hadn't thought of before. Put it in the coffin? Or have someone smash a few big iron nails and hang it up?
Hobert was afraid of being beaten, so these two ideas were just "ideas" and he didn't dare to say them.
He asked: "Then what should I do?"
The coffin said: "Add 3 donuts, um, at least 2."
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief, meaning "you have to add money"!
He handed all the remaining 5 donuts to the coffin: "They just came out of the oven, I"ll give them all to you, so you don't have to worry about them going bad for a few days."
The coffin reached out and took the 5 donuts into the coffin.
Then the coffin suddenly jumped, and the three large wooden boxes and several boxes jumped with it, and were arranged in a regular manner.
The space in front of the coffin became illusory. The messenger first stepped into the spirit world, and the wooden boxes and wooden boxes, like "coffin cubs" following behind, also entered the spirit world one after another.
Hobert scratched his head, it didn't seem that difficult! She just wanted to get a few more donuts!
Fortunately, a few donuts are nothing compared to the role of the messenger, and Hobert didn't take it too seriously.
Hobert also used "Travel" to go to Feynapotter City, found Mr. Dophis, and asked him to tell Christian that he was going to carry out the relevant seal.
Of course, the main thing was to tell Christian that his sealing method came from 'the saint he met in Backlund before", and it was not suitable to be announced to the Earth Mother Church, so he lied that he had obtained the method from the family's ancient books and asked Christian to verify it, so that Christian would not leak it.
In addition, Hobert asked Mr. Dophis to help him buy three hundred new rifles and twenty officer pistols.
This was not difficult for Christian. After all, his current and previous job was to manage logistics, and he had recently been promoting relevant reforms. There were many arms dealers willing to take this business.
At the same time, Dophis told Hobert that the railway and house design team had already set off a few days ago and were expected to arrive in two or three days.
After exchanging information, Hobert saw that Christian would not come back in the middle of the journey today, so he used "Travel" to return to his fiefdom.
After lunch, Fors returned to Backlund.
And Hobert returned to the study, thinking about how to kill the giant beast in the lake.
With that giant beast there, it would add many variables to the sealing process, and it would even be difficult to complete the sealing at all. Hobert planned to get rid of the giant beast first, and then carry out the sealing.
At two fifty in the afternoon, Hobert told Roy not to disturb him, and he pretended to go back to his bedroom for a nap.
At three o"clock, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog, and he appeared again in the giant hall. What was more magical was that in the position roughly opposite him was Miss "Magician" Fors.
With "Justice" Audrey's unwavering greeting, this week's Tarot Gathering officially began.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - 404 It’s time for the Tarot Club again (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Welcome prod. flakez to the Church of Raven, +1 bonus]
Audrey obtained three Roselle's Diaries from the "Psychology Alchemists" this week. She is now a formal member of the Psychological Alchemists and has gained a stable source of diaries.
At the same time, she also learned that the Psychological Alchemists had a "Mutated Pituitary Gland of a Faceless Hunter", but the premium was a bit high, and she didn't know if Mr. "World" could accept it.
After Audrey sacrificed the diary, it was naturally Mr. Fool's reading time.
After about seven or eight minutes, "The Fool" Klein said, "You can begin."
Audrey first said, "Mr. World, I have found you the mutated pituitary gland of a Faceless Hunter, for 2000 pounds!"
Klein's first reaction was: Why don't the Psychology Alchemists just rob someone? A main material of the same level, "Emperor" only sold it to me for 1200 pounds!
But he quickly calmed down. The main materials for Sequence 6 were originally sold at a high premium, and there were not many opportunities to sell at the base price like "Emperor".
This was just as the Emperor said. The Beyonder characteristics and main materials he sold at the Tarot Gathering were indeed only at cost price.
"Okay!" Klein thought for a while before manipulating "World" to say, "Although the premium is a bit high, I am willing to buy it."
His savings were still enough to support this expense, and his potion had been basically digested. As long as there were relevant materials, he would buy them immediately, and he could be promoted immediately after his condition met the requirements.
After completing this transaction, "World" asked Hobert again: "How much do you know about the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway?"
In the Roselle's Diary he had just seen, it mentioned the Primordial Moon and the Uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway.
However, Roselle didn't quite understand the relationship between the two. Although Klein had some guesses, he was not sure whether his guesses were correct or not.
Because Klein had a special feeling for the Church of the Evernight Goddess, he was very interested in the Primordial Moon and the Uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway, so he asked.
Moreover, he asked in front of everyone. Of course, he knew that such a question would arouse everyone's curiosity. If "Emperor's" intelligence needed to be paid for, other members could also share it with him.
Hobert asked back, "Can you first talk about how much you know, and then I can quote a price to help you complete it."
The other members all looked at "Emperor" and "World". Involving Uniqueness meant involving the issue of True Gods, and they would certainly be interested.
"World": "I know that the Primordial Moon can still respond occasionally, but I don't know whether the Primordial Moon can be equated with the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway."
Audrey curiously joined the topic: "Isn't the Goddess 'Lady of Crimson'? Why didn't you consider the Goddess?"
After she finished speaking, she exclaimed: "Oh my god, I'm actually speculating about the Goddess! It's all Hobert's fault, he made me lose respect for the gods!"
Fors tried her best to adapt to the environment here as soon as possible: Discussing True Gods is a routine operation of the Tarot Club. Normal heart, normal heart, don't have any psychological burden... Okay, I can't do this. Don't you know? You will be punished by the gods for discussing the gods like this! Why are your tones and expressions so calm?
"World" explained: "Because the Goddess is not the True God of the 'Moon' pathway, nor is it the adjacent pathway of 'Moon'.
"I don't know why there is 'Ladyof Crimson' in Her honorific name? But in terms of pathways, the Primordial Moon seems to be closer to the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway than the Goddess."
"World" shook his head: "It is precisely because all of this is more chaotic that I have to ask Mr. Emperor for advice."
Audrey nodded slightly. She had always felt that the Goddess represented the Scarlet Moon and the stars, after all, both are in the night sky, but now that she thought about it, the symbols symbolizing the Goddess in the church only had stars, and she had never seen the Goddess symbols in any church with the moon.
It didn't matter when she didn't notice this before, but now that she thought of this, she also felt a little strange.
"World" added: "I have several guesses about this. The Primordial Moon may be... disguised as a god, such as the Earth Mother or the Evernight Goddess."
He was just about to say a god's "vest", but in this era, the word was just a noun.
Audrey asked again: "Why consider the Earth Mother?"
"Hanged Man" Alger replied: "Because that is the adjacent pathway of 'Moon'."
Audrey nodded: I see.
With Hobert's lead, Alger is now willing to share some information that is not very valuable. If it were before, this question would definitely be charged.
"World" continued: "The second guess is that the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway or a Sequence 1 is automatically responding to prayers."
Fors blurted out: "The Uniqueness and Sequence 1 can automatically respond to prayers? Oh my god, this, I mean, this is incredible!"
Klein thought to himself: Roselle guessed that the Hidden Sage was an evil god formed after the activation of the corresponding Uniqueness. Although there is no way to verify it, this guess seems to make sense. After all, at the high level of the extraordinary world, everything is possible.
Hobert replied: "Many people have guessed this. It is difficult for us to verify the specific situation, but as far as I know, Uniqueness does have a certain amount of activity."
Then he said: "800 pounds! I mean information about the 'Moon' Uniqueness.
"The reason it's worth this price is because some information cannot be disclosed temporarily, and your guesses about the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway are already very close to the truth.
"Of course, the most important thing is that I happen to be able to give a clear answer."
He still remembered the battle of the gods that took place in the Fifth Epoch.
"World" looked at the other members, and Audrey was the first to say: "I also want to join the transaction!"
Mr. "World's" guess had completely aroused her curiosity. The key was that she was financially tight this last month. In another two weeks, she would be financially free again, so she didn't care about such expenses at all.
"Me too!" Fors also said immediately.
With the previous transaction experience at the Tarot Club, she was very interested in the information from the Emperor. The key was that she had just received a reward of 1,000 pounds from Hobert, which made her unprecedentedly wealthy.
Alger also said: "Count me in!"
He had just eliminated a pirate group, and after the spoils were cashed out, he received a profit of 332 pounds.
"Little Sun" raised his hand and smiled embarrassedly: "I can only borrow money again, but the monitoring of me is not so strict now. I think I can pay off all the debts in another week or two."
He has been participating in patrols normally recently, and the accumulated merits have long been enough to repay Mr. "Emperor's" debts. If he continues to patrol like this, in a week or two, he may be able to exchange a main material for "Solar High Priest".
Hobert nodded: "The reward is a main material at the Sequence 8 level."
"No problem!" Derrick said immediately: "A total of 5 Beyonder characteristics are still owed to you, and they will be repaid together in a while."
Hobert said to everyone: "You need to pay 200 pounds each."
200 pounds is nothing to the current Tarot Club members.
Seeing that everyone had no objection to the price, Hobert said: "Then let's start!
"First of all, I want to tell everyone that no matter what happens, don't pray for power from the Primordial Moon!
"That is indeed a god disguised, but it is not the Earth Mother or the Evernight Goddess, but a god you cannot know now!
"If you want to know, please let Miss Justice advance to 'Psychiatrist' as soon as possible!
"Of course, that's another price."
Klein realized something: That is a god disguised in the astral world! Sure enough, it is very dangerous, so aren't those who believe in the Primordial Moon very dangerous?
Alger nodded: Just as I guessed before, there seem to be many gods in the astral world, and they all seem to be malicious. Hiss~ Could it be that they are the evil gods that the church has been fighting against?
Derrick also realized: There is so much intelligence and knowledge in the mysterious world that cannot be known without protection!
Fors smiled helplessly: Okay, I regret it a little bit. Why did you let me know this? I'm only a Sequence 8!
Audrey asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, according to you, the Primordial Moon does not represent the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway, so why does Her name also have the word 'Moon'? Isn't Uniqueness unique? Why can other gods share this authority?"
Hobert said: "I can't give you an accurate answer on this point.
"However, in my opinion, 'Moon' represents all feminine power. I think as long as it is a pathway related to femininity, it should be able to use the moon as a medium to complete some mystical operations.
"So many pathways of gods seem to be able to get involved with the 'Moon'.
"In addition, the moon is not only a pathway, but also represents the scarlet moon we see in the night sky, which is a physical entity.
"The Uniqueness of this pathway has the relevant authority of the moon, but the Uniqueness cannot represent the entire moon.
"Just like the Uniqueness of the Storm pathway, it can have the authority of lightning and storms in a certain area, but this does not mean that the 'Lord of Storms' represents all the lightning and storms in the world.
"You can regard the former as Beyonder power, and the latter as natural power. After having the corresponding status, you can also control the natural power in a certain area.
"Of course, this is just my personal opinion, for reference only, and is not included in the fee for this question."
Audrey "Oh"ed. She felt that Hobert's thinking was profound and reasonable.
Klein and Alger were both lost in thought. They also felt that the "Emperor's" thinking was more valuable than the information on the "Primordial Moon".
This is definitely independent thinking formed after having rich mystical knowledge. Although the "Emperor" said "for reference only", they all felt that this should be the answer, even if it is not, it should be very close.
Fors and Derrick did not really realize this because of the lack of relevant experience and knowledge.
Hobert added: "Let us continue the previous question. As far as I know, the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway is with the Evernight Goddess, so Her honorific name has the description of 'Lady of Crimson'."
Klein was surprised: With the Goddess?
He manipulated "World" to ask: "Why is it with the Goddess?"
Logically speaking, the Goddess and "Moon" are not adjacent pathways. What does She want the Uniqueness of the Moon pathway for? Or can Uniqueness be used as a sealed artifact? Isn't that something that is abstracted and conceptualized by the relevant authority?
"I probably know the answer to this question." Hobert smiled: "But the value of this question is very high and involves too much. If you want to explain it clearly, you need to meet two conditions.
"First, Miss Justice can provide hypnosis services, and second, the value is about 5000 pounds!"
Klein's eyes narrowed: The value is so high! That means there is a huge secret involved!
Audrey then asked: "Mr. Emperor, what is the use of the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway for the Goddess? According to your previous explanation of Uniqueness, can the Goddess also control the authority of another pathway."
Hobert did not answer directly, but said: "If we inject spirituality into the Beyonder characteristics of other pathways, we can also use the abilities of those items, which is equivalent to a sealed artifact with not low negative effects."
Alger on the side nodded slowly, which was similar to his idea. As long as he has the corresponding Uniqueness, he can exert a certain amount of authority.
Klein: Sure enough, Uniqueness can be used as a sealed artifact to a certain extent.
Fors was surprised: The gods also use sealed artifacts? Well, they were also likely to be Beyonders before! Ah, this idea is really blasphemous!
Everyone calmed down and learned another secret about the gods. For the current members of the Tarot Club, this information is not needed yet, but this does not prevent them from feeling excited.
While everyone was calming down, Hobert said: "I need 10 milliliters of sap from the Crown Tree, one Black Giant Golden Bizarre Flower, and 10 grams of bark from the Dragon Pattern Tree."
The other members were all stunned. Is this the main material used for Sequence 5? But it doesn't sound like it!
Alger said: "I know where to sell Crown Tree sap. 10 milliliters will cost about 800 pounds. I also know where to sell Black Giant Golden Bizarre Flowers, 300 pounds each."
Of course he knew that this was an auxiliary material for Sequence 5.
Hobert nodded: "I want them all. After you buy them, we will complete the transaction."
He asked again: "Then only the bark of the Dragon Pattern Tree is left."
Alger said: "I will pay attention to it for you."
Audrey followed suit: "I will also pay attention to it for you."
Derrick said a little embarrassedly: "I have heard of the Dragon Pattern Tree. I can't get in touch with monsters of such a high level for the time being."
Hobert smiled: "It's okay."
Fors also decided to write a letter to ask her teacher if there were any corresponding materials after the gathering ended.
Last week, she also decided to ask her teacher if there was a mutated pituitary gland of a Faceless Hunter that "World" needed, but this letter only "wrote" to the stage of taking out the letter paper.
After this transaction ended, "World" asked Hobert again: "How much do you know about the 'Angel Families'?"
Hobert was stunned for a moment before saying: "I don't know much, I only know almost all of the angel families!"

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - 405 Angel Family

Angel Family? Alger shifted his posture. The name itself makes one want to explore it!
Audrey simply asked, "Mr. World, what is an 'Angel Family'?"
Then she thought to herself, "World" has been trading very frequently these past two weeks! Not at all as aloof as before. It seems he has integrated into the Tarot Club family.
However, what Audrey didn't know was that "World" had so many questions only because Mr. Fool had some doubts after seeing Roselle's diary.
And coincidentally, Mr. Fool's financial situation was good, and he was willing to spend hundreds of pounds to answer his questions.
He didn't expect "Emperor" to know almost all of the Angel Families. He first answered Miss Justice's question: "The so-called 'Angel Family' refers to Beyonder families where angels have appeared."
Audrey was slightly stunned: There are such powerful families.
Alger: It's about what I guessed.
Fors: God, angels, um, um, I can accept talking about gods, is there some psychological barrier to talking about angels? Okay, don't lie to yourself. Beyonder families have had angels appear before? Like those angels with many pairs of wings? Angels who serve gods? Heavens, aren't they creatures that only exist in the kingdom of gods?
"World" then said to "Emperor": "I also know some information about 'Angel Families,' but I don't know if it's comprehensive."
Hobert smiled and said, "We can use the Solomon Empire, Tudor Empire, and Trunsoest Empire of the Fourth Epoch as coordinates to sort out those Angel Families.
"Do you know which empire those families were loyal to?"
"World" replied, "The Angel Families loyal to the Tudor Empire and Trunsoest Empire are relatively clear, but the Angel Families loyal to the Solomon Empire seem to be more chaotic."
Hobert nodded: "I understand. If I'm just helping you sort out these Angel Families, it only costs 300 pounds. If you want to know the approximate experiences and current situation of these families, it will cost 5,000 pounds!"
"World" almost didn't even think: "I only need 300, no, I mean, you only need to help me sort them out."
Hobert nodded, and then saw that the others were also very interested: "If you also want to join the transaction, then this question is worth 1,000 pounds, because the full picture of this question is completely worth this price.
"However, Mr. World knows more than you, so he will pay less."
Audrey and Alger said almost in unison: "I'll join!"
Fors hesitated for a moment and raised her hand: "I'll join too!"
Derrick heard that this was a question about the Fourth Epoch, so he wasn't very interested and didn't intend to join the transaction.
Hobert said: "Then how about Mr. World paying 100 pounds, and the other three members paying 300 pounds?"
Everyone had no objection, so Hobert asked "Mr. Fool" to block "Little Sun's" sight and hearing.
The transaction began, and Hobert said: "The history of these families can basically be traced back to the Third Epoch, but what really made these families well-known was the Fourth Epoch.
"Although this is not an official title, what 'Angel Family' represents is basically the top nobles of the Northern Continent during the Fourth Epoch."
Everyone then realized that this was a title from the Fourth Epoch, so this question must be a piece of history from the Fourth Epoch!
Audrey and Alger immediately felt that they had made a profit, only Fors was not very interested in this.
"Let me give an example first," Hobert said: "For example, the Angel Families loyal to the Trunsoest Empire include: the Augustus family..."
"Isn't that..." Fors said in surprise: "Isn't that the Loen royal family?"
Isn't it said that it's a family from the Fourth Epoch? How can there be a family from the Loen royal family? Could it be that those families have been passed down to modern times?
"That's right," Hobert smiled and said: "There are also the Castiya family, the Sauron family, and the Einhorn family!"
Fors took a deep breath: Okay, I shouldn't doubt "Emperor," "Emperor's" information has never been so simple! The four Angel Families used in the examples are actually the royal family, royal family, or former royal family of the Northern Continent.
Alger pinched his chin: So there are angels in these families. No wonder their ruling position is so stable. In the Fifth Epoch, an angel walking on the ground has enough deterrent power!
Audrey didn't expect that these families had all been loyal to the Trunsoest Empire! Why did such a powerful empire decline?
Hobert then said: "Let's sort out the relatively clear Tudor Empire. The families loyal to this empire include the Abraham family, the Antigonus family, the Amon family, the Tamara family, and the Jacob family.
"We talked about the Abraham family in more detail at the last gathering. The Antigonus family and the Amon family have also been mentioned before. The strength of the Tamara family and the Jacob family is slightly inferior to the previous three families."
Alger asked: "I've heard of the Tamara family, but why have I never heard of the Jacob family?"
Hobert smiled and said: "This is because after the Blood Emperor fell, the Jacob family was hunted down by the Six Gods. What's even more terrifying is that they were also hunted down by Amon!
"Actually, this belongs to the experience of the Angel Family and the modern situation. Okay, I'll give you an answer as a gift.
"The angel of the Jacob family was killed by Amon, and the Beyonder characteristics were taken by Amon. For a long time, Amon was Jacob!"
Alger was stunned for a moment before he understood: "You mean, Amon stole the fate of Jacob!"
Klein was as surprised as Alger: In other words, Jacob and Amon are angels of the same pathway! Amon can even steal the fate of an angel! No wonder "Emperor" said that the strength of the Jacob family is slightly inferior to that of the Amon family!
Audrey: I really want to know the experiences and current situation of these families, but I don't have enough money! Um, I also want to know the information that Hobert mentioned, which is worth 20,000 pounds, and those pieces of information worth 5,000 pounds! Alas, I don't have enough money!
Fors: So scary, so scary, I hope I never meet Amon in my life. Otherwise, Xio and Hobert will treat Amon as me. Heavens, it's terrifying to even think about it.
Hobert said: "Let's continue. What's more chaotic is the Angel Families loyal to the Solomon Empire.
"Here, I need to sort out the approximate history of the Fourth Epoch for everyone first. Initially, there was only the Solomon Empire in the Northern Continent.
"After Solomon fell, the Trunsoest Empire, the Tudor Empire, and the Second Solomon Empire were established one after another.
"So many families that were originally loyal to Solomon later turned to be loyal to the other two empires.
"The nobles belonging to the Solomon Empire, or rather, the First Solomon Empire, include Adam, the Amon family, the Antigonus family, the Medici family, the Zoroast family, the Zaratul family, the Sauron family, the Einhorn family, the Castiya family, and the Augustus family.
"In addition, the Tudor family and the Trunsoest family also once served the First Solomon Empire."
Audrey said in surprise: "Almost all the Angel Families we know once served the Solomon Empire? Why did such a powerful empire perish?"
Klein and Alger also had similar questions, while Fors had the urge to scratch her head: Why haven't I heard of most of these families? How many powerhouses are hidden in history?
Hobert smiled: "The main reason is historical factors. Many nobles didn't serve the Solomon Empire because of Solomon, but because of the 'Fallen Creator'! Another reason is the formation of the Six Gods Alliance, which led to the fall of Solomon. We've talked about this before, so I won't repeat it."
Klein then manipulated "World" to say: "Adam?"
Only the name, "Emperor" did not add the word "family."
Hobert smiled: "This is because I don't know whether to call it the Adam family or Adam. I can't tell you these details now."
He seemed to remember that Adam didn't have a strict gender distinction, and Hobert was skeptical about whether Adam could leave descendants.
The other members already had a consensus that when "Emperor" said "can't reveal it now" or "we'll talk about it after Miss Justice is promoted to a psychiatrist," it meant a huge risk.
So Klein didn't continue to ask.
Hobert continued: "During the Second Solomon Empire, I only know that the Zoroaster family and the Zaratul family supported this empire.
"There may be other families that I don't know, but the angels who supported the First Solomon Empire before have either fallen or gone to support other empires. Only the Zoroaster family and the Zaratul family have not changed to support other empires."
Klein nodded: No wonder the Second Solomon Empire was the first to perish. It turns out that the high-end combat power of this empire was the weakest.
Fors also sighed: The emperors of the Second Solomon Empire were really miserable.
Audrey then asked curiously: "What is the internal connection between the Solomon Empire and the Second Solomon Empire?"
Hobert smiled: "This answer can also be considered a gift: The two empires have the same emperor!"
Klein behind the gray fog changed his posture: The same emperor! The same emperor?
Alger almost stood up: He, I mean, didn't Solomon fall?
Audrey almost didn't maintain her "Spectator" state: "Mr. Emperor, is there any secret here?"
The most surprised was Fors: What does the same emperor mean? Could it be that the Solomon Empire and the Second Solomon Empire only had one emperor! "Black Emperor" is not a common code name for emperors, but a unique title for Solomon? Heavens, heavens, how could this be?
Hobert smiled: "Miss Justice's and Hanged Man's questions are not in the answer to the 'Angel Family' question. Let me think, the answer to this question may be worth... Okay, I'm not very willing to reveal the answer to this question."
Because he is a Beyonder of the "Black Emperor" pathway, of course he doesn't want more people to know the secrets of the "Black Emperor."
Audrey puffed out her cheeks: Bad guy! Hobert is a big bad guy!
Alger also had a somewhat unfinished feeling. It was the first time he had heard "Emperor" unwilling to reveal information, which aggravated his curiosity.
Klein already understood: "Emperor" knows the ultimate secret of the "Black Emperor," or rather, the secret about the true god of this pathway, but because this pathway involves himself, he doesn't intend to answer.
Fors didn't notice this question at all. Her mind was still full of: So the Blood Emperor, the Underworld Emperor, and the Night Emperor... The "War of the Four Emperors" is actually a battle of four people, no, four true gods? If I tell these to the historians, they will definitely burn me as a witch!
Finally, Hobert said: "Other Angel Families include the Night Emperor's queen, 'Beauty Goddess,' who can be regarded as the leader of the vampire family at that time.
"In addition, there are also three demon families: the Nos family, the Andariel family, and the Beria family.
"However, the actions of these three families are very secretive and rarely known.
"The Eggers family in the Southern Continent has now also fallen into the ranks of Angel Families.
"I only know so much about the Angel Families. If you hear of new 'Angel Families,' you are welcome to add to it."
Alger sighed: I didn't expect there to be so many powerhouses in the Fourth Epoch!
Klein: The strength of the First Solomon Empire exceeded my expectations. It's hard to imagine that such a behemoth still existed in the Fourth Epoch! The four Angel Families among them are actually all the rulers of the Northern Continent now.
Audrey smiled: Was Hobert's last sentence a sign of pride? That's right, knowing so much knowledge is enough to make him proud.
Fors: One emperor, heavens, two empires, one emperor, how did he do it?
After this round of transactions, everyone calmed down for a few seconds before starting a new transaction.
Audrey: "I'm looking for three materials: a pair of Mirror Dragon's eyes, 50 milliliters of its blood, and the fruit of the Elder Tree."
She has already obtained the potion formula for "Psychiatrist" from the "Psychology Alchemists."
Everyone said they would help Miss Justice pay attention.
Derrick said: "I know where there are Mirror Dragons. It's easier to hunt them with help, but I have to wait another week or two. I plan to participate in the exploration mission assigned by the Chief before offering sacrifices to Mr. Fool."
He said: "Thank you for your help. The Chief has basically ruled out my suspicion and arranged for me to explore the half-destroyed temple of the 'Fallen Creator'.
"I think this should be my final test."
Hobert nodded, "Little Sun" has improved a lot.
The "Political Commissar" Alger asked: "Is the 'Shepherd' elder still in the dungeon?"
"Yes, this exploration is led by the 'Chief,'" Derrick did not hide anything.
"In this way, the degree of danger is much lower than last time," Alger concluded.
Derrick humbly asked for advice: "What should I pay attention to during the exploration?"
"Fool" at the top of the bronze long table opened his mouth and said: "Flesh, whispers."
Klein only gave two words, and let the Tarot Club members understand the rest themselves.
This is the demeanor of a big shot!
Hobert: To be honest, the Seer is really annoying! But in terms of pretending to be an evil god, I still have a lot of room for improvement. At least there is still some gap compared to Klein.
Alger pondered for a second or two, and as expected, he had already comprehended some information on his own. He said to "The Sun," who had thanked "The Fool," "Specifically, it means don't look at what you shouldn't look at, don't listen to what you shouldn't listen to, don't eat what you shouldn't eat, and don't touch what you shouldn't touch."
Hobert nodded: He who knows "The Fool" is "The Hanged Man"!
Derrick added, "I need the 'Solar High Priest' potion formula. The reward will be paid with the main ingredients of the potion."
"I have relevant channels to obtain the formula," Alger said. "But I don't know what main ingredients you have there. You need to know that not all main ingredients are so popular."
"I have a list of the main ingredients and a list of nearby monsters here!" Derrick said immediately.
Klein resisted the urge to shake his head: "Little Sun" is still too naive.
However, he did not offer any reminders, because he also wanted to see.
