chapters.title: Chapter 406 - 406: The Parties of the Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The "Little Sun's" list was prepared for Mr. Emperor. He was afraid that some of the materials he paid for would be difficult for Mr. Emperor to convert into cash, so he prepared this list, ready for Mr. Emperor to check at any time.
However, Hobert didn't make such a request, but instead benefited "The Fool" and "The Hanged Man" first.
Hobert sighed: It can't be blamed on Alger for being too cunning, it's just that "Little Sun's" posture is too correct, everyone wants to take advantage of him.
Alger didn't rip off Derrick too much, he chose three materials that were about the same value as the "Sun High Priest's" potion formula, and that he was confident he could sell quickly.
With this transaction concluded, the Tarot Gathering entered its final stage: the exchange of information.
Audrey said: "Another major event has occurred in Backlund: Duke Negan has been assassinated!"
Alger paid more attention. Although he had heard about the assassination from the Church, he didn't know the specific details.
Fors was slightly stunned. She hadn't been in Backlund recently, and didn't expect such a thing to happen.
Derrick still had an impression of Duke Negan. He remembered that it was mentioned at a previous gathering that someone wanted to assassinate the Duke but failed. However, he wasn't very interested in Duke Negan's affairs.
Audrey continued: "The 'Apostle of Desire' used a special setting to complete the assassination of Duke Negan, and broke through with serious injuries at the cost of severe injuries.
"By the time the 'Nighthawks' caught up with him, he was already dead. It is said that the trace of that 'Death Messenger' appeared at the scene again, but the 'Death Messenger' was not there to silence anyone, his target was the organization that commissioned the 'Apostle of Desire'."
Fors couldn't help but sigh for the umpteenth time: The Tarot Gathering commits crimes quite frequently.
Alger was stunned: "Death Messenger"? Is this another action related to Mr. Fool? Which organization is that?
Just as Alger was wondering, "The Fool" Klein took the opportunity to remind him casually: "Don't mention the name of that organization outside, and don't write it down!"
"Why?" Audrey blurted out.
Klein leaned back in his chair and replied in a calm tone: "What is said will surely be known!"
Audrey, Alger, and Derrick all thought of "0-08".
Alger: Could that secret organization be formed by high-level Spectator Beyonders? Is it a powerful organization that I don't know about at all? Is Mr. Fool sending his followers to find them? The high-level situation in this world is indeed more complicated than I imagined.
Audrey: What an extremely secretive and dignified organization! In some ways, it's even more terrifying than the Churches of the Seven Gods, and Mr. Fool, and our Tarot Gathering, are looking for their traces!
Fors: Mr. Fool means that, as long as it's not in His kingdom of God, not talking to Him, mentioning or writing down the name of that organization will be sensed by them using some method or item? How terrible! It's better for me not to know.
Hobert: Unexpectedly, you showed off again, but it's good to tell them, lest Audrey be targeted by the "Twilight Hermit Club."
After a few seconds of silence, Fors said again: "Moon Lake in South Colson is being developed, and it will definitely become a famous scenic spot in the future.
"If you have relevant channels, you can help promote it."
Everyone was stunned. This information seemed a bit abrupt, and everyone didn't quite understand what was going on.
Only Hobert wanted to thank Fors for thinking about promoting his territory at the Tarot Gathering.
Fors cleared her throat with a slightly flushed face and said: "Everyone will know about it in the near future."
Everyone nodded and said nothing more.
Because Klein was attending the gathering in the lavatory, staying any longer would definitely arouse suspicion, so after everyone's exchange came to an end, he announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.
...
Backlund, Earl Hall's villa.
After returning to the real world, Audrey didn't rush to get up. She first quietly sorted out what she needed to do next:
"There's a psychology class tomorrow afternoon. I can tell Miss Islant that the person I met at the Beyonder gathering who was looking to buy the 'Mutated Pituitary Gland of the Faceless Hunter' has agreed to the deal, and she can send the Beyonder material over soon.
"Facilitating this transaction will of course reward me with more Russell diaries, while accumulating the 'Hypnotist' potion formula.
"Well, I have to collect the materials for 'Psychiatrist' as soon as possible. Audrey, you can't be lazy! Susie is already Sequence 8, you can't let it catch up!"
...
Backlund, Cherwood Borough.
Fors paced back and forth in the room, finally made up her mind, pulled out a chair, found stationery and a pen, brewed for nearly a minute, and began to write a letter to Dorian Gray.
Just as she wrote the beginning, Xio happened to come back from outside: "Your letter!"
Fors took it over and saw that it was actually a letter from Dorian! She quickly opened it and browsed through it, gradually revealing a wry smile: "Xio, Teacher Dorian said he's coming to Backlund tomorrow, and he also brought the 'Trickmaster' potion!"
When she communicated with Dorian before, she revealed that Mrs. Anissa had left her Beyonder characteristics to her.
Of course, she didn't say it explicitly, only that Mrs. Anissa had allowed her to inherit some Beyonder abilities.
Dorian was more relieved, at least Fors's character had another layer of guarantee from Anissa.
Fors said: "What should I do? Do I have to take the 'Trickmaster' potion again?"
She still vividly remembered the experience of taking the potion last time. Now that the previous 'Trickmaster' potion hasn't been digested yet, she has to take a new one?
Xio scratched her messy hair and said: "Tell your teacher the truth and ask for his forgiveness."
Fors sighed. If she severed contact with Dorian because of this, it would be too much of a pity: "Well, I, I'll ask Hobert again if there's a better way."
This time she didn't hesitate and immediately took action, using the "Traveler's Door" to come to Jeffrey Town, but Hobert wasn't in the study.
Asking the maid, she learned that Hobert had just gone to the town, so Fors simply went to the town to find Hobert.
In the town near Moon Lake, Fors saw Hobert, who was watching Roy lead people to clean up the two adjacent houses.
Hobert also saw Fors. He pointed to the two houses: "Look, this is a two-story building with a small yard and spacious rooms, which can be converted into a hotel.
"That side doesn't have a yard, the entrance is the living room, you can open up the rooms and turn them into the restaurant's lobby, and the second floor is private rooms."
Fors nodded. Of course, she knew about Hobert's renovation plan.
Before she could say anything about her own affairs, she heard Hobert say again: "I plan to give you all the income from the hotel and restaurant to you."
Fors: "I have... ah?"

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - 407: Bull Demon King's First Appearance
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Before Fors could react, Hobert continued, "I took a look earlier, and the original decorations of the house are still there. It just needs some renovation, which won't take too long.
Once the railway and villa design teams arrive, they can move in first. Their meals and accommodations will be paid for by the Lord's Mansion. I'll also have Roy help you find shop assistants and a manager, so you can start making money as soon as you take over.
Once the large dock is back in operation, with this location, the restaurant and hotel should easily bring in tens of gold Lire per week…"
"Wait, wait, wait…" Fors said, "I can't accept it! We, we…"
We're a contractual couple, have you forgotten? If you give me property, how will it be divided after the contractual couple agreement ends?
Hobert had already thought of a reason: "I've thought about it. As the Lady of the Manor, you naturally need some pocket money. These tens of gold Lire may not be much, but it should be enough for your spending money.
If you don't find gold Lire convenient, you can exchange them for gold pounds at my place, according to the current exchange rate between the two countries."
Fors: "But…"
"Just accept it," Hobert said. "I can't let you spend your own money while you're in Jeffrey Town.
"It's just a few tens of gold Lire, not a lot of money. It's too formal to keep refusing."
Fors suddenly didn't know how to refuse, and before she could continue to refuse, Hobert had already called Roy over to implement the matter, entrusting the accounts of the hotel and restaurant to the "Lady of the Manor."
Fors felt like she had inexplicably gained two properties, and if she could earn tens of gold Lire per week, these two properties would definitely be very good.
If this income were converted into gold pounds, Fors would definitely be a wealthy member of the upper-middle class, but still far from being a millionaire.
Hobert was about to inspect other places when Fors came back to her senses: "Hobert, I came to ask for your opinion on something."
Hobert stopped: "What is it?"
"Do you remember the Abraham family we talked about a long time ago?"
Hobert nodded. It was when he had just become a lawyer, during a conversation with Fors, that he had mentioned this family. At that time, the two of them weren't very familiar.
"Some time ago, I met a member of the Abraham family…" Fors briefly described her experience of becoming Dorian's student, and mentioned that she had only revealed to Dorian that she was an "Apprentice" at the time, and now Dorian was bringing the "Trickmaster" potion to find her.
Hobert said, "I have two suggestions for you. The first suggestion is to just act like you're an Apprentice and take another 'Trickmaster' potion.
"At the low sequence, as long as your condition is good, repeatedly taking potions won't be too dangerous.
"The second suggestion is to tell the truth. Of course, you have to be careful about how you tell the truth. Just say that your fiancé is a Beyonder, and he found the 'Trickmaster' potion for you.
"Before that, your fiancé didn't trust Dorian very much, so he repeatedly advised you not to reveal that you were a 'Trickmaster'. But now you feel that you must be honest with your teacher, so you're telling him the truth.
"In short, push everything onto your 'fiancé'. Dorian probably won't blame you, and may even be touched by your sincerity."
Fors opened her mouth: Is that even possible?
Then she hesitated: "So, I still have to lie?"
Hobert smiled and asked, "Am I a Beyonder?"
"Of course."
"Did I sell you the 'Trickmaster' potion?"
"That's right."
Hobert finally asked, "Where are you lying? You're just telling the truth in a different way."
Fors suddenly thought of Mr. Hanged Man at the Tarot Gathering. That's probably how he taught 'Little Sun' to deal with the chief of City of Silver.
Leaving Fors to ponder in place, Hobert continued to inspect the town. Amidst everyone's flattering greetings, he began to plan his next steps in his heart.
After dinner, Hobert pondered in his study how to deal with the giant beast in the lake.
At this moment, he suddenly heard a prayer from the "Nation of Disorder". Locking the door and entering the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert found an unfamiliar star expanding.
Hobert was slightly taken aback, and then realized it should be Lawrence Burke, the patriarch of the Balk family.
Spreading his spirituality over, he saw Lawrence, who was over 1.9 meters tall, with a few strands of white hair, broad back, and thick shoulders.
He said in a pious tone: "…Great Creator, we are about to have another conflict with the Rose School. As the Balk family, who is willing to be loyal to you, we lack the power of the Angel level.
"When the conflict occurs, we pray that you can lend a hand and stop the opponent's Angel.
"After this battle, we will dedicate all the spoils to you, and every member of our family will faithfully believe in you and serve you."
Hobert nodded. His attitude was acceptable, and the conditions offered were good.
However, he didn't intend to respond to the other party immediately. How could a big shot like the "Creator" be waiting in the kingdom of God at all times, replying to some unfamiliar prayers?
While waiting, he decided to browse the stars of Alice and Ethel. Alice was attending a ball. In the magnificent ballroom, she was toasting and chatting happily with the nobles.
The conversations between these nobles were really uninteresting.
Hobert jumped to Ethel's star. She was running, her subordinates were nowhere to be seen, and there was blood on her clothes.
Or rather, she was running for her life, traversing through the forest, using vegetation to block her tracks.
Hobert was stunned. Did the mission fail?
He turned up the "True Vision" and found that there were indeed pursuers behind him, at least a demigod was chasing after him.
Hobert pondered for a moment. He could test the combat power of the "Bull Demon King" and save the owner of this star at the same time.
Since he had high-end combat power such as the "Bull Demon King" and the "Holy Infant King", he hadn't used them in actual combat even once.
In a few days, he would have to stop the Angel of the Rose School as soon as he came up, which made Hobert feel a little unsure.
First, he would test the effect of the "Bull Demon King" in actual combat, so that he wouldn't be caught off guard when using higher-level combat power.
…
In the mountains of northwestern Feynapotter.
Run, run with all your might!
Ethel tried to adjust her breathing. She didn't expect that the Intis Republic would have detected this rendezvous operation.
More than ten years ago, the Kingdom of Feynapotter developed a Rear Admiral into a spy in the southern war zone of the Intis Republic.
For more than ten years, this spy provided a lot of valuable information. He had always been very careful, and this source of information had been very stable and safe.
The Feynapotter royal family and the military had secretly commended him more than once. Each time, they sent high-ranking military officers or members of the royal family to commend him at the appropriate time, to show the royal family and the military's importance to him.
Not long ago, that spy provided another key piece of information, enough for the royal family to commend him again.
Ethel was not only a member of the royal family, but also a high-ranking officer in the northern war zone, so Ferdinand II sent her to commend that spy.
Theoretically, there shouldn't be any problems with this commendation, but when Ethel arrived at the rendezvous point, she was ambushed.
The demigod responsible for protecting her was given priority, controlled, and then eliminated!
The other subordinates were either killed or lost their combat power in the process of covering Ethel's escape.
Only Ethel escaped, and she was also injured.
As she ran, she pondered: There must be a traitor on Feynapotter's side, otherwise the opponent's manpower wouldn't be so targeted.
Just as she thought of this, clusters of flames flew from behind Ethel, passed over her head, and finally the flames reunited in front of her, solidifying into a middle-aged man with a full beard: "Okay, the cat-and-mouse game is over. Either you surrender immediately, or we knock you out and take you back."
Ethel looked coldly at the man in front of her. As a princess most valued by King Fernando II, she couldn't be taken back alive. Even if they took her body back, it was estimated that the Intis Republic would make a big fuss about it.
What to do?
How to commit suicide? How to destroy her body?
Thinking of this, Ethel felt a burst of sorrow. She still had a bright future. Her father had promised her that as long as she trained in the northern war zone for a few years and accumulated some military achievements, when she returned to Feynapotter City, she would be a duchess.
Moreover, in her work, she had also met a handsome and dashing lieutenant colonel, and she was planning to promote him to Rear Admiral and wait for him to propose to her.
But all of this was just a bubble!
Ethel smiled sadly: "What if I choose neither?"
As she spoke, she picked up her gun and was about to shoot herself in the temple.
The man with a full beard was an "Iron Blooded Knight". He smiled contemptuously and casually kicked a stone on the ground. The stone flew up and knocked her pistol away before Ethel could fire.
As a Sequence 5, Ethel didn't even have the ability to commit suicide in front of a demigod.
At this time, the other seven or eight pursuers also caught up and surrounded Ethel.
Ethel said with a wry smile: "Earth Mother, in the name of being your devout believer, please kill me!"
The "Iron Blooded Knight" crossed his arms and smiled, admiring Ethel's desperate expression.
In her prayer just now, Ethel suddenly found inspiration: "No matter which evil god, as long as you hear my prayer, I am willing to offer my soul and body…"
Although she didn't say the specific honored name, the "Iron Blooded Knight" knew that it was not appropriate to let Ethel talk nonsense any further.
He was about to step forward to knock Ethel unconscious when suddenly, he felt a surge of power descending. Under the enormous pressure, even the "Iron Blooded Knight" didn't dare to look up.
Then, several Sequence 6 who followed had the urge to kneel.
Silently, between Ethel and the "Iron Blooded Knight", there appeared a black monster emitting a sacred black light, with a bull's head but a pair of golden deer antlers.
Everyone was stunned: How free must an evil god be to accept such a broad prayer?
This bull-headed, deer-antlered monster was, of course, the "Bull Demon King" projected by Hobert.
The order Hobert gave it was: kill everyone except Ethel.
That's right, kill them. Since he was going to take action, he had to kill everyone around him to show the power of the "Creator's" servants.
Hobert's style was different from Klein's, or rather, the abilities that the "Nation of Disorder" and the "Sefirah Castle" were good at were different, which led to Hobert and Klein having different styles when pretending to be evil gods.
Although the "Holy Infant King" and the "Centipede Demon Lord" had the rank of Angels, they couldn't use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to create the image of Angels.
But the "Sefirah Castle" could more easily create the image of Angels, giving people a great visual impact.
Of course, the power of the "Nation of Disorder" just couldn't create too impressive images. The "Holy Infant King" and the "Centipede Demon Lord" were both very good fighters.
Because in addition to the extraordinary power of high rank, they also had terrifying physical attacks.
Although the "Bull Demon King" was a level lower than them, it was also a terrifying existence for demigods.
Everyone else present, including Ethel, was still confused by the appearance of the "Bull Demon King", but the "Iron Blooded Knight" had already reacted: "Fatal attack!"
He sensed the power of the "Bull Demon King", so he decided to seize the opportunity.
The "Iron Blooded Knight" threw a punch, guided by his spirituality, towards the golden horns on the "Bull Demon King's" head.
The "Bull Demon King" calmly opened its mouth, revealing its white teeth: "Woo ah~"
It let out a roar that struck the depths of people's hearts. The "Iron Blooded Knight" immediately felt as if his chest had been hit by a heavy object, and he took a step back with some stuffiness.
His "fatal attack" was thus interrupted.
Immediately afterward, mental shocks, like a tide, swept over, causing the "Iron Blooded Knight's" hands to tremble.
This was the "Bull Demon King's" "mental attack".
Demigods were still like this, and the other Sequence 5 and Sequence 6 who came with him all let out painful wails.
Especially the Sequence 6, kneeling on the ground in pain, blood flowing from their ears, corners of their eyes, nostrils, and corners of their mouths, especially their eyes, which were severely congested, as if they could burst open at any time.
The "Bull Demon King" then opened its mouth again and uttered a solemn word: "Chaos!"
Puff~ Puff~ Puff~
The heads of three Sequence 6 were directly crushed by the surging "power of disorder". Only three headless corpses were left on the scene, with blood spurting from their cavities.
Several Sequence 5 had also basically lost their combat power after two rounds of attacks.
The "Bull Demon King's" eyes, burning with black flames, looked at the "Iron Blooded Knight".
The "Iron Blooded Knight" knew that he was no match and immediately turned into scattered flames to escape.
But the "Bull Demon King" reached out and hit one of the flames. The "Iron Blooded Knight" rolled out of the flames, standing somewhat awkwardly.
"Filth!" The "Bull Demon King" spat out another word, and many viscous liquids immediately appeared on the surrounding ground.
The surfaces of the plants contaminated by these liquids were covered with a layer of iron-black spots. These spots quickly expanded, eventually connecting into one piece, and finally completely turning iron-black.
Those Sequence 5 were also quickly covered by the mucus, and no matter how they struggled, iron-black spots appeared on their bodies.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 408 The Fourth Believer
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Dragon243 for becoming a believer of the Church of MissRaven, +1]
Only the "Iron-Blooded Knight" was surrounded by a huge flame, isolating these mucus from the flames.
Two flame spears appeared in his left and right hands, and he threw them at the "Bull Demon King" one after another.
Since he couldn't leave, he had to fight desperately.
Then the "Iron-Blooded Knight" clenched his fists, and within a few tens of meters around him, a raging fire ignited. He held a huge orange fireball in both hands and pressed it towards the "Bull Demon King".
The two flame spears hit the "Bull Demon King's" chest one after another, but a black mist quickly enveloped them and quickly devoured them.
The fireball in the "Iron-Blooded Knight's" hand was the size of a steam car, and the surrounding trees were instantly withered by the heat.
"Order!" Two black light clusters appeared on the "Bull Demon King's" hands. He steadily held the huge fireball from this side and eroded it little by little. The flames near the "Bull Demon King" turned black, and the black flames became more and more.
The "Iron-Blooded Knight" simply let go of the huge fireball with both hands. He knelt down on one knee, pressed one hand on the ground, and a white-hot wall of fire appeared, burning directly towards the "Bull Demon King".
"Bull Demon King": "Distortion!"
The fire wall made a bend and "turned back" to burn the "Iron-Blooded Knight". At the same time, the "Bull Demon King" threw the black fireball in his hand on the ground, and the black flames spread rapidly.
The "Iron-Blooded Knight" immediately felt that the surrounding order had become very unfriendly to the flames, and he couldn't control the surrounding flames at all.
"Fatal Strike!" The "Iron-Blooded Knight" had to choose close combat. He had a strong physique, extremely strong vitality and defense. In fact, close combat was his forte.
Who would have thought that the "Bull Demon King" easily grabbed the left fist that the "Iron-Blooded Knight" used to launch a "Fatal Strike", and it stretched out its other hand forward!
Puff~
He took out a "thumping" heart.
The "Iron-Blooded Knight" stared blankly at the heart in front of him. It took a full second before he seemed to understand that it was his own heart!
He broke free from the "Bull Demon King's" restraint, staggering step by step, trying to leave here, and gradually walking faster and faster.
The "Iron-Blooded Knight's" vitality was indeed very tenacious. He actually ran without a heart.
"Distortion!" The "Bull Demon King" used distortion again, and the "Iron-Blooded Knight's" escape turned into a charge, and finally fell to the ground when he rushed to the "Bull Demon King".
The "Bull Demon King" threw the heart in his hand on the ground and went to solve the remaining Sequence 5s who were still struggling one by one.
Ethel felt as if she was in a dream, especially the "Iron-Blooded Knight", who was so easily had his heart dug out by the monster in front of her!
After the black monster had dealt with all the enemies, Ethel felt its eyes burning with black flames looking at her.
Ethel immediately knelt down on one knee: "Great god, thank you for your salvation. As I said before, I am willing to dedicate everything I have!"
With her rich knowledge of mysticism, she of course knew that reneging on the debt in this situation was the most stupid choice.
But then Ethel discovered that the monster with golden horns in front of her suddenly knelt down in one direction.
Ethel looked in that direction in surprise and saw the solid and mysterious figure in mid-air.
He sat upright on the throne among the swords, emitting a sacred black light. Even in the dark night, these lights were still as obvious as dust under the lights.
The huge pressure made Ethel lower her head immediately. She changed the object of her worship: "Great god, thank you for your salvation. I am willing to dedicate everything I have to you!"
Hobert said in a faint tone: "I am not interested in the flesh and soul of mortals."
Ethel immediately asked respectfully: "Then what can I do for you?"
The great voice asked instead: "Are you a descendant of Castiya?"
Ethel's eyes narrowed: Castiya was the founder of the Feynapotter royal family. Does this mysterious existence know my ancestors?
She said: "Yes, I am Ethel, the daughter of Ferdinand II, a descendant of Castiya."
Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne", was slightly stunned: She is actually a genuine princess!
"No wonder I can hear your prayers," Hobert said, "You can call me 'The Creator'."
Ethel was stunned: "Great 'Creator', do you really not need me to offer anything?"
"The Creator" smiled and asked: "Do you have anything that can interest me?"
Ethel was stunned again. She didn't seem to have anything that could interest a god.
"The Creator" continued: "Be ready to be dispatched at any time. Without my permission, you must not reveal my name to others."
After speaking, the great figure in mid-air disappeared, and the monster with the bull's head and deer antlers also disappeared.
Ethel stood there for a few seconds under the night sky: I didn't make any promises, aren't you afraid that I won't admit it in the future?
But soon she took advantage of the moonlight to see clearly the pursuers whose heads were crushed, the pursuers whose bodies were covered with rust-like spots, and the "Iron-Blooded Knight" with a hole in his heart.
She smiled: If I dare to deny it, maybe my end will be worse than these people.
Then she breathed a sigh of relief and thought: Being ready to be dispatched at any time is better than really sacrificing flesh and blood. Also, why did "The Creator" say "No wonder I can hear your prayers" after knowing that I am a descendant of the great Castia?
Ethel shook her head and did not continue to think about this question: Anyway, I survived, I still want to become a duchess, and I still have Colonel Bairde...
Thinking of this, her eyes suddenly narrowed and gradually became cold.
After waiting for the Beyonder characteristics of the "Iron-Blooded Knight" and others to be extracted, Ethel took the Beyonder characteristics and quickly left here.
...
At this time, Hobert on the "Iron Throne" secretly said it was a pity that in order to maintain the image of "The Creator", he did not let the other party sacrifice those pleasing Beyonder characteristics and magical items to the "Nation of Disorder".
Then, Hobert reflected on the process of communicating with Ethel just now, and felt that when he communicated with the other party, he was still a little unnatural compared to Klein's treatment of the Tarot Club members.
Of course, this has a lot to do with the fact that Klein's "believers" all came to him on their own, while his "Creator's" believers have to actively contact him.
But it is much better now than when he first contacted Elliott. In the face of absolute strength, Ethel will not notice "The Creator's" unnaturalness.
A princess of the Feynapotter Kingdom!
Hobert sighed. If he could develop her into a believer, it would save a lot of trouble in the development of Jeffrey Town.
Then, Hobert responded to Lawrence, who was "waiting aside": "Okay. Recite my name before the battle begins."
After testing, he has enough confidence to resist an angel.

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 409 Killing the Giant Beast at the Bottom of the Lake
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Eric Friesen foe becoming a believer of the Church of MissRaven, +1]
The next day, which was Tuesday morning, the residents of Jeffery Town heard that the lord was going to challenge the giant beast at the bottom of the lake again.
Those who had seen the giant beast yesterday followed again, and those who had not seen the giant beast yesterday also followed because they wanted to see it.
In a short time, almost all the people in Jeffery Town appeared by the lake, and some even ran to the neighboring villages to call some villagers to see the giant beast.
A large area of the reeds by the lake had been flattened. Now, no one was afraid of the monsters that often came ashore from the lake. Even the giant beast in the lake had become a topic of conversation for everyone.
While discussing the giant beast, everyone stared at the lord pacing by the lake. They speculated: the lord seemed to be thinking about how to eliminate the giant beast.
In fact, Hobert was considering how to end the situation with so many spectators today.
After the verification last night, the best way to defeat the giant beast was actually to pray to himself and let the "Bull Demon King" deal with the giant beast again.
But now that so many people had come, it was different. It was best for the lord to defeat the giant beast himself, so that everyone would be impressed by the lord's martial virtue and form a new, strong sense of identity.
This would greatly help with the digestion of the potion, and there was even a high probability of completely digesting the potion.
Since there was such a purpose, he had no choice but to use the tactics he had thought of yesterday to challenge the giant beast at the bottom of the lake, instead of "finding a helper."
So, in full view of everyone, Hobert once again stepped into Full Moon Lake.
This caused everyone to exclaim. People who had never seen this scene did not expect the lord to enter the lake bottom in this way. The lord's breath was long enough! It was estimated that the distance from the lake shore to the deep-water area was quite far.
On the opposite mountain, Viscount Teuton, of course, had already prepared his telescope and began to spy on the situation by the lake again.
Because of his previous exploration experience, Hobert simply swam quickly to the top of the underwater forest, using himself as bait to attract the giant beast.
Soon, the lake water stirred again. Hobert immediately felt that his body was showing signs of abnormality and loss of control. Sure enough, the giant beast had such abilities!
Hobert immediately injected spirituality into the "Order Crystal". A black shield-like barrier appeared around him, effectively blocking the process of abnormality and loss of control.
Suddenly, Hobert felt ropes binding him. He looked down and saw that at some point, a piece of seaweed had floated not far from him. It grew rapidly, like a green tentacle, wrapping around Hobert's body.
Hobert struggled a bit, and it was more resilient than expected.
So he quickly used "Blink" to leave the position he was in.
As Hobert had expected, in the next second, the giant beast's giant mouth appeared again, and it almost bit Hobert.
After breaking free from the seaweed, Hobert used another "Blink" to come behind the giant beast, attempting to approach the giant beast's back.
Although the giant beast was huge, it moved nimbly in the water. It immediately turned its body and bit at Hobert again.
Hobert waited for the giant beast to approach, watching the bloody mouth getting bigger and bigger. Just as he felt the huge suction, Hobert used "Blink" again, coming above the bloody mouth and touching the giant beast's head with his hand.
However, the suction generated by the giant beast's bloody mouth was greater than Hobert had expected. He was immediately sucked into the giant beast's mouth.
The giant beast did not expect that Hobert would take the initiative to come to its door. It immediately closed its giant mouth and swallowed downwards.
Hobert felt as if he was in a torrent. He quickly pulled out his knife with the help of the "Ocean Pendant" and stabbed it into the giant beast's throat to temporarily stabilize his body.
Hobert quickly placed his hand on the giant beast's throat again. The giant beast and the lake water in front of Hobert suddenly became illusory. Hobert took the giant beast into the spirit world.
What was more magical was that even in the giant beast's throat, Hobert could clearly see the scene in the spirit world.
Taking advantage of the giant beast's obvious daze, Hobert fiercely cut open the giant beast's flesh, opening a hole in its throat that was big enough for one person to crawl out of.
Soon, the giant beast and Hobert left the spirit world and came to a valley full of gravel and only a few plants.
This was the tactic Hobert had considered yesterday. He knew that he had no chance of killing the giant beast underwater, because that was the giant beast's home field, and because several powerful abilities could not be used underwater.
For example, "Lightning Strike". Even if lightning struck the giant beast, water conducts electricity, and Hobert felt that he would definitely be electrocuted.
And "Holy Light", the huge heat, it is estimated that the surrounding lake water could be burned into boiling water. The giant beast would be uncomfortable, and Hobert would be even more uncomfortable.
This rocky valley was not far south of Jeffery Town. If you were going to "Sapphire Manor" for a vacation, this was the only way to go.
Hobert had passed by here when he left "Sapphire Manor" before. The entire valley was full of rocks, and there was no place for vegetation to grow.
Moreover, there was no one living nearby. When Hobert was considering tactics yesterday, he felt that this place was suitable as a battlefield.
So he came to explore again yesterday and finally decided to send the giant beast here and solve it here.
As long as he risked bringing the giant beast here, his tactics would be half successful, because in terms of the environment, this place was unfavorable to the giant beast that lived underwater.
However, the degree of risk in approaching the giant beast still exceeded Hobert's imagination. If he did not have the "Ocean Pendant" to control the water flow, he would have been sucked into the giant beast's stomach.
Although he didn't know what the situation was inside, the giant beast had been trying to swallow Hobert, which meant that its stomach had a way to subdue Hobert.
As soon as he appeared in the real world, Hobert immediately crawled out of the cut-open hole. He was surprised to find that if he was any later, the huge hole would have healed.
The giant beast quickly recovered. It shook its head violently, throwing Hobert, who was on its neck, out.
In mid-air, Hobert threw the "Order Wood" in his hand into the crack in the stone: "Order!"
By the time Hobert landed, the "Order Wood", which was more than ten meters high and tens of meters wide, had already taken shape.
The giant beast roared and rammed its huge body into the "Order Wood", but only shook the "Order Wood" slightly.
Here, the giant beast completely lost the environment that was beneficial to it. Without the help of the lake water, its limbs made its movements very slow.
Because of the sparse vegetation around it, and Hobert's use of the "Order Crystal" to resist loss of control and abnormality, the power of its Beyonder abilities was greatly reduced.
The giant beast now only had brute strength left, which made it angrily raise its neck and roar: "Woo~"
At this time, Hobert would certainly not approach the other party. He threw out a "Disorder Stone": "Disorder!"
Under the "Order Wood", circles of invisible black ripples rippled out, but the giant beast only glared at Hobert and did not have any effect at all.
Obviously, the giant beast used its ability to neutralize the power of the "Disorder Stone".
But it didn't matter. Hobert completed the process of "bribery" in the process: "Weakness!"
The giant beast's level was obviously higher than Sequence 5, but it had not reached the level of Sequence 4. Hobert's weakening had a limited impact on it.
"Lightning Strike!" Hobert used the speed advantage of being able to fly low to unscrupulously attack the giant beast that could only crawl slowly.
"Lightning Strike" hit the giant beast's back, scorching a large area.
Hobert did not give the other party any chance to breathe: "Holy Light!"
The huge light fell, almost submerging the entire giant beast.
When the light dissipated, the giant beast's skin became dry, cracked and black. The light just now made it close its eyes. At this time, it suddenly opened its eyes and roared again.
"Holy Light" made it temporarily lose its mind. It instinctively used its Beyonder power to make the surrounding vegetation more lush, no longer stingy with its Beyonder power and spirituality.
The weeds and small shrubs that grew out of the cracks in the rocks immediately grew wildly. The rocky valley, which had been desolate for who knows how many years, was actually half covered in green.
As the giant beast regained its sanity, it immediately stopped the consumption of spirituality that was causing the vegetation to grow wildly.
Then the giant beast twisted its body, and the dark skin and flesh fell off. The places on its back that were scorched by "Lightning Strike" and "Holy Light" healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Hobert, who was in the low air not far away, pondered for a while and immediately summoned the wind blade.
However, the giant beast's skin's defensive power was also quite strong. Only a few wind blades cut open its skin, but it healed quickly.
Hobert frowned. This self-healing ability was also strong!
Taking advantage of the gap in Hobert's attack, the giant beast chose to escape out of the valley, which forced Hobert to keep attacking. He first stole the giant beast's idea of leaving, and then immediately used "Madness" when the other party had just regained its thinking.
Then it was "Lightning Strike", and then it was "Holy Light".
Hobert sadly discovered that even on land, he did not have many abilities that could harm the giant beast.
After the second "Holy Light", the temperature in the valley continued to rise, and it had basically reached the level of summer.
Hobert was not discouraged and used "Wind Blade", "Lightning Strike" and "Holy Light" again.
After the third round of attacks, the giant beast's self-healing ability obviously slowed down, and it was panting heavily, and breathing seemed very difficult.
Hobert pursed his lips and smiled. Under the blessing of the "Order Wood", he kept "distorting" the surrounding environment. Now those "twists" have finally accumulated and are taking effect.
The entire valley had become extremely dry and oxygen-deficient. For this kind of amphibian-like giant beast, dryness would make it very weak.
And oxygen deficiency was a fatal blow. This kind of huge creature needed a lot of oxygen. Once the oxygen content was reduced, it would be difficult for it to survive for too long.
At this time, Hobert was already a little uncomfortable with the oxygen content, let alone the giant beast in front of him.
Soon, the giant beast no longer had the strength to escape, but Hobert's attack continued: "Wind Blade! Lightning Strike! Holy Light!"
Hobert took a deep breath. He had consumed too much spirituality, and he had to rest a little.
At this time, the giant beast no longer had the strength to shake off the scorched wounds and flesh on its back from "Lightning Strike" and "Holy Light" like before.
Hobert flew to the outside of the canopy of the "Order Wood" and gasped for a few breaths. He was still constantly "twisting" the environment under the canopy, just quietly watching the giant beast become weaker and weaker, and fall to the ground and groan in pain.
Now the "Order Wood" could last for fifteen minutes. Hobert waited patiently for eleven or twelve minutes. The giant beast seemed to have fainted from lack of oxygen.
Only then did Hobert carefully approach the giant beast with a knife. The giant beast felt Hobert's malice. It wanted to bite Hobert again, but it just opened its mouth and could not move its head at all.
Hobert was wary of any accidents and quickly "Blinked" to the giant beast's head, looking at the giant beast's unwilling eyes, looking at the skin that had become very dry due to the dry environment, and fiercely stabbed the Tang knife into its head.
The giant beast used its last strength to twist its body, but it still could not stand up.
Hobert slashed hard, and the sharp Tang knife cut open the giant beast's skull, leaving a deep scar in its brain.
The last trace of the giant beast's spirituality dissipated, causing the valley, which had previously turned green, to bloom with beautiful flowers.
At this time, the "Order Wood" also quickly withered and turned into an ordinary wooden stick.
Hobert looked at the flowers: "At least you left a trace in this world."
Then he smiled: "I heard that dinosaurs died from food shortages and lack of oxygen. Huge things have the advantage of being huge, but once you leave the environment that makes you comfortable, you will immediately lose your advantages!"
He sat next to the giant beast for a while, recovered the "Order Wood" and the "Disorder Stone", and then used "Travel" again to return to the bottom of Full Moon Lake.
The rocky valley where they had fought later became "Hundred Flowers Valley", covered with flowers and green, and became an attraction of "Sapphire Manor".
Hobert, who returned to Full Moon Lake, was preparing to drag the giant beast's body to the surface immediately, but then he thought that if he went back like this, it would not be in line with the "storyline" of having gone through a fierce battle.
So he began to use the "Ocean Pendant" to manipulate the water flow of Full Moon Lake, sometimes spraying up like a fountain, and sometimes spinning like a whirlpool.
The people on the shore saw these "visions" and sure enough pointed and discussed how fierce the battle was at the bottom of the lake.
After tossing for a few minutes, Hobert felt that his spirituality was about to dry up, and then he finally floated to the surface: "Find two thick ropes!"
Fors and Seel, who had been sweating for Hobert on the lake shore, quickly found ropes and threw them into Full Moon Lake.
The lord's subjects also breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that the lord had won.
Hobert wrapped the ropes around the giant beast's upper and lower jaws respectively, and floated to the surface again: "Pull!"
At this time, there were hundreds of people on the shore, and the young adults among them pulled the ropes under Seel's organization.
The two ropes immediately tightened. At first, when it was at the edge of the deep-water area, it was not very heavy. As the giant beast's body entered the shallow water area, it gradually became heavier.
When pulling it to the shore, everyone was not only surprised by the giant beast's size, but also had to use all their strength to continue pulling the giant beast up.
"The lord has defeated the giant beast!"
"Long live the lord!"
When the giant beast's body was completely exposed to the water, everyone cheered and spread the news.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 410 The Baron's Potion is Completely Digested
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert sat on the chair that Seel had brought over and rested for a while before saying, "Seel, you come and cut open the giant beast's abdomen!"
As he spoke, he stretched out the Tang sword in his hand and stuck it into the ground.
Seel accepted the order, held the knife with both hands, and stabbed into the giant beast's abdomen. The sharpness of the Tang sword exceeded Seel's imagination. He felt as if he hadn't used much force at all, and he had completely cut open the abdomen.
As the giant beast's abdomen was cut open, a large number of internal organs flowed out, among which there were several crystals shimmering with brilliant colors around its liver.
The clever Seel immediately understood that this was what the Baron was looking for. Before everyone could react, he quickly cut off a piece of clothing and wrapped the crystals.
Hobert nodded with satisfaction, gave Seel a wink, and told him to keep the crystals safe and give them to him later.
He then said to Roy, "Find someone to collect all the internal organs of the giant beast!"
Hobert estimated that the Church of the Earth Mother would not waste any spiritual materials: "The giant beast's corpse will be placed by the lake!"
Let more people come and see and feel the lord's martial virtue.
He got up and said to the surrounding residents: "You may have heard the old people say how prosperous the waterway here used to be, but you have never seen it, and you can't even imagine what a prosperous waterway looks like.
"Now the problem of Full Moon Lake blocking the waterway has been solved! Next, I will devote myself to dredging the Taidi River waterway.
"In the near future, Jeffery Town will be prosperous again. Get ready to welcome a better new life!"
In fact, the situation of the waterway being cut off has not been completely resolved, but there is no need to announce the sealing of the center of Full Moon Lake in public.
Amidst the cheers of the surrounding people, Hobert put on his new cloak and left with Fors and his guards, including Seel.
Just after leaving the crowd, Hobert felt the long-lost cracking sound in his spirituality. The 'Baron of Corruption' potion was completely digested.
After the potion is digested, Hobert's continued role-playing as the lord, and the people's continued recognition of his lord status, will make his spirituality and potion more compatible.
Back at the Lord's Mansion, Fors whispered to Hobert that she wanted to go back to Backlund. After Hobert successfully killed the giant beast of Full Moon Lake, she could safely meet with her teacher Dorian.
Hobert took the cloth bag from Seel, returned to the study alone, and reviewed the Sequence 5 promotion ceremony.
He had already considered the Sequence 5 promotion ceremony and thought of ways to facilitate the ceremony. In order to make the ceremony a success in one go, Hobert had reviewed it many times.
While he was considering this matter, Bishop Simpson's messenger, the big dog, appeared in the study again.
This time, it was holding a cloth bag in its mouth. After putting the cloth bag on the desk, it stuck out its tongue and looked at Hobert expectantly.
Hobert smiled helplessly and said to the outside: "Roy, that who, that Alan..."
Alan was a male servant who had just started working today.
"Go to the kitchen and get more than 5 Neg of raw meat!"
Alan, who had just started working on his first day, had witnessed the lord killing the giant beast. At this time, his mood was still difficult to suppress. After hearing the order, he immediately trotted to the kitchen.
Hobert opened the cloth bag, inside were three wooden boxes and a letter.
One wooden box was full of gold Solas banknotes, one wooden box contained two tubes of yellow and two tubes of orange medicine, and one wooden box contained two jars of blood.
Alan had already brought the raw meat and presented it to the Baron respectfully.
"Put it on the ground." Hobert picked up the letter and opened it.
"Yes." Alan retreated to the door again.
The big dog picked up the meat, wagged its tail at Hobert, and disappeared into the spirit world.
Hobert smiled: "I wonder if I will develop feelings after feeding it a few more times?"
He looked at the letter:
"Respected Baron Hobert:
I didn't expect there to be so many spiritual materials. This transaction needs to be approved by the Archbishop, which adds an extra step to the process, so the speed is much slower. Please understand.
The box contains 4100 gold Solas, and the extra money is our first transaction, the sincerity I express..."
Seeing this, Hobert thought: Is the sincerity of an archbishop worth more than 30 gold Solas?
He continued to read: "...I was very surprised to see your plan to seal Full Moon Lake. After reporting it to the Archbishop, the Archbishop said that he would fully support your sealing operation.
"The two jars of blood in the wooden box were collected from the church's dungeon, fresh blood from the 'Biologist' and 'Potions Professor'. If you have any other needs, please contact me.
"In the other wooden box, the yellow one is a potion that can restore your own spirituality in ten minutes, and the orange one is a potion that can restore your strength in eight minutes.
"You should know that these four tubes of potion are very valuable, but this time we provide them to you for free as support for your sealing operation."
The signature is Bishop Simpson's fire lacquer seal.
Hobert folded the letter again, put it in the drawer, then counted the gold Solas to confirm that it was correct, and put a tube of yellow and a tube of orange potion on his body.
The gold Solas was sacrificed to the "Nation of Disorder", and the other two wooden boxes were placed on the bookshelf.
...
Backlund, Port District.
Fors came to the hotel that Dorian mentioned in the letter, came to the door of room 208, knocked three times first, then knocked twice, and finally knocked five times.
A few seconds later, the door opened, and Fors saw Dorian, who was of medium build, with his hair neatly combed and wearing a black suit.
Fors immediately smiled and said, "Teacher Dorian."
Dorian let Fors in, closed the door, and said, "Your talent has exceeded my imagination. You have actually understood the 'Acting Method' from the words I mentioned in the letter!"
This compliment made Fors a little blush: "You flatter me."
Dorian said again: "This time I brought the 'Trickmaster' potion..."
Fors mustered up the courage: "I was just about to tell you about this. Teacher, I'm sorry, I have concealed something in this matter. My... my fiancé is also an Beyonder.
"He just helped me find the 'Trickmaster' formula and potion more than two months ago. I'm sorry, I'm already a 'Trickmaster'."
After saying this, Fors felt relaxed all over: "The reason why I concealed it from you before was because my fiancé told me that the Beyonder world is full of darkness and trickery. I couldn't completely trust you at the beginning.
"But after several meetings and contact through letters, I felt your noble character. I am very ashamed and guilty for concealing it from you before."
Dorian was stunned for a few seconds before saying: "I am the one who should be ashamed, Miss Fors.
"The reason why I provided you with the potion formula and main materials actually has my purpose.
"Your sincerity makes me ashamed. My divination is correct. You are the one who can save my family. Your sincerity is the most powerful evidence!"
Fors breathed a sigh of relief. This was the best result.
"If you have time, maybe I should meet your fiancé. I believe he is also a gentleman of noble character," Dorian said with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 411: The Nobles' Little Trouble
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Fors chose to face Dorian with the utmost sincerity. Not only was she not blamed by her teacher, but Dorian was also touched by her sincerity and became even more trusting of this student.
Fors recounted her extraordinary experiences: before meeting her fiancé, she was somewhat ignorant of the mystical world. Through her interactions with her fiancé, she learned much about the mystical world, but it was incomplete. It was not until she met teacher Dorian that she had a place to answer her questions and gradually gained a comprehensive understanding of the mystical world.
Dorian also spoke of his family's curse and the currently fragmented Abraham family.
Both teacher and student showed great sincerity, making the atmosphere of communication very harmonious.
At the end of the conversation, Dorian left behind the "Astrologer" potion formula.
Fors glanced at it: "Sequence 7: Astrologer.
Main materials: Meteorite crystal, Lavos squid blood crystal.
Supplementary materials:…"
"Thank you for your help, teacher Dorian, this is exactly what I need." Fors was telling the truth. Although she could get potion formulas at a lower cost than the market price from Hobert, even so, the "Astrologer" formula would still cost at least seven or eight hundred pounds.
Dorian smiled slightly: "Finding the main materials for the 'Astrologer' potion is a test for you. As long as you can find one of them, I will provide you with the other main material."
Fors had a more real understanding of the "Angel Family". Even after more than a thousand years, they still had a huge foundation!
After thanking Dorian again, Fors said, "Teacher, I saw someone at a Beyonder gathering buying dragon-patterned tree bark. I wonder if you have any there?"
Dorian smiled slightly: "This is a coincidence of fate. In addition to the main material for 'Trickmaster', I also brought a few mystical ingredients, one of which is more than ten grams of dragon-patterned tree bark.
"I usually wouldn't carry such materials with me, but I happened to bring them this time."
...
Feynapotter, Jeffrey Town.
Hobert was planning to call Philip and others to deploy the matters of the Mentor of Disorder ritual and the subsequent construction work in Jeffrey Town.
Seel suddenly came to report: "Lord, Knight Louis and Knight Duke request to see you."
Hobert was stunned for a moment, pondered for a while, and then said: "Let them wait for me in the main hall."
A few minutes later, Hobert came to the main hall of the lord's mansion. Albert Louis and Grove Duke immediately knelt on one knee: "Lord!"
Hobert was not surprised by the two people's sudden "enthusiasm".
These two people can be regarded as the most knowledgeable people in Hobert's territory. Through Hobert's series of policies and the giant beast's corpse on the shore of Full Moon Lake, they certainly understood that this was a lord who had both the means and the martial prowess.
Of course, they came at this time to express their loyalty.
After Hobert sat down, he looked at the two people and then said: "In my territory, every inch of land and every subject must be under my rule.
"You can now move to Jeffrey Town, one to serve as 'Judicial Knight' and the other to serve as 'Taxation Knight'. These are two lucrative positions."
Albert and Grove opened their mouths wide together. They never expected that the "cost" of allegiance would be so high: giving up the territory inherited from their ancestors.
They quietly looked at the unsmiling Hobert, and determined that he was not joking, nor was he like other nobles who were asking for the sky-high price, waiting for them to bargain.
They realized at the same time that if they didn't do this, they would face more serious consequences.
"Times have changed." Hobert spread his hands: "If local nobles don't want to be eliminated in this torrent, they can only lean towards the center, and the center in the territory is me!
"Now I can give you generous conditions and solve this problem peacefully. If I take the initiative to find you after a while, you will not be able to keep anything."
The two knights fell into contemplation together. In the past when the waterway was prosperous, the local nobles of Southern Kerr were suppressed by the king in Feynapotter City to the point where they only had honorary titles left. When the waterway was interrupted and this place was isolated from the world, the system immediately regressed and returned to the land aristocratic era of two or three hundred years ago.
In Southern Kerr, formal barons and viscounts had to bow their heads to some terrifying forces. Even the lords enfeoffed by the king could not manage this closed area.
Nobles with titles had to make huge compromises, even close to being puppets.
However, the most basic knight class was greatly preserved. Their fiefdoms were generally based on villages. In order to maintain the stability of the grassroots, the interests of most knights were protected, and their power was even consolidated.
At this time, the powerful lord in front of them suddenly wanted to take back the ruling power of the territory, and the two knights were of course difficult to choose.
Hobert was not in a hurry and waited for them to "consider clearly".
In fact, there was nothing to consider. As long as they dared to say no, Hobert planned to kill one on the spot to establish his prestige. He estimated that the other would immediately yield.
However, Hobert underestimated the two knights' endurance. After considering for more than twenty minutes, the two almost simultaneously expressed their willingness to accept the lord's arrangement.
A smile finally appeared on Hobert's face: "Albert Louis, right?"
Albert immediately bowed and said: "Yes."
"You have a Sealed Artifact, but you are not an Beyonder!"
Albert was slightly stunned: "Lord, you have a unique vision. In order to express my loyalty to you, I will offer the ancestral…"
"I am not interested in your Sealed Artifact." Hobert smiled: "If you do your job well and are loyal enough, I will give you a choice in three months.
"You can choose to become an 'Arbiter' or a 'Lawyer'!"
The carrot and stick, a set of combined punches, will never be out of date.
Albert immediately knelt on the ground and said excitedly: "I choose 'Arbiter'!"
Becoming an "Arbitrator" was the dream of their three generations, but the Feynapotter Kingdom was similar to the Loen Kingdom, and had very strict control over the Beyonder characteristics of the "Justiciar" pathway. They had never had the opportunity to become an "Arbiter".
After Albert expressed his determination to be loyal, Hobert looked at Grove again: "Grove Duke! Which pathway are you an Beyonder of?"
Grove immediately bowed and said: "Lord, I am a 'Lawyer'."
Hobert smiled slightly: "Similarly, if you perform well enough in these three months, I will give you the potion formula for 'Barbarian'."
He once again received Grove's allegiance.
"It's almost New Year's Day. The lord's mansion will hold a New Year's celebration. You can stay in the lord's mansion for the time being to facilitate participation in this event." Hobert said:
"Let your servants move your homes to Jeffrey Town, and then go home to appease your families."
Before completely taking over the territories of the two knights, Hobert would of course not let them go back.
After coming out of the main hall of the lord's mansion, the two knights looked at each other and felt that the current situation was somewhat unreal.
They were originally under the great pressure of the new lord to express their obedience and allegiance, but now their territories were gone and they had become direct subordinates of the lord's mansion.
At the same time, they seemed to have a better future. As long as they served the new lord with their hearts for three months, they would be able to obtain the potions and potion formulas they had dreamed of before!
Then the two exchanged a few polite words and, under the supervision of the lord's guards, went to order their servants to move their homes.
In the main hall of the lord's mansion, as soon as the two knights left, a majestic figure sitting on a high-backed chair and surrounded by gray fog suddenly appeared in Hobert's mind.
It was "The Fool"!
Then the picture changed and a female voice of prayer appeared: "…Respected Mr. Fool, please tell Mr. Emperor that I have found the dragon-patterned tree bark, and 10 grams will cost 500 pounds."
The picture ended, and Hobert was a little dumbfounded: judging from the dress, it should be Fors.
He returned to the study, locked the door, and prayed to the Fool: "The Fool who does not belong to this era…, Respected Mr. Fool, I am willing to accept this transaction. The 500 pounds can be deducted from my income at the Tarot Gathering."
At the end of yesterday's gathering, Hobert asked Mr. Fool to temporarily keep the rewards sacrificed by Alger and others, and after completing the transaction with "The Hanged Man", he would bestow the traded materials and the remaining rewards to himself.
He didn't expect that the transaction with "The Hanged Man" had not yet been completed, and Fors had found the dragon-patterned tree bark in advance.
This made Hobert couldn't help but sigh: The resources of the Tarot Gathering are becoming wider and wider. Audrey represents the resources of the Loen nobles and the "Psychology Alchemists", Alger represents the maritime resources, and "Little Sun" represents the City of Silver. Now, Fors represents the resources of the Abraham family.
Hobert completed the prayer, thinking that he would be able to complete the transaction immediately, but who knew that after waiting for a while, Fors came over: "Hobert, I have good news!"
She had just returned from Dorian's place, so of course she couldn't go back immediately to get the dragon-patterned tree bark, so she prepared to trade it at night.
Fors said to Seel: "You go out first."
Seel glanced at the lord, and after seeing Hobert nod slightly, he bowed slightly to the two of them, came outside the study, and closed the door.
"Teacher Dorian didn't blame me!" Fors smiled.
"I told you, your sincerity will definitely move him." Hobert knew Dorian's importance to Fors, and also knew Fors's role to Dorian. He had long "foreseen" this result.
The two had just chatted a few words when Seel outside said: "Lord, Albert hopes to talk to you alone."
Seel was very respectful to these two "Knight Lords", but after seeing their humble appearance in front of the lord, he felt that these knights were just like that.
So the original "Knight Louis" has now become "Albert".
Hobert was stunned. Didn't he say that he didn't want his Sealed Artifact?
Several Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts are still lying in the "Nation of Disorder". He really doesn't like Grade 3 now: "Let him in."
Albert entered the study: "Lord."
Then he looked at Fors on the side.
Hobert said: "This is my fiancée. Just say whatever you have to say. There is no need for her to avoid it."
He had already prepared to refuse the other party's offer of the Sealed Artifact, but who knew that Albert said: "Lord, I am here to tell you a shocking secret?"
"Your intention… um? Speak."
Albert lowered his voice and said: "Grove has already pledged allegiance to Viscount Teuton!"
Hobert was immediately stunned, not surprised by the secret Albert said, but realized that these two bottom-level nobles immediately showed their noble colors after deciding to pledge allegiance to the lord: attacking each other.
But Hobert had to deal with these broken things at this time: "Are you sure?"
"Absolutely true!" Albert said: "My squire has seen Grove send envoys to Viscount Teuton more than once."
Hobert nodded, was about to speak, but suddenly thought of another thing.
The study immediately fell into silence, and the invisible pressure made Albert breathless.
After a full half a minute, Hobert suddenly smiled: "Very good, the information you told me is very useful! You go back first, I will properly solve this matter."
Albert breathed a sigh of relief: "Yes!"
Hobert deliberately said to Seel in front of Albert: "Call Grove here."
Albert showed a happy expression, feeling that he had already occupied a favorable position in this matter.
After Albert left, Fors on the side whispered: "I think he should also have contact with Viscount Teuton."
"Double-dealing is the nature of nobles." Hobert smiled: "These two knights are afraid that the other will expose their old secrets first, so of course they have to rush to inform!
"According to common sense, this matter can only be resolved through several arguments, and ultimately it will be unresolved due to insufficient evidence, but this has removed a piece of Albert's heart disease.
"Even if someone mentions this matter again in the future, the lord will not punish them for this matter."
Fors shook her head: "I am indeed not suitable for politics."
"However, I don't plan to deal with it according to the usual practice among nobles."
Fors was stunned: "Do you want to punish them now?"
"Punishing them for insufficient evidence will put them on the moral high ground." Hobert smiled: "Moreover, Grove is more useful to me now.
"Watch the show quietly for a while, and don't make a sound."
Fors nodded.
Seel soon brought Grove over. After learning that Albert had come in advance, he secretly said something bad.
He had to prepare to bite Albert back and then enter the stage of arguing as soon as possible.
Who knew that as soon as Grove arrived at the lord's study, he heard the lord ask: "Does Viscount Teuton trust you very much?"
Grove quickly knelt on the ground: "Lord, in the past few years, this territory had no owner, I…"
"You only need to answer me, to what extent does Viscount Teuton trust you?" Hobert said: "I have a task for you to do. After it is done, you will be given a huge reward."

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - 412: A leisurely move amidst the busy schedule
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Grove was stunned for a moment, then looked up at the lord. It didn't sound like sarcasm. "I, I suppose he trusts me."
"What have you done for him? Tell me the truth. I can sense if you're lying."
Grove was stunned again. "I haven't done much. Just, just frequently reported on Viscount Teuton's situation, and later, frequently reported on the movements of those bandits living in the mountains! And I've offered him some wealth and two young women..."
Grove said seven or eight things in a row, his voice getting softer and softer. At this point, he realized that he was more like a knight loyal to Viscount Teuton.
Hobert nodded with satisfaction. "Good, good."
Grove immediately retorted, "That bastard Albert wasn't any better..."
Hobert waved his hand. "I'm giving you a task that's very suitable for you."
"Just give the order."
"Tomorrow, defect from the Lord's manor and join Viscount Teuton, and completely gain his trust, gradually becoming an indispensable figure in his eyes. Of course, I will provide assistance in this process."
Grove didn't react for a moment. After two or three seconds, he understood: the lord was targeting Viscount Teuton.
Hobert picked up the piece of paper beside him. "This is the potion formula for 'Barbarian'. If you agree, it's yours."
"If you can successfully complete the task in the future, I will also give you the subsequent potion formula for 'Briber' and the main ingredients."
Hobert smiled. "I am a Beyonder of the 'Lawyer' pathway. How far I can go, you can go just as far."
Grove only learned today that the potion after "Barbarian" is "Briber"
After thinking for a long time, he asked, "What if I fail?"
"Then I will also give you the main ingredient for 'Barbarian'. You, and your son, will both have a good job." The conditions Hobert offered were tempting enough.
Grove no longer hesitated. "I am willing to serve you."
Hobert poured spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon": "If you talk about this matter with anyone outside of this room, you will immediately commit suicide!"
Grove immediately said, "I will definitely keep this a secret!"
Hobert said, "I just gave your subconscious an order. Regardless of whether you guarantee it or not, when you leak the secret, you will immediately commit suicide."
Grove opened his mouth wide. This was a Beyonder world that he felt relatively unfamiliar with, but he knew that the lord was not scaring him.
He added, "I have something that can make Viscount Teuton tempted."
Hobert pondered for a moment. "I'll send it to you at the latest tonight."
As he spoke, he pushed the note in front of him towards Grove.
Grove respectfully took it. "In this life, I will only be loyal to Lord Hobert!"
Fors looked at Hobert sitting there with a smile on his face, and he didn't look like a "gentleman of high moral character" at all.
However, Fors was not afraid of such Hobert. She knew that Hobert had a heart that yearned for justice, but his means of achieving his goals were easily misunderstood.
Hobert said to Sheer outside, "Call Phillip, Conrad, and Roy here."
Soon, the three people came to the study.
Hobert said to Phillip and Conrad, "Send out all the manpower to issue a notice, saying that the lord will publicly announce how to pay taxes next year tomorrow, and let everyone in the town and all the villages come!
"After the announcement, the lord will also hold a banquet! To celebrate the New Year in advance!"
He said to Roy, "While ensuring the repair of the hotels and restaurants, after tomorrow's banquet, organize three hundred people to cut all the reeds by the lake and repair the large wharf as quickly as possible!"
After the three subordinates left one after another, Fors suddenly said, "I feel like something big is going to happen."
Hobert smiled. "That's right, something big will indeed happen tomorrow."
He glanced at the tightly closed door of the study. "Help me buy a loudspeaker in Backlund, and buy more batteries. After I announce how to pay taxes next year tomorrow, you have to help me explain it to everyone."
Fors was slightly stunned before nodding.
After only Hobert was left alone in the study, he asked Allen to order the kitchen to make donuts and wrote a letter to Jessica: How is Carrie's progress? I have a way to go to Backlund tonight. If the progress is smooth, the transaction can be completed tonight.
The kitchen knew that the lord "liked to eat donuts", so they had already prepared the corresponding ingredients, and soon more than a dozen donuts were baked.
Hobert summoned the messenger: "Is this okay? You take six donuts, and then wait there for a reply?"
The messenger stretched out her hand. "Yes, but waiting for more than ten minutes will cost three more donuts."
Hobert counted out six donuts. "No problem."
More than ten minutes later, the messenger brought Jessica's reply, and Hobert paid her three more donuts as before.
Jessica's reply was also simple: Carrie has done a lot of research in advance. Four Beyonder materials have produced two Beyonder weapons, and the success rate exceeds expectations. If you can come to Backlund, please come to 56 Empress Borough after 8 pm and meet in the large warehouse in the backyard.
Hobert smiled slightly. A Beyonder weapon is enough to tempt Viscount Teuton.
Even in Feynapotter City, Beyonder weapons are very rare Beyonder items, let alone in South Colson, a mountainous area that has been isolated from the world for more than half a century.
At more than three o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert received a reminder from Klein: "Hanged Man" had just traded the juice of the Crown Tree and the Black Giant Gold Monster Flower from other pirates, and the transaction could be completed.
In the evening, Hobert received a reminder from "The Fool": The transaction with Miss "Magician" was completed.
Hobert then performed the granting ceremony and obtained three Sequence 5 auxiliary materials and a small stack of gold pounds.
At the previous Tarot meeting, Hobert received a total of 1,800 pounds and a reward of one Beyonder material.
Three auxiliary materials, Crown Tree sap 800 pounds, Dragon-patterned Tree bark 500 pounds, and Black Giant Gold Monster Flower worth 300 pounds.
After completing these transactions, Hobert can still get 200 pounds in cash.
Seeing that small stack of cash, Hobert smiled. "It wasn't a waste of time."
After dinner, Hobert locked himself in the study again, first changed into the Loen-style clothes he bought in Backlund last time, then changed his appearance and used "Travel" to come to Backlund.
In Minsk Street, which Hobert was familiar with, he took a carriage to the backyard of 56 Empress Borough.
Jessica was already waiting at the entrance of the backyard. After Hobert got off the carriage, he changed back to his original appearance in front of Jessica.
"Oh my god..." Jessica exclaimed, "I was worried that you would be recognized."
She smiled and pointed behind her. "This is a property of Princess Alice. The people from MI9 don't dare to break in and arrest us."
Hobert was stunned. The name of this princess sounds a bit familiar!
