chapters.title: Chapter 413 - 413: Promoted to Mentor of Disorder (4k words)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[This is where chapters are beginning to reach 3k words, sometimes 6k]
Hobert finally understood why Jessica had been so fearless before, unafraid of exposing her residence whether facing MI9 or the "Judgment Group."
It turned out that the owner of the residence was willing and capable of providing them with a certain degree of security. Hobert wasn't quite sure about Alice's position in the royal family, but her status as a princess was there, and in many cases, she represented the majesty of the royal family, enough to make the people of MI9 dare not offend her.
Jessica whispered, "You should still change your appearance. Although Princess Alice promised not to interfere in our private affairs, there are other servants here, and it wouldn't be good if they saw you."
After all, Hobert had killed a prince not long ago, who was Alice's younger brother.
Hobert changed back to the appearance he had when he was riding in the carriage before, and then followed Jessica into the courtyard.
While walking inside, Hobert asked, "How is the 'Barbarian' potion being digested?"
"Digested? Hmm, that's a very appropriate word." Jessica smiled and said, "During the legislative process of the 'Labor Law,' I felt that the potion was being digested very well, and my condition has been very good."
Hobert nodded. What Jessica was doing was also equivalent to challenging the existing order in Backlund, so the potion was being digested to a certain extent: "When you feel that you have completely mastered the 'Barbarian' potion, write to me. I have the potion formula and main materials for 'Briber' there."
Jessica smiled and agreed, opened the small door of the large warehouse in front of her, and invited Hobert in.
This not-small warehouse is still divided into two parts. As soon as you enter, you can see the entire warehouse. It is much larger than Carrie's studio before, but it is still packed full by her.
On one side of the warehouse entrance, there is a small room, seemingly designed to record the entry and exit of warehouse property, but now it has been cleaned up by Jessica for receiving customers.
Carrie was already waiting inside, wiping a light red sword. Hobert noticed that there were many mysterious symbols engraved on the sword.
After learning that the unfamiliar-looking man in front of her was Hobert, Carrie smiled and said, "I can only say that we are very lucky to have created two mystical weapons in one go."
She raised the sword in her hand: "As long as you inject a weak amount of spirituality into it, it will become hotter and hotter until it turns red, and the sword will ignite flames. Each strike can sprinkle some sparks, which has the effect of interfering with the opponent's vision and increasing one's own power. In addition, there is about a 5% chance that it can help the holder find the enemy's weakness."
Hobert took the sword and played with it for a while. The ability of this sword was already very good: "How long does the effect last?"
"The effect produced by Beyonder materials is not like spiritual materials that lose so quickly." Carrie said, "However, it must be repaired by me or other craftsmen every year and a half. If it is repaired on time, there will be no problem using it for more than ten years."
As she spoke, she opened another wooden box on the table, which contained a crimson war hammer, also engraved with many occult symbols.
Carrie continued: "The materials you gave me are one of the main materials of 'Provoker'. I tried to use related spiritual materials to make these weapons have corresponding pathway abilities, not limited to the abilities of 'Provoker'.
"Like this war hammer, there is a certain probability that it will strike out flames that cover the opponent. The higher the probability of striking out flames, the darker the place. I tried it at night, and the probability can be as high as 10%.
"It also has an ability to provoke with a certain probability, causing the surrounding enemies to change their attack targets and attack the holder together. If the holder's defensive ability is strong enough, this is a very good ability in team battles, but if the holder is an Beyonder who is inclined to intelligence, this skill is tantamount to suicide."
Hobert nodded: Very suitable for use in the "Forsaken Land."
First of all, it is dark enough there, and secondly, the defensive abilities of the Beyonders there are generally very high.
Hobert asked, "How much does the material and labor cost in total?"
"Not much material was used." Jessica said from the side, "However, it took Carrie a lot of time. Please pay another 200 pounds for labor."
Hobert nodded and took out the 200 pounds that he hadn't warmed up yet: "I brought you three more of the same main materials this time."
Carrie was slightly stunned: "I must remind you again that you didn't lose money on these two mystical weapons, but that doesn't mean we'll have such good luck next time."
Theoretically speaking, there would be no problem selling these two weapons for 2,000 pounds.
But the cost is very high. "Provoker" is a relatively "popular" Beyonder pathway, and four main materials of this level are worth between 1,200 and 1,500 pounds.
Adding the 200 pounds for labor, Carrie and Jessica thought that the cost was between 1,600 and 1,700 pounds.
But the two weapons can only be sold for 2,000 pounds in the end, which is too little profit for them.
Hobert smiled and said, "I have relevant channels to obtain relatively preferential Beyonder materials. Just let go and do it. Even if you don't succeed once, I will still pay you the labor cost."
Carrie smiled: "Okay, but if there are three of the same main materials, I am confident that I can at least make one Beyonder weapon.
"Let me take a look. This seems to be the main material of 'Beast Tamer'. I have to check the information again to be sure.
"Hehe, I'm looking forward to what kind of Beyonder weapon I can create."
Hobert suddenly thought of a new question: "If it fails, will these main materials be wasted?"
This doesn't make sense, after all, that is a Beyonder material, and the Beyonder characteristics should not disappear.
"Those materials will be combined with the weapon, but will not give the weapon any ability." Carrie spread her hands: "Such materials are equivalent to being scrapped. They cannot be used to prepare potions, nor can they be used in the production of other weapons."
Hobert seemed to understand something: "If I'm not mistaken, a Beyonder weapon can be used for more than ten years, not because its extraordinary effect is gone, but because the metal material of the weapon can only support it for more than ten years?"
Carrie nodded: "That's the truth."
"If you encounter this kind of weapon, you can help me buy it at a low price. In my eyes, they still have residual value." Hobert said, "Also, I will also recycle weapons that have failed to be made. This is part of our transaction."
Carrie wondered: "What do you want these things for?"
Of course, it is to take them to the "Nation of Disorder" to crush them and obtain the Beyonder characteristics of the Beyonder materials for recycling and utilization.
Hobert smiled: "Of course I have my uses."
Carrie nodded and didn't continue to ask.
After talking about business, Jessica poured three glasses of wine, and the three of them sat on the sofa to chat.
While chatting, Carrie talked about Hobert's messenger, saying that the messenger's level must be very high.
Jessica also sighed: "And it can emit huge mental pressure. Today, when she was waiting for a reply, she made me feel huge pressure.
"This made me have to write faster, and I finished the reply in two or three minutes."
Hobert smiled: "According to my observation, her level is indeed not low..."
Wait, it only took two or three minutes to finish writing, why did it take more than ten minutes to give me the reply?
Okay, okay, the level is not low, but she likes to cheat summoners out of donuts.
Hobert took a sip of wine to hide his unnaturalness, and he suddenly thought: "Is this wine aged?"
Jessica smiled: "Princess Alice also gave us the wine cellar here and told us that we can drink freely. I looked at it before, and there are quite a few aged wines."
Hobert said, "Is there three-year-old white wine?"
"Yes."
"Then please get me a bottle, I just need it."
Originally, Hobert was going to find a winery to buy a bottle later, which saved him an extra trip.
"No problem." Jessica quickly brought the wine.
Hobert was about to give money, but when he thought about it, it would be too distant if he gave money, so the action of giving money was changed to thanking her.
After chatting for more than twenty minutes, around nine o'clock, Hobert left with two wooden boxes on his back and the wine in his hand.
He still didn't use "Traveling" in the Empress Borough. This is a gathering place for nobles. The royal family, the military, and the church protect this place relatively strictly. It is still safer to leave here honestly and then use "Traveling".
Back in his fief, Hobert first put the white wine on the desk, then opened the two wooden boxes and named the two weapons "Crimson Sword" and "Provocation War Hammer" respectively.
After playing with them for a while, Hobert closed the wooden boxes and quietly asked Seel to send the "Crimson Sword" to Grove.
After dedicating the "Provocation War Hammer" to the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert returned to his room and used meditation to fall asleep as soon as possible. He wanted to maintain an excellent state to deal with tomorrow's promotion.
...
Before dawn, the villagers and residents of the town made an appointment to go to the lord's mansion. Under the rule of the previous group of bandits, they had to pay taxes once a month.
If the leaders of those bandits had not been killed by the lord, it would have been time for them to pay taxes again.
So recently everyone has been a little uneasy. The lord's mansion has not sent anyone to urge them to pay taxes, and they don't know how the new lord plans to collect taxes.
When everyone learned that the lord was going to announce how to collect taxes, it immediately attracted widespread attention. Almost everyone in the family came out, wanting to hear how to pay taxes next year, otherwise this New Year would definitely not be good.
Hobert also got up very early today. Philip came to report early in the morning that almost all the residents of the entire territory had come.
The front of the lord's mansion was already full of people, and even the roads up and down the mountain were crowded with people.
But the outside was not noisy, and even the sound of loud talking could not be heard.
Obviously, compared to doing household registration statistics, the people respected Hobert's authority more. They were very conscious of not making noise in front of the lord's mansion.
Hobert ate a simple breakfast and returned to his study, placing all the extraordinary materials on the desk.
He had already prepared tools such as measuring cylinders, balances, and beakers. After all the materials were ready, he began to prepare the potion.
First, 80 milliliters of three-year-old white wine, which is normal wine, nothing to say.
Then add the juice of the crown tree, the golden juice quickly merges with the wine, turning into a warm light yellow.
Then there is the black giant gold monster flower and the bark of the dragon pattern tree. The giant gold monster flower is a flower with gold and black colors, about the size of a palm, but very light.
The bark of the dragon pattern tree is a piece of bark that seems to be mixed with black stars and golden patterns, and even seems to be able to see a little starlight and weak golden light.
After the giant gold monster flower and the dragon pattern tree bark were added to the beaker, they were quickly melted and underwent a chemical reaction-like change. The liquid in the entire beaker seemed to be tumbling.
Finally, Hobert added the "Mentor of Disorder" Beyonder characteristic that had been divided and re-condensed.
Its shape is like a tightly clenched translucent black fist. This fist intuitively gives a sense of strength and evil. The patterns and light spots on it seem to follow normal rules, but they are full of disharmony, and seem to contain a lot of madness and chaos.
Just looking at it makes people feel uneasy, as if a serious obsessive-compulsive disorder patient saw an extremely messy room and wanted to roll up his sleeves and tidy up the room.
The Beyonder characteristic also quickly melted, but there was no violent reaction in the beaker, but Hobert seemed to hear some mind-numbing whispers from the beaker.
But if the line of sight leaves the beaker, the whispers disappear.
Hobert took out the glass medicine bottle that he had prepared, and not a drop of the potion in the beaker was left, all poured into the medicine bottle.
Hobert put on the stopper and put it in his pocket.
Opening the door of the study, Fors was already waiting outside.
She had gone to a high place to look outside just now. Even Fors, who lived in a big city, rarely saw a scene of thousands of people gathered together.
These are all the people of this territory, and they are all loyal to Hobert. Thinking of this, Fors was excited for Hobert.
Hobert stretched out his hand, and Fors naturally took his arm.
Accompanied by the guards and supported by the respectful servants, the two came to the front of the lord's mansion.
"Lord!"
"Madam!"
The loud greetings from outside made Fors slightly stunned. She was not as shy as when she first entered the lord's mansion, but greeted everyone generously.
Philip had prepared a small high platform in advance, the horn was tied to the tree, and the microphone was placed on the table on the small high platform.
Hobert and Fors came to the high platform hand in hand, and the people behind also saw them. For a time, the sound of "Lord" was endless, and the scene was very enthusiastic.
Hobert smiled and waved to them, the greeting process lasted for more than a minute, and the scene gradually calmed down.
This scene made Seel straighten his chest, while Philip's eyes were filled with tears.
Under Fors's guidance, Hobert turned on the microphone switch: "As I said yesterday, I called you here to announce how Jeffery will collect taxes in the future."
The people who had never seen a horn were wondering how the lord's voice was so loud when the lord spoke.
But Hobert came up and said to the point, which made everyone quiet down immediately.
"I hereby announce," Hobert smiled: "Jeffery will be exempt from all agricultural taxes from today on!"
This news shocked Grove, Albert, and the others. Of course, they understood the significance of the agricultural tax to the landed gentry. Without the agricultural tax, the lord would lose more than 80% of their income. How would they support the expenses of the lord's mansion?
Fors also showed a surprised expression. She realized yesterday that Hobert would greatly reduce the taxes on the people in the territory, but she never expected that Hobert would simply waive all the taxes!
However, most people were a little confused. Many people didn't understand what agricultural tax was, and of course, they didn't know which part of the tax the lord was reducing.
Hobert continued to explain: "You don't have to pay taxes on what you get from farming, from orchards, or from vegetable gardens!"
The scene suddenly became quiet, and everyone couldn't believe it.
Until someone in front of the stage mustered up the courage to ask: "Lord, that is to say, no matter what I plant, no matter how the harvest is, I don't have to pay taxes, right?"
"Yes!"
After a few seconds of silence, someone shouted: "Long live the Lord!"
Then everyone followed and shouted: "Long live the Lord!" "Long live the Lord!"
The shouts were earth-shattering, and many people were so excited that their eyes were filled with tears.
Taking advantage of the extremely enthusiastic scene, Hobert quickly handed the microphone to Fors, and then, surrounded by Seel and others, came to a small room at the entrance of the Lord's Mansion.
Hobert said to Seel when he entered the door: "Guard here and don't let anyone in."
"Yes!"
Hobert locked the door tightly, and recalled the ritual of advancing to "Mentor of Disorder" again: taking the magic potion in his own territory, amidst the heartfelt gratitude of the people.
Now that both requirements had been met, taking advantage of the cheers outside still deafening, Hobert opened the bottle and drank the magic potion in one gulp.
The moment the magic potion entered his mouth, Hobert felt his consciousness explode. For a moment, his consciousness was in chaos, and he instantly lost control of his consciousness and body.
Hobert became muddle-headed. His spiritual body broke through the roof and came into the air.
At this time, the sun rose, and the sunlight shone on Full Moon Lake, making the lake water look soft and warm. The sunlight shone on the vibrant vegetation, making this land look full of life.
What a beautiful lake, what a beautiful rural scene, and there are so many people outside!
"Long live the Lord!"
"Long live Jeffrey Territory!"
Hobert heard shouts, and a burst of passionate emotions repeatedly washed over the completely emptied Hobert, allowing him to regain emotional fluctuations.
Lord? Baron Hobert, I am Baron Hobert!
Yes, they are grateful to me for exempting them from agricultural taxes, and they are cheering for me!
This place with beautiful scenery is my territory!
Suddenly, Hobert regained his consciousness, and then he heard confusing whispers in his ears, making Hobert's head ache.
Hobert was about to resist the whispers through meditation, but the cheers outside gradually drowned out the whispers, until only the cheers remained in Hobert's ears.
He breathed a sigh of relief and regained control of himself.
Perhaps the magic potion was digesting well, or perhaps the ritual was very effective, the process of advancing to "Mentor of Disorder" was smoother than Hobert expected.
He lowered his head and clenched his fist, feeling that his strength had increased again, and his physique was stronger. Although he didn't dare to compare with the "Guardian", he was close to the physique of a "Dawn Paladin".
At the same time, he felt that his speed had also improved significantly. He possessed various fighting skills. Even if he had not learned fighting, he would be a fighting master in battle.
The blessing on fighting skills, the "Justiciar" pathway started from "Arbiter", and by the time it reached the "Sheriff" level, it was already a fighting master.
However, the "Black Emperor" pathway only "completed" it all at once at the "Mentor of Disorder" level.
Hobert stroked the "Fighting Ring" on his hand. This magical item, which he had worn for the longest time, could finally "retire".
Then Hobert let his spirituality spread and felt his new abilities.
The first is "Disorder", which is the signature ability of "Mentor of Disorder". It can cause the locked target to fall into chaos, making it difficult for attacks to land on oneself, and making it easy for the enemy to make wrong choices.
At the same time, it can cause a certain amount of chaos in an area of about five meters, such as the temperature in this area suddenly rising, the road surface in this area suddenly becoming uneven, etc. This state can be superimposed.
In addition, the ability of "Distortion" has been greatly improved. In addition to strengthening the ability to distort the target's language, actions, and intentions, it can also distort the concepts of oneself and the target, so that both parties bear half of the damage, curses, diseases, etc.
Hobert unconsciously touched his "Healing Fork". The sequence 5 level "Distortion" plus "Healing" is a perfect match!
"Corrosion" has also been strengthened, which can corrode the minds of people within twenty meters, and Hobert can already control whether to make the enemy greedy or gloomy. In any case, it is easier to make the other party make irrational choices.
The strengthening of abilities such as "Weakening" is the greatest. You don't have to use "Bribe" to use the four skills of "Weakening", "Charm", "Arrogance", and "Connection".
Especially "Arrogance" and "Connection", which were somewhat useless skills before, have become surprisingly useful abilities.
"Arrogance" can make the target become proud, arrogant, and reduce their mental state, leading to misjudgment.
"Connection" can quickly create a link between the two parties, causing the target's hostility to temporarily disappear.
And "Charm" now has two modes. The first mode is to make it difficult for the enemy to generate the desire to attack, and even lose the desire to fight for a short time.
The second mode is more like "Charm" + "Distortion", allowing the enemy's attack to fall on their companions, and quickly generate goodwill towards oneself, believing that their companions have betrayed them, thereby becoming one's own helpers in a short period of time.
If this ability is used well, it is a very explosive skill in team battles!
Finally, there are the changes in Hobert's temperament and spirituality brought about by the magic potion.
He can act like an ordinary person, or he can make himself extremely majestic, causing the surrounding creatures to unconsciously lower their posture and want to submit.
The change in spirituality is that the "storage" of spirituality has become huge. Now when Hobert uses "Holy Light" or "Underworld Gate" again, there will not be too much burden.
Hobert took a deep breath, Sequence 5 was indeed a level stronger than Sequence 6.
At this time, the atmosphere outside was still very enthusiastic. Hobert adjusted his state, and after going to the "Nation of Disorder" to re-seal the figure in the pool, he came out of the room.
Seel immediately felt that the Lord was different from when he went in.
His back seemed to have become taller, and he seemed to be more majestic than before.
Hobert returned to the small high platform outside and took the microphone from Fors.
Fors had been asked so much that she was overwhelmed. She didn't know whether raising livestock and poultry was within the scope of agricultural tax, and she didn't know whether taxes should be paid if the vegetables grown were used for trading.
Hobert returned to the high platform and answered everyone's questions one by one.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, northern city of Tuburia.
Lieutenant Colonel Byrd was frantically packing his bags!
Knock knock knock~
Someone knocked on the door.
Byrd cocked his pistol: "Who is it?"
"It's me!" It was Ethel's voice.
Byrd was first surprised, then desperate, and finally tried to calm himself, put the gun back in its holster and opened the door.
Ethel stood at the door and smiled at the room: "You seem to be packing your luggage?"
"Honey, I was just about to find you!" Byrd said happily: "You don't know, after hearing the news of your attack, I couldn't stay for a moment and wanted to rush over to protect you! Mother above, let you return safely."
Ethel smiled slightly: "Thank you for your concern."
As she spoke, she suddenly kicked Byrd away: "Take him away!"

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - 414: Sealing the Full Moon Lake
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Outside the city of Tubulia, in the dungeon of the military camp, the screams of Lieutenant Colonel Bayerd echoed.
In the interrogation room, Bayerd had been tortured beyond recognition, his spirit on the verge of collapse.
Ethel sat opposite him, smiling: "Darling, seeing you beaten like this breaks my heart. You should just tell the truth quickly."
"The matter isn't as complicated as you think. Only you had the chance to see the letter my father wrote to me, and the orders sent through top-secret channels."
"And I simply don't believe you're a spy for those Intis bastards. Otherwise, I would have noticed something was wrong with you long ago."
"Here, you can speak freely. Do you see the chandelier hanging from the ceiling? It's a sealed artifact from the Fourth Epoch. It can interfere with hypnosis and psychological suggestion, and effectively resist 'Secrecy' abilities."
"Here, you have no secrets to hide."
Bayerd wept bitterly, his handsome face bearing many scars: "Ethel, please, believe me. I really am just an ordinary spy…"
"That's a disappointing answer." Ethel waved her hand at the interrogator.
The interrogator, wearing gloves, carefully brought over a set of shackles.
"No…" Bayerd, of course, recognized this sealed artifact, but no matter how he resisted, the interrogator carefully placed the shackles on his feet.
The moment the shackles closed completely, Bayerd's roar became muffled, and he trembled all over in pain.
Then a stench emanated from his body. The ever-dapper and handsome lieutenant colonel lost control of his bowels.
After about twenty seconds, the interrogator quickly removed the shackles. Bayerd immediately slumped, as if all his strength had been drained.
Ethel stood up with her hands behind her back, as if strolling through her own garden: "Prisoners have described the pain caused by this sealed artifact: like every bone in your body being broken inch by inch."
She looked at Bayerd: "Tell the truth. For the sake of our past relationship, I can spare your life."
Bayerd weakly said: "It was, it was the Second Prince…"
Ethel smiled: "I know my royal brothers better than you do. If you said it was the ambitious Bishop (Third Prince), I might believe you, but Blaze (Second Prince) doesn't have the guts or the means."
She said to the interrogator: "Fifteen more seconds, but don't let him die of pain."
"I'll talk, I'll talk…" Bayerd quickly said: "It was the Crown Prince, the Crown Prince ordered me to monitor your every move. Otherwise, my parents, my brothers and sisters would all die."
As he spoke, Bayerd wept bitterly: "Please, let me go. I'll never participate in the royal family's…"
Ethel took out a gun and pulled the trigger without hesitation. The bullet blew a large hole in the back of Bayerd's head, and his plea for mercy came to an abrupt end.
Ethel wiped the corner of her slightly moist eyes with her finger: "I lied to you. The moment I came back alive, you were doomed."
"You betrayed me, and I lied to you once. Okay, we're even."
She stared at the corpse in front of her for a while before glancing at the interrogator out of the corner of her eye.
The interrogator immediately said: "General, the members of my family have poor hearing. From my grandfather to my son, they all have hearing problems."
Ethel smiled: "Smart people always live long."
She walked out of the dungeon step by step, seeing the clear blue sky outside: "It's time to return to Feynapotter City."
…
South Colson, west bank of Full Moon Lake.
Recently, Viscount Teuton had been holding his ancestral telescope, looking at the opposite bank: "Isn't it not New Year's yet? What are they cheering about over there?"
"Huh? Why are they slaughtering sheep and pigs? What are they celebrating?"
Viscount Teuton asked the butler impatiently: "Where are the scouts I sent out? Haven't they returned yet?"
The butler quickly replied: "News came last night that Knight Louis and Knight Duke were placed under house arrest by Baron Hobert. The original helpers in the town are also unwilling to help us anymore, so it's difficult for the scouts to get information now."
"It hasn't even been a month!" Viscount Teuton exclaimed.
He was referring to the fact that Hobert had only been here for less than a month.
"My lord, I'm back!" At this time, the scout who had been sent out finally returned. He knelt on the ground: "Hobert, Hobert has exempted all agricultural taxes in Jeffery's territory!"
"What!" Viscount Teuton almost jumped up: "Has he gone mad?"
After thinking for a moment, Viscount Teuton immediately said: "Block this news! We must block this news!"
If this news spread throughout the territory, his subjects would definitely run away.
The scout added: "My lord, I also brought back Knight Duke, who escaped from Hobert's mansion!"
Viscount Teuton was stunned: "Quick, let him in!"
Grove Duke knelt on the ground, carrying a wooden box: "My lord, you must help us take back our fief! Hobert actually took our fief and plans to put us under house arrest in the lord's manor.
"I took advantage of the fact that the lord's manor was holding a celebration today and was short of manpower to escape. My lord, for the sake of my service to you in the past, please help us take back our fief!"
Viscount Teuton was somewhat hesitant and would not immediately agree: "You, you get up first."
"That's right!" Grove presented the wooden box to Teuton: "Anyway, I'm going to fight Hobert to the death, so I simply stole Hobert's weapon when I left!
"Now I offer the weapon to you, my lord. Please, you must help me!"
Viscount Teuton opened the wooden box and knew at a glance that this sword was no ordinary item.
He held it in his hand and immediately realized that it was a Beyonder weapon!
He had only heard of this kind of weapon and had never seen it before.
Viscount Teuton played with it lovingly for a while before closing the wooden box and reaching out to help Grove up: "Don't worry, I will definitely help you take back your territory!
"But we must wait for the opportunity. You will live in my lord's manor for now. Here, you will still enjoy the treatment of a knight. If anyone dares to disrespect you, I will kill them!"
Grove was filled with gratitude: "Thank you, my lord!"
…
Hobert killed a total of three pigs and four sheep. The pig bones and offal were not wasted. Under Hobert's guidance, a simplified version of Chaotian Pot was made.
With the addition of chili peppers and spices, the aroma immediately attracted everyone. As soon as it was cooked, Hobert only ate a few bites before it was eaten clean by the residents of the territory.
The joy of the people had not diminished. Although there were many freshly slaughtered pigs and sheep, it was not enough for three thousand people to eat. The residents of the town and several surrounding villages voluntarily brought bread and vegetables, so that everyone could eat their fill at noon, and even the mutton soup and pork soup were drunk clean.
Since they could remember, they had to pay taxes, and taxes were the burden of everyone here.
But now it was different. This burden was suddenly gone, and they felt that their backs were a little straighter.
In the afternoon, many people were still chatting excitedly in front of the lord's manor and voluntarily helping the servants wash pots and dishes.
Hobert ordered that no one should be driven away. They could chat for as long as they wanted.
At the same time, Hobert also asked Philip to send someone to Viscount Teuton's mansion on the opposite side of Full Moon Lake to demand Grove.
When night fell, Fors smiled at the table: "Today I realized that happiness is really contagious.
"The matter of tax exemption clearly wouldn't make me that happy, but seeing their smiling faces, I still feel happy for them."
Hobert smiled: "Yes, it makes me feel much better too."
Helen on the side asked: "If you don't collect taxes, what will so many people in the lord's manor eat?"
"Of course, we'll buy food from the people!" Hobert smiled: "After the tax exemption, there will definitely be more food in the territory, and the price of food will definitely be lower.
"Before the interests of the people are harmed, the lord's manor will have to buy a large amount of food. If there is less food on the market, the price will naturally stabilize.
"The food in the hands of the people will be turned into money, which can further prosper the economy of the territory, killing many birds with one stone."
Helen opened her mouth. She wanted to ask: Did you have a plan for this long ago?
But she felt that she should rather ask: Why do you know so much?
But in the end, she didn't ask anything.
After dinner, when he returned to the courtyard with Fors, Hobert said: "Come to the study at nine o'clock. I have something I need your help with."
Fors was stunned and nodded.
Arriving at the study, Hobert locked the door and entered the "Nation of Disorder".
He checked the seal on the figure again. The figure was now clearer, a handsome young man, about twenty years old, and now he could see that he had copper-colored hair.
Hobert pondered for a moment. There was still no better way to send him out of the "Nation of Disorder", so he could only wait.
Then Hobert felt the changes brought about by the advancement. First of all, he could control more territory in the "Nation of Disorder". His consciousness could cover the largest pool at the foot of the mountain.
Inside, there were many, many stars. The function of these stars was still unknown.
In addition, his strength in all aspects of the "Nation of Disorder" had been greatly strengthened, and the magical items in the "Nation of Disorder" had also been greatly improved.
In particular, he could mobilize more power from the "Nation of Disorder" in the real world, and he had the ability to hide the aura of the "Nation of Disorder", so there would be no more incidents like suddenly encountering Philip I or George III.
Moreover, Hobert gained a new ability in the "Nation of Disorder": Prohibition!
This was a very high-ranking "Prohibition!"
Hobert's spirituality guided him to look at the two new stars in the pool in front of him.
Combined with the newly acquired "Prohibition" ability, Hobert seemed to understand: "If I hadn't encountered the Brass Book in advance, then these two new stars would have appeared after advancing to 'Mentor of Disorder'."
He suddenly realized that the meeting with Castiya, that is, Philip I, had inadvertently saved Ethel, a descendant of Philip I.
Hobert smiled and shook his head: Fate is really wonderful.
After patrolling the "Nation of Disorder" again, Hobert broke off a piece of "Order Wood" and left the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert took out the two jars of blood sent by Bishop Simpson and found a thick enough pen.
When it was almost nine o'clock, Fors came to the study, and Hobert explained: "I got a way to seal the corruption of Full Moon Lake from my father. I plan to seal the source of the corruption tonight.
"But I need you to do me a favor. How about we take a walk to Full Moon Lake together?"
Hobert stretched out his arm, and Fors smiled and took it: "No problem."
She was curious about how Hobert would seal it.
The space in front of the two became illusory. After entering the spirit world, they arrived at the bank of Full Moon Lake in the blink of an eye.
Not far away was the corpse of the giant beast that looked like a large ship. On the other side of the corpse was a bonfire, and two guards were guarding the corpse.
The moonlight was good tonight. Hobert and Fors came to the lake by the moonlight.
"I need you to use ice magic to create a layer of ice in the lake that is about the size of a bed." Hobert followed up with an explanation: "I need to draw a seal formation on it.
"I considered using paper, but after it gets wet, the formation on the paper will definitely become blurred immediately, so drawing the formation on the ice is the most suitable."
Fors smiled: "Then you'll have to wait a while."
She released an "Ice Magic" towards the water surface, but only a palm-sized piece of ice appeared on the water surface, and it was very thin.
Hobert found a stone and sat down: "It doesn't matter. You can just practice your Beyonder abilities, and I can also practice my Beyonder abilities."
"What are you practicing?"
"Try using 'Ice Magic' again."
Fors used "Ice Magic" towards the lake again, and this time the ice that appeared was as big as the surface of a square stool.
She said in surprise: "Oh my god, how did you do it?"
Hobert smiled: "I tried to lower the temperature of that area."
This was the ability of "Disorder", which could make the lake surface within a five-meter radius freeze more easily, and the longer it was used, the faster it would freeze.
Fors began to use "Ice Magic" continuously, and took a short rest after using it seven or eight times. The spirituality of Sequence 8 was too weak, and even this simple spell was a bit difficult to use continuously.
While Fors was resting, Hobert suddenly asked towards the reeds: "Helen?"
The reeds parted, and Helen was still able to walk out with a graceful posture on the rocky river beach: "Your spirituality seems to be stronger."
Hobert asked: "What are you doing here?"
Helen smiled: "Can't I come for a walk?"
In fact, she was here to meet with the person that the Theosophy Order had developed on the west bank, but she didn't expect to meet Hobert and Fors.
Hobert smiled and said nothing.
When Fors had rested enough, they continued to make ice. Suddenly, an ice spear like a crystal pierced into the water, and a large area of water around the ice spear showed a hard ice layer.
Helen smiled: "Although I don't know what you're doing, I can help."
As she spoke, she threw two more ice spears into the water, and soon the area of the ice layer reached Hobert's needs.
Fors was a little unhappy: "Look at the ice surface you made, it's uneven!"
Helen snapped her fingers, and the ice surface immediately became smooth.
Fors said to Hobert in a huff: "I feel like I'm in very good condition. I'm going to prepare for advancement tomorrow!"

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - 415 Report to the King
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert quickly smiled and soothed, "Alright, alright, don't get so worked up with the guest. The main ingredient for the potion is with me. You can advance whenever you want."
Fors felt a little better in her heart: No matter how powerful you are, you're still a guest. I'm the mistress of Full Moon Lake! Uh, the mistress of the east bank of Full Moon Lake.
Seeing that the ice layer was large enough, Hobert injected spirituality into the "Ocean Pendant", controlling the water flow to make the ice layer float towards the center of Full Moon Lake.
Hobert then dived into the water, following closely behind.
The fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts underwater were so frightened by Hobert that they dared not show their faces again. There was only one giant beast, and it was no longer a threat in the water.
He smoothly arrived at approximately the center of Full Moon Lake. Hobert used the ability of "Flight", leaned over on the ice surface, and began to write the sealing magic circle.
This is the benefit of "knowledge itself". All the mystical symbols of the magic circle are in Hobert's memory. He can write them with a wave of his hand when needed.
Only half of the blood sent by Bishop Simpson was used, and the magic circle was already written.
To prevent the ice from melting, Hobert quickly inserted the previously folded "Order Wood" into the center of the magic circle.
The magic symbols on the magic circle suddenly emitted a faint light, as if they had life, piercing through the ice layer and turning into a black glass cover with inscriptions.
This "glass cover" radiated a thin black mist around it, isolating the surrounding lake water. The symbols entering the water did not touch the lake water, nor were they diluted by the lake water.
Hobert dived into the water again, guiding the "glass cover" to gradually fall onto the "bubble" structure he had seen before.
The "gem" inside the bubble still emitted a dazzling color under the light of Hobert's staff.
Until the magic circle like a "glass cover" was completely placed on the "bubble", Hobert injected spirituality into the "Order Wood" in the center of the magic circle. The magic circle seemed to become elastic, slowly stretching and completely covering the entire "bubble".
Then, three small branches suddenly grew out of the "Order Wood" underwater. The branches grew rapidly, and the leaves quickly spread out.
As a faint black light rippled out, the light of the gem inside the "bubble" was completely obscured by a thin layer of black mist.
The "trees" in the underwater forest not far away immediately swayed. The creatures inside seemed to sense the change in the environment and became agitated.
Hobert tried to approach the sealing magic circle. When he was five or six meters away from the magic circle, he seemed to encounter an invisible barrier and could no longer get closer.
This is the protective mechanism of the magic circle itself. Only by using the "Order Crystal" as a medium and using the power of the "Nation of Disorder" can the operation of the sealing magic circle be terminated.
Otherwise, it would have to be forcibly broken, but the creatures underwater do not currently have such ability.
Hobert waited for a while. Seeing that the creatures in the underwater forest were agitated, but did not actively come to destroy the magic circle, he floated to the surface.
During the ascent, Hobert could feel that the influence of the underwater corruption source was now only at the bottom of the lake. If he hadn't dived down, he wouldn't have been affected by the corruption source.
Back on the shore, Fors, who was waiting there, smiled and said, "It's a success!"
As a Beyonder, her spirituality sensed that some changes had occurred in Full Moon Lake.
Hobert smiled and said, "It's a success. From now on, this waterway will become smooth again."
Helen, who was on the side, asked, "The corruption source in the lake has been sealed like this?"
This is too simple, isn't it? She remembered that the high-level members of the "Theosophy Order" had come to study the corruption source in Full Moon Lake, and the final result was: it cannot be sealed.
"As long as you find the right method, things will be simple." Hobert smiled and said to Helen, "Thank you for your help today. I won't disturb your walk."
He stretched his arms, and Fors stepped forward and took his arm. The two left, talking and laughing.
Helen rolled her eyes, watching the loving couple walk away. She gradually realized that this was a big deal! The problem of Full Moon Lake has been solved, and perhaps the extraordinary power of the Earth Mother Church and the royal family will return to this area.
The more she thought about it, the more she felt that this matter was more important than contacting the informant on the west bank. So she simply gave up this contact and hurried to report to Ms. Monica.
More than twenty minutes later, a small boat docked, and a young man quietly came to the river beach. He was shivering from the cold winter wind, and his lips were purple, but when he thought of Miss Helen's smile, he immediately felt that everything he had done was worth it.
But he looked around in the reeds. Strange, where did Miss Helen go?
After waiting for more than an hour, Helen still did not appear.
Just as the young man was about to go to other places in the reeds to look for her, an exaggerated giant sword composed of scarlet magma and blue flames pierced in from behind the young man.
The young man looked incredulously at the tip of the sword protruding from his chest. He wanted to shout, but his throat had been burned to ashes, and he could only fall to the ground in pain.
The giant sword that pierced the young man's body turned into a blue fireball, setting the young man's body on fire, even burning his bones.
In the darkness of the reeds, there was a voice like a self-questioning: "Strange, how did the contact person find me?"
...
Thursday morning, Feynapotter City, Life Cathedral.
Simpson came to his office as usual. As soon as he entered the door, he found the letter on the table.
Bishop Simpson guessed that it should be a letter from Hobert. Recently, he only communicated with Hobert through the messenger of the spirit world.
Honestly, Simpson did not have much hope for Hobert's plan to seal Full Moon Lake. He had consulted relevant files. The church had indeed sent an angel before, hoping to solve the problem of Full Moon Lake. The angel had made many attempts, but all ended in failure.
Hobert mentioned in the letter that using a magic circle to seal, but it was difficult for Bishop Simpson to believe. The power of the magic circle was too weak. Without a high-level sealed object to continuously provide power to the magic circle, the power of the magic circle could not seal the corruption source at all.
And if there was a high-level sealed object, who would waste it on sealing a corruption source?
Bishop Simpson opened the letter while pondering.
Inside the envelope were two pages of letter paper and a simple line drawing.
After reading a few lines, Simpson stood up unconsciously: "He succeeded!"
Continuing to read, Simpson was more and more surprised. He quickly took the letter to find the Archbishop.
When he arrived at the door, he tried hard to take a deep breath, carefully folded the letter, and calmed his emotions.
As soon as he opened the door, he became the smiling, knowledgeable, patient, and calm bishop again.
Arriving at the Archbishop's office, Simpson appropriately showed his surprise: "Your Excellency, Hobert actually succeeded! He said in the letter that we can send someone to Full Moon Lake to check the seal.
"At the same time, he also said that as soon as he arrived in the territory, he was repairing the church that we had abandoned before. Now the church can be reused.
"He is willing to provide some food, poultry, and necessary daily necessities for the bishop we send."
Archbishop Gabriel also couldn't believe it. He took the letter from Simpson and glanced at it: "Immediately send someone to contact Hobert! And investigate the specific sealing process!"
If South Colson can be brought under the control of the church, this will be a great achievement.
At the level of the Archbishop, there are not many achievements that can interest them. Spreading the glory of the Mother Goddess to an unfamiliar area is within the scope of their interest.
Simpson took the painting in the envelope and showed it to the Archbishop: "This is a giant beast captured by Hobert in the lake. It looks like an Ancient Azure Dragon Beast?"
Gabriel glanced at it and nodded: "It is an Ancient Azure Dragon Beast. The church thought it was extinct!"
He looked at Simpson: "Be sure to let Hobert sell us the liver crystal of the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast. Don't be stingy with gold Solas."
The liver crystal of the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast can replace one of the main materials of Sequence 4 "Classical Alchemist".
To be precise, in ancient times, the liver crystal of the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast was one of the main materials of "Classical Alchemist". Later, because the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast was almost extinct, it was replaced with other materials.
Simpson said, "Hobert said in the letter that he is only willing to sell the crystal to the bishop who comes to Jeffery Territory."
Gabriel smiled and said, "This is a very good opportunity. You can go to South Colson to gain experience. As long as you re-establish the parish there, you can apply for another main material of 'Ancient Alchemist'."
Bishop Simpson was moved. How could he not be moved? In the church, if you want to advance to a demigod, you also need great achievements.
Most people wait a lifetime and cannot wait for such an opportunity.
But Simpson's reason ultimately defeated his desire for merit: "Your Excellency, according to the information we have obtained, there is more than one demigod of the heretics in South Colson. It is best to send a demigod?"
"Does the church have any extra demigods?"
Simpson smiled bitterly: "No."
At the level of demigod, they are the quasi-high-level members of the church. They generally hold several positions and cannot get away at all.
"You can continue to establish a good cooperative relationship with Hobert." Gabriel smiled and said, "Based on Hobert's performance, the Jeffery family from Loen must have a family as support.
"We can use their power, and they must also need our power. When necessary, we can make some compromises and concessions."
The Archbishop said: "Of course, this is a matter for the future. Put down your work and immediately organize a survey team composed of pastors and bishops who have not taken potions.
"After the survey team confirms that there is no corruption, you can go there yourself."
...
Jeffery Territory.
Wayne, who was driving a small steamship fully loaded from Bugas City, almost didn't recognize Full Moon Lake.
Especially the corpse of the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast, almost scared Wayne to turn around and run away.
Fortunately, he finally chose to believe in the new lord, believe in his nephew Seel, and continued to the pier with a straight face.
Under Roy's organization, dozens of people were cutting reeds, and the main pier was also bustling with people.
When people saw Wayne coming back, they greeted him to dock quickly. The main pier was in need of the cement and steel bars on his ship!
Wayne chatted with several reed-cutting workers for a while and learned that the monster in the lake had been killed by the lord and dared not come ashore. The giant beast corpse on the river beach was hunted by the lord!
Finally, there was a bombshell: the lord exempted all the serfs from agricultural tax.
Whether it was Wayne who ran the boat or the merchants who opened shops in the town, they all had land at home. Their main business had always been farming, and running boats and opening shops could only be regarded as side businesses.
Wayne greeted the workers to help unload the goods, but he was already very surprised. He had only been away for a few days, was this still the former Jeffery Town?
He asked the assistant assigned by the lord's mansion to stare at the workers unloading the goods, and he went to the lord's mansion to report back with the clerk sent by the lord's mansion.
At this time, Hobert had just received a letter from Bishop Simpson. He immediately called Allen over: "You go find some helpers and collect the eyes, blood, brain, tongue, teeth, skin, a dozen scales on the abdomen of the front limbs, bones, and meat on the two hind limbs of the giant beast corpse by the lake. If you have any questions, ask Roy."
Hobert had only collected the internal organs and some blood of the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast before. He didn't expect that there were so many rare spiritual materials on its body.
Bishop Simpson said in the letter that the blood of the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast will not coagulate, and you can squeeze its muscles to continue collecting.
As soon as Allen left, Seel reported that Wayne was back.
Hobert received Wayne and Clifford, the clerk sent by the lord's mansion, in the main hall. First, Clifford reported the financial income and expenditure this time.
They first sold the dried fruits provided by the lord's mansion, and the income plus 22 gold Solas, they bought a lot of building materials.
Hobert asked about the unit price of several dried fruits, and also asked about the unit price of building materials, and found that the price of building materials was much higher than he expected.
But he quickly understood that he came from a country known as "infrastructure maniac", not all countries can do this, and there are also limitations of the times.
Then Wayne briefly reported the process of this voyage: Bugas City and the small ports along the way are still the same.
"Jeffery Town is about to undergo a huge change!" Hobert smiled and said, "In this regard, as the initiators of the huge change, we must seize the opportunity."
He paused and said: "Now that the waterway has reopened, your small boat is not enough to support the consumption of Jeffery Town. In the future, when the territory has more projects, it will need more building materials.
"I have talked to Seel, you not only understand the driving of small steamships, but also understand large steamships.
"I will give you the official position of 'Ship Knight', you go buy a large cargo steamship, and three medium and small passenger ships.
"As soon as the ships are bought, immediately open cargo and passenger flights from Jeffery Territory to Bugas City!"
Wayne didn't expect that he could become a knight in his life: Thanks to my nephew! No, letting my nephew be a servant to the lord is the wisest choice I have ever made. Look, this kid is looking smug with his sword on his waist.
Hobert said to Clifford again: "You will be Wayne's deputy, and you will still be in charge of the financial affairs of the ship, and report to Philip on time."
He also said: "The shipping of small steamships should not be stopped, and you should set off immediately to purchase more building materials."
Wayne took the order and prepared to go home, and then set sail again.
At this moment, he didn't feel tired at all. The position of "Ship Knight" gave him tremendous motivation. Now he only wanted to know where to buy ships to handle affairs well for the Lord.
The thought that after these ships were bought, they would all be under his command, made the fatigue of more than a week disappear without a trace.
After meeting Wayne and others, Hobert returned to his study and gave all the 4600 gold Lire he had to Phillip. This money was definitely not enough to buy ships.
He came to Feynapotter again, first inquiring about the approximate prices of cargo ships and passenger ships used for river transportation. At this time, ordinary freighters or cruise ships sailing on the ocean were worth about 24,000 gold Lire.
Currently, the world's largest cruise ship, the "Umbria," is in service in Luen. It is said that this cruise ship cost 78,000 pounds, which is 93,600 gold Lire.
The reason it cost so much is that many structures of this cruise ship were experimental in nature. At this time, most of the structure of cruise ships was still wood, while the main body of the "Umbria" was steel.
The "Etruria," which came after the "Umbria," had similar performance and structure to the former, but the cost was reduced to 56,000 pounds, which is equivalent to nearly a third cheaper.
The ships on the inland river are much cheaper because there is no need to consider the wind and waves at sea. About 4,000 gold Lire can buy a freight steamship that Hobert likes.
With a displacement of up to 800 tons (which is 'high' for this era), it is a behemoth on the river.
The passenger steamships that Hobert needed cost about 1,500 gold Lire each.
The reason they are so expensive is mainly due to the decoration and supporting facilities.
That is to say, buying ships would cost at least 8,500 gold Lire , plus hiring sailors and captains, at least 10,000 gold Lire should be prepared.
This investment may not be recouped in the next few years, but Hobert still felt that he should spend the money when he needed to. In a place like Jeffery Territory that relies on shipping for food, he should of course have a few ships in his hands.
Hobert exchanged the 7,140 pounds he had for gold Lire, and after deducting the handling fee, he received a total of 8,559.2 gold Lire.
The construction of railways and other projects will cost more money in the future. Hobert plans to sell the gold in his hand when he needs money again. Those gold are worth about 7,200 gold Lire, and even if the purity does not meet the requirements of the bank, selling it for 6,500 gold Lire should not be a problem.
Hobert then realized that he was so rich that he could basically complete the early investment of a territory.
After exchanging the currency, Hobert came to Earl Christian's mansion again.
He planned to leave 1,000 gold Lire for Dophis and ask him to hire some reporters.
But Dophis didn't want it: "The 1,000 pounds you left before have not been spent yet. I exchanged 1,200 gold Lire, and hiring a design team only cost 800 gold Reales."
"400 gold Lire is enough to hire some major newspaper reporters."
Hobert smiled helplessly: "Actually, that's my reward for you."
After all, he is Christian's butler, not his own.
Dophis said seriously: "I get paid by the Earl's mansion every week."
"Okay." Hobert took back the 1,000 gold. He planned to help Dophis inquire about the clues of the "Skeleton Lord" when he had time.
According to the information he had obtained before, a "Skeleton Lord" should be in a certain location in South Colson.
Dophis added: "Mrs. Mona arrived in Feynapotter a few days ago. Yesterday, she hired a boat and took Donna to Jeffery Territory."
Hobert was stunned: "Then I'll send someone to pick them up as soon as I get back. South Colson is very chaotic now."
"You don't have to worry about their safety." Dophis said: "Your father sent people to protect them."
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief: "That's good."
But he still planned to send Seel to meet them.
After saying goodbye to Dophis, Hobert used "Travel" to return to his study. He first called Seel and asked him to take a few people to Bugas City to rent a small steamship, and then wait for the Christian Earl's Mansion ship at the port of Bugas.
Hobert said bluntly: "Mrs. Mona on the ship is my mother, and Miss Donna is my sister. Be sure to be respectful and polite! Also, go to Bugas City to buy some new clothes and dress neatly."
Seel was slightly stunned. He didn't expect the Lord's father to be an Earl!
After watching Seel leave, Hobert asked the male servant outside to call Albert Louis.
The people sent to demand Grove yesterday also returned, naturally without success.
Albert already knew about Grove's defection, which completely exceeded his expectations, so he had been frightened all the way to the main hall today.
Hobert asked with a smile: "Grove has defected, and you have a choice. Do you want to be a 'Judicial Knight' or a 'Tax Knight'?"
Albert heard that the Lord didn't seem unhappy, so he quickly said: "Judicial Knight!"
The agricultural tax has been completely exempted, and the "Tax Knight" is obviously a pit!
Hobert took out a piece of parchment and a copy of the "Feynapotter Constitution": "I have summarized twelve simple and easy-to-understand regulations from this constitution. The specific content is on the paper. After a while, you will take people to explain these twelve laws to the villagers in each village.
"At the same time, you have to find the corresponding detailed rules from the 'Constitution', so that you have a basis when you judge cases."
At this time, Albert, who was in his forties, lamented that he was already this old, and he still had to study.
Hobert added: "But I have another errand for you now. In the afternoon, you will leave with Wayne's ship, take a few followers, go to Feynapotter City, and report the news that shipping has been reopened to His Majesty the King.
"Take it, this is the official document."
Such a big thing happened in South Colson. As a Baron conferred by Fernando II, of course, he had to report to the King.
The key is that after Fernando II receives the report, there will definitely be some policies to restore the Taz River shipping, and Jeffery Territory can also benefit from it.
Of course, you can't put all your hopes on Ferdinand II, after all, this involves the interests of another waterway.
Albert took the document with both hands, and was suddenly a little dazed: Why would the Lord send me to do such a face-showing thing?
Hobert added: "Remember, after arriving in Feynapotter City, first let the butler of the Baron's Mansion take you to see Earl Christian.
"That's my father, you can just explain your intentions to him and then follow his orders."
Albert's hand holding the document trembled slightly: You didn't say it earlier! If I knew you were the Earl's son, I would have greeted you and pledged my allegiance to you as soon as you came to the territory!
On the surface, he was relatively calm and respectfully said: "Yes."
After watching Albert leave, Hobert gave the pattern he had drawn to the male servant and asked him to find someone to make a flag.
Hobert was going to take action himself to solicit business for the newly opened Taz River.
