chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 416 Today is Different from the Past
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The main body of Hobert's design had two structures: on the left was a crescent moon, symbolizing that his territory had half of Full Moon Lake. On the right side of the crescent moon was a standing lion, symbolizing Hobert's rule over the mountains on the east side of Full Moon Lake.
Combined, it was the territorial emblem of Jeffery Territory.
Hobert intended to use it as the symbol of Jeffery Territory and Baron Hobert.
While the valet went to make the flag, Hobert came to his study to consider how to play the role of "Mentor of Disorder."
After a little thought, he felt that "Mentor of Disorder" was similar to "Baron of Corruption," and the focus should be on "Disorder," while "mentor" was just a title.
So, was it to create disorder? Or to be in the midst of disorder?
If creating disorder, what kind of disordershould be created? Creating disorder in the territory? Creating disorder in the Feynapotter Kingdom?
If being in the midst of disorder, what kind of disorder should one be in?
Hobert pondered for a long time, and he believed that "creating disorder" seemed to fit the core of "Mentor of Disorder" better.
Regarding how to create disorder, he gradually had some ideas.
First of all, the reopening of shipping would inherently cause disorder among the residents of the old and new waterways.
And the "land revolution" that Hobert was going to promote in the territory would definitely make the territory chaotic for a period of time.
He could wait for these two things to end, first see if the potion showed any signs of loosening or digesting, and then make a summary.
And he couldn't do nothing in terms of "mentor". Recently, Selena may have been afraid of her family being implicated and had not written to him.
Hobert planned to write a letter to Selena in the next two days and tell her how to summon his messenger.
To see if there could be a breakthrough in the "mentor" aspect.
After having a direction to try, Hobert took out the map and checked the ports along the Taz River. Finally, he set his target on Granada Port outside of South Coulson.
Generally, cargo ships or passenger ships departing from Seville, the largest coastal port in the Feynapotter Kingdom, would head west at Granada Port and enter the Yaw River.
Then they would have to pass through the central and western parts of Feynapotter before finally reaching the capital.
After the servants made the flag and sent it over, Hobert looked at the pattern, which was similar to what he had designed. He changed his appearance, rolled up the flag, carried it on his shoulder, and used the ability of "Travel" to enter the spirit world.
A few minutes later, Hobert appeared in the suburbs of Granada Port and took a carriage to the dock.
The dock here was very large, with ships coming in and out all the time, making the whole city full of vitality.
This was what a busy waterway should look like, with people busy, smiling, and full of hope.
Before asking Dophis to invite reporters, Hobert had a feasible plan to promote the reopening of the Taz River waterway.
Coming to Granada Port was the first step of the plan. Next, he first inquired about the cargo ships in the port with serious delays. With the help of Beyonder abilities, he quickly found a suitable target: the Nohar.
That was a large inland river cargo ship, which had been delayed due to previous repairs and could no longer reach Feynapotter City as scheduled.
If the delay was too long, the company to which the "Nohar" belonged might have to pay a large sum of money, which met the "requirement" of taking risks.
Hobert came to the berthing position of the "Nohar". It was a steamship with a thick and tall chimney in the center of the ship, but it still retained the structure of sails. It was an old-fashioned steamship.
Stevedores and crew members were working hard to save as much loading time as possible.
Hobert injected spirituality into the "Psychological Spoon" and said to a crew member directing on the dock: "Take me to see your captain!"
The crew member's originally anxious expression immediately turned into a smile: "Okay, sir!"
As a Sequence 5, Hobert would certainly not solicit business like an ordinary salesman. Problems that could be solved with Beyonder abilities should definitely be solved with Beyonder abilities.
After Hobert met the bewildered captain, he continued to use the ability of the "Psychological Spoon": "Call all the crew members here!"
Captain Dean immediately smiled and said: "Okay, sir!"
With the captain's shout, the crew members came to the deck one after another.
Hobert smiled and said to everyone: "Your voyage has been delayed. Fortunately, you heard at the dock that the Taz River waterway has reopened, so you plan to take the risk and take the Taidi waterway, which can save half the time.
"This way, you will not only not be overdue, but also arrive early.
"At this time, you just happened to meet me, the envoy of Baron Hobert. I promise you that as long as you hang the flag representing Jeffery Territory on the bow of your ship, if you encounter danger in South Colson, you can immediately ask for help by launching flares.
"Baron Hobert's guards will arrive immediately to help you solve the difficulties you encounter."
The crew members were sometimes dazed and sometimes incredulous, but they were all hypnotized by Hobert one after another, believing that what the man in front of them said was a very correct decision. They had never heard such convincing things since they were young.
Hobert handed the flag in his hand to the captain: "Okay, you can set sail after loading the goods. You will only remember that you asked me to help you solve the problem, and you will forget the specific process of my boarding."
After Hobert left, the captain and crew seemed to wake up from a dream together.
Captain Dean clenched the flag in his hand: "What are you bastards standing on the deck for? Hurry up and load the goods! And store enough vegetables and food. No one has traveled the Taz River for so many years. There must be no ports to supply!"
...
Hobert returned to his study. The primary task now was to wait for the arrival of the "Nohar" and ensure that they safely reached the capital.
Then, cooperate with the invited reporters to publicize this matter widely.
In the future, more and more ships will take this route.
Hobert was about to ask the valet to call Philip when Philip came himself: "Your Lordship, a group of people have come to the port, saying that they are the designers and engineers you invited."
"That's right, that's right!" Hobert smiled and said: "Arrange them in the newly renovated hotel, and the meals will be solved in the restaurant next door. All food and accommodation expenses will be borne by the Lord's Mansion.
"And let two designers or responsible persons from the design team come to see me."
"Yes." Philip left and came back more than an hour later, bringing back a bald middle-aged man and a middle-aged man wearing glasses.
Hobert received them in the main hall of the Lord's Mansion. Philip introduced them. The bald middle-aged man was a railway designer named Skola, and the middle-aged man wearing glasses was Walker, an architectural designer and planner.
Hobert had asked the servants to hang up the simple map of his territory that he had drawn in advance: "I believe you should know the purpose of your trip."
Skola smiled and said: "Yes, Your Lordship, Steward Dophis explained it very clearly. I will help you design a small railway, and the engineer will supervise the entire construction process."
Philip on the side looked surprised. He didn't expect that the Lord was going to lay railways in the territory!
He had only heard people talk about trains and railways, and he had also seen photos of them at Viscount Wright's place, but he had never seen the real thing.
"I will help you design a resort, and the engineer I brought will supervise the entire construction process." Walker smiled.
Hobert said to Walker: "You have a new task now, to help me plan Jeffery Town. If your plan satisfies me, I will also pay you a satisfactory reward."
Walker often dealt with nobles, and he bowed slightly: "Happy to serve."
If it were an ordinary noble in a remote and poor place, these two people would certainly not travel all the way here, and even if they came, they would not be so complimentary.
But Hobert had the endorsement of Earl Christian, and there were rumors that the father and son had brought a huge amount of wealth from Loen, and the conditions in Jeffery Town were much better than they had imagined, and the scene of dismembering large aquatic beasts by the lake impressed them deeply.
So from the moment they settled down, they knew how to face Baron Hobert.
Hobert pointed to the map he drew: "I hope that the railway starts from the dock, goes up the mountain along this gentle slope, goes around the mountain, comes down, and returns to the dock along the lake again."
Skola considered for a while with his chin pinched before saying: "Your Lordship, I have observed the mountains in your territory. Although they are not very steep, they certainly cannot run trains with too much load. Of course, you don't need such a large train.
"My suggestion is that when you buy the locomotive, buy a locomotive with no less than 1800 horsepower, so that you can at least transport 50 tons of goods or passengers up the mountain at one time."
Hobert nodded, that was enough. The train he designed was mainly for pulling people, not for pulling goods.
He said to Walker again: "I want to build a resort on the south side of the mountain, that is, in these difficult-to-cultivate places on the mountainside, and I want to build a wide road from the dock to the resort, and also build a large activity center.
"The road must cross the mountain peak. On the north side of the mountain, I want to build a casino, a reception center, an auction house, an entertainment center. After going down from the north side, there is a wasteland full of rocks here, which can be built into a golf course."
Walker quickly wrote down Hobert's requirements in his notebook: "I need to go to the field to survey."
"No problem, Philip, you arrange for someone to take them around."
After Skola and Walker learned about their specific tasks, they bowed slightly and said goodbye.
Hobert waited for more than ten minutes before calling Philip back again: "Open a small market on the open space next to the big dock, where you can sell vegetables and other things.
"Send someone to maintain law and order, and send someone to set up a 'fair scale', but don't collect taxes for the time being."
Philip: "Yes."
Hobert stretched. There were no important things to do today, so he could rest for a while.
But as soon as he returned to his study, he heard prayers from the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert saw that the stars representing Lawrence were expanding. He spread his spirituality over and heard Lawrence's prayer: "...Great 'Creator', I report to you the progress of our preparations. Our combatants are basically in place, and we plan to launch an attack on the 'Rose School' on Sunday afternoon in three days."
"Sunday afternoon." Hobert muttered to himself, but he did not immediately reply to Lawrence, but planned to wait a while before speaking.
During the waiting period, Hobert looked at the other stars.
Elliot was riding in a carriage with others, as if on the road. From their conversation, Hobert learned that Elliot had also been transferred to participate in the attack on the "Rose School".
Upton was selling a set of small steam cranes to customers. He looked much more stable and looked like a successful businessman.
Rafter was looking at maps and geographical magazines, seemingly considering where to go after leaving Backlund?
Alice was "giggling" with a group of noble ladies again. It seemed that there was endless gossip among the nobles. Of course, in the intervals of discussing gossip, they would also appreciate the recent dramas, operas, and poems.
Finally, there was Ethel, who was sitting at her desk handling official business, looking unsmiling and authoritative.
After looking around, Hobert focused his attention on Rafter's star. It was time to go to the relics of the Trunsoest nobility again.
Since Rex's charlatan friend said that Hobert would loot the secret room, he certainly had to help the charlatan complete the prophecy.
Previously, Hobert was afraid that he would not be able to capture the corpse of the "Ancient Death" into the "Nation of Disorder", and lose face in front of his believers.
However, after being promoted to Sequence 5, Hobert's spirituality told him that with the power he could mobilize in the "Nation of Disorder" now, he could do it.
As for the fact that Mr. Azik wanted to go and see the corpse of the "Ancient Death" in the future, but couldn't find it, he could only blame Mr. Azik for going too late.
"Hehehe~"
Hobert smiled, as if he saw Mr. Azik's figure searching for the corpse of the "Ancient Death God" underground, so he planned to write a letter to Mr. Azik after he moved the place away to explain the situation to him.
Hobert also thought that before carrying out this action, he had to find some blood from "mid sequence" "Death" or "Door" pathway Beyonders.
He remembered that Mr. Azik said that the easiest way to find the door that kept changing position was to paint the blood of Beyonders from the "mid sequence" of these two pathways on the wall.
Hobert thought about it, it seemed that he could only find blood from relevant pathways from Mr. Dophis. Fors was still a "Trickmaster" now, and her blood could not attract that door.
But he planned to talk about it tomorrow. After replying "Okay" to Lawrence, Hobert returned to the real world to drink tea, doing nothing and letting his mind go blank.
Chat with Fors at dinner, look at the moon together, and enjoy life.
Fors had been in Backlund all day today. She seemed to have been stimulated last night and had found a circus to perform magic tricks in order to digest the potion as soon as possible.
Hobert encouraged Fors a few words, and then proposed to take a look at the manuscript of her new book.
As a result, Fors hesitated and talked about other topics.
Hobert immediately understood that she might not have written an introduction yet.
So Hobert began to talk about the importance of this book to Jeffery Territory, the importance to the entire waterway, and the importance to the residents of the territory.
Fors became more and more ashamed as he listened. That night, the light in Fors's room stayed on until late into the night, only turning off to rest after one o'clock in the morning.
As soon as Fors lay down, someone quietly sneaked into the yard.
Hobert, whose spirituality had greatly increased, immediately woke up. Taking advantage of the time it took for the other party to sneak into the yard, he quickly wrapped himself in his pajamas.
To prevent emergencies, Hobert would hang his mystical items on the "cloth buttons" reserved on his pajamas before going to bed, so that his skin could touch those mystical items as long as he wrapped his pajamas tightly.
This would not affect the use of these mystical items in combat in the event of an emergency.
Hobert grabbed the cane by the bed, took two "Disorder Stones" from the bedside table, and finally stood quietly under the oil painting, ready to meet the enemy.
The other party didn't seem to be in a hurry to attack, but after preparing, someone chanted a spell in Hermes: "Speech!"
Damn! It's a spell!
Hobert took off the oil painting with his other hand, held it in front of him, and immediately crashed open the door to go out.
At the same time, a black spell broke the window glass and was thrown into the room, immediately emitting an ear-piercing babble.
Hobert, who had reached the door, felt a surge in his head. Although Hobert left the room earlier than the few people outside had expected, a series of abilities still slammed at him after Hobert went out: "Arrogance", "Imprisonment", "Whip", "Fireball", "Wind Blade"!
The "oil painting" helped Hobert block most of the attacks. At the same time, Hobert injected spirituality into the "Crystal of Order" on the hilt of the knife, forming a thick black shield to block the other attacks.
But it seems that no one saw the content of the "oil painting", because no one exclaimed: "What a beautiful scenery!"
It seems that the previous "Cold Night Squad" had informed other mercenary squads of the ability of this sealed item, so the mercenary squad that attacked this time was prepared.
Although no one exclaimed, their movements obviously had a brief pause.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert glanced at the yard. There were a total of six figures, which should be another mercenary squad.
After blocking the opponent's first round of attacks, he immediately used "Blink" to come outside the yard, and then used the ability of "Flight" to escape towards the lake.
His series of operations completely stunned his opponents, and Hobert actually escaped.
In order to avoid the newly renovated lord's mansion from being destroyed again, he prepared to fight by the spacious lake.
But Hobert had not flown far when a pale wall made of bones suddenly appeared in front of him. It seemed extremely tough and insurmountable.
Hobert immediately realized that this was a special undead creature.
He glanced behind him, and the six pursuers had already caught up, so Hobert simply pulled out his knife and stuck his cane on the ground: "Order!"
In an instant, a towering tree rose from the ground, its canopy covering an area of nearly a hundred meters, encompassing part of the lord's mansion.
The pursuers were all stunned. They obviously did not expect that Hobert would have such a visually impactful mystical item.
Not to mention them, even Hobert didn't expect it. Before this, he estimated that after his promotion, the coverage of the "Order Wood" could increase to sixty or seventy meters, but it actually reached a hundred meters!
Such a behemoth was extremely shocking, blocking the night sky.
"Weaken!"
Hobert was slightly stunned. This skill was not used by him, but came from a pursuer.
Before he could inject spirituality into the "Crystal of Order" again, he felt that his strength, spirituality, speed, and other aspects had been weakened.
But immediately afterwards, under his "Distortion", the negative impression of "Weaken" was minimized, and his state recovered somewhat.
At the end of the second round, Hobert determined that there must be a "Mentor of Disorder" among the enemies because they could use "Weaken" and "Arrogance" without "bribery"!
This "Mentor of Disorder" should be the captain.
And the special undead creature that appeared in front of him just now made Hobert guess that there should be an Beyonder of the "Death" pathway among the pursuers, most likely a "Spirit Guide". A "Spirit Medium" cannot summon such a powerful undead creature.
In addition, based on the attacks he received as soon as he went out, there should also be a "Wind Blessed" among the enemies.
The other three enemies should have two "Arbiter" pathway and one "Hunter" pathway. The specific strength is temporarily unknown.
At the same time, Hobert felt a substantial enhancement in the ability of the "Order Wood". As the owner of the "Order Wood", Hobert only needed to stand under the canopy of the tree, and the surrounding order and rules would become beneficial to him.
Just like just now, he found that he could even "distort" his negative state under the canopy of the tree. He tried it, and his "weakened" state immediately improved.
At the beginning of the battle, Hobert was still worried about whether he could drive away the members of this mercenary squad. After fighting and understanding his own strength and the opponent's strength, Hobert felt that he could arrogantly think: None of these six enemies can leave!
Taking advantage of the visual impact of the "Order Wood", which made the six enemies a little hesitant, Hobert seized the opportunity in the third round: "Corrosion!"
From the moment he went out, he had been using "Corrosion" silently, and now it finally broke out.
The "Corrosion" after the promotion has also been greatly enhanced. The movements of the Sequence 6 members were once again paused. In the next few seconds, they had to work hard to fight against the darkness and greed in their hearts.
One of the Sequence 7 members was completely hit. He felt that the "Order Wood" was a rare mystical item, so he abandoned Hobert, the enemy, and turned to hug the "Order Wood", wanting to take it for himself.
Only the "Mentor of Disorder" was not greatly affected: "Disorder!"
Hobert, who was very familiar with this ability, knew that "Disorder" was like the "Death" of the "Disciplinary Knight". As long as the target was determined, it could not be avoided at all.
So Hobert simply: "Distort!"
He "distorted" the concept between himself and the enemy. For the next two seconds, he and the "Mentor of Disorder" fell into a state of "Disorder" at the same time.
When Hobert regained his senses, two Sequence 6 members who had recovered from "Corrosion" had already rushed in front of him.
The "Spirit Guide", holding a steel sword with Beyonder abilities, pierced Hobert's heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 417: The Power of Sequence 5 (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[100 powerstone]
The enemies were all experienced Beyonders, skilled at seizing opportunities. Taking advantage of Hobert's confusion, they immediately closed in for a fatal strike.
Hobert didn't even have the chance to raise the "Oil Painting" in defense. The "Spirit Guide's" sword was definitely a magical item, capable of piercing Hobert's chest. He had the "Zombie Spoon's" blessing, and ordinary swords couldn't even penetrate his skin.
For the first time, Hobert felt the sensation of a cold, sharp weapon piercing his chest. Blood splattered, and even his heart was pierced, as if a hole had been punched through his chest.
Fortunately, Hobert's physique had been greatly enhanced. He smashed the "Oil Painting" at the mercenary attacking from the other side and kicked the "Spirit Guide" away: "Distortion!"
He once again "distorted" the concept between himself and the opponent. The "Spirit Guide," flying in mid-air, felt a pain in his chest and bled, bearing half of Hobert's injury.
Hobert quickly used "Healing" on himself, repairing the ruptured heart and starting it beating powerfully again.
However, the other mercenary, who had dodged the "Oil Painting," now held a white-hot spear and thrust it into Hobert's chest.
The attack was so fast that Hobert didn't even have time to use "Blink," so he had to resort to the faster "Paper Figure Substitute."
Poof~
The white-hot spear incinerated the paper doll, and Hobert appeared several meters away.
As soon as he appeared, the "Mentor of Disorder" launched a new attack: "Arrogance!"
Hobert immediately used: "Underworld Gate!"
A bronze gate with intricate patterns appeared beside the "Mentor of Disorder," and countless indescribable eyes within emitted a terrifying gaze. The "Mentor of Disorder" was immediately grabbed by pale arms, and chilling screams echoed in his ears.
Meanwhile, Hobert bent down to help up the crops that had been trampled in the earlier battle: These scumbags are no match for me. I don't even need to attack; they'll be scared away. I should focus on what a lord should do. Watching the crops grow is truly gratifying!
After the effects of "Arrogance" wore off, Hobert discovered that two "Blazing White Spears" were already embedded in his body, and he heard another enemy say, "The use of magical items is prohibited here!"
Even the wounded "Spirit Guide" rushed over, clutching his wound, ready to strike again.
Only the "Mentor of Disorder" was temporarily controlled by the "Underworld Gate," unable to move.
Through this intense exchange, Hobert finally figured out the enemies' strengths. The "Mentor of Disorder" was undoubtedly the leader, and the other members included a "Spirit Guide," a "Conspirer," and a "Judge."
There was also the "Wind Blessed," whose heart was probably incredibly dark or greedy, as it took him about ten seconds to recover from the "Corrosion" state, and the "Interrogator," who still clung to the "Order Wood."
Their coordination was excellent. If Hobert were still a Sequence 6, he would have already died twice, even with so many magical items.
The information provided by Harvey Hayden didn't mention such a strong mercenary squad. It seemed more like a joint raid by the main forces of the "Prairie Wolf Squad" and the "Blizzard Squad."
Hobert endured the pain in his chest and took two steps back, dodging the "Spirit Guide's" thrust. At the same time, he recited an incantation in ancient Hermes: "Summon!"
A space beneath the canopy immediately became illusory, and a knight in full armor, with an eyeball hanging on his face and a gleaming longsword in his hand, appeared. It was Hant, who had signed a contract with Hobert.
Hobert said, "Help me kill that 'Wind Blessed'!"
Hant received the order and charged towards the "Wind Blessed."
Hobert used "Blink" to dodge the "Conspirer's" and "Spirit Guide's" new round of attacks.
At this moment, the "Blazing White Spears" on his body had dissipated, but he didn't immediately heal himself. Instead, he used: "Distortion!"
Two small bloody holes appeared on the "Conspirer's" body, bearing half of Hobert's injuries.
Only then did Hobert use "Healing" to heal himself. At the same time, he observed the battlefield situation. The "Mentor of Disorder" was about to break free, and the "Spirit Guide" and "Conspirer" were both injured.
He immediately made a choice and used: "Disorder!" on the "Spirit Guide."
Hobert wasn't confident in quickly resolving the "Mentor of Disorder" but was confident in quickly resolving either the "Spirit Guide" or the "Conspirer."
The "Spirit Guide" fell into a state of "Disorder." Hobert used "Blink" to appear in front of him, but before his knife could strike, the "Spirit Guide" was pulled away by the "Judge" behind him: "Death!"
Since he issued the "prohibition," Hobert had used magical items multiple times, greatly increasing his power.
When Hobert used "Disorder" on the "Spirit Guide," the "Judge" determined that Hobert's target was the "Spirit Guide."
At this point, Hobert guessed that the "Spirit Guide," "Conspirer," and "Judge" came from the same team, and their coordination was even better. It wasn't that the "Judge" was unwilling to join the attack earlier, but two attackers were perfect; three would be a bit chaotic.
However, the "Judge" followed behind, ready to step in and support a teammate in danger.
Since that was the case, Hobert simply abandoned the "Spirit Guide" and used: "Death!" on the "Judge."
Both were unavoidable, and both struck each other's chest. Hobert took two steps back and coughed twice. The "Judge" was sent flying, breaking two ribs.
Hobert sneered inwardly: The "Death" of the "Judge" was not in the same league as the "Death" of the "Disciplinary Knight!"
At this moment, a wall of fire surrounded Hobert, igniting his pajamas and burning off a strand of his hair.
Hobert: "Charm!"
The target of "Charm" was not the "Conspirer" who cast the "Wall of Fire" but the "Mentor of Disorder" who had just broken free from the "Underworld Gate."
The "Mentor of Disorder," whose mind had just been impacted by the Underworld, was immediately hit, and for the next three seconds, he would have no desire to attack Hobert!
Hobert didn't attack the "Conspirer" either. Instead, he kicked the "Spirit Guide," who had just recovered from the "Chaos" state and was still a bit dazed, sending him flying into the "Order Wood."
With Hobert's current strength, he could kill some "Low Sequence" Beyonders with a kick. The "Spirit Guide" was immediately knocked unconscious.
Then, Hobert used "Blink" to appear in front of the "Conspirer," grabbed one of his arms, and stabbed him in the chest.
It wasn't that the "Conspirer" didn't want to dodge, but Hobert's strength was too great to avoid.
At this point in the battle, Hobert seized the opportunity and reversed the situation in an instant.
"Retreat!" The "Mentor of Disorder" said without thinking.
The "Judge," clutching his chest, dragged the "Briber," who had finally recovered from the "Corrosion" state, away with him.
The remaining three teammates couldn't escape. They didn't dawdle; they left immediately.
Hobert used: "Arrogance!" on the "Judge."
"Distortion!" The "Mentor of Disorder" distorted the target of "Arrogance." Then, stars suddenly appeared between Hobert and them. The area under the "Order Wood" was filled with tranquility and peace, causing Hobert to abandon the desire to pursue.
When the stars disappeared, Hobert came back to his senses, and the opponents were already far away.
Hobert didn't pursue. Instead, he turned around and dealt with the "Spirit Guide," who was still unconscious, and the seriously injured "Conspirer."
On Hant's side, he had just sliced off half of the "Wind Blessed's" head.
The battle came quickly and ended quickly.
Hobert accelerated the extraction of the Beyonder characteristics. He placed the three Beyonder characteristics and the "Spirit Guide's" sword together: "You choose first."
Hant chose the "Spirit Guide's" Beyonder characteristic, then bowed slightly to Hobert and disappeared into the void.
Hobert collected the Beyonder characteristics and the sword and touched the "Order Wood," which immediately transformed back into its scabbard form.
He looked around and suddenly had the illusion of being in a dream. He felt like he hadn't fully woken up before experiencing an intense battle that required his full effort.
Suddenly, Hobert came to his senses and went to the study to get a small vial, collecting some of the "Spirit Guide's" blood, so he wouldn't have to trouble Mr. Dophis.
Then, he used the "Spirit Wine Glass" to communicate with the "Wind Blessed." First, he asked about their origins. As expected, it was a joint operation by the "Blizzard Squad" and the "Prairie Wolf Squad."
Hobert then asked about their base, which was also in an old house, probably not far from Full Moon Lake.
Just as he was about to end the communication, Hobert had an idea and asked for the potion formulas for "Sailor" and "Seafarer." Christian had previously given him the potion formulas for "Folk of Rage" and "Wind Blessed."
Now, Hobert had a complete series of potion formulas from Sequence 9 "Sailor" to Sequence 6 "Wind Blessed." For Hobert, these formulas were useless, but Hobert liked to collect them, just in case they might be useful in the future?
After doing all this, Hobert stood in the center of the battlefield, reflecting on the intense battle.
He sighed in his heart: "Distortion" and "Healing" are so useful together!
Then, he sighed again: This is Sequence 5! Although it hasn't undergone the qualitative change of a demigod, its own power is already very strong.
In this battle, Hobert basically used his own abilities because his own Beyonder abilities were strong enough, and he didn't need to use the abilities of magical items as the main means of attack anymore.
Hobert put away the oil painting, wrapped himself in his somewhat tattered pajamas, and checked to make sure he hadn't left any magical items behind before returning to the yard.
He woke the male servant Allen and asked Allen to have people bury the bodies outside and clean up the blood on the ground.
Hobert wiped his face, changed into the clothes he wore during the day, and quickly put himself into a state of sleep through meditation.
Although he had used "Underworld Gate" once earlier, after Sequence 5, his spirituality had greatly improved, and these spiritual expenditures could be recovered in a short period of time.
Three hours later, during the most exhausting time before dawn, Hobert took out the "Faceless Necklace" and held the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" in his other hand: "The current location of the 'Mentor of Disorder' marked by the 'Oil Painting' this morning."
Although he didn't know what means they used to make him ignore the existence of the "Oil Painting," the "Oil Painting" had been left on the battlefield and had already marked their spirituality.
After reciting it seven times, Hobert saw the "Mentor of Disorder" sitting on the ground with his eyes closed, resting, and the "Judge" holding his bandaged chest, looking somewhat painful, and the "Briber" on guard, half-asleep and half-awake.
As expected, the three people who had been running around all night always needed to rest at this time.
And the captain of the "Cold Night Squad" didn't have time to tell the other mercenary squads that Hobert had the abilities of "Divination" and "Travel."
The captain of the "Blizzard Squad" had seen Hobert's "disappearance," but he didn't know that Hobert had just appeared not long ago at that time, and he didn't know that Hobert could accurately locate the enemy's position.
Based on the situation at the time, they thought that Hobert had followed the clues and launched a surprise attack, and then he had been chasing the captain of the "Cold Night Squad."
After the divination, Hobert held a knife in one hand and the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" in the other.
Then, the space in front of Hobert became illusory, and he appeared in front of the "Mentor of Disorder" under the guidance of the "Faceless Necklace."
Because of the increase in strength, this time Hobert was close enough to the enemy. He first stole the opponent's consciousness for the next one or two seconds, and then stabbed out with a knife, piercing the "Mentor of Disorder's" abdomen.
Hobert then raised the knife horizontally and slashed upward with force.
Unfortunately, he only slashed thirty centimeters before the "Mentor of Disorder," who had regained his senses, pressed down hard with both hands.
While retracting the knife, Hobert used: "Disorder!"
The "Mentor of Disorder," who had been ambushed and in a passive state, immediately fell into a state of "Disorder." Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert pulled out the knife and chopped off the opponent's head with one strike.
The "Exile" of the "Judge" and the "Weakening" of the "Bribed" only hit Hobert at this time.
Hobert was pushed out by a great force, and his abilities in all aspects were also "weakened."
But it was all too late. With the death of the "Mentor of Disorder," the remaining two had only escape on their minds.
The "Briber" turned and ran!
The "Judge" laughed loudly: "What's the point of running? Is it even useful anymore?"
Then he said to Hobert: "The bounty on your head is really too low. With your strength, you're worth at least 30,000 pounds! Hahaha, if I had known you were worth that much, I would never have come to Feynapotter, hahaha..."
Hobert struck out with the knife again, and the opponent's laughter came to an abrupt halt.
As for the "Briber" who had escaped, Hobert kicked up a fist-sized stone, knocked the opponent unconscious, and then went up and killed him with a knife.
Hobert used the "Spirit Wine Glass" to communicate with the "Mentor of Disorder," confirming their base and that there were only six Sequence 8s and two Sequence 9s in the base now.
After collecting the Beyonder characteristics and magical items, Hobert was about to use "Travel" to wipe out the opponent when he suddenly had an idea and used "Travel" to come to the "Hippopotamus".
The "Hippopotamus" was very crowded, the cabins were full of makeshift beds on the floor, and snores rose and fell.
Seel's status was different now, and he slept alone in the previous cabin.
Hobert appeared in front of him and shook him awake: "Call Albert to the deck, I'll take you to see the world."

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - 418 Even the Door Was Removed (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Zubastaye for becoming a free member]
Seel looked at the Lord disappearing in front of him, stunned for a full three or four seconds before quickly putting on his shoes and going to Albert's room inside the cabin.
Albert opened the door, yawning: "It's not even dawn yet!"
"The Lord wants us on deck!"
Albert stared blankly at Seel: "Are you sleepwalking?"
"Suit yourself."
Watching Seel leave the cabin, Albert hesitated and followed him out. If Seel was really sleepwalking, it would just be a few extra steps.
But if what he said was true, the loss would be too great if he didn't go.
Arriving on deck, Albert really saw the Lord standing at the bow with his hands behind his back.
He looked again at the still moving "Hippo" and the river water on both sides of the "Hippo". He was still on the ship!
Although he didn't understand what was happening, he immediately respectfully called out: "Lord Hobert!"
Hobert glanced at the swords in their hands, then asked Albert: "Do you have the Sealed Artifact with you?"
Albert nodded: "Yes!"
The ancestral treasure, of course, had to be carried with him.
"Tonight, an enemy force is invading Jeffery Territory. I have already killed their leaders. Now they have eight soldiers left, just right for you to practice with."
Seel immediately became excited. Since gaining Beyonder abilities, he had not had a chance to use them and had long wanted to fight.
Albert was pondering that the Lord might need help, which is why he needed their assistance: "I'll have Wayne stop the ship."
"No need!" Hobert held their shoulders: "I'm going to take you through the Spirit World. Lower your heads and don't make eye contact with the creatures of the Spirit World."
Before Seel could ask what the Spirit World was, the space in front of them became illusory, and they arrived in the Spirit World, where there was no distinction between front, back, left, and right.
Their eyes couldn't take it all in at once, and they found everything strange. They were stunned for a few seconds after leaving the Spirit World, as if savoring the wonderful journey just now.
Hobert pointed to the farmhouse on the hillside in front of them: "The eight soldiers are inside. I will directly rush in, and you will intercept the two enemies who escape.
"Those two enemies are evenly matched with you. Do your best to defeat them!"
After speaking, Hobert ignored their reactions and strode toward the farmhouse.
The mercenary on guard outside noticed Hobert and immediately blew his whistle to warn, but after only one blow, a black light flashed, and a knife was already stuck in his forehead.
Hobert quickly stepped forward, sheathed the knife with one hand, and kicked out with the other, directly knocking down a wall.
Ignoring the enemies crushed by the wall, Hobert quickly stepped forward and killed an enemy trying to escape through the window with a single slash.
He then kicked an enemy who overestimated himself and attacked Hobert, causing his chest to collapse.
Albert outside was already dumbfounded. Now he understood that the lord was really letting himself and Seel practice.
This made Albert feel flattered. After all, Seel was the Lord's confidant, and he also had the opportunity to participate in this experience, which showed that the Lord valued him.
In fact, it was just because Hobert knew in his heart that nobles like Albert would be loyal once they knew that the new lord had an Lord for a father.
So, while Hobert was training Seel, he brought him along.
The battle there had already ended, and two enemies covered in dust and with terrified faces ran out.
These were the two Sequence 9s. Hobert followed closely behind. Without the Lord giving any further orders, Seel and Albert drew their swords and rushed up to intercept the two fleeing enemies.
Hobert stood behind and instructed: "Seel, besides stabbing, a sword can also slash and pick!
"Albert, pay attention to the timing of using the Sealed Artifact. Don't let it conflict with your attacks.
"Seel, pay attention to your steps. Follow the feeling of your spirituality.
"Albert, ordinary people have extremely limited spirituality. Don't use the Sealed Artifact too frequently.
"Seel…"
Under Hobert's guidance, Seel finally killed his opponent in seven or eight minutes, while Albert took two minutes longer. Both of them sat on the ground, panting heavily.
This was thanks to Hobert's presence, otherwise these two would not have been able to defeat the mercenaries with rich combat experience.
After the two of them had caught their breath, Hobert asked Seel: "How do you feel?"
Seel immediately stood up and said: "Even with Beyonder abilities, I must practice every day and not slack off. Next time I encounter such an opponent, I will definitely not be so strenuous!"
Hobert nodded with satisfaction and looked at Albert.
Albert was somewhat envious of Seel, who had gained Beyonder power after following the Lord for such a short time.
Feeling the Lord's gaze, he immediately stood up and said: "Although I have practiced swordsmanship since I was a child, I am still too weak for a Beyonder.
Hobert commented: "Your strength and agility are not much different from your opponent, but you lack experience fighting Beyonders. Of course, this is only for some Sequence 9s. Many Sequence 9s are stronger than you just by taking the potion.
"If you have fought Sequence 8s, you will truly feel your own weakness."
Hobert deliberately raised his hand noticeably, and the eight corpses immediately stood up. Soon, the Beyonder characteristics in their bodies were extracted, and the corpses handed over their Beyonder characteristics to Hobert one by one.
Seel and Albert stood there stiffly, not even daring to breathe loudly. If they hadn't seen the Lord raise his hand just now and knew that these corpses stood up because of the Lord's abilities, they would have turned around and run away long ago.
Especially Albert, whether it was traversing the Spirit World or manipulating corpses, he felt that he had only seen the true face of the Beyonder world today.
At the same time, he was glad that in middle age, he had finally met someone who could give him the abilities he wanted and whom he could devote all his efforts to serving.
He secretly laughed in his heart: Grove is such a fool to defect. He doesn't even know what opportunities he has missed.
...
Back in the study, Hobert heard banging noises from next door. It turned out that Allen had woken up the carpenters early to repair the door and windows of Hobert's room.
Hobert wasn't very sleepy either, so he locked the door of the study and sacrificed all the spoils of this battle to the "Nation of Disorder".
This raid was more clean and efficient than the last, completely eliminating two mercenary squads and harvesting 14 Beyonder characteristics and two Mystical Items.
The threat from Loen might only be the people from MI9.
However, after this battle, the people from MI9 probably wouldn't take action without a demigod leading the team.
Hobert believed that, based on the strength he had shown in Backlund before, MI9 would not mobilize a demigod for him.
As for mercenaries, Hobert remembered that the top mercenary teams in the entire Northern Continent, there were only a dozen or so, basically with official backgrounds, carrying out anti-enemy operations that were not suitable for officials to take action.
Now that three of them had been wiped out in South Colson, it was estimated that the other mercenary squads also knew that Hobert's strength was completely inconsistent with the bounty.
Not that the bounty was too high, but that the bounty was too low. It was estimated that the other top mercenary squads would not easily take action.
Thinking of this, Hobert was a little disappointed. Without these transport teams, his income would definitely be affected.
The next step was to build his own Beyonder market in the auction house. He planned to take out those Beyonder characteristics he had accumulated before to activate the market and alleviate the financial pressure on Jeffery Territory at the same time.
Thinking of this, Hobert turned his attention to the Beyonder characteristics in front of him.
Among them was a Sequence 5 "Mentor of Disorder" Beyonder characteristic; three Sequence 6 characteristics, one "Wind Blessed", one "Judge", and one "Conspirer".
One Sequence 7 "Briber" Beyonder characteristic; six Sequence 8 characteristics, three "Sheriff", one "Barbarian", one "Provoker", and one "Pugilist" Beyonder characteristic.
Two Sequence 9 characteristics, one "Arbiter" and one "Warrior" pathway Beyonder characteristic.
In addition, he also harvested two Mystical Items, one was a Sealed Artifact of the "Darkness" pathway, which could make creatures in a certain area lose most of their active will.
Although it was a Sealed Artifact with an area of effect attack, it did not distinguish between friend and foe.
Hobert seemed to imagine such a scene, where two groups of people who were about to rush together to fight, under the effect of this Sealed Artifact, would stare blankly at each other, without the will to fight.
Then this Sealed Artifact could be named "Peace Envoy".
And the sword that could pierce Hobert was a Mystical Item of the "Hunter" pathway, with the ability of "Fatal Strike", which could make the sword extremely sharp and almost indestructible. Every stab was a "Cull", even if the stabbed position was not the target's weakness, it could become a weakness.
However, Hobert did not intend to replace the knife in his hand with it, because this sword also needed three strikes to break through the "Guardian's" "Dawn Barrier", while the Tang knife in Hobert's hand only needed two strikes, which showed how strong this knife's "armor-breaking" ability was.
Hobert put these two Mystical Items in the "Nation of Disorder", just as an accumulation of his own Sealed Artifacts.
After he established his own Beyonder force in a while, he could give it to the "official Beyonder" in the territory to use.
At that time, with Sealed Artifacts and official Beyonder, the official Beyonder system of this territory would be established.
And the power of the Earth Mother Church and the Theosophy Order could gradually be marginalized, only responsible for religious cases.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert did not leave the "Nation of Disorder" immediately, but considered the issue of "reducing the burden" on himself.
One problem he was facing now was that he had too many Mystical Items on him. Although the negative effects were not strong, he had to spend a lot of effort to avoid them every day.
The key was that as Hobert's own abilities became stronger, some items could be placed in the "Nation of Disorder" on weekdays, and then taken out when needed.
For example, the "Psychological Spoon", this Mystical Item was rarely used now, Hobert preferred to kill the enemy and communicate with the spirit.
And its ability to block attacks from the spirit world had also gradually become useless.
Originally, the "Black Emperor" pathway had a "passive skill" to resist mental attacks. At the level of "Mentor of Disorder", Hobert's mental power had become so strong that he could effectively resist mental attacks and mind attacks.
The ability of "Berserk" had not been used for a long time. Now Hobert had the ability of "Arrogance", which overlapped with "Berserk".
Now the biggest role of the "Psychological Spoon" was "Hypnosis", which could be completely taken from the "Nation of Disorder" when needed.
Another Mystical Item that was somewhat useless was the "Light Ring". Its power was very strong, but in this battle, its ability was not used once.
It was still because Hobert's own ability could completely replace the abilities of some Mystical Items.
If it was some exploration action in the dark, or knowing that he was going to face enemies who were afraid of sunlight, it would not be too late to go to the "Nation of Disorder" to get it.
The situation of the "Dream Stealing Pocket Watch" was similar to that of the "Light Ring", and there was no need to carry it on his body anymore.
Originally, Hobert was also preparing to put the "Ocean Pendant" in the "Nation of Disorder", but its "flying" ability was really useful, strengthening Hobert's mobility speed, and could be worn on his body temporarily.
The situation of the "Faceless Necklace" was similar to that of the "Ocean Pendant", and the ability of the "Paper Figure Substitute" was very useful, and could be worn on his body temporarily.
The "Fighting Ring" was useless and must be placed in the "Nation of Disorder".
As for the other Mystical Items, there were also the "Healing Fork", "Traveler's Knife", "Spirit Wine Glass", and "Zombie Spoon". They all had irreplaceable roles, or new roles, and could be carried on his body temporarily.
Hobert had six Mystical Items on him, which was a little easier.
Then Hobert turned his attention to the scepter he got from Medici, which was a demigod-level Sealed Artifact, which could enhance his combat power.
With a wave of his hand, he held the scepter in his hand and felt its negative effects again: "The holder's thinking is easy to become distorted, originally intending to attack but will become defense; the holder will become abnormally greedy, any property can attract a certain amount of attention; the holder will become fond of laughing, sometimes laughter will interrupt the use of his own Beyonder abilities."
Hobert stretched out his hand again and summoned the "Power of Order" to try to seal it.
But the sealing effect was not as good as imagined. None of the negative effects of the scepter were reduced, except that the negative effects could be greatly reduced in the first ten minutes of use. However, a certain negative effect would briefly affect the holder, regardless of whether the holder continued to hold it.
In other words, this scepter can only be used for ten minutes at a time! Then it needs to rest for at least half an hour before it can avoid the negative effects again.
Hobert pondered for a moment, took a "Crystal of Order", deformed the "Crystal of Order", and wrapped the scepter.
This turned it into a scepter with a black crystal appearance. Hobert planned to pin it on his waist and use it as an ornament usually, and then "remove" its outer shell when using it.
After doing these things, Hobert returned to the real world. The sky outside was just beginning to brighten, and there were crowing chickens everywhere.
Hobert used "Travel" to reach the highest point of the mountain, exhaling white mist, looking at the misty Moon Lake, and watching the rising wisps of smoke.
Hobert had gradually poured his feelings into this territory, especially after seeing this vibrant scene, he hoped even more that it would become rich and prosperous.
Then Hobert turned his gaze to the territory of Viscount Teuton across Moon Lake, and to the entire South Colson that was gradually awakening.
He stretched out his hand and made a gesture of grabbing and clenching his fist.
Hobert smiled, not feeling that his actions were childish at all.
The next second, he entered the spirit world again and returned to his study.
Breakfast was ready, and Hobert's room was also repaired.
After breakfast, Hobert took a nap, and around ten o'clock, he started to get busy again.
...
Backlund, 29 Sivellaus Street, Empress Borough.
Rafter, who was studying a geography magazine, felt a movement in his heart and looked towards the door.
Knock knock knock~
After three knocks, he twisted the handle and opened the door. A man wearing a black crystal mask, a black windbreaker, and a black crystal scepter on his waist came in.
Rafter immediately got up excitedly: "The Favored!"
And this "Favored" was of course Hobert: "The great 'Creator' wants you to go to the suburbs of Backlund. I have brought you two things."
After speaking, Hobert took out a black mask made of "Crystal of Order". Rafter had dedicated the mask Hobert gave him before back to him in a very knowing manner. There was also a small bottle of blood: "Bring the map!"
Rafter quickly found a map of the extreme suburbs of Backlund. Hobert marked the location of the ruins: "After arriving at the marked location, pray to the 'Creator', and He will send you to an underground ruin.
"In the ruins, there is a noble courtyard. After finding it, the 'Creator' will unlock the seal there and send you to the underground part of the ruins!
"When you arrive at the underground part, you will see an underground corridor. First, set up an altar, and then smear this bottle of blood on the wall.
"Attention! Close your eyes immediately after smearing the blood! Otherwise, you will die!
"After feeling a great sense of fear, close your eyes and make a sacrifice to the 'Creator'!"
When Rafter heard that he might die, his heart trembled slightly, but then he thought that with the gaze of the "Creator", he would not be in much danger, and then he calmed down.
Hobert pointed to the mask on the table: "As long as you complete this task, this mask is yours.
"This is the symbol of the 'Creator's' Favored. You will be directly under my leadership. I will occasionally give you some tasks. As long as you complete the tasks, you will accumulate merit and I will give you some rewards.
"If there is any problem that cannot be solved, pray to the 'Creator' if it is urgent, and write me a letter and summon my messenger if it is not urgent.
"The method of summoning the messenger is..., the reward for each summoning is three donuts."
Rafter wrote them down one by one, and suddenly felt a sense of excitement and peace of mind from finding an organization: "What should I call you?"
"Just call me the Favored!"
"Yes!"
Rafter watched the "Favored" open the door and leave, and then his spirituality felt that the other party had disappeared outside the door.
Rafter stared at the direction of the door for a while before he seemed to suddenly wake up, put away the mask and the potion, changed his clothes, disguised himself, and left the room through the window.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert used "Travel" to return to his study. In the future, if anything happens, he plans to contact Rafter directly.
This is the correct way to use a "small account". Otherwise, it would be inappropriate for the "Creator" to come forward for every little thing.
At the same time, when he plans to buy a train, he will tell Upton the way to summon his messenger to achieve a one-way connection with him.
Tomorrow, Hobert also plans to take a "long trip" to the Southern Continent to meet with Elliott and establish a one-way connection with him.
In this way, he will connect all the current resources together through the identity of the "Creator's" Favored.
Hobert drank tea, waiting for Rafter to arrive at the designated location in the suburbs of Backlund.
At this time, Allen brought the ancient Azure Dragon Beast's blood, skin and other spiritual materials, as well as the previously collected internal organs, to Hobert's study.
Fortunately, it is winter now, and these things are all spiritual materials, so they have not deteriorated after being left for several days.
Because the ancient Azure Dragon Beast was huge, there were many spiritual materials, filling seven large boxes.
Hobert didn't know how to use these materials, so he simply sold them all to the Church of the Earth Mother.
However, the liver crystal of the ancient Azure Dragon Beast was of course not included in this sale.
Hobert made a list, and then summoned the messenger, spending ten donuts to ask the messenger to send the seven large boxes to Feynapotter City.
After finishing these, Hobert heard the prayer from the "Nation of Disorder".
Arriving at the "Nation of Disorder", it turned out that Rafter had arrived.
Hobert then used the "Teleportation Statue" again to send Rafter to the ruins.
...
Suburbs of Backlund.
Rafter held up the lamp and looked around, marveling at the size of the ruins, and then recalling what the "Favored" had said, he went to the tallest and largest building in the ruins.
After arriving at the noble courtyard, Rafter's eyes became magical again. When he came back to his senses, he had already appeared in a long underground passage.
Rafter sighed: "I didn't expect that there are so many ruins in Backlund."
Knowing that the "Creator" was watching him, he didn't dare to delay. After a simple sigh, he quickly followed the instructions of the "Favored", set up the altar, and then smeared the blood.
Soon he saw a strange and bizarre stone door shape appearing where the blood was smeared. At this time, he suddenly remembered the "Favored's" instructions and quickly closed his eyes.
Having lost his sight in the unknown ruins, Rafter immediately became a little nervous and cramped.
Especially after a feeling of fear that made his whole body tremble appeared a few seconds later, Rafter wanted to open his eyes several times, but he endured it.
He finally understood why the "Favored" wanted him to set up the altar in advance. In this state, let alone setting up the altar, it would be difficult to even light a candle.
Amidst the occasional trembling sound of teeth colliding, Rafter completed the sacrifice process.
A surge of power appeared in the underground ruins, neutralizing the feeling of fear to the depths of the soul.
Soon, the feeling of fear completely disappeared.
The "Creator's" voice appeared in Rafter's ears: "You can open your eyes now."
Rafter opened his eyes and saw an ordinary stone room in front of him. He didn't know what made him so afraid. He only knew that the level of that thing must be very high, otherwise the "Creator" would not be interested.
In addition, he found that the strange and bizarre door had disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - 419: Agreement with Vice Admiral Iceberg (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Congratulations to ThousandWordz for advancing to Sequence 9: Reader, +5 bonus]
That door was, of course, taken away by Hobert. Since he was looting the place clean, he couldn't possibly leave behind the "Traveler's Door."
Hobert had previously learned the magic circle for arranging the "Traveler's Knife" from Christian. If needed, this "Traveler's Door" could be put to use immediately.
Moreover, this door could change its appearance; it wasn't necessarily limited to being a stone door. A regular wooden door would also work.
Next, Hobert turned his gaze to the corpse of the ancient death god in front of the "Iron Throne." Even in the "Nation of Disorder," the corpse of the death god, with its enormous divine bird form, still emanated the scent of death.
When light was one or two meters away from it, it would turn pale, as if all color had withered away.
Hobert prepared a separate room for it outside the main hall. His spirituality told him that if he injected the power of the "Nation of Disorder" into the corpse of the ancient death god, it wouldn't revive, but something very terrifying would definitely happen.
Hobert decided not to tempt fate.
As for that black hound spirit beast, Hobert currently had no way to manipulate it.
However, he could do the same thing as with "Bull Demon King," injecting the power of the "Nation of Disorder" into the black hound spirit beast's body, making it temporarily obey Hobert's commands.
It could use the powers of the Sequence 3 of the "Death" pathway, and also use the abilities of "Disorder," "Order," "Distortion," and "Prohibition."
However, normally, Hobert couldn't command it.
It could sense the location of the ancient death god's corpse and would spontaneously go to find it. If it encountered an insurmountable obstacle, it would face the direction of the death god's corpse and stop there, unmoving.
Hobert sighed, feeling like he had encountered a stubborn and loyal child. So, he expanded the room holding the ancient death god's corpse and moved the black hound spirit beast inside as well.
After that, Hobert felt a sense of relief. The treasures of Backlund that he knew of had finally been looted clean by him.
Like Amon's mausoleum, although he knew about it, he wasn't familiar with it. The main thing was that he didn't want to get involved with Amon right now, so he never intended to plunder it.
When he left Backlund before, Hobert still felt some regret, wondering how long it would take for Medici's Beyonder characteristics to be buried? He remembered that the Church had directly collapsed that ruin.
He also wondered whose hands the death god's corpse would ultimately fall into? Now, it had all fallen into his, Hobert's, hands, so he could rest assured.
Looking at Rafferty in the underground ruin again, he had finally recovered from the extreme fear he had just experienced. Hobert then used the "Teleportation Statue" to send him back to the surface.
Then he said to him, "You can leave Backlund now."
Next, Hobert withdrew his spirituality and returned to the real world.
Sitting behind his desk, Hobert had Ellen outside instruct the kitchen to make doughnuts. He spread out the stationery and wrote a letter to Azik.
The content of the letter was roughly: "When I and the family members were exploring the room where the ancient death god's corpse was stored again, we found a way to seal the black hound spirit beast and took away the ancient death god's corpse."
"If Mr. Azik still wants to look at the corpse of the ancient death god, you can write me a letter in advance, and I will take you to see it."
While waiting for the doughnuts, the messenger suddenly appeared in the study.
She brought Jessica's package, which contained two failures in Carrie's eyes. Those were weapons that had not had any effect when combining Beyonder materials with weapons.
In the eyes of the "Artisan," both of these weapons were failures.
There was also a letter from Jessica, as well as a forwarded letter from Selena.
Hobert was slightly stunned. He had originally wanted to take the initiative to write a letter to Selena.
"Please wait a moment, I need to reply," Hobert said to the messenger.
Messenger: "Ten minutes for three doughnuts!"
You still have the nerve to say that!
Hobert put his pocket watch on the table: "Start timing now!"
He first replied to Jessica, writing only a few sentences, stating that he had received the package she sent.
Then he replied to Selena. In Selena's letter, she stated that after thinking for so long, she had finally decided to become an Beyonder in the future and asked Hobert to give her this opportunity. However, she hoped to spend a good year with her family and hoped to find Hobert again after graduation.
Hobert's reply to her was also very simple, telling her that he would go to her after the New Year to have a good talk, and told her the way to summon his messenger, as well as the reward for each letter.
Hobert neatly sealed the two letters and stamped them with sealing wax: "It's not even ten minutes yet, let's count it as ten minutes."
Messenger: "Aren't you going to check again?"
"No need, I have confidence," Hobert said with a smile.
At this time, the doughnuts had just come out of the oven. Hobert sent out a total of three letters this time. The messenger waited a few more minutes, and he paid her a total of twelve doughnuts.
Fortunately, the kitchen made more than a dozen at a time. In addition to paying the messenger, Hobert also ate two.
But Hobert was afraid that the news that he liked to eat doughnuts and could eat more than a dozen at a time would spread. The key was that this was the second time today that he had "eaten" more than ten doughnuts.
After finishing all this, Hobert had nothing important to do. He strolled around Jeffrey Town and used "Travel" to take a look at the "Nohar" ship that was going upstream.
The appearance of this ship made people along the way stop to watch.
It had been more than fifty years since a ship of this size had passed through this waterway. Children ran and played along the banks, while more people stopped their work and watched the ship go upstream along the river until the ship's shadow became smaller and smaller.
There's no danger for the time being.
Hobert returned to his study again, still idle.
So, Hobert thought, should he go explore the road first?
He had never been to the Southern Continent. What if it was difficult to cross the Berserk Sea from the spirit world?
Then he thought of the island that had just been discovered at sea, which was said to have Fourth Epoch ruins and many extraordinary creatures.
Some newly discovered islands basically have some extraordinary creatures, but they will soon be hunted down by the pirates who come.
Hobert wasn't interested in those extraordinary creatures, but he was very interested in the Fourth Epoch ruins.
Because he knew the exact location from Alger, he could reach the island by using the "Faceless Necklace" for divination.
The more Hobert thought about it, the more tempted he became, so he changed into a Loen-style outfit. Like the last time he "went on a long trip," he used "Travel" to first come to Conant City on the southern coast of the Northern Continent.
Then he transferred through Bayam, the capital of the Rorsted Archipelago, and finally came to that nameless island.
This was already the southwestern section of the Berserk Sea, very close to the Southern Continent.
Hobert appeared on an uninhabited beach. In the entire Northern Continent, it was winter at this time, but in the Southern Continent it was summer.
The power of nature is still amazing even in this extraordinary world.
At the same time, Hobert found that he was wearing too much. It was perfect to wear summer clothes or spring clothes here, but Hobert's windbreaker had thick sweaters and leather vests inside.
However, he didn't intend to find a deserted place to discard a few pieces of clothing. For the "Mentor of Disorder," the weather would no longer make him feel uncomfortable. If he didn't want to sweat, he wouldn't sweat a drop, and he wouldn't feel hot.
The location of the beach was relatively low. Hobert used the ability of "flying" to fly up, and his eyes passed through the dense trees to see a small mountain range on the island.
Hobert returned to the ground and waited for a while before he could use the "Travel" ability again. This time he used "Travel" to come to the highest peak on the island.
From here, the entire island could be seen at a glance.
This island was divided by a small mountain range running north-south. There was a plain on the east side, all dense forest. The west side was narrower, but there was a place very suitable for a port.
There were ruins there, and the Fourth Epoch ruins should be there.
Hobert also saw several ships and several camps, which should be pirate ships and pirate camps.
So far, no official force has announced that it owns the sovereignty of this island, so naturally no navy or official Beyonders will come here.
Hobert used "Travel" again to come to the west coast of the island, not far from the ruins.
While walking towards the ruins, Hobert also encountered two pirates walking together.
After they saw Hobert, they watched from afar for a while, and one of the pirates said, "Hey! You fool wearing thick clothes!"
Hobert ignored them, but they chased after him, and one of the pirates said, "This is the territory of the 'Skull' Pirate Group. Did you pay taxes for passing through here?"
Hobert glanced at them: "What is your captain's bounty!"
Another pirate puffed out his chest: "As high as 1500 pounds! How about it? Are you scared!"
"Get out of here, my bounty is 30,000 pounds!"
The two pirates laughed: "Sure enough, he's a fool. He doesn't even know how to brag! Are you a pirate general?"
Another pirate simply took out his gun: "Pay the tax first! Your windbreaker is also good..."
Hobert stuck his cane in the sand, broke the other party's gun with his left hand, and twisted the other party's arm with his right hand, adding a "joint" to the other party's arm.
Amid the pirate's screams, he looked aside and kicked the other pirate's calf, breaking it: "Gentlemen, are you satisfied with the tax I paid? Do you want some more?"
The two pirates endured the pain and quickly begged Hobert for mercy.
Hobert smiled, picked up his cane, and continued to the ruins.
As Hobert approached the ruins, he realized just how massive the original structure had been. Judging by its remains, the building had been constructed against the mountain, stretching at least a thousand meters in length and three to four hundred meters in width. Even by modern standards, it would have been a colossal edifice.
Judging from the collapsed walls, it must have been quite tall.
Hobert even suspected that some Beyonder power had been used in the construction of this behemoth. Otherwise, only a steel-reinforced structure could have supported such a building, yet there was little metal to be found in the ruins.
Ahead, he saw a section of wall that hadn't completely collapsed, and standing in front of it were several people.
A young woman was sketching and writing in front of the wall, while several men coldly surveyed the surroundings, acting as her sentries.
They noticed Hobert as well, and several pairs of eyes fixed on him with a chilling gaze.
From a distance, Hobert called out, "I'm a scholar interested in Fourth Epoch relics. I mean no harm, I just want to examine the walls for any clues!"
The men adopted defensive postures, but the woman seemed to say something quietly, and one of the men finally said, "Come on over."
Hobert approached at a leisurely pace. Up close, he saw that she was a beautiful woman with an oval face, a high, straight nose, thin lips, and a pair of clear, light blue eyes like a spring of water.
The men, led by a blonde individual, kept a close watch on Hobert.
"Good afternoon, Madam! Good afternoon, everyone!" Hobert greeted politely.
The woman gave a slight nod in response, but the other men completely ignored him.
Hobert didn't press the conversation, but instead turned his attention to the relatively well-preserved wall before him.
The wall's surface was clean, which was what struck Hobert as odd. He reached out and poked the wall. After more than a thousand years, exposed to wind and rain, the wall showed surprisingly little sign of decay!
Walking further, Hobert spotted a faded emblem high up on the wall. After a long look, he finally recognized it: a massive crest carved into the wall, depicting a crown!
"Trunseost!" Hobert blurted out.
The black crown was the emblem of the Trunsoest family.
The woman beside him asked, "You recognize the Trunsoest family crest?"
I know it all too well, Hobert thought with a smile. "I happened to see it in a book. But... why would the Trunsoest family crest be here?"
The Trunsoest Empire's territory was on the Northern Continent, and this sea area was already quite close to the Southern Continent. Could it be that the Night Emperor's power had once reached the Southern Continent?
"That's what I'm trying to figure out," the woman said. "Do you have any ideas?"
Hobert pondered for a moment. "Could this have been a secret base built by the Trunsoest Empire to launch a surprise attack on the Southern Continent?"
"It seems you know a lot about the history of the Fourth Epoch!" The woman extended a hand in self-introduction. "Edwina."
Hobert politely shook her soft hand. "Jeffrey."
Hobert had changed his appearance before setting out, so he wasn't worried about being recognized. Besides, no one on the high seas would care about a traitor from the Loen Kingdom, even if they knew.
After all, there were too many vicious criminals on these seas, and Hobert's little escapade was insignificant in comparison.
After introducing himself, Hobert noticed the expectant looks on the faces of the men around him. He realized he had missed something earlier. After a moment's thought, he finally grasped the key point: "Vice Admiral Iceberg!"
These men just wanted to see Hobert's surprised expression.
Edwina smiled. "Indeed. You can let go of my hand now."
"Oh, I'm sorry. I was just too surprised," Hobert said with an embarrassed laugh. He hadn't expected "Vice Admiral Iceberg" to be so...un-icy.
"I was hoping someone could discuss this problem with me," Edwina said. "As you said, it's very strange for Trunsoest relics to appear here."
Hobert glanced at the men beside her. Can't they discuss it with you?
However, he was met with angry glares.
Hobert thought, Alright, alright, I get it. You want to, but you don't have enough knowledge. Just looking at your faces, I can tell you dropped out of school early.
"I'd be glad to help," Hobert said politely. "I'm also looking forward to a clash of ideas."
Edwina immediately asked, "Did you attend a grammar school?"
Otherwise, he wouldn't use such precise adjectives.
"I used to study at Backlund University, but unfortunately, I didn't graduate."
"That's excellent," Edwina said. "My subordinates have also discovered another clue. Come this way."
She led Hobert to a corner of the wall, where there was a structural diagram drawn with a sharp object, along with several words in ancient Feysac.
Hobert read haltingly, "Length, sample box, guideline?"
Apart from "length," Hobert didn't know the meaning of the other words. He looked at the simple structural diagram. "This looks a bit like the structure of a fire door on a large ship!"
Just two days ago, he had learned about the prices of large cargo ships in Feynapotter City. The salesperson had explained in detail the advantages of their company's cargo ships, one of which was that their ships had advanced fire doors.
Edwina nodded in satisfaction. "It seems you're quite knowledgeable. That's right, this is a design drawing for a fire door. The words next to it are all technical terms used in shipbuilding."
"If I'm not mistaken, the Trunsoest people built a huge ship here. During the shipbuilding, two engineers discussed the design of the fire door in this corner."
"While discussing, they couldn't help but sketch a few lines and make a simple record in ancient Feysac."
Hobert looked at the surrounding ruins in disbelief. "So, this used to be a massive dockyard."
"I have the same guess," Edwina said, hands clasped behind her back. "According to the size of this dockyard, the ship's length should be close to 2000 meters, with a width of 300 meters! The height would be several tens of meters! Enough to accommodate the population of a small city!"
"The Trunsoest Empire!" Hobert felt a thunderclap in his mind, and many clues connected.
Edwina's eyes flashed with brilliance. "That's right, the treasure of the Trunsoest Empire really exists!"
Hobert, however, had already thought of something else. "Do your subordinates include Beyonders of the 'Sailor' pathway?"
"Vice Admiral Iceberg" was taken aback. "Yes!"
"I happen to know some secret information about the 'Trunsoest Empire'," Hobert said. "But I need to verify it first. Please have a 'Sailor' pathway friend dive deep from the harbor and search outwards along the seabed to see if they can find anything strange."
At the captain's instruction, two "Sailors" took off their hats and jumped into the sea.
Hobert sat on a rock, waiting quietly.
Edwina asked, "You don't seem to be a 'local'."
Hobert smiled. "There don't seem to be any locals on this island anymore."
Of course, he knew that ordinary pirates couldn't glean much information from his clothing, but "Vice Admiral Iceberg," the former "Erudite," should have understood many things.
Hobert changed the subject. "The material of these walls seems very special."
"It's said to be a construction method that existed in the Third and Fourth Epochs," Edwina said candidly, without reservation. "It has now been lost."
"I've found some clues in books. In addition to mixing some spiritual materials into the ingredients, some magic arrays should have been incorporated during construction, while praying to the gods for power."
"With the blessing of the gods, the scale of the building could be larger than we can imagine, and it could stand for hundreds or thousands of years."
Hobert nodded slightly. This construction method was no longer applicable. Praying to the gods for power or blessings, they might only respond after a long time, and the construction period could be greatly delayed.
Things were different in the Third and Fourth Epochs. At that time, the gods were still in their kingdoms, and there were so many angels. There were plenty of objects to pray to.
After waiting for half an hour, the two sailors emerged from the water one after another.
After coming ashore, one of the sailors began to report the underwater situation: "The water in the dockyard is very deep. We explored outwards along the seabed and encountered a cliff after about a few thousand meters!"
The other sailor reported: "That cliff is very peculiar. The rock below is recessed, and looking at it, the base of this island seems to be getting thinner and thinner."
"We searched around the cliff, and the surrounding area is a similar structure. It's like, it's like... the top is a huge cake, and the bottom is just a goblet."
"That's right!" Hobert clapped his hands. "This island was originally on the coast of the Northern Continent and was moved here by the Underworld Emperor."
"Vice Admiral Iceberg's" subordinates were stunned, and then they all showed obvious expressions of disbelief.
Hobert said to Edwina, "During my two explorations, I learned some more detailed information about the 'Trunsoest Empire'. If you agree to two conditions, I'll tell you all the information."
The first mate with the golden hair, Olfers, said, "Captain, don't agree to him. This is clearly a trap."
The other sailors chimed in, "This kid doesn't look like a good person."
"Look, he's wearing so many layers on such a hot day. He must be a madman."
"…"
Edwina waved her hand at her subordinates. "Tell me your conditions, and then I'll decide whether to agree."
Olfers and the others were dejected. They knew that the captain couldn't resist the temptation of 'historical secrets'.
"The first condition is goodwill from 'Iceberg Admiral' and the forces behind her. We may have deeper cooperation in the future."
Edwina nodded. "No problem."
Hobert continued, "The second condition is to help me find the whereabouts of 'Admiral Dusk'. After finding him, we can launch a hunt together, or you can simply provide information.
"As long as your information is accurate enough, and you can treat your ship as my 'forward base', and I hunt down 'Admiral Dusk', I will share a portion of the spoils with you."
Edwina asked, "What is your strength?"
Hobert was slightly stunned, then shamelessly said, "A bounty of 30,000 pounds!"
