chapters.title: Chapter 420 - 420 Claiming sovereignty over the island (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Of course, Hobert remembered Lorotta's request and the huge bounty for taking down "Vice Admiral Dusk."
Before, when Hobert was still Sequence 6, he knew he didn't have the strength to kill "Vice Admiral Dusk," so he never considered it.
Now it's different. Having advanced to Sequence 5, Hobert was eager to spar with a "Pirate Rear Admiral." If possible, he could directly eliminate the opponent and collect a large bounty.
Edwina and several of her crew members re-evaluated Hobert.
Logically, a 30,000-pound bounty should indicate a "Pirate Admiral"-level powerhouse, but why had they never heard of a pirate named "Jeffrey?"
Nor had they heard of any pirate with a 30,000-pound bounty.
Edwina didn't dwell on the issue. After considering it, she said, "I can help you find traces of 'Vice Admiral Dusk,' but I won't provide further assistance."
Hobert nodded: "That's fine."
Of course, he knew that the relationship between the forces behind "Iceberg Admiral" and those behind "Vice Admiral Dusk" wasn't good, but it wasn't bad either. Rashly engaging in a violent conflict wouldn't be worthwhile for "Iceberg Admiral."
At the same time, she was willing to provide some information detrimental to "Vice Admiral Dusk." Although there were no deep-seated grudges between "Pirate Admirals," conflicts occasionally occurred.
Edwina was happy to send another "Pirate Admiral" an enemy, making things difficult for a potential rival.
This response was similar to Hobert's expectations: "However, this means I can't share the spoils with you."
Edwina hummed in agreement: "How can I contact you?"
Hobert took out the fountain pen from his pocket: "I'll give you the method to summon my messenger."
Edwina handed over her notebook. After Hobert finished writing, she took it back and read the incantation and the reward for sending the message: "Your handwriting is good."
Hobert capped the pen and smiled: "It's alright, I've practiced since I was young."
He said: "Then let's begin. I discovered a notebook of Duke Southville of the Tudor Dynasty in some ruins in the suburbs of Backlund.
"He once served as a guard to the Night Emperor and was deeply trusted by him.
"During the Four Emperors era, he was assigned by the Night Emperor to set a trap against the Underworld Emperor…"
Edwina asked, "A trap against the Underworld Emperor?"
"Yes, but Southville didn't record the specifics of the trap in the notebook."
"Iceberg Admiral" nodded slightly, gesturing to "please continue."
Hobert continued: "Later, when I was exploring a hidden island with a friend, we encountered a ghost ship at the intersection of the spirit world and the real world.
"Through communication with the ghosts on the ghost ship…"
"Please wait." Edwina interrupted Hobert again: "You said you communicated with the ghosts on the ghost ship? Also, under what circumstances would you encounter a place where the spirit world and the real world intersect?"
Hobert said half-truthfully: "This was caused by the special environment of that island. I'm not very clear about the specific situation."
To explain it clearly would require discussing the formation process of the Berserk Sea. Of course, it couldn't be ruled out that "Vice Admiral Iceberg" knew this information, but if she didn't, this information combined with the information about "Vice Admiral Dusk's" location would be unequal.
To avoid trouble, Hobert simply used this ambiguous answer to brush it off.
"As for communicating with ghosts, I don't think it's an incomprehensible thing." Hobert smiled slightly: "It's similar to the process of communicating with spirit world creatures or underworld creatures."
"You were lucky." Edwina said, "As far as I know, ghosts on ghost ships generally carry strong malice."
Hobert nodded earnestly: "Thank you for your reminder. I will be careful when dealing with similar events in the future."
He continued: "According to the information obtained from the ghosts, the Underworld Emperor saw through the trap. He grabbed the island where the trap was created from the northern Berserk Sea and moved it to the south."
"And he gave the Tudor family members who created the trap a vicious curse. Those cursed members took the 'Tudor Dynasty Empire' and fled, disappearing in a huge storm."
Hobert spread his hands: "The treasure information of the 'Empire' may be true, and there is indeed such a large ship.
"But there is probably no treasure on it. It's just a giant ship cursed by the Underworld Emperor. The purpose of building this ship was not for the Tudor family members to escape, but a trap set for the Underworld Emperor."
Edwina was a little disappointed: "What a pity."
For her, who chased treasures, this result was indeed regrettable. After all, that was one of the six great treasures at sea.
If the truth of its existence had never been verified, then this treasure would have always existed for them, but now that they learned the truth from Hobert, this treasure disappeared from their "treasure hunting goals."
"I don't think so." Hobert smiled slightly: "The ship itself is a huge treasure, but it's hard to find it, and even if you find it, it's hard to utilize it."
Edwina smiled slightly: "You're right."
"Your erudition is impressive, and my conversation with you has been very rewarding," Hobert smiled slightly: "I hope to have the opportunity to continue discussing issues in the future."
Edwina also said: "Your adventure experience is enviable. I hope to have the opportunity to hear your adventure stories in the future."
"No problem." Hobert smiled slightly: "Then, everyone, I'll take my leave first. Remember to write to me when you have news of 'Vice Admiral Dusk.'"
The others couldn't wait for Hobert to leave and enthusiastically saw him off.
After Hobert walked away, a sailor said, "Captain, this guy is bragging, right? How could he have a 30,000-pound bounty! That's higher than your bounty."
"Iceberg Admiral's" pirate group had always been keen on finding various treasures at sea, so although Edwina's strength had reached the level of "Vice Admiral," her bounty was not high.
Edwina looked at the sailor: "If you wore such thick clothes in this weather, wouldn't you feel hot?"
"Yes! So, he's either a madman or a fool."
"How many times have I told you, don't judge a person so arbitrarily." Edwina criticized like a strict teacher: "You must observe carefully. The more bizarre a person's behavior seems, the more carefully you must observe.
"Didn't you notice that he didn't sweat a single drop?"
Orvus had noticed this a long time ago and knew what it meant, but at this time he still cooperated and said: "In other words, his bounty really is 30,000 pounds?"
Edwina: "Adding the mystical items on him, almost."
…
When he reached a deserted place, Hobert used "Traveling" to leave. After several transfers, Hobert returned to his study.
Sitting in the chair and taking a sip of tea, he sighed: I didn't expect that the island was where the "Tudor Dynasty Empire" was built.
I believe "Miss Iceberg" will give up searching for this treasure after learning the details of the "Empire."
He planned to go back to the ruins when he had time to see if he could find any clues about the "Empire."
For others, that cursed ship may be difficult to find, and even if found, it would be difficult to utilize.
And Hobert was a descendant of the Tudor Dynasty. As long as he found the "Empire," he would have the opportunity to explore it. Maybe the ship could accept the descendants of the Tudor Dynasty?
Hobert re-examined the entire clue of the "Empire" and made a similar judgment to before: This ship is in some corner of the Berserk Sea. The most likely place is where the spirit world and the real world intersect.
Occasionally, it can also return to the real world, so people have been witnessing this ship.
As for the specific situation of this ship now, Hobert estimated that it should be full of the smell of death, full of the atmosphere of withering.
The Underworld Emperor's curse should still be all over the ship. I wonder if the spirits of the Tudor family members are still on the ship?
It sounds scary, but if a way to utilize it is found, this must be a good "passive skill."
As for that nameless island, Hobert suddenly had some new ideas.
…
Saturday morning, central West Balam, the suburbs of Crowley City.
Dozens of elite family members secretly gathered together to listen to the task assignments made by the elders.
The Blake family's operation in Crowley City had not been in vain. So far, the "Rose School" still had not discovered the gathering of the Blake family's extraordinary powers.
Of course, it was also possible that the "Rose School" members in the city were just bait, and the "Rose School" was waiting for the Blake family to gather its forces and then eliminate them in one fell swoop.
In short, this battle was full of uncertainty.
Elliot was assigned to the ambush group, responsible for ambushing the enemy's reinforcements.
Just as everyone was dispersing, they all looked towards the position at the door, where a man wearing a black crystal mask, a Loen-style windbreaker, and a black crystal scepter on his waist appeared.
Many people immediately put on a fighting stance. If there weren't too many family members participating in this operation, it would be necessary to gather together to emphasize discipline and reaffirm the confidence to win.
Otherwise, they would never gather together on the eve of the raid, which would give the enemy the opportunity to destroy them all at once.
The demigod elder Chester, who was responsible for assigning tasks, asked, "Who are you looking for?"
He didn't feel any malice from the other party.
Hobert was prepared to meet Elliot's companions, but he didn't expect to come at such a good time, right when they were holding a general meeting.
He said coldly, "Elliot."
Chester winked at Elliot, signaling him to go over, and then signaled the others to leave quickly with his eyes.
Elliot stepped forward and said, "I don't seem to know you!"
Hobert's tone was no longer so cold: "The 'Creator' knows that there will be a fierce battle tomorrow, and asked me to bring you two things."
The people who were leaving suddenly stopped again and turned to look at Elliot and the "Windbreaker Man."
They had long heard the story between Elliot and the "Creator." Today was the first time outside the story that they had met other people related to the "Creator."
Chester immediately realized that the "Creator's" believers had a loose organization, which was the "Creator's" power in the real world.
Hearing Hobert say this, Elliot felt that the "Windbreaker Man" in front of him looked familiar. Judging from his figure, he looked a lot like the person who sold him the "Baron of Corruption" Beyonder characteristic: "Are you another believer of the 'Creator'?"
"I handle some mundane affairs for the great 'Creator.'" Hobert threw a black crystal mask to Elliot. On the forehead of the mask, there was a mystical symbol representing the "Creator."
He said: "This is the symbol of a believer. This mask has the ability to resist divination. Injecting spirituality can form a shield that lasts for one or two seconds, which can effectively block the attacks of Beyonder abilities! Most importantly, after wearing it, you will be less prone to losing control!"
The eyes of the people around him lit up. Even Chester was a little tempted. The Balk family members both hated and feared getting out of control!
Elliot thanked him excitedly: "Thank you…"
Hobert raised his hand: "Thank the great 'Creator'!"
He continued: "As long as you wear this mask, you will officially accept the identity of a believer. I will occasionally issue tasks to you. After completing them, I will give you some rewards, such as the main ingredients of the 'Mentor of Disorder' potion, or the main ingredients of other levels of that sequence."
Elliot bowed: "Praise the 'Creator.'"
Hobert gave him two more stones: "'Disorder Stones' can make enemies within thirty meters extremely prone to getting out of control. The activation incantation is 'Disorder.'
"Pay attention to recycling them after the battle. In the future, you can use the used 'Disorder Stones' to exchange for unused 'Disorder Stones' here. If there are any losses, report to me as soon as possible."
The eyes of the people around him became hot again. This was a good thing to deal with the 'Rose School'! Many members of the 'Indulgence Faction' were already emotionally unstable. A little stimulation might cause them to get out of control.
Even if they didn't completely get out of control, they would have to distract themselves to fight against getting out of control, greatly reducing their combat power.
Elliot praised the "Creator" again.
Hobert wrote the summoning method and reward for his messenger on a piece of paper in advance: "Write to me if you have any questions. You don't need to trouble the 'Creator' with such trivial matters as buying Beyonder characteristics."
"Yes." Elliot respectfully took the note.
Hobert waved his hand and turned to leave.
Chester immediately chased after him with a smile: "Envoy of God…"
"Call me 'God's Chosen'!"
"Oh, 'God's Chosen.'" Chester followed suit: "Does the great 'Creator' have any instructions for the Balk family?"
Hobert could hear that this was asking in a roundabout way: Didn't the "Creator" give the Balk family any mystical items?
He said: "Your patriarch only asked the 'Creator' to stop the 'Rose School's' angels and did not ask for other help."
The family members around him didn't know until now that the patriarch had asked for the "Creator's" help.
Chester opened his mouth, not knowing what to say for a moment, and could only watch Hobert leave.
He glanced at Elliot, who was wearing a mask for a while and playing with the "Disorder Stone" for a while, and could only sigh that his previous defensive psychology against the "Creator" was too strong, which led to the lack of certainty in this surprise attack.
If he had devoutly believed in the "Creator" earlier and prayed for this great being to send His followers to help, the probability of success in this battle would have increased a lot!
This idea was very beautiful, but Chester never imagined that even if the "Creator's" followers were all invited, the impact on the battle would not be very significant.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert returned to his study and changed back into the attire of a baron.
Then he used the "Faceless Necklace" to guide him and found Seel again.
At this time, the "Hippo" had already docked at the port of Bugas City, and Seel and others had just checked into the hotel. Albert was also in Seel's room. He was going to rest and take the afternoon train to Canter Town in the southern part of Feynapotter City.
Seeing the suddenly appearing Baron again, the two were a little surprised and a little excited.
Hobert said, "Tell your subordinates that you are going out for a while. I want to take you to the Berserk Sea."
The two were slightly stunned, not expecting to take a "long trip" suddenly!
After saying hello to his subordinates outside, Hobert supported the shoulders of the two and used "Travel" to return to the lord's mansion.
He then ordered: "You have two hours to gather some helpers, bring some food and water, and follow me to kill pirates."
If someone else said this, Seel and Albert would definitely think it was a joke, but when the Baron said it, they had no doubts.
About two hours later, Seel and Albert each gathered a dozen people and came to the Baron's yard to wait.
Fors was still away during the day today, otherwise she would have come out to ask.
Hobert carried three rolled-up flags and pushed the door open from the courtyard. Many people thought they were seeing things. It seemed that they saw a dense forest from the courtyard door.
Hobert glanced at the loose formation and sighed in his heart: We must train a modern armed force as soon as possible.
After the Baron appeared, everyone immediately quieted down and looked at their lord.
"What you experience today must be kept secret!" Hobert gave the flag to Seel: "I will cut off anyone's tongue who tells it!"
Everyone responded in unison: "Yes!" "Don't worry, Baron!" "We will definitely keep it secret!"
Hobert waved his hand: "Go, follow me to kill pirates. There is a reward of 5 gold Solas for killing one, and there is a chance to share the spoils! If you cooperate to kill a pirate, you can divide the 5 gold Solas together."
Everyone was stunned, and before they could ask, they saw the lord push open the courtyard door.
At this time, they saw clearly that there was indeed a dense forest in the Baron's yard.
Some people have already understood why the Baron wanted them to keep it secret. This is simply an encounter from a fairy tale. They just passed through a door and came to another place.
"Change clothes!" Hobert said as he took off his winter clothes, and finally put on his outermost coat: "Wear long sleeves and trousers, the mosquitoes here are fierce."
Everyone took off their thick clothes by the door.
"The pirates' camp is on the beach, follow me and rush in!" Hobert drew out his knife and led everyone to the beach.
The people behind picked up various weapons and followed closely behind.
In the camp on the beach, there was a skull flag without a head. At this time, there were not many people in the camp. Most of them had entered the forest to find extraordinary creatures.
The people in the camp noticed Hobert and others and immediately took out their guns to aim. At this time, the highest commander in the pirate camp was a boatswain. He shouted: "I will shoot if you move forward."
After seeing the real guns, everyone was a little daunted, but fortunately, the lord was there, so there was no rout.
Hobert said to Seel: "Plant the flag!"
Seel planted the flag with the moon and lion painted on it on the beach. Hobert said in a solemn tone: "In the name of Baron Hobert, appointed by King Ferdinand II, I declare sovereignty over this island. From this moment on, this island is part of Jeffery Territory.
The 'Skull' pirate group ignores the sovereignty of Jeffery Territory and brazenly establishes a camp here. Now, I, Baron Hobert, declare war on the 'Skull' pirate group! Charge!"
As he spoke, he used "Corrosion" on the pirates!
A dozen pirates were about to rely on the camp to shoot at the enemy when suddenly they had serious infighting and began to kill each other. Therefore, before everyone rushed into the camp, they had already collapsed on their own.
When Seel and others rushed into the camp, they probably recovered from the state of "Corrosion", but at this time their guns were of little use.
Under Hobert's instructions, Seel and Albert besieged the boatswain, and others, either two or three people, or three or four people, besieged an ordinary pirate.
However, some people were confused after rushing into the camp and didn't know what to do, just running around with weapons.
The battle lasted for two or three minutes and ended. Only two of Hobert's subordinates were injured, but none of the enemies escaped and were all killed.
Next was to collect the spoils and board the ship. More than 30 people took away everything they could.
When the people from the "Skull" pirate group came back, they saw: their home was gone!
The camp was in a mess, and even the tents, the fish that had just been caught in the morning, and the rum were all stolen by some unscrupulous person.
At this time, the "Jeffery Army", which had already sent a batch of spoils back, led by Hobert, rushed into another pirate group's camp.
As before, Hobert declared sovereignty: "...Now I, Baron Hobert, declare war on the 'Black Whale' pirate group! Charge!"
"You are mistaken! We are the 'Black Seagull' pirate group!"
Hobert: "Then declare war on the 'Black Seagull', charge!"

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 421 Baron Hobert's Promise of Protection (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The "Black Seagull" pirate group only had a Sequence 9 as their captain. After Hobert killed him, it was as good as wiping out the entire pirate group.
While cleaning up the battlefield, Hobert saw "Vice Admiral Iceberg" leading a few subordinates out of the forest.
Hobert was stunned. Why hadn't this woman left yet?
"Hobert Jeffrey!" From afar, Edwina, who had seen Hobert's "true face," said, "I wondered why that name seemed so familiar when I heard it. So you're the 'traitor'!"
When Hobert gave Edwina the method to summon his messenger yesterday, she inevitably learned his real name.
Fortunately, Hobert was prepared and only told her his last name, instead of directly using a fake name.
Hobert smiled and said, "This island is now part of the Jeffrey territory, but we are allies, so you can land on the island freely.
"I just thought of a good name. How about naming this place 'Dock Island'?"
Although the Baron doesn't legally have the power to expand territory, after declaring sovereignty over a nameless island and giving it a name, Hobert, according to colonist customs, now owns the island.
"Good name!" Edwina said, "Alright, you can continue playing your lord game. We should go now."
"Take care, take care, remember to write to me!"
After seeing off "Vice Admiral Iceberg," Hobert became even more fearless on this island. He led his men to kill the captains of three small pirate groups one after another. He also plundered the camps of the 'Skull' pirate group and the 'Black Whale' pirate group, killing the first mate of the "Black Whale" pirate group and the boatswain of the "Skull" pirate group.
Most of the members of these pirate groups had gone into the forest to search for extraordinary creatures. Otherwise, under Hobert's leadership, they would definitely have wiped out whoever they encountered.
It wasn't until dusk that everyone was too tired to walk. Hobert had Seel plant all the flags on the beach before completely withdrawing.
Hobert, who was walking at the end, simply dismantled the "Traveler's Door." Anyway, he knew how to build the magic array for the "Traveler's Door." He would just rebuild it when he brought people here next time.
Otherwise, it would be easily discovered. If there were pirates who knew how to use the "Traveler's Door," they might directly attack the Jeffrey territory tens of thousands of miles away.
The spoils of war had already filled the front yard of the lord's mansion. While everyone was carrying them back, Philip was making records.
Hobert took the record sheet and glanced at it. Most of them were daily necessities such as tents, lanterns, and tables and chairs. The valuables were worth about nine hundred pounds.
Pirates usually carry valuable belongings with them. This money was all searched from the bodies of the killed pirates.
The harvest of extraordinary materials was not small. A total of 15 Beyonder ingredients of 6 kinds were found. Hobert only recognized three of them.
One of them was the blood crystal of the Lavos Squid, which is one of the main materials for "Astrologers." Hobert planned to sell it to Fors.
At the same time, there were also a large number of spiritual materials. These were all Beyonder materials and spiritual materials that the pirates had just hunted Beyonder creatures and had not had time to sell. Now they were all cheap for Hobert.
There were four Beyonder characteristics, three at the Sequence 9 level, which were a "Sailor," a "Bard," and a "Prisoner" Beyonder characteristic.
One Sequence 8 level, "Pugilist" Beyonder characteristic.
Hobert gave the "Sailor" Beyonder characteristic to Seel, the "Bard" Beyonder characteristic to Albert, and each gave a Sequence 9 main ingreident, which was considered their spoils of war.
Then, according to the number of enemies killed, everyone was rewarded. Because the captured currency was all gold pounds, Hobert asked Philip to distribute the rewards in gold Lire.
The most received 23 gold Lire, and the least only completed two assists and received only 2 gold Lire.
However, Hobert allowed them to choose one to three more spoils from the yard. Most people chose practical and easy-to-carry lanterns.
So a large number of tents, daily necessities, meat, fish, and wine were left in the yard.
Hobert had the kitchen prepare a big meal of fish and meat, and everyone had a feast.
At the banquet, Hobert pointed to the young man next to Albert: "Is this your son?"
Albert quickly knelt down to Hobert with the young man next to him: "Yes, my lord. His name is Corwin, and he is my eldest son."
Hobert nodded: "He fought very bravely today. Let him be my guard tomorrow."
Albert said happily: "Thank you for your grace, my lord!"
Hobert waved his hand and said to one of Seel's subordinates, "What's your name?"
The subordinate immediately stood up and bowed: "My lord, my name is Jack."
Hobert "hmmed" and said, "You were also very brave today. Before Seel comes back, you are responsible for the security of the lord's mansion. After Seel comes back, you will be the deputy captain of the guard."
Jack also bowed like Albert: "Thank you for your grace, my lord!"
Hobert asked again: "Are you literate?"
"I went to school for a few years." Jack was a little embarrassed: "But I've almost forgotten everything now."
Everyone burst into laughter.
Hobert also smiled: "Follow the teachers in the territory to relearn grammar and arithmetic. If there are any errands in the future, I will dare to arrange them for you."
Jack bowed again: "Yes!"
Everyone looked envious. This was obviously a prelude to promotion. At this time, they regretted why they hadn't been more brave and desperate in the battle this afternoon?
The banquet ended. Everyone who had drunk some wine respectfully bid farewell to the lord after eating and drinking their fill, and then dragged their tired bodies away, talking and laughing, and even a little excited.
As residents or retainers of a remote area, if Hobert hadn't led them today, they might never have left the land under their feet in their lives, and they might never have had such a crazy act.
After everyone left, Hobert sent Seel and Albert back to Bugas City. They had their own tasks.
Back in his study, Hobert first saw two corpses lying on the floor of the study, the first mate of the "Black Whale" pirate group and the boatswain of the "Skull" pirate group.
These were specially sent by Seel after the battle.
After locking the door of the study, Hobert prayed to The Fool: "...Great Mr. Fool, please tell Mr. Hanged Man that I killed two pirates with bounties today. I hope to meet with him and ask him to help me collect the bounty."
Although asking Alger to collect the bounty would cost him some "handling fee," it would save a lot of trouble. The key is to get the bounty quickly.
A few minutes later, the majestic image of The Fool appeared in Hobert's mind, and then the picture turned into Alger's prayer screen.
He had just docked today and was now at the pier of a small island, indicating that he could meet with "Emperor" now.
So Hobert changed his clothes, put on his mask, grabbed the two corpses with both hands, and after one transit, used "Travel" to arrive at the meeting place.
It wasn't the first time the two had met, so there was no need to be so cautious and polite. Hobert threw the corpses on the ground and introduced straightforwardly: "One is the first mate of the 'Black Whale' pirate group, with a bounty of 900 pounds, and the other is the boatswain of the 'Skull' pirate group. I don't know how much the bounty is."
"300 pounds!" Alger replied, "The total bounty is 1200 pounds. I need to use some relationships and do some lobbying to get the bounty quickly.
"Plus my own remuneration, I will charge you 15%, which is 180 pounds."
"No problem, when can I get the bounty?"
"Next Monday."
Hobert stretched out his hand: "Happy cooperation."
Alger shook his hand: "Happy cooperation."
After Hobert left with "Travel," Alger looked at the place where he left and whispered: "He finally went to sea! But that's good, at least I have a helper at sea."
...
Sunday morning, Jeffrey Territory.
Hobert was still in his sleep when he heard Allen knocking on the door: "My lord! Signal flare!"
Hobert turned over and got out of bed, and only after yawning did he realize that Allen was talking about the distress signal of the "Nohar" .
Since bluffing the "Nohar" into the Taz River channel, Hobert had asked Allen to find a few people to take turns staring at the south, and immediately notify him after discovering the signal flare.
According to the speed of the cargo ship, the "Nohar" could reach Jeffrey Town today. He didn't expect to encounter danger so early in the morning.
Hobert estimated that the bandits on both sides of the river were still in a state of surprise the previous two days, and now they finally couldn't bear it and were going to rob a fortune.
After putting on his clothes, Hobert looked south and saw that the light emitted by the signal flare in the air had begun to weaken, but it was still visible.
Hobert looked at Corwin, who had come to work early: "You come to the study with me."
After arriving at the study, Hobert said, "Prepare for battle!"
With yesterday's experience, Corwin immediately realized that the lord was going to take him to solve the problem that appeared on the side of the flare: "My lord, I am ready."
Hobert supported his shoulders and took him through the spirit world to the shore not far from Full Moon Lake.
Two small boats were approaching the "Nohar" on the water, and two groups of people on the shore were chasing the cargo ship.
...
At this time, Dean, the captain of the "Nohar," was staring at the two small boats with sweat on his forehead. Even if he ignored the bandits on the small boats, just colliding would likely cause the "Nohar" to leak.
And on this long-abandoned waterway, it was impossible to find a dock that could repair large cargo ships.
Dean looked anxiously at the shore. What about the protection promised by Baron Hobert's special envoy? Could he have been deceived?
At this moment, Dean saw a boulder flying from the shore, hitting a small boat right on target.
Amidst the wailing of the bandits on the small boat, the small boat lost power and began to sink.
Dean quickly looked at the shore with a telescope, but he did not find any weapons such as catapults on the shore, only a young man in noble attire.
He saw him move his shoulders and easily lifted a stone weighing at least two hundred jins, and threw it into the river again.
Next to the young man stood a young man dressed as a noble warrior, who looked surprised, obviously shocked by the scene in front of him.
Another boulder flew and hit the other boat very accurately.
Dean sighed: "This is the first time I've seen such a strong man!"
He quickly continued to observe the direction of the young noble with the telescope. At this time, the noble and his guard had engaged in a battle with the thirty or forty bandits who had chased after them on the shore.
Dean once again sweated for them, the strength was too disparate.
But for some reason, the bandits suddenly had infighting. Taking advantage of this opportunity, the two easily defeated the bandits like tigers entering a flock of sheep.
The nobles and guards did not pursue, but shouted: "See clearly, the bow of this ship is flying the flag of Jeffrey Territory. Whoever dares to attack them will only have one ending: death!"
The voice was full of energy, and even the pursuers on the opposite bank heard it clearly, thus giving up the pursuit.
Dean finally breathed a sigh of relief and said to the surrounding crew: "Our previous choice was correct. Baron Hobert's envoy is a man of his word."
...
Corwin on the shore looked at Hobert with admiration. After the battle experience of the past two days, Corwin was already convinced of the lord's martial virtue.
At this time, Corwin saw the lord turn his head and say to him: "Later you go to the ship and tell the captain and crew that we are the reinforcements sent by Baron Hobert.
"And tell them that Full Moon Lake is ahead, and the east side of Full Moon Lake is Baron Hobert's territory, and they can dock for repairs.
"When you come back, just jump directly from the ship, and I'll catch you.
"Remember?"
Corwin nodded: "Remember, but..."
Before he could say "but," the lord grabbed his collar and threw him into the river like he had just thrown the stone.
Corwin's mind went blank, and he stood firmly on the deck of the "Nohar" with a look of horror.
Looking at the surprised expressions on the faces of the surrounding crew, Corwin also reacted after two or three seconds. He cleared his throat and said arrogantly: "We are the reinforcements sent by Baron Hobert..."
After repeating what Hobert had taught him, Captain Dean quickly came over to thank him.
Corwin waved his hand and said it was nothing. When he went back, he completely trusted the lord's arrangement. He took a step forward and jumped off the ship amidst the exclamations of the crew.
Corwin pinched his nose and was ready to fall into the water.
At this moment, a gust of wind blew across the river, and this gust of wind actually held Corwin up!
The disbelief on Corwin's face immediately turned into a hearty shout: "Yahoo!"
He felt like he could fly, spread his arms and laughed twice, flew close to the water and landed on the shore, standing firmly in front of the lord.
The crew on the "Nohar" had long been stunned.
Hobert on the shore asked with a smile: "How does it feel?"
"It's great, my lord. It's the first time I've felt that life can be so happy."
Hobert sighed: "It's good to be young!"
Although he looked only one or two years older than Corwin on the surface, the experience of "two lifetimes" made his mental age at least forty years old.
He remembered that when he first used the ability of "Flight," he only thought that this ability would increase his mobility.
But Corwin exclaimed, "So life can be this enjoyable!"

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - 422 Angel-level Combat Power: Hundred-eyed Demon Lord (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Back in the study, Hobert asked Corwin, "Have all your family moved to Jeffrey Town?"
"Yes, Lord."
Hobert nodded, "Go and get Conrad."
Soon after, Conrad arrived at the study.
Hobert instructed, "Take some people to the former territories of Knight Louis and Knight Duke to register the population, fields, and properties. Also, appoint village chiefs for them, or let them elect their own."
He paused and added, "The first cargo ship to be repaired at Jeffrey Port is about to arrive. Assign three people to set up a table and a few chairs in the room next to the hotel, and put up a sign that says 'Port Registration and Taxation Office'.
"This is a registration form, berthing fee standard, and tax standard that I got from another port. Use the form for reference, and collect taxes temporarily according to this standard.
"The staff in this office will be under your leadership for the time being. Issue receipts for the money collected and hand it over to Phillip."
Conrad recorded these requirements, said "I'll do it immediately," and hurried away.
Hobert then said to Corwin, "Take a few of your family's retainers to the port to maintain order, guide the 'Nohar' to dock, and let the crew know where to stay, eat, and pay taxes."
Corwin responded and trotted off with his men to the port.
As soon as he left, Phillip arrived at the study.
It turned out that after several days of surveying, they had come up with a preliminary plan, and the two of them had collaborated on a 'Jeffrey Territory Future Plan' to present to Hobert.
They were both masters of drawing, and their map was much more detailed than the simple map of the territory that Hobert had drawn.
This map basically met Hobert's requirements. Even the places that were not designed according to Hobert's requirements were due to Hobert's lack of geological knowledge when he made the requests.
The two of them had provided solutions for these places, allowing Hobert to choose.
On the map, the not-so-fertile hillsides were well utilized and would be filled with tall and spacious resort hotels in the future, and the railway also avoided the good fields as much as possible.
Valk suggested that Jeffrey Town should expand northward and towards the port, building squares, schools, hospitals, and other facilities in the north, and town governments, post offices, hotels, commercial streets, and so on in the direction of the port.
This plan was very scientific, and Hobert was very satisfied. He directly asked Phillip to give Scholar and Valk a total reward of 300 gold Lire.
At the same time, Hobert made a request, "Build a hotel on the hillside that ordinary people can afford, and also a hotel similar to a bachelor apartment, to provide for young people and travelers who like to travel."
He had already thought of the name for this hotel, it would be called "Youth Hostel".
Valk added and modified these two buildings on the spot, and the plan was finalized.
Then Hobert called Roy, who had just repaired the dock, "I discussed with Conrad before, and the total manpower that can be mobilized in the entire territory is about 1,500 people.
"Among them are 1,200 young adults aged 17 to 47, and 300 women responsible for logistics such as cooking.
"In the next week, all of this manpower must be mobilized and divided into three large construction sites, namely the construction and renovation of the town, the construction of the railway, and the construction of the resort area and hotels.
"These three construction sites must be carried out simultaneously. Communicate more with the two designers and the engineers they brought, and use manpower more scientifically."
Roy quickly said, "I have communicated with several engineers several times in the past few days, and I have gained a lot."
Hobert nodded in satisfaction, "I will purchase a large amount of medicine and hire several doctors. It is imperative to ensure that medical treatment is available immediately for illnesses and injuries. If there are too serious injuries, come to me immediately, I am also proficient in medicine."
Everyone in the room was a little strange, not knowing what the lord meant.
Hobert was stunned when he saw everyone's expressions, and then he realized that there were always deaths in construction in this era. In their view, since those workers had accepted the job and arrived at the construction site, they had to be ready to fight death at any time.
Especially when building railways, because there was no flexible large-scale equipment, all materials were transported manually, and the places where the railways passed were generally far from the city. Railway workers who were injured did not have time to be sent for medical treatment, and the mortality rate was particularly high.
Hobert simply made it clear, "Doctors will follow the construction site, and we will strive to not have a single death!
"In addition, workers must be given sufficient remuneration, just like the previous renovation of the lord's mansion and the repair of the dock. Although it is semi-mandatory to call them to work on the construction site, don't treat them unfairly!"
Phillip reminded, "If this is the case, our expenses will be very large."
After reserving the money for buying ships and hiring crew members, Jeffrey Territory had less than 3,000 gold Lire in its account.
The lord rewarded 326 gold Lire to those who had made meritorious service in killing the enemy yesterday, and another 300 gold Lire were rewarded today, so Phillip only had about 2,300 gold Lire left.
This amount of money, let alone starting three construction sites at the same time, cannot even support the workers' wages for long.
"I'll figure out a way to get the money," Hobert said, "Just start construction!"
He estimated that the money from selling the spiritual materials from the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast would be credited soon. Whether it was credited or not, he planned to exchange the gold in his hand for gold Lire.
In that case, even if the territory was fully operational, it could cope for a while.
If it really didn't work, he planned to go to sea again to hunt some pirates. Those guys were all walking gold pounds.
In addition, Hobert had so many Beyonder characteristics in his hand, and he could also sell a batch to deal with emergencies. He was far from being in dire straits.
Then Roy said, "Lord, with our current level of freight, the building materials on the construction site will definitely not be able to keep up."
Hobert pondered for a while, "Go and discuss with the engineers and make a list of the required building materials and the approximate amount, and I will find a way."
Roy: "Yes."
This simple construction meeting lasted until more than ten o'clock in the morning. Hobert successively called Conrad and others to express his determination to mobilize the entire territory for large-scale construction, and roughly assigned tasks for the next period of time.
When the meeting ended, everyone heard the clamor from Full Moon Lake.
Several people came out of the study together and looked into the courtyard. It turned out that the "Nohar" had docked, and almost half of the town's residents had come to the dock to watch the excitement.
Most of them were seeing such a large cargo ship for the first time.
Hobert smiled and said, "See, the new era of Jeffrey Territory has begun. As the future builders and rulers of this territory, you must prepare in advance."
Phillip and Conrad, who already had some political literacy, immediately understood that this was the lord's political promise.
Although the others did not fully understand, they also became excited after seeing the scene in front of them.
After Phillip and others left, Hobert heard the prayers from the "Nation of Disorder".
He thought that the battle in the Southern Continent had begun. He entered the "Nation of Disorder" and saw that Lawrence was reporting to him that they were ready for battle and praying for further assistance from the "Creator".
Hobert thought: You only burn incense when you need it, that's you.
But he knew that this was a battle related to the survival of the Burke family, so he asked Lawrence to build an altar and rewarded him with two "Order Wood".
...
Southern Continent, Crowlier City.
Lawrence's mind heard the voice of the "Creator": "The activation spell is: Order!"
Lawrence lowered his head and saw the two pieces of wood that appeared on the altar: "Praise the Creator!"
Of course, he could feel the surging "Power of Order" contained in these two seemingly ordinary pieces of wood.
At the same time, Lawrence had a further understanding of the strength of the "Creator". Seemingly such a casual thing, it was a very high-level magical item.
This proved that the "Creator's" power had reached the point of being able to do whatever he wanted. At least he had the relevant authority to give such a high level of power to an ordinary branch.
Leaving the room of the altar, Lawrence handed one of the "Order Wood" to Chester, who was waiting outside: "I can feel that this is a magical item that is of great help to our Pathway. Use it at a critical moment."
Chester nodded, somewhat worried, "But even so, the enemy is still much stronger than us..."
Lawrence raised his hand: "When we decided to cooperate with the Feysac people, we were already preparing for this day. If the family wants to have new development, it must leave 'No Town' and come into contact with new things.
"If we win this battle today, the family will have unlimited prospects. If we lose, we can just return to 'Nonexistent Town' to recuperate for twenty or thirty years."
He smiled and said, "Besides, we didn't have faith before, but now we do.
"Go and believe in the 'Creator', He is the key to our victory."
After speaking, Lawrence left quickly. The battle was about to begin, and he was going to the outside of the city to prepare to ambush the opponent's demigod.
But as soon as he left the city, he saw a middle-aged man on the side of the road wearing a black clergy robe, with brownish skin and sunken eyes like a dried corpse.
Although there were constant carriages and pedestrians coming and going on the road, Lawrence still saw this person at a glance!
Lawrence stopped: "Zatwin!"
This was a Sequence 3 "Disciple of Science" of the "Rose School".
"Lawrence!" Zatwin's tone was a little awkward, as if his throat didn't know how to pronounce because he hadn't spoken for a long time: "I bring endless despair and the most vicious curse to the Balk family!"
He said coldly: "We have long discovered through sealed items that you are constantly gathering manpower in Crowlier City. The reason why we didn't actively attack you is because we are waiting for you.
"This time we will eliminate all of you! From the patriarch to every member of the Balk family!"
As he spoke, two more people appeared behind Lawrence and on one side respectively.
They were Mahmosi, whose lips were sealed with metal nails with mysterious patterns, and Jacks, whose skin was dark brown, his face was full of wrinkles, and his white hair was sparse.
These two were also "Disciples of Silence", and Mahmosi was also a student of the "Son of God" Suah.
Lawrence felt that every pedestrian on the road, every carriage, every leaf on the side of the road, every blade of grass, and even every stone on the ground, every grain of sand, was full of malice towards him.
He smiled slightly, took out a red crown from the cloth bag on his waist, which seemed to be stained with blood, and slowly put it on his head: "Fortunately, we have also made some preparations!"
Mahmosi' sealed lips suddenly opened. Almost at the same time, Jacks also opened his mouth, and the two of them issued a silent curse towards Lawrence.
But Lawrence's figure suddenly disappeared, replaced by a towering tree. He "distorted" the position and concept between himself and this big tree.
So the curse target of the two "Disciples of Silence" changed from Lawrence to this big tree.
The two "Disciples of Silence"' silent "curses" caused the big tree to split from the middle, and three branches grew out. One of the fleshy branches was covered with eyes without eyelids, and each eye was full of malice.
On a green branch, there grew garlic, peppers, half a hen, a human hand, and other messy things.
As for a black branch, it was covered with black long hair, and the hair fluttered in the wind, as if it had life.
"Ah ~"
Screams continued on the road. All creatures within 20 meters of the big tree, such as pedestrians and horses, became grotesque monsters or were covered with lumps because of these two powerful curses.
Further away, most of the ordinary people who saw this cursed big tree went crazy, and those who did not go crazy were also severely impacted mentally.
Lawrence immediately said after dodging: "Cursing is prohibited here!"
The crown on his head was a sealed item from a "Balancer", a legacy of the Trunsoest family, which allowed Lawrence to briefly possess the position and ability of a "Balancer".
But it can only be used for five minutes. After five minutes, the holder will either gradually be "ordered", and the Beyonder characteristics in his body will still be there, but he will no longer be able to use Beyonder abilities. Or the holder will fall into fantasy, fantasizing that he is a certain king, and live in his fantasy world, and his mental body will never be able to return to the real world.
Mahmosi and others were surprised to find that this "prohibition" was very high, and they had no way to violate this "law".
Zatwin, who had not issued a "curse" just now, immediately became illusory after discovering Lawrence's conceptual change with the big tree.
But when he approached Lawrence, he found that he could not enter Lawrence's body and could not complete the possession.
This was Lawrence's other sealed item in action, which could effectively prevent possession by evil spirits and resentful souls.
This was the heritage of the Trunsoest family. More than a thousand years after the fall of the Night Emperor, Lawrence, as the patriarch, could still arm himself with a Grade 0 and a Grade 1 sealed artifact.
Moreover, these two sealed items were equivalent to disintegrating the "Disciple of Silence's" best "curse" and "possession" from the beginning.
The other two Burke family's demigod elders also carried a Level 1 sealed item each. This was Lawrence's greatest confidence in daring to launch this battle.
Mahmosi opened his mouth again, emitting a shriek that seemed to pierce the eardrums. This was not a curse, but a pure attack on the spirit body.
Zatwin, closest to Lawrence, held a spear made of ice and thrust it at Lawrence.
Jax rushed towards the rear of Lawrence at an extremely fast speed, preparing to completely surround Lawrence.
Lawrence ignored the attack on his spirit body and the ice spear close at hand, and once again issued a decree: "The battle here must be fair and just."
Reaching the level of the divine "Balancer" not only allows one to "prohibit," but also to issue "decrees" that are beneficial to oneself!
Zatwin's ice spear pierced Lawrence's chest, and the shriek attack followed, causing great damage to Lawrence's spirit body.
However, when the three people launched another attack, as long as Zatwin attacked, Mahmosi and Jax had no desire to attack. As long as Mahmosi attacked, the other two had no desire to attack.
Truly achieving fairness and justice!
What? Lawrence is still wearing a Level 0 Sealed Artifact on his head? He is now an "Enforcer"! He is the "judge" of whether this battle is fair and just, and is not restricted by the "decree."
At this time, Lawrence dodged Zatwin's attack while saying, "Distort!"
He distorted the concept of himself and Zatwin, transferring most of the damage he received to Zatwin.
Zatwin felt the severe damage he had received. He held his chest with one hand and took out a small straw doll that he had prepared in advance, transferring most of the damage that Lawrence had transferred to him onto the straw doll.
Several hundred meters away, a fleeing pedestrian was suddenly frozen by a layer of ice. The plants and trees around him immediately withered, and at the same time, his spirit body was also dissipated.
Although these damages had been transferred nearly twice, and both times were "most" of the damage, it was still fatal for ordinary people, even "Low-Sequence" Beyonders and most "Mid-Sequence" Beyonders.
Seeing that he could not solve Lawrence for a while, Mahmosi winked at Zatwin and Jax, telling them to entangle Lawrence.
His expression became solemn, and he took out a jar of scarlet blood, preparing to pray to the angels of the "Rose School."
"It's best not to do this." A leisurely voice came from the city wall: "The Feysac Empire will definitely retaliate for the damage you caused to Crowlier City today."
The speaker was Jonas, the demigod "Iron-Blooded Knight" sent by the Feysac Empire.
The metal nails on Mahmosi's lips opened again, and he asked in somewhat broken Feysac language: "Is the Feysac Empire preparing to help the Balk family?"
Jonas spread his hands: "If you fight in the forest where there are no people over there, I have no objection."
Of course, the Feysac Empire would not participate in this conflict. Even if the Balk family was a partner, they were unwilling to provide too obvious assistance.
The battlefield suddenly became heavy. Although Mahmosi and the others did not want to have high-level conflicts with the Feysac Empire, was Lawrence willing to leave here?
At this time, riots broke out in Crowlier City. The battle that was supposed to happen in the afternoon started early, and the "Rose School" was ambushing members of the Balk family everywhere.
Although this was completely contrary to the Balk family's plan, they also had contingency plans, and immediately concentrated their forces and fled outside the city.
The main force of the Balk family was ambushing there at this moment.
As more than a dozen members of the Balk family left the city, Lawrence put away the crown on his head and used the method of "distorting" distance to leave here and go to the predetermined battlefield.
Mahmosi sealed his lips again, and followed closely with Jax and Zawent.
Arriving at the predetermined battlefield, Lawrence put his hands under his jaw and prayed with the most pious attitude in his life.
Jax and Zawent stared closely at Lawrence, without launching a new attack, while Mahmosi knelt on one knee and also began the summoning ritual.
The two sides did their own things, as if they had become harmonious for a while.
Mahmosi sprinkled half a jar of scarlet blood on the ground: "I, in the name of my teacher Suah, summon:
""The King of Curses;
"The most evil monster in history;
"The spreader of resentment and despair;
"The embodiment of endless madness.""
The scarlet blood on the ground suddenly projected a clear light. The angel of the "Rose School" thousands of miles away felt Mahmosi's summoning in the name of the leader.
It immediately entered the Spirit World and easily found the location of the scarlet blood.
The light became brighter and brighter, outlining a shadow full of evil and madness.
This was a summoning by a "Disciple of Silence," so the ritual was very simple. If it was a "Low-Sequence" Beyonder performing the summoning, in addition to obtaining the consent of the summoned person in advance, a very complex ritual was also required.
Smiles appeared on the faces of Mahmosi and the other two, and they looked at Lawrence together, but to their surprise, a surging power also descended around Lawrence.
At the same time as the angel of the "Rose School" appeared, a huge eyeball appeared in front of Lawrence. There were small eyes on the white of this eyeball.
This eyeball clearly exuded an aura of mutation, but it was surrounded by a holy light intertwined with clarity and darkness.
Mutation and normality, evil and holiness!
Mahmosi and the others were a little surprised. The other party had also summoned an angel-level monster? A saint?
In short, as soon as the eyeball appeared, they felt an unprecedented surging distortion power. The eyeball seemed to have the authority related to "distortion," and it itself was in an extremely "distorted" state.
This was the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" that Hobert "created" by injecting the power of the "Nation of Disorder" into the black eyeball with the meaning of the avatar of the "Knowledge Moor" obtained from Old Neil's ritual.
It has the position of an angel and can last for seven minutes, but because it has a certain divinity, it is not controlled by Hobert.
As soon as the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" appeared, it immediately "reproduced" two extremely distorted and powerful figures in mid-air. The two figures were tearing at each other and fighting each other.
Mahmosi and the other two immediately felt a huge impact, and their spirit bodies and bodies had suffered irreversible damage and mutation.
Fortunately, Barranca, the angel of the "Rose School," stood in front of them in time: "Leave here!"
Then Barranca opened his mouth slightly. Although he didn't say anything, it seemed to emit the most vicious curse in the world. The "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" was hit by the curse and turned into an ordinary glass ball, and the phantom in mid-air gradually disappeared.
In the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne," twitched the corner of his mouth. He didn't expect the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" to "reproduce" the battle between "God Almighty" and "Celestial Worthy" as soon as he came up!
It is estimated that the angel of the "Rose School" has also suffered a lot of damage because of this.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - 423: The Battle of Angels Becomes a Battle of Shaking People (Bonus 7)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert had already protected Lawrence on the battlefield with the "Power of Order", otherwise this guy would definitely have been hurt by the phantoms in the air.
Lawrence felt the protection of the "Creator", praised the "Creator", and left immediately without even daring to look at the battlefield.
After leaving for a distance, Lawrence breathed a sigh of relief. That was the power of an angel. Although he was a Sequence 3, and it seemed that he was only one level lower than Sequence 2, Lawrence clearly felt the difference in level.
Just as he breathed a sigh of relief, he ran into Mahmosi and the other three. The four of them exchanged glances.
Mahmosi almost didn't even think about it, and poured the other half of the scarlet blood on the ground: "I, in the name of my teacher Suah, summon:
"The embodiment of evil;
"The follower of the Chained God;
"The lingering malice;
"The master of the source of curses."
At the same time as Mahmosi began a new summoning, Lawrence was a little stunned, but he also immediately prayed to the "Creator" again with a worried mood.
The reason for his apprehension was that Lawrence was afraid that there was only that one angel serving the "Creator", and he would not be able to send out new power to fight against the other party's angel.
… …
In the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert was watching the battle between the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" and Barranca, the angel of the "Rose School".
The "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord", who had turned into a glass ball, suddenly transformed into streams of virtualized knowledge. The forms of this knowledge included rolling numbers and words, as well as obscure and difficult-to-understand symbols, and books emitting a bright glow, etc.
If it were an ordinary person, just one glance would cause their brain to explode from the knowledge gained.
Streams of virtualized knowledge re-integrated, once again forming the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" in the shape of a giant eyeball. In this way, He cracked Barranca's "Deformation Curse".
Then two more illusory figures appeared on the battlefield. These two figures were much clearer. One emitted a scorching light, and the other stood on the waves, wearing lightning.
This was the battle scene when the ancient sun god "reclaimed" his authority.
The two figures who were originally fighting looked at Barranca together. The sky seemed to split in the middle, one side was scorching hot, as if to boil all the water on the earth, and the other side was covered with dark clouds and thunder.
Barranca felt that his body was also divided by the scorching sun and the thunder. The left side of his body was hot and sweaty, and the right side of his body was a little numb from the thunder.
You know, as an angel, he had forgotten the feeling of sweating, and ordinary lightning had no effect on him at all.
The appearance of such a reaction was enough to show the high level of this "reappearance".
Barranca's body immediately became illusory and disappeared. Then, Barranca 's figure was reflected on the huge pupils of the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord".
The "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" and Barranca shared the damage of the "Mystical Reenactment".
"Mystical Reenactment" is one of the most core abilities of the high-level "Mystery Pryer" pathway. The forms are diverse and the functions are diverse.
After being possessed, the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" once again showed a scene, which was the image of a giant bird. She stood on a black pillar, her body covered with pale flames and feathers composed of mysterious patterns, as if everything around her would wither and lose its vitality. Her eyes seemed to be cast in bronze, and inside were hidden layers of illusory doors.
This is the ancestor of the phoenix, Gregrace. She raised her head as if making a silent cry. This cry made Barranca's figure in the pupils of the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" stagnate, and suffered severe damage from the spirit body.
However, the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" does not have a solidified spirit body. All the reactions He makes are more like the reactions made by Beyonder power and position. In Hobert's opinion, He is more like a high-level artificial intelligence.
No emotions, no thoughts, just carrying out the attack that He considers the "optimal solution".
The reason why Hobert was staring at this battle was because he was afraid that the angel of the "Rose School" would abandon the opponent, the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord". At that time, if the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" stupidly didn't know to pursue the opponent, there would be no way to stop the opponent's angel.
If this happened, Hobert would immediately "prohibit changing opponents"!
What he didn't expect was that the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" had obvious advantages, and Barranca didn't dare to run away at all. Once he ran away, he might be completely in danger, so he could only bite the bullet and fight the opponent.
Then Hobert understood that the black eyeball symbolized the "Knowledge Moor", and the power source of the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" was the "Nation of Disorder".
The products of two Sephirot, although only with the position of an angel, can also suppress ordinary angels by half a head.
In fact, Barranca was also a little confused at this time. Wasn't he supposed to come and harvest the demigods and saints of the Balk family? How could there be such a powerful and strangely state opponent?
Just as Hobert was engrossed in watching this high-level fight, he heard the sound of prayer in his ear again.
He glanced at the pool, it was Lawrence again?
Hobert spread his spirituality to the star representing Lawrence: This old brother with nails on his mouth is going to summon an angel again? Hehe, fortunately, the "Creator" also has some "inventory".
… …
On the walls of Crowlier, Jonas felt the arrival of the angel and saw the "Mystical Reenactment" of the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" three times in succession.
Even from such a distance, Jonas felt his spirit body being impacted.
He murmured to himself: "The Balk family can indeed get the help of an angel…"
He still remembered that the last time the Balk family ambushed the "Rose School", an angel had once taken action to help them.
Just as he thought of this, Jonas suddenly felt something and looked to the other side: "Two angels?!"
… …
The scarlet blood that Mahmosi splashed out once again projected a bright glow. As the glow became brighter and brighter, it outlined a shadow full of evil and malice.
In front of Lawrence, there also appeared a huge sphere, half of which was pink flesh, and half of which was a transparent film like a soap bubble.
Inside the film was filled with light yellow liquid, and a jet-black baby was curled up in the center of the light yellow liquid.
He looked like a pregnant uterus, with an umbilical cord connecting the baby and the flesh.
This was the "Holy Infant King" created by Hobert using the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring" obtained in Tingen City.
He exuded the aura of order and depravity, and also had the level of an angel, which could last for eight minutes.
The surprise of Mahmosi and the other three was beyond words. Why didn't they know that the Balk family had such strong strength before? They could even summon two angels to help them?
Fortunately, on Mahmosi's side, a figure of an old man holding a cane also appeared in the scarlet blood. Although he was old and decrepit, his eyes were full of malice, and he exuded an evil aura.
The "Holy Infant King", who appeared one step ahead, suddenly opened his eyes. His eyeballs were also completely black. Suddenly, the surroundings were filled with the power of depravity.
On the surrounding plants and animals, a layer of thick, pitch-black mucus appeared. Under the action of this layer of mucus, life quickly degenerated into malice, and plants and animals died on a large scale.
Mahmosi and the other three uncontrollably scratched themselves. They felt that their bodies had degenerated, and their "bodies" wanted to grab their souls out so that they would no longer be controlled by the spirit body, so that the "bodies" could jump into the abyss of depravity.
The three of them felt that their spirit bodies were also beginning to degenerate, as if a new personality was about to appear, a personality that hoped to enter the abyss of depravity with the "body".
The old man summoned by Mahmosi, this angel named Claester, slammed his cane made of long bones on the ground.
The head of the cane was a small skull, and a pale light suddenly lit up in the eye sockets of the skull. This light was like a ripple that kept expanding, and the pale halo neutralized the surrounding power of depravity.
Claester said to Mahmosi and others in a hoarse voice: "Leave here!"
The "Holy Infant King" opened his mouth slightly. Although there was light yellow liquid and a film, everyone present still clearly heard his tender and crisp voice: "Leave!"
Mahmosi and the other three immediately felt that their connection with the real world was being broken little by little. They were also crying without tears: The angel asked us to leave "here", not to leave the world!
Claester waved his hand at the three of them, re-establishing the connection between the three of them and the spirit world. Although their condition was still a bit strange, they were finally "not leaving this world".
The three people who fled in a hurry encountered Lawrence not far away.
Lawrence was about to put on the crown again and fight the opponent to the death. The crown could still be used for three and a half minutes.
At this moment, they all looked at the sky, where an evil and terrifying force appeared.
Mahmosi was very familiar with this power: "Teacher!"
Then he felt that he was locked by his teacher, knowing that this was his teacher using himself as a coordinate to descend power.
He smiled a little excitedly and a little crazily, Suah was about to descend on this land!
People of the world, tremble! Prepare to welcome your pathetic fate!
An arm flowing with strange liquid appeared in the air. Pale skull heads grew out of these liquids, eyeballs with obvious blood vessels grew out, tongues with sharp teeth grew out, and all kinds of strange things grew out, making the feeling of extreme evil and extreme madness spread rapidly around.
Not only Lawrence and others looked at the sky, but the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" and Barranca who were fighting also looked at the sky. The evenly matched "Holy Infant King" and Claester looked at the sky.
On another battlefield, the demigods and "Mid-Sequence" individuals of both sides looked towards the sky.
On the walls of Crowlier City, Jonas and Anthony looked towards the sky together.
Jonas smiled wryly, "The situation is beyond control."
If the leader of the "Rose School of Thought" descends, then this battle will not be something that the Balk family and the senior members of the "Rose School of Thought" can control.
The deterrent of the Feysac Empire will also cease to have any effect, and they can only watch helplessly as this place turns into a domain filled with strange creatures.
Just then, another huge, solid figure appeared in the sky. He seemed to be sitting on a throne made of sharp swords, his whole body radiating a holy light that seemed to end all chaos, yet also seemed to bring complete disorder.
He exuded an aura of majesty, causing people to involuntarily lower their heads, unconsciously wanting to submit.
Jonas, who had been fortunate enough to witness a "God's Descent" before, knelt down on one knee involuntarily, his eyes solemn: "Who is this?"
On the "Saint's Battlefield" side, Lawrence smiled and said, "The Creator! Praise the Creator!"
Mahmosi: "The Creator?"
On the "Angel Battlefield" not far away, Claester: "The Black Emperor?"
Barranca: "The Justiciar?"
On the "Mid-Sequence Battlefield", the people of the "Rose School of Thought" were dumbfounded, while the members of the Balk family shouted, "The Creator! Praise the Creator!"
The "Creator" in the sky emitted an incomparably solemn voice: "Divine Descent is forbidden here!"
At the same time, he used the "Power of Order" to sever the connection between Suah and Mahmosi, causing Suah to lose His target.
The arm flowing with eerie liquid gradually faded and eventually disappeared into the sky.
Claester and Barranca couldn't help but frown.
Lawrence smiled knowingly: "Praise the Creator!"
Mahmosi and the other two were shocked, the "Leader's" descent was "forbidden"!
Lawrence stuck the "Order Wood" into the ground: "Order!"
The canopy of the "Order Wood" covered an area of several hundred meters. Just as Mahmosi and the other two regained their senses, Lawrence had already put on the red crown again: "Curses are forbidden here!"
After saying that, he charged towards Jacks, who was closest to him: "Amplify!"
Jax was shocked. His current state was not good, and the power of Lawrence's charge, after being "amplified", became extremely terrifying!
Mahmosi and Zatwen came together to help him resist Lawrence's impact.
"Arrogant!" Lawrence, having gained the upper hand, launched a series of attacks. He was surprised to find that his extraordinary power, under the blessing of the "Order Wood", had become exceptionally strong, even approaching the level of an angel!
Mahmosi and the other two had just been affected by the enemy's two angels, and their current state was not good.
Lawrence became more and more courageous in battle, actually holding back the three Saints on the other side with his own strength, and even possessing a slight advantage.
...
Jonas on the city wall: "I have to send a telegram to Saint Millon (the capital of the Feysac Empire) immediately! A god has appeared in the Southern Continent, a god!"
No, I should just pray directly to the great "Conqueror" Emperor Peter!
General Anthony on the side stared blankly at everything. Only today did he realize what the top combat power of this extraordinary world was.
At the same time, the majestic figure in the sky left an extremely deep impression on him!
After Jonas left, he suddenly knelt on one knee on the ground. If he could have such a powerful backer, who would want to be a dog for the Feysac people?
...
On the "Mid-Sequence Battlefield", the projections of Suah and the "Creator" disappeared one after another. The members of the "Rose School of Thought" were slightly dazed, but then they launched a fierce attack on the members of the Balk family.
On the "Mid-Sequence Battlefield", Elliot initially used the "Disorder Stone", causing several members to lose control on the spot, and plunging a large number of members of the "Rose School of Thought" into a state of near loss of control.
The Balk family took the opportunity to launch a surprise attack, and at one point gained a considerable advantage.
However, the strength of the two sides was too disparate. This time, the "Rose School of Thought" not only dispatched three Saints, but also dispatched seven demigods, in order to completely cripple the Balk family! Even completely eliminate them!
The two demigod elders of the Balk family both carried Grade 1 sealed items, and Chester also had a "Order Wood", but even so.
The two demigod elders could only hold back four demigods from the other side. The "Rose School of Thought" still had the "surplus" of three demigod elders. Under the suppression of levels, the three demigods caused very terrifying casualties to the Balk family.
Even if Elliot used the "Disorder Stone" again under the cover of his clansmen soon after, it did not change the battle situation.
Elliot, who was knocked away by a Sequence 5 of the opponent, wanted to stand up, but his brain was like it was lacking oxygen, and he was weak all over, unable to stand up no matter what.
In his heavy breathing, everything in front of him was like a dream.
But after seeing one companion after another fall, Elliot's eyes filled with tears. He prayed with unwillingness: "...Great 'Creator', the Balk family has suffered too much hardship over the years, please be our patron saint and let us be freed from those hardships! Please protect my companions, please help us defeat the enemies in front of us!"
As he spoke, Elliot cried bitterly, while also waiting expectantly for the "Creator's" response.
After about one or two seconds, suddenly a milky white light enveloped Elliot.
Only then did Elliot realize that the reason he couldn't stand up just now was because he had suffered a very serious head injury, and now the wound was healing quickly.
At this time, a Sequence 5 "Wraith" discovered Elliot kneeling on the ground, crying bitterly, as if he had completely lost his will to fight.
The "Wraith" revealed an evil smile. His nails quickly lengthened, preparing to rush over and shovel off Elliot's head!
Elliot also sensed the malice of the "Wraith". Just as he was preparing to dodge, a tall and mighty black figure appeared in front of him. It had a black bull's head, but it had two golden deer antlers.
This was the "Bull Demon King" controlled by Hobert. Hobert's order to it was: to withstand the attacks of the demigods on the battlefield and eliminate as many "prisoner" pathway Beyonders on the battlefield as possible.
The "Bull Demon King" stretched out a hand and happened to insert it into the chest of the "Wraith", then he grabbed the "Wraith's" shoulder with his other hand and pulled out his heart, liver, spleen, lungs, and long intestines.
The "Bull Demon King" threw down the "Wraith", which was only left with an empty cavity, and rushed towards a "Rose School of Thought" demigod.
The "Wraith's" vitality was very tenacious. In a state where his internal organs had been hollowed out, he fell to the ground and still hadn't died immediately. He really couldn't understand what kind of opponent he had encountered?
As the "Wraith" was dying, he saw the Balk family member who had just been crying bitterly. At this time, his eyes were full of determination, and he mercilessly sent his knife into the head of the "Wraith", who no longer had the protection of the "Steel Skin" ability.
Elliot shook off the blood and brain matter on the knife: "That is the helper sent to us by the 'Creator'! With the help of the 'Creator', we will definitely be able to win this battle!"
The morale of the Balk family members finally recovered somewhat. Under the organization of several Sequence 5s and with the help of sealed items, they began to resist the attacks of the opponent's demigods.
The "Bull Demon King" first rushed to the canopy of the "Order Wood". Here, Elder Chester, with the help of the "Order Wood" and a sealed item on his body, was fighting two "Rose School of Thought" demigods alone.
But that was all. It was basically impossible to defeat his opponents.
The "Bull Demon King" rushed into it: "Distort!"
It "distorted" a "Rose School of Thought" demigod with the concept of a stone under its feet, and then it shattered the stone with one foot. This kick was like hitting the demigod, causing him to suffer huge damage.
The demigod's figure immediately became illusory, minimizing the physical damage.
Then he took this opportunity to possess the "Bull Demon King".
Who knew that the "Bull Demon King" would say loudly: "Order!"
He actually directly locked this "Rose School of Thought" demigod in his own body!
The "Bull Demon King" was an entity composed of solid power. It had no spiritual body at all, nor did it have the concept of a physical body. The "Wraith Possession" ability of the "Rose School of Thought" demigod had no effect on it at all. Instead, he had drilled into the cage composed of the "Power of Order" himself.
Now, under the canopy, it had become a two-on-one.
Chester seized the opportunity and used: "Arrogance!"
Another "Rose School of Thought" demigod immediately entered a state of "arrogance". The "Bull Demon King" seized the opportunity and slapped his head off.
This allowed the "Rose School of Thought" demigod to recover from the state of "arrogance". His cavity was bleeding, and he bent down to pick up his head and ran.
Chester took a step forward and stabbed out with the crimson sword in his hand. After being stabbed, the "Rose School of Thought" demigod immediately fell to the ground and was covered by orange-red flames.
This sword came from a sealed item formed by a Sequence 3 "War Bishop" of the "Hunter" pathway who died tragically on the battlefield of the "War of the Four Emperors".
This level of "Cull" was enough to completely kill this seriously injured Sequence 4 "Puppet".
After the "Bull Demon King" joined the battle under the canopy, two demigods from the "Rose School of Thought" rushed over to support, but they were still one step too late.
Thus, a new battle began, with "Bull Demon King" and Chester facing off against two demigods from the "Rose School." These two demigods immediately realized they were outmatched, so the last demigod from the "Rose School" joined the fray.
With all of the enemy's demigod-level combat power tied down, the effects of Elliot's two "Disorder Stones" from earlier immediately became apparent.
Although the "Rose School's" demigods were not greatly affected, many Sequence 5, Sequence 6, and Sequence 7 members found themselves in dire straits.
Without the demigods to help them charge forward, their decline was immediately exposed, and the Balk family regained control of the battlefield.
…
In the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert, seeing that the battle situation had turned around, turned his attention to the "Angel Battlefield."
At this moment, Hobert heard Lawrence's plea again. On the "Saint Battlefield," Lawrence was once again in a precarious situation, praying for the "Creator's" help.
Hobert smiled helplessly, not expecting that this battle would evolve into a "battle of calling for reinforcements."
He moved the black dog spirit beast from another room in front of him: "The 'Creator' has done his best! If you want to call for more reinforcements, I can only throw the corpse of the Ancient Death into the battlefield!"
However, in that case, the most likely outcome would be that General Anton's territory would completely disappear from the map for a very long time.
