chapters.title: Chapter 424 - 424: The Family that Pledges Allegiance to the "Creator"
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
As the duration of the crown's use ended, the battle on Lawrence's side changed once again.
The three Saints of the "Rose School" also possessed Grade 1 sealed artifacts.
For Beyonders at this level, sealed artifacts only serve as a surprise tactic. When facing enemies, they prefer to use their own abilities, as their abilities are already strong enough.
However, today was different. The three individuals were not in good condition, and this poor condition was caused by the enemy's angels, making it difficult to recover in a short time.
At this moment, the sealed artifacts on their bodies began to play a role. After Lawrence's crown's usage time ended, they utilized their own abilities and sealed artifacts to gradually regain the advantage.
After all, they were three Saints. Even if their condition was not good, they could not be suppressed by a single enemy Saint all the time.
Lawrence had no choice but to pray to the "Creator" for power once again.
Upon hearing Lawrence's prayer, Mahmosi immediately became vigilant. If the "Creator" were to send another "Angel" to the battlefield, they would immediately use their own spirituality to their advantage and hide in the spirit world.
Fortunately, only a black hound spirit beast appeared before them, which relieved them. They knew that the heart of the black hound spirit beast, which still roamed the Southern Continent, was the main material for Sequence 3 and was not too difficult to deal with.
At this moment, their mood relaxed. It seemed that the "Creator" only had this much power, actually sending a black hound spirit beast to its death.
Zatwen's figure became illusory, intending to possess the black hound spirit beast.
Possession at the "Disciple of Silence" level could not be handled using the "Bull Demon King's" "cage-like" method.
Because "Wraith Possession" at this level could possess objects, even the black hound spirit beast, whose body was based on pure power, could be affected by the "Disciple of Silence".
The black hound spirit beast's response exceeded everyone's expectations, and its ferocity far exceeded their imagination. The black hound spirit beast's hands turned pale white, and it stretched them forward together, penetrating the phantom-like Zatwen.
Then, the black hound spirit beast stretched its hands outward, tearing Zatwen in his Wraith state in half.
Although Zatwen's phantom reassembled, his spirit body had suffered severe damage.
At this moment, the black hound spirit beast's eyes suddenly turned scarlet, and a strong sense of fear permeated the area. Mahmosi and the others did not dare to look directly at the black hound spirit beast.
Otherwise, even Sequence 3 "Disciples of Silence" could suffer great damage to their spiritual bodies.
"Charm!" Lawrence seized the opportunity and launched another attack. The already very weak Zatwen was immediately hit, turning into Lawrence's helper and attacking Mahmosi and Jacks.
The black hound spirit beast pushed its hands flatly. Centered on it, the surrounding area gradually lost its color. Flowers withered, leaves lost their life, as if vitality was leaving this land.
Mahmosi and Jacks also felt their spirituality and vitality rapidly withering and dissipating.
At this moment, they realized that the black hound spirit beast in front of them only had the appearance of a spirit beast. It was actually a creature with complete "Ferryman" abilities.
Although it was also a Sequence 3 level opponent, it had just joined the battle and was in good condition, and its Beyonder abilities were among the top of Sequence 3.
However, the previous underestimation had already sown the seeds of bitter fruit. Mahmosi and Jax gradually could not hold on.
Mahmosi, the commander-in-chief of this battle, finally made a decision. He raised his head and let out a sharp scream, and then a circle of blue flames appeared around him, and the surrounding space became illusory.
Mahmosi burned his own spirituality, creating an escape passage in the spirit world.
The black hound spirit beast opened its mouth and made a hoarse sound: "Entry into the spirit world is prohibited here!"
But this "prohibition" was too late. Mahmosi and Jacks had already entered the spirit world one after another. Only Zatwen, under the state of "Charm," was one step late, watching the passage to the spirit world disappear.
How could Lawrence and the black hound spirit beast give up such a good opportunity? They immediately rushed up to launch a siege. Zatwen quickly couldn't hold on and burned his body with white spiritual flames.
This was not him committing suicide, but him completely transforming into a Wraith state, trying to escape from the spirit world.
From then on, he would not have a physical body, and there would be no hope of promotion. His condition would not be too good, but it was better than dying here.
But how could the black hound spirit beast let him escape from the spirit world? With a wave of its hand, a "Underworld Gate" with intricate patterns appeared.
The "Underworld Gate" at the "Ferryman" level was naturally not comparable to the "Underworld Gate" of the "Spirit Wine Glass".
These two bronze gates were larger and more solid, and there were more pale arms stretched out. Moreover, even if these arms did not actually grab Zatwen, as long as they made a grasping motion, Zatwen in the Wraith state could not move from the spot.
Taking this opportunity, the black hound spirit beast chased up and pressed its hand against Zatwen's back. Zatwen immediately screamed, and the spirituality supporting his spiritual body quickly disappeared. His spiritual body was rapidly becoming withered and decayed, swallowed by the power of death.
More than ten seconds later, this "Disciple of Silence" in the "Wraith" state was as thin as transparent, and finally only a Beyonder characteristic flickering with evil light remained.
The black hound spirit beast pointed to that Beyonder characteristic, signaling Lawrence to pick it up.
Then, one of them traversed the spirit world, and the other quickly distorted the distance, using their fastest speed to arrive at the "Mid-Sequence Battlefield".
Mahmosi's scream just now was the order to retreat.
But how could the Balk Family, which already had a certain advantage, let the people of the "Rose School" retreat so easily?
As soon as the retreat began, a demigod of the "Rose School" was killed. Those members of the "Rose School" who were in poor condition immediately became targets for the Balk Family members.
When the black hound spirit beast and Lawrence joined the battlefield, this battle gradually evolved into a massacre.
In the end, only three demigods of the "Rose School" escaped with their high spirituality, and only more than thirty Beyonders below the demigod level escaped.
The failure of this battle dealt a heavy blow to the "Mid-Sequence" Beyonders of the "Rose School".
And of the eighty-plus elite members of the Balk Family who participated in this battle, only less than twenty were not too seriously injured and could still move on their own. They were making the final touches on the battlefield.
No less than thirty family members were killed in battle, and more than thirty were seriously injured, the kind of serious injury that even "Mid-Sequence" Beyonders could die from.
If this battle had not been won, these thirty-plus seriously injured would have been finished off by the members of the "Rose School" and become "killed in battle".
"Bull Demon King" and the black hound spirit beast disappeared on the battlefield, and many Balk Family members looked in the direction they left, praising the "Creator".
...
On the other side of the "Angel Battlefield", the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" disappeared into the void, as if it had completed its mission and returned to the "Creator's" divine kingdom.
In reality, its "duration" had ended, and the power of the "Nation of Disorder" was diluted by the real world.
When Baranka saw that Mahmosi and the others had all retreated, there was no point in him staying here, so he also disappeared into the void.
At the same time, Hobert withdrew the "Holy Infant King," who was evenly matched with Claester, creating the illusion that the "Creator's" angel-level combat power had retreated.
Claester left the battlefield with a gloomy face.
The entire war ended here.
...
Without anyone teaching him, Elliott seemed to have suddenly figured things out.
Because his head was injured just now, he was covered in blood. Now the bloodstains had dried up, becoming as strange as a totem, and with some sense of sacredness.
"Carry all the seriously injured people here!" He knelt down in front of a seriously injured family member, holding the injured person's head, and prayed in the most pious posture: "Great 'Creator,' please bring hope of life to this seriously injured family member. In the years to come, we will devoutly believe in you and offer you all our loyalty. Please save this humble life!"
Everyone was attracted by this solemn scene, and everyone quieted down, even the wounded no longer groaned.
In mid-air, the image of the "Creator" sitting on a sharp sword appeared again, and beams of milky white light descended from mid-air, accurately hitting each seriously injured person.
Without exception, their injuries healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The Balk Family members spontaneously knelt down to the image of the "Creator," many with tears in their eyes. If it weren't for the "Creator's" help in this battle, it would have been impossible to win with the Balk Family's strength alone.
And the consequence of failure would be the death of many people, and even everyone here would be spared.
When the figure of the "Creator" disappeared, Lawrence got up and said: "From now on, the Balk Family will be loyal to the 'Creator.' Everyone must devoutly pray to the 'Creator' and serve the 'Creator' with the most serious attitude!"
Everyone together: "Praise the 'Creator'!"
Then Lawrence said: "Cheer! The Balk Family has won this war. We will return to the public eye and return to the Beyonder world!"
Before this, the Balk Family had been dormant for too long, and their true strength was seriously disproportionate to the benefits they received.
But they have been hesitant to fight this "battle for survival" because they lack the highest-end combat power: no angel protection.
This war was also largely forced and had to be fought. If the "Creator" had not appeared, they would never have taken the risk and would have chosen to return to "Nonexistent Town" to lie dormant.
Fortunately, with the help of the "Creator," they fought a resounding extraordinary battle.
From now on, in the Southern Continent, whether it is the "Rose School" or the Pale Empress of the "Numinous Episcopate," they must face the existence of the Balk Family.
With the protection of angels or gods, the Balk Family can rest easy.
Otherwise, if the Balk Family only had one Saint, even in the Southern Continent, it would only be a second-rate family.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffrey Territory.
Hobert of the "Nation of Disorder" almost exhausted his spirituality after using the "Healing Fork" to heal so many wounded in a short period of time.
He quickly left the "Nation of Disorder" and returned to the real world to take a nap.
He got up at two o'clock in the afternoon and ate lunch.
While eating, Hobert sighed in his heart: No matter where you are, the startup phase is always so hard.
While eating, he habitually summarized.
Overall, the strength shown by the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" and the "Holy Infant King" exceeded Hobert's expectations.
Unfortunately, their usage times are limited. They can be used one and three more times respectively, and the "Bull Demon King" has also been used twice and can be used eight more times.
The black hound spirit beast, which has complete Beyonder characteristics, can theoretically be used countless times.
After returning to the study and drinking a few sips of tea, he asked Allen to call Corwin to inquire about the situation of the "Nohar".
...
Dean, the captain of the "Nohar" was somewhat incredulous. Since entering South Colsen, he had seen violence and crime openly displayed in front of everyone, and he once thought that there was no order here.
He didn't expect that in this mountainous area, there would be an orderly Jeffrey Town!
It doesn't look prosperous here. Most of the vendors in the small market next to the pier are selling vegetables, fruits, or dried fruits, and few people sell poultry and livestock.
Dean sent people to inquire, and the prices were very fair, and the Baron had set up a "fair scale" here. If anyone has any objection to the seller's scale, they can immediately go to re-weigh it, and each re-weighing only costs 1 Solas.
Dean also saw the warrior who had boarded the ship before. He was maintaining order on the pier and politely told the crew where to eat and stay, as well as where to pay fees and taxes.
The cost of berthing in the port is the same as in other ports. For a ship of the "Nohar's" tonnage, it costs 1 gold Solas per hour of berthing. If you stay overnight in the port, as long as you leave before noon the next day, it only costs 6 gold Solas.
This is a common trick used by ports. As long as you stay overnight, you have to spend money, and as long as you spend money, you can promote the prosperity and development of the port, so there are generally considerable discounts for ships that stay overnight.
In the afternoon, after the people watching the excitement had dispersed, the crew went ashore in groups of three or five.
Dean also went ashore to have a drink at the only restaurant in the town. He originally planned to replenish some vegetables and set sail immediately, but when he heard the hotel manager talking about the deeds of Sir Hobert, he was fascinated. When he came back to his senses, it was already more than five o'clock in the afternoon, so he simply decided to stay here for the night.
The manager's story surprised Dean a bit. Are there still such capable nobles now? He destroyed the bandits' den with his own strength and carried out household registration and real estate registration.
Knowledgeable Dean knew that household registration and real estate registration are the measures that best demonstrate the Baron's level of governance.
As for the later battles with the monsters and behemoths in Full Moon Lake, Dean didn't quite believe it. He always felt that the manager must have exaggerated, but the fact is that under the leadership of this Baron, the Taz River channel was dredged.
Dean could also understand the move to exempt agricultural taxes some time ago. Since the channel has been dredged, the price of local agricultural products will quickly drop, and agricultural taxes will soon become worthless, and commercial taxes are the main tax support.
Unknowingly, Dean had been drinking for three hours, and he had finished listening to Sir Hobert's stories. He admired and respected this capable Baron.
At this time, more than a dozen out-of-towners came to the restaurant for dinner. During their chat, Dean learned about Sir Hobert's grand construction plan.
This made Dean sigh: "If every noble in Feynapotter was as capable as him, we would have been the strongest country in the world long ago!"
This sentence aroused widespread resonance.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - 425: The Cyclic Exploration Encountered by Little Sun
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert had just learned about the "Nohar" in his study when he heard prayers from the "Nation of Disorder."
He praised Corwin a few words and asked him to continue staring at the pier to avoid any mistakes.
After Corwin left, Hobert locked the door. As expected, it was Lawrence who was presiding over the sacrifice.
The altar was filled with offerings. Hobert took a quick look and found that there were actually 3 Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts! The main ones were Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts, with as many as 13 pieces, and 5 Grade 3 Sealed Artifacts.
Through Lawrence's description in front of the altar, Hobert learned that one of the three Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts was formed by the demigod imprisoned by the "Bull Demon King" losing control in the previous battle.
The other two came from a dead Saint of the "Rose School" and a demigod.
The other offerings were Beyonder characteristics from the enemy, most of which were from the "Prisoner" pathway, and some from the "Apothecary" pathway.
Hobert didn't stand on ceremony with them, and with a wave of his hand, he moved them all into the "Sacrificial Gate."
This was his due, because the "Creator" played a major role in this battle.
Then Lawrence held a ceremony for the Balk family to pledge allegiance to the "Creator". After Hobert responded briefly, he couldn't wait to turn his attention to the pile of spoils.
First, he looked at the three Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts. One of them, obtained from the Saint, was actually a Sealed Artifact from the "Error" pathway!
The ability is: "It can steal conceptual things, such as distance, location, etc.; it can steal and keep an item, and present it at the right time; it can accurately steal the desired ability from the target!"
Hobert sighed: As expected of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, this ability is simply generations apart from the 'Dream Stealing Pocket Watch'.
However, the negative effects cannot be ignored: "It is easy to be forgetful and have a bad memory, sometimes even forgetting that you are in a battle; it is easy to lose things, especially important or valuable things; it is easy to encounter Beyonder beings of Sequence 2 or higher from the 'Error' pathway."
Hobert suddenly recalled that he seemed to remember that a Saint of the "Rose School" had encountered Amon and was stolen by Amon. Could it be the Saint who was killed in this battle?
Then this Sealed Artifact is good, but it cannot be taken to the real world for use for the time being. If Amon comes to collect the coins in the gas meter one day, there will be no place to cry.
This time, Hobert didn't even try to seal this Sealed Artifact. He sensed through his spirituality that before he became a demigod, the "Nation of Disorder" had extremely limited sealing ability for Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts.
And even if it could be effectively sealed, a maximum of two to three Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts could be carried on the body.
First of all, even if effective sealing is possible, the negative effects of Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts are very powerful. Often, the holder will encounter great danger because of the Sealed Artifact.
For example, the Sealed Artifact in Hobert's hand: forgetting that he is in a battle; easily encountering powerful people of Sequence 2 or higher from the "Error" pathway.
Either way, it is fatal to Hobert now.
Secondly, as one's own strength becomes stronger, Sealed Artifacts and mystical items will gradually become items that play a supporting role. If one relies too much on Sealed Artifacts, it will be putting the cart before the horse.
Only in the Sequence 6 or Sequence 7 stage, when the Beyonder's spirituality is relatively strong, and his own strength and Beyonder abilities are not enough to make up for his shortcomings, can he equip as many mystical items as possible, or some Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts with not very strong negative effects.
By Sequence 5 or higher, the demand for mystical items or Sealed Artifacts is reduced, and the negative effects of Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts themselves make it difficult to wear multiple items at the same time.
Therefore, Hobert plans to treat all the Sealed Artifacts he received today as an accumulation for the Beyonder organization he will establish in the future. Whenever he may need to use a Sealed Artifact, he can go to the "Nation of Disorder" to retrieve it.
The other two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts are both Sealed Artifacts of the "Prisoner" pathway, mainly based on curses, possessing a strong physique, and the ability to give objects spirituality.
Among the 13 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts, 7 are also "Prisoner" pathway Sealed Artifacts, 3 are "Corpse Collector" pathway Sealed Artifacts, 2 are "Apothecary" pathway Sealed Artifacts, and 1 is "Lawyer" pathway Sealed Artifact.
The "Lawyer" pathway Sealed Artifact came from a member of the Balk family who died in a previous battle.
The other 5 Grade 3 Sealed Artifacts are mainly based on various curses that can cause inexplicable harm to opponents.
The stone platform that Hobert manifested before could no longer hold these Sealed Artifacts, so he simply manifested a larger stone platform to hold the gains of this battle.
Then his eyes turned to those Beyonder characteristics. This time he received as many as 73 Beyonder characteristics, of which 66 were "Prisoner" pathway Beyonder characteristics, ranging from Sequence 7 to Sequence 3.
Hobert also obtained Beyonder characteristics of the demigod and Saint levels for the first time, and he obtained 4 pieces at once!
There are also 7 "Apothecary" pathway Beyonder characteristics, ranging from Sequence 7 to Sequence 5, presumably because followers of the "Original Moon" participated in this battle.
In addition to being happy, Hobert suddenly realized a problem. Most of these Beyonder items cannot be immediately realized, or he will not actively realize them!
For example, he would never sell the three "Puppet" Beyonder characteristics and one "Silent Disciple" Beyonder characteristic.
Hobert would never allow such strategic materials to circulate into the hands of the "Rose School" again, unless they were sold to "Temperance Faction" members like "Miss Bodyguard".
However, the only "Temperance Faction" members Hobert knew were Sharon and Maric. At most, he could sell two Beyonder characteristics to them.
There should be other "Temperance Faction" members, right? Hobert didn't think about this question before, but now that he thinks about it, Hobert believes that the "Temperance Faction" should be like some Beyonder families, choosing to disperse and hide in order to avoid being wiped out by the enemy.
If the "Temperance Faction" only has Sharon, Maric, and "Miss Messenger", then they are embarrassed to be called the "Temperance Faction"? This is clearly the "Temperance Squad", no, the "Temperance Trio".
In addition, Hobert does not plan to realize Beyonder characteristics below the demigod level in large quantities before finding a suitable channel.
After all, now that the Balk family has pledged allegiance to him, and they have just experienced huge battle losses, it would be meaningless to replenish the "Rose School" with ammunition at this time.
Currently, only the 7 "Apothecary" pathway Beyonder characteristics can be sold, but not all of them can be sold. Hobert plans to train a few "Apothecaries" himself, and then let them sit in the town's hospital in the future.
However, most of them can be realized, because Hobert does not plan to let these "Apothecaries" advance too quickly, otherwise it will be difficult for them to continue to sit in the hospital with peace of mind.
Hobert smacked his lips. He originally thought that this harvest was quite fruitful, but most of it cannot be realized.
Thinking of this, Hobert slapped his head: Idiot, Beyonder characteristics are more value-preserving than gold, what's not to be satisfied with? Look at the Poor God... cough cough, look at Klein, what kind of life did he live before going to sea? He basically achieved financial freedom after going to sea.
Hobert's self-comfort made him feel a lot more balanced.
Then he thought again: I can't become arrogant just because I have the combat power of an angel level. After all, they have a limit on the number of uses, and I must use them carefully before I become an angel!
Following this line of thought, Hobert found that he didn't seem to have anything to be proud of. The combat power of the angel level is cool, but it can only be used on the prayers of the dependents.
Because those two guys are indiscriminate attacks and don't give the "Creator" any face!
Hobert needs to constantly use the "Power of Order" in the "Nation of Disorder" to protect the pray-ers.
If he uses the method of praying to himself to use the combat power of the angel level, then the most likely result is that his body will be destroyed, and Hobert will stay in the "Nation of Disorder" forever.
Hobert smacked his lips again. He originally thought he was very powerful and very rich, but it was all his own illusion?
It can't be said that way. Hobert refuted himself: After all, he can still use it to show off in front of the dependents, and he can use them to get benefits from the dependents. It's just that those dependents are all smart people, thinking that the "Creator" would not like paper money or gold and other wealth, and generally only sacrifice some Sealed Artifacts that they think are more precious.
Doesn't the "Creator" know that he is a miser and is reluctant to realize Sealed Artifacts?
In the end, Hobert put his eyes on those Beyonder characteristics again, and his mood gradually became beautiful again.
...
South Continent, outside Crowley City.
After the members of the Balk family buried the bodies of their companions, they said their final farewells together.
Many members have begun to pray to the "Creator" for the dead. Eliot took this opportunity to announce the honorific name of the "Creator" to everyone.
The members who prayed just now awkwardly discovered that the "Creator" did not have any "business" related to the dead.
On the way back, Lawrence called Eliot over: "Write a letter to the 'Favored of God' as soon as possible. I want to talk to him about the future development direction of the Balk family for a period of time."
Commonly known as "reporting work".
Eliot nodded: "I'll write it right away."
"Also." Lawrence instructed again: "I heard that the 'Favored of God' has some 'Lawyer' pathway Beyonder characteristics in his hand. Ask in the letter if we can buy some."
Every additional "Lawyer" Beyonder characteristic means one less madman in the Balk family.
Eliot nodded: "I will mention this to the 'Favored of God'."
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert, who was lying on the bed reading a magazine he took from Fors's room and resting, received two letters from the messenger one after another.
One was from Eliot and the other was from Rafter.
After the messenger left, Hobert read Eliot's letter first. Of course, there was no problem in selling a batch of "Lawyer" Beyonder characteristics.
He counted them in the "Nation of Disorder" just now. For so long, he had accumulated more than a dozen copies of "Lawyer", "Barbarian", and "Briber" Beyonder characteristics.
It would be a waste to put so many Beyonder characteristics there. Now is the time when Jeffery Territory is short of money. Even if the other party doesn't say it, Hobert will find an opportunity to promote it.
As for discussing the future development plan of the Balk family, he can talk about it in two days. He consumed too much spirituality today and really doesn't want to move anymore.
So he asked Allen outside the door to ask the kitchen to make donuts, and then went to read Rafter's letter.
It turned out that Rafter wanted to leave Backlund, but was afraid of being noticed by the royal family, so he hoped that the "Favored of God" could help.
Hobert stretched and went to the study to write back to Eliot and Rafter.
He made an appointment with Rafter to meet at 8:00 am tomorrow and with Eliot to meet at 8:00 am on Tuesday.
When the donuts were ready, Hobert summoned the messenger.
Just as Hobert was paying 6 donuts, he suddenly thought: "I remember your surname is Tudor, right?"
"That's right."
"Are you a member of the Tudor family?"
"Yes." The messenger was a little strange: "Why are you suddenly so polite and started using 'you'?"
Hobert smiled: "I just have a question to ask. You should have participated in the 'War of the Four Emperors', right?"
"Ask a question, three donuts."
"No problem!" Hobert looked at it. There were still seven donuts on the plate, which was enough.
"I participated in the 'War of the Four Emperors'." Messenger: "Three donuts."
"Does this count too?"
"Yes. Six donuts."
Hobert made a "stop" gesture and said to the outside: "Ask the kitchen to bring two more donuts!"
He took a deep breath and asked: "Do you know the origin, function, and current situation of the 'Trunsoest Empire'?"
"I know. Nine donuts."
Hobert stared at the coffin for four or five seconds. Maybe the messenger was a little embarrassed, so She added: "I only know that."
She said: "I also know that the clues to the 'Empire' may be hidden in the city of Santiago de Rolo! That was once the capital of the First Solomon Empire, and now it has disappeared into the dust of history."
Hobert was strange: "Why are the clues to the 'Trunsoest Empire' hidden in the capital of the First Solomon Empire? I remember that the city disappeared when Solomon first fell, right? And the 'Empire' was built hundreds of years later."
The messenger replied: "As far as I know, the capital of the First Solomon Empire was on the south bank of the Jan Sea, at the source of the Honachis Mountains, which was once the territory of the Trunsoest Empire.
"And the Night Emperor is the 'Judge'. He has a mystical connection to his own territory, and the manifestation of this is knowing some secrets about his territory, such as knowing where the disappeared capital of the First Solomon Empire is.
"The Night Emperor fell too fast, and the Trunsoest family was not prepared at all. When they were hunted down by the Six Gods, some of them fled to Desi County in present-day Loen, and it is said that this part later fled to the South Continent.
"Some fled to Midseashire County in present-day Loen. It is said that they hid in the city of Santiago de Rolo and have never appeared in people's sight since."
"These two groups of members took away most of the wealth of the Trunsoest Empire, including the empire's knowledge, related technological achievements, etc. There is reliable intelligence to prove that the design drawings of the 'Empire' and many related intelligence and information were taken away by the group heading north."
She paused and added, "Twelve donuts."
Hobert nodded repeatedly, not to mention twelve, he would agree to one hundred and twenty!
As expected, having an elder at home is like having a treasure!
At this time, Allen returned from the kitchen and said to Hobert, "Your Excellency, the kitchen said that there are only thirteen or fourteen donuts in one batch, and they are all brought to you."
Although he couldn't see the messenger's expression in the coffin, Hobert could clearly feel her frustration.
Hobert quickly said, "Here are seven for you first, and I will make up the five you owe you when you send the letter next time. Well, I will add three interest to you, a total of eight!"
The messenger left contentedly.
Alan outside asked again, "Your Excellency, do you want me to make another batch for you?"
"No need," Hobert said, "I'm just asking, if there isn't any, then there isn't."
He sat in the chair behind his desk, considering whether to take some time to go to the County to find the lost city?
But this is not an urgent matter now. Hobert returned to his room and continued to read the magazine, but every few lines he read, he would think about the "Empire" thing.
...
The Forsaken Land of the Gods, in the city that converted to the "Fallen Creator."
The City of Silver team set up camp in the leeward and rested in the camp for a while.
When the frequency of lightning gradually stabilized, Colin, who was sitting cross-legged and leaning against the stone pillar, said, "Leave after 50 lightning strikes."
The members immediately began to make the final preparations. During a cautious exploration, they arrived at the periphery of the abandoned temple.
Inside the temple, they saw the idol of the "Fallen Creator" and large areas of murals.
On the murals that Derrick saw, there were several figures painted, including a girl in a black classical long dress, her face was blurred, and strange eyes loomed around her.
There is also a young man wearing a pure white robe, his face painted pure gold.
In the lower right corner is a beautiful lady, holding a baby with a rotten face in her arms, and at her feet are black ears of wheat, springs wriggling with flesh, and herbs flowing with pus...
Derrick looked all the way, a total of six images. The other three images are sea monsters, an old man with an evil smile holding a book, and a giant warrior wearing dilapidated armor.
The general meaning of these murals is that when the Great Cataclysm came, six evil gods crawled out of the abyss. The "Fallen Creator" took on most of the sins and pains in order to save the world, and therefore there were situations symbolizing being eroded and changes in image.
Continuing to look forward, Derrick saw the relevant text expressing the "Rose Redemption", and a long line of people walking on the plain, their goal being the distant mountains and the cross at the top of the mountains.
At the very front of the team is a tall and thin man with silver hair hanging down his back, with layers of light wings behind him.
It's an angel!
Derrick recalled the information he got from Mr. Emperor. The "Rose Redemption" seems to be an organization loyal to the "Fallen Creator".
As for this long team, Derrick thought sadly: They came from the southern and northern continents mentioned by Miss Justice and the others. Most of them died on the road or in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods".
After passing through the hall with murals and the idol of the "Fallen Creator", they came to the room behind the hall, which seemed to be an altar.
"Woo woo woo~"
There seems to be a cry behind the altar.
The people who were not the first time to perform exploration tasks did not have much fear, but just stared at the dark space in front of them.
Chief Colin calmly ordered, "Derrick, Joshua, go around and take a look."
Derrick carried the animal skin lantern, carefully guarded and slowly walked around to the back of the altar with Joshua.
As the darkness was gradually dispelled by the light, they saw a black shadow curled up behind the altar.
Two steps forward, they finally saw the black shadow clearly: it was a seven or eight-year-old child.
He shouted excitedly, "Save me, save me!"
Colin, who was following behind, asked, "Who are you?"
The child stopped asking for help, his expression suddenly became dazed: "My name is Jack! I'm so hungry..."
Derrick was also in a daze for a while. When he came back to his senses, he saw their goal this time, the city that had converted to the "Fallen Creator".
The City of Silver team set up camp in the leeward and rested in the camp for a while.
When the frequency of lightning gradually stabilized, Colin, who was sitting cross-legged and leaning against the stone pillar, said, "Leave after 50 lightning strikes."
The members immediately began to make the final preparations.
...
Feynapooter Kingdom, the baronial manor of Teuton.
Viscount Teuton looked through the telescope for a long time, confirming that it was indeed a large cargo ship.
Yesterday, his subordinates reported to him that this was a large cargo ship from downstream, and he didn't quite believe it, but as the scouts sent out yesterday returned, he had to believe it.
"The channel has really been cleared?" Viscount Teuton asked Grove, who was beside him, "What do you think?"
"The first person to plant new varieties of crops always finds it difficult to get a good harvest." Grove smiled and said, "Let Hobert try his best to open the channel. We just need to keep an eye on what he does, and as long as it is successful, we will follow suit.
"Let Hobert help us try and make mistakes, and we will just seize the results."
Viscount Teuton nodded in satisfaction. He recently discovered that Grove, who didn't seem to have any outstanding qualities in the past, was actually better than the knights and staff in the Teuton territory. The key point was that he was Hobert's mortal enemy.
Now, Viscount Teuton will consult with him on everything.
...
"Sometimes a person's enlightenment is just a moment away." Hobert smiled and said to Corwin, "The easiest way for ordinary people to be enlightened is to put what they want most in front of them.
"He will try his best to own it and obtain it. Whether he succeeds or not, this process is a process of enlightenment."
Of course, it can also be called getting the hang of it.
Corwin nodded slowly, feeling that what the Duke said made sense.
Hobert added, "For example, Captain Dean, who wants to invest in the Jeffrey Territory, in the big cities of the kingdom such as Feynapotter City, the channels for creating wealth have been monopolized by a group of people.
"And everything in the Jeffrey Territory has just begun, with infinite possibilities. This kind of opportunity is not common now."
He paused and said, "How about this, let him wait for me in the main hall at nine o'clock, and I will talk to him in person."
Corwin, who was in charge of delivering the message: "Yes."
Before that, Hobert had to go to Backlund.
After locking the study door from the inside, he used "Travel" to come to Rafter's residence.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - 426 King of Angels: Ouroboros
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Backlund, Sivellaus Street.
Rafter bowed slightly and greeted, "Blessed of God!"
Hobert asked, "Are you ready to leave?"
"I am ready." Rafter picked up two small leather suitcases.
Hobert nodded: "Where are you planning to go?"
"I plan to go to the Rorsted Archipelago first." Rafter said, "Although it is a colony of Loen, the local official Beyonders should not have the energy to capture a 'fugitive' like me."
Dealing with pirates alone is enough to keep them busy, unless the royal family clearly knows Rafter's location. Otherwise, with the cover of the 'Crystal Mask of Order,' they won't know where Rafter has gone.
Rafter continued: "I plan to advance to 'Baron of Corruption' there, and then develop in the Southern Continent."
Hobert nodded slightly: "If you encounter any difficulties there, you can write to me."
After all, he had been used as cannon fodder several times, and it was not easy for Rafter to survive until now. As long as the request wasn't excessive, Hobert would help him.
Perhaps in the future, there will be opportunities to use such an 'ace cannon fodder'.
Using "travel" to take Rafter through a transfer, they arrived in the suburbs of Balam.
Then Hobert returned to his territory and, at nine o'clock, received Dean, the captain of the "Nohar," in the main hall of the lord's mansion.
After a brief exchange of greetings, Hobert asked, "I heard from Corwin that you want to buy two shops in Jeffrey Town?"
Dean clutched his hat and said, "Yes, my honorable lord. I would actually prefer to invest in the construction projects of Jeffrey Town, but my savings are only enough to invest in shops."
Hobert smiled and said, "I can guide you to a way to make a fortune. For a period of time, building materials sold to Jeffrey Territory will be tax-free!"
Dean's eyes lit up immediately. For a captain, the fees paid for a cargo ship to dock at a port are only a small part of the expenses. Paying taxes to the port is a huge cost.
As long as a transaction occurs in the port, taxes must be paid. Although the tax rates for different goods are different, generally speaking, goods shipped from Granada Port and traded in Feynapotter Port, the sum of the taxes from the two ports will double the value of most goods.
If the target port exempts a certain type of commodity from tax, it means that the port lacks such goods. As long as they are transported, they can be sold out, and basically one-quarter to one-fifth of the cost can be saved.
Hobert added: "You only have a few days. When your ship docks at Feynapotter Port, I will announce this news."
Dean nodded: "That's enough, that's enough!"
Doing this kind of business once can multiply his wealth several times!
Dean bid farewell to Hobert. He had to hurry back to the ship to send a telegram, asking his wife to mortgage the house and the stocks he had previously purchased, borrow some money from relatives, and add the family savings, which would be enough to order two ships of building materials from Granada Port.
Arriving at Jeffrey Town, he paid the management fee for the cargo ship to dock, and met Corwin at the pier.
Corwin instructed: "South Colson is still a bit unstable. Be sure to put the flag on the bow of the ship, and launch flares if you encounter danger."
"Yes, yes, yes." Dean quickly agreed, thanked him, and hurriedly sailed away.
In the lord's mansion, Hobert in the main hall was about to return to his study when Roy brought a list of required building materials.
The project is divided into five stages, with slight differences in the materials required for each stage.
Hobert estimated it and almost showed a surprised expression. The building materials required for the first stage alone amounted to 56,000 gold Lire!
The five stages will cost a total of 270,000 gold Lire. This is just a preliminary estimate, of course, some surplus must be left, and 300,000 gold Lire must be prepared.
Hobert's hands almost trembled: No, I have to find investment. No matter which country it is, this is a lot of money, a sum that a mere baron, a mere evil god, cannot bear!
This is just the cost of construction. The decoration of resort hotels and various entertainment venues is another large sum of money.
It must be decorated decently, otherwise the main consumer group, the nobles, will not be willing to come again after one visit.
Hobert suffered from the loss of never having done business. He originally thought that about 100,000 gold Lire would be enough to complete the construction, but the total cost was several times higher than he had estimated.
If only he hadn't generously rewarded Scholar and Valk so much money!
Roy also reported: "There are two new problems now. The first is that land acquisition is very troublesome, and the second is that the town's renovation project and construction project can start first, but we don't have enough building materials now."
Hobert nodded: "I will find a way, you still mobilize manpower first and do the preliminary preparations."
After Roy left, Hobert paced back and forth with his arms folded. He considered issuing stocks while looking for large investments.
These must be done in Feynapotter City.
As for the problem of insufficient building materials, the just-departed Dean's distant water cannot quench the immediate thirst, so he can only use "Creator Express".
Hobert, who had just made a simple plan, received a package from Bishop Simpson, a letter and a small wooden box.
This time, Hobert was not in the mood to tease the big dog. After having Allen bring raw meat from the kitchen, he quickly opened the letter.
This letter made Hobert feel a little better. The ancient Azure Dragon Beast's seven boxes of materials sold for a total of 16,000 gold Lire.
It was more valuable than Hobert had expected. This money also slightly alleviated Hobert's anxious mood.
After counting the money in the wooden box, Hobert closed the lid of the wooden box: "Eat one bite at a time, do one thing at a time! Don't rush, don't rush."
Just as he finished lunch, Philip presented Hobert with two banknotes, one for 5 gold Lire and one for 1 gold Lire: "Lord, this is the port management fee paid by the 'Nohar'."
After investing so much in the territory, he finally saw some return money.
But… Hobert looked at these 6 gold Lire and thought of the total cost of 300,000 gold Lire, and couldn't help but smile bitterly: "Find a booklet to save these two banknotes, their commemorative value is greater than their actual value."
"Yes."
At a little after two in the afternoon, Hobert, who had been thinking about where to raise money, adjusted his state and prepared to participate in the Tarot Gathering.
…
Forsaken Land of the Gods.
The City of Silver team established a camp in the leeward area. The Chief ordered the team to rest in the camp until the frequency of lightning became stable before exploring the abandoned temple.
In the open-air camp, where flames were burning and someone was always on duty, Derrick leaned against a stone pillar, sleeping to recover his strength.
As if in a dream, he saw the great and mysterious "Fool" sitting on the ancient high-backed chair: "Prepare for the gathering."
Yes, Mr. Fool.
Derrick responded silently, counting his heartbeats.
His eyes never opened, as if everything that had just happened was just part of a dream.
After 1000 heartbeats, Derrick waited a little longer before feeling himself entering the silent and peaceful Giant Temple.
As soon as he opened his eyes, scenes suddenly flashed back in his mind, as if an external force had instantly poured all the lost memories back into his brain.
Those scenes included: the temple of the Fallen Creator, murals detailing the scene of the coming of the apocalypse and the Fallen Creator resisting the six evil gods and protecting the surviving humans; murals of the pilgrim's team; beautiful and dangerous "mushrooms"; Jack, a strangely eerie pale yellow-haired boy of unknown origin.
Such scenes were repeated over and over again, a full five times! But each time there were some differences in the details: the first time, outside the temple of the Fallen Creator, all the animal skin lanterns were extinguished, almost causing a terrible tragedy.
The second time, someone couldn't control himself and almost swallowed the "mushroom".
…
Each time, it ended with the little boy Jack's mutation, or Chief Colin killing the little boy Jack, and began with arriving at that city and starting to build the camp.
We have explored the temple five times, we have been living in this experience, and there is no way to truly end it. The more Derrick understood the sudden increase in his memories, the more terrified he felt, the more his hair stood on end.
"Justice" Audrey, who was sitting on the other side of the bronze long table, originally wanted to greet Mr. "Fool" and everyone with pleasure and ease as usual, but her eyes swept over and immediately noticed that the "Little Sun's" emotions were not right, and immediately asked:
"Mr. Sun, what happened? Is the exploration of the Fallen Creator not going smoothly?"
Derrick grabbed at hope and quickly described the course of events in general, and finally said: "After that little boy mutated, or was cleaned up, we would be in a trance for a while, and when we came back to our senses, we would start building the camp and preparing to start a new exploration, with no previous memories.
"This process has been repeated five times, with only slight differences in the details. If it weren't for Mr. Fool's reminder, I wouldn't even know that I have been living a repeated life during this time."
He naturally thought that the extra memories after coming to the gray fog originated from the Fool's reminder, so he stood up and solemnly saluted "Fool" Klein, who was sitting at the head of the bronze long table.
Klein indicated: I still listened to your description before I understood what happened.
But the divine temperament that should be there still had to be there. He maintained his original posture, nodded slightly, in response.
Hobert sighed inwardly: "It's so fast, Little Sun has reached this point, then it's not far from Klein leaving Backlund. The Backlund smog! Should I participate in this event? Save…"
"Hehe, I think too highly of myself, I'm just a Sequence 5 who is worried about money, what can I stop? It was like this last time, I went to Tingen City with blind confidence, but nothing changed.
"Forget it, let the smog be the smog, I'm not the ruler of the Loen Kingdom, why bother with these trivial matters…"
"But, Old Kohler, whom I have never met, the shrewish widow who lived by washing clothes and supported two daughters, whose names I have forgotten, why do these people linger in my head?"
He remembered a sentence: "People like us are like straw in the field, we will fall when the wind blows, and even without the wind, we may fall by ourselves…"
"Mr. Emperor!" Audrey said: "Mr. Emperor?"
Hobert came back to his senses: "Oh, sorry, I was distracted just now, what do you want from me?"
It turned out that "Little Sun" was asking everyone how to solve this problem. As a result, Audrey and "Magician" Fors had no clue, and "Hanged Man" Alger and "World" did not speak easily. They all turned their attention to "Emperor" Hobert.
As a result, Hobert was distracted just now, so Audrey reminded him.
Hobert adjusted his emotions and asked Derrick: "You just said that there were pilgrimage scenes in the murals you saw, right?"
"Little Sun" quickly replied: "Yes!"
"Mr. Fool, please help him manifest the angel that appeared in that scene."
Klein nodded slightly, and with Derrick's cooperation, manifested a scene from the mural.
After seeing the mural, the other members were attracted by the holy wings of the figure walking at the front of the pilgrimage team.
Hobert nodded pretentiously: "Tall and thin, silver-white hair, beautiful face. Hmm, it fits the description of 'Ouroboros the Tail-Devourer' very well."
Hanged Man: "Tail-Devourer?"
Audrey: "Ouroboros?"
Everyone looked at me, and I looked at you, unfamiliar names and nicknames.
"I must declare." Hobert said: "The knowledge I am going to talk about next also has considerable value, but like last time, in order to help 'Little Sun' out of trouble, let's not talk about the price."
Derrick stood up immediately and bowed slightly: "Thank you, Mr. Emperor."
Hobert waved his hand: "Ouroboros is the 'King of Angels' of the 'Fate' pathway…"
Audrey said excitedly: "This is actually an 'King of Angels'! We know another 'King of Angels'!"
Like Audrey, the other members also recalled Mr. "Door" and the Emperor's explanation of the "King of Angels" at that time.
"No, no, no, Ouroboros is different from the Mr. 'Door' we mentioned before." Hobert quickly explained: "This is the real 'King of Angels', and the reason I called Mr. 'Door' 'King of Angels' before was just to indicate his level."
Everyone looked at each other, not quite understanding the "Emperor's" meaning.
Derrick scratched his head: "Sorry, Mr. Emperor, I don't quite understand what you mean."
The eyes of the other members turned to Hobert: We don't quite understand either.
Hobert smiled: "Okay, let me remind you again, do you remember? I said that the concept of 'King of Angels' seemed to be just a title at first, and later gradually evolved into a level between Sequence 1 and True God.
"My calling Mr. 'Door' 'King of Angels' is to indicate that he has reached this level."
Alger immediately understood: "Then Ouroboros, this 'King of Angels', is the source of this title, or one of the sources!"
Hobert nodded: "That's right."
Klein behind the gray fog: So that is to say, Ouroboros has a great background!
Audrey: There seems to be a lot of fascinating ancient history here, or high-level Beyonder history, but unfortunately Hobert's answer this time is of a "semi-public welfare" nature, and he is unwilling to say more.

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - 427 Discussing the Creator at the Tarot Club (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Congratulations to A K for advancing to Sequence 9: Reader, +5 bonus]
Hobert continued, "From what I know, Ouroboros is an 'King of Angels' of the 'Fate' pathway. He can fix time and events within a certain range, causing them to repeat endlessly.
"Also, according to some vague records, Ouroboros seems to enjoy painting murals and likes to leave his abilities within them.
"All of this aligns with 'The Sun's' description."
Alger pinched his chin: So, at the level of 'King of Angels,' one already possesses such miraculous and powerful abilities!
Fors exclaimed, "'Fate' pathway? A pathway I've never heard of! This pathway's angel actually has such amazing abilities! This is simply, simply like the power I imagined gods would have!"
'Little Sun' visibly breathed a sigh of relief: Mr. Emperor has found a clue so quickly, he will definitely be able to help me solve the problem!
He asked, "Mr. Emperor, how should I solve this problem?"
"Since each exploration ends at the little boy's location, it proves he must be the key!" Hobert said, "Try not to let him undergo any mutations or be killed, and perhaps you can find a way to break the cycle.
"When you return to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' and encounter the little boy again, try to communicate with him as much as possible to see if you can obtain more information and find an opportunity to break the situation."
Seeing 'Little Sun' looking worried and nodding somewhat blankly, Hobert asked, "You mentioned earlier, what is the little boy's name?"
"Little Sun" replied, "It's Jack."
Hobert asked Alger beside him, "I remember you mentioned before that you pursued a 'Listener' from the Aurora Order who was taking a child out to sea. Was that child named Jack?"
Alger, of course, remembered that father and son. Although he had suspected it, he couldn't be sure: "That's right, their purpose in going to sea was to find the 'True Creator's' sanctuary."
Derrick was somewhat stunned: "That Jack came from your world to the vicinity of City of Silver?"
After a brief surprise, he felt inexplicably delighted.
Although he had heard Mr. Emperor mention that many believers of the True Creator had come to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' from the North and South continents, it was all a long time ago. Derrick felt it was more like a story, without any real feeling.
But that little boy, Jack, had indeed appeared before him, and these two feelings were completely different.
This meant that the area where City of Silver was located had never been completely sealed off. Since a little boy could come to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods,' they could certainly leave the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.'
Hobert smiled: "See? Opportunities often lie within difficulties. Never be intimidated by difficulties, because they may contain hope."
Derrick nodded happily: "Mr. Emperor, thank you for your guidance."
Everyone also felt that what Mr. Emperor said was very philosophical. Klein recalled a saying: Misfortune may be a blessing in disguise, and a blessing may be a misfortune in disguise.
Alger suggested, "You can find an opportunity to mention the Sonia Sea, the Loen Kingdom, and port cities in front of the little boy Jack. Maybe there will be a different reaction. Of course, try to avoid your City of Silver's Chief."
Hobert also suggested, "Trust your teammates, trust your Chief, and find a way to let them discover the problems you encounter."
Derrick nodded repeatedly, already having a rough plan in mind.
Alger suddenly added, "Of course, it cannot be ruled out that there are other key points. You'd better describe the specific situation, such as the detailed content of the murals, and maybe Mr. Emperor can find something useful."
Hobert twitched his lips. If you want to fleece a sheep, just fleece it, why do you have to drag me in?
But he didn't say anything, because he had seen a scene in the murals just now and felt that Ouroboros painted quite well (maybe it was him), and it wouldn't hurt to look at the whole picture of the murals.
So, with Mr. Fool's help, Derrick manifested all the murals he had seen.
When Hobert saw the "evilized" images of the Six Gods, he couldn't help but sigh: If Ouroboros lived in the Common Era, he would definitely be a good public intellectual with excellent professional skills.
Just when everyone was wondering which evil gods these depicted, "The World" suddenly said that he had seen similar images, so he manifested the images of the Six Gods he had seen in the Tudor ruins.
Alger was somewhat dazed: "So the murals are distorted images of the Six Gods. They, they once really had human forms…"
Audrey was somewhat angry: Blasphemy! This is blasphemy against the Goddess.
But she quickly calmed down, because in the Tarot Club, members led by "The Emperor" often blasphemed against the gods.
Fors felt that there should be a huge mystery here!
Derrick was stunned at first, then realized: "Mr. Hanged Man, are these the gods you mentioned, such as the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms?"
"Yes!" Alger responded affirmatively.
Derrick asked the question in the minds of the other members: "What do they have to do with the apocalypse? What do they have to do with our land being abandoned by God?"
The hall was silent for a second or two, then everyone habitually looked at "The Emperor."
Hobert said, "Twenty thousand pounds!"
Only now did he feel that his previous asking price seemed too low. Alas, 300,000 gold Lire!
Everyone was somewhat dazed, so that was why that piece of information was worth 20,000 pounds, because the Six Gods were involved in the Great Cataclysm!
Audrey sighed: There must be a huge secret here, I really want to know.
Then she thought: Soon, soon, the New Year is coming, and from next week, my financial situation will recover somewhat. If I am thrifty, saving a few thousand pounds a month should not be a problem. At most four months… no, three months, and I will definitely be able to save 20,000 pounds!
Klein guessed: Did the Six Gods play a positive or negative role in the Great Cataclysm? From the information I have now, the Six Gods seem to have risen around the time of the Great Cataclysm. Could the Great Cataclysm not be a fleeting historical event? But a period similar to a tide of the times, and the Six Gods seized the opportunity in this tide and gained considerable benefits? Also, the "Rose Redemption" that appeared in the murals is also a key. "The Emperor" mentioned it before, but only in passing, without going into detail.
Alger sighed: In previous gatherings, we have been discussing the secret history of the Fourth Epoch, and now it seems that the Third Epoch and the history between the Third and Fourth Epochs seem even more confusing.
Fors' mind was full of: Twenty thousand pounds! If I had this money, and solved the problem of the Full Moon Curse, I wouldn't think about advancing anymore, and I would definitely spend the rest of my life peacefully in the picturesque town of Jeffrey.
After receiving Mr. Emperor's answer, Derrick did not continue to dwell on this issue, because he remembered that Mr. Emperor had said that under Mr. Fool's guidance and protection, these questions would be answered sooner or later.
The reason they can't be answered now is only because their level is too low.
At this time, Mr. Fool, sitting at the head of the long bronze table, suddenly tapped the table with his hand.
Audrey and the other members looked excitedly at the head of the table, which meant that Mr. Fool had something important to remind them.
Mr. Fool said in a relaxed tone, "Rose Redemption!"
Everyone was stunned, "Rose Redemption" is also a key point?
At the same time, everyone noticed that Mr. Fool's state seemed to have changed, as if he had become more powerful and more indescribable.
If it were a normal gathering, Miss Justice would have been able to discover it during the greeting, but this time everyone's attention was drawn to "The Sun" from the beginning, and they only noticed it now.
Everyone had their own guesses, but the conclusions were similar: Mr. Fool's power is stronger than before.
Hobert also had similar guesses, has he advanced to Sequence 6? Of course, he is more powerful than before.
But Mr. Fool is still so "mysterious." After reminding them of the "Rose Redemption," he did not provide further explanations, and everyone had to turn their attention to Hobert again.
Hobert resisted the urge to twitch his lips: You finished showing off, and you want me to clean up the mess!
He sighed, thinking of an idiom that had been circulating for a long, long time: Don't expose people's difficulties.
"Mr. Fool's reminder is very important," Hobert said.
The nonsense the leader just said is very important!
He further explained, "Ouroboros was, and is now, a member of the 'Rose Redemption.' After Medici's fall, he should be the actual leader of this organization.
"Also, 'Rose Redemption' is indeed the key to unlocking that '20,000-pound question!'"
How is it? Am I giving enough face?
Alger: Mr. Fool knows the inside story of the Great Cataclysm!
Then he felt that his previous idea was a bit ridiculous: How could an ancient god like Mr. Fool not know these things?
Audrey asked curiously, "Medici?"
Hobert smiled, "That's another question."
I need more money.
Klein: I originally thought that 'Rose Redemption' was an organization loyal to the Fallen Creator and would be related to Ouroboros. I didn't expect 'Rose Redemption' to be connected to the Great Cataclysm!
Klein, the only one besides Hobert who knew some relevant information at the gathering, thought again: "Sure enough, Ouroboros is an important member of 'Rose Redemption.' Judging from 'The Emperor's' tone, 'Rose Redemption' seems to have undergone a huge change. The earliest 'Rose Redemption' is different from the current 'Rose Redemption'?
"Also, I remember 'The Emperor' mentioned the Medici family when talking about 'Angel Families.' But I have never heard of this family. Could it be that the angel of the Medici family has fallen, and this family has become decadent?"
Because of Hobert's influence on Rafter, Klein and Sharon did not come into contact with Medici's evil spirit through Rafter, so they did not know the Medici family and the information about "Bansy Harbor."
Derrick tried to summarize the information from the previous conversation: "Mr. Emperor, does Mr. Fool mean that 'Rose Redemption' and the image of Ouroboros in the murals are also key!"
Hobert was afraid that "Little Sun" would misunderstand: "Mr. Fool is reminding you to pay attention to relevant information about 'Rose Redemption.' This is the key to unlocking all the doubts in your heart."
Derrick stood up, thanked Mr. Fool and Mr. Emperor again, and then said to Hobert, "Mr. Emperor, thank you for publishing the knowledge. I will provide you with five Sequence 8-level materials as a reward after this matter is over.
"Adding the five main materials I owed you before, I owe you a total of ten main materials."
During this exploration, Derrick accumulated a lot of merit, and it was easy for him to exchange for ten Sequence 8-level main ingredients.
Hobert then remembered, "By the way, I have a mystical weapon here. I don't know if you are interested?
"This weapon is in the shape of a warhammer and has a certain probability of striking out flames. The darker the place, the higher the probability of striking out flames. The highest probability can reach 10%.
"It also has an ability to provoke with a certain probability, causing the surrounding enemies to change their attack target and attack the holder together."
Derrick: This, this is too suitable for use in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods!'
He asked, "Mr. Emperor, how can I get it?"
Hobert had already thought about the price: "Fifteen Sequence 8-level main ingredients, or seven Sequence 7-level main ingredients. The requirements are still the same as before, try to exchange them with the same materials."
Derrick stood up and said, "Thank you, Mr. Emperor."
He had calculated before that what the Emperor needed were those useless stock main materials. In the outside world, a Sequence 8 main material sells for 300 pounds, while those main materials accumulated for hundreds or even thousands of years in City of Silver have no value at all. The exchange ratio between the two parties is about 1:30.
And Mr. Emperor usually ignores this exchange ratio and treats the materials provided by Derrick, which are of little value in City of Silver, as a value of more than 200 pounds.
Derrick did not expect that the Emperor would not take the opportunity to bid up the price for a mystical weapon that he valued and that City of Silver needed very much.
He originally thought that Mr. Emperor would have to ask for at least 30 Sequence 8-level main materials, or even 50, and Derrick would not think it was too much.
Because even if he used 50 stock main materials, in the eyes of Derrick and the residents of City of Silver, exchanging them for a mystical weapon would be a very, very worthwhile deal.
In fact, Hobert was originally going to ask for 20 sets of mystical materials, but when he learned that he could crush the failures in Carrie's eyes and recycle the main materials, he felt that he could give "Little Sun" more profit margin. (Note)
Hobert smiled and said, "Since we are all members of the Tarot Club, we should naturally help each other."
Klein and Alger were a little envious. They roughly estimated that "The Emperor" could earn at least 2,000 pounds in this transaction.
They only used these materials as a unit of measurement, but they did not know that Hobert could use these main materials to create more mystical weapons, and the value would be more than doubled.
However, this transaction has a considerable time cost.
The two were envious, but they could not carry out similar transactions. Klein did not have the channel of a "Artisan," and although Alger knew a "Artisan," he had communicated with the "Artisan" not long ago, and the "Artisan" said that he was not good at making mystical weapons.
It wasn't impossible to make it, but the failure rate was relatively high. Alger did a simple calculation and realized he wouldn't earn much even after busying himself for a long time, so he gave up on the idea.
With the "Little Sun" issue resolved and the transaction completed, the Tarot Club returned to "normal."
Audrey contributed three pages of her diary, and now it was the Fool's reading time.
After a few minutes, Klein said in a calm tone, "You may begin your transactions."
Fors first turned to Miss Justice on one side and said, "I have received a reply. My teacher has a pair of Mirror Dragon's eyes, priced at 1,000 pounds."
After quoting the price, she was a little uneasy, because Dorian's teacher's asking price was 800 pounds, which was already a significant markup, and she had added a full 200 pounds on top of that.
Fors was prepared to haggle with Miss Justice and give a final price of 900.
"Deal," Audrey said with some joy!
At the New Year's ball, she would officially declare her adulthood, and her financial situation would immediately improve. Furthermore, New Year's was only a few days away.
D... Deal? This stunned Fors for a second or two: Why didn't she haggle?
The transaction was completed with the seller in a semi-dazed state.
Then Alger said, "Help me inquire about news of the 'Creator.' If the information is valuable, I will pay a reward ranging from 300 to 2,000 pounds."
This was a very well-paid task issued by the Church of Storms. Even a suspected clue could earn a reward of 300 pounds.
Klein, sitting at the head of the table, glanced at Hobert without leaving a trace.
Hobert sat up straight, as if he had nothing to do with it.
None of the other members had heard of the name "Creator." Audrey asked, "Hanged Man, who is the 'Creator'? Is this a nickname?"
"It's a title of respect!" Alger, who had inquired a lot of information from the church, quickly corrected, "I received news that yesterday at noon, an Beyonder family loyal to the 'Creator' had a fierce Beyonder battle with the 'Rose School' in General Antonie's territory.
"It is said that both sides dispatched Saints, and many people were turned into monsters and madmen by the aftermath of the battle. A large forest has since withered and become a wasteland."
With Alger's level, he only found out about this level of battle. The church did not announce to him that Angels had been dispatched at that time.
When he first heard the news, Alger once thought that the "Creator" was another identity of Mr. Fool, so he announced this task at the Tarot Club.
He didn't dare to test any further. He was reporting to his leader with the mentality of reporting his work: Look, should I report some less valuable clues to the church?
Of course, Klein also understood what Alger meant. He pondered for a moment before saying, "You can ask 'Emperor'!"
The first reason he said this was to tell "Emperor": Didn't expect that! I know that you are a believer of the "Creator."
In the future, if there are any matters involving the "Creator" or "God-level" events, it will be easier to handle!
For example, some things can be communicated with the "Creator." "Klein, a believer of Mr. Fool," sometimes needs the help of the "Creator," and Hobert, a believer of the "Creator," sometimes needs the help of the "Fool." We help each other, and it also means exchanging hostages.
This way, Klein would be more at ease when asking the "Creator" for help.
The second was to announce to everyone that "Emperor" was a believer of the "Creator." This was equivalent to the superior "Fool" certifying and introducing "Emperor."
Anyway, everyone would know this identity sooner or later. The effect of the superior "Fool" announcing it to everyone is completely different from "Emperor" announcing it himself, or other members announcing it for "Emperor"!
This is very similar to a colleague in the company doing a good deed, and the company boss or chairman personally praising him, which is completely different from the effect of other colleagues of the same level praising the good deed.
The "Fool" would be so considerate of a certain member because Hobert's further explanation of the "Rose Redemption" just now was very helpful, making Klein feel that he should show something in a way that is difficult for everyone to notice.
Alger, who felt he had some guesses about the "Creator" incident after hearing this news, was most surprised: Mr. Fool has already handed over some real-world affairs to "Emperor" to handle?
Audrey: Hobert knows something about the 'Creator'? Why haven't I heard him mention it?
Of course, Hobert also understood that this was not Klein kicking the ball to him, but creating an opportunity for him to announce another identity.
After announcing this identity, it was not impossible for some linkage to be achieved between the "Fool" and the "Creator."
Especially since Hobert knew that these members present, at least at the "demigod" level in the future, creating this relationship early on meant that the "Tarot Club" was likely to become the "Creator's" foreign aid in the future.
So Hobert first said to Klein, "You knew it all along!"
Hehehe, that was actually me telling you on purpose, hoping to "mutually support" you.
Then he said to Alger, "I am actually a believer of the 'Creator'!"
Alger took a deep breath: The "Creator" is not Mr. Fool! Is He, is He also an ancient god who is awakening? Otherwise, it would be impossible that I have never heard of His respected name before, but now He suddenly shows amazing strength! Mr. Fool knows the "Creator" and even brought the "Creator's" believer into the Tarot Club. Is there some kind of cooperation between the two ancient gods?
Audrey was somewhat unhappy: Humph! Hobert didn't even tell me!
Fors: Is the "Creator" a god like "Fool"? Otherwise, it would be impossible for "Emperor" to call himself a "believer." No wonder Mr. Emperor knows so much. It turns out that there is an organization similar to the "Tarot Club" behind him, or a secret organization like the "Aurora Order."
Derrick was a little envious: That's great, the god that Emperor believes in can still affect the real world.
"Then, then I won't report any information about the 'Creator,'" Alger didn't expect things to be like this. He was originally holding the mentality of "reporting to the leader," but he completely guessed wrong.
The most embarrassing thing was that the "Creator's" believer was sitting next to him, but he was issuing a task to obtain information about the "Creator."
Hobert smiled, "It's not impossible to provide some insignificant news."
Who would refuse money?
"You can report to the church," Hobert said, "In this battle, the 'Creator' prevented the descent of the 'Abomination'!"
Note: In Chapter 411, when Hobert went to Backlund to complete the Beyonder weapon transaction with Carrie, he talked about the problem of failed Beyonder weapons.
At that time, the author-kun ignored the law of conservation of Beyonder characteristics. Under the reminder of a book friend, he made relevant revisions.
The approximate content added after the revision is: Hobert realized that he could shatter the failed products and extract their Beyonder characteristics, so Jessica sent him the failed products.
