chapters.title: Chapter 428 - 428 Lack of money is a common problem for evil gods (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert felt that the Storm Church must also know that the "Creator" and the "Abomination" had also taken action in this battle. Even if they knew, they wouldn't be stingy with generous rewards.
Although the other members didn't know what "Abomination" represented, since it was related to "God," the level couldn't be low.
Klein and Alger even speculated whether there had been a battle at the Angel level in this fight?
Audrey simply asked, "Mr. Emperor, what does 'Abomination' mean? And also, what kind of organization is the 'Rose School'?"
Klein felt that one day, he would send Miss Justice a pure gold thumbs-up! To express his feelings at such moments. Miss Justice can always ask the questions he wants to ask when it's inconvenient for him to ask.
Although he had a good relationship with "Miss Bodyguard," Sharon had only revealed some information about the "Rose School" to him and hadn't talked about the "Abomination," so he also wanted to know, what is "Abomination"?
In order to unify the front, Hobert didn't hesitate to announce the relevant information about the "Rose School" to everyone: "This is a mysterious organization formed by the 'Prisoner' pathway, mainly active in the Southern Continent.
"The Beyonders of this pathway are good at curses and possession, but they themselves are also cursed and must endure great pain.
"For example, Sequence 7 of this pathway is called 'Werewolf.' They are like being cursed in some way, turning into werewolves during the full moon, completely losing their minds, and killing everyone around them, including their closest relatives.
"Initially, the main purpose of the 'Rose School' was to keep its members sufficiently restrained, resisting the pain and curses brought by the potion with firm will.
"But later, a great change occurred in the 'Rose School.' Members no longer maintained restraint but indulged in the madness and desires of their hearts, harming innocent people without any scruples, creating various bloody tragedies. It is an evil organization that all orthodox churches are trying their best to crack down on."
Klein behind the gray fog: This is consistent with Miss Sharon's description.
Alger: I didn't expect the "Rose School" to have a relatively restrained past.
Audrey: Sure enough, Mr. Fool's allies are also constantly cracking down on these evil organizations.
After hearing Hobert say that the "Rose School" was an evil organization, she had already classified the "Creator" as an ally of Mr. Fool.
Hobert added, "'Abomination' is the leader of the 'Rose School,' a Sequence 1."
Klein guessed: The "Creator" may be a "King of Angels," at least at the Sequence 1 level. But not a god, if it were a god and in good condition, he would never have heard of Him before.
Alger asked in surprise, "In this battle, did a battle of the Angel level, no, the God level, occur?"
Audrey and Fors also became surprised. Since entering the Fifth Epoch, there have been no records of divine warfare. Even battles at the Angel level, they have never heard of.
Hobert said, "In this battle, the 'Creator' and the 'Rose School' each sent two Angels, each sent three Saints, and both sides sent a total of nearly 200 'Mid Sequence' participants."
As long as the Storm Church knows the information of the "Creator," they will know all this information on the surface. It doesn't matter to tell Alger.
At this time, everyone was shocked by the strength of the "Creator!"
Klein: Can't compare, can't compare.
Alger: The scale and height of this battle have completely exceeded my imagination. Such strength should be comparable to established mysterious organizations like the 'Demoness Sect'! With two Angels, they even have the confidence to challenge the orthodox churches. It's just that the Saints and 'Mid Sequence' Beyonders still have obvious gaps compared to the orthodox churches. And before this, I had never heard any news about the 'Creator'!
Audrey: Although I don't know what such strength represents, it sounds very powerful. I wonder if the Angel serving the "Creator" knows the Angel serving Mr. Fool?
Fors: It sounds very powerful. I have never seen a battle involving so many Beyonders.
Derrick: That's great, City of Silver doesn't have the protection of Angels.
Hobert continued to Alger: "Of course, you only need to make a rough report, and the details can be blurred as much as possible. Re-package the channels to obtain information. I will give you one-tenth of the reward obtained from your church."
Alger already had an idea. He planned to wait until Wednesday or Thursday, after this matter further fermented, and after the relevant information became more familiar, he would falsely claim that he learned this information from a Feysac person.
He had inadvertently learned before that General Anton was a puppet controlled by the Feysac people. The other crew members did not know this information, which could be used here.
Audrey asked again, "Mr. Emperor, what was the result of this battle?"
Hobert smiled and said, "The 'Creator' won. I believe the 'Rose School' will be honest for a long time."
Then he said seriously, "But the followers of the 'Creator' also suffered considerable losses!"
"Please allow me to express my respect to them!" Audrey said, "They sacrificed for justice, very glorious!"
Alger was pondering: This may also be a struggle between gods, or the "Creator" may be expanding his sphere of influence. It seems that the situation in the Southern Continent will undergo a major change.
"Thank you." Hobert added, "If you encounter people from the 'Rose School,' as long as you determine that they are not members of the temperance faction, you must be careful! They must be criminals with blood on their hands, and there is a high probability that they are lunatics!"
This is the last step in unifying the front. Hobert estimated that even if everyone had never seen members of the "Rose School," they would have hostility towards the "Rose School" under his constant emphasis.
Now that the Balk family has taken refuge in the "Creator," he certainly wants to find allies to deal with the "Rose School" in the future.
Hobert asked Alger: "Have the major orthodox churches already learned about this battle? What is their reaction?"
There is no airtight wall in the world. Hobert's pathway is destined to launch some well-known battles or events. It is impossible to develop in a low-key manner like the "Fool."
However, Hobert doesn't have enemies as difficult as Amon. So far, besides George III, Hobert can't think of any other direct enemies of the "Creator."
In order for George III to become a god, there is not even a Sequence 1 in the "Black Emperor" pathway.
There are only two Sequence 1s in the adjacent pathways, "Hundred Eyed Demon Monarch" and "Holy Infant King," which are enough to protect the followers of the "Creator."
Alger replied, "Yes, I believe that the orthodox churches have already learned about this battle through their respective secret channels, especially with the Angel-level battle, the major churches must be very concerned about this matter.
"However, now the Storm Church and the Evernight Goddess Church are just watching, after all, the 'Creator' is cracking down on heretical organizations, and His main ruling area is not in the main dioceses of the orthodox churches.
"I don't know what the reaction of the other churches is yet."
Hobert nodded: "I know."
The reaction was similar to what he had imagined.
After this topic came to an end, Audrey suddenly said, "Mr. Fool, I have a question to ask Mr. Emperor. I request a private conversation with him."
Klein was stunned: What secrets are you two going to share again?
Hobert was also a little strange. What did Audrey want to talk to him about?
After the two established a separate communication space, Audrey asked, "Have you encountered any troubles recently?"
Hobert was stunned: "What?"
"At the beginning of the gathering, I found that something seemed to be troubling you."
Hobert smiled. Even if he adjusted his emotions and was relatively restrained after the gathering started, Audrey still noticed.
"Indeed, I have encountered troubles." Hobert smiled and said, "Lack of money!"
Klein behind the gray fog: This is also my trouble.
Audrey was stunned: "How much do you lack?"
"200,000 pounds!"
Audrey almost couldn't maintain her "Spectator" state: "2-200,000 pounds? You, why do you need so much money?"
If there were such a fortune, it would be enough to be among the top social circles of Backlund. If there were a certain amount of influence, it would not be impossible to become a member of the Lower House.
Klein: Fortunately, I have the Clown's abilities, otherwise the "Fool" would have lost his composure! 200,000 pounds! Did your whole family get scammed to Myanmar?
If the construction project of the territory only costs 100,000 gold pounds, Hobert has the confidence to raise it, after all, he has accumulated so many Beyonder characteristics.
Just selling the Beyonder characteristics of the "Hunter" and "Lawyer" pathways in his hand can basically raise this money.
As for 300,000 gold pounds, even if he took out the Beyonder characteristics in his own body, it would be difficult to raise this money.
Of course, if he were willing to sell those Sealed Artifacts and the Beyonder characteristics of the "Prisoner" pathway demigods and above, this money could be easily raised, but Hobert would rather have a stalled project than let those Beyonder characteristics flow back into the hands of the "Rose School." This is a strategic issue.
Hobert smiled and said, "I am doing something that requires a lot of money."
Audrey considered for a moment before saying, "I can lend you 10,000 pounds a week or two after the New Year."
Hobert shook his head: "I'll go find some investment first."
If not, he will borrow from Christian. His savings over the years should be considerable.
Even if he doesn't borrow from Christian, it is not difficult for him to come forward and help raise some funds. Among the arms dealers, there are many wealthy people.
Hobert wondered to himself: I wonder if they're still willing to marry their daughter to me?
Audrey said "Oh" and then asked, "Is General Christian's treason related to the 'Creator'?"
Hearing Audrey say this, Klein realized this issue: Could this be the 'Creator's' scheme in the Northern Continent?
However, Hobert immediately denied Audrey's guess: "I am the only one in my family who is a favored of the 'Creator,' and my family doesn't know this."
He smiled and said, "Or rather, there aren't many favored of the 'Creator' in the Northern Continent."
Before yesterday, there weren't many favored of the "Creator" in the whole world.
Audrey felt much better: Maybe his identity as a favored of the "Creator" needs to be kept secret, and he can't even tell his family, and of course, he can't tell us, his good friends.
She smiled and said, "Hobert, I'm already Sequence 8, and I should be able to reach Sequence 7 soon."
"Congratulations, congratulations!" Hobert smiled and said, "I've just advanced too, and I'm already Sequence 5!"
Audrey's smile disappeared: "Hobert, you're not a gentleman at all."
Klein smiled: Serves you right for being single!
But then he thought about it and felt that Hobert's answer was a high EQ response; only friends who weren't very close would blindly flatter.
Finally, Klein realized: He's Sequence 5, how come I can't tell at all?
He opened his Spirit Vision and saw that Hobert's spiritual body seemed more solid inside, as if it contained the power of order and rules, yet it was full of dissonance and chaos, looking very contradictory.
Klein thought: Is this Sequence 5? Although there hasn't been a qualitative change, he can already conceal the internal structure of his spiritual body.
After Audrey and Hobert finished communicating, they entered the final information exchange session.
At the end of the exchange session, "The World" said in a hoarse voice, "Ladies and gentlemen, some news I've received recently indicates that a major event is brewing in Backlund, which will bring extremely unstable factors, and perhaps a tragedy will occur."
Audrey asked with concern, "What major event is it?"
"I don't know the specifics." Then "The World" raised his head and sincerely looked at "The Fool" across the long bronze table: "Your favored in Backlund, Honorable Mr. Fool, should also have noticed something, right?"
Everyone's eyes focused on the head of the long bronze table, and Hobert also looked towards the head: Are they playing a duet again?
"The Fool" Klein leaned back slightly under everyone's gaze and said in a calm tone, "Edessak Augustus."
Audrey: Edessak? Will he be in danger? Or will he cause some danger?
Fors: Augustus? Is this a prince? The king has already lost one son, could his other son also be in danger?
Hobert smiled: I knew it, how could an ordinary person resist in front of a Witch?
Everyone discussed this topic briefly for a few more sentences, and this week's Tarot Gathering ended.
...
Backlund, Empress Borough, inside Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
Audrey stood in front of the full-length mirror, staring blankly at herself in the mirror: Hobert is already Sequence 5, so fast!
Then she thought again: Edessak... could it be that something will happen to the royal family?
She drew a scarlet moon on the figure in the mirror, trying to make herself optimistic, and prepared to inquire about news from her parents and brother at dinner in the best condition.
She restrained her emotions, sat in front of the piano, and casually played music, using beautiful melodies to cleanse her soul.
After playing for a while, she found that the golden retriever Susie had opened the door and came in at some point, sitting next to her.
"Audrey, what problem have you encountered? Your piano music tells me that you have something bothering you," Susie suddenly said.
Audrey was stunned for a moment, not knowing how to answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - 429: Sequence 2 and Sequence 3 Ritual (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the Forsaken Land, within a city that had converted to the "Fallen Creator."
With his eyes closed, Derrick quietly recalled the information he had obtained at the Tarot Gathering, confirming that he had not forgotten the memories of repeatedly experiencing the same segment of life.
As the frequency of lightning gradually stabilized, Chief Colin, sitting cross-legged and leaning against a stone pillar, spoke: "Depart after 50 lightning strikes."
Derrick took a deep breath, once again reviewing the plan he had made at the Tarot Gathering.
During this exploration, he attempted to damage the mural inscribed with the words "Redemption Rose", but nothing happened.
Derrick looked at Ouroboros's image in the mural: It's not the mural's fault.
Chief Colin and the other members of the team were drawn to Derrick's abnormality.
Fortunately, "Little Sun" had made considerable progress under the guidance of "The Hanged Man" Alger, and he falsely claimed to have seen a small blond boy, concealing his act of damaging the mural.
Because of his reminder, when the exploration team arrived at the room with the altar and saw the little boy named Jack, the chief scrutinized his yellow hair, and everyone immediately became alert.
Just as the chief was considering how to respond to the little boy's plea for help, Derrick suddenly asked, "How can we save you?"
The little boy Jack revealed an excited expression: "Save me, send me home!"
Colin glanced at Derrick, not stopping their conversation.
Derrick asked curiously and fearfully: "Where is your home?"
The little boy weakly raised his hand and said: "My home is in Enmat Harbor."
Derrick gripped the "Hurricane Axe" in his hand: Enmat Harbor? Although Mr. Emperor and Mr. Hanged Man didn't mention it, judging from the word 'harbor,' Jack really doesn't belong here.
Thinking of this, Derrick felt a burst of joy, unable to hide his excitement.
His reaction did not arouse suspicion from Chief Colin and his companions, because they were just as excited.
Even Colin couldn't help but ask: "How did you, or you all, come here?"
The little boy Jack revealed a look of reminiscence: "My father and I first traveled by boat, then joined his companions and continued by boat. After a very, very big storm, the remaining people landed and followed the direction of the Lord's gaze, all the way to here."
Following the direction of the Lord's gaze? Colin and Derrick and the others almost simultaneously looked towards the statue on the altar.
Then they seemed to look in the opposite direction of the statue's gaze in perfect unison, the surrounding map gradually perfected by City of Silver's continuous exploration appearing in everyone's minds.
Giant King's Court!
That direction is the ruins of the Giant King's Court!
At this moment, Derrick keenly noticed that there was dark red blood slowly seeping from the clothes on the little boy Jack's chest and abdomen.
"Are you injured?" he asked cautiously.
Jack lowered his head, answering in a drifting tone: "Some bad things have grown..."
As he spoke, he pulled open his clothes, revealing his naked chest and abdomen. There, inlaid, were two eyes, a nose, and a mouth.
That human face was gentle and indifferent, very much like the silver-haired angel in the mural!
Derrick felt somewhat excited: Mr. Emperor's guess was correct, this little boy is the key, it is because of that "King of Angels's" ability that we are trapped here.
"I'm so hungry..." Jack's mouth stretched to the roots of his ears: "So hungry..."
The power of madness and corruption spread around, and Chief Colin originally wanted to seal Jack, but the little boy was very fragile. As soon as Colin made a move, Jack fell to the ground.
Derrick felt dazed for a moment, and when he regained consciousness, he was back to the time when they were just preparing to set up camp.
Until Chief Colin said: "Depart after 50 lightning strikes."
The seventh exploration began quickly. This time, Derrick did not damage the mural. They once again arrived at the room with the altar and found the little boy Jack.
After a conversation similar to the previous exploration, Derrick once again saw the human face on Jack's body. He did not make any stimulating moves, but instead lowered his voice and said to Colin: "Chief, the human face on his chest looks very similar to the angel in the mural just now."
Colin was first stunned, then glanced at Derrick out of the corner of his eye.
After a few seconds of silence, he said in a low voice: "Your reminder reminds me of something. I once saw records about the 'King of Angels' in the classics..."
Derrick almost nodded repeatedly, saying yes, yes, yes.
This aligns with the information provided by Mr. Emperor. Mr. Emperor's information is indeed so accurate and reliable!
Colin looked at the abnormality in Derrick's eyes, and continued without pausing: "...It is said that when the 'the Omniscient and Omnipotent God' was watching this world, He was surrounded by many angels.
"Among them, the leader of all angels, the Kings of Angels closest to God's work, there are eight in total.
"Unfortunately, in the long history, the records in the classics are somewhat brief, and only two Kings of Angels have relatively detailed records.
"One of the Kings of Angels is called the Angel of Fate, 'Ouroboros, the Tail-Devourer.'"
This time, Derrick had to hold his chin to suppress the urge to nod: Regardless of the pathway, alias, or name, it's exactly the same as Mr. Emperor said!
He tried to make himself look somewhat surprised: "The Tail-Devourer?"
Colin looked at the little boy Jack: "This means that we may have stepped into a river that we cannot leave, a river with its head and tail connected.
"Fortunately, this should only be some of the power left by that Angel of Fate. He is not hiding here."
As he spoke, Colin took out a dark red metal tube, unscrewed the lid, and drank the liquid inside.
His light blue eyes quickly faded, his pupils standing up, reflecting the figure of the little boy Jack.
Colin first inserted the long sword in his hand into the ground, then pulled out another straight sword, coating it with golden, sunlight-like oil.
The little boy Jack noticed Colin's actions, and his expression immediately changed, as if a thick shadow enveloped him.
Before Jack could open his mouth, Colin pulled out the long sword stuck in the ground, and the two swords emitted golden and silver-white light respectively.
The two rays of light impacted the shadow on the little boy Jack's body. After a shrill scream, the golden and silver-white rays of light disappeared, and the human face between the little boy Jack's chest and abdomen disappeared, leaving only a hollow where wriggling internal organs could be seen.
A few meters to Jack's side, Colin's two swords pierced a fragmented human face. The organs on the human face twitched a few times, and then there was no movement.
For a moment, Derrick felt that there was an invisible, water-wall-like barrier silently breaking around him.
He was overjoyed, knowing that he and the others had finally escaped the repeated life.
At this moment, Derrick sincerely thanked Mr. Emperor and Mr. Fool. It was they who gave him reminders and solutions to the problem, otherwise he might have to repeat it dozens or hundreds of times to find clues.
Moreover, people always repeat the same choices. If they can't find the problem the first time, without the corresponding memories and experience, they probably won't notice the abnormality the hundredth or thousandth time.
Thinking of this, Derrick once again realized how terrifying and bizarre the power of the "King of Angels" was!
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert accepted the bounty of 1020 pounds that Alger had received. He put the money aside and stared at the roof for a while: "The Great Smog of Backlund, huh!"
The room was silent for a long time before Hobert suddenly got up and came to the "Nation of Disorder".
This time, he turned to the back of the "Iron Throne", where there was a stone coffin. With a wave of his hand, the "Power of Order" covering the coffin disappeared.
With another wave of his hand, the stone lid of the coffin opened.
Inside, a spirit body lay flat, sometimes solidifying and sometimes slightly fading.
If you ignore the process of his fading from time to time, this spirit body is no different from a normal person.
His eyes were closed, he had a straight nose, and his hairline was slightly high. It was Dunn Smith's spirit body, which Hobert had spent a lot of effort to protect.
Hobert said: "Sorry, Captain Smith, I've been busy recently and haven't had time to find someone to help you shape a brand new body. I guess you'll have to lie here for a while.
"Take a good rest, after all, your potion always made it difficult for you to sleep well before."
As he spoke, Hobert showed a slight wry smile: "Since coming to this world, there have been too many things that make me unwilling. I want to change some things, and I have been working hard for it.
"But, but I'm still too weak! The Tingen incident is like this. After I got involved, not only did I fail to save you, but things became more complicated.
"I'm too weak, too weak."
Hobert leaned weakly against the coffin and sat down: "This matter is also too complicated. Although I have an angel-level assistant, I dare not use it. If I push Adam too hard, then I will be helping to make things worse.
"This doesn't even include the Augustus family's angels and the power of the church. My appearance will only make things more complicated."
He let out a long breath, as if he had made up his mind: "Never mind, I still have a pile of my own troublesome things!"
Hobert stood up, put the stone lid back on, and re-wrapped the stone coffin with the "Power of Order".
He sat on the "Iron Throne" and smiled: "What am I worried about? A small Sequence 5, why bother so much? As long as Klein doesn't ask me for help, I'll pretend this never happened!"
Shaking his head, Hobert looked at the pool in front of him. Many stars were expanding, and Hobert spread his spirituality over.
The owners of these new stars were all members of the Balk family, and there was no substantive content, just their daily prayers.
Hobert found Upton's star and told him that the "Favored of God" would go back to meet him at 9:30 tomorrow.
Then he reached out and summoned the two "failed products" that Jessica had sent him. Using the power of the "Nation of Disorder", he easily shattered the weapons and aggregated the Beyonder characteristics inside.
The Beyonder characteristics of mystical materials are obviously smaller than the Beyonder characteristics of a certain sequence, only the size of a finger, but the effects are still there, just without the shape of the materials. I wonder if Carrie will be affected when using them?
Then Hobert thought of another thing. He picked up the "Black Emperor Card" placed on the handle of the "Iron Throne" and looked at the back.
"Sequence 3: Frenzied Mage
"Main materials: The complete brain of a six-whiskered strange beast, a complete phantom multi-eyed butterfly.
"Auxiliary materials: 12 ml of white-striped spider venom, scales and crystals of the carp, 8 ml of brain fluid of the six-whiskered strange beast, 50 ml of red wine stored for eight years.
"Ritual: Achieve amazing achievements in a certain field, so that people associate the abstract concept of that field with the actual name of the Beyonder. The more people who can associate the two, the greater the probability of successful advancement."
Hobert sighed. The ritual for advancing to Sequence 4 only requires seizing a certain amount of power and wealth. As long as you plan in advance, it is not too difficult.
However, the ritual for Sequence 3 is completely on a different level. It is already developing in the direction of associating the Beyonder with certain conceptual things, and you have to plan in advance and find a good field to "achieve amazing achievements".
If you want to associate a certain field with a name, Hobert has many examples in his mind, such as e-commerce and Bezos, electronic communication and Zuckerberg, mobile phones and Steve Jobs or Tim Cook, and so on.
To achieve this, the conditions of the times, environment, culture, policies, and personal efforts are indispensable!
After thinking about it, Hobert finally had a good idea: crossing the river by feeling the stones of Emperor Roselle!
It has been more than a hundred years now, but when it comes to consul and emperor, the first thing everyone thinks of is Roselle!
Relatively speaking, the royal family of the Feysac Empire seems to have no presence at all.
This is enough to show that Roselle has done the emperor profession to the extreme!
Of course, Hobert also knows that the environment and conditions of Emperor Roselle's time are no longer available. It is impossible to make everyone familiar with him by "being an emperor" in Sequence 4.
But you can refer to Roselle's history of success and use the advanced ideas of the AD era to achieve amazing achievements in a certain field.
Hobert nodded slowly. This is a good idea. If you have time, you can think about it carefully.
He picked up the "Black Emperor Card" again and continued to read.
"Sequence 2: Duke of Entropy
"Main materials: The complete brain of a black-scaled emperor crystalline gold beast, or the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Duke of Entropy'.
"Auxiliary materials: 10 ml of blood of the black-scaled emperor crystal gold beast, 10 ml of bile of the blue-blooded emperor crystal gold beast, 60 ml of white wine stored for 9 years.
"Ritual: Cause a chaos involving all levels in the largest city in the world, and use the unique and unprecedented new order proposed by the Beyonder to quell the chaos. Drink the potion in the confusion and helplessness that this chaos brings to people, and in the unwillingness of people to accept the new order."
Hobert put down the "Black Emperor Card". When he first got this blasphemy card, he glanced at the rituals for advancing to Sequence 3 and Sequence 2.
At that time, it may have been because his own level was not high and he felt that this step was still far away, so he didn't think much of it.
Now, seriously looking at the advancement rituals of these two sequences, there is only one thought in his mind: Is it too late to change the pathway now?
This is clearly a script prepared for Roselle, but Roselle directly advanced to "Black Emperor", and he did not use any of these rituals that he could achieve without much preparation!
Hobert chuckled silently: I have so many troubling things, what does the Backlund smog count for?
Right?
...
Southern Continent, Crowlier Town.
Elliot could feel that Governor Jonas and General Anthony were noticeably more enthusiastic towards the members of the Balk family.
Governor Jonas warmly invited the Balk family members injured in the battle to recuperate at his manor.
Originally, those members who were in mortal danger were already jumping around after being treated by the "Creator", while the slightly injured who had not been treated by the "Creator" had to find a place to recuperate.
General Anthony offered one of his luxury villas for Lawrence and other elders to live in.
In the huge villa, only a few elders and Elliot, the favored one of the "Creator", lived.
But there were no less than a hundred servants in the villa.
On Tuesday morning, Elliot got up early and ordered the servants to prepare refreshments and tea, as he was going to entertain the "Blessed of God".
Even the patriarch Lawrence could only wait outside the reception room for the "Blessed of God" to receive him.
Elliot often looked at the pocket watch on the table, watching the time pass minute by minute.
Finally, at 7:58, the space in the corner of the reception room suddenly became illusory, and the "Blessed of God" wearing a mask and carrying a wooden box came out from inside.
Elliot also quickly put on his mask, and he stood up and said, "Blessed of God!"
Hobert nodded: "Sit."
He sat consciously at the head, placing the wooden box on the table to his left.
Elliot then sat down: "Blessed of God, thank you for providing the 'Disorder Stone', which allowed us to maintain the initiative on the battlefield despite being significantly outnumbered."
Hobert smiled: "This is all the guidance of the 'Creator'."
"Praise the Creator!"
Hobert had no choice but to follow: "Praise the Creator!"
Elliot asked, "Blessed of God, what gesture should be used to praise the Creator?"
The mask concealed Hobert's awkward smile: This, the 'Creator' and the 'Blessed of God' have not considered it yet!
But without a gesture, it seems like a scam.
Hobert had no choice but to borrow from the memory in his mind. Hobert stood up, hammering his chest with one hand and his back with the other: "Praise the Creator!"
Elliot followed suit, feeling that the first half of the action was a bit like the gesture of the Storm Church, but more powerful. He even felt that he had become more energetic in these two beatings!
Hobert smiled: "The slogan of praise can also be: Offer my heart!
"It means willing to dedicate one's life to the 'Creator', to lofty ideals and goals!"
Elliot's excitement made the back of his head tingle: This represents the most sincere loyalty to the 'Creator'! And lofty ideals and goals! This is the power of faith!
A dozen seconds later, Elliot gradually calmed down from his self-admiration, and the two sat down again.
Hobert said: "I have considered the matter mentioned in your letter, please ask Lawrence to come in."
After Lawrence came in, he inevitably exchanged a few pleasantries.
After praising the "Creator" again and thanking the "Blessed of God", Lawrence, sitting on Hobert's side, said: "Blessed of God, I would like to talk about the future development direction of the Balk family this time."
Hobert was still a little uncomfortable with this kind of religious conversation. He took a deep breath. Even if he was uncomfortable, he had to adapt. As the "Blessed of God", the consequences would be very serious if he showed any slackness towards the "Creator".
Lawrence continued: "We are preparing to purchase some manors and land to enrich the family's industry. If there is an opportunity to purchase mines, that would be great.
"The next step is to prepare more family members to go out to the small towns for training, and gradually occupy more positions in General Anthony's territory, and jointly control General Anthony's territory with the Forsaken.
"In the future, we also plan to expand our power to the surrounding areas, such as General Adrian's territory in the south, and the Arenas Autonomous Region in the northwest.
"In short, we will control more resources, wealth and population. If the 'Blessed of God' has any needs in this regard, we are willing to dedicate these resources and wealth to you."
Hobert said: "If the 'Creator's' cause has needs, I will come to you.
"But I have some immature suggestions for the future development direction of the Balk family."
"Please speak!" Lawrence of course knew that the so-called "immature suggestions" were instructions from the "Blessed of God"!
"The industrial age has arrived!" Hobert said: "Instead of investing all the wealth in resource-based industries, it is better to simply invest in manufacturing.
"The looting model of the countries in the Northern Continent is to import cheap raw materials and resources from the Southern Continent, process them into industrial products, and then sell them to the Southern Continent. This makes the wealth of the Southern Continent and the Rorsted Archipelago flow to the Northern Continent.
"In seemingly voluntary transactions, resource looting and industrial looting are realized.
"And industrial products are still scarce in the Southern Continent, and the prices are several times higher than in the Northern Continent."
These words opened Lawrence and Elliot's eyes. After all, they had been nestling in the Southern Continent for so many years. Although Lawrence had the ambition to revitalize the family, his vision and concepts had become disconnected from the world.
Hobert said: "In today's world, and for a long time to come, if you want to be self-reliant, you must experience the beatings of the industrial age!
"It is difficult for other extraordinary families, or even old extraordinary organizations such as the 'Rose School' and the 'Numinous Episcopate', to accumulate wealth with industrial products.
"But the Balk family is relatively easy, because the 'Creator' has many dependents in the Northern Continent, and they can help you buy some machines that are prohibited from being exported by the Northern countries, and then send them to the Southern Continent through offerings to the 'Creator'.
"You can start with the textile industry or the smelting industry, and gradually accumulate the management model and technology of the industrial age.
"At that time, the Balk family's industry will be useful to the 'Creator', and the 'Creator' will pay more attention to the Southern Continent."
Lawrence clapped his hands: "Thank you, Blessed of God, for guiding the way. Whether it is textiles or smelted metal, they are very popular in the Southern Continent."
Hobert nodded: "While building factories, you can select a group of outstanding young people from the family to study in the Northern Continent."
Lawrence quickly said: "Then I will have to trouble the 'Blessed of God' to help arrange the study matters."
"No problem, but you must let them learn Loen or Feynapotter in advance." Hobert said: "Or I will see if I can get permanent spells in these two languages through channels."
Lawrence said: "I will have Elliot write to you again about the specific matters."
He also said: "Respected Blessed of God, you should know the situation of the Balk family, so we would like to buy as many Beyonder characteristics from you as possible."
"I brought them." Hobert opened the lid of the wooden box on the table, which was full of various Beyonder characteristics of the "Lawyer" pathway below demigod.
Lawrence and Elliot were stunned. Originally, they thought that they could buy at most a dozen Beyonder characteristics, but they did not expect that it would be like wholesale.

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - 430 Trissy Cheek (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert introduced, "I have brought a total of 18 Beyonder characteristics of the 'Lawyer', and 17 Beyonder characteristics of the 'Barbarian'.
"Now that you are already believers of the 'Creator', these two Beyonder characteristics can be sold to you at the base price of 300 pounds and 600 pounds respectively.
"For Sequence 7 and above Beyonder characteristics, because the 'Favored Ones' have more difficulty acquiring them, or there is a premium when purchasing them, selling them to you will also have a premium."
Lawrence's eyes never left the wooden box, and he nodded, "That's understandable, understandable."
In the Southern Continent, the premium for Beyonder characteristics or materials is generally higher than in the Northern Continent, which Lawrence fully accepts.
At the same time, Lawrence had a renewed understanding of the power of the 'Creator's' 'Favored'. Being able to accumulate so many Beyonder characteristics indicates a large organization.
The reason there are so many Beyonder characteristics is simply because the 'Creator' has the skill of 'reprocessing'. For example, obtaining a Beyonder characteristic of 'Mentor of Disorder' is just one to others, but for Hobert, it is five Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert continued to introduce, "I also brought 11 Beyonder characteristics of the 'Briber', each for 1500 pounds."
In fact, there were two more that he didn't bring, which were reserved for Jessica and Upton.
He continued, "There are also 6 Beyonder characteristics of the 'Baron of Corruption', each for 4000 pounds.
"And one Beyonder characteristic of the 'Mentor of Disorder', for 8000 pounds."
"No problem!" Lawrence said almost immediately. In his opinion, the premium given by Hobert was not high.
Hobert smiled and said, "That's good, then the total value of the 'Lawyer' Beyonder characteristics is 5400 pounds, the 'Barbarian' Beyonder characteristics is 10200 pounds, and the 'Briber' Beyonder characteristics is 16500 pounds.
"Plus 6 'Baron of Corruption' Beyonder characteristics, worth 24000 pounds, plus 8000 pounds, totaling 64100 pounds. I'll round it down to 64000 pounds for you."
"Good, good, good!" Lawrence first said "good" several times, then smiled and said, "Well, we have a little shortage of gold pounds. The entire family only has a total of 3000 pounds.
"Can we use currencies from other countries to pay? Or simply pay with gold?"
Previously, the Balk family mainly operated in the "killer and mercenary service industry", with business mainly in the central and southern parts of West Balam.
And the entire West Balam is not within the sphere of influence of Loen. Various countries' currencies circulate here, and many people only recognize gold.
After friendly consultation, the final payment for this batch of Beyonder characteristics was divided into three methods: 3000 gold pounds, 24000 gold Lire to replace 20000 pounds, and 41000 pounds worth of gold.
Hobert left the Beyonder characteristics first, and at the latest in the evening, he would hand over the gold and paper money to the "God's Favored" through a sacrifice to the "Creator".
This was because Lawrence was here to fight this time, so he certainly wouldn't bring so much money. He was prepared to use his Saint's ability to have the family members staying in the town count the payment and make the sacrifice.
After the transaction, Hobert secretly breathed a sigh of relief. The money for the first batch of building materials was finally available, and even half of the money for the second batch of building materials was available.
This gave him time to raise more funds.
At the end of the conversation, Hobert said to Lawrence, "Don't have too much conflict with the 'Rose School' recently, and focus on restoring your strength first."
"Yes." Lawrence said, "But we should be able to recover our strength soon."
The Balk family can pray for power to the sealed artifact that creates the barrier of "Nonexistent Town", and crush the Beyonder characteristics. This is the key to their survival.
Some family members are waiting for the Beyonder characteristics to advance. As soon as the Beyonder characteristics are crushed, new combat power can be formed immediately, and these Beyonder characteristics that Hobert sold to the Balk family can also be quickly digested by them.
Hobert nodded, "Development is the absolute principle!"
Then Hobert asked Eliot, "Have both 'Disorder Stones' been used?"
Eliot took out the used "Disorder Stones": "They have all been used."
Hobert took out the two "Disorder Stones" that he had prepared earlier and recovered the two used stones.
Then he said to Lawrence, "You can also exchange new 'Order Wood' by praying to the 'Creator' with the used 'Order Wood'. If there is any loss, report it to the 'Creator' immediately."
This was the purpose of his exchange of "Disorder Stones" with Eliot: to tell Lawrence that he must recover the "Order Wood".
Lawrence nodded repeatedly. The "Order Wood" in his hand could still be used for more than ten minutes.
The three chatted for a few more words, and Hobert got up to say goodbye, leaving with "Traveling".
After two transfers, Hobert came to the forest in the Conant City Cemetery again. Here, he took out the gold that Eliot had sacrificed twice before, as well as the prepared mask from the "Nation of Disorder".
Then, under the guidance of the "Faceless Necklace", he used "Traveling" to come to the "Roselle Exhibition Hall", Upton's office.
Upton was somewhat surprised by the way the "God's Favored" appeared. He had originally instructed the employees in the exhibition hall that if anyone was looking for him, they should bring him up, but the "God's Favored" came by himself.
"God's Favored!" Upton got up and locked the door.
"I have brought a new task." Hobert went straight to the point, "As long as you complete this task, you can get the remaining one-third of the Beyonder characteristic of the 'Briber'."
Upton's eyes lit up. His "Barbarian" potion had been completely digested, and he was preparing to buy the remaining one-third of the Beyonder characteristic of the "Briber" with gold pounds.
He smiled and asked, "What is the task? Is the reward worth more than 400 pounds?"
Theoretically, one-third of a Sequence 7 Beyonder characteristic is worth about 400 pounds, but a Sequence 8 Beyonder characteristic already has a premium, let alone a Sequence 7 Beyonder characteristic?
Hobert took out the list he had prepared earlier: "Purchase the materials on the list."
"Such a large quantity!" Upton couldn't help but be surprised.
"How much do you estimate it will cost?"
Upton, who had contact with merchants from all walks of life by selling steam engines, roughly knew the price of bulk building materials.
He made a simple estimate: "38,000 pounds to 41,000 pounds!"
After saying this number, he was surprised again. He originally thought that he had made a lot of money recently, but compared to this number, he sighed: Selling me wouldn't raise that much money.
Upton had such thoughts because he was worried that the "God's Favored" would ask him to pay in advance like last time.
Hobert was sighing in his heart at this time that the price of building materials in Loen was much lower than in Feynapotter.
In Feynapotter, these materials would cost at least 56,000 gold Lire, which is equivalent to nearly 47,000 pounds!
Sure enough, infrastructure construction can best show comprehensive national strength. In this regard, Feynapotter does have a certain gap with Loen.
Hobert said, "Just buying these materials doesn't require one-third of the 'Briber' Beyonder characteristic as a reward. I have another commission."
As he spoke, he took out the cloth bag containing gold: "These transactions can only be settled with gold. You must find a suitable channel to exchange the gold for gold pounds.
"This gold is worth about 5500 pounds to 5800 pounds. You can use it as a deposit for the goods first, and in a few days, I will bring you gold worth no less than 36,000 pounds."
"No problem." For Upton, who had local gang channels and had initially established business contacts, selling such a large batch of gold was stressful, but not a big problem!
He thought to himself: When I sell gold worth more than 40,000 pounds, the price of gold in the entire Conant will probably fall.
He was very satisfied with the "God's Favored's" reward. After all, large-scale building material business is not difficult to achieve, it just takes some time and renting a warehouse.
Finally, Hobert gave Upton the mask: "After the test of time, you are now a formal Favored One of the 'Creator'.
"This is a symbol of the 'Creator's' Favored. This mask has the ability to resist divination. Injecting spirituality can form a shield that lasts for one or two seconds, which can effectively block the attacks of Beyonder abilities! In addition, after wearing it, it will be less prone to loss of control!"
"Less prone to loss of control!" Upton almost shouted. After he finished speaking, he realized his gaffe, but fortunately there was no one else here.
Taking the mask, Upton gently stroked it. His parents died because of signs of loss of control for different reasons, so he had a heart knot about loss of control no less than that of the Balk family members.
Hobert smiled and said, "Praise the Creator!"
Upton quickly followed, "Praise the Creator!"
This praise was particularly sincere.
Hobert also said, "I have another task here. A group of Favored from the Southern Continent want to come to Loen's textile factories, smelting factories, and some factories that produce daily necessities to learn. Please arrange it for them.
"The reward will be settled directly with gold or with Beyonder characteristics."
Upton pondered for a moment: "This is not too difficult. I can usually contact many such factory owners. I can exchange discounts on steam engines or maintenance and upkeep discounts for opportunities to learn in their factories."
Hobert nodded: "I will compensate you for the discounts you give at twice the price, as tuition."
Upton didn't refuse any more: "Okay."
Finally, Hobert took out a piece of paper with the method of summoning the messenger and the reward for sending the letter, so that Upton could write to him directly if he had anything to do in the future.
After the "God's Favored" left, Upton read the summoning spell again: "It's 'Traitor' Hobert!"
...
Backlund, in the underground building of the vampire Marquis Nibbs.
Emlyn White looked at the iron-black coffin and said to the ancient vampire lying inside, "Lord Nibbs, I accept the Ancestor's mission!"
A few days ago, Nibbs claimed to have received instructions from the Ancestor, asking the excellent young vampire Emlyn to pray to "The Fool".
In fact, the Ancestor did not specify that Emlyn should complete it, but Nibbs believed that Emlyn, who already believed in the Earth Mother and the Ancestor, was very suitable to complete this task.
If the task is completed, then everyone is happy. If it is not completed, and "The Fool" projects strong malice, then for the vampires, Emlyn's death is not a loss.
Nibbs heard Emlyn's words and responded in an old voice: "Very good, when do you want to start? Is there any wish you haven't fulfilled?"
What wish... hasn't been fulfilled? Emlyn felt his calf soften and almost regretted it.
But when he thought that this was the Ancestor's mission, he straightened his neck and said, "No need! I can start now!"
So Emlyn, who was no stranger to rituals, lit candles, burned essential oils and herbal powders under the protection of Lord Nibbs.
In the smoky atmosphere, Emlyn began to repeatedly recite the honorific name of "The Fool": "The Fool who does not belong to this era..."
After reciting for more than ten minutes, Emlyn was a little tired. He said half relieved and half disappointed: "Lord Nibbs, there is no response."
Nibbs was silent for a long time before saying in a rather hoarse voice: "Okay, don't leave yet, wait here for a while."
After spending more than an hour in worry and trepidation, Emlyn left the underground building, his destination was the Harvest Church in the South Bridge district.
Just as he got into the carriage, Emlyn suddenly felt a blur in front of his eyes and saw an endless gray-white fog.
Then, he was shocked to find himself in a mysterious and majestic giant palace, sitting at an ancient bronze long table.
At the top of the long table, there was a great figure, looking down at him: "Why are you praying to me?"
Emlyn's mind suddenly "buzzed" and blurted out: "This is the Ancestor's revelation..."
He told everything about the Ancestor choosing him, plus his own inner activities, and the fearless spirit when facing the Ancestor's mission, all in one breath, just short of reporting the number and characteristics of his dolls.
Klein heard that this was Lilith's revelation, and he thought of the simple description of Lilith in Roselle's diary, and the "Emperor's" relevant information on the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway.
He couldn't help but come to the conclusion: Could this be the instruction of the Evernight Goddess, after all, the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway is with the Goddess.
One thought after another flashed through Klein's mind. He leaned back in his chair and asked with a smile: "What does your Ancestor want you to pray to me for?"
Emlyn couldn't help but sit up straight: "Honorable Mr. Fool, the revelation given by the Ancestor is this: I, Emlyn White, will become the key to saving the vampires and defeating the doomsday, and it all starts with praying to you."
The word "chuunibyou" suddenly appeared in Klein's mind: Young man, think about it again? Are you missing the point?
He thought about it and decided to observe first: "Actually, I probably understand what your Ancestor means. He hopes that with my help, you will grow into a true high-level being, so as to save the vampires when the doomsday comes."
Next is the "joining ceremony", choosing a code name, announcing the gathering time, keeping secrets, and so on.
But when it came to the confidentiality procedure, Emlyn had some concerns: "But, Lord Nibbs..."
Klein countered with great certainty, "Lilith shouldn't have asked you to report to anyone afterward, right?"
He directly called the Ancestor's name, sounding like an old friend! Emlyn's heart trembled, and he lowered his head: "It seems not."
Klein tried hard to suppress his laughter: "This is a secret transaction. You don't even need to report to Lilith; otherwise, it will alert some guys."
Thus, the Sanguine Clan's double agent, Emlyn, officially joined the club.
Back in the real world, Emlyn felt that what had just happened was like a dream.
Then he thought of those Sanguine who laughed at him for liking dolls and becoming a servant of the Church of the Earth Mother: Hmph! You'd never guess that only I am favored by the Ancestor. Just wait and see! When I become stronger, you'll know how ridiculous your previous mockery was!
At this moment, he happened to pass Order Square, and today's chimes sounded different, as if they were particularly pleasant.
But soon, the gentlemen in the carriage took out their pocket watches and found that it was not yet eleven o'clock, not yet time for the chimes.
For a time, a "buzzing" discussion arose in the carriage. On the square outside the carriage, many gentlemen or ladies also stopped to look at the clock tower.
For so many years, the "Bell of Order" had its first time error.
But Emlyn didn't care about these things. He came to the Harvest Church in a good mood, found his servant's uniform, and skillfully wiped the candlestick.
At this moment, his heart stirred, and he looked towards the door: "The traitor is here again!"
...
East Borough, inside a greasy cafe.
Klein enjoyed his lunch, which was more than half an hour early, while listening to Old Kohler tell him the news he had collected in the past week.
Unfortunately, there was no information of great value.
After the other party finished speaking, Klein thought for a while, then took out a 2-pound note consisting of loose change and pushed it over.
Old Kohler waved his hand in fright: "You already gave it to me just now."
Klein smiled and said, "Within this week, I'm going on vacation to the south, and it may take two or three weeks to come back, so I'm paying you the corresponding reward in advance. Don't forget to help me collect information."
"Okay, okay!" Old Kohler happily and gratefully accepted the banknotes.
This reminded him of the happiest time in his life. At that time, he also had a few pounds in savings.
Then, he had already thought about how to spend the New Year. He planned to buy the ham that he couldn't bear to buy before and pair it with his bread.
It's really something to look forward to... He swallowed unconsciously.
After saying goodbye to Old Kohler, Klein took a carriage to the Red Rose Manor, explaining that he was too weak to investigate the real cause of Tarim's death and asked Prince Edsac to find someone else.
After obtaining Prince Edessak's permission, Klein left the manor by carriage and breathed a long sigh of relief.
Just then, he felt his spirituality suddenly become tense. The carriage door quickly opened and closed silently.
A figure was quickly outlined. It was a lady wearing a heavy black dress, a sapphire ring on her hand, a slightly round face, slender eyes, a gentle temperament, and an extremely outstanding appearance.
Klein was stunned for a moment, then blurted out: "Triss!"
Trissy was pleasantly surprised: "You know me... I knew you knew me!"
Klein asked cautiously, "What do you want to do?"
Trissy smiled: "It's very simple. Report me to the Nighthawks, Punishers, and the Hivemind as soon as possible, and let them come here to catch me!"
Klein tasted the meaning: She is trying to get out of here!
So he asked, "What are you afraid of?"
"Someone is manipulating my life!" Trissy widened her eyes and said, "There are always some terrifying coincidences! Hehe, they even changed my name!"
Klein almost jumped up. Of course, he knew this feeling: "What did they change your name to?"
Trissy frowned beautifully: "Trissy Cheek!"
Cheek! Klein once again had a numb feeling all over his body. A Roselle diary frantically echoed in his mind:
"...I got an ancient book, which actually mentioned the name of the 'Primordial Demoness'!"
"Her name is: Cheek!"
Trissy's eyebrows calmed down, with a bit of grievance, a bit of temptation, and a bit of mischievous smile: "If you can tell the orthodox church about this, and I can meet you just before they arrest me, I don't mind letting you understand what is called true pleasure."
How dare I! If I suddenly awaken as the "Primordial Demoness," the Fool can't resist it! Klein sighed silently.
After speaking, Trissy's figure disappeared quickly, as if she had never been here.
Only then did Klein suddenly come back to his senses, using "Flaming Jump" to leave the carriage, and quickly found the Azik copper whistle and candles he had hidden before, asking Mr. Azik and the "Creator" for help respectively.
...
Time turned back to ten o'clock.
After saying goodbye to Upton, Hobert left with "Travel" and reappeared in the cemetery in the suburbs of Conat.
Huh! Why didn't I use "Travel" to return to the lord's mansion just now? Hobert realized belatedly.
He looked at the outside of the forest, which was the direction of Backlund!
Hobert thought: I'll go take a look! There won't be any danger, right?
So he changed his appearance and used "Travel" to come to Order Square.
There are still many people walking, chatting, and feeding pigeons here. Hobert smiled: Is this how it is before every disaster comes? It's like, it's like just another ordinary day, it seems like nothing will happen as usual.
He glanced at the clock tower with the "Bell of Order": Dogshit order!
Hobert had a whim and used the illusion of the "Faceless Necklace" to cover up his disappearance from the spot with "Travel".
The next second, he appeared on the clock tower. Because it was not yet the hour, the bell ringer was still resting below.
Hobert looked at the huge bronze bell in front of him and suddenly picked up the bell hammer and struck the bronze bell.
Dong~dong~
The gentlemen outside took out their pocket watches and looked in the direction of the clock tower. For so many years, the "Bell of Order" had its first time error.
Hobert sneered: "It's really ugly! It looks like a fake at first glance!"
He took out a knife and cut the bronze bell in half before the bell ringer came up.
Then, Hobert left with "Blink", sat blankly in Order Square for a while, watching batches of police enter the clock tower.
One of the policemen was very tall, a bit like a crane standing out from the crowd, which reminded Hobert of Bishop Utravsky.
Using "Travel" again to come to Rose Street, ignoring the vampire servant's title of "traitor" to himself.
He sat next to Bishop Utravsky: "Father, why when I was weak, knowing that there was danger, I could still use practical actions to stick to my inner thoughts. But now that I have become stronger, I hesitate, become confused, and don't know how to choose?"

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - 431 0-08 strikes again (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Utravsky looked at Hobert beside him: "That's because, after you become stronger, there will be more people relying on you."
"If something dangerous happens to you, many people's fates will be affected and hurt."
"For those who support you and are close to you, you will no longer put yourself at risk."
"You are not actually confused, but unable to be truly at peace with your choices!"
Hobert was slightly stunned, and suddenly felt a sense of enlightenment. His heart quickly understood: "The reason I am so tormented and hesitant now is entirely because of the pressure I put on myself!
"It's because I know the high-level game behind the Great Smog, and I know that if I participate, there will be danger. If I am in danger, or am written to death by Adam, what will happen to Jeffery's territory?
"The people there have become an inseparable part of me, and I really can't take risks.
"But if I do nothing, when I look back in the middle of the night, when my mind is blank, I will definitely hate myself for doing nothing!
"This is the root of my anxiety!"
Hobert suddenly laughed twice, and then said with a smile: "Stupid! How could I become more and more stupid!"
I can't change the Great Smog incident, and I don't have the ability to change it, but I can change some trivial things, such as saving Old Kohler, or killing that 'Demoness of Despair' to vent my anger.
Hobert shook his head and said, "What was I worried about before? Did I really think that I could change the world by myself?"
Utravsky on the side said: "When a person feels that he is stupid, it is when he gains wisdom.
"When a person realizes that his abilities are limited, it is when he truly matures."
Hobert was stunned again. He got up and bowed to Utravsky and said, "Father, thank you for your enlightenment."
Utravsky smiled slightly, obviously enjoying the feeling of enlightening others.
Hobert looked at the 'Holy Emblem of Life': "Father, I seem to feel the call of the Earth Mother. I hope you can help me complete the baptism and let the power of faith dispel my hesitation and confusion."
Utravsky said seriously: "Okay!"
He ordered Emlyn: "Go get the holy water and holy objects!"
Emlyn curled his lips, but still honestly went to the backyard to get the holy water and holy objects.
The so-called holy water is not water containing the extraordinary power of 'Sun', but water that has been blessed by the Earth Mother.
The holy objects do not have any Beyonder abilities. They are dried and dyed crops, including golden wheat ears, red sorghum, and green and yellow rice, etc.
Utravsky came to the Holy Emblem, prayed to the Earth Mother piously, then stood in front of the Holy Emblem, facing Hobert who was kneeling on one knee: "In the name of the Earth Mother, I baptize you!"
Utravsky dipped his index finger in the holy water and drew a simple 'Holy Emblem of Life' on Hobert's forehead, and then waved the holy objects up, down, left, and right on Hobert's head.
While waving, the bishop preached the doctrine of the Earth Mother Church: "Every life is a 'plant', absorbing nutrients from the earth, slowly growing, flourishing, and decaying. When they wither, these lives will fall into the earth, return to the embrace of the mother, and grow again in the coming year..."
This process lasted for more than ten minutes before Utravsky said to Emlyn on the side: "You are a witness to Hobert's baptism!"
Emlyn looked reluctant, but his eyes were full of smiles.
At this point, the baptism officially ended.
Hobert got up and drew the shape of a leaf on his chest: "Praise the Mother!"
Then he took out more than 200 pounds of cash he carried with him from his wallet and said to Utravsky: "Father, please buy as many herbs as possible to treat lung and respiratory infections!"
Utravsky took the money without any doubt and asked Emlyn to go with him to buy medicine.
Hobert sat in the chair, looked at the 'Holy Emblem of Life' and smiled slightly, then put away his smile and lowered his head as if praying.
...
Klein only wrote the word "Help" on the letter paper, and then summoned the messenger with Azik's copper whistle to send the letter out.
Then he lit a candle, quickly burned the essential oil, and prayed to the 'Creator'.
In fact, he could also pray directly to the 'Creator', but Klein felt that with the assistance of candles and essential oils, the success rate would be higher.
Finally, he reported to 'The Fool' about Edessak's love for the witch Trissy Cheek in the way he prayed for himself.
Quickly came to above the gray fog, Klein added in the tone of 'The Fool': "Cheek, this is the real name of the 'Primordial Demoness'."
Then he threw this 'image' into Miss Justice's star.
...
On the yellowed notebook, an ordinary-looking quill pen wrote:
"For unknown, inexplicable reasons, the Dallasco meteor shower arrived on this planet two days early.
"Part of their landing point happened to be the forest where Detective Sherlock Moriarty was hiding.
"Yes, just right!"
...
While Audrey notified the Church of the Evernight Goddess about Cheek through her mother.
Klein's eyes in the forest froze. Several burning meteorites fell at high speed, covering the entire forest.
Klein even had the idea of ​​being unable to resist, despairing and waiting for death.
Even if he kept using 'Flaming Jump', he couldn't escape the forest and the core danger zone before the 'meteor shower' hit the ground.
At this moment, the space in front of him seemed to be suddenly splashed with paint from oil paintings. The reds were redder, the yellows were yellower, and the various colors were more intense.
Mr. Azik walked out of the 'oil painting'. He didn't have time to reminisce about the past. Azik pulled Klein into the colorful spirit world.
...
In the Red Rose Manor, Prince Edessak silently looked at Trissy for nearly a minute, then suddenly he closed his eyes: "You go!"
Trissy raised her eyebrows in surprise: "You want to let me go?"
Even if you know that I used to be Tris, even if you know that the feelings for me are arranged by some kind of power...
Edessak turned to look out the window: "Go."
Trissy was confused for a few seconds, and quickly walked to the door. Before opening the door, she couldn't help but look back: "What about you?"
Edessak smiled: "Me? Let me live in this beautiful story and welcome its final ending, whether good or bad."
...
Hobert in the Harvest Church heard the prayer from the 'Nation of Disorder'.
After being promoted to Sequence 5, without entering the 'Nation of Disorder', he can basically hear the content of the prayer clearly. It was a request for help from Klein.
Hobert stood up and used the 'Faceless Man Necklace' to 'navigate' to the East Borough. He saw several people who were dressed relatively cleanly, but whose hair and beards were neglected, were sharing a marinated ham.
The oldest of them was Old Kohler.
Hobert didn't expect that he only knew the name, ham and other vague elements, and he found Old Kohler in one go.
Several people looked at Hobert warily, each hugged the ham and quickly left.
Hobert smiled and said to them: "Happy New Year!"
The few people ran faster after hearing this greeting.
The surrounding fog became thicker and thicker. Hobert turned back to his original appearance and put on the mask symbolizing the 'Creator's' devotee.
Just wearing the mask was enough, and the fog had become so thick that it seriously hindered his vision.
Hobert found a secluded place, prayed to himself, came to the 'Nation of Disorder', and used his star to project the 'Bull Demon King' and the black dog spirit beast to the East Borough of Backlund.
He had drawn a bottom line for himself in the Harvest Church just now: he could not dispatch angel-level combat power, otherwise the situation would completely get out of control.
He just found two saint-level helpers and would not stimulate all parties.
As for Klein, he could ignore him, after all, he had Mr. Azik as a backer, so he wouldn't die.
Returning to the real world, Hobert looked at the 'Bull Demon King' and the black dog spirit beast, who were more than one person tall, and smiled, using the 'Crystal of Order' to control them to follow closely behind him.
The fog was getting thicker and thicker, and people around him began to cough violently.
Hobert continued to use the 'Faceless Necklace' to navigate. After turning to the next street, he found the 'Demoness of Despair' with excellent appearance and temperament.
She was laughing in a low voice: "The history of the Kingdom of Loen will remember this day: the Backlund Smog Incident!"
Hobert coldly said to the 'Bull Demon King' and the black dog spirit beast: "Kill her!"
The smile on the 'Demoness of Despair's' face disappeared, and she felt the aura of death and depravity.
...
In the dark valley, Azik was fighting against Ince Zangwill and a 'Law Enforcer'.
Under Azik's attack, '0-08' briefly broke away from Ince's control.
The quill pen floated in front of the gray rock wall, frantically writing lines of words: "In fierce battles, there will always be all kinds of accidents, for example, Ince Zangwill's belt breaks and his pants fall down."
Ince simply tore off his falling pants. Just as he was about to grab '0-08', he suddenly felt that he no longer had any intention to grab it: he could defeat Azik with his own strength.
So Ince seemed to have forgotten about the quill pen and turned to attack Azik.
The quill pen seemed to be affected by an unknown force. After a brief pause, it continued to write: "The masked man who appeared in the East Borough is a huge variable. I can't even see the appearance under his mask, and I don't know who he is!
"The only thing that can be determined is that he seems to be related to the 'Creator' who just appeared in front of the world two days ago.
"Although he has two powerful helpers, unfortunately, he himself is too weak. Ryan Salomon, who has been waiting in Backlund hoping to find more clues, and Orseya Tamara from the Tamara family, happen to be not far from there. They are very interested in the masked man's two helpers.
"After encountering Ryan Salomon, the masked man did not cautiously leave quickly. He felt that a 'Demoness of Despair' Beyonder characteristic was a very tempting wealth.
"This is the negative effect of one of his sealed artifacts. Although he sealed the artifact, wearing the artifact for a long time has also had a certain impact on him.
"The negative effect happened to appear at this time. When he wanted to leave, it was too late..."
...
In the smog of the East Borough, Hobert crossed his arms and watched the 'Bull Demon King' and the black dog spirit beast beat the 'Demoness of Despair' to a pulp.
In a word, it was great!
Hobert occasionally used 'Healing' on the people around him who were coughing badly, and told them to leave here quickly.
With the black dog spirit beast and them beating the 'Demoness of Despair', the smog didn't seem to be as thick as it was just now, and most people had time to escape from the place where the smog was thickest.
Suddenly, Hobert felt something. He raised his head, passed through the thick fog, and saw an old man standing on the roof. He gave people a feeling of being dusty and full of vicissitudes.
Although the fog blocked him, Hobert couldn't see the other person's appearance clearly, but he was sure that this was the member of the Salomon family who had inquired about his whereabouts.
Ryan Salomon glanced at Hobert wearing the mask, and then looked at the black dog spirit beast. He could feel that the body of this black dog spirit beast was filled with the power of order and chaos.
That power was even more intense than the 'power of order' in the wood he held.
(As Hobert advanced, the power he could mobilize from the 'Nation of Disorder' became more pure.)
Hobert secretly said something bad, and used the 'Crystal of Order' to order the black dog spirit beast: You go deal with the old man on the roof!
This kind of order doesn't need to be spoken out, otherwise the enemy will definitely attack Hobert first.
The 'Bull Demon King' alone can still kill the 'Demoness of Despair', it only takes half a minute to happily get a copy of the 'Demoness of Despair's' Beyonder characteristics!
Ryan took out a bracelet from his pocket and stayed on his wrist. In an instant, he became extremely charming, and his appearance changed a little, becoming a handsome old man. The sense of vicissitudes just now also disappeared.
As soon as the black dog spirit beast left the battle, Ryan came to the street by 'twisting' the distance: "All things grow!"
Bang!
The flowers and plants raised on the second-floor window sill suddenly grew rapidly, squeezing through the windows, and soon grew as big as big trees, blooming with big and bright flowers,
Other small plants such as weeds raised at home and growing on the street also grew into towering trees, and they all bloomed with bright flowers and bore huge fruits.
For a time, several people seemed to be in a forest.
Hobert even felt the urge to grow a few more centimeters, and his stomach was rumbling, as if there was life being conceived.
The huge fruits of those big trees cracked open, and strange lives fell out of them. They were like combinations of plants and animals, making baby-like cries.
This is the ability of Ryan's bracelet. This sealed artifact came from the Solomon Second Empire period, a Sequence 2 'Life Giver' who was seriously injured and out of control on the battlefield.
This 'Life Giver' was once a subordinate of the Night Emperor's Queen, a nobleman of the Trunsoest Empire, and also a blood clan duke.
The reason Ryan used this right away, the only Grade 0 Sealed Artifact he currently possessed, was because he sensed the aura of death emanating from the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
Therefore, he intended to use the aura of "life" to suppress the aura of "death" from the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
This was, of course, an exploitation of rules and order, as the bracelet's aura of "life" was at the Angel level, while the aura of "death" was only at the Saint level.
However, Ryan quickly discovered that the Black Hound Spirit Beast didn't seem to be affected much, and the towering trees that had instantly grown, along with the creatures that had fallen from the fruits, were still rapidly withering.
Hobert smiled and said, "Just kidding, the Black Hound Spirit Beast has been blessed by the ancient God of Death; there's only one of its kind in the entire world."
