chapters.title: Chapter 432 - 432 Backlund Great Smog Incident (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
[200 powerstone]
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
During the first round of the contest between Ryan and the Black Hound Spirit Beast, Hobert was not idle either. He felt his stomach getting bigger and bigger, and something inside was taking away his strength and spirituality.
He quickly entered the "Nation of Disorder" and took out the level 1 sealed artifact of the "Error" pathway.
Hobert comforted himself: Using it once in a while shouldn't be so unlucky as to immediately attract Amon.
He put on the glove-shaped sealed artifact with one hand, and grabbed his stomach with the other. Instantly, a bloody creature with three arms, four legs, and a monkey-like head covered in fish scales appeared in his hand.
Hobert quickly threw the monster away: "The 'Moon' pathway's abilities are really disgusting!"
He glanced at the "Demoness of Despair" who had been suppressed by the "Bull Demon King". Her belly was also rapidly expanding.
On the other side, the Black Hound Spirit Beast summoned the "Gate of the Underworld". A bronze gate with heavy patterns appeared, and pale arms stretched out from it, restricting Ryan's movements. Ryan immediately "amplified" his power and spirituality, and "amplified" the surrounding aura of "life".
Although these auras had no effect on the Black Hound Spirit Beast, the "Gate of the Underworld" was affected by the aura of "life". The evil spirits inside seemed to have gained new life and were unwilling to be commanded by the Black Hound Spirit Beast, releasing Ryan.
The "Gate of the Underworld" itself rapidly faded due to the aura of "life".
This allowed Ryan to quickly break free from his restraints and gain freedom.
At the same time, the creatures that fell out of the fruit rushed over to block the Black Hound Spirit Beast from attacking Ryan.
Hobert looked at the other battlefield again. The "Bull Demon King" once again "distorted" the "Demoness of Despair's" attack, and stomped the "Demoness of Despair's" head, who had already been knocked to the ground, into the ground.
The "Demoness of Despair" trembled all over and was in a semi-comatose state.
She was also relatively unlucky. Whether it was disease, curses, or charms, they had little effect on the "Bull Demon King".
However, the "Bull Demon King's" Beyonder abilities and "physical attacks" could cause considerable damage to her.
Hobert coughed twice. As soon as the "Demoness of Despair" died, he would immediately use "Travel" to leave, and then go to the "Nation of Disorder" to take back the "Bull Demon King" and the Black Hound Spirit Beast, leaving Ryan to fight the air.
Just as he thought of this, he suddenly had a bad feeling. Following the guidance of his spirituality, he looked at a dilapidated house on the side of the street.
A woman wearing a veil and unable to see her face pushed open the door and came out of the house. If it weren't for the suffocating pressure emanating from her, her movements would have seemed as casual as if she were about to go to work.
Hobert sensed something was wrong and immediately injected spirituality into the "Traveler's Knife".
But the woman's movements were even faster: "Entry into the Spirit World is forbidden here!"
Her speech was fast, but everyone present could clearly hear every word she said.
The illusory space in front of Hobert was instantly covered by thick fog, returning to its normal state.
This lady was Olseya Tamara, who was "coincidentally" not far from here, looking for clues about the "Tree of Order".
She was not very interested in Hobert, as long as he couldn't escape. Like Ryan, the "Bull Demon King" and the Black Hound Spirit Beast attracted her attention. She could feel the pure and rich power of the "Bull Demon King".
Olseya quickly approached the "Bull Demon King" and prepared to use the power of "Imprisonment" to try to seal it.
The situation quickly became unfavorable for Hobert. He quickly took out the scepter pinned to his waist, broke open the shell of the "Order Crystal", and ordered the "Bull Demon King": Deal with that woman who just appeared!
The "Bull Demon King" dodged Olseya's seal: "Distort!"
It distorted the concepts of Olseya and a monster that fell out of the fruit, and the monster was instantly stomped into meat paste by the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
"Deprivation!" Almost at the same time, Olseya deprived the monster of its qualifications to exchange concepts with her.
So the blow that the monster received was not reflected on her.
"Fall!" The "Bull Demon King" made another move, and started a back-and-forth battle with Olseya.
At the same time, as the only Sequence 5 on the battlefield, Hobert watched both sides of the battlefield, so as not to be affected by the aftermath of their battle, while drawing his knife and rushing towards the "Demoness of Despair" to deliver the final blow.
Just a few meters away from the "Demoness of Despair", the "Demoness of Despair", whose head was stomped into the ground but whose body was on the surface, let out a desperate roar.
She pulled her head out of the ground, and at this moment, her hair was burning with spiritual flames, and her eyes were filled with holy light.
At the same time, her aura soared, even stronger than before!
The battle with the "Bull Demon King" just now made her realize what true despair was, and she actually digested the potion because of this.
And she restored her state as soon as possible by burning her spirituality.
This method is very harmful to herself, but she must do so now, otherwise she may die here!
When Hobert saw this scene, he turned around and ran without thinking. He was a little regretful now. He shouldn't have had the idea of delivering the final blow, he should have run away immediately.
"Cough cough cough!" The surrounding fog immediately became thicker again. Hobert felt an itch in his throat, coughed violently, felt weak all over, and developed a fever.
He knew that he was being specially taken care of by the "Demoness of Despair". Otherwise, with his Sequence 5 physique, even if there were mystical viruses and bacteria in the surrounding smog, it would be impossible for him to get sick so quickly.
Without time to use "Healing", Hobert could only run away quickly. He knew that the "Demoness of Despair" would definitely chase after him immediately.
And he, a Sequence 5, even if he had two level 1 sealed artifacts on him, might not be her opponent.
Reaching out and grabbing forward, Hobert stole the distance in front of him, allowing him to suddenly appear on the street.
So damn useful! It's even better than "Blink!"
While sighing, Hobert prepared to steal the distance in front again, but the arm he stretched out couldn't move. When he wanted to continue running forward, he realized that his legs couldn't move either.
He then noticed that he seemed to be deeply trapped in strands of thin and tough hair.
Then Hobert felt a chill all over, frozen stiff, and a layer of frost suddenly appeared on the ground.
He knew that the "Demoness of Despair" was rapidly approaching.
"Disorder!" Hobert used Chaos with the scepter in his hand. That scepter could use three demigod-level abilities: "Exploit", "Magnify", and "Disorder"!
Demigod-level chaos can already make some existing orders and rules chaotic.
Hobert used "Disorder" to make the friction between the frost and hair on the ground chaotic, making the hair have the friction of frost. The friction of the hair wrapped around him became very small, so Hobert could swing the knife in his hand in a small area to cut off those hairs.
If it was an ordinary knife, it would definitely not be able to cut it, but the knife in Hobert's hand was different. He quickly cut off the hair around him and cleared a free area.
At the same time, the "Demoness of Despair" also caught up!
"Magnify!" Hobert amplified the smoothness of the frost on the ground, greatly reducing the friction.
Even the Sequence 4 "Demoness of Despair" was almost slipped by the sudden reduction in friction.
Then she took back the ability of frost and quickly pursued by stomping on the ground: "Charm!"
"Exploit!" Hobert immediately felt like a fawn was bumping around in his chest. The "Demoness of Despair", who had burned her hair short in front of him, was as likable and unforgettable as his first love.
Not to mention being her enemy, Hobert didn't even want to make her angry.
Even if he gave up everything he had, he would not hesitate if it could make her happy.
Ryan and Olseya had similar thoughts to Hobert. Yes, Olseya also had the feeling of seeing her first love.
It's just that the two saints have not risen to the level of licking dogs like Hobert.
This is Hobert's rule of "Exploit" Beyonder abilities, turning "Charm" from an individual attack into a group attack.
"Distort!" Ryan "distorted" the "Charm" effect he received onto the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
Of course, this would not have any effect on the Black Hound Spirit Beast, whose body was filled with the "Power of Order".
However, when Ryan used "Distort", the Black Hound Spirit Beast let out a scream. This scream hit Ryan's spiritual body, putting Ryan at a disadvantage in an instant.
Olseya simply said: "Charm is prohibited here!"
When she used the "Prohibition" ability, she was also preempted by the "Bull Demon King".
And because "Charm is invalid" here, Hobert also woke up from the state of licking the dog.
Even Ryan, who was fighting with the Black Hound Spirit Beast, sighed in his heart that the "Exploit" that Hobert had just displayed was very skillful.
But in just one or two seconds, the "Demoness of Despair" had already caught up and kicked Hobert away.
Hobert felt like he had been hit by a cannonball, and almost vomited out the acid in his stomach.
At the same time, Hobert felt that his condition was getting worse and worse, and his throat seemed to be blocked by something, making it difficult to breathe.
The "Demoness of Despair" chased up closely, with a long spear made of frost in her hand, ready to nail Hobert to the ground.
Just as the "Demoness of Despair" stabbed out the ice spear, Hobert endured the suffocation and the bone-piercing pain, and stole Olseya's position.
The moment the ice spear hit Hobert, his position was exchanged with Olseya's position.
Olseya reacted quickly, and with a wave of her hand, she knocked the ice spear away: "Imprisonment!"
The "Demoness of Despair" was imprisoned by an invisible force, standing still and unable to move.
When Olseya got up from the ground, she found that the "Bull Demon King" had run far away with Hobert in his arms. Olseya abandoned the Black Hound Spirit Beast and Ryan and immediately chased after them.
Hobert, in the arms of the "Bull Demon King", quickly used "Healing" on himself, "Cough cough cough~", he finally coughed up the phlegm in his throat, as if he had saved his life.
Two or three seconds later, he used "Healing" on himself again, and the injuries and diseases on his body were completely cured.
But soon he discovered that it seemed that from the time the "Demoness of Despair" burned her hair, the surrounding fog had become yellow and thicker again.
The streets were already full of people struggling to die.
Hobert quickly used "Travel" to leave the East Borough, and then found a deserted place to enter the "Nation of Disorder" to take back the "Bull Demon King".
Olseya in the East Borough was at least a saint, and felt that she was quite knowledgeable, but she was still stunned in place for a second or two: That monster disappeared suddenly, it didn't enter the Spirit World!
Strange!
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" went to take back the Black Hound Spirit Beast, but found that he couldn't find the Black Hound Spirit Beast!
...
After the "Bull Demon King" left with Hobert in his arms and Olseya chased after them, a female figure wearing a hood and a dark robe was outlined on the street that had been almost destroyed by the previous battle.
She has a handsome face, but without any expression, her black eyes are dark and deep, but lack spirituality.
Whether it was the "Demoness of Despair" who was "Imprisoned", or the Black Hound Spirit Beast and Ryan who were fighting, they all looked at this woman.
Then, they seemed to turn into pencil drawings, as if they were being quickly erased by an eraser.
They had no power to resist, and only had time to show a dazed look with unwillingness.
Then the female figure disappeared, as if she had never appeared.
On this street where people had already run away, there were large pits, several walls collapsed, and dozens of large trees squeezed the houses precariously. The pale yellow thick fog rolled, covering everything, as if to cover up the fierce battle that had just taken place here.
...
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" suddenly realized a problem. When he met the "Frenzied Mage" of the Solomon family just now, why didn't he run away quickly?
But now is not the time to think about this problem, and Hobert did not continue to look for the Black Hound Spirit Beast, because he knew that after the power of the "Nation of Disorder" in the Black Hound Spirit Beast's body was diluted, he could sense the position of the Ancient Death God.
There is no need to actively look for it, just show a little bit of the aura of the Ancient Death, and it will come over by itself.
Now there is something more important to do.
Hobert returned to the real world, used the "Faceless Necklace" to navigate himself, and entered the Spirit World again to save Old Kohler.
...
"Happy New Year!"
Old Kohler hid his ham in a paper bag and left in a hurry.
After walking a distance, he muttered, "What a strange guy."
He was talking about the guy who said "Happy New Year" to everyone just now.
Old Kohler glanced at the ham in his arms with some worry. Looking at the red meat mixed with a lot of white, his throat couldn't help but squirm, and he swallowed.
As he walked, he felt that the fog around him was getting thicker.
Old Kohler raised his palm to cover his mouth and nose: "Why is the fog so smelly today?"
"Cough cough cough~"
There were coughing sounds everywhere. Old Kohler himself also coughed: Am I sick? Damn, I wanted to have a good New Year... Maybe I'll be fine after a sleep, yes, it's nothing serious, I'll be fine after a sleep.
Fortunately, the further he went, the fog seemed to fade a little.
(At this time, the "Demoness of Despair" was being beaten.)
Old Kohler breathed a sigh of relief: Fortunately, fortunately, it was just that the fog was a bit smelly just now.
A wonderful New Year is waiting ahead.
But a few minutes later, the surrounding fog became dense again, and the once-clear church steeple in the distance was gradually swallowed by a mixture of pale yellow and iron black.
Old Kohler felt his face burning and his forehead seemed to be on fire: Damn it! This damned fog!
He was about to take two quick steps to leave this "fog zone," but his chest tightened, his throat felt uncomfortable, and he soon had difficulty breathing.
"Ho Ho Ho~" Old Kohler heard his own difficult gasps, his hands softened, and the paper bag containing the ham fell to the ground.
He subconsciously squatted down to pick it up, but fell there instead.
Old Kohler held onto the bag of ham, trying to pull it into his arms.
Thump! In Old Kohler's blurring vision, he saw someone else fall a few steps away. Suddenly, he had an epiphany, knowing that he was about to die.
Just like his wife and daughter, when the disease came, they quickly lost their lives.
People fell one after another, which reminded him of what a drunkard in a bar had said when he was inquiring about information: "People like us are like straw in the field, we fall when the wind blows, and even without the wind, we may fall on our own!"
The wind is coming...
Such a thought flashed through Old Kohler's mind.
What he didn't understand was why he suddenly fell when his life had just gotten on the right track and was developing in a sufficiently good direction?
At this moment, Old Kohler made the sound of bellows being pulled, and he was even too weak to lift his hand.
But the question kept lingering in his mind: "Why?"
When his vision was very blurred, he seemed to see a person appearing out of nowhere not far in front of him. Was that the Grim Reaper?
A milky white light fell on Old Kohler, and the discomfort in his body was rapidly disappearing.
A lot of thick yellow phlegm flowed from the corner of Old Kohler's mouth, and his lungs started working again. Soon he regained his vision.
He saw a person wearing a mask and a black windbreaker squatting in front of him. He seemed to be saying something to him.
After a while, Old Kohler realized: I'm not dead!
At this time, he heard the other person clearly: "Do you know a widow who does laundry work and supports two daughters? Her youngest daughter was just rescued from Karpin."
"You, are you talking about the Liv family?" Old Kohler said in a hoarse voice: "Her two daughters are called Freya and Daisy!"
The masked man, Hobert, recalled for a moment: "Yes."
"I know."
"Take me there!"
"Okay, okay." Old Kohler got up with difficulty: "I'll do it right away..."
"Close your eyes!" Hobert suddenly exuded a majestic aura and ordered: "Imagine the location of that family in your mind."
Old Kohler clenched the paper bag in his hand: "Okay, okay..."
Hobert supported his shoulder and entered the spirit world again.
Soon, they appeared in front of a dilapidated building. Old Kohler felt the hand on his shoulder move away, and he opened his eyes to find that he was already at the door of the Liv family: "My God, this is simply a miracle."
However, Hobert didn't have time to accept Old Kohler's flattery. He strode into the damp room in front of him. The mother and daughter had already fallen to the ground.
Hobert didn't have time to look carefully. He first used a "Healing Spell" on Freya, waiting anxiously for more than a second, and then used a "Healing Spell" on Liv.
At this time, Hobert squatted down to look. Liv's eyes had lost their luster, but Freya was recovering rapidly.
Soon Freya was able to sit up. She found her mother still lying on the ground, and seemed to understand something. She knelt on the ground, crying and saying to Hobert, who was wearing a mask: "Please, please."
"Sorry, I, I, I can't resurrect."
At this time, Old Kohler began to cough violently again.
Hobert took a deep breath, grabbed Freya's shoulder, and pulled her out.
Freya cried out: "Mom! Mom!"
But her mother could no longer respond, just lying quietly on the damp ground, as if she were asleep.
Freya's eyes blurred, and she appeared on a strange street. In front of them was a church decorated with wheat and other crops.
Hobert said to Old Kohler, who was exclaiming about the miracle, and Freya, who was still crying silently: "You wait here! If you feel unwell, go to the church to get some potions."
Old Kohler nodded repeatedly: "Okay, okay, okay."
Hobert waited for a while, and when "Travel" could be used again, Freya suddenly said: "Daisy! Kind sir, please save Daisy."
Hobert didn't have time to explain, just nodded and returned to the East Borough.
Although he couldn't save Liv, he would save as many people as he could now.
Arriving at the street in the East Borough near the source of the fog, the ground was covered with corpses of people who had struggled painfully before their deaths. The rolling pale yellow fog seemed to bury the entire street! And all the creatures on the street.
Hobert walked among the corpses one by one: "I have heard of gods who used themselves to mend the sky; I have heard of gods who found ways to make fire for people, gods who enlightened the people; I have heard of gods who chased the scorching sun to make the sunrise and sunset more regular; I have heard of gods who led the people to control floods!
"But I have never heard of a god who despises life so much! Doomsday? Hehe, who said the doomsday is more than ten years later? In a world with such gods, every moment is doomsday!"
From the beginning of the street to the end, Hobert did not find anyone who still had breath.
He looked at the dense fog, at the silent street, and stood there for a long time without speaking.
At this time, a gust of wind blew from a distance, and the fog seemed to suddenly come to life and rolled up.
The Storm Church finally reacted and was dispelling the fog.
Only then did Hobert use "Travel" to return to Rose Street, which was already crowded with people queuing up to receive potions.
He was about to go find Old Kohler and Freya, but suddenly stood there motionless, forgetting his purpose, forgetting where he was, and even wondering why he was here?
After three or four seconds, Hobert reacted, recalled his purpose and today's experience: as long as he used the sealed artifact of the "Error" pathway that looks like a glove, he would be affected by its negative effects!
After disengaging from the battle before, Hobert immediately used the "Order Crystal" to seal the scepter and gloves. He could effectively avoid the negative effects of those Level 2 mystical items on him by using this method.
Before coming into contact with Grade 1 sealed artifacts, Hobert had hardly been affected by negative effects.
But this method obviously cannot avoid the negative effects of Level 1 sealed artifacts.
Hobert quickly touched the mystical items on his body. Thank goodness, he didn't lose any valuables.
Only then did he go into the crowd and find Old Kohler and Freya.
Old Kohler stepped forward and said, "Kind sir, how can I thank you?"
Hobert under the mask showed a forced smile: "Please give me a bite of the ham in the paper bag."
(At the suggestion of book friends, the author has revised the Sequence 2 ritual again. The specific content has not changed, but the scope of the ritual has been changed from a country to a large city.)

When Freya saw Hobert return "empty-handed," tears fell again.
Hobert explained to her, "Your sister is safe and sound, currently at the Church of the Evernight Goddess."
Freya breathed a sigh of relief, "Thank, thank you, kind sir. How can I ever thank you enough?"
Hobert drew his knife, carefully wiped it with a handkerchief, cut a small piece of ham from the one Old Kohler handed over, tilted his mask open, and put it in his mouth, chewing as he said, "We'll talk about it later."
He cut two more pieces of meat and handed them to Old Kohler and Freya respectively.
The moment Old Kohler tasted the meat, a smile immediately crept onto his face, as if the illness he had just experienced was a test for getting to eat this bite of meat.
Although Freya had no appetite, she didn't dare refuse Hobert, so she put it in her mouth and chewed, but it was like chewing wax.
Hobert put away his knife and then said, "I have something to tell you. This fog was actually created by someone, or rather, by a force. It's not a natural disaster!"
Old Kohler was almost choked by the piece of ham he couldn't bear to swallow. His first reaction was surprise and disbelief, but then he thought of the mysterious man's magical abilities and gradually believed it.
Freya was also stunned. Although it sounded incredible, she didn't question it, because she could clearly feel that she was only one step away from death just now. On the streets of the East Borough, there were people teetering on the brink of life and death every day.
She knew the aura of death too well. If it weren't for this gentleman, she knew that she would have died with her mother on the damp ground.
It made no sense for a gentleman with such magical abilities to deceive her and Old Kohler in such matters.
Hobert then asked, "Do you want to avenge those who died today?"
A strong anger flashed in Old Kohler's eyes, but then it gradually disappeared.
He touched the gray hair at his temples, "Sir, I'm old. It's a blessing from the gods to live another day. I don't want to get involved in the affairs of big shots."
Hobert nodded and looked at Freya again.
In addition to anger, Freya also felt grief over her mother's death, "Sir, what can I do to get revenge?"
"Make yourself stronger until you have the ability to defeat those people," Hobert said, "Become my student, and I'll teach you how to become stronger."
Freya was about to nod immediately, but she hesitated, "Sir, can I bring my sister with me to follow you?"
"No! If you separate, you will each have considerable growth, but if you stay together, you won't be able to take revenge at your current rate of growth." Hobert explained further:
"After you leave, Daisy will enter the orphanage of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, where she will at least have food and clothing. She has a regularly distributed fund and can continue to go to school until she graduates from grammar school.
"When you have the ability to return to Backlund in the future, you can come back to see Daisy, and you can also take her with you after she graduates.
"Of course, all of this is on the premise that you are good enough."
Freya hesitated. Her mother had just passed away, and Daisy was still young. The two sisters should depend on each other.
Hobert didn't urge her or continue to persuade her. If he really wanted Freya to follow him, he could completely use the power of the 'Mental Spoon' to hypnotize her.
Of course, he wouldn't do that. Instead, he let Freya choose for herself. Even if Freya chose to stay in Backlund, he wouldn't interfere in any way.
Freya also realized that this was an opportunity to change her destiny.
If she stayed in Backlund, although she could take care of Daisy, she would still have to do laundry work, and even occasionally work as a street prostitute to make a living.
There were too many examples of this around her.
But if she followed this gentleman, although the future was full of uncertainties, at least she would have a chance to escape her current fate.
After thinking for two or three minutes, Freya said, "Sir, I am willing to go with you, but on the condition that I can say goodbye to Daisy."
Hobert nodded, "No problem."
He paused and then said, "Come with me."
Hobert led Old Kohler and Freya into the Harvest Church. At this time, the church was very busy. Emlyn was diagnosing people entering the church and distributing medicine, while Bishop Utravsky was distributing food to everyone.
Hobert first introduced Bishop Utravsky, and then he said, "Father, this old man is a survivor of the Great Smog incident. Can you take him in for a few days?"
It would be best to wait until the official Beyonder investigation is over before letting him go back.
Utalavsky agreed to let Old Kohler stay here as a helper for a few days, and the Harvest Church would temporarily take care of his food and lodging.
He glanced at Freya. Hobert sighed, "I only rescued two people."
"Giant Bishop" said, "The Earth Mother will see your actions to save lives. At your reminder, we have prepared enough medicinal materials to save so many people. The Earth Mother will also see these kind actions of yours."
Hobert thought: The way he said that makes me feel a chill down my spine.
He drew a leaf symbolizing life on his chest: "These are all good deeds done under the guidance of the Mother! Praise the Mother!"
Hobert pointed to Emlyn distributing medicine over there and introduced Old Kohler, "That is Mr. Emlyn, a very excellent doctor. You can go to him directly if you feel uncomfortable. It's free."
Emlyn also recognized Hobert, who was still wearing a mask, "Don't listen to the 'traitor's' nonsense. My consultation fees are very high."
Hobert added, "He is practicing medicine at the Harvest Church and does not charge consultation fees."
Emlyn curled his lips and said nothing more.
Just then, when he had a little free time, he looked at Old Kohler a few times, "Old man, your body is very weak. If you can afford it, eat more meat. If you can't afford it, eat more soybeans."
"Thank you, doctor, thank you, doctor." Old Kohler could of course see that although this handsome doctor had a bad tone and looked impatient, he was very skilled in medicine and was willing to think about poor people like himself.
Ordinary doctors would not care whether patients like Old Kohler ate meat or soybeans.
After settling Old Kohler and saying goodbye to Utravsky and Emlyn, Hobert left with Freya.
Before leaving, Hobert said to Old Kohler, "Happy New Year!"
Old Kohler then realized, "So it's that gentleman."
He tried hard to recall the gentleman's appearance, but because he didn't see the other person's face clearly at the time, the recall was unsuccessful.
At this time, the thick fog had been blown away a lot by the wind, and even the outline of the sun could be seen.
Hobert found a deserted corner and used 'Travel' to take Freya to the Church of the Evernight Goddess first.
At this time, the light yellow fog had just dissipated, and the church was still tightly closed.
Hobert explained his purpose to the servant of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, and Daisy did recognize Freya, so the servant let Daisy out.
The sisters first hugged each other and cried bitterly. Daisy tightly grabbed her sister's clothes, "I thought I would never see you and Mom again."
"Mom, Mom..." Freya didn't know how to speak for a moment.
Daisy realized that something was wrong and quickly went home with Freya. After seeing her mother lying on the ground, she naturally cried again.
Hobert found a hearse, carried Liv's body, and took Freya and Daisy to the cemetery together.
This time, Hobert didn't use 'Travel' to take them to the cemetery, giving the sisters enough time to say goodbye to their mother.
Hobert did not ride in the carriage with them, but found a deserted place and quickly sacrificed the sealed artifact of the 'Error' pathway to the 'Nation of Disorder'.
The negative effects of a Grade 1 sealed artifact are too terrible!
At the same time, he took some gold pounds from the 'Nation of Disorder' through sacrifice. He had given all the money he had with him to Bishop Utravsky before.
When the hearse arrived at the cemetery, Hobert had already bought the cemetery and the coffin, and had also invited a pastor.
Liv was not cremated hastily like the others who died in the East Borough today, and was not hastily placed in a small box.
She had her own tomb and coffin, and even a tombstone where an epitaph could be engraved.
Hobert asked for the sisters' opinions, "How about writing 'She was a competent mother' for the epitaph?"
The sisters, who could no longer cry, nodded slowly, quietly watching their mother being laid to rest and buried.
When the staff had all left, only Hobert and the Freya sisters were left in front of the tombstone.
Freya told Daisy in a low voice that she was going to leave with this masked gentleman. Daisy had already witnessed Hobert preparing the tomb and coffin for her mother, and had helped invite the pastor, so she was already mentally prepared.
In the East Borough, such things were too common. The stewards of dignitaries helped bury relatives, or gave a sum of money to take away a seventeen or eighteen-year-old girl.
Some of those girls never came back, while others became the lovers of some big shot, allowing the entire family to live a good life.
Daisy said, "Sir, my sister doesn't talk much, but she has a kind heart. Please treat her well."
Hobert didn't explain, but just said, "Study hard!"
After sending Daisy onto the carriage, the carriage sped away in the sisters' reluctant eyes.
It wasn't until the carriage disappeared on the street that Freya wiped the tears from her eyes and said to Hobert, "Kind sir, thank you for waiting patiently. Let's go."
Hobert looked blank, "You, who are you?"
He looked around, "I, how am I at the entrance of the cemetery?"
Freya opened her mouth, not knowing how to answer for a moment.
After a second or two, Hobert's eyes were no longer so confused: I put it all back in the 'Nation of Disorder'! The aftereffects of the Grade 1 sealed artifact are so great!
He said to Freya, who was looking surprised, "This is the price of gaining power."
Freya nodded as if she understood.
Then Hobert used 'Travel' to take Freya to Jeffery's territory, to his study.
He had Freya move a chair herself and sit on one side of the desk.
Hobert took off his mask and said, "First, let me introduce myself. My name is Hobert Jeffery. You may have heard of me."
Freya thought for a moment, and finally shook her head slowly. Her previous work did not involve politics, or even newspapers.
Seeing the other party's reaction, Hobert explained, "I used to be a lawyer in Backlund, but for some reason, I am now a Baron of the Kingdom of Feynapotter.
"Okay, let's talk about your learning tasks. Starting tomorrow, I will spend two hours a day teaching you the writing and pronunciation of Loen and Feynapotter. You will also spend two to three hours a day practicing. The other half of the day..."
Freya, who had always dreamed of learning words and grammar, had already stood up happily. She snatched the words, "The other half of the day, I will clean your mansion spotlessly!"
"No, you can't clean it all by yourself. Sit down, sit down." Hobert continued, "You have to go around the territory and take a look. You don't have to do anything else, just look!"
Hobert didn't plan to let Freya become an Beyonder right away. He planned to wait until Selena came and give them the opportunity to become Beyonder at the same time.
Before that, let Freya adapt to her new life.
Freya was a little uneasy, "But, but..."
"Use your eyes to feel the changes in this territory during this period, and try to broaden your horizons as much as possible. This is the prerequisite for becoming a good student."
Freya nodded quickly, "Yes, yes..."
"Allen!" Hobert called in the male servant waiting outside, "This is my student, Miss Freya. She's a little uncomfortable here. Take her to visit the manor and arrange her in the room next to Marcy and Mary.
"Also, take her to the town to make some local-style clothes, and find a desk and chair in the warehouse and send them to my study.
"Oh, right, she can't speak Feynapotter yet, so you can help her arrange these things."
Marcy and Mary are Fors's two maids.
"Yes!" Allen was also a little strange. The Baron hadn't come out of the study all day, so how could he suddenly have a female student? And she can't speak Feynapotter?
Strange as it was, Allen still took Freya out very politely. Only then did he dare to look up at the "Baron's student".
She looked seventeen or eighteen years old, her skin and hair were a little rough, her cheeks were thin and a little yellow, and her hands seemed to have some burns, but even so, the vigor that a girl should have was still there, but she looked a little shy.
Allen also looked at Freya's clothes, which had exotic features, but the clothes looked a little old and had patches.
After making a basic judgment on Freya's background, he couldn't help but sigh, "What good luck!"
Being favored by the Baron and becoming the Baron's student is definitely good luck.
Hobert rested for a while, but as soon as he stopped, images of corpses lying on the streets of the East Borough immediately appeared in his mind.
Only then did he belatedly realize: The Black Hound spirit beast hasn't been recovered yet! Why hasn't it come to me?
Hobert quickly entered the 'Nation of Disorder', but he still couldn't sense the Black Hound spirit beast.
He pinched his chin and pondered for a while, then returned to the real world and used the 'Faceless Man Necklace' to divine the whereabouts of the Black Hound spirit beast, but the result of the divination was a pitch-black night.
Hobert was about to change to another divination word when he suddenly thought: Could it have been taken into Foggy Town!
He immediately changed the divination word: "The Black Hound spirit beast blessed by the ancient Death God is in Foggy Town!"
"..."
After reciting it seven times in a row, the divination failed.
Hobert sacrificed the "Faceless Necklace" to the "Nation of Disorder" to re-divine, but the divination still failed.
Although the level of the "Nation of Disorder" is high, it only has a certain ability to resist divination, but it doesn't add much to divination.
Hobert pondered for a while and had another idea. He held a wisp of "Power of Order" in his hand, trying to establish a connection with the "Power of Order" in the black dog spirit beast.
This time, he finally felt the "Power of Order" in the black dog spirit beast, but that was all, and he couldn't get more information.
But this was enough for Hobert. After such a long time, the "Power of Order" in the black dog spirit beast had not been diluted, which was enough to prove that it was now in a closed space.
It should be Foggy Town!
Isn't this just bad luck! In the blink of an eye, he was sent into Foggy Town by the Evernight Goddess!
Hobert frowned: "It would be better to send the 'Bull Demon King' in!"
Then he seemed to realize something and said to the skull of the crow-feathered golden-horned evil monster: "I don't mean anything else, I just hope to let you see the world!"
The "Bull Demon King" can only be used seven times now, while the black dog spirit beast can theoretically be used countless times.
Hobert sighed: Now it's all right, not only the angel-level combat power, but even the saint-level combat power has to be used sparingly.
At this moment, Hobert saw a strange star expanding in the pool in front of him.
He spread his spirituality over, and sure enough, it was a member of the Balk family who was offering the payment for Beyonder characteristics.
...
South Continent, outside Crowlier City.
Elliot and Lawrence and others are discussing the construction of textile factories and sending people to the Northern Continent to study.
Lawrence suddenly wanted to play with that Level 0 Sealed Artifact, so he took out the crown sealed in the cloth bag and played with it in front of everyone.
The other people at the venue didn't think there was anything wrong with this, and thought it was the most normal thing.
Only Lawrence, who was holding the Sealed Artifact, felt that his current behavior was a bit strange, but he couldn't say what was strange.
Then Elliot felt that he hadn't prayed to the "Creator" for a long time, which made him feel very unfaithful, so he said goodbye to everyone and returned to his room to pray to the "Creator", saying that he had important things to report.
After praying once, the "Creator" did not reply in time, and then Elliot prayed for the second time.
...
On the "Iron Throne", Hobert looked at the pile of gold and kinreaux in front of him, and his mood gradually improved.
At this time, he saw the star representing Elliot light up.
Spreading his spirituality over, Hobert almost jumped off the "Iron Throne". Elliot was bowing his head and praying piously, and standing next to him was a simple and gentle priest in a simple white robe with a light golden beard and a cross pendant hanging on his chest.
"Adam!"
Although Hobert had never seen Adam before, he was sure that this was Adam!
Hobert's first thought was to pack his bags and run! He wouldn't be the "Creator" anymore, nor would he be a baron, and he would lie dormant somewhere for two years.
But soon, he slowly sat down again and quickly calmed down: When I decided to help the Balk family fight that battle, hadn't I already prepared myself for the possibility of encountering such high-level figures!
Then he understood: This is the influence of the original book on me. I always feel that Adam and Amon are strange and terrifying. But the premise is that if Adam and Amon are on the same path or adjacent paths, then these two enemies are terrible! I don't have the most direct conflict of interest with them, so what am I afraid of!
Thinking of this, Hobert quickly calmed down: The only conflict I have with Adam now may be that, in his opinion, I am hindering George III from becoming the Black Emperor, or hindering the "era torrent" created by Adam, but I have no ability to stop these two things.
Hobert nodded: In fact, what Adam mainly cares about is whether the suddenly emerging "Creator" will hinder the "era torrent" he created? As for whether George III becomes a god, he won't take it too seriously. As long as the event of George III preparing to become the Black Emperor causes a full-scale war between the Loen Kingdom and the Feysac Empire, and the entire North and South Continent enters a state of war, Adam will not care whether George III becomes a god.
After clarifying the main contradictions, Hobert began to ponder how to deal with Adam who suddenly came to his door: First of all, one thing is certain, if he talks to Adam in a short time, Adam will not be able to harm himself in the "Nation of Disorder".
This is certain, after all, the level of the "Nation of Disorder" is here, and Adam is now only at the "King of Angels" level.
Of course, if you babble with the other party for an hour or two, it will be hard to say.
Then, we must quickly clarify the root of the conflict between the two sides and show that we do not pose a threat to the other party.
Hobert sighed, and he can't appear too cowardly, otherwise, if he deals with Adam again in the future, he will be at a psychological disadvantage.
After thinking for a while, Hobert projected his image into the star belonging to Elliot: "Adam!"
...
Southern Continent, in a luxurious villa outside Crowlier City.
Adam saw the image of the "Creator". The black divine light emanating from Him blocked Adam's sight and perception.
But Adam still obtained some information based on some details: He is still very weak, and now he can only occasionally exert the strength of a god by using a certain Sealed Artifact. "Nation of Disorder"? It shouldn't be, that is a huge source of corruption, even Trunsoest couldn't resist its corruption, or is the "Creator" Trunsoest?
Only the "Creator" said in a solemn tone: "Adam!"
Adam was not surprised that the other party knew him.
As soon as the "Creator" spoke, Adam saw or rather felt more information: "You are a descendant of Trunsoest!"
The "Creator" almost blurted out: How the hell did you see that?

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 434: Wedding Date Confirmed (Bonus 8)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Already panicking inside, Hobert tried his best to appear calm: "I know why you've come to me."
He resisted the urge to wipe away the cold sweat and smiled faintly: "I won't affect the so-called tide of the times, because this tide is also beneficial to me. I'm even less interested in whether you become a god or not."
Adam nodded slowly, not surprised that the "Creator" knew his purpose; in fact, this was more reasonable.
Based on this, the "Creator's" promise seemed more credible.
"Contact me directly if anything happens in the future." Hobert wanted to end the conversation as soon as possible.
As for contact information: guess!
But Adam suddenly said, "George III will become the Black Emperor, and the God of Combat Church just sent the Brass Book of Trunsoest to Castiya."
Hobert smiled faintly: "You also know how forced George III's ascension to godhood is.
"You can fool Augustus and those other fools with that kind of talk, but you can't fool me."
Adam didn't continue speaking. He saw a lot of contradictory information, such as the "Creator's" weakness exceeding his imagination.
But the "Creator" happened to know a lot of secrets. Logically speaking, knowing so much, he shouldn't be so weak. Could it be that he's hiding his strength?
Adam remembered the last time he couldn't see through his opponent's reality like this was in the Fourth Epoch.
In the end, he concluded: the other party is at most at the level of an angel, but a difficult opponent.
After this simple and rapid psychological game, Hobert immediately cut off contact with Elliot.
Adam also left. Elliot felt that his prayer was pious enough, so he went back to continue the meeting. No one felt there was anything wrong with this.
...
In the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert wiped away a cold sweat, but he quickly realized: I'm in a spirit body state right now, where would the cold sweat come from.
He smiled helplessly: Even with the protection of the "Nation of Disorder," Adam could see through my reality if we talked any longer.
After waiting for a long while, Hobert felt that his mood had calmed down before looking at Elliot's situation again.
They were in a meeting, as if nothing had happened just now.
Forget it, it's fine if they don't know.
But on second thought: No, it wouldn't be right if my believer didn't know Adam's basic information. As long as they know Adam, Adam will know them. And if they don't know Adam, it's as if I'm afraid of Adam and dare not tell my believers about his information.
Hobert sighed: Ah, dealing with people on the "Visionary" pathway is really troublesome. If there's even a slightly unexpected point, they can interpret a lot of information from it.
So Hobert projected the scene of Elliot's prayer just now into his star.
...
Southern Continent, in a luxurious villa in the suburbs of Crowlier City.
Elliot, who was in a meeting, suddenly had a picture in his mind. When he was praying just now, there was actually a priest with a golden beard standing next to him!
Elliot blurted out, "How did I not notice!"
Lawrence and the others were stunned. Elliot quickly explained, "Just now, the 'Creator' gave a hint. I, I was praying just now, and there was actually a priest standing next to me. How did I not notice at all?"
Everyone was a little surprised. To be able to deceive the spirituality of a Sequence 6, that priest's level should not be low.
Lawrence said, "Pray to the 'Creator' again and ask what's going on?"
Elliot then reacted from his shock and went to a corner next to the meeting room to pray.
It's not that his psychological quality is too poor, but this kind of experience is too scary.
Imagine one day, a person is working or studying as usual, feeling that there is nothing worth paying attention to all day long.
But in fact, when he is working and studying, there is a person sitting quietly next to him, watching his every move.
This feeling of having no privacy and being unable to detect the other person's existence is frightening to think about.
After Elliot prayed to the "Creator," the image of the "Creator" once again appeared in front of everyone through Elliot's star: "That is the Angel of Imagination, Adam!"
As the "Creator" spoke, he waved his hand, and the entire meeting room was immediately filled with the "Power of Order," and everyone seemed to suddenly wake up.
Everyone immediately stood up. Before they could praise the "Creator," they each discovered what was wrong with them just now.
Lawrence: "Why did I take out the 'Balancer Crown' to play with while in the meeting just now?"
Elliot: "Why did I suddenly want to pray to the 'Creator' in the middle of the meeting just now, and for so long?"
Chester: "Why didn't I feel that your performances were wrong just now?"
"Creator": "This is Adam's ability!"
Hobert didn't explain in detail, letting them experience it for themselves.
The more they thought about it, the more scared they became, especially Lawrence. As the only Saint in this room, he only felt a little strange when he was holding the "Balancer Crown"!
The key is that he exposed the family's Grade 0 Sealed Artifact in front of the other party.
Lawrence asked, "Great 'Creator,' what Sequence is Adam?"
Hobert: "He is a King of Angels!"
Lawrence and the two demigod elders' eyes narrowed. The three of them could read some family books of a confidential nature, which contained descriptions of the "King of Angels."
Elliot also asked, "Respected 'Creator,' why did Adam come?"
Hobert said in a solemn voice, "Looking for me. He has already left now."
After speaking, the "Creator" also disappeared from the meeting room.
The few people looked at each other, and no one spoke for a long time.
It wasn't until two or three minutes later that Elliot asked, "Patriarch, elders, what Sequence is 'King of Angels'?"
Lawrence glanced at the other two demigod elders before saying, "Above Sequence 1, below True God."
"True… True God!" Elliot was full of surprise. He didn't expect that he, who was still very weak, could come into contact with such a high-level existence.
Then the few people looked at each other. Such an existence could only be here to look for the "Creator," otherwise no one else would have known he had been here.
This should be a high-level meeting. As for what the two big figures specifically talked about, they could only guess.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Returning to the real world, Hobert immediately prayed to himself, then returned to the "Nation of Disorder" and used "True Sight" to confirm that Adam was not appearing beside him.
Hobert knew Adam better. In addition to ignoring Adam's existence, he could also change other people's decisions without anyone knowing. Without "True Sight," Hobert felt that he would become paranoid and wonder: Did I make this decision myself? Or did Adam help me make it?
Another thing is Adam's "Author" ability, which can "write people to death" without leaving home, which belongs to "remote attack."
However, Hobert wasn't too worried about being in danger in the real world. He had thought about this issue before.
He believed that the "Nation of Disorder" could help him cut off the connection between the "Creator" and Hobert, and also cut off the connection between the masked man in the Backlund smog and Hobert returning to Feynapotter.
The incident just now proved Hobert's guess, otherwise Adam would have come directly to Hobert, and would not have just gone to Elliot.
So, after sealing Adam's memory in the "Nation of Disorder," there is currently no danger in the real world.
At noon in the Harvest Church, Hobert dared to participate in the smog incident based on this kind of thinking.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert thought: Adam suddenly came to me, it shouldn't be just because the "Creator's" "subordinate" appeared in the smog incident.
Before Hobert participated in the "Backlund Smog Incident," he had done a lot of thinking in the Harvest Church.
Until now, he still believed that the "tide of the times" that Adam had been pushing should be: the improvement of the steam engine made the world enter a new era, the production capacity of various countries in the Northern Continent gradually became surplus, and the gap between the rich and the poor in various countries gradually increased. The series of contradictions caused by these unprecedented problems can only be solved by a world war.
As for George III's promotion, it is the best catalyst for these contradictions. After all, after more than a thousand years of game and battle, the extraordinary power of the four countries in the Northern Continent is basically in a balanced state, and none of them will rashly start a full-scale war.
But it's different if George III wants to become a god. This will force the Feysac Empire, the mortal enemy of the Kingdom of Loen, to start a war before George III becomes a god, and make the Kingdom of Feynapotter join the war without hesitation.
Hobert believed that this "tide" was not very related to the scale of the smog. This was a consequence caused by an accident triggered by Trissy and Klein, and it was also a "population balance" done by George III who needed a large number of slaves to build the mausoleum, which may not have been in Adam's "script."
Even if it is in Adam's script, as long as the smog incident occurs, Adam shouldn't care whether so many people die, because even if so many people don't die, the sudden appearance of enough respiratory infection patients can also attract widespread attention.
Now, thinking back to this question, Hobert believed that Adam suspected that the "Creator" knew that George III was preparing to become the Black Emperor because the "Creator's" "subordinate" participated in the smog incident.
Just now, the "Creator" showed amazing strength in General Anthony's territory in the Southern Continent. Adam was afraid that the "Creator" would destroy his "tide of the times" script, so he planned to come forward and talk to the "Creator".
But because the "Creator's" "subordinate" did not take any action to destroy George III's mausoleum, and the "Creator" also admitted that he would benefit from Adam's "tide of the times."
Adam didn't feel any threat here, so the matter was resolved.
Hobert smiled slightly: "Sure enough, grasping the main contradiction is equivalent to grasping the bull's nose of the problem."
The situation was urgent just now, and he didn't have time to think so much, but he still grasped the main contradiction and responded properly.
With this matter over, Hobert plans to be honest for a while, focusing his energy on developing the territory, and after a while, no one will pay attention to the "Creator" anymore.
As for the risks encountered in this matter, Hobert believes that this is the "cost" he has gained, just like the action to subdue the Balk family.
Sometimes the opportunity for development comes as soon as it comes, regardless of whether Hobert is ready. If you want to seize the opportunity, you must bear the risks involved. There has never been a good thing that you can enjoy the results without taking risks.
Hobert knew that his idea was incompatible with the essence of "enduring" in this extraordinary world, but "enduring" is the development essence of the "Fool" pathway. If Hobert also does this, he may never become the "Black Emperor."
The only thing that Hobert couldn't figure out was why he didn't leave immediately when he encountered the "Frenzied Mage" of the Solomon family before? He even foolishly waited for the Beyonder characteristics of the "Demoness of Despair" to explode.
After Hobert repeatedly pondered, he believed that this was the work of 0-08 or Adam. Although the mask he was wearing gave him a certain protection, he would still be arranged with some seemingly normal but somewhat abnormal behaviors after careful consideration.
Prevent fire, prevent thieves, prevent Adam!
Returning to the real world, the sky was already dusk.
Just as Hobert was preparing to have dinner, Fors ran over from her room: "Hobert, a big thing happened in Backlund today!"
She spoke with gestures, telling the story of the Backlund smog incident.
Hobert then said, "I know about this. A friend asked me to help rescue people. I also rescued a girl from the smog."
"Is that so?" Fors "praised," "So amazing! You only saved one girl?"
"There's also an old man!" Hobert quickly said, "I originally wanted to bring them all back to the territory, but the old man didn't want to come, so I had to arrange for him to stay in Backlund.
"As for that girl, you will see her at dinner later."
Fors said "Oh." This topic was considered over: "Do you know why the smog happened?"
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief and asked with a curious expression, "Isn't it because the smoke from the factory is too serious, making the smog somewhat toxic?"
He sighed in his heart: Sure enough, life in this world depends entirely on acting.
Just over an hour ago, Hobert had used his acting skills to deceive the most difficult man in the world to deceive, but he was still walking on thin ice in front of Fors.
Fors told the news that Xio had heard: A prince fell in love with a witch. The king ordered the prince to abandon the witch. In a fit of anger, the witch increased the toxicity in the smog, causing serious consequences. The prince has committed suicide to apologize.
This story was obviously fabricated, but Fors firmly believed it, because the prince who committed suicide was named Edessak, and Mr. Fool had reminded him at the Tarot Club.
Of course, Fors would naturally not tell Hobert about Mr. Fool's reminder, but only explain to him how reliable Xio's intelligence was.
There was one more person at the dinner table. Helen curiously looked at Freya. The fiery gaze from those beautiful eyes made Freya blush a little.
Hobert introduced Freya: "This is my fiancée, Miss Fors. This is a guest of the lord's mansion, Miss Helen."
Freya, who had changed into local attire, breathed a sigh of relief. Now she was finally convinced that Mr. Hobert hadn't brought her back out of lust.
Because his fiancée was very elegant, beautiful, and had a great figure.
And his lover was shy and lovely, with eyes that seemed to speak, directly captivating people's hearts.
Based on Freya's experience, she naturally assumed that Helen was the teacher's lover.
Hobbes then said to Fors, "Tomorrow morning, go find Xio and buy me some textbooks. I'm going to teach Freya to read and write. After she has accumulated a certain vocabulary, you can teach her grammar!"
Because Helen was present, Hobert didn't directly tell Fors to go to Backlund, but instead asked her to "find Xio."
Fors, of course, understood Hobbes's meaning, and she nodded, "No problem."
Hobbes added, "I have a second matter to discuss. My mother and sister, Donna, will arrive in Jeffery's territory tomorrow morning, at the latest in the afternoon."
He said to Fors, "After buying the textbooks, come back quickly and go with me to the docks to welcome Mother."
Hobert had mentioned this before, and Fors nodded somewhat nervously, "Okay!"
Finally, Hobert said to Helen, "Please ask Ms. Monica to come by tomorrow afternoon. I have something to discuss with her."
The Backlund smog incident had put Hobert's Witch Church on his list of enemies, but of course, he wouldn't tell the Knowledge Church: I'm going to be enemies with your superiors.
He planned to observe whether there was a possibility of using the Theosophy Order to let the enemies wear themselves out, which was also a way to deal with them.
Besides the Witch Church, Hobert also included the Aurora Order and the Loen Kingdom's royal family on his list of enemies.
The Aurora Order went without saying; he would kill them on sight.
As for the Loen Kingdom's royal family, they could only be temporarily included on the list of enemies, as he currently had no means to deal with them.
Helen nodded, "Okay."
Hobert then said, "Alright, with the serious matters out of the way, let's eat."
After dinner, Hobert returned to his study. Suddenly, the light in the study dimmed, and Hobert sensed something. He saw a huge skeleton appear in the study.
Its eye sockets flickered with dark red light, and it seemed to stare at Hobert for a second or two, as if confirming it was him, before opening its hand and placing a letter on the desk.
Then the skeleton collapsed as if it had fallen apart, and its bones scattered as it left the study.
Hobert didn't make any rash moves, because he suspected this was Mr. Azik's messenger.
Opening the letter on the desk, it was indeed from Mr. Azik.
Azik first expressed his apologies in the letter, saying that he had been a little busy recently and hadn't replied to Hobert's letter.
He also stated that after separating from Hobert last time, he had gone to see the corpse of the Ancient Sun God alone, but it could no longer remind him of more things, and he shouldn't need to observe the corpse of the Ancient Sun God again in the future.
At the end of the letter, Azik reminded Hobert to seal the corpse of the Ancient Sun God, otherwise it would easily attract Beyonder beings of the "Death" pathway.
Mr. Azik also thoughtfully listed two sealing methods, both relying on the power of the spirit world to seal it.
Hobert immediately asked the kitchen to make doughnuts, and he wrote a simple reply.
He first thanked Mr. Azik for the reminder and the sealing methods provided, and promised to seal the corpse of the Ancient Sun God properly.
Hobert also briefly mentioned his current situation and invited Mr. Azik to visit his territory.
After waiting for more than half an hour for the doughnuts to be made, Hobert summoned the messenger to send the letter, and settled the 8 doughnuts he owed from last time.
Returning to his bedroom, Hobert couldn't help but see the scene he saw in the East Borough of Backlund when he closed his eyes.
He had to use meditation to fall asleep as soon as possible.
The next morning, Hobert personally directed everyone in the yard to clean the Lord's manor and tidy up the road up the mountain.
Around nine o'clock, Fors, who had rarely gotten up early, had already bought the textbooks. After applying light makeup, she rode in a carriage with Hobert to the docks to welcome Mona and her party.
The news that the Lord's mother was coming had already spread, and the docks were filled with people welcoming Mona and her party.
Around ten o'clock in the morning, two ships, one large and one small, were finally seen entering Full Moon Lake from upstream.
Before the ship docked, Donna was already shouting loudly on the ship, "Hobert, is being a Lord fun?"
Hobert smiled, "I'll let you be a Lord for a day tomorrow, and you can try it yourself!"
The two were speaking in Loenese, and only Fors on the side smiled knowingly. The people around didn't know what they were shouting, but everyone could hear the joy in their conversation.
The ship finally docked and the gangway was lowered. Hobert had been chatting with Donna in shouts for more than ten minutes.
Donna was the first to rush down and spread her arms to hug him: "Hobert!"
After hugging her brother, Donna hugged Fors: "Sister-in-law! From the first time I saw you, I knew you would definitely be my sister-in-law!"
Fors blushed a little, and suddenly didn't know how to face Donna.
The last time they met, she was still a "friend's sister", but this time they met, she was already a "fiancé's sister."
But even without her responding, Donna could chatter on and on by herself.
Hobert reached out to help Mona, who was getting off the ship: "Mother."
"Mm." Mona smiled and sized up Hobert: "You've lost a little weight."
Hobert smiled and said, "Maybe I haven't quite adapted to the food in Feneport yet."
Mona took Fors's hand again: "Are you used to living here?"
"It's very nice here," Fors quickly said.
The two held hands and talked for a while, and then the residents on the dock bowed and shouted, "Madam!"
Mona smiled and waved to them, showing that Hobert was well-loved by the people here.
The group rode in carriages back to the Lord's manor, and because it was already noon, they went to the dining room to eat first.
As soon as everyone sat down in the dining room, Mona asked Hobert, "Have you set a wedding date yet?"
Hobert was stunned; he hadn't really thought about it.
Fors was also stunned: Aren't we contract spouses? Do we have to get married properly? If we have a wedding, wouldn't I really be married to Hobert?
Mona glanced at the two young people and said helplessly, "These young people nowadays!
"Since you haven't made any plans, I'll decide for you. The wedding date is set for January 28th!"
