chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 435: Launching the Land Revolution (Bonus 9)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert pondered for a moment and immediately agreed, "Alright!
"However, we plan to hold our wedding in my territory."
He suddenly thought that the wedding of Earl Christian's son would surely attract many dignitaries, which would be like a wave of publicity for his territory.
Fors saw Hobert agree so readily, and being in such a setting, she couldn't say anything more.
Mona nodded, "You decide on that."
She added, "I will have Dophis come to Jeffrey Territory a few days in advance to help you decorate the wedding venue and make preparations for the reception."
With the wedding settled, Mona was finally in the mood to enjoy the food.
The uncertainty of Hobert's wedding date had been worrying her.
Hobert then introduced Freya, as it was a family dinner, and Hobert didn't invite Helen.
However, Helen was also busy at noon today, as she went to inform Mrs. Monica.
Mona introduced a young man in his twenties she had brought with her: "This is Angus Jeffrey, your cousin."
Angus politely stood up and bowed slightly to Hobert.
Hobert also stood up and shook his hand politely, a little puzzled: How did a cousin suddenly appear? Didn't Christian have no siblings? Could it be... Could it be Christian's illegitimate son?
Regardless of this cousin's background, the protagonists of this lunch were Hobert, Mona, and Donna. With Donna enlivening the atmosphere, the atmosphere in the restaurant was cheerful.
Donna suddenly said to Hobert, "I don't plan to go back, Hobert. Give me a high-ranking position."
Hobert smiled, "I'm just a baron, where would I get a high-ranking position for you?"
"Then you can knight me!"
"Don't mess around, go back to school."
"I know your and Father's and Dophis' secret!" Donna chuckled, "Father told me to choose my own life."
Hobert was taken aback, "What secret?"
"The secret that you have magical abilities!"
Hobert glanced at Mona, who smiled, "If you need manpower here, keep her here. I'm relieved to have her with you."
Hobert then nodded, "I happen to need someone trustworthy to collect taxes for me, so why not give you this job? But I have to say in advance, if you need money, ask me. If you hide tax money, I'll send you home immediately."
Mona was about to say something, but Hobert added, "In the beginning, it's impossible for you to be in charge of taxation. How about this, there's a meeting this afternoon. You can participate together and follow them outside to get a feel for the specific work situation."
Donna immediately agreed, "No problem!"
This arrangement also reassured Mona, "I have nothing to do this afternoon, so I'll go listen to your meeting too."
Hobert nodded, "Okay."
"Also," Mona said, "Your father wants you to arrange a job for Angus too."
Hobert didn't know the truth about this guy and didn't immediately agree, "I'll think about it and find him a good job."
The official business ended there, and the family didn't talk about these things anymore.
Hobert didn't think that talking about official business at a family dinner would ruin the atmosphere. In his opinion, these were just words spoken behind closed doors between family members.
After a fairly lavish lunch, Hobert took them to the pre-arranged yard to rest.
Donna and Angus went to rest separately. Mona said she wasn't tired yet and asked Hobert to talk to her for a while.
As Hobert expected, his mother immediately brought up Angus' background: "Your father's surname is actually Tudor, you should already know that, right?"
"I know."
"Well, there are basically three branches of the Tudor family left, one of which is the family your father was born into." Mona continued to explain, "When your father was young, he disagreed with the clan leader's distribution of family resources, so he left the family and developed on his own."
Hobert then realized that his mother, Mona, knew a lot of inside information. It was just that she hadn't participated in some of Christian's affairs before, or maybe she had, but Hobert didn't know.
Mona continued, "In the past, no matter how difficult your father was in the Southern Continent, the Tudor family never offered a helping hand.
"Now that your father is highly appreciated by Ferdinand II, they have come again, saying they want to invite your father to participate in the family's Council of Elders.
"Your father told them he didn't have time, so they sent Angus, saying he was your father's helper.
"This made it difficult for your father to keep him or send him away, so he sent Angus to you.
"Just find him a job, and if it doesn't work out, just send him away. Anyway, the Tudor family hasn't given you any favors, so there's no need to be polite with them."
Hobert asked, "What sequence is Angus?"
"It should be Sequence 6."
Hobert smiled, "It's a pity to send him away. I'm just preparing to clean up the surrounding forces. He's Sequence 6 after all, so I might as well use him."
Mona also smiled, "You decide."
Then Mona talked about Fors, liking her more and more. Hobert also followed this topic and talked about how he met Fors.
At two o'clock in the afternoon, according to Hobert's notification yesterday, Conrad, Philip, Roy, and others came to the main hall to attend the meeting called by the lord.
When they saw Mona in the main seat, they were all slightly stunned, but they still called out together, "Old Madam."
Hobert, who was sitting in front of Mona's side, said, "My mother wants to hear about the management of the territory, so she's attending this meeting with me."
Hobert knew that Mona was worried about whether he could be a good lord. After all, from lawyer to lord, the professional span was quite large.
"Let's first discuss the issue of re-allocating land." Hobert asked Conrad, "How is the preparation work going?"
"The manpower is already in place." Conrad said, "I am training them, and we can officially start in the next few days."
Hobert said, "I plan to have you form a propaganda team and go to each village to publicize the policy of re-allocating land, so that you can give them better training in the work."
"But," Conrad said, "This time we are re-allocating land by confiscating the land of the village bullies and distributing it to other villagers.
"If we publicize it in advance, will it give the village bullies some time to prepare?"
The previous field property registration had already made the land situation in Jeffrey Territory very clear.
These village bullies were all people who had been favored by Viscount Wright before, or who supported the bandits in power. A small number of them actually controlled nearly one-third of the land.
In addition, there was land belonging to the bandits on the mountain before. Some of that land belonged to the Wright family before, and some was taken from the villagers by the bandits through coercion.
The bandits had already been defeated by Hobert, but the ownership of these lands was a problem.
The remaining one-third of the land belonged to the vast majority of the population, the self-cultivating farmers.
Hobert smiled, "What are they preparing? To rebel?
"Not only should we publicize the policy of equal distribution of land, but mainly to tell them that from now on, the ownership of all land in the territory belongs to the lord.
"After the land is distributed to them, they only have the right to cultivate and lease it, but not to buy or sell it.
"Even the lease contract must be reported to the lord's mansion, otherwise the contract will be invalid!"
If those village bullies dared to resist, it would be easier to solve. They could be directly tied to the construction site and undergo labor reform for a year or two first.
Conrad said, "Yes, I will do the corresponding publicity!"
Hobert then said to Seel, "Take people to protect the safety of the propaganda team."
After all, this was moving the interests of some people, so it was better to be careful.
Seel said, "Yes!"
Then Hobert added, "My mother also brought 300 new-style rifles, as well as dozens of pistols, and two instructors.
"After you complete the task of protecting the propaganda team, organize fifty young adults and formally form the army of Jeffrey Territory.
"Remember my previous request?"
Seel said happily, "I remember! We can't only recruit young people from the town, we should try to average the quota to the entire Jeffrey Territory. I'll go to each village with the propaganda team to determine the quota."
Hobert nodded in satisfaction and said to Corwin, "You also participate in this propaganda team and publicize the 12 simplified regulations that I have made.
"This was originally your father's job, but now I'll give this job to you first."
Finally, Hobert said to Donna, "And you, Donna, you follow the propaganda of the new tax law. Do you know about personal income tax and business tax?"
Everyone certainly knew that Donna was the lord's sister, but since the lord directly called Donna, it meant that he had work requirements for her.
Although Donna's university major was not law, she also knew some basic knowledge of personal income tax and business tax.
After listening to her description, Hobert added some details. In the future, the personal income tax in Jeffrey Territory would be collected starting from a monthly income of 2 gold Lire, and divided into several levels, 2 gold Lire to 5 gold Lire was one level, and 5 to 10 gold Lire was another level.
The higher the level, the greater the proportion of taxation.
The business tax is collected from a single transaction of 1 gold Lire or more, and is divided into two tax standards: one is the transaction amount, and the other is the type of tax.
These tax laws are not very useful now, because the monthly income of the residents of Jeffrey Territory, except for some people working in the lord's mansion, is almost all below 2 gold Lire.
The transactions are only for trading vegetables and other crops, and the shops in Jeffrey Town are currently unlikely to have a one-time transaction amount of more than 1 gold Lire.
It is time to collect taxes when the territory develops.
Finally, it was to discuss the progress of the project with Roy. More than 600 people have now been mobilized and are preparing to lay railways and build concrete roads leading to the mountains.
The renovation work in the town has also begun, but the problem is that the building materials are used up, and Roy can only follow the drawings and direct them to dig the foundation first.
Hobert asked Roy to clear a piece of ground, and the first batch of building materials would arrive soon.
Mona, who had been watching, nodded in satisfaction. She didn't expect that Hobert was only in his twenties and had never been a nobleman before, but he could manage the territory in an orderly manner, at least it looked orderly.
She didn't quite understand the role of Hobert's new policies, but she still had the ability to judge people. The people who worked for Hobert were all shrewd, capable, and loyal enough to Hobert.
Whether a person is capable can be seen from the way they speak, and their dissatisfaction with Mona sitting in the main seat is enough to show the lord's position in their hearts.
After the meeting, Hobert asked Donna and Corwin to participate in the propaganda team's meeting as Conrad's subordinates, and prepare to start "going to the countryside" this afternoon.
The word "going to the countryside" was "invented" by Hobert just now. Hobert translated it directly as "go to the countryside", extending the meaning to "carry out relevant work in the countryside".
There is no concept of "going to the countryside" in the current Northern Continent, but now Hobert clearly stated that understanding the situation in the countryside is an important criterion for the promotion of Jeffrey Territory's government personnel.
After Conrad and others left to implement the work at the meeting, Mona encouraged Hobert a few words, praising him for being able to understand the territory so well in such a short period of time.
After only a few words, Alan came to report: "Lord, Miss Helen brought Mrs. Monica here."
Hobert nodded and said to Mona, "Mother, go to the backyard to rest first, I want to talk to them about something alone."
Mona agreed, and Fors accompanied her out from the side door.
Hobert came out of the main hall and welcomed Monica into the side hall.
Although the side hall was also very spacious, it was much smaller than the main hall, and it had sofas and coffee tables, making it a very suitable place for secret talks.
Monica's temperament was still so charming. She didn't need to use "charm", and her every move showed the charm of a woman.
However, Hobbit was already Sequence 5 at this time and could directly face the charm displayed by Monica.
After a few simple pleasantries, Hobert said, "Mrs. Monica, you should have heard that the Taz River waterway has been reopened.
"Although we have only had political cooperation and no cooperation on interests..."
Hobert's so-called "political cooperation" was his default of the "Theosophy Order's" legitimacy in religion, and the "Theosophy Order" recognized the rationality of Hobert's rule over Jeffrey Territory.
"As political allies, I must remind you that this will be a huge change in South Kolson, please be prepared." Hobert probed.
Mrs. Monica smiled, "Lord Hobert, your abilities far exceed our imagination, and we are already preparing for this.
"But according to our estimates, the Church of the Earth Mother should not be able to send a demigod to South Colson to sit in, so we only need to train the believers to hide their beliefs."
They are very good at this, after all, in other places, the believers of the "Theosophy Order" secretly preach and secretly hold rituals.
Hobert said seriously, "If you think so, then please forgive me, I will terminate the political alliance with you."
Monica was stunned before smiling, "We can't compete with the Church of the Earth Mother for believers!"
Although the Church of the Earth Mother will not send a demigod, if they find out that there are so many believers of the "Theosophy Order" here, they will definitely organize enough power to carry out a purge.
"Forgive my bluntness, but the Theosophy Order is a bunch of idiots!" Hobert said, "It is precisely because the Church of the Earth Mother is weak in South Colson County that you have the opportunity to legalize!
"Not only is there the power of the Theosophy Order here, but also the power of the Blood Sanctify Believers and the Aurora Order. You can fully cooperate, purge these forces with the Church of the Earth Mother, and then use the base of believers to strive for legalization."
Ms. Monica was slightly stunned before smiling and saying, "You are a natural politician, but you don't understand religion. The Church of the Earth Mother will not allow our existence.
"Even if we help them eliminate the other forces entrenched here, they will still turn around and wipe us out."
"That's why I invited you here," Hobert said, "I am preparing to form my own official Beyonder force. As a political ally, I invite a portion of the Beyonder power of the Theosophy Order to join and help solve Beyonder events involving religion.
"If you are willing to join, I will talk to the Church of the Earth Mother about your legitimacy issues.
"At the same time, this is a political commitment to you as your political ally. Even if the Church of the Earth Mother goes back on its word afterward, I can still protect your official status. The Theosophy Order will always have a legitimate force in South Colson."
This was unexpected by Monica. She fell into a brief silence, and after a full half minute, she asked, "Aren't you afraid that getting involved with the Theosophy Order will affect your political career and personal reputation?"
Hobert smiled: "Power is the only standard in this world for measuring a person."
"I mean, can you withstand the pressure?" Monica asked, "I can see that you have advanced to Sequence 5, and I also know that your father is Christian.
"But such power does not seem enough to make the Church of the Earth Mother yield to you and your father."
Hobert bluntly stated the matter: "I understand what you mean. You are afraid that I am also using you, you are afraid that I will also betray you.
"Let me put it this way, I can ask a Saint to help me strike at the demons and demigods of the Aurora Order at any time.
"The reason why I am cooperating with you is indeed for my own purposes, but my purpose is to hope that you can have a certain legitimacy in my territory, so as to prevent the Church of the Earth Mother from dominating my territory.
"I think this is a win-win cooperation. Do you want to always live in the shadow of the orthodox churches? Do you want to always preach in such a secretive manner?"
Hobert's last sentence moved Monica. Anyone who has lived in the sun, who would want to live a secretive life again?
She was silent for a long time before saying, "This is not something I can decide."
The main leadership of the Theosophy Order is mostly composed of 'Door' pathway Beyonders. Monica and a part of the witches are only responsible for 'diplomatic work'.
Hobert finally threw out the most valuable intelligence: "You better come to a conclusion quickly. I just got news yesterday that the people from the Church of the Earth Mother will arrive in Jeffrey Town in two or three days."
In fact, when he received the payment for the spirituality materials of the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast, Bishop Simpson had mentioned this matter in his letter. The reason why he only told Monica now was to give them enough pressure.
After seeing Monica off, Hobert asked Allen to call his cousin Angus. After a few simple pleasantries, Hobert asked, "I have been considering for a long time, and there is a job that is very suitable for you. I am forming an official Beyonder force in the territory and need a trustworthy captain. I think you are very suitable!"
Angus's eyes lit up. Although the Tudor family has a long and glorious history, even if this family is strong now, they are still wild Beyonders.
It is precisely because they were once the masters of the Tudor Empire that they value the identity of official Beyonders.
The Tudor family sent Angus here, hoping to use Christian's identity to obtain a certain semi-official status in Feynapotter, at least to establish a reliable stronghold.
But Angus did not expect that he would be directly dispatched to this remote place, making it difficult for him to leave or stay.
He had already given up hope for the errands Hobert had arranged for him, but he did not expect that the situation would take a turn for the better, and he would have the opportunity to become an official Beyonder.
As for Hobert, of course, he would not completely hand over the power of the official extraordinary force to the Theosophy Order.
Before learning about Angus's background, Hobert had always planned to cultivate his own official Beyonder force. It was a bit slow, but the power cultivated was more reassuring.
At that time, Hobert did not intend to introduce the power of the Theosophy Order into the official Beyonder force.
After learning that Angus came from the Tudor family, he immediately had the idea of introducing external forces to strike at the demons and the Aurora Order. Even if there were battle losses, he would not feel heartache.
On the other hand, Hobert planned to cultivate his own Beyonder power in Seel's 50-man troop.
Angus nodded almost immediately: "I am willing to stay in Jeffrey Territory and become a member of the official extraordinary force here."
Hobert nodded and asked, "What Sequence are you?"
"Sequence 6."
"'Judge' or 'Baron of Corruption'?"
"Judge!"
Christian's branch of the Tudor family had basically switched to the 'Arbiter' pathway a long time ago.
"You should have heard about the Kingdom of Loen's bounty on me. They sent a lot of mercenaries to kill me, including a 'Disciplinary Knight'," Hobert said with a smile, "Unfortunately, they all died here!"
Angus's eyes lit up!
"I don't know if it is easy for you to be assigned the opportunity to advance to 'Disciplinary Knight' in the family," Hobert saw Angus's expression and already knew the answer: "But here with me, as long as you can be competent in this job, as long as you can make enough contributions, that Beyonder characteristic is yours!"
Angus quickly said: "I will definitely be able to do this job!"
Hobert nodded: "Then the first task I give you is to go back to the family and find some clansmen who want to become official Beyonders, but you have to make it clear to them that being an official Beyonder is prestigious, but there are also considerable dangers. They must be mentally prepared."
Angus smiled: "As long as you are in the extraordinary world, there may be danger anywhere."
He asked again: "How many people do I need to find?"
Hobert said: "It's up to you. The other captain is also a Sequence 6 and has about seven or eight subordinates."
It's just that whether that captain exists is still unknown.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 436: George III, a little troublesome for children (Bonus 10)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert dealt with the official Beyonder affairs and mentioned that he had a batch of "Arbiter" pathway characteristics he wanted to sell. If the Tudor family was interested, they could send someone to discuss it.
After discussing business, Hobert returned to his study to teach Freya vocabulary. However, he found that Freya's pronunciation was not very standard, so he started with the alphabet again, correcting her pronunciation.
Since she was learning Loenese first, which was Freya's native language, he only needed to correct her pronunciation slightly.
Hobert also assigned her ten relatively simple words, asking her to copy them at least fifty times and read them fifty times.
Originally, Freya wanted to find a soft patch of land to practice the words on the ground.
Hobert rejected her idea: "Practice on paper! After you finish writing, you can see if you've made progress."
The first day ended there. Hobert let Freya practice in the study by herself, and he returned to his room. He originally wanted to take gold from the "Nation of Disorder" to find Upton.
However, he found that the 36,000 pounds worth of gold was too heavy, so he only took out a portion of the "Briber" Beyonder characteristic through bestowal.
Then, he changed into Loenese-style clothes, put on a mask, and used "Travel" to come to Conant City, to Upton's office.
Upton quickly got up and said, "Blessed of the God."
Although he knew that the person in front of him was the "Traitor" Hobert, he didn't have much sense of belonging to the Kingdom of Loen. Treason didn't matter much to him.
Hobert took out a small wooden box: "This is your reward, a complete 'Briber' Beyonder characteristic."
Upton thanked him and took it with both hands. He opened the wooden box and took a look. It was indeed the "Briber" Beyonder characteristic.
He breathed a sigh of relief. Although he didn't know if it was his father's Beyonder characteristic, he would soon become a "Briber"! If he continued to serve the "Creator", becoming a "Baron of Corruption" wouldn't be difficult, and there was even hope of becoming a "Mentor of Disorder".
"As for the remaining gold," Hobert said, "because the quantity is too large, I have asked the 'Creator' to give it to you through bestowal."
"In the evening, find a suitable place and pray to the 'Creator'."
Upton nodded: "Okay."
"Is the progress of purchasing materials going smoothly?"
"Smoothly, a batch of materials has already been delivered to the warehouse."
"Give me the address of the warehouse." After getting the address, Hobert smiled and said, "If there are new tasks, I will come to you again."
As he spoke, his figure disappeared in front of Upton.
Upton took a deep breath and opened the wooden box again to examine the Beyonder characteristic. He seemed to see infinite hope.
...
Hobert didn't return to the lord's mansion immediately, but went to the cemetery in the suburbs to rest for a minute. Using the "Faceless Necklace" for navigation, he came to a small town in the suburbs of Backlund.
There was a dilapidated hotel here. Hobert followed the guidance given by the "Faceless Necklace" and knocked on a door.
A hoarse voice came from inside: "Who is it?"
"Hobert!" There were no other guests here, and Hobert had already hypnotized the hotel owner with the "Psychological Spoon", so he could safely report his name.
A few seconds later, the door opened with a "creak".
Hobert could imagine that Klein must have been divining the authenticity of the visitor.
But the divination must have failed, because Hobert was wearing a mask made of "Order Crystal", a fire lacquer seal, a pocket watch key, and a sword hilt, a box for holding sealed items, and so on.
After Klein saw the mysterious symbol belonging to the "Creator" on the visitor's mask, he confirmed that the person was Hobert.
It's just that he was a little curious, he used burning paper dolls for anti-divination processing for every step of his actions, how did Hobert find him?
Although Klein performed anti-divination processing, because he had prayed to the "Creator", there was another close connection between him and Hobert, so Hobert could easily find him with the "Faceless Necklace".
Hobert entered the door and saw Klein without a beard, similar to the way they looked when they first met.
Now Klein is already a "Faceless", whether or not he has a beard is just a matter of his thought.
Hobert saw that his face was not good, so he used a "Healing Spell" on him, immediately curing Klein's cold caused by Mr. A.
Klein smiled and said, "Thank you, how did you find me?"
"The guidance of the 'Creator'." After the two sat face to face on the chairs, Hobert added: "I was ordered to stop the Great Smog in Backlund yesterday, but I failed."
Klein was stunned: "The 'Creator' heard my prayer?"
"Yes." Hobert said: "The 'Creator' told me that you were also involved in this incident, but you had already been rescued by someone else at that time."
Klein nodded, he thought that the "Creator" did not want to participate in this matter.
Hobert did not continue this topic: "What are your plans next?"
"I'm going to go to sea." Klein didn't hide anything. He knew that he might be marked by the "Creator", and Hobert could easily find out his whereabouts.
Hobert smiled and said, "Going to sea is a necessary path for every wild 'Seer', because there are beautiful mermaids on the sea."
Klein was not surprised that Hobert knew that he was going to sea to find mermaids. After all, this was the knowledgeable "Emperor": "Do you know where there are mermaids?"
This question was once discussed at the Tarot Club, but Klein still wanted to ask if there were other channels.
"If you don't want to return to the embrace of the Evernight Goddess, go to the depths of the Sonia Sea to find them." Hobert smiled and said, "But before that, you have to find a reliable ship."
Klein nodded slowly. He had inquired through several channels and got almost the same answer.
Hobert got up and said, "Hurry up and improve your strength!"
He said as he walked out: "If I were a demigod, I would have had hope to stop this Great Smog yesterday."
"Remember to write to me if you have time."
Klein looked at Hobert's disappearing back. From this back and Hobert's tone, he felt Hobert's unwillingness.
...
Backlund, Saint George Borough.
In a small villa, a woman with chestnut hair, wearing a lady's shirt with lace flowers, matched with a gray skirt over the knee, curled up on the sofa in front of the fireplace, reading the letter in her hand.
This is Bernadette, "Queen Mystic", who has been staying in Backlund during this time, looking for opportunities for promotion.
"Creator!" She suddenly smiled and said, "I wonder how that shy 'Lawyer' is doing recently!"
...
In the Sodolak Palace, George III, with a small mustache and a firm face, held a crystal wine glass, looking out the window, wondering what he was thinking.
"Father!" A cry interrupted George III's contemplation.
Alice, with a noble temperament and beautiful face, who George III had loved since childhood, cried with red eyes: "Just, just now I watched Edessak buried. He, he was so good since he was a child, how could he like a witch?"
In order to show his punishment for this disappointing son, George III did not attend Edessak's funeral.
Hearing Alice say this, George III's eyes were also a little red: "Child, I can't believe it's true, but the facts are so."
Alice wiped her tears: "I want to kill all the witches in Loen! They must pay the price for seducing the prince!"
George III nodded: "That's what I think too. I'm not too old to kill people!"
With George III's promise, Alice seemed to be comforted a lot. She knelt down beside George III's legs and cried again, while George III stroked her hair and comforted her patiently.
After crying for a few minutes, Alice vented her grief and finally felt better. Supported by an old attendant, she sobbed and bid farewell to the king.
The old attendant supported Alice out the door, and secretly stuffed a note to Alice when he reached the door.
Alice naturally put it away while crying. This old attendant, or rather old eunuch (this is a title, not an insult) named Bernie, people call him Old Bernie, and has been serving George III.
Alice once bribed Old Bernie heavily, asking him to reveal some of her father's preferences or needs.
Quickly returning to her bedroom, Alice's face turned cold, and she couldn't see any sadness at all: "Don't think I don't know, you have been in contact with the Demoness Sect!"
She opened the note, which was a brief introduction to the "Creator", who had just appeared in the Southern Continent, a powerful existence suspected of being a god. There was also the "Creator's" honorific name on the paper.
Alice clenched the note: "Edessak, sister will definitely avenge you!"
...
On George III's side, he was still holding the wine glass, without drinking a sip of wine: "Give it to her."
Old Bernie bowed and said, "Given to her."
George III's eyes were no longer red: "Pay close attention to her movements."
He smiled: Three Sequence 1s and Uniqueness are all here with me. I want to see what kind of god this is, daring to call himself the 'Creator in the Shadow of Order'!
As for Alice, it was the possible price to pay for this test. George III believed that in this delicate period of the "Black Emperor" pathway, only a prince or princess of the Loen royal family could attract the attention of the "Creator".
...
Hobert did not return to his territory, but went to Christian's mansion.
He first found Dophis, and after knowing that Christian was in the mansion, he went to see Christian together.
Hobert mainly came to Christian to talk about Donna. After confirming that Christian's attitude was no different from Donna's description, he was relieved to leave Donna behind.
There was also the matter of Angus. Hobert talked about his arrangements for Angus and asked Christian about his views on that branch of the Tudor family.
"The patriarch is an old antique." Christian obviously still had a lot of opinions on that patriarch: "But that is indeed a force that can be used."
"There is a Saint, four demigods, and a considerable number of Sequence 5 members in this branch of the family. They are a considerable Beyonder force wherever they are placed."
"They also tried to find opportunities to become nobles again, but they didn't behave harmless enough like the Pond family, and always flaunted the demigod-level combat power in the family, which resulted in the encirclement and suppression by the church and the royal family."
Christian pursed his lips and smiled, as if she was not talking about the family she was born into: "Fortunately, I left them early, otherwise I would have been killed by them."
"I want to use them to clear the Beyonder forces around the territory." Hobert got to the point: "They may have some sacrifices."
Christian smiled: "I haven't regarded them as family for a long time. Sending them to you is just to see if you are useful."
Hobert nodded, it could be seen that Christian was completely disheartened with the family.
With Christian's current strength, he can completely create an Beyonder family, which makes him have no sense of belonging to the Tudor family at all.
With such an answer, Hobert was relieved.
After chatting for a few more words, Hobert got up and said goodbye.
After he got the payment from the Balk family and met the Tudors, he planned to put it together himself to see if he could raise enough money to build the territory.
If there is a big gap, he will come to Christian for financing, and if the gap is small, he will borrow or ask Christian for a little.
When he returned to the territory, it was already evening. During dinner, Hobert discussed with his mother and Donna how to spend the New Year tomorrow.
Although the territory is still in ruins, the first New Year as the new lord should be grand.
Monlisa also plans to go back after spending the New Year here.
After dinner, everyone went to rest, but the bitter "Creator" had to work overtime.
Hobert returned to Conant City in the Kingdom of Loen again, and took a taxi carriage to the large warehouse rented by Upton.
Using "Blink" to enter the warehouse, Hobert breathed a sigh of relief as he looked at the piles of building materials: "Fortunately, I was more cautious and didn't let Upton sacrifice, otherwise the 'Creator' couldn't take away so many building materials at once, and would definitely lose face in front of the believers."
"What's more, the 'Creator' is not a porter. The water pump is at least a 'high-tech' product of this era, and it's a bit degrading to sacrifice these cement and steel bars to the 'Creator'."
Hobert began to light candles on the open space to prepare a simple altar. He smiled bitterly as he prepared: "I take back what I said just now, the 'Creator' is now a porter!"
Then Hobert began to sacrifice himself to himself, grabbing these cement and steel bars into the "Nation of Disorder" again and again.
Although the "Creator's" "grabbing power" has been greatly improved after being promoted to Sequence 5, it still took more than a dozen grabs to move all the materials to the "Nation of Disorder".
In the middle of this, Upton prayed to the "Creator" for the gold as the remaining payment, and Hobert almost bestowed him the steel bars piled by the pool.
At this time, inside and outside the hall built by Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" were piled with building materials.
Sitting in the middle of it, Hobert felt that the current "Creator" was a merchant who wholesaled cement and steel bars.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - 437 Happy New Year! (Bonus 11)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Town.
Old Bogg was a watchman on the construction site; before that, he was a "Gong-Banger," responsible for patrolling the lakeside and sounding the alarm immediately upon spotting a monster.
Fortunately, there's no longer a need for anyone to do that dangerous job.
Old Bogg looked at the construction site illuminated by the lights and couldn't help but sigh.
Everyone knows that the current Lord is very wise, but he's just too restless. At noon, Old Bogg heard the Knight Lord...
Calling him Knight Lord, but before this Lord came, Conrad was a recognized simpleton.
He was always slow when working in the fields, looked a bit dull, and worried about paying taxes every month, even though he could read and write.
In the blink of an eye, he's now a Knight Lord!
This has made several thugs who used to bully Conrad afraid to go out, but a few days ago, Conrad caught them and put them to work on the construction site, doing the hardest and most tiring jobs, it is said.
Old Bogg walked forward unhurriedly. The Knight Lord actually said today that he would divide the lands of those bullies among everyone.
No one believed it, and even if they did, no one would dare to take it.
Most of the bullies have been around since Viscount Wright was in power. Old Bogg remembers that there were bullies in the town and villages when he was a child, and after those bullies died, there were their sons, and another batch of bullies.
Now the land is being divided, but who knows what means they'll use to take it back in the future?
Ahead was the excavated foundation. Old Bogg sighed again. How long will it take to build with so much foundation dug up?
Such good land, dug up everywhere with ditches, but the building materials are said to be coming in a while, what a mess!
With so much money, the Lord might as well give some to everyone in the territory so they can have a good year.
Just as he was thinking this, Old Bogg saw a faint light not far ahead: "Those troublemakers!"
Kids often run to the construction site to play at night, and of course, thieves often visit too, so there's almost nothing valuable on the construction site at night.
Rumble~
The sound of something heavy falling to the ground startled Old Bogg.
Unfortunately, the night was not very clear, and the light in Old Bogg's hand couldn't see what was happening ahead.
Old Bogg only felt like there was something terrible in the air ahead. This feeling reminded him of his experience as a "Gong-Banger," being stared at by a ghost-like monster, with a similar feeling.
Rumble~
Another sound of heavy objects falling!
Old Bogg swallowed and retreated behind a pile of earth.
He had been a "Gong-Banger" for seven years. The "Gong-Bangers" before him had died in the mouths of monsters after working for no more than three years.
It's not that he was so powerful, but he knew not to be brave, to hide when he should hide, to run when he should run, nothing is more important than his own life.
The rumbling sound rang more than a dozen times before finally quieting down.
Old Bogg came out from behind the pile of earth and stared blankly at what was in front of him.
There seemed to be a small mountain over there!
He approached it boldly and saw a lot of cement and steel bars, as well as scaffolding and other tools.
After a long while, Old Bogg finally came back to his senses and ran towards the town: Too scary! Steel bars and cement actually fell from the sky just now! Luckily, I didn't go any further, or I would have been crushed to death by these things!
What happened just now was completely beyond his understanding, he could only think that those building materials fell from the sky.
Before he reached the town, he saw many people rushing this way with lights, and the person at the head was Roy!
Old Bogg quickly went forward to report. Roy was relatively calm, listening to Old Bogg's report while coming to the mountain-like building materials.
Seeing the piles of building materials, Roy was also speechless for a long time.
Just now, the Lord suddenly came to tell him that a batch of building materials had just been unloaded from the cargo ship, and asked him to find someone to guard it and sort it out tomorrow.
What cargo ship can carry so many things?
Also, why was it unloaded directly at the construction site? It's so far from the dock! Are the porters so dedicated these days?
But after a long silence, Roy still said to everyone: "These are the building materials that have just been unloaded from the dock, some of you stay to guard them!"
Old Bogg was about to say something, but Roy glanced at him: "Don't forget, the Lord is a 'God-Favored One' of the Earth Mother!"
In fact, he didn't know what was going on, but if he wasn't sure, it was always right to push it to God.
Old Bogg lowered his head in horror: So that was a miracle just now!
...
The next morning, Hobert yawned and rubbed his shoulders as he came to the yard.
He was indeed quite tired yesterday, but seeing the large pile of building materials down the mountain, he felt a sense of accomplishment again.
But soon Hobert thought again that this was only a quarter of the first batch of building materials. He sighed, wondering if he should ask 'The Fool' to help with the transportation?
Hobert shook his head with a smile, estimating that if 'The Fool' helped move the building materials, he would simply cancel his qualification to participate in the Tarot Gathering.
Today is New Year's Day, and Philip was directing the servants to clean the yard early in the morning.
Actually, there wasn't much to clean, as it had just been cleaned a few days ago to welcome Mona and her party.
This is the first New Year in this world!
Just as he was feeling emotional, Hobert's spirituality sensed something. He looked at his study, opened the 'Crystal of Order' sealed outside the scepter, and struck a fighting pose.
"Sorry, I came uninvited." A man's voice came from the study: "But please rest assured, I have no malice."
Hobert opened the door of the study and saw a man in his thirties, clean-shaven and with his hair combed meticulously.
Freya had already come to the study to practice her vocabulary. Although the sudden appearance of this gentleman startled her, she did not panic because her teacher had also appeared so suddenly before.
She was just a little curious: Did teachers and their friends like to appear and disappear so suddenly?
Hobert probably guessed that the other party was from the 'Theosophy Order,' but he still asked: "May I ask who you are?"
"I am Jonathan, the vice president of the 'Theosophy Order' in Southern Colson."
Sure enough, Hobert put away his scepter: "Please sit down. Hehe, I don't think I need to introduce myself."
Then he asked Freya to ask Allen to bring tea.
The two sat down around the desk, and Jonathan looked around the study: "I heard Monica mention the 'Fire Dragon' you invented. I must say, you are a creative young man."
Hobert smiled: "I didn't create this thing, I just brought it here."
After Freya and Allen brought the tea, Jonathan politely took a sip: "Regarding your proposal yesterday, we had a meeting all night.
"The final decision was to try to cooperate with you more deeply."
He spread his hands: "I must say, you have provided us with a new way of thinking. Many people are amazed by this proposal. As Monica said, you are a natural politician."
Through the descriptions of Monica and Helen, Jonathan really wanted to meet this young man, and the final cooperation matters would also be discussed by him personally with Hobert.
So Jonathan came directly to Hobert's study.
Although this was a bit irregular, the 'Mystic' could go wherever he wanted.
Hobert smiled and said, "It should be said that you made the right choice.
"But I have two conditions. First, there must be no extremists among the official Beyonder!"
Jonathan nodded: "That's for sure."
"Second, the 'Theosophy Order' must provide a squad, the captain can report their actions and tasks to the 'Theosophy Order,' as well as the information obtained in the tasks, but must obey my command!"
Jonathan did not immediately agree, but asked: "Is it only this one squad?"
"No, there is another squad, the captain of that squad is a Sequence 6." Hobert used his 'pie-drawing magic.'
Jonathan asked again: "How many members does the other party have?"
"About seven or eight."
"How should the Sealed Artifacts or spoils seized in the mission be distributed?"
Hobert said: "Whichever squad gets it belongs to that squad, but if it is obtained jointly, I have the right to distribute it!"
Jonathan thought for a moment: "Okay."
He paused and said: "I will let Helen, the captain dispatched by the 'Theosophy Order,' be stationed in Jeffery Town. After returning, I will equip her with two Sequence 7, four Sequence 8, and three Sequence 9 members."
Hobert stretched out his hand and smiled: "Happy cooperation."
The two shook hands, and Hobert suddenly thought: "Oh, right, I have several 'Apprentice' pathway Beyonder characteristics to sell, I wonder if you are interested?"
"Of course, I'm interested." Jonathan smiled: "How many are there specifically? What Sequence are they?"
"6 'Apprentice', 4 'Trickmaster', 3 'Astrologer', 1 'Scribe."
These Beyonder characteristics all came from the Tamara family. To avoid attracting attention, Hobert had not sold these Beyonder characteristics.
Jonathan: Are you kidding me by calling this a few?
He asked: "Where did you get so many Beyonder characteristics?"
Could it be from the members of the 'Theosophy Order' in other regions?
Hobert smiled: "Some ancient families also have the inheritance of the 'Apprentice' pathway."
He deliberately did not explain clearly, it could be the Abraham family, or it could be another family.
Moreover, Jonathan had not heard recently that there had been a large number of casualties among the members of the 'Theosophy Order'.
Even if such a situation occurred, with the opportunity to recover the Beyonder characteristics, Jonathan certainly would not let it go: "How much do you plan to sell them for separately?"
"As allies, I'll give you the base price for 'Apprentice' and 'Trick Magician', 360 gold Lire and 720 gold Lire." Hobert smiled:
"But 'Astrologer' and 'Scribe must have a premium, after all, it took a lot of effort to get them, 2000 gold Lire and 5000 gold Lire respectively."
This price was slightly higher than the price given to the Balk family for those Beyonder characteristics. Believers and allies were ultimately somewhat different.
Jonathan thought the price was reasonable: "Okay."
"Then the total value of 6 'Apprentice' Beyonder characteristics is 2160 gold Lire, and the total value of 4 'Trickmaster' Beyonder characteristics is 2880 gold Lire." Hobert said, taking out paper and pen to list a list:
"3 'Astrologer' Beyonder characteristics, total value 6000 gold Lire, and 1 'Scribe' 5000 gold Lire.
"Let me calculate, the total is 16040 gold Lire, I'll round it down to 16000 for you."
"Okay." Jonathan smiled: "I'll have Monica bring the money to trade with you in the afternoon."
After sending Jonathan away, Hobert continued to teach Freya vocabulary. Freya studied very hard, so today he taught twenty words.
After that, Hobert enjoyed the festive atmosphere. Everyone around him was full of smiles, and everyone was full of hope for the coming year.
In the afternoon, Monica came to complete the transaction. The money and goods were fine, and the two said "Happy New Year!" to each other before returning to celebrate the New Year.
Hobert was finally relieved. Currently, he has 58000 gold Lire, of which 16000 was just obtained from the transaction, 24000 was the harvest from the transaction with the Balk family, and 16000 was the money from selling the Ancient Blue Dragon Beast, and the last 2000 gold Lire was Hobert's "old money."
In addition, Hobert has nearly 4600 pounds and 5000 pounds worth of gold.
The payment for the second batch of building materials is not a concern for the time being. After completing the transaction with the Tudor family, it is estimated that the third batch of payment will also be available.
Hobert plans to ask at the Tarot Gathering who can contact the Temperance faction of the "Rose School". It would seem too targeted if he directly asked Klein.
If the Temperance faction digests another batch of "Prisoner" pathway Beyonder materials, or sells them two Sequence 4 Beyonder characteristics, it is estimated that the payment issue for the building materials will be basically resolved.
He only needs to worry about the decoration costs.
Hobert smiled and said to himself: I am richer than I imagined!
In the evening, under the unified deployment of Philip, more than a dozen bonfires were piled up on the streets of the town. As soon as night fell, everyone lit the bonfires and began to sing and dance around the bonfires.
Today is a rare day for them to relax, everyone is singing and dancing together, celebrating this special day.
Looking down from the Lord's Mansion, the town was brightly lit, full of laughter.
Hobert was also driven by the atmosphere created by everyone, and said to Fors next to him: "Let's join them too!"
Fors had wanted to go for a long time. Although she usually didn't like singing and dancing, she wanted to see the New Year customs that were different from Loon. Hearing Hobert's invitation, she immediately agreed.
Looking at the backs of Hobert and Fors leaving, Donna "hmph"ed: "Hobert has changed, he doesn't take me to play with him anymore."
Monrisa smiled: "He's about to start a family, of course, it's different from before."
"If he doesn't take me, I'll go myself." Donna said: "Freya, let's go together."
Before Freya could say anything, Donna pulled her out the door.
When the two of them came to the town, Hobert and Fors were already dancing in front of the bonfire.
The dance steps they had learned previously were out of sync with the surrounding environment, so they simply learned the cheerful and simple steps of the people around them.
The benefits of being a Beyonder were evident at this moment, as they learned almost instantly and quickly integrated into the cheerful environment.
The arrival of the lord and lady brought the bonfire dance to a climax. The residents of the town surrounded Hobert and Fors, dancing and laughing.
The days when they were exploited by bandits and knights seemed to have been forgotten, as well as the bewilderment and unease brought about by the Earl's mobilization throughout the territory and the sudden promulgation of new policies.
Everyone was single-mindedly enjoying the joy of this moment.
It wasn't until the bonfire gradually died down that everyone felt tired, and reluctantly returned home, and then smashed things!
In this almost isolated town, the custom of smashing everything that can be smashed on New Year's Day is still popular.
They believe that this can throw away all the troubles of the past year and welcome the new year without any burden.
In large cities such as Feynapotter, this custom no longer exists, but a new custom has formed: on New Year's Day, young people jump into the cold river to wash away all their troubles and greet the new year cleanly.
However, it is also possible to greet the new year with a runny nose and a cold.
...
Kingdom of Loen, a small town outside Backlund.
Klein, in a dilapidated hotel, looked at the fireworks in the direction of Backlund: "New Year!"
He spent this New Year alone.
...
Backlund, Empress Borough, Earl Hall's villa.
The weather today was rare and clear, as if it had wiped away the tragedy that had just occurred in Backlund.
Audrey, who had just attended the New Year's ball, stood on the terrace, looking at the fireworks not far away: "Happy New Year, Susie."
"Happy New Year! Audrey."
...
Rosted Archipelago, Hillston Port.
Alger avoided those reveling Loenese and continued to his destination in silence.
The local New Year is not on the same day as the Loenese New Year, so Alger did not feel any festive atmosphere.
Even the local New Year could not make Alger happy.
Because it would make Alger realize that another year had passed, but he was still alone.
...
Kingdom of Loen, Tingen City.
Selena locked herself in her room and stuffed cards with pre-written greetings into envelopes.
Then, according to the method mentioned in Teacher Hobert's letter, she prepared the altar.
This made Selena a little nervous and a little excited. She cleared her throat and said in Hermes:
"In my name, I summon:
"Spirit wandering in the void, friendly creatures that can be driven, messengers belonging exclusively to Hobert Jeffery."
The flame of one of the candles suddenly turned a ghastly green, and the candlelight quickly grew larger. Selena took a step back in surprise. This was the first time she had received a response in a mystical ritual.
Soon Selena felt as if something had been added to the room. Almost at the same time, she felt as if a huge rock was pressing on her spirit, making it difficult for her to breathe.
Fortunately, soon, the letter on the simple altar, as well as the three donuts she had prepared in advance, disappeared, and the huge sense of oppression also disappeared.
Selena stared blankly at the altar for a while before saying, "So cool!"
At this time, only the exclamation invented by Emperor Roselle could express her feelings.
She realized today that mystical rituals are so easy to get a response if you find the right method!
Before... well, Selena smiled: no wonder Teacher Hobert repeatedly told me not to contact Teacher Hanass' friends, it turned out they were all liars, and none of the rituals they taught me ever received a response. Fortunately, I met Teacher Hobert, this is the real mystical mentor.
Just as she was thinking about this, Selena's mother suddenly called from below: "Selena, Elizabeth and Melissa are here!"
They had agreed to go out to watch fireworks tonight.
The three girls bid farewell to Selena's parents and walked happily in the light of the gas street lamps.
There were many young people on the streets who were going out to watch fireworks in groups. On this special holiday, the night in this city seemed particularly lively.
As they chatted, they talked about their plans for the coming year.
Elizabeth was preparing to try to get into Backlund University, while Melissa was going to Backlund with her brother and continuing her studies at the University of Technology there.
Selena sighed: "Next year in the second half of the year, I may be the only one left in Tingen City."
She didn't tell her two good friends about her plan to go to Hobert and become a Beyonder for the time being.
Although it was not yet the season for graduation, the atmosphere of "graduation season" had already been pulled to the max.
"Let's talk about something happy!" Selena suddenly said, "How are you planning to spend the New Year's holiday?"
Elizabeth said: "I'm going to Conant City with my parents tomorrow for vacation."
Melissa: "Reading books, tidying things up."
So Selena extended an invitation: "Melissa, let's go to Boklund Manor together! My family is going there for vacation, ask your brother to come along!"
Elizabeth also persuaded: "Melissa, the hot springs there are very good, it is said that they can wash away all troubles."
But Melissa said: "We can't spend too much before Benson finishes his exams, let's talk about vacationing later."
Elizabeth and Selena smiled at each other, and Selena said, "Melissa, in the future, you will definitely be a good wife."
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Manor.
Today is January 1st.
Hobert stared at the roof for a while. After returning yesterday, he drank some wine with Fors and Donna and the others, and slept until after eight o'clock.
Alcohol had long since had no effect on the physique of Sequence 5. The reason why Hobert could sleep so soundly was purely because he was relaxed last night.
Hobert stretched, changed into his Baron attire, and put on his cloak: "Allen, tell Roy and Scholar to wait for me at the construction site in town!"
Roy and the others did not expect that the Earl would enter work mode just after the New Year.
They basically crawled out of bed, eating bread while going to the construction site.
When they arrived at the construction site, they couldn't help but laugh when they saw that the others were as embarrassed as they were.
Soon, Hobert also arrived, with Donna and Freya by his side.
Donna scratched her messy hair: "In theory, today is still a holiday, and your lord calling everyone up so early is illegal.
"Does anyone want to sue him? I'll help you contact a lawyer."
The few people smiled at each other, and didn't dare to speak.
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - 438 A New Year's Gift for Fors
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert ignored Donna's joke. "Are the materials ready? How's the progress on the construction site in town?"
Roy replied, "We started laying the foundation yesterday morning, but I gave everyone half a day off in the afternoon. I plan to start work this afternoon."
Hobert nodded. "The construction can wait. We need to start renovations first. I'm turning all those houses I bought into hotels, inns, and restaurants!"
"We need to be fast! Or we won't make it!"
Roy was taken aback. "Make what?"
"The wedding!" Hobert had initially planned for wedding guests to stay in tents when he agreed to his mother's proposed wedding date, but he's been reevaluating and realized he could accomplish more if he pushed.
Hobert said, "My wedding with Miss Fors is set for January 28th."
"With my father's influence, there will definitely be a lot of people attending the wedding. We need to provide them with adequate accommodations!"
Roy was momentarily stunned, then happily said, "I'll do everything I can to renovate the town. But that will require a lot of construction materials…"
"Make a list," Hobert said. "Wayne should be back soon. He can go shopping."
"Yes, sir."
Hobert looked at Scolara. "The land redistribution will start today. I've already spoken to Conrad and asked him to divide the land on the mountain first."
"The land acquisition issue has been resolved. Can the railway be completed before the 28th?"
Hobert's approach was simple: reclaim ownership of all the land, and then divide the land outside the railway and road routes among the people.
This completely bypassed the land acquisition process.
Scolara shook his head helplessly. "Your Lordship, the quick completion of land acquisition is indeed surprising, but that's just the beginning of railway construction."
"Next, it will take a lot of time to transport the materials to the railway line, and then to lay the tracks."
"Although the total mileage of the Jeffery territory railway is not very long, based on my experience, with mountains involved, 28 days might not even be enough to get the materials to the line."
Hobert thought for a moment. "What if the materials could be delivered quickly, like a batch to the railway line by tomorrow morning?"
Scolara smiled and shook his head, but still replied, "In that case, I'm confident we can lay the railway before the 28th. But we don't have enough manpower to transport all the materials to the line in a day and a night."
Hobert nodded. "Take me to the railway line for a look."
The group followed the railway line up the mountain.
As Hobert said, Conrad had already begun redistributing the land under the protection of Seel and the other guards from the Lord's manor.
The village bullies naturally started arguing with Conrad, and their families started wailing and crying.
But under the muzzles of Seel and the others' guns, all the arguments were ineffective.
The villagers then realized that the lord was serious this time. For a moment, the whole village was in chaos, and everyone ran to see the land distribution and ask how much land they could get.
The village's formerly respected figures were no match for the authority of Seel and the others' guns. Even the threats of the village bully, who used to have the final say, weren't so scary anymore.
Amidst the excitement, there was also some confusion. It was like carrying a huge rock on their backs since birth.
Now that the rock was suddenly lifted, they felt top-heavy and didn't even know how to take the next step.
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that Hobert had initiated a "once-in-a-millennium change." The concept of "equal land distribution and tax exemption" had never existed in the North and South Continents. Land was always seized by force; whoever had the bigger fist got more land.
Hobert forcibly redistributed the land in each village and reclaimed ownership for the Lord's manor using violent means from the lord's manor.
He knew very well that only more violent means could protect the interests of ordinary and vulnerable people.
Passing through the excited and confused villagers, the group arrived at the top of the mountain.
Hobert asked Valk, "It shouldn't take too long to transport the materials for building a paved road to the line, right?"
"That's right," Valk said. "Building a road is definitely faster than a railway."
"What about the construction time for the villas?" Hobert asked again. "Can we build the auction center and about five villas within a month?"
Valk smiled helplessly. "Your Lordship, that's an impossible goal."
"Building just the walls wouldn't take much time, but because it's on a mountain, we have to excavate large areas of flat land, and the later decoration will also take a lot of time."
Hobert said, "Tell me where needs to be leveled."
After learning about the specific difficulties and the approximate construction progress, Hobert returned to the Lord's manor, and Roy and the others went back to their respective tasks.
Back in his study, Hobert replied to the letters and cards from Jessica and Selena.
In the letters, he sent his regards and asked Jessica how the new extraordinary weapon manufacturing site was doing.
In the other letter, he told Selena that he would find time to talk to her soon.
He didn't avoid Freya when summoning the messenger, but he didn't actively teach her either.
After replying to the letters, Hobert dictated a few words to Freya. Seeing that she had grasped them well, he taught her twenty more words.
After learning, Freya suddenly asked, "Teacher, I have a question to ask you?"
Hobert sat back in his chair. "What is it?"
"Why is it so difficult for me to fit into the surrounding environment?" Freya clenched her fists, somewhat nervously. "I tried to befriend Mary and Marcy, but they always kept their distance from me."
"I want to befriend Miss Donna and Miss Fors, but I don't think I'm as good as them, and it's always difficult for me to join in their conversations."
Hobert smiled. "That's because you're not clear about your own position. In this complex society, you must first find your own position, otherwise, your actions and words will seem abrupt to others."
"Because of your previous experiences in the East Borough, you feel close to Marcy and Mary, but they think you are the lord's student, the master, so they will have a distance from you."
"At the same time, because you are my student, in the eyes of Fors and Donna, you are a junior, so they will not accommodate your feelings, and naturally will not consider whether you can join the topic when chatting."
Freya thought for a while. "I understand, thank you, teacher. I, I think I should put myself in the same position as Mr. Seel and Mr. Conrad. No, I'm not as good as them, I mean, I'm with them, one, one…"
"Level."
"Yes, people on the same level!"
Hobert nodded. "I'll give you one more word today, the spelling of 'level' is…"
This word was relatively long, and Freya memorized it carefully and understood it seriously.
Overall, Freya was relatively introverted, but before, she had to work non-stop and had no time to think.
Hobert asked again, "Did you go around the territory yesterday?"
"No, no!"
"Go out with Conrad this afternoon and tell me your thoughts tomorrow morning."
Freya quickly said, "Yes, sir!"
In the midst of busyness, it was soon lunchtime.
Before eating, Hobert returned to his room to get a small wooden box and brought it to the restaurant.
Before eating, Hobert pushed the wooden box to Fors. "This is a New Year's gift for you!"
Fors was slightly stunned. Amidst Donna's teasing, she opened the wooden box. Inside were a few pieces of blood-red crystal, as beautiful as rubies. She blurted out, "Lava Octopus blood crystal!"
This was precisely one of the main materials for "Astrologer" that she had been searching for.
Donna sat back in her chair. "Tch, I thought it was a diamond ring."
Fors said, "Hobert, I can't accept this. This, this is too precious."
The base price of Beyonder materials at Sequence 7 is 600 pounds, but the main materials at this level basically start to have a premium, selling for seven or eight hundred pounds is very normal.
At this week's Tarot Gathering, Fors sold materials to Miss Justice for 1000 pounds.
"Sister-in-law, you're too easily satisfied," Donna laughed. "Just such a small thing, you should say: Three more servings!"
Everyone laughed at Donna's joke. Hobert said to Fors, "Take it. You've been working lately, and you've been accompanying my mother to see the scenery in the territory. You're quite tired, so take it as a reward."
The so-called work was that Hobert required Fors to finish her new book before the 15th, so that a batch of books could be printed and placed at the wedding site on the wedding day.
So these days, you could see Fors writing furiously at night.
Monlisa also smiled and told Fors to put it away. Fors then felt that she could write one more chapter tonight.
At the end of lunch, Monlisa told everyone that she planned to leave tomorrow.
After Hobert failed to persuade her to stay, he asked Phillip to prepare some local specialties and asked Allen to take people to tidy up the rented ship.
In the afternoon, Hobert received payment from Alger. The Storm Church gave Hobert 1500 pounds for the information he provided. After Alger deducted 150 pounds, Hobert received 1350 pounds.
While lamenting the Storm Church's stinginess, Hobert became more certain that the Storm Church knew more information about the battle in the Southern Continent, otherwise they would not have only given 1500 pounds.
…
Across Full Moon Lake, in Viscount Teuton's mansion.
Viscount Teuton frowned as he watched Jeffery Town, which had been busy since the afternoon of the 1st. "Is Hobert preparing to expand that town into a small city?"
He put down his telescope. "Also, where did he get so much money?"
Viscount Teuton certainly knew the cost of construction. Even with the accumulation of so many generations of viscounts, he would not dare to spread out such a large scale.
"We can report all of this, including Hobert's ambition, to the king!" Grove said.
Viscount Teuton pondered for a moment. "That's a good idea."
After the waterway is opened, the royal power will also radiate to South Colson again, and of course, it will not allow the strength of a certain noble to be unique.
Viscount Teuton, who has been secretly loyal to the royal family, is definitely the royal family's first choice for support.
"In addition, we can also put Hobert in trouble," Grove suggested.
Viscount Teuton shook his head. "As far as I know, Hobert is a Sequence 6. It is difficult for me to shake his rule with my strength."
Grove smiled. "Aren't there some powerful figures in your territory?"
A trace of fear flashed in Viscount Teuton's eyes. "You don't know the horror of these people! Don't provoke them, and don't try to betray them."
"Of course, I'm not going to provoke them, nor am I going to betray them," Grove smiled. "Since Hobert has chosen to cooperate with the 'Theosophy Order', we can let Hobert see their existence and let the Theosophy Order know their reality.
"These are all seen and investigated by Hobert himself. What does it have to do with us?"
Viscount Teuton looked across Full Moon Lake, feeling a little tempted.
Grove added, "The New Year is over. As the only viscount nearby, shouldn't you invite the baron opposite to a banquet? Express your welcome to this new baron!"
Viscount Teuton pondered for a moment, then smiled. "Don't try to take revenge at the banquet. You are not strong enough!"
"Of course not!" A trace of resentment flashed across Grove's face. "I know, now is not the time."
Viscount Teuton nodded. "Go and have someone write an invitation and have Knight Keton deliver it in person."
"Yes!"
"Oh, right," Viscount Teuton smiled. "Old Knight Conner passed away more than a year ago, and his family property has been squandered by his two good-for-nothing sons.
"They no longer have a sense of knightly honor. I will deprive them of their knightly titles, and that territory will be given to you!"
Grove said excitedly, "Thank you for your reward, Your Lordship!"
…
Hobert received an invitation from Viscount Teuton in the evening. He was a little strange. Why would Viscount Teuton suddenly invite him to a banquet?
He was slightly stunned and said to Allen, "Treat this knight well."
Then Hobert called Philip, Conrad, Roy, Seel, Corwin, and others to discuss the matter.
Corwin said, "This matter is definitely not that simple. Everyone, the traitor Grove is currently in Viscount Teuton's mansion. This may be a trap."
Philip said, "The current situation is not chaotic. A viscount cannot set a trap in his own mansion to harm a nominal baron.
"At most, Viscount Teuton will send assassins under Grove's confusion, or simply have his guards cross the river to conquer us, but he has not done so, which shows that he has not been confused by Grove."
Hobert nodded. "I can't refuse this invitation. Seel and Corwin will go with me tomorrow. Everyone else should do what they need to do and don't be affected."
"Yes, sir!"
They had all seen the lord defeat the Ancient Azure Dragon Beast, so they had nothing to worry about regarding the lord's safety.
In the evening, Hobert was about to "go out" when Helen suddenly came. "I heard that you are going to Viscount Teuton's mansion for a banquet tomorrow?"
"That's right," Hobert was stunned.
"I haven't been to the other side of Full Moon Lake yet. Take me with you to see it," Helen said with a smile.
Actually, it was because the informant she had developed earlier had disappeared without a trace, and she planned to go to Viscount Teuton's territory to see if she could reconnect with them.
Hobert smiled: "Tell the truth."
"Okay, I want to see if that place is suitable for developing the 'Theosophy Order's' power."
Hobert knew she still wasn't telling the truth, but he didn't ask any further: "No problem, but you have to dress up as a maid."
Helen was slightly stunned: "Can't I dress up as your assistant or something?"
"For this kind of private banquet, I don't plan to bring an assistant."
"Okay."
After seeing Helen off, Hobert locked the door and used "Travel" to go to the warehouse where the building materials were stored.
Those building materials had already been transported to the warehouse by Roy's men, or simply started to be piled up on the construction site.
Finding the warehouse where the railway laying materials were stored, Hobert once again sacrificed the materials to the "Nation of Disorder."
Then, using the method of bestowal, he sprinkled them as evenly as possible along the route where the railway was to be laid.
First, there was the roadbed, which required a lot of gravel, and then the sleepers and rails. These were all relatively heavy materials, and in the absence of large equipment, they could only be transported to the railway line little by little by manpower.
If someone else possessed the "Nation of Disorder," they would never do the kind of work that railway workers do.
But Hobert was different. He didn't have the airs of the nobles, and he also found the decency of the middle class ridiculous. For him, when he encountered this kind of thing, there was only one principle: practicality is the key.
Since he had Beyonder powers, he would use Beyonder powers to carry out the construction. If he delayed his career because of his status and decency, Hobert would find that ridiculous.
After several sacrifices and several bestowals, he finally scattered the materials for several kilometers, just at the beginning of the mountain.
That's all for the first batch of materials. A large part of the materials have not been shipped from Conant, and because the land acquisition work was only completed today, the work of clearing the roadbed along the way and building culverts and bridges has not yet been completed.
Building culverts is for waterproofing, and building bridges is to facilitate the surrounding residents to cross the railway. These constructions are essential.
Then Hobert came to the mountainside again. After praying to himself, he entered the "Nation of Disorder" and used the surging power of "Distortion" to distort a small area of the terrain, making the slopes there flat and gentle.
The flowers, plants, and trees that were previously on the ground were still on the ground, as if someone had re-kneaded the surrounding terrain under the ground using a method similar to kneading plasticine.
After doing all this, Hobert smiled and said, "Today's work is finally over."
So, the next morning, Scholar and Valk ran to the lord's mansion in a panic: "Lord, Lord! Damn it, your territory was haunted last night!"
Scholar said, "The materials stored in the warehouse were all scattered along the railway line."
Valk: "The hillside that we said would take a lot of effort to level yesterday has become flat!"
"It's haunted! Lord!"
"Nonsense." Hobert didn't like hearing this: "This is clearly the result of me praying for the help of the gods. When have you ever seen evil spirits so kind as to help us with construction?"
The two designers then came back to their senses, they had indeed never seen that.
But what the lord said about "God helping" surprised them even more. During the construction, it was inevitable to dig out some bones and ancient tombs. They knew that evil spirits were real, but they had never seen a god respond.
In the end, they had no choice but to think in terms of "God's Chosen."
Hobert smiled and asked, "If there is divine help, do you think you can complete the task I gave you within a month?"
The two men opened their mouths in surprise before saying, "Yes!"
Hobert nodded, talked to them about some engineering issues, then changed into more formal clothes and sent his mother away with Fors, Donna, and others.
Returning to the lord's mansion, Hobert changed back into his baron's dress, and asked Allen to bring the horse.
Along with Helen, Seel, and Corwin, the four of them rode to the pier, and boarded a locally made wooden boat with their horses.
Knight Keton, who had sent the invitation yesterday, was already waiting at the pier in Teuton's territory. Kettn couldn't help but glance at Helen a few times, and then smiled and guided the group to Viscount Teuton's mansion, but he would still steal glances at Helen from time to time.
Hobert noticed that the size of Teuton Town was larger than that of Jeffrey Town, but it was lifeless here. There were so many residents, and there were many pedestrians on the streets, but their walking posture was like walking dead, their expressions were numb, and they were as thin as firewood.
The only place where you could feel that they were alive was when they were worshiping some hideous statues, or when they were kneeling before some abstract symbols.
In the streets and alleys, there were small statues everywhere. These statues had two thick goat horns on their heads, and their faces were either wearing cold smiles, or their faces were hideous, or their faces were solemn, holding giant swords.
Many people in the streets prostrated themselves before the statues, shouting some respectful words in the local dialect with all their strength, as if they were possessed by evil spirits.
The religious atmosphere was also a bit crazy, and it gave Hobert a feeling of numbness and ignorance. This feeling reminded Hobert of a movie he had watched when he was very young, which depicted the White Lotus Sect.
Hobert's mind immediately flashed the information provided by Bishop Simpson. In the isolated South Coulson area, not only were the forces of the "Theosophy Order" entrenched, but there were also signs of the Blood Worship Cult and the Aurora Society.
Now it seemed, where were these just signs? This was the first time Hobert had seen someone worshiping and kneeling before demons in the street!
The demon's followers turned a blind eye to Hobert's group's horses. Whenever they encountered believers worshiping demons and being blocked, Knight Ketton would ask everyone to wait patiently until the entire set of kneeling rituals was over before leading everyone forward.
Obviously, Knight Keton was used to this scene, and as a knight, he had to give way to these believers and dismount to show a pious appearance.
In addition to these statues, there were also some abstract symbols painted on the walls. Hobert had seen these abstract symbols in a notebook before.
The notebook came from the room where the ancient god of death's corpse was stored. That unlucky guy who had turned into a skeleton had encountered a scene of offering sacrifices to demons when he was looking for the Skeleton Lord.
In the related exploration, he saw and wrote down such symbols in his notebook.
According to the description in the notebook, there shouldn't only be symbols, there should also be large trees with corpses hanging on them.
After leaving the town, Hobert and his party indeed encountered such a large tree.
