chapters.title: Chapter 439 - 439 Gift from the Abyss
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
As described in the notes, a huge tree was hung with shriveled or fresh corpses.
From the fresh corpses, it was clear that the people who had been hung up had suffered inhuman torture before their death.
It is said that these emotions, such as pain, resentment, and fear, can please higher-level demons.
Hobert simply counted, and there were already more than two hundred corpses hanging on the tree, which made the towering tree creak.
Seeing this scene, Hobert, although he had some opinions about the gods, still fully affirmed the role of the orthodox church.
If there were no blows from the orthodox church, many places might be like Teuton Viscount's territory, where the people are numb and dull, and there may be countless such trees full of corpses.
When he came to the tree, Knight Keton dismounted and knelt down piously, and then introduced to everyone with some pride that there was also a "Sacrificial Tree" in his territory, but unfortunately he has only hung up more than thirty corpses now.
For this reason, he said that he still needs to work harder to hang up a hundred corpses as soon as possible.
When Hobert was talking to him, he took a strand of hair from his clothes without paying attention: You don't have this chance, because I will go and kill you tonight.
As for why Hobert did this to these corpses who were hung up and had nothing to do with him?
Because Hobert was beaten in Backlund and had a belly full of anger, and he had nowhere to vent it.
Finally, they arrived at the Teuton Viscount's mansion. The viscount, who was in his prime, greeted Hobert very politely at the door, and secretly glanced at Helen, who was dressed as a maid, and sighed in his heart that Hobert was very lucky.
The banquet began in a harmonious atmosphere, until Grove came to the banquet, and the atmosphere immediately became subtle.
Grove deliberately approached Hobert, as if provoking him, and wandered around in front of Hobert twice.
He sneered and said, "I heard that Baron Hobert is going to take all the land in the territory under the name of the lord's mansion?"
"That's right," Hobert certainly wouldn't give him a good look: "It's just to prevent knights like you from running rampant in the countryside!"
"You are smearing the face of the nobles! There will be no good results!"
Hobert smiled and said, "Your son is now my servant!"
"You..." Grove drew his sword and was about to rush up and fight Hobert desperately, but fortunately, Teuton stopped him, and the two of them did not fight at the banquet.
After Grove left with a look of indignation, the atmosphere of the banquet became harmonious again, as if the little episode just now had never happened.
Of course, this kind of harmonious banquet is basically just talking nonsense.
When the banquet was about to end, Teuton euphemistically expressed his hope that Hobert could take action to clean up the monsters in the lake again.
After Hobert beat those fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts so that they dared not go to Jeffery Town, those fish-headed crocodile-bodied beasts began to attack Teuton Town like crazy.
Hobert laughed and did not agree or refuse.
The banquet ended in such a harmonious but estranged and inefficient atmosphere and conversation.
After Hobert and his party said goodbye, they rode their horses and left unhurriedly.
It was still Knight Keton who sent them to the pier.
At the pier, several well-dressed men were waiting there. The leader, who looked like he was in his thirties, had black hair and unruly eyes. No matter how he smiled, it seemed like he was smirking.
Knight Keton quickly dismounted and prostrated himself in front of the man: "Mr. Arlin!"
This Mr. Arlin with a smirk on his face didn't even look at Keton, but said to Hobert: "I have brought you a gift."
He stretched out his hand to show the gift in his palm, which was a delicate wooden box with a demon pattern engraved on it.
Hobert did not dismount: "Is the demon family showing goodwill to me?"
"It seems that you know something about us!" Arlin smiled evilly: "This is a gift from the great 'Abyss' to you. You are the person chosen by Him!
"Cheer! 'Abyss' will return to the earth!"
Hobert smiled: "Sorry, I am a devout believer of the Earth Mother!"
After speaking, he bypassed Arlin and others, came to the pier, and boarded the ship while watching Arlin and others.
Arlin chased after him to continue giving gifts. They stood there and smiled at Hobert, smiling so hard that it made people feel goosebumps.
At this time, town residents like zombies came to the pier and knelt down and cheered towards Hobert.
This made Hobert once suspect that he had been tricked by some high-level demon?
But he repeatedly checked his spirituality and spirit, and found nothing wrong.
Until the boat sailed to the center of Full Moon Lake, the demons and the demon's believers on the pier were still watching Hobert.
Hobert was also staring at them. Suddenly, he felt his pocket tighten. While staring at the opposite pier, he stretched out his hand and took out a delicate wooden box with a demon pattern engraved on it.
"Damn it!" Hobert almost lost his hand and dropped the wooden box in the cabin.
He glanced at Arlin on the pier again. Although he could no longer see Arlin's face clearly, he could still feel his smirk.
Helen on the side said: "I really can't tell that you have the inner being of a demon, and you actually made these demons offer gifts as soon as they saw you."
In fact, Helen was the most nervous just now. The "Theosophy Order" had had some conflicts with the demon family before, and she thought that the people on the pier were coming for her.
Hobert smiled and said, "Since you like it so much, I'll give you this gift."
"I don't want it."
"Give it to you, don't be polite!"
Helen showed a beautiful chuckle and hummed cutely twice: "Don't try to trick me, this gift must not be a good thing! Otherwise, you wouldn't give it to me."
"Since you don't want it, then I'll throw it away!" After saying that, Hobert threw the small box into the lake and watched it sink into the water.
Helen also noticed that this gift was unusual. She asked with some concern: "Do you want to ask Ms. Monica to help?"
"No need," Hobert smiled and said, "I'm not afraid even if the 'Abyss' comes!"
"Lying," Helen said with a smile: "You are obviously starting to be afraid."
Then she asked: "What is the Abyss?"
"When you become the captain of the official Beyonder of Jeffery and make great contributions to me, I will tell you," Hobert said thoughtfully while looking at the lake.
He was a little strange, why did that demon say: The Abyss has chosen me?
The Abyss, besides being a real place, symbolizing the source of all evil and the land of depravity, is also the title of Sequence 0 of the "Demon" pathway.
Hobert didn't know whether the demon was talking about the place of the Abyss or the person of the "Abyss".
No matter what it was expressing, Hobert felt strange. He had never been in contact with a "Demon" or the "Abyss" pathway before. How could the "Abyss" give him a gift!
That oil painting!
Hobert suddenly thought that according to the records in "Colin Antigonus's Notes", the oil painting was obtained from the Southern Continent, supposedly from a demon family.
Thinking of this, Hobert said to everyone: "I remembered something important, I have to go back first!"
Before a few people could agree, Hobert had disappeared from the wooden boat.
One or two seconds later, the space in Hobert's bedroom suddenly became illusory. Hobert stepped out of the illusion and glanced at the oil painting hanging on the wall.
It was still the landscape painting, and there was no change.
Hobert sat on the chair and continued to consider what was going on?
Suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration and glanced at the table next to him. I don't know when, a small wooden box with a demon pattern engraved on it appeared in the center of the table.
Hobert was not as surprised as last time. He carefully looked at the wooden box, and then entered the "Nation of Disorder" in the way he prayed to himself, and checked the small wooden box with True Sight.
It looked like an ordinary small wooden box, and it did not reveal any evil aura.
Returning to the real world, Hobert simply opened the small wooden box. Since this small wooden box was destined to follow him, it was better to take the initiative to investigate it than to turn a blind eye.
Inside the small wooden box was an ancient ring with a demon head carved on it. Perhaps because of its age, the platinum ring had become a little black.
Hobert did not touch the ring. He entered the "Nation of Disorder" again and observed the ring with "True Sight".
Under "True Sight", the demon on the ring seemed to come alive. Although it was only a head, its expression was sometimes ferocious, sometimes angry, and sometimes roaring.
Hobert did not dare to bring the ring to the "Nation of Disorder". He was afraid that this was a trick of the "Abyss" to seize the "Nation of Disorder".
Although the probability that the "Abyss" knew that he was the master of the "Nation of Disorder" was very small, what if the other party knew through some means?
"Demons" and "Devils", besides being synonymous with evil, are also known for their cunning.
Hobert had never dealt with demons before, so of course he had to be careful.
Returning to the real world, Hobert didn't even mean to touch the ring. He closed the box, put it in a locked drawer, and then locked the drawer.
He knew that ordinary locks would definitely not be able to lock this box, or this ring, but this way he could feel more at ease.
As for why the "Abyss" wanted to give Hobert this ring? He planned to investigate it tonight.
Because of the protection of the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert was not afraid of the "Abyss". The current "Abyss" may still be the "Demon Monarch" Farbauti of the Second Epoch.
Speaking of those eight ancient gods, except for this "Demon Monarch", they have all fallen once. Although the "Progenitor of the Sanguine" and the "Dragon of Imagination" are not completely dead, they have fallen after all.
Only Farbauti has no clear information showing that He has fallen. On the contrary, Hobert still remembers that in the current Fifth Epoch, He is still active as the "Dark Side of the Universe".
This should be an ancient god who cherishes his life and understands the essence of "evil". Hobert felt that He should not mess around.
Letting out a long sigh, Hobert took out a note from his pocket.
This was what Grove secretly stuffed into him when he was at the Teuton Viscount's mansion, when Grove walked into the restaurant and wandered around in front of Hobert twice.
Hobert opened the note and read it. The contents were Grove's previous plan for Baron Teuton: first, use Hobert as an unstable factor to request the king's assistance; second, use Hobert's power to strike at the demons that had already lost control in Baron Teuton's territory.
After reading it, Hobert burned the note with spiritual flames: "This is a good strategist!"
This note was both a report to Hobert and an attempt to take credit.
Hobert pondered for a moment. These two strategies were equivalent to "getting something for nothing" for Baron Teuton. He didn't pay much cost, but he was likely to gain huge benefits.
For Hobert, he could freely go to the other side of Full Moon Lake to strike at the demons in the future, without having to worry about Baron Teuton's territorial awareness.
As for the king's assistance, Hobert smiled. Of course, the more assistance, the better.
Then Hobert went to the study and wrote a letter to Bishop Simpson, talking about his experiences in Baron Teuton's territory and inquiring about more detailed information about the South Colson demon family.
After another while, Seel and the others returned.
Facing their worried gazes, Hobert told them: "It's alright, go and do your work!"
Seel and Corwin couldn't help much, and Hobert wasn't comfortable letting Helen help, so he simply lied that the problem had been solved.
Just as the few people were about to leave, Hobert called out to Corwin again: "You come with me to the main hall."
Seeing that the lord was about to start dealing with government affairs again, Seel and Helen were completely relieved.
Arriving at the main hall, Hobert said: "I have a task to assign to you."
Corwin said somewhat excitedly: "Please tell me."
Generally, when the lord assigned a task, it was a sign that he was going to be given an important role.
"Go to Bugas City or Granada Port and hire a batch of carpenters and renovation workers." Hobert said: "In a while, a large number of renovation workers and carpenters will be needed in the territory. If they are unwilling to come, then pay them a generous salary."
Corwin nodded: "Yes!"
"Go to Philip and collect 500 gold Solas, take the ship rented by Seel, and set off this afternoon."
Hobert had previously asked Seel to rent a ship in Bugas City to lead the way for Montresor and his party. That ship had been docked in the port.
"Yes!" Corwin shouted again with high spirits and turned to leave.
"By the way." Hobert called out to him: "Go and call Grove's son here."
As soon as Corwin left, Alan came to report: "Lord, Wayne is back."
Hobert quickly called him in. Wayne happily paid his respects to Hobert and reported the general experience of buying the ship.
The ship was easy to sell, but it took several days to gather the crew.
They were all brand new steamships. According to Hobert's requirements, one was a cargo ship with a displacement of about 800 tons, and four were passenger ships that could carry 32 people.
Hobert was very satisfied with the task that Wayne had completed. After listening to the report from the accompanying financial staff, he immediately knighted Wayne as "Knight of Shipping!"
Wayne was so happy that he couldn't close his mouth. He had forgotten all about the hard work during this period.
Hobert said: "Rest for one night, and I will have to trouble you to make another trip to Granada Port to purchase a batch of decorative materials. I will have Roy send you the list in a while."
"As for the passenger ships, one will go with Corwin, one will go to Granada Port, one will go to Bugas City, and one will go to Feynapotter City."
"Regardless of whether there are passengers or not, stay in the port for one day and one night before heading back."
Wayne said with some difficulty: "But, but we don't have the relevant procedures."
"No relevant procedures are needed! Someone will naturally send us the procedures in a while." Hobert smiled and said: "If you can argue with the port staff and attract people to watch the excitement, I will also give the captain a reward!"
"By the way, each ship must have an eye-catching banner: South Colson, Jeffery Town Welcomes You!"
Wayne didn't understand what the lord was going to do. He was stunned for a few seconds before reacting under Seel's repeated winks: "Yes!"
After letting Wayne go to rest first, Corwin brought three people. Because the lord didn't say clearly which son to call, Corwin brought all three of Grove's sons.
After dismissing Corwin, Hobert looked at the three people. Grove's eldest son was called Archie, who was burly and had a long beard like a rude warrior.
The second son was called Edgar, who was also very tall, but had not yet grown a beard.
The third son, Dennis, was still a teenager in his teens, thin and not as tall as his two older brothers.
But only Dennis glared at Hobert with anger in his eyes and dared to look Hobert in the eye, while Archie and Edgar were obsequious and showed enough obedience.
Hobert said: "I need two servants recently. Archie and Edgar will stay and be my servants. As for Dennis…"
"Hobert Jeffery! This is an insult to the knight…" Dennis only shouted halfway before Edgar quickly covered his mouth.
Archie quickly apologized: "Lord, the child doesn't know how to speak, please don't take offense."
Dennis broke free from Edgar's hand: "You are afraid of him, but I am not afraid…"
Hobert smiled and said: "Since you are so brave, stay and be my manservant too!"
So the news quickly spread throughout the town that the fleeing Grove had angered the lord who went to the banquet, so the lord had all of Grove's sons be his manservants to vent his anger as soon as he returned.
Grove on the other side naturally cursed again. Baron Teuton scolded with Grove while trusting Grove even more.
But in order to prevent Grove from being threatened by Hobert with his sons, Baron Teuton sent Grove five beauties and hoped that the nearly fifty-year-old Grove would give birth to a child in Teuton's territory as soon as possible to inherit his current family business.
In the evening, Hobert received a reply from Bishop Simpson. The bishop said in the letter: "According to our understanding, the forces of the Blood Worship Sect are entrenched in the five adjacent territories of Baron Teuton, Baron Eugene, and Baron Felix.
"Mainly members of the Norse family. It is said that a demigod is in charge, but it is not clear in which field.
"There are also some members of the Andre family. The specific distribution of the members of the two families is also not clear, but there are at least three Sequence 5s."
While Hobert asked the kitchen to bring raw meat to entertain the spirit world dog that was already drooling, he pondered the opponent's strength.
If it was at Sequence 6, Hobert would have felt that he couldn't afford to offend them, but after being promoted and having a few Level 1 sealed items, Hobert's courage also grew, and he felt that he could completely go to the other side to fight.
After nightfall, Hobert changed into a set of tight and neat clothes, brought his portable magical items and sealed items, and entered the spirit world under the "navigation" of the "Faceless Necklace."
What Hobert was looking for was Knight Crichton, who had led the way for him today. In just one or two seconds, Hobert came out of the spirit world and saw Crichton devoutly worshipping a demon statue.
Crichton was startled when he saw Hobert: "Lord…"
Hobert deliberately did not change his appearance or wear a mask. He needed to distinguish between the two identities of Baron Hobert and "Favored of the Gods."
It was both for him to distinguish and for others to distinguish.
Crichton seemed to realize something and jumped to the weapon rack to get his sword. Hobert took a step forward and slashed Crichton's throat with a knife.
Amidst the gushing blood of "sizzling" sounds, Hobert kicked down the demon statue and sat on a chair, watching Crichton struggle to cover his neck and die in pain.
Then Hobert began to use the "Spirit Wine Glass" to communicate with the spirit world: "The residences and strengths of the Blood Worship Sect members that you know."
"…"
After chanting seven times, Hobert saw the residences of the Blood Sanctify Sect members one by one.
Their residences were easy to confirm. Either the walls had words written in blood, or there were piles of human heads in front of the door.
As for their strength, Crichton's understanding was very vague. He only knew that some people could use curses, some people liked to kill people, and some people could become huge and become "demonized" monsters.
Hobert pondered for a moment. The one who could turn into a "demonized" monster should be a Sequence 6.
Then he discovered that Yarlin, who appeared at the pier today, was not among these people.
However, Hobert did not continue to ask, because it was too late. From the moment he started communicating with the spirit world, it was estimated that these demons had sensed that someone was posing a threat to them.
If he didn't hurry up, he might not be able to catch even one demon.
"Travel" had just finished its cooldown, and Hobert stepped into the spirit world again and came to the residence of that Sequence 6 named Atwood.
The door of this "demon"'s house was piled with human heads, some of which were still "fresh" and some of which were just skeletons.
Seeing that the other party's door was open, Hobert quickly jumped to the roof and saw a figure running away quickly not far away.
He may have felt that the danger was very close to him, and he was "demonizing" himself while running away.
Hobert immediately used "Blink" and "Flight" to catch up: "Disorder!"
Although "demons" also have a strong defense against attacks in the spiritual field, Hobert was one sequence higher than him, so Hobert's "Disorder" made the demonized Atwood make a foolish choice.
He kicked open the door of a nearby house, preparing to add a few of his "collections!"
Hobert had already caught up: "Holy Light!"
Because he knew that he was going to deal with demons, Hobert put on the "Light Ring."
A huge beam of light fell, completely engulfing Atwood.
After the strong light passed, Atwood screamed and fell to the ground. The goat horns on his head, as well as his ears, nose, shoulders, and legs, had all melted to varying degrees, making him look like a melting wax figure.
The attack of "Holy Light" really has a bonus against demons!
Hobert was about to step forward and slash off the "demon"'s head, but he suddenly stopped, because he found that he had been surrounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - 440 The Only Living Ancient God
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert found himself surrounded by seven or eight demons.
Each of them sported goat horns and wore mocking smiles as they looked at Hobert and his fallen companion.
The blood-type patterns and demon statues scattered all around made Hobert feel as if he were in Hell itself!
Hobert smiled. "I didn't expect the demons' ability to foresee danger to be so keen."
The demons' smiles deepened. A huge demon stepped out from the group, a wicked grin on his face. "Isn't this Baron Hobert? Lost in a midnight stroll?"
The demons erupted in laughter.
Seeing the other party's wicked smile, Hobert knew it had to be Yarlin.
Hobert said to himself, "Your ability is quite good. Saves me the trouble of finding you one by one. Disorder!"
A "Disorder Stone" was thrown on the ground, and several Sequence 6 "Devils" immediately froze, struggling against losing control.
Fortunately, they were in a "Demonized" state, and their control over themselves was significantly enhanced. They desperately burned the goat horns on their heads, trying to recover as soon as possible.
Yarlin, who was not greatly affected, suddenly had more than twenty blue fireballs appear around him. The fireballs were controlled by Yarlin's will, and one by one, they smashed towards Hobert.
Hobert used "Blink" and appeared directly in front of Yarlin: "Holy..."
Halfway through the ability, Hobert suddenly felt his heart throb twice. He felt unwell and extremely restless, and he actually interrupted his own ability.
This was the "Desire Apostle's" detonation of desire. Hobert had always tried to restrain his desires, but just now he had the desire to kill Yarlin, so Yarlin seized the opportunity.
Fortunately, the "Lawyer" pathway was also known for resisting mental attacks, otherwise Hobert's heart would have suffered great damage.
Yarlin couldn't laugh anymore. He didn't expect Hobert to be so fierce. His fireballs hadn't all been thrown yet, and Hobert had already rushed over, wanting to fight him at close quarters!
Buzz~
A thick magma greatsword appeared in Yarlin's hand, stabbing towards Hobert, who was clutching his heart. Because of the high temperature, his stab actually produced the sound of cutting through the air.
Who knew that Hobert would actually grab his magma greatsword with his bare hands and send his black knife towards Yarlin's heart.
Yarlin immediately released the hilt and dodged nimbly.
Suddenly, Yarlin felt Hobert's aura soar, and he immediately sensed a fatal threat.
Then Yarlin understood that Hobert had released the seal of some sealed item.
This time, Hobert brought two Grade 1 sealed items to deal with possible dangers. One sealed item was the scepter he always carried with him, and the other sealed item came from a "Rose School" demigod.
He didn't dare to use the sealed item from the "Error" pathway randomly. The first time he used it, Amon didn't come, but that didn't mean he would be so lucky in the future.
For the sake of easy distinction, Hobert named this Level 1 sealed item from the "Rose School" "1-103".
In fact, according to the naming convention of sealed items, it should be named "1-003", but that might expose the fact that the "Creator" had very few Grade 1 sealed items, so he simply named it "103".
The appearance of "1-103" was a moving human skin. Its ability was: "It can turn inanimate objects without spirituality into monster puppets. These monsters will undergo unknown mutations, some may even possess Beyonder abilities, some will be controlled by the holder, some will not be controlled by the holder, and some may even attract some powerful and evil gazes!"
The negative effect was: "As long as you wear it, you will become crazy and bloodthirsty, but you can retain most of your sanity. Only by killing one person can you remove the wearing state. Wearing it for more than five minutes has a certain probability of suffering an unknown curse. Some curses turn the holder into a slug, some curses make the holder lose his mind, and some curses completely turn the holder into a werewolf, but he can maintain corresponding sanity. Even a Sequence 2 'Ancient Bane' cannot remove such a 'transformation curse'."
In other words, if he didn't kill an opponent within five minutes, Hobert would likely turn into a slug.
The reason why Hobert dared to "catch the blade with his bare hands" just now was because he was affected by the sealed item, and his sanity went offline for a short while. The hot greatsword, after being released from Yarlin's control, turned into a ball of orange-red magma.
Hobert quickly withdrew his hand, but his hand was still severely burned.
But at this time, Hobert seemed to be unaware of the pain. He now had only one thought in his mind: Kill!
Hobert's eyes were bloodshot, and he charged towards Yarlin with his knife.
At this time, the demons who were fighting against losing control gradually recovered, but what greeted them was an army of monsters made up of objects.
A small bamboo basket floated up and covered the top of a demon's head.
The demon struggled to break free, but he couldn't.
Pfft~
The bamboo basket imitated the "Dragon's Fart", allowing the demon to enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by farts.
A wall suddenly opened its arms and hugged a demon. The wall kept saying to itself, "I am a fossil, I am a fossil. You don't believe it? Hehehe, I have something wrapped inside!"
A piece of clothing hanging in the yard suddenly "jumped" down from the clothesline. Soon, it exuded golden light and wrapped around a demon. The demon let out a painful scream.
The clothes laughed: "You didn't expect it, but I am actually a sunflower. Wherever I go, the sun follows!"
The demon who was burned by the sunlight cursed: "Sunflowers go to find the sun, how can the sun find the sunflower?"
A stick standing by the wall jumped and poked a demon's butt. The stick slowly said, "I, actually, am a poop stirrer!"
The tiles on the roof threw themselves out and smashed towards a demon. They kept shouting: "I am a dart! I am a dart!"
Pa~
The demon smashed a tile, and the tiles shouted: "Don't let the sacrifice of our compatriots be in vain! Charge!"
The demon was covered by tiles.
Even the knife in Hobert's hand had life: "Friend! Your swordsmanship is too poor, watch mine!"
The black knife spun on its own and slashed at Yarlin.
Hobert quickly dodged backwards. The black knife's attack almost cut Hobert: "Disorder!"
Yarlin paused briefly, and the black knife plunged into his chest. At the same time, he grabbed hard and detonated Hobert's bloodthirsty desire.
"Distortion!" Hobert gradually regained more sanity, and had been guarding against this point from Yarlin.
He "distorted" the concept of himself and Yarlin, so that the other party also suffered half of the detonation of desire.
The veins on Hobert's face bulged, his eyes turned red, and he pounced on the nearest demon.
The bloodthirsty desire once again overcame reason, and he once again grabbed the head of the demon with his bare hands!
The demon's head was covered with a bamboo basket, and he couldn't avoid Hobert's attack at all.
Hobert twisted hard, and with a "crack", he twisted the other party's head 360 degrees: "Leave none alive! Cough cough cough, TMD, who farted? It smells so bad!"
He knew that the demon was not dead yet, so he continued to twist, one circle, two circles, three circles, and then pulled hard, pulling off the demon's head.
The demon, spraying dark red blood, grabbed with both hands, as if looking for his head, and his head was kicked out by Hobert as a ball, hitting another demon.
The headless demon reached out and grabbed a few times, and fell straight to the ground.
Yarlin was not doing well either. He was already bloodthirsty and cold-blooded, so the impact he received was no less than Hobert's.
He punched the wall that he thought was a fossil, and when he saw a demon struggling to come out, he exclaimed, "It really is a fossil!"
As he spoke, a magma greatsword appeared in Yarlin's hand, and he pulled open his posture and slashed horizontally. Both the wall that thought it was a fossil and the demon were cut in half.
Hobert and Yarlin, who had each killed a life, had their bloodthirsty state weakened.
Hobert regained most of his sanity: "Corrosion!"
The demons' already dark hearts were immediately severely corroded by this skill! The demons, who were originally resisting those strange monsters, immediately lost most of their sanity.
Some stood in place and sang a song that no one had ever heard with great devotion, allowing the monster to poke his butt. At this moment, he was really crazy.
Some squatted on the ground drawing circles, allowing the clothes exuding the breath of sunshine to wrap around him: "Curse you!"
Even Yarlin hugged the upper body of the demon that he had cut in half: "How about we dance?"
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert quickly took off "1-103" and resealed it: "Why is this battle so strange?"
He quickly picked up the black knife not far away, preparing to take advantage of the demons' temporary state of irrationality to start a massacre.
Hobert had long guessed that "Corrosion" must be the most effective attack method against demons.
So when he found himself surrounded, he began to brew mental corrosion against the demons.
It's just that Hobert was affected by the sealed item, and his IQ was occasionally offline. It wasn't until he regained most of his sanity this time that he remembered his arrangement for "Corrosion".
Before Hobert could rush to Yarlin, he felt a huge wave of malice coming.
It was as if an invisible tentacle was entangling Hobert's emotions and desires.
Hobert immediately used "Blink" to recover the "Disorder Stone", and then used "Travel" to leave with the demon corpse whose head he had twisted off.
Hobert's figure disappeared, and only three or four seconds later, a middle-aged man with no expression walked out of the shadows. He looked at the ugly "demons" and said, "Fools!"
At this time, Yarlin took the lead in regaining his sanity. He dropped the half corpse he had just been holding and returned to a normal human state: "Archbishop Bowen!"
Although the demon forces are inherited in a family manner, because they jointly formed the loose "Blood Sanctify Sect", even if Yarlin and Bowen were related, they had to call the other party Archbishop.
Bowen glanced at the "monsters" that were gradually losing their vitality and turned back into clothes, wooden sticks, and ordinary tiles: "Were you the one who summoned me just now?"
As soon as Yarlin felt that the situation was not right, he immediately summoned this demigod, but this convenient summoning can only be used in a close-range state. Fortunately, this demigod did not leave South Colson tonight.
He said, "Your Excellency Archbishop, before the battle started, I did not feel a fatal threat on the other party."
If he had felt that Hobert was carrying a Level 1 sealed item, Yarlin would have watched his companions being killed from afar, and then designed a trap to deal with Hobert.
Bowen took a deep breath: "His sealing of sealed items is very special, so you didn't perceive it in advance."
At this time, more and more demons regained their sanity. They ended their "Demonization" state and became ordinary people.
Bowen glanced at the wound on Yarlin's body, and he sneered, "This wound is unusual. If you don't want to die, don't move."
Without waiting for Yarlin to answer, Bowen grabbed towards the direction of the wound, and a thick magma emerged from Yarlin's body.
These magmas cooled immediately after falling to the ground and exuded the breath of death.
Yarlin felt that part of his soul had been caught out. He knelt weakly on the ground, sweating profusely and trying to repair the trauma of his spirit body: "Thank, thank you, Archbishop."
The demon, whose butt was painfully poked by the stick, asked, "Archbishop, should we go to the other side and kill that hateful Baron?"
Bowen sneered: "He is a chosen one. We don't need to take action. Sooner or later, he will fall into the endless abyss!"
...
Hobert was surprised to find that he had not returned to his territory, but had come to Knight Cutton's room.
At this time, the Beyonder characteristics in Cutton's body had been analyzed, which was an "Arbiter"'s Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert knew that Cutton was a Sequence 9 Beyonder, but he had just left before he had time to speed up the analysis of the Beyonder characteristics in order to attack one of the demons faster.
Hobert threw the headless demon corpse on the ground, and after a little thought, he understood what was going on: This was the negative effect of "1-104"!
"1-104" was the scepter that Hobert had been carrying with him. "1-101" was the Level 1 sealed item from the Error pathway, and "1-102" was another Level 1 sealed item from the "Rose School".
Although Hobert did not use "1-104" this time, he also released its seal, so he was naturally affected by its negative effects.
One of the negative effects of the scepter was that it would make the holder unusually greedy. Fortunately, "1-104" had been resealed by Hobert using the power of the "Nation of Disorder".
Within ten minutes of use, it would only become relatively greedy, but not "abnormally greedy".
So Hobert unconsciously returned to Cutton's place, wanting to pick up his Beyonder characteristics and see if there was anything valuable here.
Since he was here, he certainly couldn't leave empty-handed. Hobert picked up Cutton's Beyonder characteristics, and then used the "Spirit Wine Glass" to communicate with the demon's corpse.
Once again in the spirit world composed of gray fog, Hobert stood before a man of about thirty years old, staring ahead with lost eyes.
Hobert asked, "Why does the Abyss want to give Hobert a gift?"
"…"
After asking seven times, the gray fog in front of Hobert parted, revealing a sacrificial scene in a cave.
Inside the cave, magma gurgled and bubbled, and on the altar was a "sacrifice" still twitching and bleeding.
A middle-aged man in a sacrificial robe, his face expressionless, stood before the altar and said, "Our sacrifice has finally pleased the 'Abyss'! Grand Duke Reitz's idea is correct! The 'Abyss' is our 'Demon Lord'!"
"He is trapped somewhere and needs our sacrifices to provide Him with the power to escape. Therefore, as long as we persist in sacrificing to the 'Abyss,' our monarch will return to the earth!"
After the demons cheered, one of them asked, "Your Eminence Archbishop, what instructions did the 'Abyss' give us?"
The Archbishop said, "The 'Abyss' told me that tomorrow a baron named Hobert will come to Viscount Teuton's mansion for a banquet. We must give the 'Monarch's Ring' to Hobert!"
"The 'Monarch's Ring'? Heavens, that's the ring the monarch once wore!"
"Indeed." The Archbishop said with a cold smile, his expression unchanged, "Hobert is the person chosen by the 'Abyss.' He can help the 'Abyss' further escape its predicament."
Another person asked, "Is Hobert also a demon?"
The Archbishop sneered, "His spirit body and life are useful to the 'Abyss'!"
The scene ended, and Hobert pondered with his arms crossed, "They have been sacrificing to the 'Abyss.' If the 'Demon Lord' Farbauti, or rather the 'Dark Side of the Universe,' still holds the uniqueness of this pathway, then these sacrifices pointing to the 'Abyss' are also pointing to Farbauti."
"But why does the 'Abyss' know my movements so clearly? Is it just because of that painting's effect?"
Then Hobert felt a little strange again. Why didn't they do any anti-divination or anti-spiritualist measures for such an important plan?
After thinking for a while without getting the answer he wanted, Hobert asked the spirit in front of him, "Your understanding of the 'Abyss.'"
"…"
After asking seven times in a row, the spiritualist scene changed multiple times, flashing scenes of the other party discussing the "Abyss" with his companions.
Most demons know less about the "Abyss" than Hobert. They only know that it is their god.
Through their discussion of the Abyss, Hobert learned some inside information about the Blood Sanctify Sect. More than a thousand years ago, after the appearance of the "Dark Side of the Universe," the higher-ups of the Blood Sanctify Sect had a huge disagreement.
Some high-level demons believed that it was the incarnation of the "Demon Lord" and should be sacrificed to and loyal to the "Dark Side of the Universe."
However, more high-level demons claimed that they had received instructions from the "Demon Lord" that the "Dark Side of the Universe" was not Him, and that everyone should not believe in the "Dark Side of the Universe."
This group of demons later split again. Some continued to believe in the "Demon Lord" Fabuti, because the "Demon Lord" occasionally responded to their sacrifices.
Others began to directly believe in the "Abyss," believing that as long as their sacrifices pointed to the uniqueness of the Abyss, they could still get in touch with the "Demon Lord." Moreover, they believed that the "Demon Lord" was obviously in some kind of trouble. If they directly sacrificed to the "Abyss," they could effectively bypass the power that was troubling the "Demon Lord" and directly contact their god.
Seeing that the demon's spirit was beginning to fade, Hobert immediately asked, "All Sequence 5s and that demigod's information in Southern Colson!"
"…"
After chanting silently seven times in a row, the appearances and names of Sequence 5s and that demigod appeared one after another, as well as some information about them.
The demigod was called Bowen, who was the archbishop who presided over the sacrifice before.
Also, there were not three Sequence 5s, but five Sequence 5s, including the three who liked to smirk, Yarlin, the seemingly wooden Shandy, and a voluptuous female demon, Gloria.
There were also two Sequence 5s that this demon had never seen before, only knowing that they were called Wordsworth and Weitz.
The demon's spirit was very faint, and Hobert, in the spirit of not wasting it, asked this demon for the potion formula of the "Abyss" pathway.
But only the potion formula for Sequence 7 was presented before this spirit completely dissipated, and Hobert was forced to withdraw from the spirit communication.
Hobert accelerated the extraction of Beyonder characteristics, and then simply searched Keton's place.
Just as he was about to leave, Hobert's mind moved. He found a rope, hung Keton's body on the so-called "Tree of Sacrifice," and dipped it in blood to write the phrase "Evil Politics" on his body.
Then he used "Travel" to return to his room. Hobert first sacrificed what he had gained tonight, an Beyonder characteristic of Sequence 6 "Devil" and one of "Arbiter" that he didn't usually use, "1-103" to the "Nation of Disorder."
Then he returned to the real world, pondered the information he had obtained through spiritualism, and fell asleep while thinking and guessing.
As he fell asleep, Hobert clearly felt some power invading his dream. Since Hobert was contaminated by an outer god last time and almost died in his dream, he would wear a bracelet made of "Order Crystal" every day to sleep.
The "Order Crystal" bracelet would keep Hobert awake even in his dreams, and he could use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to wake himself up at any time.
In the dream, Hobert walked on a beautiful grassland. At the end of the grassland was a black hall that gave people a huge sense of oppression.
The hall was a sea of flowers, and in the sea of flowers was a stone throne.
Hobert entered the hall and came to the throne. He recalled that this was the hall deep within the painting, and there was also a sea of flowers and a throne in that hall.
The difference was that on the throne in Hobert's dream at this time sat a thin, short-haired, middle-aged man with a short beard on his chin.
The middle-aged man was wearing a classical costume, and his two thin and long arms were placed on the armrests of the throne.
He had the aura of a monarch, looking down at Hobert expressionlessly like a statue: "Flegrea divined you, descendant of Trunsoest! You will help me escape my predicament and help me get rid of my greatest enemy!"
Hobert smiled and said, "While occupying my body?"
He guessed that the other party should be the "Demon Lord" Farbauti.
The middle-aged man on the throne had a tone somewhat like a charlatan: "Even if I don't actively look for you, you will defeat my greatest enemy in the future.
"Now that I'm actively looking for you, I need you to do me a favor."
"What favor?"
"Kill those annoying demons on the other side!"

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 441: The Struggle between Farbauti and the Mother Tree of Desire
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert paused for a second or two: "You, aren't you 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti?"
The middle-aged man on the throne said: "For a very long time, I was called that name!"
Hobert was even more confused: "Aren't you Sequence 0 of the 'Abyss' pathway? The god of demons?"
"I am."
Hobert smiled: "Then why did you kill those demons?"
"Because those fools kept trying to awaken me!" Farbauti's face, like a statue, finally showed some impatience: "More than two thousand years ago, I told them that I was actively entering a state of slumber to avoid my enemies.
"But they were honest for a few hundred years, and then they began to offer sacrifices to me non-stop!
"As a result, my enemy found me again, and I had to make some sacrifices to get rid of the enemy again.
"I simply stopped using 'Devil Monarch' to respond to their prayers, and these fools actually started offering sacrifices directly to the 'Abyss'!
"In a fit of anger, I took back the 'Bloody Archduke' characteristic from the Andariel and Beria families, but why don't they learn their lesson? Before long, they started offering sacrifices to the 'Abyss' again."
Hobert recalled Elder Bowen's solemn speech in front of the altar, never expecting that there would be such smart people among the demons!
Then he thought: Case solved, no wonder the Andariel and Beria families gradually declined more than a thousand years ago and became vassals. It turns out that Farbauti directly killed their leaders!
Farbauti continued: "Kill those demons on the other side and stop them from continuing to sacrifice, and that ring is yours!
"That ring has been with me for a long time, and finally one day, it gained demigod-level abilities. I can help you re-seal it so that its negative effects become almost negligible.
"In addition, I can also help you strengthen the painting's abilities!
"What do you think? Descendant of Trunsoest? This deal is very worthwhile, right?"
It was indeed a good deal, but Hobert did not immediately agree, but asked: "Who is your enemy?"
"Telling you will harm you!"
"The Mother Tree of Desire, is it?" Hobert discovered that in this dream, he possessed some memories about the Outer Gods that were sealed in his subconscious.
Farbauti said: "As expected of the person divined by Flegrea. Since you know 'Mother Tree of Desire', you have not been contaminated by Her.
"That's right, that has always been my biggest enemy.
"She has been trying to contaminate me, so I had to hide by sealing myself.
"Waiting for the person divined by Flegrea to appear and drive Her to the depths of the starry sky."
Hobert asked again: "What is your relationship with 'Demonic Wolf' Flegrea?"
"Not enemies."
Hobert nodded: "The 'Dark Side of the Universe' that appeared more than a thousand years ago is?"
Farbauti showed a slight smile: "That is the battlefield where I and 'Mother Tree of Desire' compete.
"More than a thousand years ago, because too many demons offered sacrifices to me, 'Mother Tree of Desire' found me again.
"This time, She successfully contaminated me..."
Hobert's eyes narrowed, ready to leave the dream at any time.
Fortunately, Farbauti continued: "So I made the contaminated part of myself degenerate, and made Him a separate individual.
"This individual possesses all my characteristics, and even possesses some of my authority and divinity, whether in a practical sense or in a mystical sense. This individual is me!
"But he is not the complete me. As long as the me in front of you still exists, even if he is completely contaminated, 'Devil Monarch' is still 'Devil Monarch'!"
"'Mother Tree of Desire' was indeed fooled and began to compete with me for control of that individual.
"So far, I have no hope of winning this battle, but I have not lost either.
"Later, that individual called himself 'Dark Side of the Universe' and began to respond to the demons' sacrifices himself, which is another matter."
Hobert twitched his lips: Hey, hey, hey, your clone has its own will! Don't you have any sense of crisis? Or did you give all your emotions to the "Dark Side of the Universe"?
This reminded Hobert of the concept of a "firewall". The "Dark Side of the Universe" is Farbauti's firewall!
Then he thought: At the level of a True God, it is indeed difficult to be killed. Even if the level of "Mother Tree of Desire" is one level higher than that of "Devil Monarch", as long as Farbauti is careful and does not confront head-on, with the protection of the barrier, he can still fight back and forth with the other party for a thousand or two thousand years.
Thinking of this, Hobert asked again: "Is the scene in the painting your dream? Your 'real body' wouldn't be hiding in your dream, would it?"
Farbauti took a deep look at Hobert: "That is indeed a part of my dream. 'Mother Tree of Desire' does not have this kind of authority, so She can't find me at all."
He added: "You know too much, this is not a good thing."
"I just don't want to die in someone else's conspiracy without knowing why." Hobert smiled harmlessly: "Sorry, I didn't mean you. I can feel your sincerity."
Hehe, sincerity from a devil.
Hobert paused and asked: "Is your condition okay now?"
"I can maintain it for quite a long time."
"Then I'm relieved." Hobert smiled: "Are you so confident in Flegrea's divination? To be honest, I don't want to drive away 'Mother Tree of Desire' for you right now.
"And sometimes, the divination results interpreted by diviners may not be accurate, let alone a divination from thousands of years ago."
Farbauti said expressionlessly: "First of all, you are not driving away 'Mother Tree of Desire' for me, but for yourself.
"Secondly, the reason why Flegrea's divination is credible is because you have an unimaginable close relationship with the True God later known as 'The Fool', or 'Lord of the Mysteries'.
"Even a divination from thousands of years ago, involving the Uniqueness of the same pathway, will guarantee sufficient accuracy."
Hobert was slightly stunned. He didn't expect the "Seer's" ability to be so ridiculous. Basically, other pathways are always affected or hindered in various ways when it comes to the Uniqueness.
The "Seer" pathway was also affected after involving the Uniqueness, but this effect made the divination of the Uniqueness holder more and more accurate.
"One last question." Hobert said: "If I drive away 'Mother Tree of Desire', what will you bring to this world after you regain your freedom?"
"Of course, it's depravity, filth, and corruption."
Hobert shook his head: "If that's the case, I don't want you to regain your freedom."
Farbauti's face still didn't show any emotion: "You say that only because your level is not high enough and you don't know enough.
"This world needs balance, and Beyonder characteristics also need balance. One day you will look forward to my regaining freedom."
Hobert thought: The Black Emperor will also master certain authorities of depravity and corruption. Does it really need the "Abyss" to help me balance these authorities after reaching a certain level?
Hobert shook his head. This theory sounded plausible, but on closer inspection, it was full of deception.
"Okay." Farbauti said: "Having said so much, we can continue the transaction just now.
"I have given that ring some of the abilities of high-level demons. As long as you wear it, demons will not be able to perceive your malice towards them, and they will not be able to manipulate your emotions and desires.
"After you kill all the demons on the other side, these abilities will automatically disappear, and this ring will show its original ability, which belongs to Sequence 4 'Demon'!"
Hobert said: "I want to kill those demons just because I want to kill them, not because of a transaction with you."
He never dared to make a deal with Farbauti. This was a deal with a devil... no, with the "Devil Monarch". Who knows what the consequences would be once a deal was reached?
"Whatever you say." Farbauti said.
Hobert asked again: "You use paintings to open up your dreams. Aren't you afraid that 'Mother Tree of Desire' will invade from here?"
Farbauti showed a slight smile: "You should have explored it. Only I can actively descend into this dream. No one can find me through this dream."
"This is really the last question." Hobert smiled: "It's hard to imagine that as the 'Devil Monarch', your dream is not a barren land full of volcanoes and magma.
"Can I understand it this way? In the minds of demons, there are also beautiful scenery and seas of flowers?"
This question made Farbauti stunned for a full three or four seconds before he shook his head slightly: "You don't understand, you don't understand, this used to be my home!"
Boom~
The dream suddenly shattered, and Hobert, lying on the bed, opened his eyes: "It's just talking about beautiful scenery and seas of flowers, is it necessary?"
This used to be my home!
This sentence echoed in Hobert's mind: Could it be that what I just said made the "Devil Monarch" homesick?
Silently smiling, Hobert, who was completely awake, suddenly felt as if he was wearing a ring on the ring finger of his left hand.
He raised his hand to take a look, and it was indeed the ring that Farbauti gave him!
Hobert immediately sat up and tried to pull it down hard, but he couldn't take it off no matter what.
He was about to enter the "Nation of Disorder" when he suddenly seemed to think of something and glanced at the painting on the wall.
After taking a few deep breaths, Hobert completely calmed down, got up and came to the study, left the perception range of the painting, simply prayed a few words to the "Creator", and then entered the "Nation of Disorder".
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert spread his spirituality to his own star and used "True Sight" to see his left hand covered with a layer of black mist. The source of these mists was the ring.
Looking closely, the inside of the ring seemed to have some sharp teeth-like structures that pierced into his spiritual body.
From a practical point of view, this ring could be taken off, but from a mystical or extraordinary point of view, this ring was firmly "biting" Hobert's spiritual body and became an inseparable part of him.
So it wasn't that Hobert didn't have the strength in his hand just now, but that his subconscious thought that he and the ring were a whole!
Hobert pondered for a while, boldly used the power of "Distortion" to distort the object that those "teeth" were biting. When those "teeth" loosened, Hobert immediately wrapped the ring with "Power of Order".
Immediately afterwards, Hobert returned to the real world, gently took it off, and sure enough, he took it off.
Hobert immediately sacrificed this ring to the "Nation of Disorder", sat on the "Iron Throne", Hobert put the ring in his palm, and could clearly see some black sharp "teeth" inside the ring.
They wriggled like they were alive.
Using the level of the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert learned the ability of this ring.
As Farbauti said, it does have the effect of blinding the perception of demons and blocking one's desires and emotions.
But it also has a hidden ability that allows the holder to gradually become a demon! Not the adjective "demon", but the final form is the kind of tall demon with goat horns that I saw tonight.
Even if Hobert is not an Beyonder of the "Abyss" pathway, he will still become a demon.
At the same time, Hobert discovered that the last ability may have been secretly given by Farbauti, so it was somewhat out of place with the ring.
More precisely, it was a bit like the blessing of the "Mother Tree of Desire" on the Sealed Artifact that Elliott sacrificed to Hobert before.
After being promoted to Sequence 5, Hobert's operations in the "Nation of Disorder" became more diverse.
He used the power of "Distortion" to try to extract this ability, and this ability was easily extracted by him.
Hobert beckoned a rock from the "Nation of Disorder" and attached this ability to the rock. The lines on the rock twisted and formed a demon's face.
This stone is similar to the previous "Cursed Jade Stone", but it belongs to the "Blessing of the Abyss". The blessed Beyonder will forever become a demon and can use the demon's abilities, but will unconsciously be attracted by the abyss and eventually throw themselves into the embrace of the abyss.
The difference is that now Hobert's power in the "Nation of Disorder" is becoming more and more precise. Without harming the ring, he extracted this "Blessing".
Hobert rubbed his chin and thought: In this way, the transaction initiated by Farbauti really has problems. Perhaps taking the opportunity to contaminate me is just one of his purposes. However, Farbauti may not have thought that "the devil is one foot tall, and the Tao is one foot two tall". The contamination hidden in the ring was discovered by me and dealt with accordingly.
Hobert smiled, named this stone that can be used three times "Gift of the Abyss", and then put it on the stone platform where the Sealed Artifacts were placed.
Then Hobert sat on the "Iron Throne" and thought of 'Demonic Wolf' Flegrea. Perhaps because this ancient god mastered the relevant authority of "Darkness", Hobert did not have too much impression of Him.
If He really gave Farbauti such a divination, then He should also have divined his own fall. Didn't He leave a backup plan for his resurrection?
That's not possible. Even "Attendant of Mysteries" Zaratul has a backup plan for resurrection. Flegrea, who has mastered the Uniqueness of "The Fool", should also have his own arrangements.
In addition, He has the relevant authority of "Concealment", and few people can discover his arrangements. Hehehe, it's scary to think about.
Then Hobert thought that this was something that Klein had to worry about. Let's worry about himself first.
Tonight, I already fought with the "Blood Sancitfy Sect." Hobert didn't intend to hide his identity at the time; he was even looking forward to them attacking first and fighting on his home ground.
Although the residents of the territory couldn't help, Hobert could boldly use methods like the "Order Wood," going all out without worrying about recovery issues.
Now that he had already killed one demon, he had no choice but to kill all of them so that Hobert could rest easy.
But now was not the time for a full-scale war with the demons. It wouldn't be too late to start a full-scale war after the people from the Church of the Earth Mother, the Theosophy Order, and the Tudor family had all arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 442: Digesting the Potion for the First Time
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Finally, Hobert thought about his deal with Farbauti again, and he still felt that the deal was full of doubts.
His suspicion started from the previous spirit channeling. It seemed that Farbauti or the high-level demons deliberately did not process those information, thus misleading him.
Moreover, Farbauti mentioned the concept of "transaction" many times during the conversation, which also aroused Hobert's vigilance. Whether in the stories of the Common Era or in the stories of this extraordinary world, people who have made deals with devils have never had a good ending.
There was another thing that Hobert thought of in his dream, but didn't say: Could the demons' sacrifices be affected by the "Mother Tree of Desire"? This might be the way the "Mother Tree of Desire" is looking for Farbauti.
Regarding this point, Hobert felt that Farbauti should have thought of it. Since this is the case, Farbauti still wants to kill those demons, which obviously means that Farbauti is hiding something on this issue.
In addition, Farbauti was able to recover the Beyonder characteristics of the two angels, "Bloody Archduke", before, but now he can't even recover the Beyonder characteristics of a demigod and several Sequence 5s?
Hobert guessed that the reason why Farbauti entrusted this matter to him was nothing more than three reasons. The first reason was that He had split himself once, and his condition should not be very good.
The second reason was that if He took action again, He might be detected by the "Mother Tree of Desire".
The third reason might be that He discovered the aura of the "Nation of Disorder" on Hobert, and used this transaction to set a trap for Hobert.
Hobert believed that Farbauti did this, and it should be related to all three reasons.
In the end, Hobert decided not to be influenced by Farbauti, and just do what he should do.
However, Hobert didn't intend to completely fall out with Farbauti. He planned to face Farbauti in a "fighting without breaking" manner.
After all, this is the mortal enemy of the "Mother Tree of Desire", and Hobert believes that if the Balk family wants to become bigger and stronger, there will definitely be a lot of conflicts with the "Rose School", and the "Mother Tree of Desire" is also a potential enemy of Hobert.
The enemy of the enemy is a force that can be used and united.
After figuring this out, Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder" and went back to his bedroom to sleep.
He deliberately did not bring the ring into the real world. If the oil painting is part of Farbauti's perception, this is a deterrent to Him.
...
A layer of water mist floated on the Taz River in the early morning, making the entire Feynapotter Port a bit hazy.
This morning, many people came to the port, looking at the downstream of the Taz River.
Most of them are from shipping companies or freight companies. They came here just because they heard a message: The Taz River shipping seems to be reopened.
"Here it comes! Here it comes!"
A huge "figure" broke through the mist and appeared in everyone's sight.
Its appearance gradually became clear, and finally slowly docked.
This is the "Nohar" which everyone originally expected to be severely overdue, but arrived in Feynapotter ahead of schedule.
The pier was already noisy with people talking.
Until Captain Dean and others disembarked, reporters and colleagues immediately surrounded them and asked questions.
But most of the reporters were asking: "Have you encountered any accidents along the way?"
"What are your thoughts now?"
Questions like this.
Among the crowd, a young man in his twenties, dressed as a reporter, shook his head: As expected, they were hired with money and didn't ask the key questions at all.
It's not as good as some of the questions asked by freight company colleagues: "How many days did you save on this voyage?"
Dean replied with a smile: "As you know, although we sailed cautiously along the way, it only took half the time."
"Are there any supply ports along the way?"
"Did you encounter any danger?"
"..."
The young reporter finally couldn't stand it anymore: "Captain Dean, how did you defeat those bandits?"
"It wasn't us who defeated them." Dean smiled and said, "It was Baron Hobert who defeated those bandits with his entourage very easily!"
The young reporter then asked: "Why did Baron Hobert help you?"
Dean pointed to the flag inserted at the bow of the ship: "This is the protection promised by Lord Hobert. As long as the flag of the Jeffery Territory is inserted at the bow of the ship, you can launch flares for help if you encounter any danger in the South Colson area! Lord Hobert's help will arrive in time."
Flag, help, protection! The reporters who were invited only then realized that all of this was full of legendary color, and it was indeed a news story worth reporting!
At this time, the reporters opened their shorthand notebooks and scribbled down notes.
Once they entered a professional state, the reporters asked the point: "Is this Baron Hobert the gentleman who was offered a reward of 10,000 pounds by the King of Loen?"
"After he went to the Jeffery Territory, have there been any new changes in that territory?"
"What? The waterway was opened by Baron Hobert?"
"Is it so chaotic there that bandits have become the rulers?"
"..."
There was no need for the young reporter to guide them anymore. The reporters asked about the current situation of South Colson and the Jeffery Territory bit by bit. The surrounding people showed enough surprise, which made the reporters even more convinced that this must be a report that would be attractive enough to readers.
The young reporter withdrew from the crowd and came to the corner. His appearance changed rapidly, and finally turned into Baron Hobert himself, who was being fiercely discussed on the pier.
Then, a phantom-like layer appeared around Hobert, causing everyone to unconsciously ignore him.
Soon, Hobert disappeared into the air, but the surrounding people didn't seem to notice this at all.
At this moment, a small warship docked, and Ethel, dressed in military uniform and looking heroic, came down from the warship and saw the bustling scene at the freight terminal.
Ethel was a little curious and called her adjutant: "Go and ask what's going on?"
Just as Ethel got into the carriage, the adjutant had already found out: "General, the waterway of the Taz River has been reopened."
"Oh?" Ethel smiled: "In that case, freight transportation will be much more convenient in the future."
She didn't take it too seriously, and thought that the royal family had reopened the waterway.
Ethel arrived at the palace smoothly and met Ferdinand II in the spacious and luxurious Cassia Hall.
Cassia Hall is part of Ferdinand II's bedroom. It is about the size of a conference hall and is where Ferdinand II summons confidants to discuss internal royal issues.
If it is routine official business, it is handled in his office.
The father and daughter first said some words of missing each other, and then Ethel reported on the process of going to commend the senior spy before.
However, she did not mention the crown prince's harm to her. She only said that the spies of the Intis Republic obtained relevant information, which exposed her whereabouts and the identity of the senior spy.
She had completely destroyed the intelligence network of the Intis Republic in the northern theater, and so on.
After talking about official business, the father and daughter chatted idly. Ethel had noticed just now that there was a map of Colson County hanging on the wall: "Father, I heard at the pier. The waterway of the Taz River has been reopened?"
"Yes." Ferdinand II said: "Hobert just submitted a related report a few days ago. I asked people to investigate it, and there is indeed news that a cargo ship docked this morning."
"Hobert? Hobert Jeffery? That traitor?" Ethel didn't have any good feelings for these traitors.
Ferdinand II suddenly smiled: "That fool George III, it's fine if Christian, who he has been suppressing, is a talent, but Christian's son is also very capable. He actually sealed the corruption of Full Moon Lake and dredged the waterway of the Taz River."
This surprised Ethel a little: "I remember that the corruption of Full Moon Lake seems to be able to erode even demigods, right?"
Ferdinand II nodded: "Hobert said in the report that he found inspiration from a sealing magic circle in the family's classics and tried to complete the seal."
The king paused and then said: "I am preparing to send someone to find out the specific situation."
He looked at the map of Colson County, took a deep breath and said: "Next, we have to find a way to take back the rule of these local nobles."
The Feynapotter Kingdom had many successful cases of this kind before, and it was not difficult for Ferdinand II.
"I don't know where Hobert got so much money?" Ferdinand II was very interested in talking about this: "I just received a report from Viscount Teuton this morning. Hobert seems to be expanding Jeffery Town into a small city."
Ethel smiled: "Then let him build it. When the fruit is ripe, it will be time to pick it.
"We can also invest in Viscount Teuton's territory and cultivate Viscount Teuton, using this excuse to send our people there to prepare for taking back the rule there."
Ferdinand II nodded: "Your two older brothers are not as good as you!"
...
Jeffery Territory.
Hobert, who had taken a "stroll" around Feynapotter Port early in the morning, drank a large bowl of hot porridge in the restaurant.
The Feynapotter Kingdom does not have the dietary habit of drinking porridge in the morning, but now Hobert doesn't care about the issue of fitting in, he just does what makes him comfortable.
After breakfast, Hobert came to the study and continued to teach Freya words.
After the learning process, Hobert asked: "What did you feel after going out for a walk yesterday?"
Freya suddenly had red eyes: "Teacher, why doesn't Backlund have an organization to protect the poor?
"I only remember that the patrolmen are terrible, they beat people at every turn, and whoever gives more money, they will make a judgment that is beneficial to them.
"No one cares about our life or death, no one gives us a little bit of the rich's money, not even a little bit, and people won't die every day."
Hobert smiled: "The situation in Backlund and the Jeffery Territory is different. If I have the opportunity in the future, I will tell you about the problems in Backlund.
"We will only talk about the problems in the Jeffery Territory today. Do you think that if I divide the land equally, the villagers' lives will be better? Will the bullies in the village disappear?"
Freya thought for a while: "It should be, I asked Miss Donna to help me translate and asked the villagers some questions.
"Everyone is forced to rely on the bullies because the bullies are fierce and the villagers owe the bullies some food.
"If the land is divided equally, the bullies will not have so much food source, and everyone will gradually not owe the bullies anything, and the bullies will not be fierce."
Hobert nodded in satisfaction: "You can take the initiative to investigate, which exceeded my expectations.
"Your approach is very correct, and you should do this in the future. Without investigation, there is no right to speak!
"The reason why many policies in the countries of the Northern Continent today will arouse huge contradictions is precisely because the government's investigation efforts are not enough, and the responses made are full of some officials' self-righteousness.
"But the analysis after the investigation is equally important. You must be good at finding the essence of the problem and the root of the contradiction!"
Hobert couldn't remember many of the original words in "On Contradiction", but he still remembered many of the theories in it.
He continued: "On the surface, there is a relationship of interest between the bullies and the villagers, but it also involves the issue of the right to handle civil disputes!
"The reason why the villagers rely on the village bullies is largely because the village bullies can resolve civil disputes in the village relatively fairly, and their solutions have timeliness and binding force.
"Because it is only 'relatively fair', the village bullies will naturally favor the party that is close to them, so everyone has to rely on him and try to become the party that the village bullies are close to.
"The so-called timeliness means that they can flexibly solve problems according to the situation on the spot.
"The so-called binding force means that after solving the problem, they can give both parties enough binding force so that both parties can implement his solution."
Freya thought for a long time before saying: "That is to say, the problem of the village bullies still cannot be completely solved, and the villagers still have to be bullied by them?"
"This is exactly what I want to say next, the third step after investigating clearly and sorting out the main contradictions." Hobert smiled and said: "Properly solve the problem!
"The main contradictions have been sorted out, so wouldn't it be good to take back the right to handle civil disputes?
"It's just that solving the problem requires attention to the way and method, and it is unrealistic for the villagers to come to the lord's mansion to handle disputes.
"Then the staff of the lord's mansion can go to the countryside. The previous publicity of simplified regulations with Corwin was a start.
"In the future, there will be a civil court in the town, and there will also be three patrol teams. Their task is to go to the villages every day to solve various disputes among the villagers.
"In up to three months, the last breeding ground for bullies will also disappear completely!"
The more Freya listened, the brighter her eyes became: "I knew that the teacher must have a solution!"
Hobert smiled and said: "Others can only learn the model of solving problems, but you have to learn the process of solving problems!"
Freya seemed to tremble all over, and suddenly understood a lot of things, then immediately stood up, said nothing, and bowed deeply to Hobert.
Hobert felt the signs of the potion being digested for the first time. Although not much was digested, probably only one-tenth or even one-fifteenth, it was a good sign that it had started to be digested.
Hobert asked Freya to continue practicing words, while he calmly considered this issue:
"This should be from the digestion of the 'mentor' aspect. Teaching a few words cannot be called a mentor. Teaching the laws of social operation or the way to conduct oneself is called a mentor.
"And the 'Mentor of Disorder' is not just that! I tried to teach Freya to define her position before, but the potion showed no signs of digestion at that time, but this time it did.
"The only difference is that this time, I presented a brand new solution to a grassroots problem that has plagued the Northern Continent government since ancient times... Well, copied from the Common Era, it's the first time it's being used in this era.
"In this regard, Roselle constructed a Western colonial system, bringing both its advantages and disadvantages to this era.
"The biggest logical problem with this system is that it advocates human rights but does not respect personality. The biggest problem in terms of government operation is that the central government cannot reach the grassroots level.
"Although some villages in the Northern Continent today have management organizations similar to village governments and village councils, there are no positions like 'village party secretaries,' and the central government has almost no control over these organizations.
"This kind of governance thinking may be the reason why they lack the idea of great unification, which is another issue. Now, the problem I have to consider is: I teach students new governance thinking and concepts, and the potion is digested.
"This is not only something that the 'mentor' aspect can encompass, but also an interaction and explanation of the signs of chaos appearing in the territory, and the proposal of a 'unique' solution.
"In other words, the 'Mentor of Disorder' cannot be split like the 'Baron of Corruption.' As far as digesting potions is concerned, the 'Mentor of Disorder' is mostly a whole!
"Telling students why this society is chaotic, or the root of the chaos, that is the 'mentor' of chaos!"
Hobert's thoughts became clearer and clearer. He continued to think: "It's not that the path of 'creating chaos' is impassable, but that chaos must be created purposefully, and there must be a certain degree of control over the chaos created.
"The 'Mentor of Disorder' is by no means as simple as a destroyer of rules. Chaos can promote the formation of new rules. Only by understanding the meaning and function of chaos can one be called a 'mentor'.
"Simply understanding is not enough. You also have to teach this knowledge to students, forming an interaction between the mentor and the student, or a collision in the spirit world, to truly complete a digestion process.
"The most direct evidence of these ideas is that more than 800 people throughout the territory have been mobilized to invest in the construction of the territory, and old people like Dophis have said that they have never seen so many people mobilized at once in their memory.
"This has caused no small amount of chaos in the territory, but this chaos has not loosened the potion, because this chaos is basically emotional chaos, not chaos in order.
"Reallocating land, although everyone is happy, has caused chaos in order. After my interaction with Freya, this chaos interacted with me, so the potion was digested.
"I estimate that the potion will be further digested after the right to handle grassroots civil disputes is completely recovered."
Thinking of this, a smile gradually crept onto his face, because he suddenly thought that killing the demons on the other side, even if he did nothing after that, would be equivalent to re-establishing a new ruling system, and the potion should be digested accordingly.
Just as Hobert finished considering this question and breathed a long sigh of relief, Hobert heard a commotion in the yard.
Freya looked outside, then at Hobert, then put down her pen and opened the door to the study.
It turned out that Allen and Dennis, who was on his first day of work, had a dispute, and the two were fighting.
When Allen saw the door open, he immediately let go of Dennis and respectfully stepped aside, while Dennis was still unwilling to give up and was about to grab Allen's collar.
Hobert stood at the door and asked, "What's going on?"
Allen reported: "It's time for the lord to have tea. I asked Dennis to go to the kitchen to get tea, but he refused, saying that I was insulting him, and he hit me. I had no choice but to fight him."
Dennis retorted unconvinced: "Why didn't you go?"
Allen very cleverly did not speak.
Hobert asked Dennis, "Didn't I make it clear to you before you came? Allen is the senior male servant, and you three brothers must listen to his commands."
Dennis was unconvinced: "Why?"
"I know you're not convinced." Hobert smiled instead of getting angry. "How about this, I'll give you a chance. Use the most powerful way you've learned to attack me. As long as you can touch my clothes, I'll admit defeat, and you three brothers don't have to be male servants anymore.
"And I will only use my right index finger to block your attack. Using one more finger will be considered my loss!"
Dennis smiled and said, "You said that!"
Allen shook his head and stepped aside.
"Of course I said it." Hobert smiled slightly. "Everyone in the yard is a witness."
"Okay! Then I won't be polite!" Dennis was still considered smart. He didn't expect to defeat Hobert head-on, but attacked with agile movements, aiming only to touch Hobert's clothes.
But when he rushed to Hobert's side, Hobert's hand suddenly appeared in front of him.
The index finger of this hand bent slightly, and then flicked, hitting Dennis's forehead directly, sending Dennis flying out.
The servants in the yard and Freya in the study were all stunned. Of course, they knew that Dennis was no match for Hobert, but they didn't expect that the lord could defeat Dennis so easily.
Hobert stood at the door of the study and waited for Dennis, whose forehead was red, to get up before asking, "Are you convinced?"
He had just pushed Dennis out, and did not concentrate all his strength on one point on his forehead, otherwise Dennis's forehead would have been shattered.
Dennis suddenly knelt on the ground with a "plop": "Lord, please teach me how to fight."
As the son of a knight, he had been learning how to fight with his father since he was a child, but just now, he knew that even if he learned with his father and older brothers for the rest of his life, he would not be able to beat Hobert.
Hobert smiled slightly: "Learn how to fight from me, and then defeat me?"
Dennis's face was flushed: "No, no."
Hobert smiled: "Little kid, your thoughts are all written on your face!
"I can teach you, but you have to clean the study spotless every day. As long as Allen is still the head male servant, you have to obey his orders."
Dennis nodded repeatedly: "Okay, okay!"
Hobert finally said: "Also, pour my foot-washing water every night!"

chapters.content:
