Around ten o'clock, Hobert, accompanied by Philip, Alan, and a red-faced Dennis, arrived at the pier to welcome the delegation sent by the Mother Earth Church.
The pier was once again crowded with people, many of whom were seeing people in church attire for the first time.
It had been over fifty years since a pastor had preached or a bishop had performed a ceremony here, but most people still believed in the Mother Earth, and for them, faith had become a habit.
Originally, they thought they would be excited to see the bishop and pastor, but when Hobert appeared with his butler and two male servants, their excitement gradually faded.
Because they finally realized that the Mother Earth Church sent pastors and bishops not because there were a large number of believers here, but because the Lord had defeated the monster in Moon Lake.
Without the Lord, they might never have seen clergy in their lifetime.
So when Bishop Dick and his party disembarked, they found that the atmosphere on the pier was not right. They had been warmly welcomed at every port along the way.
Arriving at the port of Jeffrey Town, it couldn't be said they weren't welcome, as so many people had turned out. But if they were welcome, why didn't their eyes and body language show any sign of welcome?
It had been so many years since anyone had come to spread the gospel of the Mother God, so they should have been excited, even tearful, right?
But they just watched quietly, more like they were watching a show than welcoming them.
Baron Hobert only offered a polite greeting before handing over the reception matters to his butler.
Butler Philip took them to visit the repaired church and promised some donations to the church, but he knew nothing about Moon Lake.
This made Bishop Dick feel depressed, as it was the first time he had encountered such a cold reception.
...
That night, the major newspapers in Feynapotter City rushed to report the news of the reopening of the Taz River.
With the radiation of the railway, the major cities of the Feynapotter Kingdom learned of this news in the following Saturday and Sunday.
The first to react were the cities along the Yawei River in the west. They asked reporters, reputable experts in the shipping industry, and others to publish reports, emphasizing that the Taz River waterway was very dangerous even if it reopened, and there were no supply ports along the way.
In short, the Taz River waterway was described as a very dangerous route, with less than one in ten ships reaching Feynapotter City.
These debates in the newspapers had almost no impact on Jeffrey Territory in the deep mountains, because there were no newspapers here.
The entire territory operated in an orderly manner for two or three days, and Hobert finally enjoyed a belated vacation.
He personally went to the kitchen to make dumplings, dipped them in vinegar and minced garlic, and ate more than fifty in one go.
Before, in the Common Era, he ate dumplings almost every festival and was completely tired of them. Now, being able to eat one, tears almost fell. This is the taste of the New Year!
Fors and Donna also thought the taste was very good, much better than meat buns and pies.
Hobert spent a whole morning making them, and the three of them quickly ate them all.
After lunch, Fors returned to Backlund early because she had to attend the Tarot Gathering.
Hobert asked Donna to draw on the tax laws of the Feynapotter Kingdom and the Loen Kingdom to draft a dozen "Tax Rules" applicable to Jeffrey Territory.
Theoretically, Hobert, as a baron, did not have the power to make and promulgate laws, so he found a loophole and promulgated some detailed rules.
Donna was also very busy now. After lunch, she returned to the house to continue reading the tax laws of the two countries.
Hobert basked in the sun in the yard for a while, then returned to his room to prepare for the Tarot Gathering.
At three o'clock, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog, and he came to the Giant Palace above the gray fog again.
As soon as everyone's figures appeared, Hobert noticed that there was one more person in his row. Just by looking at the other person's figure, Hobert guessed that it was "The Moon" Emlyn White, the current servant of the Harvest Church and the witness of Hobert's baptism.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool." "Justice" Audrey's greeting always rang out first: "You have saved Backlund once again!"
"The Moon" Emlyn, who was attending the gathering for the first time, was stunned: Ah? What? When was I saved "again"?
Even though "The Hanged Man" Alger was drifting at sea, he had received news of the Backlund smog incident. He firmly believed that since this matter had attracted the attention of "The Fool," it definitely involved a struggle with the evil god. So he was not surprised to hear Audrey say that.
Fors was also concerned about this matter. She had been busy writing articles these days and rarely appeared in Backlund, but Xio was still in Backlund, and she seemed to be able to receive tasks every day, making it difficult for her to leave.
While thanking The Fool, Audrey was also observing the others.
She saw surprise in the body language of the new member and Fors, expectation in Mr. Hanged Man, and neither Mr. World nor Hobert seemed surprised by this.
Audrey was a little strange: Did Hobert also know some inside information?
Then she thanked "The World": "Mr. World, if it weren't for your advance warning, perhaps hundreds of thousands of people would have died in this smog in Backlund."
"In fact, I also saved myself," Klein manipulated "The World" and smiled.
Then, as "The Fool," he responded with a smile: "I just provided a little insignificant help."
"No, it was because of the reminder from your attendant that the Evernight Goddess Church was prepared, prevented the awakening of the 'Primordial Demoness,' and kept the corruption level of the smog within a controllable range," Audrey described the news that surprised the other members again:
"He also destroyed the Aurora Order's ritual and once again isolated the 'True Creator' who was trying to descend from the real world."
Emlyn almost jumped up: The "Primordial Demoness" wanted to wake up? The "True Creator" tried to descend? Why is this different from the information announced within the Sanguine? Wasn't it said that a disaster was caused by a "Demoness of Despair" trying to advance?
Alger leaned back in his chair: I said it, this must involve the struggle of the gods.
Fors was also surprised and scared: Wasn't it said that this was a disaster caused by a prince and a witch? How could it involve two evil gods? God, if any of them descended, the entire Backlund would be destroyed. Fortunately, "The Fool" prevented all of this.
Seeing that someone knew and remembered his contributions, Klein was relieved: "Unfortunately, he had to leave Backlund because of this."
Audrey stood up and gave a sincere salute: "Please convey my thanks to him."
Klein maintained his image and did not respond, just nodded: "In addition, the 'Emperor' made an outstanding contribution to preventing the 'Primordial Demoness'!"
Everyone turned their attention to "The Emperor." Hobert didn't want to mention this, but since "The Fool" said so, he couldn't help but respond.
And Hobert suddenly thought that he should describe this inhumane massacre to everyone and remind Audrey to pay attention to the movements of the royal family.
So Hobert said: "After the 'Creator' received the relevant news, he noticed the actions of the Demoness Sect, so he sent me and two saints to stop the 'Demoness of Despair' who was spreading the disaster."
Audrey was a little surprised. This was information she didn't know: Hobert also participated in this event! I didn't expect the 'Creator' to send saints! Why didn't the church make this information public?
Alger looked surprised: This, this is a joint action between the 'Creator' and 'The Fool'! Yes, they seem to be hostile to some evil gods, but it is not clear what they can get by doing this? At the last gathering, everyone just learned that "The Emperor" was an attendant of the "Creator." Only one day later, the two gods joined forces in an action. They...they had expected it!
As a relatively well-informed Sanguine, Emlyn had just heard about the relevant information about the "Creator" in the Southern Continent a few days ago. Every Sanguine was happy after hearing about that battle. It is said that many believers of the 'Primordial Moon' died in that battle.
He thought: This Tarot Gathering member codenamed "Emperor" knows some inside information about the "Creator." Could he be a believer of the "Creator"? Why does the "Creator" want to stop the descent of the evil god?
Fors was first surprised, then smiled helplessly: Before, I confidently told Hobert that the smog incident was caused by a prince and a witch. I didn't expect there to be so much information I didn't know! Fortunately, Hobert knows even less and won't think I'm deceiving him.
"The Sun" Derrick also had a similar guess as Alger, believing that this was a joint action between the 'Creator' and 'The Fool.' He, who had nothing to do with it, also began to pay attention to this event.
Even Klein was a little surprised: There were even 'saints' involved! When Hobert met me in the suburbs of Backlund, he said it so lightly. I thought he was the only one who came to Backlund!
Hobert continued: "But under the influence of '0-08,' two hostile saints 'happened' to appear."
Klein, Audrey, and Alger recalled the abilities of "0-08" and couldn't help but sweat for "The Emperor."
Especially Klein, who was almost killed by a meteorite this time, once again felt the power of a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
Fors and Emlyn didn't know the specific situation of "0-08." They only knew that a battle between saints also took place on the day of the smog incident!
Audrey asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, what was the final outcome of the battle?"
Hobert asked instead: "How many people died in this smog?"
"According to statistics, there were more than 30,000 people!" Audrey got the internal statistics. The numbers published in the major newspapers were 3,000.
Hobert was slightly stunned before realizing that his actions were also effective. He remembered that about 60,000 to 70,000 people seemed to have died in the original book!
This made his mood less heavy: "We effectively stopped the 'Demoness of Despair' from spreading the disaster. Unfortunately, when the other party's two saints were in place, the 'Demoness of Despair' began to spread the disaster again."
Alger followed this topic and said: "If it weren't for your obstruction, I think the death toll would have increased by at least double!"
Audrey nodded, she thought so too.
And Klein finally understood Hobert's helplessness. If he was a demigod, he would indeed have a hope of stopping this disaster.
Derrick also discovered this: "Mr. Emperor, that is to say, the battle situation at that time developed into two saints plus a 'Demoness of Despair' against two saints plus you?"
Audrey finally realized this: "Oh my god, Mr. Emperor, that is to say, you had to deal with a demigod?"
Hobert smiled: "Yes, I almost died in Backlund."
Everyone was silent for a few seconds. Before, "The Emperor's" understatement made them think that the focus of the battle should be on those saints. At this moment, they finally understood the tragic degree of this battle!
Especially Alger, who had acted with Hobert, believed that he was the one among all the members who knew best how powerful "The Emperor" was, but even so, "The Emperor" almost died in this battle.
This made Alger sigh: If I encountered this level of battle, I might not be able to last three seconds.
Hobert said: "I think I should let you see the tragic situation in the East Borough at that time, so that you can have the most direct understanding and feeling of this disaster."
After obtaining The Fool's consent, Hobert presented the scene he saw at that time, the streets of the East Borough full of corpses.
Everyone saw that in the rolling thick fog, many parents and children died embracing each other. At the last moment of their lives, parents were still using their arms to shield their children from the thick fog.
They also knew that such shielding was useless, but what could they do? Only this one way to protect the lives they cherished most.
There were also young lovers who died embracing each other. Their lives had just become wonderful, but they fell on the cold streets.
More were the elderly, but it was not appropriate to call them elderly, after all, they were only about forty years old.
They may have once had happy families, or a small house that could shelter them from the wind and rain, a good, relatively decent job.
But because of such ridiculous and helpless reasons, they lost their good lives and could only live a hungry life, only to sleep on the streets.
No, sleeping on the streets is not allowed, because parks and streets are not for homeless people to sleep on.
The key is that once you fall into this situation, it is like falling into despair, and only a very few people regain their original lives.
In fact, the members present are not the bottom of this era. Even Audrey, who knows the most about this event, only knows some statistics.
Although Klein directly participated in this action, he did not know the situation in Backlund.
Although Fors and Emlyn were in Backlund at the time, they were not at the scene and only knew that many people died.
Alger was at sea and had no direct feelings.
Even Derrick, who was in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods," felt heavy after seeing so many people die, especially so many ordinary people.
The members of the Tarot Club were collectively silent after seeing these scenes. For the first time, they directly felt the sorrow of this era and the insignificance of life under extraordinary powers.
"Quickly improve your strength!" Hobert said, "When we become stronger, perhaps when we encounter similar things again, we can prevent such tragedies from happening."
Everyone looked at Hobert together. At this moment, everyone deeply agreed with his words.
Audrey breathed a sigh of relief, "Fortunately, this incident is finally over."
"It's not!" Hobert said, "The cooperation between the royal family and the Demoness Sect and the Aurora Order is still continuing. They need a large number of slaves and innocent girls. For ordinary people, this is a disaster in itself."
"The Backlund smog disaster may reappear, and may even trigger a greater disaster."
"The royal family?" Audrey was a little surprised, "Isn't the royal family also a victim?"
"No!" Hobert explained, "Because the cooperation between the royal family and the Demoness Sect may be leaked, the 'Demoness of Despair' used the Backlund smog incident and the arrival of the 'True Creator' to divert everyone's attention."
Audrey could no longer maintain her "Spectator" state. This was information she didn't know.
The others were also surprised that this incident was actually related to the royal family!
Fors directly asked, "Why is the royal family cooperating with these two evil religions?"
"Because the royal family's ongoing conspiracy may not be supported by the orthodox churches," Hobert replied.
"The World" suddenly said, "This reminds me of something!"
Then he said to "The Hanged Man", "I found the Ballem you mentioned!"
Previously, Alger had posted a task to find the slave trader Ballem during the "information exchange" stage of the Tarot Club, but there had been no results.
Alger asked in disbelief, "Ballem involved in multiple slave cases on colonial islands?"
"Yes, brownish-red skin, Southern Continent race, Backlund accent, the third tooth on the left is a false tooth," "The World" answered hoarsely.
"It's him!" Alger recalled for two seconds and asked, "Where is he? What is his current identity?"
"The World" replied, "Ballem is in Backlund. Someone saw him meeting with a member of Military Intelligence Section 9 who is loyal to the royal family. I don't know who it is because the other party was wearing a mask."
"The World's" words were equivalent to providing evidence for what "The Emperor" had just said. The royal family was indeed in contact with some slave traders.
Moreover, except for Emlyn, who had just joined the club, the other members all thought of the Capim incident, in which there was also a shadow of a member of the royal family.
Audrey asked Hobert, "Mr. Emperor, what conspiracy is the royal family brewing?"
Although she didn't like the members of the royal family who didn't respect women, she always felt that the royal family should be on the side of "justice".
But some of the information she had recently obtained had seriously shaken her idea.
Hobert did not hide anything, "George III is dreaming about becoming a god!"
Even Klein behind the gray fog was stunned: Becoming a god? I can guess that there must be a bigger conspiracy behind the Backlund smog incident, but I never thought that it would be related to becoming a god!
Alger was surprised at first, then a little excited: So that's it! The "Creator" and "The Fool" don't want George III to become a god, so they have repeatedly disrupted their actions! It must be like this! Haha! The other members must not have thought of this.
Audrey's surprise today has almost exceeded the surprise she has felt in the past week: Becoming a god? The king actually wants to become a god? This, how is this possible!
Fors: I didn't hear wrong, did I? The smog incident can actually be related to becoming a god. Fortunately, fortunately, Hobert doesn't know too much about the inside story, otherwise my previous explanation would be too embarrassing.
At this time, she suddenly thought: Hobert said that a friend asked him to help rescue people. Could he have learned more information from his friend?
Derrick was more excited: Before, we were discussing the gods in history, or the gods who had ascended to the throne before this. Today is the first time we have talked about a person who is becoming a god.
Emlyn smiled and leaned on the back of his chair: Nonsense, in our Sanguine's long records, the last time someone became a god seems to have been more than a thousand years ago! There has been no record of anyone becoming a god since the Fifth Epoch! "The Emperor" must be talking nonsense, but, but why do the other members believe it? Are they a bunch of fools? It must be like this, they were deceived by "The Emperor's" lies, only I saw through everything.
So Emlyn prepared to expose this lie. He asked with a somewhat arrogant smile, "Mr. Emperor, why are you so sure? I mean about George III becoming a god?"
Hobert glanced at him, "Because I am a Beyonder of the 'Lawyer' pathway."
This answer completely exceeded Emlyn's expectations. Originally, he wanted to tell everyone how difficult the process of becoming a god was: "This, what does this have to do with your pathway?"
Hobert asked with a smile, "Want to know the answer?"
Emlyn answered very honestly, "Yes!"
"2000 pounds!"
"Cough cough cough... I'll think about it."
Klein understood a lot of questions based on "The Emperor's" words: No wonder Hobert is so clear about the conspiracy behind the scenes. It turns out that "The Creator" and George III are on the same pathway or adjacent pathways. The possibility of adjacent pathways is greater. Hobert is a Beyonder of the "Lawyer" pathway, and the Augustus family is a Beyonder of the "Arbiter" pathway. George III wants to become a god, as a god of adjacent pathways, "The Creator" will definitely pay more attention to this matter, and as a devotee of "The Creator", he must know more.
Klein doesn't know that George III wants to become the "Black Emperor" at this time, so he has such a guess.
Alger, Audrey, and Derrick, members who know the law of Beyonder characteristics, have similar guesses.
Fors and Emlyn were confused and couldn't figure out what was going on.
Audrey asked again, "Mr. Emperor, why does the country... George III need a large number of slaves and innocent girls to become a god?"
"I don't know the specific situation." Hobert planned to stop there. If he explained the problem too clearly, it would also reveal some key information about himself.
Moreover, concerning "The Creator", if he knew too much detail, it would also seem a little disrespectful to "The Creator".
Klein, who learned the Sequence 5 potion formula, guessed: Could this involve a ritual? A ritual to become a god?
The others have not yet been exposed to the rituals required for advancement, so there are no related guesses.
After this topic ended, Klein pointed to Emlyn with a smile, "This is the new member, Mr. Moon!"
Audrey was stunned: Why would a gentleman choose the "Moon" card?

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 444 Eight Kings of Angels (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to ArcherArchX for becoming a free member, +1]
After introducing the new members, it was time to sacrifice Roselle's diary again.
However, Audrey and Alger didn't gain anything this week, but Fors obtained three pages of the diary through her teacher.
Emlyn, who was watching from the sidelines, was surprised and amazed: That was actually Roselle's diary! Mr. Fool actually understands the mysterious symbols invented by Emperor Roselle! Of course, He understands, He is an omnipotent God! Hehehe, as expected, the Ancestor guided me to join this gathering. Just by listening in, I've obtained a lot of high-level information.
Audrey, on the other hand, was appreciating Mr. Moon's expressions, sometimes surprised, sometimes excited, sometimes trembling: This Mr. Moon is not a gentleman who knows how to hide his emotions. All his thoughts are written on his face and in his body language.
Klein spent a few minutes reading the diary: "You can begin."
Audrey immediately asked Derrick, "Little Sun": "Have you gotten rid of that cycle?
Derrick first nodded, then bowed to the head of the bronze long table: "Great Mr. Fool, thank you for your guidance, which allowed the Chief to find clues from the mural with the 'Rose of Redemption'."
The somewhat bewildered "Fool" Klein responded with a smile: "Very good!"
Then Derrick bowed to Hobert: "Emperor, thank you for providing information about the 'Angel of Fate'. The information you provided is exactly the same as what the Chief saw in the ancient books, allowing us to completely solve the problem after only two cycles."
Hobert smiled: "No need to thank me, you paid for the extraordinary materials! This is a transaction."
Not only was the "Fool" bewildered, but so was Emlyn: What 'Rose of Redemption'? What 'Angel of Fate'? What 'escape from the cycle'? These terms were all outside his knowledge. He could understand each word, but he didn't know what they meant together.
Emlyn wondered: Could it be that the seemingly young "Sun" had just escaped the pursuit of an angel? Liar! He must be lying!
But having learned his lesson from before, Emlyn didn't immediately expose "Sun", because he found that the other members believed him. He decided to wait and see, and expose him after the other party revealed a bigger flaw.
After hearing "Emperor's" words, Derrick immediately responded: "Emperor, although we have successfully solved the problem, we have not returned to City of Silver yet. Once we return, I will immediately pay you all the Beyonder materials I owe you."
Hobert nodded: "No rush."
Audrey then asked: "What was the specific process like?"
Derrick didn't hide anything: "In the sixth exploration, I tried..."
He described in detail the actions he took and the corresponding results, emphasizing the details of the little boy Jack coming from Enmat Port and the details of the mural where the 'Rose of Redemption' was located.
Alger clearly told Derrick: "Enmat Port is a port in the Northern Continent."
Except for Emlyn, everyone else was a little excited, because this proved that there was still some connection between the outside world and the "Forsaken Land of the Gods."
Emlyn was a little strange: What are you excited about? Who hasn't heard of Enmat Port? It is one of the most famous seaports in the Kingdom of Loen, supporting more than half of Backlund's supplies together with Pritz Harbor, one in the south and one in the north. This is common sense, right!
Derrick added: "The Chief told me that he saw in an ancient book that when the the Omnipotent and Omniscient God gazed upon this land, He was surrounded by many angels, and the leaders of the angels, the kings closest to the God's throne, were eight in total, including the descendants of God.
"They are the Kings of Angels mentioned by the Emperor. The Chief suspects that Amon is the 'Angel of Time ' among the Kings of Angels, and the one in the mural is the 'Angel of Fate', Ouroboros, the 'Tail Devourer'!"
Everyone had heard Hobert explain the Kings of Angels before, so at this time, except for Emlyn, everyone was not too surprised by this concept, only that there were eight Kings of Angels in total!
Audrey asked curiously: "Mr. Sun, what are the titles and names of the other six Kings of Angels?"
"The Chief didn't say, and I didn't dare to ask..." Derrick responded somewhat ashamed.
I really want to know the answer! Audrey subconsciously looked at Hobert.
Hobert smiled: "The information is very valuable, worth 5,000 pounds!"
He explained: "The reason it's worth so much is because after telling you this information, the previous information worth 20,000 pounds will be greatly reduced."
"Deal!" Audrey said.
"De..." Hobert thought he had misheard. All previous transactions of similar prices had failed.
Who knew that this time Audrey would take the initiative: "I am willing to pay 2,000 pounds for this information. Are you willing to jointly pay the remaining 3,000 pounds!"
After the New Year, she had completely paid off her previous debts. At the same time, because she received many adult gifts, including gift money, Audrey had no problem paying for this alone.
Moreover, because of the role she played in the Backlund smog incident, Earl Hall personally promised that he could reimburse her for magical items or mystical transactions worth no more than 10,000 pounds.
So for Audrey after the New Year, her financial situation was not just a little good, but very good!
However, after experiencing the financial difficulties of the previous three consecutive months, Audrey decided to save the money in her hand.
In addition, she invited everyone to participate in the transaction, and others could also raise some questions that she might easily overlook.
Derrick, who also really wanted to know the answer, said: "I am willing to pay 7 main materials of Sequence 8. Emperor, is it okay to replace 1,500 pounds?"
He had obtained a lot of merits in this operation. In addition to his previous accumulation, he could completely exchange for a main material of the Sun High Priest, and then exchange for the materials to pay off the Emperor's debt, as well as the 7 main materials he promised this time.
Before Hobert could say anything, Alger immediately said: "I'll pay 500 pounds!"
Since he explored the island in the depths of the Berserk Sea with "Emperor" once, and had the main materials to advance to Sequence 6 left over, his financial situation had been very good.
Fors: "I'll also pay 500 pounds!"
She originally wanted to save money to buy a main material of the "Astrologer", but because she received a New Year's gift from someone, she no longer had to worry about the main material of the "Astrologer", because Teacher Dorian promised that as long as she found one of the main materials of the "Astrologer", Dorian would provide another one.
It's just that Fors hasn't completely digested the potion of the "Trickmaster" yet, and doesn't plan to tell Dorian that she has obtained the "Crystallized Blood of the Lavos Squid" yet.
There were only 500 pounds left, and everyone looked at "The World" together.
Klein, who originally wanted to freeload, helplessly manipulated "The World" and said: "Okay, I'll pay the last 500 pounds."
Klein had just advanced to Sequence 6, and had to leave Backlund, where he had a certain network of relationships. His financial situation was not very optimistic.
Originally, his financial situation would have been worse, but when he bought one of the main materials from Hobert, he got a discount on the base price. Also, because he and Hobert had done a very profitable task a long time ago, he had a deposit of 809 pounds after adding and subtracting.
Audrey looked at Hobert with a smile: "Emperor, 5,000 pounds are all collected!"
Hobert smiled. I haven't even started a group purchase yet, and you've helped with crowdfunding. As expected of a banker's daughter.
He asked Emlyn: "Mr. Moon, are you participating in this transaction?"
Emlyn's money was used to buy puppets, and he couldn't even take out 500 pounds now: "I, I'll consider it."
"Then please Mr. Fool to block Mr. Moon's sight and hearing, so we can start the transaction," Hobert said.
Klein nodded slightly, and after blocking Emlyn's sight and hearing, everyone looked at "Emperor".
Hobert said: "The other six 'Kings of Angels' are, 'Dark Angel' Sasrir, 'White Angel' Aucuses, 'Wind Angel' Leodero..."
Hearing this, Klein and Alger couldn't sit still anymore.
Hobert continued: "...'Wisdom Angel' Herabergen, 'Angel of Imagination' Adam, 'Red Angel' Medici."
"Except for the origin and current situation of 'Dark Angel' Sasrir, which is another question, most of the information of other Kings of Angels is included in this transaction. You can think about how to ask questions.
"But for fairness, Miss Magician, Mr. Hanged Man, and Mr. World can only ask one question."
Alger asked the first question: "Le, Le, Le..." He stuttered for a long time before taking a deep breath and calming his tense emotions: "Leodero, is the current Lord of Storms?"
That was the true name of the Storm Church's True God. When Alger read this name in the Book of Storms, he didn't feel anything, but when he was about to say it, Alger realized how difficult it was.
"That's right," Hobert said, "Not only is Leodero the current Lord of Storms, Aucuses is the current Eternal Blazing Sun, and Herabergen is the current God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
"Their path to godhood is another question. Today we will only talk about their information as Kings of Angels or before that."
Alger felt so nervous about attending the Tarot Gathering for the first time: "Re, really, is that so!"
After participating in the Tarot Gathering and learning about the relevant information, he already knew in advance that the Lord of Storms was also an Beyonder before becoming a god. But after really coming into contact with this knowledge, he realized how serious a blasphemy it was to hear this knowledge itself.
Klein leaned back in his chair behind the gray fog: "Emperor" really didn't disappoint. The information worth 5,000 pounds involved three True Gods in one go, and the remaining five Kings of Angels were definitely not easy to deal with either. In addition to angels like Amon, this was the second time he had heard "Emperor" mention Medici. Only he and "Dark Angel" were relatively unfamiliar. If he had the chance, he would ask about the relevant information of this "Red Angel".
Audrey was a little excited: This is the information worth 5,000 pounds! As expected, it's different from the 2,000 level!
Fors: Oh my god, I only spent 500 pounds and heard the origins of three True Gods!
Derrick felt an indescribable sadness: The "Omnipotent and Omniscient God" had so many powerful angels around Him, but He still fell. Did He encounter a more powerful enemy? But why haven't I heard of the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God" having opponents after regaining His authority?
Audrey followed up with this topic and asked: "Emperor, can you talk about the origins of these three Kings of Angels who later became gods!"
Hobert said: "There are not many records left of the 'Wind Angel' and the 'White Angel' before they belonged to the 'Ancient Sun God'. Angels in that era were not as scarce as they are today, and angel-level battles often occurred. They should be two who emerged from these battles.
"Herabergen is also called the 'Dragon of Wisdom'. In the Second Epoch, He was a subsidiary god of 'Dragon of Imagination' Ankewelt. After the 'Ancient Sun God' woke up, he betrayed the 'Dragon of Imagination' and turned to the 'Ancient Sun God', becoming the 'Wisdom Angel'."
Klein took a deep breath: After the "Ancient Sun God" woke up? Hmm, this question should not be included in this question.
Fors opened her eyes wide: In other words, the main body of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom is a giant dragon! This is incredible.
Derrick: This is an angel from the enemy camp of the former 'Giant King's Court'!
Audrey asked in surprise: "Can a subsidiary god betray his main god?"
Hobert explained casually: "Yes, because the subsidiary gods at that time had great autonomy."
At this time, Derrick asked: "Emperor, can you explain the origin of the 'Angel of Time '? Is He really a descendant of the Ancient Sun God?"
"Yes," Hobert said, "Both the 'Angel of Time ' and the 'Angel of Imagination ' are descendants of the Ancient Sun God. To avoid you from encountering danger, after this question is answered, I will sacrifice a magical item of the 'Audience' pathway to the Fool to help you hypnotize yourselves so that you will forget the relevant information after leaving the Tarot Gathering."
Everyone nodded, looking at the "Emperor" with anticipation: Finally, they were going to know some information about Amon. As expected, the power of 5,000 pounds was infinite. Before this, "Emperor" wanted Miss Justice to become a "Psychiatrist" before discussing such issues.
Hobert first asked everyone a question: "If you take too many potions, causing too many Beyonder characteristics in your body, what should you do?"
Audrey and Fors frowned together. This seemed to be a difficult problem indeed.
Alger, who had recovered from the previous "Leodero" question, replied: "The best way is to have children and pass the excess Beyonder characteristics to the children.
"Some children are born as half of Sequence 9, that's how it happens."
Fors immediately thought: Xio is in this situation!
Then she was a little surprised: It can be operated like this! Fortunately, I don't have extra Beyonder characteristics in my body.
Thinking about it, she blushed a little.
Alger added: "I heard that high-Sequence Beyonder also excrete excess Beyonder characteristics through having children. Some children are born as Sequence 5!"
"That's right," Hobert nodded with a smile: "Then what method should a god use to excrete excess Beyonder characteristics in the body?"
Everyone was slightly stunned, almost simultaneously realizing the answer: "Also to give birth to children?"
Immediately, they understood that this was the origin of Adam and Amon!

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 445: Hobert makes a lot of money at the Tarot Club (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to zak moe foe becoming a free member, +1]
[T/N: gone back and fixed as much as I could.]
Hobert further explained, "Adam and Amon were born with the Uniqueness of the 'Visionary' and 'Marauder' pathways, respectively. It can be said that they were Kings of Angels from birth."
The other members felt a sense of understanding, followed by envy.
Who wouldn't be envious? Being only one step away from a True God from birth.
Alger sighed, "My lifelong efforts might not even reach some people's starting point."
Klein also sighed, "Indeed, the 'starting line' difference is even greater in the Beyonder world!"
Derrick then asked, "What is their current situation?"
"They both served the Solomon Empire and the Tudor Empire during the Fourth Epoch," Hobert said after some consideration.
"Amon's main body should be in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods,' while Adam has formed the 'Twilight Hermit Order.'"
Hobert did not reveal the information about the awakening of the Ancient Sun God's divinity in Adam, as this intelligence was too valuable, far exceeding the scope of 5,000 pounds.
Behind the gray fog, Klein's eyes narrowed. He had just learned from Roselle's diary that the mysterious organization Roselle had previously participated in was the "Twilight Hermit Order." During a gathering, Roselle even encountered an old man suspected to be Hermes.
However, Klein did not immediately inquire about information regarding the "Twilight Hermit Order." He planned to ask "The Emperor" separately later.
Just as everyone was digesting the knowledge they had just gained, "The World" said to "The Emperor" in a hoarse voice, "Please describe the relevant information about the 'Red Angel' Medici."
Hobert smiled and said, "He joined the 'Rose Redemption' at the end of the Third Epoch and fell in Backlund during the Fourth Epoch."
Fors and the others were stunned. They had been listening to a high-level extraordinary history of the Third Epoch, and the sudden appearance of the name Backlund felt a bit strange.
Audrey asked curiously, "Mr. Emperor, how did he fall?"
Hobert replied, "This is a secret history of the Fourth Epoch, involving one of the 'Four Emperors,' which is another question."
Behind the gray fog, Klein had some guesses: I remember when "The Emperor" helped organize the relevant information about the various angel families, it was mentioned that the Medici family once served the Solomon Empire. At that time, I guessed that it might be because the family's angel had fallen early, which is why the current Medici family is unknown. Now, listening to "The Emperor," there seems to be a secret involved in the Fourth Epoch.
The other members also had their own guesses, but they couldn't find the key point.
Finally, Audrey and the others turned their attention to Fors. At this time, Fors remembered that she still had one question left.
However, she felt that just listening was already very worthwhile.
But since everyone was looking at her, Fors cleared her throat and asked, "Mr. Emperor, please describe the information about the 'Dark Angel' Sasrir that can be disclosed in this transaction!"
Of the other seven Kings of Angels, "Angel of Fate " Ouroboros had been discussed in detail at the last gathering, and the other six Kings of Angels had also been described successively. Now, only the "Dark Angel" was left without relevant descriptions.
"I can only tell you that He was the King of Angels of the 'Secrets Supplicant' pathway at that time," Hobert said with a smile!
Alger couldn't help but shift his sitting position: I remember that the 'True Creator' is the True God of the 'Secrets Supplicant' pathway!
Klein immediately had a similar guess: Could the "Dark Angel" be the current "True Creator"? Hiss, I have never heard of the 'True Creator's' real name until now, and I dare not confirm such a guess.
Derrick simply asked, "Mr. Emperor, can there be a True God in a pathway that already has an King of Angels?"
"In terms of the concept of strength level, it is not possible," Hobert said with a smile. "I know what you want to ask. I can only tell you that the situation of the 'Dark Angel' is quite special. As of now, the True God and King of Angels of the 'Secrets Supplicant' pathway have not appeared simultaneously. Well, the King of Angels here represents a conceptual level."
Although the Sequence 1 characteristic of the "Secrets Supplicant" is now with the "True Creator," Sasrir is still sleeping on the second Blasphemy Slate formed by the remains and will of the "Ancient Sun God."
The sleeping Sasrir certainly does not have the level of an King of Angels at this time, but it still makes it difficult for Hobert to give a definition. Are the True God and King of Angels of this pathway "in the same frame"?
In addition, this is about the fall of the "Ancient Sun God," which is far beyond the scope of 5,000 pounds, so Hobert did not intend to say too much in detail.
After hearing Hobert's words, the others successively denied their guesses. They finally knew why "The Emperor" had stated from the beginning that the "Dark Angel" was another question. It turned out that He was related to the more active evil gods, and He had many secrets.
With the end of the transaction, Hobert, with the consent of "The Fool," first returned to the real world, sacrificed the "Psychological Spoon" to "The Fool," and hypnotized several other members to forget the relevant information about Amon and Adam after leaving this gray fog.
After this transaction ended, it was time for the "free trade" session.
Audrey asked, "Everyone, has anyone helped me find the fruit of the Elder Tree?"
The other members were silent. Fors had asked her teacher, and Dorian did not have the fruit of the Elder Tree.
"Little Sun" knew where there were Mirror Dragons, but because he had entered a "loop" before, his return was delayed, so the Magician Miss completed this transaction in advance.
Alger and Klein had also paid attention to some extraordinary gatherings, but they had not obtained relevant information.
Hobert simply did not pay attention to this matter.
At this time, Emlyn suddenly said, "I remember that a Sanguine Marquis has the fruit of the Elder Tree, but the Sequence 7 main material will definitely have a premium, which may require more than 800 pounds.
"And because I bear a certain risk, I also have to charge a certain intermediary fee, the total value should be around 900 pounds!"
Sanguine?
Alger immediately captured the key point in these words: Is the new member a vampire?
Audrey said happily, "No problem, can we complete the transaction this week?"
After the Backlund smog event, Audrey urgently hoped to improve her strength to protect her parents and family.
Fors on the side was a little ashamed, because just last week she sold the "Mirror Dragon's Eyes" to Miss Justice for 1,000 pounds.
However, Audrey did not care about this. In her opinion, it was normal for two Sequence 7-level main materials to have a premium of about 2,000 pounds.
Emlyn replied, "I think it should be possible."
Audrey couldn't hide her joy, which meant that she was expected to become a "Psychiatrist" this week!
Through her usual acting, the "Telepathist" potion had been basically digested. With the main material, she could try to advance as long as she was in good condition.
After completing a transaction, Emlyn regained his confidence. He asked eagerly, "Everyone, who knows how the Sanguine can improve their strength, I mean, without relying on gifts from their elders."
As soon as he finished speaking, he felt a series of gazes looking over.
Now all the members noticed Emlyn's description of the "Sanguine."
Audrey's eyes lit up as she re-examined Mr. Moon: Sanguine? A vampire from legends?
As a novelist, Fors undoubtedly had various beautiful or bizarre imaginations about the Sanguine, and her eyes were also shining brightly.
Derrick thought of the vampire hidden in the depths of the darkness, covered in pus, and moving like the wind.
Klein and Hobert had the urge to shake their heads and laugh: Just like "Little Sun" when he first joined the association, he was not cautious!
Emlyn, who was being watched by a series of gazes, was a little at a loss, vaguely understanding that he seemed to have asked something he shouldn't have: What are you looking at me for? Am I not allowed to have a Sanguine friend? Should I explain a few words?
But then he thought: What about the Sanguine? I am a Sanguine, there is nothing wrong with admitting it! Our Sanguine has a long history, a long life, and a wealth of accumulation. We are a noble race!
Thinking of this, Emlyn raised his chin and proudly added, "Yes, I am a pure Sanguine!"
Hobert couldn't help but smile: What's there to be proud of? Mr. Servant of the Harvest Church?
Audrey also pursed her lips and smiled: No one asked if you were! Mr. Moon is a little guilty, so he made an overreaction!
Hobert said, "Vampires can also…"
"It's Sanguine!" Emlyn corrected.
Hobert deliberately said, "Okay, Mr. Vampire…"
"Blood…" Emlyn took a deep breath: "Forget it, you say it."
"If a vampire wants to improve his strength, in addition to inheriting the legacy of his elders, he can also take potions like humans to advance," Hobert said.
Emlyn immediately denied this method: "But the main materials of those potions are my own race!"
Alger smiled and said, "If a Sanguine Baron dies in a sudden conflict and has no time to find an heir, and you accept this legacy in the form of a potion, this is to prevent the loss of the Sanguine's power! It is beneficial to the entire Sanguine!"
A pirate that Alger knew had the characteristic of a "Sanguine Baron," but he had not been able to sell it, so he tried to sell it to Emlyn.
Hobert also followed up and said, "Or the characteristic left by the believers of the 'Primordial Moon.' Those believers should be your mortal enemies, right?"
Emlyn admitted, "That's right, we often hunt the believers of the 'Primordial Moon.'"
"Don't the Sanguine use their characteristic to improve themselves?" Hobert simply said, "As far as I know, vampires can take the characteristic of the 'Apothecary' pathway.
"I happen to have Sequence 6 'Potion Professor,' which you call the 'Sanguine Baron,' that I seized from the believers of the 'Primordial Moon.'
"If you need it, I'll sell it to you for 3,500 pounds!"
Alger did not continue to participate in this transaction. He understood that "The Emperor" was obviously selling the spoils of the previous battle, and the characteristic of "Sanguine Baron" in his hand still needed to contact that pirate, and he had no pricing power.
"3,500?" Emlyn knew that for Sequence 6 characteristic, this was considered the base price.
But if he had such a large sum of money, he would have moved several dolls he had been eyeing for a long time home, and he could also equip all the dolls with several new sets of clothes!
Emlyn's first reaction was to give up the transaction, but then he thought of the ancestor's favor, the glory of the Sanguine, and was a little embarrassed.
This time, Hobert simply "interrupted" and said, "You can go back and consider it first."
"Okay!" Emlyn breathed a sigh of relief!
Hobert added, "In addition, I have a batch of characteristics that I want to sell to the Sanguine. I don't know if you would be willing to contact the higher-ups of your Sanguine for me?"
Emlyn casually asked, "How many are there, and what are their Sequences?"
"7 copies of 'Vampire' characteristics," Hobert introduced, "3 copies of 'Potion Professor,' which is 'Sanguine Baron' characteristic, and 1 copy of 'Scarlet Scholar,' which is 'Sanguine Viscount' characteristic!"
Hobert still had use for the characteristics below Vampire, and the Sanguine did not need it.
Emlyn was a little surprised: "So many!"
Klein and Alger were not surprised. They both knew that "The Emperor" was helping the blessed of the "Creator" to deal with the spoils.
Audrey and Fors did not know that the "Rose School" also had believers of the "Primordial Moon," so they were secretly sighing at "The Emperor's" wealth.
However, they also guessed that this should be jointly owned by many blessed of the "Creator," and never thought that it belonged to Hobert alone.
After a brief surprise, Emlyn quickly calmed himself down: "How much do you plan to sell those characteristics for separately?"
Hobert pondered slightly and said, "Each 'Vampire' characteristic is 2,000 pounds, and each 'Sanguine Baron' characteristic is 4,500 pounds.
"If you want it, I can leave one for you, the price is still 3,500 pounds, this is the benefit of the Tarot Club members! If this transaction is successful, I can even sell it to you directly for 3,000 pounds!
"Finally, the 'Scarlet Scholar' characteristic is 10,000 pounds!"
This price was a little more expensive than selling it to the "Theosophy Order," after all, that was still half a political ally, and Hobert was not very familiar with the Sanguine now.
Klein had already quietly calculated a detailed account: 14,000 pounds plus 13,500 pounds plus 10,000 pounds! The total is 37,500 pounds! If this transaction is completed, it will be the highest transaction amount in the Tarot Club, and it is difficult to be surpassed.
Emlyn also simply calculated it, and while marveling at it was a huge sum of money, he smiled helplessly: "The higher-ups of the Sanguine don't know that I participated in the Tarot Club."
Hobert had already thought of a solution: "You can say that you met a blessed of the 'Creator' at a gathering, and he was selling the spoils.
"If the Sanguine doesn't want it, he plans to sell it to the 'School of Life.'"
Audrey asked curiously, "School of Life?"
Hobert simply explained, "There are also believers of the 'Primordial Moon' in the 'School of Life.' Relatively speaking, they are not as evil as the believers of the 'Primordial Moon' in the 'Rose School.'"
Audrey nodded.
Emlyn was still hesitant because even with a good reason, it would easily expose his new channels, and Earl Nibbs might very well associate it with him receiving the "Fool's" attention.
Hobert followed up, "The opportunity to strengthen the Sanguine and show your strength and channels to your fellow clansmen is right in front of you. Whether you can seize it depends on you."
As for whether he would be suspected by the Sanguine's higher-ups, Hobert wasn't worried about that because even without this transaction, the Sanguine's higher-ups would still have suspicions.
These words struck a chord with Emlyn: Wasn't the reason I was favored by the Ancestor because I always took the ideal of strengthening the Sanguine as my responsibility? As for showing my strength in front of my fellow clansmen, that's not important! Yes, not important!
Thinking of this, Emlyn said, "I will report this transaction to the Sanguine's higher-ups."
Hobert smiled and said, "I await your news."
The payment for the third batch of building materials was settled.
The other members of the Tarot Club haven't had any transaction projects recently.
Audrey is preparing to advance to Sequence 7. Besides, she is now a formal member of the Psychology Alchemists and has a source for potion formulas, so she doesn't have any needs in this regard.
Alger is still digesting the "Wind Blessed" potion, and he knows that he can buy the Beyonder characteristics of "Ocean Songster" from "Emperor," so he doesn't need to consider advancing for the time being.
Derrick and Fors are both still digesting their respective Sequence 8 potions, and they both have Sequence 7 potion formulas, and the main materials are also settled, so they don't need to trade at the Tarot Club.
So the "free trade" session has almost become "Emperor's" special.
Seeing that no one else initiated a transaction, he said again, "Does anyone have a connection to the 'Rose School' Temperance faction?"
Everyone was stunned, guessing whether "Emperor" was looking for allies for the "Creator's" forces in the Southern Continent.
"World" said in a hoarse voice, "I can contact the Temperance faction. I happen to have a question to ask you. We can exchange information."
Klein believed that if Hobert was looking for allies, it would be a good opportunity for Sharon and Maric, after all, the "Creator's" power in the Southern Continent seemed to be very strong.
Hobert was waiting for "World" to talk, he smiled and said, "What information do you want to know?"
"Everything about the 'Twilight Hermit Order'!"
Hobert pondered for a moment: "This is not information of the same level. The 'Rose School' contact information I need is only worth 200 pounds, I'll give you an extra 100 pounds, let's say 300 pounds.
"But the information about the 'Twilight Hermits' is worth at least 1800 pounds! If you need to trade, you need to pay me another 1500 pounds."
"World" smiled helplessly, just about to say that he wouldn't trade for now, Audrey suddenly said, "Mr. Emperor, can I contribute 600 pounds to join the transaction? Is anyone willing to join?"
Hobert nodded and smiled, "Of course."
Klein was also hoping for another crowdfunding or group buying, so that he could know the information about the "Twilight Hermit Order" for a small amount of money.
Although Alger, Fors, and Derrick were also very curious about the information, they had already spent money once today, and trading again would be an unplanned expense for them.
And they didn't want to know the answer as much as Audrey did, so they didn't plan to trade.
Emlyn was a little confused again: What "Twilight Hermit Order"? Is this a mysterious organization? How come I haven't heard of it?
Seeing that everyone had no intention of trading, Audrey simply said, "Then why don't Mr. World and I each pay 900 pounds, and the two of us will conduct the transaction."
"World" sighed, "Sorry, I'm still not participating in this transaction."
Although Audrey couldn't quite see "World's" psychological activities, she could also feel "World's" embarrassment.
So Audrey smiled and said, "Mr. World, your reminder during the Great Smog event deserves some substantial thanks.
"I am willing to pay 1500 pounds for this transaction, and you only need to pay 300 pounds.
"Mr. World, please don't decline, this is what you deserve."
Hobert thought: This is called high EQ, helping is not called helping, it's "deserved"!
Even the always stingy… no, the always frugal Klein was embarrassed to say, "I can pay 600 pounds, of which 300 pounds will be paid with the 'Rose School' Temperance faction's contact information."
Audrey did not refuse "World's" request because she knew that refusing a gentleman's payment was hurting that gentleman's self-esteem.
And that gentleman regretted a little after saying that he would pay 600 pounds: Dying for face! People have the family fortune of an Earl, do you?
After sighing deeply in his heart, Klein comforted himself again: Forget it, forget it, 9 pounds in cash is enough for me to buy a boat ticket.
Alger sighed in his heart: "Emperor" can directly get 5000 pounds in cash at this gathering, plus Beyonder materials worth no less than 1500 pounds, to be precise, worth 1700 pounds to 2000 pounds, and information worth 300 pounds. If he can facilitate a transaction with the Sanguine…
Alger smiled wryly: How good it would be if I had so much money.
However, the fact that the proceeds from the transaction with the Sanguine were not all for Hobert alone made him feel a lot more balanced.
Emlyn exclaimed: This Miss Justice is really rich! She has already spent 3200 pounds at this gathering, and has confirmed a transaction with me worth about 900 pounds. And she seems to be under no pressure!
After discussing the price, Hobert asked Mr. Fool to block the senses of the others.
Hobert said to Klein and Audrey, "I said just now that the president of the 'Twilight Hermit Order' is Adam, let me list two more members of this secret organization: Hermes and Roselle!"
Audrey looked surprised and said, "Roselle? Emperor Roselle?"
Klein was a little disappointed because he knew this information.
Hobert continued, "That's right! It's Emperor Roselle."
He looked at Audrey's surprised expression and said, "And the reason why this information is worth this price is because Adam's current situation is quite special."
He smiled and said, "Adam is preparing to advance to True God!"
The "Fool" behind the gray fog almost jumped up: Adam is also preparing to become a god?

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 446: Twilight Hermit Order
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After a brief silence, Hobert continued, "Over the long years, Adam, who inherently embodies the uniqueness of that pathway, has successively found and accommodated two Sequence 1 characteristics."
"Now, he only needs to obtain the final Sequence 1 characteristic and complete the corresponding ritual. Theoretically, he can then become a god."
Klein only recovered from his surprise at this moment, and he manipulated 'The World' to ask, "So, the last characteristic is...?"
Hobert smiled and said, "That's right, it's 0-08!"
Although 'The World' didn't show much emotion, Klein behind the gray fog suddenly felt an invisible force lingering around him.
From his arrival in this world to his experiences in Tingen City, and his recent experiences in Backlund, he felt as if an invisible hand was manipulating his destiny.
Now Klein wondered, could this invisible hand be Adam?
But immediately afterward, Klein denied his idea, because he really couldn't figure out what benefits Adam would gain from manipulating him?
This gray fog space? If Adam wanted to obtain it now, he should be able to do so easily, right? Why would he still manipulate me? To make me stronger?
Audrey on the opposite side also recovered from her surprise: "Mr. Emperor, have there been many Angel-level figures trying to become gods recently?"
"No." Hobert said, "Let's go back to the question of the 'Twilight Hermit Order' members. Doesn't the name Hermes sound familiar to you?"
Audrey then realized: "Hermes language! Is that a descendant of Hermes?"
Of course, she knew Hermes, who provided humans with the ability to communicate with natural forces. It was precisely because this was common knowledge that she hadn't thought of it.
Hobert smiled and said, "It's Hermes himself!"
He said, "I'll give you a piece of information. The Psychology Alchemists have a close connection with Hermes. It can even be said that some members found the relics left by Hermes, which laid the foundation for this organization."
While Audrey was surprised that Hermes had lived to this day, she nodded slightly and said, "Thank you for your gift."
She couldn't help but imagine: Could Hermes be the president of the Psychology Alchemists? Or was the establishment of the Psychology Alchemists due to some psychological suggestion left by Hermes in the relics?
Hobert smiled, indicating that it was nothing, and then he said, "As far as I know, George III is also a member of this organization."
This once again surprised Klein and Audrey. Klein immediately made a guess, and he manipulated 'The World' to say, "George III's actions to become a god are closely related to Adam."
"Yes." Hobert said, "According to reliable information I have obtained, the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristic that George III needs to become a god were all provided by Adam."
Klein asked with some surprise, "What is Adam's purpose?"
Hobert did not answer directly, but instead began to tell the story from another direction: "From a long time ago, Adam has been trying to revive the 'Ancient Sun God'.
"In recent centuries, the 'Twilight Hermit Order's' purpose has been to stir up a torrent of the times, and George III's process of becoming a god will be a catalyst for this torrent."
Klein roughly understood Hobert's meaning: "Adam supports George III in becoming a god in order to stir up a torrent of the times!
"And Adam's purpose in becoming a god is to revive the Ancient Sun God."
With 'The World's' explanation, Audrey understood Hobert's meaning. She felt that these purposes and processes of becoming a god seemed very far away from her, but now they seemed very close.
Hobert smiled and said, "You can understand it that way, but I want to explain that there is also a very secret piece of information in this, which is just a guess, but the possibility is very high.
"But I can't tell you now, or rather, that information is worth more than 1800 pounds."
Currently, the awakening of the 'Ancient Sun God's' divinity in Adam's body may not even be certain for Amon. If Hobert said this information very confidently, there would be a big problem.
Klein nodded. Such an answer was already beyond his expectations.
Audrey on the opposite side asked, "Mr. Emperor, why are you so knowledgeable about Adam's information?"
Klein also looked at Hobert, because he had a similar question. The information that Hobert knew about the 'Twilight Hermit Order' seemed to have surpassed Roselle.
Regarding this question, Hobert was prepared: "Just last week, Adam went to see 'The Creator'.
"Because of 'The Creator's' intervention in the Backlund smog incident, Adam was worried that 'The Creator' would affect the torrent of the times that he had worked so hard to create."
Klein and Audrey were both a little surprised. They didn't expect such a high-level meeting to have taken place last week!
Klein thought: So Hobert learned so much about the 'Twilight Hermit Order' through 'The Creator's' attention to George III's process of becoming a god.
Audrey asked curiously, "What is the torrent of the times that Adam wants to create, or is creating?"
Hobert said, "The Creator believes that the improvement of the steam engine has brought the world into a new era. The production capacity of various countries in the Northern Continent is gradually becoming surplus, and the gap between the rich and the poor in various countries is gradually increasing. These unprecedented problems have triggered a series of conflicts."
Klein was stunned. He seemed to have heard a description of the Second Industrial Revolution.
Audrey said with some worry, "Can't these problems be solved?"
Hobert smiled: "There is currently no solution in sight."
Specifically, the current policy strategies of the North and South Continents simply cannot solve such conflicts.
Only by transferring the contradiction of overcapacity can there be a possibility of resolving the conflict.
Either transfer it externally, or transfer it to the lower classes. External transfer will inevitably lead to war, and transfer to the lower classes will aggravate domestic conflicts.
So for the current rulers of the North and South Continents, it is a dilemma.
Klein asked again, "What role did George III play in this?"
Hobert smiled: "I can't answer you this question."
Klein was slightly stunned, but thinking of George III's abolition of the Corn Laws in recent years and the implementation of many new policies, it seemed to be exacerbating domestic and foreign conflicts: Hobert's deliberate concealment, could it be because it involved some key rituals?
Audrey keenly realized: "Mr. Emperor, will Adam's becoming a god have any impact on me, who is on the same pathway?"
"For now, you can only become Sequence 2 of that pathway at most." Hobert said, "You may have the opportunity to become Sequence 1 of that pathway in the future."
Audrey asked strangely, "Why are there these effects?"
Hobert smiled: "That's another question."
Klein used his rich mystical knowledge to guess: According to the Law of Conservation of Beyonder characteristics, when a pathway has a True God, there may be no Sequence 1. After all, to become a True God, you need three Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 1 of that pathway. But why does Miss Justice have the possibility of becoming Sequence 1 in the future? Could there be some law here that I don't know?
Hobert once again used the 'Psychological Spoon' to hypnotize Audrey and 'The World', so that they would forget the information about Adam after leaving the gray fog.
'The World' then said, "Go to the 'Bravehearts Bar', ask for a beer, tell the bartender that you are looking for Miss Sharon, introduced by Sherlock the detective. No matter what reply you get from the bartender, drink the beer and leave by taxi carriage. Miss Sharon of the Temperance faction will meet you in the carriage."
Hobert nodded. In fact, he knew this method, but he also knew that Klein would return to Backlund in the future and have contact with Miss Sharon again, so he had to spend 300 pounds to go through the motions.
The Audrey on the opposite side keenly captured the name "Sherlock the detective": Could this be the identity of Mr. "World" in the real world? So he is a detective. No wonder he has such a strong "counter-reconnaissance" ability. All along, it has been almost impossible for me to get any psychological information from him.
Klein had abandoned this identity, so he was not afraid of Miss Justice knowing.
After this transaction ended, it was time for the final information exchange.
Little Sun proposed to determine a gesture to pray to Mr. Fool, but the experienced Alger opposed it: "Compared with other secret organizations, the most significant characteristic and advantage of our Tarot Club is that the members do not know each other.
"To give an extreme example, even if one of our members is arrested and tortured, it will not affect the others.
"Once there is a complete set of 'codes' or iconic gestures, the betrayal of a traitor can allow hostile forces to use these methods to fish us out one by one."
This remark calmed everyone down and dispelled the idea of designing prayer gestures.
It's just that Audrey felt a little regretful. Not only Audrey, but Klein also felt a little regretful: I just thought of a special gesture!
Hobert thought to himself: This is the difference between a 'Seer' and a 'Lawyer'. The 'Seer' pathway develops its power in a habitually secret way, while the 'Lawyer' pathway cannot be hidden after reaching a certain level.
With the shelving of this proposal, Klein announced the end of this Tarot Club.
...
Backlund, South of the Bridge District.
Emlyn's vision returned to normal, and he saw the large and small dolls in the room.
Huff~
Emlyn breathed a sigh of relief, calmed down, and recalled his first Tarot Club: "Except for Mr. Fool, the strength of the other members will not be too strong. Are they all like me, chosen for some reason?
"I have the Ancestor behind me, who is behind them? What can be determined is that 'The Emperor' has 'The Creator' behind him!"
Emlyn thought of the transaction initiated by "The Emperor" at the gathering: "What information is worth 5,000 pounds? Why do the other members still look so convinced? They actually started collecting money immediately!"
He also thought of the Beyonder characteristic that "The Emperor" was selling to him: "3,000 to 3,500 pounds... the hope of becoming a Baron in a short time, it really makes me embarrassed!"
As for the transaction initiated by "The Emperor" to the Blood Clan, he decided to talk to Lord Nibbs about it at a gathering in two days to see if Lord Nibbs was interested.
Although Emlyn doesn't go out much, he occasionally attends some Blood Clan gatherings and knows some knowledge about Beyonder characteristics.
It is precisely because of this that he knows that although the price quoted by "The Emperor" has some premium, those premiums are within an acceptable range.
The key is that it is an Beyonder characteristic from a follower of the "Original Moon". I believe Lord Nibbs should not refuse such a transaction.
If he facilitates the transaction, he will be equivalent to getting a reward of 500 pounds.
But there are still 3,000 pounds!
Emlyn sighed in his heart, he was so worried about money for the first time.
Then he began to imagine: "The Emperor" will receive an income of more than 30,000 pounds after completing this transaction. Although he knows that it is not his alone, if he has so much money, he will be in the millionaire class in Backlund. If I have so much money...
Emlyn looked at the room full of dolls and showed a happy smile.
...
Above the gray fog, in the ancient palace.
Klein picked up the "Psychological Spoon" and hypnotized himself once.
The previous two times were "The Emperor" hypnotizing "The World". For Klein, who could not yet exchange with a Secret Puppet, such hypnosis had no effect on his main body at all.
Fortunately, Hobert had to return to the real world to perform the granting ritual in order to regain the "Psychological Spoon", which gave Klein room to operate.
Then everyone began to make sacrifices to "The Fool". These sacrifices were basically the income of "The Emperor".
Klein also thought of his wallet, which would only have a pitiful 9 pounds left. Of course, in addition to banknotes, he also had 5 gold coins, but he only had so much money on him.
When he first came to Backlund, his financial situation was better than it is now!
At present, he has to take it one step at a time and wait until he goes to sea. There are plenty of villains at sea, so if that doesn't work, he'll "borrow" a little from them.
Returning to the real world, Klein sacrificed the reward for Hobert to the gray fog, and then granted the "Psychological Spoon" along with those gold pounds to Hobert, who had performed the corresponding ritual.
Klein's plan was to rest in the hotel for one night and then embark on his journey to Pritz Harbor.
He sighed: Fortunately, the train ticket had already been bought in advance, otherwise it would be an expense that would make him feel heavy.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert first put away the "Psychological Spoon" on the altar, and then counted the gold pounds he had obtained.
The income from this gathering was exactly 5,000 pounds, including 3,200 pounds from Audrey's two transactions, 800 pounds from Klein's two transactions, and 500 pounds each from Fors and Alger.
In addition, there were 7 Beyonder Materials of Sequence 8 level from Little Sun.
In the final free exchange session, the two had already discussed that in the afternoon of two days later, that is, on Wednesday afternoon, "Little Sun" would pay Hobert a total of 17 Beyonder characteristics for the arrears plus this reward.
Then Hobert would give the "Provoker Warhammer" to "Little Sun" in the way of offering it to The Fool. After "Little Sun" exchanged the weapon for enough merit, he would exchange it for Hobert's asking price: 15 Beyonder Ingredients.
In other words, Hobert will receive 32 sets of mystical materials in the coming week.
He smiled slightly: A small profit.
