chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 447: Politics is all about smoothing things over
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After this period of accumulation, Hobert now has over ten thousand pounds.
He plans to use this money to buy locomotives and carriages, and because some modifications may be involved, the carriages need to be ordered in advance.
As usual, Hobert did not immediately put the cash into the "Nation of Disorder." He once again sketched out the blueprint of the territory in his mind, and as he thought, evening arrived.
Hobert came to the yard and stared blankly at Full Moon Lake in the sunset for a while.
Golden afterglows echoed on Full Moon Lake, adding a touch of tranquility to the lake surface. The people on the construction site began to go home, showing long-lost smiles at this moment.
Hobert felt an unprecedented sense of satisfaction: This is my territory!
...
Tuesday morning, Loen Kingdom, Tingen City Railway Station.
On the platform, Serena wiped her tears and said, "Melissa, remember to write to me."
Melissa felt inexplicably sad when she saw her friend in tears. She wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes: "We are only separated temporarily. Maybe you will come to Backlund to work or study in the future."
No, I might go to Feynapotter. I am already learning Highlander by myself, Serena thought.
Woo~
The departure time arrived, and they said their final goodbyes. Serena watched the train gradually move away from the station and begin to accelerate, eventually disappearing from view.
Chris Wood, with red hair and gold-rimmed glasses, came over to comfort his sister: "Separation is only for reunion. Tingen City is not far from Backlund. If you miss each other, you can visit each other by train."
Serena said with tears in her eyes: "But, but, only I am left in Tingen City."
Chris patted his sister's shoulder: "People will always experience a stage of loneliness."
Serena wiped away the last bit of tears and smiled: "Chris, you are like a philosopher today."
Chris also laughed: "Everyone says I have the temperament of a philosopher. Okay, we should prepare to leave too."
Over there, Mr. and Mrs. Wood, and Chris's fiancée, Vina, waved to Serena.
Serena took a deep breath, trying to shift her emotions to the New Year's vacation mood.
The train to Boklun Manor departed half an hour later. The always lively Serena stared blankly at the scenery speeding backwards outside the window, as if it was her 18-year-old self that would never return.
The sociable Mr. Wood and Chris had already mingled with the surrounding passengers. They talked about the world situation, the Loen Kingdom's newly built steel behemoth, and the mortal enemy Feysac Empire across Midseashire.
Serena noticed that the train had entered the mountains and would pass through a tunnel in a few minutes. She asked her father: "Dad, are we almost there?"
Mr. Wood looked at his pocket watch: "Honey, there are still a dozen minutes."
A passenger in the front left asked: "If you get off at the station ahead, are you planning to go to Boklun Manor for vacation?"
Mr. Wood smiled: "Yes, I heard the hot springs there are very good."
"That's right, and you can go hunting!" The passenger laughed: "I heard there are wild boars and sika deer, but you can only hunt one or two rabbits at most each time."
Wood laughed: "Hunting is for young people..."
Suddenly, a passenger with a low hat brim behind him said: "Don't go to Boklun Manor. There has been something bad there recently. If you go there, you will all turn into monsters!"
The Wood family looked at the passenger in surprise. Serena also turned her head to look at him. The passenger's coat collar was high, and the hat brim covered his entire face.
Although she couldn't see the other person's appearance, Serena could feel the madness and distortion emanating from him. This feeling made Serena feel uncomfortable all over.
Serena also noticed that he seemed to only have a left hand and no right hand.
Chris Wood asked with a smile: "Sir, what has appeared there? Why would we turn into monsters!"
The passenger said: "In short, don't go."
Woo~
The train's whistle woke Serena from her dream. She saw that her parents, brother, and sister-in-law all looked blank, as if they had just woken up from a dream as well.
Serena immediately looked behind her, and the other family members also looked there.
That seat was empty.
Chris Wood laughed: "You, you wouldn't be having a dream where a passenger advised us not to go to Boklun Manor, right?"
The other family members all looked at Chris with some surprise in their eyes.
Chris's smile gradually disappeared, and the family was silent for a few seconds.
Serena swallowed: "Or, or, why don't we go? It's rare to have a vacation, it's good to stay at home too."
Mr. Wood took out the Boklun Manor tickets and smiled helplessly: "I've already bought the tickets."
These were discounted tickets obtained through a relationship with a bank client, and even the discounted tickets cost a lot of money.
Mrs. Wood said: "We can't change our itinerary because of a strange dream. We, we'll go to the manor and take a look first. If something is wrong, we'll go home immediately!"
Serena was also persuaded, because she also really wanted to soak in the hot springs and see the snow scenery.
A dozen minutes later, the train arrived at the station, and the Wood family took a carriage directly to Boklun Manor.
Everywhere here there are gurgling springs. The temperature of the springs that just come out can reach a dozen degrees. In winter, they make the entire valley misty, adding a bit of dreamlike color.
The ice waterfalls and rime along the way made the family couldn't help but point and praise. The train episode was thrown to the back of everyone's minds.
After taking a carriage for more than half an hour, the family arrived at Boklun Manor.
There are many hot springs here, and the resulting mist seems to wrap the entire manor.
Entering the manor's reception hall, everything here seemed normal. Many guests were in the hall smoking and chatting, and the manager warmly greeted them: "Hello, welcome to Boklun Manor!"
Serena felt that this manager was a bit strange, or rather, his expression was a bit strange, a bit stiff? Or a bit contrived?
Neither.
After pondering for a long time, Serena realized that it was like the expression of a puppet in a puppet show, a little exaggerated, a little unnatural.
The manager seemed to notice Serena and gave her a puppet-like smile.
Serena was about to tug on her father's clothes when a bearded man came in from outside. He held a hunting fork and wore clothes made of simply processed animal skins. He looked furry all over: "Is there any gentleman who wants to go hunting? If you're lucky, you can hunt sika deer or wild boar."
Chris said with great interest: "Father, I want to go take a look."
"Go ahead, son." Mr. Wood smiled: "Enjoy the New Year's holiday, and I will settle the three beautiful ladies."
Watching Chris leave, Serena realized that she had forgotten what she was worried about just now.
She opened her mouth, as if she had forgotten something very important, but she couldn't remember what it was even after racking her brains.
"Let's go, Serena." Mrs. Wood smiled: "I can't wait to enjoy the hot springs."
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Baron Hobert finally received Bishop Dick, but what made Bishop Dick a little dissatisfied again was that Hobert sat at the head, while they, the clergy, could only stand, as if they were reporting their work.
Hobert certainly saw the dissatisfaction of Dick and others. He smiled and said: "Everyone, I am a baron conferred by the king, not by the Earth Mother Church, so there is no superior-subordinate relationship between us.
"Because I am a devout believer of the Mother Goddess and a friend of Bishop Simpson, I am polite enough to greet you.
"But that's all. What else are you expecting? Do you expect me to humbly report the situation of Jeffery Territory to you?"
These words left Dick and others speechless.
Hobert added: "I can send a ship to take you to the center of Full Moon Lake to see if there is indeed no corruption. I believe you have monitoring methods.
"Okay, Allen, help me send these distinguished guests away."
Dick and others realized after leaving the main hall that they had almost been kicked out. Was this Jeffery Territory's custom of treating distinguished guests?
Some of them came to Full Moon Lake in anger, boarded the wooden boat provided by Hobert, and indeed did not detect any corruption in the center of Full Moon Lake.
After getting this result, they boarded the boat and left immediately, acting as if they didn't want to stay here for even a minute.
Hobert watched their boat leave from the Lord's Mansion, and even Philip asked with some worry: "Lord, will we offend these bishops and priests because of this?"
Hobert laughed: "I want to let the people of the Earth Mother Church see my attitude: Although I hope the church will send people here, it's not that I invited you here. It's that you came running over after I solved the problem."
The Earth Mother Church will never not send people because of the attitude towards the delegation. On the contrary, they will re-examine how to deal with the relationship with the local nobles.
Hobert did not dwell on this issue too much. Today, he was still busy taking soldiers to the Shipyard Island for "training" to see if there were any pirates to fight.
At the same time, he let the lumberjacks and craftsmen take a look at the wood there. Hobert planned to build a lumberyard on the island, because the construction of the territory required a lot of wood, and if he could build his own lumberyard, he could save a lot of money.
In Jeffery Territory, he only needed to build a kiln to dry the wood.
Because Hobert and the "Jeffery Army" appeared too strangely last time, those small pirate groups did not dare to come again. The 'Black Whale' and 'Skull' pirate groups, because they knew that the strength gap with Hobert was too great, chose to leave cautiously.
So now there are only some small pirate groups on Shipyard Island that are not well-informed or willing to take risks. Hobert led people to charge and kill them, but unfortunately, he did not catch any pirates with bounties. The spoils were far less than last time, but he did seize more fish than last time.
In the evening, Hobert held another banquet in the yard, eating grilled fish and stewed fish with everyone, and rewarded them as he did last time.
After deducting the spoils distributed to everyone and the bounties distributed to everyone, this time's spoils were only about two hundred pounds left, as well as some living supplies.
Those things that could only be used at sea, such as fresh water, vegetables, sextants, etc., were simply not transported back.
This time's biggest gain may be that several lumberjacks found a more suitable lumberyard, and the craftsmen also believed that the wood for the construction of the territory could be completely provided by Shipyard Island.
Subtracting the money saved from the cost of drying the wood and the wages generated by logging, Hobert calculated that he could save as much as 30,000 gold lire.
Even more money could be saved by using a large amount of wood for later decoration and furniture making. This money did not belong to the "construction funds", so it was not easy to calculate at present.
For Hobert, the money saved was equal to the money earned.
While the atmosphere in the yard was cheerful, a guest came to the entrance of the Lord's Mansion.
It was a middle-aged man, wearing a bishop's robe, looking very easy-going.
Hobert saw him at a glance: "Bishop Simpson, I didn't expect you to come so quickly. Come, come, try these sea fish. It's hard to eat such fresh sea fish in Feynapotter."
Bishop Simpson smiled and sat next to Hobert, readily taking the grilled fish and wine glass handed to him: "I asked Dick to 'report' to me as soon as he had accurate information.
"Then, with the help of the Archbishop, I arrived at your territory as quickly as possible.
"I have been to Full Moon Lake and confirmed the information you said in the letter."
Because there were still many ordinary people present, Bishop Simpson did not say it too clearly.
Sure enough, Simpson did not mention the cold reception Dick and the others received.
Hobert took a sip of wine and smiled: "I welcome the bishop of the Earth Mother Church to preach on this territory again.
"But you also see that I want to build this place into a resort area, and I also want to try to implement some new policies, which may delay your preaching."
The implication was: I have a lot of things to do, don't affect me.
Bishop Simpson smiled: "The Archbishop has instructed me to maintain a good cooperative relationship with you after I come to Jeffery Territory."
The implication was: We have enough sincerity to cooperate.
Hobert smiled slightly and said to Allen and Dennis: "Prepare a small stove in the side hall, bring a pot of fish separately, and prepare a small grill, and take a few skewers of grilled fish."
The two immediately went to work.
Hobert also said to Seel: "Let everyone drink to their heart's content tonight. If there is no wine, move it from the warehouse. I have something to talk to Bishop Simpson about."
Seeing that the lord was about to leave, everyone stood up almost at the same time to see the lord off.
Hobert waved to everyone. After entering the side hall, the yard became lively again.
Simpson saw all this in his eyes. He thought to himself: In less than two months, Hobert has completely gained a foothold in an unfamiliar territory and has cultivated a group of soldiers who are very loyal to him.
He took his wine glass and grilled skewers, and followed Hobert closely: Utravsky's evaluation of him was correct. This is a person with profound thoughts, a person whose ability is far greater than his current status. Even if Hobert was given a country, he could quickly establish rule. Before that, he just lacked a platform, an opportunity.
Arriving at the side hall, the fish stew pot was bubbling and boiling once more.
There was also a small dining table, with chopsticks, bowls, and dishes on one side, Hobert's usual tableware, and knives, forks, and plates on the other.
The fish grilling oven would take a little longer.
After Hobert and Simpson took their seats, Simpson smiled and said, "I heard from Utravsky that you were baptized in his church?"
"Yes," Hobert replied with a smile, "Utravsky and I are good friends."
He could sense that Bishop Simpson was trying to use the authority of the Earth Mother Church to regain the initiative in the conversation.
But Hobert didn't give Simpson the chance. He said, "Last night, I raided the demonic forces in Baron Teuton's territory and obtained accurate information: the Blood Sanctify Sect has a demigod and five Sequence 5s in South Colson!
"I plan to give you the Beyonder characteristics of that demigod and the credit for annihilating those demons. I think, with one of the Sequence 4 main materials, you should be able to get a chance to advance to demigod from the church, right?"
Simpson was stunned for a good two or three seconds: "You, you are confident in killing their demigod? As far as I know, demons have the ability to foresee danger, making them difficult to kill!"
"Of course, I'm confident," Hobert said, taking a light sip of wine, "But the prerequisite is that you agree to my plan for constructing official Beyonder forces in Jeffery's territory."
"Tell me."
"My family is very supportive of my development in Jeffery's territory, so they sent me a Sequence 6 and some helpers," Hobert said, "And before that, I had already contacted the Theosophy Order, and they basically agreed to my demon eradication plan and will send a Sequence 6 and several helpers..."
Simpson frowned and said, "Cooperating with the Theosophy Order will get you killed!"
"Hear me out," Hobert said with a smile, "South Colson is full of evil Beyonder forces. If we rely only on you and me, we will have to pay a huge price to complete the cleanup.
"We can completely use the Theosophy Order to consume the power of the Blood Sanctify Sect and the Aurora Order!"
Simpson also took a sip of wine: "They're not that stupid, are they? To be used by you like that?"
"Of course, they're not stupid," Hobert said with a smile, "I promised them that as long as this battle is over, I can keep a legitimate official Beyonder team for them.
"Of course, the price they have to pay is: to send out a demigod to help kill the Blood Sanctify Sect's demigod, and the Beyonder characteristics of that Sequence 4 'Demon' will be given to you as your credit."
The Theosophy Order certainly did not make such a promise, but Hobert was confident that he could make them fulfill such a promise. If it really didn't work, he would let the 'Bull Devil Monarch' take action.
However, Hobert didn't really want the 'Bull Devil Monarch' to appear in South Colson, as it would easily lead some people to associate him with the 'Creator'.
Bishop Simpson was tempted, of course he was tempted. That was an opportunity to become a demigod!
Taking this step meant a qualitative change in oneself, becoming a legendary half-human, half-god.
Bishop Simpson originally thought he would never have a chance in his life. Who would have thought that an opportunity would come so suddenly! When Bishop Gabriel talked to him about this issue before, he still felt that it was just drawing a pie in the sky. He didn't expect that this in-depth conversation with Hobert would already have a concrete plan!
Hobert continued from the side: "Without the help of the Theosophy Order, we two Sequence 5s simply can't kill the other side's demigod, and we don't have much chance of winning against this group of demons.
"I don't know the church's promotion standards, but according to my idea, killing ten Sequence 5s may not necessarily be as meritorious as killing one demigod, right?"
Hobert's guess was very much in line with the actual situation. Bishop Simpson pondered for a moment before saying, "I must report this matter to the Archbishop, but he may not agree."
This was basically an agreement, but there were still some concerns.
Hobert smiled and said, "Anyway, the church can't send enough power to wipe out the evil Beyonder forces here for the time being. You can just say that you are cooperating with some 'folk Beyonder organizations' to deal with the Blood Sanctify Sect and the Aurora Order.
"There's no need for the Archbishop to agree, just let him default."
Hobert would not say things like "Since the Archbishop asked you to cooperate with me, this is my plan," as it would be equivalent to giving Bishop Simpson an excuse to pin the blame on him in the future.
Simpson didn't hear the promise he wanted, so he said with some concern, "What if, after we cooperate, the Theosophy Order recklessly creates tragedies in South Colson?"
"If such a tragedy occurs in my territory," Hobert said coldly, "I will make the Theosophy Order pay the price."
Hobert dared to make a promise on this point. Not only did he make a promise, but if such a thing happened, he would really do it.
Bishop Simpson thought for a long time before smiling and saying, "I will report to the Archbishop."
But it did not include the deal with the Blood Sanctify Sect's demigod.
Hobert raised his glass, and the two clinked glasses: "Happy cooperation!"
Hobert's plan was that as long as Bishop Simpson became a demigod with his help, then the two would be an inseparable community of interests. When the time came to talk about the Theosophy Order, the positions of both parties would be different.
Dennis, who was on the side, didn't quite understand what the two were planning, but he had already given Hobert an evaluation in his heart: a sinister baron.
After seeing Simpson off, Hobert asked Dennis to fetch him foot-washing water.
After the foot-washing water was brought, Hobert asked, "Do you know why I asked you to do this?"
Of course, it was to humiliate me! But the words came to his lips, and Dennis still didn't dare to say them.
Hobert looked at the angry expression on Dennis's face: "When you figure out this question, you won't have to fetch me foot-washing water."
Dennis was slightly stunned, then smiled: "I will figure out this question tomorrow!"
Hobert smiled, guessing that this kid wouldn't be able to sleep tonight.
...
Loen Kingdom, East Chester County, Boklun Manor.
Selena looked at the guests in the hall smoking cigarettes or cigars and chatting, and the fog rolling outside in the wind.
Something seemed a little wrong!
"Beautiful lady, welcome to Boklun Manor."
Selena saw the hall manager with an exaggerated and unnatural smile: "You... you..."
"Hehehehehe~"
A sinister laughter echoed around.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 448 She is corrupted
chapters.content:

The eerie laughter around her made Selena's hair stand on end. She looked around with some bewilderment, unable to find her parents and sister-in-law. She only saw people around her, all looking at her with exaggerated, unnatural smiles.
Selena felt a chill run down her spine and stumbled away from the reception hall.
Everyone in the hall watched Selena leave as if watching a play, with unnatural smiles on their faces.
As soon as Selena stepped outside, she realized it was already night.
Suddenly, the reception hall went pitch black, and the entire valley was devoid of any light.
All the buildings seemed to turn into monsters, as if they were about to rush over and devour Selena at any moment.
The warmth from the key ring gave Selena courage. She called out to her father and mother, trying to stay away from the buildings.
Just then, Selena finally saw two figures in the snow, an adult and a child. They both wore hats, had red noses, and were wrapped in red scarves.
"Excuse me!" Selena didn't see the unnatural smile on their faces, so she hurried forward and asked, "Have you seen my parents? What's happening here? Why has everything become so strange?"
"This used to be a very nice hot spring resort!" the man replied, his eyes wide. "A few days ago, a thick fog suddenly floated in from the horizon. Ever since then, the staff and guests here have all become very strange."
Selena asked, "A thick fog?"
The child, who also had large eyes, said, "Yes, the fog seemed to be filled with something terrible. Look, the fog is coming!"
Selena looked in the direction they were pointing. The fog was like a living thing, rolling and forming a human figure that landed in front of the reception hall door.
The figure saw Selena and quickly chased after her.
Selena quickly ran into the forest. The child with the big eyes shouted, "Run! Run! When you come back here, find Mr. Harold. He knows more about what's going on."
Selena didn't have time to ask why the adult and child weren't running. She plunged into the woods, struggling through the snow.
Although the trees blocked her view, she knew that the figure made of fog was still chasing her. She couldn't stop, she had to keep running, keep running!
Until her strength was exhausted and she could no longer run.
The warm key ring once again gave Selena courage. She broke off a branch, leaned against a tree, and prepared to fight the figure!
It was getting closer and closer.
The branch shook, the snow on it fell, and a dark figure walked out from the trees.
"Chris!" Selena exclaimed, "How is it you?"
Chris didn't speak, but just gave a wry smile.
Selena felt that her brother looked strange, so she didn't approach him. "What's wrong, Chris?"
Chris still didn't speak. He pointed to the snow next to him. There was an abstract symbol there, and it wasn't there before.
The symbol consisted of winding vertical and horizontal lines, as well as several dots.
Selena asked, "What does this mean?"
Chris didn't say anything. He pointed to the sky again.
Selena looked up along his finger. She saw a… fireplace?
Her vision suddenly became distorted. It was indeed a fireplace. She was back in the reception hall!
The difference was that Selena was also sitting on the sofa in the hall. The entire hall was filled with people, and they were all asleep.
Sitting next to Selena were her mother and sister-in-law, and her father was sitting on the opposite sofa.
Everyone was covered with blankets, waiting for the hunters to return.
Selena, a little dazed, remembered that the people who had gone hunting in the afternoon hadn't returned by evening. The whole family was very worried about Chris, so they were all waiting in the hall.
When they came to the hall, they found that many people whose friends or family members hadn't returned from hunting were already waiting here.
As a result, they waited and waited, and eventually fell asleep.
So it was a dream. Selena breathed a sigh of relief.
But she quickly noticed something was wrong. There was mud and snow on her shoes and her sister-in-law's shoes. Most of the snow had melted, and the carpet was wet.
"They're back!" someone suddenly said!
This startled everyone awake. They all came to the door. A dozen young men and women who had gone hunting had indeed returned, but… Selena felt that something was off about them.
Leading the way was the hunter who gave a furry feeling. His job was to take the resort's guests hunting. "We encountered a grizzly bear!"
The hunter said with a smile, "Unfortunately, they're not real hunters, otherwise we could have tried to hunt that grizzly bear."
"We had no choice but to avoid the grizzly bear, so we came back so late."
Selena saw a long-haired woman in the group sharing the fun of hunting with her friends. "Oh my god, it was my first time encountering a grizzly bear in the wild. It was so exciting!"
Selena remembered that she seemed to have a round face when she set out, but now she had a long face.
Also, a young man in the group had become dark-skinned. Selena clearly remembered that he was a fair-skinned young man.
But Selena was more concerned about her brother. She stared at Chris's mouth. Fortunately, Chris opened his mouth with a smile and said, "I'm going hunting again tomorrow. This is what a vacation should be like."
Selena breathed a long sigh of relief: He didn't become "mute". It was just a dream!
Mr. Wood said, "Do you know how worried everyone was about you?"
Chris stroked his fiancée Vina's back. "Sorry for making you worry. Well, another group of people are going hunting tomorrow morning. I can go with them and definitely be back in the afternoon."
Mr. Wood shook his head. "Okay, okay, since it's a vacation, have fun."
Everyone was tired and sleepy. After chatting for a while, they all returned to their rooms to rest.
Selena stayed in a room by herself. She stared at her dirty shoes for a while, feeling that there were important clues in her dream just now.
So she prepared to write to Professor Hobert tomorrow morning, explaining the situation here and asking the professor to help her interpret the dream.
Lost in thought, Selena, who had been tired all day, quickly fell asleep. When she woke up, the sun had already risen.
At breakfast, Selena talked about her dream last night. Before she could finish, Vina said with a smile, "I had almost the same dream yesterday, except I was chasing someone who knew important information, not being chased."
Mrs. Wood joked, "Could it be that the two of you were one escaping and one chasing?"
The whole family laughed, only Selena glanced thoughtfully at her sister-in-law's shoes.
After breakfast, Chris went hunting again, and Vina, feeling uneasy, followed along.
Selena returned to her room, first wrote the letter, then asked the restaurant for three donuts and summoned Professor Hobert's messenger.
After sending the letter, Selena felt much better and went outside to the courtyard for a walk.
Coming out of the reception hall, she thought of her dream last night again: I remember turning around there and meeting an adult and a child.
Selena smiled as she walked in that direction: It was just a dream. But she was still going to check it out.
Turning the corner, Selena stood there in a daze for a long time. There were two snowmen, one big and one small!
They both wore hats, had big eyes, noses made of carrots, and red scarves around their necks.
After a long while, Selena felt cold all over: The snowmen came to life? No, no, no, it's just a dream, just a dream… Is it really a dream? Why are the snowmen in this position? Coincidence?
Selena suddenly thought of the snowman's reminder. She had to find Mr. Harold.
"Miss, I see you're shivering. Are you feeling unwell?" a kind-looking middle-aged man asked. He had a cigarette in his hand, and it seemed he had just taken a puff, as the smoke hadn't completely dissipated.
"I, I want to find Mr. Harold!"
The middle-aged man was slightly stunned. "That's me!"
Selena asked, "Mr. Harold, do you know more about what's going on?"
Harold looked surprised, and the cigarette fell to the ground. He took two quick steps forward and said to Selena in a low voice, "Run while you still have your sanity!"
Selena panicked a little. "Where to run?"
"Run outside the resort!"
"Where to run to?"
"See that pine forest? Climb over a mountain from there, and there's a small village. You'll be safe when you get to that village."
…
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffrey Territory.
Hobert received a reply from Bishop Simpson early in the morning. In the letter, Bishop Simpson said, "His Excellency the Archbishop has not made any instructions regarding cooperation with the Theosophy Order."
That was a default approval. Of course, the Archbishop wouldn't make any instructions, since he would still "kill the donkey after it grinds the mill."
It was just that after Hobert was tied to Bishop Simpson in the future, there would be more room for maneuvering in how the "donkey" was killed.
After sending the big dog away and having breakfast, Hobert taught Freya her vocabulary for the day before asking Allen to invite Helen over.
When the beautiful and elegant Helen arrived in the study, Hobert cut to the chase: "Tell Monica or Chairman Jonathan that the Earth Mother Church has agreed to my cooperation plan, but they have given a condition. The Theosophy Order must help us kill a demigod on the other side, and the Beyonder characteristics of that demigod must be given to the Earth Mother Church before we can fully reach an agreement."
Pfft~
Dennis, who was cleaning the study, lost his grip and dropped the book in his hand to the ground: The Baron is insidious!
Helen didn't pay attention to the male servant's mistake. In her opinion, since it was a cooperation, then of course everyone should state their own conditions. Cooperation could only be promoted if everyone was interested.
However, what Helen didn't expect was that the Earth Mother Church would actually have the intention of cooperating.
As far as she knew, this was the first time that the Theosophy Order had cooperated with a true god church!
Helen knew very well that she was just a messenger. She agreed and immediately went to inform Ms. Monica.
Hobert glanced at Dennis beside him: "Were you just thinking: This Baron is so insidious!"
Pfft~
Another book fell to the ground.
Hobert looked at the somewhat surprised Dennis: "When I can't see your thoughts from your expression, you won't have to clean the study every day."
He paused, not sure if he was talking to Freya or Dennis: "Politics is like mixing mud. You can mix it with water and soil, but it's still just mud. Only by adding some sand, grass, and other debris can it become harder and harder, and finally become a whole."
"If you don't have this ability, mud will always just be mud."
After waiting for seven or eight seconds, he said to Dennis, who was contemplating, "Go, bring me my tea!"
After Dennis left, Allen came in from the door and whispered, "Sir, what if he leaks your…"
Hobert waved his hand: "This kid doesn't seem to have much scheming, but he's very clever and won't joke with his family's lives."
Allen nodded and said nothing more.
Hobert said to Seel outside: "Keep a closer eye on the military affairs. Just come over for about an hour each day. You don't have to stay here every day!"
"Also, bring Grove's eldest and second sons into the army. Two big, clumsy fools who can flatten a watering can just by watering flowers."
Seel smiled: "Yes."
"The name of the potion you took is 'Hunter'!" Hobert said: "From now on, I will give you three days of vacation every week to learn how to be a real hunter from the hunters in the territory."
Seel was slightly stunned: "Yes."
Although he didn't understand the purpose of the Baron, he knew that following the Baron's orders wouldn't be wrong.
Hobert returned to his room and was about to use "Travel" to ask Upton how the material purchase was progressing when he felt something. Using Spirit Vision, he saw the space in the room become illusory.
The messenger came out of the spirit world, and a letter popped out of the coffin, landing in Hobert's hand.
Hobert opened the letter and was slightly stunned. There wasn't a single sentence that made sense. He felt something and turned the letter over.
Upside down, the letters formed a ferocious wolf face.
Seeing that the messenger hadn't left, Hobert asked, "Who sent the letter?"
"That little girl who likes mysticism," the messenger said. "The donuts she paid with were day-old donuts."
Hobert smiled: "I'll give you three more when she sends her next letter."
He looked at the letter again: "Selena's prank?"
Does she not want to graduate from me anymore?
"She's been contaminated," the messenger said.
"Contaminated? Did she provoke the Aurora Order again?"
"No, it's a more serious contamination than that."
Since he was Selena's mentor, he couldn't just ignore it, so Hobert asked, "Did she send this letter from her home?"
"East Chester County, Boklun Manor."
Hobert asked again, "Do you know what the source of the contamination is?"
Messenger: "I received very contradictory information. I felt a familiar aura, but at the same time, I felt very unfamiliar. What is certain is that there is the scent of a 'Seer'."
Scent? Hobert thought of the big dog that delivered the letter this morning. He smiled: "Thank you!"
"You're welcome, three donuts!"
Hobert smiled and shook his head: "No problem!"
"Also, be careful with this painting. It has become different from before!"
Hobert was slightly stunned and thanked him again.
Messenger: "You're welcome, three donuts. You owe me nine donuts in total."
After the messenger left, Hobert realized: "Is he actively 'marketing' now? And it seems a little like a forced sale?"
Hobert shook his head helplessly, but then he thought that nine donuts were all he could afford.
He didn't go to rescue her immediately, but crossed his arms and pondered the rescue plan before changing into clothes with a Loen style, carefully putting on the magical items and sealed items.
This time, he covered the painting on the wall with thick cloth and carried it on his back. First, it was a very good shield, and second, he wanted to try to pull Farbauti in to share the risk.
Most importantly, Hobert wanted to see what changes had taken place in this painting?
Since the messenger had reminded him, the painting must have undergone some changes, but Hobert didn't dare to bring it to the "Nation of Disorder" again, so he could only pay attention to the changes in the painting during the battle.
If it was very dangerous, he would just throw the painting away: Brother Farbauti, I don't want to throw away the painting like this, but the battle is too fierce, and I have to do this to save my life.
Hobert smiled, first changed his appearance, used "Travel" to come to Backlund, and found a travel agency to inquire about the situation of Boklun Manor.
After getting detailed information about the manor, Hobert sighed: The manor in the depths of the mountains; the deep mountains covered with ice and snow! It's too easy to think of "The Shining"! Or rather, this is a standard environment for a ghost story to happen!
While thinking wildly, Hobert came to a deserted corner and used "Travel" to come to East Chester County.
He stood on the high mountain, looking at the Boklun Manor surrounded by fog in the distance, and could see the guests of the manor coming in and out.
This lively scene was not what Hobert imagined, with only Selena, or only Selena and her friends and family.
Hobert crossed his arms and thought about it again, then took out the letter Selena had just written and prepared to use the "Faceless Necklace" as a medium to navigate and find Selena.
But the necklace was hanging there motionless. Hobert: Divination failed? No, the messenger said that there was the scent of a "Seer" here, so there may be anti-divination power nearby.
He checked the magical items and sealed items on his body again, and then used "Travel" again to come not far from the manor.
He hadn't taken a few steps forward when Hobert saw a hand on the road, or rather, a hand holding a cane. The hand was cut off neatly from the forearm, and a string of black gemstone bracelets was worn on the wrist. It was suspended in mid-air, holding the cane tightly.
Seeing that this hand had no "offensive" nature, Hobert prepared to bypass it and continue walking forward.
Unexpectedly, the hand pulled out the cane inserted in the ground, as if jumping on one leg, and blocked Hobert's path.
Hobert, who had a lot of adventure experience, calmly asked, "Do you need my help? My medical skills are very good and can sew severed limbs."
Or I can sew you back to the corpse.
The hand put the cane on the ground and then let go, waving at Hobert.
Hobert asked, "Don't need my help?"
The hand waved again, then pointed in the direction of the manor.
Hobert understood: "You don't want me to go to the manor?"
The hand held the cane again, as if to say: That's what it means.
"Thank you for your reminder," Hobert said. "I also know there is danger there, but my student is in the manor, and I must go to save her."
The hand stopped for two or three seconds, and suddenly the bracelet on the wrist seemed to come to life and flew out of the severed wrist in the direction of Hobert.
As soon as Hobert caught the bracelet, the hand and cane also fell to the ground.
Hobert was slightly stunned holding the bracelet. This was a sealed item. He bowed slightly to the hand: "Thank you for your blessings and gifts."
He buried the hand holding the cane tightly in the woods by the roadside to prevent it from being crushed by passing carriages.
When burying it, Hobert noticed that it was a right hand.
For safety reasons, Hobert used "Travel" again to return to the mountain opposite the manor. He simply set up the altar and dedicated the bracelet to the "Nation of Disorder" for inspection.
Using the authority of the "Nation of Disorder", he knew the ability of this sealed item: "It can quietly put the opponent into a deep sleep and enter the enemy's dream, creating some monsters in the dream to attack the opponent. The opponent's injuries in the dream are real injuries, and death in the dream is real death."
The negative effect is: "The holder is prone to sleepwalking. While sleepwalking, he will completely become another person and do things that are difficult for ordinary people to understand. If he dies wearing this necklace, it will seal part of the holder's spirituality and will in the body, turning the holder into a living corpse with wisdom, but the holder will also miss the opportunity to enter the underworld, and eventually become an evil spirit after the body rots."
Hobert pondered that the holder of the necklace should have encountered an irresistible attack, and one hand was cut off neatly.
The negative effect of the necklace preserved part of the holder's will, giving the hand a certain wisdom to prevent guests who wanted to enter Boklun Manor.
Following this line of thought, Hobert felt that this should be a sealed item of the Evernight Goddess Church, and its owner may have come from a Night Watcher squad member who had sacrificed or fled with a severed arm.
Looking at the necklace in his hand, Hobert decided to investigate the situation of the manor if he had the opportunity, and then report it to the Evernight Goddess Church.
Returning to the real world, Hobert used "Travel" again to come near the manor. This time he did not encounter any obstacles. He entered the reception hall while watching the tourists playing in the snow.
The manager greeted him enthusiastically: "Welcome to Boklun Manor, how can I help you?"
"Your smile is too ugly, the best help is to stop smiling! Okay, keep smiling, the expressionless look is even more ugly." As he spoke, Hobert took out the police ID card issued by the Evernight Goddess Church: "According to witnesses, a fraudster has mixed into the guests of the manor. I want to investigate the tourists here, please cooperate with the staff of the manor."
The manager asked with an unnatural smile, "What is the name of the criminal?"
"He has many false identities, and I have five different identities in my grasp."
"What are the physical characteristics of the criminal?"
"He is proficient in disguise. It is said that he once disguised himself as a woman and deceived a pirate general. I even have reason to suspect that you are him?"
"Sorry," the manager said helplessly, "We may not be able to help with this."
"I don't need your help, I just need you to assist my investigation," Hobert said with a smile. "I have been chasing him for several months. After a series of investigations, I can recognize him!"
The manager nodded: "You can also say the false names the criminal has used, maybe he used one of them to register?"
Hobert nodded: "As far as I know, a false name he recently used was Gehrman Sparrow."
A certain adventurer sneezed loudly at sea!

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 449 Daly and Leonard enter (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The lobby manager certainly couldn't find the name. Hobert smiled and said, "I'll investigate in the reception hall. Please get me a cup of tea."
Hobert's so-called investigation was just looking at the people around him, one by one, very carefully.
He noticed that the smiles on everyone's faces were somewhat unnatural or exaggerated.
Just seeing this, Hobert felt that there was definitely something wrong with this manor, but he didn't immediately ask about Serena's whereabouts, just observing quietly.
As for the corruption the messenger mentioned, that was the least of Hobert's worries, because the 'Bell of Order' could break all corruption.
The waiter brought Hobert tea, but Hobert didn't take a single sip.
Finally, Hobert saw a middle-aged man with a normal expression. He was smoking a cigarette on a chair outside, as if thinking about something.
In a place full of abnormal people, suddenly discovering someone who shows no signs of abnormality, then that person must be the problem.
Hobert got up and went out to chat with the smoking middle-aged man: "Hello, sir."
The middle-aged man glanced at Hobert: "Hello, is there anything I can do for you?"
Hobert sat down beside the middle-aged man with a smile and a leisurely expression: "I just saw you seemed to be thinking about something, and I was a little curious. Of course, more importantly, I came on vacation alone and wanted to find someone to chat with."
"Sorry," the middle-aged man stood up and said, "I'm not in the mood for chatting."
"Has anything strange happened here recently?" Hobert asked tentatively.
The middle-aged man sat down as expected and asked in a surprised whisper, "You noticed it too?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, may I ask what your name is?"
"I'm Harold. And you?"
"Everyone calls me Jeffrey."
Harold asked softly, "Then Mr. Jeffrey, why are you carrying an oil painting on your back?"
If I said this isn't really an oil painting, but a bomb, would you believe me?
Hobert knew he had found the right person, because the oil painting was wrapped in a thick cloth, and it was difficult for ordinary people to "guess" that it was an oil painting at a glance.
"That's my drawing board," Hobert said, "Actually, I'm an art student here to sketch."
Harold nodded and didn't continue the topic: "Do you have any clues about the problems with this manor?"
Hobert spread his hands: "No clues at all. I can only feel that something seems wrong, but I don't know what to do."
Harold's voice was even lower: "Listen to me, Mr. Jeffrey, run while you still have your sanity!"
Hobert asked, "Where to run?"
"Run out of the manor!"
"Run to where?"
"See that pine forest? Cross a mountain from there, and there's a small village. Once you get to that village, you'll be safe."
But Hobert had no intention of getting up and leaving: "Mr. Harold, let's escape together!"
"No, I still need to investigate what's going on here."
Hobert pondered for a moment: "I also want to investigate what's going on. Is there anything I can help with?"
Harold looked at Hobert, then smiled: "Few people have your courage. As far as I know, there seems to be a problem with the public hot spring. You can go take a look."
Hobert said "Oh": "But, I'm sorry, I'm allergic to hot springs."
"Allergic to hot springs?"
"Yes." Hobert said very sincerely, at least he thought he was being very sincere.
Harold nodded: "Well then, do you see that forest outside the manor? Yes, that's the one. It's said that forest elves appear there. You can ask the forest elves for information."
The direction he pointed was the same direction he had just told Hobert to escape to.
"Sorry, I'm allergic to pine needles. It's all pine trees there!"
"Allergic to pine needles?"
Hobert said sincerely: "Seeing pine needles makes me feel uncomfortable all over!"
Harold carefully scrutinized Hobert: "Then go take a look at the lake outside the manor. It's said that a talking monster appears there. Go ask the monster if it knows anything."
"There are no hot springs on the lakeshore, no pine trees. To facilitate tourists to walk, all the vegetation has been cleared away. There's nothing around, only a small lake."
Hobert opened his mouth: "Wait a minute…"
Let me think, should I be allergic to the lake? Or should I be allergic to water?
Just as Hobert was in trouble, a burst of horse neighing suddenly sounded from the direction of the manor entrance. Two carriages with the Holy Emblem of the Night entered the manor.
Hobert smiled: "The people in the carriage are good helpers. They can help to go to the lake…"
Harold had disappeared without Hobert noticing.
Hobert's eyes narrowed. He didn't even know when the other party had disappeared. This guy definitely has a big problem!
However, Hobert did not take further action. Based on the cane-wielding hand he had encountered before, Hobert guessed that the Nighthawk team had already conducted at least one round of investigation in the manor.
But that investigation had obviously failed, so now that the Nighthawks are breaking in so unscrupulously, it must be because they have enough confidence to solve the problem here.
Hobert prepared to observe how the Nighthawk team investigated while looking for Serena.
So far, Hobert had not found any trace of Serena. He guessed that Serena might have escaped, but of course, this possibility was unlikely. Or Serena was trapped in one of the three places Harold had just mentioned, and was already severely corrupted.
Hobert planned to wait for the Nighthawks to investigate those three places, and then he would save Serena by the way.
If the Nighthawks didn't know this information, he would find an opportunity to tell them.
As he spoke, the carriage with the Holy Emblem of the Night came closer. The door opened, and the first to come down was a woman with a bewitching beauty and emerald eyes.
Hobert smiled: He ran into an acquaintance, it was actually Ms. Daly!
Then, he saw the red gloves on Ms. Daly's left hand.
Hobert, who was more familiar with the Nighthawk's extraordinary system, understood that the "Red Gloves" had taken over the case from the Nighthawks.
Daly didn't notice Hobert. Surrounded by her subordinates, she began to check the surrounding environment.
At this time, the door of the second carriage opened. Hobert felt something. The first person to come down was actually Leonard, who was unkempt and had a poet's romantic air.
And after Leonard got out of the carriage, he looked directly at Hobert.
Hobert was a little helpless: The old man's nose is sensitive enough. Did he "smell" the scent on me? Or did he "smell" the oil painting?
This was an opportunity. Hobert believed that he could use Leonard's subsequent probing to inform the "Red Gloves" of the information he knew.
Watching eight or nine "Red Glove" members enter the reception hall, Hobert sat for a while, then also came to the hall and said to the hall manager: "After preliminary investigation, I already have some clues, but I'm a little tired now. Arrange a room for me. I'll rest first and continue the investigation later."
"No problem, sir." The hall manager asked softly, "Have you locked down the fraudster?"
"Yes, I found a lot of clues!" Hobert glanced at the two Red Glove members in the sofa area.
Hobert followed the waiter to a small room with a heater, a bed, and a table, which were common furnishings in hotels.
Outside the window was a snow scene, the scenery was not bad, and the room was quite warm.
Hobert locked the door, took off the oil painting, and prayed to himself simply first, then entered the "Nation of Disorder."
As soon as he entered the "Nation of Disorder", a small stream of white mist emerged from Hobert's spiritual body, and the mist immediately dissipated in the "Nation of Disorder".
At some point, Hobert had been subjected to hidden corruption!
Then Hobert frowned. He remembered that when he was previously polluted by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," an extra personality seemed to have appeared in his spiritual body. The corruption was only eliminated after the "Bell of Order" rang.
But this time, the corruption was only a small stream of white mist, which didn't seem as serious as the "Mother Goddess of Depravity." What puzzled Hobert was, why didn't the "Nation of Disorder" react at all? The white mist, as corruption, actually dissipated on its own in the "Nation of Disorder"?
Was the source of this corruption very weak? Or was the source of this corruption special?
But now was not the time to think about this question. Hobert began to consider when he was polluted.
Was it when he was talking to Harold? Or was he polluted as soon as he entered the manor?
While thinking, he covered his own stars with spirituality, using "True Sight" to see the environment he was in.
Hobert noticed that there was a faint cloud of white mist in the direction of the door.
He could be sure that there was no cloud of white mist before he came to the "Nation of Disorder".
The white mist seemed to be alive, rolling around. There seemed to be a tentacle wrapped in the white mist.
Although the tentacle did not extend towards him, the corruption should have been spread by it.
After advancing to Sequence 5, the range of "True Sight" was already very large. Hobert raised his vision and found that the entire manor was shrouded in a thin white mist, with tentacles emitting white mist everywhere.
When entering the manor, Hobert also saw a lot of fog around the manor, but that was normal water mist, which was clearly different from these white mists.
What is this? Can't even see it with spirit vision?
Hobert looked in the direction of the depths of the tentacles, towards the forest outside the manor.
The white mist there was even more serious. Unfortunately, the field of vision of "True Sight" was limited, and he couldn't see the situation there clearly.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert realized that the corruption here was more complex than he had previously thought.
Hobert didn't plan to continue exploring. He planned to find Serena from the three places Harold mentioned and leave immediately, leaving the rest to the official Beyonders to solve.
In addition, since the corruption was all over the manor, he would have to enter the "Nation of Disorder" in an hour to "disinfect".
After making up his mind, Hobert returned to the real world. He looked towards the direction of the door and indeed saw nothing.
Knock knock knock~
The knock on the door startled Hobert: "Who is it?"
"A colleague!" Leonard's relaxed voice sounded from outside.
Hobert opened the door: "What colleague?"
Standing outside the door was the poet classmate who, like Hobert, liked to wear a trench coat.
"I think we should talk inside." Leonard smiled.
Hobert invited him into the room. Leonard took out the police-issued certificate: "See, I told you I was a colleague."
Hobert smiled: "Please sit down."
After sitting down, Leonard asked: "I heard from the hall manager that you are investigating a fraudster?"
"That's right, what are you investigating?"
"We are investigating a murderer!"
Hobert laughed: "The hall manager must have been shocked!"
What's going on with this batch of guests? One moment there's a fraudster, the next moment there's a murderer!
Leonard asked in a relaxed tone: "Do you have any clues?"
"Yes, I think Mr. Harold has…"
"Harold? Does he like to smoke?"
Hobert recalled, he seemed to have a cigarette in his hand all the time: "Do you know him?"
"He's one of my companions." Leonard gripped his cane tightly, leaned back on the chair, and the smile on his face gradually disappeared: "And he's now in York Mountain!"
Hobert was stunned: "York Mountain?"
Leonard's answer exceeded his expectations. As far as he knew, the former kingdom of the Evernight Goddess, the "Dark Heaven," was located on York Mountain in the Amantha Mountains, and the headquarters of the Church of the Evernight Goddess was also there.
The poet classmate spread his hands: "Alright, let's not do this meaningless probing! We know you have a problem, and you should have seen through our identities!"
Hobert nodded and thought: Leonard mistook what I just said as a test of him!
He didn't intend to explain, the two of them were already testing each other.
Leonard asked: "Do you have anything to say?"
"One of my students is trapped here, and I'm here to rescue her." Hobert said "honestly": "Also, I learned that the public hot spring, the pine forest outside the manor, and the lake outside all have problems."
"Anything else?"
"I just arrived too." Hobert also spread his hands like Leonard: "That's all I know."
Leonard suddenly asked: "What's that on the table?"
"An oil painting."
"Just an oil painting?"
"You can understand it that way."
"Then." Leonard stood up and said: "My two colleagues will send you to…"
Hobert waved his hand: "You should solve the problem of the manor first."
Leonard: "Perhaps, you are the root of the problem!"
Only then did Hobert understand: This was a reminder from the "Old Man"!
"It looks like we have to change the way we cooperate." Hobert held the oil painting in one hand and said: "You will only find out how wrong you were when things are over."
Although Leonard had made some preparations, he could only watch Hobert disappear before his eyes: "Old man, didn't you say he wasn't very strong?"
"Is the ability to 'travel' very strong?" A voice only Leonard could hear said: "That oil painting interfered with me."
Leonard curled his lips ungentlemanly: "Then, he's gone, is the source of corruption still there?"
"Still here!" the voice said, "I advise you to evacuate the manor quickly. This is a very high-level contamination."
"How high-level?"
"High-level to the point that even your Evernight Goddess might not be able to save you if you are contaminated too severely."
Leonard frowned involuntarily, pondering how to remind Daly, the commander of this operation.
…
On the hilltop opposite Boklun Manor, Hobert smiled helplessly, "With the old grandpa's help, it didn't work this time."
He slung the oil painting on his back, changed his appearance, and prepared to enter the manor again to observe the Nighthawks' actions.
Just as he was about to leave, Hobert's spirituality sensed something. He saw a team of a dozen people on the hillside.
Rather than a team of a dozen people, it was more like a dozen monsters. Hobert saw that there was a woman in the team who was more than two meters tall. It wasn't so much that she was tall, but that her head accounted for a third of her body.
There was also a dark and shiny young man in the team whose eyes had turned orange-red, flowing with flame-like brilliance.
Someone was covered in cracked, hard skin, someone was covered in barbs like those found on caltrops, and a young man and woman were covered in scales, spitting out snake tongues every time they spoke.
Hobert suddenly understood: This group of people has been severely contaminated.
He used "Travel" to arrive on the path they were sure to take, and soon he waited for them: "Are you guests of the manor?"
At the front of the team was a grizzly bear. Hobert originally thought it was a pet raised by Boklun Manor, but who knew the grizzly bear would speak, "We are the manor's hunting team, may I ask who you are?"
"I am a tourist at the manor." Hobert pointed to the oil painting on his back, "I went too deep into the forest while looking for a good spot, and got lost."
He immediately understood that these people hadn't realized that they or their teammates had turned into monsters!
"Then come with us." The grizzly bear said, "We are looking for a grizzly bear. If we can't find it by 11 o'clock, we plan to return to the manor."
Hobert was stunned: Are you looking for yourself? Or are you looking for a female bear?
Hobert joined this team of monsters, and soon he noticed the conversation between the "snake man" and the "snake woman" behind him.
The "snake man" said, "Darling, that was just a dream, how could I not talk to you?"
The "snake woman": "But that dream was too realistic. I chased and chased, chased into a forest, and then I saw you, but you didn't speak, just hinted for me to look at the traces in the snow."
The "snake man" hissed and laughed, "Serena also had a dream, dreaming that she was chased into the forest…"
Hobert listened to their conversation for a while, but unfortunately they didn't continue to discuss Serena, so he turned his head and smiled, "The Serena you mentioned, is it Miss Serena from Tingen City?"
The "snake man" asked in surprise, "You know her?"
"Yes." Hobert smiled, "Yesterday I met her while painting in the backyard. She is a very beautiful and lively girl."
After chatting, Hobert learned that the "snake man" was called Chris, Serena's brother, and the "snake woman" was called Vina.
Then Hobert asked about Serena and Vina's dreams. Hobert could basically conclude that it was Vina and Serena chasing each other at that time.
Their spirituality should have realized the danger, so they fled here in a half-dreaming state, but unfortunately, they were caught back by some force.
…
Inside the manor, Daly learned of the clues Leonard had obtained and decided to investigate separately.
Leonard and a male colleague went to the public hot spring together.
The two tried their best to look like ordinary tourists, changed their clothes, came to the hot spring, and looked around vigilantly.
This was an indoor hot spring as large as a large conference room, surrounded by tiles, with waiters shuttling among them, providing guests with wine, snacks, or fruit.
There were many guests in the hot spring, chatting and laughing freely, and everything seemed normal.
After a full half an hour, just as Leonard and his colleague were about to leave the hot spring to take a rest, suddenly, the entire hot spring became silent.
The two "Red Gloves" then noticed that everyone's movements were frozen, standing there motionless like statues.
A person covered in seaweed-like things walked out of the depths of the hot spring step by step.
It was impossible to see the monster's appearance or gender.
Leonard and his colleague were about to react, but found that their whole bodies were paralyzed, and every movement was very difficult.
Fortunately, Leonard had the whistle for help by his hand. He immediately blew the whistle, then calmed down and looked at the strange man who suddenly appeared in the hot spring: "Who are you?"
"Of course I am a guest soaking in the hot spring!"
It can communicate!
Leonard asked again: "Why have you become like this? What have you done to us and the other guests?"
"That is the toxin on my body. I discharged it into the hot spring, so you can't move, and you have all become my prey…"
At this time, two "Red Gloves" who were on standby in the hall rushed in. Seeing the monster approaching Leonard and others, they raised their guns and pulled the trigger repeatedly.
Whoosh~
The monster disappeared into the hot spring.
The Red Gloves regrouped in the hall. Daly and another team member went to explore the lakeside, but found nothing. In addition, a group of Red Gloves did not return.
Just then, someone shouted: "The hunting team is back!"
…
Hobert gripped the black blade tightly, quietly watching the scene before him.
The hunting team members were covered with a layer of gray moths. If he hadn't been chatting with them just now, Hobert would have thought these gray moths were lying on some humanoid wooden stakes.
The reason why Hobert was just observing and not driving away these gray moths was because these gray moths seemed to be absorbing the contamination from the hunting team members.
Previously, those team members who had turned into monsters gradually returned to their human forms.
It's just that the long-faced girl's face was still a bit long, and the dark-skinned young man's skin was still a bit dark.
Doo~
Hobert heard a sharp whistle, which was the Nighthawks' distress whistle.
He immediately followed the whistle, but found nothing, only two large cocoons on the pine tree!
Wait, pine tree!
Hobert suddenly realized that he had entered the forest that Harold had mentioned, the forest with forest elves!

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 450: The Contaminated Seer Saint
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert paid attention to the surrounding movements while using his knife to cut open two insect cocoons. As expected, two unconscious "Red Gloves" members fell out.
Hobert put on his gloves and examined the two members. They were not severely contaminated. Only then did Hobert carry them back to the hunting team, one in each hand.
The gray moths had all flown away, and the team members seemed to suddenly wake up, completely unaware of what had just happened. Some even said they thought they saw a grizzly bear again.
Hobert glanced at the team leader at the front, who gave off a furry feeling, and was speechless for a moment.
He pretended that nothing had happened and lied that he had found two unconscious people in the snow. Everyone helped carry the two people back to the manor.
"The hunting team is back!"
Amidst the shouts of several guests playing in the snow, Hobert and his group returned.
Mr. Wood and Mrs. Wood rushed out and said to Chris, "Serena is missing! We've searched the entire manor and can't find her."
Hobert listened to Mr. Wood's description from the side and quickly made a judgment: Serena disappeared not long before I arrived.
Meanwhile, in the hall, Leonard saw a young man in the hunting team carrying an oil painting. Without the old man's reminder, his intuition told him that the oil painting was the one that had disappeared before his eyes.
And the person carrying the oil painting must be the same person as before, but with a different appearance.
The other "Red Gloves" members saw the two teammates being carried in the team. After learning that the young man carrying the "easel" had saved the two companions, Daly stepped forward to express her gratitude.
Once the "Red Gloves" members gathered again, Daly whispered, "There's something wrong with the 'easel' of the young man who saved our teammates."
Leonard hesitated for a second or two before saying, "That's the person who gave me the three suspicious location information before. He, he changed his appearance, but I can recognize the oil painting he's carrying."
Everyone was stunned, and then they all looked at Daly.
Daly considered her words and said, "The situation here is obviously more complicated than Harold reported. Since the other party has enough goodwill towards us, we can cooperate.
"Leonard, please invite him over. At this time, we should put aside our prejudices and prioritize saving the tourists here."
...
When Hobert saw Leonard wave to him and sit down next to him, he knew that Daly had made the most rational choice.
"Sorry!" Leonard said with a smile, "We should always investigate the most obvious doubts."
Hobert asked, "And now?"
"Now we want to invite you to discuss the solution to the problem with us."
"Sorry," Hobert mimicked Leonard's tone and smiled, "I've provided you with such important information, but the reward I got was almost being arrested."
Leonard was slightly stunned before understanding Hobert's meaning. He immediately went back to report to Daly.
Soon Leonard returned, "The condition we can offer is that you have the priority to choose the gains in this mission. Even if there are no Beyonder gains, you will not be treated unfairly."
Only then did Hobert nod, "It seems that some official Beyonders are also reasonable."
He then sat among the "Red Gloves", first listening to the "Red Gloves"' investigation, and then said, "Everyone, I have a question. Why don't you quickly evacuate these tourists and then try to solve the problem?"
"A previous group of colleagues did this," Daly replied, "But after the tourists leave the manor for a distance, they will return here on their own.
"The method of evacuating tourists is not effective at all and easily alarms the source of corruption here."
Harold was the first Nighthawk captain to arrive here, but their actions failed, and the team members also sacrificed themselves here.
Only Harold escaped with serious injuries and took the train to the east at the station before Boklun Manor, reminding the people who came to the train for vacation not to go to Boklun Manor for the time being, and went to York Mountain.
Therefore, the Church of the Evernight Goddess sent Daly and others, who were reporting on the Backlund smog incident at headquarters, to investigate and eliminate the corruption here.
Hobert nodded, "My suggestion is to investigate from those three suspicious locations, but they all seem to be quite dangerous. I suggest investigating one by one.
"How about Mr. Leonard and I go to the hot spring again? You can wait outside the hot spring. No matter what happens inside, only come to support after the whistle blows."
He found that the "Red Gloves" didn't know more information than himself, and their investigation progress was too slow. If he waited any longer, Serena would be in grave danger, so he planned to take action himself.
Finally, Hobert said to Daly, "I don't think it's possible for us to solve the problem here with our strength."
Daly nodded, "I've already sent someone to ask for help."
Hobert 'hmm'ed and got up, heading to the public hot spring with Leonard.
At this time, outside the reception hall, two team members who were sent to ask for help, along with the two teammates who had just been rescued and were still unconscious, were preparing to take a carriage to the nearest church to ask for help from headquarters.
When the two unconscious team members were carried onto the carriage, a tiny crack appeared on their foreheads.
However, the two team members responsible for asking for help did not notice this in time.
...
In the public hot spring, Hobert asked about the entire process of the monster's appearance.
Leonard also explained in detail, and finally he said, "...As long as you come out of the hot spring, the feeling of paralysis will quickly disappear, but the tourists in the hot spring didn't realize that they were as still as statues just now."
At this time, the "Red Gloves" had blocked off the area, and there were no tourists in the hot spring.
Hobert held a "utensil" and sat in the pool, "You come down too. If we want to lure the other party out, we must take some actions to weaken ourselves."
Leonard hesitated for a moment, but still sat in the pool.
Hobert chatted, "You should have seen it too, right? The people in the manor are more or less contaminated and have become a little abnormal.
"But the problem is, if they were severely contaminated, they would have turned into monsters long ago, but they haven't! Don't you think it's strange?"
Leonard no longer had the confidence he had during the last conversation, "What are your guesses about this?"
"I heard Harold say that there is a village across that mountain," Hobert said, "Do you think that the people who have been severely contaminated are all in that village?"
"Very likely."
"Also, I found that," Hobert added, "The hunting team is generally more contaminated than the tourists in the manor!"
Leonard wasn't stupid either and immediately guessed, "The hunting team is closer to the source of corruption?"
He added, "Then we should investigate the hunting team..."
Halfway through his sentence, he denied himself, "It's dangerous to act rashly before getting enough information!"
Hobert nodded, "That's right."
In the two people's chat, half an hour passed in the blink of an eye, and the monster emerged from the depths of the hot spring again.
If there were ordinary people here, they would stand there motionless again, as if they had fainted.
But Beyonders like Hobert and Leonard were only paralyzed and moved with difficulty.
Hobert frowned and asked the monster in the hot spring, "I'm very curious, why are you wrapped in seaweed? Is it because you can't afford clothes?"
"Fool! This isn't seaweed!" the monster said.
"Okay, if you say it isn't, then it isn't," Hobert agreed readily, "Did something happen here that turned you into this?"
"Yes, it all started with that evil fog!" the monster said.
Hobert asked, "Evil fog?"
"You ask too many questions!" the monster was very close to Hobert, "But your physique looks very strong!
"That fog makes me have to keep looking for a new body, you are a good choice."
At this time, a milky white light fell, "Healing!"
Hobert immediately recovered his combat power, he jumped ashore and pulled out the knife from the cane not far away.
The monster turned around to run, Hobert quickly stepped forward and used the back of the knife to knock the opponent onto the shore.
The seaweed on the monster's body was like a snake, and it was about to drill into the hot spring in the blink of an eye. Without the "seaweed" wrapping it, only a severely rotten corpse remained on the shore.
Hobert was quick-witted and nailed the "head" of the "seaweed" to the shore with a knife, and then stretched out a foot to step on the tail of the "seaweed".
After taking a closer look, Hobert could probably determine that this should be a strip of human skin!
Hobert said to it, "You're going to answer a few questions!"
A small slit opened in the front section of the human skin, "Let me leave after answering the questions!"
"Okay, good!" Hobert agreed very readily, "What is the evil fog you just mentioned?"
"I don't know, anyway, that night, a strange fog came, and then many people became strangely shaped, and I became like this."
"What's in the fog?"
"I don't know, I only know that some people around me disappeared and then reappeared. They became completely different from before. They also said that they went to the village on the other side of the mountain!"
"What's in the village on the other side of the mountain?"
"Don't know."
Hobert asked a few more questions, and seeing that he couldn't get more information, he pulled out the knife stuck in the ground.
The human skin breathed a sigh of relief and was about to slip away when Hobert suddenly said, "Wait a minute."
Human skin: "Do you have any more questions?"
"I want to solemnly apologize to you, I lied just now!" Saying that, Hobert cut the other party in half with a knife, and then held the knife horizontally and cut it in half vertically.
The human skin didn't even leave a last word, twitched a few times on the ground, and soon lost its movement.
Hobert never intended to let go of the human skin from the beginning. No matter what the reason, it was no longer a person, but a monster that constantly devoured lives!
At this time, Leonard in the public hot spring weakly stretched out his hand, "Pull me up."
Hobert pulled him up and draped him in a bath towel.
Leonard asked, "You had a way to save yourself from the beginning, right?"
"Of course!" Hobert smiled, "I only said half of what I said before: If we want to lure the other party out, we must take some actions to weaken ourselves; but we must have enough confidence to escape danger, otherwise we are just courting death."
As he spoke, he put his "utensils" back into the cloth buttons reserved in his clothes.
Leonard sat on the shore, feeling deceived.
After reuniting with the other "Red Gloves" members and telling them the information he had just obtained, the group headed to the second target, the lake outside the manor.
Hobert and Leonard walked in the front, discussing the new information in a low voice.
Leonard suddenly said, "Could it be... could it be that this corruption comes from a 'Seer' pathway Saint or Angel?
"He or She doesn't know what kind of corruption he or she has suffered, so he or she hides outside the manor and uses 'spiritual threads' to transfer his or her corruption to other people or other creatures!"
Hobert could be sure that this must be a reminder from the old man.
Then he thought of the messenger's reminder, thinking that it was entirely possible, because the operating range of the "Scholar of Yore"'s spiritual threads seemed to reach several hundred meters, and the distance that could be affected reached 5 kilometers!
There was enough space for him to hide in the dark and quietly transfer his corruption.
Hobert hadn't thought of this before because he saw many tentacles wrapped in white mist with "True Sight". He naturally thought that the source of corruption was a monster.
But now Hobert thought, could that be the spiritual threads under "True Sight"?
"The Nation of Disorder" does not have the corresponding characteristics of the "Seer" pathway, so the spiritual threads are somewhat abstract in the vision of "The Nation of Disorder"?
Thinking of these, Hobert smiled helplessly, "We can only completely solve the problem after your support arrives. Before that, we will try our best to collect information."
The key is: do not have a direct conflict with the source of corruption!
Arriving at the lake, it was ordinary, just an ordinary semi-naturally formed, semi-artificially modified lake.
Because the water in the lake comes from hot springs and mountain springs, the fog on the lake is very thick. Even though it is noon now, the line of sight can only see the center of the lake.
The roads along the lake are paved with stone slabs, which are very suitable for walking here.
The only thing that is a little abrupt is that there is a warning sign on the shore that says: Do not throw stones into the water! It's very dangerous!
Daly said, "When we came just now, there was no sign."
"That's easy!" Hobert said, picking up a pebble and throwing it into the lake, but there was no reaction.
So he found a stone the size of a fist and threw it into the lake, but there was still no reaction.
Hobert found another stone the size of a head and threw it towards the lake, everyone watched as the stone disappeared into the fog.
Plop~
After waiting for two or three seconds, there was still no reaction.
While Hobert was looking for a larger stone, a child's voice suddenly sounded in the mist: "Help! I, I can't swim!"
It sounded like he could be drowned at any time. Everyone could hear the sound of splashing water, and they could also see the figure of a child in the mist.
But no one went to save him, because the voice appeared too abruptly.
Even ordinary members of the "Red Gloves" have experienced many cases, and of course, they know that sometimes a call for help is not a genuine call for help.
Hobert pondered for a moment and asked, "How should we save you?"
"Of course, by swimming over to save me!" It was the voice of a little boy.
"Is flying over okay?"
"Fly, fly...? No, no!"
Before everyone could react, Hobert had already flown low and entered the fog. He did indeed see a little boy struggling in the water.
But there was also a huge figure beneath the little boy!
After circling the little boy, Hobert finally saw clearly that there was a strange fish underwater, and on the head of the strange fish, there was a little boy!
