chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 451 The Uncertain Mist Is the Source of Pollution
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert frowned, unsure whether the little boy had been corrupted into this state, or if the strange fish was the one corrupted.
The "little boy" immediately began to dive after seeing Hobert fly.
Hobert plunged into the water, giving chase relentlessly, and because he wore the "Ocean Pendant," he quickly caught the strange fish.
But the strange fish was too slippery, so Hobert had no choice but to sink his hands into the fish's flesh.
With the "Ocean Pendant" on him, even creatures that lived underwater were no match for Hobert.
He dragged the strange fish, swimming vigorously towards the shore, and then tossed it onto the land.
Even the "Red Gloves," who frequently dealt with extraordinary cases, were astonished upon seeing the appearance of the strange fish.
The fish somewhat resembled a man-sized grouper, but behind its eyes grew the upper body of a seven or eight-year-old boy.
At this moment, the little boy cried out, "I can't leave the water, I, I'm suffocating, I'm suffocating!"
It was evident that the "little boy" seemed to have no bones, his arms were limp, but in the water, they could easily deceive!
Leonard pulled Hobert, who was coming ashore, and whispered, "I didn't expect you to have so many magical items on you."
Without mystical items from the "Sailor" pathway, it would have been difficult to catch this strange fish.
Hobert smiled slightly, "Not many, just one or two."
Leonard curled his lip ungentlemanly, indicating that he didn't believe such nonsense.
Daly immediately began to interrogate the strange fish, "Answer my questions properly, and I'll put you back in the water."
This strange fish probably only had the intelligence of a seven or eight-year-old child, and immediately cried, "Ask quickly, ask quickly, I, I can't breathe!"
"How did you become like this?"
"It's all because of that evil white mist a few days ago!"
Hobert followed up, "What was in the white mist?"
"I, I seemed to see the shadow of a wolf!"
Hobert was taken aback, "Do you know what a wolf is?"
"I possess memory fragments of several people I've eaten!"
Hobert pondered for a moment, "I remember that high-level Beyonder creatures of the 'Seer' pathway are basically wolf-shaped!"
Hobert wondered if this was because of inheriting Flegrea's genes? Or was it that from the very first season, a group of wolves contained the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Seer'?
Then he recalled the pattern composed of letters on the letter Selena wrote him, which was a wolf's head.
At this moment, Leonard suddenly said, "Demonic Wolf of Fog!"
Hobert was stunned, this must be a reminder from the old man again!
Daly, having the authority to access related information, explained to the other team members, "The 'Demonic Wolf of Fog' is a creature known for its strangeness and variability, said to be above the level of a demigod.
"It has the ability to control marionettes, and possesses extremely strong anti-divination and anti-reconnaissance capabilities."
Hobert thought back, he didn't seem to have any memory of how Klein got this main ingredient.
"The information is becoming clearer!" Daly said, "The source of the corruption is a 'Demonic Wolf of Fog,' its condition may already be very bad, close to being out of control!"
Daly pondered for a moment, "We must find a way to get the tourists here out of danger as soon as possible!"
Having identified the source of the corruption, Daly also determined that this was not a problem that the "Red Gloves" members in the manor could solve, so she completely changed her mission from resolving the source of corruption to rescuing the tourists here.
At this moment, screams came from the direction of the manor.
Daly immediately ordered everyone to return and investigate.
The monster on the ground shouted, "Hey, hey, hey, you promised to put me back in the water."
"Almost forgot about you." Daly grabbed at the strange fish, which screamed miserably and quickly lost its life.
Daly kicked the fish into the water, "I fulfilled my promise, I put you back in the water. But I didn't say whether it was the living you or the dead you that I put back in the water."
Hobert, walking at the back, smiled. At least he had told "Seaweed" that he was lying, Daly was planning to "fulfill her promise in another way" from the beginning.
Still some distance from the manor, they saw a giant moth flying in the air above the manor, its wings scattering a lot of gray powder. The people in the manor's courtyard who inhaled the powder fell to the ground as if asleep.
There was also a giant moth flying at low altitude, it was very strong and could throw a person far away.
Soon, those in the courtyard who were not injured and had not inhaled the powder fled into the hall.
The two moths then turned their attention to Daly and the others who had just entered the manor. They took out their revolvers, but Leonard suddenly shouted, "That's, that's Hant!"
Only then did everyone realize that below the long antennae and large compound eyes on the moth's head was a human face.
Hobert vaguely recognized that their appearances seemed to be one of the two "Red Gloves" members he had rescued!
"Fire!" Daly ordered.
Bang, bang, bang~
Under the attack of the "Demon Hunter Bullets," the two "moths" fell to the ground, making painful sizzling sounds.
The "Red Gloves" members aimed their guns at one of the "moths." They hesitated slightly, but ultimately pulled the triggers together!
Only then did everyone come forward to check, and finally confirmed that these were the two team members that Hobert had rescued earlier, who could not be awakened after fainting.
Daly asked Hobert, "You said before that you rescued them from a cocoon, right?"
"Yes." Hobert said, "They should have suffered serious corruption at that time, but this corruption seems difficult to detect."
Not only Hobert, but even Daly and the others had not noticed any signs of corruption in the two companions.
The companions who had been rescued by Hobert had turned into this, the other two members who had requested assistance should have already met with misfortune. Daly ordered two more members to take another carriage to seek help.
At this time, Leonard suggested, "Should we retreat as a group? And wait for higher-level assistance?"
Daly shook her head, "I brought 1-068, even if we encounter the source of corruption, we have the strength to fight."
But it would be best if there were no direct conflict.
After two more members left, only Daly, Leonard, and a Sequence 7 named Jess remained of the "Red Gloves" members in the manor.
At this time, the tourists who had fled to the hall earlier came out to check the situation, and they were all amazed to see such large moths.
Daly had Jess deal with the tourists and organize them to rescue the injured.
She, Leonard, and Hobert took a short rest and went to the third suspicious location.
At this point, Hobert no longer had any hope of saving Selena. She may have entered that pine forest, or she may be in the village on the other side of the mountain. In any case, she had either turned into a moth or had been severely polluted.
But since they had already checked two suspicious locations, it wouldn't hurt to go to the last location to see if they could gather more information.
Entering the pine forest, everything seemed to quiet down immediately, or rather, there was no sign of life here.
In the trees and under the trees, there were many cocoons of different sizes.
Hobert cut open two of them with his knife. Some of the cocoons contained people, and some contained wild animals. Logically speaking, these corpses should have lost their lives in the past few days, but without exception, they were all highly decayed, and many dense gray moth larvae were crawling out from under the corpses' brownish-gray skin.
Hobert suddenly thought of the gray moths that had landed on the hunting team before, and he felt a little nauseous.
Suddenly, Hobert's scalp went numb, and he felt extreme danger. He thrust his knife into the air, but hit nothing.
Then he looked up and saw a pair of huge eyes.
Hobert suddenly felt a little dizzy, as if he saw strange brilliance from the dense canopy. That brilliance was very dazzling, very charming, and almost attracted all of Hobert's attention.
With the last bit of focus, Hobert injected his spirituality into the "Order Crystal" on his cane, and a black shield immediately appeared around him.
In that instant, Hobert seemed to lose all vision. Almost instinctively, Hobert threw himself to the ground and rolled, and his vision became dim again.
A gray moth the size of a rhinoceros landed beside the three of them. Its tail had a structure like a scorpion's tail, and it had just stabbed at Hobert. Fortunately, Hobert used the power of "Nation of Disorder" with the help of the "Order Crystal" to get himself out of the illusionary state.
Seeing that Hobert was about to wake up, the moth quickly flapped its wings to take off. Hobert rushed over in three steps and cut off its "scorpion tail" with one slash.
Then the blade went upward, cutting a hole in its abdomen.
Amidst the moth's "sizzling" sound, Hobert used "Lightning Strike" again, hitting the moth's head directly.
The moth fell to the ground, but it was still not dead.
Immediately, a scalp-numbing "buzzing" sound rang out. Hobert, as well as Daly and Leonard, who had woken up from the illusion, discovered that they were surrounded by countless moths. Some of these moths were the size of normal moths, and some were as big as cats and dogs!
"Golden clouds, fluttering over the silent earth; vast silent fields, shimmering with dewdrops!"
As Leonard recited the verses in a melodious voice, silent waves that could not be seen rippled around, and most of the gray moths became calm, or folded their wings and fell to the ground from mid-air.
Hobert seized the opportunity and slashed off the head of the giant gray moth that had been struck by lightning with one blow!
The gray moth's six legs and wings struggled desperately, as if its vitality was even more vigorous.
Hobert saw the pair of wings with huge eyes again. These eyes were on a pair of hind wings, and even though Hobert was mentally prepared, he still felt a little dazed.
He quickly cut off this pair of wings with his knife, letting the pattern of the wings face the ground.
"Many times I marvel at the endurance of life." A voice suddenly appeared on a tree branch behind Hobert and the others.
It was Harold, of course, the three people under the tree knew that this must be a fake Harold.
Then Hobert had doubts about his spirituality and ability. The illusionary attack of the giant gray moth just now had affected both Sequence 5s.
Now, a person suddenly appeared behind them, and Hobert and Daly had not noticed it.
Harold said, "That was originally an ordinary gray moth, which survived the initial stage of corruption by a one in ten thousand, or even one in a million chance.
"Later I found that it actually had the ability to absorb corruption, and its offspring also had this ability, so I simply tricked some people into coming to this forest to raise them and absorb the corruption from my body.
"As a result, it later developed the ability to create illusions. It does not possess Beyonder characteristics, but its wings are like a magic circle that can cause people to have illusions.
"And the power that drives this magic circle is the corruption it absorbs from me, the level is quite high, and anyone below the level of an angel will be affected by this illusionary magic circle."
He paused and smiled, "You have done me a great favor, otherwise I wouldn't know how to deal with it."
Harold looked at Hobert, obviously very interested in the things on Hobert's body that could isolate such high-level corruption.
Hobert guessed, "You are the Demonic Wolf of Fog that was polluted?"
"It seems you have obtained a lot of information about me." Harold, or rather, the Demonic Wolf of Fog, generously admitted, "That's right, it's me."
Hobert asked, "Do you know Selena from Tingen City?"
"That's a little girl with very high inspiration." Harold, or rather, the Demonic Wolf of Fog, said, "I told her to run into this forest, but she didn't completely believe me, and instead chose to escape in another direction.
"She has been wandering in the mountains, but she has not escaped my control so far, and has been subjected to my corruption."
Hobert did not expect that this little girl was quite clever, "Why don't you turn the people here into marionettes? And just simply lure them?"
"If they become my marionettes, they will have a close connection with me, and the corruption may return again." Harold said, "So I will only briefly connect your spirit body threads and transfer the corruption to you."
Hobert asked again, "Has this method been successful?"
"Very successful." Harold smiled, "The corruption on my body has been basically transferred out!"
"How did you get polluted?"
"Don't know."
Hobert was stunned, "Don't know? You don't know even with your level and ability?"
"I have received some revelations, but I can't interpret them." Harold shook his head, "But I can be sure that this is very high-level corruption."
Harold thought for a moment and said, "Before I was polluted, I got a small bottle of white mist, which is said to contain the ultimate secrets of the Trunsoest Empire.
"But the next day, the mist in the bottle disappeared, and I was polluted. Thinking about it now, I should have been polluted because of this."
Hobert showed a very interested expression, "The ultimate secret of the Trunsoest Empire?"
Harold smiled, "Although your chances of surviving are very slim, I still can't tell you the details."
"How are you going to kill us?"
"I don't have to do anything, this corruption will soon cause you to show signs of losing control." Harold said, "The people you sent out to seek help, they can't leave the barrier I set up at all.
"You're definitely going to say that you had a colleague named Harold who escaped from here."
Seeing "Harold" talk about Harold was a bit awkward for everyone.
"Harold" sneered: "I let him go on purpose."
"If none of them had escaped, the Church of the Evernight Goddess would definitely organize a stronger team to deal with me, and they might even send a demigod."
"But if someone escapes, they will only send a relatively elite 'Red Gloves' team."
"This will buy me some time, and by the time the Church of the Evernight Goddess realizes something is wrong and sends a second batch of reinforcements, it will be at least two days later."
And in those two days, Hobert and the others would have already turned into monsters due to the corruption.
This made Hobert sigh: As expected of the 'Old Schemer' pathway! This is just a magical creature of that pathway, and it's already so good at playing tricks and schemes.
Then Hobert tentatively asked: "I have the ability to 'Travel', you can't trap me!"
Harold smiled: "Haven't you noticed? Since you approached the manor, the two times you used 'Travel' you only appeared on the mountain opposite the manor, and didn't leave the five-kilometer radius!
"You have been corrupted, which is equivalent to having a psychological suggestion planted in you, you can't escape!"
Hobert then asked: "What about the village you mentioned across the mountain?"
He asked questions while moving his wrist, as if he had been injured in the battle with the giant gray moth.
"Not bad, not bad, you actually noticed the village!" Harold laughed: "If you were in normal condition, I would have planned to turn you into my marionette!"
Hobert understood: "That's your 'Marionette Village'!"
"Not anymore. During this corruption, they began to worship a god from the depths of the universe." Harold said: "I have severed contact with all the marionettes. They have become living corpses with some intelligence, but their remaining intelligence is limited to worshiping that evil god.
"Predating living people is their nature. Without my restraint, they will find food themselves."
And for those living corpses, Boklun Manor is the largest 'food garden' around.
Hobert nodded: "So, you won't turn me into a marionette, right?"
Harold raised his head: "I should say, you no longer have the qualifications to become my marionette."
"That puts my mind at ease." Hobert smiled: "I'll show you something good."
He suddenly raised the oil painting!
When Hobert was moving his wrist just now, his other hand was untying the rope on the oil painting.
Daly and Leonard, who were closer, also noticed this, so at the same time as Hobert raised the oil painting, Daly already had a necklace with a huge black pearl in her hand.
The surroundings instantly darkened, as if it had suddenly become night, and the Demonic Wolf of Fog fell into a dazed, half-asleep state.
The Demonic Wolf of Fog originally had time to switch positions with a marionette, even under the attack of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, so it stood there confidently, as if showing off its masterpiece, and talked eloquently.
But what it didn't expect was that just as it was about to switch places with the marionette, its mind suddenly went blank, and the thought of switching positions with the marionette seemed to have been stolen.
If it were in the past, it wouldn't have met Hobert and the others in its true form, but today it had just severed contact with its previous marionettes and was in a stage where it didn't have a normal marionette that could be turned into a human form.
By the time the Demonic Wolf of Fog came back to its senses, it had already been affected by "1-068", and its heart became very peaceful, and it would almost immediately fall asleep.
The Demonic Wolf of Fog also felt very strange, there were clearly no Beyonders of the 'Marauder' pathway among these three people, nor were there any Sealed Artifacts of that pathway, so how could its thoughts have disappeared just now?
Hobert, however, already understood that it was the old grandpa in Leonard's body who had taken action, because he didn't bring the demigod-level "Marauder" pathway Sealed Artifact "1-101".
In a half-asleep state, the Demonic Wolf of Fog saw a beautiful landscape painting, which made it sigh: "What a beautiful landscape!"
The monster with the eye growing on its chest appeared, and Hobert noticed that its skin had turned black, and the curse it emitted had also been significantly strengthened.
It seemed that Farbauti just descended once in this dream and brought some strengthening to the oil painting.
The Demonic Wolf of Fog finally woke up a bit, and it tried its best to use its ability. Its position was finally exchanged with a flying ash moth marionette hundreds of meters away.
In the end, the monster's curse fell on an ash moth, and the Demonic Wolf of Fog on the original branch disappeared without a trace.
Hobert quickly stepped forward and killed the monster with one blow, and the monster's shadow turned into nothingness.
As he picked up the oil painting, he said: "The guys of the 'Seer' pathway are so hard to kill." He also wrapped the two wings into the oil painting.
Hobert didn't expect to kill the Demonic Wolf of Fog with one blow. Being able to successfully mark the Demonic Wolf of Fog's spirituality was already a blessing. He would find this magical wolf to settle the score when he had the opportunity.
Daly also knew that now was not the time to hunt down the Demonic Wolf of Fog: "We must make some preparations before the Demonic Wolf of Fog's marionette arrives at the manor."
Hobert nodded: "You guys go back first, I'll go find Selena."
Without waiting for Daly and the others to answer, Hobert had already used the ability of "Low Flight" to fly out of the canopy and search for Selena's figure on the mountain.
More than ten minutes later, Hobert finally found Selena, who was exhausted and sitting on a rock to rest.
Seeing Hobert, who had returned to his own appearance, descending from the sky, Selena happily said: "Teacher! I knew you would come to save me!"
Hobert smiled, the main purpose of this trip to Loen was finally achieved.
Just as he was about to use "Travel" to take Selena away, Hobert suddenly saw an abstract symbol painted in the snow, the symbol consisted of zigzagging vertical and horizontal lines, and several dots.
Hobert's eyes narrowed, he was very familiar with this symbol, but he couldn't recall the relevant information.
Selena noticed that Hobert's eyes were different from just now, she explained: "That's a symbol I saw in a dream, and I don't know why it's so deeply imprinted in my mind, I couldn't help but reach out and draw it several times."
"You wait here for a while!" Hobert used two "Blink" to hide behind a big tree, and then entered the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert instantly "recalled" the relevant memory: "Uncertain Mist!"
Hobert finally understood that it was "Uncertain Mist" that had polluted the Demonic Wolf of Fog, and the source of the corruption was that bottle of white mist.
No wonder even the Demonic Wolf of Fog's level couldn't divine the source of the corruption, and only knew that this corruption level was very high.
Hobert also finally understood why these white mists that polluted his spiritual body would directly integrate into the "Nation of Disorder", because the "Uncertain Mist" the part of the "Nation of Disorder", and it has the same origin as the "Nation of Disorder" controlled by Hobert, so the corruption is just some nutrients for the "Nation of Disorder".

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 452 The True Image of the Uncertain Mist
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert, having changed his appearance once again, returned to the mountain lodge with Serena. The Wood family quickly greeted them, eager to inquire about the situation. Serena introduced Hobert to her family: "This is my mysticism mentor; I was fortunate to be rescued thanks to him."
"You don't need to worry anymore. As long as my mentor is here, we won't be in any danger."
The two giant gray moths from before had left a significant psychological impact on the family. If it weren't for some plainclothes policemen (Red Gloves) holding them back, they would have already rushed out to search for Serena and leave the lodge.
Of course, that was assuming they could leave.
Hobert turned to Serena and said, "I'll have a proper talk with you later."
He then approached Daly, "How about we make a deal?"
Already feeling overwhelmed, Daly casually asked, "What deal?"
She didn't know how many puppets the Demonic Wolf of Fog had, but since they could form a village, there were likely many.
However, she currently only had two subordinates. The two she sent for reinforcements had not yet returned, and she didn't know how things were on their end.
"I'll personally block those puppets, but the condition is..."
Daly glanced at Hobert, "What is it?"
She initially thought Hobert was joking, but his serious expression suggested otherwise!
Hobert repeated, "I can block those puppets, but the condition is that all the Beyonder characteristics on them belong to me!"
After learning about the "source of corruption," Hobert had a plan to deal with the enemy. If it were corruption from other ancient gods, he wouldn't dare be so arrogant. But against the corruption of the "Uncertain Mist," with the "Nation of Disorder" in hand and within Earth's barrier, this level of corruption was nothing to him!
Daly scrutinized Hobert again, "Don't be reckless!"
Hobert smiled, "Just tell me if you're willing to make this deal with me."
Daly pondered for a moment before saying, "Deal!"
She wasn't confident in leading the tourists away. Leaving aside whether they could escape the barrier mentioned by the Demonic Wolf of Fog, just encountering those puppets during the transfer would be a massacre.
Since this young man carrying an oil painting was so confident, she might as well let him try. It was just some Beyonder characteristics; it wasn't a significant loss for the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
After reaching the agreement, Hobert jumped onto the roof, observing the surroundings.
Daly, on the other hand, was still trying to set up defenses in case Hobert failed to stop the puppets.
In the end, Daly arranged for everyone to gather in the reception hall. The space was large enough, and they only needed to block the side doors and focus on guarding the main entrance.
After settling everyone down, only a few minutes passed before a man in his thirties suddenly appeared in the courtyard. He was expressionless and seemed devoid of any life.
Many tourists thought they were seeing things because the man suddenly appeared in the snow, where there had been nothing before. Soon, everyone sensed something was wrong with him. Even ordinary people could feel that he wasn't a normal human.
The man "flashed" again, appearing in front of the window, startling many of the onlookers, who retreated in fright.
Just as the man was about to "Blink" again, he suddenly looked up at the roof. Hobert jumped down from the roof, "Disorder!"
The man immediately used "Blink" to dodge, but "Disorder" had already locked onto the target, making it impossible to evade even with "Blink."
The man simply disappeared from the courtyard, using "Travel" to avoid "Disorder."
"Disorder" also had an effective range. Once outside that range, Hobert's attack could be avoided.
After this brief exchange, Hobert understood the state of these puppets: they lacked intelligence, relying mainly on instinct to fight. Their senses weren't very sharp; they only noticed me ambushing on the roof when I was a dozen meters away.
This skirmish seemed to herald the start of the puppets' attack. Soon, over a dozen figures darted into the courtyard, some human, some beast-like.
Lightning, holy light, curses, and other attacks rained down on Hobert in the courtyard.
Even with their limited intelligence, Hobert and Daly, along with the other four, were no match for them.
Daly and Leonard in the reception hall were closely watching Hobert, ready to launch a rescue if he was in danger.
Serena was also sweating for her teacher; the enemies seemed very difficult to deal with.
A layer of black shield appeared around Hobert, blocking the first wave of extraordinary attacks.
Then everyone saw Hobert lower his head and begin to pray, seemingly taking a few steps back unconsciously.
(After Sequence 5, Hobert only needed to take three or four procedural steps back to enter the "Nation of Disorder," unlike the larger movements he needed initially.)
Immediately afterward, a tremendous mental pressure appeared in mid-air. Even ordinary tourists without spiritual vision couldn't help but lower their heads, afraid to look outside.
Daly and others saw the figure sitting amidst the swords. It radiated holy light, and its majestic aura filled the air, causing people to lower their heads involuntarily, wanting to submit.
Even Daly lowered her head unconsciously.
Leonard heard a voice only he could hear exclaim, "Solomon?"
That was Pallez's "old boss."
However, the voice then said, "It can't be Him! Trunsoest?"
Because Hobert wasn't using his original face, he wasn't afraid of Daly and the others finding out that he could beseech the "Creator's" attention.
...
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert immediately saw white mist entwined around the puppets as he projected his power using his astral projection.
Without Hobert even needing to act, this white mist flowed towards the "Creator" on its own!
The puppets seemed to sense something as well, turning their heads to run back.
Hobert reached out and grabbed, accelerating the flow of mist toward himself.
The mist was like the puppets' life force. As the mist gradually disappeared, their movements slowed down, and they eventually fell to the ground, becoming truly abandoned puppets, mere corpses.
Hobert withdrew his power, feeling a sense of foreboding. The palace he had built cracked open from the middle, and he saw the white mist he had absorbed into the "Nation of Disorder" congeal in mid-air.
It formed a phantom wheel-shaped object with a black ring on the outside and chaotic but orderly small black cylinders in the center. Some of these cylinders intersected, while others didn't connect with any other cylinders.
The wheel-shaped object gave a sense of solidity and antiquity, as if it had existed for a very long time, filled with mystery and the unknown.
Its appearance was somewhat similar to the "wheel-shaped space station" Hobert had seen in the Common Era, but Hobert sensed through his spirituality that it wasn't an alien high-tech product. It was the image of the "Uncertain Mist's" main body.
However, what was in the "Nation of Disorder" was just a projection.
Even as just a projection, Hobert felt a tremendous threat. His control over the "Nation of Disorder" seemed to waver.
Therefore, Hobert immediately mobilized the greatest power he could muster to entangle the "Uncertain Mist's" projection. With his efforts, the projection, which didn't have much actual power, was crushed and dissolved in the Nation of Disorder.
In the instant the other party dissolved, Hobert saw two scenes. The first scene was the "Uncertain Mist's" main body appearing on the ocean of a certain planet. The main body, of course, wasn't as illusory as the projection but was very solid.
Dense white mist constantly surrounded and flowed around the "Uncertain Mist," giving a mysterious and powerful feeling.
Even just a scene gave Hobert tremendous pressure. This was the pressure brought about by the difference in position, almost making him kneel before the "Iron Throne."
This scene flashed by, followed by a second scene.
The second scene was a picturesque valley with snow-capped mountains, a magnificent hall on the mountainside, and birds and flowers in the valley. Some villas and residences were scattered throughout the scenic valley.
In the magnificent hall, a grand ritual of sacrifice to the "Uncertain Mist" was being held. In the front row were three people who looked somewhat similar. The person in the middle had perfectly symmetrical features, gray eyes, and black hair, looking like a wax figure.
On the left was a woman with gray eyes and black hair. Her expression was erratic, as if she had difficulty concentrating.
On the right was a young man with black hair. He looked somewhat unruly, as if he didn't want to participate in such a ritual.
This scene also flashed by. Hobert only saw the three people clearly before the scene disappeared.
Hobert checked the situation in the "Nation of Disorder." There was no trace of the "Uncertain Mist" anymore.
Then he "closed" the palace he had built. First, he had a guess about the scene just now: that was equivalent to the projection sending coordinates to its main body before dissolving, but it was sent to Hobert instead.
The scene he just saw was a fragment of the main body's memory held by the projection.
This should be a warning mechanism similar to a projection, telling the main body that there was danger here, or that there was an opportunity.
However, in the special environment of the "Nation of Disorder," such a "warning" couldn't be sent out at all. Even in the real world, similar warnings would be difficult for the "Uncertain Mist" to locate Hobert after being blocked by the barrier.
Hobert could make such a guess based on Farbauti's experience fighting the "Mother Tree of Desire." If every move Farbauti made could be watched by the "Mother Tree of Desire," then the "Devil Monarch" would have fallen long ago.
Also, the two scenes were very crucial information, but now wasn't the time to consider these things. There were still many people outside looking at him expectantly, so Hobert immediately returned to the real world, pretending to say, "Praise the Creator!"
Then he used the "Spirit Wine Glass" to arrange the dozen or so puppets that had turned into corpses in a row and accelerated the extraction of the Beyonder characteristics within them.
Four or five seconds later, the puppets lined up to send the Beyonder characteristics or extraordinary materials into Hobert's hands.
There were a total of ten Beyonder characteristics and four extraordinary materials.
The Beyonder characteristics of the four extraordinary creatures that were turned into puppets by the Demonic Wolf of Fog were basically in a certain part of their bodies. Hobert could easily sense the parts with Beyonder characteristics with his spirituality and have them dig out the characteristic parts themselves.
The only flaw was that Hobert didn't bring enough containers today and couldn't collect some of the spiritual materials on them.
After Hobert collected all the spoils, Daly and Leonard came out of the hall to avoid causing unnecessary misunderstandings.
Hobert smiled, "I told you, I can solve these puppets myself."
Daly smiled. Who would have thought that this "young man carrying an oil painting" could beseech the help of a god-like existence: "According to our previous agreement, if there are no gains in this mission, we will also give you a reward."
Hobert wasn't greedy, "No, I've already gotten what I wanted just now. I don't need your reward."
"These are two different things. What you gained just now was our deal and doesn't belong to our previously agreed mission," Daly said generously to win over the young man. If possible, she would use the reward to attract him and wait until her own demigod arrived.
After all, in the eyes of official Beyonders, all hidden existences other than the seven orthodox gods are evil gods.
And those hidden existences didn't disappoint official Beyonders, often showing enough madness and evil.
So Daly planned to arrest the young man when she was confident.
Hobert smiled, "I don't want the reward. You guys do what you need to do. I'm going to talk to my student alone."
Daly secretly felt it was a pity, "Okay, the Church of the Evernight Goddess will remember the contribution you made today."
For Hobert, this problem was easy to solve, but for Daly and the others, it was difficult. They were even prepared to sacrifice themselves here.
After all, that was a Demonic Wolf of Fog's puppet, and there might be a demigod-level opponent among them.
Just then, a scream came from the crowd. Someone suddenly fell to the ground. The moisture in his limbs was quickly drained, but his stomach quickly bulged.
Finally, his limbs became as dry as dead wood, and his body and head were like a fat worm, rolling around on the ground, constantly shouting, "Save me, save me..."
Seeing that the other party's mutation was irreversible, Leonard directly shot him, ending his pain.
The process of ordinary people being polluted and turning into monsters is irreversible. Killing him was a relief for him.
The people around were so frightened that they were about to scatter and flee, but Daly immediately said, "Gather around me. I will pray for the power of the Goddess to dispel the evil power in your bodies!"
Everyone seemed to have found a backbone and gathered around Daly.
With Leonard's assistance, Daly quickly prepared the altar and then prayed for the Goddess's power: "The Evernight Goddess stands higher than the cosmos and more eternal than eternity; You are the Lady of Crimson, the Mother of Concealment, the Empress of Misfortune and Horror, the Mistress of Repose and Silence.
"Your devout believers beseech Your attention.
"We pray that You will save these innocent people around the altar and eliminate the corruption in our bodies."
While chanting the prayer, she burned the corresponding essential oils and herbs. The altar was filled with a sense of tranquility.
After the prayer was completed, a surge of profound peace descended, making the surrounding tourists feel as if they were in the dead of night, on the verge of falling asleep.
A cup of coffee next to the altar suddenly tipped over, and the coffee-colored liquid flowed like it was alive to the center of the altar, forming letters one by one.
Having performed so many rituals, this was the first time that Daly had encountered such a situation.
The coffee ultimately formed a sentence: Let Hobert eliminate your corruption; he has already received my blessing in advance.

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 453 Arranged by the Goddess (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to John Doe for becoming a free member]
Daly stared at the words on the altar for a full ten seconds. Usually, rituals involved praying to the Goddess for healing companions, crafting charms, or seeking the power of fate, the power of darkness, and so on.
No matter what they prayed for, they would recite the prayer and wait for the Goddess's response.
Generally, the Nighthawks' prayers would receive some response from the Goddess.
But that response was only the Goddess bestowing some kind of power; there had never been a response like a sentence appearing on the altar.
As the overwhelming sense of drowsiness faded, Daly came back to her senses: "Hobert, who's Hobert? Which Hobert?"
Finally, she looked at the young man with the oil painting on his back, talking to Selena in the yard.
…
Hobert called Selena over to the two large "moths": "They were two Beyonders before, but they were contaminated by a high-level power, so they became like this."
Selena had seen them earlier, but hadn't looked closely. Now, she felt somewhat shocked: "Teacher, is this the true face of the world?"
"Yes," Hobert said. "I said in the letter that I wanted to talk to you about something recently, and that's what I wanted to talk about.
"Your and Elizabeth's intuition are both relatively high, so the probability of encountering extraordinary events is higher. The Aurora Order, your previous divination teacher, wanted to develop you into their peripheral members because they valued your intuition."
Selena felt a huge sense of crisis for the first time: "Teacher, what should I do?"
"Either pretend nothing happened and try to tell yourself not to touch extraordinary events, or things that look or sound strange," Hobert scrutinized the "moths" in front of him:
"Or, become an Beyonder as soon as possible and have the ability to protect yourself.
"The Beyondr world and Beyonder power won't give you time to spend more time with your family and then become an Beyonder without any worries. Sometimes, the closer you are to your relatives, the easier it is to bring disaster to them."
Selena lowered her head with tears in her eyes and said, "I understand, Teacher. I will say goodbye to my family and then leave with you."
"Enjoy your New Year's holiday," Hobert said. "When the New Year's holiday is over, I will come and pick you up."
Selena wiped the corners of her eyes: "Thank you, Teacher!"
At this moment, Hobert saw Daly and Leonard walking over quickly, and he stepped forward: "I'll help Selena clear the corruption in her body, you guys take care of your own business!"
"Hobert Jeffrey!" Daly stared at him with certainty.
Hobert scratched his head and smiled: "You've mistaken me, my name is Gehrman Sparrow."
Daly shook her head: "The Goddess has given instructions, asking you to help eliminate the corruption in our bodies. She said you have already received the gift in advance!"
"F..." Hobert saw Daly and Leonard's faces suddenly darken, and he immediately changed his words: "Don't worry, I will help you solve the problem."
Then he thought seriously: When did I ever receive a gift from the Evernight Goddess or the Evernight Goddess Church?
Suddenly, Hobert recalled the hand he encountered before entering the manor, and the bracelet on that hand.
Now that bracelet was lying on the stone platform of the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert went with Daly to the reception hall, while taking a breath: Could this be the Evernight Goddess's authority related to fate?
Selena's family are all devout believers of the Evernight Goddess, and Hobert didn't quite believe that there was no Evernight Goddess's manipulation in this.
For a moment, Hobert also felt that his actions this time seemed to have been arranged: What are you arranging me for? I didn't hang out with you in the "Sefirah Castle" for so many years! We're not that familiar! You want me to eliminate corruption, aren't you afraid of losing prestige in front of the 'Red Gloves'?
Hobert glanced at Daly and the others, and found that they had no doubts about the Evernight Goddess, but instead looked respectful, believing that everything was in the Evernight Goddess's control.
He smiled helplessly: Well, I still have a lot of room for improvement in the matter of "being a god."
Then Hobert guessed that the Evernight Goddess had also marked him, after all, when he just became a "Lawyer", he had prayed to the Evernight Goddess for help twice.
And the first time he prayed, the help he received was obviously a little strange. The power of the Evernight Goddess's descent seemed a little too strong, and he fell asleep before he could even lie down on the bed.
After figuring out this problem, Hobert also came to the crowd. He once again pretended to pray, praying for the help of the "Creator".
Because the corruption on the passengers was not as serious as on the marionettes, there was no need for the image of the "Creator" to appear this time. Just through the star representing Hobert himself, he could absorb the corruption of the "Uncertain Mist".
After the corruption in their bodies was absorbed, everyone felt relaxed and thanked Hobert.
Then Hobert came to the woods with moths again, and he repeated the same operation, absorbing all the corruption that the moths in the woods had absorbed.
This corruption may have been transferred once, so it was not as pure as the Mist Wolves and those marionettes. It did not form the image of "Uncertain Mist" again in the "Nation of Disorder", but silently dissolved in the "Nation of Disorder".
…
Dozens of kilometers away from Boklun Manor, a wolf, about the size of a rhinoceros, shuttling through the snow and trees suddenly stopped.
Its body was surrounded by a thick, rolling mist. Within dozens of meters, only a cloud of mist could be seen, and at most a figure of a giant wolf could be seen in the mist.
Hundreds of meters away, only a cloud of mist could be seen.
The Demonic Wolf of Fog looked in the direction of Boklun Manor: "The corruption there has disappeared!"
He shook his head thoughtfully and continued to flee.
…
Inside Boklun Manor, Hobert sat opposite Daly and Leonard.
Hobert spoke first: "I didn't expect us to meet again here. As you know, I have a bounty on my head, so I can't use my own appearance in the Loen Kingdom."
Daly smiled: "Then you can reveal your identity, are you afraid that I will arrest you to exchange for the bounty?"
"I'm doing this to avoid causing trouble for you," Hobert said shamelessly, while he looked at Daly's subordinates over there, as if to say: I don't distrust you, but I don't trust your subordinates.
In fact, he didn't intend to recognize Daly and Leonard at all, so that everyone could avoid trouble.
Leonard suddenly thought of a sentence Daly had said a long time ago: "Although the royal family said you are a traitor, the Evernight Goddess Church has never issued a similar statement."
Hobert thought about it, and it was true: "In that case, can I continue to trade with you? I had agreed with Captain Thomas that he would buy some Beyonder characteristics from me."
Especially those Beyonder characteristics that are difficult to sell, such as the "Criminal" pathway, that is, the "Abyss" pathway, and the "Seer" pathway.
Hobert only wanted to sell these Beyonder characteristics to the orthodox god churches, otherwise it would be easy to return to the hands of the Blood Sanctify Sect or the Aurora Order through multiple transactions.
Daly said: "I can report this matter, and I think there is no problem.
"It's just that the trading object will change from the Nighthawk team to the 'Red Gloves'."
Hobert: "That's great."
This was another huge gain of his trip.
He asked again: "Is the reward you mentioned earlier still valid?"
Daly smiled elegantly: "Didn't you say you didn't want the reward?"
"That was then, this is now," Hobert smiled.
He was also once a semi-official Beyonder, so of course he knew that Daly was using the reward as bait to find an opportunity to control him or investigate him.
Daly took a sip of the tea brought by the waiter and said: "You are still a formal member of the Nighthawk team, and saving the Goddess's believers is what you should do, why do you need a reward?"
Hobert sighed: Sure enough, "talking about feelings hurts money". Talking about this kind of thing with acquaintances is not as refreshing as talking to strangers.
The three chatted for a while, Hobert left a way to summon his messenger, and confirmed the time to pick up Selena, and then left here using "Travel".
The barrier set by the Demonic Wolf of Fog was a thick fog that could make people lose their way, but such a thick fog could not stop abilities like "Travel".
Hobert had been polluted before, and those pollutions would make him make the choice to continue staying near the manor.
Now that the corruption has basically been eliminated, at most there are a few Demonic Wolf of Fog's marionettes still wandering in the deep mountains, which no longer affects Hobert's use of "Travel".
As for how Daly and the others would leave, Hobert believed that in the absence of corruption, the "Red Gloves" should have a way to cross the barrier set by the Demonic Wolf of Fog.
Returning to his territory, Hobert first ate a late lunch, then returned to his room and sacrificed all the Beyonder characteristics and extraordinary materials he had just obtained to the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert sat on the iron throne and first checked the ten Beyonder characteristics, one of which was actually a demigod-level Beyonder characteristic of the "Warrior" pathway!
That is to say, there was a "Demon Hunter" among the Demonic Wolf of Fog's marionettes!
Hobert realized that the Demonic Wolf of Fog at its peak was actually very powerful, and even demigods were not its opponents.
The "Demon Hunter" marionette should be at the forefront in the Demonic Wolf of Fog's battle with the enemy to make up for the Demonic Wolf of Fog's shortcomings in melee combat and defense.
The other Beyonder characteristics were mostly Sequence 5. In terms of attack, there were "Light Priest", "Ocean Songster" and "Reaper".
In terms of playing tricks in the back, there were "Wraith" and "Dream Stealer", in terms of recovery, there was "Druid", and in terms of escape, there was "Traveler".
There were also a "Spirit guide" and a "Rose Bishop", which were more versatile than the equipment that Hobert had painstakingly managed.
This should be that the Demonic Wolf of Fog spent a long time accumulating so many marionettes that could cooperate with each other.
Not to mention demigods, even a Sequence 3 facing the attack of ten marionettes may not be the Demonic Wolf of Fog's opponent.
The four creatures also had their own uses, one of which should be one of the main materials needed by the "Sheriff".
Because it was in the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert's spirituality could give a clear judgment.
Hobert couldn't judge the other main materials at present, but they were also main materials at the Sequence 5 level.
Hobert looked at the dazzling array of spoils in front of him, and felt as if the Demonic Wolf of Fog's accumulation of decades, or even hundreds of years, had been harvested by him all at once.
If all of this was really arranged by the Evernight Goddess, it wouldn't hurt to arrange it a few more times.
The last trophy was the hallucination-inducing wings that Hobert had taken back casually.
He studied it briefly, and it was indeed as the Demonic Wolf of Fog said, it was a bit like a "naturally formed" magic circle, and Hobert hadn't figured out its specific use yet.
Hobert once again manifested a stone platform, put all the spoils on the stone platform, and then seriously considered the problem of the Evernight Goddess.
The only explanation he could think of was: "Uncertain Mist" and other ancient corruption are quite troublesome to solve for the current Evernight Goddess. The Evernight Goddess may have known for a long time that I am the "Creator", after all, if she marks me, she can often "spy". Or the Evernight Goddess simply knows that I am the "Creator's" blessed one, so she arranged me in this matter to help solve the corruption of the "Uncertain Mist".
As for the Evernight Goddess's "spying" problem, Hobert didn't think much about it, after all, he often "spied" before, and the Evernight Goddess wasn't embarrassed, what was there for him, a young man, to be embarrassed about?
And according to Hobert's spying experience, after he is promoted to demigod, he can use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to briefly avoid being "spied".
After becoming an angel, unless he invites the Evernight Goddess to watch, even if the Evernight Goddess wants to watch, she can only see some blurred pictures.
Hobert smiled: It's like wanting to peek at me taking a bath.
And about the fact that "Hobert is the 'Creator'" being known by the Evernight Goddess, Hobert didn't think there was a big problem, after all, he had always shown enough goodwill to the Evernight Goddess Church.
The most important thing is that his pathway doesn't conflict with the Evernight Goddess's pathway. Unless it involves god-level transactions, he shouldn't be suppressed by the Evernight Goddess.
The reason is simple: lack of motivation.
If he maintains the status quo, Hobert is still a member of the Nighthawk team, and the "Creator" is also the Evernight Goddess's secret ally.
But if he changes this strategy, Hobert will have a very hard time. If she can kill him, everything will be fine. If she doesn't kill him, the Evernight Goddess will lose a potential ally and gain an enemy.
In terms of cost, maintaining the status quo is the most beneficial for the Evernight Goddess.
After having a certain conclusion on this matter, Hobert recalled the two pictures when the projection of the "Uncertain Mist" disappeared.
The first picture brought a lot of impact to Hobert. This was the first time he had come into contact with the body of the "Uncertain Mist", and it was also the first time Hobert had felt the power of the "Uncertain Mist".
Before, Hobert had always felt that the "Uncertain Mist" was not a pillar among the outer gods, and its power should be ranked behind the "Mother Tree of Desire", and the key was that it had always had no sense of existence, so it shouldn't be very strong.
Today, Hobert had a thorough change of this self-righteous feeling. That was after all an ancient being, an ancient being with part of the "Sephirot"!
Even without the support of any Sequence 1 characteristic, He is still a very powerful existence. At least below the level of True Gods, no one can hope to harm Him.
Hobert also thought about how, after he prepared to become King of Angels, he planned to find trouble with the 'Unshadowed Crucifix,' which would have been purely to deliver Beyonder characteristics!
Then Hobert recalled the second scene, that bird-filled and fragrant valley, which Hobert had seen in a spiritual connection long ago.
That was the settlement of the Tamara family!
And among the three people at the very front of the sacrificial ritual, it is very likely that one of them is Tamara herself.
Back then, among the five great families of the Tudor Dynasty, besides the Abraham family, the Amon family, and the Antigonus family, which had the level of 'King of Angels,' the other two families were the Jacob family and the Tamara family.
To be a great noble family of the empire at that time, one had to be at least a Sequence 2 Angel. The Tamara family initially controlled the 'Justiciar' pathway, and later, through marriage with the Abraham family, they gained control of some of the 'Door' pathway's potions and Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert had previously speculated that the ancestor of the Tamara family should have been a Sequence 2 'Balancer' of the 'Justiciar' pathway, because all three Sequence 1 characteristics were with the 'Night Emperor' at that time.
However, after the 'Blood Emperor' Tudor fell, there was no definite information proving that Tamara had also fallen. Hobert suspected that Tamara herself should have survived to this day.
Having reached the level of an Angel, as long as they didn't die in the 'War of the Four Emperors' back then, in the Fifth Epoch, unless they died of old age, almost no one could kill them in the North and South Continents without the presence of True Gods.
Later, after the 'Night Emperor' fell, Augustus and Castiya, who betrayed their 'old boss,' each obtained a Sequence 1 'Hand of Order'.
A similar history had been staged before, where Tudor and Trunsoest obtained the Sequence 1 characteristic by betraying their 'old boss,' Solomon.
The Uniqueness of the 'Justiciar' pathway is now with Castiya, but according to Adam, it seems that the Church of the God of Combat gave it to him not long ago.
There is also a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Justiciar' pathway, which is likely in the hands of a certain orthodox god's church, after all, it was the six gods who joined forces to kill the 'Night Emperor' back then.
The Church of the God of Combat should have also obtained the 'Brass Book' at that time.
Tamara should not have the courage and ability to take a Sequence 1 characteristic under the gaze of the six gods, unless there is some unknown transaction involved.
So Hobert guessed that if Tamara is still alive now, she should still be a Sequence 2 'Balancer.'
As for where that Sequence 1 characteristic is specifically, Hobert also has some guesses. From the perspective of dividing the spoils, the Church of the God of Combat already has the Uniqueness and should not have another Sequence 1.
The Church of the Eternal Night, the Church of Storms, and the Church of the Earth Mother are also unlikely to possess that Sequence 1. The former two churches support the founding of Loen, and the latter supports the founding of Feynapotter.
In the 'War of the Violated Oath,' in which the countries of the Northern Continent almost beat each other's brains out more than six hundred years ago, I believe that if these three churches had the Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 1, they would have given them to the secular forces they supported in order to achieve greater results and more believers.
Then the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom and the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun are more likely to possess that Sequence 1, and the probability of the Eternal Blazing Sun is greater than that of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
Because the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom also supported the Kingdom of Feynapotter in the early Fifth Epoch. Although they later broke up with the Church of the Earth Mother, they had at least supported it.
From the perspective of gaming and dividing the spoils, the Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun has a greater probability of obtaining that Sequence 1.
Hobert reviewed that period of history and could probably feel that after the six gods joined forces to kill the 'Night Emperor,' they were roughly divided into three to four camps.
Since the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms joined forces to seal 'Mr. Door' in the 'War of the Four Emperors,' it can be seen that their relationship was relatively close at that time, and they were in one camp.
Therefore, the God of Combat, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom must be hostile to this camp. In the early Fifth Epoch, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom and the Earth Mother were basically in the same camp, and they jointly supported the founding of Feynapotter.
The God of Combat and the Eternal Blazing Sun do not seem to have a very close cooperative relationship and can be regarded as 'non-aligned' or two different camps.
Then, from the perspective of the gods' game, the God of Combat, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom would not allow the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms camp to hold another Sequence 1 of the 'Justiciar' pathway.
Similarly, the Lord of Storms and the Eternal Blazing Sun would not allow the God of Knowledge and Wisdom and the Earth Mother camp to hold another Sequence 1.
The best result would be for each of the four camps to have one, so the Eternal Blazing Sun has the greatest probability of obtaining the last Sequence 1.
Returning to the Fourth Epoch, after Abraham was jointly sealed by the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms, many forces of the Abraham family should have defected to the Tamara family, after all, they are relatives who often intermarry.
Therefore, after the 'War of the Four Emperors' ended, the strength of the Tamara family should have increased, and it may even have directly added a 'Traveler.'
Or, in the long years of more than a thousand years, it is not impossible for the Tamara family to cultivate an Angel of the 'Door' pathway themselves.
These two forces should be the mainstay of the Tamara family today.
In addition, based on the law of mutual exchange of adjacent pathways, the Tamara family also controls certain Beyonder characteristics of the 'Black Emperor' pathway.
This pathway started the latest, and the highest-sequence holder may only be a demigod or a Sequence 3 Saint, and it is unlikely to be a Sequence 2 Angel.
Hobert guessed that these three pathways are not very united, which is why in the second scene, the three chief priests in front of the altar looked at each other with seeming agreement but were not sincere.
The reason is also obvious: the Angel of the 'Door' pathway can basically be equated with the corruption of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity.'
And the Tamara family seems to have an unclear relationship with the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity.' Eighty or ninety percent of the time, Tamara herself got something with the imprint of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' from her 'old boss,' and since then, she has established a 'connection' with the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity.'
Thinking about it now, the Tamara family is very much like an outer god's 'forward base.' Hobert is even considering whether to report it to the Evernight Goddess.
Then the three people in the second scene that Hobert obtained are likely to be the highest-level forces of the Tamara family: a Sequence 2 'Balancer,' a Sequence 2 'Planeswalker,' and at most a Sequence 3 'Frenzied Mage.'
Among the Angel families that have failed to become rulers of the North and South Continents, this kind of strength should be relatively high.
After sorting out the gains and intelligence from this operation, Hobert returned to the real world. Not long after, he received a notification from The Fool that 'Little Sun' had paid the 'Emperor' the arrears and rewards.
