chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 454: Reminder from the Poet Classmate (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Gregorius matthew Surya kusuma for becoming a free member]
Hobert looked at the seventeen dazzling Beyonder ingredients on the altar: the season of harvest had arrived!
He put the materials away, sacrificed the "Provoker Warhammer" to "The Fool," and then waited for another fifteen Beyonder ingredients.
Just then, Hobert thought of a very serious problem: these seventeen materials of five different kinds were difficult for him to distinguish by name and pathway!
His first thought was, who should he consult?
At that moment, the messenger suddenly appeared in Hobert's room, and a letter accurately flew into Hobert's raised hand.
Hobert looked at the sealing wax on the envelope, which was an abstract pattern of a book and an eye, quite unfamiliar.
Opening it, it turned out to be a letter from "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina.
The content of the letter was short, simply telling Hobert that pirates had discovered the flagship of "Vice Admiral Dusk" in the southwest of the Berserk Sea. Edwina promised that she would continue to send people to investigate the specific location of "Vice Admiral Dusk."
There was also a page of drawings in the letter, a very neat hand-drawn sea chart that was no less than a printed version.
It had a few islands marked in elegant handwriting, and the location where "Vice Admiral Dusk" was discovered.
Hobert compared it with the sea chart he had bought from Feynapotter, and easily got the approximate location of "Vice Admiral Dusk."
Putting down the sea chart, Hobert suddenly thought, isn't there a ready-made teacher!
So he began to write a reply, first thanking Edwina for providing the information, and then asking her in detail what the five Beyonder ingredients he had obtained this time were.
...
"Forsaken Land of the Gods," City of Silver!
Chad, the old man in charge of logistics, brought Derrick to the top of the round tower, to the Chief's room: "Your Excellency, take a look, Derrick was lucky enough to get an extraordinary weapon during an outing to collect materials!"
Chad handed over the weapon, which was somewhat bloody, stained, and looked very old.
Chief Colin took the "Provoker Warhammer" and looked at it. As a former "Weapon Master," he roughly knew the weapon's abilities as soon as he touched it.
Finally, he concluded: it's very suitable for facing monsters!
The always rigorous Colin even had a slight smile on his face, and he casually asked Derrick, "How did you get it?"
After this period of growth, Derrick had already prepared a response: "Chief, because of a transaction with a companion, I owed him a pair of 'Mirror Dragon's Eyes,' so I went to try to hunt a Mirror Dragon today, on the way..."
Derrick described vividly how he encountered a powerful monster, how his abilities restrained it, and how he accidentally obtained the warhammer after a fierce fight.
"Very good." Colin said to Chad, "Redeem more merits for him!"
As he spoke, he winked at Chad.
Chad understood and took the "Provoker Warhammer" returned by the Chief with both hands: "Yes!"
Derrick secretly breathed a sigh of relief in his heart. He originally prepared the reason he gave to Chad, but he didn't expect to report it to the Chief.
After the two left the round tower together, Chad indeed redeemed more merits for Derrick.
Derrick received the merits, exchanged them for materials, and happily went back.
Because he had seen the Chief, Derrick was more cautious this time and did not immediately exchange for the Beyonder ingredients that needed to be paid to "The Emperor" as planned, but only exchanged for a main material of "Solar High Priest."
After Derrick left, Chad took the "Provoker Warhammer" and came to the Chief's room again.
Colin picked up the "Provoker Warhammer" from the wooden box: "What did Derrick redeem with his merits?"
"A main material of 'Solar High Priest.'" Chad reported: "After returning from this exploration, he has already exchanged for a main material of 'Solar High Priest.' I heard that he also exchanged for some useless main materials on the black market."
Colin was stunned: "Useless main materials?"
"Yes, they are all main materials that cannot be used in the potion pathways we have mastered, and a lot can be exchanged with very few merits."
Colin thought for a while and asked again: "Are 'Mirror Dragon's Eyes' not among his redeemed items?"
"I'm not sure about this." Chad said: "But I heard that he exchanged for main materials at the Sequence 8 level."
He recalled for a moment and said: "About twenty days ago, he did come to exchange for 'Mirror Dragon's Eyes,' but there was no stock left."
Colin nodded. In this case, except for Derrick's exchange for useless main materials being a bit abnormal, there was nothing else that was too suspicious.
He stared at the "Provoker Warhammer" for more than ten seconds, and suddenly had an idea. He found a damp rag and wiped the old-looking areas of the weapon. After repeatedly wiping it a few times, it was wiped clean.
It was the same when wiping other places. Soon the weapon in Colin's hand became brand new.
Chad also saw something was wrong, because weapons seized from monsters had never been so clean. The stains on them could not be wiped off with a simple wipe: "Chief, should we find someone to keep an eye on him..."
Colin raised his hand: "No need, give Derrick some freedom, maybe he can bring us some surprises."
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert learned that "Little Sun" would have to wait a few days to pay for the weapon in order to avoid being suspected by the Chief.
Hobert first sacrificed the seventeen Beyonder ingredients he had obtained to the "Nation of Disorder," and waited until evening before finally receiving Edwina's reply.
As Hobert expected, Edwina indeed recognized all five main materials and gave a relatively detailed description of the monsters that yielded the five materials.
This gave Hobert an idea, and it would be easier to price them when selling them in the future.
Then Hobert pondered what to send Edwina as a return gift to thank her for her explanation.
Although Hobert knew that she liked to teach others, he still had to express his gratitude, so that it would be easier to ask her questions next time.
After thinking for a while, Hobert remembered that he had a notebook of Duke Southville from the Fourth Epoch, which recorded many anecdotes from the mid and late Fourth Epoch.
For Hobert, only a few paragraphs in this notebook were important, and there were excerpts already.
In fact, for those who don't know "0-05" or "Genie," those conversations that are more important to Hobert are just some anecdotes about the Night Emperor.
Hobert came to the "Nation of Disorder" and searched for a long time before finally finding the notebook. After rereading it, he simply tore off some places that might have important information, preparing to lie that he only had a part of this notebook himself.
This kind of ancient book was gathering dust in Hobert's place, so it was better to give it to Edwina, who had this kind of hobby.
After the kitchen's second batch of donuts was ready, Hobert packed the reply letter and the notebook full of Fourth Epoch anecdotes into a package and gave it to the messenger.
In the evening, it was time to wash his feet again.
After Dennis put down the foot washing water, he preemptively answered: "Lord, you asked me to fetch water for you, hoping that I would exercise my arm strength and waist strength while fetching water, right?"
Hobert looked at Dennis with bright eyes: "If you think I'm so superficial, I think you'll have to fetch water for another 50 years."
Dennis was slightly stunned and started to ponder again.
Before going to sleep, Hobert received another reply from Edwina, saying that she liked the notebook very much and read it all in one breath after receiving it.
Hobert smiled: "I'm glad you like it."
Hobert fell asleep while considering how to hunt "Vice Admiral Dusk."
Early the next morning, Hobert was sleeping soundly when a letter floated on his face.
By the time he took the letter away, the messenger had already entered the spirit world, as if to express his dissatisfaction with starting work so early.
Hobert yawned: "Who is sending me a letter so early?"
To his surprise, it was actually Leonard's letter.
In the letter, Leonard briefly described how they took the tourists away from Boklun Manor. They also found two or three Secret Puppets who had been caught in the net on the mountain.
However, the corruption on those Secret Puppets did not seem to be serious anymore, and they solved the problem relatively soberly.
Then Leonard reminded Hobert that the hidden existence that solved those Secret Puppets should be a big shot from the Fourth Epoch who had not completely died, and asked Hobert to be careful and not to completely trust this kind of god in poor condition.
Hobert smiled helplessly: Should I remind him to pay attention to the old grandpa in his body?
But thinking that Leonard was doing this out of good intentions, he sent a letter back to express his gratitude.
The kitchen of the lord's mansion had to start making donuts at dawn.
He summoned the messenger again. The messenger said while receiving the letter: "You've been very busy lately, sending letters so frequently that I don't have much time to rest."
Hobert immediately said: "I'll add three donuts for you this time!"
"It's good to be busy!" After getting six donuts, the messenger quickly disappeared into the spirit world.
Hobert smiled and took the remaining donuts to the restaurant to share with Donna and Fors.
After breakfast, Hobert started his work for the day. First, the land distribution work that had been going on for a week was basically completed, and Conrad came to report to Hobert on the progress of the work.
At the same time, in the past two days, Hobert's potion had indeed digested another wave, but the degree of digestion was not as obvious as last time.
Of course, this kind of formal business had to be discussed in the main hall. Hobert knew the number of cultivated land and orchards in the territory like the back of his hand, and had a clear understanding of the work reported by Conrad.
There was plenty of cultivated land in the territory. After all the land was distributed, there was still a large part of the lord's cultivated land.
After reporting on the land distribution, Conrad said again: "Lord, I found a phenomenon during the land distribution. There are many more people in each village!"
Hobert was stunned: "Did we have cases of falsely reporting the population when we did the household registration before?"
"That's not the case," Conrad smiled: "I did some research. The extra people are residents from the surrounding territories. I heard that we don't collect taxes here, so they came to rely on relatives and friends."
Hobert nodded and asked: "How many more people are there?"
"According to my preliminary understanding, there are more than 300 people who can rely on relatives and friends." Conrad said: "There are about 800 people who have no relatives and friends to rely on, and just want to rent land to farm here."
Hobert pondered for a while: "Didn't you just say that there is still a lot of land belonging to the lord's mansion? If we distribute those lands, how many people can we distribute them to?"
"About 400 people."
"Then distribute it!" Hobert smiled: "But pay attention, the land distributed to these people should be slightly less than the original residents, giving priority to the relatives and friends of the original residents, in order to reflect the preferential treatment for the original residents and create a little sense of superiority for them!
"I suggest that the extra land can be distributed to about 500 people, you can handle the specific situation yourself!"
Conrad immediately opened his notebook and wrote while saying: "Yes."
"Since these people are going to live on this territory, they must do three things. The first is household registration! The second is to divide households by family! The third is to obey the lord's mansion's dispatch."
Conrad immediately said: "I will do a good job in publicity."
"As for the housing problem of these people," Hobert said again: "The lord's mansion will rent tents to them for free and sell them building materials at a fair price.
"They can pay for the building materials in gold Lire, or they can pay for the building materials in crops.
"The tents rented to them are only free for one year, and the building materials sold to them on credit can be repaid at a fair price within one year, and interest must be paid on them after one year!"
Those tents were seized by the "Jeffery Army" from the Shipyard Island, and they were piling up and getting moldy in the warehouse of the lord's mansion.
As for building materials, the Jeffery Territory will not lack building materials in the future.
The shorthand Conrad lamented that the lord was a political expert he had never seen before, and always had a way to "turn waste into treasure." No matter what the problem was, it was not a problem in his hands!
"As for the remaining 600 people, we can't give up either!" Hobert said: "Their housing problem can also be solved by renting tents and selling them building materials on credit.
"The food problem can be solved by the construction site, which is currently in urgent need of manpower. If one person in a family works on the construction site, they can provide food for other family members.
"But the food must be deducted from the salary of the person working, and if the salary is not enough to pay for the family members' diet, another person in the family must work on the construction site!"
Hobert paused and said: "This will bring a lot of burden to the financial work in the territory. Go and call Philip and Roy, and let's discuss a standard."
This discussion lasted for more than two hours. Now there is more and more paperwork in the territory. As long as the residents in the territory have a little bit of literacy, they are arranged to do the corresponding paperwork.
Hobert asked the teachers of the school in the territory to open a night school to give these paperwork workers remedial lessons.
And stipulated that only those who have passed the corresponding examination and graduated from the night school can get full salary.
At the end of this meeting, Hobert made a major personnel appointment: "I am going to let Conrad be the mayor of Jeffery Town!"
In the main hall, these three people, who have been trained to a certain level of governance and political level, were all slightly stunned. With the lord in charge, does Jeffery Town still need a mayor?
"After the town government is built, Conrad will take your team to work there." Hobert was both explaining and making arrangements:
"Recommend a few candidates from your subordinates to me. I'll reappoint a 'Registry Knight' who will report to the town mayor in the future."
"Roy will be the 'Construction Knight' and will report to the town mayor."
"When Albert returns, he will be the 'Judicial Knight' and will also report to the town mayor."
"Also, the newly appointed 'Shipping Knight,' Wayne, and the soon-to-be-appointed 'Taxation Knight,' Donna, will all report to you."
"In the future, after the hospital and school are built, there will also be 'Medical Education Knights.'"
"Once the territory's tourism industry develops, there will also be 'Tourism and Culture Knights,' 'Agriculture and Animal Husbandry Knights,' and so on, all of whom will report to the town mayor."
Conrad felt a surge of joy in his heart. This was equivalent to being the second-in-command of the Jeffery territory!
At this moment, he also understood the significance of the Duke setting up the town mayor position, and he couldn't help but sigh in his heart: 'Thank goodness! I seized this opportunity, or my life would have been wasted in mediocrity.'
Hobert glanced at Phillip: "From now on, you will be the 'Finance Knight' and will report to me."
"When Corwin returns from out of town, he will be the 'Human Resources Knight,' in charge of talent recruitment and staff promotions. Knight-level promotions will be directly assessed and handled by me. Corwin will also report to me!"
Phillip smiled and bowed slightly: "Yes! As for the butler's job, will I hold it concurrently, or..."
Of course, he was happy. Although he and his son were not as high-ranking as Conrad, both father and son were in charge of key departments, especially the 'Finance Knight,' who was clearly a confidant of the Duke.
This arrangement was clearly more favored by the Duke than Albert and Corwin, the original knightly father and son.
"Allen is quite meticulous; the butler's job can be handed over to him!" Hobert had already thought about the arrangements.
Allen, who was at the door, immediately showed a smile. Although he had not become a 'Knight,' as a butler, he would surely be trusted by the Duke.
Finally, Hobert said, "These personnel arrangements are to be kept secret for now. After the town government is built, we will gradually implement these arrangements."
This noon meeting took a lot of energy from Hobert, so he took a nap at noon before teaching Freya vocabulary in the afternoon.
...
Rorsted Archipelago, Bayam.
Rafter Pound passed the final round of assessment and finally became a tutor at the Tony Manor.
It is said that the Tony Manor is one of the largest manors in the entire colony. Some say it is one-third the size of Masik, but after a few days of observation, Rafter felt this statement was a bit exaggerated.
However, one-fifth of the mountainous area in the central Blue Mountain Island belongs to the Tony Manor; nearly one-quarter of the most fertile land on Blue Mountain Island belongs to the Tony Manor.
It also includes a large number of rainforests, beaches, lakes, and so on. The Tony Manor even built its own railway to transport products from the manor.
As for the background of the Tony Manor, there are many speculations. Some believe that this is the King's property because the largest manor in the Rorsted Archipelago is actually the 'King's Manor.'
The royal family couldn't easily purchase another manor of similar size, so they simply called it the Tony Manor.
Others believe that the power behind the Tony Manor is the family of Valentine Tony, the first governor of the Rorsted Archipelago.
Although Governor Valentine made great achievements in battle, the Tony family currently has little influence in Backlund. Some say that Governor Valentine exchanged all his battle merits for land in the colony.
Regardless of the forces behind it, ordinary people cannot afford to offend it.
Now that the Tony Manor is recruiting a tutor, Rafter plans to use the tutor's identity to cover up some of his illegal activities in Bayam.
Yes, he plans to establish his own gang in Bayam and then obtain a certain degree of development by bribing the Governor's Office, thereby digesting the 'Briber' potion.
However, this is very risky and can easily be targeted by official Beyonders or other Beyonder organizations coming to seek gold, so he needs an identity that he can disengage from at any time.
At the same time, he must prepare for the subsequent 'Baron of Corruption.' If he can do well in the Tony Manor and become the manager of a certain area of the manor, he can take the opportunity to digest the Sequence 6 potion.
If he doesn't do well, Rafter plans to take the forces he has built up to the Southern Continent to find opportunities.
The forces of the Northern Continent countries are even weaker there, and there are warlords everywhere.
Like Hobert's idea back then, he can raise a team himself. With his Sequence 6 strength, it is enough to occupy a territory and become a small warlord.
It was not surprising that Rafter passed the assessment because he had a pure Backlund accent, understood noble etiquette and noble dances, and most importantly, he knew a lot of real-time noble information.
In addition, Rafter never forgot to play the role of 'Briber' and bribed the examiner of this assessment, adding another layer of insurance to this assessment.
In this way, Rafter arrived at the Tony Manor, which looked like a small palace, by carriage.
This manor is actually not far from Bayam. A one-hour drive can take you from here to the port of Bayam.
Under the leadership of the butler, Rafter met Mr. Tony, who had blood-colored hair, a mustache, and black pupils.
For some reason, Rafter always felt that this Mr. Tony looked familiar. Mr. Tony also smiled and said, "You look a lot like one of my nephews."
Rafter immediately climbed up the "pole" and directly called Mr. Tony, who was seven or eight years older than him, uncle.
After leaving Backlund, Rafter completely let go. The original noble etiquette and dignity had long been thrown behind him. He now just wants to advance as soon as possible and become a 'Mentor of Disorder'!
This is the first step in restoring the family's glory.
After obtaining Mr. Tony's approval, Rafter finally settled in this huge manor. The treatment here is very good. He has his own set of rooms with a study and living room, which gives him enough free space.
However, the butler specifically instructed that after 8 pm, Rafter's range of activities is limited to the courtyard of his residence.
Rafter solemnly agreed on the surface, but didn't take it too seriously.
In the afternoon, he met five eligible students, who all looked very well-mannered.
There is more than just him as a tutor in the entire manor, it's just that the Tony family has five eligible children, so they need to find a new tutor. Other tutors also have their own students to take care of.
At night, Rafter secretly got up, preparing to return to Bayam to find suitable gang forces that could be secretly subdued.
After carefully observing the situation outside, there was actually no one patrolling! He jumped onto the wall and suddenly froze: "Why am I jumping on the wall instead of sleeping well at night?"
So he returned to his room and changed into his pajamas. At this time, Rafter suddenly realized: Why am I back again?
He changed into neat clothes again, and just jumped onto the wall: "The moon is so beautiful tonight!"
After admiring the moon, Rafter returned to his room again, changed into his pajamas and lay on the bed, his eyes wide open, without any sleepiness.
Although he still couldn't remember what was wrong, he could be sure that tonight was definitely very wrong!
Rafter came to the wall again: "Bayam is so beautiful at night!"
He returned to his room again, changed into his pajamas and lay on the bed, staring with wide eyes, without any sleepiness.
Although he still couldn't remember what was wrong, he could be sure that tonight was definitely very wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 455: The Official Beyonder Organization is Formally Established
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Kingdom of Feynapotter, Jeffery Territory.
It was Hobert's foot bath time again.
Dennis placed the water, not immediately answering Hobert's previous question, but asked, "Sir, you are already a lord, why appoint a town mayor?"
Hobert smiled and nodded slightly: "Progress!"
He explained: "Facts have proved that the chief executive officer system is a very practical and advanced system.
"A town under large-scale construction has thousands of daily tasks, which are very cumbersome.
"According to the advanced experience of various countries in the Northern Continent, these cumbersome tasks should be handed over to the bureaucracy.
"And I should focus all my energy on outlining the future blueprint of the territory and guiding the town government."
Dennis opened his mouth wide. This was some knowledge he had never been exposed to before, as if a new door had been opened for him!
After thinking for a long time, he asked again: "Sir, what if the town government disobeys the direction you have pointed out after a long time?"
"Good, good, you can perceive that the mayor's power is too great." Hobert smiled and said: "So I have to hold the financial power and the power to employ people in my hands."
Dennis's eyes lit up, and an advanced power framework was built in his mind. No matter what actions the town government wants to take, it needs the support of money.
As long as the power to appoint the main officials of the town government is in the hands of the lord, this bureaucracy cannot escape the control of the lord.
Hobert asked while soaking his feet: "What do you think is missing in this structure?"
Although Dennis was clever, his knowledge was insufficient after all, and he couldn't figure it out after thinking for a long time.
"Supervisory agency!" Hobert said: "Okay, the water is cold, take it away."
Suddenly, Hobert felt again that the potion in his body showed signs of digestion again. Although it was not as much as when he lectured Freya before, the three digestions added up have digested one-fifth.
Hobert couldn't help but sigh: As expected, the higher the sequence, the slower the digestion.
Then he realized that the highest administrative officer system in the entire Northern Continent was not perfect enough, otherwise he would not have digested the potion when he explained these to Dennis just now.
In the yard, Dennis remembered when he was splashing water that he had forgotten to answer the lord's previous question.
However, he was already very satisfied with the knowledge he gained tonight, and that question can be answered tomorrow.
Suddenly, Dennis seemed to understand something!
At this time, a few snowflakes fell on the place where the water had just been splashed, and quickly melted. Dennis looked up: "It's snowing!"
The snow fell all night and did not mean to stop the next day.
The construction sites in the territory had to rest for a day.
On this snowy morning, Hobert's cousin Angus returned, along with eight Tudor family Beyonders and a family elder.
Hobert first met Angus in the study and asked about the situation of his return home.
"The family is very supportive of your career in South Colson," Angus said conservatively.
It's more than just support. The members who wanted to participate in the official Beyonders filled Angus's living room, and even some Sequence 6s wanted to follow Angus.
In the end, Angus had to use a lottery to determine who would come with him.
Then he brought a Sequence 6 (in fact, he could have brought more Sequence 6s, but Angus was afraid of affecting his status, so he only brought one who was willing to obey his arrangements.), four Sequence 7s, two Sequence 8s, and one Sequence 9.
Hobert was very satisfied with such combat power, and asked: "How did the elders in the family consider the transaction I proposed before?"
"A representative was sent to talk to you, but, but..."
"But what?"
"It's just that this elder has a bad temper."
Hobert smiled: "I will meet him in the afternoon. You can remind him euphemistically that it's okay to test me, but don't go too far, otherwise I will turn my face!"
These testing methods are all that Hobert has left over from playing. It can be said that the initial meetings will lay the foundation for future ways of getting along and status. Of course, the Tudor family will first send a crazier person.
Angus nodded: "Understood!"
"As for the treatment of team members," Hobert said: "It is the same as that of normal official Beyonders. There are two types of rewards, one is gold Solas plus merits, and the other is pure merits.
"The so-called gold Solas plus merits is the same as ordinary official Beyonders. They receive a weekly salary regularly, and can accumulate merits only after making contributions.
"The reward method of pure merits is that not only will you have merits after making contributions, but you will also be paid with merits at ordinary times. Merits can be exchanged for gold Solas, but gold Solas cannot be exchanged for merits!
"Merits can be exchanged for potions, amulets, main materials for potions, Beyonder characteristics, and even sealed artifacts. I have a list here for the specific exchange standards, you can take a look."
Angus took it over and took a look. 300 merits can be exchanged for an Beyonder characteristic of "Arbiter"! The Beyonder characteristic of Sequence 6 "Judge" requires 3,500 merits!
Angus immediately asked: "If the weekly salary is settled with merits, how many merits can I receive a week?"
"Sequence 9 can receive 4 merits per week, which can be exchanged for 4.8 gold Solas. Sequence 8 doubles and can receive 8 merits, Sequence 7 gets 20 merits per week, and Sequence 6 gets 45 merits!" Hobert had already thought about the exchange ratio and the number of merits issued.
Angus was excited for a while, which means that he can exchange for an Beyonder characteristic of "Arbiter" in seven weeks!
Seeing the other party's excited face, Hobert knew that this plan was very practical.
It's not to say that this plan is fraudulent, but it is easy to ignore the fact that a Sequence 6 can only earn 300 pounds in seven weeks.
Hobert is unwilling to do such a chore anyway. A Sequence 6 earns more even if he is a bodyguard for someone.
If a team member has any doubts about this, Hobert will calculate such an account with him: "But you are a respected and honorable official Beyonder! And you can also exchange for Beyonder characteristics at almost the basic price!
"These are your benefits! Where can ordinary Beyonders have such benefits as you? They may pay a premium of seven or eight thousand pounds to purchase the Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 6, and it depends on luck, and you can't buy it if you want to!"
I believe that if you say this, even people with doubts will think that they didn't think of this, and continue to work for Hobert.
After discussing the treatment, Hobert asked Philip to settle Angus and other team members.
Their office and residence had already been prepared, in Jeffery Town, the area closest to the Lord's Mansion.
Just after sending Angus away, Allen came to report that Wayne was back, bringing back a whole ship of decoration materials that would be needed in a while. This time, Wayne can finally rest in the territory for a few days.
Wayne was accompanied by two ships of building materials transported by Captain Dean. After inspection, Philip settled the payment in person.
Dean made a lot of money and invited the crew of the two ships to have a big meal at a restaurant on the shore.
As long as these two ships go back, without Hobert publishing advertisements or doing any publicity, people will often come to Jeffery Territory with building materials.
The lower reaches of the Taz River can be regarded as completely open.
It's just that Wayne reported to Hobert that there were still some bandits following along the way, and it seemed that they would still rob if they had the opportunity.
This aroused Hobert's attention. He planned to take the soldiers in the territory to the lower reaches for "training" after they had been trained for a while!
As if they had discussed it, the Beyonders sent by the "Theosophy Order" also arrived on this snowy day.
According to Jonathan's previous agreement, the "Theosophy Order" sent two Sequence 7s, four Sequence 8s, and three Sequence 9s.
Compared with the power of the Tudor family, their power is much weaker, and most of them are Beyonders of the 'Door' pathway, and their frontal combat power is not very strong.
Hobert also gave Helen a list of merits to exchange for Beyonder characteristics, and after explaining it to her, asked her to go back and explain it to the team members.
From the Demonic Wolf of Fog, Hobert had just obtained an Beyonder characteristic of "Traveler", which made him dare to make promises to the Beyonders of the "Door" pathway.
Although Hobert does not have the Beyonder characteristics of the "Witch" pathway now, it does not affect him from making promises first.
In the afternoon, Hobert met the Sequence 5 sent by the Tudor family to discuss the Beyonder characteristics business in the main hall.
The other party not only had a bad temper, but also looked very arrogant. As soon as he entered the main hall, he said: "According to seniority, you should call me grandpa."
Hobert ignored him and asked Angus: "Who is this?"
Angus hurriedly said: "This is..."
The other party interrupted Angus: "According to seniority! I am your grandfather!"
Hobert said to Angus again: "Introduce me, who the hell is this?"
Angus: "This is..."
The other party interrupted Angus again: "I am your grandfather!"
Hobert sneered: "Introduce me! Who the hell is this?"
Angus waited for a while, and seeing that the elder's face was flushed with anger, he quickly said: "This is Mr. Bunier."
Hobert then smiled and stood up and said: "Welcome, welcome! Mr. Bunier, please sit down!"
While saying that, he pointed to the seat at the lower position!
Bunier had no intention of sitting down. After trying to restrain his anger, he said with a smug look: "I heard that you have a batch of Beyonder characteristics and want us to buy them?"
Hobert sat in his seat carelessly: "I do have a batch of Beyonder characteristics, and I want to sell them to you for the sake of being from the same clan!"
Bunier sneered: "How many characteristics? What are the sequences?"
Hobert said unhurriedly: "17 copies of 'Arbiter', 15 copies of 'Sheriff', 4 copies of 'Interrogator', 3 copies of 'Judge', and 1 copy of 'Disciplinary Knight'."
In fact, Hobert has 5 Beyonder characteristics of "Interrogator" in his hand, but he reserved one for Xio who is preparing to be promoted.
When he heard 17 copies of "Arbiter", Angus opened his mouth wide. At first, he thought that Hobert only had a few Beyonder characteristics to sell, but he didn't expect that he would sell more than a dozen copies!
Bunier was also obviously stunned for a second or two. He cleared his throat to cover up his embarrassment before asking: "How much do you plan to sell each of them for?"
Hobert said: "'Arbiter' 400 gold Solas, 'Sheriff' 1,000 gold Solas, 'Inquisitor' 3,000 gold Solas, 'Judge' 7,000 gold Solas, 'Disciplinary Knight' 14,000 gold Solas."
This was the most ruthless time Hobert had ever asked for a price. He thought that with the other party's attitude, he would bargain again and again, so he overpaid a lot.
But even if the premium is a lot, this is a price that can be barely accepted in the outside world.
Especially the Beyonder characteristics above Sequence 7, the royal families of the two countries of Loen and Feynapotter control them so much that they often cannot be bought even if they have money.
Hobert guessed that this should also be the dilemma faced by this branch of the Tudor family, after all, the Beyonder characteristics of the "Lawyer" pathway are not so scarce.
What Hobert and Angus didn't expect was that Bunier sneered: "I will only give you half the price for the Beyonder characteristics of each sequence!
"I guessed on the way here that in this poor mountainous area, even if you have Beyonder characteristics, it is difficult to sell them.
"Now it seems that this is indeed the case, otherwise you would not have accumulated so many Beyonder characteristics in your hands."
Hobert was stunned for a long time before saying: "You, you..."
Are you sick?
Bunier smiled triumphantly when he saw Hobert's "surprised" expression: "As expected, I guessed it! Don't worry, although you father and son are sorry for the family, the family..."
Hobert simply said: "Allen, send this guest away! Let him go out and calm down!"
Bunier was slightly stunned: "You have to think clearly, no one except the family will want your..."
"I have many sales channels!" Hobert also sneered unceremoniously: "For example, the royal family of Feynapotter, such as the Solomon family!"
He said to Angus on the side: "Tell your elders that if you want to facilitate this transaction, send someone with a normal brain to talk!"
No wonder Christian wanted to leave the Tudor family. It turns out that there are people with sick minds in these extraordinary families now!
At this time, Bunier realized that he had completely guessed wrong, but as an elder, he still wanted to save face.
It's just that Hobert didn't give him this opportunity. He pulled out the scepter on his waist and said: "You don't think that the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Disciplinary Knight' were given to me by someone else, do you?
"Get out! If you appear in my territory again, you will definitely appear with the Beyonder characteristics of 'Disciplinary Knight'!"
Bunier immediately realized that Hobert had a Level 1 Sealed Artifact in his hand!
He is sick, but that doesn't mean he is stupid, and immediately left in despair.
Hobert asked Angus: "Are the Tudor family all this kind of stuff now? No wonder they have been forgotten by the world!"
Of course he knew that this was the Tudor family patriarch giving him a blow.
Angus smiled bitterly. He couldn't figure it out either. Christian and his son obviously didn't like this, so why did the patriarch still use this old trick?
This deterrence obviously failed again. Before, Hobert still said "Our Tudor family", but now he simply said "Tudor family" or "Your family"!
Obviously, the goodwill Hobert had just built up towards the family vanished instantly.
After Hobert left the main hall, the anger on his face quickly disappeared. In fact, he wasn't as angry as he seemed.
As the saying goes, "Life is all about acting." He was just expressing his anger to Angus.
Now that there were no more spectators, he naturally didn't need to continue acting.
He went to the study to continue teaching Freya vocabulary.
This time, while he was teaching, the messenger suddenly appeared, placed a long package on Hobert's desk, and then disappeared from the study.
Hobert continued teaching Freya vocabulary as if nothing had happened. Freya had 'seen' messengers a few times and didn't take it too seriously.
Dennis, who was becoming more and more professional as a male servant, was startled. Why did he suddenly feel a sense of fear? And something suddenly appeared on the desk?
But seeing that Hobert and Freya both acted as if nothing had happened, Dennis also suppressed his curiosity, glancing at the package on the desk and then at Hobert.
He waited until Hobert finished teaching Freya vocabulary before Hobert took the package back to his room.
Although Dennis was scratching his head with curiosity, this time he restrained himself from asking. He took a few deep breaths and realized that patience was a way to temper his inner world.
Back in his room, Hobert didn't know about Dennis's inner thoughts, but he did deliberately not give Dennis a chance to ask. 'Silence' is an inner practice in many situations.
He opened the package and looked at it. It was from Jessica. Inside the long box was an extraordinary weapon that Carrie had just completed.
It was a black sword that looked sharp and menacing.
In the letter, Jessica first expressed her apologies, saying that they had gone to the sea for a few days during the New Year, so the production cycle of this weapon was a bit longer.
The following was a detailed introduction to the weapon: "The first ability is to be sharper when cutting through the flesh of enemies, and there is a 3% probability in battle that it can cut the enemy even without directly touching them."
"The second ability is that when facing non-human opponents such as beasts and monsters, the wielder can exhibit a certain aura that makes beasts or monsters fear, and there is a 5% probability that the beast or monster will give up resistance."
The last part of the letter was Jessica relaying Carrie's recent research results: "Beyonder materials make it easier for extraordinary weapons to gain Beyonder abilities than spiritual materials, and they generally gain two abilities, making them more powerful than extraordinary weapons made from spiritual materials."
Carrie suggested that Hobert could sell this weapon for 1300 to 1500 pounds. She was always concerned about Hobert's cost issues.
In her opinion, if it could be sold for 1500 pounds, Hobert would not only be able to recover his costs in this transaction, but also make a small profit.
Although extraordinary weapons have no negative effects, their abilities are only probabilities and are full of uncertainty, so even if they have two abilities and are relatively scarce, they can only be sold for this price.
Actually, this new weapon is quite good. Even without the probabilistic abilities of only 3% and 5%, it can become sharper when attacking enemies and also enhance the wielder's aura.
The second ability seems to be tailor-made for the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'.
However, Hobert planned to sell it to Little Sun after a while. He already had a lot of Beyonder ingredients in his hand, and he didn't have a stable sales channel yet.
There were also two failed weapons in the package Jessica sent.
Hobert smiled. If Carrie's mystical weapons could be mass-produced, he would definitely make a fortune!
Hobert first asked the kitchen to make donuts, then wrote back to Jessica, saying that he was very satisfied with the weapon, and stuffed 200 pounds of material costs into the envelope.
Then Hobert said that he had found a way to extract Beyonder ingredients from failed weapons, and put two Beyonder characteristics of the Sequence 8 level main ingredient of the 'Hunter' pathway in the return package for Carrie to see if she could use them.
If she could, he wouldn't have to worry about the cost issue in the future.
Hobert only partially concealed this matter. After all, even if he didn't explain it to Jessica, Carrie would probably discover or think of this, so he might as well generously tell the other party his 'business secret'.
At the same time, Hobert also provided three main materials of the Sequence 8 level of the 'Assassin' pathway, which is also the 'Witch' pathway, hoping that Carrie could try to make a weapon.
These three main materials were just paid by 'Little Sun'. The reason why he knew so clearly what pathway the materials were from was because he had just consulted 'Vice Admiral Iceberg'.
After writing the reply, Hobert named the new weapon 'Black Jade Sword' because the sword looked as beautiful as black jade.
Then he simply sacrificed the two failed weapons to the 'Nation of Disorder', and took the Beyonder ingredients and characteristics to be sent to Jessica from the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Then Hobert selected some Beyonder characteristics and several sealed artifacts from the stone platform where he stored his spoils and brought them to the real world.
After sending the letter, Hobert took the 'Black Jade Sword' and a dozen wooden boxes to the courtyard of the Anton Tudor family and the 'Theosophy Order' Beyonders.
A sign of the 'Special Operations Department' had already been hung at the entrance of the courtyard. Starting tomorrow, it would be officially open for business, but no one knows what they do yet.
The courtyard had just been renovated and looked brand new. Each Beyonder had been assigned a separate room, and each team had been assigned three offices, as well as a shared lounge and a large conference room.
Except for the two captains, everyone was here for the first time. After settling down, they gathered in the conference room to chat.
The team members on both sides were still quite excited. One side was an ancient family that had been hiding for more than a thousand years, and the other side was an evil secret organization that had been doing it for about a thousand years. Suddenly, they became official Beyonders, and official Beyonders recognized by the orthodox church.
This made them feel novel and excited, like college students who had just settled in their dormitories.
Just as everyone was chatting happily, Helen suddenly stood up and said, "Our lord is here!"
Everyone looked towards the entrance of the courtyard and sure enough, they saw a young man in a noble cloak entering the courtyard.
The two captains got up to greet him, and the others, although they didn't take the so-called lord too seriously, also followed to greet him.
After exchanging a few polite words, Hobert entered the room and sat at the head of the conference table: "I'm here to talk to you about the purpose of the 'Special Operations Department' and everyone's powers.
"Of course, most importantly, I'm here to show you that I have the ability to fulfill your promises."
He lined up ten small wooden boxes on the conference table and then opened them one by one.
Everyone's breathing immediately became heavy. Each wooden box contained an Beyonder characteristic, from 'Arbiter' to 'Disciplnary Knight', from 'Apprentice' to 'Traveler'.
The Beyonders, who had been somewhat unconvinced because they didn't know Hobert's strength and thought Hobert was a baron from a remote area, immediately became respectful.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 456 The Purpose of the Goddess
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After a few seconds of silence in the meeting room, Helen asked Hobert, "Oh my god, how did you get the 'Traveler's' Beyonder characteristics?"
Hobert explained casually, "He wasn't in a good state at the time."
That was the truth, he had become a Marionette, how could he be in a good state?
Helen smiled and said, "You're so lucky."
Hobert closed the wooden boxes one by one and said, "Your captain should have explained the use of merits to you.
"I'm showing you these Beyonder characteristics just to tell you, don't think there's no future here just because it's a mountainous area. In at most three months, this place will become the most important port on a prosperous sea route!
"And the rewards we provide for you far exceed your imagination. For example, I even have a main ingredient for a 'Imperative Mage'."
The Tudor family gasped, especially Angus, whose eyes were filled with enthusiasm, which meant there was hope of becoming a demigod here!
Hobert said to Helen, "I don't currently have any Beyonder characteristics from the Witch pathway, but if there are any corresponding materials you need, I will definitely help you buy them."
Helen gave a charming but not vulgar smile: "You'd better keep your word!"
"Of course." Hobert smiled and opened the rectangular wooden box in front of him again: "This is the 'Black Jade Sword', a Beyonder weapon, its ability is..."
After repeating the abilities of the "Black Jade Sword", Hobert added: "The detailed rules for exchanging Beyonder weapons are also in the list given to your captain, I think they should have explained it to you."
In fact, they didn't. Even Helen and Angus only glanced at the exchange rules other than the Beyonder characteristics and didn't take them seriously at all.
Now they had to awkwardly take out the "Merit Exchange List" that Hobert gave them, take a look, and then explain it to their team members.
Exchanging for a Beyonder weapon requires 1800 to 2000 merits.
A member boldly asked, "Lord, is this the only extraordinary weapon you have?"
Hobert smiled and replied, "I know an 'Artisan' who is good at making extraordinary weapons!"
Everyone looked at each other, which meant he could buy new extraordinary weapons at any time, which made many people envious.
Then Hobert took out another wooden box and introduced the two tubes of potion inside: "This one can quickly restore strength, and this one can quickly restore spirituality.
"Because we will have in-depth cooperation with the Church of the Earth Mother, exchanging for such potions won't cost much merit, and some will be distributed to you for free before the battle begins."
Hobert took out a few more small wooden boxes: "Finally, let me introduce the sealed artifacts of our Special Operations Department.
"Although our Special Operations Department has just been established, this new department still has six Grade 2 sealed artifacts and five Grade 3 sealed artifacts..."
Everyone was surprised again. This was comparable to the number of sealed artifacts of an official Beyonder in a medium-sized city.
Then Hobert briefly introduced the abilities of two Grade 2 sealed artifacts and two Grade 3 sealed artifacts.
These sealed artifacts all came from the spoils of the extraordinary war with the "Rose School" before.
Hobert continued: "Because everyone comes from different forces, the spoils of war, if obtained entirely through your own efforts, can be distributed by the captain within the team or handed over to your respective organizations.
"If you choose not to hand over the spoils to the Special Operations Department, even if you have made contributions, the Special Operations Department will not issue merits.
"If the spoils are obtained while holding sealed artifacts provided by the Special Operations Department, the Special Operations Department has the right to share the spoils.
"If the spoils are obtained through cooperation between two teams, I have the corresponding right of allocation if you cannot negotiate a solution!
"If you do not have a channel to dispose of the spoils, you can exchange them for merits or gold livres, but the number of merits and gold livres exchanged depends on the pricing of the actual object."
Hobert's method of distributing the spoils was relatively reasonable, and everyone in the room had no objections.
Finally, there were the application rules for sealed artifacts. The five Grade 3 sealed artifacts will be stored in the "Special Operations Department". Two or more team members can apply, and they can be used after the captain approves.
The Grade 2 sealed artifacts are stored in the Lord's Mansion. The captain takes the application form to the Lord's Mansion to collect them, and they can be used after Hobert approves.
After discussing the sealed artifacts, everyone came back to their senses: sealed artifacts, application forms, this is what official Beyonders should have!
At this time, they realized that Hobert's strength and ambition had far exceeded their understanding of a baron.
This was quickly confirmed, because Hobert then said: "You may want to ask, what is the specific scope of jurisdiction of the 'Special Operations Department'?
"I want to tell you, the entire South Colson is within the jurisdiction of the 'Special Operations Department'."
Helen really wanted to remind Hobert: You are just a baron on one side of Full Moon Lake! Even the 'Theosophy Order' doesn't dare to brag like that!
Hobert didn't seem to see Helen's moving eyes: "In other words, the entire South Colson, apart from the extraordinary power of the Church of the Earth Mother, only the 'Special Operations Department' is a legitimate official extraordinary organization.
"If we don't take care of the extraordinary cases here, who else can we expect to take care of them?"
Then he changed the subject: "In addition to handling extraordinary cases, you also have the responsibility of supervising the officials, knights, and staff of the Lord's Mansion.
"If you find any dereliction of duty or violations of laws and disciplines, you must immediately report to the Lord's Mansion!"
Hobert had long planned to let the "Special Operations Department" serve as a "supervisory agency". These people had no local background and would not be bound by the local convoluted family relationships.
The team members felt the importance of their responsibilities, and at the same time felt the Lord's Mansion's respect for them, which made them very happy.
Even Helen and Angus did not expect that Hobert would be so generous in granting them such great power.
Actually, this understanding was due to the fact that these two people had no political literacy, because Hobert had just said very clearly that they only had the power to supervise, not the power to investigate, let alone the power to judge.
Finally, Hobert got to the point: "As the only official extraordinary organization in this area, how can we allow demons and lunatics from the Aurora Order to exist within our jurisdiction?
"Therefore, I and the Archbishop of the Feynapotter City Diocese of the Church of the Earth Mother will have a cooperation to eradicate these tumors entrenched in our jurisdiction!
"This operation will be a three-party cooperation. After the power of the Church of the Earth Mother arrives, we will immediately launch a series of actions to drive the other party out of South Colson!"
With the previous foreshadowing, everyone already had a certain sense of ownership. Driven by Hobert's words, they couldn't wait to immediately attack those demons and members of the Aurora Order! To make this territory peaceful and harmonious.
Overall, Hobert was very satisfied with his mobilization, giving everyone sufficient motivation to fight.
Of course, he knew that the so-called "official Beyonder" was just a fig leaf. Everyone was actually moved by the benefits he showed.
Back at the Lord's Mansion, Hobert met Albert, who had been waiting at the door for a while.
This time, Albert went to Feynapotter City and even met the king, feeling that he had broadened his horizons.
After returning, his attitude towards Hobert became more and more flattering, and his determination to be loyal became more and more obvious.
Hobert simply asked a few questions about the trip to Feynapotter City, focusing on discussing Albert's work content next.
Now, Albert agreed to whatever Hobert said without any doubt.
The conversation lasted until evening before Albert left.
Hobert had long planned to go and see what the Demonic Wolf of Fog was up to tonight. If the time was right, he planned to simply turn the Demonic Wolf of Fog into an extraordinary material and high-level spiritual material.
He first used the "Faceless Necklace" to divination through the oil painting. As Hobert expected, all the divinations failed.
So Hobert simply took out the sealed artifact he had just obtained from the Church of the Evernight Goddess from the "Nation of Disorder".
This sealed artifact has the ability to enter dreams and can be used to enter the dream in the oil painting.
Hobert held the sealed artifact in one hand and supported the oil painting with the other, and once again came to the peaceful grassland and soon came to the door of the oppressive hall.
When Farbauti pulled Hobert into the dream last time, this place was similar to an ordinary hall.
But when Hobert came in by himself, it was like when he came in with Christian. The hall became very deep, and the walls and top were painted with monster murals.
Hobert was about to look for the wooden statue of the Demonic Wolf of Fog, but his legs seemed to suddenly lose control, striding forward, taking a long step with each stride.
Fortunately, this was in a dream, otherwise Hobert would have worried about tearing his balls!
Hobert was a little surprised: That's not right! I'm using the sealed artifact of the "Sleepless" pathway, I should have enough self-control in the dream!
Then Hobert seemed to understand: I'm using the sealed artifact of the "Sleepless" pathway! And it was given to me under the arrangement of the Evernight Goddess! Then, the Evernight Goddess's purpose in giving me this sealed artifact is likely to enter Farbauti's dream with me!
Thinking of this, Hobert simply stopped fighting for control of his legs! He strode past the location of the wooden statue of the Demonic Wolf of Fog, passed through a sea of swaying flowers, and came to the deepest part of the hall.
The monsters in the murals seemed to ignore Hobert's existence and did not appear in the hall to obstruct Hobert. Not only that, but the demons in the murals hid when they saw Hobert.
Hobert finally stopped in front of the throne.
Then, a string of vertical words appeared on the high stone back of the throne: Your arrangement in the Tucker Plain has been destroyed by me.
After this string of words appeared, Hobert felt that he had control over his legs again: The Evernight Goddess entered Farbauti's dream just to leave a message for Farbauti?
Hobert glanced at the content of the "message" again. The Tucker Plain is a large plain in central Loen Kingdom, spanning East Tucker County, Southville County, Winter County, and Desi County.
It is the largest grain-producing area in Loen Kingdom and even the entire Northern Continent.
Who does "you" refer to?
Hobert pondered for a while, could it be Farbauti and Flegrea?
What are they planning there?
Hobert pondered for a while, and finally could only guess that this should be a game between the Evernight Goddess and the ancient gods.
With such an experience, Hobert simply withdrew from the dream. As for the plan to use part of the Demonic Wolf of Fog's spirituality to find its traces, he could wait a while before talking about it.
After sitting in his room for a while, Hobert smiled helplessly: I'm just an errand runner, why make it so heavy?
He looked at his watch, it was only a little after seven in the evening, it was still early.
So Hobert brought forward what he had originally planned to do tomorrow to today.
He asked the kitchen to bake another batch of doughnuts and wrote a letter to Upton in Connaught City, asking about the progress of purchasing building materials.
At about half past eight, the letter was "sent", and at a little after nine, Hobert received a reply.
In the reply, Upton roughly described the process of purchasing building materials and had completed all the purchasing tasks.
At the same time, he said in the letter that because he had recently sold a large amount of gold, he was being targeted by an extraordinary organization. He noticed that he was being stalked by the other party, so he requested the help of the "Blessed".
Hobert smiled slightly. He seemed to see some walking Beyonder characteristics again.
Because Upton's wording was not very urgent, Hobert planned to go to him tomorrow to take a look.
As for tonight, he planned to rest early, but thinking that the snow on the construction site was already very thick, if the snow was not cleared, the construction site would definitely become very muddy, which would affect the construction progress.
So the "Creator" worked overtime again, letting the "Nation of Disorder" provide power, and using the ability of the "Ocean Pendant" to blow away all the snow on the construction site.
After doing all this, Hobert lay on the bed and used the power of meditation to fall asleep faster.
As he expected, he was pulled into a dream by a force in the middle of the night and came to the hall full of flowers again.
Farbauti, the tall and thin middle-aged man, was already sitting on the throne.
Almost as soon as Hobert stood still, the other party asked urgently: "The 'Fool' who just appeared recently, is not Flegrea?"
Hobert replied affirmatively: "No!"
"Hahaha ~" Farbauti had drastic emotional changes in front of Hobert for the first time.
When he opened his mouth, Hobert saw that there was no tongue in Farbauti's mouth, only a fleshy red cavity. He didn't know how he made a sound.
This made Hobert obviously uncomfortable: He was very curious about what the real appearance of Sequence 0 "Abyss" was like?
Farbauti smiled twice before saying: "You really guessed it, Flegrea's interpretation of an important divination had a serious deviation!
"He divined that the 'Fool' in the future would gain powerful power and status, and you, Hobert, would provide important assistance to the 'Fool'.
"At that time, Flegrea thought that the current 'Fool' was his identity after resurrection! It's hard to imagine that he was so wrong!"
