chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 457: Taking Fors to Earn Extra Money
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert didn't laugh at Flegrea like Farbauti did; for a "seer," misinterpreting some divination was unavoidable.
After all, fate isn't so easy to decipher; it's easy to get an interpretation that's the opposite of the actual situation.
Flegrea might have divined that someone would ascend to the position of "The Fool" in the future, and that person would be someone "not belonging to this era." Of course, Flegrea would think that was himself after his resurrection.
After all, both "The Fool" and "not belonging to this era" seemed to describe him.
Hobert was curious: "What arrangements did you and Flegrea make in the Tucker Plains?"
"Of course, arrangements for Flegrea's resurrection!"
Hobert nodded; that made sense. The Evernight Goddess would definitely destroy such arrangements. If Flegrea was still as mad as he was before his resurrection, he might even try to seize the uniqueness of the "Sleepless" pathway from the Evernight Goddess.
In other words, Flegrea divined that he might fall, and that someone "not belonging to that era" would ascend to the "Fool" position in the future, so he confidently made arrangements for his resurrection, only to have them destroyed by the Evernight Goddess at some point.
Flegrea might have other backup plans, but currently, his hope of resurrection is slim. He's being watched by the Evernight Goddess from the front, and blocked by the newly risen "Fool" from behind.
And soon, both the Evernight Goddess and "The Fool" will have the chance to become Outer Deities.
If Flegrea wants to resurrect from the two pathways he previously occupied, there's currently no chance.
Farbauti's emotions gradually subsided, and he became expressionless again: "In that case, this thing is useless to me here."
He raised a hand, and Hobert felt like something had appeared in his hand, but it looked like nothing.
"Give this to Amanises."
As he spoke, Farbauti reached out his hand. Hobert unconsciously reached out to take it. His two hands felt weight, but visually and spiritually, there was nothing in his hands.
"This, this..." Hobert asked strangely, "Could this be the 'Concealment' authority?"
That's not right! The Evernight Goddess is now the true god of the "Darkness" pathway, and she should have already grasped the "Concealment" authority!
Besides, Hobert remembered that in the Goddess's image, one of her hands was empty, like she was holding the "Concealment" authority of the void.
At this time, Farbauti explained: "It comes from the cosmos, and you can use it to find the cosmic part of the 'River of Eternal Darkness.'
"Also, holding this item can maximize Amanises's state, turning all the creatures in the universe that worship the cosmos into her anchors!
"Before, Flegrea was able to maintain a certain amount of sanity while possessing the uniqueness of both the 'Darkness' and 'Fool' pathways at the same time because he held this item.
"As far as I know, the undead bird Gregrace has a similar item!"
Hobert felt a bang in his mind: The Evernight Goddess herself is the "Concealment" authority. Does she need to hold any sealed artifact to grasp the "Concealment" authority? Then, in the battle with the God of Combat, the thing held in one of the Evernight Goddess's hands should be this thing Farbauti gave me! The Evernight Goddess used it to stabilize her anchors, so she was able to maintain a good state in the subsequent war, even when her followers wavered!
Thinking of this, Hobert took a deep breath: The war in the Northern Continent will not break out for another half year, but the pressure of the battle of the gods is already at its peak. The Evernight Goddess is already preparing for war. I believe the God of War is not idle either, such as giving the uniqueness of the Justiciar Pathway to Philip I, Castiya, of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
Farbauti also urged: "Sacrifice it in the dream outside the hall. If you bring it to the real world, the entire Southern Colson area will fall into eternal darkness, and all life in Southern Colson will fall into eternal dreams!"
Hobert looked at his empty hands: "Okay."
Obviously, in this round of the game between the Evernight Goddess, Flegrea, and Farbauti, the Evernight Goddess won completely. Farbauti's state is not very good, so he had to obediently hand over this special sealed artifact that Flegrea had previously stored with him, or that he had obtained while Flegrea fell.
Of course, the main reason why Farbauti handed over what the Evernight Goddess needed because of a single sentence from the Evernight Goddess should be that his main body is hiding in the dream.
This guy said before that the "Mother Tree of Desire" does not have the relevant authority of dreams, and he was very confident that he was safe in the dream.
But now it's different. If he makes the Evernight Goddess unhappy and she turns to help the "Mother Tree of Desire," it's estimated that she can easily "blow up" Farbauti's equipment.
When dividing the spoils, the Evernight Goddess can still get what she wants.
Of course, in order to preserve the strength of the Earth side, the Evernight Goddess is unlikely to do so.
Hobert certainly wouldn't let go of this opportunity. He asked Farbauti: "Do you know 'Uncertain Mist'?"
Farbauti was obviously stunned. He also gained knowledge today. This kid dared to take advantage of Amanises's power to obtain the information he needed.
However, this only surviving ancient god is all about being flexible: "I know. He is also an outer god. As far as I know, he used Solomon and Trunsoest to briefly descend his power to the Northern Continent three times."
Hobert then asked: "What is the specific process like?"
"Projecting one's will, and forming a projection with independent consciousness under the protection of a certain ritual or sealed artifact."
Hobert immediately thought of the projection he had just killed a few days ago. That should be one of the projections?
So he asked again: "What are the characteristics of such a projection?"
"Beyonders or Beyonder creatures are very susceptible to the projection's corruption, becoming the medium for him to spread corruption." Farbauti explained in detail: "The more creatures that are polluted, the stronger the projection's power!
"However, the projection has enough wisdom to avoid the investigation of the orthodox god's church. Sometimes they will actively hide themselves, quietly influencing a powerful Beyonder and turning him into a believer who believes in him."
Farbauti said: "The 'Mother Tree of Desire' likes to do this. One of Tolzna's subordinates became a believer of the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' and the 'Mother Tree of Desire' found a suitable opportunity to capture Tolzna."
Hobert recalled that Tolzna seemed to be the "Chained God," the "King of Angels" of the "Prisoner" pathway. There is no accurate information to prove that he has fallen, but according to Farbauti's meaning, he should be living a life worse than death.
Hobert remembered that the leader of the "Rose School," the "Abomination" Suah, was born from a Sequence 1 that the "Mother Tree of Desire" tore from the "Chained God."
Then Hobert suspected that Tamara herself, did she get a projection of "Uncertain Mist," and the entire Tamara family began to believe in "Uncertain Mist"?
Then, is the one who polluted the Demonic Wolf of Fog also one of the projections?
The Demonic Wolf of Fog was very proud of his corruption transfer operation. Now, in Hobert's view, it is estimated that the corruption on the Demonic Wolf of Fog has not been eliminated, and his transfer process has caused more creatures to be polluted.
However, the Demonic Wolf of Fog's transfer was not without effect. He successfully transferred the projection to the Marionettes.
This is because the Marionettes were once a part of the Demonic Wolf of Fog. Such a transfer can only be completed by Beyonder creatures or Beyonders of the "Seer" pathway.
Secondly, the projection of "Uncertain Mist" is also willing to do so, because those Marionettes can easily become his believers and are more easily controlled by him.
The only thing he didn't expect may be that he would soon encounter Hobert, who absorbed the main power supporting the existence of the projection into the "Nation of Disorder," turning the projection into ordinary "Great Old One's corruption."
Hobert even believed that if he hadn't taken action, most of the tourists in the manor would gradually become believers of "Uncertain Mist" in the years to come.
Thinking of this, Hobert asked again: "Do you know where the three projections are specifically?"
The answer he got was: "Didn't you just destroy a projection? I don't know where the other two are."
Hobert nodded slowly: It seems that as long as he uses the oil painting, Farbauti can perceive some of the things happening around him through the oil painting.
Finally, Hobert said: "Thank you for your answer."
Farbauti didn't respond, but disappeared directly from the throne, seemingly to express his dissatisfaction with Hobert.
Hobert didn't take it too seriously, and left the hall with his hands as if holding a ball of air.
He felt that if others saw him like this now, they would definitely think he was a fool, carefully holding a ball of air as if holding a bomb that could explode at any time.
After finding a suitable place, Hobert carefully put down the thing in his hand, and then materialized candles, essential oils, and other items in the dream to simply set up an altar.
After lighting the candles, Hobert began to recite the prayer: "Evernight Goddess, more sublime than the starry sky, more eternal than eternity, you are the Lady of Crimson, the Mother of Concealment, the Empress of Misfortune and Fear, the Mistress of Repose and Silence.
"Your devout believer begs for your attention;
"Beg you to accept my offering;
"Beg you to open the door to the kingdom."
That surging sense of tranquility that made people sleepy descended in the dream. Hobert saw twinkling starlight, giving people an illusory and dark feeling overall, and the sacrificial door like a transparent starry sky opened.
Hobert took the opportunity to ask: "Great Evernight Goddess, may I ask how long Farbauti's state can be maintained?"
This was actually asking if the Evernight Goddess was willing to help Farbauti hide his tracks after receiving the thing.
The sand around the altar suddenly flowed towards the altar as if it had life, forming letters on the altar, eventually forming a sentence: I will continue to provide him with help in terms of "Concealment."
The sacrificial door like a starry sky closed, and Hobert realized that the sacrificial ritual was over. The altar was "empty" before, and now the altar still seems to be empty.
At this time, Hobert had time to savor the Evernight Goddess's answer just now, and quickly found the key point: "Continue" to provide him with help in terms of "Concealment"!
In other words, she was already providing help in terms of concealment for Farbauti before?
No! Hobert realized: Farbauti and Flegrea did not form alliances with other ancient gods. In that era when the ancient gods had crazy tendencies, "not an enemy" meant the possibility of being a friend. Farbauti should have realized the existence of the "Mother Tree of Desire" very early, so he sought some help from Flegrea.
Hobert guessed: At that time, Flegrea might have divined that he would be resurrected in the future as "The Fool who does not belong to this era," but there were many obstacles on the road to resurrection. There is someone who can help "The Fool who does not belong to this era."
Hobert didn't know exactly how to help, but thinking of his previous conversation with Farbauti, it seemed that he was very important to "The Fool."
He guessed that he might help Klein stabilize his state and resist the will of the "Celestial Worthy" to resurrect in the future, but he must become "Shadow of Order" before he has such ability.
In short, Flegrea must have divined that Hobert was of great use, so the two ancient gods may have reached a deal. Farbauti looked for opportunities to provide Hobert with some help to help Hobert grow faster, while Flegrea provided some help in terms of "Concealment" and stored the thing he sacrificed to the Evernight Goddess today in Farbauti's place.
So Farbauti, like Flegrea, has always had little presence, especially in the Third Epoch and Fourth Epoch, he still has little presence.
It is very likely that as time went by, the Evernight Goddess grasped the "Concealment" authority in the Third Epoch and was still providing "Concealment" help to Farbauti. Compared to outer gods like the "Mother Tree of Desire," the Evernight Goddess should be more hopeful that Farbauti can continue to persevere.
In this way, Farbauti did not completely hand over the remnants of that outer god today because of the pressure from the Evernight Goddess, but also had the meaning of "paying rent."
However, even if he understands this, Hobert will not completely trust Farbauti, because even if he has a transaction with Flegrea, it will not affect him making some sinister arrangements while improving himself.
After ending the sacrifice, Hobert finally withdrew from the dream. Just as he was about to continue sleeping, the image of "The Fool" suddenly appeared in his mind again.
Then "The Fool" played a video for Hobert. It was "Moon" Emlyn reporting in a prayerful way that after several days of discussion, the high-level vampires agreed to the deal with the "Emperor."
However, the vampires requested that they send two "Vampire Viscounts" to directly trade with the "Favored of the Creator." The time and place of the transaction will be discussed by Emlyn and the "Favored of the Creator."
Half-asleep and half-awake, Hobert first sighed: My dream is really busy tonight!
Then he muttered in his heart: Is Emlyn sick! Late at night... Well, vampires seem to be energetic at night.
Hobert tried to wake himself up, prayed to "The Fool," and thanked "The Fool" for notifying him of the transaction in the middle of the night.
Finally, Hobert said that the specific transaction time and place would be discussed at the Tarot meeting next Monday.
After lying back on the bed, Hobert looked at the dark roof and sighed: It's not so busy during the day.
In fact, as a Sequence 5, even if he is not on the "Sleepless" pathway, three or four hours of sleep a day is enough.
However, Hobert felt that sleeping seven or eight hours a day was a normal routine and made him feel psychologically comfortable, so he went to bed around ten o'clock every night and occasionally slept in the next day.
So Hobert used meditation to fall asleep again, and this time no one disturbed him, and he slept until dawn.
The next morning, on the way to the restaurant for breakfast, Hobert, with his keen hearing, heard Scholar in the neighboring courtyard's office muttering to Valk about Jeffrey's haunted territory again.
The snow in other places had reached their ankles, but there was no snow at all on the construction site. They really couldn't figure out why and could only assume it was haunted again!
It is said that many people were kneeling and worshiping at the construction site this morning, believing it to be a miracle!
Hobert shook his head and did not explain to them whether it was a miracle or a haunting.
While eating breakfast, Hobert asked Fors, "What are your plans for a while?"
Fors smiled wryly: "Writing a book, but fortunately, it will be finished in another two or three days. I plan to start large-scale construction with the Baron and end with the territory being built into a tourist attraction and an important port on the Taz River waterway."
"You make the decision on this." Hobert smiled: "You've been writing for so many days in a row, it's been quite boring, right? How about I take you out to earn some extra money today?"
Since becoming Sequence 5, Hobert no longer cared about ordinary extraordinary organizations.
So, in Hobert's view, helping Upton solve the problem today was just a way to earn extra money.
Fors felt as if she had never had such a strong desire to go out: "Okay, okay, then I might as well take a break today. If we come back early, I plan to go see the snow scene."
Hobert: When did I mean to let you take a day off?
However, seeing Fors's happy look, Hobert thought about it: Well, a day off is a day off, as long as it can be finished before the 15th, so that there is time to contact the publisher and publish it.
Donna smiled and said, "Where are you going to play? Take me with you, I've been working since I came to the territory."
"No!" Hobert directly refused: "Don't even think about going anywhere until you sort out your own work."
Donna pouted: "Stingy! I don't want to go!"
Hobert and Fors smiled at each other, knowing that Donna's little temper was up again.
After eating breakfast, Donna continued to work sulkily, while Hobert and Fors came to the study together.
Hobert briefly explained the next action: "Do you remember Upton, whom we helped before? Remember it."
"Yesterday I received a letter from Upton asking for help. He was targeted by an extraordinary organization for helping me with a favor. Today I am going to investigate.
"There may be some battles. I'll lend you this pistol again. When the time comes, you can pick up the Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 9 and Sequence 8 attacks, and I will buy them with gold pounds."
Today, in addition to taking Fors out for a walk, the other thing is that he hopes Fors can accumulate some practical experience, so that he can find her to be a helper in the future.
Especially when she becomes a "Traveler", she will be a powerful assistant.
This is a part of Hobert's construction of his extraordinary power. While training Seel and others, he can also train Miss "Magician" by the way.
After all, Hobert knows how fast her promotion speed is!
Fors took the pistol with enchanting abilities. This was a magical item she was familiar with. With it, ordinary Sequence 8s were not Fors's opponents at all.
This time, Hobert simply didn't wear a mask. After all, the other party already knew his identity, and with Fors by his side, there was no point in wearing a mask.
However, he prepared a mask for Fors, not the kind worn by "God Envoys", a mask with the mysterious symbol of the "Creator" on the forehead, but an ordinary mask.
When Hobert and Fors first met Upton, they wore this kind of mask.
Holding Fors's shoulder, Hobert used "Travel" to bring her to Conant City, Upton's office.
Upton quickly got up to greet him. He was about to call out "God's Envoy", but noticed that Hobert was not wearing a mask today, and there was one more person.
So he simply didn't call anything, but smiled and said, "It's great that you can come in person!"
He glanced at the person next to Hobert and found that she looked like one of the female Beyonders who had helped him deal with the Tamara family members before.
Hobert said, "Briefly explain the situation!"
Upton began to tell: "The batch of gold that was sold some time ago, because the quantity was too large, was targeted by many gangs. They all thought I had robbed a transport ship transporting gold from a certain country."
He smiled helplessly and continued: "Most of the gangs were easily dismissed by me, but one gang had an extraordinary background, so I was careful when dealing with them.
"When negotiating with their boss, he said that he wanted to buy a batch of gold from me at a low price, and threatened me that if I didn't sell it to them, they would rob it.
"Then I was stalked. After investigating, I found out that there was an extraordinary organization behind this gang. I didn't have the confidence to solve the problem, so I asked you for help."
Hobert asked, "What is the name of the extraordinary organization behind them?"
"I don't know, I only found out that this happened."
Hobert nodded: "You wait in the office for a while."
After speaking, Hobert left with "Blink". Upton warmly entertained Fors: "Please sit down, would you like coffee or black tea?"
The person who could be brought by Hobert with his real face must be extraordinary, so of course he had to treat her well.
However, before he could make the tea, Hobert came back: "There are six stalkers in total, only one of whom is an extraordinary.
"Through spirit vision, I already know the gang's hideout. Let's go, we'll go and destroy this gang."
Upton opened his mouth: "Are we going to do it right away?"
"Otherwise, are we going to keep them for the New Year?"

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 458 Old acquaintance
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Upton savored the previous battle. The three of them directly used "Travel" to arrive at the Black Hand organization's lair. Hobert didn't waste words with them; he kicked their boss half to death with one foot.
Hobert also had no intention of interrogation, finishing him off with a single knife.
And that lady was also a ruthless character, firing several shots at a Black Hand leader, emptying her gun.
Of course, it wasn't that she was abusing the corpse, but her marksmanship was average. Six bullets didn't kill him, but stray bullets killed one of his subordinates.
In the end, the lady still had to pull out her dagger to give that Black Hand leader relief.
The other three Black Hand members, seeing their boss and leader dead, immediately knelt on the ground begging for mercy and asking Upton to plead for them.
But Upton still drew his short sword, killing them one by one. This operation must be kept secret, as he planned to continue living in Conant City.
By the time Upton finished killing the three Black Hand members, Hobert had already finished his spirit channeling: "The extraordinary organization behind them is the 'Judgement Group'."
Hobert smiled meaningfully: "Old acquaintances!"
Upton was taken aback: "You know members of the 'Judgement Group'?"
"Yes, I killed one of their Sequence 6 members, which should be a core member of the 'Judgement Group'," Hobert said casually.
Hobert still hadn't found a suitable opportunity to deal with that 'Dawn Paladin' Beyonder characteristic, but his 'Mutated Fire Rose Spider' had become a stepping stone for Hobert to build a relationship with the Church of the Earth Mother.
Upton, standing to the side, thought: Is this human language?
I'm old acquaintances with him!
You know him?
I killed his family!
Hobert smiled: "According to the information I gathered before, the person in charge of the 'Judgement Group' in Conant City is a 'Deputy Leader' named Gale.
"He has at least one Sequence 6 and two Sequence 7 helpers, as well as at least six or seven Sequence 8 and Sequence 9 subordinates.
"From the spirit channeling of this Black Hand leader, I learned of a stronghold of the 'Judgement Group'. It might be difficult to catch Gale there, but we should be able to kill another core member of theirs.
"By continuing to spirit channel, we'll find Gale sooner or later."
Fors was a little worried; the enemy's strength was very powerful! That 'Deputy Leader' named Gale actually had three mid-sequence assistants, so Gale was likely a Sequence 5!
However, Fors recalled the battle she participated in with Jeffrey in which they dealt with an entire mercenary squad. She was worried, but she didn't show it.
Upton thought for a moment and asked, "Could the Gale you're talking about be the boss of 'Balan Fisheries Company'?"
Hobert was stunned: "The location of the stronghold I obtained from spirit channeling is a fish shop."
He paused and added, "'Judgement Group' Deputy Leader Gale is tall, with a horizontal scar on his face, running from his left ear across his nose to his right ear."
Gale's appearance was obtained by Hobert from spirit channeling from the 'Dawn Paladin' before.
Upton nodded repeatedly: "That's right! It's him!"
Then he secretly thought, "That was close." Previously, a subordinate had advised him to seize the seafood industry in Conant City as well.
At that time, Upton had already obtained the general agency authorization for 'Keen Mechanical Trading Company' and was focusing on contemporary 'high-tech' products, so he didn't get involved in the seafood business.
Fortunately, he didn't get involved, because the mastermind behind the entire seafood industry in Conant City was Gale!
After confirming the target, Upton said, "I'll send someone to investigate immediately..."
"It's too late," Hobert said. "At most, in two or three hours, Gale will receive the news of the Black Hand's destruction.
"While the initiative is still in our hands, take us to the place where we're most likely to catch Gale.
"As for his subordinates, it doesn't matter if a few escape."
Upton thought for a moment: "Gale should be at his fish shop now, but he has many helpers there!"
Hobert smiled: "Prepare for the upcoming battle. If I'm entangled by Gale and you're in danger, you can escape from there first."
Fors nodded: "Okay."
She was best at running away. Even if one 'Door' couldn't get her away, two 'Doors' would definitely allow her to escape.
After a simple battle preparation, Hobert and Upton briefly formulated a battle plan.
To hide his identity, Hobert changed his appearance when he set off from Upton's place.
Upton wore the mask bestowed upon the devotee by the 'Creator'. With this mask, they wouldn't have to worry about their details being divined.
The three of them used "Travel" again to arrive near 'Balan Fisheries Company'.
Upton pointed out the approximate location of Gale's office. Hobert briefly surveyed the terrain and used "Travel" again to take them upstairs and into the office.
But they found nothing! The rough-style office was empty.
Upton smiled awkwardly: "In theory, Gale should indeed be in his office at this time."
Hobert cracked his knuckles: "There should be people from the 'Judgement Group' here. Now that we're here, we can't leave empty-handed."
His understanding of surprise attacks was to strike wherever he could. He couldn't waste a surprise attack opportunity just because things didn't go according to his plan.
So Hobert openly opened the office door. Seeing two thugs standing in front of another room door in the corridor, he kicked them one by one without saying a word, knocking them unconscious.
Although separated by a door, Hobert's spirituality was enough to sense that there were enemies inside. However, the people inside should also have similar spiritual warnings. Time was tight. To avoid the enemies making any preparations, Hobert waved his hand, signaling Upton and Fors to keep their distance, and he kicked open the door.
Just as he was about to rush into the room, Hobert discovered that it was a conference room, packed with people, with no empty seats.
At the head of the table sat a scarred face, Gale himself.
As it happened, they were discussing today whether to develop Upton into a member of the 'Judgement Group' or to seize the gold in his hands.
So the members of the 'Judgement Group' in Conant City were basically all here.
They didn't react for a moment after seeing Hobert. Even Gale was stunned. Even with spiritual reminders, no one expected someone to be so bold as to come here to make trouble for the 'Judgement Group'!
Hobert smiled: "Sorry everyone, I went to the wrong room."
After saying that, he took a step back.
Gale was the first to react: "Catch him!"
Hobert had only taken one step back: "Corrosion!"
For him, sometimes enemies gathering together wasn't a bad thing.
Because this time Hobert's "Corrosion" wasn't brewed for a long time, Gale and a "Judge" weren't greatly affected, but those Sequence 8s and Sequence 9s were affected by the "Corrosion", lost their minds, and fought with their companions.
The originally spacious conference room became a chaotic mess!
Hobert's estimate of the 'Judgement Group's' grassroots personnel had a considerable error. In the conference room, there were at least six or seven Sequence 8s and seven or eight Sequence 9s.
But the more enemies there were, the better, because now Hobert could reap their lives like harvesting straw.
Gale roared and overturned the huge "conference table" towards Hobert.
Hobert kicked the conference table away, knocking out a Sequence 8 and a Sequence 9 at the same time, and removed the seal on "1-103".
Although Hobert didn't take ordinary extraordinary organizations seriously, he wouldn't underestimate the enemy tactically.
Gale lifted the conference table, creating space to draw the giant sword hidden in the cello case he carried with him. He drew the sword and threw away the scabbard with one hand. But before the scabbard hit the ground, it suddenly flew back and sheathed the sword.
Gale heard the scabbard say, "I am the scabbard, it is the giant sword, we are a loving couple, don't disturb our good times!"
Gale was stunned for a full second. He had used the sword for so many years, and this was the first time he had encountered this situation, and the first time he had been stunned in battle: "Would you be more comfortable if I pulled the scabbard back and forth a bit?"
The sword and scabbard both made shy noises.
A chair in the conference room suddenly stretched out its legs and tripped a Sequence 9 who was fighting with his companion: "Hahaha~ idiot, you can't even dodge this, I'm not playing with you anymore!"
It went to trip a Sequence 7, but the Sequence 7 kicked off its outstretched leg.
"Ah! My leg! You broke my leg!" the chair screamed. "Fortunately, I still have three, I'll trip you again!"
The chairs had all come to life, traversing through the battle in groups. Some would stretch out their legs to trip the people fighting, and some ran around yelling, insisting that the members of the 'Judgement Group' sit on the back of the chairs.
Under the influence of "Corrosion", some Beyonders actually went to sit down, but just as they were about to sit on the chair, the chair suddenly ran away, causing the Beyonder to fall on their butt on the ground.
The table, already broken in the middle, flipped over and completely twisted into two halves: "Although I am not complete, I still look forward to a warm embrace."
After saying that, it flew towards an Beyonder and slammed them against the wall, pressing down hard.
Someone broke the window, and there was broken glass everywhere. They flew around like a swarm of bees, shouting: "I am a scalpel! I am a scalpel! I think you all are sick, stand still, let us operate on you."
Any Beyonder who still had a little bit of sanity dodged one after another. Those who couldn't dodge in time were immediately stabbed into sieves by the glass.
The opened window had two thick branches extending in from outside. The branches wrapped around an Beyonder: "Did you nail nails into me? Are you sick, or are you blind? My relative, the wooden board, likes nails, I don't like them!"
Fors and Upton, who were following behind, were dumbfounded and didn't know how to attack for a while.
The conference room was in chaos, but the core members of the 'Judgement Group' who were not too affected by the "Corrosion" quickly reacted.
They all guessed that the other party should have a very powerful sealed artifact. Gale finally stopped struggling with the giant sword in his hand. The light of dawn radiated from his body, and these rays quickly expanded and radiated dozens of meters around!
Outside, adjacent to the fishing boat harbor, many fishermen and stevedores looked upstairs. They wondered why different rays of light were emitted from there?
In order to hide his identity, Gale rarely used his abilities. Usually, when he really had to fight, he would use the giant sword he carried with him, rather than the "Sword of Dawn" he condensed.
After all, this was not the Feysac Empire. If he exposed his Beyonder abilities, it would easily attract the siege of the Nighthawks.
But this time he felt a huge threat, so he planned to use the "Light of Dawn" to disperse the surrounding effects.
But those chairs, tables, trees, and glass still attacked the members of the 'Judgement Group' while chattering.
Those "low-sequence" Beyonders who were affected by the "Corrosion" regained some sanity, and the effects of the "Corrosion" were rapidly weakening.
The other Sequence 6s and Sequence 7s were preparing to break through the walls from three directions and leave the area affected by the sealed artifact.
A "Werewolf" used his steel-like fists to smash a hole in the wall. He was about to enlarge the hole, but his arm was actually caught by the wall bricks.
Only to hear the wall say: "Hehehe, caught you, caught you!"
The infinitely powerful "Werewolf" wanted to pull back his hand, but couldn't pull it back.
The wall said: "Don't try to cheat! If I catch you, I catch you! Now, it's your turn to catch me!"
"Werewolf": "You let go first, and I'll catch you again!"
"This is the punishment for being caught just now!"
The "Judge" wanted to knock open the wall in front of him with his shoulder, but the wall moved back and dodged: "Hehehe, I dodged."
The "Judge" went to bump it again, and the wall moved in another direction again: "I dodged again."
"Judge": "You're just a wall, what are you dodging!"
While "1-103" was turning the members of the 'Judgement Group' upside down, Hobert wasn't idle either, but the bloodthirsty negative effects dispersed his sanity.
He didn't take advantage of this excellent opportunity to kill the other party's "mid-sequence" members, but killed a Sequence 8 and a Sequence 9 in front of him.
After killing two Beyonders, Hobert gradually regained some sanity. Seeing the trapped "Werewolf", he raised his knife and rushed towards him.
The "Werewolf" also saw Hobert rushing towards him and was very anxious. His legs were kicking on the wall, trying hard to pull out his trapped arm.
Just as Hobert's knife was about to hit the opponent, a "Sword of Dawn" blocked in front of the "Werewolf".
Gale stepped forward and swung another sword, Hobert could only step back and block horizontally with his knife.
The power of the "Mentor of Disorder" was not as good as the "Guardian", but it wouldn't be like the previous Sequence 6, who was directly knocked away by the opponent's sword.
"Lightning Strike!"
As Hobert regained more sanity, he certainly wouldn't compete with the opponent in strength!
Hobert was very grateful for the training those mercenaries gave him. Before that, he would have found Gale very tricky.
But now, Hobert felt that Gale's reaction was slower than those mercenaries. This didn't seem like a very difficult enemy to deal with.
This was of course the case. After all, mercenaries often had to fight, while Gale often planned conspiracies.
Hobert's use of 'Lightning Strike' made Gale panic a little, and he quickly used the 'Dawn Barrier' ability to block it. But at this moment, a bronze door with mysterious patterns appeared beside him.
Pale hands grabbed Gale, and Hobert took the opportunity to step forward, continuously slashing. First, he broke through the 'Dawn Barrier', then he broke through the 'Dawn Armor', and sent his black blade into Gale's heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 459: Killing Another Sequence 5
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
When Hobert was still Sequence 6, he had no way to effectively attack a "Guardian." But now that Hobert has become Sequence 5, with more attack methods at his disposal, he actually managed to wound a "Guardian" so easily.
This is inseparable from Hobert's tactics. First, the surprise attack put Gale at a psychological disadvantage.
Then, Hobert concealed his magical items, and after finding an opportunity, he quickly used "Lightning Strike" to attract Gale's attention and "Underworld Gate" to restrict Siil's actions.
After that, he attacked at the fastest speed, severely injuring Gale before the "Judge" and the two Sequence 7 "Pyromaniacs" and "Briber" could react.
Through the tempering of previous battles, such tactics almost naturally formed in his mind and began to be implemented.
So even if Hobert hadn't fully regained his sanity, it didn't affect his formulation and implementation of tactics.
The first to be surprised was Gale, who never thought that he would be so seriously injured.
Of course, Gale knew that the enemy in front of him was a Sequence 5, and the Sequence 5 of the Warrior pathway had never been afraid of anyone in battle. Gale hadn't been injured for several years.
Of course, even if Hobert's knife pierced Gale's heart, he wouldn't die for a while.
Immediately afterwards, the "Judge" and the others were also surprised. He realized that instead of crashing through the wall to escape, he should join forces with the vice-captain to eliminate the enemy in front of him: "Underworld powers are forbidden here!"
And the "Pyromaniac" and "Briber," who had previously been preventing their subordinates from attacking each other, also attacked Hobert together. One used "Fireball," and the other kicked a piece of wood at Hobert, completing the "bribery" process, and then used the combo "Weaken."
Hobert, whose "bloodlust" hadn't completely subsided, grinned and put away his knife: "Exploit!"
This was the ability of "1-104." Hobert "utilized" the "Briber's" weakening, turning the "weakening" on himself into a "weakening" on everyone in the conference room.
Gale finally escaped from the "Underworld Gate" because of the "Judge's" "prohibition." But immediately afterwards, the injured Gale was "weakened" again, which made his self-healing ability much worse, and blood kept flowing from his chest.
That's not all, Hobert: "Weaken!"
Everyone else in the conference room was "weakened" twice, while Hobert was only "weakened" once.
The price of using "Weaken" was that he took a "Fireball" from the "Pyromaniac."
The "Fireball" ignited a piece of clothing on his body, but the Sequence 7 "Fireball" caused extremely limited damage to him.
Hobert attacked Gale again!
"Exile!" The "Judge" quickly came to Gale's rescue.
But Hobert suddenly used "Blink" to come in front of the "Pyromaniac." The "Pyromaniac" quickly ignited a "Wall of Flames" in an attempt to stop Hobert.
But his "Wall of Flames" was blown away by a surge of power, which was the power generated by "Exile," which could even blow away spirits!
The "Pyromaniac" used his agility to dodge, but Hobert, driven by "Exile," quickly caught up with the "Pyromaniac" and cut him in half with a knife.
If it were a "Disciplinary Knight's" "Exile," Hobert wouldn't have had time to play such tricks. Unfortunately, it was just a "Judge."
Hobert didn't stop and immediately attacked the "Briber" next to him.
The "Briber" pulled the trigger of the revolver in his hand, firing continuously, but Hobert was not afraid of bullets at all, and stray bullets accidentally injured a companion: "Charm!"
However, the "Mentor of Disorder" had extremely strong resistance to mental attacks, and the "Briber's" "Charm" was useless.
And Hobert had already rushed in front of him, and a knife struck Gale's "Dawn Barrier" in front of the "Briber."
"Chaos!" Hobert took the opportunity to use the "Mentor of Disorder's" signature ability on Gale, causing Gale to fall into a state of "chaos."
Hobert used "Blink" to stab Gale in the chest again with a knife.
Gale recovered from the brief state of "chaos" and punched Hobert in the jaw, knocking Hobert flying. As he was about to fly up, Gale's "Dawn Sword" came again, preparing to cut Hobert in half.
Hobert quickly used "Blink" again to dodge.
Even when injured and "weakened" twice, Gale's combat power was still strong.
If it were a one-on-one fight, Hobert would have a very difficult battle, but Hobert had already taken the initiative with a surprise attack, and he could also use Gale's other teammates.
The "Blink" used by Hobert not only dodged Gale's attack but also appeared in front of the "Judge." The "Judge," who had been looking for a chance to attack: "Death!"
He punched, launching a death attack on Hobert, who smiled slightly: "Link!"
When the "Judge" used "Exile" just now, Hobert had secretly established a connection with him. Now that Hobert suddenly used "Link," the "Judge" was immediately hit, lowered his fist, and felt that Hobert was a very familiar person, unwilling to hurt Hobert, and lost the desire to attack Hobert.
But Hobert's attack would not be delayed because of this. He slashed over with a knife, hitting the "Dawn Barrier" again!
Hobert reached out to Gale: "Underworld Gate!"
This was Hobert's tactic. After Hobert's surprise attack succeeded, Gale was still difficult to deal with.
Fighting with injuries would not affect the combat power of the Beyonder of the "Warrior" pathway too much.
But Gale was not alone, which gave Hobert an opportunity. For Hobert, sometimes he only has a chance when enemies are concentrated together.
Although Gale made the "Dawn Armor" on his body more solid to prevent Hobert from taking advantage of the attack again, the "Dawn Armor" could not stop the hands stretching out from the bronze door.
What was even more deadly was that the two knives Gale took were connected to the power of the Underworld. The fear in Gale's heart was detonated. His hands trembled, he could barely hold the sword, and his legs were weak, almost unable to resist the hands stretching out from the "Underworld Gate."
Hobert immediately used "Blink" to prepare to deliver the final blow, but Gale suddenly inserted the "Dawn Sword" into the ground.
Bang~
The giant sword collapsed, turning into pieces of dawn-like light fragments, pouring out forward.
These fragments were extremely sharp, cutting holes in the "Underworld Gate." Hobert used "Blink" again to dodge, but because the distance was too close, he still couldn't dodge.
"Disorder!" This time, Hobert didn't use "Disorder" against a specific person, but instead caused a small area to fall into directional "chaos," changing the direction of most of the light fragments in front of him.
But the light fragments were too dense, and Hobert was still hit by several fragments, which caused Hobert to suffer very serious injuries: "Distort!"
Hobert "distorted" the concept between himself and the trapped "Werewolf." The "Werewolf" suddenly bled, bearing half of Hobert's injuries.
Then Hobert used "Healing," and the injuries on his body healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
During this period, Hobert did not receive any attacks from the enemy, because Gale's "Storm of Light" injured Hobert, but more of it killed his own people.
Whether it was the "Dawn Paladin" or the "Guardian," they rarely used "Storm of Light" when they were not sure, because before becoming demigods, they could only simply control the direction of the "Storm of Light" and could not target a specific target, which could easily cause accidental injuries.
If it was Hobert's side that was ambushing, using skills like "Storm of Light" was the most appropriate, just like having a "Vulcan Cannon" in his hand. If there were no other teammates on the battlefield, he would just keep "shooting" at the enemies.
But the situations Hobert encountered before were all situations where the enemy had a large number of people. Using "Storm of Light" would be helping Hobert!
But one thing to say, the power of the "Storm of Light" was really great. The "Underworld Gate" was cut to pieces, and the surrounding walls, chairs, trees, and other monsters temporarily given spirituality by "1-103" were also "killed" in large numbers.
But the "Judgment Squad" also suffered significant losses. The "Judge" dodged in time but was also injured. The "Briber" was seriously injured and had fallen to the ground. Two Sequence 8s and Sequence 9s received their lunch boxes on the spot, and other Beyonders were also injured.
Only the "Werewolf"'s direction was not within the attack range of the "Storm of Light," so the "Werewolf" was not injured.
Gale used this ability in such a narrow space, indicating that he had been forced into a desperate situation.
Upton and Fors were very glad that they did not rashly enter the conference room without being sure.
At this time, the Sequence 8s and Sequence 9s, who had completely recovered from the "Corruption" state and escaped the entanglement of those monsters, reacted and fled from the windows and doors.
Upton and Fors were prepared, one blocking the window and the other blocking the door.
Bang bang bang~
Gunshots rang out one after another outside.
And in the conference room, which was already a mess and no less than being bombed by artillery, Hobert began to reap the fruits of this battle.
"Charm!" Hobert's "Charm" was not comparable to that of the "Briber." The "Judge," who had just been "Connected," was immediately hit, feeling that Hobert was like a long-lost friend, wanting to invite him to the tavern for a drink.
But Hobert didn't intend to accept the other party's invitation at the moment. He was attacking Gale, who was still stubbornly resisting.
Gale, who was still in a "weakened" state, had a "Dawn Sword" that had been re-condensed with a very light color.
The key was that the wound on his chest had begun to flow out a thick black liquid, which was obviously severely negatively affected by the "Underworld." But in this case, he still fought back and forth with Hobert.
It's just that as the "Dawn Light" around him faded, Gale's resistance to Beyonder abilities also decreased.
The "Distortion" and "Disorder" used by Hobert had been eroding Gale's defense against Beyonder abilities, and finally Hobert seized the opportunity: "Arrogance!"
Compared to pure Beyonder attacks like "Distortion" and "Disorder," "Arrogance" was more inclined to an insidious mental attack, which was more likely to affect Gale.
Sure enough, Gale was affected by "Arrogance," propping up the "Dawn Sword" with one hand and hooking his index finger at Hobert with the other.
How could Hobert let go of this opportunity? He slashed up with a knife, breaking through the "Dawn Armor" on Gale's head and neck, and then another knife, and the head of this "Guardian" flew far away.
Gale's body raised the "Dawn Sword," as if preparing to fight again.
Clang!
In the end, this body finally fell to the ground, and the "Dawn Armor" on it gradually disappeared.
At this time, Hobert had already killed the "Judge."
The intense desire to survive made the "Judge" quickly get rid of the "Charm" state: "Imprison!"
"Distort!" Hobert did not use the protection of the "Order Crystal," not because he didn't have time, but because it was unnecessary.
He "distorted" the concept between himself and the "Judge," and both of them were "imprisoned" at the same time.
The "Judge's" ability to "imprison" was weakened as a result, which was equivalent to only having one-half of an "imprisonment" on each person.
As a Sequence 5 Hobert, he broke free from the shackles of "imprisonment" before the "Judge." When the "Judge" attacked again, Hobert had already come close to him.
The "Judge," who was very bad at fighting, only resisted for a few seconds before being seriously injured by Hobert with a knife. With the second knife, he also received a lunch box.
Then Hobert killed the "Werewolf" trapped by the wall, and the "Briber" who was lying on the ground dying.
The most aggrieved was the "Werewolf." In the fierce battle just now, he was only doing one thing from beginning to end: pulling his arm.
His arm was not pulled out, and his life was lost.
Finally, Hobert re-sealed the two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, and went to the corridor outside to help Upton and Fors kill several "low-sequence" Beyonders who wanted to escape.
Hobert used the power of the "Spirit Wine Glass" to manipulate the corpse back to the conference room.
This fight had already been noticed by the people downstairs and on the street, but after hearing the continuous gunshots, most people did not dare to come up to check the situation.
Even those who came up to check the situation were scared away by the fierce battle in the corridor and went directly to the patrol police on the street.
Hobert let Fors and Upton clean up the spoils, and he came to Gale's body and began to channel.
Coming to the channeling space with the gray fog as the background, in front of him was Gale with dazed eyes and a hideous scar on his face.
Hobert asked: "The leader of the Judgment Squad and other deputy leaders."
"..."
After chanting silently seven times in a row, the gray fog in front of Hobert separated, and a picture appeared of a meeting in a luxurious living room.
Sitting opposite Gale was that gloomy old man Steven, and a cold-looking middle-aged man.
This was the scene of Gale's first time attending a Judgment Squad leader-level meeting. A voice first introduced Steven, and then introduced the cold-looking middle-aged man named Loft.
Sitting at the bottom was a woman who looked somewhat aristocratic, named Shandora.
Sitting next to Gale was that beautiful and charming woman, named Simone. Hobert suspected that she was a "witch."
In addition, there was the leader of the "Judgment Squad" sitting at the top, but his appearance was still not clear, but this time the picture was clearer than the last time he used the "Spirit Necklace."
Based on the attire of the individual, Hobert was able to ascertain that he was a Count from the Feynapotter Kingdom, which immediately narrowed down the possibilities, as Feynapotter only had about twenty Counts.
The noble's large sapphire ring caught Hobert's attention, or rather, it had caught Gale's attention at the time.
Hobert had a feeling that it was no ordinary ring.
Hobert then posed his second question: "What is your relationship with the Intersea Mutual Aid Society?"
"..."
The gray fog swirled, generating the answer Hobert sought. Before Gale appeared a person wearing a loose war robe, still with an indiscernible face, only his tall and burly physique was visible.
"You will go to the 'Judgement Group' as a link for cooperation between our two organizations. This is also Captain Vick's intention.", the voice said in a commanding tone.
"At the same time, you will also be responsible for transactions and information transfer between our two organizations, causing as much disruption as possible in the southern part of Loen, and managing our industries well with the cooperation of the 'Judgement Group' to earn gold pounds."
The gray fog reappeared before Hobert's eyes, and he immediately understood that the 'Judgement Group' and the 'Intersea Mutual Aid Society' had economic and 'business' cooperation, with Gale being responsible for these collaborations.
At the same time, the scope of 'Captain' may have narrowed again. His name is Vick, if that's his real name.
Hobert also asked about the potion formula and the password to the safe in his office, but unfortunately, Gale didn't know the 'Demon Hunter' potion formula.
Hobert was just asking on a whim, as he certainly knew that this was strategic-level information and wouldn't be told to a spy like Gale.
As for the safe in the office, Hobert had noticed the large and tall safe when he appeared in Gale's office.
In the end, Hobert only asked about Gale's subordinates who hadn't come to the meeting before withdrawing from the spirit channeling.
He didn't ask for information about the 'Judgement Group's' strongholds, because attacking the 'Judgement Group' was just to earn extra money for him, and there was no need for sustained strikes.
Moreover, after learning of Gale's death, he estimated that the strongholds he knew would be immediately abandoned, and the secret transactions he knew would be immediately terminated.
To confuse the 'Judgement Group' and the official Beyonders, Hobert used the enemy's blood to write a sentence on a still intact wall: I found you, hehe.
Returning to the real world, Hobert accelerated the extraction of the Beyonder characteristics, and the three divided the spoils according to the enemies they had each killed.
Seeing that the patrolmen had not yet arrived, Hobert went to Gale's office again and opened the safe. Unfortunately, there wasn't much cash inside, mostly contracts, with only two Beyonder materials.
The cash and Beyonder materials were, of course, taken away without hesitation.
The three then used "Travel" to return to Upton's office, rested for a few minutes, and then went to the 'Judgement Group's' last stronghold in Connat City, eliminating a Sequence 8 and a Sequence 9 there.
At this point, the 'Judgement Group's' power in Connat City was completely wiped out.
Ordinary official Beyonders would find it difficult to do this so cleanly and efficiently because they had to investigate, plan, and then launch a siege.
In particular, the investigation process could easily allow Gale and others to sense the danger, thus making the operation full of uncertainty from the beginning.
Hobert didn't have so much trouble, attacking wherever he went, mainly focusing on spontaneity.
Perhaps only 'Demons' could effectively avoid enemies like Hobert, but now even Demons can't avoid it, because their god betrayed them and gave Hobert a ring that could avoid being detected for malice.
As for other pathways, some with high spirituality, such as the 'Seer' pathway, might foresee danger or even divine it, but they can't completely avoid it.
Otherwise, there wouldn't be any 'Seers' dying in this world. Even someone as strong as Zaratul could hardly avoid being killed.
Hobert and the others were doing the final division of spoils in Upton's office.
In the battle, Upton obtained five Beyonder characteristics, and Fors obtained three.
Upton pushed two Sequence 8 characteristics he obtained to Hobert: "Today, I invited you to help, and I originally shouldn't have taken any Beyonder characteristics.
"But I'm planning to turn some of my subordinates into Beyonders so that I can better expand my power to reflect my value."
Because Fors was present, he didn't say it too clearly. What he meant was: When I am more valuable, I will be more useful to the 'Favored'.
Hobert didn't stand on ceremony with him and put away the two Beyonder characteristics. Although this matter started because of his commission, he played a major role in today's battle. It was as if Upton had picked up the three Beyonder characteristics on the street.
Upton asked Hobert, holding the three Beyonder characteristics in his hand, "I recognize one of them as the 'Lawyer' Beyonder characteristic. What pathways do the other two belong to?"
Hobert took the two Beyonder characteristics that needed to be identified. At his current level, he could already distinguish the pathways to which the Sequence 9 characteristics belonged: "This one is 'Arbiter', and this one is 'Warrior'."
He said, "I have the corresponding potion formulas there, and I can sell them to you cheaper, 200 pounds. Write me a letter if you need them."
These two potion formulas definitely can't be bought for 200 pounds on the market, but as a follower of the 'Creator'! There must be some visible benefits.
Upton nodded: "Okay!"
It's good to have an organization. You don't have to go everywhere to find related potion formulas, and you can buy them at very low prices.
Hobert was about to leave with Fors when Fors suddenly said, "Now that we're here, let's go to the beach to take a look."
She had long wanted to go to Connat City with Xio for a few days, but she always lacked the financial resources, so she never made it.
Upton immediately said, "All expenses for the two of you in Connat City can be charged to the Coast Gang's account!"
Fors looked at Hobert with expectant eyes.
Hobert smiled: "Okay, but we have to go back and put down the spoils first, and then come back after changing into more casual clothes."
Fors nodded repeatedly.
So the two first returned to Jeffery Territory, Hobert sacrificed all the spoils he had obtained to the 'Nation of Disorder', and then quickly changed his clothes.
Fors put on her favorite yellow dress and took Hobert's arm.
Hobert suddenly felt a huge sense of separation. He was still killing people like flies just now, and now he was going on a trip!
The space in front of them suddenly became illusory, and the figures of the two disappeared.

The Punisher Bolton led a team to the meeting room of "Balan Fisheries Company." Two neat rows of corpses lay on the floor, as if someone had arranged them after they died.
The floor was covered in sawdust, and not a single piece of furniture was intact.
The glass in the windows was long shattered, and it looked like the glass was shattered by the shockwave of a violent explosion, because there were many glass fragments on the corpses on the ground.
But strangely, no one witnessed or heard a violent explosion.
The strangest thing was the branch of a large tree outside, extending into the room. From the outside, it looked as if the tree had bent down and stretched its branch in.
Someone witnessed the tree suddenly coming to life, and some even heard the tree talking.
In addition, one wall of the meeting room seemed to have become elastic, turning into a wavy shape, and two of the walls were full of fist-sized holes.
People who had participated in the war were very familiar with this scene. This was a room that had been swept by the enemy's heavy machine guns or cannons.
But the problem was that no one had witnessed heavy machine guns appearing here, nor had they heard the sound of heavy machine guns, nor had they left any traces of setting them up.
So the police believed that this was a Beyonder case and transferred it to the Punishers. Gale was ostensibly a believer in the "Lord of Storms."
Bolton glanced at the line of words Hobert had left behind: "This is likely a vendetta, but it should be a grudge from a long time ago."
"The murderer killed so many people in a row, and even wrote 'Hehe,' which shows that he is a rational and perverted Beyonder!"
At this time, a police officer quickly walked over from the stairs: "Everyone, are there any clues?"
Bolton glanced at the police officer with some anger: "We just arrived."
The police officer was full of smiles: "It's the group of reporters downstairs who keep asking questions. I was thinking that if there are any clues, I'll go and perfunctorily answer them."
Bolton said impatiently: "Tell the reporters that it was a vendetta or a gang fight."
The police officer said awkwardly: "The person who called the police saw this line on the wall, and now the reporters also know this line. Everyone already knows that it is not a simple vendetta or a gang fight."
Two Punisher team members looked at their captain. The captain was very sure just now that this was a vendetta.
Bolton's old face turned red, and he reached out and punched a wall, making it shake: "Why isn't it a vendetta?"
The police officer didn't know the inside story, and quickly explained: "Because in the case of a vendetta, they would definitely write something like 'I have taken revenge.' What the other party wrote was 'I found you,' which is obviously the beginning of a serial murder case!"
Bolton was stunned, and glanced at the words on the wall again, muttering to himself: "Isn't it because 'I found you' that I took revenge?"
This reminded him of the lunatics of the Aurora Society. He still firmly believed that this was a vendetta, because he had handled too many similar cases.
An ordinary person was targeted by a bully, causing his family to be destroyed.
At this time, the ordinary person encountered the opportunity to become an Beyonder. After a few years or more than ten years, the avenger, whose mind had been distorted by hatred and potions, would definitely come back and go on a killing spree.
It's just that the scene wasn't too bloody, and the bodies of Gale's family members were not seen. According to the investigation, Gale's family members were fine.
In this regard, it seems a bit abnormal.
This is the difference in the concept of official Beyonders and the police in thinking about the case. Bolton was too lazy to explain to the police officer: "Then you can explain to the reporters according to the gang fight. If not, I will go and talk to those reporters."
Two Punisher team members quickly asked the police officer to explain to the reporters according to the captain's statement, because last month, the captain had just been punished by the headquarters for hitting a reporter.
...
When Hobert and Fors reappeared on the streets of Conant City, the two immediately blended into the joyous atmosphere of the tourists.
For the Loen people, the first choice for vacation is Conant City.
In Hobert's impression, the Desi Bay is just on the northern edge of the subtropics. The warm wind on the sea blows just right to Conant City. When the entire Northern Continent enters the cold and dry winter, it is still as warm as spring here.
In the summer, the Cruz Mountains in Southville County can block most of the hot air from the southeast, so the summer in Conant City is not as hot as other coastal cities.
There are also beaches here, as well as small islands not far from the coastline, which can be described as a natural tourist resort.
It is still the New Year holiday, and there are many tourists from the northern counties.
Upton's company and "Balan Fisheries Company" are in another district, where there are fewer tourists, and it is not easy to feel the atmosphere of a resort.
On the shopping street and the coastal street, there are crowds of people, and there are street performers performing everywhere. Most of these performances are musical instrument performances that can be completed independently by one person, such as violin, saxophone, etc.
Hobert and Fors chatted in a low voice, occasionally stopping to admire the street performances. When they encountered wonderful places, Hobert would also reward a few copper pennies.
Generally, the places where there are performances are very crowded. Hobert would gently put his arm around Fors's shoulders to block others.
At first, Fors was attracted by the street performer's guitar performance. When she came back to her senses, she suddenly blushed.
She didn't know when, but she was no longer resistant to having intimate gestures with Hobert.
At this time, she heard Hobert say in her ear: "I can also play the guitar! In a few days, you can help me buy one from Backlund, and I will play it for you."
When Hobert was in college, he was still a literary youth. Not only could he play the guitar, but he also sang very well. He was once a campus heartthrob.
But after graduation, people were all competing for "Do you know who his father is?" Gradually, he rarely played the guitar.
Fors felt her chest beating "thump, thump, thump": "Okay, okay."
Guitar performances are rarely heard in Backlund. This is a characteristic musical instrument of the Feynapotter Kingdom. The gentlemen of Backlund believe that this musical instrument is too frivolous.
In Loen, only tourist cities like this have guitar performances.
The more Hobert listened, the more itchy he became, so he simply took out a 5-soli banknote: "Hello, can I borrow your guitar for a while?"
This is a scene that often happens in Conant City. A gentleman who comes to vacation suddenly becomes itchy, and borrows the artist's instrument to play a song.
But most of those are violins, accordions, etc. Few people borrow guitars, but there was still immediate applause of encouragement around.
"Of course." The street performer, a young man with a beard, stood up and handed the guitar to Hobert.
Hobert thanked the young man, took the guitar in one hand, and took Fors's hand in the other to bypass the street performer's "money box."
Hobert focused on plucking the strings to find the feel, but Fors was inexplicably nervous, because there were at least dozens of people watching around, and there were more tourists on the outer layer.
The key is that she had never seen Hobert touch a musical instrument, and was very worried about Hobert.
Classical guitars are somewhat different from modern guitars, but they are similar. Hobert tuned the sound, and his mind suddenly fell into a state of confusion, because his mind was full of songs.
But these songs are all Chinese songs. Could it be that they are translated into Loen language on the spot? That would give people a completely different feeling!
Fortunately, the pretending youth, cough, cough, fortunately, the experience of being a literary youth did not embarrass him. He plucked the strings and sang one of the English songs that impressed him more, "Sound of Silence," translated as "The Sound of Silence."
Loen is also a language with alphabetic pronunciation, so it is similar to the European and American languages in Hobert's concept. There is nothing wrong with translating it, and the lyrics don't even need to be changed.
After the brisk and somewhat ethereal prelude was played, the surrounding tourists stopped talking and were completely attracted by the rhythm.
When Hobert's crisp and clean singing sounded, many passing tourists also began to come over to watch.
Fors, who was on the side, finally breathed a sigh of relief and began to appreciate Hobert's performance.
The street performer who contributed the guitar first realized that this was actually a new song that he had never heard before, but the lyrics were very meaningful, the rhythm was light and clear, and it was very attractive. It sounded like a song that had been repeatedly polished.
More and more people were attracted by Hobert's singing. After a song was sung and played, there were actually one or two hundred people around!
Hobert stood up and bowed slightly to everyone.
Everyone then applauded Hobert, and Fors applauded and said excitedly: "That's great, Hobert, I mean you sang really great!"
Looking at her appearance, it was as if she had just received everyone's applause and affirmation.
"It's okay, it's okay." Hobert returned the guitar to the street performer.
The artist quickly asked: "Sir, can I sing your song just now?"
"Of course." Hobert doesn't rely on this to make a living, so naturally he wouldn't be so stingy.
Amidst the continued applause of everyone, Hobert pulled Fors out of the crowd.
Suddenly someone shouted: "Fors, it's really you!"
That was a woman in her thirties, who looked good.
"Rin!" Fors smiled: "I didn't expect to meet you here."
Then she introduced: "This is Rin, a best-selling author."
When she introduced Hobert, she suddenly didn't know how to introduce him: "This...this is..."
Friend? Or...?
Hobert smiled: "Let me introduce myself, Miss Fors and I are purely boyfriend and girlfriend."
Rin nodded with a "I understand" expression. She smiled and said to Fors: "You're fast enough. Last time we talked about marriage at the salon, you said you were single, and now you have a boyfriend!"
Hobert corrected: "It's fiancé."
He just corrected it casually, but after he finished speaking, he felt that he hadn't considered Fors's feelings, so he glanced at Fors. Seeing that Fors didn't mean to stop him, he felt relieved.
Rin covered her mouth: "Oh my god, you...your progress is too fast!"
At this time, Fors realized what "fiancé" meant. Most of the time, this meant living together.
She was a little embarrassed: "It's not what you think!"
But she couldn't make too specific rebuttals, because she and Hobert did "live together."
Rin doesn't care about these: "Be sure to write to me when you get married, I must attend your wedding!"
Of course, lunch was on Hobert, the "fiancé." When you come to a coastal city, how can you not eat seafood?
Hobert very gentlemanly let the two ladies order as much as they want. Rin was indeed not polite. Shrimp, fish, and crab all had to be the best, but Fors first looked at the prices behind the dishes.
Until Hobert reminded her: "You forgot, our expenses are charged to the Coast Gang's account."
Since Upton said so, if it is not charged to the Coast Gang's account, it would be disrespectful to Upton.
Fors then remembered and began to order the dishes she liked, without considering the price.
The three were eating happily when suddenly a middle-aged man with a beard and a fierce face sat down next to Hobert: "Long time no see, old friend!"
Hobert scrutinized the middle-aged man: "You have mistaken me for someone else."
"Let me introduce myself," the other party said to himself: "I am a bounty hunter. I may mistake my wife, but I will never mistake the face on the wanted poster, Mr. Hobert."
After all, he came out to play. Of course, Hobert was unwilling to wear a "mask," so he just made his beard longer and changed his hairstyle, looking seven or eight points similar to his original appearance.
Everyone is here for travel, who would pay attention to whether there is a traitor published in the newspaper around them?
Sure enough, even after a performance, no one recognized Hobert.
But in the restaurant, Hobert was very unlucky to meet a bounty hunter.
Hobert smiled: "You really have mistaken me for someone else. My name is Sherlock."
He suddenly thought that this name also seemed unusable. The military and church people seemed to be looking for Sherlock Detective.
But the bounty hunter didn't notice this: "Don't worry, I'm also here on vacation and won't pull you to collect the bounty.
"If I suddenly have 50 pounds more in my wallet, I should be able to pretend that I didn't see you."
Of course, the bounty hunter would not be stupid enough to subdue the "ten thousand pound wanted man." He felt that since Hobert brought a woman to Conant, he must also be here to play, and of course he would not want others to discover his whereabouts.
This is also a busy restaurant. If the other party doesn't want everyone to discover his whereabouts, he won't easily make a move, so he dared to take the opportunity to blackmail him.
Hobert really didn't want to spoil the fun because of this, and was about to use "Connection" to resolve the problem, when seven or eight people came over, led by a middle-aged man who was a little fat, but looked quite rich.
There was a sixteen or seventeen-year-old girl with a bit of cute baby fat, holding a noblewoman's arm slightly behind, and the remaining four or five people were all burly bodyguards.
The middle-aged man smiled at Hobert: "Mr. Matthew, I didn't expect to meet you here."
Hobert stood up: "Mr. and Mrs. Dominic, I'm very happy that we met again. Elizabeth, are you here on vacation too?"
This is exactly the Elizabeth family who came to Conant City on vacation.
Elizabeth showed a cute smile: "Yes, Mr. Matthew."
Dorothy changed her face like a face change. The last second she was still smiling, but when she saw the bounty hunter, she asked with a look of disgust: "What do you want from Mr. Matthew?"
The bounty hunter looked at the bodyguards and said, "It's nothing, I mistook him for someone else."
With that, he got up and left.
Dorothy winked at two of the bodyguards, and they immediately followed. To prevent the bounty hunter from continuing to harass Hobert, they would of course have a "chat" with him in private.
Dorothy smiled and chatted with Hobert for a few words, then shook his hand. "I won't disturb your vacation, goodbye, and I wish you a pleasant stay."
He leaned closer to Hobert while shaking his hand: "Mr. Ulysses once said that as long as you are willing to go to Tingen City, there will be a new identity and a decent new job waiting for you."
Hobert said, "Please thank Mr. Ulysses for me. I will visit him when I have time."
Elizabeth also came over to say goodbye: "Goodbye, Ho… I mean, Mr. Matthew."
"Goodbye, and I wish you a pleasant stay too."
After seeing Elizabeth's family off, Hobert smiled and explained to Fors, "I handled a case in Tingen City before, and that's when I met Mr. Dorothy. I didn't expect to meet him here."
Fors nodded. She remembered this incident. At that time, she and Xio were hiding from Qilangos, and Hobert went to Tingen City on a business trip, so she and Xio stayed at Hobert's place.
Looking back now, it may have been the shared living during that time that made her feel that going to Feynapotter with Hobert later wasn't a big deal.
At this time, Rin carefully observed Hobert: "Don't say, you really do look a bit like the 'traitor' Hobert!"
She laughed and said, "If Fors' and my books really can't sell one day, we'll ask you to pretend to be Hobert and send you to the police station to collect the 10,000-pound bounty."
At the same time, she also felt a little strange. It was clear that the other party introduced himself as Sherlock, but why did that middle-aged man call him Mr. Matthew? Could his full name be Sherlock Matthew?
Then Rin couldn't help but think: Could he really be Hobert? The 'traitor' who killed the prince fell in love with a best-selling author. Oh my god, I have inspiration for my next book!
Fors smiled unnaturally from the side: "That day should not come."
Because even if there were ten Fors plus ten Rins , there would be no way to bring Hobert to the police station.
"I don't mind." Hobert smiled and said, "To be able to earn 10,000 pounds in one day, just thinking about it makes me feel like I've struck it rich!"
He suddenly thought that he seemed to have earned more than 10,000 pounds today: Hehehe, as expected, earning extra money can make people feel happy.
The three of them spent about 6 pounds on this meal, and even Rin felt a little embarrassed. Usually, eight or nine people in a restaurant, plus opening two bottles of good wine, might not even cost that much money.
Rin noticed that Hobert had the bill charged to an organization called the "Coast Gang."
Curiosity arose, and after saying goodbye to Hobert and Fors outside the restaurant, she returned to the restaurant and asked the waiter: "Hello, excuse me, what is the 'Coast Gang' that the gentleman just mentioned?"
The busy waiter didn't even look up: "Sorry, I don't know."
Until a 1 Soli bill was handed to him, the waiter immediately put on a smiling face. At this time, there were not many people in the restaurant, so the waiter whispered: "Beautiful lady, the Coast Gang is the largest gang in Conant City!"
Rin couldn't help but cover her mouth, unable to imagine that Fors had met people from the underworld! No, it was that Fors' fiancé seemed so familiar with people from the underworld!
The waiter probably felt that his answer was not worth 1 Soli, so he continued: "However, Mr. Upton is a very reasonable gentleman. He has been here for dinner before and doesn't look rude at all.
"Oh, by the way, Mr. Upton has also recently obtained the general agency rights for 'Keen Machinery Company'!"
Rin was surprised again. She had heard science fiction writers mention "Keen Machinery Company," which should be one of the leading steam engine companies in the country.
The value of this company's general agency is self-evident. Unexpectedly, a gang leader could obtain the general agency of this company! Someone must have used rich channels and connections behind this to complete such an operation!
She suddenly thought of the gentleman who helped "Sherlock" out of the siege: "Do you know Mr. Dorothy?"
"I know him." The waiter smiled and said, "I have a colleague from Tingen City who knows him. He is a large arms dealer and also runs transportation, shipping and other businesses. It is said that he is a big businessman in Tingen City."
Rin sighed: Fors' fiancé knows very powerful friends! Could he really be Hobert! Although he betrayed his country and king, he never betrayed his lover. It's definitely possible to write this in the next book, but you can't use real names, otherwise it will easily cause dissatisfaction from the royal family and the "traitor."
…
Hobert felt that the wind on the coast was still a bit cool. After all, it was still winter.
But it was only relatively cool. It was much warmer than the wind in Jeffery's territory. Tourists only needed to wear autumn clothes.
After strolling on the beach for a while, Fors stretched her waist and looked at the sea: "I finally walked on the beach here. Okay, let's go back."
Hobert took out his pocket watch: "It's only two o'clock in the afternoon."
"It will be troublesome if someone recognizes you again." When the bounty hunter threatened Hobert just now, Fors was very worried.
Of course, she was worried for the bounty hunter, afraid that Hobert would cripple him with one punch, and her vacation, which had just started, would be ruined.
Hobert smiled and said, "Let's wait until someone recognizes me. Anyway, we can leave at any time."
Fors smiled and said, "Okay then."
Continuing to walk forward, the two played beach volleyball for a while, and then took a boat to see the deserted island.
Unfortunately, the water was a little cold and you couldn't swim, which Fors felt was a pity. Hobert looked at Fors' figure and stopped at the position of her chest, also feeling that he was missing out on a lot of fun.
After getting off the boat, the two bought a coconut each, drinking while sitting on beach chairs on the beach, watching the sun gradually fall from the horizon.
Fors sighed: "Hobert, this is what life should be like.
"Sometimes I really want to turn down everything, and not worry about promotion, curses, or anything, and just go out and play and see the world.
"Let my life stop and take a break."
Hobert smiled and said, "With me here, you can do whatever you want."
But the book still needs to be written, and it needs to be finished as soon as possible.
Fors held Hobert's hand and smiled sweetly.
