chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 461 It’s time for the Tarot Club again (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to keshavs for becoming a free member]
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Donna yawned: "You woke me up so late just to show off these expensive and useless things you bought?"
Hobert lightly flicked Donna's head: "This is a gift your sister-in-law bought for you! Don't take it if you don't want it."
"I want it! Sister-in-law is the best!" Donna immediately said with a smile: "I've loved seashells since I was little, I'll put it on my desk."
Hobert thought he was hearing things: "Didn't you just say these things were expensive and useless?"
Donna stood up, displeased, and said: "Hobert! How can you say that about something my sister-in-law bought for me?"
Hobert opened his mouth wide, and after a long while, he said: "I have never seen such a shameless person!"
Fors watched the siblings and couldn't help but shake her head and chuckle.
Back in his room, it was already past ten o'clock at night.
Hobert didn't feel tired, he just felt that today had been too exciting. In the morning, he was fighting and killing, and at noon he transformed into a tourist. Shopping on the commercial street at night really felt like accompanying a girlfriend.
After savoring it for a while, Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" to check his spoils of war today.
Today's spoils of war included 2 sealed artifacts, as many as 22 Beyonder characteristics! There were also 2 Beyonder materials, and 422 pounds in cash.
He first placed the cash neatly stacked with gold pounds and gold livres on the stone platform, and then Hobert looked at the two Beyonder materials. They were Sequence 6 and Sequence 7 level Beyonder materials, probably traded and hoarded at the Beyonder gathering.
One of them was a "Mutated Heart of the Black Radiance Beast", which is one of the main materials for "Baron of Corruption".
Thinking of Gale having a "Briber" subordinate, it was probably a reward prepared for that subordinate in the future.
One of the two sealed artifacts was a "Seer" pathway sealed artifact, with the ability to divine and use some "Magician" skills.
The other was an earring, a Beyonder item of the "Assassin" pathway, which allowed the wearer to have excellent skills and fighting abilities, and also had the effect of concealing traces, but not invisibility.
Finally, there was Hobert's favorite part: checking the Beyonder pathways. This battle yielded 1 "Guardian" Beyonder characteristic, and 1 "Judge" Beyonder characteristic.
3 Sequence 7 level characteristics: one "Briber", one "Pyromaniac", and one "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristic.
8 Sequence 8 level characteristics: two "Pugulist", two "Sheriff", two "Barbarian", one "Provoker", and one "Lunatic" Beyonder characteristic.
9 Sequence 9 level characteristics: three "Warrior", two "Lawyer", two "Arbiter", and two "Hunter" Beyonder characteristic.
After "crushing" a batch of them, Hobert looked at the slowly re-aggregating Beyonder characteristics and thought: Although the "Judgement Group" Beyonders are somewhat like a motley crew, they mainly come from the four pathways of "Warrior", "Arbiter", "Lawyer", and "Hunter".
He let his thoughts wander: The "Warrior" pathway obviously came from Gale, the "Arbiter" and "Lawyer" pathways came from Feynapotter nobles, and the "Hunter" pathway should also come from the Feynapotter Kingdom. It's just hoarding the spoils from the Beyonder battles with the Intis Republic, so it's better to use them to play some role.
Finally, Hobert looked at the "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristic: Where did the "Prisoner" Beyonder characteristic come from?
Hobert remembered that one of the two "Numinous Episcopate" executives he killed before was a Beyonder of the "Prisoner" pathway.
Although this pathway appeared somewhat abruptly, Hobert didn't take it too seriously. It's extra money, make a profit when you can, who knows when you'll earn it next time, no need to worry about these things.
Hobert looked at his accumulation of the "Warrior" and "Hunter" pathways. He planned to keep the Beyonder characteristics of these two pathways for now, to cultivate Beyonder forces loyal to him.
Hobert brought some gold pounds back to the real world, and the next morning, he spent 1200 pounds to acquire the three spoils of war from Fors.
For Fors, the 1200 pounds were earned easily, just providing cover and stopping the Sequence 8 and Sequence 9 enemies from escaping.
Fors, who had spent almost all of her savings at the Tarot Gathering before, became rich again!
Fors played all day yesterday and half a day today, dragging Hobert to see the snow scene, and Donna followed along shamelessly.
Arriving at the mountain peak, Hobert looked at the snow-covered landscape in his territory, which made him feel very proud, and he immediately thought of the poem "Ode to the Plum Blossom".
When Hobert was in college, he used this poem to participate in a recitation competition, but unfortunately only got fifth place, and now he has almost forgotten it.
He only remembered: "The northern scenery, a thousand miles of ice, ten thousand miles of snow."
He only remembered: "Pity Qin Shi Huang and Emperor Wu of Han, lacking literary talent, Emperor Taizong of Tang and Emperor Taizu of Song, slightly inferior in grace. The proud son of heaven, Genghis Khan, only knew how to bend his bow and shoot big eagles."
Although Fors also recited a few poems, Hobert felt that in terms of sentiment and mind, those poems were far inferior to this poem in his mind.
The only flaw was that the weather had begun to warm up, the snow was melting quickly, and the mountain roads were a bit muddy.
So the three of them returned to the Lord's Mansion at noon and did not continue to enjoy the snow in the afternoon.
That afternoon, Hobert received two letters, one from Elliot, who said in the letter that the Balk family had organized 36 young members of the family, hoping to study in the Northern Continent.
But the problem now is that their Loen language is still very poor and has not reached the level of normal communication.
So Elliot wanted to ask the "Favored of God" to arrange a study class, so that they could learn Loen language first after arriving in the Northern Continent.
All tuition and other expenses will be borne by the Balk family, paid in gold.
Hobert pondered for a while, but he could ask Edwina if there were any permanent Loen language charms?
While writing a letter to "Iceberg General", he received a letter from Daly.
Daly informed Hobert that the Archbishop had approved the continuation of trading Beyonder characteristics with Hobert, and the specific person in charge was Leonard.
This was good news, so after replying to Edwina, Hobert wrote a letter to Leonard, saying that he had several Beyonder characteristics of the "Secret Supplicant" pathway in his hand, and asked him about the purchase price from Sequence 9 to Sequence 6.
While waiting for the two to reply, Corwin returned to Jeffery Territory.
Hobert simply asked how the errand went? Then he appointed him as "Human Resources Knight", temporarily equipped with only one assistant, to do human resources work.
The operation of the territory has been on the right track. Although Hobert has been "absent from work" for two days, the territory is still operating normally, but there are a few things that have been backlogged and need to be dealt with by Hobert.
After Conrad takes office as the mayor, such backlog of things will no longer occur.
At more than four o'clock in the afternoon, Edwina and Leonard replied one after another.
Both replies were simple. Edwina said that there were charms that could permanently master languages, but the price was relatively high. She thoughtfully gave the price in gold livres: 52 gold livres each.
Charms with time limit are cheaper. For example, you can speak, understand, and write Loen language within a month, which only costs 8 silver livres, and it will be even cheaper if you want a batch.
Hobert calculated that 36 permanent charms would only cost 1872 gold livres. He believed that the Balk family should not be short of this money, after all, they will need to import equipment from the Kingdom of Loen in the future, need to read the instructions, need to communicate with Loen engineers, and so on.
Let the kitchen make donuts first. Hobert replied to Elliot, telling him about the permanent charm. Hobert didn't ask for much, just added 3 gold livres in the middle, telling them 55 gold livres each.
Then Hobert opened Leonard's letter. He only replied with a phrase: Basic price!
Hobert shook his head: Lazy poet classmate, in the attainment of "laziness", he can be compared with Fors.
Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" and took out 8 Beyonder characteristics of the "Secret Supplicant" pathway.
They are 2 "Secret Supplicant", 2 "Listener", 2 "Shadow Acsetic", and 2 "Rose Bishop".
In fact, these 8 illegal characteristics only came from two "Rose Bishops". After breaking contact with the Church of the Evernight Goddess, Hobert has not had a way to sell these materials.
If it is the basic price, their selling prices are 300 pounds, 600 pounds, 1200 pounds, and 2500 pounds respectively.
Although Sequence 9 and Sequence 8 seem very cost-effective, Sequence 7 and Sequence 6 are definitely not as good as selling at Beyonder gatherings, but Hobert is only willing to sell these Beyonder characteristics to the orthodox gods' churches.
He roughly calculated that he could sell a total of 9200 pounds. Hobert smiled, happy that he had successfully turned a 5000 pound deal into 9200 pounds!
After the donuts were made, Hobert sent the two people's letters and packages separately.
Half an hour later, Hobert received a reply from Elliot.
Elliot stated in the letter that the Balk family was willing to buy 40 permanent charms, but could only pay in gold.
Hobert then wrote to Edwina to confirm the deal.
Leonard's reply fully demonstrated the work characteristics of the Nighthawks. Leonard sent a package at twelve o'clock in the evening, which was neatly filled with cash.
Seeing so much cash, Hobert, who had already slept, suddenly felt refreshed. He counted it all night, not a pound less!
After sacrificing the money to the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert remembered that Leonard only sent the money, and didn't even send a reply!
Shaking his head, Hobert continued to sleep, even smiling in his sleep.
He even had a dream in which he completed a transaction with the vampires and rolled around on a bed made of money.
...
The construction work in the territory is steadily advancing. Leisure time always passes quickly. The snow in Jeffery Territory basically melted in only two days. Except for the construction site, everywhere else is muddy.
For the villagers, this is the last period of rest. After the spring, the weather warms up quickly, and they will start spreading manure and sowing seeds soon. At that time, they will be busy day and night.
This year everyone is particularly hopeful, because the area of ​​their own land is much larger, and the crops harvested in the land will belong to them. Just thinking about this makes people happy.
In a blink of an eye, it was Monday afternoon again, and it was time for the Tarot Gathering.
At three o'clock sharp, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog, and he came to the giant-like hall again.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool!" The first item of the gathering: "Justice" Audrey's greeting.
"The Fool" Klein responded: "Good afternoon, our 'Psychiatrist' Miss."
Last Friday, Audrey completed the transaction with "Moon" Emlyn and was finally promoted to "Psychiatrist".
Hobert also echoed: "In the future, if there are any transactions that are not suitable to be brought to the real world, you can ask Miss Justice to hypnotize us."
Audrey smiled and said: "If any members have psychological problems, they can also come to me for treatment. I don't charge any consultation fees at the moment!"
Then Audrey continued to greet as usual. As the number of members increased, the time spent in this session became longer and longer.
Then it was the sacrifice diary and Klein's reading time, but this time Klein's reading process was very fast. Hobert estimated that the diary sacrificed this time did not have much valuable information.
Major events have occurred in the previous gatherings, which have disrupted the procedures of the Tarot Gathering. Now that it has suddenly returned to the normal procedures, Hobert is a little unaccustomed.
The third session is free trade. "Moon" Emlyn first said to Hobert: "When and where do you plan to trade?"
Hobert was not in a hurry to answer this question, but said to Klein: "Mr. Fool, I request to communicate with Mr. Moon alone."
"Can."
Emlyn was slightly stunned, can it still be like this!
After Klein established a separate communication space, Hobert said: "The time is Tuesday at eight o'clock in the evening, as for the transaction location..."
He asked knowingly: "...I heard that Backlund has a Harvest Church, are you familiar with it?"
Klein, sitting at the head of the bronze long table: You asked the right person, he is not very familiar with it, he just goes there every day.
"How can a noble vampire be familiar with places like the Harvest Church!" It was as if someone had stepped on Emlyn's tail, he almost shouted it out.
But he immediately seemed to think of something, glanced awkwardly at the Fool at the head, and then said: "I, I occasionally pass by there."
Hobert nodded: "That's good, I require the transaction location to be opposite the Harvest Church in Backlund."
"This..." Emlyn was a little embarrassed. This seemed to imply a humiliation to the vampires. I wonder if Lord Nibbs will agree?
"You still have to tell them!" Hobert smiled and said: "If it's just me trading with you, I might even give the vampires some discounts.
"But since they are going to send two viscounts, then sorry, there are no discounts, and I must decide the transaction location, because those two viscounts made me take huge risks for this."
Emlyn "hmm"ed: This is a good excuse, but... but why do I feel insulted?
Hobert added: "I need a batch of medicines to treat colds, chills, and diarrhea, preferably made into three types, ready to use, starting with a hundred servings each!"
Because of the snow, Hobert heard that many people on the construction site were sick. The "pharmacist" he was cultivating had not yet been finalized, and now there were only two barefoot doctors from the territory watching over the construction site. The medicine they prescribed was not very effective.
Emlyn raised his chin: "You've come to the right person."
Although the quantity required was not small, he and his parents could complete this order.
He was very familiar with the prices of various herbs: "Each portion for treating colds requires 15 Solas, each portion for treating chills requires 2 Solas, and each portion for treating diarrhea requires 6 Solas."
These were all common ailments, and the herbs used were very ordinary, and a dozen portions could be made at a time.
Emlyn added at the end: "The expiration date is one month."
Hobert calculated and couldn't help but sigh: He still needed to cultivate his own pharmacist! Three hundred ordinary potions would cost 115 pounds!
He said: "Deal!"
With this transaction settled, the two ended their private exchange.
The other members were no strangers to the "Emperor's" transaction with the vampires, so they didn't show much curiosity.
At this time, "The World" said in a hoarse voice: "I want to sell an Beyonder characteristic. Its original owner was good at divination and could change his appearance."
This was the first soul released from the "Creeping Hunger", and it was an Beyonder characteristic of the "Faceless".
As soon as "The World" finished speaking, Hobert immediately said: "I'll take it for 4,000 pounds!"
Klein didn't expect it to be so smooth. He originally thought it might be difficult to sell, after all, none of the Tarot Club members were related to the "Seer" pathway.
He thought he would have to ask everyone to help inquire through their respective channels.
"Deal!" Klein said immediately.
As a fairly popular Beyonder characteristic, the price given by the "Emperor" was not very high, but the advantage of this transaction was that it was clean and efficient.
And Hobert had already decided to sell this Beyonder characteristic to the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
In order to make up for the lack of ritual magic in the "Sleepless" and "Corpse Collector" pathways at the "Low Sequence", the Church of the Evernight Goddess currently has many Beyonders of the "Seer" pathway.
Therefore, the acquisition of this kind of Beyonder characteristic cannot still be based on the base price.
Even if it was based on the base price, this transaction would still be profitable for Hobert.
Audrey said with some regret: "It's a pity, it's just an Beyonder characteristic."
The Beyonder power to change appearance sounded very tempting.
Hobert opened his mouth, but in the end, he didn't say anything.
Through the battles of the previous two days, Hobert felt that the "Faceless Necklace" was becoming more and more useless. Before, Hobert felt it had some use because of the "Paper Substitute" ability of the "Faceless Necklace", and he had been wearing it.
But when Hobert reviewed the battle with Gale, he suddenly realized that the "Paper Substitute" ability was not very useful.
If he encountered a powerful enemy, such as a demigod, one "Paper Substitute" would not be enough.
But if he encountered an enemy of Sequence 5 or below, he wouldn't need the "Paper Substitute" ability at all.
Hobert originally planned to sell it to Audrey, but then he thought about it again. This necklace also had the ability to divination.
Hobert still had a need for this aspect, so he couldn't sell it for the time being.
Then "The World" initiated a new transaction: "I need the remaining spirituality of an ancient wraith and a pair of eyes of a six-winged gargoyle."
"I seem to have the eyes of a six-winged gargoyle there," Hobert said. "But I need to go back and confirm."
"Well, I'll reply to you tonight at the latest."
That was what he had obtained from tomb raiding before. At first, he thought it was the core crystal of the six-winged gargoyle, but when distinguishing the levels in the "Nation of Disorder", it didn't seem to be a main material of Sequence 5.
After hearing "The World's" request, Hobert realized that it might be an auxiliary material of Sequence 5.
At that time, Hobert's level was too low to make a detailed distinction. Now he should be able to complete this distinction, but he had to go to the "Nation of Disorder" before he dared to confirm it.
Even if it was an auxiliary material, it could be sold for seven or eight hundred pounds at this level.
"The World" said in a hoarse voice: "Okay."
Because no one had the "remaining spirituality of an ancient wraith", this transaction was temporarily put on hold, and everyone said they would help "The World" pay attention.
This free trade session was unusually hot. "The Hanged Man" Alger even asked everyone to help inquire about the "Ocean Songster" potion formula.
The "Wind Blessed" potion had begun to be digested, and he planned to take advantage of his current good financial situation to prepare for his promotion to Sequence 5.
Hobert immediately thought of Edwina's pathway. He believed that the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom should have the corresponding potion formula, and they should also be happy to spread these potion formulas.
However, the price must also be very beautiful, so Hobert planned to ask Edwina when he had time before giving Alger a definite reply.
Audrey looked at the Tarot Club like this and felt somewhat gratified. At the beginning, this gathering was only trading potion formulas of Sequence 9 level.
Now, most of the members have become "Mid Sequence", and they have already begun to trade potion formulas of Sequence 5 level.
The free trade session ended here, and everyone entered the information exchange session.
Audrey asked Emlyn curiously: "Mr. Moon, do vampires really imitate human nobles and use baron, earl, etc. to distinguish ranks?"
"It's humans who imitate our vampires!" Emlyn's chin was raised so high that you could almost see his nostrils: "How many years have human nobles existed? Our vampires have had our own history since the Second Epoch!"
"Little Sun" Derrick said a little unconvinced: "There are no similar records in the City of Silver's classics!"
Emlyn said proudly: "The records of the small City of Silver, how can they be compared with the history of our vampires."
After he finished speaking, he thought in his heart: Where is City of Silver? I've never heard of it.
Derrick said a little aggrieved: "Mr. Emperor, please judge for us, which came first, the vampire's title or the human noble's title?"
Hobert pondered for a moment: "Humans should have appeared first."
"Little Sun" looked at Emlyn triumphantly.
Emlyn said coldly: "Mr. Emperor, what is your basis? Could it be that humans already had nobles in the Second Epoch?"
"In that Second Epoch with dragons and giants, humans were indeed like a second-class race." Hobert smiled: "But I don't feel any inferiority as a weak human being.
"Because humans used the time of the Second and Third Epochs to become the masters of this world. There may still be dragons and giants now, but the number should be very, very small.
"Anyway, the elves of the North and South continents are extinct. Mr. 'Hanged Man' can testify to this."
Alger nodded, indicating that he did know about this.
Before Emlyn could speak, Hobert said again: "Of course, my guess is based on the time of the appearance of the first 'Blasphemy Slate'."
Everyone was stunned. How did it get related to the "Blasphemy Slate"?

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 462 Eight Ancient Gods (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to gabs gomes for joining, +1]
During the free trading session earlier, Audrey felt happy, but she always felt like something was missing.
Now she finally understood, what was missing was 'Emperor's' seemingly endless high-level intelligence, and yes, well, and the blasphemy against the gods.
At the Tarot Gathering, it seemed like you couldn't get past this stage without blaspheming against the gods or discussing them.
Emlyn asked strangely: "What does our previous argument have to do with the first 'Blasphemy Slate'?"
"The Fool had previously explained information about the Blasphemy Slate at the Tarot Gathering," Hobert said with a smile. "Mr. Fool, can I tell Mr. Moon that information for a fee?"
Klein slowly nodded: "You may."
"I think this information is worth at least 1,000 pounds," Hobert asked with a smile: "Mr. Moon, do you want to continue listening?"
"I... you..." Emlyn was a little angry, this was a bit of a rogue move. They were in the middle of an argument, and suddenly he had to spend money to buy information to prove that his opponent's statement was correct?
Hobert added: "How about this, you can replace these 1,000 pounds with medicine. I'll place an order with you whenever I need it."
"With Mr. Fool as a witness, the actual value of the information I'm about to tell is definitely more than 1,000 pounds. The Sanguine with a long history should also have similar records, but I believe you definitely don't know this information at your current level!
"If you knew similar information, I wouldn't take a copper penny from you!"
Emlyn took a deep breath: "Of course I believe in Mr. Fool's witness. Tell me, I want to hear what information I don't know?"
As a member of the Sanguine, he knew far more information and history than ordinary Beyonders!
Everyone showed expressions of waiting to watch the show. If it were someone else, it would be hard to say, but compared to 'Emperor', Mr. Moon's words were too confident.
Hobert said: "As far as I know, the first 'Blasphemy Slate' only appeared occasionally during the Second Epoch, and it wasn't until the Third Epoch that it was fully presented to the world."
Klein behind the gray fog thought: Is this really some of the information I disclosed before because of 'Emperor's' bribery? Why does it sound so unfamiliar to me? The Nighthawk's related information only said that the first 'Blasphemy Slate' appeared in the Third Epoch, and it existed in the Second Epoch?
Audrey also felt a little strange: Did Mr. Fool say the specific time when the first 'Blasphemy Slate' appeared at that time? Why don't I have any impression at all?
Alger realized something: I only know that the first 'Blasphemy Slate' appeared in the Third Epoch, but I didn't know that it also appeared in the Second Epoch! Mr. Fool must have given 'Emperor' some valuable information separately after the gathering. After all, 'Emperor' was bribing Mr. Fool at that time, and we were just bystanders.
Derrick was a little confused: When I was in school, I heard that the first 'Blasphemy Slate' was a gift from the 'Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord' to people, but this is the first time I've heard that it appeared in the Second Epoch. Mr. Fool never mentioned these things before, but Mr. Emperor said that it was information that Mr. Fool had disclosed. How strange!
"Magician" Fors hadn't joined the Tarot Gathering at that time, and didn't know the process of 'Emperor' bribing Mr. Fool. At the moment, she didn't dare to breathe loudly, for fear that 'Emperor' would remember this matter and ask her for 1,000 pounds as well.
The most surprised person was Emlyn: This, this is indeed information that I haven't heard of, damn it! The noble Sanguine actually lost to a human in terms of history!
But he still stubbornly said: "Mr. Emperor, is this worth 1,000 pounds? What can this explain?"
"Think about it carefully," Hobert said with a smile: "Without exception, the eight ancient gods of the Second Epoch were known for their madness and distortion.
"And in the Third Epoch, and after that, there were very few mad and distorted gods. Every pathway has also become traceable, and people can effectively resist the madness and distortion brought about by Beyonder characteristics."
Emlyn opened his mouth. He seemed to have thought of a very important piece of information, but he didn't know how to express his thoughts for a while.
The other members had similar feelings. Klein and Alger were the first to understand what "Emperor" meant.
Alger said to "Emperor": "Are you saying that there was no systematized pathway system in the Second Epoch at all?"
Before this, he thought that there might not be a complete potion formula system in the Second Epoch, but there should be the concept of "pathway", but listening to "Emperor's" meaning, it didn't seem to be the case?
Hobert nodded: "That's right."
"Then..." Alger found that his voice was too loud. He calmed down a little before asking: "Then, how did those ancient gods become gods?"
Hobert nodded: "We can only say that they were lucky, and they didn't die after swallowing so many Beyonder characteristics."
The other members were all in a brief shock. They all knew from the myths that the Second Epoch was a barbaric era, and after listening to what Emperor said, they realized the extent of its madness and bloodiness!
In Audrey's mind, some extremely brutal scenes of the Second Epoch appeared. At that time, there were strong creatures everywhere. They were fighting and fighting, and in the end, only eight extraordinary creatures ascended to the throne of God. At that time, humans, heavens, humans were as weak as ants at that time.
Even Derrick temporarily forgot the argument just now and began to imagine the scene of the City of Silver struggling under the rule of the Giant King.
Everyone looked at Emlyn in unison, as if saying with their eyes: Your 1,000 pounds is really worth it!
Even Klein, who had always been frugal, was thinking about whether to help Emlyn bear one or two hundred pounds?
Hobert continued: "The history of the Sanguine can indeed be traced back to the Second Epoch, but at that time, a Beyonder was equal to madness and distortion. The Sanguine must not have distinctions such as barons and earls.
"In the Third Epoch, the Sanguine also benefited from the 'Blasphemy Slate', and then there was a distinction between sequences.
"And at this time, humans have also risen, and nobles have also appeared.
"I am not a historian and cannot give you a clear answer, but according to my guess, humans should have appeared with the division of titles first. After all, the Sanguine did not play a big role in the entire Third Epoch.
"In the Fourth Epoch, there was a Sanguine archangel who became the Queen of the Night Emperor."
Emlyn was speechless for a while. He didn't know how to refute "Emperor", because after Emperor's reminder, he also recalled that the history of the Sanguine in the Third Epoch was indeed a bit vague, and it was indeed in the Fourth Epoch that they ushered in glory again.
At this time, everyone had forgotten the original intention of the argument. Audrey asked: "Mr. Emperor, why did the first 'Blasphemy Slate' appear in the Second Epoch? Is there any unknown secret in this?"
"That's right!"
"You, give me a price!" Audrey said with some excitement and nervousness.
"Thirty thousand... no, fifty thousand..." Finally, Hobert sighed: "I'm sorry, with the information you currently have, I really can't price it.
"Or rather, that level of information can't be measured by money."
Everyone was secretly surprised by "30,000" and "50,000", but later "Emperor" directly gave the price of "priceless", which was the first time Emperor had made such an expression.
Audrey asked again: "Then how can I get the answer to this question?"
Hobert pondered for a while: "Wait a minute, when the time is right, Mr. Fool may explain it to everyone, or I will conduct related transactions with everyone and tell everyone."
But this level of information is difficult to measure with money, so let's talk about it when there is a chance.
Audrey was a little disappointed, but then asked: "Mr. Emperor, there are a total of eight ancient gods, right? Can I trade with you for information related to the ancient gods?"
"Of course," Hobert said with a smile: "A simple introduction is 3,000 pounds, but overly detailed information, such as the current state and situation of the only surviving ancient god, is not included in the answer."
And the related information of Lilith's "fall", etc., are all key information that can affect the current situation, of course, it cannot be easily revealed.
Audrey once again launched crowdfunding: "Is there anyone willing to join the transaction together? I can pay Mr. Emperor 1,000 pounds, and the rest will be collected by everyone."
"I am willing to pay 500 pounds!" Fors, who had just obtained 1,200 pounds, said first. Now, trading high-end information with the emperor has become a habit.
Alger hesitated slightly: "I'll also pay 500 pounds!"
Although he also knew that he should save money to buy the "Ocean Songster" potion formula, he didn't want to miss such a transaction!
Derrick: "I am willing to offer two Beyonder ingredients at the Sequence 8 level."
The previous "Provoker Warhammer" gave him a lot of merit, and two Beyonder ingredients were a piece of cake for him.
Then, as usual, everyone looked at "The World".
Klein, who had just obtained 4,000 pounds, also said confidently: "I will also pay 500 pounds! Deduct it from the money from selling Beyonder characteristics."
In the end, only Emlyn was left. He moved his lips, but in the end he didn't say anything, indicating that he was not very interested in this issue: Ancient gods, I also know a few, there is no need to spend such unjust money.
Audrey didn't want the new members to be isolated, so she said again: "How about this, I will pay 300 pounds more to give Mr. Moon the right to listen, but he cannot ask questions, is that okay? Mr. Emperor?"
"No need!" Emlyn refused: "I'm not interested in this question!"
Audrey smiled: "Mr. Moon, this will be your reward for answering my question just now, please be sure to accept it."
Reward? What reward? Emlyn thought for a while before realizing that Miss Justice was talking about how he answered her question about the way the Sanguine distinguishes levels just now: "You are an upright and generous lady, but there is no need to pay a reward for this."
Audrey continued to smile: "Mr. Moon, please participate, the transaction initiated with Mr. Emperor is one of the important links in the Tarot Gathering."
Fors recalled that after participating in such a transaction, she couldn't stop at all.
Hobert also said to Emlyn: "If you join the transaction, I will give you a piece of information when I talk about the Sanguine Ancestor, as a welcome to the new member."
As soon as this remark came out, the other members more enthusiastically invited Mr. Moon to join the transaction. Emlyn reluctantly agreed. He also wanted to see how worthwhile the information worth 3,000 pounds was.
After discussing the price, Hobert smiled: "Then let's start!
"The eight ancient gods are 'Giant King' Aurmir, 'Elf King' Soniathrym, 'Sanguine Ancestor' Lilith.
"And 'Dragon of Imagination' Ankewelt, 'Phoenix Ancestor' Gregrace, 'Mutant King' Kvastir.
"There are also 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' Flegrea and 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti."
Everyone remembered carefully, and they all sighed that many mythological figures were actually ancient gods!
Then Hobert began to elaborate: "'Giant King' Aurmir, 'Little Sun' should know very well, is the god of the 'Warrior' pathway, and the City of Silver was once under the rule of the 'Giant King'."
"Little Sun" nodded repeatedly: "That's right, later we received the redemption of the Lord and began to believe in the 'Omnipotent and Omniscient God'."
Hobert continued: "The 'Giant King's' subsidiary gods are, 'Harvest Goddess' Omibella, 'Dawn God' Badheil, 'God of Honor'…"
"Wait a minute!" Alger interrupted in surprise: "Sorry everyone, I suddenly remembered a confidential document I read, which said that the name of the 'God of Combat' is Badheil!"
The others were also surprised, and then looked at "Emperor" together.
Hobert smiled: "That's right, this eldest son of the 'Giant King' is the later 'God of Combat'!"
The hall was silent for a full five or six seconds before everyone reacted and spread their thoughts.
Klein behind the gray fog thought: It turns out that the Seven Gods can be traced back to the Second Epoch.
Alger felt his heart pounding: I know the origin of another god! All along, they have been so high above that I always forget that they also have origins.
Audrey: Heavens, "God of Combat" is actually the son of "Giant King"! How does it feel like the position of God in the "Warrior" pathway is like a noble title? Did "God of Combat" inherit his father's position?
Fors: "God of Combat" He is actually a son, no, I mean, He was actually born by someone else, and not... okay, so the gods really have a birth process!
The most surprised person was Emlyn: Is this how "God of Combat" came to be? Mother above, cough cough, Ancestor above, why do we, a group of "Mid Sequence" Beyonders, need to know these things?
Then he realized: No wonder they all said that "Emperor's" information was worth more than its value, this one piece of information alone is worth more than 3,000 pounds! Am I crazy, or is "Emperor" crazy?
"Little Sun" Derrick thought for a while before asking: "Mr. Emperor, is the 'Harvest Goddess' the Earth Mother you are talking about? I noticed that their authority is very similar."
Reminded by Derrick, everyone suddenly realized this and looked at "Emperor" with either surprise or excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - 463: The Ancient God’s Subsidiary Gods (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to KleeDaddy for joining, +1]
Hobert smiled and said, "This question is very complicated and not within the scope of this answer. Well, to be precise, I cannot answer this question until the situation is clear."
He thought to himself: The Evernight Goddess is hovering over my head right now. If I ruin her plans, I believe there will be no 'Emperor' left in this world.
Derrick nodded with some disappointment, "Alright then."
Klein and Alger both realized that the "Emperor's" answer implied a huge hidden story.
Emlyn: Is it or isn't it? What does 'not within the scope of this answer' mean? We all paid for this.
Thinking of this, he felt a little guilty, because his "spectator seat" came from Miss Justice's payment, and he certainly understood that this answer was worth more than 3,000 pounds.
Hobert continued: "'Elf King' is a true god of the 'Sailor' pathway. Oh, by the way, let me mention that, as mentioned before, there is a high probability that there are Beyonder characteristics of other pathways in the bodies of ancient gods."
"But what specific pathway is impossible to verify, so I'll just say His 'True God pathway'."
Hobert paused slightly and then said: "'Elf King's' subsidiary gods are 'Calamity Queen' Cohinem and 'God of Luck'."
Alger said, "Sorry everyone, I need to ask another question."
In the last transaction, Audrey, who paid the most, could ask questions freely, but for the sake of fairness, others could only ask one question.
Although this was not stated in advance this time, everyone felt that it would be fairer to follow the previous practice.
"Little Sun" Derrick said, "Mr. Hanged Man, I can give you my chance to ask a question."
Although he had asked a question just now, he did not get an answer, so it doesn't count as using up his chance to ask a question.
Alger was not polite: "Thank you."
After all, he had given Derrick a lot of guidance before, so now it was like using up the favors from those times.
Alger asked the "Emperor": "As far as I know, there are still a small number of natives on some islands who still believe in the 'Calamity Queen'. May I ask, does the 'Calamity Queen' still... still exist?"
Hobert replied: "As far as I know, after the 'Elf King' fell, She also fell along with Him. But Her Beyonder characteristics seem to have been preserved in a relatively special way, and have not been completely reused, so Her will has been preserved to a certain extent within a small range."
Alger opened his mouth: What a strange state!
Klein behind the gray fog couldn't help but think: I didn't expect that the ancient gods and subsidiary gods of the Second Epoch still have an impact on the present.
Hobert continued: "'Sanguine Ancestor' Lilith is a true god of the 'Moon' pathway, and her subsidiary gods are 'Goddess of Beauty' Auernia and the Goddess of Life."
Emlyn exclaimed: "Your Majesty Auernia has indeed followed the Ancestor since the Second Epoch!"
Hobert smiled and continued: "And the information I give to Mr. Moon is: Before Lilith 'fell', there were some problems with her state. In addition, it is said that her fall was due to a betrayal!"
Emlyn stood up abruptly: "Who? Who betrayed the Ancestor!"
Hobert thought to himself: It seems that Emlyn's level has not reached the authority to know these things.
Logically speaking, the vampires should know some inside information about this matter. After all, the "Goddess of Beauty" did not fall until the Fourth Epoch, giving them enough opportunities to tell their clansmen some secrets about the Ancestor's "fall".
Hobert smiled at the angry Emlyn: "The value of this answer is 3,000 pounds."
This piece of information is free, but an explanation requires payment.
Emlyn immediately calmed down a lot: "3...3000 pounds! Then, then I must trade with you as soon as I have enough money."
Hobert smiled: "No problem."
Everyone smiled at each other, marveling at how much the "Emperor" knew, and also marveling at his high-end or hidden information, one ring after another.
Even if Hobert didn't explain this information in detail, everyone couldn't help but come up with many associations.
Klein leaned back in his chair and thought: It seems that there are many secrets between the ancient gods of the Second Epoch. These secrets may be the key to unraveling some historical questions.
Alger folded his arms: The more information he gets from the "Emperor", the more he feels that the history of the gods is the history of an era! Every time at this time, one can't help but feel how insignificant human power is!
Audrey: I really want to know the answer, but I can only wait for a while, because this is a question that Hobert prepared for Mr. Moon.
The hall was quiet for a few seconds, and then Emlyn seemed to suddenly come back to his senses: "That's not right, the Ancestor clearly hasn't fallen. Some of the vampire elders occasionally receive instructions from the Ancestor!"
He thought to himself: I came to participate in the Tarot Gathering because I received instructions from the Ancestor?
"This question is also included in those 3,000 pounds," Hobert said with a smile: "But I can only give you a simple answer and cannot explain it to you in detail."
Emlyn nodded, which meant that the Ancestor had indeed not fallen!
"Let us continue," Hobert continued: "'Dragon of Imagination' is a true god of the 'Visionary' pathway, that is, the 'Spectator' pathway. In addition, there are Beyonder characteristics of other pathways in His body, but what specific pathway is impossible to verify.
"His subsidiary gods are 'Nightmare Dragon' Alzuhod and 'Wisdom Dragon' Herabgen.
"According to some of our previous transactions, we know that '0-08' was formed after Alzuhod fell. And last week we just said that 'Wisdom Dragon' is the current God of Knowledge and Wisdom."
Only Emlyn was a little surprised: This is already the second god to appear! Could it be that the current Seven Gods were all subsidiary gods of the ancient gods?
Because of "0-08", everyone was relatively familiar with the "Dragon of Imagination", so they did not stop here, and Hobert continued: "'Phoenix' Ancestor is a true god of the 'Death' pathway, and at the same time has certain Beyonder characteristics of the 'Door' pathway in His body."
Audrey asked: "Mr. Emperor, these two pathways don't seem to be adjacent pathways!"
"Yes, they are not adjacent pathways."
Everyone's thoughts were similar: No wonder the ancient gods were all crazy. It turns out that they have two non-adjacent Beyonder characteristics in their bodies. The "Emperor" is right, becoming a god in the Second Epoch all depends on luck!
In fact, everyone had already anticipated this point, but now there is direct evidence to prove the previous guess.
"'Mutant King' is a true god of the 'Prisoner' pathway," Hobert said: "We mentioned not long ago that the members of the 'Rose School' are mainly Beyonders of this pathway.
"His subsidiary gods are 'God of Spiritual Beings' Tolzna and the God of Combat."
Tolzna belongs to a somewhat "niche" "god", and no one has heard of Him, so Hobert did not make further explanations.
"'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' is a true god of the 'Sleepless' pathway, and at the same time He has the Beyonder characteristics of an King of Angels level of the 'Seer' pathway in His body," Hobert said:
"His subsidiary gods are 'Goddess of Misfortune' Amanises, 'God of the Undead' Salinger, and 'God of Wishes' Kotar."
Even Klein, who had been a Nighthawk, did not know the true name of the Evernight Goddess.
His attention was drawn to another name, so he manipulated "The World" and asked: "Salinger? Is that the later 'Underworld Emperor'?"
Klein had seen some descriptions of the "Underworld Emperor" in a previous diary, including the Underworld Emperor's true name.
Hobert smiled: "Yes!"
He thought to himself: You don't even know what you just missed.
Everyone was not as surprised as before, after all, this was not the first subsidiary god to later ascend to the throne of God.
Finally, Hobert said: "'Devil Monarch' Farbauti is a true god of the 'Criminal' pathway. Members in Backlund should still remember that the murderer in the 'serial murder case' that caused a stir before was an Beyonder of this pathway."
Except for Emlyn, who had just joined, everyone was deeply impressed by this matter.
A certain Mr. Fool sitting at the head of the table had also investigated the "Apostle of Desire" and finally finished him off.
Everyone savored the answers just now, and no one spoke for a while.
Audrey savored it while saying in her heart: This is the atmosphere that the Tarot Gathering should have!
After a dozen seconds, the free exchange session restarted, and Klein manipulated "The World" and said: "I heard about a matter at sea, which is related to the Storm Church."
Alger frowned: Related to the church? Why didn't I receive a notification?
Klein was a little disappointed. He originally thought that he could find out from the "Hanged Man" how the Bansy Harbor incident was handled, but judging from the "Hanged Man's" reaction, he didn't know about it.
However, Klein still manipulated "The World" and continued to describe: "The ancient customs of Bansy Harbor have revived, and some residents have become cultists. Even the bishop of the Storm Church has fallen.
"I heard that the matter has been resolved, but many people have died."
Alger recalled the situation in Bansy Harbor and took the initiative to explain to everyone: "There is a tradition of human sacrifice there, and the target of the sacrifice is an evil spirit called the 'God of Weather'.
"Overseas, in the Southern Continent, there are many similar evil spirits. They seem to have been cleared, but they actually survive in a strange state."
"This reminds me of an King of Angels," Hobert suddenly realized that Klein had not met Medici in Backlund and did not know the relevant information. He felt that he should remind Alger.
Audrey asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, what does this have to do with the King of Angels?"
Other members had similar questions, except for Emlyn. He remembered that other members had traded information about the King of Angels at the last gathering.
This made Emlyn inexplicably excited, and he found another reason why the Ancestor asked him to pray to Mr. Fool: Sure enough, this is a savior gathering preparing for the end of the world. We are all the chosen ones and will gradually face evil existences such as the "King of Angels", "Primordial Demoness", and "True Creator".
This made Emlyn suddenly have an impulse to initiate a transaction with the "Emperor" to obtain information about the King of Angels, but the fact that he had no money ruthlessly shattered the fantasy in his mind.
Hobert replied: "I remember that the descendants of an King of Angels live in Binsy, which is now Bansy Harbor, and that King of Angels is the 'Red Angel' Medici we mentioned at the last gathering."
Klein was stunned: So there are descendants of the Medici family still alive, but they should be relatively weak and can only hide in this small port.
Alger did not expect that this incident would lead to an King of Angels. He was already thinking about how to report this news to the church.
While accumulating merit for himself, he can also make the Storm Church more vigilant.
"Everyone, I have a question," Emlyn said: "The thing is, suppose, a strong person arranges for you to investigate something. Although you have successfully obtained the information, you cannot report it to that strong person for some reason. Then, how should you continue to get support from that strong person?"
Other members, including Hobert, turned their attention to Alger. In their minds, Mr. Hanged Man has rich experience in this area.
Alger glanced at "The Moon": "It's very simple, but you must bear certain risks."
Emlyn subconsciously denied: "It's not me!"
"Suppose it's you!" The Hanged Man replied with a smile: "You can slowly show some abnormalities in your daily life to make that strong person aware of your problem.
"He will have two choices, one is to directly torture you, but this can easily break the clue.
"The second is to inadvertently provide you with help so that you can do more in-depth investigations, and then send someone to monitor you.
"I think the second possibility is the greatest. The risk you need to bear is how to not expose the information you want to hide under surveillance."
It can still be like this? Then Emlyn realized that he no longer needed to show any abnormalities. His transaction with the followers of the "Creator" that he mentioned to the vampires was a relatively abnormal move.
Because in the vampires' impression, the "Creator's" sphere of influence should be in the Southern Continent, but Emlyn, who doesn't usually go out, "met" the followers of the "Creator" in Backlund and established contact very accurately. This sounds incredible.
Emlyn finally understood: No wonder Lord Nibbs seemed very interested in the transaction, but still discussed it for a few days before finally confirming the transaction matters. It turned out that they were not worried about the followers of the "Creator", but had concerns about me.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but smile bitterly and said to the "Hanged Man": "Thank you for your suggestion."
Alger smiled slightly, indicating that it was nothing.
Then, Audrey started another topic: "I heard a piece of news this morning that a large-scale conflict between Beyonders just happened in Conant City.
"One of the parties, using a fishing company as a cover, suffered huge losses. It is said that more than twenty Beyonders died.
"Some people described it as a rare tragedy in the Beyonder world."
She got the news from her father. Since the last Backlund smog incident, Earl Hall has allowed Audrey to participate in the meetings with the Archbishop every three days.
In addition to doing prayers and sermons, the Archbishop also routinely informs important believers like Earl Hall of some extraordinary cases encountered by the church and some information that can be disclosed on a small scale to increase important believers' understanding of extraordinary cases, so that they can have self-help references when encountering similar incidents.
The Punishers connected the case in Conant City with the previous case at the Nicro shipyard in Backlund, and contacted the "Nighthawks" to form a joint investigation team.
The details of the tragedy in Conant City were then revealed to the "Nighthawks."
The Punishers did this not because they had found clues about Hobert, but because the two cases were very similar: many people died!
Ordinary Beyonder cases usually involve one or two deaths, at most a few.
But these two cases involved a dozen or twenty deaths, which was a clear difference from other cases.
This was actually because, in other Sequence 5 level conflicts, the strengths were usually comparable, and many times it was just a fight without anyone dying.
If the strength was vastly different, the stronger side would focus on harvesting the enemy's "Mid-Sequence" Beyonders, and would not care about the enemy's "Low-Sequence" Beyonders, or would maintain their status and be too lazy to fight those "Low-Sequences."
So, in similar conflicts, the "Low-Sequences" also had a high probability of escaping.
But Hobert didn't think so. In his eyes, those were all 300 pounds walking around, or "300+600" pounds walking around. If he couldn't harvest the consistently frugal goods, he would try to harvest a wave, which was why so many people died.
Alger guessed, "It might be a conflict between Beyonder organizations."
Fors suddenly said weakly, "Um, I seem to know something about this."
Everyone was stunned. Alger and Audrey had suspected that it was related to "The World" or "The Emperor," but they had never thought that it would be related to the "Magician," who rarely spoke.
Audrey said, "Miss Magician, if you have detailed information, can you tell us about it?"
Fors confirmed, "Is the case you're talking about happening at the 'Balan Fisheries Company'?"
Audrey nodded, "That's right."
"Then we're talking about the same thing," Fors said, "That was an action I took with two companions."
Everyone was surprised again, and Hobert also pretended to be surprised.
Klein: I saw Miss Magician in disguise at the pier before. Judging from her temperament, she doesn't seem like someone who likes fighting!
Emlyn couldn't believe it: Miss Magician looks like a quiet girl, but I didn't expect her to create such a tragedy as soon as she makes a move.
Audrey also couldn't believe it: I didn't expect Fors to be able to do such a thing! I wonder if the two companions she mentioned include Xio?
Fors realized that everyone seemed to have misunderstood something, and quickly explained, "Those who were killed were all members of the 'Judgment Group.' They were supported by the Feynapotter Kingdom and specialized in sabotage in the Loen Kingdom!"
Before the action, Hobert explained the immoral things that the "Judgment Group" had done, so that Fors would not have any psychological burden.
"The 'Numinous Episcopate' that appeared in southern Loen before was planned and organized by the 'Judgment Group.' This evil cult not only performs live sacrifices, but also uses infant sacrifices!" Fors said:
"And this is just a conspiracy planned by a deputy leader of the 'Judgment Group.' Many heinous cases in the Loen Kingdom were planned by them.
"They also forcibly force wild Beyonders to join them, otherwise they will turn those Beyonders into Beyonder characteristics!
"In this operation, we only killed the Beyonders of the 'Judgment Group,' at most a few thugs who helped them, and did not kill anyone outside the 'Judgment Group'!"
Audrey also felt a sense of shared hatred: "These people deserve to be killed!"
Alger's focus was not here: "How did you three kill more than twenty Beyonders?"
Even three "Mid-Sequence" Beyonders could not kill more than twenty "Low-Sequence" Beyonders. Those people were Beyonders, not stones. Wouldn't they run?
Fors explained, "One of my companions has a very powerful and strange sealed artifact."
Alger nodded, which sounded more reasonable: "Your companion is a Sequence 6 or Sequence 5, right?"
"Yes, it's Sequence 5!"
This was even more reasonable. Alger smiled and said, "Then the enemies must all be 'Low-Sequence' Beyonders!"
"That's not the case," Fors said, "The other side also had a Sequence 5."
Alger thought he had misheard: "That is to say, each side had a Sequence 5?"
"Yes."
Several male members with rich Beyonder combat experience felt a little unbelievable. "The World" asked in a hoarse voice, "Are your two companions both Sequence 5?"
Fors thought for a while, feeling that saying only the sequence number would not reveal too much information: "One is Sequence 5, and one is Sequence 7."
"The World" then asked, "What about the enemies?"
Fors said with a slight sense of pride, "It seems like there were four or five 'Mid-Sequences,' and the rest were 'Low-Sequences.'"
Alger immediately made a judgment: Miss Magician's companion should be holding a Grade 1 sealed artifact, otherwise there would not be such a result.
Klein had a similar idea, and thought: The spoils of this battle, the Beyonder characteristics alone could sell for a lot of money.
Emlyn was stunned for a few seconds before he thought: Are you kidding me? Three people won without any advantage and killed so many people?
At this time, Audrey was already a little strange: "Why don't the official Beyonders eliminate the 'Judgment Group'?"
Alger said, "It is difficult to completely wipe out this kind of local Beyonder organization. It is very likely that the official Beyonders' investigation will be discovered by them at the beginning, so they will immediately transfer, and in the end, they can only catch some peripheral members."
Fors also said, "My companion also said that being able to achieve such a great result this time, surprise attacks and luck accounted for at least half of the factors.
"Originally, he thought that at most he could kill one core member of the 'Judgment Group,' and they would react."
Who knew that Gale and the others would be holding a meeting at that time!
Audrey frowned, "Isn't there any other way?"
"Yes!" Alger smiled and said, "Dispatch demigods, seal off the entire city, and the attacking force is at least twice the strength of the opponent, so that they can be effectively prevented from running away separately during the pursuit."
Everyone smiled together. The step of "dispatching demigods" alone was very difficult. After all, there were only so many demigods of the official Beyonders, and they had many more important things to do, such as deterring the enemy's demigods, or sitting in a certain place.
After discussing this issue for a few more sentences, Klein announced the end of the gathering.
...
In the middle of the Berserk Sea, on the "White Agate."
Klein, who had finished the sacrifice and bestowal ceremony, got up from the bed and saw that the sky outside the window was dim, as if brewing a storm.
With a dull whistle, the ship finally docked.
Klein pushed open the door of the bedroom and found that Danitz had thoughtfully packed his luggage in advance.
Danitz smiled and said, "We have finally arrived at 'Generosity City.'"
From Bansy Harbor to now, he had been worried, and now, he was finally free.
Klein, no, Gehrman Sparrow, said, "You can talk about which pirate contact points are in Bayam."
Danitz's expression twisted: Shit...

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - 464: Doomed Hobert (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Oka for joining, +1]
Hobert almost broke even in this gathering. He spent 4,000 pounds to buy the 'Faceless' Beyonder characteristic and sold information for 4,300 pounds.
Of course, this includes the Little Sun's two Beyonder materials and Emlyn's 1,000-pound potion. The total immediate income is only 2,800 pounds.
So, Hobert sacrificed 700 pounds to pay Klein for the Beyonder characteristic.
After a short rest, Hobert used 'Travel' to come to Conant City and discussed with Upton the matter of the Southern Continent's Blessed learning delegation.
Upton will be responsible for the reception and learning matters. The expenses required will, of course, be paid by Hobert first, and after calculating the total expenses, an additional eight or nine percent will be reimbursed by the Balk family.
Although this is a matter for the Blessed, Hobert has been busy and used many of his own channels. Adding a 10% markup is already a very fair charge.
For this reason, Hobert first paid Upton 2,000 pounds as a fee for learning matters, with refunds for any surplus and additional charges for any deficiency.
Then, he discussed with Upton the matter of customizing a train and carriages. Hobert paid Upton another 2,000 pounds as a deposit for the train and modification costs, also with refunds for any surplus and additional charges for any deficiency.
As for Upton's remuneration for these two tasks, there are two options: one-sixth of a 'Baron of Corruption' Beyonder characteristic, or a 600-pound reward.
Upton, of course, chose to accumulate Beyonder characteristics. 3,600 pounds cannot buy a Sequence 6 Beyonder characteristic.
Finally, Hobert talked to Upton about the spoils of war: "According to convention, if you obtain spoils of war such as Beyonder characteristics above Sequence 9, you must hand them over to me for processing.
"Common curses, corruption from loss of control, etc., can be dealt with. Most importantly, Beyonder characteristics that have been processed can reduce the burden of potions on Beyonders."
Upton was stunned, not expecting such a good thing: "Do I need to pay any fees?"
"No," Hobert said, "This is a benefit for the Blessed."
He was also concerned about the Blessed. Otherwise, taking too many potions would definitely bring a considerable burden to the Blessed.
As for the fees, the Blessed don't need to worry. As long as they send the Beyonder characteristics, it is equivalent to having already paid the fee.
Amid Upton's constant exclamations of "The benefits for the Blessed are really too good," Hobert left his office and came to the warehouse where building materials were stored.
Seeing the building materials piled high, Hobert smiled wryly, leaving only one word: Move!
It took a full hour and a half for Hobert to move all the materials into the 'Nation of Disorder.' After advancing to Sequence 5, he felt the first sign of spiritual exhaustion.
And in the 'Nation of Disorder,' the mountains and fields were full of building materials, as if to rebuild the mountain under Hobert's feet.
Returning to Jeffery's territory, Hobert was not in a hurry to move the building materials out. He planned to rest for a while and pile the materials in different construction sites in several batches.
Then Hobert rummaged through the pile of sundries and finally found the pair of eyeballs he had obtained during the tomb robbery. He used the 'Nation of Disorder' to confirm that it was a Sequence 5-level auxiliary material.
Then this must be the eyes of the Six-Winged Gargoyle. Enduring his fatigue, Hobert completed the transaction with Klein for 700 pounds before returning to his room to rest.
That night, Hobert fell asleep without meditation.
...
Hobert had just gotten up and was about to have breakfast when he received a letter from Edwina. He originally thought the talisman was ready, but it was just a letter.
Opening it, he found that Edwina had obtained the latest information. Yesterday, 'Vice Admiral Dusk' and 'Admiral of Blood' had a major battle in the southern waters of Capri Island.
Now is the weakest time for 'Vice Admiral Dusk's' fleet. Edwina guessed that 'Vice Admiral Dusk's' fleet might go to the nearby Pontgar Island or Lambei Island to rest.
But it is more likely to temporarily hide their tracks at sea, and after some of the wounded die and some of the wounded basically recover their combat power, they will land on an island to rest.
Regarding the current location of the fleet, Edwina gave three locations at sea. If they are not in these three locations, it means that the other party may have left relatively safe waters, in which case it will be difficult to find them.
Without delay, Hobert prepared to take action immediately.
This is not because Hobert is reckless, but because he had considered the tactics of hunting 'Vice Admiral Dusk' before.
The ocean is 'Vice Admiral Dusk's' home field, coming and going without a trace. Even if Hobert has the ability to 'Travel', the first step of finding the opponent is difficult to achieve.
So once he gets the news, he must strike immediately!
Even if he goes all the way just to let 'Vice Admiral Dusk' take a look at the oil painting, the purpose of this attack will be achieved.
As long as the oil painting marks 'Vice Admiral Dusk', then Hobert can calmly launch continuous surprise attacks, and he can exhaust 'Vice Admiral Dusk' to death.
He carried the oil painting on his back and adjusted the magical items on his body.
Now, whenever Hobert encounters a battle he is not sure about, he will carry the oil painting on his back.
And hunting a pirate admiral is a battle he is not sure about.
Although the other party is also a Sequence 5, pirate admirals are generally filthy rich, possessing at least one Sealed Artifact.
And the first mate and second mate on the ship are also difficult to deal with.
Hobert also plans to use 'Vice Admiral Dusk' as a target for practicing his skills. Even if the hunt is unsuccessful, it is good to improve his combat skills.
And in this kind of large pirate group, not only the pirate admiral and first mate have high bounties, but even the boatswain, squad leader, and captains of other ships must have bounties. Killing one at random is not a loss.
Then Hobert took the sea chart and, after transiting with 'Travel,' first came to Pontgar Island.
Hobert used 'Travel' to search the two small islands, but did not find any ships of the 'Vice Admiral Dusk' fleet.
Pirates as experienced as them would certainly not rest on an island when they are vulnerable.
So Hobert used 'Travel' to continue to check the three locations at sea given by 'Vice Admiral Iceberg.' As for the specific location, he used the 'Faceless Necklace' to navigate.
After arriving at sea, Hobert suddenly lost confidence in this operation. It was not the first time he had come to the sea, but the scene of looking out and not seeing any land or any ships was still a bit despairing.
After Hobert used 'Travel' to come to the sea, he immediately switched to using the 'Low Flight' ability to fly at sea.
However, the boundless sea also has a benefit: good visibility.
Without much effort, he could determine that the 'Vice Admiral Dusk' fleet was not nearby.
And when Hobert came to the second location, he unfortunately encountered a huge storm.
As far as the eye could see, the clouds were very low, giving people a great sense of oppression.
The sea was full of strong winds and huge waves. In the air, the waves did not feel very intense, but once on the sea, he could feel that the surrounding waves were as high as small mountains!
Flying here was like flying on a moving land, which made people feel insecure and even a little frightened.
Fortunately, he was wearing the 'Ocean Pendant,' otherwise such a strong wind would definitely blow people into the sky like a piece of paper.
Although the visibility was poor at this location, Hobert vaguely saw lights in the storm. After flying closer to observe, he determined that it was a fleet of eight ships.
The flagship among them was as long as seventy or eighty meters and eleven or twelve meters wide. In Hobert's concept, such a large ship was about the size of a warship with a displacement of three to four thousand tons.
To be honest, it was a bit unbelievable for a wooden ship to reach this length, which was about the length and width of a four-story residential building with seven or eight units.
In the hammering of the storm, Hobert finally checked the equipment on his body and then dived into the water.
Although it was in a storm, Hobert estimated that someone might have spotted him, so he prepared to attack from underwater.
Being in the turbulent waves, even Hobert, a Sequence 5, felt a little frightened. This is the power of nature.
It took him some effort to find the location of the fleet's flagship.
From a distance, Hobert saw the monster-like bottom of the flagship. For some reason, Hobert had an illusion that it was a living monster, giving people the feeling that it could open its mouth at any time and swallow him into its belly.
The closer he got, the more Hobert felt that something was wrong. This ship seemed to have extremely high spirituality, and the bottom of the ship was dark and occasionally wriggled.
This made Hobert think: A flagship at the level of a naval admiral basically has certain Beyonder characteristics.
When he came near the ship, Hobert saw several people jump into the water. He realized that his tracks had been discovered.
However, Hobert was not flustered. He moved flexibly in the sea like a fish. The people who entered the water were not as agile as him, and they almost chased him to the bottom of the flagship.
Hobert pulled out his knife and cut a hole in the bottom of the ship. He swam into the ship along the seawater.
The light in the ship's bottom hold was very dim, and the water level was not high, only up to Hobert's thighs.
As soon as he came out of the water, Hobert smelled a strong smell of blood and saw corpses hanging on the walls of the ship.
Then he discovered that the hole he had just entered the cabin was quickly 'healing,' and the water was quickly drained.
The ground was full of white bones and more corpses. It could be seen that they had died tragically, and their flesh and blood seemed to have grown on the ship.
Some of these corpses seemed to have struggled before they died, but they still did not escape the fate of merging with the ship.
Just as Hobert was preparing to use 'Blink' to enter the upper level, his spirituality sensed something and he looked warily in the direction of the stairs.
Lights and footsteps appeared, but Hobert did not hide, but instead went to meet them.
A Sequence 5 is enough to run amok at sea.
Soon, Hobert saw a pirate wearing clothes with the characteristics of the Rorsted Archipelago, carrying a lamp towards this side.
Hobert was about to attack and then conduct spirit communication, but the other party took the lead and said: "Guest, if you haven't had breakfast yet, the captain invites you to have breakfast together."
Hobert put away his knife and smiled slightly: "That's really great, please lead the way."
The upper level was a storage room with many wine barrels and food, as well as some goats, pigs, and many chickens, ducks, and geese. Of course, there were also some goods.
The second floor was where prisoners were held and goods were stored, but Hobert saw that the cages were basically filled with girls dressed in different regional styles.
Some of them had numb expressions, and some were sobbing softly.
The pirate leading the way politely said: "Guest, if you like any of the ladies, you can let her serve you in the restaurant."
"No need," Hobert said in a bad tone.
This is a pirate, the outlaw in people's mouths.
The third floor was where the crew members rested, as well as the lower-level turrets. At this time, the ship's gun ports were all closed, and the cannons were firmly fixed, but as the ship swayed, the cannons could still sway slightly with the ship.
The cabin was shaking so violently, but there were still crew members sleeping like dead pigs.
The fourth floor was some public areas such as restaurants, as well as weapon depots with heavy iron doors, and a large winch. Seven or eight people were shouting slogans and slowly turning the winch to fix the ropes on the ship.
Going out from here was the stormy deck, and many sailors were busy fighting against the huge storm.
The pirate leading the way covered his hat and walked close to the wall, for fear of being blown away.
Hobert saw that a huge wave was coming, which had swallowed the bow of the ship, and the entire ship began to tilt significantly to the front left, giving the illusion that it was about to capsize.
But the giant ship under his feet still broke through the huge waves and continued to move forward in the turbulent waves.
"You bastard fools!" A voice shouted loudly: "Turn the rudder to the left! Advance along the direction of the waves!"
The fifth floor, which was higher than the deck, had exclusive restaurants for the captain and first mate, and even entertainment venues such as bars and card rooms.
The view here was good, but Hobert found that the shaking seemed to be even greater.
There were five people sitting around the dining table in the restaurant, the leader was in his forties, with a mustache on his lips and a frighteningly pale face.
There were also seven or eight almost naked girls shuttling among them, serving these five people.
The leading man smiled and said: "Welcome to the 'Flesh and Blood Tree'! Girls, bring this guest a breakfast."
Hobert opened his mouth slightly: Do you believe me if I say I went to the wrong place?
Then he felt something was wrong. This was the second time he had gone to the wrong place recently. Last time he broke into the 'Judgment Group's' meeting room, and this time he simply came to the 'Admiral of Blood's' 'Flesh and Blood Tree'!
The first thing he thought was whether he was entangled in bad luck: Don't do this! I helped you sacrifice things to you from Farbauti, and you let me be entangled in bad luck?
But now is not the time to think about this. Hobert sat generously opposite the 'Admiral of Blood': "Sorry, I hope I didn't disturb you enjoying breakfast. I'm just here to ask for directions."
A one-eyed dragon with a scruffy beard on the left asked: "Ask for directions? The road to hell?"
"The road to the 'Vice Admiral Dusk's' flagship," Hobert thanked the girl who served him breakfast and said: "I heard from a friend that you just had a conflict with him."
"Admiral of Blood" Senor asked, "What do you want him for?"
"To hunt him down, of course!"
