chapters.title: Chapter 465 - 465 Codename "1-102" (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Nominu for joining as free member, +1]
If you ignored the corpses in the hold and the large number of imprisoned girls, Senor, apart from his slightly sunken eye sockets and pale face, looked like an ordinary middle-aged uncle.
Everyone burst into laughter when they heard Hobert was going to hunt the "Vice Admiral Dusk."
Senor smiled and said, "Young man, I know you're strong. I knew it when you approached this ship, but this is at sea, and it's not as simple as you think."
Hobert smiled. "Alright, since you don't know either, I'll go look again."
"Wait a moment." Senor suddenly tossed Hobert a small glass bottle containing a small piece of wood. "I just used this to design a trap for Bulatov (the 'Vice Admiral Dusk's' name)."
"If you have the ability, use it to find Bulatov."
Similar to the "Vice Admiral Iceberg's" idea, Senor was happy to send an opponent to his opponent.
Hobert looked at the glass bottle seriously. It seemed to be a piece of wood taken from the ship. "Thank you."
"You're welcome. I'm always so helpful," Senor said earnestly, while his subordinates seemed to be trying hard to suppress their laughter.
He paused and added, "Also, this breakfast costs 3,000 pounds. You can leave after paying the bill."
Finally, he thoughtfully added, "If you don't have that much money, you can pay with corresponding items."
Hobert looked at the breakfast in front of him. "I didn't eat a single bite."
"Young man, be reasonable," Senor said. "Although you didn't eat, you didn't refuse when I served you breakfast, did you?"
Senor's subordinates finally burst into laughter.
The 'Admiral of Blood' smiled coldly. "Let me introduce you. This is the ship's First Mate, Caesar, who, like you, is also a Sequence 5.
"To your left are the flagship's Third Mate, Clarin, Combat Captain Oled, and Third Captain Byrd."
This was Senor's way of intimidating him.
There were at least five 'Mid-Sequence' Beyonders in the restaurant, including two Sequence 5s. They all felt that Hobert should pay the bill.
Hobert smiled. "What follows will be a conversation between men. Please, ladies, leave."
Senor sneered. "This young man is taking pity on these little girls. But I am the captain of this ship, and only I can give orders here."
The people at the table looked at Hobert with smiles, as if they were looking at an inexperienced junior.
Senor dragged a girl to his side and put a hand under her short skirt. Tears streamed from the girl's eyes, and she trembled all over, closing her eyes in pain, but she didn't dare to resist.
Senor said coldly, "This is a descendant of a noble from Loen, a reserved little girl. She tastes very good. Would you like to try her?"
Unfortunately, Senor didn't see the young man's angry expression. The young man in front of him was still so calm, as calm as before.
"Never mind then," Hobert said. "I'll show you something."
Hobert, who had been preparing, suddenly flipped the oil painting forward.
Senor and the others tensed up, preparing themselves, but none of them expected that the first thing Hobert did was use the oil painting to block their view.
Their spirituality told them that the oil painting was dangerous and that they should quickly turn their heads away.
But for some reason, it seemed like there was a huge attraction that made their eyes unable to resist glancing at it.
In the end, the people in front of them had to exclaim in horror, "What a beautiful landscape!"
Senor was also puzzled. Wasn't the young man letting those little girls out to avoid accidentally hurting them? Why did he still launch a Beyonder attack?
Immediately afterward, the monster in the oil painting appeared on the dining table, but before it could deliver its curse, Senor let out a soul-piercing shriek.
Poof~
The monster disappeared without a trace like a deflated ball.
At this time, First Mate Caesar and the others' Beyonder attacks were blocked by Hobert with the oil painting. At the same time, he released the seal on "1-102."
This sealed item was more suitable for use against more powerful enemies. Its ability was: "It can summon monsters from the mirror world that desire to have a face. These monsters will try everything to devour enemies so that they can obtain the enemy's face and become stronger in the mirror world. It can summon up to four monsters, but the holder has no control over the summoning process or what kind of monsters are summoned."
The negative effect is: "This item opens the mirror world, and the creatures inside all want to have their own faces, so they will try to devour people in the real world and take their faces whenever they have the chance. If the holder doesn't want to die a terrible death, they should not look in the mirror for a day, stay away from any glass products, and stay away from anything reflective. After a day, the opened mirror world will disappear.
"It cannot be confirmed what kind of monster will be summoned. It may think the enemy's appearance is too ugly and want to take the holder's appearance. In that case, it is equivalent to summoning an enemy. It may also summon monsters that attack indiscriminately."
After releasing the seal on "1-102," the wooden puppet in Hobert's hand began to shake its head from side to side.
Da da da~
It shook faster and faster, with greater and greater amplitude.
It raised a hand, and a piece of glass on the restaurant's window lost all its color. The other side of the glass was another world, an evil world, and now only a layer of gray film separated the two worlds. A human-shaped shadow appeared inside the gray film.
The shadow's face could not be seen clearly, but everyone in the room could feel it looking at the outside world with evil eyes.
The combat captain named Oled accidentally glanced at the monster, stood up straight suddenly, and then walked stiffly towards the window.
Oled quickly restrained his spirituality and attention. Before competing with the evil monster for control of his body, one of his legs stepped out and then back, then out again, then back again.
It was like dancing a very awkward dance.
The others ignored Oled. They all knew this was the ability of the sealed item on Hobert's body, so they attacked Hobert together.
But the more people there were, the more operational Hobert's ability became: "Weaken!"
This skill was the unwavering vanguard. Senor and the others didn't care, because even if they were "weakened," their combined strength was still stronger than Hobert's.
"Abyss Shackles!" First Mate Caesar was at the very back, preparing to control Hobert.
A set of dark and solid shackles appeared out of thin air in the restaurant. In theory, these shackles should have appeared on Hobert's feet or body, but strangely, the shackles flew around Hobert, refusing to latch onto him.
That was because Hobert was holding the oil painting in front of him. Anything related to the "Abyss" didn't dare to approach the oil painting.
At the same time, Senor's "Ice Arrows" and Third Mate Clarin's "Frost Cyclone" had reached Hobert.
Their attacks caused the temperature in the restaurant to plummet. If you accidentally touched the "Frost Cyclone," your flesh would immediately become stiff. And even if you didn't touch the "Ice Arrows," your flesh would still become stiff if you were close enough.
The latter was equivalent to an upgraded version of the former.
"Distort!"
These two kinds of frost attacks were distorted by Hobert and smashed towards Third Captain Byrd, who was attacking Hobert with a knife. Byrd dodged agilely, and his attack was also resolved.
Hobert withstood the second round of attacks from Senor's men, and the puppet in his hand raised its other hand.
A glass on the table that had not been knocked over lost all its color and suddenly turned dark gray. A blurred black shadow could be seen inside, and slippery tentacles stretched out from it, coiling towards Caesar, who was closest to it.
Caesar immediately threw a small glass bottle at the tentacles.
Smash~
The glass bottle was shattered by the tentacles, and the dark red liquid inside splashed on the tentacles. A "sizzling" corrosive sound could be heard.
The tentacles shook violently, but they still couldn't shake off the potion, and they couldn't stop the tentacles from being rapidly corroded.
Caesar was about to continue attacking Hobert when the tentacles suddenly retracted, and then tentacles with obvious exoskeletons stretched out from the glass, with inverted barbs on the tentacles that looked very sharp.
Each tentacle was as thick as an arm, and a dozen of them stretched out at once, making the glass on the table look very small.
But incredibly, these tentacles stretched out from a small glass. The tentacles were very thin when they first stretched out, but they suddenly became thicker after leaving the glass for a distance.
Scarlet moonlight appeared around Caesar. In the moonlight, he would become more agile, his spirituality would be more abundant, and his strength would be greater.
His nails grew rapidly, and his nails were suddenly covered with mystical symbols and patterns. He waved his hands, blocking the tentacles' attacks.
Each strike had a strong "corrosive" effect, but it had little effect on the tentacles.
And it was difficult for the tentacles to attack Caesar, because Caesar's speed was now so fast that it was dazzling.
The girls finally gathered at the door, crawling and rolling. The door of the restaurant was opened, and the wind blew in. As the girls screamed and ran out, the guards also discovered the fighting in the restaurant.
"Enemy attack! Enemy attack!" The sound never stopped.
On the other side, Senor and the other two were launching their third round of attacks on Hobert. They were all known for their speed and strong attacks, and they liked close combat.
At this time, they had already rushed in front of Hobert. Clarin, who was in the front, kicked the oil painting, which was like a shield, causing Hobert to crash heavily into the cabin.
Seeing this was a good opportunity, Senor immediately transformed into a shadow and possessed him.
"Disorder!" Hobert, who was almost falling apart, caused Senor to fall into a brief state of chaos: "Underworld Gate!"
Hobert regretted not wearing the "Light Priest Ring." For Senor in shadow form, "Holy Light" would definitely have an attack bonus.
Senor, who had recovered from the brief state of "chaos," suddenly slipped and miraculously avoided the pale hands stretching out from the "Underworld Gate."
However, the suction of the "Underworld Gate" was still very strong, and Senor rolled towards the bronze door involuntarily.
He let out a piercing shriek at the bronze door, and the arms, eyes, and sounds in the bronze door all froze.
The price Hobert paid for using the "Underworld Gate" was that he took a blow from Clarin.
Clarin originally wanted to tear off one of Hobert's arms. The power of a "Zombie" was enough for him to tear apart the body of a Sequence 5!
Of course, he couldn't tear apart Sequence 5s with extremely strong physiques such as "Guardians" and "Druids," or "Priests of Light" who could partially "lightify" or "Shepherds" who could "shadowify."
Although Hobert's path could also enhance his physique, it was still within the range that the other party could tear apart, but Hobert had the "blessing" of the "Zombie Spoon," making it difficult for the other party to succeed.
Clarin turned around and slammed Hobert to the ground. The floor of the restaurant was of some unknown structure and was not damaged at all, directly throwing him into a daze.
At this time, the puppet shaking its head raised a leg, and a metal plate on the ground suddenly lost all its luster and turned gray. A cloud of dust like ashes floated out of it.
This layer of dust formed a layer of gray mist above everyone's heads, rolling and stirring non-stop as if it had a life of its own. Including Hobert, everyone immediately felt their spirituality rapidly draining away.
These gray mists were attacking indiscriminately. Whoever couldn't hold on first would be the first to collapse, thinking that their spirituality had been exhausted.
Clarin on the other side had the advantage and directly chased after him with another kick. Hobert used "Blink" to dodge. Before he could counterattack, Senor in shadow form had already rushed over.
It turned out that Senor had summoned a black swamp, and vines grew out of the swamp. Now the "Underworld Gate" was trapped in the swamp, entangled by the vines, and it would be difficult to play an effective role within ten seconds.
"Knight!" Hobert ended the summoning of the "Underworld Gate" and recited this summoning word at the same time.
Hant, wearing a knight's uniform and with his eyeballs hanging on his cheeks, appeared from the void. His white longsword flashed with a pale light, forcing back Senor in shadow form.
Hobert ordered, "Entangle him!"
Footsteps could already be heard in the corridor. Although it was suicide for ordinary pirates to participate in this battle, there must be other "Mid-Sequence" Beyonders on board. The longer it dragged on, the more disadvantageous it would be for Hobert, so Hobert summoned Hant, hoping to find an opportunity to counterattack.
Senor did not rashly possess Hant, who was full of Underworld aura, but attacked Hant's spiritual body in shadow form.
But strangely, the pale white light emitted from Hant's body effectively isolated Senor's attack on the soul.
The strange thing about this matter was that Hant clearly came from the Underworld, so the source of his power should be from his own spiritual body. In theory, attacking his spiritual body would cause him a fatal blow. But he couldn't be attacked. How frustrating!
Hant's appearance allowed Hobert to take the initiative. Facing Clarin, who continued to chase after him, Hobert also kicked out, leg against leg, causing Clarin to take a step back.
Both of them had the boost of the "Zombie" state, and they used all their strength in that kick. They both felt a wooden pain in their calves from the earlier clash, and almost reached out to rub them.
At this moment, the puppet, whose head was shaking violently, lifted its last leg.
In the corner, the wine bottle suddenly lost all its color and turned gray. A dark gray hand, devoid of any life, reached out from inside and grabbed the calf of Third Mate Byrd.
Byrd was the only Sequence 7 in the dining hall, and in a battle of this level, his role was actually not significant.
When the "Underworld Gate" appeared earlier, the fear in his heart exploded, and the suction of the "Underworld Gate" greatly affected him.
The suction of the "Underworld Gate" was a pull from the soul level, directly acting on the soul. Therefore, Byrd, who had not yet recovered after the "Underworld Gate" disappeared, was grabbed by this hand and immediately dragged down, being pulled little by little towards the wine bottle.
Now the situation was great for Hobert. He only needed to deal with Clarin.
So Hobert blocked Clarin's attacks while carrying the oil painting on his back again.
Freeing up a hand, he pulled out the knife hidden in his cane and began to fight back.
"Distortion!"
This "Distortion" was not used on Clarin, but on the boatswain who came to support from outside.
The boatswain had been outside directing the crew to fight the storm. After receiving the alarm of an enemy attack, he immediately came to support.
He was a "Wind Blessed." He put on his gloves and was about to rush in to punch Hobert, but when he rushed to the entrance of the dining hall, Hobert changed his thought of "supporting the captain" to "supporting the captain's woman."
So the boatswain looked at the several girls huddled in the corner of the corridor, shivering from the frost: "Give them some clothes! Idiots!"
As he spoke, the boatswain took off his already soaked shirt, preparing to put it on one of the girls, but he hesitated for a moment: WTF, can someone tell me, which one is the captain's woman?
At this time, in the dining hall, Hobert had already forced Clarin into a corner. Just when Clarin was in a precarious situation, eight pale-faced men rushed in from outside the dining hall.
They held knives and guns and attacked Hobert together, finally giving Clarin a chance to breathe.
These eight men were puppets cultivated by Clarin. One of them was killed by Hobert with a single knife, but they seemed unafraid of death and continued to charge at Hobert.
Suddenly, the movements of the remaining seven people slowed down. Hobert was using the "Spirit Wine Glass" to compete with Clarin for control of these living corpses.
Because they were puppets carefully cultivated by Clarin, and the "Spirit Wine Glass" was not as high-level as the "Azik Copper Whistle," Hobert could only slow them down for the time being.
"Charm!" Hobert put Clarin, who was about to whip up another "Frost Hurricane," into a state of "Charm."
Clarin was immediately captivated by Hobert's charm, and really wanted to invite Hobert to his room to enjoy the pleasure brought by the girls and handsome young men who served him.
But Hobert had already rushed close, and with one knife, he slashed from the head to the abdomen.
Clarin's two eyes were falling in different directions, one forward and one backward. At this moment, he still hadn't recovered from the "Charm" state. His eyes were full of surprise, unable to understand why this extremely charming old friend suddenly turned against him?
As the seven living corpses stopped moving and fell to the ground one after another, it indicated that Clarin's life and spirituality were rapidly draining away.
At this time, Hobert was observing the situation on the battlefield. Oled's movements had become smoother, obviously Oled was gradually gaining the upper hand in this battle for his body.
He took the opportunity to break the wine glass that had stretched out tentacles, but the tentacles were not affected much, and continued to stretch out from the fragments.
He threw a few more potions at them, and rust-like spots appeared on the tentacles, and their movements were becoming sluggish.
Under the moonlight, he was rapidly breaking away from the "Weakened" state, and his spirituality and power were becoming stronger.
Senor was completely suppressed by Hant, but Hant was unable to hurt Senor for the time being.
Only Byrd was about to be dragged into the bottle and was struggling desperately.
Hobert quickly made a decision. He used "Blink" to come to Byrd's side, first stabbing the other person in the chest, and then cutting off the other person's grabbed leg.
Then, dragging the half-dead Byrd, he used "Blink" again to grab Clarin, who had not completely died, and used "Travel" to leave here.
But when the space in front of him became illusory, a middle-aged man with a grin came out first. He had sunken eyes, a pale face, and a black mustache.
It was Senor!
He let out a sharp shriek at Hobert, and Hobert immediately felt pain from the depths of his soul: "Arrogance!"
Senor, who could have continued to expand the results of the battle, suddenly put his hands on his hips and laughed loudly: "Hahaha, I am a Pirate Admiral. That knight with the eyeballs wandering outside is nothing great except for his swordsmanship. And this kid carrying the oil painting wants to use 'Travel' to leave! What a joke, the Spirit World is like my backyard. As long as he uses 'Travel' on this ship, I can block him!"
While he was gloating, one of the tentacles suddenly whipped over and sent Senor flying.
This did not cause him much damage. On the contrary, if he hadn't flown out, he would have been pierced through the heart by Hant who was chasing after him.
Hant's sword was not an ordinary weapon either. If it pierced through the chest, it would also cause great damage to a "Wraith."
"We'll regroup later!" Hobert shouted to Hant, dragging two half-dead trophies and running out: "Corrosion!"
He had been brewing it for a long time, and immediately the pirates who came to support from outside the dining hall were affected by "Corrosion."
Hobert took the opportunity to rush out and came to the deck in the wind and rain.
At this time, the boatswain, who had recovered from the "Distortion" state, shouted: "Surround him! He doesn't dare to enter the Spirit World, he can't escape!"
"Skinny Horse!" Hobert shouted in Hermes, and a huge, winged skeleton horse came out of the void.
Hobert jumped on the horse's back, and the skeleton horse took him away from the Flesh and Blood Tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - 466: Transaction with the Sanguine (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[The Church of MissRaven has obtained its first Grade 1 Sealed Artifact: ArcherArchX.]
This skeletal horse is called Maximillian, another contract object of Hobert's "Spirit Wine Glass," and this is the first time Hobert has summoned it.
The reason for summoning it is that Hobert is not a proper "Wind Blessed" after all, and his "low flying" ability cannot take away two "trophies."
Moreover, the other party's boatswain has already chased after him, and that is a true "Wind Blessed."
The ghostly horse's skeletal wings spread out, spanning four to five meters, and without needing a running start, it directly lifts Hobert and the two "trophies" into the air.
Hobert laughed loudly: "You thought I couldn't escape just because I couldn't enter the spirit world?"
The boatswain ran over with large strides, the surrounding storms swirling around him, lifting him up to continue chasing Hobert in mid-air.
Just as Hobert was preparing to chase after this "Wind Blessed," he suddenly noticed a ball of red mist appearing in the ghostly horse's empty stomach.
Poof~
The red mist was released from behind, enveloping the shouting "Wind Blessed."
Hobert grimaced: Never open your mouth when chasing enemies in the future, who knows what kind of fart they'll release!
Then he realized: "Horse, could this be your 'weird' ability?"
Hobert remembered that his request at the time was for it to be able to fly and possess a weird ability.
Maximillian proudly raised its head, as if wanting to let out a neigh, but perhaps due to the lack of vocal cords, it had to give up.
Hobert thought: It's just releasing a fart, what's so great about it?
However, Hobert soon discovered that the storm dispersed the red mist, and red flames were burning on the boatswain's body.
The rainstorm did not extinguish the flames, and the boatswain jumped into the sea, but the red flames still did not immediately go out.
At this time, Hobert had already flown away from the "Tree of Flesh and Blood" ship, and he suddenly realized that this ghostly horse could definitely play a huge role in naval battles.
In an era without anti-aircraft guns or similar weapons, any airborne force at sea possesses a huge advantage.
After putting some distance between himself and the "Tree of Flesh and Blood" ship, Hobert used "Travel." The space in front of him became illusory, and this time the "Admiral of Blood" was not blocking the way.
Hobert used "Travel" to arrive at the nearby Pontus Isle, where dark clouds covered the sky, as if a huge storm was about to come.
Hobert hid in a corner of the jungle, first recovering his condition, and then killed the not-yet-dead Byerly with one strike, while Crane had already breathed his last.
The ghostly horse stood aside, quietly watching Hobert accelerate the extraction speed of the Beyonder characteristics, waiting to divide the spoils of war.
Hant stepped out of the void and also waited aside to divide the spoils of war.
This time Hobert only obtained two Beyonder characteristics: "I summoned Hant first, let him choose first."
The ghostly horse lowered its head, as if nodding.
Hant took the "Zombie" Beyonder characteristic, while the ghostly horse took away Byerly's Beyonder characteristic.
If it were in the past, Hobert would have gotten nothing.
But this time it was different. Hobert prayed to "The Fool," contacted Alger, and handed over the two corpses for Alger to deal with.
After seeing the two corpses, Alger was a little surprised: "This… this is 'Iron Hand' Clarin 'Crimson Butcher' Byrd"
Hobert "Hmm"ed: "That's right, what are their respective bounties?"
"5500 pounds and 3900 pounds," Alger said, "Where did you hunt them down?"
"On the 'Tree of Flesh and Blood' ship." Hobert didn't expect that his hunt would earn 9400 pounds!
The violent sea is indeed full of walking pounds!
Alger thought he heard wrong: "The 'Tree of Flesh and Blood' ship?"
Isn't that the "Admiral of Blood's" flagship?
Hobert didn't care too much: "Still split the spoils according to the old rules!"
After speaking, he stepped into the spirit world and used "Travel" to leave.
Alger stared at the corpses in front of him for a few seconds before realizing that he had to hand over the two corpses to the governor's office before the news of the "Tree of Flesh and Blood" ship being attacked spread, lest he be noticed helping to deal with the bounty and be targeted by the "Admiral of Blood."
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert came out of his room, as if he had just woken up.
He ordered Allen outside the door: "Go to the restaurant and bring breakfast to my room. The tableware should be wooden bowls or wooden plates. Do not use metal tableware or glassware."
He also said to Dennis: "Find some glue and paste a layer of paper on all the glass on the windows and doors. In this yard, anything reflective must be covered with a layer of paper."
Although Allen and Dennis found these orders a bit strange, they executed them without fail.
After eating breakfast, Hobert wrote a letter to "Vice Admiral Iceberg," summarizing the hunting process and results, and promised to give her 2000 pounds as a reward for providing information.
Then he entered the oil painting hall and smashed the wooden statues of the girls he saw in the restaurant, but of course he would keep the wooden statues of Senior and others intact.
After the letter was sent, the lord's mansion welcomed a special guest: Dophis!
With only a dozen days left until the wedding, Dophis was sent by Christian to arrange the wedding venue and arrange related matters.
Along with Dophis came hundreds of servants and wedding planners.
Hobert first asked Allen to arrange for these people to stay, and asked Dophis about the recent situation of his parents.
So all day long, Hobert was discussing the details of the wedding with Dophis. He didn't expect that a noble's wedding, even a baron's wedding, would be so cumbersome.
And on the wedding day, in addition to Christian, there will be three earls, seven viscounts, and a dozen barons to congratulate.
Dozens of merchants involved in arms and military supplies will also come.
Doing a good job of entertaining these people is another key point of the wedding.
Hobert thought that although many nobles and wealthy merchants would come on the wedding day, the reputation of Jeffery Territory would only spread in a small circle, which was far from enough!
While Hobert was thinking, it was already past seven in the evening, but he still had no way to expand his influence, so he could only prepare for the deal with the vampires first.
Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" and brought all the Beyonder characteristics to be sold tonight to the real world, and put them into small wooden boxes that had been prepared long ago.
Then put the small wooden boxes into a large box.
At 7:50, Hobert put on his mask and sprayed some perfume. The perfume bottle was also covered with paper in advance.
Carrying the suitcase, Hobert used "Travel" to come to Rose Street in Backlund.
Emlyn was already waiting here. He was slightly stunned when he saw Hobert's mask, because the "Traitor" had also worn the same mask: Could the "Traitor" also be a follower of the "Creator"?
He was just about to distinguish the smell of the person in front of him when he suddenly pinched his nose: "How much perfume did you spray?"
Hobert, who never wore perfume, suddenly wore perfume tonight to make Emlyn's sense of smell fail. Otherwise, this guy's nose is more sensitive than a dog's nose, and he can determine in minutes that the person in front of him is the "Traitor."
Hobert smiled: "This is my personal hobby."
Emlyn fanned in front of his nose: "Come with me."
He pointed to the tallest building around: "That is the Harvest Church."
Then he pointed to the opposite of the Harvest Church: "That is a clothing store, but I spent 5 pounds to rent it for one night. We can trade in it."
The clothing store owner who got the money was overjoyed. This was equivalent to a week and a half of his income, and he knew that Emlyn was a servant of the Harvest Church, so he didn't have to worry about the other party stealing his goods.
Hobert smiled: "After the transaction is completed, you will be equivalent to getting 500 pounds of remuneration. Please go in and put away the mirror first, otherwise this transaction will definitely be interrupted by accident."
Emlyn felt that this request was a bit strange, but he did it anyway.
After learning that the mirrors were put away, Hobert entered the clothing store. The two viscounts inside were standing and sitting. After Hobert entered the store, they looked at Hobert and frowned at the smell of perfume on Hobert's body.
Emlyn introduced: "This is Viscount Ernest, this is Viscount Ivan."
Then he introduced Hobert to the two viscounts: "This is a 'Creator' follower I met by chance at a gathering."
The three Sequence 5s simply nodded, as a greeting.
After the four people sat down in the reception area of the clothing store, Ernest asked: "We got the news that the 'Creator' severely damaged the 'Rose School' in the Southern Continent?"
Hobert smiled: "That was last year's news."
Ernest smiled and asked: "Did you participate in that battle?"
"No, I'm just a small soldier." Hobert smiled and said: "A small soldier responsible for selling stolen goods."
At this time, Ivan suddenly said: "It sounds like your accent is a relatively pure Backlund accent."
"Yes, my teacher is a Backlund gentleman." Hobert smiled and responded to their probing.
After chatting for a few words, Ernest and Ivan found that they could not get any information from Hobert's mouth. Ernest put the box next to him on the coffee table: "Okay, let's start trading."
Hobert also took out the suitcase in his hand and put it on the coffee table. To his surprise, Ernest and Ivan did not bargain.
But then he understood: The proud vampires never bargain.
The transaction was very smooth. Since he was a follower of the "Creator", the vampires would not do anything to Hobert.
And Hobert did not intend to do this business once, and believed that the vampires were allies that could be won over, so naturally he would not cheat in the transaction.
This time, a total of 7 "Vampire" Beyonder characteristics, two "Potion Professor" Beyonder characteristics, and one "Scarlet Scholar" Beyonder characteristic were sold.
According to the previous quotation, they were 2000 pounds, 4500 pounds and 10000 pounds respectively. In fact, Hobert's bottom line was 1600 pounds, 4200 pounds and 9500 pounds respectively. Since the other party did not bargain, he would naturally not reduce the price himself.
Hobert counted for a long time before he finally counted clearly that it was a total of 33,000 pounds. The money and goods were cleared, and the atmosphere was much more relaxed.
Ernest smiled: "I hope our transactions can continue in the future. The vampires with a long history have enough wealth to buy all the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Primordial Moon' believers in your hands."
Hobert glanced at Emlyn out of the corner of his eye, and this guy also raised his chin: Do all vampires like to emphasize "long history" and "rich wealth"?
In Hobert's opinion, this seemed to be saying: My family has a vault, my family has antiques, and I have Beyonder characteristics! Come on!
While thinking wildly, Hobert smiled: "This time I felt your sincerity, and I will give you some discounts next time."
Ernest didn't seem to care too much about these: "I was thinking, if possible, can we establish a smooth communication mechanism? In fact, we are natural allies in dealing with the 'Rose School'."
Hobert nodded: "That's no problem. If there is anything, I will contact this Mr. Emlyn. He also knows which gatherings I often appear in and can find me."
Ernest and Ivan looked at each other. Of course, they could hear that Hobert meant: Among the vampires, he only trusted Emlyn.
After the transaction ended, Hobert left with the money box, and Ernest and Ivan went back to report as soon as possible. Emlyn stayed at the end and sprayed related potions to cover up the traces of their visit.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert used "Travel" to return to his room and sacrificed the big box of pounds to the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", looking at the pile of pounds, a smile climbed onto Hobert's face. Now he has more than 50,000 pounds in his hand, which is enough for the third batch of payment!
As for the first batch of building materials, Hobert "transported" out a lot to the construction site in the territory. Tonight, he mainly sprinkled the materials on the railway along the way.
The problem of transporting materials that was a headache for Scholar was solved by the "Creator."
As for the other building materials, I'll talk about it tomorrow.
Finally, Hobert glanced at the pool in front of him. Recently, there have been many more stars, all of whom are members of the Balk family.
If he encounters a member whose own state is not very good and who prays to get rid of the "out of control" state, Hobert will conveniently restore the order between their Beyonder characteristics and themselves, temporarily getting rid of the doom of out of control.
Just as he was about to leave the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert suddenly thought that if the princess of Feynapotter Kingdom came to attend his wedding and praised Jeffery Territory a few words, it should be explosive enough!
Hobert looked at the star representing Ethel and could use the identity of a follower of the "Creator" to send an invitation.
But Hobert did not act immediately, he wanted to think about it again.
...
Loen Kingdom, Conant City.
Late at night, an old man with an gloomy face looked at "Baran Fishing Company" and sneered. The next second, he turned into a shadow, avoided the police guarding here, and came to the conference room on the second floor.
The old man snapped his fingers, and a ball of dark flames ignited. He saw the sentence on the wall: "I found you, hehehe!"
The flame was fleeting, and the old man sneered: "What arrogant tone!"
Then he seemed to realize something and looked towards the office.
In the darkness, a lithe figure emerged from the office: "What a pity, Gale had such a great physique, to die just like that. There isn't a single useful man left in the Judgement Group."
The old man chuckled coldly: "You could go to the Church of the God of Combat in the Feysac Empire, if he doesn't try to sleep with you before arresting you."
The lithe figure laughed back: "What would an old man like you know about these pleasures?"
These were none other than the other two Vice-Leaders of the Judgement Group: Steven and Sandora.
Steven didn't continue the topic, but instead asked: "Did you find any clues?"
Sandora shook her head: "Even if there were clues, they were taken away by the 'Punishers'."
"Still can't divine anything, is it?"
"Yes, it seems to be the enemy we encountered in Backlund."
Steven frowned: "Strange, when did we make such an enemy?"
Sandora naturally had no way to answer this question: "No matter what, this is the biggest crisis the 'Judgement Group' has faced since its establishment!"

Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
After finishing teaching Freya vocabulary, Hobert suddenly remembered something very important. He returned to his room, set up a simple altar, and recited the Evernight Goddess's honored name:
"More sublime than the starry sky, more enduring than eternity, Black Evernight Goddess, you are the Lady of Crimson, the Mother Concealment, the Empress of Misfortune and Horror, the Mistress of Repose and Silence.
"Your devout believer begs for your gaze;
"Begging you to help me eliminate misfortune!"
A surge of tranquil power descended. Although the sun was shining brightly outside, the room felt as silent as deep night.
A piece of sealing wax near the altar suddenly floated onto it. The wax, about the thickness of a finger and half the length of a candle, softened and turned into a red liquid within seconds.
The liquid formed letters, which eventually composed a sentence: That is misfortune, but it is also a reward for you. There will be another such misfortune.
Then the tranquil power disappeared, giving Hobert the feeling that the 'other party has logged off'.
He pondered for a moment, and it seemed to be the case. He had twice entered the wrong 'room', but both times he had gained quite a bit.
The first time, he had basically trapped Gale and his subordinates in a conference room. The second time, although he hadn't found the 'Vice Admiral Dusk', he had managed to mark the 'Admiral of Blood' with the oil painting.
And he had also obtained a clue about the suspected 'Vice Admiral Dusk', but this clue was given by the 'Admiral of Blood', so he had to take it to the 'Nation of Disorder' to disinfect it before using it.
Well, let's just take it as a reward. Although both battles were quite dangerous, his gains were also considerable.
Hobert also thought that next time he prayed to the Evernight Goddess, he should prepare a bowl of fine sand next to the altar, so that when She wanted to communicate, She wouldn't have to find something suitable on the spot.
After cleaning up the altar, Hobert received a letter from 'Vice Admiral Iceberg'. Edwina first apologized for her misjudgment, and at the same time encouraged Hobert not to be discouraged. She would continue to monitor the 'Vice Admiral Dusk's' whereabouts and notify Hobert immediately if there was any news.
Hobert felt that Edwina's tone was very much like a teacher encouraging a student who had just experienced a setback, which made him a little unsure of his position.
At the end of the letter was the transaction regarding the charms. Edwina said that because Hobert was buying in bulk, he could pay 50 gold Lire per piece.
Along with the letter was a package containing forty neat brass charms.
The metal corresponding to the God of Knowledge and Wisdom is brass, which is not as expensive as the gold corresponding to the Eternal Blazing Sun.
Hobert found a wooden box and prepaid 2,000 gold Lire and 2,000 gold pounds to Edwina.
Hobert had to give this 2,000 pounds, because it was the intelligence fee for the entire 'Admiral of Blood' pirate group. If he could hunt down the 'Admiral of Blood', this amount of money would be nothing.
For the next three days, Hobert assisted Dophis in preparing for the wedding. During this time, he first completed the transaction for Emlyn's potion through 'The Fool'.
After the potion was distributed to the construction site, it prevented many people from worsening their conditions or even losing their ability to work.
The potions for treating colds and chills were not enough, while the potions for treating diarrhea were not needed as much.
So Hobert placed another order with Emlyn, asking for 200 portions of medicine for treating colds and 300 portions of medicine for treating severe chills. This order was worth 180 pounds in total, which was deducted from the 1,000 pounds.
Hobert had just placed the order when he completed a transaction with 'Little Sun', or rather, Little Sun repaid his debt.
For the 'Hammer of Provocation' and the expenses at the last Tarot Gathering, 'Little Sun' once again paid 'The Emperor' a total of 17 Sequence 8-level main ingredients of 5 kinds.
These main ingredients were basically the same as last time, with only one new material that had not been seen before.
Hobert wrote another letter to 'Vice Admiral Iceberg', asking what this material was, and also asked about several Beyonder ingredients seized from the dockyard island, so as to have a clear understanding.
Now Hobert only had the materials seized from the Demonic Wolf of Fog and a few others that he was not very clear about. He knew what the main ingredients were for the other materials.
Hobert had been too busy to hunt the Demonic Wolf of Fog recently, so he could only let it jump around for a few more days, and deal with it when he was not so busy.
In addition, Hobert received 7,990 pounds through 'The Fool' from Alger through his channels, after Alger left 15%.
After deducting the reward to 'Vice Admiral Iceberg', there was still 5,990 pounds. The bulk of the proceeds from this operation was still with Hobert.
During these three days, Hobert unloaded all the building materials from the 'Nation of Disorder' at night on the construction sites that needed them.
Also, Bishop Simpson led a team to Jeffery Territory. He not only brought many bishops and priests, but also brought two 'Druid' teams.
'Druid' is not only the name of Sequence 5 of the 'Planter' pathway, but also the official extraordinary being title of the Earth Mother Church.
In ancient times, this name represented the messengers of the forest, the warriors who defended all life, which was very in line with the Earth Mother Church's official Beyonders.
These two Druid teams were both elite, including 2 Sequence 6s and 4 Sequence 7s, as well as several 'low sequence' Beyonders.
But Hobert had been quite busy recently and couldn't spare time to fight demons, so he could only put this matter aside for the time being.
In the blink of an eye, it was Saturday, and Fors could finally breathe a sigh of relief. Her new book was finally finished. It had to be said that this was the fastest book she had ever written.
If it weren't for Hobert's urging, she wouldn't have known that she could complete a novel in a month.
Arriving at Hobert's study, Fors quickly handed the manuscript to Hobert, because she had to contact the publisher, proofread it many times, and typeset it. There were still many processes waiting.
Hobert briefly looked at the manuscript and said to Freya, who was beside him: "I have something to talk to Miss Fors about. Please close the door for me."
Freya nodded and closed the door when she went out.
Fors sat opposite Hobert, leisurely drinking tea: "Is there anything you are not satisfied with in the plot?"
"No, I want to talk to you about something else." Hobert took out a red invitation from the drawer. This invitation was very exquisite. The outermost layer was silk, and the inside was hard cardboard. When opened, it was the content of the invitation: "This is the wedding invitation I have chosen."
Christian had already sent out the invitations from Feynapotter City. The invitations designed by Hobert were prepared to invite some of his friends and subordinates and residents in the territory to attend the wedding.
In the Feynapotter Kingdom, red invitations are not popular, because most of them are followers of the Earth Mother, so they mostly use green, which symbolizes vitality, or yellow, which symbolizes harvest, and even white, which symbolizes holiness, are used by many people.
When the invitation designer handed Hobert a white sample, Hobert almost threw it in the other person's face.
Fors was a little unnatural: "Invi, invitation?"
She had always been a little evasive about the wedding: "Hobert, I don't think we need to make it too grand, after all, after all…"
After all, we are just contract couples.
"This is exactly what I want to talk to you about." Hobert smiled: "I think we should all follow our true inner thoughts and make choices, don't you think?"
Fors didn't quite understand what Hobert meant.
Hobert took a deep breath, concealing his slight nervousness: "Miss Fors, I want to say that through this period of time together, I have developed enough affection for you and would like to officially become your boyfriend and fiancé, not just the so-called contract relationship."
Fors looked surprised: Is this Hobert's confession? I just came to send a manuscript, how did I receive a confession? What to do? What to do now?
Fors was a little nervous and a little shy. Her pretty face was slightly red, and a few strands of hair fell down, making her shyness very cute.
"I hope we can all follow our inner feelings." Hobert continued to guide: "You don't dislike me either, do you?"
Fors straightened her back, stood up and sat down again, picked up the cup and put it down, and finally nodded slightly.
Hobert smiled and stood up, came behind Fors, his hand just hanging on Fors's shoulder: "Then listen to me, I will pay you the remaining 'contract couple' remuneration in a while, and then we will end this contract.
"Next, please continue to live in the lord's mansion and help your boyfriend, Baron Hobert, deal with those nobles and wealthy businessmen who are always trying to arrange marriages.
"And our wedding is an important part of achieving this goal. As long as I get married, those barons and wealthy businessmen will completely give up.
"As for our wedding, not only will it be held, but it will also be a grand event, so that our relatives and friends can all attend!"
As Hobert spoke, he leaned down, put his face on Fors's shoulder, very close to Fors, and at the same time his hands hung naturally on her chest.
Such intimate behavior was a bit uncomfortable for Fors at first, but she did not avoid or push Hobert away, because they had already had a lot of intimate behavior.
Listening to Hobert's voice in her ear, that little bit of discomfort gradually disappeared.
Fors grabbed Hobert's wandering hand: "But, but, this is still too fast. We only confirmed our relationship today, and we are getting married in half a month. I, I always feel a little unacceptable."
Hobert smiled: "So, you agreed to my confession just now?"
Fors looked at Hobert with three points of annoyance and three points of smile, and said nothing.
Everything is self-evident.
Hobert saw that this delicate and glossy face with healthy skin was right in front of him, and he kissed it.
Fors dodged: "I, I'm not ready yet."
"Does this still need to be prepared? Then are you ready now?"
"Con, considered ready."
Pa da~
Hobert was so unpromising that he almost kissed out the saliva.
Fors hid in Hobert's arms, enjoying this moment of sweetness. She had described so many love scenes before that she was almost numb, but now she felt that love was really such a sweet feeling.
The two hugged like this for a while, and Hobert continued the topic just now: "We can hold this wedding well, and we can get married first and then fall in love."
"But, but, if we find that we are not suitable for each other in the future, then we will have to get divorced?"
"We won't get divorced." Hobert, who was already prepared, smiled: "We can continue to be 'contract couples'."
Fors also smiled, which meant that no matter what, she would spend the rest of her life with the man in front of her?
But the proposal of "getting married first and then falling in love" was very novel, which made Fors a little tempted.
Next, they began to discuss who to invite to the wedding.
"Xio must be invited, and I will also invite her to be my bridesmaid." Fors said: "I really want to invite Teacher Dorian, but I don't know if he is willing to attend?"
Hobert said: "You can send him an invitation and briefly introduce me in the letter. It's up to him whether he comes or not."
Fors also said: "I originally wanted to invite my friends from the medical school and some writer friends, but they are all ordinary people and I can't bring them to Feynapotter, so I can only forget it.
"And I have already broken contact with my relatives, so I won't bother them. But I can send an invitation to my father, but only send one, because our wedding will be over when we reach the Southern Continent.
"Well, the key is that I don't want him to appear at my wedding either."
Fors let out a long breath, feeling that this matter was too heavy.
Hobert said: "Then why not invite the members of the Justice League to attend the wedding?"
Fors nodded: "Okay."
After discussing this matter, they discussed the new book and going to see the publisher.
Hobert had already asked Dophis to contact the publisher in advance. The two returned to their rooms, changed into more formal clothes, and then used 'Travel' to come to Spring Publishing House in Feynapotter City.
The scale of this publishing house can rank in the top three in the entire Northern Continent, and most of the best-selling novels in the Feynapotter Kingdom are also published by this publishing house.
Because Dophis had greeted them in advance, the two waited for a while before meeting Mr. Gordon, the editor-in-chief.
This was a middle-aged man in his fifties, wearing black-rimmed glasses. The office was a bit messy, but his desk was relatively clean.
He looked through the manuscript for more than an hour before saying: "Miss Fors, your writing is still very good, but this kind of biographical book is not very popular now, please be prepared."
Before Fors could say anything, Hobert asked first: "If we sign a contract with your company, how many copies does your company plan to print?"
"Three thousand copies." Mr. Gordon smiled: "If it weren't for Mr. Dophis's instructions, we would only be willing to print one thousand copies at most, because the Jeffery Town that appears in this book is really not very famous.
"Mr. Hobert, to be honest, we would have printed more two months ago, but now, people's attention to you has sharply decreased."
Hobert did not make any explanations, but simply asked: "If we want to self-publish, how much does it cost to pay for a book?"
Mr. Gordon was slightly stunned before saying: "It depends on what kind of material you use."
"Medium to high grade."
"About one silver Solas."
Hobert said decisively, "Then let's self-publish."
Gordon, of course, wouldn't refuse: "May I ask how many thousands of copies you want to print?"
"Sixty thousand copies!"
"Six…" Gordon thought he had misheard: "Mr. Hobert, haven't I explained it clearly enough?"
Fors also tugged at Hobert's sleeve, indicating that Hobert was printing too many.
Hobert winked at Fors, indicating that he knew what he was doing: "I'll pay for it, you print the books, don't ask anything else, okay?"
Gordon opened his mouth several times before saying: "Of course, that's fine."
Leaving Fors to sign the contract, Hobert "went to the bank" and quickly withdrew 6,000 gold Lire.
Before noon, the contract was signed. Hobert overpaid 500 gold Lire, requesting Mr. Gordon to have the books printed before the 28th and sent to bookstores all over the country.
In this cooperation, Hobert was the financier, and his requests would naturally be met as much as possible.
After leaving the publishing house, Fors said: "This is the first time I've come to a publishing house to spend money."
Hobert laughed: "This isn't called spending money, it's called investing, or rather, advertising."
He took a deep breath: "Now that we're in Feynapotter, let's go shopping and spend some money."
The money he earned before was all spent on the construction of the territory, and he should spend some of it elsewhere, otherwise, he would quickly lose motivation to earn money.
In Feynapotter, it's nothing more than eating and buying clothes.
Although Hobert was also a noble, he didn't have any noble consciousness. Fors also didn't like luxury goods very much, so the two of them basically bought things at the department stores that the middle class liked to go to.
After shopping for half a day, they only spent 16 gold Lire, which made Hobert sigh that he was really getting carried away. This was equivalent to twelve or thirteen pounds in cash, and now he didn't feel any psychological pressure when spending it.
On the way back, Fors also sighed: "In the extraordinary world, spending hundreds of pounds at a time doesn't feel like much, but in daily life, just spending a few pounds makes me feel like I've spent a fortune."
Hobert smiled: "So, the real world and the extraordinary world are completely like two different worlds!"
Back in the territory, the two of them went about their own business. Hobert continued to busy himself with the preparations for the wedding and the reception of the distinguished guests, while Fors returned to Backlund and once again entered the circus to play the "Magician".
However, now Fors also had a sense of participation in this wedding and would participate in the preparation matters.
Some of the actions of the two people inadvertently were also more intimate than before.
On Sunday morning, Hobert received the first batch of invitation cards. He couldn't wait to write one and bring it to his room.
Then, he entered the "Nation of Disorder" and spread his spirituality to Ethel's star.
...
Feynapotter.
Wearing a waist-cinching court dress that showed off her good figure, Ethel, who was attending a very boring event, smiled as if she was very interested in the event.
Suddenly, her eyes were filled with black, sacred light. Ethel saw the solid figure sitting on the throne made of swords again.
Ethel almost blurted out: Great Creator!
Only to hear the "Creator" say in a solemn voice: "At eight o'clock tonight, one of my blessed will come to you."
Hobert didn't explain much and immediately interrupted the connection.
Ethel was slightly stunned, seeing that everyone around her was normal: The figure of the "Creator" just now could only be seen by me!
Then she resumed her smile, restoring the elegant and somewhat powerful temperament she had before.
This temperament was unique in the Feynapotter royal family because although she was a female member of the royal family, she had actually been on the battlefield, not just spending time in the northern war zone to gain experience.
She quietly asked her adjutant: "What are the arrangements for tonight?"
Having an adjutant by her side was also unique because Ethel really couldn't stand the slow and procrastinating style of those butlers.
The adjutant said: "Earl Ralph is holding a banquet tonight…"
Ethel raised her hand to interrupt: "Help me push it back, just say I suddenly have something urgent to deal with."
"Yes!"
Ethel attached great importance to the blessed of the "Creator". She specifically came to an estate in the suburbs of Feynapotter. This place was not as heavily guarded as the royal palace, nor was it protected by Level 0 Sealed Artifacts.
The key was that the people here were absolutely loyal to Ethel, even if they accidentally captured the blessed, it wouldn't matter.
The information given by the "Creator" was too vague. Ethel could only try her best to prevent this meeting from going wrong.
At 7:58, Ethel, who was waiting alone in the spacious living room, found that the space in front of her had become illusory.
It's "Traveling"! Ethel immediately made a judgment, somewhat vigilantly seeing a man wearing a black crystal mask and a noble cloak coming out of the spirit world.
The two looked at each other, but for Ethel, it was almost impossible to see any information from Hobert.
For Hobert, the Ethel in front of him was similar to the appearance he saw in the "Nation of Disorder", about twenty-four or five years old, with a good appearance and some freckles on her face.
After meeting, the heroic spirit on her body became more and more obvious, and there was also an unquestionable temperament, which still gave Hobert a feeling of "meeting an online friend in real life".
Hobert broke the silence first: "Princess Ethel, hello!"
Ethel was not surprised that the other party knew her identity: "Blessed, hello!"
Hobert smiled: "I came to you to seek your help."
"The 'Creator' sent you?"
Hobert seemed to have suddenly been injected with chicken blood. He pounded his chest with one hand and his back with the other, his arms raised at roughly 45-degree angles: "Praise the Creator!"
Ethel was slightly stunned before realizing that this should be the gesture of praise for the "Creator".
Then Hobert said seriously: "The great 'Creator' certainly wouldn't care about such trivial matters. The merciful 'Creator' only guided me in the direction of solving the problem."
Hobert basically learned from Klein how to use a small account to sing a duet with a large account.
Hobert's performance made Ethel put away her contempt, and unconsciously became serious: "Is there anything I can help you with?"
"Yes, please attend my wedding." Hobert handed over the invitation card that he had prepared long ago.
After Hobert's repeated weighing in recent days, this invitation did not have too much danger. After the battle in the Southern Continent, the "Creator" was no longer unknown. Moreover, Ethel had seen the strength of the "Creator".
Hobert believed that even if he exposed his identity as a blessed of the "Creator" here in Ethel, it wouldn't matter. Before he had enough certainty, Ethel would definitely not harm him, at most she would only do some investigation. And Hobert could beat Ethel in the "Nation of Disorder" at any time, so he didn't need to worry too much about her leaking secrets.
This request completely exceeded Ethel's expectations: "Attend the wedding?"
She opened the invitation card and saw Hobert's name. After a brief surprise, she immediately realized that Hobert wanted to use her identity to expand the influence of this wedding.
