chapters.title: Chapter 468 - 468: Klein Bravely Seizes Sea God's Scepter (Bonus 8)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Before seeing the name Hobert, Ethel had been imagining that the favored of the "Creator" would have needs for wealth or power, or for Beyonder ingredients.
She certainly didn't expect that Hobert would make such a request!
After Hobert made the request, the positions of the two sides were different. Although Ethel still had a smile on her face, the words she spoke were already a bit aggressive: "As a baron, shouldn't you salute a princess?"
"I should," Hobert pointed to his mask and said, "But that's when I'm not wearing this mask."
"And when I wear this mask, you should salute me!"
Ethel asked, "What does this mask represent?"
"A favored one of the God!"
Ethel asked again, "I heard that in the Southern Continent, the great 'Creator' has many favored ones?"
"With your level, I cannot reveal this information to you."
"What level do I need to reach to know this information?"
Hobert smiled, "Have you fought for the 'Creator'?"
Ethel shook her head. On the contrary, the "Creator" had saved her life.
Hobert's aura gradually overwhelmed Ethel again: "Do you know how to please the 'Creator'?"
Ethel shook her head helplessly again.
"You don't have to help. I have other alternatives to choose from," Hobert said seriously, "But if I come to you again next time, and you are still unwilling to help, I will not come to you again."
Ethel fell into a brief contemplation. For her, the "Creator" had not shown the side of an evil god, and she was still more willing to maintain a good relationship with the "Creator."
"Okay, I will attend your wedding!" Ethel thought again that helping this "Favored" was equivalent to establishing a relationship with the "Creator's" favored ones, which might be a hidden help in the future.
And if she refused, she was not only refusing the opportunity to establish contact with this "Favored", but also refusing to repay the life-saving grace owed to the "Creator."
Hobert smiled, "I will be waiting for you in my territory."
Ethel quickly asked, "How can I become a favored one of the 'Creator'?"
"Believe in Him piously, and be ready to offer your heart to Him at any time," Hobert stopped there, and left using "Travel".
Offer your heart?
Ethel didn't know if this was a metaphor.
She looked at the invitation again and smiled unconsciously: "He is actually a favored one of the 'Creator', that's interesting."
...
Jeffrey Territory.
Hobert encountered a new problem. The villa was built, but there was not enough time for decoration.
Nowadays, most Feynapotter families have abandoned the complex classical decoration style and turned to a bright and simple modern decoration style.
However, the villas for nobles are still mainly decorated in classical style. These villas are designed for nobles, so of course they must be decorated according to the needs of the nobles.
This means that there must be a lot of carving and murals, but these two types of workers are very scarce, and it is difficult to complete these detailed decoration works.
Hobert thought for a while, and simply became bolder. All the decorations of these five villas were changed to "Ming style"!
He had been exposed to some Ming-style furniture during his work in the Common Era, which were known for their simplicity and atmosphere. Relatively speaking, the patterns of Qing-style furniture are cumbersome, but they are far less dignified and atmospheric than Ming-style decoration and furniture.
Hobert made up his mind to do so. One is to use Ming-style furniture and decoration for emergency, and the other is that Hobert is preparing to try to establish his own unique aesthetic style.
Even if there is time in the future, he does not plan to change the decoration of these five villas. He will only use Feynapotter-style decoration when building new villas, so that nobles can choose between the two.
At the same time, Hobert also plans to adopt some Chinese decoration styles for other hotels and apartments to gradually establish the unique aesthetic and decoration characteristics of Jeffrey Territory.
However, as the only person in Jeffrey Territory who has seen Ming-style decoration, Hobert has to stay on the construction site almost every day. For this reason, he learned to draw woodworking drawings and decoration design drawings.
...
Berserk Sea, Bayam.
The bad weather caused by the confrontation between "Sea God" and "Sea King" has lasted for several days, and Klein has been trapped in Bayam for several days.
In the middle of the night, Klein suddenly woke up, vaguely aware of something.
He turned over and got out of bed, came to the window, and opened the curtains.
The scarlet moonlight shone in all at once, covering everything like a layer of light-colored dye.
Those low-pressure clouds that had lasted for several days and gave people great pressure had disappeared. Does this mean that the confrontation between "Sea God" and "Sea King" is over?
Klein pondered for two seconds, closed the curtains, walked back four steps, and entered the gray fog.
He sat at the head of the bronze long table, conjured a coin, and muttered the divination language: "Kalvetua is completely dead."
"..."
After seven times, he flicked the coin, watching it jump up and roll down.
Pa~
The coin landed in Klein's palm, with the king's head facing up.
This means affirmation!
"Sea God" Kalvetua is almost completely dead!
Klein recalled his previous guess: "Sure enough, the ancient elf ruins on Symeem Island (the place where 'Book of Calamities' was discovered) are closely related to Kalvetua's hiding place!"
Then he recalled the "Emperor's" guess about Kalvetua at the previous Tarot meeting.
Based on Klein's adventure to sacrifice to Kalvetua yesterday and his understanding of him these days, Klein increasingly felt that the "Emperor's" guess was very accurate.
Kalvetua is a Sequence 3, and a Sequence 3 in very bad condition. Strictly speaking, he cannot be called a "God".
Suddenly, Klein realized that Kalvetua was dead, and the military and the Storm Church should not have found his location yet!
Klein has two ways to find Kalvetua. One is to divine the iron cigarette case he sacrificed to him, and the other is to ask "Hanged Man" for Kalvetua's location. At worst, he will pay "Hanged Man" some information fees at the Tarot meeting!
How could he miss such an opportunity to pick up leaks?
Klein divined again: "Official Beyonders have found Kalvetua's hiding place."
"..."
After chanting seven times, he flicked the coin, but the coin happened to fall into the cracks of his fingers and stood on Klein's hand.
This means the divination failed.
Klein guessed that it might be because he knew too few related conditions, or the official Beyonders had related anti-divination abilities and sealed items.
After thinking about it, Klein conjured the yellow crystal pendant and changed his thinking: "It is dangerous to explore Kalvetua's hiding place now!"
"..."
This involved himself, and the divination quickly had a result: the yellow crystal pendant rotated counterclockwise, not too fast, and the amplitude was not large.
There is danger, but it can be tolerated!
Klein immediately took action. He left the space above the gray fog, arranged the ceremony, and summoned himself.
Then he returned to the gray fog, Klein picked up the "Death" card and put it into his spiritual body.
Suddenly, Klein's spiritual body became solid, emitting a pale white light all over his body, as if he was death itself, the end of all life.
Wearing the "Creeping Hunger" glove, he put Azik's bronze whistle, biological toxin bottle and other magical items into his body.
Finally, he picked up the black hardwood cane and used it to find the "lost" iron cigarette case stained with the aura of gray fog.
Klein responded to his summons and stepped out of the "Gate of Summoning". Because he is now in a spiritual state, he easily entered the spirit world.
He held the cane upright and said in a voice full of death: "The location of my exclusive iron cigarette case."
"..."
After seven times, Klein released his palm and waited for enlightenment.
The black hardwood cane slowly floated in one direction. Klein grabbed the cane and completed the process of traveling in the spirit world just by standing in place.
Klein's spirituality realized that in the surrounding space, there were pairs of indifferent eyes looking at him.
This may be due to the relationship of the "Death" card. Although it can make the spiritual body very powerful, it will also attract some attention in the spirit world.
Klein looked down at his cane and dared not look at the surrounding gazes.
Fortunately, this place is not far from Kalvetua's "Temple", and this journey ended quickly.
Klein fell into the ruins of the collapsed building with anticipation. As described by the "Hanged Man", this ruin is at the bottom of the sea, surrounded by glowing coral.
Among the coral reefs, there is a semi-collapsed ruin, and Klein appeared directly in the main hall of the ruin.
He saw that there was a huge pillar in front of him, engraved with strange patterns and symbols, extending from the center to support the nearby buildings.
At this moment, a unwilling and painful roar echoed in the hall for a long time. The sound echoed back and forth without any weakening trend.
This is the resentful roar made by Kalvetua before his death.
But Kalvetua's body was not in the hall. There were many "Sea God" believers with shriveled faces and bodies, turned gray and black.
Kalvetua died, taking away most of the water in their bodies. In a state of half-life and half-death, these believers completely went crazy, similar to the state of living corpses.
Facing the rushing believers, Klein was about to wave his cane to launch an attack, but suddenly seemed to think of something and injected spirituality into the "Death" card.
The pale white light around Klein's body seemed to suddenly become agile. The aura of death and extreme fear spread out. The believers who were already in a half-dead state suddenly stopped. Their eyes, filled with numbness, madness or confusion, suddenly became fearful and awe-inspiring, and they slowly knelt in front of Klein.
Klein breathed a sigh of relief. He had previously discovered that the "Death" card was more restrained against undead or undead-like creatures than Azik's bronze whistle.
Especially these "Sea God believers" who have lost their wisdom, basically just knelt down.
In front of the Beyonders of the "Death" path, injecting spiritual power into the "Death" card can also form a huge sense of oppression to the other party. At least the Beyonders below the demigod will be in very bad condition, and sometimes they will forget to avoid the enemy's attack because of fear.
Klein easily passed these believers and entered a collapsed side hall.
What came into view first was a huge, unimaginable cyan sea snake. Its scales were smooth and covered with patterns similar to the various symbols inside the ruins.
Although Klein had already confirmed that the "Emperor's" guess was correct through the sacrifice to the "Sea God", he still couldn't help but admire the "Emperor's" erudition after seeing the "evidence" in front of him. At that time, he was only listening to the "Hanged Man's" description, and he could guess that Kalvetua was a sea monster.
At this time, the huge sea snake opened its huge mouth and bit a stone pillar. Its body below its head hung on the ground, entwining one-third of the hall, like an undulating cyan hill.
It has already precipitated cyan mysterious light, slowly converging towards a tooth longer than a human arm.
At this time, next to Kalvetua's body, lay an old man wearing a clergyman's soft hat.
He was gnawing on the flesh and blood of "Sea God" Kalvetua.
Several clergymen have already "died" from eating too much of the "Sea God's" flesh and blood. Kalvetua's Beyonder characteristics have not been completely precipitated, and his flesh and blood contain a considerable dose of Beyonder characteristics.
This caused these clergymen to collapse on the spot and die completely, either because of "potion" overdose or because of the conflict of Beyonder characteristics of different paths.
The only remaining priest seemed to realize something, raised his head and looked at Klein, an uninvited guest, with eyes flashing cyan light.
Klein did not hesitate and immediately threw out the "Biological Toxin Bottle", and then the "Creeping Hunger" turned golden and shone out a violent sunlight: "Purification Halo!"
The blue light in the priest's eyes also became more intense and purer. His belly, which had eaten too much flesh and blood, also became much higher.
Woo~
An ethereal but shrill sound came from his body, instantly covering the entire ruin.
The priest's body swelled instantly, like the resurrected Kalvetua. Cyan smooth tentacles drilled out from under his robe. The tentacles were surrounded by a layer of white lightning, waving around at an extremely fast speed.
Klein struggled to avoid it, but was still hit by a tentacle and flew out.
Before he could get up, tentacles surged again. Fortunately, Klein was in a spiritual state at this time, so he quickly flew up to avoid it. At the same time, a brilliant beam of light descended from the sky and hit the old priest straight.
The high temperature of the "Holy Light" caused the Sea God Priest's robe to burn, and the gray-black skin and flesh also melted a lot in the pure light.
When the robe disappeared, Klein realized that there was a face in the Sea God Priest's belly, trying to drill out.
Soon the Sea God Priest's tentacles resumed their rapid waving state, but a hand suddenly stretched out from behind him, grabbed a tentacle, and put it into a seriously deformed mouth with meat shreds hanging on the teeth.
That was another priest who had died next to Kalvetua just now. Although the "Death" card did not provide Klein with any abilities of the "Death" path, he had keenly discovered before that the "Death" card could create an environment that was more likely to form "living corpses".
Klein couldn't control these living corpses and could only let them attack indiscriminately.
However, at this time, Klein was in a spiritual state and had no flesh and blood at all, so of course the living corpses would not gnaw at him.
So, from the moment he realized the sea god priest's condition was off and that he might be his enemy, Klein had been creating an environment conducive to the formation of "living corpses."
Now, three corpses of the priests sat up from the ground. Their death process was similar to their loss of control. At this moment, they had basically turned into monsters, baring their fangs and claws as they charged towards the sea god priest.
After one hand grabbed a tentacle, another mouth came over and bit onto another tentacle of the sea god priest.
The lightning released by these tentacles didn't have any effect because the Beyonder characteristics of these living corpses hadn't completely separated. They were all Beyonders of the "Sailor" pathway before their deaths, and they had some resistance to lightning.
The sea god priest wrestled with the living corpses. They rolled around and crashed into the ruins, shaking the entire structure.
But neither could do anything to the other. The sea god priest couldn't shock or electrocute the living corpses to death, and the living corpses could only bite the sea god priest, unable to inflict serious damage for the time being.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Klein flew towards the snake tooth that had absorbed all the Beyonder characteristics.
As the Beyonder characteristics condensed, the snake tooth gradually straightened, becoming a white short staff. The top of the staff was inlaid with small cyan-blue "gems," some of which had a dark undertone in their cyan-blue color.
Before he even touched the scepter, Klein heard layers of overlapping prayers in his ears, and he seemed to see a hallucination, witnessing believers prostrating and praying.
This made Klein quickly retreat a few steps. He divined with his cane and received a revelation that he could control the scepter in his current state, but only for a few seconds.
So, Klein, in his spirit body state, suddenly rushed forward, trying to pull out the scepter.
At this moment, the battle between the sea god priest and the living corpses changed. The sea god priest's stomach was torn open, forming a huge mouth full of sharp teeth, dripping with cyan-blue pus.
This huge mouth let out a roar, and for a moment, the surroundings seemed to be filled with seawater, and a terrifying vortex formed at the mouth, creating a huge suction force on everything around it.
The three living corpses were pulled off the ground by the suction force, but they were still firmly grabbing the tentacles, still biting desperately.
Splash!
The seawater in the surrounding sea area suddenly surged. On the other side, Klein used force to pull the scepter from the stone pillar. The layered prayers once again drilled into his ears, immediately making him feel intense throbbing and dizziness.
Klein looked at the sea god priest and the three living corpses. The entire hall was suddenly filled with dark clouds, accompanied by thunder and rain.
Crack~
A bolt of silver-white lightning struck the sea god priest. This was different from the silk-like silver lightning on the sea god priest's tentacles. It was a giant lightning bolt that could cover the sea god priest and all three living corpses!
The terrifying vortex disappeared, and the surfaces of the three living corpses were burned into charcoal, falling straight down.
Crack~
Another silver lightning bolt struck the sea god priest, and the giant mouth on his abdomen was directly charred. The sea god priest's head was burned smaller.
He raised his face with only a few empty holes left, and "looked" at Klein in mid-air with his two empty eye sockets, and finally fell to the ground.
Klein, whose spirit was about to reach its limit, released the scepter, letting it fall to the ground.
Floating in mid-air for more than half a minute to recover, the throbbing and dizziness in Klein's head gradually disappeared, and the feeling of madness in his mind finally gradually subsided.
After recovering for another minute or two, Klein dragged his tired spirit body to search the battlefield, first recovering the "Biological Toxin Bottle," a Sealed Artifact that paired very well with the spirit body state.
However, this time the "Death" card played a huge role, and the effect of the "Biological Toxin Bottle" had not yet manifested before the battle ended.
Then, according to the guidance of his spirituality, Klein found the iron cigarette case he had sacrificed next to Kalvetua's corpse.
Just as he was about to leave with the scepter, Klein's spirituality sensed something and came to the sea god priest's corpse. The charred abdomen of the corpse moved around, as if something alive was about to break out of its shell.
Klein used his cane to pry open the charred abdominal muscles of the sea god priest and saw that the sea god priest's stomach was still basically intact. The stomach bag formed the face of a sea snake in its wriggling!
He could still hear Kalvetua's roar in his ears.
This... this is actually Kalvetua's spiritual residue. The power of a demigod's will far exceeded Klein's imagination.
Klein used his cane to dig out the sea god priest's stomach bag, then found a piece of rag to wrap it, preparing to take it back to the gray fog for research.
At this time, Klein also noticed that the three living corpses next to him had separated out Beyonder characteristics after being baptized by lightning.
However, these Beyonder characteristics had a cyan-blue light, and should have fused more than one Beyonder characteristic. This kind of Beyonder characteristic should cause loss of control if taken. Rather than being an Beyonder characteristic, it was more like a Sealed Artifact with extremely negative effects.
Klein thought that the "Emperor" had a way to remove the spiritual residue in the Beyonder characteristics, and he might buy this kind of Beyonder characteristic.
So, Klein used another piece of rag to wrap the three Beyonder characteristics, carried the two cloth bags, and came to the white scepter again.
Klein took a deep breath and rushed over, grabbed the scepter, and immediately ended the summoned state.
Splash~
Without the power of the scepter to support it, seawater poured into the ruins, submerging the place.
...
Above the gray fog.
Klein, who had finished summoning himself to himself, used the level of the gray fog to divined the abilities and negative effects of the scepter in his hand, and named it the "Sea God Scepter."
Sitting at the head of the long table, Klein thought to himself: In the future, when the "Emperor" blasphemes the gods again, he will finally be able to give him a lightning strike. It's just that the "Fool" also likes to listen to the "Emperor's" blasphemous remarks, so the punishment of lightning can be recorded in a small notebook first, and then discussed later.
Then Klein looked at the stomach bag and the three obviously abnormal Beyonder characteristics and left the gray fog. The negative effects of these four things were terrifyingly high, and they couldn't be used at all.
Klein thought about it, and he could also try to sell the stomach bag to the "Emperor". He was knowledgeable and might find a corresponding use.
After doing all this, Klein returned to the real world and continued to sleep.
The next morning, before Klein got out of bed, he suddenly sensed something and opened his spiritual vision.
He saw a heavy coffin appearing in his bedroom, and a red invitation card floated out of the coffin and fell into Klein's hand, and the coffin immediately disappeared.
Klein was stunned for a moment before he understood that this was a messenger.
Opening the red invitation card, he saw: "Hobert is getting married! The bride is still Fors!"

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 469 Wedding Invitation (Bonus 9)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the Kingdom of Loen, Backlund, inside Earl Hall's mansion.
Audrey sat before the piano, staring blankly at the sheet music.
"Audrey, you've been a bit down since Viscount Glaint's servant came by," Susie said. "Is Glaint breaking up with you?"
Audrey was taken aback: "Susie, why would you interpret it that way?"
Susie stuck out her tongue and grinned, her dog mouth wide open: "You seem a little reluctant, a little confused, and a little annoyed, like you're determined to never pay attention to Glaint again."
Audrey gave a wry smile. Susie's interpretations were all correct, but it wasn't Glaint who caused such complex emotions.
She also knew that she should bless the wedding of her two good friends, but Audrey always felt like she had encountered a betrayal among friends!
That bastard Hobert betrayed her favor towards him!
But was that really the case?
Audrey also felt that there were some other emotions inside, making her never want to pay attention to Hobert again.
She sighed and glanced at the invitation again. She would definitely go and offer her most sincere blessings, otherwise, she would appear unreasonable and lacking grace.
She looked at the invitation again: "January 28th, eight days from now."
Susie immediately asked: "What about eight days from now?"
Audrey smiled: "Eight days from now, we're going to attend a wedding."
"Great, I love attending weddings, especially the cake at the wedding."
...
Backlund North Borough, Quiet Church back street.
Lorotta, holding a red invitation, knocked and entered Captain Thomas's office. Borgia was already in the office, holding a red invitation in his hand as well.
And as Lorotta expected, there was also a red invitation on Captain Thomas's desk.
"Captain!" Lorotta raised the invitation in her hand: "What should we do?"
"What else can we do?" Thomas said with a smile: "Our colleague invited us to attend the wedding, of course, we have to go. Not only do we have to go, but we also have to prepare a gift."
Borgia took a deep breath: "Indeed, we haven't received a notice to fire Hobert yet, so theoretically, he's still our colleague."
He opened the invitation and said: "The only thing I can't figure out is, why is the wedding venue at No. 1920 in the factory district? I remember this place is an abandoned factory."
Lorotta speculated: "Hobert is still carrying such a high bounty, so he should only hold the wedding in secret.
"But when did he come back? How did we not know anything about it?"
"Perhaps he has some arrangements or plans somewhere," Thomas said. "In short, on that day, we must also be vigilant enough. After all, Hobert's other identity is a baron of the Feynapotter Kingdom."
"Yes!"
...
Not far from the Church, in a classical building.
A meeting was being held to summarize information on the Nikola Shipyard case and the Baran Fisheries Company case.
During the break, Leonard met Daly in the corridor: "You should have received it too!"
Daly smiled and pulled out a corner of the invitation from her pocket: "It's been a long time since I attended a wedding!"
Leonard smiled: "Me too, if Captain and Klein were still here…"
Halfway through the sentence, the two fell silent at the same time.
...
Cherwood Borough, Aslan-Barton Law Firm.
Jessica knocked on Barton's office door: "Lawyer Barton, I have good news for you."
As she spoke, she closed the office door and handed the red invitation to Barton.
"Whose invitation is this?" Barton asked with a smile as he opened the invitation, then suddenly stood up: "Hob…"
Then he lowered his voice: "Hobert's wedding!"
Jessica nodded.
Barton sighed for a long time: "If Chief Rex were still alive, he would be very pleased."
Jessica asked curiously: "Who is Chief Rex?"
Barton smiled: "That was a legend."
...
St. George Borough.
Benson held up the invitation in his hand: "Melissa, I think we should accept this invitation."
"But, but, he's a traitor," Melissa said. "And your exam is about to start. What if someone sees us attending the wedding of a traitor? You might be disqualified from the exam!"
"We received Hobert's warm hospitality before, Melissa," Benson said with a smile. "In the eyes of others, he may be a traitor, but we are not the Loen Kingdom. He didn't betray us, so we can't be influenced by those remarks!
"Besides, I believe that Hobert dares to hold a wedding in Backlund, he must have made some preparations. As guests, we don't need to worry about our safety."
Melissa sighed: "Okay."
She said: "If… if Klein were still here…"
Benson stood up: "That's all in the past. Our life in Backlund has just begun, and everything will be fine."
Melissa glanced at her brother: "Benson, you're at the age to get married too. I think Miss Delia from last time was very good. Why don't you want to ask her out a few more times?"
Benson was a little embarrassed by his sister's question: "That… that…"
He smiled wryly: "That's because I don't have a decent job yet. I'll think about getting married after I finish the exam."
"But you can totally prepare for the exam while making friends with some ladies and women."
"That would distract me."
"Attending a wedding won't distract you?"
"I should go read a book, Melissa." Benson almost fled to the study: "You should go review too, your entrance exam is about to start."
...
South of the Bridge District, Harvest Church.
After Emlyn entered, he put on the priest's robe of the Earth Mother Church and skillfully washed the rag, suddenly feeling something was wrong.
Looking up, he realized what was wrong. Today, Bishop Utravsky was not praying, but playing with a red invitation.
While Emlyn was curious about whose invitation it was, he was about to start working when he suddenly heard Bishop Utravsky say: "On the 28th, I have to go out to attend a wedding."
It turned out to be a wedding invitation: "Did someone invite you to officiate the wedding?"
There are halls dedicated to holding weddings, and people hold weddings almost every day.
After the Backlund Great Smog incident, the Earth Mother's believers also numbered in the hundreds, so Emlyn guessed that a believer had invited Utravsky to officiate the wedding.
"It's to attend a wedding," Utravsky said. "By the way, he specifically stated on the invitation that as a witness to his baptism, you can also go if you are free."
"The 'traitor' is getting married?"
"Who said he can't get married?"
"That… that's true."
"If you want to go too, prepare in advance."
Emlyn said: "I'm not going."
He hated this kind of occasion the most, it was better to accompany the doll at home.
Besides, he had just received a reward from Lord Nibbs, and there were many important things waiting for him.
Utravsky smiled slightly and said nothing more.
...
Tingen suburb.
Dorothy quickly came to Ulysses's villa: "I just came back from vacation and received an unexpected invitation."
Ulysses smiled rarely: "I received it too!"
"So you are going to participate?"
"Definitely going to participate!"
Dorothy smiled: "Speaking of which, I just met Hobert in Conant City. There was a very beautiful lady sitting next to him at the time. I believe the bride should be that lady."
Ulysses immediately became interested: "How old does that lady look? Where is she from? What does she do?"
Dorothy smiled wryly, regretting not asking for this information at the time.
...
Pritz Harbor, Fisheries Association.
Dorian was stunned when he received the invitation from the messenger, thinking that the messenger had sent it to the wrong person.
But when he saw Fors's name, he realized that this was originally his student's wedding.
Also sent was a letter from Fors, in which Fors first expressed her apology. The date of the wedding was determined a bit hastily.
In fact, it was only two days ago that the decision was made to invite Dorian.
Then Fors briefly introduced her fiancé. Dorian looked at the invitation again. No wonder he felt a little familiar just now. It turned out that Fors's fiancé was a "traitor!"
Fors had mentioned her fiancé before, so Dorian was slightly surprised but not surprised after receiving the invitation.
As for whether or not he betrayed the country, it was not important to Dorian, because he did not have much sense of belonging to the Loen Kingdom.
Dorian was just considering whether to attend the wedding? After all, Hobert seemed to be a member of a Sequence family and might have some risks.
Finally, Dorian suddenly seemed to have made up his mind: He had to attend, otherwise, it would be a distrust of Fors!
Since the other party sent the invitation so seriously, the degree of danger should not be high.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffrey Territory.
Hobert looked at his pocket watch. It was already 2:55 PM, and it was almost time for the Tarot Gathering.
He always felt that he hadn't done much, and it was Monday again.
And next week will definitely be busier.
Thinking of this, he sighed for a long time. He didn't expect the wedding preparations to be so complicated!
Thinking about it, Hobert's vision was shrouded in gray fog. This week's Tarot Gathering began!
Coming to the giant hall again, Hobert suddenly found an extra person on the opposite side: Huh? Miss Hermit is online!
Everyone also saw the new member, and "Justice" Audrey still greeted everyone one by one as usual.
Through her greetings, "Hermit" Cattleya also knew the code names of other members.
"The Fool" Klein only mentioned: "This is Miss Hermit."
Everyone began to look at each other. Although there was gray fog blocking it, Hobert could still see that the new member was wearing a black robe with many occult patterns on it, and he could also see that her hair was black.
"Hanged Man" Alger had already associated with the "Admiral of Stars" he had seen at a pirate conference and guessed that this should be "Admiral of Stars" Cattleya.
Audrey, through her observation, believed that the new member's Sequence was not low, and she looked very stable and confident.
At the same time, Cattleya was also observing other members: "'Justice' is a seventeen or eighteen-year-old girl. From her clothes and jewelry, it is not difficult to see that she is very rich and has the manners of a noble. She should be a noble of Loen.
"'Hanged Man', in his thirties, with relatively rare dark blue hair. This is a mutation of the 'Sailor' path. He is wearing a robe with patterns of storms and waves... a member of the Storm Church?
"'The Sun' is not very old, and the style of his clothes is rare, with a simple beauty. It is quite tight and suitable for combat. Is he a Beyonder in this area?
"'The World'... Huh, he has a feeling of being non-living!
"'The Magician' is wearing a common Loen-style dress. Except for looking a little lazy, there is nothing special about her.
"'The Moon' is sitting casually, wearing a priest's robe of the Earth Mother. There is only one possibility for such a combination, a vampire!
"'The Emperor' looks to be in his twenties, wearing Feynapotter-style clothes, very restrained and confident. His Sequence should not be low."
After everyone had a new understanding of each other, Audrey turned to the top of the bronze long table: "Mr. Fool, I only collected one page of Roselle's diary this week."
Earl Hall's family was preparing to return to their fief in East Chester County, so Audrey didn't have time to contact the people from the "Psychology Alchemists" this week.
Because of the addition of new members, she cautiously did not mention the "Psychology Alchemists" or Backlund.
Roselle's Diary? Cattleya almost looked sharply at Miss Justice. She clearly remembered that the tall and beautiful figure had once sighed:
"That's not a note, it's his diary, but no one but him will be able to understand it."
For a time, doubts and shocking thoughts arose in Cattleya's mind: The members of the Tarot Club know that Roselle's notes are diaries? Mr. Fool is collecting Roselle's diaries? Is He doing this kind of cracking, trying to find the secrets hidden in that period of history?
Fors said with a smile: "Mr. Fool, I got three pages."
That was sent by Dorian with the letter. In the letter, he congratulated Fors and said that he would definitely come to the wedding.
"The Sun" Derrick followed closely: "Mr. Fool, I have a new copy of the ancient god legends."
"The Moon" Emlyn glanced at "The Sun": He always uses the ancient god legends to perfunctorily. At the last gathering, "The Emperor" clearly introduced the ancient gods so clearly!
"Very good!" After Klein received the manifested content, he browsed through it casually, seemingly at random.
Cattleya noticed: Mr. Fool doesn't seem to be cracking it. He, He can understand Emperor Roselle's diary?
But soon, she restrained her emotions and looked at the surface of the bronze long table.
However, the shock that Cattleya had just shown was still captured by Audrey: Miss Hermit's reaction to Mr. Fool being able to understand Roselle's diary is beyond my imagination. She cares about this matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - 470 He Betrayed Lilith (Bonus 10)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
A few minutes later, Klein made the information in his hand disappear and said with a smile, "You can start now!"
Emlyn couldn't wait to say to "The Emperor", "I've thought it over. I'm going to buy the 'Potion Professor' characteristic from you."
Hobert nodded slightly, "As I said before, you helped me facilitate the deal with the vampires, so I'll give you another 500 pounds discount, selling it to you for 3,000 pounds."
Vampires? Cattleya frowned slightly. Now that he was a priest of the Church of the Earth Mother, would the vampires still trust him?
"No problem!" Emlyn said grandly. He had just received a 7,000-pound draft from Lord Nibbs, which was the Marquis's reward for facilitating the deal.
Emlyn also realized that this reward was too generous, but he accepted it immediately, because he knew that this was Lord Nibbs's funding and test for him.
Moreover, he had already figured out how to spend the 7,000 pounds: 1,000 pounds to buy a puppet he had been eyeing for a long time, as well as several sets of clothes for the puppet, and 3,000 pounds to buy the characteristic.
As for the last 3,000 pounds: "Mr. Emperor, I would like to initiate a second transaction. Who betrayed the Ancestor!"
Cattleya frowned slightly again: Ancestor? Lilith, the Sanguine Ancestor? What 'betrayed the Ancestor'? Could it be that 'The Emperor' actually knows some secrets between the ancient gods?
"Okay," Hobert said with a smile, "According to the quote from the last gathering, 3,000 pounds, is that acceptable?"
"No problem!" Emlyn said grandly.
Audrey smiled slightly: It seems that Mr. Hanged Man's guidance worked. Mr. Moon must have received the support of a Sanguine big shot, and suddenly become so rich.
She followed up, "Mr. Moon, I am willing to contribute 500 pounds to join this transaction."
"You don't have to pay a penny to join the transaction," Emlyn said, "This is a reward for helping me pay the auditing fee at the last gathering."
Audrey did not refuse. She smiled and said, "You are a generous gentleman!"
Emlyn unconsciously raised his chin.
Alger said, "I am also willing to contribute 500 pounds to join the transaction."
"You only need to contribute 300 pounds to join," Emlyn said, "This is a reward for providing guidance at the last gathering."
Alger smiled slightly, "As expected of a Sanguine, very trustworthy."
Emlyn raised his chin even higher.
Hobert smiled aside: Just keep praising him.
"Little Sun" Derrick also hoped to use two Sequence 8-level main ingredients to join the transaction. Emlyn said, "Three, use three to replace 700 pounds to join the transaction."
Klein smiled slightly: Your double standard is too obvious.
But everyone had no objections. Emlyn even thought that "The Sun" would withdraw from the transaction, but he didn't expect that even "The Sun" had no objections.
This was because Emlyn was not clear about the exchange ratio of Beyonder ingredients between City of Silver and the outside world. Now "The Sun" had already gathered the main ingredients for "Solar High Priest" in advance, and only needed to completely digest the potion to advance.
For him, there was no burden at all now. Three pieces and two pieces were no different.
Fors also joined the transaction with 500 pounds. Last week, Hobert gave her another 1,000 pounds, saying it was the final payment for the "contract couple."
Originally, Fors didn't intend to take it. After all, they only worked as a contract couple for less than two months. According to their previous agreement, Hobert would only pay this final payment after working as a contract couple for a year.
But Hobert said again that this was a sign of the end of the "contract couple", and Fors felt it made sense, so she accepted it, and spent it with peace of mind.
Spending her boyfriend's money, of course, she felt at ease.
Finally, everyone looked at "The World" again. This was almost a "weekly look" segment, because "The World" was not very active every time he joined the transaction.
Alright. Klein manipulated "The World": "I'll also contribute 500 pounds."
After arriving at the sea, his income had increased a lot. Last week, he had just hunted the second mate of "Admiral of Blood", and at this week's gathering, he also planned to peddle the stomach pouch and Beyonder characteristics he had obtained in the elven ruins where Kavetua died.
Audrey considerately said to the new member "The Hermit", "Ms. Hermit, would you like to join this transaction? If you don't want to pay 500 pounds, you can pay 300 pounds to audit."
Hobert crossed his arms: I don't have to go around looking for people myself anymore.
Cattleya was very interested in this trading method: "Okay, I am willing to pay 300 pounds to audit."
Hobert finally said, "Let's count again. In this transaction, Mr. Moon pays 1,000 pounds, 'Little Sun' pays 3 Beyonder ingredients, Mr. World and Ms. Magician each pay 500 pounds, Mr. Hanged Man and Ms. Hermit each pay 300 pounds, and Mr. Moon grants Ms. Justice the right to audit."
Seeing that everyone had no objections, Hobert said, "Then let's begin. Because there are new members joining, I will first explain Mr. Moon's question.
"Last week, we were trading information about the eight ancient gods. When we talked about 'Sanguine Ancestor' Lilith, I said that her fall was due to a betrayal. Mr. Moon was very concerned about this matter, so he wanted to trade relevant information with me at this gathering."
Cattleya was slightly stunned: I also know the eight ancient gods, but I don't know too much detailed information. Why does "The Emperor" know these? Also, why did I hear that 'Sanguine Ancestor' did not completely fall? According to the existing information, I once suspected that "Primordial Moon" might be "Sanguine Ancestor".
Because it was her first time participating in the Tarot Gathering, she chose to listen more and talk less.
"To explain this question, I must first talk about the two camps formed by the eight ancient gods in the Second Epoch," Hobert said, "The eight ancient gods at that time all had crazy and distorted characteristics, so of course they would not coexist peacefully.
"It was normal to form alliances in battle. In the middle of the Second Epoch, the two camps were basically formed.
"One side was the 'Humanoid Creature Camp' composed of 'Giant King' Aurmir, 'Elf King' Soniathrym, and 'Sanguine Ancestor' Lilith.
"One side was the 'Non-Human Creature Camp' composed of 'Dragon of Imagination' Ankewelt, 'Ancestor of the Phoenix' Gregrace, and 'Mutant King' Kvastir.
"The other two ancient gods have never formed an alliance, but this does not mean that there is no cooperation between them."
Klein behind the gray fog recalled the Roselle diary he had just read: Not only did the gods of the Fourth Epoch have alliances or stand on teams, but also in the Second Epoch!
Cattleya exclaimed: Who would have thought that the ancient gods would actually be divided into camps! I only know the titles of the eight ancient gods, and I don't even know a few of their real names, but "The Emperor" seems to be very familiar with them. This information has far exceeded the value of 300 pounds. Could he be an Beyonder of the "Reader" pathway? Doesn't seem like it. Then why does he know so much?
Finally, she exclaimed: The Tarot Gathering is really an unexpected gathering.
The others did not react much. They were basically used to the process of "The Emperor" sorting out some seemingly complex information clearly and presenting it in his information transactions.
Emlyn stared at "The Emperor". He knew that the other party was about to get to the point: Hurry up and say it, was it "Giant King" or "Elf King" who betrayed the Ancestor?
"As far as I know," Hobert continued, "There is accurate information proving that 'Elf King' once publicly stated that it was 'Giant King' who betrayed Lilith, causing 'Sanguine Ancestor' to fall in a divine war."
"Little Sun" was about to say something when he heard this.
Hobert stopped him with a gesture: "There are also messages indicating that 'Giant King' also accused 'Elf King' of betraying Lilith!"
Emlyn clenched his fists: "Who is it?"
"Don't worry!" Hobert said with a smile, "I think it was not these two ancient gods who betrayed Lilith, but it should be 'Giant King's' queen, 'Goddess of Harvest' Omebella, who betrayed Lilith behind 'Giant King's' back."
Everyone was slightly stunned, and then one by one stared at "The Emperor".
Hobert said, "This is my guess, because there is not enough evidence to prove this so far, but this is a reasonable guess.
"First of all, we all know that the elven race is a very irritable race, partly because of the potions they take, and partly because 'Elf King' is relatively irritable.
"Such a race, such an ancient god, if it was really him who betrayed Lilith, his most likely reaction would be to admit it generously!
"Another important piece of evidence is that 'Goddess of Beauty' Auernia defected to 'Elf King' after Lilith fell, which basically excludes the suspicion of 'Elf King's' forces.
"Although the giant race also has crazy and brutal nature, they have always valued honor. Without sufficient motivation, they would hardly do anything to betray.
"The only one who has motivation is 'Goddess of Harvest'."
Emlyn followed up and asked, "Why does she have motivation?"
"Because her pathway and Lilith's pathway are adjacent pathways!" Hobert said.
Everyone suddenly understood: This is the biggest motivation!
The other members were basically used to the Emperor's description method, and only Cattleya was surprised: This requires knowing enough ancient god history, and only rich extraordinary knowledge can lead to such a conclusion! It's still that question, why does the Emperor know so much? And why is everyone not surprised at all?
Emlyn was still not very clear about the relevant information of adjacent pathways: "Wh, what do you mean?"
Audrey briefly explained a few words to Emlyn, and then asked, "Mr. Emperor, do you have any detailed information about the betrayal process?"
Fors also looked over with eager eyes, and Cattleya was also obviously a little tempted.
Hobert seemed to see three restless "gossip hearts".
Relatively speaking, Klein behind the gray fog fell into contemplation. Alger was not very interested in the details after knowing the answer.
"Little Sun" frowned. Although City of Silver had long been freed from the rule of the "Giant King Court", most of his companions were Beyonders of the "Warrior" pathway. When they heard that "Giant King" had betrayed other ancient gods, their first thought was disbelief, and the second thought was to refute it.
Fortunately, it was not "Giant King" who betrayed Lilith, but after all, it was "Giant King's" subsidiary god, "Goddess of Harvest" who betrayed, which made "Little Sun" still feel a little heavy.
In addition, "The World" did not react much, and Emlyn also hoped to hear the details.
Hobert said, "As for the details, most of them are my guesses. I will just say them, and everyone will just listen.
"I said before that in the Second Epoch, the first 'Blasphemy Slate' occasionally appeared. 'Goddess of Harvest' probably saw the first 'Blasphemy Slate' at that time and learned about the relevant information of adjacent pathways.
"After 'Goddess of Harvest' made many efforts to become a god in her own pathway but had little hope, she thought of the method of jumping to the adjacent pathway to become a god.
"This guess is relatively the most reasonable and the most likely to happen."
So Lilith had the opportunity to replace the "Goddess of Harvest", otherwise, if the "Goddess of Harvest" had been staying in the "Giant King Court", it would have been difficult for the Evernight Goddess and the Ancient Sun God to complete the next operation without anyone knowing.
It is very likely that when the "Goddess of Harvest" went to pick up the characteristic and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics of the "Moon" pathway, her fate was stolen. The "Goddess of Harvest" without fate could not return to the "Giant King Court", and eventually could only return to the "Silver Kingdom" that once believed in her like a lonely ghost, and eventually fell there.
Of course, it is also possible that Lilith had been maintaining a half-dead state, waiting for the Ancient Sun God to wake up, and after Amanises became a god, the Ancient Sun God defeated the "Giant King", the "Giant King Court" collapsed, and the "Goddess of Harvest" fell, before there was a series of operations afterwards.
But if this is the case, the "Goddess of Harvest" would probably fall in the "Giant King Court".
In short, the Evernight Goddess and the Ancient Sun God helped Lilith target the "Goddess of Harvest" together. In addition to the fact that they are adjacent pathways, there must be other reasons.
Otherwise, the Ancient Sun God could steal the corruption of the Mother Goddess of Depravity in the "Moon" pathway Beyonder characteristics and send the corruption to others, so that Lilith could regain her godhood. Why bother to become a god through adjacent pathways?
The "Mother" pathway, or the "Planter" pathway, is as easily polluted by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" as the "Moon" pathway. What is the point of Lilith jumping around like this?
As for whether the Ancient Sun God, who only possesses the characteristic of the old day, can successfully steal the corruption?
Hobert believes that there should be no problem. Klein, as Sequence 6, can steal the spiritual corruption of the True Creator at the True God level with the Sequence 6 "Tinder".
The Ancient Sun God, who possesses the characteristic of the "Error" pathway, should be able to steal the corruption at the Great Old One level.
But Hobert is not sure about these ideas and guesses, and cannot announce them for the time being, so he can only say it vaguely here.
Hobert's explanation made the three female members imagine the game between the two female gods in the Second Epoch.
After listening to "The Emperor's" explanation, Emlyn asked again, "What happened later? What happened to our Ancestor?"
Hobert said, "Lilith received some help, so she can still occasionally respond to you."
Emlyn then asked, "What about the Goddess of Harvest? Did the 'Goddess of Harvest' receive the punishment she deserved?"
"If my guess is correct, this is a conspiracy caused by Beyonder characteristics," Hobert said.
"What exactly happened to Him?"
Seeing that he couldn't bluff his way out, Hobert had no choice but to say, "It is said that He fell during the end of the Second Epoch, but no one has ever seen His corpse or the Beyonder characteristics He left behind."
Emlyn asked anxiously, "Mr. Emperor, can you give me a definitive answer?"
Hobert said helplessly, "I can only answer this question to this extent."
Emlyn continued, "I can pay you more money!"
"This isn't about money!"
Emlyn opened his mouth, at a loss for how to continue asking.
"The World" suddenly asked "The Emperor" in a hoarse voice, "I remember you mentioned before that the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway is with the Evernight Goddess?"
Just now, Klein had fallen into deep thought because he had thought of this: it seemed that the Evernight Goddess had also participated in this event, and played an important role, otherwise it would have been impossible to obtain the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway.
Cattelya looked at "The World" in surprise: Uniqueness… Evernight Goddess… What level of intelligence were they trading before?
Hobert's answer just now had obviously not made her realize how high-end the Tarot Club's intelligence trading was.
The others also recalled this point, and realized that there seemed to be many secrets surrounding this matter.
Only Emlyn asked in confusion, "What does Uniqueness mean?"
"The only one among the True Gods," Hobert briefly explained to Emlyn, and then said to "The World", "I can only explain this question to this extent.
"Even to this point, it's worth 3,000 pounds. I believe Mr. Fool wouldn't allow me to continue explaining."
Klein behind the gray fog: What does it have to do with me? I also really want to know the inside story of this matter, okay?
But he still had to maintain his composure. He responded to the gazes of the other members with silence and indifference. His silence was his statement.
Moreover, Mr. Fool's silence gave everyone enough pressure, and no one had the idea of continuing to ask.
At the same time, Klein realized that although "The Emperor's" answer was a bit of a bluff, everyone understood what he wanted to express: this involved secret transactions between gods, at least the Evernight Goddess participated in this transaction, and if these secret transactions were made public, it would not be good for anyone.
Klein recalled the handsome woman who smiled at him not long ago. She only glanced at Mr. A, and a Sequence 5 disappeared before his eyes.
For a moment, Klein felt a chill down his spine.
This was the deterrence from a god. Don't think that "The Emperor" usually doesn't take blasphemous remarks seriously, but once it involves the interests of the gods, "The Emperor's" answer stops there, knowing when to shut up.
The other members also guessed that this might involve transactions between gods.
Cattelya even suspected the authenticity of this information. The reason was simple: could a "Mid-Sequence" Beyonder really know such information?
However, she did not immediately express her doubts, and still adhered to the principle of "listen more and talk less", preparing to continue observing before speaking.
For Emlyn, since it involved transactions between the "Ancestor" and other gods, he couldn't ask any more questions in order to prevent the "Ancestor's" secrets from being revealed.
Based on the existing clues, Emlyn sorted out the participants in this transaction between gods: the "Ancestor" was definitely one of the parties in this transaction, and the Evernight Goddess also participated. Mr. Fool should also have participated, otherwise "The Emperor" would not be afraid of Mr. Fool's punishment. Perhaps the "Creator" also participated, at least the "Creator" knew the inside story and told the contents of this transaction to "The Emperor" as a Blessed.
Thinking about it this way, the answer was actually very obvious.
Emlyn also thought that he had only spent 1,000 pounds in this transaction and actually learned a secret between the Ancestor and other ancient gods. No matter how he looked at it, it was worth more than its price.
Next, everyone continued the free trading session.
Because a new member had joined, Alger did not continue to seek the "Ocean Songster" potion formula. Emlyn had just obtained the Beyonder characteristics of "Potion Professor", Audrey had just advanced, Fors and Derrick were digesting potions, and the latter was preparing to advance this week. Everyone did not have urgent trading needs.
Only "The World" spoke, "I need the remnant spirituality of an ancient wraith."
Everyone still did not have relevant materials or clues. Cattelya did have relevant clues, but she did not intend to trade immediately and planned to observe for a while.
So this transaction failed, and Hobert said, "Please help me pay attention to the 'sap of the Black Mist Lord Tree'."
Cattelya, who had rich knowledge of mysticism, had heard of the "Black Mist Lord Tree", which was a demigod-level Beyonder creature.
She immediately realized that "The Emperor" was preparing to advance to a demigod.
But Cattelya still chose to observe for a while, but Alger said, "I have relevant clues, about 1,000 pounds for 10 milliliters."
Hobert almost cursed: Sequence 4-level auxiliary materials are so expensive! A total of 20 milliliters is needed, so the same auxiliary material will cost 2,000 pounds! Sequence 5-level auxiliary materials only cost 300 to 700 pounds, okay?
But since there were clues, although the price was a bit expensive, Hobert decided to stock up in advance: "I need 20 milliliters."
Alger nodded: "I will help you contact him."
In fact, the clues he knew were 900 pounds for 10 milliliters, and he only added a price difference of 200 pounds in the middle, and he had not even mentioned the intermediary fee. This was already a considerable discount.
With the completion of this transaction, this free trading session ended, and the free exchange session came.
Alger said first, "A major event has recently occurred in the Rorsted Archipelago. Do you remember the 'Sea God' Kalvetua we talked about before?"
Audrey and Derrick recalled and nodded together.
Fors and Emlyn had not yet joined the Tarot Club at that time, so they were a little dazed.
And Cattelya certainly knew this "Sea God", but Kalvetua had only died in the past two days, and she had not received relevant news. Because it was information at sea, she listened very carefully.
Alger continued, "Latricia, disguised as an archaeologist, discovered an ancient elven ruin on Simimir Island, and took something from it, indirectly causing Kalvetua to approach collapse.
"This false god wanted to create a tsunami and submerge the island, so that everyone would be buried with him, but was stopped by the 'Sea King' of the Storm Church…"
Hobert was stunned: Sea King? Uh, okay, I must have thought wrong.
As Alger recounted this incident that happened in the Rorsted Archipelago, Cattelya was slightly stunned: Latricia is dead? The "Sea God" Kalvetua is dead, but there is still a "Sea God" responding to the prayers of believers…
Suddenly, Cattelya recalled a scene. When Mr. Fool pulled her in here, she saw that the other party was holding a milky white scepter! It exuded the aura of divinity, exuding the aura of the sea and storms that was almost tangible!
Hobert was thinking of another thing: if the power of the 'Nation of Disorder' is injected into the 'Sea God Scepter', can an 'Order Serpent' be created?

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 471 The Hermit Lady Who Doubts Life (Bonus 11)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Dany James for becoming a free member]
Audrey was the first to keenly notice that "The Hermit" was subtly looking towards Mr. Fool.
Kalvetua had fallen, only occasionally responding to believers. The Hermit was looking at Mr. Fool. Audrey's eyes lit up, and she couldn't help but make a guess: Could it be that Mr. Fool is now responding to believers in place of Kalvetua? Does The Hermit know something, which is why she's reacting like this?
Alger had actually guessed this as well. He brought up this matter mainly to see "The Hermit's" reaction.
Because there were rumors that "Admiral of Stars" had close ties with the "Moses Ascetic Order," and Laticia was a member of the "Moses Ascetic Order," Alger was taking the opportunity to test "The Hermit."
Unexpectedly, he discovered that "The Hermit" was looking at Mr. Fool. Only then did Alger realize that "The Hermit" probably knew the inside story as well.
As for Fors and Emlyn, they were purely listening to the story. Little Sun didn't pay much attention to it either.
Alger, Audrey, and Hobert, along with a few other members, either had some guesses, wanted to verify something, or were pretending to be ignorant while actually understanding, all looked towards Mr. Fool.
Mr. Fool, who was obscured by the gray fog, didn't seem to take it seriously and leisurely said, "Kalvetua relied on the relic of 'Calamity' Cohinem to become a demigod."
Fors, who noticed that the atmosphere was a bit strange, finally understood: So they were asking Mr. Fool about the 'Sea God.'
Cattleya, Alger, and Audrey had already understood Mr. Fool's implied meaning and could confirm that the "Sea God" currently responding to believers was Mr. Fool!
Cattleya realized that this might be a game between gods.
Alger then began to use his excellent ability to overthink, believing that Mr. Fool was seizing the authority of these wild gods to strengthen himself and escape his predicament faster. At the same time, he recalled that he had just talked about Cohinem with "The Emperor" last week. Unexpectedly, he encountered further clues this week.
Audrey was simply happy that Mr. Fool and the Tarot Club were becoming stronger.
Hobert simply said, "Congratulations, Mr. Fool! I think that if we encounter disasters at sea in the future, we can pray to Mr. Fool."
Klein nodded slightly, without making a specific response.
Emlyn was stunned: What's going on? Did Mr. Fool obtain Kalvetua's authority? I, I was clearly listening attentively just now, but why did I seem to miss some important information?
Fors had similar thoughts and sighed: How did they guess it? Why didn't I realize this at all?
At this moment, "The World" suddenly said, "Respected Mr. Fool, I would like to have a private exchange with 'The Emperor' and 'The Hermit.'"
Klein pretended to nod and established a space for the three of them to communicate.
"The World" said, "I have a stomach sac with Kalvetua's spiritual residue for sale."
He believed that the target customers for these things were only "The Emperor" and "The Hermit," and issuing this transaction would undoubtedly expose his identity as a servant of Mr. Fool.
Klein had been creating this identity for "The World" for some time, and "The Hanged Man" already knew this through the joint hunting of the "Admiral of Blood's" first mate last week.
Since Klein planned to take "Admiral of Stars's" ship to find the mermaids, he had no intention of hiding it from her.
As for "The Emperor," Klein estimated that Hobert had already guessed it.
Cattleya was slightly stunned and then understood the deep meaning behind it.
Hobert pretended to be profound and said, "You...so you're saying..."
"The World" said in a hoarse voice, "That's right, I played a role in seizing Kalvetua's authority."
Hobert smiled. "You remind me of a friend who went to sea."
Then he said, "I'll offer 2,000 pounds! Because I'm not sure how useful it is."
Cattleya, as if reminding Hobert, was also expressing her own opinion: "These things are almost useless except for use in certain evil rituals."
Hobert smiled slightly. "I know, but I may have some other uses for it."
For example, to test whether he could create an "Order Sea Serpent," or, if that didn't work, he could create talismans with spiritual imprints as a demigod-level spiritual attack method.
"The World" then said, "I also have three Beyonder characteristics of the 'Sailor' pathway, but they have spiritual residue, and they gnawed on Kalvetua's corpse before the Beyonder characteristics were extracted, so they were affected by Kalvetua and have a bluish-green color, making them impossible to consume normally."
Hobert was stunned. This is my...is the specialty of the "Creator": "What sequences do they correspond to?"
"Two Sequence 6 and one Sequence 7."
Hobert looked a little embarrassed and said, "How about this, I'll first buy that Sequence 7 characteristic for 1,500 pounds to see if it's useful. If it's useful, I'll take the other two.
How about 3,500 pounds for each of the other two? Even if they're useful, they can only be used as one Sequence 6 Beyonder characteristic, and I have to pay a corresponding price to remove its spiritual residue.
Even if the stomach sac and Beyonder characteristics I buy are useless, I won't return them to you."
The price he had to pay, for example, was three minutes of time and 1% of his spirituality.
Although this price was a bit lower than Klein's expected price, the Beyonder characteristics of the "Sailor" pathway were also quite popular, especially at sea. Selling a Sequence 6 for 5,000 pounds was like playing around!
However, Klein noticed that "The Hermit" frowned throughout, which made him realize that only "The Emperor" would buy similar items.
So, after showing some hesitation, he said, "Deal."
Cattleya really wanted to remind "The Emperor" again that even if the spiritual residue was removed, it was likely that it could not be used as an Beyonder characteristic: Didn't "The Emperor" even know this knowledge? Or did he really have some method I didn't know that could reuse these Beyonder characteristics and spiritual residue?
This made her somewhat doubt the authenticity of the Second Epoch intelligence she had just traded for.
After all, Cattleya was already a very powerful figure in the Beyonder world, especially in the field of mysticism, so she habitually suspected "The Emperor" first, rather than questioning herself.
It's just that she didn't make a reminder this time, because she had already made a reminder once, but "The Emperor" didn't seem to take it seriously.
This transaction ended, and "The Fool" lifted the state of private communication.
"The World" then said to "The Emperor," "I would like to know some of the history of the four empires during the Fourth Epoch, preferably in more depth, such as the attitudes of the six gods towards the four empires at that time."
The reason Klein wanted to understand these things was because in the diary he saw today, Roselle mentioned some secrets of the Solomon Empire, which made him realize that the Solomon Empire at that time was actually a vassal of the True Creator's Church.
Previously, he always felt that Solomon should be equal in status to the True Creator, which made him realize that the war of the four emperors in the Fourth Epoch might only be the surface, and behind it contained the game of the gods.
Because he had just earned 3,500 pounds, and there was a high probability of earning 7,000 pounds later, Klein initiated this transaction to satisfy his curiosity.
Moreover, he deliberately mentioned this matter in front of everyone, hoping to have another crowdfunding. He knew that at least Miss Justice would definitely join the transaction.
As for the fact that he had just exposed that he was a servant of "The Fool," it was nothing to trade information with "The Emperor."
"The Hanged Man" was still a member of the Storm Church, but he was still trading information with "The Emperor," wasn't he?
"The Fool" was, after all, a god, and it was impossible to ask "The Fool" about every little thing.
Hobert pondered for a moment: "5,000 pounds! Because some information is interlinked, and mentioning one point may lead to a lot of related information.
Also, one empire must be taken as the focus of the transaction, and I will only mention the other three empires when necessary."
"The World" nodded: "Okay, as the initiator of this transaction, I am willing to pay 1,500 pounds. Is there anyone willing to join this transaction?"
"Me!" Audrey raised her hand first: "I'll pay 1,500 pounds."
This way, she could get multiple opportunities to ask questions.
Alger, who had effortlessly earned more than 1,400 pounds last week by helping Hobert collect the bounty, was willing to pay 500 pounds without pressure.
Emlyn, who had saved 2,000 pounds in the previous intelligence transaction, followed up without hesitation.
Fors and Derrick, as usual, were willing to pay 500 pounds each, and one was willing to add two Beyonder materials to the transaction.
Cattleya didn't want to make herself too special, so she also paid 500 pounds to join the transaction.
This turned the reward for this transaction into 5,000 pounds plus two Beyonder materials.
Hobert said to "The World," "As the initiator, please highlight a key point."
Klein had already had an idea, and he manipulated "The World" to say, "The Solomon Empire!"
"Okay, let's start with the founding of the Solomon Empire." Hobert said, "I have previously announced some information that the state religion of the Solomon Empire was the True Creator's Church..."
Emlyn thought he had misheard: Isn't the True Creator an evil god? Did He ever have a church?
But seeing that everyone didn't have surprised expressions, he was too embarrassed to ask.
Cattleya was also hearing it for the first time that the True Creator had a church and had even been a state religion: "The Emperor's" intelligence was always so unbelievable, even absurd, but these intelligences didn't seem to be fabricated, because fabricating this level of intelligence required a lot of high-end knowledge. And if "The Emperor" knew these high-end knowledge, he would probably know the truth of these histories.
The other members didn't feel surprised because they already knew this.
Hobert continued, "...In fact, it wasn't made too clear at the time. About 100 years after the Great Cataclysm, Solomon, with the support of the 'True Creator' and the 'Rose Redemption,' became the 'Black Emperor'..."
"Please wait a moment." Cattleya couldn't help but interrupt, "May I ask what the 'Rose Redemption' is...?"
The considerate Audrey said, "Ms. Hermit, I can answer this question for you, so you can save your opportunity to ask a question and ask a question that you want to get the answer to more."
Seeing that "The Emperor" had no objection, Cattleya smiled and said, "You are truly a considerate lady, thank you for your answer."
Audrey said politely before saying, "According to some information announced by Mr. Emperor, the 'Rose Redemption' is an organization loyal to the 'True Creator.'"
Cattleya guessed as a matter of course: "Similar to the Aurora Order?"
"No, much higher-end than that. According to Mr. Emperor, at least two Kings of Angels are members of the 'Rose Redemption.'"
"Sorry, what does King of Angels mean?" Cattleya hadn't felt so ignorant for a long, long time. She even began to seriously doubt whether her knowledge reserves really qualified her to participate in the Tarot Club?
Audrey explained patiently: "That was the intelligence we obtained in a previous transaction with Mr. Emperor. There are a total of eight Kings of Angels. If you are interested in the specific intelligence, you can initiate a transaction with Mr. Emperor."
She said with a sense of accomplishment: "The members of the 'Rose Redemption' that we know are 'Angel of Fate' Ouroboros and 'Red Angel' Medici.
After Medici fell, Ouroboros is the actual leader of the 'Rose Redemption.'"
Looking at Cattleya, who was still somewhat puzzled and at a loss, Alger smiled and thought: So what if she's a pirate admiral? Isn't she still so ignorant!
Ever since the beginning of this gathering, Alger felt as if he had been overshadowed by "The Hermit." Now he finally breathed a sigh of relief, as if he had regained his confidence.
Because Cattleya hadn't heard Little Sun's "stuck in a loop" description, she still didn't fully understand the nature of the "Rose Redemption," but it didn't affect her understanding of the meaning of the "Rose Redemption."
She said to "The Emperor," "Please continue."
At this time, "The World" suddenly asked, "In other words, the True Creator supported Solomon to become the Black Emperor, rather than Solomon supporting the True Creator's Church to become the state religion, right?"
Hobert nodded slightly: "That's right. Theoretically speaking, the True Creator and Solomon have a relatively strong sense of mutual trust and are a relatively solid alliance camp."
Alger was the first to understand the meaning of this question and answer: In other words, Solomon is more like the True Creator's spokesperson in the secular world? Or is there a not-so-obvious superior-subordinate relationship between them!
Cattleya's thinking was very clear when it came to her own area of expertise: Similar to the present, secular regimes are largely limited by the power of the church.
The others also understood the meaning of "The World" and "The Emperor" one after another.
Fors thought: This once again subverts my understanding. I have always thought that the protagonist of the Fourth Epoch was the "Four Emperors," but it seems that it is not.
"Little Sun" was thinking: When the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God" is watching this land, I wonder if anyone is helping Him manage these secular affairs?
Emlyn was thinking: I really want to trade information about the Trunsoest Empire with "The Emperor." I wonder what role our vampires played in that empire?
Hobert then said, "I have also previously announced the angel families who were loyal to Solomon. Even now, those families are still playing a significant role in the Beyonder world.
Everyone can't help but ask, why did the Solomon Empire, which had two true gods and so many angels supporting it, perish?"
Cattleya struggled to resist the urge to ask questions. She had heard of the term "angel family" and knew of a few, but whether those families had sworn allegiance to Solomon was beyond her knowledge.
Hobert answered his own question: "Because the enemies of the Solomon Empire were the Six Gods! That's the six gods excluding the God of Steam and Machinery!
"The Six Gods first disintegrated the Solomon Empire from within, creating conflict between the angel families. Then, they promised benefits to the Tudor and Trunsoest families, first causing Solomon to fall, and then driving the True Creator back to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'!"
The surprise in Cattleya's heart was beyond words: The Six Gods had once joined forces to deal with the same enemy?
