chapters.title: Chapter 472 - 472 A Brief History of the First Solomon Empire (Bonus 12)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Taichi kaedahara for becoming a free member]
Hobert was merely reviewing previously released information, but Cattleya and Emlyn felt their money was well spent and were amazed by the details they rarely had the chance to hear.
Cattleya was slightly better, quickly thinking: "Please, please wait a moment. Are you saying that Tudor and Trunsoest also once served Solomon? They, they were the Tudor and Trunsoest who later became the Blood Emperor and Night Emperor respectively?"
"Hermit" Cattleya knew the titles and real names of the Four Emperors through her own channels and research, which was enough to prove that her knowledge accumulation was extensive compared to ordinary Beyonders.
After all, even professors who specialize in these historical studies do not have such a wealth of knowledge.
But even with so much accumulation, Cattleya now felt it was not enough.
Emlyn felt his mind was a bit overwhelmed, chewing on the information released by "Emperor," not even having the energy to ask questions.
Although the other members knew this before, it was the first time they had heard the details of the Solomon Empire's demise, so they listened particularly carefully and had their own thoughts.
Klein behind the gray fog: As expected, the best way to disintegrate the enemy is to start from within!
Alger thought: What benefits did the Six Gods give Tudor and Trunsoest? Could it be helping them establish their respective empires?
Audrey: We should have driven the True Creator back long ago!
Fors was already certain: The emperor of the Solomon Empire was always one person! Or rather, a god!
"Little Sun" was a bit confused again: According to Mr. Emperor and the others, the Seven Gods, no, the Six Gods are the orthodox gods, constantly fighting against evil gods and evil organizations. But if this is the case, why would the Six Gods tolerate the True Creator becoming the state religion?
This time Audrey was too embarrassed to answer Ms. Hermit's question again, so Hobert replied, "They are the Blood Emperor and Night Emperor who came after."
Cattleya then asked, "Then what benefits did the Six Gods promise them? To make them betray Solomon?"
Klein and Alger couldn't help but shift in their seats, as this was also what they wanted to know.
Reminded by Cattleya, Audrey realized that Hobert had not released information on this aspect before.
Fors immediately understood: This is the focus of the description just now. Hehe, I almost missed it again.
"In theory, you only have one chance to ask a question," Hobert said with a smile, "but I can answer your question as a welcome to the new member."
Emlyn was slightly stunned. Why did this sound so familiar?
Cattleya smiled and said, "Thank you."
Hobert explained: "Tudor and Trunsoest were initially both 'Lawyer' pathway Beyonders, that is, Beyonders of the 'Black Emperor' pathway."
"The Six Gods promised that after the fall of Solomon, each of them would receive a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic from the Black Emperor."
Klein: So that's how it is. This is indeed a sufficient motivation! But it seems that neither of these two people became true gods of the "Black Emperor" pathway later.
Alger nodded slightly: That's right, becoming Sequence 1 is a sufficient temptation.
Cattleya frowned and thought for a while before saying, "Sorry, I'm not questioning your information, but according to reliable information I received, the Night Emperor is a true god of the 'Justiciar' pathway."
"I don't know what pathway the Blood Emperor is a true god of, but it must not be the 'Black Emperor' pathway."
"The Night Emperor's situation still jumped to an adjacent pathway, but what about the Blood Emperor?"
Hobert smiled and said, "Want to know?"
Cattleya nodded reflexively.
"Detailed information about the Blood Emperor is also worth 5,000 pounds."
Klein behind the gray fog couldn't help but smile: The same means, the same rhetoric, I just don't know if Ms. Hermit will fall for it.
Alger took a deep breath: "Hermit" knows a lot about the history of the Fourth Epoch! If it weren't for participating in the Tarot Club, my knowledge reserve would not be even a third of hers!
Emlyn: This conversation sounds even more familiar.
Cattleya was experienced after all and more able to remain calm. She did not agree immediately but pondered for a moment before saying, "Before answering, I must confirm that your source of information is reliable!"
"You can rest assured, it is absolutely reliable."
"How do you prove it?"
Hobert smiled: "Okay, I must admit that your aggressive method has a certain effect."
He said seriously: "Because my last name is Trunsoest, yes, the Trunsoest the Night Emperor!"
This answer not only stunned Cattleya but also surprised everyone else.
Klein crossed his arms: This kid hid it deep! "Creator", a descendant of the Night Emperor, could it be that he can become a favored one of the "Creator" because he is a descendant of the Night Emperor?
Alger: He really has a good background.
Audrey's mood was not very beautiful: How much is Hobert still hiding?
Emlyn leaned back in his chair: No wonder I have a feeling of closeness to him. It turns out that during the Fourth Epoch, our ancestors were allies. If calculated by seniority, I might be his grandfather or great-grandfather. Hehe, vampires are a race with a long lifespan.
Fors sighed in her heart: This is the first time I feel that the history of the Fourth Epoch is so close to me.
"Little Sun" was thinking: Mr. Emperor's background is similar to City of Silver's, both are very much like "historical remnants."
Hobert spread his hands and asked Cattleya, "Are you satisfied with this answer?"
He had never taken the identity of "descendant of Trunsoest" too seriously and was not afraid of exposing this layer of identity.
There are no members of the orthodox gods in the Tarot Club, Alger can only be regarded as a peripheral member of the Storm Church, and he has a two-faced heart, so there is no need to worry about them arresting him.
"Sorry!" Cattleya apologized generously: "I hope I haven't caused you any inconvenience."
This time she deeply believed in Hobert's information. She guessed that the reason why "Emperor" knew so much must be because he had read the family's classics.
Hobert smiled and said, "Just don't send me to the orthodox gods, they especially like to arrest the descendants of Trunsoest."
Audrey asked curiously, "Why do they especially like to arrest the descendants of Trunsoest?"
She thought: If you make me angry again in the future, I will report you to the Evernight Goddess Church!
But Audrey was just thinking about it, because if she really did this, it would mean that she would betray the Tarot Club, and she would not do that.
"This belongs to the secrets of the Trunsoest Empire," Hobert said, "Originally, I didn't plan to explain it to everyone, but if everyone wants to ask, it is also worth 5,000 pounds."
Klein suddenly understood: After "Justice" cracked the "Emperor's" group buying sales model with crowdfunding, he is now doing pre-sales! And this trick of playing hard to get is too obvious.
Hobert brought the conversation back to the topic: "Let us continue with the Solomon Empire's problem. Maybe everyone has doubts, why didn't the Six Gods deal with the True Creator when the True Creator and Solomon's wings were not yet full, or simply say when Solomon had not yet become a god and had not gathered so many angel families?"
"Little Sun" raised his neck, he had thought about this question just now.
The others also knew that it was time to get to the point and began to focus on "Emperor."
"What I am about to say next is one of the most important aspects of this question," Hobert said, "I only mentioned it simply before, but I said it very vaguely."
"At the beginning of the Fourth Epoch, there were considerable conflicts between the Six Gods, and one of the roots of the conflict was a serious lack of trust between them."
"As for why there was a serious lack of trust, this belongs to the historical legacy of the Third Epoch and is not within the scope of this answer."
"The second root of the conflict is the problem of adjacent pathways. Why are the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom still hostile to this day? Because they are adjacent pathways."
"Similarly, the God of Combat and the Evernight Goddess are still hostile to this day because they are also adjacent pathways!"
"And the Earth Mother and the later God of Steam and Machinery temporarily do not have enemies of adjacent pathways at the god level. Although some countries resist these two beliefs, they have never had a church that is a deadly enemy."
"Even the Church of the Earth Mother and the Church of Knowledge and Wisdom, which previously accused each other, although their relationship is very bad, have not risen to the level of deadly enemies, precisely because the two gods are not adjacent pathways to other gods."
Fors was slightly surprised at first, and then sighed: So that's where the conflicts between churches come from! This is the true appearance of the extraordinary world! Before this, I only saw the appearance of this world.
Emlyn also had a similar idea, although he still didn't quite understand what "adjacent pathways" meant.
At this time, "World" suddenly asked in a hoarse voice, "I have a question about adjacent pathways. For example, the Storm Church has conflicts with the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, which is understandable because the pathways of both sides can be exchanged."
"If you switch to the other party's pathway, it is equivalent to compressing the other party's 'potion space'."
"But at the level of true gods, they have already become gods, is there still any meaning in exchanging? Why is there still such a fierce conflict?"
"Or is it that the churches of both sides have accumulated enough hatred to deepen the conflict between the gods, so that they become hostile?"
Alger, Audrey, and other members who were familiar with the knowledge of "pathway exchange" were slightly stunned. They had all thought about this question to varying degrees before, but they realized after being reminded by "World" that this should also be a very critical question.
Hobert smiled and said, "Mr. World's ability to discover this problem proves that his thinking is very sharp."
"As everyone thought, this is a very critical issue and the greatest contribution of the Ancient Sun God to the world."
"But I can't tell you now. I will tell you if other questions are involved, but I can't say it in detail, I can only say an approximate, because its value is too high."
"If any member becomes a Sequence 2 angel and still wants to attack the godhood, I can tell him the details for free."
Klein's eyes behind the gray fog narrowed: The greatest contribution of the Ancient Sun God to the world?
"Little Sun" also wanted to know: What exactly is this contribution?
Then everyone almost simultaneously realized that this question was already at a level that angels below Sequence 2 were not qualified to know.
But...
Everyone looked at "Emperor": Why do you know again?
Hobert seemed to see everyone's thoughts and smiled: "My situation is special."
"Let us continue to return to the topic of the Six Gods just now. I said before that the Six Gods joined forces because they could not stand the doctrines of the True Creator Church."
"I must admit that this reason is the most insignificant factor for the Six Gods, or rather this is just a reason that can become a league slogan and does not explain anything."
"In fact, the main reason is that the rapid expansion of the power of the True Creator and the Solomon Empire camp made the Six Gods feel threatened."
"Especially the angel families who nominally served Solomon and had close ties with the True Creator."
"For example, there are Adam and Amon among them, Kings of Angels who are only one step away from the true god, because they are born with uniqueness, so they are fully capable of fighting a true god. Although they can't win, they are also difficult to be killed by a true god."
"There are also many angels who have the hope of becoming gods, such as 'Door', who is only one ritual away from the godhood, and Medici also has the hope of becoming a god, and even Antigonus seems to have the hope of becoming a god on the surface, but he will always be a little short."
"If one or two of them become gods, the True Creator camp will have enough strength to hunt any god, and at the same time have the strength to temporarily block the support between the Six Gods."
This was exactly the answer that Klein was very hoping to get. He took a deep breath: As expected, the game behind some seemingly complex problems is not that complicated.
Audrey remembered a famous saying from the Hall family: What often unites oneself and the enemy is a more powerful enemy.
Cattleya sighed: The records of the Trunsoest family are too detailed! In some documents I read, when encountering similar problems, there would only be one or two ambiguous descriptions, and the rest would rely on my own guesses to supplement.
Fors and other members had already entered the "storytelling" session and would sigh in their hearts: The real history is more exciting than the story.
Everyone quietly listened to Hobert continue: "The first to feel threatened were the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, because the True Creator is also an adjacent pathway to them."
"Therefore, the three gods with the deepest contradictions temporarily put aside their hatred and aimed their spearheads at the True Creator together…"
Alger suddenly said: "Sorry, Mr. Emperor, to interrupt you."
"We discussed the ability of 'Shepherd' before, so can a 'Shepherd' at the true god level, can, can…"
He took a deep breath before saying: "…can he Graze other gods?"
Cattleya suddenly felt a chill down her spine: This, this question is too blasphemous to the gods!
Emlyn almost got up: Pour holy water on him! Soak him in a water tank full of holy water! Or pierce his heart with a wooden stake, hang him up! How dare the 'Hanged Man' have such thoughts?
Fors only showed a brief moment of surprise but quickly calmed down; she was almost used to such remarks.
Derrick looked towards Mr. Emperor, as, with the existence of the "Shepherd" elder, he also wanted to know the answer.
Audrey and Klein were already used to it; even "The Fool" didn't think these were shocking words and was still marveling at "The Hanged Man's" novel idea.
In fact, some information Klein had seen in Roselle's diary this week had already given him a vague answer. Roselle had mentioned that the members of the "Twilight Hermit Order" were full of hostility towards the Solomon Empire and the True Creator. The reason was that some members suspected that the True Creator had the ability to shepherd gods, which was the greatest blasphemy against gods.
Now, after listening to Hobert's description, Klein thought that perhaps blaspheming the gods was secondary. The most fundamental reason was that the True Creator and those members were of adjacent pathways.
Klein remembered that Roselle had described in his previous diary that the main members of the "Twilight Hermit Order" were of the "Sailor," "Singer," and "Reader" pathways.
The corresponding true gods of these three pathways were the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom! This perfectly matched the "Emperor's" description.
Thinking of this, Klein immediately focused his attention and looked at the "Emperor," waiting for his answer.
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying, "I'm not familiar with the True Creator, so the following are all my guesses.
"Theoretically, it is possible to Graze gods, but there must be many limitations, and it should even have a significant negative impact on oneself. After all, the spiritual imprint of a god is not as easy to remove as that of an ordinary Beyonder.
"Otherwise, the True Creator could just kill all his powerful subordinates and then Graze them. This way, the True Creator would become incredibly powerful and effectively avoid being betrayed by his subordinates.
"But the True Creator hasn't done this, which shows that the negative impact of Grazing gods must be very large, so large that the True Creator doesn't dare to do it easily.
"In the future, if you become enemies with some demigods, you will understand how powerful the spiritual imprint of a god is through the spiritual imprint at the demigod level.
"According to my guess, if you don't break up the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of a fallen god but choose to Graze Him, then the Grazed god should be easy to revive.
"And the revived god must be the True Creator's mortal enemy!"
Cattleya nodded slightly: This guess is well-reasoned. It is a rational analysis made by the "Emperor" based on the few existing pieces of information and his own knowledge. In this regard, the "Emperor's" own profound knowledge is beyond my imagination.
Alger frowned: In other words, the True Creator's motive for attacking other gods is not to Graze them!
Based on what he had seen in Roselle's diary, Klein already had some guesses: Perhaps there is a way to allow gods to obtain enough benefits or power from gods of adjacent pathways!
At the same time, he thought of Kalvetua's spiritual imprint. Just as the "Emperor" said, the spiritual imprint of a demigod is already like this, let alone that of a god.
The other members vaguely thought of something, but they couldn't form a coherent idea. They could only clarify one thing for themselves: Gods of adjacent pathways are mortal enemies, and they will eliminate each other if they have the opportunity.
Hobert said helplessly, "I told you, the information about the deeper levels of the Four Emperors will inevitably draw out a lot of other information, like this question.
"We have deviated from the topic several times. Let us return to the topic again."
The other members all smiled slightly, feeling that the information they had heard before was completely worth the price.
"I just said that the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, because they are adjacent pathways to the True Creator, they put aside their conflicts and jointly aimed their spearhead at the True Creator," Hobert said:
"And at this time, the Solomon camp made a huge strategic error. In order to contain the Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat, they allowed the 'Underworld Emperor' to unify the Southern Continent and establish the Balam Kingdom.
"The reason why it is said to be a strategic error is because, in my opinion, the Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat are actually allies that the True Creator can win over, and all six gods should not be pushed to their opposing camp.
"Although this is a strategic error, I feel that the True Creator's choice cannot be evaluated because he has suffered a profound betrayal and may have lost trust in the Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat.
"In addition, the influence of the 'Secret Supplicant' pathway on the True Creator may make his state sometimes not very good, or he may associate other gods with the most depraved and darkest aspects."
Before everyone could ask questions, Hobert said first, "I can only say this much about this question for the time being, which involves another very valuable piece of information.
"With the addition of the Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat, the six gods have basically unified their front.
"The Earth Mother, between the True Creator's camp and the other five gods' camp, is more inclined to help the God of Combat.
"Thus, the six-god alliance was formed and began to jointly fight against the True Creator.
"The above are the main reasons for the formation of the six-god alliance, and there is also a secondary reason: to seize believers from the True Creator and the Solomon Empire.
"As for the role of believers, it is also another question."
After Hobert finished speaking, the hall was quiet for a while, and everyone was digesting the information just now.
Klein, who had just begun to play the role of the Sea God, thought: I had already noticed in the previous acting that there was a subtle connection between believers and gods. The "Emperor's" last few words were equivalent to proving my feelings from the side.
Cattleya put her hands on the bronze long table: So the hostility and alliance between the gods are also because of such simple interests! Hehe, what am I thinking? Such an idea is too blasphemous to the gods!
Alger pinched his chin: In other words, the orthodox gods' churches develop believers, in addition to constantly obtaining financial and manpower contributions, are there other reasons?
Audrey sighed: As expected, it is a 5,000-pound level intelligence, with very high integrity.
Fors sighed: I seem to have heard a "Brief History of the Fourth Epoch," no, it is a "Brief History of the Beyonder World of the Fourth Epoch."
"Little Sun" was a little disappointed: So the gods are not fighting against the evil gods for justice and kindness to the people.
After a fierce ideological struggle, Emlyn had to admit: The history of the extraordinary world of the Fourth Epoch is as tortuous and intriguing as the history of the vampires.
Hobert gave everyone enough reaction time and then said to everyone, "The Solomon First Empire probably perished like this.
"Let's talk about the Solomon Second Empire!"
Everyone looked at the "Emperor" with excitement or smiles. In fact, the previous information had already satisfied them very much. They did not expect to hear about the Solomon Second Empire.
Hobert said, "When the Solomon Empire perished, Solomon also fell.
"But because of the special nature of His pathway, He was resurrected after a period of time, and then established the Solomon Second Empire!"
"Hermit" Cattleya almost jumped out of her chair: The two Solomon Empires were actually established by the same person!

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 473 The various parties of the Tarot Club (Bonus 13)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Powerstone 100]
Hobert's words were like a heavy bomb dropped on the bronze table.
Alger immediately realized: this is confidential information about the level of the gods, or rather, about the specific abilities of the gods. I have only seen such related descriptions in the confidential version of "The Book of Storms", but there are exaggerations and embellishments in it, making it difficult to distinguish which are the true abilities of the gods. The description of "Emperor" is much more direct, directly stating that the "Black Emperor" can have at least one resurrection ability.
After being surprised, Klein immediately associated it with his own resurrection experience: The ability of the "Black Emperor" pathway is a bit like the ability of the "Seer" pathway! No, it's just that the results are a bit similar, but the feeling is completely different. Roselle's diary described Zaratul's description of the "Miracle Invoker" of the "Seer" pathway. Resurrection is a miracle! These two pathways feel different.
Cattleya leaned back in her chair: What kind of gathering have I joined? Why does "Emperor" have such a deep understanding of the "Black Emperor"? His code name is "Emperor", could it be that he is a Beyonder of the "Black Emperor" pathway? Even so, it doesn't explain why he knows some secrets of the true god of this pathway. Could it be that even these descriptions are in the classics of the Trunsoest family? That's too messy. "Emperor" is even more messy, actually announcing this information like this.
Then she thought for a while before realizing that "Emperor" only said the result, but did not mention the details of the resurrection. She also thought of some words and deeds about the "Queen Mystic": This makes sense, yes, many things make sense. It turns out she has been looking for the Great Emperor, because the Great Emperor also has the ability to resurrect!
Audrey quickly returned to her audience state: "Mr. Emperor, how did Solomon resurrect? Why can he still resurrect?"
Hobert smiled and said: "This involves a big secret about my own pathway and the 'Creator'. Unless it is absolutely necessary, I will not announce the details of this information."
Cattleya nodded: Sure enough, "Emperor" will only tell us the result... Wait, "Creator"? What does this have to do with the "Creator"? Is it the "Creator" who severely damaged the "Rose School" in the Southern Continent before?
She paid attention to the reactions of the other members, and found that, except for herself, the other members did not react much: "Emperor" has something to do with the "Creator"? Everyone knows this! If they didn't know about the "Creator", someone would definitely ask. "Emperor's" identity is very complicated!
Audrey nodded after hearing this answer: "I understand."
The others also chose to understand and did not continue to ask, but everyone inevitably had their own associations.
Klein and Alger realized that at the level of gods, there must be many incredible abilities.
Cattleya was still considering the connection between the "Creator" and the "Emperor".
"Little Sun" and Emlyn couldn't help but imagine, I wonder if the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God" and the "Sanguine Ancestor" have similar abilities?
Fors lamented: I am still a Sequence 8, and I actually know so much about the abilities of the gods! But such high-end information is like being addictive, the more you listen, the more you want to listen.
While everyone had their own thoughts, Hobert said again: "After Solomon's resurrection, the North and South Continents entered the 'Era of the Four Emperors', but soon, Solomon fell again.
"I think this should not be difficult to understand. Although the True Creator was driven back to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods', He was, after all, once the emperor of the six gods' opposing camp. The six gods will of course support other emperors to make Solomon fall again.
"As for another reason why the Solomon Empire was the first to perish, I think everyone also noticed when trading information about the angel families that among the angel families loyal to the Solomon Second Empire, only the Zoroast and Zaratul families were left. The high-end combat power of the Second Empire is far inferior to other empires."
Hobert spread his hands: "This is all the information I know about the Solomon Empire. I also know a lot about the history of the Tudor Empire and the Trunsoest Empire.
"As for the information about the Underworld Emperor, we have already traded the impact of his fall, but his related information is still worth 5,000 pounds, because the detailed information about him involves an important concept again."
Audrey was already eager to try, but seeing that everyone was still savoring the information just now, and obviously had no intention of initiating a new transaction, it was difficult to complete the crowdfunding again, so she had to give up for the time being.
After this round of transactions, there was a moment of silence in the hall, and Cattleya also participated in the free exchange session: "I heard a piece of news that the first mate of the 'Admiral of Blood' was hunted in Bayam, while the third mate and the captain of the third ship of the 'Admiral of Blood' were hunted on the 'Flesh Tree' ship.
"It seems that someone is targeting the 'Admiral of Blood'."
Alger, who was sitting opposite her, thought to himself: I know this too well. I played a significant role in the Bayam operation, and I helped collect the bounty for the third mate Kralin and the captain of the third ship, Byrd...
Suddenly, Alger suddenly thought: This, could this be a joint operation between Mr. Fool's attendant and the "Creator's" attendant? The purpose is to hunt the "Admiral of Blood"? Why am I only thinking of this now?
Hobert and Klein just felt a little proud in their hearts, but they didn't have any other reaction, as if this matter had nothing to do with them.
Audrey saw the abnormality of the "Hanged Man". She didn't understand why the other party had such a violent reaction, but she didn't directly ask the "Hanged Man", but turned her head and looked at the "Hermit" and said: "Ms. Hermit, why do you have such a guess?"
"This is obviously a premeditated action." Cattleya talked about the widespread speculation on the sea now: "Especially the battle that took place on the 'Flesh Tree', which is enough to show the other party's targeted nature.
"And after killing someone on the flagship of a 'Pirate Admiral', they can still leave calmly, which is enough to prove that the other party has a deep background.
"Such a background is fully capable of organizing other members to launch a hunt in Bayam the next day."
Audrey nodded and looked at the opposite side and asked: "Mr. Hanged Man, have you heard of this?"
Alger smiled bitterly and was about to look at the "Emperor" and "World" at the bottom, but Hobert took the lead and said: "I hunted the third mate and the captain of the third ship of the 'Admiral of Blood'."
There was nothing to hide, and Hobert also wanted to show off.
This surprised Audrey a little: "Why?"
Cattleya was also surprised. She originally wanted to use this news to test the "Hanged Man" who seemed to be a member of the Storm Church, but she didn't expect to solve the case directly.
She realized: "Emperor" is very strong! I am not sure that I can kill someone on the "Flesh Tree" and still get away unscathed. Of course, it cannot be ruled out that there are other helpers, but listening to "Emperor's" tone, it seems that he completed the action alone.
Hobert replied: "Because the 'Admiral of Blood' belongs to the 'Rose School'."
Audrey nodded: "I see."
The others also understood, which made sense.
Only Cattleya was still guessing: Because the "Admiral of Blood" is a member of the "Rose School", a targeted attack was launched? This reminds me again of the "Creator" who had conflicts with the "Rose School". "Emperor" must have a close connection with the "Creator".
Audrey asked again: "Then was the hunt in Bayam planned by you?"
"That was a coincidence." Hobert smiled and said: "But I can probably guess who did it now."
As he spoke, he glanced at "World".
"World" also generously admitted: "That's right, I did it, and the reason is also because the other party is a force of the 'Rose School'!"
When Klein heard "Emperor" say "This reminds me of a friend who went to sea" during the transaction, he knew that the other party should have some guesses about "World's" identity through some details.
And this kind of guess was exactly what Klein wanted to create for other members, so he simply admitted it generously.
Alger: Are you still saying that you didn't plan it? With your interaction, it is impossible not to have planned it!
Cattleya asked: "Then do you have any further actions next?"
Hobert said: "It depends on the situation."
Because Klein already had a cooperative agreement with "Vice Admiral Iceberg", he didn't express anything at this time.
Cattleya nodded and said nothing more.
At this time, "World" coughed, pulling everyone's thoughts back.
Then, with the help of "Fool", "World" manifested a portrait and showed it to the left and right: "Does anyone know her?"
The portrait is of a beautiful lady with a hint of handsomeness, with striking red hair.
Cattleya said: "'Red-Haired Irene' has the blood of the Intis Sorren family, a fallen noble lady.
"She used to be a sea merchant, but later she was said to have been captured by 'Disease Maiden' Tracey."
"World" thanked her, and Klein had some thoughts.
And Hobert had more ideas: Is Klein's "cross-dressing show" coming?
As the discussion of this question ended, Audrey popularized the transaction method unique to the Tarot Club's sacrifices and bestowments to the new members, and this week's Tarot Gathering also came to an end.
...
Berserk Sea, on the "Future" ship.
Returning to reality, "Admiral of Stars" Cattleya looked at the furnishings on the desk, but her thoughts were reminiscing about what happened at the Tarot Gathering just now.
The "Emperor's" speech still shocked her. She had never encountered such a situation: a secret history would be so systematically presented in front of her.
This made her determined that at the next week's Tarot Gathering, she would trade information about the Tudor Empire with the "Emperor".
She has always liked to pursue this kind of secret history.
Then Cattleya thought of the "Emperor's" background and the possible connection between him and the "Creator", which always made people feel that his identity was very complicated and that he had many secrets.
And he seemed to enjoy the process of trading these secret intelligence with everyone, which was a good sign.
At the same time, Cattleya also realized that the "Emperor's" strength was not weak, not only because he could get away from the "Flesh Tree" ship unscathed, but also from the confidence in his words and actions.
Finally, Cattleya thought of Mr. Fool who could read Roselle's diary. He was hidden in the depths of the gray fog, difficult to see clearly and difficult to speculate, and she didn't know what he was planning.
Cattleya was silent for more than ten seconds, took out paper and pen, and carefully wrote: Someone has been consciously collecting the Great Emperor's diary recently.
She thought for a while and wrote another sentence: I got a very important piece of information, the "Black Emperor" seems to have the ability to resurrect, I don't know if it's true?
After writing and folding it, Cattleya took out a delicate golden harmonica that she carried with her and blew a note.
In just the blink of an eye, the letter on the desk disappeared strangely.
Even if she wasn't wearing glasses, she couldn't detect the arrival of the messenger.
...
Bayam, "Azure Wind" Hotel.
After completing the sacrifice and bestowal, Klein returned to the real world and recalled the "Hermit's" answer at the gathering: Red-haired Irene, whose reward is as high as 1,000 pounds, is actually related to "Disease Admiral" Tracey!
Tracey took over Qilangos's fleet and changed the flagship to the "Black Death", and Qilangos captured a wealthy merchant named Jimmy Neck.
That wealthy merchant had previously obtained some ancient documents related to death, which came from the royal tombs of Bayam.
This information comes from the "Nightmare" in "Creeping Hunger", and it should be of some use to Mr. Azik. I originally planned to check it out by the way.
Suddenly, Klein thought: I can completely transform myself into "Red-Haired Irene", let Danitz send me to Tracey's subordinates, and collect the bounty by the way, and I can easily wait to see "Disease Admiral" Tracey.
This, this operation is so coquettish...
But when he thought about having to "cross-dress", Klein hesitated a little for a while and found it difficult to overcome this psychological barrier.
...
Backlund, Earl Hall's manor.
Wearing a long dress that was not very cumbersome, Audrey, who was beautiful and a little casual, looked at the scenery in the manor outside the window and thought to herself: I should, shouldn't have shown anything wrong in front of him, right?
Then Audrey smiled: It shouldn't be, I am the best at restraining my emotions... Oh no, I didn't apply for a separate exchange, congratulations to him...
She took a deep breath: Audrey, accept reality, you really don't want to see him marry someone else! But why is this happening? I originally thought that there was no emotion beyond friendship between him and me. Could it be that I misunderstood my own psychology?
Audrey shook her head gently: Audrey, you can't be like this, even if there is really an emotion beyond friendship, it is impossible between him and you! You are the daughter of Earl Hall, and he is now a baron of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
"Audrey, what are you thinking about? This is the first time I have seen you show such a complicated expression!" Susie, who was on guard outside, felt that the time was almost up, so she came in to check the situation.
Audrey smiled bitterly: What am I thinking about? Why do I think so wildly the closer his wedding date gets?
Then she adjusted her mentality and smiled at Susie: "I just, just didn't expect that I am no different from other girls."

[Powerstone 200]
Feynapotter Kingdom, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert first used the granting ritual to receive what he had gained at the Tarot Gathering.
He spent a total of 5,500 pounds at the Tarot Gathering this time, and earned 7,600 pounds in cash from two intelligence transactions, as well as 5 Beyonder ingredients. The transaction with Emlyn's Beyonder characteristics earned him 3,000 pounds.
The Little Sun's materials will still take some time to be paid for, and although Alger paid him the payment for the goods today, it will take a few days to get the "sap of the Black Mist Lord Tree".
However, with Mr. Fool as a guarantor, Hobert is not afraid that Alger will take the money and not do anything.
So this time, Hobert received 5,100 pounds in cash, an Beyonder characteristic that emitted a cyan-blue light, and a constantly wriggling sea snake face stomach pouch. Approaching the stomach pouch felt like hearing roars, and also feeling discomfort in the mental body and spirit body.
Hobert took out 100 pounds from it and put it in his wallet, and sacrificed the remaining 5,000 pounds, as well as the Beyonder characteristics and stomach pouch, to the "Nation of Disorder".
After putting the gold pounds on the stone platform specially used for holding banknotes, Hobert couldn't wait to use "Power of Disorder" to crush the Beyonder characteristics that emitted cyan-blue light.
There were indeed many spiritual remnants in the Beyonder characteristics, but for the "Creator", removing such remnants was a piece of cake!
Having rich experience, Hobert separated the Beyonder characteristics and allowed them to re-aggregate.
Even with the blessing of the "Nation of Disorder"'s level, he could only distinguish between Sequence 7, Sequence 8, and Sequence 9.
In this case, these Beyonder characteristics still cannot be used as potions. According to Hobert's spiritual sense, these three Beyonder characteristics have multiple doses.
That is to say, the split Sequence 7 is likely to be a state in which 2 or 3 Sequence 7s are mixed together. If it is taken as a potion during promotion, it is equivalent to drinking 2 potions in one go.
This is tantamount to courting death, because at the Sequence 7 level, even in good condition, taking a single potion carries a considerable risk.
And if you take 2 potions at once, there is only a very small probability of not losing control.
Even a Sequence 2 angel can only do this step. This is exactly what "Admiral of Stars" Cattleya has been wanting to remind Hobert: the re-splitting problem of Beyonder characteristics at the same sequence level.
Beyonder characteristics in this situation seem to only be used to make magical items.
But this is not difficult for the "Creator". Now Hobert's technique of separating Beyonder characteristics is so skilled that he can completely distinguish by feel what the dose of Sequence 7 is and what the dose of Sequence 8 is.
So Hobert started 'manual operation", splitting the Sequence 7 Beyonder characteristics with multiple doses by feeling, and finally actually split out 2 Sequence 7 Beyonder characteristics.
Of course, it wasn't exactly 2 copies. Hobert just felt that 3 copies were not enough, and 2 copies were a little more. The dose of each copy would be a little more than the normal Beyonder characteristics, but not less, because if it was less, the promotion might fail.
Just a little more, completely reaching the level of "safe to take".
Then Hobert split out 3 Sequence 8 and 3 Sequence 9 Beyonder characteristics. Although the entire operation took half an hour, longer than he expected,
the harvest was greater than expected. It was equivalent to spending 1,500 pounds to get 2 "Seafarer", 3 "Raging", and 3 "Sailor" Beyonder characteristics.
It can be said that he made a bloody profit with tears in his eyes.
After putting the normal Beyonder characteristics on the stone platform, Hobert took the stomach pouch with the sea snake face.
Outside, as long as you get close to the stomach pouch, you can clearly feel the discomfort from the spirit body and the mental body.
But in the "Nation of Disorder", the sea snake face was 'very honest", just moving around non-stop, but almost no hissing could be heard.
Hobert took a deep breath and did not feel any warning from his spirituality, so he tried to inject the power of the "Nation of Disorder" into the stomach pouch.
Suddenly, the power of the "Nation of Disorder" became materialized, wrapped the stomach pouch, and frantically extracted power from the surroundings.
The materialized power began to shape itself. After a while, a huge, pitch-black sea snake appeared in front of Hobert, occupying about a quarter of the space in the hall!
Its head was different from ordinary sea snakes, similar to the "Jiao" in Hobert's impression. Behind its head were some erected fleshy membranes, covered with mysterious symbols with elven characteristics.
The virtual scales also had ancient patterns with elven characteristics, giving the giant beast in front of him a mysterious and solidified feeling.
Hobert could feel that Kalvetua's spiritual remnants were vying for control of the giant snake, but they were suppressed by the level of the "Nation of Disorder", and could only be manipulated by Hobert.
Through the level of the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert learned the abilities of this giant snake.
First of all, it has the abilities of "devouring", "lightning", "storm", and "small tsunami", and at the same time, it has the abilities of "order", "distortion", and "chaos" given by the "Nation of Disorder".
In terms of overall strength, Hobert believes that it is stronger than the "Bull Devil Monarch", similar to the Black Dog Spirit Beast. If it is on the sea, it can play a greater role than the Black Dog Spirit Beast.
It's a pity that this is just a spiritual remnant, like the two horns of the Golden Horn Evil Monster. This stomach pouch has usage restrictions.
However, it can be used more times than the "Bull Devil Monarch", and can be used twelve times!
Hobert was very satisfied with this result. He only spent 2,000 pounds and happily obtained a Saint-level combat power.
Finally, of course, was the naming session. Hobert thought for a while and decided to call it "Overturning Sea Great Sage", which is "Water Devil Monarch", but "Water Devil Monarch" is a bit tongue-twisting to say, and "Overturning Sea Great Sage" sounds more high-end.
After completing this series of operations, Hobert withdrew the power of the "Nation of Disorder" and threw the stomach pouch next to the skull of the Golden Horn Evil Monster.
He returned to the real world in a good mood and continued to work on the construction site in the villa area.
...
Tuesday morning, central Southern Continent, in a luxurious villa in the suburbs of Crowlier City.
Elliot and 36 other young members of the family arrived at the villa's hall early to listen to Patriarch Lawrence reiterate the importance of their trip to the Northern Continent to study.
Then they waited for the arrival of the "Favored".
Now the Balk family has built Crowlier City into the family's second base. Patriarch Lawrence is almost permanently stationed here, and a large number of family members have come here to reintegrate into human society.
In "Nonexistent Town", there is still a demigod elder stationed there, but Patriarch Lawrence has repeatedly stated that after the negotiations with General Adrian in the south, he will send a demigod elder and no less than two Sequence 5s to join the rulers there.
At that time, only one Sequence 5 will be stationed in "Nonexistent Town".
Saying it is negotiating with General Adrian is actually negotiating with the Feynapotter people, because everyone knows that General Adrian is a puppet supported by the Feynapotter Kingdom.
After the previous battle with the "Rose School", the Feynapotter Governor took the initiative to express his willingness to accept the extraordinary power of the Balk family.
How could he not accept it? That is a local Beyonder family with angel-level combat power! General Adrian's territory is right next to General Anthony's.
Unless they want to be annexed by General Anthony, it is better to quickly contact the Balk family, cede certain power and benefits, and exchange for a compromise to maintain the current situation.
The members of the Balk family certainly know that the family can get so many benefits at once thanks to the protection of the "Creator", so all the members of the family have basically become believers of the "Creator".
At 8:58 a.m., the "Favored", wearing a black crystal mask, dressed in Loen-style clothes, and wearing a windbreaker, arrived as scheduled.
Hobert behind the mask appeared carrying a door, and after standing the door aside, he seemed to have been injected with chicken blood, hammering his chest with one hand and his back with the other, with his two arms each raised at an angle of about 45 degrees: "Praise the Creator!"
From Lawrence to ordinary family members, they also made the same movements and shouted loudly: "Praise the Creator!"
Just forty or so people shouting together was already very imposing, making the atmosphere in the hall become high-spirited!
Hobert said: "I have entrusted the matters of this study in the Northern Continent to another Blessed of the 'Creator'! You will be arranged by him to study in five factories that currently use the most advanced steam engines.
"During the study period, I require you to hide your extraordinary identity and treat yourself as an ordinary young man who loves that job!
"You must not only learn modern management methods, but also go to the workshop and operate those machines with your own hands! You are required to master them proficiently and take diligent notes!
"I don't know if Patriarch Lawrence has such a requirement, but I require you to form no less than 60,000 words of notes after the study is over.
"Even if you are recording the local customs, you must fill 60,000 words! The notes are uniformly written in Loen characters, and submitted to me uniformly after the study is over. I will hand them over to other Blessed for inspection.
"If anyone is found not to cherish this study opportunity, I will take him to an extraordinary war initiated by the Blessed in the Northern Continent! He will have to participate in at least three battles before he is allowed to come back!"
When everyone heard the "homework" assigned by the "Favored", they were still worried.
But when they heard that the Blessed in the Northern Continent was launching an extraordinary war, they immediately became excited. It turned out that the power of the "Creator" in the Northern Continent was also very strong!
Lawrence on the side realized that the "Favored" was exerting influence on the family internally on this matter.
If it were someone else, he would never allow his power to be delegated, but the "Favored" was different. Even if Lawrence realized this, he didn't say anything.
"Okay, now line up in groups of two! Be sure to pay attention when entering the spirit world later, do not look directly into the eyes of those creatures." Hobert stood up the door he carried again, and said in ancient Hermes language: "Conant!"
Opening the door, the space in the middle of the door frame became illusory. The members of the Balk family picked up their luggage and entered the space inside the door in pairs.
Elliot was in the first row. When he entered the spirit world, he was a little nervous, but soon his eyes were filled with complex information, and the few remaining nerves quickly disappeared.
After traveling in the spirit world for about three minutes, another door appeared in front of Elliot. Under the guidance of spirituality, he opened the door and came to a hall with almost no decoration.
There was also a young man wearing a "Blessed" mask waiting here. Behind the "Blessed", there were also several well-dressed young men or women.
After all 36 people arrived, Upton sighed at the power of the "Creator" in the Southern Continent. At the same time, he took off his mask and revealed his black eyes and high nose bridge: 'my name is Upton, and I am a Blessed of the 'Creator'.
"The place you are in now is an apartment in a factory. For the next month, you will live here together.
"I have prepared Loen-style clothes for you over there. Remember, do not wear Southern Continent-style clothes when you go out.
"The eight people behind me are your life teachers. You will receive a set of daily necessities from them later. They will also live here during this time. Feel free to ask them if you don't understand anything.
"I know that most of you are 'Mid Sequence' Beyonders, and there are even a few Sequence 6s, but you must obey my management after coming to Conant!
"'Favored' has given me the power to punish you. I hope this power will never be used.
"Okay, young men and women from the Balk family, welcome to Conant."
...
At this time, Hobert, carrying the door, appeared in a large warehouse in Conant.
Here is stored a large horsepower locomotive, as well as 8 passenger carriages and 3 freight carriages.
Inside the 8 passenger carriages, there are also 2 sightseeing carriages that have been modified according to Hobert's requirements.
Hobert used his own self-sacrifice method to grab the modified train into the "Nation of Disorder".
The locomotive and carriages cost Hobert a total of 2,900 pounds, mainly because the locomotive was expensive. In the early morning, when establishing the "Traveler's Door" magic circle, Hobert had already replenished the 900 pounds to Upton.
When having dinner in the evening, Hobert said to Fors: "Get up early tomorrow, I'll show you something good."
Holding a knife and fork, Fors asked curiously: "What good thing?"
"You'll know when you get up tomorrow." Hobert smiled mysteriously: "Cut the meat smaller, don't you think it's hard to eat if you cut it so big?"
Fors told Hobert the skills she had discovered: "This can save several cuts, and it can also save several times of putting it in your mouth."
"I'm also convinced by you, come, I'll help you cut it." After Hobert cut it: "Open your mouth, I'll feed you, ah~"
Donna on the side seemed to shake the goosebumps on her body: "You two are so nauseating."
Hobert smiled: "You can't forget to take care of your sister after marrying a wife, come, I'll feed you a piece too."
"Don't think I didn't see it, your saliva is on the fork, I don't want it!"
...
The next morning, Fors got up early with a yawn, wore a waist-cinching dress that was recently popular in the Feynapotter Kingdom, revealing her long legs and good figure in the upper body.
She arrived at the restaurant to find that Hobert and Donna had already eaten breakfast. She quickly checked her watch and realized it was already past eight.
Fors apologized to them, feeling embarrassed, "Recently, I've been, I've been too exhausted."
Hobert put down the blueprints in his hand and smiled, "I just love your lazy side. Wake up whenever you want in the future."
Donna sighed, "When will I ever live like this?"
Hobert pointed to the documents beside her, "You have the nerve to say that? Look at what you wrote in your weekly report! Rewrite it!"
Donna made a face, "All you know how to do is exploit your little sister."
She took back her report as she spoke.
Fors smiled, "Revise it tomorrow. Today, let's go see the good stuff your brother mentioned."
Donna giggled, 'my sister-in-law is the best. Don't worry, I'll never tell Father and Mother that you like to sleep in."
"If you don't have anything nice to say, say nothing at all," Hobert said, shaking his head helplessly. "Just praise your sister-in-law a bit in front of our parents. Besides, there's no need to say things like that out loud."
Donna made another playful face, "I'll wait for you outside."
Fors ate her breakfast and sighed, "You siblings have such a good relationship."
Hobert took a sip of tea, "Donna has been mischievous since she was little, and Father and Mother dote on her. Fortunately, she still listens to me."
Fors recalled her fragmented family, and her eating speed unconsciously slowed down.
Hobert gently pinched her cheek, "This is your home now."
Fors, with a bit of milk still on the corner of her mouth, smiled sweetly, and her gloomy mood vanished.
Hobert was about to lean in for a kiss when Donna shouted from outside, "Sister-in-law! Come and see!"
Hobert smiled helplessly and gave up.
The next second, an excited Donna rushed in, grabbing Fors's hand and pulling her outside, "Sister-in-law, come and see!"
Fors was, after all, a Sequence 8. If she didn't want to get up, even two Donnas couldn't pull her up.
However, Fors put down her food and followed Donna outside, indicating that she was willing to put aside her meal to see what had made Donna so excited.
Arriving at the entrance of the Lord's manor, they could see the entire town of Jeffery and the location of the pier from there.
At the pier, a behemoth was puffing steam. Fors thought she was still dreaming and rubbed her eyes, but she confirmed, "A train!"
She asked Hobert, who had followed them out, "Wasn't there no train yesterday? Where, where did it come from?"
Hobert looked at the crowded scene on the pier and smiled, "The railway quality inspection was just completed yesterday afternoon, and the train was transported here at night.
"You also know that time is tight, so I arranged everything tightly."
Fors took Donna's hand, "Let's go take a closer look."
The three of them quickly arrived at the pier, which was already packed. It was the first time the residents of the territory had seen a train.
Someone wondered, "I don't see any horses. How will it pull so many carriages later?"
Another person dared to explain, "They'll boil the water later and lead the horses out. In this cold weather, the horses and people pulling the carriages need to drink hot water to warm up before they have the strength to work!"
Everyone thought it made sense and waited for the water to boil together.
Then everyone began to guess how many horses it would take to pull so many carriages.
At this time, Hobert's male servant, Dennis, shouted, 'make way for the Lord! Pay respects to the Lord!"
Whoosh~
Almost immediately, everyone made way for a wide path and took off their hats, "Pay respects to the Lord!"
Now, Hobert's status in everyone's mind has already taken on a certain legendary color.
In just a few months, their lives have undergone earth-shattering changes, and all of this has been given by the Lord.
Hobert also waved to everyone and came closer to the train. He asked Corwin, who had arrived early, "How's the debugging going?"
The train driver was recruited by Corwin from other places in advance. Now this train temporarily belongs to the Lord's manor. After there are cultural tourism knights, Hobert plans to transfer it to the town government.
Corwin had just asked the train driver, "It can be started at any time."
Hobert said as he boarded the train, "Open all the doors and let everyone try the feeling of riding the train.
"From today on, the train will run around the territory twice a day. Residents of the territory can ride for free for the first three months. After three months, residents within the territory can enjoy a 30% discount on tickets with their household registration book."
"Yes!" Corwin said, "I'll find Conrad later and ask him to issue a notice."
Hobert nodded and came to the rear of the carriage, where there was a small stand-like structure with a very good view.
More than twenty minutes later, Corwin organized everyone to board the train, filling all eight passenger carriages.
Of course, not everyone could get on. Too many people came to the pier to watch the excitement, and only about one-third of them got on.
Woo~
As the whistle sounded, the train slowly started.
Many people were very surprised because they really didn't see where the horses pulling the train were. How did the train start?
At the rear of the train, Hobert pointed and introduced the current progress of the territory's construction to Fors and Donna.
With nearly a month of construction work, the building complex around the train station, that is, around the pier, has been basically completed.
Although the internal decoration has not been completed and it cannot be used immediately, the buildings with a strong Feynapotter modern style are still refreshing.
Currently, there are more than 2,000 people working on the territory's construction site at most.
In addition to the territory residents who have been mobilized to the maximum extent, there are also many young people from the surrounding area who have come to Jeffery Territory to look for opportunities.
As the train began to climb the slope, the old town of Jeffery appeared in front of everyone. The old town has undergone a lot of renovation, with unique small courtyards and inexpensive hotels.
At the same time, the residents' houses have also undergone unified and simple renovations, all of which are carried out free of charge, so everyone is more supportive.
According to Roy's statistics, the current Jeffery Town can already accommodate thousands of tourists from different levels.
The train came to the mountainside, from where you can see the still busy construction site, which is the planned new town area, more than twice the size of the old town area.
After completion, Jeffery Town will reach the scale of a small city, and it will be the only city in the South Colson Mountains.

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 475 The Treasure Rex Left for His Children
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
With one arm lightly around Fors's slender waist, Hobert pointed at the scenery before them, looking every bit like he was surveying his kingdom.
Donna also puffed up with pride. This was her brother's territory, so of course, she could share in the glory.
Fors had been either writing or busy digesting her potion lately, and she hadn't noticed the significant changes in the territory.
The appearance of the train caused the villagers to stop and watch. While marveling at the behemoth, they also discussed where the horses and donkeys pulling the train were.
After the train ascended the mountain, the scenery on both sides became rural. The weather was warming up, and everyone was preparing for planting.
The fields were filled with a hopeful atmosphere.
The full view of Full Moon Lake gradually came into the trio's sight. The shimmering waves of the lake gave the massive mountain lake a unique color.
Since the seal on the 'Fallen Mother's' contamination, the area had gradually returned to normal winter conditions, but the area around Full Moon Lake remained lush and green, showing no signs of early spring.
From above, it looked like a green jade belt wrapped around Full Moon Lake.
When the train reached the front of the highest peak, it arrived at the best viewing point.
This peak was probably the highest in the vicinity, with the uppermost part becoming steep, so the railway was built to pass in front of it.
Of course, Hobert didn't waste this mountain. In addition to setting up a station here, he also enlisted the help of several 'Planters' from the Earth Mother Church to decorate the area.
Looking down from here, one could overlook the entire town and Full Moon Lake, creating a magnificent view. In the distance were mountains, rivers, and lakes; in the middle, the hustle and bustle of human life; and closer, scenery with a rich natural character.
Below this point, roughly halfway up the mountain, was a busy construction site for a planned hotel and villa area. Five villas had already been built and were mostly finished with their interior decoration.
The architectural style of Feynapotter, combined with a large amount of grand and imposing wooden decor, formed a beautiful aesthetic that was distinct from the typical Feynapotter style.
A hardened road under construction extended from the port to the villa area.
At this time, the road was almost completed, and the newly planted flowers and plants in the villa area were growing at an unconventional speed under the care of the 'Planters' and the effect of some potions.
These flowers and plants would cover the traces of construction, truly making these five villas look like resort buildings.
On the other side of the mountain, a solitary building had been erected, which was the planned auction center. Due to the limited time, only a portion of the decoration could be completed for now.
As the train began to descend, the journey gradually came to an end.
After getting off the train, Fors exclaimed, "It feels like I've already been on a trip."
Hobert smiled and said, "In the future, this will be a tourist paradise. Right now, it's all construction sites, which spoils the atmosphere a bit, but in at most two months, with the completion of most of the projects, it will look like a scenic area should."
The three of them discussed the scenery they had just seen as they returned to the Lord's Manor.
As soon as they returned to the Lord's Manor, Fors went to try on her dress, and Donna went to rewrite her weekly report. For a moment, Hobert was left alone in the study.
He took a sip of tea, planning to rest for a bit before heading to the construction site.
Just then, he had a Blink of inspiration and saw a messenger arrive from the spirit world, placing a package on the desk.
Opening the package, Hobert guessed it was from Jessica, as it contained a rectangular and a square wooden box, as well as three weapons tied together.
Opening the letter in the package, it was indeed from Jessica.
The two wooden boxes contained Beyonder weapons made by Carrie based on the Beyonder ingredients provided by Hobert, and the three tied-together weapons were unsuccessful attempts.
Hobert opened the rectangular wooden box and saw a silver-white, sharp short sword. The square wooden box contained a steel crossbow with a faint red glow.
Looking at Jessica's letter, the short sword was made using the main ingredients for the 'Assassin' pathway provided by Hobert and had two abilities:
"The first ability is that the wielder's movements will become lighter, and they will become proficient in killing techniques."
"The second ability is that in battle, there is a 2% chance of causing the enemy to turn against their companions."
Hobert marveled, "This is a very good short sword. Even without the probability-based ability, just adding 'speed' and 'agility' would be great."
Looking at the description of the crossbow, Jessica first mentioned Carrie's attempts. The Beyonder characteristics of those Beyonder ingredients could be used normally, which meant that Hobert had made the business opportunity even bigger!
Previously, Hobert had estimated that about one Beyonder weapon could be produced for every three Beyonder ingredients, and one Beyonder weapon could be exchanged for 15 Beyonder ingredients.
Adding the material fee paid to Carrie, it was equivalent to purely earning three Beyonder weapons, with a profit margin of 60%.
This profit margin was already very considerable, but now, 15 Beyonder ingredients could theoretically produce 15 Beyonder weapons. Apart from murder and profiteering, there were few deals in the world more lucrative than this.
It didn't matter if it couldn't be mass-produced. If it could be mass-produced, Hobert would have a headache instead, because with his current abilities, it would be difficult to protect the huge profits brought by such a lucrative business.
This crossbow also had two abilities: "The first ability is that even someone who doesn't know how to use a crossbow can easily hit the enemy after getting this crossbow; someone who is skilled at using a crossbow can hit the target every time."
"The second ability is that there is a 3% chance that the arrow shot will hit the enemy's vital point."
This weapon was also very good, and Hobert planned to sell it in the near future.
The last part of the letter was Jessica's congratulations on Hobert's wedding and an explanation that these two weapons did not require any material fees and were considered her and Carrie's wedding gifts to Hobert.
That was good too. When they came to attend the wedding, he could discuss the future cooperation norms with them.
After all, they would be engaging in long-term cooperation in Beyonder weapons.
After putting away the Beyonder weapons, Hobert continued to be busy.
...
Three days before the wedding, Christian and Mona arrived in Jeffery Town with Tyron.
Hobert held a grand welcoming ceremony at the dock. Christian was the first Earl to visit this land, and the dock was naturally packed again.
To the sound of the band's music, Christian and Mona slowly walked down the ship's ladder.
Hobert and Donna stepped forward, "Father, Mother."
Fors, wearing a dark dress, said, "Uncle, Aunt."
Donna smiled, "Sister-in-law, it's time to prepare to change your address."
Fors's face turned slightly red, and under Hobert's encouraging gaze, she whispered, "Father, Mother."
Christian laughed heartily, and Mona pulled Fors over and gave her an exquisitely crafted necklace inlaid with gems.
This necklace was obviously expensive. When it was taken out of the wooden box, it had a golden and radiant feel.
Mona smiled and said, "Try it on quickly."
She had originally planned to give it to Fors at the ceremony, but when she heard that "Mother," she was so happy that she gave it early.
If Fors and Hobert were still in a contractual marriage, she would not have accepted such an expensive gift.
But now it was different. She smiled and thanked them, then wore it outside her clothes. It looked really good.
Christian wanted to walk to the Lord's Manor, and Hobert naturally stayed to accompany his father.
Mona, Fors, and others took the carriage back, with Fors in charge of entertaining them.
Along the way, many people boldly greeted Christian, and Christian responded with a smile.
This made many people sigh: the Lord's father, Earl, was as amiable as the Lord.
Christian also sighed: "The mental outlook of the residents of Jeffery Town is very good. From this point of view alone, you have been very successful as a Lord."
The two walked and stopped, and Hobert told his father about the changes he had brought to the territory and his plans for the future of Jeffery Town.
From the dock to the Lord's Manor, the two actually took two or three hours.
During this time, Christian became very talkative and spoke of many of their governing experiences in the Southern Continent.
Of course, Hobert could tell that there was some boasting involved, but it was not without its gains. The biggest gain was that the Loen soldiers had never treated the natives of the Southern Continent as human beings.
The accommodation conditions at the Lord's Manor were far inferior to the newly built villas, but Christian's family would definitely live in the Lord's Manor.
After lunch, everyone rested for a while.
Christian called Hobert to his study again, "I'll take you to a place."
Hobert was slightly stunned, "Do you want to call a carriage?"
"No need." Christian took out a pendant with a Southern Continent style and grabbed Hobert's shoulder.
A bronze door appeared in front of them. Christian reached out and pushed the door open, and the two entered the spirit world together.
Hobert knew that this was not the ability of "Travel," but rather like the way that Beyonders of the Death pathway entered the spirit world.
After a dozen seconds of spirit world travel, the surrounding scenery suddenly became rich and colorful and quickly formed the appearance of the real world.
Hobert discovered that he and Christian were deep in a mountain, with towering trees as far as the eye could see. Only in front of them was a cliff more than ten meters high.
Christian put the pendant in his hand on the stone wall.
Crack~
The stone split in the middle, forming an archway-like cave below.
Christian threw the pendant into Hobert's hand, "This is the middle section of the Barchis Mountains. No matter where you are in this world, this pendant will bring you here.
"Of course, it doesn't have the ability of 'Travel' after all. After you come, you have to find your own way back."
After speaking, Christian took the lead in entering the archway-like cave.
The Barchis Mountains are on the east side of Backlund, dividing the Backlund Plain and the Tucker Plain, and are also the last barrier in the west of Backlund.
Hobert quickly followed. The depth of the archway cave was only five or six meters, and it suddenly opened up. On one side, there were messy piles of gold and gems like piles of grain, and on the other side, there were neatly stacked pounds.
Hobert was almost blinded by the gold and gems, and for a moment he didn't know how much they were worth?
And those neatly stacked pounds, he estimated at least 150,000 to 160,000 pounds! You could really roll around on it!
Christian said, "This is the first inheritance your father Rex left you, mostly the wealth he seized in the Southern Continent, as well as the proceeds from handling spoils of war.
"There are also a few Beyonder characteristics and Sealed Artifacts on the stone platform over there, but the level is not high.
"Your father's will is: If you choose to live your life as an ordinary person, this wealth is enough for you to live like a rich man for the rest of your life.
"But if you choose to become a Beyonder, this inheritance will be inherited when you get married."
Hobert swallowed hard, "These are all mine?"
In the "Disorderly Country," he now had more than 30,000 pounds in cash, but it was far less shocking than 150,000 to 160,000 pounds stacked together.
"It's all yours!" Christian smiled, "Oh, right, there are also these two documents."
Hobert glanced at it, "This, this is actually the transfer contract of Brandon Law Firm and Aslan-Barton Law Firm?"
Christian smiled, "As you can see, these two law firms are your father's property. Your family has been accustomed to establishing law firms to digest potions since a long time ago.
"Generally speaking, 'Barbarians' and 'Bribers' can also complete digestion through the profession of lawyer. Your father just carried forward this cause.
"However, before his death, he gave most of the income of the firm to Barton and the others, so he can only get about 8,000 pounds a year from the two law firms in total.
"I have been saving the income for the past twenty-three years for you, a total of 186,000 pounds. I will give it to you together later."
Hobert said, "No, that money..."
Christian raised his hand to interrupt, "I don't lack money."
"Oh," Hobert said, and did not refuse again. He never thought that he could inherit more than 300,000 pounds of property at once.
This is equivalent to... it seems equivalent to the property inherited by Audrey! No, even more, Hobert also forgot to count those gold and gems.
Judging from this property alone, Hobert can also imagine how moist Rex and Christian lived in those years.
But what Hobert never expected was that today's surprise was not over.
Christian took out another exquisite small wooden box, "This is the second inheritance Rex left you. According to his will, you will give it to you after you become Sequence 5.
"I originally thought that you would not be able to use it until at least next year. I didn't expect you to be Sequence 5 now, so I will give it to you together."
Hobert opened the wooden box, and inside was a life-like black crystal. It seemed to be constantly twisting. Just seeing it, Hobert could hear voices full of depravity.
He immediately understood, "This is an Beyonder characteristic of 'Earl of the Fallen'!"
