chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 476 The Princess Arrives
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert held the "Earl of the Fallen"'s Beyonder characteristic with mixed feelings. He had once thought that Rex hadn't left his child much at all, and even stopped taking Rex's so-called legacy seriously.
But today was different. Rex first stunned him with gold pounds, and then actually passed on an Beyonder characteristic of Sequence 4.
Beyonder characteristics at the demigod level are already difficult to measure with money.
The reason why Hobert had been hesitant to contact Sharron and the others was because he didn't know what price to set for a demigod-level Beyonder characteristic.
If a partial potion formula is worth 10,000 pounds, then the entire potion formula is worth at least 30,000 pounds, and each main ingredient is normally worth 30,000 to 40,000 pounds.
After all, the extraordinary creatures that provide extraordinary main ingredients are more or less imbued with divinity, and it is difficult to hunt them down with just Sequence 5 without the help of other demigods.
So, selling just the Beyonder characteristic for 60,000 pounds would not be a problem at all, and even an inflated price of 80,000 pounds seemed acceptable.
But Hobert also seemed to remember that the Temperance faction wasn't doing so well financially, otherwise, they wouldn't have hired Klein as a bodyguard.
If it really cost 80,000 pounds, the deal probably wouldn't go through. But if he sold it off for 30,000 to 40,000 pounds, Hobert would feel like he was losing out.
Plus, Hobert's deal with the Sanguine meant that his financial situation was still relatively good, so he wasn't in a hurry to contact the Temperance faction.
Thinking about this deal was enough for Hobert to understand how precious a Sequence 4 Beyonder characteristic was. Even in the extraordinary world where money comes quickly, not many people can advance to Sequence 4 by buying their way up.
Even if they saved up enough money, they might not encounter the Sequence 4 Beyonder characteristic they needed in their lifetime.
The reason is simple: in the orthodox churches, accumulating enough merits can directly get you the potion. For Beyonder family members like Elliot, Beyonder characteristics are basically inherited.
Christian's situation of advancing to Sequence 4 after more than 20 years of effort is an exception, and such exceptions are rare.
This is also why there are still many wild Sequence 5s in the extraordinary world, but wild Sequence 4s are very, very rare.
Here, "wild" refers to Beyonders without even an Beyonder family background.
Originally, Hobert was planning to shatter "1-104" to advance, which actually made him feel a bit heartbroken. After all, a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact is also very precious, and it felt like both the palm and the back of his hand were flesh.
However, if he had the opportunity to advance, Hobert would not hesitate to do so, but he would feel very regretful.
Now, suddenly having a Sequence 4 Beyonder characteristic in front of him made him happier than getting those gold pounds.
Christian, who was beside him, explained, "This was a military demigod that your father hunted down before he died. He didn't have time to prepare the Sequence 3 Beyonder characteristic for you, so you'll have to find a way yourself.
"However, your father left you three clues. One is that he knows that the Tamara family has a 'Frenzied Mage,' another clue is that he knows the whereabouts of a Six-Eyed Abnormality, and the last one is that 'Five Seas King' Nast is a 'Frenzied Mage.'
"If you need it, I can help you hunt down the Tamara family's 'Frenzied Mage' or the Six-Eyed Abnormality together. The Nast option is ranked last. If he were so easy to kill, the angels of Loen or Feynapotter would have taken him down long ago."
The complete brain of a Six-Eyed Abnormality is one of the main ingredients for a "Frenzied Mage." Speaking of this, Hobert thought that he also had a clue in his hand:
The Solomon family actually has two "Raving Augurs." The other "Frenzied Mage" appeared during the Backlund smog event and was likely imprisoned in "Mist Town" along with the Black Hound spirit beast.
"If I need it, I will ask you for help." Hobert then thought, "How did Rex advance to Sequence 3? I mean, how did he complete the ritual?"
Christian smiled. "Your question has once again exceeded my expectations."
Hobert's question showed that he at least knew the ritual for advancing to "Frenzied Mage."
And on this point, Hobert didn't intend to hide it from Christian.
Christian asked back, "Have you heard of Attorney Arthur?"
"Of course I've heard of him. He's a legendary figure in the legal profession. He's in our university textbooks..." Hobert was stunned. "That's, that's Rex's other identity?"
"That's right."
Hobert recalled the ritual for advancing to "Frenzied Mage": Achieve astonishing achievements in a certain field, so that people associate the abstract concept of that field with the actual name of the advancing person. The more people who can associate the two, the greater the probability of successful advancement.
So he asked again, "Is it okay not to use your own name?"
"Yes!" Christian replied with certainty. "I remember Rex talked about this ritual. Its main function is to neutralize the damage caused by the potion's abstract modification of oneself during advancement.
"According to Rex's guess, the primary problem for the 'Lawyer' pathway at high sequences may be dealing with the relationship between the real world and abstract authority."
Hobert nodded slightly, marveling at Rex's genius. Although the authority of each pathway became abstract after Sequence 2, the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway seemed a bit different.
For example, the "Black Emperor"'s godhood ritual emphasizes the changes the "Black Emperor" brings to the rules and culture of the entire world, and it also emphasizes people's recognition of the "Black Emperor" concept.
Both of these are actually emphasizing the issue of "abstraction," and Rex was able to guess many of the key issues of high sequences without knowing the godhood ritual of the "Black Emperor" pathway. Isn't that genius?
Christian continued to explain, "Even if a pseudonym is used, as long as the operations related to the advancement ritual are closely linked to this pseudonym, the ritual can still have its effect."
Hobert nodded. "I understand."
"In addition, I want to tell you another piece of information. Rex has reserved a clue for you to become the 'Duke of Entropy,' which is also his important legacy," Christian said:
"But according to his will, I can only tell you that clue after you become a 'Frenzied Mage.'"
Hobert felt the benefits of an Beyonder family for the first time. Before, when he said he was a member of an Beyonder family, no one believed him, let alone himself.
But at this moment, he realized that the benefits of an Beyonder family are the clues or advancement methods and experiences of demigod and above Beyonder characteristics.
This is completely incomparable to wild Beyonders.
After saying these things, Christian gave Hobert a dozen seconds to digest them, and then walked out in front.
Hobert glanced at the gold and pounds again and followed closely.
"By the way." Christian, who was about to leave the cave, seemed to suddenly remember something, so he stopped. "In a while, a major event will happen in Feynapotter City.
"If you plan to continue investing in the territory, you must protect your property. We may have to abandon our current title at any time!"
Hobert was slightly surprised: Could it be that the current title and status are not what Christian really wants?
However, Christian didn't mean to elaborate, so Hobert didn't ask, because he knew that Christian wouldn't say even if he asked. He would just listen to the arrangements. Anyway, he had already planned to get on Christian's "boat" before, and there was no reason to get off halfway.
The two left the cave, and the arched stone door closed on its own.
Hobert used "Travel" to take Christian back to the lord's mansion in Jeffrey Territory. Christian took out a leather bag: "The income of the law firm over the years is all inside. I also gave you three magical items as wedding gifts.
"The leather bag is also a magical item. It is connected to a space that needs to be reinforced every two years. There is still a year and a half before the next reinforcement.
"If you don't have relevant channels, you can come to me. I have a Sealed Artifact that can do this."
Hobert nodded. "Okay."
It is estimated that Fors would be close to advancing to "Magician" by then, but of course Hobert wouldn't reveal this.
Carrying the leather bag back to his room, Hobert locked the door and opened the leather bag.
Looking inside, the leather bag seemed to be leaking, with a bottomless feeling.
Then Hobert discovered that although the mouth of the leather bag was not big, his upper body could fit into the leather bag.
He stretched in and saw that the leather bag was connected to a space the size of a basement, with a pile of gold pounds neatly stacked on one side and three small wooden boxes on the other.
As long as Hobert's hand reached into the leather bag, it could appear anywhere in this space.
Closing the leather bag, Hobert sat on the chair and calmed down. He originally thought that he should be numb after seeing so many gold pounds in the cave.
But that wasn't the case!
Hobert smiled, sacrificed the leather bag to the "Nation of Disorder," and then neatly piled the gold pounds next to the Iron Throne, lying on it comfortably and rolling around.
Awesome!
It felt like life had reached its climax!
After rolling around on it a few times, Hobert went to see the three magical items.
The negative effects of the magical items carefully selected by Christian were of course not very high.
They were magical items of the "Reader," "Hunter," and "Warrior" pathways respectively. Hobert classified and put them away, and then his eyes couldn't help but look at the gold pounds again.
Looking at them, Hobert gradually realized that this money should be used as a reserve fund, and the funds for territory construction should still be raised according to the original plan.
During this period, ships traveling from Granada Port downstream to Jeffrey Port have continued, completing the acquisition and storage of the second batch of building materials.
The acquisition of the third batch of materials has also begun. The new construction project in Jeffrey Town, which started the earliest, has already entered the second phase of construction.
The second and third batches of materials used for repairing the railway in the original list have also been acquired and used in advance. Now even the railway has been repaired.
Recently, the lord's mansion has been spending money like water. The gold Lire that Hobert had earned before has long been spent.
He asked Philip to go to a bank in another port to exchange 10,000 gold pounds for 12,000 gold Lire, which was enough for the wages of the workers and the daily expenses of the lord's mansion during this period.
This was still the financial situation of the lord's mansion when Christian was responsible for all the wedding expenses.
Even so, Hobert had to give Philip 10,000 pounds a few days ago and ask him to exchange them for gold Lire again.
Because now Hobert has gold pounds left in his hand, and the gold pounds he has worked so hard to earn recently are only about 32,000 pounds, which may be barely enough for the payment of the third batch of materials.
Hobert also plans to visit Miss Sharron after the wedding, and also "visit" "Rear Admiral Dusk" and "Rear Admiral Blood."
For Hobert, there are many ways to make money, so there is no need to spend this "deposit."
The key is that Christian's last words in the cave today made Hobert feel that he should leave some money to deal with possible changes in the future.
As for the protection of property in the territory, Hobert has already had such plans, and can bind interests with the Church of the Earth Mother.
But now Hobert feels that he should change his plan. He may not have time to slowly bind interests, but must pay more interests at one time and ask the Church of the Earth Mother to protect his interests.
Hobert also has some ideas about this, but now is not the time to do something.
After thinking about these issues, Hobert returned to the real world. He still has a lot to do today.
The most important thing is to go to Tingen to pick up Selena.
Originally, Hobert would have thought that he would see a scene like a life-and-death farewell, but Selena had already packed her luggage alone and waited in her room. She just put a letter on the desk.
Selena didn't cry this time, and smiled, "In the letter, I told them that I went to pursue my dream and would come back to see them often."
Hobert nodded. The experience in Boklun Manor made Selena grow a lot.
Returning to the lord's mansion in Jeffrey Territory, Hobert asked Selena to live in the same room with Freya. Freya was very happy that she finally had a companion.
Selena was also relieved. She didn't expect that she would still have classmates, and she also saw the cheerful Donna and the always shy Tyron, two familiar faces.
This made Selena, who was already prepared to face a completely unfamiliar environment, feel a lot more at ease.
...
As the wedding date approached, more and more nobles and wealthy people arrived in Jeffrey Territory in advance.
Hobert greeted them one by one according to the previous rehearsal. Christian's family came three days in advance, that is, on the 25th. Some nobles and wealthy people who had a good relationship with Christian, or thought they had a good relationship with Christian, arrived on the 26th.
The 27th reached the climax of the arrival of guests, because in addition to most of the nobles and wealthy people arriving on this day, it was also because Princess Ethel's naval fleet arrived at about ten o'clock in the morning on this day.
That's right, this girl actually came to attend Hobert's wedding with three warships.
If it were in a certain country in the "Western Continent", doing so would be very rude and would be like showing off their power.
But in Feynapotter, everyone felt that the royal family gave Christian enough face.
According to common sense, for the wedding of a baron, the royal family would send a court viscount to the wedding to bestow rewards.
No one expected that the royal family would send a princess, or Princess Ethel, who held great power in the court! This was even more shocking than the arrival of a prince.
Hobert naturally greeted her with the highest etiquette, including music, cannon salutes, and a review of the honor guard, with children from the territory presenting flowers.
What kind of honor guard did Jeffery have? Hobert had to make do with the fifty-odd soldiers like Seel dressed up smartly.
Ethel wasn't wearing a court dress today but a military uniform.
Short hair, neat and tidy. Although her pretty face carried a smile, it made people afraid to meet her eyes.
Although the military uniform concealed many of her feminine features, it enhanced her unique feminine charm.
Not only the nobles attending the wedding came to the dock to greet her, but also the surrounding nobles, Teuton, Eugene, Felix, and others came to welcome her.
Since they came, of course, they would also attend the neighbor's wedding.
The Teuton Viscount among them was a little confused at this time, not understanding whether the royal family supported him or Hobert.
Ethel spoke a few simple words with Christian and his son, then inspected the honor guard with a serious expression, and accepted the children's flowers with a smile.
When getting into the carriage, she made a few remarks, which was equivalent to collectively receiving the nobles who came to greet her, and only Hobert and his father accompanied the princess to the villa area on the hillside.
The princess's large number of servants had already arrived yesterday and had cleaned up a villa according to some of Ethel's habits, and even replaced all the furniture and furnishings in the princess's bedroom, dining room, and living room.
When entering the door, Ethel glanced at the villa's decoration and frowned slightly.
But her eyebrows quickly relaxed, and she warmly received Hobert and his son in the living room.
After chatting for a few words, Ethel asked Hobert as if casually, "I heard that there are still a small number of troops in your territory? Are they the ones who were inspected at the port just now?"
Hobert smiled gently, "Thank you for your reminder, Your Highness. When I first came to the South Colson area, bandits were rampant here, and the security was very poor."
"In order to protect myself and the safety of the people, I had to form the Lord's Mansion Guard. They are members of the security team, not an army."
Since the royal families of various countries in the Northern Continent began to centralize power, it has gradually become illegal for nobles with fiefs to have their own private armies.
But in order to ensure their own safety, small-scale guards are allowed.
The reason why Hobert thanked Ethel for reminding him was because he heard Ethel's implication: someone said you formed a private army, give me a reasonable explanation!
So after thanking Ethel, Hobert gave a reasonable explanation.
Ethel looked at the decoration in the living room, "I have never seen this kind of decoration style before. At first, I felt a little uncomfortable, but after looking at it a few times, I felt it became more and more dignified. What style is this from?"
These decorations already look very mature and are not temporary works.
Hobert said vaguely, "This comes from the gift of a great man."
Christian also felt that the decoration in the villa was very distinctive, but when he heard Hobert say this, he thought he was fooling Ethel.
He didn't plan to ask in detail. This was the way his father and son got along. They each had their own secrets, and they could silently support each other when needed.
Ethel immediately thought of the "Creator": "I understand."
Then she said as if casually, "Your huge investment in the South Colson area has made many people jealous. Be careful to protect yourself and your property."
Christian looked at Ethel and Hobert with a somewhat strange expression. He didn't know through what channels Hobert had invited Princess Ethel.
However, Christian thought that Princess Ethel must have come to attend the wedding for the sake of a certain great man.
But Princess Ethel's reminder had exceeded the enthusiasm of attending a wedding as a formality and was more like a friend's reminder.
This made Christian wonder when Hobert had a private relationship with Ethel.
Hobert thanked Ethel again for her reminder, saying that he would definitely pay attention to this.
Then Ethel ended the conversation on the grounds that she was tired.
On the way back, Christian invited Hobert to ride in the same carriage with him.
After the carriage drove out of the villa area, Christian said, "Princess Ethel is a special existence in the royal family. Her mother is the current queen."
"This queen is not in good health and has only given birth to one son and one daughter for the king. That prince had the first legal right to inherit the throne from birth."
"Unfortunately, that little prince died at the age of three. Some say he died in a court conspiracy, and some say he died in an assassination by an enemy country."
"In short, after the little prince died, Ethel and the sons of several concubines had the legal right to inherit in order."
"I heard that this battle for the crown prince lasted for more than half a year before the current crown prince was determined. This is because Ethel withdrew from the battle for the crown prince early, and things were resolved so quickly."
"According to a well-known political compromise, Ethel will inherit the title of her maternal grandfather, Duke Charles."
"Because, coincidentally, this Duke Charles only has one daughter, the queen. The royal family originally wanted to annex Duke Charles's territory, wealth, and power by marrying Charles's daughter."
"As a result, the little prince died, and Ferdinand II had to compromise and let Ethel inherit her maternal grandfather's title and status."
"But even now, many ministers still hope that Ethel will become the crown prince because of their vested interests."
Hobert listened quietly to Christian's explanation. He didn't expect that this was a very special and powerful princess!
Christian only stated the facts without making any comments. He believed that Hobert should be able to handle the relationship with Princess Ethel well.
Hobert continued to go to the dock to welcome the nobles who came to attend the wedding, or the stewards sent by the nobles to offer congratulations. In just one day, Jeffery Town was already packed.
A baron or a wealthy man with assets of less than 300,000 gold Reals could only be assigned to a relatively spacious suite with a servant's room, and the large number of servants they brought, except for personal valets or personal maids, could only stay in cheap hotels.
But such accommodation conditions had exceeded their expectations. Originally, they thought they would have to live in tents in a remote place like South Colson.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - 477: Crossdressing Klein
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
To Hobert's surprise, the Tudor family from Christian's branch actually sent a demigod to attend the wedding.
This made Hobert couldn't help but sigh inwardly: What a great move of suppressing first and then elevating.
The other party's attitude was very enthusiastic, so Hobert greeted them with equal enthusiasm and provided them with accommodation equivalent to the baron's.
However, the reaction of this demigod named Darnell once again exceeded Hobert's expectations: "We are all family, why stay in a hotel? I'll stay in your lord's manor."
Hobert realized that the other party must have come with a mission, so he followed their wishes and asked Dennis to arrange for him and several attendants to stay in the lord's manor.
He was busy until the evening, and all the guests were settled.
At this time, the town of Jeffery was brightly lit, and all the restaurants and taverns, wherever there was food, were packed.
There were also many people walking through the streets with notebooks, occasionally stopping people on the street and asking a few questions.
Those were the reporters Hobert had hired. Originally, these reporters were just treating it as a trip, and would write a small report about the customs and culture of Jeffery, which would be worth Hobert's "sponsorship."
But when the princess disembarked, it was different. It completely stimulated their work enthusiasm. After dinner, they took the initiative to start visiting the streets.
Back at the lord's manor, only Fors was in the dining room.
Seeing Hobert, she smiled and instructed the servant: "Tell the kitchen to serve the dishes."
As she spoke, she pulled out the chair that Hobert often sat in: "I think it's getting late, so I asked Father and Mother to have dinner first. Now only you are still hungry."
Hobert grabbed Fors' hand as she pulled out the chair, leaned in and kissed it: "Our Miss Fors is already showing the appearance of a virtuous wife."
Because there were servants present, Fors gently pushed Hobert away: "That's because your requirements for a wife are too low."
"Not low at all." Hobert smiled and glanced at the chopsticks on the table, then said to Allen: "Just set up knives and forks at the wedding venue tomorrow, don't let the guests feel that I'm too special."
Allen nodded: "Yes."
Hobert ate dinner while talking to Fors.
Occasionally he would touch her little hand and her beautiful legs, and he ate very comfortably.
After dinner, Hobert yawned: "You go to sleep first, tomorrow is our big day, maintain good energy."
"What about you?"
"I'm going to pick up a special guest."
Fors smiled and said: "I thought you would be like other Loen gentlemen, going out to drink with friends, dance, and have fun all night before the wedding."
Hobert was slightly stunned: These old gentlemen play hard, isn't this the legendary "bachelor party"?
Then he smiled wryly: "After you said that, I suddenly realized that I don't have a single friend to drink with besides you and Xio."
He has many capable subordinates, such as Philip, Conrad, Corwin, and Roy.
He also has many partners, such as Helen and Bishop Simpson.
He even has many believers, such as Upton, Rafter, and Elliot.
But there's no way to sit down and drink with them as equals. If he had to call them, they would come, but everyone would feel awkward.
Fors generously said: "Then you can go out and have fun yourself, just don't forget that you are getting married tomorrow."
Anyway, she was going to the bar with Xio later.
"Forget it, I'll go pick up that special friend first." Hobert said to Dennis: "Have Selena and Freya wait for me in the study, prepare tea, they will help me entertain a guest later."
"Yes."
After Fors left, Hobert returned to his study, and after several transfers using "Traveling", he arrived in the suburbs of Bayam.
Then he took out the "Faceless Necklace" to "navigate" himself, and finally found Klein in a fisherman's house by the sea.
When their eyes met, they both felt very embarrassed, because at this time Klein was wearing an inner shirt that matched a women's long skirt, and the key point was that he actually looked quite sexy!
At this time, Hobert realized what he had missed: tonight there was a Klein's cross-dressing show.
"Cough cough." Hobert coughed twice to relieve the embarrassment: "Nice figure, but too bad there are no breasts!"
Klein also cleared his throat: "You may have misunderstood something."
"What misunderstanding is there?" Hobert laughed: "Who doesn't have a little hobby?"
"Then you really misunderstood."
Hobert smiled: "You change your clothes first, I'll wait for you outside."
After waiting for a few minutes, a stern man with thin cheeks, distinct edges and corners, and dark brown eyes came out of the fisherman's house.
Hobert didn't know if Klein felt too embarrassed to see Hobert.
Although Hobert knew that this was Klein's transformed Gehrman Sparrow image, it still stunned him for a moment.
Then Hobert laughed: "There are a few acquaintances at tomorrow's wedding, you continue to maintain this image."
Klein asked: "What are you looking for me for so late?"
"I thought it would be difficult for you to rush to the wedding from the Berserk Sea, so I came to pick you up." Hobert smiled: "Didn't ruin your good time, did I?"
Klein pretended not to hear Hobert's question: "I have already made an appointment with Mr. Azik to go to Feynapotter together tomorrow."
In a previous communication, Azik had briefly described the process of his acquaintance with Hobert.
Hobert also sent Azik an invitation. Hearing Klein's answer, he was slightly stunned: "I'm already here, let's go together, write a letter to Mr. Azik later and let him go by himself."
"I also have an appointment with Mr. Azik tonight, he will come in a while, you can talk to him directly."
Hobert then remembered that they would also go to the "Black Death" later: "Okay, I'll send you to your residence."
Without Hobert teaching him, Klein, who had rich experience in entering the spirit world, had already begun to imagine the location of the hotel he was staying in in his mind.
Hobert supported his shoulders, and the two quickly came to a luxurious room in a hotel.
Klein changed into his clothes, and the two chatted casually, the content was nothing more than how the preparations were going? And knowingly asked where the bride was from.
More than half an hour later, the colors of the space in front of the two suddenly became richer.
Mr. Azik, with bronze skin and soft features, came out of the spirit world. He was obviously stunned when he saw Hobert, but he still smiled and said: "Congratulations."
Hobert smiled and said: "Thank you."
Azik sighed: "It's been a long time since I attended a wedding, it's very exciting."
Klein also stepped forward and said: "Good evening, Mr. Azik."
"Good evening." Azik said: "Sorry, I just saw your letter and came in a hurry, I should have knocked on the door first."
Then he asked: "What exactly is going on with that batch of death-related documents?"
Klein did not avoid Hobert, and explained the clues he found by releasing the souls in "Creeping Hunger" one by one, and then talked about his assassination of Tracy.
He glanced at Hobert while speaking, as if saying: You really misunderstood me.
Who knew that Hobert listened to it like a story, and smiled: "No wonder Emperor Roselle said that everyone has a second personality, it seems that there is a beautiful lady living in our Mr. Klein's body."
Klein twitched the corners of his mouth: You didn't listen to a word of my explanation just now.
Azik smiled, put on his top hat: "So, should we take action now?"
Hobert also got up and asked: "Can I go with you?"
Azik: "Of course you can."
Hobert took out the mask and put it on: Okay, I met a "Demoness of Unaging" and a "Demoness of Afflictions" on this bachelor night, it sounds very exciting.
He smiled: If you add the description "there are two other men around"... it seems even more exciting!
While daydreaming, Klein had already picked up his cane and divined the whereabouts of his relics on the "Black Death".
Azik put his hands on Klein and Hobert's shoulders respectively, and took the two into the spirit world.
Klein's cane flew up in the spirit world, tumbling and jumping in one direction, and Azik easily followed.
Before long, the black hardwood cane stopped, and in front of it was a thick black and overlapping shadows.
At this moment, Azik said with a slightly dignified expression: "The spirit here tells me that there is danger."
Klein's expression also became serious, guessing that "Vice Admiral Ailment" had found helpers.
Azik closed his eyes for a short while, then suddenly opened them and said: "It's not a big problem, let's go in."
Klein glanced at Hobert: "You are prescient."
Hobert smiled: "No, I'm just afraid of running into acquaintances."
Klein changed into Qilangos' appearance while thinking: This is at sea, what acquaintances do you have?
The surrounding scene suddenly had a feeling of rapid fall, and various bright colors faded quickly.
In just the blink of an eye, Klein found himself back in Tracy's captain's room. The heroic female pirate was wearing a white shirt, and there were obvious bandage marks on her left shoulder.
That was the injury she suffered from Klein's previous assassination.
"It's you?" Suddenly a figure slowly emerged from Tracy's side, she was wearing a simple and holy white robe, the opening was very high, revealing a pair of flawless legs.
She was clear and beautiful, her skin was like snow, as tender as a girl, with an indescribable charm: "Mr. 'Death Consul'."
While this "Immortal Witch" was catching up with Mr. Azik, Hobert was thinking about a question: Who is the adult and who is the daughter? It seems like they grew in reverse.
Klein and Tracy were a little surprised. The helpers they each invited knew each other, and seemed to be very familiar.
After the two big shots finished the process of catching up, Katarina glanced at Klein and asked Azik with a smile: "I'm very curious, why did he assassinate Tracy? Is it for justice?"
Hobert laughed in his heart: This justice is not that "Justice", if it is really for Miss Justice, then it is a bloody story.
The glance that Katarina had just swept over was full of charm, sweet and playful, like the eyes of a teenage girl.
Klein had to use meditation to fight against this casually revealed charm, he took the initiative to look at Tracy: "Do you know the rich businessman Jimmy Neck?"
Tracy said blankly: "Who is he?"
"You may not know him, he once collected a batch of ancient documents related to death, he died in the hands of Qilangos." Klein said, wearing Qilangos' face.
Tracy's tone was obviously angry: "You are here for those documents?"
"Yes."
With big shots present, Tracy didn't dare to express her anger, she took a deep breath and asked: "Where is Irene? What did you do to her?"
Klein directly responded: "She has returned to Intis."
Tracy's expression sank, and her blue eyes glared at Klein, revealing the aura of a pirate general.
But Azik's casual glance made her suddenly become sober: "Those documents did fall into my hands, but I am not interested in them, I simply flipped through two pages and handed them over."
She laughed: "Even if you had succeeded in the assassination before, you would not be able to get them."
Azik looked at Katarina: "Can you make a copy of those documents for me?"
"This is not a big problem." Katarina turned her head and glanced at Tracy: "What are your requirements?"
Tracy stared at Klein: "Tell me Irene's whereabouts."
"Heh." Hobert couldn't help but laugh, and as a result, Katarina's flowing eyes and Tracy's glare came to Hobert's side.
He quickly explained: "'Vice Admiral Ailment' is deeply affectionate and righteous, which I admire very much."
Tracy almost started fighting, this sentence sounded like a provocation no matter how you listened to it.
And Hobert took the opportunity to ask Katarina: "Madam, can I ask you a question?"
"You say." That expression and tone, as if very much looking forward to Hobert's question.
Hobert averted his eyes impolitely: "May I ask, after the death of the Underworld Emperor, did the Primordial Demoness get the uniqueness of the 'Red Priest' pathway?"
This question stunned everyone present, Tracy obviously didn't understand what this question meant.
Klein wondered: Why would there be the uniqueness of the 'Red Priest' pathway in the Underworld Emperor's place, is it a weapon similar to a special sealed item like the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway in the Goddess's hand?
Azik seemed to have suddenly thought of something, and his expression became more and more solemn.
Katarina stared at Hobert for two seconds, this question meant that the young man wearing the mask knew a lot about the history and secrets of the Fourth Epoch.
She glanced at Azik again before saying: "As far as I know, no."
"Thank you." Hobert said.
Katarina followed up with a girlish and innocent tone and asked: "Your mask is very special, may I ask where you got it from?"
The other party's tone made Hobert suddenly want to tell the other party everything, but fortunately his mask was made of "Order Crystal", and after taking a deep breath, he regained his sanity: "Family inheritance."
Klein nodded aside: Sure enough, because he is a descendant of the Trunsoest Empire, he inherited the mask and became the favored one of the "Creator".

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - 478 We Are Getting Married
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Azik led Hobert and Klein back to the hotel's deluxe suite.
Azik asked Hobert, "You seem to know a lot about the history of the Fourth Epoch?"
"Because of the corpse of that ancient god of death, I gained access to read some secret knowledge." Hobert lied with a sincere face, "This is also thanks to Mr. Azik's help."
Azik smiled and shook his head: "I should thank you for reminding me of many things."
He pinched his temples: "Sorry, your question just reminded me of something else, my condition is not very good, I may not be able to attend your wedding."
Hobert said with some concern: "Can we help you?"
"It will be fine after a period of sleep." Azik said to Hobert again: "Put your hand out."
Hobert stretched out his hand, and Azik patted his palm, and a black skull with a phantom crown pattern appeared in Hobert's palm.
Before Hobert could take a closer look, the pattern disappeared, as if it had penetrated into his skin.
Azik explained: "Just now I gave you the ability to enter the underworld and mobilize a part of the underworld's power. In the southern continent of the Fourth Epoch, this was an unparalleled honor."
He shook his head with a self-deprecating smile and said again: "It's a pity that you are not a 'Death' pathway Beyonder, this mark is not of much help to you.
"But at certain times, you can also use it to make enemies of some undead creatures surrender, or make undead creatures have enough goodwill towards you, and will not actively attack you.
"Well, this is my wedding gift to you.
"I'll go find you after I wake up from my sleep."
Hobert looked at his palm and smiled happily: "Mr. Azik, thank you for your gift! This gift is too precious, I like it very much."
Azik also smiled, and after giving Klein a few more instructions, he entered the spirit world again and disappeared into the room.
Hobert took a deep breath and looked at Klein: "Okay, it's getting late, let's go."
The two came to the Jeffery Territory, Hobert's study, Selena and Freya were already almost asleep waiting.
Klein was slightly stunned when he saw the two girls, but then he returned to normal and thanked Freya who poured tea for him.
After chatting for a few words, Hobert asked the two girls to help the guests tidy up a guest room, and then went to rest.
Only the two of them were left in the study, and Hobert explained: "Freya is one of the two people I rescued from the Great Smog incident. I heard she knows Detective Sherlock."
Klein took a sip of tea: "Her mother and sister...?"
"I was one step late when I rescued people. Her mother's body had already been exhausted. It was only a few seconds late, and she couldn't be saved." Hobert said, "Her sister is still studying in Backlund."
"Then Selena..."
"At the beginning of the year, Selena encountered an extraordinary event." Hobert briefly described the encounter at the Boklun Manor, and finally said: "The name of the potion I took at the end of last year was 'Mentor of Disorder', and I need a few students."
Klein nodded, Selena's enthusiasm for the extraordinary world and mysticism is very suitable for being Hobert's student, and it is also reassuring to be with Hobert.
Skipping this topic, Hobert said again: "Get up early tomorrow and help me entertain the guests."
Klein was slightly stunned: "Am I not a guest?"
Hobert picked up the teapot and poured a glass of water for Klein: "Am I not entertaining you? Besides, who stipulates that guests cannot entertain other guests?
"Help me, there will be surprises tomorrow."
Klein smiled: "Lawyer!"
...
January 28th, Backlund, 1920 Brany Street, Factory District.
This is an abandoned factory, but today it suddenly became lively. First, a group of people in strange clothes came out of the factory and cleaned up the weeds in the yard.
Then the factory door opened, and two busy girls appeared at the door of the office building, one was Selena with striking red hair, and the other was Freya who didn't talk much but was very capable.
Around nine o'clock, the first carriage drove into the factory. Several men in gorgeous clothes but with obvious temperament that did not match their clothes got off the carriage. They looked at the empty abandoned factory in a daze: Did they go to the wrong place?
Selena stepped forward to greet him: "Are you here to attend the wedding?"
The leading man nodded: "Yes, yes."
"Please show your invitation card." Selena glanced at the invitation card: "Hello, Mr. Austin, please come this way. This is my companion Freya, she will take you to the wedding venue."
The visitors were Austin and others who had robbed tombs with Hobert. If there were only such experiences, Hobert would not have sent them invitations.
Later, the mercenary club sent three elite teams to assassinate Hobert, and Austin risked a huge risk to warn Hobert through Jessica.
So Hobert also invited them to attend his wedding.
Freya took a few deep breaths, trying to make herself look generous when facing strangers: "Please follow me."
She led Austin and others to the office building. On one side of the empty hall, there was a closed door.
This door was not as dilapidated as other doors, and the door was also very clean.
Freya followed the teacher's previous instructions, concentrated all her attention on the doorknob, and said in somewhat rusty ancient Hermes language: "Jeffery Territory!"
As soon as the door opened, the door frame was a piece of illusory space: "Please come in."
Austin and others looked at each other, concealed their surprise, and followed closely behind.
After shuttling through the spirit world for a while, another door suddenly appeared in front of them. When this door opened, the outside was completely a different scene. From the architectural style and people's clothing, it had an exotic atmosphere.
People were coming and going outside, looking very lively. This was the front yard of the Lord's Mansion.
On the front yard, Klein, with the face of Gehrman Sparrow, coldly directed the servants to do the next reception.
Austin and others were still reminiscing about the journey just now, and followed the servants in a daze to the wedding venue.
Back in Backlund, the abandoned factory became more and more lively, with carriages coming one after another. Selena greeted them seriously: "Ms. Daly and Mr. Leonard, we meet again, please come this way.
"That gentleman, are you also here to attend the wedding? Please ask the coachman to park the carriage over there."
At this time, Selena saw an acquaintance getting off the taxi: "Melissa, this way, this way! Mr. Benson, hello."
Melissa did not expect to meet her good friend here: "Selena, did you also receive an invitation?"
"No, I was arranged by Tutor Hobert to receive guests." Selena smiled: "We'll chat later, this is my companion Freya, please follow her to the wedding venue.
"Oh, by the way, I've seen the guest list, Elizabeth will come later."
Sure enough, after a while, Elizabeth and her family arrived.
Elizabeth was a little surprised: "Selena, your family is worried, why are you here?"
After seeing the letter left by Selena, Mr. Wood and Mrs. Wood were still a little worried and went around to inquire about Selena's whereabouts.
As Selena's good friend, the Wood couple must ask Elizabeth about it.
Selena smiled and said, "I am now studying mysticism with Mr. Hobert. If I have time, I will send a letter to my parents."
After chatting a few words, Selena had to hurry to greet the guests: "Mr. Harvey Hayden, please come this way.
"This gentleman, please show your invitation card, Mr. Dorian, right? Please go to the wedding venue with this Mr. Harvey Hayden."
Klein at the Lord's Mansion side, his eyes narrowed when he saw Melissa and Benson.
After taking a deep breath, Klein was relieved: This is the surprise Hobert was talking about last night!
He was about to step forward, but in the end he didn't take that step and continued to direct the servants to receive guests.
Back at the abandoned factory in Backlund, around eleven o'clock, Audrey and Glaint got off one after another as two gorgeous noble carriages arrived.
Selena's eyes lit up, and she sighed in her heart that this lady was so beautiful, and her clothes and jewelry were so gorgeous: "Beautiful lady, you are here to attend the wedding, please come this way."
With the arrival of two members of the "Justice League", the welcoming task on the Backlund side came to an end.
The last few guests were Captain Thomas and the other two. This morning, they received an urgent case and rushed over in a panic after going to the scene.
Selena smiled after looking at the invitation card: "Please come this way, three."
Freya had already gone to the Lord's Mansion to help, and Selena led the last three guests to the door.
Borgia said: "I said, the wedding will not be held in an abandoned factory."
Thomas also smiled and said: "I didn't expect that attending a wedding would also require passing through a 'Traveler's Gate'. This reminds me of my experience of going to headquarters to study."
Selena heard their conversation and noticed the Dark Sacred Emblem on their three carriages, knowing that they were all Beyonders.
She also recalled the encounter at Boklun Manor and sighed that the tutor knew so many Beyonders.
After passing through the "Traveler's Gate" and arriving at the Lord's Mansion, Klein stepped forward to take over: "Please follow the servants to the wedding venue, three."
Selena drank a few sips of water that Freya handed over: "The guests on the Backlund side have all arrived."
Klein nodded: "In a while, let the servants carry a table of food to the factory in Backlund to entertain the coachmen waiting there. Don't send wine."
Selena agreed: "Understood."
"Take a break, you guys go to the wedding too!" After saying that, Klein went to the wedding venue.
He didn't expect that he, who had never been married, would be in charge of the wedding reception.
However, he was only responsible for the Backlund side. The reception work on the Feynapotter side was handled by a steward named Dophis.
The wedding venue was held on a lawn not far from the Lord's Mansion. The weather was good today, not cold or hot, and it was just right to hold the ceremony outdoors.
The scene was already full of people, and the areas where they were sitting were clearly defined, with guests from Backlund and nobles from Feynapotter.
Klein also saw a few witches in the audience. He knew witches too well, so he knew at a glance that they were witches.
This made Klein believe Hobert's words last night, maybe he was really afraid of meeting acquaintances.
Then Klein thought of the sentence in Roselle's diary, "The taste of a Demoness isn't bad." He seriously suspected that the Beyonders of the "Black Emperor" pathway all had this habit?
Of course, even if there were witches, the focus of the audience was basically on Audrey. This gem of Backlund was the most dazzling presence no matter what banquet she attended.
Klein almost mistook Miss Justice for a Beyonder who had taken the "high sequence" witch potion.
Through the information of Backlund's nobles, Hobert's friends, etc., Klein easily connected Audrey to Miss Justice.
It was not until the Princess of Feynapotter, whose name was Ethel, arrived that she shared a lot of the focus of the scene. Although her appearance was far inferior to Miss Justice, she was better than her imposing manner. Many nobles from Feynapotter dared not even raise their heads after the princess arrived.
In addition, there were many guests wearing the robes of the Earth Mother Church. Klein sighed at the breadth of Hobert's social circle. He actually knew the "Giant Bishop" of the Backlund Harvest Church, and the Sanguine Emlyn, who was holding a parasol.
Finally, there were the seats reserved for local officials and people. Because there were a limited number of people who could sit down, more people watched the excitement in the distance of the venue.
After briefly reporting the reception situation on the Backlund side to Dophis, Klein also found a corner to sit down.
At 12 o'clock, the wedding officially began, and the music at the scene became solemn.
Fors, holding Hobert's arm, appeared in the aisle in the middle of the venue. Today, Fors was wearing a white dress that symbolized "purity" locally.
The veil was draped over her shoulders, and the skirt was decorated with lace and auspicious patterns, giving Fors a sense of sacredness.
The bloated skirt gave people a sense of elegance, and there was a long skirt behind it, with two seven- or eight-year-old children following behind to pull the skirt.
Hobert was wearing a Feynapotter-style, somewhat cumbersome traditional noble costume with a cloak. The reason why he liked the Feynapotter-style cloak so much was because it made him look heroic and majestic.
When the bridesmaid Xio, who was helping to hold the bouquet, appeared, everyone thought she was the bride's younger sister who was still in school, or the younger generation of the bride's family.
According to local customs, Hobert and Fors held a wooden box together.
There was a new dress in the wooden box, symbolizing a new beginning.
There was also a pocket watch that didn't look very new, symbolizing the past of the two people.
A blue flower, symbolizing the sincerity of the two people.
A somewhat crude bowl, which was borrowed from the residents of the town, symbolizing the harmony between neighbors.
There was also a pair of gemstone earrings given by Montresa, symbolizing the care of relatives.
As soon as she entered the venue, Fors saw her friends from medical school, many writer friends, and her mother's family members in the venue. They were waving to Fors and sending their blessings in advance.
After a brief surprise, Fors glanced at her fiancé.
Hobert smiled, looking ahead, and said, "I've hypnotized them; they'll forget the process of coming here and going back. But I listened to you and didn't bring your father over."
"Well, I contacted your uncle through your classmate and learned that they all really wanted to attend your wedding, so I invited them all."
Fors saw her grandmother's kind smile and smiled happily, "It's enough that they can come."
She had long been unwilling to associate with her father's family.
Especially at a wedding held in a foreign land, she naturally hoped that her relatives and friends could be present and that she could receive their blessings.
Fors took Hobert's arm and couldn't help but squeeze it a little tighter.
The two slowly came to the front of the venue, attracting everyone's attention.

Before this, Ethel knew very little about Hobert and Jeffrey's territory. She thought that Hobert had completely established his rule in South Colson by violence.
Only after coming to Jeffrey's territory did she realize that Hobert's governance level was quite high. At least Ethel had never seen such a capable person among the nobles.
If most of what the book said was true, then Hobert already had some foundation in Jeffrey's territory, which would bring considerable obstacles to the return of the monarchy.
Hobert smiled and said, "My personal ability only accounts for a small part, all thanks to the support of the royal family and the princess."
Ethel smiled at Hobert with a meaningful look: "Hypocrite!"
Hobert continued to maintain his smile: This little girl is really hard to please!
The princess continued to look out the window: "You were given the fiefdom of a viscount, but you were not ennobled as a viscount. Do you understand why?"
"I only have achievements, but my loyalty to the king is not enough."
Ethel nodded with satisfaction. It's easy to talk to smart people.
She glanced at Hobert again: So?
Hobert, however, unexpectedly played his cards differently: "I am absolutely loyal to the king. The princess should be able to see this. I am an honest person and have no ambition. I only want to manage my territory well."
Ethel almost blurted out "Bullshit", but she ultimately maintained the demeanor a princess should have: "I would be more at ease if you showed your ambition."
"I plan to retire after I've built up the territory," Hobert said contentedly. "I'll live a life of lying down and counting money in the future."
Ethel said nothing. Of course, she wouldn't believe such nonsense.
After entertaining the nobles until after four in the afternoon and seeing the scenery of the territory, Hobert returned to the lord's mansion to rest.
However, there are benefits to this tour. Many nobles are planning to come to Jeffery Town for vacation in April and May.
Back at the lord's mansion, the reporters came to say goodbye.
Hobert told the reporters about his idea of a "youth hostel", which would provide great discounts for young people who want to travel.
At the same time, he asked the reporters to be sure to write one point in the report: art students from art schools who come to sketch will have their food and accommodation covered, and if there are works appreciated by the lord, the lord will buy them and print albums in the future.
This marketing method is very novel, and even if Hobert doesn't tell them, the reporters plan to write it in the report.
After seeing off the reporters, Hobert came to the side hall and asked Dennis to guard the door and not let anyone disturb him.
He first set up the altar and completed the transaction with Alger and "Little Sun."
"The Fool" reminded him to make the transaction at noon, but he didn't have time then.
He got five more Beyonder ingredients from "Little Sun" and the "Juice of the Black Mist Lord Tree" that Alger bought for 2000.
After completing the ritual, Hobert realized: Isn't "The Fool" in the lord's mansion? From the east courtyard of the lord's mansion to the front courtyard?
He suddenly felt like he had gone the long way around!
Hobert smiled and began to prepare for the evening auction.
After the family had dinner, they rode in two carriages and followed Hobert to the back mountain to watch the excitement.
Hobert rode in a carriage with Fors and Donna. Taking advantage of the girls' chattering, Hobert said to Fors, "Observe the auction techniques carefully later. If I don't have time in the future, you will host the auction."
Fors was slightly taken aback: "I, I can't!"
Hobert held her hand and smiled gently: "It's very simple. It's actually using everyone's psychology of rushing to buy and the psychology of 'there's only one chance'."
Although he has never hosted an auction, he has seen a lot of auctions of cultural relics and is very clear about the psychological game involved.
"I won't let you work for nothing," Hobert smiled. "Currently, you get 5% of every item you sell."
Fors said seriously: "I will study hard!"
Donna asked: "Hobert, why do you emphasize 'currently'?"
"Because after Fors takes over the financial management of the lord's mansion, she can't use this commission-based accounting model."
Donna said enviously: "Brother, sorting out accounts is very tiring. Do you want me to share the burden for my sister-in-law..."
"Forget it, I'm afraid the lord's mansion will go bankrupt."
"Hmph, stingy!"
Hobert flicked Donna's head: "Isn't the pocket money I give you enough to spend? You're always thinking about these crooked ideas."
The wheels of the carriage rolled slowly, and arrived at the back mountain in the three people's chat.
Currently, the back mountain is still relatively desolate, especially at night. Only the auction building is lonely with lights, very much like the haunted building in ghost stories.
However, this is very in line with the terrifying atmosphere that Beyonder gatherings should have. The nobles and wealthy people who came to participate in the auction arrived one after another, and the back mountain became a little more popular.
Everyone wore masks, but some people were still easily recognized, such as Princess Ethel. Her powerful aura could not be concealed by a mask.
In addition, Klein and Bishop Simpson, as well as Darnell, the demigod of the Tudor family, were also invited to watch the auction.
The decoration of the auction hall is very simple, and it has not even had time to put up the ceiling. There are only rows of seats that are higher and higher towards the back, like a theater, and an auction table.
The places outside the auction hall have not even had windows installed.
However, everyone came for the mystical items, and even the nobles who are more demanding on the environment don't care too much about these.
At eight o'clock in the evening, Hobert came to the auction table: "I announce that this auction officially begins.
"The first lot is a rare Beyonder weapon. It has the shape of a crossbow, which is convenient to carry, and has two abilities.
"The first ability is that even people who have never used a crossbow..."
The nobles and wealthy merchants under the stage listened very carefully. Those who knew the business knew that Beyonder weapons were indeed rare, and those who didn't know the business were also attracted by its ability and the onlookers.
While speaking, Hobert showed everyone the Beyonder weapon he had just obtained from Carrie: "This crossbow is a good self-defense weapon for the family. Even family members who have never touched a weapon can use it to protect themselves in an emergency.
"The starting price is 1800 gold lire, with each bid increasing by 100 gold lire. The auction now begins.
"This gentleman bid 1900, that one bid 2000! 2200! That discerning gentleman directly bid 2200! 2300! 2400! 2400 for the first time, is there a higher bid? You can't stay at home every day to protect your family. With this crossbow, your family will have security."
Hobert was full of emotion and completely immersed in this auction: "2600! That gentleman must have a happy and inviolable family! 2800! This gentleman bid 2800! 3000! 3100! 3200!
"3200 for the first time, 3200 for the second time, this kind of weapon that is very easy to use is rare. You may not encounter a similar weapon this year.
"3300! That gentleman bid 3300! 3500! This gentleman knows the principle of not missing opportunities! 3700! That gentleman also understands this principle!"
Hobert found that those who were still raising the price were basically wealthy people who didn't know much about the business but had a lot of money.
So the price of this Beyonder weapon directly climbed to a price that Hobert had not expected: "3800! 3800 once, 3800 twice, is there a higher bid? 3800 three times! Sold!"
Hobert knocked on the gavel, and the first transaction was completed.
Klein, sitting in the corner, was very envious. In the blink of an eye, Hobert had earned about 3000 pounds. He didn't expect that Hobert would not only initiate group purchases, but also be so good at auctioneering.
