chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 480 Hobert's Future Economic Pillar (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Dylan for becoming a free member]
That Beyonder weapon was merely an appetizer prepared by Hobert; its normal value, in regular transactions, was at most 2,000 gold Lire.
Hobert used it as the first item for auction because of its scarcity.
But it was different at the auction, especially with these wealthy individuals who didn"t think much of a few thousand gold Lire. Once the atmosphere was built up, they seemed to enjoy the bidding process even more.
The second item for auction was an Beyonder characteristic of Sequence 7 "Interrogator".
Because there were members of the royal family present, Hobert explained, "Everyone should know that George III of Loen has a bounty of 10,000 pounds, which is 12,000 gold Lire, on my head."
'Many ignorant people have tried to earn this high reward, but none of them have managed to leave my territory.'
'The second item for auction is a contribution from a mercenary team of the Loen Kingdom, an Beyonder characteristic of an "Interrogator."'
The nobles mostly couldn"t take their eyes off it. The two royal families had extremely strict control over this pathway"s Beyonder characteristics, and noble families often had only one mid-sequence extraordinary being.
If anyone could obtain this Beyonder characteristic, the family"s strength would be greatly enhanced.
There were also some barons who had been Sequence 8 for several generations, constantly seeking an opportunity to advance further.
Their gazes became very eager.
Seeing that he had fully captured everyone"s attention, Hobert immediately started the auction: "Starting price is 1,500 gold Lire, each bid must increase by 100 gold Lire, let the auction begin!"
A baron calmly said, "1,800 gold Lire!"
Hobert didn"t expect it to be so intense right from the start: "1,800! 1,800 once…"
Before he could finish, a viscount said nonchalantly, "2,500!"
Hobert smiled and said, "This gentleman who understands its value bids 2,500! 2,500 once!"
A count also said in a calm tone, "3,500!"
Hobert"s hand holding the hammer trembled: The nobles are ruthless! Some less popular Sequence 6 Beyonder characteristics, I can only sell for about this price.
Of course, Hobert also knew that being able to sell at this price was largely due to choosing the right customer base.
If the audience was a group of nobles from the Intis Republic or the Feysac Empire, their bids wouldn"t be so crazy!
Immediately afterward, Hobert suddenly realized that auctions and Beyonder characteristics were a perfect match!
Of course, the prerequisite was to find the right customer base. If he were auctioning a "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristic, the most likely outcome would be a failed auction.
While Hobert was distracted, the nobles had already bid up to 5,000 gold Lire!
"5,000 for the first time! 5,000 for the second time! Any higher bids? 5,000 for the third time!" Just as Hobert was about to bring down the hammer, Ethel, sitting in the front row, also said in a calm tone, "8,000!"
Everyone exclaimed in unison. They all knew that 5,000 gold Lire had already exceeded the value of the item. Even if they needed it very much, the wealthy nobles were unwilling to continue bidding after reaching 5,000 gold Lire.
Ethel"s bid was more like a deterrent: The Beyonder characteristics of this pathway belong to the royal family. Only by being loyal to the royal family will you have the opportunity to advance.
Hobert on the stage was dumbfounded by Ethel"s operation. Was this malicious price inflation? But Hobert liked such tycoons!
After asking three times in a row, there was of course no higher bid, so this item was sold for a high price of 8,000 gold Lire.
Klein pondered: I wonder if an auction can be held in the Tarot Club? How annoying! It actually sold for 8,000 gold Lire, which is about 6,500 pounds! And the "Faceless" Beyonder characteristic that Hobert bought from me before wasn"t that expensive!
Hobert certainly didn"t know what Klein was thinking. He was still concentrating on the auction.
The next few items didn"t cause much of a stir. There was an Beyonder characteristic of "Barbarian", many spiritual materials seized from Gunboat Island, and two Beyonder ingredients carefully selected by Hobert.
Divided into a total of 5 auctions, the total transaction amount was only 2,000 gold Lire.
Finally, the highly anticipated finale item arrived: a Level 2 Sealed Artifact.
Whether it was nobles, extraordinary forces, or the royal family, they all valued the collection of sealed artifacts.
Hobert also had such a hobby. Now, just looking at the Level 2 Sealed Artifacts in his hand, he should be close to matching an Beyonder family with thousands of years of accumulation.
This item also had sufficient scarcity. This level of transaction rarely occurred in ordinary Beyonder gatherings.
Hobert showed everyone the colorful bracelet in the wooden box: "This is a very practical magical item. Its ability is: it can use spiritual materials to create scrolls with freezing, paralysis, and other effects. There is a 10% chance of creating scrolls with Beyonder abilities through corresponding materials; the wearer"s spirituality will be greatly increased."
'The key negative effect is not significant: it will only be very eager to obtain knowledge of mysticism; and unless the wearer prays for power from the "Hidden Sage," all ritual magic will end in failure.'
This was Hobert"s loot from the mercenary team that assassinated him. It was a magical item of the "Mystery Pryer" pathway.
"Everyone should know the scarcity of items at this level. Today, I"m using it as the finale item," Hobert said. "Starting price is 6,000 gold Lire! Each bid must increase by 500 gold Lire, let the auction begin."
"7,000!"
"8,000!"
"9,000!"
The price soared extremely quickly. Only now did Hobert have a chance to interject: "9,000! This discerning gentleman bids 9,000! 9,000 once! 9,000 twice!"
Darnell, sitting in the back row, bid, "12,000!"
"Ooh~"
Everyone exclaimed and turned to see who had made the bid.
"14,000!" Bishop Simpson followed closely.
This bid once again caused everyone to exclaim. This was a fortune that could allow someone to join the ranks of the wealthy in Feynapotter!
"16,000!" Jonathan of the Theosophy Order bid!
After Darnell"s bid, the nobles and wealthy people were silent, leaving only a few extraordinary organizations bidding and making the price terrifying!
At this time, Ethel took action again: "20,000!"
For her, money was really just paper.
"21,000!" Only Bishop Simpson followed, but he seemed to be running out of steam.
Ethel directly bid without giving others a chance: "23,000!"
Even Bishop Simpson was unwilling to follow.
Klein and Fors in the corner were stunned. They both suspected that they had misremembered: Was the exchange rate between pounds and gold Lire 1 to 5? Or 1 to 6?
In the end, the bracelet was sold for the terrifying price of 23,000 gold Lire. Some wealthy people who lacked mystical knowledge were also very surprised. They couldn"t imagine what kind of bracelet was worth so much! Was this what nobles liked to play with?
Hobert on the stage realized that building the auction house was the right move!
The reason why the price of the auction item was so high, an important concept is its scarcity, which is the core of the auction. As for the psychology of "rare opportunity" that Hobert said before, it is based on this core.
And Beyonder characteristics and extraordinary items are inherently scarce.
Those who hope to monopolize these extraordinary resources are also organizations such as the royal family and the church that don"t really care about money.
Beyonder auctions are rare because it is difficult to solve the problem of legality. Some Beyonder gatherings, such as the gathering initiated by Mr. A of the Aurora Order, if they dare to hold auctions, it is estimated that official Beyonders will come to check three times a day, and it will not be dark yet.
Hobert is definitely an exception. First of all, this is an auction in his own territory, and official Beyonders cannot control it here.
Secondly, he himself is a Sequence 5, which is already a very powerful Beyonder, and can provide enough auction items in the early stage of the auction house.
This exception is difficult to replicate.
Hobert had already realized this, so he hurriedly built the auction center.
The effect achieved by this auction made Hobert very satisfied. This evening, the auction alone created a revenue of 36,600 gold Lire for him.
Of course, this is inseparable from the fact that there are tycoons like Ethel in this auction!
The profit of future auctions may not be so considerable, but the auction will definitely attract many other transactions.
For example, Hobert noticed that Darnell was a little restless.
And this is Hobert"s own channel for selling stolen goods. In the future, if there are any spoils of war, he will have his own sales channel, and there is no need for other forces to earn the price difference.
This will be an important economic pillar for Hobert in the future.
Hobert smiled and said, "Friends who didn"t bid on their favorite items, don"t be discouraged. A large auction like tonight will be held on the 29th of every month."
'Small auctions will be held on the 5th, 15th, and 25th of each month.'
'If you need anything, you can leave your address when you leave tomorrow, and I will send the main auction item information to your residences in advance.'
'Also, did everyone see that room? There are people on duty there 24 hours a day. If you need anything, you can enter that room and make your request, and we will help you pay attention.'
'Finally, there is a second part of the auction: free trading!'
Another important source of income for the auction house is to use the popularity attracted by the auction to conduct transactions other than auctions.
Hobert certainly wouldn"t miss this good opportunity and prepared to hold an Beyonder gathering after the auction.
He began to explain the rules: "If you have any needs, you can ask the waiter to come over and write down the needs on the paper and pen we provide."
'If I can help solve it, I will ask you to stay after the gathering, and we will trade separately.'
'If I can't help solve the need, I will read it out loud on the stage to see if other participants can reach a transaction with you.'
'If you need confidentiality, I still suggest finding an opportunity to go to the room on the side of the hall to state your needs, or mark the word "confidential" on the back of the note, and I will help you pay attention.'
'Okay, now the gathering begins!'
Dennis went on stage to remove the auction table and brought Hobert a chair.
Most nobles have participated in some Beyonder gatherings, so they are no strangers to the rules of this kind of gathering.
Generally speaking, the notaries of this kind of gathering are powerful Beyonders. The second auction item barely proved Hobert"s strength. At least he is a Sequence 6, otherwise it would be impossible to kill a Sequence 7 so easily.
However, because it was the first gathering, everyone was still a little worried about Hobert"s strength, so after more than half a minute, a noble tentatively wrote down a need that he didn"t urgently need.
The lights in the audience were relatively dim, and Hobert could only see that the other party was wearing an expensive suit, and he couldn"t tell what level of noble he was.
The waiter handed the note to Hobert, opened it and saw: Need a complete five-color leaf grass.
Hobert smiled and said, "This gentleman needs an ingredient at the Sequence 9 level, and I can help solve it. Please stay after the gathering, and I will trade with you separately."
'Mr. One! This is your code name for trading later!'
"Complete five-color leaf grass" is one of the main ingredients of "Mystery Pryer".
A long time ago, when Hobert accidentally glimpsed the "Knowledge Moor", he obtained some "knowledge itself" at the cost of his head being blown open, and also obtained the potion formulas from Sequence 9 to Sequence 7 of the "Mystery Pryer" pathway.
And among the spoils of war from the shipyard island before, there was a "complete five-color leaf grass".
Seeing that Hobert easily solved the first need, someone handed over a note: May I ask what exactly is an Beyonder characteristic? Why are there Beyonder characteristics?
Hobert smiled and said, "This gentleman is asking an extraordinary question. Similarly, I can answer it. If you just simply talk about the appearance of this question, it costs 100 gold Lire. If you want me to explain the principle behind it clearly, it costs 1,000 gold Lire."
"Believe me, my asking price is very fair, because the answers to some questions cannot be bought with money."
Klein and Fors in the audience felt inexplicably familiar when they heard this sentence.
Hobert continued: "Mr. Two! This is your code name. If you want to trade, please stay after this gathering."
Next, the atmosphere of the transaction gradually became enthusiastic, and 12 transactions were initiated one after another, including 3 transactions asking for extraordinary questions.
There were 7 transactions seeking Beyonder ingredients, and two transactions seeking "low sequence" potion formulas.
Hobert himself solved 4 of the 7 Beyonder ingredients needed, and Hobert also had those two potion formulas.
Originally, Hobert thought that the first gathering transaction might be cold, but he himself did not expect that his accumulation of potion formulas, knowledge reserves, and Beyonder material accumulation could completely cope with such a gathering.
Of course, there will not be too large transactions at this kind of gathering, but this can accumulate a large number of potential customers.
Today, a Baron bought a Sequence 7 potion formula, so tomorrow he might buy Sequence 7 characteristics, or perhaps sell some Beyonder materials.
In short, they are the key players in the active Beyonder market.
After the gathering ended and most of the onlookers left, private Beyonder transactions were conducted one by one. At this time, only Fors and Donna were left in the auction building, waiting for Hobert.
Donna greeted him with a smile, "Hobert, when Father left, he said you have a better business mind than him and Rex."
Hobert smiled and said, "That"s because I spend more than they do. Alright, we should go back and rest."
"Look, the night outside is so charming. I still want to "dance" with Fors."
Fors glared at Hobert angrily. Now, dancing has become a code word between the two.
Donna, who was beside them, felt a little strange. It"s just dancing, why are these two so happy?
However, today"s business was not finished yet. As soon as he returned to the Lord"s mansion, Hobert saw Klein.
So Hobert asked Fors to go back first, and he invited Klein to the study.
As soon as he entered the study, Klein stated his purpose: "I should go back."
Hobert nodded, "Thank you for your help these past two days. Have a cup of tea, and I"ll send you back."
Klein sat opposite Hobert: "I was really enlightened tonight. I didn"t expect a Sequence 7 characteristics to sell for such a high price."
"I just found the right customer." Hobert smiled, "If I sell the same "Interrogator" characteristics to you, don"t even mention 1800 pounds, you"d have to think twice about 1200 pounds, because you don"t need it."
Klein felt a little better. His grumbling just now wasn"t because he was stingy, but because Hobert had just used 1500 pounds to buy a Sequence 7 characteristics from him at the Tarot Club this week.
Compared to 6500 pounds (roughly equivalent to 8000 gold coins), the difference was too great, so it was inevitable that he felt a little unbalanced.
Hobert sighed and looked out the window: "Our development methods are different. When I open my eyes every day, there are more than two thousand mouths waiting to eat, waiting to get paid to support their families."
"What do you think these 8000 gold coins are enough for?"
Klein didn"t echo his words, but just felt fortunate that he hadn"t built an Beyonder organization that served him so quickly. The Tarot Club was just a gathering, and he, "The Fool," didn"t have to pay any remuneration. On the contrary, he could get a lot of benefits from the Tarot Club.
"Alright, I"ll send you back. Keep in touch in the future." After Hobert finished venting his grievances, he took Klein back to Bayam to continue Gehrman Sparrow"s adventure.
Then, Hobert used "Travel" to return and said to Dennis outside the study: "Go and change the tea. You should go back and rest too."
Before Dennis could return with the tea, Darnell, Hobert"s expected guest, arrived.
This demigod of the Tudor family still looked so amiable and easy to talk to.
The two drank some tea and chatted for a while, and Darnell got to the point: "I apologize for Bunnell"s previous recklessness."
Bunnell was the Tudor family member who claimed to be Hobert"s grandfather.
Hobert smiled: "It"s okay, I forgave him a long time ago."
Darnell was stunned. Hobert"s words proved that he was really angry at the time, otherwise he could have said something like "We are all family" to make the atmosphere of the conversation more harmonious.
This made Darnell secretly scold Bunnell in his heart for being a fool. The patriarch asked him to come and demonstrate first, but he almost completely offended Hobert.
However, Darnell would only say so much. As a demigod, he couldn"t continue to apologize: "I still hope we can facilitate that transaction."
Hobert was a little embarrassed: "You also saw how popular the characteristics of the "Arbiter" Beyonder pathway is."
This was the reason why Hobert invited Darnell to the auction, to let him see what price his channels could buy the "Arbiter" pathway characteristics for.
Darnell smiled: "If we can facilitate this transaction, the family"s resources and power will definitely be more inclined towards your territory."
In fact, even if this transaction was not reached, there would be such an inclination.
After Darnell came to the site and saw it, he found that there were too many investment opportunities and living space for Beyonder powers here, and the family should increase its investment in Jeffery"s territory.
Hobert said with some difficulty: "Well, I am still happy to do business with a gentleman like Mr. Darnell."
"But the price of the Beyonder characteristics cannot be lowered anymore. You also saw that the territory needs money everywhere now. If the price is too low, my capital chain will have problems."
In fact, Hobert also hoped to reach this transaction, because this is the way to make money in the auction house: create scarcity! Raise the price!
Only when an item is very scarce will everyone"s bids go crazy, which is why Hobert only auctioned two Beyonder characteristics tonight.
At the subsequent small auction, he only planned to sell two "low sequence" Beyonder characteristics, once again to whet the customer"s appetite.
Even by the 29th of next month, Hobert didn"t plan to buy another "Interrogator" Beyonder characteristic, but planned to auction a "Briber" Beyonder characteristic.
Just to create scarcity.
Then, since everyone didn"t buy what they wanted at the auction, they would of course ask the auction house to help them pay attention to their needs in the rooms specially prepared by Hobert in the auction hall.
At this time, business will come to your door, because with the auction price as the bottom line, the price of this private transaction will not be low.
Because this is a private transaction, the auction house will never disclose the transaction information to the outside world on the grounds of protecting customer information.
And the other party in the transaction feels that the goods they get are cheaper than the auction items, so of course they will not disclose the transaction with the auction house to the outside world.
As a result, the scarcity of the market still exists.
Public auctions are the signboard of the auction house, while private transactions with customers are the real long-term and profitable transactions.
Before Darnell came, he had already thought that this transaction would cost more gold coins, but he had to do it, because without Hobert"s creation, the scarcity of Beyonder characteristics also generally exists.
It"s just that after Hobert raised the price too high with the auction price, Darnell couldn"t bargain with the "market price".
Darnell took a deep breath and once again regretted that he had not reached a deal last time: "Name your price."
Hobert smiled: "Although I have my difficulties, I still have to take care of Mr. Darnell."
"How about this, basically the same as the last quote: "Arbiter" 400 gold coins, "Sheriff" 1000 gold coins, "Interrogator" 3500 gold coins, "Judge" 8000 gold coins, "Disciplinary Knight" 15000 gold coins."
Hobert raised the price of the "Mid Sequence" Beyonder characteristics slightly.
Darnell breathed a slight sigh of relief. Fortunately, it didn"t grow too outrageously. Although the premium was a lot, it was barely acceptable.
If a "Interrogator" Beyonder characteristic cost 8000 gold coins, Darnell would definitely go back and kill Bunnell immediately.
Darnell asked again: "Is the transaction volume still the same as last time?"
Hobert shook his head: "It would be too disadvantageous for me to trade all the Beyonder characteristics to you."
"I will only give you 12 copies of "Arbiter", 10 copies of "Sheriff", 2 copies of "Interrogator", 2 copies of "Judge", and 1 copy of "Disciplinary Knight"."

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 481 Princess's Warning (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Seiyu for becoming a free member]
Actually, Hobert was still creating scarcity. He later obtained some Beyonder characteristics of the "Arbiter" pathway from the spoils of the "Judgement Group."
He had more than twenty Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 9 "Arbiter," but if he sold them all, the scarcity would disappear, and Darnell would start haggling.
Moreover, the price Hobert was asking was indeed partly due to his dislike for members of the Tudor family.
Hobert's consistent belief was that for people he didn't like, he would make more money off them, which would improve his mood a lot. He would never refuse to do business with someone just because he didn't like them.
When Darnell heard this, the amount was a third less than last time, especially with one less "Judge" Beyonder characteristic. He could even imagine the grand scene of Hobert auctioning off a "Judge" Beyonder characteristic.
"Deal," Darnell said after a moment of consideration.
Hobert took out paper and pen and listed an inventory: 12 "Arbiter" Beyonder characteristics, 4800 gold Lire.
10 "Sheriff" Beyonder characteristics, 10000 gold Lire.
2 "Interrogator" Beyonder characteristics, 7000 gold Lire.
2 "Judge" Beyonder characteristics, 16000 gold Lire.
1 "Disciplinary Knight" Beyonder characteristic, 15000 gold Lire.
"Total value: 52800 gold Lire."
Darnell took the list: "I'll bring the money tomorrow morning."
Hobert said: "I'll have the Beyonder characteristics ready."
The fourth batch of payment was secured.
After seeing Darnell off, Hobert returned to the room. Fors was already asleep.
He quietly slipped into bed, and Fors quickly woke up: "All done?"
"All done."
After some passion, the two cuddled and chatted. They first talked about the auction house and then about the tourism industry in the territory.
"The tourism industry in the territory will take at least several months or even a year or two to develop," Hobert said with one hand on Fors's body. "Even if it develops, the profits won't be as much as the auction house."
"But the tourism industry is our facade and needs to be carefully managed."
Fors held Hobert's hand. This was different from what she had imagined. Given Hobert's investment in the tourism industry, she thought it would also create huge benefits.
Then Fors realized that Hobert was telling her his inner thoughts.
Fors estimated that if Hobert didn't say these plans, no one could guess his thoughts.
This reminded Fors of her childhood when her father and mother sometimes had seemingly casual chats in the restaurant, which were actually moments of true heart-to-heart.
Those were some of her few warm memories, and a sense of happiness filled her heart, making her snuggle closer into Hobert's arms.
Hobert continued: "With the Beyonder Auction House, nobles and wealthy people will definitely visit here often in the future.
"This can greatly boost the tourism industry in Jeffrey Town, promote local economic prosperity, and make some rumors disappear without being refuted.
"I only found out a few days ago that the bastards along the Yawen River have been slandering the Taz River's waterway. The reports of our marriage can just give them a slap in the face.
"When the economy here gradually prospers, the main income of the territory will consist of three parts: the auction house, taxes, and tourism.
"There is also a part of the income, which is the operating revenue of the lord's mansion's directly-run hotels and restaurants, etc. This part of the income cannot be included in the territory's income and is considered our private stash."
Fors also began to imagine the future: "It seems like we can become very rich."
"Of course," Hobert laughed: "Conservatively estimated, the entire territory can earn fifty to sixty thousand gold Lire a month."
In fact, Hobert earned nearly 93,000 gold Lire just tonight, but such opportunities will rarely occur in the future.
Fors smiled: "I never thought that one day I wouldn't have to worry about money.
"After you said that, I want to stay in bed all day and not go anywhere."
Hobert laughed: "Then we'll dance every day and do nothing."
"Dream on."
While chatting, the two fell asleep in each other's arms.
The next day, Hobert had to get up early. Fors patted Hobert while half-asleep, as if sending him off to work.
Hobert looked at Fors, who turned over and continued to sleep, and laughed: "People usually have a goodbye kiss or hug, but our procedure is simple."
As he spoke, he put on his cloak, came to the study, entered the "Nation of Disorder," took out all the Beyonder characteristics, put them into small wooden boxes, and then put them all into a large box.
Soon, Darnell came over with a leather suitcase. One counted the money, and the other checked the goods.
Hobert didn't have time to count the money one by one today, so he could only roughly look at the thickness of the money.
Finally, the money and goods were cleared, and the transaction was completed.
After chatting for a while, Hobert invited Darnell to have breakfast together, and Darnell gladly accepted.
The atmosphere in the restaurant was always harmonious. After breakfast, Darnell politely said goodbye.
Hobert went to the side hall and handed the box of money to Philip, asking him to prepare to purchase the fourth batch of materials while acquiring the third batch of building materials.
Most of the transactions at the auction house last night were done with checks, and Hobert also asked Philip to send someone to the bank to exchange them for cash as soon as possible.
For a time, Philip's funds became very abundant again.
Without even having time to drink a cup of tea, Hobert hurried to the dock to see the guests off.
Because there were only six or seven days left until the next small auction, Hobert simply gave them the main auction items for the next auction while seeing the guests off.
At around ten o'clock in the morning, Princess Ethel's convoy arrived at the dock, and the nobles who were about to leave gave way to the princess.
Hobert and Christian also stepped forward to see her off very politely. When Ethel was about to board the warship, she suddenly stopped and said to Hobert: "I don't care whether your auction house's business is good or bad, but you are not allowed to auction Beyonder characteristics of the 'Arbiter' pathway, 'Mid-Sequence' or above.
"As compensation, the royal family will buy the Beyonder characteristics in your hand at a high price!"
Hobert immediately asked: "How high? I really have an Beyonder characteristic of 'Judge' in my hand."
Ethel frowned. Wouldn't ordinary people be frightened and anxious after hearing her warning?
But seeing Hobert take the initiative to confess the Beyonder characteristics in his hand, Ethel patiently said: "'Judge,' 5000 gold Lire."
"Oh my, look at my memory, how could I have an Beyonder characteristic of 'Judge' in my hand? I do have a 'Lawyer,' I don't know if the royal family accepts it?"
Ethel glared at Hobert, burning with anger: "Be careful I tear down your auction mansion."
"Princess, please calm down," Hobert said with a smile: "Are you satisfied with the sealed item you auctioned yesterday? Actually, if I had a Level 2 sealed item myself, I wouldn't sell it no matter what."
Ethel sneered. Of course, she also suspected that the auction house was a place for the devotees of the "Creator" to dispose of stolen goods. Seeing Hobert soften, her expression eased slightly: "How many gold Lire will it take for you to recall that Beyonder characteristic of 'Judge'?"
"8000!"
Ethel glared at Hobert: "Prepare yourself, there will be someone to trade with you."
After speaking, she boarded the gangway.
Hobert smiled: "Princess, have a safe journey, come and play often!"
Ethel waved her hand without turning her head: "I'll never come again, I'm afraid of being angered to death by you!"
The adjutant behind her almost missed a step. In public, Princess Ethel rarely expressed her negative emotions so clearly.
This made the adjutant look back and take a deep look at Hobert, the baron who seemed to have a sincere smile.
Until the afternoon, all the guests left, and the entire Jeffrey Town and port became deserted for a while.
Hobert believed that with the release of the relevant reports on the wedding, Jeffrey Territory would definitely gain huge popularity, and then it would depend on Jeffrey Town's reception work.
As long as people can be kept for a few nights, the label of a tourist town will gradually form.
In the afternoon, Hobert had time to invite his parents and younger brother Tyron to take a train to tour the scenery of the territory.
On the train, Hobert described the territory's plan to his father, told his mother about the hope of spring plowing, and talked to Tyron about Donna's current job.
In the evening, the family had a happy dinner again. Christian proposed that he would leave with Mona and Tyron tomorrow.
Although a little reluctant, Christian still had a career to be busy with, Tyron had to continue his studies, and Mona had to continue her diplomatic efforts to win more support for her husband.
Fortunately, shipping to Jeffrey Territory has opened. Taking a train and then changing to a passenger ship will take about three days and two nights to get here.
For this era, this is not too long a journey.
Back in the bedroom, Hobert looked at his watch and it was only around seven o'clock in the evening. He hadn't returned so early for several days: "There's still time today, we'll dance later."
Fors looked at Hobert affectionately: "All you know is dancing."
Hobert put his arm around Fors's waist: "I'll take you to see something fun."
As he spoke, he took out the bracelet with the relevant abilities of the "Sleepless," and entered the dream in the oil painting with Fors.
Fors was briefly surprised by the process of entering the oil painting, and then she saw a large tree full of green leaves not far away. The green leaves were brushed by the wind, making a "rustling" sound.
It seemed that this warm summer breeze was blowing on her, making her feel infinitely comfortable and peaceful.
Watching the knee-high green grass being blown into waves, Fors sighed: "If possible, I would like to spend all my time in such a landscape."
Hobert smiled: "This place is indeed beautiful, but it is not suitable for human habitation. Let's go, let's enter that hall."
Seeing the distinct layers of flower sea in the hall, Fors sighed again: "I would like to lie in this sea of flowers until the end of time."
"If I have the ability in the future, I will plant such a sea of flowers for you," Hobert said with a mischievous smile: "I will also lie here with you and dance until the end of time."
Fors smiled and pinched Hobert's waist: "Where is there such an absurd baron?"
Hobert hid himself and Fors with the ability of the bracelet, and smiled: "If I'm not absurd, how am I like a nobleman?"
Soon, the two came to a place with several wooden statues standing. Without exception, these statues looked like they had lost their moisture and had obvious cracks.
Fors was strange: "Why is there a wooden statue of Helen over there?"
"Because when I first met Helen, her spirituality was marked by the oil painting," Hobert said: "The oil painting will continue to invade the dreams of the marked person until it kills them.
"Helen's boss cut off her connection with the spirituality, so the oil painting failed to invade her dream, and her wooden statue here became cracked because it did not have new spirituality to nourish it."
Fors seemed to think of something: "This oil painting has been hanging in your bedroom, how could it mark Helen?"
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth: "Don't you think such extraordinary struggles are magical?"
"I'm more concerned, why did the oil painting mark Helen?"
"Okay, she did come to my bedroom, but my will was strong enough to drive her away."
Fors nodded with a faint smile: "Hmm."
Hobert asked knowingly: "You don't believe it?"
"I believe it!"
"Does your expression look like you believe it? Get ready to pay the price!" As he spoke, Hobert hugged Fors and tickled her.
"I believe it, I believe it, I really believe it!" Fors dodged while laughing: "I know, if you really had something to do with Helen, you wouldn't have asked me for help."
Hobert nodded: "That's more like it."
He looked at the wooden statues in front of him and said: "Today our goal is this magic wolf."
The two looked together at the magic wolf, which was about the size of a rhino. Fors asked: "This should be a Beyonder creature, right?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, finally have time to clean it up!"
He manifested the "Spirit Wine Glass" in the dream, and used the related abilities of the "Corpse Collector" pathway to the spirit body. He grabbed a part of the wooden statue that was essentially spirituality.
When performing this operation, Hobert found that with Mr. Azik's "wedding gift," the operation of the "Spirit Wine Glass" became more convenient, almost at will.
Hobert looked at his palm and guessed that the "wedding gift" should have some other effects waiting for him to discover.
The wooden statue immediately lost a leg, and Hobert had a wisp of mist in his hand. He took out the glass bottle he had prepared long ago, let the "mist" flow into the glass bottle, and then sealed the glass bottle with spirituality.
"Okay!" Hobert said: "We'll come in again to enjoy the scenery when we have time."
As he spoke, the two exited the dream, and Hobert said to Fors: "The next battle is very dangerous for you, you go to rest first."
Fors kissed him lightly on tiptoe: "Be careful."
Hobert smiled and pinched her nose, and came to the study alone.
In fact, he sent Fors away mainly to avoid exposing the "Nation of Disorder."
Currently, the secrets of the "Nation of Disorder" and the identity of the "Creator" cannot be told to anyone, including his bed partner.

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 482 The Fearful Demonic Wolf (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:

[Thanks to Michal Urban for becoming a free member]
If Hobert had directly used the "Faceless Necklace" to divine the whereabouts of the "Demonic Wolf of Fog," it definitely wouldn't have succeeded. Moreover, the "Nation of Disorder" didn't have the "Sefirah Castle"' "divination bonus," making it nearly impossible to find that "Demonic Wolf of Fog."
But having the Demonic Wolf of Fog's spirituality was different. He could bypass the "Demonic Wolf of Fog" and use the spirituality in his hand as a medium to divine the location of another spirituality.
After silently reciting the divination statement seven times, Hobert watched his cane, and as expected, it slowly tilted in one direction.
Hobert immediately used the "Traveler's Knife" to enter the spirit world, traversing rapidly through the dim and obscure realm.
When Hobert's intuition sensed that he was not far from the "Demonic Wolf of Fog," he left the spirit world and found himself in a desolate mountainous area.
This was good, to avoid accidental injury.
It would have been somewhat troublesome if the Demonic Wolf of Fog was hiding in a city.
Hobert estimated that the "Demonic Wolf of Fog's" spirituality already had a corresponding warning. He seized the time to pray to himself, then entered the "Nation of Disorder." After hesitating for about half a second, he reached out and summoned the stomach pouch with mental residue, shaping the "Great Sage," and then threw the black, illusory sea serpent into his own star.
Then, Hobert quickly returned to the real world.
Not sitting on the high "Iron Throne," Hobert realized how shockingly large the "Great Sage" was!
It looked as tall as a building, its body coiled like a small mountain!
Without time to examine it closely, Hobert immediately supported the black serpent's body with his hand and entered the spirit world again.
Fortunately, although the "Great Sage" was large, it had no weight at all. If he really had to cooperate with such a large sea serpent, Hobert doubted whether he could use "Travel" to bring it to the spirit world.
Perhaps because he was carrying the "Great Sage," Hobert felt many restless gazes when he entered the spirit world again.
Fortunately, the subsequent journey was very short. As soon as Hobert left the spirit world, he immediately ordered the "Great Sage": "Kill that… those people!"
Hobert's original order was "Kill that Demonic Wolf of Fog," but Hobert saw a group of people desperately fleeing in the forest ahead. Their running speed far exceeded that of ordinary people. They should be the "Demonic Wolf of Fog" and its marionettes, so he simply changed the order.
At the same time, Hobert hid inside the "Great Sage" and followed the "Great Sage" in pursuit.
To guard against the cunning Demonic Wolf of Fog's escape, Hobert prayed to himself again, then came to the "Nation of Disorder" to cover his star with spirituality, so that the "Creator" could intercept at any time.
The "Great Sage" crawled extremely fast. By the time he entered the "Nation of Disorder," he had almost caught up with the group. Hobert noticed that these people were all contaminated, and it was clear that the "Uncertain Mist"'s contamination had spread again on the "Demonic Wolf of Fog."
The contamination of the old days, how could it be completely eliminated by a single transfer?
Suddenly, someone in the crowd turned around and shouted, "I am willing to pledge allegiance to you! Please…"
Before the other party could finish speaking, the "Great Sage" directly crushed them with the power of order. The other party broke away from the marionette state and turned into a dead wild boar.
Hobert smiled on the "Iron Throne." This wolf was quite flexible.
However, the Beyonder creatures of this pathway were too cunning. Hobert would rather turn it into Beyonder ingredients and valuable spiritual materials than accept such allegiance.
Looking at the running crowd, Hobert seemed to see a pile of gold pounds running away.
Immediately afterward, another person in the fleeing crowd turned around and shouted, "I can find a 'Six-Legged Imp'!"
Hobert was slightly stunned. Obviously, the "Demonic Wolf of Fog" felt the power of order from the behemoth behind it, so it shouted this.
The "complete brain of the Six-Legged Imp" was one of the main ingredients for the "Earl of the Fallen," but Hobert was only stunned for a moment, because he already had the Beyonder characteristics of the "Earl of the Fallen."
The "Great Sage" chased up and crushed this marionette again. At the same time, a series of torrential and huge lightning bolts fell, and the running crowd immediately fell to the ground, leaving only three people still fleeing.
Even if the lightning just now hit the "Demonic Wolf of Fog," it could continue to escape by swapping with a marionette.
And the "Demonic Wolf of Fog's" marionettes were obviously not as strong and all-powerful as the previous batch. Otherwise, the Demonic Wolf of Fog would not have escaped so desperately without even resisting.
At this time, one of the three people turned around and shouted, "I know the location of the Solomon First Empire's Holy Land, Yadro City!"
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert thought to himself: This guy knows quite a lot!
He pondered for a moment before ordering the "Great Sage" to stop chasing. He used his star to project power into the real world, saying: "Come over here, I have something to ask you!"
At this time, in the real world, the image of the "Creator" appeared again. It was a solid figure like a giant. He seemed to be sitting on a throne in a jungle of swords, exuding a holy light, as if he could end all chaos, or bring about complete disorder.
He exuded an aura of majesty, causing people to unconsciously lower their heads and want to submit. His majesty could be felt in a large area around him, and within the range covered by his majesty, his words seemed to be an unquestionable command.
The Demonic Wolf of Fog may have been trying to show his sincerity. The two people running in front stopped together and quickly returned. The three of them knelt on the ground together, with the person in the middle saying, "Great God, please accept my allegiance. I am willing to serve you wholeheartedly."
The "Creator" Hobert didn't seem interested in this: "You said just now that you know the location of Yadro City?"
The Demonic Wolf of Fog kneeling on the ground breathed a sigh of relief. He had guessed right. This was indeed a god of the "Black Emperor" or "Justiciar" pathway, who was not interested in the Beyonder characteristics of the demigod level at all. The location of ancient ruins like Holy Land Yadro City could attract his attention.
"Yes," the Demonic Wolf of Fog said, "I accidentally discovered it while chasing a 'Earl of the Fallen' and hoping to turn him into a marionette.
"But there seemed to be a barrier there, isolating the city from the outside world. I spent a lot of effort to enter the city.
"The city was filled with terrifying power, inhabited by all kinds of monsters with Beyonder abilities.
"I found a few people living there. They were actually descendants of the Trunsoest!
"Through communicating with them, I learned that they were guarding the Night Emperor's ultimate secret, which was said to be able to obtain power greater than that of the gods!
"So I found the place where they said the ultimate secret was kept. At that time, I still had a few marionettes with good attack power. After eliminating a few guards, I searched for a long time, but only found a bottle containing white mist.
'my intuition told me that the mist was unusual, so I took it away.
"Who knew that the bottle contained a very high level of contamination. Only then did I realize that I might have been deceived. The 'Earl of the Fallen' saw that he was no match for me, so he used this contamination to replace their so-called ultimate secret.
"As a result, I took away this swapped so-called 'ultimate secret' and suffered serious contamination."
Hearing this description, Hobert nodded. The Demonic Wolf of Fog was relatively clever, telling his experience all at once, without deliberately blurring anything.
Then he thought: That so-called "ultimate secret" may not have been swapped, but was itself this bottle of white mist contaminated with "Uncertain Mist." Could it be that this bottle of white mist was obtained in the Trunsoest era and contaminated by "Uncertain Mist," which is why it was killed by the Six Gods?
At this time, the Demonic Wolf of Fog said again: "As long as you help me eliminate the contamination on my body, I am willing to take you to Yadro City."
Suddenly, he felt a huge force coming. It turned out that the huge tail of the illusory serpent was whipping towards him. The Demonic Wolf of Fog's eyes were full of fear. He didn't have time to dodge and was hit by the tail, flying out.
The last two marionettes also broke away from the Demonic Wolf of Fog's control and turned into the corpses of wild beasts.
Although the Demonic Wolf of Fog had the strength of "half of Sequence 3," his pathway's body was relatively weak. Of course, his physique was much better than that of an ordinary wolf, but when he encountered a monster of power like the "Great Sage," he was no match at all.
This sweep and fall caused the Demonic Wolf of Fog to return to the appearance of a wolf and spit out two mouthfuls of blood.
It was a white giant wolf the size of a rhino. It had different mystical patterns on its two front legs and chest. These patterns were composed of gray fluff, and it had them at birth.
Only the majestic voice in the air asked: "Are you negotiating with me?"
The Demonic Wolf of Fog glanced at the giant serpent that had instantly become docile and quickly struggled to lie on the ground: "Great existence, please forgive my rashness. I am willing to take you to Holy Land Yadro City."
Under the enormous pressure, the Demonic Wolf of Fog lived like a year, and could only let the god in front of him slaughter him.
He didn't know whether it was a few seconds or a few minutes before he heard the voice in the air say: 'my believer will examine your loyalty."
Hobert reached out on the Iron Throne and sucked away most of the contamination on the Demonic Wolf of Fog's body: "Pray to me once every three days."
Immediately afterward, the enormous pressure disappeared. The Demonic Wolf of Fog understood that he meant that he should pray to him once every three days, and he would help him reduce the contamination.
As for whether he would completely eliminate the contamination for him, it would depend on his performance.
However, the Demonic Wolf of Fog was stunned: I don't even know what god he is? How should I pray to him?
At this moment, a young man wearing a Feynapotter-style cloak crawled out of the belly of the giant black serpent.
The other party bowed slightly to the giant black serpent: "Please go back!"
The mountain-like black serpent spat out its tongue, as if responding to Hobert, and then disappeared into the air.
At this time, the Demonic Wolf of Fog had determined through divination that the young man in front of him was the young man carrying the oil painting that he had encountered at the Boklun Manor before.
He sighed in his heart that his adventure was worthwhile.
What Hobert didn't know was that their current location was in a mountainous area not far from the Boklun Manor.
Not long after the Demonic Wolf of Fog escaped from there, he realized that the contamination on his body was still there, and he had no way to completely remove the contamination on his own.
He naturally thought of the power that had eliminated the contamination of Boklun Manor. After thinking about it for two whole days, the Demonic Wolf of Fog's condition was getting worse and worse, forcing him to make a choice.
The Demonic Wolf of Fog first repeatedly divined the power that could eliminate the contamination, but did not obtain any useful enlightenment. He had to change the direction of divination and divined where his hope of removing the contamination lay.
Because it involved himself, he easily received the revelation: The hope of removing the contamination lies near Boklun Manor.
So the Demonic Wolf of Fog returned here to wait for the so-called hope.
Just when his condition was so bad that he was about to lose control, his intuition sensed a huge danger. When he saw the giant black serpent, he realized that there was also a huge opportunity for him in the face of the giant danger!
After that, there was the scene where he fled while explaining his value.
The Demonic Wolf of Fog, whose mood was indescribable as happy or confused, smiled at Hobert and said, "You are the god's believer, right?"
Hobert said: "You can call me Favored of the Lord."
"Yes, Favored of the Lord," the Demonic Wolf of Fog said, 'my name is Archibald."
Hobert was slightly stunned: Another animal with a name.
He said: "Tell me about your abilities."
Archibald changed back into a gentle middle-aged man again: "I am born with the ability to create and control marionettes by controlling spiritual threads.
There are also divination and anti-divination, as well as the ability to change my appearance and size. I can also use damage transfer, manipulate flames, and other abilities.
These abilities are probably equivalent to Sequence 3 'Scholar of Yore' of human Beyonders."
Hobert asked: "Do you have any abilities related to historical voids?"
Archibald shook his head: "I seem to be able to sense the existence of historical voids, but I can't enter them, nor can I borrow power from the past."
Hobert nodded. This should be the lack of Beyonder characteristics, so he doesn't have these abilities.
So Hobert said: "The great "Creator" has issued a divine decree, asking me to examine your character and loyalty.
For the next period of time, you will stay by my side as my servant. I will let you create marionettes, and you can only create marionettes. Without my order, you cannot have new marionettes, nor can you attack anyone around you."
Archibald nodded again quickly: "Yes."
The power shown by the "Creator" and the giant black serpent just now made him dare not disobey the young man in front of him who seemed to only be Sequence 5.
Hobert asked: "Are you still carrying the bottle containing the mist that you obtained from Holy Land Yadro City?"
"After realizing that it was contamination, I immediately threw it away," Archibald said a little embarrassedly: "I went back to look for it. The bottle should be a magical item. It is no longer in the place where I discarded it.
And maybe the things in the bottle are too high-level. I have tried it, and I can no longer divine its location."
Hobert said "Oh" and did not continue to talk about this topic. He simply explained a few words and took Archibald back to his territory.
He planned to observe Archibald for a period of time before letting him take himself to find Holy Land Yadro City to see if there was any relevant information about the "Trunsoest Empire."
As for those descendants of Trunsoest in the city of Saint Yadaro, Hobert believed they were likely the group that the messenger had mentioned earlier, who had fled north.
If they still possessed the bottles containing the 'Uncertain Mist' contamination, Hobert strongly suspected that they had become followers of the 'Uncertain Mist'.
Therefore, Hobert planned to make ample preparations before exploring the city, hoping to save them if possible, but if not, to turn them into Beyonder characteristics.
After Dennis arranged Archibald's accommodation, Hobert returned to his room.
Because Archibald still carried contamination and sought help from the 'Creator,' from himself, Hobert was certain that with its intelligence, it wouldn't cause trouble in his territory.
Fors was wearing pajamas, leaning lazily against the bed reading a magazine.
After Hobert entered, she put down the magazine and asked, "Successful hunt?"
"Sort of, I guess." Hobert thought as he took off his cloak: The prey became a servant, does that count as success?
"As long as you're not hurt." Fors said, without even a hint of getting up or moving.
Hobert pinched Fors's cheek: "Little lazybones, shouldn't you be taking my cloak and coat and offering me a cup of hot tea at this moment?"
Fors said seriously, "But I don't feel like I have any strength at all, not even enough to lift my hand. Do you think I'm sick?"
"Based on your description and usual symptoms, I know what's wrong."
Fors was a little nervous: "What is it?"
"Late-stage lazyitis, incurable!"
...
The next morning, Hobert, Donna, and the rarely early Fors saw Christian and the others off.
They watched the steamboat leave the lake entrance before Hobert, and the other two, rode back in the carriage.
On the way back, Hobert had Dennis invite Bishop Simpson, Helen, and Angus.
Now that the wedding was over, it was time to get down to business.
Archibald had clearly lived in the human world, and understood the profession of a servant very well, almost immediately entering servant mode, bowing slightly and following respectfully behind the carriage.
It would also open doors for Hobert, pull out chairs, etc., showing even more professionalism than Dennis.
Hobert and the four others met in the side hall to discuss launching an attack on the demons across the lake.
They would prepare for a day and then launch a full-scale attack tomorrow morning.
Of course, it would be a full-scale attack because a sneak attack would be pointless. The demons would probably notice their intention to sneak attack as soon as it arose.
It was better to just launch a full-scale attack.
And Hobert and the four others believed that even if those demons noticed their malice, they wouldn't run away.
Because they had a demigod and five Sequence 5s, making them stronger than Hobert and his group in terms of strength.
They would only prepare for battle in advance, waiting for Hobert and the others to come to their doorstep.
Therefore, Hobert formally sent a letter of challenge, roughly meaning that the demons should get out of the South Colson area, or tomorrow he would lead people to the other side and kill them all!
Hobert sent someone to deliver this letter of challenge to Viscount Teuton, asking Viscount Teuton to pass it on to the demons.
The meaning of the letter of challenge was actually to notify Viscount Teuton that they were about to take action, and to tell Viscount Teuton not to get in the way.
It would be best if he could provoke those demons and make them take the initiative to attack, but the other side were all high-IQ 'criminals,' and Hobert estimated it would be difficult to provoke them.
Bishop Simpson and the others returned to their respective preparations. This cooperation had long been confirmed, and they had each been looking forward to this battle for their own purposes.
After the pre-war mobilization, Hobert spoke with Seel in the main hall: "What have you learned from regularly working as a hunter during this period?"
"I understand the use of some of my abilities." Dressed in a military uniform, looking neat and tidy, Seel stood smiling in front of Hobert, "I also understand why you asked me to be a hunter, Sir."
"When I fully devoted myself to hunting and achieved certain results, I felt signs of the potion dissolving in my body."
"That feeling is very comfortable, and my abilities have become stronger."
"Until a few days ago, I realized that although hunters have a good physique and pre-arranged traps, they can't be careless and can't underestimate any prey."
"Especially those fierce prey, one might accidentally become its prey."
"Also, hunters must be patient and know when to stop."
"After understanding these issues, I suddenly realized that I am a real 'Hunter.' This feeling is wonderful, but also very real."
Hobert allowed his majesty to permeate the main hall, causing his aura to soar suddenly, putting a strain on Seel's spirit body and mind.
Observing Seel's reaction, Hobert nodded in satisfaction. Seel had spent more than a month digesting the 'Hunter' potion.
Retracting his suffocating majesty, Hobert said, "Go back and calm down. Come back at five in the afternoon, and I will give you the next sequence's potion."
"But you must be clear that, based on the merits you have accumulated, you theoretically shouldn't receive the Sequence 8 potion yet."
"This is because you have digested the potion in your body, and I don't want you to waste time, so I'm giving you the next sequence's potion in advance."
"In two or three days, I will take you to suppress bandits. Fight hard at that time, and that will be considered repayment for the current reward."
Seel gave a military salute: "Yes, sir!"
"You have another task." Hobert said, "Pay attention to the performance of the soldiers in battle. After the battle, recommend three to five soldiers who are brave in combat or quick-witted, and who are sufficiently loyal to the Lord's Manor."
"After you become Sequence 8, there must be several Sequence 9s in the guard."
"You will be the captain of the guard at that time, and those Sequence 9s will be the backbone of the guard."
Seel said seriously, "Don't worry, you know what kind of people those brats are. I will definitely recommend the people you need."
Hobert nodded in satisfaction. After Seel left, Hobert had Dennis call Corwin over: "Go around the territory and help me take a look at the spring plowing situation."
"By the way, when everyone is resting, issue a notice: After the spring plowing is over, find ten people who want to be doctors to come to the Lord's Manor."
"After I assess them, I will arrange for three people to go to the big city to study medicine. In the future, after the hospital is built, they will be stationed there."
The so-called "opportunity to study in a big city" was actually an opportunity to take the 'Apothecary' potion.
Hobert was busy handling official business all morning.
After lunch, Hobert first went to Backlund to buy auxiliary materials for Seel.
When he returned, Fors was indeed not in the bedroom.
Hobert waited patiently until three o'clock. His vision was obscured by the gray fog, and this week's Tarot Gathering began.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 483 The Unchanging Tarot Time (Bonus 4)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to D_J for becoming a free member]
The sudden busyness after the wedding made Hobert somewhat unaccustomed, but the weekly Tarot Gathering immediately gave Hobert the feeling of returning to his original life track.
While "Justice" Audrey greeted everyone, Hobert looked at Fors across from him, feeling that it was better not to reveal to her for the time being that he was "The Emperor."
That would lead to many inconveniences, such as making it difficult to explain to Fors why "The Emperor" was so knowledgeable, and the issue of being a Blessed of "The Creator."
Moreover, some things would be difficult to say at the Tarot Gathering because, before speaking, he would have to consider how to explain things to Fors after the meeting.
However, to prevent Fors from recognizing his identity as "The Emperor" later, Hobert decided to give Fors some psychological preparation in life first.
For example, he could slowly reveal his identity as a Blessed of "The Creator" to her, and then find an opportunity to reveal that he was a descendant of the Tudor family, instead of revealing that he was a descendant of the Trunsoest family right away.
With these psychological preparations, if necessary, or if Fors noticed something, Hobert could say with a surprised face: You're also a member of the Tarot Gathering? You're Miss Magician, right? I thought such a gentle and lovely lady looked so much like my beautiful and charming wife!
Fors across from him thought: "The Emperor's" gaze is a bit strange. What is he smiling at? Is there something dirty on my clothes?
Hobert quickly withdrew his gaze and glanced at Emlyn beside him: This guy should have successfully advanced, looking full of... no, completely smug! He can't wait to show off right now.
Looking at "Little Sun" again: He also advanced. Maybe he can't control his overflowing spirituality yet. Just looking at him gives people a very sunny feeling.
Then Hobert suddenly realized that almost all the members present had just attended his wedding!
First of all, "The Fool" Klein, sitting at the head of the table, not only attended but also helped greet the guests.
"Justice" Audrey and "The Moon" Emlyn also appeared at the wedding.
During the blessing session, Hobert could tell that although Emlyn looked like he was saying, "I didn't want to come, someone forced me to come," it was easy to see from his eyes and some details that he actually wanted to make friends.
Miss "Magician" across from him is the bride, and "The Emperor" is the groom.
Out of eight members, five appeared at the wedding.
Speaking of which, this wedding was a bit like a Tarot Gathering "offline event."
While he was lost in thought, Audrey had already greeted everyone.
At this gathering, none of the members had collected any Roselle's Diary entries, so they skipped directly to the free trade session.
Hobert opened his mouth and said, "Help me look out for the bone marrow of a Six-Legged Imp and the powder of an Atlanta flower."
This time, "The Hermit" Cattleya chose to intervene in a transaction: "I know where to find Atlanta flowers. You can buy them, dry them, and grind them into powder yourself.
"Based on my experience, one Atlanta flower can be ground into about 20 grams of powder. I don't know if that's enough for you?"
"Enough." Hobert only needed 15 grams.
"800 pounds for one! But I can only give it to you next week."
Hobert smiled and said, "Okay, deal!"
Cattleya added, "As for the 'bone marrow of a Six-Legged Imp,' I heard about it at an Beyonder gathering once, but that was a long time ago. I can help you contact the seller, but don't have too high hopes."
Hobert nodded, "Thank you."
No one else had heard of this material in their respective circles, not even "The Hanged Man" Alger, who had a wide circle of contacts, which made him feel a sense of crisis again, as if his position was insecure.
After cleanly finishing a transaction, "Little Sun" said again, "Seeking the 'Notary' potion formula, but I can only pay the related reward with Beyonder ingredients."
At last week's gathering, Cattleya had noticed this: Is the place where "The Sun" is located using Beyonder ingredients as currency? Is there such a place? Everyone was not surprised by this, indicating that everyone knew "The Sun's" special nature and could accept the method of paying with Beyonder ingredients.
At this time, "The World" said in a hoarse voice, "I can provide you with the 'Notary' potion formula, but you have to wait a little while."
When he releases the soul of the "Priest of Light" inside the "Creeping Hunger," he will get the corresponding formula.
"Little Sun" nodded, "I can wait, but it's best not to wait too long."
He was confident that he could digest the "Solar High Priest" potion in three or four months. Before completely digesting the potion, it would be best to know the potion formula and start collecting materials in advance.
"The World" nodded, "Within a month."
After reaching this transaction intention, "The World" added, "I need the 'residual spirituality of an ancient wraith'."
"I can help you buy it." Cattleya did not choose to watch this time, "600 pounds."
"Okay!" Klein immediately manipulated "The World" to agree. He had already traded for the other two auxiliary Ingredients, "water from the Golden Spring of Sonia Island," at the Beyam Beyonder gathering.
The last item, "bark of the Dragon-Marked Tree," was not urgent for the time being, so he planned to buy it at the next Tarot Gathering, or the one after that.
Anyway, there was still some time before he completely digested the potion.
The other members did not have any potion needs for the time being. After a brief silence, Audrey initiated a transaction again, "I hope to obtain a magical item that can change appearance. Please help me keep an eye out."
At the previous Tarot Gathering, when she heard "The World" and "The Emperor" trading for the "Faceless" Beyonder characteristic, she felt it was a pity that it was not a magical item.
If there was a magical item that could change appearance, she could boldly participate in some events with another face.
Everyone did not have this type of magical item on hand or in their respective circles, so they all said they would help her keep an eye out.
Audrey was about to initiate a new transaction with "The Emperor," but before she could speak, she noticed that "The Hermit" seemed to have something to say.
So Audrey chose to wait and see, letting "The Hermit" speak first.
Cattleya said to "The Emperor," "I hope to trade with you for detailed information about the Tudor Empire!"
Hobert nodded, "As said last time, 5,000 pounds... um, wait, there's a problem here. Do you know the United Empire?"
Everyone shook their heads blankly, except for Cattleya, who said, "I've seen related descriptions, but I don't know the nature of this empire or the specific time it appeared."
"In that case, this transaction will be 6,000 pounds." Hobert said, "I have to start with the United Empire. This is a very important stage that is easily overlooked."
"No problem." Then Cattleya learned from Audrey's crowdfunding method at the last gathering, "As the initiator, I'll contribute 2,000 pounds. Who else wants to join the transaction?"
Audrey immediately said, "Me! 1,500 pounds!"
Originally, she wanted to trade with Hobert for information about the Trunsoest Empire, but information about the Tudor Empire was also fine, as this was exactly what she wanted to know.
The initiators, "The Hermit" and "Justice," had already raised 3,500 pounds, and others joined the transaction one after another. Alger had just eliminated a small pirate group last week and was in good financial condition.
As for Fors, needless to say, her savings had reached more than 2,000 pounds, and she shouldn't have to spend money on Beyonder ingredients, potion formulas, or magical items in the future.
The potion formula and some Beyonder ingredients were provided by her teacher, Dorian, and the magical items and Beyonder ingredients that Dorian couldn't provide were provided by Hobert.
A model of "lying down and winning."
Emlyn still had the money he saved last week, so he would not hesitate to join in such transactions.
This time, even "The World" did not hesitate. Also through the last gathering, Klein discovered that "5,000-pound level" transactions had very high integrity, and the money was well spent.
Soon, everyone completed the crowdfunding, totaling 5,500 pounds plus two Beyonder ingredients.
"Speaking of the Tudor Empire, we have to start with the Solomon Empire." Hobert began to narrate, "As we said during the last transaction, Emperor Alista Tudor of the Tudor Empire was also a noble of the Solomon Empire.
"But he was bewitched by the Six Gods... cough cough, moved by the Six Gods, and became an internal agent of the Six Gods, directly leading to the fall of 'Black Emperor' Solomon.
"After destroying the Solomon Empire and severely hitting the True Creator, the Six Gods supported Tudor and Trunsoest, who had each become Sequence 1, to establish the United Empire and rule the entire Northern Continent..."
Everyone then understood that this was the so-called "United Empire" era.
Audrey carefully recalled: I have never heard of any records of this era in the history classes I took. This period of history should be buried in the mists of history.
Klein, however, thought of a term mentioned by Roselle in his diary, "Dual Consul Era." Roselle expressed his doubts in the diary, and Klein did not quite understand what it meant when he read it at the time. Now he finally knew what it represented.
Then he thought of another thing: "The Emperor's" description reminded me of the ruins found in Backlund. I remember that there were two thrones on the high platform at the same time. At that time, Miss Sharron and I didn't understand why there was such a structure. Could those be the thrones of these two rulers?
Alger, however, realized: Two Sequence 1s of the same pathway were actually "twisted" together by the Six Gods to establish a common empire. Such cooperation always felt coercive, and such an empire should be full of contradictions, right?
Emlyn was surprised: As a Sanguine, I have never heard of the "United Empire" era! Perhaps I should consult the elders in the Sanguine clan who study history and make up for my lessons so that they don't see that I am unaware and lower the status of the learned Sanguine in their hearts.
Cattleya simply exclaimed, "So that's how it is."
Many previously seemingly contradictory clues suddenly came together.
Fors listened carefully, almost taking out her notebook to record these little-known histories!
Only "Little Sun" did not have much feeling, purely listening to it as a story.
Seeing everyone looking thoughtful, Hobert thoughtfully paused for a few seconds before continuing, "According to some documents I have read, Tudor and Trunsoest had a relatively harmonious relationship during the Solomon Empire.
"But after each established their own empire, they quickly broke up. I think they should have had irreconcilable contradictions from the 'United Empire' era.
"There are probably two reasons. The first is the issue of power. Since it is dual rule, and it is not clear which is the head of state? Which is the ruler?
"Then there will inevitably be a situation of power checks and balances, which is also what the Six Gods want to see most. It's just that Tudor and Trunsoest are two ambitious people! How could they be willing to share power with others?
"The second reason is naturally that both of them are 'High Sequence' Beyonders of the same pathway. If they want to become gods, then they are the strongest competitors between them!
"The reason why this reason is placed second is because since they have each accepted the arrangements of the 'United Empire,' it means that in the early days of the 'United Empire,' their rationality made them choose to compromise with the Six Gods.
"At this time, some of the influences of the Beyonder characteristics have not occupied all of their sanity."
Everyone listened carefully, with "The Emperor" telling these secret histories like a legendary story.
Hobert continued, "The honeymoon period of the 'United Empire' should only be a short time. There is evidence that there are some ruins left by Tudor around Backlund..."
Those are the tombs.
Audrey immediately asked, "Backlund?"
"Yes." Hobert replied, "The capital of the 'United Empire' is the current Backlund."
He continued, "Those ruins are enough to prove that Tudor had been preparing to advance to 'Black Emperor' during the 'United Empire' era.
"And if He wants to become the 'Black Emperor,' He must kill Trunsoest and take away that Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic."
This sentence contained a lot of information for Klein, Alger, and Cattleya.
Alger had speculated about the process of becoming a god countless times before. Since knowing the related information about Uniqueness, he once thought that accommodating Uniqueness could become a god. But now, according to The Emperor, becoming a god seems to require multiple Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics?
Cattleya had similar guesses early on: Is becoming a god also a process of accumulating Beyonder characteristics?
The most gain from this was Klein: I had previously seen from Roselle's diary his speculation about the Beyonder characteristics required to become a god. The history of the 'United Empire,' combined with the current Loen royal family and the Castiya royal family, shows that the number of Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics is very small. After a True God appears in a pathway, all the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics may be with the True God, and the number of Sequence 2s will also become extremely limited.
Because of their lack of knowledge reserves, the other members, although they understood what "The Emperor" meant, failed to think about the rules that might be contained behind it.
"I don't know what impression everyone has of Tudor, but my impression is that he is cunning, treacherous, and very cautious." Hobert said, "As far as I know, even now, the Seven Gods are not very clear about the specific locations of those ruins.
"These ruins were built during the 'United Empire' period. Back then, not only were the Six Gods supporters of Tudor, but Trunsoest was also His partner.
"If he had been given more time, he might have become the second 'Black Emperor'."
"Perhaps Solomon, after his previous fall, sensed a great threat and decided to revive ahead of schedule. Of course, this is just my speculation. The commonly accepted reason is that Solomon's revival put immense pressure on Tudor and Trunsoest, forcing them to take risks and make their respective arrangements."
"The cause and effect between the two are almost reversed, but the commonly accepted reason is difficult to explain the ruins left by Tudor, after all, those couldn't be built in just a year or two. It's also difficult to explain why Solomon had to revive at such a terrible time."
Hobert deliberately expressed himself vaguely at this point, but everyone understood what he meant.
Only Klein found it strange: That's not right, with two Sequence 1s in a pathway, can the True God of that pathway still revive? Is what revived really the True God? Or is there something wrong with my guess?
The others didn't have the relevant concepts and assumed that a True God is a True God, and a Sequence 1 is a Sequence 1, and the two don't affect each other.
This also makes sense. Tudor and Trunsoest had betrayed Solomon before, so of course they were afraid of Solomon's revenge after his revival.
Seeing that everyone didn't ask questions at this point, Hobert quickly continued, "The above is the relevant information about the 'United Empire'. We will mainly talk about the arrangements Tudor made to deal with Solomon's revival.
"Because the True God of the adjacent pathway has been occupied by Trunsoest, He can only take a risk and jump to a non-adjacent pathway to become a god!"
This information once again surprised all the members. Audrey was the first to ask, "Emperor, as a Beyonder, I mean, can the process of advancing to a True God jump to a non-adjacent pathway?"
"Why were those ancient gods of the Second Epoch all crazy?" Hobert asked rhetorically, "Isn't it because they didn't have a very intuitive concept of sequences and pathways!
"Could it be that a lot of madness accumulated because of jumping between non-adjacent pathways?
"Of course, the eight ancient gods were very lucky, or they already had a rough concept of Beyonder pathways. In short, their 'jumps' weren't too outrageous.
"With everyone's knowledge, you should also understand that jumping to a non-adjacent pathway, going mad or dying directly is the best outcome. The greater probability is becoming a monster and completely losing oneself."
"The Hanged Man" then asked, "At the level of a True God, performing this kind of non-adjacent pathway advancement... I mean, what was the Blood Emperor's state at the time?"
"He became very crazy and bloodthirsty, but he still retained some rationality," Hobert replied.
Because of the "Queen Mystic", Cattleya knew a little about the answer to this question, but she didn't expect that the Blood Emperor had also performed such an operation.
She was more concerned: "Is there any possibility of recovering from such madness?"
Hobert glanced at Cattleya: "As far as I know, the True Gods of some pathways can use some characteristics of their own pathways to 'wash away' the madness.
"But most pathways can't do this."
Audrey asked again, "Which pathway did the Blood Emperor jump to? Which pathway's True God did he become?"
"Red Priest! That is, the 'Hunter' pathway that everyone is familiar with," Hobert replied.
Everyone immediately thought of the Feysac Empire's royal family, and the Intis royal family overthrown by Emperor Roselle.
Klein manipulated "The World" and asked in a hoarse voice, "This reminds me of the 'Red Angel'. Is there any connection between them?"
Except for Cattleya, everyone recalled the relevant content of the "Angel of Kings".
"This is exactly what I'm going to talk about next," Hobert said with a smile, "At the end of the 'United Empire', 'Red Angel' Medici designed a trap for Sauron and Einhorn.
"I think you should be familiar with these two names. That's right, Sauron is the ancestor of the Sauron family of the overthrown Intis royal family, and Einhorn is the ancestor of the current Einhorn family of the Feysac Empire's royal family.
"Medici needed their Beyonder characteristics to advance. While Medici succeeded, Tudor, along with Adam and Amon, killed Medici, and then snatched their Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics, advancing to become a True God!"
Without exception, everyone showed shocked expressions. They never expected that there would be such a shocking murder in the Fourth Epoch!
Klein behind the gray fog: The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind? This is the first time I've heard that even the opportunity to become a god can be snatched!
If Hobert knew what Klein was thinking at this moment, he would definitely say, "You will encounter people who specialize in snatching other people's godhood in the future."
After being surprised, Alger was extremely excited: There can still be such an operation, so can I... Hehe, what am I thinking? Before participating in the Tarot Club, my goal was to become a Sequence 5, and then leave the Church to establish my own power. Later, I imagined becoming a demigod, becoming an angel, and now I'm even planning to become a god? What a blasphemous and presumptuous idea... But it's still nice to just think about it.
Cattleya sighed: If it weren't for the "Emperor's" narration, I probably wouldn't have known this secret in my life. Who would have thought that the Blood Emperor became the "Emperor" in this way?
After a brief surprise, Audrey returned to the state of "Spectator": This is the true face of this world, filled with madness and plunder.
Fors thought: This is very similar to a palace coup! What we see and hear are just the results of the coup, and this process is actually full of killing and moral decay.
"Little Sun": The North and South Continents are really chaotic.
Emlyn: No, I have to catch up on history lessons after the gathering. I didn't even know such important information?
Hobert waited a few seconds before continuing, "Not long after, Solomon did revive. As Tudor became the Blood Emperor, Trunsoest became the Night Emperor.
"In addition to the Underworld Emperor of the Southern Continent, the 'Era of the Four Emperors' arrived.
"After a period of confrontation, and after a certain amount of accumulation and brewing, the 'War of the Four Emperors' finally broke out.
"This battle seemed to last for a while. At the beginning of the battle, Mr. 'Door', the strongest in the Tudor Empire, was exiled, and Zaratul, the nobleman of the Solomon Empire, was killed by Antigonus and others.
"As if it was a premonition, the first to fall was Solomon, the revived Black Emperor, and the second to fall was Tudor, the Blood Emperor!"
