chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 484 A Brief History of the Medici Family (Bonus 5)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Leonardo Cabrera for becoming a free member]
Everyone held their breath and listened attentively to "Emperor's" account of the real events of the "War of the Four Emperors" during the Fourth Epoch.
Before this, they had all thought that the battle was a contest of military strength and overall national power between the four empires.
They thought it was a series of epic battles that eventually formed a moving and magnificent history.
Now, everyone realized that the "War of the Four Emperors" was actually an extraordinary battle of a very high level, and this battle, which most people were unaware of, determined the course of Fourth Epoch history.
'the specific process of the Blood Emperor's fall has been buried deep in history," Hobert said. "However, I have some guesses about the process of His fall.
"It should be that the Night Emperor and the Underworld Emperor joined forces to cause the Blood Emperor to fall. They may have reached some kind of agreement, or it may be that the two emperors tacitly eliminated the most uncertain one among the Four Emperors.
'the indirect evidence of their alliance is that the Underworld Emperor obtained the Uniqueness of the 'Red Priest' pathway, while Trunsoest obtained at least one Sequence 1 characteristic.
'that Sequence 1 was given to the Einhorn family among the imperial nobles, which is now the royal family of the Feysac Empire.
"I don't know about the original Intis royal family, the Sauron family, but the royal family of the Feysac Empire must have a Sequence 1, otherwise it would be impossible to fight with the Loen Kingdom for so many years without showing obvious signs of decline.
"If the original Intis royal family, the Sauron family, also had a Sequence 1, or had a Sequence 1 in the past, then the Night Emperor must have received two Sequence 1 of the 'Red Priest' pathway in this battle."
The other members slowly nodded, feeling that "Emperor's" guess was reasonable.
Klein behind the gray fog: So, "Emperor" knew the outcome of the division of spoils in this battle, so he knew that the Underworld Emperor had the Uniqueness of the 'red Priest" pathway. But the question remains: What does the Underworld Emperor want the Uniqueness of the 'red Priest" for?
Cattleya looked ahead: The result of the War of the Four Emperors still affects us today, or rather, the result of their division of the spoils of victory still affects us today.
Audrey couldn't help but imagine: How intense would the war of the Four Emperors, or rather, the war of the gods, be?
Fors held her chin: I really want to write a biography novel about this! It's a pity that this information cannot be made public.
Emlyn was still in deep self-doubt: Is this really the history of the "War of the Four Emperors"? Why is the ending the only thing that is the same as the historical knowledge I know? As a Sanguine known for his erudition and long life, am I really qualified?
"Finally, let's briefly talk about the descendants of the Tudor family," Hobert said with a smile. 'the reason for providing this information is because I know them relatively well.
"According to my observation, the descendants of the Blood Emperor are relatively special. Perhaps due to the influence of being half-mad, the Blood Emperor doesn't seem to have prepared any way out for himself.
'this has led to the current descendants of the family not doing very well. Well, at least the two branches of descendants I know of seem to be in dire straits.
"Although the members of the Trunsoest family are not very numerous due to special reasons, they have inherited high-level Sealed Artifacts and Beyonder characteristics."
The Balk family at least inherited two Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, while Rafter's family pitifully only had one Grade 1 Sealed Artifact.
The situation of Christian's Tudor family may be a little better, but Hobert believes that they probably don't have any Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts either.
Klein immediately thought: Do the Chosen of the "Creator" have a large number of descendants of the three emperors? Did "Emperor" come to this conclusion after seeing the descendants of those families among the Chosen?
He manipulated 'the World" and asked: "What about the descendants of 'Black Emperor' Solomon, whom we discussed at the last gathering?"
"As far as I know, there are mainly two branches, in addition to some descendants who have changed their names and are unwilling to live the life of an Beyonder family anymore," Hobert did not hide this information. "One branch is in the Northern Continent, with a Sequence 3.
"One branch is in the Berserk Sea, which is the 'King of the Five Seas' that we all know!"
Klein suddenly recalled: I saw a description of the current "King of the Five Seas" in Roselle's diary. The "Black Emperor" ship was bestowed upon Nast by Roselle.
Alger almost stood up, not knowing whether it was a question or a self-question: "'The Five Seas... King of the Five Seas' is a descendant of the Solomon Empire?"
Then he seemed to have thought of something: "I should have thought of it long ago, after all, his flagship is the 'Black Emperor' ship!"
Cattleya had already known this, but she still couldn't help but sigh: "Emperor" knows too much! I don't believe that there would be such records in the Trunsoest family's books!
Audrey and Fors and others all had a feeling that history and the present were connected, as if they had constructed a perfect historical logic, or a historical closed loop, in their minds.
Hobert leaned back in his chair: 'the above is all the information about the Tudor Empire.
"I personally feel that although the Blood Emperor did not achieve the final victory, he was the most unrestrained one: I came, I was world-renowned, and I left."
Everyone seemed to see the Blood Emperor, full of madness, laughing and leaving when he fell. They didn't know whether it was the Beyonder characteristics that made Him so crazy, or whether He was so crazy himself?
After savoring it for a while, everyone came back to their senses from the previous transaction and entered the next free exchange session.
'the World" first smiled gloomily: "I received news that the Storm Church has taken action, and the matter of Bansy Harbor has been initially resolved."
Alger, who had been floating at sea for the past week and had no contact with the Church, immediately asked: "What was the final result?"
Klein manipulated 'the World" and said: "For a period of time, there will be no more Bansy Harbor."
It was not until this time that Audrey and others understood what they were discussing.
Bansy Harbor was the place where the descendants of Medici, suspected to be 'red Angel," lived!
Did Mr. "World" mean that the Storm Church had flattened Bansy Harbor? That's really their style!
I just don't know if Medici's descendants escaped? Did the Pope of the Storm Church come to the scene in person? Did they use any Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts?
While these questions popped up in Audrey's mind, she asked: 'mr. Emperor, did Medici's descendants flee to Bansy Harbor after their ancestor was murdered?"
"Perhaps that's the case, but perhaps they didn't escape much, just hid their tracks," Hobert analyzed. "At that time, the enemy of the 'United Empire' was the Underworld Emperor of the Southern Continent.
"'Red Angel' and his people would generally appear at the forefront of the war. Perhaps the descendants of 'Red Angel' were fighting in the Berserk Sea at that time.
"After learning that Medici was killed, they withdrew from the battlefield, but they didn't completely side with Trunsoest like the Sauron and Einhorn families."
Audrey then asked curiously: "Why didn't they do this? Is there any unknown secret in this?"
Hobert pondered for a moment: 'the following is my guess, and I'm not sure if it's true.
"First of all, Medici set up a trap to deceive Sauron and Einhorn. The two sides were mortal enemies, and Trunsoest could only accept one of them, so of course He would accept two Beyonder families and abandon the Medici family.
"Because Tudor finally obtained Medici's spoils of victory, the Medici family regarded the Tudor Empire as a mortal enemy and would not go to join the Blood Emperor.
"And in the previous battles, the three extraordinary families of the 'Red Priest' pathway must have been at the forefront, and it would be difficult for the Underworld Emperor to accept the Medici family.
"Even if the Underworld Emperor was willing to accept them, they probably wouldn't dare to go, because from a very early time, the Underworld Emperor had been cooperating with the Demoness Sect, and it cannot be ruled out that they would be tricked into becoming Beyonder characteristics."
Everyone was stunned. Klein was the first to react. He manipulated 'the World" and asked: "Are 'Assassin' and 'Hunter' adjacent pathways?"
'that's right!" Because this was just Hobert's guess, he didn't intend to charge for this information. As for the information that "Witch" and "Hunter" are adjacent pathways, just consider it a free broadcast on this Tarot Gathering.
Cattleya also realized the value of this conversation. Originally, she didn't quite understand what these people were talking about regarding Bansy Harbor and 'red Angel."
But the following conversation was very informative. There was actually information about the recent situation of the descendants of the "King of Angels," and those descendants seemed to be hiding in Bansy Harbor.
As a pirate admiral, Cattleya certainly knew about Bansy Harbor, so she listened very carefully. She planned to carefully record these conversations and review them when she had time.
'the second reason," Hobert said, "It's not difficult to hear from 'The World's' previous description that the so-called 'God of Weather' sounds like an evil god. I seriously suspect that the state of Medici's descendants should not be very good.
"As for why they are not very good, of course, it is unknown. Perhaps they have been affected by something? Perhaps there is some corruption in Bansy Harbor? Perhaps they were injured in battle?
"In short, a Sequence 2 in a not-so-good state is best to hide their tracks, otherwise they will be very dangerous."
Hobert remembered that Klein later seemed to have discovered an entrance to the suspected "City of Calamity" in Bansy Harbor. It is possible that this entrance was infiltrated from the "Western Continent."
After the passage of time, some Sephirot seems to have infiltrated the North and South Continents.
For example, the "River of Eternal Darkness" should be the earliest Sefirah to infiltrate, or rather, the earliest to be used by gods outside the seal.
But of course, this information cannot be made public yet.
Audrey then asked 'the World," who was at the lower end of the bronze table: 'mr. World, do you know the specific process?"
"World" shook his head slightly: "No, no one can understand, except for the higher-ups of the Storm Church."
Alger fell silent: I must become a higher-up in the Church!
He emphasized to himself once.
Cattleya said to "Emperor": "I hope to trade information about the 'King of Angels' with you."
"Of course, no problem." Hobert smiled and said: "I'll give you a discount, just consider it as you joining the previous gathering's transaction, so I'll give you the crowdfunding price: 1000 pounds."
Cattleya didn't even think about it: "No problem."
Klein sighed: Are pirate generals so rich?
Next, Cattleya once again experienced the joy of pursuing knowledge, and at the same time, it surprised her many times: 'the 'King of Angels' actually involves the Ancient Sun God? So He also needs some subordinates!
This Third Epoch God is becoming so concrete in my mind for the first time.
"What? Wisdom Angel, Wind Angel, Pure White Angel, are respectively the current God of Knowledge and Wisdom, Lord of Storms, and Eternal Blazing Sun? This is really blasphemous. I actually know the origins of the three True Gods, or rather, the three True Gods also have origins!
What kind of Tarot Gathering is this? This is simply a gathering to blaspheme the gods!
"What? Adam and Amon are also Kings of Angels? I have seen descriptions of these two angel families in some ancient documents, but I didn't expect their history to be traced back to the Third Epoch!
"Hiss~ 'Dark Angel' is very mysterious! I remember seeing a partial description of the 'Dark Angel's' honorific name, 'Deputy of Heaven'. He seems to be the leader of the 'Kings of Angels'? Among these 'Kings of Angels', He also seems to be more special. 'Emperor's' simple description cannot help but remind people of the True Creator… …
"...'Emperor's' explanation makes the identity of 'Dark Angel' even more confusing.
'so this is 'Red Angel'. He was already a big shot in the Third Epoch!"
The other members also listened very carefully. Even listening to this information again made their hearts uncontrollably excited!
After all, this is top-level knowledge in the extraordinary world!
After completing the transaction, Cattleya was silent for a few seconds and then asked: 'mr. Emperor, you seem to be very clear about the experiences of the 'Kings of Angels' after the Third Epoch."
"At least I'm more clear about Medici's later experiences." Hobert thought to himself: I also know that he has become 'red Oil Hot Pot" now!
Then he sighed: Sure enough, the nickname wasn't wrong. Using "hot pot" to describe the state of Medici and the others is just too appropriate. Whether it's meat, vegetables, or soup, they're all mixed together.
Cattleya smiled and said, "Can I trade more detailed information about the 'King of Angels' with you?"
She realized that there must be huge secrets hidden in this information!
Hobert considered it for a moment: "Apart from 'Dark Angel', the information on the other 'Kings of Angels' can be said in more detail.
"If you still want to get detailed information about 'Dark Angel', the price will be at least 18,000 pounds! Because there are too many hidden information involved here, and this information may even subvert everyone's perception!
"If it doesn't involve 'Dark Angel', but only talks about 'Angel of Imagination', 'Angel of Time ' and 'Red Angel', this information is worth 2,000 pounds!
"If you add the other three 'Kings of Angels', this information is worth at least 5,000 pounds!"
Cattleya took a deep breath: "Let's conduct the 2,000 pound transaction!"
She still couldn't accept sitting here and talking about the gods as if they were chatting.
Audrey on the side discovered: At this gathering, "Hermit's" attitude is very active. Well, she should be as curious as I am about these histories hidden in the mist.
Klein realized: This pathway is not only about knowledge pursuing them, but they are also pursuing knowledge!
So Cattleya launched another transaction: 'does anyone want to join?"
'me!" Audrey raised her hand first and said, "I am willing to pay 500 pounds."
Fors also said without any pressure: "I am also willing to join the transaction!"
For her, joining the information transaction with "Emperor" has become like an instinct. As long as her financial resources permit, she will definitely join in and listen.
Little Sun also said: 'me too!"
He really wanted to know more detailed information about Amon.
The other members were a little hesitant. Hanged Man was saving money to buy the Sequence 5 potion formula, and he gave himself a limit of 500 pounds for each Tarot Gathering.
Emlyn was wavering between this knowledge and the beloved puppet, not knowing what to choose.
As for "World", this time he shamelessly prepared to freeload.
So the crowdfunding was quickly completed. The reward was 1,800 pounds and a Beyonder ingredient.
The 1,800 pounds came from "Hermit's" 1,000 pounds, Audrey's 500 pounds, and Fors's 300 pounds.
The last ingredient, of course, came from "Little Sun".
After requesting Mr. Fool to block the senses of the others, Hobert smiled and said: 'then, let's begin."
He didn't really care about "Fool" Klein's freeloading, just treat it as a reward for helping at the wedding before.
"Let me first talk about 'Red Angel'," Hobert said: "It is now very difficult to trace His origins. What is certain is that He was already Sequence 2 in the late Second Epoch, and some people even speculate that He was Sequence 2 at birth… …
Audrey immediately asked: 'mr. Emperor, is He perhaps the child of a certain god?"
Fors also thought of Adam and Amon: Born as angels, that's great!
Hobert explained: 'theoretically speaking, it is indeed possible for the child of a True God level to be Sequence 2 at birth.
"But in the Second Epoch, not only were the Ancient Gods non-adjacent dual pathways, but there were also many Sequence 1 level Ancient Beasts or King of Angels level Ancient Beasts whose situations were similar to the Ancient Gods.
'many times, a half-mad Sequence 1 with multiple pathway Beyonder characteristics who gives birth to a child will have the level of Sequence 2. The process of giving birth is the process of them expelling the Beyonder characteristics of another pathway."
Audrey nodded: "I understand."
Fors suddenly thought: If I have a child with Hobert… …
She didn't continue to think about it, because just thinking about it made her face flush red.
Fortunately, everyone didn't notice Fors's strangeness, but looked at "Emperor" together, waiting for him to continue.
Hobert continued: 'there is nothing to say about Medici's history in the Third Epoch. Throughout the early and mid-Third Epoch, He doesn't seem to have done anything memorable.
"Of course, it is also possible that some of the things He did were drowned out by the era when the gods and 'Kings of Angels' walked on the earth, after all, there were still many strong people at that time.
"And the entire Third Epoch, except for the last few years, can be considered a peaceful era without large-scale wars between gods.
"Only at the end of the Third Epoch did a sudden change occur. Medici joined the 'Rose Redemption'."
Before everyone could ask questions, Hobert quickly added: "As for that great change, it is not included in this transaction."
Audrey secretly said it was a pity.
Cattleya realized that that great change might be the reason for the value of 18,000 pounds.
After many transactions, Fors finally realized that the history of the Third Epoch might be as exciting as the history of the Fourth Epoch.
"Little Sun" could be sure: This great change may be the truth I have been pursuing.
Hobert continued: 'medici's history in the Fourth Epoch, everyone knows just now. He successively became a noble of the Solomon First Empire and the United Empire.
"He formed a legion called 'Red of War', which is said to be extremely powerful.
'this is why I said that He always rushes to the forefront of the war. Many times the Beyonders of this pathway are not only fighting, but also acting."
Klein behind the gray fog: "Emperor" seems to know the Beyonders of the 'red Priest" pathway relatively well, and even knows that they need to use war to act!
Cattleya: These are some historical details, some very lovely details.
Audrey recalled, "I seem to remember my brother mentioning that the Feysac Empire also has a very powerful legion. Now that I think about it, it should be a legion composed of Beyonders, a legion similar to the 'Red of War,' except he couldn't tell me too clearly at the time because I wasn't a Beyonder yet."
Hobert suddenly smiled and said, "Key information about Medici is here. I dare say this is my exclusive information because I also participated in that event!"
Everyone was slightly stunned. Wasn't Medici already fallen?
'medici was killed in a ruin in Backlund," Hobert said. "Although He fell and the Beyonder characteristic was taken away, His remaining spirit turned into a powerful evil spirit!
"What's even more surprising is that the remaining spirits of Sauron and Einhorn were mixed with the remaining spirit of Medici. In other words, there are three consciousnesses in one evil spirit!"

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - 485: Adam and Amon Again (Bonus 6)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Sarah Bower for becoming a Sequence 9 Reader]
Sitting at the head of the bronze long table, Klein first thought of the ruins he and Miss Sharron had explored together. At that time, they were behind the door with bloodstains and discovered a powerful evil spirit: Was that Medici? No, it was an evil spirit composed of the spiritual remnants of three angels! More than a thousand years… no, two thousand years had passed, and they still remained in the place where they were harmed!
Cattleya probably understood what was going on: Evil spirits generally can only appear within a certain range, and there should be a certain force supporting the existence of the evil spirit there. I didn't expect that the evil spirit formed by the Angel of Kings would also follow the rules regarding evil spirits. Hiss~ Since the Angel of Kings can also form evil spirits, then the spiritual imprint of a god… Heh heh, this idea is truly blasphemous! It must be because I was influenced by 'Emperor' that I had such thoughts.
Fors exclaimed: It really is a magical and wonderful world! There would actually be an evil spirit with three consciousnesses! Then, would they usually chat? Uh, this gives me a lot of inspiration, a protagonist with multiple consciousnesses, he lives every day with different consciousnesses, heh heh, I don't know if such a life is wonderful or tragic.
'Little Sun' then thought of the curse of City of Silver: Why do we have to kill our own blood relatives? Theoretically speaking, doing so would easily lead to the appearance of evil spirits, but why is City of Silver the exact opposite?
Audrey simply asked: "Mr. Emperor, is that evil spirit still in Backlund? What kind of operation did you encounter this evil spirit in?"
Hobert recalled for a moment: "He should still be in Backlund now, but he may not be in that ruin anymore. I don't know exactly where he is."
Just kidding, it would be too magical if I said I knew!
"As for that operation, I only played a very limited role in it," Hobert said, "I can't reveal the specific details, I can only tell you that it was an operation arranged by the 'Creator'.
"In addition, this operation is related to Adam, who we will talk about next."
Klein behind the gray fog immediately understood: That should be a game at the level of gods! I remember that Hobert said before that after the Backlund smog, Adam once went to the 'Creator' for a negotiation. It is possible that before that, the 'Creator' had already confronted Adam, and this level of confrontation would often disintegrate the other party's intentions from some inadvertent places.
Cattleya was already certain: "Emperor" must have a close relationship with the "Creator", and is likely to be a follower of the "Creator". This can be seen from his clothes. Last time at the gathering, he was wearing Feynapotter-style clothes, but this time he is wearing Loen-style clothes. He should be running around the entire Northern Continent, handling some small matters for the "Creator".
In fact, Hobert has recently been changing his style of dressing frequently, and before entering the Tarot Club, he resolutely refused to wear a Feynapotter-style cloak, just to avoid being seen by Fors.
Fors and the other three members simply guessed the "Creator's" intentions, but because there was not much useful information, they could only guess randomly.
Audrey thought: But what is certain is that the "Creator" did not eliminate the evil spirit of the "Red Angel". Could it be that the "Creator" has some other use for it?
"Next, let's talk about Adam again." Hobert smiled and said, "In the previous gathering, a lot of his information has been announced. I even announced Adam's recent idea of wanting to become a god.
"And his roots are actually quite easy to trace. He is the child of the Ancient Sun God. Since the Fourth Epoch, he has always hoped to revive the Ancient Sun God. It is said that his idea was once a bit extreme."
Adam is preparing to become a god? Cattleya, who did not obtain relevant information in the transaction just now, showed enough shock: Apart from the Great Emperor, it seems that no one has successfully ascended to the throne of God in the Fifth Epoch.
"Little Sun" was a little gratified: There are still people who remember the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God".
But then Hobert changed the subject: "But some people also believe that Adam is using the resurrection of his father as an excuse to cover up some of his purposes.
"I am inclined to the latter. He must be hiding something.
"But there is no evidence to prove this point, it's just my feeling."
Hobert thought to himself: I can't tell you that I've seen the script, can I?
"Sun" Derrick asked after a slight daze: "Mr. Emperor, can gods be resurrected? I mean, is there any way to resurrect a god?"
He may have felt that the answer to this question was too valuable: "I can pay you some more remuneration."
"No need, this answer does have a very high value, but I don't have a clear answer here, I can only give you a relatively vague answer." Hobert thought for a moment before saying: "In fact, not only gods, but even at the level of angels, as long as you leave enough preparations, it is not impossible to resurrect.
"At the level of True God, it is actually very difficult to be completely killed. He may fall in the war of gods, but it does not mean that there is no possibility of resurrection.
"Just like what I said before, 'Black Emperor' Solomon, as long as he becomes a god, after meeting certain conditions, he has the ability to return, or rather, resurrect.
"There are also some gods, such as the Ancient Death God I know. Although She is in a half-crazy state, he still made some preparations for his future resurrection.
"As far as I know, the Ancient Sun God has also made similar preparations, but it is difficult to say whether the process of resurrection can be completed."
Derrick's eyes lit up again.
"Although the truth may be difficult for you to accept, I still have to tell you." Hobert said to Derrick: "Even if the Ancient Sun God is resurrected, he is no longer your 'Omnipotent and Omniscient God'.
"He is more like another god with most of the Beyonder characteristics and memories of the 'Omnipotent and Omniscient God'. Do you understand what I mean?"
"Little Sun's" eyes were a little dim: "I, I understand."
Klein then launched into another association: Just as I guessed before, at the level of gods, "life and death" can no longer be used to describe them. Or rather, they have jumped out of the limitations of life and death on life.
Audrey sighed: The resurrection of a god is really a magical process!
Cattleya then issued another question: Where did "Emperor" get such high-level knowledge and information? This has completely exceeded the intelligence reserves of a Beyonder family!
"Let us continue to talk about Adam." Hobert said: "In the Fourth Epoch, Adam supported the Tudor Empire, and he joined forces with Amon and Antigonus to make the great nobleman Zaratul of the Solomon Empire fall in the 'War of the Four Emperors', in order to support Antigonus in becoming a god.
"And helped Antigonus complete the ritual. He was just a little bit short, Antigonus would have become a god, but he would ultimately be impossible to become a god.
"Their actions are purely because the Tudor Empire's strength is actually relatively weak. If a second True God were to appear in their camp, it would greatly alleviate the Empire's pressure."
"But as 'Mr. Door' was sealed, and Antigonus later fell into slumber, Adam's efforts ultimately didn't have much effect."
Audrey felt: This is a more detailed 'Brief History of the Tudor Empire.' To achieve victory in the 'War of the Four Emperors,' not only did the Tudors work hard, but the nobles who supported the Tudor Empire also worked hard.
Cattleya exclaimed: This has long exceeded the value of 2000 pounds! Heh, these pieces of information are even difficult to price! If we were to summarize, the Emperor's pricing isn't without rules. Information about True Gods is priced around 1000 pounds, and slightly more detailed information is priced around 2000 pounds. Information about the Solomon Empire and the Tudor Empire, at the True God level and very complete or systematic, is priced at 5000 pounds. Information below the True God level, even about 'King of Angels,' is only priced around 700 pounds. For example, this transaction, involving three 'Kings of Angels,' is priced at 2000 pounds.
"Later, Adam formed the Twilight Hermit Order," Hobert said. "Until now, Adam has finally found an opportunity to become a God!"
Audrey and the others fell into silence. Adam's experience is actually quite rich. Born as a King of Angels with a Uniqueness, after going through the Fourth Epoch and the Fifth Epoch until now, he finally has the opportunity to become a God.
"Little Sun" asked: "If Adam becomes a God, will He continue to revive the Ancient Sun God?"
"How could I possibly know the future?" Hobert smiled and said: "When we have the chance, we'll discuss this issue in detail."
To avoid other members asking questions, Hobert simply said: "Let's talk about Amon again. I think everyone should be most interested in Him, after all, Amon's avatar once attacked Little Sun."
Cattleya was stunned: "Sun" looks young, and has already had such an experience? He has just advanced to Sequence 7. Before this, a 'low-sequence' Beyonder encountered Amon's avatar. How did he survive? The members of the Tarot Club are all very mysterious!
However, he didn't have time to continue thinking, because "The Emperor" continued: "Amon has the same origin as Adam, both are descendants of the Ancient Sun God, and was born with the Uniqueness of the 'Marauder' pathway.
"His experiences in the Fourth Epoch were richer than Adam's. I strongly suspect that the idea of murdering Medici was His idea, possibly because He wanted to play a prank on Medici."
"This 'King of Angels' is also known as the 'God of Mischief,' taking pleasure in deception and pranks, and His pranks are unprovoked."
"For example, as far as I know, Amon and Medici also had a good relationship. Perhaps it was because they were familiar that Amon played such a huge joke on Medici."
"I think His unusual way of thinking is probably related to the fact that He was born with divinity, but didn't have enough humanity."
"According to some information I've seen, after becoming a demigod, one can feel their own divinity. After becoming an angel and a King of Angels, divinity is a growing trend."
"Because I'm not a demigod yet, I can't directly describe divinity, but the most intuitive manifestation seems to be the gradual loss of intense human emotions, such as crying, laughing, sadness, and grief, etc."
Klein couldn't help but want to knock on the long bronze table with his fingers: What "information" are you reading? Can you lend it to me too?
Cattleya silently summarized in her heart: Some seemingly unimportant descriptions from "The Emperor" often contain huge amounts of information! I need to pay more attention to these descriptions in the future!
Audrey put her hands on the long bronze table: Amon's pranks, doesn't it sound like something a very disobedient child would do? I can almost imagine that when facing Amon, warning Him not to drop the vase in His hand, the more you say it, the more He will smash the vase to pieces with a triumphant smile!
Fors also had similar thoughts, and further thought: If my child is so naughty in the future, I must beat them severely!
Hobert continued: "For Amon, the 'War of the Four Emperors' is more like a game, and He enjoys it immensely.
"After the fall of the Tudor, He didn't have any psychological burden. On the contrary, He devoured the ancestor of the Jacob family… Well, I mentioned this family in the information about the angel families.
"This family was once one of the five major nobles of the Tudor Empire, the Sequence 1 of the 'Marauder' pathway. Jacob's biggest mistake in his life was probably choosing to work with Amon.
"Amon not only devoured the Sequence 1 in Jacob's body, but also stole Jacob's fate, so for a long time, Jacob was actually Amon.
"This caused a devastating blow to the Jacob family, because Amon has the habit of collecting all 'Marauder' Beyonder characteristics."
Klein sighed: What a damn King of Angels, I hope I never meet him.
Cattleya was considering: I wonder if the authority that this King of Angels possesses is a bit strange? Or is His personality just that strange?
Audrey was thinking about other things: Every time I hear about Amon's abilities, it makes people feel so terrifying, but also so magical!
"Little Sun" was more concerned: "Mr. Emperor, what happened later? After the 'War of the Four Emperors' ended, what other news is there about Amon?"
"Yes, as far as I know, there are many high-level avatars of Amon in the North and South Continents," Hobert warned. "In a moment, I will ask Miss Justice to hypnotize us, so that after we leave here, we will forget everything about Amon.
"Because if you encounter Amon, and you happen to have memories about Him, He will immediately realize that you know Him, and be able to steal your relevant memories and find the source of the related information.
"At that time, the entire Tarot Club's information may be known by Him!"
Audrey said bluntly: "What a terrifying ability!"
Klein behind the gray fog became a little uneasy: You guys are being hypnotized by Miss Justice, what should I do? Is this the punishment for eavesdropping?
Then he thought: "The Emperor" has a Sealed Artifact from the "Spectator" pathway, I'll ask him to rent it for a while. Alas, you can't be greedy for small gains!

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - 486: The Talent of Being an Evil God (Bonus 7)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Oluwatobiloba Olatilewa for becoming a free member]
Cattleya was the first time to hear about Amon's so detailed description, she recalled some of the information she had seen before, only had strange, very amazing and other descriptions.
This made her not only sigh: Hearing the information of the "Emperor", Amon's image immediately became specific, just like, just like the "Emperor" had seen Amon steal other people's fate.
Fors once again sighed: It's hard to imagine, it's hard to imagine, what kind of experience is it for a person to be stolen their fate, or for Amon to replace someone else's fate? I wonder if Amon would be embarrassed when facing other people's wives and children. Oh, right, the "Emperor" just said that Amon doesn't have too much emotional fluctuations like ordinary people, He may not even know what embarrassment is.
Audrey asked again: "Mr. Emperor, what should we do if we encounter Amon?"
"Little Sun" also stared at the "Emperor", which was also the question he wanted to ask, but just now, he had used up his chance to ask questions.
Or rather, "Justice" Audrey saw that "Sun" wanted to ask a similar question, so she asked this question, of course, she herself was also very curious about the answer to this question.
"Of course, pray to the Fool immediately!" Hobert said: "Besides that, I really can't think of any other way!"
Klein behind the gray fog: Don't talk nonsense! Why not pray to the "Creator"? What are you praying to me for? Let me watch the live broadcast of Amon taking the fate of the Tarot Club members?
But in order to maintain the image of "The Fool", when facing the gazes of "Justice" and others, he just remained silent, neither admitting nor opposing.
This made Audrey and other members recall the Fool's previous dealing with Amon's clone, and they all thought that should be the best way.
"Of course, it is also possible that you will 'forget' to pray, or Amon will pray for you instead." Hobert spread his hands and said: "Actually, encountering enemies at the level of 'King of Angels' is quite desperate, and there is almost no ability to resist below Sequence 2.
"The only thing we can do is to pray for the other party's mercy, or pray that our luck is good enough so that the other party won't discover our abnormality.
"After all, even a 'King of Angels' cannot use his abilities to deal with everyone he encounters.
"It's just that Amon is indeed a special case, perhaps the more you pray for His mercy, the more you pray that you are lucky enough, the more He will deal with you, after all, He is the 'God of Pranks'."
Hobert thought for a while and then said: "If you are unlucky enough to encounter Amon's main body, then prepare for the funeral.
"But if you only encounter His clone, you can try to ask for angel-level power to deal with it. Theoretically speaking, His avatars should range from Sequence 4 to Sequence 2.
"If you want to kill His Sequence 2 clone, you need at least two or more angels!
"Because the speed must be fast, otherwise it will definitely attract other avatars."
He paused and then said: "As far as I know, His high-level avatars are only at the Sequence 2 level, without the position of Sequence 2.
"Because when you reach Sequence 2, you will have more divinity, and His avatars may have the idea of breaking away from the main body.
"So this is an opportunity for us, an opportunity to deal with His avatars."
Klein immediately realized: The Amon clone encountered in City of Silver before should only be at the Sequence 3 or Sequence 4 level, most likely Sequence 4, otherwise the angel I materialized could not have easily killed that clone. This can also be regarded as good luck for "Little Sun" and me. It would be troublesome if we encountered a Sequence 2 level clone! Even Mr. Fool might fail.
Cattleya smiled wryly: "This reminds me of a fable: In ancient times, a person discovered that the sun was originally a big fireball, and then naively thought that he could put out the sun with water."
Audrey followed with a smile: "Yes, even if we know how to deal with Amon's avatars, first we have to become angels, and we also need an angel to help! They are not enemies of the same level at all, and it is not something we should care about."
While speaking, she glanced intentionally or unintentionally at the top seat, which was something Mr. Fool should care about.
"Little Sun" fell into deep thought: What if I encounter Amon's clone again? City of Silver has no angels, only god-level sealed items. Alas, I'm so stupid, I can ask Mr. Fool for help!
"I said before, according to the information I have, Amon's main body is in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'." Hobert said: "Except for 'Sun', the probability of the rest of us encountering His main body is extremely small."
Klein secretly breathed a sigh of relief: That's good, that's good.
Cattleya looked at "Sun" in surprise: He is from the "Forsaken Land of the Gods"? It's actually the legendary "Forsaken Land of the Gods"! The members of the Tarot Club are more than just mysterious, they are completely unexpected! There are devotees of the "Creator", people from the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", and people from the Storm Church, and Sanguine servants of the Earth Mother Church. Currently, only "Justice" and "Magician" are unclear about their details, but their backgrounds should not be simple either. Miss Justice's emotional self-control is very strong, and it is difficult to get too many useful clues. As for Miss Magician, it is precisely because she rarely speaks and expresses her opinions that it is easy to ignore her, and I have to pay more attention to her in the future!
Audrey asked again for "Little Sun": "Mr. Emperor, what is Amon doing in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'? Or rather, why does He have to be in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
"Some people say that He is looking for something there," Hobert said vaguely: "I suggest not to guess His purpose, and don't care about His purpose, because that is likely to be His trap.
"Another reason is because He has successively supported the Solomon Empire and the Tudor Empire, and also supported the True Creator... Uh, this may not be the main reason, the main reason may be that the Seven Gods don't like Him very much.
"So as long as Amon's main body appears in the North and South Continent, it will trigger a divine descent, and then drive Him back to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'."
Audrey and Cattleya and Fors all felt a lot more at ease.
"Fool" Klein breathed a sigh of relief again, and silently said in his heart: Praise the Goddess!
Derrick sighed: "It's good to have the protection of gods."
Then Derrick asked: "Mr. Emperor, how does Amon contact His avatars? Uh, for this question, I can pay more remuneration."
Hobert thought for a while: "Pay another Beyonder ingredient, this answer does involve some other information."
"No problem!" Derrick believed that Amon's method of entering and exiting the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" would be an important reference.
"As far as I know, Amon built a mausoleum for himself near Backlund, and His avatars seem to be able to use some of the arrangements in that mausoleum to travel back and forth to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'."
Klein immediately thought of Amon's mausoleum that he learned about through Miss Sharron.
Later, the Arrodes Magic Mirror "reported" to him the exploration process, and at that time he guessed that Amon's mausoleum seemed to be connected to the "Abyss", in short, there were many secrets.
And at that time, Klein had a guess, could Amon be traveling back and forth to the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" through the "Abyss"?
Derrick secretly said it was a pity, because City of Silver obviously had no way to replicate this method.
Hobert added: "As far as I know, there is another way to enter the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' through the projection of the 'Giant King's Court' in the dreamland deep in the eastern part of the Sonia Sea.
"But this method has considerable risks, and I don't know the specific method either."
Derrick repeatedly chewed on the phrase "Giant King's Court". Little boy Jack and the others also entered the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" from the "Giant King's Court", but Jack was ignorant and couldn't explain how he got in.
The "Emperor's" answer once again confirmed the key information they obtained, and the external exit must be hidden there.
"Little Sun" became more and more happy: "Mr. Emperor, thank you for your answer."
Hobert smiled: "Okay, the transaction about the 'King of Angels' ends here."
Audrey and the others fell into a brief state of aftertaste, and then Audrey came back to her senses and gave everyone psychological cues.
After releasing Alger's and Emlyn's sensory blockade, the free exchange session continued.
There was silence in the hall for a few seconds before Emlyn cleared his throat and said: "Thank you for the Emperor's help, I am already a Baron.
"I have a question, as a Sanguine, after being promoted to Baron, do I need to use the so-called acting method to promote digestion and better grasp the Beyonder characteristics, like you humans?"
While speaking, he raised his chin slightly and straightened his back.
Seeing that the "Emperor" didn't mean to answer, Cattleya answered: "Acting is necessary, because only Sequence 7 is called 'Vampire' on that pathway, and you are born that way, so you don't need to act, all the others do."
The reason why "Emperor" Hobert didn't mean to answer was actually because he was too lazy to answer. He estimated that Emlyn had already found the answer to this question. The focus of his words was "I am already a Baron."
Audrey blinked her beautiful eyes and asked with a curious tone: "Ms. Hermit, I remember Mr. Emperor said that Vampires are Sequence 7 of the 'Apothecary' pathway, I am very curious what Sequence 8 of this pathway is called?"
"Sanguine, it's Sanguine!" Emlyn corrected.
Cattleya and Audrey responded with a smile, and Audrey pursed her lips: Mr. Moon is already Sequence 6, why does it feel like he is not as mature as "Sun"?
The "Hermit" simply ignored the "Moon's" correction and began to answer "Justice's" question: "As long as you are familiar with the people of the Earth Mother Church, you can learn about the situation in this area.
"'Vampire' belongs to the 'Moon' pathway, the corresponding Sequence 9 is 'Apothecary', Sequence 8 is 'Beast Tamer'... Sequence 4 is 'Shaman King', and above that, I don't know."
"Cough" Emlyn coughed again: "Ms. Hermit, I must emphasize again, it's Sanguine, not Vampire."
Cattleya smiled: "Using 'Vampitr' is just for convenience of description."
At the same time, she carefully observed everyone's reaction: The "Emperor" was indeed calm, He already knew this. The "Hanged Man" seemed to only know a part of it. Well, probably from the Sequence 5 "Scarlet Scholar", he obviously began to pretend not to be interested. He didn't know the information above the "Scarlet Scholar", so it can be inferred that he is still in the middle and lower levels of the Storm Church. "Justice" and "Magician" listened with great interest. They are also at the bottom of their respective organizations, but they should have some support, so they are not worried and completely listen to it as a story. "Sun" is really not interested, doesn't the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" have this pathway?
The reason why Cattleya generously announced some sequence names of the "Apothecary" pathway is first to strengthen her favorability in everyone's minds, and second, this is another test of other members.
And the effect of this test made her very satisfied.
Audrey thought seriously, and raised her hand slightly like she was in a tutoring class: "Ms. Hermit, why is there no necessary connection between the various sequences of the 'Moon' pathway?"
According to her observation, there is a certain connection between the sequences of many pathways, such as the "Spectator" pathway, Sequence 8 is "Telepathist", Sequence 7 is "Psychiatrist", and above that, Sequence 6 is "Hypnotist".
She also knew that Xio's pathway Sequence 9 was "Arbiter" and Sequence 8 was "Sheriff".
However, the potion names of each sequence of the "Moon" pathway do not seem to be related.
Cattleya glanced at Miss Justice, noticing that her dresses and jewelry were completely different from the last time, with no repetition.
In a trance, she seemed to see the portrait of that queen when she was young, and the clothes on each one were different. A piece of clothing would never be worn a second time on formal occasions.
Cattleya was silent for a second or two before saying: "Different sequences within a pathway do not necessarily have to be related, or have a superficial connection. Their common feature is that they are all within the domain of the god corresponding to this pathway.
"For example, 'Moon' represents spirituality, plants, beauty, part of life and part of darkness, so this pathway has apothecaries in the field of plants, Vampire in the field of life, and beast tamers who cross life and spirituality!"
"Sanguine!" Emlyn emphasized, then raised his chin slightly: "This should be the reason for the handsomeness and beauty of our Sanguine."
Derrick retorted in his heart in a low voice: It's not like this, the Sanguine I've seen are all disgusting and hideous.
The one who felt the most was Klein, because the various sequences of the "Seer" pathway did not seem to have any obvious connection.
The exchange continued, and then Audrey said: "I recently went to a place with a custom of worshiping dragons."
That place was of course Earl Hall's territory. After attending Hobert's wedding, Audrey returned to Earl Hall's territory with her family. This is a tradition of the nobles of the Loen Kingdom.
Audrey began to mention the ancient poem about dragons, and clarified that she was inspired by it, and maintained a clear psychological activity in the dream through "psychological cues".
Through the messy dreams, she came to the edge of her own consciousness, and then, according to the "materialization method" learned from Mr. Fool, created a downward staircase, and gradually deepened into her subconscious field.
Of course, she did not describe the subconscious light spots she saw, because each light spot represented a secret that she was unwilling or ashamed to tell others.
For example, the subconscious thought of walking intimately with Hobert's arm in the territory. For example, the idea that the bride at the wedding she just attended was herself.
She focused on that feeling of loneliness, of endlessness, of being unable to find a goal, of being surrounded by a grayness that seemed to conceal all sorts of monsters, that extreme sense of oppression.
She mentioned that her emotions had been on the verge of collapse several times, and that she had barely managed to hold on with her own Beyonder abilities, finally arriving at the illusory ocean formed by the collective consciousness of living beings.
There were memory imprints from the early ancestors of humanity, and there were reflections and extensions of the various consciousnesses of the surrounding creatures. Then she mentioned the giant dragon with gray, rock-like scales that flew through the sea of collective consciousness.
Beside her, Fors suddenly had a book title pop into her head: Miss Justice's Dream Travelogue.
Then she sighed: To think there's a dragon living in the ocean of collective consciousness? Although Miss Justice didn't encounter any enemies or dangers, her experience still gives me a sense of illusion.
After recounting her experience, Audrey asked, "Ladies and gentlemen, what advice do you have? Do you think the 'Miracle of Sincerity,' Liveseyd, of the legendary dragons is also hidden in this sea of collective consciousness?
"If I want to continue exploring, what should I pay attention to? What preparations do I need to make in advance?"
"Hanged Man" Alger said in a deep voice, "I don't think you should continue exploring. This is a very dangerous act.
"According to records, most dragons are creatures of flesh and blood, including the Mind Dragon. The fact that it can exist in and roam the sea of collective consciousness of living beings indicates that the dragon you saw possesses a sufficiently high sequence, perhaps even reaching the level of a demigod.
"Before you reach Sequence 5, don't consider this issue."
Cattleya nodded and followed, "In the sea of collective subconsciousness, there are many dangerous things, the accumulated evil thoughts of humanity, various desires that erode the spirit body, terrifying memories from ancient times, etc. They are like storms and waves on the ocean, which can cause you serious psychological trauma, and even make you unable to wake up.
"Moreover, that is the sea of collective consciousness of all living beings, not just humans. Perhaps some evil spirits, some evil gods, some terrible presences are also lurking there. Do not rashly conduct in-depth exploration."
Audrey, who had been full of expectations, was disappointed, but had to admit that "Hanged Man" and "Hermit" were right.
At this moment, Mr. Fool suddenly said, "In dreams, you can chant my name!"
This was something Klein had inadvertently discovered. In dreams, chanting the name of "The Fool" allowed him to "receive" it above the gray fog and respond.
Audrey was first surprised, then delighted: "Thank you, Mr. Fool!"
Of course, she understood what Mr. Fool meant: "Hanged Man" and "Hermit" are right, but if you encounter danger in your dream, or if the Mind Dragon comes looking for you, chant the name of "The Fool."
Alger was also somewhat surprised, and he immediately thought: Mr. Fool's power has further recovered, and he can even project his power into dreams!
Cattleya was surprised: Mr. Fool actually possesses authority over dreams?
Hobert was sighing: Before I knew it, you showed off again! So being an evil god requires talent. I don't have that talent, and I still can't put on an act so casually.
Hobert did not offer any advice on this matter, because he noticed that "Hanged Man" Alger seemed to be subtly comparing his life experience and knowledge reserves with "Hermit" Cattleya, and Cattleya didn't seem to be showing any weakness.
It wouldn't be appropriate to show off his own knowledge reserves at this time.
As the discussion of Audrey's question ended, "The World" appropriately rented the "Psychological Spoon" from Hobert, and then Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.
Above the gray fog, after disconnecting from the members, Klein first completed the process of the members' sacrifices and bestowals, and then used the "Sea God Scepter" to respond to the prayers and requests of the believers.
Returning to the real world, Klein rested for a while and came to the Smelting Leaf Bar with "Fair Judge" Eirlan, the captain of the "White Magnolia," who had an appointment in advance.
Today, Eirlan was going to introduce Klein to the local military contact in Bayam.
Eirlan walked ahead and found a man in a coffee-colored jacket in the corner of the bar: "Why aren't you drinking Lerouche?"
The man, who was in his thirties, glanced at Eirlan and Klein with somewhat cloudy eyes: "I've already had it. I'll have a glass of Zahar to sober up."
Zahar was a local specialty malt beer, cheap and with a low alcohol content.
Eirlan smiled and pointed to Klein: "Gehrman Sparrow."
Then, he introduced to Klein: "Us Kent, just call him Kent.
"You guys chat, I have to go back and prepare. I'm leaving port tomorrow morning."
He waved his hand and turned to leave without hesitation.
Klein pulled up a chair and sat down, not ordering any wine, just looking at Us Kent with a blank expression.
Kent felt extremely uncomfortable under his gaze, took a gulp of Zahar and said, "You can come to me directly if you have anything in the future, as long as you can provide valuable information or help us do something."
"Okay." Actually, Klein really wanted to ask if the costume expenses for impersonating Ilene to assassinate "Rear Admiral of Disease" could be reimbursed? Although that was Danitz's money.
But in order to maintain Gehrman Sparrow's persona, he just thought about it.
Kent smiled, seemingly drunk, "I've heard Eirlan mention some things about you, but I still have to remind you, don't be so crazy when doing things on the sea!
"Pirates won't talk to you about chivalry, and they won't abide by the laws and rules of the kingdom. If you settle down in a port city or island colony, they can definitely do things like attack your family."
Family... Klein was silent for a second or two, and said plainly, "I have no family."
Us Kent almost didn't know how to respond, so he changed the subject and said, "They will also attack your friends."
Then he heard Gehrman Sparrow say in a tone without any fluctuations, "I have no friends."
Kent coughed twice before recovering: "They will also ambush you!"
Klein said quite calmly, "I won't refuse anyone who gives me money, it's polite."

Kingdom of Feynapotter, Jeffery Territory.
Hobert, through a grant, received the income from this Tarot Gathering. From the intelligence trades at this gathering, he earned a total of 8300 pounds, and four Beyonder ingredients! Plus 100 pounds for the rental of the 'Psychological Spoon'.
This income set a record for the most income ever earned at a Tarot Gathering! Of course, this 'achievement' was largely due to Cattleya, who spent money without batting an eye.
After deducting the 800 pounds paid in advance to 'Hermit' Cattleya, Hobert received 7600 pounds. 'Little Sun's' payment was, as usual, delayed.
However, the income from the pounds was already very satisfying for Hobert, and he had gathered most of the funds for the fifth batch of building materials.
Hobert decided to continue his efforts and contact Miss Sharon tonight to see how wealthy the Temperance Faction was and how many Beyonder characteristics they could purchase. Based on this, he would then decide whether to take a trip to the sea.
In the afternoon, under Hobert's care, Seel successfully advanced to Sequence 8, 'Provoker', entering a rather self-destructive phase of this pathway.
However, Seel certainly didn't dare to provoke Hobert. While restraining his spirituality, he asked Dennis, who was beside him, "Are you still fetching water for the Earl to wash his feet? Do you still secretly cry when you think of your father?"
Dennis's face immediately flushed red, and he rushed over to fight Seel.
Seel laughed twice and quickly said goodbye to Hobert before leaving.
After a while, Dennis explained to Hobert in a aggrieved tone that he didn't secretly cry, he just couldn't understand why his father suddenly abandoned him and his two brothers.
Hobert took a sip of tea: "Provokers" really know how to poke at people's sore spots!
After dinner, Hobert said hello to Fors and went to the side hall to change into Ruin-style clothes.
Now that Freya was practicing vocabulary in the study and Fors was in the bedroom, Hobert had to carry out any secret operations in the side hall.
After changing his clothes, Hobert changed his appearance into a face with a prominent Ruin-style bridge of the nose and high cheekbones. After a "transfer", he arrived at a corner not far from the Bravehearts Bar.
A quick observation revealed that it looked like an ordinary bar.
Hobert tightened his trench coat and pushed open the door of the bar with a hand holding a cane.
It was lively and chaotic inside, but the Bravehearts Bar seemed a little better than the bars in the East Borough. At least the customers here didn't have patches on their clothes, they all wore shoes, and some even had canes.
Hobert squeezed to the bar, but it was the busiest time at the bar, so he naturally had no intention of waiting like this. So, he stepped forward and squeezed a drunkard off his seat, then placed eight copper pennies on the bar: "Give me a beer."
"What are your requirements?"
"Something mellow," Hobert rarely came to bars and didn't know much about what kind of beer was available in this era.
So the bartender poured Hobert a glass of "Priest's Beer" worth 6 pence, which was considered a mid-range product among beers, but it was rarely sold at the Bravehearts Bar.
It was said that this beer was initially brewed by a missionary from the Church of Knowledge and Wisdom to help believers. Because of its mellow taste and unique characteristics, it provided a fixed source of income for a poor town.
Later, the brewing method of this beer spread widely in various countries of the Northern Continent. In order to commemorate the missionary, everyone called it "Priest's Beer".
As for the remaining two pennies, the bartender naturally assumed it was a tip, because he could tell at a glance that this gentleman was not here to drink.
Hobert didn't hide this, after all, he was here to find someone, not to act in a play. There was no need to hide his purpose so deeply.
He took a sip of beer and said, "I was introduced by Sherlock the detective, looking for Mr. Maric."
The bartender was slightly stunned, then smiled and said, "Sorry, Mr. Maric hasn't been here for a long time."
Hobert sighed: "Well, I'll come back in a few days."
With that, he drank the beer in one gulp and left the noisy bar with his cane.
Following the method Klein mentioned, Hobert found a rental carriage on the street: "Go to... go to the dock."
For a moment, he felt like he didn't know where to go. It had been a long time since he had returned, and he was already a little unfamiliar with Backlund.
The carriage had been driving for a few minutes when Hobert felt the atmosphere in the carriage suddenly change, as if it suddenly made people heavy and never happy again.
A lady with pale golden hair, a rather delicate appearance, but an abnormally pale complexion, wearing a Gothic court dress, appeared opposite him.
Hobert thought to himself, Miss Sharon has a kind of "ascetic" feeling. Emlyn, that kind of otaku, should fall immediately when they see her, right?
"Are you a friend of Sherlock's?" A beautiful, somewhat cold, and somewhat distant voice asked.
"Yes, I have experienced several adventures with him," Hobert said truthfully.
Miss Sharon simply glanced at Hobert a few times: "What do you want from me?"
"I have a batch of Beyonder characteristics to sell, I don't know if you are interested?" Hobert recalled the conversation with Dophis. There was no need to lay the groundwork when chatting with this kind of person, so he directly cut to the chase.
Miss Sharon, who seemed to have no emotional fluctuations, calmly asked: "What sequence are they? How many copies are there?"
This conversation skipped the links of mutual probing and trying to get information from each other. The reason why she asked this directly was because she determined that the other party must be selling the Beyonder characteristics of the "Prisoner" pathway, otherwise there was no need to find her whereabouts through "Sherlock".
In Sharon's view, with Sherlock's endorsement, the man in front of her was at least not her enemy, so she simply went straight to the topic.
This made Hobert, who often dealt with Bishop Simpson, Jonathan, and a group of old foxes, suddenly feel like he didn't know how to continue the conversation.
He cleared his throat unnaturally and said: "41 copies of the Beyonder characteristics of 'Prisoner', 36 copies of the Beyonder characteristics of 'Lunatic'..."
Hobert didn't mean to sell all the Beyonder characteristics in his hands in one go. That would be too alarming, and it would be seriously inconsistent with the number of enemy deaths that occurred in the Southern Continent.
But after all, Beyonder characteristics are not bread. Even if Hobert was reserved, selling dozens of copies together still sounded amazing.
Hobert deliberately paused here, preparing to admire Miss Sharon's surprised expression.
But to his disappointment, Miss Sharon still did not show any extra emotions: "Are you kidding me?"
Hobert spread his hands: "What's the point of me coming to you late at night to make this kind of joke?"
Miss Sharon looked at Hobert for a long time with delicate eyes that had no emotional color: "Are you a believer of the 'Creator'?"
This was not difficult to guess, because only the war of the "Creator" organization could obtain so many Beyonder characteristics at once recently.
Hobert didn't intend to hide this either: "That's right, in some respects, we can actually become allies.
"The question now is, I don't know how many Beyonder characteristics the Temperance Faction can eat? I think you should need them very much."
He thought to himself: If you tell me that the "Temperance Faction" currently has only two members, then sorry, I'm bothering you. Oh, right, we can still talk about the transaction of demigod Beyonder characteristics.
Miss Sharon looked ahead, seemingly considering for a while before saying: "I can't give you an immediate answer, you can first say how many Beyonder characteristics you have in your hand?"
"Okay," Hobert said: "In addition to the Beyonder characteristics of the two sequences I just mentioned, there are also 28 copies of 'Werewolf', 18 copies of 'Zombie', 7 copies of 'Wraith', and 1 copy of 'Puppet'."
This time Hobert saw that Miss Sharon's eyes suddenly lit up when she heard "Puppet".
Hehehe, finally a little reaction.
Hobert felt that after Sharon advanced to "Puppet", the potion was likely to be digested for the most part immediately. Her current state felt like she was acting in advance.
But soon, Miss Sharon returned to calm and said in a seemingly distant voice: "How much are you going to sell each of them for?"
Hobert had already thought about the price: "'Prisoner' 280 pounds, 'Lunatic' 580 pounds, 'Werewolf' 1300 pounds, 'Zombie' 3200 pounds, 'Wraith' 6000 pounds, 'Puppet' 50000 pounds!"
Miss Sharon calmly bargained: "The price is too high. I can buy the corresponding Beyonder characteristics at the Backlund Beyonder Gathering for less money than that."
Hobert smiled: "'Werewolf' and below can accept bargaining. I know that the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Prisoner' pathway are indeed not in great demand, but I have corresponding pathways of the righteous god churches, and they offer prices that are slightly higher than my previous quote.
"However, I still prefer to sell to the 'Temperance Faction' because we have a common enemy."
Hobert finally felt the atmosphere of talking to normal people. Business, of course, requires bargaining with each other.
After a few seconds of silence in the carriage, Sharon said: "I am sure I want to buy that Beyonder characteristic of 'Puppet', but you have to give me two weeks to raise funds.
"As for the Beyonder characteristics of other sequences, three days later, come to the Bravehearts Bar again, we will still meet in this form, and I will give you an answer."
Hobert nodded: "Okay, then... Hey, hey, hey, I haven't finished talking yet! Why are you leaving!"
He looked at the empty opposite side: "I originally wanted to say, if you are tight on money, you can pay in installments."
Also, selling the Beyonder characteristics of a demigod for 50,000 pounds was a huge discount. Originally, Hobert also wanted to talk to Sharon and agree that if she sold her Beyonder characteristics at this price, she would participate in a battle between the Balk family and the 'Rose School' after she became a demigod.
Hobert smiled, forget it, I'll talk about it when we meet next time.
The carriage drove out again for a while, and Hobert asked the coachman to stop.
After paying the fare, Hobert came to the corner and used "Travel" to return to his territory.
When changing clothes in the side hall, Hobert thought: Since Sharon intends to purchase Beyonder characteristics of other sequences, it means that the "Temperance Faction" has more than just her and Maric. It's just that Backlund should only have these two members of the "Temperance Faction". Maybe they, like the "resident Backlund representatives" of other forces, are responsible for conducting some Beyonder transactions in this metropolis.
Back in the bedroom, Fors hadn't fallen asleep yet. She put down the magazine in her hand: "I heard that you are going to go to war with the other side tomorrow?"
Hobert said "Hmm" and took off his trench coat and said: "I have been tolerating those demons for a long time!"
After the declaration of war was sent out, this matter was no longer a secret, but many people thought that the lord was going to go to war with Viscount Teuton. Only a few people such as Fors and Seel knew the inside story.
"I'll join the war too!" Fors played with the ring in her hand and said: "I'll just try the ring you gave me."
Hobert shook his head: "It's too dangerous."
Fors pushed Hobert's pajamas to him: "I don't have any other skills, but few people can compare to me in the ability to escape."
Hobert hung the clothes he took off on the hanger and smiled: "It's not impossible. I'll find someone to protect you tomorrow, give you a pistol, and give you a sealed artifact that is very useful below the demigod level, so there shouldn't be much danger."
He simply got into the quilt without wearing pajamas. Fors pushed him: "We're talking about serious business. I haven't heard a comparison of the strength between the enemy and us yet!"
Hobert pretended to be serious and said: "Do what you should do at what time. At night, you should do something you should do at night. As for this battle, that's tomorrow's business. We'll talk about it tomorrow.
"Hey, the buttons on your pajamas are still so difficult to undo."
487.5 🔞
...
In fact, the strength of the two sides is somewhat disparate. On the west bank of Full Moon Lake, the known opponents on the demon side include one demigod, 5 Sequence 5s, and the number of Sequence 6s should reach more than ten.
On Hobert's side, although Jonathan is a demigod, the Sequence 5 combat power is only Hobert and Simpson, and there are only 5 Sequence 6s.
These include Helen, and 2 people from the Tudor family, who belong to the special operations department established by Hobert.
The other 2 people are the captain of the "Druid", under the command of Bishop Simpson.
In order to reduce the gap between the enemy and us, and to ensure the victory of this battle, Hobert also went to great lengths to issue a level 2 sealed artifact to every "Mid Sequence" member of the special operations department!
He also lent Simpson 3 level 2 sealed artifacts.
The 5 level 3 sealed artifacts, and the 3 level 3 sealed artifacts that Hobert had just inherited from Rex, were also distributed.
However, the gap still exists. The demons have been operating on the opposite side of the lake for thirty or forty years, and there are countless Sequence 7 and low-sequence Beyonders. They can only rely on tactics and a reinforcements Hobert found to narrow the gap.
The next morning, Hobert made a final pre-war mobilization in front of all the participating members, and then under the command of Bishop Simpson, all combatants had breakfast and launched an offensive towards the opposite bank by boat!
Fors was also among them. She didn't expect that Hobert would send Archibald, the new male servant who had been following him these two days, to protect her.
This male servant looked weak and didn't seem very powerful.
However, Fors quickly put the male servant's affairs behind her. She, who already had quite a bit of combat experience, looked at the opposite side of the lake and was somewhat excited about the upcoming battle.
Archibald was even more excited, because Hobert allowed him to turn the Beyonders on the enemy's side into his Marionettes in this battle.
A Demonic Wolf of Fog without a Marionette is at its most vulnerable. If Archibald hadn't known enough, it would already be an ingredient.
If he had one or two durable Marionettes to 'take the hits' in front, Archibald's strength would receive a huge boost!
A total of 38 Beyonders launched a frontal assault, representing all the power currently in the Jeffrey Territory.
This force would be quite terrifying elsewhere, but it's different in the South Colson area. This is a region where evil forces like the Church of Blood can exist openly.
Moreover, they don't take official Beyonders seriously at all. Unlike the cat-and-mouse games in other places, this is a fight between two tigers!
Bishop Simpson was the overall commander of the frontal assault. He stood at the bow of the ship, quietly watching the opposite shore.
There was no one on the dock, or rather, no one within sight. The entire Teuton Town was as silent as the realm of the dead.
Simpson took a deep breath. Just as he and Hobert had predicted, the demons had set up a trap, waiting for the official Beyonders to walk into it.
Actually, Bishop Simpson was also a little nervous, because the enemy was strong and they were weak, and he didn't know if Hobert's tactics would be effective.
Soon, the ship completed the docking process.
While everyone disembarked, Bishop Simpson shouted, "Quickly pass through Teuton Town! Our target is on the other side of the town."
"The time has come to rescue the people and demonstrate the power of the official Beyonders!"
"First Squad, take the lead! Cole, you bring up the rear! Pay attention, pass through Teuton Town quickly!"
First Squad was led by Angus, Hobert's cousin. Helen's squad was naturally the Second Squad, along with the Earth Mother Church's Cole Squad and Domis Squad.
In terms of strength, Angus's squad was the strongest.
Under Simpson's constant urging, the official Beyonders quickly entered Teuton Town.
A map of the town immediately appeared in everyone's minds. Starting a few days ago, everyone had been forced to look at the map of Teuton Town for half an hour every day. Now, the previous preparation came into play, and everyone knew which direction to go.
Suddenly, several members walking in the front fell to the ground, foaming at the mouth and convulsing.
This was a curse that the demons had set up on the streets long ago!
Simpson cast a 'Healing' spell, and one person's symptoms immediately eased.
Helen, at the back, grabbed at another person, 'taking away' the curse on their body.
Helen carried a sealed artifact that the Balk family had seized from the 'Rose School'. The main means of attack of this sealed artifact was curses, and it also had the ability to remove some simple curses.
In terms of cursing ability, the 'Prisoner' pathway was more skilled.
"Carry these two people and pass through quickly!" Seeing the enemy's sneak attack, Simpson breathed a sigh of relief instead.
A member of the First Squad said, "The sealed artifact on my body allows me to sense the enemy's location. Everyone follow…"
That was also a sealed artifact seized from the 'Rose School', which could give the wearer extremely high spirituality and could transform into a werewolf state for five minutes, while maintaining a certain degree of rationality.
But after more than five minutes, they would lose their minds, and after more than six minutes, they would completely turn into a werewolf without reason, never able to return to human form.
"Pass through quickly!" Simpson shouted, "Hobert gave me the power to cancel your qualifications to divide the spoils of war. Whoever doesn't listen to my command, hurry back before the ship is too far away!"
Although the people in the First Squad were very unconvinced, they could only endure it for the time being.
"Attention!"
Helen, in the middle of the team, reminded loudly, and a series of pale blue fireballs emitting a sulfurous smell smashed towards the entire team.
Everyone immediately reacted, and Angus, at the front of the team, shouted, "Burning flames are prohibited here!"
As a result, after the fireballs entered a certain range, the flames immediately became smaller, almost extinguished, revealing the magma-like core in the center of the fireballs.
The two 'Druid' squads cooperated skillfully, and four members stepped forward, took out runes, and threw them in front of everyone: "Life!"
Four fiery red trees immediately appeared in front of everyone, blocking most of the fireballs.
The remaining few fireballs were also frozen by Helen's frost.
A group of people looked at each other and smiled. Although the entire team was like three piles of loose sand, and Bishop Simpson could only simply restrain them, after fighting together once, the opposition between them seemed less obvious.
Simpson's new order was not as rigid as before: "This morning, Lord Hobert gave the captains of the four squads a detailed account of the tactics for this operation. I think it is very feasible. Each captain must restrain his subordinates and pass through the town quickly!"
"Yes!" the four captains shouted together!
Next, they encountered several more sneak attacks, but their purpose did not waver. They carried the wounded and quickly passed through the town.
The 'Physicians' among the 'Druid Squads' would immediately step forward to restore their teammates' combat power as soon as possible.
After more than ten minutes of jogging, with 5 people injured, they finally passed through Teuton Town and arrived at their destination, the big tree hanging many corpses.
Bishop Simpson immediately ordered: "Helen, you protect the Doctors and Astrologers! Melee-oriented members to the outermost perimeter! Angus, you are responsible for the left flank! Cole, you are responsible for the right flank! Domis, you are responsible for the front!"
After simply setting up the formation, the 'demons' ambushing in the town poked their heads out to check. They had a very bad premonition. Some 'demons' had already guessed Simpson's intentions and were therefore a little anxious.
Simpson pulled out the knife that had been hanging on his waist. The knife was orange-red and looked extremely sharp.
He swung the knife towards the big tree full of corpses, and a fireball shot out from the tip of the knife, hitting the tree.
Whoosh~
The tree immediately burst into flames!
The 'demons' ambushing in the town rushed out: "Protect the sacred tree!"
Simpson breathed another sigh of relief. The situation was once again developing according to Hobert's predicted trajectory. He loudly ordered: "Hold your ground and wait for them to come to us!"
Many people laughed and made their final combat preparations!
Although Hobert had not yet taken action, his tactics were very successful so far.
The key to this battle was actually 'breaking the situation'. The power of the Jeffrey Territory was already at a disadvantage, but they still needed to be the attacking side, which would be very disadvantageous.
If they just killed their way to the other side, there would be no chance of victory.
The last time Hobert came to the Teuton Territory, he noticed that the 'demon's' believers were very respectful to this tree, and they had to dismount and kneel to pay their respects when they came here.
Since it was a sacrifice to 'high-level demons', this tree was also very important to the 'demons', so Hobert's tactic was to quickly pass through Teuton Town, which must have a small-scale ambush, and come directly to the big tree to burn the tree.
