chapters.title: Chapter 488 - 488 Hobert's Tactics (Bonus 9)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Paragon for becoming a free member]
Before Hobert revealed his tactics, what troubled Bishop Simpson the most was figuring out where the enemy was lying in ambush?
Only by knowing the enemy's ambush location could they formulate an effective plan and make the most correct choices.
However, Hobert's tactics directly skipped over the most troublesome aspect for their side, turning it into a headache for the enemy instead.
Additionally, before departing, Hobert had instructed Bishop Simpson that if burning the tree didn't work, they should go to the town and smash the Devil statues, destroying the symbols of the Devils.
In short, they were not to pay attention to the enemy's small-scale ambushes, and even if they still couldn't lure out the "Devils," they could simply burn the tree, smash the statues, and then return by boat.
Originally, Simpson was somewhat disgruntled about having to follow Hobert's command and also disliked being in the first wave, as it greatly implied that he would become bait.
But after hearing Hobert's plan, Bishop Simpson realized that extraordinary combat could actually be fought this way!
They had habitually used the thinking of official Beyonders to consider problems, and the thinking of official Beyonders was simple and crude: concentrate forces, surround, and annihilate.
Moreover, Hobert had also placed his wife in the first echelon, which indicated that he would never abandon the people in the first echelon, so Bishop Simpson agreed to be the commander of the first echelon.
Simpson watched the "Devils" rushing towards them, and the first step of the plan had already been achieved.
However, those "Devils" stopped halfway because they realized their strength was insufficient to defeat Bishop Simpson and his men, and they couldn't extinguish the increasingly large fire, so they ultimately chose to wait for reinforcements from afar.
The tree in front of them was indeed important to them, but no matter how important it was, their rationality would not allow them to risk their lives for a tree.
This was the nature of "criminals"; regardless of what problems they faced, they could maintain calmness and rationality.
On Simpson's side, some members were a little impatient, and Angus also said, "Bishop, should we take advantage of the enemy's main force not arriving yet and eliminate this group of enemies first?"
"No!" Simpson raised his voice and said, "This battle is different from the battles you've encountered before. Have you forgotten what Hobert said before departure? This is a team battle, relying on discipline and tactics!
"Now that our tactics have achieved initial success, whoever attacks first at this time will lose the advantage."
The members were reassured again and seriously confronted the dozen or so Devils.
Bishop Simpson sighed: Why are the words of that donkey Hobert so persuasive? I'm unknowingly quoting his words!
Then he comforted himself: Maybe this is the effect of Hobert's Beyonder characteristics. When he was Sequence 9 "Lawyer," Beyonders of this pathway were eloquent. After several Sequences of accumulation, some of Hobert's unintentional words might become extremely persuasive. I have to be careful when dealing with Hobert in the future and carefully examine whether it's my true thoughts or whether I've been "persuaded" by Hobert.
At this time, many enemies rushed over from the surroundings, which made Simpson sneer in his heart: Fortunately, I didn't listen to that idiot Angus just now, otherwise we would definitely be held back by the enemy's small forces and gradually lose our advantage.
The Beyonders in Jeffrey's territory included multiple pathways. Some Beyonders of the "Door" pathway were not suitable to be at the forefront at all, but their tripping techniques, electric shocks, and so on were much more useful than curses, making them very suitable for launching sneak attacks from behind.
If they were entangled by the enemy's small forces bit by bit, there would be no way to construct protection for the Beyonders of the "Door" pathway, and they would definitely be eliminated by the enemy first.
As more and more enemies gathered, everyone felt psychological pressure again, because the number of enemies had obviously exceeded their own, reaching about 50 people.
When Yarling, with a wicked smile, appeared, three "Desire Apostles"—the dull Sandy and the handsome Weitz—had already gathered on the outskirts of the town.
"The Archbishop ordered us to kill this group of people who are destroying the Holy Tree!" Yarling said with a sneer as he began to "Devilize" himself. Of course, they knew that Hobert had not yet appeared. They could all feel the threat from the enemy, which proved that Hobert still had a backup plan, but they had not used their full strength either.
The Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 individuals laughed "hehe" and transformed into a "Demonized" state one after another.
With Yarling's roar, the Devils launched their charge, rushing towards the square formation that Bishop Simpson had simply arranged.
Yarling and the other three Sequence 5 individuals charged at the forefront, intending to completely break the enemy's formation, and then the three "Desire Apostles" would join forces to capture Simpson.
Yes, they only intended to capture Simpson. As for the enemies wearing the robes of the Earth Mother Church, they would try to make them lose their combat power.
It wouldn't matter if a few members of the "Druid" team died, but if Simpson and his men all died here, it would definitely invite a counterattack from the Earth Mother Church.
These Devils had become accustomed to living a life of flaunting their power here. If they were to hide in the shadows again, they would really be unaccustomed to it. Therefore, their plan was to leave enough room for reconciliation with the Earth Mother Church. As for Beyonders of other pathways, they would all be killed!
However, Hobert's wife had to be kept alive to humiliate Hobert.
Simpson held his sword and came to the outermost perimeter of the team. He raised his head and roared angrily, and his body suddenly grew larger, tearing his clothes, transforming into a giant bear covered in brown fur, more than two meters tall.
His hands were different from bear paws, similar to human hands, and he could still hold the sword in his hand.
The two sides, one defending and one attacking, quickly closed the distance, finally reaching the range for using ranged skills. Simpson stomped his foot, and the weeds on the roadside grew at an extremely fast speed, turning into ink-green vines with barbs.
These vines, like tentacles, went to entangle the enemies who were charging over.
The "Demonized" individuals rushing at the front summoned fireballs to burn the vines.
A batch of vines was immediately burned by the blue flames, but another batch entangled several Devils and some Beyonders of other Sequences.
The barbs on these vines were poisonous. The entangled "Devils" were only limited in their movements because they could create poisonous mist in their "Demonized" state, and they also had some resistance to poison.
However, the entangled lower-Sequence Beyonders, such as "Unwinged Angels," immediately showed symptoms of poisoning, such as fatigue and vomiting.
As the distance between the two sides closed further, extraordinary skills began to fly. The "Devils" used curses and sulfur fireballs, the "Interrogators" used "Mental Whips," the "Judges" used "Exile," the "Biologists" used poison attacks, the "Demonesses of Pleasure" used frost attacks, the Astrologers used "Tumble," and so on, dazzling the eyes.
When the "Devils" approached and the two sides began melee combat, the battlefield completely fell into chaos.
Yarling wielded a "Magma Greatsword" like a war blade and clashed with Simpson. The "Planter" pathway also had excellent strength, and Simpson, who was also in a transformed state, was not inferior to Yarling in terms of strength.
The others also found their respective opponents and began to fight. They didn't have much experience in team battles, and Simpson didn't have experience in commanding team battles, so in the end, they still had to start one-on-one fights.
The first to notice something was wrong was the dull Sandy, who realized that the opponent's Sequence 6 seemed too powerful.
Sandy's opponent was Angus, who had used "Exile" to exile a "Devil" who had rushed close back into the thorny vines.
Logically speaking, he was a Beyonder of the "Arbiter" pathway, but when Sandy used the ability of "Corruption" to sneak attack Angus, Angus became like a phantom, dodging Sandy's attack.
At the same time, Angus opened his mouth and let out a sharp scream, which had a certain impact on Sandy's spiritual body, who had no defense against it.
Then Angus used "Psychic Pierce!"
The Sequence 6-level "Psychic Pierce" immediately made Sandy's face full of pain, as if someone was hammering his brain.
After Angus succeeded with one strike, he immediately launched a series of offensives: "Death!"
He delivered a punch that Sandy could not dodge, knocking Sandy away, fracturing his skull.
Taking advantage of this gap, Angus immediately said, "Devilization is forbidden here!"
The Sequence 6-level "Prohibition" can only be used once and cannot accumulate effects. Moreover, the "Prohibition" below the demigod level, after prohibiting a certain ability or creating a certain order that is beneficial to oneself, does not mean that this ability cannot be used or that this order cannot be broken.
Just like Angus prohibiting "Devilization," the enemy who is "Devilizing" will feel a certain burden and will be weakened to a certain extent, while Angus's power will become stronger because the opponent has violated Angus's "Law."
At the Sequence 5 level, the degree of this weakening and strengthening will increase, and for enemies who violate the "Law," the "Disciplinary Knight's" strikes can more effectively damage the enemy. Facing such attacks, the enemy cannot dodge or avoid them, they can only withstand them. This is the so-called "Retribution" process.
Therefore, Hobert, who has become a "Mentor of Disorder," no longer cares much about the "Judge's" "Prohibition," but he still has to take the "Disciplinary Knight's" "Prohibition" seriously.
At this time, Angus in the battle is increasing in all aspects of power.
A fractured skull is not fatal to an "Desire Apostle." Sandy got up from the ground and summoned the "Magma Sword" again.
At the same time, another "Judge" of Sequence 6 in the first team replaced Angus and launched a further attack: "Imprisonment!"
One of the most difficult aspects of Beyonders of the "Arbiter" pathway and the "Lawyer" pathway is that many of their abilities cannot be avoided.
Sandy, as an "Desire Apostle," still could not avoid the "Judge's" "Imprisonment," but before being "Imprisoned," Sandy used a very evil tone to form a word: "Die!"
This was his ability of "Filth Language." At the same time as he was "Imprisoned," the "Judge" felt as if his heart was being tightly gripped by an invisible hand, and blue flames were burning in his chest.
The "Judge" fell to the ground, clutching his heart in pain. Fortunately, the "Judge" remembered the Sealed Artifact on his body during his death throes.
When he injected his spirituality into the Sealed Artifact, the blue flames were quickly covered by white frost, and the "Judge's" heart struggled to resume beating.
This was the ability of the "Zombie" to control frost and make his body strong, making his body as hard as steel.
The frost extinguished the blue flames, and the strong body restored vitality to the heart.
In addition, the "Judge" at this time was already a "Zombie," already wandering on the edge of death, so Sandy's "Filth Language" was resolved.
Whether it was the Sealed Artifact on this "Judge" or the Sealed Artifact on Angus, they were very restrained against the abilities of the "Desire Apostles," because Sandy did not feel much emotional fluctuation from the enemy, which would greatly limit the "Desire Apostle's" ability to manipulate desire.
In essence, both "Wraiths" and "Zombies" do not have much emotional fluctuation, but because the Sealed Artifacts were seized from the "Rose School," they all have negative effects such as the amplification of desire.
However, after being sealed by the "Nation of Disorder," these negative effects will only appear after being used for a period of time. At that time, the Sealed Artifacts must be replaced or put away quickly.
Sandy had already broken free from the "Imprisonment" state, and Angus had already taken his place, continuing to fight Sandy. Sandy did not expect that in such a crucial battle, he would be suppressed by two Sequence 6 individuals.
As the Sequence 6 "Judge" rejoined the battle, Angus's eyes suddenly turned completely white. With him as the center, the surrounding ground suddenly turned black, and thorny vines with teeth and eyes grew out of it.
These vines greedily devoured the spirituality of the surrounding enemies, and they were like phantoms, making it difficult for Sandy's fireballs to cause damage to them.
"Slow!" Sandy used "Filth Language" again to slow down the vines that were entangling him.
Not far away, a Sequence 7 "Serial Killer" was unfortunately entangled by the vines, and the teeth immediately gnawed at his spiritual body. In the "Serial Killer's" painful screams, his spirituality was being rapidly drained.
If no one saved him, his spiritual body would be directly sucked dry, turning into a corpse.
This was just a corner of the battlefield, and Sandy's situation was not an exception.
Another "Desire Apostle," Weitz, was also entangled by a Sequence 6 and a Sequence 7 from the "Druid" team.
The sword in Bishop Simpson's hand was a magical item of the "Hunter" pathway, with excellent armor-breaking ability, and Yarling had already been injured.
This made their previous three-on-one tactics completely ineffective.
The battles at the Sequence 6 level were similar to the situations encountered by the three "Desire Apostles," being entangled or besieged by "Mid Sequence" Beyonders wielding Sealed Artifacts.
Yarling, who was in the first wave of attack as a "Devil," was also strange. Where did the enemy get so many Sealed Artifacts?
This was one aspect of Hobert's wealth. In the previous battle in the Southern Continent, he directly obtained 13 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts, and the three mercenary teams also "transported" 4 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts to him.
However, Hobert auctioned off one of them earlier in order to gather popularity.
Also, when he helped Rafter recover the Beyonder characteristics of the Pond family, he obtained 4 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts.
A few days ago, Hobert also inherited 1 Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, and Christian gave him 3 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts.
These Sealed Artifacts were all ones that he did not often use or carry with him.
There were also some Sealed Artifacts he didn't use much anymore, such as the "Teleportation Statue." Hobert gave the statue to Fors along with the pistol.
Adding everything up, Hobert now had more than 20 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts, which is why he was so generous in equipping each 'Mid-Sequence' Beyonder in the Special Operations Division with one Grade 2 Sealed Artifact. He also generously lent Simpson three.
Equipping over a dozen Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts significantly boosted the combat power of the official Beyonders.
Without these Sealed Artifacts, Yarling's side, with three Sequence 5s and several Sequence 6s, would have been enough to control the situation, but now they were locked in a bitter struggle.
Additionally, for Beyonders of the 'Abyss' pathway, the first qualitative change only occurred at Sequence 6, 'Devil.' Before that, 'Criminal,' 'Unwinged Angel,' and 'Serial Killer' had decent fighting abilities but lacked sufficient offensive power.
Therefore, the combat at the 'Low-Sequence' level wasn't showing much progress either, and Yarling felt that his side's advantage had been completely lost.
At this moment, a shrill scream caught Yarling's attention. A 'Devil' had somehow broken through the crude defense set up by Bishop Simpson and entered the rear of the opponent's formation.
However, he was immediately swarmed, shot at close range by Fors, and his condition became very strange. Helen's ice spear also pierced the 'Devil's' chest, covering it with frost.
Logically, these attacks shouldn't have been too serious for a 'Demonized' Devil, but his movements became very slow, and he couldn't dodge the attacks of the surrounding Beyonders' cold weapons.
The scream just now was the 'Devil' realizing that his life was about to end, and it was also a warning to his companions.
Yarling also noticed that there were already seven or eight corpses lying on the ground, most of them 'Serial Killers.'
Even more surprisingly, Yarling saw two of his subordinates actually helping the enemy attack the slow-moving 'Devil.'
This 'Devil' was, of course, moved to the rear by Fors using the 'Teleportation Statue.' Previously, she and Helen had tried to cooperate and had already killed several 'Serial Killers,' saving their companions from perilous situations multiple times.
After everyone was prepared, Fors simply 'moved' a 'Devil' over. Under Archibald's control with spiritual threads, the 'Devil' was quickly killed by the surrounding people.
As for the two subordinates who were 'helping' the enemy, they were two 'Serial Killers' who had been turned into puppets by Archibald.
Archibald wasn't very satisfied with these two puppets because they only had some killing skills and the ability to hide their tracks, as well as the ability to become cold-blooded and hide all emotions and auras for a certain period.
They needed to go through some rituals to obtain some Beyonder abilities from 'High-Level Devils.' They themselves only possessed the Beyonder power of 'Poison Fire' and severely lacked extraordinary offensive capabilities.
As for the ability to interfere with divination, Archibald certainly didn't need it.
With the first 'Devil' killed, there was soon a second. The excellent Sealed Artifact in Fors's hand successfully changed the course of the battle.
In fact, if Archibald used its full power, it would become the key to changing the battle.
But it lacked sufficient motivation and didn't plan to participate too much in this battle.
Hobert also knew this, so he only assigned it the task of protecting Fors.
The reason was simple: Hobert understood the concept of 'vested interests' too well. Simpson and the others all had their own purposes in this battle, so they would fight with all their might.
But Hobert had already divided up the benefits of this battle, and there was no way to give anything more to the Demonic Wolf of Fog. Only giving it cold commands to fight would only result in it slacking off.
This attitude could easily ruin things at a crucial moment.
So Hobert simply didn't count on the Demonic Wolf of Fog.
Until Fors 'moved' the third 'Devil' from the chaotic battle area to the rear, surrounded and killed it, the 'Devil' side, due to the lack of high-level combat power, finally couldn't hold on and began to show signs of collapse!
At this moment, the space behind them became illusory, and Hobert, holding a black knife, stepped out from the spirit world.
Hobert wore a cold smile: "Weaken!"
Several fleeing enemies were immediately 'weakened.' Hobert rushed up and began to massacre almost like chopping vegetables.
Hobert's appearance completely shattered the psychological defenses of Yarling and the others. Even a 'Desire Apostle' wasn't Hobert's opponent, and now Yarling and the others were all entangled and couldn't spare any hands to deal with Hobert.
This allowed Hobert to enter the enemy ranks like a tiger among sheep, causing the enemy's 'Low-Sequence' Beyonders to turn around and run.
The fleeing enemies returned to the battlefield. Their Beyonder abilities allowed them to remain calm, but calmness and reason couldn't overcome the gap brought by power.
Hobert noticed that Angus and his companions, in the most intense part of the battle, were going to pursue Sandy. Hobert quickly shouted, "Maintain formation! The enemy hasn't used their full strength yet!"
Hobert's orders were very effective for the Beyonders of the first and second squads. Angus and the others immediately gave up the idea of pursuing and went to prepare to kill the 'Devil' who was struggling nearby.
Just as Hobert said, the enemy hadn't used their full strength yet!
Sandy withdrew from the battle at Yarling's signal because Yarling had received a reminder from Archbishop Bowen that reinforcements were about to arrive.
And Bowen didn't intend to take action for the time being because he sensed the threat from the enemy's demigod. He was preparing to wait for the other side to strike first, and he had prepared a surprise for the enemy's demigod.
Sandy's retreat was just to lure some of the enemies away from their crude formation so that they could eliminate these pursuing enemies first when reinforcements arrived.
Before long, led by the voluptuous female Devil Gloria and the cold-faced Wordsworth, two 'Desire Apostles,' more than thirty reinforcements arrived on the battlefield.
Not only Simpson, but the Devils were also experiencing this large-scale group battle for the first time.
Hobert had watched this kind of battle several times. Two of them were the hundred-person and two-hundred-person group battles initiated by the Balk family, and one was the ambush of the Feysac Empire's Beyonders by the Loen mercenaries in the Southern Continent.
At that time, Hobert took the opportunity to summarize a lot of experience in Beyonder group battles, and 'maintaining formation' was the most useful and most critical point.
With the addition of the enemy reinforcements, Hobert took out "1-102," the Sealed Artifact that looked like a puppet.
Da da da da~
Before Gloria and the others could rush close, the puppet in Hobert's hand quickly shook its head, and then it raised its first hand.
A puddle of water in a nearby field lost all its color and reflection, turning into an opaque gray.
Behind the gray was another world, the most unknown and terrifying side of the 'World in the Mirror.' Suddenly, a hazy skull appeared in the gray.
Wordsworth, who was closer to the puddle, suddenly collapsed on the ground as if he had lost all his bones.
Before the reinforcements could reach the battlefield, they had already lost a Sequence 5 combatant.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - 489: Demigod War (Bonus 10)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Идеал for becoming a free member]
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After the "Desire Apostle" Wordsworth fell to the ground, two black arms covered in short, stiff down stretched out from the gray puddle. They seemed to be able to extend infinitely, reaching from the field to grab Wordsworth.
Wordsworth tried several times but couldn't sit up. He quickly summoned more than twenty fireballs with blue flames and smashed them towards the two arms and the gray puddle.
The arms, seemingly devoid of any life, nimbly dodged the fireballs. The fireballs that hit the puddle didn't make any sound of water splashing. Instead, they entered another world, transforming into fireballs burning with a gray, hazy flame.
The surrounding people were seeing gray flames for the first time. They didn't look like flames at all; rather, it was as if the fireballs were emitting gray dust.
These fireballs had completely escaped Wordsworth's control. "Slow!"
He used the power of "Devil Language" to stop the fireballs from crashing into him.
One of Wordsworth's "Devil" subordinates summoned a "Magma Sword" to chop at the two arms.
However, as soon as he summoned the "Magma Sword," he seemed to be controlled by an invisible force, rolling over in an abnormal way, ending up upside down.
At some point, the second hand of "1-102" had already been raised. In the unblinking eyes of a corpse on the ground, all color suddenly vanished, turning gray. Within this layer of gray film, there was a shadow resembling a jellyfish.
It was a jellyfish toxin that made the "Devil" feel upside down, a toxin that made the "Devil" feel that being upside down was normal.
Then, the "Devil" swung his large fist, pounding his chest forcefully, "Thump, thump." This was another type of jellyfish toxin that made the "Devil's" chest feel very heavy, only feeling comfortable when struck hard.
"1-102" effectively stopped the reinforcements' offensive. They weren't sure how many monsters the Sealed Artifact in Hobert's hand could summon. A "Desire Apostle" and a "Devil" had already been hit. The Sequence 7 and "Low Sequence" Beyonders in the reinforcements were too frightened to rush forward.
However, Gloria knew that she should eliminate Hobert as soon as possible. Only by eliminating Hobert could her companions be saved, and only by eliminating Hobert could they join up with Yarling and the others who were struggling to hold on, completely reversing the unfavorable situation.
"Die!" Gloria uttered several evil syllables, forming an evil concept.
"Knight!" As if in response, Hobert recited an ancient Hermes incantation.
Hunter, with eyeballs hanging on his cheeks, appeared in front of Hobert, taking the brunt of Gloria's "Devil Language" for Hobert.
But Hunter was already dead. The invisible hand groped around his heart, but it was useless.
As for those blue flames, they were quickly covered by the ghastly white light on Hunter's body, extinguishing rapidly like flames that had lost all fuel.
At this moment, one leg of "1-102" in Hobert's hand lifted up. A shiny metal button on a nearby corpse lost its luster, turning a hazy gray.
This time, there was no shadow, but a skeletal hand reached out, grabbing the edge of the gray button. Immediately afterward, a complete skeleton crawled out.
The button was only the size of a normal button, but it gave people the feeling that the skeleton was crawling out of a well.
The skeleton held a bone sword emitting a ghastly white light. After it came out of the metal button completely, it was about the same build as a normal person, except for being a bit taller.
To Hobert's surprise, the skeleton, holding the bone sword, rushed towards him.
This was a monster that felt that the enemy's face was not very good, and instead took a liking to Hobert's face.
Just as Hobert was about to block with his knife, Hunter suddenly deflected the bone sword: "So my bones were in the Mirror World, no wonder I couldn't find them no matter how hard I looked."
He said to Hobert: "Leave him to me. If we're talking about swordsmanship, you're no match for him."
As Hunter spoke, he and the skeleton had already exchanged several sword strikes back and forth.
Because they had already understood each other's moves and counter-measures, it was meaningless to continue attacking.
Hobert couldn't have asked for more: "He's all yours."
At this time, Gloria had already rushed to the front, and Hobert fought with this female demon who had a very good figure and was not wearing much.
Hobert complained in his heart: Is this what is called a devil figure?
Gloria at this time "Demonized", while using the "Magma Greatsword" to chop, while summoning blue fireballs, surrounding Hobert and smashing.
What made it difficult for her to understand was that she couldn't feel any emotional fluctuations in Hobert, which greatly reduced the attack power of the "Desire Apostle".
The other four "Devils" also joined the battle with "Magma Swords". Hobert was no match for four fists with two hands, and rolled and crawled to avoid their attacks.
At this time, the second leg of "1-102" finally lifted up. A sword flashing with cold light on the battlefield suddenly turned gray. In the gray film, a shadow of a crown appeared.
A Sequence 6 "Devil" suddenly seemed to have lost his soul, staring blankly at the blurry crown: "What a beautiful crown, put it on, and I will be the king, hahahaha ~"
As he spoke, he walked step by step towards the crown. After taking two steps, the "Devil" seemed to realize something, and his face began to struggle. The leg that had stepped out hesitated to fall.
"Holy Light!" Hobert endured a "Magma Sword" on his chest, and summoned "Holy Light" with the "Light Priest Ring" at the right time.
The reason why it was said to be the right time was because the laughter from the "Devil" who was just attracted by the "Crown" made the other "Devils" unconsciously try to stay away from him, resulting in them gathering together.
One "Holy Light" went down, encompassing Gloria and one "Devil", and another "Devil" was on the edge of the "Holy Light". He quickly dodged, but still had his entire shoulder encompassed by the "Holy Light".
Hobert endured the excruciating pain of a hole being burned in his chest: "Disorder!"
The "Devil" who was closest to Hobert and stabbed Hobert fell into a state of "Disorder".
Hobert slashed from his left shoulder to his right waist. The "Devil" who had recovered from the "Disorder" state was filled with horror. In his unbelievable expression, his upper body slid to the ground.
"Distortion!" Hobert "Distorted" the concept between himself and Gloria. This female demon, who had suffered considerable damage from the "Holy Light", also had wounds on her chest and was bleeding, sharing Hobert's injuries.
This made her even weaker.
Hobert used a "Healing Spell" on himself, and the wound on his chest was mostly healed. Not having time to wait for the injury to fully recover, Hobert rushed forward to attack the three "Devils" who had been hit by the "Holy Light" and were now weak.
Perhaps seeing that the Sealed Artifact in Hobert's hand was no longer summoning any monsters, those "Serial Killers" and "Unwinged Angels" were preparing to bypass the battlefield of Hobert and others from the fields to support Yarling and others who were obviously somewhat overwhelmed.
"Corrosion!" Just as they were about to pass Hobert, Hobert's long-brewing "Corrosion" erupted.
Although the Beyonders of the "Criminal" pathway are known for their calmness and rationality, their minds are usually too dark. "Corrosion" can easily detonate the dark side of their hearts, causing the grievances they have accumulated to erupt at this moment, causing infighting. Or make stupid moves like going to the corner of the battlefield to go to the toilet, or sitting on the ridge of the field watching the battle in front of them like watching a play.
Even Hobert's three opponents were affected to varying degrees. Hobert took the opportunity to stab a "Devil", and was about to backhand and kill the opponent, but Gloria, who had recovered first, deflected Hobert's knife, saving the life of that "Devil" companion.
Hobert was not in a hurry, slowly grinding down Gloria and the two "Devils". He had already used "1-102" to block the enemy's reinforcements, completing his first mission.
This is the power of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, allowing Hobert to face enemies several times his number.
With multiple Sequence 5 and Sequence 6 on the enemy side, "1-102" is easier to use than "1-103", because the monsters summoned by "1-102" will first attack the enemy's high-level combat power.
Now the problem is thrown back to Bowen. Bishop Simpson's side is gaining more and more advantages. If it weren't for Yarling constantly amplifying Simpson and others' carelessness, anger, and other emotions, causing them to always miss the chance for the final blow, there would be no suspense in the battle situation over there at this time.
If that Archbishop named Bowen doesn't care, most of his subordinates will have to explain it here.
And if Bowen makes a move first, then he will completely lose the initiative. Hobert can win without summoning reinforcements, but he will not be able to hunt the other party's demigod.
At this time, Hobert also thought that it would be a bit wrong if Bowen made a move in advance. He should be able to feel the malice from Jonathan. If he makes a move, will it mean that he has other means?
Just as Hobert was thinking about these things, his spirituality sensed something and looked at the burning tree. Suddenly, the flames in one area turned blue, and ten "Demonized" figures jumped out from inside.
Hobert was somewhat surprised, and quickly injected his spirituality into a piece of metal in his pocket, which was Jonathan's "Communicator". As long as he injected spiritual power here, Jonathan would be able to sense it as long as he was not out of the South Coelson area.
The appearance of these ten enemies was unexpected for Hobert. Judging by their size, there were 3 "Desire Apostles" and 6 "Devils" among them.
Generally, "Devils" in their "Demonized" state are over two meters tall, while "Desire Apostles" in their "Demonized" state are nearly three meters tall, making them easy to distinguish.
They were likely a batch of forces recently recruited from other places, hidden by Bowen until now.
In short, they were not within Hobert's calculations.
Moreover, this group of "Devils" appeared near the second squad of the Special Operations Team. Their position on the battlefield seemed carefully chosen, targeting the weakest point in Jeffrey's Beyonder force, where Fors was also located within the second squad.
Helen immediately led the second squad to move closer to the first squad, hoping Angus and the others could spare some energy to block these demons.
However, the "Devils" attacked with extreme speed, closing within meters of Helen and the others in the blink of an eye. Just as they were preparing to unleash a massacre, a tall and wide door filled with illusory colors suddenly appeared before them.
The space behind the door seemed to become extremely distant, as if it were another dimension.
The demons quickly halted their advance, all sensing the immense threat emanating from the door.
Ah~
Just as they were awaiting further orders from their leader, a "Devil" suddenly let out a miserable scream. Without them noticing, a man in his thirties, clean-shaven and with meticulously combed hair, had appeared beside them.
This was Jonathan, whom Hobert had "called" for assistance. He could conceal his spirituality and aura, entering a state of "Concealment."
Even "Devil" with "Danger Perception" couldn't anticipate from which direction Jonathan would appear.
The state of "Concealment," combined with a sudden attack, meant that even a Sequence 6, let alone a demigod, could fall victim to his ambush.
Fortunately, this pathway didn't have overly strong offensive Beyonder abilities. Therefore, the silver-white, frost-glowing, beautiful short sword in Jonathan's hand was a carefully selected sealed artifact, possessing extreme attack power and a significant chance of "critical hits."
"Charm!" Just as the other nine were launching attacks on Jonathan, he unleashed a skill he had recorded. The attacks of the "Desire Apostles" and others struck Jonathan, but the instant they hit, Jonathan's figure became illusory—it was just a phantom!
Simultaneously, the effect of "Charm" caused all nine to stop in their tracks. The more they looked at Jonathan, the more they found him handsome and charming, inspiring genuine affection from the bottom of their hearts.
When Jonathan reappeared, none of the "Devils" showed any intention of attacking. Thus, Jonathan easily eliminated an "Desire Apostle."
As Jonathan continued his assault, his spirituality stirred with a premonition, and he vanished once more behind an illusory door. Almost simultaneously with his disappearance, a shadowy figure carrying malice emerged.
This shadowy figure seemed to be the embodiment of evil thoughts. The remaining eight "Devils" immediately felt the growth of their own evil thoughts, which snapped them out of the "Charm" state.
Just as the shadowy figure was about to transform into a human shape, a "Holy Light" descended from the sky. Jonathan had unknowingly reappeared in a corner, using "Holy Light," which was effective against evil creatures, to attack the enemy.
The shadowy figure abruptly turned, dodging the "Holy Light," and charged towards Jonathan: "Wrath!"
The "Holy Light" struck a "Devil," causing it to lose a significant portion of its combat power.
Another door materialized in front of Jonathan, in that instant, he and the shadowy figure on the ground seemed to exist in separate worlds.
The shadowy figure's "Wrath" attack also missed its mark.
Hiding behind the illusory door, Jonathan extended his weapon-wielding hand, which turned ethereal, suddenly appearing directly above the shadowy figure. With a forceful thrust, the hand pierced towards the shadowy figure.
Suddenly, Jonathan seemed to snap back to his senses: Wouldn't it be better to use "Banishment"? Why risk directly stabbing it?
This attack method was indeed seized upon by the shadowy figure. While taking a sword strike, the shadowy figure entangled Jonathan: "Come out!"
In fact, this wasn't a tactical error on Jonathan's part; it was the "Devil's" signature skill, "Corruption!", which would slowly and gradually degrade the enemy's rationality and thinking ability, eventually rendering them dull-witted.
Jonathan was also a demigod-level Beyonder, and although he wouldn't become a fool in combat, he was still affected by "Corruption," becoming careless and making the wrong choices.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - 490 Summoning the Bloody Archduke! (Bonus 11)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Тьма for becoming a free member]
The "Devil's" power was immense; the shadow directly yanked Jonathan out from behind the door.
At that moment, it transformed back into a human form, saying, "Grief!"
Without waiting for emotional fluctuations, the "Devil" could directly trigger the enemy's emotions.
This time, Jonathan couldn't evade it and immediately recalled his most sorrowful memories. He looked around, realizing so many vibrant lives had perished just like that! He felt that so many had already died in this battle; was there any need to continue fighting?
Not only was Jonathan affected, but the eight "Devils" who had just left were also overwhelmed with grief. Two of them even knelt on the ground and began to weep loudly.
The earlier "Rage" had also influenced those around them, and now it was replaced by "Grief," making everyone feel their emotional defenses collapsing, alternating between crying and displaying angry expressions.
This gave the already precarious Yarling and the other three "Desire Apostles" an opportunity. They ignited and amplified their opponents' emotions, finally gaining a chance to breathe.
Helen, Fors, and the others knew their emotions were highly abnormal and tried to stay away from the battlefield. Among them, only Archibald's emotions were normal, but the puppets beside him were one filled with rage and the other wailing.
Just then, Archibald found a suitable target: a wounded and grief-stricken "Demon."
Suddenly, the "Devil's" movements became sluggish. Everyone was in a bad mood and didn't notice the "Devil's" abnormality at all.
After a few seconds, the "Devil" stood motionless. By then, it was too late to rescue him.
Five seconds later, the wounded "Devil" expressionlessly stood up and summoned the "Magma Sword" once more, killing a "Serial Killer."
Archibald then nodded, quite satisfied with this puppet: "Lady, please 'move' another 'Devil' over here."
He wanted to test the attack power of his new puppet. Ideally, he would use an "Desire Apostle," but the "Teleportation Idol" would experience some delay when moving targets at Sequence 5, making it difficult to achieve his desired effect.
At this point, those on the "team battle" battlefield had finally escaped the range of the two demigods and would no longer be accidentally injured by their area-of-effect attacks.
And in the dozen or so seconds that had just passed, the battle between the two demigods seemed to have reached a conclusion.
Earlier, Jonathan's emotions had been triggered by the "Devil" Bowen, and the shadow had first formed his claws, grabbing towards Jonathan.
But the moment he grabbed Jonathan, a phantom door appeared on Jonathan's body, causing Bowen to grab at empty air.
Although Jonathan's face was still filled with grief, a faint smile couldn't help but appear at the corner of his mouth. Although his emotions were triggered and ignited by Bowen, it didn't mean that he, also a demigod, had no room for resistance.
At the level of demigod, Jonathan could turn a part of himself into a phantom door, thereby avoiding damage to himself.
"Holy Light!" Jonathan cried out, covering Bowen with a massive pillar of light.
Having just "Demonized," Bowen wasn't too afraid of this Sequence 5 level attack. Even against abilities that heavily countered him, he had ways to deal with them: "Eruption!"
The ground within a dozen meters suddenly turned crimson, then liquefied, and magma spewed out, covering Jonathan and Bowen, while also blocking the falling "Holy Light."
The intense light disappeared, and the magma fell. Bowen was covered in magma, seemingly enjoying the fiery bath.
Meanwhile, phantom doors appeared around Jonathan, and the magma hadn't harmed him in the slightest.
Standing before Jonathan was now a "Devil" with rough, dark-red skin, pointed ears, fangs, a pair of yak horns, a pair of wings, and a long tail.
"Devilification" was an advanced form of "Demonification," possessing greater power and defensive capabilities, the ability to fly, and a significant boost to mental attacks.
Moreover, after "Devilification," he could use the "Transaction" ability, though this ability required some time to prepare.
At this moment, Bowen was grabbing Jonathan's weapon-wielding arm, trying to press Jonathan into the magma, but suddenly discovered that the entire arm holding Jonathan's hand was covered in a layer of white frost.
Jonathan had been using the ice power he had recorded since earlier, and this ice attack was at the demigod level. The magma droplets on Bowen's arm were all frozen.
Jonathan stepped on appearing and disappearing phantom doors to avoid falling into the magma, seemingly regaining his senses after his brief "carelessness."
The weapon in his hand, controlled by Bowen, suddenly turned illusory and appeared directly in front of him. He grabbed the weapon with his other hand and stabbed it into Bowen's chest.
Bowen glared at Jonathan as he unleashed a "mental attack" while quickly releasing Jonathan's arm and retreating.
Jonathan immediately felt a tightening all over his body, his entire being tensed up, and then an invisible torrent seemed to impact his spirit body, causing him to pause in place. The emotions he had just calmed down once again became sorrowful.
Bowen opened up a distance from Jonathan. This "Devil" actually clutched his wound and turned to run.
It turned out that Jonathan's ice attack had caused a layer of white frost to appear on the two wounds on his body.
Jonathan's sealed artifact came from a "Demoness of Despair." The earlier ice attack was also recorded from the "Demoness of Despair." The two triggered a connection, making Bowen's injuries extremely serious, forcing him to flee.
Jonathan endured the emotional fluctuations and immediately chased after him.
On the other battlefield, the eight "Devil" finally joined the fight.
This fresh force made it difficult for Bishop Simpson and the others, who had been fighting for some time, to resist. Their crude defense line was finally breached.
One of the "Desire Apostles" led three "Devil" into the second team.
Fors fired several shots in a row, all dodged by the "Devil" in front of her, and the "Teleportation Idol" had reached its maximum usage time and had just been put away.
Just as she was facing a Sequence 6 attack and feeling flustered, a hand pulled her behind him. Hobert's familiar figure appeared before her, drawing his blade to block the "Devil's" "Magma Sword."
...
Hobert's battle took a dramatic turn. Hant had been sparring with his skeleton for quite some time, finally knocking the sword out of the skeleton's hand.
The skeleton turned and ran towards where it had appeared, towards the gray button. Hant chased after it and collided with the skeleton, as if forcing the skeleton to put on clothes, gradually covering himself with the skeleton.
The skeleton struggled fiercely, and after the two pulled at each other for a minute or two, Hant finally merged his skeleton into his body.
After this process was completed, Hant underwent a noticeable change. The pale white light on his body turned silvery-white, appearing more solid, and even had a sense of holiness.
Hant took a deep breath. When he swung his sword again, he actually unleashed a silvery-white sword light!
He slowly pressed his eyeballs back into their sockets, but the eyeballs still couldn't move normally, making him look strange.
But Hobert and the others didn't dare say anything, because his sword light had just torn five enemies apart! Everyone around felt a huge sense of oppression.
Hant smiled at Hobert and said, "I'll hold them back for you!"
The enemies who had been affected by "Corruption" had gradually recovered their state, and Hobert's pressure suddenly increased.
He had already seen out of the corner of his eye that the battle situation had once again become unfavorable for Simpson and the others after the demigods took action, so he couldn't allow the two enemy forces to converge.
Hant, who had merged with his skeleton, had obviously greatly improved his strength and was more than capable of stopping Gloria and the others.
So Hobert left the battlefield here to Hant and went to support Simpson and the others. He happened to come over and help Fors resist the "Devil's" attack.
As for why Archibald didn't protect Fors? In fact, Archibald was right next to Fors, but he saw Hobert coming over, so of course he wouldn't join in the fun.
After Hobert arrived on the battlefield, Archibald thoughtfully manipulated the "Devil's" spirituality threads in front of Hobert, slowing down the Devil's movements by half a beat, resulting in Hobert killing the "Devil" with a single strike, allowing Hobert to show off in front of Fors.
Fors breathed a sigh of relief, feeling a surge of security: "It's a good thing you're here."
Hobert smiled at Fors, nodded approvingly at Archibald, and then pointed to the "Desire Apostle" who was charging over.
Archibald was stunned at first, then immediately nodded repeatedly.
Having a "Devil" puppet, Archibald actually wanted to find an opportunity to turn an "Desire Apostle" into a puppet, after all, it was rare to encounter "Devils," and he didn't know when he would have such an opportunity again.
Hobert charged towards the "Desire Apostle": "Distortion!"
Almost at the same time, the "Desire Apostle" also identified Hobert as his target: "Slow!"
Hobert anticipated that the opponent's attack would either be "Slow" or "Death," so his earlier "Distortion" distorted the concept between himself and the enemy.
The two of them simultaneously fell into a state of "Slow." The "Desire Apostle's" companions immediately rushed over to attack Hobert.
But because the "Slow" state was divided in two, Hobert quickly recovered: "Disorder!"
He stretched out his blade to block the "Magma Swords" of the two "Demons," putting the "Desire Apostle" into a state of "Disorder," but because the "Desire Apostle" was launching a "mental attack" on Hobert at the time, the "Disorder" state only lasted for a little over a second.
Adding the previous "Slow" state, it was just over two seconds. When the "Desire Apostle" recovered from the "Disorder" state, he immediately felt his head go numb, his body stiff, and every movement became sluggish.
Hobert parried the two "Devil'" "Magma Swords," took another step forward, and continued to launch attacks on the "Desire Apostle."
In fact, Archibald wanted to stop Hobert at this time, because attacking the initially controlled "Desire Apostle" at this time would instead increase the possibility of the "Desire Apostle" breaking free.
But Archibald didn't expect that the Beyonder power Hobert used was: "Connection!"
In that instant, it deepened the "Desire Apostle's" connection with Archibald, shortening the process of completely controlling the "Desire Apostle" by three seconds!
In addition to being happy, Archibald also saw Hobert kick away an enemy who was flying over, about to hit the "Desire Apostle."
This Demonic Wolf of Fog immediately realized that Hobert was very familiar with his abilities: Perhaps this is why the "Creator" asked him to investigate me, or because he has the task of investigating me, the "Creator" told him this knowledge.
Thinking of this, Archibald breathed a sigh of relief: Fortunately, he didn't try to probe Hobert, otherwise he would definitely be discovered, and the "Creator" might have murderous intentions again.
The rolling thoughts did not hinder Archibald's speed in controlling the "Desire Apostle."
Under Hobert's protection, after ten seconds, the "Desire Apostle" stopped struggling. After another five seconds, this "Desire Apostle" spat out an evil word at a "Devil" next to him: "Die!"
The Devil immediately knelt on the ground in pain, and Hobert cut off his head with a single strike.
Archibald was about to attack the other enemies when Hobert ordered: "Protect Fors!"
Archibald nodded and gathered the four puppets to protect Fors.
At this time, Fors was holding a gun in one hand and a short sword in the other, fighting back and forth with a "Serial Killer," and didn't pay much attention to Hobert and Archibald's cooperation.
The "Fighting Ring" greatly increased Fors's combat power, and with that gun, ordinary Sequence 8s were no match for her.
And the "Serial Killer," who had not undergone qualitative changes, was also forced to retreat by Fors.
In fact, Fors didn't know that even if she fought an "Desire Apostle" at this time, she might not be defeated.
Hobert, who was about to help Bishop Simpson, suddenly felt the metal piece in his pocket heat up. This was Jonathan's signal.
Hobert immediately took out a whistle and blew it sharply.
Ten Beyonders wearing Loen-style clothing rushed out of the town. They were holding weapons, and their steps were steady. At a glance, they were Beyonders with combat experience.
These ten people were wearing masks. The leader's mask was more special, the material seemed to be black crystal, giving people a sense of weight.
Yarling noticed that their eyes could not suppress their excitement.
This was the reinforcement Hobert had found from Conant City, Elliot and ten other members of the Balk family.
In addition to their rich combat experience, Hobert also gave "1-104" to Elliot, and each of the others received a Level 2 sealed artifact.
The sealed artifacts given to them were all spoils of war other than those from the battle in the Southern Continent, so as not to make them feel that the Creator's devotees had no goods.
With the addition of this fresh force, the battle situation changed again. First, the enemy's advantage quickly disappeared, and then they began to show signs of collapse.
Once such signs appeared, it was difficult to stop. Finally, the enemies' rout began, and Bishop Simpson immediately ordered a full-line pursuit.
... Hobert left the battlefield just as Elliot and the others appeared.
He had already discussed with Jonathan that as soon as he stepped into Bowen's prepared trap, he would signal Hobert when the opponent was most proud or when he had the conditions to hunt him down. Hobert would immediately bring his "helper" and kill Bowen cleanly.
Hobert left the battlefield first, using his self-prayer method to project the "Great Sage" into the real world.
Last time, he planned to test the "Great Sage's" combat power, but the Demonic Wolf of Fog directly kneeled. This time, he must test its combat power!
Hobert dared to bring the "Great Sage" to the battlefield so openly, all thanks to the ring with the demon head on his hand.
This ring came from the "Demon Lord" Farbauti and could isolate his thoughts, preventing the "Demon" from perceiving the threat from Hobert.
So Bowen always thought his biggest threat came from Jonathan, but it was actually from Hobert, or rather, the "helper" Hobert brought!
After briefly entering the spirit world with the "Great Sage" and arriving at the demigod battlefield, Hobert was dumbfounded.
Because that was not a signal to hunt Bowen at all, but more like a distress signal.
Jonathan, who always cared about his image, was now covered in dirt and desperately dodging Bowen's claws.
The reason Jonathan didn't use "Blink" to dodge was because there was a layer of mucus on the illusory door he summoned, making it impossible for him to enter the spirit world.
This was a carefully arranged trap by a Sequence 3 "Blatherer."
This "Blatherer" heard Bowen report that the South Kerr Village altar had received instructions from the "Abyss." He personally came here to inquire about the situation, just as this extraordinary battle was about to break out.
So the "Blatherer" set up this trap with Bowen.
And Jonathan's attack did injure Bowen before, but for the "Demonized" Bowen, that little injury was nothing. He just wanted to lure Jonathan into this trap.
Throughout the valley, there was a gray, viscous liquid symbolizing "corruption." All the creatures in the valley had rust-like spots all over their bodies.
They struggled hard, but their lives were still falling into the abyss bit by bit.
On the top of the mountain stood a middle-aged man in his forties with bloodshot eyes and hair and beard standing on end. This was the "Blatherer."
He was watching the battle in the valley with a playful smile. When the "Great Sage" appeared, the middle-aged man looked over in surprise.
His surprise was normal because, before this, he had not been aware of it at all!
And Hobert, because he didn't understand the situation just now, stepped into the black mucus. The mucus seemed to have a life of its own, slowly covering Hobert's feet, and he immediately felt a huge force pulling him down.
The "Great Sage" may have sensed Hobert's predicament. It opened its huge mouth, forming a huge vortex, sucking most of the mucus in the valley into the vortex.
Hobert didn't know whether to laugh or cry: "Big brother, you can't eat everything. You will… You, you're okay?"
Then he immediately came back to his senses and, taking advantage of the fact that the other party's "Blatherer" had not yet figured out the situation, he immediately ordered in his heart: "Kill him!"
The probability of the "Great Sage" killing the "Blatherer" was certainly not high, but as long as there was such an order, the "Great Sage" would attack the "Blatherer" with all its strength.
Hobert was afraid that the "Blatherer" would see the clue, so he quickly used "Blink" to get away from the battlefield.
But he felt that this was not fast enough, and the ability to "Travel" had not yet recovered, so he quickly chanted the spell: "Skinny Horse!"
The skeleton horse named Maximilian appeared, Hobert jumped on the horse's back, and let Maximilian fly away with him.
But it was still a little late. When the "Blatherer" saw the "Great Sage" rushing towards him, he opened his mouth and made some indescribable but extremely evil sounds.
Jonathan in the valley was affected by the "Blathering," and his pace began to slow down. Fortunately, he could now use abilities such as "Blink" and could hide behind the illusory door.
And Hobert, who was about to fly out of the valley, immediately lost consciousness after hearing these "Babbling" sounds from afar. His whole body twitched, and he was covered by a layer of black shadow. This layer of black shadow seemed to have a life of its own, tearing at Hobert's spirit body.
This in turn caused Hobert's body to undergo strange changes, sometimes growing black bark-like skin, and sometimes his arms becoming like tentacles.
If Hobert didn't have items with "Order Crystal" on him, he would have lost control at this time.
Hobert's mind was still there, but it seemed to be covered by a layer of black shadow, making him unable to see anything.
Only the sound of "rumbling" remained in his head, making it difficult for him to organize effective thoughts.
He almost instinctively entered a state of meditation. Finally, the sound in his head became smaller and smaller, and the black mist in front of him became lighter and lighter.
Hobert did not dare to relax and began to "recover" control of his body. By the time he basically returned to normal, a minute had passed.
He lay on the ground panting heavily. He hadn't suffered such serious injuries in a long time.
At this time, the sky was covered with dark clouds, and a series of thunderclaps kept falling. The battle in the valley had reached its most intense point.
The "Blatherer" had already been "Demonized." He flew in the air, dodging the lightning: "Outbreak!"
Rumble~
The ground trembled violently and cracked open, and magma immediately spewed out from it, turning half of the valley into a volcano.
The entire sky was reflected orange-red by the volcano!
The "Great Sage" raised its neck, and the river water in the Taz River not far away suddenly left the riverbed and rushed towards here, extinguishing some of the spewing magma.
The riverbed, which was more than ten meters wide, suddenly appeared to have a break in the flow.
The entire valley was covered by violent water vapor, and this water vapor became viscous, turning into a gray liquid symbolizing "corruption!" This liquid squeezed, trying to trap the "Great Sage."
Whoosh~
A gust of wind that seemed to be able to blow away people, towering trees, and boulders poured into the valley, and this liquid was immediately blown out of the valley.
The steam dissipated. In the air, Hobert, who was watching the battle from afar on Maximilian's back, saw that the "Great Sage's" huge body had finally taken the opportunity to entangle the "Blatherer."
The "Blatherer" was unable to move, but still tried hard to open his mouth and spit out evil words one by one.
Suddenly, Hobert looked towards the sky with a sense of foreboding. The dark clouds in the sky rolled, reflecting an abstract symbol representing a demon.
At the same time, the magma became turbulent, and the entire valley turned into a volcano.
The magma began to change color, becoming as red as blood plasma, and a red giant hand with sharp claws stretched out from it.
Hobert's spirituality made him keep staring at the sky. He couldn't look down, or he would die!
Jonathan, who had already left the valley and was still fighting with Bowen, shouted: "Run for your lives! He summoned the 'Bloody Archduke'!"
