chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 491: An Angel-Level Battle Erupts (Bonus 12)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Leonardo Cabrera for becoming a Sequence 9: Reader]
In Feynapotter City, within a simple hall of the Alhambra Palace.
Philip I of Castile, dressed in classical attire, was contemplating the bronze book before him.
Suddenly, he became alert and looked towards the southeast.
He seemed to see a brilliant fiery cloud, sensing an extremely evil power descending upon his territory.
"That is, towards South Colson." But Philip I quickly withdrew his gaze, as he had more important matters to attend to, let the people of the Earth Mother Church worry about it.
… …
Southwestern part of the Kingdom of Feynapotter, the headquarters of the Earth Mother Church, "Source of Life".
As far as the eye could see, there were flowers, plants, and trees covered with colorful but not gaudy blossoms. These flowers were not particularly beautiful, but they gave people a very comfortable and reassuring feeling.
Many huge trees formed a massive cathedral-like structure, surrounded by green leaves, full of vibrant life, appearing like a hanging garden from a distance.
Around the cathedral were many smaller plant-based buildings, each with its own purpose. Some were residences for bishops and priests, some were living areas, and others were filled with plants that bore fruits with meat or even plants that directly produced bread.
Many bishops and priests passed through the forest paths, shuttling among those buildings, busy as usual.
The Pope, wearing a green, luxurious but not extravagant, wide-sleeved robe, an oval crown, and holding a yellow staff, suddenly arrived at the communication magic circle hall set up in the giant "Garden Cathedral".
This was a gentle middle-aged woman who looked kind but gave off a sense of withering and decay.
After the staff here bowed, the bishop in charge of the magic circle stepped forward and asked, "Your Holiness, what are your instructions?"
Even if there were any instructions, a bishop or priest would be sent to deliver the message.
Since the Pope had suddenly come here, it must be something urgent.
However, the Pope did not seem anxious at all: "Contact Gabriel."
Gabriel was the bishop of the Feynapotter region, Simpson's superior.
The bishop in charge of the communication magic circle signaled to his subordinates, and the other priests understood, immediately beginning to act, either locating the target or injecting spirituality into the surrounding crystals to activate the magic circle.
Soon, Gabriel's somewhat illusory figure appeared in the center of the magic circle, which was the archbishop's spiritual body and mental body.
Without Gabriel actively praying, the Pope could directly contact him in this way.
Gabriel was about to salute the Pope, but the Pope spoke first: "What is happening in the South Colson area?"
The Pope had read the relevant reports. At this time, it was Gabriel's subordinate who had just arrived in the South Colson area to preach.
Gabriel was slightly stunned: "Today, a large-scale battle against the Blood Sanctify Sect broke out there, cracking down on the evil organization."
Gabriel was also a little strange. He, an archbishop, had the right to make decisions on such matters and had already submitted a report in advance, so there was no problem procedurally.
The Earth Mother Church has reports of cracking down on such evil organizations every day. The bishops in the Holy See would handle it. If a small victory was achieved, they would at most give the Pope a routine report after the operation was over.
The Pope paused slightly: "A high-level battle broke out there."
"Simpson once reported that a demigod-level battle might break out." Gabriel thought, but a demigod-level battle would not alarm the Pope: "Do you need me to go and support them?"
The Pope looked to the east: "Wait a moment."
He paused and said: "Even if there is support, I will go."
Gabriel was dumbfounded, which meant that an angel-level battle was breaking out in South Colson.
… …
South Colson, west bank of Full Moon Lake.
Time returned to three minutes ago.
The sky over most of the South Colson area had turned blood red, as if blood-red raindrops could fall at any time.
Archibald, who was protecting Fors and chasing the enemy, looked at the sky, wondering if he should protect Fors and leave immediately.
Other Beyonders also felt the strong malice over there, but the fleeing enemies became excited again, as if they had been encouraged by something, stopped running, and turned back to continue fighting.
So, a new battle broke out between the two sides, and Simpson and others did not have the energy to care why the sky suddenly turned red.
Ordinary people suffered. The "expanded" volcano was already Baron Eugene's territory. A violent earthquake occurred within dozens of miles around the volcano. After many ground fissures opened, orange-red lava gushed out.
Amid people's screams, the earthquake destroyed their houses and even caused landslides, burying a large number of lives.
Lava appeared in the farmland and in the town, setting off raging fires.
But many ordinary people did not panic and run away, but knelt on the ground and worshiped in the direction of the small volcano.
They could feel that that was the demon they usually worshiped. Now this demon with great power had descended, and they had to show their piety at the first moment.
Whoosh ~
The raging fire burned, and the thick smoke floated, but it could not affect their piety.
… …
The lava in the small volcano was bubbling and boiling. At this time, the lava had turned into thick blood.
With a force of the huge hand, a head with a pair of curved horns emerged from the blood. The head had no skin, only red muscles and white bones could be seen.
He had a very uneasy smile, or rather, a very fake smile, or described as a forced smile, except that he was "muscle smiling" without skin.
Even if Hobert tried hard to close his eyes, he could still feel the fear emerging from the depths of his soul.
Such fear was engraved in his genes. The ancients had such fear and powerlessness when they were hunted by those powerful ancient Beyonder beasts.
Even Jonathan dared not look over there. He was about to open a door of illusion to escape, but he heard Hobert shouting in mid-air: "Wait a minute, keep an eye on Bowen!"
"It won't work!" Jonathan shouted: "The helper I asked you to invite is not his opponent at all!"
"I will pray to my Lord now!"
Jonathan had vaguely guessed before that Hobert seemed to have a similar faith to himself: "It's too late!"
This was his experience. When he prayed to the "Primordial Demoness", it would take several days to receive a divine revelation, but most of the time, there was no divine revelation at all.
Even praying to the Seven Gods might not immediately receive a response.
Jonathan saw that Hobert was only focused on praying and did not give him an answer: "Alas!"
He gave himself a limit of 15 seconds! After 15 seconds, he had to leave, otherwise he would not be able to leave.
But only three or four seconds passed, and Jonathan suddenly looked into the air, where a surge of surging power appeared.
Then he saw a huge ball appearing in the sky, half of the ball was pink flesh, and half was a transparent film like a soap bubble.
Inside the film, there was a light yellow liquid, and a completely dark baby was curled up in the center of the light yellow liquid.
It looked like a pregnant uterus, with an umbilical cord connecting the baby and the flesh.
This was the "Holy Infant King" that Hobert had created using the "Nation of Disorder" and the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring" he had obtained in Tingen City.
Originally, Hobert wouldn't have dared to do this, because he had no way to control the "Holy Infant King" like he ordered the "Great Sage". This guy attacked indiscriminately, and Hobert himself could easily be devoured by the "Degeneration" and other elements exhibited by the "Holy Infant King".
However, Hobert, lie on horseback, just had an inspiration. He could have Maximilian fly him along the edge of the dangerous area. He would release the "Holy Infant King" and run away immediately.
In theory, he could escape the influence of the "Holy Infant King" this way.
After a little weighing, Hobert decided to take a gamble, because now he had to do his best. If he couldn't stop the "Bloody Archduke" here, it wouldn't just be a simple failure to hunt Bowen.
Simpson, Angus, and the others would definitely not be able to escape. Hobert's investment and foundation in Jeffrey's territory would also be completely reduced to nothing.
However, desperately fighting was still desperately fighting, and he still had to try his best to protect himself. While releasing the "Holy Infant King", he also did not forget to provide a layer of barrier for himself and Maximilian as protection.
However, this layer of barrier could only last for three seconds without the continuous power support of the "Nation of Disorder".
After doing all this, Hobert returned to the real world: "Run! Run as fast as you can!"
Maximilian also knew the danger and fled like a gust of wind.
They were already quite far away from the "Bloody Archduke" and the "Holy Infant King", and with such a vigorous flight, they soon left the two angels far behind.
Three seconds later, the barrier disappeared, and Hobert immediately felt an unprecedented sense of fear. His heart was about to jump out of his chest.
This was not a description, but a direct observation. Hobert could see his chest heaving.
He felt that his heart was really about to break through the obstacles of ribs and muscles and jump out of his chest.
It was because he had reached the level of Sequence 5. If he were an ordinary person, he would have been "scared" to death long ago, and even after death, he would not know what had scared him to death.
Even a Sequence 6 would faint from such a violent reaction in the body.
At the same time, whether it was on Hobert's skin or on Maximilian's bones, thick black mucus was oozing out. Those were the elements of degradation appearing in their bodies, and the elements of degradation had actually reached a visible level.
But they all knew that the most important thing at this time was to run for their lives!
Maximilian flew desperately for another ten seconds, and the sense of fear suddenly disappeared, and the elements of degradation on their body surface no longer secreted too much.
Maximilian fell to the ground as if he had lost his strength, and he couldn't get up even after trying several times.
At this time, Hobert, who felt that he had lost half his life, sighed: This is the price of desperate fighting.
But for him, this price was worth it. It could not only protect his base, but also protect the existing fruits of victory.
He used a "Healing Spell" on himself, but it had little effect, so he came to the "Nation of Disorder" again and covered himself and Maximilian with the surging "Power of Order".
Although this would not restore the negative effects on them, it would not cause them to lose control because of it.
Then, Hobert used "True Sight" to look at the distant battlefield.
Because of the connection between the "Holy Infant King" and the "Great Sage" with the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert's "True Sight" could extend to the vicinity of the battlefield.
Then Hobert saw the "Holy Infant King" beating up the "Great Sage"!
Hobert sighed: This little brat really doesn't distinguish between friend and foe!
Logically speaking, the "Great Sage" has no emotions, which is why it gained the advantage in the previous battle.
In fact, the "Blatherer" was also quite aggrieved in his defeat. At this level, using the enemy's emotions to attack is still an important means for the "Blatherer".
But the "Great Sage" has no emotions. Isn't that annoying?
Theoretically, the "Great Sage" should not have any emotions, but at this moment, Hobert clearly saw a look of fear on that illusory snake face.
He saw the "Holy Infant King" raise his hand slightly, and the huge body of the "Great Sage" was lifted up by an invisible force. After being swung around in the air, it was slammed hard on the "Bloody Archduke" who had just crawled out.
It was quite like a naughty child playing with a snake.
Through "True Sight", Hobert finally saw clearly that the "Bloody Archduke" had no skin all over his body, and the red muscles were exposed to the air.
Even if He didn't have any fierce expressions, He looked very hideous.
Of course, His expression was indeed not fierce, but a very uncomfortable smile, like sneering, like mocking, and like smiling sinisterly.
This "Bloody Archduke" is the only remaining leader of the Blood Sanctify Sect, Duke Reze!
And at this time, it is Reze's mythical creature state.
He casually flicked away the flying "Great Sage", and then He grabbed at the "Holy Infant King", and the liquid in the spherical structure like a uterus quickly decreased.
This is why Hobert was so relieved to send the "Holy Infant King" to the Southern Colson area.
Even if He attacks indiscriminately, but in the situation where there is only one opponent of the same level, while fighting, He will also fight with the enemy's angels.
And even if the enemy's angels find that the "Holy Infant King" is also attacking his own people, He would not dare to ignore this enemy.
Unless He ends the summoning or leaves this area, He will have to fight with the "Holy Infant King".
"Wah ~"
The cry of the "Holy Infant King" shook the surrounding mountains, and Reze, the main target of the attack, had his bloody head directly explode.
But soon, a huge amount of blood gushed out of His neck, and a new head was washed out.
The excess blood flowed into the small lake formed by the earthquake just now like a stream.
In the uterus, the illusory and dark child suddenly opened his eyes and spat out unspeakable filthy words at Reze.
Reze also opened his mouth, as if no sound was made, but as if extremely depraved and evil sounds were made.
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" said in his heart: Their battle is quite like a dumb person scolding the street!
On the battlefield, the "Holy Infant King" was immediately pinched by an invisible and huge force, and He was originally round, but was actually pinched into an oval!
And Reze's chest and abdomen exploded directly.
Whoosh ~
Some thick brown liquid with a pungent fishy smell flowed out from inside.
After this liquid flowed out, and a large amount of blood spewed out, Reze's chest and abdomen automatically merged and returned to their original state.
Taking advantage of the fact that the "Holy Infant King" had not completely escaped Reze's "Whispers", Reze's huge body absorbed a large amount of blood from the volcano like a sponge, but His body did not expand.
Reze opened his mouth, and a torrent of "blood flow" sprayed towards the "Holy Infant King", covering the "Holy Infant King" who had just solved the "Whispers".
A larger blood orb formed outside the "Holy Infant King," with a tremendous force struggling inside, as if trying to break free from the constraints of the "blood orb."
However, this "blood orb" was like extremely resilient rubber, and the tremendous force couldn't break through it no matter what.
After struggling a few times, the tremendous force seemed to realize that struggling like this was futile.
But the color of the "blood orb" quickly changed. Initially, streaks of black appeared, as if some ink had been mixed into the thick blood.
As the black areas grew larger and larger, becoming entire patches, suddenly, the "blood orb" was torn open from one side, and the "Holy Infant King" seized the opportunity to escape from within.
The mass of red and black mixed thick liquid did not lose control. Instead, under the manipulation of two tremendous forces, they rubbed against each other, mixed together, and attacked each other.
At this time, Hobert, who was observing the battle in the "Nation of Disorder," had regained some of his mental strength. He realized that the strengths of both sides in this battle were evenly matched. Unless he also brought in the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord," the battle could not be resolved within the "Holy Infant King's" "summoning time."
Hobert was about to summon the black eye that could be shaped into the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" when he seemed to suddenly think: perhaps that "Blatherer" was also a breakthrough point.
After pondering for a moment, Hobert decided to first deploy the "Bull Devil Monarch" to the battlefield.
Because if he deployed the "Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord" to the battlefield again, it was very likely to attract angels from other forces.
After all, this was the Northern Continent, a Northern Continent with the dual stable rule of the royal family and the church.
So, in a corner of the battlefield, next to the "Great Sage," who had become much more illusory than when he first appeared, the "Bull Devil Monarch" with a bull's head and deer antlers suddenly appeared.
Although the "Great Sage" was losing power severely, it had been clinging tightly to that "Blatherer."
The "Blatherer" was now in a very bad state, because after the "Great Sage" suffered the attacks of two angels, it would only accelerate the dissipation of its own power.
The power that composed it was very high-level, and the two angels had no way to weaken the "Great Sage" in essence.
But the "Blatherer" was different. From the moment Duke Reze began to descend, he had been suffering the attacks of angel-level negative influences.
Although the attacks from Duke Reze of the same pathway would not be too serious for him, the depravity exhibited by the "Holy Infant King" had been tormenting the "Blatherer."
Even if the "Blatherer" also had abilities related to "Depravity," the "Depravity" of the two was different. The "Depravity" of the "Blatherer" was the depravity of desire and the flesh, while the "Holy Infant King" was the depravity of the spiritual body.
Moreover, the "Language of Foulness" created by the "Holy Infant King" made the "Blatherer" feel worse than death. If it were a Sequence 3 of another pathway, he would have already lost control.
Because the "Blatherer" had a powerful mental strength, he was still putting up a final struggle at this time.
After the "Bull Devil Monarch" appeared, he immediately uttered a hoarse syllable: "Depravity!"
Its depravity was similar to the "Depravity" of the "Holy Infant King," the only difference being that the "Bull Devil Monarch's" level of depravity was lower.
But this still immediately made the "Blatherer" suffer unbearable pain. After all, before, the "Depravity" of the "Holy Infant King" was only the negative effect that He exhibited, or rather, His influence on the surrounding environment. Wherever He went, He would affect it.
And this "Bull Devil Monarch" belonged to a targeted "special care."
"Disorder!" The "Bull Devil Monarch" used his second Beyonder power.
The "Blatherer" gasped, uttered a very vicious curse, and then his spirit completely collapsed, his body rapidly swelled, and he completely lost control.
The Great Sage turned his head and swallowed the "Blatherer," who was out of control, into his stomach in one gulp.
And the curse of the "Blatherer" before his death had no effect on the "Bull Devil Monarch." Only a small area of the "Bull Devil Monarch's" abdomen turned slightly paler.
After solving the "Blatherer," the "Bull Devil Monarch" and the "Great Sage" immediately went to support Jonathan according to Hobert's orders.
At this time, Jonathan and Bowen were both exhausted. Originally, these two demigods, who were the main force in each other's plans, were now like "little transparents," on the very edge of the battlefield.
"Distortion!" Very far away from the two demigods, the "Bull Devil Monarch" distorted Bowen's idea of escaping into the idea of "making a final blow, and escaping whether he can defeat Jonathan or not."
Nonsense, how could he not escape?
Seeing that the other party's two Sequence 3 level helpers had arrived, what was he waiting for if he didn't run?
Of course, Bowen's final blow had no strength, but it bought time for the "Great Sage" and the "Bull Devil Monarch."
Crack ~
Successive giant thunders swept towards Bowen, sweeping away the surrounding trees, rocks, and finally a layer of the mountain's surface.
Jonathan, who was not far from Bowen, quickly hid in the illusory door, while Bowen had just recovered from the effect of "Distortion." Although he immediately opened his wings and turned into gray hard stone to block the lightning.
However, streaks of lightning thicker than buckets fell and swept across, ruthlessly shattering these hard stones, and plowing through Bowen's "Demonized" body again and again.
After the intense lightning, most of Bowen's body had been charred, only a small piece of his wings remained, and he had no idea where his tail had gone.
But he still struggled to get up, wanting to summon magma to speed up his self-healing, wanting to escape here immediately.
But at this time, the "Bull Devil Monarch" had come close. It tore open the "Devil's" back and pulled out the heart that was still beating violently.
Bowen wanted to use his only remaining arm to grab his back, hoping to smooth the wound.
But his struggle now was futile. After grabbing several times, he finally fell to the ground without moving.
The "Bull Devil Monarch" held the demon's heart in one hand and grabbed the demon's corpse, heading towards Hobert.
Seeing that the goal had been achieved, Jonathan took a deep breath and completely disappeared behind the illusory door.
His current state was not very good, and he couldn't help much even if he continued to stay here.
The battle at the angel level was still continuing. Duke Reze's shadow had betrayed Him at this time and was joining forces with the "Holy Infant King" to launch an offensive.
And the liquid in the "Holy Infant King's" womb was getting less and less, and the head of the black illusory infant had been exposed. He frowned, looking as if he was very uncomfortable.
Suddenly, Duke Reze seemed to sense something and glanced at the abdomen of the "Great Sage" over there.
The aura of the "Blatherer" had completely disappeared! The "Blatherer" was the summoner, and his death meant that there was no point for Duke Reze to continue fighting.

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 492 It Rained Blood (Bonus 13)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Powerstone 100]
In the volcano, which had only a shallow layer of blood left, a full amount of bright red blood suddenly gushed out as if from a spring.
Archduke Reze returned to the blood while fighting.
Archduke Reze's figure disappeared into the thick blood, and the huge blood pit rolled like boiling water. Just as the "Holy Infant King" was about to enter the blood pit to continue the pursuit, Hobert withdrew the power of the "Holy Infant King."
Archduke Reze's shadow was no longer controlled by any power and jumped into the blood pit.
This angel-level battle finally came to an end.
However, this battlefield completely changed the surrounding terrain. The entire territory of Baron Eugene was basically unrecognizable, and the territories of Viscount Teuton and Baron Felix also suffered huge losses.
On the other side, Hobert also withdrew the power of the "Great Sage" and the "Bull Devil Monarch," which had sent the spoils to his side. Only two corpses, a "Devil's Heart," and a ball of slime were left where they disappeared.
Back in the real world, Bowen's Beyonder characteristics were already condensing, and the Beyonder characteristics of the "Blatherer" were converging towards one of his hands because he had shown signs of going out of control before his death.
This was about to form a Sealed Artifact!
After waiting for a few minutes, the hand condensing the Beyonder characteristics gradually lengthened and turned into an orange-red short blade.
This short blade seemed to be spreading maddening whispers to the surroundings at all times. Hobert only glanced at it and felt a stabbing pain in his head.
Judging from the looks of it, the negative effects of this Sealed Artifact should be significant. Hobert, who was in very bad condition, did not pick it up, but simply set up an altar, preparing to sacrifice it along with the "Devil's Heart" and the "Slime Ball" to the "Nation of Disorder."
While Hobert was setting up the altar, Maximilian limped over, tugged at Hobert's clothes with his horse's mouth, and then raised his mouth towards the "Devil's Heart" and the "Slime Ball."
Hobert immediately understood: "You want them?"
Maximilian nodded.
"Take them," Hobert said generously. "Consider it a reward for your help this time, but don't return to the underworld yet. I'll think of a way to remove the slime from your body later."
Both Hobert and Maximilian had slime symbolizing "corruption" on their bodies, which could not be shaken off and probably could not be washed off with ordinary water.
As for that slime ball, Hobert guessed that it was the slime representing "corruption" that the "Great Sage" had inhaled in the valley before.
For Hobert, the "Devil's Heart" could only be used to make talismans or as a sacrifice. Since Maximilian wanted it, he would let it take it.
Maximilian held both spoils in its mouth, and at the same time, Hobert had already sacrificed the short blade to the "Nation of Disorder," but there was no time to check it now. He had to return to the real world and take Bowen's body back to the battlefield just now.
The corpse of the "Whisperer," without the support of the short blade, turned into gray sand and quickly turned into powder, which was scattered on the surrounding land by a gust of wind.
Just as he was about to leave using "Travel," Hobert suddenly felt something and saw a young woman wearing a priest's robe and a hood on the mountain peak. She was looking towards the angel battlefield.
Although the two angels had left, they left behind a blood pool the size of a volcano, surrounded by a lot of black and gray slime representing "corruption."
Seeming to notice Hobert's gaze, the young woman looked at Hobert and smiled slightly.
Because she was wearing a hood, Hobert couldn't see her face clearly, but he noticed that there were symbols of the "True Creator" on her priest's robe!
It's someone from the Aurora Order!
She didn't stay long. After taking a few glances at the battlefield, she left.
At this time, Hobert didn't want to cause any more trouble. He quickly rode on Maximilian and left using "Travel."
Back at the original battlefield, the holy tree in the "Devil's" eyes was still burning, and corpses with severed ropes often fell to the ground.
Only a pile of corpses and ten masked men with uniform Loen-style clothing and defensive formations remained on the most intense battlefield just now.
They were Elliot and others. They were only considered a support force in this battle and had no intention of participating in the pursuit, so they did not participate in the pursuit operation.
Compared to Bishop Simpson and others, Elliot and other members of the Balk family had more "team battle" experience. They consciously stayed behind to finish off the enemies, helped the "Doctor" to rescue the wounded, and collected their spoils.
Hobert, riding Maximilian, stepped forward and said, "As I said before, the reward for your help this time is two copies of the 'Lawyer' Beyonder characteristics and two copies of the 'Barbarian' Beyonder characteristics."
Although the value of these four Beyonder characteristics was not very high, they were what the Balk family needed most. The key was that Hobert provided each of them with a Sealed Artifact.
This allowed their Sequence 7 to exert the effect of Sequence 6, and Sequence 6 to exert most of the effect of Sequence 5.
Elliot, holding "1-104," could even exert the effect of a Sequence 5.
It was because of these Sealed Artifacts that no one died in this battle, only some were injured, but they achieved considerable results.
Hobert checked their spoils and said, "It's useless for you to take these Beyonder characteristics back. Let me think about it. After paying you the reward, I still have 4 'Lawyer' Beyonder characteristics and 1 'Briber' Beyonder characteristic.
"How about I exchange these 5 Beyonder characteristics for your spoils?"
Elliot could make the decision on such a deal: "No problem!"
The Balk family really couldn't use this batch of Beyonder characteristics obtained in the battle. The key was that it was difficult to dispose of them in the Southern Continent, so it was better to exchange them for some Beyonder characteristics that they could use.
So Hobert exchanged 5 Beyonder characteristics of the "Lawyer" pathway for 1 "Desire Apostle," 1 "Devil," 4 "Serial Killers," and 4 "Unwinged Angel" Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert had previously asked Leonard, and the Church of the Evernight Goddess also purchased Beyonder characteristics of the "Abyss" pathway at the base price.
All seven orthodox churches actually purchased them. They would take them to try to make magical items or do some experiments.
In short, even if they were piled up there to gather dust, these Beyonder characteristics could not be allowed to recirculate into the hands of the "Blood Sanctify Sect."
"Put the Sealed Artifacts in your place first," Hobert said. "I will ask the 'Creator' to bestow upon you the Beyonder characteristics we just discussed. When the time comes, you can sacrifice the Sealed Artifacts to the 'Creator.'"
"Okay," Elliot asked, "Did the 'Creator' send an angel to help again just now?"
Although he didn't see the "Holy Infant King," he could still feel His aura from such a distance. He had felt that aura before when he fought against the "Rose School" in the Southern Continent.
"That's right," Hobert smiled weakly. "Actually, we didn't have such a plan at the beginning. At most, we only planned to invite two saints to participate in the battle."
Then he said seriously, "However, it is our duty to combat this evil force! This time, we severely taught the Blood Sanctify Sect a lesson and ended their evil rule in this land! The 'Creator' also strongly supports such a cause!"
Elliot and others were filled with enthusiasm. Although the Balk family never claimed to be righteous, who wouldn't want to stand on the side of justice?
After chatting for a few simple words, Elliot led his men away.
They came through the "Traveler's Gate," which Hobert had set up on a ship near the pier. Before Hobert joined the battle, he had used the "Nation of Disorder" to notify them of the "Creator's" identity and told them to prepare for action.
So they came from Conant City using the "Traveler's Gate," ambushed in Teuton Town, and waited for Hobert's whistle to rush to support him.
They were all willing to participate in this battle. This was an extraordinary battle initiated by the Northern Continent's "Creator's" follower. Being able to participate in the battle here would give them bragging rights when they returned.
Moreover, they were all happy to be able to help the Northern Continent's followers, as if they had value in being valued by the "Favored of the Lord."
Of course, they were even happier to get spoils.
After sending Elliot and others away, Hobert shouted to the villagers who were poking their heads out in Teuton Town: "Bring me a wooden tub for bathing!"
The villagers shrank their necks in fright, but they didn't dare to disobey and quickly found a large wooden tub and brought it over.
Hobert had them fill it with water, and then put the hand wearing the "Light Priest Ring" into the wooden tub. The water in the tub gradually became clearer.
Although it was originally clear water, it was now clearer than clear water, and it looked like it reflected colorful colors under the sunlight.
A large bucket of "Holy Water" was made in a few minutes.
Hobert took a bucket, drew a bucket of water, and said to Maximilian, "Bear with it."
"Holy Water" could wash away the slime on Maximilian's bones, but it was, after all, an undead creature, and Holy Water was also very harmful to it.
However, for Maximilian, the damage caused by "Holy Water" could be recovered, but if the slime symbolizing "corruption" was not removed quickly, Hobert was likely to summon a completely corrupted skeleton horse that would attack indiscriminately and be as evil as a wraith the next time he summoned it.
"No need for such trouble," Hant, who was on the side, stopped Hobert's actions. He said to Maximilian, "Let me try it first."
If there was another way, Maximilian certainly didn't want to take a "Holy Water bath," so it obediently let Hant put his hand on its skeleton.
Hant's silver-white light became brighter. If you ignored those eyes, he looked somewhat holy.
The slime on Maximilian's body gradually turned into a foul-smelling black liquid.
The liquid dripped on the ground, staining the ground several meters around black.
After a minute or two, the slime on Maximilian's body disappeared. It raised its head, as if to express its gratitude.
After nodding to Hobert, Maximilian ended the summons.
Hant's silver-white light only worked on undead creatures. He was powerless against the slime on Hobert's body, so he also prepared to end the summons.
Hobert said, "The spoils you need this time..."
Hant opened his arms: "This is the best spoil!"
As he spoke, he disappeared on the spot.
The surrounding villagers were terrified, but they didn't dare to leave.
Hobert took off his cloak, wrapped the Beyonder characteristics he had just exchanged from Elliot, and jumped into the bucket.
After two or three minutes, the water in the bucket turned black.
After pouring out the water, Hobert made another large bucket of "Holy Water" and went in for another bath.
It wasn't until the third time that the water was completely clear.
Coming out of the wooden tub, the tight and wrinkled feeling on his body disappeared. Although he still felt a little weak, the negative effects on his body were gone.
Finding a place to sit down, Hobert waited for Bishop Simpson and the others to return.
This time, Simpson was determined to hunt down this group of "Devils."
However, Simpson and the others had been fighting for a long time, and the first and second teams were not very cooperative, so they withdrew after chasing for more than an hour.
In the end, two "Desire Apostles," five or six "Devils," and more than twenty Beyonders of other sequences ran away.
These people all ran in separate directions. Because Simpson and the others had no plans to pursue before the battle, they did not form an effective blockade during the pursuit, which is why so many enemies escaped.
After everyone returned, they began to take care of the wounded and count the spoils.
Because this battle was essentially a cooperative effort, Hobert had to divide the spoils on the spot.
According to the previous agreement, he gave Bowen's body and Beyonder characteristics to Simpson. In return, the Church of the Earth Mother, which had contributed the most people to this battle, made concessions in the division of other spoils.
Hobert reiterated the rules for dividing the spoils of the Special Operations Department. Because Hobert provided a large number of Sealed Artifacts, blocked the first wave of enemy reinforcements on his own, and provided assistance in hunting Bohr, he alone divided nearly one-third of the spoils.
As for his contribution to the angel-level battle, Hobert did not mention it, because he did not intend to take out the Sealed Artifact formed by the "Whisperer" to participate in the division.
After dividing the spoils, Hobert said to the members of the first and second teams, "If the Beyonder characteristics you obtained are useless, you can exchange them for merit points."
He briefly explained the rules for the exchange, and several members were pleasantly surprised to find that they could use the spoils to exchange for the Beyonder characteristics they needed!
Angus calculated that the spoils in his hand could also be exchanged for about two-fifths of the Beyonder characteristics of the "Disciplinary Knight."
Everyone had decided to exchange the spoils in their hands for merit points.
Just as Hobert was about to talk about how to deal with the fallen personnel on his side, it suddenly started to rain. Everyone glanced at the sky. The dark clouds were not thick, and it shouldn't rain much, so everyone didn't plan to avoid the rain.
Just as he was about to continue speaking, Hobert suddenly saw a drop of red rain fall on Angus's face in front of him. He quickly stretched out his hand.
It really was red rain!
He smelled it in front of his nose. It was both fishy and smelly.
"Quick!" Hobert finally realized something: "Quick! Avoid the rain! Find a place to avoid the rain! Cough cough cough!"
Everyone also realized that something was wrong and went to the trees to avoid the rain!
"Go to the houses in the town!" Hobert suddenly felt a little dizzy because he was so anxious.
It wasn't that his body had become so weak after being "baptized" by the Angel Battlefield, but rather, under the influence of the "Bloody Archduke," his emotions were easily overstimulated.
Of course, as long as he wore "Farbauti's Ring," his emotional fluctuations couldn't be exploited by the "Desire Apostle," but he would experience severe discomfort.
Simpson and the others, who had fought the "Desire Apostle" for some time, would also experience similar phenomena in the next day or two due to having their emotions manipulated multiple times, but it wouldn't be as severe as Hobert's case.
Hobert realized that this blood rain was caused by the "Bloody Archduke's" descent just now. Beyonders below the demigod level would be in extremely poor condition if they were rained on, and might even suffer permanent trauma, leading to loss of control.
And if ordinary people were rained on, they would most likely turn into extremely aggressive lunatics! There was a small chance they would directly turn into mindless monsters! In short, no ordinary person could survive this blood rain.
The blood rain grew heavier and heavier. Supported by Fors and Archibald's marionette, Hobert ran towards the town.
After running a few steps, Hobert felt much better. Just as he was about to use "Travel" to take Fors away, suddenly, the rainwater that fell on the ground sprouted rapidly and actually grew into a small red grass.
And the rainwater that fell on everyone's bodies turned into red moss.
The blood rain stopped. Bishop Simpson and the others knelt on the ground in worship, loudly praising "Your Excellence."
Only then did Hobert understand that the Pope of the Church of the Earth Mother had taken action!

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 493 Seizing power in the name of disaster relief
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
As far as the eye could see, the ground was covered with blood-red grass.
A gentle breeze blew, and the grass swayed with the wind, creating an almost seductive feeling.
Hobert wiped the red moss from his clothes, and once the moss was removed, the clothes returned to their original color.
This made Hobert exclaim, "This is the power of angels!"
At the battlefield of the two angels, the huge blood pool was still bubbling and boiling, surrounded by black, viscous liquid filled with "corruption" and "filth."
In a low-lying area, there was also a small blood lake.
Suddenly, black, gray, and red grasses began to grow in these places. These grasses not only grew extremely quickly but also rapidly became dense and thick.
The process was about as fast as pouring a layer of water onto the ground. When this layer of "water" splashed onto the ground, it was as if springs immediately burst forth!
The speed of growth was that rapid!
Soon, this grass covered the entire land at a speed visible to the naked eye. The blood pool and blood-colored lake were quickly sucked dry by these grasses, revealing the hard rock at the bottom.
However, the grass continued to grow and thrive on the rock without any difficulty, and the blood pool was quickly replaced by "red grass."
These grasses still swayed in the wind like liquid, but their essence had changed.
The original plants on this land were also quickly drained of all their moisture by these knee-high colored grasses, withering at a visible rate.
In the end, only one type of grass remained on this land, the only difference being their colors.
A few minutes later, as these grasses rapidly withered, the entire land became desolate, and no plants would grow here for ten years.
Outside Teuton Town, Hobert also devoutly thanked the Earth Mother and the Pope. He had been worried about how to deal with the blood pool, but the Pope had solved it.
Feeling the Pope's departure, Bishop Simpson and other members of the Earth Mother Church raised their heads with excitement.
The Pope's arrival meant that the Pope knew everything they had done, and there was no better reward than that!
Bishop Simpson got up from the ground and immediately ordered everyone to mobilize all available people to pull up these grasses and hand them over to the Earth Mother Church.
Because these grasses contained a large amount of toxins, prolonged contact would cause illness in ordinary people, and in severe cases, they would turn into madmen.
After the church collected them, they could be processed into materials for preparing poisons.
Hobert asked Fors to go back and convey the order: "Have Seel bring people over immediately, and also conscript three hundred young and strong men from across the river, along with the civil servants who are already prepared, to come and help with the disaster relief."
Hobert, of course, wouldn't just simply drive away the "demons." More than half a month ago, he had Corwin start drawing a batch of grassroots civil servants and professionally skilled cadres from the government and training them.
After driving away the demons, Hobert would take over the governance of this area.
However, the previous plan did not anticipate the appearance of an angelic battle, but this also provided a good reason to take over the governance: disaster relief!
That's right, the angel war was a natural disaster for the South Colson area on the west side of Full Moon Lake.
Hobert was on the edge of the battlefield at the time. In his mind, the moment the "Bloody Archduke" turned a small volcano into a neutral volcano, there was definitely an earthquake of nearly magnitude 7.
It's just that the range of the earthquake was limited, and there were no aftershocks.
But for ordinary people, it was still a huge disaster.
While Hobert asked Fors to convey the order, he also took the wounded and the remains of the sacrificed members back first, and there would be a notice about the aftermath at the latest tomorrow.
He also said to Angus and others: "The members of the first and second squads who are still in good condition should also participate in the next disaster relief operation."
Watching Fors and others leave, while waiting for Seel and others, Archibald said to Hobert: "My lord, I suggest hanging the bodies of these demons in various villages and towns so that everyone knows that the demons have been driven away by us."
Hobert was slightly stunned and glanced at Archibald.
Angus, who was resting nearby, said: "'Devils' also like to hang corpses in trees. If we do the same, wouldn't we be the same as them?"
While Hobert was thinking about this issue, he glanced at the people of Teuton Town, who were being driven by the "Druid Squad" to pull up grass, their faces numb. He adopted Archibald's suggestion: "The most important issue at the moment is to establish effective rule!"
He suddenly realized that the people here had been enslaved by the demons for decades, and there was no point in reasoning with them for the time being.
Seel and the others hadn't arrived yet, but Grove came with a team of people first. He greeted Hobert and Simpson warmly and sent food and wine.
Then, Grove read out the decree that the king had sealed the nearby area to Baron Teuton a long time ago, clarifying Baron Teuton's legal right to rule this area.
And claimed that Teuton Territory had begun to organize manpower for disaster relief, and did not need the help of any forces.
Hobert sneered in response, turned his face against Grove in front of everyone, and quarreled a few words.
However, he obviously didn't dare to disobey the king's decree now. After scolding a few words, he asked Seel and others who had just arrived to bring all the corpses of the enemies to the dock.
On the Jeffrey Territory ship, Angus whispered: "My lord, I can come again at night and kill that Grove..."
Hobert was about to interrupt Angus, but Archibald smiled and said: "Captain Angus, with my lord's magnanimity, how could he be angry with such a person?"
Angus thought to himself: Isn't this servant blind? My lord was obviously so angry just now!
He had been staring at Hobert just now. As long as his lord gave him a look, he would immediately rush up and kill the arrogant knight!
Hobert took another deep look at Archibald: This "dog" is quite smart. Did I help it turn a "Desire Apostle" into a mystic puppet, and it immediately became proactive?
Archibald gave Hobert a smile in return. Of course, the mystic puppet didn't have such a big effect. Archibald felt the angelic battle that had just taken place and realized that the "Creator" could provide angelic combat power support to its dependents at any time.
For Archibald, this was an opportunity, an opportunity to transform from a beast into someone with the background of such a powerful evil god.
Now, for it, Hobert is the key to this opportunity, so it suddenly became so active.
Leaving the dock of Teuton Town, the Jeffrey Territory fleet landed at the port of Baron Felix's territory upstream.
Baron Felix's reaction was obviously not as fast as Baron Teuton's. When he learned that Hobert was bringing manpower and supplies to help with the disaster relief, he didn't think of refusing immediately.
So Hobert unceremoniously turned his baronial mansion into the "Disaster Relief Headquarters." Baron Felix then realized that when the "demons" had just left, he had finally become the actual ruler of this territory, and now he wasn't anymore.
When the first batch of supplies arrived, there were also 300 young and strong men who had gathered directly from the construction site, as well as more than 50 civil servants. Town Mayor Conrad and Human Resources Knight Corwin came to direct the rescue work.
Hobert asked Seel and Corwin to take people to take over the governance of the two surrounding territories respectively.
Previously, the "demons" ruled a total of five noble territories. Now that the richest Teuton Territory could not be taken over, then the other territories should be taken over immediately.
One of the baron's territories was not affected by the disaster. Hobert's reason for disaster relief was not applicable to that territory, but fortunately, the baron had never been to his fiefdom, so taking over was effortless.
Hobert then led Angus, Helen, and other Beyonders to the Eugene Territory, which was the most severely "affected by the disaster."
Along the way, they saw many figures of refugees. They were skinny, dressed in rags, and some were injured.
Hobert had a deeper understanding of the previous demon rule. Those demons did not have any effective rule at all.
Under their bloodlust and violence, ordinary people had no way to resist, so the people here had no hope, and only knew to kneel and pray to the demons. No one actively engaged in agricultural production, and no one actively worked.
The harvest was always bad, so they had to eat less. Over time, they became so thin.
The manpower organized by Conrad would arrive later, settle these refugees first, and then repatriate them to rebuild their homes.
Hobert and others rode their horses forward, inquiring about the situation of Eugene Territory along the way. After several inquiries, Hobert obtained a general intelligence: Baron Eugene was dead, and almost no one there had escaped.
When they first entered Eugene Territory, they could still see some figures of refugees, but as they went further, only traces of fire and huge cracks in the ground, traces of lava that had once gushed out, remained.
Angus and Helen gradually realized that something was wrong. A demigod battle didn't seem to have such great power!
After walking a little further, everyone saw the colorful, boundless wilderness.
Even though the ground was covered with thick withered grass, it still couldn't hide the desolation here.
Hobert and others had never farmed, but their spirituality made it very clear to them that this wilderness was not suitable for cultivation in a short period of time, nor was it suitable for any human habitation.
Hobert jumped off his horse, and everyone dismounted and followed Hobert's footsteps closely.
Hobert used his cane to pull open the grass, and inside were two black figures, one large and one small, worshiping devoutly. When they were burned to death, they were still worshiping in the direction of the blood pool.
The surrounding grass absorbed the remaining nutrients from these two people, and eventually, these two people became fragile mummies, as if they would shatter with a touch.
Hobert noticed that the small figure was only seven or eight years old.
For some reason, Hobert didn't feel any guilt this time.
If it had been before, he would have felt guilty for his poorly planned plan, which accidentally triggered an angelic battle and killed so many people.
The reason for this idea was because he had been educated from a young age to be "people-oriented." No matter what, life is the most precious thing!
But now it's different. He figured out a problem in the smog of Backlund: In this world full of madness, the lives of ordinary people are so fragile, and Hobert is also very fragile.
A fragile Beyonder is not qualified to blame himself. Only after becoming strong enough will his self-blame not seem so ridiculous and humble.
After a dozen seconds of silence, Hobert suddenly said, "I bear some responsibility for the destruction of Eugene Territory."
Of course, he wasn't really blaming himself when he said this; it was just a tactic.
He continued, "It was my lack of consideration that the enemy actually summoned an angel!"
Angus, Helen, and the others behind him showed surprised expressions. They had felt the immense pressure coming from that direction before, but at the time, they had no idea that an angelic battle had taken place there.
The two of them had similar thoughts: I knew it! How could a battle at the Saint level cause such a disaster?
Then, the Beyonders present realized another problem: how was the enemy's angel repelled?
Just as everyone had this question, Archibald very cooperatively asked, "Sir, how did you resolve this catastrophe in the South Colson area?"
Hobert nodded with satisfaction. This 'hound' knows how to talk: "Of course, I also summoned an angel."
Angus and Helen behind him immediately felt like their brains couldn't keep up.
Angus first thought: I've never heard of Beyonders of the 'Lawyer' pathway being good at summoning!
He immediately realized that his thinking was wrong: Could it be that Hobert has a close relationship with an angel? I have heard that a member of the Tudor family survived as an angel, could it be that Hobert and his son have contacted other Tudor families?
Then, he realized again that this idea was wrong, because if that were the case, Hobert could have said it openly, but Hobert spoke vaguely.
Moreover, having a close relationship with an angel is one thing, but being able to summon the other party to fight for you at any time is another.
Finally, Angus realized: Perhaps that angel was sent by a mysterious being?
As soon as this thought appeared in his mind, Angus was even more shocked. Looking at Hobert's back again, he seemed taller and more mysterious!
Helen, on the other hand, realized: "I underestimated Hobert before. I always thought he was just relying on having a good father to become a Baron at such a young age."
"The more I interact with him, the more I realize that his strength and methods far exceed my imagination. He is not as useless as those nobles in Feynapotter City."
"Ms. Monica's guess is correct. There is an organization behind Hobert, and within this organization, there is at least one angel!"
"Those ten masked reinforcements should be from the organization behind Hobert."
As Hobert expected, no one cared about his self-blame; they would only focus all their attention on the angelic combat power.
Hobert added, "Everyone, take a look around to see if there is any possibility of finding survivors!"
These words awakened everyone, and they went around to search according to Hobert's orders.
However, everyone knew that there could be no survivors; that was a battle at the angel level.
But they felt that they really needed to do something now to alleviate the shocking emotions just now.
The reason why Hobert brought this group of Beyonders was to make them feel shocked and to make them feel the power of Baron Hobert, so as to pave the way for some possible operations in the future.
"Angus!" Hobert called out to the captain of the first team.
Angus, who had just taken two steps, immediately came back, waiting for Hobert's instructions.
Hobert, however, strolled through the thick weeds and came to a small hill.
Angus followed closely behind. He realized that the Baron had something to say to him.
"What are your thoughts?" After reaching the top of the hill, Hobert looked at the wilderness in front of him and asked.
Angus also looked at the wilderness in front of him and said, "This is simply like a miracle."
Hobert smiled: "In ancient times, angels were also called gods."
Then he changed the subject: "I'm asking what you thought when you saw the two corpses in the grass."
Without waiting for Angus to answer, Hobert asked and answered himself: "Just now, I suddenly realized that life is so fragile and humble."
"Yes," Angus said, following Hobert's words, "Under the majesty of the gods, all life is fragile."
Hobert glanced at Angus and continued to look at the wilderness: "There are some things you should make a choice about."
"Believe me, I don't need to repeat why my father left the Tudor family. Through this battle, I have seen your talent. That family, whose atmosphere has long been rotten to the core, will bury you for the rest of your life!"
In fact, Angus's performance can only be said to be not bad, far from reaching the level of excellence.
However, this is a good breakthrough to pry open the Tudor family, so he is currently very likely to get Hobert's high evaluation.
Hobert's words made Angus first happy, then worried. He also knew that with his background, he had no hope of becoming a demigod in this life.
So, when faced with the task of being dispatched to monitor Christian, which even the direct descendants of the family were not interested in, he behaved very actively.
After learning that Hobert could summon the help of an angel, Angus did have some other thoughts.
Hobert continued, "Did you notice the ten reinforcements who appeared at the end?"
"I noticed!" Angus was also very strange. Where did Hobert find those reinforcements?
"Many of them were once marginalized figures in the family," Hobert said very purposefully. "In less than half a year, one of them has been promoted from Sequence 8 to Sequence 6."
"I think at his current speed, he should have the opportunity to be promoted to Sequence 5 at the latest next year."
"He didn't get such a good opportunity as you at the time. He has such a fast promotion speed only because he made a very correct choice."
This is the truth. At that time, Elliot's choice was more straightforward than Angus's. Of course, it also had a lot to do with the fact that Hobert was facing Elliot as the 'Creator' at the time.
Hobert pointed to the front: "Look at this wilderness, I have the opportunity to become a person with this level of power, because at the most critical juncture in my life, I also made the right choice."
Angus no longer hesitated and knelt behind Hobert: "Sir, please accept my allegiance!"
Hobert quickly turned around and helped Angus up: "Being able to get your sincere help has also given me a great boost!"
Archibald and his marionettes watched the whole drama of Hobert's wooing of his subordinates, which made it sigh at Hobert's skills and use of language.
After helping Angus up, Hobert said again: "I already have some ideas about how to deal with the aftermath of the four fallen members, and I will leave it to you next."
"First of all, the spoils of war from the first team must be given to them, and secondly, of course, the Beyonder characteristics must be returned to them."
"I can make a promise that in addition to returning the Beyonder characteristics to their family, I will also give them Beyonder characteristics of a lower sequence!"
"For example, if the martyr is a 'Sheriff', in addition to giving the 'Sheriff' Beyonder characteristic to his family, he will also give a copy of the 'Arbiter' Beyonder characteristic."
Angus was very surprised at first, then happy: "Their families will definitely be grateful."
In this way, Angus will be able to give an explanation to the families of the martyrs, and when he returns to the family to recruit people, it is estimated that more people will want to join the Special Operations Department than before!
"However, two conditions must be met," Hobert said: "The point that you must verify is to give his Beyonder characteristics to their family, not the family."
"The second condition is that before giving it to their family, the Beyonder characteristics should be kept in my custody."
"This is to protect you, so as not to be targeted by the family. If they have any anger, they can push it all to me."
Angus said gratefully: "Thank you, Sir, for thinking so much for me."
Archibald on the side felt that there must be a problem here, but it was not clear what the problem was.
"The last point is the issue of compensation for them," Hobert said: "You have been in the territory for a while and know my current difficulties."
"In terms of compensation, I can't temporarily match the official Beyonders. The martyrs of Sequence 9 can only be given 1,300 pounds, or 1,500 gold Lire."
"Sequence 8 is doubled, and Sequence 7 is doubled again."
Angus smiled and said, "It's good to have compensation."
This is true. For wild Beyonders, they have never thought about the issue of martyrdom and compensation.
That's why Hobert proposed this compensation standard, which is less than half of that of the orthodox churches, and will continue to use this standard for a period of time.
Hobert nodded and said again: "I plan to expand the size of the first team. After handling the aftermath, it should be expanded to at least eighteen members."
"You have given such good compensation conditions, I don't think there should be any problems," Angus said with a smile.
Hobert smiled with satisfaction: "This is the focus of your next work."
"Yes!"
After ending this conversation, Hobert's main purpose of this "personal disaster relief" was completed, so that he could more happily dig the corners of the Tudor family in the future.
When the group returned to Baron Felix's manor, it was already dusk.
The initial resettlement of the refugees has been completed. Conrad, according to Hobert's instructions, is preparing to use work as a form of relief to rebuild their homes.
Moreover, Conrad found that the spring planting on the west bank of the entire Full Moon Lake was very sloppy. He planned to organize people to replant the spring first to ensure this year's harvest, and then take time to redistribute the land.
It can be foreseen that Conrad will be very busy in the future and will have no time to stay in Baron Felix's manor to coordinate the resources of all parties.
Hobert had no choice but to stay and personally sit in the "new territory" on the west bank of Full Moon Lake.
After eating dinner and solving the work problems, Hobert returned to his room. After telling anyone not to disturb his rest, he came to the "Nation of Disorder" and looked at the spoils he had obtained today again.

The most surprising spoil of today's battle was the sealed artifact from that "Blatherer."
A sealed artifact formed by a Beyonder of this level is definitely a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert waved his hand, and the short blade flew into his grasp.
It was an orange-red short sword, looking like raw iron just taken out of a furnace, with a distinct burning sensation in his hand.
Using the level of the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert quickly learned the abilities of this sealed artifact:
"It can launch mental attacks against enemies, triggering and detonating their emotions, causing them to fall into mental chaos; it can emit 'whispers' that are very easy to lose control of, even demigod-level enemies must concentrate on resisting the erosion of the 'whispers'; it can use 'words of filth,' including 'death,' 'slowness,' and 'corruption'; the weapon itself can transform into a giant magma sword, releasing steam with violent toxins."
Because the "Blatherer" had just begun to lose control when he was swallowed by the "Great Sage," the abilities of this weapon were not so bizarre.
But the negative effects were not small either: "There is a very high probability of indiscriminately detonating the emotions of everyone around, causing mental confusion, and such mental confusion is permanent damage and cannot be recovered. Each use requires continuously killing 9 people and feeding the short sword with their internal organs and souls. If not enough internal organs and souls are obtained, the short sword will devour the holder. There is a considerable probability of receiving the gaze of the Bloody Archduke, and such a gaze is enough to turn Beyonders below the demigod level into a pool of blood, and there is also a certain probability of gaining some abilities or benefits from it. Each use is equivalent to being eroded by the abyss once."
With such negative effects, he didn't dare take it outside to use at all, especially the gaze of the "Bloody Archduke," who could bear that?
And before becoming a demigod, Hobert had no way to form an effective seal on a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, which meant that this sealed artifact's abilities looked good, but he couldn't use it for the time being.
This made Hobert deeply realize what a sealed artifact was: this thing could only be used after an effective seal was made!
Hobert somewhat disappointedly wanted to put the short sword back, but then suddenly seemed to think of something. He picked up the Black Emperor card on the armrest with one hand, which made Hobert's figure become much more majestic, much more solid, and full of dignity.
With the other hand holding the short sword, he projected his power into his star.
The short sword followed Hobert's power and entered the star together, arriving in the real world!
Because of the suppression of the Black Emperor card, even if it left the "Nation of Disorder," the negative effects of the short sword would not affect Hobert for the time being.
In other words, this short sword could be used by the "Creator"! This gave the "Creator" many Sequence 3 level abilities!
Withdrawing his power, Hobert returned to the "Nation of Disorder." In fact, the "Creator" had better not use these powers, it was too degrading!
It could be used when he was sure he could kill the other party, to silence them.
Or it could be used as an auxiliary means, such as the short sword's "mental attack," which from the surface looked a bit like the "Judge's" mental attack.
However, the process of use and the effects caused were completely different, but who had the ability to go back and subdivide the gods?
Hobert looked at the short sword again, named it "1-105," and then placed it on the stone platform for holding Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts.
Then Hobert considered a question: why couldn't the previous four Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts have such an operation?
In fact, starting from Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts, Hobert could use the power of the sealed artifacts in the "Nation of Disorder." For example, Hobert could use the "Healing Fork" to heal Elliot through the "Nation of Disorder."
But without exception, these sealed artifacts could only be used in the "Nation of Disorder." For example, when Hobert projected the "Creator's" power into the real world to prevent the descent of the "Abomination," he could not bring any sealed artifacts out.
"1-105" could be brought out. If someone slashed at the "Creator" with a sword, Hobert could completely use "1-105" to conjure a giant magma sword to block the enemy's attack.
They were all Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, why was there such a difference?
After thinking for a while, Hobert roughly understood what was going on.
Although they were all Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, "1-101" to "1-104" were sealed artifacts formed by Sequence 4, while "1-105" was a sealed artifact formed by Sequence 3.
At the Sequence 3 level, one could respond to prayers within a certain range, and divinity was much stronger than Sequence 4.
Correspondingly, it was equivalent to having the ability to project power to a distance, so it could enter the real world through the "Nation of Disorder."
In addition, the special nature of the "Nation of Disorder" and the rank suppression of the Black Emperor card were also very important.
The special nature of the "Nation of Disorder" was that it could bypass many rules.
For example, also projecting power into the real world, Klein, who had the "Sefirah Castle," needed a "Secret Rite" to project a large amount of power.
But the "Nation of Disorder" completely skipped the "Implicit Ritual." Hobert could easily project the power of the "Nation of Disorder" into the real world.
The rank suppression of the Black Emperor card was also very important. Klein had the operation of summoning himself, but even in this state, he did not dare to bring out the "Sea God Scepter."
If Klein had the Fool card to suppress it, perhaps when he summoned himself, he could also temporarily suppress the negative effects of the "Sea God Scepter."
Having figured out the matter of "1-105," Hobert looked at the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring" again. It could still be used twice, and the black eyes could still be used once.
In other words, the angel-level combat power could still be used three times in total.
The "Bull Devil Monarch" had been used once and could still be used six more times. The "Great Sage" could still be used ten times. The demigod-level combat power was still relatively abundant.
Returning to the real world, Hobert was about to rest when Baron Felix sent two maids.
Hobert was already very tired today. He sent the two maids back and asked them to tell Baron Felix, "Let him do his barony well."
This was telling Baron Felix that he only wanted the rule of the West Bank, not the title.
As long as Felix was as honest as before, his barony could continue, and his descendants could continue to do it generation after generation.
Because Hobert had stayed on the edge of the angel-level battlefield during the day, he had nightmares all night.
But overall, the effect of the rest was still very good!
The next morning, he began to get busy. First, he talked to Helen about the compensation for the fallen members of the second team.
Three Beyonders from the second team died, plus four from the first team. A total of seven people died in yesterday's battle, which was equivalent to one-third of the members of the special operations department.
Fortunately, there was cooperation with the Church of the Earth Mother, and many members who were seriously injured were rescued in time.
Otherwise, the death toll might have reached about three-fifths. In that case, this special operations department might have disbanded due to the huge casualties.
After all, this group of people was pieced together by Hobert and had no cohesion or centripetal force to speak of.
But that was before. With the distribution of spoils and the handling of the aftermath of the fallen, the loyalty of the two teams, especially the first team, to Hobert had increased a lot.
As for the handling of the aftermath of the fallen members of the second team, Hobert basically handed it over to Helen and handled it according to some of the Theosophy Order's usual practices.
At the same time, Hobert would also issue a pension of 1500 gold Lire as a base. Just 1500 gold Lire was enough to buy a small manor in the countryside and live the life of a farmer from then on.
Similarly, the Theosophy Order did not have the habit of issuing pensions to the families of the fallen, so Hobert's move was also affirmed by the members of the second team.
These members of the Theosophy Order were relatively moderate, and they had basically started families in the South Colson area, or their families were here.
So these pensions were still quite useful to them. At this moment, they finally had the feeling of being official Beyonders.
As for the Beyonder characteristics of the fallen, Hobert fully respected the opinions of the Theosophy Order and did not interfere too much.
After the aftermath of the second team was handled well, the members of the two teams came to Hobert one after another with spoils to exchange for merits, and then used the merits to exchange for the Beyonder characteristics they needed.
The merits of four members were exchanged for the Beyonder characteristics used for their advancement.
Therefore, Hobert paid a "Sheriff" and an "Interrogator" Beyonder characteristic, as well as a "Trickmaster" and an "Astrologer" Beyonder characteristic.
Other people had also accumulated a lot of merits. If another such battle was launched, many more people could advance.
Seeing that someone had indeed exchanged for the required Beyonder characteristics and advanced, the members were already very supportive of Hobert.
In the end, about two-thirds of the spoils of this battle came into Hobert's hands. Compared to the payout, Hobert made a bloody profit!
Because the exchange standard was set by him. For example, the Beyonder characteristic of "Serial Killer" could be exchanged for 600 merits, which meant that an "Interrogator" had to kill four "Serial Killers" to exchange for a "Judge" Beyonder characteristic.
The "Interrogator" had no objection to this, because "Serial Killers" were indeed easier to kill. But it was also very difficult to kill four enemies of the same sequence in one battle.
For the "Sheriff," it was easier for them to advance. They only needed to kill two "Unwinged Angel" and one "Prisoner" to exchange for the corresponding Beyonder characteristics.
In the afternoon, there was nothing to do, but Hobert, who had to temporarily sit in the West Bank, went to the "Nation of Disorder" again to give Elliot the 9 Beyonder characteristics he had promised before.
Looking at it this way, it was immediately clear who was the direct line and who was the collateral line.
Finally, Hobert sacrificed all the spoils to the "Nation of Disorder." He made a statistics. There were a total of 3 "Desire Apostles," 10 "Demons," 14 "Serial Killers," 16 "Unwinged Angel," and 8 "Criminals" Beyonder characteristics.
Another big harvest!
In addition, Hobert also obtained a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact of the "Door" pathway.
There were very few sealed artifacts obtained in this battle, only three, and Hobert was assigned one of them.
Hobert had thought about this question before. The reason why Beyonders of the "Abyss" pathway rarely used sealed artifacts may be because they were relatively versatile.
For example, they had physical attack abilities such as the "Magma Sword," as well as mental and desire-related attack abilities, as well as "Words of Filth," poison gas, and remote attacks such as "Sulfur Fireballs."
The most annoying thing was that they also had the ability of "Malice Perception." As soon as the enemy had an idea, they would disappear.
What sealed artifact was needed?
The "Fabbouti's Ring" made a great contribution to achieving such great results in yesterday's battle!
If the "Blatherer" felt the threat from Hobert, or rather from the "Great Sage," and turned around and ran, then this battle would not be able to continue halfway through.
If the "Blatherer" ran, Bowen would definitely have to run too. At most, only Yarling and the others could be harvested.
But killing three "Desire Apostles" was not as impactful as killing a demigod.
For the next two days, Hobert stayed in the West Bank and recovered from the negative state he had been in on the demigod battlefield before.
On Thursday night, Hobert had dinner and returned to his room early. Then he changed his clothes, transformed into the face with the tall nose and high cheekbones that he had used to go to Backlund last time, and used "Travel" to come to the Bravehearts Bar again.
He ordered a glass of beer as a matter of course, drank it all, left the bar, and hailed a rental carriage.
After the carriage had driven for seven or eight minutes, Miss Sharron with her delicate features and light golden hair appeared in the carriage.
Hobert smiled slightly and said, "Good evening!"
"Good!" Miss Sharron responded perfunctorily, and then immediately got to the point: "There are too many Beyonder characteristics you mentioned last time. We only want a part of them."
"Which part specifically?"
"30 Sequence 9s, 25 Sequence 8s, 15 Sequence 7s, 10 Sequence 6s, 5 Sequence 5s, and also the 'Puppet' Beyonder characteristic."
Hobert was about to speak, but Miss Sharon spoke first again: "We want them in such large quantities, you must give us a certain discount."
"You should know that the price I gave is not very high," Hobert said with a slight smile. "Especially the Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 7 and above, it is difficult to buy them at this price elsewhere."
Hobert was very curious, how would Miss Sharron, who seemed to have very few emotional changes, bargain?
"You must make it cheaper, otherwise we will not consider allying with you," Sharron said in a flat tone.
Hobert smiled and thought to himself: Sure enough, she was a "ruthless person who didn't talk much."
What Sharron had just said was indeed something Hobert was more concerned about. Before coming to Sharron, he had already decided that he could give the Temperance faction some discounts as sincerity for forming an alliance.
Immediately, Hobert took out paper and pen from his bag and said, "Okay, let's calculate the total amount first, and then I'll give you a discount."
Sharron nodded, looking quite satisfied with this proposal.
So Hobert listed another list: "According to the previous quotation, Sequence 9 'Prisoner' Beyonder characteristics are 280 pounds each, 30 copies are 8400 pounds.
"Sequence 8 'Lunatic' Beyonder characteristics are 580 pounds each, 25 copies are 14500 pounds.
"Sequence 7 'Werewolf' Beyonder characteristics are 1300 pounds each, 15 copies are 19500 pounds.
Sequence 6 'Zombie' Beyonder characteristics are 3200 pounds each, so 10 copies would be 32000 pounds.
Sequence 5 'Wraith' Beyonder characteristics are 6000 pounds each, so 5 copies would be 30000 pounds.
One Sequence 4 'Puppet' Beyonder characteristic is worth 50000 pounds.
The total value of all Beyonder characteristics is: 154400 pounds!
Hobert suddenly felt like he was shipping goods. If this transaction was completed, all the payments for the buildings in the territory would be covered, and there would still be enough left over to buy decoration materials.
