chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 495: Creating a Body for Captain Dunn
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"First, we should clarify a concept." Hobert said, "The Beyonder characteristics of that 'Puppet' are already discounted."
Hobert spread his hands, "Any Beyonder characteristic at Sequence 4 is already difficult to measure with money. I think I don't need to say more."
Sharron quietly looked at Hobert.
"Cough, cough." Hobert cleared his throat somewhat unnaturally and said, "So, the 50,000 pounds in it cannot be discounted any further. What can be discounted are the Beyonder characteristics of other Sequences."
Sharron still quietly looked at Hobert.
Hobert suddenly felt that, outside of combat, the Temperance faction of the 'Prisoner' pathway was quite restrained towards 'Lawyers.'
Even if Hobert's logic was clear and his eloquence was good, Hobert was somewhat helpless when the other party didn't give any feedback.
However, Hobert's words were not completely useless. When it came to dealing with the 'Rose School' next time, he reached a verbal agreement with Sharron that the Temperance faction would also send a certain amount of force to participate in the battle.
As for the price of those Beyonder characteristics, the final transaction was completed at a price of 150,000 pounds, and the transaction would be completed uniformly in about ten days.
Taking advantage of the fact that Sharron hadn't left yet, Hobert quickly said, "If you have any new demands for Beyonder characteristics, the payment can be made in installments, or paid with a loan from me."
"No need." Sharron said, "We have ways to raise money, provided you give us enough time."
Hobert smiled. So, the Temperance faction is very wealthy!
Sharron added, "You should have more than one Beyonder characteristic of the 'Puppet,' right?"
"Yes, there are two more." Hobert said.
Actually, there were three more, but Hobert couldn't shatter that Beyonder characteristic of the 'Disciple of Silence' yet, so he temporarily said there were two more.
Sharron nodded slightly, "If there is still a need in this regard, how should I contact you?"
Hobert thought for a while before saying, "I probably go to the Bravehearts Bar every two weeks at night. If you need anything, you can wait for me at the bar for a few days."
Hobert planned to tell Sharron how to summon his messenger after the first batch of transactions was completed.
It wasn't that Hobert didn't trust Sharron, but it seemed like there would be a problem if he revealed his identity now.
After watching Sharron disappear, Hobert began to imagine how to spend the 150,000 pounds. No matter how he spent it, he now had relatively abundant money in his hands.
Hobert planned to go back and have Roy draw up a budget for the later stage of the renovation. Now that he had a new territory and more population, he could plan to speed up the construction progress.
After imagining for a while in the carriage, Hobert asked the coachman to stop, because he had just made a big deal, so Hobert specially gave the coachman a 1Sucre tip.
The coachman happily praised Hobert's generosity, and Hobert smiled and walked into the shadows of the street corner.
...
Friday morning, Feynapotter Kingdom, west bank of Full Moon Lake.
The disaster relief mission is progressing steadily. The tents and food purchased by Jeffery have arrived one after another, and the refugees' food and accommodation problems have been basically solved.
Conrad organized the refugees to replant once, and began to build the collapsed houses before, for which a lot of building materials were transferred from Jeffery.
Hobert approved these expenses very generously, and the budget was sufficient.
The reason why he was so generous was that Hobert had just completed a transaction of hundreds of thousands of pounds and indeed had money.
On the other hand, the new territory made Hobert's potion digest very significantly, probably more than a third.
Hobert believed that such significant digestion was largely due to his driving away the previous rulers.
The rulers who had been entrenched here for decades were suddenly hanged at the entrance of the village or town in the form of corpses. The people's confusion, daze, fear, and other emotions can be imagined. For a time, they must have fallen into a completely different new rule, bringing chaos in order, life, and spirit.
The key is that Hobert has become the actual controller of Felix and other four territories, so the emotions and reactions of the people here can be fed back to Hobert.
That's why so much potion was digested at once.
Hobert estimated that when the land revolution is completed, the reconstruction of homes in the disaster area is completed, and an effective rule is established, he will obviously digest the potion again.
This made Hobert feel great, so he was particularly generous when approving the funds.
Hobert also sent people to bring Dennis, Freya, and Serena to the west bank to participate in this rescue to hone their temperament.
By the way, he called Philip and Roy to discuss the next construction budget in the territory.
Regarding the later budget for decoration, their father and son had already roughly calculated it before. With most of the wood being self-sufficient, about 180,000 gold Lire was still needed.
Hobert was stunned: "It costs so much money?"
"The main reason is that the decoration required for the villas where the nobles live is expensive." Roy said, "The decoration costs for institutions such as hospitals and post offices are not high.
"And this also includes office supplies, medical equipment, etc. These don't cost much money, but the supplies prepared for the nobles are not cheap." Philip said, "A set of tableware costs more than three hundred gold Lire."
Hobert smacked his tongue: "Tableware made of gold?"
These two confidants knew that the Earl, who was also a nobleman, was very simple. Philip smiled: "It really has to be inlaid with beautiful golden carvings, and some are inlaid with gems."
"Aren't you afraid of scratching your hands!" Hobert muttered, "Then buy it openly, money is not a problem."
After discussing some details, Hobert gave Philip a batch of gold worth about 6,000 gold Lire, and more than 30,000 pounds.
This batch of gold was obtained from the transaction with the Balk family before and has not been used because it has to be exchanged before it can be used, so it is better to exchange it in advance.
As for the more than 30,000 pounds, it is mainly the payment for the goods traded with the Sanguine. This is the budget for the fourth batch of goods, but because of the income from the auction house, Hobert did not immediately give this budget to Philip.
This time, nearly 20,000 gold Lire were compensated to the martyrs, and there were also expenses for disaster relief. The money in Philip's hands was reduced at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The Temperance faction's payment will have to wait about ten days before it can be received. In order to prevent problems with the capital chain, Hobert gave all his belongings to Philip.
Of course, there is a premise that the inherited property cannot be used.
After dealing with official business, Hobert became bored again. Fortunately, in the afternoon, Fors, wearing a light yellow casual dress and a playful fedora, came to Baron Felix's manor with a stove of freshly made donuts.
Baron Hobert's hobby of eating donuts has long been widely spread.
Fors certainly knew that Hobert's donuts were for the messenger, but the current butler of the manor, Allen, and the chefs all hoped that the Lady of the manor would bring the donuts that the Lord liked to visit him.
It was difficult to refuse, so Fors had to come to the west bank with donuts: "These are the donuts you like to eat."
She smiled and said, "Everyone in the entire manor knows you love to eat this."
Hobert hugged Fors: "Nonsense, I obviously like to eat you the most!"
Archibald tactfully took the Puppet away, and did not forget to close the door when leaving.
Fors pushed Hobert: "I'm here to find you for something serious!"
"What I'm doing now is serious." Hobert said while acting with his hands, "The weather is so warm, you don't need to wear so much."
Fors smiled helplessly. Her matter was not very urgent, and she also missed Hobert a little, so she half-pushed and half-accepted Hobert's intimacy, and the two embraced each other before talking about serious matters.
During the days when Hobert was not in the territory, a noblewoman named April came to Jeffery Town and gave Fors a "Stone of Life" as soon as she took action.
Fors usually doesn't care about the external affairs of the manor, but this gift was too precious. In order to express her gratitude, she invited the noblewoman to dinner.
The two chatted happily and had already made two appointments to travel together.
Fors felt that the other party should be an Beyonder, but she didn't know the other party's purpose, so she came to tell Hobert about this.
Hobert thought for a while before saying, "Let's go back together tomorrow and invite her to have lunch. Maybe she will be willing to tell her purpose."
The "Stone of Life" is a strategic material of the Church of the Earth Mother. Simpson only has one. He was reluctant to use it in such a fierce battle a few days ago.
Someone once described that with the "Stone of Life," he has one more life.
The use of the "Stone of Life" is far from simply making one's own life become vigorous again. It can also give life to other creatures.
The effect is better than the "Healing Art," and the use is more extensive than the "Healing Art."
Since there is such a large "early investment," the other party's request must be not small, but the other party should have some request to Hobert, which is equivalent to taking the "Lady's route" and asking Fors to help introduce him.
Fors nodded: "Okay."
Then she talked about the recent situation of the auction house. During the period when Hobert was not in the territory, Fors helped sort out the auction house's "demand list."
After the nobles and wealthy people left, they sent people to inform the auction house of their needs. Hobert glanced at it and found that there were many that he could solve, and he could gradually solve these people's needs in the next one or two months.
Some needs, such as wanting a Level 2 Sealed Artifact, will have to be postponed or even indefinitely.
Since there were donuts, Hobert embraced Fors for a while, then put on his clothes and came to the study alone, writing letters to Leonard and Jessica respectively.
The letter to Leonard contained several Beyonder characteristics of the "Criminal" pathway and told Leonard that he had found a "Devil" den and would kill a large number of demons in the near future.
It was to prepare for his future sale of related Beyonder characteristics.
As for the letter to Jessica, it was to communicate with her about the distribution of magical items later. After Carrie creates a magical item, Hobert will pay 450 pounds for materials and labor.
He said in the letter: Although there is a way to re-condense the Beyonder characteristics in the Beyonder ingredients, it also takes a certain amount of time and pays a certain price.
Here, Hobert only used exaggeration. If he told Jessica the truth, it would sound terrifying.
Seeing that there were still donuts, Hobert also wrote a letter to "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina, asking her about the names and approximate uses of several Beyonder ingredients, and asking her if she wanted the Beyonder characteristics of the "Criminal" pathway?
Hobert had seized several Beyonder ingredients from the Demonic Wolf of Fog, and he still didn't know what they were called? Which pathway did they belong to?
It would be more convenient to get the answer directly by asking the Demonic Wolf of Fog, but that would make the "Creator's" believer too ignorant. It's been almost a month since those Beyonder ingredients were seized, and he still doesn't know what they are called!
So, it's better to simply "abandon the near and seek the far" and ask "Vice Admiral Iceberg."
He soon received a reply from Jessica. She first agreed to Hobert's long-term cooperation plan, and then asked Hobert to prepare a potion formula and Beyonder characteristics of a "Briber."
The process of revising the "Labor Law" allowed her to digest the potion well, and she planned to advance in the next few days.
In the evening, out of courtesy, Hobert and Fors hosted Baron Felix together. At the same time, at the banquet, Hobert explained the next work focus to Conrad and others, telling everyone that he would return to the east bank tomorrow morning.
Speaking of which, Hobert was quite helpless. The straight-line distance from here to Jeffery Town is not far, but if you start from here and take a boat to Jeffery Town, it will take at least two or three hours.
If any news is conveyed to Hobert's manor, there will be a half-day delay.
While a large river plays a huge role in the waterway, it severely hinders local traffic.
So, when Hobert embarked on his return journey the next day, he had the idea of building a bridge, and after returning to the territory, he asked Scholar, who was preparing to leave, to investigate whether there was a suitable place to build a bridge in the South Colson River Basin.
At noon, when Hobert saw Mrs. April in the manor's restaurant, his eyes narrowed. She turned out to be the beautiful lady in her thirties, wearing gorgeous clothes and with arrogance in her eyes, who had appeared at the wedding before.
Hobert had also seen this lady in a carriage in Backlund.
This made Hobert immediately vigilant, guessing April's identity and purpose.
April seemed to not notice Hobert's vigilance at all, and looked at Hobert and Fors sitting together with a gentle and even kind smile: "That's great!"
Hobert was a little confused by this compliment, so he smiled and entered the topic: "Thank you for the gift you gave to my wife before, it was too precious."
"That's what should be." April smiled.
Hobert was stunned, feeling that he and the other party were not on the same channel. What do you mean by what should be?
April said to Hobert again: "When you fought those 'demons' a few days ago, I was also on the west bank. Don't work so hard in the future!"
Hobert was horrified. How did he not notice April at all?
Before Hobert could ask this question, April added: "Okay, let's talk about business. I hope to sell some extraordinary items through your auction house.
"I have prepared three extraordinary commodities here. If you offer a suitable price, we can establish a long-term cooperative relationship."
April gestured for a servant to push over a trolley, placing the three prepared boxes on it. The servant pushed it towards Hobert.
Hobert opened the boxes and glanced inside. They contained, respectively, a mystical material, a mystical characteristic, and a magical item shaped like a metal plate.
Hobert picked up the plate and asked, "May I ask where this metal plate came from?"
This inevitably reminded Hobert of the cutlery-shaped magical items he had equipped. The plate seemed to be made by the same person.
April smiled. "I'm selling this magical item on behalf of a friend. He's not entirely satisfied with it, but I think it's quite valuable."
Hobert strongly suspected that April's so-called friend was the artisan friend Christian knew.
Of course, he was probably not just an "artisan," but more likely an "astronomer" or even an "alchemist."
This made Hobert wonder if April was a friend Christian had invited to the wedding.
As for the mystical characteristic, Hobert could tell at a glance that it was a 'Judge' characteristic.
He definitely wanted both of these items. The only uncertain one was the mystical material.
So Hobert said, "Please keep Fors company while I appraise these three items."
Seeing the cutlery-like magical item reassured Hobert somewhat. He believed Fors would be safe alone with April.
Hobert remembered that Christian had many strange friends, and April might be one of them.
He quickly went to the side hall and sacrificed the three items to the 'Nation of Disorder.' Using the 'Nation of Disorder's' authority, Hobert learned the magical item's ability and negative effects.
The ability was: "To freely change its shape, even turning its flesh into liquid to squeeze into extremely small spaces, or to increase its speed; it can detonate its flesh to create an explosion comparable to a bomb."
The negative effect was: "Each use requires feeding the plate with a small amount of the user's own flesh. It cannot be replaced with the flesh of others, otherwise the plate will devour the holder."
Hobert nodded to himself, thinking: No wonder the "master craftsman" was dissatisfied. This negative effect is quite a pain. Unless it's a mystical being whose body can regenerate, how much flesh can be used to feed this plate?
Then Hobert thought of a solution: After using it, he could first feed the plate with his own flesh, and the next time he used it, he could use its ability to change its shape to replenish the flesh he had previously fed it.
This plate was probably made with a 'Rose Bishop' characteristic, making this operation entirely possible.
In that case, the "plate's" negative effect isn't that serious: only that the user has to cut off a piece of their own flesh between uses... a "small amount of flesh," it shouldn't be too much. Also, cutting off one's own flesh requires great courage, which should be the biggest negative effect, but one could ask someone else to help.
As far as magical items go, such a negative effect is completely acceptable. After all, mystical beings generally have good physiques, and the wound will heal quickly after feeding the "plate," without affecting their normal life too much.
Hobert then looked at the mystical material, which was a Sequence 6 material, but Hobert couldn't determine the specific pathway.
Just as he was about to leave the 'Nation of Disorder,' Hobert suddenly thought of the wedding gift Christian had given him.
He rummaged through the pile of Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts and found the 'Reader' pathway magical item.
He infused it with spirituality and looked at the mystical material again. Although Hobert didn't have any relevant knowledge, he knew that it was a 'Planter' pathway material.
Combining the two pieces of information, Hobert concluded: One of the main ingredients for the 'Planter' Sequence 6 'Biologist'.
Although he didn't know the name of this mystical material, he knew enough about it.
Leaving the 'Nation of Disorder,' Hobert returned to the dining room. "Madam, I want all three items. Name your price."
"The mystical material is 2,000 gold," April said. "The mystical characteristic is 4,500, and the magical item is 7,000!"
"The price is a little high," Hobert said with a smile. "Since this is our first cooperation, I won't haggle. But I hope you can show enough sincerity next time we cooperate."
April smiled. "You're a good businessman."
Hobert didn't continue the topic, but asked the servant to call Philip to prepare the gold Lumis.
He changed the subject. "Did you refine that 'Stone of Life' yourself?"
"Yes."
"In that case, you're a 'Classical Alchemist'?"
"That's right!"
Although he had guessed it, Hobert was still a little surprised. "I know a bishop from the Church of the Earth Mother, but I heard him say that the demigods of the Church of the Earth Mother are very busy!"
April took a sip of wine. "Young man, your probing is too obvious."
She spread her hands. "I'm not from the Church of the Earth Mother."
Hobert smiled. "In that case, I have a task that is very suitable for a 'Classical Alchemist' who is not from the Church of the Earth Mother to complete."
April gestured for him to speak.
"I want you to help me refine a body that can highly integrate a certain spirit and mental body with this body."
April nodded. "I have quite a bit of research on this. But isn't the Church of the Earth Mother more professional? Given your relationship with the Church of the Earth Mother, why didn't you ask them for help?"
Hobert leaned back in his chair and smiled. "I asked them first, but they declined, saying it was an act of disrespect for life."
"Ha!" April laughed sarcastically. "I once stole research data from the Church of the Earth Mother. They have plenty of research that disrespects life."
"Their response only means that the price you offered wasn't high enough?"
Hobert was stunned. Wasn't a Sequence 5 main material enough?
Then he suddenly realized: I think I asked the wrong person! Bishop Utravsky is so devout, or rather, he basically doesn't beat around the bush on such issues. If I had asked Bishop Simpson, the problem might have been solved already.
But since the matter had already been brought up, Hobert decided to continue talking with April. If she charged an exorbitant price, he would go to Simpson.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 496: Farbauti's Fantastic Operation
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
April explained, "If you want to create a specific puppet, you must have a part of that person's body, hair or blood will do.
"There are two key points in the whole process. First, you need his complete astral projection and spirit body. If they are not complete, you will only fuse a puppet with that person's memory.
"Second, you need a medium to integrate the astral body and spiritual body into the puppet. This medium is best if it's an Beyonder item, so that it can provide enough power to support the integration process."
Hobert asked, "Can the other party's Beyonder characteristics before death be used as a medium?"
"That's the best medium!" April said, "This will greatly increase the probability of success."
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, he had made thorough preparations beforehand, and he possessed all the elements April mentioned: "What reward do you want?"
"No reward is needed." April smiled kindly again, "I have also been trying to resurrect someone who is very important in my life, but unfortunately I have not yet found his spirit.
"Seeing your friend resurrected in the way I researched, I will also be very happy..."
Speaking of this, April's left hand suddenly trembled violently. She quickly pressed her left hand with her right hand, as if her left hand was suddenly out of her control.
After seven or eight seconds, the violent shaking subsided. April took a deep breath and said to Hobert, who was on guard, pretending to be relaxed, "This is the price I pay for practicing some secret techniques."
Hobert did not relax his vigilance, but a smile reappeared on his face. He followed the other party's words and said, "Sometimes, obtaining power requires a price."
What else could he do but follow her words? After all, she was a demigod. Could he directly point out that this was a sign of loss of control?
April nodded in agreement: "That's right!"
Hobert smiled and said, "I will consider it and give you an answer tomorrow as to whether I will ask you for help."
"Okay."
The wildness shown in April's eyes, as well as her reaction just now, made Hobert a little uneasy.
So after seeing April off, Hobert simply used 'Traveling' to come to Feynapotter City, and under Dophis's guidance, met Christian in the military office.
After a few simple chats, Hobert talked about the main purpose of his trip: "Do you know a lady named April?"
Christian's face changed drastically, and he stood up abruptly: "She... she went to you?"
His father's reaction exceeded Hobert's expectations: "Yes, do you know her?"
Christian sat back in her seat, his face still not very good: "I warned her, told her not to approach you, because her condition is very bad, and she has joined an evil organization."
Hobert nodded, Christian knew April, and she was very likely to know his biological parents as well.
This made Hobert trust April a lot more.
Christian glanced at Hobert: "I believe you are fully capable of making your own judgments about some things. Ah, in the blink of an eye, you are already married."
This sentence made Hobert feel a little confused. He noticed that Christian didn't have much interest in chatting, so he got up to say goodbye and used 'Traveling' to return to the lord's mansion.
This afternoon, Hobert rarely had some free time, but for some reason, he always felt a little restless.
Soon he realized that this was a hint from his spirituality. Today, he had missed something very important.
This made Hobert lose the mood to even rest while drinking tea, and he kept pacing back and forth in the study.
Because he couldn't find any inspiration, Hobert returned to the bedroom, wanting to chat with Fors a little.
When he saw the comb and two skin care products placed on the dressing table, Hobert remembered that Fors had gone to the circus to play the 'Magic Master' again this afternoon.
Hobert smiled. Fors never used cosmetics because she was too lazy to put on makeup. At most, she would use a little skin care product in the dry winter.
And Fors rarely put the comb and skin care products back in their original place because she was too lazy to clean up.
Hobert came to the dressing table, wanting to see what the skin care products of this era were like. When he approached the dressing table, Hobert glanced at the mirror!
Suddenly, Hobert finally understood the hint from his spirituality, and many clues were connected together: "I see."
Hobert sat in the chair for a long time without saying a word, not knowing how to face April for a while.
After thinking for a long time, Hobert decided: Don't reveal it for now, otherwise everyone will feel very uncomfortable together.
...
In the evening, Hobert received replies from Leonard and Edwina one after another.
There was a small package in Leonard's letter, which contained a bundle of gold pounds. Hobert counted them. No more, no less, exactly 5,500 pounds.
In the previous letter, Hobert had put 1 'Devil', 1 'Serial Killer', 2 'Unwinged Angel', and 2 'Criminal' Beyonder characteristics.
According to the base price, the total price of these five Beyonder characteristics is indeed 5,500 pounds.
In the package, there was also a note written by Leonard: How much you have, I want how much.
Hobert smiled: "You dare to write that, you don't know how much there is specifically."
If all the 'Prisoner' Beyonder characteristics were given to Leonard, it is estimated that this guy would have to doubt his life, so Hobert thought of this way of selling them slowly.
Putting away the gold pounds, Hobert opened Edwina's letter, and neat handwriting came into view.
Edwina first expressed her apology, saying that she was a little busy today and only now replied to Hobert.
Then Edwina said that the Beyonder ingredients Hobert inquired about this time were more advanced than the previous ones. She didn't know the specific names, only knew that they belonged to that pathway and the level of the main ingredients.
This reminded Hobert of the 'Reader' pathway sealed artifact he used at noon. He guessed that at Sequence 5 of this pathway, there might be the ability to distinguish between Beyonder characteristics and the materials for pathways.
Hobert realized that although Edwina was knowledgeable, it was impossible for her to know all Beyonder ingredients.
If he encountered similar problems again, he could try to use that sealed artifact to solve them.
And when hosting the Beyonder gathering at the auction center, he could also wear this sealed artifact to make many judgments on the spot.
Continuing to read the 'Vice Admiral Iceberg's' reply, Hobert knew the level of the Beyonder ingredients, all at Sequence 5. He mainly looked at which pathway they belonged to.
To Hobert's surprise, among the 3 Sequence 5 Beyonder ingredients, there was actually a main material for the 'Demoness of Afflictions'.
Hobert smiled. This could be used to draw a big cake for Helen.
In addition, Edwina also said that she would purchase the 'Criminal' pathway Beyonder characteristics at the same price as Leonard, purchasing them at the base price.
For Hobert, this was another channel for selling Beyonder characteristics.
...
At night, Hobert was sleeping soundly when suddenly, he felt some power invading his dream.
Hobert unconsciously tightened his grip on the 'Order Crystal'. He knew someone would 'visit' tonight.
When Hobert regained consciousness, he had already appeared in the painting, in front of the extremely oppressive hall.
Hobert stepped inside and saw Farbauti, in the form of a thin middle-aged man, sitting on the throne of flowers.
'very good." Farbauti said in a hoarse voice, "You have completed our transaction very well."
"I need to say it again." Hobert said, "My purpose is actually to seize control of the West Bank."
"You don't need to be so wary of me." Farbauti leaned against the high back of the chair and said, "If I wanted to 'make a deal' with you, as soon as you opened your mouth, or had a little emotional fluctuation, you would have already sold your body and soul to me."
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth: "I really felt your deterrence."
Farbauti did not continue to discuss this issue: "According to our previous agreement, that ring is yours, but its ability has changed, and there are not too many negative effects."
Hobert simply skipped this topic: "When did the 'Mother Tree of Desire' obtain part of the 'Moon' authority?"
Farbauti did not hide information about the 'Mother Tree of Desire': "After Lilith fell, someone sacrificed a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Moon' pathway to the 'Mother Tree of Desire'!"
"Who?"
"Tolzna."
"The Chained God!"
"Yes, Tolzna was present when Lilith perished together with Kvastir (Mutant King) and Flegrea (Annihilation Demonic Wolf)." Farbauti said: "He not only obtained the Uniqueness and two Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics of the 'Chained' pathway, but also picked up a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Moon' pathway by the way.
"At that time, the death of the three ancient gods gave the several attendant gods present great benefits."
Hobert nodded. Tolzna was the attendant god of the 'Mutant King', the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' of the Second Epoch, and later the 'Chained God'.
He has now been completely polluted by the 'Mother Tree of Desire' and his whereabouts are unknown.
But Hobert remembered that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' tore a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic from him and 'gave birth' to the 'God Spawn' Suah.
Hobert asked again: "In theory, there should still be the Uniqueness of the 'Chained' pathway and a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic at the 'Chained God's' place.
"There is also a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic at the 'God Spawn' Súa's place. Where is the other Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic?"
Farbauti was slightly stunned, probably not expecting him to know so much about the 'Chained' pathway: "That Sequence 1 was originally taken by Salinger (God of the Undead, later the Underworld Emperor), and later I snatched it."
Hobert nodded: "So you knew about the ancient things very early on."
"No, I didn't know at that time." Farbauti gave a strange smile: "I sacrificed it to the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'."
Hobert opened his mouth: "This..."
What kind of coquettish operation is this?
Hobert continued to ask: "Why would the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' need the 'Chained' Beyonder characteristics?"
So the 'Chained God' was ultimately only at the level of an King of Angels, and never became a true god of the 'Chained' pathway.
"The 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' may not need it." Farbauti said: "But I know that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' least wants this Beyonder characteristic to fall into the hands of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'.
"Just like the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' doesn't want a Sequence 1 of the 'Moon' pathway to fall into the hands of the 'Mother Tree of Desire'."
Hobert nodded: "There is also antagonism between the outer gods?"
"That's right, the conflict between the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' and the 'Mother Tree of Desire' seems to be particularly large." Farbauti showed a smug smile: "For a long time, the 'Mother Tree of Desire' didn't have time to bother me."
Hobert sighed: What a good hand at checks and balances!
He asked again: "But your operation has also indirectly allowed the 'Chained God' to be polluted by the 'Mother Tree of Desire', right? After all, if He becomes a god, He can also have a tug-of-war with the 'Mother Tree of Desire' similar to yours."
Farbauti asked in return: "Why do you think Lilith would find Kvastir to perish together? Why would Flegrea, who didn't join any camp, be there?"
Hobert pondered for a moment: "The opponent was chosen for Lilith by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'? But why would Flegrea appear there?"
"Because Tolzna told Flegrea that the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Chained' can strengthen the affinity between itself and the spirit world." Farbauti said:
"And at that time, Flegrea had entered the spirit world and was said to have seen a strange castle at the top of the spirit world, but could not enter it no matter what."
Hobert was stunned. Flegrea had seen the 'Sefirah Castle'?
That's right, He had the Uniqueness of the 'Fool' pathway at the time, and may have been attracted to it.
Hobert continued to ask: "Why did Tolzna do this?"
Farbauti said expressionlessly: "Because during the Second Epoch, the 'Mother Tree of Desire' wanted to corrupt me and Kvastir, but Her power was not as powerful as the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity', and Her corruption was unsuccessful.
"So She aimed the corruption at Tolzna, using the temptation of helping Tolzna become a god to make Tolzna betray Kvastir."
Hobert took a deep breath, another betrayal from an attendant god.
Unexpectedly, Tolzna was influenced by the 'Mother Tree of Desire' so early.
Then Hobert smiled and said to himself: I've gained some strange knowledge again!
He said to Farbauti: "Thank you for your answer."
"Then, the transaction is complete." Farbauti disappeared on the throne as he spoke.
And Hobert woke up from his dream, and he was immediately a little angry: "When did I have a transaction with you?"
But Hobert thought that Farbauti knew that he had the Evernight Goddess as his backer and would not dare to do anything to him.
Then he realized: Farbauti might be doing it on purpose, just wanting to scare me, and also to satirize me for being so careful before.
Hobert muttered softly: "Do demons also like to play pranks? Next time I see Farbauti, I have to pay attention to whether he is wearing a monocle!"
Then he raised his hand and looked at it. The ring with the demon's head unexpectedly appeared on his ring finger again.
Fors in his arms was still sleeping soundly, unaware of Hobert's dream just now.
Hobert gently pulled out the arm Fors was pillowing on, then put on a piece of clothing and came to the study alone.
This time the ring on his hand was easily removed.
Only after Hobert sacrificed it to the "Nation of Disorder" and sat on the "Iron Throne" did he finally feel relieved. He didn't notice anything wrong with his spiritual body, which meant that Farbauti's previous statement, "The deal is done," was just to scare him, and also to mock him.
This made Hobert sigh: Demons really do like to deceive people!
Then Hobert used the "Power of Order" to disinfect the ring. This time, there were no arrangements left by Farbauti on the ring.
Borrowing the authority of the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert discovered that the ring's abilities had indeed changed:
"Without transforming into a 'Devil,' one can use the ability of 'Transaction.' The holder can clearly sense the target's desires and satisfy some of them in unexpected ways, causing significant damage to the target's soul or body, or obtaining some abilities or permissions that the target possesses; one can subtly influence the target, making them careless and always making wrong choices; one can use the ability of 'Malicious Perception'; one can create volcanic eruptions within a range of a dozen meters and manipulate magma to protect oneself."
The negative effect was indeed small: "After wearing it, it will show sufficient friendliness to the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti."
Hobert thought to himself: The negative effect isn't significant, but it's a bit disgusting.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 497: Riot in the New Territory
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert named the "Farbauti's Ring" as "1-106" and placed it on the stone platform for Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts.
Compared to the ring given by Farbauti, Hobert now preferred to keep "1-102" with him.
As for Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts, except for a few frequently used ones, they were basically all placed in the "Nation of Disorder."
Then, Hobert reminisced about his conversation with Farbauti. During the "Lilith's Fall Incident," the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and the "Mother Tree of Desire" each obtained a portion of Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics!
However, neither of them obtained the Beyonder characteristics they wanted. Instead, they ultimately allowed their opponent to obtain the Beyonder characteristics they desired.
This made Hobert exclaim: Farbauti is indeed a "Devil Monarch," specializing in being a pain in the ass!
Hobert also thought: So, the "Lilith's Fall Incident" wasn't a collaboration between two Outer Gods, but rather the "Mother Tree of Desire" discovered an opportunity while stalking its enemy and then used the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" conspiracy to obtain some benefits.
The entire "Lilith's Fall Incident" was a major event of the Second Epoch. If further explored, more inside stories might be uncovered.
And the "Chained God" Tolzna didn't deserve his current fate at all. It turned out that he had already betrayed his own side early on because he failed to withstand the test.
After sealing the relevant memories, Hobert returned to the real world and continued to rest.
The next day, Hobert invited April again and gave her some of Captain Dunn's hair and blood that he had collected in Tingen, asking her to help him refine a puppet.
There were only five or six strands of hair because Captain Dunn didn't have much hair to begin with.
April carefully put away the blood and hair, telling Hobert that it would take about half a month to refine the puppet. She then chatted with Fors a little before leaving.
In the next two or three days, Hobert noticed that ships gradually began to use the Taz River channel. Because only Jeffrey Territory in the entire Southern Colson area could provide supplies and docking, it had almost become a must-stop station for cargo ships.
Hobert asked Allen to inquire about it, and sure enough, the previous wedding report had played a role. Princess Ethel had even passed through the Taz River to Jeffrey Territory and highly praised it, which was enough to prove that some previous reports slandering the Taz River were rumors.
In addition, it was said that Fors's new book had sold out in major bookstores. After reading the book, many people showed enough curiosity about this place and planned to take time to vacation in Jeffrey Territory.
Unfortunately, the transportation here was not very convenient, with only a few passenger ships per week.
Hobert was wondering whether to take the initiative to contact the shipping passenger company when the passenger company took the initiative to send someone to him, hoping to set up a station at Jeffrey Port.
Hobert put forward two requirements: the first was to give Jeffrey Territory-related ship entry permits, and the second was the revenue sharing of passenger and freight transport.
The operation of the Nepote Kingdom's railways and shipping was not a direct unit of the kingdom, but some large passenger or shipping companies.
According to custom, if a station was to be set up in Jeffrey Territory, Hobert, as the ruler of this territory, had the right to demand a share from the other party.
After making the request, Hobert handed over this negotiation to Philip. As the lord, he didn't need to spend too much energy on such trivial matters.
What "Lord Hobert" was more concerned about was a report submitted by Conrad. During the post-disaster reconstruction and land reform, Conrad discovered that the people of the new territory, in addition to being excessively thin, also seemed to have some problems with their mental state.
They were still worshiping those ugly demons. Conrad had tried to destroy those statues, but was met with resistance and opposition from the locals.
After learning about this, Bishop Simpson organized people to destroy the statues and some symbolic symbols, and recited the glory of the Mother Goddess.
However, Conrad found that this didn't seem to work very well. The villagers would still worship the broken statues or the original locations of the statues.
Instead, it deepened the contradiction between the town government and the villagers, causing a confrontation between the two sides.
After reading the report, Hobert frowned. This was a bit strange. Compared to those demons, the villagers should be more willing to believe in the Earth Mother.
Then Hobert realized that this was the situation in Jeffrey Territory, or rather, the east bank of the Taz River.
This side was basically the territory of the Theosophy Order. Although the Theosophy Order's exploitation of the people was also very severe, at least they didn't like to kill people at will.
Hobert thought that the people on the west bank might have been in a bloody rule for a long time and had become accustomed to that bloody and brutal environment? Suddenly, they came to a normal environment, but they were not used to it?
He thought: No wonder they digested so many potions at once. It turned out that the people on the west bank fell into unprecedented panic and confusion after being rescued. This reaction made the hearts of the people on the west bank extremely chaotic, so they digested the potions so obviously.
At this time, only the power of religion can give people some comfort.
Hobert asked Allen to invite Bishop Simpson. He planned to renovate several churches on the west bank and let Bishop Simpson send priests there.
Hobert met Simpson in the side hall. This was the first meeting between the two after the battle with the "demon."
After each briefly talked about their recent situation, Hobert smiled and said, "I suddenly remembered that our transaction regarding the 'Ancient Azure Dragon Beast Liver Crystal' has not yet been completed."
The smile on Simpson's face grew stronger: "I was just about to talk to you about this. The previous battle was highly affirmed by the Pope, and Bowen's Beyonder characteristics are also a trophy that the Holy See values very much.
"If I get the 'Ancient Azure Dragon Beast Liver Crystal' again, I will definitely have the opportunity to become a 'Classical Alchemist.'"
Hobert held his teacup: "That's great. There should be a demigod sitting in the Southern Colson area."
If Bishop Simpson could become a demigod, it would mean that the binding of the two people's interests would become very strong.
After taking a sip of tea, Hobert said with some embarrassment: "In theory, I should directly give you that main material, but you also know that Jeffrey Territory is spending so much money now!"
"Of course I know!" Bishop Simpson cooperated and said: "Don't worry, just name a price."
"30,000 gold lire."
Bishop Simpson agreed without hesitation: "No problem."
Anyway, he didn't have to spend his own money, and Hobert didn't ask for an exorbitant price, which had already given him a lot of face.
Then Hobert talked about the mental state of the people on the west bank. Before he even mentioned the renovation of the church, Simpson shook his head and said, "They are beyond help."
Hobert was stunned: "What do you mean?"
"I went to the scene to see it." Bishop Simpson said with a look of regret: "Their spirit bodies have been affected by the 'demons' for a long time and have been somewhat polluted.
"According to the church's experience, this kind of corruption cannot be eliminated at all!"
Hobert was a little surprised: "Is there any solution?"
Bishop Simpson shook his head again: "The corruption of the spirit body is the most difficult to treat. At most, you can only use some sedative drugs to prevent them from having the energy to hurt others.
"I suggest that the administrative staff you send should do nothing, because according to my observation, most of them will heal themselves after a few months without contact with the 'demon's' statues and symbols.
"During this period, their emotions are very easy to get excited, and it is easy to offend them no matter what you do!
"And about 30% of the people have no possibility of recovery. They will worship demons for the rest of their lives and will affect the people around them.
"I suggest that after a while, check and move all these incurable people together to live, so as not to let them affect others."
Hobert frowned. He was not satisfied with this solution: "'Demons are really harmful!"
"Yes." Simpson echoed: "I have read some classics. It is said that a long time ago, there was a kingdom of demons.
"It's hard to imagine how miserable the lives of the people in that kingdom were."
Hobert asked again: "Is there no other solution?"
"This is the only solution I can give you." Bishop Simpson's words seemed to have some deep meaning.
Hobert also thought of other solutions, which were nothing more than: kill!
But Hobert was even less satisfied with this solution.
When Bishop Simpson got up to leave, he seemed to say casually: "Archbishop Gabriel is very interested in your faith."
"I am a believer of the Earth Mother." Hobert smiled and said, "I accepted the baptism in front of the Life Saint Emblem, and the Goddess's favored one performed the baptism for me."
Bishop Simpson nodded meaningfully, which was similar to his guess. Hobert's baptism was successfully completed, which meant that the Goddess recognized having two faiths at the same time.
If Hobert had malicious intentions at the time, the baptism would not have been completed smoothly. As a favored one, Utravsky would definitely be able to feel the Goddess's intentions and terminate the baptism.
Perhaps there was also cooperation between the gods, but that was not something a bishop should consider.
Simpson believed that as long as he maintained a good relationship with Hobert and provided enough support, he would definitely gain some benefits in the future.
After seeing Simpson off, Hobert asked Allen to recall Freya and the other two. He wanted to hear a detailed description of the mental state of the people on the west bank from the three of them.
Hobert's order went back and forth, and it wasn't until the next day, which was Monday morning, that Hobert saw his two students and a male servant.
After they had breakfast, Hobert immediately called them to the study and asked, "I heard that the mental state of the people on the west bank is not very good."
"It's not just not very good, it's very strange." Selena, with her red hair, was the first to answer: "Sometimes they just sit there all day, not eating or drinking.
"At first, I thought they were so sad because they lost their loved ones!
"Later I found out that it wasn't! This seems to be their habit or custom, doing nothing and eating nothing.
"I brought food and water to them and asked them to eat their fill and then go to work with me, but after they finished eating and drinking, they didn't listen to me at all.
"Two soldiers were holding guns and forcing them to work. They seemed to have suddenly changed into a different person, kneeling and smiling flatteringly, and then following them happily."
Hobert was stunned. Although he was not a mental doctor, he could still make a judgment. This was a serious mental illness.
Dennis, who was much more stable but still occasionally showed his dazed side, added: "They believe in evil gods. Bishop Simpson's preaching was so wonderful, deepening the faith of the believers present in the Goddess.
"But they couldn't listen to it. After smashing their statues, they showed angry expressions, and some even sat on the ground crying, looking very desperate."
Hobert nodded almost imperceptibly and looked at Freya.
Freya, whose face looked a little rosy and whose shiny hair was combed into a ponytail, was the last to say: "There are a total of 59 households in the village I went to, none of which are complete families. At least two people in each household were killed by the previous rulers.
"There are many reasons for being killed, because of breathing, because of walking with feet, because of passing by the river, because of being forced... When forced to do that kind of thing, they don't resist, looking like a dead person, because..."
Freya's eyes turned red and she couldn't go on.
Selena and Dennis were dumbfounded. Only now did they realize that they seemed to have missed the point.
Hobert patted her on the shoulder and comforted her: "We are here, they will no longer have such encounters."
Freya nodded, took a deep breath and continued: "I learned that their ancestors used to live a rich life, and that village used to have more than a hundred households.
"Since those demons came, they gradually realized that they must devoutly worship those demons. Only in this way, when they encounter those demons, they can be like a stray dog kicked away, being kicked away by the demons with a smile, so as to avoid being killed.
"But after worshiping the demons many times, their emotions became more and more easily agitated, or simply lost any emotions.
"As for having angry or desperate reactions after smashing the statues, it is because they are afraid that if that group of demons comes back, they will vent their anger on them.
"The bishop can leave, and our people can also leave, but they can't leave.
"I think the act of smashing the statues is too extreme and should take some softer measures to gradually change their habits."
Hobert nodded seriously: "If this is an assessment, only Freya among you three is excellent.
"Because she found the root of the problem, and you only saw the surface."
Selena was a little ashamed, feeling that she had lost an opportunity.
Dennis did not expect that he would also have this opportunity.
After spending this time with the Duke's two students, he had learned some information about Beyonders and knew how rare such an opportunity was.
"Don't be discouraged, you two." Hobert said to the competition and Dennis again: "This is a lesson. When this matter is over, I will also let you become Beyonders.
"Okay, let me talk about the several Beyonder pathways I have mastered. Freya can choose from them, and you two can listen first."
"Firstly, regarding my own pathway, after consuming the potion, one becomes eloquent and persuasive, capable of twisting others' thoughts, and the physical body becomes very strong. Subsequently, one gains the ability to distort thoughts, corrupt minds, and plunge others into chaos."
"Then there are my wife Fors's abilities. Initially, she can open a phantom door; no place can confine her. She can also use many trick-like abilities. Later, she can divine, record the Beyonder abilities of others, and appear in other countries in a very short time."
The three were slightly stunned; they only now realized that the Lord's wife was also an extraordinary being.
Hobert continued, first explaining the "Corpse Collector" and "Hunter" pathways, for which he possessed complete potion formulas: "Seel is a Beyonder of the 'Hunter' pathway, but Selena and Freya cannot choose this pathway..."
Then came the pathways for which he had partial potion formulas, such as "Arbiter," "Warrior," "Seer," "Sailor," and so on, rattling off several pathways in one breath.
Freya felt a sense of dizziness for a moment.
"You can consider it first and give me your answer in the afternoon," Hobert said.
"I want to become an 'Arbiter'!" Freya suddenly said, "That way, I can judge and punish certain people and events in the future."
Hobert nodded, "I respect your choice. Come and collect the potion in the afternoon."
After dealing with the students' affairs, Hobert's worries deepened. The real situation was more serious than Conrad's report and Simpson's statement indicated.
Hobert decided to consult Audrey at the Tarot gathering later to see if she had any good ideas.
Then, he would return to the West Bank with the students to conduct a personal investigation to see if there were any solutions to the problem.
After one o'clock in the afternoon, under Hobert's supervision and witnessed by Selena and Dennis, Freya consumed the potion and became an "Arbiter."
Hobert had just finished explaining the abilities of an "Arbiter" when Allen entered with Archie, a soldier from the guard: "Lord, a riot has broken out in the West Bank!"
"What?" Hobert stood up abruptly and asked Archie, the burly soldier, "What's going on?"
"This morning, some of the people became very angry! They started attacking us," Archie, who was also Dennis's older brother, said. "Captain Seel saw that the situation was not good, so he immediately covered the government personnel and the young adults who went to help, retreating back to the Lord's Manor.
"Now the people are surrounding the Lord's Manor, and Mayor Conrad and others are confronting them."
Hobert walked up to Archie in two steps and asked, "Did we suffer any casualties?"
"Because the response was timely, only a few people were injured, but they were all external injuries such as fractures and bleeding; nothing serious."
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief and asked, "Did Seel fire his gun?"
"Captain Seel said that without your order, he cannot fire into the crowd," Archie replied mechanically. "But in order to cover everyone's retreat, we did fire warning shots into the air!"
Hobert nodded with satisfaction, "Seel deserves the credit!"
If it were soldiers brought out by Christian, they might have already started a massacre, but Seel had been with Hobert for a while after all, and knew the Lord's style and character.
In this critical moment, Seel's response pleased Hobert greatly.
Hobert sat back in his chair and calmly thought for a few minutes before saying to the others, "Archie, Dennis, go to Roy and ask for men, and take a batch of supplies to the West Bank. Do not actively engage in conflict with the locals.
"But if you encounter an attack, you must also launch an effective counterattack.
"Freya, Selena, prepare yourselves. In a few minutes, come with me to the West Bank first."
"Yes!"
After everyone left, Hobert felt Archibald's gaze. He then said, "You stay behind. After the Lady returns, have her hold down the fort at the Lord's Manor. Don't go anywhere else. Just stay here and assist her."
Archibald nodded, "Okay."
Hobert suddenly realized that this "hound" had suddenly become motivated. In the future, when assigning tasks, he could include Archibald.
Thinking this, he returned to the bedroom, put on his cloak, and prayed to "The Fool," indicating that he had encountered an unexpected situation and could not attend this week's Tarot gathering.
Without waiting for "The Fool's" reply, Hobert returned to the study. Freya and Selena, who had quickly tidied up, had also returned.
Hobert used "Travel" to quickly bring them back to the West Bank.
The three suddenly appeared in the main hall of Baron Felix's Lord's Manor, startling everyone there.
However, those who were in the main hall at this time were all high-level personnel previously sent by Hobert. Seel was already an extraordinary being, Corwin, who had bandages wrapped around his head, knew some knowledge of the extraordinary world, and Conrad was surprised for a moment but quickly hid his emotions.
Only Baron Felix was surprised for a few seconds before bitterly saying in his heart: I actually wanted to take back the ruling power in the chaos. I am really naive. Hobert can even drive away those demons. How could I be his opponent?
After Hobert appeared in the hall, he asked, "What is the situation now?"
Conrad, while getting up to yield the superior position, reported, "The people have stormed the Lord's Manor twice, but we have repelled them with clubs."
Hobert sat down, and Freya and Selena stood consciously behind Hobert.
Hobert asked, "Have you asked what their demands are?"
"We asked," Conrad said. "They demand the restoration of faith, the re-sculpting of the demon statues, the re-drawing of abstract symbols, and the offering of sacrifices on time."
Although Conrad and others had become experts in government affairs under Hobert's training, they had not dealt with group incidents and were somewhat helpless at this time.
Hobert then recalled some methods for dealing with group incidents in the Common Era.
Even if he hadn't dealt with them, he had seen many such TV series and novels.
"Let them choose ten representatives to negotiate," Hobert said. "I will receive them outside the door of the Lord's Manor."
"Yes!" The people present immediately got up and went outside to deliver the notice.
They all knew Hobert's abilities and were not worried that Hobert would be in danger.
After Baron Felix also got up to say goodbye, Selena asked curiously, "Teacher, are you really going to agree to let them restore their faith?"
Hobert shook his head gently, "We cannot restore their so-called faith. This is the bottom line."
He smiled slightly, "Didn't I tell you at noon that my pathway will give people excellent eloquence?
"Alright, you guard the door for me. I need to do some preparations."

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 498: Tarot Club in the Emperor's Absence
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Above the gray fog, the Tarot Gathering was held as usual.
Everyone noticed that the Emperor's seat was empty. "Justice" Audrey was a little worried, but after seeing "The Magician" next to her, she thought: As long as Fors can participate in the meeting normally, it means that Hobert has not encountered any danger. It may just be that he doesn't have time to participate. She can try to get some information from Fors later.
"The Hermit" Cattleya thought to herself: Could it be that "The Emperor" was killed by some being because he knew too many secrets? Hehe, it shouldn't be, after all, his identity is not simple.
"The Hanged Man" Alger didn't think much about it. Based on his understanding of "The Emperor," he thought that "The Emperor" might have suddenly encountered something urgent. After all, he is a favored one of "The Creator," and Mr. Fool also values him very much. With such an identity, it is impossible for him to withdraw from the Tarot Club for no reason.
"The Magician" Fors just felt it was a pity that she couldn't trade for that kind of high-level information at this Tarot Gathering. But she didn't know why, her spirituality seemed to be particularly active suddenly, which made her very worried.
"The Sun" Derrick was purely worried and didn't think about anything else.
"The Moon" Emlyn glanced at "The Emperor's" seat: I asked the Sanguine about some secret history of the Fourth Epoch last week, and I was planning to discuss it with "The Emperor" to show the Sanguine' erudition, but he's not here!
"The Fool" Klein had just checked, and Hobert had simply encountered a sudden event and was not in any danger. He was the one who didn't take "The Emperor's" absence seriously.
After everyone was briefly stunned by the absence of "The Emperor," the meeting officially began.
Without the participation of "The Emperor," the trading session of this Tarot Gathering ended quickly, and the free exchange session arrived.
Audrey said first: "I had a very boring week. Does anyone have any wonderful experiences?"
Everyone's lives last week were routine, except for the one sitting at the head of the bronze table who played the role of the Supreme Commander of the Sonia Sea Navy.
They didn't encounter any major events, except that the Supreme Commander's lover was contaminated by an Outer God, and his younger brother was suddenly dismissed.
Yes, these are not major events.
Seeing that everyone was silent, Fors leaned her upper body forward slightly: "Um, I don't know if my experience can be considered a wonderful experience?"
Audrey showed a very interested look: "Even if it's not wonderful, it must be exciting!"
"Yes, very exciting." Fors said, "Last week, I participated in an encirclement and suppression of demons. We killed a total of six 'Desire Apostles' and..."
Those who knew how difficult it was to kill Beyonders of the "Demon" pathway were all shocked.
Cattleya interrupted Fors's speech: "How many of you are there? You can kill six 'Desire Apostles'?"
"We are about fifty people. The other party should have more than ninety people, of course, they did not participate in the battle all at once." Fors smiled:
"Our overall strength is not as good as the opponent, but thanks to the commander-in-chief of this battle who had a perfect plan, our advantages were brought into full play."
Everyone was stunned again. Is this reasonable? Fifty people fighting ninety people, and still without an advantage in strength?
Emlyn almost blurted out "bragging," but he thought that Miss Magician rarely spoke and didn't seem like a liar, so he decided to listen first.
"You may not understand what I mean," Cattleya said, "Why didn't those demons run away? As far as I know, they have the ability of 'malice perception'. Generally, as long as you have malice towards them, they will immediately hide.
"So, generally speaking, the most difficult thing to kill Beyonders of this pathway is to find them!"
Alger also said: "I am very curious, under what circumstances would there be more than ninety people of this pathway gathered together?"
Fors then briefly described the general situation on the west bank of Full Moon Lake and the brief process of the battle.
Cattleya then understood that the "demons" must have sensed the malice, but they also knew that their strength was stronger than the enemy, so they did not escape: The commander of this battle played a huge role in achieving such a result. And this "Magician" Miss, sure enough, you can't ignore her just because she is lazy and doesn't like to talk. She also has a powerful organization behind her.
Alger also summarized in his heart: The commander of this battle is very strong and has a good mind.
Audrey exclaimed: Hobert did such a big thing last week! Could it be that he didn't attend because the matter hasn't been completely resolved?
Klein recalled his previous experience in Backlund: At that time, an "Desire Apostle" caused everyone a headache, but that was also because of the relationship in Backlund. As "The Hermit" said, the most difficult step in hunting "demons" is actually finding them. In Backlund, it provided enough hiding places for the "Desire Apostles". But the situation encountered by "The Emperor" and "The Magician" was a special case. The "Desire Apostles" not only did not run, but also prepared to kill their opponents.
Fors added: "We, we, to be precise, our demigod, also killed a demigod from the other side!"
Everyone was a little surprised again, so it seems that this battle achieved extremely amazing results!
Audrey asked: "Can you tell us in detail about the process of the demigod battle?"
Fors was a little embarrassed: "My strength is too weak, I didn't see the process of the demigod battle."
If she saw it and described it, everyone would probably be even more surprised.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, west bank of Full Moon Lake.
Not far from the gate of Baron Felix's lord's mansion, there are five tall fir trees.
Those are five yellow firs, tall and straight. In autumn, the leaves are golden. During that harvest season, almost everyone in the entire territory can see these five golden fir trees.
These five yellow firs have become the symbol of the lord's mansion. Of course, before that, they did not represent authority, but only a large yard.
At this time, Hobert stood under the five yellow fir trees with his hands behind his back and received ten representatives elected by the people.
As soon as the ten representatives met, they felt the unquestionable majesty emanating from Hobert.
They quickly knelt down and asked Hobert to forgive the previous riot. They said that they had just lost control of their tempers at the time, which caused such an unpleasant thing to happen.
Hobert said: "Get up."
He said to Seel, "Let them all come over too, but they can only listen and not speak at will."
The "they" that Hobert said refers to the people standing not far away.
The guns in the hands of Seer and others kept them far away.
Although they were asked to come over, Seer did not let the soldiers put down their guns. They still had to rely on this to maintain order.
When the representatives got up, Hobert and others were surrounded by people. On one side were Conrad and other officials and young adults from the east bank, and on the other side were the people who participated in the riot. They were separated by several meters and were clearly divided.
Hobert said to the ten representatives: "Tell me about your demands for launching the riot."
An old man who was publicly elected braced himself and said: "Lord, you should have heard that we have our own gods to believe in. Please let us continue to believe in them.
"Everything else is easy to discuss. You say how much tax to pay, and we will pay that much tax. If you need manpower anywhere, we will do our best to provide manpower and resources."
"Is that really a god?" Hobert asked with a smile.
Just as the other party was about to reply, Hobert suddenly asked, "You look like you're over sixty years old, right?"
"52."
"Is your family relatively poor? Why are you dressed so raggedly?"
The old man replied: "The people on our west bank dress almost like this. Well, as far as I know, the east bank is not much better than us.
"The lord has never had to worry about food and clothing, and doesn't understand our difficulties."
"You're wrong!" Hobert smiled: "A ruler who doesn't think about the people's food and clothing is not a qualified ruler."
He asked in the direction of the lord's mansion: "Are there any young men from Shandy Village?"
Several people shouted: "Yes!" "Lord, I am."
Hobert randomly pointed to one: "Tell them about the changes in Jeffery's territory in the past six months."
"Yes!" The young man excitedly squeezed away his companions, grabbed his clothes and said to the old man: "Old man, do you see this? This is a new piece of clothing. I just made it last month.
"Half a year ago, Shandy Village was much poorer than you here..."
The young man enthusiastically described the changes in Shandy Village, the poorest village in Jeffery's territory, in the past six months. The people who participated in the riot listened attentively, but they were obviously a little unbelieving.
But seeing the clothes and mental state of the people in the direction of the lord's mansion, they couldn't help but doubt their own cognition.
After the young man finished speaking, Hobert said to the old man: "Belief is a matter that should be considered after being well-fed, or in other words, a belief that conflicts with being well-fed is basically problematic."
The old man was suddenly speechless by this conclusion and unique way of thinking: "This..."
A middle-aged representative on the side said: "Lord, we, we are used to that kind of belief. Please don't disturb us. As for other aspects, we are willing to listen to you and your subordinates' arrangements."
"Are you used to it?" Hobert asked sharply: "Do you think those demons will come back?
"I can tell you clearly that I can defeat them once, and I can defeat them twice.
"It was the Feynapotter government that gave this place to the demons. Baron Hobert doesn't owe you anything. On the contrary, I really couldn't stand it and rescued you.
"I gave you tents, I gave you seeds, and I let you replant in the spring.
"You didn't even have any gratitude, so why vent your resentment on me?"
The middle-aged representative was stunned: "I, I, I..."
When did he have resentment? Why did the topic completely run off track as he spoke, and it seemed as if he was really being willful to make such a request?
Everyone around was reminded by Hobert and suddenly turned the corner: That's right, why is my anger vented on the people who helped me?
Hobert noticed everyone's reaction and concluded in his heart: Most people still have normal logical abilities.
"Everyone can go out and take a look," Hobert said loudly: "This is the only place in the entire country that has been ruled by demons.
"Those demons are like mice in other places, afraid to show their faces.
"To be honest, I'm hoping they counterattack, so that I can defeat them again!"
This is the core of the problem: I have the strength to protect you!
The ten representatives looked at each other, not knowing how to continue the conversation.
Most of the people who participated in the riot were persuaded, but no one showed shame. After so many years of demon rule, they had become accustomed to solving problems with violence.
So they were only persuaded, but they didn't think there was anything wrong with their solution.
At this time, a reckless representative said: "I don't care, we just want to restore our faith. Unless you kill us all, we will go back and carve statues!"
The old man and the middle-aged man were both stunned. Then these two representatives quickly begged Hobert to forgive them and asked Hobert not to believe what he said.
Hobert carefully observed this reckless man. He tilted his head slightly, trembled unconsciously, his eyes were fierce, and the expression on his face was uncertain.
This is the kind of person who has obvious mental problems!
Hobert nodded with a smile: "You have guts!"
He said to all the representatives: "In my opinion, most of you want to have a better life, and only a few people insist on restoring their faith.
"In this way, you can distinguish yourselves on your own. Those who are willing to continue living in their homes, I promise you that if your harvest this year meets my requirements, I can ignore your beliefs.
"Don't worry, this requirement will not be a difficult goal for you to achieve. Well, I will send people to each village to do statistics and redistribute the fields, and set goals for you based on the amount of land and population.
"Since wheat is planted this season, I think it is more appropriate to set it at 400 jin per mu (about 400+ pounds). As long as you take care of it, you can completely achieve this yield per mu even if the rain is not so timely.
"If you have any objection to the requirements, you can come to the lord's mansion to request a recalculation, but after the requirements are set, you must start implementing them and cannot shirk your responsibility.
"Before the harvest, you are not allowed to carve stone statues privately, how about that?"
The old man couldn't believe it: "Are these the only requirements?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, these are the only requirements, but if you privately carve any statues or symbolic symbols about demons before the harvest, the entire village will completely lose the right to freedom of belief."
The old man still couldn't believe it: "You must do what you say."
Hobert smiled: "When have I ever lied?"
The old man exchanged glances with the other representatives, and then said: "We agree to these requirements."
"I don't agree!" It was still the reckless representative who said: "We want to restore our faith immediately!"
Hobert smiled: "This is exactly what I'm going to say next. Separate those who would rather die than restore their faith. You will be immediately gathered together and guarded by someone."
The reckless representative asked: "What are you going to do with us?"
"Aren't you even afraid of death?"
"I just, I just want everyone to know your brutal side."
Hobert nodded slightly. People with severe mental problems weren't completely devoid of logic.
However, he had chosen the wrong opponent if he wanted to argue with Hobert.
Hobert sneered, "If you had said those words to a demon before, you would already be dead!"
Not only was that blockhead representative stunned, but everyone around him was also taken aback. That was indeed the case.
Hobert said with an expression of righteousness, "Why weren't you so brave back then? Instead, you use this sarcastic tone towards people who have helped you and are willing to listen to your demands.
"You even say it with such confidence, it's simply hateful, pathetic, and pitiful!"
Conrad took the lead in applauding, and everyone finally reacted and joined in.
Hobert's words poured out the grievances in the hearts of the people from the East Coast.
The blockhead representative was scolded and stood there dumbfounded, not knowing how to react for a moment.
When the applause stopped, Hobert said, "But I can tell you your fate!
"Although you can immediately restore your faith, you will be assigned to back-breaking labor until you die on the construction site!"
The other representatives lowered their heads with some awe.
Hobert spread his hands, "Whether you are willing to put in the effort to achieve your goals in the future, or completely give up on your life, it's all up to you!
"In addition, even those who choose to stay in their homeland will have to send two young people from each village and five young people from each town to Jeffery's territory for three months of compulsory labor.
"This is a punishment for your riot, because you could have made demands to the town government and negotiated, but you used the most violent and worst method.
"If you choose the wrong method and do the wrong thing, you will be punished!"
The other representatives all said, "We accept the punishment, we accept the punishment."
In their view, the punishment for a riot was to have two people from each village arrested and executed, which was a very light punishment.
Yes, they naturally assumed that the arrested young people would have no chance of survival.
Next, Hobert instructed Conrad to assign people to count the fields and population of each village to determine the targets set for them.
On the one hand, he would concentrate the people who wanted to restore their faith immediately to the almost deserted Eugene Territory.
Most importantly, he would count the young people who were to be punished in each village and town, and they would have to set off within three days.
Hobert publicly assigned tasks, and the people who participated in the riot were completely relieved. Some villages even selected the people to be punished on the spot, causing a burst of crying and wailing.
As for who was willing to stay in their homeland and who was willing to go to the wilderness, it was easy to distinguish. Some people had already consciously gone to the wilderness.
Hobert saw three children, eight or nine years old, also going to the wilderness together. He couldn't help but stop them, "Are you going to Eugene Territory too?"
The three children looked fierce, and almost said in unison, "Yes."
"The kitchen here needs three helpers," Hobert said. "You will start doing hard labor from now on! Go to Eugene Territory tomorrow!"
The three children were about to say something, but Seer kicked them one by one towards the gate of the lord's mansion, "Bastards!"
It was unclear whether he was cursing the demons or the three little brats.
In the evening, under the escort of the Dennis brothers, a new batch of supplies arrived.
When Conrad and the others retreated earlier, their supplies had no time to be taken away. Without this batch of supplies, the dinner problem for hundreds of people would be difficult to solve.
In addition to the people Dennis brought, nearly a thousand people from the East Coast had gathered here. At night, they camped inside and outside the lord's mansion, brightly lit, looking very lively.
As for the group of people who had gone to the wilderness in advance, Hobert planned to let them starve and freeze for a night first.
During dinner, Serena at the same table asked, "Teacher, if they complete the targets given to them, are you really going to restore their faith?"
Hobert smiled and said, "I got definite news from Bishop Simpson that most people have a chance of recovering from mental corruption as long as they don't come into contact with elements related to demons in the next few months.
"And imagine, after a few months, they have received unimaginable gains, and there are no signs of the demons returning. The people who were punished on the other side tell them about the great changes in Jeffery's territory.
"If these are not enough to make them change their minds, then they should be given some treatment."
Freya was more concerned, "What are you going to do with the group who demanded immediate restoration of their faith? Are you really going to let them die in pain?"
Hobert sighed and said, "Of course, I will gather them together to prevent them from affecting others.
"Before finding a way to treat them, I will drain their energy to prevent them from harming others."
Freya nodded seriously and continued to eat her bread. She knew that her teacher would not disappoint her.
While everyone was eating, a servant from the East Coast, under the protection of two guards from the lord's mansion, found Hobert and the others who were sitting on the ground eating.
After seeing Hobert, the servant said, "Your Lordship, the Madam asked me to report to you that a riot also broke out in Viscount Teuton's territory this afternoon.
"Viscount Teuton has already begun to kill on a large scale. It is said that the effect is quite good."
Hobert was slightly stunned and immediately understood that this was Archibald's notification to him.
It can also be regarded as a kind of advice to Hobert, or a suggestion.
After all, solving problems with killing saves time and effort, and does not cost much resources.
Hobert said to the servant, "Go back and tell Archibald that I am not the same as Teuton.
"Tell Archibald again that as long as I am not here, Fors is the master of the territory."
The servant carefully remembered Hobert's words and immediately embarked on the return journey without rest.
Hobert looked around at everyone and finally asked Conrad, "What do you think makes a qualified ruler?"
Conrad quickly swallowed the food in his mouth, thought for a moment, and then said, "Just as Your Lordship said this afternoon, the ruler must first solve the people's problems of food and clothing."
"That's just the most basic requirement," Hobert said. "Ruling is a responsibility! Whether now or in the future, everyone's standard of governance is 'people-oriented' and to have enough respect for life.
"Such a governance philosophy is hard not to be thriving.
"Only by building a safe and mutually respectful society can it be an open society and can it be completely prosperous.
"This is a very simple cause-and-effect relationship, but often simple things are the most difficult to do, so some people always want to find so-called shortcuts.
"We can't be so impetuous, we must operate patiently, I believe that through our joint efforts, we will be able to create an unprecedented prosperous society!"
Everyone in the circle present had their eyes shining.
