chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 499 Audrey's Advice (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Powerstone 100]
After dinner, Hobert asked Selena to record the course of the riot she handled today, as well as the conversation at dinner, in the form of a story.
Then make several copies and send one to each department as a guiding ideology for the town government's work.
Today, the reactions of Conrad, Corwin, and Seel made Hobert realize the importance of a "guiding ideology". When facing problems, having a ready-made logic to use can truly make the town government's work more efficient, and things often develop in the direction Hobert expects.
At the same time, Hobert also understood the importance of unifying thought.
After everyone had basically rested, Hobert locked the door and prayed to "The Fool", hoping to communicate with Miss Justice alone.
More than ten minutes later, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog, and he arrived at the Giant Hall, at the "Emperor"'s seat.
Only "Justice" Audrey was sitting opposite him, and the head of the bronze long table was empty, without the figure of Mr. Fool.
But Hobert knew that "The Fool" Klein must be somewhere in this hall, otherwise he and Audrey could not appear above this gray fog.
Audrey found this kind of meeting very novel: "Em… Hobert, you didn't attend the meeting today, everyone is very worried about you."
Hobert smiled and said: "A riot broke out in my territory today."
Audrey almost covered her mouth in surprise: "A riot, good heavens, why did such a thing happen?"
Hobert briefly described the previous rule of the demons: "…Under that bloody rule, the local residents were forced to believe in demons, and inevitably suffered spiritual corruption.
"The people I sent helped them with spring planting, helped them rebuild their homes after the disaster, and forbade them from believing in demons again, but they were strongly resisted by some people, which resulted in a riot!"
Audrey clenched her beautiful fist angrily: "Damn demons!"
Then she recalled for a moment and asked: "Why do they still need to rebuild their homes? I haven't heard of any disasters in Colson County, Feynapotter Kingdom recently? Did the demons destroy their homes when they left?"
Since learning the exact location of Hobert's territory, Audrey has been intentionally or unintentionally paying attention to all information from Colson County. With Earl Hall's connections and network, Audrey dare not say that she knows Colson County like the back of her hand, but she still knows some of the major events that happen in real time.
Moreover, at the Tarot meeting in the afternoon, "The Magician" Fors didn't mention that the area near Full Moon Lake had suffered a natural disaster.
"Well… there's nothing to hide about this." Hobert said, "That disaster was the result of a battle at the angel level."
Not only was Audrey surprised, but Klein, who was sitting at the head of the table, was also a little surprised: How could there have been a battle at the angel level?
As Hobert expected, Mr. Fool was in this hall, sitting at the head of the bronze long table, but he had added a seat for himself, with his back to Audrey and Hobert.
The tall back of the chair perfectly concealed Mr. Fool's habit of eavesdropping.
Hobert briefly described the situation at the time, and finally said: "…'The Creator' was also very supportive of my actions, not only sending saints to participate in the battle, but also sending angels to participate after the other party summoned the 'Bloody Archduke'."
The result of this battle was that 90% of the people in Eugene Territory died in the aftermath of the battle, including the Eugene Baron family.
But at the same time, it stopped the "Bloody Archduke" in Eugene Territory, and at least didn't cause 90% of the people in the entire South Colson area to die.
However, Hobert didn't intend to tell Audrey, who had some "righteousness complex", about these things.
Audrey sighed in her heart at this time: As expected of the righteous god, "The Creator" not only hates the "Rose School", but also takes the initiative to eliminate those demons!
Then she was a little proud: Fors doesn't even know about the angel-level battle, but Hobert told me!
Hobert continued: "The riot has basically been resolved, but I estimate that nearly 10,000 people have suffered relatively serious spiritual corruption, so I would like to ask you if there is any way to treat their spiritual corruption?"
He sighed: "You probably can't imagine that among these people, there are many children under the age of ten!"
Audrey couldn't imagine what that area had gone through!
She frowned: "According to some of the knowledge I have learned, spiritual corruption can almost only be healed by oneself. I can only do some psychological suggestion to make them look like normal people temporarily.
"The key is…"
The key is that there are too many patients. If Audrey treats them one by one, it may take three or four months to complete a "first consultation". Adding follow-up consultations, it is estimated that it will take half a year.
This is obviously a bit unrealistic.
Audrey fell into deep thought and began to consider whether there were any other methods.
Hobert waited quietly, and the hall became unusually silent for a while.
"I have thought of a theoretically feasible method." Audrey said.
After becoming a "Spectator", she had read a large number of books on psychology. After joining the Psychology Alchemists, she had read many related research materials from there. No senior member of the Psychology Alchemists had as much reading as her.
So Audrey could think of ways to give herself psychological suggestions and explore her subconscious space.
She is very professional in terms of theoretical knowledge of the mind.
Hobert made a gesture to invite her to speak, and Audrey continued: "I think the spiritual corruption of those people should be somewhat like spiritual imprints. Theoretically speaking, a stronger spiritual imprint can be used to cover the 'imprint' left by the demons.
"If the existence that leaves the new imprint is normal enough and does not show signs of evil, depravity, or bloodlust, then under the influence of the new imprint, those people will be much more normal.
"But they will still be different from ordinary people, prone to excitement and paranoia, but a large part of them should be able to gradually heal themselves, but there must be some people who may never be able to get rid of such mental problems in their lives."
The more Hobert thought about it, the more feasible he felt this method was, and Audrey had already expressed it very clearly: he could ask "The Fool" or "The Creator" to give them a new imprint.
"The Fool" at the head of the bronze long table prayed: May the Goddess bless me, don't come to me, go to "The Creator"!
Hobert quickly made a decision: "It's better than them spending their entire lives under the influence of demons."
He took a deep breath: "Thank you for your suggestion, how much is the consultation fee?"
"No consultation fee is needed." Audrey smiled and said: "If it can be useful to you and can treat so many innocent people, that is the best consultation fee."
Hobert nodded: "I will definitely try my best to save more people."
"Hobert, you are a noble person." Audrey suddenly smiled and said: "Don't question everything you do, and don't care about those gossips, do what you think is right."
Hobert was slightly taken aback, but quickly understood that Audrey had seen the loss that he had unintentionally shown.
Yes, even though he knew that the people were so mentally disturbed because they were affected by the demons, Hobert gave them help, but in return he received riots and misunderstandings. He must have felt uncomfortable in his heart.
But as Audrey said, he knew that this method of handling was correct, and Teuton's method of handling was wrong.
That's why he concealed his loss in front of his subordinates, but he didn't expect that Audrey would see it.
Hobert smiled and said: "Thank you for your comfort, I feel much better."
If they don't understand, then they don't understand, Hobert thought: I just need to feel that I'm doing the right thing, what does it matter whether others understand or not?
After ending the separate communication, Hobert began to consider the method of applying new imprints to people with mental abnormalities, and finally came up with a simple plan.
In the next two days, Hobert stayed in Baron Felix's lord's mansion to preside over the overall situation, and the work of "diverting" the subjects was basically completed.
Most people chose to stay in their homes, began to carefully take care of the crops in the fields, and built or renovated their homes under the command of public officials.
About 11,000 people voluntarily came to the wilderness of Eugene Territory, where they looked for stones, wood, and all materials that could be carved, and carved one ugly demon statue after another.
It seemed that they only found a sense of security after seeing these statues.
The people in the villages and towns who accepted punishment also said goodbye to their families and embarked on their journey with a bit of tragicness.
Looking at the appearance of these people, Hobert inexplicably wanted to laugh. He planned to give these people a vacation three days later and let them go home. The expressions of these people must be quite wonderful at that time.
During these two days, Hobert also received the king's envoy, a court viscount.
The envoy first praised Hobert, and then informed Hobert that Colson County would send mayors and officials to the west bank of Full Moon Lake in the near future, and thanked Hobert for his contribution to the stability of the South Colson area.
Hobert clapped his hands and said: "I finally waited for the king's help, Mr. Envoy. The people here have suffered from the spiritual corruption of the demons and have launched a riot.
"There are still more than 10,000 people with extremely high aggression. I have gathered them all together. Since Mr. Envoy is here, please issue an order to execute them!"
The court viscount was stunned: "How can I issue such a cruel order?"
"It's not you who issued it, it's issued in the name of the king!"
"The king cannot cruelly kill his subjects like this!"
Hobert nodded as if he understood something: "Anyway, those people are handed over to you. I believe you should be able to dispose of them properly."
The court viscount did not give an immediate answer, but suggested to meet those more than 10,000 people.
Hobert then asked Seel to take the envoy to Eugene Territory. The worship of those people towards the demon statues and the malice shown in their words and deeds left a deep impression on the envoy.
After returning to the lord's mansion, the court viscount immediately bid farewell.
Before leaving, Hobert also asked the court viscount to ask for money for disaster relief on the west bank of Full Moon Lake, a total of 20,000 gold Solas, and generously said that he would give the viscount a 10% kickback.
The court viscount simply agreed and did not make any promises, and hurriedly boarded the ship.
He wanted to stop those grassroots officials who might have already set off as soon as possible and report the situation here to the king.
In the court viscount's view, this was completely a place that cost a lot but had little value. The most important thing was that the king certainly could not bear the infamy of slaughtering more than 10,000 people!
It would not be too late to restore the rule here after Hobert had finished all the "dirty work" after a while.
This is why Hobert emphasized "responsibility" to Conrad and others in the previous conversation.
Now, from the royal family to the government, the countries of the Northern Continent have no sense of responsibility to the people.
…
On Thursday morning, a light rain yesterday covered the wilderness of Eugene Territory with a layer of thin mist.
Clouds rose and fell, and the thin mist was stirred by the breeze, rolling in the mountains and fields, passing over the neat withered grass with dew.
Angus led five members of the First Squad and followed Hobert to this wilderness again.
Now a large area of colored grass has been cleared in this wilderness. This is the result of those more than 10,000 people who would rather die than believe in demons in the past two days. After pulling out all these grasses, they will be uniformly sent to the Earth Mother Church.
At this time, these more than 10,000 people were called up early. They very obediently came to a cleared hillside according to the requirements of the administrators.
This group of people showed an amazing duality. On the one hand, they were irritable and could easily fight each other, and often fought to the death.
On the other hand, they were very respectful to the administrators who held weapons, even if they only held wooden sticks, and they would do almost whatever they were asked to do.
However, the premise is not to touch their statues.
In the hazy mist, they saw Baron Hobert, whose hair was wet with mist, walking quickly to the top of the mountain.
Hobert looked coldly at the indifferent, fierce, or absent-minded faces on the hillside one by one.
He smiled and said: "As you expected, I can't just easily forgive you, the main participants and planners of these riots!"
Many people hugged or clenched the statues in their arms or hands. They knew that this baron with a full sense of oppression would not just let them do hard labor so simply.
"Prepare to accept your punishment!" Hobert smiled, and suddenly lowered his head and made a praying gesture.
Regardless of whether the people on the hillside understood what the baron was going to do, even Angus and others did not know how the lord was going to punish these people.
Suddenly, in the mid-air above Lord Hobert's head, a violent wind suddenly struck, and the thin mist was torn open, and a void-like place appeared in the mid-air.
Then, a terrifying force descended, and even ordinary people could fully feel the majesty in the mid-air that they dared not look at directly.
At this time, many people on the hillside had knelt down in fear.
Angus and several other Beyonders stared blankly at the figure in the mid-air that seemed to be sitting in a forest of sharp swords.
He exuded a sacred light all over his body, as if he could end all chaos, and as if he could bring complete chaos.
He exuded an aura of majesty all over his body, making people unknowingly lower their heads and want to submit unconsciously.
His majesty could be felt in a large area around him, and within the scope of his majesty, his words seemed to be unquestionable orders.
By the time Angus snapped back to reality, he realized he was already kneeling on the ground.
He quickly lowered his head, prostrating himself like the people around him.
At this moment, amidst his fear, there was also some excitement: No wonder Hobert was able to invite an angel to fight for him. So, the Christian father and son duo have pledged allegiance to a god! This is simply, simply wonderful! As long as I faithfully serve Hobert, I will also have the opportunity to rise above the ranks!

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 500: Transport Captain Reappears (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Powerstone 200]
The ordinary people on the hillside could only feel the unquestionable sense of majesty from mid-air, and the fear of knowing that the other party was in front of them, but not being able to see them.
This was a fear from the unknown, from the existence of immense power.
Such fear was deeply buried in everyone's genes. In the lives of ancient people, and in the vast universe, there were too many existences that were powerful to the point of helplessness.
They left indelible marks in the minds of the ancients, which is why people had fear.
This was a stress response, either to escape quickly after feeling fear, or to show one's weak side after feeling fear, and pray that the existence would spare them.
At this moment, the more than ten thousand people could no longer move their legs, how could they escape?
So they were left with only devoutly kneeling on the ground, or collapsing on the ground.
The statues in their hands or in their arms also slipped to the ground. At this moment, these statues were so ugly and weak.
"Evil faiths will eventually perish!" A solemn voice said from mid-air, "From today onwards, you must believe in my name, pray on time, and offer sacrifices regularly!
"Since you believe in my name, you must practice my ways.
"Besides me, you shall have no other gods;
"You shall not make idols for yourselves;
"You shall not misuse my name;
"You shall work diligently and not be lazy;
"Honor your parents, so that you may live long in this land;
"You shall not murder;
"You shall not commit adultery;
"You shall not steal;
"You shall be honest and upright, and be courageous and responsible;
"You shall not covet anything that belongs to others."
The solemn voice disappeared, and then, the surging sense of oppression also disappeared.
The shivering crowd seemed to suddenly come back to their senses, and shouted, "Believe in your name! Practice your ways!"
The shouts gradually converged, as if even the withered grass was trembling.
A ray of sunlight pierced through the thin mist, dispelling the haze of this wilderness.
The thin sunlight shone on the people, as if scattering the dark side of them, and many people felt like they had been reborn.
Hobert saw that their emotions were still easily fluctuating, and they still revealed very obvious fanaticism, hesitation, confusion and other expressions.
However, joy, excitement and other expressions also appeared on their faces.
The effect of this "treatment" was very good.
Hobert took off his cloak, revealing the pattern inside, which consisted of a simple throne and an abstract symbol representing distortion: "Remember the symbol representing the 'Creator'! From today onwards, you will only have this one faith!"
"Creator!"
"Creator!"
In the cheers of the people, the few people in the front row held Hobert's cloak with both hands like holding a sacred object, and then pulled the cloak open, displaying it to everyone.
Many people quickly bit their fingers and drew the abstract symbol on their clothes, lest they forget.
Some people took out some tools such as knives and carved it on their arms to deepen their memory.
This made Hobert couldn't help but twitch his lips, looking at everyone's fanatical expressions. Why did this scene look like spreading a Cthulhu belief?
Uh, well, for the orthodox church, it was indeed a Cthulhu belief.
Everyone's fanaticism lasted for more than half an hour, until the faces of many people showed obvious fatigue, the administrators, at Hobert's suggestion, loudly drove them to work.
They were still as docile as before, working hard in the wilderness, but after these people left the hillside, a large number of demon statues were left here.
Hobert called over the official in charge of guarding these ten thousand people, a woman who was nearly thirty years old, looked very stable, and had firm eyes.
Hobert smiled and said, "Quinna, right?"
The woman stood up straight: "Yes, Lord."
"Conrad told me about you, saying that he was relieved to give you the most difficult task of guarding these lunatics."
"Thank you for Commander Conrad's introduction, thank you for your promotion, Lord."
Hobert kicked away a demon statue in front of him: "I'm just telling you this, do a good job and don't let Conrad's introduction down."
Before Quinna could say anything, Hobert continued: "This batch of manpower must be fully utilized. After these grasses are cleared, I will send professional engineers to assist you.
"You are only responsible for transporting building materials from the east bank, and then building a batch of factories here. When the factories are built, this batch of people will be the first batch of compulsory workers here.
"If someone's emotions gradually stabilize, ask them if they are willing to go home.
"Those who are willing to go home will be handed over to the local government, and those who are unwilling to go home will be given some salary and allowed to stay and continue working.
"The initial salary should not be too high, maintaining one-third to one-quarter of the opposite bank for a period of time, and then increase it to the normal salary when they have completely recovered."
Quinna, like Conrad, had the habit of shorthand, and recorded the general meaning of Hobert's words just now.
After Hobert left on horseback with his entourage, Quinna came back to her senses: So the Lord is preparing to build an industrial zone in this wilderness.
Of course, it was to build an industrial zone. In Hobert's view, nothing would grow in this wilderness for a long time, wasn't this a good place to build an industrial zone! There was no need to worry about corruption.
In Hobert's eyes, every inch of his territory should have its value.
Controlling the mental corruption problem of more than 10,000 people, Hobert was in a good mood, and began to outline the future of the new territory.
The bridge must be repaired. Not only that, Hobert felt that the genes of the infrastructure maniac in his body seemed to suddenly awaken. He also planned to build a railway to connect the entire territory.
Hobert spent the whole day outlining the future. In the evening, he had dinner early, put on a hooded cloak, and used "Travel" to come to Eugene Territory again.
But this time he came to the junction of Eugene Territory and Teuton Viscount Territory.
At this time, the South Colson area was already very warm during the day, but it was still a bit cold at night. Some fog rose in the mountains and fields. Watching them being blown by the wind at night was very magical.
Hobert waited for a while with his hands behind his back, and saw a black figure quickly walking towards him.
When he came close, the other party saluted: "Lord!"
This person was Dennis's father, the former Grove Knight.
"You've worked hard during this time." Hobert took out a pre-prepared potion: "This is the 'Barbarian' potion I promised."
When he gave Elliot the Beyonder characteristics, Hobert specially left a copy of the "Barbarian" and a copy of the "Briber" Beyonder characteristics.
The former was to fulfill Grove's promise, after all, he had perfectly completed the tasks Hobert had given him recently.
Grove didn't hesitate and drank it in one gulp, but because the previous potion was not digested well, the process of taking the potion was a bit dangerous.
Fortunately, Hobert was watching over him, and Grove survived.
Hobert deliberately didn't say it clearly: "In your current state, you can only take the 'Barbarian' potion at most, it will be dangerous if you go any further."
Grove sighed: "I finally had such an opportunity, but I didn't expect that I would... Alas..."
Hobert smiled in the dark: "Your youngest son, Dennis, is very good. He has now obtained the opportunity to become an Beyonder, and his future achievements will definitely surpass the 'Briber'."
This was encouragement, but also a warning.
Grove was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "The conditions you promised me before can also be given to Dennis."
"That's not the same thing." Hobert said: "In the future, Dennis will follow me out of this mountain, how can he care about a 'Briber' potion?"
Grove was more relieved, which meant that Dennis would really have a great future.
"What's the latest news?"
"I only found out a few days ago that at the beginning of the year, the royal family gave Teuton a Sequence 6 potion, hoping to use him to restrain you, Lord." Grove reported:
"In addition, the royal family's news is very well-informed. After you drove away the demons, the first batch of investment in Teuton's territory arrived, as much as 100,000 gold lire. It is said that a scenic spot will also be built on the west bank."
"These fools." Hobert said: "One scenic spot is just right, build another one and wait to lose money!"
Hobert pondered for a while and said: "Try to get this project in your hands. On the surface, it is to build a scenic spot, but secretly build a characteristic ecological park."
He explained the meaning of ecological park to Grove, and then said: "I have consulted the priests of the Earth Mother Church. The soil on the west bank is very suitable for growing vegetables and fruits. Use the 100,000 gold lire in this area to avoid wasting resources.
"If there is a need, you can consult the priests of the Earth Mother Church for vegetable and fruit planting techniques."
"Yes!" Grove realized that the Lord was already preparing to pick the fruit of Teuton Territory.
Hobert also said: "Try to tell Teuton to try to be a 'Judge', this will allow him to better master Beyonder abilities.
"In addition, I will provide you with a Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristic, you find an opportunity to dedicate it to Teuton."
Grove opened his mouth wide: "Sequence, Sequence 5?"
"Yes." Hobert smiled: "Let him become a 'Disciplinary Knight'!"
Grove really couldn't understand what Hobert's purpose was? He actually wanted to turn his competitor into a Sequence 5!
That was Sequence 5, Grove didn't even dare to think about it!
After ending the meeting with Grove, Hobert used "Travel" to return to Baron Felix's lord mansion to rest.
Because a riot had just occurred, he planned to stay here for two days before going back.
Just as he was about to fall asleep, Hobert heard someone praying in the "Nation of Disorder". He sighed and had to enter the "Nation of Disorder" covered in a quilt.
A strange star appeared in the pool in front of the "Iron Throne". Hobert was a little strange. He didn't tell the group of lunatics the honorable name of the "Creator" today, so how could a new star appear?
Spreading his spirituality over, Hobert saw a middle-aged woman dressed as a court maid, constantly chanting his honorable name with a look of horror.
Hobert was slightly stunned. Was this being hypnotized, or was it a psychological suggestion?
Carefully looking at the other party's clothing style, Hobert judged that it was the clothing of the Loen court.
This made Hobert involuntarily think of George III: Could it be that this old man is testing me? Or did he notice the relationship between me and the "Nation of Disorder"?
Hobert pondered for a while and decided to ignore it, but for safety's sake, Hobert brought "1-106", that is, "Farbauti's Ring" to the real world.
After putting on the ring, Hobert didn't feel any malice towards him.
Hobert was relieved: In theory, even if George III became the "Black Emperor", it would be impossible to find me so easily.
So Hobert entered a state of meditation and quickly fell asleep.
Just as he was sleeping soundly, Hobert felt a burning pain in his hand. He once thought he was dreaming, and scratched his hand several times in his half-sleep and half-awake state, but it didn't work.
Finally, Hobert woke up and found that it was actually "1-106" that was emitting a burning sensation.
Hobert was stunned for about a second, and he suddenly realized: Someone showed strong malice towards me!
He also thought of the previous prayer: George III really wanted to murder me.
This made him immediately want to enter the "Nation of Disorder" and throw the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" and "Holy Infant King" into the real world.
Then Hobert realized that this idea seemed wrong. Theoretically, when he killed George III's youngest son during the defection, George III was the easiest to lock on to him.
Hobert couldn't understand: What is George III using to lock on to me now? Philip I is easier to lock on to me, after all, he has a "Crystal of Order" in his hand. But I have no connection with George III!
He also thought: Even if George III is unfavorable to me, he can't come in person, and the royal family's angels can't come. Because this is the Kingdom of Feynapotter, if the angels of Loen enter Feynapotter, it is equivalent to declaring war.
Hobert realized: He only needs to guard against demigod-level masters from Loen.
He put on his clothes while thinking, prepared the Sealed Artifacts and Magical Items, and maintained a fighting state.
Sitting on the chair, Hobert pondered: The Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts in my hand can...
Just as he was thinking about this, Hobert's spirituality felt something and saw the space above his sleeping bed suddenly become illusory.
Hobert was very familiar with this kind of illusion, it was "Travel"!
Hobert suddenly got up and made an attacking posture. Almost at the same time, a man with big ears, wearing Loen-style clothes, and covering his face came out of the illusory space.
After the big-eared man came to the real world, he immediately jumped down from mid-air and nailed a sword to the bed.
Hobert sighed: Fortunately, I put "1-106" on my hand tonight, otherwise I wouldn't be able to avoid this sword!
He also thought: Assassins should often carry out assassinations, so they are so skilled in stabbing this sword after using "Travel" to appear near the target.
When the big-eared man stabbed out that sword, he saw that the target was not on the bed. It was too late when he found Hobert.
"Disorder!" Hobert didn't use the ability of the Sealed Artifact, but used his best "Disorder!"
The big-eared man immediately fell into a state of "disorder": What did I just stab? Did I hit the target? But why does the target look like a pillow? Could it be that my assassination target this time is a pillow?
By the time he came back to his senses, Hobert had already stabbed him in the chest.
Hobert currently had two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts on him, "1-104" and "1-106." He felt that this was already the limit for the number of Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts he could carry.
However, neither of these Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts had the ability to directly inflict heavy damage on the enemy. "1-106" could summon a lava pool several dozen meters wide, but Dennis, Conrad, and the others lived next door, or the next door after that. A sudden lava pool would burn them all to death.
Therefore, Hobert chose the most reliable "physical attack."
After being injured, the big-eared man retreated while raising his left hand, revealing a black glove on his hand: "Imprisonment!"
At that moment, the other party's figure seemed to become incomparably tall, radiating an aura of majesty that dared not be looked at directly.
Seeing this black glove, Hobert suddenly recalled his experience in Backlund. At that time, he had just arrived in Feynapotter and suddenly thought he could sneak attack some Tamara family members, so he went to Backlund and caused chaos.
At that time, he had encountered a big-eared opponent wearing black gloves.
Without time to think too much, Hobert immediately poured his spirituality into "1-104": "Amplify!"
He remembered that the other party's glove was a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, so he "amplified" "Imprison Hobert" into "Imprison all creatures in the room."
As a result, Hobert and the enemy were simultaneously enveloped in a layer of amber-like film, standing in place unable to move.
The big-eared man, who was actually Bennett, a rising star of the Tamara family, obviously did not expect that one day he would be "imprisoned" by his own "Imprisonment."
He also did not expect that Hobert would also have a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact!
Thus, the life-and-death battle scene suddenly changed its style, with one person "imprisoned" on the bed and the other "imprisoned" in front of the bed.
Hobert asked knowingly, "Who are you?"
In his heart, he was already thinking: Could it be that the Tamara family had discovered his past rampage in Backlund?
"The one who will take your life!" Bennett said coldly, "Death!"
Hobert immediately responded, "Disorder!"
In theory, "Death" is unavoidable, but that's just in theory. The "Lawyer" pathway is specifically for exploiting loopholes in rules.
Moreover, the "Disorder" that Hobert used was created using "1-104," which could not only create chaos in the distance between Bennett and Hobert, but also cause Bennett's intentions to fall into "chaos."
The result was that the fist Bennett swung brushed past Hobert's nose.
Even though it didn't hit, Bennett felt like it did.
So, at the same time as he threw his fist, Bennett used: "Deprivation!"
He briefly "deprived" Hobert of the right to use Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts.
But at that instant, Hobert also had a corresponding response: "Exploitation!"
Because Bennett did not specify the exact duration of the "deprivation" effect, Hobert "exploited" the rules and loopholes to end the "deprivation" effect early.
As a result, Hobert's right to use Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts was deprived for 1 second, then the "deprivation" state ended, and Hobert could use Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts again.
The two people in the room, one standing on the bed and the other standing on the ground, glanced at each other. They both felt that the Beyonder abilities of the "Arbiter" and "Lawyer" pathways, when used together, were like a joke.
One strives to establish rules, and the other strives to find loopholes in the rules that are beneficial to themselves, causing the rules to collapse.
In the end, it seemed to produce a one plus negative one effect.
Seeing that his surprise attack had not achieved the intended effect, Bennett, while guarding against Hobert, prepared to use "Travel" to leave.
Hobert had no intention of stopping him, but summoned the "Underworld Gate" before the other party left.
In an instant, the entire room became gloomy and cold. Two bronze doors with intricate patterns suddenly appeared, and pale hands stretched out from the cracks in the door, and indescribable eyes peered out from the cracks, which were chilling.
At the same time, a huge suction force was generated from the cracks in the door, as if it could suck people's souls into the bronze doors.
At the moment when the "Underworld Gate" appeared, Bennett felt cold all over, especially the wound that had just been stabbed by the black knife, which was chilling to the bone.
At the same time, the space in front of Bennett became illusory, and he immediately stepped into the spirit world.
Watching Bennett leave, Hobert terminated the summoning of the "Underworld Gate," but the entire room remained cold and chilling.
Hobert rubbed his hands reflexively and immediately entered the "Nation of Disorder" to take out the "Faceless Necklace." He held the necklace in his right hand and the black knife in his left hand, and he silently recited in his heart: "The person who was stabbed by this knife."
"..."
After reciting it seven times, Hobert entered a state of half-sleep and half-awake through meditation.
He saw a scene: Bennett, whose face was unclear, was in a Roen-style living room. A young woman, presumably his companion, was helping him clean his wound.
The area around the wound was the clearest. The skin was already frozen black and purple, and some black blood was flowing out.
The other parts of the picture were very blurry. Hobert could roughly see that there seemed to be one or two other people around.
The state of dream divination disappeared, and Hobert was thoughtful: The picture is not very clear, probably because the other party has a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. Fortunately, the holder of the Sealed Artifact is a Sequence 5. If it were a demigod, he might only get a blurry picture in which he couldn't see the person's face at all.
Hobert also thought: The other party's injury has initially begun to flare up, but if his injury becomes too serious, his elders or superiors have a high probability of coming to help him solve the problem.
So Hobert divined again: "It would be very dangerous if I went to pursue the assassin just now."
"..."
After reciting it seven times, Hobert received the revelation that there was danger, but the danger was not great.
Hobert immediately made a decision: Then go. Perhaps he could find clues about the Tamara family again.
So he immediately set up an altar and used the bestowed ritual to bring the "Light Priest Ring" and the "Ocean Pendant" into the real world.
After making sufficient preparations, Hobert used the "Faceless Necklace" to navigate and used "Travel" to enter the spirit world.
At the moment of entering the spirit world, Hobert thought to himself: If Klein can go, so can I!
He plunged into the spirit world. After "Traveling" for more than ten seconds, Hobert's spirituality told him that the living room he had just seen was ahead.
He pulled out his knife and suddenly left the spirit world: "Underworld Gate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 501 Tamara Family's Elite Team
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the living room, Bennett, who was just about to summon his teacher's messenger, suddenly narrowed his eyes: "Enemy attack!"
He had just put on his coat when Hobert, wearing a black crystal mask, stepped out of the spirit world. In an instant, the entire living room became extremely cold and terrifying.
The bronze door with intricate patterns appeared again. Bennett frantically dodged Hobert's black knife. The appearance of the bronze door made his wound ache unbearably, and he didn't even have the strength to hold his sword.
The suction of the bronze door appeared again, as if drawing Bennett's strength and warmth.
Bennett struggled to raise his hand and pointed it at Hobert: "Banish!"
Hobert pointed the ring at Bennett: "Trade!"
Even without using the ring's ability, he could sense Bennett's desire for him to leave. So, after the huge thrust of "Banish" appeared, Hobert "Blinked." In doing so, Hobert fulfilled Bennett's desire to "Banish" him.
As a "Trade," Hobert avoided the fate of being "Banished."
[T/N: I'm not sure what this ability is lol, might be fanmade ability]
A man who had just rushed into the living room was immediately "Banished" out of the living room, out of the entire townhouse. When he came to his senses, he found that he had been pushed out of the real world.
He didn't have a sealed artifact with the ability to "Travel" like Bennett. With his strength, he might be permanently banished outside the real world until the end of his life.
Back in the living room, Hobert couldn't help but sigh: Sure enough, you can't make deals with devils!
In Hobert's mind, devils always used their treachery and cunning, using people's desires to make deals, and always completed the transaction in an unacceptable way. When the transaction was completed, people realized that their souls had been unknowingly sold to the devil.
This ability is actually more useful in daily life, and can be more effective when the target agrees to the transaction!
At this time, Hobert had been pushed away a distance by "Banish". He simply abandoned Bennett as a target for the time being, and faced the door of the living room: "Holy Light!"
Three members of the Tamara family who had heard Bennett's voice came to support him. At this time, the doorway was a bit crowded, and as a result, the two people in front were hit head-on by the "Holy Light."
Although they also used their respective abilities to block the huge beam of light, their clothes were still ignited. After being baptized by the "Holy Light," they were also in a dazed state for the next three or four seconds, and would only rely on instinct to avoid enemy attacks.
Hobert didn't continue to pay attention to the direction of the door. He used "Blink" to reappear in front of Bennett: "Lightning Strike!"
Bennett, who was already sweating profusely and becoming increasingly weak, had just "Deprived" some of the abilities of the "Underworld Gate". After the lightning appeared above his head, he immediately "Imprisoned" the lightning.
Because of the blessing of the sealed artifact on his hand, his "Imprisonment" effect was very good. Only a small part of the lightning fell on him, causing only a very brief paralysis effect.
The space in front of Bennett became illusory again. He was preparing to use "Travel" to find his teacher.
Hobert quickly "Distorted" the opponent's thought of "Escape immediately now" into the thought of "Escape immediately with all subordinates now."
At this time, Bennett's condition was already very bad, and he was almost helplessly affected by Hobert's "Distortion", running towards his subordinates.
Thus, the illusory space became normal.
Hobert chased after him, ending the summoning of the "Underworld Gate."
Bennett's subordinates were relatively elite. The first to arrive were two Sequence 6s and one Sequence 7. After they were hit head-on by Hobert, they did not continue to attack Hobert, but instead worked together to smash open a wall, making it easier for the people behind to support them and also making it easier for them to escape.
Because their captain Bennett had the ability to "Travel," they didn't consider a retreat route for their captain at all.
The second batch of subordinates who came to support were also a Sequence 6 and a Sequence 7. They were a little surprised to see their captain running towards them.
But they still used "Whip" and "Bribe" towards Hobert in a very disciplined manner.
Hobert, who was chasing over, felt that he had brewed enough, and stretched out his hand towards the front: "Outburst!"
Just as he expected, he felt his spirituality rushing towards "1-106" like a dam releasing a flood.
Then, in front of him, a lava pit with a diameter of ten meters appeared, encompassing Bennett and his five subordinates.
In the six people's faces of surprise, they stepped on empty air and fell downwards.
The walls of the attached villa also collapsed and began to fall into the lava. Bricks and wooden structures fell in, either sinking quickly or burning and sinking slowly.
Bennett seemed to suddenly come back to his senses. The space in front of him became illusory again, preparing to escape.
Hobert, who was being whipped by an illusory whip, had plenty of time to respond: "Disorder!"
Bennett, who was in bad shape, was once again affected by "Disorder". He felt that the lava below was warm and nice, just enough to dispel the chill on his body.
However, his instinct for survival still made him "Imprison" himself, allowing a layer of amber-like film to wrap around his entire body, thus avoiding the fate of being burned by the lava.
The others fell into the lava, and their feet and calves were immediately ignited and severely burned, making painful wails.
Only two Sequence 6s reacted quickly. An amber-colored film immediately appeared under the feet of one Sequence 6. This was obviously a "Judge". He "Imprisoned" a part of the lava, and used the imprisoned film to jump violently out of the lava pool.
Unfortunately, Hobert, who was still being whipped, had already noticed his actions. He quickly rushed over and kicked the "Judge" back into the lava pool.
The "Judge" fell into the lava and was quickly swallowed by the lava amidst a shrill scream.
Another Sequence 6 was a "Baron of Corruption", who "Distorted" the thoughts of a Sequence 7 next to him, causing the Sequence 7 to punch him heavily. At the same time, he pushed out with both hands, and using the power of his companion's fist, he rolled out of the lava pit in a somewhat embarrassed manner.
And that Sequence 7 was completely pushed down by him, and his whole body was quickly swallowed by the lava.
At this time, the "Whip" of the invisible whip on Hobert had ended. Even if he had the physique of Sequence 5, he was still whipped until his skin was torn.
Hobert endured the pain coming from his back and faced the "Baron of Corruption" who had rolled to the ground: "Lightning Strike!"
This "Baron of Corruption" didn't have a sealed artifact like Bennett. Although he "Distorted" the "Lightning Strike" a bit, most of the "Lightning Strike" fell on him.
Lightning bolts as thick as fingers jumped around him, and while he was injured by the lightning, he fell into a brief state of paralysis.
Hobert "Flashed" over and killed the "Baron of Corruption".
At this time, Bennett came back to his senses again, and the space in front of him became illusory again.
"Amplify!" Hobert raised the scepter in his hand, seizing the opportunity to amplify Bennett's injuries.
The timing he chose was just right. The injuries caused by the black knife were at a critical moment of becoming more serious, and as a result, they were immediately "Amplified", causing Bennett to become stiff and tremble, and the process of stepping into the spirit world was like slow motion.
Hobert smiled slightly. Just as he was about to use "Disorder" again, he saw a bundle of firewood flying towards Bennett, with the intention of smashing him into the spirit world.
"Distorton!" Hobert quickly twisted the direction of the firewood, causing the firewood to fall into the lava.
Hobert rushed into the lava pool while looking at the direction from which the firewood flew.
It turned out to be Bennett's last two subordinates. Just now, Bennett said he was cold, and they went out to get some firewood. How did the original living room become a lava pit?
Hobert was wearing "1-106" on his hand, and the lava only patted him like some warm water.
Bennett felt a huge threat, but his body was becoming more and more stiff. The action of entering the spirit world before had now become very difficult. The entrance to the spirit world was right in front of him, but he still couldn't take that step.
At this time, the difference between magical items and one's own abilities was revealed. If he was a "Traveler," he could now actively integrate into the spirit world and escape.
Beyonders of other pathways must take the initiative to take a step to enter the spirit world when using magical items with "Travel."
Hobert, who had relevant experience, knew this, so he was able to prevent Bennett's escape at critical moments.
At this time, Hobert rushed over and knocked Bennett away from the entrance to the spirit world, interrupting Bennett's "Travel" again.
Seeing that Bennett was about to enter the lava, a dawn-like radiance suddenly appeared on his body. This was entering the "Retribution" state. The dawn-like light protected him from being burned by the lava.
However, the "Retribution" state couldn't last long, and Bennett was convulsing at this time, and could hardly use any active abilities.
Hobert came over as if wading through water and directly pierced Bennett's head with a knife.
Although the "Retribution state" would increase Bennett's defense, it did not have the effect of "Dawn Armor".
Bennett's legs kicked straight, but he was not dead yet.
The dawn light around him quickly dimmed, as if representing his life was rapidly fading.
Bennett's last two subordinates, seeing this situation, immediately stopped their rescue efforts and turned around and ran!
"Corrosion!" Hobert used his area skill. The two Sequence 8s were immediately affected by "Corrosion". One went to the safe, wanting to take away all the wealth when leaving, and the other ran to the "Baron of Corruption" who had been struck by lightning, hoping to pick up his Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert turned back and stabbed Bennett in the heart with a knife. The "Disciplinary Knight" hummed a few times in pain, and finally died in the lava pool.
Hobert jumped out of the lava pool and solved the two Sequence 8s one after another.
And the others had either sunk into the lava or been burned to death.
Bennett, who was about to sink into the lava pool, suddenly moved again, splashing lava forward like swimming. When he finally climbed to the shore of the lava pool, his entire body had been scorched.
After landing, Bennett, who still had flames on his body, lay motionless on the ground.
Hobert used the "Spirit Wine Glass" to control Bennett's corpse to climb up.
Hobert first took off the black gloves on Bennett's hand, and then found a necklace inlaid with beautiful gems on his neck.
These two items did not deform at all in the hot lava, and must be sealed artifacts on Bennett's body.
Then Hobert used the "Spirit Wine Glass" to speed up the process of the surrounding corpses condensing Beyonder characteristics. When the Beyonder characteristics held by the corpses in the lava pool "floated out", Hobert picked them up one by one, and also obtained a sealed artifact.
Tonight was a great harvest, 8 Beyonder characteristics, 3 sealed artifacts, and one of them was a Level 1 sealed artifact.
Bennett's team was obviously more elite than the team killed on Rose Street before.
Hobert guessed that they might all be direct descendants of the family, but the level of Bennett's team was higher.
Coming to Bennett's corpse, Hobert began to communicate with spirits. After entering the gray spirit communication space, Hobert's first question was: "Why did you try to assassinate me?"
"..."
After asking seven times, in the rolling gray fog, Hobert saw Bennett reading the newspaper. When he saw the reward of 10,000 pounds for Hobert, he smiled and cut down the report and clipped it into a book at hand.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. He didn't know his true identity, but only attempted to assassinate him for the reward.
Then Hobert thought: Then my counter-kill this time is equal to an uninvited confession, which can easily allow the Tamara family to associate the "assassination of Hobert" with the annihilation of this team.
Otherwise, leave a sentence on the wall to divert their attention?
But what should I leave? If I can't divert the other party's attention, it will be another operation of "I have no silver buried here".
Hobert temporarily didn't consider this question, but asked again: "Did you ask your elders or superiors for help?"
"..."
After chanting seven times silently, Hobert saw the scene of Bennett writing a letter to his teacher. Fortunately, it had not been sent out yet.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, he was decisive when making decisions. If he was one step late, he might have run into the other party's teacher.
Then Hobert asked the third question: "Does your teacher know about your assassination attempt of me?"
In the rolling gray fog, Hobert saw the process of Bennett writing a letter to his teacher again, but he was only asking about Hobert's recent information and revealed his idea of earning this reward.
Hobert took a deep breath: That is to say, he probably knows that he wants to assassinate me, but he doesn't know the details.
Hobert did not continue to ask about the location of the Tamara family's hiding place, but cautiously withdrew from the spirit communication, found the distress letter and burned it, and threw the corpses into the lava, thinking about how to deal with the aftermath.
At this time, he glanced at the yard that had collapsed into a lava pool, and suddenly felt that he didn't need to do anything, because even if he left any clues to attract the other party's attention, they would be taken away by the official Beyonder first.
Unless the people of the Tamara family arrive before the official Beyonder, which is obviously unlikely. The surrounding people should have already called the police, and the patrol police will soon discover this lava pool and quickly report it to the official Beyonder.
However, Hobert was still a bit uneasy, so he jumped onto the roof, located the church, and used "Travel" to take a look. It turned out to be the Church of Storms.
Hobert cleared his throat, took a deep breath, and said, "The Punishers are a bunch of good-for-nothings, a bunch of cowards, a bunch of..."
A "Lightning Strike" interrupted Hobert's insults. Hobert quickly ran towards the scene, with the grumbling "Punishers" chasing closely behind, arriving at the scene even before the patrol officers.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 502: Tarot Club after Half a Month
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Back in the Kingdom of Feynapotter, on the west bank of Full Moon Lake, Hobert offered the spoils of this operation as a sacrifice to the "Nation of Disorder."
He couldn't wait to take a look at the black glove. Using the authority of the "Nation of Disorder," he discovered the glove's special nature:
The Beyonder characteristics that formed this glove had undergone extreme distortion. The Beyonder characteristics of the "Imperative Mage" within the glove were not entirely complete. It had actually been twisted together with a portion of the Beyonder characteristics of a "Mentor of Disorder," forming a very strange Sealed Artifact.
Or rather, the Beyonder characteristics of the "Mentor of Disorder" had been constantly providing the "Imperative Mage's" Beyonder characteristics with the power of "distortion," which was how this Sealed Artifact achieved a strange balance.
In addition, the spirit and mental imprint of the "Imperative Mage" who provided the Beyonder characteristics for this Sealed Artifact still had a portion remaining within the Beyonder characteristics.
Therefore, the ability of this glove is: "Within a specified time, the holder can use the mental residue within the Sealed Artifact to use all the abilities of the 'Imperative Mage'! The usage time and interval are: three minutes of use, two minutes of rest, then another two minutes of use, but with three minutes of rest, and then another one minute of use, after which you must rest for at least three hours before continuing use. If the usage process is interrupted, it will take two hours of rest to restart the timing. If used again during these two hours, the previous timing will continue."
Relatively speaking, the negative effects are not very large: "Each time this Sealed Artifact is used, the holder will fall into a state of 'chaos' at least three times in the following day. The holder needs to have a strong will to constantly fight against the spirit within the Beyonder characteristics. If there is any slack, they will be affected by the other party, and even the holder's spirit may suffer irreversible damage."
Hobert sighed: A very good Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, "1-107," that will be your name from now on.
As for the other two Sealed Artifacts, they were both Grade 2. The necklace on Bennett was the Sealed Artifact that gave him the ability to "Travel."
This Sealed Artifact only has the abilities of "Travel" and "Opening Doors," but the negative effects are greater than Hobert's "Traveler's Knife": "The holder is prone to getting lost when entering the spirit world and will always be late or one step behind at crucial moments."
This "negative effect" seems unlikely to cause much harm, but it can actually be very dangerous at times, such as the distress call from that brother (Bennett), which was just one step too late.
The remaining Sealed Artifact possessed some of the abilities of a "Baron of Corruption." Hobert habitually sealed them a little and put them on the Grade 2 Sealed Artifact side.
Finally, the most exciting moment arrived: checking the Beyonder characteristics.
This time, a total of 8 Beyonder characteristics were obtained, all of which were pathways that Hobert currently had a large demand for. Among them, Hobert had already thought of two uses for the "Disciplinary Knight" Beyonder characteristic.
There were also 4 Beyonder characteristics at Sequence 6 level, namely 2 "Baron of Corruption," 1 "Judge," and 1 "Scribe."
2 Beyonder characteristics at Sequence 7 level, namely 1 "Briber" and 1 "Interrogator."
2 Beyonder characteristics at Sequence 8 level, namely 1 "Barbarian" and 1 "Trickmaster."
For Hobert, there could never be enough Beyonder characteristics from the "Lawyer" pathway. Every time an Beyonder characteristic of this pathway is used, the Balk family will become stronger.
Hobert's foundation in the Southern Continent will be deeper.
The Beyonder characteristics of the other two pathways will be used for the advancement of the members of the First and Second Squads.
After putting away the gains from this battle, Hobert returned to the real world to rest.
In order to prevent another assassination like Bennett's, and to prevent being targeted by the Tamara family, Hobert simply kept "1-106" with him at all times.
When he lay down to rest, Hobert savored the ability of "Danger Perception."
Although this ability gives people a great sense of security, it easily makes people suspicious.
Just like before Bennett appeared, Hobert always thought that George III was going to harm him. As a result, he even had plans to run away overnight.
Therefore, "Danger Perception" cannot distinguish where the malice comes from, but can only distinguish the approximate level of danger of the malice.
Thinking about it, Hobert fell into a deep sleep. The previous "outburst" had consumed a lot of his spirituality.
In the following days, Hobert sat in the west bank, changed the beliefs of the people in the wilderness, and determined the harvest goals for each village and town. Hobert felt that his potion had been digested a lot intermittently.
So Hobert set his sights on the east bank. If he continued to change the original ruling method like now, and the lives of the people changed drastically, he estimated that he would be able to completely digest the potion without unifying the South Colson area.
This made Hobert sigh: The digestion of the "Black Emperor" pathway potion is indeed inseparable from "domination."
During this period, Hobert also completed the transaction of the Atlanta flower with "Hermit" Cattleya. After drying it according to the method provided by Cattleya, the required powder can be obtained.
Then, the auxiliary Ingredients for the "Earl of the Fallen" are only the "brain marrow of the six-legged imp" and a bottle of ten-year-old vintage wine.
On Sunday night, Hobert went to Backlund again and completed the transaction with Miss Sharon.
When he saw the 150,000 pounds in cash, Hobert was sure that the economic strength of the Temperance School was so strong!
Through this transaction, the two people established a preliminary mutual trust, providing good conditions for future transactions.
After getting 150,000 pounds, Hobert felt unprecedented wealth, but he also thought about building an industrial zone and building bridges and railways. This made Hobert sigh. It costs so much to operate the entire territory alone!
But since he has such conditions, he is very willing to invest only by himself. First of all, this will not be controlled by others, and it has to be said that this is a very good way to launder money.
Now the territory has begun to create considerable income. In the future, after the territory is completely built, it will have long-term income, and this money will be earned back many times sooner or later.
After sacrificing 150,000 pounds to the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert was smiling in his dreams.
In a blink of an eye, it was Monday afternoon. Hobert used the reason of taking a nap to prevent anyone from disturbing him.
He didn't participate in the Tarot Gathering last week. When he participated in the Tarot Gathering again, he was a little excited.
At three o'clock, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog, and he came to the familiar Giant Hall again.
After everyone saw "Emperor" again, "Fool" Klein, who knew the inside story, of course didn't take it too seriously, and "Hanged Man" Alger didn't take it to heart either. He knew that nothing would happen to the Emperor.
Audrey, the "Justice" who also knew the inside story, just smiled and said in the greeting session: "Welcome back, Mr. Emperor."
"Sun" Derrick encountered new troubles again this time, and at the same time he also wanted to ask Mr. Emperor why he didn't attend the meeting last week, but now is not the time to discuss this issue, so he can only ask when he has the opportunity.
"Magician" Fors seemed to suddenly breathe a sigh of relief. She felt that the reason for this sigh might be because she could finally trade for high-level information again.
"Moon" Emlyn smiled slightly. He could finally discuss the history of the Fourth Epoch with "Emperor" later. This will definitely make everyone realize the erudition of the Blood Race!
"Hermit" Cattleya scrutinized "Emperor." She was very curious about "Emperor's" absence last week, but she felt that she was not very familiar with "Emperor," so it was not easy to ask too clearly.
After Audrey greeted everyone, this Tarot Gathering officially began.
First of all, it was still the sacrifice of the diary and Mr. Fool's reading time.
A few minutes later, Mr. Fool said: "You can start now."
This time, "Sun" Derrick encountered a new problem again. He rushed to say before everyone else: "Elder Lovia has been released. I met her in the library."
Several members who knew who Elder Lovia that "Little Sun" was talking about were stunned. The exploration team she led had lost control, and she herself must have problems. How could the Six-Member Council of City of Silver release her?
And Cattleya, who had just joined, didn't know what they were talking about, but she didn't ask, just listened quietly.
After saying this, Derrick looked at the "Hanged Man" next to him.
Alger thought for a while and asked back: "At the last gathering, you said that the Chief of City of Silver conducted a preliminary exploration of the Giant Court. Before releasing Elder Lovia, had your Chief returned to City of Silver?"
Audrey's expression remained unchanged, but she thought in her heart: Why did Mr. Hanged Man suddenly ask about this… That's right, it is impossible for the other members of the Six-Member Council not to wait for the Chief to return to release such an important person! Then is the release of Lovia related to the Chief's exploration results? Hey, why didn't I think of this just now?
Derrick was quite surprised by Mr. Hanged Man's accurate guess: "Yes, just recently."
At this time, Fors, who was quietly listening, suddenly had an idea based on the information she had learned before: "Mr. Sun, could it be a situation like this?
"Your Chief took the exploration team and that little boy Jack to find the road that can lead to the outside world, and found that they must borrow the power of the 'True Creator'.
"Hehe, this is not a lie I made up, but a reasoning based on facts. The father of that little boy Jack belongs to the 'Aurora Order'. They followed the 'True Creator's' sanctuary to your place.
"So, for the sake of the entire City of Silver, your Chief decided to release 'Shepherd' Lovia after returning."
"If this is the case, Mr. Sun will be very dangerous next," Audrey said worriedly.
Hobert smiled and said, "No, on the contrary, I think he will be safer. Even if he shows some obvious suspicious points, the chief will turn a blind eye, and the more suspicious 'Sun' is, the more relieved the chief will be."
Audrey was stunned and looked at "Emperor" with Fors.
Derrick simply asked, "Why?"
Klein already understood: It's very simple, for balance!
It was "Hanged Man" Alger who answered "Sun's" question: "The danger of the 'True Creator' can be detected by any intelligent creature with eyes and a brain.
"Your chief will never put all his chips on Him. He will inevitably seek power that can check the 'True Creator'.
"And exposing their conspiracy, you, who have been possessed by 'Blasphemer' Amon, may represent another possibility.
"So 'Emperor' said that the more suspicious you look, the more relieved your chief feels.
"In addition, the more Lovia and the others want to hurt you, the more the chief and other elders will protect you."
Fors was a little stunned: Is this a good thing instead?
Audrey felt a little frustrated: Mr. Hanged Man is right. I still have a big gap with them in analyzing things and situations!
After "Little Sun" thanked Mr. Hanged Man, he finally breathed a sigh of relief and asked in a noticeably relaxed tone: "Mr. Emperor, why didn't you attend the meeting last time? Did you encounter something urgent?"
"Yes, I couldn't attend the meeting at that time." Hobert vaguely answered the question, and then continued: "If this is the case, we can conduct a second transaction. I still have an Beyonder weapon there."
In fact, there are still two, but he doesn't plan to sell the short sword for the time being.
The reason why he plans to initiate a new transaction is because the auction center has sold 6 Beyonder ingredients through daily transactions in the previous half month.
The transaction model of "exchanging weapons for ingredients" previously constructed by Hobert has taken shape. Now the monthly output of Beyonder weapons is three to four.
This output makes it impossible to make all Beyonder ingredients into Beyonder weapons. Therefore, if there is a chance to sell them, Hobert will not hesitate to cash them out.
After all, an Beyonder characteristic of Sequence 8 level can be sold for about 400 gold risos, and the income from 6 Beyonder ingredients is enough to pay the workers' wages once.
At the same time, the gathering held by Hobert after the auction has also basically taken shape, and has already attracted some extraordinary forces like April, or wild Beyonders.
They will sell some mystical items and also buy some.
Hobert has all the information about their buying and selling in his hands, and can purchase the items that others need, and then sell them to those who need them after adding a certain price difference.
Hobert handed over the processing of these information to Fors, while he himself only appeared at the auction and presided over the Beyonder gathering after the auction.
What Hobert wants to sell to Derrick is the Beyonder weapon made from one of the main ingredients of "Beast Tamer".
He introduced: "This weapon has two abilities. The first ability is to be sharper when cutting through the enemy's flesh, and there is a very small probability that it can cause considerable damage to the enemy even if it does not directly cut the enemy.
"The second ability is that when facing non-human opponents such as beasts and monsters, the holder can show a certain aura that makes beasts or monsters fear, and there is a very small probability that beasts or monsters will give up resistance."
Derrick's eyes lit up. This weapon is very suitable for use when facing monsters!
Hobert then said: "Here I have to explain that the probability problem of Beyonder weapons is difficult to control. It does not mean that the ability of probability will definitely be obtained after swinging ninety-nine times.
"It is possible that the probabilistic ability will be used when swinging the second time, or it may be triggered at any time thereafter, so there is no way to make the probabilistic ability controllable through prior preparation.
"In addition, these abilities belong to the level of 'Low Sequence', and will mostly be very useful against 'Low Sequence' targets and monsters.
"It also has a decent effect against 'Mid Sequence' enemies, but Beyonders at the 'Mid Sequence' level generally have corresponding methods to avoid such attacks."
"Little Sun" said: "Mr. Emperor, I know all this."
Hobert smiled: "Well, I'm just explaining it in case you don't understand something."
In fact, he was telling the other members. Of course, the Beyonder weapons in his hand cannot only be auctioned at the auction, which will affect the scarcity of the goods.
Then the Tarot Club is another very good dumping ground, after all, the members have their own circles.
After finalizing the transaction, Hobert said again: "I need the brain marrow of the six-legged imp."
"Hermit" Cattleya said: "I asked the previous seller for you, and the brain marrow in his hand was bought by one person."
Hobert let out a somewhat disappointed "Oh". He didn't expect this auxiliary Ingredient to be so hard to find.
The others did not help "Emperor" find corresponding clues.
After the transaction fell through, Alger continued: "I need the potion formula of 'Ocean Songster'."
He has saved a lot of money and believes that he should have enough financial resources to buy the potion formula of this level.
Cattleya was a little strange: "Hanged Man" is indeed a "Wind Blessed". Isn't he a member of the Storm Church? Why seek the potion formula of "Ocean Songster" outside? It is much less difficult to obtain the formula from within the church. Does he have a secret he wants to hide from the church? Or was he just pretending to be a member of the Storm Church before?
She said: "I can help you pay attention."
Seeing Cattleya's response, Alger asked smoothly: "Ms. Hermit, what do you need as a reward? I can collect clues in advance."
"Hermit" Cattleya immediately realized that this was "Hanged Man's" test. Having a need would expose many clues about her.
So she said: "I need a demigod-level mystical item with relatively acceptable negative effects."
Alger understood that "Hermit" was responding to his test in a mocking way, but he did not smash the table in front of him like most of his colleagues, but took a breath and said: "I will pay attention.
"But Ms. Hermit, you should be very clear that just the valid clues to such items may be worth the potion formula of 'Ocean Songster'."
This made Cattleya question her previous judgment: Very deep, not easily angered, this is not very much in line with the style of the Storm Church, could my first observation be wrong?
Hobert smiled aside. He didn't expect that it was already the third week, and the probing of these two old fritters was still continuing: "Mr. Hanged Man, I will also help you pay attention. The things I want are much simpler: gold pounds!"
Alger smiled slightly, showing enough goodwill: "Thank you, if you help me find out the potion formula, just name the price."
"Okay." Hobert said to Cattleya again: "Ms. Hermit, although I don't have any Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts…"
To be precise, there are not too many, only 7 at present. Hehehe, Hobert laughed unkindly in his heart.
He continued: "But I know the clues to two or three such Sealed Artifacts. If you need them, I can help you inquire."
Klein, at the head of the bronze long table, glanced at the "Scepter of the Sea God" in the corner: Two or three? "Creator" is very rich! Cough cough, or is "Fool" too poor?
Audrey observed the body language of the three people and suddenly understood something: This is the first time I have seen someone use this method to ease the atmosphere.
The other members were still a little confused and hadn't quite understood the mutual probing between "Hermit" and "Hanged Man" just now.
After hearing "Emperor's" words, Cattleya was slightly stunned before saying: "It is best to have a very strong attack effect, the kind that can quickly solve the enemy."
Hobert nodded and promised again: "I can help you inquire."
He thought for a while, "1-101" and "1-105" both meet Cattleya's needs, but their negative effects are very large and need to be resealed before they can be used.
This test ended here, and "Moon" Emlyn cleared his throat and said: "Mr. Emperor, I only learned by reading some Sanguine materials last week…"
Hobert had already drawn a key point in his heart: By reading some Sanguine materials!
"…It turns out that the Trunsoest Empire was the strongest in those years!" Emlyn smiled and said: "Not only was its national strength the strongest, but the key is that the Night Emperor also had a beautiful and dignified empress!
"That's right, that is our Sanguine's 'Goddess of Beauty' Auernia, and the royal families of the four countries in the Northern Continent are also the great nobles of Trunsoest.
"Is it because of so many powerful helpers that the Night Emperor won the early victory of the 'War of the Four Emperors'?"
Emlyn really felt everyone's attention, and he knew that the information he said must be unknown to everyone.
This made him unconsciously raise his chin.
"You're right," Hobert smiled and said, "But there is an even more important reason why the Night Emperor was able to win the early victory."
Audrey clenched her fists and said simply: "Mr. Emperor, I want to trade information about the Trunsoest Empire with you."
Hobert smiled and said: "No problem, I have already quoted a price before, I can give you a discount of 1,000 pounds, which counts as the consultation fee I owed before."
Last week, Audrey provided him with a good idea that made the minds of over ten thousand lunatics controllable, which was well worth the price.
Audrey smiled and said, "Thank you for your generosity, Mr. Emperor."
"In addition to Mr. Emperor's discount, I am willing to pay another 1,000 pounds for this information. Who is willing to join the deal?"
Emlyn opened his mouth, as if to say: We haven't finished discussing it yet! I also know… Well, I would also like to know another reason why the Night Emperor achieved early victories.
He readily said, "I am willing to offer 500 pounds to join!"
