chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 503 A Brief History of the Trunsoest Empire
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
This wasn't the first crowdfunding effort; the other members were quite familiar with the procedures.
In just a few words, everyone completed the crowdfunding.
Audrey contributed 2000 pounds, with 1000 pounds offset by previous consultation fees.
The other members, Alger, Fors, Emlyn, Cattleya, and 'The World,' each contributed 500 pounds, while Little Sun continued to provide two Beyonder ingredients.
Alger and Cattleya were both curious about what the 'Emperor' meant by consultation fees.
But now was not the time to consider this. After reaching the crowdfunding goal, the 'Emperor' immediately began to speak: "I believe everyone should remember the 'United Empire' period, which was also a very crucial period for the Night Emperor!
"Here, I want to first discuss the issue I just discussed with Mr. Moon. The great nobles of the Trunsoest Empire did play a role in the Four Emperors War, but the support of the six gods was the key to the Night Emperor's early victory!"
Everyone, of course, knew which six gods were being referred to!
Klein, behind the gray fog: Roselle also received similar information!
Alger, with his arms crossed, leaned back in his chair: I previously speculated about the role of the gods in the 'Four Emperors War.' Now it's clear—they supported the Night Emperor! With the support of six gods, how could the Black Emperor and the Blood Emperor possibly be the Night Emperor's opponents?
Cattleya, pinching her chin: I had similar speculations before, that the 'Four Emperors War' also involved a game between the gods, but I never imagined that the six gods would choose to stand behind an emperor!
Audrey suddenly realized: When exchanging information about the Solomon Empire and the Tudor Empire before, I overlooked the choice of the six gods. According to their previous experience of jointly dealing with the Black Emperor and the True Creator, they would definitely realign. But why would they uniformly support the Night Emperor?
The others had similar questions. Fors simply asked, "Mr. Emperor, when you narrated the Solomon Empire, you also said that it was difficult for the six gods to form a unified camp. Why did they choose to support the Night Emperor together this time?"
"The answer to this question is purely my personal speculation. If anyone obtains other relevant information, you are welcome to communicate and discuss it with me," Hobert said with a smile. "When I was learning about the history of the Night Emperor, I noticed a problem.
"Before the 'United Empire,' the six gods single-handedly planned the first fall of Solomon. Can it be logically assumed that the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics of the 'Black Emperor' pathway were in the hands of the six gods?
"But why later, would they rather let the Uniqueness and another Sequence 1 of the 'Black Emperor' pathway return to Solomon than let Trunsoest, whom they supported, become the new 'Black Emperor'? Instead, with their help, they allowed Trunsoest to become the 'Justiciar' of the adjacent pathway?"
Klein, who knew the most comprehensive relevant information, was slightly stunned: That's right, if the six gods supported Trunsoest, it would seem simpler for him to become a true god of the 'Black Emperor' pathway. I didn't notice this before!
The other members had similar thoughts. Only Cattleya recalled a key piece of information: I remember the Queen once said that after a new 'Black Emperor' appeared, the original 'Black Emperor' would completely fall! If the six gods allowed Trunsoest to become the 'Black Emperor,' they could also completely destroy Solomon. But why didn't they do that?
With questions in their minds, everyone focused more intently on the 'Emperor'.
"I have two guesses about this. The first guess is that the timing was not right, and the second guess is that the Uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' pathway was not in the hands of the six gods at all!" Hobert explained his thoughts in detail:
"First, let's talk about the first guess. As far as I know, becoming a 'Black Emperor' requires a lot of abstracted interaction…"
Hobert deliberately didn't explain this too clearly. In fact, the interaction he was talking about referred to linking one's name to the title of emperor, making it common knowledge among the people, and establishing a close and complex set of rules that violated normal circumstances, including architectural style.
Achieving these two points required sufficient opportunity and planning. It could be difficult or simple.
For a transmigrator like Hobert, "establishing a close and complex set of rules that violated normal circumstances" was not too difficult.
Just like the Ming-style decoration style he used before, if he had his own country, using unscrupulous operations similar to "Keep your hair, lose your head" he could change the architectural style of the entire country in two or three years.
But for Trunsoest, this should be more difficult, as it was difficult to establish a completely new cultural system.
However, linking Trunsoest to the emperor was relatively simpler for Trunsoest. After all, he was a great noble very early on and one of the emperors of the United Empire. It shouldn't be too difficult to have this kind of common sense.
Hobert continued: "…Trunsoest may not have been ready, so the six gods did not let Trunsoest become the 'Black Emperor'.
"But I don't think this reason is too difficult for the six gods to solve. They can completely use their respective authorities to help Trunsoest prepare.
"To put it bluntly, even if Trunsoest was not ready, if the six gods needed it, Trunsoest would have to obediently risk advancement.
"The reason for explaining this is to not rule out this possibility."
Hobert paused slightly and then said, "I think the second guess is more reasonable. The Uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' pathway is not with the six gods, but was taken away by the True Creator who was driven to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'.
"This explains many things. I told you before that Tudor secretly built many hidden buildings to prepare for advancing to the 'Black Emperor'.
"Why would he make these preparations? Was it because he contacted the True Creator in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?
"In order to muddy the waters in the Northern Continent, would the True Creator agree to give the Uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' pathway to Tudor? As for what conditions Tudor promised the True Creator, this is unknown.
"There should be some secret deal between them, such as Tudor grandly or secretly supporting the True Creator's return after becoming the 'Black Emperor'.
"It was precisely because of this kind of transaction that no god supported Tudor, so Tudor became the second fallen emperor.
"At the same time, it was precisely because Trunsoest knew Tudor's intention to become the 'Black Emperor' that he completely relied on the six gods in order to avoid being killed by Tudor.
"Perhaps some of Tudor's secrets were revealed to the six gods by him, which directly led to the division of the United Empire."
Hobert spread his hands: "I emphasize again, the above are all my guesses.
"According to the records, Tudor and Trunsoest both responded to the pressure of Solomon's resurrection.
"And Tudor had no choice but to jump to a non-adjacent pathway after Trunsoest became a true god of the adjacent pathway.
"However, the records are full of doubts. First of all, the timing of Solomon's resurrection was too bad. If he could wait a little longer, it would be better to resurrect after the Blood Emperor and the Night Emperor started fighting.
"Of course, it may also be that Solomon could not control the process of resurrection, or he did not know the situation outside.
"But after his resurrection, he did not go to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' to continue to unite with the True Creator, nor did he let the True Creator descend again on the Northern Continent to share the pressure for himself. Instead, he stayed on the Northern Continent and fought the Blood Emperor and the Night Emperor head-on, which is also quite suspicious.
"In addition, the alliance of the six gods this time was too uniform. Before the Blood Emperor seized Medici's victory, they joined forces to make Trunsoest a true god of the 'Arbiter' pathway.
"Unlike the last time, when Solomon and the True Creator's alliance grew stronger, the six gods formed a united camp. Does this mean that before Tudor became the Blood Emperor, the six gods reached a consensus for some reason?
"Also, why was Tudor so sure to prepare for advancing to the 'Black Emperor'? As far as I know, the preparations he made were quite comprehensive, and he even asked Mr. 'Door' to set up the relevant teleportation array.
"If he wasn't quite sure, why would he make such thorough preparations?
"If the Uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' was with the six gods, why didn't he actively approach the six gods? Instead, Trunsoest received the support of the six gods?
"Did Tudor think that with his own strength, he could defeat one or two gods and obtain the Uniqueness he wanted?
"It is based on the above doubts that I have such a guess.
"I put all the answers in front of everyone. You can believe the records, or you can refer to my guess."
Klein, sitting at the head of the bronze long table, thought to himself: The 'Emperor's' analysis feels like a combination of "official history" and "historical speculation." Official history often only has fragmentary records of some events, or deliberately blurs some events. But it is still possible to find the truth of history from some clues in other events! The 'Emperor's' speculations feel like finding the truth of history through fragments.
Alger also believed: I am more inclined to the Emperor's guess. The truth is often very simple, that is, it is built on relationships of interest, and the 'Emperor's' guess basically takes into account the interests of all parties, and is more credible than rigid data.
Audrey also sighed in her heart: Hobert's guess makes this history full, always with a feeling of listening to a senior lecturer in the Department of History giving a lecture. They often have their own unique views on a historical event, different from textbooks and historical materials, and their views are often supported by sufficient evidence. The process of listening to them dissect history is simply a mental enjoyment.
Cattleya put her hands on the bronze long table: The "Emperor's" logical thinking ability is very strong, and he successfully convinced me. He seems... seems to know a lot about the game between gods.
Fors sighed: In the "Emperor's" eyes, the game between the gods and the Four Emperors does not seem complicated, and he can always find some easily overlooked clues and draw some unbelievable conclusions!
Derrick, who is not too serious about the truth of history: Mr. Emperor's guess is too exciting, this is more like a game between gods.
Emlyn just felt: Why can't I have such understanding and views from those materials? It must be because the "Emperor" saw more detailed information! Yes, it must be so!
As for Hobert's description of the attitude of the six gods, everyone was already used to it and did not feel any surprise.
Hobert gave everyone a few seconds to think before continuing: "It was precisely because the six gods were all on the side of the Night Emperor that after the 'Four Emperors War' began, the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms jointly sealed Mr. 'Door' in the opposing camp.
"In the subsequent battle, the Night Emperor first joined forces with the Blood Emperor, who also had grievances with Solomon, to destroy the Solomon Empire together.
"As far as I know, the Sequence 1 characteristics of the 'Black Emperor' pathway were later acquired by Adam, who was once a great noble of the Tudor Empire. The two Sequence 1 characteristics in Adam's hands are likely to be the spoils of war from the two emperors joining forces to destroy Solomon."
He continued: "In the division of the spoils of victory of the Solomon Empire, I think Trunsoest is likely to have obtained the Uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' pathway and a Sequence 1.
"This should be an important reason why he was later jointly destroyed by the six gods."
Everyone was surprised: Why would the six gods jointly attack the Night Emperor they supported?

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 504 The Second Black Emperor: Roselle (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Qw2 for becoming a member]
Even Klein didn't know the details of the Night Emperor's fall, so he was very surprised to hear the "Emperor" announce the information: Didn't the six gods support the Night Emperor? Why did they join forces to make Him fall? Could it be because the Night Emperor wanted to monopolize the spoils of the early victory? Resulting in an uneven distribution of spoils?
Because of the lack of key information, Alger also thought: In theory, the Trunsoest family is an Beyonder family of the Black Emperor pathway. Could it be that after the Night Emperor obtained the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 spoils, he also wanted to make one of his family members become the "Black Emperor," but the six gods disagreed, so a conflict occurred?
On this issue, Cattleya knew no more than "The Hanged Man": It's hard to imagine where the conflict between the six gods and the Night Emperor lies. They had clearly cooperated to unify... Could it be because the Night Emperor unified the Northern Continent? The six gods' camp actually has a tendency to internal division. Could it be because they didn't want to see a unified Northern Continent, so they joined forces to eliminate the Night Emperor and supported the four major nobles of the Trunsoest Empire to establish four major countries?
Audrey's knowledge was not as good as the above three, but through previous transactions, she suddenly realized a problem: The royal families of the Loen Kingdom and the Feynapotter Kingdom are both Beyonder families of the "Arbiter" pathway, and according to the Emperor's description, the Loen royal family has a Sequence 1 Beyonder, and it is possible that the Feynapotter Kingdom also has a Sequence 1. This cannot help but remind people of Tudor and Trunsoest. Could it be that the process of the two royal families obtaining Beyonder characteristics was also a betrayal?
The other three members had limited knowledge and insight, and only thought of some of the things that Klein and others had thought of.
"Sorry, I can't tell you why the Night Emperor wanted to obtain the related characteristics of the 'Black Emperor' pathway right now," Hobert took a deep breath and said, "Because the value of this information is too high, it has already exceeded the scope of our transaction.
"As I said last time, when one of you reaches a certain level, I will tell 'Them' the details of this information for free.
"Before that, I will only tell you a rough idea.
"Let me think, if we trade information about the Underworld Emperor, I will tell you a part of this important information first.
"When we trade information about the Ancient Sun God, we will talk about it in more detail, but the relevant information about the Ancient Sun God can only be traded when the time is right."
Hobert smiled slightly: "In the mystical world, some information is not better the sooner you know it."
The "Little Sun," who originally wanted to ask a question, put down his hand again. He believed in Mr. Emperor. He is now more patient than before: Since Mr. Emperor said that the time is not right to announce some information, then I can wait a little longer.
Klein then realized: Is there any important secret after becoming a god? According to the "Emperor's" description and my guess, there are only three Sequence 1s in a pathway. This is already very obvious. In the "Emperor's" description, every time the spoils of victory at the level of gods are divided, there are three Sequence 1s and the Uniqueness. Could it be that after becoming a True God, one can still accommodate the Uniqueness and a Sequence 1 of the adjacent pathway to become stronger?
He resisted the urge to shake his head: In theory, it's impossible. After all, I haven't heard of any "Imperative Mage" who can accommodate part of the Beyonder characteristics of "Earl of the Fallen." There may be certain skills involved, or there may be secrets I don't know!
Alger and Cattleya both lacked this kind of top-level information, so they only realized that there was a big secret here, but they didn't have a complete idea of what the specific secret was.
Audrey raised her hand slightly and asked, "Mr. Emperor, to what extent can you disclose information about the fall of the Night Emperor? Can you tell us more details?"
"Let me think," Hobert paused for a second or two before saying, "Although this involves some family secrets and some very high-level information, I can still explain it more clearly.
"I will say as much as I can. If you have any questions, please keep them in your heart and ask them when you have the opportunity in the future."
Audrey nodded quickly, and the other members had no objection, because they were already very satisfied with the information they had obtained before.
So Hobert continued, "As far as I know, the main reason why the six gods joined forces to kill the Night Emperor is that the Night Emperor was corrupted..."
Everyone was stunned: Gods can also be corrupted?
However, before everyone could think about it carefully, they heard Hobert say again: "There is a component of speculation in this, but this should be the main reason, because the six gods cannot attack the Night Emperor for no reason.
"Of course, it cannot be ruled out that the six gods did not want the Night Emperor to obtain more powerful power, because at that time, the six gods did not have as much pressure as they do now.
"Hehe, I know everyone has too many questions to ask, but I can only answer this much.
"Everyone may not be very clear, the six gods' churches still regard the pursuit of the Trunsoest family as a very high-priority task, which forces the descendants of the Trunsoest family, including me, to hide in areas where the power of the orthodox gods' churches is relatively weak.
"And the orthodox gods' churches do not pursue the descendants of the Solomon family or the Tudor family so urgently, but only pursue them when they encounter them.
"Of course, I am an exception, because I have to deal with some things in the Northern Continent, so I have been staying in the Northern Continent, and my identity has been well hidden.
"The reason why I mention this is because I recognize that the orthodox gods' churches suspect that the descendants of Trunsoest have also encountered the same corruption as the Night Emperor, so they are constantly pursuing them."
Audrey was a little worried for Hobert: "Didn't you explain to the church?"
Hobert spread his hands and smiled bitterly: "It's useless to explain many things, and I think the church may not be able to distinguish who among us has been corrupted, so it's better to kill them all!"
This reminded Klein behind the gray fog of the famous saying: Rather kill a thousand by mistake than let one go.
Then he thought: The church has no way to distinguish, do the gods also have no way? Or... is the Emperor telling us that the gods also have no effective way to distinguish this corruption, and they can only distinguish it after it has been corrupted to a certain extent and shows obvious abnormalities!
The more Klein thought about it, the more frightened he became: If you think about it carefully, the "Emperor" actually revealed a lot of information in what he just said! Gods can actually be corrupted! This is a bit unbelievable. We are all Beyonders, and it is common sense for Beyonders to be corrupted for various strange reasons. I just ignored this: That is a god! The top figures in this world! Why can they also be corrupted?
Alger was also more and more surprised as he thought about it: Even at the level of gods, it is inevitable to be corrupted? Who corrupted them? Could it be the evil gods who were jointly suppressed by the orthodox gods' churches?
He resisted the urge to look at the head of the bronze long table: It's possible! But a new question has arisen, how did the first evil god come about?
Cattleya, who also realized this problem, had similar questions to Klein: Can a god, or a god in a bad state, corrupt another god?
The other members had not fully turned the corner. They felt that Beyonders would accidentally encounter corruption, and gods might also have such troubles?
In short, the "Emperor" had declared in advance that he would not answer these questions, so everyone had to temporarily hide these questions in their hearts.
Hobert added: "That's roughly what happened to the Trunsoest Empire. Here I want to give away a piece of information.
"This question was actually mentioned before, which is the relevant information about the 'Trunsoest Empire' ship. My exploration with Mr. Hanged Man almost confirmed that the 'Trunsoest Empire' ship is real!
"But we didn't discuss it in detail at the time. According to the information I obtained in an adventure, the 'Empire' ship was built for the war with the Southern Continent.
"It should be somewhere in the 'Sonia Sea' now. If you have any news about it, you can contact me.
"That is the legacy of the Trunsoest Empire. As a descendant of the Trunsoest family, I may be able to approach it, or even have a chance to board it."
Alger was slightly stunned. He hadn't thought about this problem before.
At first, Alger only noticed that the "Emperor" was very concerned about the information on the "Empire" ship. Later, the "Emperor" told everyone that he was a descendant of Trunsoest, but Alger did not immediately make any associations.
Cattleya, who was at sea, was also more concerned about this matter: "I will pay attention to relevant information for you."
Klein, who was also at sea, also thought: Perhaps the 'Creator' can help the 'Emperor' control the 'Empire' ship! In that case, will the four kings of the sea become five kings? From today's diary, I just saw Roselle's process of using the 'Black King' ship to explore the abyss, but the diary didn't say how the 'Black King' ship was obtained. I don't know how much the 'Emperor' knows about this.
This transaction ended, everyone briefly savored the information they had obtained, and then the transaction session continued.
"The World" asked the "Emperor": "Do you still want those two Beyonder characteristics?"
He was referring to the Beyonder characteristics obtained in the hall where Kalvetua died before.
Hobert said readily: "Yes! The experiment was quite successful!"
It was very successful, and more Beyonder characteristics were obtained than expected.
"The World" nodded: "There is also a transaction. We talked about it before. I hope you can help me remove the corruption from an Beyonder characteristic, and please return that corruption to me."
Hobert nodded: "No problem, still according to the price I offered before, 3,000 pounds!"
In his opinion, this was indeed a lot of discount. He remembered that Klein originally traded a mystical item of the "Marauder" pathway from a poet classmate and "stole" the spiritual corruption of the True Creator, which seemed to have cost seven or eight thousand pounds.
"The World" nodded: "Deal."
Cattleya reminded: "As far as I know, the corruption in the characteristic is removed after it is removed, and it cannot be retained."
"Thank you for your reminder." Seeing that "The World" did not mean to explain, Hobert smiled and said, "I remember Mr. World said before that the corruption in that Beyonder characteristic is a bit special."
Cattleya was slightly stunned: How special? Could it be the corruption of the demigod level?
However, she just nodded and did not continue to discuss this issue.
Klein then manipulated "The World" and asked: "How much do you know about the 'Black King' ship?"
"I don't know much. I only know that it was once obtained by Emperor Roselle," Hobert said: "There are many speculations, but you should also have discovered that some of my speculations are also very valuable. If you want to know the inside story, you need to initiate a transaction."
Audrey and the other three ladies were very interested in this when they heard that it was related to the "celebrity" Emperor Roselle.
"The World" asked: "How much are you going to ask for?"
"3,000 pounds!"
"The World" was stunned: "So much!"
Hobert sighed: "Because talking about the 'Black King' ship will definitely talk about some information about Emperor Roselle, so it's worth the price."
As soon as he finished speaking, Cattleya immediately said: "I will join the transaction, and I can pay the reward separately!"
Audrey also said: "I will also join the transaction, and I will contribute at least 1,000 pounds!"
"Me too, me too!" Fors was also actively saying.
But the other members were not as gossipy as these three ladies... cough cough, not as curious as these three ladies.
"Little Sun" was not familiar with Emperor Roselle at all, and did not know that he was a legend in the Northern Continent.
Alger and Emlyn were simply not very interested, but Klein thought: I dare not say anything else, who knows Roselle better than me? I even know that "the taste of the witch is really good"!
However, in order to get news about the 'Black King' ship, Klein also contributed 300 pounds to join the transaction, instead of choosing to freeload like last time.
The second round of crowdfunding for this gathering was quickly completed, raising a total of 3,100 pounds.
Specifically, Cattleya 1,500 pounds, Audrey 1,000 pounds, "The World" and Fors each 300 pounds.
After Mr. Fool blocked the senses of the others, the transaction began.
"Let's start with the 'Black King' ship first," Hobert said: "Please don't be misled by some legends of treasures at sea.
"For example, the 'Empire' ship I just mentioned, there are legends at sea that it is a ship that the survivors of the Trunsoest Empire prepared to take all the treasures to leave the Northern Continent.
"I have seen the shipyard that built the 'Empire' ship. It is a super project, and it is not something that can be built with the energy and time when an empire is at the end of its rope.
"Similarly, I think the construction of the 'Black King' ship may also have its purpose. You must know that when the Black Emperor Solomon fell, he would not give his descendants time to board the ship and escape the Northern Continent.
"I believe the nobles of the Solomon Empire also know this, so I think the construction of the 'Black King' ship must not be for escape."
Hobert leaned back in his chair and suddenly asked with a smile: "Have you heard of the Western Continent?"
Cattleya replied: "Legend has it that there are not only the North and South Continents in this world, but also the East and West Continents.
"But this is just a legend. So far, no one has seen those two continents. I once suspected that the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' is the Eastern Continent, but I have not found any strong evidence."
"The World" interjected: "According to our previous discussion, the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' should undoubtedly be the Eastern Continent, but there are currently no clues about the Western Continent."
Audrey's eyes lit up with small star-like sparkles: "The New World!"
She was already imagining exploring the sea with Susie, overcoming pirates, storms, and giant waves to finally find the New World.
Fors was also starting to fantasize that one day, some strangely dressed people would arrive in the territory. After inquiring, she would learn that they were actually people from the Western Continent, and that the South Colson area was connected to the Western Continent by a 'Traveler's Gate'. From then on, the people of the North and South Continents would have contact with the West Continent.
As for why the West Continent people would come to them, it was simply because going to sea was too tiring for her.
Hobert continued, "Since the Eastern Continent exists, then the Western Continent should also exist.
"According to some information I've gathered, Emperor Roselle went to sea many times in his early years, initially seemingly to search for the Western Continent.
"It seems he didn't find it. Only after several voyages did he begin to sail south, eventually opening up safe sea routes to the Northern and Southern Continents."
His memory of this period was indeed somewhat vague, which was why he spoke so vaguely.
Cattelya frowned slightly: The Emperor once searched for the Western Continent? How did I not know that? I thought his initial goal was to open up new sea routes and colonize the Southern Continent.
"The World" really wanted to raise his hand: I can testify to this, because I saw it in the diary.
Audrey was somewhat fascinated: Hobert's information channels are very wide, he even knows about Emperor Roselle's early intelligence! But this is not surprising, because after the Emperor's death, many of his subordinates described the Emperor's past from various angles in their personal biographies. Hobert may have read the biographies or notes written by the subordinates who went to sea with the Emperor.
Fors recalled for a moment: I've never heard "Mr. Emperor" describe these things before, but it sounds like something the Emperor with countless legendary stories would do.
"One question is," Hobert said, "The Emperor's family was already in decline at that time, so why did he suddenly think of searching for the New World? Going to sea was very expensive back then, why was he so sure about spending money on it?
"According to ordinary people's thinking, if there is no certainty, one should not set off into the vast sea to search for a continent in mythological stories, right?"
Cattelya and the other three ladies nodded together, seeming to understand what "The Emperor" wanted to express.
Klein behind the gray fog: I have to say a few words about this. Roselle's thinking sometimes, he, he is indeed not very normal.
Hobert continued to deduce according to his logic: "If the Emperor first found the 'Black King' by chance, and then had the idea of exploring the New World, wouldn't this logic be much more reasonable?
"Further reasoning, did the Emperor obtain some information about the West Continent and the South Continent on the 'Black King', before deciding to go to sea to find opportunities?"
He certainly knew that Roselle's sailing had a lot to do with his thinking as a person from the AD era, but this point could not be stated clearly, and could only be clarified with seemingly rigorous logical reasoning.
This deduction made Klein couldn't help but sigh: There is also some truth to it, but I still doubt whether Roselle had a brain in his early years. For a time, he completely fell in love with the luxurious and decadent aristocratic life of Intis. And "The Emperor" may not know that Roselle had accumulated some wealth through "inventions" in his early years, so the cost of going to sea was not difficult for him to raise.
The three ladies were once again impressed by "The Emperor's" powerful logical deduction ability, and all felt that this order should be correct.
"Then let's ask further, why would the 'Black King' have relevant information about the West Continent and the South Continent?" Hobert smiled slightly: "Does this indicate that the 'Black King' went to sea many times during the Fourth Epoch under the support of the 'Black Emperor' Solomon, and carried out some secret exploration activities?
"Here, I want to talk about the previous transaction again. If my guesses are correct, was the 'Black King' going to sea Solomon looking for a way out for himself?
"Solomon knew that the Six Gods and the other two Emperors would definitely join forces to deal with him.
"And at that time, he broke with the True Creator and could not go to the East Continent.
"The South Continent at that time was the territory of the Underworld Emperor, so he organized manpower to search for the legendary West Continent, hoping to escape to the West Continent when the Solomon Empire was in crisis.
"As for the 'Black King' having relevant information about the South Continent, it may be that they accidentally entered the South Continent while searching for the West Continent."
For example, sailing south along a giant wall composed of gray fog, sooner or later they would reach the South Continent. Or there is no giant wall composed of gray fog at all, only a sea area covered by mist, and after coming out of that sea area, it is the South Continent.
In short, anything is possible on the sea of the extraordinary world.
Klein sighed: This forms a logical closed loop, "The Emperor's" logical reasoning ability is really strong! Is he really studying law? Oh, I forgot, this guy is a hateful 'lawyer'!
Audrey smiled and exclaimed, "This is a journey to explore historical mysteries!"
Cattelya and Fors also had similar feelings.
"The World" asked, "Then what do you know about the abilities of the 'Black King'?"
"I learned from a friend that there was a special construction or building method in the Fourth Epoch," Hobert said. The friend he was talking about was of course "Vice Admiral Iceberg":
"For example, when building a large building, they would ask the gods for blessings while building, which would make the building very strong and would not be damaged for thousands of years.
"In theory, buildings built in this way would have some characteristics of the gods who bestowed the blessings. For example, if you always pray to the Evernight Goddess, then the building may have the ability to hide itself.
"Since it is a ship of the Solomon Empire, and it is said to be huge, it is likely to be built using this construction technique. Perhaps Solomon would also specially bestow some special power to that ship.
"Then, theoretically, the 'Black King' at least possesses some 'distortion', 'corruption', and 'distortion' abilities of the 'Lawyer' pathway."
Klein behind the gray fog nodded slightly: If it has the abilities of "corruption" and "distortion", and "distorts" its own state, the "Black King" is entirely possible to sail in the "Abyss".
But Cattelya was more concerned: "How did the Emperor find the 'Black King'?"
Hobert smiled slightly: "Maybe this is what people call 'destiny', because later Roselle became the 'Black Emperor'."
Except for Cattelya, the other three people were shocked. Audrey immediately asked, "What 'Black Emperor'?"
Hobert: "It's the 'Black Emperor' that Solomon once became, or rather, Roselle is the second 'Black Emperor'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 505: The Madness of Emperor Roselle's Later Years
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Behind the gray fog, Klein immediately felt as if he had been slapped in the face: Wasn't Roselle a Beyonder of the "Savant" pathway? How did he later become the "Black Emperor"? This is too outrageous... But upon closer thought, given Roselle's demonstrated way of thinking, it wasn't impossible.
At this time, Klein had not yet read the relevant diary entries where Roselle resolved to become the "Black Emperor."
Cattelya stared at "The Emperor": Few people know these hidden secrets. How would he know them? And why is his tone so certain?
Fors covered her mouth in surprise: "The Great Emperor became the 'Black Emperor'?"
She had read so many autobiographies about Roselle, how come no one ever mentioned this? Could it be that the Great Emperor suddenly declared himself emperor and changed the republic to an empire because he became the "Black Emperor."
Finally, she exclaimed: I never imagined that in the Fifth Epoch, just over a hundred years ago, so many secret events occurred.
Audrey also briefly lost emotional control, but as an Spectator member, she quickly regained control of her emotions: "Mr. Emperor, when did Emperor Roselle become the 'Black Emperor'? Some of the biographies I've seen suggest that he was a member of the Church of Steam and Machinery. His, his pathway..."
Hobert smiled: "Just as you imagined, Emperor Roselle jumped to a non-adjacent pathway."
"He did this because the pathway he was on, as well as the adjacent pathways, already had True Gods, or were occupied by beings suspected of being True Gods."
"If he wanted to become a god, he had no choice but to do so."
Klein immediately thought: So that's how it is! No wonder historical records say that Roselle went mad in his later years. I thought it was like those powerful emperors in my memory, who would go crazy in their later years. I thought "mad" was just an adjective, but now it seems that it might have been stating a fact.
Fors thought of the "Blood Emperor" mentioned at the previous gathering: "Does that mean it's true that Emperor Roselle went mad in his later years? In that case, wouldn't he be in a similar state to the 'Blood Emperor'?"
Hobert nodded: "Perhaps he got his inspiration from the 'Blood Emperor'…"
Klein was slightly stunned: I do have some impression of this. Roselle seemed to have talked about the "Blood Emperor" with Mr. "Door" before, and Roselle also claimed to have been inspired. But that diary entry was incomplete and didn't explain what kind of inspiration he received. Now it seems, it was inspiration on how to become a god!
Then he thought: No wonder Roselle complained in his diary that for a Beyonder, having a True God in their pathway is a huge disaster. It means that no matter how hard you try, you can't become a True God. I suddenly understand Roselle's despair a little.
"…Don't you all think that the 'Blood Emperor' doesn't care at all about his madness after becoming a god?" Hobert smiled: "In fact, there is a chance to regain sanity after becoming a god by jumping to a non-adjacent pathway."
Cattelya immediately asked: "How to recover?"
"Have children."
If someone else had said this, Cattelya would have thought the other party was joking, or a villain who liked to tell dirty jokes.
But when "The Emperor" said this, and his expression looked very serious, Cattelya nodded slightly and said: "I understand."
Hobert saw that Audrey and Fors hadn't understood, so he explained to them: "Let's use the 'Blood Emperor' as an example. Theoretically speaking, the reason why the 'Blood Emperor' is in a semi-mad state is that his original 'Black Emperor' pathway characteristics conflict with the 'Hunter' pathway characteristics he just consumed, so he exhibits a semi-mad state."
"Then, theoretically speaking, if the 'Blood Emperor' successfully expels all the 'Black Emperor' pathway characteristics from his body, the conflict of Beyonder characteristics will disappear, and the 'Blood Emperor' will also become normal."
"But this process is uncontrollable. You can only rely on probability to expel the excess Beyonder characteristics from the body, and there is a considerable probability that you will also expel some 'Hunter' pathway Beyonder characteristics, but there is still a chance to become normal in the future."
Audrey understood: "So, Emperor Roselle used this opportunity to become a god, just to one day become a normal god? It's a pity that he, no, He failed."
This is completely different from the mysterious and ambitious Emperor Roselle in her impression.
Hobert smiled: "Not necessarily."
He asked: "Does everyone remember the special characteristics after becoming the 'Black Emperor'?"
Before anyone could answer, he answered himself: "We said before that the 'Black Emperor' has the characteristic of being able to resurrect."
"This pathway is somewhat special. Theoretically speaking, this is equivalent to a filtering process. After the Great Emperor is resurrected, only the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Black Emperor' pathway can return, and he will become a normal 'Black Emperor'."
Reminded by "The Emperor", everyone thought of this.
Klein immediately recalled: I remember when Roselle described the process of making the 'Blasphemy Cards' in his diary, Roselle said that if his plan failed, these 'Blasphemy Cards' would be the greatest reliance he left to his children. Perhaps letting himself die once was Roselle's plan?
Audrey was very surprised: Could it be that the Great Emperor did not truly fall? Yes, he must not have fallen!
Fors was surprised: Is that how the power of gods is used?
Then the two of them thought of the "Creator" at the same time: Could that be the resurrected Emperor Roselle?
Cattelya simply asked: "Is all of this, including the fall, the Great Emperor's plan? Then now, has the Great Emperor been resurrected?"
Hobert spread his hands: "I don't know about that, but I think Emperor Roselle should have some plans for this."
He explained casually: "The reason I know this is because I understand the situation of the 'Black Emperor' pathway better, but I have no way to understand the specific plans of Emperor Roselle."
"So the above answers, except that I can confirm that Emperor Roselle did become the 'Black Emperor', are basically my guesses."
This time Hobert lied, because he guaranteed the accuracy of all the above information.
Klein nodded secretly: It's already amazing to be able to make so many seemingly logical guesses through these clues. I remember only seeing one diary entry of Roselle mentioning the "Creator". I don't know if Roselle had more close contact with the "Creator" later?
Before Klein had time to think about this question, he heard "The Emperor" continue: "In addition, I can also be sure that the Beyonder characteristics and Uniqueness that Emperor Roselle obtained to become the 'Black Emperor' came from the Twilight Hermit Order and were provided by Adam!"
Cattelya was surprised again: "That 'King of Angels' Adam?"
Others were also surprised to varying degrees, but they soon vaguely guessed Adam's purpose.
Hobert directly explained Adam's purpose: "Yes! I guess that Adam invited Emperor Roselle to join the Twilight Hermit Order in order to use the 'trend of times' created by the Great Emperor to advance."
"But Emperor Roselle did not develop according to the script set by Adam, and because Adam lacked a Sequence 1 characteristic at that time, Adam failed to become a god that time."
Cattelya didn't expect: The Great Emperor was once a member of the Twilight Hermit Order!
And Audrey recalled: I remember the Emperor mentioned this information, and Hermes! Hermes also seems to be a member of this organization.
Klein thought of some information that "The Emperor" announced after the Backlund smog event. He manipulated "The World" and asked: "So Adam approached the Loen royal family again?"
"That's right," Hobert smiled: "George III seems to be easier to control than the Great Emperor."
He added: "There is also such a rule for the resurrection of the 'Black Emperor': When Roselle becomes the 'Black Emperor', it means that Solomon has completely fallen."
Cattelya, who had not yet joined the Tarot Club at that time, asked with half-guessing and half-affirmation: "Now Adam is preparing to let George III become the 'Black Emperor'? I remember the King of Loen seems to be only a Sequence 5."
Hobert smiled: "Emperor Roselle wasn't even a Beyonder of the 'Black Emperor' pathway! Didn't Adam still approach him?"
"Why did I say before that even if Trunsoest is not ready to become the 'Black Emperor', the Six Gods can use their authority to help Him get ready?"
"That's because in the eyes of a god, the requirements and preparations for becoming a god are not that difficult."
"Even the 'King of Angels' Adam can use his authority to do many things."
Cattelya suddenly realized: "Oh no! Then the Great Emperor... then the 'Creator'…"
Although she didn't say it too clearly, everyone understood what she meant: If George III becomes the 'Black Emperor', Roselle will completely fall. And the 'Creator' is obviously not the resurrected Roselle, because if the Great Emperor was resurrected, then according to the information previously announced by the "Emperor", there cannot be a second True God in the "Black Emperor" pathway.
Audrey noticed: Miss Hermit seems to care a lot about Emperor Roselle's information! Although I am also full of curiosity about the Great Emperor, I am not as excited as she is.
Fors was completely sighing about another thing: I didn't expect that so many secrets were hidden behind such familiar historical events. I don't know why, but I suddenly feel that this matter is very far away from me, and it's also a bit unreal... Alas, I'm just a Sequence 8 now, and although the potion is about to be completely digested, I'm still just a Sequence 8, but I know so many secrets, is this really good?
Then she asked herself and answered: Okay, this feeling seems pretty good too.
After a brief surprise, Cattelya completely fell into panic. Since she learned for sure in the Tarot Club that the Great Emperor could be resurrected, she had always held hope for this.
But this hope was also extinguished in the Tarot Club.
Hobert saw Cattelya's worries. He joked in his heart: Is this what is called doting on grandchildren?
After a slight smile, Hobert said to Cattelya: "Hermit, although I don't know why you are so worried, I want to tell you that the 'Creator' will not sit idly by and let such a thing happen."
That's right, because the "Creator" wants to become the Black Emperor, George III will not succeed.
As for Emperor Roselle, let's talk about this later. After he becomes the King of Angels and waits for the Fool to become half a Great Old One, Hobert believes that this problem may be solved.
Hobert can't let go of the opportunity to become the "Black Emperor", but he can find a way to save Roselle's life.
Now Hobert still doesn't know what the Fool can do after becoming a god, and he doesn't know if there are any loopholes that can be exploited, so he can only take it one step at a time.
The "Emperor's" comfort did not reduce Cattelya's worries, but it made her realize her previous gaffe.
Immediately, she thanked the "Emperor" and restrained her emotions.
After this transaction, Audrey and Fors had the same shocking feeling as the previous gathering. Now, when they trade information about the behind-the-scenes of the Trunsoest Empire, they no longer have any feelings, they just feel that they have satisfied their curiosity. It's different from the feeling of going back to savor for a long time after each Tarot Club meeting.
It has to be said that some information about Roselle once again subverted the cognition of the two ladies, enough for them to savor for a long time after the Tarot Club meeting.
Even Klein, who claimed that no one knew Emperor Roselle better than himself, gained a lot.
Even Cattelya, who thought she knew many secrets of Emperor Roselle, also admired the "Emperor's" logic and reasoning.
In her opinion, the information about Emperor Roselle is like the speculation about the "Black Throne", the Emperor knows some clues and infers the whole picture from it!
Alger, "The Hanged Man", saw that everyone's emotions were heavy. He suspected that he had missed some key information?
He shook his head slightly and put this matter behind him, and started a new transaction with "The Emperor": "I hope to rent your mystical item with the 'travel' ability. I want to go to the island we explored together to hunt some Beyonder creatures."
Alger recently had time and opportunity, so he prepared to hunt some Beyonder ingredients to earn some extra money.
"No problem." Hobert smiled: "By the way, a friend of mine just got a mystical item with the 'travel' ability. Are you interested in buying it? Well, the negative effects are not big."
Hobert didn't plan to auction this kind of magical item with scarce and highly sought-after characteristics in the auction center, but he could sell it to the members of the Tarot Club to improve the strength of his allies.
Alger was about to nod, but he finally smiled and said: "I'll just rent it."
No need to ask, it must not be cheap. After he collects the Sequence 5 potion formula and Beyonder characteristics, he will consider this type of magical item.
Hobert nodded: "No problem, 100 pounds, no more than three days."
Alger: "Deal."
Cattelya asked: "Mr. Emperor, what are the abilities and negative effects of the magical item you mentioned? How much do you plan to sell it for?"
"The abilities are only 'travel' and 'opening doors'." Hobert said: "The negative effects are: the holder is prone to getting lost when entering the spirit world, but after trying up to three times, they will find their target; also, the holder is prone to being late."
After sealing it with "Nation of Disorder", the negative effects are much smaller.
Hobert added: "As for the price, 12,000 pounds!"
This is indeed a significant discount, considering that a single 'Traveler' characteristic often sells for this price.
The previous transaction with Alger was due to the sealed artifact formed from the 'Traveler' characteristic being unusable, resulting in a transaction price of less than 10,000 pounds.
Cattleya: "I'll consider it."
Even for a pirate admiral, over ten thousand pounds is not a small sum.

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 506 Bernadette Visits Jeffrey Town
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The trade of magical items with "travel" capabilities initiated by Hobert ultimately failed to find a suitable buyer.
Audrey originally had the idea of purchasing it, but she had recently traded for a lot of intelligence, and she couldn't come up with that much money at the moment.
She could ask her father to reimburse her for a portion, but then she thought that if she disappeared from her room for twenty or thirty minutes, it would most likely be discovered by the maids, which would be very troublesome.
In the end, she convinced herself: it's better to save the money to buy a mystical item that can change her appearance.
The others didn't have such a large sum of money, so the trade ultimately didn't happen.
Then "The World" requested a private conversation with the Hermit, and Hobert, thinking of Klein's previous transaction with him to remove the corruption of Beyonder characteristics, guessed that Klein was contacting the Hermit to prepare for entering the eastern part of the Sonia Sea.
That is to say, Klein is about to advance to Sequence 5!
After the two people's private conversation ended, the Tarot Gathering entered the free exchange session.
Audrey said first: "I received a message that the vault of Barclays Bank was robbed of more than 50,000 pounds in cash three days ago!
"This is already the fourth case of a large amount of cash being stolen in the last half month, with a total loss of about 160,000 pounds!"
Emlyn exclaimed: "This series of thefts hasn't been solved yet? Good heavens, 160,000 pounds! I wonder when the robbers will spend so much cash?"
If he had such a sum of money, he would definitely buy all the dolls he liked... no, he would definitely buy a doll-making factory! And buy a large showroom filled with dolls and the clothes they would wear on different occasions!
"According to the information I received," Audrey, who also got the news from the Bishop of Backlund, said: "This is definitely a case involving Beyonders. It is said that a Beyonder called a 'Wraith' is a major suspect, but unfortunately, no specific suspect has been identified yet."
Hobert and Klein were both stunned. Hobert thought: Could this be the source of the payment I received? Is this the method Miss Sharron mentioned for raising money? No wonder she said that as long as they had time, money wouldn't be a problem. I naively thought it was the time for them to sell their assets!
Klein thought: Speaking of 'Wraith,' I only know Miss Sharron. When 'The Emperor' asked for Miss Sharron's contact information some time ago, I guessed that 'The Emperor,' in addition to forming an alliance with the Temperance faction, would also deal with the spoils of war from the Southern Continent, which should contain a large number of Beyonder characteristics. Could it be that Miss Sharron is continuously committing crimes to buy those Beyonder characteristics?
Cattleya said: "'Wraith' is a Sequence 5 of the 'Prisoner' pathway. Beyonders at this level can, to a certain extent, do whatever they want.
"But even so, very few Sequence 5 Beyonders commit crimes like this continuously, because it is very easy to be targeted by the elite squad of official Beyonders, and being caught is only a matter of time."
Audrey nodded: "I hope the case can be solved as soon as possible and the criminals brought to justice."
Hobert thought: I hope the case will never be solved, after all, the stolen money is still with me. Uh, or rather, whether the case is solved or not doesn't matter to me, but don't think about recovering the stolen money.
After finishing the discussion of this matter, Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.
Above the gray mist, after finishing the members' sacrifices and bestowals, Klein returned to the real world, turned on the faucet, and splashed the cold tap water on his face, making him completely awake.
After savoring the information obtained at the Tarot Gathering and resting for a while, Klein decided to volunteer at the hospital for a period of time to find an opportunity to act as a "Faceless."
More than half an hour later, he pushed open the door and entered the "Oravi Medical Relief Foundation," which is a charitable organization with the background of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, and one of its responsibilities is to provide trained volunteers to various hospitals.
Arriving at the registration desk, Klein saw a female staff member flipping through a newspaper, so he lightly knocked on the table.
"What is it?" the lady asked, putting down the newspaper.
"I want to volunteer."
The lady looked up at Klein: "Name..."
After clearly seeing the appearance of the person in front of her, her eyes froze, and the pen she had just picked up fell to the ground with a "clatter."
The newspaper in front of her happened to have a portrait, and that portrait was of the crazy and dangerous adventurer Gehrman Sparrow.
The lady in her thirties trembled and said, "You, you want to volunteer?"
"Yes."
Klein didn't expect that Gehrman Sparrow was already so famous!
"But, but you are an adventurer!"
Forget it, I'll change my face and clothes later and come back. Klein asked expressionlessly: "Who stipulates that adventurers can't volunteer?"
The lady had an expression as if she was about to cry and blurted out: "Not me!"
"Sorry, I don't want to volunteer anymore." After saying that, Klein quickly left.
The lady in charge of registration breathed a long sigh of relief. She quietly drew a crimson moon on her chest: Goddess, how could such a dangerous guy come to volunteer? I had already decided to hand over the form filled out by Gehrman Sparrow to the police station.
...
Feynapotter Kingdom, west bank of Full Moon Lake.
On the altar in front of Hobert, there were three Beyonder characteristics that were obviously a little abnormal.
Two of them emitted a blue light, which Hobert had spent 7,000 pounds to collect, two Beyonder characteristics taken from the death hall of Kalvetua.
There was also one that looked like a viscous liquid mixed with black, which was the "Marionettist" Beyonder characteristic that Klein had entrusted to be processed.
The fee for processing the Beyonder characteristics was 3,000 pounds. Hobert's earnings from selling intelligence at this gathering were 6,600 pounds and two Beyonder ingredients.
With this addition and subtraction, Hobert also received 2,600 pounds in cash.
With that 150,000-pound transaction, Hobert didn't really care about these few thousand pounds in cash.
After waiting for a while, Hobert sacrificed the three Beyonder characteristics and cash to the "Nation of Disorder." After sitting on the Iron Throne, Hobert first summoned the "Marionettist" Beyonder characteristic.
According to past experience, he crushed this Beyonder characteristic. At the same time as the Beyonder characteristic was crushed, a force with a viscous feeling appeared in the "Power of Disorder."
Hobert summoned a stone from the "Nation of Disorder" and attached this force to the stone shaped like a round cake.
The colorful granite suddenly became pitch black and shiny, eventually becoming like a piece of black jade.
Using the authority of the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert learned the specific usage of this black jade. It contained the rapping of the "True Creator." If you were to touch it in the real world without taking any protective measures, you would be immediately affected by the rapping, and Beyonders below the demigod level would lose control in three to six seconds.
This was different from the "Blessing of the Abyss" that Farbauti had previously "extracted" for Hobert personally. The whispers of the True Creator were more like a broadcast of Beyonder powers.
Hobert reached out and summoned another piece of granite, covering half of the round black jade. As long as you held the granite side, you could use the black jade to attack actively.
The number of active attacks was three. After three times, the whispers of the "True Creator" would be transferred to three different targets.
This was equivalent to dividing the whispers into three, but it could still easily cause "low-sequence" Beyonders to lose control.
The whispers had only been divided, but the overall power had not weakened. It would take a long, long time for the whispers emitted by this evil god to weaken.
Then Hobert followed the previous method, crushing the two Beyonder characteristics of the "Sailor" pathway and making detailed distinctions. Finally, he obtained 3 "Wind Blessed," 4 "Seafarer," 3 "Folk of Rage," and 2 "Sailor" Beyonder characteristics.
During this period, the "Marionettist" Beyonder characteristic had re-condensed. In order to prevent Klein from having a burden when taking the potion, Hobert only brought the "Marionettist" Beyonder characteristic and the black jade to the real world.
As for the four Beyonder characteristics such as "Faceless," Hobert left them in the "Nation of Disorder."
That's right, all of this was for Klein's sake.
Then Hobert thought happily: Should I write to Leonard and discuss selling the "Seer" Beyonder characteristic?
It wasn't until the evening that Hobert re-sacrificed the Beyonder characteristics and the black jade to "The Fool."
The next morning, Hobert summoned his three students again, inquired about their recent work, and then gave Selena and Dennis the opportunity to become Beyonders.
Selena chose to become an "Apprentice." Hobert didn't mention again that the potion formula for this pathway was incomplete, because after Fors reached Sequence, Selena would most likely reach Sequence as well.
Moreover, "Apprentice" was very suitable for Selena's current identity and she should be able to digest the potion quickly.
Dennis chose Hobert's pathway without hesitation, so Hobert had a requirement for him: to learn Loenese on his own.
After he could communicate fluently with Selena and Freya, Hobert would send him to a law firm in Backlund to digest the potion.
Then Hobert told them that he was going back to Jeffery Town and announced the way to summon his messenger, so that they could contact him with the messenger if they needed anything.
Hobert planned to let them experience here for a period of time before calling them back.
After explaining some official matters, Hobert left the west bank with soldiers such as Seal and returned to Jeffery Town.
After hearing the news, Fors came to the gate of the Lord's Mansion to greet him.
Today she wore a light yellow dress, and her clothes were indeed much lighter than the last time they met.
Hobert jumped off his horse and opened his arms: "My beautiful lady, have you missed me in the past week!
Because there were many servants around, Fors was embarrassed to say anything, but smiled and looked at Hobert with a slightly blushing face.
Donna on the side said with a smile: "We all understand, this means 'I missed you!'"
Hobert smiled and hugged Fors, kissed her on the cheek, and then pulled her back to the Lord's Mansion.
As soon as the group arrived at the study and said a few words, Allen came in to report: "Lord, Madam, Knight Donna, the King's envoy has arrived."
Hobert was stunned: "The King's envoy?"
He thought, did the envoy go to the wrong place? He, Hobert, didn't seem to be very familiar with the King. On the contrary, Teuton on the other side often went to the King to inform.
Allen affirmed again, "Yes, the King's envoy."
Only then did Hobert change into the noble attire of a Baron and come to the main hall to receive the envoy.
The envoy, with a cold face, entered the main hall and proclaimed, "In the name of the King!"
As he spoke, he opened an exquisite wooden box and took out a roll of parchment with a wax seal.
Hobert was slightly stunned and quickly knelt on one knee before the envoy.
The envoy proclaimed, "Order: Baron Hobert Jeffery, must arrive at the Alhambra Palace on the morning of March 5th to attend the National Day celebration banquet!"
Hobert was taken aback. The King wants me to attend a banquet?
Then, he suddenly recalled his conversation with Christian and realized that this banquet was not simple.
After finishing the proclamation, the envoy handed the roll of parchment to Hobert: "Baron, please rise. We shall meet in Feynapotter City!"
With that, the envoy was about to leave.
Hobert quickly stood up and smiled, "Envoy, sir, please stay for lunch before you leave."
"No, thank you," the envoy said. "I still need to proclaim the order to other nobles and officials."
Watching the envoy leave, Hobert felt the parchment in his hand suddenly become heavy: "Some arrangements need to be brought forward."
He said to Allen, who was beside him, "Go and invite Bishop Simpson to come here."
Allen said, "My lord, Bishop Simpson returned to Feynapotter City two days ago to report on his duties."
Hobert was slightly stunned before saying, "I understand."
"Well, go and prepare. Tomorrow, I will inspect the territory newly conferred upon me by the King."
"Yes, sir."
Returning to his study, Hobert found that Fors and Donna were both busy with their own affairs. He was about to have Archibald outside the door call for Seer when he suddenly felt something and looked towards the bedroom.
As if sensing something, he pushed open the door to his room and saw a lady sitting on a chair. She had waist-length chestnut hair and a very well-proportioned figure, neither fat nor thin.
She was wearing a white Intis-style shirt, paired with a dark jacket, a knee-length gray skirt, and a pair of long leather boots.
This heroic lady was casually flipping through a magazine with her legs crossed.
"Bernadette!" Hobert said with a smile, "No, it's the Queen Mystic!"
He thought: Others come to me in the study, or directly and openly have the butler report it. You're good, you directly appear in the bedroom? At least you should knock, right? Otherwise, it's easy to be misunderstood!
Bernadette smiled faintly, "I didn't expect you to become a Baron in this way, nor did I expect you to get married so quickly."
"Yes, I'm married. You don't have a chance," Hobert said with a grin, as if retaliating.
He clearly remembered being called naive by this little girl.
Bernadette put down the magazine, "It seems that married life has enlightened you."
As she said this, her eyes suddenly became deeper, a depth that was fleeting: "I heard that your place is a scenic spot? Won't you invite me to take a stroll around your territory?"
Hobert reached out his hand, "Please."
Archibald at the door was slightly stunned when he saw the two people coming out together, followed by five male servants.
Bernadette glanced at the male servants casually, and finally accurately looked at Archibald's true form.
This made Archibald slightly stunned and subconsciously slowed down two steps, giving Baron Hobert and this mysterious and powerful lady enough space.
Hobert introduced in a natural tone, "This is the former Lord's Manor of a Viscount, but it has been abandoned for several years. I spent a lot of effort to complete the renovation."
"There are a total of eight courtyards. That side is the front yard..."
Just as they arrived at the front yard, Donna happened to return from outside and saw Hobert strolling with a lady who was particularly well-dressed, yet very elegant and beautiful.
This lady's aura reminded Donna of Princess Ethel she had met before. She couldn't quite explain what that feeling was, but she looked very powerful at first glance.
"Hobert!" Donna greeted him. "Who is this beautiful guest?"
Hobert opened his mouth, but suddenly didn't know how to introduce Bernadette. Queen? It's okay to call her that in private, but it seems a bit obsequious to call her that in front of others.
Princess? Uh, she hasn't been a princess for many years, she has been a "Big Sister" for many years!
Finally, Hobert said, "Bernadette."
Donna greeted, "Miss Bernadette, hello. You have such a wonderful aura!"
Bernadette smiled, "You are also very lovely."
Hobert didn't want Donna to get involved, so he waved his hand at her, "Go and do your work."
Donna pouted, "Why are you always playing around? You only know how to force me to work!"
After they separated, Donna suddenly remembered: I saw Miss Bernadette in Backlund! In that Intis-style restaurant! Hobert even went up to chat with her. Hehe, luckily my sister-in-law wasn't there at the time.
Hobert took Bernadette to the train station at the pier, but the train would not depart again for another four or five hours.
This was when the privileges of the lord were displayed. With Hobert's order, the boiler was quickly fired up, and after waiting for more than ten minutes, the train started.
However, this time, besides the train driver, there were only Hobert and Bernadette on the train.
The two first sat down in the noble's compartment, but Bernadette felt that the view here was not good enough, so Hobert took her to the end of the train, to that small grandstand.
Hobert began to point out the landscape again, except this time the person next to him was not Fors, and he didn't put his arm around her waist: "This area used to be a reed marsh. You probably can't imagine how desolate it was back then."
"Now, the functional organs of the town have been built here. That's the town government, that's the post office and telegraph office, and further over there are the security bureau, the tax bureau, and the court. The staff have now officially moved in and started working."
After more than half a month of finishing construction and decoration, the functional organs of the town have begun to operate normally, but the flowers and plants that have just been planted in the yards of these buildings have not yet grown, and they look a bit bare.
Bernadette listened quietly to Hobert's brief description, quietly looking at these brand-new buildings, her expression becoming gentle.
Woo~
The train began to climb uphill, and gradually you could see the scattered old town area, and the new Jeffery Town area under construction.
"The hospital and school are basically completed," Hobert continued to introduce. "The hospital can be put into use next month, and the school will be later, probably in April."
"The plaza, commercial area, and residential area are also being built as soon as possible, but I estimate that it will still take two months to complete, which should be in time for this year's summer tourist season."
Bernadette suddenly asked, "Where did you get so much money?"
As the leader of the "Element Dawn," she was quite aware of the construction costs.
Hobert smiled, "All thanks to the help of my family."
Bernadette shook her head, looking at the crowded construction site, "If it really was your father's funding, you wouldn't have that sense of pride when introducing all of this."
Looking at the territory that was completely different from when he first arrived, Hobert held the handrail with one hand and said, "Maybe it's because my skin is thicker."
Speaking of which, Hobert and Bernadette's relationship was not particularly close, but in Hobert's impression, the "Queen Mystic" in front of him was quite special.
Although Hobert looked like he was entertaining Bernadette as an old friend, Hobert naturally wouldn't tell the truth when it came to financial and other non-public issues.
Arriving at the mountain, it was a pastoral scene. The spring planting had already been completed, and the seedlings of the crops had grown to the height of a calf!
The farmland was full of people, who were diligently weeding. Many people were doing farm work while talking loudly. You could clearly hear joy and hope in their voices.
"The farmers here are very motivated," Bernadette concluded.
"Yes, maybe it has something to do with my abolishing the agricultural tax," Hobert said, sighing at the difference between the farmland on the east and west banks of Full Moon Lake. Although there were also many people in the farmland on the west bank, they all looked sad and gloomy, like Zombies, with no enthusiasm for the land and crops under their feet.
Bernadette glanced at Hobert, "A landed aristocrat who voluntarily abolished the agricultural tax."
"That's right, you don't care about that little bit of grain income. You have higher ambitions."
Hobert just smiled faintly.
The train reached the highest point. Hobert and Bernadette got off the train, and the two walked to climb the highest peak.
The entire hillside was uniformly planted with knee-high grass by Hobert. In the middle of the thick grass, there was a path more than one meter wide paved with gravel. On both sides of the road were wooden handrails without bark, separating the grass and the path.
The spring breeze blew, and the grass rose and fell like waves, and the air was full of the scent of grass.
At the top of the mountain were some wooden benches. Hobert invited Bernadette to sit on the bench. The scenery in front of her made the knowledgeable "Queen Mystic" feel physically and mentally happy.
Full Moon Lake was already very far away from here, and the entire lake surface was in sight. You could even see half of the South Colson mountainous area from here.
There was a sparkling lake surface in the mountains, which was originally pleasing to the eye. At this time, it was also the time when vegetation was growing wildly. As far as the eye could see, it was all pleasing green.
There were also towns and villages dotted along the lake shore, and the surrounding mountains, magnificent and full of vitality, made people feel that their distance from nature had become very close.
The two looked at the scenery in front of them quietly for a few minutes, and then Hobert suddenly said, "This beautiful scenery is very suitable for heart-to-heart talks. Tell me, what are you here for?"
Bernadette leaned on the back of the chair, "I heard some news about the 'Creator'. It reminded me of asking you to say hello to the 'Creator' before. Did you deliver it?"
