chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 507 Fors’ Request
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert had guessed that Bernadette was coming to ask about this matter, and at the same time, he also guessed that Bernadette believed the "Creator" was her resurrected old father.
"The great 'Creator' told me some things about the 'Black Emperor'." Hobert still decided: I'm not acknowledging this daughter.
The reason was simple. Bernadette could easily expose him. If, in a fit of anger, she did something like kill a servant of the "Creator" to vent her hatred, Hobert would be the one to suffer.
Even if Bernadette considered the power of the "Creator" and wouldn't retaliate, the "Creator's" reputation would still be at risk of being tarnished.
So, Hobert simply stated the matter clearly this time: "I only just learned that the 'Queen Mystic' is actually Emperor Roselle's daughter..."
Hope involuntarily flickered in Bernadette's eyes.
"But the 'Creator' told me that you guessed wrong. He is not the resurrected Roselle!" Hobert said decisively.
Only when her father was mentioned would Bernadette, the leader of the "Element Dawn," show such obvious emotional fluctuations. She couldn't help but feel somewhat disappointed, but then she asked, "Does the 'Creator' know where my father is now?"
Hobert said, "The 'Creator' didn't say. He only said that your father was affected by some kind of corruption in his later years."
Bernadette suddenly turned around, exuding an extremely oppressive aura. She stared intently at Hobert: "What kind?"
"The great 'Creator' said that even knowing the source of that corruption, even for angels and below, would result in the same corruption," Hobert said. Although he had sealed away the relevant memories, he still remembered the precautions.
Bernadette was clearly encountering this kind of information for the first time. After a brief shock, she quickly returned to normal and leaned back in her chair: "How should I thank the 'Creator'?"
Of course, she knew that such an important reminder must have a price tag attached.
"When I need you to thank me, I will take the initiative to find you," Hobert said. This time, he didn't borrow the "Lamp Genie."
Borrowing the "Lamp Genie" now wouldn't seem out of place. After all, the "Creator" understood the situation of the "Black Emperor" pathway so well, it was equivalent to telling Bernadette: I am a god of that pathway or a neighboring pathway!
His knowledge of the "Lamp Genie's" existence wouldn't surprise Bernadette.
But borrowing the "Lamp Genie" now would be useless. Hobert was just a Sequence 5. Apart from looking a bit like a god in certain areas, such as shattering Beyonder characteristics, he was just a "Mid-Sequence" Beyonder being at this time.
If he encountered a being like the "Lamp Genie," he would be seen through immediately.
It would be better to wait until he was stronger before borrowing from Bernadette.
Bernadette nodded slightly, saying nothing more, staring blankly at the beautiful scenery before her.
After a while, she said, "What a wonderful place. A good place to keep all bad moods away from me."
Hobert smiled and said, "You can come whenever you want in the future.
"Especially when you're tired. I'll tidy up a courtyard for you in the lord's mansion. You can stay as long as you want.
"If you don't want that much trouble, do you see the construction site over there? The hotel there will be completed in another month or two, and there's also the villa area over there. Several buildings are ready to move into now."
Bernadette took a deep breath: "I'll come to rest for a few days in the summer, but I won't notify you at that time."
Hobert smiled: "No problem. If you're not well taken care of anywhere, you can come to me to complain."
After discussing serious matters, the conversation between the two became more casual than before. They got up and chatted as they walked down the mountain.
The train was waiting on the other side of the mountain. After Hobert and Bernadette boarded, the train slowly started again.
Bernadette saw some buildings on the back of the mountain, one of which looked very grand and already had doors and windows installed, looking like it had been completely renovated.
"That side will be a large entertainment center in the future," Hobert continued to be the tour guide for this trip. "The auction center that has already been built is specifically for auctioning extraordinary items. After the auction, there will also be gatherings for Beyonders. If you have time, you can come and see if there's anything you need."
Bernadette asked, "Are the auctions held regularly?"
"There are small auctions on the 5th, 15th, and 25th of each month, and a large auction on the 29th of each month," Hobert very much hoped that a big figure like Bernadette in the extraordinary world could participate.
Bernadette nodded: "At midnight on the 28th, you can put the auction information on the wooden chair on the top of the mountain. If there's anything I need, I'll participate."
"Okay!" Hobert thought to himself, as expected of the "Queen Mystic"! The way she obtains information is mysterious enough!
He simply guessed that Bernadette had probably marked the location of the wooden chair on the top of the mountain so she could send her mysterious servant to take away the auction materials.
After taking a train ride around the territory, Bernadette seemed to be in a good mood. Hobert then strolled around the lake with Bernadette.
Hobert had Archibald prepare the grill, charcoal, and other items, then boarded a modified wooden boat and hired someone to row to the lake to fish.
These wooden boats were originally used by the people in the territory for travel, but now that Hobert provided steam passenger ships, these wooden boats were almost useless.
Decades ago, there were fishermen around Full Moon Lake. Later, after monsters appeared in the lake, no one dared to go into the water to fish anymore.
It had been abandoned for decades, and now no one knew how to fish anymore.
The key was that there were still some large fish and beasts in the underwater forest. Although they didn't dare to go ashore, the fish in the lake were only enough for their food. Even if they wanted to fish, they couldn't catch anything.
Based on the principle of not wasting anything, Hobert modified these wooden boats that everyone didn't use anymore. Most of them were converted into small cargo ships, and one was converted into a small boat for fishing. Hobert planned to go to the lake to fish in the summer to cultivate his sentiments.
At this time, this boat was used to entertain Bernadette. The two leisurely talked about some interesting stories of the mystical world, enjoying a rare moment of peace.
Looking at the beautiful rivers and mountains around them, even though Full Moon Lake was still in full view just now, in the blink of an eye, the two were already boating on Full Moon Lake.
Even these two Beyonders on the boat felt that nature was truly amazing.
During the conversation, Hobert realized that Bernadette's knowledge reserves were quite amazing. She was aware of most of the information that Hobert had released in the Tarot Club so far.
On the other hand, just as Cattleya admired Hobert's meticulous logic, Hobert's views on some events also gave Bernadette a similar feeling.
Archibald, who boarded the ship with them, listened very carefully. Only now did he realize that Hobert was actually someone who could talk about ancient and modern events with a big figure in the extraordinary world.
How could an ordinary Sequence 5 have such a level? He thought this was the result of being influenced by the "Creator."
In the blink of an eye, it was evening. The construction site closed, and the workers went home talking and laughing. The two cargo ships docked at the port first hung large lights on the bow and stern. Gradually, the lights of the town lit up little by little, showing the vitality of this town.
Because several cargo ships docked here every day, and two passenger ships full of tourists had come in the past two days, the town's restaurants and hotels became lively.
Some workers would now appear in restaurants in groups of three or five for small gatherings. All of this showed that this town had a bit of nightlife.
Lights were also hung on the wooden boat in the lake. Hobert had Archibald light the stove. He skewered the raw meat, smeared it with oil, sprinkled cumin and chili powder, and grilled it with a sizzle.
Bernadette was slightly stunned: "Your method of grilling meat is quite different from Desi's barbecue."
Hobert had already learned that Emperor Roselle had only "improved" some dishes, and had no involvement in kebabs, hot pot, snacks, and the like.
Thinking that there were no folk songs circulating in this world, Hobert couldn't help but sigh: The Emperor's life was really boring.
It was precisely because he had done some research that he dared to grill meat in front of Bernadette. Otherwise, if Bernadette suddenly started calling him "Dad" while eating, it would be a waste of such good grilled meat.
When boarding the ship, he also brought up a bucket of beer.
Drinking beer, eating kebabs, and looking at the beautiful scenery of Full Moon Lake, Hobert's face was full of satisfaction, and Bernadette also enjoyed the food and scenery before her.
After a few glasses of wine, the conversation between the two became more casual, and Bernadette was indeed a daughter taught by the Emperor. Many of her values were very much to Hobert's liking.
Gradually, after she put down the airs of the "Queen Mystic," Hobert actually had the illusion of meeting an old friend in a foreign land.
Previously, in Hobert's conversation with Klein, he had tried to find this feeling, but Klein was a bit like a taciturn gourd, and he pretended to be someone from this era very well.
If it weren't for "The Fool" holding the Tarot Club every week, Hobert would have suspected whether the Klein he met was Zhou Mingrui?
As the two talked, they talked about the situation in the Northern Continent. Hobert said, "You should also be aware that the countries of the Northern Continent now seem to be able to coexist peacefully, but they will inevitably have a war."
Bernadette was slightly stunned: "As far as I know, the Feysac Empire has repeatedly provoked, but the Loen Kingdom has no intention of starting a war. The nobles and the wealthy are busy making money. Are they willing to fight?
"After all, war will cause turmoil. The key is that the money or resources in their hands are likely to depreciate or be subject to the military, which does not seem to be in their interests."
"It is precisely because of interests that they will fight," Hobert smiled and said, "You should have been to Backlund. The entire city, the entire Loen, produces a large number of products every moment.
"Who are they going to sell to? The poor in Backlund's East Borough? Or the natives of the Southern Continent?
"The main force that can afford these things is actually the citizens of the Northern Continent.
"But the problem now is that the products produced by the four countries are obviously surplus. Who is willing to accept the products of other countries?
"This is a fundamental contradiction in wealth. Now it seems that everyone is willing to coexist peacefully, only because everyone is not sure of putting the other to death."
Bernadette nodded slowly. She suddenly recalled that when she listened to her father telling some truths before, her father could often grasp the key to the problem like this, and explain a seemingly ordinary but very important thing very thoroughly, changing some of her views.
Immediately following, Bernadette realized that what she was seeing, the great change from a high level that would occur in Backlund, could it be a war?
Unfortunately, she could only see some blurry shadows and had no way to distinguish whether the upheaval was a war initiated by the Kingdom of Loen.
At this time in the Northern Continent, the Kingdom of Loen possessed the strongest comprehensive strength, so Bernadette naturally assumed that it would be the Kingdom of Loen that initiated the war.
Bernadette finished the beer in her glass: This is indeed a good idea, but it is difficult to prevent the outbreak of war.
Her Sequence 2 advancement ritual required her to prevent a high-level disaster.
Around nine o'clock in the evening, having eaten and drunk her fill and gained a lot, Bernadette bid farewell to Hobert, transformed into a phantom in front of Hobert, and disappeared.
Hobert burped and had Archibald row the boat to shore.
The two marionettes were rowing the boat, and Archibald's main body, while tidying up, asked, "Sir, I heard Seel at the pier this afternoon say that you are planning to take the soldiers to suppress bandits?"
"Yes." Hobert had planned to take Seel and the others to suppress bandits last week, which was actually like a training exercise, but they encountered a riot and had to wait until now.
Many crew members of the cargo ship said that they had seen bandits in the waters outside Jeffery's territory, and that bandits even wanted to board the ship, but their wooden boats could not catch up with the steamships.
Therefore, bandit suppression could no longer be delayed and must be carried out as soon as possible, lest a robbery really occur.
Archibald smiled and said, "I used to command the regular army of the Feysac Empire, why don't you give me this job?"
Hobert was slightly stunned, looking at Archibald: "You have commanded the regular army before?"
Archibald quickly and earnestly reported to Hobert: "Yes, because I really need a 'Warrior' pathway and a 'Hunter' pathway marionette.
"So I went to the Southern Continent, found a suitable target there, and turned a 'Reaper' into a marionette.
"It just so happened that the Feysac Empire's colony was at war at the time, and I thought it was quite fun, so I played the role of that 'Reaper' and continued to fight the enemy.
"As a result, I got addicted to fighting. I stayed in the Feysac military camp for a total of eight years. I was originally a nobleman who went there to gild myself, but I actually became the military commander-in-chief of the Feysac Empire in various colonies in the Southern Continent.
"I initiated and won the Battle of Yaral."
Hobert was stunned, because he had learned about this battle in his university course "Modern Brief History", which was a classic modern army battle.
This course was also called "Modern History", which was a course explaining the history of the last few decades and the current situation of the North and South Continents.
Archibald sighed and continued: "Unfortunately, the people of the Church of the God of Combat discovered my main body, and I had no choice but to give up that identity.
"But before I left, I gave the Church of the God of Combat a surprise and turned their archbishop in the Southern Continent into a marionette."
Archibald's eyes flickered with light, that was the origin of his demigod marionette, and it was also the most glorious period of his life.
Hobert smiled, pondered for a moment, and then said: "Alright, but even if a soldier is dying and cannot be saved, you cannot turn him into a marionette!"
In fact, Hobert knew very well that he had no problem planning a Beyonder battle, but when it came to knowledge of guns and artillery, he didn't even have the most basic tactical knowledge, and would only lead people to charge forward.
"Don't worry." Archibald said: "In terms of making marionettes, I will listen to your arrangements in everything."
Hobert nodded, and the matter was settled.
Returning to the Lord's Manor, Hobert pushed open the bedroom door and smiled: "Beautiful lady, have you been waiting for me for a long time? I'm here!"
But immediately following, Hobert found that the atmosphere in the room seemed a little wrong. Fors was flipping through a magazine expressionlessly, without any response.
Hobert was stunned, she was fine in the morning.
He took a closer look at the magazine in Fors's hand, it was the magazine that Bernadette had flipped through before.
He took off his cloak, sat next to Fors, and smiled: "You also know that there are occasionally some strange guests in the territory now, but there is no way, I have to entertain them well."
Fors saw the tiredness on Hobert's face, and her expression softened a little, but then she asked with a straight face: "Did you let another woman into our room? As soon as I entered the door, I smelled a faint scent of perfume!
"Fortunately, I didn't see a woman's hair on the bed, otherwise I... I would never come to this room and sleep on this bed again!"
Hobert cursed Bernadette in his heart: I knew it! Appearing in the bedroom is easy to cause misunderstanding... Wait, a dignified "Queen Mystic", a Sequence 3, wouldn't be able to hide the scent of perfume on her body? I don't believe it even if you beat me to death! This brat is doing it on purpose! I'll teach her a lesson for Old Huang when I see her next time... Forget it, I can't beat her now!
Not having time to think too much at the moment, he quickly put his arms around Fors and coaxed: "You don't know how excessive the guest I entertained today was! She just likes this kind of prank and always says hurtful things..."
Hobert tried his best to portray Bernadette as a naughty child next door.
Fors was also stunned: "Is she really an adult?"
"Yes! I have similar feelings to you." Hobert smiled wryly: "As soon as I heard you say the scent of perfume, I knew it must be her prank, because I haven't smelled any perfume for most of the day.
"If it weren't because I can't beat her, I wouldn't be so indulgent to her!"
Fors smiled and said: "There are still people you can't beat."
The atmosphere had eased a lot, and Fors gradually responded to Hobert's kisses and hugs.
After a burst of passion, the two people talked about the affairs of the territory as usual.
After talking about the auction house, Fors suddenly said: "Hobert, promise me one thing, if you have another woman, don't bring her to our room."
Hobert looked at Fors, who had a serious look on her face in his arms: "I'm so busy all day long, wouldn't it be better to have some time to drink tea and fish on the lake? Do you think I have time to find another woman?"
"Now is now, maybe you will have time in the future?" Fors had heard Xio talk about those nobles' mistresses, and in this era, it was abnormal for nobles not to keep mistresses.
In the relatively conservative Kingdom of Loen, this kind of thing would not be discussed publicly.
But in the Intis Republic, many nobles would compare their mistresses' charm, figure, and licentiousness. Nobles without mistresses either had financial problems or physical problems.
Fors also knew that it was unlikely for the man in front of her, who had great achievements, to have only one woman in his life. She had already prepared herself mentally for this, but she also had her bottom line.
Hobert knew that even if he swore to the gods now, Fors would not believe him.
So he simply said: "Don't worry, I will protect our family!"
Fors was very satisfied with this answer and kissed Hobert as if it were a reward.
The two people tacitly did not continue this topic. Hobert said: "Accompany me to inspect the new territory tomorrow. There is a manor that originally belonged to Viscount Wright. Let's go and take a look together."
Fors agreed: "Okay!"
Early the next morning, after Hobert finished breakfast, he first used "Travel" to watch a play on the west coast.
Originally, he planned to give the young people who were being punished two days off after working for three days, but in the past few days, the ships of Jeffery's territory were busy transporting building materials and some necessary supplies to the west coast, so the vacation time was postponed for a few days.
Hobert wasn't so idle as to visit every village. He randomly looked at the reactions of three villages and a small town, and Hobert was satisfied to see the villagers' stunned expressions.
The villagers in one village even thought they had seen a ghost and wanted to organize people to fight the ghost. Some people were even so frightened that their legs went weak and they sat on the ground.
Looking at their yelling appearance, Hobert had a feeling of a successful trick: You guys caused a riot before, which made me worry for several days. Now I will also make you feel scared, and we can call it even.
At this time, the grassroots civil servants sent down from each village began to loudly publicize some changes in Jeffery's territory and some new policies of Lord Hobert.
At the same time, Hobert also saw the scene of the young people who were being punished crying with their families.
He saw parents holding their children's faces and looking at them again and again, and he saw young girls who had lost their lovers and regained them, and rushed out to hug them without being shy.
Hobert's smile gradually disappeared: Losing and regaining makes many people wake up from numbness! As expected, only when you lose it will you know how to cherish it.
He didn't continue to watch, but returned to the east coast, and set off from the Lord's Manor around nine o'clock, taking Fors and a dozen guards and servants to inspect the territory.
This couldn't help but remind Hobert of the last time he inspected the territory. At that time, he only had one servant, Seel, and he didn't even have a horse when he first set off.
Now the horse that Hobert is riding was still "sponsored" by Dennis's father, Grove.
Moreover, during that inspection, the residents of the territory guarded against Hobert as if he were a thief. Now it's different. No matter where Hobert passes, the farmers in the fields respectfully greet this lord.
Some people even invited Hobert to drink tea or wine under the tree. Regarding the act of drinking alcohol at noon, Hobert smiled and euphemistically criticized: "It is easy to make mistakes when drinking alcohol at noon. I'd better have a few sips of tea."
So, not long after the group came out, Hobert got off his horse and started drinking tea with the people farming in the fields.
Through chatting, Hobert learned that some families in the village had become wealthy. Without exception, these families had large populations, many family members working on the construction site, and received more wages every weekend.
Especially after the opening of the Lord's Manor direct-sale store in Jeffery's territory town, the workers who had money in their hands would of course buy some modern industrial products, which initially made the economy in the territory prosper.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 508: The Origin of the Theosophy Order (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Powerstones 300]
Walking and stopping along the way, Hobert felt the enormous changes in the territory. The people were highly motivated in their labor in the fields and on the construction sites, creating more wealth than before.
The key was that they themselves could get a considerable portion of the wealth they created.
Many new houses had appeared in the villages, tall and beautiful, with red bricks and red tiles.
It wasn't that the people here also felt that red was festive, but because the brick kilns in the territory could only produce red bricks and red tiles.
More were houses that were half-built or under construction with the help of neighbors, relatives, and friends.
That was hope, that was the future.
But after arriving at the new territory, the situation changed drastically.
The people here were indifferent and numb, there were few people in the fields, and the crops were growing far less vigorously than what he had seen in the morning.
So the inspection speed was much faster, and in the evening, they arrived at the former Viscount Wright's manor.
It had long been abandoned, with only the tall walls and huge lawn proving its former glory.
Hobert had heard from the original servants of the Lord's Mansion on the way that the scenery here was quite good, but when he arrived, it was already evening, and the surroundings looked like ordinary grassland.
Wild rabbits had already made their nests here. Hobert shot a few casually while walking with Fors. He handed one of them to a servant: "Roast it, I'll use it to entertain guests later. The rest are for you."
While waiting for the roasted rabbit, Fors, who was already a little hungry and had started eating bread with jam, was still marveling at what she had seen and heard today.
It was the first time she had felt such a strong sense of comfort. Hobert had brought about earth-shattering changes in the lives of the people, so they welcomed Hobert with their greatest enthusiasm and supported his rule.
"This world has become accustomed to establishing rule through violence," Hobert suddenly said with emotion, "Perhaps this has something to do with the fact that the essence of this world is madness."
"Haven't the Beyonders of the 'Lawyer' and 'Arbiter' pathways ever thought about making this world a better place, so that more people would support their rule?"
A voice suddenly came from the darkness: "They should have had someone think of that."
A middle-aged man with a meticulously groomed beard and hair came out of the darkness into the camp, and the guards immediately pointed their guns at him.
Hobert smiled and said, "That's my guest."
Everyone did not relax their vigilance because of this, but only stopped pointing their guns at the other party.
The person who came was Jonathan, whom Hobert had planned to meet during this inspection.
Jonathan suddenly had several bullets in his hand. While playing with the bullets, he sat down opposite Hobert: "But the problem is, they immediately realized a problem: what's the use of ordinary people's support?"
At this time, the surrounding guards realized that the bullets in their guns were gone.
Jonathan casually threw the bullets in his hand at the feet of the guards. He originally thought that these guards would immediately bend down to pick them up, but who knew that they would load another bullet into their guns and stare at Jonathan.
Seeing Jonathan's slightly surprised expression, Hobert smiled: "Didn't you expect that ordinary people could also look you in the eye so firmly?
"As long as someone supports them, they are not as servile as you think."
Jonathan glanced at Hobert: "But they still have to rely on you, and ultimately they still have to rely on the extraordinary."
Hobert took a deep breath: "Yes, that's a problem.
"In fact, if ordinary people are allowed to develop, they can also create weapons with destructive power comparable to gods, and they can also use their methods to land on the moon and travel through the sky."
Jonathan smiled and shook his head: "Young people are still imaginative."
Hobert also smiled and did not continue to discuss this topic: "How have you been lately?"
Jonathan nodded: "The negative effects have all disappeared."
Hobert grunted and said bluntly: "I've had some feelings during these two weeks on the West Coast. You people don't know what rule is.
"Hand over the governance of the East Coast to me, and I will make it more prosperous, and it will attract more people. I will still not interfere with religious matters. If you have conflicts with the Church of the Earth Mother and need me to mediate, I will come forward."
Jonathan agreed to this very readily: "Okay."
But then he added: "But I have a condition."
"Speak."
"Talk to me about your faith."
Hobert was stunned, looking at Jonathan: "It's the first time I've preached to a demigod."
Fors was slightly stunned. She remembered that Hobert was a believer of the Evernight Goddess in Backlund, and after coming to the Kingdom of Feynapotter, he became a devout believer of the Earth Mother.
She couldn't help but think: Did this demigod of the Theosophy Order want to believe in the Earth Mother?
In the previous battle, Fors had seen Jonathan from afar. Later, Hobert introduced him to her as a demigod of the Theosophy Order.
"The Lord awoke from chaos and saw that the order of the world was so unbearable, that morality was no longer the standard for measuring whether a person was good, but money was; violence filled every corner of this world and was whitewashed by gods and rulers; vicious thugs lived a good life, while those who truly loved life and were kind toiled all day long and had no time to enjoy life."
With Hobert's current eloquence, this kind of thing came almost without thinking, and like the "Bible" of various churches, it would start from human nature and on a large scale, expounding the core ideas.
He continued: "So the Lord sighed: 'Humanity in the Fifth Epoch is more miserable than in the Second Epoch, at least in the Second Epoch, humans rarely killed and deceived each other.' Therefore, the Lord intends to overthrow the existing order and establish a new order for the world!"
As he spoke, Hobert suddenly realized that he was actually connected in this way with the honorific name he had racked his brains to come up with before, but which was very devaluing.
He didn't know whether his honorific name determined the cause he would pursue in the future, or whether the cause he would inevitably pursue in the future determined his honorific name in reverse?
Jonathan was slightly stunned when he heard these words: "Your faith is easily at odds with all the gods!"
Fors also realized: Isn't this the doctrine of the Church of the Earth Mother?
But Hobert smiled and said, "The god I believe in has already found an ally."
It's just that that ally is only Sequence 6, no, almost promoted to Sequence 5.
Jonathan guessed: "The Earth Mother?"
"No." Hobert said: "My relationship with Bishop Simpson is purely my personal behavior to develop the territory."
Fors wondered: What is Hobert's true faith? Why haven't I ever heard him mention it? Uh, maybe it's because I don't care much about the issue of faith. "Mr. Fool" may be my most devout faith, but now that I think about it, unless I have something to trouble Mr. Fool with, I have never performed daily prayers! No, this makes me seem too impious. I will perform daily prayers to Mr. Fool every day from now on, but, but it seems very troublesome, well, three days... once a week for daily prayers.
Jonathan was very curious: "Your unique way of developing the territory is not from the instructions of a god?"
"No, as long as we develop according to His outline, He rarely interferes with the affairs of His blessed." Hobert was telling the truth.
Jonathan fell into silence, and after a long while, he suddenly asked: "Do you know the origin of the Theosophy Order?"
"I've heard of it roughly." Hobert replied: "The Theosophy Order seems to be a branch of the Demoness Sect."
Fors was stunned again. She heard such high-level intelligence in the real world for the first time.
Jonathan asked again: "Aren't you curious why the main members of the Theosophy Order are Beyonders of the 'Apprentice' pathway?"
"According to the information I have, after Mr. 'Door' of the Fourth Epoch fell, the Demoness Sect took the opportunity to harvest some of the Beyonder characteristics of the Abraham family without the protection of angels." This was actually Hobert's guess.
Fors sighed: Hobert knows a lot, he even knows Mr. 'Door', but he doesn't know that Mr. 'Door' didn't fall, but was sealed. Thinking of this, she felt somewhat emotional: As expected, the information obtained at the Tarot Gathering is very high-end, and it is a secret that most Beyonders do not know! Mr. Emperor knows so much!
"Mr. 'Door' did not fall, He was just sealed," Jonathan corrected.
Fors, who was cutting off a rabbit leg and eating it, smiled slightly: As expected.
Jonathan then said: "I don't know how much you know about the history of the Fourth Epoch, but what I can tell you is that when Mr. 'Door' was first sealed, the power of the Demoness Sect was basically in the Southern Continent, and they had no time and space to deal with the Beyonders of the Abraham family."
Hobert was slightly stunned: That's right, I didn't think of this before.
Jonathan continued: "After Mr. 'Door' was sealed, the Abraham family split once. They split with the Tamara family... Do you know the Tamara family?"
"Yes." Hobert nodded: "I've killed many people from this family."
Jonathan was slightly stunned. What was that supposed to mean?
Hobert smiled: "You go on."
Jonathan cleared his throat: "At that time, the Abraham family and the Tamara family often intermarried. Some relatives of the Tamara family in the Abraham family advocated joining the Tamara family, while many other clansmen planned to maintain the independence of the family and be ready to welcome the return of Mr. 'Door' at any time. This was the first split of the Abraham family.
"But the members who joined the Tamara family soon ushered in the second split. The reason for the split was very strange. It was said that the god found by the Tamara family to exempt the clansmen from the curse had problems, and the Tamara family desperately wanted to cultivate a 'Planeswalker' for some reason.
"I need to explain to you the curse of the Abraham family..."
"I've heard of that curse," Hobert said: "Is it that you hear some maddening whispers during the blood moon?"
Fors also nodded: I am a victim of this curse.
Jonathan sighed: "You know a lot of secrets."
He thought again, and felt that this seemed to be taken for granted, after all, Hobert had an organization behind him, and a god.
Jonathan showed a puzzled expression: "In theory, the Tamara family helped find a god who could help the clansmen avoid the curse, and cultivated a 'Planeswalker', all of which were good things.
"But I don't know why, the clansmen still split at that time.
"Well, only a few people know the inside story of this matter, and those few people do not include me.
"After the split, our elders contacted the Demoness Sect and received the protection of the 'Primordial Demoness'.
"But because our ideas are so different from the Demoness Sect, the Demoness Sect had to establish the Theosophy Order."
Hobert tore off a piece of rabbit meat and handed it to Jonathan: "I didn't expect there to be so many secrets."
Jonathan shook his head with the rabbit meat and said: "Didn't you hear the problem? The 'Primordial Demoness' is a... well, okay, you know, She is not a righteous god.
"What I find strange is, why did those elders who have passed away join the Demoness Sect? What is the difference between this and the previous problematic god?"
Fors was slightly stunned, she didn't expect there to be other branches of the Abraham family.
Hobert sighed: Choosing the lesser of two evils.
He said: "Have you ever thought that perhaps the god found by the Tamara family could cause you more harm than the 'Primordial Demoness'."
"I have thought about this question, but I really can't figure out, what harm can be greater than a god in a bad state?" Jonathan asked somewhat confused.
Hobert knew very clearly that there was! But he forgot what it was, he still remembered that some memories that could not be carried outside were sealed by himself in the "Nation of Disorder", so he did not delve into it.
Jonathan did not continue to dwell on this issue, but said again: "Some of the high-level members of the Theosophy Order are from the Demoness Sect, and some are saints of the Abraham family.
"Currently I know that three saints of the Abraham family have been completely influenced by the 'Primordial Demoness' and have begun to fanatically believe in the 'Primordial Demoness'.
"And I and the other two demigods of the Abraham family still remember the agreement with the Demoness Sect a long time ago, the 'Primordial Demoness' helped us avoid the curse, and we helped the Demoness Sect do some things that they were inconvenient to come forward to do.
"But there are still too many clansmen of the Abraham family who have been corrupted, they have been completely brainwashed by the Demoness Sect, and believe that killing a person is helping them be liberated."
He sighed: "I have also been affected to some extent, for example, at certain times, my subconscious will think that I am a woman, or I will feel the irresistible charm of the 'Primordial Demoness'.
"If there is a chance, I don't want to continue to be influenced like this, and I don't want the clansmen to be immersed in the bewitchment of the Demoness Sect and completely become vassals of the Demoness Sect."
Hobert probably understood Jonathan's appeal: There is a group of Theosophy Order members with Jonathan as the main leader who hope to break away from the Theosophy Order! Hiss~ The rift between the Theosophy Order and the Demoness Sect, or rather the rift within the Theosophy Order, is deeper than I thought!

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 509 Captain Dunn Decides to Stay
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Fors, who was beside him, couldn't help but ask, "Mr. Jonathan, I'm curious, since you want to obtain some protection, why don't you seek refuge with the orthodox Churches?"
"Because the Mr. Door we believe in is sealed by one or some of the Seven Gods," Jonathan explained. "Almost every member of our clan has a premonition after advancing to 'Astrologer' that one day Mr. Door will definitely break free from the seal and return to the real world, so it is impossible for us to believe in our enemies."
Fors nodded: "I understand."
She thought to herself: I know this, Mr. Door is sealed by the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms.
Then she thought: The Abraham family members of the Theosophy Order are stronger than Teacher Dorian's members, but they are also more radical.
However, Hobert thought: "I knew before that the doctrine of the Theosophy Order believes that the spirit is the essence of human beings, and the body is just a cage that binds the spirit. Knowledge must be obtained through spirituality, so that the spirit can gradually be freed from the body, and after layers of trials by the stars, it can finally break away from the material world and return to the purest and most real self, to obtain eternal salvation."
"But I didn't study it carefully before. At first glance, this doctrine seems to be the acting reference for the 'Rose School', or the 'Prisoner' pathway. But on second thought, this doctrine is not really related to the Demoness Sect.
"Your words just reminded me that they have always believed in Mr. Door, so the doctrine of the Theosophy Order can also be regarded as a description of the growth process of the 'Door' pathway Beyonder, or simply a description of Mr. Door."
"Your previous remarks were very misleading!" Jonathan said to Hobert with a smile: "Let us convince a large number of members of the Theosophy Order, and even many members of the Demoness Sect are deeply convinced of your theory!"
Hobert's previous remarks on another interpretation of the 'Witch' pathway potion and the proposal to actively move closer to the orthodox Church were indeed very misleading.
Jonathan made full use of this, which was equivalent to screening out those members who were unwilling to continue living secretly, and these were members with similar ambitions to Jonathan and others.
Finally, Jonathan said meaningfully: "The only thing we lack now is protection."
Of course, Hobert understood that Jonathan meant: Can the god you believe in give us such protection?
He said: "I will report this matter."
The implication is: I can't decide whether to accept you or not, I will report this to the 'Creator'.
Jonathan gave an "Um" and said: "I'll wait for your news."
He finished the rabbit meat in his hand, took out a towel and carefully wiped his hands, then got up to leave.
Hobert sat by the campfire in silence, considering whether to accept Jonathan's group.
Accepting them would add at least three demigod-level combat powers, but they would also have to face the anger from the Demoness Sect, and there might be angel-level battles again.
If he didn't accept them, it would be easier, but Hobert felt it was a pity, that was three demigod-level combat powers!
Another question is, I don't know if the 'Creator' can isolate the curse of Mr. Door? This must be tested first. If Jonathan comes with the team and finds that the 'Creator' can't help them at all, it will be embarrassing.
After thinking for a while, Hobert felt it was necessary to accept this power.
For the "evil gods" related to rulers, they will eventually establish their own country. At that time, the extraordinary power in the country cannot be supported by the Balk family alone.
It is necessary to unite all forces that can be united to form the extraordinary forces of one's own country.
If you dig into the orthodox Church, you are just asking for death!
You can only unite the descendants of angel families like the Abraham family, but these families have more or less problems.
For Hobert, the risk of solving these problems is great, but these problems are also an opportunity. As long as he helps them solve the problems, he can exchange them for their loyalty.
Finally, Hobert decided that helping is helping, but don't worry about this matter, you can wait until you become a demigod before talking about it.
After eating a few bites of rabbit meat, Hobert and Fors returned to the tent they had set up to rest.
Fors really wanted to know Hobert's belief, but she also knew that this should be a very private matter. If there were confidentiality requirements like the Tarot Club, it might embarrass Hobert.
So she decided not to ask first. Based on her understanding of Hobert, he would definitely tell her if he could.
Only when the two of them were intimate did Fors put aside this question and become focused.
Being intimate in the wild gave the two of them a new experience, allowing them to wholeheartedly enjoy the joy of this moment.
After a burst of passion, the two hugged each other and chatted as usual.
Hobert suddenly said: "Regarding my true belief, I didn't mention it to you before because I had an oath that I cannot reveal the existence of that great being to members outside the family unless it is for evangelism."
Fors nodded lightly: I knew it was like this.
"But it's different now." Hobert lowered his head and kissed Fors on the forehead: "You are now a member of our family, and you may need the protection of that great being for a period of time."
He said: "You should have heard of the 'Blood Emperor', right? That's right, it's the 'Blood Emperor' who established the Tudor Empire in the Fourth Epoch.
"Christian is a descendant of the Tudor family. Now you know where Angus, this cousin, came from, right? That's right, they are all members of the same family."
Fors was a little surprised. She hugged Hobert's waist to feel enough reality: When I was trading information about the Tudor Empire in the Tarot Club, I felt that these people and things were so far away from me, but I didn't expect them to be so close.
This made her involuntarily think of the "Emperor" in the Tarot Club. After thinking about it carefully, she felt that the "Emperor" was quite similar to Hobert in figure.
But the feeling was different. Hobert made people feel enthusiastic, focused, and occasionally a little bad, while the "Emperor" gave people a feeling of mystery, erudition, and loftiness.
Then she thought: I remember the "Emperor" said that he had many colleagues from the Tudor family. Could it be that Hobert believes in the "Creator"?
Fors probably couldn't imagine that the reason why Hobert said that at that time was to make his words at this moment more credible.
Only Hobert continued: "Our family believes in a great god named the 'Creator of Human Order'..."
Fors hugged Hobert's arm even tighter: It really is like this!
"But don't mention this to other family members for the time being, because this is not something that can be discussed in public." Hobert also said: "You also heard the order conveyed by the King's messenger. I will leave the territory this Saturday or Sunday to attend the National Day celebration next Monday.
"When Father came to Jeffrey Town before, he reminded me that something big was going to happen in Feynapotter City. I guess this big event is likely to happen on National Day.
"Starting two weeks ago, I have asked Philip to set up a company to divide and reorganize the industries in the territory to deal with possible accidents.
"After this inspection, you will start to ask about these company accounts. Although I won't let you do the accounting, you have to have a general idea.
"You must be careful during the period you stay in the territory. I will leave Archibald to protect you and rearrange the 'Traveler's Gate' for you. You must ensure that you can escape back to Backlund at any time.
"If you encounter difficulties or dangers that cannot be solved, you can pray to the 'Creator' and ask for his help."
Fors said with some worry: "You're just going to attend a banquet, what danger could there be?
"Could it be that your investment in the territory is too large, making the royal family jealous? If not, just give them these industries, it's just money, there's no need to take risks."
"In the eyes of the royal family, my investment in the territory may be the most inconspicuous problem." Hobert patted Fors on the back to comfort her: "Don't worry, with Father around, I won't be in too much danger, but I guess my baronial title may be lost."
"Just lose it, it's just a title." Fors said anxiously: "Is there anything I can do to help you?"
"Just stay in the territory for me." Hobert said with a smile: "Don't worry, you know I have a 'travel' magical item, no place can trap me."
Fors felt a little relieved: "I really want to advance as soon as possible, so that I can share some of the pressure for you."
Hobert pinched Fors's nose: "Didn't you participate in the battle against the demons before? You've already helped me a lot."
He also said: "Don't worry, after going to Feynapotter City, I will first go to see Bishop Simpson. In critical moments, the Earth Mother Church will also provide necessary help and protection, so you don't have to worry at all."
Fors then understood that Hobert had been preparing for this moment for a long time, which made her feel a lot relieved.
At the same time, she secretly encouraged herself to advance as soon as possible: In that case, I can help Hobert, and he will discuss such problems with me again, instead of leaving all the pressure to himself.
In Hobert's comforting voice, Fors fell asleep with worries, and Hobert also fell asleep.
Close to midnight, Hobert was awakened by the sound of prayer.
Who is so sick?
After cursing in his heart, Hobert pretended to be in a hurry to urinate, came outside the tent and entered the "Nation of Disorder", and saw again in the pool in front of the "Iron Throne" that there was a strange star.
Spreading his spirituality over, this time it was a man wearing a Loen-style court guard uniform praying to him.
This time Hobert was not as surprised as last time. He realized that someone was indeed testing him. The other party was likely a member of the Loen royal family. Was it George III?
Hobert thought for a while and decided not to pay attention, because if the other party was just testing him like this, it would be impossible to find him, so there was no need to worry for the time being.
Hobert, who had returned from outside the tent, meditated for a long time before falling asleep again.
The next day, they continued to inspect, and Fors finally understood why the people loved Hobert so much. Without his actions in the past six months, it is believed that the area around Jeffrey Town would be as poor as these mountain villages.
At noon, the group returned to the manor where they had set off in the morning.
At this time, Hobert realized the scenery of this manor. As far as the eye could see, there were low hills, and the undulating ground was covered with green grass, interspersed with some wildflowers.
Among the flowers and plants, various insects were already busy. There were no magnificent scenes, nor were there any novel landscapes, but seeing such a scene made people feel very happy.
Fors asked the servants to put the recliner on the grass. She basked in the sun comfortably, watching the spring wind and clouds, and watching Hobert riding a horse and having a great time.
This place is indeed very suitable for riding horses. On horseback, there is a sense of conquering the land in front of you.
After riding the horse for a while, the gloom in Hobert's heart these days was swept away. He said to the guards and servants: "Go back at three o'clock in the afternoon."
After speaking, he lay on the recliner next to Fors: "This manor must be well renovated..."
Fors suddenly said: "I want this manor!"
Hobert smiled and said: "It's yours. You have to treat me well when I come here as a guest in the future."
"I'm not kidding."
"I'm not kidding either." Hobert smiled and said: "I'll ask Philip to go through the formalities when I go back, strip it from the Lord's Mansion's property, and then transfer it to your name."
Fors smiled sweetly: "Hobert, you are so good."
Hobert smiled and pinched her face. Fors rarely made such a request, and of course he had to try his best to satisfy it.
Fors looked at the blue sky and held Hobert's hand: "I really want to stay here forever and not go anywhere."
"We will see more beautiful scenery than here in the future..."
"No," Fors suddenly said: "The scenery here is enough for me. If I see the more magnificent scenery you mentioned, I will be greedy."
Hobert was slightly startled, turned his head and glanced at Fors: "We can't stay here forever."
"I know you can't stay here forever." Fors smiled happily: "But I will stay here and keep thinking of you, and when I miss you, you will happen to miss me and appear in front of me."
If it weren't for that curse, if it weren't for wanting to help Hobert, she wouldn't have any motivation to advance.
Hobert gave an "Um" and smiled: "You can live however you want."
The two smiled at each other and continued to enjoy this wonderful time.
But such a time is ultimately short. At three o'clock in the afternoon, the group embarked on their return journey and returned to the Lord's Mansion in the evening.
After dinner, Archibald and Seel reported to Hobert their first bandit suppression results. They successfully defeated a group of more than 30 bandits on the east bank and seized a lot of spoils.
Just like the bandits in Jeffrey Territory before, these bandits, to a certain extent, were the rulers of that territory, so they would have a lot of property.
Hobert inquired about the details of the engagement, and Seel provided a comprehensive report. Archibald, with his extensive experience in leading troops, had made remarkably accurate judgments about the enemy.
How to lure the enemy? How to set up the ambush? Everything was meticulously planned in advance, leaving the enemy disoriented. With only seven or eight soldiers injured, they managed to kill twelve enemies and capture over twenty.
Those twenty-odd individuals were all sent to the construction site, where they would face a life of hard labor, of course.
Hobert was finally relieved to entrust the task of suppressing the bandits to Archibald. He also instructed Seel to bring forward the two soldiers who had performed exceptionally well in the battle. After commending them, he promised to help them become Beyonders.
Hobert only mentioned the three pathways of "Hunter," "Warrior," and "Sailor" for them to choose from.
...
On Friday morning, April, who had an appointment with Hobert, arrived at the front yard's side hall with two servants carrying a wooden box the size of a coffin.
After closing the door, only Hobert, April, and the wooden box on the table remained in the side hall.
Hobert opened the coffin-like wooden box, revealing a tall man with a prominent nose lying inside.
He looked exactly like Dunn Smith, except his hairline wasn't receding, and his hair appeared lush.
Hobert smiled, "You even cured his receding hairline."
April was slightly taken aback, "No wonder. When this body was first refined, it didn't have much hair. I thought I had made a mistake somewhere. The reason it's so thick now is because I found a way to make it grow."
Hobert stroked his chin and said, "This is good news for middle-aged men."
Then he asked, "Is it just a matter of merging the soul with this body?"
"It requires the consumption of one 'Life Stone' each year," April explained. "Moreover, this body will also age, lasting about sixty to seventy years.
"When that time comes, even using 'Life Stones' will have no effect. You can only refine a new body, provided that his spirit body hasn't weakened, otherwise, it won't be possible to merge again.
"Also, the fusion process must be performed by me."
Hobert nodded, "Wait a moment, I'll go get his spirit body and Beyonder characteristics."
Quickly arriving at the study, Hobert excitedly sacrificed the "Spirit Wine Glass" to the "Nation of Disorder."
He went behind the "Iron Throne" and opened the stone coffin hidden there.
Inside lay Captain Dunn's spirit body and spiritual body, sometimes illusory, sometimes solid.
Hobert had been sealing the stone coffin with the "Power of Order," so there was no loss of spirituality in the spirit body.
Hobert carried the stone coffin to the side of the pool in the hall, stood it upright, and picked up the "Spirit Wine Glass." He suddenly felt a little nervous: What if Captain Dunn didn't want to be resurrected? What if…
Never mind, let's wake him up first.
Injecting spirituality into the "Spirit Wine Glass," invisible ripples spread throughout the hall. Captain Dunn in the stone coffin suddenly opened his eyes.
He was first a little dazed, then saw the clear pool, the spacious hall, the bronze giant door on one side of the hall, and the high Iron Throne.
Finally, Dunn's eyes, like deep lakes, looked at Hobert in front of him.
"Hello, Captain Dunn," Hobert smiled. "It's good to see you again."
Dunn's memory was still from the operation in Tingen to stop the descent of the True Creator. He looked down and didn't find any wounds on his body: "I remember, I seem to be dead."
Hobert thought: If I say, "Captain, you're mistaken," would I be able to get away with it?
"You did not have any vital signs at the time," Hobert decided to tell the truth. "I took the liberty of preserving your Beyonder characteristics and soul."
Dunn pinched his chin and pondered for a few seconds before asking, "Then, our mission…"
"You saved Tingen."
"No, we, we saved Tingen." Dunn scrutinized Hobert: "You seem to be more than just an external member of the Nighthawks team."
"That's right," Hobert smiled. "But one thing I want to explain is that I am a favored one of the Goddess…"
Right?
Then Hobert confidently said: "That's right, I am a favored one of the Goddess. I have received instructions directly from the Goddess."
Hobert could feel that Dunn was very wary of him.
Dunn asked, "Then, Mr. Favored One, this is obviously not somewhere belonging to the Church of the Evernight Goddess, right?"
"No," Hobert replied. "I asked a great existence to help me protect your soul to prevent the loss of spirituality."
"Why do that?"
"Because I don't want you to die." Hobert spread his hands. "Or rather, you shouldn't have died. You saved a city."
"Is that all?"
"Klein and Leonard also didn't want you to die, and neither did Miss Daly. She especially didn't want you to die." Hobert forced a smile. "I don't know if you can imagine Miss Daly being heartbroken and drowning her sorrows in alcohol every day."
Daly was indeed heartbroken, but Hobert didn't know if she was drowning her sorrows in alcohol.
Dunn fell into a long silence. He was pondering, and also weighing things. Finally, he seemed to have made up his mind: "But I'm already dead."
He looked at Hobert and smiled, putting down most of his guard: "I've seen too many Beyonders who are unwilling to accept their death. I don't want to become like them, so…"
Hobert was slightly stunned, but then he changed his persuasion strategy: "Captain Dunn, the world needs you!
"Moreover, I found a 'Classical Alchemist' to refine a body with a lifespan of sixty to seventy years for you. You won't become a wraith, and your state will be as normal as before.
"Oh, right, I also specifically told that 'Classical Alchemist' to cure your hair loss."
Dunn didn't pay much attention to the last two sentences, but asked with a smile: "I'm not some important figure, why would the world need me?"
"You're wrong, Captain Dunn. You are a vanguard of justice, a protector of the people, and a sword to punish the forces of darkness." Hobert said emotionally:
"The forces of justice in this world are so few. Your death will be a major loss to the forces of justice and will allow more evil forces to breed.
"Yes, this world may not need you, but the kind people who are forced into a corner by the dark forces need you, and the ordinary people who have been persecuted by the dark forces need you!
"Please stay and help them."
The hall fell silent again. After a long while, Captain Dunn suddenly asked, "What do you need me to do?"
Hobert took a deep breath. Colleagues and friends had not been able to make Dunn decide to stay, nor had his lover made him decide to stay. He was staying for the sake of justice in his heart and the people who needed his help.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 510 Resurrection of Captain Dunn
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
At that moment, Hobert briefly described his recent experiences: "...Overall, there are a large number of people in my territory who have been spiritually corrupted by demons, and some followers of the Theosophy Order.
"As for the members of the official Beyonder organization I just formed, they have no problem killing people, but they have no experience in dealing with Beyonder events.
"I hope you can teach them how to handle Beyonder events. Also, in the Southern Continent, there is a newly formed official Beyonder organization that also severely lacks similar experience.
"They need an experienced person to guide their work."
Captain Dunn crossed his arms and smiled, "It sounds like your organization is not an evil secret organization."
Hobert smiled, "It is a secret organization, but not evil."
"I never thought that after cracking down on secret organizations for so many years, I would become a member of a secret organization myself." Captain Dunn finally made up his mind, "Okay, I'll go with you and see if I can help."
He added, "But if I find that you are lying, or if my own condition is abnormal, I will still end my life immediately.
"For the sake of our fighting together, don't stop me."
Hobert smiled, "Don't worry about that. Well, I'll store you in the 'Spirit Wine Glass' first, and then return to the real world to set up the altar..."
"Wait a minute," Captain Dunn suddenly said, "You just said that your territory is in the Feynapotter Kingdom, right?"
"Yes, I will prepare Feynapotter's Highlander language charms for you, so you don't have to worry about language problems."
Just as Hobert was about to pick up the "Spirit Wine Glass", Dunn said again, "I forgot to ask just now, you said that the composition of the official Beyonders in your territory is very complex, how complex is it?"
Hobert was slightly stunned: he really didn't expect that even as a spirit body, the Captain's memory was still so excellent!
At that moment, he explained the origins of Angus's First Squad members and Helen's Second Squad members.
Hobert picked up the "Spirit Wine Glass", waited for a few seconds, and after confirming that the Captain had no new questions, he injected his spirituality into the "Wine Glass", attached Captain Dunn's astral body and mental body to the wine glass, and picked up Captain Dunn's Beyonder characteristics.
Captain Dunn was able to see and hear Hobert's actions and voice in his current state, so Hobert pretended to thank the empty throne, and requested that the "Wine Glass" and Beyonder characteristics be bestowed upon himself.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert respectfully placed the two Beyonder items in his hand in front of the "Iron Throne", and then his figure disappeared and returned to the real world.
After setting up the "Bestowal" ceremony, Hobert re-entered the "Nation of Disorder" and bestowed the "Wine Glass" with Dunn's spirit body and the Beyonder characteristics of "Nightmare" upon himself.
When he was sucked into the bronze door, Dunn in the "Wine Glass" vaguely saw a tall and solid figure sitting on the "Iron Throne", but before he could see it clearly, after a dizzying experience, he arrived in the real world.
Hobert brought the "Wine Glass" and Beyonder characteristics to the front yard and handed them to April, who was waiting there.
April first pinched the wine glass to feel whether the spirit body inside was complete, and then held the Beyonder characteristics of "Nightmare" and placed it under the ribs in the direction of the heart of the body.
The skin of the body slowly separated up and down, like a mouth suddenly opened, and "swallowed" the Beyonder characteristics.
A few seconds later, the body gave people a sense of tranquility, but immediately afterwards, the body trembled, and one after another finger-sized fleshy bumps grew on the body, but these fleshy bumps disappeared quickly.
But then they grew out again, and then disappeared.
Hobert was stunned: "Is this a precursor to losing control?"
April explained unhurriedly: "Don't worry, this is a normal phenomenon, just like an ordinary person suddenly taking a Sequence 7 potion."
She said to the "Wine Glass": "After you enter this body, the connection established with the spirit world when you originally digested the potion can be re-endowed to this body. As long as you don't die from losing control, these symptoms of losing control can disappear immediately.
"Okay, get ready, I'm going to integrate your spirituality into the body."
April stretched out her hand and scratched the skin on the front chest of the body with her not-so-long nails.
But there was no bleeding, and there was no color of muscle, but a gray-black gap appeared, with something like a thick gray-black liquid inside, as if they would flow out in the next second, but they never flowed out.
Then these liquids suddenly changed color and turned white again, also about to flow out, but they couldn't flow out.
April casually explained, "Black represents the Beyonder characteristics just now, and white represents this blank-like body."
As she spoke, she brought the wine glass to the front of the gap, injected spirituality, and Captain Dunn's spirit body and mental body were injected into the liquid that was sometimes black and sometimes white.
April's movements suddenly became faster. She threw the "Wine Glass" to Hobert, and took out a piece of metal with yellow, blue, and red colors intersecting from her pocket with the other hand.
She held the metal block with both hands, and a brilliant light emerged from the metal block, covering the entire side hall, giving all the objects here, including the walls and the ground, an unspeakable sense of sanctity.
The liquid on the chest of the body seemed to be sucked out by some suction, and then formed a vortex. The black representing the Beyonder characteristics, the white representing the body, and the gray representing Dunn's spirit body were all stirred together.
The metal block also floated up and came to the top of the body. It gave the three liquids the power to rotate, causing them to stir and stir. At first, the three colors could be distinguished, but later they were stirred too finely, and the three colors seemed to become one color.
And the light on the metal block gradually dimmed, and finally it became an alloy of iron and lead, with no color on the surface.
The thick liquid that had been stirred into one color fell back into the gap in front of the body's chest. Those liquids no longer changed color, but always appeared gray.
April reached out to catch the falling metal block, leaned down and gently wiped the front chest of the body with her fingertips, and the gray-black gap disappeared.
She smiled, "The spirit body is very well integrated with the body."
Hobert asked, "In that case, is he completely alive?"
"There is still one last step." April put away the metal block and took out a crystal-clear, crystal-like colorful stone from her pocket.
This is a "Stone of Life". April placed it on the forehead of the body. After taking her hand away, the stone slowly rotated by itself, emitting colorful light, and the entire side hall was filled with the breath of life.
A few seconds later, the color on the Stone of Life was dull and no longer like a crystal, but merely like an ordinary stone painted with color.
As the stone fell to the ground, the body also opened its eyes. He sat up abruptly, staring at his hands in a daze.
Hobert, who was on the side, asked, "How do you feel?"
"I don't feel anything." Dunn looked at Hobert with deep eyes: "Just now, was our conversation a dream?"
Hobert was very satisfied with this effect. Dunn himself couldn't distinguish what was different between this body and the original body.
As for him not being able to distinguish what is reality? What is a dream? "Nightmares" basically have this problem.
April, who was on the side, was very satisfied with her work, and then she said, "The first 'Stone of Life' is a gift, and each 'Stone of Life' after that is worth 3,000 gold Lire."
"No." Hobert smiled, "The cost of refining the body can not be given to you, but the money for the 'Stone of Life' must be given to you."
He shouted outside, "Allen, get 5,000 gold Lire from Philip."
Hobert smiled and said to April, "You must accept this money. I hope you can share my joy."
April smiled slightly and did not decline any further.
After getting the money, she said, "I'll come to see you again in a few days."
"I may be going to Feynapotter City in a few days." Hobert explained, "But Fors will be in the Lord's Mansion."
April nodded and left quickly.
Hobert looked at Captain Dunn, who was walking back and forth, "How do you feel now?"
"I seriously suspect this is a dream." Dunn frowned slightly and said, "I remember Klein said that you are quite frugal when it comes to spending money. Why were you so generous just now?"
"I..." Hobert was dumbfounded. He had only been to Tingen for a few days. How did Klein come to this conclusion? Could it be because I didn't take the initiative to pay the fare when I took the bus with him? Please, you can get reimbursed, okay?
He solemnly said, "Captain, you remembered it wrong. Klein is the stingy one!"
Successfully resurrecting the Captain was a huge encouragement to Hobert!
Before, he always felt that no matter how hard he tried, it would be difficult to change the established reality.
After Captain Dunn was resurrected, Hobert became full of confidence. If he encountered something similar to preventing the True Creator from descending or the Backlund smog again, he would not hesitate to participate and do his best to strive for a result that he was satisfied with!
After letting Allen settle Captain Dunn, he quickly wrote a letter to "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina, hoping to get a permanent charm in the Feynapotter language as soon as possible.
And he put 60 gold Lire in banknotes in the envelope. The extra money was considered the cost of expedited production.
Edwina replied at lunchtime, so in the afternoon, Captain Dunn, dressed in Feynapotter-style clothes, began to chat with the guards of the Lord's Mansion.
Having heard that the scenery here was good, he also took a train ride from the pier to enjoy the scenery of the territory.
However, Hobert wasn't as leisurely as Captain Dunn. He was making the final arrangements for the territory. First, he recalled Conrad. While Archibald and the others were suppressing bandits in the front, Conrad had to establish effective rule in the rear until the entire East Bank was brought under the rule of Jeffrey's territory.
Because of the experience on the West Bank, Hobert didn't need to personally direct this time. He could leave it all to Conrad.
And the situation on the West Bank was now stable, so Corwin could just keep an eye on it.
Next, Hobert spoke with Philip, Roy, Angus, and others separately. He also summoned the ten villagers who had been selected earlier and wanted to become doctors, and chose three people from them, giving them the 'Apothecary' potion.
Of course, he couldn't just let them start working like that. There was a 'Beast Tamer' in the territory's church, and Hobert paid this 'Beast Tamer' to give the three 'Apothecaries' some lessons first.
Then, Hobert asked Mr. Fool to contact 'Moon' Emlyn, claiming that he wanted to buy some herbal formulas from him.
As for the money, it would be deducted from the previous debt.
Although after becoming an 'Apothecary,' one possessed relevant knowledge of herbs, herbal formulas were an experiential thing. Obtaining the formulas could save a lot of exploration.
Soon, Emlyn sent Hobert over thirty Chained formulas through sacrifice and bestowal.
Emlyn wrote on the first page: For herbs without specific dosages, it depends on the extent of the disease, the patient's physical condition, and other factors. 'Apothecaries' have the corresponding Beyonder abilities to accurately do this.
Hobert quickly glanced through it. Almost all common diseases were covered. Perhaps this thing was worthless within the Sanguine clan, but it was of extremely high value to Hobert.
So, the remaining hundreds of pounds between him and Emlyn, the debt agreed to be repaid with potions, was written off.
Finally, Hobert called in Seel and told him to pay attention to the warriors who performed outstandingly during the subsequent bandit suppression. When the bandit suppression mission was over, he would give three to five more soldiers the reward of becoming Beyonders.
After finishing everything in the territory, it was already Saturday morning. After lunch, Hobert took Dunn to the Special Operations Division's courtyard.
The thirty-plus members who had been notified earlier gathered in the conference room.
Unlike the coldness they showed during their first meeting, everyone immediately stood up to welcome Hobert when he entered the room.
Hobert greeted everyone with a smile while walking with Dunn to the head of the conference table.
"I believe you've all heard," Hobert said, and the conference room immediately fell silent.
He said, "I've invited a teacher for you from the Nighthawks, this is Captain Dunn!"
Everyone applauded in support.
"Captain Dunn's greatest achievement is leading two 'Low-Sequence' members to stop the descent of the True Creator."
"Wow ~" Many people exclaimed, and the applause for Captain Dunn gradually became more enthusiastic.
Hobert smiled and said, "A mature official Beyonder system allows you to exert more powerful combat power.
"In the near future, the entire South Colson area will be under our jurisdiction. As a qualified official Beyonder, you must learn how to handle cases and have a rigorous system!
"Okay, I'll just say so much. Now, let's have Captain Dunn give us a lecture."
Amid everyone's warm applause, Hobert quietly left the conference room and stood outside the door, listening to Dunn's lecture: "Your lord was a little wrong just now. At that time, I was leading three members to stop the descent of the evil god.
"The third member is your lord, Hobert!"
"Wow ~" This time, even more people exclaimed!
"It is because he knows enough about official Beyonders," he said with a serious face, "and also understands that these systems are written with blood and tears by generations of official Beyonders, so he hopes that you can master these things and become qualified official Beyonders as soon as possible.
"Today is my first meeting with everyone. Let's first discuss a few common misconceptions that official Beyonders often encounter when solving Beyonder cases…"
Hobert watched Dunn passionately explain the precautions for handling cases in the conference room, and a smile appeared on the corner of Hobert's mouth, revealing a gratified and satisfied smile.
