chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 511 Princess Ethel's Invitation
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Feynapotter City, Huanna District.
Hobert searched back and forth on the street several times: "It seems to be here?"
He stepped into the doorway. The male servant sweeping the floor saw Hobert and asked politely, "Who are you looking for?"
"Looking for your butler." Hobert had forgotten the name of his butler in Feynapotter City.
Seeing Hobert's extraordinary bearing, the male servant asked politely again, "May I ask who you are?"
"Baron Hobert."
The male servant was stunned, a familiar name: "Please wait a moment."
Two minutes later, the butler and the male servant walked out quickly. The butler also clearly recognized Hobert after a few glances before saying, "Your Lordship, we have been waiting for your return!"
The male and female servants in the yard all looked over. It had been more than half a year, and this was the first time they had seen the owner of the mansion.
Only then was Hobert sure: This is my mansion.
He had only stayed here for one night in total before, but so far, he had already spent 6,000 gold Solas for this mansion.
Half of it was for daily expenses, and the other half was for repairs.
Hobert also knew that this kind of repair was purely a waste of money, because he wouldn't stay here for more than a few nights throughout the year.
However, this kind of repair was an attitude, proving that Hobert valued the King's reward, so he went to repair it. And the cost of repairs could not be too high, as that would be equivalent to expressing dissatisfaction with the King's reward.
The act of repairing was not only to show his attitude towards the King, but also to tell the nobles that Baron Hobert's financial situation was very healthy, so as to avoid rumors in the noble circle that were detrimental to Jeffery Territory.
Hobert knew that this group of nobles didn't have any serious business to do all year round, and they were the best at spreading gossip.
Repairing the baronial mansion was an easy task, but it could shut their gossiping mouths, so Hobert was barely willing to spend this money.
Most of these expenses were paid by Dophis, and Hobert later returned the money to Dophis.
Hobert sat in the living room for a while and then said to the butler, "Prepare a carriage for me."
His carriage also came from the King's reward, and he had only ridden it once so far, while the coachman had been on duty for more than half a year, and today was the first time he had driven the carriage.
The coachman, who had nearly ten years of "driving experience," felt a little unreal at the moment he sat in the driver's seat, and he found that he was even a little rusty in how to drive.
More than half an hour later, Hobert arrived at the Life Cathedral. After praying devoutly to the "Emblem of Life" in the front row, Hobert asked the priest to help him find Bishop Simpson.
More than twenty minutes later, Bishop Simpson, with a happy face, came out from the back: "Hobert? Is it really you? I thought the priest had made a mistake. Are you here to attend the National Day banquet?"
"Yes," Hobert said with a smile, "I received His Majesty the King's invitation."
He felt the change in Bishop Simpson's temperament. If he guessed correctly, he was already a demigod.
"Let's talk in the back," Simpson invited Hobert to a room in the backyard of the church.
There were many reception rooms in the backyard for important believers, and the furnishings were all similar, with a table and a few chairs, and a copy of the "Life Bible" on the table.
Hobert first congratulated Simpson, and then asked, "Becoming a demigod, what changes do you feel?"
"I don't feel much change," Simpson said with a smile, "But some of my original abilities have changed a lot. For example, the 'Healing' at Sequence 5 level can only treat physical injuries.
"And the Healing after promotion can also treat some mental corruption or trauma."
Hobert was stunned. The "Healing" at Sequence 5 level could have such abilities?
His "Healing Fork" could treat mental damage, but this kind of damage was only useful if treated immediately. Like the residents on the west bank of Full Moon Lake, the accumulated mental damage could not be treated.
Hobert was sure that the Beyonder characteristics of making the "Healing Fork" were definitely an Beyonder characteristic of Sequence 5 level.
He also thought of April's current state, which made him seriously doubt whether there was something wrong with the Beyonder characteristics of the "Healing Fork" in his hand?
But now was not the time to think about this issue. He just thought about it briefly and continued to chat with Bishop Simpson.
After chatting for a while, Hobert took out a small wooden box: "This is a gift I brought you."
Simpson opened it with a smile: "Why are you being so polite?"
"Open it and take a look, I believe you won't refuse."
Simpson recognized it at a glance: "Blood crystal of the Four-Clawed White Antelope!"
The thing in the box was the Sequence 6 level Beyonder material that April had sold before, and it was the "Planter"'s material.
Hobert smiled and said, "This is an Beyonder material I just received. I could only use the Sealed Artifact to identify it as a material from the 'Planter' pathway. I didn't even bargain at the time, and bought it directly."
Simpson closed the lid of the wooden box: "I'll have the priest go..."
"This is a gift from a friend," Hobert said with a smile, "If you plan to give money, then you're being too polite."
Simpson was slightly stunned: "Just say what's on your mind."
They were already deeply connected together in a relationship of interest, which was more reliable than ordinary friendship, so Hobert didn't beat around the bush: "After the auction house in Jeffery Territory is built, it will be beneficial to everyone. In the future, if you encounter Beyonder materials and Beyonder characteristics of the 'Planter' pathway, I will definitely help you buy them immediately."
Bishop Simpson nodded: "No matter how much money you spend, I can make it up to you."
Hobert smiled and said, "However, I have received relatively reliable news that the royal family is preparing to use tough methods to seize my property in Jeffery Territory.
"So during this period, I have sorted out and reorganized the property in the territory, and established three companies. I hope these three companies can be protected by the church!"
"That's simple," Simpson said, "You donate a sum of money to the church in the name of the company, and I will apply for a 'devout and friendly believer' title for you. I will take care of the formalities for you, and I will get it done for you next Monday."
Hobert clapped his hands: "That's really great!"
These 2,000 pounds were not spent in vain.
"I also brought you something," Hobert said with a smile, "But I think you should present this thing to Archbishop."
Simpson took the wooden box that Hobert handed over. As soon as the wooden box was opened, a ray of morning light shone out from the wooden box. A light yellow, goose egg-sized object covered with holes was slowly beating inside, like a very energetic heart.
It was obvious that it was not an ordinary thing, so Bishop Simpson's gaze turned to Hobert.
Hobert smiled and said, "This is an Beyonder characteristic of a 'Demon Hunter'. I plan to give it to you."
Simpson suddenly thought of Utravsky in Backlund. Thanks to the materials provided by Hobert, this Mother's Chosen had been promoted to "Guardian." Hobert was not giving away Beyonder characteristics, he was clearly giving the Earth Mother Church a demigod!
Simpson closed the box and immediately said, "I'll take you to see the Archbishop."
"Okay."
Arriving at the Archbishop's office, Gabriel quickly got up and smiled when he saw the Beyonder characteristics: "Baron Hobert, thank you for your contributions to the church all along. The church will never forget everything you have done!"
Hobert also smiled and said, "This is all as it should be. After all, I am a devout believer of the Mother Goddess."
"Then we must give something back to show the power of faith."
Seeing that the groundwork was almost laid, Hobert said, "No matter when or what happens, I will always be a devout believer of the Mother Goddess."
Gabriel also said, "We have a lot of protection measures for devout believers, but the premise is that you are within the territory of the Feynapotter Kingdom."
Hobert smiled slightly: "Thank you for your help."
The Archbishop's reply was very satisfying to Hobert. He was saying: As long as you are in the Feynapotter Kingdom, we can protect you no matter what dangers you encounter.
After all, he had given the Earth Mother a demigod, and the value of this was immeasurable.
After chatting for a few words, Hobert said goodbye, and Simpson personally sent him to the entrance of the church.
After watching Hobert's carriage leave, Simpson returned to Gabriel's office: "Your Excellency."
Gabriel looked at the small wooden box sent by Hobert thoughtfully and said, "What kind of danger will he encounter that requires the church's high-level protection?"
Simpson briefly described the conversation between him and Hobert just now, and Gabriel asked some questions about Jeffery Territory, and then immediately made a judgment: "I am afraid that the royal family is not just trying to seize Hobert's property."
Gabriel said, "As far as the South Colson area is concerned, protecting Hobert is beneficial to us."
He thought for a while and then said, "You will return to the church in South Colson next Monday. Since it has begun to prosper, let it continue to prosper."
"Yes!"
...
Hobert did not return to his mansion, but went directly to Christian's mansion. Mona was very happy to see Hobert. After chatting for a while, Christian got off work, Tyron got out of school, and the Earl's mansion gradually became lively.
After dinner, Christian called Hobert to the study, and the father and son talked about the current situation in the Northern Continent.
When Hobert said goodbye, Christian smiled and said, "The National Day celebration is a big event. Prepare well tomorrow and go to the banquet with full energy the day after tomorrow."
Hobert immediately understood: Sure enough, the National Day celebration was the big event Christian mentioned before.
The next day, Hobert first went to school to see his younger brother, Tyron, who was studying at Feynapotter University, also one of the top universities in the country.
Then he went to Christian's mansion again and had lunch with Mona.
In the afternoon, Hobert returned to his mansion, intending to stay home and prepare.
He first readjusted the sealed items he was carrying. He had a limit of two level 1 sealed items, and he finally chose "1-102" and "1-106".
The former summons monsters based on the enemy's level, and can summon monsters at the Saint level at most.
The latter has a good "group attack" skill, wiping out large areas of those below the demigod level.
As for level 2 sealed items, Hobert only planned to bring the "Traveler's Knife", "Spirit Wine Glass", "Healing Fork", and "Zombie Spoon".
Then, Hobert prayed to "The Fool" again, asking for another leave of absence.
He didn't know what would happen tomorrow, so it wasn't a good time to attend the Tarot Gathering.
Just as Hobert was recuperating in the Lord's Mansion, he suddenly received an invitation from Princess Ethel.
This surprised Hobert.
The butler who delivered the invitation did not leave immediately, his meaning was obvious: prepare and leave quickly.
Hobert was about to change into his Baron's formal attire, but then he thought that the invitation was for a regular banquet and didn't need to be so formal.
In noble banquets, there are different specifications for invitations for different occasions, and the wording is also different.
The wording on the invitation sent by Princess Ethel was similar to a private gathering of a few colleagues or friends. Of course, when members of the royal family send out such invitations, it only shows that they value a certain guest, and you can't really treat the princess as a colleague.
But it also meant that it didn't need to be so formal.
So Hobert wore a suit that was more casual, and followed the butler's carriage out of the city.
He met Princess Ethel at a manor outside the city. She still had short hair and was dressed even more casually than Hobert, in a cotton white shirt and light-colored pants.
Ethel's temperament was such that even in such casual attire, Hobert felt a sense of a mature woman.
She looked at Hobert coldly and said, "I heard that you arrived in Feynapotter City yesterday. Do you know anyone here with a higher status than me?"
Hobert was slightly taken aback. These words were obviously criticizing him for not visiting her sooner.
This was actually an oversight on Hobert's part. After arriving in Feynapotter City, he was preoccupied with how to get protection from the church and how to face the dangers that might occur tomorrow.
But publicly and privately, and in terms of etiquette, Hobert should have visited Princess Ethel as soon as possible, after all, she had condescended to attend Hobert's wedding and read out the king's blessings and rewards at the wedding.
If it were another baron, he would often find reasons to visit.
But Hobert was different. He had come to Feynapotter City, but he hadn't taken the initiative to visit Ethel.
Fortunately, Hobert had a thick skin and immediately found a reason: "Your Highness, I have long wanted to visit you, but this time I came to the capital at the invitation of the King to attend the National Day celebration.
If I were to visit you for personal reasons first, I'm afraid some would say that I am disrespecting the King's orders, so I planned to visit you immediately after the celebration."
Ethel coldly 'hmmphed': "Don't let it happen again."
She was obviously satisfied with this reason.
The layout of this manor was not luxurious, but it was full of martial spirit. There were many suits of armor standing in the corridor, and many cold weapons and firearms hanging on the walls.
Hobert wouldn't be surprised if this was the manor of a warlike prince, but it was the manor of a princess.
Ethel, who was walking in front, casually introduced: "This is the manor my grandfather gave me. It is said that it was actually a castle more than a thousand years ago. At that time, the Kingdom of Feynapotter had not yet been established, and there were occasional wars here, so there are some armor and weapons."
What she didn't say was that she rarely used this manor to entertain guests, and only a few of her confidants were qualified to visit here.
Hobert recalled Christian's introduction to Ethel: It seems that her grandfather's title also has a long history.
The restaurant had two windows, one facing west, where you could enjoy the sunset, and the other facing the garden, where you could admire the beautiful flowers and plants.
Dinner was authentic Feynapotter-style cuisine, each dish with a strong olive oil flavor, and they also liked to use garlic and onions as seasonings.
Six out of ten dishes in a noble dinner were seafood, because the Kingdom of Feynapotter had a long coastline, which meant that the kingdom had a rich supply of seafood as food.
But Feynapotter City happened to be inland, and if the transportation was a little slow, the seafood would not be fresh.
Only nobles and wealthy merchants were willing to spend a lot of money to transport seafood by express train, and most of the middle class in the capital could only eat some pickled seafood.
After the dishes were served, the two began to chat about the recent situation in Jeffrey Territory, and the atmosphere of the meal gradually became harmonious, and Ethel's tone was no longer so cold.
After dinner, Hobert accompanied Ethel for a walk in the garden.
In fact, Hobert hated such socializing. He could do whatever he wanted in his territory, but in front of Ethel, he had to appear very well-behaved and respectful.
"Come to Feynapotter City next year." Ethel said suddenly.
Hobert was slightly taken aback at first. This was a normal reaction, because they were just talking about the Kingdom of Feynapotter's railway network, and he didn't understand why Ethel suddenly said this?
Then he realized that this was the purpose of Princess Ethel's banquet: "My territory has not been built yet."
"Half a year is enough for you to build your territory and sort out all the problems in the entire South Colson area." Ethel looked at Hobert with a very dignified gaze: "I know you have this ability."
However, for Hobert, who was also Sequence 5, Ethel's dignified aura didn't work very well: "I have nothing to do in the capital…"
Ethel said boldly: "You can choose any department in the capital. As soon as you come to the capital, you will be the deputy of an independent department. Within three years, I will support you as the head of the department, and within five years, you will have the opportunity to obtain the qualifications of a member of the Upper House."
Hobert gave a thumbs up in his heart, and sighed at Princess Ethel's generosity. This was the way to do great things.
So even though Hobert knew that his life might change dramatically tomorrow, he still asked: "What do you need me to do?"
"Help me accomplish a major task." Ethel smiled: "After it's done, you will at least be ennobled as a Count."
Hobert suddenly realized that this princess might have thoughts of fighting for the throne: "Why did you choose me? Aren't you afraid that I will leak the secret?"
"I have been using the 'Concealment' ability during our conversation." Ethel said: "Even if you are Sequence 5, you will not have the idea of talking to others about this.
Unless you encounter an opponent at the Angel level, even if you are hypnotized by a Beyonder of the 'Spectator' pathway, or 'Spiritually Connected' after death, you will keep our conversation a secret."
As expected of Princess Ethel, she must have this political literacy.
Hobert smiled: "Saying that sounds unlucky."
Princess Ethel shook her head with a smile: "Do you still care about what is lucky or unlucky?"
He might not care at other times, but something big might happen tomorrow, and Hobert still hoped to have a good start.
Then Hobert thought: Princess Ethel didn't receive the notice that something big might happen tomorrow?
Princess Ethel continued with her hands behind her back: "As for why I value you so much, the reason is very simple: you are outstanding!
Several of my capable subordinates are basically soldiers, and they lack political literacy. They are somewhat weak in terms of administration or government affairs.
Another reason is, of course, because I know your background very well and you will not be someone who is against me."
Ethel's eyes became deep, and Hobert of course understood what she meant: Not only is your background in the noble circle simple, but you also represent the power of the "Creator", and you are likely to be a strong ally.
Hobert realized that he was so good. If he were Princess Ethel, he would definitely win over someone like him.
"The conditions are very generous, and I am inclined to agree." Hobert said truthfully: "But this is such a big matter, I still have to go back and consider it, and give you an answer after tomorrow's banquet."
If there were no changes that might happen tomorrow, he would really be inclined to agree.
Going all the way up like this, he would be confident of winning the throne of the Kingdom of Feynapotter in a few decades.
But he also didn't want to be under someone for a long time, and when he thought of the doomsday more than ten years later, this idea only appeared for a short while, and was rejected by himself: Although this method is safe, everything I get in the Kingdom of Feynapotter is likely to become a constraint on me, affecting my development of my own power!
Princess Ethel nodded in satisfaction: "Good!"
She added: "I heard from the intelligence department that the Kingdom of Loen has sent a large number of spies during this period. Although they are not aimed at you and your father, you still need to be vigilant at night."
Hobert was stunned again: "Thank you for your reminder."
"In addition, don't interfere with any other business at tomorrow's celebration ceremony." Ethel reminded again: "Kneel when you should kneel, bow when you should bow, and after drinking and eating, honestly return to your mansion."
Hobert thought: She knows that something big will happen tomorrow.
"I'm just here to go through the motions." Hobert smiled.
After saying goodbye to her, Hobert was on the carriage back, really unable to figure out what Christian would do tomorrow?
But Hobert knew very well that following Christian would definitely lead to good opportunities.
Because he had "1-106", Hobert wasn't afraid of being attacked and rested well that night.
Early the next morning, Hobert took the carriage bestowed by the King to Christian's manor, preparing to go to the Alhambra Palace for the banquet with his father.
When he arrived at the mansion, Christian was just about to leave, but his face was pale, and there were obvious bandage marks under the clothes on his chest. He swayed as he walked, leaning on Mona as she helped him towards the carriage.
Hobert thought to himself: You told me to conserve my energy, what did you do last night?
He quickly greeted him: "Father, are you injured?"
Christian smiled and said, "Last night, I led a team to eliminate several Loen spies. I didn't expect them to have a very powerful sealed artifact, and I was accidentally injured as a result."
"Don't worry, you know my body well. I'll be fine in three or four days at most."
For Christian, a demigod, to be injured and unable to use Beyonder abilities to heal immediately, it was enough to show the power of that sealed artifact.
Mona glanced at Hobert: "Be careful."
Hobert nodded: It seems that today's plan remains unchanged.
The father and son arrived at the Alhambra Palace. As soon as they entered the palace gate, a court earl said to Christian: "Earl Christian has contributed to thwarting the Loen spies' plan. The King has granted special permission for you to rest in the side hall and come out to participate when the celebration begins."
Hobert was stunned: Christian's injury might be part of his plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 512: Descendants of the Blood Emperor
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Stepping through the gates of the royal palace, Hobert, who was supporting Christian, felt a sudden discomfort, realizing he had entered the area of influence of a Sealed Artifact.
Hobert saw guards at the entrance requesting everyone to temporarily deposit their weapons for safekeeping. A nobleman surrendered his weapon, but was stopped again by a guard. The nobleman had no choice but to hand over his mystical items as well.
Clearly, within the range of this Sealed Artifact, the guards had a way of detecting the mystical items hidden on the attendees.
However, the mystical items Hobert carried were sealed within the "Crystal of Order." Unless the rank of the Sealed Artifact exceeded that of a "Sephirot," it would be impossible to detect his mystical items.
At this moment, the Alhambra Palace was bustling with activity. Those who could enter the palace for the banquet were nobles, parliamentarians, high-ranking officials, and members of the royal family.
In Founder's Square, there was an even grander celebration, mainly attended by merchants and commoners. It was said that in previous years, the celebration was presided over by the King, but this year it was the Crown Prince.
When the court earl announced "The King's Special Decree," the surrounding nobles and parliamentarians all heard it. For a time, some were envious, and some were jealous.
Hobert thought to himself: Ferdinand II is a professional king. He has given Christian favor and honor, but also isolated him again, forcing Christian to rely solely on the crown.
The court earl led the father and son through a side door to a relatively secluded side hall.
The court earl was very thoughtful, arranging for two male servants to attend to Christian. After chatting and laughing for a few moments, the court earl politely took his leave.
Christian seemed exhausted. He sat in a chair to rest for a while, checked his pocket watch, and took out a small incense burner from his pocket, handing it to Hobert: "This is a medicinal incense bestowed by the King. It has a pain-relieving effect. Light it."
The two court servants were about to come over to help Hobert light the incense, but Hobert, accepting the incense burner, smiled and said, "I can light it myself."
He opened the incense burner and saw only a brown, egg-sized fruit inside, with no "medicinal incense" at all.
Hobert confirmed Christian's intention, turned his back to the two servants, took the fruit out of the incense burner, and infused it with spirituality.
As Hobert expected, the incense burner was actually a vessel for sealing the fruit, and also a means of avoiding detection by the Sealed Artifact that enveloped the entire palace.
The moment he held the fruit in his hand, he felt an extraordinary power.
The instant spirituality was injected, the fruit levitated, its skin peeled away, and inside was a pure black flower bud.
The flower bloomed rapidly, and black light instantly covered the entire side hall, a sense of tranquility filling the heart, as if the place had suddenly entered night.
The two servants, seeing this scene, were about to run out, but were intimidated by the majesty emanating from Christian. With a "thud," they knelt on the ground together.
Before they could beg for mercy, Christian twisted off the handle of the chair, broke it in half in his hand, and threw it seemingly casually, but accurately hitting the heads of the two servants.
As if struck by a blunt instrument, a large hole was smashed into each of their heads, and they fell to the ground, quickly losing their breath.
Christian changed his previous languid demeanor, stood up from the chair and unbuttoned his shirt. There were indeed bandages on his chest, but there were no wounds inside the bandages. Instead, a small bottle, a pen, and a small box were hidden in the bandages.
The inner layer of the bandages was coated with a thick black liquid, which could obviously also shield against the Sealed Artifact's ability.
The small bottle contained a starlight-emitting, silvery-white liquid. Each time it was shaken, it was like starlight twinkling.
Christian slowly put on his clothes: "It's not easy to deceive Ferdinand II."
Hobert glanced at the flower that continued to emit black light: "So, last night's events..."
"Of course, it was all staged by me," Christian said with a smile. "A few spies, how could they hurt me?"
He opened the small bottle, and starlight filled the air, echoing the white light of the flower.
Christian dipped the pen into the liquid in the small bottle and came to the center of the side hall, drawing a magic circle as he said: "That flower is a Sealed Artifact that can create a small, hidden space."
"Even angels will find it difficult to discover us. We can speak freely in here."
Hobert stood aside and asked, "So, what's the big event happening today?"
"Castilla, the angel we saw when we were ennobled," Christian said with a smile, "He is preparing to try to accommodate the uniqueness of the 'Arbiter' pathway today, on National Day, amidst the people's remembrance of him."
"Well, I believe I don't need to explain to you what uniqueness means, right?"
Hobert nodded: "The people's remembrance, is that the ritual he needs?"
"No, it will make his state very stable, creating good conditions for accommodating the uniqueness," Christian explained. "Of course, the people's support for him is also crucial to him."
Hobert nodded: The people participating in the celebration will act as anchors, and everyone's support for Castilla should be related to the godhood ritual, or simply be part of the ritual. In such an atmosphere, his success rate in accommodating the uniqueness may be higher.
He then asked: "Then your treason..."
"About a year ago, the military obtained a secret intelligence from a high-ranking Feysac Empire spy," Christian explained the whole story in detail:
"This intelligence indicated that the Church of the God of War was going to hand over something very important to the Feynapotter royal family."
"After our investigation, we finally determined that the Church of the God of Combat was actually preparing to give the 'Trunsoest Bronze Book' to Castilla."
"After I learned of this intelligence, I realized that the opportunity I had been waiting for had come. So I risked seeing the King, and George III hesitated for a few seconds before agreeing to my plan."
"Before defecting, although I was mostly acting for the Feynapotter Kingdom's ambassador, some things were not acting, such as the royal family's suppression of me."
"I knew that because of the Rex incident, if there was no opportunity, I would have no hope of using the Loen royal family to advance to demigod in this lifetime. So I suggested that the royal family's suppression might as well be more obvious."
"In addition, the Beyonder ingredients for advancing to demigod were indeed obtained by myself. This is enough to show my ability, and it is also the reason why George III is willing to cooperate with me."
He changed direction and continued to draw the magic circle: "The royal family's increasing suppression of me naturally attracted the attention of the Feynapotter ambassador. Recruiting officials or officers is also one of their important tasks."
"Ambassador Tim quickly approached me. The subsequent events were logical. My secret contact with people from the Feynapotter embassy was reported, and then I had to defect."
"In order to attract the attention of the Feynapotter royal family, I 'exposed' the fact that I had advanced to demigod during this process. After arriving in Feynapotter, I showed my talent, and then captured a batch of Loen spies, showing my hatred for Loen spies."
"Then you also know that I was highly valued by Ferdinand II and gradually gained his trust."
"All of this is for today. I can have enough space and time to build this magic circle within the range of that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact."
"This is very crucial. If this magic circle is outside the range of the Sealed Artifact, our raid will be noticed by the Castilla family from the beginning, and my plan will have almost no chance of success."
At this time, the magic circle had been drawn, and the starlight liquid had just been used up. Christian threw the pen and bottle aside and stretched comfortably.
Hobert asked, "In other words, our treason is just part of the plan?"
"That's right."
"But we have already killed a prince. If we return to Loen, George III..."
Christian smiled and said, "When I told him that I had to kill a prince to gain the trust of the Feynapotter royal family, he agreed without hesitation."
"Afterwards, we can push this matter to the Feynapotter people. I can even catch a Sequence 5 hiding in the Feynapotter embassy to 'close the case'."
Only then did Hobert remember that George III did not care about the life or death of his children.
He pointed to the magic circle again and asked, "Then what is this magic circle for?"
Christian glanced at his pocket watch again. Perhaps it was not yet time, so he put the pocket watch back in his pocket: "In a while, Loen's 'Protector' William Augustus and Duke of Southville Dlink Augustus will use this magic circle to come here. There may also be a few royal demigods."
"One of the abilities of the Sealed Artifact that surrounds the Alhambra Palace is to prevent the entire palace from establishing normal connections with the spirit world, so abilities such as 'Teleportation,' 'Travel,' and 'Underworld Gate' cannot be used here at all."
"But it cannot prevent descents from the astral world. After I build this magic circle, they can first enter the astral world and then descend here accurately."
Hobert thought to himself: Fortunately, it's just going to the astral world. If it were transiting through the cosmos, then... then that seems very dangerous.
Because the relevant memories were sealed by himself, Hobert only knew at this time that the cosmos was very dangerous.
The astral world is the location of the gods' kingdoms, which is still within the protection range of the barrier.
In Hobert's concept, the astral world is probably the distance from the outer layer of the atmosphere to low Earth orbit, while the cosmos is outer space beyond low Earth orbit.
Hobert asked again: "What is your purpose in doing this?"
Christian smiled and said, "I said before when I left Backlund: What the Loen royal family owes me, I will always take back."
Hobert was slightly stunned. He remembered that the sentence that followed was: retrieve it in a way you wouldn't expect.
Sure enough, it was unexpected!
"If the plan succeeds, when I return to Backlund, I will be a duke, with a hereditary seat in the Upper House, and a 'Chaos Hunter' Beyonder characteristic waiting for me." Christian smiled:
"The 'Arbiter' pathway is too tightly controlled by the two royal families. It took me more than ten years to get the opportunity to advance to a demigod, but from what I know, this may be the highest sequence I can reach without any special opportunities.
"If I want to continue to advance, the only way I can think of is to kill a Sequence 3 member of the royal family, or kill the head of the Tudor family.
"But I am not confident in either case, so I have been staying in the Loen military, looking for opportunities."
Hobert vaguely saw a hint of excitement and madness in Christian's eyes. He suddenly realized: This is a descendant of the Tudor family. Usually, they appear steady, resourceful, and have excellent emotional control. But when the opportunity comes, they will gamble everything like gamblers, with the courage to burn their boats. Such people are the type who plan to kill the person in front of them tomorrow, but can still call them brothers today. But deep down, they are sentimental people. As long as they recognize someone as a friend, they will show their very reliable side.
He felt that Christian in front of him was a replica of the "Blood Emperor". At this moment, his temperament was very similar to the impression of the "Blood Emperor" in Hobert's mind.
In the end, Hobert couldn't help but admire Christian's perseverance and his bold plan.
He took a deep breath: "What do you need me to do in a moment?"
"This array only allows entry, not return. After we begin the action to destroy Castiya's containment of the uniqueness, it will definitely attract most of the attention within the royal palace to us. At this time, you go and find the sealed artifact that protects the royal palace." Christian said:
"I only secured the title of viscount for you, but if you can hand over that sealed artifact to the royal family, you will definitely get the title of earl.
"Of course, that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact is worth much more than an earldom. You can also choose not to hand it over, but you will have to leave the Northern Continent with the sealed artifact and be careful of the pursuit from the Loen and Feynapotter royal families.
"You can choose for yourself regarding this.
"If you successfully control the sealed artifact, ignore us and immediately use 'Travel' to leave here, so that everyone can evacuate quickly.
"If you feel it's too difficult, then find your own way to leave the royal palace and ignore us as well."
Hobert nodded: "I understand."
Today, he also had to go crazy with Christian to have a chance to get the title of earl.
Christian pointed to the black flower and said, "Remember to take it with you when you leave. The incantation to put it away is 'Secrecy'. It can make it easier for you to get rid of the pursuit of demigods."
Hobert nodded. Christian, as always, had thought of a way out for him.
Although today's action is quite risky, there are still ways to escape.
Christian looked at his pocket watch again: "Get ready, it's almost time."
He took the small wooden box that he had just hidden in the bandage. Inside was a dazzling small crystal ball, and countless insects seemed to be crawling inside the crystal ball.
Christian smiled and said, "This is an Beyonder characteristic of a 'Secrets Sorcerer'. The royal family is really going all out this time! If those adults don't pick it up later, remember to take it away."
Hobert nodded vigorously. It would be great if he could earn a demigod-level Beyonder characteristic!
Christian placed the Beyonder characteristic in the center of the array, then touched the ground with both hands and injected his spirituality into the array. The array immediately emitted a starlight-like brilliance, and the entire side hall became magical.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 513: Hobert betrayed his country again
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The brilliant light on the array solidified into starlight floating in the air, mixed with the black light emitted from the black flowers, as clear as the night sky.
Seeing that the array was operating normally, Christian knelt on one knee in front of the array and devoutly recited:
"Sword of Order;
"The embodiment of rules;
"The master of all laws;
"The protector of the Kingdom of Loen.
"Your loyal follower begs for your attention and descent!"
After the incantation was completed, the starlight in the array exploded, and in the colorful light, the colored light actually had a misty feeling.
Then a vortex appeared in the color, and it quickly expanded, eventually forming a phantom door.
Suddenly, a somewhat illusory figure appeared in the door, and this figure quickly solidified. A middle-aged man with a cloak, black hair, blue eyes, a square face, and a dignified temperament walked out of it.
The whole process was like a person coming from the distant void to the real world.
Then four people walked out of the phantom door one after another. The second person was a slightly arrogant old man. His black hair was mixed with a lot of silver threads, and he had no beard on his face. This was Duke Dlink Augustus of Southville.
Hobert was familiar with the third person. He had a long face and wore a white wig on his head. Most importantly, he was wearing a dress, a cloak, and extremely long shoe tips, which were out of touch with the current era.
Hobert could be sure that this was the person who hosted the Beyonder gathering in the mercenary club, and should have the level of Sequence 3.
Of the remaining two people, one was a lady in a black dress, and the other was a handsome man with black hair, golden eyes, a neat dress, mature and refined.
The Sequence 3 "Chaos Hunter" who hosted the Beyonder gathering and whose dress was out of touch with the contemporary era was Grov Augustus. The other two were Georgina and Selt, both outstanding members of the royal family's saints.
Of course, the first to come out was the "Protector" William Augustus. He examined Christian and his son who were kneeling in front of the magic circle: "Christian!"
Christian lowered his head: "Your subordinate is here."
"You did a good job." William said in a dignified tone: "According to your agreement with George, there is a Duke title in Backlund, and an Beyonder characteristic of 'Chaos Hunter' is waiting for you."
Then he said to Hobert: "Child, you should be Hobert, right? In Backlund, there is also a Viscount title waiting for you."
This was to reiterate the benefits they could get before the war. The people behind William were all members of the Augustus family. Of course, they did not want an King of Angels to appear in the Feynapotter royal family, so of course they would fight with all their strength.
So before the upcoming battle, William wanted to make a final effort to win over Christian and his son.
Christian and Hobert said respectfully together: "Thank you 'Protector'!"
"Get up!" William said.
Christian got up and said: "I will lead the way for you, and my son will stay and wait for an opportunity to control the sealed item in Alhambra Palace."
"No need to lead the way." William looked outside the door: "I can feel where Castiya is. You guys try to keep up with me!"
After saying that, He walked in the front and left this secret space.
For a moment, the nobles and senior officials who came to participate in the celebration trembled unconsciously, which was a fear and tremor from the depths of their souls.
But they looked around and found nothing was wrong.
William led an angel and four demigods, and swaggered through the front hall, which was the most crowded at this time.
It wasn't that no one noticed them, but everyone was afraid to look William in the eye, or even look in His direction.
After William and the others passed by, everyone realized that something was wrong, and they discussed what big shot had just passed by?
William and others also discovered that there was not a single demigod-level figure in the front hall, which showed that Castiya was also prepared.
Of course, there would be preparations. It would be strange if the Castiya family had no preparations for such a big event.
Christian, who was following behind William and the others, found that although his steps were normal, every step seemed to be able to walk more than 20 meters!
This was because William stipulated: For members of his own side, the distance in front of them was shortened by one-twentieth, so one step was equivalent to the previous twenty steps.
They only took about twenty steps and came to the remote area of the palace. In front of a seemingly ordinary hall, William stopped, and his majestic aura soared: "Philip!"
Philip Castiya was Philip I, the "Founder" of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
A middle-aged man in his forties walked slowly out of the hall. He had black hair, a black beard, and a face full of stubble. He wore a black felt hat and looked very easy-going.
It was Philip I whom Christian and Hobert had met before.
He was still holding the "Trunsoest Brass Book" in his hand, standing in front of the hall and also exuding a majesty that made people dare not look directly at him: "William, you really came after all, but your speed is faster than I expected."
William sneered: "Philip, your tricks are still so naive! So easy to see through!"
They were not only old rivals, but also former colleagues, so they called each other by their names.
Philip I glanced at Christian: "So a little mouse came into Alhambra Palace."
Christian noticed that about one-fifth of the Brass Book had been integrated into Philip I's chest.
William, or rather William I, suddenly drew a silver rapier from the air. Without rushing forward, the distance between Him and Philip I quickly shortened.
The battle suddenly began after these two old rivals simply "reminisced".
Duke Dlink of Southville stepped forward to prepare to flank Philip I. A young man in Feynapotter-style leather armor came in from the side door of the yard: "Dlink, we meet again."
He was Chester, the angel of the Castiya family. He became an angel in the war when he was very young, so he still looks young at this time.
The last time the two fought was in the "War of the Violated Oath" more than 600 years ago, and they were also old rivals.
Chester loudly proclaimed His "Law": "This is the palace of the Feynapotter Kingdom, and the power of the Feynapotter people should be enhanced!"
Dlink also proclaimed His "Law": "For the sake of fairness, the side with fewer people should have their power enhanced!"
The reason why Dlink has such a "Law" is because the saints of the Castiya family, who had been waiting nearby, came to the courtyard one after another, and the battle at the saint level immediately broke out.
After Chester proclaimed his "Law", a silver-white sword appeared in his hand. This was the "Sword of Order", a skill that could only be possessed after becoming a "Balancer".
At the level of "Balancer", they themselves represent order, and the "Sword of Order" is a physical weapon composed of the power of the "Balancer" to control order.
In the blink of an eye, Chester appeared in front of Dlink: "Old thing, I guess you are too old to walk."
Dlink's "Sword of Order" also appeared instantly, blocking Chester's attack: "Little guy, you are still so rude!"
Then He shouted loudly: "Chester Castiya does not respect the elderly and should be punished!"
A solid black leather whip appeared in the void, with sharp barbs, and lashed towards Chester's back.
Chester's body flashed with silver-white light, resisting the attack of the leather whip. He retaliated in kind: "Dlink Augustus, invading Alhambra Palace, should be punished!"
A thick wooden stick appeared from the void, with a sharp ax at the top of the stick.
This specially shaped wooden stick smashed towards Dlink, but it was also blocked by the silver-white light emanating from Dlink's body.
These two old rivals are too familiar with each other, and their battle is impossible to determine the winner in a short time.
The four demigods on the Loen side are only responsible for blocking the demigods of the Castiya family who hold powerful sealed items.
Dlink's eyes glanced towards William I, the key to this battle is still with the two "Firsts".
Fortunately, the process of Philip I integrating the Uniqueness has already begun, and His current state is very unstable. If he is lucky, he can not only stop the enemy's intentions, but also seize the "Trunsoest Brass Book".
...
After William I and others left, Hobert couldn't help but smile. These adults really didn't take away the Beyonder characteristic of "Secrets Sorcerer."
It's not that they don't value this Beyonder characteristic at the demigod level, but they all have sealed items with strong negative effects on their bodies at this time. It is not a wise move to bring an Beyonder characteristic with divinity.
Now they have more important things to do, and this Beyonder characteristic is not that important compared to that matter.
Hobert deformed the fire lacquer seal on his waist, wrapped the Beyonder characteristic of "Secrets Sorcerer", and then put it into his pocket.
If no one asks him for it later, he will of course pretend not to know.
It's public property, so don't take it for nothing.
After waiting for a minute or two, Hobert estimated that the battle had already begun, so he came to the black flower and said in ancient Hermes: "Secrecy!"
The flower retracted and turned into a goose egg-sized fruit again, the black light disappeared, and the state of secrecy no longer existed.
Hobert cautiously changed the shape of the watch key on his waist and wrapped the fruit.
In this way, in the eyes of the sealed item in Alhambra Palace, Hobert has no magical items on his body, and will not "pay attention" to him.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert ran out of the side hall and shouted: "Enemy attack! Enemy attack!"
By now, the outside was already in chaos. Although the battle between Chester and Dlink was of a high level, it didn't seem to create much commotion.
However, the battle at the Saint level felt like they couldn't hold back their strength.
Just now, a door flew over from the battlefield, turning several nobles into minced meat!
Even without Hobert shouting, they knew there was an enemy attack.
Hobert dared to run out and shout so openly because he guessed that his and his father's identities couldn't be exposed so quickly, at least not everyone knew they were betraying the country for the second time.
The last time they betrayed the country, Hobert just went through the motions, but this time he had a substantial mission, which made Hobert somewhat excited.
After joining the chaotic crowd, Hobert breathed a sigh of relief, as this way no guards would notice him.
The momentum of the battle over there grew larger and larger, and everyone basically felt the pressure from the Beyonders, so people began to run out the door one after another.
At this moment, Hobert suddenly shouted: "You fools! Protect the King! Now is when the Feynapotter Kingdom needs us the most!"
He judged that the sealed artifact was likely near the King's current location, because such an arrangement could form an effective response. Ferdinand II and the sealed artifact both needed protection now, and if the two were not far apart, the manpower to protect them could support each other.
But it was definitely not Ferdinand II in control, as that would be too dangerous.
Many nobles were scared out of their wits and didn't want to stay here for a moment. Ignoring Hobert's calls, they continued to run outside.
But some nobles and officials realized that this was indeed an opportunity to show themselves, but they would not remind those fools who only knew how to escape, and instead spontaneously went to the King's bedroom.
After shouting twice, Hobert followed the crowd forward. He didn't know where Ferdinand II's bedroom was and needed these opportunists to lead the way.
The battle over there became more and more intense, and occasionally walls, wood, and corpses flew over, either smashing down several walls or killing and injuring several people.
Hobert sighed: This is as exciting as charging forward in the face of artillery fire.
Some people obviously wanted to retreat, but most people's eyes were still firm. For opportunists, such an opportunity only comes a few times in a lifetime.
Suddenly, the sky was covered with dark clouds, as if it was about to rain, and then lightning struck the ground one after another. Hobert guessed that it should be the sealed artifact used in the battle over there.
Arriving at the bedroom area of the Alhambra Palace, it was already in chaos. Except for the guards who were still holding their posts, the maids and eunuchs were following their masters to safe places to take refuge.
Following the crowd, Hobert arrived outside the Cassia Hall where Ferdinand II was, but was blocked by the guards who were waiting in full force.
The nobles shouted to protect Ferdinand II. After a while, a eunuch came out and shouted: "The King has ordered: You protect the bedroom from the outside. After this battle is over, everyone will be rewarded!"
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief. As long as Ferdinand II let everyone stay, their actions to risk protecting the King would not be buried.
Hobert had already retreated to the back of the crowd. He noticed that there were also many guards guarding a palace not far from Ferdinand II's bedroom.
That should be his target. He reached into his clothes, preparing to take out the two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts.
It was no longer possible to use the crowd to conceal his tracks in the next action. He would be exposed the moment he acted, so the next attack must be fast, accurate, and ruthless!
Boom~
Just as Hobert was about to act, a silver object smashed half of the Cassia Hall.
The silver-white object did not decelerate at all, passing through the crowd and smashing into a palace behind everyone.
Everyone opened their eyes wide, stunned by the scene in front of them.
It turned out that wherever the silver-white object passed, whether it was an Beyonder or an ordinary person, they were smashed to pieces, forming a passage of blood, broken limbs, and internal organs.
The people on both sides of the passage were splattered with a lot of blood!
"Ah!"
It was unknown who shouted first. The nobles scurried away with their heads in their hands. Most of them had never been on a battlefield. Even if they went to the army, they were just there for gilding. Where had they seen this scene?
Even the palace guards were a little shaken. Under the loud scolding of the captain of the guard, they hurried to check the situation in Cassia Hall.
Even Hobert, who had committed so many murders, felt a little nauseous at the sight of this scene.
However, this created an opportunity for him. He also pretended to be frightened, "twisting" the direction in which several nobles were fleeing, and ran towards his target.
While running, he glanced at the palace where a wall had been knocked down by the silver object. If he was not mistaken, the silver object was a person!
Sure enough, Hobert saw the ruins formed by the collapsed wall being lifted, and a figure emitting a silver-white light appeared. It was Celt, who looked mature and refined, but at this time, his originally straight dress had been broken.
At this time, a ray of dawn appeared in the Cassia Hall that had been smashed, and a majestic and tall figure covered with a layer of golden illusory armor appeared there.
Just looking at the silver-white rapier in his hand gave people a feeling of being stabbed.
After a brief accumulation of power, the warrior holding the "Silver-White Rapier" rushed towards Celt, and behind the warrior, there was also a demigod of the Castiya family wearing a Feynapotter-style costume: "Confinement!"
This "Confinement" was used on Celt. Celt reached out his hand, and the ring on his hand emitted a brilliant light. At that moment, the "Dawn Armor" and "Silver-White Rapier" on the warrior appeared on him.
A high-level sealed artifact of the "Marauder" pathway! Hobert thought in his heart.
He guessed that this sealed artifact might have come from the spoils of the "War of the Four Emperors", because at that time, both the Solomon Empire and the Tudor Empire had great nobles of the "Marauder" pathway.
Hobert did not continue to watch the battle. In case any of these three demigods got anxious and showed the state of a mythical creature, then even if he gouged out his eyeballs, it would be useless.
Finally arriving at the target palace just now, Hobert suddenly thought: Why would a demigod of the "Warrior" pathway participate in the war?
… …
Dlink glanced at William I over there. His eyes narrowed. The situation of William I suppressing Philip I and beating him was completely different from what he had imagined.
A middle-aged man who looked a little thin was using the scarlet sword in his hand to block William I's attack.
"Alexei Einhorn!" Of course, Dlink recognized the middle-aged man in front of him. This was the first emperor of the Feysac Empire, a "Conqueror"!
At the end of the Fourth Epoch, Dlink and the others called him Little Einhorn. With the support of the gods, he became the emperor of the Feysac Empire and gave himself a local-style name. Everyone had forgotten his original name.
Philip I on the edge of the battlefield smiled and said: "William, since I knew you would come, wouldn't I have made some arrangements?
"Wait a little longer, and when I merge with the 'Trunsoest Brass Book', you won't be able to leave today."
William I sneered: "Of course I guessed that you had made some arrangements! Hehe! Little Einhorn, when did you become Philip's lackey?"
Alexei had a crimson fireball in his hand: "William, I still remember that you once showed your love to the Queen!"
William I, who had always been quite majestic, had a calm expression, but at this time, the "Hand of Order" had a distorted expression: "Bullshit!"
In a fit of anger, he crushed the talisman that he had been holding in his hand for a long time. A ball of lightning exploded in William I's hand, and then he shouted at Alexei: "Death!"
The silver light of the "Sword of Order" in his hand became more and more intense, as if it could kill Alexei with one blow.
Even Alexei, who was also Sequence 1, had to deal with it carefully, throwing the fireball in his hand towards William I.
However, the silver light around William I made the fireball slide open.
This small fireball floated all the way to the Saint battlefield before exploding, and the Saints were caught off guard and were blown away one by one.
The seemingly ordinary fireball had the power of a missile!
At this time, the angel from the Feysac Empire, Awatoma Einhorn, also slowly walked out, preparing to besiege Dlink with Chester.
Suddenly, he looked at the sky.
It was still sunny just now, but now it was covered with dark clouds.
Awatoma was a little strange, he had not used his weather-related abilities.
Crack~
A thick lightning bolt fell and landed in the center of the battlefield. The lightning dissipated, and a middle-aged man wearing a Storm Church robe appeared there. This person was Pope Gaard II of the Storm Church!
During that time, William I had quietly changed the rules here. The barrier formed by the Grade 0 sealed artifact had a brief loophole, and the helpers he had invited could directly arrive at the battlefield within the next half minute.
But once half a minute had passed, the power of the Grade 0 sealed artifact would repair the loophole.
After Gaard II arrived at the battlefield, he simply distinguished it and rushed towards Awatoma.
The air around him was stirred, forming a wide range of wind blades. The surrounding trees, walls, and several guards who were running away were all cut down by the wind blades. They were blown into the sky by the strong wind and smashed towards the distance.
The Saints even ran away quickly, looking for a new battlefield that would not be affected by the battle between the angels.
Awatoma stomped his left foot forcefully, and within hundreds of meters, raging flames instantly erupted. The fire grew larger and larger with the wind, forming a solid wall that blocked the wind blades.
Crack~
Thick lightning bolts fell continuously. Clyde Wells, the Dean of the Holy Wind Cathedral, arrived at the battlefield soon after. Behind him, several flashes of lightning indicated the arrival of Saints from the Storm Church to provide support.
In the raging flames, a small tree that had not been ignited suddenly began to grow wildly, transforming into a towering tree in the blink of an eye.
Crack~
The tree split open, and Roland, the Pope of the Earth Mother Church, who had planted a seed in this tree long ago, emerged from it. Several Saints followed behind him to provide support.
Once they were all out, the towering tree quickly withered and was immediately engulfed by the raging flames.
Roland's goal was very clear: the Dean of the Holy Wind Cathedral, Clyde Wells.
Whoosh~
A violent roar suddenly appeared in the sky. At some point, a fiery meteorite pierced through the dark clouds and crashed into the Alhambra Palace.
Several coughs echoed from the intense flames of the meteorite's landing. An old man leaning on a cane walked out. He was Demps Solon from Intis.
On the other side, a twilight-like glow covered the fire in the courtyard, and Larrion, the Chief Shepherd of the God Combat Church, joined the battle.
So many Beyonders had suddenly gathered in the Alhambra Palace. The reason why the people in the palace, or in the city of Feynapotter, had not turned into lunatics and monsters was because none of them had manifested the form of a mythical creature.
Most of the Beyonders were only there to help. Whether William I and Dlink could stop Philip I from accommodating the "Trunsoest Brass Book" was the key.
At this moment, Philip I had already accommodated one-third of the Uniqueness. Currently, his condition remained good.
