chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 516: Hobert is on the front page again
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Buck was somewhat exasperated: "Didn't you hear what I said? They have no regard for the law, no regard for the King!"
Simpson smiled: "Of course, they have no regard for the King. This place was abandoned by the royal family for over fifty years, yet it has prospered rapidly under Hobert's management."
"Tell me, what's wrong with them doing this?"
Buck took another step back, encountering such a question for the first time.
Finally, Buck closed the door of the Lord's manor, looking at the empty building alone. He didn't expect that he would eventually compromise with these unruly commoners!
Buck seriously suspected that these people were either hypnotized or psychologically manipulated by Hobert using extraordinary powers, or that their spiritual bodies were simply destroyed, turning them into soulless puppets who only knew how to be loyal to Hobert.
Yes, it must be so!
Buck had seen people whose spiritual bodies were eroded by evil organizations, as crazy and fearless as the people outside.
Outside the door, Bishop Simpson loudly said to everyone: "Don't worry, everyone, Hobert will be fine. Go back, we still have work to do tomorrow!"
If Hobert had died in Feynapotter, he would have already received the news.
After calming the crowd and sending them back, Simpson returned to the church. He was about to pray at the Life Symbol when he suddenly sensed something. He saw a black horse pass through the church window, but the glass on the window didn't break because the black horse was a spirit world creature.
Simpson stroked the black horse's mane and took the letter tube off its back. Then, the black horse disappeared into the church.
This was a messenger from his superior, Gabriel. Opening the letter in the tube, Simpson was slightly stunned by the content: "Contact Hobert?"
...
Tuesday morning, Xio, as usual, rode her newly bought bicycle to do a task.
Just as she wiped the seat, she heard the newsboy shouting: "Extra, extra! Loen spies, father and son, raid Feynapotter City! Hobert secretly planted explosives and blew up the Alhambra Palace!"
Xio was slightly stunned and quickly said to the newsboy: "Give me one!"
Because she was too excited, she took out two extra pennies when paying: "Keep the extra."
Saying this, she couldn't wait to read the contents of the newspaper.
After thanking her, the newsboy continued to sell newspapers loudly.
Xio saw the headline on the front page: The Christian father and son turned out to be pretending to surrender!
The subtitle was: They almost assassinated Ferdinand II!
She stood in front of her bicycle and read quickly. The general content of the report was: Christian and Hobert received a secret mission from the King to assassinate Ferdinand II.
So, the royal family staged a play with Christian, making it seem as if Christian was being ostracized, which eventually led to the defection that shocked the Northern Continent more than half a year ago!
During that incident, a Prince was actually assassinated by a Feynapotter spy. In order to allow Christian and his team to better complete the assassination mission, the blame was placed on them.
After more than half a year of planning, Christian and Hobert launched their attack on Feynapotter National Day, but unfortunately, the assassination failed. However, the bombs planted by Hobert destroyed a large number of palaces in the Alhambra Palace, killing and wounding many nobles and officials, and achieved amazing results.
Xio looked up: Am I still dreaming?
She clenched the newspaper and was stunned for a few minutes before she seemed to suddenly realize something and ran back to her rented house quickly.
Arriving at Fors's bedroom door, Xio injected spirituality into her hand as she turned the handle. Opening the door, she saw Jeffrey's Territory, with its exotic architectural features, and the mansion of Baron Felix.
At this time, Fors on the bed was already awake, but she was lying on the bed staring at the ceiling in a daze, with no intention of getting up.
"Fors, where's Hobert?" Xio rushed in with the newspaper and asked.
Fors glanced at Xio lazily and tightened the collar of her pajamas: "He said in the letter that he has returned to Backlund."
Xio glanced at the newspaper again: "So, this is true? Hobert defected before in order to assassinate Ferdinand II?"
Fors took the newspaper and looked at it: "This report... That's right, the newspaper certainly can't report that there was a battle at the Saint level in Alhambra Palace yesterday!"
Xio was surprised again, but she immediately realized that the report in the newspaper was just a disguise: "Then what's the truth?"
Fors stretched hard and was still considering whether to get up now or wait a while: "Hobert said in the letter..."
She briefly described Hobert's letter from yesterday to her friend. Only then did Xio know that such a fierce battle had taken place in Alhambra Palace yesterday.
Then Xio realized: "So, you and Hobert are going back to Backlund?"
"He's going back to Backlund."
"You're not going back?"
"Xio, I'll take you to a place!"
Fors finally made up her mind: There's no way, I have to get up now.
She took Xio on a boat, bypassing Jeffrey Town. Along the way, Fors introduced the surrounding scenery to Xio.
Xio hadn't had time to appreciate the beauty of this place the previous few times she came to Jeffrey's Territory. Only now did she realize that the scenery on both sides of Full Moon Lake was quite beautiful, and both sides were under construction, looking full of vitality.
The two of them landed from a small port on the other side of the mountain. After arriving here, the scene was different from the west bank. The people working in the fields put down their work and greeted Fors: "Lady of the Territory!"
"Madam Baron!"
"Madam, is the Lord okay?"
Many people came to inquire about Hobert's situation, and Fors patiently explained to them that Hobert was safe.
After hearing the news that the Lord was safe, everyone was relieved and returned to the fields to continue working.
Xio sighed: "I didn't expect you to be so loved by the people."
"It's not that I'm loved," Fors smiled. "They love Hobert, and I'm just basking in the glory."
"If you keep walking forward from this valley, you'll know why they love Hobert."
Continuing forward, they came to the new territory that the King had just conferred to Hobert. Xio immediately felt the poverty and numbness here.
Xio finally understood that it was under Hobert's leadership that the people in the villages just now had become wealthy, which was why they loved Hobert so much.
They came all the way to a manor with beautiful meadows. At this time, the manor's buildings were being repaired and would not be habitable for some time.
But this still does not affect this beautiful, vibrant meadow.
Xio took a deep breath: "I've only seen such beautiful scenery in oil paintings."
Fors sat on the grass, looking fascinated: "The moment I saw the scenery here, I felt that this was the territory in my heart."
She smiled slightly: "But, Xio, in Hobert's eyes, this is just a place to rest."
Xio also sat next to Fors, seemingly understanding what her friend meant.
"I really like the life here," Fors smiled. "So, let me take care of Hobert's first territory. In Backlund, in Loen, there is a broader stage waiting for him."
"But it must be full of intrigue and deception. Whenever he is tired, he can come back and rest, and the door here will always be open for him."
Xio realized for the first time: Fors is a wife!
...
Outside Feynapotter City, in a luxurious royal manor.
Philip I, sitting in the darkness of the hall, breathed with a "whooshing" sound, as if suffering from severe bronchitis.
Ethel stood in the light in the hall, bowing her head and quietly waiting for Philip I to ponder.
Philip I said: "In other words, the one who summoned that giant bird was an existence called 'The Creator'?"
"That's what I guessed," Ethel said. "Last year, we received information about 'The Creator'. His forces defeated the 'Rose School' in the Southern Continent."
"It is said that there was a fierce battle at the Angel level at that time, and 'The Creator' personally took action to prevent the leader of the 'Rose School' from descending."
"And I inadvertently learned that Christian's son, Hobert, is a favored one of 'The Creator'. Could it be that Hobert asked 'The Creator' for help, and 'The Creator' sent that giant bird to the battlefield?"
Because she was in front of a "Hand of Order", Ethel was not worried that her secret report would be known to "The Creator". Moreover, she did not tell Philip I about her connection with "The Creator".
"Perhaps, the actions of the Hobert father and son were also authorized by 'The Creator'," Philip I said after a short silence. "At that time, I felt a lofty power, like the 'Black Emperor' and the 'Justiciar'."
He once served Solomon and later Trunsoest, so he was very familiar with the True Gods of these two pathways.
Philip I said: "'The Creator' probably doesn't want me to accommodate the Uniqueness either, but..."
But the state of this "Creator" is very strange. He can obviously corrupt the "Trunsoest Brass Book" and has a very high position.
But strangely, the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar" pathways should not be with "The Creator".
This reminded Philip I of some words he heard from Trunsoest more than a thousand years ago about the Outer God named "Uncertain Mist": Could "The Creator" be an identity designed by "Uncertain Mist" to make it easier to descend power?
However, these intelligence could not be told to Ethel, so Philip I simply changed the subject after saying half of it: "Pay close attention to the relevant information about 'The Creator'."
"Yes," Ethel said, "Then the plan I just mentioned?"
Philip I coughed twice before smiling: "What a smart child, your analysis is also very reasonable, but I have to consider it again."
At the same time, He was also considering whether to let Ethel lead the Castiya family? He found that the family members were either indignant and wanted to retaliate against the Kingdom of Loen, or they were polluted and completely lost their fighting spirit. The princes were also very disappointed in their ideas in order to achieve their respective goals.
Only Ethel was still considering how to solve the problem.
...
Kingdom of Loen, East Chester County, in the Earl of Hall's manor.
Because it was far from the city, the newspaper was not delivered here until noon.
Audrey couldn't wait to open the newspaper. After taking a look, she shook her head: The palace was not destroyed by Hobert! This is covering up the truth!
She noticed that there was also a message at the end of the report: Hobert and Christian were commended by the King and will be conferred titles this Saturday. The father and son will also receive a hero's treatment, ride in the King's car into the city, and receive the welcome and cheers of the people.
Audrey suddenly realized: Hobert will return to Backlund as a nobleman!
Because there was no one else in the room, Susie asked with her tongue out: "Audrey, what makes you so happy?"
"A friend of mine is coming back," Audrey smiled. "Returning like a hero."
Speaking of this, she suddenly thought: "Father is going back to Backlund tomorrow, I want to go back with him to witness the moment Hobert is conferred the title."
After speaking, she put down the newspaper and left the room with a solemn expression as usual to talk to her father about this matter.
Susie sighed in the room: "It's a pity, I haven't played enough on the grass here."
...
Backlund, Cherwood Borough.
Jessica stood at the door of the law firm and finished reading the headline of the newspaper.
Then she smiled: "Lawyer Hobert is back!"
...
St. George Borough.
Melissa had already started her studies at Backlund Technical University. When she went downstairs for breakfast, she saw Benson staring at the newspaper: "What's the news today?"
"There's big news!" Benson raised the newspaper. "Hobert's previous defection turned out to be carrying out a secret mission for the King. Now Hobert has returned to Backlund, and it is said that the King will confer him a title."
Melissa was slightly stunned and leaned over to read a few sentences of the report: "This is indeed big news."
She planned to write to Elizabeth as soon as she got to school to tell her the news.
However, she believed that Elizabeth should have also seen this report.
...
Awwa County.
Ulysses hammered the table and laughed: "I said, Chief Christian must have his plan. After such a round trip, he will definitely be conferred the title of Duke!"
He walked back and forth in front of his desk happily for a few steps before going back to continue reading: Hobert must have played a significant role in this incident, otherwise this report would not have used so much space on him.
Ulysses suddenly thought: Isn't Elizabeth planning to apply for a university in Backlund? He could send her to Hobert to help take care of her. Young people should communicate and interact more.
...
On this day, the streets and alleys were shocked by the news in the newspapers.
Some people did not expect that the "traitor" who everyone was shouting to kill half a year ago was actually a national hero!
Some people did not expect that the royal family had planned such an amazing conspiracy.
Others envied the King's reward to the Hobert father and son, guessing what title they would get.
In short, today's report made Hobert once again receive the attention of the people of Loen, and this time the attention was even higher than last time, because the whole incident had a thought-provoking story and even had a certain legendary nature.
Often such characters are the easiest to be remembered by the people.
Hobert, who was recuperating at the royal manor outside the city, was unaware of these events. This morning, he received a letter from Bishop Simpson, stating that several demigods from the Church of the Earth Mother had suffered varying degrees of contamination during yesterday's battle and requesting Hobert's assistance in resolving the issue.
This slightly surprised Hobert: Why didn't they seek help from the Earth Mother?
Unbeknownst to Hobert, the saints of the Church of the Earth Mother had immediately sought help from the Mother, but the Mother's response was unexpected.
Roland entrusted this matter to Gabriel, who in turn asked Simpson, the one most familiar with Hobert, to address it.
These demigods were not interested in politics. To them, yesterday's battle was Philip I's fight to accommodate the uniqueness.
Or rather, it was a war between two extraordinary families, not a war between two nations.
Therefore, they didn't pay much attention to Christian and Hobert's betrayal. Besides, even a patriot would compromise when their life was at stake.
Moreover, with the Earth Mother's endorsement, they were even less likely to care about Hobert's political stance.
Simpson understood Hobert's temperament, so in his letter, he only asked for Hobert's help, without mentioning his assistance in protecting the people of the Jeffery region.
He knew that if he mentioned what he did last night, Hobert would feel threatened by the situation in the territory.
He would help, but at least not until next week.
Hobert pondered for a moment and concluded that this was not Simpson's plan to trap him. Simpson knew that Fors was in the territory. If the Church of the Earth Mother decided to help the royal family and not protect Hobert's assets, Simpson would definitely try to capture Fors first.
In that case, Archibald, with the "Desire Apostle" as his Marionette, would be alerted in advance and would definitely take Fors away from the territory at the first opportunity.
Since none of these things had happened, it meant that the cooperation between the Jeffery region and the Church of the Earth Mother was still solid.
Another reason Hobert was willing to help was to treat Christian's injuries.
Hobert believed that the Church of the Earth Mother should have a method to heal Christian.
After deciding to help, Hobert immediately replied to Simpson, briefly mentioning the issue of treating Christian and inviting the saints to Loen for treatment.
After replying, Hobert went to inform Christian about the matter.
Upon hearing that Hobert had contacted the Church of the Earth Mother, Christian felt he could suffer less in the coming days: "I'll take you to a place."
Although it was a royal manor, their surveillance was not strict.
The father and son used "Travel" to reach a small wooden house, surrounded by dense forests. The northern trees had already grown tender leaves, well concealing the location of the small wooden house.
"This is a safe house that Rex and I set up back then, located in the northern part of the Tucker Plain, in the Hornacis Mountains. It's very hidden and safe," Christian said. "Please have your friends from the Church of the Earth Mother come here to treat me."
They had already left Feynapotter and couldn't let others know that they were still in contact with people from the Church of the Earth Mother.
Hobert marked the location with the "Traveler's Knife": "No problem."
Then, the father and son returned to the manor. In the afternoon, they finally received a reply. Simpson said that the saints had agreed to come to Loen to resolve the contamination issue, but only if there was a hidden place.
Hobert wrote another letter, asking Simpson to find him. After sending the letter, Hobert went to the safe house that Christian had just taken him to see.
As for how Simpson would find him, Hobert believed they would have a way.
Sure enough, Hobert had only been in the safe house for a dozen minutes when Simpson opened the door and entered, as if visiting a friend's house. He smiled and said, "I didn't expect you to do such a big thing yesterday!"
Hobert smiled wryly: "I'm just a small character; I didn't play much of a role inside."
Simpson didn't know the details of yesterday's battle. Even if he did, he wouldn't have thought that the giant bird at the end was summoned by Hobert.
To Simpson, a Sequence 5 was indeed a marginal figure on a battlefield like yesterday's.
Simpson briefly talked about the situation in the Jeffery region, and finally he said: "...Now Buck doesn't even bother hiding in the lord's mansion anymore. He knows the mission is definitely not going to be completed, and it's useless even if he comes out."
Hobert also smiled: "The royal family probably doesn't have much energy to manage the Jeffery region right now."
Once the Feynapotter royal family recovers from the shadow of yesterday's defeat, the territory should face another crisis. That's when they will truly have to play a game with the royal family. However, with the support of the Church of the Earth Mother, Hobert is confident in completing this game with the royal family and protecting his assets in the Jeffery region.
Once that crisis is overcome, the Jeffery region will truly be safe.
But now is certainly not the time to talk about this. Hobert then asked Simpson why he had sought him out to solve the contamination issue.
Simpson said frankly: "I heard this is from the Earth Mother's guidance."
Hobert opened his mouth, wondering when he had come under the Earth Mother's gaze.
He then thought of his experience at the Boklun Mountain Manor at the beginning of the year, which made him wonder: Are the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother, or rather, beings at the level of True Gods, unable to eliminate the corruption from the "Nation of Disorder"?
Hobert shook his head gently: Probably not, but even if they have a way, it should be more troublesome. It's simpler and more convenient to issue a divine decree: "Go and invite the Tathagata... cough cough, go find Hobert".
Then Hobert thought: I wonder what reward the Earth Mother will give me? Hey? Did the Mother not mention a reward in the divine decree? The Evernight Goddess did mention it.
However, Hobert thought that the gods shouldn't default on their debts and would definitely give him some reward.
It's just that these rewards might be delivered at any time, and he might have already received them, like the bracelet he got before entering Boklun Mountain Manor.
Wait, Hobert thought again: The Earth Mother probably knows that these people's corruption comes from the "Nation of Disorder", so is the Mother telling them to come to me, is she saying: Deal with it yourself!
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled somewhat guiltily: Forget it, I already promised Simpson, so I'll help even if there's no reward.
While thinking about his thoughts, Hobert chatted with Bishop Simpson for a while before Gabriel and several other saints arrived one after another.
Simpson was responsible for scouting the way. If Hobert had any problems, Simpson would use the talisman in his pocket to send a signal.
If Hobert had no problems, they would come over a dozen minutes after Simpson arrived.
Although there were instructions from the Mother, they still had to be careful.
Hobert politely stepped forward, shook hands with Gabriel, and nodded to the other saints.
The saints didn't look like they had been contaminated, only a little pale.
This was only because they had been contaminated for a short time, and it hadn't spread in their bodies yet.
After exchanging a few polite words with Gabriel, Hobert said: "I received baptism from Bishop Utravsky. No matter which country I am in, I am a devout believer of the Mother."
The baptism of each church is equivalent to a screening. As long as they can pass the baptism, not to say how devout they are to the Mother, at least they have no malice.
Hobert said this to introduce himself, and also to explain to everyone that he had passed the screening of the baptism, and that the baptism was conducted by the Mother's blessed.
Sure enough, after Hobert said this, everyone's defensive psychology was obviously not as strong as before.
"Next, I will pray for the power of a mysterious existence to remove the corruption on everyone," Hobert smiled. "That existence is indeed very good at removing certain corruption. The loving Mother and the Evernight Goddess both know this."
Bringing out these two gods is of course to set off the status of "Creator" from the side.
And the so-called "some specific corruption" refers to the corruption of the "Nation of Disorder". I can't guarantee that it is useful to find the "Creator" for other corruption.
Everyone was relieved to hear that the Earth Mother and the Evernight Goddess both said it was good, and they all smiled and complimented a few words, asking Hobert for help.
Hobert then began to set up the altar, lit the candles, and began to recite the "Creator's" honorific name: "The Creator of Human Order;
"..."
Next is the prayer part: "Your devout servant, prays for your power, prays for you to eliminate the corruption on the people in front of the altar."
After Hobert read it aloud once, he repeated it again, his voice getting smaller and smaller, and finally became a silent recitation.
The demigods behind him were lined up together, and their expressions gradually became solemn, which was the most basic respect for the gods.
After Hobert began to recite silently, he stepped back slightly and stood there completely still.
His astral projection had actually gone to the "Nation of Disorder". Hobert sat on the "Iron Throne" and then spread his spirituality to the star that represented him.
Through "True Vision", Hobert saw that, in addition to Simpson, the five saints including Gabriel were indeed entangled in a wisp of thin black mist.
Different from the corruption of "Uncertain Mist", these black mists immediately resonated with the "Nation of Disorder".
Of course, there will be resonance, after all, they all come from the "Nation of Disorder", but Hobert can treat this corruption like the "Trunsoest Brass Book", let this corruption detonate, quickly and completely corrupt the other party, and can also completely eliminate the corruption.
Hobert smiled: It's just that I won't choose the extra choice.
In order to make the cooperation between the Jeffery region and the Church of the Earth Mother closer, Hobert projected a lot of power into his star.
...
In the real world, Simpson and others felt something in their spirituality and saw a figure sitting in a forest of swords in the air.
He exuded a sacred brilliance, as if he could end all chaos, and as if he could bring complete chaos.
He exuded an aura of majesty, causing people to lower their heads unconsciously, and wanting to surrender unconsciously.
Simpson and others knelt on one knee and lowered their heads. They realized that this was a real god!
Then Gabriel and others felt a lightness all over their bodies. The coldness mixed in the spiritual body and the body was being quickly drawn away. Soon they all felt their bodies begin to warm, and their spirituality also felt that the very high-level contamination in their bodies was eliminated.
It wasn't until Hobert in front of the altar said: "Praise the 'Creator'."
Everyone woke up like a dream and thanked Hobert one after another.
Hobert smiled: "I will convey your thanks to the 'Creator'."
He continued: "I will bring my father over now."
Gabriel said to his colleagues: "You go back first, I will stay and treat Hobert's father."
The other four demigods thanked Hobert again before leaving one after another. Finally, only Simpson and Gabriel were left in the small wooden house.
"Please wait a moment." Hobert used "Travel" to return to the royal manor and brought Christian to the small wooden house.
After a few simple polite words, Gabriel began to examine the wound.
At this time, Hobert realized that Christian's sternum was directly broken, and several ribs were also broken. With a little force, the bones and muscles of the entire right chest could be lifted directly.
The right lung inside was also injured. If it was an ordinary person, such an injury would have killed him long ago.
Gabriel checked and said: "Don't expect the wound to heal itself. The order of this part of your body has been directly destroyed. Even if you are a demigod, it won't be long before it will fester and necrosis, and eventually the order of your whole body will be out of balance."
Hobert asked nervously: "Your Excellency Archbishop, is there any way?"
"The only way is to remove the damaged tissues around the wound." Gabriel said: "Then let the cut muscles, bones and internal organs grow back."
Before Hobert could ask anything, Christian smiled and said: "Then let's start."
Gabriel put on a mask and took out his portable kit, which contained scalpels, hemostats, scissors and other tools, a total of more than a dozen.
The surgery was performed on the dusty floor of the small wooden house.
Even though it was a mystical surgery, it took more than an hour.
Gabriel first removed the parts that could no longer heal themselves, which cut out a huge wound. Christian's entire right lung and right chest were basically cut off.
Hobert could clearly see Christian's posterior ribs and spine.
Then Gabriel used the "Stone of Life" and portable potions to quickly start the growth of the missing parts.
The right lung grew first. As Christian breathed, it contracted and expanded. Compared to the previously malfunctioning lung, the newly grown lung looked healthy and vigorous.
Then came the sternum, ribs and muscles, and finally the skin. After the wound healed, there was nothing different except that the muscles there looked more tender.
Even the nameless finger that Christian was missing grew back.
Hobert sighed in his heart: This surgery is really eye-opening, but unfortunately it is difficult to popularize.
After the surgery, Christian got up and moved around, feeling no discomfort at all.
After thanking each other, they left the small wooden house one after another.
...
Backlund, Sodela Palace.
In a remote palace, William I, sitting on the throne, listened to the report from Mitchell, a demigod from MI9, who was kneeling below.
He asked: "Before that, there was no information about the 'Creator'?"
"There is a piece of suspected intelligence." Mitchell lowered his head. Of course, he knew who was on the throne, so he said without reservation, "In October of last year, facing the provocations of the Feysac Empire, we sent several mercenary groups to strike at the forces of Feysac in the Southern Continent.
"This battle went very smoothly and achieved considerable results. However, when cleaning up the battlefield, someone snatched an Beyonder characteristic and a Sealed Artifact.
"When the mercenaries chased after the opponent, a mysterious being covered the robbers' escape and erased his traces with very mysterious means."
"Later, after divination, it was discovered that the person who snatched the Sealed Artifact was a member of the Balk family, but the existence that helped the Balk family member escape could not be divined for any information about Him.
"At the end of last year, that battle took place in the Southern Continent, one of the sides of which was the Balk family. Therefore, I and several colleagues associated this with the previous incident and believed that the 'Creator' had long been sheltering the Balk family."
William I nodded: "Very good, you have done your job well!"
He thought in his heart: So, that young man named Hobert is also a blessed of the 'Creator'!
After returning from the battlefield of Feynapotter, William I realized that at that time, there was an adjacent pathway, an existence similar to a god, constantly watching the battlefield.
But this puzzled him, because he knew very well where the uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' pathway and the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics were.
So he first secretly summoned Christian and asked about the giant bird, but did not get the answer he wanted.
He also thought of the 'power of order' he felt from the giant bird at that time. He was almost certain that it must have come from the 'Justiciar' pathway or the 'Black Emperor' pathway.
William I thought for a while, but did not remember any 'old guys' with a similar feeling, so he judged that this existence must have appeared recently.
He summoned the intelligence personnel of MI9 and immediately locked onto the target.
William I rewarded Mitchell and then fell into deep thought.
This reminded him of the words he had heard in Trunsoest and associated them with the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Having seen the second 'Blasphemy Slate', he of course knew what the 'Nation of Disorder' represented, which made him think: I suspected that the Night Emperor had made arrangements in the 'Nation of Disorder' back then. Could it be that He has been resurrected in the 'Nation of Disorder'?
In the end, William I believed that the 'Creator' had not shown malice towards the Augustus family, and he could try to win over Hobert to see if he could obtain more information.
...
Thursday, Backlund, in the luxurious villa of Earl Hall.
Audrey returned with her father, because a large number of servants had gone to the fief, so the villa looked relatively empty.
But that's not to say that there were no servants here. Even if Earl Hall and his family were not there, there were at least fifty servants in this villa taking care of it.
They had to clean every day, and maintain the lawns, flowers and trees.
That night, Earl Hall invited his good friend Earl Wolfe to his home for dinner.
Because it was a private invitation between good friends, there was no band or dance party, only a sumptuous dinner.
Audrey sat at the lower end of the table, listening to the conversation between the two earls.
Only three people were dining in the luxurious and spacious restaurant, but it did not seem empty because there were many servants.
"I just met Countess Georgiana yesterday," Earl Wolfe said, taking a sip of wine, "The Countess said that Hobert made outstanding contributions in this operation, and the King will give him a special reward.
"I guess this young man may be directly ennobled as an Earl."
Audrey's fork paused slightly. She originally thought that Hobert would be ennobled as a Viscount at most, but she did not expect that he would be directly ennobled as an Earl! In that case, Glaintet would have to bow or kneel on one knee when he saw Hobert.
Earl Hall laughed happily: "Then Duke Reagan should take action."
Duke Reagan was an old aristocrat, but because of the rise of new capital and the reform of abolishing the Corn Laws, his property had shrunk drastically. Last year, he was on the verge of bankruptcy and could only barely support himself by marrying into wealthy businessmen families and lower-level nobles.
Because the objects of his marriage repeatedly broke the nobles' bottom line, the nobles often joked about him in private.
"It's not just Duke Reagan." Earl Wolfe, who had been in Backlund for some time, smiled and said, "Lord Quint and Lord Sylvester have also expressed strong interest in this.
"After hearing that I had helped Hobert, they all asked me to introduce their daughters to Hobert."
These two lords were both millionaires in Backlund and were now very influential members of the House of Commons.
However, the power of the Loen Kingdom was still mostly concentrated in the hands of high-ranking nobles, so they would definitely lean towards the nobles and let their daughters become countesses, which would allow them to successfully integrate into the high-ranking nobles.
At this time, Audrey couldn't help but say: "Uncle Wolfe, I heard that Hobert is already married. Don't Duke Reagan and the others know about it?"
"Of course they know." Earl Wolfe smiled and said, "But that was a marriage in the Kingdom of Feynapotter. What does it have to do with the Kingdom of Loen? Even if Hobert remarries in Loen, it won't have any impact."
He even believed that it was inevitable for Hobert to remarry, after all, although the father and son had very high titles, they did not have very solid relationships among the high-ranking nobles.
If they could have a marriage alliance, they could integrate into the circle of nobles.
Christian does have a son, but in Wolfe's opinion, that son has not yet reached the sincerity of marriage.
Audrey was a little surprised: It can be like this!

Feysac Empire, Dusk Cathedral.
Chief Larrion was lost in thought as he looked at the "Trunsoest Brass Book" in front of him. Just now, the God of Combat had re-sealed the "Brass Book", making it look even more ancient.
It can now be used as a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact again, but the negative effects are a bit significant.
At the same time, during the sealing process just now, the God of Combat told Larrion that the corruption of the "Brass Book" came from the Sephirot "Nation of Disorder", and this Sephirot seemed to possess a certain degree of intelligence.
Larrion was pondering: I had only heard before that Uniqueness, under certain conditions, would possess a certain degree of intelligence. I didn't expect that "Sephirot" also has such characteristics! But fortunately, the other party is not entirely an opponent, because in addition to being interested in the "Brass Book", they should also be very interested in the Beyonder characteristics within Philip I and William I.
Putting away the "Brass Book", Larrion lifted his foot and walked towards the entrance of the cathedral. Awatoma of the Einhorn family was still waiting there, hoping to find out who the opponent was this time.

The Berserk Sea, Chasm of Storms.

"A descendant of the family will follow a descendant of the Night Empress from the Northern Continent to regain the family's glory," Dophis did not hide anything.
Hobert asked again: "Is it convenient to say which family you belong to?"
"My surname is Eggers."
Hobert almost couldn't hold back: "You, you think too highly of me. I only have such a small fiefdom now. Do you think we can help you restore the rule of the Underworld Emperor? That's unifying the entire Southern Continent!"
"It only says to restore glory, not to restore status and the throne." Dophis had considered this point long ago: "As long as the family's glory can be restored, the Aggers family will not have constant internal strife like it does now, and the family will have hope of revitalizing.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 518: The first group of members of Redemption Rose (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Prasant for becoming a free member]
Hobert remembered that the descendants of the Underworld Emperor did seem to be divided into many factions, among which the "Royalist Faction" and the "Artificial Death God Faction" were the strongest and most famous.
It seemed there were also smaller factions such as the "Sleeping Faction" and the "Underworld Faction," which was a typical consequence of not having a real leader or a spiritual leader.
Like a competent king, he must set a goal that most people in the country can accept and are willing to work towards, and then the prime minister, nobles, and officials all work towards this goal.
This way, everyone has something to strive for, and even if there are some conflicts, there is a higher tolerance for errors.
The situation of the Eggers family clearly lacked a goal that everyone could accept. The nobles, prime minister, and officials all had their own ideas, and over time, they naturally began to divide into factions.
Now it seems that within the Eggers family, there are still people like Dophis who hope that the family can reunite and revitalize.
Hobert did not continue to inquire about the Eggers family's situation. He just smiled and said, "I dare not promise you anything, because I know that predictions like this may only be off by a little bit, but the reality can have huge deviations."
Dophis nodded: "I know, even if I misjudge again, I won't blame you."
Hobert smiled: "Be optimistic, maybe this time it's right?"
He didn't continue the topic: "Okay, then Mr. Dophis, from now on, you are my butler."
He took out all the banknotes from his wallet, about 300 pounds: "First, help me thank the servants sent by the royal family, and decide how much to give as a thank-you fee.
"Then start hiring servants for me. Well, next week I want to hold a small tea party, a friendly one, no need to be too grand, help me prepare."
Dophis took the money and said: "This money is not enough.
"Recently, I did some research. A count's mansion needs 60 to 200 servants, but if there are only 60 servants, people will think that the count's finances are in trouble, but 200 servants are too extravagant.
"So, a normal count's mansion usually hires 120 to 150 servants, and there is also the manor bestowed by the king, which also needs at least 30 to 50 people to manage.
"You also need to hire an accountant and two cashiers to record the output of the manor, as well as the rent or harvest that the farmers in the manor need to pay."
Generally speaking, the grapes, vegetables, cattle, and sheep in the manor are directly managed by the count's mansion.
However, the area of this kind of manor bestowed by the royal family must be small, and there will be a lot of cultivated land, and generally the cultivated land in this kind of manor is very fertile.
In the past, it was popular for counts to hire farmers to cultivate the land, paying the farmers a fixed salary every year, and all the output belonged to the count's mansion.
But this quickly led to a new problem, because it was a fixed income, everyone had no motivation, and the yield of the farmland was not as good as ordinary land.
So now it is popular for farmers to rent the count's farmland for cultivation, giving a certain rent or handing in a certain proportion of the harvest every year.
Calculated, the count's mansion had more income than before, so this method quickly became popular in the manors of the nobles.
"Of course I know." Hobert smiled wryly: "I'll give you another 5,000 pounds later."
Dophis nodded: "I will take out some of the money to repair the count's mansion again."
Hobert thought that there would be two hundred more mouths waiting to eat every day in the future. He couldn't help but sigh deeply, but in the end he could only say: "You can handle it."
Thinking that Longtail Island would have an income of about 50,000 pounds a year, Hobert's mood improved a lot. Overall, this deal was still profitable.
After Dophis went out to work, Hobert locked the door of the reception room, first took out 5,000 pounds in cash from the "Nation of Disorder," and then opened the map given by the king to check the location of Longtail Island.
This island is in the eastern part of the Rorsted Archipelago, not very far from the eastern route of the route to the Southern Continent. It is about two and a half days' voyage from Blue Mountain Island, where Bayam, the capital of the Rorsted Archipelago, is located. This is not too far at sea, nor is it remote.
Hobert nodded. The location of the fief was good. At least it wasn't a place where birds don't lay eggs.
Then he measured the area of Longtail Island, and to his surprise, this island was more than a dozen times the size of South Colson! But it can only generate 50,000 pounds of revenue per year?
Immediately, Hobert understood that these colonial islands generally carry out resource plundering, such as minerals, wood, etc. Selling minerals can sell 50,000 pounds, which is still a good income.
After reading the map, Hobert sat in the chair and fell into deep thought. He was going to find an opportunity to inspect his territory.
Selling resources is too low-end. He still has to develop manufacturing or tourism.
Don't even think about developing tourism there. It takes at least ten days to reach from Backlund by boat, if you don't encounter bad weather on the way. Most middle-class people only have two or three weeks of annual leave, so it is impossible to travel so far.
As for developing manufacturing, it is not easy. The products produced can only be sold to the Southern Continent, because if they are sold back to the Northern Continent, it will not be cost-effective due to shipping costs.
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled. He should go and see before making any decisions.
...
In the eastern part of the Sonia Sea, in a ruin of a battle of gods.
Klein left the "Future" and the protection of the brilliant starry sea, stepped on a small boat, and placed himself in the ocean.
The mermaid's song came faintly, as if it directly penetrated his spiritual body, making him numb and uncontrollably wanting to hear more.
For Klein, the degree of the song was far from enough. His spirituality told him that he had to get a little closer and make the song clearer to meet the needs of the ritual.
He used the "Sailor" pathway's talisman to push the small boat forward. After sailing for a while, the mermaid's song suddenly became louder, as clear as if it were right next to Klein's ear.
Klein was in a trance for a moment, almost jumping into the sea, swimming towards the source of this beautiful song.
He tried his best to control himself and found many reefs ahead, and figures were chanting softly on the edge.
These creatures have human heads, with a bit of beauty in their pure eyebrows. Their lower bodies are huge fish tails, rhythmically beating the reefs.
Klein quickly took out the potion and drank it in one gulp amidst the singing.
Suddenly, Klein found himself becoming abnormally stiff, just like when he was manipulated by the strange wooden puppet of the Sealed Artifact "2-049".
His thoughts began to slow down, gradually giving up the idea of regaining control of himself.
At this time, the mermaid's song came, allowing Klein to maintain his last emotions, and with the help of the song's temptation, he gradually got rid of the stiff and slow state.
A few minutes later, Klein completely recovered. He first felt the usage and effect of the spirit body threads, and then suddenly discovered: "In theory, there should also be a copy of the 'Seer' to 'Faceless' Beyonder characteristics in this Beyonder characteristic!
"I was ready to deal with the mental pressure brought by the extra Beyonder characteristics, but why can't I feel their existence at all?
"Could it be because my previous acting was too good, so I instantly digested the extra potion?"
Klein carefully felt his previous abilities. Apart from the enhancement brought about by the advancement, there was no strengthening in any other aspects, which made him feel even more incomprehensible.
...
Because the nobles were all in their fiefs at this time, there were not many social balls that needed to be attended, which gave Hobert more time to start sorting out his plans to return to Backlund.
However, South Colson could not be left unattended, so Hobert rested on Sunday morning and came to Baron Felix's mansion in the afternoon using "Travel."
Fors saw Hobert and gave him a warm hug. She looked at Hobert seriously: "It's good that you're okay."
"Of course I'm okay." Hobert kissed Fors' forehead: "How is the situation in the territory?"
"I heard Allen say that Bishop Simpson has been watching the people from the royal family." Fors said: "The operation in the territory is normal, and no one has been harmed."
Hobert nodded. The effect of the "Demon Hunter" Beyonder characteristics given earlier was still good: "It is impossible for the royal family's demigods to stay here all the time. On Monday, I noticed that many of the Castiya family's demigods were killed and injured. Now they should be very short of demigod-level combat power."
He said seriously: "However, after the royal family recovers from this disaster, they will definitely make some arrangements to bypass the church and target Jeffrey's territory. At that time, it will be another crisis."
Fors sighed: "The people of South Colson finally had a few good days."
Hobert also smiled helplessly. Thanks to his increasingly close connection with the Earth Mother Church, his industry in South Colson was guaranteed with the protection of the church.
However, the jurisdiction of the South Colson area may still have to be taken back by the royal family.
This is also the reason why Hobert returned to the territory. He planned to have Conrad complete the control of the East Coast as soon as possible, and completely incorporate it into Jeffrey's rule before the royal family reacted.
Hobert will then be able to basically digest the potion. When the time comes, he will give the jurisdiction to the Feynapotter royal family. After all, this is the territory of the Feynapotter Kingdom, and the church can only protect Hobert's property.
As for Conrad and the group of honed administrative staff, Hobert had already thought about where they would go. The territory granted to him by the Loen Kingdom needs a group of people he can trust to work.
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled and said, "King George III has granted me an island. Have Conrad, Philip, Angus, and Helen prepare. Next Tuesday, we'll go and take a look at our new territory."
Fors was slightly taken aback: "Do you plan to move all the people from here to that island?"
"I…" Hobert was stunned: "It's not impossible, but it'll have to wait until the project here is finished."
"Don't worry, the industries here can definitely be preserved. It's not difficult for the Church of the Earth Mother to do that."
"The Feynapotter royal family may rely more on the Church in the next few years and won't fall out with the Church over a property worth hundreds of thousands of gold Lire."
When the time comes, we can open a 'Traveler's Gate' between Longtail Island and here. With Bishop Simpson's cover, there won't be a problem no matter how many people want to go over.
After settling on the time to inspect the new territory, Hobert dealt with the accumulated government affairs in the territory. In the evening, he met with Grove at the usual place.
After learning that Viscount Teuton had just begun to digest the "Judge" potion, Hobert couldn't help but frown and said, "Too slow!"
If it were in the past, he could have prepared slowly.
But now, there may be significant changes in the future, so he must seize the time.
Then, Hobert asked, "Have you found a chance to tell Teuton that he has a chance to advance to Sequence 5?"
"I found an opportunity." Grove said, "I said that someone was originally going to sell Beyonder characteristics at the Jeffrey Territory's auction house, but he took the wrong road and happened to be met by me. During the chat, after learning that the other party had an Beyonder characteristic from the 'Arbiter' pathway, I kept him here, and we are currently negotiating the price."
Grove smiled and said, "I'll find an opportunity to tell Teuton that that person actually obtained an Beyonder characteristic of a 'Disciplinary Knight' by chance. I believe Teuton will sell everything he has, even embezzle public funds, to buy it."
Hobert nodded in satisfaction: "Tell Teuton that this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Before the King's people come, if he can eliminate the Aurora Order's forces, he will have the opportunity to be named an Earl."
"But before that, he must advance to Sequence 5 to have the strength to drive away the Aurora Order's people."
He took out the Beyonder characteristic and a piece of Order Crystal that he had prepared long ago: "This crystal can make people less prone to losing control. It is a very high-level mystical item."
"Tell Teuton that even if he hasn't completely mastered the Sequence 6 potion, he can use this crystal to try to advance."
Grove took the crystal with both hands: "Yes."
"I've been made an Earl." Hobert finally said, "In the new territory, I need many people I trust to manage it."
This sentence was telling Grove: Do a good job for me, and I can still give your family wealth and glory.
Returning to Baron Felix's lord's mansion, Hobert first showed affection to Fors, and then talked about the battle that took place in Feynapotter City on Monday.
Hobert told Fors more information, such as that there had been battles at the angel level there, but of course, the matter of the corpse of the Ancient Death God could not be said.
Fors was so surprised that her little mouth was open for a long time. She never thought that Hobert could encounter such a dangerous battle, but fortunately, Hobert returned safely.
Then the two talked about the future of the territory. Hobert always felt it was a pity to give up the governance here, after all, this was the territory he had built up bit by bit.
But giving it up was necessary. After all, he and Christian had caused Philip I's attempt to accommodate the Uniqueness to fail, and Ferdinand II would not allow Hobert's power to exist in the Kingdom of Feynapotter.
… …
The next morning, Hobert returned to Backlund. At three o'clock in the afternoon, he attended the Tarot Gathering on time.
The tide-like gray fog covered Hobert's vision. He appeared again at the Tarot Gathering venue, which was like a giant's hall, sitting on one side of the bronze long table.
Everyone was slightly stunned and immediately noticed two differences from the last gathering.
First, "The Emperor" was not absent this time, and second, "The World's" temperament seemed to have changed, no longer as lifeless as before.
Hobert immediately realized: "The Creator's" ally, the mysterious Mr. Fool, has finally advanced to Sequence 5!
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool!" "Justice" Audrey's greeting sounded as usual.
This was already a fixed part, indicating the official start of the Tarot Gathering.
When the greeting was over, "The Fool" Klein looked at "The Hermit" Cattleya. He chuckled and said, "Tell Bernadette that she can exchange some answers for certain things."
When Cattleya heard this familiar name, she knew that her little thoughts could not be hidden from Him at all. Obviously, Mr. Fool already knew everything!
This made her feel very heavy, and she could not help but feel a strong sense of fear.
Audrey had been in a good mood these few days, but today Mr. Fool suddenly issued such a reminder, which made her immediately realize that the name Bernadette must not be simple.
Hobert: Idlers get out of the way, it's Mr. Fool's time to show off!
The others, for a while, did not realize what the name Bernadette represented.
Among them, "The Sun" Derrick vaguely felt that the atmosphere was a bit wrong, so he asked curiously: "Mr. Fool, who is Bernadette?"
Well asked! Klein secretly praised, and replied casually: "Roselle's eldest daughter, the owner of the 'Dawn,' the leader of the Element Dawn."
The name Bernadette was not a secret more than a hundred years ago, and now many ordinary people know that this is the name of Emperor Roselle's eldest daughter.
But most people would think of her as a historical figure, so even "The Hanged Man" Alger did not make the relevant associations for a while.
Hearing Mr. Fool say this, the happiest person was Alger: "Queen Mystic"! Ha, "The Hermit", I can confirm that you are "Admiral of Stars" Cattleya! So the rumors that you broke with the "Queen Mystic" are false!
He felt that the suppression he had suffered in the past three months had disappeared all at once.
Audrey, combined with Mr. Fool's reminder and the Hermit's reaction, probably understood what was going on: The answer that the "Queen Mystic" wants to obtain is in Roselle's diary?
Then she realized: That is to say, the Hermit secretly revealed a little bit about our Tarot Gathering to that "Queen Mystic" by means of hints! Really, how can you reveal the affairs of the gathering to others? I didn't even tell Susie!
Audrey almost forgot her image and etiquette education and puffed up her cheeks.
The others probably understood what was going on. While Fors was worried that the existence of the Tarot Gathering would be leaked, she had already instantly conceived a story of spies and counter-spies.
Emlyn watched gloatingly, thinking that "The Hermit" was simply stupid: Even our Sanguine's Ancestor treats Mr. Fool with an equal attitude and sent me, this special envoy, to be cultivated. You, a demigod, actually want to make small moves under the gaze of Mr. Fool! Sure enough, I can't understand some of the thoughts of the "Short-lived species."
Perhaps only Derrick, Hobert, and "The World" did not show any worry.
Derrick was because in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", even if the members of the Northern Continent were exposed, he would not be in too much danger.
Hobert was deeply impressed by this matter and knew the development of the subsequent plot.
As for "The World", he would not have his own ideas until a long time later.
The hall was quiet for a few seconds before Cattleya regained her ability to think from the emotion of fear, turned to look at the head of the bronze long table and said: "Yes, I made some mistakes, I will not defend myself."
"Mr. Fool, no matter how you punish me, even kill me, I am willing to accept."
Alger sneered: Hypocritical, if Mr. Fool wants to punish you, can you still resist?
Audrey tasted the underlying fear of the other party from the subtle movements and tone of "The Hermit".
In her opinion, people who specially emphasize that they are willing to be executed are often very afraid of dying.
Fors regained her composure from the "Fool's" indifferent and calm attitude, believing that the situation of the Tarot Gathering should not have been leaked, or that the leaked part was insignificant.
So, like "The Moon" Emlyn, she was waiting with some curiosity and expectation to see what kind of punishment Mr. Fool would make.
Seeing that Mr. Fool was silent for a short time, Cattleya restrained her uneasy mood, raised her head slightly, and observed this existence behind the thick gray fog without leaving a trace, trying to grasp the other party's true intentions so as to make a more prepared and correct response, so as not to make mistakes again and make the situation irreversible.
Her black eyes floated with a mysterious look, seeing through the gray fog and seeing "The Fool".
Suddenly, Cattleya's eyes became hot, and illusory blood flowed out.
At the same time, she heard an eerie, terrifying, and depraved terrifying roar in her ears, which instantly occupied her senses with extreme pain, and her body appeared uncontrollable convulsions and tremors.
Immediately afterwards, cracks that could see flesh and blood quickly opened on her face, the back of her hands, and the uncovered parts of her clothes, forming indescribable eyes inside!
Cattleya's screams echoed above the gray fog, and the other members saw the changes in "The Hermit's" body.
The disgusting and hideous scene frightened Audrey to immediately withdraw her gaze, and Alger, Fors, and others also lowered their heads, seemingly directly feeling "The Hermit's" pain.
Klein behind the gray fog sighed: The True Creator's mutterings are indeed useful.
Although Hobert also lowered his head, he was thinking at this time: I still have the "Blessing" of the "Devil Monarch", but unfortunately it doesn't have such an effect?
Two seconds later, Klein stopped while he was ahead, silently using the gray fog to suppress the ravings of the "True Creator," and calming the abnormality of "Hermit" Cattleya.
The trembling of "Admiral of Stars" began to subside at a speed visible to the naked eye.
At this time, Alger said in a low voice: "One must not gaze directly at a god!"
This sentence made the other members realize a fact: although Mr. Fool usually had no airs, rarely spoke, and almost always granted requests, He was still a god.
In the extraordinary world, there is a common understanding: one must not gaze directly at the gods who are high above and far beyond reality!
Only Hobert thought to himself: "Commissar Downfall's" nickname is truly well-deserved, a single sentence elevated the entire punishment process!
Klein saw that today was also a good opportunity to knock on the other members, and he was satisfied with this effect, so he said blandly: "Let's leave it at that."
Ever since "Emperor" joined the Tarot Club, "The Fool" had felt a lot of pressure, especially since "Emperor" knew too much, greatly reducing "The Fool's" sense of existence.
However, "Emperor's" attitude had always been relatively respectful, and Klein couldn't find a reason to knock on him, so today was a good opportunity to demonstrate "The Fool's" unshakable position.
Hearing this sentence, Cattleya, whose spiritual body had just recovered, breathed a sigh of relief: "I will remember your generosity."
Klein in the gray fog nodded slightly, and this matter came to an end.
After a full ten seconds of silence in the hall, Hobert cleared his throat and said: "Everyone, I wonder if anyone has inquired about the marrow of the six-legged imp monster that I need?"
The silence of everyone made Hobert unable to help but frown: This is going to be fun, the ritual is almost ready, and one auxiliary ingredient is still missing!
Hobert pinched his forehead and suddenly thought: Archibald said before that he knew the whereabouts of a six-legged imp, should I go hunt it? It's just that going to hunt a Beyonder creature that already has a little divinity for an auxiliary Ingredient is a bit ridiculous.
After a few seconds, Audrey raised her hand slightly and said: "I hope to obtain the complete pituitary gland of a young Mind Dragon, or the spinal fluid of a Black Hunting Basilisk and a fruit of the Psychedelic Wind Chime Tree."
By helping the Psychology Alchemists obtain a knight's notes from the "War, of the Violated Oath" she had already obtained the Sequence 6 "Hypnotist" potion formula.
Cattleya said: "Since the Fifth Epoch, Mind Dragons have been nearly extinct, and are difficult to find.
"I have a way to get the spinal fluid of the Black Hunting Basilisk, but it will take two to three weeks.
"I will help you inquire about the fruit of the Psychedelic Wind Chime, but I can't guarantee any news."
Alger, who was watching, suddenly felt that the development of the matter was different from what he had expected. "Hermit," who had been knocked on and punished by Mr. Fool, was more deeply involved in the Tarot Club's transactions.
This made him inexplicably have a strong sense of crisis again. At this moment, he hoped that "Hermit" would return to her previous state.
Klein was also a little surprised: I thought "Hermit" would be depressed for a while because of this, could it be that she is the type who doesn't listen unless you hit her? Well, educating children requires hitting them, the Queen was hit too little… The Queen's style of doing things isn't very good either, the Great Emperor was also hit too little.
While complaining in his heart, Klein manipulated "The World" and said: "Who among you has the Sequence 4 potion formula or clues for the 'Seer' pathway?"
Audrey was a little excited: Following "Emperor," "The World" is also about to move towards the demigod level? Perhaps in the near future, there will be two demigod members in the Tarot Club!
Hobert saw that everyone was silent and said: "As far as I know, only the Secret Order has the most complete potions for the 'Seer' pathway. The Church of the Evernight Goddess should also have them, but I don't know if they have the Sequence 4 potion formula.
"In addition, you can also start with the Zaratul family and the Antigonus family, but to a certain extent, the Zaratul family is equivalent to the Secret Order, and in today's world, the whereabouts of the Antigonus family members also seem to be difficult to find."
This made Hobert suddenly think: My black hound spirit beast is still in Foggy Town! Should I take me with you when you go to Foggy Town?
"The World" nodded and said: "Thank you for your reminder."
He thought of Antigonus's notes. It seems that this is the only way he can come into contact with the potion formula.
After a few seconds of silence, Cattleya opened her mouth and said: "I need a drop of blood from a mythical creature, no matter what mythical creature."
Everyone became silent again. Fors and Emlyn and other members felt that today's transactions seemed very far away from them.
Audrey thought to herself: I forgot about Ms. Hermit. She was already a Sequence 5 when she joined the Tarot Club, so she must be preparing to advance to a demigod.
Klein manipulated "The World" and said: "I will keep an eye out."
Given that this was Ms. Hermit's rare request, Audrey and others also made similar responses.
Only Hobert did not make a similar promise. At this time, he was diverging his thoughts and thinking: With my relationship with the Earth Mother Church, theoretically speaking, I should be able to obtain a drop of the church's angel's blood. If I pray to the Goddess, I might also be able to obtain a drop of blood from an angel of the "Sleepless" pathway. There are also the angels of the Loen royal family. If I can obtain something that Duke Southville likes, it wouldn't be difficult to ask for a drop of his blood. It's just that these bloods are not Ms. Hermit's first choice.
Emlyn cleared his throat and said: "I hope you can help me find these 'Primordial Moon' believers. For every valid clue, I will pay 100 pounds, and 500 pounds for a direct lock!"
By making a request to The Fool, he had manifested the information of five people, all with the strength of Sequence 7.
This was a competition issued by the Sanguine's Great Nibbs. Whoever hunts the most "Artificial Sanguine" will receive an Ancestor's Ring.
After everyone said they would help "The Moon" pay attention, the trading session temporarily ended and entered the free exchange session.
"Little Sun" lived up to expectations and brought information that everyone was interested in: "During this time, I followed the exploration team led by the 'Chief' to Afternoon Town.
"This is the only way to 'Giant King's Court', the gate that divides mythology and reality."
Derrick omitted the less important experiences along the way and started directly from Afternoon Town, realistically describing the gray and silent appearance there, and then talked about the process of his team discovering the underground altar.
In the underground chamber with the secret altar, he distinguished the names of Ouroboros, Medici, and Sasrir, and unknowingly entered the other side of the town, seeing the title of "Dark Angel" and the phrase "Rose Redemption."
Speaking of this, he once again thanked Mr. Fool for helping him out of trouble.
Then, Derrick briefly introduced that his shadow had turned into a monster, and that in a collapsing church, he encountered a clergyman who kept repenting.
He knew that this confession was very important, so he repeated the content of the confession verbatim: "Almighty Lord, I confess… seduced Sasrir, and the kings frequently went to the palace belonging to dusk to conspire.
"The people of this town have also changed at some point. They set up secret altars, hold strange rituals, and do all kinds of things that you do not allow.
"I discovered all this, but it was too late. Depravity, blood, darkness, decay, killing, filth, and shadows have been flowing and engulfing this land.
"A great disaster will begin here!"
Everyone's minds appeared in a dark environment, a broken temple with a clergyman praying, just thinking about it was terrifying.
Hobert thought to himself, even if the clergyman said "Steamed lamb, steamed bear paw, steamed deer tail, roasted duck, roasted chicken, roasted goose" at this time, it would be scary enough. No, that seems scarier than confession!
"Great Cataclysm!" Alger suddenly seemed to realize this, and said as if to remind everyone.
The other members were slightly stunned and agreed with "Hanged Man's" guess in their hearts.
"We think so too." Derrick said: "Of course, that was a later guess.
"After clearly hearing the clergyman's prayer, the Chief asked three questions: Who are the kings? What does the great disaster refer to? Who seduced Sasrir."
"The clergyman said 'The kings are Sasrir, Ouroboros, Medici…', when he said this, a stream of transparent flames suddenly burst out of his body, burning him into a cloud of black gas."
Everyone then understood that "Kings" referred to "Kings of Angels!"
After Derrick finished talking about his experience, he suddenly asked the head of the bronze long table: "Mr. Fool, may I ask who seduced 'Dark Angel' Sasrir?"
The smile behind the gray fog almost froze: Not me again? How would I know?
Fortunately, when he helped Derrick recover from the strange state before, he realized that "Little Sun" might ask such a question, so he made some preparations in advance. At the moment, he smiled meaningfully: "Because it is secret."
Hobert was slightly stunned: You know that the Evernight Goddess is involved? That's right, in fact, "Little Sun's" experience has very clearly pointed to the Evernight Goddess, as a former Nighthawk, it is normal for Klein to have associations.
Alger thought: Which names are themselves equal to secrets? Sequence 0 level True Gods?
Cattleya also associated with the relevant authority of the "Evernight Goddess", but she was not very sure of her judgment, because Mr. Fool's reminder was too vague.
The other Tarot Club members also fell into contemplation, but then they looked at "Emperor" again.
Similar things have happened more than once. The Fool gives hints, but the hints are too vague, and perhaps only the knowledgeable "Emperor" in the Tarot Club can interpret them.
Seeing everyone looking over, Hobert smiled and said, "Mr. Fool's hint is already very obvious, 'Secrecy'. Doesn't everyone associate it with the 'Mother of Concealment'?"
That's right, what that clergyman said was about the Evernight Goddess, because She herself represents 'Secrecy', so in many things that need to be kept secret, people find it difficult to say Her name."
Everyone nodded almost in unison: Similar to what I guessed.
Only Klein behind the gray fog thought: Actually, I'm not sure either, but it's safer to say that, maybe there are other reasons, but in the final analysis, it's all 'Secrecy'.
"Little Sun" then asked: "Mr. Emperor, why did the Evernight Goddess seduce Sasrir? What are the Kings of Angels plotting again?"
Hobert thought for a moment before saying: "Since you have already investigated this far, the time is ripe to trade some information about the 'Great Cataclysm'."
"8,000 pounds, that's my asking price. I will use the information I know to analyze the clergyman's prayer and announce the list of the first members of the 'Rose Redemption'."
Audrey immediately reacted: "Mr. Emperor, is this part of the 20,000-pound information you mentioned before?"
"Yes," Hobert said, "I have already released information about the Kings of Angels before, which can be regarded as some basic information, just to help everyone understand 'Sun's' question just now."
The information of the eight Kings of Angels is actually just basic information!
Audrey immediately said, "I offer 2,000 pounds!"
Everyone also joined the transaction. The crowdfunding ended quickly. Audrey paid 2,000 pounds for this, and "Little Sun" paid 8 Beyonder ingredients of Sequence 8 level, replacing 2,000 pounds.
Then, Cattleya and Fors each paid 1,000 pounds, and Alger, Emlyn, and "The World" bore the last 2,000 pounds, each paying 700 pounds.
Currently, Audrey, Fors, and Cattleya have the best financial situation among the Tarot Club members. They either have a good background, a good husband, or a high enough status, so they don't take spending one or two thousand pounds seriously.
Secondly, there are Klein and Alger. After Klein left the "Future," he just hunted the "Slaughterer" Kircheis, the first mate on the "King of immortality's" flagship, and is now very wealthy.
Alger, on the other hand, stayed on the island he discovered with "Emperor" for three days last week, hunting 7 Beyonder creatures one after another, and the Beyonder ingredients and spiritual materials he obtained were worth six to seven thousand pounds. Although he has not sold them all yet, he believes that his savings are enough to buy the Sequence 5 formula and Beyonder characteristics.
The poorest are "Little Sun" and Emlyn. However, because of the special environment in which "Little Sun" is located, he is indeed relatively poor in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", but the resources he possesses make him relatively wealthy in the Tarot Club. Of course, the prerequisite is that the other party is willing to accept Beyonder ingredients as payment.
As for Emlyn, he is really poor. Of course, the collection in his bedroom is valuable, but he would never sell it even if he was beaten to death.
After the crowdfunding ended, everyone looked at "Emperor."
The 5,000-pound level of information was already enough to surprise them. What content would the 8,000-pound level of information have?
Hobert first pondered which information should be said and which should not be said.
Then he said unhurriedly: "The reason why this information has extremely high value is because it is secret enough, and unlike the information about Trunsoest that we traded last time, it has a lot of my speculation.
This time, I can tell everyone very clearly about the information we are trading. I just happen to know the truth about this matter through certain channels.
However, what I need to warn everyone is that you must never spread this information in the real world, otherwise you will definitely be obliterated!"
Everyone suddenly understood that this information might involve some gods, and it is likely to be the disreputable experiences of those gods.
Audrey thought to herself: Could it be that the list of the "Rose Redemption" is more secret than Blood Emperor murdering Medici?
Alger then associated: I understand, what "Emperor" is referring to must be the three Kings of Angels who later became True Gods. To be precise, the churches of the three True Gods will not let go of those who spread this secret information.
After warning everyone, Hobert said: "The members of the 'Rose Redemption' are the Evernight Goddess and the Dark Angel, as well as the Earth Mother, the God of Combat, the God of the Undead, and the God of Spiritual Creatures, as well as the Red Angel, the Angel of Fate, the Pure White Angel, the Angel of Wisdom, and the Wind Angel."
The hall was silent for a full three seconds before Klein behind the gray fog closed his mouth that had opened in surprise: Holy crap, what kind of immortal lineup is this? What do the members of the "Rose Redemption" want to do? Destroy the entire universe?
