chapters.title: Chapter 519 - 519: The Plot of the Evernight Goddess and the Dark Angel (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Nishinoya for becoming a free member]
After her initial surprise, Audrey quickly composed herself and asked, "Mr. Emperor, are you referring to the Earth Mother and the God of Combat as they are now?"
Although she already had the answer in her heart, she felt she had to ask the question, as if seeking an outlet to release the surge of astonishment within.
The initial members of the "Rose Redemption" were simply too astonishing. She had originally thought that the members of the "Rose Redemption" would, at most, include a few Kings of Angels, but unexpectedly, there were actually three true Gods!
Hobert understood what Audrey wanted to ask and replied, "Yes, the current Earth Mother and God of Combat!"
Audrey continued, "I remember when we traded information about the Kings of Angels, you said that the Pure White Angel, the Wisdom Angel, and the Wind Angel later became the Eternal Blazing Sun, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and the Lord of Storms, respectively?"
Hobert knew that Audrey's question was less about confirming previously obtained information and more about regulating her emotions. He replied, "That's right!"
Audrey leaned back in her chair: "So, all six Gods of the Fourth Epoch participated in the 'Rose Redemption'?"
"More than that!" Cattleya also recovered from her shock: "I also remember when trading information about the ancient Gods of the Second Epoch, His Majesty mentioned that the God of the Undead was the later Underworld Emperor!"
Alger smiled: "Seven True Gods then!"
Fors also joined the discussion: "So, the 'Rose Redemption' is an organization that directly and profoundly influenced the Fourth Epoch?"
Emlyn looked puzzled: "How could the Goddess of Beauty, Auernia, not be involved?"
Everyone looked at the Sanguine, as if asking: Did a Sanguine have to participate?
However, the atmosphere in the hall was greatly eased by "The Moon's" peculiar thought process.
Previously, when the other members received astonishing information, they would only make some guesses in their hearts, but today was different. They had to speak their minds, because the list given by "The Emperor" was simply too shocking.
Before this, who could have imagined that there would be an organization encompassing so many Gods!
And no one had expected that the "Rose Redemption," repeatedly mentioned by "Little Sun," possessed such terrifying power!
Everyone finally understood why "The Emperor" had warned them to keep it a secret right from the start. If the relevant information about the initial members of the "Rose Redemption" were spread, it was estimated that they would be jointly obliterated by six of the seven existing orthodox churches!
In today's North and South Continents, that would be equivalent to seeking one's own death.
Derrick then asked, "Mr. Emperor, what were they plotting?"
The other members had also calmed down and looked at "The Emperor" together. They seemed to have some guesses, but they didn't dare to continue thinking about it.
However, Hobert did not answer directly, but said, "Before answering this question, I need to explain something to everyone. The current orthodox churches were actually secret organizations a long time ago."
"That's why the clergymen 'The Sun' encountered would say: The people of this town have also changed at some point. They have set up secret altars and hold strange rituals…"
"From the perspective of the clergy of the Ancient Sun God, Afternoon Town at that time was full of heretics, or members of secret organizations."
Klein recalled some of the content he had read when he was a Nighthawk: I remember reading similar information.
Audrey, lacking relevant knowledge, exclaimed: It's hard to imagine that in the Third Epoch, worshiping the Evernight Goddess was not allowed.
Cattleya was the first to understand "The Emperor's" meaning: "Are you saying that the Gods who are now high above were evil Gods back then?"
Everyone was shocked. Klein also followed Cattleya's train of thought: Because I used to be a Nighthawk, in my concept, the seven orthodox Gods and the orthodox churches are symbols of the mystical world order. I almost never thought that since the orthodox churches were secret organizations, the orthodox Gods might have once been evil Gods! Then, it seems much more reasonable that they gathered together to plot.
Alger, a member of the Storm Church, also immediately understood: Evil Gods… Hehe, who would dare to say now that the seven Gods were once evil Gods? Sure enough, in the extraordinary world, power determines everything. The Gods must have been plotting something at that time, and later their plot succeeded, so the six Gods have their current status!
Audrey felt that her brain was a little insufficient: Evernight Goddess… Evil God, Heavens, just thinking about such an idea makes one feel like blaspheming the Gods!
Fors smiled wryly: During the past few weeks of trading information with The Emperor, I no longer have the feeling of trepidation I had when I first entered the Tarot Club. I naively thought that it was because I had heard enough secrets between the Gods and that no information could surprise me anymore. As a result, "The Emperor's" information once again refreshed my understanding of the Gods!
Emlyn was still struggling: Could "The Emperor" be mistaken? How could such an important organization not have Sanguine involved? Or perhaps the Goddess of Beauty, Auernia, believed that there was no need to participate in such an organization. Yes, that must be it. An organization that determines the fate of mankind, we Sanguine don't need to participate. Hey? Why does everyone look so surprised, and even a little frightened?
Of course, they were frightened! The idea that the orthodox Gods were evil Gods was enough to earn one a trial by fire experience card just by thinking about it.
"Little Sun" also understood: Because they were once evil Gods, they plotted. It's hard to imagine that evil Gods later became orthodox Gods!
However, "Little Sun" also thought of something: "Mr. Emperor, the six Kings of Angels are subordinates of the 'Omnipotent and Omniscient God'. Why did they also participate in this plot?"
The other members were all slightly stunned. Their brains were a little overwhelmed today. When encountering things that completely exceeded their comprehension, they were not as clear-headed as "Little Sun," whose temperament was more pure.
Yes, there were also Kings of Angels! They were not members of secret organizations at that time! Moreover, six of the eight Kings of Angels joined the "Rose Redemption"! Was this an organization mainly composed of "evil Gods"? Or was it an organization mainly composed of Kings of Angels?
This was equivalent to the True Creator, the Hidden Sage, and the Primordial Demoness establishing an organization, and most of the Angels in the orthodox churches also joined.
"That's exactly what I'm going to say next," Hobert said with a smile: "Because the target of their plot was your 'Omnipotent and Omniscient God,' the Ancient Sun God!"
Silence was the main color in the hall of today's Tarot Club. After another few seconds of silence, "Little Sun" stammered: "They, they finally… succeeded, succeeded?"
Hobert looked at "Little Sun." The answer was obvious. Of course, they succeeded, otherwise the Fourth Epoch would not be dominated by the six Gods, but would still be dominated by the Ancient Sun God!
Or rather, there would be no Fourth Epoch at all. As long as the Ancient Sun God was there, it would always be the Third Epoch!
Only then did the others feel that their brains had resumed operation. All along, the concept of "The Cataclysm" belonged to the common sense information of the extraordinary world.
However, most people only knew about the event of "The Cataclysm" but did not know the specific impact of this event. They only knew that it was a standard event!
Many Beyonders even thought that "The Cataclysm" was actually a natural disaster like a meteorite falling or a major earthquake.
Beyonders like Klein, Alger, and Cattleya, who knew more hidden knowledge, knew that "The Cataclysm" made the Eastern Continent disappear from human sight and understood that "The Cataclysm" created the "Forsaken Land of the Gods."
They only knew that the fall of the Ancient Sun God led to the occurrence of "The Cataclysm," but they were completely unaware of the specific process and cause.
Today they finally knew the relevant information about this process! It turned out that almost all the big figures at that time were plotting to murder the Ancient Sun God?
Klein leaned back in his chair: This is something I didn't expect before. I realized that when the Ancient Sun God fell, there should have been a war of Gods. The eastern part of the Sonia Sea where I found the mermaids should have been the battlefield of the God war that year. However, I didn't expect that so many Gods and Kings of Angels participated in the God war! I remember that the power of Gods such as "The Sun" and the Earth Mother appeared successively in the ruins of the God war. So many years have passed, and these powers are still affecting that land! However, what is unexpected is that it was not a God war between two camps, but the Gods took the Ancient Sun God as their opponent!
Audrey broke the silence: "Mr. Emperor, why did they do this? I mean those Kings of Angels?"
"Little Sun" seemed to suddenly think of something: "The Evernight Goddess seduced Sasrir and established the 'Rose Redemption'. This must be the Evernight Goddess's conspiracy!"
Derrick's voice was filled with grief and a hint of trembling: "It must be so!"
He could not accept the fact that the Kings had betrayed the Ancient Sun God!
Audrey wanted to defend the Goddess, but she gave up before she could even open her mouth, because she didn't know how to defend, and she could see that "The Sun's" emotions were very unstable now, so she should not stimulate him any further.
"Don't be so agitated," Hobert comforted: "I said before that the Ancient Sun God left himself some escape routes."
"I'm not very clear about the specific situation of these escape routes, but I will help you inquire. Perhaps there is still hope? After all, even the crazy ancient Gods of the Second Epoch have the possibility of resurrection, let alone the Ancient Sun God!"
He said this because now was not the time to announce the specific arrangements of the Ancient Sun God!
Derrick took a deep breath and calmed himself down before saying: "Thank you, Mr. Emperor. If you have any relevant information, please trade it to me immediately."
"If you don't want Beyonder ingredients anymore, I can try to apply for a Sealed Artifact for you!"
Hobert's words seemed to rekindle Derrick's hope. If he knew where the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God's" resurrection hope lay, he could probably apply for any Sealed Artifact from City of Silver based on that!
In that case, Derrick wouldn't even care about exposing himself.
"We'll talk about that later," Hobert said solemnly. "I remember reminding you once before that the Ancient Sun God has indeed fallen. You must accept this fact."
Derrick's emotions had stabilized a lot by this point: "I know."
"Then let's continue our previous transaction," Hobert said. "The purpose of 'Rose Redemption's' initiation is not within the scope of this transaction.
"But I must remind everyone that from the Second Epoch onwards, the Evernight Goddess and the Ancient Sun God had a close cooperation.
"So, the real situation is not that the Evernight Goddess seduced Sasrir, but that They jointly initiated 'Rose Redemption'.
"I speculate that the Evernight Goddess should have contacted the God of Combat, the Earth Mother, the God of the Dead, and the God of Spiritual Creatures, while Sasrir contacted the other Kings of Angels.
"This speculation is because the second 'Blasphemy Slate' had not yet appeared at that time. The Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat were not enemies like they are now, and there wasn't much conflict with the God of the Dead.
"So, it's no problem for Her to contact these gods."
Everyone fell into contemplation again. Klein realized: Judging from "Emperor's" meaning, the purpose of forming "Rose Redemption" seems to be even more shocking information than the member list of this organization!
Alger, however, found it a bit strange: Why weren't the Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat enemies during the Third Epoch? Theoretically, the concept of adjacent pathways should have existed long ago!
Cattleya noticed: Why did "Emperor" mention the second "Blasphemy Slate"? Could it be that the gods only became enemies after the second "Blasphemy Slate" appeared?
Audrey felt much better: I knew it couldn't be a conspiracy by the Evernight Goddess. But, it's so strange, why did They target the Ancient Sun God?
Fors, already using her habit of conceiving stories, had her own guess: Could it be that the Ancient Sun God possessed something that other gods and Kings of Angels desperately needed or wanted to obtain? But a new question arises, what needs do gods have?
Emlyn, on the other hand, firmly believed: The Ancient Sun God must have done something that provoked public anger, otherwise everyone wouldn't attack Him so uniformly.
"Little Sun" had no choice but to accept the fact that the Kings of Angels had betrayed the Ancient Sun God!
Hobert smiled slightly and said, "I wonder if you've noticed a question: Why did so many gods and Kings of Angels besiege the Ancient Sun God?
"Or rather, have you ever thought about this question? Why was it a conspiracy of so many gods and Kings of Angels? Rather than a premeditation by the Kings of Angels, or a premeditation between two or three gods?"
Today's news was too shocking, and everyone felt a bit unable to process it. After "Emperor" said this, the other members realized the problem.
Klein: That's right, thinking about it this way, the reason I was surprised was precisely because "Rose Redemption" had too many people and was too strong, right? Why would such a strong force need to conspire? As long as they discussed the issue of dividing the spoils, they could just take action directly!
The other members had similar thoughts and all looked at "Emperor", waiting for his explanation.
Hobert answered himself, "This is another very crucial piece of information in this transaction.
"After our transaction ends, we must accept Miss Justice's hypnosis. After leaving Mr. Fool's protection, we will forget the relevant information.
"Because just knowing, even knowing some information, Beyonders below the angel level will be contaminated."
Everyone was slightly stunned and immediately thought of the relevant information about Adam and Amon.
And Klein keenly noticed that it was more than that. He manipulated "The World" to ask, "Mr. Emperor, this information seems to be even more dangerous than the information about Adam and Amon?"
"Of course it's more dangerous!" Hobert said solemnly, "If you know many details about Adam, Adam won't take you too seriously if he sees that you are a Beyonder below the demigod level.
"If you know detailed information about Amon, He can only lock onto you within a certain range.
"And the information I'm about to announce, no one should have any wishful thinking. Just knowing it will cause contamination! Moreover, the contamination accumulated before becoming an angel cannot be removed even after becoming a god."
Before even hearing the information itself, everyone already had the illusion of having their jaws drop twice.
Audrey: It's hard to imagine that there is such dangerous knowledge in the world!
Cattleya couldn't help but think: What kind of information would that be?
Klein had already thought of some clues: I've always suspected whether there is a higher level of power concept above the gods? This transaction may provide the answer to this question.
Hobert gave everyone a few seconds to digest, and then said, "The reason why the gods and angels of 'Rose Redemption' had to secretly conspire is because the Ancient Sun God was a level stronger than the true gods!"
Klein smiled slightly: I knew it, there is another level above the gods!
Alger's thoughts were similar to Cattleya's: Another level above the gods? What would that level be?
The other members hadn't quite grasped this concept yet: What does it mean to be a level stronger than the gods? Could it be that gods have different levels of distinction?
"I think everyone should have some thoughts on this," Hobert continued. "It's understandable that Beyonders of adjacent pathways are mortal enemies, after all, they can advance through adjacent pathways and are seen as usable Beyonder characteristics in each other's eyes.
"But at the level of True Gods, at the apex of a pathway, why are They still mortal enemies? Theoretically, even if they replace the gods of adjacent pathways to become gods, they are still at the True God level."
Fors looked away: Uh, why didn't I think of this before?
"Little Sun" nodded repeatedly: That's right, Mr. Emperor is right!
Emlyn also nodded after a few seconds: I... I also had such doubts long ago! Yes, yes, I've had them for a long time! Hmm, hmm, I forgot how long these doubts have existed!
Hobert answered himself, "It's because the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of adjacent pathways can raise True Gods to a higher level! That's why True Gods of adjacent pathways are mortal enemies!
"And the Ancient Sun God accommodated the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of more than one pathway, so He was much stronger than normal gods. That's why the three True Gods, six Kings of Angels, and two beings at the level of Kings of Angels in 'Rose Redemption' needed to conspire!
"Because even with three True Gods and eight beings close to True Gods, they were not completely confident in defeating the Ancient Sun God!
"So They had to conspire, to find a way!"
Hobert decided to stop there, because this information was far beyond the value of 8,000 pounds!
For a moment, everyone seemed to have gained a huge amount of information, and countless questions seemed to pop up in their minds, but they didn't know how to ask.
At this time, Klein manipulated "The World" to ask, "Mr. Emperor, may I ask which pathways' Uniqueness and Sequence 1 did the Ancient Sun God accommodate?"
Hobert said, "I can only tell you that when He fell, He had the Uniqueness of 'Bard', 'Sailor', 'Secrets Supplicant', 'Reader', and a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of these four pathways.
"In addition, I speculate that He should also have a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Visionary' pathway in His body."
Everyone was stunned: This... so much! Are they all adjacent pathways?
Klein even thought: It sounds like the Ancient Sun God was a patchwork monster made up of Uniqueness!
Cattleya noticed that "Emperor" highlighted the precondition "when He fell", which meant that before that, the Ancient Sun God had more than just the Uniqueness of these pathways in His body!
This made her think: "I remember you said when we discussed Adam and Amon before that the Ancient Sun God created these two brothers in order to expel excess Beyonder characteristics.
"Does that mean that before, the Ancient Sun God also had a Uniqueness of the 'Visionary' pathway in His body? As well as a Uniqueness of the 'Marauder' pathway?"
"Yes," Hobert said. "During the Second Epoch, the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics of the 'Visionary' pathway were all with the 'Dragon of Imagination' and His son, the 'Nightmare Dragon'.
"Later, the Ancient Sun God defeated the 'Dragon of Imagination'. He should have taken and accommodated the Uniqueness and two Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics from the 'Dragon of Imagination'.
"The 'Nightmare Dragon' also fell, but the Beyonder characteristics in His body have always existed in the form of Sealed Artifacts.
"Then, when the Ancient Sun God created Adam, in addition to giving Adam the Uniqueness of the 'Visionary' pathway, He should have also given Him a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic.
"I speculate that the Ancient Sun God should have kept one for Himself to maintain the balance of His own Beyonder characteristics."
Cattleya nodded, feeling that "Emperor's" analysis was very reasonable.
Klein immediately manipulated "The World" to ask again, "Why would the Ancient Sun God have the Uniqueness of the 'Marauder' in His body?"
Hobert smiled and said, "Mr. World, you have too many questions."
According to the previous practice, "The World" actually only had one chance to ask questions, but he had already asked twice, this is the third question.
Reminded by "World," Audrey and Alger recalled that Mr. Fool's pathway was adjacent to the "Marauder" pathway. However, "Marauder" and the Uniqueness possessed by the Ancient Sun God didn't seem to be adjacent pathways.
Audrey wasn't entirely sure, but Alger was very certain about this point because he had speculated that Mr. Fool should be a deity of the "Seer" or "Apprentice" pathway.
Alger thought to himself: Perhaps Mr. Fool is also an existence "Above the Gods"!
After hearing Hobert's words, Audrey said, "Mr. Emperor, I am willing to give my opportunity to ask a question to…"
However, Hobert suddenly raised his hand: "There's no need, because I can't answer this question now, or rather, I don't know the complete answer. We can discuss this issue again when we have the opportunity in the future."
This was the second time today that Hobert had indicated he wasn't entirely clear about the answer. This was actually a subtext: I don't know everything!
He could still say that he saw some secret history of the Fourth Epoch from the family's classics, but if he knew some arrangements of the Ancient Sun God during the Third Epoch, or the information about the Ancient Sun God's awakening from the underground, it would be too terrifying!
Audrey saw that Hobert seemed to be concealing something, but she just thought that the information was very important and could not be traded together with the "Rose Redemption" information.
Klein also realized that the fact that the "Marauder" Uniqueness was once inside the Ancient Sun God might involve very secret or very high-level information.
The reactions of the other members were a bit slower. After a few people discussed it, they roughly realized what they were talking about.
Hobert took a deep breath and said to "Little Sun" again: "Finally, I will give you some more information to help you analyze your experience in Afternoon Town."
Derrick immediately sat up straight: "Thank you, Mr. Emperor."
Everyone also stopped their respective guesses and looked at Hobert again.
Hobert waved his hand towards "Little Sun", signaling that he didn't need to thank him, and then he said: "The strange state you entered should be 'Hidden State'!
"That's right, this is exactly the authority related to the Evernight Goddess. As for the point that your shadows have become monsters, it is the authority related to the 'Secrets Supplicant' pathway.
"As far as I know, the demigods of the 'Secrets Supplicant' pathway have the ability to make the target's shadow come alive.
"I guess that the Evernight Goddess and the Dark Angel Sasir, at the gathering of the secret organization 'Rose Redemption' in the 'Giant Court', should have made some arrangements to avoid being discovered.
"And after thousands of years, these arrangements have dissipated their power, so there was your special experience and the shadow monsters you encountered.
"It is also possible that after experiencing the 'Great Cataclysm', those arrangements mutated, and some of your actions happened to awaken these mutated powers."
Derrick carefully wrote down the Emperor's words and thanked him again. Then, Audrey gave each member a psychological hint to ensure that they would not recall the information about "Above the Gods" outside this giant hall.
As this transaction came to an end and the free exchange session continued, the hall was silent for a while before Alger said: "I also heard about the major event that Miss Justice mentioned last week, which happened in Feynapotter City!"
Audrey glanced at Hobert without leaving a trace, and then smiled: "I didn't expect this matter to spread to the sea so quickly!"
"The information on the sea is not closed off," Cattleya also joined the topic: "It's just that there will be some delay."
She paused and said again: "Similarly, I also heard about this matter. I heard that it should be a conflict between the Augustus family and the Castiya family."
With such a big commotion in Feynapotter City, the Moses Ascetic Order certainly also obtained some information and announced the obtained information to some members, so that these members could inquire about more news.
So, the information Cattleya obtained was actually more advanced than the information Audrey obtained: "It is said that an angel-level battle took place at that time! In the end, the Augustus family seemed to have won."
Alger opened his mouth, not knowing what to say. He had not received information of this level from the Church.
The other members were all slightly stunned. Another angel-level battle happened?
The last time everyone heard about this level of battle was last year, which happened in the Southern Continent.
Only Klein and Audrey knew that an angel-level battle had also taken place not long ago in the South Colson area of the Feynapotter Kingdom.
Then Audrey nodded slightly: No wonder the royal family's rewards for Hobert and his son are so generous. They must have played a huge role in this matter, allowing the Augustus family to win in this battle!
Fors didn't find this surprising, because Hobert had just mentioned these things by her pillow last night.
Alger said at this time: "It is said that the 'Creator' also participated in the battle."
In fact, he had not received any notification in this regard, but he discovered some clues from the Church's notification, which made him think of some information about the "Creator" that he had obtained before.
This was actually a more confident guess of his. If it were before, he certainly wouldn't have announced such a guess that he wasn't completely sure of to everyone, but since "Hermit" had said so much, he felt that if he didn't say something, he would feel a little guilty.
As soon as Alger said this, everyone looked at Mr. Hanged Man together. Seeing that the other party only said this, everyone looked at Hobert together again.
Hobert smiled and said: "That's right, the 'Creator' not only participated in the war, but also played a decisive role."
Cattleya frowned: It has actually risen to the level of a battle between gods. It seems that this incident is not as simple as it seems on the surface!
Audrey was slightly stunned: Why did I read a trace of pride from Hobert's body language? Ah, I understand, Hobert must have prayed for the power of the 'Creator' at that time, so that the Augustus family won.
"The news I know is indeed more detailed than yours," Hobert said: "Because a Blessed of the 'Creator' participated in this operation."
Fors nodded: "Emperor" and Hobert are colleagues who are often in contact.
Audrey smiled and resisted the urge to shake her head gently: Hobert is telling the truth, it was indeed a Blessed of the "Creator" who participated in this operation, that Blessed is you!
In fact, Hobert had a strong desire to confide in this matter, because it is not suitable to talk about this matter in Backlund now, but after all, he had done such a big thing, and it was too torturous not to let people talk about it.
So Hobert told Fors more details about this matter last night, but he couldn't talk about the Ancient Death God's corpse.
Hobert said: "About a year ago, the Castiya family obtained the Uniqueness of the 'Arbiter' pathway. Just last Monday, the angel of the Castiya family hoped to accommodate this Uniqueness during the National Day celebration.
"And as everyone knows, the Augustus family has the same extraordinary pathway as the Castiya family, so of course they would not sit idly by and let this happen, so a fierce battle broke out in the Alhambrah Palace in Feynapotter City!
"If it weren't for an Sealed Artifact blocking the aftermath of this war, it is estimated that the entire Feynapotter City would have disappeared!"
Alger and Cattleya listened carefully to every detail. For them, this was first-hand information.
Emlyn and "Little Sun" were purely listening to the excitement.
Klein thought thoughtfully: The Creator should be a deity of the 'Arbiter' or 'Lawyer' pathway. Of course, He would not sit idly by and let this happen!
"It is said that both families invited a large number of helpers!" Hobert continued: "The Castiya family invited an angel each from the Earth Mother Church and the War God Church, and also invited two angels from the Feysac Empire.
"On the Augustus family's side, they invited the angel of the original royal family of the Intis Republic, and two angels from the Storm Church."
Everyone was somewhat surprised. Klein behind the gray fog: I thought it was just a battle between the angels of the two families. I didn't expect so many angels to participate! This battle has brought out the entire situation in the Northern Continent!
Cattleya had already counted it in her heart: Adding the two angels each family possesses, this battle has eleven angels participating! Before this, such a battle was simply unheard of! Oh, right, the 'Creator' also took action, otherwise the Augustus family, which was slightly at a disadvantage, could not have won.
Alger gave a shallow wry smile: The Storm Church actually dispatched two angels! It is the main force in this battle, but the information I got is not as high-end as "Admiral of Stars"!
Audrey also did not expect that so many angels would participate in the war: It's a miracle that Hobert can survive in such a war! No, he has the protection of the "Creator", which is relatively safe.
Fors smiled slightly: I know all this!
Not everyone is so concerned about the situation in the Northern Continent. For example, Emlyn couldn't figure it out: Why are the angels of the Church joining in the fun in a battle between two families?
Finally, Hobert said: "After the 'Creator' took action, the battle ended. In the end, the Augustus family won a certain victory. At the same time, the 'Creator's' goal was also achieved, and the angel of the Castiya family failed to accommodate the Uniqueness."
For the other members, this seemed to be the expected result. After all, in their minds, the "Creator", like Mr. Fool, may be a newly awakened deity.
But even if it is just awakened, it is still a deity!
In a situation where a deity participates in the battle, there is almost no suspense.
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Cattleya took the initiative to share her experience in the God war ruins last week: "In the northeast direction of the Rorsted Archipelago, there is a safe lane to enter that dangerous sea area…"
She started with the abyss crack that separated the sea, described the sun chariot that could not be gazed upon, the night that had to be slept through to avoid it, and the sea area filled with terrifying whispers.
Throughout the whole process, she didn't mention Gehrman Sparrow at all. As for other anomalies along the way, she only briefly mentioned a few, such as the sea area with remnants of the aura of the "Earth Mother" that could make hair grow wildly.
In the end, she focused on the sea surface where a huge corpse was sleeping, and the adventurer's sailboat with the words "Fountain of Youth" written in blood.
"Fountain of Youth" is one of the six great legends of the sea, which has aroused a lot of reverie.
Audrey was about to imagine herself searching for the "Fountain of Youth", but suddenly realized something was wrong: "A person who has encountered a monster attack and is about to die would not write down treasure information.
"If he wanted to remind subsequent companions or relatives who came to look for him, he should have written that there was danger here, or what the source of the danger was.
"If he intended to tell passing ships that there was a 'Fountain of Youth' here, then he lacked sufficient motivation to write something similar when he was dying."
Emlyn echoed, "Yes, if it were me, I wouldn't desperately try to tell others that there is a treasure here before I die."
Klein manipulated "The World" and said in a hoarse voice: "'Fountain of Youth' is a scam!"
Hobert also echoed: "'Demons' love to deceive people! Perhaps it is a requirement for the advancement ritual of this pathway? If so, many Beyonders of the same pathway should have used the 'Fountain of Youth' scam."
Cattleya glanced at "The Emperor" and "The World". The other members thought that the "Demon" Hobert said was a noun or adjective, but Cattleya knew that it was also the title of Sequence 4 of the "Criminal" pathway.
After exchanging their experiences, everyone began to teach "Little Sun" Ancient Hermes, and finally Klein looked around: "Let's end here."
Everyone stood up together: "According to your will!"
Watching the figures disappear one by one, Klein waited for a while to complete the members' sacrifices and bestowal rituals.
He didn't leave the gray fog immediately, but materialized parchment and a pen, and wrote a divination statement: My hope of advancing to Sequence 4.
After putting down the pen, Klein took the parchment, leaned on the back of the chair and entered a state of meditation, chanting the divination statement.
After seven times, he successfully entered the dream world.
Because of the blessing of the "Sefirah Castle", Klein quickly received some revelations, including the dilapidated palace on the towering mountain, and the leather black notebook.
Soon Klein woke up from the dream and immediately interpreted it: the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains and the Antigonus family's notebook. Of course, the Hornacis Mountains cannot be visited, so now we can only find a way to obtain clues from the Antigonus family's notebook.
Klein left the gray fog, ready to try his new abilities.
…
Sonia Sea, on the "Future" ship.
At this time, there was no wind and waves on the sea, and the sailing speed of this flagship was not very fast.
In the captain's room, Cattleya stared at the bookshelf in front of her for a while. At the Tarot Gathering just now, the information about the "Above the Sequence" could not be brought out of the giant hall.
But the information about the "Rose Redemption" would not be affected.
I didn't expect the history of the Third Epoch to be so confusing, Cattleya thought: This is definitely not information that "The Emperor" can obtain from his family. It is very likely that he obtained these secrets from "The Creator". Otherwise, he is also a Sequence 5, and today's information would definitely corrupt him!
Although she couldn't remember any information about the "Above the Sequence", Cattleya still remembered that the information "The Emperor" said could be contaminated. She realized: "The Creator" may also have a kingdom of God similar to the gray fog. "The Emperor" should have obtained this information under the protection of "The Creator". And he should have also done some hypnotic processing, only when he is in the kingdom of God, he can "recall" these memories.
Then Cattleya also realized: "The Emperor" only knows part of the information. At the previous Tarot Gatherings, he almost answered every question, and even if he didn't know the specific information, he had very logical guesses, but today he rarely said "I don't know" twice!
That's right, how could anyone know everything?

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - 520 Princess Ethel who turned the tide (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Blackbeard for becoming a free member]
62 Empress Borough, Backlund.
Hobert completed the bestowal ritual and received 6,100 pounds in cash and 8 Beyonder ingredients from Little Sun, which would be paid upon his return to City of Silver.
He put 100 pounds into his wallet, which had been empty for several days, and then sacrificed 6,000 pounds to the "Nation of Disorder." The 5,000 pounds he had taken out earlier would last for a while.
Having earned so much today, Hobert was in a great mood. He asked the kitchen to add a few dishes and planned to have a drink in the evening to relax, as he had been tense for the past few days.
But in the evening, Dophis suddenly came to report: "Earl, Tim, the ambassador of the Feynapotter Kingdom, requests an audience."
"What is he here for?" Hobert frowned: "Decline it."
He was no longer the small lawyer he used to be; he could refuse to see ambassadors whenever he wanted.
Moreover, he had just been made an Earl for tricking the Feynapotter royal family. Why would he meet the ambassador of the Feynapotter Kingdom at this time? Even if Hobert had a thick skin, he would feel embarrassed!
Dophis went out to decline and returned with an envelope: "This is from the ambassador to you."
Hobert opened the letter and read it. It said: Tonight at eight o"clock, in the abandoned warehouse in Whiteland Town, eastern suburbs of Backlund. Don't leave without seeing me.
The signature was: Ethel.
Hobert's eyes narrowed. He looked carefully, and it was indeed Ethel!
At this moment, the letters on the stationery faded rapidly, and finally, only a blank piece of paper remained.
Dophis, who was next to him, asked, "Do you need me to make any preparations?"
Hobert waved his hand gently: "Let me think about it."
He really couldn't figure out the intention of this Princess Ethel to meet with him. Did she still hope that he would go back and help her fight for the position of crown princess?
Hobert shook his head with a smile, that would be too whimsical: Did she want me to pay for the reconstruction of the Alhambra Palace? Hehe, dream on! Uh, it's not impossible for me to rebuild the Alhambra Palace. Whoever enters the palace in the future has to buy a ticket! It's possible to give Ferdinand II and Ethel a monthly pass.
After thinking for a while, Hobert thought: Could Ethel be planning to ask me for help to remove the corruption from the members of the Castiya family?
Last Monday, Hobert noticed in the "Nation of Disorder" that many members of the Castiya family were corrupted by the "Nation of Disorder". If left unchecked, they will definitely lose control or die one after another in the next few weeks to a year or two.
The more Hobert thought about it, the more he felt it was possible: It's hard to say about others, after all, they just finished fighting, and then they come to ask their opponents for help! But Ethel can indeed do such a thing.
Guessing her intention, Hobert began to consider whether to inform the Loen royal family about this matter?
In the end, Hobert shook his head, not because he was soft-hearted or nostalgic, but because he was already an Earl now, and even if he caught another princess from an enemy country, it was impossible to obtain a reward that interested him too much.
Moreover, Hobert also hoped that the Augustus family and the Castiya family would maintain a confrontation, or rather, maintain a balanced state.
Hobert will take action when Philip I wants to accommodate the uniqueness, and Hobert will definitely disrupt the situation when George III wants to be promoted to "Black Emperor" in the future!
Then, the corruption of the "Nation of Disorder" may cause the Castiya family to lose many middle and high-level combat capabilities in the coming period, which may break the balance between the two families.
If Ethel came for this matter, Hobert was willing to help and could take the opportunity to negotiate terms.
So Hobert decided to meet Ethel in the evening, but he couldn't do it without any precautions. Hobert returned to his study and brought "1-104" and "1-106", several "Order Crystals", and his knife to the real world.
Because of the lessons learned from Philip I, Hobert had not brought "Order Crystals" and "Order Wood" with him during this period to avoid being noticed by George III.
Of course, there was no way to drink alcohol for dinner. Hobert ate a simple dinner, told Dophis where he was going, and then used "Travel" to come to Whiteland Town in the eastern suburbs of Backlund.
Hobert estimated that the fact that Tim came to him this afternoon had already reached the royal family's ears, and there would definitely be people from Military Intelligence 9 outside the Earl's Mansion.
But the surveillance of him would not be too strict, after all, everyone knew that he had just tricked the Castiya family, and no one worried that he would have any conspiracy with the Feynapotter ambassador.
The abandoned warehouse was easy to find, because there were only two warehouses in the whole town, one was still in use and the other was abandoned.
Hobert observed around the abandoned warehouse for a long time, and seeing that there was no ambush, he used "Blink" to enter the warehouse.
Ethel had already arrived. Today, she was wearing a knight's uniform with Feynapotter characteristics, sitting on a chair in the center of the warehouse, waiting with her legs crossed.
There was only Princess Ethel in the warehouse. After the two looked at each other, Hobert pulled out a chair and sat across from Ethel across a broken table.
Ethel broke the silence: "Don't you have anything to say about what happened at the Alhambra Palace?"
Hobert smiled: "What's there to say? It's just each for their own master. Aren't you not as angry as you were last week?"
"The matter has already happened, and anger cannot solve the problem." Ethel said with her arms folded: "Moreover, we were enemies at the time, but now we are not."
If Ethel really got angry as soon as she came up, hoping to take the initiative, then Hobert wouldn't indulge her. He would leave immediately and make an appointment another day.
If the other party didn't express their sincerity with real money, then don't make an appointment again.
Hobert smiled: "I am the Earl of the Loen Kingdom, and you are the Princess of the Feynapotter Kingdom. Although the two countries are not in a state of war, the relationship is not very friendly."
"But aren't you still a follower of the "Creator"?" Princess Ethel cut to the key point: "I think you shouldn't want the Castiya family to be too weak either."
In fact, Hobert's solo arrival tonight was very telling.
Hobert was already sure that Ethel was here to find the possibility of eliminating the corruption of her family members.
It's just that he just smiled and didn't say anything more.
Ethel was silent for a second or two. She took a deep breath and asked: "Aren't you curious about what I asked you to come out for?"
The fact that she can talk here unpretentiously is enough to show her level of negotiation, but some things still need to be brought up by her.
Hobert also had his own purpose, so he followed this topic and said: "I am indeed a little curious."
"Last Monday, was the giant bird that determined the direction of the battle an incarnation of the "Creator"?" Ethel asked.
"No, it just carried some of the "Creator's" power." Hobert replied ambiguously.
"The power that He casually revealed corrupted many people." Ethel finally said the key point: "I heard that Backlund is already preparing to go to war with the Feynapotter Kingdom!
"If the corruption of the Castiya family members is ignored, once the two sides go to war, the Castiya family will quickly collapse due to the lack of sufficient Beyonders.
The worst result is that the Augustus family obtains most of the Beyonder characteristics of the Castiya family. Without our checks and balances, the Augustus family will go to war with the Balk family in the Southern Continent sooner or later.
"It's better to eliminate this war from the root and let the Castiya family continue to contain the Augustus family."
She said this as if she was thinking about Hobert, without saying a word of "begging".
Hobert smiled: "For us, these are not very important things."
Ethel continued: "We can protect all your assets in the South Colson region."
Hobert thought: That's right! There is no reason to help for nothing.
But his conditions are more than these: "Give me the right to govern South Colson, and don't send anyone to this area anymore."
Ethel directly refused: "We cannot allow a country within a country to appear in the Feynapotter Kingdom!"
"I am not going to establish a country in the South Colson region." Hobert smiled: "It nominally still belongs to the Feynapotter Kingdom, but it is like a fiefdom that has been divided."
Ethel said: "That's not possible either..."
Hobert simply got up directly: "You can go back and consider it and we"ll talk again."
"You must guarantee that it will not threaten the rule of the Feynapotter Kingdom! The soldiers and Beyonder power in the South Colson region will never leave that mountainous area!" Ethel also stood up.
"Do you have any misunderstandings?" Hobert looked at Ethel: "I am going to use that territory to make money, not to subvert the rule of the kingdom!
"I will also increase investment there and continue to dredge the river to make that waterway and that mountainous area more prosperous, but you don't want any taxes, they all belong to me."
Hobert said with a smile: "If I wanted to subvert the rule of the Castiya family, I would never choose a mountainous area as a base."
Ethel considered it and then said: "If criminals escape to South Colson, police or intelligence agency personnel can freely enter and exit there to pursue them."
She was afraid that it would become a den of spies for the Loen Kingdom.
"I also hate those criminals," Hobert considered it and then said: "Our security personnel will send the criminals you need to you.
"In addition, you must be clear that I will not allow the forces of the Loen Kingdom to enter my territory. As you said, I am a follower of the "Creator."
Ethel nodded almost imperceptibly. Hobert's last sentence made her feel a lot more relieved, that is to say, Hobert will govern there as a follower of the "Creator", not as the Earl of the Loen Kingdom.
"I can't make the decision on this matter, I need to report it to Feynapotter immediately." Ethel said meaningfully: "The complete South Colson area used to be the territory of an Earl, which is quite in line with your current title."
Hobert spread his hands: "You gave up your rule over that area."
Ethel did not continue to discuss this topic: "Wait here for a while, I"ll go out for a while, and I"ll give you an answer immediately."
Hobert sat back in the chair and watched Princess Ethel leave the warehouse. Don't mention it, her back looks quite heroic.
In fact, for a princess, being able to risk going to an enemy country to negotiate with the enemy's Earl, especially the enemy's Earl who obtained his title by tricking the Castiya family, is enough to show her courage.
Ethel came to a small room outside the abandoned warehouse. She knelt on one knee on the ground and reported to Philip I, who was far away in the Feynapotter Kingdom.
She first recited the honorific title, and then reported the general process of the conversation just now.
After repeating it four or five times, Ethel finally received Philip I's reply: "Promise him."
This voice suddenly appeared in her mind. Along with the voice, there was also a blurred figure. It could be seen that it was indeed Philip I.
Recalling the time when the "Creator" took the initiative to "contact" her, all the vision could be occupied, and she could see a very solid figure.
This made Ethel even more certain that the "Creator" is really a god!
Immediately afterwards, the figure in Ethel's mind disappeared. After waiting for a while, she saw that Philip I had no other instructions, and then returned to the warehouse.
"The king can agree to your conditions, but we must establish an observation mechanism." This is what Ethel thought of on the way back:
"We will not send any administrative personnel to the South Colson area, but we must send an observation group every year to observe whether there are any signs in South Colson that are detrimental to the royal family or the entire country."
Hobert shook his head with a smile: "Your so-called signs are too broad. If I want to buy a batch of guns to suppress bandits, is it considered detrimental to the royal family?"
"Of course not, we are just conducting a certain observation, so that everyone can rest assured."
Hobert shook his head: "We might as well establish a mutual liaison organization. You can ask questions directly if you have any questions. We do not welcome any supervisory agencies, and we will not be manipulated by your so-called evidence of some people with ulterior motives against the royal family."
Ethel nodded: "Okay, but members of the liaison organization can go to the South Colson area."
Seeing that Hobert was about to refuse again, she said with a slight wry smile: "That is the territory of the kingdom, and we always have to send people to take a look!
"I promise, just take a look! Not surveillance, not secret agents, just take a look."
Seeing Ethel insist, Hobert had to say: "Okay, but in exchange, I can auction the Beyonder characteristics of the "Arbiter" pathway at the auction center."
Ethel had to compromise: "But send me a detailed list of the auction items. The royal family must know when the auction will be held."
It would be good to spend more money to buy the Beyonder characteristics of the auction.
Hobert stretched out his hand and shook hands with Ethel: "Deal!"
Then Hobert said meaningfully: "Congratulations!"
The conclusion of this agreement will definitely greatly increase Ethel's popularity among the Castiya family! There will be more supporters in the battle for the throne.
What he didn't know was that even Philip I was doing the final observation on Ethel to see if he should support her as the crown prince.
Ethel certainly understood what Hobert was talking about: "Thank you."
Hobert retracted his hand: "I"ll tell you the honorific title of the "Creator". After you return to Feynapotter City, gather all the corrupted family members together, and then recite the honorific title of the "Creator". He will uniformly remove the corruption for the members of the Castiya family."
Ethel smiled and said, "You trust me so much, aren't you afraid that I will break my promise and not give you the governance of the territory?"
"Then there will be giant birds like that visiting Feynapotter City again," Hobert replied indifferently.
Hobert was not worried about this, because he knew that the Feynapotter Kingdom would never take such a risk, Ethel's words were just a test.
Ethel just smiled and didn't continue the topic: "If I want to find you, how should I contact you?"
"Pray to the "Creator" in case of emergency, and send a letter to the Lord's Mansion of Jeffery Territory if it is not urgent." Hobert does not intend to tell her the contact information of the messenger at this time.
...
After Ethel got the title of "Creator", she immediately left Whiteland Town with the sealed item.
After all, this is an enemy country, and the longer you stay, the more dangerous it is.
Back in the suburbs of Feynapotter City, in that luxurious royal manor, Ethel immediately reported the detailed negotiation process to Philip I.
At this time, Philip I was more hunched than last week, and the "whoosh whoosh" sound in his lungs and trachea was even louder!
Many Beyonder members of the Castiya family were in a more serious condition than Philip I, and there were already signs of getting out of control.
If this continues, the situation will only get worse. Philip I agreed to Ethel's plan and sent her to negotiate with the dependents of the "Creator".
That night, all the contaminated family members were brought to this manor.
Ethel told everyone about the role played by the "Creator" in the previous battle. The "Creator" did not show up that day, and most Beyonders below the angel level did not feel the existence of the "Creator".
Ethel also told everyone that she ventured to Backlund and contacted the dependents of the "Creator" to find hope for removing the corruption.
These family members had already contacted the familiar Mother Earth churches in the past week, hoping to get a way to eliminate the corruption from the Mother Earth Church.
As a result, after some inquiries, they learned that the archbishops of the church had asked the "Creator" to eliminate the corruption on their bodies.
So when everyone heard the title of "Creator", they knew that they were finally saved.
Amid everyone's compliments, Ethel asked people to set up an altar, then bowed slightly to the altar, and said in a pious tone: "Creator in the Shadow of Order..."
At this time, Philip I also appeared in the corner of the hall, after all, he was also very seriously corrupted.
It's just that Philip I still has some reservations about the "Creator". Asking the "Creator" for help is a last resort. It is better for the Castiya family to start believing in external gods than for a large number of demigods and Sequence 5 level members to die in a short period of time.
Moreover, they are all corrupted, and the Beyonder characteristics in their bodies may also be corrupted. If the Beyonder characteristics are crushed, it will not be possible to remove the corruption, which is even more troublesome.
At this time, Philip I heard Ethel in front of the altar praying for the power of the "Creator" to remove the corruption from the family members in front of the altar.
He stared intently at the altar, wanting to see if the "Creator" was "Uncertain Mist"?
Whoosh~
A violent wind blew out from the altar, causing the corners of everyone's clothes to rustle.
Immediately afterwards, a figure appeared in the mid-air above the altar, as if sitting in a jungle of sharp swords.
He exuded a sacred light, as if he could end all chaos, and as if he could bring complete chaos.
He exuded an aura of majesty, causing people to lower their heads unconsciously, and want to surrender unconsciously.
The Castiya family who were still standing immediately knelt on one knee. They lowered their heads, and almost the same thought appeared in their hearts: this is really the pressure from the gods!
Before, they doubted the identity of the "Creator" god. Many people guessed whether he was a wild god on an island in the Southern Continent or the Berserk Sea. Now, no one dares to think in this direction.
Immediately afterwards, everyone felt that the coldness wrapped around their bodies and spirits quickly disappeared. The corruption that had been troubling them these days was instantly drawn away without a trace.
Philip I felt that the thick phlegm in his lungs and trachea had also disappeared. He stared at the figure of the "Creator"!
That's not "Uncertain Mist"!
According to the description of the Night Emperor, the main body of "Uncertain Mist" is a ring of billowing white mist...
In addition, the feeling that the "Creator" gives people is completely different from that of "Uncertain Mist".
When the figure of the "Creator" disappeared, Philip I came back to his senses. The reward for removing the corruption this time was really just the governance of the South Colson area!
There was no mark by an outer god, and no spiritual brand was imprinted.
Philip I suddenly smiled. He had repeatedly weighed the pros and cons in the past few days before finally making such a decision, but his repeated weighing was just a joke.
Ethel bowed piously in front of the altar, and the ceremony ended.
The experience just now made her a little fascinated: so, this is the feeling of being blessed by a god.
...
In the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert did not consider detonating the corruption in the bodies of the Castiya family members, causing a large number of deaths of their middle-sequence Beyonders, and taking the opportunity to defeat this Beyonder family.
But if he really did this, it would only benefit the extraordinary families of other countries in the Northern Continent. With Hobert's current strength, he would not get much benefit.
And the negotiation result with Ethel will also be invalidated.
So Hobert just thought about it and took action to remove the corruption from those Castiya family members, including Philip I. For now, this is the best choice.
This suddenly reminded Hobert of a sentence: It is completely different to have a sword and not use it and to have no sword to use.
After regaining his strength, Hobert returned to the real world. It was already late today. He rested for a while, and as soon as it dawned, he went to Jeffery Territory by "Travel".
Fors was rarely up early once. Conrad, Philip and other backbone members of the Lord's Mansion were already waiting here. The notice they received was: today they will follow the Lord to inspect the new territory.
They already had some guesses about what would happen in the future. Although they were a little unwilling, as long as Hobert gave an order, they were still willing to leave the land where they were born and raised and go to live on another land.
After Hobert appeared from the illusory spirit world, he first smiled at everyone: "The situation has changed! Allen, go prepare a boat, we are going back to the Lord's Mansion on the East Coast together!"
Everyone was stunned. Isn't the Lord's Mansion on the East Coast occupied by the royal family?
