chapters.title: Chapter 523 - 523: The Qualitative Change and Abilities of Demigods
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The abilities at the demigod level filled Hobert with pleasant surprise, and he couldn't help but exclaim: "The Sequence Four level is indeed a qualitative change!"
Another signature skill of the 'Earl of the Fallen' is 'Exploitation.' Besides exploiting the convenience and loopholes of certain rules, this ability can extend or end some abilities or negative effects prematurely.
It can also 'Exploit' the opponent's attacks, which basically means gaining temporary control over the opponent's abilities.
Just like when hunting the six-legged imp, it could gain partial control of Hobert's 'Underworld Gate'.
"Tampering" involves creating a combat environment favorable to oneself in a certain area, altering some basic rules of that area.
The other abilities are basically qualitative changes from previous abilities. For example, 'Bestowal' is a qualitative change from the previous 'Bribery'.
However, 'Bestowal' has become so powerful that it has become an offensive skill, capable of 'Bestowing' a certain negative state of oneself onto the opponent, regardless of whether the opponent wants it or not.
As long as the opponent is in the state of 'Bestowal' and is below the angel level, 'Charm', 'Connection', and 'Arrogance' will have a 100% success rate, and the opponent cannot dodge, guaranteeing a hit!
In addition, 'Charm', 'Connection', and 'Arrogance' have also been greatly enhanced. Most importantly, these three abilities have become effective within a certain range and can target specific individuals.
There is also another signature ability of the 'Earl of the Fallen': 'Corruption'!
This ability does not require any build-up and can immediately cause enemies within a certain range to lose the desire to attack, becoming listless or irrational.
At this time, the hearts of these people have already been corrupted, and they will, for a certain period of time, loathe all positive and upright emotions and actions, and take pride in despicable and base thoughts and deeds. For example, they will watch their teammates being killed without lifting a finger, and take pride in it; they will sneak attack their teammates in a despicable way, and take pride in it; they will immediately betray their superiors, and take pride in it; they will unconsciously want to undermine the morale of their teammates.
This is equivalent to an upgraded version of 'Corrosion', except that the ability of 'Corrosion' is still there, and it can be used directly without any build-up. It can make opponents greedy or irrational.
Other abilities that have undergone qualitative changes include 'Distortion', 'Disorder', and 'Weakening'.
The Sequence 4 level of 'Distortion' can not only perform conceptual distortion, but also distort the opponent's intentions, goals, and attack effects. For example, directly 'Distorting' the target's attack intent, making the target hostile to their own companions in a short period of time, and can also 'Distort' the fatal wounds caused by the target into minor injuries.
In addition, it can also 'Distort' distance, allowing one to step out several meters in one step, achieving an effect similar to 'Blink', and can also float in mid-air for a certain period of time by distorting gravity.
The demigod level of 'Disorder' can cause some 'constants' to fall into chaos, such as causing a huge, seemingly solid building to collapse instantly.
It can also, for a certain period of time, make all common laws such as distance and direction, natural laws, etc., within an area chaotic. As long as the target steps into that area, the direction of their attack will change unconsciously.
Ranged attacks such as bullets, cannonballs, and pyromaniac fireballs are also effective.
If attacking a single target, it will still cause the opponent to fall into a state of 'Disorder', but this state has been greatly enhanced and can also deal with demigod-level opponents.
After a Sequence 5 level target falls into a state of 'Disorder', they may not recover for seven or eight seconds.
"Weakening" has also become conceptualized. Besides weakening the target's strength, it can also weaken some of the negative effects suffered by oneself, weaken the environment and rules that are beneficial to the enemy, and so on.
Hobert revealed a long-lost smile and sighed again: "Demigod is indeed a qualitative change!"
Because no one came to disturb him, Hobert simply entered the 'Nation of Disorder' to take a look at the blurry figure sealed in the pool and to briefly check out the new abilities that could be used in the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Unlike the previous promotions, as soon as Hobert sat on the 'Iron Throne', a vortex of power seemed to form around the throne, indicating the further submission of the 'Nation of Disorder' to Hobert.
Hobert first went to feel the pool that had previously sealed the blurry figure. To his surprise, this time the figure did not break free and remained obediently in the pool.
He was a little uneasy and simply went to the pool to take a look.
He saw that the blurry figure in the water was already very clear. He looked to be in his twenties, with bronze hair and a handsome face, but with a bit of a nerdy air.
Hobert raised his hand, and the other party's head emerged from the pool, but the area below the shoulders was still confined by the water in the pool.
Hobert asked condescendingly, "Are you Trunsoest?"
The other party pursed his lips and smiled, but did not speak.
Hobert asked again, "Why are you in the 'Nation of Disorder'?"
The other party's gaze turned elsewhere.
"How tragic, besieged by the six gods who once supported you, your vast empire collapsing rapidly, and you were only one step away from becoming an Outer God!" Hobert continued with a smile.
The other party suddenly looked at Hobert and showed a slight look of surprise. He opened his mouth, seemingly wanting to say something, but Hobert saw that his mouth was still illusory, and he couldn't make any sound at all.
Hobert made a judgment: to confirm again, this is Trunsoest, and he looks a bit like a mental imprint.
But what Hobert couldn't understand was, why did this imprint also become stronger as he became stronger?
In addition, Hobert judged that the other party's consciousness seemed to have basically awakened, but it did not seem to have the ability to communicate.
Hobert waved his hand again, letting the other party sink back into the pool.
He stood in front of the pool, pondering how to bring this mental imprint into the real world. It was also unsettling to keep it sealed in the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Hobert quickly thought of two solutions. The first solution was to bring the mental imprint out of the 'Nation of Disorder' like he did with Captain Dunn's spirit body last time.
But it was not certain whether this method would work, after all, this was a mental imprint, not a spirit body. How to carry it out?
The second solution was to directly use the method of bestowal to 'Bestow' the other party into the real world.
But the problem is, who should perform the 'Bestowal' ceremony?
Because this is likely to cause some danger, one cannot bestow oneself, and it is best not to use the followers, after all, it is not easy for the 'Creator' to develop a few followers.
Finally, Hobert thought of a way. When encountering enemies of low Sequence, subdue them, and then use the 'Psychological Spoon' to hypnotize them, so that they can complete the 'Bestowal' ceremony.
After formulating the plan, Hobert prepared to try it out when he had the opportunity.
Sitting back on the 'Iron Throne', Hobert felt that the area of the 'Nation of Disorder' that he could control had become much larger, which included the dilapidated town and the largest lake in the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Hobert felt that the huge lake was a bit unusual.
He got up again, and the next second he appeared by the huge lake.
Looking at the clear lake water, Hobert immediately saw a picture of someone praying devoutly. After a little discernment, Hobert recognized that it was the residents on the west bank of the Full Moon Lake, the group of people who were being guarded and forced to work in the wilderness.
Hobert roughly understood: In other words, people who pray to the pattern pointing to me can also be seen in this lake. However, the picture is very blurry, and you can't hear what the other party is saying, but if necessary, this huge lake will transmit the power of their faith to me, and those people can also act as anchors.
He looked back at the dilapidated town on the shore of the lake: Can I regard this place as the 'Creator's' Divine Kingdom?
As for the function of this Divine Kingdom, Hobert remembered that Klein could split 'Worms of Spirit' from his body after becoming Sequence 4, and he could leave the 'Worms of Spirit' in the 'Sefirah Castle' to respond to the simple prayers of believers.
However, Hobert found that he could not do this, so when there were more believers and subordinates, it was impossible for the gods to respond to every believer's prayer.
The 'Nation of Disorder' gave the solution: hire 'workers' or find corresponding sealed artifacts.
Hobert realized that hiring ordinary people or believers to work for him was the simplest method. He only needed to give them the authority to respond to believers and give them some simple abilities, and most prayers could be responded to by them.
And Hobert only needed to use the pool in the main hall to pay attention to a few important believers.
The more Hobert thought about it, the more feasible this method seemed. Moreover, he only needed to recruit two people at the beginning, after all, the 'Creator's' business was not very large.
As for the remuneration... what remuneration is needed? Entering the 'Creator's' Divine Kingdom to work, isn't this the best remuneration?
Hobert shook his head with a smile. Jokes aside, it didn't seem appropriate not to give any remuneration.
But giving money was even more inappropriate, it would devalue the job. It would be better to give the family members of the employees some benefits or preferential treatment, and then highlight the glorious nature of the job, which he believed should be easy to recruit people.
However, Hobert planned to wait and see first, otherwise, if the employees saw that the 'Creator's' believers were basically members of the Balk family, it would be easy to expose the fact that the 'Creator' was still in the start-up phase.
Returning to the 'Iron Throne', Hobert used his spirituality to continue to feel the new permissions he had gained in the 'Nation of Disorder'. First of all, he found that he could use the power of the 'Nation of Disorder' to help petitioners make talismans.
Currently, the available charms include those from the "Black Emperor" pathway, such as "Disorder" and "Distortion." After wearing the black glove "1-107" seized from the Tamara family, I can also create charms from the "Justiciar" pathway, like "Exile" and "Prohibition."
However, this is limited to these two pathways. Hobert also picked up "1-105," the most powerful Sealed Artifact he currently possesses. This artifact comes from a "Blatherer" of the "Abyss" pathway, but it's impossible to create charms related to that pathway.
In terms of the strength of the charms, there are two modes to choose from. One is creating charms at the demigod level, which requires Hobert to mobilize the power of the "Nation of Disorder" and consume about one-third of his own spirituality.
That is to say, it's best to create only one per day, otherwise it would be very dangerous in a real-world battle.
The other mode is for charms below the demigod level, where about 15 can be created at once. If the "Earl of the Fallen's" potion is completely digested, the number should reach around 20.
Creating such a batch of charms also requires a significant amount of spirituality, so it's best to only do it once a day.
In terms of spirituality consumption, creating charms related to the "Lawyer" pathway is not cost-effective for Hobert. After all, even if he continuously uses dozens of demigod-level abilities in battle, his spirituality wouldn't be depleted.
However, this can be used as a way to display divine power and strengthen the faith of his followers.
Leaning back in the "Iron Throne," Hobert sighed, "Reaching Sequence 4 truly brings divinity. These operations make the 'Creator' look more like a god."
Then, Hobert sensed that he no longer needed to walk backward to enter the "Nation of Disorder"; he could enter simply by silently chanting the incantation in his mind.
In addition, the abilities of the "Order Tree," "Disorder Stone," and "Order Crystal" have all undergone qualitative improvements, especially the "Order Tree." Hobert can now summon a tree covering two hundred meters.
The size of this tree is quite terrifying!
The "Order Crystal" can mobilize more power from the "Nation of Disorder" to form a shield around him that lasts for more than ten seconds.
Immediately afterward, Hobert thought that the "Order Crystal's" shield could be used when summoning the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" or the "Holy Infant King."
After summoning them, the ten seconds would be enough for him to leave the angel-level battlefield.
Undoubtedly, this strengthened Hobert's utilization of high-end combat power.
But it's best not to use these two abilities carelessly. Using either one would reveal the surging power of the "Nation of Disorder," and George III should be able to sense it if used in some corner of Backlund.
Finally, Hobert turned his attention to those Sealed Artifacts. After becoming a demigod, he could use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to perform preliminary sealing on these artifacts.
First, he tried to seal "1-101," whose negative effects easily attract Beyonders at or above the demigod level from the "Marauder" pathway. It was finally sealed, and this demigod-level Sealed Artifact from the "Marauder" pathway could finally be taken to the real world for use.
Hobert also sealed the other Sealed Artifacts, greatly reducing their negative effects. Even "1-105" from the "Whisperer" could be used in the real world for 3 minutes, requiring only the sacrifice of one person's internal organs, blood, and soul.
When sealing "1-107," Hobert noticed the artifact's uniqueness. The spiritual residue and incomplete spirit body within the Sealed Artifact were resisting Hobert's sealing.
At this time, Hobert discovered that after becoming a demigod, he could sense the internal structure of this Sealed Artifact. He had noticed before that it was a Sealed Artifact composed of some "Imperative Mage" Beyonder characteristics and a complete "Mentor of Disorder" characteristic.
The two Beyonder characteristics, along with the remaining spirit body and spiritual residue, formed a delicate balance. If the sealing power was uneven, this balance would be broken, and the Sealed Artifact would be completely ruined.
Then, Hobert realized that he could temporarily put this balance into a state of "Disorder." Taking advantage of this opportunity, he could drag out the soul and spiritual residue. If he put them back before the "Disorder" state ended, it wouldn't affect the balance of the Sealed Artifact.
Hobert estimated that the "Disorder" state of the Sealed Artifact could last for about 6 minutes, so he used this method to drag out the soul and spiritual residue of the Sealed Artifact.
In front of the "Iron Throne," a somewhat blurred and illusory male figure formed.
He looked to be in his fifties, with black hair and features that conveyed a slight unnaturalness, making his face look somewhat like a wax figure.
Hobert asked, "What is your name?"
The other party replied in a somewhat dull tone, "Curtis Tamara."
"Do you remember how you died?"
Curtis "recalled" slightly, "I died in an internal family battle."
Hobert quickly asked, "Did the Tamara family experience a civil war?"
"Yes."
"When was that... what specific time was it?"
Hobert originally wanted to ask "How long ago was that?" but thought that Curtis had been in the glove since his death, so it would be difficult to distinguish how long ago the civil war occurred.
So he simply changed his question.
"The Fourth Epoch, 1022."
Hobert was stunned. "Did they use an epoch system in the Fourth Epoch? But, when is 1022?"
So Hobert asked again, "Before you died, what major event happened?"
Curtis said, "Thirty years ago, the Night Emperor fell!"
Hobert nodded. That happened after the Night Emperor fell, before the Pale Era.
Hobert had originally thought that the Pale Era would arrive soon after the Night Emperor fell, but now it seemed that there should have been some time in between.
Hobert asked again, "Why did the Tamara family have a civil war?"
"Incompatible beliefs and ideologies."
Hobert thought of the scene he had seen before from the "Uncertain Mist," where three members of the Tamara family were sacrificed: "Be more specific!"
Curtis seemed to recall carefully before saying, "During the United Empire era, our patriarch Tamara was loyal to Trunsoest..."
Hobert was stunned. "Is this guy confused? Aren't you nobles of the Tudor Empire?"
He heard the other party continue, "Inadvertently, the patriarch learned of the existence of the great 'Uncertain Mist' from Trunsoest and found clues to this great being, so the patriarch defected to Tudor..."
Hobert roughly understood: Trunsoest must have asked Tamara to find clues to the "Uncertain Mist," but Tamara found the clues and simply wanted to keep them for himself, so he betrayed Trunsoest.
He also thought: Thinking carefully, it is quite strange for a "Balancer" like Tamara to appear in the Tudor Empire's camp. Theoretically, the Night Emperor, who had become a "Justiciar," should have been able to exert some influence on him. What would happen in a war? After the two sides finished their harsh words and were about to fight, Tamara suddenly knelt down, and there was no way to pull him up.
Finally, Hobert thought: "Suicide" is not enough to describe Tamara's behavior! He treated the clues to the "Uncertain Mist" as a treasure, but the entire family was ruined.
Curtis continued: "Not long after entering the Four Emperors era, the patriarch found the great 'Uncertain Mist' according to the clues. That is the true god of the 'Black Emperor' and 'Justiciar' pathways in the entire universe!
"But some fools in the family just didn't want to believe in the great 'Uncertain Mist.'
"Especially after the Night Emperor fell, with the patriarch's help, Pedy Tamara, who was appreciated by the patriarch, killed a 'Duke of Entropy' who had been severely injured by the Six Gods and successfully jumped to an adjacent pathway, becoming an angel.
"We took the opportunity to attack the Trunsoest family and gained many benefits, including the potion formulas of the 'Black Emperor' pathway and many Beyonder characteristics.
"We all thought that the family would become stronger, but no one thought that it was the beginning of the family's split.
"Pedy, who was appreciated by the patriarch, publicly opposed worshiping the 'Uncertain Mist' and ordered the Abraham family members who came to join us not to worship this great being.
"After several unsuccessful negotiations, a civil war finally broke out."
Hobert slowly nodded. This connected with Jonathan's description. However, the second split of the Abraham family should have occurred before the civil war of the Tamara family. The remaining Abraham family members were all willing to believe in the "Uncertain Mist," so they were ordered not to engage in such worship.
He also thought: After the Tamara family defected to the Blood Emperor, was the reason for actively marrying into the Abraham family to borrow the power of Mr. "Door" or the abilities of the "Apprentice" pathway to get rid of the Night Emperor's influence on them?
After a moment of thought, Hobert felt that this was very likely.
With almost 6 minutes gone, Hobert finally asked, "Do you know the final result of the Tamara family civil war?"
"Pedy and the others can't win!"
Hobert nodded and "stuffed" the incomplete spirit body and spiritual imprint back into "1-107."
Then he pondered the conversation just now: Tamara himself was influenced by the "Uncertain Mist" from a very early time. Judging from the current composition of Tamara members, the civil war may have caused a split in the Tamara family, but the main members of the Tamara family still control the potion formulas for "Arbiter," "Lawyer," and "Apprentice."
I just wonder if those members who were unwilling to believe in the "Uncertain Mist" are still alive? I wonder if I can still find traces of them now? And I wonder if there is anything here that can be exploited?
Then Hobert thought again: I have been right to kill the members of the Tamara family all along. I didn't expect that they had taken advantage of the fire to rob and attack the members of the Trenssos family before! And they even took the opportunity to obtain a copy of the "Duke of Entropy's" Beyonder characteristics! In that case, the Tamara family should have two Angels.
Hobert suddenly realized: Thinking about it from another perspective, this is a clue for my advancement to Sequence 2! After all, there are only a few Sequence 2, and now he at least knows that a copy of the "Duke of Entropy's" Beyonder characteristics is in the Tamara family!
Putting "1-107" back on the stone platform, Hobert realized that he had been in the "Nation of Disorder" for some time, so he returned to the real world.
After retrieving the "Order Wood" nailed to Teuton's body, Hobert walked out of the empty courtyard, and Grove was waiting at the gate: "Your Grace, I have already killed all of Teuton's sons. What should I do with Teuton's women?"

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - 524: Reopening the Justice League Gathering
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In this kind of cunning and forceful struggle, Hobert certainly didn't plan to leave any future troubles.
Moreover, as members of a noble family, they should be prepared to face this fate, just as every Beyonder implicitly agrees to join a life-or-death competition.
Besides, generally speaking, noblewomen basically fall into the category of spoils of war, which is why Grovee asked that question.
Although Hobert had previously said he wanted to seize all of Teuton's women, it was to plunge Teuton into deeper pain.
"Let those who want to go home go home," Hobert said. "Those who don't want to go home, send them to the lord's mansion on the other side and let the Madam handle it."
Hobert couldn't help but recall the scene that appeared in his mind during his promotion. He suddenly realized that it was the potion corroding his consciousness, and that he might also fall when corrupting others in the future.
In order to prevent this from happening, Hobert believed that he must stick to his bottom line and not let others fall, dragging himself down with them.
This is actually a process of resisting the potion, after all, the potion not only gives Beyonders abilities, but also affects their temperament and will.
Hobert suddenly realized that if it were in the past, he would definitely have questioned killing Teuton's sons, or felt uneasy about it.
But now, Hobert found that he didn't feel anything at all.
This was wrong. After all, they were several lives. It was okay to order their deaths for his own purposes, but he had to know what he was doing.
Otherwise, what was the difference between him and a tyrant who regarded life as worthless?
Thinking of this, Hobert frowned. After thinking carefully about the rulers of this world, they were no different from the tyrants in Hobert's memory.
Hobert didn't want to become like that himself. He made up his mind to strengthen his emotional training in the future, neither being too flamboyant nor too indifferent.
In short, he must maintain enough humanity to resist the erosion of the potion.
However, now was not the time to think about this. Hobert came to the main hall of Teuton's lord's mansion and designated it as the town government.
Hobert said to Grovee, the great contributor this time: "You have two choices. The first is to be the first mayor of Teuton Town, but you must also listen to the mayor's arrangements in terms of business."
"This position is relatively easy and suitable for retirement."
"The second option is to go back and rest for one to two weeks and help me establish an intelligence agency. This agency is directly under the lord's mansion, which means it only obeys my orders."
Grovee thought for a while: "I don't think I'm too old yet. I've finally met a wise leader like you, and I still want to work harder."
Hobert smiled: "Okay, after the handover with Conrad is completed, go home and rest for a while."
"Currently, your eldest son and second son are both fighting bandits. Among them, your eldest son is already a Beyonder, and he has chosen to become a 'Warrior'! You will have to wait until they return from bandit suppression before you can reunite."
"As for Dennis, he is currently in Backlund. I will bring him back in a few days."
Grove sighed inwardly: I didn't expect that in my fifties, my family and I would encounter such an opportunity!
He had long heard that Hobert had reused Albert and Corwin after seizing the knight's fief. Now Grove finally understood that this Earl used people regardless of their background, only looking at their ability and loyalty to him.
Even the two knights who had obvious opposition to the Earl when he first came to the territory were still accepted by the Earl after sincerely pledging their allegiance.
Hobert sat here, took over all of Teuton's property, and returned to the lord's mansion on the other side. He drank a few glasses of wine for dinner and celebrated.
In the evening, he naturally "danced" with Fors. After some intimacy, Hobert realized that although he possessed a certain divinity and had become indifferent in some aspects, his feelings and love for Fors had not changed.
This made Hobert realize that as long as he had time in the future, he should spend more time with Fors to keep his emotions in a lively state.
The two of them chatted intimately before going to bed as usual. Fors told Hobert: "The 'Magician' potion has finally been completely digested. I have already written to my teacher to tell him the good news and can get another extraordinary material from him."
"If everything goes well, I plan to adjust my state and complete the promotion next Monday or Tuesday."
Hobert smiled and said, "Our Lady of the Manor is also a 'Mid Sequence' Beyonder."
Then, the two talked about the "Justice League" gathering. While chatting, Fors fell asleep in Hobert's arms.
But Hobert didn't feel sleepy at all. Another reaction after becoming a demigod was: eating very little and sleeping very little.
Theoretically speaking, it is enough to eat only one meal a day and rest for only three hours.
Even if you use meditation to fall asleep, you will wake up after three hours.
Hobert estimated that the demigods of the "Sleepless" pathway should only sleep for half an hour a day, otherwise they would not be able to work 22 hours a day, and still have time to deal with their own life problems.
Since he couldn't sleep, Hobert began to think about some plans for the future. Having a few extra hours in a day suddenly seemed pretty good.
… …
Friday morning, Backlund, 62 Empress Borough.
The carriages of Earl Wolfe and Earl Vincent entered Hobert's Earl's mansion half an hour before the gathering.
The carriages stopped, and Corali, the youngest daughter of Earl Wolfe, and Karl, the youngest son of Earl Vincent, got out respectively.
They were members developed by Audrey and Glaint.
At that time, Hobert also planned to open up relations with the Loen nobles through these members. Who knew that before he knew it, Hobert had already become a noble himself.
Then, Xio and Jessica arrived one after another by taxi carriage, and finally Viscount Glaint and Audrey's carriage arrived one after another.
After half a year, the "Justice League" gathering restarted.
The gathering was held in the study, but this Earl's study did not have many bookshelves, and it looked a little empty.
In the center of the empty study was a long table and eight chairs. The gathering members sat around the long table, chatting and laughing.
At ten o'clock, Hobert announced: "Let's begin!"
Everyone had already sat down according to their previous seats. Hobert sat at the head, and Jessica sat behind Hobert.
Fors and Xio sat on the left, Audrey and Glaint sat on the right, Coralie sat behind Audrey, and Karl sat behind Viscount Glaint.
Audrey looked at Fors opposite her, and Hobert at the head. The eye contact between the two showed their sweetness and affection, which made Audrey feel a little uncomfortable.
But she was very good at adjusting her psychological state and did not let anyone see her discomfort.
Viscount Glaint, one of the initiators, said first: "I have already entrusted Miss Xio with my needs before. I need the potion formula and main ingredients for Sequence 8 of the 'Apothecary' pathway."
Hobert said unhurriedly: "In Feynapotter, I have a good cooperation with the Church of the Earth Mother and can help you get the potion formula for 'Beast Tamer'. As for the main ingredients of the potion, I have them on hand."
Glaint knew that his problem was not difficult for Hobert. He asked with a smile: "About how much money will it cost?"
But Hobert said: "No need for pounds, I need you to do me a favor."
Viscount Glaint made a gesture of please speak.
"I plan to make some investments in Backlund and take over the governance of the territory as soon as possible," Hobert said. "But I lack some reliable subordinates."
"This made me think of the noble children who have received good education and have good vision."
"Well, I mean those noble children who have no right of inheritance and are not valued by their families."
"I heard that they have to find their own way after graduating from university or getting married?"
Glaint and Karl nodded at the same time, and Glaint said: "That's the case."
There are too many such noble children. After all, the noble's high-quality resources are also limited, and they are generally more fertile, so of course, limited high-quality resources must be used on those noble children who look promising.
The reason why Karl also nodded was that if he had not become a Beyonder and been valued by the family, he would have to make a living in the future.
Of course, it is not difficult for them to work in government departments or become department heads in a certain company. However, in that case, with their income and network resources, they will gradually move away from the previous noble family.
Now that he is valued by the family, the family will arrange a leadership position in a government department or a high-level position in a large company invested by the family. If he works harder, he will have a good life.
"Help me gather such a group of people," Hobert said. "I will conduct a simple interview with them and then train them. They will have a great opportunity to become the core management of my business in Backlund."
Becoming a confidant of an Earl is already a very good choice for a noble child who is not valued by the family.
For Hobert, this group generally feels that they have been treated unfairly and generally complains about the current social system. This group of educated and knowledgeable noble children is very easy to reform into high-end talents.
This was an idea Hobert had only last night.
Glaint, the Viscount, said, "This isn't too difficult. Is there anything else I need to do?"
For him, it was just a matter of a meal. If a Viscount hosted, the noble scions would definitely flock to it.
"I'll let you know when I need your help," Hobert said.
For him now, gold pounds were no longer the greatest need. The resources in Viscount Glaint's hands were worth more than gold pounds.
Another initiator, Xio, looked at Hobert and said, "I need the 'Interrogator' Beyonder characteristic."
She had already obtained the potion formula from the Masked Man of MI9.
Hobert thought for a moment and said, "As previously stated, 1200 pounds."
Karl, sitting behind Viscount Glaint, swallowed. He had recently heard that an 'Interrogator' Beyonder characteristic had appeared at a certain Beyonder gathering, and was quickly bought, with the final transaction price reaching as high as 2800 pounds!
"Or you can also pay with help," Hobert added.
Xio was taken aback: "What help?"
"In a while, I'm going to recruit a batch of workers from the vagrants or the poor in the East Borough. At that time, help me screen their character," Hobert said.
"This is too simple. I'll just pay with gold pounds," Xio didn't want to receive such preferential treatment. "When you need help screening, just give me a call and I'll lend a hand."
"You may have misunderstood me," Hobert smiled. "The number of people I want to recruit is not small, and the workload may be very large. Hmm, I may even need to assign you an assistant at that time."
Xio asked, "How large specifically?"
"Tens of thousands!" Hobert replied.
The other members all thought they had misheard. Audrey simply asked, "Hobert, what industry are you investing in? Why do you need so many workers?"
Hobert smiled mysteriously: "That's confidential for now."
This made Audrey even more curious.
Hobert then looked at Xio: "Of course, the overall recruitment work will be carried out in batches. Let's set a value. If the number of recruits reaches 10,000, it will replace the value of the Beyonder characteristic."
"I will pay you again for the portion above 10,000. If it's less than 10,000, it will be considered that you have completed the task."
For an 'Interrogator,' it is very easy to make vagrants tell the truth. Such screening is not difficult, but as Hobert said, the workload is very large.
Xio had a concept of 10,000 people. Even if she had an assistant, she would have to work continuously for more than a month to complete the screening work.
She nodded: "Okay, I'll pay with doing a task."
As a Sequence 8, Xio could easily earn around 200 pounds a month by doing bounty tasks. Sometimes, if she was lucky and encountered good tasks, such as the task she received from Hobert before, earning four or five hundred pounds a month was not a problem.
After becoming a Sequence 7, she could take on higher-value tasks.
Of course, an 'Interrogator' certainly couldn't earn 1200 pounds in a month, but making an 'Interrogator' work at high intensity for more than a month was worth that price.
Official Beyonders of the same level certainly did not have as high an income as bounty hunters, but official Beyonders had many benefits provided by the organization.
Taking Klein as an example, such as Captain Dunn's business guidance and some protection, such as Old Neil teaching him mystical knowledge, such as him being reimbursed for some of his private expenses, such as the main ingredients for potions, etc.
The safety guarantee alone could not be compensated by any amount of money.
After receiving Xio's reply, Hobert nodded: "After the gathering ends, I'll give you the Beyonder characteristic."
Xio added: "I hope to buy that mystical revolver."
Originally, she had finally saved enough money to buy the handgun and the Beyonder characteristic, but the money for the Beyonder characteristic was not spent, which made her very flush at the moment.
"No problem," Hobert said, "Still the originally agreed price, 1300 pounds!"
"Deal!"
Karl and the others didn't quite understand what the transaction just now meant, but Audrey realized that Xio and Hobert had just completed a transaction regarding a mystical item!
She really wanted to know the specific ability of that handgun, but because neither of them meant to explain, she didn't ask. However, Hobert had obviously given some discounts. At other gatherings, even at the Tarot Club, a mystical revolver couldn't be sold for this price.
Fors was about to advance to Sequence 7, and currently had no needs.
Audrey did need the fruit of the Hallucination Bell, but she knew that the chances of the "Justice League" acquiring this main material were slim, and it would also easily expose her as Miss Justice.
After several initiators had no transaction needs, the other members began to stir.
Karl was the first to raise his hand and said, "Earl, I have completely mastered the abilities of 'Arbiter,' and I really want to obtain the Beyonder materials of 'Sheriff.'"
Since he became a Beyonder, Earl Vincent had also begun to pay attention to the cultivation of this youngest son, so he gave him the 'Sheriff' potion formula in advance, but he had not been able to buy the relevant Beyonder materials or Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert nodded: "Prepare 600 pounds, and after the gathering ends, I will fetch the Beyonder characteristic for you."
"Also, at the Justice League meeting, just call me Hobert."
"Okay, Earl… I mean, Mr. Hobert," Karl nodded repeatedly with an excited expression: "I've already brought the money!"
He didn't expect that the problem that had been troubling him for several months would be solved so easily.
The dignified and graceful noble lady, Corati, also said, "Mr. Hobert, I need the next potion formula and Beyonder materials for 'Apprentice.'"
Hobert smiled: "As last time, I have the Beyonder characteristic here, and Miss Fors has the potion formula."
This transaction was concluded for 1200 pounds, with Hobert and Fors each receiving 600 pounds.
Finally, Jessica said, "I need the potion formula and Beyonder characteristic of 'Briber.'"
"I have also prepared them for you," Hobert smiled: "The formula is 1000 pounds, and the Beyonder characteristic is 1200 pounds!"
"No problem," Jessica said immediately.
"You can also pay with doing a task," Hobert said: "I may need to cultivate a batch of subordinates of the 'Lawyer' pathway in the future. Guide them so that they can digest the potion as soon as possible."
"Digesting the 'Lawyer' potion will replace 50 pounds of debt, digesting the 'Barbarian' potion will replace 100 pounds of debt, and digesting the 'Briber' potion will replace 200 pounds of debt."
Jessica smiled: "I haven't even digested the 'Briber' potion yet."
Hobert leaned back in his chair: "You will eventually digest it, won't you?"
Jessica pondered for a moment before saying, "Okay, I'm willing to pay with doing a task."
For her, it was just a matter of providing some guidance, prioritizing suitable cases to Beyonders for handling, and giving some guidance.
After this transaction ended, everyone realized that Hobert, who was sitting at the head of the table, was like a supplier, seemingly able to meet the needs of all the members.
Corati thought: I didn't feel very surprised just now. Maybe it's because at the previous gathering, Earl Hobert gave us a feeling of omnipotence.
And Audrey noticed even more that Hobert was more willing to have everyone pay by doing tasks: This shows that Hobert's financial situation is good, and he needs helpers more than gold pounds.
Jessica then peddled two Beyonder weapons, and Viscount Glaint sold several potions. The free transaction session ended.
Hobert said, "Let's move on to the intelligence exchange session."
Then he asked, "Does anyone know the detailed situation of Longtail Island?"
Karl was the first to say, "I don't know, but I can help you get the relevant information and deliver it to you tomorrow night."
His second brother worked in the Bureau of Land Resources, and it was not difficult to obtain relevant materials about Longtail Island. He planned to hire several people to complete the detailed transcription work this afternoon and all day tomorrow.
Hobert nodded: "Do you need any reward?"
"No need!" Karl smiled: "Being able to buy such an affordable Beyonder characteristic at the 'Justice League' gathering is the best reward."
Hobert glanced at Karl, who was somewhat reckless half a year ago, but was now much more stable, and nodded: "Okay."
Glaint sighed: "Fiefdom, ah, this is a place to yearn for."
Karl said, "Mr. Hobert, can you tell us about your great adventure in Feynapotter City? I heard that there was a very fierce Beyonder battle that day?"
"Yes," Hobert smiled: "But because my level was too low, I didn't participate in the main battlefield battle."
Fors smiled: You have to be able to participate in a battle at the angel level.
Audrey thought to herself: Who said you didn't participate? I'm sure the power of the 'Creator' must have been what you prayed for!
"My task was to control a Sealed Artifact, but the task failed," Hobert only intended to say this much: "Because the enemy was too powerful!"
Karl asked curiously, "How powerful?"
"Everyone should have the concept of a demigod, right?" Hobert asked after seeing everyone nod, and then said: "Those responsible for guarding the Sealed Artifact had at least five demigods and twenty or thirty Sequence 5s."
Everyone gasped, and Karl simply exclaimed in surprise: "So many people!"
Hobert smiled: "I was very lucky to be able to run out of there."
Glaint and Karl had already begun to imagine that fierce battle, but only the careful Corati noticed that since Mr. Hobert's mission failed, why was he able to receive such a generous reward?
However, seeing that no one else seemed to have noticed this, and Count Hobert didn't want to elaborate, she didn't ask about it.
After discussing some of Feynapotter's customs and anecdotes, the gathering came to an end.
Hobert asked everyone to wait in the study while he retrieved the Beyonder characteristics from the "Nation of Disorder." He then wrote down the "Briber" potion formula at the desk in his bedroom.
Returning to the study, Hobert gave the "Trickmaster" Beyonder characteristic to Corati and the "Sheriff" Beyonder characteristic to Karl.
He gave the "Briber" Beyonder characteristic and the potion formula to Jessica.
Finally, he gave the "Interrogator" Beyonder characteristic and the revolver to Xio. Afterward, Hobert saw everyone off. Fors, of course, stayed at the Earl's mansion, as she was now the Countess.
Xio also stayed behind. Using the tools provided by Hobert, she brewed the potion. Because she had digested the "Sheriff" potion very well, the advancement process was without risk.
After Xio gathered her spirituality, the three of them had lunch together. Dophis took Fors and Xio on a tour of the Count's mansion, while Hobert used "Travel" to reach Conant City and Upton's office.
The Balk family members, who were originally scheduled for about a month of learning, had their stay extended for a period of time and finally concluded today.
Upton had already calculated that even with the month-long extension, it only cost a little over 1600 pounds.
Hobert had previously paid 2000 pounds for tuition. He simply waved his hand generously, giving each student 12 pounds in cash to buy souvenirs, and he wouldn't ask Upton to refund the 2000 pounds of tuition.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - 525 Hunting for Vice Admiral Dusk (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to B.I.G. E for becoming a Sequence 9: Reader]
As the "Creator," He must always show His majesty and mystery, but as the "Favored One of God," He must, of course, win over the elites of the Balk family.
Adding up to only 360 pounds, it greatly increased the elites' goodwill towards the "Favored One of God." Hobert felt that the money was well spent.
While Elliott and the others were out shopping, Hobert chatted with Upton about his experience in this training session.
Upton, smoking a cigarette and wearing a vest, looked very casual, and praised the young people of the Balk family. They were able to endure hardship and were patient, far more outstanding than the young people of some large families in Loen.
Finally, Upton asked: "The power of the great 'Creator' seems to be mainly in the Southern Continent? Do you need me to develop business in the Southern Continent?"
"There are also some forces in the Northern Continent." Hobert smiled and said, "It's just that you don't know it. Someday I'll invite you to the Kingdom of Feynapotter to vacation and let you see the power of the 'Creator' in the Northern Continent."
Upton thought of Hobert's previous visit to Conant City to find reinforcements, and he nodded: "It's really exciting!"
"As for the high-end steam engines you sell, it's very difficult to leave the port through normal channels." Hobert said, "Please ask the 'Creator' to help transport them to the Southern Continent."
The two also talked about the previous raid on the "Judgment Group." Upton told Hobert: "After that, I seemed to be under short-term surveillance, but my suspicion should have been quickly ruled out. For more than a month, I haven't felt any new surveillance."
Hobert nodded slightly, muttering "What a pity" in his heart. He is now a demigod and can completely beat the "Judgment Group." If there are any clues, he doesn't mind earning some extra money.
After the students returned from shopping, Upton treated everyone to a big meal. It wasn't until the evening that Hobert used the "Traveler's Gate" to send everyone back to the Southern Continent.
They had long been holding back a lot of experiences and wanted to go back and brag about it!
Having close contact with the "Favored One of God" was secondary. The key was that they participated in the battle of the Favored Ones in the Northern Continent and learned that there were so many Favored Ones of the "Creator" in the distant Northern Continent.
This made them feel like "We are not alone."
Lawrence reported to the "Favored One of God" on the progress of the work in the Southern Continent recently. The first batch of 6 factories is about to be completed. After this group of professional talents in the family returns after training, they plan to start training workers, purchasing machines, and trying to produce.
Finally, the tall Lawrence paid Hobert for the learning expenses and the money for the permanent Loen language charm, totaling about 4,000 pounds of gold.
Next is the issue of purchasing machines. Hobert asked the Balk family to discuss which machines they needed first, and then just send him a letter to place an order.
… …
In the afternoon, Backlund, outside the train station.
Fors wore a yellow knee-length dress and a hat sewn with blue flowers, waiting for Dorian Gray teacher at the door.
The weather today, like the past few days, was drizzling, and the occasional breeze made her shiver.
This made Fors sigh: Jeffrey Town is still good, where the sun is bright and it is already early summer. The key is that the sun is very warm during the day, and I can sit under the sun for a whole afternoon!
Finally, a figure of medium build, wearing the most popular black suit in Loen and a silk top hat, appeared in sight. It was Dorian Gray!
Fors immediately held up an umbrella to greet him, but as soon as she took a step, Fors saw the teacher raise his left hand into a fist and press it against the first button of his suit.
This is… danger! Fors moved her gaze away with an unchanged expression, looking at a young man behind her, naturally passing Dorian Gray.
Dorian Gray had agreed with Fors in previous letters on the code words and gestures in case of emergency. The meaning of the action just now was very simple, which was to tell Fors not to approach him.
The young man behind Dorian Gray was a little dazed by the lazy and beautiful Fors, and instinctively tidied up his clothes and pressed his hat.
As soon as he finished these actions, Fors had passed him and continued to move forward.
The young man shook his head with a smile, feeling somewhat lost in his heart.
Fors wandered around nearby, boarded a rental carriage, and went straight to the Hat Tricks Inn at 22 Hope Street, Cherwood Borough.
She arrived at the inn before Dorian Gray and asked for a room facing the street.
Hiding behind the curtains, Fors saw Dorian Gray, after getting off the carriage, first make a gesture of opening his five fingers and pressing them on the second button of his suit.
Fors breathed a sigh of relief, which meant the crisis was over.
If the crisis had not been resolved at this time, Fors would have prepared to use the messenger to ask Hobert for help.
After waiting for more than twenty minutes, Fors knocked on the door of the room that Dorian Gray had booked in advance and flashed into the room.
She asked with some worry and concern: "Teacher, what was the problem just now?"
Dorian Gray closed the door and smiled with a bitter expression: "I saw an acquaintance."
He sighed: "To be precise, it's an enemy!"
Fors asked curiously: "What did he do? Is he very powerful?"
Dorian Gray was silent for a few seconds: "I briefly mentioned to you before the organization I was in. This organization suffered a serious blow due to the betrayal of some people. That was one of the traitors just now."
He didn't mention the family, nor the conflict between family members and students, so as not to cause Fors to have unnecessary associations.
In fact, Fors already basically knew these things: "These traitors are really hateful!"
"Okay, let's not talk about these unpleasant things." Dorian Gray first took out an iron box, which contained a crystal clear crystal, which was another ingredient of the "Astrologer": "I didn't expect you to find another ingredient so quickly."
Fors told the truth: "Thanks to my husband."
She took the material: "Thank you, teacher."
"Your promotion so quickly is the best thanks." Dorian Gray smiled and took out a piece of parchment folded several times from his clothes: "This is the potion formula for 'Scribe'. Your digestion of 'Magician' and 'Apprentice' has exceeded my expectations. This is my biggest surprise in the last ten years."
Fors did not hide anything: "I made a special trip to the circus."
Dorian Gray nodded with relief: "I'm sorry, because of the previous losses, I don't have the main material for the 'Scribe' potion here for the time being. You need to find it yourself.
"However, I have prepared a gift for you."
As he spoke, he took out a palm-sized notebook from his large pocket. Its cover looked very hard and was copper-green in color, looking very old.
This notebook is composed of three kinds of paper, one is tan, rare in quantity, one is yellowish-brown, like parchment, about ten sheets, and the other is ordinary white paper.
On the cover, there is a line of ancient Feysac words written: I came, I saw, I record.
"This is a pretty good magical item." Dorian Gray introduced, "Because its negative effects are easy to avoid."
Fors could hardly suppress her excitement: "What's it called? What are the negative effects?"
Dorian Gray stroked the cover of the notebook: "It's called 'Leymano's Travels,' but I prefer to call it 'Leymano's Magic Book.'
"This 'Magic Book' allows you to record a certain Beyonder power when you see it, and save it on one of the pages of the notebook.
"But you must remember that after using it once, the corresponding page will become blank again, waiting for you to record again."
He handed the "Magic Book" to Fors while explaining in more detail: "It corresponds to the 'Scribe' of our 'Apprentice' pathway. Beyonder abilities higher than Sequence 6 have a probability of failure when recording.
"According to the experience of previous users, the success rate of Sequence 5 Beyonder abilities is not low, but it is quite difficult for Sequence 4. It may not succeed even once in ten times.
"And I think no demigod will show you again and again. If it were an enemy, he would have killed you ten times.
"The tan paper is specially used to record Beyonder abilities with divinity, and there are only three sheets in total."
Fors was slightly stunned: Uh, I really have such an opportunity. Hobert has just been promoted to demigod, and I can do an experiment with him tonight.
Dorian didn't notice Fors's distraction. He began to describe the negative effects of the "Magic Book": "Its negative effect is: every time you use it, it will make you get lost, the kind of getting lost where you encounter various dangers. You must draw your own blood and apply it evenly on the cover to eliminate this effect.
Remember, don't underestimate that kind of getting lost; you must deal with it as soon as possible."
"Yes, Teacher," Fors responded seriously.
Looking at the notebook in her hand, Fors suddenly felt that she should do something for her teacher: "What's the name of the traitor? What does he look like?
If there's a chance, I want to avenge you and your organization."
"No, don't think about such things!" Dorian said solemnly, "I know that Hobert is likely a Sequence 5, but you two are still unlikely to catch a 'Traveler'!
The key is that the other party has joined a very evil organization called the Aurora Order. If your raid fails to kill him, it will definitely bring you great danger!"
Fors almost blurted out that Hobert had already advanced to a demigod, but thinking that Hobert had said to keep it secret for the time being, she didn't say anything more.
Dorian thought for a moment and then said, "But you do need to know him to avoid him. His name is Lewis Wien. I'll draw his appearance for you later."
"Okay," Fors said, "I promise to avoid him!"
… …
No. 62 Empress Borough, in the bedroom of Earl Jeffery's mansion.
Crack ~
Sitting at his desk, Hobert crisply bit into an apple, looking at the portrait in his hand. His cheeks were thin, and there was some gloom between his eyebrows, like an addict.
Putting down the portrait, Hobert said, "This guy doesn't look like a good person at all!"
Standing behind Hobert, Fors, leaning on his back, said, "He's indeed not a good person. He's a traitor to the Abraham family."
She said, "Today, Teacher Dorian gave me a gift. I really want to kill this traitor as a thank you to Teacher Dorian."
Hobert smelled the fragrance emanating from Fors: "Leave it to me! I'll find a chance to kill him for you. That way, you'll have the characteristic for your Sequence 5 advancement."
He handed the apple in his hand to Fors, letting her take a bite as well.
The hardest part is finding the other party's whereabouts, but Hobert remembered that the other party came to Backlund afterward.
Fors chewed on the apple and said, "Teacher Dorian said he's very strong and has also joined an evil Beyonder organization."
"Am I not strong?" Hobert smiled.
Fors hugged Hobert and smiled with some pride, "Of course not!"
Hobert then asked knowingly, "What organization did he join?"
"The Aurora Order!"
"To be honest, I've been cracking down on such evil organizations since Sequence 9, no, since I was 9 years old. There's no way around it, your husband is just that righteous!" Hobert suddenly thought of Audrey, but his thoughts immediately returned.
Fors kissed Hobert's cheek: "Hobert, you're so good."
Hobert pinched her little nose, put the apple core into a special metal plate, and then wiped his hands with a wet towel that the servant had prepared in advance: "Does Dorian have any 'Scribe' characteristic or Beyonder materials there?"
"He said that because of the previous losses, he can't provide me with 'Scribe' Beyonder ingredients."
"I have some there," Hobert said, "Just focus on digesting the potion as soon as possible, and advance immediately after you've completed the digestion."
Fors nodded, suddenly feeling that it was so good to have someone to rely on.
"Oh, right," Hobert remembered, "Accompany me to visit a few of Father's old friends tomorrow."
"No problem, do I need to wear formal attire?"
"No, it's not too formal a visit." Hobert looked at the grandfather clock in the corner: "Heavens, is it already 11 o'clock at night? Isn't it time for the anticipated 'dance' again?"
… …
The next morning, a little after eight o'clock, the well-dressed Hobert and his wife took the Earl's carriage to the Cherwood Borough first.
Hobert visited Barrister Barton at the "Aslan-Barton" Law Firm. Strictly speaking, this was Hobert's first mentor when he entered society.
Dophis had already prepared products from Feynapotter as gifts. Of course, these products were bought from the Feynapotter section of the Backlund gift shop. To this, Dophis said that he was very familiar with such operations.
The two had a pleasant conversation and also confirmed the cooperation that Hobert would often send lawyers for training in the future.
Around nine o'clock, Hobert and Fors bid farewell and came to 1899 Nikolaus Street together to visit Mr. Dicos.
Hobert had also sent Mr. Dicos a wedding invitation before, but Dicos was on a business trip to Constant, south of the Inland Sea, at the time. Because he hadn't sent Mr. Dicos a letter before, the messenger didn't mark him and could only send it to Nikolaus Street according to the address.
As a result, Dicos missed Hobert's wedding and heard that he had been regretting it for a long time. This time, he warmly entertained Hobert and his wife.
This former adjutant saw Hobert and Fors visiting him together and was very gratified. Because Dophis had sent a letter of visit two days ago, Dicos was prepared and gave Fors several very expensive gifts.
Hobert only took two items and didn't let this elder spend too much.
In addition to the three of them, there was also a young man in his twenties with slightly upturned eyes and beautiful eyes, pouring tea for the guests.
He was Dicos's youngest son. He didn't expect that the recently famous Earl Hobert actually had a deep friendship with his father, and he actually treated himself as a junior in front of his father.
After chatting for a while, Dicos asked, "What are your plans after returning to Backlund?"
"I plan to reshape the current electricity industry!" Hobert didn't hide his thoughts these days.
Dicos was a little surprised: "This market is very niche."
"That's because everyone hasn't used electricity in the right places." Hobert smiled: "I plan to ask scientists to do some technological research to develop this industry in the direction I need."
Dicos nodded slightly: "You are like your father, making people unable to see through you."
He pointed to his youngest son and said, "I've introduced him just now, this is Todd.
"I think the career you are going to carry out should need someone to run errands. He has been with me since he was a child, is very familiar with Backlund, and also understands the commercial structure of the entire Northern Continent.
"Let him be a helper for you."
Hobert smiled: "That's great! I'm currently lacking trustworthy people around me.
"I just don't know if Todd is willing to go to my place?"
Todd was slightly stunned. Originally, his father had already promised to let him manage the branch in Constant, but why did he suddenly change his mind?
However, with guests present, he would not violate his father's wishes: "It is my honor to serve the Earl!"
Hobert nodded: "Let's do this, come to 62 Empress Borough next Monday and officially start working!"
After the Earl and Countess bid farewell, Todd asked his father, "Do you guess that the industry the Earl wants to develop has very good potential?"
"Even if there is no potential, he will dig out the potential." Dicos smiled: "This kid inherited Commander Rex's genius-like mind and also inherited Commander Christian's steadiness. His career will definitely be successful."
Todd nodded. He always had great faith in his father's judgment.
… …
Hobert and Fors's third stop was Tingen City.
The two directly used "Travel" to arrive at the villa in the suburbs of Tingen City and, after the butler's notification, soon met Ulysses.
Mr. Ulysses also warmly entertained Hobert and his wife and inquired about their recent situation.
After chatting for a while, Hobert said, "Mr. Ulysses, I recently need a thousand new-style rifles and twenty cannons, as well as 300,000 rounds of ammunition and 3,000 rounds of shells."
If it were before, he could have asked Christian to buy these weapons, but Hobert heard that after Christian became a councilor, he no longer cared about military logistics.
"No problem." Ulysses agreed readily: "These will probably cost about six thousand pounds, mainly because the cannons are expensive, requiring 100 pounds per cannon."
This was the price Ulysses could get. If Hobert went to contact the arms company himself, he would have to go through very cumbersome procedures to buy new-style cannons, and the price would be several times higher.
Like the second-hand old-style weapons that Klein later helped the military sell, Ulysses could even sell them to Hobert at scrap iron prices.
It's just that after Hobert had his own territory, he hoped to manufacture guns and cannons himself, so he definitely wanted to buy the latest weapons and take them back to disassemble and copy.
Fors hadn't expected firearms to be so cheap. In Backlund, a revolver cost 3 to 5 pounds, let alone a rifle.
Actually, the cost of these weapons wasn't high, but various restrictions created their scarcity, giving the impression they were very expensive.
After finalizing the small arms deal, Ulysses mentioned Elizabeth's plan to go to Backlund to apply for university.
"Let her stay at the Earl's mansion," Hobert said. "I'll hire a tutor to give her lessons, which will be more targeted."
Ulysses smiled. "Then I'll entrust her to you."
He didn't know many people in Backlund, and more importantly, he didn't know anyone in the education sector, so he couldn't help Elizabeth much with her university application.
After agreeing on Elizabeth's arrival time in Backlund, Hobert prepared to leave, but Ulysses wouldn't let them go. They had lunch before he let them depart.
Back in Backlund, the couple returned to their bedroom, changed into Feynapotter-style clothes, and discussed the three visits they had made that day.
Fors had certainly felt the enthusiasm of the three people they had met, but except for Barton, the barrister, Hobert hadn't mentioned them before.
Hobert, while putting on his trousers, said, "They were all my father's comrades-in-arms in the Southern Continent. I heard my father talk about them.
"Among them, Mr. Ulysses had the greatest military achievements, but because of his humble origins, he was never able to enter Backlund's circles.
"And Dicos was injured in the leg, returned home to inherit the family business, and made the family business flourish.
"Barton, the barrister, was also disappointed with the military's promotion system, so he simply helped my father manage the law firm."
Hobert, who had finished changing, concluded, "The Kingdom of Loen is still a 'hereditary system' world. Most officials and employees in various departments inherit their parents' jobs.
"Or rather, this happens in every era, it's just a matter of how serious it is. Hopefully, the civil service exam will bring some changes to this situation."
Fors, smoothing out her skirt, said, "That's human nature!"
Hobert slipped his hand under her skirt. "Yes, that's human nature."
Fors, adjusting her hair, removed Hobert's hand. "Do you have any solutions for this?"
"Why should I care?" Hobert said with a smile. "This isn't my country."
Fors smiled slightly, not continuing the topic. "The manor across the mountain will be renovated in a few days. I plan to call it Green Meadow Manor."
"Good name!" Hobert praised, thinking, 'Good thing I didn't have to name it, I hate naming things the most.'
After the two finished changing, Hobert greeted Dophis and used "Travel" to reach Jeffery Territory.
Fors stretched in the sunlight. "From now on, unless there's something important, I don't want to go back to Backlund."
Seeing Fors ask the servant to bring her a comfortable chair, Hobert smiled. However, he had other things to do today and couldn't bask in the sun with Fors.
Hobert used "Travel" again to leave, finding Archibald, who was commanding the bandit suppression.
They were resting in the mountains. According to intelligence, they had just wiped out the last group of bandits on the east bank last night and were preparing to return to Jeffery City this afternoon.
Upon seeing Archibald, Hobert took out the small piece of wood he had obtained from "Admiral of Blood": "This comes from a ghost ship, or a ship with Beyonder power.
"Try it and see if you can divine the location of that ship."
"Admiral of Blood" said that this piece of wood could find the location of "Rear Admiral Dusk." Although pirates' words couldn't be easily trusted, Hobert believed that even if he couldn't find the location of "Rear Admiral Dusk," he could find clues about him.
Because sending an enemy to "Rear Admiral Dusk" was in the interest of the "Admiral of Blood."
However, "Admiral of Blood" wouldn't sincerely help. Hobert had already taken this small yellow piece of wood to "Nation of Disorder" for inspection in advance. As he expected, "Admiral of Blood" had indeed hidden a curse on it.
If he directly used this piece of wood for divination or kept it with him often, he would be cursed and eventually die miserably.
Hobert, in the "Nation of Disorder," used the Beyonder characteristics of the "Disciple of Silence" to easily eliminate the curse.
Therefore, Hobert planned to use "Rear Admiral Dusk" to practice and feel the qualitative change after advancing to a demigod.
Archibald, with the appearance of a gentle middle-aged man, took the piece of wood. After a second or two of silence, he said, "That ship has anti-divination abilities."
Hobert smiled slightly, thinking, 'That's okay. The previous oil painting marked "Admiral of Blood." Since I can't find "Rear Admiral Dusk," I can go to "Admiral of Blood" for a refund.'
However, Archibald then said, "You can take me to the Spirit World. In there, I can divine the approximate location of that ship."
As a Beyonder creature with a demigod level in divination, he had ways to bypass some anti-divination designs.
Hobert nodded. "Be prepared. If you can find the location of that ship, you can add at least two more puppets.
"And I can be sure that the enemies on the ship are either from the 'Warrior' pathway or the 'Hunter' pathway."
Archibald smiled. "What's there to prepare for? Just bring my 'Desire Apostle' puppet."
Hobert "Hmm"ed and checked the mystical items on his body. He was currently only carrying the "Traveler's Blade," "Spirit Wine Glass," and "Ocean Pendant" as Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts.
If it weren't for the possibility of fighting at sea, he wouldn't even bring the "Ocean Pendant."
Currently, Hobert's physique had far exceeded that of a "Zombie," so he didn't need the "Zombie Spoon."
As for the two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, Hobert chose "1-101" from the "Marauder" pathway and "1-107" from the "Arbiter" pathway.
In addition, there were also auxiliary mystical items such as the "Order Wood," "Disorder Stone," and "Crystal of Order."
After checking these items, Hobert supported Archibald and its Seer puppet's shoulders and came to the Spirit World.
Divination is the process of obtaining information from the Spirit World. The Spirit World has no concept of time, so it is possible to understand revelations about the future.
It is also possible to bypass obstacles such as the obstacles and distances of the real world to obtain more information from afar.
If you come directly to the Spirit World to perform divination, for a "Seer," this information will actively come together.
Archibald closed his eyes in the Spirit World, his lips moving slightly as he muttered something. After seven or eight seconds, he suddenly opened his eyes and said, "Found it! I'll lead the way ahead."
This journey to the Spirit World lasted more than five minutes. Hobert felt that many Spirit World creatures had set their sights on them, but because there were two demigods among the three of them, those Spirit World creatures had not acted.
Just as Hobert was about to leave the Spirit World to rest, Archibald suddenly said, "It's here."
The scene in front of him was colorful and unclear what was outside the Spirit World.
Hobert said, "Okay." Everything in front of him suddenly became rich and colorful. The three of them left the Spirit World and appeared in a forest.
Archibald saw Hobert's confusion. "I can't find the exact location of that ship, but it must be nearby!"
Hobert jumped upwards, then he "twisted" the gravity under his feet and floated directly up.
He easily came to the canopy of a large tree and looked into the distance. This was a small island, and there was a village on the coast outside the forest.
There was a port on the coast, and several pirate ships were docked there. The leading ship was seventy or eighty meters long and golden in color, as if it were a ship made of gold, or as if it were emitting a golden light.
Hobert glanced at the flag again and confirmed that it was "Rear Admiral Dusk's" fleet.
He jumped down from the canopy. "The ship we're looking for is on the coast. Divinate whether our actions will be smooth."
Archibald didn't expect Hobert to be so cautious. The opponent was only a Sequence 5, and they were launching a surprise attack.
However, it was never wrong to be cautious. He divined whether his next actions would be dangerous and received the revelation that "there is a certain amount of danger, but it is still within acceptable limits."
Hobert then said, "Divine again, whether the enemy has a Sealed Artifact with 'Travel' abilities on them."
"Such divination phrases are easily avoided by the enemy's anti-divination abilities." Archibald said, "I should divine whether our main enemy will use the ability of 'Traveling' to escape."
The divination result was: No.
Hobert nodded slightly, still cautiously put on his mask, supported Archibald and the Marionette's shoulders, and once again entered the illusory spirit world. A few seconds later, they directly appeared on the flagship of "Vice Admiral Dusk" Bulatov Ivan.
Hobert glanced at the deck under his feet. When he got close, the ship's body didn't have that golden sensory feeling, but it still looked like a large ship made of sandalwood, with obvious yellow color, looking very strong and durable.
The few sailors on the deck were stunned by the sudden appearance of the three people.
Hobert said to a sailor: "I'm looking for your captain."
At the same time, he used the ability of "Charm". At this time, "Charm" could already attack in a range. The sailors were about to warn, but soon they relaxed again.
The sailor who was asked smiled as if he had met an old friend: "Our captain has gone ashore. I heard that he is going to negotiate a big deal here."
Hobert asked as if casually chatting: "What about your first mate?"
"The first mate went with the captain."
Hobert was about to ask about the second mate's whereabouts when suddenly a door on the second floor of the superstructure of the ship was suddenly pushed open, and a large man of about two meters walked out: "What's going on?"
He had already felt that the atmosphere on the ship seemed wrong.
The sailor said to Hobert as if offering a treasure: "That's our second mate."
"Very good." Hobert smiled: "Disorder!"
At this time, Hobert could already put targets within 50 meters into a state of "Disorder"!
The second mate, who was just covered in the light of dawn, immediately felt that the clouds in the sky were so beautiful, which suddenly gave him the idea of admiring the clouds.
By the time he came back to his senses, a young man wearing a black mask and a cloak, and a gentle middle-aged man had already appeared in front of him.
Immediately afterwards, the second mate felt his body become stiff. The formation of a thought seemed like a very difficult task.
With the blessing of "Connection", Archibald only took three seconds to complete the initial control of the second mate, and only eight seconds to turn the second mate into a Marionette.
Archibald sighed in his heart: "Seer" and "Lawyer" are good partners after becoming demigods!
Before this, it would only be this fast for him to turn ordinary people into Marionettes. For Beyonders, it would take at least a dozen seconds to turn the other party into a Marionette.
Hobert was sighing: Demigods are indeed different. The other party's second mate has already been dealt with, and the other party realized that something was wrong.
Moreover, it was not the sailors on the flagship who realized that something was wrong, but the other pirate ships. Seeing everything that happened here, they realized that the flagship seemed to be under attack, so they warned the other ships.
Hobert then returned to ask the sailor: "Where exactly did your captain and first mate go?"
The sailors scrambled to point out the direction to Hobert: "It's the two-story wooden building over there."
Hobert stood on the high side of the ship and saw that there were indeed many people around the two-story building.
Hobert said to Archibald: "I'll go over first, you follow up as soon as possible."
As he spoke, he used "Traveling" again to come to the front of the small building. The pirates guarding outside were startled, and two pirates subconsciously wanted to attack Hobert.
But Hobert used a "Blink" to get past them and came to the door on the second floor, kicked it open, but there was no one inside.
Hobert knew it would be like this. After all, the "Hunter's" ability to perceive danger is very sensitive, so before the action, he asked Archibald to divine whether the other party had an Sealed Artifact with the ability of "Traveling".
He estimated that the "Vice Admiral Dusk" or the first mate realized the danger very early and escaped.
However, the reason why Hobert was still so unhurried was because "Connection" had another use: it could easily find the association of things or rules.
He wanted to experiment to see if it was easy to use.
Even if "Connection" is not as easy to use as imagined, he can also use "True Vision" to observe the surroundings. Anyway, the other party cannot escape with "Traveling".
Hobert immediately found the place associated with the "Vice Admiral Dusk". The window frame was stepped on by the "Vice Admiral Dusk", and all the way up, the grass on the ground and the broken branches were guiding Hobert's direction.
Unknowingly, Hobert chased into the woods. Suddenly he stopped and saw a simple and crude extraordinary trap on the road in front of him. In addition, he also felt three spiritual presences in different directions around him.
Hobert immediately realized that the escaped "Vice Admiral Dusk" and others realized that the source of danger was chasing them, so they hastily set up a trap and hid in three directions to ambush the source of danger.
Hobert smiled slightly, because he didn't feel any danger, so he unhurriedly put the area of the extraordinary trap into "Disorder".
He was still cautious and not underestimating the enemy, otherwise he wouldn't have bothered with this seemingly clumsy trap.
In addition, Hobert also noticed a problem. The "Hunter" pathway should have the ability to hide themselves, but the other party was so openly "showing" their spirituality, which kept him in a cautious attitude!
At the same time, Hobert found that he was very calm in the battle. In the previous extraordinary battles, he had to keep running, constantly attacking or evading attacks.
But now, there was no need for that at all. He could quickly catch up with the escaped enemy through continuous "Distortion" of distance.
The "Disorder" used by Hobert triggered the trap, and a fireball emerged from the ground and smashed towards him.
But because that area was in a state of "Disorder", the attack direction of the fireball changed and smashed elsewhere.
Hobert released the majesty belonging to a demigod: "Who should I start with?"
The surrounding birds or small animals were all shocked by the pressure shown by Hobert, shivering in the trees or on the ground, expressing their submission in their own way.
The three people had good psychological qualities. They haven't rushed out to fight or continued to escape.
"Corruption!" Hobert felt that it was time to end this game. The creatures within a hundred meters around immediately became depraved, losing all positive and upward thoughts. Hobert suddenly rushed forward and punched down a big tree.
But the person behind the big tree was tied there, and was already incontinent with fright.
Hobert immediately understood that the arrangement of the three spiritual presences he felt was probably the real trap, just to hold him back for a while.
This made him sigh: "As expected of a cunning Hunter."
Because the person behind the big tree was wearing pirate clothes, Hobert simply killed him.
Then Hobert seemed to realize something. He smiled at the other two places with spiritual fluctuations: "Some people think they are smart, but they are just being clever."
Hobert did not continue to pursue, but suddenly rushed towards another place where he sensed spirituality. There was still only a "low-sequence" pirate hidden there.
When rushing towards the third target, that target couldn't hold back and began to flee. Hobert: "Distortion!"
Hobert "Distorted" the other party's intention, and running away became charging, so the other party suddenly turned around and charged towards Hobert with a look of horror.
Hobert punched over: "Magnify!", he "Magnified" the power of this punch and directly smashed the other party's head down.
He guessed that the Beyonder with a different head in front of him was probably the arranger of this trap. According to common sense, the pursuer should immediately continue to pursue after discovering the second layer of the trap.
In this way, the arranger of the trap would have plenty of time to escape, but Hobert found that the other party deliberately exposed his position, which might be a problem.
As a result, there really was a problem!
