chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 537: The Light of the Earl (Bonus 3)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Ken kaneki for becoming a free member]
Hearing Hobert's question, Portland immediately said, "Many people have had such ideas, but no one has put them into action, because..."
At this moment, the light bulb on the other side of the generator suddenly flickered and went out.
The president of the Technical University spread his hands and smiled, "It seems this light bulb did not receive the blessing of the God of Steam and Machinery."
This is a joke in the tech world about electricity, because how long a light bulb lasts depends entirely on luck. If you're lucky, it can last for dozens of hours, but if you're unlucky, it breaks in a few minutes.
So, professors joke that those short-lived light bulbs did not receive the blessing of the gods.
At this time, light bulbs are basically used as test pens, observing whether the bulb lights up to determine the state of the current during experiments.
As for the lighting function of light bulbs, it is not yet well known. The only commercial orders for lighting purposes are for military flashlights.
Hobert had also bought one, but only used it once when exploring the ruins with Mr. Azik. Later, it broke after being left there for a while.
It wasn't that the light bulb couldn't be used, but that the flashlight was broken.
Portland continued what he hadn't finished saying, "Because electricity doesn't have many uses. The telegraph machine should be the biggest use, but it doesn't use much electricity either."
"I have a great idea that can bring electricity to every household," Hobert asked, "Would that require a huge amount of electricity?"
Portland was slightly stunned, "Used for what?"
"Lighting."
Portland immediately thought, "Have you found a way to extend the life of light bulbs?"
"Sort of, but a series of experiments are still needed."
"How long can it be extended?"
"800 hours shouldn't be a problem."
Portland was slightly surprised, "According to our calculations, electricity generates more than 2000 degrees of high temperature when it emits light!"
Hobert smiled, "Of course I know!"
Portland considered for a moment before saying, "As a friend, I must remind you that the electricity market is not large."
"Because light bulbs and batteries are very expensive, and ordinary people cannot afford them."
Audrey nodded slightly. She had heard of batteries, which could be used in wireless telegraph machines. Batteries were not very expensive for her. But ordinary people would not spend money on this, and even nobles might not be willing to spend the money.
Hobert was not surprised that the president did not have the concept of laying wires. "That's why I'm going to see a professor in materials science later."
He added, "I now need a large generator, but I only understand the principle and can't apply it in a short time, so I need someone who can build a large generator!"
This is the reason why he generously donated those 5,000 pounds. The speed of information dissemination in this era is not as fast as in the Common Era. It may take one or two years to recruit the talent you need.
The best way is to use pounds as a guide to let professionals recommend professional talents.
Portland certainly knew that this was the reason why the Earl was willing to donate those 5,000 pounds. He thought for a while and then said, "I have a student who is proficient in electrical and mechanical engineering. He just resigned last year for personal reasons and only started looking for a job again last month."
Hobert asked, "Is it convenient to say why he resigned?"
"He was seriously ill."
Hobert once again felt the characteristics of this era: if you don't experience the treatment of extraordinary powers, some diseases require one or two years of treatment and recuperation.
For example, tuberculosis. Although Roselle invented so many things, he did not "discover" antibiotics.
Therefore, many diseases can torture a person for several years. People who can recover have truly overcome the disease! But most patients did not withstand the torment of the disease.
In this era, there are many special therapies for treating tuberculosis, such as "high-altitude therapy," which involves establishing tuberculosis hospitals on mountains with moderate altitudes, using the cooler climate on the mountains to cool down patients who have fevers all day long.
Of course, in the Feynapotter Kingdom, there is basically no such trouble. You only need to pray to the Earth Mother Church frequently, or donate a sum of money to the church, and the symptoms will "magically improve."
Portland agreed to write a letter to that student this afternoon, asking him to go to the lord's mansion for an interview.
After chatting for a few more words about electricity, Hobert and Audrey got up to say goodbye.
Then they came to the teaching building. When Hobert was on the front page headlines the previous two times, the newspapers included his portrait, so many students recognized Hobert and greeted the Earl one after another.
Hobert also responded to their greetings enthusiastically, without any airs.
As for Audrey, the students, while amazed, only dared to secretly look at her out of the corner of their eyes, not daring to look directly at her.
In a small conference room in the teaching building, Hobert met Professor Isaac, who had a high academic status in materials science.
This professor was not very tall, wore glasses, and looked very stern: "Earl Hobert, hello. I heard that you want to invest in my research project?"
Different from Portland's state of being half politician and half scientist, this professor was a more pure scholar, so he spoke more directly.
"That's right, I plan to invest 3,000 pounds," Hobert didn't even ask what project the other party was researching.
Professor Isaac adjusted his glasses and took a serious look at this generous nobleman.
When ordinary nobles and wealthy people invested, he needed to explain for a long time. He was ready to explain how his research could make a profit, but before he could speak, the other party directly invested 3,000 pounds.
He praised, "You are an Earl who understands the true value of science."
Hobert smiled, "Can we sit down and talk?"
"Please sit down, please sit down!"
After the assistant brought coffee, Hobert got straight to the point, "In addition to investing in your research project, I also transformed a laboratory in my manor and plan to study the uses of tungsten."
"Ah, that's a lovely element," Isaac said with a look of affection, like talking about his own child, "Its melting point is as high as 3400 degrees, and it is very malleable."
Speaking of this, he frowned and said, "But the use of tungsten is very limited. I have also considered using it to make alloy materials, but it can only be used in some places that require high-temperature resistance, such as steel."
Many people have a misunderstanding, always thinking that people in the past were very stupid. Obviously, all the technical requirements for an invention have been met, but that invention has not been launched for a long time.
In fact, this is a "futurist effect." Often, the stage from scratch to something is the most difficult, because people in the future are already accustomed to the existence of that invention and can no longer feel the difficulty of going from scratch.
When Hobert was in the Common Era, he also discussed this issue with friends. It is possible that people only a few hundred years later will find people in the 21st century incomprehensible. Why use thermal power plants and hydropower plants when the controllable nuclear fusion system is right there?
"I thought of a good use, but I don't know if it will be successful, so I need some experiments," Hobert smiled: Yes, I "thought" of it, you can use tungsten wire to make the filament of an electric light.
He added, "I hope to have an expert in materials science to help me complete this experiment, preferably someone who understands electricity."
"I do have many students who are looking for jobs," Isaac said, "I can write letters to two or three of them and ask them to go to the Earl's Mansion for an interview."
Relatively speaking, the demand for talents in materials science is relatively small at this time. Many of Isaac's students can only switch to other research fields after graduation.
Hobert nodded and said without hesitation, "I also hope to study more uses of natural rubber. Do you have any students who are proficient in this research?"
Hobert unconsciously recalled the military flashlight he bought. After the flashlight broke, he opened it and took a look and understood where it was broken: it was this world that made the flashlight not good.
First of all, the shell of the flashlight is wooden. Although it has been waterproofed, the waterproof effect is very limited in the humid environment of Backlund.
Secondly, Hobert found that the shell of the battery's electrolyte was actually oilcloth! Some leakage and corrosion had already occurred.
The reason why these structures look so strange is entirely because this world has no oil!
In the Common Era in which Hobert lived, the shell of flashlights and electrolytes could be made of plastic.
The relationship between oil and plastic is like wheat and flour.
The reason why the Northern Continent has completed the initial process of industrialization, but has not yet entered the Second Industrial Revolution, is fundamentally because chemical materials have not kept up with the development of the times.
In fact, in the early days of the Second Industrial Revolution, oil did not play a big role as fuel.
If there is an internal combustion engine structure, most transportation vehicles can be driven by electricity, and oil is not necessarily needed.
The huge role that oil plays is actually in the chemical field.
Because the chemical field involves all walks of life, such as polyester, acrylic, nylon, etc., which are widely used in the textile industry, more than 90% of the ingredients come from oil.
They don't need to wait for the growth and maturity of flax and cotton, and they can continue to start production.
For Hobert, who came from the Common Era, these are all common sense things.
But for a world that has never seen plastic, the first thing inventors can think of for the flashlight shell is a waterproofed wooden structure. The container they can think of for holding electrolyte is also a special acid-resistant and corrosion-resistant oilcloth.
Hobert had already realized this, so his solution was to use natural rubber to replace petroleum rubber and some plastic uses.
More than 100 years ago, Roselle laid the first telegraph line in the North and South continents, which was a metal wire wrapped in natural rubber.
Even the top scholars in science and technology in the modern Northern Continent have not considered laying electric wires all over the streets and alleys, because the cost of materials is too high.
It is acceptable as a telegraph line, but as electric wires stretched across the streets and alleys, no one can afford such a preliminary investment.
The key is that there is only so much natural rubber production. Even if you can pay this huge cost, it is limited by the production of rubber, and it will take a long time to reach a scale.
Hobert didn't know if Roselle had ever thought of using extraordinary powers to increase the production of natural rubber, but considering that the Intis Republic and the Feynapotter Kingdom were in a long-term state of war and could not get help from the Earth Mother Church, I believe that even if he had such an idea, it would be difficult to implement.
For a time, Hobert's thoughts drifted far away.
"I also think that natural rubber should have a wider range of uses," Isaac smiled.
Isaac's words brought Hobert back to his senses: "You are a scientific worker with a long-term vision."
After chatting for a few more words, Isaac promised to write letters to several students who studied rubber, and Hobert and Audrey said goodbye.
In the carriage on the way back, Audrey smiled and said, "Hobert, the career you are going to undertake has not officially started, and you have already spent so much money. Is the return of this career so rich?"
"Not as rich as you think," Hobert smiled, "The reason why I invested so much money is because I have other more important purposes."
He had already thought about it, the light bulbs produced by the factory would be called "Earl's Light"!
Hobert also wanted to print a simple drawing with the portrait of Earl Hobert on the packaging paper of each light bulb, the purpose is to make everyone have relevant associations.
Let people think of Earl Hobert when they think of light bulbs, just as Hobert thinks of Edison when he thinks of light bulbs.
Audrey was slightly stunned, and then smiled: "If your funds are short, I can persuade my father to invest in you."
Originally, she planned to invest in Hobert herself, but she found today that the investment in Hobert's career seems to be very huge, and the 20,000 to 30,000 pounds she can use may not play a big role.
If you use more than 30,000 pounds of funds, you need to be authorized by her father.
Hobert smiled, "It's not needed yet, but sooner or later other nobles will be invited to invest together, but not now."
His current financial situation is still good, and he is unlikely to be short of money in the future.
Inviting other nobles to invest is to tie part of the political power of Backlund with a part of the profit, so as to avoid troubles caused by some people because of jealousy.
But you have to wait, wait until you first build up the brand effect, then he can always maintain the dominance of the company when there are other shareholders.
On the way back, Audrey fell into contemplation again. She could feel that Hobert's current career might bring some changes to the future, but so far, she still doesn't understand what Hobert wants to do.
Audrey looked out of the car window, the evening mist covered the streets and alleys again, and she understood another truth: Although I can judge the truth of Hobert's words and deeds, I still can't complete the real "mind reading". Everyone's mind island is like a barrier. Without the other party's knowledge, I can't judge the other party's intentions at all.
Suddenly, she felt that her potion had digested a lot.
...
Back at the Earl's Mansion, Hobert received a letter from Elliot. The Balk family had decided on the steam engine they wanted to buy.
The letter included a list. They planned to buy 21 various steam engines in one go. Hobert directly called Todd, who stayed for dinner, and asked him to give a low price. These machines were worth about 18,000 pounds in total.
Each steam engine was priced at a base rate that Upton would find hard to match. Hobert added 200 to each and sent the quote to Elliot.
With Hobert's current savings, whether he made the 4200 or not was irrelevant, but the Bulk family's method of payment was sure to be in gold. Hobert would still have to convert it, which would incur some fees.
If the Tudor family or the Sanguine wanted this batch of steam engines, Hobert would charge them at least 30,000!
Hobert also hoped to use the Bulk family's wealth to develop a light industry in the Southern Continent, so he still wanted them to have some cash flow for new investments.
Late at night, Hobert looked at the empty bedroom and still couldn't quite get used to it.
He thought that since he was planning to go to the Jeffery territory tomorrow anyway, he might as well go tonight, and he could get intimate with Fors, and perhaps he could fall asleep quickly after being intimate.
So Hobert used the 'Traveler's Gate,' which had already been set up in the Earl's mansion in Backlund, to come to the bedroom of the lord's mansion in Jeffery City.
Fors was sleeping soundly at this time. Hobert burrowed into the quilt and started kissing and caressing her, and she woke up with red cheeks.
Just as the two of them were about to get down to business, Hobert's spirituality suddenly sensed danger!
He was slightly stunned, wrapped Fors in the quilt, and used the 'Traveler's Gate' to stuff her into the Backlund side.
Fors stood in front of the door on the Earl's mansion side for a full seven or eight seconds before suddenly coming back to her senses. She realized there was danger on the Jeffery territory side.
"Madam!"
Fors was about to reach out to grab the doorknob when the voice of the butler, Dophis, sounded.
The bedroom door opened without any wind, and Dophis stood at the door holding a candle: "You'd better not go back yet."
Fors immediately understood that her return would also be a burden to Hobert. She said anxiously, "Then, then what should I do?"
"If the danger there is something the Earl can't handle, he will come over with you," Dophis analyzed calmly. "I will have a maid bring some tea and snacks. Please wait patiently."
Fors still wanted to say something, but in the end, she found that she seemed to be able to do nothing but wait.
...
Naked, Hobert looked at the corner: "Who are you?"
At this time, the monster in the oil painting hanging on the wall stepped out, but before it could utter a curse, it was completely swallowed by a tide of shadows.
There was no light in the room. Hobert felt that the corner over there was like a dark bottomless cave, as if it were darker than darkness, as if it could swallow all the light.
A gloomy male voice in the shadows smiled and said, "What a disappointment. I originally wanted to see the lord and lady's good show in bed."
Then he said: "I didn't expect there to be such a powerful sealed artifact in your bedroom. Although the monster just now was very weak, I can feel that its abilities are more than that."
Hobert didn't immediately grab his clothes, but moved to the bedside, picked up the gloves from the bedside table, and smiled as he put them on: "It seems you know Jeffery territory quite well!"
"Well, after all, we've been neighbors for a while."
Hobert's movements of putting on his gloves were very slow, as if he was afraid of alarming an enemy who wasn't sleeping very soundly: "Are you from the Aurora Order on the other side?"
"Yes."
"Are you here to retrieve the Aurora Order member we caught?" Hobert pretended to joke easily: "You're late. I ordered him executed a few days ago!"
"I know, just a 'Secret Supplicant'." The gloomy voice said: "I'm here for something else."
"What is it?" Hobert began to put on the other glove.
"Kill Hobert and Fors and completely control the entire South Colson area." The other party said without any emotion: "Originally, my plan was to taste your wife in front of you first, and then slowly kill you.
"I didn't expect you to already be a 'Earl of the Fallen'."
Hobert frowned: A bunch of lunatics! They should all be exterminated.
Before Hobert could continue to stall for time, the other party said again: "Are you wondering why I suddenly came to kill you? There are two reasons. The first is that sooner or later you will kill to the other side of the river after you are ready, so we might as well take the initiative and catch you off guard.
"The second is because we received a message that you have become the true master of this land. As long as you kill you, we can completely rule the South Colson area."
Hobert put on both gloves: "Wishful thinking!"
"That's not necessarily true." The other party seemed to sneer: "I know that your gloves must be magical items, but don't you want to know why I haven't interrupted your process of putting on your gloves?"
As soon as the other party finished speaking, Hobert saw his knife suddenly pulled out of his cane and slashed at him.
Hobert dodged the attack from the black knife and vaguely saw a black figure tightly holding the knife.
He immediately realized that it was his shadow!
And the enemy in the shadows was a 'Black Knight'! A demigod of the 'Secret Supplicant' pathway!
If Hobert hadn't advanced, then tonight would have been really dangerous.
Suddenly, figures flickered in the surrounding darkness, and Hobert seemed to be in a dark crowd.
At the same time, Hobert could feel an extremely evil force controlling this group of dark figures, and they all cast hostile gazes at him.
Two figures closer to him wrapped around Hobert's legs like tentacles, and more shadows wrapped around Hobert like pythons, trying to strangle Hobert to death, or trying to hold Hobert down so that the shadow could kill Hobert with a knife!
"Connection!" Hobert finally took action, strengthening the connection between himself and his shadow.
The shadow holding the knife suddenly stopped there, as if suddenly plunged into confusion, not knowing whether it was Hobert's shadow or, like those shadows, belonged to the darkness.
"Weaken!" Hobert's attack was very cautious, because he still couldn't clearly feel the opponent's position.
This was the advancement of 'Shadow Transformation'. Before the 'Black Knight's' main body took action, it was difficult for opponents of the same level to detect the opponent's position.
Although it was in the darkness, those shadows seemed to suddenly fade, and the power of the entanglement around Hobert also weakened.
"Distort!" Hobert suddenly distorted the distance between himself and the bed, and the shadows wrapping around his legs were torn in half, turning into ordinary darkness.
Hobert grabbed his clothes with one hand and took out a 'Disorder Stone' from his pocket!
After becoming a demigod, Hobert could allow the 'Disorder Stone' to function within a range of tens of meters, and he could also choose the target of attack, so he would no longer harm his own people.
The enemy seemed to feel the danger of the 'Disorder Stone', and another shadow appeared in the corner. This was the 'Black Knight's' shadow.
A layer of viscous black substance immediately appeared in the entire room. These liquids seemed to be formed by extreme depravity, and even the tables and chairs that had long lost their lives had patches of black.
But these viscous liquids did not appear on Hobert's body. Obviously, the 'Black Knight' was a little impatient and seemed to have forgotten that the 'Earl of the Fallen' also represented 'Depravity'.
When Hobert took the potion, the black viscous liquid representing 'Depravity' had already entered his body. This type of depraved attack could not harm him at all.
"Disorder!" Hobert threw out the 'Disorder Stone'. The 'Black Knight's' shadow flew up and tightly wrapped the 'Disorder Stone' before the 'Disorder Stone' burst out with the power to cause Beyonder characteristics to lose control.
Hobert was slightly stunned. This was the first time he had seen this kind of operation!
But that shadow suddenly trembled violently. Its body rapidly expanded, and some strange objects grew on its body, including tentacles, goat hooves, and bull heads.
Eventually, it turned into a monster with black flames flashing in its eyes!
It raised its head and howled silently, destroying all the furnishings in the bedroom at will.
This shadow had lost control!
...
At this time, in Jeffery City, Special Operations Division.
Figures flickered in the courtyard, but no one could be seen.
In the darkness, it seemed that some force had pushed the door open, and evil forces invaded the room.
Suddenly, the lights in the room came on, and there were actually more than a dozen groups of shadows on the ground under the lights.
As Angus announced loudly: "It is forbidden to transform into shadows here!"
Those shadows obviously paused, as if they had encountered some resistance.
And Angus's power was rapidly increasing.
The shadows simply returned to normal human form and fought with the surrounding Beyonder members.
According to Captain Dunn's training, the Special Operations Division had someone on duty every night, and one of the people on duty every day was an 'Astrologer'.
The 'Astrologer' on duty tonight noticed the danger, and after performing a divination to confirm it, woke up the other members.
Angus first thought of going to protect the lord, but Dunn disagreed: "Even if you go to support him, you won't be able to help much, but if Jeffery City doesn't have any Beyonder power, many people will be killed!
"If that happens, you will truly fail Hobert's expectations of you."
Angus and Helen almost simultaneously thought of Hobert's usual words and deeds and felt that Captain Dunn was right, so they stayed.
After this delay, before they had time to prepare seriously, the enemy's attack had already begun, and the enemies were either Sequence 6 or Sequence 7, and their strength was very strong.
Fortunately, after establishing a complete 'Sealed Item Application Rules', Lord Hobert left 3 Grade 2 sealed artifacts in the Special Operations Division.
Angus and Helen each took one, and the other was given to a Sequence 6. Under their leadership, they quickly stabilized the situation.
He even forced a 'Rose Bishop' to tear apart one of his 'Shadow Ascetic' companions and use the explosion of his companion's flesh and blood to cover himself.
At this time, three figures walked out of the shadows at the entrance of the courtyard. The leader was wearing a hooded bishop's robe with a cross and an upside-down man pattern embroidered on it.
Angus and Helen looked at each other. These three people were definitely all Sequence 5!
...
Outside Jeffery City's military camp, the military camp, which now had a scale of 500 people, ended a day of training, and snores echoed throughout the camp. Only the guards were still patrolling carefully.
The shadow under the brazier suddenly lengthened and rushed towards a barracks.
Just as the shadow was about to enter the door, a blue lava giant sword fell from the sky and stuck in front of the shadow.
Archibald and his 'adjutants' came over unhurriedly: "It seems I can have another 'Secret Supplicant' pathway adjutant."
He smiled: "Okay, come out, your positions have already been exposed!"
"Shadow Transformation" cannot hide the lines of spirituality.
The 'Shepherd' leading the team was slightly stunned. According to the information they had gathered, shouldn't there only be some 'low sequence' Beyonders in the military camp? Why did it seem that these staff officers were not weak.
While the 'Shepherd' was wondering, one of the 'staff officers' showed a dawn-like light around his body, and then a dawn giant sword appeared in his hand and slashed towards the 'Shepherd'.
The 'Shepherd' was about to dodge, but his movements suddenly became stiff.
...
In the lord's mansion, Hobert's hide-and-seek with the 'Black Knight' continued.
The 'Black Knight's' words sounded very crazy before, but when fighting, he seemed very cautious and had been observing Hobert in secret.
In fact, if Hobert also had this ability, he would carefully observe his opponent first, and then make a targeted attack plan.
Hobert had already seen through the opponent's thoughts, so he did not use his most core abilities, and he did not even release the seals of the two sealed items.
If he could force the opponent out without using his full strength, then Hobert would win in this game.
If Hobert's reality was seen through by the 'Black Knight' in the following response, then the 'Black Knight' would win.
It's just that the 'Black Knight' didn't know that his hope of victory was very slim, because the 'Earl of the Fallen' in front of him was also a 'Creator'. If he saw this, he would definitely be completely desperate!
Hobert dodged the attack of the 'Black Knight's' shadow. The shadow absorbed the power of the surrounding darkness, and its body was getting bigger and bigger. Hobert could even feel the overflowing madness!
Its most powerful attack was 'Depravity', but unfortunately it was useless to Hobert.
"Connection!" Hobert saw that the shadow's state of loss of control was almost there, and timely strengthened the connection between the shadow and the 'Black Knight' to see if he could transmit its loss of control and madness to the main body.
Crash~
There was a sound from the roof. It turned out that the other party was not in the room at all.
The 'Black Knight' had just cut off the connection with his shadow, but now the faint madness and sense of loss of control transmitted from the shadow made him expose his whereabouts if he was not careful.
"Magnify!" Hobert, who had been accumulating for a long time, finally took action. He jumped up and 'magnified' a slap he slapped out, blowing half of the roof off.
Then, Hobert 'distorted' gravity and hovered in mid-air, roughly determining the location of the 'Black Knight': "Arrogance!"
The current 'Arrogance' is already a range ability. In the darkness, a group of shadows suddenly surged, forming a figure that seemed to be wearing black armor. His two arms suddenly turned into long blades and slashed towards Hobert.
"You lost!" Hobert smiled, "Disorder!"
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - 538: Madman's Attack
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the first round of their contest, Hobert forced the "Black Knight" out of the darkness and quickly seized the opportunity to gain a certain advantage, throwing the "Black Knight" into a state of "disorder."
Hobert charged forward, punching his opponent to the ground: "Magnify!"
He "magnified" the next step he took, stomping the "Black Knight's" head into the ground. Just as Hobert was about to deliver another blow, the "Black Knight" under his feet recovered from the "disorder," turning into a pool of liquid and quickly flowing away.
"Distort!" Hobert "distorted" his opponent's idea of escape, making him stay in place.
Then Hobert "distorted" the distance between himself and his opponent, stomped on him, and bent down for a fierce punch: "Weaken!"
After weakening his opponent in all aspects, one punch landed, causing the "Black Knight" in his blood-flesh liquid state to cough up blood.
Bang~
Just as Hobert was about to continue his attack, he was suddenly blown away by an explosion of blood from the ground.
But this kind of explosion couldn't hurt him anymore, it just stopped his attack.
As Hobert landed on the ground, two arms like sharp blades slashed towards him. Hobert felt that these blades could cut his soul, and his spirit seemed to shrink back!
"Disorder!" Hobert plunged the space between himself and the "Black Knight" into a state of "disorder," and the "Black Knight's" attack immediately deviated in other directions.
Just as Hobert was about to launch a new round of attacks, he suddenly noticed the "Black Knight" trembling, as if enduring great pain!
Before Hobert could figure out what was happening, a crazy and twisted power spread from Hobert's feet to his whole body. His body suddenly swelled up, growing black fleshy tumors, which quickly disappeared, but then new tumors grew again!
Hobert felt like his brain was being stirred by an iron bar, and the intense pain made tears and snot flow down his face. He knelt on the ground, unable to move.
The "Black Knight" also seemed to be undergoing intense pain, but he could still slowly walk towards Hobert, obviously his pain was not as intense as Hobert's.
Because of the extreme pain, Hobert, with saliva and snot running down his face, realized with his dull brain that if this continued, he would surely die under the opponent's blade!
Hobert struggled to concentrate, and finally felt his spirit being pulled upwards.
Then everything in his sight turned black, and he arrived in the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert felt his entire brain was numb, but his condition was gradually recovering.
Without time to make other arrangements, Hobert threw a surge of "Power of Order" into his star, and then immediately returned to the real world.
At this time, the "Black Knight" had already raised his blade. If Hobert had returned half a second later, he would have been decapitated.
Hobert's body was covered by a surge of "Power of Order," and his condition also recovered slightly. He rolled aside, dodging the "Black Knight's" attack.
Hobert, now kneeling on the ground again, noticed that the out-of-control shadow that had just smashed the bedroom into ruins had reattached itself to the ground at some point. Now, the out-of-control shadow was tightly embracing his own shadow.
He then realized that the out-of-control and madness he had felt just now was because the "Black Knight" had mixed his shadow with his own, causing Hobert's shadow to be severely affected by the "Black Knight's" shadow. Those effects were then transmitted from the shadow to Hobert!
No wonder the "Black Knight" was in so much pain, because he had to re-establish some connection with his own shadow in order to control it to complete such an attack.
And establishing a certain connection meant he had to be affected by the already out-of-control shadow.
After understanding the key to the problem, Hobert stretched out his hand towards the "Black Knight": "Distort!"
He "distorted" the concept of the "Black Knight" and the shadow, and the two evenly shared the out-of-control state of the shadow!
"Ugh ah~"
The "Black Knight's" flesh and blood seemed to have lost all restraint, swelling and piling up, turning the "Black Knight" into a constantly squirming monster.
...
In the special operations department of Jeffrey City, the battle in the courtyard was extremely fierce!
Angus, Helen, and a Sequence 6, each holding a Grade 2 sealed artifact, were fighting against the opponent's three Sequence 5s.
"Death!" Angus swung his deadly punch. The "Shepherd" in front of him suddenly put on a coat like the light of dawn. These rays of light quickly condensed and eventually became a golden armor!
Angus hit the enemy, only knocking him away and crashing into a wall. The enemy was not harmed as a result.
The "Shepherd" got up from the collapsed bricks and stones and charged towards Angus. The dawn light around him dissipated, and a "Blazing White Spear" appeared in his hand, and his body burned with intense flames from the inside out.
Angus raised his hand, and a South Continent-style bracelet on his wrist appeared with a layer of silvery-white luster. Opening his mouth, he uttered syllables that no one could understand and were extremely frightening.
The "Shepherd's" attack slowed down. He was stiff all over, feeling like his spirit was about to break free from his body, and the two became very uncoordinated.
Just as Angus was about to launch a new attack, the "Shepherd's" body suddenly swelled up, goat horns appeared on his head, and he exuded an evil aura.
The "Demonized" state improved the "Shepherd's" physical body and spirit, alleviating the "Undead Language's" control over the spirit. He raised his hand and issued a "Devil Language" spell: "Slow!"
Angus was already cursing in his heart: Damn it, how can I fight this?
"Im…prison!" Angus, who was knocked away by the "Demonized" enemy, tried his best to use this ability, so that the "Shepherd" could not immediately chase after him.
Angus crashed into a wall, and the wall became loose as a result.
His whole body felt like it was falling apart. He struggled twice before standing up again. He saw out of the corner of his eye that his two companions, with the help of sealed artifacts, could only barely hold off the enemy!
At this time, the "Shepherd" charged over with the "Dawn Greatsword" in hand, moving very quickly.
"Exile!" Angus concentrated and continued to fight the enemy.
Because there was a light of dawn around the opponent, other abilities did not work well. Only "Exile" could curb the enemy's offensive.
Suddenly, Angus noticed that the enemy's condition was not right. After he was pushed out by "Exile," the movement of swinging the "Dawn Greatsword" slowed down.
Almost at the same time, a man covered in flames rushed in from outside and pierced the "Shepherd's" "Dawn Armor" with a sword, piercing his chest.
Archibald, wearing a military uniform, appeared at the entrance of the courtyard: "I heard there was an enemy attack here?"
...
In the Lord's Mansion, the "Black Knight" usually accumulated some out-of-control factors, so theoretically, the out-of-control at this time would become irreversible.
In such an emergency, the "Black Knight's" pupils suddenly turned into golden vertical pupils, and the process of squirming in his flesh and blood stopped. The process of out-of-control was interrupted.
Hobert, who was also trying to recover, was waiting for this opportunity. He instantly released the seal on the two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, reached out and grabbed the opponent, and stole his "Herding" ability!
The "Black Knight" immediately showed a surprised expression, but his and the shadow's out-of-control had been temporarily soothed and deeply hidden in the depths of his heart, and would not erupt for a while.
Hobert took the opportunity to rush over and kick the enemy away, and the courtyard wall was knocked down.
At this time, Hobert had time to pick up the blade not far away. Suddenly, he looked in the direction of the "Black Knight," where an unfamiliar, black, and strong figure appeared: "All living things are forbidden here!"
"Distort!" Hobert distorted the other party's prohibition into: All beings who were once alive are forbidden here!
The smoke and dust from the courtyard wall dissipated. In the dim moonlight, Hobert saw a majestic and semi-transparent figure. His judgment was correct, it was an evil spirit!
After realizing that he could not use the "Grazing" ability for a while, the "Black Knight" decisively ended the herding of this evil spirit.
This evil spirit was a demigod-level evil spirit that he "grazed", with the strength of a "Imperative Mage".
Because it was originally an evil spirit, after being released, its soul did not enter the spirit world, but quickly turned the Lord's Mansion into its territory.
Hobert's "distortion" made the evil spirit's prohibition detrimental to it!
"Deprive!" It then deprived the content of the previous "prohibition".
The "Black Knight" took advantage of Hobert's confrontation with the "Imperative Mage" evil spirit to merge into the shadows again. At this time, his condition was very poor, and he had to quickly find a place to lick his wounds.
"Bestow!" How could Hobert let the opponent leave!
Although his out-of-control state had ended, the previous out-of-control still made him very weak. He "bestowed" his "weak" state to the "Black Knight"!
The "Black Knight's" shadow paused slightly, and the balance he had managed to maintain was in danger of collapsing again!
The "Imperative Mage" evil spirit sketched an evil smile and stretched out his hand to Hobert: "Imprison!"
This stopped Hobert's pursuit!
The evil spirit was not covering up the "Black Knight's" escape, it simply didn't want anyone else's intentions to succeed.
Being in a "grazed" state for a long time had eroded much of the evil spirit's wisdom. Now it was almost fighting purely on instinct.
"Connection!" Hobert strengthened the Connection between the "Black Knight" and the "evil spirit", which seemed to remind the evil spirit of something. The hand it stretched out to Hobert stretched out to the "Black Knight" again: "It is forbidden to escape here!"
The "Black Knight's" escape attempt seemed to immediately encounter great resistance.
Hobert took this opportunity to use a range ability: "Corruption!"
The evil spirit immediately fell into a "corrupted" state, and some of the emotions it suddenly possessed became nowhere to put.
The black shadow formed by the "Black Knight" paused obviously. He usually had too many "corrupted" emotions and memories. At this time, his own state was completely affected by the "corruption" and became very unstable.
After leaving the "imprisoned" state, Hobert chased after him while using another range ability: "Corrosion!"
The two consecutive abilities were very targeted, making the "Black Knight's" state worse.
Hobert also used "distortion" to finally catch up with the "Black Knight": "Magnify!"
Another fierce kick directly kicked the "Black Knight", who was struggling to fight the negative state, out of his shadow form and back into human form.
Hobert "distorted" the distance again and stabbed the opponent's chest with a blade.
Blood gushed out for a while!
Bang~
The blood once again blasted Hobert away.
But the "Black Knight's" out-of-control began again. This time he couldn't herd the souls of the "Spectator" pathway, and once the out-of-control process started, it would be difficult to stop!
Hobert, who was blasted away, reached out to the "Black Knight": "Distort!"
He "distorted" the other party's intention to resist the out-of-control state, and "distorted" it into allowing the out-of-control state to develop.
Although the time for the "Black Knight's" intention to be "distorted" was very short, it was enough to make him completely out of control and unable to form an effective confrontation.
At this time, the evil spirit was attracted by the blood, opened its illusory mouth, and devoured a mouthful of blood. Then it was like a layer of black gauze, covering the "Black Knight's" body.
Hobert held the blade, looked at the "Black Knight's" painful expression, and watched the evil spirit prepare to occupy this body that was beginning to lose control.
He didn't immediately step forward, but looked for opportunities to kill one of them, while also guarding against the "Black Knight's" escape.
The "Black Knight" finally made a choice, he began to allow his own out-of-control, and even accelerated the process of out-of-control.
Then his shadow stood up again, completely discharged the shadow's out-of-control into his body, and then the shadow left the body and strode away.
"Arrogant!" Hobert knew that the other party must have a way to escape.
The escaping shadow seemed to be suddenly stimulated by something, stomping its feet and wandering in place.
Hobert immediately chased after him: "Psychic Pierce!"
This was the ability of "1-107". The demigod-level mental piercing made the shadow seem to be about to explode, and it covered its head hard.
"Whip of Pain!" Hobert launched a new offensive, and tentacles, goat hooves, and other shapes began to appear on the shadow's body. It began to lose control again!
Bang~
Just as Hobert was staring at the shadow, the "Black Knight's" body suddenly cracked open, and a monster with only two legs, no arms on its shoulders, and a bird-like head fell out of it.
This monster was covered in mucus. It was only about the size of a seven- or eight-year-old child. After falling out, it ran away without saying a word!
The evil spirit hesitated as it looked at the escaping monster. In the end, it continued to choose to possess the pile of out-of-control flesh and blood.
Hobert quickly chased after him. At this time, he realized that the escaping shadow was just a cover. The "Black Knight" was not only once a "Shadow Ascetic", he was also once a "Rose Bishop".
When he realized that his out-of-control was irreversible, he simply stripped away his flesh and blood that had not yet lost control, gave the out-of-control flesh and blood to the evil spirit, and used the shadow to confuse Hobert.
After Hobert chased after him, two thin wings suddenly grew out of the opponent's back, and he actually flew into the sky.
Hobert "distorted" gravity and followed into the sky.
But once in the sky, "distorting" distance couldn't catch up with the winged monster.
So Hobert chanted a spell: "Lean Horse!"
Maximilian immediately appeared, and after receiving Hobert's command, carried Hobert to chase after it.
The monster's somewhat bizarre face immediately revealed a look of surprise. Flying was his last resort for escape, but he didn't expect Hobert to still catch up!
The "Black Knight" wasn't like the demigods of the "Rose School" and the Blood Sanctify Sect, who could summon angels to help. If he summoned angels from the True Creator Church, he would likely be besieged by angels from the orthodox churches.
Moreover, it was almost impossible to do so in a hurry. After all, the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" was a place similar to having a seal. Even the True Creator couldn't directly send power to the North and South Continents, let alone angels.
Hobert waved the sword in his hand, about to slash at the monster, but who knew Maximilian would rush up and bite the monster's head.
With a forceful chew, brains splattered everywhere!
Hobert was slightly stunned. This was too brutal!
The monster's wings flapped desperately, as if struggling.
Hobert leaned forward on the horse's back and pierced the monster's chest. The headless monster hung on the sword.
This monster wanted to grow a head again, but his body, which wasn't large to begin with, didn't have enough flesh. After growing for a long time, it only grew some pink flesh, and the thin legs were "borrowed" by other places.
Finally, the fleshy lump on Hobert's sword stopped wriggling, completely losing all signs of life.
Hobert smiled: "The first Sequence 4."
Returning to the Lord's manor, before landing, Hobert saw the "Black Knight's" out-of-control flesh and evil spirits, forming a creature like a toad, with short limbs, a huge body, and a flat head, covered with a layer of bumpy skin.
Seeing Hobert, the monster opened its mouth: "Flying is prohibited here!"
Maximilian quickly descended, and Hobert distorted the distance, so they landed almost steadily.
Jumping off the horse, Hobert first shook the meatball-like monster corpse off the sword.
The monster's long mouth opened again: "The use of weapons is prohibited here."
The sword in Hobert's hand immediately became very heavy, but he didn't drop the sword. Instead, he smiled and said, "Do I need to use weapons to deal with you?"
If that evil spirit hadn't possessed those flesh, it might have lived a little longer.
Unfortunately, it didn't have much sanity.
Hobert stretched out his hand: "Disorder!"
The monster's surroundings immediately fell into a state of disorder. It was about to open its mouth to continue "prohibiting," but suddenly realized that its power seemed to be drawn away.
"Tamper!" Hobert used two abilities in a row, causing the "toad" in front of him to collapse rapidly.
Hobert guessed that the "Black Knight's" Beyonder characteristics were on that escaped monster. The reason why the remaining flesh was still collapsing was likely because the Beyonder characteristics of the souls "grazed" by the "Black Knight" were still in those out-of-control flesh.
Although the process of "grazing" was a way to control other souls and Beyonder characteristics by combining body and spirituality, once the "shepherd" began to lose control, the "grazed" Beyonder characteristics would accelerate the process of losing control.
So the "Black Knight" should have simply abandoned them all together.
Hobert's "Disorder + Tamper" was to temporarily extract those Beyonder characteristics from the flesh. As expected, these flesh collapsed.
The flesh spread out, leaving only the evil spirit standing there in a daze.
"Distort!" Hobert tried to "distort" the state of the evil spirit, so that it would become a true soul, and the underworld could start to absorb it again.
At this time, the evil spirit seemed to have regained its senses, resisting Hobert's "distortion."
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert went to the ruins over there and found the "Spirit Wine Glass."
At this time, the evil spirit also broke free from the "distorted" state. Hobert held the wine cup: "Underworld Gate!"
The bronze door with heavy mystical patterns appeared, and just opening a small gap seemed to suck in the surrounding temperature. Even Hobert couldn't help but shiver.
Arms stretched out, and malicious gazes looked outside. Terrifying roars came, and the evil spirit stood there motionless. The underworld had a natural oppressive feeling towards evil spirits.
Hobert stretched out his hand towards the evil spirit: "Disorder!"
The evil spirit immediately fell into a "disordered" state, walking step by step towards the Underworld Gate.
Just as it was about to enter the "Underworld Gate," it broke free from the "disordered" state: "Banish!"
Whoosh~
The "Underworld Gate" was "banished" outside the Lord's manor, and the influence of the underworld on this place was weakened a lot.
"Weaken!" Hobert weakened the state of the evil spirit, making it look more transparent: "Tamper! Distort!"
Hobert used "Distort + Tamper" to try to distort the connection between the evil spirit and its source of power. In theory, the existence of the evil spirit must have something providing it with power.
Hobert only had a concept of this and didn't know what that thing was, so he just tried to distort and tamper.
This attempt worked very well. The already very weak evil spirit became ethereal, like a flame about to go out, as if it had been hit in the soft spot.
Hobert seized the opportunity and cut the evil spirit in half with a single blow.
His black blade also had considerable restraint against evil spirits.
The evil spirit didn't move, shrinking into a ball of shadows. The Beyonder characteristics began to separate.
Hobert then ended the summoning of the "Underworld Gate." Just as he was about to find a nightgown, he suddenly discovered that the meatball he had thrown on the ground was gone!
The "Black Knight" wasn't dead yet!
"Connect!" Fortunately, the other party's state was now extremely poor, and Hobert easily found the other party's trace.
The "Black Knight" had been rolling away to escape and was about to escape from the Lord's manor, but at this time, he began to lose control for the third time!
This was the loss of control hidden in the subconscious by the soul of the "Spectator" pathway! At this time, because he had too little flesh, he couldn't maintain his own state at all, and those losses of control finally broke out!
This time, the "Black Knight" still couldn't "graze" the souls of the "Spectator" pathway, nor could he peel off his own flesh. The "Black Knight" was completely unable to suppress the process of losing control.
Hobert stabbed the expanding meatball with a blade, and the expansion process stopped immediately. The "Black Knight" could no longer maintain his life and died.
Soon Hobert discovered that the "Black Knight's" Beyonder characteristics were gathering towards the skin on the outer layer of the meatball!
Hobert was slightly stunned: This, this is going to form a sealed artifact? But he only lost control for a short while!
Then Hobert thought again: You can't say that either. In the battle just now, this "Black Knight" had accumulated too many factors of losing control. Although he used various methods to eliminate a lot of loss of control and madness, in essence, his loss of control was already very serious.
Hobert kicked the meatball back to the backyard, which had become a ruin, and went to the ruins of the bedroom to find a nightgown to put on.
Looking again at the flesh that had lost control of the "Black Knight," there were indeed three Beyonder characteristics that were separating out. Those were the characteristics of the Beyonders who had been "grazed" by the "Black Knight."
Only after the "Black Knight" died, or released the soul, could these souls end the painful "grazing" process and return to the underworld, becoming normal souls, and the Beyonder characteristics could begin to separate out at this time.
Hobert picked up three Beyonder characteristics and at the same time discovered that there was still a piece of flesh wriggling in these seemingly lifeless flesh!
After a little thought, Hobert understood. Before, in the urgency of the situation, when the "Black Knight" peeled off his collapsing flesh, these flesh must still contain some of his Beyonder characteristics.
This was very similar to digging out a piece of flesh from an Beyonder after his death, when the Beyonder characteristics had not yet separated out. This piece of flesh must contain some Beyonder characteristics.
If it was a "high sequence" Beyonder, such a piece of flesh was likely to form a sealed artifact.
Hobert held the three Beyonder characteristics and pushed them towards "Lean Horse": "Choose one!"
Maximilian turned his head and raised his chin towards the wriggling flesh. Hobert was stunned: "You want this 'mutated flesh'?"
Maximilian immediately nodded.
Hobert then picked up the blade and dug out the piece of flesh. Maximilian took the piece of flesh back to the underworld.
At this time, the Beyonder characteristics of the evil spirit had been separated out. Hobert held it in his hand. Without going to the "Nation of Disorder," he could be sure that this was indeed an Beyonder characteristic of an "Imperative Mage"!
At this time, Archibald and Angus and others led people to support them.
When they saw that the backyard had almost become a ruin, they were a little worried at first, but when they saw the Lord squatting on the ground peeling a meatball-like thing, they breathed a sigh of relief: "Lord!" "Sir!"
In fact, the peeling process was not difficult, like peeling off a piece of cloth with black starlight from a strangely shaped meatball.
Archibald and others then realized that this was actually a sealed artifact.
Hobert shook the skin and asked Angus and others: "Did you also suffer an attack?"
"Yes." Angus said first: "Fortunately, there was a warning from the 'Astrologer,' and we made some preparations.
"The enemy has 3 'Shepherds,' and a total of more than a dozen Sequence 6 and Sequence 7s.
"Thanks to Chief of Staff Archibald's timely arrival, he helped us solve those three 'Shepherds.'"
Then Archibald reported: "A 'Shepherd' led the team to attack the barracks. I seriously injured him, and the other attackers have been solved by me. The spoils will be presented to the Lord's manor later."
As he spoke, Archibald's two puppets escorted the "Shepherd" over.
Hobert nodded: "Very good, turn him into your puppet! This is your reward!"
Since Archibald was so particular about the rules, Hobert certainly didn't object to him having another puppet.
"Yes! Thank you, Lord!" Archibald connected the spiritual line of the "Shepherd" who had already fallen into a coma and quickly turned him into a puppet!
Hobert said to Angus again: "When you faced the enemy's surprise attack, you didn't rush to the Lord's manor to support, but stuck to your posts. You did a good job. Everyone will be credited once."
Angus was about to say that it was Captain Dunn's suggestion, but the Lord's reward had been announced, and it was a little inappropriate to say this at this time.
So Angus decided to report to the Lord when he had the opportunity to meet Hobert alone.
Hobert, wearing a nightgown, ordered: "Now you go back to prepare, send the wounded to the hospital, and set off in twenty minutes to cross the river with me and completely recover the west bank of Full Moon Lake!"
He ordered Archibald: "You and Seel lead the other Beyonders in the Defense Force to lead the team, closely following behind to completely occupy the west bank!"
Hobert said to the butler Allen and others: "Go find out if there are any wounded in the ruins, and come to repair the Lord's manor tomorrow!"
After everyone left, Hobert first sacrificed this time's loot to the "Nation of Disorder," and then pulled up the "Traveler's Gate" that had fallen on the ground and leaned it against the wall.
Opening the "Traveler's Gate" and arriving at the Earl's mansion in Backlund, Fors, who was waiting anxiously, immediately rushed over and hugged Hobert.
Then she looked Hobert up and down. Seeing that he hadn't suffered any injuries, she felt relieved.
"The problem has been solved." Hobert smiled and said, "That group of lunatics from the Aurora Order actually took the initiative to attack the actual leader of the South Colson area."
Fors asked: "Was Jeffrey City attacked?"
"It was also attacked, but fortunately, Angus responded, no, I think it was the experienced Captain Dunn's response." Hobert smiled and said, "They protected the city and the people."
Then he said: "You rest here for a while, I have to lead the team to kill to the other side of the river, you go back tomorrow morning!"
Fors immediately said: "I want to join the battle too!"
Hobert thought for a while, the main force of the Aurora Order on the west bank should have come to attack and died in Jeffrey City. He looked at Fors's eager eyes and nodded: "Okay, don't leave my side."
Hobert nodded to Dophis outside, indicating that the crisis was over. Then the couple closed the door and quickly changed into Feynapotter-style combat uniforms.
When they returned to Jeffrey City, Angus and Helen's two teams were ready to go.
Hobert led more than 30 Beyonders to the outside of the city and joined Archibald and others who were already waiting here.
Now in the Defense Force, in addition to Archibald and Seel, there are already 5 "Hunters," 3 "Warriors," and 1 "Sailor."
They were all Beyonders who had made contributions in the process of suppressing bandits and were given potions by Hobert.
Hobert led the members of the Special Operations Department to cross the river first. When they arrived on the other side of the river, it was already dawn.
There were Beyonders from the Aurora Order on the pier. They were waiting here to meet the attackers tonight, but they waited for the enemy to cross the river by force!
Seeing that the leader of this group was only a Sequence 6, Hobert allowed Angus and others to rush up and fight them.
After quickly resolving the battle, Hobert gave the "Spirit Wine Glass" to Angus, asking him to conduct spirit channeling and learn about the important strongholds of the Aurora Order.
According to Angus's description, it was a church built on the mountainside.
Hobert didn't expect that the Aurora Order would actually build a church on the west bank!
Just as Hobert had guessed, the entire raid encountered no real resistance.
Only on the way to the church, there were many corpses hung on javelins. Upon closer inspection, they had all been skinned.
Yet on their faces, devoid of skin, there was a strange smile, sending chills down everyone's spines.
Hobert believed that the rule of the Aurora Order's lunatics was no better than that of demons.
At this moment, the Beyonders in the church seemed to know that the sneak attack had failed, but they did not intend to escape. Instead, they were devoutly and fanatically praying before the idol, and then rushed madly towards Angus and the others.
Hobert looked around. Among the enemies, there was only one Sequence 5, who was being besieged by Angus, Helen, and two other Sequence 6 members, each wearing Sealed Artifacts.
So Hobert still did not act. Instead, he looked at the huge inverted cross in the church.
Since he had subordinates, and they could handle the situation, Hobert naturally didn't need to take action himself.
Fors also seemed to have received Hobert's signal, only taking out the "Leymano's Travels" without participating in the battle.
The battle ended quickly, with more than a dozen enemies killed. Angus once again performed spirit channeling and learned of some other strongholds of the Aurora Order.
Because there were too many strongholds and no Beyonders with too much strength at the moment, the Special Operations Division was divided into four teams to carry out raids separately.
However, there was not much of a surprise attack effect at this time. It was more of an action to kill as many as possible.
Hobert and Fors stayed at the church, along with one Sequence 7 and two Sequence 9 members to protect the lord.
Saying it was protection was actually just staying here to run errands when the lord needed them.
While everyone was waiting for Archibald to occupy the area, Hobert saw groups of ordinary people gathering at the foot of the mountain. Even on the hillside, he could feel their eager gazes towards the church.
Having had the experience of taking territory from the hands of demons before, Hobert thought for a moment and came up with a solution.
He first stretched out his hand towards the church: "Tamper!"
Rumble~
Hobert "tampered" the mechanical structure of the tall church's foundation, and the church immediately collapsed.
However, the inverted cross in the church pierced through the dome and still stood tall.
Under the light of dawn, the cross and the inverted idol on it actually had a sense of holiness, especially the idol's single eye, which seemed to be made of gemstones, reflecting a scarlet light.
"Do not look directly into His eyes," Hobert reminded the others, "Evil Gods are also Gods."
Fors immediately averted her gaze from the eye and observed other parts of the idol: This is the image of the True Creator! I've only heard 'The Sun' describe it before. This is the first time I've seen it in the real world!
The believers at the foot of the mountain became even more fanatical, almost running up the mountain.
The Beyonders protecting Hobert were a little flustered. There were so many enemies, and they were just ordinary people. How should they deal with them? Could they kill them all?
"You don't have to worry about anything later!" When the believers rushed close, Hobert stood in front of the idol and began to pray.
Seeing that the believers were about to rush to Hobert, his three subordinates were even prepared to use force to protect the lord. Just then, a huge sense of oppression appeared in the sky.
Fors and the three members of the Special Operations Division looked behind them together. A majestic figure flashing with black light appeared in mid-air.
That figure sat on a throne made of swords, wearing armor emitting a black, holy light, and a crown also emitting a holy light. Unfortunately, they could not see the other party's face clearly, only their eyes flashing with black mist!
A huge sense of oppression swept over them, and absolute majesty shook everyone's hearts!
The Beyonders next to Hobert immediately knelt down. At this moment, they seemed to support this solid figure from the bottom of their hearts, unwilling to disobey any of his orders.
The majestic aura spread around, and the fanatical, mad cultists also looked at the mid-air in disbelief.
After becoming a demigod, as long as one holds the Black Emperor card, ordinary people can see the image of the 'Creator'.
That black light was so holy, and that huge figure was so majestic.
This is the power of God!
The inverted idol's eyes turned and also looked at the mid-air, as if projecting an extremely evil gaze.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert sneered slightly, stretched out his hand, and a surge of majestic "Power of Disorder" descended, entangling the idol.
Crack~
The idol, made of an unknown material, cracked and quickly collapsed. The idol's scarlet eyes lost all their light.
The believers seemed to sense something and began to worship the "Creator" in mid-air.
At this time, the wave-like oppression in the sky disappeared, replaced by the demigod-level oppression emanating from Hobert: "God says: Do not believe in Evil Gods!
"Today, you have seen the face of God, you should believe in the true God! Pray on time, offer sacrifices regularly!
"Besides the 'Creator,' you shall have no other gods;
"You shall not make idols for yourselves;
"..."
Hobert preached like a bishop, and even Fors and the others listened very carefully.
After that, just like last time, Hobert displayed the pattern pointing to the "Creator," and this group of believers basically converted.
But after Hobert withdrew his majesty, some believers still jumped out to fight Hobert, who had destroyed their idol.
As a result, before they could rush to Hobert, they turned into irrational monsters!
Hobert realized that the people ruled by the Aurora Order were more severely polluted than those ruled by demons. Many people were already monsters wearing human skin.
