[Thanks to Abdi Nuur for becoming a free member]
Hobert's carriage hadn't gone far when a coffin emerged from the void. After a letter popped out, it disappeared.
Opening the letter, Hobert discovered it was from Klein. He thought to himself, 'Only today do I realize I've taken so much blame for you!'
He opened the letter and saw that Klein was asking him to meet at the Tussock Riverbank in the suburbs of Backlund at midnight.
Hobert was stunned: What's so important that he needs to meet me in person?
He exerted a little force with his hand, 'tampering' with the density of the letter, turning it into tiny paper scraps. As they floated out of the carriage window, they turned into white dust.
After resting for a while, at 11:58 PM, Hobert used 'Travel' to arrive at the meeting place he had agreed upon with Klein.
It was far from the city, with no villages nearby, only the Tussock River flowing silently in the darkness.
Klein had just arrived as well. The two smiled at each other.
Hobert thought to himself, 'Is tonight a 'friends reunion'?' To see two old friends on the same night!
He asked knowingly, "I heard you're being targeted by the Church of the Lord of Storms?"
Klein's appearance at this time was black hair and brown eyes, with the temperament of a scholar, just like when he first met Hobert. He asked in return, "Haven't you heard about my experiences?"
Hobert laughed, "I only heard that Gehrman Sparrow became a favored one of the 'Creator,' but I only got this information tonight and haven't had time to verify it."
He said this on purpose to make it easier for Klein to make relevant associations.
And Klein lived up to expectations: 'It's about what I guessed. Hobert is only responsible for matters related to the 'Creator' in the Northern Continent, so he's not very well-informed about the Berserk Sea. And the 'Creator' certainly wouldn't proactively tell his favored one about the events in Bayam!'
"The 'Creator' saved me in Bayam," Klein said directly. "I asked you out to ask if you need my help with anything recently?"
Hobert immediately understood that Klein didn't know how to repay the 'Creator', so he was learning from 'The Hanged Man' to prepare to thank the 'Creator's' favored one.
"There is indeed something I need your help with."
Klein made a gesture for him to speak.
Hobert suddenly brought up another issue: "What are your thoughts on how to obtain the 'Magician' potion formula?"
Klein was slightly stunned: "There is no feasible plan at the moment."
Hobert certainly knew that this guy wasn't telling the truth. He then said, "If you want to sneak into a church of the Evernight Goddess, such as Saint Samuel Cathedral in Backlund, to obtain the potion formula, remember to call me."
Klein looked puzzled.
Hobert explained, "During the Backlund smog incident, a Saint sent by the 'Creator' lost contact. According to limited clues, we suspect that Saint was imprisoned by an Sealed Artifact of the Evernight Goddess Church. If there's a chance, I need to sneak into Saint Samuel Cathedral to look for clues."
Klein immediately considered the possibility of acting with Hobert, but he soon felt that doing so was too risky.
Just as he was about to refuse and ask Hobert if he had any other requests, Hobert added, "I recently obtained an Sealed Artifact that can transform into a small mass of flesh, to be hidden on another person in a very secretive way."
This made Klein change his mind again: "If I have such ideas, I will contact you immediately."
Hobert "hmm"ed and asked, "What are your plans after this?"
Klein didn't hide anything: "I can't stay in the Rampaging Sea any longer. I plan to return to Backlund under another identity."
"If you need help, you can come to the Earl's manor or write to me."
"I will," Klein said with a smile.
"I just saw Leonard tonight," Hobert said. "Besides the current Sequence advancement, he's still the same as ever."
Klein sighed, "Leonard!"
It seemed like someone who had appeared in his life a long time ago.
Watching Hobert leave, Klein stood quietly by the river for a while before using 'Travel' to arrive at the Tingen City cemetery, in front of Dunn Smith's grave: "Captain, I've come to see you."
He looked at the tombstone for a long time without saying a word. He originally thought he would have a lot to say, but when he arrived at the cemetery, he found that he couldn't say anything.
After a long while, Klein used divination to find Old Neil's grave: "Why didn't I carefully observe your condition at that time? If you hadn't lost control a second time, perhaps..."
He sighed, "How can there be so many perhaps? In this extraordinary world, we are too fragile."
...
62 Empress Borough.
Hobert lay in his bedroom, lamenting that Klein seemed to be getting more and more withdrawn.
He remembered that before, Klein would tell him some of his plans for the future, but now Klein was unwilling to reveal anything.
Turning over, Hobert thought again: 'Leonard can't be a poet in this life. Although his thoughts are unconstrained, the questions he thinks about are too practical and not poetic at all, but this way of thinking is very suitable for investigating cases.'
Thinking and thinking, Hobert fell into a deep sleep and woke up early the next morning.
While eating breakfast, Hobert chatted with Elizabeth, asking about her exam preparation and planning to get to know some education councilors at the upcoming balls.
Or use Portland's relationship to see if he could find a convenient channel to enter Backlund University.
Today was Monday, and the students introduced by Portland, the president of Backlund Technical University, and Professor Isaac of the Physics Department came for an interview.
Hobert chatted with them and felt quite satisfied with their professional skills, so he hired all four of them.
Hobert was very generous with the salary. The student introduced by Portland had rich work experience, and Hobert gave him a salary of 12 pounds per week.
The three students introduced by Isaac were somewhat lacking in practical experience, but Hobert also offered a salary of 8 pounds per week for each of them, and arranged accommodation and food for them on the manor.
This salary and treatment were rare in Backlund, especially for the three university graduates in materials science. This was the highest-paying job they had encountered.
On the way to the manor in the suburbs by carriage, Hobert assigned tasks to them.
Portland's student, Fich, was responsible for designing a small power station. Hobert explained the principle of the power station to Fich in as much detail as possible.
The difference between the mechanical structure of the power station and ordinary steam engines was its turbine, which could better Exploit thermal energy.
If ordinary steam engines could only Exploit about 8% of the heat energy after coal combustion, the power station with a large turbine could Exploit up to 40% of the heat energy!
Hobert had only seen the concept diagram of the turbine and could only try his best to describe it clearly.
Fich was a little confused at first. After all, the turbine was not a product of this era and was not easy for him to understand.
But after understanding the principle, he was confident that he could design a prototype in two or three weeks, assemble it, and test the effect.
As for the three students introduced by Isaac, Hobert asked one to study the application of tungsten wire in electric lights, one to study more uses of rubber, and one to study how to convert electrical energy and acoustic energy into each other.
The four people looked at each other and seemed to say in their hearts at the same time: 'This money is not easy to earn!'
The tasks Hobert gave were all in the relatively unpopular field of electricity, and although the learned Earl gave them theories that they were not unfamiliar with, they had not applied them in this way before, so there was nothing to learn from.
However, after seeing the manor that was being renovated on a large scale, the four people became ambitious again and felt that this was indeed an opportunity to show their talents.
After settling them down, Hobert urged them to get to work as soon as possible.
What these four researchers didn't know was that Hobert had repeatedly used the "1-107's" "Secrecy" ability when he talked to them about the key points.
So Hobert simply didn't sign a confidentiality agreement, because it wasn't necessary.
Without having time to eat lunch, Hobert embarked on the return journey, fearing that he would not be able to return to the Earl's manor by three o'clock in the afternoon.
After returning to the Earl's manor, Hobert locked himself in the bedroom under the pretext of rest.
At exactly three o'clock in the afternoon, his vision was covered by gray fog, and he reappeared in the Giant's Hall, sitting on one side of the bronze long table.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool!" With "Justice" Audrey's crisp greeting, this Tarot Gathering officially began.
After the greeting session, "Hermit" Cattleya first said: "Mr. Fool, I only collected one page of Roselle's diary this time."
Next was "Fool" Klein's reading time. After reading a few lines, he was surprised to find that this page of the diary was actually Roselle's record of obtaining information about the 'Black Emperor' rebirth process from Mr. 'Door'!
In addition, there was a lot of information about the 'United Empire' during the Fourth Epoch. The former made Klein understand many of the things that the 'Emperor' had reserved in his previous information about the 'Black Emperor'.
The latter allowed him to verify the 'Emperor's' relevant information and guesses about the Fourth Epoch. In the end, he concluded that this information was basically consistent with what the 'Emperor' said, and the Emperor's guesses were also reasonable, making the relevant information and history more abundant.
After reading this diary with a huge amount of information, Klein smiled and said to Cattleya: "What is your request?"
Cattleya immediately asked: "May I ask who is the protagonist of this diary besides Emperor Roselle?"
This question immediately made Audrey look at Mr. Fool with curiosity. The other members were also very interested. Anyone who could be written in Roselle the Great's diary must not be an ordinary person.
Klein couldn't help but complain in his heart: 'That is to say, this diary was carefully selected by Bernadette. If it were another one, I would tell you that the other protagonist is a witch, a certain noble lady, a certain noble young lady.'
He leaned back in his chair leisurely and replied: "Mr. 'Door'!"
For a time, everyone appeared a brief daze.
"The Hanged Man" Alger frowned: According to the information obtained from "Emperor", Mr. "Door" was a figure of the Fourth Epoch. How could he have contact with Emperor Roselle of the Fifth Epoch?
Audrey was curious: In what way did they meet, what would they communicate?
"Magician" Fors thought: Could it be that the seal on Mr. "Door" became less secure a hundred years ago? That's why I can hear those whispers during the full moon?
The other members probably had similar guesses to their own.
Cattleya had already traded for information about the Angel family before joining the Tarot Club, so only she didn't know who Mr. "Door" was.
After observing the abnormality of the other members, she asked: "Does everyone know who Mr. 'Door' is?"
Audrey and the other members all looked at the "Emperor."
"Emperor" Hobert said: "Mr. 'Door' is an King of Angels of the Fourth Epoch, um, the King of Angels here refers to a level of power, not a title."
He added: "Except for the eight Kings of Angels around the Ancient Sun God in the Third Epoch, when describing others as Kings of Angels, they all refer to the level of strength, not the title."
Cattleya asked: "Why haven't I heard of Mr. 'Door'?"
Hobert had to further answer: "He was sealed."
Cattleya followed up and asked: "Then why can he contact Emperor Roselle?"
This was also the question in the minds of the other members, including Klein, so everyone unanimously stared at the "Emperor."
"This..." Hobert paused slightly: "I'm not too clear about this either, I only know some information."
He originally wanted to say "This information needs to be traded", but after thinking about it, if he knew this secret information very clearly, it would be easy to be suspected, so he said "I only know some information".
Cattleya immediately said: "I am willing to initiate a transaction for relevant information, even if I only know a part of it."
"I am also willing to initiate a transaction!" Fors also immediately said, she would not let go of any information about Mr. "Door"!
Cattleya was slightly stunned and looked at Miss "Magician". In her impression, Miss "Magician" rarely took the initiative like this.
"Let me think about it," Hobert said, "3000 pounds."
He then smiled: "In order to allow everyone to improve faster, let's offer 3000 pounds!"
After becoming a demigod, Hobert didn't have much need for gold pounds anymore, and he earned money faster. Instead, he hoped to get more demigod helpers, so there was no need to scavenge other members.
The crowdfunding for this transaction was completed as quickly as ever.
This time, Cattleya and Fors each contributed 750 pounds, and the other members each contributed 300 pounds. Of course, "Little Sun" used Beyonder ingredients to pay off his debts as usual.
Before the transaction began, Cattleya looked at Miss Magician again: Everyone didn't show surprise at Miss "Magician's" enthusiasm this time! Usually, she would at most follow along with the transaction. Could it be that Miss "Magician" has a special connection with Mr. "Door"? And everyone knows this?
Then she thought: Just as I thought before, although Miss Magician rarely speaks and looks very low-key, she never seems to worry about money! Moreover, she has never bought any magic potion formulas or Beyonder ingredients, but compared to last week, her temperament at this gathering seems to be different, as if she has been promoted! Who provided her with the formula and Beyonder ingredients? Her identity is indeed not simple!
"'Mr. Door's' full name is Bethel Abraham," Hobert said, "In this transaction, we will mainly talk about this King of Angels."
Cattleya was slightly taken aback: "A member of the Abraham family?"
Although she had never heard of "Mr. Door," she had heard of the Abraham family.
Fors answered this question: "To be precise, he is the ancestor of the Abraham family."
Cattleya nodded slightly, guessing the relationship between Miss Magician and the Abraham family.
Hobert waited for their question and answer to end before continuing: "According to limited clues, this 'Mr. Door' should have been promoted to an angel in the Third Epoch.
"The Sequence 3 of this pathway before becoming an angel is called 'Wanderer'. It is said that they can wander in the cosmos and travel between different planets."
This stunned Klein: If he had this ability, what would he need a spaceship for?
Then he realized: In the mystical world, in addition to the concepts of orange stars and brown stars, there are also concepts of other planets! That's right, I remember seeing some descriptions before I time-traveled. Before people could see the surface of Mars clearly, they thought that some humans should also live on other planets. The concept of planets has actually existed for a long time!
Audrey sighed in her heart: Wandering in the cosmos! It sounds so romantic!
Fors was a little excited: I will have such abilities in the future! I must go and see what those stars look like!
The male members such as Alger did not have such romantic ideas. Alger just thought: Other planets are good hiding places. The "Apprentice" pathway seems to be developing in a direction that is increasingly difficult to catch.
"The Sun" Derrick carefully savored the word "planet" before he roughly understood the meaning of the planet: How great it would be if City of Silver could migrate to other planets! It's a pity that we can't even go to the North and South Continents now.
"The Moon" Emlyn wondered: I wonder if there are moons on other planets? Are there any puppets?
Hobert gave everyone a few seconds to imagine, and then reminded everyone: "It is said that 'Mr. Door' liked to travel in the cosmos after becoming a 'Wanderer'.
"Please remember this, because this is very important!"
The other members were slightly taken aback and didn't understand why Hobert would give such a reminder.
Only "The Emperor" continued: "In the Fourth Epoch, it is said that 'Mr. Door' has accommodated the uniqueness of this pathway and all Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics, and is known as: the King of Angels who is most likely to be promoted to a True God!
"During the 'War of the Four Emperors', he was jointly sealed by the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms, who supported the Trunsoest Empire."
At this time, Klein suddenly recalled: I remember that Roselle said in a diary before that after going to sea, he encountered 'Mr. Door' who was trapped in the storm and lost in the depths of darkness. I didn't notice this before. It may be precisely because 'Mr. Door' was sealed by the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms that he appeared to be trapped in darkness and storms.
Cattleya keenly noticed something: "Why was 'Mr. Door' sealed?"
The other members were slightly taken aback. Why else? Of course, it was because of the "War of the Four Emperors"! The Beyonders of the "Door" pathway found it difficult to deal with just thinking about it. The Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms were eliminating potential threats.
"The Hermit" Cattleya seemed to see through everyone's thoughts, she spread her hands: "Didn't everyone notice this? Who else did the gods seal during the 'War of the Four Emperors'?"
Everyone was stunned. It seemed that they had never heard of anyone else being sealed by the Six Gods.
In this way, 'Mr. Door's' encounter seemed indeed quite special. And people who have such special encounters must have something special about them.
Hobert admired the "Pirate Admiral's" insight very much: "The Hermit's question is indeed the most critical part of this transaction.
"Although there is no direct evidence to prove it, the existing clues all indicate that 'Mr. Door' was corrupted while wandering in the cosmos after becoming a 'Wanderer'!
"So, as 'Mr. Door' becomes stronger and stronger, he is actually becoming a bigger and bigger destabilizing factor!
"Therefore, when the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms believed that the time was right, they immediately sealed 'Mr. Door'."
This answer was unexpected by everyone. Klein behind the gray fog first thought: Then Roselle, who communicated with 'Mr. Door' many times, is also in danger of being corrupted!
Alger smiled slightly: The seemingly ordinary actions of the gods always contain profound meaning.
Fors immediately asked: "Who corrupted 'Mr. Door'?"
Hobert did not answer directly, but said: "At that time, 'Mr. Door' was not yet an angel and was not strong enough to resist such corruption!"
Fors recalled the information she had previously traded from "The Emperor" and immediately understood: "Above the Gods!"
Klein silently recited in his heart: Outer Gods!
Then he manipulated "The World" and asked: "Are there many such contaminations in the cosmos? Why hasn't this corruption spread in the North and South Continents?"
The second question had been a question that had been hidden in his heart for a long time.
Hobert simply replied: "As far as I know, yes!"
Klein was slightly taken aback. Generally, when asked during a transaction, "The Emperor" would try to answer in as much detail as possible.
And if he didn't answer in detail, there were generally two reasons, either Hobert didn't know the answer, or the value of the answer was too high and exceeded the scope of this transaction.
Looking at Hobert's expression, Klein believed that both were true.
Fors couldn't help but frown when he heard this answer: So the cosmos is very dangerous!
Audrey had the same question as "The World": Why are those "Outer Gods" all in the cosmos? And haven't affected the real world?
Alger realized: According to some clues, the gods seemed to have gone to the astral world at the beginning of the Fifth Epoch. Were they going to guard against this group of "Outer Gods"?
Then he also had the same question as Klein before: But "Outer Gods" should be stronger than gods, how did the Seven Gods resist their erosion?
Cattleya was more concerned: "Why was 'Mr. Door' able to contact Emperor Roselle?"
The other members were slightly taken aback and immediately realized that this was another key piece of information in this transaction, so they stopped their respective guesses and looked at "The Emperor" together.
"Part of the following transaction content is my guess," Hobert said, "The one who corrupted 'Mr. Door' occupied the Crimson Moon.
"So, at the time of the full moon, that existence can to a certain extent offset the seal on 'Mr. Door'.
"Or 'Mr. Door' can use his own corruption to obtain power from the full moon and temporarily get rid of the power of the seal to a certain extent, approaching the real world.
"The latter is more likely. If it is the former, 'Mr. Door' is likely to be in a semi-mad state during the full moon.
"In addition, although He is rational during the full moon, it may be because He has been corrupted, or because the existence occupying the Crimson Moon has tampered with Him, making His attempts to communicate with His descendants become maddening whispers, making it almost impossible for anyone to know what He is saying.
"If one day you can understand what He is saying, either you are strong enough to block those tampering or contaminations, or He is bewitching you!"
Fors asked: "Whispers of the full moon?"
"Yes," Hobert nodded.
Cattleya was slightly taken aback: Why didn't I hear whispers during the full moon? Can only members of the Abraham family hear these whispers?
Then she realized a key question: The Crimson Moon is occupied by "Outer Gods"? Is it because of His occupation that the blood moon phenomenon occurs? This reminds me of the "Primordial Moon"!
Emlyn didn't know the details of Miss Magician: For blood clans, the full moon is when our power is at its fullest, but even the most learned Crimson Scholars among the blood clans have never announced that there will be whispers during the full moon!
Fors asked again: "What are the whispers of 'Mr. Door' saying?"
"The great 'Creator' said that He was warning His descendants not to rescue Him!" Hobert brought out his big name.
Everyone was stunned, and then their hearts were immediately filled with questions.
Under the cover of the gray fog, Klein was somewhat surprised: I thought before that 'Mr. Door' was asking for help, but I didn't expect the opposite to be true?
Fors was slightly taken aback: Why is He telling the descendants of the Abraham family not to save Him? Is it because He has been corrupted? Once there is an opportunity, He reminds His descendants not to encounter such corruption as He did?
Cattleya was more concerned: "So Emperor Roselle established contact with 'Mr. Door' and communicated with Him during the full moon?"
Hobert nodded: "That should be the case."
"The Hermit" Cattleya quickly asked: "Then has the Emperor also been corrupted?"
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying: "As far as I know, he has been corrupted to a certain extent, a corruption that is difficult to detect!"
The other members, including Klein, sat up straight, their expressions or body movements showing their surprise.
Klein sighed: I clearly had some guesses, but at this moment when I know the exact answer, I still can't help but be a little surprised.
Then he worried: I read Roselle's diary, could I also have been corrupted because of this?
Audrey was somewhat detached from the state of Spectator: Oh my god, Emperor Roselle was actually corrupted by "Outer Gods"! Then, which of the eccentric words and deeds he did were made under the influence of corruption? Which were made under normal circumstances?
"Little Sun" leaned back in his chair: Suddenly I feel that the outside world is so dangerous!
Emlyn smiled: This is really an unexpected thing. Humans are really a fragile race. Like us blood clans, we are rarely corrupted.
But thinking of those adults lying in coffins who were not in good condition, Emlyn's idea was somewhat lacking in confidence.
Cattleya was the first to recover from her surprise: "Then will the Emperor bring this corruption to the people around him?"
"Theoretically, no," Hobert said, "Because this corruption is very weak and will only be used at specific times."
"The Hermit" breathed a sigh of relief, then the Queen was not affected.
Fors asked: "We often hear the whispers of the full moon, especially when the blood moon is clearer, will we also be corrupted?"
"No," Hobert said, "As I said before, this is when 'Mr. Door' is somewhat rational. Of course, He will not give His corruption to His descendants."
There may be slight corruption, but Hobert believed that it was only possible to be used by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" after leaving the earth and entering the cosmos.
Klein asked from manipulating "The World": "We know so much information about Emperor Roselle, about 'Mr. Door', won't we be corrupted because of this?"
Hobert understood that what Klein really cared about was whether he would be corrupted because he had read so many of Roselle's diaries?
So he replied: "Here we have Mr. Fool's protection, and this giant hall's protection. As long as we don't bring this information to the real world, we will not be harmed in any way."
Klein breathed a sigh of relief, manipulating "The World": "That's good!"
Fors asked again: "What is the current state of 'Mr. Door'?"
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying: "In my opinion, the seals of the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms are, to some extent, a kind of protection for Him!
"Until now, He has not been completely corrupted and fallen into complete madness, but the corruption He has suffered is already very serious and will constantly lure some people to the cosmos, eventually causing more people to be corrupted."
Fors nodded thoughtfully: He has not been completely corrupted, which means there is still hope of being rescued?
Thinking of this, she shook her head: Doing so is very dangerous, and may even bring great danger to the entire real world. It's better not to make such assumptions! The cosmos is so terrible, I won't go even if I have such abilities in the future!
Audrey sighed: It has been more than a thousand years, and 'Mr. Door's' call is still continuing. Thinking about it seriously, such an encounter is really despairing!
Klein noticed the first half of "The Emperor's" words: Could this be another secret arrangement of the gods? Perhaps the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms were not sure of killing 'Mr. Door', so they joined forces to seal Him?
Cattleya frowned: It's a pity that after performing psychological suggestion later, I may only remember that 'Mr. Door's' condition is not very good after leaving this gray fog, and I won't be able to pass all the information to the Queen.
"Little Sun" and Emlyn felt like they were listening to a story the whole time and didn't have any sense of involvement. The former was because they were in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" and felt that these things were far away from them. The latter was because he was a bit carefree and always felt that this was a matter of the "human world" and had nothing to do with him, a Sanguine.
Seeing that everyone no longer had any questions, Hobert said: "This transaction ends here!"
Cattleya seemed to have just recovered: "I would also like to ask, what specific effects did Emperor Roselle suffer?"
"Because Emperor Roselle jumped to the 'Black Emperor' pathway, I do know some inside information about this." Hobert smiled. "But that's another transaction."
She was about to initiate a new transaction, but then she thought that this information must involve "Above the Sequence" again. Even if the transaction was completed, it would be difficult to bring these messages out. It would be better to wait until the Queen's questions involved the Emperor again in the future, and trade with the Emperor together.
As usual, for most of the next minute, everyone was still immersed in the information they had just heard.
Although the previous transaction did not yield any shocking news, it changed their impression of Emperor Roselle again, and invisibly subverted some cognitions!
After most of a minute, "The World" looked around and said in a hoarse voice: "I want to sell a magical item. I named it 'Biological Poison Bottle'."
He briefly described the magical item he obtained when helping Miss Bodyguard fight against the members of the "Rose School".
Seeing that no one spoke, Klein couldn't help but let "The World" add: "Everyone can help me find a buyer, and I will give a certain commission to the member who sells it."
Hobert then asked: "How much are you planning to sell it for?"
"5200 pounds!" Klein immediately manipulated "The World" to quote.
"5200 pounds." Emlyn repeated the price softly, without any extra thoughts.
Cattelya paused obviously, as if thinking of something, before saying: "It's not necessary for me."
Audrey keenly read the other party's emotions: Miss Hermit seemed to be afraid of something.
"Hermit" Cattelya was just considering that Frank Lee might do some terrible experiments after coming into contact with the "Biological Poison Bottle". Because this magical item has an aphrodisiac effect, she didn't want to see the crew's children growing on the deck of the "Future", or the moo-mooing kind.
"I want it!" Fors suddenly said. She believed that selling this magical item at the auction house could fetch at least 8,000 to 10,000 pounds, after all, it was a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact.
Then she seemed to think of something, and then said: "Is it possible to accept payment in the form of gold lire?"
Klein sighed secretly and manipulated "The World" to say: "Sorry, not accepting it for the time being."
"Then I need some time to raise the pounds! How about we complete the transaction tomorrow?" Fors basically had gold lire in her hand, and she still had to find Hobert to exchange for this large pound transaction.
As for Hobert on the opposite side, seeing that Fors had a bit of the posture of a lord's wife, he quietly watched her complete the transaction.
Even if Fors didn't make a move, Hobert also planned to complete the transaction with Klein. After all, this kind of Grade 2 Sealed Artifact was still very easy to sell. If auctioned, it could at least be used as the finale auction item.
It didn't matter if "The Emperor" and "The World" completed the transaction and then handed it over to the auction house for processing. Hobert had already given Fors a heads-up in advance, telling her that the auction house would also handle the spoils of other dependents of the "Creator".
At that time, the "Biological Poison Bottle" could be said to be a commodity to be disposed of by a dependent of the "Creator".
Of course, Klein had no objection to Miss Magician's request. He manipulated "The World" and said: "No problem."
He thought it would be difficult to complete the transaction just now, but he didn't expect that this transaction, although a bit tortuous, was finally completed.
In fact, Klein originally planned to sell this magical item to "Justice" or "Hermit", but these two ladies didn't seem very interested.
What he didn't expect was that the final buyer was Miss Magician, who usually spoke very little!
After the transaction, Cattelya couldn't help but guess with a frown: Judging from Miss Magician's accent, it's a bit of Backlund accent. Why would she use gold lire as the settlement currency? Could it be that she grew up in Backlund, but was recently sent to the Fenebpotter Kingdom by her family?
In Cattelya's opinion, this Miss Magician was becoming more and more mysterious!
Emlyn exclaimed: Miss Magician, who usually looks very low-key, is very rich! Although she said she was going back to raise pounds, if it was settled in gold lire, the transaction might have been completed immediately!
After the transaction was completed, "The World" spoke again: "I have a 'Book of Secrets', which is a book on mysticism by 'Shaman King' Klarman of the Southern Continent, suitable for 'Mid Sequence' Beyonders with a good foundation.
"Price, 1000 gold pounds!"
The life of a rich man has put a lot of financial pressure on Mr. Fool. Now he spends about 10 pounds as soon as he opens his eyes every day, and this is just the servants' salary, not counting other expenses.
Audrey smiled and said, "This is exactly what I want."
Fors was also very interested: "I also hope to get it!"
This made Klein couldn't help but sigh: The ladies of the Tarot Club are generally richer than the men! "The Moon" Emlyn also seemed very interested, but had a "I have no money" expression. As for "The Hanged Man", who had just had a big expense last week, he probably couldn't buy anything recently.
Audrey said to "Magician" Fors: "Why don't we crowdfund it? 500 pounds each, you read it for a few days, and I read it for a few days."
"The World" said: "You can get the whole 'Book of Secrets' by praying to Mr. Fool, and you can browse it in your mind!"
Audrey praised: "That's great!"
This suddenly reminded Hobert of a scene: In the elementary school classroom, an elementary school student opened the textbook, held a handful of air and pressed it on his forehead, as if this process could stuff the knowledge in the textbook into his little head!
Mr. Fool's ability made that child's wish come true.

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 542 The Protagonist of This Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Klein, manipulating "The World," reminded them: "I must remind you, never pray to 'Primordial Moon,' as it will turn you into writhing masses of flesh that mate crazily with different creatures, giving birth to all sorts of children. Of course, you must not pray to other hidden existences either, as that is equally dangerous."
Fors was somewhat frightened by this, and Audrey immediately stated firmly: "When holding secret rituals, I only pray to Mr. Fool!"
And 'The Creator'! Fors added in her heart, then smiled wryly. In the orthodox churches, both of these deities seemed to be 'hidden existences,' or simply evil gods.
Then, "The World" initiated the third transaction: "I also have a 'Interrogator' Beyonder characteristic here, for only 1200 pounds."
This was the Beyonder characteristic obtained during the 'Judgment' against Capim. Fearing being targeted by the royal family, he had never sold it. Now, he was clearing out all his inventory!
"I'll take it!" The one buying this Beyonder characteristic was still Fors. She knew that Xio had already advanced to 'Interrogator,' and she also knew how popular Beyonder characteristics of this pathway were in Feynapotter.
Buying it today meant she could sell it tomorrow at a high price of 5000 gold lire, which was roughly 4000 pounds, but only in private transactions.
Hobert withdrew his hand halfway. From now on, he wouldn't need to take action to acquire magical items and Beyonder characteristics at the Tarot Gathering.
The other members once again looked at Miss "Magician" with new eyes. At this Tarot Gathering, she had already spent around 7000 pounds!
Audrey sighed: Is being a lord's wife so profitable? Isn't she afraid of spending all of Hobert's wealth?
Even for her, 7000 pounds was not a small sum. If she relied on writing books, she didn't know how long it would take to earn that much money!
Even "The Sun" suspected: Has Miss Magician found a new source of income recently?
Emlyn finally realized: Could it be that I am the poorest person in the Tarot Gathering? No, I must quickly win the competition, so I can get many rewards! And I also need to work hard to earn money and become a noble viscount as soon as possible!
So he asked "The Magician": "Is there any new information on the previous commission?"
Fors was slightly stunned because a few days ago, Hobert had just unified the entire South Colson area, and all the expenses for various supplies required her approval before Philip would allocate the money.
Also, the auction the day before yesterday had made the private transactions through the auction house boom. She had been so busy these past two days that she had forgotten about this matter.
"I'll give you an answer by tonight at the latest." Fors needed to ask Xio if she had obtained any new clues.
Then, she noticed that everyone was looking at her strangely. Only then did she belatedly realize that she had been quite active in the transaction part of this gathering!
Previously, she had always watched other members being active at the Tarot Gathering, but now she suddenly had the feeling of becoming the protagonist of this gathering, which made her a little embarrassed.
Emlyn nodded and said to "The Sun": "I have the Elder Tree root crystal and auxiliary Ingredients you wanted. They cost me a total of 2000 pounds, plus my reward of 200 pounds, for a total of 2200 pounds."
Derrick said: "I'll give you the monster list. See if there are any materials you need. Well, but I may have to go back to City of Silver before I can pay you for all the materials. Because I'm still in Afternoon Town, still building the camp, I may not have enough time to hunt monsters."
Emlyn was a little embarrassed: "Is that so!"
He had spent all his money to buy these materials. If he couldn't recoup his costs quickly, he might even be in danger of going bankrupt.
Hobert smiled and said: "How about this, let's have a three-way transaction. 'The Sun' will pay me 8 Sequence 8 main ingredients, and I'll help you pay this amount!"
Emlyn's eyes lit up: "I have no objections!"
"The Sun" also happily said: "Thank you, Mr. Emperor."
"To show my gratitude, I will pay you 9 ingredients!"
Thanks to his efforts, the Sequence 8 main ingredients that were originally gathering dust in the City of Silver's warehouse now required twice the previous merit points to exchange for.
If this continued, exchanging for Sequence 8-level main ingredients would not be as cost-effective as exchanging for some rarely used Sequence 7-level main ingredients.
Hobert then said to Emlyn: "I obtained a 'Scarlet Scholar' Beyonder characteristic last week, which is the Beyonder characteristic corresponding to your Sanguine viscount. Are you willing to make a deal with me?"
Too willing! Emlyn was happy at first, but in the next second, he quickly became disappointed: "I don't have enough money right now."
"We can trade in other ways." Hobert smiled and said: "You seem to be in Backlund, right?"
Emlyn nodded: "Yes."
There was nothing to hide about that.
"How about I give you some tasks to perform in Backlund to offset the debt?" Hobert smiled and said: "If you digest the potion in advance, I can give you the Beyonder characteristic in advance."
"Advance first, then continue to repay the debt."
Emlyn really wanted to agree, because his experience in making potions for many years had already allowed him to digest most of the "Potions Professor" Beyonder characteristic. If all went well, he would be able to completely digest the potion by the second half of the year.
After hesitating again and again, he said: "The tasks you give me must not involve betraying the Tarot Gathering or the Sanguine!"
Everyone nodded in satisfaction at Mr. "Moon's" awareness of putting loyalty to the Tarot Gathering first.
"Don't worry about that." Hobert smiled and said: "It's likely to be tasks dealing with the 'Rose School' or the Aurora Order, or even tasks dealing with the followers of 'Primordial Moon.'"
"I won't even make you do anything that betrays the Church of the Earth Mother."
Emlyn smiled unnaturally: "That's not something I care about too much."
Audrey smiled slightly: Mr. Moon's lie is too clumsy!
The other members couldn't help but smile: Mr. Moon almost had the word "cares" written on his face.
Hobert then said: "For the sake of fairness, how about we still use pounds to measure this transaction?"
He said: "I'm asking for 8000 pounds for this Sequence 5 Beyonder characteristic of 'Scarlet Scholar,' and you can pay this amount in the form of several tasks. We can discuss how much each task is worth at that time."
Emlyn nodded and said: "Your offer is very fair."
Because it was paid in the form of tasks, as long as the "Emperor's" asking price was not too excessive, he would not have any objections.
"Then, let's confirm this transaction under the witness of The Fool."
"Okay!"
After completing this transaction, Hobert immediately said to Klein at the head of the bronze table: "Mr. Fool, I request a private conversation with Miss Justice."
Audrey was slightly stunned: What does Hobert want to talk to me about? We're going to meet at the ball tonight! Can't whatever it is wait until tonight?
After establishing the environment for a private conversation, Hobert asked Audrey: "Do you still want a magical item that can change appearance?"
Yesterday, Hobert gave both of the "Faceless" Beyonder characteristics in his hand to Winston. With that old man's craftsmanship, the magical items he creates wouldn't be bad.
Magical items that can change appearance are also very rare, at least they are rarely seen on the market.
Audrey asked happily: "Do you have any relevant news?"
"I recently met a very skilled 'Artisan'." Hobert said: "You should still remember that I acquired a Beyonder characteristic from 'The World' that can change people's appearance."
"Of course I remember!" Audrey asked: "How much money will this magical item cost after it's made?"
"5000 pounds!"
"That's too cheap!" Audrey exclaimed, then she said: "Hobert, you don't have to do this. I'm not short of money right now."
Moreover, this magical item can be reimbursed by Earl Hall.
Hobert smiled and said: "Of course I know you're not short of money, but as old friends, some care is still necessary."
He paused and then said: "Also, after I advanced to a demigod, I suddenly found that the pounds that used to bother me were not too difficult to obtain."
"Or rather, at this stage, pounds are no longer that important to me."
"Well, you can think of my discount as an investment, an investment in the members of the Tarot Gathering."
"The Fool" sitting at the head of the table opened his mouth: Really? Can you get pounds relatively easily after becoming a demigod? Then I have to advance quickly too!
Audrey nodded slowly: "Alright then!"
She was already prepared to have Earl Hall reimburse her for 8000 pounds. Of course, the extra 3000 pounds would continue to be invested in making herself stronger.
"I considered it before attending the Tarot Gathering." Hobert said: "Although we will meet often during the subsequent social season, it is still more discreet to trade these magical items through The Fool."
Audrey said: "I think so too."
"Then, I'll see you tonight!"
"See you tonight."
Klein, sitting at the head of the bronze table, sighed in his heart: The social season of the nobles, ah, I heard that the entire month of April is the busiest time for the nobles of Loen. However, my new identity, Dwayne Dantès, will not be too affected, because this identity cannot currently come into contact with such high-end circles at all.
After the private conversation ended, they entered the free exchange session.
Alger turned his head and asked "The Sun" beside him: "Are you still in Afternoon Town?"
"Yes, but I'm about to return to City of Silver. The new exploration team has already arrived." Derrick also proactively mentioned, "I've already told the Chief that I obtained the 'Justiciar' potion formula while clearing out the monsters in Afternoon Town."
Alger gently nodded. "What was his attitude?"
"He only said, 'Very good.'"
Alger chuckled. "Your Chief is very happy to see you grow. In comparison, he's probably more worried about that 'Shepherd' elder."
He didn't continue that topic, instead throwing another piece of news to all the members: "I just heard that adventurer Gehrman Sparrow is wanted by the Storm Church with a bounty of up to 50,000 pounds!"
As he spoke, he intentionally or unintentionally looked towards "The World" at the end of the long table.
"The Hermit" Cattleya simply glanced at "The World": Did this guy go assassinate "Sea King" Jahn Kottman? Otherwise, how could he suddenly become a wanted criminal of the "Pirate Admiral" level?
Hobert stroked his chin: Is this guy's head worth so much now?
"The World" hoarsely chuckled twice: "The Storm Church is really generous. Even I'm tempted."
"The Moon" Emlyn crossed his arms and also exclaimed, "The great adventurer of the Berserk Sea! His news has been frequently published in the newspapers in recent months. To be honest, I really want to meet this guy."
Hobert, Alger, Cattleya, and Klein, who was hiding behind the gray fog, all looked at this… no, this Sanguine, not knowing what to say for a moment.
Audrey, however, had already noticed through the expressions of the other members: Could "The World" be Gehrman Sparrow?
Then she smiled: If that's really the case, Mr. Moon, your wish has come true!
After a few seconds of eerie silence in the hall, Alger cleared his throat and said again: "According to internal information from the Storm Church, this Gehrman Sparrow is very likely a favored of the 'Creator'."
Audrey, Fors, and the others all looked at "The Emperor," while Alger kept his eyes fixed on "The World."
Unfortunately, "The World" didn't seem to have any reaction. At least Alger didn't get any useful information. He looked at "The Emperor" with some disappointment.
Seeing that "The World" had no intention of explaining, Hobert smiled and said: "I also just got the news that last Monday night, Gehrman Sparrow disrupted a conspiracy of the 'Rose School,' and was therefore targeted by a demigod of the 'Rose School.'
"Because Gehrman was very clear about the 'Creator's' determination to strike at the 'Rose School,' he reported this matter to the 'Creator.'"
Klein, sitting at the head of the bronze long table, was very satisfied with "The Emperor's" wording: Gehrman "was very clear about the 'Creator's' determination to strike at the 'Rose School'" rather than Gehrman was very clear about the conflict between the "Creator" and the "Rose School"!
The former is a kind reminder, while the latter becomes Gehrman's request for help!
It's not to say that Gehrman can't ask the "Creator" for help, but that would be very unreasonable. After all, in Alger and Cattleya's eyes, Gehrman is a favored of "The Fool." Why would he ask another god for help when he encounters danger?
Alger listened very carefully because he knew that since "The World" didn't offer any refutation, then what "The Emperor" said was definitely firsthand information about this matter!
Then he thought: Mr. Fool and the "Creator" have a very close relationship. Then Gehrman may not really be a favored of the "Creator." It is very likely that this is another cooperation between the two gods, and Gehrman only played a role in it!
To be honest, he was quite surprised when he heard from the Church that Gehrman was a favored of the "Creator." After all, he had judged long ago that Gehrman was "The World," and "The World" was a favored of Mr. Fool.
Because it happened at sea, Cattleya also listened particularly carefully. She always felt that news about the "Creator" had appeared too frequently in the Berserk Sea recently! Last week, the "Creator's" favored "Emperor" just hunted down the "Twilight Hermit," and this week there seems to be news about the "Creator" again?
Fors didn't expect that the "Creator" wouldn't have also attacked the "Rose School" at sea last week, right? If that's really the case, the "Creator's" efforts to strike at evil cultists are even greater than the orthodox churches! Well, speaking of which, I actually participated in the action against the Aurora Order. To be honest, it feels pretty good to strike at evil organizations. Although I didn't contribute much to it, it still made me feel comfortable.
The other members, after hearing about the "Creator" and the "Rose School," also knew that something big must have happened in the Berserk Sea last week, so they all stared at "The Emperor," listening to him continue.
"For this reason, the 'Creator' ordered the favored in Bayam to use this as a clue to launch a series of attacks against the 'Rose School.'" Hobert said this to cover up the hunting of "Admiral of Blood."
Although the hunting of "Admiral of Blood" had always been in his plan, he hunted down "Twilight Hermit," and then went to hunt down "Admiral of Blood," making it seem as if the "Creator" only had one favored.
Hobert continued: "I also heard that the 'Creator' personally covered Gehrman's departure from Bayam. Because I didn't participate in this action, I only know a rough idea."
Audrey asked curiously: "Then is Gehrman a favored of the 'Creator'?"
She had just guessed that Gehrman might be a favored of Mr. Fool, but "The Hanged Man" said that he was a favored of the "Creator." Whose favored is he? It's all making her confused.
Hobert smiled, pretending to glance at "The World" before saying: "How should I put it, he is, but he isn't.
"I think that he reported the matter about the 'Rose School' to the 'Creator' only out of a 'communication link' duty."
Everyone carefully savored the phrase "communication link."
Alger immediately had a mature guess: Gehrman must be the communication link between "The Fool" and the "Creator"! Then Gehrman's report to the "Creator" was likely instructed by Mr. Fool!
Audrey also had a similar guess, and she also thought: Then the attack on the "Rose School" in the Berserk Sea should be another cooperation between the two gods! Ha, this is judgment from justice!
Cattleya realized: Does there seem to be a deep level of cooperation between the "Creator" and "The Fool"? Gehrman is the "communication link" between the two gods, so he is not only a favored of Mr. Fool, but also has many cooperative matters for which he is responsible for reporting to the "Creator." In addition, "The Emperor" should play a similar role as Gehrman.
Emlyn opened his mouth slightly: What does "The Emperor" mean? Is it or isn't it? What is a "communication link"? Why does this guy talk like those politicians who like to beat around the bush and deserve a beating?
In the short silence in the hall, "The Hanged Man" Alger said again: "I received news that when Gehrman left, a fierce battle broke out between the demigods of both sides?"
Hobert didn't continue to explain, but looked at "The World," the meaning being very clear: You should tell the specific details, I'm not Gehrman's spokesperson!
Klein certainly knew that in a gathering with a favored of the "Creator," it would be too impolite for "The World" to say nothing, so he manipulated "The World" to clear his throat and said: "As far as I know, there was even a battle at the angel level!"
Everyone's eyes immediately turned to "The World" again. Fors sighed in her heart: Angels are clearly so far away from me, but why do I feel that angel-level battles are nothing big? Is it because I've heard too much about them?
Cattleya sat up straight. The two angel-level battles that everyone had discussed before, one occurred in Feynapotter and the other occurred in the Southern Continent, both far away from the Berserk Sea. This time is different, it happened in Bayam!
Emlyn frowned: Why would "The World" know the details of this matter? Who did he hear it from? Does he know Gehrman?
Under everyone's gaze, "The World" continued in a hoarse voice: "Gehrman summoned an angel of the 'Death' pathway, who fought with the angel of the 'Rose School.'
"And the 'Creator' took action and defeated the leader of the 'Rose School,' the 'God of Sin' Suah!"
The reason Klein said this was because he really felt the pressure from the "Creator" at the time, which was stronger than Suah.
Later, Suah didn't chase after him, and the demigods of the "Rose School" didn't find him either, so he naturally thought that it was the "Creator" who defeated Suah, which allowed him to leave so calmly.
The so-called "summoned" angel of the "Death" pathway was also the truth, except that the angel didn't voluntarily get summoned to the battlefield.
Hobert smiled helplessly in his heart: Actually, it was just a temporary block. If the fight continued, it would be exposed.
Audrey immediately thought of the angel of the "Death" pathway who helped her pass the examination of the Psychology Alchemists: Could it be that angel?
"Little Sun" also thought of the angel who helped him solve Amon, but he was a little confused at this time: It sounds like "The Emperor" and "The World" didn't participate in this action, but why does it feel like the two of them participated in the action?
Alger smiled slightly: I am 100% sure that this is definitely another joint action between Mr. Fool and the "Creator"! When targeting the "Rose School," not only were several demigods dispatched, but Mr. Fool also sent an angel of the "Death" pathway to participate in the battle, while the "Creator" simply directly confronted the leader of the "Rose School"!
Cattleya always felt that this battle was very, very close to her, but she found that she couldn't imagine how powerful an angel-level battle would be.
"The World" finally said, "Gehrman said that he is very grateful for the 'Creator's' rescue, which allowed him to get away from the battlefield in an instant."
Hobert nodded slightly, indicating that he would convey this gratitude.
He said in his heart: Actually, there is no need to "convey" it, the "Creator" is listening in front of you!
Alger was a little excited after hearing "The World's" words: The gods took action to help "The World" reach the edge of the battlefield. I wonder what kind of experience that is?
Cattleya then asked, "What was the result of this battle?"
"The World" looked at "The Emperor", and everyone seemed to have discussed it, and looked at "The Emperor" along with "The World's" line of sight.
"A 'Disciple of Silence' from the 'Rose School' and 'Admiral of Blood' were eliminated!" Hobert said.
"What?" Cattleya looked at "The Emperor" in disbelief: "'Admiral of Blood'?"
Then she realized that her reaction seemed to be too strong, so she cleared her throat to relieve the embarrassment before saying: "What I mean is, how did you find the 'Admiral of Blood'?"
She didn't sympathize with the "Admiral of Blood" at all, but felt a lot of pressure. After all, both were "Admirals", and Senor died too suddenly.
You must know, in the past few years, the "Admiral of Blood" has been galloping on the sea, and has never been heard of being fatally attacked.
"We didn't take the initiative to find him." Hobert didn't tell the truth on this detail: "Senor also participated in this operation! At the demigod level battlefield, a Sequence 5 is very fragile."
Although Cattleya was also a Sequence 5, Hobert's words gave her a lot of comfort.
If the "Creator's" believer could easily find a "Pirate Admiral", Cattleya would definitely think that her "Future" was not very safe either.
In fact, Hobert's ability to accurately find "Vice Admiral Dusk" and "Admiral of Blood" one after another was full of chance. Of course, the source of all this was thanks to "Vice Admiral Iceberg's" precise calculations, which allowed Hobert to find one of them not long after their naval battle broke out.
Now Hobert can only find "Vice Admiral Iceberg" through messengers, and he is also powerless to find the location of other "Pirate Admirals".
Alger then asked, as if he knew it already, "Another 'Pirate Admiral' has died?"
His words reminded the others that this was the second "Pirate Admiral" who had died recently, and the news of the "Vice Admiral Dusk" being hunted down had not yet spread throughout the 5 Seas.
Of the previous seven "Pirate Admirals", only five remained. For the Forsaken Sea, this was a huge change, and even meant an imbalance of pirate power in some aspects.
Cattleya then realized: The Fool and the "Creator" seem to be influencing the real world step by step. Now they can change the situation in the 5 Seas, and they may be able to change the situation in the Northern Continent in the future.
Audrey simply thought: These are two extremely vicious "Pirate Admirals"! They should have been killed long ago.
Fors asked curiously: "After a 'Pirate Admiral' dies, will other great pirates become new 'Pirate Admirals'?"
"That's hard to say." Hobert replied, "As far as I know, there is usually a force behind the 'Pirate Admirals', such as the 'Admiral of Blood' representing the 'Rose School's' interests at sea.
"The 'Rose School' may send another Sequence 5 to the sea to play a similar role to the 'Admiral of Blood', but it's just that the captain of the 'Tree of Flesh and Blood' will be changed.
"Other pirates can indeed take the opportunity to compete for the title of 'Pirate Admiral'. For example, after the 'Vice Admiral Hurricane' died, the original 'Disease Maiden' took his place and became the 'Vice Admiral Ailment'.
"But it is also possible that the 'Rose School' will send someone to quickly incorporate the original 'Admiral of Blood's' fleet, and then fight another 'Pirate Admiral', or do something that can spread throughout the Forsaken Sea, then he is likely to become the new 'Pirate Admiral'."
Alger nodded slightly, expressing his approval of "The Emperor's" words.
Cattleya suddenly laughed mockingly, thinking that she was just a chess piece placed in the Forsaken Sea by a major force, but with a lot of autonomy.
"Thank you for your answer, Mr. Emperor." Fors felt that she had a new understanding of "Pirate Admirals".
Audrey finally smiled and concluded: "Then this battle has achieved good results, eliminating a Saint from the other side and destroying their conspiracy!"
She began to imagine that if she got the miraculous item that could change her appearance, and encountered this kind of action again, she could participate in it too!
Audrey very much wanted to further participate in this extraordinary world, especially to experience the extraordinary battle and accumulate some experience, so as not to be at a loss when she encountered this type of battle.
And Hobert was someone she could trust, and she could participate in battles that Hobert also participated in with confidence.
But she suddenly thought that she seemed to lack direct offensive weapons and abilities. The ability of "Psychological Cue" was more inclined to be auxiliary, and "Awe" and "Madness" could not cause heavy damage to the enemy!
While she was thinking wildly, the exchange session continued.
Fors asked "The Sun": "Is the image of the True Creator a giant falling on a huge cross?"
"Little Sun" was slightly stunned: "Yes, Miss Magician, where did you encounter this image?"
"Yes." Fors sat forward: "I'll share my experience from last week, which is related to the Aurora Order and the True Creator."
Sitting in a row, Cattleya leaned over to look at "The Magician", hoping to get more clues about her from her description.
Audrey also sighed: Fors is very active in this Tarot Gathering!
Klein behind the gray fog: "The Emperor" had a fight with the Aurora Order last week?
"Little Sun" straightened up and stared at Miss Magician, wanting to know the situation of the True Creator that this lady encountered in the Northern Continent.
Seeing that everyone was looking at her, Fors took a deep breath and said: "On Saturday night, we were attacked by the Aurora Order..."
Speaking of this, she blushed slightly, because when they were attacked, she and Hobert were naked.
Fortunately, the gray fog concealed the subtle expressions on her face, and she continued: "After a period of fighting, we began to counterattack on Sunday morning, quickly occupied the pier controlled by the Aurora Order, and occupied the church dedicated to the True Creator at dawn..."
"Please wait a moment." Alger interrupted, "You said a church dedicated to the True Creator?"
In the entire Northern and Southern Continents, are there still people who dare to build a church dedicated to the True Creator?
Because Fors did not want to reveal the details, she spoke a little vaguely at the beginning, which made Cattleya even more confused: Why have I never heard of any pier being controlled by the Aurora Order? This, this sounds like the Aurora Order has a fixed base.
Audrey thought: I have heard that there are many evil forces in the Southern Colson area. I didn't expect the Aurora Order to be so arrogant that they dared to openly build a church for the Evil God!
"The place where I am is a bit special." Fors simply introduced: "A small area has been under the rule of the Aurora Order for a long time."
Cattleya couldn't help but ask: "What about the official Beyonders? The official Beyonders actually allow the rule of the Aurora Order?"
"Because of some special reasons, there have been no official Beyonders there for a long time." Fors further explained that Hobert had talked to her about the corruption of Full Moon Lake, but did not tell her the real reason for the corruption.
As soon as this was said, everyone except Audrey, who had already understood, was a little surprised: There is such a place?
Cattleya sighed: The members of the Tarot Gathering are indeed not simple in their identities!
Emlyn was thinking: If our Sanguine went there, would we be able to occupy a territory and establish our power there.
So he asked, "Miss Magician, is it convenient to reveal where exactly you are talking about? Is it also suitable for other forces to seize territory? I can pay to buy this information."
Fors raised her head and smiled: "This information does not need to be bought, because we have unified that area and have established preliminary rule!"
Audrey leaned back in her chair: Fors seems to be very proud of this!
Cattleya reached out and stroked her forehead: I actually have a feeling of being ill-informed. Is this Miss Magician really in the Northern Continent? From what she said, it seems like she is in the Feynapotter Kingdom, but why have I never heard of such a place that can be occupied by extraordinary forces? Could it be that she is in the Southern Continent, in a colony of the Feynapotter Kingdom?
Then she belatedly thought: Is Miss Magician really from the Abraham family? I heard that this family has declined!
Emlyn was a little disappointed: "Okay then."
Fors continued: "In the church of the True Creator, I saw a statue similar to the description of Mr. Sun. The eyes of the statue looked very evil, as if they could move with my gaze!"
"Don't look at the eyes of the statue!" Although Derrick knew that Miss Magician was fine, he still earnestly reminded, "That will make you very easy to lose control, or turn into a mass of wriggling flesh."
"My—, the commander of this operation also reminded me of this." Fors originally said "My husband", but when the words came to her lips, in order to avoid revealing more information, she immediately changed her words.
She said, "In the local area, there are many believers of the True Creator. They seemed to have foreseen something and rushed up to stop us from destroying the church."
"Fortunately, 'The Creator' appeared in time to deter those heretics and destroy the idol of the True Creator."
Klein and Audrey didn't feel much about it, after all, they both knew that "The Magician's" husband was a favored one of "The Creator."
Audrey just thought: "The Creator" is indeed a deity standing on the side of justice, and is even dealing with the Aurora Order.
Klein was thinking: "The Creator" was quite busy last week! Not only did He take action in Bayam to defeat the "Abomination," but He also competed with the True Creator in Feynapotter. Because His actions are so frequent, the protagonist of this Tarot Gathering has become "The Creator!"
The other members were very surprised. Emlyn looked incredulous: Are you kidding me? Miss Magician is also a favored one of "The Creator"? That's not right, there are two favored ones of "The Creator" in the Tarot Club!
Cattelya was completely confused: How did it get involved with "The Creator" again? In this way, Miss Magician is not only mysterious, but also makes it impossible for people to guess any information about her!
Alger sighed: "The Creator" initially only influenced the situation in the Southern Continent, where the orthodox churches' power was relatively weak. Recently, He has gradually begun to influence the situation in the Berserk Sea. Although it is impossible to determine the region where Miss Magician is located, it seems to be the Northern Continent. Does this mean that "The Creator" also has some arrangements in the Northern Continent?
Derrick asked directly: "Miss Magician, is 'The Creator' an enemy of the True Creator?"
"Every normal deity should regard the True Creator as an enemy!" Fors answered.
Audrey noticed the main point Fors wanted to express: "The Creator's" state is very normal!
"Little Sun" then asked "The Emperor" beside him: "Mr. Emperor, can you tell me the honorific name of 'The Creator'?"
Hobert hesitated slightly before saying: "It's possible, but only you can know it, and you can't tell anyone."
Derrick nodded: "I know, it needs to be kept secret, right?"
"Not entirely." Hobert reminded cryptically: "Telling you the honorific name of 'The Creator' is out of help from a fellow Tarot Club member, but I believe that 'The Creator' does not intend to develop believers in City of Silver for the time being."
Cattelya and the others immediately understood what "The Emperor" meant.
Alger even realized: "The Creator" and "The Fool" should have a certain agreement in terms of developing believers, given their alliance.
Klein also breathed a sigh of relief: Fortunately, "The Creator" is not interested in City of Silver.
Derrick also heard the implication of "The Emperor's" words. He immediately stood up in a slightly flustered manner and bowed to the head of the bronze long table: "I'm sorry, Mr. Fool, I don't have any disloyal intentions towards you, it's just... just..."
Strictly speaking, he is not a favored one or believer of "The Fool," but he has received so much help from "The Fool." If he were to spread the honored name of another deity, he would feel like it was a kind of betrayal.
Behind the gray fog, the mysterious Fool chuckled: "I have a favored one who has also asked 'The Creator' for help."
Derrick breathed a sigh of relief: "Thank you for your generosity and tolerance!"
Everyone understood the meaning of Mr. Fool's words. Merely asking "The Creator" for help does not count as betraying Him.
After "Little Sun" sat down, Hobert announced the honored name of "The Creator" and said to Derrick: "As far as I know, 'The Creator' does not have any favored ones in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods,' so I don't know if 'The Creator's' help to you will be delayed."
"Little Sun" said: "Mr. Emperor, no matter what the result is, I must thank you for telling me the honorific name."
Hobert smiled and indicated that it was nothing.
Cattelya said to "The Magician": "I'm sorry, my next question may be a little rude, are you sure 'The Creator' is in good condition?"
"I'm sure!" Fors replied almost immediately: "I have seen the image of 'The Creator,' and the feeling it gives is completely different from that of the True Creator. Just like Mr. Fool, I can't feel any distortion or madness at all."
Cattelya sighed in her heart: How wonderful it would be if the "Hidden Sage's" condition was also so normal!
After that, everyone discussed some of their own experiences, but compared to the experiences of Gehrman and Miss Magician, they themselves felt that their experiences seemed quite boring.
After a brief discussion, this Tarot Gathering ended.
