chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 546: Searching for Amon's Avatar
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert's first thought was: even someone as strong as Amon needs to use humanity to fight divinity!
Amon is inherently unique, and theoretically, the divinity within him must be greater than his humanity.
Perhaps that's why he might need some humanity to maintain balance.
Hobert even felt that Amon's love for pranks might be his way of trying to show his human side.
Merely playing pranks might not be enough; even if he doesn't have emotions, he should 'deceive' himself to generate certain feelings, thereby stimulating his emotions and enlivening his spirituality.
Next, Hobert considered whether to hunt Amon's avatar.
Hobert's first thought was that he didn't want to get involved in this matter. He was currently preparing to accept Jonathan and the members of the Theosophy Order to strengthen his power, and he didn't have time to provoke Amon.
The key is that this matter is difficult to control. Given Amon's arrangements for his avatars, he will eventually find out who hunted his avatar.
Encountering an avatar at Sequence 3 or Sequence 4 would be fine, but the thought of encountering a Sequence 2 avatar coming to capture him is terrifying.
Hobert guessed that the Amon avatar at Tony Manor should be a Sequence 2 because he recalled sensing a gaze from Bayam when he covered Klein's departure from Bayam earlier.
Thinking about it now, the owner of that gaze seemed to be at the level of an angel.
So Hobert was inclined to rescue Rafter and leave Bayam with him.
But then Hobert realized a problem: the Messenger seemed overly enthusiastic about hunting Amon.
In Hobert's memory, the Messenger was someone who always stayed out of things. The key was that she didn't ask for donuts this time, which made Hobert a little uneasy.
But then Hobert figured out the problem: it might be because the Messenger's last name was Tudor!
Regardless of her current state or past experiences, she, or rather She, was an important member of the Tudor family.
Hobert even suspected that She was a close relative of the Blood Emperor; otherwise, She wouldn't have had the opportunity to become an angel in that era.
And precisely because he was a close relative of the Blood Emperor, even if he wanted to seduce Amon, it could be arranged.
Then this issue had to be reconsidered because Hobert realized that this was a good opportunity to subdue the Tudor family.
If he could play a significant role in this event, even if he couldn't completely subdue the Tony family, he could get a lot of support from this family in the future.
So the question now is whether such benefits are worth the risks that will arise.
This made Hobert think of the barrier that the 'Order Crystal' can now form. If he were facing Amon's main body, Hobert would simply surrender. He estimated that the barrier formed by the 'Order Crystal' couldn't stop Amon's main body's abilities.
But an avatar is different. Hobert believed that using the 'Disorder Crystal' was enough to buy himself a few seconds to save himself or call for help.
Although the risk was still not small, it was just like the question Hobert had previously envisioned: there are risks in doing anything!
Some opportunities may never come again if missed, such as helping the Tony family get rid of Amon's control. Helping now can save some people; helping later... it is estimated that the family will be completely lost, and there will be nothing to help with.
Hobert estimated for a while, and finally made up his mind: I'm not even afraid of the Demoness Sect, why would I be afraid of Amon's avatar! Let's do it!
After making up his mind, Hobert returned to the real world and summoned the Messenger again: "It's okay for me to help hunt Amon's avatar, but after this action, you need to fight for me three times."
The Messenger was silent for a few seconds before saying: "If I help you deal with angel-level opponents, I need you to provide me with wooden sticks like your staff. Only with such blessings can I temporarily restore my best state."
Hobert nodded: "No problem, I can give you a 'Order Wood' for this hunt, but remember to return the used 'Order Wood' to me. This needs to be recycled."
Then he asked: "Can the barrier formed by the 'Order Crystal' really completely block the power of Amon's avatar?"
This is very important.
"Yes." The Messenger said firmly: "Amon's avatar's divinity is not very strong, so the avatar can't control many authorities! Amon's main body won't give some authorities to his avatar either."
Hobert slowly nodded: That is to say, this is a matter of Sequence. Because the divinity is weak, the avatar's Sequence is low, so there is nothing to do with the power of the "Order Crystal." If you encounter Amon's main body, the Sequence is sufficient, although the "Order Crystal" has the power of a Sefirah, Amon will definitely be able to find loopholes.
After confirming this again, Hobert asked: "How can I notify you of the best time to take action in a short time?"
"We can establish a spiritual contract." The Messenger said: "That way, you only need to recite a spell to summon me to the real world."
If it was when he first met this Messenger, Hobert would never establish such a private contract, because it meant that the Messenger could also find Hobert's location at any time.
But now that he has established basic mutual trust and knows each other well, Hobert is not opposed to such a contract.
So he immediately handwritten a contract, first stipulating that the summoning spell was the ancient Hermes word for "Messenger."
Then he stated that even if he knew Hobert's location, the Messenger could not tell others or other creatures, nor could he harm Hobert or peep at him, and then they signed their names separately.
Still with the spirit world as a witness, when the contract was swallowed by the dark green flames, it meant that the contract began to take effect.
Hobert came to the "Nation of Disorder" again and began to prepare. This time he chose the first-level Sealed Artifacts "1-107" and "1-109". The reason was simple: he was afraid that "1-101" of the "Theft" pathway would suddenly betray him.
Then he spread his spirituality to the star representing Rafter. At the same time, he noticed that when Medici's evil spirit possessed Rafter before, there was a red line on his star, but when Rafter was "parasitized", there was nothing unusual about the star.
Hobert glanced at the real world through the stars. There was a figure wearing a black classical robe, a matching pointed soft hat, black curly hair, black eyes, a wide forehead, and a thin face, with limbs like octopus tentacles wrapped around Rafter.
Seeing that iconic monocle, Hobert was a little hesitant.
Then he realized that this was because his previous impression of Amon was too strong, and he always felt that the monocle was like a nightmare that could not be dispelled.
But thinking about it carefully, compared to existences like the Messenger, Amon's avatar is not scary. Although the ability is a bit weird, it is not invincible.
Amon's avatar seemed to sense something and looked towards the air.
After suppressing his psychological shadow, Hobert temporarily withdrew his spirituality and looked at the fruit-like Sealed Artifact he got from Christian.
Bringing this Sealed Artifact to the real world as well, Hobert prepared the altar and placed a cup of fine sand in front of the altar, and then prayed to the Evernight Goddess: "Evernight Goddess who stands higher than the cosmos, more eternal than eternity…
"Your devout believer begs for your attention;
"I found an Amon avatar that may be at Sequence 2 level and is organizing forces to hunt it down. Please grant me the power of concealment!
"If the hunt is successful, I will offer you six 'Worms of Time'."
After the prayer was finished, the surging sense of tranquility that made people sleepy descended around the altar. Hobert seemed to see twinkling starlight above the altar.
Then a pure darkness descended on the altar, covering the fruit-shaped Sealed Artifact placed in the center of the altar.
A second or two later, the pure darkness disappeared, and Hobert found that the fruit on the altar had grown about three times larger!
Fine sand floated out of the cup and turned into letters on the altar, eventually forming a sentence: Only fifteen minutes of effect.
That's enough!
After Hobert thanked the "Evernight Goddess", the magical starlight flickering above the altar disappeared, and the surging power of tranquility also disappeared.
He picked up the fruit on the altar and named this Sealed Artifact that had been strengthened by the "Evernight Goddess": "Fruit of Concealment."
After making all the preparations, Hobert came to the "Nation of Disorder" again, and then said to Rafter in the image and tone of the "Creator": "Keep praying."
...
Bayam, Tony Manor.
After writing the letter to the "Favored," Rafter rubbed his hands together, eagerly awaiting the arrival of the "Favored." To him, a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact was an extremely precious item. Since he had encountered one, he naturally wanted to find a way to snatch it if circumstances allowed.
Even if he wasn't qualified to use it himself after stealing it, he believed the "Favored" would give him plenty of benefits.
Just half an hour after the letter was sent, his vision was suddenly filled with a tall and solid figure. When he saw the sacred black light, Rafter immediately realized it was the "Creator."
Could it be that this Sealed Artifact had attracted the attention of the "Creator"? Rafter didn't dare to look directly at the "Creator," so he quickly lowered his head. Just as he was about to kneel on one knee, he heard the "Creator's" command.
Although he didn't understand the "Creator's" intention, Rafter immediately obeyed the command and began to pray incessantly to the "Creator."
Soon, Rafter, who was bowing his head in prayer, felt as if a surge of powerful energy was descending upon him. Then, he seemed to sense something tugging at his spirit body.
Rafter didn't waver and continued to pray earnestly. He firmly believed that under the gaze of the "Creator," he would not be in any danger.
A few seconds later, Rafter felt his whole body lighten, as if his spirit body had shed some burden.
This made him realize, had he been possessed again?
Just as he was about to thank the "Creator," Rafter began to cough violently, gasping for breath. Finally, he spat out a worm the size of a thumb.
It had twelve transparent segments on its body, but it was now dead, lying stiffly in Rafter's palm.
Just as Rafter was surprised, a scene suddenly appeared in his mind: That, that's me!
Rafter quickly distinguished that the person in the scene, entangled by a phantom figure, was himself!
Rafter realized: Was I really possessed by an evil spirit again?
Immediately afterward, he saw the phantom figure reaching into the air, which made him immediately realize that his prayer seemed to have established a close connection with the "Creator," and that the figure was grabbing at the "Creator"?
Just then, Rafter saw the "Creator" take action. The figure on his body seemed to suddenly become distorted, and then was dragged down from Rafter's body by a huge force.
The "Creator" reached out again, and the figure seemed to be crushed by a huge force.
Rafter sighed: Fortunately, I completely surrendered to the "Creator" before, otherwise I might have lost myself unknowingly.
This made him sigh again: He really made the right bet in Backlund.
Just then, his spirituality stirred, and he saw the space in front of him become illusory. The "Favored," Hobert, emerged from within: "Give me this worm."
Rafter immediately reacted: "Yes, yes, yes."
Hobert was still wearing a mask and a Feynapotter-style trench coat.
He looked like he hadn't changed much from a few months ago, but Rafter's spirituality could confirm that the "Favored"' temperament had undergone a considerable change.
Rafter waited for the "Favored" to put the worm away before asking respectfully: "Fortunately, I wrote you a letter to report. Was I possessed again just now?"
"No, it was 'parasitized'." Hobert briefly explained, then asked: "Are you sure the Tony family is a branch of the Tudor family?"
"I'm sure!" Rafter said: "When I first came to the manor, I found that I looked very similar to the patriarch of the Tony family. Later, I realized that it was because our appearances were inherited from the great Blood Emperor."
Hobert nodded again: "Take me to see the patriarch of the Tony family."
He paused and added: "This manor is very dangerous now. Don't leave my side."
"Yes, yes, yes." Rafter quickly moved a few steps closer, then he thought: "But now outside, the outside is shrouded in the power of the Sealed Artifact."
"Just follow me closely." Hobert strode out in front.
Rafter quickly followed. He was still very nervous until he reached the gate, but the "Favored" in front had already stepped out and stretched out a hand. A huge "distorted" force caused the power that wanted to steal their thoughts to ignore the existence of the two people.
Because Rafter was a "Briber," he could clearly feel that the power the "Favored" had just displayed was indeed the power of "Distortion."
He didn't expect that the problem that had plagued him for two or three months would be easily solved by the "Favored."
Under the light of the gas lamps, the huge manor looked very magnificent, but because there was no one there, the magnificence carried a hint of eeriness.
Hobert glanced at the gas lamp. In the firelight, there seemed to be a pair of eyes staring at him, the person who had broken the rules of the manor.
He looked away from the gas lamp and walked ahead, asking: "Is the Tony family mainly composed of Beyonders from the 'Lawyer' pathway or the 'Arbiter' pathway?"
"As far as I know, it's the 'Hunter' pathway and the 'Lawyer' pathway."
"'Hunter' pathway?" This made Hobert slightly stunned.
"That's right."
Hobert immediately thought that Blood Emperor Tudor had served as a "Red Priest" for a period of time, and many Beyonder characteristics of the "Hunter" pathway must have approached Him.
It was normal for the Tudor family to accumulate a certain amount of "Hunter" pathway Beyonder characteristics.
Rafter added: "However, they also have Beyonders from another pathway. Perhaps because of my lack of knowledge, I can't distinguish what pathway those Beyonders belong to."
Hobert used another "Disorder" towards the front to continue to make the perception of that Sealed Artifact malfunction: "Describe their abilities in detail."
Rafter described: "Some of them are very insidious and can always make people fall into their traps unconsciously."
Hobert nodded: "Maybe they are Conspirers."
This also made sense. At that time, Amon had supported Tudor in becoming the Blood Emperor, and the messenger lying in the coffin had also flirted with Amon. The Tudor family did indeed have a high probability of obtaining a portion of the Beyonder characteristics of the "Marauder" pathway.
Moreover, the Solomon Empire, the opponent of the Tudor Empire, also had a great noble from the "Marauder" pathway, and it was also possible to obtain a portion of the Beyonder characteristics of the "Marauder" pathway in battle.
Rafter continued to describe: "Some of them can bewitch enemies into becoming their teammates."
Hobert was stunned: "'Spectator' pathway?"
"They can even make close teammates turn against each other."
Hobert slowly nodded: "Sounds like the ability of the 'Spectator' pathway!"
Could this be some of the Beyonder characteristics obtained from Adam back then? Then the Beyonder pathways of this Tony family are very complicated!
"Some seem to use a certain desire of the target to make the opponent crazy and obedient to his orders."
Hobert was stunned: What pathway does this Beyonder seem like? "Criminal"? "Mystery Pryer"? "Spectator"? It doesn't seem very fitting.
At this time, Hobert suddenly stopped and looked at the wall in front: "Your reaction is too slow."
In the faint moonlight, a figure was outlined on the wall: "This Sealed Artifact was not originally intended to deal with demigods."
Hobert guessed that the other party should be a "Earl of the Fallen." At the same time, he realized that the other party had just used "Tampering" with the light to hide his tracks.
Although this method cannot achieve the effect of invisibility, it can basically hide oneself or produce illusions in places where the visibility is not very good.
The figure on the wall said: "You can completely visit the Tony Manor during the day."
He did not feel Hobert's malice.
"Originally, I planned to leave after rescuing my people," Hobert said: "But someone asked me to come and see if you can still be saved."
The person on the wall looked at Hobert for a few seconds without speaking. At this time, Rafter took the opportunity to say: "This is Master Tony, the patriarch of the Tony family."
Master Tony, who had scarlet hair, a mustache, and black pupils, said: "Come with me."
If Hobert was a Sequence 5, then this Master Tony would not care whether he was entrusted by someone or not, and would have rushed up to capture him.
But when a demigod says that he is entrusted by someone, Master Tony has to take it seriously.
Hobert and Rafter jumped onto the courtyard wall and followed Master Tony to a large courtyard.
This courtyard looked magnificent, but the arrangement of trees and buildings made people feel a little uncomfortable, as if it was arranged to be contrary to common sense.
Rafter quickly recognized that this was Master Tony's courtyard, and he had been here when he joined the job.
When they arrived at the hall, although it was brightly lit, there were no servants.
This Master Tony in his forties introduced himself: "Osment."
Hobert also briefly introduced himself: "Jeffrey."
Osment gestured, "Please sit," and said, "So, Mr. Jeffrey, who commissioned you, and where do we need rescuing from?"
Hobert did not sit down but looked at Osment: "Have you heard of Amon?"
Osment was visibly surprised. He looked around, and only after confirming that there were no servants nearby did he say, "Saying it so openly will alert the other party!"
His reaction didn't mean he knew Amon very well. He had only heard that Amon was a 'High Sequence' Beyonder of the 'Marauder' pathway, and he didn't know how powerful Amon was specifically, nor did he know all of Amon's abilities.
Osment was surprised because he heard Hobert say Amon's name. He combined this "High Sequence Beyonder of the 'Marauder' pathway" with his previous guesses and felt that what Hobert said should be very close to the truth.
Hobert smiled and said, "You've already noticed something, haven't you?"
"Of course!" Osment took two steps forward and whispered, "Many family members and servants have become a little strange. Only a fool wouldn't know they have a problem."
This was also why Hobert directly looked for the person in charge of the manor. The difficulty of "parasitizing" a demigod and "parasitizing" Beyonders below demigod level were completely different.
If a demigod was "parasitized" by a "Worm of Time," although he would forget the process of being "parasitized," the constant warning of his spirituality would definitely make him act strangely.
So Hobert judged that this Master Tony either had noticed that the people around him were strange, or he could distinguish whether he was "parasitized," or whether he had been replaced by Amon's avatar. In short, as long as he found him, either they would fight, or they would have an extra helper.
Rafter, who was behind them, didn't quite understand the content of their conversation: Wasn't the biggest problem of the Tony Manor the worship of evil gods? Why did it sound like there was an even more serious problem?
Hobert tightly gripped his cane, carefully observing Osment: "The other party should have noticed."
He pointed to the person behind him: "The problem of him being 'parasitized' has been solved. This process will definitely make the other party aware of something wrong."
Osment was slightly stunned: "You can solve the problem of being 'parasitized'?"
Hobert deliberately spoke vaguely: "It's not me who solved the problem."
Osment re-examined the young man wearing the mask: "May I ask, who entrusted you to help us?"
Hobert smiled and said, "I can only tell you that person's surname is Tudor."
Rafter behind him was stunned: I didn't make such a request. Could it be, could it be another family member?
Osment's trust in Hobert immediately increased a lot: "Can the two of us working together solve this problem?"
Hobert felt that Osment should be fine, because if he was "parasitized" or he was Amon's avatar, he wouldn't say such stupid things.
"I brought strong reinforcements." Hobert said, "How many demigods are there in the Tony family?"
"There are currently two in the manor," Osment replied. Of course, this kind of key information had to be told truthfully.
Hobert basically ruled out Osment's suspicion: "Please wait a moment."
Only after initially ruling out suspicion would he do the final confirmation, in case Amon's avatar suddenly launched an attack when entering the "Nation of Disorder."
He then sat down, placing himself within the black barrier of the "Order Crystal," and then lowered his head as if in prayer.
Osment took a step back, carefully observing every move of this "Mr. Jeffrey."
Rafter guessed that the "Favored" should be praying to the "Creator."
Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" and used "True Vision" to confirm that Osment was indeed not an Amon avatar, nor had he been "parasitized," before returning to the real world and dispelling the protection of the "Barrier": "Please take me to see the other demigod."
"Alright," Osment said, "This way, please."
They went out through the side door of the courtyard. Osment, who was leading the way, asked, "If the other party notices our actions, wouldn't we be very passive?"
"To be honest," Hobert said, "I really hope the other party will take the initiative to attack. He's an expert at playing hide-and-seek!"
If the other party sensed danger and left on their own initiative, that would truly be the "Fool" watching from above, saving them the risky move.
Hobert estimated that Amon's avatar should still be watching, so he wouldn't act rashly for the time being.
Because it was the "Creator" who killed the "Worm of Time" in Rafter's body just now, with the cover of the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert estimated that the other party didn't get too much information about him at all.
Nor would he call more of his avatars over. It was simple, there might be danger here. Would he call other avatars over to be a burden when he escaped? Or to make the enemy's spoils of war richer?
Just as he went out the door, Hobert looked at the gas lamp again. This time his feeling was more real. There seemed to be a pair of eyes really looking at him from inside the gas lamp.
Whoosh~
Suddenly, the flame of the gas lamp became intense.
Bang~
The glass of the gas lamp shattered, and the flame "flowed out" of the lamp, forming a human figure.
This change made the three of them slightly stunned. Then Osment knelt on one knee: "Your Highness Raymond, I didn't expect that the events in the manor would also disturb you?"
Rafter took a step back in surprise.
Hobert immediately realized that this "Fire Man," who was called "His Highness Raymond," was likely an angel in poor condition.
In a previous chat with Angus, Hobert had heard Angus say that, according to the elders of the Tudor family, there was still an angel who had survived.
At first, Hobert thought they were talking about the Messenger, until he saw this "Fire Man" he realized that the Messenger "lived" in a coffin, and he didn't know if he had died once before.
If he had died once in front of the world, the Messenger would not be passed down by word of mouth.
In addition, Osment kneeling and calling him "Your Highness" indirectly proved Hobert's guess.
This "His Highness Raymond," whose appearance and characteristics could not be seen clearly, with a face composed of flames, said to Hobert: "I sensed Beverly's aura on you. Has she, has she been resurrected?"
Hobert's exclusive Messenger was named Beverly Heather Tudor.
Hobert said, "According to my observation, no."
"I witnessed the entire process of her death and was very grieved to bury her." The not-very-three-dimensional facial features composed of flames made a happy expression: "She didn't die, that's just great!"
"I can't explain her state either," Hobert explained. "She is now more like a spirit world creature."
"This may be the way Amon said to help Beverly deceive death." Raymond said, "Beverly had said long ago that angels are very fragile in the 'War of the Four Emperors'.
"So she had been preparing in advance. After her death, the Beyonder characteristics have not been extracted. I should have thought that this must be some of her preparation that worked."
Hobert listened quietly, hoping that Raymond would say more about the details of what happened back then.
Through Raymond's words just now, Hobert felt that the relationship between Amon and Beverly was not just a matter of bedfellows. At least Amon, who was very bastard in the eyes of others, had also helped Beverly deceive death.
It was just that Raymond didn't continue that topic but asked Hobert, "Have you found Amon's avatar?"
Hobert was stunned: "You know that the manor has been invaded by Amon's avatar?"
"Of course, I know," Raymond said. "It's just that my condition is not very good, and I'm not sure I can drive that avatar away."
He said, "But if Beverly helps, we can try to hunt this avatar."
Hobert smiled: You also want to hunt Amon's avatar? Hehe, from this point, it can be seen that you and the Messenger are a family.
He asked, "Do you know where Amon's avatar is?"
"I don't know. He should have stolen someone's fate and disguised himself as a member of the clan," Raymond said. "Unless I meet him face to face, it's difficult for me to distinguish him."
Hobert said, "Then we are responsible for finding him, and you also join the hunt, how about that? But when dividing the spoils, you have to be ranked behind Beverly."
"No problem."
"In addition, as the initiator of this hunt, I have actually done your family a great favor. When necessary, I need you to repay this favor."
"No problem either, but the premise is that it's something I can do."
"Of course," Hobert smiled.
The hunt hadn't even started yet, and he felt he had already made a profit.
Hobert asked again, "How should I notify you in time of the location of Amon's avatar?"
Raymond said, "As long as it's within the manor, as long as there is a battle, I will know."
Whoosh~
The flames suddenly exploded, and the "fire man" in front of them disappeared, leaving only a damaged gas lamp.
Osment took a deep look at Hobert. He felt that this young man must have a great background, as even the notoriously grumpy Prince Raymond seemed very polite to him.
Hobert said, "Let's continue."
Soon, Osment led them to a secluded courtyard: "Mr. Valentine lives inside. He doesn't like socializing and rarely goes out. He has been secretly protecting Tony Manor."
What he didn't explain was that this Mr. Valentine was the one who stood out in the colonial battles more than a hundred years ago and became the first governor of the Rorsted Archipelago of the Loen Kingdom.
Hobert said to Rafter, "If a battle breaks out later, close your eyes immediately and pray!"
Rafter nodded seriously.
Hobert then asked Osment, "What sequence is Mr. Valentine?"
"Sequence 3."
Osment knocked on the door and asked, "Mr. Valentine?"
"Please come in."
The door opened, revealing a small reception room. A gas lamp illuminated everything in the reception room. A short old man, wearing simple robes, stood on the inner side.
He looked very kind and smiled at Hobert, "Child, has anyone told you about the special nature of your destiny?"
Hobert was stunned. He originally thought this was a "Frenzied Mage" or a "War Bishop." Why was he reading his fortune right away? It felt like the intention of a demigod from the "Monster" pathway or the "Seer" pathway?
The other party continued, "Two people have manipulated your destiny, one of whom is very vague, but I can basically tell who it is. However, I can't see the other one at all."
Hobert, who had been holding his cane tightly, was slightly taken aback: "Who is the very vague one?"
"I can't tell you," Valentine said. "Telling you in advance wouldn't be good for you."
Osment briefly explained the current predicament facing Tony Manor. Valentine pondered for a moment and said, "I suggest that we first investigate under the cover of night to see if we can find more people who have been 'parasitized'."
He smiled and said, "This might make the other party show himself, so we can go and besiege him."
Hobert corrected, "It might also be Him."
Valentine frowned: "If it really is Him, why is He still hiding?"
Osment said, "Maybe... maybe He finds it fun, I mean, watching us fail to find Him is fun for Him."
Originally, he wanted to say, "Maybe it's because Prince Raymond and this Mr. Jeffery can bring in strong reinforcements, so He hasn't taken action." But he suddenly realized, was Mr. Valentine trustworthy?
So Osment paused slightly before finding another reason.
Valentine asked, "Do you have any plans for this?"
Hobert replied, "Originally, I thought that if I walked around the manor, the other party would show himself.
"I have a Sealed Artifact that can protect my safety for a dozen seconds. Using these dozen seconds, I will try my best to negotiate with the other party.
"At the level of the other party, they wouldn't be coming for Tony Manor's assets, nor would they be coming for the Tony family's Beyonders. He might be coming for the Sealed Artifact that protects the manor.
"At worst, we can give him that Sealed Artifact, and that will resolve this dispute."
Valentine nodded: "This plan is good."
"Then," Hobert took a step back and smiled: "Hello, Mr. Amon."
Osment and Rafter were both stunned. They unconsciously retreated behind Hobert.
Valentine's smile did not diminish at all: "How did you guess?"
"Actually, this was originally a multiple-choice question," Hobert said. "Since you want to steal fate, why not just steal the fate of a demigod? This way, it will be more convenient for you to move around in the manor.
"After confirming that Mr. Osment was not the problem, I basically concluded that it was likely that the other demigod had a problem.
"But I heard that Mr. Amon is good at deception, and he is also very likely to have stolen the fate of someone in the manor other than the two demigods in order to deceive, so I designed the question just now.
"When you heard it was 'Him,' your reaction was too big. Even Mr. Osment knows that Amon is a 'High-Sequence' Beyonder, how could you not know?"
Hobert smiled and said, "To avoid misjudgment, I designed the so-called plan to deal with Amon's avatar.
"There is a huge loophole in this. The enemy has sneaked into the manor so silently for so long. If it was for a Sealed Artifact, they would have snatched the Sealed Artifact and left long ago.
"But you still said 'the plan is good,' because you don't care about these things at all.
"Someone who has been secretly protecting Tony Manor for a long time is actually indifferent to the plan to deal with the enemy. This is obviously unreasonable.
"So, Mr. Amon, did you forget to steal Mr. Valentine's memory?"
Valentine, or rather Amon, clapped his hands: "You are a qualified 'Lawyer'!"
Osment asked, "What did you do to Mr. Valentine?"
"Of course, I completely replaced his fate."
Osment couldn't be sure whether Valentine was dead or in a strange state.
Hobert then asked, "Did you come to Tony Manor for that Sealed Artifact? If that's really the case, please take it and leave."
"Valentine" showed a kind smile and said in the tone that Valentine liked to use: "Child, your probing is too superficial.
"At first, I was indeed attracted by the Sealed Artifact, but soon I thought that I could use Tony, a non-Tudor family member, to test the state of a hidden existence."
Hobert was slightly taken aback: "Did you let the young people of the Tony family believe in evil gods?"
"Yes, but now the game is over," Amon's avatar said. "I'm not a person who likes to take risks. I can feel the special nature of your body. You can leave. I won't make things difficult for you!"
"Thank you for your magnanimity," Hobert said, injecting spirituality and the power of the "Nation of Disorder" into the "Crystal of Order." The "barrier" instantly stood in front of the three people.
Clang ~
Amon's avatar's "theft" was blocked by the barrier.
Hobert thought to himself: I totally believe you! How could you let us go!
"Messenger!" He immediately chanted the ancient Hermes word, and Beverly's coffin broke through the void and appeared in front of them.
Seeing that his ability was blocked and a coffin appeared, Amon's avatar cautiously did not continue to attack Hobert, but grabbed towards the coffin and began a tentative attack, only to grab out a half-eaten donut.
Hobert had already dragged the blindfolded Rafter out of the door under the cover of the barrier.
He quickly took out the "Concealment Fruit" and threw it into the air. Under the faint moonlight, a dark and shiny flower bloomed, and a phantom shadow appeared in the entire Tony Manor.
These phantom shadows appeared in the real world, replacing the real Tony Manor, while the real Tony Manor entered a hidden space.
The moment this hidden space formed, a burst of fire burst out from the ground, heading straight for the courtyard where Amon's avatar was located.
Hobert was very clear that he had to quickly get away from the battlefield and then participate in the battle through his identity as the "Creator."
He didn't release the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" and the "Holy Infant King" because Amon's abilities had a certain restraint on them, which could easily cause their summoning time to end early.
A dozen seconds passed, the barrier disappeared, and Hobert felt that he had run far enough, so he put down Rafter in his hand and looked back at the battlefield that was already very intense.
Just as he was about to enter the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert felt something and looked at the roof over there.
At some point, there were two Amon's avatars standing and sitting there. One of them pinched his monocle and said, "Didn't anyone tell you that Amon's avatars never act alone?"

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 547: Hunting Amon's Avatar
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
As Hobert fled the battlefield, the messenger's coffin stood upright.
Crack~
The coffin lid separated from the coffin.
Amon's avatar reached out, wanting to steal the thoughts of the being inside the coffin.
But when He reached out, He stole a leftover donut instead, and He immediately realized that His stealing ability had been "distorted."
Whoosh~
The coffin lid smashed towards Amon's avatar.
Amon's avatar seemed to not move at all, but He dodged the attack of the coffin lid.
The coffin lid, as if it had a life of its own, spun around and flew back to the coffin, slamming into the ground with a "thud."
Inside the upright coffin, there was a beautiful lady wearing a classical court dress, who looked to be in her twenties, with a pale face and a faint smile.
The smile looked playful, with a hint of rebelliousness and frivolity in her eyes.
On her left was a delicate metal crossbow, and on her right was a wooden stick with fresh leaves still attached.
Amon's avatar smiled and said, "Beautiful lady, you look like a legendary newly awakened Sanguine lady."
"Ha." Messenger Beverly laughed, "Your level of complimenting others has dropped a lot."
Amon's avatar smiled and said, "We do know each other, don't we?"
Whoosh~
At this moment, a ball of burning flames rushed in from outside, forming a fiery humanoid in the drawing room: "Sis, you're really not dead!"
Beverly looked at the fire person with a smile: "I knew it, the one who would survive in the end would be you, you little rascal."
Amon's avatar pinched the corner of His eye: "What a touching scene, congratulations on your reunion."
Beverly said: "Same old rules!"
"Okay!" The fire humanoid shouted, and suddenly turned into a ray of fire, rushing towards Amon's avatar.
Although the "fire person's" movements were very fast, Amon's avatar noticed that the other party had a blazing white spear in his hand as he rushed over. He reached out to steal it, but to his surprise, he still only stole a half-eaten donut!
Poof~
The blazing white spear pierced into Amon's avatar's body.
Whoosh~
Amon's avatar was completely covered in raging fire.
Beverly and Raymond had honed their tacit understanding in the "War of the Four Emperors". Just now, Raymond was the main attacker, and Beverly provided cover. When Amon's avatar was stealing the "blazing white spear" from Raymond's hand, Beverly performed a "distortion", causing Amon's avatar to steal a leftover donut for the third time.
Amon's avatar stole the fire on His body, the blazing white spear in His chest, and the wound all at once. He smiled unharmed: "Interesting."
At this time, Beverly, who was in the coffin, grabbed her coffin lid and suddenly appeared in front of Amon, slapping him with the coffin lid.
Amon's avatar reached out and found that He couldn't steal the coffin lid, so He had to dodge immediately. Raymond appeared just in time on the path He was dodging, and gave Him another blazing white spear.
Thud~
The heavy coffin lid slammed on the ground, and a crack was smashed into the ground. The entire wall in front was shattered.
Beverly smiled and said, "Can't steal it, can you? Hehe, your main body participated in the making of this coffin."
Amon's avatar pulled away from the siblings at this time. The blazing white spear and the wound that had been inserted into Him disappeared again. He smiled and said, "Your cooperation is very tacit. If you were in good condition, even our main body might have to deal with you seriously."
"But..." Amon stretched out a hand, His fingers nimble, as if plucking a few invisible threads: "You have both suffered fatal injuries!
"This lady, the reason why you haven't come out of the coffin all this time is because you were stitched together, right?
"And this young man, you seem to have been fighting against the tendency of losing control in your body. Your fate is really peculiar. Yes, it was after Tudor became the Blood Emperor that you were born.
"Haha, so you are an Beyonder characteristic of a Weather Warlock that He expelled from His body! And there are many Beyonder characteristics of the 'Black Emperor' pathway in your body.
"Originally, your body could allow the Beyonder characteristics of these two pathways to reach some kind of distorted balance. Let me see, so there is a big hole in your chest, which broke the balance in your body."
"Hehe." Amon's avatar smiled and said: "This has given me a lot of loopholes."
He looked at Raymond. Raymond, who was composed of fire, covered his chest and knelt on one knee, as if he was enduring great pain.
He looked at Beverly again. Beverly, who was standing there, suddenly slid her upper body to one side, but her abdomen and below remained motionless.
Amon's avatar smiled and said, "How about I give you the wound and the blazing white spear that I just had on my body?"
Beverly held the coffin with both hands, straightened her body, and also smiled: "Why don't you just manipulate our fate? In my opinion, you don't seem to have that ability."
Amon's avatar shook His head: "I have to say, your delaying tactics are too low-level. Do you really think someone will come to save you?"
"No, I just want to see you again." Beverly smiled: "Because next, I'm going to slap your face."
Just as she said this, her spirituality sensed something and looked in the direction Hobert had just fled.
"Ha, you finally felt it!" Amon clapped His hands: "Yes, that's right, that surprised expression. Didn't expect it? There's another avatar at the angel level over there!"
Beverly was indeed a little surprised: "Impossible! Could it be that you, you are Amon's main body?"
Then she shook her head: "If it was the main body, how could He not recognize me?"
"When you took that letter just now, I knew you might know the main body." Amon's avatar admired the surprised expressions of the siblings: "Since we are acquaintances, then of course we have to break some previous habits."
He smiled and said: "Why do you think my main body wants to show some habits? It's to prepare to deal with people who 'understand' Him."
Beverly picked up the metal crossbow at hand: "Quick! Kill this avatar and go rescue them! There is hope for the Tudor family to rise again among them!"
Raymond was stunned: "How did I not discover that Osment has such potential?"
"What Osment?" Beverly shot an arrow: "I'm talking about him, the one wearing the mask!"
...
Hobert looked at the two leisurely Amon avatars on the roof: "I told you, Amon's avatars are not so easy to hunt."
Through spirituality warning, he probably sensed that one of the avatars was at the angel level, and the other was probably at Sequence 3.
In order to distinguish them, Hobert called them the Angel Amon Avatar and the Sequence 3 Amon Avatar in his mind.
The standing Angel Amon Avatar had a "Worm of Time" in his hand: "Should I parasitize you? Or should I kill you?"
Hobert casually threw Rafter, who had been keeping his eyes closed, aside, and said to Osment beside him: "These two..."
He was slightly stunned: What was I going to say?
At this time, the Sequence 3 Amon Avatar sitting there jumped down from the roof and smiled: "I just stole something, let's try it out to see if it's easy to use."
The Sequence 3 Amon Avatar opened his hand, and in his hand was a delicate small dagger.
Osment looked surprised: "'Fatal Dagger'!"
He quickly reached into the clothes around his waist. The leather case sealing the dagger was indeed empty.
Hobert quickly asked: "What is the ability of this Sealed Artifact? What level is it?"
Whoosh~
The Sequence 3 Amon used the "Fatal Dagger" in his hand to ignite raging flames around him. Tall walls of fire continuously formed crows composed of flames, rushing towards Hobert and Osment.
While dodging the flying crows, Osment explained: "It has..."
He suddenly realized that he had forgotten what abilities the Sealed Artifact he had been carrying with him had!
Hobert was also strange: I should have planned a way to save myself long ago, what should I do? That's right, I should enter that place... uh, what did I want to do just now?
The Angel Amon Avatar, who had been stealing Hobert's and Osment's thoughts on the roof, suddenly said "Huh". He smiled and looked at Hobert: "Your fate is very special! I actually saw a blurred figure of Trunsoest from it, and someone has manipulated your fate, but it's a pity I can't see who it is."
Then He smiled: "You seem to have something very precious! But that thing seems to be only able to be stolen by my main body. Let me see, that thing is... 'That Place'?"
On another battlefield, Amon's avatar did not frequently steal Beverly's or Raymond's thoughts, because their levels were similar. At most, Amon's avatar could only steal thoughts for one or two seconds, and it was easily "distorted" by Beverly.
But this side was different. An avatar at the angel level could steal large chunks of thoughts from Hobert, who was only a demigod.
"Interesting." The angel-level avatar smiled slightly, and then, through stealing thoughts, He knew that Hobert was going to use the barrier ability again, so He reached out and stole Hobert's cane.
But His hand was empty, and He didn't steal anything.
At the same time, the barrier formed by the "Order Crystal" appeared again, and Hobert finally breathed a sigh of relief inside: Amon is indeed very terrifying! My biggest secret was easily known by Him, fortunately I was prepared and always called "Nation of Disorder" "That Place" in my mind!
Then a fierce look appeared in his eyes: This avatar must not be allowed to leave this secret space alive! Not even dead! He can only leave in the form of a "Worm of Time".
Thinking of this, Hobert looked at Austin beside him again. Fortunately, this guy was muddleheaded and had been having his thoughts stolen, relying entirely on instinct to dodge the fire crows, so he shouldn't have heard clearly what the Angel Amon Avatar was saying.
Hobert glanced at Rafter, who was holding his head and curled up on the ground, praying earnestly. He didn't know if he had heard Amon's words.
Now was not the time to worry about this. Hobert immediately recited the incantation in his mind. He had the feeling of being pulled on his spirit body, but this time he felt a slight resistance when he entered the Nation of Disorder.
During this period, the Angel Amon Avatar tried to find loopholes and seek opportunities to manipulate Hobert's fate, but without exception, they all failed. His ability could not break through that barrier.
Fortunately, He realized that this barrier had a time limit. After failing to steal the duration of the barrier, He had to wait patiently.
At this time, on the battlefield next to Him, the Sequence 3 Amon Avatar had used the dagger in his hand to poke a hole in Austin's chest from a distance.
Not a wound, but a hole that could be seen through his chest, through which the walls and trees behind him could be clearly seen.
The Sequence 3 avatar said with a smile: "This thing is very easy to use, the opponent can't hide even if he wants to, but unfortunately this kind of 'fatal attack' can't be used continuously."
Austin knew that he was not an opponent, so he turned around and ran, but as soon as he took a step, he forgot what he wanted to do.
At this time, Hobert had arrived at the "Nation of Disorder", sitting on the "Iron Throne", and sure enough, he saw the star representing Rafter in the pool expanding.
Spreading his spirituality over, he found that the "True Vision" seemed to have a layer of black gauze, and the real world he saw was a bit unclear.
Hobert recalled that when he entered the "Nation of Disorder" just now, he also felt a slight resistance, probably because they were currently in a secret space.
Then Hobert realized that this layer of "black gauze" was an obstacle, and it was impossible to project too much power into the secret space.
But fortunately, the "Nation of Disorder" was of great help in finding loopholes. Hobert "distorted" the concept of the real world and the secret world.
With a wave of his hand, it was as if he had lifted a layer of black gauze curtains, and his vision immediately became clear. At the same time, this allowed him to avoid that layer of obstacles and project all his power into the secret world.
Hobert took the umbilical cord of the evil god's offspring in his hand, injected energy into it and threw it into the secret world, and also threw "Bull Devil Monarch" and "Great Sage" into the secret world.
When he went to get the moving black eyeball, Hobert hesitated for a moment, and finally put it down, took the "Black Emperor" card in one hand, the "1-105" in the other, put on "1-108", and entered the real world himself.
...
There are now two Tony Manor, one in the real world and one in the secret world.
In the urgent situation just now, Hobert didn't have time to distinguish them, and many people in Tony Manor entered the secret world with him.
The Beyonders among them have already felt the battle that broke out in the backyard where Mr. Valentine was located.
For extraordinary families that have been inherited for thousands of years, there are ready-made plans to follow when encountering such a surprise attack.
Currently, "low-sequence" Beyonders are organizing ordinary people to evacuate, but there is no need to organize the backyard. No one has run out yet.
"Mid-sequence" Beyonders gathered together and went to the battlefield to support under the leadership of Sequence 5.
However, after a few Sequence 5s met, they decided to stay away from the battlefield for the time being. They could feel that the level of battle there was too high, and they couldn't help even if they went.
While they were discussing how to avoid the battlefield in the backyard, a Sequence 7 suddenly drew a short sword and stabbed the Sequence 6 in front of him, who had no defense at all.
The surrounding people were slightly stunned, but they immediately stepped forward to control the Sequence 7, and some people went to check the Sequence 6's injuries.
The Sequence 7 who started the attack shouted loudly: "He smiled strangely just now, and made a gesture of pushing his glasses, but he was obviously not wearing glasses!"
The two people who captured him, the one on the left, rubbed his eye socket: "Maybe he's just shooing away the bugs in front of him."
The one on the right adjusted his monocle and smiled: "I'm wearing glasses, it's okay to adjust them, right?"
The Sequence 7 seemed to realize something: "Help!"
But he was already surrounded by several family members.
Those Sequence 5s realized something was wrong and stepped forward, saying: "Let him go! Let him go now."
When the family members dispersed, the Sequence 7 was already dead.
These Sequence 5s were a bit slow to react. While they were exchanging glances, discussing how to handle the situation, another similar attack occurred over there.
This time, most people understood that there seemed to be spies mixed in the crowd.
Everyone became suspicious, and even the Sequence 5s unconsciously distanced themselves.
At this moment, a Sequence 5 shouted: "Everyone, keep your distance and monitor each other. The spy must have transformed into someone we are familiar with.
"Appearances can change, but the tone and movements can't be imitated so closely. If we look carefully, we should be able to distinguish the spies!"
At the Sequence 5 level, they are qualified to know about the manifestations of abilities like "Parasitism," but they rarely encounter "Parasitism."
The reason is simple: if an Beyonder team only has members below the level of a demigod, they will not survive if they encounter "Parasitism" during their mission.
And if the "Parasitism" is not targeting them, then Beyonders below the demigod level will not be able to detect that the other person has been "Parasitized."
So, their first thought was that someone had changed their appearance and infiltrated the Tony Manor.
At this moment, another Sequence 5 shouted loudly: "Before we identify the spies, no one should move rashly. If anyone actively attacks others, they must be a spy. Everyone, work together to kill them!"
If someone had just changed their appearance and sneaked in, this rule would be very effective.
But they were facing Amon's avatars.
As soon as the two Sequence 5s maintaining order finished speaking, a "MidSequence" Beyonder took the initiative to attack someone else, and the surrounding people immediately surrounded and killed them.
Then, more people began to attack their companions.
This made the Sequence 5s feel strange. How could it seem like most people were spies? Or rather, it seemed like the Tony family members were the spies!
Although the Sequence 5s realized something was wrong, their orders were no longer effective.
At this moment, a Sequence 5 named Zert suddenly shouted: "Members who believe in the 'Uncertain Mist,' gather around me!"
Two Sequence 6s immediately approached. Zert raised his hand and said, "Greatness!"
The two Sequence 6s knelt down in front of him with a "thump." They felt that Zert's figure in front of them was exceptionally great, and their bodies could not help but want to worship him.
But their consciousness was clear, and they wanted to get up, but their legs had no strength at all and they couldn't get up no matter what.
Zert smiled: "You are not believers of the 'Uncertain Mist' at all!"
At this time, several true believers of the "Uncertain Mist" approached him, and several people formed a simple square formation.
They did not actively attack others, but if they encountered attacks from other family members, they would never tolerate it and would immediately take action.
At this time, on the roofs around the battlefield of chaos, more than a dozen Amon avatars were watching the battle.
Yes, what this group of "Intermediate Sequence" Beyonders didn't know was that their battle was being watched by a group of Amons.
Of course, some people saw Amon's avatar, but the moment they saw it, their memories of seeing Amon's avatar were stolen, or their vision and hearing were "deceived."
Those were all demigod-level avatars!
It was the Amon avatar who replaced Valentine's fate, and the thirteen avatars summoned from the surrounding area.
After they arrived here, they discovered that the enemy only had two demigods, so there was no need to besiege them. So, they came in groups to have some fun.
Amon Avatar Number Six sighed: "I thought that with the barrier basically intact, it would be difficult for the 'Uncertain Mist' to complete the bestowal."
The monocles on the eye sockets of these avatars can block corruption from the Outer Deities, so they can freely discuss the "Uncertain Mist."
Amon Avatar Number Three wiped the silver monocle in his hand and said: "When the other Outer Gods bestow their gifts, they may indeed encounter some obstacles, but the 'Uncertain Mist' can always exploit some loopholes in the rules. It's like the 'Son of Chaos' that bypassed the barrier and sneaked in."
Amon Avatar Number Ten laughed: "Poor 'Son of Chaos.'"
Amon Avatar Number Seven looked at the melee, pinched his chin, and said seriously: "The ability bestowed by the 'Uncertain Mist' is really strange. It's a bit like the ability of the 'Justiciar' pathway, but there are obvious differences."
Amon Avatar Number Nine followed: "Look, their ability can actually bewitch the 'Worm of Time' in a very short period of time! Hehe, this is like a combination of 'Distortion' and 'Charm.'"
Amon Avatar Number One said: "I suddenly had a good idea. By 'Parasitizing' the recipient, can we peek at the 'Uncertain Mist' in reverse?"
Amon Avatar Number Five smiled: "That's indeed a good idea, but I think it would take our main body to do it to be absolutely sure."
While they were actively discussing, they suddenly looked together in the direction of the two escaped demigods of the Tony family. They felt that the hidden space over there seemed to have suddenly opened a hole.
...
In Valentine's courtyard, the arrow that Beverly shot directly pierced a hole in Amon's avatar's chest, as if an invisible arrow had taken away that part of the flesh.
Amon's avatar didn't care about the wound on his body at all. He waved his hand at Beverly, and the dark coffin fell down.
Beverly in the coffin was completely split in half from the middle and became two sections.
At this moment, the entire courtyard was suddenly filled with thick fog that was impossible to see through. Under the cover of the fog, Raymond punched over and directly knocked Amon's avatar away.
Before Amon's avatar landed, Raymond had already arrived at the landing point in advance, raised his knee and bumped it, turning Amon's avatar into an inverted V shape.
Then came another punch with flames, but this time, his fist was caught by Amon's avatar.
Amon's avatar wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and said, "You hurt me."
If Raymond continued to attack, he could completely hammer Amon's avatar to death, but unfortunately, his condition was not good.
Amon's avatar grabbed at Raymond's chest, and a ball of beating flames appeared in his hand, like a heart wrapped in flames.
Raymond seemed to have been instantly drained of all his strength and fell directly to the ground.
Amon's avatar continued to attack, but suddenly felt something and looked outside. A huge sphere suddenly appeared there. Half of the sphere was pink flesh, and half was a transparent membrane like a soap bubble.
Inside the membrane was filled with light yellow liquid, and a completely dark baby was curled up in the center of the light yellow liquid.
It looked like a pregnant uterus, and there was an umbilical cord connecting the baby and the flesh.
Immediately afterwards, a tall, stalwart figure flashing with black light appeared behind the meat ball.
This figure sat on a throne made of swords, wearing a black holy light armor, and wearing a crown that also emitted holy light. He couldn't see the other person's face clearly, but could only see the other person's eyes flashing with black mist!
A huge sense of oppression hit him. Although the distance was very far, it still made Amon's avatar feel full of majesty and even shocked his heart!
"That's not right!" Amon's avatar said: "This is the King of Angels of the 'Black Emperor' pathway?"
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Beverly threw the wooden stick on her right hand: "Order!"
The wooden stick completed the process of expansion and growth in half a second. Almost in the blink of an eye, it was already covering the sky and covering the entire Tony Manor.
The thin moonlight was blocked, but it was not dark under the tree, as if everyone's body and every building were flashing with faint black light.
Beverly sat up from the coffin, then raised her leg and stepped out of the coffin. She hammered her left leg: "I really miss the feeling of being able to walk on my own!"
The flames on the "Fireman" who fell to the ground also disappeared instantly, revealing his true face, which was a young man with dark red hair, who looked only seventeen or eighteen years old.
He was born as an angel, and his body stopped growing after adulthood.
Raymond reached out and touched his face with some surprise, then laughed heartily twice: "Haha!"
Amon's avatar looked at the towering tree: "This is a very high-level magical item. It can instantly create a space that allows you to temporarily return to your best condition.
"Let me see, this is 'tampering' and 'distorting' the rules, right."
Beverly didn't answer, but put the metal crossbow on her waist, picked up the coffin lid with both hands and slapped it towards Amon's avatar: "Frenzy!"
Amon's avatar was about to dodge, but suddenly fell into a brief state of confusion and madness.
Pa~
Beverly slammed Amon's avatar into the ground like nailing a nail: "It's a pity that such a handsome face is about to be smashed."
Amon's avatar appeared in the courtyard, his head was obviously flatter: "I didn't expect that the coffin lid would really be a weapon!"
At this time, Raymond, who cooperated tacitly with Beverly, launched a sneak attack, holding an ice dagger and stabbing it into the lower back of Amon's avatar.
Amon's avatar held the two blazing white spears he had just stolen and stabbed at Raymond, but Raymond, who was so fast that he had afterimages, dodged it.
Then he smiled: "The situation seems to have reversed, and I seem to be in great danger now."
...
On another battlefield, the angel Amon avatar was a little surprised. He felt like he was being stared at by the baby in the womb. Although he couldn't see the baby's eyes, he felt the other party's vicious eyes.
The angel Amon avatar seemed to understand: "This is the recently very active 'Creator'?"
It wasn't until the solid figure wearing black armor appeared behind him that he understood: "That is the 'Creator,' so this guy who looks like a womb is an angel who is loyal to the 'Creator'?"
The baby in the womb suddenly opened its mouth: "Loyalty!"
The angel Amon avatar immediately felt that he had infinite loyalty to the "Holy Infant King" and was about to kneel down immediately.
So, he immediately grabbed himself and stole this idea. The kneeling action stopped, and the idea of loyalty disappeared. He smiled slightly: "Interesting."
At this time, Hobert, who had the aura of an King of Angels, asked the "Bull Devil Monarch" and the "Great Sage" to besiege the Sequence 3 Amon avatar, while he looked at the battlefield of the "Holy Infant King" and the angel Amon avatar, ready to sneak attack at any time.
"Wow~"
The "Holy Infant King" cried, shaking the entire Tony Manor.
Many ordinary people and "Low Sequence" Beyonders in the distance fainted directly when they heard this sound.
On the "Intermediate Sequence" battlefield that was being watched, many Beyonders experienced dizziness and mild loss of control.
The Amon avatars who had been watching the fun before had disappeared.
Austin, who was not far away, stopped in place, his condition was not very good.
The Sequence 3 Amon avatar on the opposite side immediately stole the influence he received and gave these negative effects to Austin.
At this time, Austin's thoughts were no longer being stolen continuously, and he began to fight back, "distorting" the concept between himself and the Sequence 3 Amon avatar. The hole in his chest immediately turned into an ordinary wound, and most of the negative effects he received returned to the Sequence 3 Amon avatar.
The Sequence 3 Amon avatar was about to fight back, but the "Bull Devil Monarch's" offensive arrived. Now the situation has turned, and it has become a three-on-one.
On the angel-level battlefield over there, as the main target of the "Holy Infant King," the body of the angel Amon avatar rapidly expanded and almost exploded in place.
A phantom that was even larger than the "Holy Infant King" immediately appeared behind him. This phantom was like the surface of a stone-carved wall clock, divided into twelve grids in total. Each grid was either gray-white or cyan-black, interspersed with each other, with clear boundaries, and had different symbols.
He moved his time forward by a few seconds to restore his state.
"Exploit! Distort!" Hobert made a series of extremely solemn sounds.
A pure black pointer appeared on the illusory clock behind the angel Amon avatar. This pointer rotated rapidly, and the angel Amon avatar felt his time was passing rapidly.
Hobert almost laughed shamelessly. Originally, he was just trying to see if he could affect the illusory giant clock.
What he didn't expect was that he actually briefly "utilized" the control of the clock and made the angel Amon avatar's time pass rapidly.
If it were the main body, Hobert's move would have at least a certain effect at the level of a True God, but the avatar in front of him was only about Sequence 2 level, which allowed Hobert to suppress the opponent with his position.
This is the utilization of Beyonder rules. Even if Hobert's level as an King of Angels is very watery, his position is sufficient most of the time.
Moreover, under the "Tree of Order," Hobert felt that the "Creator's" ability was also enhanced to a certain extent. The most obvious manifestation was that he could Exploit more rules of the Beyonder world.
The angel Amon avatar immediately ended the summoning of the mottled clock. He looked several years older than before.
He didn't attack the "Creator," but instead grabbed towards the "Holy Infant King," trying to steal the other's time.
If it were an angel from another pathway, it would be difficult to see through the "Holy Infant King's" true nature, but the Angel Amon's avatar, who was equally good at, or rather, exceptionally good at finding loopholes, had already realized that the "Holy Infant King's" existence had a time limit.
"Distort!" The "Holy Infant King" distorted the Angel Amon avatar's "theft."
Behind him, Hobert spoke again, "Bestow!"
He "Bestowed" the Angel Amon avatar's "theft" to the Sequence 3 Amon avatar over there.
The Sequence 3 Amon avatar, who was already in desperate straits not far away, felt that a lot of his time had suddenly been stolen, and in an instant, white hair appeared on his head, turning him into a fifty or sixty-year-old man.
Before Hobert could rejoice in his operation, he saw a row of Amon avatars not far away, uniformly grabbing at the "Holy Infant King" non-stop.
Hobert smiled helplessly: Damn, did I stir up an Amon nest?
Although these Amons were all at the demigod level, they couldn't stand the large number of thefts. After a dozen or so attempts, there would always be one or two successes.
Although each time only a few seconds could be stolen, the "Holy Infant King" could only be maintained for a few minutes in total. How could he withstand them stealing like this?
So Hobert put down "1-105" in his hand first. He took out "1-108" from the "Disciple of Silence" and removed the eye patch from this white puppet-shaped sealed artifact.
This was a sealed artifact with a certain degree of activity. Any creature that made eye contact with it would be cursed.
The Amon identities were stealing enthusiastically when suddenly a lifelike snow-white puppet appeared between them and the "Holy Infant King."
Immediately afterward, their spiritual warning made them quickly look away, but in the end, there were still three avatars who didn't have time to move their eyes and made eye contact with the puppet's eyes.
One avatar was immediately decapitated, but he supported his head, smeared his neck with his hand, and he actually "deceived" his neck, making his neck think it was still intact!
One avatar exploded in place, because all of this happened so suddenly that he couldn't save himself. Only two "Worms of Time" struggling a few times before dying were left on the ground.
On the shoulder of another avatar, a dark hand with long nails immediately rested. That hand came from the spirit world, and the position above his arm could not be seen, as if this hand was the entirety of the creature.
The third Amon avatar immediately stole the position of a palm tree in the yard, allowing the palm tree to appear on the roof, while he stood in the original position of the palm tree.
Then he "deceived" the owner of the hand, allowing the owner of the hand to leave, satisfied with grabbing the palm tree.
But the shoulder that had just been touched by the hand immediately turned black, as if poisoned.
Just as this avatar was about to steal away the negative effects on his shoulder, a black giant sword fell from the sky and cut him in half.
Without any room for resistance, this avatar disappeared like a bubble, leaving only three "Worms of Time" on the ground.
That giant sword was "1-105" blessed by Hobert, a sealed artifact from a "Blatherer."
Although this sealed artifact was not very effective against the Angel Amon avatar, it was one sword per target against this kind of avatar with only Sequence 3 or Sequence 4 level.
"1-105" itself did not have such strong power, it all depended on Hobert using the blessing of the position.
Now Hobert held "1-108" in one hand, using the ability of this sealed artifact to turn one of the Amon avatars into a rabbit wearing a monocle, and stabbed forward with "1-105" in the other hand, solving another avatar.
And these avatars' attacks on the "Creator" were without exception "distorted" or "granted" by Hobert to other avatars, or simply blocked by Hobert with the power of the "Nation of Disorder."
The remaining few avatars knew that they were no match at all, so they simply fled immediately. They no longer had the idea of fighting. Now the more important task was to leave here and tell the other avatars and the main body what happened here.
Before they could run far, they were blocked by a huge figure with illusory scales. Under the siege of the "Great Sage" and other three saints, they had already solved the Sequence 3 Amon avatar and ambushed here under Hobert's instructions.
Osment, who had regained the "Fatal Dagger," also followed, attacking from both sides. In just over a minute, these avatars all turned into Worms of Time and were sucked into the stomach by the "Great Sage."
Hobert looked again at the battle between the Angel Amon avatar and the "Holy Infant King."
At this time in the battle, the Angel Amon avatar's shadow suddenly attacked Him, and the Angel Amon avatar stole the "Holy Infant King's" shadow, sending his own shadow to it.
So the Angel Amon identity's shadow began to attack the "Holy Infant King."
The "Holy Infant King" raised his small hand, and the shadow was swallowed by a piece of darkness. When the darkness faded, the shadow seemed to have lost all vitality and turned into an ordinary shadow.
The "Holy Infant King" clenched his small hand, and the shadow was immediately grabbed into a ball, as if enduring great pain.
Before the Angel Amon avatar had time to steal his shadow back, he suddenly seemed to be gripped by some great force, revealing a painful expression.
Hobert assisted at the right time: "Magnify!"
This angel-level avatar was immediately squeezed out of shape.
Taking advantage of the fact that He was temporarily controlled by the "Holy Infant King," Hobert went up and stabbed with his sword.
Although the Angel Amon avatar could not raise his hand, He still stole most of the power that Hobert had injected into "1-105." This black giant sword shrank at a speed visible to the naked eye, and finally became a dagger, unable to stab Him.
At the same time, He once again lost the opportunity to steal back his shadow.
"Distort!" Hobert temporarily "distorted" the Angel Amon avatar's idea of resisting with all his strength into the power to give up most of the resistance.
The "Holy Infant King" seized the opportunity: "Depravity!"
Many black, viscous liquids suddenly flowed out of the mouth, eyes, ears, and nose of the Angel Amon avatar. His body was eroded by the "Depravity" and was no longer very obedient to His command.
However, while spitting out black mucus, He smiled and said, "I...know...your...secret."
At this time, the "Holy Infant King" opened his mouth and let out a sharp, maddening "language of foulness." The Angel Amon avatar's head immediately exploded, and eventually His entire body turned into "Worms of Time" scattered all over the ground.
Hobert smiled and said, "You know too much, so you have to die."
