chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 548: Recipients of the Uncertain Mist's Boons
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After the Angel Amon's clone was jointly defeated by Hobert and the "Great Sage Equaling Heaven," the "Worms of Time" that He had previously parasitized in insects, animals, and even microorganisms all ended their "parasitic" state one after another, stiffly appearing in the corners.
"Great Sage" opened its mouth and sucked all the "Worms of Time" over, and then it came to Hobert's front.
Hobert glanced at Osment and Rafter, who was still lie lying on the ground. The dagger in his hand turned into a blue greatsword with a sulfurous aura once again.
Then, Hobert injected "Power of Order" into the greatsword, causing it to emit a black light.
At this moment, his thought was to silence them, to kill these two people who had met with the Angel Amon's clone.
But suddenly, Hobert seemed to wake up and thought: The idea that Amon's clone stole from me didn't actually reveal too much information. They only knew that Trunsoest had influenced my fate. As for the "that place" that Amon mentioned later, how would they know which place it was?
Hobert put away "1-105": Just knowing this is not enough to kill them to silence them! Besides, given their state at the time, they might not have been able to hear the Angel Amon's words clearly. The only thing to pay attention to is to do a good job of cleaning up the aftermath, because since the "Creator" appeared, "Hobert" has been standing there without moving, but this is easy to cover up.
After reason once again defeated the bloodlust, Hobert returned to the "Nation of Disorder" and retrieved the power of the "Great Sage Equaling Heaven," who was preparing to find Beverly and Raymond to fight.
This guy also knew who was strong and who was weak. After sensing the King of Angels' position of the "Creator," he decided to find trouble with the two angels who were not in good condition.
After retrieving the power of the "Bull Devil Monarch" and the "Great Sage," the "Great Sage" in front of Hobert's main body disappeared, and the "Worms of Time" that had been sucked into its belly were all piled up in front of Hobert.
Having no time to stay in the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert immediately returned to the real world, pretendingly saying: "Praise the Creator!"
Just now, he had been posing in a praying posture, looking like he and Rafter had been praying all along, establishing enough connection with the "Creator" so that the "Creator" could continuously transmit energy over.
This point can stand scrutiny. It's like the "Son of God" Suah. Each time its power needs an accurate coordinate. Sacrifice and constant prayer are almost standard for the arrival of evil gods.
Although the state of the "Creator" must be better than that of the "Son of God," and it doesn't need to pray constantly to descend power, but if Hobert doesn't say it, who would know?
Hobert opened his eyes and saw Osment in the center of the courtyard over there, kneeling on the ground, shivering.
When the "Creator" had the intention to kill, Osment's spirituality keenly felt it, but the suppression of the same pathway made him feel his own powerlessness, leaving only kneeling on the ground to beg for mercy and tremble.
Hobert said to Rafter, who also felt the threat: "The great 'Creator' has already left. You can stop praying and open your eyes."
Only then did Rafter raise his head and look around. Most of the previous battle was a contest at the level of Beyonder abilities, and the surrounding buildings were not damaged much.
He patted the dust on his body: "Thank you for the protection of the 'Favored' just now."
Of course, Rafter felt the great pressure from the surroundings just now, but Hobert had been maintaining the black barrier around him while entering the "Nation of Disorder," so Rafter, who was closer to the core of the battlefield at Hobert's feet, did not receive any damage.
Of course, he also knew why Hobert would let him close his eyes, because opening his eyes would easily see the complete or incomplete state of mythical creatures, and he would lose control because of it.
Hobert put away the "Worms of Time" on the ground, and then said to Osment: "It seems that the battle that took place in Valentine's courtyard has also ended. Now the other people in the Tony Manor or the 'Worms of Time' in their bodies should all be dead. Go and retrieve them."
"Yes, yes, yes." Osment felt that it was a matter of course for him to obey Hobert's orders.
… …
In the courtyard where Valentine had lived before, because Beverly and Raymond were both good at close combat, the surroundings had basically turned into ruins.
Beverly glanced at the few "Worms of Time" on the ground. In the middle of them was also an Beyonder characteristic of the "War Bishop," which should be the deceased Valentine. Putting away this Beyonder characteristic, He said to Raymond: "Did you feel the ultimate majesty just now, and see the figure wearing black armor?"
"I saw it, and I felt it." Raymond said: "I remember Solomon had a similar feeling, and there was similar black armor."
He asked: "Is the 'Black Emperor' pathway going to have a new True God?"
Beverly did not answer this question, but asked: "Do you still remember Antigonus?"
"I remember. He looks very young, but gives people a very vicissitudinous feeling."
"I witnessed Antigonus become a King of Angels." Beverly reached out and stroked the thick Tree of Order: "After you grew up, His condition was not very good, and I was not very familiar with Him.
"Before His condition became not very good, I often went to Him for divination, and vaguely learned that our father, the great Blood Emperor, would fall, and the Tudor family would leave the sight of the world for a long time.
"Until the appearance of the new 'Black Emperor,' the Tudor family took this opportunity to become great again."
Raymond immediately asked: "The young man with the mask you mentioned just now, is he the subordinate of that King of Angels just now?"
"Perhaps not just a subordinate, I can feel that his relationship with the 'Creator' is very close." Beverly looked at her brother and said: "This will be the key for us to contact the 'Creator.' We must maintain a good relationship between Tony Manor and him."
Raymond nodded: "I will."
"In addition, he may also be our hope for restoring our state." Beverly said: "Not this kind of temporary recovery, but a complete recovery.
"When Antigonus divined for me, he also drew a circle-like pattern and told me that if I encountered danger, finding this circle-like thing would save me.
"Although reality deviates from this divination, that circle-like thing must be the key! I once asked Antigonus, is that a donut?"
Raymond twitched the corner of his mouth. He knew that his sister liked to eat donuts the most, but according to common sense, it shouldn't be a donut, right?
If it is a donut, what kind of donut is it? It is unlikely that even the donut made by the Earth Mother herself would have such an effect, right?
However, the suppression from the bloodline made him dare not say anything, and could only listen quietly from the side.
Fortunately, Beverly was not so influenced by donuts that she lost her mind: "Antigonus replied that he couldn't see clearly.
"For the past few hundred years, I have been looking for this circle. My spirituality tells me that through Hobert, I should also be able to obtain that key thing."
Raymond nodded: "I understand, I will guide Tony Manor to lean towards Hobert as much as possible."
Beverly "um"ed: "Before that, we must continue to lie low."
For the orthodox churches, for "remnants" like the Tudor family, having a demigod-level leader, they will only turn a blind eye, and even establishing a certain force outside the Northern Continent is nothing.
But if they were to learn that there are still angels in poor condition, they would definitely launch a new round of encirclement and suppression.
As for now, in a hidden state, the Evernight Goddess probably already knows the existence of their siblings. Beverly is not worried about this point. First of all, the "Creator" is more likely to attract the attention of the Evernight Goddess. Secondly, Beverly has discovered that as long as they do not pose a threat to the church, the current Seven Gods seem to not care much about these things.
Beverly took advantage of her good condition to give her brother a few more instructions, but the two people's spirituality felt something, and they both looked at the courtyard that had already turned into ruins.
"Are you two descendants of Tudor?" At this time, Hobert walked quickly and put all the seized "Worms of Time" on the ground.
Beverly nodded: "That's right."
Hobert glanced at the messenger, thinking, 'No wonder Amon is willing to have an "in-depth exchange" with her. The messenger looks like a delinquent girl, which might be right up Amon's alley.'
While his mind wandered, he asked, "Has the Blood Emperor Tudor found any clues about the 'Uncertain Mist'?"
"To my knowledge, they have found some," Raymond replied to Hobert. "The 'Uncertain Mist' has bestowed its power upon Solomon and Trunsoest.
"We speculate that some of Trunsoest's actions may have been influenced by the 'Uncertain Mist'."
Beverly didn't interrupt, as this information wasn't clear when she died.
"So, with our help, Tamara obtained the clues about the 'Uncertain Mist' left behind by Solomon," Raymond said, sharing the information without reservation.
"According to our observations, the 'Uncertain Mist' is trying to influence Beyonders of the 'Black Emperor' and 'Justiciar' pathways. Also, it's looking for a lamp, supposedly to destroy it completely."
Hobert simply nodded slowly. His spirituality told him that he knew what the lamp represented, but he had left the relevant memories in the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Then, he felt discomfort in his spirit body, believing that the detailed information about the 'Uncertain Mist' was contaminating him, so he changed the subject: "Does Tamara know that you are using her for experiments?"
Actually, Hobert, now under the protection of the 'Crystal of Order,' could briefly discuss the Outer Deities, as long as he quickly sealed those memories to avoid significant risks.
Hobert didn't expect that Tamara, who had defected to the Tudor Empire, hadn't been treated well at all but was instead being used as a pawn.
"She knows, and she is willing to gain power through the 'Uncertain Mist' and use it to take revenge," Raymond further explained.
"Originally, the Tamara family had a 'Hand of Order,' but the Six Gods, in order to support Trunsoest, seized the characteristic of the 'Hand of Order'.
"Tamara hates the Six Gods and Trunsoest."
Hobert nodded slightly, not expecting such a hidden history, but on second thought, it made sense.
Both the Augustus family and the Castiya family were loyal to Trunsoest. As Sequence 2 of the same pathway, there was no reason for the Tamara family not to be loyal to Trunsoest!
However, the fact that the Tamara family supported the Tudor Empire was problematic in itself.
Hobert recalled the interrogation of the undead in '1-107.' Perhaps his spirit body was incomplete and lacked the relevant memories, only remembering that Tamara betrayed Trunsoest because of the clues about the 'Uncertain Mist'.
Or perhaps the Six Gods or Trunsoest used some ability to make Tamara "keep secrets."
After all, this wasn't a glorious matter. Not completely destroying the Tamara family was already the mercy of the Six Gods and the Night Emperor.
Of course, it was most likely not mercy. Perhaps the 'Hand of Order' of the Tamara family, seeing that his death was inevitable, simply offered his characteristic in exchange for the temporary safety of the Tamara family.
When the time was right, Tamara immediately fled this dangerous camp.
For a moment, Hobert made many guesses. At this time, Osment came over with the 'Worms of Time' he had collected, respectfully placing them in front of the group.
Hobert smiled and said, "Thank you for your answer."
Putting the 'Worms of Time' together, they had captured 68 of them this time! Far exceeding their expectations.
However, the danger of this hunt also far exceeded their previous expectations.
At least they had never expected that two Angel-level Amon avatars would appear. Fortunately, the 'Creator' intervened, otherwise, the consequences would have been unimaginable.
"As a Blessed of the 'Creator,' who contributed the most this time, may I distribute the spoils?"
Neither of the two Angels present had any objections, and the two demigods had even less to say.
"First, I will take out 8 to give to the existence that provided the hidden space." Although Hobert had only promised the Evernight Goddess 6 'Worms of Time,' since the harvest far exceeded expectations, it was better to be generous and give two more.
Hobert then said to Beverly, "Also, I will give each of you 8, and give Osment 2 for his performance in the battle.
"The rest will belong to the 'Creator' and our Angels and Saints who participated in this battle. What do you think?"
Beverly certainly had no problem. After all, this time, the 'Creator' and the Angels loyal to Him had single-handedly taken down an Angel-level clone of Amon, as well as most of the demigod-level avatars.
After distributing the spoils, Hobert instructed Osment, "These 'Worms of Time' are materials for high-level talismans, and their Beyonder characteristics can also be obtained by crushing them or similar methods.
"But before that, they must be properly kept to prevent their Beyonder characteristics from returning to the main body."
Osment was slightly stunned and nodded seriously.
Raymond suddenly said to Osment, "Come with me."
The two went behind the 'Tree of Order,' as if they had some confidential matter to discuss. After a while, Osment returned with Raymond, looking solemn.
Beverly smiled and said, "Then this hunt concludes with our victory. Well, I should release the 'Tree of Order' state."
She could feel that the 'Tree of Order' could last for a few more minutes. Since Hobert didn't ask for it, she would honestly take it into the coffin.
Beverly returned to the coffin first. After releasing the 'Tree of Order' state, the coffin lid closed, and the messenger girl returned to her original appearance.
Raymond's body also burst into flames again, turning back into the original fire man.
Hobert stretched out his hand towards the air. The huge flower in the air closed and turned into the shape of a fruit, falling into Hobert's palm.
This strengthened Sealed Artifact could still be used for a few more minutes.
Under everyone's gaze, the Tony Manor in the hidden space gradually overlapped with the manor in the real world. Finally, the two Tony Manors merged into one.
Raymond nodded slightly to Hobert and then burrowed back into the underground of Tony Manor.
The messenger also disappeared into the void.
Hobert and the others saw the crescent moon in the sky again and heard the sound of the waves in the distance, and suddenly felt that the encounter just now was like a dream.
Osment was the first to react and said to Hobert, "Mr. Jeffrey, Tony Manor owes you a favor. Feel free to ask for anything."
Raymond had called him behind the 'Tree of Order' just now to tell him the importance of this masked young man.
Hobert didn't immediately answer Osment's question but asked Rafter behind him, "What do you want?"
Hobert had only realized just now that although this Rafter looked like a gambler, he basically sent him a fortune every time he contacted him.
Tonight's operation was indeed a huge risk for Hobert, but he also gained the favor of the Tony family and 42 'Worms of Time'.
He didn't really have to share the spoils with 'Bull Devil Monarch' and the others. All 42 'Worms of Time' were his. It could be said that he had achieved 'Worm of Time' freedom in one go.
So, Blessed like Rafter still needed to be carefully cultivated.
Seeing that Rafter was a little hesitant, Hobert added, "If you don't want to continue staying in Tony Manor, I can arrange for you to go to the Southern Continent or the Feysac Kingdom. There are many Blessed of the 'Creator' there."
Seeing this, Osment quickly said, "I can arrange for this Mr. Rafter to work in the external communication department of Tony Manor, using bribes to the Governor-General's Office and Backlund to digest the potion.
"After he advances, he can also be arranged to manage a piece of land in the manor to continue to digest the potion."
Rafter was slightly stunned. The conditions offered by the other party were exactly what he needed.
So, he said to Hobert, "Thank you for the favor of the 'Favored One.' I have been in Tony Manor for nearly three months and have developed a good impression of this place. I will continue to stay here."
Hobert nodded: "I respect your choice."
This was also what he most wanted to see, letting Rafter act as the liaison between the "Creator's" blessed and Tony Manor.
Then Hobert simply said to Osment in a half-commanding tone: "You can't use that Sealed Artifact from the 'Marauder' pathway casually anymore, otherwise it might attract Amon's avatar."
Although it was unknown how long Tony Manor had been using that Sealed Artifact without any problems, these things, when used for too long, would sooner or later attract Amon's avatar.
This was almost inevitable, just a matter of time.
Hobert was also a little strange, why the angels of Tony Manor hadn't reminded them of this.
What he didn't know was that Raymond's condition was actually very poor, and most of the time he couldn't communicate normally. He only felt Beverly's aura tonight, and his condition was briefly better.
Although Osment had encountered Amon's avatars before, it was the first time he had encountered an angel-level Amon avatar.
This was like a paradox, if he had encountered Amon's angel-level avatar before this, he might not be alive now.
So Osment and others didn't have the concept of guarding against Amon's avatar, which ultimately led to this disaster.
Osment quickly said, "We will definitely not use it randomly again in the future, if you need that Sealed Artifact..."
Hobert waved his hand: "I don't mean that."
One "1-101" was enough, too many Sequence 1 Sealed Artifacts of this pathway would easily be targeted by Amon.
Hobert smiled politely and said, "Well then, the matter has been resolved, I'll take my leave!"
"Please wait!" Osment said: "Mr. Jeffrey, under the inducement of Amon's avatar, many young people in our family have begun to believe in evil gods, and have already received the grace of the evil gods through sacrifices, what should we do?"
Before, Amon's avatar, under the guise of Valentine's destiny, talked to Osment about this matter, saying that the doomsday was coming, and the Tony family needed to find a god to rely on, even if it was an evil god, it could give Tony Manor a support in the doomsday.
Osment believed it to be true, and also provided many conveniences for the sacrifices of the young people in the family.
Now he knew he had been fooled, but what about those young people in the family? Those were all elites of Tony Manor!
Hobert sighed, Amon's avatars' "deceptions" were all very clever lies, the doomsday was indeed coming soon, and it was indeed necessary to get the protection of the gods at that time.
But that was to let the gods protect them, to avoid being invaded by Outer Gods, not to throw themselves into the embrace of Outer Gods.
He pondered for a moment before saying, "Are you willing to let them convert to the 'Creator'?"
In that case, the relationship between the "Creator" and Tony Manor would be even closer.
Osment immediately said: "Of course, we couldn't ask for more!"
"However, before that, I need to first examine their condition." Hobert said: "Whether they can be accepted in the end depends on the will of the 'Creator'."
Then he asked Osment: "What grace did the evil god give them?"
"The blessing gave them some Beyonder abilities."
"Beyonder abilities?" Hobert asked again: "Briefly obtaining some abilities?"
"No." Osment looked a little puzzled: "It's obtaining many self-contained Beyonder abilities without taking potions."
Hobert pondered for a moment before asking: "Specifically, what method was used to obtain the abilities?"
"By sacrificing spiritual materials to the evil god, after establishing a stable connection with the evil god, one can pray to the evil god for power," Osment said:
"However, not all prayers can be successful, we have done some experiments, it seems to be purely a probability problem, and has nothing to do with Sequence level or pathway."
Before, the Tony family really thought this was a way to gain power, so they did a lot of experiments.
This reminded Hobert of the crown on Longtail Island ten years ago. If the "Mountain God" was really an angel, it seemed that he gave the native power through the process of grace.
There was also the Sequence 6 "Wind Blessed" of the "Sailor" pathway. If one could obtain the grace of the Lord of Storms, they would be able to master more Beyonder abilities.
Wasn't the "Concealment Fruit" in Hobert's hand a kind of blessing?
But the problem was that these powers were temporary, or phased, not Beyonder abilities that could be used for a long time.
Hobert asked again: "What is the probability of losing control after the ritual is completed?"
"There has been no sign of losing control so far."
Hobert opened his mouth in surprise: Obtaining power from the Outer Gods without losing control! This was a bit unbelievable.
"There is also a very important piece of information." Osment said: "We have done experiments with the 'Hunter', 'Lawyer', and 'Arbiter' pathways, and all can obtain the same grace from the evil god, and there is no sign of any conflict with the Beyonder characteristics in their bodies."
Hobert frowned: This was even stranger!
Osment continued: "The only consequence may be that the recipients' temperaments have changed somewhat, but not in the direction of madness, and it has not caused too much impact."
Hobert slowly nodded: "Bring them to see me."
Osment immediately made arrangements. He personally accompanied Hobert to the front yard, to the courtyard that had not been damaged by the battle, and ordered his subordinates to organize the followers of the "Uncertain Mist".
It had to be said that this sudden attack by Amon's avatars caused many Beyonders below demigod level in Tony Manor to be killed by their own people, lost control due to the influence of the angel-level battle, or turned into lunatics.
The followers of the "Uncertain Mist" suffered almost no losses.
Of course, this was inseparable from the fact that Amon's avatars regarded them as research objects.
About twenty young people came to a spacious living room.
Among the young people, Zert, the leader, and another Sequence 5, saw a person wearing a black crystal mask sitting on the inner side of the living room.
The material of the mask, those black crystals looked very attractive, as if they contained infinite power.
On the side of the masked man was the tutor Rafter, who stood there like the masked man's servant.
Hobert carefully looked at the twenty or so young people in front of him. They looked energetic, without any signs of madness or loss of control.
"I am a friend of Mr. Osment." Hobert introduced himself: "I came to help deal with the enemies who attacked tonight.
"I heard that you performed very well tonight. For this reason, I have been invited to assess your condition, which is considered one of the rewards for you."
Everyone did not doubt Hobert's words. They also felt the angel-level battle before. Tony Manor could not have dealt with the battle tonight independently.
Judging from Mr. Osment's respect for this masked man, it was not difficult to guess that he should have played a huge role in the battle tonight.
"First, show me your abilities." Hobert said: "I will assess whether the state of your abilities is stable."
Zert asked: "How should we show them?"
"Use your abilities on me!" Hobert said: "With all your strength! Start with you first."
"Yes." Zert took a deep breath, stretched out his hand towards Hobert, and used: "Instigation! Greatness! Charm!" one after another.
The ability of "Instigation" made Hobert feel that Rafter was very hateful, and he wanted to kick him to death, but Hobert easily "distorted" his thoughts.
The ability of "Greatness" made Hobert feel that his body uncontrollably wanted to submit to the other party. His consciousness was clear, but his body was out of control.
However, the body's reaction was also easily "distorted" by Hobert.
The third ability, "Charm," made Hobert feel that he was willing to obey any instructions from Zert next, and it was resolved by him using the ability of "Exploitation" to end this state in advance.
In the end, Hobert summarized in his heart: It was probably at the Sequence 5 level, a bit like the abilities of the "Lawyer" and "Arbiter" pathways, but there were obvious differences, giving people a feeling of being adjacent to these two pathways.
Hobert asked: "How are your other abilities? Do you feel they are still stable?"
"As stable as my Beyonder abilities." Zert introduced without any precautions: "When entering the 'Politician' state, my intelligence will be greatly enhanced, while the intelligence of people around me will be correspondingly weakened.
"When I enter the 'Bureaucrat' state, I can make the target's logic more complex, and they like to come up with ideas that have nothing to do with important matters.
"In this state, the probability of my traps succeeding will be greater. Even if I haven't set up traps in advance, I can still slow down the reactions of the surrounding enemies."
Hobert nodded pretentiously: "It can be seen that you are using your abilities very well."
Then he asked as if inadvertently: "'Politician' and 'Bureaucrat'?"
"These are the names given by the great 'Uncertain Mist' to different levels." Zert explained: "'Politician' is equivalent to the Sequence 9 ability, but the 'Politician State' will also have corresponding improvements after obtaining higher-level Boons.
"In order to facilitate distinction, we call the obtained Boon the 'Politician Pathway'."
Hobert asked: "You have already obtained five levels of Boons, right?"
"Yes."
"What are the names of these five levels of Boons?"
Zert replied: "Politician, Bureaucrat, Dignitary, Orator, Diplomat."
Hobert nodded and smiled: "Your condition is very good, next."
"Instigation! Greatness!"
After once again "twisting" the influence of these two abilities, Hobert asked: "Why did you only use two abilities?"
This Sequence 5 said: "About a week ago, Mr. Valentine did a similar test, but strangely, after that test, I couldn't use the 'Charm' ability!"
Hobert was slightly stunned. Valentine a week ago should have been Amon's angel-level avatar. Could it be that He did something to this blessed person?
So he said: "You come over."
The blessed person came in front of Hobert. Hobert lowered his head as if he was devoutly whispering something. In fact, he entered the "Nation of Disorder" and carefully looked at the other person with "True Sight", but he didn't see anything wrong with him.
Hobert frowned slightly. Under "True Sight", even if the other party's fate was tampered with, he could still see some clues, but apart from a thin circle of white mist surrounding his body, there was nothing unusual.
Because he was in the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert's memories of both the Outer Deities and Amon were complete in his mind.
This gave him a bold guess: Could it be that the 'Charm' ability of this Tony family member was stolen by Amon's avatar?
The power of the Outer God's Boon is different from Beyonder Power. Beyonder Power is based on Beyonder characteristics, so the ability of the 'Marauder' pathway can only steal an ability for a period of time, and then it has to be 'returned'.
This is because the Beyonder characteristics are still on the Beyonder who had their ability stolen, which destined his ability to only be stolen temporarily.
The power of the Boon, however, is not based on Beyonder characteristics. Once these powers are stolen, they are gone!
If this is really the case, Hobert estimates: This stealing process should be very complicated, and may require 'deceiving' the Outer Deities' position to a certain extent! After all, these powers are Boons from the Outer Deities, and it is impossible for anyone to steal them. Therefore, Amon's avatar only stole one ability.
The more Hobert thought about it, the more he felt that this should be the case. Amon's avatar himself said that one of his important purposes in coming to Tony Manor was to use the Tudor family members to observe the state of the "Uncertain Mist".
Such observation must involve some research, and perhaps one of his research purposes is to try whether he can steal the power of the Boon.
After figuring this out, Hobert took another look with "True Sight". Suddenly, he realized with his spirituality: After becoming an angel, I can take these Boons back to the "Nation of Disorder"!
After thinking about it carefully, Hobert felt that this was normal. After all, this was the Boon of the "Uncertain Mist", and part of the composition of the "Uncertain Mist" was the source material "Nation of Disorder" in the cosmos.
It was normal for him to be able to take back these Boons for the "Uncertain Mist", but this recovery was limited. He could only recover the Boons from the "Politician" to the "Diplomat" level, and it would not work any higher.
There was no time to think about it in detail at this time, so Hobert quickly returned to the real world and said to Sequence 5 in front of him: "Your condition is also normal, but you can no longer use the 'Charm' ability."
The other party was slightly stunned: "Why is that?"
Then he asked: "Are you also a believer of the great 'Uncertain Mist'? I just felt a gaze similar to the 'Uncertain Mist'."
Hobert thought to himself: Of course it's similar.
But he smiled and said: "I am the favored of the great 'Creator', but the relationship between the two of them cannot be told to you for the time being."
As a "Favored", when you need to be unfathomable, of course you have to show it.
Hobert's appearance of being in control of everything really frightened everyone in the living room. Osmund also believed that this "Favored" had received instructions from the "Creator" through the prayer just now, and now he knew everything about the "Uncertain Mist".
"As for why you can no longer use the 'Charm' ability, it was caused by the attackers tonight." Hobert found the most trustworthy reason to prevaricate: "You should have noticed that the enemy had already sneaked into the manor a long time ago."
The blessed ones had basically experienced the battle caused by Amon's avatar, and they deeply believed Hobert's lies.
Next, Hobert patiently asked them to show their abilities one by one. After this process was over, Hobert asked again: "Have you heard any whispers in your ears?"
Everyone answered almost at the same time: "No."
Hobert asked again: "Has anyone felt any changes in their emotions? For example, being easily angry, or being easily sad."
"No!"
This is strange!
Hobert smiled helplessly. Why didn't obtaining the Outer God's Boon show any signs of loss of control? When did the Outer God become so kind and amiable?
He pondered for a while and asked again: "What are your opinions on the colonial strategy of Loen?"
This was to examine their worldviews.
"Loen people are all fools!" Zert suddenly became indignant: "They didn't organize the power of the Rorsted Archipelago at all!"
Another blessed person also said: "Organizing the natives of the entire Rorsted Archipelago completely has the ability to launch a world war."
The emotions of the other blessed people seemed to have suddenly found an outlet, and they began to express their opinions: "We should seize the power of the Governor's Office and form a large-scale navy and army!"
"That's right, we should take this powerful army and conquer the entire Southern Continent!"
"Then the Northern Continent, let the four countries of the Northern Continent crawl at our feet."
"..."
Hobert felt a lot more relieved when he saw their impassioned speeches: While obtaining this power, they are very enthusiastic about conquering and ruling more territories.
Note: The Boon system was not announced when the settings for this book were being made, so there were no settings in this regard at the beginning.
At that time, the author Jun was also preparing for secondary creation. The reason why the Outer Deities of the Stars did not lose their position may be because each pathway actually has four Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics. The Outer Deities retained multiple Sequence 1 of the corresponding pathway to maintain their position.
The Boon system has solved this problem.
Since there was no such setting at the beginning, let the protagonist not know the Boon system before this, otherwise it would be quite abrupt to suddenly mention the Boon system now.
Fan Pathway + the actual names for comparison
9. Politician (Broker)
8. Bureaucrat (Shadow Merchant)
7. Dignitary (Prosecutor)
6. Orator (Ambitionist)
5. Diplomat (Under-the-Table)

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 549: About the Boon system setting of "Uncertain Mist"
chapters.content:
About the Boon system setting of "Uncertain Mist"
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The author has been waiting for a long time, but the "Uncertain Mist's" Boon system has not yet been announced, so I had to create a second version. The following is the setting for the entire Boon system:
[T/N: Added additional abilities that may fit from canon to distinguish it from BE lol, in italics is mine]
9. Schemer/Politician: Becomes smarter, but also uncontrollably more insidious. They possess an Eloquence that can charm or instigate others through their speech.
8. Bureaucrat: Skilled at planning various conspiracies, disrupting the existing order, and enjoying it. Their Pacifying aura can steer the target's thoughts towards less important matters.
7. Dignitary/Noble: Evokes the enemy's desire for power, causing them to fall into temporary confusion, or be bewitched into becoming their pawn. They possess the power to discern crimes an individual has committed.
6. Orator: Makes people want to worship and kneel involuntarily. Their words will be treated as imperial edicts, making people unwilling to disobey. Changes some people's values, causing their values to become chaotic and making them do some abnormal things. Their ambition makes them outstanding, akin to a great leader to be obeyed by others. As an Orator, their words will affect others, but will not be mentally influenced by others.
5. Diplomat: Makes all of people's emotions become chaotic. At this time, a few words can make close comrades-in-arms turn against each other. Their words are akin to contracts. The shadows of betrayal can be easily stirred with a few words.
4. Overseer (Governor/Statesman): Within a certain range, evokes people's desire for power and makes them go crazy, absolutely obeying the caster's orders. However, after the caster has used these people, they must kill them all within three days, otherwise their desire for power will unite them to overthrow the caster. Can make an area temporarily become chaotic. Different from disorder, in a chaotic area, Beyonder abilities may become ineffective. Within their range, they gain Protection to attacks from those without Godhood.
3. Probability Minister: Can apply chaos conceptually, such as making the target's Beyonder characteristics chaotic, which can cause the target to lose some Beyonder abilities, and there is a small probability that the other party will temporarily become an ordinary person. The Probability Minister cannot control the Beyonder abilities and probabilities lost by the target. They can weave a vortex of chaos that disrupts the normal flow of order (laws) and fate. Even Beyonder characteristics get caught up in their Vortex.
2. Chaos Chancellor: Further improves the ability of chaos. All constants in the universe can temporarily become ineffective, and can create attacks similar to black holes. Chaos is destruction, destruction is deconstruction. Their chaos can deconstruct all things.
1. Truth (Sovereign of Disorder is direct translation, Truth is the canon name): In the kingdom under his rule, east is west, and sometimes east is also east. Up is down, and sometimes up is also up. Good is evil, and sometimes good is also good. He can make all conceptual things in the country enter a state of chaos, and people will lose all common sense standards. They can redefine the logic from the chaos. The Truth is gray, belonging to neither extreme.
0. Lawless: Can destroy natural laws and mystical laws to a certain extent. Laws symbolize truth and certainty, the constant of natural order. Destroying the laws can twist all certainties into a state of uncertainty.
The author is very aware of his naming skills. These are temporary names. If I see some good names in the comments, I may change them.
The reason for telling everyone about the setting is to say that this book will temporarily use the second-creation gift system as the standard. After the original work announces all the gift sequences of the "Uncertain Mist", the author will modify it.
However, in this author's setting, the Boon system does not appear often. After all, there was no such thing in the initial setting, and it will only appear in some unavoidable places.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 549 The Mission of Protecting the Queen and the Princess
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After the recipients of the "Uncertain Mist" left, Hobert pondered for a dozen seconds before saying, "My suggestion is to just observe and not pay attention for the time being."
Firstly, he discovered that these recipients were not like those people on the west bank of Full Moon Lake who had been corrupted by demons or the True Creator. They seemed very normal and full of energy. Their spirit bodies and astral bodies had no problems, except when facing specific issues.
Of course, this was also the biggest problem.
Hobert realized that the "Uncertain Mist" seemed to be influencing their will to some extent, and problems would definitely arise in the long run.
Secondly, and most importantly, the 'Creator' couldn't solve this problem yet, so Hobert felt it was better to maintain the status quo.
But these inner thoughts, of course, could not be revealed to Osment.
Hobert continued, "The influence they receive is not significant, but they can use powers outside of the pathways. From the current perspective, it is still relatively worthwhile."
"However, if they continue to receive higher-level Boons, this matter may get out of control, so they cannot be allowed to continue receiving Boons."
Hobert wasn't completely lying about this point either. If something happened to the recipients now, he could use the 'Creator's' authority to 'distort' or 'tamper' with it, and the problem could basically be temporarily resolved.
That is, for the Boon recipients of the 'Uncertain Mist,' Hobert had such confidence. As for the recipients of other Outer Gods, Hobert felt that even using the 'Creator's' authority might not work.
Osment agreed, "We will no longer support their sacrifices and bestowals, and we will also observe and monitor them carefully."
"It's best to find a suitable reason," Hobert said. "After all, they are all good lads willing to take risks for the family."
"Yes!" Osment simply used the tone of a subordinate.
Hobert then asked for the Honorific Name of the "Uncertain Mist." He got up, instructed Rafter to write to him if there were any problems, said goodbye again, and used "Travel" to leave.
Back in the bedroom of his Earl's mansion in Backlund, Hobert finally took off his mask and breathed a sigh of relief. After checking that the door was still locked, he first sacrificed eight "Worms of Time" to the Evernight Goddess.
After the gate flickering with starlight opened and took away the "Worms of Time," Hobert waited for a while before sacrificing all the remaining "Worms of Time" to the "Creator."
He entered the "Nation of Disorder" and captured the "Worms of Time."
Looking at these worms covered in rings and faintly revealing mystical symbols, Hobert wondered: I wonder if 'The Fool' can respond to the ritual of making talismans now?
Then he thought: It seems that the 'Error' pathway and the 'Black Emperor' pathway are very similar to some extent at the 'High Sequence'! For example, 'Deception' is somewhat similar to the effects of 'Disorder' or 'Tampering'.
Hobert had a bold idea: Could I try praying to myself and use the "Worms of Time" to create advanced talismans?
Thinking of this, he shook his head again. Now, when he prays to himself, he only needs to use the corresponding spiritual materials to obtain talismans at the demigod level of the 'Black Emperor' pathway. There is no need to go around in such a circle to obtain some talismans that are similar to the 'Black Emperor' pathway.
Hobert summoned a piece of "Order Crystal," made it into a small square box, then put all the "Worms of Time" into the box, and finally closed the lid.
When there is a chance, he will pray to 'The Fool' and see if he can make advanced talismans.
After putting away the "Worms of Time," Hobert began to review the battle tonight.
If nothing unexpected happens, soon, or rather now, Amon's other avatars will definitely notice that the avatars on the Rorsted Archipelago are gone. At that time, the avatars will definitely take action.
But with Tony Manor as a buffer, Hobert wasn't too afraid of Amon's avatar's revenge.
After tonight's battle, Hobert felt that Amon's avatar was indeed powerful. For example, Hobert was completely unable to form a complete thought during the battle.
Without the help of the "Order Crystal," tonight's battle would have had a different outcome.
But the 'Creator' is not to be trifled with either. Hobert realized that the biggest difference between the 'Creator' and 'The Fool' is that the 'Creator' can use the loopholes of death and life to create two angel-level thugs.
Even without these thugs, they could temporarily restore Beverly and Raymond to their original states and hunt down Amon's angel-level avatar.
He felt that the key to fighting Amon's avatar was: the main body must never participate!
What if next time Amon's avatar realizes that the "Order Crystal" in his hand is the key and simply rushes over to take the "Order Crystal" away? Then the 'Creator' will disappear from this world.
No, or maybe that 'Creator' sitting on the 'Iron Throne' in the future might start wearing a monocle.
Even if the 'Nation of Disorder' is not the Sefirah that Amon needs, he might steal it to play with for two days. Of course, the premise is that he has a way to avoid being corrupted by the 'Nation of Disorder'.
After having a basic strategy to deal with possible risks in the future, Hobert began to think about the state of the "Uncertain Mist" and the "Blessings of the Outer Deities."
A long time ago, Hobert had thought about a question: How do the Outer Deities in the cosmos maintain their own state?
Theoretically speaking, one must have certain Beyonder characteristics plus part of a Sefirah in order to maintain the position of a Great Old One without falling.
But the Beyonder characteristics of the 22 pathways are basically on Earth, and the Sefirot may have been torn apart. They themselves retained a part, but how was the problem of Beyonder characteristics solved?
After learning about the "Boon System," Hobert suddenly thought that after the "Original Creator" awakened, he caused the Beyonder characteristics and Sefirot of these Outer Deities to tear apart.
But there is no evidence to show that the "Original" attracted all the Beyonder characteristics and Sefirot in the entire universe. Perhaps the Outer Deities still had some Beyonder characteristics and Sefirot left to maintain their own state.
The majority of the Beyonder characteristics and Sefirot in the universe that were attracted by the "Original" then formed the 22 extraordinary pathways and the nine Sefirot!
Such a conjecture is at least valid on the "Uncertain Mist." Hobert clearly knows that it possesses a certain "Nation of Disorder," and the Bestowal System can prove from another aspect that it also possesses certain Beyonder characteristics, and these characteristics seem to be very similar to the abilities of "Lawyer" and "Arbiter."
Thinking of this, Hobert looked again at the Honorific Name of the "Uncertain Mist" he obtained from Osment:
"Bridge of Light and Darkness;
"Interstice Between Black and White;
"Ever-Uncertain Mist;
"The Truth that Oversees All Things."
This made Hobert a little strange, because the Honorific Name of the "Uncertain Mist" that he obtained from the Tamara family was clearly:
"The Mist in the Depths of the Universe;
"The Ruler of Gray and Truth;
"The Symbol of Chaos and Distortion."
[T/N: altered slightly to better fit]
Why are the two Honorific Names different?
After a little thought, Hobert guessed: Could it be that the two Honorific Names have different effects?
The Honorific Name obtained from the Tony family is used to bestow Beyonder powers, while the Honorific Name from the Tamara family can break through the barrier and establish a certain connection with the "Uncertain Mist"?
Hobert followed this line of thought: Or, to describe it from another perspective, the Tamara family obtained the Honorific Name of the "Uncertain Mist" in the Fourth Epoch. At that time, the influence of the Outer Gods on Earth was very limited. Could it be that there was no Bestowal System yet?
When the barrier further weakened at the end of the Fourth Epoch, did the Outer Gods use the method of bestowal to influence the Earth more deeply?
Hobert sighed, clearly the apocalypse is still more than ten years away, but some games seem to have already begun.
Becoming a god! Hobert exclaimed in his heart: In this extraordinary world, only becoming a god can protect oneself.
Finally, he thought of the words those two Amon avatars said to him: My fate must have been affected by Trunsoest. The direct evidence is the family's curse. But who is the other person influencing my fate? Amon's avatar can't even see it clearly!
Hobert seemed to vaguely think of something. His spirituality also told him that his idea was crucial, but for some reason, it was difficult to form a complete thought.
After thinking for a while, Hobert simply stopped thinking. He would first find a way to resolve Trunsoest's influence on himself.
After resealing the related memories, Hobert returned to the real world. He had some insomnia again that night. As soon as he closed his eyes, he saw Amon wearing a monocle, as if He could find him at any moment.
This was a subconscious shadow left on Hobert by Amon's clone. It was indeed quite terrifying at the time. For more than half a minute, Hobert felt like he was in a state of confusion.
However, his spirituality was acutely aware of extreme danger. The feeling was like Hobert experiencing sleep paralysis. Although his brain was nearly awake, his body wouldn't obey his commands. The key was that he could also feel like there was a very dangerous person standing beside him, ready to hurt him at any time.
He only slept for a little over half an hour, and most of the time he was having nightmares. However, after waking up, Hobert found that his spirit was surprisingly good.
While eating breakfast, Hobert heard Dophis say that Miss Norma and her mother had already arrived.
After Hobert finished breakfast, he met them and asked them to wait in the reception room.
As usual, Hobert took the MI9 carriage to work. When he arrived at the office and was about to ask his secretary to notify Byron to come over, the secretary, Sharlene, stepped forward and said, "Director, the Director-General has asked you to come over."
Hobert was stunned: Countess Georgina? What does she want me for?
"Understood," Hobert said. "I'll change into my uniform and go immediately."
Georgina's underground office was also on the third basement level, but it was not in the same area as Hobert and the other action department offices.
The MI9 office building had the same structure as a normal building above ground, but each floor of the underground section was several times larger than the above-ground section.
Moreover, it was designed like a maze, with no straight lines and no road signs.
It was said that this was to delay intruders from finding the file room or the prison.
But Hobert felt that this protection was only useful for Beyonders below the demigod level. If he wanted to invade here and was confused by the maze-like structure, he would just smash a straight path through.
In addition to this architectural structure, Hobert also sensed a "warning mechanism" built with Sealed Artifacts in the lobby on the first floor.
Although he didn't know the specific effect, he guessed that the Sealed Artifacts should be able to detect if MI9 members were hypnotized or possessed.
Under Sharron's guidance, Hobert arrived at Georgina's office: "You wait for me outside."
He was mainly afraid of not being able to find his way back.
He pushed the door open. Georgina's office was even larger than Hobert's. When the secretary opened the door, Georgina, who was also wearing a double-breasted uniform, was reading a document. She pointed to the opposite side of her desk: "Sit down for a moment."
MI9 had specially designed uniforms for women, like the skirt style Sharron wore, but Georgina wore a men's uniform.
This reminded Hobert of Princess Ethel of the Feynapotter Kingdom. In terms of androgynous temperament and oppressiveness, Countess Georgina was still far behind without using her Beyonder abilities.
"I called you here today to give you a mission," Georgina said after reading those lines. "Next Monday, go protect the Queen for a day."
Hobert was slightly stunned: "I just came to MI9 and have no experience in protecting important people…"
"Don't try to push it off," the Director-General said with a smile as she looked at Hobert. "You're the only one who has time that day, you have to go."
Hobert smiled: "Alright, I'm just not proficient in the business and I'm afraid of embarrassing MI9."
Then he asked, "Is there a large event that day? Do you need to send more people to protect the Queen?"
"No, one of the demigods guarding the palace has something to do that day and needs to rest for a day," Georgina said as she began to explain the details after Hobert accepted the mission. "And on Monday, the Queen needs to have someone to protect her."
Hobert was slightly stunned: "There's only one demigod protecting the Queen?"
Georgina smiled and asked, "How many did you think there were?"
Then she said, "Read more documents that are helpful to your work!"
Georgina explained, "There are only four demigods protecting important members of the royal family. If necessary, they will be borrowed from the army. MI9 is the royal family's first choice every time they are borrowed."
Hobert thought it was right. After all, demigods weren't cabbages. The Sand Isles facing the Feysac Empire, the vast colonies, strategic locations, and so on, all needed demigods.
Moreover, with the addition of Sealed Artifacts, four demigods could basically defend the palace and take turns to rest. If the enemy's attack couldn't be handled by four demigods, then four more would probably be useless.
The royal family's greatest reliance should be the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact and the mechanism to quickly call angels for support.
Georgina finally said, "Your protection time is from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. I suggest you go to the palace earlier. There will be members of the Royal Guard to tell you some precautions."
Hobert nodded: "Okay."
It's a pity that I won't be able to slack off happily next Monday, and I won't be able to attend the Tarot Gathering.
Under Sharlene's guidance, Hobert returned to his office. Byron was already waiting in the secretary's reception area.
Hobert told Sharron a few words, and then took the carriage back to the Earl's mansion with Byron.
The four-wheeled carriage they were riding in was also designed with a low chassis. Sitting inside, they were not as tall as the people standing outside. This design also ensured the speed of the carriage to the greatest extent.
When Norma and her mother saw Byron's cold face in the reception room of the Earl's mansion, there was a trace of fear in their eyes. The MI9 people might have left some psychological shadows on them when they went to arrest people.
Under Hobert's chairmanship, the following conversation seemed very harmonious. The two parties quickly reached an agreement that Lord Bradley would donate 30,000 pounds to MI9 in exchange for bail.
MI9 was different from other departments. The interrogation work was completed internally, and they could not follow the police's interrogation regulations. That is to say, torture was legal here.
Generally speaking, the subsequent trial by the court was just a formality.
Before handing the prisoners over to the court, lawyers were not allowed to intervene, especially the nobles and wealthy people who were accustomed to playing with the law, who hated this department to the core.
But after entering MI9, most of them immediately cowered, because they were still reluctant to part with their luxurious lives and hoped that such a life could continue.
Under the operation of Hobert and Byron, Lord Bradley and his son were released that afternoon. Before leaving work, MI9 received a check for 30,000 pounds.
After Byron went to the bank to exchange the money, according to internal regulations, 3,000 pounds were given to Hobert, and the rest of the money was deposited into MI9's public account.
Hobert gave 1,000 pounds of the 3,000 pounds to Byron, and took out another 1,000 pounds to distribute to the case handlers, even the secretary Sharron, who only ran two errands, received 30 pounds.
Hobert also promised to treat all his colleagues in the action department to dinner next Tuesday at noon.
Everyone didn't expect this new Deputy Director to be so generous. For a time, the entire action department praised Hobert.
At the ball in the evening, Hobert met the Bradley family again. The forty-year-old Lord thanked Hobert with tears in his eyes.
This was the first time he had been arrested, and he was arrested by MI9.
Byron and the others kept interrogating them with Beyonder abilities, which made their spirits very fragile and prone to fluctuations. It would take them a while to recover and become normal again.
While comforting the father and son, Hobert also felt how powerful MI9 was. Or rather, in the Loen Kingdom, this might be the only department that could restrain most nobles and wealthy people.
Some people sarcastically called them the King's hounds. This scolding was very appropriate. The reason why the royal family had always maintained sufficient influence and control over MI9 was to use this department to maintain the cornerstone of its rule.
However, MI9 couldn't arrest people randomly. If the prisoner had nothing to do with spies and there was no relevant evidence, they would have no way to legally arrest people.
The parliament and the government could intervene in MI9's internal investigations under certain conditions.
So, rather than saying that MI9 was the cornerstone of the royal family's rule, it was better to say that it was the royal family's last deterrent.
On Sunday morning, led by Qonas, Hobert joined the "East Balam Veterans Club," completed the formalities, paid the membership fee, and received a badge with a forest, ocean, and blade tip emblem.
After a brief tour of the club, Hobert even ran into a few acquaintances, or rather, some of Christian's former colleagues, whom he had met a few times at social gatherings like dances.
Qonas joked, "Coming here, do you feel a sense of coming home?"
Hobert smiled and replied, "I do recognize quite a few people here."
At noon, as previously agreed, the two had lunch at the Loen Kingdom Hotel, casually chatting about the current situation.
MI9 had relevant regulations that prohibited discussing work in public places, so everyone dining nearby knew that these two were from MI9, but even in their casual conversation, Hobert and Qonas wouldn't mention even the most trivial matters related to MI9.
On Sunday afternoon, finally able to rest, Hobert said hello to Dophis and used the "Traveler's Door" to arrive at the Green Grass Manor in South Colson.
Fors had nothing to do this afternoon either, so they went to sunbathe on the lawn together.
The afternoon sun was very warm, and the fragrance of the surrounding grass made one feel drowsy. Hobert and Fors chatted and chatted, and he actually fell asleep.
Ever since encountering Amon, his nerves had been tense for the past few days. Now he finally relaxed, holding Fors's hand as he entered dreamland.
Fors looked at the sleeping Hobert, suddenly smiled slightly, and felt a sense of accomplishment: He was just saying that he had been suffering from insomnia these days, but he fell asleep beside me in no time.
Hobert slept very soundly, until it was really too late and Dophis came to call him to attend the dance, Fors had no choice but to wake Hobert up.
On the way to the dance, Hobert asked "The Fool" for leave, as he wouldn't be able to attend tomorrow's Tarot Gathering.
He quickly received a reply from "The Fool": "Understood."
...
Early Monday morning, Hobert traveled by carriage to Soderak Palace.
At this time, on Empress Borough, there were only carriages delivering goods to the mansions of nobles. In the mist, they lit their carriage lamps, like ghost ships on the sea.
Arriving at the side gate of the palace, an officer of the Royal Guard was already waiting there.
"Earl Hobert, it's a pleasure to meet you." The officer smiled and introduced himself, "You can call me Chad. I will be working with you today, responsible for the security work for the entire day."
Hobert shook hands with the other party without any airs: "I'll have to listen to your arrangements for today's specific work."
Among the officers in charge of palace security, who knew who was whose relative or confidant?
Hobert was just temporarily seconded to work for a day, so of course, while being neither arrogant nor humble, he would be as polite as possible.
Chad led Hobert into the palace, to a small office. Chad then began to talk about today's security mission: "While the Queen is in the palace, you only need to rest in the lounge. We will take care of the daily security work."
"But today the Queen will also be going out, and then you will have to sit in the Queen's carriage for close protection."
Georgina had briefly described Hobert's mission before, but she hadn't made the specific tasks clear.
According to regulations, Hobert's specific tasks would only be revealed after he entered the palace.
Hobert nodded, not particularly concerned. Then he realized that even the royal family wouldn't treat a demigod like a servant or guard. As long as the royal family members didn't go out, he would just rest or guard the palace's sealed artifacts.
A "temp worker" like Hobert would certainly not be allowed to guard the sealed artifacts.
Moreover, the royal family's request to MI9 for a temporary transfer was very clear: it was mainly to protect the Queen.
Chad continued: "According to convention, when you hand over with Mr. Claremont later, you will be granted temporary use of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact and a charm."
"The ability of that Grade 1 Sealed Artifact is: it can detect targets in various hidden states; it can turn a small area into a 'Secret Realm,' effectively hiding traces; it can summon a 'door' in front of itself, placing itself and the target in two separate spaces, able to evade most Beyonder power attacks."
"The negative effect is: it will always inadvertently enter the spirit world, and long-term wear will turn you into a hopeless directionally challenged person."
"As for that charm, it can summon Duke Southville, to be used in times of extreme crisis."
Chad smiled slightly: "You participated in the Battle of Feynapotter City, so I believe I don't need to explain what summoning Duke Southville means."
Hobert nodded: "I understand."
Chad then mentioned several of the Queen's preferences, lest Hobert offend the Queen in some minor matters.
At seven forty, the two men, leading a guard of several dozen people, went to relieve another guard.
Chad first took Hobert to the lounge specially prepared for demigods in the Queen's bedroom, and handed over to an old man who looked more than sixty years old, very kind, and in good spirits.
After receiving the seal artifact in the shape of a button and the dark golden charm, the handover was officially completed. The two demigods shook hands, and the kind Claremont left, leaving only Hobert alone in the lounge.
If you walked from the door of this lounge, it seemed to be far from where the Queen rested and worked, but it was only a wall away from the Queen's bedroom and her office.
As a demigod, such a wall certainly couldn't stop Hobert's spirituality. If the Queen was in any danger, Hobert might discover it sooner than Chad, who was guarding the Queen's side.
There were fine cigars and cigarettes in the cabinet next to him, and the coffee and black tea were special supplies that only the King and Queen could drink.
But there were no entertainment tools at all. The walls were bare, not even an oil painting was hanging.
After staying for more than an hour, Hobert felt bored and sighed in his heart: This job is suitable for old men like Leimund.
Around ten o'clock, the Queen was finally about to go out.
Hobert stretched hard, silently yawned, and quickly came out to keep up with the pace of the guard.
He noticed that at the very front of the team was not only the Queen, but also the noble Princess Alice. It seemed that the two were preparing to go out together.
Hobert didn't care too much. Anyway, in his opinion, guarding one sheep was the same as guarding two.
Arriving at the carriage of the King's standard, the Queen and the Princess got into the car first, and Hobert quickly stepped forward and got into the car third.
The carriage of the King's standard was several circles larger than that of the Earl's standard. When Hobert's current carriage was standing in the carriage, he had to lower his head, while the carriage of the King's standard didn't need to lower his head at all. If you jumped lightly inside, your head wouldn't touch the roof. It was simply like pulling a small living room around the world.
It is said that the Queen likes canaries very much, so there is also a special place for hanging birdcages in the carriage. This time, the Queen brought a birdcage and a canary.
The Queen, who was in her forties and dressed and styled very solemnly, glanced at Hobert, who came up last, and just nodded slightly to him as a greeting.
Alice was slightly stunned: "Why is it you?"
"Today, the captain of the Royal Guard is taking a break." Hobert simply explained, and then greeted the Queen and the Princess before sitting on one side of the carriage, paying attention to everything outside the car window.
Alice didn't say anything more and continued chatting with the Queen.
The carriage slowly accelerated and drove out of the palace, leaving the city from King's Avenue.
Hobert learned from the conversation between the Queen and Alice that they were going to visit Duke Bowen today, who was the Queen's brother and Alice's uncle.
Bowen had fallen ill last year and had been recuperating in a manor in the suburbs with fresh air.
The weather today was not very good. It was already past ten o'clock, but the fog had not completely dissipated, which made ten o'clock at noon look almost like early morning.
Hobert was sighing about Backlund's weather when suddenly, his spirituality sensed the advent of danger.
He immediately made a gesture to the Queen and Alice, signaling them not to speak.
Hobert injected his spirituality into the button on his cuff, the seal artifact provided by the royal family, to find out if there were any hidden enemies nearby.
At this moment, Alice suddenly covered her chest with a look of horror, as if she couldn't catch her breath.
Hobert immediately felt an evil force descending on Alice. He immediately stepped forward to check. Alice was already foaming at the mouth and had somewhat lost her will.
The Queen covered her mouth in surprise: "Oh my god!"
She rose to help, but Hobert stopped her with a hand.
At this moment, Hobert had already made a judgment: Alice was cursed!
"Chaos! Distortion!" Hobert threw the surrounding area into chaos and tried to distort the surrounding evil forces in order to isolate Alice from the caster, or to "distort" the curse onto the canary in the carriage.
But it didn't work. Hobert immediately helped the dying Alice to lie down: "Excuse me."
There are generally two types of mediums for curses. One is that the caster obtains a part of the cursed person's body, such as hair or flesh, so they can curse the target from a great distance.
This is equivalent to a phone call in the field of mysticism. The caster's power needs to maintain contact with the cursed person in a mystical sense for a few seconds in order to curse someone to death.
Some casters with lower sequences also need ritual magic to assist them, performing curses continuously for several days before they can curse someone to death.
The other type of medium is an item on the cursed person that the caster can use, or simply an item made by the caster, to perform the curse.
This is equivalent to a telegram. As long as a brief command is issued in a mystical sense, the curse can be triggered using the item as a medium.
So, since "Chaos" and "Distortion" don't work, this curse must be using the second type of medium.
Hobert maximized his spirituality and stared at Alice's headdress, earrings, etc. with "Connection": Not these things.
He had no choice but to search her body. When he reached the skirt area, Hobert felt a hard object on the side of Alice's right leg. He quickly lifted the princess's skirt.
Fortunately, noble clothes are more complicated. Alice also wore a pair of safety pants, otherwise Hobert would have felt a little embarrassed if there were only panties under the skirt.
I have to say, Princess Alice's legs are very beautiful, neither fat nor thin, and the stockings fit perfectly, making them round and sexy.
Because saving people was the priority, Hobert didn't have time to look closely. In the leather sheath on Alice's right thigh, he found a stiletto.
This is a magical item, but still not what Hobert was looking for.
Hobert looked at the princess's other leg. There was also a delicate garter on her thigh, which was also wearing stockings.
In earlier times, stockings were a more rare luxury than they are now, and garters were a structure used by nobles to hold up stockings.
Later, as stockings became more elastic, the function of garters disappeared, but garters were still retained as accessories.
Among the nobles, garters are relatively private accessories, and only very close people give each other garters.
The reason is simple. In the more conservative Loen, men, women, or ladies' legs are rarely exposed in public.
Even if the garter is sexy, few people can appreciate it.
These thoughts flashed through Hobert's mind. He reached out and tore off the cloth garter, and immediately felt that his hand contained a very evil power.
Hobert immediately threw the garter on the carpet, checked it, and after seeing that he had not been eroded in any way, he went to close Princess Alice's skirt.
At this time, Princess Alice had not yet recovered her sanity, but her breathing had stabilized.
Hobert took out his handkerchief and wiped the white foam from the corner of Alice's mouth: "Distortion!"
He "distorted" the concept of Alice and the canary, so that most of the influence Alice received went to the canary.
The canary kicked its legs and died, while Alice's condition recovered a lot at once.
The Queen glanced at the dead canary, seeming a little reluctant, but her daughter was more important: "How is she?"
All of this just now took only three or four seconds. The Queen didn't even have time to order the coachman to stop.
Hobert didn't take back his handkerchief. After using "Connection" to cut off the mystical connection between himself and the handkerchief, he put the handkerchief on the seat.
It wasn't that he was picky, but to avoid suspicion.
After all, there was Alice's saliva on the handkerchief. If she was cursed again, Hobert would also be somewhat suspected, so it would be better to simply throw the handkerchief away.
Then he sat aside, giving way to the Queen.
Under the Queen's care, Alice took more than ten seconds to recover.
At this time, Hobert said: "I suggest we return to the palace immediately, and let the members of the guard who are good at divination divine the location or approximate information of the assassin."
However, the hope should not be great. Judging from the ferocity of the curse just now, the caster's sequence should not be low, unless Klein or Archibald is found to divine, otherwise nothing may be divined.
The always dignified Queen asked with some lingering fear: "What happened to Alice just now?"
Fortunately, Hobert reacted quickly. If it were an ordinary Beyonder, they would not be able to find the key to solving the problem in such a short time.
And judging from that curse, it would kill Alice in five seconds, six seconds at most.
If Hobert had been a little slower, Alice would have been a corpse by now.
How could the Queen not be afraid?
"The princess was cursed just now," Hobert replied.
"No need to go back." At this time, Alice pointed to the garter on the carpet calmly and asked: "Did the other party use this garter to curse me?"
Hobert nodded: "According to my observation, yes."
The Queen immediately asked: "Who gave you this garter?"
"Edessak!" Alice said coldly.
The deceased prince who was said to be obsessed with the witch.
The Queen seemed to have thought of something. She asked somewhat sternly: "Are you still investigating Edessak's affairs?"
Alice glanced at her mother: "Yes!"
This assassination using the curse was clearly aimed at Alice's investigation. Even if it didn't kill her, the warning was very obvious.
"How many times have I told you, don't continue the investigation!" The Queen said seriously: "I don't want to lose a daughter after losing a son!"
Alice nodded: "Okay, Mother, I won't investigate any further."
The Queen sighed. She knew her daughter too well. Alice agreed so readily, which only meant that she hadn't listened to her advice at all.
Hobert was already shouting in his heart: Hey, hey, hey, don't talk about this kind of thing in front of me, okay? I'm just a temporary worker! I don't want to know these secrets of yours, and those broken things in the royal family!
Fortunately, the mother and daughter did not continue to talk about this matter, but they did not turn the car back to the palace. They seemed to know who the assassin was and were sure that they would not assassinate again.
Hobert guessed that it should be someone from the Witch Cult, and there must be an inside responder in the palace.
Otherwise, it would be impossible for the assassin to take advantage of the time when the experienced demigod was resting and Hobert was temporarily transferred to carry out the assassination.
Because theoretically, although Hobert is also a demigod, he is too young after all, and he has not undergone corresponding training. Maybe when he finds out that it is a curse, Alice will be hopeless.
Moreover, the other party's assassination time was quite precise. The curse was carried out only after Alice left the palace. Hobert didn't believe it was a coincidence.
The atmosphere in the carriage became a lot duller. When they were about to reach their destination, Alice took out a delicate leather bag and put away the torn garter.
After the carriage stopped, Hobert got out of the carriage first to be on guard.
The Queen got out of the car second. When she got out of the car, she saw Alice also put Hobert's abandoned handkerchief into the leather bag.
She was slightly stunned, but pretended not to see it.
Hobert, who got out of the carriage first, saw Duke Bowen coming out to greet him. The duke with gray hair looked thin.
Hobert almost immediately made a judgment: It seems that there is an evil force entwining Duke Bowen's spirit body.
