chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 550 The Real George III
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert glanced at Duke Bowen, judging that the cause of his illness also seemed to be related to a curse.
However, he didn't make a sound. This wasn't the only demigod in Backlund, and it was impossible that no one had noticed this before.
Hobert dutifully followed behind the Queen and Princess, diligently carrying out his task of protection and vigilance. The Bowen couple couldn't help but glance at this handsome young man.
Of course, they had seen Hobert, but they had only attended the ball hosted by the King on April 1st, and had not attended any balls since. They also didn't know that Hobert worked for MI9, so they were a little puzzled by his presence here.
More than half an hour later, the Queen's visit ended, and the group embarked on their return journey.
It was evident that the Queen and Duke Bowen had a good relationship. Duke Bowen was reluctant to part, and the Queen, sitting in the carriage, also looked worriedly in the direction of the villa after the carriage began to accelerate.
After the carriage left the manor, the Queen suddenly asked Hobert, "Have you discerned the cause of Duke Bowen's illness?"
Hobert was slightly stunned, thinking, 'Why ask me?'
He bowed slightly and said, "Your Majesty, my experience is shallow, and I have not studied medicine, so I have not discerned the cause of his illness."
The Queen looked at Hobert and nodded slightly, saying, "It is good that a young man knows to be cautious."
Then, she changed the subject, "It was I who specifically requested Georgina to transfer you here."
Hobert was slightly stunned again. He thought it was really because he was the only MI9 demigod available today.
After observing for the past few days, he had discovered that the others were indeed quite busy.
At the same time, he had a question in his mind: Why did the Queen do this?
After a moment's thought, Hobert said, "Thank you for your Majesty's consideration. I didn't think too much when I received the transfer order from MI9."
This was to express his position: I am a member of MI9, loyal to the royal family, and there is no need to win me over in private. There is also no need to privately assign me any tasks. Just have Georgina issue orders for any tasks.
Of course, this was also to indicate: I will not accept private solicitation, and I refuse tasks outside of my official responsibilities.
For other nobles, this would definitely be an opportunity, but Hobert did not intend to stay in Backlund forever, so he did not intend to tie himself to the royal family.
The Queen smiled and said, "The more cautious you appear, the more you fit my ideal candidate."
Hobert: I… I give up!
After all, these were the top ruling class, each one of them shrewd, and a single sentence had blocked all of Hobert's paths.
"I won't make things too difficult for you!" At this time, the Queen changed the subject, "You only need to secretly help me investigate who wants to harm Duke Bowen."
She sighed and said, "I have sent many people to treat Bowen, and even spent a lot of money to invite the bishop of the Church of the Earth Mother to diagnose him. Their diagnoses are consistent: Bowen is under a slow-acting curse."
"But they have exhausted all kinds of methods and have not been able to resolve this curse."
"Perhaps it's time to change our approach and find out who the caster is."
Hobert glanced at the Queen and then at Alice. Sure enough, he saw a hint of disapproval on Alice's face: 'You still have the nerve to talk about your daughter? Aren't you also conducting some dangerous investigations?'
But immediately after, Hobert felt that this seemed to be human nature. Even politicians with their minds full of political goals would have one or two people they cared about, and that would often be their bottom line.
He sighed and continued to decline, also speaking the truth, "But I am not good at solving curse problems."
The Queen didn't say anything, she just looked at Alice.
It was as if she was saying: 'Lying to my face.'
Hobert smiled wryly, "That kind of urgent curse is different from a slow-acting curse.
"Based on my limited understanding, slow-acting curses are more difficult to resolve, and it is also more difficult to find the medium of the curse and the caster behind it."
"The Queen should know that my abilities are not suitable for breaking this kind of difficult curse."
"Your ability is secondary to this matter!" The Queen stared at Hobert: "In fact, even now, I don't fully believe the diagnoses of those people before! Can you investigate whether Duke Bowen is really under a curse?"
Hobert thought for a moment and understood the Queen's meaning: "Because I currently have no power background and have not yet been tied to any interests."
The Queen nodded slightly, "As Georgina said, you are indeed very smart."
Then she promised, "As long as your investigation has a breakthrough progress, I will also promote you to Rear Admiral in advance."
For a demigod, promotion to Rear Admiral is only a matter of time. However, Hobert was not cultivated by the royal family, so he must go through the procedures and work in MI9 for a year or so before being promoted to Rear Admiral.
The hurdle of being promoted to General was once a concern for Christian, but Hobert was not very enthusiastic about this military rank.
The Queen also saw this, and she reacted quickly: "At the same time, I will make you the most prominent member of the Kingdom of Loen."
Alice, who had been listening, suddenly bowed slightly. She understood the Queen's meaning. This meant that the Queen was already considering marrying a princess to Hobert.
The most prominent member of the kingdom is of course a member of the royal family!
If he marries a princess, Hobert will also become a member of the royal family.
Hobert did not understand the Queen. He thought the Queen meant to support him in entering the Upper House.
He knew that if he didn't agree now, he would be too disrespectful to the Queen.
Sometimes, dealing with superiors is so helpless.
Their gifts may not be what you want, but if you don't take them or show any disgust, you will definitely offend them.
"Of course, I will take the task assigned by the Queen to heart," Hobert said, incidentally stating his needs, "If there are any bad rumors about my fief, Long Tail Island, in the future, please don't believe them."
In the future, he will still focus his main energy on the territory, and many of the manor owners on Long Tail Island are operating for nobles, and some have business dealings with the wealthy in Backlund.
When Hobert cleans them up, it may cause condemnation in Backlund.
If the Queen can back him up, those nobles and wealthy people will definitely not dare to say a word.
The Queen readily agreed, "No problem."
For her, that was just an island on the Chaotic Sea that didn't even have a gold mine.
Rumors from that kind of place would not have much impact in Backlund.
Although Hobert had accepted the Queen's mission, he did not intend to investigate it too seriously.
Especially when encountering danger, he would definitely quit.
However, the necessary attitude was still there. Hobert immediately inquired about the specific situation of Duke Bowen and the investigation results of the previous people.
The Queen promised to send Hobert the relevant detailed information tomorrow.
Soon, they returned to King's Avenue and entered Backlund.
Hobert breathed a slight sigh of relief. As long as he sent the mother and daughter back to the palace, his mission today would be basically completed.
Just as he was thinking this, Hobert suddenly sensed danger again.
He suddenly stood up and pulled Alice from her seat.
Clang ~
Almost at the same time, the car window shattered, and two crystal-like short arrows broke through the glass and shot in, hitting the position where Alice had just been sitting, smashing a large hole in the carriage!
A horse's wail came from the front. The remaining force of the two short arrows actually killed a horse!
Chad in the convoy immediately said, "Protect the Queen and Princess!"
The guards surrounded the Queen's carriage in a well-trained manner, and several Beyonders immediately jumped onto the surrounding rooftops to find the assassin who broke the glass.
Hobert once again injected his spirituality into the button provided by the royal family, but he immediately realized that his spirituality seemed to be trapped in a quagmire, and he did not receive any feedback of power at all.
Hobert glanced at the button out of the corner of his eye. He didn't know when, but the surface of the button was already covered with a layer of frost.
Obviously, the other party knew about the Sealed Artifact in Hobert's hand and had made corresponding preparations in advance.
Hobert released the seal on his gloves: "Invisibility is prohibited here!"
Suddenly, Hobert felt that there seemed to be someone coming from the bottom of the carriage. He immediately grabbed Alice's collar, lifted her up, and placed her behind him.
Almost at the moment Alice's feet left the ground, an ice spear-like weapon pierced through the carpet and went straight for Alice.
Hobert kicked it away and stomped down hard, but he didn't hit any target.
Cough cough ~
Alice and the Queen coughed one after another, and they had a slight fever.
Hobert also felt a little uncomfortable in his throat. At the level of a demigod, one would almost never get sick.
The fact that he felt uncomfortable must have been caused by a Beyonder virus.
Since the other party couldn't 'hide' silently, they had to start using other methods to attack.
The two car windows suddenly became deep and dark, and you couldn't see the outside scenery, as if they had turned into a bottomless black hole.
From the left car window glass, thin and tough hairs stretched out, tightly entangling Hobert and Alice, making them unable to move temporarily, but the hair perfectly avoided the Queen.
From the right car window glass, clusters of black flames shot out, flying towards the two people as fast as bullets.
Hobert stared at the flames: "Disorder!"
The black flames perfectly avoided Hobert and Alice, burning off many of the hairs.
Hobert, who had regained some freedom, kicked the right car door away and faced the left car door, which was a little further away: "Banish!"
Under the push of a huge force, the left car door flew away and gradually became illusory, eventually disappearing.
Before everyone could catch their breath, two very illusory hands suddenly stretched out from the wine bottles in the carriage's wine cabinet, grabbed Alice's neck, and tried to drag her into the mirror in the glass bottle.
Hobert grabbed the other party's arm and yanked it outwards.
Although the Beyonders of the "Demoness" pathway have agile skills, they are not known for their strength. She was obviously staggered by Hobert's pull, and seemed to be almost pulled out of the mirror world.
But at the same time, because of this pull, the force that almost broke Alice's neck finally eased.
"Exploit!" Hobert used the rules of Beyonder abilities to prematurely end the opponent's ability to travel through the world in the mirror. Her arms visibly became much more solid, and a head of beautiful hair emerged from the bottle.
Before she could see the opponent's face, the bottle shattered with a crash. Hobert, who was clutching the opponent's arm, was left with only a handful of broken glass.
At this moment, a phantom image was reflected on the window on one side of the street. Before she could see the appearance of the phantom image clearly, it disappeared again, jumping to the glass further away.
It wasn't that the opponent was driven away by Hobert, but that her purpose was assassination. After the surprise attack failed, she chose to retreat immediately.
Hobert, still on guard, realized that the opponent should be a Sequence 4, "Demoness of Despair."
Hobert thought to herself, 'Who are you looking down on? I am an "Earl of the Fallen." You sent a "Demoness of Despair" to assassinate me?'
It's not that the other party was careless, it's just that there was a certain deviation in their information. Currently, only Georgina and a few others in the royal family clearly know that Hobert is a Sequence 4, and others are not yet aware of this.
Being able to sit in the Queen's carriage and protect her at close range immediately exposed the information that Hobert had already advanced to a demigod. But the problem is that they don't have any information about Hobert's battle with other demigods, and they know nothing about Hobert's fighting style.
In addition, they were certain that Hobert had not performed any protection missions before, and believed that Hobert lacked relevant experience, so in the end, they still only dispatched a Sequence 4.
The reason why Hobert has such speculation is because the other party has already carried out two assassinations in a row. This is no longer a warning, but a real assassination!
Regarding this point, even Alice didn't seem to have thought of it. She was a little scared after she was safe: "Did he really want to kill me?"
The Queen also snorted coldly: "That's too much!"
Assassinating a princess in front of the Queen is indeed too much.
The Queen said to Chad outside: "Change the car! Return to the palace as quickly as possible!"
The three of them got into a carriage used by the guards, bypassed the already somewhat dilapidated carriage, and quickly returned to the palace.
When getting out of the carriage, the Queen specifically instructed Hobert behind her: "Come with us."
If there hadn't been this instruction, Hobert would have really planned to find a lounge to hide in. Anyway, they were back in the palace, so even if he didn't closely follow the Queen and Alice, it wouldn't be considered a dereliction of duty on his part.
But since the Queen had said so, he had no choice but to follow behind the mother and daughter.
Leaving the royal stables, crossing the square with the "Protector" sculptures, they arrived at the main hall of the entire Sodela Palace, the Thales Hall.
Only then did Hobert realize that the Queen was going to find the King.
He sighed in his heart: This is the right person to find! Rather than looking for the elusive Demoness Church, it's better to find the King.
This hall doesn't look very grand, but on the four walls of the building are majestic statues. The stone eyes of those statues seem to be looking at everyone approaching the hall with majestic eyes.
This makes the hall full of mystery, and anyone who comes here, including Hobert, who has already been promoted to a demigod, feels that they must submit to the master of this hall.
For the sake of caution, Hobert covered the "Order Wood" and the "Crystal of Order" with a wall of spirituality.
Although after reaching Sequence 4, Hobert can completely control the aura of the "Nation of Disorder," and even angels cannot detect anything unusual, he doesn't know why today, but he always feels a little uneasy.
Hobert was stopped outside the hall. The Queen and Alice simply tidied up their clothes. Alice pulled her collar down, deliberately exposing the ferocious red strangulation marks on her neck, and then they entered the hall together.
More than ten minutes later, the eunuch Bernie came out and said: "His Majesty invites Hobert Jeffrey in for questioning."
Hobert was stunned and handed his cane to Chad on the side. This move was perfectly normal. After all, it would be a little impolite to meet the King with a cane.
Seeing that he handled it very naturally, Hobert breathed a sigh of relief and followed Bernie in.
First, he passed through a corridor full of exquisite works of art and oil paintings, then passed through a banquet hall, and finally came to a spacious room full of birds and flowers, where the mist in Backlund still hadn't dissipated, but it was full of sunshine.
As soon as he entered the door, Hobert glanced at George III. He was obviously stunned, because he felt that the George III in front of him was different from the previous few times they had met!
He couldn't explain exactly where it was different, but he just felt it was different.
According to the court etiquette he had learned before, Hobert knelt on one knee: "Your Majesty, praise your kindness and majesty."
"Get up." George III was also looking at Hobert, and then asked with a curious tone: "Are you the Hobert who performed well in the battle of Feynapotter?"
Hobert realized that George III was actually asking: Are you a believer of the "Creator"?
"There was a "Protector" present at the time, and my contribution was really insignificant." Hobert got up and glanced at the Queen sitting on the King's side and Alice standing by the Queen's side out of the corner of his eye.
George III didn't pay much attention to Hobert's answer, but asked: "Did you solve the two assassinations that Alice suffered?"
"Yes."
"Was the assassin a Demoness?"
Hobert cautiously replied: "The first assassination used curses, I'm not sure, but the assassin on the way back was indeed a "Demoness"!"
George III was a little angry: "These lunatics dare to assassinate the princess! Not driving them all to extinction is my biggest mistake!"
He looked at Alice, his eyes full of doting: "Don't worry, I will definitely find the murderer for you."
Alice, who was originally very noble, was now crying like a pear blossom, nodding pitifully.
At this time, the Queen said meaningfully: "Your Majesty, I know you are busy with affairs, but no matter how busy you are, you should be cautious when choosing cooperation partners."
Hobert understood that the King had never admitted that he had cooperated with the Demoness Sect.
And the Queen should know some inside information, but not much, otherwise she wouldn't be so advising.
The Queen didn't completely expose it, but just expressed her dissatisfaction in the direction of the King: "Today they dare to assassinate the princess, maybe tomorrow they will assassinate me, and the day after tomorrow they will assassinate the King!
"Such a force must be severely Strike!"
The Queen's direction was correct, she just reminded the King: I know you have a certain degree of cooperation.
Then she pointed the contradiction to the Demoness challenging the King's authority.
Hobert interjected: "Your subordinate takes his leave."
George III nodded lightly, and Bernie winked at a guard, who led Hobert away.
After leaving the hall and taking the cane from Chad, Hobert thought of George III he had just seen again: Could it be that the George III's he had seen before were all fake?
He thought about it carefully, and it wasn't impossible.
Hobert remembered that before the Godhood Ceremony, George III seemed to have exploited certain loopholes to advance from Sequence 5 to Sequence 1 all at once, which made his state very unstable. He should be like those Sanguine Dukes in poor condition, and can only be active in certain areas.
Then, those who occasionally appear in public may be his substitutes?
Because Hobert blocked his memories of Adam, he didn't realize that those who appeared in public may also be phantoms conjured up and manipulated by George III.
About twenty minutes later, the Queen and Alice came out, and Hobert followed them back to the main hall of the Queen's palace.
Just as he was about to take his leave again, the Queen suddenly said to him: "Thanks to you being by Alice's side today. I don't know what your preferences are, so I'll reward you with a few trinkets."
For the Queen, Hobert, who seems to have no desires, is the most difficult person to deal with.
Hobert did not refuse: "Thank you, Queen!"
Alice on the side said: "Mother, let Hobert go back with me and protect me throughout the day, okay?"
The Queen smiled and said: "Do you think I, the Queen, am just a decoration?"
She had sternly warned the King today that if the Demoness Church continued to assassinate Alice, then the King would be equal to despising the political power of Duke Bowen!
Hobert, standing below, thought to himself: That's not necessarily true. You only thought of political games, but not the games of Beyonder powers. Besides, it's a well-known fact that George III is a waste of children. Two princes have died last year alone, directly turning the prince into a "high-risk occupation."
"Of course I believe in Mother." Alice sat on the Queen's side and said: "I actually want to ask Hobert for detailed information about the Demonesses."
The Queen glanced at her daughter and then at the sunny and handsome Hobert: "I know, then let him protect you next."
Hobert was a little helpless. He originally thought that today's mission was not difficult, but it turned out that he seemed to be approaching a dangerous vortex all the time.
So Hobert had no choice but to follow Alice back to her palace.
It was a very exquisite courtyard in Sodela Palace. As soon as Alice entered the door, she said to the chief servant who greeted her: "Prepare an extra lunch."
The chief servant, a capable woman in her thirties, glanced at the stranger Hobert behind her and said: "Yes."
"What I mean is, prepare a lunch of the same standard as mine!" Alice added: "Put Earl Jeffrey's tableware in the dining room."
The chief servant couldn't help but glance at Hobert again: "Yes."
It's no wonder that the chief servant was so surprised. Alice had only entertained the late Prince Edessak in her dining room. Today, she made an exception to entertain this Earl, which shows how special this Earl is, or rather, how important he is in Princess Alice's mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 551: Hobert is a good staff member
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Actually, lunchtime had already passed, and Hobert had only been sitting in the lounge for a few minutes when a servant invited him to Alice's dining room.
The princess's dining room was about the same size as the one used in Earl Hobert's mansion, but much more exquisite.
The oil paintings hanging on the walls were much higher quality than those Hobert had hanging in the Earl's mansion hall. One of them looked familiar to Hobert, and he only remembered it after taking a closer look. It was a piece from the art exhibition he had seen with Audrey before.
At the time, neither he nor Audrey had purchased any works from that art exhibition. Audrey didn't because she already had a considerable collection and had excellent painting skills, and there wasn't any piece in the entire exhibition that she particularly liked, so she didn't buy anything.
Hobert simply didn't want to waste his money.
After he sat down, the servant immediately served the dishes and poured Hobert a glass of aperitif.
"Please change it to coffee or juice," Hobert smiled. "I'm still working."
The servant was slightly stunned, but nodded and changed it to juice for Hobert.
"I heard you're usually quite frugal?" Alice, sitting in the main seat, suddenly asked, "Even the dining process is very simple."
Hobert suspected that his eating habits were probably already known throughout the noble circle, but Alice was being polite, not saying he was stingy, only that the "process was simple."
He said, "Yes, Your Highness."
Then he joked, "Maybe I'm not used to the extravagant life that an Earl should have yet."
"If you were the same as other Earls, it wouldn't be interesting," Alice suddenly asked with an aloof expression, "Do you think my leg ring looks good?"
The word "good-looking" was about to come out of Hobert's mouth, but he barely "hit the brakes": "The situation was urgent at the time, I didn't notice."
Truthfully, it wasn't just good-looking, it was also very sexy.
And if he were a leg person, he would probably have already fallen. Alice's legs were indeed impeccable.
Hobert thought to himself: No wonder leg rings later had some other meanings. It's really because they have a special meaning among ornaments.
Then he realized that it was very strange for the princess to ask such a question, and he had to deal with it carefully.
Alice suddenly smiled: "Liar."
Hobert pretended not to hear. No matter what he answered at this time, it would bring endless trouble in the future.
He was also a little helpless: I'm just being a bodyguard for a day, I don't want to be labeled as a 'princess's male favorite' in the noble circle in the future.
Alice was, after all, a princess, and did not continue the topic, but talked about her assassination: "Tonight, I'm going to attend a ball. I think you should have received an invitation too. Do you think there will be another assassination attempt against me then?"
"It's hard to say." Hobert didn't say anything like he would definitely protect the princess, but smiled and said, "The key is that I know nothing about the assassin."
"In any case, thank you very much for your rescue today," Alice smiled. "I have prepared some gifts for you, and they will be sent to your Earl's mansion later."
Hobert did not refuse: "Thank you, Princess."
Next, Alice began to inquire about the witch's abilities. Hobert did not hide this, after all, he also regarded the Demoness Sect as an enemy. In this regard, he was willing to provide some help to Alice.
After dinner, Alice went back to take a nap for a while, and then invited Hobert to the garden for tea, and then took a walk with Hobert in the garden, not allowing any servants to follow.
"You dance very well," Alice suddenly said, "We can dance another dance tonight."
Hobert smiled and said, "That's my honor."
"You probably can't imagine how pathetic it is to be a princess of Loen," Alice changed the subject again, "Watching my dearest brother die, but I can't do anything about it."
Hobert didn't say anything, and he didn't want to comment on it.
And he had roughly guessed that Alice was talking to him alone because she wanted him to investigate Edessak's case.
This was something he would never agree to!
Who knew that Alice would change the subject again: "You and Audrey seem to be friends?"
"Yes." Hobert was a little strange, what exactly did Alice want to say: "We met when I 'left' Backlund."
"Aren't you very curious why I'm talking so incoherently?" Then Alice answered herself, "Because my conversations are always being eavesdropped on, and even written words can be 'eavesdropped' on.
"But according to reliable information I have obtained, the Sealed Artifact that is eavesdropping on our conversation from a distance has a drawback.
"As long as you constantly change the topic, you can effectively avoid this eavesdropping ability. The person holding this Sealed Artifact is too far away from us and cannot discover this, and will only think that we are not talking at this time."
Hobert was slightly stunned: Are you sure that the other party doesn't know about you getting this information? If the other party deliberately let you get this information, or already has a new response, then our changing the topic is just acting for ourselves to see.
If that's really the case, the other party is similar to 'screen peeking' and should be laughing at this time, right?
But thinking about Alice's usual performance, she should have repeatedly confirmed this life-threatening matter.
Then Hobert smiled helplessly: "Then let's talk about some coherent topics."
He felt a big "danger" character was floating above his head, and the next conversation must be very dangerous.
It's not that being eavesdropped on is dangerous, but that he will be very dangerous as long as he knows those things.
"You are a very special noble," Alice changed the subject again, "Before you, no noble dared to look me in the eye when dancing with me, they didn't even dare to keep their eyes on my face."
Several times Alice also felt that her thoughts were very strange, but she was sure that since then, Hobert had gradually become special in her eyes.
Hobert sighed: "It's okay."
After all, it's not like you're that ugly, why wouldn't people look at your face?
"Actually, I know why I was targeted," Alice said, "My investigation has made breakthrough progress. In the past few years, the Demoness Sect has been secretly transporting a large number of slaves to Backlund. Most of these slaves come from the Rorsted Archipelago, and many come from your fief, Longtail Island.
"But after arriving in Backlund, these slaves don't know where they went."
Hobert didn't say anything: I don't know if you believe it? Actually, I know more.
"I heard that you were married once in Feynapotter?" Alice asked, "Why haven't you brought your wife to the ball?"
"My wife doesn't like such occasions," Hobert replied.
"Another thing I can be sure of is that Edessak's death is greatly related to the Demoness Sect," Alice continued to tell her investigation results, "As far as I know, Edessak's beloved Trissy seems to be still alive, and she should know a lot of inside information.
"Also, I heard that she is very special to the Demoness Sect, and so special that she seems to be related to the Primordial Demoness."
Hobert was slightly stunned. He didn't expect that Alice had indeed investigated a lot of key information. Perhaps it was because she knew about Trissy's relevant information that the Demoness Sect was determined to assassinate her.
Alice then changed to another topic: "In this case, your wife is very happy. She can not attend such occasions if she doesn't like them."
Hobert smiled and said, "I can still give her this kind of freedom."
Alice, who was walking in front, stopped, looked back at Hobert, her eyes were a little complicated, took a deep breath and said, "The next investigation may be difficult to continue.
"I found that the royal family is deeply cooperating with the Demoness Sect and the Aurora Order. Although I don't know the purpose of the cooperation, the cooperation project has received the support of the entire royal family."
Hobert was a little helpless and still didn't comment on this topic.
"In this world, no matter how high your status is, you always have to do things against your will," Alice said, "Sometimes I even hate myself for being a princess, or hate the conservative atmosphere of the entire Loen, which makes some of my ideas impossible to express, and can't even be expressed in my expression or eyes."
Hobert scratched his chin, always feeling that Alice's words were meaningful.
Alice sighed: "I'm not interested in the royal family's conspiracy. I just want to know who killed Edessak. I just want to kill that person and take his head to Edessak's grave to pay tribute."
Hobert saw a trace of exhaustion in the princess's eyes, but he still didn't say anything.
"So I said, your wife is happy," Alice returned to the topic of his wife, "She can not attend the ball if she doesn't want to. In my opinion, this is a kind of happiness."
Hobert smiled and said, "Sometimes, this world is not that complicated. Don't do things you don't want to do. Who can't be willful?"
Then he waited for Alice to entrust him to investigate Edessak's case. He was ready to refuse outright and would not leave Alice with any illusions.
But this time Hobert miscalculated. Alice did not entrust him to conduct the investigation, but smiled and said, "Many people have died in the investigation of Edessak's cause of death. Don't worry, I won't entrust it to you.
"I'm telling you this today just because I simply hope that someone knows my investigation results."
She touched her neck, which still had red marks: "Being on the verge of death twice today made me suddenly feel a strong sense of fear of death.
"The first thing I thought of after escaping danger was to let others know about my investigation. If I really die, someone will know my true cause of death.
"It's not that I hope you will avenge me, but I don't want to be used like Edessak after I die, even if someone knows why I died."
This made Hobert slightly stunned. Alice's impression on him was similar to Ethel's, both of whom were "political monsters", but Ethel was more aggressive, even to the point of preparing to compete for the throne.
Alice, in addition to the nobility she showed, was much more peaceful, but the two people's unscrupulous behavior to achieve their goals was quite similar.
It wasn't until Ethel showed anger when she left Jeffrey Town after attending Hobert's wedding that Hobert felt that she was a person of flesh and blood.
And just now, when Alice said she was afraid, he also felt that this was a living person, not a high-level puppet cultivated by the royal family.
Although he was filled with emotion, Hobert would certainly not be impulsive and participate in this matter.
He just said: "Your Highness, your purpose is too clear, at least your opponent completely knows your purpose.
"It's better to do nothing for a while. One is to paralyze the other party, and the other is to look for better opportunities.
"Then your positions will change. You know their purpose, but your purpose is temporarily hidden. Maybe you can take some initiative."
Alice was slightly stunned, thought for a while and said, "If you weren't an Earl now, I would have recruited you as my staff!"
She suddenly smiled: "As you said before, some things are so simple!
"I finally understand Emperor Roselle's saying: People in the game are always easily confused by their opponents, and the bystanders around the chessboard clearly understand the thoughts of the two chess players."
Hobert was slightly stunned: The authorities are confused, the bystanders are clear?
Alice then asked, "What do you think of the tea you just drank?"
Hobert nodded: "It tastes good."
"I'll send you some later."
The two chatted casually for a while. Alice had some affairs to deal with, and Hobert was finally able to go to the lounge to rest.
Looking at Hobert's departing figure, Alice suddenly thought of some novels she had read when she was relaxing.
At that time, she also thought that some descriptions in the novel were ridiculous, but since dancing that dance in the palace banquet hall on April 1, she knew that some people were really special.
Alice had never had this feeling before. It was a completely new experience for her, but she soon sadly discovered that she couldn't do anything, and could only watch Hobert joke with Audrey and the others.
In the evening, Hobert and Alice took a carriage to Earl Vincent's mansion to attend the ball. When he got out of the princess's carriage first, Vincent, who was standing at the door to greet guests, was stunned and didn't know whether he should go up to greet them for a while.
Hobert knew something was wrong when he saw Vincent's expression: We're just going the same way, don't think too much, and don't spread rumors!
Then he smiled and shook his head. He wondered what other nobles would think when they heard that he and Princess Alice shared a carriage to attend the ball. Would everyone follow his example and eat very simply every meal?
Hobert smiled as he helped Alice out of the car in a gentlemanly manner. He wasn't afraid of any misunderstandings, because they would know after a little inquiry that he had the task of protecting the royal family today.
After Alice got out of the car, Vincent reacted: "Your Highness, your arrival has made this banquet more solemn."
Alice maintained her usual noble demeanor: "No, it's just that you have prepared it carefully."
Vincent smiled slightly: "Please come in, I have specially prepared strawberry cream pudding for you."
"It's really something to look forward to." Alice walked inside, saying to Hobert beside her, "Earl Vincent is a gourmet, especially his estate-grown strawberries, which are red and sweet."
Vincent watched the two enter, feeling that something was off, until he greeted two more guests and suddenly realized: Princess Alice's tone was very amiable tonight! There wasn't that feeling of rejecting people from a thousand miles away. Uh, or rather, her tone was very amiable when speaking to Hobert.
On the other side, Hobert didn't take it seriously. Strawberries? What's so great about them?
He remembered strawberry picking festivals in some places where you could eat your fill for very little money, and they even gave you a pound or two to take home.
After chatting with Alice about this topic for a while, Hobert realized that people in this era had not yet fully domesticated strawberries, the reason being simple: because there was no plastic film, strawberries were difficult to grow on a large scale.
If you wanted to grow strawberries, you had to build a glass greenhouse!
So the price of strawberries was very high at this time, and only nobles could afford them.
This gave Hobert another reason to develop the plastics industry as soon as possible.
Seeing the dazzling array of food in the banquet hall, Hobert finally understood why Alice said Vincent was a gourmet.
In his memory, only during the court ball on April 1st was there such an abundance of food, and the key was that every dish was delicious.
For example, Hobert didn't used to like lamb chops very much, but he didn't expect them to be made so delicious.
In addition, Hobert had pigeon meat for the first time in Backlund, as well as crispy on the outside and tender on the inside roast suckling pig, delicious venison, and swan meat, which was relatively precious to nobles. Dishes like foie gras and steak were second-class foods at this banquet.
Moreover, Earl Vincent knew how to match the food very well. Shrimp, crab, fish and other seafood were interspersed among the dishes, as well as fresh vegetable salads, especially the fruits at the banquet, which even Alice praised repeatedly.
For example, pineapples, which were not very valuable in Hobert's memory, were shipped from the Rorsted Archipelago and stored in cold storage until early summer, still fresh and juicy. Pineapples at this time of year were not something ordinary people could afford.
What Hobert found peculiar was that red and juicy watermelons were also regarded as very good fruits by the nobles. Hobert clearly remembered that he used to eat half a watermelon in a morning.
After chatting for a while, he learned that most of the watermelons at this time were not very sweet, and most of them had very little flesh.
Hobert then realized the importance of agricultural research. Fruits that were commonplace in his time were scarce here.
At the same time, Hobert realized that his understanding of this world was not detailed enough, and he only learned these common sense things today.
Or rather, he simply didn't have access to so many fruits in his previous life, so he didn't notice.
After the dance began, Hobert, who was already full, asked Alice to dance, which made many people look sideways, because they realized that before this social season, they hadn't seen the princess dance for a long time.
And this seemed to be Alice's second dance this social season, and the key was that both times were with the same person.
At this time, some noble ladies began to talk about how they saw Hobert and the princess come to the ball together today, and it was said that they were having a good time at the table.
Some squires felt that this might be a signal, and they had completely given up hope of marrying Hobert.
At about eight o'clock in the evening, Hobert handed over the button and charm to Klement in a corner where no one was paying attention. His task for today was finally completed.
Hobert stepped forward and said to Alice, "Your Highness, Mr. Klement is here."
Alice nodded slightly. She knew that she was surrounded by noble ladies. After Hobert's task was completed, he would not stay by her side. "Let's talk again when we have time."
Hobert smiled and nodded, then nodded to the other ladies as he left the ladies' gathering.
In the distance, he saw Georgina, who had also come to the ball, so he walked straight over: "Chief."
Generally, Georgina stayed alone at the ball. She seemed to know what Hobert wanted to say: "According to the regulations, official business is not discussed in public."
"Countess..." As Hobert spoke, he waved to the wine waiter. The moment he took a glass from the tray, it seemed that his hand slipped slightly, and the glass fell, spilling bright red wine.
Just as the wine was falling, Hobert suddenly "distorted" the direction of the wine's fall. The spilled wine actually drew an "L" shape, and some of it splashed on Georgina's evening dress.
Hobert's "performance" was very natural, and Georgina didn't even guard against it. When she realized Hobert's intention, she couldn't completely avoid it.
At this time, Georgina sighed: How could a demigod knock over a glass because of a slip of the hand? But Hobert's performance was so seamless that I didn't react for a moment.
Hobert couldn't help but grin, and quickly apologized: "Sorry, Chief, my hand slipped."
He said to the waiter: "Please prepare a private room."
This kind of situation was very common at balls. The waiter nodded slightly and invited them to a small reception room around the ballroom.
Georgina shook her head with a smile: It's really not a good idea to mention "regulations" to Beyonders of the "Lawyer" pathway.
Arriving at the small reception room, Hobert took the towel handed by the waiter, then closed the door and said: "I only knew halfway through the mission that the Queen took the initiative to borrow me.
"Why didn't the Chief tell me about this?"
Georgina opened Hobert's hand, snatched the towel, and bent over to wipe the wine stains on her skirt: "Did you think you were working at a newspaper? Wanting to publish all the news you know?"
"The nature of our work is confidential, and I will not allow anyone to violate this!"
Of course, Hobert knew the nature of MI9's work. In fact, the reason why he questioned Georgina was more to express his attitude.
Sometimes, it may be just because the other party said one less sentence that he would be in extremely dangerous situation.
In order to avoid such a thing from happening, of course, he had to warn the other party.
So Hobert spread his hands: "Of course I will keep it secret, but you should tell me some information in advance, otherwise I will think it is a betrayal!"
"If I said it, would you have taken on that task so readily?" Georgina threw the towel on the chair beside her: "If one day I tell you all the information that should and shouldn't be said, then, if nothing else, my condition should be very bad.
"We are colleagues, if you have a chance, save me."
This was to indicate that unless she lost control, she would definitely act according to the regulations, but after all, we are colleagues, I will give you some hints.
But because Georgina was his superior, and Hobert had a threatening tone just now, her tone was very bad, and after she finished speaking, Georgina left the reception room without looking back.
Hobert also followed out. He didn't care too much about Georgina's anger towards him. On the contrary, their conversation was very effective. Hobert expressed his attitude, and Georgina also explained her attitude.
After arriving at Audrey and Glaint, Audrey asked curiously: "Hobert, some people say that you and Princess Alice came in the same carriage?"
"Yes."
"Why?"
Hobert suddenly discovered a very troublesome thing. According to the regulations of MI9, the content of his work today must be kept secret.
So: Why did you come to the ball with Princess Alice in the same carriage? And stay by her side all the time?
Hobert could only answer: Keep it secret, or guess.
Such an answer is a bit like "five thousand words are omitted here"!
Now he is a little worried about whether the things tonight will ferment?
