chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 552: Mr. Azik Arrives in Jeffrey City
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Midway through the ball, Earl Vincent, holding a wine glass, came over to chat with Hobert.
Given Vincent's seniority, he would normally be with Christian and Earl Hall, but he came to talk to Hobert because his youngest son, Karl, was currently working in Hobert's territory.
Hobert's personal valet, or rather, his student, Dennis, now frequently traveled between Backlund and Jeffrey City, sometimes helping the noble children send letters home.
Hobert had announced the relevant confidentiality clauses from the beginning, so those noble children probably knew that they were currently within the territory of Feynapotter, but their parents thought they were on Long Tail Island.
Karl had already written two letters home, and from some details, Vincent learned about some of Hobert's management methods for the territory, which made him look at Hobert with new eyes.
Most importantly, in Hobert's territory, there was a training mechanism for officials, and Karl had to go to the town government every three days to study, and the content of the study was knowledge and precautions for solving practical problems.
What surprised Vincent was that his youngest son, Karl, whom he had never been optimistic about, was making rapid progress, especially in his thinking about solving problems, which had undergone tremendous changes.
This made Vincent want to actively get closer to Hobert, and he realized that Hobert would definitely achieve greater success in the future.
And with Karl following Hobert, the Vincent family would also be able to reap many benefits.
After the ball ended today, Hobert returned to the Earl's mansion somewhat tiredly, first thinking about the Queen's request, and then recalling Alice's unusual behavior today, thinking and thinking, he actually fell asleep for once.
Early the next morning, Hobert came to Military Intelligence Section Nine, changed into his uniform, and just sat down when Sharlene handed him a bill and a folder: "Chief, this was just sent by the Chief Director's secretary."
Hobert glanced at it, it was a receipt for a black women's evening dress, worth 180 pounds.
He smiled: "Cheapskate!"
Hobert then thought of the evening dress Georgina wore yesterday: the style was obviously so old-fashioned, and it still cost 180 pounds! The last time I bought Audrey such a youthful and beautiful dress, it was only 160 pounds.
Then Hobert seemed to think of something, and pushed the bill back to Secretary Sharlene: "Go to the finance department and help me reimburse this bill."
Sharlene was slightly stunned: "What reason should I use to reimburse it?"
"Losses during the mission." Hobert said: "Give the reimbursed money to the Chief Director's secretary."
Sharlene was a little unsure: "This reason..."
A male chief, reimbursing a women's evening dress, this was indeed a bit unbelievable.
Hobert smiled: "When you treat everyone at noon, please invite the colleagues from the finance department as well."
It had been decided last week to treat the entire section to a big meal today.
After Sharlene left, Hobert glanced at the folder that was sent together, he knew that it was the information the Queen gave him.
However, he didn't even look at it and put it in the drawer.
I just want to slack off today, I'll talk about this task in a couple of days.
...
Tingen City, North Sector, 66 Fania Street.
Serena jumped out of the rental carriage and stretched hard.
After paying the fare with her luggage bag, she stepped forward and knocked on the door.
"Who is it?" After more than ten seconds, Mrs. Wood's voice came from inside.
"It's me, Mom."
Mrs. Wood suddenly opened the door: "Heavens, am I dreaming! Is it really you, Serena?"
It had only been three or four months since they last met, but Serena gave people a completely different feeling. Her wine-red hair was tied into a very neat bun, making her look much more mature all of a sudden.
Her face was full of confident smiles, and she was wearing a suit instead of a girl's dress.
It was as if when she left, she was just a teenager, but when she came back, she was already in her twenties.
"Of course it's me!" Serena warmly gave her mother a hug and greeted the maid: "I have two days off, so I came back to see you."
Mrs. Wood was overjoyed: "I, I'll go tell your father."
"No, Mom." Serena smiled: "When he sees me when he gets off work, it will definitely be a huge surprise for him, right! Is there anything to eat at home? I haven't had lunch yet."
While eating, Serena chatted with Mrs. Wood, and she learned that her brother Chris was preparing to marry his fiancée Vina in the near future, but the wedding date had not yet been finalized.
This was because their savings were not enough, even if they added the savings of Mr. and Mrs. Wood, they would not be able to hold a decent wedding.
If it really didn't work, they could only get married first and hold the wedding later, because Vina was pregnant.
Serena, eating bread, was already preparing to leave the 30 pounds in cash she had saved up during this time.
She had saved more than 30 pounds during this time, but she had always been living in the Earl's mansion, and there were not many places to spend money.
For the middle class, 30 pounds could hold a very decent wedding. If there was still a need for money, she planned to borrow from Dennis and Freya after returning.
After eating dinner, Serena returned to her room, saw her unchanged bed and wardrobe, saw the mystical materials she had bought with her pocket money, and saw the occult books and her notes that could be bought on the market.
She immediately felt a very strong sense of separation, as if she saw her ignorant self still wandering in this room.
Serena sat alone in the chair for a long time before finally recovering: the current Serena is no longer the Serena of the past.
Recalling the changes in the past few months, Serena herself could hardly believe it: "It turns out that going from relying on parents to being independent and autonomous is not as difficult as I thought, well, that's because I met a good mentor."
In the afternoon, Mr. Wood came home from work, and when he saw his daughter setting the table with his wife, his somewhat numb face was full of disbelief, and finally there was some smile.
When Chris also came home from work, the restaurant was full of laughter.
During this time, in order to save expenses, dinner was not very rich, there was no wine on the table, only mutton stewed with potatoes with a few pieces of meat, but it still couldn't stop their good mood.
Chris asked Serena: "Your letter said that you have returned to Backlund?"
"Yes." Serena would write home regularly, but she would only tell them where she was now, what kind of work she was doing, and other information.
Chris stuck out his tongue and sighed: "Your life is really magical. Some time ago, you were a grassroots official abroad, and now you are a housekeeper assistant in Backlund."
His sticking out his tongue was a "sequelae" left in the Boklun Mountains at the beginning of the year, and his fiancée Vina also had this habit.
Serena smiled: "Chris, this is the life I like!"
Mr. Wood smiled happily and didn't say anything. Before, his plan was that after Serena finished technical school, he would find her a stable technical or design job in the factory, and after accumulating a certain amount of experience, she would get married and have children in an orderly manner.
Since his daughter suddenly left home, saying that she wanted to pursue her dream, Old Wood's mentality has undergone no small changes. As long as his daughter is healthy and safe, sends a letter home once a week, and comes back to see him often, he will be content.
After eating dinner, the family played cards for a while, and Old Wood and his wife went back to rest first.
Serena and Chris, like before, came to the small living room on the second floor where only a small table and two chairs could be placed, and chatted while drinking tea.
Serena took this opportunity to give Chris her 30 pounds of savings.
This surprised Chris a little: "Where did you get so much money?"
"I didn't write clearly in the letter." Serena smiled: "I am actually a housekeeper assistant in an earl's mansion now, and the salary is very high."
In fact, most of her savings came from the pocket money Hobert gave to the students.
Chris declined twice, but seeing that Serena insisted on giving it, he accepted it, because he really needed the money now.
Then he sighed: "Backlund really has more opportunities."
"You haven't seen the other side of Backlund." Serena's expression suddenly became serious: "I have a colleague from the slums of the East Borough, and everything that happens there is chilling just to hear about."
...
Time goes back three hours.
Backlund, South of the Bridge District, inside Vasco Public Elementary School.
Daisy, who was cleaning the school kitchen, heard the school worker shout: "Daisy, someone is looking for you!"
Daisy was slightly stunned. Since her mother passed away and Freya left Backlund, no one had come to see her.
Sometimes she would sadly think that she would have to face a lonely life alone from now on.
Daisy wiped her hands and walked unhurriedly towards the school gate. Is that Freya waving to her?
At first, she couldn't believe it, and then tears welled up uncontrollably: "Freya! Freya, is it really you?"
Freya smiled through her tears. Although she had returned to Backlund for more than a month, she had been very busy. Now that Hobert had given her a vacation, she finally had time to see Daisy.
She hugged Daisy, who was throwing herself into her arms, tightly: "It's me, Daisy, yes, it's me!"
Daisy, who was usually very strong, was crying very hard at this moment, as if venting the loneliness and fear suppressed in her heart.
After crying for a full three minutes, Daisy released Freya: "I'm sorry, Freya, I got your dress dirty. It, it looks very expensive, right?"
She felt a little unfamiliar with the Freya in front of her. The originally introverted and shy sister was now confident and sunny, with shiny hair and a good complexion.
Especially Freya's dress, which looked new and beautiful.
Completely different from the girl who used to make a living by washing clothes.
Freya took out a handkerchief and wiped away her sister's tears: "It's okay, Daisy. I brought you two dresses too, look."
She took out two new dresses from her backpack.
Daisy was overjoyed, fondling them and looking at them over and over again.
Several classmates in her class laughed at her for her clothes being too small, and she was very envious of the new clothes of several classmates in the class.
The last time she got new clothes was a long, long time ago, and she had already forgotten the feeling of getting new clothes.
Freya took out another cloth bag: "There are also two pairs of new shoes, several pairs of socks, and several pieces of cotton underwear inside."
Daisy suddenly froze: "Freya, I, I only need one dress. You, you don't have to work so hard."
She didn't know where these clothes came from, but she knew that Freya must have put in a lot of effort to get them.
At this moment, she felt inexplicably distressed.
Freya, who hadn't cried much just now, couldn't stop the tears from flowing out at this moment: "Daisy, your sister has a formal job now. We don't have to worry about clothes and shoes being too small anymore."
In the sisters' memories, it seemed that they had never had a pair of shoes that fit.
Daisy was a little incredulous: "Really?"
"Really." Freya smiled and said: "I am now a police officer. My salary is enough to support us."
Moreover, there was also the 10 pounds of pocket money that Hobert gave to the students every week. She didn't spend a penny of this money, and saved a full 40 pounds.
Daisy was even more incredulous: "How could you become a police officer?"
"No, I'm not like Abel. I brought basic justice to that neighborhood, and everyone loves me." Freya smiled and said: "I also brought you this."
Abel was the police officer in the neighborhood where they used to live. Everyone gritted their teeth when they mentioned him, but there was nothing they could do about him.
As Freya spoke, she took out two apples from her backpack.
Daisy intoxicatedly smelled the fragrance of the fruit: "I have forgotten the taste of apples, but Freya, these two apples are so strange. Why haven't they been cut open?"
The apples they had eaten before had to be cut off a part.
Freya said: "Because these two apples have no rotten spots. And this…"
She took out a piece of stewed meat wrapped in oiled paper: "From now on, every week, you have to eat a piece of stewed meat or a fish, and two apples."
Daisy glanced at her sister, knowing that it was safe to eat, so she put the clothes and apples aside and devoured them.
The aroma of the meat made the school worker next to her swallow her saliva. Freya stepped forward and handed the school worker a pack of cigarettes wrapped in newspaper that she had prepared long ago, about a dozen in total, and thanked the school worker very politely.
In fact, the school worker had been standing aside watching to avoid Freya being a thief, and now he was a little embarrassed to receive Freya's cigarettes.
After Daisy finished eating the meat, Freya asked: "Isn't school over? Why are you still helping in the kitchen?"
Daisy briefly described her current situation. It turned out that the foundation established by Capim's inheritance was only responsible for Daisy's tuition and meal expenses.
Accommodation fees were not included. In order to solve Daisy's accommodation problem, the school asked Daisy to work as a helper in the kitchen, which was equivalent to deducting her accommodation fees.
Freya nodded slowly: "You don't have to help anymore in the future."
She said: "I will come over again tomorrow to pay your accommodation fee."
Hobert had talked to Freya about Daisy's problem. Hobert's suggestion was to maintain the status quo, because in the future he might send Freya to Longtail Island, or have other assignments. At that time, Freya would no longer be in Backlund.
Could it be that Daisy would have to live outside by herself at that time?
In addition, the public school Daisy is currently in is actually very good. If she were to go to a better private aristocratic school, the living and learning conditions would be better, but in that kind of environment, it would be easy for Daisy to become inferior.
Freya felt that the teacher made a lot of sense, so she didn't give Daisy too many promises.
Daisy said again: "Freya, you don't have to work so hard."
… …
Hobert gave the two students a vacation because they had basically digested the potion. He wanted them to relax, adjust their state, and then prepare them for advancement.
Only Dennis had been busy with immigration matters recently and didn't have much time to go to the law firm, so he hadn't fully digested the potion yet.
On Wednesday morning, Hobert used the "Nation of Disorder" to complete two transactions. One was the arms transaction agreed with Ulysses before, and the other was the steam engine transaction with the Balk family in the Southern Continent.
On Ulysses' side, Hobert directly "traveled" to the armory and sacrificed the weapons to the "Nation of Disorder". Archibald completed the ceremony of granting in the military camp.
Suddenly, there was a mountain of weapons, and the key was that there were more than a dozen cannons. Seel and the others didn't react for a long time.
The steam engine transaction was about the same, except that Elliott completed the granting ceremony.
Not long after the ceremony ended, Hobert took a trip to the Southern Continent using "Travel" and talked to Lawrence, the patriarch of the Balk family, alone, hoping to recruit a squad of Beyonders from the Balk family.
Of course, the Balk family would not be allowed to work for nothing. Hobert would arm this squad with 1 Beyonder characteristic of "Mentor of Disorder" and 2 Beyonder characteristics of "Baron of Corruption", and would also provide them with 2 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts.
The condition was that this squad must absolutely obey the orders of the "Favored". If members of the squad were sacrificed, the Balk family would need to replenish them.
In the composition of Hobert's extraordinary power, he certainly would not allow the Tudor family's power to dominate.
Lawrence immediately agreed. Before, when he heard Elliott talk about the power of the "Creator" in the Northern Continent, he once thought that that was the main extraordinary power loyal to the "Creator".
At least their battles were directly under the command of the "Favored" and would be helped by the "Creator". That might be the battle that happened under the instruction of the "Creator".
The Balk family, located in the Southern Continent, seemed to have never entered the core level of the extraordinary power loyal to the "Creator".
Now that the "Favored" personally came to recruit and gave such generous conditions, they would of course immediately agree.
I believe that the selected team members will definitely feel very honored.
After the agreement was reached quickly, Hobert asked Lawrence to choose people first, and he would come to pick them up in a week, and suggested that Lawrence send several more batches of family members to the Northern Continent to learn advanced technology and management methods.
Hobert also planned to spend some money to fund the young people of the Balk family to travel to various countries in the Northern Continent to see what the world looks like now.
In the afternoon, Hobert had already appeared in Jeffery City and went to the villa arranged for Winston. The old man didn't go fishing today: "You came just in time!"
Winston, who had shaved his beard clean, said: "I was just about to have someone look for you."
The mystical items that Hobert entrusted him to make were all completed. Winston took out one of the rapiers: "This is a weapon made with the materials you provided."
Hobert took the weapon and was slightly stunned. Such a large piece of material was only used to make a rapier?
Fortunately, he didn't let his doubts show, because Winston followed up with an explanation: "Its first ability is to change its own shape."
"It is now a rapier, but it can be turned into a normal-sized sword, or even a two-handed greatsword!"
"This is the thinnest and smallest state. As long as it is within the scope of the material volume, you can arbitrarily change its shape, length, and thickness."
Hobert sighed: "This is a masterpiece of a grandmaster!"
He injected spirituality into the rapier and sure enough felt that he could control the size and thickness of the rapier. After the change, it could also ensure that it was very sharp.
Hobert couldn't help but think of the "Golden Cudgel (Staff of the Monkey King)".
Winston smiled and accepted Hobert's compliment, continuing to explain, "Its other abilities are all related to the 'Death' pathway. When used, it can emit attacks similar to 'Words of the Dead,' causing enemies to feel involuntary fear and retreat; it will also make the target feel cold all over, slowing their movements.
"These 'Words of the Dead' are very special, and have a miraculous effect against Beyonders of the 'Death' pathway. Beyonders of the 'Death' pathway below the level of demigod will completely lose their ability to resist, and Beyonders at the demigod level will also be significantly affected.
"Another ability is that as long as it pierces any part of the target's body, the target's spiritual body will suffer permanent damage.
"Even angel-level spiritual bodies are no exception, but they have many ways to circumvent this, making it difficult to truly harm them."
Hobert sighed, "This is completely a different level of weapon compared to my previous black knife!"
Winston smiled without saying a word, watching Hobert play with the rapier for a while, the old man then said, "My commission is complete, and I should be leaving."
Hobert smiled, "How should I thank you?"
"Your hospitality is the best thanks." Hobert's hospitality here was indeed quite good. He could fish in the entire Full Moon Lake as he pleased, and there were chefs from Feynapotter City to help cook the fish.
When he was in the mood, he could take the little train to tour the mountains or go to the entertainment center.
"Then stay here for a while," Hobert said, "I plan to place the second 'Traveler's Door' between Jeffery Territory and an island. You can go to that island to try fishing for sea fish."
Winston was slightly stunned, obviously tempted.
"I'll also invite a few chefs from Backlund who are good at cooking fish, and I've also heard that there are many chefs in Bayam who are good at cooking sea fish, so you can eat fish of all flavors."
Winston swallowed his saliva, "That's right, the fish made in Bayam is spicy, but it has a unique flavor, especially the local grilled fish, which is very distinctive."
Hobert promised, "Within three days, I will invite the best chef from Bayam for you!"
This matter could be entrusted to Rafter.
Winston finally stayed, and Hobert was relieved, taking the remaining mystical items to leave.
Before leaving, Winston instructed, "Although the 'Traveler's Door' is a combination of magical item and magic circle, in theory, there will not be too many negative effects, but you should also pay attention, do not let too many people enter the 'Traveler's Door' at once.
"'Low-Sequence' Beyonders should use the 'Traveler's Door' as little as possible to avoid some corruption from the spirit world. After all, this is not a true 'travel,' without the protection of corresponding Beyonder abilities.
"'Mid-Sequence' Beyonders should pay attention, do not look around in the spirit world. After using the 'Traveler's Door,' there is a small probability of spiritual instability, and the negative effect of suddenly becoming a road idiot will occur, but these effects can be recovered on their own after a certain period of time."
Hobert glanced at the "Traveler's Door" in his hand: "Okay!"
He didn't expect that the "Traveler's Door" would have so many probabilistic negative effects, and he would have to design a regulation for using the "Traveler's Door" when he had time.
Back at the lord's mansion, Hobert took out the rapier again and looked at it again. Just now, he felt that this weapon had some connection with the "wedding gift" that Azik had given him before.
He remembered that Mr. Azik said that the "wedding gift" he gave him was a mark, which was equivalent to giving him the authority to mobilize a part of the underworld's power.
Even without the honor in the Southern Continent during the Fourth Epoch, this gift was quite powerful! It was a pity that Hobert was not a Beyonder of the "Death" pathway, otherwise he would definitely be able to develop more uses for this gift.
Hobert strengthened the connection between the rapier and the mark, and with a casual wave, it was as if he had cut through a transparent piece of paper, and a huge gap appeared in front of him.
The surrounding temperature was immediately sucked away, and the entire room was filled with an unspeakable sense of fear. Illusory figures lay around the gap, peeking into the real world.
Hobert discovered that he had actually opened a gap between the underworld and the real world in this way.
However, without the obstruction of the "Underworld Gate," the terrifying creatures inside could easily drill out.
The reason why they didn't come out now was just because they were afraid of the rapier in Hobert's hand and Azik's mark on Hobert.
Hobert waved the rapier again, and the gap in front of him disappeared: This ability should be more aggressive than the "Underworld Gate," because I can command those monsters lying around the gap to come out and attack the target.
At the same time, Hobert himself could also use this gap to enter the underworld, but with "Travel," entering the underworld was not very useful.
Since it is a rapier, the "Order Wood" can be turned into a thinner, or more normal, cane.
After wrapping the rapier with the "Order Wood," Hobert sacrificed the other extraordinary items to the "Nation of Disorder," and briefly looked at their abilities and negative effects.
Hobert found that he now had three mystical items with "Shepherd" abilities. Because he had "1-109," these three extraordinary items were useless to Hobert.
Hobert decided that he could give these three sealed items to his confidants in the form of rewards. For Beyonders below the demigod level, sealed items with the ability to "graze" were very practical.
And for them, this was definitely a first-class magical item. Even if they could only use it temporarily, they would definitely be grateful to Hobert.
Hobert could also use their use to graze some souls, otherwise they would be "empty" in the "Nation of Disorder."
Coming out of the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert was about to build the "Traveler's Door" between Jeffery City and Shipyard Island, but his spirituality sensed something, and he glanced in the direction of the yard, as if an acquaintance had come.
He put the "Traveler's Door" aside first and opened the door to take a look outside.
In the yard, there was a middle-aged man with gentle features and brown skin, admiring the surrounding Feynapotter-style architecture with his hands behind his back.
The servants and guards in the yard were all ignoring him.
Hobert was a little surprised: "Mr. Azik!"
That middle-aged man was Azik, he smiled slightly: "I heard that you have been doing a lot of big things recently?"
Hobert thought to himself: Are you referring to Hobert or the "Creator"?
He smiled and said, "Just some things that go with the flow. Please come in and sit down."
"Take me around your territory," Azik said, "I heard in Feynapotter City that the South Colson area has a new look."
"No problem," Hobert smiled, "Let's go to the pier and take the train."
Azik followed behind and asked curiously, "I heard that there were some miracles when that railway was being built?"
"What miracles?" Hobert smiled, "Just using ritual magic to transport some building materials.
"But at that time, my rule was not as stable as it is now, so I declared it a miracle."
Azik smiled, "In the previous few meetings, I didn't think you could do so well when ruling a territory."
Hobert lied, "Maybe there is indeed a component of talent. I didn't expect myself to do so well before."
Azik's questions either involved the "Creator" or the matter of transmigration. There was no way, Hobert had to muddle through.
It was Azik. If Klein asked himself like this, Hobert would suspect whether this kid was testing him?
At this time, they came to the street. Everyone greeted Hobert warmly as usual, and at the same time cast curious glances at Azik, wondering what was so special about this guest? The Earl was going to personally entertain him?
The tourists also watched this scene with great curiosity. They had heard in Feynapotter City that there was no need to salute the lord and nobles in South Colson, and officials and policemen would chat and laugh with the common people.
This was an incredible thing in both the North and South Continents.
Fortunately, Azik did not ask those questions that made Hobert stand ready, but looked at the shops on the street with Hobert's gaze: "There are many nobles and wealthy people among the tourists here."
Hobert explained with a smile, "I built an extraordinary auction house on the other side of the mountain, and many nobles and wealthy people come here because of its reputation.
"My wife has been taking care of the affairs of the auction house. I heard that some wild Beyonders have begun to participate in the auction and the Beyonder gatherings that follow.
"I believe that the extraordinary transactions in Jeffery City will definitely become more and more prosperous in the future."
Then he sighed, "However, there are still too few ordinary tourists. We've opened three shipping lanes, and each lane has three passenger ships docking every day, but sometimes a medium-sized passenger ship only has seven or eight passengers."
He laughed, "Half of them are government officials from the lord's manor."
As they walked along the stone-paved road, Azik smiled and said, "Don't worry, tourist cities attract popularity little by little."
Hobert nodded, "Currently, I'm planning to launch some special delicacies, special products, and so on to gather popularity as soon as possible. Well, I'm planning to hold a tourism festival in May and a picking festival on the opposite bank in June."
"I believe that next year, the situation will be much better than it is now."
Azik couldn't help but glance at Hobert, "Your ideas are very… very creative!"
The words "tourism" and "festival" were commonplace, but it was the first time Azik had heard them linked together as a phrase.
Moreover, he didn't quite understand what a "tourism festival" meant. But he was too embarrassed to ask, and in the end, he could only sigh, "Young people's ideas are really novel!"
Walking and stopping, the two arrived at the pier, just in time for the afternoon train.
When the passengers saw Hobert boarding the train, they all stood up to chat with him.
Hobert naturally chatted with them about current prices and wages, as well as the progress of the territory's projects, poultry farming topics, and so on.
This surprised the tourists from other places and Azik, because they had never seen a nobleman who knew so much about the prices of vegetables and daily necessities, or even how to raise poultry.
It took them more than half an hour to get away from the chatting and reach the first carriage, which was rarely open to the public.
At this time, the train was just starting to move slowly. Before he could sit down, Azik couldn't help but ask, "You seem very approachable, but why haven't you opened this luxurious carriage to the public?"
"Being approachable is a way to make the social atmosphere more relaxed. The previous secret organizations put too much psychological pressure on the people." Hobert invited Azik to sit down, then took out a bottle of wine from the wine cabinet:
"I remember very clearly that when I first came here, I was standing at the gate of the lord's manor, overlooking the town of Jeffrey at the foot of the mountain."
"As a result, the town with more than a thousand people didn't have a single sound of talking!"
He poured a glass of wine for Azik, "Now, if you come and take a look, you can hear the noise from the town even in the lord's manor."
Hobert handed the wine to Azik, "As for this carriage, it's to show the lord's authority."
"A lord must indeed have an approachable side, but also an authoritative side, so that he can have a stronger control over the people in the territory."
Azik took the wine and smiled, "I didn't expect that there would be so much knowledge in ruling a territory."
Hobert was stunned: Didn't you used to be the "Death Consul"? No… The rule at that time was not called rule at all. It was just a rough order established by Beyonder power in operation. Seeing the order of Jeffrey City, Mr. Azik did not recall his memory as the "Death Consul", which shows that the social status of the Southern Continent at that time was not comparable to that of the Southern Colson area at all.
He also poured himself a glass of wine, and then began to talk about the new district of Jeffrey City: "That's the new district. Hospitals, schools and other supporting facilities have been built and have already begun to operate."
Most of the construction sites in the new district have been basically completed, and the few construction sites that are still under construction are basically building residences.
"That piece of land is also included in the new district, and that piece too. Those are all left for building residential areas."
"Currently, there are only two or three thousand permanent residents living in Jeffrey City. My initial plan was for a small city that could accommodate 30,000 people, and the supporting facilities were built according to 30,000 people."
"In the next step, the more residential areas are built, the more people can live in. However, it is estimated that it will take a few more years before the population can reach the level of a small city."
Now the new district is still very deserted. If it weren't for the hospitals and schools being there, there shouldn't be any popularity at all.
Tourists only go to the newly built square at most for a walk, and the newly built commercial street has not yet been occupied by any shops.
But so many brand-new buildings, just standing quietly on this land, still make Hobert feel very proud.
As the train began to climb the slope, the whole picture of the new district gradually emerged. Azik took a sip of wine and said, "There are very few such urban plans."
He smiled and said, "According to some of my memories, I have witnessed the development of some cities. Those cities were all built in disorder at the beginning."
"It was not until the operation of the city was affected that some urban transformations had to be carried out, but this city was planned before it was built."
Azik was right. Most of the cities in the Northern Continent came from this way. At the beginning, there was a period of barbaric development.
Hobert heard that Backlund was also like this. Some streets used to be very narrow, and even carriages could not pass through.
For a long time, Backlund was only a medium-sized city that could only accommodate hundreds of thousands of people from the current point of view.
However, the Empress Borough has not undergone major reconstruction, because the location of the Sodela Palace, hundreds of years ago, there were no buildings around except the palace.
It is said that at that time, the palace was only one-third of its current size, and the surrounding area was forests and farmland.
It is hard to imagine how much wealth people have created in these hundreds of years without large-scale wars.
At this time, the train completed the process of climbing the slope, and the scene changed accordingly. As far as the eye can see, it is pastoral scenery.
The fields are full of wheat, and the neat ears of wheat form a wheat wave in the breeze.
On the train, everyone who saw this scene seemed to see infinite hope in the field.
Hobert sighed, "Time flies so fast. In about a month, the wheat will be harvested."
Azik suddenly thought of the scene a long time ago when he led the knights to chase and kill the enemy in the wheat field and let the enemy's blood spill on the wheat.
He couldn't help but pinch his forehead. It seemed that there was no memory of harvest in his entire mind.
Seeing that Azik's face was not very good, Hobert did not introduce his agricultural policy, but after the train started to turn, he pointed to the mountain on the opposite bank and said, "Look, that is the plantation area of the Southern Colson area."
"The first batch of vegetables will mature in early May. The varieties of vegetables have been improved by the bishops and missionaries of the Earth Mother Church. They are larger and can be stored for a longer time than vegetables in other places."
"The first batch of mature vegetables is mainly cabbage. In addition to selling it in the Southern Colson area, I will also have people transport it to other places to sell in bulk."
"The agricultural and animal husbandry knights in the territory have calculated that even if the freight is added, it is far lower than the wholesale price of vegetables in Feynapotter City."
Speaking of this, Hobert suddenly smiled: I have planted vegetables in the extraordinary world!
At the same time, he also found that the vegetable production in the North and South continents was actually very low at this time, and most of the production was in the nobles' manor.
Even fresh vegetables represent the nobles' special supply. The vegetables that ordinary families eat are mostly peas, potatoes, and onions, which can be stored for a long time.
At this time, the "cabbage price" is not a low price.
Later, Hobert studied it and realized that if there is no unified organization and advocacy, ordinary farmers would not dare to grow vegetables at all.
If you can't sell the grain, you can eat it yourself, but if you can't sell the vegetables, you can only rot them in the ground, and you will not be able to harvest anything because you missed the planting of the grain.
If you want the "cabbage price" to really become a cabbage price, you need a very stable grain price and grain supply, as well as providing enough vegetable sales channels, so that everyone realizes that growing vegetables is more profitable than growing grain, then they will spontaneously grow vegetables.
However, the people on the west coast do not have such awareness yet. Currently, the land for growing vegetables is basically the land of Viscount Teuton and the unowned land.
In this regard, Hobert has to thank the Feynapotter royal family, because the first batch of investment in the characteristic agriculture of the West Coast came from the royal family, but that investment was quickly controlled and used by Hobert, and eventually intercepted the investment results.

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - 553: So You Are Mr. Emperor (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:

[100 powerstones bonus]
"That over there is South Colson's industrial zone." Hobert pointed to the wilderness formed by the angel-level battle: "Currently, all industrial products in the South Colson area need to be imported, and even daily necessities are very expensive.
"So in my plan, the industrial zone will focus on producing daily necessities, and the first factory will start construction in May.
"I heard it's a tableware factory, because most people in the entire South Colson area are still using wooden bowls and wooden spoons, and many people have never seen metal tableware in their lives.
"To be honest, metal tableware is more durable, but considering local customs, ceramic tableware will definitely be produced. In the future, when everyone's quality of life improves, there will also be porcelain tableware."
Azik took a deep breath: "I have also met some officials, but to be honest, they all give me the feeling that they are just muddling through their days in their positions.
"You are different. You know your territory like the back of your hand, which is actually a remarkable thing."
Hobert thought to himself that it was only because the requirements for officials were too low now. In the territory under his rule, there would be absolutely no officials who held positions without doing any work!
Azik took a sip of wine: "Why does this wine have the flavor of the Backlund region?"
"That's right, this is exactly what I brought from Backlund." Hobert said with some embarrassment. He couldn't taste the so-called flavor and characteristics of the wine at all.
In his mouth, he always felt that the taste of wine was similar. He was too embarrassed to ask others what the difference was in the taste of wine. He just nodded to whatever others said.
At this time, the train came to the best viewing position again. Unlike the scenery Hobert saw when he entertained other guests before, the West Bank also became part of this beautiful scenery, because many places there already had vigorous vitality.
It's just that the vitality still has a forced element at this time. The local situation is special, and a thorough agricultural reform has not yet been carried out.
Hobert had previously discussed this matter with Conrad and others. A thorough land reform would not be carried out until the second half of this year, and it would be carried out in two batches. The area previously ruled by the Blood Sanctify Sect would be redistributed after the wheat harvest, and the area ruled by the Aurora Order would be redistributed after the autumn harvest.
All of this would be carried out after the current government demonstrated its new agricultural policy, which would be more conducive to carrying out the land redistribution work.
Next, Hobert introduced the construction of the hotel to Azik, as well as the construction of entertainment facilities on the hillside.
Most of those entertainment facilities are also open to ordinary tourists, including a live shooting experience range, a haunted house, a wonderland, and so on.
These projects, which are common in future amusement parks, are still very novel in this era.
In addition, Hobert plans to build a Ferris wheel, a carousel, and a pirate ship in the next step.
At the same time, he also "invented" many board games. It is said that many nobles have gone crazy playing them, and many ordinary tourists have also gone to the entertainment center to experience them.
There are also indoor sports such as bowling and billiards. Especially billiards, which is basically exclusive to nobles and wealthy people at this time, but Hobert opened all these venues to ordinary tourists, allowing many people to experience it.
Outdoors, there are tennis, baseball, and golf courses, which have also been basically built.
At this time, the entertainment for the middle class is actually very scarce, because there are almost no public sports venues in this era. After coming to South Colson, many middle-class people will come to experience it, and this has attracted many repeat customers.
When the train started to go downhill, Hobert introduced the road hardening plan and the bridge and railway construction plan in the South Colson area.
Hobert plans to first build a bridge across the Taz River, and then build a railway and road connecting the east and west banks.
There must be hardened roads between towns.
The second step is to build another bridge, and the railway and wide road will form a loop around Full Moon Lake.
As for hardened roads, they must be built to every village.
Azik realized a problem: "These investments should be difficult to get a return on in the short term, right?"
Hobert drank the wine in his glass: "That's right. If it were a businessman, no one would ever come to the South Colson area to build bridges, railways, or roads."
Azik smiled: "The way you put it, I would almost think you are doing a charitable cause."
Hobert poured himself half a glass of wine again: "Mr. Azik, let me tell you a story.
"A place was hit by a drought, and the price of food doubled, but the officials in that place not only didn't try to lower the price of food, but also raised the price of food three times!"
Azik frowned: "This official wants to take the opportunity to make a fortune, right?"
Hobert smiled, and then poured another glass of wine for Azik: "Before long, many grain merchants who heard the news transported grain to the disaster area.
"As a result, there was too much grain, and the price quickly returned to par, or even below par."
Azik was slightly stunned, first feeling a little unbelievable, and then feeling that it was natural: "This is a competent official, and, and his actions are unheard of."
Hobert continued: "This is not over yet. He also started asking the rich to donate money to build some public facilities.
"And he carried out many entertainment activities, such as competitions with local customs, and lavish spending during festivals, etc."
Azik pondered for a while, and probably understood: "This is the same reason why you keep building roads and building things."
"That's right." Hobert smiled: "Only in that official's jurisdiction in the entire disaster area did no one starve to death, and there were no cases of farmers selling their fields or daughters.
"When I took over the entire South Colson area, it was almost like a disaster area: cut off from the entire world for half a century; almost no industry or commerce; farmers had no enthusiasm for production.
"Although the situation is a little better now, most people are still very poor, so I have to use some special means to stimulate people's enthusiasm for life."
Azik looked at Full Moon Lake, which occupied half of his vision, and then smiled at Hobert after a long while: "What you are doing now is great.
"I have become accustomed to looking at this world from the perspective of a Beyonder or a history professor. This perspective is making me more and more distant from this world, and even the real world has become a little unreal."
Azik said seriously: "This is wrong. If you have no emotion for the real world, then you will not have any emotional color when destroying this real world or harming the lives of ordinary people."
Hobert recalled those thoughts in the night market before: "Perhaps, the higher the sequence Beyonder, the more they should integrate into the lives of ordinary people.
"Sometimes I even think that the so-called 'acting method' is reminding Beyonders that no matter how powerful we are, we are all part of this world.
"We must integrate into this world so that our state can become more stable."
Azik pinched his chin and thought for a while: "Your idea is very unique, and it seems to make a lot of sense."
Hobert smiled. In fact, this idea has a bit of the concept of "harmony between man and nature". In his view, many underlying principles should be interconnected.
At the same time, he also knew that the concept of "harmony between man and nature" could not solve the madness problem of Beyonder characteristics, and could only be used as an acting direction for the "acting method".
Back at the train station, Azik expressed that he had not had enough of this trip and conversation, but Hobert had only thought of this stage, so he could only discuss it with Azik here.
Hobert's ideas are not very useful to himself at the moment, after all, he does not have to constantly fight against divinity now.
But he felt that these ideas should be very useful to Mr. Azik. Azik had said on the pirate admiral's ship that he seemed to have no emotion or warmth when he was acting as a "Death Consul".
In fact, this is very telling. At that time, Azik's divinity had the upper hand.
Later, Azik revived like an "Undying" and lost all his memories every once in a while. After he experienced different lives, his state may have been better.
So as long as he is willing to integrate more deeply into this society, will his state become better?
Hobert's carriage was already parked outside the station. After the two got into the carriage, they talked about Backlund again.
Azik smiled: "It's hard to imagine how brilliant Backlund will become in the future if it is handed over to you to manage."
"Not necessarily." Hobert smiled: "The power there is too complicated. Maybe I will be sent to prison by nobles and rich people a few days after I become the mayor of Backlund."
Not maybe, Hobert felt that it would definitely be like this.
He smiled again: "Making a wealthy place wealthier is nothing great.
"Making a poor place wealthy can show my skills."
While talking, the two arrived at the lord's mansion. Hobert asked the chef to make a Feynapotter-style meal, and then they chatted about Klein while drinking tea in the restaurant.
"The last time I saw him, he seemed more autistic." Hobert then remembered that he had originally wanted to take the time to catch up with Klein, but since the conversation on the banks of the Tussok River, he had not seen him again except for meeting him in the Tarot Club.
"He has too many things hidden in his heart." Azik smoked the cigar that Hobert had brought from the Sodela Palace a few days ago, and nodded in satisfaction with the taste of the cigar: "I really should invite him here to relax."
Hobert was too embarrassed to tell anyone that he had taken the cigar from the palace. As an earl, he still had to save face.
At this time, Dophis, as usual, came to urge Hobert to attend the ball.
Hobert finally found a reason this time: "Tell Earl Hudson that I have urgent matters today and can't go, or just tell him that I have an urgent task."
Dophis glanced at Azik sitting there, and a sense of oppression from a higher level came over him. He immediately understood that it might be the "Death" pathway saint that Hobert had met in Backlund.
Entertaining such a guest is indeed more important than attending a noble's ball: "I understand, I will convey your apologies to Earl Hudson."
Sitting back at the dining table, Azik: "If you have something to do…"
Hobert smiled bitterly and waved his hand: "Mr. Azik, let me tell you this, now I feel a little nauseous when I hear waltz music!
"I have attended more than a dozen balls in a row, and I have danced more in these ten days than I have in my entire life before."
Azik smiled: "I forgot, it's the social season now."
Fors also came to dinner. She felt that she hadn't had dinner with Hobert for a long time.
Azik expressed his apologies to Fors for not attending the wedding, while Hobert asked Fors to act as a junior when introducing them to each other.
The atmosphere at dinner was very harmonious. When Azik said goodbye, he said with emotion: "I just thought that I haven't had dinner with friends for a long time."
Hobert smiled: "You are welcome to come here more often to relax. I dare not say anything else, but there is still a hearty dinner.
"Well, by the way, when the date of the Tourism Festival is set, I will send you an invitation. Come and visit if you have time."
Azik agreed, said goodbye to Fors again, and then entered the spirit world and left.
When only Hobert and Fors were left in the restaurant, Hobert smiled: "Haven't we 'danced' at night for a long time?"
Fors smiled: "You're not tired of dancing after attending so many balls in a row?"
Hobert pinched Fors's butt: "It seems that the beautiful Countess has forgotten what is different about our 'dance'."
Fors opened his hand: "There are still serious matters that need to be dealt with.
"The level 2 sealed artifact and the Beyonder characteristic of the 'Interrogator' that I mentioned last time have been traded. You can take a look later."
Hobert has a rule in the auction house that the sealed artifacts and Beyonder characteristics that are received must be handed over to him for processing.
The reason he gave was to prevent the traded goods from having curses or mental residues that could cause mutation or loss of control.
In fact, he just wanted to see if he could seal the sealed artifacts again and shatter those Beyonder characteristics.
This can make the sealed artifacts more valuable and turn a Beyonder characteristic into several Beyonder characteristics.
But at this time, Hobert suddenly realized that he could no longer play dumb.
These two items were traded at the Tarot Meeting. Hobert also heard about the ability and negative effects of the sealed artifact at that time, and also knew that this sealed artifact was bought by Miss "Magician".
Now that this sealed artifact has come into Fors's hands, he can pretend not to know it now, but in the future, as Fors's spirituality becomes higher and higher, and with the characteristics of "Astrologer", she will be able to associate "Emperor" with Hobert sooner or later.
When Fors recalls Hobert's deception on this sealed artifact in the future, the two will definitely encounter a crisis of trust.
On the way back to Green Lawn Manor in the carriage, Hobert sighed in his heart. That was a situation he was very unwilling to see. Therefore, this secret could not be kept tonight.
So next, it was time to test his acting skills. When Fors introduced the ability of the "Life Toxin Bottle": "This sealed artifact can randomly create different toxins, which will diffuse around as soon as it is opened."
Hobert was visibly stunned and looked at Fors with some seriousness. At the same time, he controlled his gaze, appropriately displaying some confusion, as if he had heard such a description somewhere.
Fors didn't pay it much mind at this point and continued, "It takes effect in less than a minute, and then the symptoms get progressively worse…"
Fors clearly saw Hobert's expression gradually turn to surprise, which made her slightly stunned. "What's wrong?"
"Does its random toxin include itching, headache, vomiting, and… an aphrodisiac?" Hobert's expression changed just right, especially just now; his surprise was gradual.
But now he was less surprised, looking like he had everything under control.
This time it was Fors's turn to be surprised. "How… how did you know?"
She immediately had two guesses: one, that Hobert had seen this sealed artifact before, and two, that Hobert was a member of the Tarot Club.
Before she could think about it further, Hobert had already taken her hand and smiled. "There's something I've never told you, or rather, I never planned to tell anyone.
"Christian is actually my adoptive father. My biological father is called Rex Trunsoest."
"Trunsoest!" Fors exclaimed, immediately making related associations: a descendant of the Night Emperor, a favored one of the 'Creator,' knowledgeable. In the end, all the clues pointed to the fact that her husband was Mr. "Emperor"!
She re-examined Hobert, still feeling that his temperament was not quite the same as Mr. "Emperor's," but then she thought that changing his temperament might be Hobert's way of protecting himself when attending secret gatherings.
Hobert knew from Fors's expression that his acting was very successful; she didn't suspect him of hiding anything at all.
However, just in case, Hobert changed the subject. "Wouldn't it be even more exciting when we go 'dancing' again? I'll charge bravely like the 'Emperor.'"
Fors's cheeks flushed slightly. "Generals are the ones who charge bravely, right?"
Then she realized that Hobert was taking a risk by revealing his identity. After all, according to the rules of the Tarot Club, no one is allowed to actively reveal the secrets of the Tarot Club without the Fool's permission. Ms. "Hermit" was a lesson.
"Generals are also under the command of the Emperor!" Hobert picked Fors up in his arms. "Charge!"
Fors looked at Hobert with a smile, letting him carry her to the bed.
After a bout of passion, the two chatted in each other's arms as usual.
First, they discussed the recent construction problems of the territory, and then they talked about the recent income of the auction house.
After discussing these things, Hobert suddenly said, "If… I mean, if I look very cold in the future, or if I don't seem to have any emotions, be sure to spend more time with me and take me around the territory more."
Fors was stunned. "Do you… do you feel any discomfort?"
She thought that Hobert was showing signs of losing control.
"No, after becoming Sequence 4, I can clearly feel that my empathy has decreased," Hobert only told Fors his worries completely.
"At first, I didn't pay much attention to it, until I realized some time ago that I had become very indifferent to some issues, and my understanding of life seemed to be changing subtly.
"Like a few days ago, when I was carrying out a mission, even though it wasn't necessary to kill people to silence them, I unconsciously wanted to kill them to avoid future troubles."
Hobert finally sighed, "Losing reverence for life is a very terrible thing. I don't want to become like a stone statue in the future, without any emotion.
"In the afternoon, I also talked to Mr. Azik about this matter. We both agreed that feeling the warmth of the real world more often should be helpful in combating this indifference.
"What makes me more fortunate than Mr. Azik is that I can still feel warmth from my wife."
Fors hugged Hobert tightly. "Shall we not advance in sequence anymore?"
Hobert patted Fors's back. "If we lived in another era, I might at most be a Sequence 6."
He sighed. "But according to some information I've obtained, there may be a great change in the world in the near future.
"I must have the ability to protect the people and things I cherish."
Fors buried her face in Hobert's arms. "Hobert, I want to become stronger too. I want to protect you too."
Hobert touched Fors's hair and smiled. "I knew it. You will definitely be my last reliance in my inner world."
Originally, he didn't intend to talk to Fors about these things, but just today, he suddenly realized that some things don't cease to exist just because he doesn't talk about them.
Since the matter is right in front of him, it's better to let Fors be mentally prepared in advance.
...
In the following days, Hobert slacked off at work during the day and attended dances in Backlund at night.
On Saturday, Hobert came to the suburban manor again during working hours to inquire about the research progress of the laboratory.
It is now certain that the first tungsten light bulb will be launched before next Wednesday.
The production of wires has already had a mature process. After the parts ordered from the mechanical factory are delivered, a batch of machines for producing wires can be assembled.
As for the research on plastics, there is still no progress at all.
The research team formed by Gerna has also discovered that some additives are needed to change the shape of plastics.
However, they only have a general direction for what kind of additives to use, and they need to experiment many times to find the key.
Hobert suddenly realized that perhaps this research needed some luck.
Should I put up a statue of "The Fool" in the research institute? After all, he is the "King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck"!
Then Hobert thought that there is a "Fate Serpent" in Backlund now! I don't know if it has been born yet.
It is possible to entrust "The World" at the Tarot Gathering, and at worst, make some ice cream and send it to that little brat.
In the blink of an eye, it was Sunday night. After attending the dance, Hobert returned to the bedroom, and suddenly his spirituality sensed something, and he looked at the moon in the sky.
Its color is getting darker and darker, changing from crimson to blood red.
Today is the Blood Moon!
At this time, Hobert suddenly remembered that he and Fors had agreed to do an experiment!
So he quickly locked the door and entered the "Nation of Disorder".

chapters.content:

South Colson, Green Meadow Manor.
Fors, in her sleep, suddenly woke up, watching the scarlet moon outside becoming increasingly red, the whispers in her ears feeling like they would manifest at any moment.
Fors took two seconds to fully wake up, immediately tidied her pajamas, and prepared to pray to "The Fool": "The one who does not belong…"
She also suddenly remembered that she had promised Hobert to do an experiment.
Fors cleared her throat: "Creator in the Shadow of Order;
"You are the Beginning and End of All Order;
"You are the Master of Laws who holds the Bell of Order!"
"…"
While praying, Fors could already faintly hear whispers like murmurs, and she knew that this blood moon was about to form.
…
In the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert sat upright on the "Iron Throne," seeing a strange star appear in the pool in front of him, extending his spirituality towards it, and it was indeed Fors.
After establishing a connection with Fors, according to the rehearsal, Hobert first "distorted" Fors' hearing, preventing her from hearing the whispers.
However, it seemed that simply blocking the receiver's hearing was not very effective, so Hobert immediately used "Disorder" to create chaos in the space around Fors, in order to isolate the blood moon from the real world.
This method seemed to work, but Fors still frowned slightly, indicating that it was only somewhat effective, and she could still hear some whispers.
Hobert took a deep breath, somewhat regretting doing this experiment with Fors.
If he were doing this experiment with someone else, he could take his time to think of another solution.
But then again, he only felt comfortable doing this experiment with Fors's cooperation, otherwise, if others knew that the "Creator" also had things he wasn't sure about, it would affect the "Creator's" image.
At the time, Hobert had hesitated for a long time before finally deciding that he still had to do this experiment with Fors.
After calming himself down, Hobert thought of a solution: he "tampered" with the intensity of the spirituality around Fors's bedroom.
He calmed down the spirituality that grew after the blood moon occurred, making it less active.
Then he changed "Disorder" to "Distortion," twisting the connection between Fors and the blood moon, which was equivalent to cutting off the channel through which the whispers were transmitted to Fors's ears.
Fors seemed to breathe a sigh of relief, her brow relaxed, and she praised the "Creator."
Hobert also breathed a sigh of relief, it seemed that this experiment was successful.
Then Hobert sighed: "The Fool" is still good, able to directly pull people to the top of the gray fog, completely isolating the whispers.
Only after the "Blood Moon" ended did Hobert say to Fors in the tone of the "Creator": "Very good."
…
Green Meadow Manor.
After praying to the "Creator" many times, Fors successively felt the power of "Distortion" and "Disorder."
Because Hobert had demonstrated similar abilities in front of her many times, Fors was very familiar with the feeling of "Distortion" and "Disorder."
Finally, she felt that the spirituality around her seemed to change, and the whispers in her ears completely disappeared.
Fors breathed a sigh of relief, it seemed that the "Creator's" attempt was successful!
So after praising the "Creator," she quietly waited for the blood moon to end.
As she waited, Fors actually sat on the bed and fell asleep again for a while.
"Very good."
The solemn voice of the "Creator" appeared in Fors's ears, startling her awake instantly, and the figure of the "Creator" flashed before her eyes.
Fors felt that the image of the "Creator" was more imposing than that of "The Fool," and the black light emanating from Him also made the "Creator" look more sacred.
Unfortunately, before she could see clearly, the figure of the "Creator" disappeared.
Fors stared blankly at the scarlet moon outside the window, the whispers that had been bothering her all along, she didn't expect that it would be so easy for the gods to solve.
"The Fool" can solve it easily, and the "Creator" can solve it so easily too!
Just as she was in a daze, a space in the room became illusory, and Hobert emerged from the illusion: "How is it?"
"I only heard one or two whispers at the beginning," Fors smiled, "After that, I couldn't hear anything, I even fell asleep, wouldn't this be disrespectful to the 'Creator'?"
"No!" Hobert immediately said, "The 'Creator' said the experiment was very successful and gave you a mystical item as a reward for it."
Fors was slightly stunned: "Actually, it's, it's nothing."
In fact, she preferred the "Creator's" way of handling things, every time she was alone with Mr. Fool "above the gray fog," Mr. Fool would give Fors a huge pressure.
She wanted to chat about something, but she didn't know what to chat about, and if she didn't chat, she felt a little embarrassed.
The "Creator's" method is better, still in her own room, no need to face this god-like existence.
Hobert smiled: "You should also guess why the 'Creator' did this experiment, it is very important to us, so there must be a reward."
Saying this, he took out the "Teleportation Statue."
"I don't want it, I'm helping you," Fors said, but her hands honestly reached out.
The first time she saw the ability of the "Teleportation Statue" was during the battle against the Tamara family that Hobert had planned.
At that time, Hobert used the "Teleportation Statue" to cooperate with Xio, easily killing two Sequence 8s, which impressed Fors deeply.
The abilities shown by the "Teleportation Statue" afterwards made Fors always feel that with this mystical item in hand, enemies below Sequence 5 were not so difficult to deal with.
Now that the "Creator" rewarded her with this sealed artifact, it made her very happy. In the future, she would have "Leymano's Travels" for attack and the "Teleportation Statue" for defense. She instantly felt that she also had the confidence to challenge Sequence 6 beyond her level.
Hobert handed the box sealing the "Teleportation Statue" to Fors: "Next Tuesday, I will establish the 'Traveler's Gate' from the Lord's Mansion to Longtail Island.
"Prepare yourself, accompany me to take over Longtail Island, and meet with those manor owners. In the future, when I am not on Longtail Island, you will be stationed there."
Fors smiled: "I will be too busy."
Although she said so, she was still very happy that Hobert invited her to take over Longtail Island together.
"Just like here in South Colson, let Condra take care of the specific affairs, you just need to show your face occasionally," Hobert said, "I will let you personally manage some important industries."
Fors put away the "Teleportation Statue": "Okay."
Hobert lay on the bed: "I'm really looking forward to it. After rectifying Longtail Island, we can have a barbecue on the beach!"
Fors put down the "Teleportation Statue" and also lay down beside Hobert: "I never thought that one day I would become the mistress of an island.
"Hobert, thank you, you made my life more magical than my novels."
Hobert stroked Fors's fair thigh exposed outside her pajamas: "Actually, I should thank you more, you made me realize that I really live in this world, and all the experiences are not dreams, nor a game."
…
Above the gray fog.
Klein, sitting at the head of the bronze long table, yawned: Why hasn't Fors prayed to "The Fool" yet? Could it be that I was wrong, and tonight's changes in the scarlet moon are not a prelude to becoming a blood moon?
…
A new week began, and Hobert went to the MI9 as usual.
Just after changing into his uniform, Sharlene knocked on the door and came in: "Chief, the chief's secretary just came to inform you that the chief is looking for you."
"Looking for me again?" Hobert was now very reluctant to hear the phrase "the chief."
This time, Hobert found Georgina's office himself. Countess Georgina was reading the newspapers sent in the morning: "Come and sit down."
Hobert sat opposite her.
"You have a mission at the beginning of next month," Georgina said, looking at Hobert without a smile.
"It won't be to protect some important person again, will it?" Hobert was also very reluctant to hear the phrase Sodela Palace now.
"The specific mission will only be announced to you when you depart," Georgina tapped the newspaper with her finger: "It's still a protection mission, but this time you will be on a business trip for a while, so be prepared."
Hobert nodded: "Okay, but please tell me the level of danger of the mission before it starts."
"This time I will be more detailed than last time," Georgina promised.
Coming back from Georgina, Hobert said to Sharlene, "Get me a copy of today's Backlund Morning Post."
He noticed that the newspaper next to Georgina was the Backlund Morning Post.
Hobert turned to the second page and found the place where Georgina had tapped with her finger. There was a small report: Members of the Loen royal family will hold an informal meeting with members of the Masin and Feynapotter royal families in early May.
Hobert nodded slightly: Early May, the time is right, eighty or ninety percent I will have to go with them to protect the royal family members.
Then he shook his head and smiled. He had only worked in the MI9 for a short time, but he already had the awareness of an intelligence officer.
As for Georgina's reminder, it was what Hobert had fought for at the ball before.
Although according to the regulations, Georgina could not tell her subordinates the details of the mission, the regulations did not say that she could not hint at the general content of the mission so that her subordinates would have sufficient preparation time.
So for the second mission, Georgina gave a hint, as for whether Hobert received it, she didn't care.
It wasn't that Georgina was so indulgent towards Hobert, but as a demigod, she was qualified to be capricious, and sometimes Georgina had to make certain compromises.
At a little after two in the afternoon, Hobert simply used "Travel" to come to Green Meadow Manor.
At this time, Fors was already preparing to participate in the Tarot Gathering. Seeing Hobert coming, she smiled slightly.
Since they already knew each other's identities at the Tarot Gathering, they could completely participate in the Tarot Gathering together.
The two of them lay face up on the bed together, staring blankly at the warm sunlight shining in through the cracks in the curtains.
After a long while, Fors said, "Why do I feel like I've been lying down for a long time?"
"Let me take a look," Hobert took out his pocket watch: "Why hasn't it reached three o'clock yet? Is it because we're just lying down and not doing anything?"
Fors smiled: "This reminds me of the first time I participated in the Tarot Gathering, I was a little nervous and a little expectant."
Suddenly, the two people's vision was simultaneously submerged by the gray fog, and when they came back to their senses, they were already in the Giant Hall, sitting on either side of the bronze long table.
The two smiled at each other, suddenly feeling that this feeling was quite magical.
"Good afternoon~ Mr. Fool! Good afternoon…" Audrey, "Justice," greeted as usual.
But when she greeted Alger, "The Hanged Man," she suddenly noticed Hobert smiling at Fors.
Audrey immediately realized that this smile was not right, it was too sweet. "The Emperor" should not give such a smile to "The Magician."
She seemed to realize something and looked at Fors again, and Fors's smile was even sweeter.
Audrey immediately concluded: Fors knew that Hobert was "The Emperor!"
This made her good mood disappear all at once. All along, she had felt that she knew that Hobert was "The Emperor," and this was a secret that belonged only to herself and Hobert.
Now, this secret had been learned by others.
Everyone noticed that "Justice" was not right, and Derrick, "The Sun," simply reminded her: "Miss Justice?"
Audrey came back to her senses and concealed her mood very well. She smiled and said, "Sorry, I was distracted just now."
Then she continued to greet: "Good afternoon~ Mr. Hanged Man…"
This was just a small episode. Seeing Audrey return to normal, everyone did not continue to pay attention to this matter.
Only Hobert clearly noticed it and seemed to understand Audrey's thoughts.
But he didn't think much about it. In fact, he had already noticed some changes in Audrey's attitude towards him before.
But after marrying Fors, he simply stopped thinking about these things.
The Tarot Gathering continued as usual. First, Cattleya, "The Hermit," offered a diary to The Fool, and then it was "The Fool" Klein's reading time.
This time the reading time was a little longer. About ten minutes later, Klein asked "The Hermit": "What is your request?"
Cattleya directly asked: "Honorable Mr. Fool, I want to know if Emperor Roselle has seen the Blasphemy Slate?"
Everyone was stunned: The Emperor has seen the Blasphemy Slate?
They always felt that the "Blasphemy Slate" was very mysterious, as if it was very far away from them. It appeared a long time ago and had been missing ever since.
Unexpectedly, the well-known Emperor Roselle had seen it. That was only a little over a hundred years ago!
It was as if there was a well-known big shot, and everyone had heard about his legends, but unexpectedly, the neighbor had met that big shot.
All the members looked at the head of the bronze table.
Klein brewed for a while before saying: "Yes!"
He sighed in his heart: Fortunately, Roselle mentioned this in the previous diary.
Really seen it!
Cattleya realized: Perhaps it was because the Emperor had seen the "Blasphemy Slate" and learned the apotheosis ritual of the "Black Emperor" pathway that he had the idea of jumping to a non-adjacent pathway.
Alger sighed inwardly: I really want to see what the "Blasphemy Slate" looks like.
Everyone else had similar thoughts to Alger, except for Audrey, who was a beat behind and only now showed surprise.
After Klein finished speaking, he didn't add anything, but instead smiled and said, "It's your turn."
He didn't directly say that he saw the 'Blasphemy Slate' from the 'Twilight Hermit Order,' thinking that he might be able to answer this question again next time.
Cattleya then bowed to 'The Fool' to express her gratitude, and then looked at 'The Magician' and said, "I want to know the clues to the direct descendants of the Abraham family, 1000 pounds!"
Why are you talking to me directly? 'The Magician' Fors was first startled, but then felt it wasn't unexpected, because in last week's transaction, although it wasn't explicitly stated, her performance was very much like a member of the Abraham family.
But Fors didn't want to sell out her teacher's information, she deliberated for a moment before asking, "What are you looking for them for?"
Cattleya sighed inwardly: As expected, she is a seemingly ordinary lady who actually hides many secrets and is very cautious and meticulous in her work.
She said: "I am looking for the direct descendants of the Abraham family, hoping to get the contact information of Mr. 'Door'. Perhaps we have opportunities for cooperation in this regard.
"Well, just for conveying the message, I will pay you 350 pounds in cash. If they are willing to contact, I will pay the remaining 650 pounds."
"As far as I know, they cannot effectively contact Mr. 'Door'," Fors said. "But I can help you convey the message."
As for the 350 pounds or something, she really doesn't care about it now, so she simply didn't mention the pounds.
If they had a way to communicate with Mr. 'Door', the Abrahams would have known long ago that the curse they were talking about was actually Mr. 'Door's' warning to family members.
Cattleya could see that Miss 'Magician' was almost certain that the Abraham family did not have a way to contact Mr. 'Door', which made her a little disappointed.
Then, as if holding on to the last hope, she asked 'The Emperor': "Mr. Emperor, do you know how to contact Mr. 'Door'?"
"Wasn't I clear enough before?" Hobert smiled helplessly: "Mr. 'Door' is very dangerous. Any creature that has communicated with Him may be corrupted.
"Even if I know, I can't tell you the contact information."
He only remembered to prepare various gems, and the specific ritual steps were already unclear.
Cattleya said: "Perhaps..."
"No perhaps!" Hobert said sternly for once: "Don't have any illusions about this world. Do I still have to teach you this?"
Cattleya smiled bitterly. The Queen Mystic certainly knew this, but when she encountered such an important clue, the Queen certainly wanted to ask Mr. 'Door' about the Great Emperor's situation.
She could roughly understand the Queen Mystic's mood. As far as she knew, the Queen's investigation and search had lasted for hundreds of years. Finally, she found important clues at the Tarot Club, so she would definitely take some action.
Hobert turned to Fors and said: "Even if the Abraham family has relevant information, don't trade with 'The Hermit', so as to avoid the tragedy that none of us want to see."
Miss 'Magician' nodded obediently: "Okay."
Klein behind the gray fog also felt that 'The Emperor's' handling was the most appropriate. Speaking of which, Roselle's diary provided him with so much help, and he was very grateful to Roselle in his heart.
At the same time, he and Roselle also had a 'hometown' friendship, and he couldn't watch his daughter make irrational decisions, but he didn't stop her.
If 'The Emperor' didn't stop her, he would have let 'The World' jump out to stop her.
Then Klein realized that if Bernadette was really so eager to know the answer, she might have directly prayed to 'The Fool', but she didn't do so.
It can be seen that she has not completely lost her mind, but just can't help but want to know more information.
Alger was somewhat gloating: 'The Hermit' also has irrational times. Women are indeed emotional animals.
'The Moon' Emlyn raised his chin: The Hermit usually looks quite smart, but I didn't expect her to be so foolish.
Audrey sighed in her heart: Mr. Hanged Man's expressions have already betrayed their thoughts. I suddenly have a deep feeling that they are not involved, and they can't understand the Hermit, or rather the Queen Mystic's feelings. I think the Queen Mystic may just want to know the contact information, and may not really contact him. As long as she knows that way, she may feel better in her heart.
The hall was quiet for a few seconds before Cattleya nodded slightly towards 'The Emperor': "Thank you."
She had also reminded the Queen Mystic, but soon she found that her reminder was useless. The Queen rarely had such irrational times.
At this time, cutting off all avenues for obtaining information may not be a bad thing for the Queen. After a while, when the Queen regains her sanity, she will no longer pursue this matter.
Audrey had completely returned to her previous state and asked other members: "Does anyone have any clues about the psychedelic wind chime tree fruit?"
"I have clues," Alger said after thinking for a moment. "But it will be at least two weeks before it is possible to obtain it."
"No problem!" Audrey was overjoyed, and didn't even ask the price.
It's been more than a month, and there are finally clues! Of course, there is no problem waiting another two or three weeks.
Hobert suddenly recalled that he had seized a 'Dreamwalker' Beyonder characteristic from 'Black Knight' and had been throwing it in the 'Nation of Disorder' without having time to crush it.
After re-aggregation, it also contains a 'Hypnotist' Beyonder characteristic, but considering that Audrey had previously bought a main material for 'Hypnotist', and he remembered that the psychedelic wind chime tree was not difficult to get, he would not grab Alger's business.
Then Hobert said: "Does anyone know the clues of the 'Life School of Thought'? Or does anyone have a way to make people have good luck for a certain period of time?"
Everyone looked at 'The Emperor': This guy is already lucky, what more good luck does he want?
Klein behind the gray fog found that he seemed to know the clues of the 'Life School of Thought' and also knew how to make people have good luck in a short time.
So he manipulated 'The World' and said: "I know where there is a way to temporarily gain good luck, but with the other party's level and ability, they are not interested in pounds. Before contacting Him, you must first think about how to pay the reward."
Hobert pondered for a moment: "How about three 'Worms of Time'?"
Everyone was stunned: Three... Worms of Time?
Derrick was stunned for a moment, then immediately coughed, as if something was about to cough out of his throat.
