chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 555: Lilith's Primordial Moon and the Mother Tree of Desire
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Hermit" Cattleya frowned slightly: "Worm of Time"? I remember there's a sequence potion called "Worm of Time," but judging from "Emperor's" tone, it seems like the "Worm of Time" is some kind of item?
"Magician" Fors was a bit puzzled: Why is Hobert looking for ways to gain good luck? And where did he get so many "Worms of Time"?
"Emperor" Hobert saw the confusion on Fors's face and roughly understood what she was thinking.
He sighed: In the future, every reaction at the Tarot Gathering, especially things Fors doesn't know about, I have to think about how to explain it to her afterward.
But then, Hobert thought of a way to solve it once and for all.
Behind the gray fog, Klein paused for a second or two before figuring it out: Is the "Worm of Time" you're talking about the same thing as the "Worm of Time" I know? That's something only Amon's avatars have... No, that's not right, other demigods of the "Marauder" pathway should also be able to obtain "Worms of Time."
"Justice" Audrey naturally thought of "Sun's" previous experience and had a very deep impression of "Worms of Time." She never expected that the reward Hobert offered would be "Worms of Time."
"Sun" Derrick coughed a few times before asking, "Mr. Emperor, where did your 'Worms of Time' come from?"
Hobert smiled slightly, "Of course, from Amon's avatar!"
The most surprised was Fors: "You, you encountered Amon's avatar?"
She remembered that "Worms of Time" have the ability to "parasitize." Could Hobert have already been "parasitized"?
Thinking that there might be a pair of eyes staring at her during her recent intimate moments with Hobert, she felt a little shy and a little scared at first.
But then she thought, if Hobert were parasitized, Mr. Fool would definitely notice. Besides, he is a favored one of "The Creator," so if he were in any danger, "The Creator" should be able to detect it in time.
Fortunately, everyone else was surprised by the source of the "Worms of Time" and didn't notice the urgency in the Magician's tone, or that she simply called the "Emperor" "you" instead of Mr. Emperor.
Cattleya asked in disbelief, "Is that the King of Angels Amon that we mentioned during our previous intelligence trade?"
Hobert emphasized, "It's Amon's avatar."
Audrey said with emotion, "Mr. Emperor said before that there are also Amon's avatars in the North and South Continents, but I didn't really take it seriously.
"I didn't expect those avatars to really exist, and that members of the Tarot Club have even fought them."
"Little Sun" was more concerned: "Mr. Emperor, how did you kill Amon's avatar? If you think this information is too valuable, I can trade it with Beyonder ingredients."
Hobert smiled, "The role I played in this battle was merely to lure out the other party's avatar."
Then he said to Derrick, "If those below demigod level encounter Amon's avatar, there is only one solution: run while praying to Mr. Fool.
"Well, if you can still remember to pray to Mr. Fool, that is."
Fors was completely relieved: It sounds like it was an action led by "The Creator," so there's no danger. Now that I think about it, Hobert did seem to mention this a few days ago. He suddenly had a murderous impulse during a mission when he didn't need to kill anyone. Since he didn't explain it clearly at the time, it might have been confidential. Never mind, I won't ask after the gathering.
Behind the gray fog, Klein smiled helplessly: Why pray to "The Fool"? If "The Fool" encounters Amon's avatar, he plans to pray to "The Creator."
Derrick nodded slowly, "I understand."
Klein: It's best if you don't encounter Amon's avatar before "The Fool" has a way to deal with it.
Audrey was more concerned: "Mr. Emperor, where did you encounter Amon's avatar?"
Hobert replied with a smile, "For a long time, there won't be any Amon's avatars on the Rorsted Archipelago.
"Oh, well, that's not necessarily true. Perhaps there will be some Amon's avatars who will investigate why the avatar on the Rorsted Archipelago disappeared."
Alger frowned: The Rorsted Archipelago again? A lot has happened on the Rorsted Archipelago recently! Or rather, as long as the favored ones of "The Fool" or "The Creator" are on the Rorsted Archipelago, something is Chained to happen.
Audrey was slightly relieved to hear that it wasn't in Backlund.
Then she asked, "Amon's main body is in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.' Why would He send avatars to the North and South Continents?"
"I heard that Amon has a habit of collecting Beyonder characteristics of the 'Marauder' pathway. This may be Him looking for other Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics," Hobert said. "Of course, it may simply be because it's fun."
Everyone recalled that the "Emperor" had said that this King of Angels had the title of "God of Mischief."
Klein pondered for a moment before manipulating "The World" to say in a hoarse voice, "I need to ask that one if he is satisfied with such a reward before I can give you an answer."
Hobert nodded, "Okay, no problem."
After this special transaction ended, this short transaction session of the Tarot Gathering came to an end.
As the exchange session began, "Little Sun" said, "I have become a 'Notary.' Now there is an opportunity to choose a sealed artifact. What type of sealed artifact should I choose?"
Alger, who understood the "Sun" pathway best, said, "Although 'Notary' will gain a great increase in physical fitness, they are still more inclined towards support.
"The ability to notarize effectively can be temporarily enhanced, and the ability to notarize ineffectively will be weakened or forcibly dispelled. At the same time, 'Notary's' are good at making contracts. Once they sign and approve, even Sequence 5 cannot violate them.
"Based on these characteristics, I suggest you choose a sealed artifact that is good at controlling targets. If not, then choose one with strong attack power."
Derrick thanked him sincerely, "Thank you, Mr. Hanged Man."
In his mind, the most great and respected person in the entire Tarot Club was Mr. Fool, the most knowledgeable and admirable person was Mr. Emperor, and the most reliable, kindest, and most benevolent person was undoubtedly Mr. Hanged Man.
At this time, Emlyn thought to himself: This guy has actually caught up to my level. No, I can't let him surpass me!
He obtained Mr. Fool's consent and manifested a slender doll: "Ladies and gentlemen, does anyone know what this is?"
The puppet was obtained from a Primordial Moon believer he had just hunted. He thought this should be an important clue to finding other hunting targets!
"This is a 'Moon Messenger,'" Cattleya examined it for a few moments and said, "This is very dangerous. It's best to hand it over to your Sanguine's higher-ups."
Then she explained, "It is an Beyonder item made by followers of the 'Primordial Moon' through bloody rituals lasting hundreds of years. It is said to have the integration of divine power and possesses strange and terrifying abilities and effects."
Emlyn changed his sitting posture and said with a "hey," "I encountered it while hunting that 'Primordial Moon' believer.
"She is already dead, and I am still alive."
Hobert smiled slightly: No one asked you where you got it; they're just telling you it's dangerous!
Sure enough, Cattleya was slightly stunned and didn't know how to respond for a moment.
At this time, Audrey asked, "Mr. Emperor, are there many followers of the 'Primordial Moon'?"
Emlyn glanced at "Justice": Why don't you ask me this question?
"I don't think there are many," Hobert thought for a moment and then said, "And these followers don't seem to have a very strict organization. Most of the members have joined the 'Rose School' and the 'Life School.'
"But I heard that the 'Primordial Moon' followers of the 'Life School' seem to have rebelled some time ago."
Behind the gray fog, Klein nodded slightly. He had also received such news and had helped the Fate pathway councilor of the Life School "escort" the "Die of Probability."
Emlyn added, "There are also some who have not joined any organization."
Audrey continued to ask, "Why is this happening?"
She smiled and said, "I think the Beyonders of this pathway seem very scattered. The Sanguine are Beyonders of this pathway, and the 'Primordial Moon' followers in the 'Rose School' and 'Life School' are also Beyonders of this pathway."
Emlyn was a little unhappy: "Don't confuse us Sanguine with the 'Primordial Moon' followers. They are all dirty thieves who stole our Sanguine's Beyonder characteristics!"
"Yes, yes, you are different," Audrey followed suit. "But the Beyonders of this pathway are still very strange. Like Mr. Moon, they believe in the ancient god Lilith. I remember that the 'Rose School' and the 'Life School' also have very different concepts.
"They, they even sound like they are not Beyonders of the same pathway."
Cattleya replied, "It is because their beliefs are different that they adhere to different concepts."
Audrey smiled, "This is exactly what I am going to ask next. Are there two beings similar to gods in this pathway?"
"Only our Ancestor!" Emlyn said with some excitement: "From beginning to end, only our Ancestor is the 'Moon'!"
Derrick almost asked: What is your codename, Mr. Moon? In the Tarot Club, aren't you "Moon"?
But because he noticed that the atmosphere was a bit wrong, he didn't ask.
Fors advised, "Mr. Moon, please don't be agitated. We are just doing some discussions and have no other intentions."
Audrey also took great care of "Moon's" emotions and said, "Sorry, Mr. Moon, I am just curious why there is a being like the Primordial Moon besides the Sanguine Ancestor in this pathway?"
"That's because, that's because..." Emlyn suddenly found that he couldn't explain this question clearly.
In the end, he sighed and said, "The 'Primordial Moon' must have stolen the Ancestor's authority through some method, just like those artificial Sanguine stole our Beyonder characteristics."
Cattleya said, "Sorry, Mr. Moon, what I am about to say may make you unhappy, but according to some rumors I have heard: 'Primordial Moon' is Lilith in disguise!"
Emlyn turned red with anger, but because "Hermit" apologized first, and he also knew that this was a discussion, he took a deep breath and didn't let his anger out. He clenched his fists and said:
"Absolutely impossible! How could the Ancestor become the belief of that group of thieves! She, She is the Sanguine's Ancestor!"
The Sanguine has always regarded the followers of the "Primordial Moon" as mortal enemies and will never accept that the "Primordial Moon" is the Ancestor Lilith.
The other members did not speak. They didn't think so. After all, that was a god, and it sounded like it was a god in not-so-good condition.
Who knew if it was because they were in bad condition that they liked bloody sacrifices and eventually became the "Primordial Moon"?
But Mr. Moon was very sensitive to this issue, and everyone did not continue to discuss it in this direction.
Behind the gray fog, Klein even suspected that the "Primordial Moon" might be the Evernight Goddess in disguise? But in his heart, he didn't want to admit that the Evernight Goddess would like blood sacrifices.
"Little Sun" felt that the current "Moon" was very similar to himself in the past, and couldn't bear to hear others say bad things about the "Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord."
At this time, Hobert, who had not participated in this topic and had been thinking, suddenly said, "Everyone, I just thought that with some of the information I have heard and the information I have unintentionally obtained in some actions, I can probably help you sort out the problems of the 'Moon' pathway."
The other members looked at "Emperor" together, and Audrey almost immediately raised her hand and said, "I want to initiate a transaction."
Emlyn followed closely: "I also want to initiate a transaction."
"Don't worry," Hobert smiled, "This transaction involves a lot of scattered but high-level information. Let me think about it. Let's price it at 4,000 pounds!
"But I want to make one thing clear in advance: I will not have any descriptions or answer any related questions about the uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway!"
Audrey said, "I'll offer 1,000 pounds!"
"I'll also offer 1,000 pounds!" Emlyn followed closely again.
Klein secretly sighed in his heart. He originally wanted to learn more about the relationship between the goddess and the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway.
But he was still willing to offer 400 pounds to listen to "Emperor's" explanation of this seemingly chaotic pathway.
Fors was also willing to offer 400 pounds to listen to the answer, but then she thought: I don't need to be so troublesome later. Can't I just give this 400 pounds to Hobert? No, do I even need to give it to him?
Cattleya also offered 400 pounds. She realized: According to "Emperor's" pricing habits, if it is a very complete piece of information, he will generally price it at 5,000 pounds. This time he is asking for 4,000 pounds, which can only mean that this information is not very complete. Is the missing part about the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway?
A crowdfunding was quickly reached. Alger also offered 400 pounds, and Little Sun offered two Sequence 8-level Beyonder ingredients.
"Let's start with 'Ancestor Lilith,' which Mr. Moon is most concerned about," Hobert said. "We talked about it before when we were conducting the ancient god-related transaction. According to some clues, the ancient god Lilith once fell in that ancient god war during the Second Epoch."
Emlyn immediately said, "But we Sanguine can still receive the Ancestor's revelations!"
"I know, listen to me first." Hobert smiled and said, "According to the existing intelligence, the ancient god Lilith did survive in a peculiar way, but how peculiar it is is unknown."
More precisely, it can't be said now.
To cover up the truth and divert everyone's attention, Hobert came up with a good idea: "The ancient god Lilith may still retain a Sequence 1 characteristic, and has been using this to give some instructions to the Sanguine.
"But because she may be sleeping most of the time, the Sanguine only know that the Ancestor is still alive, but they don't know the current state of the Ancestor, and can only occasionally receive the Ancestor's enlightenment.
"Of course, it cannot be ruled out that it is a Sequence 1 characteristic with the spiritual residue of the ancient god Lilith, automatically replying to the prayers and sacrifices of the Sanguine.
"I just think the first possibility is higher."
Under no circumstances can everyone associate Lilith with the Earth Mother, not even the members of the Tarot Club.
Regarding the future war of the gods, Hobert is currently on the side of the Goddess and the Earth Mother, so at this time, no relevant information about their secret plans can be revealed.
However, based on the principle of honest transactions of the Tarot Club, the information Hobert gave was not entirely groundless. Lilith always needs a certain way to issue instructions to the Sanguine, right?
Could this way be the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway?
It's just that Hobert only said what he knew on this issue, not all the information.
"Moon" Emlyn immediately nodded and said: "I think it must be the first guess. Now the Ancestor has discovered the opportunity to restore power and completely wake up, so he sent an enlightenment to let me join the Tarot Club, let me gain stronger power, so as to help the Sanguine get through the crisis in the future and completely awaken the Ancestor."
Cattleya was slightly taken aback: I didn't expect Mr. Moon to have joined the Tarot Club after receiving the enlightenment from the Sanguine Ancestor, but the question is, "Moon" is a servant of the Earth Mother Church, why would Lilith rest assured to entrust this task to him?
Alger also learned this inside story today: Could this involve transactions between gods again? Just like "Emperor", is "Moon" the link between Mr. Fool and Lilith?
He glanced at "Moon" on the side: Are there no Sanguine left? This guy doesn't seem very reliable!
Audrey, who also learned about this today, nodded slightly: No wonder Mr. Moon is so proud. It turns out that he was chosen by the Sanguine Ancestor.
Klein shook his head helplessly: The 'Fool' should know about this kind of thing, why are you announcing it to other members?
Then he thought: I prefer the second guess. Lilith has already fallen in the previous war of the gods, but I don't know who picked up the Sequence 1 characteristic with Lilith's spiritual residue, and has been using that or Sealed Artifact to influence the Sanguine to achieve some ulterior secrets. It is even possible that this person is the Evernight Goddess, directly using the Uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway to influence the Sanguine.
Hobert continued: "The Sanguine are a special group in the 'Moon' pathway. Apart from drinking blood, they are still normal in other aspects. At least I have rarely heard of Sanguine who are cruel and bloodthirsty.
"Some of them use the convenience of doctors to obtain blood, and some use blood donation institutions to obtain blood. There are very few extreme cases of hunting humans."
"Mr. Emperor knows Sanguine very well!" Emlyn loved to hear this: "Noble Sanguine disdain to do some bullying and killing. Only those artificial Sanguine will hunt humans in order to play the role of 'Sanguine'.
"Emperor's" answer swept away the depression that had been suppressed in his heart before. He even couldn't help but grab "Emperor's" hand next to him: "Mr. Emperor, you are definitely a friend of the Sanguine. If you need any help, please feel free to ask us."
Hobert smiled and said meaningfully: "We are actually helping each other."
He said: "Because now many believers of the 'Primordial Moon' are concentrated in the 'Rose School'.
"And attacking the 'Rose School' is our important task in the future."
Hobert withdrew his hand: "Let's talk about the 'Primordial Moon' again. I don't know if you still remember that I said before that one of the very special points of the 'Moon' pathway is that this pathway not only has a Uniqueness, but also has a physical entity.
"The Crimson Moon is equivalent to the concrete manifestation of this pathway. When talking about Uniqueness, I also proposed such a theory.
"Although Uniqueness can control the natural power of a certain category, and is to a certain extent the abstract representation of the natural power in that category, Uniqueness cannot be equated with that part of the natural power.
"Just like the 'Lord of Storms' can call wind and rain, and even transform into lightning, but He is not lightning itself. Lightning is just a tool He uses Uniqueness to control.
"Similarly, the 'Moon' pathway is also like this. If someone occupies the Crimson Moon, the entity of this pathway, can it also affect the Beyonders of the 'Moon' pathway?
"Just like if someone can create lightning in the clouds, does he get a part of the power of the 'Sailor' pathway to another extent? And have a certain impact on the Beyonders who happen to be using lightning?"
Emlyn sat up straight: "You, you mean someone now, no, I mean, an evil god has occupied the Crimson Moon!
"Oh my god, our Sanguine viscounts have to seriously study the moon to gain power! Then they, they…"
Aren't they all being corrupted?
Hobert replied: "She does not have the Uniqueness of this pathway. Although he occupies the Crimson Moon, he cannot completely represent the abstract, or in other words, he cannot completely represent the moon in terms of mysticism.
"So only studying the moon has a certain probability of being corrupted."
Emlyn breathed a sigh of relief: "That's good, that's good."
But the others held their breath. First, Klein manipulated "World" and asked: "Is the 'Above the Sequence' who occupies the Crimson Moon the 'Primordial Moon'?"
"You can understand it this way." Hobert made some more concealment: "Because of some unknown reasons, She has a very strong affinity with the 'Moon' pathway, so She can occupy the Crimson Moon and stare at the Beyonders of the North and South continents with malicious intentions."
The intelligence value about the pathways supporting the Outer Deities is too high, so Hobert can only use "unknown reasons" to gloss over it.
Before this, Klein had only communicated with Hobert about this matter alone, so the other members were not aware of what happened on the Crimson Moon.
After hearing Mr. "World's" question, Cattleya was the first to react: "Did the 'Primordial Moon' pollute 'Mr. Door'? Is the 'Primordial Moon' an 'Above the Sequence'?"
Hobert affirmed again: "Yes."
But he didn't explain further.
A picture suddenly appeared in Audrey's mind. A hideous monster was lying on the moon, its tentacles reaching into the moon, constantly drawing nutrients from the moon. And staring closely at the North and South continents, as long as there is a chance, it will pollute some unlucky Beyonders.
Fors had a similar guess. At the same time, she thought: Is this information all obtained by Hobert from the "Creator"? Does the "Creator" also have a communication gathering similar to the Tarot Club?
"Little Sun" is more concerned about: "Mr. Emperor, what impact does the 'Above the Sequence' occupying the Crimson Moon have on the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
"City of Silver doesn't seem to be affected, right?" Hobert said: "But the population of the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' is too scattered. City of Silver is not affected, and it does not necessarily mean that other surviving cities are not affected."
Derrick nodded. For now, as long as City of Silver is not affected, that's fine.
Hobert continued: "Let's talk about why it is difficult for the believers of the 'Primordial Moon' to form a unified organization.
"This is because someone has been interfering with the 'Primordial Moon'!"
Emlyn leaned forward: "Is it our Ancestor?"
"No, it's the 'Mother Tree of Desire'!" Hobert is also reminding everyone: Pay attention to the "Mother Tree of Desire".
Cattleya was slightly taken aback: "Mother Tree of Desire?"
Of course, she has heard of the "Mother Tree of Desire" and knows that this is an evil god, but in her feeling, this evil god's power does not seem to be very strong, only slightly stronger than those wild gods in the Rorsted Archipelago.
Alger also knows that this is an evil god, but does not know the specific information, so in his mind, this evil god has always been categorized with the Primordial Demoness and the True Creator. In terms of power, it seems to be a level lower than these two relatively active evil gods.
Only Klein knew that the "Mother Tree of Desire" was an Outer Deity, and only he had encountered the Celestial Church that believed in the "Mother Tree of Desire".
Emlyn had only heard of Suah, and did not know that there was a "Mother Tree of Desire" behind Suah.
Other members heard the name "Mother Tree of Desire" for the first time.
Audrey asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, is the 'Mother Tree of Desire' also an evil god?"
Hobert replied: "To be precise, this is an 'Above the Sequence'."
Audrey was a little surprised: "There is more than one 'Above the Sequence'?"
"Yes." Hobert gave an affirmative answer.
Alger asked the question that had been in his mind for a long time: "Why do these 'Above the Sequence' look, don't seem to be very strong? Or, why is their influence on the real world very limited?"
Hobert simply replied: "This question is not included in this transaction."
Klein, who had the same question, was a little disappointed. At the same time, he also realized: There must be a huge secret in this! Could it be a higher level of game?
Cattleya then asked: "Is the power that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' displays in the real world very limited?"
This question can be answered. Hobert said: "For now, yes."
Klein, Cattleya, and others, excluding "Little Sun" and Emlyn, clearly heard the key point, which is "for now". It's hard to say what will happen in the future.
Hobert continued: "In an operation, I encountered an ancient god who has survived to this day…"
Emlyn just wanted to ask: Is it our Ancestor?
But then, he felt that it should not be. The reason is very simple: I am the person chosen by the Ancestor, and I have no chance to meet the Ancestor. How could "Emperor", a believer of the "Creator", meet him?
"…After completing the affairs entrusted by that ancient god, I got a piece of information from Him. A Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Moon' pathway was obtained by the 'Mother Tree of Desire'." The ancient god Hobert was talking about was of course "Devil Monarch" Farbauti.
He paused and then said: "So the 'Mother Tree of Desire' can show some characteristics of high-sequence Beyonders of the 'Moon' pathway."
The other members were all in surprise and contemplation. They were surprised that "Emperor" could have such an adventure. All along, they thought that "Emperor's" information was obtained from his family or from the "Creator".
Looking back now, in fact, "Emperor" has said many times before that some information was obtained from some explorations or his actions.
In other words, some information is hard-won.
As for their contemplation, they were different. Klein recalled that in addition to the strong desire shown by the "Mother Tree of Desire", it seems that it does have the characteristics of fertility.
"Admiral, I want to have a child with you."
Klein took a deep breath. This sentence is still deeply imprinted in his mind.
Alger and Cattleya felt that the relevant information about the "Mother Tree of Desire" in their organization had to be rewritten.
Emlyn was the first to react. He asked: "Mr. Emperor, is there any way to take back that Sequence 1 characteristic?"
Hobert opened his mouth, but for a moment he didn't know how to answer: Didn't I make it clear enough just now? That's an Outer Deity, how can you take it back!
"I have no way." Hobert simply said, and then he said meaningfully: "This is a matter between gods."
This time Emlyn understood "Emperor's" hint and looked at the head of the bronze long table, but he just opened his mouth but didn't ask anything.
The reason is very simple. He suddenly realized that he was too weak. Even if the "Fool" gave a way, it would be difficult for him to do it.
If he asks the "Fool" for help, he realizes that he is not qualified enough at the moment, and maybe the Ancestor has to personally ask the Fool for help.
Seeing that "Moon" didn't ask anything, everyone continued the previous topic.
Klein after the gray fog breathed a sigh of relief. He was ready to use the charlatan's usual method to cover it up again. It's best if "Moon" doesn't ask.
Fors then asked: "You… Mr. Emperor, from which ancient god did you get this information?"
Hobert took a deep breath and replied: "Devil Monarch Farbauti."
The other members looked at each other. None of them had a deep impression of this ancient god, especially after the Second Epoch. It seems that there is no information about this ancient god anymore.
Klein then manipulated "World" and said: "How did the 'Mother Tree of Desire' get that Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Moon' pathway?"
Hobert thought for a while, this question can also be answered: "In the war of the gods when the ancient god Lilith fell in the Second Epoch, the attendant gods present all got a lot of benefits.
"Among them, the 'God of Spiritual Creatures,' who later became the 'Chained God' Tolzna, obtained the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of this pathway. At the same time, he also obtained a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic from the 'Moon' pathway.
"After the God War ended, Tolzna sacrificed the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Moon' pathway to the 'Mother Tree of Desire.'"
For the other members, the 'Chained God' didn't leave much of a deep impression. However, they remembered that when they traded information about the 'Rose Redemption' with 'The Emperor,' this 'Chained God' was also among the first members of the 'Rose Redemption.'
This should also be a god who has witnessed many historical events, but why haven't we heard any news about Him since then?
Cattelya then asked, "Why did Tolzna do this?"
"It is said that He was secretly corrupted," Hobert said. "Or, for Him, it was a transaction. He obtained the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of this pathway from it.
"He only needed to pick it up during battle and sacrifice it through special means."
Hobert guessed that at the time, the 'Mother Tree of Desire' probably wanted the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'The Hanged Man' pathway the most, but Tolzna wouldn't possibly sacrifice the Beyonder characteristic He needed to the 'Mother Tree of Desire' as long as He had a shred of rationality left.
This surprised everyone a bit. Audrey even exclaimed, "It seems like there are many people or gods who have been corrupted by the 'Above the Sequence'!"
Hobert hummed in agreement but didn't offer any further explanation. Instead, he continued, "It is precisely because the 'Mother Tree of Desire' is using the Beyonder characteristic in its possession to interfere with the 'Primordial Moon' that the 'Primordial Moon's' believers appear to lack cohesiveness.
"Because the god they worship is sometimes the 'Primordial Moon' and sometimes the 'Mother Tree of Desire.'
"Some of the 'divine revelations' they receive are also contradictory. Believers receive different orders or are affected differently, so their internal conflicts are heavy.
"The recent betrayal of the 'Primordial Moon' believers in the 'Life School of Thought' is likely another contest between the two of them, because the betraying believers have all joined the 'Rose School.'"
Everyone reacted. Why did this involve the 'Rose School' again?
But when they thought about some of the information that 'The Emperor' had previously announced, they understood. Audrey asked for confirmation, "Does the 'Rose School' have close ties with the 'Mother Tree of Desire'?"
Hobert nodded, "Yes."
It was only at this moment that everyone realized that 'The Emperor' hadn't provided detailed interpretations in many parts of this transaction.
However, this was understandable. After all, this information was already far beyond the value of 4,000 pounds. If a detailed explanation were given, the transaction would be completely unequal.
Hobert finally concluded, "Therefore, Beyonders of the 'Moon' pathway have such a distinct sense of detachment because the gods influencing them are: the ancient god Lilith, the 'Primordial Moon,' and the 'Mother Tree of Desire.'"
As usual, after each transaction, the hall fell into silence. Even Emlyn didn't expect that so many secrets were hidden behind the conflict between the Sanguine and the 'Primordial Moon' believers.
After more than ten seconds, Alger cleared his throat and said, "Recently, I went to Bayam."
Everyone's attention focused on him. Alger smiled and said, "In the suburbs of Bayam, a mountain range has been cut in half."
The other members were stunned for a moment before they recalled that just half a month ago, Gehrman Sparrow had escaped from Bayam and triggered a battle at the Saint and Angel levels!
At the time, Cattleya had imagined what a battle at the Angel level would be like, but she found that she couldn't imagine it at all. Now, she finally realized just how intense a battle at the Angel level could be.
So the other members looked at 'The Emperor' again.
Hobert smiled and said, "That was indeed the impact of the previous battle."
At this moment, a concept appeared in everyone's mind almost simultaneously: At the level of Angels, their battles can already change the terrain of a small area.
Then, Klein, controlling 'The World,' asked 'The Emperor,' "In which aspects is the 'Above the Sequence' mainly concentrated in its influence on the real world?"
Of course, he also knew that the value of this question was actually quite high, but if 'The Emperor' was willing to answer it for free during the free exchange phase, that would be great, and it could save him some money.
That's why he asked this question during the free exchange phase. Even if 'The Emperor' wanted to charge, it didn't matter. The previous question was equivalent to warming up, arousing everyone's strong interest in the 'Above the Sequence.'
Klein estimated that even if a fee was required, everyone would immediately start crowdfunding.
Hobert didn't answer immediately but considered it for a moment before saying, "Thinking back, I have indeed come into contact with some of the 'Above the Sequence's' influence on the real world. Speaking of which, the value of this information is quite high.
"But in order to allow everyone to take precautions, for 1,000 pounds, I will tell you all the influences I know of to prevent you from being corrupted unknowingly."
Everyone thanked 'The Emperor.' When crowdfunding, they found that it was impossible for six people to divide the cost equally. If some contributed more and some contributed less, it would require calculating tens of pounds at a time.
So, the three ladies simply contributed 300 pounds each, while 'The World,' who raised the question, only needed to contribute 100 pounds. The other members could listen for free.
While Klein was very satisfied with this result, he once again sighed, the ladies of the Tarot Club are indeed wealthy!
Seeing that the crowdfunding was over, Hobert began, "First of all, please note that you should not casually look up at the cosmos in the future, including the night sky!
"Because the 'Above the Sequence' are all in the cosmos. You don't know what your gaze will inadvertently see.
"Although the probability of being affected is extremely small at present, it is not nonexistent."
Everyone was stunned. They didn't expect that the first precaution 'The Emperor' mentioned would make them feel a little unable to react for a while.
The night sky has always been above everyone's heads. Before this, no one felt that it was dangerous.
Klein behind the gray fog smiled slightly: I don't have such troubles now, because you can't see the cosmos in Backlund at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 556: There is no middleman who does not make a profit from the price difference
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The reminder of "Emperor" was like reminding everyone that "water is a poison," creating a subversive cognitive illusion.
However, based on what Hobert said earlier, everyone immediately understood: the cosmos is dangerous!
Cattleya simply asked, "Mr. Emperor, how many 'Above the Sequence' are there in the cosmos?"
Hobert replied, "I don't know."
This type of question cannot be answered for the time being, at least not in this semi-free question format. It should wait until Klein becomes an angel.
"I heard that there is a 'Naturism Sect' in the Rorsted Archipelago," Hobert continued, "As far as I know, it is a subordinate organization of the 'Rose School'.
"I heard rumors that the origin of this sect is that some Beyonders who loved astronomy accidentally saw something they shouldn't have seen with a telescope."
Klein behind the gray fog thought: I know too much about this sect, and I also know their connection with the 'Rose School'. I didn't expect their reckless behavior to be reflected in every aspect.
Fors was a little scared: Fortunately, although I like the cosmos, I have never used a telescope to look at it. Uh, speaking of which, although I like the cosmos, I rarely have time to appreciate it. I used to be busy writing books, and now I'm busy with auction houses and entertainment centers.
Audrey exclaimed: Without the cosmos, life seems to be a lot less romantic! Huh? Now that I think about it, I rarely look at the cosmos! Not only because of Backlund's thick fog, but also in the manor in the fief, I rarely look at the cosmos.
"Little Sun" had no cosmos to see, and Alger and Emlyn didn't notice this.
Cattleya thought for a moment and suddenly asked, "Mr. Emperor, now that you mention it, I suddenly recall that if it weren't for ritual needs or necessary mystical observations, I don't seem to look up at the cosmos.
"I didn't think much of it before, but now it seems a little unbelievable."
Hobert was slightly stunned before saying, "Perhaps, perhaps it is a kind of escape from our spirituality?"
He paused and added, "Not only Beyonders, but thinking about it, I have seen more than once in newspapers and magazines that people lament that modern people are too busy to even have time to appreciate the cosmos.
"Could it be that everyone's spirituality is trying to avoid their gaze from coming into contact with the cosmos?"
Everyone was stunned. This idea was the first time they had heard of it, but it seemed to make some sense.
"Can ordinary people's spirituality also make such a reaction?" Fors asked the question in everyone's mind.
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying, "I didn't take ordinary people's spirituality too seriously before, but thinking about it carefully, it should be possible.
"After all, the danger in the cosmos is too great, so great that even without knowing the specific source of danger, it can still make people avoid it.
"Of course, this may also stem from the fear in people's deep consciousness. In ancient times, someone may have seen that huge danger, and the degree of danger was so great that it could be written into the common consciousness of mankind.
"So, people's current spirituality is just a reaction based on subconscious information."
Finally, he spread his hands: "This is just my guess."
These words made the hall silent again.
Klein nodded secretly behind the gray fog: This is very mystical.
Audrey also thought for a few seconds and said, "Based on my experience of exploring the 'sea of collective subconscious' last time, I seemed to feel a common human fear in the human sea of collective subconscious.
"Logically speaking, those fears will affect people's subconscious and make us make stress responses from the subconscious."
Other members also recalled that they had previously discussed that those common human fears might include the fears of ancient people towards the ancient gods.
"Above the Sequence" should be more terrifying than the ancient gods. Fear of them must leave some indelible traces in the subconscious.
"This question cannot be verified for the time being. We will fill in the specific theory when we have time in the future." Hobert's words interrupted everyone's thoughts: "Anyway, try not to look up at the cosmos in the future."
Everyone felt that the "Emperor" made sense. After all, even Beyonders of the "Dream Weaver" pathway may not have in-depth research on human collective consciousness. Sitting here and imagining will only lead to some vague guesses.
Hobert continued, "The second point is, never respond to unknown calls.
"As mentioned in a piece of information I briefly announced earlier, I learned during the exploration of a tomb that an angel of the 'Door' pathway was corrupted.
"According to the literature in the tomb, the deceased Beyonder was a descendant of the Antigonus family, and they had been seeking ways to advance to an angel."
Klein and Fors listened to this information very carefully. Of course, they still remembered the information announced by the Emperor before.
At that time, Klein really wanted to exchange more detailed information with the "Emperor", but he didn't have the money at the time.
Only to hear the "Emperor" continue: "One of their 'High Sequence' Beyonders heard a call from the cosmos and, with the help of that call, became an angel of the 'Door' pathway.
"But after becoming an angel, He began to uncontrollably want to go to the cosmos. Later, He was completely corrupted in the cosmos, and after returning from the cosmos, He corrupted His own people!"
Hobert said seriously, "This is an important revelation, and I believe that everyone has heard this before: Do not respond to any unknown calls!
"Because the call from the cosmos will not only corrupt a person, but also his relatives and friends."
Other members nodded slightly. They received more education on "do not pray to strangers", as for the point of not responding to strange calls, they did not hear many corresponding warnings.
Klein and Cattleya almost simultaneously thought: Roselle responded to a strange call and was corrupted as a result.
"The third point is to pay attention to those crazy, bloodthirsty, or poorly self-controlled Beyonders or organizations." Hobert said, "The Beyonders of the orthodox churches are basically very rational. Mr. Fool and the devotees of the 'Creator' generally have strong self-control.
"Those organizations that engage in bloody sacrifices or killings at every turn are without exception either affiliated with evil gods or related to 'Above the Sequence'.
"Like the 'Rose School' and the 'Naturism Sect' I mentioned earlier, these are, so far, organizations belonging to 'Above the Sequence'.
"Everyone must be vigilant, and if there is a chance, you can also strike them down."
Regarding this point, everyone also understood very well, and at the same time had a new understanding of the "Rose School".
Alger was even pondering: Could it be that the confrontation with "Above the Sequence" is a collaboration between Mr. Fool and the "Creator"?
Hobert continued: "The fourth point is something I discovered in my recent action: Be careful of those who have Beyonder abilities outside of the 22 pathways."
Other members were stunned. They originally thought that the following reminders were things that everyone had heard so much that their ears were growing calluses, but suddenly there was a "abilities outside of the 22 pathways"!
Before everyone could ask questions, Hobert further explained: "As we all know, all Beyonder abilities are within the scope of the 22 pathways, but in a recent action, I encountered some Beyonder abilities that were not in these scopes.
"According to the information announced to us by the 'Creator', these Beyonder abilities come from the Boons of those 'Above the Sequences'!
"Beyonders who have received grace can use some Beyonder abilities that we have not seen before."
Cattleya almost immediately asked, "How long can these Beyonder abilities last?"
"As far as I know, it's similar to Beyonder abilities." Hobert replied, "As long as 'Above the Sequence' does not take it back, it can be used permanently."
This surprised everyone again. Audrey then asked, "How did 'Above the Sequence' do it?"
"The relevant theory is something I only recently figured out." Regarding this point, Hobert did not hide anything: "This is a bit similar to some of the blessings of the 'Lord of Storms' to the 'Storm Blessed'.
"The 'Storm Blessed' who has received this blessing can use many more abilities related to storms, lightning, and waves than the 'Storm Blessed' who has not received it."
Alger nodded slowly when he heard this. That was indeed the case.
Hobert continued, "Other gods should have similar abilities, but there is a problem with the duration.
"And 'Above the Sequence' is at a higher level than the gods, so Their Boon can be maintained for a long time.
"The specific way to obtain power currently seems to be through special sacrificial rituals. I believe that in this ritual, the recipient should be transformed by 'Above the Sequence' from the physical to the spiritual, so that they can use the grace ability for a long time."
Klein manipulated "The World" and exclaimed, "I didn't realize before that 'Above the Sequence' could influence the real world so deeply."
Others had similar exclamations in their hearts at this time.
Emlyn then asked, "How should we deal with these recipients? If we come into contact with them, will we be corrupted?"
He thought that he would have to hunt the followers of "Primordial Moon" next. Regardless of whether "Primordial Moon" is the one on the crimson moon or the one who has been interfering with Him, they are both "Above the Sequence".
So his hunting may encounter the "recipients" that the "Emperor" said. For him, these are some unheard-of enemies.
"Currently, you can treat them as normal Beyonders." Hobert said, "Except that they are a bit extreme in some things, there is currently no difference from other Beyonders.
"However, it should be noted that their Beyonder abilities have not been heard of before, and some are difficult to defend against."
Emlyn breathed a sigh of relief: "That's good."
Hobert reminded again: "The above are the points that everyone needs to pay attention to, and they are also the main means by which 'Above the Sequence' currently influences the real world."
Cattleya frowned: If you don't say it, we wouldn't even know, there are such high-level dangers around us.
Klein thought of many things. First of all, he had a basic understanding of the state of the Outer Deities: Currently, they can only influence the real world to a very small extent.
Then he could be sure that there must be something blocking the invasion of 'Above the Sequence' into the North and South continents, possibly the seven gods, or some other force.
Others also launched corresponding associations, but basically they were lamenting that this world is too dangerous.
After waiting for a few seconds, Klein saw that everyone was in contemplation, so he manipulated "The World" and said to Hobert: "I hope to get the information you just said about the Antigonus family."
Hobert nodded: "Yes, but this involves information such as Mr. 'Door' and 'Primordial Moon', so it cannot be exchanged for free, so my asking price is 1000 pounds!"
Klein was stunned. He didn't expect that it also involved "Primordial Moon". This Tarot Gathering was almost turning into a special session for "Primordial Moon".
At the same time, Fors and Cattleya's eyes lit up immediately after hearing that it also involved Mr. 'Door'. They had already decided to join the transaction again.
Emlyn and Audrey also decided to join the transaction again after hearing that it was also related to "Primordial Moon".
Emlyn felt that "Primordial Moon" seemed to be closely related to him, and Audrey was simply curious.
Alger and "Little Sun" were not very interested in this transaction. "Little Sun" was really not interested, because these "Above the Sequence" did not seem to have affected the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" yet.
And Alger was because he was relatively poor recently.
In the end, five members were willing to conduct the next transaction with the "Emperor", each splitting a reward of 200 pounds.
Hobert briefly explained the origin of that notebook. Klein then realized that the characteristics of the Human-skinned Shadow and the eyes of the Six-Winged Gargoyle that he had traded before were all obtained by Hobert in this operation.
Then Hobert began to briefly describe the contents of the notebook. The author of the notebook was Colin Antigonus. In Colin's ancestors' time, there were still three demigods. They seemed to often hear whispers from their ancestors.
So they believed that their ancestors should still be alive, but they didn't know where they were sealed?
One of the demigods went to find the legendary "Nation of the Evernight". It is said that their ancestors came from there. Finally, he found clear clues and believed that the "Nation of the Evernight" should be in the Hornacis Mountains.
After making sufficient preparations, he went to the Hornacis Mountains to search, but he never returned.
Hearing this, Klein thought: Fortunately, I restrained my curiosity before and didn't go to the Hornacis Mountains. Even the demigods of the Antigonus family will disappear, let alone a "Marionettist".
Then he thought: In this case, the ancestors of the Antigonus family may indeed be somewhere in the Hornacis Mountains?
This reminded Klein of the scene he had divined before, the dilapidated palace, and the wriggling worms intertwined on the chair in the depths of the palace.
Hobert continued: "Colin's ancestors also tried to find the whereabouts of their ancestor Antigonus through sacrifices and prayers, but they never received a response.
"They were not discouraged. Finally, one day, with their unremitting efforts, they finally received a response, but everyone in that sacrifice lost control, or became madmen, and another demigod was written off."
Klein behind the gray fog smiled slightly: I also know this is a tragedy, but I really want to laugh.
Fors seemed to understand something, saying, "Perhaps this is what a family of Beyonders is like. When there are no enemies to bring them danger, their ancestors are the greatest danger."
Thinking carefully, the Abraham family's situation is similar to that of the Antigonus family, except that the Abraham family had to search for Mr. Door because of a 'curse,' while the Antigonus family 'brought it upon themselves.'"
The other members participating in the transaction also had their own feelings, mostly lamenting that the dangers of the mystical world are everywhere.
At this time, 'The World' asked 'The Emperor' in a hoarse voice, "Is it true that the ancestor of the Antigonus family is in the Hornacis Mountains?"
Hobert smiled and said, "This question is not within the scope of this transaction."
He thought to himself: I need to charge more.
It's not that he's stingy, but this transaction was originally a friendly price, and he can't provide too much important information.
Klein didn't continue to ask. He already had a rough guess in his mind. Based on the information provided by Hobert, he now knew for sure that there was danger in the Hornacis Mountains, and he completely rejected the idea of going there. If he had to go there in the future, it wouldn't be too late to initiate further transactions with the Emperor.
Audrey asked curiously, "Mr. Emperor, why can their sacrifices receive a response? Does this mean that their ancestor is really not dead? It's just that their state is very strange."
Klein secretly gave Audrey a thumbs up in his heart.
However, Hobert said, "The main transactions are about the Antigonus family and 'Mr. Door,' as well as the 'Primordial Moon.'
"I will not give a clear answer to this question for the time being."
He paused and then said, "How about this, I will bundle some information and guesses about Adam, Amon, and Antigonus together, and we will conduct a transaction together when we have the opportunity.
"But I think, unless you need this information, there is no need to know these things."
Audrey nodded, indicating that she understood.
Then she recalled that 'The Emperor' had said a long time ago that Antigonus had two friends, and she guessed that those two friends wouldn't be Amon and Adam, would they?
Hobert continued to describe the contents of the notebook. The only remaining demigod of the Antigonus family was originally an 'Scholar of Yore.' He accidentally obtained an Beyonder characteristic of the neighboring pathway, 'Planeswalker.'
With the help of a hidden existence, he became an angel of the 'Door' pathway. This newly promoted angel was called Spike Antigonus.
According to Spike himself, the position of the hidden existence that provided help was very high, like a god of the 'Door' pathway, but not quite.
That hidden existence said that Antigonus's ancestor was sealed in a place with Him. Because of the special nature of the pathway, He could project power into the real world and hear his calls, but Antigonus could not do this.
In addition, the information given by this mysterious existence was very contradictory, sometimes telling Spike to look for Him and rescue the ancestor of the Antigonus family, and sometimes telling Spike not to go.
In the end, Spike responded to the call, also to rescue his ancestor, so he entered the cosmos.
Hearing this, the other members, based on some of the information previously announced by 'The Emperor,' were somewhat surprised that this angel named Spike actually came back later!
In theory, He should have been gone forever.
Hobert continued, "According to Spike's own account, He followed that call and came to a strange planet.
"There seemed to be traces of human activity there, with huge temples and large-scale cities.
"But now there were only wastelands left. Following the sound of the call, Spike came to a deserted temple.
"In that temple, there were tall stone pillars and exquisite sculptures.
"At the end of the temple, there were magical doors stacked together.
"Through that door, you could see a beautiful full moon, which seemed to be the moon hanging in the sky, but it looked so beautiful that you couldn't take your eyes off it.
"Then Spike heard that sacred voice, and He willingly knelt down on one knee, pledging allegiance to that voice, to the moon in front of Him."
Having had previous transactions, everyone immediately realized that it was obviously the 'Primordial Moon'!
Then everyone thought of that door. Fors asked, "Is that stacked door 'Mr. Door'?"
Hobert said, "I think it's part of Mr. Door's power. According to some information about the 'high sequence' Beyonders of the 'Door' pathway given by the 'Creator,' we speculate that that planet may have once worshiped 'Mr. Door,' or there may be legends about 'Mr. Door' there. In short, the intelligent life on that planet built huge palaces for 'Mr. Door.'
"That civilization may have become extinct after 'Mr. Door' was corrupted or sealed."
Another planet's civilization! Klein suddenly felt a sense of science fiction.
Audrey also learned today that 'high sequence' Beyonders can really affect the intelligent creatures of other planets, which made her couldn't help but imagine and yearn for it.
But in the end, she could only sigh: Unfortunately, the cosmos is too dangerous to go to other planets to see.
The most regretful was Fors: I can obviously go to other planets in the future to see other civilizations, but I can't go.
Cattleya, who heard this information for the first time at this gathering, asked, "That is to say, 'Mr. Door' has been contaminating some Beyonders."
Hobert nodded: "Yes.
"So I said, if one day you understand the content of 'Mr. Door's call, either you have become strong enough, or 'Mr. Door' is bewitching you to go to the cosmos."
Cattleya recalled 'The Emperor's' previous sigh and nodded thoughtfully.
Finally, Hobert said, "This angel named Spike has forgotten that His original intention was to rescue His ancestor, which is enough to prove that He has been corrupted and has become a loyal believer of the 'Primordial Moon.'"
Everyone nodded slowly, all expressing their approval of this conclusion.
With the end of this round of transactions, this Tarot Gathering was coming to an end.
After chatting about their respective encounters last week, Klein announced the end of the gathering.
Watching the members leave one by one, and completing the sacrifices and bestowal rituals between the members, Klein returned to the real world and took out the paper crane that had become very fragile, gently unfolding it.
Then he planned to ask all the questions he had accumulated recently at once, so he sharpened the pencil with a knife, writing the letters very small: Someone wants to get good luck in a short period of time and has offered a very good price. I wonder if you are interested?
Is your umbilical cord blood considered the blood of a mythical creature? If so, what price do I need to pay to get a drop?
Do you know how to make talismans with 'Worms of Time'?
After writing it full, he carefully folded the paper crane again.
Then he fell on the bed and entered the dream world through meditation.
In a daze, Klein suddenly woke up and saw the desolate black plain.
He went all the way into the dark spire in the middle of the plain, passed through the chaotic layout, and came to the depths of the tower.
Here, as usual, a circle of Tarot cards was scattered.
In the middle of the Tarot cards, a black baby carriage slid out of the shadows, with an unidentifiable baby wrapped in black silk lying inside.
Klein greeted politely: "Mr. 'Snake of Fate'."
Will Auceptin in baby form said "Hmm" and asked: "What kind of price did your friend who wants to get good luck temporarily offer?"
Klein said calmly: "Two 'Worms of Time'!"

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 557 The New Master of Longtail Island
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Time returned to around four o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert and Fors returned to the real world together.
Neither of them got up, but turned to look at each other, and both saw smiles on each other's faces.
It was as if they had a common, unspeakable secret, a kind of joy.
Fors said, "Hobert, I didn't expect you to have so many wonderful experiences and know so much information!"
Hobert sighed, this moment had finally arrived.
Fortunately, he had already thought about how to deal with it: "Some are my experiences, some are not. I was given the task of exchanging information at the Tarot Gathering, so sometimes I am 'The Emperor', not Hobert."
He sighed in his heart: Sure enough, after telling one lie, you have to use more lies to cover it up.
Especially in front of Fors, every lie made Hobert feel guilty, but the contradiction was that some things could only be buried in his heart and then covered up with lies.
He sighed in his heart: Fortunately, this is the last lie in this matter.
Fors, who was beside him, felt that Hobert's statement made sense. After all, "The Emperor" had always given the impression of being the representative sent by "The Creator" to the Tarot Gathering.
Next was the offering of rewards for this Tarot Gathering transaction, Hobert simply said: "We are now basically moving things from the left hand to the right, so there's no need to pay me your intelligence fee."
He smiled and said: "But in the future, when you encounter intelligence transactions, try not to be the main paying member."
Fors nodded, at this time she felt like she was a shill.
After completing the granting process, because there was no sacrifice from "Miss Magician", Hobert received a total of 4,700 pounds in cash and 2 Beyonder ingredients this time.
Seeing those two Beyonder ingredients, Fors seemed to understand something: "I was wondering before, where did you get so many Beyonder ingredients?"
Every month, Hobert could provide about 10 Sequence 8-level Beyonder ingredients to the auction house, and it had never been interrupted since the auction house opened.
At this time, Fors recalled that "The Emperor" and "The Sun" had successively traded 3 Beyonder weapons, and Hobert had obtained dozens of Beyonder ingredients from the transactions.
Moreover, every time at the Tarot Gathering, "Little Sun" could provide some new Beyonder ingredients.
At the last Tarot Gathering, "The Sun" also mentioned that because of his large amount of exchange, the Beyonder ingredients that had been in storage for a long time in City of Silver began to "increase in price", it could be said that he alone drove up the value of some Beyonder ingredients in the entire City of Silver.
Leaving the two Beyonder ingredients and 700 pounds to Fors, Hobert put away the 4,000 pounds in cash: "It costs a lot of money in Backlund, I have to take most of the money there."
Fors pushed the 700 pounds back to Hobert: "I don't have any places to spend gold pounds now, take them all, I'll take them from the safe when I need money."
The Sequence 6 potion formula and main ingredients had already been obtained, and now she had three mystical items in hand, so there was really no place to spend money.
Hobert didn't refuse, and stuffed the 700 pounds into the cloth bag together.
Fors asked: "What have you encountered recently that requires good luck?"
"It's a scientific research project that I invested in." Hobert smiled and said: "Because there will be constant attempts, I want to give those researchers some luck, maybe it will speed up the pace of research."
Fors opened her mouth, she hadn't thought of such a use.
She paused for a few seconds before saying: "If I'm lucky enough when I'm writing a book, can I keep bursting out with good inspiration, so will my writing speed become faster?"
Hobert was slightly stunned: "Uh, I think the problem with your writing is not a lack of luck!"
He remembered that there was a book with lawyers as the theme, why hasn't it been finished yet? Will he still not see that book by the end of the world?
Originally, Hobert had planned that if that book was published early, it might also play a certain anchoring role. Now it seems, let's face reality, that book may not be published for a while.
After chatting with Fors for a while, Hobert used "Travel" to return to the Earl's residence in Backlund, put down the cash first, and then returned to his room, and took out a copy of the "Wind Blessed" Beyonder characteristic and a copy of the "Gravedigger" Beyonder characteristic from "Nation of Disorder".
Then he immediately visited Captain Thomas and donated the "Gravedigger" Beyonder characteristic to the Evernight Goddess Church.
And in the subsequent conversation, he told Thomas that he was going to take over Longtail Island.
Thomas immediately stated that the local Evernight Goddess Church would definitely support Hobert's rule.
Hobert also said: "On Longtail Island, I need the help of the Earth Mother Church, so I hope to build or renovate a church of the Earth Mother Church there."
Thomas knew that Hobert's sudden gift of Beyonder characteristics was definitely not as simple as saying hello.
He got up and said: "Wait here for a moment."
More than ten minutes later, Thomas came back: "Archbishop Anthony said: Longtail Island is your fief, and it is your freedom to spread any religion you want."
Hobert knew that there was no big problem with the Evernight Goddess Church, he smiled and said: "Thank you Archbishop Anthony for me."
Then he got up and said: "I'll treat you to a meal another day, I have to attend a ball today, so I'll go back first."
Hobert also remembered this morning that he forgot to say hello to the Evernight Goddess Church and the Storm Church.
Leaving the Blackthorn Security Company, Hobert first returned to MI9 to clock out from work, and then took MI9's carriage to Holy Wind Cathedral.
After showing the "Wind Blessed" Beyonder characteristic to the servant, he successfully met Bishop Graham: "Earl Hobert!"
Graham, who was in his thirties, had light blue hair, and was wearing the Storm Church's bishop robe, immediately recognized Hobert.
Hobert smiled and shook hands with him, the two exchanged a few polite words, and Graham took Hobert to the backyard of the cathedral.
In a small reception room, Hobert pushed the Beyonder characteristic in the box to Graham, expressing his willingness to donate this "Wind Blessed" Beyonder characteristic to Graham.
Graham opened the box and looked at it, confirming that it was indeed a "Wind Blessed" Beyonder characteristic: "Earl, you must explain where this Sealed Artifact came from."
Hobert was prepared: "When I was in Feynapotter, three mercenary squads successively tried to assassinate me, one of whom was a 'Wind Blessed'."
Graham nodded, as long as it wasn't the Storm Church's bishops.
Hobert's statement was no problem, because the military did have some Beyonders of the "Sailor" pathway, not only in the navy, but also in the colonial army in the Southern Continent.
Many of these retired officers returned to the Northern Continent and joined the mercenary club.
Then Graham looked at Hobert, he didn't remember Hobert being a believer of the Lord of Storms, and even this Earl had always had little contact with the Storm Church.
So why did he suddenly donate a Sequence 6 Beyonder characteristic? You must know that the "Wind Blessed" Beyonder characteristic is very popular in the Berserk Sea!
"I came here this time to get to know the Bishop," Hobert said: "Of course, there is also something I want to ask for your help."
When dealing with this group of grumpy old men, Hobert chose to be straightforward, telling them that he was going to take over Longtail Island next, and that he was going to build an Earth Mother Church on the island.
Graham nodded slightly, Hobert was able to say hello in advance and send an Beyonder characteristic, which represented respect for the Storm Church.
He didn't care whether there was a third religion on that island in the Berserk Sea, where most of the population was indigenous.
Generally, the believers developed on this kind of island are not devout, or even simply difficult to develop believers, because it is simply difficult to explain the Storm Church's doctrine clearly to the natives.
But he was also very clear that this was not something he could decide.
The encounter was similar to that of the Blackthorn Security Company, Graham asked Hobert to wait here, and it wasn't until more than half an hour later, when it was almost dark, that Graham came back.
He stood opposite Hobert and said seriously: "Earl Hobert, the Archbishop asked me to tell you that the Storm Church has felt your kindness to us, so we also show equal kindness.
"First: There is only one Earth Mother Church allowed on Longtail Island, and the size and specifications cannot exceed the Storm Church's church; the number of clergy sent by the Earth Mother Church cannot be more than the number of clergy in the Storm Church's church on Longtail Island.
"Second: The Earth Mother Church is not allowed to preach to the Storm Church's believers, nor is it allowed to obstruct the Storm Church's preaching, otherwise we will directly intervene in the affairs of Longtail Island."
Hobert agreed immediately: "No problem."
After all, he was not familiar with the Storm Church before, and at this time they were able to let go and not obstruct the people of the Earth Mother Church from going to Longtail Island.
As for these two regulations, in Hobert's view, they were full of loopholes and would not affect his career at all.
Leaving the Holy Wind Cathedral, Hobert found that it was too late to go back and change into formal attire, so he simply took the MI9's carriage to attend a ball at an Earl's residence.
When the MI9's carriage stopped in front of an Earl's mansion, it attracted the attention of many people.
This department was too special for the nobles, even Georgina took an Earl-level carriage when she attended the ball.
Then Hobert, who was wearing less formal attire, got out of the car, and said to the Earl waiting at the door, whose name he also forgot: "Sorry, when I was about to get off work, there was suddenly an urgent case, and I didn't have time to go back and change into formal attire, I hope I'm not late."
The Earl who was greeting the guests at the door was obviously stunned for a moment before saying: "Of course you're not late, please come in."
When Audrey saw Hobert's casual wear, she shook her head helplessly: "Hobert, your attire is very ungentlemanly."
Hobert also noticed the gazes of the people around him, but he just smiled slightly: "I hope that because of my dress, many gentlemen will not invite me to participate in their gentlemanly balls."
Viscount Glaint shook his head: "You're a bit whimsical to think that way."
Hobert is an Earl, his father is a Duke, and now the father and son are members of the House of Lords, and Hobert has also started working in MI9.
For the nobles, even if they don't like them, there's no need to offend them.
...
Tuesday morning, Longtail Island.
The governor of Longtail Island, Yannis, came to the Governor's Mansion as usual. As soon as he got out of the carriage, his secretary greeted him and said: "Governor, Earl Hobert's special envoy has arrived."
Yannis was slightly stunned, and asked as he quickened his pace: "When did the special envoy arrive?"
Why didn't he notify himself?
The secretary's eyes were a little strange: "Just, just arrived."
It was indeed just arrived, but no one saw how he entered the Governor's Mansion, he seemed to suddenly appear in the hall of the Governor's Mansion.
But Yannis didn't have time to ask in detail at this time. As the governor, he had already received the telegram that Longtail Island had been sealed to Earl Hobert. The royal family had given him a new appointment, but he had been delaying leaving.
Because Yannis's industries were all on Longtail Island, there was a private iron mine, a rubber forest, and two manors.
At the same time, he often colluded with the garrison to capture the natives in the mountains and secretly engage in slave trading.
If possible, he hoped to continue to help Earl Hobert manage Longtail Island.
But Earl Hobert had not sent anyone to Longtail Island, so Yannis took the initiative to send someone to Backlund, but the person he sent was still on the road.
Arriving at the hall of the Governor's Mansion, Angus, who was in his twenties and looked very easy-going, was holding his arms and admiring the murals with the style of the Rothde Archipelago.
"Special Envoy!" Yannis said respectfully.
On Longtail Island, Yannis looked more majestic than the emperor, but in Backlund, he was completely a marginal figure of the royal family. If he hadn't been promoted to Sequence 5 by chance, he would not have been able to become the governor of a large island.
In Backlund, let alone the Earl's special envoy, he had to be polite even when he met the confidant of a lord.
Angus smiled and said: "Hello, Governor."
Seeing that the other party's expression was amiable, Yannis breathed a sigh of relief first: "Please come to the office for detailed talks."
Angus nodded and followed him to the Governor's office.
Looking at the luxurious decoration of the office, Angus sighed: "It's more impressive than the Earl's office."
Yannis was startled: "This, this is prepared for you."
Saying this, he quickly handed over a cigar.
Until this time, he still thought that this special envoy was simply here to understand the situation.
Angus waved his hand: "Go and prepare the information of Longtail Island, the Earl and a group of officials will come over in a while."
Yannis was stunned: "They also came by boat..."
"They didn't come by boat," Angus didn't continue to explain, but said: "Prepare for the handover, try to complete the handover this morning, and the Earl will inspect the territory in the afternoon."
Yannis was a little surprised, so fast!
Leaving the office, Yannis didn't react for several minutes.
Finally, he made up his mind and returned to the office: "Special Envoy!"
He saw that the special envoy was setting up a door in the center of the office at this time, and the special envoy was drawing some mysterious symbols on the carpet next to the door.
"What's the matter?" Angus asked without looking back.
"I am willing to donate a rubber forest to the Earl, can you help me say a few good words and let me continue to be the governor of Longtail Island?" Yannis smiled and said: "No one knows this island better than me, under my management, this island will definitely be able to operate stably."
Then he stepped forward and whispered, "If you are willing to help, I will give you an estate."
Angus glanced at Yannis, then continued writing the array, "The Earl will be here soon, talk to him."
"Okay, okay, okay." Yannis nodded repeatedly, "I'll go prepare the documents for the Earl to review."
After the governor left, Angus shook his head. If it were another Earl, perhaps this governor could have stayed on Longtail Island, but knowing Hobert, if he were told to run the territory unchanged, he would definitely be unhappy.
Soon, the staff of the Governor's Office heard that the Earl had sent a special envoy, and everyone was in a panic.
However, some staff members thought that it was just a special envoy, and if the Earl wanted the territory to continue operating, he would need someone to manage it, so they would not lose their jobs.
But before long, a team of soldiers came out of the Governor's Office, and the leading officer coldly ordered with a frosty face: "The Earl orders: All staff members are to gather in the hall to receive two months' salary and return tickets to Backlund! Everyone can leave their posts this afternoon."
"Those who want to continue working must pass the assessment of the human resources department and a series of studies before they can return to work."
This stunned everyone. Judging by this, the Earl didn't seem to plan to keep a single old employee!
Then someone wondered, where did these soldiers come from? Their uniforms don't seem to be from the Loen military, do they?
Everyone looked at Governor Yannis, who was also dumbfounded: When did these people hide in the office?
After thinking for a moment, he realized that these people might have come through the 'Traveler's Gate'.
Just as everyone was feeling strange, several more teams of fully armed soldiers came out of the Governor's Office, shouting slogans.
They were well-trained, well-equipped, and even had heavy machine guns!
After gathering in the courtyard, there were about three hundred of them.
Seeing the guns in the hands of these soldiers, everyone swallowed their full of complaints back down their throats.
Before long, a group of clerk-looking people came out of the Governor's Office, and the leading official introduced himself, "My name is Conrad, and I am the newly appointed Mayor of Longtail Island."
"May I ask who are the staff members of the land resources department?"
Two people stood up.
Conrad waved his hand, and three of his subordinates stepped forward to take over from them.
"May I ask who are the staff members of the finance department?"
In just a short while, Mayor Conrad sorted out the handover work of the Governor's Office.
Those staff members who went to take over shook their heads repeatedly after seeing the files and materials left by the Governor's Office. Two weeks ago, Hobert gave everyone who came to work on Longtail Island a copy of 'Introduction to Longtail Island'.
The Earl's introduction was more detailed than the information of the specific functional departments of the Governor's Office!
On the Governor's Office side, Earl's special envoy Angus came out with ten grim-looking members.
Angus said to Yannis, who was already stunned, "I am here to take over the secret files and secret affairs."
That is, the Beyonder files and cases of the island.
Yannis was stunned for a moment before he reacted, "Ah? Okay, okay."
He didn't expect the Earl to have so many Beyonder subordinates.
You know, many Earls would only hire a few Beyonders to protect themselves, but Earl Hobert sent ten Beyonders to Longtail Island. How much would that cost?
Several Beyonders from the Governor's Office finally felt a sense of crisis when handing over the Beyonder work.
They were once pirates or adventurers, and they already had their own industries on Longtail Island, and they didn't want to leave here.
At this time, several soldiers carried out the leather chairs of the Governor's Office, and next to this luxurious chair, there was also a chair.
A few minutes later, a man and a woman came out of the Governor's Office again. The man was handsome and cheerful, and the woman was mature and lazy. The soldiers in the hall immediately saluted the two.
These two were naturally Hobert and Fors.
Hobert and Fors sat down unhurriedly on the chairs in the hall, and the soldiers ended their salute.
At this time, Seel, who had been prepared in the courtyard, led three hundred well-equipped soldiers to change defenses with the local Loen garrison after notifying the local garrison in advance.
Conrad also replied, "Lord, the handover of the Governor's Office has been basically completed."
Angus also came out with people, "Lord, the secret files and cases have also been handed over."
Hobert nodded, "Proceed according to the original plan!"
"Yes!"
Angus went back to dismantle the 'Traveler's Gate', preparing to reinstall this gate in the courtyard, and then another batch of soldiers and logistics personnel would come.
This group of people will be stationed near the Governor's Office to protect the clerical staff to complete the asset registration and confirmation work of this city.
Because there have been two experiences of occupying new territories, the government department has a mature workflow. After occupying a new territory, the first thing is to re-sort out the situation of property, population, and land.
Colonies are quite rough in this regard.
Of course, you can't completely blame the colonies. The total population of Backlund is estimated, and the colonies will certainly not be much better.
Yannis stepped forward and said, "Earl!"
At this time, he had given up any hope of continuing to serve as governor. The Earl's takeover of the entire territory was so clean and neat, it was obviously premeditated.
Since the other party has never contacted him, then he must no longer be in the other party's "premeditation."
Hobert smiled, "Governor Yannis, thank you for your hard work."
"It's not hard work." Yannis also smiled, "The iron ore on Longtail Island..."
"I know." Hobert said, "On Longtail Island, only one-third of the iron ore and copper ore belong to the Governor's Office, and the rest is invested by the Navy or some nobles."
Yannis was first a little surprised, and then he thought that this was reasonable. Since he was ready to take over the officials of Longtail Island, how could he not understand the mineral resources on Longtail Island?
Hobert explained, "This is the fief given to me by the King. I don't care what it was like before. From now on, all industries here must uniformly pay taxes to me.
"The specific tax standards are in accordance with the Loen Kingdom's 'Tax Law'."
Yannis was slightly stunned. He just wanted to remind the Earl that this method of taxation would definitely not work. After all, this is the Rorsted Archipelago, not Backlund. There is no such thing as a 'Tax Law'.
There are only port usage fees, land usage fees, and other fees, because no one here will abide by the law.
But then he thought, anyway, he was not hired as the governor, so he can do whatever he wants.
Hobert asked, "Does the Governor have anything else?"
"No." Yannis smiled bitterly, "I just suddenly have to leave here and feel a little reluctant."
He was actually considering whether to wait on Longtail Island for a while? Wait until the Earl offends all the dignitaries of the Rorsted Archipelago, and he can come out to clean up the mess and continue to be the governor.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 558: The "Earl's Light" Bulb at the Banquet (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
