chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 562: Escape Journey with Princess Alice
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Tremble!" The "Roselle" on the stage said, "When the new 'Black Emperor' descends upon the earth, it will subvert the entire world, and that will be the doomsday and disaster of the whole world!"
No surprise, no applause, Spectator in the theater became very focused, so focused that their expressions were a little stiff.
In Hobert's view, the atmosphere gradually became strange, and the dangerous aura became stronger and stronger.
The "Roselle" on the stage has a problem!
Hobert immediately made a judgment: "Stop the performance!"
Whirr~
Everyone either turned around or turned their heads to look at Hobert.
"Polonov, that idiot!" "Roselle" said, "He didn't even notice that there is a demigod in the Loen royal delegation!"
Hobert grabbed Alice and Bertram by the collar and dragged them back.
As soon as the princess and prince moved, they returned to normal and showed surprised expressions.
Ricmont, who was protecting in the back row, also came back to his senses at this time and hurried forward to meet him, helping Bertram to run out.
Feynapotter also reacted, quickly covering Princess Ethel and the prince to walk out from another exit.
The others still sat there motionless, as if continuing to enjoy the performance.
For Hobert and Ricmont, it was the best choice to leave here first, because no one knew whether Feynapotter's demigod was a helper or an enemy.
It wasn't until they left the theater that Alice asked Hobert: "What was that just now?"
"There's something wrong with that actor!" Hobert replied simply, he couldn't draw a conclusion about what the specific problem was, but there must be a problem.
As soon as he finished speaking, Hobert, who was walking in front, suddenly stopped, and the front was not the way out of the theater.
Hobert was about to turn around and talk to Ricmont, but found that Ricmont and Bertram behind him were gone.
Alice also noticed this, she firmly said: "Just a few seconds ago, I could still hear Bertram's panting."
That prince was far less calm than Alice, probably because he was nervous, so his panting was loud.
Hobert didn't even feel when they disappeared, and when he looked at the corridor they were in, the sides were dark as if there was no end.
A thin layer of mist floated on the soft carpet, as if it was no longer in the real world at this time.
Hobert propped up his arm: "Hold my arm."
Alice immediately stepped forward and took Hobert's arm.
Hobert injected spirituality into the "Traveler's Knife". Fortunately, the ability of "Travel" is still available.
He cautiously observed it and saw that there seemed to be no problem in the spirit world, so he and Alice entered the spirit world together.
Soon Hobert noticed that there was not a single spirit world creature in the spirit world!
Something is wrong!
Hobert immediately left the spirit world, and as a result, he saw the "Roselle" on the stage again, but the other viewers were gone, and only the three of them were in the empty theater.
The "Roselle" on the stage smiled and said: "It seems that you have a Sealed Artifact with the ability of 'Travel' on you, but it's useless. My Sealed Artifact has marked you two. If you travel through the spirit world or the underworld in any form within three days, you will return here."
Hobert stared at the other party: "Are you a Saint from the Intis Republic?"
And it is very likely that he is a Saint of the "Seer" pathway.
"The child's reaction is quite fast." The other party smiled and said: "But I cannot admit this."
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth, doesn't this equal to admitting it?
The other party said again: "How about we play a game? If you can get out of here, I will send you back to Loen.
"But I want to explain to you that I will also tell the other two demigods about your whereabouts.
"If you can return toBacklund under our pursuit, you win."
Hobert negotiated with the other party: "Why don't you just let us out? The game should start from the most exciting place."
"Haha, hahahaha!" The "Roselle" on the stage suddenly laughed, and laughed so hard that he couldn't catch his breath.
Hobert waited for the other party to laugh for a while before asking while guarding against the other party's sneak attack: "Is it that funny?"
"Sorry." The other party was laughing with tears in his eyes: "I just thought of a past event, okay, the game can begin."
"Wait." Hobert asked: "Where are the others?"
"I let them out at the time." The other party smiled and said: "It's enough to trap Princess Alice, what do you want others to do in here?
"If you hadn't noticed something was wrong, I would have just trapped the princess behind you."
Alice grabbed Hobert's arm hard, the scene was scary to think about.
"Okay, the game starts." The other party made a gesture to leave: "Please."
Hobert took Alice and prepared to go out from another exit to take a look.
But after only a few steps, he seemed to suddenly think of something and looked at the door on the stage where the actors entered and exited.
Hobert looked at the "Roselle" on the stage for a few seconds, then smiled and said: "How about we also go to the stage to interact with you?"
"Roselle" was slightly stunned, and Hobert took Alice to the small stage without any explanation.
Hobert stared at the other party cautiously, and gradually moved to the entrance and exit of the actors with Alice.
The "Roselle" on the stage smiled: "I didn't expect you to discover it so quickly."
He suddenly raised his hand and said again: "But don't think about playing tricks, as long as you join this game, you can't break the rules."
Hobert realized that the other party had done something when he raised his hand.
But he didn't feel any dangerous aura, and there was no time to do a careful inspection at this time.
Hobert opened the door, and outside was a lively bar. Compared with the weird theater, this place was like another world.
Looking back, it was a room full of sundries.
The two people came out of the door, which shocked the drinkers. The whole bar became quiet.
First of all, their formal wear and court dresses were obviously expensive, and the man was handsome and the woman was noble and beautiful, which stunned them.
And the bartender was surprised that the door was behind the storage room. When did these two go in?
After coming out, Hobert immediately went to get the talisman that could summon Duke Southville, but only took out a paper doll.
Hobert finally understood that when the other party raised his hand just now, he replaced the talisman with a paper doll.
Theoretically speaking, even if the other party is a Sequence 3, there is no way to replace the talisman so easily. It must be the Sealed Artifact he said that made it easy for him to do this.
But another question came up. Hobert was a little confused. Why did the other party let himself and Alice go so easily? Is this just wanting to play a game?
But now is not the time to think about this question. Hobert must face reality. His wishful thinking has failed. Originally, he planned to summon Duke Southville as soon as he came out and announce the end of the game.
Now it's good, the angel can't be summoned, and "Travel" can't be used, so I can only walk back to Backlund!
Fortunately, Hobert's wallet was with him. He took out a 1 soli paper money, squeezed to the bar and gave it to the bartender: "Where is this?"
Everyone was slightly stunned again, and the bartender accepted the tip: "Ludsey Town."
"What county?"
"East Tucker County!"
Hobert nodded. It was indeed in the territory of Loen, and it was on the east side of the Balchis Mountains. If he could find the train station smoothly, he could return to Backlund in most of the day.
"Is there a clothing store in town? Is there a rental carriage?"
"Turn left when you go out and walk for a while to reach the clothing store. There are rental carriages at the intersection over there."
Hobert stroked his top hat and nodded to express his gratitude. He took Alice and walked out: "We must first change into clothes that are convenient for action, and we must act quickly. The other party may catch up at any time."
It's only past seven o'clock in the evening, although it's already dark, but there are still many people on the streets of the town.
But Hobert didn't go to the clothing store first, but went to the rental carriage, gave the other party a 10-pound note, and asked him to pick up a Mr. Orwell at the nearby train station.
If he doesn't pick up anyone by midnight, he will come back. The coachman happily raised his whip and set off. He usually doesn't earn that much money in a month.
During the conversation, Hobert talked about the direction of the railway.
Then the two came to the entrance of the clothing store. Hobert "distorted" the feelings of the owner and customers inside, making them suddenly feel stomach pain.
When they all went to the toilet, Hobert and Alice entered the store and locked the door.
Alice said: "I have money, you don't need to rob."
Hobert chose clothes while saying: "It's best not to let anyone see our disguise process!"
Alice thought about it and agreed, and then she realized: "You, why are you giving me men's clothes?"
Hobert said to her: "Next, we are going to play hide-and-seek. We must try our best not to let them find us. The best way is to turn the princess into a man."
Alice hugged her clothes: "It sounds exciting."
Hobert smiled slightly: "It's dangerous, not exciting, go change your clothes quickly!"
The two came to the fitting room. Although there were two fitting rooms, they were separated by a layer of cloth, and the two could see each other's calves.
When Alice saw Hobert's pants on the ground, she suddenly felt her heart pounding a few times: Hobert is taking off his clothes next to me!
She tried to restrain her mind and quickly went to change her clothes, but she couldn't help but peek at Hobert.
Since childhood, Alice had maids to help her put on and take off her clothes, so she was not skilled at taking off her clothes, and even less skilled at putting on clothes, after all, these were men's clothes that she had never worn.
Fortunately, Hobert didn't seem to be very fast, only a little faster than Alice.
In fact, Hobert had completed the process of bestowing himself, took out the "Faceless Necklace" from the "Nation of Disorder" and a mystical item with the ability of "Faceless".
This mystical item was just made by Winston. At that time, two pieces were made in total, one was sold to Audrey, and one had been kept in the "Nation of Disorder". I didn't expect it to come in handy now.
Hobert briefly explained the ability of the mystical item and handed Alice a mask made of "Order Crystal": "Keep it with you, so that even if we get separated, they won't be able to divine your location."
While speaking, Hobert turned into a middle-aged man while finding a bottle of spirits from the clothing store owner, opened the bottle and gulped a few mouthfuls, then handed it to Alice.
Alice frowned slightly when she smelled the spirits, but she still quickly finished the remaining mouthfuls.
At Hobert's suggestion, Alice turned into a slightly hunchbacked old man.
The rest was to dirty the clothes, leave 10 pounds in cash for the clothing store, and then Hobert and Alice pretended to be drunk and fought, rolling on the dirt road outside. After a few rolls, the two became more and more like drunks.
After all these preparations were completed, Hobert said: "Back to the bar."
Alice, whose appearance had now turned into an old drunkard, was slightly stunned, and immediately understood that if they returned to the bar, it would definitely exceed the other party's expectations.
Hobert held a wine bottle in one hand and hooked Alice in the other, muttering some songs that Alice had never heard before, and it even seemed to be a language she had never heard before.
He swayed back and forth, singing as he walked, as if he could fall at any time.
This made Alice also let go of her acting, also singing songs that no one understood, and swaying forward with Hobert.
When there was still some distance from the bar, two big men came out of the bar. The older one had a slightly narrow nose, a round face, and thin lips. This was a typical Feyasc appearance.
The two looked a little unhappy, glanced at the two drunks outside, one went to the clothing store, and one went to the only intersection in the town.
This must be the pursuers, and one of them must be a demigod.
It's not that they were negligent and didn't notice Alice who was close at hand, but if Hobert, disguised as a drunk, didn't intend to attack them, their spirituality would not have a clear warning.
At most, they would take a few more glances at these two drunks and think they were very interesting.
Of course, Hobert would not conflict with the other party at this time. Although he was confident that he could defeat the other party's demigod, who knew if this was the only demigod who came after him?
Hobert shouted loudly and entered the bar, and found that the drunks inside were relatively quiet, and the bartender carefully went to check the storage room to see if there was anyone inside.
Amid Hobert's scolding, the bartender had to come back and pour them wine first.
Soon the bar returned to its original lively atmosphere. After a little inquiry, Hobert learned from these drunks who were already drunk that two people had just come out of the storage room door. After asking some questions, they left without even giving a tip.
As for the questions they asked, they were naturally related to Hobert and Alice who had appeared before.
So they went to the clothing store and the intersection.
After drinking a glass of wine, Hobert felt that the time was almost up, and took Alice away from the bar again.
It was already past eight o'clock, and there were not many lights in this kind of small town.
After the two swayed into the darkness, Hobert pulled Alice and ran forward quickly.
At this time, there was not a single person on the road. Hobert simply carried Alice on his back and advanced in a "distorted" manner. Alice, clinging to Hobert's back, felt like she was traveling at lightning speed, faster than any carriage or train!
After running through the wilderness for more than half an hour, the two saw a Blink of fire in the distant sky, obviously the pursuers had caught up with the carriage and returned to the town after realizing they had been fooled.
Alice smiled: "They are always one step behind you."
Hobert smiled without saying a word. He was a master of hide-and-seek when he was a child.
The demigod who played "Roselle" must not have imagined that Hobert possessed an ultimate anti-divination mystical item like the "Crystal of Order." After letting Hobert go, they couldn't divine his location.
However, among the two people who later chased after them, the one with obvious Feysac characteristics should be a demigod of the "Hunter" pathway. As long as they knew that Hobert and Alice had once disguised themselves as drunkards, they could quickly track them down based on some clues.
So, the two of them had to run! Keep running!
Soon, Hobert, carrying Alice on his back, found the railway. In fact, if that demigod continued to chase the carriage, they could still find clues, but he returned to the town in the first instance.
Hobert began to advance in the direction of Backlund. Alice, who had returned to her original appearance on his back, suddenly said: "Wait, I thought of a problem."
"What problem?"
"If I hadn't appeared in Masin, but appeared in Backlund, their goal would also be achieved," Alice said seriously.
Hobert thought about it, and it was indeed the case.
The princess, who was originally going to participate in the event, suddenly returned to Backlund. How should this be explained?
Or rather, as long as Alice was discovered to have appeared in Backlund, it would almost declare the failure of this diplomatic event.
If Alice was in a "missing" state, the negotiations on the Masin side would continue, but after the final results were achieved, some agreements would have to be reached, right?
Alice should be authorized to sign that agreement after the negotiation results were reported to Backlund and obtained Backlund's approval.
Of course, Prince Bertram could also be temporarily assigned to sign it, but the activities in the past few days had already shown that Alice was the head of the delegation. If Prince Bertram signed it, the other party might not buy it.
Therefore, the Intis Republic and the Feysac Empire didn't necessarily have to kill Alice and cause a shocking international incident. They only needed to force her back to Backlund.
After Hobert understood this, he asked Alice: "Do you know where the Duke of Southville lives specifically?"
Alice was slightly stunned and shook her head.
Hobert sighed and said: "In that case, there won't be too much danger if we return to Backlund.
"But if we go to Masin again, it will definitely be a very difficult road. Which path do you plan to choose?"
Alice thought for a full half a minute before saying: "Return to Masin!"
"Okay." Hobert continued to "sprint" forward using distortion.
Alice was slightly stunned: "I thought you would object."
Hobert smiled: "Then I would be letting down your determination."
Alice was very moved. She felt that the back she was lying on was so upright!
But she soon discovered: "Isn't this still going back to Backlund?"
Hobert smiled and said: "We have to pretend to go to Backlund."
Alice reminded: "It's best not to seek help from the royal family, and don't appear publicly in Backlund."
She knew several Intis Republic spies in the palace. The reason for keeping them was to use them when necessary.
If people found out that Princess Alice had returned to Backlund, this matter would likely be impossible to hide.
In other words, any power in Backlund now has the risk of exposure, so it's better not to contact them at all.
"I know," Hobert said with a smile.
More than twenty minutes later, the two caught up with a train heading to Backlund.
And soon, when two trains met, Hobert took Alice and jumped onto the train going in the opposite direction of Backlund.
It was a freight car. Hobert found a half-full carriage to rest in.
The pursuers should not have caught up to the railway at this time. Even if they did, they would think that Hobert and Alice had boarded the train to Backlund.
In that case, they wouldn't chase so closely. By the time they found out that the target was not on the train to Backlund, it would be at least the second half of the night, so Hobert and Alice were basically safe tonight.
This was a carriage loaded with large bundles of cotton thread, and sitting on it was neither too soft nor too hard, just right.
Alice, who was also a little tired, suddenly sighed: "To be honest, this feeling of no one being able to eavesdrop on my conversation and no one paying attention to my demeanor is quite good."
Hobert smiled and said: "I can sell you that mystical item that changes appearances, and you can leave the palace and play around in someone else's appearance."
Alice rubbed her arms: "That's a good idea."
She said: "I'm a little cold."
Hobert found that he was also wearing a single layer of clothing.
"As a gentleman, shouldn't you open your arms to me at this time?" Alice smiled: "Haha! Now no one will say that I'm not being ladylike enough by doing this."
As she spoke, she simply got up and sat next to Hobert.
Hobert smelled the alcohol coming from her breath. He then remembered that those few sips of spirits and the later glass of inferior wine might have made her a little drunk, right?
Without thinking too much, Hobert opened his arms.
He wasn't a saint either. Being able to secretly hug a princess was quite exciting to think about.
Alice snuggled into Hobert's arms, hugged his waist, and smiled triumphantly again: "Hobert, do you have any thoughts of becoming a member of the royal family?"
Hobert certainly understood what she meant: "I'm sorry, Princess, I know your feelings, but I can't give you too much, and I can't have too deep of an entanglement with the royal family."
He had wanted to explain this for a long time. It wasn't that he was such a saintly gentleman, but he felt that it would be a jerk if he didn't make some things clear.
"I understand." Alice leaned against Hobert's chest, enjoying this moment of warmth. As for future things, she would think about them later.
Soon, Alice, who had drunk some spirits and relaxed from the process of escaping just now, actually fell asleep in Hobert's arms.
Hobert, who had been in a state of vigilance, suddenly felt that his potion had digested quite a bit.
He pondered for a while before seeming to understand. First of all, in order to prevent being eroded by the potion, he had set many bottom lines for himself, and he had given himself strict principles in terms of love between men and women.
And tonight, whether it was the thrill of escaping or the excitement of outwitting the pursuers, the emotions that the two had suppressed in this process naturally made them feel that hugging each other in this state was a way to seek a sense of security.
At this time, Hobert realized that it was precisely because of this state that his demands on himself had been lowered.
At the same time, he seemed to suddenly understand that to digest the potion at the level of a demigod in the "Lawyer" pathway, one must not only break the external rules, but also break the rules or principles that one has designed for oneself.
And such behavior is mostly depraved, so the potion will be digested.
Another thing is that Hobert believed that he had enough appeal to Alice, which made her break the etiquette that a princess should have and the ingrained restraint, and actively request Hobert's embrace.
This can be said to be a true expression of emotions, but from another perspective, isn't it a kind of depravity?
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled and found that it didn't matter if he broke the principles he had set for himself. It wasn't some heinous crime.
He even reflected on whether the string in his heart had been too tight in the past, so tight that it was a bit inhumane?
Hobert didn't continue to think about it, but he decided that he could appropriately relax his bottom line in the future.
After all, he was already an Earl now, and it would be too boring to be so tight.
After a while, Hobert realized again, could this be the beginning of his complete depravity?
But immediately afterwards, he temporarily put this question out of his mind.
It wasn't until dawn that Hobert woke Alice up.
The pursuers behind them should be chasing here non-stop at this time. If they continued to take the train, they would definitely be caught up.
When the train entered a small city, Hobert and Alice changed their appearances again and once again "patronized" a clothing store.
When they came out again, they were dressed as a young couple.
This kind of "character role-playing" made Alice very satisfied, so she could recklessly hug Hobert's arm and openly make some intimate gestures.
After having breakfast in a coffee shop, Hobert prepared to change to a carriage for another ride, so the two boarded a long-distance carriage to the Southville County.
On the carriage, the two casually chatted with other passengers, occasionally showing some sweet actions, making everyone think that they were a couple going to Southville County for vacation.
Hobert called himself Anthony, a lawyer. This time it was purely a natural performance. He told several interesting cases he had encountered before, and everyone not only admired him but also labeled him as a lawyer in their hearts.
Alice did know that Hobert had worked as a lawyer before, but she didn't expect that he had encountered so many bizarre cases. At this time, the admiring look in her eyes was not entirely feigned.
In an atmosphere of laughter and joy, the whole morning passed.
Close to noon, suddenly the coachman's exclamation was heard, and the carriage stopped abruptly.
Then came the coachman's scolding: "You two damn bastards don't want to live anymore? Do you know..."
The coachman's voice suddenly stopped, because one of the people who stopped him pushed him off the seat with a casual push.
This caused the passengers in the carriage to exclaim. They were not taking those remote roads. There was a small town not far ahead. How could there be robbers in such a place?
Hobert saw that the two people were the two who chased out of the tavern yesterday.
He gripped his cane tightly, ready to fight at any time.
The two opened the car doors on the left and right. The passengers in the car were all frightened, especially the Feysac man, who gave them a great psychological shock.
Alice also tightened her grip on Hobert's arm, leaning tightly on him. Her fright was not entirely feigned.
Hobert tried to make himself calm: "Gentlemen, if you want to rob money, we will give you the money we have on us, but please don't hurt us."
As he spoke, he took off his top hat and put his wallet in the hat.
Others also reacted, and someone said: "Anthony, the lawyer, is right, please don't hurt us."
"Fortunately, there is a courageous young man like Anthony, the lawyer, otherwise I wouldn't have realized this."
"..."
Everyone put money into the hat while speaking, so as not to be hurt.
The two people on the left and right stared at the people in the carriage for several laps, but they only glanced at Hobert and Alice.
When Hobert handed the money to the other party, the big guy snorted: "No backbone."
With that, they closed the car doors.
The passengers in the carriage were stunned. They didn't expect the other party to leave like this?
Hobert also smiled, feeling that the other party cheated when digesting the "Hunter" potion? Didn't they find anything?
Then he realized that the other party only thought that the target might be on the carriage on this road, and they were not sure which carriage it was.
Of course, the most likely thing was that everyone's recognition of "Anthony, the lawyer" made the other party take it lightly.
And if the other party had caught the top hat that Hobert handed over just now, they might have discovered some clues, but the other party did not suspect this young couple who looked very intimate at all.
After all, one of the two targets was a princess who had always behaved very noble, especially the princess of Loen, who was known for her restraint. In their concept, it was impossible for her to make such intimate gestures with a man who protected her.
Hobert returned the money and wallets in the top hat without any difference. The passengers scolded whether the two people just now were sick?
Hobert got out of the car and helped the coachman who had fallen to the ground. After confirming that the other party was okay, Hobert stuffed 5 pounds of banknotes into his hand as compensation for implicating the other party.
The coachman seemed to understand something and returned to the driver's seat silently, continuing on his way.
The atmosphere in the carriage gradually became enthusiastic. Taking advantage of the fact that everyone was not paying attention, Alice whispered in Hobert's ear: "That was so thrilling just now!"
Hobert smiled: "That's what makes it interesting."
He found that he seemed to be enjoying this game after all.
At more than three o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert and Alice arrived at their planned stop and got off the car, then took a boat south.
On the boat to Desi County, Hobert and Alice changed their clothes again.
Because the two bought tickets in the name of husband and wife, it was only natural to have a cabin on the boat.
But because they were playing ordinary couples, they only wanted a medium cabin in order to fit the persona, and as a result, there was no servant's room, which made it difficult for them to change clothes.
Alice smiled and said: "When one of them changes, the other one closes their eyes for a while."
Hobert said: "Why don't I go out first..."
"That would be weird!" Alice said seriously, "Do normal couples avoid each other when changing clothes? That would expose us to risk."
Hobert smiled, "If you're not afraid, why should I be? I'll change first."
And while he was changing, Alice didn't close her eyes.
Fortunately, it was just a change of clothes, not a full undress, otherwise Hobert would have felt a little embarrassed.
In return, Hobert didn't close his eyes when Alice changed, and seeing her shapely legs, he sighed in his heart again: those legs are truly amazing.
Hobert's slightly aggressive gaze made Alice very satisfied.
At the same time, Hobert felt his potion digest a little more.
At this point, the digestion of the potion was like a measure; as long as it digested, it seemed to prove that the two people's hearts had opened up some of the things they had originally held onto.
After changing clothes and resting for a while, the two went to the restaurant for dinner.
Watching the beautiful evening scenery on both sides of the river, Hobert and Alice, transformed into a middle-aged couple, looked at each other with much more tenderness.
After dinner, Hobert kept watch again while Alice rested.
At about midnight, Hobert carried Alice horizontally and jumped onto a bridge over the river by "distorting" his own weight and temporarily "tampering" with gravity.
He quickly waited for a passenger train and climbed aboard. This railway was the one they had taken to Masin before, and it was also the only railway to Masin.
Hobert guessed that the other party was very likely to intercept them within Masin, but this journey through the Kingdom of Loen should be relatively safe.
There weren't many people on this train. They found two seats side by side and sat down. Alice fell asleep in Hobert's arms again, and even Hobert dozed off.
They both knew that tomorrow's journey would be difficult.
They rested until dawn, when they were about to enter Masin. The two washed their faces to wake up and then went to the dining car for breakfast.
Opening the door of the dining car, Hobert didn't go in immediately but observed the surroundings.
In the dining car, there was an early-rising old woman, a disciplined officer, a couple who seemed to be in a cold war, a middle-aged man with a delicate mustache, and several crew members who were taking advantage of the few customers to quickly enjoy breakfast.
Seeing that there were no problems, Hobert took Alice into the car.
"Eat more!" Hobert ordered a large plate of food.
They might not have a chance to eat lunch today, and whether they would have a chance to eat dinner depended on the results of today's actions.
Alice also obediently devoured a lot, and finally burped unladylike.
Hobert drank the red tea in his cup and asked with a smile, "Ready?"
Alice replied, "Ready!"
"Let's go!"
"Excuse me, please wait a moment." At this moment, a middle-aged man in his forties with a delicate mustache and a friendly smile, who was sitting at the next table, suddenly said.
Hobert was slightly stunned, feeling like he had seen this person somewhere before.
"Little friend, you're good at hide-and-seek!" The other party smiled.
Hobert immediately became alert. This was the actor who had played Roselle before!
The other party continued, "I haven't had so much fun in many years! You actually have very powerful anti-divination mystical items, as well as mystical items that can change your appearance."
"To be honest, if I didn't know your purpose, I wouldn't have been confident in finding you again."
He smiled and said, "To make this game more interesting, how about I injure you before those two idiots catch up?"
Without knowing when, the early-rising old woman, the disciplined officer, etc., the entire carriage of people had turned into the appearance of this man with the delicate mustache.
Almost at the same time, they all looked at Hobert and Alice.
This scene made Alice feel a chill down her spine, and she unconsciously stood behind Hobert.
Hobert sat down again, unhurriedly poured himself a cup of red tea, took two sips, and then said, "You've patiently waited for us to finish breakfast, which shows that you really want this game to continue."
"To make this game more exciting, shouldn't you give us ten seconds to escape?"
As a result, the other party burst into laughter again: "Haha, hahahaha!"
Hobert waited for him to finish laughing again, "What's so funny?"
"Nothing." The other party laughed with tears in the corners of his eyes, "I just remembered something from the past, so..."
Just as the other party was speaking, Hobert had already drawn his rapier, and the blade quickly lengthened, stabbing the other party in the heart.
But Hobert wasn't happy because the other party's expression was too calm. Even if a mosquito bit him, he shouldn't be so calm.
The other party smiled and said, "That was a surprise attack."
Hobert retracted his rapier. The other party disappeared as soon as he finished speaking, and then an identical middle-aged man with a delicate mustache emerged from the void. The one Hobert had stabbed earlier was indeed a "historical projection."
The middle-aged man who had just emerged smiled and said, "The material you used to forge this weapon looks very familiar."
This seemed to be an order, and people with the exact same appearance around them, either using Beyonder abilities or weapons, attacked Hobert together.
Hobert had no intention of fighting them at all. He picked up Alice and crashed out of the window.
The Marionettes dressed as old women, officers, etc., chased after them closely. Finally, the exquisite mustache man who had been talking to Hobert unhurriedly finished the coffee in his cup.
He snapped his fingers, and a dry leaf five kilometers away was ignited. The next second, he appeared at the location of the leaf, making a gun shape with his hand: Bang bang bang bang~
Like a machine gun, the "Scholar of Yore" fired a series of "air cannonballs" with the power of coastal defense guns.
Running through the forest with Alice tucked under one arm, Hobert didn't dodge, but these "cannonballs" perfectly missed him, blasting trees and rocks into the air.
This "Scholar of Yore" once again used "Flame Jump" to come to the front of Hobert, Hobert suddenly stopped and ran in the opposite direction.
Although he couldn't see the other party's "spirit body threads", he could feel the danger ahead.
Behind him were the Marionettes chasing after him. The sword in Hobert's hand turned to normal thickness, and he lunged at one of the Sequence 5 Marionettes with a thrust.
The Marionette was a Guardian in life. His lightsaber was thrust into the ground, forming a solid "Dawn Barrier".
Hobert slashed in front of him, and the space in front was cut open like wallpaper. Countless malicious hands stretched out from inside at the same time, and a gap was also cut open in the "Dawn Barrier".
Hobert hardly slowed down, squeezed through the gap before it merged again, and kicked the "Guardian" Marionette away. The rapier suddenly lengthened, and with a violent wave, he cut the Marionette in half in mid-air.
At the same time, eight ghouls emerged from the gap in the underworld and began to attack the Marionettes.
Hobert, who had already run a distance away, didn't forget to wave his hand to close the gap in the underworld.
Before the Marionettes could surround him, Hobert broke out of their encirclement.
The "Scholar of Yore" didn't chase too closely but arrived at the battlefield afterward, glanced at the Marionettes entangled by the ghouls, and then looked at the Marionette that had been cut in half, whose "spiritual threads" were severely damaged, and obviously could no longer be used.
He smiled and sighed, "The little friend has a lot of good things on him!"

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 563 The Hateful Seer (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[200 Powerstones bonus]
The "Scholar of Yore" had no intention of dealing with Hobert alone. He was merely leading his Marionettes, following far behind, as if genuinely enjoying the game.
Hobert had no intention of turning back to counterattack, because he was very clear that if the other party summoned one or two angels from the "Historical Void," the only thing Hobert could do was ask the "Creator" for help.
They chased and fled like this for a morning. Hobert still hadn't lost his general direction, and continued to advance towards Masin.
Perhaps because his goal was too clear, as he passed through a desolate valley, a high wall of fire suddenly appeared in front of him.
Immediately afterward, the two Feysac people who had been chasing Hobert and Alice blocked the way.
In addition, two people wearing Intis Republic attire were also blocking Hobert, but judging from their positions, they were wary of the two Feysac people.
However, Hobert was their common target at this time, because they had almost run their legs off in the past two days searching for Hobert. After stopping Hobert, they pounced on him almost immediately.
Seeing that this battle was unavoidable, Hobert had no choice but to put Alice aside and prepare to fight with all his strength.
At this time, the "Scholar of Yore" also led his Marionettes and caught up from behind.
The large man with Feysac features was Polonov, the demigod of the "Hunter" pathway who had previously probed the Loen Kingdom delegation.
He complained to the "Scholar of Yore" in ancient Feysac: "If you could have killed them that night, there wouldn't be so much trouble now."
The "Scholar of Yore" smiled: "You also agreed to my plan at the time. No one wanted to bear the infamy of killing a Loen princess, so we had to rush them back to Backlund.
"It's just because of some idiot that they escaped from under their noses that we had to run around looking for them."
Polonov snorted coldly and said nothing more.
Blocked in the middle, Hobert watched them talk while considering whether to release "Bull Devil Monarch" and "Great Sage" to help.
The "Scholar of Yore" continued: "You guys do it. I did a divination, and this kid is a source of danger. If the three of us besiege him together, I will encounter some danger.
"But if you two besiege him, I won't be in any danger."
Hobert was slightly stunned at first, and then sighed in his heart that it was no wonder everyone said that "Seers" were difficult to kill. He believed that if he entered the "Nation of Disorder," this guy would definitely turn around and run.
Moreover, the other party's Seer was very experienced, obviously bypassing the "Nation of Disorder" and directly divining his own safety.
The two people wearing Intis Republic-style clothes obediently said, "Okay, Mr. Brandon."
Polonov sneered: "Mystifying."
However, in his opinion, his own two demigods and two Sequence 5s were completely capable of defeating Hobert and capturing Alice alive. It didn't matter if this "Cleric" didn't help.
Hobert was now ready for battle, so he took the first step: "Order!"
An "Order Tree" covering hundreds of meters rose from the ground. Currently, he had to deal with two opponents, so he had to be careful. He decided to first try how long he could last if he exerted all his strength under the attacks of two demigods? Was there any possibility of counter-killing?
If the "Scholar of Yore" took action or wanted to run away later, he would simply "invite" the "Creator" to take action and kill them all.
The "Order Tree" gave Polonov and the other four people a certain psychological impact, but the two demigods from different countries quickly restrained their emotions and launched an attack on Hobert from different directions.
Polonov's body was suddenly covered with a layer of flame from the inside out, and he slammed a punch towards Hobert, this was a "Cull!"
The Intis Republic's demigod, called Cornell, was also an "Iron-Blooded Knight." He used a violently burning wall of fire to block Hobert's retreat.
The two Sequence 5s were very self-aware and did not participate in the battle between the demigods. They were waiting for an opportunity to bypass the battlefield and prepare to capture Alice.
Hobert stretched out his hand and swiped, and Polonov's fist smashed towards Cornell.
With the blessing of the "Order Tree," the intensity and duration of Hobert's "Distortion" had been greatly improved!
Cornell quickly dodged, and dozens of fire crows flew out from his back, smashing towards Hobert.
As a result, these fire crows turned around in mid-air and rushed towards Polonov!
The flames on Polonov's body suddenly burned violently, blocking the fire crows' offensive: "Don't be counterproductive!"
Cornell frowned, took a step back, and planned to watch the two fight for a while first.
Hobert had already rushed over and stabbed Polonov with his sword.
Polonov had a blazing white spear in his hand, blocking Hobert's attack. Then, the flames on his body suddenly swelled up, almost engulfing Hobert in the flames.
Hobert slightly retracted his sword, swiped in mid-air again, and once again, like tearing open wallpaper, he tore open a gap in the underworld, basically sucking away the flames on Polonov's body, leaving only a faint flame.
Brandon, the "Scholar of Yore" sitting on a stone outside the battlefield to watch the battle, clapped his hands to express his appreciation for Hobert's handling of the situation.
Alice, who was also at the edge of the battlefield, was sweating for Hobert.
At the same time, she did not dare to relax her vigilance, and according to Hobert's instructions just now, she paid attention to the movements of the two Sequence 5s.
On the battlefield, the gap in the underworld quickly disappeared. Polonov wanted to trap Hobert with a "Wall of Burning," but his "Wall of Burning" turned around under Hobert's "Distortion" and surrounded Cornell, who was ready to attack at any time.
Polonov had also fought against many "Earls of the Fallen ," but today was the first time he had seen this kind of rogue-like "Distortion" that seemed to be able to be used continuously!
If there was no blessing from the "Order Tree," Hobert's "Distortion" would not be as easy to use as it is now. He could only "Distort" the direction of the "Wall of Burning," but he could not continuously "Distort" the direction of these skills.
Generally, the "Cull" of an "Iron-Blooded Knight" can only "Distort" the "Fatal" point of the opponent, but cannot "Distort" the entire attack.
After some probing, Polonov understood which of his abilities were enhanced under the canopy.
His response strategy was to dodge Hobert's attack, quickly retreat, and not take the initiative to attack.
He was covered in fire and moved very nimbly. Even if Hobert "magnified" his speed, he couldn't catch up with him.
Now Hobert finally knew that the other party had not cheated when digesting the "Hunter" potion, because the other party had obviously discovered that the "Order Tree" had a time limit, so he could delay for a while and look for an opportunity.
Hobert used a trick, pretending to try his best to catch up. Finally, when the position and timing were right, the thin sword in his hand suddenly lengthened and pierced Polonov.
This shocked Polonov very much. Fortunately, he had a miraculous item that could produce "Dawn Armor" in a small range in response to emergencies. Although the range was small, it was enough to block most demigod-level attacks.
After Hobert realized that he had not pierced Polonov's skin, he immediately retracted his sword, then leaped backward, and the sword in his hand lengthened again, piercing a Sequence 5 who was trying to bypass the battlefield.
The moment the Sequence 5 was stabbed, the whole person was covered in flames to block the spread of the injury.
But soon, the flames disappeared, leaving only the Sequence 5 trembling all over on the ground.
His spiritual body had been stabbed, and the power of the underworld invaded his body with the thin sword, causing him to lose his combat power instantly.
Brandon, who was sitting on a rock watching the show, said at this time: "Oh, right, I forgot to tell you just now that the sword in his hand can change shape at will."
Polonov gritted his teeth a little at this, because the one who was stabbed just now was the Feysac Empire's Sequence 5.
But he didn't have time to care about his subordinates at this time, and didn't even have time to scold him, because he found that his body was becoming stiff and the flames on his body were almost gone.
This was the effect of the "Language of the Dead" attached to Hobert's thin sword. Although this effect was not so obvious, it could be superimposed. The longer the battle lasted, the greater the impact the opponent received!
Hobert had been using Azik's mark from just now to "tamper" with the surrounding environment, making the environment more conducive to the power of the underworld.
"Magnify!" Hobert's next attack magnified the "Language of the Dead" attached to the thin sword.
Polonov seemed to hear a very terrifying murmur. He felt like he had fallen into an ice cave. While his whole body was frozen stiff, his limbs seemed to stop working.
"Disorder!" Hobert's counterattack began. Taking advantage of the opponent's "chaotic" state, he punched the opponent towards the tree trunk.
Since the thin sword couldn't stab the opponent for a while, it was better to just use his fist!
At the same time, his attack was also to prevent the opponent from escaping the range of the canopy.
Polonov was actually very cautious. He had been staying away from the central area of the canopy, but at this time he was punched back by Hobert.
The moment he hit the tree trunk, he suddenly turned into a group of flames that shot out in all directions. These flames merged in front and re-formed Polonov.
His lips were a little purple from the cold at this time, and he complained to Cornell: "You can't help at all."
Cornell snorted coldly and temporarily blocked Hobert, who was chasing over, with a "Wall of Burning."
He also realized that under the canopy, neither he nor Polonov could deal with Hobert alone. Of course, he couldn't stand idly by at this moment.
Taking advantage of this moment to catch his breath, Polonov pulled out a bottle of strong liquor from his clothes like a magician. After gulping down a few mouthfuls, his condition seemed to improve a lot.
Brandon, sitting on the stone, stroked the delicate beard on his chin and said strangely, "He was just blasted into a ball of fire. Where did he hide the wine?"
Alice suddenly recalled a joke about the Feysac people: "You never know where they will hide their wine; if you accidentally destroy his wine, then congratulations, this may be the last thing you do in your life."
Brandon nodded slightly: "I've heard those two jokes too."
At this time, the battlefield had formed a situation where Polonov and Cornell were besieging Hobert.
Just like their initial tentative attacks, one person definitely couldn't defeat Hobert, and two people's attacks could easily be exploited by Hobert.
This is a characteristic of Beyonders of the "Lawyer" pathway. Sometimes, dealing with one enemy is almost as difficult as dealing with two enemies.
It's just that with two enemies, Hobert has little chance to counterattack.
Polonov and Cornell had the same idea, which was to maintain the current state. After the duration of the "Tree of Order" ended, they would definitely be able to defeat Hobert.
Of course, Hobert also knew the other party's plan. While "distorting" the opponent's attacks, his long-planned counterattack began.
Hobert first took the opportunity to suddenly summon the "Underworld Gate" using the "Spirit Wine Glass."
This Sequence 5 level ability, in theory, is difficult to play a significant role in a battle between demigods.
However, the environment under the canopy enhanced its power. Then, at the cost of enduring a punch from Polonov, Hobert slashed with his rapier, creating a huge "Underworld Gate."
Many more malicious hands stretched out, as if trying to grab something.
This made the two "Iron-Blooded Knights" feel as if they had fallen into an ice cave again. They reacted almost simultaneously, fleeing to the outside of the canopy as quickly as possible.
In a normal environment, the power from the Underworld is not so strong. They can use their own flames to dispel the chill on their bodies.
But the environment under this canopy is abnormal.
Originally, they thought that Hobert would never leave the canopy, but unexpectedly, Hobert actually chased after them and stabbed Polonov with his sword: "Exploit!"
The mystical item on Polonov's body appeared again in response, but Hobert used "Exploit" to prematurely end its duration.
This sword, which Hobert had endured until now, finally pierced Polonov's chest.
The price of this strike was that Hobert's abdomen was also pierced by Cornell's blazing white spear.
"Bestow!" Hobert immediately "bestowed" most of the injuries from Polonov's punch and the injuries caused by the blazing white spear to Cornell.
Cornell's chest immediately had a clear dent, and his abdomen suffered serious injuries. His whole body was instantly covered in flames, with a bright red flame burning from his chest and abdomen respectively.
After the flames on his body disappeared, the red flames at the wound were still there. When the red flames also disappeared, the injury had healed for the most part.
"Magnify!" Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert magnified the injury in Polonov's chest. The wound immediately became very hideous and flowed with a lot of black, thick liquid.
Hobert stabbed again with his sword, and part of Polonov's body completely turned into flames, causing Hobert's sword to miss.
Even as strong as a demigod, Polonov felt that his body and abilities were a little out of control. Hobert no longer used his sword and directly threw a punch, which he surprisingly failed to dodge.
The force of this punch sent Polonov flying again, but Hobert "tampered with" the air density in the direction he was flying, causing Polonov to immediately feel like he had crashed into an airtight wall.
Hobert took a step forward and kicked again. At this time, Hobert was more like an "Iron-Blooded Knight", punching flesh and kicking with the wind, beating this demigod of the Feysac Empire without any power to fight back.
At this moment, Cornell came forward to block Hobert's attack, but a phantom door suddenly appeared between the two.
This was the ability of the button that Hobert had obtained from the royal family, and he didn't use it until the critical moment of the counterattack.
Cornell looked at Brandon, who was still sitting on the stone. This "Scholar of Yore" still had no intention of taking action.
Cornell pondered for a moment and decided to attack Hobert, preferably taking advantage of this opportunity to seriously injure him.
At this time, Polonov had been beaten until he was covered in blood, which reminded him of the time when he was in school and fought with older students.
Only at that time had he been beaten so badly.
Hobert threw another punch, but this punch only rested on the opponent's chest. At this time, Polonov's whole body shook violently.
At this moment, his internal organs were experiencing a series of constant explosions. This was the ability of "1-109" obtained from the "Black Knight" of the Aurora Order: Flesh and Blood Bomb.
As long as the enemy is injured and starts bleeding, it can be detonated.
When Hobert fought the "Black Knight" before, he was blown away twice in a row, and he knew the power of the bomb very well.
After continuous explosions, Polonov's internal organs had been blown to pieces. Although he could turn part of his body into flames to avoid fatal damage, the explosions in his chest and abdomen were difficult to avoid all the damage.
Polonov seemed to have been hollowed out, rolled his eyes, and fell to the ground.
Hobert's set of counterattacks was as smooth as flowing water. A dozen seconds ago, he was still at a disadvantage, but now he had severely injured a demigod.
This is also Hobert's current fighting style. Once he seizes the opportunity, not many demigods can withstand his counterattack.
Cornell's attack finally arrived at this time. He turned into a ball of flame, bypassed the phantom door, and struck Hobert with a fire fist the moment Polonov fell.
At this time, they had left the area under the canopy. Hobert only "distorted" the extraordinary damage attached to this punch, but he himself was still blown away.
Cornell appeared in mid-air like a stream of light and kicked Hobert in the abdomen.
Hobert spat out a mouthful of blood. This was not an ordinary blow, but "Slaughter". Even if every blow did not hit Hobert's weak point, the place that was hit would become a weak point, thus suffering serious damage.
This ability consumes a lot of spirituality, but it is the best way to attack when seizing the opportunity to approach the enemy.
"Disorder!" Hobert used his Beyonder power to avoid Cornell's next attack.
After he landed on the ground, he spat out another mouthful of blood.
Cornell continued to launch his offensive. This time, he used "Fatal Attack."
In a head-on battle, the "Iron-Blooded Knight's" attack is quite powerful, but he had no chance to use it under the canopy of the "Tree of Order" just now.
"Weaken!" Hobert had used most of his hidden strength in one go in order to severely injure Polonov, which led to Cornell taking a certain initiative.
The injured Hobert quickly changed his tactics, trying to avoid the opponent's frontal attacks as much as possible, while defending and giving the opponent a wave of negative states first.
Orange flames suddenly burned under Hobert's feet. He quickly somersaulted to avoid it, even setting his pants on fire: "Bestow!"
He once again "granted" most of his injuries to Cornell.
Several dark fire crows flew out from Cornell's back, sending most of Hobert's "Bestow" back in the form of flames.
At this time, the trap he had "set up" took effect. Hobert stepped on empty air and opened his arms to maintain balance.
In battle, this is definitely a superfluous and fatal move.
At the demigod level of the "Hunter" pathway, this simple trap can almost be created "out of thin air". He can keenly detect cavities under the surface and make use of them, allowing the "prey" to accurately step into the trap under his influence.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Cornell punched Hobert. This was a "Fatal Attack!"
Hobert once again "distorted" the opponent's "fatal" damage. While he was being blown away, he used: "Connection!"
He strengthened the Connection between Cornell and Polonov, making Cornell very worried about the injuries of this temporary comrade Polonov and wanting to go over and check on him.
Hobert landed on the ground and rolled before standing up again.
Although he was embarrassed just now, he had already "sent" most of the damage he had received.
His counterattack also began. When Cornell was "weakened" and in the state of "grant", the effects of the "Connection" and other three abilities would be enhanced.
Just as Cornell recovered from the "Connection", Hobert's "arrogant" ability smashed into him, making him feel that Brandon's observation was really hateful. He rushed over to teach him a lesson.
Hobert attacked from behind and kicked him down: "Charm!"
Cornell immediately felt that although Hobert had kicked him down, the battle just now made him feel indeed a little tired, and it was quite nice to lie down for a while.
Hobert took a step forward and stepped on Cornell. The rapier in his hand suddenly turned into a two-handed greatsword, and he was about to chop off the opponent's head with one sword.
At this time, one of Brandon's puppets with a sword rushed over and blocked this fatal blow for Cornell.
Hobert jumped back immediately, feeling that this puppet should be at the level of a demigod.
Cornell got up in a disheveled manner and retreated to Brandon's side.
Brandon smiled and said, "You lost because you were deceived by the illusion he created from the very beginning."
"In my opinion, summoning this big tree does indeed enhance his abilities to some extent, but he is very clear that such an enhancement is not enough to deal with two demigods at the same time."
"So from the beginning, he was trying to alienate you. As for his purpose in summoning this big tree, it was just to make you think that he was relying on this big tree and that he could not leave the range of the canopy."
"So you thought that as long as you encountered danger, you could retreat outside the canopy."
"At this time, it became the time when you were most careless, and it was also the best time for him to launch a counterattack."
"That idiot Polonov didn't understand, and neither did you. When you used 'Slaughter' just now, you had already gained an advantage."
"But subconsciously, you still thought that as long as you were not under the canopy, you could defeat him. As a result, he gradually turned the disadvantage into an advantage, and finally delivered a fatal blow!"
Brandon smiled and said, "This is what a 'Lawyer' does, creating loopholes for himself and using self-created loopholes to defeat the enemy."
Hobert was slightly stunned. This was indeed the tactic he had thought of when facing the two demigods.
Although there were some minor errors in the implementation, it didn't matter much. In the end, he won. If it weren't for Brandon's rescue, he would definitely have completed the feat of a 'double kill'.
However, Brandon's rescue was inevitable, after all, they were both Beyonders of the Intis Republic.
Cornell looked like he had learned a lesson. At the same time, the way he looked at Hobert seemed a little gloating, because after this evaluation, it meant that Brandon was about to take action.
"You guys go first," Brandon said. "Leave this to me."
Cornell nodded and said, "Yes, Mr. Brandon."
Hobert slowly retreated to the canopy of the "Tree of Order" and greeted Alice, asking her to retreat as well.
If the opponent was just a "Bizarro Sorcerer", Hobert would still fight him to try, but if it was an "Scholar of Yore", then he wouldn't even think about it and would directly call for reinforcements. Who knew what kind of guys they would summon to help?
After Cornell and the others left the valley, Brandon suddenly took action. However, he didn't attack Hobert, but a Marionette suddenly sprinted forward and pierced Polonov's head with a sword, pinning him to the ground.
Just now, the seriously injured Polonov was also preparing to sneak away during this opportunity, but he died under the sword of Brandon's Marionette.
"Let's talk about how to deal with the spoils, shall we?" Brandon smiled and said, "My sword just now can also be considered as participating in the battle. Polonov is of course yours."
"However, that 'Reaper' who hasn't completely died will be mine, as compensation for the Marionette you damaged for me this morning."
Hobert was slightly stunned, not understanding the other party's intention.
"If you don't speak, I'll take it as you've agreed." Brandon waved his hand, and the Marionette beside Polonov's corpse pulled out the sword inserted into his head and kicked the demigod's corpse in front of Hobert.
And the Sequence 5 who had been stabbed by Hobert earlier stood up from the ground like a zombie and joined the ranks of Brandon's Marionettes.
At this time, the duration of the "Tree of Order" was up, and the canopy quickly shrank, eventually turning into an ordinary wooden stick.
Brandon suddenly waved his hand: "The game is over, you guys take the spoils and leave."
Hobert was still carefully guarding against Brandon: "That sounds like a clumsy lie."
"Hahahaha." Brandon laughed heartily: "Logically speaking, the Intis Republic cares more about your meeting than the Feysac Empire does."
"After all, although Lenburg is not adjacent to us, it is not far from the Republic."
"That's why they asked me to take action and must disrupt this meeting."
"But according to the news I just received, this meeting has made almost no substantial progress, so there is no need to continue blocking you."
Hobert understood: "This Feysac Empire's big guy doesn't know that you have lost your common goal and have become enemies from friends again."
"And I killed a demigod of the Feysac Empire, further deepening the conflict between the two countries. For the Intis Republic, it also eliminated a demigod opponent for you."
Brandon smiled: "Little friend is very smart, but this guy is not stupid either. In order to make him willing to die, I didn't even tell Cornell the news from Masin."
"So after the two people met, although they were wary of each other, they still looked like they were fighting against a common enemy."
Hobert sighed: "'Seers' are really hateful!"
Then he suddenly asked as if in retaliation: "You are my biological father Rex's friend, aren't you?"
Alice on the side was slightly stunned. After all, Rex was the "Legendary Colonel" more than twenty years ago. She had heard some of his stories in the palace.
The smile on Brandon's face disappeared. He stared at Hobert for a while before saying, "You are much more careful than your father. You actually noticed my hint."
When Hobert heard Brandon call him "little friend" for the first time, he felt that he had heard this title somewhere.
When he heard this title for the second time, he suddenly remembered that it wasn't that he had heard it somewhere, but that he had seen it.
In the room where the corpse of the Ancient Death was parked outside Backlund, Hobert had obtained the notes left by Rex. On it, there was a message from "Rex's Seer friend".
The message's address to Hobert was: Little friend!
"Many of your reactions are too similar to Rex, especially that shameless energy." Brandon smiled, which was the reason for his previous few laughs.
Then he spread his hands: "How about the meeting gift I gave you? A demigod of the Feysac Empire is enough for you to be rewarded."
Hobert looked at Brandon with a serious face.
Brandon smiled a little embarrassedly: "Well, I didn't expect that we would meet in this way. Originally, I planned to look for you when you were Sequence 3."
"What do you want to find me for?"
"To divine for you whether you should advance to Sequence 2," Brandon smiled: "But you probably won't listen to my divination results, at least your father didn't listen at all."
"In addition, your father put some of the gains we obtained together during our adventures over the years in one place. That is the inheritance he left for you."
"It also includes some of the inheritance and documents of the Trunsoest family. He entrusted me and Christian to jointly witness you inherit this inheritance."
Hobert smiled and said, "Sounds very good."
Brandon spread his hands: "But I heard that you seem to be quite wealthy, at least richer and more powerful than I was when I was young."
He smiled slightly: "Today is not the time to reminisce about the Outer Deities. Our chat may cause you trouble. Fortunately, I have a Marionette of the 'Spectator' pathway. How about asking him to help you forget our conversation just now?"
Alice raised her hand slightly and said, "Hello, Mr. Brandon, I have a method to avoid interrogation."
"Polite good child." Brandon smiled.
Hobert said: "I also have a way to avoid it."
"Ah, brat, you haven't even called me uncle yet, even if you call me Mr. like this princess." As he spoke, Brandon got up and left.
While walking, he said to Hobert without turning his head: "Say hello to Christian for me. That guy's plan to go undercover in Feynapotter was wonderful!"
Soon, Brandon and his Marionettes disappeared into the sparse forest.
Hobert was a little worried and still stared at the direction Brandon left for a while, because Hobert couldn't be sure whether this guy was Rex's friend or not?
Even if he is Rex's friend, he is not his Hobert's friend. So many years have passed, who knows if there will still be any affection?
After waiting for a while, Hobert squatted beside Polonov's corpse, reached out his hand, and prepared to "Shepherd" this demigod.
He injected his spirituality into '1-109' and used the ability of "Shepherd", so he immediately felt that the "1-109" in the shape of a leather hand ring seemed to become very ferocious.
With a slight force, "1-109" sucked out Polonov's spirit body. The expression on the other party's spirit body was a little distorted, as if he was experiencing great pain.
Soon, Hobert felt that he could make three choices. "1-109" did not provide any options, but as long as the spirit body had the ability, he could choose it.
Hobert, who had already considered it, chose "Slaughter", "Fatal Strike", and "Fire Crow Art".
After making the selection, a small groove appeared on the leather bracelet of "1-109", and then a blood-red gemstone filled the groove.
At this point, the entire "Shepherd" process was completed.
Hobert searched out two mystical items from Polonov's body, and then he found a place to sit down a little tiredly: "Let's rest for a while before we leave."
The battle just now consumed a lot of his spirituality. The key is that every time he can only "send" most of the injuries away, he has actually accumulated a lot of pain himself.
He used the "Healing Fork" to heal himself twice, but the injuries caused by the previous "Slaughter" would take two or three days of recovery to fully heal.
...
In Masin City, a small signing ceremony will be held at 4:30 in the afternoon, but because Princess Alice has not been found yet, this event will inevitably end in a anticlimactic manner.
In the past two days, politicians from both countries have been blaming and shying away from each other. Although everyone is gritting their teeth and saying that this event was a success, everyone knows that this exchange will definitely have the opposite effect.
Even if Princess Alice returns to her country safe and sound afterwards, politicians from both countries will definitely attack each other with this.
But to everyone's surprise, just as the signing ceremony was about to begin, Princess Alice appeared!
She was wearing a noble court dress, without makeup, and only had a very simple bun.
Following behind was Earl Hobert, who had also not appeared in the past few days.
Before everyone could inquire, the signing ceremony began, and the delegation from the Kingdom of Loen was still represented by Princess Alice.
She roughly looked at the results of the negotiations over the past week. Just as Brandon said, there was no substantial progress at all!
However, with Alice signing the agreement, it was equivalent to putting a perfect end to this event.
In the evening, members of the royal families of the two countries jointly attended the farewell ball. Ethel spent a lot of effort to find Hobert, who didn't even want to dance, in a corner of the ball.
She smiled: "Your return exceeded everyone's expectations.
"After our review, we should have encountered an 'Scholar of Yore' and an attack from a Sequence 0 Sealed Artifact that night.
"However, the other party didn't seem to intend to harm us. In the end, only you and Alice disappeared. Obviously, you were trapped somewhere, and the other party intended to use this to disrupt this exchange."
Hobert yawned: "The escape process was indeed quite difficult."
"Anyway, welcome back." Ethel smiled and raised her glass: "I'm really fed up with those stupid politicians. The successful conclusion of this exchange at least deprived them of a reason to quarrel."
The two people clinked glasses and took a sip of wine together. Ethel said meaningfully: "Remember to write to me."
Hobert nodded, knowing that the other party was reminding him that once there was progress on the Castiya family's secret belief in the 'Creator', he must write to her.
Early the next morning, both parties boarded trains and left Masin.
This finally allowed the Masin royal family to breathe a long sigh of relief.
In the next two days, Alice and Hobert didn't show up much, and no one openly discussed the princess's disappearance.
It wasn't until they returned to Backlund that Hobert and Alice were questioned separately.
The one who questioned Hobert was Georgina, the director-general of Military Intelligence 9. The duchess asked very politely, like a chat between colleagues.
After all, Hobert made a great contribution to this incident.
Most of what happened in those two days could be told truthfully. As for how Bolunof's Beyonder characteristics were handled, Hobert glossed over it. Georgina didn't ask for details. They had already defaulted that it was Hobert's spoils of war.
The parts that could not be said mainly involved the intimate contact with the princess, and the experience of the two people appreciating each other's figures.
Based on the situation at the time, Georgina could probably sense that Hobert was hiding something, but of course she wouldn't be foolish enough to ask for details.
It was already past 6 pm when Hobert returned to the Earl's mansion. This 11-day mission was finally over.
And Hobert also missed a Tarot Gathering because of this. At this Tarot Gathering, 'The World' and 'The Hanged Man' agreed to explore the island mentioned earlier in the near future.
'The World' asked 'The Fool' when 'The Emperor' would have time. In the end, they set the exploration time for the night three days later.
Georgina gave Hobert a few days off to let him have a good rest.
The next day, Hobert originally planned to have a good rest in the Earl's mansion, but in the morning, the King and Queen sent rewards, as a reward for Hobert's protection of Alice. Military Intelligence 9 also sent a commendation order.
Hobert was almost constantly entertaining and welcoming guests.
In the afternoon, many nobles who had some friendship with Hobert sent gifts to congratulate Hobert on his meritorious service.
Among them were Audrey and Viscount Glaint, these friends came to visit.
In the reception room, Audrey smiled and said: "Congratulations Hobert, I heard that you are very likely to be promoted to Rear Admiral because of this meritorious service."
Hobert smiled: "After being promoted to Rear Admiral, I can get a few dozen pounds more salary every month."
Viscount Glaint then said: "Now you are a hero of Loen! I didn't expect you to be so brave that you blocked a bullet for the princess!"
Hobert was stunned: "Bullet... who said that?"
Glaint: "Princess Alice said it herself in an interview with the 'Backlund Morning Post'. To tell the truth, I have only seen the battle of wits and courage between you and the spies of the enemy country in storybooks.
"And the part where you chose between personal safety and national interests was quite touching to me."
Hobert smiled: "Is that so!"
May I ask which part you are talking about? I don't remember having such an experience at all? No wonder they said they came to visit me when we first met!
