chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 568: Death of the Ancient Sun God
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Sun" Derrick's mind was filled with pain and despair.
He recognized that the one being devoured in the mural was the Creator that City of Silver believed in, and he also recognized that the three figures around were "Eternal Blazing Sun," "Lord of Storms," and "God of Knowledge and Wisdom"!
Derrick sadly muttered to himself: God is dead, eaten, and will never return.
After a long silence, "Justice" Audrey seemed to be asking herself and everyone else: "Is this the origin of the Three Gods?"
Blasphemy! Audrey suddenly felt a little terrified: I actually said such blasphemous words!
"Magician" Fors's pupils shrank: Three Gods?
Reminded by Miss Justice, and based on some information she had obtained before, she understood what the scene depicted in the mural symbolized.
"Hanged Man" Alger responded: "Perhaps, but there's no way to explain the baby."
He quietly glanced at Mr. Fool, and found that this great being had no intention of explaining, but just watched calmly, so he looked at "Emperor" again.
The reactions of the others were similar to Alger's, and finally their eyes focused on Hobert.
"It's time to trade this information with everyone." Hobert said, "However, before that, I want to apply to report some things to Mr. Fool alone."
Everyone was stunned, why report to Mr. Fool alone first?
Alger thought of "Emperor's" performance in the burial hall: He was obviously participating in this adventure with a mission. When he obtained some information during the adventure, he must have reported that information to the "Creator" first. So, is his separate report to Mr. Fool because the "Creator" has some private, or even God-level, information to communicate with Mr. Fool?
Then he sighed in his heart: I really want to know the content of "Emperor's" separate report!
Cattleya, who didn't know too much inside information, guessed: Maybe there are some secrets involving Mr. Fool that will be announced in this exchange?
"Moon" Emlyn thought: Could it be that Mr. Fool also participated… Hehe, what am I thinking? If that were the case, how could Mr. Fool allow such a mural to be displayed in the Tarot Club?
Derrick also came back to his senses at this time, and looked at Mr. Emperor and Mr. Fool with slightly red eyes.
Klein was also strange: What's there to report?
Then he sighed: I hope this guy doesn't report anything that would embarrass "The Fool".
"Yes!" Klein said, sitting at the head of the long bronze table, and then he established a separate communication environment.
Hobert said: "Respected Mr. Fool, the following information exchange may involve many blasphemous remarks, so I request your understanding in advance."
Klein said as if he knew what those remarks Hobert was referring to: "I know!"
He thought to himself: Haven't you blasphemed against the gods enough times before? Why do you know to report in advance today?
"There is also a private matter to report!" Hobert said, "Miss Magician and I have not leaked any information about the Tarot Club, even after marriage."
"But the previous transaction of 'Biological Poison Bottle' made us know each other's identity, and I also ask for your understanding for this matter."
Klein said in the Fool's flat tone: "As long as it's not active disclosure, it doesn't matter."
This was the answer Hobert expected, and he continued: "Thank you for your understanding."
Then he said: "In order to maintain the normal trading status of the Tarot Club, Miss Magician will continue to trade with me normally in the future, but after the transaction, she will no longer pay the reward by offering sacrifices to you."
Klein behind the gray fog: Why do I feel like your private money has been discovered? Miss Magician should simply not pay the reward, right? Do you have to hand over your income from the Tarot Club?
Klein breathed a sigh of relief and lifted the separate communication state: Fortunately, he doesn't want to seek confirmation from me.
Hobert said to everyone: "Everyone may have felt it, I don't value the amount of pounds in my transactions with you anymore, and the asking price for each transaction is not high."
"But this transaction requires 8,000 pounds! Because this is worthy of the weight of this transaction."
"I hope everyone can participate in this exchange, and even pay the reward in the form of debt, and we can even discuss the way to pay the reward."
Audrey was the first to raise her hand and said: "I'll pay 2,000 pounds!"
She didn't seem to hear the last sentence Hobert said at all.
Little Sun immediately said: "I hope to replace the reward of 2,000 pounds with 4 Beyonder ingredients of Sequence 7 level!"
He would participate in this transaction even if he had to sell everything he owned, and besides, the pressure of such a reward was not great for him.
Hobert nodded: "Yes!"
The two of them had already solved half of the reward, and then Cattleya was willing to pay 1,000 pounds.
"World" and Alger, who had so much income just now, also rarely showed off and each paid 1,000 pounds.
Finally, Fors and Emlyn each paid 500 pounds and claimed the last 1,000 pounds.
After completing the crowdfunding, Hobert first organized his language before starting to say: "Everyone should still remember the relevant information of 'Rose Redemption'."
"Let's first talk about 'Dark Angel' Sasrir. In some myths, this King of Angels was created by the ancient sun god with one of his ribs."
Cattleya thought of some questions she had before: No wonder "Emperor" did not announce the detailed information of "Dark Angel" before. It seems that "Dark Angel" has an extremely close relationship with the ancient sun god. Maybe knowing the relevant information of "Dark Angel" will reveal how the ancient sun god fell.
Hobert continued: "This is actually a metaphor. The great 'Creator' said that Sasrir is actually the human side split from the ancient sun god!"
"In other words, Sasrir is more like an avatar of the ancient sun god!"
Everyone opened their mouths wide, and even Audrey couldn't maintain the state of "Spectator": "His avatar can be an King of Angels?"
While surprised, Klein did not forget to manipulate "World" to speak: "At the level of Outer Deities, which is 'Above the Sequence', you can split your humanity. Then, then the ancient sun god only has divinity left?"
Derrick didn't know how to react for a while, but he remembered that Chief once described "Dark Angel" as the "Deputy of Heaven". At that time, he thought it was an King of Angels who was very trusted by the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God", but he didn't expect that it was the "Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord" himself!
The most surprised was Cattleya. This was a result she had never expected!
The others were still in a somewhat dazed state at this time. A good King of Angels turned into an avatar!
Hobert smiled slightly: "Sorry, I can't answer your questions, because my understanding of 'Above the Sequence' is very limited."
"But one thing is certain, Sasrir is the human side of the ancient sun god!"
He paused and said: "Another piece of information that can be confirmed is that the purpose of 'Rose Redemption' is to assassinate the ancient sun god."
Cattleya was the first to realize: "That's not right, right? I remember that Sasrir was the main initiator of 'Rose Redemption'. He, that is, he was assassinating himself!"
The avatar wants to assassinate the main body!
Everyone immediately had such an idea. Fors's mind even appeared with one story after another.
Cattleya smiled bitterly: God, what am I thinking? Am I out of control? Why do I have such thoughts?
Klein behind the gray fog glanced at "World" across the long bronze table, but then he breathed a sigh of relief: Fortunately, that's just a puppet, at most a Marionette. He doesn't have to worry about being hurt by "World", and he doesn't have to worry about him rebelling.
Then he sighed in his heart: In this extraordinary world, is the risk of opening a small account so great?
Emlyn suddenly thought of the puppets that accompanied him. Before, he always felt that those puppets were unique and had emotions.
Now, looking back, he even felt that these ideas were a bit terrifying!
"Little Sun" felt a little strenuous, as if he couldn't keep up with Mr. Emperor's narration: Didn't he just say that "Dark Angel" is the Lord's avatar? How did he become the mastermind of assassinating the Lord again?
"Things are not that simple!" Hobert said, "I don't know the specific situation of the things I am going to describe next, because it involves some very high-level information."
"But I can tell you very clearly that the cause and result of the matter is as I described it, but I am not clear about some theoretical details."
He said this to avoid explaining the awakening of the consciousness of "God" and "Celestial Worthy". Even a demigod would find it strange to know such high-level information, so it is better to pretend not to know.
When everyone heard "Emperor" say this, they knew that they were about to grasp some very high-level and very secret information!
"The ancient sun god was in a very bad state at that time," Hobert said, "I can't explain clearly what state he was in specifically. You can understand it as being subjected to a special corruption."
"This corruption will make him become like another person, or another god."
"Do you remember that I said before that Emperor Roselle used death to 'wash away' excess Beyonder characteristics?"
"The ancient sun god probably also planned to use death to clear the corruption he was subjected to!"
"Although he does not have the 'Black Emperor' characteristic that can be resurrected, he is the 'Omnipotent and Omniscient God' and has many ways to use the process of death without truly dying."
Everyone had a feeling of not being able to react for a while, like a primary school student listening to a university course. They seemed to understand something, but they seemed unable to react for a while.
But soon they realized why they had such an idea: That is a God!
A God seems to be a kind of creature different from humans. How can their thoughts and their logic be so easily understood by ordinary people?
At the same time, Klein also thought: Outer Deities will also be corrupted? Who corrupted them? Or who can corrupt Outer Deities? Well, maybe it's not corruption. "Emperor" said that the ancient sun god may become another god. Could this be an attack by another Outer Deities?
Alger smiled in his heart: Death is the end of life for me, but for gods, it is a kind of rebirth. Thinking about it this way, I feel that I am so small that it is a bit pitiful.
Cattleya crossed her hands on the long bronze table: "World" just mentioned a new word "Outer Deities". "Emperor" did not refute it, that is to say, the real name of "Above the Sequence" is actually Outer Deities!
Then she sighed: Before participating in the Tarot Club, I thought I was knowledgeable and very learned, but after joining the Tarot Club, I realized that I was as ignorant as a child, and I realized that the essence of the extraordinary world was like this!
Derrick's heart ignited a glimmer of hope: Mr. Emperor said before that the Lord still has the possibility of resurrection, so does that mean that the Lord we believe in may return?
Next, Hobert said the point: "Under the organization of 'Dark Angel' and the Evernight Goddess, the members of 'Rose Redemption' began to frequently appear in 'Giant King's Court' to conspire."
"After they reached some agreements and plans, the action to assassinate the ancient sun god began."
"The specific process is unknown. According to some very vague information, the entire plan started with the sleep of 'Dark Angel' Sasrir. His consciousness and Beyonder characteristics returned to the main body together, and together with the ancient sun god, they fought against that special corruption."
"The Evernight Goddess and other gods and Kings of Angels took the opportunity to launch a surprise attack. Although there was the confrontation between the ancient sun god and Sasrir, that special corruption still began to resist."
"This battle was earth-shattering and created huge ruins of the war In the end, the ancient sun god fell!"
Cattleya suddenly realized: "It's the Sonia Sea!"
Klein also recalled his previous experience of looking for mermaids. There were indeed many gods' auras there. At that time, Klein was wondering what kind of battle caused such consequences?
It turned out to be the Divine War in the Third Epoch that all the gods and most of the Kings of Angels participated in!
Audrey sighed: Thousands of years have passed, and the traces of the Divine War are still there! It can be seen how fierce it was at that time!
Fors felt that when she was strong enough in the future, she must go and see it and feel the power of the gods!
"Yes!" Hobert replied affirmatively: "Not only that sea area, but the current 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' is still filled with the power of 'Concealment', 'Corruption', and 'Lightning'."
"In the complete darkness, City of Silver will have monsters, or companions will disappear unconsciously. The other party should have entered the 'Concealment' state."
"And those monsters are likely to be their former disappeared companions. After being corrupted by the power of 'Corruption', they turned into monsters and hid in the shadows, and they would attack the residents of City of Silver when they had the opportunity."
"The power of 'Lightning' is obviously the power of 'Tyrant', that is, the power of the 'Sailor' path. I remember 'Sun' said that 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' is basically illuminated by lightning!"
Derrick was first surprised, and then he firmly remembered what Mr. Emperor had just said. He realized that this was what City of Silver had not understood for thousands of years.
Klein thought: I didn't expect that the operating logic behind the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", which sounds so strange, would be so simple when explained from the "upper level"! Those appearances are the consequences of the war! Or rather, in the war, the gods changed the nature within a certain area!
Then he smiled: Suddenly, I have the illusion of a magician revealing the secret.
Cattleya sighed and said with emotion: This is the power of the gods, it's really despairing!
Derrick asked: "Mr. Emperor, was the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' caused by that war?"
Hobert thought for a while and then said: "I think it should be caused by the fall process of the Ancient Sun God!"
"This is my own guess. I think the fall process of the Outer Deities, which is the 'Above the Sequence' mentioned before, can have a huge impact on this world."
"This is what I think. When the Uniqueness on them is in the body of the Outer Deities, it is still within a controllable range. Once the Outer Deities fall, the 'collision' between the Uniqueness will make them uncontrollable."
"If a single Uniqueness loses control, it may not cause a big reaction, but if several Uniqueness lose control together, it may cause very serious impact within a certain area."
"After all, that is the abstract expression of natural forces. Their brief loss of control may be equivalent to a reconstruction of the relevant natural forces."
"These 'reconstructed' forces are staggered and colliding, and then explode with energy enough to destroy the world."
"Of course, this is purely my personal guess. I only know that the so-called 'Great Cataclysm' was caused by the fall of the Ancient Sun God, and the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' was formed."
"The theory of specific details can only be supplemented by guessing."
Derrick nodded slightly: Mr. Emperor's guesses are generally very reasonable. Before finding a more accurate theory, Mr. Emperor's theory can be used to explain it completely.
Klein sighed: This theory is a bit like nuclear fusion, that is, the theory of hydrogen bombs! Two hydrogen atoms collide under tremendous pressure, producing strong light and high temperature. Hehe, I regained the demeanor of a keyboard warrior.
The others didn't have any opinions on the "Emperor" theory. After all, they had just come into contact with this information today and had not fully digested it.
Hobert waited for a few seconds before saying again: "If the Ancient Sun God can be resurrected, he may be able to reorganize the disaster he caused during his fall. At most, there will be ruins of the war, and there will be no 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' that has existed for more than two thousand years."
"But his resurrection process was interrupted! The 'Pure White Angel', 'Wind Angel', and 'Wisdom Angel' suddenly betrayed the Ancient Sun God!"
"The 'Pure White Angel' seized the Uniqueness of the Ancient Sun God's 'Sun' pathway and a Sequence 1 characteristic, the 'Wind Angel' seized the Uniqueness of his 'Tyrant' pathway and a Sequence 1 characteristic, and the 'Wisdom Angel' seized the Uniqueness of his 'White Tower' pathway and a Sequence 1 characteristic."
"Therefore, the resurrection process of the Ancient Sun God was forced to terminate! It is because his resurrection failed that the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' has not returned to normal."
Klein sighed: Sure enough, guard against your own followers like you guard against fire and thieves! In addition, the Sequence 0 of the 'Reader' pathway is called 'White Tower'!
Audrey frowned: This is not the first time I have sighed. Why do betrayals between gods happen so frequently? The followers of the Second Epoch betrayed the ancient gods, and Tudor and Trunsoest betrayed Solomon in the Fourth Epoch. The Third Epoch was no exception. The three Kings of Angels betrayed the Ancient Sun God!
Cattleya listened quietly to the "Emperor's" description: White Tower! Hehe, listening carefully to the "Emperor's" description, I always inadvertently discover some important information, which is enough to show the "Emperor's" erudition!
This time, Derrick's eyes did not turn red again. He already knew that the resurrection process ultimately failed, so when he heard the description of the failure process, his heart was very calm, and he had already accepted this fact imperceptibly.
Hobert continued: "Sasrir, can also be said to be the personality side of the Ancient Sun God, realized that his plan had failed, and urgently recovered the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Hanged Man' pathway, and integrated the negative emotions before the fall of the Ancient Sun God, and finally transformed into the 'True Creator'!"
Derrick stood up abruptly: "No, it's impossible, how could it be the 'True Creator'! It's not like this!"
That is the "Lord" that City of Silver has believed in for thousands of years, how could he transform into an evil god!
Klein behind the gray fog was also a little lose one's composure, and quickly and silently covered himself with gray fog: So this is how the "True Creator" came to be! No wonder he dares to call himself "Creator"! No wonder in the early Fourth Epoch, the "True Creator" would be enemies with the "Eternal Blazing Sun", "Lord of Storms" and "God of Knowledge and Wisdom". It's not because the "True Creator" may have the ability to "graze" the gods. There is a certain reason because they are adjacent pathways. I believe the most important reason should be the feud forged by this betrayal process.
Everyone was very surprised at this time, and no one noticed Mr. Fool's lose one's composure!
Audrey couldn't believe her ears: The Ancient Sun God turned into an evil god! And he is now in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", but he no longer protect the living beings there, and also caused many members of City of Silver to lose control.
Fors sighed: This is very similar to the plot in a horror novel! A gentleman who is widely respected by people is betrayed and killed by friends and servants, and then this gentleman transforms into an evil ghost!
Alger sighed because of another matter: The level of "Above the Sequence" is so strong! Even if the plan fails and cannot be resurrected, it can still retain the position of a true god! Hehe, now even if I know how the "Lord of Storms" got his godhood, I am not surprised! Is this affected by the "Emperor"? Or is it because I had unintentionally thought about this before, but I just didn't want to admit it?
Emlyn was surprised for a while, but soon couldn't help but laugh because that history was too distant: This reminds me of a sentence from Emperor Roselle: History is more exciting than drama!
Cattleya thought of the most content after calming down: The histories of the Third and Fourth Epochs are connected, the fall of the Ancient Sun God... Although he did not completely fall, he did not successfully resurrect. In short, this event caused the so-called "Great Cataclysm"!
She continued to think: This event created the pattern of the early Fourth Epoch. According to the information about the "Rose Redemption" traded with the "Emperor" before, the Evernight Goddess, the God of Combat, and the Earth Mother had already become gods in the Third Epoch.
Because the three Kings of Angels betrayed and seized the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics they needed from the Ancient Sun God, they became gods one after another after the "Great Cataclysm", or early in the Fourth Epoch. Together with the previous three gods, such as the Evernight Goddess, these were the six gods at that time!
Also because of the betrayal of the three gods, such as the "Eternal Blazing Sun", the three gods, such as the Evernight Goddess, did not trust them very much. The "Eternal Blazing Sun" and other three gods were also suspicious each other because they were adjacent pathways. The Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat are also adjacent pathways, and they also do not trust each other very much!
Therefore, in the early Fourth Epoch, there were very complex contradictions between the six gods, which gave the "True Creator's" camp a lot of development space, until the "True Creator" threatened the safety of the six gods, the three gods of adjacent pathways, such as the "Eternal Blazing Sun", had to cooperate.
The "True Creator" should have shown some thoughts of revenge in the early Fourth Epoch. Thinking of what the "Emperor" said, the "True Creator" should not have checked and balanced the Evernight Goddess and the God of Combat at that time, but should have united with them. Looking at the current performance of the "True Creator", he should have displaced his anger on the three gods, such as the Evernight Goddess, so this made the Evernight Goddess join the camp of the "Eternal Blazing Sun", forming the "Six Gods camp", and quickly disintegrated the "True Creator" camp.
After sorting out this whole history, Cattleya felt comfortable: Only in the Tarot Club can you get such high-level information. If it is another gathering, or even through the "Moses Ascetic Order", you may not be able to understand this history so thoroughly.
At this time, "Little Sun" still could not accept the fact that the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God" had transformed into the "True Creator".
It is very ironic that the "Omnipotent and Omniscient God" that City of Silver has always believed in is in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", but he has not brought redemption, but will bring madness and out of control!
Everyone did not open their mouths to persuade, because they all knew that such things can only be accepted by "Little Sun" himself.
After more than half a minute, "Little Sun" sat down and apologized: "I'm sorry, I just, just..."
Hobert said: "Still that sentence, City of Silver now has new hope."
Derrick unconsciously glanced at Mr. Fool, then retracted his gaze. He now finally understood why Mr. Emperor had repeatedly reminded himself before that even if the "Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord" really resurrected, he would not be the Ancient Sun God they believed in.
Seeing that everyone had recovered from the shock just now, Hobert continued: "So the 'True Creator' is the human side of the Ancient Sun God, and also the true god of the 'Secrets Supplicant' pathway."
"Similarly, it can also be considered that he is Sasrir, they are all one concept."
He paused and then said: "When we conducted the transaction before, we said that the Ancient Sun God had the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics of a total of five pathways."
"The 'True Creator' recovered the relevant characteristics of the 'Secrets Supplicant', and the 'Eternal Blazing Sun', 'Lord of Storms' and 'God of Knowledge and Wisdom' respectively seized the relevant characteristics of 'Sun', 'Tyrant' and 'White Tower'."
"There is also the 'Author', which is the Beyonder characteristic of the 'Visionary' pathway. Although I have not found a clear record, it should have been obtained by Adam."
Suddenly mentioning Adam, everyone felt a bit like returning to reality, or finding a "acquaintance" in that familiar and unfamiliar history.
Hobert said again: "Last week, I conducted an exploration with 'The World' and 'The Hanged Man', and encountered a church. The murals that everyone saw just now were discovered in the church."
"According to the information I just got, that church should have been built by Adam. We should have mentioned this before. Adam has been carrying out the action of resurrecting the Ancient Sun God in the Fourth Epoch."
"But it is said that he does not think that the 'True Creator' is his father. It seems that he and Amon do not recognize this point. In the early Fourth Epoch, they did not even join the 'True Creator's' camp."
"So there is that infant in the mural looks unpleasantly, that is the description of the 'True Creator'!"
"But although they don't recognize it, there have been no conflicts between the two sides."
As for the fact that Adam's consciousness has long been occupied by the Ancient Sun God, it is not suitable to be announced to the public at this stage.
Alger nodded: That's all right! Those murals are painted from Adam's perspective, of course they will vilify the "True Creator".
Klein said with emotion in his heart: The things that Roselle didn't understand back then have finally been understood today. So the relationship between the four gods, such as the "Eternal Blazing Sun", and the King of Angels Adam is like this. On the surface, it looks intricate and complex. After understanding the events and contradictions behind it, the relationship between them is not difficult to understand.
Audrey also said with emotion: From the aspect of Beyonder characteristics, it is easy to sort out the context of a matter.
"Little Sun" lowered his head and remained silent for a long time. Finally, he made a decision: Just treat the "True Creator" as an evil god. Although he has a close connection with the "Lord", what he is doing now is the act of an evil god! You must not hesitate at the critical moment!
Hobert smiled slightly at last: "The above is the intelligence about the Ancient Sun God, which is the 'Great Cataclysm'."
Like usual, everyone began to savor the intelligence they had just traded.
After a long while, "The World" suddenly said in a hoarse voice: "In the church, I also discovered a special mural."
Then he feignedly obtained Mr. Fool's consent and presented the mural depicting the Ancient Sun God and the "Blasphemy Slate".
Cattleya also immediately recognized it: "Is this depicting the Ancient Sun God? Is the one in front of him the Blasphemy Slate?"
Alger was slightly stunned. When he saw this mural twice, he noticed the slate, but he didn't even think that it was the Blasphemy Slate!
Klein manipulated "The World" and said: "I think so."
Audrey said with emotion: "So this is what the Blasphemy Slate looks like."
Emlyn stared at the Blasphemy Slate for a few eyes: This is the legendary "Blasphemy Slate". That's not right, I heard that it records the potion formula. I always thought it was similar to a stone tablet. How can such a slate record several formulas? Or are the letters on it written very small?
Derrick also temporarily came out of his emotions and looked at the slate. After all, the City of Silver teaching material has records about the "Blasphemy Slate".
"The World" said again: "As far as I know, the content of the second 'Blasphemy Slate' is different from the first 'Blasphemy Slate'."
Nonsense! Of course it's different! Emlyn thought to himself: Isn't this obvious? If the content is the same, would there be a need to distinguish between the first and second ones? Wait, the sequence and pathway are fixed, how can the content be different?
Everyone also seemed to realize this problem. Cattleya said: "Could it be because the potion name and main material required for promotion are different?"
Then she explained, "I heard that the names of some Beyonder creatures have changed over the long history, and after some Beyonder creatures became extinct, the Beyonders found alternative Beyonder creatures. Many Fourth Epoch potion formulas are different from what they are now."
Audrey nodded. We had discussed at the previous Tarot Gathering what to do if some Beyonder creatures became extinct. I didn't expect that alternative creatures could be found.
Klein didn't say anything, but he felt that things were definitely not that simple.
"That's just the superficial difference," Hobert joined the discussion. "As far as I know, the biggest difference between the two 'Blasphemy Slate' is the different meanings they represent."
He smiled, "Although this information is also very high-level, my knowledge is limited. Consider it a gift from this Tarot Gathering."
Mainly because the origin of the "Blasphemy Slate" cannot be announced in the identity of "Emperor."
This level of intelligence can be given away! This was far beyond Klein's expectations. The reason why he showed that mural just now was to attract everyone's attention so that they would be more active in crowdfunding. He didn't expect Hobert to be so generous!
Fors thought of some of the ideas Hobert had expressed before: The "Creator's" mission for him might be to conduct more intelligence exchanges with us and let us know more?
The other members also looked at the "Emperor" with great curiosity.
"As far as I know," Hobert said, "the first 'Blasphemy Slate' mainly records the path to becoming a god.
"We talked about the Second Epoch before. The reason why those ancient gods were able to become gods was all thanks to luck, and even after becoming gods, they were basically crazy, bloodthirsty, and lacked rationality.
"The first 'Blasphemy Slate' was of great significance at the time, as it provided a path to becoming a god while maintaining rationality."
Emlyn smiled and said, "Then we probably can't understand the first 'Blasphemy Slate', right? After all, the main ingredients required for the formula are the names of ancient creatures."
This reminded Audrey of the "Psychiatrist" potion formula she had traded from "The Sun". The first time she saw the formula, she realized that everything from the name of the potion formula to the name of the main ingredients was unfamiliar. Fortunately, there was Mr. Fool's translation.
Hobert pondered for a while before saying, "Although I haven't seen the 'Blasphemy Slate', my feeling is that the content on it should be some conceptual information.
"For example, what it presents to Beyonders might be the promotion ritual and the measurement of the Beyonder characteristics used in the promotion potion?
"After Beyonders see the measurement of Beyonder characteristics, they can naturally associate it with the relevant Beyonder creatures?
"So even if the Beyonder creatures recorded on the 'Blasphemy Slate' became extinct, when looking at the 'Blasphemy Slate' again, alternative Beyonder creatures would appear.
"If no alternative Beyonder creatures can be found, perhaps the words 'a copy of the Beyonder characteristics of a certain sequence' will directly appear!"
Emlyn opened his mouth, "So magical?"
Audrey and Fors had similar thoughts.
Klein thought: This is very mystical.
Hobert spread his hands and smiled, "This is a magical world in the first place! But this is just my guess. What the real 'Blasphemy Slate' is like can only be known by seeing it in person."
Then he said, "So the significance of the first 'Blasphemy Slate' is generally considered to be that there is a way to advance that avoids most madness and loss of control.
"This also provided a prerequisite for the rise of mankind. Compared with those huge beasts, the physique of humans at that time was too weak.
"At that time, relying on directly devouring Beyonder characteristics to obtain Beyonder abilities, the huge beasts were also more able to withstand loss of control, so humans at that time had no advantage in this regard.
"Many legends point to one fact: in that era, human ancestors 'tested medicines with their own bodies' and summarized some relatively safe promotion methods.
"But we all know that after Sequence 5, some rituals are needed. Human ancestors may have indeed tested some valuable information, but the overall rise of mankind cannot be separated from the promotion of the 'Blasphemy Slate'.
"From then on, smaller humans stood on the same starting line as those magical beasts, whether intelligent or not, and may even have had greater advantages than them.
"Thus, mankind began to rise in the Beyonder world!"
Everyone listened very carefully. Although the "Emperor's" words were not surprising, they straightened out some things that they could not think of or understand before.
For example, other members hardly associated the "Blasphemy Slate" with the rise of mankind.
Audrey quickly asked, "What about the second Blasphemy Slate? What is its significance? Is that a prerequisite for making mankind prosperous?"
Hobert thought for a while before saying, "According to my understanding, the second 'Blasphemy Slate' has great significance for the gods.
"Well, before explaining this, let me first talk about a concept.
"The name of what we said before, 'Above the Sequence', is Outer Deities!"
Cattleya sat forward: It really is!
Alger followed and read it out: "Outer Deities!"
This word was very unfamiliar to him!
The other members also firmly remembered this word. What this noun represents must be very high-level information.
"According to some information I have learned, a god who has mastered the uniqueness of multiple pathways and certain Beyonder characteristics is called Outer Deities," Hobert continued. "But I don't know exactly how to master it."
The reason for not knowing is very simple. This is not something a demigod should know.
Klein had already grasped the relevant concept of Outer Deities because of the transaction with the "Emperor", but Hobert's words allowed Alger to unravel a long-standing doubt: the root of the contradiction between true gods of adjacent pathways!
Hobert then said, "The second 'Blasphemy Slate' is said to be about how to become Outer Deities."

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 569 I unexpectedly met Adam!
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The Way to Become an Above the Sequence!
Everyone at this moment only had a vague concept of what it meant to be an Ancient Sun God. The "Emperor's" words made them realize that, just like becoming a Sequence 0 True God, there was a specific method to becoming an Above the Sequence.
Moreover, this method was unclear even to the usually knowledgeable Emperor.
Klein immediately understood: What Roselle hadn't seen must be the content about how to become an Above the Sequence!
Alger sighed: This is the "Blasphemy Slate," only such high-level information is worthy of its legendary status.
After a brief moment of surprise, Cattleya quickly calmed down and organized her words to ask: "Where did the 'Blasphemy Slate' come from? I mean, who summarized the way to become an Above the Sequence?
"Also, who summarized the 22 relatively safe advancement methods on the first 'Blasphemy Slate'? And who recorded this information on the 'Blasphemy Slate'?
"Was it an ancient god? Or the legendary Original Creator?"
Hobert felt that he couldn't disclose too much detailed information about the first 'Blasphemy Slate' for the time being, so he said: "The era when the first 'Blasphemy Slate' appeared is too long ago, and I don't have any relevant information here.
"However, I do know that the summary of how to become an Above the Sequence on the second 'Blasphemy Slate' was completed by the Ancient Sun God, because He was an Above the Sequence.
"This is His great contribution to the Beyonder world!"
Cattleya nodded. She remembered that during a previous Tarot Gathering, the "Emperor" had said something similar.
She said: "Does that mean the first 'Blasphemy Slate' should be from the Second Epoch, or even earlier, by someone who advanced to godhood in a relatively safe way?
"Not necessarily," Hobert said. "Like me, I didn't receive systematic mystical training, but only occasionally came into contact with mystical symbols. However, as I advanced, I gradually became able to clearly feel the connection between Beyonder powers and those mystical symbols, and it was easy to understand their meaning.
"Now, I can even understand the operating principles of most magic arrays."
Cattleya nodded: "I understand what you mean. Some things can be deduced from one's own Beyonder characteristics and a high sequence."
Hobert smiled: "I think so."
The conversation between the two made Audrey realize a problem: In the Beyonder world, mature concepts are very important. Hobert and the Hermit had roughly the same level of understanding, so their communication was very efficient.
Hobert continued: "For the gods, the second 'Blasphemy Slate' ended the era of wars fought for various ridiculous reasons and ushered in an era of gambling for the position ofAbove the Sequence!
"Thus, the brand-new Fourth Epoch began!"
These words made everyone realize that the gods were already gambling to become Above the Sequences at the beginning of the Fourth Epoch!
Klein sighed: As a Sequence 5, he was completely unaware of such things. The concept of "god" was like a huge dividing line. Below this dividing line were the masses, and above this dividing line, one had completely transcended the thoughts and consciousness of ordinary people.
Audrey felt as if she had seen a distant peak, but all she could do at the moment was praise the peak because she was too far away from it.
Alger smiled wryly: Clearly, my goal before joining the Tarot Club was just to become a Sequence 5, and later I had the ambition to become a demigod. Now, I'm almost unable to define my goal.
The other members also had their own feelings. For a while, the entire hall was silent.
After a long while, Klein manipulated "The World" to ask: "Where are the two 'Blasphemy Slates' now? Or rather, who has them?
Hobert vaguely replied: "It is said that the Ancient Sun God once held the first 'Blasphemy Slate'. After His fall, it disappeared and should now be in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'. The second 'Blasphemy Slate' seems to be in Adam's hands."
Klein nodded almost imperceptibly. This was related to the diary of Emperor Roselle he had seen. Roselle had seen the second "Blasphemy Slate," but the way to become an Ancient Sun God was hidden by Adam.
Cattleya suddenly said: "Can we see the 'Blasphemy Slate' as the light brought to the Beyonder world by the Ancient Sun God?
"I remember Mr. Emperor once said that the first 'Blasphemy Slate' appeared in the Second Epoch, and the Ancient Sun God also appeared in the late Second Epoch.
"And now Adam, the son of the Ancient Sun God, holds the second 'Blasphemy Slate'. I believe this 'Blasphemy Slate' is also closely related to the Ancient Sun God."
Emlyn and Derrick realized this after hearing Cattleya's summary!
Audrey sighed again: The Hermit's logical ability is very strong. She can think of so much information so quickly!
"You can say that," Hobert continued to announce more information to everyone: "According to reliable information I have obtained, the second 'Blasphemy Slate' seems to be the remains of the Ancient Sun God, fused with a part of His will."
Everyone immediately showed varying degrees of surprise.
Alger thought to himself: It's always called "Blasphemy Slate," as if it were a naturally formed object. I didn't expect its "main material" to be the remains of the Ancient Sun God!
Klein wasn't very surprised: No wonder the "Emperor" guessed that the content displayed on the "Blasphemy Slate" was a mode similar to direct communication with spiritual bodies, since it fused the will of the Ancient Sun God!
Emlyn had the urge to scratch his head: The "Blasphemy Slate" is not a stone tablet, but it's made of remains? It sounds terrifying!
Fors suddenly thought: I wonder if I can write books with my will after I continue to advance and become an angel? That way, I don't have to write with a pen, and I can write very quickly!
After a slight pause, Cattleya asked: "Whose will formed the first 'Blasphemy Slate'?"
"I don't know!" Hobert said bluntly: "However, what is certain is that the first 'Blasphemy Slate' appeared before the Ancient Sun God appeared."
Alger followed up with his analysis: "Could the first 'Blasphemy Slate' be a product of the First Epoch?"
Derrick looked at "The Hanged Man" and couldn't help but mutter to himself: "The First Epoch!"
For City of Silver, the First Epoch was also a very distant history with only very vague records.
Klein also sighed: Has the Tarot Club's information exchange finally touched on the First Epoch? Then he realized that he currently had almost no information about the First Epoch.
Hobert smiled: "It's not impossible."
Cattleya sighed: "The First Epoch! The Disorder Epoch! It's a pity that there doesn't seem to be any relevant records left."
This epoch was like a blank in history. Everyone knew of its existence, but then they realized that they had no knowledge of it.
After everyone fantasized for a while, Hobert said: "The above is all the information I know about the 'Blasphemy Slate'."
Then he said: "Please, Miss Justice, give us psychological cues, because information about the Above the Sequence is not suitable to bring into the real world."
Of course, everyone had no objections. After accepting Audrey's psychological cues, they thanked the "Emperor," after all, this information was very valuable and helped them sort out their thoughts.
After this topic ended, Alger curiously asked the "Emperor": "Mr. Emperor, which pathway's Beyonder were we talking to in the burial hall at that time?"
Although Alger couldn't see the "Emperor's" expression, he felt that the "Emperor's" expression was a little strange at this time. He only heard the "Emperor" say: "That should be Adam!"
Alger almost slipped off his chair: "A... Adam!"
He originally thought that it was at most an angel-level Beyonder, or even only Sequence 3, because he didn't feel any threat at the time.
Also, because he had encountered a long-haired monster with stealth and petrification abilities outside the church, he thought it was just a Beyonder with stealth abilities!
Unexpectedly, that was a King of Angels!
He actually witnessed... no, heard a King of Angels talking to the "Emperor"!
This gave him the feeling that characters from myths had walked into the real world!
Klein wasn't so surprised because he had already guessed it.
The other members' eyes went back and forth between the "Emperor" and "The Hanged Man": Where exactly did they explore last week? Not only did they see such a huge amount of information in the murals, but they also encountered Adam!
Fors frowned: Hobert didn't tell me about such an important thing before attending the Tarot Gathering! Well, maybe his relevant memories were sealed, and he only "remembered" after coming to the "Gray Fog"
After a moment of surprise, Audrey asked Hobert: "What does Adam look like? How did you escape from there?"
"I don't know," Hobert said with a wry smile: "If He wants to hide Himself, with our current level, we might not find out until we die.
"Well, it's even possible that after we landed on that island, He had already been observing us all the time, watching us move forward, watching us fight.
"Not only watching us, but at that time, our thoughts and what we thought in our hearts were like a book placed in a library that Adam could read. To Him, we had no secrets."
Although Hobert sealed the key memories he could think of, he was still afraid that Adam would learn some key information.
Fortunately, Hobert also knew that Adam couldn't be so idle and wouldn't stare at a demigod and two Sequence 5s without letting go.
Of course, the key is that all three of them have backers!
Everyone was once again shocked by the "Emperor's" description. Such an ability is too terrible.
Audrey found it a little unbelievable: "Is this pathway so terrifying at the King of Angels level?"
"It should be said that every pathway is quite terrifying at the King of Angels level," Hobert said with a smile: "But the abilities of Adam and Amon are particularly strange!"
In fact, after the "Seer" pathway reaches "High Sequence," no, from Sequence 5 onwards, it also begins to develop in a strange direction.
Klein actually felt a little chilly behind his back: It's hard to imagine that our exploration team may have had four people at the time! Anyway, I only remember there being three people.
Cattleya also said: "What a terrifying ability! Although we know that Mr. Fool has been providing us with protection, let's imagine that there is actually another member eavesdropping on our gathering.
"If someone hadn't reminded us, we wouldn't have realized his existence at all."
This description made everyone feel insecure and unconsciously looked at the empty seats around them.
Hobert smiled and said: "Adam wouldn't care too much about small characters like us!"
Alger nodded: "That's right."
He remembered that Adam seemed more concerned about the state of the "Creator" at the time.
However, the two people's "harmonious duet" did not comfort everyone, and everyone still felt a little insecure.
Hobert continued: "As for how we escaped."
He smiled: "Of course, we were let go. Don't you think we can escape from the gaze of a King of Angels?
"Even if we escaped by chance, as long as we are still in this world, we are very likely to be poisoned by a poisonous insect that accidentally falls into the kettle while drinking water, or be killed by an Beyonder's ability out of control or the ability of a sealed artifact not being controlled while walking on the road as usual. In short, it is easy to die from a small or extremely small probability of coincidence."
This reminded Klein of Anderson's encounter, but that guy encountered an attack from the "Spectator" pathway's "psychological cue" aspect, making everyone around him regard Anderson as an enemy.
However, those ordinary people's methods of attack were very clever, or rather, it seemed that they were really able to attack Anderson because of various coincidences.
The scene at that time was still vivid in Klein's mind, and even now he doesn't know what the demigod of the "Spectator" pathway looks like.
Hobert's description made everyone understand the "Spectator's" attack methods even more, and everyone almost came to a relatively unified conclusion: It is impossible to defend against!
Finally, Alger sighed: "Fortunately, we have the gaze of Mr. Fool and the 'Creator', and Adam did not embarrass us."
He believed that even if these two did not always pay attention to that exploration operation, judging from Adam's meaning, he was also very clear that the "Emperor" and "The World" were the blessed ones of two great figures.
Then the other members also realized that even if they encountered the legendary Adam, "The Hanged Man" and the others had successfully escaped, and at least so far they seemed to be in no danger.
That is to say, Adam also has a certain fear of the "Fool" and the "Creator" and will not easily attack Their blessed ones.
Klein behind the gray fog thought to himself: I am more inclined to believe that Adam hopes that this mural will be more widely spread through the "Fool" and the "Creator".
After all, these two "evil gods" are in a similar situation to His Adam, and their forces are not orthodox churches, so they are considered "gray forces" and do not resist this type of information.
With the end of this topic, everyone felt that they had gained too many surprises at this Tarot Gathering.
After a moment of silence, Emlyn cleared his throat: "I hope to rent a mystical item with a strong offensive ability to complete the next hunt."
Audrey was very interested in this form: "Rent?
"Oh, yes, with Mr. Fool's witness, we can indeed conduct rental transactions with confidence!"
"Exactly!" Emlyn exclaimed inwardly: Truly a clever lady.
He smiled and said, "At other gatherings of Beyonders, transactions involving the rental of mystical items are almost impossible to achieve due to a lack of sufficient trust and a strong guarantee.
"But at the Tarot Club, with the witness of Mr. Fool, who possesses god-like power, we can all confidently engage in such transactions."
Emlyn's idea seemed to open a new door for everyone!
Even Klein marveled: This guy's thought process is really different. I didn't even think of conducting such transactions. Should I collect a certain percentage as a security deposit? Heh, forget it. That would really make 'The Fool' a middleman.
Fors suddenly realized that 'Leymano's Travels' was very suitable for such transactions: "I have a mystical item here that I can rent to you…"
She briefly described the abilities and negative effects of 'Leymano's Travels,' then considered it slightly and said, "The rental fee is 50 pounds per day.
"But there's one requirement: you can freely use the abilities in the book, but when you return it, it must have two additional pages of abilities.
"If you use the demigod-level abilities, it must have four additional pages of abilities.
"The abilities recorded from you can be repeated and have no level restrictions!"
Emlyn was a little surprised: "It actually has demigod-level abilities?"
Then this hunt is guaranteed!
Even if he encounters a situation like the 'Moon Puppet' last time, he can easily solve it!
Cattleya nodded slightly: After all, Miss Magician also has an organization behind her! They can definitely provide her with the opportunity to record demigod-level abilities.
Alger sighed: Miss Magician's background is not simple.
Audrey and Klein's gazes almost simultaneously turned towards Hobert. Those demigod abilities must have been provided by him!
Emlyn asked, "Is it convenient to reveal what those demigod-level abilities are?"
"Yes." Fors secretly glanced at Hobert before saying, "There are demigod-level 'Distortion,' 'Disorder,' and 'Exploit'!"
Klein and Audrey almost simultaneously thought in their hearts: As expected!
Cattleya was a little strange: Aren't these all abilities of the 'Lawyer' pathway? Have the Abraham family members changed pathways?
Fors continued: "The demigod who recorded these abilities once tested them. Using this level of 'Distortion' and 'Disorder' on a Sequence 6 Beyonder can prevent the opponent from breaking free from the corresponding state for 12 to 15 seconds!"
Speaking of this, she felt a little proud in her heart.
Although this may reveal some information about Hobert's abilities, just like wanting to find a place to talk about how handsome her boyfriend is, Fors has a strong desire to confide in this regard.
Or rather, it is not suitable to confide in this information elsewhere. Only at the Tarot Club, when other members do not know Hobert's true identity, is it okay to talk about it without bringing any danger to Hobert.
Moreover, Hobert does not object to such a statement. This is equivalent to a public advertisement. If everyone has problems that cannot be solved and it is inconvenient to ask 'The Fool' for help, they can request the help of 'The Emperor.'
Fair prices and guaranteed after-sales service!
Emlyn was a little surprised when he heard this: "Are you serious?"
Then, as long as he can find a way to get close to the hunting target, throwing a 'Disorder' over will end the hunt.
Then he added, "Do I really only need to record four of my own abilities?"
Klein nodded slowly. He had personally experienced this. In the process of defeating the six-winged gargoyle, Hobert used a similar 'Disorder' ability, and as a result, that monster did not break free from the state Hobert imposed until it died.
Cattleya exclaimed: This is the qualitative change of a demigod!
Alger also recalled the process of the 'Emperor' eliminating the six-winged gargoyle: Sequence 6 is as fragile as a child in front of a demigod!
He doesn't have much contact with the 'Emperor,' and he has never met the 'Magician' in the real world, so he never thought that these two would be a couple.
Fors suddenly remembered one of Hobert's words, so she smiled and responded to Emlyn: "This is a benefit of the Tarot Club!"
"But I still want to thank you for providing the mystical item and the explanation just now." After thanking her, Emlyn asked, "Can you explain the 'Exploit' ability again?"
"This is an ability I like very much." Fors smiled and said, "It can extend the duration of some states or continuous abilities that are beneficial to oneself.
"Using Sequence 6 as an example, the duration of this level of state or ability can be extended by at least one and a half times.
"It can also instantly end all negative effects and mental attacks suffered.
"If used on enemies, it can end some of their abilities early, such as the 'Dawn Sword' and 'Dawn Armor' summoned by the 'Dawn Paladin.'
"Moreover, it can also be used on sealed artifacts, such as making a Grade 2 sealed artifact unusable for 5 to 10 seconds, or strengthening and prolonging the consequences and duration of the sealed artifact's negative effects."
Klein exclaimed: The main point of this ability is to catch people off guard! I can imagine that if 'Creeping Hunger' suddenly cannot be used normally, it will not only cause immeasurable consequences but also undermine my confidence in battle.
Cattleya frowned and thought: "Exploit should also be able to end some spells and ritual magic early. This ability is very restraining to my abilities! Fortunately, I haven't encountered a demigod-level 'Lawyer' pathway opponent before.
After listening to the explanation, Emlyn said, "I want to rent this mystical item! Hmm, I'll start renting it from the day after tomorrow!"
Fors smiled and said, "Okay."
After this transaction ended, Derrick took the initiative to say, "I just learned a new piece of information. It turns out that the former Chief of City of Silver did not die. He just built a mausoleum for himself and lived in it.
"However, he hasn't appeared for a long time, so many people, including me, thought he was dead.
"I heard that the 'Six-Member Council' is planning to open the former Chief's mausoleum. Will such an action bring danger to City of Silver?"
Hobert suggested, "Regarding mausoleums, it is easy to associate them with Beyonders of the 'Death' pathway!"
"That's right." Alger thought so too. Then he asked "The Sun", "Was your former Chief also on the 'Warrior' pathway?"
"Little Sun" nodded: "Yes, he was once a 'Demon Hunter'."
"He may have found the corresponding Beyonder characteristics and potion formula and tried to jump to an adjacent pathway." Alger guessed. Then he asked:
"Has there ever been a Sequence 3 of the 'Warrior' pathway in City of Silver, or in the history of City of Silver?"
Derrick tried hard to think: "It seems not, at least not now."
"Then, can we assume that there is some reason that hinders the advancement of the City of Silver demigods?" Alger once again made a guess based on the clues provided by Derrick.
He said: "In order to obtain stronger power, in order to try to find a new way out, perhaps your former Chief hoped to be promoted to Sequence 3 of an adjacent pathway."
Derrick nodded, very much agreeing with Mr. "Hanged Man's" guess. City of Silver has been trying for more than two thousand years, and there are too many tragic stories.
Audrey asked curiously, "Mr. Hanged Man, if the current Six-Member Council wants to open the former Chief's mausoleum, does it mean that his advancement failed? Or is it for other purposes? What kind of consequences will such an action lead to?"
Derrick nodded repeatedly. He also had such questions.
Klein glanced at the "Death" card on the bronze long table: Perhaps there was a problem with the former Chief's advancement ritual.
He thought that the "Emperor" should also know this, so he didn't let "The World" take the initiative to remind him.
"I don't know either." Alger answered while looking at the "Emperor" again.
The meaning was obvious: The knowledgeable "Emperor" might know the answer.
So "Little Sun" and other members looked at the "Emperor" again.
"I heard that the ritual for promoting to Sequence 3 of the 'Death' pathway requires a mausoleum of one's own." Hobert reminded again, "The former Chief failed to come out on his own, probably because the advancement process was not very smooth."
He said: "This is inevitable because no one knows whether the potion formula in the former Chief's hand is complete.
"Even if you know the complete ritual, each advancement after Sequence 6 is very dangerous. This is when the role of Beyonder organizations is reflected.
"As far as I know, there are actually some techniques for designing the ritual during advancement.
"But City of Silver should not have such information and can only rely on their own exploration."
Everyone seemed to see City of Silver, which had been in a state of exploration for more than two thousand years, gradually becoming majestic as it walked to the present step by step.
Hobert said to Derrick: "There is too little information currently known. It is not clear where the problem is, so there is no way to guess the consequences of this matter.
"I suggest you inquire more to see if you can get more information. After having more information, everyone will help you analyze it."
Derrick was slightly stunned: "Okay, Mr. Emperor, I will try my best!"
After this topic ended, "The World" said to Hobert: "You mentioned earlier that the way to temporarily obtain good luck has been answered. You have to wait a little longer to find a suitable opportunity to obtain it.
"The other party is very satisfied with the price you offered. You can pay in advance, or you can wait until the time is right to pay."
Hobert smiled and said, "I will offer a sacrifice to Mr. Fool around 5 o'clock.
"Well, the large amount of cash I acquired from the Beyonder characteristics was also sacrificed at that time."
Klein manipulated "The World": "Okay."
At this point, this Tarot Club came to an end. After chatting about some interesting things that happened last week, Klein announced the end of this Tarot Club.
...
Forsaken Land of the Gods, City of Silver.
Returning to the real world, Derrick looked at the candle on the table as usual. Fortunately, it was not extinguished.
Then he stared at the dim roof for a while. When discussing the former Chief's problem, he could feel the respect of other members.
He recalled the Emperor's help to him all along, allowing him to conduct transactions with the outside world more conveniently. He believed that the Emperor's help was precisely because of such psychology.
This made Derrick feel both proud and sad.
Pride because City of Silver has never given up. It is commendable to constantly explore and persevere.
Sad because they have to do this!
Then, Derrick thought of the murals displayed by the "Hanged Man". He lay on the bed, and tears flowed uncontrollably.
At the Tarot Club, he had been trying his best to restrain his grief.
The pain that he had suppressed in his heart now emerged and became uncontrollable.
Derrick did not wipe his tears. He vowed that this was the last time he would cry! He vowed that if the sun did not return, he would be the sun of City of Silver! He vowed to protect City of Silver forever from the invasion of evil gods such as the "True Creator"!
...
Northern Continent, Feysac Kingdom, South Colson area, Green Meadow Manor.
Hobert and Fors returned to the real world together again. The two did not rush to get up.
Fors held Hobert's hand: "Thinking about it now, City of Silver is not easy."
"Yes." Hobert squeezed Fors's soft hand: "So help if you can."
Then he got up and said: "I have to go back to Backlund. I spent too much money at this gathering."
Fors smiled and said: "But the harvest is not small."
Hobert put on his coat and said, "Well," "There are no social engagements tonight. We will have dinner together at the Lord's Mansion."
"Okay."
Hobert kissed Fors on the forehead and used "Traveling" to return to Backlund. He opened the safe and started counting money.
He calculated that the cost of this Tarot Club was 28,850 pounds, plus 6,500 pounds for acquiring the Black-haired Baboon and Psychedelic Wind Chime Tree yesterday, and 13,000 pounds for helping "Little Sun" purchase the potion formula. The cost for these two days was as high as 48,350 pounds!
And this time, Hobert's income at the Tarot Club, not counting the 4 Beyonder ingredients from "Little Sun", and deducting Fors's 500 pounds, the final income was 5,500 pounds!
Then he still needs to sacrifice 42,850 pounds to "The Fool"!
Looking at the gold pounds in the second safe also bottoming out, Hobert couldn't help but sigh: Have I been spending too much money lately?
This acquisition will take some time to recover the capital, and Hobert is now investing in the construction of Longtail Island at all costs. Although he used "Creator Logistics" to save a lot of money, he has already invested more than 20,000 pounds in just over a month.
The "Earl of Light" light bulb factory and wire factory have been mass-produced. The initial investment is very large, and Hobert has recently invested more than 20,000 pounds.
In order to seize the rule of Longtail Island, Hobert has also spent nearly 90,000 pounds. Fortunately, with the cooperation of Bishop Jodi, about 50,000 pounds have been "repatriated" so far, otherwise, Hobert's money in the safe would not be enough to pay for this expense at the Tarot Club.
Hobert returned to the "Nation of Disorder" and "bestowed" upon himself three "Worms of Time." As he prepared to leave the "Nation of Disorder," he glanced at the 150,000 pounds and over 80,000 gold Lire stored there.
This money came from large transactions with Miss Sharon and Simpson. Because Hobert had plenty of money recently, he hadn't touched these savings.
He hesitated for a moment, deciding to leave the deposit untouched for now. There was still around 15,000 pounds in cash in the safe, which should last him for a while.
After counting the money and taking the "Worms of Time," it was already past 4:30 PM. Hobert simply performed the sacrifice to "The Fool" ahead of time.
Then, he conducted the "bestowal" ritual and obtained the Beyonder characteristics and materials traded at the Tarot Gathering.
After waiting for more than ten minutes, he sacrificed the traded items to the "Nation of Disorder," sealing what needed to be sealed and shattering what needed to be shattered.
By the time he returned to the Lord's manor in South Colson, it was already past 5 PM.
Fors and Donna were already waiting in the dining room. Hobert smiled and said, "I heard we're having fish tonight?"
"That's right," Donna replied with a smile. "I caught some big fish at the dockyard island when I was off yesterday!"
Just as Hobert was about to compliment her, Helen, the captain of the Special Operations Department's Second Team, hurried in from outside: "Lord! It's fortunate you're at the manor. Something major has happened on the West Bank."
Hobert was taken aback: "The Blood Sanctify Sect isn't attacking again, are they?"
"We can't rule out that possibility!" Helen said. "An entire village has already died! Teacher Dunn is also at the scene."
"He believes it was an attack by an Beyonder of the 'Death' pathway. Teacher Dunn organized an encirclement once, but they got away!
"It can't be ruled out that they are helpers hired by the Blood Sanctify Sect, because they are very familiar with the situation on the West Bank!"
Hobert frowned: "You're saying an entire village has died?"
"That's right!"
Hobert stood up and picked up his cane: "We'll go take a look at the West Bank immediately."
Fors and Donna wanted to go too, but because Hobert only had one mystical item with "travel" abilities, he had Helen arrange to pick them up later.
Supporting Helen's shoulder, Hobert arrived at the West Bank.
They arrived at a valley with lush vegetation, but among the vegetation were many white skeletons.
In the distance, there were even small hills made of various bones, about the size of a mound.
Dunn, Elliott, and others were not far away. Elliott was the captain of the extraordinary team provided to Hobert by the Balk family, and is currently undergoing training as an official Beyonder in Jeffrey City.
Once Elliott completely digests the "Baron of Corruption" potion, he will take the "Mentor of Disorder" potion provided by Hobert, becoming a Sequence 5.
Because the case required a large number of people, Dunn also called them in for support.
In addition, there were several members of the Second Team, who were the main force investigating the case.
After Hobert appeared, Dunn led the team over: "This case needs your help."
Then he pointed to a man in his thirties with light yellow hair: "This is Raymond of the Second Team. His team was the first to discover the Beyonder elements of this incident."
Raymond stepped forward and respectfully called out: "Lord!"
Then he began to report: "In the past week, the security team of Lobi Town has received several similar reports. Basically, people in each village have discovered that someone seems to be lurking around the cemetery at night.
"The security team in the town sent people to investigate and found that there were cases of corpses being stolen.
"During the investigation, they encountered attacks similar to zombies, so they handed the case over to the Special Operations Department.
"After divination, we found that the corpses were actually crawling out of their graves on their own, so we determined that this was a Beyonder case.
"After careful investigation, we found that anomalies actually started appearing three weeks ago. At that time, the corpses of people who died in Lobi Town disappeared, and were found in a very remote place the next day."
Hobert was stunned: "Three weeks ago?"
"Yes, yes."
Hobert nodded. It was probably around that time that Mr. Azik came to Jeffrey Territory.
Although he had only heard the beginning, he could almost be certain that this case was related to an Beyonder in the "Death" domain, and it might not be a helper of the Blood Sanctify Sect.
After all, the Blood Sanctify Sect is not a small organization, and it is unlikely that they would ask Beyonders from other pathways to help them raid Jeffrey Territory.
To be precise, according to the intelligence gathered in the last few months, the Blood Sanctify Sect has only tried to infiltrate Jeffrey Territory, and there has been no sign of a large-scale attack.
Raymond continued to report that after their investigation and ambush, they found nothing unusual. Until the day before yesterday, Mike reported to the town government. After Raymond and the other two communicated with him, they realized that Mike was already dead!
They returned to the village before Mike and found that the people in the village were also dead, but they didn't seem to realize that they were dead and were still working as usual.
Raymond and others did not find any useful clues. When they were about to leave the village, they found a pale white skeleton in the village.
Just as they were about to pick up the skeleton, it turned into powder in front of them.
At the same time, everyone in the village seemed to suddenly realize something. After saying goodbye to their families, or after some unbelievable crying or screaming, they all turned into corpses.
Raymond, who had lost the lead, asked Dunn for help. Dunn arrived at the scene in the evening.
Based on his experience, the skeleton should have been left in the village by an Beyonder of the "Death" pathway, allowing the villagers to move as Zombies.
And the corpses that crawled out of the graves before should also be the effect of this skeleton.
This inference was made because Dunn took out a map, marked the location of the skeleton, and also marked the locations where cases such as corpses crawling out of the cemetery had occurred before. Obviously, the location of the skeleton was in the very center.
Hobert couldn't help but admire after seeing the map marked by Dunn: Professional things should be done by professional people. For such cases, only experienced people like Dunn can quickly sort out the broken clues and find new ones.
