chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 570 Hobert's Demigod Butler (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to DAVID RODRIGUEZ for becoming a free member]
Based on the limited clues, Dunn made a very logical guess about this bizarre extraordinary case.
He also roughly deduced the course of events from the descriptions of the case by Reinette Tinekerr and others.
About three weeks ago, a cloud of black fog covered the village where Mike lived. After the black fog receded, a piece of pale white skeleton remained in the village.
From that moment on, the villagers were already dead, but they didn't realize it and continued to work normally.
Because the harvest season was not far away, the villagers had little mobility, and no one noticed this for a long time.
That piece of skeleton basically affected the corpses of the entire Lobi Town. Whether it was a newly deceased corpse or a long-dead corpse, they all turned into zombies.
It wasn't until the Special Operations Team intervened and the skeleton disappeared that this effect also disappeared.
It was because of the reconstruction of the entire case and the sorting of the clues that Dunn finally guessed that the murderer would definitely return to check after learning that the skeleton had disappeared, and even come back to try to manipulate the corpses of the villagers again.
So, under Dunn's organization, Helen and Elliot set up an ambush.
As Dunn expected, the black fog appeared again in the early hours of this morning, and the corpses of the villagers turned into zombies again.
However, the Beyonder hidden in the black fog was very vigilant, discovered Dunn and others' ambush, and quickly left.
Helen and others immediately launched a pursuit! The other party knew the uninhabited mountainous areas like the back of their hand, so Helen guessed that it was someone from the Blood Sanctification Sect who was helping him.
They chased until noon today, but the other party still escaped.
However, in the process of chasing, they found some new clues, which can quickly start a new round of pursuit.
The reason for calling Hobert to help is because in the process of the pursuit, the Beyonders of the Special Operations Team had a fight with the other party. Helen discovered that the other party actually showed the ability of a demigod!
Fortunately, the Second Squad had a large number of people, and there was a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact provided by the Lord's Manor, so only people were injured, but there were no casualties.
Dunn pointed to the pile of white bones like a hill: "That should be some skeletons collected by the other party from the surrounding area. I just checked it, and most of them are animals."
"According to divination, this pile of bones is closely related to the murderer, but the other party should have a certain anti-divination ability, and it is impossible to use these bones to divine the murderer's location."
"However, we can also find traces of the other party through other methods of divination."
The 'Skeleton Lord' is not a demigod in the strict sense, but there are always some animals, insects and other creatures dying in the places it passes.
So, the 'Astrologer' only needs to divine this kind of unnatural death to find some clues.
Hobert looked at the pile of bones and suddenly remembered something. He asked Dunn: "Have you heard of the Beyonder creature called Skeleton Lord?"
Dunn thought for a while and shook his head.
Hobert thought it was also true. Dunn was only a captain-level official Beyonder 'before his death', and should not have access to information at this level.
Logically speaking, Helen's level in the Theosophy Order is higher than Dunn's, but organizations like the Theosophy Order are far behind the orthodox churches in terms of intelligence! Helen also doesn't know anything about the 'Skeleton Lord'.
Hobert then explained: "I received information last year that there may be a Skeleton Lord in the Southern Colson area, or rather, one."
"And the eyes of the Skeleton Lord are said to be one of the main ingredients for Sequence 4 of the 'Death' pathway."
Hobert didn't know how long the 'Gatekeeper' who died in the room where the ancient Death's corpse was parked had been dead. After coming to Southern Colson, he had never heard any rumors about the 'Skeleton Lord', so Hobert thought it had already left here.
Who knew that the 'Skeleton Lord' was still hiding in the deep mountains.
Dunn nodded: "I see. That makes sense. Why the murderer still chose to escape despite having the ability of a demigod."
During the previous siege, Dunn, Helen and others had already realized that if the murderer was a demigod, there was no need to escape at all.
After all, the Special Operations Team only has Helen, a Sequence 5, in the Southern Colson area at this time. A demigod can wipe them out.
So Dunn and others guessed that the other party might be a Sequence 5, but it is very likely that they have a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. Calling Hobert was to deal with that Grade 1 Sealed Artifact.
Now that they know what the murderer is, it's even easier to handle!
Immediately, the group followed the clues and began a new siege.
After discussing a few words with the 'Astrologer', Hobert found that their divination results were not as useful as his own 'Connection'. After all, the level is higher.
So in the next action, Hobert looked for clues in front. During the continued pursuit, Hobert said to Helen: "After this case is over, I will apply for certain permissions for you."
"In the future, if you need a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, you can pray to the 'Creator' and prepare the 'Bestowal' ritual to obtain the help of the corresponding Sealed Artifact. After solving the problem, you can sacrifice it to the 'Creator' again."
Helen was a little surprised. That's a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact! Aren't you afraid that I'll take the Sealed Artifact and run away?
Then she shook her head and smiled: In that case, I would definitely die miserably.
So Helen nodded: "Yes!"
In the subsequent search process, they found two more piles of bones, but they couldn't find the 'Skeleton Lord' even late at night.
At this time, Dunn's previous method of 'drawing a map' came into play again. He believed that these piles of bones must have some special significance for the 'Skeleton Lord'.
Since the other party is a 'Duke', wouldn't these piles of bones prove that this is part of its rule? You can try using the map again to find further clues.
After marking the locations of the three skeleton piles, they found the rules for the placement of the skeleton piles. Although they are in different directions, they have a common center point.
Everyone once again marveled at the practicality of this method.
Dunn took the opportunity to explain to everyone that this method is only useful in specific environments, such as this kind of Beyonder creature with territorial awareness, but it is not omnipotent.
In any case, everyone was very impressed with the experience Dunn showed.
It was already late at night. In order to prevent the 'Skeleton Lord' from going out to attack the villagers again, everyone lit their kerosene lamps and searched overnight.
This level of Beyonder creature has at least the intelligence of a normal person. It knows that although it has been discovered, as long as it returns to its long-established territory, it will not be afraid of those Beyonders below the demigod level.
After crossing another mountain peak, everyone found a small town with a pale white 'light' in the mountain.
There seemed to be many pedestrians on the streets there. If it weren't for the abnormal color of the lights, it would look like a mountain town with a rich nightlife.
However, although this town looks crowded, there is no sound at all, and there are not only 'pedestrians' on the streets, but also some wild animals.
This made the term 'Ghost Market' appear in Hobert's mind!
When everyone saw that town, everyone seemed to have an illusion that the town also 'saw' them!
Without time to rest, the Beyonders of the Special Operations Team immediately launched a surprise attack!
Fors and Donna, who came with them, also joined the attack. Hobert winked at Fors. Fors understood and kept protecting Donna, who seemed a little excited.
When they got close to the town, a faint smell of decay wafted over. Everyone found that the 'residents' of the town seemed to have encountered foreign enemies and spontaneously organized to meet the enemy.
Most of them are ordinary zombies. Some are still intact, and some can already see bones. There are also some dead Beyonders mixed in.
Helen, Elliot and others were ready to face a fierce battle.
But just as the two sides were about to fight, Hobert, who was rushing in the front, suddenly drew out his rapier and cut open a 'Underworld Gate'.
The zombies seemed to have seen terrifying things that they had never seen before in their lives and after their deaths, and they all turned their heads and ran!
But after running a few steps, they fell down in pieces and turned into normal corpses.
Only a few zombies who used to be Beyonders of the 'Death' pathway were still holding on, but they couldn't even stand up under the pressure shown by the rapier.
The members of the Special Operations Department, such as Helen, were stunned for a full three seconds before they came back to their senses and stepped forward to eliminate these 'persistent' zombies.
At this time, a burst of black mist emerged from the underground of the town. Helen and others retreated backwards and stood ready.
Hobert stepped forward and said: "Everyone, withdraw from the town, I will deal with it!"
Helen sighed in her heart: Is this a demigod? A Beyonder battle was resolved by the other party like this.
While thinking, she organized everyone to withdraw from the town.
Donna, who originally wanted to show off her skills, was just panting from running during the charge, and didn't even touch the corner of the enemy's clothes before she had to withdraw from the town.
She looked at Hobert, who was going deep into the town alone: "I didn't expect Hobert to be so powerful!"
Fors just smiled and said nothing.
Then Fors also looked at Hobert's back, with some worry in his eyes.
But it was not worried that Hobert could not solve the 'Skeleton Lord', but worried about Hobert's current duties. The risks that a demigod has to bear are greater than when he was a Sequence 5!
Hobert in the town 'distorted' the gray mist. A passage appeared in front of him. He walked step by step into the black mist containing the aura of death.
Hobert remembered that when fighting the feathered serpent on that island, it had also spewed out a black mist from its body.
But upon reaching the level of an angel, those of the "Death" pathway are usually surrounded only by gray mist, perhaps because angels of this pathway are closer to the underworld.
Through the channel "Distorted" open, Hobert seemed to see the pale white manor house, and a skeleton sitting on a throne, with giant pale white bones and a pair of scarlet eyes.
It felt like with every step forward, the figure of that skeleton grew larger.
Hobert also exuded the majesty of the "Earl of the Fallen," and transformed the thin sword in his hand into a normal sword, raising it high above his head.
The skeleton's figure returned to its original size, and the surrounding black mist seemed to thin slightly!
Hobert saw the skeleton sitting on the throne slowly rise, and then, it ran!
Hobert was stunned for a moment, it really ran! And it ran into the underworld!
He quickly chased after it, once again using the thin sword to cut open a "Underworld Gate," and followed it into the underworld!
Previously, when fighting the Feathered Serpent, he had half-willingly entered the underworld once.
The underworld is clearly different from the spirit world. First of all, the underworld is cold and biting, and as soon as you enter, it attracts a large number of ghosts.
They don't come to watch the excitement, but to see if there is a chance to kill Hobert and then use his body to return to the real world.
Even if this is not a "Death" pathway Beyonder, their corpses will rot after death, and they will have to return to the underworld after a few days, but those who can become ghosts all desperately want to return to the real world to fulfill their regrets from their lifetime.
The ghosts here are also slightly different from the ghosts in the real world. In the real world, ghosts are basically Beyonders or involve Beyonder factors.
Most of the ghosts in the underworld are formed by ordinary people. They are the "residents" here, having lost most of their memories and the concept of time.
Theoretically speaking, the God of Death could turn these ghosts into normal spirits and make them disappear from the underworld, but the God of Death has been fallen for a long time.
Besides ghosts, there are various special undead in the shape of skeletons and zombies, such as Hant and Maximilian, who have established contracts with Hobert.
Many natural spirits can also freely enter and exit the underworld, and their appearances are often bizarre.
Except for the Beyonders of the "Death" pathway, Beyonders of other pathways are very dangerous here.
But Hobert is different, because he has Mr. Azik's mark, so it is more convenient for him to move here than in the spirit world!
Even without Mr. Azik's mark, just holding his own thin sword makes the ghosts dare not approach him.
As soon as Hobert stepped into the underworld, he used the special mark on his body to mobilize part of the power of the underworld to find the Skeleton Lord, and then he "Distorted" to catch up with him.
The Skeleton Lord seemed to realize something and quickly left the underworld!
Hobert also chased closely and left the underworld. There was no moon tonight. After coming out of the underworld, Hobert quickly adapted to the surrounding dark environment and found that this was the location of one of the bone piles.
The Skeleton Lord should have felt the suppression of Hobert himself and that thin sword on it, and was still running away desperately.
"Weaken!" Hobert added negative effects to the opponent while "Twisting" the distance again, and the thin sword in his hand suddenly lengthened, piercing into the opponent's bones.
But the Skeleton Lord did not stop. Hobert realized that this guy might not have pain.
So he injected his spirituality into "1-109," and his right fist was covered with a layer of orange light: "Slaughter!"
He shattered the Skeleton Lord with one punch.
Hobert didn't expect the opponent to be so weak. Just as he was about to step forward to crush the opponent's head and collect the pair of scarlet eyes, suddenly, the scarlet eyes quickly dimmed and finally disappeared without a trace. Even the pale white light on its bones disappeared.
All this happened so fast that almost in the blink of an eye, the Skeleton Lord became like an ordinary skeleton.
Hobert even squatted down to check. It was like a corpse that had been left in the wilderness for who knows how many years, and eventually the flesh and blood rotted away, leaving only bones.
Hobert frowned. Could it be that collecting the Skeleton Lord's eyes requires certain specific conditions? If the conditions are not met, nothing can be collected?
That's not right!
Hobert then thought that even if he couldn't collect Beyonder ingredients, there should be Beyonder characteristics extracted, right? Now there is nothing, which is very strange!
Suddenly, Hobert looked at the bone piles not far away. The "Astrologer" had once divined that these bone piles were closely related to the Skeleton Lord.
Hobert seemed to have thought of something, and injected his spirituality into "1-109." Two thick flames extended from his back, quickly forming dozens of fire crows, and whizzed into the bone pile.
Whoosh~
The bone pile was quickly lit, and after burning, it emitted an eerie green flame like a ghost fire.
Hobert immediately used "Travel" to reach the location of another bone pile. Here, he really saw the Skeleton Lord standing up from the bone pile.
Hobert smiled: "No wonder the main material is the scarlet eyes. Or rather, the so-called Skeleton Lord is just a pair of eyes! Whichever skeleton these eyes are on, that skeleton is the Skeleton Lord.
"Well, that might not be right either. You should have used some ritual or method to make those skeletons have a certain connection with you, so that you can possess those skeletons!"
The Skeleton Lord only had a skeleton frame and could not speak. Its teeth, which were opening and closing at this moment, were enough to express its surprise: Did he discover this secret so quickly?
The two flames reappeared behind Hobert, and dozens of fire crows drilled into the bone pile in front of him again.
The Skeleton Lord jumped out of the eerie green flames, and Hobert stepped forward: "Exploit!"
At the same time, he punched out, knocking the opponent's head to the ground.
When the Skeleton Lord jumped out of the flames just now, its eyes showed a tendency to dim again, but Hobert's ability to "Exploit" extended the time for the Skeleton Lord to "transfer" to other skeletons.
Hobert quickly turned the staff head into a box, and at the same time bent down, his other hand clenched his fist and smashed the Skeleton Lord's head, and picked up two scarlet eyeballs, and threw them into the box as quickly as possible.
One or two seconds later, the Skeleton Lord, or rather the two eyeballs, seemed to finally realize that they had failed to enter another skeleton. It bounced around in the box, but could not break through the barrier set by Hobert.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. He finally caught this guy!
For him, with the thin sword and Mr. Azik's mark, he had a lot of restraint against both the "Death" pathway Beyonders and Beyonder creatures, so it was not difficult to solve a Skeleton Lord.
Even without these cheating-like advantages, Hobert was half a sequence higher than the Skeleton Lord.
But what Hobert didn't expect was that the Skeleton Lord could actually "borrow a corpse to return the soul."
Looking at the scattered skeletons on the ground again, because the Skeleton Lord had failed to leave just now, those skeletons still looked taller and more mighty than normal human skeletons, and the pale white color on them had not been lost.
Hobert remembered that the auxiliary Ingredients seemed to require the bone powder of the Skeleton Lord, so he sacrificed these skeletons and the eyeballs in the box to the "Nation of Disorder."
After entering the "Nation of Disorder," the pair of eyes became very well-behaved and honest. Hobert opened the box and wondered how to kill it, but he immediately realized that the eyes seemed to be already dead.
This may be a common problem encountered by the "Death" pathway: How to kill the dead again?
Hobert smiled and decided to leave this difficult problem to Dophis.
He returned to the real world and used "Travel" to reach the third bone pile, and burned and destroyed this bone pile as well.
Returning to the town in the hollow, Hobert told everyone that he had solved the Skeleton Lord, and asked everyone to pile up the corpses here and burn them. Half of the Beyonder characteristics would be handed over to the lord's mansion, and half would be everyone's merit.
Although tonight's battle meant that everyone just followed the lord in the mountains for half the night, they had started running around for this case early this morning.
Even Raymond and others had started investigating this case a few days ago. When Hobert joined the action, the case had been sorted out almost completely.
These credits should not be ignored.
Hobert's decision made everyone very happy, because this time they had harvested 11 Beyonder characteristics. Even if only half of them were taken and everyone had to share, they could still get a lot of merit.
After all, this was not A Beyonder battle, but just a Beyonder case investigation during peacetime.
After burning the corpses, they returned to the lord's mansion, and it was already late at night.
However, the chef knew that the lord and the lord's wife had not had dinner, so he waited for Hobert and the other two to return.
Hobert saw that the fish brought up by the servant was still hot, thanked the chef and the servant a few times, and was about to eat, but saw the dead fish eyes on the fish head.
This made Hobert think of the Skeleton Lord's eyeballs that he had thrown in the "Nation of Disorder," and he suddenly lost his appetite.
Forcing himself to eat a few bites, Hobert said to Fors, who was obviously hungry and had already eaten half of the fish in big mouthfuls: "I plan to give the Beyonder ingredients formed by the Skeleton Lord to Mr. Dophis."
Fors was slightly stunned at first, then smiled and said: "I have no objections."
Hobert simply put down his knife and fork and began to talk about that past event: "Last year, I explored a ruin with Mr. Dophis, and found a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact in the ruin."
That so-called Grade 1 Sealed Artifact was the black hound spirit beast that was currently being held in Misty Town.
"At that time, with our abilities, there was no way to obtain this Sealed Artifact." Hobert only spoke of the general situation: "We agreed to explore it together after we were both promoted, but I encountered Mr. Azik and explored that ruin with him."
"Because of this exploration, I became very familiar with that Sealed Artifact. Later, I used an opportunity to obtain that Grade 1 Sealed Artifact."
At this time, Fors and Donna stopped eating and were listening to Hobert's past.
Fors only learned today that Hobert and Dophis had actually been on an exploration mission together.
"I've always felt like I owed Mr. Dophis a favor for this matter," Hobert said. "Back then, we discovered clues about the Skeleton Lord in that ruin. I wanted to give this main ingredient for advancement to demigod to Mr. Dophis to repay this favor."
"But after being in South Colson for so long, I haven't found any clues about the Skeleton Lord. I thought I would have to repay this favor in other ways."
Fors expressed her understanding and was also willing to listen to Hobert's past: "Now it's good, we can just hand this main ingredient to Mr. Dophis."
Hobert smiled slightly: "I'll go back to Backlund after I finish eating, and I'll come to accompany you again tomorrow night."
Seeing that the story was over, Danitz picked up his knife and fork again: "What was that saying again? Oh, right, averted a great battle!"
Fors blushed slightly, then looked at Danitz with a wry smile.
Hobert glanced at him: "No one will think you're mute if you don't speak."
After having dinner together, Hobert chatted with Fors for a few more words before returning to Backlund.
After resting for a while, it was already past five in the morning.
He first used "Bestowal" to bring the Skeleton Lord's eyes and a piece of the Skeleton Lord's bone to the real world.
Hobert discovered that the eyes were very well-behaved even when they arrived in the real world.
Knocking on Dophis's door, the butler of the Earl's mansion was indeed already awake.
Hobert said with a smile: "I've brought you a gift."
Dophis looked at the box in Hobert's hand, seeming to sense something: "What reward should I give you?"
"No reward is needed," Hobert said with a smile. "I've already obtained the Sealed Artifact from the ruins outside Backlund."
He raised the box in his hand: "It should have been yours in the first place."
The expressionless Dophis did not decline, but said: "I will advance this morning and need your help."
Hobert smiled and said: "No problem."
It turned out that the other materials were already prepared, leaving only the materials related to the Skeleton Lord.
Originally, he was supposed to go to the MI9 office today, but it was clear that Dophis's advancement was more important, so Hobert simply took a leave of absence.
After breakfast, the two came to Hobert's study, and Dophis began to use the measuring cylinders and balances here to prepare the potion.
Dophis first added auxiliary Ingredients to the beaker. The bone powder of the Skeleton Lord was freshly ground. Even when ground into bone powder, it still looked faintly pale white.
Hobert felt that this should be a very good spiritual material from the "Death" pathway, so he said: "I still have some bones of the Skeleton Lord there. I can give you some more if you need them."
Dophis shook his head: "It's not very useful to me."
Then he explained: "The bone powder of the Skeleton Lord is much better in effect and experience than mummy powder, and it is effective for a week after taking it once."
Hobert seemed to see a wave of gold pounds crashing towards him. He smiled and said: "This is good news for the nobles."
Then he had to state: "It's not very useful to me either."
In this regard, the "Exploit" ability is much more useful than these drugs, but in order to pursue a passionate experience, Hobert actually doesn't use "Exploit" very much.
Dophis continued to prepare the potion, adding 20 grams of Skeleton Lord's bone powder, a pair of antennae of the gray spirit moth, a three-colored undead flower, and 30 milliliters of zombie brain fluid to the beaker.
Then he began to add the main ingredient, first adding a snow-white crystal, and then Hobert saw the scarlet eyes of the Skeleton Lord again.
But Dophis did not add it immediately, but waited for the snow-white crystal to dissolve first.
Hobert reminded: "It's best to add it quickly, otherwise it will easily burrow into the surrounding skeletons."
"It can only do this in its territory," Dophis explained. "There need to be many corpses and skeletons around it before it can gradually create its own territory."
Hobert nodded slightly: "I see."
After preparing the gray-white potion, Dophis held the potion and said to Hobert: "I need you to do me two favors."
"Tell me."
"First, kill me within ten seconds of drinking the potion!"
Hobert was slightly stunned: "Are you sure this is helping?"
This is clearly sending you on your way!
Then Hobert recalled that the ritual for advancing to "Undying" was: to become a dead person.
Before, when he saw this ritual, he guessed that it might be using some means to become a "dead person" in the mystical sense. He didn't expect that before becoming "Undying", one had to really die once.
Dophis continued to say his request: "Don't let my body suffer too serious damage."
Hobert asked: "What is considered too serious damage?"
"For example, dismembering and mincing, and for example…"
Hobert raised his hand: "I'm not that perverted."
Dophis nodded: "Second, after I become an 'Undying', I will lose my memory. I will only be able to recover some important memories in the next month."
"But I have already left relevant diaries and notes. You need to take me to my room and let Serena take over my work for the next month."
Hobert asked strangely: "Can you recover your memory in a month?"
He remembered that Mr. Azik would take many years to gradually recover his memory!
"I can only recover important memories within a month," Dophis explained. "But as the number of times I die increases, the process of recovering my memory will become slower and slower."
"In addition, writing diaries and notes in advance will greatly help in recovering my memory."
Hobert nodded slowly. He realized that Mr. Azik's strength had regressed to the "Undying" state for some reason, and it must have been quite sudden, which did not give him enough time to prepare.
"I understand," Hobert said. "I hope you don't even forget how to read and write by then."
"According to some information I have seen, most of the time I will not forget some things that are more inclined to instinct. If I really forget the ability to read and write the first time I am resurrected, it means I am extremely talented," Dophis said:
"But even if I forget how to read and write, I will understand the meaning of the words after seeing them."
"I have also left relevant teaching materials that can allow me to quickly restore my reading and writing ability. In the first few days, I only need Serena to send food to my room on time."
Hobert nodded: In other words, the more you forget, the higher your talent?
Then he realized that Dophis had been preparing for today's advancement for a long time: "Let's start! Leave the rest to me."
Dophis took a deep breath and solemnly drank the potion in his hand.
Hobert stared at Dophis's Adam's apple. Seeing him swallow the potion, he slapped his head out of a 360-degree rotation.
Dophis almost didn't struggle, and fell cleanly to the ground twitching.
Hobert waited quietly for Dophis's resurrection. After waiting for more than ten minutes, Hobert was about to suspect that he had really killed the other party when he finally saw the muscles and bones on Dophis's neck begin to twist.
After four or five minutes, Dophis's head turned back 360 degrees, and there was some brilliance in his wide eyes again.
Then Dophis resumed breathing, tried to move his hands and feet, and slowly got up to face Hobert face to face.
After staring at each other for a while, Dophis's eyes gradually became confused and fearful. He opened his mouth: "I… ah, where, I… ah… you, ah, who…"
Hobert discovered that the other party had lost the ability to connect languages: "According to your theory just now, you are very talented."
Then he smiled: "Do you want to ask who I am? Have you forgotten? I am your father!"
Dophis obviously didn't quite understand Hobert's meaning, and was a little unresponsive for a while.
Hobert smiled: "Your expression is so rich now, it's much better than always having a cold face. To be honest, I always felt that you were already a dead person before you became an 'Undying'."
He got up and gently carried Dophis on his shoulders: "Okay, I'm not teasing you anymore, I'll send you back."
In front of Dophis's desk, there were indeed many diaries and notes piled up. On the desk, there was also an open notebook, which was obviously the first one to read.
Hobert pressed Dophis, who was like a child, on the chair and let him read the notes himself.
Then he instructed Serena to pay more attention to Dophis during this period and report any situation to him in time.
As for the other servants, don't let them approach Dophis for the time being.
… …
In the blink of an eye, it was the last day of May.
On this day, a construction team came to Order Square and erected a tall iron pole in the center of the square, with a pumpkin-sized light bulb on top of the iron pole!
At this time, most people didn't recognize light bulbs and assumed that Order Square was adding some new building.
Curious people went to ask, and there were dedicated people in the construction team explaining: "This is 'Earl's Light'!"
The vast majority of people didn't understand the meaning of this sentence and assumed that the new building was a donation from some earl.
After preliminary experiments, the staff set up a rain shelter, seemingly planning to stay there for a while.
Until dusk, as night fell, the gas lamps around Order Square were lit.
Gradually, the fog of Backlund made Order Square hazy.
Many people who had finished their day's work, after dinner, strolled to the square chatting and laughing.
Just then, something seemed to light up in the middle of the square, getting brighter and brighter, eventually becoming dazzling.
The strong light it emitted pierced through the fog, illuminating the entire Order Square, making the gas lamps as dim as fireflies in comparison.
Most of the people strolling in Order Square had never seen the full view of the square at night, but now they did!
Even leaving the square and walking down a street, they could still see the light in the square.
Further away, some even thought that the fog in Backlund wasn't too thick today, so they were seeing the moonlight tonight!
The first to recover were the people in the square.
Some panicked and hurried home with their wives and children.
Others were very curious about what it was and cautiously went to check it out.
As a result, they found that many people were already asking questions under the bright light, with staff maintaining order and loudly explaining with a "megaphone": "This is 'Earl's Light,' a light bulb that brings light to Backlund..."
At the same time, there was a product display, with many fist-sized light bulbs lit up.
They were also very bright, giving people the illusion of still being in daylight.
The staff shouted emotionally: "Buy the light bulbs and hang them on the roof, and the whole room will be as bright as day!
"The light bulbs aren't expensive either, only 8 pence each! If used for two hours a day, they can last for a year and a half.
"Please keep the receipt. If it breaks within one month from the date of purchase, you can exchange it for a new one at our sales department."
Although he introduced it vigorously, no one bought it. Everyone was basically watching the excitement and learning about this novelty.
Some people asked questions repeatedly, asking if the light bulb burned gas?
Some people asked what electricity was and how to obtain it?
The staff patiently explained it again and again.
That night, Order Square was very lively. The display of large electric lights gave many people the feeling of watching a wonderful circus.
By late at night, everyone noticed that the huge light bulb had not been extinguished.
A few people who knew what light bulbs were like were very strange: How is this a little different from the light bulbs I've seen?
In the second half of the night, residents around Order Square got up to go to the toilet and saw that the electric lights in the square were still on!
While going to the toilet, they muttered: "This is big news, it will definitely be published in tomorrow's Backlund Morning Post."
However, the next day's "Backlund Morning Post" did not publish that kind of advertising advancement.
However, a piece of apology news aroused the curiosity of many people.
The general meaning of this report was that the "Earl's Light" factory's experiment on light bulbs in "Order Square" was complained about by nearby residents.
Because the light bulb was too bright, it kept people from sleeping.
In response, the "Earl's Light" factory published an apology to the residents around "Order Square."
Then, it briefly introduced the experiment, saying that there had been a new breakthrough in the research on light bulbs, which made the lifespan of the light bulbs very long.
In order to verify this major new breakthrough, this experiment was designed.
Finally, it said that for the future of Backlund, and to give Backlund light, please ask the residents around "Order Square" to be patient for the next two months, because according to the estimate, the light that has been on will only last for two months at most before it goes out.
For a time, everyone was talking about this report and was full of curiosity about the experiment in progress.
In terms of public opinion, Hobert absolutely crushes the advertising industry in this world.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 571: "Earl's Light" Bulb Released (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:

Hobert was very clear that if normal advertising methods were used, people would first think it was an advertisement and wouldn't bother to read it carefully.
Secondly, a large amount of space would be needed to explain what a light bulb is, what electricity is, and so on, and very few people would read to the end.
So it would be better to promote it lightly with this kind of apology, and it must be stated that the residents around Order Square had to complain to the relevant departments before they had to publish an apology in the newspaper.
But the light bulb only lit up yesterday, how could people complain so quickly? When did the bureaucracy of the Loen Kingdom operate so fast?
This was purely a show that Hobert had arranged in advance, but because the method was novel, it easily achieved the desired effect.
At this time, for gentlemen and ladies, newspapers are an important channel for obtaining information, so if everyone has time, they usually read most of the newspaper while eating breakfast, so they have topics to chat with colleagues.
So today in Backlund, most of the middle class knew about the experiment in Order Square.
And they used their limited knowledge to explain new things such as electricity and light bulbs.
This was a large-scale popularization of electrical knowledge, although the direction of the popularization was not necessarily correct, they spontaneously learned the basic knowledge of electricity and light bulbs.
When passing through Order Square, everyone would also look at the light bulb that was still lit in the center of the square.
Even during the day, its brightness was clearly visible.
For two or three days in a row, the topic of light bulbs was relatively popular.
But after four or five days, the popularity of this topic basically passed.
At this time, the Backlund newspapers published another piece of information, that a professor in the scientific community criticized the 'Earl's Light' factory, saying that their reports were untrue.
Because according to normal logic, the lifespan of a light bulb should not exceed ten days! Not only that, the lifespan of most light bulbs is only a few minutes, a few hours!
Then he began to list his data from some experiments, telling everyone the true lifespan of light bulbs, and telling everyone not to believe the previous false reports!
When the report came out, everyone didn't think much of it at first.
But in the evening, the Backlund evening newspapers followed up with a report, saying that the 'Earl's Light' light bulb factory had found the professor who made the critical remarks this morning, and made a 3,000-pound bet with him!
As long as the lifespan of the experimental light bulb can exceed ten days, the professor will have to compensate the 'Earl's Light' factory 3,000 pounds for reputational damage, and publish an apology in the newspaper.
If the large light bulb goes out within ten days, the 'Earl's Light' factory will donate 3,000 pounds to the other party for scientific research sponsorship.
This immediately made everyone start to pay attention to this matter again. First of all, this was a dispute and a bet, which easily aroused the appetite of gentlemen and ladies, as well as the curiosity to watch the excitement.
Secondly, this bet amount is the amount most likely to make the middle class fantasize. With their income, they certainly understand what 3,000 pounds is.
With this money, they would have their own set of housing, or rent a larger house, and own their own carriage, in short, it would improve their lives by a notch!
If the bet amount is 10,000 pounds or tens of thousands of pounds, it would indeed be more surprising, but they don't have a practical concept of this amount of pounds.
That night, many people ran to the square to ask how many days the light bulb had been lit, and the people who came to the square to watch were even more crowded!
The next day, the topic of 'Earl's Light' light bulbs became popular again, and everyone was discussing how many days the light bulb could last.
Some curious gentlemen would even visit their friends in the scientific community to solve their doubts and complete a middle-class social visit.
Many ladies also wrote letters to their classmates or friends with relevant knowledge to connect with each other.
The answers they got were basically the same. As the professor who criticized the 'Earl's Light' factory said, under normal circumstances, it is difficult for any light bulb to last more than ten days.
However, combined with previous reports, many people in the scientific community have guessed that the 'Earl's Light' factory should have found a new material for manufacturing filaments, and the specific results will have to be determined after this bet is over.
For a while, the relatively marginalized scientific community suddenly became a popular topic in Backlund.
At the dance or banquet held in June, be sure to invite a friend from the scientific community to explain the knowledge involved in this bet to everyone.
This will make the host very respectable.
And those scientific workers or scholars who are usually unknown are very grateful for this dispute, which has made them become very popular.
Nobles such as Earl Hall also began to pay attention to this matter. Earl Hall even pointed to the newspaper and said to his good friend Earl Wolfe: 'This is definitely a commercial advancement that can be written into business school textbooks!'
After Klein saw the relevant reports, he also muttered in his heart: 'No wonder the devotees of the 'Creator' regard the draft left by Emperor Roselle as a treasure. It does leave a lot of 'advanced' concepts in it.'
...
East Borough, 19 White Whale Street, this is a very dilapidated apartment.
Emlyn had been patiently squatting here for a day. Through the clues provided by Miss Magician, he had indeed found two targets in this hunting competition, Galis Kevin and Argos.
By dusk, he finally waited for Argos to leave, and now only Galis was in the room.
This was a very good opportunity. Emlyn waited for more than ten minutes and did not see Argos return. He decided to take action.
Emlyn covered the smell of his body by taking extraordinary potions and spraying potions, and then sprayed potions that could temporarily hide his body.
Taking out the 'Leymano's Travels', he first found the astrological interference ability belonging to the 'Astrologer', so that the other party's spirituality could not find him in time.
Taking a few deep breaths, Emlyn, who rarely participated in extraordinary battles, once again recalled the battle plan that had been deduced countless times in his mind.
The action began. He came to Galis's door at his fastest speed. The 'Leymano's Travels' was turned to the page with the 'opening' ability.
Emlyn pressed his palm against the wall and opened a virtual door without substance. He rushed in and quickly found Galis's location. At this time, the 'Leymano's Travels' had been turned to the page with the 'chaos' ability.
Galis didn't understand what was going on, and fell into a state of 'disorder'.
Emlyn quickly stepped forward, distorted Galis's cervical spine with the hand that didn't hold the book, and then pulled off his head with force.
Galis's headless body fell down, and blood spurted everywhere.
Emlyn's calm expression was quickly replaced by a look of astonishment. He looked down at the head in his hand in disbelief, and saw Galis's bewilderment. This guy didn't understand what was going on until the moment he died.
So simple? So easy? Although Emlyn was very proud, he didn't think he could kill a competition target so easily.
But the fact told him that it was that simple.
Emlyn glanced at the 'Leymano's Travels' again. What he used just now was not the demigod-level 'Disorder', but the 'Disorder' in the middle pages that could record the abilities of the 'Mid Sequence'.
After becoming a demigod, Hobert can also control the 'Disorder' at the Sequence 5 level. After all, three pages can record the abilities of the demigod level, so this 'Leymano's Travels' also records many 'lawyer' pathway abilities at the Sequence 5 level.
The 'Disorder' at the Sequence 5 level can last for three or four seconds for an Beyonder at Sequence 6 or Sequence 7, and Emlyn only used this much time from the beginning of the action to the success of the hunting.
In addition to emotion, Emlyn found a small wooden box and some waste newspapers from the house, and squatted next to him waiting for the Beyonder characteristics to be extracted.
Just after two or three minutes, Emlyn suddenly looked up at the door.
Although the house was full of blood, it still did not affect him smelling Argos's smell.
He's back so soon?
For a time, Emlyn was a little nervous, wondering how to deal with this situation.
Bang!
Argos knocked on the door outside, and then stopped making any noise.
Emlyn immediately understood that the other party smelled the blood and had noticed something was wrong in the apartment!
What to do? Rush out and solve him?
No, this will be seen and will be caught by official Beyonders.
Emlyn instinctively took out the potion and hid himself again.
He suddenly had an inspiration, put Galis's head on the bed, and hid himself in the corner, which made the room present a scene where the assassination was completed and the murderer had escaped.
As soon as he hid, the window on the terrace was opened, and Argos jumped in from outside.
In the room, Argos saw the body of his companion. He frowned at first, but when he saw the stack of newspapers and the small wooden box, his pupils shrank!
Not good!
Emlyn then remembered that he had forgotten to cover the wooden box.
Argos almost didn't think about it, and illusory wings grew on his back, and immediately flew to the balcony.
Emlyn quickly went to flip through 'Leymano's Travels'.
Pa~
But because he turned too quickly, he dropped it on the ground.
When he picked it up again, Argos had already flown out of the window, landed on the street in the surprised eyes of many people, and quickly fled!
Emlyn really wanted to slap himself at this time, and made such a low-level mistake!
But it was too late to chase him now. Emlyn was about to put away Galis's head and retreat.
Suddenly, he seemed to think of something, turned to the page recording the demigod-level 'Distortion', and he said to himself: Try it!
Once again injecting spirituality into the 'Leymano's Travels', the mysterious symbols recorded on this page suddenly distorted and disappeared into the void.
At the same time, Emlyn actually sensed Argos, who had run three or four hundred meters away!
He immediately 'Distorted' the other party's intention, turning escape into charge.
Argos, who was on the street, suddenly turned around and ran towards Emlyn at a speed that seemed to run out of afterimages!
Emlyn was stunned: It really works! That's three or four hundred meters! Not three or four meters, nor thirty or forty meters!
This is the ability of a demigod! It is estimated that if the demigod himself uses it, he may be able to attack targets within 500 meters!
Emlyn realized that he was too conservative just now. He should have used the demigod-level 'Disorder' outside the apartment, and then swaggered upstairs and entered the room to solve the target.
When he saw Argos running back with a look of horror, Emlyn finally breathed a sigh of relief, and once again gave the other party a 'Disorder', easily killing the other party.
Taking a few deep breaths, the strong smell of blood made Emlyn quickly regain his composure: It's over, it's another instant kill!
This made him realize once again that Miss Magician's background was not simple, and then Emlyn's mouth rose: 'No wonder the Ancestor asked me to join the Tarot Club, this is definitely a gathering prepared to welcome the end of the world!'
There were footsteps outside, and someone may have called the police.
Emlyn quickly began to clean up the scene, cleaning up his own traces to avoid being found by official Beyonders.
When he left with the target's head and Beyonder characteristics and got on a taxi carriage, he still had an unbelievable feeling when he recalled the experience just now.
...
On the night of June 9th, the ten-day deadline arrived, and Order Square became crowded again.
At 6 pm, the light bulb was on.
At 7 o'clock, it was still on.
At 8 o'clock, it was still on!
At 9 o'clock, the brightness of the light bulb was still normal!
No one knows who started cheering and applauding first. They seemed to be celebrating something, but they didn't know exactly what they were celebrating. In short, they felt like they had witnessed something!
Hobert in the crowd also applauded. He smiled slightly, but he knew what he was celebrating.
The next day, June 10th, the so-called professor published an apology to the 'Earl's Light' factory, saying that he had made a rash conclusion without understanding the facts, which had a very bad impact on this company that symbolizes Backlund's vigor and future, and so on.
At the end of the report, the professor also speculated that with the new technology found by 'Earl's Light', the lifespan of their light bulbs should be between 1000 and 1300 hours.
The gentlemen and ladies who read this report immediately calculated that if they use it for 2 hours a day, this light bulb can actually be used for 500 days!
Even if the professor's calculation is not accurate, 800 hours should be able to be used, right? That can also be used for 400 days!
Of course, it is impossible to use it on time and in quantity every day, and it will definitely be used more occasionally.
Then it should be no problem to use it for 10 months, and if you think about it, this lifespan is quite long.
So far, the topic of light bulbs has reached enough popularity.
On June 11th, a report on the official sale of 'Earl's Light' light bulbs once again fermented this topic.
The report stated that the products of 'Earl's Light' have been inspected by relevant departments and have passed all national standards certifications.
Although everyone doesn't quite understand those inspections and standards, they look very powerful.
The report also stated that in response to everyone's requirements and expectations, the 'Earl's Light' factory decided to pre-sell light bulb products on the 15th of this month.
In the first three months of sales, there would be dedicated sales stores, and after three months, the light bulb company would seek cooperation with major department stores.
Household light bulbs are priced at 6, 8, and 10 pence, depending on the brightness.
As for obtaining electricity, users around the Empress Borough borough can have electric wires installed for free, and only need to pay electricity bills regularly.
The cost of electricity, based on 3 hours of use per day, is about 1 and three-quarters of a penny per day.
For users in other areas, the "Earl's Light" factory can provide battery services.
Light bulbs and household wires are also installed for free. Each battery pack can power an 8-penny light bulb for about 20 hours. Specialized staff will come to the door to replace the batteries. The cost of each replacement is 1 soli and 3 pence, which is 15 pence.
However, each user using batteries must pay a deposit of 10 pounds. If electric wires are laid to the user's block, the wires will be laid for free, and the deposit will be refunded after a set of batteries is returned.
This offer will only last until September. After that, electric wires, lamp holders and other products will be charged a certain fee.
After some calculations, everyone came to the conclusion that using electric lights was only slightly more expensive than gas lamps!
And the cost of the light bulbs can basically be ignored, after all, it only costs 1 penny, or even less than 1 penny, per month.
The key is that replacing the new lighting tool is free!
Installing gas lamps and gas meters, as well as the corresponding pipelines, costs a lot of money. Currently, many Backlund landlords are reluctant to install a set of gas lamps in their houses.
After all, gas lamps and oil lamps are only slightly brighter, but the cost is several times higher!
Many people were excited after seeing this report, and felt that free installation was very cost-effective. The key is that the cost of lighting has not increased much!
At the end of this report, the "Earl's Light" factory stated that because the factory's initial production capacity is limited, only 10,000 light bulbs and supporting batteries and wires can be supplied before the 18th.
Many gentlemen were eager to try and wanted to buy a light bulb to try it out.
Fortunately, there are still a few days to discuss with the family.
Hobert certainly knew that the next few days would be a critical period for everyone's consideration.
Therefore, from the 11th to the 15th, reports about the "Earl's Light" light bulb never stopped.
There were the most direct advertising reports, as well as some reports carefully designed by Hobert.
For example, the advancement on the 12th was an anecdote about a coachman who delivered goods to the Empress Borough borough in the early morning and thought he was late. He rushed to his destination, but the person receiving the goods had not yet gotten up.
Because under the light of the light bulbs, the entire Empress Borough borough was as bright as day, and the coachman arrived more than an hour early.
In fact, with the current usage of light bulbs in the Empress Borough borough, it is far from reaching this level. Hobert's report is just conveying a message: nobles have already begun to use light bulbs on a large scale. This is a trend, a trend!
The report on the 13th was about a patrolman who heard someone shouting "catch the thief" while patrolling. He and the surrounding citizens who were awakened quickly surrounded and caught the thief.
According to the thief's confession, he had already broken into that house twice without being discovered.
But today he was discovered because the owner of the house, as a trial user of the light bulb factory, had just replaced the light bulb. In the bright environment, the owner discovered the thief's trail.
The thief repented: I really shouldn't have gone to such a bright house to steal things.
Hobert doesn't care whether the thief's direction of repentance is right or not. Even if everyone knows that this is his designed propaganda, it doesn't matter. The information he wants to convey has actually been accepted by everyone: after installing light bulbs, because the house is bright enough, thieves will have certain concerns.
The advancement on the 14th was in the story section of the newspaper.
There was a story of a young man who gained love because of the light bulb experiment in Order Square.
At this time, everyone realized that the light bulbs on the square had been lit for half a month, and still maintained normal brightness.
After half a month of preheating, it was finally the day of sale on the 15th. Dozens of sales stores were crowded with people, and tens of thousands of orders were received in just one morning.
The first thousand or so users who pre-ordered used light bulbs that night.
The reason why there were so few was because the electricians Hobert had trained at the beginning were not very skilled.
For this day of sale, in the past month or so, Hobert trained 300 electricians, and temporarily recruited 1,200 vagrants before the sale. Each electrician was equipped with 2 assistants, and the remaining 600 people were responsible for carrying and transporting batteries and wires.
For this reason, Hobert rented a large number of carriages. The carriages were all marked with the "Earl's Light" light bulb logo. In the areas of Backlund where the middle class was more concentrated, a carriage like this could be seen passing by on the street almost every once in a while.
Although the second batch of electricians has already begun training, Hobert is not in a hurry. Just install them at this speed, which can create a sense of scarcity.
The key is that if the installation is too fast, the power may not be enough.
The first large power plant built in the suburbs will not be completed until early July.
Before that, the only power plants providing electricity to the entire Backlund were the medium-sized power plant built in the manor and the small power plant near the Empress Borough borough.
Currently, electric wires have been strung on several main roads in the Empress Borough borough, and some nobles have already used electric lights.
There is also a group of nobles who are installing them, and the power consumption here will definitely increase day by day in the future.
Therefore, the medium-sized power plant in the manor mainly provides electricity for the entire middle class.
If the number of electric lights sold can be installed, it is estimated that the power supply will become tight in a few days, which is an even bigger problem!
As long as the large power plant in the suburbs is repaired, there is no need to worry about the power consumption problem for the time being.
Unless machine electricity and large-scale heating electricity are popularized, at most three large power plants will be enough to provide sufficient power for Backlund's lighting.
After a few days of sales, the popularity of light bulbs has not diminished, and the installation of orders has been scheduled until August.
Some nobles couldn't sit still and sought channels to seek cooperation with Hobert.
However, Hobert refused all invitations to dances, salons, etc., on the grounds of being busy.
The Viscount Glaint's house first became lively. It should be said that the mansion had never been so lively since his father passed away.
Earl Hall's mansion also became crowded, and Audrey was so annoyed that she simply hid in the manor in the suburbs.
Just when some people began to have some crooked ideas, preparing to put pressure on Hobert by destroying his business, a message came from the sea.
Everyone then realized that while Backlund was enthusiastic about light bulbs, a huge change had taken place on Longtail Island!
