chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 574: Doesn’t your Worm of Time cost money?
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
For this afternoon tea party, Hobert invited Earl Hall, Glaint, Lord Bradley, and several other nobles with whom he had a good relationship, telling them that he planned to sell 20% of the shares of "Earl's Light" for a total price of 800,000 pounds!
He could invite friends to the Earl's mansion to buy them tomorrow.
The nobles had no intention of bargaining at all, they knew that Hobert was not short of money now, and he had just solved the Longtail Island issue.
At this time, his selling of shares was entirely to take advantage of this opportunity to establish a solid interest group to hedge against risks.
For the nobles, the price of 800,000 pounds was not high, after all, it would cost 1 million pounds to buy a baronet title.
Earl Hall alone paid for 5% of the shares, and this was only in consideration of the feelings of other nobles, otherwise he would have bought all 20% of the shares himself.
Earl Hall had already realized before that Hobert's improvement of electric lights might cause the wealth of the entire Loen to undergo a redistribution.
It's just that he didn't expect this redistribution process to be so fast!
After the afternoon tea, Hobert saw that it was only four o'clock in the afternoon, so he took a turn around Longtail Island.
At this time, the Governor's Office had completely controlled the western plains of Longtail Island, first by dividing the villages and towns basically based on the previous rubber plantations.
The previous towns and natural villages, after being merged or re-divided, were all assigned town chiefs, town government officials, and village chiefs, establishing a very effective bureaucracy.
And Conrad temporarily transferred a lot of manpower from the South Colson area, as well as the second batch of Backlund noble children who had just completed the assessment, to register land and assets.
For the Loen people on Longtail Island, this island had become chaotic and completely lacked the order that a colony should have.
The local natives also felt some changes, first of all, a person from the Northern Continent moved into the village and could communicate with everyone in some local languages.
The first thing he did was not to rob things or women, but to teach everyone how to farm and brought many advanced agricultural tools from the Northern Continent that could be used for free.
The iron and copper mines were all temporarily shut down, and the miners who had obtained resident status began to build a large number of brick houses, forming natural villages based on the iron or copper mines.
After that, they will also widen and reinforce the mines, equip them with the most advanced water pumps, and then start re-excavating the ore.
The ore that Hobert bought for 16,000 pounds before was enough for a while.
The transformation of Longtail Island was proceeding in an orderly manner, because it had not yet reached the point of dividing the land and forcing the local natives to live a modern life, so Hobert temporarily did not feel the digestion of the potion.
After having dinner with Fors in the evening, Hobert returned to Backlund and met Klein on the bank of the Tussock River, at the place where the two had met last time.
Without any pleasantries, Klein said as soon as they met: "I plan to take action in three days, that is, on Saturday night, you be prepared."
Hobert nodded: "No problem."
"In addition, the opportunity to obtain good luck has arrived, let those who want to obtain good luck attend the ball I am holding tomorrow." Klein took out two invitations: "There are only two places."
Because that "Snake of Fate" Will Auceptin, who is reincarnating, only got two "Worms of Time".
Klein said: "Let those two people be sure to find an opportunity to chat with Dr. Allen's wife, it is best to help her, such as handing her an ice cream."
Hobert put away the invitation and said again: "No problem."
He took out a box made of "Order Crystal": "This is the preparation I have made for the action three days later."
Klein opened the box and looked at it, inside lay six thumb-thick "Worms of Time": "You, you..."
Don't your family's "Worms of Time" cost money? Another six?
Hobert smiled slightly: "Please help pray to Mr. Fool to make these six 'Worms of Time' into talismans, I'll take four and you take two.
"If those advanced talismans are not used in this action, then the two talismans will be yours."
Originally, Hobert planned to pray for the power of the Fool himself to make talismans, but he suddenly realized that he had no concept of making talismans, he didn't know what metal to use, nor did he know what symbols to engrave.
He thought that Klein was quite knowledgeable about this, so he simply let Klein make them.
Klein closed the box: "Leave it to me."
This will be the biggest confidence for the infiltration operation.
Hobert also told him: "Remember to return the box to me."
That is a box made of "Order Crystal".
After talking about the business, the two chatted about the sales of light bulbs for a few more words, and then left with "Travel".
The next day, Hobert still didn't go to work, and twenty or thirty nobles came to the Earl's Mansion again, snapping up the 20% of the shares.
Hobert sent another 2% of the shares to Christian, and 1.5% of the shares to the Queen and Alice each.
Christian sent someone to send 80,000 pounds in cash, Hobert symbolically kept 10,000 pounds, and asked Serena to take the other money to send it back to Christian.
But the servant went to look for her and found out that Serena had asked for leave the day before yesterday to go back to attend her brother's wedding.
Hobert had hardly been in the Earl's Mansion these days, so he didn't know about this, and he didn't take it too seriously, so he asked Dophis to return the money.
So far, Hobert's community of interests has been built, he still holds 55% of the shares, and he has the final say on the development of "Earl's Light", and has absolute control over "Earl's Light"!
This will avoid many risks encountered by "Earl's Light", as for this allowing Hobert to completely integrate into the circle of nobles, that is just a matter of convenience.
At this time, Hobert's funds have reached several million pounds, enough for him to achieve further expansion plans.
In fact, at the same time as the electric lights were sold, Hobert's actions had already begun, first he bought a small factory, transformed it into a school, and established the Backlund Electrician School to solve the current serious shortage of electricians.
Then he leased three more large factories, recruited a large number of vagrants to produce supporting facilities such as wires, batteries, utility poles, crossarms, and porcelain pots.
At the same time, he leased a medium-sized factory, purchased a large number of carriages and horses, established a distribution agency, and a battery door-to-door replacement service, etc.
The biggest investment was buying two large plots of land in the suburbs, and quickly started building the second batch of large power plants.
The construction of supporting facilities in Backlund is like this, and the rest can only be done after the corresponding technicians are trained, little by little, pulling the wires all over the streets and alleys of Backlund, leaving a mark belonging to Hobert in this era.
Now Hobert has sent people to Pritz Harbor, not far from Backlund, to buy land, prepare to build power plants, lay wires, and provide electric light services.
Todd has also sent people to East Chester County and Enmat Harbor to conduct research according to Hobert's instructions, preparing to use the massive funds in his hands to lay the framework for electric light services first.
As for the large cities in the northern Midseashire County and Constant City, although there are also a large number of potential customers, Hobert has no intention of developing there for the time being.
Because that is where the war will be the most intense later, even if the power plant is built, it will not be enough for them to squander.
Now, Hobert only provides a general direction for the "Earl's Light" light bulb factory, and the specific affairs are all managed by Todd.
Hobert also sent an invitation to Upton, asking him to serve as the deputy general manager of "Earl's Light".
After all, Todd is still young, and he has suddenly become a hot commodity from being unknown before. Hobert is afraid that he will not be able to resist some temptations and relax his strict requirements on himself.
At the same time, Hobert also hopes to use Upton's accumulated connections to develop a series of basic industries on Longtail Island.
Hobert did not use the money from "Earl's Light" for the construction of Longtail Island, but a sum of money from a group of financial personnel headed by Fors and Philip.
Even without using the money from "Earl's Light", Hobert still has 200,000 pounds in savings, enough to build Longtail Island into a medium-sized, complete industrial base.
Hobert's long-term plan is to use Longtail Island as a springboard to seek opportunities to build a country in the Southern Continent during the subsequent war.
At that time, the Northern Continent will be in a mess, especially the fall of the industrial town of Constant will cause Loen to lose a large amount of industrial production capacity.
And in the later stages of the war, Backlund will also become panic-stricken, and if Hobert has industrial needs during the nation-building period, he may not be able to obtain enough industrial products from Loen.
So it is better to "do it yourself and have enough food and clothing".
Moreover, the labor and raw materials on Longtail Island are very cheap, and the construction cost is not high. These construction projects can also bring a lot of employment opportunities and create wealth for the natives of Longtail Island.
...
On Thursday morning, Hobert finally returned to MI9 to work, but as soon as he went to work, he started to slack off.
Hobert first went to the South Colson area and obtained the "Beast Tamer" potion formula from Bishop Simpson, then returned to Backlund and handed the formula to Viscount Glaint.
In the past month or so, Glaint has introduced three more batches of Backlund noble children to Hobert. For now, these noble children are enough.
This greatly alleviates the shortage of manpower in the recent period, but if there are more, this group may be difficult to control in the future.
Since Glaint has basically completed the tasks assigned by Hobert, then according to the previous agreement, give him the "Beast Tamer" potion formula and Beyonder characteristics.
In the past period of time, in addition to establishing a mature immigration mechanism, Hobert also established a new training mechanism, recruiting literate people from the East Borough of Backlund and vagrants, conducting basic training and sending them to the grassroots level to gain experience.
Compared with the residents of the East Borough, there are a large number of people who have attended grammar schools among the vagrants. They are all bankrupt middle class.
It's just that the quality of these people is uneven and not easy to manage, but this mechanism can almost completely solve the future shortage of manpower.
And these people also need this job very much. Although the salary is not high, it includes food and accommodation. Such a job is almost non-existent in Backlund.
This is also the reason why so many people break their heads to enter the "Earl's Light" light bulb factory every time it recruits, because it includes food and accommodation.
This can save more than 90% of the expenses for the poor, and even for ordinary workers, it can save about 60% of the expenses.
At first, many rich people secretly laughed at Hobert for giving such good treatment, but soon they couldn't laugh anymore, because the workers in their factories also demanded such treatment.
Even without such a request, the enthusiasm for work has become not high.
Under Hobert's care, Viscount Glaint completed the advancement.
At the same time, he once again mentioned the matter he had entrusted to Hobert before, asking him to steal back his father's ring from Earl Vincent.
In order to avoid alerting the enemy, this time Glaint told Hobert that the opening spell of that ring was to say in ancient Feysac: Summer of Winter County.
The reward is still a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, which is also the most valuable reward that Viscount Glaint can offer.
Hobert promised to help him pay attention to this matter. If he can get it easily, he will take it, but if he has to take some risks, then there is no need.
Leaving from Viscount Glaint's place, Hobert returned to his mansion, and happened to meet Serena who had returned from Tingen City.
"Is your brother's wedding over?" Hobert asked casually.
"It's over." Serena smiled slightly: "They may have a baby in another month or two! I have to save money quickly to buy a gift for the baby."
Hobert smiled and said: "It's just right, you can do something for me, and I will reward you when you come back."
Serena nodded repeatedly: "You say."
"Elizabeth has successfully entered Backlund University, you help me choose some gifts to thank Lord Atwood." Hobert said: "You must be solemn and atmospheric, and apologize to him, because I am busy with official duties and have to ask you to thank him."
After the "Earl's Light" light bulb became famous in one fell swoop, Hobert's status among the nobles quickly increased. For a current Minister of Education, it is completely possible to send a butler to visit and thank him.
Serena was stunned: "Is it that simple?"
She then realized that the teacher wanted to give her a reward on purpose: "Thank you, teacher."
Hobert smiled slightly: "Go."
In the blink of an eye, it was evening, and Hobert was about to go to Longtail Island to find Fors for dinner and "dancing", but Fors rarely came to the Earl's Mansion in Backlund.
She came with Xio.
Hobert smiled: "We haven't had a small gathering for a long time, let's go to Longtail Island to taste the local fruits, or go to Jeffrey City to eat authentic Feynapotter-style food?"
Fors said with a solemn expression in a low voice: "Xio has found Lewis."
Hobert recalled for a moment before remembering that this Lewis was a traitor of the Abraham family and is now an envoy of the Aurora Order.
He took Fors and Xio to the study and talked about this matter in detail.
Xio said: "You should still remember Mr. A's gathering, right? That's right, it's that Mr. A.
"It is said that he participated in the Backlund smog incident and disappeared in that incident, and this gathering stopped.
"Recently, this gathering has started again, and now the host of the gathering is Mr. X.
"After several observations, I found that this Mr. X should be Lewis, whom Fors has been looking for."
Hobert nodded and asked, "When is the next gathering?"
"Tomorrow night," Xio replied.
Hobert hummed, "Tell me the address and password for the gathering. I'll go kill him tomorrow night."
Xio reminded him, "Let me investigate further. Mr. X seems to have many helpers around him."
"All the better," Hobert smiled. "It will make my spoils richer."
Then he laughed, "Don't worry, I've used the resources of MI9 to investigate Lewis as well. Although I didn't get much information, I'm confident I can kill him."
He's just a Sequence 5. Hobert can easily kill him now.
Xio nodded, "It's good that you're confident."
Then she smiled and said, "It's been a while since we gathered, but I have a mission tonight. I have to stake someone out."
After telling Hobert the address and password, Xio left in a hurry.
Fors watched Xio walk away and said, "Xio is still so busy."
She felt sorry for her good friend, "How can we help her?"
"Give her more remuneration for this mission," Hobert said.
Fors said, "That's for sure."
"I talked to Xio's superior at MI9 and asked him to give Xio some high-paying, safer missions," Hobert said. "But that's all I can do. With Xio's personality, she won't accept too obvious help."
Fors sighed, "I once invited her to help on Long Tail Island, but she refused."
"That method is not good, I… Ouch?"
Fors was startled by Hobert's sudden "Ouch": "What's wrong?"
"I, I was thinking that we have to act ahead of time for tomorrow's gathering," Hobert laughed. "Otherwise, Xio might be suspected if she doesn't attend the gathering."
Actually, he suddenly remembered that Fors seemed to have encountered an accident with Xio when she asked Xio to help find the main ingredients for the 'Scribe', and then Xio joined the Tarot Club and started her amazing life.
But the problem now is that Hobert has already prepared the Beyonder characteristics for Fors to advance to 'Scribe'. They won't encounter such danger at all!
So how will Xio join the Tarot Club? And how will she start her amazing life?
But of course, these questions cannot be told to Fors.
Until dinner, Hobert and Fors were still discussing this issue.
They used to be very good friends, and now Hobert and Fors are living very good lives. There's no reason to let their former good friend still work so hard from dawn till dusk.
Hobert did think of a way: "Come to Backlund more often these days, and when you chat with Xio, tell her about the rampant pirates and cultists on Long Tail Island."
"And tell her that the governor's office is short of official Beyonders, and that we will be advancing into the mountains next, touching on the interests of the Mountain God Church."
"After laying the groundwork for a few days, ask her to protect your safety and give her a higher salary."
"If she wants to develop her career on Long Tail Island, give her some support."
Fors nodded, "That's a good idea."
First of all, what Hobert said is basically true. Long Tail Island does have the worries of the Mountain God Church internally and pirates externally, and there is currently a shortage of extraordinary power.
However, Hobert is already trying his best to solve this problem. Archibald just arrived on Long Tail Island with artillery last week, which not only greatly supplemented the island's coastal defense forces, but also brought a group of military Beyonders.
Currently, Seel is already a 'Pyromaniac', and many officers are already 'Warriors', 'Provokers' or 'Barbarians'.
They can solve ordinary pirate attacks.
Of course, the most important thing is that Archibald is now on Long Tail Island. It is itself a demigod-level Beyonder creature, and there are currently three Sequence 5 marionettes. Even if the 'Pirate Admiral' comes, he will not return.
With it and Angus on Long Tail Island, even if the Mountain God Church's Beyonders launch an attack on the governor's office, Hobert doesn't need to support them.
Moreover, after the land revolution that will take place soon, Hobert is preparing to start recruiting soldiers on Long Tail Island.
In up to half a year, Hobert will be confident that he can completely squeeze the Mountain God Church's living space clean.
There is no need to tell these things to Xio. Let her take a look at Long Tail Island and feel the thriving atmosphere. Maybe she will like it there.
But soon, Fors realized that this idea seemed a little naive.
Fors said, "Xio's goal is to investigate the cause of her father's death and restore the family's glory. She probably won't leave Backlund for a long time before this goal is achieved."
Hobert hummed, as if this goal could be achieved in the second half of this year: "Regarding this, I will help her with some investigations, hoping to resolve her knot as soon as possible."
Until the two of them returned to the bedroom together at night to rest, they didn't talk much about the assassination of Lewis.
Through "Leiman's Travel Notes", Fors knew how strong Hobert's abilities had become, and it also let her know how easy it was for a demigod to kill a Sequence 5.
...
After nightfall on Friday, it began to rain lightly.
This made the air in Backlund much better. Carriages were still galloping on the streets, and the coachmen lowered their hat brims to prevent rainwater from falling into their eyes.
After a layer of rainwater covered the horse lamp, the light seemed to spread out a little, becoming somewhat unreal.
Hobert, who had changed his face, looked at the street. Pedestrians on both sides of the road hurried by with umbrellas, while homeless people huddled in corners, hoping that the light rain would end soon.
Now there is a joke in Backlund: Earl Hobert has hired all the homeless people!
Although this joke is a bit exaggerated, since Hobert returned to Backlund, he has immigrated 40,000 homeless people to the South Colson area.
When several branches of "Earl's Light" started construction, Hobert recruited nearly 30,000 homeless people one after another.
This has reduced the number of homeless people on the streets of Backlund by a quarter, because Hobert also recruited some extremely poor people in the East Borough, otherwise the number of homeless people would have been reduced by a third.
But according to the current trend, this quarter of the "share" will be filled again in the next two or three months, and the number of homeless people will return to about 200,000.
It's not that there are only 200,000 homeless people in Backlund, but that the entire "leftovers" of Backlund are only enough to support 200,000 homeless people.
Looking at the wet street, Hobert withdrew his gaze, and his thoughts drifted away for a while.
The carriage came all the way to the East Borough. Hobert got out of the car in the rain and put on his hood.
In fact, he could completely "distort" the angle of the raindrops, and not a single drop of rain would fall on his clothes, but that would instantly expose his strength.
So Hobert, like most passers-by, lowered his brim and hurried to a dark alley, in front of a dilapidated wooden door.
Hobert recalled the password Xio told him, bent his fingers, first three light and three heavy, then two long and three short.
A few seconds later, the door opened silently, and a waiter wearing an iron mask examined Hobert, who had changed his appearance: "Friend, who introduced you?"
Hobert frowned: "Are you new here? I used to attend Mr. A's gatherings at 177 Empress Borough, and no one ever asked who introduced me."
In fact, he only attended once.
Mr. X only initiated a few gatherings after replacing Mr. A, and indeed many previous participants only came to participate in this gathering again these two times.
Seeing that Hobert said the address of the previous gathering initiated by Mr. A was correct, the waiter let him pass.
Hobert unhurriedly passed him, and when he passed through the not-so-long corridor, his spirituality felt three gazes sweeping over him one after another.
Mr. X had just taken over the Backlund Beyonder gathering, and he was very cautious at this time.
Through the short corridor, he came to a fairly spacious living room, and those gazes and examinations all disappeared.
Hobert's Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts were all in a sealed state, and even the examination of an angel might not be able to see the clues. Of course, no one noticed his abnormality.
And although Hobert didn't wear a mask, he was using the "Order Crystal" of the staff head to perform anti-divination operations, so as not to let the highly spiritual "Traveler" detect the danger.
He came relatively early, glanced at the rows of chairs, and finally sat down in a place close to the main seat.
After waiting for more than ten minutes, the time for the gathering arrived.
Hobert glanced at the gathering, there were only thirty people, only about half of the number of the previous Mr. A's gathering, and many wild Beyonders should still be watching.
There is no need to worry that Xio did not attend this gathering and will be suspected by the Aurora Order.
At this time, Mr. X came to the door with a golden mask and walked unhurriedly to the main seat.
He was wearing a black classical robe, wearing a magician's hat, and did not exude much momentum, but the members who participated in the gathering unconsciously lowered their heads.
Mr. X faced everyone, sat in the main seat, and said in a low voice: "Let's begin."
"Okay!" Hobert's figure suddenly became illusory, and then appeared in front of Mr. X.
He didn't use "Distortion", but used the "Blink" of the "Traveler's Knife".
Hobert's right hand suddenly inserted into Mr. X's chest, and took out a still beating heart.
Mr. X's body was just a little illusory, and he didn't have time to enter the spirit world. He looked incredulously at the hooded man in front of him, holding his still beating heart in his hand.
His figure, which had begun to become illusory, also became solid again, and quickly lost his vitality.
Under the golden mask, the incredible expression gradually turned into fear, and froze on this corpse's face.
At this time, the members who came to participate in the gathering suddenly realized that the host of this gathering had been killed, screamed and ran out, and the living room became a mess.
Hobert threw the heart in his hand casually, took out a handkerchief and wiped the blood on his hands, and said: "The Beyonders of this pathway are really weak!"
"Travelers" are indeed notoriously difficult to catch, but once their ability to escape is restricted, or they simply don't have time to use it, it also means that they will be in great danger.
Hobert was fast enough, so he didn't even use the ability of "Disorder" or "Distortion", and directly went up and killed the opponent.
At this time, the surrounding shadows seemed to become viscous, and the shadows began to flow towards Hobert. They were unable to determine Hobert's strength, but they couldn't just leave like this, so they tried to attack.
After Hobert wiped the blood stains on his hands, he threw Mr. X's body into the leather bag with spatial magic: "Corruption!"
"Ah~"
Three screams immediately came from those shadows. The dim shadows suddenly jumped up, and three strange-shaped human figures like black paper appeared. They seemed to be enduring great pain.
Then these three shadows stopped struggling and fell straight to the ground, and the "black paper" revealed the faces of three people.
They had always been influenced by the "True Creator" at ordinary times. At this time, Hobert's "Corruption" was like suffering a high-level ability attack of this pathway at close range, and they actually died tragically!
Hobert unhurriedly put their corpses into the leather bag. He could feel that there were still some gazes peeping at him in the surrounding shadows, but Hobert was not very interested in these Sequence 7 or lower members.
At this time, those members who participated in the gathering were still blocked in that narrow corridor. Hobert simply pushed down a wall and left the living room unhurriedly.
There were basically no street lights on the streets of the East Borough. Hobert walked step by step in the dim alley.
At this time, the darkness on the street suddenly became viscous, and illusory figures appeared one by one, staring at Hobert unkindly.
In Hobert's impression, the Aurora Order seemed to have a demigod in Backlund. He didn't have any nonsense. While his fist was covered with a layer of orange-red light, he suddenly rushed over to "Slaughter!"
The viscous shadows didn't expect the other party to launch a fierce attack without even trying. They quickly dispersed like a tide.
But Hobert appeared in front of the shadow like a Blink, and stomped it on the ground. The violent blow rippled like a circle in the shadow, and at the same time stepped out a big pit on the ground.
A black shadow rolled to the side, rolling silently on the ground.
The "Black Knight" let his shadow bear this blow of "Slaughter". The shadow was seriously injured, but the "Black Knight" was unscathed.
"Connection!" Hobert, who had experience fighting the "Black Knight" once, let the shadow on the ground Connection with its master.
This allowed the shadow's injuries to be transmitted to the body to a certain extent, and a muffled groan came from the approximate end of the dim alley.
"Disorder!" Threw this ability in that direction, because "Disorder" can occur within a certain range, so it doesn't matter even if it doesn't hit the opponent.
Taking this opportunity, Hobert "distorted" the distance while rushing over, and injected spirituality into "1-109": "Fire Crow Technique!"
Two flames stretched out from his back, turning into dozens of fire crows and smashed towards the opponent. The darkness at the end of the alley immediately became viscous, and stood up like a semi-solid liquid to block most of the fire crows' attacks.
The fire crows exploded, blowing bricks and tiles at the end of the alley and the land was sunken.
Many people were still in their sleep and were "hit" onto the street by the shock wave of the explosion.
Hobert took this opportunity to rush to the opponent, stabbing with a thin sword, and the semi-solid "dark liquid" was pierced: "Weaken!"
The "Black Knight" dodged the rapier somewhat clumsily and was weakened.
At this moment, a figure surrounded by bright, illusory symbols appeared between the two. This figure gradually emanated a twilight hue, and its appearance became clearer. It had only a giant vertical pupil on its face and wielded a two-handed greatsword.
Hobert's subsequent thrust failed to pierce this giant figure. At the same time, he felt his strength rapidly draining away, and even his mind grew weary, as if he loathed all combat and only wished to peacefully await the arrival of death.
"Bestow!" Hobert struggled against the weariness of his mind, "bestowing" the negative state on his body to the "Black Knight" behind the giant figure.
A wisp of twilight color appeared on the "Black Knight," but this wisp quickly "flowed" to the ground, disappearing into the shadows. He gave all these negative states to the surrounding shadows, causing half the alley to briefly emit a twilight glow.
Simultaneously, the tall figure with the giant pupil dissipated, and the figure surrounded by bright, illusory symbols reappeared.
Hobert realized that this was the "Mystic" herded by the "Black Knight." What he had just "reproduced" might have been a scene like "God of Combat's Charge" or "Giant King's Advent."
Hobert raised his other hand and injected spirituality into "1-107": "Banish!"
The figure floating with illusory symbols immediately felt a tremendous force, as if it were about to be blown into another world.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert thrust his sword at the "Black Knight." While recalling the "Mysticologist" the "Black Knight" conjured a blue magma greatsword in his hand, blocking Hobert's strike.
At the same time, goat horns grew from the "Black Knight's" head, and his skin became dark and sinister, as if he were clad in a layer of armor. This was the "Demonification" state.
The "Black Knight" instantly switched to the soul of a "Desire Apostle." Hobert casually slashed, creating a "Underworld Gate," and the surrounding rain was swept into the Underworld along with the cold wind.
Hobert's mastery of Underworld power grew more proficient. While using the power of the Underworld to put pressure on the herded souls as much as possible, he extended his rapier: "Magnify!"
He magnified the "Language of the Dead" that the rapier had been emitting. From the start of the battle, the "Black Knight" had been under attack by the "Language of the Dead," and now these attacks finally manifested. The "Black Knight" felt his muscles stiffening, as if his body were becoming increasingly foreign.
However, the "Black Knight's" flesh magic came into play at this moment. His heart instantly doubled in size, providing surging power to his blood and accelerating its flow. The feeling of muscle stiffness gradually disappeared.
Hobert thrust again, and a hand reached out from the "Black Knight's" chest, gripping the rapier.
The "Black Knight" himself quickly returned to normal from the "Demonification" state. An arm extended from the hand on his chest that was grasping the rapier, and then a seemingly illusory, exquisite "puppet" emerged. Its eyes were blank and lifeless.
Hobert was slightly stunned, not expecting this "Black Knight" to have herded two demigod-level souls.
The highly spiritual "puppet" could use its spirituality to cover the rapier, blocking Hobert's attack.
"Pity!" Hobert's lips turned down: "You can only herd one soul at a time."
Although the switch was seamless, the coordination of various abilities was difficult to deal with only below the demigod level. In demigod combat, a single spiritual body's attack could not produce unexpected results.
Even continuous skills were somewhat weak.
As Hobert spoke, a puppet-like figure was solidifying from illusion in his pupils.
This was the possession of the "Puppet" level. Hobert simply reversed the rapier and stabbed it into his own chest.
The "puppet," whose eyes had been lifeless, immediately showed a painful expression and screamed, leaving Hobert's body.
Hobert pulled out the rapier: "Bestow!"
He once again "bestowed" most of the injuries to the "Black Knight."
This was the battle of demigods. Combos that were very effective below the demigod level could be broken in strange ways in demigod battles.
The "Black Knight's" usual combo was "Puppet" possession. He commanded his shadow to attack the target.
Then, the second step was to use the "Mysticologist" to create an offensive "reproduction," while controlling the target with his shadow.
There was a third step and a fourth step after that.
However, in the battle with Hobert, his shadow was severely injured by Hobert from the start. He did not dare to manipulate the shadow now, fearing that the shadow's injuries would affect him.
The "Black Knight's" combo became a joke.
The "Underworld Gate" was always there. The "Black Knight" clearly felt that his herded souls were being affected by some force, as if it were vying for control of these souls.
He realized that he had no chance of winning in this battle.
So, after having the "Puppet" block Hobert's offensive again, he prepared to immediately hide in the darkness and escape.
Hobert had been waiting for this opportunity. He knew that with his current abilities and the use of sealed artifacts, he was confident in defeating most Sequence 4s of various pathways head-on.
Even if he could not defeat the "Black Knight" in a short time, Hobert was sure that the "Black Knight" would run away at the first opportunity. After all, the Aurora Order was a hidden organization, and even if it had cooperation with the royal family, it was not something that could be seen in the light.
The commotion just now was so great that the Church's demigods could arrive in as little as two minutes. He definitely did not dare to fight a protracted battle.
"Connection!" Hobert had already used the battle to put the "Black Knight" in a state of "weakness" and "bestowal," so the three skills, including "Connection," were guaranteed to succeed.
The "Black Knight's" escape came to an abrupt stop. He looked at his shadow. Although he had run away, he had not taken his shadow with him!
Hobert punched him out of the shadows.
The "Black Knight" suddenly realized that even if he ignored the shadow, it would return to his side after a while.
But Hobert's second punch had already arrived. The "Black Knight" immediately turned into an exquisite puppet, using the extremely strong physique of the "Puppet" to receive this punch, but was beaten back repeatedly.
Then Hobert kicked out. The "Black Knight" realized that even the physically strong "Puppet" seemed unable to block this kick.
The "Black Knight" finally realized that something was wrong.
Of course, something was wrong, because Hobert was now using the "Fatal Attack" from "1-109," each strike heavier than the last. An average demigod would only last until the fourth strike.
But the "Black Knight" had no time to dodge and could only block with his arms.
Crack, an arm was kicked off.
However, the "Black Knight" immediately used his flesh to return the protruding broken bone to its original position.
The "Black Knight" was about to switch to the soul of the "Mysticologist" to block Hobert's next strike. With his previous experience, he did not dare to run away now.
But the rapier in Hobert's hand suddenly lengthened, piercing the "Black Knight's" chest.
The "Black Knight" was stunned: "It can, lengthen!"
Hobert's actions from "Connection" to "Fatal Attack" were actually just preparing for the rapier's attack. He needed such a moment, a moment that could unexpectedly wound the "Black Knight."
Letting the rapier become the main attacking weapon was entirely because it could destroy the "Black Knight's" spiritual body, which could effectively prevent him from using his tenacious flesh magic.
The rapier suddenly widened, tearing open half of the "Black Knight's" chest.
The "Black Knight" immediately retreated, using flesh magic to heal the wound, but he found that the wound could not heal!
The wound was like a huge vortex, and his life force and spirituality were rapidly draining from it.
"Arrogance!" Hobert used this ability almost like a judgment. At the same time, the sword in his hand turned into a two-handed greatsword.
The "Black Knight" seemed to think that he could continue to fight Hobert, but he was stepped on the chest by Hobert and his head was chopped off with a sword.
The "Black Knight" did not even have the chance to use flesh magic to escape, because his spiritual body had become fragmented, which made him realize that he could not manipulate the damaged flesh.
He could only feel his life rapidly draining away in fear and soon reached its end.
Whoosh~
A gust of strong wind blew from the direction of Holy Wind Cathedral. Hobert glanced at it, quickly collected the "Black Knight's" body, did not forget to seal the "Underworld Gate," and left the scene using "Travel."

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 575 Entering the Foggy Town (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:

[Thanks to omar amurrio for becoming a free member]
Archbishop Randall Valentinus of Holy Wind Cathedral was the first to arrive at the scene.
At this time, the black, viscous liquid-like substance in the shadows had not completely dissipated, and on the ground, there were still traces of what looked like wriggling blood, like caterpillars.
Especially at the end of the alley, it had almost blasted through this dead end and connected it to the street in front.
This burly archbishop, with thick, deep blue hair, surveyed the scene.
Soon, an old man wearing a black cleric's robe with five Night Saint emblems on his chest seemed to emerge from the void.
This was Archbishop Anthony Stevenson of Saint Samuel Cathedral. He nodded slightly to Redale, as a greeting.
Anthony also looked at the scene: "The Aurora Order's 'Black Knight'?"
Both archbishops saw the few drops of blood that were still wriggling just now but were now almost lifeless. Redale said, "I think so."
He paused and then said, "Who killed this 'Black Knight'?"
Both of them knew that there were many demigods in Backlund, but battles between demigods were rare because their actions would quickly attract the attention of the churches' demigods.
Even in some situations where they had to fight, it was difficult to determine a winner in an hour or two.
The usual situation was that the two would fight fiercely, but seeing that they could not quickly determine a winner, the official Beyonder's demigods would be about to arrive, so they would tacitly end the battle.
However, the battle that had just taken place in this dark alley had clearly resulted in a victory.
Whether it was from the black shadows on the ground that were lifeless but had not completely dissipated, or from the spiritual perception of the two saints, it proved that the "Black Knight" was dead.
At this moment, an old man wearing a white priest's robe and a soft hat quickly flew in from the sky and landed steadily.
Behind him were a pair of mechanical-looking but thin and light silver wings.
When the old man landed, the wings automatically folded and disappeared under the white priest's robe.
He was Archbishop Horamick Hayden of the Steam Church. When his feet landed, the pupils of his eyes suddenly became illusory, and streams of information flashed through his eyes.
A second or two later, his pupils returned to normal: "The one who fought the 'Black Knight' also seems to be a Sequence 4, but he has good anti-divination abilities. I can't see any information about him."
The three saints looked at the blood that had completely lost its vitality and saw the shadow that had completely disappeared.
Although the other party had killed a demigod of the Aurora Order, the expressions of the three gradually became serious.
A demigod who could kill a "Black Knight" in about 1 minute had come to Backlund, and they knew nothing about it.
...
Hobert arrived in the western wilderness of Backlund, belonging to the Balk family, and dumped the corpses from his leather bag.
The battle with the "Black Knight" had only lasted about a minute, so the Beyonder characteristics of these corpses had just begun to be extracted.
Hobert took off the Mr. X mask, revealing a face with thin cheeks and a gloomy look between his eyebrows, like a drug addict.
It was indeed Lewis Wien!
Hobert injected his spirituality into "1-109" and once again activated the sealing item's "Shepherd" ability.
Lewis's soul was sucked out of the corpse by "1-109" and entered the leather bracelet that Hobert wore on his wrist with a painful expression, adding another dazzling blue gem to the bracelet.
Hobert's spirituality immediately had three options again: "Travel", "Blink", and "Divination".
This way, Hobert could give the "Traveler's Blade" to Fors, so that she would have the ability to escape immediately when she encountered danger.
Using the rapier, he cut off Lewis's head. Hobert accelerated the extraction speed of the Beyonder characteristics of the other corpses, and recovered one "Black Knight" and three "Rose Bishop" Beyonder characteristics.
At the same time, several other pathway's Beyonder characteristics were extracted from the "Black Knight's" corpse.
Finally, Hobert used "Fire Crows" to burn all the corpses and bury them in the soil.
He used "Travel" again and returned to the study of the Earl's mansion.
Fors was indeed still waiting here, and she immediately stood up: "How is it?"
Hobert handed the head in the cloth bag to Fors: "I didn't expect there to be unexpected gains."
Fors glanced at the head in the cloth bag. It was indeed Lewis: "What gains?"
"I also hunted down an important member of the Aurora Order by the way," Hobert said with a smile.
He did not say that it was a "Black Knight", so as not to worry or blame Fors.
Fors smiled: "Thank you, Hobert."
Hobert pinched her face: "This is what I should do."
Fors had to deal with the head, and Hobert had to recover his condition, so the two left the room and went about their business. There was no time to "dance" tonight.
Hobert came to the study, took off his shirt, and the wound on his chest had begun to rot and was bleeding some black blood.
It was the wound that Hobert inflicted on himself with his sword in order to prevent the "Puppet" from possessing him.
This sword caused great damage to the "Puppet", but Hobert was also injured as a result, and he could only "bestow" most of the injury away.
Hobert drew his rapier again and cut out a "Underworld Gate", using the power of the Underworld to restore the injured spiritual body.
After sealing the "Underworld Gate", Hobert found a small knife, dug out the rotten flesh, and then used the "Healing Fork" to heal the wound quickly.
After doing all this, Hobert sacrificed the Beyonder characteristics he had gained today to the "Nation of Disorder".
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert crushed these three demigod-level Beyonder characteristics while pondering how to deal with them.
The "Mysticologist" Beyonder characteristic could be sold to Bernadette, and the "Puppet" Beyonder characteristic would be kept to see if Miss Sharron would need it in the future.
But how to deal with this "Black Knight" Beyonder characteristic? This time, Hobert acted cleanly and did not give the other party a chance to become a Sealed Artifact.
The problem was that Hobert did not need the Beyonder characteristics of this pathway. It would be a pity to sell it to the orthodox churches at a low price.
After thinking for a while, Hobert thought of Old Man Winston, whom he had kept. He would see if he could make it into a mystical item.
It didn't matter if the negative effects were a little stronger, it was better than directly using Beyonder characteristics.
As for the "Rose Bishop" Beyonder characteristics, they could be crushed and sold to the orthodox churches in the future.
There was also 1 "Desire Apostle" and 1 "Scarlet Scholar" Beyonder characteristics.
The former would also be dealt with by the orthodox churches, and the latter would be sold to the Sanguine when he found a chance.
...
Saturday morning, Pritz Harbor.
Dorian walked out of the Fishermen's Connection, seemingly unhurried, but his heart was filled with doubts and worries, because he had just received a letter from his student Fors through someone.
It said that she had something important to meet him about, and she was now staying at the Sea Breeze Street Hotel at number 55.
What Dorian wondered was, how could his student, who was always lazy, suddenly run to Pritz Harbor to meet him?
He was worried about whether Fors had encountered some difficult problems?
Dorian wasn't worried that this would be a trap, because at the end of the letter, there was a code that they had already determined. At least in Fors's view, this meeting was safe.
After a simple observation of the Sea Breeze Street Hotel, Dorian finally walked in. After confirming that there was no danger, he came to the outside of the room Fors mentioned in the letter and knocked on the door according to the agreed code.
The door was opened, and Fors made a "everything is safe" gesture to Dorian before Dorian felt relieved and entered the door.
"Teacher, I know this visit is a bit rushed," Fors smiled after closing the door: "But I have something very important to ask you about."
Dorian was slightly relieved. At least it seemed that Fors's matter was not too dangerous or urgent: "Tell me slowly."
The two sat down on the two chairs in the hotel. Fors picked up a small leather bag and said: "I know that Lewis Wien once betrayed the organization and caused you a lot of harm. I have always wanted to find him and avenge you."
"Give up this idea!" Dorian sat up straight: "Even if you have 'Leymano's Travels', you are definitely not his opponent.
"Even if Hobert is also a Sequence 5, even if he is stronger than Lewis, he may not be able to kill him.
"But as long as he is not killed, his organization will definitely launch a revenge! They are all a bunch of lunatics, even if Hobert is an Earl, he can still become their target!"
He took a deep breath: "You have such a heart, which makes me very pleased, but you don't need to take risks."
If Hobert was still Sequence 5, it would definitely not work, Fors muttered silently: "Hobert has succeeded!"
Cough cough cough! Dorian choked on his saliva, coughed, and took a few sips of tea before he was relieved.
Then he seemed to realize something: "Hobert has advanced to Sequence 4?"
Fors nodded slightly, this could not be concealed, otherwise it would not make sense.
Dorian asked with some worry: "Have you encountered any trouble? Have you accidentally left any clues?"
"Shouldn't have," Fors said: "Hobert changed his appearance, and he has a mystical item that resists divination.
"According to his description, he seized the opportunity and succeeded quickly, and the other party didn't even have time to enter the spirit world."
Dorian sighed: "That's good, that's good."
Fors opened the exquisite small leather case on the ground, which contained a head wrapped in newspaper.
Dorian saw the face he would never forget. His smug smile was gone, and his face was filled with disturbing fear.
As an "Astrologer", Dorian's spirituality could confirm that this was Lewis Wien's head.
"Good, very good..." Dorian whispered a few words slightly excitedly, took out a fist-sized pure crystal ball from his pocket: "It is made of star crystal and can effectively improve your astrology."
Before Fors could refuse, Dorian laughed and said: "Lewis is my enemy. You helped me get rid of him, so I have to pay you some reward."
Fors immediately refused: "No, no need. Hobert has already kept his Beyonder characteristics for me to advance to 'Traveler' in the future."
Dorian said with a serious expression: "Do you want to make me feel guilty and uneasy?"
Then he smiled: "Don't worry, your teacher still has some wealth."
Fors didn't say anything else. If she didn't want anything, it might really make Teacher Dorian uneasy.
Dorian thought for a while and then said: "Wait here for a while, I'll be right back."
Ignoring Fors's retention, he insisted on leaving and returned about an hour later. First, he handed Fors a box: "There is still a crystal ball inside, but this is a mystical item.
"It allows people who don't know 'Divination' to use 'Divination', but it can only have the level of Sequence 7 at most.
"If it is someone who knows 'Divination', it can bypass some anti-divination abilities and improve the accuracy of 'Divination'; it can also be used as a medium for dream divination, roulette divination, and other forms of divination.
"The negative effect is: do not use it under the cosmos, otherwise it will attract malicious gazes."
After Dorian finished introducing it, he said again: "This mystical item does not conflict with your 'Divination' ability, it is equivalent to giving you a higher sequence of 'Divination'."
Then he took out two documents: "These are two properties in Backlund, one in Hillston District and one in Cherwood District, both in good locations."
Fors was slightly stunned: "Teacher, this is too much! How about this, I only want that crystal ball."
She roughly calculated that these two properties were worth at least 6,500 pounds, and that crystal ball was also worth about 4,500 pounds, so Dorian gave her 11,000 pounds at once! This is the foundation of the former angel family!
They are indeed unknown now, but there are still many properties such as land, forest farms, real estate, manors, and mines.
"No," Dorian said seriously: "Normally, the reward for assassinating Lewis Wien, who is supported by the Aurora Order, would be at least 30,000 pounds. What I gave you is still too little, but I can only give you so much for now."
Fors knew that these rewards were not easy to decline: "Teacher, these are enough. Really, when hunting Lewis, we never thought about asking for any reward.
"Hobert's main purpose was also to target the Beyonder characteristics on him."
Dorian smiled: "That's a good young man."
If Hobert wasn't Fors's husband, and Dorian knew that the two were very loving, he would have suspected that Hobert had other plans.
Dorian even thought just now that Fors meeting Hobert was her opportunity, and at the same time, wasn't this an opportunity for the Abraham family?
He advanced to demigod at a young age. He must be a member of an Beyonder family, or, as reported in the newspaper, he has the support of the Loen royal family.
This is a demigod who has enough goodwill towards the Abraham family, and in the future, he may get more help from him.
The key is that Dorian still thought that Fors and Hobert didn't know that he was a descendant of the Abraham family, so he could safely ask Fors for help in some matters.
Then, Dorian asked Fors about the digestion of the "Astrologer" potion.
Fors smiled slightly, "I'm now in the habit of divining before I do anything."
Then she said seriously, "Not long ago, I discovered a fact: 'Divination' is not omnipotent. I mean, for various reasons, you can't be too superstitious about the results of 'Divination'."
Dorian nodded with satisfaction: "This isn't the first time I've said it, you have a high talent!"
...
Backlund, MI9.
Hobert found Byron in the lounge and chatted with him in the corner about Xio's recent situation.
Finally, Hobert asked in a low voice: "Do you know the real cause of Xio's father's death?"
Byron smiled helplessly: "My position at the time was too low, and I didn't know the specifics."
Hobert nodded, pretended to think for a moment, and then said: "Okay, there's nothing else."
He went over to pour himself a cup of coffee, and while drinking it, he said to several intelligence personnel who suddenly became restrained: "Sorry, I interrupted your chat, please continue."
He smiled and raised the coffee in his hand: "I'll leave after I finish this cup of coffee."
Byron smiled and said: "We were just chatting, you didn't interrupt us."
"That's good." Hobert smiled: "I heard you say just now that you got some news about the Aurora Order? Are you finally going to crack down on this crazy secret organization?"
This was his main purpose in coming to the lounge; he knew that someone would complain about this matter today.
As he expected, one intelligence officer complained: "We are investigating the person who killed an important member of the Aurora Order."
Another intelligence officer joked: "I really can't figure out why we're investigating the murderer. Are we going to give him a good citizen award after we find him?"
Generally, investigations into cases where members of such secret organizations are killed are just a formality. If evidence is found, it is recorded; if not, the case is closed as a vendetta or a dispute over spoils.
After all, no one cares how these villains die.
However, this case is being pushed very urgently from above, and the investigation is quite thorough.
Others also began to joke about this matter: "It's as if we're going to avenge the Aurora Order."
Hobert took a sip of his coffee and thought: It's very likely that you will become accomplices.
After listening for a while, Hobert roughly knew that MI9's investigation direction had indeed been misled by him.
According to the eyewitnesses they found, it is currently believed that it should be an Beyonder of the "Apprentice" pathway who committed the crime, after all, the opponent used "Blink".
As for the signs of explosions that appeared on the streets outside, some people believe that it is likely to be a recorded ability.
This is why Hobert used the "Blink" ability yesterday, instead of the "Distortion" ability.
If the Aurora Order gets such news, they are likely to suspect that this is the Abraham family's revenge, or purely to hunt down that "Traveler".
Even if they guess that "Blink" may come from a mystical item, it is difficult to guess Hobert's specific pathway, because according to the traces at the scene, the murderer may also be an Beyonder of the "Hunter" pathway.
The ability of the "Lawyer" pathway, as long as you are careful to avoid it, will generally not leave too obvious traces.
As Hobert said, he left after finishing his coffee.
In the afternoon, Qonas came to see Hobert, and the two talked about the "Earl's Light" light bulb. Now Qonas is also a shareholder of "Earl's Light", which has invisibly brought the two closer together.
Hobert smiled and said: "The advancement of light bulbs is not over yet, because the big light bulb in Order Square is still on!"
Qonas praised: "I have to say, you are a business genius."
Then he said: "There is a card game at the club tonight, would you like to participate?"
"Some other day." Hobert smiled helplessly: "Todd is coming back from Pritz Harbor this afternoon, and I want to have a simple meal with him."
"It seems that the hot sale of 'Earl's Light' is not all good." Qonas joked: "You don't even have time for entertainment."
After Qonas left, the smile on Hobert's face immediately disappeared.
He certainly guessed that Qonas's visit was an observation and test of himself. Although Hobert found a good reason to go to the lounge in the morning, this was his first time going, and it was after the Aurora Order case happened.
It's not that Qonas suspects Hobert, after all, on the surface Hobert has no motive for the crime, but he just wants to completely rule out Hobert's suspicion.
Hobert's performance was also very natural. If he had accepted Qonas's invitation just now, it would have made him seem guilty, after all, he rarely participates in club entertainment activities.
In that case, Qonas would definitely test him further.
Because of Hobert's performance, Qonas has ruled out Hobert's suspicion.
After getting off work, Hobert met Fors in the Earl's mansion study.
"Teacher Dorian's reward is too generous." Fors said: "He actually gave me a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact and two properties."
Hobert listened to the specific information about those rewards: "That crystal ball might be useful to me, let me use it for a while first. As for those two properties, I suggest you can use them to collect rent."
Fors was slightly stunned: "I was planning to give them all to you, after all, I didn't play any role in this matter."
"You are Hobert's wife and Dorian's student, that's your greatest role." Hobert patted Fors's plump butt: "Okay, let's go have dinner, I have an action tonight."
...
As night fell, Hobert used "Travel" to come to the bank of the Tussock River again, the place where he and Klein had met before.
Klein was already waiting here. After the two met, there were no pleasantries. He took out four talismans: "Through praying to Mr. Fool, I have created three types of talismans, namely Fate Siphon Talisman, Deception Talisman, and Deprivation Talisman.
"The Fate Stealing Talisman can steal the target's fate for three seconds, and can exchange one's own fate with the other party.
"The Deception Talisman can deceive the target, causing the other party to make wrong judgments, or not notice some key actions.
"The Deprivation Talisman can steal three Beyonder abilities from the target, stealing in the order of the most recently used ability, going back in sequence.
"Here is one Fate Siphon Talisman, one Deception Talisman, and two Deprivation Talismans. The activation incantation is 'Steal' in Ancient Hermes."
Hobert put away these four talismans that looked like black crystal cards: "They are all quite strong."
With these talismans, dealing with the "Frenzied Mage" in Foggy Town is not a big problem.
But the specific information about Foggy Town cannot be told to Klein for the time being.
Klein is also very cautious about this kind of action, and only at this time did he reveal all his plans.
Then Hobert turned into a small pool of flesh and blood and hid in Klein's pocket.
Klein used "Travel" to come to the dark place on Phelps Street where St. Samuel Cathedral is located. After waiting for a while, a group of believers who participated in the evening mass came out of the church.
Soon, several servants walked out of the church with various cleaning tools and began to clean the street in front of the church, mainly cleaning the manure from the carriage parking spots.
Today, Backlund rarely has no mist. The scarlet moonlight shines on the earth. The red moon seems to be watching everything that happens on the street.
Klein found a servant walking at the back, used the power of "Wraith" to possess the other party, then controlled him to slowly walk into the corner, let him drink a sleeping potion, and settled him down.
Then Klein transformed into the appearance of this servant, carefully swept horse manure for more than ten minutes, followed the servant back to the church, and successfully moved into the servants' dormitory.
Before long, the servants fell into a deep sleep, and Hobert came out of Klein's pocket to rest.
Although the negative effects of "1-109" are relatively easy for Hobert to avoid, if there is a chance, he still needs to rest to keep himself in the best condition.
One person lay on the bed, and one person stood on the ground, both waiting very quietly.
Until dawn came, Hobert once again burrowed into Klein's pocket. Klein first used the "Paper Angel" blessed by the "Gray Fog" ability to interfere, in order to avoid Archbishop Anthony's spirituality, and relying on the "Queen Mystic" help, the erosion aura of "Wraith" interfered with the sealing core at the bottom of the church.
In this way, they came silently to the place where the guardians closer to the core area lived, and once again used the potion to make a sparse-haired guardian fall asleep.
Klein transformed into the appearance of the guardian, ate all the white bread on the table in front of the window, drank a glass of water, and vividly imitated the way he walked, seemingly struggling to get to the underground area.
As soon as he arrived in the corridor of the underground area, Klein almost didn't control his emotions, because he saw Leonard, with black hair and green eyes, outstanding appearance, but a somewhat casual temperament, walking towards him.
Klein knew that a Marauder pathway angel was parasitized in the body of the poet student, but at this time he could only bite the bullet and move forward, hoping that the poet student was afraid of exposing his own secrets and pretended not to know.
While moving forward, Klein quickly thought that it was the Marauder pathway angel who could detect his specialness, not Leonard.
He quietly breathed a sigh of relief: Then the possibility of the other party exposing me is very small, after all, he also has a lot of problems, and he is not an angel who believes in the Evernight Goddess, once he exposes me, he will also be at risk of exposure, there is no need to take this risk at all.
Soon the two approached, nodded slightly to each other, and pointed their right index and middle fingers clockwise four times on their chests, as if drawing a round moon.
Then one inward and one outward, brushed past each other.
Klein silently breathed a sigh of relief, the Marauder Angel really pretended not to see anything, and didn't even remind Leonard.
Cautiously walking in the underground passage for more than a minute, Klein finally came to a cold door.
He was very clear about the handover process between the Nighthawks and the guardians, knocked on the door of the guard room outside the door, and opened the Chanis Gate under the witness of the rotating Nighthawks.
Inside the door, the deep darkness surged immediately. Klein felt as if there were invisible tentacles scraping his skin in the darkness, penetrating into his body, and linking with the eroded "Wraith".
Klein tried to make his expression indifferent and entered the door, closing the Chanis Gate.
He took the horse lamp from the side and lit it, patiently waiting in front of the door for a while, so as not to have a Nighthawk come early to collect or return something.
According to his experience, as long as the internal guardian is not disturbed by the Nighthawks for five minutes after entering the Chanis Gate, then the Chanis Gate will be opened again when an Beyonder case occurs that day and a Sealed Artifact needs to be used.
He spent five minutes in incomparable torment, Klein finally started moving forward again, walking towards the stairs leading to the second floor.
After passing the rooms where various Beyonder materials, potion formulas, and secret knowledge were stored, and where heretics or wild Beyonders were imprisoned, Klein stepped steadily into the underground.
This is an area separated by steel, brick, or silver. The doors of these areas are closed, only the door of the armor soaked in the steel bathtub is open.
Passing this Sealed Artifact, Klein's spirituality seemed to be guided. He turned a corner and saw a stone room with a bookshelf made of bones, with only an ancient notebook with a hard cover placed on it.
It is the Antigonus family notebook!
According to the agreement with Hobert, he will get this notebook first, and then look for the clues of the saint who disappeared in the Backlund smog incident together.
Things went smoothly, but Klein still didn't have the slightest carelessness and recklessness, carefully entered the room, and was about to reach out to take the notebook.
Pa~
Just then, the sound of the door opening suddenly sounded outside, as if someone had walked over.
Klein's pupils dilated. While lunging towards the bone bookshelf, letting the marionette grab the Antigonus family notebook, he reached into his pocket and pulled Hobert out, hoping that this demigod could temporarily withstand the crisis behind.
Hobert originally thought he could take a "ride" directly into Foggy Town, but he didn't expect Klein to prepare to resist.
Leaving the cover of the "Wraith" marionette, he had to "distort" the illusory tentacles in the darkness, so that the sealing core would not notice him for the time being.
At this moment, he saw a figure wearing a hood and a classical robe standing outside the door. She had a beautiful face but no expression, and her eyes were deep but lacked spirituality.
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth: People are already standing there, what's the point of resisting! Get ready to pose and go straight to Foggy Town!
So Hobert reached back with his hand, preparing to pull Klein away together.
But he found that he had grabbed nothing. Looking at the corner of his eye, Klein had disappeared, and the Antigonus family diary was still placed on the bone bookshelf.
Hobert looked at his hands and feet again, and then he realized: Why don't you let me disappear yet? If Klein goes to Foggy Town and I don't go, that would be embarrassing.
But then, Hobert felt that he would definitely be sent to Foggy Town, after all, the Black Hound spirit beast was still inside, and the Solomon family's "Frenzied Mage" should also be inside.
Without Hobert's help, it is almost impossible for Klein to walk out of the town by himself.
So, Hobert looked towards the figure outside the door, his eyes seemingly saying: Come on, what are you waiting for?
A smile suddenly flashed across the other person's handsome face, and then he pointed at Hobert with his index finger. Hobert's spirituality sensed something, as if something had changed within him, but he couldn't quite put his finger on what it was.
Fortunately, in the next second, Hobert was erased like a pencil drawing rubbed out by an eraser, quickly vanishing.
Hobert's vision went black at first, as if he had entered a deep, dreamless sleep. He didn't know how long passed before the darkness before his eyes suddenly shifted, and a cold wind blew over him.
He struggled to open his eyes and saw that he was in a cornfield, with a mist above him. The scarlet moon was hidden within it, appearing and disappearing intermittently.
Hobert quickly regained his thoughts: A cornfield? I don't remember any cornfield?
Immediately afterward, Hobert realized that these corn stalks were not normal. They were all turning their leaves, as if turning around to "look" at Hobert.
