chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 576 Zaratul in the Church
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the cornfield, a creature, black all over, resembling both a rat and a rabbit, was gnawing at the roots of the corn stalks.
Perhaps it was too engrossed in its gnawing, as it didn't notice a corn stalk behind it quietly bending low.
Just as the creature was about to bite through the corn stalk's root, it suddenly raised its head, finally realizing the danger!
But it discovered it too late. The bent-low corn stalk abruptly opened its corn fruit, which was as large as two adult palms. Its red tassels resembled the proboscis of a blood-sucking creature, and the enveloping leaves were like thin membranes. When fully opened, there were no corn kernels inside, only a monstrous mouth full of backward-pointing teeth.
This "corn fruit" lunged down, swallowing the rat-like creature in one bite.
The creature struggled violently inside the "corn fruit," but soon, it became still.
Hobert realized that these were not corn at all, but monsters disguised as corn!
What Hobert found strange was that after the corn "saw" him, they seemed to regard him as some kind of monster, and they all tilted away, trying to avoid Hobert!
Hobert took a few steps forward, and the corn in front of him also moved away.
He smiled: "So shy, are you?"
After confirming that these corn plants were not aggressive, Hobert used "Distortion" to cover distance quickly. However, this cornfield seemed endless, and after several distortions, he still couldn't leave.
While advancing, he injected his spirituality into the "Order Crystal," searching for the trail of the Black Hound spirit beast!
Theoretically, as soon as he entered "Foggy Town," the Black Hound spirit beast should have been attracted by the "Order Crystal." Why hadn't that fellow appeared yet?
But soon, Hobert stopped, hearing a faint "rustling" sound in the distance, as if some monster was hiding in the cornfield. He extended his left hand and injected spirituality into "1-107": "Hiding is forbidden here!"
Whoosh!
All the corn to his left suddenly fell to either side. At the end of the cornfield, Hobert saw an old man who seemed weathered and worn. It was Ryan Salomon, who had disappeared during the Backlund smog event!
When the other party saw Hobert, the corners of his mouth stretched back, suddenly revealing a grim smile: "Frenzy!"
Hobert was already prepared and immediately activated the "Order Crystal's" shield!
However, even when the other party was still hiding behind the corn, the characteristics he emitted had already begun to affect Hobert, causing a series of crazy thoughts to burst into Hobert's mind, making it difficult to form a complete train of thought.
It was hard to imagine how serious the consequences would be if he were hit head-on by the other party's "Frenzy."
Then, Hobert realized that his spiritual warning and perception had failed here.
Hobert and the "Frenzied Mage" Ryan were at least one or two kilometers apart, but the other party arrived in front of Hobert with a single "Distortion."
Hobert, recovering from the slight "Frenzy" state, discovered that the eyes of this "Frenzied Mage" flickered with a crazy brilliance.
Clang~
He raised his hand, without seeing any force applied, nor touching the barrier, but the barrier made a soft sound, as if it had been struck by a heavy blow.
Perhaps because the barrier was unharmed, Ryan's crazed gaze seemed to regain some rationality.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert poured his spirituality into "1-109." Releasing the barrier, he threw a punch: "Slaughter!"
Ryan, who was regaining his sanity, was sent flying by the punch. Hobert felt that he had broken several of the other party's ribs, causing a depression in his chest: "Magnify!"
While amplifying the serious injury into a fatal one, he raised his left hand again: "Exile!"
A glimmer of intelligence finally began to Blink in Ryan's eyes: "Distortion!"
He "Distorted" the concept of himself and a corn stalk, and the corn stalk was "Exiled" several kilometers away.
Hobert was somewhat surprised: A Sequence 3 level "Distortion" can even distort the target of "Exile?"
All along, he had felt that some of the "Justiciar's" abilities were unavoidable for the target. Only now did he realize that the reason he had this understanding was simply because he had not encountered a strong enough enemy.
Of course, this was also related to the fact that Hobert was one level lower than Ryan and was using a Sealed Artifact. If a "Chaos Hunter" had used "Exile," the "Frenzied Mage" might not have been able to distort it.
Ryan looked at Hobert, a sneer flashing across his face: "Bestow!"
Hobert's entire chest suddenly collapsed, and his heart and lungs felt like they were about to be crushed by some force!
He spat out a mouthful of blood, realizing that this "Frenzied Mage" could "Bestow" all of his injuries onto himself.
Hobert gritted his teeth and threw out a "Deprivation Amulet": "Steal!"
Ryan's three abilities, "Bestow," "Distortion," and "Frenzy," were deprived, which made him somewhat dazed for a moment.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert immediately fled, while "Bestowing" most of his injuries to a nearby corn stalk!
The corn stalk immediately exploded into a pile of minced meat!
Unfortunately, the "Deprivation Amulet" only stole the other party's abilities, preventing them from using them for three hours. Hobert could not use these abilities himself.
Therefore, Hobert could only use the Sequence 4 level "Distortion" of space to flee quickly.
Fortunately, Ryan's "Distortion" ability had been deprived; otherwise, the other party could have caught up with Hobert in an instant.
However, the range of the other party's abilities was also very large. He raised his hand, just about to unleash a new ability towards Hobert. Hobert had been paying attention to this all along, and at this time, he immediately injected his spirituality into "1-107": "Deprive!"
The "Arrogance" that Ryan was about to use was also immediately briefly deprived. This was "Deprivation," which could prevent the target from using that ability for three minutes.
Taking advantage of this gap, Hobert finally escaped the cornfield.
Although still within the attack range of the "Frenzied Mage," Hobert now had a certain amount of reaction time because of the distance between the two.
Moreover, Hobert discovered that the Frenzied Mage did not chase after him but instead went to the corn near the battlefield just now, to lick the blood that Hobert had spat out onto the corn leaves.
Alarmed, Hobert finally saw the town in the mist.
The most conspicuous building in this town was a steeple church with a very ancient style. It was black all over, without a bell tower, and black crows circled and lingered at the top.
Many buildings were scattered around the church, including ordinary two-story houses, simple wooden houses, and bakeries with hanging signs.
Hobert found Klein lying on the ground near the bakery, coughing and struggling, as well as the "Wraith" puppet being devoured.
Devouring the puppet was a woman wearing a plain white robe. She looked holy, dignified, and her appearance was bright and radiant.
She elegantly dug out the "puppet's" heart and bit off a large chunk, half of her face covered in blood.
This was Panatiya, the "Demoness of Despair," who had also been "captured" into the town during the Backlund smog event!
In this scene, she looked very much like a fallen saint.
After Panatiya saw Hobert, she distorted off one of the puppet's arms and threw it to Hobert, grinning with a mouth full of blood: "'Frenzied Mage' sir, please, I don't mean to eat alone."
Hobert was stunned: This lady has mental problems, actually mistaking me for that "Frenzied Mage"!
But then he realized something was wrong and immediately injected spirituality into "1-109." Two pillars of fire appeared from behind him, turning into dozens of fire crows.
Sure enough, the surroundings were already covered with black hair, surrounding Hobert.
Hobert immediately directed the fire crows to burn the hair!
At this time, several ice arrows had appeared in front of Panatiya, shooting fiercely towards Hobert.
As Hobert had expected, Panatiya's mental state was indeed not good, but not so bad that she would mistake people.
The reason she said that just now was to make Hobert think that her mental state had already developed some problems, and then find an opportunity to attack.
"Disorder!" Hobert dodged the ice arrows, then snapped his fingers.
Boom~
The flesh and blood bomb of "1-109" caused Klein's puppet to explode, scattering flesh and blood all over the ground.
Hobert let two fire crows hover around him and said to Panatiya, who was rushing towards him: "I have no intention of disturbing your meal, just here to rescue my companion."
Panatiya stopped, looking with some regret at the flesh and blood all over the ground. She hadn't had time to enjoy it properly, and it had turned into minced meat.
Hobert added: "You eat in peace, we'll leave now, otherwise, I'll burn this flesh and blood into charcoal."
Panatiya did not answer, but squatted down with a wary look, picking up the flesh and blood on the ground.
Hobert also carried Klein, about to find a place to rest first.
Suddenly, the three people present all looked towards the sky.
The red moon had penetrated the mist, clearly illuminating the town.
Panatiya showed a look of horror. Her hair grew longer, like tentacles, picking up the flesh and blood within her range, and rushed into a nearby house.
Hobert also quickly carried Klein into the house and immediately locked the door.
It was temporarily safe in the house. Hobert and Klein each found a chair to sit down. Although Hobert had "Bestowed" most of his injuries, the remaining small portion was also a very serious injury.
After all, that was the attack effect of "Slaughter" + "Magnify."
He suddenly thought that if the "Frenzied Mage" were to fight someone, he could give himself a brick to the head and then "bestow" all the injuries to the enemy.
If two "Frenzied Mages" were fighting, it would be even more exciting. This one "bestowed" the injuries to that one, and that one "bestowed" them back. They could fight like this until the end of time.
And Klein wasn't doing much better. He lost his Marionette right away, and accidentally saw Panatiya's incomplete Mythical Creature form, so his spirit was severely impacted. Then he encountered a demigod-level "disease" attack.
If Panatiya hadn't wanted to save some fresh "ingredients," Klein probably wouldn't have lasted until Hobert arrived.
Hobert injected his spirituality into the "Fork of Healing," using it twice in a row, and his injuries were only half healed.
Ever since Aipuli reminded Hobert to keep the Beyonder characteristics in the "Fork of Healing" safe, he had been carrying this mystical item with him.
Then Hobert treated Klein, but could only heal the diseases on his body. The mental shock Klein suffered could only be recovered by himself through meditation.
Fortunately, Klein's many "daredevil experiences" had made his spiritual body's self-healing ability very good.
The two of them quietly gasped for a while before each told their experiences just now.
Unlike Hobert, Klein appeared in a bean field, where countless bean pods opened their mouths and tore at Klein. It took him a lot of effort to get rid of that bean field.
His pants were also basically torn to shreds, but fortunately he wasn't hurt.
Afterwards, Klein, who had entered the town first, encountered the "Demoness of Despair."
After Hobert finished talking about his experience, a thought appeared in his mind: He was no match for the "Frenzied Mage" at all! Fortunately, the other party had a tendency to be crazy. If he had silently "gifted" his own madness to me from the beginning, I might already be dead.
He sighed, "If I didn't have the talisman, I might have died in that cornfield."
Klein also sighed, "Today I finally understand the power of a demigod. I didn't even have a chance to use the talisman."
Or rather, even if he used the "Deprivation Charm," he would not be a match for that "Demoness of Despair."
Hobert looked out the window for a while and said, "I have some information about this town here. In some documents, it's called 'Foggy Town'.
"The specific source is unclear, only that it is related to the 'Concealment' authority."
Klein nodded and said, "I just divined that this is a dangerous source of the Sonia Sea's eastern Divine ruins at night."
He further explained, "After entering the ruins, when night falls, if anyone doesn't sleep, when dawn comes, they will find that they have disappeared silently.
"Once, because of an accident, I woke up from a dream and saw such a mysterious and strange Foggy Town in the distance of the sea."
Hobert pondered for a moment and said, "According to the information we traded before about that mural, this makes sense."
Before, they had traded information about the fall of the Sun God, which mentioned the battle between the "Rose Redemption" and the ancient Sun God.
The Evernight Goddess also participated in the war at that time, and it is normal to leave some power about "Concealment" in the ruins of the God War.
The two people looked at each other, but they didn't say the specific content of the information they exchanged, or how it "made sense."
They thought of going together to avoid eavesdropping.
But no matter what, Klein could be sure that the creatures who disappeared at night in the ruins were all sent here.
Because they were not directly obliterated, the divination results for them were that they were still alive. At the same time, because of the interference of "Concealment," it was impossible to know their whereabouts.
He also thought: This place is closely related to "Night." Could it be a "prison" personally created by the Goddess? It's possible. She is the 'Mother of Concealment' and should be able to directly transform people and things into a "Concealed" state!
Thinking of this, Klein said again: "The scenes in this town have many similarities with the ancient ruins on the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains.
"I just saw that there was half-eaten white bread, a glass of red wine, and messy silver knives and forks on the table in the room.
"It looks like someone was enjoying dinner, but suddenly evaporated!
"I have read relevant documents before. In the ancient ruins on the Hornacis Mountains, the furnishings and decorations are well preserved. Some tables are still filled with many plates, and there are traces of dry rot in the plates. In some rooms, there are also half bottles of wine that have almost turned into clear water."
This was his doubt. At the same time, if this place was related to that ruin, there might be other dangers.
Hobert thought for a while and said, "This reminds me of a piece of information I forgot where I saw it. The kingdom on the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains is likely to be the divine kingdom established by Antigonus and his sister."
Klein was slightly stunned: "Antigonus's sister?"
The King of Angels also has a sister?
It's not that they can't have sisters, but these great figures in the ancient mystical world have experienced a long time after becoming angels, and their families may have already passed away.
Moreover, Klein heard about the information about Antigonus's sister for the first time.
"Yes." Hobert said, "She is called the 'Mother of the Sky,' and their kingdom is called the 'Nation of the Evernight.'"
Klein was stunned: "Mother of the Sky? Nation of the Evernight?"
The title "Mother of the Sky" sounds like she won't live past three episodes.
As for the "Nation of the Evernight," Klein had heard of it before. If Antigonus's sister's title was "Mother Concealment," then it is very likely to be the Evernight Goddess.
He also recalled that in a free exchange session of a Tarot meeting, the "Hanged Man" mentioned that the "Nation of the Evernight" was destroyed by the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
Klein speculated that this should be a war of national extermination launched by the Church of the Evernight Goddess for the Beyonder characteristics of the "Nation of the Evernight."
Hobert looked at the figures moving outside the curtains: "Before the action, the 'Creator' gave a hint: The church is the key!"
Klein was slightly stunned: "Just now, that 'Demoness of Despair' said that the church is very dangerous!
"Of course, it may also be her lie, but I personally think it's the truth."
The reason is very simple, who would tell such a bizarre lie to "food"? Moreover, in general, the ability of "instigation" needs to be supported by some real information.
"It may be very dangerous for her." Hobert said, "Have you ever thought that if this place is related to the ruins on the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains, then the danger we encounter may come from 'Concealment,' but also from the high sequence of the 'Seer' pathway?"
Klein understood: "You mean, in that church, there is danger from the 'Seer' aspect?"
Then he asked and answered himself: "It's very possible. These foods on the table actually have spirit body threads.
"Just now, I was wondering why this was the case. After you reminded me, I realized that maybe when the 'Seer' pathway reaches the high-sequence Beyonder, the Spirit Body Thread can appear on some inanimate objects."
Finally, he smiled helplessly: "Isn't there a high-sequence of the 'Seer' pathway guarding the exit in that church?"
"That's too extravagant!" Hobert sighed, "Not to mention angels, even Sequence 3 is a member of the God's Council in the real world, the bishop of the region.
"If it is in a secret organization, then it may be the leader."
He "guessed": "There may be an arrangement like a Sealed Artifact there."
Klein nodded, which made more sense.
"After the state of the Crimson Moon ends, we have to risk exploring that church." Hobert said again, "Now let's summarize our enemies."
Klein also agreed with Hobert's suggestion. The most likely way out was hidden there. He said, "The 'Demoness of Despair' just now is the one who created the Backlund smog."
"I know." Hobert smiled helplessly: "I was almost killed by her before."
Klein was slightly stunned, recalling his experience just now, and thinking that Hobert was also a Sequence 5 during the Backlund smog incident.
At this time, he deeply realized that what Hobert said was just stating the facts, not describing anything.
"There is also Mr. A from the Aurora Order, who is a 'Shepherd'." Klein said, "As far as I know, he should have also come to this Foggy Town."
To be precise, Mr. A disappeared in front of Klein.
Hobert nodded: "If it's a 'Shepherd,' he can indeed survive in such an environment for a long time."
Moreover, his condition may be better than the "Demoness of Despair" and the "Frenzied Mage," after all, he can "eat himself" when he is extremely hungry.
Then Hobert said: "The saint who disappeared from our side during the smog incident that I have been looking for should also be in this town.
"But his condition has not been very good. His level of wisdom in some aspects is not very high. Maybe he has been tricked into the church by the enemy.
"However, the other party should not die here, because he was once a guard of Death and has received the 'blessing' of Death. It is difficult for ordinary sealed items to control him."
To be precise, he is already dead, how can he die again?
However, Hobert was not sure whether the Black Hound Spirit Beast still had a "Spirit Body Thread."
Klein was slightly stunned: The guard of Death? This saint seems to have a lot of stories!
Hobert continued, "Also, there's that 'Frenzied Mage' I mentioned earlier. He's a descendant of the Solomon family and possesses a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
The cornfield where I appeared, and the soybean field where you appeared, were probably created by that Sealed Artifact.
But that's a Sealed Artifact from the 'Apothecary' pathway, not the 'Planter' pathway, so the crops that grow are all monsters. In this town's special environment, eating those crops might kill you faster!"
He thought for a moment and added, "However, the 'Frenzied Mage' didn't use that Sealed Artifact just now, and our Saint didn't appear either.
Could it be that the Sealed Artifact was taken by our Saint?"
It's not impossible. If that's the case, I wonder if the Black Hound spirit beast has undergone some kind of mutation.
Finally, Hobert concluded, "After exploring the church, it's best if we can confirm the state of our Saint and prioritize meeting up with him. That's the only way we'll have a chance of winning."
Originally, his plan was for the Black Hound spirit beast to entangle the 'Frenzied Mage' while he seized the opportunity to take out the 'Demoness of Despair,' and Klein would take out Mr. A.
Before the action, Hobert had specifically confirmed that he could still sense the Black Hound spirit beast's existence using the 'Order of Power' from the 'Nation of Disorder.'
In other words, after so much time, the 'Order of Power' within it hasn't disappeared, and it can still follow Hobert's commands.
Hobert guessed that the closed environment of Foggy Town might have prevented the 'Order of Power' on it from completely dissipating.
But the problem now is that we haven't seen the Black Hound spirit beast after being in Foggy Town for so long!
Klein also agreed with Hobert's simple plan. They wouldn't be able to defeat those three enemies with just the two of them.
The next question is, how do we approach the church?
The connection to the Spirit World is severed here, so 'Travel' and 'Blink' can't be used.
Hobert also faces a huge risk in using the method of 'Distorting' distance to pass through walls. Similarly, because the connection to the Spirit World is severed, their spirituality isn't very sensitive. If they accidentally 'Distort' into the street outside, they'll be in trouble.
Fortunately, Klein's Sealed Artifact with the 'Travel' ability also has the ability to 'Open Doors.'
They can observe the situation on the other side of the wall through that illusory door and then decide whether to pass through the door.
So, the two of them cautiously moved towards the church little by little through the illusory 'door.'
When passing through the third room, Hobert looked at the shadows in the corner and immediately raised his hand: "Arrogance!"
The shadow suddenly became like a pool of black liquid, flowing to the side to avoid Hobert's attack.
"Exploit!" Hobert prematurely ended the opponent's "Shadow Transformation" state.
A figure rolled out from the "liquid," his expression a mixture of madness and fear. It was Mr. A, who had become very thin.
Just as Hobert was about to continue attacking, Mr. A took the opportunity to smash through a wall and hide in the room Hobert and Klein had just come from.
Boom!
The sound of the wall being smashed was loud, and the whispers on the street outside instantly disappeared. They all seemed to turn their heads and look at the room where Hobert and Klein were.
Klein quickly "Opened the Door," and the two entered the next room closer to the church and waited quietly for a few minutes.
The gazes outside gradually shifted away, and the whispers gradually returned.
The two breathed a sigh of relief at the same time.
Hobert smiled and whispered, "This guy really survived!"
At this time, the whispers outside gradually diminished. The two seemed to sense something and vaguely saw the crimson moon re-entering the mist through the windows and curtains.
Hobert said, "Quick, let's go!"
Klein immediately opened the door in front and reached the room closest to the church when the whispers disappeared.
Hobert and Klein suddenly felt crazy thoughts appearing in their minds, such as going out to catch the 'Demoness of Despair' and playing a "game" together.
For example, catching Mr. A just now and tasting his flesh and blood.
At the same time, they felt that their movements were very uncoordinated. They clearly wanted to raise their hands but turned around, clearly wanted to move forward but stood still.
After experiencing the cornfield, Hobert knew that this was a range attack of 'Frenzy.' The 'Frenzied Mage' seemed to have regained a lot of sanity.
But fortunately, his spirituality was also affected, and he couldn't determine the specific location of Hobert and Klein, so he could only use this range attack.
As for why he could use the Beyonder abilities stolen by the 'Deprivation Charm' in advance, it was not difficult to explain. It should be that after Hobert escaped, the 'Frenzied Mage' used the ability of 'Exploit' to prematurely end the state of being deprived of abilities.
The level of the 'Deprivation Charm' is probably higher than Sequence 3, but not quite to the level of Sequence 2. There is no time to recover the 'deprived' abilities during the battle, but after the battle, the 'Frenzied Mage' will have a lot of room to maneuver.
"Distort!" Hobert "Distorted" the negative influence on himself, grabbed Klein's shoulder, and then quickly passed the distance between the room and the church by continuously "Distorting" the distance.
The two stood in front of the church and glanced back.
The 'Demoness of Despair,' Panatiya, was rapidly chasing after them using mirror jumps, while the 'Frenzied Mage' stood far away on the roof, watching Hobert and Klein's actions.
The 'Frenzied Mage' at this time gave people the feeling that he was not as crazy as before, and the two of them seemed to have joined forces.
Hobert glanced at them and, for the last time, "Distorted" the distance, entering the church with Klein.
Panatiya jumped out of the glass, quietly watching the two enter the church, and gradually revealed a look of fear.
Inside the church, the 'Frenzy' state on Hobert and Klein quickly disappeared. They quickly regained their vision in the dim environment and saw figure after figure hanging in the air within their sight.
They were all humans, some wearing black classical robes, some wearing brown jackets, some wearing fluffy skirts, and some with tattered clothes like beggars.
They were all hanging from high places like smoked meat being dried, their heads hanging down, swaying.
This immediately reminded Hobert of some ghost stories about "hanged ghosts," but he couldn't see the ropes hanging them.
Whoosh~
A cold wind blew in the church, and the corpses hanging in the air simultaneously turned to Hobert and Klein.
"Disorder!" Hobert raised a hand.
The corpses seemed to immediately lose direction, some turning to the left, some turning to the right, in short, no longer looking at the two intruders.
Hobert noticed Klein's gaze and explained with a smile, "It's creepy when these guys look over together!"
If it were before, Hobert wouldn't have acted casually, lest he wake up some unknown power.
But recently, Hobert has noticed that breaking the inherent rules, or breaking some conventions, such as being reckless when you should be cautious, can make his spirituality more lively.
Of course, such "breaking" is done with a certain degree of certainty. For example, Hobert would not do suicidal things like going out to find the 'Frenzied Mage' to fight.
The two observed the figures for a while. Fortunately, they were all humans, and Hobert didn't find the shadow of the Black Hound spirit beast among them.
"Spirit Body Threads!" Klein suddenly said in surprise!
Hobert quickly hid behind Klein. He remembered that the 'Spirit Body Threads' would become a bit strange here, and his current spirituality was not as sensitive as it was outside. He also didn't know if there was any danger from the 'Spirit Body Threads' at the moment? .
Klein explained again, "Their 'Spirit Body Threads' are extremely special, and they all converge at the top of the church. It turns out they are suspended by 'Spirit Body Threads.'"
Hobert asked, "What danger does it pose to us?"
"Our 'Spirit Body Threads' are like metal encountering a magnet, uncontrollably drifting upwards," Klein said. "Don't resist. I'll pull your 'Spirit Body Thread' back."
Hobert immediately felt that his movements were somewhat stiff. He did not resist as Klein said.
Klein added, "Our 'Spirit Body Threads' still have a tendency to float upwards, and we must constantly resist it."
Hobert nodded: "No wonder this church is full of danger for the 'Demoness of Despair' and Mr. A. Even if the 'Frenzied Mage' comes in, it will be difficult to accurately 'Distort' his 'Spirit Body Thread.'"
Klein asked in disbelief, "The 'Frenzied Mage' can even 'Distort' 'Spirit Body Threads'?"
Klein had always felt that 'Spirit Body Threads' could only be seen by Beyonders of the 'Seer' pathway and should be a unique ability of this pathway.
"I can do that too," Hobert casually explained. "It's just a 'conceptual' application of 'Distortion,' but the 'Distortion' is not so precise, and it's still very dangerous in this environment."
Because he can't see the 'Spirit Body Threads,' maybe the 'Distortion' direction is wrong and he will get closer to the source of danger and be hung up instantly.
Then, the two looked together at the interior of the church. In the depths of the church, there seemed to be an altar.
The two walked forward step by step, trying to ignore the swaying figures above their heads that seemed to be looking down at them.
After walking twenty or thirty meters, the two came to the altar and saw a stone statue standing on the altar. It generally presented a female human image, but two animal legs grew from the ribs and waist, covered with short, thick, hard black hair.
Beneath the stone statue, souls slumbered.
Taking a few more steps forward and clearly seeing its face, Klein's gaze froze.
Because the statue had a delicate and beautiful face, the very same one who had brought them to the Misty Town.
Hobert's expression also became solemn, not because he was surprised by the other party's appearance, but because he felt that the four beast legs were really ruining the overall image.
He couldn't help but think: Is the real image of the Evernight Goddess similar to this? One leg ruins everything.
Then he saw a figure diagonally behind the statue, so he gestured to Klein and went around the statue.
They saw an old man in a black robe sitting behind the statue. He was wearing a hood, his head was lowered, his eyes were tightly closed, and the white beard around his mouth was long and dense, as if it hadn't been trimmed for decades.
Klein whispered to Hobert, "There's something wrong with his 'spirit body threads'."
The old man's 'spirit body threads' actually stretched out from his body and then returned to the point where they came from.
Hobert thought to himself: He should be referred to as "Him."
He took a step forward: "Old sir!"
Klein felt that Hobert's actions were a little reckless, but on second thought, the old man's condition was so strange, if he wanted to harm them, he would have done so long ago, and wouldn't have waited until now.
The old man opened his eyes, looked Hobert up and down, and finally his gaze fell on Klein behind him: "Finally, another 'Seer' has come here."
Klein thought to himself: Why say 'another'?
The hooded old man said: "In the Beyonder world, having a trustworthy partner is a very rare thing."
What he was talking about was Hobert's willingness to let Klein manipulate his 'spirit body threads'.
Just now, the two of them hadn't paid much attention to this. After the old man said this, Hobert realized that in this world, there wouldn't be more than five people he could trust so much, and Klein was one of them.
Even if Audrey had the ability to manipulate 'spirit body threads', Hobert wouldn't be so relieved. He knew that although Audrey wouldn't harm him, her condition was sometimes not very good, making it difficult to be completely at ease.
Klein had a similar feeling. Just now, he asked Hobert not to resist his manipulation of the 'spirit body threads', and he really didn't resist.
Is it just because they once fought side by side? Klein suddenly thought of this question.
The white-bearded old man said again: "Do you want to escape from here? I can tell you how."
Klein was not moved: "Then why are you still staying here?"
The old man lowered his head and chuckled: "Because I am already dead."
Klein only felt a chill run down his back and quietly took a step back.
Hobert smiled: "I almost thought you were a Beyonder of the 'Death' pathway."
The old man slowly raised his head, glanced at Hobert, and then slowly said: "I used a special Beyonder power to find a gap in the world's history and destiny, cut out my own image, and fixed it here, maintaining it until now.
"As for my body and my spirit, they have already completely died."
Klein sighed in his heart: What an incredible ability.
But he had no way of confirming whether it was true or false: "Then why do you want to guide us on how to escape?"
The old man's long beard trembled slightly: "After you open the door, the history and destiny here will change, and this image that I cut out will also disappear with it.
"When that time comes, you will see an urn of ashes. I only hope that it can be scattered into the Serenzo River near the Intis capital, Trier, which is my hometown."
Hobert really wanted to ask: How did your ashes get here?
But he realized that he wouldn't get a real answer, so he turned to ask: "Do You know Emperor Roselle?"
The old man's expression suddenly became solemn.
Klein also noticed that Hobert had used "You" again.
Hobert spread his hands: "It's not hard to guess. Born in Trier, a Beyonder of the 'Seer' pathway, must be a member of the Secret Order.
"And I happen to know that Emperor Roselle had cooperated with the Secret Order."
The old man's expression gradually became kind again: "What a clever young man."
"I want to confirm one thing," Hobert said, "After Emperor Roselle fell, did he release the Beyonder characteristic of 'Knowledge Emperor'? Is that Beyonder characteristic in the hands of the God of Steam and Machinery?"
The old man was silent again.
Klein, thinking of some of the information and diary entries he had traded before, was also very interested in this question.
After a few seconds, the old man smiled and said: "I don't have any relevant memories. Maybe I don't know, or as a historical projection, I don't know this history.
"But theoretically speaking, it is possible to release a Beyonder characteristic of 'Knowledge Emperor', and it is most likely to fall into the hands of the God of Steam and Machinery."
Then he asked: "Where did you learn about these secrets? As far as I know, very few people know about this, maybe you can count them on one hand. Has the current world announced the real cause of Roselle's death?"
Klein thought to himself: Now you can't count them on one hand anymore, at least all the members of the Tarot Club already know. Of course, if this old man had more than a dozen fingers on one hand in his lifetime, then that's another matter.
Hobert only vaguely said: "I am a Beyonder of the 'Lawyer' pathway."
The hooded old man was not satisfied with this answer. He pondered for a moment and asked again: "Is the outside world going to have a new 'Black Emperor'?"
Hobert smiled: "You're already a dead man, so don't worry about that."
Klein turned his head to look at the corpse hanging from the top of the church and barely managed not to laugh: If it weren't for the Beyonder world, Hobert's actions would obviously be very unethical, disrespectful to the elderly, and disrespectful to the dead!

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 577: The Battle of Demigods in the Foggy Town
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The white-bearded old man didn't expect Hobert to be so shameless. He had answered Hobert's question seriously, but Hobert answered his question in this way.
However, the old man was not angry, just smiling and said: "It's been a long time since I've met a young man as thick-skinned as you."
Klein thought to himself: It's been a long time since you've met one? Could the last one this thick-skinned have been Roselle?
"Alright, let's not waste any more time," the old man said. "Before the Crimson Moon arrives again, I'll tell you how to leave here."
He seemed to weakly raise his hand and point forward: "Do you see the wall over there? Is there an indentation on it?"
Hobert and Klein had already seen that there were ancient symbols on the wall, but there was a blank space in the middle, so they couldn't form a complete pattern.
At this time, they looked carefully. The blank area was about the size of two palms, with an obvious inward indentation, as if the surface brick had been dug away.
"As long as you can find the corresponding obsidian and place it in the indented area, you can initially free this wall from the state of 'concealment'," the old man said slowly.
"When that time comes, I will tell you a complex special symbol, which is the key to opening the 'Gate of Escape'."
At this time, Hobert looked like he was listening attentively, but a symbol suddenly appeared in Klein's mind: a vertical eye composed of many secret symbols!
That was in Tingen City, when he was still a Nighthawk, the information that the Antigonus family's notebook passed to him through the infection of the "Misfortune Doll"!
Hobert asked, "Where is that obsidian?"
The old man chuckled: "In the hands of that 'Frenzied Mage'."
Hobert asked with a smile: "Old sir, do you have a way to advance to 'Frenzied Mage' in a short period of time?"
The old man was stunned: "No."
"Then we have no way to seize that obsidian!" Hobert said seriously.
Before, "Bull Devil Monarch" and the Black Hound spirit beast had fought against Sequence 3s. Hobert had never faced an enemy of this level. Before this, Hobert didn't have a specific concept of Sequence 3.
Only after fighting the "Frenzied Mage" today did Hobert realize the difference between Sequence 3 and Sequence 4.
When it comes to demigods, each advancement is a qualitative change.
It's just that advancing to Sequence 2 is a "big qualitative change", and advancing to Sequence 3 is a "small qualitative change".
Hobert had just thought about this question. At the "Frenzied Mage" sequence, he could completely use Beyonder abilities to "bomb" opponents of the same level, because even area-of-effect Beyonder abilities would have great offensive power.
Just like now, Hobert can also use "distortion" to attack enemies by distorting gravity, etc., but it is still effective against Sequence 5 and Sequence 6, but against Sequence 4s of the same level, it is better to use fists directly.
Because the physique and strength of the "Earl of the Fallen" are comparable to half a "Demon Hunter", most Sequence 4s of the pathway have to take Hobert's physical attacks seriously.
The key is that Hobert can physically attack while using Beyonder abilities, so that even if the opponent is hiding in the "shadows", or in a similar state, Hobert can injure the opponent.
Hobert guessed that at the level of "Frenzied Mage", he could obviously change the surrounding rules, and using Beyonder abilities would be more "cost-effective" than attacking directly.
These thoughts only flashed through his mind.
He only heard the hooded old man in front of him say: "The Black Hound spirit beast that has a close connection with you is sealed in a room inside the mill."
"I'll help this young man of the 'Seer' pathway a little bit. When that time comes, if the three of you fight three, you may not have a chance of winning."
He looked at Klein: "Um... when you came in, there was also a marionette?"
"Yes, but it has been eaten," Klein replied calmly.
The old man smiled: "I'll help you summon it from the history of this world."
As soon as he finished speaking, Klein saw a figure quickly outlined beside him, which was the "Wraith" that had been eaten before, and the "Spirit Body Threads" of the marionette was still controlled by Klein.
This made Klein's eyes suddenly focused. The ability shown by the old man was too strange.
Then the old man also strengthened the connection between Klein and the marionette, so that the marionette could also use Klein's abilities, and could instantly switch positions with the marionette.
He also used a paper figure to erase the mental trauma Klein had just received, as well as the mystical virus that "Healing" could not immediately cure.
This made Klein once again surprised by the old man's ability. He thought about it and finally asked: "Please forgive our rudeness just now. What should I call you?"
The old man smiled: "You can call me Zaratul."
At this moment, Klein's mind was filled with an echo of "F*ck", through the transaction with Hobert in the Tarot Club, through reading Roselle's diary, of course he knew who Zaratul was?
In the Fourth Epoch, there was a Zaratul who was at least at the Angel level, but He had already died in the "War of the Four Emperors".
In the era of Emperor Roselle, there was another Zaratul, who was already a Sequence 2 "Miracle Invoker" more than a hundred years ago, and was considered by the "Magic Mirror" Arrodes to be an angel who lost control and became a monster in the process of advancing to Sequence 1 "Attendant of Mysteries".
No matter which one, it was an angel.
However, he quickly thought that Zaratul was a surname, perhaps the old man in front of him was a member of the Zaratul family.
The old man who called himself Zaratul smiled and said to Klein: "Looking at your reaction, do you know me?"
Klein concealed: "I've heard of this surname."
Zaratul looked at Hobert again: "And you, young man, your reaction is too flat."
Hobert smiled and said: "My father has a friend whose surname is Zaratul. He should be your junior, but I don't know his name."
Zaratul nodded and asked: "What are his characteristics?"
"He's very punchable, but unfortunately I can't beat him," Hobert said seriously.
This seems to be a common trait of the Zaratul family members. At this time, Hobert also wanted to kill or influence this "projection", but this old man is at least at the Sequence 3 level, so he can't beat him.
Klein on the side thought: That should be a member of the Zaratul family. I remember that Roselle wanted to beat Zaratul several times, and even threatened to beat every "Seer" of the Zaratul family he met.
However, this topic did not continue. Hobert then asked: "How should I lift the seal on that Black Hound spirit beast?"
"I don't know," the old man Zaratul said: "The one who sealed it is a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact. I can only help when I get to the scene."
Hobert understood: "Did the 'Frenzied Mage' seal it?"
"Yes."
Hobert thought: This is interesting. To deal with the "Frenzied Mage", you must first lift the seal on the Black Hound spirit beast, and to lift the seal, you must first deal with the "Frenzied Mage".
But in this regard, Zaratul, this historical projection, obviously can't help much.
Zaratul asked at this time: "What other help do you need? Maybe I can provide some help in other areas."
Klein said at this time: "Can you summon a fish from the history of this secret world, a fish from the outside world? Even if it has become food."
"I can!" As soon as Zaratul finished speaking, the "Wraith" had a lump of crushed fish meat glued together in its hand.
Zaratul added: "It can only last for a quarter of an hour. When it's over, it's like you've never eaten it."
After Klein asked the marionette to put away the fish meat, he said again: "I also need the potion formula for 'Bizarro Sorcerer'."
Zaratul glanced at Klein, then at Hobert, and chuckled: "No problem. When you get back the obsidian, I will give you the formula along with the 'opening' symbol."
His expression just now seemed to be saying: No wonder you trust each other so much. It turns out that your faces are quite thick!
Hobert said: "Mr. Zaratul, it's fate that we can meet here. Why don't you give us the potion formula for 'Scholar of Yore' as well?
"After we go out, we will not only scatter your ashes in the river, but also erect a monument for you by the river, a gilded... no, a pure gold monument!"
Zaratul stared at Hobert for a full two seconds: "Let me consider it."
At this moment, the crimson moonlight shining in through the church window suddenly became clear and bright, causing the corpses hanging in mid-air to cast shadows.
The church suddenly became strange. Even if the two people's spirituality could not connect to the spirit world, they felt a strong danger signal.
Hobert immediately grabbed Klein's shoulder and "distorted" space twice to come to the outside of the church.
The moon in the sky gradually revealed itself, and both of them felt a dense gaze suddenly coming from behind.
Almost in an instant, Hobert used "distortion" to come to a room with Klein.
The feeling of being watched by many eyes immediately disappeared. Outside the closed curtains, figures began to appear, coming and going.
After the two breathed a sigh of relief, they began to discuss the next plan.
Hobert said: "After the red moon ends in a while, I'll see if I can use this fine sword in my hand, and the connection with the saint I'm looking for, to trick the 'Frenzied Mage' into temporarily lifting the seal.
"If the other party doesn't take the bait, we can only start cooperation with them on the pretext of leaving here."
Klein took out several mushrooms he carried with him: "These are some special mushrooms. If eaten normally, there will be no harm, but if they encounter fish meat, they will quickly begin to multiply, which will have amazing power."
Hobert smiled: "This is good stuff!"
Klein also said: "In a while, I'll put on a show and make them all eat a little."
The two of them exchanged a smile, as if their conspiracy had succeeded.
The crimson moon outside showed no signs of disappearing, and Klein continued, "Are you curious as to why I'm searching for the Sequence 4 potion formula?"
Then, he answered himself, "It's a test for me."
In Klein's view, this needed to be explained, otherwise, as a Blessed of Mr. Fool, searching for a potion formula seemingly from the same pathway as 'The Fool' would be quite illogical.
Hobert was slightly taken aback. Klein hadn't said it, and he hadn't even thought of that.
He then smiled, "I've encountered similar trials before."
It could only be said that it's best not to expose someone's shortcomings.
Klein secretly breathed a sigh of relief and asked, "Whose image does that statue depict?"
"It somewhat resembles the appearance of the 'Demonic Wolf,' from the 'Demonic Wolf Clan' ruled by the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' in the Second Epoch," Hobert explained simply. "Judging from the sleeping soul in front of the statue and its appearance, it's very likely to be the 'Mother of the Sky.'"
Hobert paused and added, "After we get out of here, I need to confirm it."
"If this news is true, then this is definitely a major discovery. The 'Mother of the Sky' is actually a descendant or of the same race as the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf'?"
The latter option was just Hobert indicating that he wasn't "entirely sure," and adding it as an aside.
"If you obtain definite information, I'd like to trade with you for information about the 'Mother of the Sky' and the 'Nation of the Evernight,' as well as Antigonus."
Hobert nodded, "Alright."
Then, Klein asked, "What conspiracy do you think Zaratul in the church has?"
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying, "I think his, or rather, His conspiracy might be in the real world, not directed at us.
"He might be using the characteristics of Foggy Town to achieve some purpose.
"But it's definitely not as simple as scattering his ashes in the river. I don't know if you've considered why his ashes appeared here?
"This is Foggy Town, not Zaratul's territory.
"If he died after coming to Foggy Town, that wouldn't make sense either. In that case, he would either become 'food' or jerky; it's impossible for him to turn into ashes."
Klein nodded, thinking that Hobert made a lot of sense.
Hobert added, "The potion formula he gave might be real, but I wonder if there's something strange about the 'door opening' symbol he provided?
"Perhaps the moment the door opens, his purpose will be achieved.
"More than that, we should be worried about where the door leads to?
"What if it opens to the Cathedral of Serenity? That would be interesting."
Hobert smiled, "Perhaps the Cathedral of Serenity is a relatively safe outcome."
At this moment, the moonlight outside faded, the whispers gradually diminished, and the shadows gradually disappeared.
The two of them took a deep breath; what had to come, had come.
Klein had his marionette transform into his appearance, and then used the "Wraith's" ability to hide in a coin on the marionette's body.
Hobert supported the marionette's shoulders and used "Distortion" to arrive in front of the church door.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert shouted loudly at the town, "We entered the church and came out alive!
"And we found a way out! If you don't want to die here, let's talk!"
That "Frenzied Mage" reappeared on the rooftop in the distance, but the sound of his voice seemed very close to the two of them: "The danger inside originates from the 'Spirit Body Threads'?"
"Frenzied Mage" Ryan had also explored that church and almost didn't make it back.
Hobert was also from the "Lawyer" pathway, so there was no reason why a "Frenzied Mage" would be in mortal danger while a "Earl of the Fallen" safely found a way out.
Then what guaranteed their safety was that "Marionettist" beside him.
"Yes!" Klein shouted, "This church is very strange; it can automatically attract 'Spirit Body Threads.' I can control everyone's 'Spirit Body Threads' and prevent them from being absorbed by that power."
"And then we all become your marionettes?" Panatiya, looking dignified and holy, appeared from a piece of glass dozens of meters away from them.
Hobert, however, said, "That 'Frenzied Mage' can 'Distort' this process."
The "Frenzied Mage" still had no intention of approaching: "And then my 'Spirit Body Threads' will be sucked into the church!"
Hobert spread his hands: "There's always a risk to getting out, but I think even the biggest risk is better than waiting here to die!"
Panatiya, who was smiling charmingly, suddenly said, "You found a way out, why don't you leave immediately? Why come and discuss it with us?"
"Because they need this." Ryan in the distance took out a piece of obsidian the size of a normal brick from his pocket.
Panatiya smiled, "Ah, so you're asking something of us."
"It's just cooperation!" Hobert said, "Only my companion can help everyone leave here.
"And once the crimson moon disappears, if we hide in the church, you won't be able to catch us!
"You've seen the situation in the church; there are hundreds of corpses. My 'Marionettist' companion can connect their 'Spirit Body Threads' end to end, so they can be used as food.
"Although the taste of those 'jerky' definitely won't be pleasant, it's enough to slowly exhaust you to death!"
Klein recalled the appearance of those mummified corpses, and felt a little nauseous listening to it.
He didn't actually possess such an ability; Hobert was lying, but this lie was difficult to verify, after all, "Spirit Body Threads" were something only the "Seer" pathway could see, and other pathways lacked sufficient understanding.
And Hobert's statement was not entirely unfounded; Zaratul's "Spirit Body Threads" inside were in such a state.
Ryan and Panatiya both fell into contemplation. They were very clear that falling into such a stalemate would indeed be detrimental to them, because it was already difficult for them to suppress the madness in their hearts. After a few more months, they would completely go mad even if they didn't starve to death.
While they were considering, Hobert suddenly pulled out the rapier in his hand: "Perhaps in a few days, you won't be qualified to negotiate terms with us.
"Look at this rapier. Mr. 'Frenzied Mage,' you should be able to sense the connection between it and that sealed Saint on our side!
"As soon as I entered the town, based on the connection between them, I sensed that the Saint was sealed in the mill. If we can remove the seal on him, we can completely kill you and obtain that obsidian!"
Ryan frowned slightly. That Black Hound spirit beast was indeed sealed by him in the mill, and even from a distance, he could feel that the rapier and the Black Hound spirit beast gave a similar feeling, which made him believe Hobert's words a bit more.
After entering Foggy Town, the Black Hound spirit beast had been continuously attacking Ryan, after all, the last order it received was: attack this old man.
This put Ryan in great danger, and several times he almost exposed himself to the crimson moonlight.
He had no choice but to use a Sealed Artifact on his body to design a seal and get rid of the Black Hound spirit beast's attack.
However, he was not good at sealing, and that seal was indeed very easy to break.
Just as the entire town fell into silence, Mr. A, wearing a hooded robe, suddenly came out of the room: "Respected Mr. 'Frenzied Mage,' I think I can help you establish a mechanism of mutual restraint."
Ryan glanced at this thin figure: "Speak."
"I can use 'Flesh and Blood Magic' to burrow into the stomach of one of them. Once they break the agreement, I will immediately make him explode," Mr. A said cautiously.
Ryan smiled: "How am I supposed to trust you?"
"I can give my hair and flesh to this Ms. Panatiya. As long as you discover that I have any actions outside the plan, immediately cast a death curse on me."
Ryan shook his head slightly; he didn't trust Panatiya either.
Hobert smiled at this time: "As long as the seal on our Saint is lifted, you will have a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact in your hand. Doesn't that Sealed Artifact have a way to instantly kill a 'Shepherd'?"
Reminded by Hobert, Ryan suddenly realized that this was the case. He said to Mr. A: "You also need to give me a copy of your hair and flesh."
Then he smiled somewhat ferociously: "If you have any thoughts of betrayal, you will immediately turn into a mindless monster, and your soul will be trapped by me, forever unable to enter the spirit world.
"At that time, you will be forever left in Foggy Town. Even if your body is eaten, your soul will be resurrected in the body of the person eating you, continuing to painfully be a mindless monster, forever."
In fact, it was possible to do this without hair and flesh. Ryan did this to give Mr. A enough pressure.
Hobert swallowed his saliva; this was the most vicious curse he had ever heard.
Even Mr. A was somewhat moved: "Then, before leaving… …"
"I will burn your hair and flesh in front of you before the door to leave here," Ryan said, using a "Distortion" to come in front of everyone.
Mr. A nodded: "Okay!"
Then he looked at Panatiya next to him.
Panatiya also said: "I will also burn your flesh and blood before leaving."
After reaching a basic cooperative intention, Hobert said: "Then, let's go to the mill over there first. Before entering the mill, this Mr. A will burrow into my stomach… …"
"No!" Ryan said: "Let him burrow into the 'Marionettist's' stomach!"
He was very clear that the key to this action was that "Marionettist."
Hobert smiled helplessly: "We have a very good relationship. I know his sister and brother, he knows my wife, and he even attended my wedding."
Nearby, Klein was sweating a little. He understood, of course, that Hobert's previous words were meant to make the "Frenzied Mage" actively request Mr. A to enter his stomach, as this would also create sufficient restraint on Hobert. However, Hobert's subsequent explanation might backfire.
Fortunately, Ryan added, "I insist on my own idea."
Hobert spread his hands: "Alright, alright, let him enter the 'Marionettist's' stomach."
He had just been a little playful, and his spirituality had become much more lively.
"With a mutual restraint in place, release our Saint. I will explain our plan to him," Hobert said. "Then we will enter the church together.
"Let the 'Marionettist' control our 'spirit body threads,' place the obsidian in the corresponding position, fill in the corresponding symbols, and the door will open. We will each remove the threat, and I will go out first…"
Ryan interrupted again: "No, I'll go out first!"
Hobert thought of a compromise: "You go out with our Saint!"
Ryan thought for a moment: "Okay."
"No!" At this time, Panatiya also said: "I want to go out with you."
Ryan suddenly smiled: "Don't worry, I will cover you. After all, I still want to continue experiencing the ultimate pleasure after I go out."
Hobert was slightly stunned. Could it be that because Panatiya allowed Ryan to enjoy the ultimate pleasure, there was a simple alliance between them?
Panatiya smiled charmingly: "Of course, no problem."
Just as Mr. A was about to speak, Hobert smiled and said, "Only I can guarantee your safety. I am from MI9 and know some of the inside story of the royal family's cooperation with the Aurora Order."
Mr. A was stunned: "I remember you seem to have defected, right?"
Before the Backlund smog incident, Hobert and his son had "defected."
Hobert smiled: "When did MI9's affairs need to be reported to you?"
Mr. A seemed to understand something: "Okay."
After discussing everything, the five people, wary of each other, walked step by step towards the direction of the mill.
After walking a few steps, Klein casually grabbed a few mushrooms from his pocket, threw one into his mouth, and chewed with relish.
Ryan and the other two immediately looked over, and saliva immediately appeared in their mouths.
Hobert casually took a mushroom from Klein and threw it into his mouth, saying to Ryan and the others, "Bear with it, there will be food to eat when we get out!"
A hint of madness appeared in Panatiya's eyes: "No, since we have already started cooperating, we must share food!"
Mr. A had even less reason left, as if he was about to pounce and snatch the mushrooms at any moment: "That's right! Share the food."
Even Ryan said: "As you said, there will be food after we go out. What does this little bit of food matter? Share it with everyone."
The temptation that food brought to them exceeded Hobert and Klein's imagination!
Klein had no choice but to reluctantly say: "Only two for each person!"
Panatiya almost screamed: "You've already eaten two!"
Hobert waved his hand: "Give them all! If you have any food on you, give it to them too."
Klein distributed the mushrooms to them. Because Klein and Hobert had both eaten them, Ryan and the other two only slightly identified them before gobbling them down.
Klein then took out the lump of fish, eating a bite himself first. It was just that Klein ate the mushrooms, and the marionette ate the fish.
Then Klein stretched out his hand and shared the fish with everyone.
Hobert frowned, indicating that he was unwilling to eat.
Ryan hesitated for a moment and did not reach out to take it either.
So, the remaining fish was divided between Panatiya and Mr. A. After Mr. A recognized that it was ordinary fish, he immediately stuffed it into his mouth.
Panatiya waited for a few seconds and, seeing that Mr. A was not abnormal, also stuffed it into her mouth.
After the food was eaten, the madness in the three people's eyes gradually subsided.
This made Hobert couldn't help but sigh that the desires of human instinct were the most irresistible to temptation. The Sequence 3 "Frenzied Mage" had only eaten a little less fish than the Sequence 4 "Demoness of Despair."
Soon, they arrived at the mill. Mr. A gave a few strands of his hair and a small piece of flesh to Ryan and Panatiya respectively.
Then, Klein controlled the marionette to open its mouth, and Mr. A crawled into the marionette's stomach.
After Hobert and Ryan witnessed all this, they entered the mill together.
Opening the door on the inside of the mill, Hobert saw a bracelet inlaid with emeralds suspended from the roof. The bracelet filled the entire warehouse-sized room with vitality, and strange creatures constantly appeared.
For example, ears of wheat that grew ladybugs, sunflowers that could hop around on their own, and so on.
And in the very center of the room, there was a creature more than a person tall, with the head of a dog and the body of a human. It had its eyes tightly closed, its whole body was covered with black fur, and the expression on its face was very kind and reassuring.
Just seeing this face could calm people's minds.
This was exactly the Black Hound spirit beast that Hobert was looking for.
At this time, it was emitting a pale white light all over its body, and the strange creatures around it quickly lost their vitality under the illumination of the light.
Then new creatures appeared, and the Black Hound spirit beast constantly emitted a pale white light.
Ryan stared at the Black Hound spirit beast while retracting the bracelet.
The vitality in the room suddenly disappeared, and the Black Hound spirit beast slowly opened its scarlet eyes.
Hobert and Ryan had already turned their gazes away. Even a demigod's spirit body would be severely damaged if they made eye contact with a "Ferryman."
After the Black Hound spirit beast was freed from its sealed state, it immediately began to attack Ryan, and the atmosphere in the entire room immediately became gloomy and terrifying.
Hobert stepped forward, as if explaining something, but after approaching the Black Hound spirit beast, he pointed at Ryan: "Kill him!"
Ryan's eyes narrowed, and he retreated while shouting, "Kill that 'Marionettist,' no one will get out!"
At this moment, the madness in his heart almost drowned out his reason! His current mental state had left him with no energy to think about why Hobert would break the agreement?
Mr. A did as he was told. To be precise, even without Ryan's order, he would still rudely crawl out of the "Marionettist's" stomach.
Mr. A, who had "broken out of the stomach," knelt on the ground vomiting non-stop, spitting out one bright mushroom after another. Even more mushrooms grew densely on his body like bamboo shoots after a spring rain.
Because Frank Lee used the flesh and blood of the "Rose Bishop" when cultivating these mushrooms, Mr. A was the best nourishment for these mushrooms.
Panatiya also covered her stomach with a painful expression. Her stomach was getting bigger and bigger, as if something rapidly proliferating was growing inside.
Only now did Ryan realize that they had been schemed against!
He took the sealed artifact and quickly left the town, preparing to run towards the cornfield outside the town.
The Black Hound spirit beast followed closely behind. The living beings that appeared in its sight quickly withered. It slightly opened its mouth and spat out a syllable that made people feel cold all over.
Ryan and Panatiya's movements suddenly became a little stiff.
But Ryan immediately "bestowed" the influence brought by the "Language of the Dead" to a corn stalk outside the town, and continued to run outside the town.
Hobert, who came out behind him, told the Black Hound spirit beast not to chase after him, but to join him in encircling and killing Panatiya.
The reason was simple. The "Frenzied Mage's" purpose in going outside the town was likely to seal the Black Hound spirit beast again. At that time, even if Hobert killed Panatiya, he would still have to face that "Earl of the Fallen" alone, and he still had no chance of winning.
In this gap, Panatiya had a sharp frost short knife in her hand. She cut open her abdomen and cut off her stomach, which had grown to about the size of a horse's belly, and threw it on the ground.
Bright mushrooms quickly grew from both sides of the stomach and quickly grew into a cluster, covering the stomach on the ground.
"Magnify!" Hobert immediately magnified Panatiya's injuries, turning them from serious injuries into fatal injuries.
The Black Hound spirit beast stretched out a hand towards Panatiya, and Panatiya immediately fell to the ground, as if countless evil spirits were tearing at her spirit body.
"Exploit!" At this time, Ryan returned, ending the Black Hound spirit beast's "Undead Tearing" in advance.
Ryan also realized at this time that he had to protect Panatiya to stall that "Earl of the Fallen," so that he would have a chance to reseal the Black Hound spirit beast.
"Disorder!" Hobert focused on the "Frenzied Mage" while preventing Panatiya, who had suffered fatal injuries, from having the opportunity to transfer her injuries.
The Black Hound spirit beast opportunely filled the gap and summoned the "Underworld Gate," but this place could not connect to the underworld. The bronze door with intricate patterns showed no intention of opening.
However, this huge bronze door separated Ryan.
Hobert took advantage of this rare opportunity, pulled out his rapier, and thrust it out. The rapier instantly lengthened, piercing through Panatiya's head, who had just recovered from the state of "Disorder."
The rapier widened, breaking Panatiya's head.
Whoosh ~
Panatiya instantly turned into shattered glass, and she appeared in front of a window of a house.
"Arrogance!" Hobert once again interrupted Panatiya's process of wanting to transfer the fatal injury to other mirrors.
On the other side, Ryan had already used "Disorder" to pass through the "Underworld Gate," which had failed to connect to the underworld. The bracelet on his wrist immediately became dazzling.
The cluster of mushrooms that grew around Panatiya's stomach pouch instantly became as tall as towering trees.
These mushrooms quickly began to multiply, and soon the surface of the entire street was covered with a dense layer of mushrooms.
The mushrooms under Hobert and the Black Hound Spirit Beast's feet rapidly grew larger. Just as they were about to be surrounded by the mushrooms, Hobert quickly tossed the thin sword in his hand to the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
The moment the Black Hound Spirit Beast caught the thin sword, the mushrooms wrapped them up in layers.
From within the mushrooms, Hobert saw that the surrounding mushrooms had grown bloodthirsty mouths and fangs like sharp thorns.
Hobert was about to use "Disorder" when he keenly noticed that these mushrooms didn't seem to be trying to bite him. On the contrary, they seemed to be avoiding Hobert as much as possible, as if they had seen something terrifying. It was just a pity that their roots were stuck in the ground and they couldn't escape.
Hobert, feeling a sense of understanding, took out the "Healing Fork."
Whoosh ~
Hobert was surprised to see the mushrooms trembling, which made him wonder if the "Healing Fork" had such an effect! No wonder April told him to keep it safe.
There was no time to consider this problem at the moment. Hobert easily broke free from the encirclement of the mushrooms and looked towards the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
The mushrooms around it had already withered. The thin sword emitted a pale white light in its hand, covering the Black Hound Spirit Beast with a layer of pale white armor.
An extreme fear and sorrow in the face of death filled the entire street. The Black Hound Spirit Beast seemed to have returned to its strength when it was under the command of the ancient Death God, like a war god walking out of the white light!
The mushrooms on the entire street were withering, which made Ryan a little unbelievable. This Black Hound Spirit Beast, which seemed to have little intelligence, seemed to have suddenly become more intelligent, and part of its strength seemed to have risen to a higher level!
The thin sword was gently waved by the Black Hound Spirit Beast, and Ryan's spirit body immediately separated from his physical body. He uncontrollably walked towards the Black Hound Spirit Beast step by step. With each step he took, his spirit body faded a little.
However, he couldn't move after taking two steps. It turned out that the hand with the bracelet on it had not separated from his physical body.
Seeing the bracelet, Ryan seemed to have thought of something, and his spirit body stopped moving there.
On the other side, Hobert didn't have time to look at the battle on the Black Hound Spirit Beast's side: "Connection!"
He strengthened the connection between Panatiya and the mushrooms on the ground, which made Panatiya's face full of pain, and her exposed intestines wriggled back and forth, as if new mushrooms were about to grow.
Then Hobert poured spirituality into "1-109". Two pillars of fire appeared behind him again, and dozens of fire crows rushed towards Panatiya like rocket shells.
Panatiya, in great pain, quickly used "Mirror Substitute" again to avoid Hobert's attack. She was now completely unable to fight back. Even the straw doll used to transfer injuries was taken out, but Hobert's continuous attacks left her no time to use it.
"Distortion!" Hobert "distorted" Panatiya's idea of escaping into an attack. The "Demoness of Despair" who had just entered the mirror world suddenly rushed towards the fire crows.
Boom ~
The little doll in Panatiya's hand exploded and flew out. Her already severely injured body was blown to pieces.
"Magnify!" Hobert, who had already rushed to the front, magnified his strength. With one punch, he broke Panatiya's spine.
Panatiya, who had fallen into a brief coma, didn't have time to use the ability of "Mirror Substitute" this time.
Panatiya suddenly straightened her arms, her nails quickly lengthened, and slender, smooth tentacles suddenly grew out of her broken body.
Hobert immediately realized that this was about to go out of control!
He poured spirituality into "1-109" again: "Slaughter!"
With one blow, Panatiya completely lost her vitality.
Hobert didn't have time to rest and immediately went to help the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
After the spiritual tug-of-war just now, Ryan, with the help of the Sealed Artifact, finally regained a trace of sanity.
When he returned to his body, Ryan's spirit body had already been severely damaged.
The Black Hound Spirit Beast, as if walking out of the light, approached step by step with a long sword in hand. With each step closer, the fear in Ryan's heart increased, which made him lose the courage to face the Black Hound Spirit Beast directly!
He didn't even know how to use the power of the bracelet, because no matter how he used it, he couldn't hurt the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
Or rather, even if it was a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, it would still be difficult to harm the Black Hound Spirit Beast.
The Black Hound Spirit Beast was like a rock in a torrent. No matter how powerful the life force was, it couldn't affect it at all, and it couldn't even cause any mutation.
Before this, Ryan had never encountered such an enemy. For a Sequence 3 who wielded a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, almost no one on the North and South Continents could harm him.
Even the angels of the church could use the Sealed Artifact to escape safely.
But now it was different. Ryan had a sense of powerlessness. When he was young, he wanted to restore the glory of the Solomon family and visited family members everywhere, but he didn't feel so desperate when he saw that they had long lost their ambition.
The Black Hound Spirit Beast approached step by step, and Ryan decided to flee the battlefield. This unprecedented sense of powerlessness was related to his severely damaged spirit body and his no longer so firm will.
But more than that, it was the Black Hound Spirit Beast, an enemy who couldn't be killed and attacked Ryan like a machine at all times, that destroyed the will of this "Frenzied Mage"!
Just as he was about to escape, Ryan realized that something was wrong. He found that his legs seemed to have become particularly heavy. Looking down, he didn't know when his legs had been wrapped in a layer of constantly churning black, mysterious mist.
At the same time, he found that he had become much taller, and his hands had also turned dark black at some point.
Ryan twitched the corner of his mouth. He didn't know when he had been in a semi-out-of-control state, and his body had become a semi-mythical creature as if it were a stress response.
At this point, the last trace of his sanity disappeared!
The madness accumulated over the past six months, and the Black Hound Spirit Beast's attack on his will, made him completely give up himself!
"Ah ~"
With a roar, he now only had the instinct to fight!
From Hobert's perspective, this "Frenzied Mage" swelled several times in a very short period of time. At first, black mist like curly hair appeared around him. Finally, these black mists solidified and turned into a suit of armor.
With a roar, he forced the Black Hound Spirit Beast, who was approaching step by step, to retreat.
Hobert shouted, "Give me another 'Deprivation Charm'!"
Klein, who had been hiding on another street, threw over a black crystal-like charm.
Hobert caught it and rushed to the battlefield.
