chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 580 Bernadette asks the Fool the fifth question
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert got dressed, kissed Fors goodbye, and arrived at Longtail Island around 11 a.m.
He met the head of the Tudor family in the reception hall of the Governor's Mansion, or rather, the head of one of the three branches of the Tudor family today.
His name was Barnett Tudor, an old man who looked gray-haired and had a clean face without a beard.
Barnett was dressed like a Backlund gentleman, meticulous and very rigorous.
Archibald, with a serious face, sat opposite Barnett, the atmosphere a bit heavy.
Angus and other members of the Tudor family stood aside or in the corners.
Seeing Hobert arrive, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
Hobert smiled at Barnett and said, "Welcome, sir!"
Before Barnett could speak, Hobert continued to Angus, "Have the kitchen prepare a sumptuous lunch..."
"No need!" Barnett's voice was a bit sharp and very authoritative: "I heard that people who ate at your restaurant before have lost all their savings and had to venture to other islands."
"That's slander against me!" Hobert said seriously: "There was one manor owner who wasn't greedy and knew how to respect other people's personalities, and he got what he deserved."
Barnett glanced at Hobert, then said to the Tudor family members, "You may leave, Angus, stay."
Hobert didn't let Archibald leave; after Hobert entered the room, Archibald immediately got up and stood behind Hobert with great presence of mind.
Barnett noticed this and was secretly shocked.
He had just sensed that Archibald had the aura of Sequence 3, although the state was a bit strange, the level was there.
It was this Beyonder with Sequence 3 that was so respectful to Hobert.
After Hobert sat down, Barnett suddenly sighed and said, "I've been to see where the Tudor family members live now, and to be honest, it's pretty good."
Around the end of June, the families of the Special Operations Division had just moved into the new buildings built for them.
Hobert smiled and said, "This is what I should do."
"I'd like to know, how will you treat these Tudor family members in the future?" Barnett stared at Hobert.
Angus breathed a sigh of relief, fortunately, their conversation wasn't so confrontational, and the patriarch didn't come to interrogate him right away.
Hobert spread his hands: "My father is a member of the Tudor family, of course, he is now an upper house member of Loen, a 'Chaos Hunter'..."
He said this on purpose, after all, Christian felt that there was no future in the Tudor family, so he came out to make a name for herself.
And now, Christian is already a Sequence 3.
Barnett's face didn't look good when he heard this.
Hobert continued: "...Of course, I won't mistreat the Tudor family members, and my territory needs enough official Beyonders, I think they will have a good prospect of development here."
Barnett said in a sharp voice: "If you have such a plan, you can discuss it with me, as the patriarch, I will definitely support you.
"But you used despicable means to win over family members, causing sharp contradictions within the family!"
Angus became nervous, what was coming had come after all.
The so-called "despicable means" was actually criticizing Hobert for recruiting a large number of people from the family without the patriarch's permission.
Hobert first said seriously: "How my territory develops doesn't intend to report to anyone."
Then he smiled: "I heard a long time ago that some family members need to find jobs themselves for a living.
"I have suitable jobs for them here, and they need this job."
Hobert's first sentence was to emphasize his principle: Old man, I have the final say in my territory, no one can point fingers on my territory!
The following words were to change the concept, turning his previous "poaching" into an employment relationship.
Barnett looked at Hobert coldly: "Young man, I'm not senile yet."
Hobert took a banana from the table in front of him, peeled the banana peel and said, "Old man, as the patriarch of a Beyonder family, of course, you must have enough management and handling wisdom.
"Then you should understand a very simple truth, people follow the benefits."
He took a bite of the banana: "I can provide family members with better opportunities, why do you want to stop them from a better future?"
Angus wanted to praise the lord at this time: When it comes to the art of language, you have to look at the "lawyer". In my opinion, it is a matter of being at a loss, but in the lord's view, it is an upright thing that is in line with human nature and the trend of the times.
Barnett was also slightly stunned, but he quickly said: "You must know that I have the right to take all family members back."
"Take them back to do what? Lock them all up?"
Barnett opened his mouth, but still didn't say anything.
Managing a family is completely different from managing a business. Managing a business can be done according to rules and regulations.
But managing a family is different. There must be affection, there must be rules, and even if you try to be fair, everyone will hate you. It is difficult to grasp the degree.
If he really locked up these family members, Barnett might only be able to maintain the dignity of the patriarch with force in the future.
He suddenly shook his head and smiled: "You will be a good leader."
Hobert put the remaining banana peel on the table: "You wouldn't have such an evaluation just because I can speak eloquently, right?"
The other party's sudden praise made Hobert deal with it carefully.
"No, I'm not blind." Barnett said: "Just look at what you have done in the South Colson area and Longtail Island, you are going to subvert the operating rules of modern society!"
Hobert was slightly stunned, this old man was the first to point out the cause he was doing in person.
This point, even the Backlund nobles who withdrew from Longtail Island did not realize, or they simply didn't care about these.
Barnett continued with a smile: "And according to my observation, you are a person who knows the development process of things very well, not impatient, and knows the mystery of waiting!"
He sighed: "Am I not waiting? The family has had no future for hundreds of years.
"On the one hand, it is difficult to obtain new Beyonder characteristics, on the other hand, with the increase in the number of family members, it is difficult for the family's remaining industries to allow everyone to live a relatively comfortable life.
"So from the moment I became the patriarch, I was waiting, waiting for someone who could change the status quo of the family."
Angus was slightly surprised, as if he was getting to know this patriarch who he had previously thought was stubborn and unfair for the first time.
Then he realized why the patriarch asked him to stay, obviously hoping that he would listen to his heart.
This also surprised Hobert. Previously, Hobert's impression of Barnett came entirely from Angus and others, and Hobert's impression of this patriarch was not good during the previous Beyonder characteristic transaction.
But now, Hobert can confirm that Barnett's description of the current situation of the Tudor family is basically the truth, and the fact that he is unable to change the status quo is also the truth.
Hobert took a deep breath: "As you said, I may be an opportunity for the Tudor family, you should increase your support for me!"
"I came here to tell you this!" Barnett said: "I will send more family members to assist you in batches until the entire Tudor family is moved to the South Colson area."
This was not only beyond Angus's expectation, but even somewhat beyond Hobert's expectation.
However, thinking of the Tudor family's gambler mentality, Hobert felt that it was not surprising that the other party did so. The members of this family have always brought all their wealth and invested in the gamble once they seize the opportunity.
Hobert sighed. If Barnett had remained tough and opposed, things would have been easier.
But thinking about it carefully, how could a fool become the patriarch of a Beyonder family? Then the next step must be a tug-of-war negotiation.
As Hobert expected, Barnett then said: "But as a condition, the Beyonder power in your territory must be dominated by the Tudor family, and the Tudor family's opinions must be sought for personnel advancement and welfare, etc."
Hobert leaned back in his chair and smiled: "I think you have some misunderstanding? I have cooperation with many Beyonder forces, such as the Beyonders of the Trunsoest family."
He said somewhat indifferently: "Even if they are both from the Tudor family, my relationship with the other two branches is closer than with your branch.
"One of those two branches has an angel whose condition is not very good. According to the principle, they are more qualified to be the leader of Beyonder forces.
"And the other branch has completely devoted itself to me. They are now in Bayam and completely obey my orders."
The so-called "they" actually refers to Rafter alone.
Barnett didn't insist: "Then if the Beyonders of our clan want to be promoted, the family should have the final say."
Actually, it was his patriarch who had the final say.
This was his real purpose. He was too lazy to care about the Tudor family members who were respectively codenamed Tony and Bond.
Hobert spread his hands: "This is very unreasonable. I provide all the resources, but I don't have the final say on whether the Beyonders are promoted."
He smiled: "You can seek territory yourself and establish rule."
Barnett thought for a while and then said: "Don't underestimate the heritage of a Beyonder family. I know that you can provide members with some Beyonder characteristics, but what about the next step? Can their highest achievement only be Sequence 5?"
"I have already prepared a copy of the 'Imperative Mage' Beyonder characteristic for Angus." Hobert smiled and said, "As long as he doesn't make big mistakes, digests the 'Disciplinary Knight' potion, and I need it, I can let him be promoted first.
"In addition, I also got a copy of the main material of 'Imperative Mage'."
Not only was Barnett stunned, but Angus was also stunned. Originally, he was a little worried that after the family began to strongly support Hobert, his current position would not be guaranteed.
Now he was relieved, feeling that his consistent loyalty had received the due reward.
Barnett pondered for more than ten seconds and then said: "In this way, you will not get the full support of the family, and I will recall some members.
"It's a pity, I thought this was a good opportunity for cooperation."
"You may not understand one thing." Hobert said seriously: "Do you think I am taking care of Longtail Island and South Colson for myself?"
He suddenly said to Angus: "Tell me about the process of receiving a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact."
"Yes!" Angus said: "The process of receiving a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact is to hold a ceremony of granting to the 'Creator'. First, prepare an altar, draw the symbol representing the 'Creator', light three candles..."
The more Barnett listened, the more frightened he became. Of course, he had heard of the "Creator" and also knew that Hobert had a "Creator" background.
But unexpectedly, the "Creator" didn't sound like an evil god at all, and could even use granting to allow Angus to obtain a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact when needed.
Hobert smiled and said: "Old man, you can go back and think about this matter, but what I want to tell you is that my current authority is limited and the resources I can call are also limited.
"But soon, I will be able to mobilize some demigods and Beyonder families loyal to the 'Creator'. At that time, the power of the Tudor family will be dispensable to me."
To be precise, it was that after Hobert was promoted to Sequence 2, or just promoted to Sequence 3, those families that had goodwill towards the "Creator" would naturally lean towards Hobert.
Barnett fell into deep thought.
Angus thought that after he became a demigod, there would be many demigod colleagues, which made him somewhat excited.
Archibald was thinking that after Hobert could mobilize the demigods, would his position not be as high as it is now? How should he express his loyalty to the "Creator"?
After Hobert waited for more than half a minute, he suddenly said: "Old man, do you know the main members of the royal family when the Blood Emperor was in power?"
Barnett was slightly stunned: "Of course I know, the family has always had picture albums passed down."
"That's great." Hobert got up: "In order to make you understand the current situation better, and to let you see what level of people I am talking to about cooperation."
Then, he said in ancient Hermes: "Messenger!"
Some space in the reception room suddenly became illusory, and a coffin floated out of the spirit world and stood in front of everyone.
Hobert pointed to Barnett and smiled at the messenger: "Let me introduce you, this is Mr. Barnett, one of the current patriarchs of the Tudor family."
Barnett knew at a glance that this coffin was unusual, which reminded him of some records in the family's passed down notes, and he quickly stood up.
Hobert also said to Barnett: "This is Ms. Beverly Heather Tudor."
Barnett was a little surprised: "Princess?"
He was a little unsure, because according to the family's notes, this princess died in battle!
Hobert asked the messenger: "Can you let her see your face?"
"Of course, I'm not afraid of being seen." Saying this, the coffin lid slid upward, revealing the scene inside the coffin. Inside was a very beautiful lady wearing a classical court dress.
She seemed to be only in her twenties, her face was pale, and she was smiling shallowly. The smile looked very playful, and there was some rebelliousness and frivolity in her eyes.
There was a delicate metal crossbow on her left hand, and a wooden stick with fresh leaves on her right hand.
Seeing the other person's face, Barnett immediately knelt on one knee: "Your Royal Highness, so you're not dead!"
The Messenger said: "I was dead, otherwise why would I be lying in a coffin?"
Barnett was stunned again, not knowing how to respond for a moment.
Hobert, however, stared blankly at the coffin lid: I remembered it opening like a flip-top, but I didn't expect it could slide!
Then he smiled and said: "Ms. Beverly, the reason I've taken the liberty of inviting you here is that this Mr. Barnett is very eager to meet you."
The Messenger looked at Hobert, then at Barnett, her eyes sparkling: "A new era has arrived, this is the Tudor family's opportunity!"
As she spoke, she held out her index finger and gestured the number 1 to Hobert.
Hobert first marveled at the Messenger's intelligence, already roughly understanding why he was invited.
Then Hobert also understood that the other party meant: this counts as one instance of help provided by Her.
Previously, when the Messenger detected Amon's avatar invading the Tony Manor, in order to prevent the Tony Manor from falling, the Messenger asked Hobert to hunt down Amon's avatar.
At that time, the Messenger promised to provide Hobert with three instances of help within Her capabilities.
Hobert immediately nodded to the Messenger, indicating no problem.
Barnett, kneeling on the ground, didn't see any of this, he said somewhat nervously: "I will obey the Princess's orders, I will definitely seize the opportunity to make the Tudor family great again."
The Messenger nodded: "It's good that you haven't forgotten this mission."
The Messenger was also willing to see the Tudor family leaning towards Hobert.
After speaking, the coffin lid slid down and closed, and the Messenger returned to the spirit world.
Barnett knelt on the ground for almost half a minute, in the past six months, he had been turning a blind eye to Hobert's 'poaching', just to occupy the moral high ground and increase bargaining chips for today's negotiation.
But unexpected situations arose one after another, Hobert's eloquence, or rather, Hobert's shamelessness, exceeded his expectations.
Immediately afterward, the resources that Hobert could mobilize were even more beyond his expectations, of course, what surprised him the most was this Princess.
He had seen the royal family portrait album left by the family, and among them, besides the wise and martial Blood Emperor, the most eye-catching was this Princess.
In the notes left by family members, they more than once expressed regret for the Princess's death.
Princess Beverly was actually Hobert's partner, so what was there for him to negotiate?
It was like the cooperation between two head offices had already been finalized, what was there for him, a branch manager, to negotiate?
After Barnett was surprised that this Princess was not dead, he realized that Hobert was definitely the hope of the Tudor family, and it was definitely right to bet all the chips on Hobert.
It's just that what he couldn't accept was that he, the patriarch, would not have much decision-making power in this matter.
After Barnett reluctantly accepted this fact, he slowly got up and sat opposite Hobert.
At this time, Hobert looked relatively amiable: "If you plan to stay out of it, then I will at most recruit a batch of Tudor family members.
"But if you also want to join the game, you always have to pay something.
"In the future, the Tudor family members must obey my orders at work, but in life, it doesn't hinder their sense of identity with the Tudor family."
Barnett smiled bitterly: "I understand, as I said before, I will send the family's Beyonders to you in batches."
Hobert said: "What's more important than this is to publicize the belief in the 'Creator' to them.
"There are no rigid requirements for the belief in the 'Creator', but they must know whose power they belong to."
Actually, Hobert doesn't currently have that much demand for Beyonders, in Hobert's view, Angus's team is already a bit bloated, it's better to wait until it's needed.
Barnett nodded and suddenly asked: "What is the main material for the 'Imperative Mage'?"
It was a roll of reddish-brown parchment the size of half a palm, seeing it was like seeing a constitution with sacred colors.
This was obtained by Hobert from Archibald's marionette, at first he didn't know what the main material was called, some time ago he specifically asked Christian: "Striped Patterned Tiger's Crystallization!"
Barnett exclaimed: "It seems that this is indeed the arrangement of fate."
Then he said: "The family happens to have another main material, as well as corresponding auxiliary Ingredients, if you need them, I can send them all here.
"But I have a condition, those who are promoted using these materials must be members of the Tudor family."
Hobert nodded and smiled: "No problem!"
In the future, a demigod under his command +1.
Barnett offered another main material, which was equivalent to his submission to Hobert.
Hobert once again asked the kitchen to prepare lunch, this time Barnett did not refuse.
...
Northern Continent, a desolate valley in the central plateau.
On both sides of the valley, there are many dilapidated houses, which seem to have been uninhabited for a long time.
In the center of the valley, there is a bottomless cave.
"Uh ah ~"
Inside the cave, there was suddenly a terrifying cry, which sounded like the cry of a beast, but not quite.
Entering the cave, you can first see many rooms built on both sides of the cave, they are built against the mountain, and one after another space that can be lived in is dug out of the rock.
At this time, the people living in the cave are prostrate on the ground piously facing the inside of the cave.
They worship, they pray.
In the shadows of the deepest part of the cave, which these cultists cannot see, there is a humanoid monster, she has the structure of limbs and torso, but she sometimes grows two more legs, sometimes the extra legs disappear, and a pair of wings grow out.
The head of this monster sometimes grows horns, and sometimes grows antlers.
In short, her whole body seems to be constantly changing.
The only thing that remains unchanged is that face.
The features are exquisite, mature and beautiful, it is actually April!
At this time, her face is indifferent, without a trace of emotion, and even seems to have no feelings.
"Uh ah ~"
She once again made a cry that was not like a human being, but she seemed unaware of it, still with a cold face.
At this time, April's consciousness was already blurred, she seemed to be in a cloud of fog where she couldn't see her fingers, forgetting where she was, forgetting what she was doing, and even forgetting who she was.
"Mother ~"
A kind greeting appeared in April's ear, she still looked around, looking for the child she was unwilling to give up even if she died.
"Mother ~"
The voice appeared again, and the surrounding fog suddenly rolled! April seemed to think of something, as if she realized something.
"Mother ~"
Tears welled up in April's eyes, in the days and nights of fighting against madness and loss of control, as well as the erosion of the evil god, what kept her going was that child with chubby little mouth, bright and pure eyes, and a smile that could melt the heart.
"Mother ~"
"Hey!" April had been waiting for this title for a long, long time, suddenly, the fog collapsed, darkness covered the vision, and she regained consciousness!
After seeing her current appearance, she used all her strength to begin to restrain her spirituality, to begin to restrain all the mutations.
Finally, she returned to normal.
Looking at the black jade with the patterns of pigeons and vases in her palm, April showed a loving smile.
But immediately afterward, she put away her smile, put on her robe, and came to the outside of the cave.
The worshiping people seemed to realize something, and became more and more pious.
Even Spike, who had a mustache on his upper lip and a dazed look in his eyes, came out of the room: "You, you actually succeeded!"
April smiled: "Of course.
"I said long ago that I am closer to the Great Mother Goddess than you."
...
Time came to Monday, and it rained again in Backlund that day.
In such weather, Backlund was even brighter, because the fog was completely washed away by the rain.
Hobert had just arrived at MI9 when Qonas came over: "While there are no cases today, let's go out and play cards."
Before Hobert could refuse, Qonas said again: "Admiral Amyrius and Lieutenant General Miller are at the club today."
They are the main military shareholders of the 'Earl's Light' factory.
Hobert thought for a while, and then nodded: "Okay, let's go."
The two chatted casually and took a carriage to the 'East Balam Veterans Mess'.
Halfway there, the sky suddenly cleared.
Backlund in the sun was wet and spotless.
Qonas looked outside and said: "To be honest, I haven't had such a good view in Backlund for a long time.
"Storm above, is that the sun? I almost forgot it was a round cake."
Hobert smiled very supportively: "You are a humorous gentleman."
Coming to the club's card room, they indeed saw Admiral Amyrius, with his hair neatly combed back, and Lieutenant General Miller, with his auburn hair, in a private room.
The four exchanged simple pleasantries and began to sit down to play "Fight Evil", with one as a substitute, and bets starting at 1 pound.
During the card game, Hobert learned the reason for being called today.
Admiral Amyrius, who had just taken office as the Minister of National Defense, and Lieutenant General Miller of the General Logistics Department, used their influence to pass the procurement plan for installing electric lights in the barracks.
This is a considerable order, not only the barracks around Backlund, but also the fixed barracks across the country will gradually install electric lights!
This is also the reason why Hobert wants to form his own interest group, these big figures can win 'national level' orders for the light bulb factory!
"This is really exciting news." Hobert was already thinking about how to expand the scale of production.
After a second or two, Hobert suddenly realized: "Sorry, I haven't taken over such a large-scale business before, I don't know what percentage is popular now?"
Hobert was asking about kickbacks.
Even shareholders must have kickbacks, otherwise why would people be so busy running around? How much is the dividend?
Qonas on the side explained: "10%."
If he were talking about this kind of business with nobles, Hobert's question would be a bit too straightforward, but talking about business with soldiers, being occasionally straightforward would not make them disgusted.
Moreover, it was 10% for Amyrius and Miller each, correspondingly, if Hobert's quotation was higher than the market price, the two of them would turn a blind eye when approving the corresponding documents.
Hobert nodded, preparing to give Qonas some benefits when this round of transactions started, of course, provided he was still alive.
After completing the transaction, Lieutenant General Miller left first because he had something to do.
The remaining three continued to "Fight Evil", Hobert found that his card skills were really poor, with bets starting at 1 pound, he had already lost more than 100 pounds.
Amyrius couldn't help but smile and said: "If you are short of money one day, you can call Hobert to play cards."
Hobert laughed along: "I'm afraid I'll lose all the light bulb factory's assets because of playing cards."
In the midst of the laughter, Amyrius suggested playing "Texas Hold'em", as the Admiral said, this form of entertainment that tests observation, judgment, and acting skills is more suitable for Hobert, for a time the three were evenly matched and had a great time.
I don't know who first turned on the demigod's pressure, the three were also conducting spiritual confrontation in addition to playing cards.
When Colonel Calvin, Amyrius's subordinate, entered the card room, he immediately felt as if his chest had been hit hard.
Councilor Macht, who entered the door with him, held the position of his heart: "Goddess ah."
Then his eyes rolled over and he fell straight to the ground.
Fortunately, Colonel Calvin supported him.
Hobert and the other three then restrained the majesty emitted by the demigod, and then smiled at each other.
They finally came to the conclusion that their strengths were similar after the spiritual contest just now.
This changed Amyrius and Qonas's view of Hobert, although they didn't say it out loud before, they always felt that Hobert was benefiting from Christian's light and didn't have much ability himself.
At this time, they were first and foremost convinced of Hobert's strength, then the "Earl's Light" light bulb factory may really have been created by Hobert alone, rather than receiving Christian's order.
Amyrius and Qonas certainly wouldn't say things like "sorry", and finally Hobert said with a smile: "I was too focused on playing cards just now."
As he spoke, he used a "healing spell" on Councilor Macht.
Councilor Macht woke up, but needed to slow down for a while, Colonel Calvin calmed down and said to Admiral Amyrius: "General, it's settled, Dunn is willing to go to the Southern Continent."
Hobert was slightly stunned: Dunn? Is it Klein! The arms business in the Southern Continent?
Then Hobert smiled and sighed: "Time flies so fast, it's already July in the blink of an eye."(Note)
At noon, Hobert had lunch with Amyrius and Qonas at the club, and the three took carriages and went about their business.
After Hobert returned to MI9, he started slacking off again, came to South Village, and found Fors in the Green Manor.
The two smiled at each other and lay on the bed chatting while waiting for the start of the Tarot Club.
At three o'clock, the two people's vision was covered by gray fog, and they appeared on both sides of the bronze long table respectively.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool ~" "Justice" Audrey's crisp voice rang out as usual, this is already an unchanging part of the Tarot Club.
After greeting everyone, "Hermit" Cattleya was about to speak when she saw Mr. Fool tap the mottled bronze long table with his knuckles.
The dull sound immediately tightened the spirits of the Tarot Club members, signifying that Mr. Fool had something to say.
Audrey judged in her heart: Whatever Mr. Fool emphasizes at the beginning must be a major event!
"The Fool" Klein looked around and smiled slightly: "Amon recently arrived in Backlund, an Avatar."
"The Sun" Derrick immediately recalled some unpleasant memories: The Blasphemer Amon!
"The Magician" Fors looked at Hobert: Two or three months ago, "The Creator" had just hunted Amon's Avatar in the Rorsted Archipelago. Now Amon's Avatar has appeared in Backlund. Could it be that He found some clues and tracked them to Backlund, or simply went to find Hobert?
"The Emperor" Hobert was thinking to himself: Klein has had a pretty fulfilling week. He must have seen Amon's Avatar from a distance or obtained corresponding clues. If it were a frontal encounter, Mr. Fool would definitely be wearing a monocle to attend the gathering.
Then he thought: No wonder he agreed to the arms deal to the Southern Continent today. He's taking the opportunity to go out and hide!
Audrey was a little worried: Amon! 'Angel of Time' Amon, how did He appear in Backlund? I've always treated the battle that happened in the Rorsted Archipelago as a story. Only when Amon's Avatar appeared in Backlund did I deeply realize that He is a character in mythology and also exists in reality.
She asked, "Honorable Mr. Fool, can I find a way to inform the Church about this matter?"
Inform, inform the Church? Hobert smiled: Miss Justice, you are definitely a devout believer of Mr. Fool, a competent member of the Tarot Club!
Klein had already considered this matter, but at the same time, he realized that the Church might not be able to catch all of Amon's Avatars, and Amon's Avatar might trace back to the informant through the fact that he was discovered.
The risk is too great.
So Klein just said in a calm tone: "Ignore Him!"
"The Hanged Man" Alger was both in awe and suddenly enlightened: Ignore Him! As long as it's not Amon's main body appearing, it won't cause any major problems for Mr. Fool? Hmm, Mr. Fool emphasized this matter at the beginning, the purpose should be to make us be careful.
Audrey also interpreted the meaning of "this is just a small matter".
Hobert couldn't help but resist the urge to twitch his mouth: You've shown off again.
Fors was still a little worried for Hobert, so she asked: "Honorable Mr. Fool, what does Amon's Avatar want to do in Backlund?"
Klein pondered the wording and looked around with a smile: "Looking for you."
Hobert pinched his forehead, concealing his discomfort: Fool who doesn't belong to this era, you are the God of showing off!
He paused and thought to himself: On the matter of showing off, I only admire "The Fool". One thing, he can show off twice! No, it's actually because everyone is too cooperative, giving him the opportunity for a second round of showing off.
As Klein expected, Audrey had already linked the previous sentence "Ignore Him" and started to imagine: Amon's Avatar is here to find us, but we don't need to care about Him! In other words, under the protection of Mr. Fool, we don't need to be afraid of being discovered by Amon!
Alger also had related associations: According to the information obtained from the Emperor before, Mr. Fool and Amon are adjacent pathways. Is Amon trying to find Mr. Fool through us? This, is this a game between gods to compete for the position of the Outer Deities?
Cattleya didn't know the relevant information about adjacent pathways. She just recalled: "The Creator" had already hunted Amon's Avatar once in the Rorsted Archipelago, and now that Mr. Fool knows about Amon's Avatar in Backlund, will He also organize people to hunt?
Fors breathed a sigh of relief: It's good that he's not simply coming for Hobert.
"The Moon" Amyrius and "The Sun" Derrick, after a half-beat, tasted the meaning of Mr. Fool's two sentences, and praised Mr. Fool in their hearts.
Seeing that the members of the Tarot Club were already alert to Amon's Avatar, Klein leisurely looked at everyone like the previous gatherings, signaling the official start of the gathering.
Cattleya stopped her inner speculation: "Honorable Mr. Fool, this time there are three more pages of new diary."
After the diary materialized, the Fool's reading session began.
Klein's eyes swept across the diary. This time the content of the diary was relatively chaotic, with descriptions of the "Twilight Hermit Order", speculations about the abyss, and also mentioned encountering a small church that believed in the ancient Sun God!
The priest in the church was a gentle and restrained middle-aged man, wearing a simple white robe, with light golden whiskers that almost covered the lower half of his face, and had a pair of clear light-colored eyes like a child.
After reading the three pages of the diary, Klein thought for a few seconds, the diary in his hand disappeared, and then he looked at the "Hermit".
Cattleya lowered her head and said: "Honorable Mr. Fool, I want to know, where is the spiritual and mental destination of Emperor Roselle? On that small island, or in the depths of the cosmos?"
Klein remembered a diary he had seen a long time ago: That island? The primitive island that made Grimm die and surprised the Great Emperor? It seems that the Great Emperor attached great importance to this island in his later years, even "Queen Mystic" Bernadette had a certain awareness.
Then he thought: Why would Bernadette associate it with the depths of the cosmos? The Great Emperor behaved too beyond the times in many places, so his daughter suspected that he was an alien?
Klein pondered slightly and smiled: "Neither."
Cattleya chewed on Mr. Fool's answer, and suddenly didn't understand the real meaning of the question just now.
Hobert realized: Is this Bernadette tentatively looking for the last tomb of Emperor Roselle?
Other members were either confused or had various interpretations of the question and answer. For a time, the hall fell into silence.
Finally, Klein, shrouded in gray fog, said: "You may begin."
Hobert cleared his throat and said: "Just now Mr. Fool mentioned Amon's Avatar. I think, as a member of the Tarot Club, I have an obligation to briefly describe the previous battle against Amon's Avatar."
Everyone's eyes lit up, Klein: I didn't expect my reminder to lead to such key information.
Audrey also sighed: What's going on today? Is the Tarot Club really going to go to war with Amon's Avatar?
Cattleya asked: "I will participate in the transaction with this information, how much do you plan to bid?"
Hobert smiled: "Free!"
He thought to himself: Just kidding, now my net worth has suddenly increased to several million pounds. I just finished a business deal worth hundreds of thousands of pounds this morning. Do I still care about your few thousand pounds?

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 581 Mother of the Sky and the Nation of the Evernight
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Let me start by describing my feelings about that battle!" Hobert said, "First of all, Amon's power is terrifying. Under the attacks of his Beyonder abilities, I even found it difficult to generate coherent thoughts.
"Of course, after your thoughts are stolen, you won't be able to react for a while.
"When I reviewed it later, I realized that all my thoughts had been stolen in the beginning, or rather, there were no secrets at all during that time!
"If it weren't for the mystical item bestowed by the great 'Creator' in advance, Amon's Avatar might have stolen all my memories, including the memories of participating in the Tarot Club."
He spread his hands: "I even 'forgot' to pray to the 'Creator' or to 'The Fool'!"
Everyone almost gasped together. This ability sounded terrifying.
Klein behind the gray fog sighed: Fortunately, I only got the clues of Amon's Avatar through the Arrodes magic mirror. If I brushed past him and even a single thought was stolen, my secret might be discovered.
"Hanged Man" Alger sweated for "Emperor": Even a demigod has no power to fight back. Once a person below demigod level encounters Amon, wanting to escape is a luxury.
"Magician" Fors was a little scared: Fortunately, Hobert is a follower of the "Creator", otherwise I might have lost him forever! Even if he appears in front of me, he may not be the real him.
"Justice" Audrey also felt scared: I didn't expect the previous hunting operation to be so dangerous! Hobert only mentioned it briefly before, and it gave me the feeling that it was not very difficult. Fortunately, Hobert is fine, and fortunately, the "Creator" foresaw it.
The most rational one was "Hermit" Cattleya: The abilities of the "Marauder" pathway are difficult to deal with at "High Sequence"! To fight, you always need a plan, at least a thought. But these thoughts and plans will be stolen, and you may forget that the person in front of you is the enemy! This is very scary!
"Moon" Emlyn belatedly thought: If I encounter Amon, wouldn't he know that I am the person chosen by the Ancestor! I am the winner of this Sanguine competition! He, no, He will definitely be very envious.
Hobert continued: "So, I said before, the best way to deal with Amon's Avatar is to pray to 'The Fool', if you still remember this.
"And parasitism is not such a terrible ability.
"His other terrible ability is to steal other people's fate and place it on himself.
"I said this ability before, and everyone may not have fully experienced it. The situation we encountered at that time was the chief person in charge of the Rorsted Archipelago…"
What he was talking about was Mr. Valentine. If he used the title of the Tony family patriarch, it would be too specific, and it seemed to have nothing to do with the "Creator".
After fooling Barnett yesterday, Hobert seemed to have opened up a new world. He could completely ask the messenger to recruit the Tony family when needed.
Hobert could feel that the messenger wanted the Tudor family to lean towards the "Creator", and He seemed to have a good relationship with the not-so-well angel of the Tony family. It couldn't be more appropriate for the messenger to recruit them.
It's just that Hobert doesn't need so many forces now, and recruiting them early would be a burden.
But this does not prevent Hobert from bragging and classifying them as the "Creator's" forces.
Emlyn was a little surprised: Ancestor bless me, please don't let me encounter Amon, otherwise my perfect life will definitely be targeted by Him!
"…The chief person in charge of the Rorsted Archipelago was stolen of his fate by Amon's Avatar." Hobert continued: "He has been avoiding praying and reporting to the 'Creator' for various reasons, so that no one can discover this.
"For a long time, the entire power of the Rorsted Archipelago was serving Amon's Avatar. Even when I saw him, I didn't notice anything unusual.
"If I hadn't remembered that the meeting was a bit strange later, I might have had to wait until the 'Creator' took the initiative to assign tasks to the person in charge of the Rorsted Archipelago to find out."
Cattleya nodded slightly, expressing her understanding. Even if it is a person in charge of a region, the gods will not pay attention to him all the time unless they have any instructions. Only the "Hidden Sage" is an exception, but it is more like actively instilling knowledge than paying attention.
Everyone listened carefully to "Emperor" continuing: "Afterwards, we conducted an investigation and found that the cause of the whole incident was that the companions in the Rorsted Archipelago abused the sealed artifact of the "Marauder" pathway, which attracted Amon's Avatar.
"So, if you know that there is a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact of the "Marauder" pathway around you, or a demigod or above Beyonder of that pathway, you must be careful!
"Amon has the habit of collecting Beyonder characteristics of the same pathway. Maybe one day, He will come to your door."
Klein behind the gray fog had the urge to cover his face: My neighbor is a demigod of the "Marauder" pathway parasitizing in a rat. Because I often go to church, I often meet my poet classmate! This is like hovering on the edge of danger!
The others were thinking about the Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts and demigods of the "Marauder" pathway around them, but Alger quickly realized the ridiculousness of his thoughts: Hehe, what am I thinking? I haven't even touched a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, why would I have such worries?
Everyone had similar thoughts to Alger, and they all realized the scarcity of Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts. After a knowing smile, they slowly shook their heads.
Hobert continued: "After discovering the problem, the hunt for Amon's Avatar began.
"What I want to tell you is that the seven orthodox gods all hate Amon, so if you pray directly to the true god, you may get some help from a certain god.
"But before that, you must first show enough kindness and respect to that god, and also that the god has enough kindness to our beliefs.
"This needs to be adapted to local conditions. Under the instruction of the 'Creator', I got the help of 'Concealment' power from the Evernight Goddess.
"In the battlefield after the action started, a hidden world was formed, which can effectively isolate Amon's other avatars from coming to support."
Everyone was stunned when they heard this. Klein thought: I wonder if I will get corresponding help if I pray to the Goddess?
He thought seriously, he has always been respectful enough to the Goddess. Now the more important thing is, what is the Goddess's attitude towards "The Fool"?
Audrey smiled slightly: I didn't expect there to be such an operation. If Hobert hadn't said it, I wouldn't have thought of it.
Then she thought: I wonder if I will get any rewards if I report Amon's news directly to the Goddess?
But Audrey changed her mind and gave up the idea: At that time, the Beyonders of the church will definitely come to verify the source and authenticity of this information, which will be very troublesome, and there is even a risk of exposing my participation in the Tarot Club.
Cattleya was slightly stunned: This method is the first time I have heard of it… Well, to be precise, it is the first time I have felt that gods also have emotions such as disgust. I have always thought that They are aloof and very indifferent, but in the mouth of the emperor, They seem to have some personality aspects of emotions? Well, there should be, after all, the ancient sun god has a personality.
"Then the second step is to prepare enough, overwhelming power." Hobert said: "And it's best to prepare as much power as you have.
"Because Amon's Avatar is very cunning, and this cunning will not only deceive strangers, but even people who are familiar with Him can hardly escape.
"One of our angels was very familiar with Amon during the Fourth Epoch, so He planned this battle plan.
"But what is unexpected is that some of Amon's performances in the Fourth Epoch were to deceive acquaintances during the battle. As a result, the power of Amon's Avatar far exceeded expectations, and the 'Creator' personally took action to save the situation!"
Klein nodded lightly: This sounds like something Amon could do.
Then he realized: The "Creator's" subordinates have very complex backgrounds.. There are guards who once served Death, and angels who are very familiar with Amon. How did these people get together?
But then Klein realized: Maybe they were originally subordinates of the "Creator", but were sent to Death, or sent to monitor Amon?
"Little Sun" only felt that Amon was terrible before. He always thought about how to avoid Amon and never thought about fighting Amon head-on. At this time, listening to "Emperor" telling the course of the battle, he was also very excited: So, Amon, no, Amon's Avatar can be defeated, but you have to be careful, otherwise it is easy to fall into His trap.
Fors sighed: I only know that Angus is a member of the Tudor family, and the Elliot and others who are still receiving training in Jeffrey City are from a Beyonder family in the Southern Continent. I didn't expect the "Creator" to have subordinates who are familiar with Amon… But thinking about it, it is reasonable. The "Creator" can even accept people from the Theosophy Order, so it is not surprising to have these strange subordinates.
"In the end, the three angels and several saints used the advantages gained by the 'Creator' to eliminate two angel-level avatars of Amon and more than a dozen saint-level avatars." Hobert said: "This is the beginning and end of this war."
Klein smiled slightly: No wonder you are so generous in the "Worm of Time" aspect, it turns out that you have eliminated so many avatars!
Alger was a little frightened: This battle is equivalent to destroying a large secret organization! Although it is a bit one-sided to think so, the results achieved are indeed very great!
Cattleya calmly analyzed: I have to say that Amon's avatars are a very terrifying force when concentrated together, but this is also a disadvantage, because these avatars have single abilities, so if the method is appropriate, they can easily be wiped out in one fell swoop. Hehe, my idea is really arrogant!
Audrey asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, what about the person in charge of the Rorsted Archipelago whose fate was stolen? Was he rescued?"
Hobert shook his head: "No, it is said that after his fate is stolen, he will be in a state similar to 'concealment'. No one can see him or hear his voice. He will gradually lose all contact with the real world, and then die painfully in loneliness."
In addition to being surprised, everyone felt that this ability was too vicious.
Hobert added: "As for those parasitized companions, a group of them were rescued. The group who died were basically not killed by Amon's Avatar, but basically killed by their own people.
"The parasitized people kept provoking everyone in the battle, and as a result, their own people fought with their own people. Fortunately, the battle on the main battlefield ended quickly, so it did not cause too many casualties."
At this point, the other members had a complete understanding of the whole picture of this war, and then they were thinking about what countermeasures they should have if they encountered Amon?
But their thoughts eventually came to a consistent answer: There is nothing they can do except pray.
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Klein manipulated "The World" to ask Hobert: "Do you have any definite information about the 'Mother of the Sky' and the 'Nation of the Evernight'?"
Mother of the Sky?
Nation of the Evernight?
Everyone looked curiously at "The World" and then at "The Emperor".
They felt that just hearing the two titles sounded very powerful.
Among them, Cattleya and Alger knew about the "Nation of the Evernight", but had only seen some fragmentary records, and she had never heard of the "Mother of the Sky", so she was very curious about the relevant information.
Hobert nodded: "I have obtained some definite information. Do you want to listen to it yourself? Or do you want everyone to listen together?"
Under everyone's expectant eyes, "The World" said: "Let everyone listen together!"
Of course, everyone should listen together, so that it is easier to crowdfund.
Hobert nodded: "Okay, the reward is the detailed method of making talismans with 'Worms of Time'. Well, as detailed as possible, I haven't made talismans before."
Klein immediately manipulated "The World" and said: "Deal."
"Little Sun" raised his hand slightly: "Mr. World, can I get a method of making talismans with 'Worms of Time'? What price do I need to pay?"
Klein paused slightly before letting "The World" say: "Your chief should know the specific method. What he lacks now is an existence to pray for power."
Derrick was slightly stunned: "I see, thank you for your answer."
Hobert said to the others: "As for everyone, if you want to join the transaction, you must provide me with a help when I need it. The value of this help will not exceed 1000 pounds."
Klein was slightly stunned: What is this new way of playing?
Fors suddenly recalled the "Justice League" meeting that Hobert held when he returned to Backlund three or four months ago. At that time, the Beyonder characteristics and potion formulas provided by Hobert were all paid for by other members in the form of tasks. Now this method is also used in the Tarot Club?
Audrey thought: My father just talked about Hobert's net worth at dinner yesterday. It is hard to imagine that Hobert has rapidly accumulated millions of pounds of wealth in the past month! But few people know the inside story, and Hobert has no intention of announcing this matter, so everyone does not know this legendary story! But I am very clear that Hobert uses "help" to settle the reward because he does not lack these thousands of pounds at all.
Audrey's idea was right. Hobert really doesn't lack money at all right now, but if this information is completely free, it would be like disrupting the "market rules". And over time, everyone might even take it for granted and not think it's a help to them.
That's why Hobert decided to settle with "favors".
If he needs their help in the future, he can just go directly to a member without owing them any favors.
Even if such "help" isn't needed, other members will see it as a debt, it's just that the "creditor" isn't in a hurry to collect.
Knowing the inside story, Audrey was the first to say, "This kind of transaction is like 'bartering', or using information in exchange for some of our resources or abilities. I am willing to pay in this way."
The others also expressed their willingness. After all, there's no need to spend money on this information now, and they can repay the debt in their own way in the future. Of course, they would be willing to use this kind of transaction!
After agreeing on the reward, Hobert began, "Does everyone remember the ancient god 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf'? Good if you do. First, please have Mr. Fool conjure a statue for me."
After Klein, sitting at the head of the table, nodded, Hobert conjured the statue of the "Mother of the Sky" from the Foggy Town church.
It generally presents a female human figure, with a beautiful face, but two beast legs grow from the ribs and waist, covered with short, thick, hard black hair.
At the foot of the statue, there are souls sleeping.
Seeing this statue, the other members felt both sacred and eerie, wanting to worship it, yet wanting to stay away.
Alger even thought of the Evernight Goddess, but he felt that this idea seemed a bit blasphemous.
Hobert continued, "When I saw the four beast legs of this statue, I thought of the description of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf'. After consulting the relevant information, I confirmed that the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' did indeed have beast legs very similar to those on the statue."
"In the corresponding description, the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' has eight legs, which can also correspond to the statue, after all, the statue also has two arms and two legs."
"So I guessed, could this 'Mother of the Sky' be a relative of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf'?"
The knowledgeable Cattleya finally recalled, "'Mother of the Sky'? Is that the belief discovered in the Hornacis Mountains?"
The other members were all confused and puzzled.
Hobert nodded: "Yes. Oh, right, I haven't told you why I'm explaining the background of this statue."
He glanced at "The World" and, seeing that he had no objections, explained, "Last week, Mr. World and I conducted a joint operation and found this statue in an ancient church."
"At that time, according to our findings, we found clues related to the 'Nation of the Evernight' and the 'Mother of the Sky', but whether it was in ordinary historical materials or in the extraordinary world, there were not many records about it."
"Mr. World is very curious about this, so he entrusted me to investigate the 'Nation of the Evernight' and the 'Mother of the Sky'."
The other members nodded slowly, if they encountered such extraordinary ruins, they would definitely investigate it.
Audrey thought: The cooperation between Tarot Club members has been very frequent recently. A month ago, Hobert, Mr. World, and Mr. Hanged Man launched an exploration. Unexpectedly, last week, Hobert and Mr. World launched another cooperation.
Klein nodded as "The World", this was an affirmation of Hobert's description, and also an approval of this way of describing it, explaining the ins and outs without revealing key information.
After all, breaking into the Chanis Gate of the Saint Samuel Cathedral is not a glorious thing, of course it cannot be spread as one's own glorious deeds.
Cattleya and other members were very curious about their exploration experience and process, but the "Emperor" didn't mean to elaborate, and they didn't ask.
Alger said: "I remember a long time ago, I mentioned in the Tarot Club that the 'Nation of the Evernight' was destroyed by the Church of the Evernight Goddess!"
Audrey also recalled the information announced by Mr. "Hanged Man" at that time, and had a more concrete understanding of the "Nation of the Evernight".
"Yes, but we'll get to the point of the country's destruction later." Hobert continued, "I verified my previous guess with the 'Creator' and got a positive answer. The 'Mother of the Sky' is indeed a descendant of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf'.
"And I also got a very shocking news! Well, I'll talk about this news later, let's talk about 'Mother of the Sky' and Antigonus first.
"They are the daughter and son of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf', both natural mythical creatures. 'Mother of the Sky' is the older sister, and Antigonus is the younger brother."
"Antigonus?" Cattleya asked, "Is that Antigonus who was active in the Fourth Epoch?"
"That's right." Hobert gave a definite answer, "Also the ancestor of the later Antigonus family!"
Everyone was stunned, they didn't expect that this great nobleman of the Fourth Epoch was actually a descendant of the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf"!
Alger suspected: Could it be that the angels, or rather, the great nobles, who were active in the Fourth Epoch can be traced back to the Second Epoch?
Audrey also sighed: Such a background is very unexpected. I originally thought that after the Second Epoch, the ancient demonic beasts with crazy tendencies were basically extinct, but I didn't expect them to become great nobles in the Fourth Epoch!
Emlyn also had a similar idea, he sighed: This is the extraordinary world! There are always some creatures as long-lived as the Sanguine!
Derrick realized: The descendants of the ancient gods who ruled the earth in the Second Epoch, their influence is so far-reaching.
Hobert gave everyone a few seconds to sigh, and then continued: "According to some fragmentary clues I got, I basically restored the birth and demise of the 'Nation of the Evernight'.
"After the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' fell, 'Mother of the Sky' and Antigonus fled to the Northern Continent and hid in the highlands of the Hornacis Mountains.
"Later, in order to stabilize their state, they cautiously developed some believers on the plateau, and as the number of believers increased, the 'Nation of the Evernight' gradually formed.
"And from the pathways of 'Mother of the Sky' and Antigonus, the religious beliefs of the 'Nation of the Evernight' can be explained."
Hobert explained: "In an archaeological work about the 'Nation of the Evernight', historians discovered that the people of this country all believed in the 'Mother of the Sky', but their concept of death was very strange, believing that relatives could be resurrected after death.
"So in this country, when someone dies, they will place the deceased's body at home, waiting for the resurrection of their relatives.
"What is difficult for historians to understand is that, according to some records on the murals, those who died really resurrected!
"If we interpret this process with mystical knowledge, it is not difficult to understand. According to some of Antigonus' abilities, it is not difficult for us to judge that these deceased people were not really resurrected, but became Antigonus' puppets!"
The most surprised person was Klein: Antigonus alone, no, one wolf, can control a small country-scale, or a city-scale, of puppets?

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 582 The Fool and Antigonus
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Justice" Audrey asked, "Emperor, is the scale of the 'Nation of the Evernight' small? Or are there few deceased people there?"
Answering this question was "The World," or rather, Klein, who graduated from the history department: "According to the ruins found on the mountain top, the 'Nation of the Evernight' has at least a city that can accommodate tens of thousands of people, as well as corresponding villages and towns."
Audrey frowned: "Then, there should be many deceased people, right? Of course, the number of deceased people each day may not be large, but for a country of this size, it would accumulate to a large number."
"Emperor" Hobert pondered how to answer before saying, "I said earlier that Antigonus was born as a mythical creature, meaning he was an angel from birth.
"And angels were called demigods in ancient times. They can already do many things that seem like miracles to us!
"Or to put it simply, after becoming a Sequence 2, they are even more like gods, possessing powers and abilities that we can hardly imagine.
"For example, they can manipulate marionettes in units of ten thousand."
"Hanged Man" exclaimed, "If he were a general, he could launch a medium-sized war with his marionettes."
Other members had similar thoughts. In their view, this was more like a miracle!
This was the first time they felt that angels could exhibit god-like powers!
Klein was more concerned: "Why does he need so many marionettes?"
Hobert weighed it in his heart and decided to keep this secret for now. After all, this isn't the 'Lawyer' pathway, nor is it the Sequence 1 advancement ritual for the adjacent pathway 'Arbiter.' It's the kind of information that would be strange for a 'Lawyer' pathway demigod to know.
So, he lied, "I'm not very sure either, but considering that Amon needs to use his avatars to stabilize his state, does he also need a large number of marionettes to stabilize his state?"
Klein nodded slightly, feeling that this method of stabilizing one's state was quite good.
He sometimes worries about needing believers to stabilize his state in the future.
Because that means he must establish his own church and develop his own power.
If he could solve this problem with marionettes, that would be great.
Cattleya asked, "So, some miracles that we find difficult to understand may be things that those angels or gods have to do?"
Could this concept be used to explain the 'Hidden Sage' chasing after Beyonders to instill knowledge?
Hobert didn't know how to answer this question: "Maybe so."
Cattleya nodded slowly: Then a new question arises, "Why does the 'Hidden Sage' chase after us to instill knowledge? Can't he solve the problems he encounters in other ways?"
Audrey exclaimed, "I still can't imagine what it would be like for a city of tens of thousands of people to be under the control of one person's will? Would those people be doing the same actions and saying the same words?
"Goddess, living in such a city, how could the residents of the 'Nation of the Evernight' think that such a bizarre thing is the resurrection of loved ones?"
Through "Justice's" description, everyone seemed to imagine such a bizarre scene.
In a city, some residents' movements and language are normal, while a portion of the residents, regardless of gender or age, are doing the same actions and saying the same words.
Hobert smiled, "This may be the help brought by divinity. Well, I'm not sure about the specific operations, but we can speculate.
"What if we design a personality, life, and identity for a marionette, and then just connect it with a 'spirit body thread,' without managing it, and the marionette can operate on its own according to these designs?"
Sitting at the head of the table, Klein suddenly looked at "The World" sitting opposite him. At that moment, he seemed to see "The World" reveal a strange smile.
But soon, he breathed a sigh of relief. He was just scaring himself.
That's just a puppet! Klein comforted himself: As long as it's a marionette, the spirit body thread is under my control, and it's impossible for him to do anything beyond my expectations.
Audrey exclaimed, "Unbelievable!"
Alger said, "Maybe this is the power of God."
He lowered his head and glanced at the head of the bronze long table. Cattleya also had a similar action. They both knew that this question could get a clear answer from "The Fool."
But they didn't dare to look directly, only daring to look at that mysterious gray fog.
"The Fool" seemed not to notice their gazes and did not offer an explanation.
They didn't dare to ask either, after all, they couldn't figure out the thoughts of the gods. Asking such a question might offend Mr. Fool.
At this time, "The Moon" Emlyn suddenly asked, "Excuse me, can the Beyonders of this pathway give life to dolls? I mean, can they make dolls move on their own?"
Klein quickly made the gray fog cover himself, he was afraid that everyone would see "The Fool" twitching the corner of his mouth!
Hobert also slapped his forehead: This brain hole is also quite bizarre.
Seeing that everyone's expressions were a bit strange, Emlyn didn't feel that there was anything special about his question: "We're just doing some discussions, aren't we?"
"That's right!" Cattleya seemed to understand something: "I don't think so."
She explained, "I heard that to make a marionette, you need to control the other party's 'spirit body thread,' and dolls don't seem to have 'spirit body threads.'"
Even "The Sun" Derrick understood: Mr. Moon likes dolls? Isn't that something only children play with?
Although resources are scarce in City of Silver, there is also the concept of toys, but being laughed at by classmates if you still play with toys after going to school.
Emlyn's disappointment was evident: "That's a pity."
Originally, Klein wanted to tease him, saying that "Seers" can give "spirit body threads" to some items after reaching "high sequence", but he thought about it and didn't say it.
If Emlyn really asks him to give life to his doll in the future, he is really afraid of turning this guy into a marionette, lest he do something disrespectful to life.
After "The Moon's" interruption, a rather serious and bizarre discussion could no longer be serious or bizarre.
Hobert cleared his throat and continued, "The great 'Creator' said that around the early Fourth Epoch, Antigonus advanced to Sequence 1 and began to operate in the Northern Continent.
"This is linked to the information I obtained from other channels before. Antigonus first pledged allegiance to the Solomon Empire and later supported the Tudor Empire.
"His colleagues should be familiar to everyone, Mr. 'Door,' Amon and Adam!"
Suddenly, the mysterious "Nation of the Evernight" was linked to the history that everyone was familiar with.
Hobert continued, "What I'm going to say next has nothing to do with the 'Nation of the Evernight' and the 'Mother of the Sky,' but it's a secret about the Tudor Empire."
This is also one of the reasons why Hobert asked each of them for "help" worth 1000 pounds.
As for the source of this information, Hobert explained it this way: "This information comes from the notes of a member of the Tudor family, and the credibility is quite high."
Everyone never doubted the source of information from "Emperor." Hobert said this purely out of guilt.
He said, "Adam and Amon helped Antigonus become the King of Angels. This process is truly unbelievable."
Other members, including the Fool at the head of the table, straightened their backs. This is the specific method to become the King of Angels. When "Emperor" guessed the way to become the King of Angels before, everyone was very interested.
Even if they don't have the opportunity to become the King of Angels, it doesn't prevent them from wanting to hear how to become the King of Angels.
But that time, he only said a rough idea. This time, there will be specific operations.
Of course, Klein is the one who most wants to get this information, after all, that is the way for the "Seer" pathway to become the King of Angels!
Everyone held their breath and looked at "Emperor," only to hear him say, "First, they captured a demigod of the Solomon Empire. Adam performed deep hypnosis and corresponding memory transplantation, making the other party think that he was Antigonus.
"Then, with Antigonus's cooperation, Amon stole his identity and fate. Antigonus used his corresponding abilities to combine the identity and fate in Amon's hands with the experimental subject.
"The demigod of the Solomon Empire began to live as Antigonus and actively tried to accommodate the uniqueness of the 'Seer' pathway after a period of time, but ultimately failed and lost control.
"At this time, Antigonus lifted his previous abilities, allowing his identity and fate to return to Amon's hands. Amon ended the theft and returned them to the original owner.
"In this way, Antigonus successfully accommodated the uniqueness and became the King of Angels."
Everyone was collectively silent for a few seconds, and then their questions came one after another.
First, Audrey asked, "Adam can do 'memory transplantation,' this, this is really unbelievable."
Originally, she thought that if Adam wanted not to be noticed by everyone, using psychological hints would make everyone not notice him. This was already a very terrifying ability.
But unexpectedly, Adam once again refreshed her understanding of a "high sequence" Spectator, and can actually "transplant memories"!
Just imagine, this is the ability to turn one person into another!
Audrey's heart immediately appeared with such a superficial concept: A and B are enemies, A and C are friends, A asks Adam to help him avenge, so Adam transplants C's memory to B, then A has two friends, and the enemy's personality disappears.
Just thinking about it, she felt cold in her heart.
Hobert vaguely replied, "I'm not very sure about this either, but I said before that the source of this information is relatively reliable, and Adam should have such ability!"
Derrick suddenly asked, "I wonder if Adam can preserve the memories of the dead and then transplant them to another person, um, is this a resurrection in some sense?"
He first thought that it would be great if there was a way to preserve his parents' memories before.
Emlyn said, "You should ask this, transplanting the memory of a dying person to a young person, is this a resurrection in some sense?"
Fors felt that this was very similar to the ideas of some science fiction novels, so she asked, "Then the question is, is this living person the dying person? Or the young person?"
Hobert suddenly clapped his hands: "This is the ability of the King of Angels level. We, as ordinary Beyonders, should not use universal morals and consciousness to think about these things!
"Because this will only consume our energy, and the final result of thinking is of no use to us!
"I suggest that the discussion of this issue ends here. When everyone has enough divinity, perhaps there will be no such problems."
Other members either nodded or used body movements to express their approval. This issue seems to be difficult to have a result.
Alger then asked, "Didn't you say just now that people who have their fate stolen will lose all contact with this world? Is it because Antigonus is a Sequence 1 that he was not harmed in this regard?"
Hobert also felt that this question was difficult to answer. He pondered for a while before saying, "I think Amon did something, or Sequence 1 can last longer in a state without fate."
He only remembered that this happened, but the use of Beyonder abilities can only be explained by speculation, and before that, Hobert did not make corresponding speculations.
Cattleya then asked, "Where did Antigonus's uniqueness come from?"
That is the uniqueness, not potatoes that can be seen everywhere on the roadside.
Hobert had an impression of this: "There are two corresponding pieces of information about this. One is picked up when the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' fell.
"The other piece of information shows that because of the 'Law of Beyonder characteristics Convergence' Antigonus encountered the uniqueness of the pathway."
Hobert spread his hands: "Both of these statements are reasonable, and I have not found any relevant clear records, so I don't know which one is closer to the truth."
Everyone also realized that this was after all something that happened more than a thousand years ago. If Antigonus himself did not leave corresponding records, or knowledgeable people left corresponding notes, it is indeed difficult to restore such details.
Finally, Klein manipulated "The World" to say, "Why did they do this? I mean, does every pathway have to do this to become the King of Angels? Or can this effectively avoid madness and loss of control after accommodating the uniqueness?"
Afraid that Hobert didn't understand, he explained, "What I mean is, if it's just to avoid losing control, then can't Amon simply steal the loss of control when it occurs?
"Adam can also make certain psychological hints to keep Antigonus sane when he loses control."
In fact, there is some risk in asking this, after all, "The Fool" is like the true god of this pathway, but as a blessed one, he doesn't know why?
But this information is very important, and Klein must ask clearly.
Moreover, "The Fool" will not tell all the information of the pathway to the blessed one, so asking this is not a big problem and is worth the risk.
"I understand what you mean." Hobert said, "They obviously have simpler and more practical methods, why would they make things so complicated?"
"The World" nodded, indicating that was exactly what he meant.
Hobert pondered for a moment, then tentatively speculated, "I'm not entirely sure why, but I suspect that accommodating the Uniqueness might require a certain ritual?"
He spread his hands. "Although accommodating the Uniqueness isn't a true advancement, the risks should still be considerable. Using a ritual as an aid would make sense."
Klein slowly nodded, finding this conjecture quite reasonable.
Then he asked, "Why did Amon and Adam help Antigonus? Was it merely to enhance the Tudor Empire's strength?"
Thinking about it, the two brothers had done quite a bit during the Fourth Epoch, seizing Medici's chance to become a god and helping Tudor establish their empire.
Only today did he learn that they had also helped Antigonus accommodate the Uniqueness.
"I think there are two reasons," Hobert said. "First, Antigonus likely had a deal with Tudor, and Tudor asked the brothers for help. Second, Amon was willing to help.
"First, besides Mr. 'Door' truly supporting Tudor, most other great nobles were essentially forced to choose to support Tudor.
"For example, Adam and Amon. We previously traded information about the death of the Ancient Sun God, so everyone should understand that those two brothers certainly wouldn't support Trunsoest, who was favored by the Six Gods.
"It's said that Amon had some conflicts with Solomon, but I'm not sure what they were. However, the brothers certainly wouldn't support the Solomon Empire, which was clearly at a disadvantage and constantly seeking a way out.
"Ultimately, they basically had no choice but to support the Tudor Empire.
"There was also another great noble, Tamara. As far as I know, she betrayed Trunsoest due to unfair treatment from the Six Gods and had no choice but to rely on Tudor.
"So, to win over the wavering Antigonus, wouldn't Tudor promise to help him accommodate the Uniqueness?"
"The World" gave a muffled "Mm," indicating that he thought "The Emperor's" guess was reasonable.
Audrey thought, 'Is this the politics of the Beyonder world? It's similar to the tactics used by current politicians. Well, whether it involves Beyonder abilities or not, the methods of vying for benefits are largely the same.'
Alger crossed his arms. "The Emperor's" reasoning process has given me a more concrete understanding of the Tudor Empire's situation during the Fourth Epoch. It seems the struggles of the four emperors weren't as complicated as I imagined.
Cattleya, however, noticed Tamara mentioned by "The Emperor": Besides the trade with "The Emperor," I've also seen some fragmented records about this family elsewhere. It sounds like this family has quite a story as well.
"Now, for the second reason," Hobert said, "Amon was also very willing to conduct this experiment. After all, he and Antigonus are from adjacent pathways, and he was eager to participate in the process of accommodating the Uniqueness in this pathway, to observe the process."
As for Amon's goals of using this experiment to test the extent of the Celestial Worthy's awakening, to dilute and resist the Celestial Worthy's consciousness, and so on, this information was too secret and not suitable for Hobert to reveal publicly at this time.
Klein, behind the gray fog, always felt that Amon wouldn't be so kind. After all, Amon was born with the Uniqueness, so what was there to observe? But Klein couldn't clearly state Amon's specific purpose.
At this moment, Emlyn, who didn't know about "The Fool's" pathway information, suddenly asked, "Did Antigonus become a god in the end?"
Audrey was slightly surprised, feeling that "The Moon's" question was disrespectful to Mr. Fool, but considering that Mr. Moon hadn't joined the Tarot Club when Hobert announced Mr. Fool's pathway, he might not know about it at all.
Alger couldn't help but secretly glance at the gray fog above: Could Mr. Fool be Antigonus? After all, this great noble from the Fourth Epoch seemed to have completely disappeared after the Blood Emperor's fall. No one knew if he was still alive.
After realizing that the atmosphere in the hall was somewhat tense, Cattleya observed "The Sun," who rarely concealed his emotions, and through some recollections, roughly concluded that Mr. Fool and Antigonus were from the same pathway, but she wasn't sure.
Emlyn also sensed that the atmosphere was a bit off: "Is, is there something wrong with my question?"
"There's nothing wrong with it," Hobert said with a smile. "Antigonus didn't succeed, and couldn't have succeeded."
Emlyn was slightly stunned: "Why do you say that?"
Hobert pondered for a moment: "Because he couldn't obtain all the Beyonder characteristics needed to advance to a true god."
Alger immediately understood "The Emperor's" meaning: Mr. Fool is not Antigonus! Because Mr. Fool possesses some of the key Beyonder characteristics, Antigonus couldn't have succeeded!
Audrey had a similar idea, and at the same time, she thought: Maybe due to unknown reasons, Mr. Fool lost most of his Beyonder characteristics while sleeping, and then Antigonus obtained some of them by chance. When Mr. Fool woke up from his slumber, he took back those Beyonder characteristics!
Then she thought: So, is Mr. Fool the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf" from the Second Epoch?
She didn't continue to think about it, because that idea was too blasphemous!
Fors speculated: Was Amon helping Antigonus accommodate the Uniqueness to resist Mr. Fool, who was from an adjacent pathway? As long as Antigonus became stronger, Mr. Fool, who was sleeping at the time, would become weaker and wouldn't pose a threat to Amon?
Through "The Emperor's" vague answer and her previous speculation about Mr. Fool's state, Cattleya was already certain that Mr. Fool was the true god of the "Seer" pathway!
At this time, "The Fool" Klein still didn't give any reaction to everyone's discussion. He knew that he should give some reaction at this time, but because he didn't know the specific situation of this matter, he didn't dare to give too clear of a reaction.
In the end, he felt that it was better not to give any reaction.
He could just step in and knock them down a peg when the members dared to directly discuss "The Fool."
Finally, he sighed in relief: Hobert seems to know some inside information, but now is not the time to ask about it. Or rather, it's fortunate that he knows some inside information, giving "The Fool" "room to exist," otherwise I would have thought that this was Antigonus's palace?
Hobert thought: Brother Fool, I can only help you this much. The rest is up to you.
Realizing that the atmosphere in the hall was still a bit off, Emlyn didn't continue to ask.
Hobert quickly skipped over this topic: "After the Blood Emperor's fall, Antigonus also disappeared. As for the 'Nation of the Evernight,' as everyone knows, it was destroyed by the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
"At the same time, the great 'Creator' also told me a shocking piece of news: The Evernight Goddess is actually of the same race as Antigonus and the 'Mother of the Sky.'"
