chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 583 The Life of the Goddess
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"The Fool" Klein and the other members took a few seconds to react before expressing their surprise.
Especially Klein, a believer of the Goddess, and "Justice" Audrey, they felt this was completely blasphemous to the gods!
But considering that this news came from "The Creator," they became silent.
After their initial surprise, the other members felt that this seemed like an acceptable fact. After all, they already knew that the God of Knowledge and Wisdom was once a giant dragon!
However, they were still surprised. Could the origins of the gods be traced back to the Second Epoch?
"When I heard this news, I was also very shocked," Hobert said. "But it also seems very logical. After all, it is said that the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' controls both the 'Sleepless' and 'Seer' pathways."
"Moreover, when we traded information about the ancient gods, we mentioned the attendant gods of the ancient gods."
"Among them, the attendant gods of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' included Salinger, the 'God of the Dead,' and Amanises, the 'Goddess of Misfortune.'"
"I only just learned that this 'Goddess of Misfortune' is the later Evernight Goddess."
So, Amanises is the true name of the Evernight Goddess!
Klein realized at this moment that his experience as a Nighthawk gave him a very unique feeling towards this god.
He hadn't felt anything when he heard the true names of other gods before, but hearing the true name of the Evernight Goddess felt very blasphemous! He really wanted to forget this name immediately, but the name lingered in his mind.
Alger, on the other hand, began to recall the names of those attendant gods they had traded before: At the time, he hadn't paid attention to these attendant gods, but now it seemed that after the ancient gods fell, their attendant gods played a significant role in the Third and Fourth Epochs. Currently, just from what I know, four of those attendant gods later became gods, namely the current God of Combat, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and the Evernight Goddess, as well as the fallen Underworld Emperor.
Cattleya realized: When "The Creator" was encircling and suppressing Amon's avatars, he asked "Emperor" to pray to the Evernight Goddess, and received the help of this god. Moreover, "The Creator" knows so many secrets about the Evernight Goddess. These two gods should have been very familiar before, right? Does that mean the origin of "The Creator" can also be traced back to the Second Epoch?
Audrey also thought of this: Do the Evernight Goddess and "The Creator," as well as Mr. Fool, know each other? Have they formed a broad alliance?
This made Audrey feel a little better because, in her opinion, these three gods were full of justice and should be on the same front.
Klein also belatedly realized that "The Creator" and the Evernight Goddess might have known each other before.
Then, he suddenly realized that this was an opportunity for "The Fool" to speak. Otherwise, the members had been discussing "The Fool's" pathway so much, but "The Fool" had not expressed any opinions on this, which would be very strange.
So, Klein, sitting at the head of the table, smiled and said, "Your discussion has reminded me of something!"
Everyone looked towards the head of the bronze table. However, Mr. Fool didn't say specifically what he had recalled, but this was enough to create corresponding associations in everyone's minds.
Audrey sat up straight: I knew it, Mr. Fool must know the Evernight Goddess. It's just that Mr. Fool seems to have only recently awakened from his slumber last year and may not have fully recovered his memories.
Alger also nodded in a "I understand" manner: Maybe Mr. Fool simply doesn't know Antigonus. After all, Mr. Fool was sleeping at that time.
Fors strengthened her previous guess: Amon's help to Antigonus was obviously to prevent Mr. Fool from suddenly awakening. It's a pity that Antigonus still failed, or rather, the arrangements Mr. Fool made before his slumber meant that no Beyonder of the same pathway could replace his position as a true god.
"Moon" Emlyn also pondered in his heart: No wonder the Ancestor asked me to attend this gathering. Mr. Fool must have recalled something about the Evernight Goddess. Since he knows an attendant god from the Second Epoch, there's no reason why he wouldn't know the Sanguine Ancestor, one of the ancient gods at the time.
Hobert smiled slightly and thought to himself: "The Fool" seems to have said something, but also seems to have said nothing at all. But this sentence is just right. This crisis public relations is good!
At this time, "Sun" Derrick, who didn't have a strong sense of identity with the seven orthodox gods, suddenly said, "Mr. Emperor, if the Evernight Goddess and the 'Mother of the Sky' are of the same race, why did the Evernight Goddess destroy the 'Nation of the Evernight'?"
Everyone was stunned: That's right, since they are of the same race from the Second Epoch, shouldn't they help each other? How could the Evernight Goddess simply destroy the "Nation of the Evernight."
Hobert took a deep breath and considered for two or three seconds before saying, "I have a conspiratorial guess here. Since 'Sun' has asked about this, I will share this guess with everyone."
"It doesn't matter if you don't agree with my view, just treat it as listening to a story."
Everyone held their breath and looked at "Emperor." Klein guessed that what "Emperor" was about to say was very likely to be black material about the Evernight Goddess, or black material fabricated by others.
"It is said that after the Blood Emperor fell, the Church of the Evernight Goddess also hunted down Antigonus." Hobert saw that everyone didn't quite understand what this news represented, so he further explained:
"If the Church of the Evernight Goddess attacking the 'Mother of the Sky' can be understood, after all, the 'Mother of the Sky' is an angel of the 'Sleepless' pathway, and attacking Her is to obtain Beyonder characteristics and further strengthen the power of the Church."
"But the question is, why did the Church of the Evernight Goddess also hunt down Antigonus?"
"Is it just because Antigonus supported the Tudor Empire? Then why haven't we seen other churches pursue Antigonus as relentlessly as the Church of the Evernight Goddess? Even now, they still attach great importance to the descendants of Antigonus and related cases?"
"Is it just because Antigonus is one of the gods of the 'Nation of the Evernight,' and they are afraid of his revenge after destroying the 'Nation of the Evernight'?"
Everyone then understood why "Emperor" wanted to emphasize this point. It was indeed a bit illogical.
Moreover, everyone could hear that although "Emperor" kept talking about the "Church of the Evernight Goddess," he was referring to the Evernight Goddess.
Klein first recalled the series of cases triggered by the diary of the Antigonus family. The Church of the Evernight Goddess did attach great importance to such cases.
Then, based on his previous experience as a keyboard warrior, he guessed: Could it be that the Evernight Goddess has some huge secret that she is afraid will be spread by her compatriot Antigonus?
This time, Hobert didn't give everyone time to guess, but simply continued: "So I heard such a guess that in the battle of the gods that occurred in the Second Epoch, the ancient god Lilith fell, taking with her the 'Mutant King' and the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf.'"
"That is to say, in that battle, the opponent of the ancient god Lilith was two other ancient gods?"
"How did She make two ancient gods perish with Her?"
"Before this, regarding this battle of the gods, I also found a related piece of information. It is said that Antigonus once personally saw the blood of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' splatter on the 'Goddess of Misfortune.'"
"This information seems to be a specific description of that battle of the gods, but everyone think carefully, why would the blood of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' happen to splatter on the 'Goddess of Misfortune'?"
Everyone seemed to have thought of something, but they always felt afraid to think further.
"Could it be that the 'Goddess of Misfortune' helped the ancient god Lilith, allowing the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' to complete the process of 'perishing together'?" Hobert said:
"Otherwise, the 'Goddess of Misfortune' is more likely to be dealing with the attendant gods of the ancient god Lilith. Why would She suddenly appear on the battlefield of the three ancient gods?"
Audrey immediately said somewhat excitedly: "Impossible! Absolutely not like that! Perhaps, perhaps She was just going to help!"
Klein, however, already felt that this might be the case. The reason was very simple: With a true god in the same pathway, if you want to become a god, you either have to jump to an adjacent pathway, or backstab the god of that pathway.
And the Evernight Goddess encountered a very tragic thing at the time: Not only was there a true god in the "Sleepless" pathway, but there were also gods in the "Warrior" and "Corpse Collector" pathways.
Then, if you want to become a god, there is only one way!
Klein breathed a sigh of relief. He didn't feel that there was anything shameful about this. If it were him, he would do the same.
One reason is because the ancient gods have limited rationality, and such a boss is terrifying.
Secondly, it was a matter of survival. In an era when ancient gods could start fighting at any moment, even angels didn't have a complete sense of security.
Alger broke out in a cold sweat: I seem to have a chance to become a god? Heh heh, what am I thinking? After leaving the Tarot Club, will I be struck by lightning and turned into charcoal?
Cattleya smiled: The backstabbing between gods! If I hadn't joined the Tarot Club, how would I have learned about this information?
Derrick could now understand Miss Justice's feelings. Based on this lady's previous behavior, she seemed to be a believer of the Evernight Goddess.
During the previous Tarot gathering where they discussed the death of the Ancient Sun God, Derrick had also lost his composure like Miss Justice.
Some things are like that; you don't know how important they are to you until they are touched.
Audrey also realized her loss of composure: "Sorry, I mean, I mean..."
However, Hobert suddenly said: "If the facts are really as speculated, then I think the Evernight Goddess did the right thing!"
The other members were all stunned.
"During the Second Epoch, humans were a race that was slaughtered and enslaved at will by the ancient gods. Although they are called ancient gods, I feel that they should be the enemies of mankind!" Hobert said righteously:
"From the perspective of a human, there is nothing wrong with the Evernight Goddess obtaining the opportunity to become a god from such ancient gods. Moreover, as far as I know, the Evernight Goddess Church is one of the earliest secret organizations to protect humans."
"How early? Perhaps the secret organization of the same period was the Creator of City of Silver, that is, the church of the Ancient Sun God."
"So, it is undeniable that the Evernight Goddess sheltered many humans as early as the Second Epoch!"
"Miss Justice, do you think She did the right thing?"
Audrey fell into a long silence. She felt that her understanding of justice had changed again.
Before this, she was very disgusted with the view of "not caring about the process, only caring about the result", but today she realized that caring too much about the process would also give herself a lot of psychological burden.
So, after a few seconds, Audrey breathed a sigh of relief: "Yes, I think you are right!"
Hobert smiled: "Congratulations, Miss Justice, you are not lost in the maze of universal values."
He put away his smile and said again: "Let's continue."
"Perhaps because the process of the Evernight Goddess becoming a god conflicted with the Demonic Wolf clan, She targeted other Demonic Wolves, such as Antigonus and the 'Mother of the Sky', to prevent their revenge."
"This can also explain why the 'Mother of the Sky' and the Evernight Goddess are on the same pathway, but the 'Mother of the Sky', as a member of the same race, is not an angel of the Evernight Goddess Church."
"It can also explain why, during the Fourth Epoch, Antigonus was loyal to both the Solomon Empire and the Tudor Empire, always standing on the opposite side of the Evernight Goddess!"
Cattleya leaned back in her chair and smiled slightly: Although "Emperor" repeatedly said that this was a 'conspiracy theory' guess, it was a very logical conjecture, and the truth was often so simple.
Alger also sighed in his heart: Among the current seven gods, four already have a black history. The godhood of the Eternal Blazing Sun, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and the Lord of Storms all came from betrayal of the Ancient Sun God. Among them, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom had betrayed twice, once betraying the "Dragon of Imagination" in the Second Epoch, and betraying the Ancient Sun God in the Third Epoch.
He took a deep breath and continued to ponder these blasphemous thoughts: Today, I also learned that the godhood of the Evernight Goddess may also come from a betrayal. Then what about the God of Combat and the Earth Mother? And what about the God of Steam and Machinery? How did their godhood come about? Could there be similar stories?
Klein suddenly breathed a sigh of relief after "Emperor" finished speaking: The truth is often difficult to accept, but whether you accept it or not, it is the truth.
Then he controlled "The World" and asked: "Why did the 'Mother of the Sky' appear in the Evernight Goddess Church's cathedral?"
The other members all looked at "The World": What? The "Mother of the Sky" also appeared in the Evernight Goddess Church's cathedral?
Alger immediately thought: Back then, when the "Mother of the Sky" found it difficult to defeat the Evernight Goddess and couldn't escape, she simply joined the Evernight Goddess Church? This, this contradicts "Emperor's" speculation just now.
Hobert pondered for a moment and said: "Have you noticed that She doesn't seem to have any intelligence."
Klein understood Hobert's meaning: "That's a sealed artifact!"
What? The "Mother of the Sky" became a sealed artifact of the Evernight Goddess Church?
Even Cattleya and Derrick, who had a sense of separation from the orthodox churches, felt it was a bit unbelievable.
But thinking about it, it seemed reasonable. The "Mother of the Sky" might have formed a sealed artifact when she died.
[T/N: she aint dead lol]
Hobert neither nodded nor shook his head at Klein's words, because it was not just a sealed artifact.
Alger smiled and said to himself: This is the end of a loser.
In his opinion, didn't the "Sea God" Kalvetua also become a sealed artifact?
Audrey and Fors felt a little uncomfortable somewhere in their hearts, but they couldn't say exactly where.
Hobert finally concluded: "The 'Nation of the Evernight' eventually perished, the 'Mother of the Sky' became a sealed artifact, and Antigonus also disappeared."
Everyone fell silent again, savoring the information they had just exchanged.
A dozen seconds later, Klein controlled "The World" again and asked: "What is Zaratul's purpose?"
The other members were slightly stunned, Zaratul?
Then everyone thought of the Zaratul family of the Fourth Epoch. Cattleya and Alger also thought of the connection between the Zaratul family and the Secret Order.
This made Alger sigh: What kind of ruins did they encounter in their exploration last week? How can they be related to so many big figures in the extraordinary world?
"I have also done some investigation on this." Hobert said: "Do you want to listen yourself, or do you want everyone to listen together?"
This time, Klein ignored everyone's expectant eyes: "Listen myself."
Zaratul is different from Antigonus after all. Antigonus was a figure from the Fourth Epoch, but that Zaratul may have been a person from more than a hundred years ago. This may involve some secrets of the "Seer" pathway.
Hobert nodded: "Okay, I may ask you to do me a favor in the future, but the total value of this favor will not exceed 2,000 pounds."
"The World" nodded: "No problem."
So, in everyone's disappointed eyes, Klein, sitting at the head, established a separate communication space between "Emperor" and "The World".
"We have traded relevant information before." Hobert said: "The Zaratul family also has to start from the Fourth Epoch."
"It is said that the ancestor of the Zaratul family, um, let's call Him Big Zaratul, and the one we met in the cathedral is called Little Zaratul."
Klein thought of the white-bearded old man and felt that it didn't seem to have much to do with "Little", but in terms of seniority, that was indeed "Little Zaratul".
Hobert continued: "It is said that Zaratul hoped to obtain another Sequence 1 characteristic, so he was loyal to the Solomon Empire."
"However, that characteristic had not been found yet, and He died in the 'War of the Four Emperors'. The characteristic was seized by Antigonus."
Hearing this, Klein thought in his heart: In that case, Antigonus had gathered two Sequence 1 characteristics and a Uniqueness at that time. He was already an King of Angels only one step away from a true god!
He frowned: Two Sequence 1 characteristics have already surfaced, and both of them were once with Antigonus. I don't know if Antigonus has fallen or what his state is? In short, the whereabouts of these two Sequence 1 characteristics are currently unknown, and where is the last Sequence 1 characteristic?
Klein smiled bitterly in his heart: Hobert thought that the Sequence 1 characteristic was with "The Fool", so neither Antigonus nor Zaratul had any hope of becoming a god. Only "The Fool" himself knew that if there was a Sequence 4 characteristic, "Mr. Fool" would not have done such a dangerous thing as stealing notes from the bottom of Saint Samuel Cathedral.
At this time, he suddenly thought: The clue to the Sequence 1 characteristic that Solomon, or rather the True Creator, asked Zaratul to be loyal to, wouldn't it be the third Sequence 1?
The more Klein thought about it, the more he felt it was possible. After all, during the Solomon Empire era, Antigonus had already joined the Solomon Empire as a "Concealment Servitor." Therefore, this Sequence 1 characteristic was obvious and didn't need to be searched for. Later, when Antigonus became the King of Angels of that pathway first, Zaratul wouldn't even think of targeting him. So, what Zaratul wanted to obtain must be the third Sequence 1 characteristic. By relying on two Sequence 1 characteristics, he could also become a King of Angels and be able to contend against Antigonus.
Seeing Klein in deep thought, Hobert waited for a while. Only when Klein seemed to have finished his contemplation did he continue, "Little Zaratul is interesting. I heard that he seemed to have had an accident while advancing to Sequence 3 and disappeared from the Fourth Epoch, directly appearing in the Fifth Epoch."
Klein was slightly stunned and manipulated "The World" to ask, "Was he sealed somewhere at the time? Sealed for hundreds or thousands of years?"
Hobert shook his head. "I'm not very clear about the specifics. It is said that he felt like he went from the Fourth Epoch to the Fifth Epoch overnight."
"The World" chuckled hoarsely, "What a strange encounter."
In his heart, he thought: Could this be considered time-travel?
Hobert continued, "The main reason we know some information about Little Zaratul is because he invested in Roselle after successfully advancing to an angel.
"In some of Emperor Roselle's notes, we can occasionally see some descriptions about Little Zaratul."
Klein behind the gray fog thought: So that's how it is.
With such a "source of information," Klein was even more convinced of what Hobert said.
Hobert continued, "According to some clues we found, Little Zaratul seemed to have obtained the Antigonus family's notes in order to advance to Sequence 1."
Regarding this point, Klein had seen it in Roselle's diary, and he also knew that the Antigonus family's notes were stolen from the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery with Roselle's help.
Hobert said, "Do you remember our previous transaction about the Antigonus family members? Among the members of that family, there is a demigod. It is speculated that their ancestor may have been sealed in the Hornacis Mountains.
"I have verified this information with the great 'Creator.' The answer given by the 'Creator' is that if Antigonus is not dead, he should be there.
"It's just that we don't know what state he is in now."
When it came to high-level information about the "Seer" pathway, Hobert had to be as vague as possible, because just like the empty shell "Creator," if he spoke too detailedly, "The Fool" would easily be exposed!
Klein recalled some of his previous divinations. At this time, he was quite certain that Antigonus should be in the Hornacis Mountains, in an old palace.
Then he could also be sure at this time that the whispers in his ears every time he advanced were influenced by Antigonus!
At the same time, Klein realized that Hobert had concealed something in the previous transaction regarding the "Nation of the Evernight" and Antigonus.
He couldn't help but think: Maybe he wasn't too sure about the authenticity of this information, so he didn't announce it? Of course, it might also be because Hobert felt that this information involved Mr. Fool, and he didn't dare to announce it to everyone.
No matter what the reason, Klein felt that these 2,000 pounds were well spent. He wouldn't even mind paying this sum of money right now!
Hobert continued, "I speculate that Antigonus is indeed in the Hornacis Mountains, and that Antigonus family's notebook may have a subtle connection with Antigonus?
"Of course, it is also possible that this notebook records the hope that Little Zaratul needs to advance to Sequence 1.
"Well, I want to state again that most of what I am about to say is my speculation. I only know some fragmented information, and these fragments can only be filled in with speculation."
"The World" gave a muffled "Hmm." Hobert's speculations had always been very meticulous. Even knowing that it was speculation, Klein was willing to listen, because before knowing the truth, Hobert's speculation was very close to the truth!
Hobert continued, "In any case, Little Zaratul should have arrived at the Hornacis Mountains and obtained a Sequence 1 characteristic.
"And I think this Uniqueness is the Uniqueness that Antigonus seized from Zaratul back then, because Antigonus never had time to accommodate this Uniqueness due to the outbreak of the 'War of the Four Emperors.'
"Under the pursuit of the Evernight Goddess, he fled to the Hornacis Mountains with this Uniqueness and was severely injured by the Goddess there, or simply sealed there.
"Little Zaratul was detected by the Evernight Goddess during the process of advancing to Sequence 1 in the Hornacis Mountains…"
Klein was stunned and manipulated "The World" to ask, "Detected by the Evernight Goddess?"
"Yes, after all, that is the 'Nation of the Evernight.' The 'Foggy Town' we escaped from is also there. Advancing there, of course, the Evernight Goddess will detect it!" Hobert speculated:
"Perhaps Little Zaratul was detected by the Evernight Goddess as soon as he entered the Hornacis Mountains, so he had no choice but to advance in the Hornacis Mountains."
Klein suddenly thought of the palace they came out of from "Foggy Town": Could Antigonus and Little Zaratul be in those palaces?
Hobert continued, "So the Goddess intervened in Little Zaratul, and the specific process of intervention is unknown. My understanding is that a part of Little Zaratul's personality was sealed into 'Foggy Town.'
"I remember you said that Zaratul's advancement failed and he turned into a wriggling maggot. It may be because his personality was incomplete that he failed to advance.
"This seal by the Evernight Goddess may have been sealed for more than a hundred years, until we released part of Zaratul's personality a few days ago.
"Of course, much of the above is my speculation and is for reference only."
In addition to being surprised, Klein manipulated "The World" and asked, "Antigonus has the Uniqueness, and it may not be easy to kill. But for the Evernight Goddess, Little Zaratul should not be difficult to deal with. She can even split and seal his personality? Why not just kill him?
"Also, will our release of Zaratul's personality disrupt the Evernight Goddess's plan?"
Hobert scratched his head before saying, "Regarding your first question, I don't know the specific reason, but I have heard that the 'High Sequence' Beyonders of this pathway seem very difficult to kill."
Klein suddenly understood: It's not that they are very difficult to kill, but that they will be resurrected! If the Evernight Goddess kills them, they will be resurrected! And it is very likely that they will use resurrection to get rid of the Evernight Goddess's control. So the Goddess only seals them, which should be the best way to deal with them.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. Seeing Klein's expression, he knew that he had understood, so there was no need to explain it in too much detail.
He said, "As for the second question, I don't think we need to have such worries at all.
"That is 'Foggy Town' after all, the Evernight Goddess's prison. If she doesn't want to let people out, I don't think we can release people no matter how hard we try.
"As for what the purpose of releasing Zaratul is, that is not something we should consider."
"The World" was silent for a few seconds before saying, "After leaving 'Foggy Town,' I divined Zaratul's current situation again and found that he seemed to have returned to normal. He disappeared from his original position, and I can no longer divine his whereabouts."
Even using this gray fog, he could not divine it. Klein suspected that it was because his Sequence was too low and the power he could mobilize was limited.
However, even if the Sequence becomes higher, it should be difficult to divine Zaratul's whereabouts. That is Sequence 1 of the "Seer" pathway, and its anti-divination ability should have reached a terrifying level.
Hobert nodded, "He should have his own things to do and won't have time to take revenge on us for the time being."
Mainly to take revenge on you! Klein said in his heart: It was you who threatened to scatter his ashes, I didn't say anything.
Hobert added, "The 20,000 pounds I promised you will be given to you later through a sacrifice to Mr. Fool."
Klein was stunned and manipulated "The World" to ask, "Are you taking action so soon?"
"No, I will pay you this money in advance. It will take some time before it can be used."
Klein suddenly asked, "Are light bulbs quite profitable?"
Hobert nodded, "They have made a lot of money, but they have also spent a lot. I have used the money to invest in other cities."
Klein said as if he was notifying him, "I will be going to the Southern Continent recently."
"It's time to go out and relax." Hobert spread his hands and said, "Staying in Backlund for too long makes you feel bored."
Then he added, "Write to me if anything happens."
"Okay." Klein instructed "The World", "I need to borrow the 'Tyrant' card for a bit. What compensation should I pay?"
Hobert didn't ask why he wanted to borrow it, he just said, "Borrow it first, and we'll settle it together later."
Then he added, "Oh, right, 'The Creator' agreed to let me trade this 'Blasphemy Card' with you, but the reward is a Beyonder material at Sequence 3 level.
"Given that you currently don't have the strength to provide such a reward, I can lend it to you first, and we'll discuss the specific transaction after you advance to a demigod."
"Alright."
The two ended their private exchange, and the trading session continued.
"The World's" gaze turned to Fors: "I have a commission."
Fors was slightly taken aback: "A commission for me? I recently…"
"Don't rush to refuse." Klein manipulated "The World" to say, "Help me contact the Abraham family. I want to obtain information about the spirit world city of Calderón from them, most importantly, its location."
Cattleya had some understanding of Calderón City: "World", why are you suddenly looking for this mysterious spirit world city? Is it an instruction from Mr. Fool?
Hobert thought to himself: No wonder he wants to borrow the "Tyrant" card from me. It turns out he plans to use the method of summoning himself to collect the Beyonder materials needed to advance to Sequence 4.
The other Tarot Club members didn't know what city "The World" was looking for, so they could only remain silent.
Fors pondered for a moment before saying, "No problem, I will help you inquire."
"The World" asked in a flat tone: "How much compensation do you need?"
"500 pounds." Fors smiled and said, "If you get the information you need, add another 300 pounds."
Klein manipulated "The World" to say: "Deal."
No other members initiated new transactions, so this Tarot Gathering came to the free exchange session.
At the beginning of this session, Alger asked "The Sun": "Have you investigated the matter of the former chief's mausoleum clearly?"
"Little Sun" replied somewhat shamefully: "No, I have been constantly assigned patrol missions during this period, and I have never had time to investigate."
Alger was not surprised by this. He asked somewhat strangely: "Why don't you find friends you are acquainted with to help?
"You can not tell them the real purpose, break the whole thing into small, inconspicuous tasks, and let them collect information on different aspects separately.
"This will neither expose anything nor implicate them in a dangerous situation."
Derrick was silent for a few seconds and then said somewhat shamefully: "I have no friends."
In fact, he originally had some friends when he was taking general knowledge education classes and training in the combat training ground, but after Derrick took on the secret of the Tarot Club, he gradually drifted away from these friends without realizing it, and there was not much contact.
The last time someone visited his house, they were polluted by the "True Creator".
Alger was choked by "The Sun's" answer, took a breath, and then reorganized his words: "This is not good for you.
"You can't save City of Silver by yourself. You must unite a group of people, have some friends who can provide you with help at critical moments."
Derrick said with some concern: "But, this will make them suspected."
Alger suddenly said seriously: "Being suspected is better than being killed!
"City of Silver is at a dangerous crossroads, you must consider carefully what to do.
"It is impossible for there to be no sacrifices in this kind of thing, and there may even be a lot of sacrifices. Do you want their sacrifices to be useless, or very valuable?"
Everyone listened quietly to "The Hanged Man's" advice. Hobert and Fors and other members sighed. "The Sun" should have been a carefree teenager at this age, but in City of Silver, he has to bear such a heavy burden.
Only Emlyn said in his heart: Is there still a choice? Does this guy think he has the ability to solve the problem of the Forsaken Land of the Gods? Even True Gods can't do this.
At this moment, Derrick's heart was full of struggle and pain. He realized that his previous actions seemed to have problems.
Alger didn't persuade him anymore, the rest needed him to figure out for himself.
No one else comforted him, because at this time, no language would have a comforting effect.
The hall was silent for a few seconds, and "The World" suddenly looked at "Justice": "Can you treat more serious mental illnesses now?"
Audrey's spirit perked up, and she eagerly replied: "Yes.
"Mr. World, do you have a friend who needs treatment?"
Klein sighed silently and made "The World" smile and say: "No, I need treatment."
Last week, after the operation with Hobert ended, when Klein went back to review, he realized that although Hobert seemed a bit reckless, his mental state was very good.
So Klein examined his own mental state. It was okay not to examine it, but after examining it, he found that his mental state was not very healthy.
The entire magnificent palace suddenly became quiet.
Alger and Cattleya both knew that Mr. World was the crazy adventurer Gehrman Sparrow, but they never thought that he had already developed a more serious mental illness?
Hobert also sighed silently in his heart: I discovered long ago that Klein put too much psychological pressure on himself and became a little withdrawn. However, I also know that there is only one way to solve this problem: avenge the captain!
Audrey carefully observed "The World" with some surprise, and then recalled "The World's" previous words and deeds: "Mr. World, according to my observation, you should not have a more serious mental illness.
"If it's just simple anxiety, you can relieve and recover through self-regulation and self-relaxation, and you don't need to receive treatment."
"The World" smiled and said: "I am just making an appointment now. If similar symptoms appear in the future, I hope to receive timely treatment."
Audrey thought for a while before saying: "No problem, but I may need a friend to send me for treatment. I hope you can be mentally prepared."
She planned to have Hobert use "Travel" to send her for treatment if needed: It's so extravagant, seeing a doctor requires a demigod to pick you up and drop you off. If you weren't a member of the Tarot Club, the consultation fee alone would be a big expense.
"The World" said in a low voice: "Okay."
Everyone talked about some interesting things they encountered last week. When no one spoke, Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.
… …
Empress Borough, in Earl Hall's luxurious villa.
After Audrey returned to the real world, she looked at the ceiling in a daze for a long time: Goddess… the Goddess is actually from the Demonic Wolf clan!
In the minds of other believers, God is God. This is a symbol, a sign!
But through several transactions of the Tarot Club, Audrey knew that God was once a Beyonder.
But in her subconscious, all the righteous gods should be human beings. Before, when she knew that the God of Knowledge and Wisdom was a giant dragon, Audrey was just a little surprised and didn't feel anything.
At today's gathering, involving the Evernight Goddess she believes in, she truly realized the seriousness of this problem.
Audrey slowly got up and stretched.
The race issue can be put aside for now. The means by which the Evernight Goddess obtained the godhood made Audrey feel blasphemous just thinking about it.
She couldn't help but shake her head with a smile, and said in her heart: "This reminds me of a sentence Hobert said before, some things are better not known than known.
"At that time, I just thought he was complaining. Under my observation, I can see a lot of his thoughts. Today I realized that he was actually reminding me to use the 'Mind Reading' ability sparingly. Knowing too many things is not a good thing."
Thinking of this, Audrey put away her smile: Thinking about it this way, Hobert has repeatedly described to me in conversations that this world is not a black and white world. He has been trying to get me to notice this, to get me to mature as soon as possible, but I have focused on other things.

Hobert saw the familiar roof and suddenly yawned.
Bathed in the warm sunlight, feeling lazy all over, and with his beloved by his side, it was the perfect condition for an afternoon nap.
But he couldn't sleep today. He yawned again, having arranged the altar to receive the bestowal and obtained the method of making talismans using the "Worm of Time."
This knowledge appeared directly in his mind. He only needed to "recall" it, and the knowledge would immediately appear.
Fors also struggled to get up: "I have to write a letter to my teacher."
Hobert tidied up the altar but found her lying down again: "Why aren't you writing?"
"I'll lie down and think about it first, then get up and write when I've got it all figured out," Fors said, yawning as she spoke.
"Oh." Hobert began packing up to return to Backlund. He put on his coat, took the documents Fors had brought about the Longtail Island, and three coconuts.
Finally, he picked up his cane. When he looked at Fors again, the writer was already asleep, still contemplating how to write her letter.
Hobert smiled helplessly, kissed Fors on the forehead, and then used "Travel" to return to Backlund.
He arrived at his study and had just finished offering the 20,000 pounds in cash and the "Tyrant" card to "The Fool" when the butler, Dophis, reported, "A Mr. Leonard wants to see you."
Hobert was taken aback and immediately got up: "Take me to him."
Soon, in a small reception room, Hobert met Leonard, who had black hair, green eyes, and outstanding looks but a somewhat scattered and casual temperament.
He smiled and said, "It seems the light bulb factory is very busy!"
"It's alright, probably not as busy as you guys," Hobert said with a smile. "You seem to have something urgent to discuss? Why didn't you send a messenger with a letter?"
"Because the matter I want to discuss with you is very confidential!" Leonard said with rare seriousness.
Hobert understood his implication and asked Dophis to leave first. After the door was closed, he asked, "What is it?"
Leonard was still a little uneasy. He took out a silver dagger, built a wall of spirituality, and then whispered, "I discovered a big secret today."
Hobert thought: Could it be that he discovered that I entered the Chanis Gate?
But he remained calm on the surface and said, "What is it? That you had to come and find me in person?"
"Klein is not dead!" Leonard's expression was very complicated at this time, with relief, surprise, and incomprehension!
Hobert was very surprised: How could I have forgotten this? So, you've already gone to Tingen City to dig up the grave?
Leonard took a deep breath: "When I came to this conclusion, I was as surprised as you."
Hobert "mm"ed, but thought to himself: Actually, the points we're surprised about are different!
Leonard continued, "This morning, when I was sorting out old cases, I got a photo of that so-called Sherlock detective, not long after he came to Backlund, and I accidentally discovered that it looked very similar to Klein.
"So I mentally removed the glasses and mustache from the person in the photo, and it was at least eighty percent similar to Klein!
"I immediately re-investigated Sherlock Detective's landlord. This great detective only did very simple disguises when he first appeared.
"Haha~" Leonard suddenly laughed excitedly: "Unless Klein has a twin brother, it's hard to convince me that it's not Klein!
"At the same time, the timing also matches. Sherlock appeared a week after Klein 'died', and Sherlock was also involved in the Lanevus case.
"And the subsequent Capim case and the Backlund smog incident were all him tracking down Ince Zangwill."
Leonard clenched his fist excitedly and finally concluded, "Sherlock is Klein. He has been looking for Ince Zangwill! He has never forgotten to avenge the captain!"
Hobert then began to perform, as if belatedly realizing: "You mean, Klein is not dead?"
"No, he's more likely to have been resurrected!" Leonard said, "I was present at the autopsy, and he was dead at the time!
"Before the case of the Evil God's Descendant's Advent, I discovered that he seemed to be connected to a hidden Beyonder organization.
"He must have wanted to avenge the captain so much that he sacrificed something important as the price to resurrect!"
Leonard looked at Hobert with a serious face: "Let's go to the cemetery in Tingen City to confirm it together."
"Goddess above, you're not going to dig up Klein's grave, are you?" Hobert smiled bitterly in his heart: Goddess above, this guy is actually inviting me to dig up a grave together. Thank you very much, you're thinking of me for such a good thing.
Leonard took a deep breath: "If this isn't confirmed, how can people feel at ease?"
Hobert pinched his forehead: "You're right, I'll have the butler book train tickets."
"Don't you have an artifact with the ability to 'Travel'?" Leonard asked strangely. "Do you still need to take the train?"
Hobert smacked his lips: "This, this news is too shocking, it's making me a little confused."
Leonard nodded: "Understandable. When I first came to this conclusion, I almost fell while walking normally.
"By the way, please ask the butler to bring some shovels and spades and other tools."
Hobert had no choice but to take the tools and use "Travel" to bring Leonard to the cemetery in Tingen City.
Leonard suddenly stopped after walking two steps in the cemetery.
Hobert glanced at the tombstone in front of Leonard, which was Old Neil's tomb.
He sighed in his heart: I saved him twice, but I still couldn't save him.
Then Hobert reminded Leonard: "Not everyone has the chance to be resurrected. Some people die and that's it."
Leonard nodded: "I know!"
Soon, the two arrived at Klein's grave and began digging.
At this time, there were still many people in the cemetery mourning deceased friends or relatives. They were somewhat surprised to see these two young men digging graves.
It's still broad daylight! They wouldn't be grave robbers, would they?
Soon everyone reacted, bid farewell to their friends or relatives who were sleeping in the cemetery, and quickly left.
Before leaving, they did not forget to take another look at the two young men, who were still working hard. Many people decided to call the police immediately!
Because there was no grave mound, Hobert and Leonard quickly dug into the tomb. The coffin inside was open, and there was nothing in the somewhat old wooden coffin.
Hobert sighed: The scene where I pulled Klein out of the grave is still vivid in my mind.
"As expected." Leonard slowly released the shovel in his hand and looked at the coffin as if he was talking to himself.
"It seems your guess is right." Hobert reached out and closed the coffin: "However, I think we should keep this a secret."
Leonard also came back to his senses: "You're right!"
So the two filled the grave pit again and returned to Backlund before the police arrived.
In the drawing-room of the Earl's residence, Leonard took a sip of the tea that had already cooled down and suddenly said, "I know where to ask about Klein's whereabouts."
Of course, it's to find that Dwayne Dantes. He now strongly suspects that he must know Klein!
Leonard looked at Hobert: "I'm going to the Southern Continent with Daly's team recently. If there's any news about Klein, how should I tell you?"
"Write a letter!" Hobert said, "My messenger is quite capable, and we've also signed a contract. You don't have to worry about the contents of the letter being leaked."
"Okay." Leonard got up to say goodbye.
Hobert added: "By the way, help me contact Ms. Daly and say I have something to meet with her. It's best to chat with her before she goes to the Southern Continent."
"No problem."
After seeing Leonard off, Hobert shook his head and smiled. He really didn't expect that he could participate in the process of digging a grave.
Don't mention it, it's quite refreshing, after all, that's digging the grave of "The Fool"!
Returning to his study, Hobert sighed: Leonard is going to the Southern Continent, and Klein is also going to the Southern Continent. This means that Ince Zangwill's death is not far away, and it also means that Klein will have the opportunity to be promoted to demigod.
He paused and thought again: If Klein writes to me for help, I will immediately go to war, after all, I also want to beat this old boy.
Although I will meet Adam, He is here to take away "0-08", so He basically acts as an Spectator in this event and there will be no danger.
And I can also take this opportunity to talk to Adam.
The only thing that Hobert cares about is whether to tell Ms. Daly the truth?
This is something that Hobert was still hesitant about before today. With his participation in the war, Daly will definitely not die in the battle, but I can't guarantee what Daly's state will be after avenging her revenge?
It was only when he was digging the grave just now that Hobert made up his mind to tell Daly the truth, and then let Daly choose what to do next.
The next day, which was Tuesday, Hobert first received good news that the laboratory of the manor had made a major breakthrough!
The first is the research on the conversion of electrical energy and acoustic energy. The experiments have been successful many times and have basically found a way to convert the two.
In other words, the world's first telephone was born!
In addition, major breakthroughs have been made in the research on plastics. Researchers have found additives suitable for plastics. Currently, plastics can be made strong and durable.
This is the best choice for battery casings. It is non-conductive and corrosion-resistant, and is more suitable than the hard rubber currently in use.
All these breakthroughs started on Friday night last week.
After attending a banquet called Dwayne Dantes, the two researchers suddenly recalled some inspiration from a long time ago and felt that they should experiment with these ideas.
So they experimented overnight, and it turned out that their inspiration was exactly the correct experimental result they had been searching for.
After receiving this news, Hobert not only immediately issued rewards ranging from 100 pounds to 3,000 pounds to the relevant researchers, but also sighed that the three "Worms of Time" he had spent were really worth it.
Not to mention the results of plastics, this is a material that is completely different from metal and wood and has a wide range of applications.
It will not rust, does not need to be painted, and is very light and durable.
As for the telephone, this is an invention with epoch-making significance. From the birth of the first telephone, it means that the speed of information dissemination has suddenly become many times faster.
This change is enough to change the entire era.
At the same time, in the morning, Hobert also received a letter from Daly sent by a messenger, inviting him to meet at St. Samuel's Church at two o'clock in the afternoon.
If he hadn't seen Leonard yesterday and suddenly received such a letter, Hobert would have suspected that he was being lured.
At 1:55 p.m., Hobert used "Travel" to come to the street near the church, and then walked into the church.
Ms. Daly, with her green eyes, blue eyeshadow and blush, giving people a bewitching beauty, was already sitting on the church's bench, seemingly having just finished praying: "Long time no see."
Hobert also smiled: "Long time no see."
"I heard Leonard said you were looking for me?"
"That's right." Hobert didn't sit down at all: "Can I invite Ms. Daly to my territory, um, I have something I want to ask you to help with."
Daly got up and smiled: "If I didn't know you were married, I would have thought you were looking for an excuse to date me."
The two walked out, and Hobert asked, "Have you been busy lately?"
"I have to travel to major cities in Loen now, so I'm very busy." Daly smiled: "The recent newspapers have been reporting about light bulbs, which is a brand new product."
She said: "I have done experiments, and some spirits with very weak power are even afraid of the light of electric lights."
Hobert was slightly stunned: "There is such a thing?"
He didn't expect this.
Daly nodded: "According to our research, light is very similar to sunlight."
Hobert, who had already walked to a deserted corner, propped up an arm and smiled: "Maybe I should contact the Eternal Blazing Sun Church to see if they have any demand for electric lights."
Daly took Hobert's arm: "I seem to have introduced you to a big business."
At this time, the space in front of the two became illusory, Hobert took a step forward and took Daly into the spirit world.
A minute later, they appeared in the study of the Lord's Mansion of South Colson.
The courtyard where the study was originally located was damaged during the battle between Hobert and the Aurora Order's "Black Knight", and it has just been rebuilt.
Fors had already been waiting here: "Ms. Daly, hello."
Daly smiled: "Hello, Countess."
Fors knew that this was Hobert's friend, so she said: "Just call me Fors."
Hobert took out a teacup from his arms: "I'm not going to ask you to drink tea. This is a mystical item."
He said: "This mystical item can change your appearance. Well, you need to change your appearance for a while, it's best to change it in a way that no acquaintances can recognize."
Then Hobert said to Fors: "You help Miss Daly choose a dress with local characteristics, it's best not to have any Backlund-style decorations."
After speaking, Hobert left the study and waited in the front hall.
Daly in the study asked Fors strangely: "What exactly does Hobert want me to do?"
She thought that Hobert's territory had ghosts or something that needed her ability to help.
Fors smiled and said, "I don't know either. Hobert only told me to help you change your clothes."
In fact, when Hobert came in the morning, he briefly told her the whole story, but Fors also felt that now was not the time to tell Daly the truth.
Daly smiled and said, "If you hadn't come to help me change my clothes, I would have thought Hobert had some ideas about me?"
"Ah?" Fors was stunned. Isn't this Ms. Daly from Loen? Why does she speak like those Loenese people in the colonies?
After changing clothes and disguising her appearance, the two came to the front yard to find Hobert.
Hobert nodded with satisfaction: "Not bad, if I hadn't come to me with Fors, I wouldn't have recognized you."
Then he said: "Ms. Daly, next I will take you to see an acquaintance, maybe you miss him day and night, maybe you have forgotten him.
"But no matter what, in order not to break his peaceful life, please be sure to control your emotions."
Daly smiled and said, "You mysteriously asked me to come here just to see someone?"
"Yes, please come with me." Hobert used "travel" to take Daly to the roof opposite the Special Operations Department.
At this time, it was not far from the afternoon class time, and Elliott and other team members went to the classroom in twos and threes.
The scorching sun was the most venomous at this time. Although Hobert and Daly were not afraid of heat and cold, they were very uncomfortable being exposed to the sun like this.
Just as Daly was about to ask a question, she saw a familiar figure appearing on the street.
Daly rubbed her eyes, thinking she had seen it wrong.
Upon closer inspection, it was really that person!
She suddenly felt cold all over, and her whole body became weak.
Is this another illusion? Another dream?
If it is a dream, she hopes this dream will be longer, because she hasn't dreamed of him recently.
She is so lonely, she is so sad, did he forget himself in the underworld? Otherwise, why is he unwilling to appear in his dreams?
Daly took a few deep breaths and was about to reach out to stop him, but Hobert said beside her, "I said, it's best not to disturb his peaceful life."
Only then did Daly see that he was chatting and laughing with the street vendors, while chatting, he was also smoking a pipe, no longer as rigorous as before, nor as cold as before.
After chatting for a while, he looked at his pocket watch, said goodbye to the vendors, and came to the yard with the sign "Special Operations Department" hanging on it.
He greeted a few people in the yard casually, occasionally stopping to say a few words, and finally, he entered a classroom.
The students who had been waiting in the classroom immediately stood up, and he began to talk to everyone with a smile.
That smile was cheerful, sincere, and not like the bitter smile that was always revealed in Tingen City.
After watching for a long time, Daly asked, "Can I, can I take a closer look?"
She could feel that Dunn had a new life, and he loved his new life very much.
"Of course." Hobert said, "But you have to wipe away your tears first, and control your emotions."
Only then did Daly realize that tears had already filled her entire face. After wiping away the tears with a handkerchief, she waved her hand towards her chest and abdomen, where a phantom door seemed to open.
A palm-sized, tiger-headed little ghost peeked out from the phantom door. Daly grabbed the ghost and pressed it to the position of her heart.
In an instant, Daly's appearance changed, her face was pale, unlike a living person. Her whole temperament also seemed to have changed, as if she had suddenly lost all emotions and feelings.
Only then did Hobert leave the roof with her and came to the Special Operations Department.
Currently, the main force in the Nancolson Special Operations Department is the second team, and Angus's first team has been transferred to Longtail Island.
After chatting with Helen, who had rushed over after hearing the news, Hobert took Daly to the classroom and sat in the last row.
Everyone in the classroom also saw the lord bringing in a strange woman, but Hobert waved his hands at everyone as soon as he entered the door, asking everyone to continue listening to the lecture, so everyone did not stand up.
Dunn also nodded at Hobert before continuing to lecture: "...As I said just now, this is everyone's last class.
"I have already talked about the knowledge of mysticism and the response to some common cases.
"In the last class, let's talk about the perception ability of spirituality.
"I have already talked about the relevant theoretical knowledge before, so I won't repeat it here.
"What I want to tell you is that the spirituality of Beyonders is quite sensitive. When you accidentally encounter the target or clue you are desperately looking for, you have a certain probability of feeling it.
"Even if her performance is unfamiliar to you, even if it seems to be far from the clue you are pursuing..."
Elliott, sitting under the podium, was slightly stunned: Teacher Dunn used the wrong word, it should be "it" instead of "her".
Dunn lectured for more than half an hour, and then asked Hobert to speak on stage.
Hobert got up, said a few platitudes first, and then began to talk about practical things: "You will be the third team members of the Special Operations, yes, this is a team specially established for you.
"You will be stationed on Longtail Island with the first team, but you will be stationed on the east side of the port, which has not yet been developed, but after you move in, the construction work there will begin.
"There will be casinos, extraordinary auction houses, and real estate development. Your work is very difficult..."
It was after four o'clock in the afternoon that the class was over.
The students went back to pack their luggage, and they had to have dinner with Teacher Dunn in the evening.
Hobert took Daly back to the lord's study, and Daly grabbed the ghost that she had placed in her heart before and put it back into her body.
At this time, Daly's emotions had stabilized and calmed down.
She looked at Hobert and couldn't help but smile: "I didn't expect you to play such a big joke on me."
Hobert spread his hands: "You should know better than me that if the Church of the Evernight Goddess knows that Dunn is still alive, they will definitely send someone to arrest him, and I will not be spared, and may be forced to break with the Church of the Evernight Goddess."
"I don't blame you." Daly said, "I am very grateful to you, really, very grateful to you."
Hobert took a deep breath: "Although according to your reaction, my question seems a bit redundant, but I still want to ask: Do you want to come to South Colson and live with Dunn?"

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 585: The Revolt of the Theosophy Order
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Daly didn't immediately answer Hobert's question. Instead, she looked into Hobert's eyes and said, "I need you to answer two questions for me first."
Hobert sat on Daly's side and said, "Go ahead."
"Why are you helping Dunn?" Daly asked. "According to my investigation, you only met Dunn a few times in Tingen City. Yet, you're willing to take such a big risk to help him?"
Hobert leaned back in his chair and smiled. "I didn't expect you to have investigated me."
"As a friend, I won't reveal your secrets to the Church," Daly said seriously. "But as a 'Red Glove,' I naturally need to have a comprehensive understanding and evaluation of you."
Hobert spread his hands. "Alright, that's your job after all."
He crossed his legs and said, "As you can see, Backlund is shrouded in mist. In fact, it's not just Backlund, but the entire human world is shrouded in the mist of humanity and madness."
"However, there are always some rays of light that can pierce through the mist and shine on the dim earth."
"Dunn is that light, so I will save him."
Don't ask for details. If you ask, it's just, do you believe in the light?
Daly nodded slowly, noncommittal to this answer. "Then, what method did you use to revive Dunn? What are the side effects?"
Mainly, she felt that Dunn seemed to have changed drastically, which made her wonder if it was really Dunn. She had handled many cases where people wanted to use evil gods to revive their families, resulting in tragedies.
The process of her acquaintance with Hobert, the Beyonder cases she handled, was about the Henry couple wanting to revive their son, but their son turned into a zombie, and the couple also died in the ritual.
"When Captain Dunn died, I asked 'The Creator' to preserve some of his flesh, as well as his Beyonder characteristics and spirit body." Regarding this, Hobert told the truth:
"Later, I met a 'Classical Alchemist' and asked her to use Captain Dunn's flesh to refine a body. Then, using the Beyonder characteristics as a medium, the soul was fused with the flesh, forming the current Dunn."
"It can be said that whether it's the body or the soul, it's almost identical to Dunn himself. Even he himself feels that there is no discomfort at all."
"Oh, and by the way, I also helped him treat his hair loss problem."
In the corruption incident that occurred in the Boklun Mountain Manor before, Daly and Leonard already knew that Hobert was a devotee of "The Creator," so they could safely mention "The Creator's" help in front of Daly.
Hobert picked up the teapot, intending to pour Daly a cup of tea, but realizing that the tea was already cold, he put the teapot down again. "As for the side effects, it consumes a 'Stone of Life' every year."
"But don't worry about this. I have a good relationship with the Church of the Earth Mother, so I'll take care of the 'Stone of Life' matter."
"Another thing is that Captain Dunn's current state is almost impossible to lose control, but it's also very difficult to advance."
He finally said, "When Captain Dunn had just 'awakened,' I asked him for his opinion on whether to revive him. At first, he really didn't have the idea of reviving."
"Until I mentioned that the people in the Southern Colson area who were being persecuted by some secret organizations were in great need of someone to help me train a group of decent official Beyonders, Dunn decided to stay and help me."
"After living in this picturesque town for a long time, Dunn gradually fell in love with it, and his temperament seemed to have changed somewhat."
"However, I think it's a change for the better, at least he knows how to enjoy life."
Daly fell into a long silence. After about two or three minutes, she said, "Just now, I thought that as long as he was alive, that was enough, but suddenly I also desperately hope to live here."
She asked Hobert, "Do you think Dunn can accept me?"
Hobert spread his hands. "That's a matter between you two. I can't give you any advice."
"As a friend, I can only help you say goodbye to your previous life and stay here if you want to stay in Southern Colson."
"I'm willing to stay," Daly said immediately.
The previous life and death separation made Daly cherish this opportunity very much. Even if she still couldn't be with Dunn, Daly would be satisfied if she could see him often.
"Don't you ask me how to let you stay?"
Daly smiled and said, "Do I look like I don't trust you that much?"
Hobert said with a chuckle, "Yes!"
...
That night, Dunn finished dinner with his students and saw Hobert on the dark street on his way home: "Is that Daly?"
Hobert smiled helplessly. He knew when he heard Dunn's lecture that Dunn used his spiritual perception to determine that it was Daly: "Sorry, I didn't say hello to you before bringing her here."
"No, I want to thank you," Dunn said. "I've been thinking about a lot of things during this time, especially in terms of feelings. My previous performance was like, like a coward."
Hobert said, "I can probably guess your state of mind at the time."
"After all, you are engaged in a job where you may lose your life at any time. In order to avoid the sadness of the living, you are not very dare to express your emotions."
"There is no cowardice or cowardice in this, it's just that you have seen too many partings of life and death, and you don't want the people you love to bear such pain."
Dunn didn't refute, but was silent for a while before asking, "Is she, is she okay?"
"She has been seeking opportunities to avenge you," Hobert replied. "I learned that her next revenge action has a great risk, so I brought her to see you."
Dunn smiled wryly.
"However, she now has other plans," Hobert smiled. "She plans to go back to complete her last task, then say goodbye to her past life, and move here to live with a new identity."
Dunn looked at Hobert's back: "Thank you."
Hobert didn't look back, but showed a bright smile: "You're welcome!"
...
The next day, Hobert in Backlund learned that Klein, Leonard, and Daly had taken an airship to the Southern Continent.
Of course, they didn't know each other's identities, but they happened to hitch a ride with the military.
Not long after they went to the Southern Continent, Leonard first asked a messenger to send a letter to Hobert.
The content of the letter was very simple. He had contacted Klein and found clues to Ince Zangwill. They were tracking him down separately.
Hobert replied: I also hope to participate in this revenge. If you find Zangwill's trace, write to me immediately.
That afternoon, Klein sent another letter to Hobert, also stating that he had found clues to Ince Zangwill. If he got his exact whereabouts, please Hobert provide some help.
Hobert replied: If you don't call me to besiege Ince Zangwill, you don't treat me as a friend. I will hit you once every time I see you in the future! Pray to 'The Creator' in case of emergency, write to me if you are not in a hurry!
After sealing the letter, Hobert summoned Klein's messenger, Reinette Tinekerr, wearing a long black dress and carrying four heads in her hand, from the spirit world.
After Hobert gave the letter to Her, he said, "The cost of this letter will be paid by the recipient."
Reinette's four heads said: "You... really... are... friends... both... so... thrifty..."
...
Southern Continent.
After learning that Hobert chose the "cash on delivery" form, Klein was stunned.
After paying the messenger a gold coin, he murmured to himself: "Didn't I make it clear in the letter? Sending a letter requires paying gold coins!"
...
Hobert in Backlund has also been very busy recently. In addition to continuing to implement his investment, he is also constantly receiving new orders.
These new orders all come from his "shareholder group."
Especially on July 12, the big light bulb that had been lit in "Order Square" for 43 days went out.
The middle class once again set off a wave of ordering light bulbs!
It has been lit for 43 consecutive days! This made them very confident in the quality of 'Earl's Light' bulbs.
At the same time, the people around "Order Square" felt very uncomfortable, and the entire square became dark again.
So on the evening of the 13th, when Hobert was invited to attend a small dance party hosted by Earl Hall, the mayor of Backlund proposed the idea of building circuit lights around "Order Square."
Other councilors and nobles who attended the dance party also expressed their willingness to promote relevant construction plans.
Some councilors also said that they would try to promote the intention of installing electric lights in their departments!
Then in the future, "Earl's Light" will receive a continuous stream of street lights and government departments installing electric lights business. This is the benefit of having a 'shareholder group'. Orders for this kind of government construction will be delivered to your door.
At the same time, shareholders reminded Hobert that someone was already imitating light bulbs, so he asked him to find a way to prevent counterfeiting.
This reminded Hobert: "This matter is very serious and must be handled properly!"
After finishing the business, Audrey, wearing a light green dress, showed her youthful beauty and complained: "Since 'Earl's Light' started construction, you have become the protagonist of the banquet, and it has become difficult to say a word to you."
Hobert smiled and said: "I actually want to make similar complaints, but that would be a bit irresponsible. After all, so many people have invested in 'Earl's Light', and I always have to be responsible for their interests."
Audrey nodded first to show her understanding, and then whispered: "Let's go out for barbecue again when we have time. During this time, I asked the chef to make many kinds of barbecue, but it's always not as delicious as the barbecue you made."
"No problem," Hobert agreed readily: "I also want to eat one recently."
"Well, let me think about it. I seem to be quite busy recently. How about Saturday night?"
"Okay!"
After agreeing to enjoy the food together, the dance party ended soon.
The next day, Hobert announced something that shocked Backlund and even the entire Loen.
In the Backlund Morning Post, Hobert published the following announcement: In order to alleviate the public's urgent need for light bulbs, factories that are interested in producing light bulbs and wires can purchase the technology of light bulbs and wires from 'Earl's Light' for 1 pound!
This is basically equivalent to publishing the manufacturing process of light bulbs and wires!
For a time, the factory owners in Backlund couldn't sit still and spent money to buy the three-year patent right.
It doesn't matter whether you make light bulbs or not, get the technology first.
Many shareholders of "Earl's Light" also expressed their incomprehension and went to the Earl's Mansion to ask Hobert, but Hobert didn't see anyone.
Hobert even rejected all banquets, dance parties, salons and other invitations. Many people speculated that Hobert regretted making the light bulb technology public. Others speculated that Hobert was brewing a new business plan.
In fact, Hobert is preparing to accept the affairs of Jonathan and others. They have made preparations and are waiting to take the opportunity to gather together on the next blood moon to revolt.
At that time, they will directly pray to "The Creator" and immediately flee to Southern Colson after the blood moon ends.
At that time, the remaining forces of the Theosophy Order will come to chase them at any time, and the Demoness Sect will not let it go.
Of course, Hobert would not put these time bombs in Southern Colson, which he regarded as the foundation, so more than a month ago, Hobert asked Corwin to assign manpower to build wooden houses on the shipyard island, preparing to temporarily settle Jonathan and others there first.
If a Beyonder war breaks out, it will not damage the cities and towns that have been built with great difficulty.
As for the Demoness Sect's attack, it is not so easy to resolve.
Hobert is preparing to take this opportunity to see if he can trick the Demoness Sect, in order to avenge the previous smog incident in Backlund.
There are personal grievances in this. After all, Hobert was beaten badly by the "Demoness of Despair," and he has always been brooding about it.
Although that "Demoness of Despair" has been killed by him, he still has no good feelings for the Demoness Sect.
Of course, the main reason is that the entire Backlund, and even the members of the Tarot Club, may have forgotten the tens of thousands of people who died in the smog.
But Hobert has never forgotten, the street full of corpses, the despair of people struggling before their lives, is still very clear in Hobert's mind.
At that time, Hobert made up his mind that he must do something for those who died in the smog, otherwise he would not know what he was getting stronger for.
Having the power to resist in the doomsday is a great motivation, but Hobert does not want himself to have too much divinity, like the Beyonders in those secret organizations, without any human temperature.
After the Backlund smog incident, Hobert permanently listed George III, the Demoness Sect, and the Aurora Order on his list of enemies.
But as a person who has received "external Confucianism and internal Legalism" education, Hobert knows the truth that "a gentleman takes revenge, ten years is not too late", so he has not acted for more than half a year.
Now Hobert feels that the time is relatively ripe, and it is natural to take revenge.
Or rather, when he decided to accept Jonathan and others, Hobert already had a series of plans.
Later, he met the Tony family and the complete surrender of the Tudor family, which made the plan gradually become more secure.
Now the only problem is, if the Demoness Sect is beaten in a hurry, will the Primordial Demoness take action?
Regarding this question, Hobert decided to pray to the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother before taking action, so as to avoid the Primordial Demoness really descending on Southern Colson.
As for the rewards for these two deities, Hobert believed that if it was just to prevent the descent of the Primordial Demoness, he could give a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact. Hobert currently has ten of this level of Sealed Artifacts, so there's no pressure to "pay" with them.
If anyone were to go head-to-head with the Primordial Demoness, Hobert would not hesitate to sacrifice "0-70" to express his determination to fight to the end with the Demoness Sect.
...
Time came to the night of July 15th. Hobert, holding the already sleeping Fors in his arms, was about to think about the Longtail Island when suddenly his spirituality sensed something and he looked out the window.
The crimson moon was rapidly becoming redder. This was the signal for Jonathan and the others to "rebel!"
Fors's spirituality was also touched, and she suddenly sat up, her mature and beautiful nude body exposed to Hobert: "It's the Blood Moon!"
"That's right!" Hobert had already gotten up, quickly put on his clothes, and picked up his cane: "I have to go prepare quickly. I can't stay by your side."
After saying that, he quickly kissed Fors on the forehead and disappeared from the bedroom of Greenery Manor.
Fors also quickly tidied her hair, put on a robe, and prepared to pray to the "Creator" at any moment.
...
Hobert didn't go far, just to the study of the lord's mansion. Just as he instructed the butler, Allen, to act according to the previous plan, he heard the prayers coming from the "Nation of Disorder".
To prevent any mistakes on this day, Hobert had instructed the butler, Allen, in advance on who to invite to preside over the situation, what corresponding preparations to make, and so on.
However, Hobert certainly wouldn't tell Allen the entire plan, only what Allen needed to do.
Entering the "Nation of Disorder" and sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert indeed saw three unfamiliar stars appearing in the pool in front of him.
Hobert immediately spread his spirituality to the first unfamiliar star. He saw Jonathan praying to the "Creator."
The Intelligentsia has a tradition: when they realize the Blood Moon is about to happen, Jonathan and other demigods, as well as the "Travelers," will quickly use "Travel" to gather family members together as much as possible.
Only by doing this can the Primordial Demoness effectively protect them during the Blood Moon. When they didn't do this at the beginning, many family members failed to receive any protection during the Blood Moon.
Hobert could roughly guess the reason behind this: Each time interrupting the whispers of the Blood Moon takes some time. If it were a true god, they would be able to protect hundreds of people at the same time. However, the Primordial Demoness's condition is not good, and some of her abilities are inferior to those of true gods, so she can only protect a portion of people.
For Beyonders of other pathways, it is almost impossible to do this, but for members of the Abraham family, it is not difficult to do so.
First of all, Beyonders of this pathway have very high spirituality. As long as the crimson moon changes, they can sense it, especially Jonathan and other "middle-sequence" Beyonders. They can sense it even before the Blood Moon begins to form.
After that, they will immediately begin to "transport" family members. The "Traveler" can bring two people into the spirit world at a time, while Jonathan can bring ten people into the spirit world.
As for Sequence 6, they generally record several "travels" in advance and use them at this time.
So, it doesn't take long for members of the Intelligentsia in a certain area to gather together.
The preparations that Jonathan said he was going to make earlier were to transfer family members who had the intention of "rebellion" to the "jurisdiction" of the three demigods participating in the rebellion under legitimate reasons, and to arrange everyone's families to South Colson as much as possible with appropriate reasons.
Of course, for the sake of Concealment, Jonathan only informed the other two demigods about the rebellion. Others only roughly knew that they were going to break away from the Demoness Sect, but they didn't know how to break away specifically.
In addition, several "Demonesses of Affliction" who also wanted to break away from the Demoness Sect did not know the details either. Jonathan promised to notify them during the rebellion.
However, for safety's sake, he would definitely transfer his family members away before notifying them, in case there were people among them who were loyal to the Demoness Sect.
So, Hobert saw from the True Vision that there were dozens of members of the Abraham family around Jonathan.
To give them enough shock, Hobert simply allowed the "Creator's" figure to appear above their heads.
...
The crimson moon gradually became blood-red, and that whisper seemed like it would appear in their ears at any moment.
Jonathan, surrounded by everyone, prayed to the "Creator" over and over again. The surrounding family members were very nervous!
Suddenly, everyone's spirituality seemed to realize something, and they all looked up at the top of their heads.
A solid figure appeared in mid-air. The figure sat on a throne made of swords, wearing armor emitting a black, holy light, and wearing a crown that also emitted a holy light. Unfortunately, they couldn't see the other person's face clearly, and could only see the other person's eyes flickering with black mist!
He exuded a holy radiance, as if he could end all chaos, and as if he could bring complete chaos.
Jonathan was also very shocked by this scene. He had received several "divine revelations," but he could basically only feel great pressure and could not see any image at all.
So, Jonathan's image of the gods was actually very vague. At this moment, he and the other family members realized that the image of the gods was so tall and holy.
At this time, a huge sense of oppression came over them, and the full majesty shocked everyone's hearts!
The majestic aura exuded by the "Creator" made people unconsciously lower their heads and want to surrender unconsciously.
Soon, this sense of oppression disappeared, and everyone looked at the top of their heads somewhat blankly, and sure enough, there was nothing there.
Many people suddenly became a little bewildered and uneasy, as if they had lost their due protection.
After about half a minute, a family member pointed out the window and said, "Look, the Blood Moon has formed!"
But they didn't hear any whispers in their ears.
"Praise the Creator!" Someone suddenly said!
This praise was echoed by everyone: "Praise the Creator!"
...
Hobert used this half-minute to spread his spirituality to the other two stars one after another. In addition to allowing the image of the "Creator" to appear, he also used "tampering + distortion" to change the density of spirituality around them, which was not enough to support the spread of whispers.
Because Fors didn't need to show the image of the "Creator," it only took two seconds for her to get rid of the Blood Moon's intrusion.
This Blood Moon was shorter, lasting only about twenty minutes. Hobert paid close attention to the situation of Jonathan and others, and Hobert did not return to the real world until the Blood Moon ended.
Under Hobert's prior deployment, Allen had sent people to invite Mayor Corwin and Deputy Mayor Donna, and organized the corresponding personnel to do a good job of reception.
So, when Hobert came to the front yard, it was already brightly lit.
Hobert sat down on the chair prepared for him in front of the main hall, and Fors also came at this time, sitting next to Hobert.
At this time, Jonathan led the first batch of members who rebelled and appeared in the center of the yard.
