chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 586: The Gaze of the Primordial Demoness
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Jonathan and ten other members suddenly appeared in the brightly lit courtyard.
Seeing this, Jonathan breathed a sigh of relief, which proved that Hobert was prepared.
The other members were a little nervous, after all, this was a defection, not a vacation.
Hobert nodded slightly to Jonathan: "Leave a person in charge and hurry up to pick up the others."
"Okay." Jonathan appointed a Sequence 6 to temporarily maintain order here, while he disappeared into the void again to pick up the others.
While the nine Theosophy Order members were at a loss, Allen asked the servants to bring chairs for them to sit on, and also brought up a table with several large teapots and basins of cups, allowing them to fetch water if they were thirsty.
Those whose families had already moved to the South Colson area had also been notified to come.
The greetings from their families, and Allen's command of the servants' reception, gradually eased their nervous emotions.
Then, the members of the Theosophy Order arrived in batches, and gradually members' families began to appear, including the elderly and children. Allen asked people to bring up another table of sweets and pastries.
More and more family members heard the news and rushed over, and the scene became more and more lively.
Until this time, the Theosophy Order and the Demoness Sect had not yet reacted.
The Abraham family's curse is rather special. It's not that you will die if you hear it once. If you only hear it once, it will only make your condition very bad.
The higher the Sequence, the worse the condition. For a demigod like Jonathan, he would lose control after hearing the whispers two or three times in a row, while for an 'Apprentice', it wouldn't be a big problem to hear it ten or eight times.
So before this, whenever the Blood Moon asked the Primordial Demoness for protection, there were always people who, for various reasons, did not have time to pray to the Primordial Demoness, or did not have time to gather together to avoid the curse.
If the Primordial Demoness was in good condition, she might immediately notice, why are there so few Theosophy Order members requesting her protection this time?
However, her condition has not been very good. As long as those members who have not rebelled still pray to her for protection, instead of none praying at all, she will most likely not notice the disappearance of Jonathan and others so quickly.
It doesn't matter if she notices, the Demoness Sect's obstruction is obviously too late. By the time the Theosophy Order members who have not rebelled leave the protection of the Primordial Demoness, Jonathan and the others have already begun to transfer the members. Even if they immediately organize people to chase after them, they will still be one step late.
Currently, Jonathan and the others have calmly begun to transfer the members' families. The Demoness Sect probably hasn't noticed this yet.
However, just in case, under Hobert's instruction, Donna began to persuade the Theosophy Order members' families to leave temporarily.
The reason for the persuasion was also very simple: the enemy might chase after them, and there might be a battle here. Beyonders had to stay and be ready to fight at any time, but family members were too dangerous here.
Everyone thought this was true, so they let their families leave first, and the Beyonders remained vigilant at all times.
As Angus and Elliot, who had just been promoted to Sequence 5 "Mentor of Disorder", led the team to arrive, nearly two hundred Beyonders had gathered in the courtyard.
Hobert organized everyone to stand in an orderly manner to avoid sudden events.
Next, Jonathan and others began to pick up the "Witch" pathway Beyonders who also participated in the uprising.
The reason for their uprising was similar to Helen's previous decision to be loyal to Hobert: for their own better development.
The Demoness Sect at this time is more like a "Witch Family", with several families Chained by marriage and deep interests controlling the church and deciding how the resources in the church should be distributed.
Members of these families, as long as they have good qualifications, can easily be promoted to Sequence 5 and have the opportunity to be promoted to demigod.
And the "Witch" pathway members of the Theosophy Order almost all lack such a background.
Like Tris, she came from the Theosophy Order, so she was arranged to be by Prince Edessak's side, a pawn that could be abandoned at any time, and also used to experiment with becoming a vessel for the Primordial Demoness.
The "Witch" pathway members in the Theosophy Order actually don't have a very bright future.
This is what Hobert learned, the internal contradictions of the Demoness Sect that can be exploited, and also the main reason why those "Witch" pathway Beyonders want to revolt.
But they don't have the same sense of identity as the Abraham family and are full of uncertainty, so they will be brought over last.
What Hobert and the others didn't expect was that after they successively arrived in the courtyard of the Lord's Mansion, they immediately exposed and reported each other as spies, and the entire courtyard was in a state of panic for a while.
Hobert did not immediately order the arrest of those suspected spies, because he did not yet understand the specific situation, so as not to allow the real spies to succeed.
"I will send someone to investigate clearly later!" Hobert said loudly: "Now everyone look at me."
Whether it was from the notification of relatives and friends, or their own guesses, the rebels in the courtyard already knew that Hobert was the receiver of this rebellion operation, and one of the main planners.
Hobert took a box made of "Order Crystal" from Fors. When the box was opened, it contained a crystal ball composed of many insects embracing each other.
Jonathan and the others' eyes lit up immediately. This was a "Secrets Sorcerer" Beyonder characteristic.
This Beyonder characteristic was the "road sign" used by Christian during the battle of Feynapotter to guide the angel of the Augustus family of the Loen royal family to the location. It was collected by Hobert, who was in the rear.
Later, people from the Loen royal family inquired about the whereabouts of this Beyonder characteristic, but Hobert told them that the situation was urgent at the time and he didn't have time to take it away.
Because Hobert had made such great contributions, no one asked about this Beyonder characteristic again, and it was assumed that it was lost.
Even the Abraham family members who didn't know what this was felt very close to this crystal ball and hoped to have it.
"Look at this again." Hobert closed the box and took another box of the same appearance from Fors.
Opening this box, there was a ball of delicate thread like silk, half pure white and half jet black, with spots of light moving rapidly on the "silk".
In Hobert's view, this Beyonder characteristic has a sense of science fiction.
The eyes of several "Demonesses of Affliction" also lit up. This turned out to be a Beyonder characteristic of a "Demoness of Despair"!
This Beyonder characteristic came from the just-concluded operation in Foggy Town.
Hobert closed the box again: "Showing you these is to let you know that as long as you are determined to break away from the control of the Demoness Sect, the 'Creator' can give you a very good prospect.
"I also know very well that there must be spies from the Demoness Sect among you. However, everyone has times when they are forced to accept some tasks. As long as those spies pretend not to have done anything to harm everyone, I can pretend not to know."
Someone boldly asked: "Mr. Earl, how can we obtain the Beyonder characteristics for advancement?"
Hobert smiled and said: "Let Helen and the others answer this question for you!"
Helen and the other members of the second squad had already decided to be loyal to Hobert.
They were the first extraordinary forces to arrive here to maintain order. At this time, Helen stepped forward and said: "Everyone knows that I have just been promoted to Sequence 5!
"I have worked for the Demoness Sect for so many years, and I have only obtained one Sequence 5 main ingredient. I may have to wait five or ten years before I have the opportunity to become Sequence 5.
"And after I was sent to serve Earl Hobert, I only participated in two battles and obtained another main ingredient!
"There is even a colleague who got the opportunity to be promoted to Sequence 5 in less than half a year!"
To everyone's surprise, someone asked: "Are those battles dangerous?"
"Which battles are not dangerous?" Helen smiled and said: "But even if it is dangerous, the Lord and the Lady will participate in the battle with us."
This surprised everyone, because most of the time, they were cannon fodder. Often, with an order from the Demoness Sect, they had to risk their lives. Only when sharing the credit could they see the figures of the Demoness Sect members.
Helen added: "You should have heard about the compensation for the members who died in those two battles, right?
"The Lord will not only ask the angels who serve the 'Creator' to help crush the Beyonder characteristics and hand them over to the heirs designated by the martyrs, but also receive a considerable amount of compensation."
Everyone heard about the two compensations, after all, neither the Demoness Sect nor the Theosophy Order had any compensation.
This made everyone realize that the Beyonder squad really had the treatment of official Beyonders.
Helen continued: "I dare not say anything else, the advancement opportunities here are absolutely fair and just."
She also talked about the standards for exchanging merit points and issuing merit points. At the end, everyone learned that the Special Operations Department Second Team only had 10 official member slots, and they all requested Hobert to increase some slots.
Hobert then went along with the flow and increased the number of official members to 25, and Helen was still the captain.
After outlining a good blueprint for everyone's future, everyone's emotions basically stabilized, and they were no longer as confused and panicked as before.
At this time, Hobert asked Helen, Angus, and others to take them to the shipyard island and rest in the wooden houses prepared for them.
Hobert, however, took Jonathan and the other three "Door" pathway demigods, as well as two "Demonesses of Affliction" who were elected as representatives, to the study of the Lord's Mansion.
Hobert said: "The members of the Theosophy Order will definitely come after a while. Even if they don't come, they will definitely send people to scout.
"I will go to the shipyard island with everyone in a while. We must be vigilant these two days and be prepared for their attacks at all times."
Jonathan said: "Half of the Theosophy Order's power has been taken away by me, so there is no need to be too afraid of the Theosophy Order's revenge. The main thing is to be afraid of them asking the Demoness Sect for help."
Hobert nodded: "I have made corresponding preparations. If only the Saint comes, there is no need to alarm the 'Creator'.
"But if they send out angels, we must pray for the help of the 'Creator'."
At this time, Ms. Monica, one of the representatives, said: "I accidentally heard a message before, and I don't know if it is true.
"It is said that the Demoness Sect actually has 3 angels! It's just that two of them are in very poor condition and haven't appeared for hundreds of years. There is also one who seems to have just completed the advancement twenty or thirty years ago, and the condition seems to be better."
[T/N: its 4 in canon]
Hobert nodded: "This is a very important piece of information, which is of great help to my subsequent preparations."
If the other party only has three angels, then it is stable.
He can also use that eye and umbilical cord to summon the power of angels once each.
In addition, there are messengers and the angel of Tony Manor as foreign aid. Although their condition is not very good, it doesn't matter. The condition of the Demoness Sect's angels is also not good.
Even the 'Creator' can appear on the battlefield, ready to sneak attack at any time.
The reason why it is not the main attack is because the 'Creator' only has an empty shell, which is easily exposed. Even angels in poor condition can clearly understand His state after fighting the 'Creator' for a period of time.
After saying a few simple words, the six people followed the crowd to the shipyard island.
Dozens of wooden houses have been built here, with more than a hundred rooms, and all the living supplies and materials have been prepared.
This shows how well prepared Hobert is, and the last trace of tension has disappeared.
Hobert has his own wooden house. After blowing out the candle, he looked at the island scenery outside the window and listened to the sound of the waves. He felt the digestion of the potion.
Sure enough, the rebellion he promoted made the "Earl of the Fallen" potion have a very obvious digestion again. After all, making people rebel is also a kind of depravity.
Of course, this rebellion has a certain degree of spontaneity, but Hobert played an important role in it. Without his promises and help, Jonathan and others would not have rebelled.
Hobert pondered that if a corresponding battle occurred because of this rebellion, the potion might have a certain digestion, but it would definitely not be as obvious as it is now.
Then he sighed, if there were two more rebellions like this, especially rebellions with the participation of demigods, the "Earl of the Fallen" potion might be completely digested.
Unfortunately, rebellion is easy to plan, but rebellions with the participation of demigods are difficult to encounter.
The development of the situation was as Hobert expected. In the early morning, the scouts of the Theosophy Order accurately found the shipyard island, but they were quickly discovered by Jonathan and others and captured.
According to the confession of the scout, three scouts came to investigate together, and Jonathan and others only caught one of them.
When they first came to the shipyard island, Jonathan and others made corresponding anti-divination arrangements. The pursuers definitely did not learn their location through divination.
Then there is only one possibility, that someone among the rebels reported their location, so it attracted pursuers.
Jonathan and others advocated immediately launching an investigation, but Hobert stopped him and gathered everyone together and said: "As everyone has heard, our location has been exposed, and there must be spies on this island.
"Next, the Theosophy Order and the Demoness Sect will definitely send people to attack us, but it doesn't matter. Under the gaze of the 'Creator', we will defeat them.
"This is the last chance I give those spies! Before this battle, I will still not investigate who is a spy, but after this battle, if our movements are still exposed to the Demoness Sect, I will immediately thoroughly investigate, I hope everyone can understand."
Everyone dispersed with their own thoughts. Hobert looked at the sky. It was already early morning, and the sun was about to rise. He smiled at the reaction of the Demoness Sect: "Is that all they've got?"
It had been nearly four hours since Jonathan and the others' betrayal, but the attack hadn't arrived yet! Although there was the Theosophy Order in between, any news would be delayed. And it would take time to investigate how much power had defected.
But their reaction speed was still too slow.
As soon as he returned to his room, Jonathan, along with two other demigods, found Hobert: "You're too lenient with the spies."
Hobert smiled: "Those are your relatives or colleagues. It's easy to find problems with an investigation. Can you really bring yourselves to do it then?"
The three demigods exchanged glances. In fact, they suspected that the spies were most likely Beyonders of the 'Witch' pathway, not members of the Abraham family, which was why they advocated for a thorough investigation.
At this moment, Monica and another witch also arrived at Hobert's room, afraid that this lord would make decisions unfavorable to Beyonders of the 'Witch' pathway.
"Haha," Hobert said with a smile, "I happen to have a deck of cards here. How about we play a round of poker?
Everyone was stunned. Poker, right now?
But they soon realized that playing cards was just Hobert's way of comforting them, because Hobert always lost. And after losing, he would talk to them about his ideas.
After a few rounds of cards, they all relaxed. They even thought that Hobert was deliberately losing to them, which made them embarrassed to win.
The core idea that Hobert discussed with everyone was: keeping these spies to report back would make the Demoness Sect send as many Beyonder forces as possible to chase after them, so they could strike the pursuers hard while they were still vigilant. Otherwise, they wouldn't have a peaceful life afterward.
Moreover, they were fighting on their home turf, so they had some initiative. If they couldn't win, they could still run back to South Colson.
If the pursuers didn't come for a long time, could they keep everyone gathered on this island? Could they continue to live in this defensive posture?
Everyone thought about it, and that was indeed the case. What reassured Jonathan and the others the most was that Hobert said he could quickly ask other saints to come and support them! Although they didn't know how many would come, even one or two saints should be enough to deal with the pursuers.
So everyone no longer had any objections to Hobert's decision, and they even began to discuss what to name their organization.
There were 187 Beyonders who defected this time, including 3 demigods, 12 Sequence 5s, and several Sequence 6s and Sequence 7s, and nearly half of the Beyonders were Sequence 8s and Sequence 9s.
This was already the lineup of a secret organization that was not very strong, but definitely not weak.
Taking the Aurora Order, which was more rampant among the secret organizations, as an example, the Aurora Order had only 5 saints, and the 22 Divine Envoys were mostly Sequence 5s, and some Sequence 6s and Sequence 7s with special abilities.
Currently, the strength of Jonathan and others was roughly equivalent to three-fifths to three-quarters of the strength of the Aurora Order.
This was based on previous comparisons. After Hobert's two blows, the current strength of the Aurora Order might be slightly stronger than Jonathan and the others, or even similar to them.
So it was reasonable for Jonathan and the others to establish a Beyonder organization.
Jonathan also sought Hobert's opinion, asking him to give their organization a good name.
Hobert said he respected their own opinions. In fact, he hated naming things the most: Don't ask me, or I'll just give you a number.
In the end, Jonathan and the others decided to call it the "Theosophy Order Council", and still claimed to be the Theosophy Order to the public. They also continued to advocate the Theosophy Order's tenets, and criticized those members who did not revolt for betraying the Theosophy Order's tenets.
Currently, the council was composed of five people, including Jonathan, who were responsible for handling the organization's daily affairs and allocating Beyonder resources.
Their uprising also brought some Sealed Artifacts and Beyonder materials. With Hobert's consent, these things were kept by the council, and their use was sought to be fair and just.
"Ah~"
Just as Jonathan and the others were happily playing cards, a scream suddenly came from outside.
The six people immediately rushed out of the room. Many people were running towards them in a panic, and some were running out of the wooden house area in desperation.
Jonathan quickly stopped the running people and asked them what was going on.
Hobert "magnified" his voice: "Don't run outside! There may be ambushes outside! Come here!
"Sequence 5s and Sequence 6s immediately perform their command functions! Command the people around you to come over!"
Although the trees outside the village had been cut down, Beyonders of the 'Witch' pathway had the ability to hide, so they might have been ambushed outside!
As soon as he finished shouting, Hobert felt a very uncomfortable gaze sweep over him, which made the blood in the left side of his body surge, while the right side of his body felt like it had fallen into an ice cave!
Just as Hobert was about to open the barrier of the 'Order Crystal', the gaze disappeared.
At this time, Jonathan also learned the cause of the scream through inquiries. It turned out that a Beyonder of the 'Witch' pathway suddenly screamed in pain, and her hair turned into more than a dozen venomous snakes.
And that Beyonder completely lost consciousness, and seemed to have become a puppet of the venomous snakes, and began to pounce on other people.
Everyone was already a little nervous, and after hearing the scream, they immediately panicked, which caused the scene just now.
Hobert immediately said: "Sidley and Monica, come with me to check what's going on. Jonathan, stay here to organize everyone and defend against enemy attacks! Well, I suggest that all those below Sequence 6 should hide first!"
Sidley was another demigod of the 'Door' pathway.
Jonathan felt that Hobert's disposal was very reasonable, especially the selection of personnel was very reasonable, with people from the 'Creator', people from the Abraham family, and representatives of the 'Witch' pathway.
So he said, "Yes!"
Hobert pulled out his rapier and walked in the front, coming to the outside of the Beyonder's wooden house where the accident occurred.
The door was open, and the three people saw that there was indeed a figure with a head full of venomous snakes wandering in the house.
Those venomous snakes with colorful scales saw Hobert and others, and each of them distorted their bodies, and pairs of cold eyes stared at Hobert and the other two, spitting out their tongues at them, looking ferocious and terrifying.
That figure also turned around. At this time, her face was dull, her skin was unnaturally white, and a pair of white eyes stared at Hobert and the others.
And in the wooden house, there were also two people who had been completely petrified. From their stiff facial expressions, it could be seen that the petrification process must have been very painful.
The Beyonder with a head full of venomous snakes suddenly opened her mouth and asked Hobert: "Who are you? Who...do you represent? Why...why instigate rebellion?"
Sidley and Monica's minds seemed to have been greatly impacted, and they both covered their hearts and took a step back.
Hobert also seemed to realize something, and immediately propped up the barrier of the 'Order Crystal': "Because the tenets of the Theosophy Order have been destroyed by the Demoness Sect! Because the Demoness Sect's distribution of Beyonder resources is unfair!"
Hobert guessed that this was very likely the projection of the gaze of the Primordial Demoness, which caused the Beyonder to undergo a mutation.
Recalling the uncomfortable gaze just now, Hobert realized that the power that the Primordial Demoness could project was very limited because of her poor condition.
Otherwise, the gaze of a normal True God would either be difficult for Hobert, as a demigod, to detect, or the malicious gaze would immediately turn him into a runaway monster.
And that gaze was probably at the level of an angel, which showed that the Primordial Demoness was actually very weak.
At first, Hobert thought it was the gaze of an angel of the Demoness Sect, but after seeing the encounter of this Beyonder in front of him, Hobert guessed that it was very likely the Primordial Demoness.
As a Beyonder of the 'Witch' pathway, and a former member of the Theosophy Order, this meant that they were likely to be marked by the Primordial Demoness. It was a special connection, even if the Primordial Demoness was very weak, a single gaze could make the other party completely out of control and mentally dead.
Hobert also guessed that the Primordial Demoness's body should still be asleep at this time, but she just glanced over here, otherwise Hobert and the others would not be able to withstand His questioning.
When the other party heard Hobert's answer, the venomous snakes stood up one by one, spitting out their tongues, as if they were about to jump over and attack Hobert and the others.
The body with a head full of venomous snakes mutated, like a balloon expanding, and the skin on the face covered the facial features, turning into a face with nothing.
Sidley and Monica hid behind Hobert and breathed a long sigh of relief. They also seemed to realize who was questioning them just now.
Boom~
The corpse that had expanded to the extreme suddenly exploded, and pieces of minced meat turned into venomous snakes after landing, and quickly swam around.
And that Beyonder was left with a skeleton and a small amount of flesh, but the venomous snakes on its head seemed to be unaffected, and were still making attacking gestures towards Hobert and others with their fangs and claws.
Hobert noticed that the visual impact had disappeared, and the power of this gaze might be difficult to maintain, and the Primordial Demoness had left, so he removed the shield: "Disorder!"
The venomous snakes that were swimming around suddenly seemed to lose their sense of direction, sometimes to the left, sometimes to the right, sometimes forward, sometimes backward.
The three people breathed a sigh of relief. The power projected by the Primordial Demoness was indeed limited, and these venomous snakes were not difficult to deal with.
Immediately, the sword in Hobert's hand became the size of a normal knight's sword, and he rushed towards the skeleton with "venomous snake hair" with fangs and claws.
That skeleton also rushed towards Hobert, but Hobert raised his sword and slashed open an "Underworld Gate", and immediately an arm covered with black hair stretched out from it.
Hobert was stunned. Originally, he felt that the heads of these venomous snakes might have to be cut off one by one, which was not only very troublesome, but also easy to be bitten by them, so he used the power of the Underworld to suppress the opponent's spiritual body.
Unexpectedly, this time it was not like before, with many arms stretching out from the "Underworld Gate" and grasping aimlessly, but only one black arm stretched out.
Those venomous snakes seemed to have encountered something that frightened them, and quickly made evasive movements.
The black arm opened its hand and grasped over the heads of those venomous snakes, seeming to grab a wisp of black, illusory gas. These venomous snakes quickly began to petrify, and then the entire skeleton also began to petrify.
In just one or two seconds, the venomous snakes on the head and the venomous snakes on the ground turned into stone statues.
Hobert immediately realized that this black arm was attracted by the aura of the Primordial Demoness.
After grabbing that trace of aura, the arm that clenched its fist suddenly turned to Hobert.
Hobert's spirituality immediately sensed the danger and quickly closed the "Underworld Gate".
But this time the "Underworld Gate" failed to completely close as Hobert wished, and a region the thickness of an arm was left. Although that arm had retracted to a certain extent, it still had not completely left.
Rumble~
Just as Hobert was about to mobilize the power of the Underworld to "suck" the other party back, a huge sound came from the distance. That arm paused, seemed to consider it, and immediately returned to the Underworld, and the "Underworld Gate" also disappeared.
Too late to check the stone statue, Hobert and the other two saw that Jonathan and the others were being attacked, so they quickly went to support them. The huge sound just now turned out to be a wooden house being overturned by the aftermath of the Beyonder battle.
Hobert saw that there were six demigods attacking, and a smile unconsciously climbed to his face. The wait in the middle of the night was not in vain, and the fish finally took the bait!
The reason why he didn't clear those spies was that he hoped that the Demoness Sect could send many demigod-level forces to chase after them, so that he could beat them hard.
Immediately, Hobert understood the enemy's position, and suddenly stopped and made a prayer, and then immediately came to the "Nation of Disorder", and threw the black dog spirit beast, "Bull Devil Monarch" and "Great Sage", which had been prepared for a long time, into his stars.
...
Although Jonathan and others were always on guard, the enemy's surprise attack still caught them a little off guard.
The opponents were all saints and Sequence 5s, and Jonathan and others' subordinates immediately suffered casualties. Jonathan and another demigod were also beaten without any power to fight back.
Fortunately, Jonathan saw from afar that Hobert and the others were coming to support them.
Suddenly, everyone's spirituality perceived that a surging power appeared in the air, where a huge bronze door appeared. The giant door opened, and three black figures flew out from it.
After the thin black mist dissipated, a giant sea snake appeared on the battlefield. It had black membranes behind its head, and the illusory black scales looked very thick and solid.
As soon as it appeared, the morning sun on the horizon was immediately blocked by thick dark clouds, and the sky became dim and unclear.
Thunder rumbled in the dark clouds, as if a surging power was brewing.
Next to the sea snake, there was also a black monster emitting a sacred black light, with a bull's head but a pair of golden deer antlers.
On the other side of the sea snake, there was also a black figure, but everyone's spirituality issued a warning that they could not look at each other, so everyone only felt a surge of fear, but no one could see its overall appearance clearly.
Jonathan almost laughed out loud. He didn't expect Hobert to invite three saints to participate in the war at once! And these three seemed to be at the Sequence 3 level.
At this time, Hobert also returned to the real world. He gave his rapier to the black dog spirit beast, and then ordered: "Kill the opponent's demigods as much as possible!"
The six enemy Saints who came to attack were also a bit confused at this moment. According to their investigation and intelligence, the enemy only had four demigods, right? How did three more suddenly appear?
The situation reversed all at once. Six against four, they would have won steadily, but now it's six against seven, with no chance of victory!
Just as the "Wanderer" and the "Demoness of Unaging," who were commanding this operation, were hesitating whether to retreat immediately, the Black Hound Spirit Beast and the others had already rushed over, each choosing their own opponent to fight.
Jonathan and the other three demigods also returned to the battlefield, while Monica commanded Sequence 5 and Sequence 6 to face the opponent's Sequence 5s.
Hobert, who was wandering the battlefield, sighed, 'Fortunately, the battlefield wasn't set in South Colson, otherwise, the newly built buildings would have been overturned by the battle by now.'
At this moment, he seized the opportunity and shouted at the demigod who was fighting the "Great Sage": "Arrogance!"
The "Demoness of Despair," who was about to escape, felt that she could persist a little longer, so she rushed back to fight the "Great Sage."
Rumble~
A muffled thunderbolt struck the "Demoness of Despair," and her whole body flickered with electric sparks, falling into a brief state of paralysis.
The "Great Sage" took advantage of this opportunity and whipped her away with its tail. This sea serpent, possessing barbaric power, also used the "Magnify" ability. The "Demoness of Despair" spat out a mouthful of blood while still in mid-air.
Hobert immediately poured his spirituality into "1-109," used "Blink" to arrive in the direction where the "Demoness of Despair" was flying, and then switched to the spirit body of the Shepherd: "Slaughter!"
He punched out, directly turning the "Demoness of Despair" into a horizontal "V" shape.
Whoosh~
The "Demoness of Despair" shattered into a mirror, and she herself appeared dozens of meters away, wiping the blood from the corner of her mouth and immediately entering a state of invisibility.
The "Great Sage" opened its mouth wide, and a vortex of air suddenly appeared in its mouth. Stones the size of heads on the ground were immediately swept up, and the trees around where the "Demoness of Despair" had just disappeared were also uprooted, and even the overturned wooden houses flew towards the "Great Sage's" big mouth.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert poured his spirituality into "1-107": "Invisibility is prohibited here!"
Although it didn't immediately make the "Demoness of Despair" reveal her figure, she would definitely be subject to many restrictions in the state of invisibility.
One or two seconds later, the figure of the "Demoness of Despair" suddenly appeared in mid-air, but she immediately transformed into a cane and appeared in a place outside the suction of the "Great Sage."
Hobert filled the gap in time: "Distort!"
He "distorted" the other party's idea of escaping into a charge, so she once again rushed towards the "Great Sage," and a gust of wind blew towards the "Demoness of Despair."
Puff puff puff~
There was the sound of sharp blades cutting through flesh in the gust of wind, and the front of the "Demoness of Despair" was covered with dense, grid-like small wounds.
Whoosh~
She transformed into a mirror again, but due to the influence of Hobert's "Distort" just now, this "mirror substitute" was used a little late, and she was still cut with many knife wounds on her body.
Hobert reached out to the "Demoness of Despair": "Magnify!"
The serious injuries on the "Demoness of Despair's" body became fatal injuries, and this kind of injury could not be replaced with a substitute; the injuries had to be transferred to a doll.
But just as she took out the wooden doll she had made, the water in the pond not far away seemed to suddenly come to life, slapping towards her. The "Demoness of Despair" did not dare to neglect and quickly rolled over to dodge.
On the other side, Hobert had already poured his spirituality into "1-107": "Death!"
The "Demoness of Despair" saw that Hobert's body suddenly became huge and full of majesty, causing her spirit body to tremble uncontrollably, not daring to disobey the other party's "judgment!"
The "Demoness of Despair" couldn't dodge such an attack and was hit by Hobert's punch.
Puff~
The "Demoness of Despair" turned into a wooden stick again, and the wooden stick immediately exploded, with wood chips flying everywhere.
She appeared more than ten meters away and fell to the ground as soon as she appeared, and the doll in her hand also fell into the distance.
The "Death" of the doll could only help her bear most of the damage even with a substitute. She, who was already seriously injured, suffered new injuries.
The "Great Sage" spat out a snake letter towards the "Demoness of Despair," and the water walls that had been scattered all over the ground reappeared. This time, the mass of water turned into the shape of a sea snake, opening its mouth to swallow the "Demoness of Despair."
The "Demoness of Despair" wanted to dodge, but she found that her body was no longer listening to her commands.
At this moment, a illusory door appeared in front of her, and an injured Secrets Sorcerer appeared next to the "Demoness of Despair."
Whoosh~
The sea snake-shaped water passed through the door, but came out from other locations.
The Secrets Sorcerer was also struggling to hold on just now. After dodging the attack of the mass of water, he immediately clutched the wound on his chest and slumped to the ground.
And the Bull Devil Monarch immediately chased over, using the method of "distorting" distance.
Just now, the Secrets Sorcerer also used the "Illusory Door" to block the Bull Devil Monarch's attack, but what he didn't expect was that the Bull Devil Monarch actually distorted the space, opening a hole in the "Illusory Door" and goring him high into the air.
Among the demigods, the Secrets Sorcerer, whose body was relatively weak, was hung on the antlers by this gore, and the Bull Devil Monarch shook him off after shaking for a long time.
At this time, Hobert stepped forward, and he, the Great Sage, and the Bull Devil Monarch blocked the retreat in different directions.
An "Illusory Door" immediately appeared again in front of the Secrets Sorcerer. At this time, he and Hobert and others were in different spaces, but the Bull Devil Monarch and the Great Sage used "Distort" almost at the same time.
Their "distorting" of space immediately made this "Concealed Space" riddled with holes!
This is also the reason why the Secrets Sorcerer doesn't use "Travel" to leave. Once he uses "Travel," the surrounding space will become distorted, preventing him from entering the spirit world.
Whoosh~
The Great Sage summoned the sea snake-shaped water back and poured it into the "Concealed Space."
The Secrets Sorcerer and the Demoness of Despair were in the water, and the water pressure became huge, as if to crush them into meat pies!
The Secrets Sorcerer raised his hand with difficulty and quickly dispelled the "Concealed Space."
The water flow dissipated, and dozens of fire crows flew towards them almost instantly. In the huge explosion, the two enemies were blown to pieces and lost their lives.
Hobert was just about to besiege other enemies when he saw the backs of the other four enemy demigods running away.

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 587 Klein's Revenge
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The "Lawyer" pathway's "Distortion" ability, at the demigod level, is relatively effective against the "Travel" ability.
The "Earl of the Fallen" sequence can "distort" the target's will, causing them to abandon the idea of entering the spirit world.
At the "Frenzied Mage" level, one can completely distort space, making it impossible for the target to enter the spirit world.
However, when encountering a "Wanderer," distorting space is not very effective, because they also have the ability to leave from the astral world. Simply distorting space cannot prevent them from escaping.
Because Hobert, "Bull Devil Monarch," and "Great Sage" were all dealing with the "Secrets Sorcerer" and Demoness of Despair just now, when that "Wanderer" left with his other three companions, Jonathan and the other three demigods of the 'Door' pathway had no way to effectively stop them.
And the black hound spirit beast wielding the rapier was also unable to stop the "Wanderer" because of the "Demoness of Unaging's" obstruction.
In the battle just now, the black hound spirit beast gained a lot of advantages, but it would be difficult for it to defeat a Sequence 3 in a short time on its own.
It can be said that if they had run a little slower, they might have left that "Demoness of Unaging" behind when Hobert and the others surrounded them.
Looking back at the wooden house, the enemy's Sequence 5s had also fled, leaving only a scene of devastation in the village composed of wooden houses.
Hobert said with some regret, "What a pity, only two were left behind."
Jonathan and the others looked at each other in dismay. What was there to regret about killing two enemy demigods? In their lives, they could count the number of demigods who had died before them on one hand!
According to the previous agreement, any spoils from battles between the Theosophy Order or the Demoness Sect would belong to Hobert, or be distributed by him.
And even without this provision, those two demigod-level Beyonder characteristics should be divided up by the saints Hobert "invited," because Jonathan and the others didn't help at all.
As for the Sequence 5 level battles, there were no spoils. They were a "Traveler" paired with a "Demoness of Affliction." A total of 7 "Travelers" and 7 "Demonesses of Affliction" came.
Their strength was similar to Monica's group.
So the spoils of this battle were only the Beyonder characteristics of the "Secrets Sorcerer" and "Demoness of Despair."
Hobert put away the Beyonder characteristics and recalled "Bull Devil Monarch" and the others, then said to Jonathan and the others not far away, "I'll put these Beyonder characteristics away for now, but they will eventually be used for your advancement.
"Of course, provided that you have accumulated enough merits with the 'Creator.'"
Jonathan regretted a bit that he hadn't completely pledged allegiance to the "Creator" at the time, but only agreed to have an extraordinary team obey Hobert's command and fight for the "Creator."
With just those 25 Beyonders, when would they accumulate enough merits for a demigod's Beyonder characteristic?
Next was the statistics of battle damage. Including those who mutated due to the Primordial Demoness's gaze and the three who were petrified, a total of eight people died and more than a dozen were injured in the battle just now.
In addition, seven or eight of the wooden houses they had just stayed in for one night were completely destroyed, and more than half were damaged to varying degrees.
Jonathan and the others followed Hobert back to the "Witch" pathway Beyonders who had been petrified earlier. Whether it was the skeleton with a head full of snakes or the two petrified people lying on the ground, they showed no signs of life.
Hobert said to the onlookers, "This is the end for being a spy! You don't think the Demoness Sect will really give spies benefits for their information, do you?"
He didn't know if this Beyonder who was already petrified and had a head full of snakes was a spy, but at this moment, Hobert needed her to be!
Hobert stared intently at the crowd, clearly seeing that the faces of several people were not very good.
But Hobert still didn't plan to arrest these suspected spies. It would be best if they could attract another group of demigod attacks.
After letting Jonathan deal with the three petrified corpses, Hobert sent someone to notify Donna in South Colson. Soon, a large number of construction workers poured in, starting to repair the damaged wooden houses, and a team of doctors and nurses came to bandage the wounded.
At the same time, a group of chefs and assistant chefs from the construction site came to light fires and cook for everyone.
Hobert then returned to his wooden house to rest. As for the two Beyonder characteristics, to avoid Jonathan and the others from suddenly visiting, he decided to sacrifice them to the "Nation of Disorder" at night.
At this time, the dark clouds in the sky dissipated, and the sunlight shone on the village on the small island, and a hot day began.
Jonathan, who had arranged everything outside, came to Hobert's wooden house again: "Earl, several seriously injured people have been sent to South Colson for treatment."
Hobert nodded: "In a moment, bring the Beyonder characteristics of the dead. I'll ask an angel to help you shatter them."
"Okay." Jonathan sat in the chair: "That, that, Sidley secretly told me that he seemed to have felt the Primordial Demoness's gaze just now?"
Hobert glanced at Jonathan, who was a little worried: "Go tell Sidley and Monica that, to prevent unnecessary chaos, this news can only be made public within the scope of your five directors."
"Okay, I will."
Hobert added: "Tell them there's no need to worry about it."
He smiled and said: "Why do you think the Primordial Demoness has been in a state of slumber? One aspect is that Her condition is not good, and the other aspect is to hide Herself, so as not to be known by any of the seven orthodox gods, and thus be attacked by the orthodox gods.
"It's already the limit for Her to cast some gazes. If too much power is projected, the 'Creator' will definitely take action. That's not something you and I should worry about."
It was uncertain if the "Creator" would take action, but Hobert would immediately pray to the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother. The Primordial Demoness would probably get beaten up.
Jonathan breathed a sigh of relief: "That's good, I'll go tell the others."
Hobert "hmm"ed and said: "Continue to be vigilant to avoid another enemy raid!"
Throughout the day, people outside were busy building wooden houses, and there were no more raids.
At night, after Hobert admired the night view of the island, he returned to the wooden house, drew the curtains, and sacrificed the two spoils and the Beyonder characteristics sent by Jonathan to the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert first invested his spirituality into his star and used "True Vision" to look around, and found nothing unusual.
Then he shattered several Beyonder characteristics and quickly re-aggregated them.
After finishing all this, Hobert went to look at the skull of the Crow-haired Golden Horned Evil Monster and the stomach pouch with Kalvetua's mental remnants. "Bull Devil Monarch" could be used twice more, and "Great Sage" could be used six more times.
The black hound spirit beast could be used all the time, but Hobert estimated that after he became an angel, he might not need their help very much. For example, since he was promoted to demigod, they have appeared less and less often.
But even if they were not needed, Hobert planned to keep them in the "Nation of Disorder" as a souvenir.
More than two hours later, Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" again, brought the shattered Beyonder characteristics to the real world through bestowal, and shattered the Beyonder characteristics of the "Secrets Sorcerer" and "Demoness of Despair" for future rewards.
The next day, the Theosophy Order did not organize a new attack, but everyone knew that the Demoness Sect would never give up.
So on the third day of the Theosophy Order Council members' uprising, when the shipyard island was raining heavily, Jonathan and others found Hobert again.
Looking at the rain outside, which was like pouring water from the sky, Hobert smiled and said: "I just got some news that several courtesans in Backlund are inquiring about the 'Creator.'
"The last attack was more like a tentative battle, more like testing the 'Creator's' determination.
"Now that they know the 'Creator's' determination to protect you, I think they will carefully collect information and launch a new revenge operation after a while."
Although many stories about the "Creator" are circulating in the extraordinary world, Hobert is the only more active devotee of the "Creator."
Upton and Rafter are almost negligible, after all, they did not carry out any actions in the name of the "Creator."
So before this, the Demoness Sect may have only heard some news that the "Creator's" power was in the Southern Continent and the like.
If you inquire about it in the royal family of the Loen Kingdom, you can get a lot of information, which should include the knowledge that Hobert is very likely to be a devotee of the "Creator."
But at the same time, they will also know about the battle in Feynapotter City and the fact that the "Creator" dispatched two angels in that battle in the Southern Continent. After obtaining this information, they will definitely mobilize their forces and take action after they are confident.
Jonathan asked: "Do you also think that the Demoness Sect will retaliate again?"
"That's for sure!" Hobert said: "Even if it's for the sake of internal stability and unity, they will definitely mobilize all their forces to launch a fierce offensive!
"This has long been in my imagination, you don't need to worry too much."
Hearing Hobert say this, they were really at ease, mainly because of the sacredness and greatness shown by the "Creator" when he helped them resist the curse of the Blood Moon before, and the three saints who had previously pledged allegiance to the "Creator" yesterday, which made them feel the power of the "Creator" and his power.
Hobert added: "But the next battle will not take place on this island."
I believe that after inquiring, the Demoness Sect will know that South Colson is still under Hobert's rule, so it can also be regarded as the "Creator's" territory.
So Hobert guessed that the other party's next target of revenge is likely to be South Colson, because no matter how they fight, Hobert's loss will definitely be greater.
"I will leave Shipyard Island tomorrow." Hobert finally said: "I am going to organize the power to resist the Demoness Sect. After all, this is an old secret organization, and it used to be an orthodox church. It is not too much to take it seriously.
"You must restrain your subordinates, unless they are 'Travelers' or accompanied by 'Travelers,' otherwise, try not to leave Shipyard Island during this period."
Jonathan and others responded one after another: "Yes!"
At the same time, they also felt that this uprising was the right choice. For them, the devotee of the "Creator" was going to fight the Demoness Sect head-on!
However, what they didn't know was that even their uprising was actually within Hobert's plan.
The next day, Hobert really left Shipyard Island and returned to Backlund.
Recruiting people is not so important right now. He came back this time because he received a letter from Klein, preparing to meet him alone in Mr. Fool's Divine Kingdom.
Hobert estimated that the battle against Ince Zangwill was about to begin, so he simply returned to Backlund to prepare.
At nine o'clock in the morning, when it was time for his appointment with Klein, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog, and he appeared above the gray fog, on one side of the bronze long table.
But this time, the tall and magnificent giant hall was very deserted, with only Hobert and the "World" at the bottom.
Hobert looked around and said: "Have you found Ince Zangwill's whereabouts?"
"Yes." The 'World' at this time was Klein himself, and he said: "Because I need to avoid the ability of '0-08', I can only ask Mr. Fool to discuss the specific action plan with you here."
Hobert made a gesture to speak.
"I hope you can join the battle after a period of time after it starts." Klein explained: "Because I want to use this battle to achieve some goals."
He wanted to use the planning and process of this battle as a ritual to advance to "Bizarro Sorcerer."
Hobert nodded: "No problem, what is Zangwill's condition now?"
"According to the accurate information I got, it's not very good!" Klein explained his information in great detail: "He used to be a 'Gatekeeper' and seems to be targeted by a very powerful evil spirit. Occasionally, he will do things that are contrary to his wishes.
"His appearance in the Southern Continent is also to seek help from the Spirit Church to get rid of the evil spirit on his body."
Then Klein talked about his plan: "I got a very high-level curse talisman, and I will use it on Zangwill after the battle starts to make him unlucky enough.
"In addition, Leonard is estimated to participate in the battle at that time, and try to hold Zangwill back.
"I will use my marionette and the 'Fate Siphon Talisman' saved from Foggy Town last time to separate Zangwill from the evil spirit on his body, so as to avoid that unstable factor from affecting the battle.
"Then I will ask you to join the battle. At this time, Zangwill is unlucky enough, and his condition will be very poor. I believe he will not be your opponent."
Hobert nodded: "No problem, I will trample him under my feet and torture him!"
Klein was a little moved: "If possible, please give me and Leonard some space for revenge!"
"I will."
"Thank you."
The two agreed on the emergency contact method, and then left above the gray fog.
Back in the real world, Hobert explained a few words to Dophis, and then used "Travel" to go to the Southern Continent first, so that after the battle started, he would have to use a few minutes of "Travel" to rush to the battlefield.
...
In the afternoon, Southern Continent, East Balam.
Daly casually asked Leonard: "Why do you always move around the church area, and don't go to farther places to investigate?"
Leonard thought for a while and said frankly: "Waiting for news."
Daly nodded thoughtfully without asking any more questions.
Suddenly, Leonard's spirituality was touched. A letter appeared out of nowhere and fluttered to the ground next to the streetlight.
The contents of the letter were simple, just one line of words: 'Sybelle, North Governorate, Cooke Town, Resurrection Square.'
Leonard's expression was grave, and he turned to Daly and said, "Madam, please help me conceal my whereabouts."
Daly said very seriously, "Take me with you!"
Leonard stared at Daly for a second or two, said nothing, grabbed her shoulder, and the space in front of them became illusory as they stepped into the spirit world together.
This mystical item with the ability to 'travel' was sent to Leonard by Klein in a previous letter, so that he could rush to the battlefield as quickly as possible.
When their figures were redrawn, they saw Ince Zangwill with his high nose bridge and one eye in the large Resurrection Square.
Flames of hatred immediately ignited in Leonard's eyes.
At this time, Zangwill was in a very unlucky and poor state. Klein's Sequence 5 marionette, 'Admiral Hell' Ludwell, was holding back his spirit body.
Daly did not act blindly. After observing briefly, she came behind Ludwell and opened her arms.
A bronze door with countless strange patterns descended and creaked open a crack.
This was a Underworld Gate, a gate full of temptation for all undead creatures!
The terrifying suction caused a black figure to appear above Zangwill's head. This figure gradually solidified in the real world. It was a man wearing blood-black armor, young and handsome, with red hair, scars that cut deep into the bone on his face, and a banner-like mark between his eyebrows.
The young man said 'Yo,' "My luck is really bad today. You two, we've already died together once. Is it necessary to do it again? Especially when being manipulated by a weakling like this little chick."
On the left side of his face, a scar tore open, bloodily opening and closing, "Okay, let's clear the surrounding garbage first..."
The man in blood-black armor stretched out his palm and drew a illusory long sword with dark red rust from his body, easily breaking free from Daly's extraction and Ludwell's control.
At this moment, 'Admiral Hell' Ludwell solemnly recited in ancient Hermes, "Fate!"
The position of this marionette and Zangwill dimmed at the same time, and then quickly returned to normal, but the person possessed by the evil spirit changed from Ince Zangwill to Ludwell.
Instantly, a phantom wearing black-red armor appeared above its head. In a hotel room near the square, Klein calmly manipulated the marionette, causing him to turn and walk towards the 'Underworld Gate' summoned by Daly.
Daly immediately understood the marionette's intention and made the gap in the 'Underworld Gate' a little bigger.
Ludwell allowed pale arms to grab him, and pushed the gap in the 'Underworld Gate' even wider, rushing into the virtualized bronze door.
Seeing this, Daly immediately withdrew her palm and stopped maintaining the bronze door covered with mysterious symbols.
Clang!
'Admiral Hell' Ludwell, along with Sauron Einhorn Medici inside him, was isolated from the real world.
Over a hundred meters away, Klein breathed a sigh of relief. This crucial step was finally completed. After that, they could fully deal with Ince Zangwill.
Leonard took out a pistol and held it against his temple with one hand, and tightly grasped the 'Fate Siphon' with the other, "Fate!"
This was the 'Worm of Time' he had obtained from the 'Old Man' Pallez Zoroast in his body, and he had prayed to Pallez for power to create the 'Fate Siphon'.
While throwing out the charm, Leonard pulled the trigger and committed suicide, exchanging fates with Zangwill in this way.
In that instant, countless silver-white lightning bolts raged, and the surrounding scene shattered like a broken mirror. Leonard suddenly woke up and found himself standing in place, only pointing the revolver at his temple, and the 'Fate Siphon' was not thrown out!
What he had just done was just a dream!
At this time, Zangwill's eyes were filled with gloom. The moment the 'Underworld Gate' appeared, he created a large-scale dream in Resurrection Square.
But because Klein was far away, his marionette did not fall into the dream, which destroyed Zangwill's entire dream.
However, the moment the 'Underworld Gate' closed, Klein's marionette disappeared from the square, and he dragged Daly and Leonard into the dream.
This forced Klein, who was far away, to quickly enter the 'Gray Mist Above' and use lightning to wake Daly and Leonard.
Seeing that the dream had no effect, Zangwill directly took out the 'Arlesuhod Quill' and quickly wrote on the clothes at his arm:
"Ince Zangwill is in very good condition today and can effectively control his demigod mythical creature state. Therefore, he decided to make no reservations and try his best to escape from here."
As the last stroke of the classical quill fell, Ince Zangwill's body changed. Four arms without skin and covered with feathers grew from his waist and ribs.
His teeth grew longer and sharper, even covering his face.
In an instant, Zangwill was lying on the ground, transformed into a strange creature with eight legs and covered in white feathers.
The entire square inexplicably turned to night. The insects in the soil, even the bacteria on the floor tiles, died one after another, entering eternal slumber.
This was a collection of the power of 'Night' and 'Death'.
Above the 'Gray Fog', Klein saw Daly and Leonard rapidly losing their lives in their sleep, and used lightning to create a lightning forest, covering Zangwill.
Cracking sounds were endless.
This woke Daly and Leonard again. Their spirituality seemed to realize something, and they immediately closed their eyes and quickly retreated outside the square.
In the square, seeing that he could not get rid of the lightning strikes at all, Zangwill put away one 'leg' and wrote on himself while running with '0-08': "An unknown existence was attracted by the battle and felt very sympathetic to Ince Zangwill's encounter. He decided to help him and take him away from the underworld!"
At this time, Daly, hiding in the corner, realized that a force was coming from the underworld. She took a deep breath, suddenly rushed out, opened her outer robe, took out a men's walking stick, and pinched the head of the stick and pulled it out, pulling out a thin sword.
Klein on the 'Gray Fog' was slightly stunned: Isn't this Hobert's walking stick? How is it in Daly's hands?
In an instant, Daly's skin became a little more transparent. Her coiled hair pushed away her hood and scattered around: "Spirits who roam the underworld, fearsome undead creatures, unpredictable visitors!
I, in my name, beg you to leave here!"
Behind Zangwill, a figure was outlined. It was a piece of blood-colored flesh, with countless eyes growing on it, and arms of different races inserted into it.
It was about to grab Zangwill, but suddenly stopped and cast gaze after gaze at Daly.
At this time, the quill in Zangwill's hand began to write on its own: "An unknown existence has descended on Resurrection Square and is about to take Ince Zangwill away. No, it was attracted by Daly Simone, or rather, by the thin sword in her hand. That thin sword actually has the aura of an ancient death god.
Oh, it abandoned Ince Zangwill. It decided to listen to Daly Simone's advice, or rather, order, and leave here.
Ince Zangwill is so unlucky! Hehe!"
