chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 592: Deciding to Propose to Audrey Hall (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Tyrie Aetherley for becoming a free member]
Sitting on the ground, Hobert used another "Healing Spell" on Audrey, temporarily improving her mental state.
Her beauty was still dazzling, but she was leaning entirely against Hobert's chest, allowing him to feel the softness and delicacy of her body. For a while, there was nothing but the sound of their breathing against the backdrop of the planet's ambience.
The two stayed in this position for an unknown period of time, until Audrey's corruption lessened.
Although the two of them appeared fine on the surface, Hobert knew that he and Audrey had both been severely corrupted and needed to return to Earth quickly to use the "Nation of Disorder" to absorb the corruption.
But how to leave this place?
He could try entering the "Nation of Disorder" to absorb the corruption.
However, after learning that the watchful presence outside was the "Uncertain Mist," Hobert understood the whole story.
The boy born in Selena's house was a portion of the "Uncertain Mist's" divided consciousness, but due to the existence of Earth's protective barrier, the power it could bring was very limited. Therefore, it could only use the method of influencing Selena to set a trap and send Hobert to this planet.
As for why this planet, one reason might be that Mr. "Door" had previously left some "road signs" in the cosmos that the little boy could use.
Another reason should be that this place has a protective magic circle.
The little boy had a very close cooperation with the "Uncertain Mist," giving Hobert enough time to explore this place, and then the "Uncertain Mist" appeared and kept watching here.
Severely corrupted, Hobert and Audrey had to hide in this magic circle and use it to isolate the "Uncertain Mist's" gaze.
It's not that this magic circle is so strong, but that it was only the "Uncertain Mist's" gaze.
It's like the sunlight outside the window is dazzling, so you pull the curtains to block the sunlight. If you explain this behavior with optics, the direction is completely wrong. This is just an act of blocking sunlight.
Hobert knew that the "Uncertain Mist" was creating opportunities for him, giving him time to enter the "Nation of Disorder"!
Theoretically, the "Nation of Disorder" is on Earth, within the protective barrier, and Hobert has no way to enter the "Nation of Disorder."
The main body of the "Uncertain Mist" certainly can't perform any operations, but as long as he tries to enter the "Nation of Disorder," the little boy on Earth will definitely find this source based on the reaction of the "Nation of Disorder"!
After that, the change of ownership of the "Nation of Disorder" is certain, and Hobert will also die on this strange planet.
So, if Hobert were himself now, he would never give the "Uncertain Mist" any chance.
But now it's not certain, because Audrey is here. When she felt that her life was coming to an end, she confided her inner feelings.
This caused the emotions in Hobert's heart to completely explode. In that case, he might try to enter the "Nation of Disorder" to save Audrey's life.
Hobert also understood why the little boy had to stay in Selena's sister-in-law's belly for more than seven months. He was observing the people and things around him, allowing himself to have some humanity.
It was precisely because the little boy possessed some humanity that he sent Audrey here as well, putting Hobert in emotional torment.
Hobert was very clear that even if he tried to enter the "Nation of Disorder," he would not be able to save Audrey, and they would inevitably die tragically here in the end.
But another voice in his heart would say: How do you know if you don't try? What if you can enter the "Nation of Disorder"?
Audrey, who was mentally exhausted, said to Hobert again: "Hobert, if I'm about to lose control, kill me immediately. I don't want to become a monster."
"It won't happen," Hobert smiled. "How could the beautiful Audrey become a monster?"
Audrey lay in Hobert's arms and smiled weakly: "Hobert, you're lying."
She felt her feelings towards him grow stronger. If she had been the one to marry him, if they weren't trapped on an unknown planet...
She placed a hand on Hobert's chest and said with a heavy heart: "How wonderful it would have been if we had made our mutual admiration clear sooner."
In the heat of the moment, she acted impulsively and pressed her body to his. The warmth of Hobert's body brought her comfort in what she believed were her final hours.
Hobert sighed: "We were previously bound by too many rules."
Suddenly, Hobert felt the last bit of the "Earl of the Fallen" potion being digested.
Just now, Audrey broke the aristocratic decency she had always adhered to, and Hobert betrayed his marriage!
These are the things that the two people have been adhering to, the reason why they have long had affection for each other and knew that the other person had affection for themselves, but they have been slow to express their true thoughts.
Now, they have broken the last rules that bound them. The more they adhered to them before, the more serious the "fall" is now.
Not only that, Hobert completely let go of his thoughts and was already fantasizing about a life where he had both Fors and Audrey at the same time.
He found that his love for Fors had not diminished, but he had simply given Audrey an extra share of love.
Thinking about it, Hobert, who was already somewhat desperate, was actually ignited with fighting spirit again. He lowered his head and gently kissed Audrey's lips. She didn't resist and instead hugged him closer.
"There will always be a way, we will definitely be able to go back! After we go back, I will immediately go to my father and ask him to propose an engagement to Earl Hall!" Hobert said resolutely.
The marriage of the Loen nobility also has an engagement procedure. Generally, when both parents feel that the marriage is suitable, they hold a grand banquet and ball to announce the marriage to other nobles.
His marriage with Fors was only valid within the Feynapotter Kingdom, so he still counted as an eligible bachelor in the Loen Kingdom, and there was no shortage of noble ladies who wanted to marry him.
Audrey's originally pale face also had a touch of blush: "I will also tell my father that I want to marry you!"
Audrey decided that Hobert was the one for her, the "prince charming" of her dreams. If they survived, it was acceptable to marry him.
Hobert smiled and scratched Audrey's face with his index finger, feeling that his previously withered spirituality had become lively again at this time: "Let me think, let me think..."
Since there is no way to use the "Nation of Disorder," he can only think of other ways.
First, Hobert thought of using the power of the underworld to return, but then he thought that the underworld is only a part of the spirit world, an area opened up by the Ancient Death in the spirit world. It is not yet known whether this planet has an underworld.
But he still took out the thin sword and scratched it, and sure enough, there was no reaction, so he had to ask for help from outside.
The first outside help Hobert thought of was "The Fool," so he prayed to "The Fool" several times, and unsurprisingly, there was no response.
There certainly wouldn't be any response. Although the Sefirah Castle is powerful, Klein is too weak now. Currently, he can only respond to prayers around the world, and he cannot respond throughout the universe for the time being.
Theoretically speaking, the seven orthodox gods in the astral world should be able to respond within the scope of the universe, but they cannot do this under the gaze of the outer gods!
However, Hobert still prayed several times unwillingly, reciting the honorific names of other gods besides the Eternal Blazing Sun several times.
He still didn't get any response!
Hobert wondered whether to pray to the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" or the "Mother Tree of Desire," these are all genuine Outer Deities.
But then he immediately thought: Even if they come, they will at most drive away the "Uncertain Mist," and they will not be so kind as to send himself and Audrey back to Earth.
If they are discovered by them, they may die even more tragically.
Finally, Hobert sighed: Could it be that he has to wait until Klein becomes half a Great Old One before there is hope of going back?
Thinking of this, Hobert suddenly recalled something. He had once helped the Evernight Goddess retrieve a sealed artifact in a stable state from the "Devil Monarch" Farbauti.
This should be a very crucial step in the Evernight Goddess's plan to become a god.
At that time, Farbauti said that with that sealed artifact, all creatures in the universe who believe in the "cosmos" could become the Evernight Goddess's anchors.
Then that is to say, if you pray to the Evernight Goddess in the universe, she can hear it!
But Hobert then thought that he and Audrey had prayed to the Evernight Goddess more than a dozen times before and after, why hadn't they received any response?
After a little thought, Hobert seemed to understand. The Evernight Goddess can only hear the prayers, but she shouldn't be able to reply.
To get a response from the goddess, you must establish a certain connection with the Evernight Goddess!
Thinking of this, he reached out to take out the candle he carried with him.
But thinking that establishing an altar may not be able to establish a connection, because the connection between the altar and the kingdom of the gods is theoretically a channel connecting in the astral world.
On Earth, this is easy to do.
But the astral world of this planet must be different from the astral world on Earth, just like the spirit world position of the Berserk Sea is different from the spirit world position of Loen.
At this time, Hobert thought of the "Concealment Fruit" he was carrying, which was originally used to guard against the angels of the Tamara family, but it could be used as a lighthouse to guide the goddess.
Just as Hobert was about to use the "Concealment Fruit," the earth suddenly trembled, and the entire tower became shaky, and the magic circle protecting them also began to shake violently.
Hobert grinned, revealing a smile. The "Uncertain Mist" must have sensed that Hobert was about to take uncontrollable actions, so it immediately took action to stop it.
He quickly injected spirituality into the "Concealment Fruit." This magical object immediately floated up, the peel faded away, and inside was a pure black flower.
The flower bloomed rapidly, and a sense of tranquility filled the hearts of Hobert and Audrey. The black light instantly covered the tower and a large area around it, making it seem as if it had suddenly entered the night.
At the moment when the "Concealed World" and the "Real World" separated, Hobert saw the tower collapsing and a huge crack opening on the ground!
At this time, Hobert quickly prayed to the Evernight Goddess: "The Evernight Goddess stands higher than the cosmos and more eternal than eternity. The Mother of Concealment, The Empress of Misfortune and Horror, Mistress of Repose and Silence."
"Your devout believers beg for your attention;"
"I pray that you take me and Audrey back to Earth!"
Hobert and Audrey both felt a huge suction force from the direction of the sky.
Although the surrounding scenery seemed unchanged, Hobert and Audrey could clearly feel that they were rapidly leaving the ground.
At that moment, a voice came from outside. Hobert wasn't sure if it was a voice, but he understood the meaning it conveyed: "There are two suns on this planet, there's nowhere to hide!"
The "Concealment Fruit," that black flower, began to shake violently. The hidden space where Hobert and Audrey were located also shook with a "rumbling" sound, as if a tin-roofed house was being hammered by a great force.
At the same time, the hidden space rapidly shrank. It was previously about the size of Tony Manor, which occupied one-fifth of Blue Mountain Island, but now it was only about the size of a small reception room.
Fortunately, the surrounding scenery changed, and starlight appeared outside the hidden space.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. This indicated that the Evernight Goddess had allowed this hidden space to break through the blockade of the "Uncertain Mist" and was returning the space, along with Hobert and Audrey inside, to Earth.
Hobert and Audrey smiled at each other. Audrey didn't hold back her praise: "Hobert, you're amazing!"
She wanted to hug him, but held back instinctively due to her noble etiquette training.
"We must thank the Goddess!" Hobert suddenly drew a full moon on his chest with a serious expression and said, "Praise the Goddess."
Mirroring Hobert, Audrey also habitually drew a full moon on her chest: "Praise the Goddess."
Then she said, "Hobert, take me to the Rorsted Archipelago, I've only seen the scenery there in magazines, I really want to go and see it!
"I also want to go to the snow mountains of Amantha, and I want to go to the Eternal Night Plain.
"I also want to go to the Gargas Islands to eat whale meat, I also want to go…"
As she spoke, Audrey began to cry with some excitement: "There are so many, many places I want to go with you."
Audrey had walked the boundary between life and death once. She didn't want to stay caged as a noble anymore. She wanted to experience the world with Hobert by her side.
Hobert kissed Audrey's eyes: "Okay, we'll go slowly. Wherever you want to go, I'll go with you!"
Audrey didn't hold back this time and snuggled into Hobert's arms: "Mmm."
Perhaps it was because the surroundings were too tranquil, or perhaps it was because Audrey's spirit was too weak, she relaxed after learning that she could return to Earth.
She actually fell asleep in Hobert's arms.
Hobert quietly looked at the hypnotic cosmos, pondering how to deal with that little boy later.
After about seven or eight minutes, when the black flower began to slowly wither, the surrounding hidden space dissolved.
Hobert found himself in bright sunlight, surrounded by bushes, familiar vegetation, and insects.
They were back on Earth, but they didn't know where they were now.
The "Concealment Fruit" seemed to have exceeded its load-bearing capacity. Instead of retracting its petals and turning back into a fruit like before, it quickly withered. Petals of black fell off, turning into a small ball of black mist, which eventually dissipated quickly into the air.
In the end, this mystical item only left some powder, which fell on the ground and quickly grew into several Deep Sleep Flowers.
Hobert didn't feel sorry at all. It was worth it to sacrifice a mystical item to get himself and Audrey out of danger!
He first looked around and saw a spectacle in the sky not far away. It was clearly daytime, but a peaceful night sky could be seen over there.
He speculated that their current location should be in the Amantha Mountains, and that place where it was still a peaceful night sky during the day should be the "Tenebrous Heaven," the location of the Cathedral Serenity, the headquarters of the Evernight Goddess Church.
Audrey was still sleeping and very weak. The corruption in her body had to be extracted immediately.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert made a praying gesture and then entered the "Nation of Disorder." After feeling the pull from above, he sat on the "Iron Throne" as usual.
Hobert looked around and didn't notice anything unusual. He quickly waved his hand and brought all the Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts to his side.
Then he picked up the "Black Emperor" card and merged it into his spiritual body.
Hobert's image changed. His whole body was covered in black armor, and on his head was a crown with a holy light. A large, long cloak suddenly appeared behind him.
Finally, Hobert released Trunsoest, who was sealed in the pool.
At that moment, the hall he had built trembled violently, as if it could collapse at any moment.
Opposite the "Iron Throne," the bronze door used for sacrifice and bestowal was suddenly pushed open a crack, and a child's arm reached in.
Whoosh~
Half of the hall collapsed at once, and the surrounding mountains, forests, clouds, sky, and clock tower could be seen.
But Hobert remained seated on the "Iron Throne" without moving.
That arm tried to stretch into the "Nation of Disorder," and finally half of its upper body squeezed in, revealing a small head with black hair.
He, or rather He, was the child born in Selena's family.
"I didn't expect you to be able to come back!" The other party said with a childish voice and a smile: "But it's useless, you can't beat me!"
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert immediately felt the "Iron Throne" being pulled towards the bronze door. A consciousness was trying to seize control of the "Nation of Disorder."
Fortunately, Hobert had merged with the "Black Emperor" card in advance and was the current master of the "Nation of Disorder." His Sequence was only slightly lower than that of the boy.
So the "Iron Throne" only moved slightly towards the bronze door before stopping in place.
This was the tactic Hobert had thought of during the process of returning to Earth. He felt that although the boy was only a part of the "Uncertain Mist," he should possess the Sequence of half an Outer God in certain aspects, such as competing for the "Nation of Disorder."
Therefore, Hobert had to use the "Black Emperor" card to raise his Sequence. In this way, at least he wouldn't be defeated at the first touch when competing for control of the "Nation of Disorder!"
This was also the reason why Hobert didn't let the Black Hound spirit beast and other henchmen come to help, because they might be controlled by the little boy and help him attack himself!
The little boy was also a little surprised. He obviously didn't expect Hobert to have such a high status!
He tried his best to pull the "Iron Throne," which symbolized control of the "Nation of Disorder," but it only moved a little closer to him.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert competed with the little boy for control while slowly picking up the "Marauder" pathway Sealed Artifact "1-101" and grabbing him. He instantly stole the little boy's thoughts for the next two seconds.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief. This guy was now like the "Creator," possessing only status but not enough Beyonder characteristics to support it.
Hobert was too clear about this state. In some respects, this little brat was difficult to deal with, but most of the time, a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact could completely deal with Him.
According to the time of the stolen thoughts, Hobert deduced that this little boy might only have the strength of Sequence 4, but his Sequence was extremely high in many cases.
These thoughts flashed through Hobert's mind. Taking advantage of these two seconds, he first used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to push the little boy out, but failed.
So he quickly picked up "1-105," the Sealed Artifact corresponding to the "Abyss" pathway Sequence 3 "Blatherer."
A two-handed greatsword emitting a sulfurous smell appeared in Hobert's hand. He threw it at the little boy like a dart, hoping to nail him to the bronze door.
The little boy with dazed eyes suddenly had the ring-shaped symbol above his head rotate.
The blue flames on the two-handed greatsword disappeared, and then quickly shrank, turning into a dagger and falling between Hobert and the little boy.
Hobert was stunned: What ability is this?
But now was not the time to think about this. Taking advantage of the fact that the little boy had not yet recovered his ability to think, he took "1-110," which he had obtained from the Feathered Serpent and roughly corresponded to the "Death" pathway Sequence 3 "Ferryman."
This was Hobert's tactic. If he used any power from the "Nation of Disorder" to attack the little boy, it might form a pull with him. So it was better to attack the little boy with the Sealed Artifacts, because the Sequence of the "Nation of Disorder" suppressed these Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, and their negative effects could be ignored.
Holding "1-110" in his hand, a layer of pale white light immediately covered the armor on Hobert's body. At the same time, Hobert in his spiritual state became much taller and mightier, exuding a terrifying aura.
The moment the little boy recovered his thoughts, Hobert waved his hand at Him, and his life force began to drain rapidly, rushing towards death.
This blow immediately made the little boy frown and had to retreat a little outside the door.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert desperately competed with the other party for control of the "Nation of Disorder" and tried to push the other party out with the power of the "Nation of Disorder."
The little boy went out a little more. He wanted to come back, but he had to be distracted to resist the rapidly disappearing life force, which put Him in a predicament of "fighting on two fronts."
At this moment, Trunsoest, who had been unsealed, came to the collapsed hall.
He looked at Hobert on the "Iron Throne," who was continuing to exert force and could not take care of other things, and then looked at the little boy who was trying to squeeze in.
Trunsoest walked towards the bronze door without hesitation and kicked the little boy hard.
The little boy gritted his teeth and continued to persevere, but then Trunsoest stepped on the little boy's face with one foot and pushed his head out.
So the little boy only had one arm left in the "Nation of Disorder." Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert quickly closed the bronze giant door.
This time his efforts finally worked, and the bronze door was slowly closing.
Just as it was about to close, the little boy quickly retracted his arm.
Thump~
Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne," was panting, as if he had just experienced a fierce battle!
But he didn't have time to rest at this moment. He smiled and said to Trunsoest, "Thank you for your help, but I'm sorry, you have to go back again."
As he spoke, Hobert waved his hand, and Trunsoest was thrown into the pool at the foot of the mountain, sealed by Hobert once again.
A/N:
Also!
I am very sorry that the recent two chapters may have contained plots that made everyone uncomfortable. Here, the author solemnly apologizes to everyone. The author's foreshadowing was still too little.
In the future, if there are similar plots, the author will definitely handle them carefully.
However, the protagonist's character will indeed undergo some changes later. After "falling," there will be "madness," which will definitely have some impact on him, but the author will learn from the experience and try to add more foreshadowing to make it look more reasonable.
Also, the author wants to explain that it's not that the barrier is no longer effective, allowing the Outer Gods to project too much power onto Earth, but that the Uncertain Mist has been planning for over a thousand years.
As mentioned before, the corruption of the Uncertain Mist was obtained from the hands of the Trunsoest family members.
Spoiler alert: in the author's setting, this is what polluted Trunsoest.
From that time on, the Uncertain Mist hoped to be "born" in this world, but it has always been guarded by members of the Trunsoest family, and now it finally has such an opportunity.

chapters.content:

[Thanks to Boom B for becoming a free member]
Hobert took a few breaths, mobilized a rich concentration of "Power of Order", and condensed it into the shape of black chains and bolts, setting up several blockades inside the bronze gate.
But this could only increase the difficulty for the little boy to enter the "Nation of Disorder", and could not completely prevent his intrusion.
Fortunately, the little boy's strength is not very strong now, and he should need a certain opportunity to get a chance to enter the "Nation of Disorder".
He has already used up this opportunity, so there is no need to worry about him constantly trying to enter the "Nation of Disorder".
After setting up the blockade, Hobert used his star to look at the real world.
Sure enough, both he and Audrey had a very strong layer of white mist on them.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert reached out and grabbed, and the corruption on the two of them was rapidly sucked into the "Nation of Disorder", forming a cloud of white mist that lingered for a long time.
This was corruption from the main body of the "Uncertain Mist", and it seemed particularly difficult to clean.
Hobert used the "Power of Order" to interweave it back and forth several times before dispersing the thick fog and quickly dissolving it in the "Nation of Disorder".
Looking at himself and Audrey in the real world again, both their spiritual bodies and physical bodies were clean, without any corruption.
Back in the real world, Audrey in Hobert's arms finally woke up. Because she didn't have to fight the corruption anymore, her spirit looked much better, but she was still a little weak.
Hobert looked at his pocket watch, which had been damaged under the pressure of the "Uncertain Mist". He smiled helplessly: "I don't know what time it is now, and I don't know how long we've been 'missing'."
Audrey was very calm at this time: "Anyway, it has been discovered by the family, so there is no need to rush for a while.
"Let me rest for a while, let me enjoy this beautiful moment."
From here, you can see the grass at the foot of the mountain like waves, and the towering snow-capped mountains in the distance. The scenery is not bad.
Hobert and Audrey enjoyed this moment of tenderness very much, but a few seconds later, Hobert suddenly thought: "The Selena family's life and death are uncertain, I will send you back first, and then go to Tingen to take a look."
Audrey was slightly taken aback: "We will go to Tingen together."
Hobert thought for a while and said, "I will send you to the Church of the Evernight Goddess in Tingen."
While speaking, Hobert took off his windbreaker and put it on Audrey, wrapping her somewhat torn long skirt.
Then he used "Travel" to send Audrey to the Church of the Evernight Goddess in Tingen, and then used "Travel" to come to Fania Street in the North Borough.
As soon as he came out of the corner, Hobert saw many people gathered in front of Selena's house, and several policemen were talking to each other outside.
Hobert took out the MI9 certificate and asked the policemen what happened in the house.
It turned out that a few hours ago, someone heard screams coming from Selena's house, so they called the police, but after the police came, they couldn't get in.
The reason was very ridiculous. Every policeman who came to the door would fall, and fall very badly! Two policemen had fallen into the hospital.
Hobert seemed to understand something. He walked to the door, and sure enough, a "Falling Spell" came from inside. After "distorting" it, he opened the door and went in.
Hobert saw Selena kneeling not far from the door in the dim room. Her face was full of horror, and her left hand was raised towards the door.
But she no longer had any vitality. The Beyonder characteristic merged with her bracelet, forming a sealed artifact that could make people within a certain range fall.
Hobert sighed silently, closed her eyes, took off the bracelet, and laid her on the ground.
Mr. Wood and Mrs. Wood were still sitting on the sofa as they were when they came last night, with smiles still on their faces and expressions still a little tired. They were also dead.
Finally, Hobert came to the bedroom on the first floor and found the bodies of Selena's brother and sister-in-law.
Without going to the second floor to check, Hobert knew that the boy had run away long after killing everyone.
He slowly returned to the living room, sat on the sofa and looked at Selena's body expressionlessly. Her lively and talkative figure seemed to appear in front of him again.
The deaths in the Beyonder world are always so sudden.
Hobert originally planned to let Selena go to the Special Operations Department to train, hone her temperament, and give her important responsibilities in the future.
A few years later, she would get married and have children, and form a happy family.
When she came back with her husband and children, Mr. Wood and Mrs. Wood should be very happy and run out to greet her from afar.
But this fresh life was gone like this.
Her soul had already entered the underworld. Even if it was recalled, there would be obvious defects, and it would be difficult to stabilize her state after resurrection.
After sitting for more than half a minute, Hobert finally regained his emotions, opened the door and used his authority and pounds to let the police outside summon people to handle the funeral.
In the evening, the Selena family had been buried in the cemetery.
Hobert stood in front of Selena's grave for a long time. After the priests and workers had left, Hobert said, "Next time I come, I will bring Him, no, His head to pay tribute to you!"
After taking one last look at Selena's tombstone, Hobert returned to the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Audrey, who was already a little worried, knew from Hobert's expression that the people had not been rescued.
Hobert asked, "Did you pray to the Evernight Goddess to express your gratitude?"
Audrey nodded, wanting to comfort Hobert, but felt that no comforting words were appropriate at this time, so she just grabbed Hobert's hand, letting Hobert try to feel the warmth transmitted from her palm.
Hobert patted the back of Audrey's hand, indicating that he was fine, and then he began to pray to the Evernight Goddess, and whispered the whole story, and finally hoped that the Evernight Goddess could provide the boy's location.
As soon as he finished his request, the entire church suddenly became more silent, and the internal Night Emblem turned into an endless cosmos.
In a half-dreaming state, Hobert heard a soft and somewhat ethereal voice: "He used some methods to hide himself. Be careful, he will bring you many misfortunes!"
Hobert sincerely thanked the Evernight Goddess, and then said, "I will also become his greatest misfortune!"
At this time, Hobert broke away from that half-dreaming state, and the endless cosmos turned back into the Night Emblem.
Only Hobert heard the conversation just now, and even Audrey next to him did not hear it.
The two walked out of the church together, came to a deserted corner, and Hobert used "Travel" to directly send Audrey back to her bedroom.
At this time, her bedroom was empty, but the doors of the cloakroom and other rooms in the bedroom were open, and the servants should have looked for it more than once.
Hobert first put Audrey on the bed, covered her with a blanket, and then came to the corridor and shouted, "Please call Earl Hall over!"
The servants who were searching in vain were startled. They had already searched the bedroom and found no one!
Some people recognized Hobert. They had many speculations about his appearance at the door of Audrey's bedroom and the disappearance of Miss Audrey for a whole day.
At the same time, they immediately went to notify Earl Hall.
When Susie saw Hobert, she knew that Audrey had returned and ran into the bedroom from outside to check.
Audrey, who was lying half-lying on the bed, smiled and said, "Susie, were you worried about me?"
Susie glanced at Hobert at the door: "Woof woof!"
About seven or eight minutes later, Earl Hall and his wife, with anxious faces, rushed over with many guards and servants.
As soon as he came to the end of the corridor, Earl Hall asked loudly, "Hobert, where did Audrey go?"
Hobert was guarding the door of the bedroom at this time: "Guards and servants should not come in for the time being. Go prepare some food, not cold, not spicy, not too greasy!"
Then he invited Earl Hall and his wife to enter the door.
After seeing Audrey lying on the bed, Earl Hall and his wife finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Audrey sat up: "Mom and Dad, I'm sorry, I made you worry."
Countess Caitlin rushed over to hold her daughter's hand, sat on the edge of the bed and asked with red eyes, "Where did you go? When did you go out?"
Earl Hall stood next to Hobert and looked at Hobert with a serious face.
Hobert said, "I'm sorry, I took Audrey out to play last night, and we encountered danger."
He had just asked the servants that he and Audrey had been missing for a whole day, which meant that today was Sunday.
Hobert saw Caitlin's complaining eyes and Earl Hall's frowning brows.
But he still continued: "Audrey is very healthy now, just a little weak and needs to rest for a few days. I suggest that she not participate in any social activities in the next few days."
Earl Hall said seriously: "Hobert, I originally thought you were a very stable young man, but I didn't expect you to do such an amazing thing.
"Even if your friendship is deep, you can't enter Audrey's bedroom!
"This is very impolite and a behavior that is easy to be ridiculed by other nobles!"
Audrey quickly said, "Father, it's me..."
Hobert waved his hand at Audrey: "Uncle Hall is right to criticize. I didn't consider it carefully. I will take responsibility for this."
Earl Hall's heart skipped a beat, and he had a strong bad feeling: Why did he suddenly call me uncle?
At this time, the servants brought food.
Hobert personally checked it and it met the requirements he had just said. Because he was afraid of stimulating Earl Hall and his wife, he did not feed Audrey, but let the servants serve her to eat.
Before eating, Audrey said to the servants: "Earl Hobert has not eaten either. Send him a portion of the same food."
Hobert was not polite: "I just want that yogurt nut oatmeal, give me more."
Earl Hall always felt that something was wrong.
The servant brought the oatmeal, and Hobert stood in front of Audrey's bed and ate it in big gulps with a spoon.
At this time, Earl Hall realized that Hobert's performance was too casual, and it was like returning to his own home!
After drinking a bowl of sweet and sour oatmeal, Hobert handed the bowl to the servant, and then said to Audrey: "Take a good rest, I will come to see you in two days."
Audrey nodded: "Put the revenge aside first, let's find the boy's trace together."
"Okay." Hobert said to Earl Hall, who had a somewhat ugly face, "My father will come to visit tomorrow, I hope you can agree to my marriage with Audrey."
After speaking, Hobert bowed slightly and left quickly.
Caitlin then reacted: "Did I hear it wrong just now? Just, just now he said, said marriage?"
"You didn't hear it wrong!" Earl Hall probably understood their thoughts from Audrey's expression when she talked to Hobert just now: "What he said was indeed marriage."
At this time, Audrey, who was sitting on the bed, said very firmly: "Father, I want to marry Hobert!"
Caitlin covered her mouth in surprise: "Oh my God, Audrey, you, you..."
Earl Hall calmly reminded: "He has been married once."
The look in Audrey's eyes was still very firm: "I don't care!"
Caitlin was about to faint, but Earl Hall sighed: "We'll talk about it tomorrow."
...
Hobert did not return to the Earl's Mansion, but went to MI9. Chief Georgina was still in her office.
After entering the door, Hobert went straight to the point: "I want to issue a reward order."
Georgina, who was originally looking at the documents, glanced at Hobert who suddenly broke in: "MI9 is a functional agency, not serving someone!"
Hobert sat opposite Georgina and said, "A family has all been killed by the murderer."
Georgina said indifferently: "That's the police's business, not within the scope of MI9's responsibilities."
Hobert thought for a while: "I will install electric lights for MI9 for free; the pounds for the reward will be paid by me."
"I firmly believe that the murderer must be a spy from an enemy country!" Georgina said seriously: "Give me the portrait, I will sign the reward order!"
Hobert took the paper and pen, and quickly drew the portrait of the little boy according to the guidance of spirituality, and wrote the words "100,000 pounds" below.
After seeing the portrait of the little boy, Georgina looked at the reward amount and then asked: "Are you serious?"
Hobert said seriously: "The reward order to the major churches must be noted that this is a devotee of an evil god, with at least a level of Sequence 4, very dangerous!"
Georgina nodded slowly: "I know."
Hobert certainly knew that such a reward order might not be very useful for capturing the little boy, but it could compress his activity space.
After leaving MI9 and returning to the Earl's Mansion, Hobert also sent the portrait of the little boy to South Colson and Longtail Island, and told Angus and Helen that after discovering this little boy, do not deal with it yourself, and immediately pray to the "Creator".
Then Hobert asked people to call Elizabeth, Dennis, who had just been promoted to "Barbarian", and Freya on Longtail Island, and announced the news of Selena's death.
The three were a little unbelievable, but they had to accept the news.
Elizabeth cried: "Mr. Hobert, why is this happening? She is only 18 years old this year!"
"Of course I know." Hobert buried himself in the sofa and said, "I also feel sorry for her."
Dennis's eyes were red: "We also agreed to go to the harvest festival together."
Freya also choked up and asked: "Has the murderer been caught?"
"No." Hobert said, "I am looking for him, and I will find him."
Or, after a while, he might come to him himself, but that would mean that the little boy was sure of killing Hobert, or was sure of using Hobert again to try to enter the 'Nation of Disorder'.
The four people lit candles, simply arranged a memorial scene, mourned Selena together, and talked about Selena's life, and went back to rest very late.
For Elizabeth and the other three, tonight was destined to be a sleepless night.
Hobert also sat at his desk for a long time, but he was not entirely thinking about Selena and the little boy, but also about his advancement.
Currently, the potion has been completely digested, and he also has Beyonder characteristics. As for the auxiliary Ingredients, he has been asking Fors to help him pay attention to them, but so far he has only received the venom of the white-striped spider.
As for the other three auxiliary Ingredients, Hobert has eight-year-old red wine in his wine cellar, and the scale crystal of the Carp Fish is not a rare material either. Hobert estimates that he can trade it from Alger or Cattleya.
The most difficult to find is the brain fluid of the Six-Whiskered Mutant Beast. In the past six months, Hobert has never heard of this auxiliary Ingredient, nor has he heard of the whereabouts of the Six-Whiskered Mutant Beast.
Hobert thought for a while and decided to visit several Beyonder families the day after tomorrow to see if they had such accumulation?
The main reason why he was not fully prepared was that Hobert did not expect that he would encounter the opportunity to completely digest the potion so quickly.
Hobert sighed: Might as well use the time to find auxiliary Ingredients to restore my state.
He suffered serious corruption last night, and his spirit body may need to rest for a few days to fully recover.
Then Hobert came to the "Nation of Disorder" and checked the blockade he had set up. It was still very strong and showed no signs of loosening.
Hobert is now sure that although there is a certain connection between the little boy and the "Nation of Disorder," he does need a certain opportunity to have a chance to invade the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert reorganized the scattered Sealed Artifacts, then repaired the dilapidated hall before considering the little boy's matter.
He first thought that this should be a conspiracy that "Uncertain Mist" had been brewing for a long time. According to Farbauti, "Uncertain Mist" used some loopholes in the rules to descend power on Earth three times in total.
Hobert guessed that these three descents of power may have formed something similar to the bottle of white mist found by Archibald. One of them was once obtained by Solomon, so Solomon began to hunt down the "Genie"!
Another bottle was obtained by Trunsoest, and Trunsoest was later polluted by the "Nation of Disorder."
Hobert guessed that it was very likely that Trunsoest wanted to use that bottle of white mist to find the "Nation of Disorder," but as soon as the "Nation of Disorder" was found, He was severely corrupted, so the six gods took action, and the Night Emperor fell.
This conjecture can be verified with Trunsoest, who is sealed at the foot of the mountain in the pool, but Hobert thought about it and finally gave up. He decided to wait until Trunsoest could communicate normally before he would talk about it, and perhaps gain unexpected gains.
This is not a distant thing. Hobert felt that after he was promoted to Sequence 3, the sealed Trunsoest would be able to communicate with him normally.
Then Hobert continued to think about the little boy's problem. His goal was very clear, which was to come to Earth to seize the "Nation of Disorder."
This gave Hobert a certain sense of urgency about being promoted to True God. Only by being promoted to True God can he have a chance to fight against the "Uncertain Mist" in the cosmos and completely eliminate the power it projects onto Earth!
Finally, Hobert thought of the butterfly effect that Adam had reminded him of before, and guessed that this little boy might be the most direct manifestation of the butterfly effect. After all, he didn't remember the original book mentioning this guy.
In any case, that little boy is currently the biggest enemy, and all forces must be mobilized to find him and eliminate him!
Even if he can't be completely eliminated, he must be crippled!
After considering many other messy things, Hobert returned to the real world, watching the fog outside gradually thicken.
He took a deep breath, as if he had made up his mind, and used "Travel" to come to Longtail Island.
Above the sky of Longtail Island, there was a large and bright crimson moon, and the waves were constantly lapping on the beach. There were sounds of night insects everywhere.
Compared to Backlund's night, the night here is more like night.
Hobert stood in front of the bed in the bedroom, looking at the sleeping Fors.
He had been watching for more than half an hour, and Hobert, who was usually eloquent, couldn't figure out how to bring up the matter between him and Audrey.
Thinking about it, Hobert sat on the edge of the bed and held Fors's hand.
Fors woke up groggily from her sleep: "Hobert?"
She asked again after seeing Hobert's expression: "You, what's wrong with you?"
"I…" Hobert smiled helplessly: "Sorry Fors, I…"
Fors's expression gradually became serious: "I see, is it Princess Alice? Or Miss Audrey?"
Hobert couldn't believe his ears: "Huh?"
"Since I started writing, I have liked to observe the people and things around me, which is very helpful for the detailed descriptions in my novels." Fors said:
"At the Earl's mansion party, I discovered Alice's and Audrey's admiration for you."
As well as Hobert's restraint and forbearance.
Hobert opened his mouth, and finally repeated those words: "Sorry, Fors…"
"You should apologize for disturbing my good dream." Fors said without any expression: "Go back, I need to rest."
"I…"
"Go back, I need to rest!" After Fors finished speaking, she lay down again and turned her face to the other direction.
Hobert knew that staying here would not help, and would only make Fors even more angry, so after saying good night, he returned to Backlund.
Fors also had insomnia. She sat up, looked at the beach under the moonlight outside, and sighed for a long time: "This day has finally come."
...
The next morning, Hobert, who had not slept all night, first went to MI9 to urge the release of the bounty order, and then took a carriage to Duke Christian's mansion.
As a member of parliament, Christian doesn't have to go to work every day now, so Hobert's adoptive parents are at home.
The three of them chatted for a few words before Hobert explained his intention: "Father, I want to marry Miss Audrey. I hope you can help me mention this matter to Earl Hall."
Christian was slightly startled: "Are you serious?"
"I am serious." Hobert said: "Audrey and I have just experienced some things that have allowed us to let go of many of our own constraints and face this relationship directly."
Christian was silent for a few seconds before saying: "Since that's the case, I will go to Earl Hall's place."
Then he asked: "Does Fors know about this?"
Hobert said: "I have, I have told her about this, and I will find time to talk to her properly."
At this time, Mona suddenly opened her mouth and said: "You child, like your father, are not worry-free."
Hobert smiled helplessly, not knowing whether his mother was talking about his adoptive father Christian or his biological father Rex.
Mona sighed and then said: "I will go talk to Fors and express my apologies for you."
So they acted separately. Christian took a gift to Earl Hall's place not far away, and Mona went to Hobert's mansion and used the "Traveler's Gate" there to go to Longtail Island.
Hobert stayed in the Duke's mansion to wait for news.
More than two hours later, Christian came back first: "My conversation with Earl Hall went smoothly. We have already agreed to have me host a dance in a few days to announce that you are in love."
The marriage of Backlund nobles is divided into two stages: choosing a marriage partner, and engagement and marriage.
The most complicated is actually the stage of choosing a marriage partner. Generally, it has to be compared repeatedly, and it may take seven or eight years to make a final decision.
After all, the marriage of nobles is called "a battlefield without gunpowder smoke." Many nobles have strengthened their families through marriage, and even annexed the territories of other nobles through marriage.
However, the situation of Hobert and Audrey is relatively special, skipping the first step and directly reaching the second step.
The first stage of the second step is to announce the news that the man's father has proposed marriage to the woman's father. If the woman's family does not refuse, then it is considered relatively satisfied with this marriage partner.
At this time, both parties have to examine each other, and there is still a long way to go to the engagement step.
Therefore, Christian was somewhat surprised that Earl Hall could agree so readily. According to the set of procedures of the nobles, even if Earl Hall was very satisfied with Hobert, this marriage issue would have to be discussed two or three times before there could be a result.
After all, the entire Backlund knows how beautiful and excellent Audrey is, and Earl Hall places high hopes on her.
After listening to Christian's description, Hobert felt that this should be inseparable from Audrey clearly expressing her attitude towards marriage.
On the other hand, the entire Backlund noble circle has a consensus that Hobert will definitely get married again in Backlund.
Although their father and son have integrated into the aristocratic class through their respective channels, the nobles of Backlund still believe that Christian and his son will definitely conduct another marriage alliance in order to quickly complete the binding of interests.
Hobert and Audrey have been inseparable on many occasions. I believe Earl Hall has been somewhat mentally prepared for this before.
Then Hobert talked to Christian about his preparation for advancement. Christian was very surprised at Hobert's speed of digesting the potion.
Then he told Hobert: "I have the brain fluid of the Six-Whiskered Mutant Beast here. I collected it unintentionally a few years ago.
"I originally thought that you would need a year or two to digest the potion, so I didn't rush to tell you."
Hobert clapped his hands. He didn't expect that the problem that had been bothering him would be solved so easily!
Then, at the Tarot Gathering this afternoon, if he can trade for the scale crystal of the Carp Fish, he can try to be promoted tomorrow if his condition is good.
Hobert also talked about his encounter with Brandon during his previous mission to Masin.
Christian didn't seem to have any good feelings for this Seer: "This guy is very annoying."
Hobert nodded, which was a consensus between the two.
After another half an hour, Mona came back. After she entered the room, she said: "Fors doesn't seem surprised by this."
She sighed: "She also said that when you left South Colson half a year ago, she had such psychological preparation."
Hobert fell into silence.
Christian patted Hobert on the shoulder, wanting to say something, but because Mona was present, he didn't say anything.
Hobert got up and said: "I'm going to Longtail Island to see Fors again."
He decided to spend more time with Fors recently.
Using "Travel" to come to Longtail Island, it was lunchtime at this time.
However, Hobert did not find Fors in the Governor's Mansion restaurant, but found her in the living room.
Fors was in front of a full-length mirror. She saw Hobert's arrival from the mirror, and did not turn around: "Hobert, I am far from Audrey's beauty."
Hobert sincerely said: "No, Fors, you know the darkness of this world but still love this world, and still love life. This is where you are most beautiful."
Fors was still looking at Hobert in the mirror and said: "Xio has already told me some time ago that the entire Backlund noble circle believes that you will definitely get married again.
"As you said, this is the nobility."
Hobert said seriously: "You will always be the hostess of Longtail Island and South Colson."
"But thinking that others will share your love with me, I am still very unhappy." Fors then said: "Hobert, I will never go to Backlund again in the future, and please don't let Audrey come to South Colson and Longtail Island either."
Hobert nodded: "No problem."
"Okay, you can go back."
Hobert scratched his head: "We can go to lunch together."
"No, you should go back." Fors said: "Now the hostess of Longtail Island does not welcome you."
"Okay." Hobert also felt that staying now was not a good choice.
Returning to Backlund, Hobert was relieved. Fors would still be angry with him, and could still negotiate with him, which meant that she still cared about him.
Then Hobert sighed that this era had saved him. After all, this was still an era where the aristocratic class was the ruling class, and it was normal for a noble man to have several women at the same time.
If this happened in the AD era, it would be a proper "Shura field."
Hobert never expected that the first half of the "Shura field" had passed so smoothly.
Audrey doesn't care, Fors drives Hobert away.
Then there is only the second half left, find an opportunity to "break the ice" with Fors, and as long as you are careful in the future, this matter will basically be over.
Hobert sighed, lamenting that he had become a scumbag with peace of mind.
After sorting out his mood, Hobert put the brain fluid of the Six-Whiskered Mutant Beast obtained from Christian into the safe, and then used the "Traveler's Gate" to go to South Colson, went to the auction house to pick up the venom of the white-striped spider, and finally went to the wine cellar to find a bottle of eight-year-old wine.
It was about three o'clock when Hobert returned to his room, preparing to attend the Tarot Gathering.
The thought of seeing Audrey and Fors at the same time filled him with a strange excitement.
At precisely three o'clock, the gray fog obscured Hobert's vision, and when it cleared, he was once again in the giant hall above the gray fog, on one side of the long bronze table.
Hobert looked at Fors, the "Magician," almost directly across from him, but Fors glared at him and looked away.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Foo... Fool," Audrey, "Justice," greeted, noticing Fors's reaction and pausing slightly in the middle of her greeting.
In fact, since last night, she had been wondering how to face Fors in the future. After thinking about it, she decided to avoid it if possible.
Everyone noticed the Justice Miss's absent-mindedness during her greeting and was curious about what was troubling this optimistic and cheerful noble lady.
It was because she was distracted by the earlier incident that she noticed a new member at the Tarot Gathering halfway through her greeting.
It was a gentleman, sitting to the right of Mr. Moon.
While greeting, she observed the new member: black hair, no coat, a somewhat awkward posture, as if he didn't like sitting so formally, and a rather nonchalant demeanor.
Audrey then noticed that the gentleman was quickly looking around! This behavior was not inherently problematic; anyone entering such a strange and secretive place would instinctively survey the other members. But the problem was that the gentleman's eyes moved too quickly!
To Audrey, this was a very clear signal: he was looking for someone!
Thinking of this, Audrey's mood improved considerably: this gentleman knew someone present!
Who could it be? Audrey continued to observe and found that the gentleman's gaze lingered on Hobert: he knew Hobert?
At this moment, Hobert was also somewhat helpless. Initially, when he saw "Star" Leonard, he was pleased that this guy had finally joined the club.
But when he saw Leonard's gaze fixed on him, he wanted to remind him: Poet classmate, I'm not the person you're looking for.
Then he thought it wasn't Leonard's fault, because compared to the other members, he did resemble Klein more.
Although "Hanged Man" Alger was cautious and didn't even seem like someone from the Storm Church, his inherent boldness, acquired from years at sea, couldn't be concealed, making him distinctly different from Klein.
"Sun" Derrick was over two meters tall and a sixteen or seventeen-year-old teenager, more vibrant than Klein.
And "Moon" Emlyn's slightly raised chin and, even with the gray fog obscuring him, his handsome face, were far more attractive than Klein's.
Although it couldn't be ruled out that he had altered his appearance, his temperament was vastly different from Klein's. Moreover, making oneself handsome at such a secret gathering was a flamboyant move and easily remembered by other members.
Based on Leonard's understanding of Klein, he wouldn't do that.
That only left "World" and "Emperor." "World's" hunched appearance gave off a sinister vibe, which clearly didn't resemble Klein.
So Leonard finally looked at "Emperor," but then he seemed to realize something and shook his head. Although "Emperor" wasn't as handsome as "Moon," he was still better-looking than Klein.
After much deliberation, Leonard looked at "World," after all, hunching and sinister could be faked.
"This is the new member: Star!" At this moment, "Fool" Klein, at the head of the bronze table, announced.
Leonard thought helplessly, "Star" always makes me feel like it's a substitute for a lady.
Everyone was drawn by the "Fool's" voice, and only then did they notice that the Fool Mr. had undergone some subtle changes compared to the last gathering.
This great being seemed to be more harmonious and unified with the entire space of this palace, the entire gray fog.
His aura was even more lofty, like the sea, or like the sky.
Audrey immediately realized: Fool Mr. is further recovering, taking back more authority from the Divine Kingdom?
This made her somewhat joyful, and the gloom from earlier was swept away.
She introduced herself with a smile: "Hello, I am 'Justice'!"
Alger, Derrick, and others introduced their code names one by one.
Leonard also took this opportunity to carefully observe the other members: Justice Miss. seemed to be a young girl with a great sense of style. Hanged Man Mr. looked very rugged and seemed like a rather frank person...
After observing all the way to "World," Leonard concluded in his heart: very gloomy, this should be Klein's disguise.
During this process, everyone also observed the new member and formed their own opinions about this Star Mr.
After the self-introductions, "Hermit" Cattleya said to "Fool" at the head of the bronze table, "Honorable Fool Mr., I did not receive Roselle's diary this time."
Klein nodded lightly. The meaning of not receiving it was that the "Queen Mystic" did not provide a new diary. He calmly replied, "Let's begin the transactions."
Currently, almost everyone had what they needed. Audrey was about to advance to Sequence 6, "Hypnotist," and the main ingredients and formula for advancement had long been obtained.
Alger was currently worried about how to digest the "Ocean Songster" potion, because his singing was really terrible.
"Little Sun" Derrick had just obtained the Beyonder characteristics and potion formula of "Priest of Light" from "World," spending a total of 12,000 pounds, which "Emperor" had helped him pay. He was now dreaming of earning merits, exchanging materials, and repaying Emperor Mr.'s debt as soon as possible.
Fors was about to completely digest the "Astrologer" potion. Hobert had already prepared the Beyonder characteristics for her to continue advancing, and she had also obtained the potion formula from her teacher. She also had several practical mystical items and had no needs.
Emlyn was also about to advance, but "Emperor" had already promised to provide him with Beyonder characteristics, and the potion formula could also be obtained from the Sanguine.
Cattleya had obtained the blood of mythical creatures and was currently planning to advance to a demigod, so she had no new needs.
Klein had just become a demigod and was pondering how to digest the potion, and the Sequence 3 potion formula and main ingredients would be difficult to trade at the Tarot Gathering.
Currently, the only ones with needs were Hobert and Leonard, but Leonard didn't know how to initiate a transaction, so he chose to wait and see.
So Hobert spoke first: "I need the scale crystals of the Shadowed Fish."
Apart from Leonard, everyone immediately recalled that the last time Hobert requested Beyonder materials was when he was preparing to advance to Sequence 4. Was he now preparing to advance to Sequence 3?
Fors really wanted to ask Hobert privately, but she ultimately restrained herself and still didn't want to pay attention to this guy.
Cattleya said, "I know where there are Shadowed Fish, and I happen to be not far from their activity area.
"Although its value is not very high, it is difficult to catch, so I will ask for 2,000 pounds.
"Well, the 'help' I owed you last month can be deducted by 1,000 pounds."
"Deal," Hobert agreed, "When can you give it to me?"
Cattleya said, "Before eight o'clock tomorrow morning, or before eight o'clock the day after tomorrow."
She explained with a smile, "To catch this kind of fish, it must be between 5 a.m. and 7 a.m. If I don't catch it tomorrow morning, I can only catch it the day after tomorrow morning."
Hobert "Oh"ed and said, "If you need help, I can help."
Cattleya immediately became somewhat wary and said, "It shouldn't be necessary."
This transaction ended, and Leonard, seeing that someone had already started, relaxed a lot and took the initiative after a few seconds of deliberation: "I need a mystical item."
"What type?" Audrey responded in a timely manner to avoid the new member encountering a cold reception after making a request for the first time.
Leonard subconsciously responded: "I don't know."
Everyone looked at "Star," with three of the gazes from the ladies containing care.
Klein, who was very familiar with Leonard's nonchalance and casualness, suppressed his laughter and slandered in his heart: This is probably an idiot.
