Under the awning in the eastern mountains, Hobert watched the pouring rain outside with a cold face.
His concern earlier wasn't entirely feigned, but it wasn't enough to make him lose his shoes in a panic.
Hobert opened his spatial magic leather bag, took out his shoes, and put on a vest, instantly making him look more composed.
After re-buttoning his cuffs, Hobert waved to Angus at another awning, inquiring about what had happened.
After listening to Angus's description, Hobert suddenly remembered a document he had seen before, sometimes "Mountain God" Megali would display her power somewhere on Longtail Island.
For example, causing a certain area to lose direction, or fundamentally disrupting the order of a village, and so on.
Was Fors's encounter a coincidence?
Hobert took a deep breath and gently waved his hand. Angus immediately noticed that the raindrops within his sight no longer fell, but were suspended in mid-air, which surprised him slightly: the Earl's power seemed to have become stronger.
Whoosh~
Four or five seconds later, the raindrops seemed to finally escape the strange power's constraints, and continued to fall to the ground with great momentum.
Just now Hobert didn't feel any abrupt power, so he got up and took a step unhurriedly, appearing five kilometers away when his foot landed.
Angus in the awning was a little surprised and excited. He was completely sure that the lord was now a Sequence 3.
He was excited because only the patriarch in the Tudor family was a Sequence 3, and it was very difficult to become the patriarch. Anyway, Angus knew that he would not be able to become the patriarch in his lifetime.
But serving "The Creator", becoming a Sequence 3 didn't seem difficult, and it didn't seem to be the ultimate peak.
A few minutes later, Hobert returned to the awning, still finding no clues about the "Mountain God".
Sitting in the chair under the awning, Hobert saw that the frozen water droplets on the ground not far away were just beginning to melt.
This reminded Hobert of the "ice water whirlwind" he saw in "True Sight". The Mountain God's state seemed a little strange, because the "Black Emperor" pathway did not emit cold aura.
Although it was possible to "tamper" with the surrounding temperature to freeze the raindrops, there was no need to do so. The "Black Emperor's" main ability was "distortion", and lowering the temperature was only to create more favorable conditions for himself, or unfavorable conditions for the target.
For example, if the "Hunter" pathway used fire-type attacks, they could lower the temperature to make the enemy need to consume more spirituality to complete a normal attack.
At that time, Fors and Xio did not need to use temperature reduction to suppress them.
So Hobert was almost certain that the "Mountain God's" state was a little strange, making it difficult for her to suppress the cold aura she was emitting.
Hobert thought for a while, but couldn't figure it out, so he waved his hand, and the surrounding rainwater suddenly changed its path and fell elsewhere: "Let's start again!"
So the next journey was a bit magical for ordinary people. The rain was still pouring, but not a single drop fell on the team members.
This would definitely expose the existence of extraordinary power to some extent, but Hobert didn't think he had an obligation to keep it secret.
He would still hide it before, but now that he has become a "Frenzied Mage", he is too lazy to hide it.
Moreover, the officials among these people basically came from the "Traveler's Gate", and these servants had just experienced an extraordinary event, they had already been exposed to the supernatural, so there was no need to keep it secret.
When they arrived at the river, the rain basically stopped.
Hobert saw that the river water had begun to become turbid, and even seemed ready to rush out of the river bank at any time.
The villagers on both sides of the river had begun to take their families and prepare to flee to higher ground.
As for the crops in the fields, they could not be taken away. Whether they could be preserved, and how much could be preserved, all depended on "the will of the gods".
On the way back, Hobert talked to the officials in charge of agriculture and water conservancy. Dams must be built, but how high and how to build them must be consulted with professionals.
Spend money when necessary, and don't save money on the planning stage.
After setting the tone for this matter, Hobert asked Angus to protect everyone back, and he took the lead to "travel" back to the Governor's Mansion.
After meeting Fors and Xio in the office, Hobert said calmly: "The matter of building the dam has been basically determined, and next we will begin to discuss how to build it."
Fors nodded: "I see."
Hobert said to Xio: "I have something to talk to Fors alone."
Fors said: "Is there anything Xio can't know?"
Obviously, she didn't intend to give Hobert a chance to talk alone.
Xio looked at Hobert with a smile, wondering how he would respond.
Hobert cleared his throat: "Okay, recently 'The Creator' is going to launch a war against the Demoness Sect in the Southern Colson area. The main participants have basically begun to gather in Southern Colson, they have..."
"Wait." Xio raised her hand: "I'd better go out."
She was not willing to have too much involvement with "The Creator" at the moment. If she knew the next plan of "The Creator's" forces, it would be difficult to avoid being involved.
Fors was also a little helpless. She knew her friend's thoughts and knew that such things should be kept as secret as possible, so she had to watch Xio open the door and leave.
"I mean, we have to do a good job of reception." Hobert smiled: "This is a good time to show the construction achievements of Southern Colson."
Fors rolled her eyes at Hobert: Why did he start talking about things that weren't secret again?
"How is the construction of the factory area?" Hobert asked as he walked towards the wine cabinet, only to find that there was no wine left: "Where's my wine?"
Fors, who was sitting on the sofa, replied: "I had someone take it away."
It wasn't that she was too angry to have someone take it away, but that Hobert drank too much wine at last week's tourism festival, so she had someone put all the wine away.
Hobert smacked his lips and had to pour a cup of tea: "I suggest we establish a work mechanism, because the next period of time is a critical period for the construction of Longtail Island.
"If we don't want the people here to be like they are now, braving the heavy rain and taking their children and the elderly to the open high ground to avoid floods, we can't be careless.
"In this regard, maintaining effective communication between you and me is very important."
Although Hobert's way of gaining sympathy was a bit shameless, it was very useful. Fors had always sympathized with the local natives, so she had always wanted to do something for them.
At the same time, Fors gradually fell in love with governing recently, because she saw that under Hobert's advocacy, the policies promoted by Mayor Kondra had greatly improved the situation of some natives.
For example, the miners, their working environment was much safer, and they only worked eight hours a day, and their diet was completely improved.
Fors clearly saw that their faces were no longer so sallow, and they also had some energy and spirit, no longer as numb as before.
At the same time, Fors also knew that her level was limited, so she had never interfered in the city government, but carefully completed the work that Hobert gave her: reviewing financial appropriations, paying attention to the observation of officials' abilities, and coordinating the supervision department to supervise the work of the city government.
And reviewing financial appropriations requires more consideration of the actual situation, so Fors has been touring around recently.
Hobert's suggestion, Fors had no reason to refute, so she began to talk about the recent construction of the industrial zone.
This is equivalent to acquiescing to Hobert's suggestion.
At present, the construction of the second batch of relatively technical industrial zones has been fully launched. Hobert directly used the name of "The Creator" to let Upton travel back and forth between Longtail Island and Backlund to coordinate these technical issues.
There is no problem with the planned construction of the second batch of factories, but there are many problems with the planned construction of the third batch of factories.
First of all, the third batch of factories is relatively technical, such as machinery factories, steam engine factories, shipbuilding factories, etc. Only Hobert can easily obtain relevant technologies through Mr. Digos for steam engine factories.
Even if Hobert uses the identity of the Earl, it is difficult to obtain other types of technologies.
The key is to establish corresponding research and development institutions to transform the obtained technology into processes that can be used for mass production. If this institution is set up on Longtail Island, it is difficult to recruit people.
Another problem is the construction land. The entire eastern plain of Longtail Island has been basically utilized, unless it is squeezing arable land, otherwise there is no large area of land available for factory construction.
However, there are many places in the mountains that are suitable for building factories.
Hobert calculated the time before saying: "I expect that the war with the Demoness Sect will be completely resolved within a week. Even if I fail, I will definitely severely damage the Demoness Sect.
"Longtail Island can develop with confidence, don't worry too much about the Demoness Sect's revenge."
He said: "Then the next step is to solve the problem of the Mountain God Church. There is no need to worry too much about the technical personnel problem. I estimate that by the end of the year at the latest, we can get whatever kind of talent we want.
"So after solving the problem of the Mountain God Church, these factories will start to be built!"
Fors was slightly taken aback, but did not ask why the technical personnel problem could be solved by the end of the year. Generally, Hobert said that it could be solved, it could definitely be solved.
After the work was finished, she got up and was about to issue an eviction order, but Hobert said again: "Let's talk about Xio's problem."
Fors sat down again: "What's the problem?"
"I only thought of it when I was inspecting just now, should I let Xio join 'The Creator's' forces?"
Fors nodded first. This was a good opportunity for Xio.
But she shook her head again: "Xio will not join at the moment."
"As long as you also think my idea is good, I can think of a way." Hobert said: "Sometimes, whether to join 'The Creator's' organization is not up to Xio to decide."
Fors did think that this idea could help Xio. According to her observation, so far, whether it is Hobert, a devotee of "The Creator", or Angus and others, who serve "The Creator's" power, there have been no obvious mental problems.
On the contrary, some people on the west bank of Full Moon Lake have become more mentally stable after they started praying to "The Creator".
Moreover, according to some information announced by Hobert at the Tarot meeting, and some actions of "The Creator", it shows that this is a very normal god.
Xio has no faith at the moment, if she can believe in "The Creator", that would be great.
However, Fors was still a little worried: "What are you going to do?"
"I can ask 'The Creator' to issue some tasks to Xio, so that Xio can gradually integrate into our group." Hobert said:
"After I leave in a while, you lie to Xio and say that when you prayed to 'The Creator' for help just now, 'The Creator' noticed Xio."
Such an operation made Fors a little confused: "Can 'The Creator' agree to such a request?"
That is a god, will he help Hobert solve such trivial matters?
"Doesn't Mr. Fool often provide us with help?" Hobert smiled: "Otherwise, why does everyone want to be a devotee of God?"
He paused and said: "I only need to pay some acceptable price, or complete other tasks, to offset this request."
Fors immediately said: "I will pay you the corresponding reward."
Hobert smiled: "No need, Xio is also my friend."
Fors was about to say something, but Hobert said: "If you really want to give me some reward, let the kitchen make an extra work meal, after all, it's almost lunchtime."
Fors opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but in the end she didn't refuse.
Seeing Fors agree, Hobert whispered: "When you talk to Xio in a while..."
In the office, one person was responsible for coming up with ideas, and the other was listening carefully, and occasionally the two discussed it.
Lunch was eaten by Hobert, Fors and Xio together. Xio was a little surprised to observe Hobert and Fors. They casually talked about some things on Longtail Island, and there seemed to be no estrangement when they first met.
After lunch, Hobert left Longtail Island. He knew the principle of knowing when to stop.
It was already very good to get to this point today. This kind of thing should be done slowly, don't rush.
After Hobert left, Fors suddenly said to Xio very seriously: "Xio, there is one thing I want to formally notify you."
Her friend suddenly became so serious, and Xio was a little unaccustomed to it: "What's the matter?"
"When we were attacked by an unknown force this morning, I prayed for the help of 'The Creator'." Fors said: "Hobert just told me that 'The Creator' noticed you."
Xio was a little surprised, and immediately went to feel her spirit body and spirituality, and found nothing uncomfortable.
"Don't be surprised," Fors smiled according to the rhetoric that Hobert told her: "Hobert asked me to remind you that if 'The Creator' issues you any tasks in the future, then congratulations, you will have the opportunity to become a devotee of 'The Creator'."
Xio didn't know whether to laugh or cry: "What's so congratulatory about this?"
Then she asked: "What tasks will 'The Creator' issue me? What if I can't complete them? Why would he notice me, instead of noticing you?"
Fors saw that Xio was indeed beginning to actively learn about the "Creator" as Hobert had guessed, so she began to tell her about what the "Creator" had done in the past year or so.
She didn't make a single summary statement, but the focus was on saying that the "Creator" was a very normal god, and how he helped the people at the bottom, and described this gaze as an opportunity.
She also said that Hobert was also at Sequence 7 when he received the attention of the "Creator" under some coincidental events. In the past six months, he has not only done many things to help ordinary people, but now he is already a demigod.
Xio had always felt that the "Creator" was a god who was both righteous and evil, but ultimately similar to evil gods like the "True Creator" and the "Primordial Demoness."
Listening to Fors's narration, and recalling the scenes she had seen on Longtail Island recently, there was no sign of bloodiness or distortion at all, but instead it was filled with a beauty of a new order.
The more she heard, the more Xio felt that this might really be an opportunity.
...
Hobert returned to Backlund to continue preparing for the war.
He estimated that he might spend less time in Backlund recently, so he first asked Chief Georgina for a leave of absence.
Hobert didn't have any actual responsibilities in MI9. He was usually just slacking off at work, so he could take leave whenever he wanted.
Then, Hobert took a carriage to Earl Hall's mansion, first visited Audrey's mother, Catherine, and presented a gift.
Today, Earl Hall and his eldest son, Hibbert, were not at home, so Hobert came to visit Catherine first.
Catherine didn't have a good impression of Hobert, but she didn't have any malice either. The reason she didn't have a good impression was mainly because there were too many bad rumors about Hobert before. In her opinion, he was not a stable nobleman.
The reason she didn't have malice was because Hobert was indeed very capable and had many ideas. He always brought unexpected surprises.
Considering that Hobert was likely to marry his daughter in the future, Catherine still received him warmly.
After chatting for more than ten minutes, Hobert made a request to see Audrey.
Although this was not in accordance with the rules, after all, their "relationship" had not been made public, Catherine did not refuse.
So, Hobert met Audrey, who was having afternoon tea in the garden.
She was wearing a relatively loose long dress, and her hairstyle and jewelry were relatively casual, but matched with her beautiful face and perfect figure, these clothes and jewelry became radiant.
Beside Audrey, there was a golden retriever lying down. There was half a bowl of dog biscuits in the food bowl in front of it, and another bowl of water. It seemed to be enjoying a pleasant afternoon.
Seeing Hobert, she stood up and smiled: "Hobert, I thought you had forgotten me."
Hobert smiled and quickly stepped forward, picked up Audrey and spun her around: "How could I? My little elf."
The moment Audrey was picked up, she was taught to be reserved since she was a child as an aristocrat, so the first thing she thought of was to break free, but she soon felt that being held and spun around was quite exciting, so she only left "giggling" laughter.
After all, this was Earl Hall's mansion, so Hobert couldn't do too much. So he put Audrey down, took her hand, and kissed the back of her hand: "Because of that little boy, I've been quite busy lately."
Audrey nodded slowly and asked the servant to serve Hobert tea and snacks.
She asked with a smile: "You won't have time to attend the ball next Thursday, will you?"
Next Thursday, Duke Christian will hold a ball to announce the two's "relationship."
Hobert sat next to Audrey: "Of course I don't have time. Next Thursday, I'm going to dance the opening dance with the beautiful Audrey at Duke Christian's ball. I don't have time to accept your invitation."
Audrey was stunned for a moment before she understood Hobert's joke: "Hobert, you seem to be different from before, but... but that's good."
Originally, she wanted to say "but I like it very much", but the habits she had developed since she was a child prevented her from expressing it so directly.
Hobert took a sip of tea and smiled: "That's because I was Earl Hobert before, but now I'm Miss Audrey's lover."
Audrey's cheeks were a little red: "That's really good."
Then she asked: "I heard from my father that 'Earl's Light' has started selling equipment for manufacturing light bulbs?"
Audrey smiled: "It is said that many shareholders are very surprised by this."
In the past few days, she began to pay attention to the operation of "Earl's Light" in an "open and honest" manner without any concealment. Earl Hall usually helped her pay attention to information in this regard. Only Hibbert expressed dissatisfaction with this and repeatedly reminded Audrey to be reserved.
Hobert tasted another piece of snack: "This is also the reason why I don't want to see those shareholders, because it's too troublesome to persuade them one by one. Facts will 'persuade' them."
Then he asked: "Would you like to take a position in 'Earl's Light'?"
Audrey was slightly stunned: "I'm already working in a charity."
Working before marriage is the main way for noble women to experience life.
"It's up to you." Hobert smiled: "I just think the decision-making level of 'Earl's Light' is too young and I'm a little worried."
Currently, the top decision-makers of "Earl's Light" are Hobert's two confidants, Todd and Upton. The middle level is several noble children from Backlund. At the same time, the decision-making level has also absorbed several grassroots worker representatives.
Although these people do not have shares, they have bonuses in addition to their monthly salary.
Audrey smiled and shook her head: "Hobert, I'm younger than those managers. If I participate, their average age will be younger, right?"
"The meaning of your joining is different." Hobert said very seriously: "My strategy is generally no problem, but I'm just afraid that they will do something inappropriate when I'm not here.
"As long as you are in 'Earl's Light', even if you don't do anything, they will think more about it when making decisions."
In fact, "Earl's Light" currently completely follows Hobert's decision. The company's decision-making level is more like a department that discusses how to implement Hobert's decisions.
Audrey immediately said: "After going to 'Earl's Light', I want to do some practical work."
"Of course!" Hobert smiled: "You can be the CFO."
Audrey was stunned: "I don't know much about finance."
"That's why I want you to be the CFO." Hobert said: "Specific affairs can be left to professionals. The CFO doesn't necessarily know everything.
"Well, I'll find you a teacher to familiarize yourself with the specific business while working."
He smiled and said: "Your main responsibility is to supervise the source and destination of every penny, so that there will be no situation where a roll of toilet paper in the factory costs 3 pounds to buy."
As the daughter of a banker, Audrey immediately understood that Hobert wanted her to supervise and spend the money where it should be spent.
The two chatted about "Earl's Light" and the ball next Wednesday for a while, and Hobert got up to say goodbye.
Audrey didn't ask how far the investigation into the little boy's matter had progressed, or what Hobert had been busy with during this period, but just reminded Hobert to be careful.
After coming out of Earl Hall's mansion, Hobert took a carriage to Christian's mansion.
Similarly, after discussing the ball, Hobert told Christian about his upcoming actions in South Colson and asked him to participate in this action to cover up any possible accidents.
Christian knew that Hobert might have a close relationship with the "Creator", but he had never asked about it.
Today, Hobert asked him for help, and he agreed very readily.
After having dinner with his parents and younger brother at the Duke's mansion and chatting for a while, Hobert returned to the Earl's mansion.
Arriving at the study, Hobert called Dennis over again, because Dophis had already gone to South Colson yesterday. During this period, Hobert planned to leave the Earl's mansion to him to manage.
After explaining this matter, Hobert sat at his desk and considered his arrangements for the next few days.
Thinking about it, he thought of Fors again, and thought of Audrey.
Suddenly, Hobert recalled a question. It was not long after he was promoted to "Earl of the Fallen". Hobert was very worried that if he continued to be promoted, his humanity would become weaker and weaker, and he would become more and more cold.
At this time, Hobert suddenly realized that after being promoted to "Frenzied Mage", his humanity not only did not weaken, but was even warmer than before.
He realized that this was likely the influence of Fors and Audrey, as well as his parents, sisters, brothers, subordinates, and others.
In theory, friendship, family affection, and love can all strengthen and solidify humanity.
Hobert also recalled his previous conversation with Trunsoest, who said that Auernia gave him a lot of humanity. He, a "Justiciar", at least a "Prince of Abolition", could get more humanity from his queen.
Hobert is now a "Frenzied Mage", and can get double the humanity bonus from Fors and Audrey.
For a Sequence 3, this kind of humanity is enough to resist its divinity, and even for Sequence 2 it should be enough.
Along this line of thought, Hobert also thought that although his humanity did not show any signs of being weakened, it did not mean that divinity had no influence on him at all.
Hobert thought carefully about his behavior in the past two days, and he noticed that he seemed to hate the current rules more and more. Whenever he encountered any rules, he always wanted to break them.
Just like yesterday when he went to visit Dr. Allen, he could have used a mystical item to change his appearance and take a taxi to "see a doctor."
But at that time, Hobert felt very annoyed by the middle class's habits of visiting and so-called decent behavior, so he simply pretended to be an acquaintance of Dr. Allen to visit.
Even if it would cause some trouble afterwards, he felt it was acceptable.
Now, looking back, Hobert realized that he had been breaking some of his habits and some of the principles he had set for himself for a while.
But at that time, he was not so disgusted with normative things. This was obviously influenced by divinity unconsciously.
Regarding this point, Hobert felt that he should be alert, because some rules are not necessary to break, or it is not cost-effective to violate some rules.
When encountering such rules, don't violate them if you can.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert calmed down and used "Travel" to come to the Lord's Mansion in South Colson.
After letting the servants clean up the bedroom for him, Hobert went to the villa area to meet Lawrence of the Balk family, as well as Barnett of the Tudor family and Osmund of the Tony family.
Hobert only personally greeted them when they came. After that, Hobert asked Donna, who had been promoted to "Sheriff", and the housekeeper Dophis to entertain them.
In the past few days, Donna took the people from the three families to tour the entire scenic spot, as well as the plantation on the west coast, and the factories and farmland, and explained to them the current governance policy of South Colson and some special policies.
At this time, the three families had a deep understanding of the South Colson area. The first thing they realized was that the power of the "Creator" also had a place in the northern continent where the seven orthodox churches gathered.
Don't look at the small South Colson area, with a population of only more than 100,000, but as long as there is such a place, it shows that the "Creator" has been widely recognized in the northern continent. At least the organization that serves the "Creator" is not like the Aurora Order and the Demoness Sect, which are well-known secret organizations.
Secondly, they realized that the policies in this territory were very different from other places, which seemed to be showing some will of the "Creator".
This made them further realize the influence of the gods on the real world.
Finally, there was their mutual guess that the reason why Hobert brought the three families together was to make the power loyal to the "Creator" seem less thin.
So the three families felt that they were just a part of the "Creator's" power.
After Hobert met with the heads of the three families separately and briefly talked about the arrangements for the next few days, he used "Travel" to come to the highest peak on the east bank of Full Moon Lake.
Under the moonlight that was still bright tonight, Hobert stared blankly at his territory in front of him.
At this time, Hobert felt a little unreal. At this time last year, he was still a college student with only 15 pounds of pocket money.
Now Hobert doesn't even know how much his assets are. As soon as he has time, he thinks about how to spend the money.
As for his current identity, he is already an earl, with two territories, thousands of subordinates, a regular army of 3,000 people, and nearly 800,000 subjects.
And all this happened in the past year.
This made Hobert not only feel that this mysterious world was magical, but his fate also seemed very magical.
Thinking of the large-scale Beyonder war he was about to organize, Hobert couldn't help but feel a little excited, with a bit of arrogance that "the world is in my hands."
"Your advancement speed is as fast as taking a train!" Bernadette's voice suddenly sounded.
Hobert looked over along the voice and saw Bernadette sitting on a swing surrounded by flowers and vines. The rope of the swing seemed to be tied in the void. In short, the top of the rope could not be seen.
Bernadette looked a little unreal, like a character in a TV or movie.
She was wearing a very smart shirt and a pair of neutral trousers, with boots that had long shafts.
Her hairstyle was very fashionable, but distinctly different from the hairstyles of women in the Northern Continent, looking very elegant and unrestrained.
Coupled with Bernadette's stern expression, Hobert had the illusion of meeting a beautiful woman in the square downstairs in his neighborhood.
Bernadette swung forward on the swing and jumped off the swing surrounded by somewhat illusory flowers and vines, standing right in front of Hobert.
She immediately became real, without any sense of illusion.
And the swing and flowers behind her disappeared.
Hobert smiled slightly, answering like a charlatan, "These are all gifts from the Lord."
Bernadette didn't continue the topic, but asked, "I heard you're going to have a Beyonder war?"
"Yes, the opponent is the Demoness Sect." Hobert said, "If you participate, I will pay you a certain reward. As for the spoils, the sealed artifacts can be yours, and the Beyonder characteristics must be mine."
Bernadette asked again, "Do you have a chance of winning?"
"Currently, the odds of winning are not small," Hobert replied.
Bernadette pondered for a moment and said, "What kind of reward are you going to give me?"
Hobert smiled and said, "A 'Mysticologist' Beyonder characteristic."
He obtained this Beyonder characteristic from the second Aurora Order demigod he killed. It's useless to keep it in the 'Nation of Disorder,' so it's better to trade it with Bernadette.
Hobert added, "Of course, if there are no demigod-level Beyonder characteristics among your spoils, all the spoils of Element Dawn must belong to me before you can get this Beyonder characteristic."
The conditions Hobert offered surprised Bernadette. Element Dawn currently only has two demigods, and Bernadette is one of them.
Although Cattleya is about to become a demigod, she is still one step away. Moreover, she is ostensibly a member of the Moses Ascetic Order.
Even if Cattleya is promoted, Element Dawn's high-end combat power is very limited. This is why everyone knows that Element Dawn is fighting against the Moses Ascetic Order, but they have never heard of them breaking out into large-scale battles.
It is because Element Dawn has always lacked high-end combat power, so they try their best to avoid decisive battles. The Moses Ascetic Order is a relatively loose organization, so the two sides have been confronting each other for more than a hundred years, but rarely break out into battles.
Bernadette smiled and said, "Sounds like a good deal."
She said, "But in addition to these rewards, I also want a promise from you."
Hobert asked, "What promise?"
"If I need certain help, you can't stand by and watch." Bernadette said, "Of course, I will also pay you."
Hobert probably guessed what kind of help Bernadette wanted him to do: "No problem."
Bernadette nodded: "Tomorrow, the Beyonders of Element Dawn will arrive at your lord's mansion one after another."
Hobert said, "I will do a good job of reception."
He added, "The day after tomorrow, around 10 a.m., we will hold a war meeting, please be sure to attend."
"No problem." Bernadette agreed, stretched out a hand, and the swing she had just sat on reappeared, still unable to see where the top of the rope was.
Then flowers and mysterious vines appeared. Bernadette sat on the swing and said, "Goodbye!"
She swung forward and disappeared from Hobert's sight.
Having invited the last foreign aid, Hobert also returned to the lord's mansion to rest.
Just as he was about to fall asleep, a picture suddenly appeared in Hobert's mind.
It was Emlyn informing Hobert through Mr. Fool that the Sanguine had decided to send a demigod to participate in the war.
Hobert sat up and smiled helplessly: "Do these Sanguine like to discuss things in the middle of the night?"
However, while "The Fool" had not yet returned to bed, Hobert immediately prayed to "The Fool", asking Mr. Fool to tell Emlyn: The war meeting will be held the day after tomorrow, please the Sanguine rush here quickly, and please the demigod participating in the war be sure to attend this meeting.
Then Hobert asked Mr. Fool to tell "The World", and also invited Mr. World to attend the meeting.
After doing these things, Hobert was no longer sleepy. He guessed that Klein should have been woken up by Emlyn and was now sleepless!
Thus, Hobert looked at the ceiling and thought about things, until dawn.
On Friday morning, Fors also came early, because many people were to be received today.
First, the Temperance faction of the Rose School, led by Sharon and two other demigods, arrived in three batches.
They are different from the Balk and other families, belonging to foreign aid forces, and are relatively considered guests.
Therefore, Hobert and Fors had to personally receive them, so as not to be rude.
They basically gathered in Backlund and then came through the "Traveler's Gate" set up by Hobert.
At noon, the forces of Element Dawn arrived in two batches.
They used ancient space witchcraft, arriving from the sea and the Northern Continent respectively. Currently, only some members of Element Dawn know how to use this witchcraft.
In the afternoon, Sanguine Earl Rosalind led more than a dozen Sanguine, including Emlyn, to arrive.
At this point, all the foreign aid forces have arrived.
After entertaining these foreign aids, it was already past four in the afternoon. Hobert and Fors had just arrived in the study to drink tea when the butler Allen reported that Mrs. April had arrived.
Hobert hurried to the front yard and met April, who was waiting in the main hall. She looked radiant, and her mental state was even better than the last time they met.
April also seemed to re-examine Hobert: "Child, you look more energetic."
Hobert smiled slightly: "Mother, are you, are you okay?"
"Thanks to the black jade ring you gave me." April said, "It helped me get through the most difficult time."
Of course, Hobert's call of "Mother" also played a big role.
Hobert was very happy: "That's good, that's good!"
Then he said to Fors, who came in from behind, "Quick, tell the kitchen to prepare a sumptuous dinner!"
"Maybe you need to prepare a few more tables." April smiled and said, "I heard that the Demoness Sect is conducting a secret gathering to attack South Colson?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, but unfortunately I only know their two gathering points."
So he can only report to the orthodox churches twice, otherwise, if he starts a wave of reports, it will be enough to kill the Demoness Sect's spirit.
April said, "I have long disliked these witches, so I also brought some Beyonder forces to participate in the war."

Klein arrived in South Colson around eight o'clock on Saturday morning, using the identity of Gehrman Sparrow.
Because the distance to control the marionette had reached five kilometers, he found a hotel in the town to stay, and then manipulated the marionette to come to the Lord's Mansion.
Now he can share the vision and ability with the marionette . Although it is the marionette that arrives at the Lord's Mansion, Klein feels as if he is on the scene.
The one who received him was Dophis, who looked expressionless: "Mr. Gehrman, welcome."
The two had met at Hobert's wedding.
Klein realized that this butler seemed to feel different from before. He guessed that the other party might have been promoted to a demigod.
This made him sigh in his heart: What a luxury to have a demigod as a receptionist!
"Hello." Klein, with a cold persona, simply said hello.
Dophis made a gesture to invite him in: "This way, please."
While walking inside, Klein asked, "Am I the first to arrive?"
"No,Earl Hobert, Councilor Jonathan and Mr. Archibald have already arrived," Dophis introduced.
Klein thought to himself: I don't know Jonathan and Archibald.
Following Dophis, Klein was led to a very spacious conference room.
On the wall inside the conference room hung a huge map of the Northern Continent.
Hobert was standing in front of the map with a middle-aged man who looked very gentle and wore a military uniform, and a middle-aged man with his hair combed to be feminine, seemingly discussing something.
Dophis pointed to one of the chairs: "This is your seat, please help yourself."
Klein nodded, and saw that there were many seats around the wide and long conference table, some were separate, some were behind a large seat, and there were several large seats and small seats.
Klein's seat was one of the separate large seats.
"Ah, Gehrman." Hobert smiled: "I didn't expect you to come so early."
He greeted kindly, "Have you had breakfast? The kitchen made Feynapotter-style croissants this morning."
A smile gradually appeared on Klein's stern face: "I have eaten."
Hobert said "Oh" and then said: "Let me introduce, this is Mr. Archibald, the chief of general staff for this war, who is responsible for war planning.
"The one who just went out is Deputy Chief of Staff Dophis, you have met before, who is responsible for the logistics of the entire campaign.
"And this Councilor Jonathan is the intelligence officer for this battle."
Klein shook hands with the two of them respectively. When shaking hands with Archibald, he felt a familiar aura.
Or rather, the person in front of him seemed to be a marionette.
The two smiled at each other, and didn't say much other than saying hello.
Hobert invited Klein to sit down: "The Harvest Festival will open in a few days, are you interested in participating?"
Klein slandered in his heart: Please win this battle first.
He said, "Of course I will come and see it."
At this time, the door of the conference room was opened again, and Hobert smiled: "You sit down first, I'll go and receive them."
Klein nodded and sat in his seat.
Soon he understood why Hobert was so confident, planning to open the Harvest Festival before the war even started, because the extraordinary power gathered this time completely exceeded his imagination!
The first person Hobert received was a very tall man named Lawrence.
There were three of them in total, and they were arranged on three large seats, one in the front and two in the back.
Klein realized at this time that these large seats were prepared for demigods.
And Jonathan, whom he had met just now, was also sitting in a large seat, and behind him were two large seats and two small seats.
In addition to Archibald and Hobert himself, there were already 9 demigods in the conference room!
But more demigods arrived one after another. Hobert received another demigod dressed as a gentleman named Barnett. The two subordinates he brought were also demigods.
Then came a demigod wearing a coat with the style of the Rorsted Archipelago, whom Hobert called Osment. The two people behind him were actually demigods.
Just as Klein was sighing that these demigods who came together should each represent a Beyonder organization, Hobert greeted a very beautiful lady who looked to be in her thirties.
He heard Hobert call the other party "Mother", and Archibald stood up and politely called the other party Ms. April.
Klein guessed in his heart that this should be a member of the Trunsoest family. Hobert's rich network of contacts is inseparable from the fact that he is a descendant of the royal family.
This Ms. April only brought one Sequence 5 subordinate.
And the next participant surprised Klein a bit. It was Miss Sharron, who looked a little unreal!
Miss Sharron was also a little surprised when she saw "Gehrman Sparrow". Their seats were next to each other, but they didn't start chatting immediately, but simply nodded and exchanged glances to observe the other members of the meeting.
After that, the one who came in was the demigod Archbishop Simpson, wearing the robes of a bishop of the Church of the Earth Mother. His arrival obviously stunned everyone. No one thought that people from the orthodox church would participate.
Following closely behind was the Sanguine Earl Rosalind, who was somewhat surprised to see so many people in the conference room, probably not expecting so many people to participate.
The person who came after that surprised Klein again. It was Bernadette!
Bernadette smiled slightly when she saw Gehrman Sparrow. Under the guidance of butler Dophis, Bernadette and her demigod subordinate took their seats.
Klein looked around and sighed in his heart: This is how the high-end power of the orthodox church is.
Because everyone belonged to different Beyonder organizations, they were all watching each other, and almost no one communicated with each other.
Emlin, who participated in the meeting with Rosalind, thought after seeing Gehrman Sparrow: This is Mr. World, the recognized crazy adventurer. He is here to participate on behalf of Mr. Fool's forces! Huh, the way he looks at me seems a little wrong, it seems, it seems like he knows me?
Then he thought: That's right, a noble Sanguine, handsome, and qualified to participate in such a high-level meeting. These conditions make it easy to lock me as "Moon".
At this time, the last participant, the majestic Christian, arrived. Everyone had seen this Duke in the newspaper, and they were not surprised by his participation. After all, he was Hobert's father.
Klein was a little strange, why were Hobert's mother and father's seats so far apart?
And it seemed that although they were familiar, their relationship didn't seem to be harmonious.
Dophis beckoned for the servants to close the door. Hobert stood up and announced: "This combat meeting officially begins!"
Klein finally realized at this time how terrifying the power that the "Creator" had gathered!
Those sitting were either demigods or the backbones of some medium-sized Beyonder organizations.
And those who could sit in the large chairs around the conference table must be demigods. Klein counted and there were as many as 25!
He was a little strange. He hadn't encountered many demigods since he came to this world for so long. He always felt that there were not many demigods in this world, but when they gathered together like this, the number of demigods was so terrifying.
After a little thought, Klein understood that he usually hid in Backlund. Not to mention demigods, even angels might not be able to find his trace.
But Hobert was different. His territory and power were there, and he couldn't hide even if he wanted to. Some demigods wanted to take his life, and some demigods would unite around him. This was the difference between being in the dark and being in the light.
At the same time, Klein finally understood: No wonder Hobert was so confident. It turned out that he had gathered such terrifying combat power this time! Does this guy have a fear of insufficient firepower?
Not to mention the Demoness Sect, even if the orthodox church didn't send angels or use Grade 0 sealed artifacts, it would be difficult to resist such a large-scale enemy.
Then Klein thought again that it was a good thing that there were people from the Church of the Earth Mother among the participants, otherwise such a gathering would definitely be highly valued by the Church of the Earth Mother! They might even send angels to stare at this place.
If he was careless, he might start a confrontation with the Church of the Earth Mother before he even started a war with the Demoness Sect.
But as long as they had people and were attacking the Demoness Sect, the Church of the Earth Mother would default to the legality of this meeting, and the Feynapotter royal family would not say anything.
After that, if a large-scale extraordinary war was carried out on the territory of the Feynapotter Kingdom, as long as it didn't cause large-scale civilian casualties, no one would stand up to stop it.
At this time, Hobert, who was standing at the head of the conference table, said: "Please, Archibald, the chief of general staff for this war and the general commander behind enemy lines for this battle, explain the enemy's and our situation, and the tactics we plan to adopt!"
Archibald stood up and bowed slightly to everyone: "Hello everyone, I am honored to be able to plan such a large-scale extraordinary war.
"I think, except for this Patriarch Lawrence, few of you have participated in extraordinary wars, or almost none. This is one of our disadvantages.
"According to the reliable intelligence we have obtained, the enemy has two 'Ageless Witches' who participated in the large-scale and protracted extraordinary war of the Pale Disaster at the end of the Fourth Epoch!
"And these two 'Ageless Witches' will definitely play an important role in this battle."
Klein recalled the "Vice Admiral Ailment" he had seen on the ship. As far as he knew, at least that "Demoness of Unaging" had participated in many battles in the Fourth Epoch.
Archibald continued: "Of course, the enemy's disadvantages are also very obvious. The long-term decentralized deployment makes their organizational ability very worrying, and the power of the Demoness Sect is far less powerful than ours!
"According to our existing intelligence, the enemy is collecting intelligence and then gathering, but as of today, they have not launched a large-scale attack.
"We have only had a small-scale battle with the other party on Longtail Island. The other party seemed to want to kidnap the Lord's wife, but because we were prepared, the other party did not succeed!"
Although Hobert hadn't been in South Colson much during this time, Archibald and Jonathan had done a lot of preparation work and had already fought two small-scale battles with the other party on the Shipyard Island and Longtail Island respectively.
Archibald continued: "I personally guess that the other party should have received the news that we have gathered a large amount of extraordinary power, and they should realize their own lack of power at this time!"
Bernadette, who was sitting near the head of the table, asked: "If they don't fight this war, what should we do? Are we just going to keep waiting here?"
After all, the Demoness Sect had been a secret organization for so many years, and they could choose to disband temporarily at this time.
Then all kinds of disgusting tactics would be used in turn, such as launching small-scale raids after everyone disbanded, etc.
"I think they will fight, and even if they retreat, we will take the initiative to attack!" Archibald said: "I'll talk about taking the initiative to attack later, let me talk about the reasons why the other party must fight first.
"First of all, according to our understanding, whether it is the Demoness Sect or the Theosophy Order, the internal contradictions are already very intense.
"In normal times, such contradictions can be suppressed by higher sequences, but gathering together and doing nothing will definitely make the opposing forces within them question their leadership, or it will lead to more uprisings or defections.
"In addition, according to the limited intelligence we have obtained, many famous courtesans in various countries and regions have suspended all external activities for various reasons.
"This should be the Demoness Sect doing everything possible to gather the power they can gather. As long as they are still gathering power, it means they will definitely take action!"
Although the demigods sitting there felt that it made sense, they also felt that this war might be difficult to fight into a large-scale mutual charge battle.
Archibald continued: "After simulation, we believe that the most likely tactic the other party will take is harassment warfare!
"Because the other party has the help of the Theosophy Order, there are many Beyonders of the 'Apprentice' pathway, who are very mobile.
"In the previous small-scale conflicts, they have already adopted such tactics, a Beyonder of the 'Apprentice' pathway, paired with a Beyonder of the 'Demoness' pathway.
"If they have an advantage, they will immediately engage in battle, and if they don't have an advantage, they will leave immediately.
"Faced with their tactics, our relative tactic is to prioritize solving the Beyonders of the 'Apprentice' pathway!
"According to our statistics, there are two demigods, eight 'Travelers', and seven or eight sealed artifacts with 'Travel' abilities in this pathway!
"If we can use demigods to solve their 'Travelers', their delivery ability will be halved!"
At this time, everyone realized that this war had been prepared in great detail, and this meeting was not as simple as holding a "meet and greet".
Although everyone present usually directed others and found it difficult to accept the direction of others, everyone felt that they could listen to what Archibald had to say and then express their opinions.
"The enemy's second tactic is likely to be the 'virus tactic'!" Archibald said: "Given the experience of the Backlund smog incident, a Beyonder of the 'Witch' pathway at the demigod level can kill all the ordinary people in Jeffrey City in twenty seconds.
"Therefore, tomorrow we will evacuate the population from the city and leave an empty city to fight the enemy!"
"We believe that the enemy will never just try to harass us so simply. If the enemy wants to wage a large-scale war in Jeffrey City, they will first try to raid the Lord's Mansion, and then turn the water source into a source of poison, polluting this land with toxins."
"I have communicated with Bishop Simpson. The Earth Mother Church does have some ways to eliminate this Secrets Sorcereral virus, but it takes time. Before the virus is eliminated, Jeffrey City and the entire resort area can only be left empty."
"The surrounding farmland cannot be planted with anything either."
"Although this cannot kill our living forces on a large scale, it will bring huge losses! The Demoness Sect's tactics will basically achieve their goal."
"After all, they don't want to fight us to the death, they just want to achieve a certain victory to appease internal conflicts."
"If the enemy achieves this goal, we will be considered defeated."
At this time, everyone successively realized a point of difference between extraordinary combat and extraordinary warfare: in extraordinary combat, if one's stronghold is destroyed by the enemy, one can just leave that stronghold.
Because the cost of a stronghold is not high, and most of the cost is borne by the landlord.
But a city cannot be abandoned just like that!
Archibald continued, "Our corresponding tactic for this is an ambush!"
"We will ambush the water source, ambush the windward side, and ambush the city center, these places that easily spread the virus!"
"If they don't appear in these places, then their speed of spreading the virus must be slower, so we will have enough time to besiege them!"
The demigods finally understood why Hobert would hand over the planning and command of this battle to this stranger named Archibald.
This is a demigod with a war mindset. After coming here, everyone in their hearts already greatly admired Archibald's war planning level.
Archibald gave everyone a few seconds to understand the tactics, and then said, "If the enemy does not attack for a long time, then we must counterattack!
"Now, please let Councilor Jonathan speak and report their major discoveries to everyone."
Archibald sat in the seat below Hobert, and Jonathan stood up in front of the map and said to everyone: "Two days ago, we used some scattered clues to find the Demoness Sect's headquarters!"
For a time, everyone was moved by this. This is equivalent to discovering a fatal weakness of the enemy. No wonder Archibald clamored for a counterattack, it turns out he knew where the enemy's headquarters was!
Jonathan walked to the map and pointed to the huge map and said: "It is located on the west side of the Central Plateau, within the territory of the Intis Republic, upstream of the Srenzo River!"
At this time, Sharron, a member of the Moderation faction, suddenly reminded: "According to our intelligence, the Demoness Sect's headquarters seems to be in the Southern Continent."
"Yes!" Jonathan said: "We also obtained such clues, and associated with the history of the Demoness Sect, we had some doubts about the headquarters location we just obtained.
"Later, after our discussion, we unanimously believed that this should be the Demoness Sect's headquarters in the Northern Continent!
"After all, in recent centuries, members of the Demoness Sect have been active in various countries in the Northern Continent. If the headquarters is still in the Southern Continent, it would be very inconvenient."
Sharron nodded, indicating that she also recognized this guess.
Jonathan then said: "Now, please Mr. Archibald continue to explain the tactics of this battle."
Archibald came to the head of the conference table again: "Earl Hobert and I both believe that the enemy should have deliberately exposed the location of their headquarters to us!"
The demigods were all stunned, but they quickly understood what Archibald meant.
Wearing a military uniform, Archibald continued to explain: "If I were the commander-in-chief of the Demoness Sect, I would definitely try to make myself the defending party when my strength is weak.
"The easiest way is to expose my headquarters and turn the enemy into the attacking party.
"In this way, the other party can use the long-term arrangements in the Demoness Sect to consume our living forces!"
This is also what everyone just thought of, and is thinking about how to solve this problem.
"This can also explain why the Demoness Sect has been shrinking its forces, but has not launched a large-scale attack," Archibald said: "We believe that the enemy will definitely be divided into two parts in this battle: harassment and defense.
"On the one hand, they will use their mobile advantage to harass Jeffrey City, and on the other hand, they will defend the Demoness Sect's headquarters!"
"For the solution to this tactic, please let Hobert explain to everyone."
Hobert slowly came to the head of the conference table, and seeing everyone looking at him, Hobert said: "At that time, the 'Creator' will send angels to break through the Demoness Sect's headquarters defense!"
Several demigods almost exclaimed at this time, but several demigods such as Bernadette suddenly smiled: That's right! This is not an ordinary offensive and defensive battle, but a great Beyonder war involving gods!
Problems that are difficult to solve in ordinary offensive and defensive battles are not too difficult in such a Beyonder battle.
At the same time, everyone also realized why Hobert was giving the next explanation, because the next thing must involve the 'Creator's' arrangement at the angel level.
Sure enough, Hobert continued: "According to the information we have, the Demoness Sect may have 3 angels, two of whom have reportedly not appeared for hundreds of years.
"There are rumors that They have already fallen, and there are also rumors that Their condition is very bad and They can only stay in a certain fixed area to sleep.
"But to be prepared for the worst, we will assume that we are facing three angelic enemies!
"So this time, in addition to the 'Creator' dispatching two angels, we will also invite two angels as foreign aid. Everyone does not need to have any concerns about the power at the angel level!
"If the Primordial Demoness descends with power, the 'Creator' will immediately take action!"
Hobert had felt the gaze of the Primordial Demoness when he was on the boatyard island. As he remembered, the Primordial Demoness's current state is extremely poor!
Maybe in the cosmos or in the astral world, He can maintain a relatively good state, but in the real world, the power He can descend is very limited.
After Hobert advanced to Sequence 3, although the power projected from the 'Nation of Disorder' can still only support the empty shell of the 'King of Angels'.
But it is much stronger than before. If he could only fight 'Abomination' Suah for three or four rounds before, now he can fight Suah for thirty or forty rounds, and it is no problem to block a Sequence 1.
If the Primordial Demoness descends with power stronger than Sequence 1, it will inevitably affect Her main body. It will not be too late to pray to the Evernight Goddess or the Earth Mother at that time.
Everyone heard that there was still a surplus of angelic combat power, and the last bit of worry disappeared. This is exactly the effect Hobert wanted to achieve.
Hobert continued: "Our general offensive plan is to first have the angels attack to destroy the enemy's arrangements.
"During this period, it is best for all of you sitting here not to attack first. After the opponent's angels are lured out and the battle between the angels begins, we will then take the opportunity to attack.
"Because the angels will definitely be held back by each other, the angels' attack can only be regarded as a feint attack at this time. We are the main force in killing the enemy's living forces.
"At that time, the 'Creator' will personally command the battle on the front line, and the 'Creator' will personally point out the offensive route to everyone! In order to avoid the visual impact of the angel battle affecting our state.
"It is best for everyone to pray to the 'Creator' before the battle, so as to avoid being unable to rescue in time when danger occurs.
"If you don't want to pray, try to stay with people who have prayed before."
Speaking of this, everyone's expressions became a little serious.
There are three types of demigods who came to participate in this battle. The first type is like Lawrence, Barnett, and Osment, who came to join the 'Creator', and of course they will not refuse to pray to the 'Creator'.
The second type is Klein, Christian, and April, who trust Hobert very much. If necessary, they will also pray to the 'Creator' in advance.
But the third type of participants, either for Hobert's sake or for the rewards Hobert promised, are unwilling to pray to the 'Creator'.
Hobert did not dwell on this issue, but continued: "I emphasize again, our main task is to eliminate the enemy's living forces at or below the demigod level as much as possible.
"The 'Creator' will only point out the route to everyone, and the specific command tasks will be carried out by everyone individually.
"The current question is who will stay behind and who will attack? It is not appropriate for too many people to stay behind, nor is it appropriate for too few.
"So I suggest that Bishop Simpson set up several mobile forces for the determined remaining forces. If the enemy's attacking force is too strong, stay behind. If it is not very strong, immediately go to support the front line.
"In addition, after the war begins, there will be three 'Traveler's Gates' connecting from here to the Demoness Sect's headquarters. I will announce the locations of those gates to everyone before the war."
This tactic is not complicated, because such a tactic will have higher fault tolerance.
Hobert said: "I have prepared some information for everyone, which are descriptions of the abilities related to the 'Apprentice' and 'Witch' pathways. After you take them back, you can let your subordinates circulate them."
He said loudly: "Tomorrow is the last preparation time for everyone. If the enemy has not launched an offensive by tomorrow, we will launch an attack on the Demoness Sect headquarters at seven o'clock the morning after tomorrow!"
Everyone agreed, and then Dophis distributed the information to everyone.
Hobert then asked everyone: "Are there any other questions?"
Earl Rosalind asked: "Will you launch an offensive with us?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, I will follow everyone's offensive pace at that time and pray constantly."
Everyone immediately realized that Hobert would become the connection point between the 'Creator' and the real world at that time.
Hobert added: "The commander-in-chief of Jeffrey City is Archibald."
Everyone asked a few more questions, but no one raised any objections to the tactics announced by Hobert.
Finally, Hobert said: "If you need some charms of the 'Lawyer' and 'Arbiter' pathways, you can pray to the 'Creator' to obtain them.
"Dophis will provide free black iron and corresponding spiritual materials, but if you want to obtain demigod-level charms, you need to prepare the corresponding metal and spiritual materials yourself.
"Metal is not difficult to obtain, you only need black iron with better color, but the requirements for spiritual materials are higher.
"The first choice is demigod-level spiritual materials of the 'Lawyer' and 'Arbiter' pathways, and some special materials can also be used as a medium for making charms."
This is the ability that Hobert possessed in the 'Nation of Disorder' when he became the 'Earl of the Fallen', but he has never used it.
Hobert's words made everyone very excited, and they all prepared to receive the materials.
As for the demigod-level charms, there was no need for that.
After the war meeting ended, Hobert personally settled Christian down, and then returned to the study and immediately entered the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Because someone was already praying for the 'Creator' to bestow charms.
Sitting on the 'Iron Throne', Hobert's spirituality spread to the first beating star, which was Lawrence. He was praying for some charms of the 'Arbiter' pathway.
Such a request is very reasonable, after all, the Balk family are all Beyonder of the 'Lawyer' pathway.
So Hobert mobilized the power of the 'Nation of Disorder' and evenly embedded these powers in the many carved black irons placed in front of Lawrence.
...
In a villa on a mountain outside Jeffrey City, Lawrence followed the prayer method given by Dophis and placed the carved black iron, along with the corresponding spiritual materials, on the altar.
Then he prayed to the 'Creator' again and again.
Lawrence couldn't tell how many times he had prayed to the 'Creator'. Suddenly, a surging power poured into the altar, and the carved black iron instantly underwent a significant change.
The carved inscriptions suddenly lit up, and the entire black iron became even darker, as if it had turned into another metal, and the charm was also wrapped in a thin layer of black light.
Then the surging power disappeared, and dozens of charms appeared in front of Lawrence and others.
After praising the 'Creator', Lawrence scanned the charms with his spirituality and found that they were all at the Sequence 5 level! This made them praise the power of the 'Creator' again.
...
In the 'Nation of Disorder', Hobert quickly received the second prayer. He spread his spirituality over and it was Klein!
Hobert was stunned. This guy is also praying for some charms of the 'Arbiter' pathway? For a 'Trickmaster', such charms should not be of great use, right?
But thinking that the other party was here to help, such a request should not be rejected, so Hobert mobilized the power of the 'Nation of Disorder' and gave Klein a batch of charms.
Next, the Tudor family and the Tony family successively prayed and obtained a batch of charms of the 'Lawyer' pathway.
Hobert nodded: This is also more reasonable. After all, the Tudor family are basically Beyonder of the 'Arbiter' pathway and need charms of the 'Lawyer' pathway very much. And half of the Beyonder of the Tony family are Beyonder forces of the 'Hunter' pathway, and charms of the 'Lawyer' pathway are also of great use to them.
At this time, a familiar star beat again. Hobert was stunned: It's Klein again? What is he praying to the 'Creator' for?
Spreading his spirituality over, Klein was actually praying again to obtain a batch of charms of the 'Lawyer' pathway!
Hobert then realized: This guy is here to stock up, right? Or does he feel that he has finally caught the 'Creator' once and wants to fleece him hard?
"Forget it," Hobert thought, "Just treat it as helping a friend generate income!"
So he waved his hand again, providing Klein with a batch of "Lawyer" pathway charms.
Throughout the afternoon and into the next morning, people continuously prayed to the "Creator" for power, obtaining batches of charms.
Sharron, Bernadette, and others, who were clearly still wary of the "Creator," also prayed to the "Creator" after hearing that other Beyonder organizations had successfully obtained charms.
However, they all had their subordinates complete the prayers, with Emlyn performing the prayer for the Sanguine.
Hobert marked them one by one so that he could immediately find the organizations he wanted after the war started.
All day Saturday, the Demoness Sect did not launch any offensives, so early Sunday morning, each Beyonder organization completed their assembly according to the notification from the previous afternoon.
At this time, Hobert announced the locations of the three "Traveler's Doors" to everyone, and according to the previous arrangement, the Ballek family and the Sanguine rushed to the front line through one of the doors.
The Tudor family and the Element Dawn went through one door, and the Temperance faction and Klein went through one door, each rushing to the front line.
Other forces temporarily stayed in Jeffrey City. If support was needed, the "Creator" would notify Archibald, who would arrange support personnel based on the actual situation.
Jonathan and others from the Theosophy Order Council had already been waiting at the front line.
After everyone regrouped in three sections within the Intis Republic, they began to approach the Demoness Sect headquarters under the leadership of the Theosophy Order Council.
The "Traveler's Doors" were directly dismantled and would be installed in a more forward position.
The Demoness Sect headquarters, from the outside, looked like a summer resort built close to the mountain. However, upon observation, it was not difficult to discover that this was just a disguise. The resort was connected to the mountain behind it, and the main structure should be in the cave behind.
This resort had a huge courtyard, which looked very lively with many carriages parked in several large parking areas.
The Beyonder forces on the "Creator's" side approached the resort from three different directions, and when the resort came into their view, they began to make final adjustments.
At the same time, members of the Theosophy Order Council quickly began to restore the "Traveler's Door."
They did not conceal these actions. If the Demoness Sect could send someone to destroy the "Traveler's Door" at this time, that would be even better.
...
Just as Jonathan and others had guessed, there was a huge space in the mountain behind the resort!
Inside was a church dedicated to the Primordial Demoness, and the central institutions of the Demoness Sect!
In the square in the center of the cave, the "Saintess of White" Katarina Pelle, dressed in white, pure and beautiful, looking like a maiden, was standing in front of a huge mirror, observing the enemy's situation.
In front of her was not only a huge mirror, but also several smaller mirrors arranged in an arc in front of Katarina.
At the top of the cave, there was a snow-white crystal, emitting a holy light, illuminating the entire cave.
Behind Katarina were the "Black Witch" Clarice, wearing an Intis-style court dress, serious yet with a hint of charm, and several "Demonesses of Despair."
The huge mirror in front of Katarina was divided into three sections, upper, middle, and lower, each displaying enemies from three directions.
She smiled and whispered, "Attack quickly, I've been waiting for you."
Seeing Hobert stepping forward alone from the crowd, Katarina pulled a hair from her head and burned it in front of one of the smaller mirrors.
A picture immediately appeared on the mirror, showing Clifford the "Wanderer" thousands of miles away.
Katarina said, "Start the operation!"
...
Within the Feynapotter Kingdom, southeastern part of the central plateau.
In a sparse forest, Clifford, clean-shaven, hair meticulously combed, and movements appearing somewhat effeminate, held a mirror and said, "Yes!"
After cutting off contact with Katarina, Clifford said to the twenty-odd people around him, "One 'Apprentice' paired with one 'Demoness'!"
"Attack in two waves. The first wave, concentrate on attacking the wells of Jeffrey City!"
"There must be an ambush there, but they have many places to ambush, so the extraordinary power there must not be very strong. In a short time, we will have a considerable advantage!"
"The first wave must last at least three minutes! At this time, the second wave will strike. By now, the enemy's forces should have all gone to support the wells. We must all buy Ms. Laura half a minute to fill Jeffrey City with viruses, to pollute the water and soil there, and to turn it into a permanent dead city!"
At this time, the graceful Ms. Laura stepped forward and smiled at everyone, "Come forward."
Everyone lined up and walked towards Laura, who kissed their foreheads one by one. This was the "Demoness's Blessing."
Those who received the blessing, in addition to having their adrenaline surge in a short time, being in a relatively excited state, acting more agile, and having more abundant spirituality, could also avoid being harmed by the viruses spread by Ms. Laura in a short time.
After everyone received the blessing, the first batch of raiders set off using "Travel." The few spies who returned on Tourism Day had basically figured out the structure of Jeffrey City.
So the first twelve people found the wells in Jeffrey City without much difficulty.
Guarding the wells was an elite Druid squad led by Bishop Simpson. Seeing the space in front of them become illusory, one of the team members immediately blew a whistle for help.
Bishop Simpson raised his hand, and thick vines with purple barbs sprouted rapidly from the ground. The first wave of enemies seemed to have fallen into a pile of vines.
The leader of this wave of enemies was a "Demoness of Despair" and a "Secrets Sorcerer." The 'Secrets Sorcerer' immediately created a "Concealed Space" to protect everyone from the attack of these poisonous vines.
After avoiding the vines, the "Concealed Space" disappeared.
The "Demoness of Despair" summoned several ice arrows and shot them at the members of the Druid squad. As the ice arrows shot out, a layer of frost rose from the ground.
Just as the two sides were about to engage in close combat, the "Demoness of Despair" and the "Secrets Sorcerer" sensed something and looked at the roof in front of them.
Duke Christian, with an imposing presence, suddenly appeared there. He looked at the battlefield below, but did not immediately join the battle, but said, "Teleportation is forbidden here!
"Blink is forbidden here!"
At this time, Christian stretched out his right hand and made a downward waving motion. A "Traveler" who was fighting suddenly stiffened and fell to the ground, lifeless.
He was "executed" by Christian!
The "Demoness of Despair" was really desperate at this time. She felt that her side could hardly last for three minutes.
...
In front of the Demoness Sect headquarters.
Hobert stopped far away and began to pray.
Arriving at the "Nation of Disorder" and sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert glanced at the resort in front of him. He was about to release the "Holy Infant King" to "clear the mines," but he noticed something was wrong. The enemy's reaction was too bland.
They should have easily found out that the "Creator" had two angel subordinates, but looking at the resort not activating any defensive formations until now, it seemed to be saying: Welcome the "Creator's" angels!
Hobert thought for a moment: I might as well give you a tough one!
With a wave of his hand, he summoned the corpse of the Ancient Death God, injected "Power of Order," and threw it into the star representing himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - 602 You call this a feint? (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
