[Powerstone bonus]
Klein looked at the headquarters of the Demoness Sect in the distance, and he was very sure that the other party had already discovered their tracks.
Since they didn't take the initiative to attack, it should be as Hobert and the others guessed, that they had set up many traps in the church headquarters.
Sharron, who was beside him, suddenly looked in the direction of Hobert and said, "A secret door has opened."
Klein also looked at Hobert, and he thought to himself: It seems that under Hobert's prayer, a mysterious passage to the 'Creator' has been connected.
But what Klein didn't expect was that the image of the "Creator" suddenly appeared in mid-air.
He was wearing a suit of armor emitting a black, sacred light, and a crown with a huge black gem on his head!
His face was a mask that showed no emotion, and his back was a long, illusory cloak.
He exuded a sacred radiance, and these radiances seemed to have a solidifying effect like dust.
He seemed to be able to end all Disorder, and he also seemed to be able to bring complete Disorder.
Although they were far apart, the Beyonders of the Temperance faction were still overwhelmed by the majesty of the "Creator" and wanted to prostrate themselves on the ground to express their loyalty to him.
Klein's eyes narrowed, and the image of the "Creator" looked even more majestic than before!
Only to hear the "Creator" say in a deep voice: "Lie down, close your eyes, and restrain your spirituality!"
The Beyonders in the three phalanxes were all stunned, but some reacted quickly, such as Klein, who immediately lay down after hearing the "Creator's" instructions, and beckoned to Sharron and Maric: "What are you waiting for? Lie down quickly!"
Sharron realized this later and ordered the dozens of Beyonders behind her: "Lie down."
In fact, without her order, the Beyonders behind had already fallen to the ground, but they were not lying down, but prostrating on the ground, trembling all over, due to the pressure of the "Creator."
Only demigods could barely withstand the majesty of the "Creator."
Lawrence and others in another phalanx immediately lay down after marveling at the increasingly majestic image of the "Creator."
Rosalind was a little surprised by the sudden appearance of the "Creator", but she immediately issued orders to lie down, close her eyes, and so on.
Bernadette of the third phalanx stared at the "Creator", sighed with some disappointment after a second or two, and immediately lay down.
Barnett and others of the Tudor family in the distance were first surprised when they saw the image of the "Creator", and then replaced by ecstasy!
This is a god! The Tudor family has not had the protection of a god for more than a thousand years, but now, they have regained the protection of a god.
They had just laid down in excitement when they felt a huge mental pressure in front of them, and many Beyonders were pressed to the ground, gasping for breath.
… …
In the cave, the "Saintess of White" Katarina in front of the mirror felt an ominous premonition filling her heart after seeing the image of the "Creator" appear.
Their arrangement in the manor could even Hide angels, but they might not be able to Hide a god!
Sure enough, the "Creator" in mid-air made a pushing motion outwards.
Rumble ~
A torrent of thunderous power poured down from mid-air, and a giant bird appeared in the manor.
Its body surface was covered with burning black flames and feathers composed of illusory mysterious patterns. Its eyes were deep black, but it seemed that layers of illusory doors overlapped in the darkness.
All the light around it seemed to be covered with a thin black veil, turning grayish-white.
Sadness!
In the manor, including Katarina and others in the cave, they also felt the sadness represented by death! They all missed their dead comrades, friends, and relatives.
The giant bird, which was seven or eight stories high, looked down on all living beings around it.
The horses pulling carts in the courtyard and several Beyonders were immediately stunned when they saw this huge figure, and fell to the ground like harvested straws. Their souls had already gone to the realm of the dead.
But their corpses sat up neatly and knelt on one knee piously towards the corpse of the Ancestor Phoenix, while horses and animals such as wild rabbits and mice around the manor were prostrate on the ground.
Then, they stood up and went to find living things around them to tear and bite.
… …
Inside the cave, the moment the corpse of the Ancient Death appeared, many dense cracks suddenly appeared on the mirror in front of Katarina.
Crash ~
The huge mirror shattered all over the ground.
Puff puff ~
Katarina, who was watching in front of the mirror just now, didn't have time to close her eyes, and her two eyeballs burst directly, and two lines of blood flowed from her crystal-clear and snowy skin.
She felt her thinking stop for a second or two before suddenly thinking: "Quick, go and turn off the traps outside! Don't anger Him!"
Two "Demonesses of Despair" immediately rushed to the manor outside by jumping through the mirror surface after hearing the order, but they rolled out of the "Mirror World" just as they reached the front of the square.
One of the "Demonesses of Despair" weakly said: "The world in the mirror seems to be stirred by some terrifying force!"
Katarina was a little desperate: "It's too late."
… …
The body of the Ancient Death in the manor instinctively wanted to kill all living creatures and build its own undead kingdom here.
It could feel that there were still many fresh lives inside the manor, so it raised its wings and fanned out a gust of wind that could freeze souls, blowing the roof of the manor away.
This made Hobert, who was watching from behind, sigh: Using a cannon to kill a mosquito!
If this had happened during the battle between the Balk family and the "Rose School" in the Southern Continent, the enemy's forces below the angel would have been completely wiped out.
Of course, the Balk family would also have been completely wiped out.
Wahhh ~
The roof of the manor made a sound after being blown off, like a wail, and then, a piece of holy white light appeared inside the building.
Suddenly, a spear like crystal shot out, hitting the chest of the Ancient Death's corpse.
The corpse of the Ancestor Phoenix with a huge body tilted its head and glanced at the spear in its chest, as if it didn't quite understand the purpose of this spear?
At this time, the spear tilted, it only made a few feathers of the Ancient Death's corpse a little deformed.
Although this corpse could only borrow a part of the Ancient Death's power by means of "Exploit" and "tampering", the hardness of its flesh was similar to that of the Ancient Death when She was alive.
The spear that failed to penetrate the Ancient Death's corpse did not fall to the ground. Its front end exploded, and ice crystals flew everywhere. Almost in an instant, the Ancient Death's corpse and the entire manor were frozen in the ice crystals.
From Hobert's perspective, it was like a huge transparent amber had formed there, which was more beautiful than a diamond under the sunlight.
This was not the end. The back half of the spear was suddenly stretched and widened by an invisible force, forming a huge mirror.
The mirror surface quickly became dim, and the corpse of the Ancient Death and the entire manor in front of Her suddenly disappeared from the real world and appeared in the mirror.
Hobert couldn't help frowning behind him. If an angel was really sent to "test the waters", they would be injured by this.
And they would be trapped in the "Mirror World", making it difficult to continue participating in the battle for a while.
Then Hobert was a little worried, wondering what would happen to the corpse of the Ancient Death? After all, it didn't have much sanity.
The mirror that the spear had turned into suddenly shattered, as if cutting off the passage between the "Mirror World" and reality.
But in the next second, the space where the manor was originally located became illusory, and a transparent door appeared with many mysterious symbols and looked a little magical.
Its shape looked like both the "Underworld Gate" of the "Death" pathway and the illusory door summoned by the "Door" pathway.
Squeak ~
The door suddenly opened, and the corpse of the Ancient Death, still frozen in ice crystals, floated out of it.
However, at this time, its head had broken free from the ice crystals.
Following that, the huge door disappeared.
Wahhh ga ~
The corpse of the Ancient Death screamed strangely, and even Hobert, who was protected by the "Nation of Disorder", felt his spiritual body tremble. He quickly glanced behind him.
Sure enough, the spiritual bodies of many of his own Beyonders lying down in the distance had left their bodies and were about to fly towards the Ancient Death.
"Tampering!" Hobert "tampered" with the Beyonder power belonging to the undead behind him, and the huge attraction from the soul was greatly reduced, and these spiritual bodies returned to their original bodies one by one.
It's just that these Beyonders have suffered a lot of damage to their spiritual bodies.
At this time, the demigods lying on the ground successively took action to help them offset most of the damage.
Behind the already disappeared manor, a illusory door suddenly appeared in the mountain, and dozens of souls flashing with pale white light came out of the mountain with blank eyes.
Just a few seconds ago, they were still a fresh life, but just in that instant, as the main attack target of the Ancient Death's corpse, their lives immediately came to an end.
These spiritual bodies dissipated one by one, going to the underworld.
The corpse of the Ancient Death stretched its wings.
Crash ~
The ice crystals covering its body shattered, and the corpse of the Ancient Death regained its freedom.
Hobert seemed to notice that the huge corpse of the Ancient Death seemed to be a little smaller. He guessed that the attack of the ice crystal spear just now might have consumed a lot of its power.
At this time, the corpse of the Ancient Death took a step forward and kicked with its claws growing illusory feathers.
Rumble ~
The entire mountain was kicked down like this. Looking at its relaxed appearance, it was as simple as kicking down a dining chair.
The mountain did not collapse, but was kicked down, so the space in the belly of the mountain was hardly damaged.
Hobert saw that inside the mountain's interior space, there was a huge statue of the "Primordial Demoness". The outer layer of the statue was painted with bright colors, making it look lifelike.
That was a beautiful woman's image, with hair extending from her head to her ankles, clear and thick, like venomous snakes, one tentacle after another.
At the top of each hair, there was also an eye, either open or closed, looking densely packed.
Hobert saw that the people of the Demoness Sect were escaping from the passage left in the mountain, while Katarina was in front of the huge stone statue, as if praying for something.
Suddenly, Hobert saw that the outer shell of the stone statue was rapidly peeling off, like damp wall skin, and inside, there were more vibrant colors, and a surge of power erupted.
This power swept the ground, and the corpses controlled by the Ancient Death's corpse turned into grayish-white stone statues one by one.
"Disorder!" Hobert didn't feel the arrival of any power, indicating that this was not the divine descent of the "Primordial Demoness", it should be that before, she had left the power in the stone statue in a special way.
Therefore, Hobert used "Disorder" to prevent this force from breaking through the stone statue. As expected, the speed at which the outer shell of the stone statue fell off slowed down.
The corpse of the Ancient Death seized the opportunity and spat out a mouthful of black flames. This mouthful of flames hit the stone statue directly and covered it, burning on the stone statue.
The spirituality within the mountain turned into fuel for the flames. Katarina, who was escaping from the "Mirror World," felt her spiritual body being extracted by a force behind her.
She took out an ugly puppet from her pocket and threw it behind her. The puppet immediately floated towards an unknown force, and the extraction force on Katarina was weakened by more than half.
The Ancient Death's corpse's target was not Katarina, but the stone statue in front of it, so it allowed this "Demoness of Unaging" to escape successfully.
Suddenly, dozens of firm hairs fell from the stone statue, and all the flames on its body were transferred to those hairs.
Hobert waved his hand: "Tamper!"
At the Sequence 3 level, "Tampering" can already "tamper" with the target's abilities, as well as the effects achieved by the target's abilities.
After being "magnified" by the "Nation of Disorder," the abilities displayed by that stone statue can also be "tampered" with.
The hairs that the stone statue had just dropped returned to its head, and black flames burned on its entire body again.
During this period, the corpse of the Ancient Death spread its wings. The mysterious patterns on its wings suddenly flowed, forming an abstract giant bird pattern. This pattern was not particularly beautiful, but it made people unable to take their eyes off it.
The stone statue turned gray inch by inch, and its spirituality poured out like a flood that had burst its banks.
Hobert stepped forward again and launched an attack: "Distort!"
He "distorted" the concept of the stone statue with a corpse that had just been petrified by it. This made the stone statue's consciousness believe that it was just a stone, and it gave up any struggle.
Wahhh-ga~
The corpse of the Ancient Death screamed strangely, and its eyes suddenly turned into a layered, illusory "door." The stone statue disappeared bit by bit, and it was unknown where it was being sent by the corpse of the Ancient Death.
Although the corpse of the Ancient Death was not controlled by Hobert, its target was also the stone statue, so it formed a cooperation with Hobert.
Hobert smiled slightly. The power in the stone statue had not completely erupted, but it was solved by himself and the corpse of the Ancient Death.
Just then, the stone statue suddenly cracked open from the middle, revealing a thick vine that flickered with white light and had eyes and a mouth!
Hobert was also stunned for a moment before he understood that it should be a hair of the "Primordial Demoness!"
This hair was not just a hair. It represented the sum of the power of the "Primordial Demoness" projected onto this stone statue in advance.
It was equivalent to a clone of the "Primordial Demoness!"
Boom~
This hair exploded, and Hobert saw the sky suddenly torn open by a giant hand, and a scarlet eye looked towards the ground.
At that moment, all living things on Earth mutated, turning into ugly zombies and biting plants.
Among those zombies that pounced on other creatures, there were Klein, Audrey, and Fors.
In the sky, there were dark figures with eight legs and the image of a mother with a grim smile. These were the puppets of that giant eye, patrolling the earth and searching for normal living beings who were hiding.
The sun turned blood-colored, and the entire earth seemed to be sprinkled with a layer of blood, filled with evil and mutation.
Suddenly, Hobert suddenly came back to his senses and saw that the stone statue in the mountain had shattered into pieces, and there was no more vitality.
He wiped the tears from the corners of his eyes. Just now, he saw the doomsday, the most desperate apocalypse for him.
Fortunately, that was just an illusion created by the "Primordial Demoness's" clone!
Looking at the corpse of the Ancient Death again, it was also stunned in place, a circle smaller than before, and the black flames on its body were also much more illusory. Obviously, it was also affected by the "apocalypse."
But soon, the corpse of the Ancient Death seemed to come back to its senses. It glanced at the stone statue that had been shattered into pieces, then looked around left and right, and suddenly turned its head and rushed towards Klein and the others.
Hobert secretly said, "Too bad." The people of the Demoness Sect had already run out a distance, and now Klein and others had become its preferred targets.
"Distort!" Hobert "distorted" the direction of a large area, turning east into west and left into right.
Although the corpse of the Ancient Death changed its direction of advance at once, it left the "distorted" space with a "Blink."
"Tamper!" Hobert quickly "tampered" with the "power of order" in the corpse of the Ancient Death, hoping that the power in its body would be quickly exhausted.
However, Hobert's "tampering" only played a certain role. No matter how he tampered with some of the "power of order," he couldn't change it.
Those forces could still allow the corpse of the Ancient Death to maintain its state for about half a minute.
Hobert couldn't help but twitch the corners of his mouth. After half a minute, Klein, Bernadette, and the others would have died several times over!
Now, he could only quickly remind Klein and the others to quickly use the "Traveler's Door" to escape. Save as many as he could.
Although this would cause a lot of damage to the image of the "Creator," at least it could reduce the number of deaths.
Just as Hobert was about to issue a reminder, he suddenly thought: I can't "distort" the corpse of the Ancient Death, can't I "distort" Klein and the others?
Thinking of this, Hobert quickly went to "distort" Klein and dozens of others. As expected, he "distorted" them to ten kilometers away at once. After a few "distortions," they were out of danger.
After becoming a "Frenzied Mage," he could use the "Nation of Disorder" to do more god-like operations.
Hobert breathed a sigh of relief and immediately projected his image into the star representing Klein, telling him the location of several Demoness Sect members and asking them to intercept them.
And he told them, don't look back no matter what.
Fortunately, the corpse of the Ancient Death did not have much consciousness. If it wanted to chase Klein and the others, it would be easy to chase, but it was attracted by Lawrence and the others again and went to attack new targets.
Hobert repeated the old trick and sent Lawrence and the others to chase the members of the Demoness Sect again.
Then, he transferred Bernadette and the others, and let them also carry out the pursuit.
After these three waves of Beyonders were transferred away, the corpse of the Ancient Death, which did not have much time left, was attracted by a flock of goats not far away.
Hobert simply observed the three friendly formations that had already entered the battle. He returned to the real world and chased the corpse of the Ancient Death by "distorting" the distance.
At this time, the lives within a radius of hundreds of kilometers had all withered. Animals, insects, and even bacteria had all died, and plants had all withered in the midsummer season, and leaves had fallen all over the ground.
Fortunately, the headquarters of the Demoness Sect was located in a remote location, otherwise Hobert would have been too busy.
Finally, the "power of order" in the corpse of the Ancient Death was exhausted, and it fell heavily to the ground.
Hobert quickly set up a simple altar with candles and sacrificed the corpse of the Ancient Death to the "Nation of Disorder."
Only then did he breathe a sigh of relief and sigh in his heart: Although the corpse of the Ancient Death is a weapon for "stealing the home," it must be used with caution. If it is not controlled well, it will cause immeasurable consequences, and the prestige of the "Creator" will easily be lost.
Then, Hobert sighed, "Plans can't keep up with changes." He didn't expect to start fighting with high-end combat power right away, and there was no chance for the angels to take action at all.
After re-sealing the corpse of the Ancient Death in the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert quickly returned to the real world and chased Klein and the others by "distorting" the distance.
...
Klein and Sharron and the others attacked the first wave of enemies, and there were only seven or eight enemies.
The "Demoness of Unaging" can use the spirit world and the "Mirror World" to escape quickly, and the "Demoness of Despair" can also use the "mirror jump" method to leave quickly.
But Beyonders below the demigod level are difficult to leave quickly.
Before the war, Hobert had repeatedly emphasized that if possible, kill as many of these Demoness Sect members as possible!
Because there were Klein and three Temperance faction demigods, these few enemies were vulnerable. Just when they were about to achieve victory, Klein sensed that the huge pressure in the distance had disappeared.
Only then did he look up and look over there, only to see that a huge area, including the opponent they had been lying down in before, had become a dead silence.
White mist was floating everywhere, as if these mists were the souls of that area that were dissipating.
And the mountain behind the headquarters of the Demoness Sect had fallen, yes, completely fallen!
It could be seen that there were countless petrified creatures inside, as well as many scattered stones. This headquarters had been completely destroyed.
Klein recalled the battle plan described by Hobert before. The angel went to disarm the traps of the Demoness Sect, which could only be regarded as a feint, but could the current results still be called a feint?
Shouldn't they disarm most of the traps at the headquarters of the Demoness Sect, and then have the demigod-led forces besiege the headquarters of the Demoness Sect after attracting the opponent's angels?
But now the headquarters is gone, and only the enemies who have no fighting will left to attack!
Just as this one-sided battle was about to end, Klein's spirituality felt something and looked at the eyes of a corpse that died with eyes wide open.
On one of the lifeless eyeballs, a beautiful figure suddenly appeared. Before she could see her appearance clearly, the other party had already grabbed a heavily injured witch, and then they prepared to enter the mirror again.
Klein immediately realized that among this wave of enemies, there was a child that the other party valued.
After all, the Demoness Sect is inherited in the form of a family, and many Sequence 6 or Sequence 5 are the children of some demigods.
Klein stretched out his finger: "Bang~"
He blew up the corpse that could be used as a "mirror" to prevent the other party from quickly returning to the mirror.
Since she's here, try to keep her here.
Klein was about to besiege the enemy demigod with Sharron and others when his spirituality had a warning of danger, which made him suddenly roll backward, and his ankles and knees were a little stiff!
It's an "Demoness of Unaging"! Although Klein's spirituality did not sense where the enemy was, he had experienced this petrified feeling before when exploring Adam's island.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 603: The Creator dispatched four angels
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert, who was in pursuit, suddenly sensed something. He re-entered the "Nation of Disorder" and used his true vision to check the current battle situation, discovering that the demigods who had escaped were back.
He immediately understood their intentions. Since the corpse of the ancient death god that troubled them had disappeared, they must have returned to cover their fleeing subordinates, or rather, descendants.
A "Demoness of Despair" and an "Demoness of Unaging" arrived at Klein and Sharron's battlefield.
Several enemy demigods appeared on Bernadette's battlefield and Lawrence's side.
Hobert smiled. If these demigods had just run away, the Demoness Sect would have only suffered a heavy blow to their forces below the demigod level. Now that they had returned, it gave Hobert a good opportunity to severely damage their demigod power.
So, according to his previous plan, Hobert released the "Bull Devil Monarch," the Black Hound spirit beast, and the "Great Sage" into the real world.
Hobert led them to Klein and Sharron's battlefield.
Klein, who was using a Marionette to avoid the "Demoness of Unaging's" petrification effect, saw the three black figures behind Hobert.
One was pitch black with a bull's head and deer antlers. One was huge with hard, illusory scales. One had a human body but with thick black hair, and dared not make eye contact. It was the saint who had once been trapped in "Foggy Town."
Hobert used a "Distortion" to arrive at the battlefield: "Tamper!"
The "Demoness of Despair," who was surrounded by Sharron and others, saw that the situation was not good and had long given up on rescuing anyone. Through a mirror created from a drop of blood, she hid in the "Mirror World."
The figures of Sharron and the other two demigods immediately became illusory and disappeared into the real world, chasing into the "Mirror World."
The "Demoness of Unaging," who was originally attacking Klein, naturally noticed the reinforcements Hobert had brought. She had no intention of fighting, after all, her job was to stall the opposing demigods, not to fight them.
So, she immediately abandoned her "Stealth" state and entered the layers of "Mirror World."
Just as she was about to escape, the "Demoness of Unaging" realized something was wrong. The "Mirror World" had undergone significant changes, with gray vortexes appearing one after another. From the vortexes, arms with eyes stretched out, creating many obstacles for her escape.
The "Demoness of Unaging" immediately realized that Hobert had just "Tampered" with the environment of the surrounding "Mirror World!"
Then, the "Mirror World" rumbled, as if it were about to collapse.
She immediately abandoned her plan to stay in the "Mirror World" and switched to "Leap" to escape.
But as soon as she came out of the "Mirror World," Hobert's "Distortion," which had been waiting outside, smashed into her, and her thought of escaping immediately turned into the thought of charging forward.
The reason why the "Mirror World" had shown signs of collapse earlier was because the "Bull Devil Monarch" and the other two monsters had taken turns using "Distortion."
On the other battlefield, the "Demoness of Despair" had already tumbled out of the "Mirror World" in a sorry state and was being besieged by Sharron and others.
The "Demoness of Unaging" in front of Hobert never dreamed that the enemy could suddenly send four Sequence 3s as reinforcements, and she was immediately a little stunned.
The Black Hound spirit beast had already taken Hobert's rapier. He raised the rapier upwards, and a pale white light burst out from his body.
The "Demoness of Unaging," who had just left the "Distortion" state, immediately felt as if she had fallen into an ice cave. Her joints became stiff, and her spirit body seemed to be torn apart by pairs of invisible hands.
Suddenly, a giant thunderbolt fell from the sky, hitting the "Demoness of Unaging" directly. In addition to the damage from the thunder's burn, it also briefly paralyzed her.
The "Charm" ability on her body seemed to be activated, becoming very moving. Just looking at her made Hobert's heart beat rapidly, his face flushed, and he recalled the scene of "dancing" with Fors.
But the "Bull Devil Monarch" and the other monsters were unmoved. At this time, the "Bull Devil Monarch" had already used "Distortion" to arrive in front of the "Demoness of Unaging" and used his golden antlers to ram her, directly turning her into a horizontal "V" shape.
The moment she flew out, Hobert had basically recovered from the "Charm" state and immediately reached out: "Exploit!"
He lengthened the time of the other party's "Substitute" ability. What was originally an instant "Mirror Substitute" became a 3-second process.
In fact, the "Great Sage" and the others also possessed such abilities, but their intelligence was limited, making it difficult for them to perform such complex operations.
These three seconds were fatal to the current "Demoness of Unaging." At this time, part of her body was real, and part was in a mirror state.
The Black Hound spirit beast waved the rapier again, and the "Demoness of Unaging's" spirit body quickly separated from her physical body.
The "Great Sage" flicked its tail and struck the "Demoness of Unaging's" physical body.
Hobert acted in a timely manner: "Tampered!"
He "Tampered" with the air density behind the "Demoness of Unaging," turning it into an air vortex as hard as a steel plate.
So, the "Great Sage's" great strength, as well as the steel-like air, sandwiched the "Demoness of Unaging" in the middle, instantly squeezing her internal organs out of her mouth.
At this time, the "Demoness of Unaging" finally used her high spirituality to resist the Black Hound spirit beast's capture and finally returned to her body.
What awaited her was Hobert's "Magnify," turning a serious injury into a fatal one. Under the siege of four Sequence 3s, the "Demoness of Unaging" was on her last breath.
At this time, Hobert keenly discovered that the "Demoness of Unaging" had actually given up resisting!
So, under the "Bull Devil Monarch's" "Corruption," the "Great Sage's" "Lightning," and the Black Hound spirit beast's attack on her spirit body, the "Demoness of Unaging" quickly lost her life.
Hobert quickly asked the "Bull Devil Monarch" and the others to step back a little, because he sensed something was wrong.
Bang~
Sure enough, the "Demoness of Unaging's" body split open from the middle and quickly shrank.
Hobert seemed to realize something: "Distortion!"
He wanted to distort the state of the "Demoness of Unaging" and a tree next to her, but he failed. Watching the "Demoness of Unaging" shrink rapidly, she turned into a vivid puppet that split open from the middle.
This puppet was lifelike and very similar to the "Demoness of Unaging." Several thick strands of hair were wrapped around the puppet's head.
However, these hairs quickly withered, turned yellow, and eventually turned into dust.
Hobert suddenly recalled that he had forgotten where he had heard that the "Demoness of Unaging" had the ability to resurrect.
Now it seemed that this resurrection ability was a kind of special "Substitute Technique," using a pre-made exquisite puppet to die in place of the "Demoness of Unaging."
And the "Demoness of Unaging" should be resurrected somewhere at this time. Hobert guessed that the place where she was resurrected was likely the place where the puppet was stored before.
Hobert smiled, not disappointed. He had realized in the previous battle with the "Rose School" that it was very difficult to kill someone at the Sequence 3 level.
The two Sequence 3s who died in the "Rose School" were without exception, because they were first affected by the Angel's battle, and their condition became very bad.
Then, under a two-on-one attack, they failed to escape and were completely killed.
If they were in good condition, it would be difficult for two Sequence 3s to besiege and kill one Sequence 3. After all, at Sequence 3, the ways to escape are always unexpected.
Hobert looked at the "Bull Devil Monarch" and the other three monsters. He suddenly thought of a good idea and prepared to find another "Demoness of Unaging" to try it out.
So, Hobert first went to Sharron and the others' battlefield and told them the approximate escape direction of some Demoness Sect members. As for what method to use to chase them, it depended on Sharron and their own ideas.
The battle where Sharron and others besieged the "Demoness of Despair" was also basically over. The "Demoness of Despair" was already seriously injured and seemed to show signs of losing control.
There were four demigods here, enough to kill the "Demoness of Despair."
So, Hobert took people to support Bernadette and the others. Here, an "Demoness of Unaging" and three "Demonesses of Despair" were holding back Bernadette and the others.
However, after they sensed Hobert's support, they immediately fled.
Barnett raised her hand and said: "It is forbidden to form mirrors here!"
For a time, all the surrounding scenery seemed to be covered with a layer of black veil, looking very rough and not very reflective.
The speed of the three "Demonesses of Despair" escaping suddenly slowed down. Barnett exchanged a look with Bernadette and quickly led the two demigods of her family to pursue the "Demonesses of Despair."
Bernadette raised her hand and "summoned" a very simple and unadorned mirror that was jet black all over.
Bernadette took the mirror and said: "Magic mirror, magic mirror, help me find the trace of that 'Demoness of Unaging'."
The mirror flickered, and suddenly the figure of "Demoness of Black" Clarice appeared. This "Demoness of Unaging" was somewhat surprised to see Bernadette.
Just then, Bernadette pushed down the simple and unadorned mirror. The jet-black mirror shattered, and Clarice, who had escaped from the "Mirror World," returned to the real world.
The moment she reappeared, the ground was immediately covered with frost, but because of Barnett's prohibition, these frosts looked gray and did not form any reflective mirror surfaces.
But this was enough for Clarice. She could still use these frosts to escape quickly, but the speed was a little slower.
"Frenzy!" At this time, Hobert arrived and immediately made Clarice lose her direction and any ability to think. Many chaotic thoughts arose in her mind.
When she regained her senses a little, the five Sequence 3s, including Bernadette, surrounded her.
For a moment, they paused briefly, forming a confrontational situation.
Bernadette reminded: "She can resurrect and use resurrection to escape."
"I have already witnessed it." Hobert said: "So, it is best to only beat her half to death and make her completely lose her fighting ability."
After a brief exchange, Bernadette raised her hand, and her own temperament underwent a huge change. A crown composed of ice crystals and huge snowflakes appeared on her head, a snow-white cloak appeared behind her, and a long blue scepter appeared in her left hand.
She reappeared the "Ice Queen," allowing herself to briefly possess the ability to manipulate some "Ice" related abilities.
For a time, everything within sight was covered with ice and snow.
She pointed the scepter in her hand at Clarice, and the ice and snow immediately sealed the "Demoness of Black's" feet and calves, and quickly spread upwards.
"Giggle~"
Clarice suddenly let out a burst of laughter. At this moment, she seemed to become more beautiful and moving, and every movement exuded a heart-wrenching temperament.
Bernadette's face suddenly turned red, and she was affected by the other party's "Charm" and couldn't bear to continue attacking.
Hobert, who also had a red face, raised his hand: "Bestow!"
He "Bestowed" all the negative effects he received to the besieged "Demoness of Unaging." Before the new "Charm" affected his judgment, he quickly threw out a small stone: "Madness!"
This was the "Disorder Stone" that Hobert hadn't used for a long time. As his level increased, the ability of the "Disorder Stone" was further strengthened, and it was now very effective against a Sequence 3.
Clarice's charming expression suddenly became ferocious, as if her spirit body had been hit hard.
She quickly threw an ugly puppet out of her sleeve. The moment the puppet left her hand, its whole body seemed to be burned by flames, bearing all the damage Clarice had received.
This was also the reason why Hobert rarely used the "Disorder Stone" now. After reaching the demigod level, sudden attacks of loss of control were easily avoided by the target using various means.
Without the interference of "Charm," Bernadette's attack continued, and Clarice's knees were frozen, as if she had gradually lost the ability to escape.
At the same time, the "Bull Devil Monarch's" Corruption attack, the "Great Sage's" Wind Blade, and the Black Hound spirit beast's spirit body attack followed.
Under the attack of five Sequence 3s, the "Demoness of Black" had almost no room to resist.
This allowed Hobert to calmly experiment with the effects of Sequence 3 level abilities in actual combat.
The moment Clarice used a substitute, Hobert used the "Disorder Stone" again!
Clarice had just completed her mirror substitute, and her spirit and spirit body immediately suffered a violent attack.
The moment Bernadette wanted to throw out a wooden puppet again, she pointed at the "Demoness of Black's" head, and Clarice's head was immediately covered with ice crystals, briefly freezing her thinking.
Hobert gave Bernadette a thumbs up in his heart, which allowed him to calmly use "Exploit," repeating the old trick, lengthening the other party's "Substitute" process to 3 seconds.
At the same time, Hobert asked the "Bull Devil Monarch" and other monsters to only do "Distortion" and "Disorder" attacks, allowing Clarice to continue to suffer the torment of "Madness."
"Tamper!" Hobert still had time to "Alter" Clarice's "Substitute" ability, so that the other party could not give all the attacks she received to the substitute.
Then Hobert successively used "Magnify" and "Frenzy," "Magnifying" the loss of control on the other party, and using "Frenzy" to make the other party lose some sanity, making the other party's state worse.
In fact, this was Hobert's plan: to make the other party lose control!
If she was killed in a state of loss of control, she would probably be able to resurrect, but Hobert could perform some operations, trying to seal her or block her resurrection process.
Clarice suffered continuous attacks, and her condition became extremely poor. Her hair was like it was affected by static electricity, all "exploded" up.
Meanwhile, the attacks from "Bull Devil Monarch" and the others continued, and Clarice's mind remained in a state of being "distorted," unable to resist her descent into corruption.
Just as she teetered on the brink of losing control, Clarice's hair suddenly floated upwards, forming a hollow circle above her head, which instantly transformed into an ice crystal mirror.
The scene reflected in the mirror was not the surrounding landscape, but a dark, icy, and unfamiliar vista.
Hobert and Bernadette immediately sensed the danger with their spirituality and quickly retreated.
Suddenly, the mirror above Clarice's head grew immensely large, and a pale hand reached out from within.
Following the hand, a stunningly beautiful face with snow-white skin covered in frost emerged. Her classical attire was also coated in a thick layer of ice, making her movements appear stiff, as if she needed to inch her way out.
Bernadette instantly felt a surge of vitality in the left half of her body, while the right half rapidly lost its luster and began to petrify.
Hobert fared no better, experiencing intense heat on his left side and an icy chill on his right, as if he were about to freeze.
This immediately made him realize that the being crawling out of the mirror was an angel from the Demoness Sect, albeit in poor condition!
Even in weakened condition, it was still an angel, an enemy that Hobert and Bernadette had no hope of defeating.
Coughing, Hobert used "Distortion" to move away from the battlefield while saying to Bernadette, "Leave this to me!"
The "Demoness of Catastrophe," not yet fully emerged from the mirror, was being held back by "Bull Devil Monarch" and the others, allowing time to escape.
However, Hobert already felt a pain in his throat, like the onset of a cold.
Without hesitation, Bernadette raised her hand and summoned a carriage that looked like a pumpkin, pulled not by horses, but by four giant rats, with a white goose as the driver.
She coughed as she jumped into the carriage and sped away.
As the carriage raced along, it left a trail of pumpkin seeds.
Pop pop pop~
These pumpkin seeds exploded, creating a smokescreen to cover the pumpkin carriage's escape.
She avoided traveling through the spirit world, fearing that the "Demoness of Catastrophe" might have corrupted it, creating unknown dangers there.
Hobert didn't linger either. After moving a certain distance away, he entered the "Nation of Disorder" and used "True Sight" to take a look.
The "Demoness of Catastrophe" had emerged from the cold, dark environment, but the frost on her body showed no signs of melting, and her movements remained stiff.
The "Bull Devil Monarch" was now completely wrapped in layers of gray hair, rendering him unable to fight.
The "Great Sage" had transformed into a "female snake." Theoretically, this monster shouldn't have a gender, but Hobert could sense that it had become female and was unwilling to continue attacking the "Demoness of Catastrophe."
Only the black hound spirit beast was still struggling to hold on with its thin sword.
The "Demoness of Unaging," who had been on the verge of losing control, had also regained her senses, although she was somewhat surprised by the scene before her. Unable to do anything else, she could only focus on gathering her spirituality and recovering her strength.
Hobert once again lamented: It shouldn't be difficult for a Sequence 3 to escape from a Sequence 2, but in a direct confrontation, even three Sequence 3s are no match for a Sequence 2.
Bernadette had already run far away, and the battlefield of Barnett and the other demigods was also a considerable distance from here.
The other Sequence 5 and lower-level forces had already split into teams to hunt down members of the Demoness Sect.
Seeing that the surroundings were a suitable battlefield for angels, Hobert took out the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring" that he had prepared long ago, poured "Power of Order" into it, and then threw it into his astral projection.
Then Hobert sighed, "This is the last time."
...
The stiffly moving "Demoness of Catastrophe" suddenly distorted her neck and looked up at the sky, where a giant sphere had suddenly appeared. Half of this sphere was pink flesh, and the other half was a transparent, soap bubble-like membrane.
Inside the membrane, filled with pale yellow liquid, a jet-black infant was curled up in the center.
It looked like a pregnant uterus, with an umbilical cord connecting the infant and the flesh.
As soon as the "Holy Infant King" appeared, a black, viscous tide surged toward the "Demoness of Catastrophe."
The "Demoness of Catastrophe" coughed delicately, and a barrier of ice crystals immediately appeared around her, slowing the speed of the surrounding black tide.
Then she plucked a strand of her hair covered in frost, and while staring at the "Holy Infant King," the hair in her hand burned, producing ash-black flames.
The jet-black infant, as if in a womb, actually shrank back and coughed as if sick.
The speed of the surrounding black tide also slowed down considerably.
Clarice, the "Demoness of Black," who was not far from the battlefield and had not yet recovered her strength, was already being affected by the "Holy Infant King's" aura of "corruption" and had to quickly leave the battlefield.
The three monsters, "Bull Devil Monarch" and the others, were also rescued by the "Creator" and escaped their previous states, leaving the battlefield and following the "Demoness of Unaging," waiting for an opportunity to launch a new offensive.
Hobert was about to withdraw his gaze, preparing to join forces with the "Holy Infant King" to drive away the "Demoness of Catastrophe," when he suddenly sensed something and looked towards the other side of the mountain, where another evil power seemed to be descending.
...
Lawrence and Rosalind's formation also encountered the enemy's demigods while hunting down members of the Demoness Sect.
But after blocking for seven or eight minutes, the enemy demigods' purpose had been achieved, and they began to retreat.
At this time, Lawrence used the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact in his hand to hold back two of the "Demonesses of Despair."
Lawrence and the other three demigods launched a siege against these two "Demonesses of Despair." After killing one of them, the other "Demoness of Despair" was about to lose control due to her serious injuries.
Just then, her hair also formed a mirror frame, and an angel was descending from the mirror in the middle.
Lawrence quickly shouted, "Scatter, scatter!"
He prepared to use the Sealed Artifact in his hand to block the other side's angel for a while, and then immediately escape himself.
But at this moment, the image and voice of the "Creator" suddenly appeared in his mind: "Pray to me."
Although Hobert could talk to Lawrence through his astral projection, to descend the power of the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" level, he needed Lawrence's prayer to broaden the connection between him and the "Nation of Disorder."
Lawrence's spirits lifted when he received the order, and he immediately prayed to the "Creator."
During his prayer, a familiar, surging power appeared in mid-air, and a giant eyeball appeared there, with small eyes growing on the white of the eyeball.
This eyeball clearly exuded an aura of mutation, but it was surrounded by a sacred radiance intertwined with clarity and darkness.
Mutation yet normal, evil yet sacred!
Lawrence had seen this "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" before. At this time, he bowed slightly to this strangely-state angel and left the battlefield under the protection of the "Creator."
The porcelain doll-like "Demoness of Catastrophe" gave the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" a beautiful smile, and then opened her mouth and blew out a breath.
This breath instantly turned into a blizzard, a blizzard in the middle of summer!
Dark clouds suddenly appeared very low in the sky, and a strong wind wrapped in cold snowflakes spun around the Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch.
If it were an ordinary blizzard, it would not harm the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" at all, but this blizzard was mixed with despair and a cold wind that could chill even angels to the bone.
The surface of the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" was immediately covered with a layer of white frost, as if it was about to be frozen.
Several eyes on the white of his eyes suddenly began to blink, and two figures appeared in mid-air, one was a giant light and shadow that seemed to support the sky and the earth, and the other was a tall figure covered in twilight light.
The "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" reproduced the scene of the ancient sun god fighting the giant king, and the giant light and shadow seemed to look at the land ravaged by the blizzard.
In an instant, the sunlight pierced through the thick dark clouds, and the sunlight shone on the earth again. The strong wind in the blizzard stopped, but the heavy snow was still falling.
In the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert, sitting on the "Iron Throne," sighed: Even an angel in poor condition can launch this level of natural disaster attack!
...
Far away from the two angel battlefields on a high mountain, the "Saintess of White" Katrina, whose eyes had recovered, seemed to be saying to the air: "The current situation is not the development we expected."
The summoning of the two angels was not something that the two subjectively wanted to do, because the "Saintess of White" had previously ordered only to carry out interception and harassment, striving for a certain amount of time.
They all knew that there were four demigods in each of the enemy's three formations, so they were equipped with corresponding manpower.
But what they didn't expect was that four Sequence 3s could support Klein's formation in such a short period of time, so one "Demoness of Despair" died.
On another battlefield, the strength of the "Queen Mystic" far exceeded their expectations, so the "Demoness of Black" Clarice was trapped and almost lost control.
As for the third battlefield, they did not expect that one of the demigods would have a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, and another "Demoness of Despair" has now died.
The summoning of angels is actually a self-protection mechanism in their bloodline, which is activated when they encounter an extremely dangerous state.
To be precise, this war deviated from Katrina's plan from the beginning.
They obtained information that the "Creator" had two angel subordinates, but they were not very clear about the war that took place in Feynapotter City.
To be precise, the parties involved in the war at that time were not very clear. Why could the "Creator" transform into the image of a phoenix and descend into the real world?
Except for the gods of the righteous god churches, who explained it to the participating personnel on our side at the time, the other participating parties thought that the "Creator" had descended into the real world.
In addition, the parties involved in the matter at that time chose to keep it secret.
So the information obtained by the Demoness Sect was: "The Creator" descended at that time and reversed the situation.
So the Demoness Sect designed those traps in the headquarters. The ice crystal spear trap was already there, but the descent of the "Primordial Demoness's" power in the stone statue was completed after a large number of sacrifices and multiple rituals.
The plan of Katrina, the commander-in-chief of this war, was to use the spear to temporarily prevent one of the enemy's angels from participating in the war, and then use their more normal angel to meet the enemy's second angel, and use the power of the "Primordial Demoness" to hold back the descent of the "Creator".
If Hobert still chose to attack the Demoness Sect's headquarters at this time, Katrina would use the traps and magic circles that had been operated around the headquarters in the Northern Continent for hundreds of years to severely damage the enemy Beyonders who raided the headquarters.
This plan was indeed very good. If they followed this plan, Hobert's side would indeed pay a heavy price, and they might not be able to win.
But as Hobert lamented, "Plans can't keep up with changes." This war did not develop according to Katrina's plan from the beginning.
At the same time, it did not develop according to Hobert's plan.
This is war.
A very beautiful voice suddenly came from the air around the "Saintess of White" Katrina: "Since the war has developed to this point, let's do our best to intercept the other party.
"Otherwise, the consequences will be disastrous if the 'Creator' and the angels who serve Him catch up."
Katrina nodded: "Fortunately, we have also invited foreign aid."
A moving laugh came from the air: "To be precise, that foreign aid came to our door on its own."
...
On the angel battlefield, Hobert moved his gaze away from the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch."
The "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" was slightly stronger than the "Holy Infant King," so Hobert was more relieved to let Him face an angel alone. He glanced at the other battlefield, and the "Holy Infant King" was not in any danger either.
So Hobert returned to the real world, racing against time to use "Distortion" to come to the middle of the two battlefields, so that he could use his own astral projection to descend power on either battlefield at any time and influence the battle situation.
Just as he arrived in the center of the battlefield, before he could pray to himself, a delicate voice suddenly came from behind him: "Little brother, what are you doing here?"
Hobert suddenly felt a chill down his spine, and the hair on his body stood on end.
"Cough cough cough!" Just as he was about to use "Distortion" to continue escaping, he coughed violently, as if his lungs were about to be coughed out.
Let alone use Beyonder abilities, even breathing was difficult.
"Ah, such a handsome little brother." That girlish voice sounded again: "Come and be my collection!"
Hobert felt as if his throat was blocked by a mouthful of thick phlegm. He bent down and coughed until his tears flowed, and then he found that his legs had been petrified!
He quickly rolled over on the ground and used all his strength to use "Frenzy."
For about half a second, the source of the voice was affected and stopped the petrification and virus attack on Hobert.
Taking advantage of that half-second, Hobert used "Distortion" to escape the very center of the petrification and virus.
With phlegm in his throat, he mumbled the incantation: "Messenger!"
The space in front of Hobert became illusory, and a horizontal coffin floated out from the spirit world.
Hobert once again felt feverish, his throat clogged with phlegm, and his legs began to petrify again.
Using "Distortion" again weakened these symptoms, and after using "Distortion" several times, he finally escaped the danger.
"Bestow!" Hobert struggled to use this Beyonder power, "bestowing" the negative effects onto a large tree.
Half of the tree immediately turned into gray stone, and half of its leaves turned black and quickly fell off, dying from the disease.
Hobert took a deep breath, feeling like he had escaped death!
Only then did he remember: Why didn't I use the "Order Crystal's" shield?
After a little thought, Hobert understood that he had been affected when the other party called out "Little Brother."
Now, when Hobert recalled that "Little Brother" call, a happy smile involuntarily appeared on his face, as if the goddess he had long admired had finally accepted his confession.
Shaking his head, Hobert regained his sanity, but he estimated that the influence of the other party's ability would last for a while.
At this moment, a towering black tree suddenly grew on the hillside. Almost instantly, its canopy spread out, and the sky within sight was completely covered by the dark black leaves.
This also meant that Messenger Beverly had returned to her best state.
Feeling that he had recovered a bit, Hobert hid in the canopy of a large tree before entering the "Nation of Disorder."
After entering the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert didn't worry about his physical body being suddenly harmed or discovered because of the protection of the ritual.
Arriving in the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert found himself roughly in the center of three angel battlefields, meaning that all three battlefields could help.
He first glanced at Beverly's battlefield in the middle. She had already left the coffin and was holding a heavy, wide coffin lid in one hand and a delicate metal crossbow in the other, shooting at the air.
Although the enemy was still in a state of "invisibility," Beverly could sense their presence. Every time Beverly shot an arrow, the other party would use an ice arrow to knock it away.
Even under "True Sight," Hobert could only clearly sense the opponent's position but couldn't see where they were.
Rumble!
Suddenly, the earth shook violently, and a small-scale earthquake appeared on the battlefield!
The earthquake cracked a huge fissure, splitting a mountain on the battlefield in two! The fissure was also very deep, and even magma could be seen at the bottom!
The fissure spread to both ends, heading straight for Beverly. She calmly held the coffin lid in front of her: "Disorder!"
The fissure suddenly deviated from its original path, drawing a neat semicircle around Beverly, and then continued along its previous path after reaching a distance.
Hobert suddenly understood that the "Demoness of Catastrophe" could not only create disasters like large-scale plagues but also blizzards, earthquakes, and other disasters!
Beverly, having recovered her state, had no problem dealing with the enemy in front of her.
Hobert was about to shift his attention to the "Holy Infant King," but he saw a beautiful figure suddenly appear not far from Beverly.
She seemed to perfectly match all of Hobert's aesthetics. If it weren't for the protection of the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert estimated that he would likely stand there like an idiot, completely captivated by her beauty.
This was the still-normal "Demoness of Catastrophe" of the "Demoness Sect." After ending her invisibility, she waved her hand and created a tall mirror made of ice crystals on her side.
Beverly seemed to understand something. She took out a small glass bottle containing a clump of dark red hair.
Crushing the glass bottle, the dark red hair inside suddenly burst into flames.
Whoosh~
The flames burning from these hairs were very unusual, as large as a bonfire!
A fire person walked out of the flames. The moment he walked out, the flames on his body disappeared instantly, revealing his true face. It was a young man with dark red hair, looking only seventeen or eighteen years old.
It was Beverly's younger brother, "Weather Warlock" Raymond.
And coming out of the "Demoness of Catastrophe's" mirror was a man in his thirties with a sallow complexion. Hobert felt a little uncomfortable looking at his appearance.
After a moment of realization, he understood that the person's facial features were very symmetrical, looking like a mannequin.
Hobert recalled that he had seen this man in the memory fragments of the "Uncertain Mist" when dealing with the Boklun Manor incident.
Coupled with some of the information he had obtained later, he, no, He should be Pedi Tamara, the "Duke of Entropy" of the Tamara family.
That is, the angel who blocked Hobert and Audrey when they encountered Orseya in the suburban villa of Backlund before.
Hobert was stunned: Why is He here? Or when did He get in touch with the Demoness Sect?
After thinking about it a little, Hobert seemed to understand that Orseya had been in Backlund recently, and she should be actively inquiring about news about Earl Hobert. At this time, the Demoness Sect was also doing similar things, so they had some contact!
Hobert sighed: My enemies have all come together, but you came at a really bad time. Now is still the time when the "Creator's" angel power is the most abundant. After today, the "Creator's" combat power in terms of angels can only ask for foreign aid.
Then he thought: In this battle, the "Creator's" side actually dispatched four angels! At the next Tarot Club meeting, there will be something to brag about.
