chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 606 The Rise of a New Force
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert looked at the Sealed Artifact in his hand, which was shaped like a delicate porcelain doll. It was very well-behaved in the "Nation of Disorder", only carrying a smile but not emitting laughter.
Using the authority of the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert knew that this Sealed Artifact had the characteristic of being alive and would intermittently emit a "giggling" laughter.
When this laughter appeared, all males and male creatures within 10 kilometers, including the holder, would mistake the doll for the opposite sex they had long admired, and this opposite sex was currently presenting the most seductive state.
Hobert sighed: This is an indiscriminate attack ability. The holder's only advantage is knowing the consequences caused by this laughter and being able to prepare in advance.
Its abilities include: "It can become invisible; it can enter the 'Mirror World'; it can create mystical viruses. If there is enough time, it can create a plague that sweeps across a country; it can maximize the holder's personal charm; it can offset Beyonder damage by burning hair; it can create blizzards, avalanches, earthquakes, floods, tsunamis, and other disasters."
Hobert touched his short hair. If he used the method of burning hair to offset the damage, his little bit of hair might be burned away in less than two seconds.
As for its negative effects: "If the holder uses it for more than 1 minute cumulatively, if it is a male, he will turn into a female; if it is a female, she will love females from then on, and the accumulation will restart after 6 hours of rest; the holder will not be able to see his appearance in the mirror. When he sees himself, it means that the holder has been completely trapped in the 'Mirror World' and will never be able to return to the real world; after using it once, he will be prone to various disasters in the next 6 days and will implicate the people around him; after using it once, he will be very tired of reading and studying in the next 3 days, and may even be so tired that he wants to commit suicide."
Hobert smiled. The last negative effect was obviously influenced by the final blow of the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch".
Its negative effects did not seem as powerful as the "0-70" he had obtained before, but they were difficult to avoid. Hobert found it difficult to continuously "distort" his gender. Obviously, this Sealed Artifact was somewhat unfriendly to male Beyonders.
Moreover, his abilities such as "distortion" and "tampering" could not profoundly affect the "Mirror World".
As for the third and fourth points, as long as he found the right way, it would not be difficult to avoid them.
Hobert simply did not carry out further sealing, because with his current level, even a new seal would be difficult to achieve the desired effect.
It would be better to simply put it in the "Nation of Disorder" for use and then seal it after advancement.
Next was the naming stage. When Hobert was chatting with Lawrence and the others a few days ago, he recalled that the Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts in the orthodox churches also had names in addition to their numbers.
Even some special Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts also had their own names in addition to their numbers.
For Hobert, this made the naming stage a lot more complicated.
He thought about it and named the Sealed Artifact in his hand: "0-71" Calamity Porcelain Doll.
Then the name of "0-70" was also changed accordingly to: "0-70" Creation Bracelet.
Hobert, who was quite satisfied with this name, went to look at another Sealed Artifact he had seized, which was a pure black ring formed by the "Demoness of Black".
Its abilities encompassed most of the "Demoness of Unaging's" abilities. After sealing it a bit, the negative effects were still relatively easy to avoid. Currently, using it in the real world for 10 minutes would not be affected in any way.
After naming this ring "1-111", Hobert returned to the real world in the form of a bestowal, carrying the Sealed Artifact "1-101" corresponding to Sequence 4 "Parasite" of the "Marauder" pathway, and the Sealed Artifact "1-102" corresponding to Sequence 4 "Puppet" of the "Prisoner" pathway.
Then he set up the altar and offered sacrifices to the "Evernight Goddess".
In fact, this sacrifice should have been carried out long ago. Previously, when the "Evernight Goddess" saved him and Audrey and allowed him to avoid sharing memories with Trunsoest, he needed to express his gratitude.
However, Hobert felt that he might still need to pray for the power of the "Evernight Goddess" during this war, so it would be better to perform the sacrifice together after the war.
What he didn't expect was that the "Creator" himself solved the difficulties, but he still had to perform the sacrifice to thank the Evernight Goddess for her previous help.
As for these two sacrificial Worships, Hobert had already thought about them. "1-101" was easy to attract Amon, and Hobert needed to use it carefully and avoid it seriously, but the orthodox churches could use it with confidence.
Unless Amon's avatars were crazy, He would not easily attack the Beyonders of the church.
And "1-102" and "1-103" were both Sealed Artifacts corresponding to "Puppet", and one of them could be sacrificed.
So, after setting up the altar and placing a bowl of fine sand, Hobert piously chanted: "The Evernight Goddess who stands higher than the cosmos and more eternal than eternity…
"Your devout believer begs for your attention;
"Begging you to open the door to the Divine Kingdom;
"Thank you for bringing me and Audrey back to Earth before, and thank you for allowing me to keep my secret.
"I hereby offer sacrifices to express my gratitude."
A sense of peace that made people feel at ease descended around the altar, and Hobert seemed to see the deep night sky above the altar.
The next moment, the door dotted with stars opened, and a huge suction force sucked away "1-101" on the altar.
Hobert was stunned: Does the Evernight Goddess think one Sealed Artifact is enough?
In fact, the value of an orthodox god being able to respond to Hobert's prayers at any time is immeasurable. After all, the Evernight Goddess really has churches and Nighthawks, and so many dependents and believers.
Unlike the "Creator" and the "Fool", who have only a few dependents and very few believers.
Just as Hobert was about to thank the Evernight Goddess again, the fine sand he had placed aside suddenly flew out of the bowl and formed a line of words in front of the altar. The meaning of connecting the words was: This is the thank-you gift for saving you.
Hobert was stunned: "Respected Evernight Goddess, are you not interested in the second sacrificial offering? I can change it."
The sand on the table was blown away by a gentle breeze, forming a new line of words: No, I need you to do something for me.
Clang ~
The door dotted with stars closed, and the Evernight Goddess disconnected from the altar. The deep sense of peace also disappeared.
Hobert was stunned for a while before he understood that the Evernight Goddess had already marked the price for allowing him to have enough Concealment to avoid being affected by Trunsoest.
The fact that the Evernight Goddess did not say what she wanted him to do meant that Hobert's current strength was not enough to help Her complete that matter.
He thought to himself: You're not going to ask me to help you fetch water from the River of Eternal Darkness, are you? That's Klein's job, how can I compete with him for it?
Hobert shook his head with a smile: This is obviously the Evernight Goddess's investment in me. As for how high the returns will be paid in the future, let's talk about it later.
As far as he was concerned, if he succeeded in building a country in the future, there would be no problem in allowing the Church of the Evernight Goddess to preach in the country, but if the church wanted to interfere in the country's political affairs, sorry, no way!
Putting "1-102" back into the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert rested for a while and prepared to deal with the spoils distribution the next day.
…
The former kingdom of the Earth Mother, within the Source of Life.
In the early morning, crystal clear dewdrops rolled between the dense leaves, eventually falling onto the forest path that was very harmonious with the entire lush forest.
In the church headquarters, which seemed to be built on a towering tree, the Pope convened an emergency meeting and listened to the reports of several archbishops on the war that had occurred yesterday.
The main reporter was Simpson, but he himself was not here, but attended the meeting in the form of a wooden stake standing in front of the conference table.
This wooden stake was more than one person tall and also carried a verdant branch of leaves, as if it were a piece of wood that had just been cut down from the forest outside.
The wooden stake had rough eyes, ears, and a mouth made of bark. Simpson, thousands of miles away, could share the senses and functions of these organs.
After he reported a few words, an archbishop in the headquarters couldn't help but plan to ask: "Are you sure that the 'Creator' dispatched 25 demigods in this battle?"
"I'm sure!" Simpson said: "I was a little unbelievable at the time, so I counted twice!
"Many Beyonder organizations that we didn't expect are very likely to be loyal to the 'Creator', or organizations that have in-depth cooperation with Hobert."
"For example, the Tony Manor in the Rosterd Archipelago, the Balk family in the Southern Continent, and the Tudor family, which has always been in hiding.
"What is certain is that they are all families loyal to the 'Creator'.
"In addition, the Temperance Faction of the 'Rose School', Element Dawn, the Sanguine, and the Spiritual Research Society all have good cooperation with Hobert."
Another archbishop, also attending the meeting in the form of a wooden stake, was somewhat surprised: "Spiritual Research Society?"
The Spiritual Research Society is the organization to which April belongs.
Simpson nodded: "Yes, their vice president, April, personally participated in the war this time."
The meeting room suddenly fell silent. Everyone knew that this April was a traitor to the Church, and the Church of the Earth Mother had always regarded the Spiritual Research Society as a hostile organization.
Another archbishop asked: "It is not difficult to understand that the Temperance Faction cooperates with Hobert, after all, they have a common enemy. Why did Element Dawn and the Sanguine participate in the war?"
"Sorry." Simpson said: "I was unable to find out relevant information."
The Pope, who looked full of love, raised his hand and said to Simpson: "Continue."
After Simpson reported the process of the war, everyone fell into silence.
The Demoness Sect's defeat was a matter of course. That was four Angels, a full four Angels! Plus more than twenty demigods, it would have been no problem to attack the 'Source of Life'.
Simpson said: "According to my analysis, these four Angels are not all loyal to the 'Creator', and it seems that the condition of two of the Angels is not very good."
Everyone did not make any comments on this, but if they were to be enemies with the 'Creator', they still had to prepare for war as if there were four Angels!
The Pope suddenly said in a soft voice: "The Church's attitude towards the 'Creator' is cooperation, and Hobert also needs the power of the Church.
"This mutual assistance model must continue to be extended. In the future, we may get more benefits from it!"
After setting the tone, the Pope ended the meeting.
However, the Pope, Pope Roland, and the Dean of the Institute of Life Sciences did not leave.
With a wave of his hand, the Pope summoned a green leaf that floated in from outside the window.
The green leaf quickly grew larger, and Hobert's portrait appeared on it.
The Pope said: "This is Hobert's appearance. He looks too much like Rex. And April is also involved."
In the end, I don't know if he was asking himself or the other two Angels: "Is this a coincidence?"
The three Angels fell silent at the same time.
… …
The next day, Hobert got up early and asked Mr. Fool for leave, as he would not be able to attend today's gathering.
After washing his face, combing his hair, and changing into a more formal tailcoat, he carried a large wooden box to the side hall of the Lord's Mansion.
Hobert told the butler Allen: "If I am meeting with guests and new guests arrive, please ask them to wait in the main hall."
Allen agreed and asked his subordinates to serve tea and snacks.
Now Allen is not only the butler of the Lord's Mansion, but also the butler of the Longtail Island Governor's Mansion, and Fors trusts him very much.
Soon, Hobert welcomed his first guest, the Sanguine Countess Rosalind.
After politely inviting the Sanguine Countess to sit down, the two talked about the extraordinary war that had just ended. The number of Sanguine participating in the war was not large, but two members died in battle.
However, because their self-healing ability was very good, the injured had already recovered.
Hobert opened the wooden box next to him and, according to the previous agreement, took out the prepared 5 Beyonder characteristics and handed them to Rosalind.
The Countess simply checked the Beyonder characteristics and handed Hobert the 9 Beyonder characteristics they had seized yesterday.
In fact, they also seized a Sealed Artifact, but according to the agreement, the Sealed Artifact belonged to the Sanguine.
After completing the previously agreed transaction, Rosalind was not in a hurry to leave, and Hobert was not in a hurry to see the guest off.
The two drank tea and chatted.
Hobert smiled and said: "This is a very perfect cooperation. We each get what we need."
The beautiful Rosalind said meaningfully: "This is indeed a cooperation that exceeded our expectations."
She was referring to the strength of the participants and the scale of the war exceeding expectations.
Hobert then got to the point: "I think we should establish a long-term cooperation mechanism, because we have a common enemy.
"In the future, we can jointly launch attacks on the 'Rose School'!"
For Hobert, his battle was not over yet.
He wanted to use the achievements and momentum gained from this victory to reposition his relationship with various organizations.
To put it bluntly, Hobert gathered everyone together with benefits this time. In fact, during the battle, apart from the commendable performances of the Balk family, the Tony family, and the Tudor family, the performances of the other forces were very poor.
Otherwise, this battle would have been a greater victory and given the Demoness Sect a heavier blow.
After Hobert repositioned the relationship between the various parties, he strived to be able to immediately gather the required organizations if there were similar battles in the future, and the other party could invest in the battle relatively seriously!
This process is probably from a mob to a group of stragglers centered on the "Creator" forces.
If you want to obtain a very elite extraordinary force, you must go through constant tempering in war.
Countess Rosalind said seriously: "I will convey your thoughts to the Marquis and will also attach great importance to the cooperation with the respected 'Creator'."
Then she added: "I heard that the 'Traveler's Gate' between the Lord's Mansion and Backlund will be reopened at noon. At that time, I will immediately return to Backlund, and I will come back soon to convey the Sanguine' decision.
"And my subordinates will not leave and will participate in the Picking Festival tomorrow."
Hobert smiled and said: "Welcome more Sanguine to taste the delicacies and fresh fruits and vegetables."
Then they talked about helping the Sanguine crush the Beyonder characteristics. Rosalind said that there was no need for this, and the Sanguine had a way to crush them themselves.
At this time, Rosalind bid farewell, and Hobert politely sent her to the door.
Miss Sharron was already waiting in the main hall. After Hobert sent off the Sanguine Countess, she passed through the wall and stood there watching the servants take away Rosalind's water glass and wipe the table and chairs.
It's just that the servants couldn't see the somewhat illusory Miss Sharron.
After the servants finished cleaning, Hobert asked them to leave, invited Miss Sharron to sit down, and placed a teacup in front of her.
Just as he was about to pour her tea, Miss Sharron said: "No need, I don't drink."
Now she can go without food or water for a week.
However, Hobert still poured the tea: "This is politeness."
Then he opened the wooden box next to him again, took out a Beyonder characteristic of "Puppet", and pushed it to Sharron: "This is the reward promised to you for participating in the war."
After Sharron glanced at the box, she nodded slightly, and then with a wave of her hand, a small pile of Beyonder characteristics gushed out from the middle of the table like a spring.
There were also two Beyonder characteristics of "Demoness of Despair", one was the spoils of the Temperance Faction's joint siege, and the other was the spoils of the joint siege with Klein.
However, for Klein, these Beyonder characteristics were of no use, so when dividing the spoils, he gave all the Beyonder characteristics he seized to the Temperance Faction.
Klein therefore obtained the priority right to choose Sealed Artifacts. In the end, he obtained 1 Grade 1 Sealed Artifact and 2 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts.
Especially that Grade 1 Sealed Artifact made the "Fool"'s demigod-level Sealed Artifact no longer so thin.
Hobert simply counted. Sharron brought a total of 26 Beyonder characteristics. Except for the two Beyonder characteristics of "Demoness of Despair", the other characteristics were mainly Sequence 6 and Sequence 7.
After further negotiations with Hobert, Sharron bought 15 Sequence 9 "Prisoner" and 15 Sequence 8 "Lunatic" Beyonder characteristics for 13,000 pounds.
This was a bit beyond Hobert's expectations. He had not made corresponding preparations and could only promise to send them to her in the afternoon on the grounds that the Beyonder characteristics were not in the Lord's Mansion.
Then, according to the previous agreement, Hobert took out two Beyonder characteristics of "Puppet" and 12 other Beyonder characteristics of the corresponding sequence.
However, Sharron negotiated with Hobert again and used a Beyonder characteristic of "Puppet" to replace some Beyonder characteristics of other sequences.
This made Hobert very "embarrassed". After pulling back and forth, he agreed to use the Beyonder characteristic of "Puppet" to replace 2 "Wraith", 10 "Zombie", and 12 "Werewolf" Beyonder characteristics.
As the negotiation concluded, Hobert did a mental calculation and realized that even after trading with the Ascetics twice, he still had over thirty Beyonder characteristics from the "Prisoner", "Lunatic", and "Werewolf" pathways in his possession.
He also had a dozen or so "Zombie" Beyonder characteristics, six "Wraith" Beyonder characteristics, and two "Puppet" Beyonder characteristics.
Most importantly, he had one "Disciple of Silence" Beyonder characteristic.
This made Hobert sigh once again: Beyonder wars are truly profitable on a large scale!
These Beyonder characteristics were all spoils of war that the Ballek family and the Rose School of Thought obtained during their battles in the Southern Continent, because the Creator provided effective protection.
It had been half a year, and they were still reaping the benefits of these spoils.
After completing the transaction with Sharron, Miss Sharron was not in a hurry to leave.
So Hobert smiled and said, "I also have a 'Disciple of Silence' Beyonder characteristic here."
Sharron, who usually didn't have much emotional fluctuation, showed a subtle change in expression.
Just as Hobert expected, the "Puppet" potion, if not melting in Sharron's mouth, should be very easy to digest.
Hobert said, "But this level of Beyonder characteristic is not something to be traded, but a strategic reserve."
Sharron immediately asked, "What price do I have to pay to get it?"
As far as she was concerned, as long as the price was not unacceptable, it was better than risking hunting down the "Disciples of Silence" of the "Indulgence Faction".
"It's not what price you have to pay." Hobert said seriously, "The 'Creator' needs to have absolute trust in the Temperance faction before handing this Beyonder characteristic over to you."
Sharron quietly looked at Hobert.
After seven or eight seconds, Hobert sighed: Shouldn't she ask how to gain the 'Creator's' absolute trust at this time?
However, Sharron wasn't just now so "good at chatting," so Hobert asked her, "Does the Temperance Faction need the protection of a deity?"
The "bodyguard lady" with delicate features considered it and said, "Yes!"
They needed it too much. If they had the protection of a deity, the Temperance Faction wouldn't have to hide everywhere, avoiding the angels of the Indulgence Faction.
They could gather strength more easily, instead of becoming less and less organized as they were now.
Hobert smiled and said, "If the Temperance Faction can be loyal to the 'Creator' to a certain extent, you will not only receive a certain amount of protection, but also obtain the 'Disciple of Silence' Beyonder characteristic by completing the tasks assigned by the 'Creator'."
Then he explained, "The 'Creator' doesn't care about your beliefs, just needs you to show enough sincerity."
This time, Miss Sharron finally asked, "How to show sincerity?"
"Send 15 Beyonders to form a Beyonder squad and follow my command." Hobert said, "They can exchange for Beyonder characteristics here by earning merits.
"They can also enjoy the treatment of official Beyonders. The specific exchange plan is…"
After finishing the details of exchanging merits for Beyonder characteristics in one breath, Hobert took a sip of tea and said, "These 15 Beyonders will be protected by us, and the entire Ascetics will also receive a lot of help from us."
Miss Sharron paused for a few seconds before saying, "Sounds like a good deal."
She was Reinette Tinekerr's student, a "red and rooted" member of the Temperance Faction. After becoming a demigod, she already had some power to express her views on such matters.
However, she didn't immediately agree and said she would go back and discuss it.
The Temperance Faction didn't ask Hobert to help shatter the Beyonder characteristics. Originally, Hobert wanted to chat with Miss Sharron, but he felt that he really couldn't chat anymore, so he politely sent her away.
After waiting for a while, Hobert saw that no new guests were coming, so he asked Allen to invite Bernadette and the nominal head of the Tony family, Osment, separately.
Although both were invitations, the "invitation" for the two was different.
Bernadette was a Sequence 3, so even if he wanted to share the fruits of victory, Hobert had to invite her over to discuss it.
The Tony family was more like his own people. Hobert's invitation to him was more like a superior's appointment with a subordinate.
More than twenty minutes later, a green, very beautiful vine suddenly grew in the center of the side hall.
The vine grew taller and taller, and the leaves kept opening around, emitting a light green light, which reflected the space at the top of the vine into light green.
A graceful figure appeared in the light. The figure quickly became clear. It was Bernadette, wearing a long waisted dress.
She stepped down from the top of the vine and smiled, "Lord Hobert is finally free to see me?"
The vines behind Bernadette quickly became transparent and disappeared into the air.
Hobert smiled and said, "Distinguished guests always arrive at the last moment."
He invited Bernadette to sit down and poured her tea, just like the two guests he had met before.
Bernadette raised her hand, and a delicate little leather bag appeared in her palm: "It's all in here."
As she spoke, she threw the leather bag to Hobert.
Hobert caught the leather bag and opened it to take a look. Although the leather bag was small, it had more than twenty compartments, separating all the Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert also opened his wooden box and took out the "Mysticologist" Beyonder characteristic that he had prepared, as well as one copy each of the Beyonder characteristics from Sequence 9 "Mystery Pryer" to Sequence 5 "Constellations Master".
"You're at a bit of a disadvantage in this transaction." Hobert smiled and said, "But considering that I will have to provide you with help in the future, let's trade like this first, and talk about the help later."
Bernadette nodded: "Okay."
Hobert asked, "Can you tell me now what kind of help you need me to provide? I can prepare for it."
Bernadette crossed her legs: "I only glimpsed a very vague future. I don't know exactly what kind of help it is, but it won't be life-threatening for you."
Hobert thought to himself that your action is very unladylike, but he also thought that describing a woman as a lady in the Intis Republic is like scolding someone.
So he didn't comment on it and continued the conversation just now: "Okay."
Then Hobert asked with a smile: "Are you interested in establishing a longer term cooperative partnership with us?"
"Long term cooperative partner?" Bernadette was somewhat interested. "Tell me about it in detail."
"It means that we maintain a very close cooperation with each other without interfering in each other's internal problems, and we are in a relationship of priority support." Hobert explained:
"If Element Dawn is in danger, we will support you as soon as possible.
"Similarly, if we need it, Element Dawn must also quickly organize forces to support us.
"Such support must have at least reciprocity, just like our cooperation this time. As long as you participate in the war, I will pay you a reward and promise a favor. Correspondingly, you will share the spoils with me.
"Our contributions and gains are basically equal."
Bernadette pinched her chin and thought for a while: "That's a good suggestion."
Hobert added: "There is a premise that if I go to help Element Dawn, I will listen to your dispatch, but if I think it is too dangerous, I reserve the right to refuse.
"If you come to help us, the same is true, and you can also reserve the right to refuse."
"You're very thoughtful!" Bernadette asked, "Do we need to sign any agreement?"
Hobert smiled: "That's not necessary."
He sighed in his heart that it was a pleasure to negotiate with the leader of such a Beyonder organization. As long as the other party felt it was appropriate, they immediately confirmed this in-depth cooperative relationship.
The two chatted for a while, and Bernadette got up and stretched out her hand. A braid made of golden hair hung down from the void.
Bernadette grabbed the braid and prophesied like a prophecy: "From then on, the 'Creator's' reputation will spread far and wide, and he will officially participate in the game of this era!"
Hobert smiled and said, as if he was also saying a prophecy: "The change of era is originally an era of the rise of new forces!"
He believed that the change of era was not a secret in the "Queen Mystic's" place,
Bernadette's eyes sank, but she quickly returned to a smile: "I will contact you when I need your help."
The braid pulled upwards into the void, and Bernadette also disappeared into the void.
Hobert drank a few sips of tea to rest, and then invited Osment of the Tony family in.
Osment, still wearing a black robe, sat politely opposite Hobert and placed the stone box containing the spoils on the table.
The stone box opened, revealing Beyonder characteristics neatly arranged in small compartments. The box had three layers, and once they were all laid out, the sheer number of Beyonder characteristics altered the light and atmosphere of the entire side hall.
Although the Tony family joined the war relatively late, their spoils of war ranked first in both quality and quantity.
This was mainly due to the help of Beverly and Raymond. Although these two angels were not in good condition, Raymond had to return to Tony Manor after participating in the battle for more than twenty minutes, and Beverly also returned to the spirit world after participating for more than half an hour.
But their brief assistance still achieved results that Lawrence and the others could not match.
Hobert pointed to the 'Demoness of Unaging' Beyonder characteristic: "You're even planning to give me this?"
This is the second Sequence 3 level spoils of war received so far.
"Yes," Osment said with a smile.
This made Hobert a little embarrassed, because it was difficult to set a price.
Raymond had already set the tone, selling the 'Demoness of Despair' level Beyonder characteristic to Hobert for 50,000 pounds.
The 'Demoness of Unaging' Beyonder characteristic was one level higher. When it came to things at this level, it wasn't just a matter of the price of a Sequence 4 characteristic increasing by one or two times.
Hobert didn't rush to set a price, but asked again: "Have you not considered keeping some 'Witch' pathway Beyonder ingredients?"
Osment shook his head: "Beyonders of this pathway are prone to bringing disasters and attracting a lot of trouble."
The Tony family had already mastered the potion formulas for three pathways; there was no need to open up a new pathway.
Moreover, they lacked corresponding potion formulas, especially those for demigods and above, which were almost impossible to obtain through trading.
As for the issue of male family members being unwilling to switch pathways and become women, it was an almost negligible factor.
Hobert had no choice but to say: "For this 'Demoness of Unaging' Beyonder characteristic, you name a price."
Osment said seriously: "We hope to use this Beyonder characteristic to obtain an opportunity."
"What opportunity?"
"An opportunity to form a Beyonder team loyal to the 'Creator'!"
Hobert was slightly stunned: Look at these people's awareness!
"Okay," Hobert said with a smile: "But I won't let you suffer a loss. What is the ritual for advancing to 'War Bishop'?"
Osment immediately understood Hobert's intention and said: "There are two ways. The first is to launch a surprise attack. The more unexpected the enemy is, the more fear and panic gained from the war, and the faster the enemy collapses, the better the effect of the ritual.
"The second is to conduct a miraculous defense battle. The greater the gap between the enemy and us, the more tragic the battle, and the longer the defense lasts, the better the effect of the ritual."
Hobert nodded and said, as Osment expected: "I will find a way to help you complete the 'War Bishop' ritual, but not now, but in the not-too-distant future."
Osment said with emotion: "That would be great!"
Then he stood up and bowed slightly: "Thank you, 'Favored of God'."
Through this extraordinary war, the Tony family took the opportunity to promote another 'Iron-Blooded Knight'. Currently, the Tony family has recovered to the strength of four demigods.
If a 'War Bishop' appeared among the two 'Iron-Blooded Knights', they would completely recover from the blow of Amon's clone.
Hobert invited him to sit down and began to count the spoils of war. Osment gave a very low price, and Hobert bought all the spoils of war for only 180,000 pounds.
As for the Tony family's official Beyonder team, the number is temporarily 15 people, and Osment has half a month to form it.
After talking with the Tony family, Hobert was a little tired, so he decided to rest for a while and continue to divide the spoils of war in the afternoon.
… …
Loen Kingdom, Rubber Island.
This island is not far from the mouth of the Tussock River, with convenient transportation and beautiful scenery.
In the direction facing the sea, there is a magnificent royal manor.
In a small hall, "Protector" William I sat on a high throne, exuding a majesty that made people dare not look directly at him.
He asked Georgina, who was standing below: "Where did the 'Creator' get so many angels?"
Georgina lowered her head and said: "It's not clear. We don't know much about the battles between angels.
"The people of the Demoness Sect only know that the 'Creator' dispatched four angels, because we have not yet contacted Ms. Sherry, we do not know the specific battle process.
"But it is certain that the angels of the 'Creator' side won."
William I asked again: "Where did those demigods come from?"
"Those demigods come from many Beyonder organizations," Georgina replied: "What is certain at present is that there are members of the Aurora Order and the Tony family!"
William I was silent for a few seconds before saying: "We still underestimated the strength of the 'Creator'."
He asked: "When will Hobert be awarded the title? Is it the rank of Rear Admiral?"
"It was originally planned for next week," Georgina replied: "It's the rank of Rear Admiral."
"Change it to General!" William I said: "Give him a seat in the Lower House!"
Georgina was stunned. She reminded: "His father is already a member of the Upper House. If you give him a seat in the Lower House, the nobles and members of parliament will definitely oppose such a decision."
William I said: "Let any noble who dares to object 'show loyalty'. At this critical time, we must use all means to win over Hobert, so that we can maintain a good relationship with the 'Creator'."
He paused and said: "Didn't you say that Alice has a good impression of Hobert? Create opportunities for them. It would be best if Alice could conceive Hobert's child."
Georgina was a little surprised: "This, Hobert shouldn't marry Alice. He has feelings for Audrey…"
William I asked back: "Who said he must marry her?"
Georgina was even more surprised. She raised her head slightly and looked at William I's feet: "Your Majesty, we are, after all, the royal family!"
William I sighed: "You don't know how dangerous we are now!"
The crisis that the Loen royal family is facing now may only be understood by William I and Duke Southville.
It seems that the orthodox churches have defaulted to George III becoming a god, but the process of becoming a god is too forced, and William I does not have much confidence.
If it fails, Loen's morale will completely plummet. Under the shadow of war, the entire royal family may be destroyed.
And the 'Creator' is a force that no one had calculated on before yesterday!
While He has not yet inclined to any force, we must strive to form an alliance with Him. In addition to gaining a solid ally, it can also greatly increase the royal family's fault tolerance.
Even if George III fails, the royal family will not be completely passive, and can still use the method of selling some benefits to obtain the 'Creator's' help and tide over the risk period.
This is not just as simple as adding an ally. When the orthodox churches are preparing to use the Augustus family as a pawn, they will consider the 'Creator's' factor.
When the enemy is preparing to launch a war, they must also consider the 'Creator's' factor.
The superposition of these two factors is enough for the royal family to survive the most dangerous moment.
William I, who has been playing games in this cruel extraordinary world for more than two thousand years, is too clear about how much influence and energy this newly rising force will bring!
William I stared at Georgina: "Do as I say!
"The next main task is to find out what Hobert needs and what the 'Creator' needs!
"Do you believe it? That one from Feynapotter will also use all the means he can think of to win over the 'Creator'.
"We have such a good opportunity, of course we must make good use of it!"
"Yes!" Georgina agreed, and then asked: "Then, what is our attitude towards the Demoness Sect?"
William I thought for a while and said: "Kill a few people from the Demoness Sect, and continue to cooperate behind the scenes."
The greater the failure of the Demoness Sect, the more they will have to rely on the Loen royal family, and the easier it will be for Loen to use them in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 607: Hobert's Recruitment Operation
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
During lunch, Fors told Hobert that someone was dealing with the Beyonder characteristics of the "Door" and "Witch" pathways, and she knew that the spoils of war had not yet been completely divided.
Hobert didn't care too much, telling her to collect as much as she could.
In the afternoon, Hobert first went to the "Nation of Disorder" to retrieve the Beyonder characteristics he had traded with Miss Sharron in the morning, and had his servant send them to the Temperance faction.
By this time, guests had already arrived. Hobert first met Barnett, who had his clothes and hairstyle meticulously arranged.
However, the "old gentleman's" complexion was not very good at this time, because the Tudor family suffered the greatest losses in this war.
When the Demoness Sect launched its counterattack, the main targets were the Tudor family and Element Dawn.
Element Dawn also had good teamwork ability because their headquarters were on an island and they often engaged in naval battles.
But the Tudor family was different. Over a thousand years of hiding had made them have no concept of Beyonder warfare!
If Barnett hadn't been a Sequence 3 "Chaos Hunter," the Tudor family's three demigods might have been completely wiped out in the war!
Fortunately, Hobert's support was timely, and he quickly withstood the pressure of the counterattack.
However, the Tudor family still had one demigod die in battle, Barnett and another demigod were also injured, and about a quarter of the family members were killed in battle.
"I will ask the angels to help shatter the Beyonder characteristics of the martyred members," Hobert said first. "How the Beyonder characteristics are distributed after shattering is up to you to decide."
Barnett's complexion improved a little.
Hobert continued, "I will also give you the main ingredient for the 'Imperative Mage' in my hand, the crystal of the Striped Tiger of Laws.
"It is also up to you to decide who to give it to."
Barnett visibly relaxed a lot.
Hobert had already thought about the compensation for the Tudor family: "The Angus team will be increased by ten places, but the added personnel will be selected by Angus.
"In Jeffrey City, free housing will be provided to members of the Tudor family on a per-household basis. Members of the Tudor family are welcome to move in at any time."
Barnett finally had a smile on his face. He was very satisfied with the compensation Hobert offered.
Hobert then asked, "How is your condition? Have you shown any signs of losing control due to your injuries?"
"My problem is not big," Barnett said. "But Darnell's condition is not very good."
Darnell was another demigod of the Tudor family who had once traded Beyonder characteristics with Hobert on behalf of the Tudor family.
Hobert nodded: "You can let him pray to the 'Creator.' I believe that with the help of the 'Creator,' his condition will definitely improve."
Barnett said, "I will tell Darnell."
At this time, he put the wooden box in his hand on the table and pushed it towards Hobert.
The wooden box contained simply separated Beyonder characteristics. The Tudor family's harvest was also quite large, because they had been in the most intense battlefield, and there were two Beyonder characteristics of "Demoness of Despair."
Hobert said, "You have two choices. The first choice is to exchange them for merits according to the relevant regulations. But I must tell you that I don't have that many Beyonder characteristics of 'Arbiter' now.
"The merits you exchange back may not be able to be fully exchanged for Beyonder characteristics. You can consider exchanging for some Sealed Artifacts, or the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Lawyer' pathway."
He paused and then said, "The second choice is to form another team of Beyonders with 25 members. You will designate both the captain and the members.
"But they must obey my command and be loyal to the 'Creator'.
"After training, they will be sent to the Southern Continent."
Barnett considered for a moment before saying, "I choose the second option."
Because the family had just suffered considerable casualties, he would temporarily have many Beyonder characteristics available for use.
Barnett was very clear that the opportunity to designate the captain and members might only come once, so he had to cherish it. This was likely the key to continuing the family's will in the 'Creator's' forces.
Hobert smiled: "Okay."
In fact, no matter what choice Barnett made, it was acceptable to Hobert, or rather, it was the result he wanted to see.
This was the benefit of being a resource allocator.
With the end of this conversation, most of the Tudor family's power was reorganized and received by Hobert, and they were prepared to play an important role in the upcoming Longtail Island and Southern Continent operations.
After sending Barnett away, Lawrence of the Balk family was welcomed.
This family patriarch, who was a full head taller than Hobert, immediately handed over all the Beyonder characteristics captured in this battle to Hobert.
Hobert also prepared 7 copies each of the Beyonder characteristics of "Lawyer" and "Barbarian" for him, 4 copies each of the Beyonder characteristics of "Briber" and "Baron of Corruption," and 2 copies of the Beyonder characteristics of "Mentor of Disorder."
"I won't let you suffer," Hobert said with a smile. "After you go back, you can choose three 'Mentors of Disorder,' and then set up an altar and loudly describe their character and abilities, as well as some of their previous deeds, by praying to the 'Creator'.
"In the end, the 'Creator' will designate one of them and bestow upon him a Beyonder characteristic of 'Earl of the Fallen'."
Lawrence was very happy and made a gesture on his chest: "Praise the Creator!"
In this way, the Balk family would be able to add another demigod.
Hobert continued with a smile: "Elliott's team needs to be expanded to 25 people. As for you, Patriarch Lawrence, this is prepared for you according to the divine revelation."
Hobert handed Lawrence a delicate wooden box. Lawrence seemed to realize something, opened the wooden box, and inside was indeed a mask made of black crystal.
This was the symbol of the "Favored!"
Lawrence was so excited that he almost shed tears, feeling that he had finally received the recognition of the god.
He carefully stroked the mask and immediately felt that there seemed to be a force in the mask that was very compatible with his own Beyonder characteristics! Moreover, the level of this force was very high!
This surprised Lawrence a little, but also felt it was natural.
The things bestowed by the gods must be very high-end.
"I believe you have heard of its function," Hobert said with a smile. "It has extremely high anti-divination ability and effectively prevents loss of control."
"Yes," Lawrence carefully closed the lid: "Elliott told me about it."
He carefully put the mask away, looking very fond of it.
Hobert then said, "In addition, for you, for the Balk family, the 'Creator' will personally arrange it."
He smiled: "Congratulations, we are on the same level from now on."
These words really brought tears of excitement to Lawrence's eyes. He originally thought that this "Favored" would incorporate the Balk family, but he didn't expect that the "Creator" would personally incorporate them.
Then the harvest of this battle was really too great!
Hobert continued, "Let us pray to the 'Creator' together."
As he spoke, Hobert got up and knelt on the soft cushion that had been prepared aside, clasped his hands together, and pressed them against his chin, making a praying gesture.
"Big Shot" went online.
Lawrence was half a beat slower and immediately followed to kneel down and pray.
As soon as he whispered the honorable name of the 'Creator,' the majestic image of the 'Creator' immediately appeared in Lawrence's mind.
The 'Creator' said in a deep voice: "From this day on, in my name, spread the light and shadow of order.
"You can pray to me when you encounter danger, you can pray to me when you have requests, and you can pray to me when you have doubts in your heart.
"My command is the decree, my thoughts are your will, and you must not have any disloyal thoughts."
Lawrence was already moved to tears, and kept saying, "Praise the Creator!"
The 'Creator' began to issue specific orders: "Go back and reorganize all the combatable forces of the Balk family, organize them, and be ready to be dispatched at any time.
"From now on, they are first and foremost Beyonder forces loyal to me, and then members of the Balk family.
"You must be prepared for the upcoming great changes, expand your power, and gain true rule.
"Hobert will explain the specific plan to you."
After saying these generalities, the image of the 'Creator' disappeared.
Lawrence sat there for a long time, unable to calm down. This was the order of the 'Creator,' a direct order to him, a legendary 'Divine Revelation'!
After more than half a minute, Lawrence regained his ability to think and began to think about the 'Creator's' order.
At this time, Hobert had already sat down again and picked up the teapot to refill Lawrence's tea.
Lawrence got up, first thanked him, and then asked, "The 'Creator' said that the specific plan should be asked of you?"
Hobert said seriously, "The 'Creator's' plan in the Southern Continent has two parts. The first part is to build a light industrial base, a heavy industrial base, and a large agricultural production base in the Southern Continent.
"All investment and technical issues related to the construction will be handled by me."
"You need to find a safe location and, during construction, consider how to protect these places."
Hobert paused and then said, "The second part is to gather Beyonder forces to the Southern Continent as much as possible within three months!"
"At the same time, all the Beyonder forces of the Balk family must take turns to South Colson to complete the official Beyonder training during this period."
"Only members who have completed the official training can enjoy the treatment of formal official Beyonders."
"Afterward, I will send statistical and auditing personnel. Members who become formal official Beyonders can exchange their merits and salaries for merit points."
"Currently, merit points will be issued by me temporarily. I will give you the relevant documents regarding the specific uses of merit points later."
Lawrence nodded, picked up his teacup, and thought: These tasks are not difficult to complete. After all, the Balk family has already participated in the Beyonder rule of two generals and a local king. As long as there is enough funding, requisitioning a few pieces of land is not a problem.
Then he sighed in his heart: From today onward, all family members will be official Beyonders. This is a very celebratory thing.
But Hobert suddenly asked, "Do you know what this means?"
Lawrence was taken aback by the question: "What?"
Hobert said seriously: "To lay the foundation for building a country."
Lawrence was shocked, and the teacup in his hand fell.
Hobert waved his hand, using the ability of "Tampering", turning the falling teacup into a slow descent.
Lawrence quickly caught the teacup: Building a country! The "Creator" wants to build a country in the Southern Continent! The rule in South Colson and Longtail Island are just two attempts! The ultimate goal is to build a country!
Hobert added: "Only a few 'Favored' have received relevant orders. Do not publicize this news for the time being."
"I know." Lawrence put down the teacup with a somewhat trembling hand. Of course, he knew that this would be the highest level of secret.
Then he let out a long breath. Once, his family was the royal family of the Northern Continent, but now, they had long been tormented by the family's curse and lost their ambition for a country.
Even he, the patriarch, felt somewhat unreal after hearing the concept of building a country.
Hobert continued: "Go back and requisition land first. Tell me how much money you need in a letter, and I will raise it as soon as possible."
He planned to let Audrey supervise this money. The initial investment plan was 500,000 pounds!
With the current size of "Earl's Light", such a sum of money could be misappropriated just by making false accounts.
Afterward, the massive funds earned by "Earl's Light", except for a portion reserved for dividends, would all be used for investment in the Southern Continent.
Of course, doing so would seriously violate relevant financial regulations and the provisions for shareholders, dividends, and other commercial behaviors, so a completely trustworthy person was needed to operate and supervise it.
That person was Audrey.
Hobert also knew that with Audrey's personality, she would definitely feel very guilty for doing such a thing, but Hobert had already thought about how to persuade this kind noble lady.
This thought flashed through Hobert's mind. He chatted with Lawrence for a few more words about incorporating Beyonder forces before very politely sending this newly promoted "Favored" away.
Hobert rested for a while before continuing to meet Jonathan and Monica, who had been waiting for more than half an hour.
After the two entered, they first saw the stone boxes, wooden boxes, leather bags, and so on piled beside Hobert.
"Sit down." Hobert smiled and said, "I've kept you waiting."
After the three took their seats, Hobert poured tea for them as usual and then looked at them.
Jonathan took out a small wooden box and handed it to Hobert.
The wooden box was opened, revealing a space the size of a wooden crate, filled with the spoils of this battle, including the captured Sealed Artifacts.
According to the previous agreement, all the spoils they obtained from the war against the Demoness Sect belonged to Hobert.
Their spoils were not much, because in this battle, the "Door" pathway Beyonders in the Theosophy Order mainly served as scouts and rapid support, and only the "Witch" pathway Beyonders participated in the frontal combat.
Hobert nodded and casually put the wooden box aside.
"This is the Beyonder characteristic that needs to be shattered." Jonathan handed over a small cloth bag, which also had space magic on it.
Hobert smiled and took it, saying, "I'll give it to you the day after tomorrow at the latest."
Jonathan and Monica exchanged a glance before saying, "We have a request."
Hobert gestured for them to speak.
It was the charming Monica who made the request: "We hope to increase the number of the Helen team."
After witnessing the strength of the "Creator's" forces, the entire Theosophy Order had undergone a huge transformation regarding the "Creator."
Previously, most of the members of the council felt that the "Creator's" forces were similar to the Theosophy Order before the split.
Until this war, the "Creator's" forces erupted with terrifying strength, and they even had a huge advantage in the frontal war with the Demoness Sect!
So now the council members were complaining that Jonathan had asked for too few official extraordinary quotas when negotiating the conditions before.
But Hobert sighed and said, "There aren't that many quotas anymore."
Jonathan and Monica were somewhat disappointed.
"However, I expect there will be some more quotas by next year at the latest." Hobert smiled and said, "If there are any extraordinary wars before that, I will give priority to the Theosophy Order's quotas."
Finally, he said, "After all, when I first came to South Colson, we had relatively good cooperation."
Jonathan and Monica both sighed in their hearts: Fortunately, they overruled the objections at the time and decided to cooperate with Hobert!
Hobert smiled and said, "In addition, I will be forming two research societies. You can pay attention to the relevant announcements. If you are interested, you can take a look."
This battle had yielded a large number of "Witch" pathway and "Door" pathway Beyonder characteristics. If they were only used by Helen's team, it was estimated that even by the time of the doomsday and the transition of eras, they wouldn't use even a tenth of them.
And if they were sold to the orthodox churches, Hobert also felt it was inappropriate.
Before, when Hobert was alone, it was normal to exchange Beyonder characteristics for money.
But now that Hobert was the leader of a Beyonder organization, his thinking had also changed. Since there were such a large number of organized Beyonder characteristics, then why not form his own Beyonder forces belonging to that pathway?
Because Hobert didn't have a complete plan yet, he only said a general idea. Jonathan and Monica didn't understand Hobert's meaning, so they didn't take it too seriously.
"Before that, the members of the Theosophy Order can continue to live on the Shipyard Island." Hobert said, "If you want to buy a house in Jeffrey City, you can enjoy a 5% discount."
"If you want to buy a house and settle down in Longtail Island, you can enjoy a 40% discount."
"Of course, the premise of all this is that you must abide by the relevant local management. After registering with the government departments, you will all enjoy the rights that citizens should have."
The reason why the houses on Longtail Island were so cheap was mainly because Hobert's series of operations on the island had cut off the financial paths of many Loen people, and they were forced to leave Longtail Island.
Before leaving, they hoped to sell their real estate and assets that they couldn't take away, but at that time, most of the Loen people were leaving the island, and no one wanted these assets at all.
And the local natives didn't have much money.
So a large number of properties and assets were abandoned. The Governor-General's Office, which had conducted an asset census, of course, confiscated everything honestly and politely.
Jonathan and Monica were quite satisfied with the conditions given by Hobert.
For them, as long as they lived in South Colson or Longtail Island, they didn't have to worry about safety issues.
After sending away these two members of the Theosophy Order, Hobert's work came to an end. He took out his pocket watch and looked at it. It was already past three in the afternoon.
… …
Above the gray fog, in a palace that seemed to be used by giants.
This Tarot Gathering had reached the free exchange session.
"Justice" Audrey glanced at the empty "Emperor"'s seat and then asked towards the lower end of the bronze long table: "Mr. World, has the war initiated by the 'Creator' ended?"
Although she had already heard that Klein had appeared in Backlund today.
Then the war should have ended, and Duke Christian and Hobert should not have been seriously injured, otherwise Audrey would have definitely received the news.
But she still hoped to confirm it with "The World" here.
The others were also very curious about this matter. Among them, "The Star" Leonard in Backlund had already heard some news, but he didn't know the authenticity of those news.
The other members, besides the participating "Moon" Emlyn and the "Magician" Fors, who was responsible for some logistical work, had not yet received any relevant information.
Sitting at the lower seat, "The World" said in a hoarse voice, "The war is over."
"The Hermit" Cattleya asked, "Was it a victory?"
"The World" used his usual descriptive style, "From today onwards, the Demoness Sect's power in the Northern Continent will almost collapse, and many courtesans in various countries will disappear."
Everyone was somewhat surprised, each marveling at the power of this war in their hearts.
"The Hanged Man" Alger thought: If I hadn't received the news in advance, I would have found it hard to believe that a war could almost disintegrate a first-rate secret organization!
Audrey smiled slightly: This is the "Creator", this is Hobert! A force dedicated to fighting evil forces!
Then she thought: Mr. World also represented Mr. Fool's power in the war. This is another collaboration between two gods.
Cattleya recalled Mr. Fool's reminder last week: The era is changing because of this!
She thought: Clearly, the gods who will leverage the era in the future are Adam! It's the "Creator", it's Mr. Fool, these gods of the old era!
At this moment, Emlyn raised his chin and followed up, "From now on, the members of this organization can only carefully hide in corners to survive."
Everyone was slightly stunned, what's it got to do with "Moon"?
But everyone immediately realized: Mr. Moon also participated in the war!
Fors was already recalling the Sanguine members she had seen, wanting to find Mr. Moon among them.
But she quickly gave up, because the male members of the Sanguine all looked very arrogant, and many liked to raise their chins.
Alger then asked, "How many Beyonders did the 'Creator' side mobilize?"
"The World" seemed to recall for a moment before saying, "There are three Beyonder families loyal to the 'Creator', and an organization loyal to the 'Creator'."
The organization he was talking about was the Theosophy Order.
Because they were responsible for reconnaissance work in the battle, as well as support and logistics after the war began.
The key is that they are not like the members of the Element Dawn and the Temperance School, who would occasionally slack off. They were very attentive in this battle, so Klein mistakenly thought they were a force loyal to the "Creator".
"The World" continued: "There are also the Church of the Earth Mother, the Element Dawn, the Temperance School of the 'Rose School', and the Sanguine participating in the war, and there is also an organization that seems to have been established by the Trunsoest family."
The so-called "organization established by the Trunsoest family" refers to April's organization, because Hobert calls April mother, so Klein thought it was an affiliated organization of Trunsoest.
Everyone was very surprised by such a lineup!
Leonard was the first to ask, "The Church of the Earth Mother also participated in the war?"
"Yes," "The World" replied simply.
In Leonard's view, this was a war between two secret organizations. If a righteous god's church participated, then the nature would change.
As for the Element Dawn's participation, it was not surprising. After all, at the last Tarot Gathering, "The Emperor" had an appointment to meet "Queen Mystic".
When they heard about the Sanguine, everyone didn't have much reaction. Similarly, last week, "The Emperor" also threw out an alliance proposal to the Sanguine.
The Temperance School's participation was also reasonable. "The Emperor" had a deal with the Temperance School a long time ago.
And although "The World" did not explain, Mr. Fool's power must have also participated in the war under the leadership of "The World", after all, they are allies.
But when these very reasonable organizations are added together, it is very terrifying.
Cattleya roughly calculated that the "Creator" side alone should have about 600 Beyonders participating in the war.
Since entering the extraordinary world, she had never seen so many Beyonders in one battle.
Audrey asked curiously, "Mr. World, what was the specific battle situation like? Did any angel-level forces participate?"
"Yes!" "The World" replied, "When evacuating, I also went to the angel-level battlefield to see.
"There is a midsummer snowfield, and a bottomless rift valley!"
Everyone followed this description and tried to imagine how fierce the battle between angels was, but they soon realized that their minds lacked relevant material and they couldn't imagine the specific scene.
"The World" added: "In addition, the 'Creator' also took action and directly destroyed the Demoness Sect's headquarters."
Because at that time, he didn't dare to spread his spirituality, and Sharron was by his side, he didn't enter "the gray fog", and didn't know the specific battle situation.
So he thought that the corpse of the ancient death god participated in the war, which was the "Creator's" action.
The other members who were still thinking about the battle scenes of angels just now smiled in relief: After all, that is a god, it is normal to not imagine what kind of ability He has!
...
South Colson, Lord's Mansion.
Hobert came to the backyard, April's residence.
Her subordinates were arranged in hotels, only April lived in the Lord's Mansion.
The beautiful and dignified April was not surprised by Hobert's arrival. She asked with a smile, "Are you done?"
"Almost," Hobert said with a smile.
April nodded, she raised her hand, and a small hazy door appeared in the room.
This door opened, and a standing cabinet made of thorny bones, bigger than a wardrobe, came out of it.
Hobert's spirituality felt that this standing cabinet seemed to be a spirit world creature.
April snapped her fingers, and the cabinet door opened by itself. Inside was a crystal arch, the center of the arch was very illusory, and the space behind the arch could not be seen clearly.
"Try to put it in a closed space with nothing in it, and carry out further sealing," April said, "It will constantly lure the people around it into this door, and then send them to a corner of the universe.
"And there is a certain probability that it will be sent to the 'Primordial Moon'.
"I haven't figured out the other negative effects yet, you can explore it yourself, but be careful, it's best to have higher sequence helpers."
Hobert smiled and said, "Mother, this trophy..."
Before he could finish speaking, April smiled and said, "Just treat it as a return gift for your black jade."
"However, the trophies obtained by my subordinates should be handled in the auction house."
Then she spread her hands and said, "Our organization is a bit special. Although I can order them to fight, I don't have the power to make them hand over the trophies."
Hobert sighed: "This is beyond my expectations."
At noon, Hobert heard Fors mention that someone was handling the trophies. The auction house had already sent all the Beyonder characteristics they had received to Hobert.
For him, it was indeed beyond his expectations to be able to receive those trophies just by spending some money.
Originally, Hobert was going to promise some benefits, but listening to April's meaning, her subordinates didn't seem to want any benefits.
After chatting with April for a while, Hobert returned to the main hall in the front yard again.
His work was not over yet, but the rest was all praise for his own people.
Angus, Helen, Elliot, and Seel, who had been notified, came to the side hall together to offer the trophies.
The former three represented the Special Operations Department, and Seel represented the military.
This time, Hobert also arranged for the military's Beyonders to participate in the war, but they mainly took on the work of cleaning up the battlefield, which was to give them the opportunity to observe the battle of Beyonders.
After this period of development, the military already has three Sequence 7s, and there are already more than a dozen Sequence 8s and Sequence 9s, which is already a considerable Beyonder force.
Seel presented a lot of trophies, but they were basically obtained from the Demoness Sect's headquarters during the battlefield cleanup. They were all Beyonders killed by the corpse of the ancient death god.
There were only two trophies that belonged to them. Seel was not discouraged, because the military's Beyonders earned merit not in such battles. They are now basically earning merit in the battle against pirates.
Before the war, Angus and the other three obtained the temporary right to use a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact from the "Creator" through the arranged granting ceremony.
Each team also obtained the temporary right to use 5 level 2 sealed items, so the trophies turned in by the three of them were quite considerable.
It's just that there are no semi-god level trophies in it.
After converting their submitted trophies into relevant merits, Hobert said to Angus, "Your team has added ten more places, go back to the family to pick people these two days."
Angus nodded happily: "Yes!"
In this way, his subordinates reached a total of 35 people! This was larger than the scale of most Beyonder organizations established by wild demigods.
Hobert said to Helen, "When the time is right, I will launch a battle against the Mountain God Church, and you must lead the main force of the Second Team to participate!"
Helen smiled and said, "No problem!"
This was exactly what the members of the Second Team were looking forward to, after all, relying solely on investigating cases to earn merit was too slow.
Finally, Hobert said to Elliot, "Next, the eastern port where you are stationed will be opened, so the quota for your subordinates will also increase."
"This is the last time to replenish manpower from the Balk family, because the Balk family has accepted the 'Creator's' reorganization."
"If you want to replenish manpower in the future, you can only choose from the two research societies."
Elliot didn't know what Hobert's research society meant, but he was still very happy, after all, this was the family's long-standing expectation.
This made Angus and Helen very envious, because after this battle, they also hoped that their family or organization would be incorporated by the "Creator."
After the four of them left, Hobert sighed helplessly.
After the Tony family's team and the Tudor family's second team are formed, he will have to support 125 official Beyonders.
And that's not counting the fact that when the power of the Balk family completes its reorganization, this number is likely to exceed 200!
In terms of the current territory size, such an official force is too bloated.
However, these official Beyonders need to be trained in advance and make corresponding preparations in advance. Now, preparations must be made for the start of the war in the Northern Continent!
Hobert sighed: This is equivalent to an early investment.
Next, Hobert invited Mr. Dophis.
After taking his seat, Mr. Dophis handed over a Beyonder characteristic of the "Demoness of Despair", which was his only trophy from this battle.
Hobert smiled and said, "I have clues about the 'Ferryman' Beyonder characteristic here. If you need it, I can help you obtain it."
Now that the Artificial Death is gone, the Sealed Artifact obtained from killing the Feathered Serpent can be crushed into Beyonder characteristics for use.
In addition, Hobert also remembered that on the island he explored with Alger before, there was a stranded ghost ship, and the person on the ghost ship was also likely to be a "Ferryman" in a very strange state.
"I don't need it yet." As Dophis recovered more and more memories, his personality became more and more cold: "I need time to digest the potion."
Hobert asked, "How long do you think it will take to digest the potion?"
"Resurrect three times."
Hobert opened his mouth: "180 years later?"
He remembered that the interval between each resurrection of the "Undying" was 60 years.
Dophis said with a somewhat indifferent expression: "Perhaps the 'Creator' can help me digest the potion."
He explained: "As far as I know, Beyonders at the 'Prince of Abolition' level and above can 'tamper' with the interval between each death of the 'Undying' from 60 years to 60 days."
Hobert felt a little helpless in his heart: You probably can't imagine that the "Creator" is currently only Sequence 3.
However, he pondered it again, theoretically speaking, the level of the "Creator" should be enough, so it is worth a try: "Leave this to me, I will pray to the 'Creator' for help."
Dophis drank the tea in front of him and stood up and said, "Remember to call me if there are any more wars like this."
Then he said, "I'm going back to Backlund."
Without waiting for Hobert to reply, he had already left the side hall.
Hobert, who knew Dophis very well, could hear that the sentence he said when he got up was equivalent to expressing "I am at your disposal at any time" in a subtle way.
The last person Hobert met was Archibald.
The two people sat opposite each other, and Hobert smiled and said, "In the blink of an eye, we have worked together for more than half a year."
Archibald also sighed, "Yes, time really flies."
Hobert said, "This is thanks to the 'Creator' for sending me such a capable assistant."
"I am also very grateful for the grace of the 'Creator' who saved me back then." Archibald seemed to realize something and responded cautiously.
Hobert stood up: "Let us pray to the 'Creator' together."
"This is exactly what I expect."
So the two knelt together on the soft cushion and prayed to the "Creator."
Soon, Archibald felt the gaze from the "Creator."
In the past six months, Archibald had to pray to the "Creator" every few days to absorb the corruption on his body, so he was very familiar with the gaze of the "Creator."
This time, the "Creator" stared for a full seven or eight seconds before beginning to absorb the corruption from his body.
Those seven or eight seconds were when Hobert was staring at Archibald, to see if he had mutated because of such a long period of corruption, or if there was any arrangement from that little boy on him?
After careful observation, Hobert confirmed that there was only ordinary trace corruption on Archibald's body, and after it was completely absorbed, there would be nothing unusual.
Archibald felt that all the corruption on his body had been absorbed, and he excitedly said repeatedly: "Praise the Creator! Praise the Creator!"
After praising for more than ten seconds, he smiled at Hobert as if he had come back to his senses: "Thank you, 'Favored'."
After all, half a year ago, the "Creator" ordered Hobert to observe his character, and now that the "Creator" has completely removed the corruption from his body, of course Hobert made a relevant report.
"The main thing is that your performance in the past six months has gained the trust of the 'Creator'." Hobert smiled and said, "The 'Creator' has already issued a divine decree. From today onwards, you will officially become my deputy."
"Mainly responsible for war planning, army training and deployment, and the training of military Beyonders."
Archibald smiled and said, "I'm good at this."
Hobert asked again, "If you get another main ingredient of 'Scholar of Yore', can you be promoted to a real 'Scholar of Yore'?"
"Yes." Archibald said, "I mastered my own Beyonder characteristics not long after I was born."
Hobert nodded and said, "I have clues to another main ingredient of 'Scholar of Yore', and I will try my best to facilitate the relevant transaction."
Archibald immediately said: "I will always show my loyalty to the 'Creator' and to you."
Hobert nodded, this was a smart man.
After Archibald left, the work of dividing the spoils of war and rewarding his subordinates was also completely over.
Hobert breathed a long sigh of relief. He fought for a day yesterday, and today he spent another day with his nerves tense. After suddenly relaxing, he actually felt a little tired.
Looking at the sunset outside, Hobert showed a somewhat tired smile: After this battle, the "Creator" is qualified to divide the world.
...
Central Plateau, the destroyed headquarters of the Demoness Sect.
There was a priest wearing a simple white robe and with light golden stubble covering the lower half of his face. He looked very ordinary, so ordinary that no living being would notice him.
It was the "King of Angels" Adam.
He stood in front of the former stone statue of the "Primordial Demoness", looking at the rubble on the ground.
After a long time, he opened his mouth and said: "Where did He come from? Why does He look so abrupt in this world? Who gave Him the trajectory of fate to recreate the order of the world?"
...
Tuesday morning, South Colsen.
The West Bank's Picking Festival officially opened. Because of the popularity and surprises of the previous Tourism Festival, this Picking Festival once again attracted a large number of tourists.
The West Bank is not like the East Bank, with so many dense buildings. Here, more emphasis is placed on creating pastoral scenery.
The only thing that is not very harmonious with the pastoral scenery may be the long food street.
Klein arrived early, hesitating about what to eat first.
At this time, he saw a very familiar food, pork belly cooked with spices and a little aged vinegar, mixed with green peppers, and eaten in a round flatbread.
Klein was stunned: What the heck! Isn't this roujiamo sandwhich?
Could it be that this delicacy also comes from Roselle's notes?

The South Colson Harvest Festival was an eye-opener for members of various Beyonder organizations!
Another purpose of this Harvest Festival was actually a celebration of this victory.
Hobert had also long promised that all expenses of the participating members, including logistics personnel, on this day, as long as they were not deliberately wasteful, would be borne by the Lord's Manor.
So, apart from the Temperance Society, most members of other organizations stayed to take a look.
Firstly, they were amazed by the variety of food here, and the taste was also very good. They had never eaten many of these things before.
Secondly, they saw the form of selling agricultural products for the first time.
They actually let tourists pick their own produce in the fields. The vegetable farmers only weighed and collected money at the edge of the fields, and taught those who didn't know how to use farm tools how to harvest vegetables.
Many tourists didn't know that cabbages were chopped like this, potatoes were dug like this, the leaves of young corn could be so green, peppers could be so colorful, and cucumbers could be so tender on the vine...
Many city dwellers with children had a great time, and many nobles were also enjoying this kind of labor.
Moreover, most of the vegetables here were below market prices. As they dug and picked, the vegetables in people's hands became too much to carry.
At this time, the South Colson Lord's Manor provided two services: the first was vegetable recycling, and the second was vegetable storage and transportation.
The so-called vegetable recycling referred to recycling at wholesale prices.

Hobert took a big gulp of champagne, and continued to enjoy the nobles' unwillingness but helplessness.
After a while, Audrey and Earl Hall came back together.
Hobert knew from the expressions of the two that Earl Hall was not looking for Audrey just now, but had something to say to him, so he smiled and said: "Father in law..."
Earl Hall cleared his throat and said: "You should still call me Earl Hall."
This title sounds more reassuring.
Then he said seriously: "I have received some news that the Gas Association is preparing to submit a report to the parliament on restricting the development of the electric light industry."
Hobert was stunned: "What is the reason for their restriction?"
Earl Hall replied: "It is said to be environmentally unfriendly."
Hobert resisted the urge to twitch his mouth: Are my ears playing tricks on me?
