"Not environmentally friendly?" Hobert thought he had misheard. "Electricity isn't environmentally friendly?"
Earl Hall smiled. "It's said they saw such a large chimney at the power plant, emitting large amounts of white smoke every day, which apparently violates the current Atmospheric corruption Investigation Committee's relevant laws."
"Ah, I understand." Hobert nodded, a smile appearing on his face. "Clearly, it's a misunderstanding caused by their lack of understanding of how power plants operate."
Earl Hall, however, put away his smile and said, "Things are not that simple. I hope you can handle it carefully."
Hobert smiled. "Thank you for your reminder. At the latest by next week, 'Earl's Light' will have a response."
Earl Hall said nothing more, chatted with Hobert for a few more words, and then gave the central position of the ball back to Hobert and Audrey.
Watching her father leave, Audrey asked, "Hobert, is the power plant really causing a lot of pollution?"
Hobert smiled. "Do you have time tomorrow? How about I take you to visit the power plant?"
Audrey smiled helplessly. "Tomorrow might not work. Well, probably not for the next few days, because the elders in the family, and the elders on my mother's side, will probably come to inquire about our relationship. I have to entertain them."
Hobert nodded. "That's okay. We'll visit the power plant together next week."
He smiled and added, "Once you've visited the power plant, you'll know that their so-called environmental concerns are a complete joke."
"Or rather, whether it's environmentally friendly or not isn't their main point!"
"The main point is that the appearance of 'Earl's Light' has suddenly taken too much market share in the lighting industry. That's the main conflict between them and me."
Hobert took a deep breath and said, "Submitting a report to the council is just their first step, to gain some attention with it."
"I've even figured out what they'll do next. People will definitely die in Backlund because of electricity, and there will be many electrical accidents."
"Their goal is to use the fear of the unknown to suppress 'Earl's Light'."
Following this line of thought, Hobert suddenly realized that he was actually facing the entire gas industry's chain of interests, and the politicians who benefited from this industry.
With the wider application of electricity, conflicts with existing interest groups were almost inevitable.
They wouldn't think about who could better represent the future of humanity; they cared about their immediate interests.
This wasn't necessarily short-sightedness; it was just human nature.
Unless Hobert could publish all the current processes in the electricity industry, allowing the gas lamp industry to get a share of the pie in the electricity industry at a very low cost.
But for now, Hobert still needed to use "Earl's Light" to absorb massive amounts of funds to develop the Southern Continent's business. Before the next commercial action was fully rolled out, he didn't plan to release more of the monopolized technology.
Audrey listened to Hobert's analysis and asked with some worry, "Then what should we do?"
Hobert smiled. "There's nothing to worry about. Gas isn't without its safety hazards either."
He simply skipped the topic. "It seems you'll have to complete your advancement next week."
"Yes," Audrey said with some regret. "I'm just too busy this week."
"I have to be there when you advance."
Audrey smiled. "I know."
As they were chatting happily, some nobles excused themselves and left, and then many nobles followed suit.
Thus, the ball had to be stopped after only a few dances.
Hobert and Audrey also joined the ranks of seeing guests off. After seeing off most of the nobles, Hobert smiled and said, "It seems their congratulations just now were equivalent to farting."
Audrey said seriously, "Hobert, your language is very ungentlemanly."
Hobert nodded. "It's indeed not gentlemanly enough. Let me rephrase it: their congratulations just now were like releasing gas from the lower middle part of their bodies."
"Ah, it's good to have attended grammar school. You can describe it so appropriately."
Audrey covered her mouth and chuckled, then put her hand down and cleared her throat. "I don't care."
She said seriously, "Even if all of Backlund opposes our relationship, I don't care."
Hobert naturally put his hand on Audrey's waist, and while walking back to the ballroom, he said, "It's not that serious. Their departure at this time is probably just because they're afraid of losing face. Anyway, I don't take it to heart."
Returning to the entrance of the ballroom, Audrey pushed Hobert's hand off her waist. "I'm just afraid it will create more enemies for 'Earl's Light'."
"Don't worry," Hobert said confidently. "They don't know what the true meaning of 'Earl's Light' is."
Audrey was taken aback. "What is it?"
Hobert smiled. "You'll understand when you start working at 'Earl's Light'."
As they spoke, the two returned to the ballroom.
Many nobles who were close to Christian and Earl Hall hadn't left, as well as Hobert and Audrey's friend Viscount Glaint, and Baron Bradley, whom Hobert had saved before, among others.
Hebrew sighed, "I didn't expect them to be so lacking in gentlemanly conduct."
"I think we should have gentlemanly conduct in this regard," Hobert laughed. "They probably just can't accept that the 'Jewel of Backlund' has taken a liking to an ugly and poor brat."
"I think if they continued to stay here, they might really cry."
"So we should have gentlemanly conduct and let them go."
The young people laughed heartily together.
Hibbert also laughed a few times rather unkindly before saying, "Your sarcasm is really sharp!"
If Hobert was ugly and poor, then there would be no handsome and wealthy young people in Backlund.
Everyone held a small-scale dance party again, happily and lively until about ten o'clock in the evening before it ended.
Hobert, who returned to the Earl's mansion, fell asleep as soon as his head hit the pillow. His sleep had been very good these days.
On Friday, Hobert finally had time to rest for a day.
He spent most of his time by the window, staring blankly at the garden outside, only occasionally considering his next plan.
After resting for a day, Hobert felt his spirits were very high, so he went to MI9 to work on Saturday.
As soon as he arrived at the office, Hobert asked his secretary, Sharlene, to bring the files on the Aurora Order.
The Demoness Sect had been badly damaged, and they would definitely lie dormant for a while, making it difficult to launch new attacks against them in the short term.
Then it would naturally be the Aurora Order's turn.
There were many files about the Aurora Order, and it took two file room clerks to help move them all to Hobert's office.
Hobert looked at them for a while and found that most of these files were about the tragic cases created by members of the Aurora Order.
Moreover, he discovered that many cases were clearly not the Aurora Order's actions, but because they had not been solved for a long time, they had become the Aurora Order's doing.
Not only did these lunatics in the Aurora Order not defend themselves, but sometimes they would even take the blame for many cases.
So they became "scapegoats." Sometimes when MI9 did things that couldn't be seen in the light and had to find an explanation, they would also frame the Aurora Order.
Pushing aside the files on these types of cases, only a dozen files remained.
Hobert looked through them and found that the information about the Aurora Order's strongholds, personnel, etc., in Backlund was very detailed.
After a little thought, Hobert quickly understood that this should be the information that MI9 had obtained while cooperating with the Aurora Order.
Hobert carefully looked at the information about these Aurora Order members.
He planned to have Xio verify it, and then organize a wave of assassinations to see if he could lure out any big fish.
As for whether the Aurora Order could find out that the mastermind behind all this was Earl Hobert based on the information provided by MI9, that would be great. Hobert could sit back and wait for their demigod to come to his door to die.
The recent victory had increased the power that Hobert could control a lot, especially the three demigods of the Balk family, who could now be freely mobilized in the name of the "Creator."
The change this brought to Hobert was that before the war, he had to find opportunities to attack the Aurora Order while trying to avoid being noticed by them.
But now it was different. Hobert could openly investigate them and not be afraid of having a head-on conflict with them.
After such a change, Hobert suddenly discovered that he had many more methods at his disposal.
Hobert spent the entire morning reading the materials. After having lunch at MI9, he was about to continue reading the materials when Georgina suddenly pushed the door open.
Hobert put down the folder in his hand and smiled. "Chief, if there's anything, you can just have Sharlene convey it. Why did you come in person?"
As he spoke, he stood up and invited Georgina to sit on the sofa over there.
Georgina glanced at the files on Hobert's desk and asked, "I heard you're investigating the Aurora Order's files?"
"Yes," Hobert smiled. "The existence of these terrorists is a challenge to the peace of the entire Loen Kingdom."
"As a member of MI9, my sense of justice cannot tolerate their existence."
Georgina smiled and sat on the sofa. "Tell me the truth."
Hobert smiled. "I just got some information that the Aurora Order seems to have some connection with the Demoness Sect, so I wanted to investigate it."
This was the reason he had prepared long ago. Since they were cooperating with the Loen royal family, they must have some connection.
Georgina frowned. "Is there such a thing?"
"Yes."
However, Georgina didn't seem to care much about Hobert's answer. She asked again, "Actually, I'm very curious. Why are you so determined to eliminate the Demoness Sect?"
Hobert said meaningfully, "This is a goal, an order."
Georgina nodded thoughtfully. As for what she could think of, Hobert didn't care.
Then the duchess said again, "I'm going to hold a small ball next Friday. This is the invitation."
Hobert took the invitation. "You could have just had the secretary send it over."
Then he asked casually, "Who will be attending?"
"Some colleagues, a few friends, and a few members of the royal family."
Hobert smiled. "Thank you for your invitation. It's my honor."
Georgina got up and said as she walked out, "Oh, right, you'll be awarded a title next Wednesday. Remember to free up your time."
"Okay." Watching the chief leave, Hobert looked at the invitation in his hand again. He suddenly couldn't figure out if Georgina had come to test him or to deliver the invitation.
He shook his head and didn't think much about it, continuing to look at the materials in his hand.
After reading the materials in his hand, Hobert began to slack off.
In the evening, Hobert had nothing to do, so he locked the bedroom door early and came to the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert pulled over the pile of Beyonder characteristics and began to count the spoils of this war.
First of all, the level 0 and Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts had already been classified.
Moreover, the news that the Demoness Sect had an angel who "cut off its tail to survive" and that the "Demoness of Black" had died was not announced in the externally released war report.
So only Hobert knew the specific situation of these two spoils for the time being.
In addition, there was also a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, the crystal archway that Aipoli had given Hobert.
The only use of this archway might be to put it on the battlefield during battle and let some enemies who couldn't resist the temptation drill into it themselves.
Although it had the ability to roam the cosmos, there was a certain probability that it would be sent to the "Primordial Moon," which, for Hobert, was tantamount to courting death.
So, in Hobert's opinion, it would be better to crush this Sealed Artifact into Beyonder characteristics when needed.
In addition to this archway, there were also 9 Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts in terms of Sealed Artifact spoils.
These Sealed Artifacts came from the Demoness of Pleasure Council and the seizures from Angus and others.
After naming the crystal door "1-112," Hobert went to check the mountains of Beyonder characteristics.
It was not an exaggeration to use mountains of them this time, after all, there were nearly 300 Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert quickly classified them. Among them, there were 62 Beyonder characteristics of the "Door" pathway, 218 Beyonder characteristics of the "Witch" pathway, and 9 Beyonder characteristics of the "Hunter" pathway.
The Beyonder characteristics of the "Door" pathway were 1 "Secrets Sorcerer," 7 "Traveler," 23 "Scribe," and 31 "Astrologer" Beyonder characteristics.
No "low-sequence" Beyonder characteristics were seized, because no "low-sequence" Beyonders participated in this war from the Demoness of Pleasure Council.
The Beyonder characteristics of "Secrets Sorcerer" and "Traveler" were seized in the raid on Jeffrey City, and the other characteristics were seized from the front lines.
It could be said that the Demoness of Pleasure Council existed in name only after this battle. Perhaps a "Scribe" was the top combat power of the Demoness of Pleasure Council.
After classifying these Beyonder characteristics, Hobert waved his hand, and all the Beyonder characteristics of the "Hunter" and "Witch" pathways came before him.
The Beyonder characteristics of the "Hunter" pathway were 1 "Reaper," 1 "Conspirer," 3 "Pyromaniac," 3 "Provoker," and 1 "Hunter" Beyonder characteristic.
The "low-sequence" Beyonder characteristics were basically seized from the headquarters of the Demoness Sect.
According to the reports from Seel and others who cleaned up the battlefield, there were not only "low-sequence" Beyonders there, but also hundreds of servants such as chefs and coachmen.
None of them were spared, and they had already died the moment the corpse of the Ancient Death descended.
The members of the Demoness Sect had already sealed the fate of these ordinary people when they chose not to evacuate them before the war.
Hobert refocused and continued counting the spoils of war.
The spoils from the "Witch" pathway included 1 'Demoness of Unaging' characteristic, 9 'Demoness of Despair' characteristics, 19 'Demoness of Affliction' characteristics, 62 'Demoness of Pleasure' characteristics, 75 'Witch' characteristics, 33 'Instigator' characteristics, and 19 'Assassin' characteristics.
Looking at these spoils, Hobert estimated that they had wiped out about 70-80% of the Demoness Sect's middle management.
Even if they had the corresponding and sufficient Beyonder characteristics, it would take them at least three to five years to recover.
Moreover, they likely didn't have any Beyonder characteristics that could rapidly restore their strength, so it could be said that it would take them centuries to recover.
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled, very satisfied with the effect of the blow.
He glanced at the pile of Beyonder characteristics in front of him, which was precisely why he wanted to use them to build his own extraordinary force.
Because there were simply too many, even if Helen's team of 25 people ate them like meals, they couldn't finish them all.
Hobert couldn't just give them to Jonathan and the others for no reason, especially since he hadn't yet incorporated the Demoness of Pleasure Council.
Furthermore, Jonathan and the others had dual affiliations with the Abraham family and the Demoness of Pleasure Council, so their recognition of the 'Creator's' subordinates would be weaker.
Hobert wasn't comfortable with incorporating them on a large scale.
So, it was better to simply build his own force, even though it would be more troublesome, it was an investment for the future.
Next, Hobert was troubled by the problem of potion formulas.
The 'Door' pathway potion formulas could still be obtained from Fors, but what about the 'Witch' pathway potion formulas?
It should be known that one of the reasons the Tony family gave up these Beyonder characteristics was the difficulty in obtaining potion formulas.
Hobert sighed.
He could trade for relevant potion formulas from the Demoness of Pleasure Council, but it was unlikely they would have the complete 'Demoness of Despair' potion formula.
For a long time to come, the Demoness Sect would rarely appear in people's sight, and the chances of obtaining potion formulas would be even less.
Just as he was thinking about this, he suddenly had a bold idea.
So, Hobert took an 'Instigator' Beyonder characteristic in his hand: 'Connection!'
Immediately, knowledge of dark magic and the 'Instigator' potion formula appeared in his mind: 'Sequence 8: Instigator'
'Main ingredients: the heart of a Demon Throat Honey, the venom sac of a Dark Lurker.'
'Supplementary ingredients: 100ml of pure water, the syrinx of a Demon Throat Honey, 5 drops of blue datura juice, 10g of water fern powder, one walnut without the peel.'
Hobert was first stunned, then smiled: It really works!
Theoretically speaking, within the Beyonder characteristics that haven't been crushed, there are traces of the previous owner's spirit.
Klein, in the 'Sefirah Castle', could use these spiritual remnants to divine the corresponding potion formula.
Although Hobert couldn't divine, he could create a 'Connection'!
After all, the connection between Beyonder characteristics and potion formulas was very high!
So, he quickly started from Sequence 9 'Assassin', 'Connecting' from bottom to top, all the way to 'Demoness of Affliction', and it was all very successful.
But when connecting to the Sequence 4 'Demoness of Despair' potion formula, he only 'Connected' to the advancement ritual and one of the main ingredients.
Hobert realized: In other words, I can only 'Connect' to potion formulas below the demigod level!
But that's enough, because after advancing to Sequence 2, I will definitely be able to 'Connect' to the demigod-level potion formula, and by that time, the extraordinary force I've established probably won't need that level of potion formula.
In a cheerful mood, he categorized the Beyonder characteristics in front of him.
Following the idea of potion formulas, Hobert suddenly thought of Klein's 'Scholar of Yore' potion formula problem.
Hobert smiled and said to himself: I wonder if Klein will feel very regretful next time at the Tarot Gathering, when I tell him that he can obtain the potion formula from the Evernight Goddess, and wonder why he didn't think of this before?
Hobert also thought that he remembered the main ingredients of the 'Scholar of Yore', which were the eyes of a Hound of Fulgrim and the heart of a Demonic Wolf of Fog.
He also thought: I might as well tell Klein the two main ingredients, after all, even just a portion of a potion formula at this level is very valuable!
Thinking of this, Hobert suddenly had an inspiration: I wonder if 'Connecting' these two main ingredients in my mind can 'Connect' to some other information?
On the principle of trying it out without losing anything, he 'Connected' the two main ingredients of 'Scholar of Yore'.
What he didn't expect was that he immediately received a lot of information: 'Sequence 3: Scholar of Yore'
'Main ingredients: a pair of eyes of a Hound of Fulgrim (also known as the Guardian of the Sefirah Castle) + one transformed heart of a Demonic Wolf of Fog.'
'Supplementary ingredients: 100ml of Hound of Fulgrim blood + 30g of Demonic Wolf of Fog frost crystals + a large number of authentic ancient historical records.'
'Ritual: Completely detach from reality for at least three hundred years, and take the potion after you have become history and no longer belong to the current era.
The essence of the ritual is to eliminate distractions and provide a clear and accurate positioning mark for oneself to become an "Scholar of Yore", preventing one from getting lost.'
This was actually the complete potion formula for 'Scholar of Yore'!
This result surprised Hobert a bit; just knowing the main ingredients could connect to the complete potion formula?
Immediately Hobert realized: It's not like that, these potion formulas were originally in my mind!
He quickly understood that this was some information he had seen when reading books before.
But even as an avid book fan, it was impossible for him to memorize the complete potion formula, only the two impressive main ingredients were remembered by him!
Now, using Beyonder means, he restored this information that he had once seen but not remembered from his mind!
Hobert smiled unconsciously: This is a huge treasure!
There are quite a few potion formulas that appeared in the original book.
Following this line of thought, Hobert 'recalled' a lot of key information.
For example, Klein's transformed heart of the Demonic Wolf of Fog was also obtained from the Evernight Goddess.
When Hobert first thought of this, he didn't have much of an impression.
Now it seemed that because this matter involved the Evernight Goddess, there was a hidden interference, and Hobert couldn't remember it.
But now, firstly, Hobert's level was higher, and secondly, he had the 'guidance' of the Evernight Goddess, and he could also present a hidden state at certain times, so he 'recalled' this matter.
The train of 'recollection' seemed like a flood that had burst its banks, and Hobert recalled more and more things from before his transmigration.
He was surprised to find that there were obvious gaps in his memory of before his transmigration, even though he had recalled many things now, the gaps in his memory were still very obvious.
For example, Hobert racked his brains, but couldn't remember what he did before he transmigrated?
But another puzzling thing was that when he explored the nameless island with Alger last year and encountered cultural elements of the elves, he could connect them with some knowledge gained from his work.
Also, when preparing for the auction house, he also remembered watching a lot of videos about auctions because of his work.
But he just couldn't remember what his job itself was.
Hobert realized that the problem was not small!
The biggest problem was not that his memory was missing, but that he hadn't realized that his memory was obviously missing before!
Hobert suddenly thought of some of Amon's clone's previous words, as well as the relevant descriptions of Trunsoest.
This should be related to the person who changed his destiny, or rather, that existence!
But he didn't have a clue now.
Hobert sighed: There's no other way, I can only work hard to advance to find new clues.
Moreover, when facing the unknown forces in this world, thinking too much is useless, but it will affect your state because you think too much.
So, Hobert simply stopped thinking about it, and instead picked up the 'Black Emperor' card on the armrest of the 'Iron Throne' and looked at the last few pages.
He mainly looked at the rituals for Sequence 2 and Sequence 1.
The ritual for Sequence 2 was: Trigger a chaos involving all levels of society in a world-renowned large city, and use the unique and unprecedented new order proposed by the advancing person to quell the chaos.
Drink the potion amidst the confusion and helplessness brought to people by this chaos, and the unwillingness of people to accept the new order.
Regarding this ritual, Hobert already had some ideas when he decided to found 'Earl's Light'.
He was going to establish a new company, which would research and produce telephones, motors, radios, phonographs, electric cars, refrigerators, and a series of electrical products, thereby setting off an electrical revolution!
Currently, the mere popularization of electric lights had already caused dissatisfaction in the gas industry.
In the next period of time, Hobert would definitely have a series of struggles with them, and Hobert was confident of winning.
After he won, it would definitely bring huge chaos to the entire gas industry.
And with the application of various electrical appliances and plastic products, it would have a considerable impact on the lives of the residents of Backlund, which in turn would affect the upstream and downstream industries of all walks of life, and corresponding chaos would occur in all levels of society.
But because electrical appliances were more convenient and had more functions, once such a wave formed, no individual could stop it.
At that time, whether everyone was willing or not, they could only be forced to accept the wave of the times.
This was less risky than planning a rebellion in Loen and establishing a new order, and it could use such a wave to plunder most of the wealth created by the Northern Continent over the past hundred years, and then use it in the country established in the Southern Continent.
The role it could play was also greater than launching a coup.
Because even if Hobert used a coup to become the King of Loen, he would be restrained by the Church.
Hobert was very clear that the Evernight Goddess's investment in him now was not to let him have a conflict of interest with the Church of the Evernight Goddess in the future.
In terms of dominance, Hobert would certainly not bow to theocracy, so the moment he became king, he might have to be prepared to break with the Church.
So far, none of those who opposed the Seven Gods, or rather, the gods, had a good ending, and Hobert certainly didn't want to be the next one.
So, establishing a country in the Southern Continent was the best solution.
In addition, tonight, Hobert discovered that his marriage with Audrey could complete the last step of this ritual.
The sense of smell of the nobles was quite keen.
After Hobert made the first wave of money using electrical appliances, the nobles would definitely rush to invest in the electricity industry.
At that time, the nobles and the wealthy may not fall into chaos, but may instead be a huge opportunity.
But in the matter of Hobert marrying Audrey, it was enough to make many nobles in Backlund envious, angry, and hateful, but in the end, they could only accept it helplessly.
Although it was not the same as the electrical revolution, it could allow Backlund's most leisurely noble class to fall into a certain amount of chaos because of Hobert.
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled, withdrew his thoughts, and looked at the relevant description of Sequence 1: "Sequence 1: Prince of Abolition'
'Main ingredients: A Beyonder characteristic of Prince of Abolition.'
'Supplementary ingredients: 30 grams each of five specialties of the advancer that the people can Connection with.'
'Ritual: Overthrow the rule of a country, or establish a country through rebellion.
Create a set of systems in the established country that violates the common sense of this world, and establish a culture and order that is difficult for everyone in the territory to accept.'
This was also why Hobert had to build a country, because when he reached Sequence 1 'Prince of Abolition', he must have his own country.
In addition, this ritual reminded Hobert of the 'United Empire' of the Fourth Epoch.
Trunsoest and Tudor betrayed Solomon and jointly established the 'United Empire'.
Hobert was not very clear about the system practiced by the 'United Empire', but he knew that the architectural style of the Fourth Epoch had always been known for its asymmetry.
Just like the tower that Hobert had seen on another planet, the left side was one style, and the right side was another style.
It looked as if two buildings with completely different styles each took half and stuck them together.
This was a culture that was difficult for people to accept.
Of course, after decades, the people got used to it, but in the beginning, all the people should find it difficult to accept.
This kind of asymmetry seemed to be popular in the Solomon Empire era, but the Solomon Empire did not control the entire Northern Continent.
At that time, the God Kingdoms of the Seven Gods were not like the headquarters of the Church as they are now.
At that time, there were really seven countries!
After the establishment of the 'United Empire', it basically controlled all the territory of the Northern Continent, and at this time, the asymmetrical style spread in the original God Kingdoms of the Seven Gods.
The rituals for Trunsoest and Tudor to advance to Sequence 1 were basically completed.
No wonder the two of them completed their advancement not long after the rebellion.
It turned out that their rebellion was equivalent to completing half of the ritual.
Hobert sighed: This is really a pathway without a sense of security!
It was also quite difficult for Hobert to build a country through rebellion, because it was a rebellion rather than a coup.
First of all, he had to be loyal to the ruler of a country before rebelling.
It was difficult to do just to be accepted by the ruler, and it might take a lot of time and benefits.
Even the Kingdom of Loen and the Kingdom of Feynapotter could not completely accept Hobert, because he still had the label of 'Creator's' favored one.
So, it would be better to overthrow the rule of a country, and Hobert had already found one: the Highland Kingdom in the Southern Continent, ruled by the "Rose School."
Currently, the colonization by the four countries of the Northern Continent has not completely eliminated the Bayonne Empire and the Highland Kingdom; they each still have a lot of territory and population.
It's just that these two countries have been suffering from economic plunder by the Northern Continent.
When the time comes, launch a Beyonder war that can destroy a country, completely defeat the rule of the Highland Kingdom, and the ritual will be half completed.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert re-examined the general plan, plundering the Northern Continent with the electricity revolution, and then using the plundered wealth to quickly establish a country.
After taking another look at the spoils of this battle, Hobert left the "Nation of Disorder."
Returning to the real world, he was still not sleepy, so he began to consider how to digest the potion.
The ritual for "Duke of Entropy" was already considered, but the potion for "Frenzied Mage" had just begun to be digested.
The method of launching a Beyonder war could only make the potion show signs of digestion, but not the kind of obvious digestion.
Hobert estimated that launching an ordinary war, and it must be the kind that enters another country's territory and brings great disaster to the people of that country, might greatly digest the potion, after all, that would be chaotic enough.
Thinking of this, he shook his head, feeling that launching a war was not the right idea, after all, it was "Frenzied Mage," not "War Bishop."
Based on previous experience, Hobert believed that the key to digesting the potion should mainly be on the "frenzy" aspect, and the magician might just be a title.
For example, Klein's "Magician," Hobert remembered that he mainly focused on playing the "deception" part, and did not consider playing the "magician" part.
The magician in Hobert's concept is not the kind who conjures fireballs, but the kind who eats vegetarian food, chants Buddhist scriptures, and knocks on wooden fish.
It seems that playing either of these two roles doesn't quite grasp the key point.
So, how should "frenzy" be acted?
Hobert thought of the previous acting directions of "Earl of the Fallen" and "Mentor of Disorder," and felt that his "frenzy" might be one aspect.
The main thing should be to make the people in the territory become "frenzy," or to make others become "frenzy," which might be the right direction.
Hobert smiled slightly. Next, there was a very good experiment on Longtail Island that could test whether this direction was correct.
Finally, Hobert thought of the problem of Trunsoest. He planned to also consult Klein separately at the Tarot Gathering the day after tomorrow to see if he had any good ideas.
...
On Sunday morning, Hobert originally planned to rest for a day, but Allen, the butler from the Jeffrey City Lord's Mansion, came through the "Traveler's Gate" to report that Special Envoy of King Ferdinand II of Feynapotter had arrived, requesting Hobert to personally receive them.
Hobert was not surprised by this and came to the Lord's Mansion through the "Traveler's Gate."
Entering the main hall of the front yard, Hobert saw that the King's Special Envoy was actually the heroic Princess Ethel, wearing a women's swallowtail coat.
She smiled and said, "Congratulations on your victory. The Kingdom of Feynapotter also deeply hates these secret organizations and has been working hard to combat evil organizations. The victory you have achieved is also what we hope to see.
"For this reason, the King asked me to express my condolences to the warriors of this battle and to reward you personally."
The so-called reward mainly relaxed the policies on South Colson and transported many supplies.
Although the Kingdom of Feynapotter had not explicitly stipulated to isolate South Colson, it had stipulated many high-tech and products that could not be sold to South Colson in commerce, scholars at the level of university professors could not go to South Colson, and restricted the commodities of the South Colson area, etc.
In short, almost only tourists could still enter and exit South Colson normally. Other goods and people had almost some restrictions and regulations.
In addition, there were a large number of troops and Beyonder forces stationed on the two main roads in and out of South Colson.
Basically, it was treated as a country within a country.
Now these regulations have all been lifted, and the garrison has basically withdrawn.
The second reward was a financial appropriation, preparing to build a railway directly from Feynapotter to Jeffrey City, and all the expenses incurred in the construction of the railway on the South Colson side would be borne by the royal family.
Moreover, the royal family also very considerately gave Hobert the power to decide how to construct the South Colson section of the railway and who to entrust with the construction.
Hobert expressed his gratitude and said that he would organize manpower as soon as possible to carry out the railway planning work.
Building a railway is also very good, which can better connect the South Colson area with the outside world, and tourists can also take the train instead of just traveling by boat.
Hobert entertained Princess Ethel well and took her to visit the completed Jeffrey City, and they seemed to enjoy themselves.
When the two were having lunch, Princess Ethel whispered, "About what we talked about before, the members of the Castiya family hope to believe in the 'Creator'. Has the 'Creator' responded?"
Hobert smiled and said, "Not yet. I will help you mention this matter when I pray next time."
Although he could hear that what Ethel said this time was not a test, he currently did not need believers from the Castiya family, so he was not interested in this.
Although Ethel was a little disappointed, she did not mention this matter again.
That afternoon, the princess left by boat. When boarding the ship, she invited Hobert, who had come to the pier to see her off, to hunt at her manor.
Hobert agreed casually and didn't take it too seriously.
After seeing Ethel off, Hobert stayed at the Lord's Mansion for one night.
At noon on Monday, he came to Greenlawn Manor and saw Fors as expected.
Because they had already had lunch together before, Hobert stayed for lunch today and was not driven away by Fors.
After lunch, Hobert continued to chat with Fors, with no intention of leaving.
Fors said a little helplessly, "It's almost time for the Tarot Gathering."
"I would have forgotten if you didn't say so." Hobert said, lying on the bed: "What are you waiting for? Come lie down, do you want to participate in the Tarot Gathering standing up?"

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 610: Exciting Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert smiled at Fors and said, "Come on, it's not your first time attending the Tarot Gathering, what are you being shy about?"
Fors was a little speechless: "I'm not shy, it's just that you're occupying my bed!"
Hobert lay on the bed, crossing his legs: "It's almost three o'clock in two minutes. What if I don't make it back to the Lord's Mansion in time? Would you have the heart to let me stand during the Tarot Gathering?
"Besides, the risk of standing during the Tarot Gathering is too high. What if someone discovers me and ambushes me?"
He paused and added, "We're attending the Tarot Gathering, not doing anything else."
Fors thought that made sense, but as soon as she sat on the edge of the bed, she felt something was wrong again: "Who told you to keep hanging around? You just now..."
"Alright, alright, it's almost three o'clock, lie down quickly!" As he spoke, Hobert gently pulled Fors.
Fors glanced at the clock, and it was indeed almost three o'clock, so she reluctantly lay down.
Watching the sun outside the window being obscured by clouds for a while, and then emerging from the clouds again.
Hobert yawned: "What a great time for an afternoon nap."
Fors also yawned and stared blankly at the sky outside.
The two of them quietly watched the outside, enjoying the tranquility of the moment.
Suddenly, Hobert took Fors's hand. Just as Fors was about to pull it back, her vision was covered by gray fog. When she came back to her senses, she was already sitting on one side of the bronze long table.
Fors raised her hand, preparing to say something to Hobert, but suddenly realized that now was not the time to say anything, so she could only sigh with a helpless expression.
"Good afternoon! Mr. Fool~" "Justice" Audrey was sitting in the same direction as Fors. She only saw Hobert smile, but she didn't see Fors's hesitation.
So her greeting was not affected in any way.
After Audrey greeted everyone, the Tarot Gathering officially began.
"Hermit" Cattleya first said to "Fool" Klein at the head of the table, "Respected Mr. Fool, I still haven't received any of Emperor Roselle's diaries this week."
Klein was slightly stunned. He clearly saw "Queen Mystic" Bernadette from afar at the South Colson Harvest Festival last week. She didn't seem very busy at the time!
After thinking for a moment, first of all, Klein ruled out the possibility that the other party no longer had Roselle's diary. Combining the contents of the previous diaries, he suspected whether the diary that Bernadette was about to provide next was very important, very crucial, or extraordinarily special, which was why the "Queen Mystic" was hesitant?
That must be it! After Klein roughly had an idea in his mind, he nodded slightly and said, "Don't worry."
Then he smiled and said, "You can begin."
Then Klein immediately asked "World": "I have two items for sale, both of which are relatively low-level."
Cattleya said, "Low-level doesn't mean useless. Many low-sequence abilities can even turn the tide in Sequence 5 battles."
"World" nodded lightly and explained the effects and negative effects of the "Murloc Cufflink" and the "Green Radiance" ring.
The former was a mystical item that Klein obtained when he was an adventurer in the Berserk Sea. It allowed him to move freely underwater for 10 minutes, and illusory scales would appear on his body, making him as difficult to catch as a fish.
The latter was a mystical item obtained from the Marionette Enzo, which could treat minor illnesses and external injuries.
These two mystical items were indeed not high-level, but their abilities were good.
So Klein added some premium: "'Murloc Cufflink' 500 pounds, 'Green Radiance' 1000 pounds."
"Magician" Fors immediately said, "I want them both."
Almost at the same time, Audrey also said, "I want the 'Murloc Cufflink'."
The two looked at each other. Audrey, who was always very modest, didn't want to give in at this time: "I'll add 150 pounds!"
Fors also felt that "Justice's" attitude towards her seemed to have changed a lot since the last few gatherings.
She had even guessed whether this noble lady from Backlund was Audrey?
Regardless, Fors was unwilling to give in at this time: "I'll also add 150 pounds, 800 pounds!"
Audrey immediately said, "I'll add 200 pounds! 1000 pounds!"
Klein was a little dumbfounded. He controlled "World" and asked, "Are you serious?"
But the two ladies ignored "World". Fors said, "I'll add 300 pounds!"
Audrey: "I'll add..."
"I'll add 200 pounds!" Hobert quickly said, "1500 pounds!"
As he spoke, he winked at "World" repeatedly. Klein understood and immediately said, "Deal."
Then Klein thought to himself: What was going on just now? Why could a Sequence 9-level mystical item sell for such a high price of 1500 pounds? "Justice" and "Magician" are acting a little strange.
Because the news of Hobert and Audrey's relationship was not published in the newspaper, Klein didn't know about it.
The other members were also a little strange, wondering why the two ladies were fighting over this "Murloc Cufflink".
To avoid a new round of disputes, Hobert simply said, "I want the 'Green Radiance' ring too, 1200 pounds!"
Without needing to wink again, "World" immediately said, "Deal!"
Cattleya keenly felt: Does "Emperor" know why Miss "Justice" and Miss "Magician" are arguing? Why would he know?
"Hanged Man" Alger also realized: What are these two ladies arguing about? Could it be that they both took a fancy to these two mystical items? No way, these aren't particularly scarce mystical items. Or are they acquainted in the real world? What kind of conflict happened in the real world?
At this time, although Fors didn't look at "Justice", she had some guesses in her heart: "Justice" is Audrey! She, she's a "Spectator", so she recognized me a long time ago.
She glanced at Hobert: Does he know that "Justice" is Audrey? Am I the only one who doesn't know this?
At this time, Audrey also calmed down. She first said "Sorry", and then said meaningfully, "I really wanted to have it."
She could give in on other things. She could be a lady, she could show her magnanimity, but she was unwilling to give in on this matter.
Fors also said, "I really want to have it too."
"Moon" Emlyn on the opposite side smiled and said, "Ladies, you're using the wrong word. It's 'it', not 'him'."
But then he found that he was the only one laughing, and the "Emperor" next to him was looking at him with unfriendly eyes.
Alger crossed his arms: Could it be that these two ladies in the real world have both fallen in love with the same man?
Klein also seemed to have guessed something: This doesn't seem like a choice that Miss "Justice" would make. Or did Hobert force her to make this choice? Hehe, scumbag!
To avoid this topic from continuing, Hobert immediately said to "World": "I've prepared your reward. I didn't expect that the 'Creator' actually had something you needed."
Klein naturally knew that Hobert was talking about the "Scholar of Yore" potion formula: "Let's communicate separately."
After establishing a separate communication environment, Klein said, "Does the 'Creator' know where to obtain the 'Scholar of Yore' potion formula?"
Then he smiled and explained, "Now I'm only missing the potion formula."
The implication was that Mr. Fool had already prepared the main ingredients for him, and finding the potion formula was just another test for him.
Hobert first breathed a sigh of relief, and then, promoting the spirit of "life is hard, don't expose it", smiled helplessly: "I understand, I'm in a similar situation to you."
Then he said, "I obtained the complete 'Scholar of Yore' potion formula from the 'Creator'."
"World" was stunned, somewhat surprised: "Complete potion formula?"
"I was also quite surprised when I obtained the formula," Hobert said truthfully. "I can tell you the complete formula, but because the value of the formula is too high, you must pay something more in order for our transaction to be equal."
Klein thought that Hobert's request was very reasonable, so he manipulated "World" and said, "Okay, what do you need?"
"I need a favor from you in the future," Hobert said. "With the help of the 'Creator', I finally learned the truth about the family curse.
"It turned out to be a resurrection method left in the bloodline by Night Emperor Trunsoest! When I advance to Sequence 2, He will revive in my body!"
Klein was somewhat surprised: True Gods are indeed not that easy to kill!
He immediately asked with "World": "How can I help?"
"I don't know either," Hobert said with a wry smile. "Because I haven't thought of a solution to the problem yet."
Then he said, "The thing is, back then, Trunsoest and Queen 'Beauty Goddess' Auernia changed the spiritual bodies and physical bodies of their descendants..."
Hobert briefly explained the problems he encountered, and how his father had tried to use changing his fate to fight against the family curse, but now his fate could no longer be changed.
Finally, he said, "You also help me think of a way. If I need your help, you have to help me solve Trunsoest."
"Okay," Klein agreed, and then the eyes of "Fool" and "World" were fixed on Hobert: "Your descendants are very much like Doppelgangers who are always ready to carry the Night Emperor's consciousness!"
Hobert thought he had misheard: Klein is too careless, right? How could he say words like "Doppelganger"?
But then Hobert realized that Klein was staring at him: Damn it! This guy is observing my reaction.
He quickly showed a slight confusion: "Doppelganger? What does that mean?"
Klein smiled: "It's nothing."
From "World's" perspective: Hobert had a moment of panic and evasiveness just now.
And "Fool" discovered through observing Hobert's astral body that Hobert was lying just now.
Klein was certain that Hobert also knew what avatars were.
Then he thought: If he heard it from the "Creator", he could completely admit it openly, but he was eager to deny it, which means that he himself knew it, and didn't hear it from the "Creator".
Finally, Klein thought: So... hehe.
He said, "I will definitely help when the time comes."
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth: This kid actually ambushed me! But where did I expose myself? He obviously believes that I am a transmigrator.
Then he realized: The time was relatively tight just now, my handling was very problematic, I shouldn't have denied it immediately. If Klein was really testing me, I have already exposed myself.
So he said, "It's good that you know."
Klein controlled "World" and nodded. He understood that this secret was the deepest level of secret for both of them. Saying it too clearly would put a psychological burden on them. It would be better to completely open up when needed.
At the same time, of course he also knew that while testing Hobert, he had also exposed himself.
But now, in his eyes, Klein is just an identity.
If necessary, he can completely create a new identity, an identity that Hobert has no way of knowing.
At worst, he won't let "World" participate in the Tarot Gathering. Hobert can't possibly connect Klein with "The Fool".
So Klein felt that it was worth taking such a risk to test Hobert, because being truly aware of Hobert's background means that in some things, others may not be trusted, but Hobert can be completely trusted. There's no need to be so restrained anymore.
Hobert sighed in his heart: I didn't expect that this Tarot Gathering would expose a layer of disguise right from the start.
He also felt that this was a good thing. At least the common identity of transmigrator is more reliable than the identity of "Fool's Believer" at a critical moment.
But it's enough to just reach this level. The identities of Klein being "Fool" and Hobert being "Creator" cannot be revealed for the time being! Otherwise, everyone will feel awkward if we participate in a Tarot Gathering.
Klein pondered for a moment and manipulated "World" to say, "Is there anything or anyone that Trunsoest is particularly afraid of?"
Hobert was stunned for a moment before realizing that his previous train of thought seemed to be a bit biased. He was always thinking about finding loopholes from fate, his own pathways, and Trunsoest's arrangements.
This is typical "Lawyer" thinking, while Klein's method is typical "Seer" thinking: If I'm not the target's opponent, then the enemy of my enemy is my friend!
"Speaking of what he's afraid of... I can't say he's afraid, but there are people who make Him wary!" Hobert smiled: "It's the little boy in the bounty I released earlier!
"But the problem is, the little boy is also very dangerous to me. If I'm not careful, I will also..."
Speaking of this, Hobert had some ideas: "I may ask you to help contain the little boy at that time. He is currently only at Sequence 4, which should not be difficult for you to deal with."
"World" said in a hoarse voice: "No problem."
Hobert straightened his back and stretched it slightly. The matter of Trunsoest has put a lot of pressure on him during this period. Today, he finally has a good idea, and his body and mind are relaxed a lot.
Then he asked Mr. Fool to help him materialize the "Scholar of Yore" potion formula.
After "World" looked through the formula, Hobert said again, "I also want to initiate a transaction with you, using the 'Tyrant' card in exchange for a pair of Hound of Fulgrim's eyes."
Klein suddenly thought of Archibald, the chief of staff he had seen at the Lord's mansion: There are also Beyonders of the "Seer" pathway among the subordinates of the "Creator"! Is he also about to advance to Sequence 3?
After a little thought, Klein immediately nodded and said, "When I acquire Beyonder materials, I will try my best to complete this transaction."
At this time, he regretted a bit that he had spoken too confidently just now, and the acquisition of Beyonder materials could no longer go through the "Creator's" path.
Hobert said, "Okay."
He thought to himself: For you, as long as you broaden your horizons, this is not a difficult task.
Just as Hobert thought the private exchange was about to end, "The World" suddenly asked again, "Do you have any information about the 'Abyss'?"
Hobert was stunned: "I do have some here."
He was a little strange, why did Klein suddenly need information about the 'Abyss'?
Then Hobert said again, "Because of some of my experiences, I even have some real-time information about the 'Abyss', but it's quite valuable and needs to be traded."
"Okay," "The World" said, "I will initiate a transaction after the private exchange ends."
A few days ago, when he was dealing with the uncontrolled demigod of the Jacob family, he encountered Amon's avatar, which made him realize that he needed to make some preparations to avoid being caught off guard when encountering Amon's avatar.
Klein remembered that Amon's avatars could enter and exit the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" through the "Abyss". Although the passage in the cemetery in the suburbs of Backlund was destroyed by the Church of Steam and Machinery, he didn't know if those avatars could still use the "Abyss" in other forms?
In addition, he had also seen many descriptions about the Abyss in Roselle's diary, and had long been very interested in the current situation of the Abyss, and had long wanted to initiate related transactions with Hobert.
Hobert smiled, Klein even wanted other members to share the debt: "Okay."
The two ended their private exchange, and before "The World" could say anything, Cattleya said to "The Emperor" first, "I want to initiate a private transaction with you."
Everyone was stunned, another private transaction?
Hobert followed suit: "Okay."
After establishing a private exchange environment again, Cattleya said, "I want to obtain detailed information about how Emperor Roselle was corrupted."
In several intelligence transactions about Emperor Roselle at the Tarot Gathering, it had been roughly mentioned that the corruption he suffered came from the Outer Deities, but there was no detailed exchange.
Before, Cattleya always felt that such intelligence would involve some information about the Outer Deities, and even if detailed information was exchanged, it could not be brought to the real world.
But a few days ago, she had just received a letter from the "Queen Mystic", asking Cattleya to trade for this information.
Hobert also guessed that this should be the information Bernadette wanted to obtain. He was a little strange, why didn't Bernadette ask in person when they met before?
After thinking for a while, Hobert understood that at that time, Bernadette represented the leader of Element Dawn. It involved dividing the spoils after the war. It was not a wise choice to do such a transaction at that time.
Hobert considered it before saying, "I mentioned before that we have some secret information about Emperor Roselle, so I am quite familiar with this matter.
"But I must remind you, if I describe it in detail, you will have to ask Miss Justice to help you with psychological cues later, so you can't bring it to the real world.
"Of course, I can also pick out some information that can be brought to the real world to trade with you. You can choose how to trade."
Cattleya hardly hesitated: "I choose the transaction that can be brought to the real world."
"No problem," Hobert said with a slight smile: "Then just use the free listening opportunity from the last Tarot Gathering, or owe another 1,000 pounds of debt?"
"Use that opportunity."
Hobert "um"ed and pondered for a while before saying, "The reason why Emperor Roselle was corrupted is because he knew some too advanced information at a too low level, without any protection.
"You should be clear about this. In the Beyonder world, some things will be corrupted just by knowing them.
"In addition, there is currently no way to completely remove the corruption suffered by Emperor Roselle."
Klein, listening behind the gray fog, couldn't help but think: Roselle's current state is very strange! He didn't resurrect like Solomon, and there is no news about whether he still has an undiscovered mausoleum, and now there is another point, the corruption on his body cannot be removed.
Cattleya couldn't help but frown: "You... I mean, can't the 'Creator' do anything about it?"
"Not currently."
"Does that mean there will be in the future?"
Hobert didn't make any promises, but just said, "We all know that the respected Mr. Fool and the great 'Creator' are gradually regaining their authority and power."
Then he said, "Another piece of information is that at some point in the future, I may seek Bernadette's assistance in finding Roselle.
"Now I must state that we have no malice towards Roselle, and please Bernadette can improve herself as soon as possible. If she is at her current strength, we will not ask her for help."
Cattleya was a little surprised by this: The "Creator" seems to be the "Black Emperor", or a true god of adjacent pathways. What does He, what does He want to do with the Great Emperor? This sounds very dangerous.
Klein was also a little strange: What does the "Creator" want to do with Roselle? But what is certain is that He is not looking for him to exchange feelings.
Hobert seemed to see Cattleya's concerns, so he continued, "If the 'Creator' wants to harm Roselle, He can just do nothing. After he recovers a certain amount of strength, Roselle will be completely dead.
"And we have always shown enough goodwill to Bernadette, which is enough to show our position."
Cattleya was stunned at first, then said seriously, "I will pass your words on."
The two people's private exchange ended, and everyone noticed that the Hermit's feeling seemed much heavier.
Audrey was very curious: What information did they exchange just now? It made the always steady Hermit so emotionally changed?
Fors thought: I wonder if Hobert and "The Hermit" know each other in the real world, have they met?
At this time, "The World" initiated a new transaction: "I want to get information about the 'Abyss'."
Cattleya came back to her senses: "I know some information about the 'Abyss'."
Alger and Emlyn, as well as "The Star" Leonard, also said that they knew some information.
Finally, Hobert said, "I know more comprehensive information, and even speculated why the 'Abyss' has become so abnormal now."
Emlyn frowned and glanced at "The Emperor", as if saying: Why didn't you say it earlier?
After the war meeting ended, Emlyn figured out that Hobert was "The Emperor"! Because Archibald and Jonathan, who were doing war planning at the time, were obviously different from "The Emperor". After thinking about it, only Hobert seemed like "The Emperor".
The other members of the Tarot Gathering all thought this was normal. All along, the information from "The Emperor" was the most complete.
"The World" then said, "I choose to trade with 'The Emperor'. Does anyone want to trade with me?"
Audrey raised her hand first, and Fors was not to be outdone. Other members, even Cattleya and others who claimed to know some information about the Abyss, also raised their hands to participate.
In the end, everyone was willing to trade with "The Emperor" again.
Hobert said simply and neatly: "800 pounds of debt per person!"
This price was also recognized by everyone. Among them, Leonard owed the most, as high as 4,600 pounds, but he was not worried about it. After all, "The Emperor" did not urge him to pay.
After confirming the price, the transaction began.
Hobert organized his language before saying, "First, let's talk about the concept of the 'Abyss'. We all know that the Abyss is the source of all depravity and malice, and the residence of demons.
"At the same time, as far as I know, this is also the name of Sequence 0 of the 'Demon' pathway, that is, the 'Criminal' pathway."
Klein behind the gray fog had long known that the Sequence 0 of "Criminal" was called "Abyss". He thought: The value of this information alone is more than 800 pounds!
Alger nodded slowly: He knew the name of another Sequence 0.
Pay attention to listening to some seemingly casual descriptions of "The Emperor"! Cattleya reminded herself again in her heart: There are often many unexpected information contained in it.
Leonard was strange: Why is "Abyss" the same name as Sequence 0 of the 'Criminal' pathway?
Hobert continued to explain according to his own ideas: "In my understanding, 'Abyss', um, I mean the place of the Abyss. If I refer to the true god of this pathway, I will call Him Farbauti."
Audrey and others quickly recalled the information about the ancient gods that they had traded before, and at the same time they realized that Farbauti was really an ancient god without much presence.
Except for mentioning it at the Tarot Gathering, there is no information about this ancient god anywhere else.
"The 'Abyss' in my understanding is the embodiment of depravity and malice, or human evil," Hobert said: "It is different from the moon and the sun. It is a real entity, but it can indeed affect the real world.
"It's like 'Death'. We understand what death is, and we also know what the specific meaning of death is, but the concept of death is still somewhat abstract.
"After all, we have only seen the process and results of 'death', but we have not seen the appearance of 'death' itself.
"And 'Death' is the embodiment of 'death', the embodiment of 'death'!"
"Similarly, 'Abyss' is also like this. We all know the process and consequences of depravity and malice, but who can explain what 'depravity' itself is?
"Because this is just a human concept, it is abstract, and it is something that is passed down from mouth to mouth among most people.
"'Abyss' is the manifestation of these abstract concepts in the real world. Yes, this is very similar to the description of the authority of the gods.
"Thinking about the name of Sequence 0 of the 'Criminal' pathway, we can easily come to such a conclusion: The place of 'Abyss' is the same thing as Sequence 0 of the 'Criminal' pathway.
"They all have a common abstract meaning. Perhaps the root of Farbauti's power, to a certain extent, comes from the 'Abyss'."
Leonard leaned back in his chair. Every time "The Emperor" explained this kind of conceptual thing, he always had a sense of returning to the classroom of the Faculty of Arts. In his impression, "Abyss" was just a title. After being explained by "The Emperor", the meaning implied behind this title was clear at a glance.
Klein sighed: Why didn't I think of it before? Hobert's perspective and thinking mode are completely a combination of a "modern person's" thinking mode and a mystical thinking mode.
Then he smiled a little embarrassedly in his heart: Hobert must have done research-related work before he transmigrated, otherwise he wouldn't like to do this kind of conceptual thinking, just like me, I haven't done too much of this kind of thinking.
Cattleya recalled the information about the Abyss that she knew, and she sighed silently: The information I have is like the difference between a child's graffiti and a world-famous painting compared to the information of "The Emperor".
Hobert continued: "I don't know whether the creatures of the universe had evil thoughts first and then there was the 'Abyss', or whether there was the 'Abyss' first and then the creatures had evil thoughts.
"But it has existed for a very, very long time, perhaps at the beginning of the formation of the universe, the 'cosmic consciousness' like divinity also had certain evil thoughts, perhaps its evil thoughts formed the original 'Abyss'.
"Here we will not do further thinking, because there is no evidence to prove these guesses.
"Next, let's talk about the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti. We have done some transactions before. This is an ancient god. It is now unknown how He became a god.
"But what is certain is that He became a god in the early Second Epoch, mainly mastering the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Criminal' pathway, as for the other pathways He mastered, it is unknown.
"But according to my observation, He has not shown much madness, and He was quite restrained in the Second Epoch, so I guess He has fewer Beyonder characteristics of other pathways."
The members who had traded about the ancient gods before didn't have much Connection, only Leonard sighed in his heart: The history of the Second Epoch is like a common meal in the transactions of the Tarot Gathering!
Hobert suddenly paused here and said again, "Once I reviewed the history of the Second Epoch that I knew, and suddenly thought of a question.
"I don't know if it's right, it's still that sentence: for reference only."
He paused for another second or two before continuing, "I found that the ancient gods may be different from the current gods.
"According to some information I got, the first Blasphemy Slate should have appeared in the middle and late Second Epoch, so the eight ancient gods who appeared in the early Second Epoch should not have much idea about the ritual of becoming a god.
"And I refer to the relevant information of Mr. 'Door', for the gods, whether there is a ritual of becoming a god seems to make a big difference.
"In my understanding, what the ritual of becoming a god brings should be the improvement of the position."
"For example, even if one accommodates the Uniqueness and consumes the Beyonder characteristics needed to advance to a True God, they would still be an King of Angels without the sublimation of a ritual."
"Only after performing the corresponding ritual can one become a God in the true sense."
Audrey smiled slightly: Hobert is starting his blasphemous remarks again.
Leonard was still a little unaccustomed to such descriptions: Isn't this a bit too straightforward? But why doesn't anyone seem uncomfortable with it?
Klein recalled some of the information he had obtained before: No wonder Roselle's diary described Mr. Door as the King of Angels closest to God. It turns out he was only one ritual away from becoming a God.
Then he thought: Why didn't he perform that ritual? It doesn't make sense that he found the Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 characteristics but didn't know the ritual to become a True God of that pathway, right?
Hobert continued: "The Ancient Gods, in the beginning, probably didn't perform corresponding rituals either."
"This is very interesting. Their abilities are more diverse than those of the current True Gods. For example, the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' possesses the abilities of both the 'Sleepless' and 'Seer' pathways at the King of Angels level."
"But at the same time, the authority of His 'Sleepless' pathway abilities is half a grade lower than that of the current Evernight Goddess."
For a moment, the hall became very quiet. Everyone wasn't surprised but found the 'Emperor's' explanation and his line of thinking very interesting.
Cattleya took a deep breath: This explanation has made me completely understand the concept of the Ancient Gods. The 'Emperor' is more suitable for writing textbooks. With him, it seems that all ambiguous questions can be systematically understood, as if even mysticism is no longer mysterious.
Fors thought to herself: So, in the early Second Epoch, there were no True Gods, only gods built up from Beyonder characteristics. The madness and disorder of that era can be directly felt through Hobert's description.
Hobert continued: "The reason I want to explain this first is because, according to my observations and conjectures, Farbauti is different from other Ancient Gods in that he later became a True God of the 'Prisoner' pathway!"
"The specific time of his apotheosis is unknown. I guess it might be in the late Second Epoch or early Third Epoch."
"It is precisely because he became a True God and didn't have many Beyonder characteristics from other pathways in his body that he is an Ancient God who has never fallen until now."
Alger sighed again: This Ancient God really has no presence. It is now the Fifth Epoch, and he has passed through four Epochs, but there are very few records about him. I believe many Beyonders haven't even heard of this Ancient God's name.
Emlyn asked: "Emperor, have you seen Farbauti?"
He noticed that the 'Emperor' said 'according to his observations and conjectures.' Had he seen Farbauti, or was he observing through some appearances?
"Yes," Hobert said, "Well, I said before that in an exploration, I obtained an oil painting related to Farbauti."
"Later, by chance, I saw Farbauti through that oil painting."
"And because I completed some relatively high-level tasks, I had the opportunity to communicate with Farbauti. I learned a lot of firsthand information about the Second Epoch from Him."
"For example, a lot of information about the war in which Lilith, the ancestor of the Sanguine, fell."
Cattleya understood: So, that's where the 'Emperor' got a lot of his information about the Second Epoch? How else would the 'Emperor' know so many secrets about the Second Epoch?
Klein leaned back in his chair: This is what is called opportunity! It seems that transmigrators have a lot of opportunities.
Audrey sighed: The Ancient Gods of the Second Epoch... just listening to it, such an exchange has a sense of historical weight.
Fors recalled: Hobert seemed to have mentioned this, but he didn't seem to say that he had obtained any information from the Ancient God.
"According to Farbauti's description," Hobert continued, "He had 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' perform several divinations for him. Perhaps those divinations helped him avoid several crises later on."
"He also said that during the Second Epoch, the 'God of Spiritual Creatures,' later the 'Chained God,' was already being influenced by the 'Mother Tree of Desire' at that time."
"However, according to Farbauti, the 'Mother Tree of Desire' had very limited influence on the real world at that time. In the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' view, He was just cooperating with a hidden existence."
"At that time, Farbauti was at least at the level of an King of Angels, so he was not affected by the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' but it cannot be ruled out that he was affected without knowing it."
Klein couldn't help but frown: The 'Mother Tree of Desire' was influencing the real world during the Second Epoch? Then, tracing back further, can we see earlier traces of Her?
Alger sighed silently: It's the 'Mother Tree of Desire' again. After obtaining some information about the Outer Deities, I realized that the essence of this world is actually more dangerous than it looks!
Fors sighed: Fortunately, I have Mr. Fool and the 'Creator's' protection, avoiding me and Hobert from directly facing some terrible dangers.
Leonard, who had not experienced some previous transactions, asked: "'Mother Tree of Desire'? Isn't this a Evil God that only appeared in the Fifth Epoch?"
"She existed very early," Hobert vaguely explained, "Perhaps She appeared before the Second Epoch."
He didn't intend to continue dwelling on this question and continued, "We all know that Farbauti has almost no presence in history. The main reason he rarely shows up may be because of the 'Mother Tree of Desire'."
"According to Farbauti himself, the 'Mother Tree of Desire' became much stronger during the Fourth Epoch and could already corrupt Him."
"By the Fifth Epoch, the battle between Farbauti and the 'Mother Tree of Desire' entered a fever pitch. When Farbauti realized that he would definitely fail, he divided himself."
"The divided part is the Dark Side of the Universe!"
Leonard was stunned upon hearing this: This is also an Evil God that only appeared in the Fifth Epoch!
