chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 611: Klein Plans to Hunt for Amon’s Avatar
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
MissRaven
13 May
"Hanged Man" Alger was a little surprised: "Dark Side of the Universe" is "Devil Monarch" Farbauti? This, this feels like a layer of mask has been removed.
Then he thought: I really don't understand, how do these gods divide themselves? What will be the state after the division?
"The Fool" Klein thought: Farbauti's failure is inevitable, after all, He is only at the level of a True God, while the 'Mother Tree of Desire' is at the level of a Great Old One. Even if I don't know the reason, these Outer Gods can't project too much power into the real world, but the rank of the little power they project is sometimes a little higher than that of a True God.
"The Hermit" Cattleya thought: I heard that the "Dark Side of the Universe" occasionally responds to prayers, so according to the description of "The Emperor", Farbauti is influencing the real world through the identity of the "Dark Side of the Universe", while Farbauti himself is hiding?
The other members had at most heard of the "Dark Side of the Universe" and did not know the specific situation, so they did not have corresponding associations.
"The Emperor" Hobert continued: "The struggle between Farbauti and the 'Mother Tree of Desire' is roughly divided into three stages. The first stage is Farbauti hiding, and the 'Mother Tree of Desire' searching.
"The second stage is that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' found Farbauti, and Farbauti had to face the 'Mother Tree of Desire' directly, but if it was a head-on struggle, Farbauti knew that he was definitely not an opponent.
"So He split out the 'Dark Side of the Universe' and used the 'Dark Side of the Universe' to pull with the 'Mother Tree of Desire'.
"This way, even if the 'Dark Side of the Universe' is polluted, Farbauti's main body can effectively avoid corruption.
"At the same time, Farbauti can also use the fight with the 'Mother Tree of Desire' for control of the 'Dark Side of the Universe' to make the 'Mother Tree of Desire' concentrate its main energy only on this 'battlefield'."
Klein smiled: What a good move of retreating to advance!
"Justice" Audrey thought: The struggle at the level of gods becomes… becomes unimaginable!
"The third stage is the stalemate stage, the 'Mother Tree of Desire' still has no way to completely control the 'Dark Side of the Universe'." Hobert said:
"And Farbauti, who is hiding in the dark, has not had any chance of winning in the fight for the 'Dark Side of the Universe' so far, but he will not lose for the time being.
"So they fell into a stalemate."
He paused and said: "In addition, as far as I know, since Farbauti hid, he basically doesn't respond to the prayers of the 'demons' anymore.
"According to Farbauti himself, He once used the 'Dark Side of the Universe' to give some divine revelations, asking the 'demons' to all pray to the 'Dark Side of the Universe'.
"But there are still many 'demons' who presumptuously think that their monarch has encountered some difficulties, or may be sealed by some power.
"So some of them continued to pray to the 'Devil Monarch', while others simply sacrificed directly to the 'Abyss'.
"Although Farbauti has not responded to them, these prayers and sacrifices themselves still caused a lot of trouble for Farbauti.
"Everyone should have heard that there are a total of three 'demon families' in the mystical world. Among them, the Andariel family and the Beria family began to decline more than a thousand years ago.
"The reason for their decline is that they always sacrificed to Farbauti, which made Farbauti's situation very dangerous, so Farbauti simply killed the angels of these two families."
Klein leaned back in his chair: Every god who needs to hide has some smart followers. The Underworld Emperor Salinger is also like this, and His followers made the plan to resurrect Him very tortuous. The "Devil Monarch" Farbauti wanted to hide to avoid a head-on conflict with the "Mother Tree of Desire", but the "demons" repeatedly "called" Him.
"The Star" Leonard crossed his arms: So that's why those two "demon families" began to decline.
Then he thought: The information that my level can access only knows that two "demon families" have declined, but the information does not explain why they declined. I wonder if the church has complete information about this issue?
"The Moon" Emlyn smiled: Farbauti's misfortune is to encounter these brainless demons. Like our Sanguine, although we know that the state or situation of the Ancestor is not good, we have never made random sacrifices and prayers, but just quietly waited for the Ancestor to give some response.
The knowledgeable Cattleya had already guessed: "Were those 'demons' affected by something? Otherwise, why would they violate the divine revelation of the 'Dark Side of the Universe'?"
Hobert smiled: "That's what I think too. The 'Mother Tree of Desire' can easily have a certain impact on the 'Criminal' and 'Prisoner' pathways.
"The 'Mother Tree of Desire' should have realized that the 'Dark Side of the Universe' is just a bait, so He would try to influence the 'demons' to sacrifice and pray to Farbauti, looking for Farbauti's whereabouts.
"And if the 'demons' are allowed to pray, Farbauti runs the risk of exposing his hiding place, so he had to kill the angels of those two families.
"But at the same time, it also exposed Farbauti's plan, because even if the 'Dark Side of the Universe' is allowed to kill those demons, it also means confirming the 'Mother Tree of Desire's' guess that the 'Dark Side of the Universe' is really just a bait.
"At this time, the ingenuity of Farbauti's plan is reflected. Even if the 'Mother Tree of Desire' knows that the 'Dark Side of the Universe' is a bait, He cannot sit idly by.
"So the 'Mother Tree of Desire', which originally had difficulty penetrating power into the real world, had to fight on two fronts.
"On the one hand, He has to continue to fight for control of the 'Dark Side of the Universe', and on the other hand, He has to find the whereabouts of the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti.
"And Farbauti can hide and just fight with the 'Mother Tree of Desire' for control of the 'Dark Side of the Universe'."
Alger suddenly realized: This is the struggle between gods, with unimaginable wisdom and means.
Leonard sighed: Is this really just "The Emperor's" guess? Why is his guess always so detailed, as if… as if he also participated in the planning.
Cattleya breathed a sigh of relief: I never had much concept of the 'Criminal' pathway before. I didn't expect there to be so many stories behind this pathway.
Then she noticed: Why did "The Emperor" say that the "Mother Tree of Desire" is likely to have a certain impact on the "Criminal" and "Prisoner" pathways?
Klein also thought of this question: Could it be that the "Mother Tree of Desire" has a certain connection with some pathways in the real world?
At this time, Hobert said again: "According to some information I have obtained, the Abyss seems to have become a bit strange recently. It is said that even demons can no longer survive there.
"Based on what we know about the struggle between the 'Mother Tree of Desire' and Farbauti, it is not difficult to make a corresponding guess: the 'Abyss' should have been affected by some influence from the 'Mother Tree of Desire', so some changes have occurred.
"It is even possible that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' is influencing some 'demons' through the Abyss, so they keep praying and sacrificing to Farbauti.
"In short, some changes have occurred in the Abyss, some not-so-good changes.
"In addition, we must be wary of the Beyonders of the 'Demon' pathway. This pathway represents depravity and malice. The 'Prisoner' pathway can still control their desires and distortions through restraint.
"But according to my observation, the Beyonders of the 'Criminal' pathway basically have no goodwill after the 'Unwinged Angel' sequence. Even if they don't play the role of 'demons', the Beyonder characteristics will gradually make them evil."
As soon as Hobert said this, Leonard immediately said: "The Beyonders of this pathway are originally the enemies of all of us Beyonders."
Alger also rarely made a positive statement: "That's right, the appearance of 'demons' is generally accompanied by heinous tragedies. They… they seem to like to destroy everything beautiful or kind."
Audrey and Fors both recalled the "serial murder" case last year. One nodded and the other said "Yes" to express their agreement.
At this time, "The World" suddenly said: "I have received a message that Amon's avatar can enter and exit the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' through the 'Abyss'!"
Before everyone could be surprised, he asked again: "What impact does the change in the 'Abyss' have on Amon?"
Cattleya and others were all surprised by Amon's methods. They didn't expect Him to be able to use even the "Abyss"!
Only "The Sun" Derrick looked at "The World": "Mr. World, are you saying that you can reach your world from the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' through the 'Abyss'?"
It was Hobert who answered his question: "Amon can use the 'Abyss' because He is the King of Angels.
I believe that only angels or higher-level beings can guarantee they won't immediately fall in the 'Abyss.' According to legends, even angels can fall in the 'Abyss,' indicating that even at the angel level, one cannot stay in the 'Abyss' for long.
So, don't think about using the 'Abyss' to leave the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.' Doing so could easily turn everyone in City of Silver into demons!
"Little Sun" wasn't particularly disappointed: "I understand. Thank you for your answer."
Then, Hobert answered Klein's question: "Theoretically speaking, the changes in the 'Abyss' have little impact on Amon's actions."
"The World" pondered for a few seconds and then asked: "Then, can Amon's avatars use the 'Abyss' to quickly support other avatars?"
Hobert smiled: "I feel that His avatars should find it easier to do this through the Spirit World."
Klein had, of course, already considered this. He asked only to confirm his thoughts: So, that means Amon's avatars can, at most, use the 'Abyss' to enter and exit the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.'
Therefore, he manipulated "The World" and said to the head of the bronze table: "Honorable Mr. Fool, I wish to communicate separately with 'The Emperor' and 'The Star.'"
Leonard was slightly stunned, wondering what Klein wanted from him.
Hobert, however, roughly guessed what Klein wanted to do.
After establishing a separate communication environment, "The World" said in a hoarse voice: "I encountered Amon's avatar in Backlund."
Hobert said "As expected" in his heart, and then knowingly asked: "Backlund?"
Leonard was already considering whether to take the old man away from Backlund, or to hide in the church and not go out during this period.
Then, he carefully checked whether "The World" had a habit of wearing a monocle.
"Yes, the suburbs of Backlund," Klein's "The World" added: "He seems to have been attracted by a demigod from the Jacob family, but I don't know if that's His real purpose."
Hobert smiled: "Or that fellow is here to find a Blessed of the 'Creator' or 'Fool.'"
After becoming Sequence 3, when he faced Amon's avatar again, he felt more confident than before.
Of course, he still couldn't win in a head-on battle, but he was confident that he could run away.
This was Hobert's "confidence." After all, as long as he wasn't instantly killed, Amon's avatars weren't difficult to deal with. The only fear was not having a chance to escape.
Leonard was slightly stunned: Not here to find the old man? And 'The Emperor's' words seem to have some deeper meaning!
Hobert asked Klein: "What are your plans?"
"Respond proactively."
Hobert nodded, glanced at Leonard, and asked as if he didn't know anything: "This Mr. Star…?"
"The World" explained: "He can contact an angel of the 'Marauder' pathway."
Hobert said "Oh," as if he had recalled the information about the Zoroast family that "The Star" had previously traded.
Then, Hobert said: "You also know that I participated in a hunt for Amon's avatar…"
Leonard's expression didn't change much, but he was very surprised inside: What? Did I hear wrong? He participated in a hunt for Amon's avatar?
Then, he carefully observed whether "The Emperor" had a habit of wearing a monocle.
"…The most important thing about such an operation is its Concealment!" Hobert continued: "If you can't isolate the spread of information between Amon's avatars, a batch after batch of avatars will be attracted after the battle begins."
"If this operation can ask for the help of the Evernight Goddess, that would be the best."
Klein said: "After the Tarot Gathering ends, I will perform the corresponding prayer ritual."
Leonard was a little confused: Will Klein's prayer be answered by the Goddess?
However, although he was a Nighthawk, he didn't dare to pray to the Evernight Goddess. He didn't think that the Goddess wouldn't notice that an angel of the "Marauder" pathway was "living" in his body when he performed the corresponding ritual.
Hobert added: "The power to deal with Amon's avatar must be sufficient."
"The Fool will send an angel to participate in the battle, a Sequence 1," Klein referred to "Fate Snake" Will Auceptin, who had already confirmed his participation.
Then he looked at Leonard: "Will the angel behind you participate in the battle?"
Sequence 1! Leonard was first a little surprised, and then took a deep breath: "I can't make decisions for Him, but if it's 'concealed' enough, and our strength is strong enough, I think He should participate in the battle."
Klein looked at Hobert again, and Hobert smiled: "I don't dare to make decisions for the 'Creator' either, but the 'Creator' also doesn't like Amon.
"In addition, I must inform you in advance that the 'Creator' will not send angels to Backlund at this time."
Hobert suddenly had the feeling that two people who loved to brag were sitting together chatting, one saying that the "Fool" would send an angel, and the other saying that the "Creator" would not send angels to Backlund at this time.
It all sounded very impressive, but Hobert knew the angels who served the "Fool." Many years later, they might really serve Him, but now, it could only be considered unilateral service in the "Fool's" words.
As for the angels of the "Creator," not only would they not be sent to Backlund at this time, but they couldn't be sent anywhere, because "Holy Infant" and "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" were already offline.
If Hobert wanted to "send" an angel, he would have to find Messenger Beverly or Raymond at Tony Manor. They would probably be willing to help, but Hobert wasn't entirely sure.
So, it was better to simply say that if a cooperation intention was reached, the "Creator" would personally take action. After all, the "Creator" had no problem facing Amon's avatar now.
Among the three, perhaps only Leonard felt that their previous conversation was very impressive: What? Mr. Fool will send an angel to participate in the battle? The old man will most likely agree. What? The "Creator" will not send angels to Backlund at this time? Does He have a certain agreement with the orthodox gods or the royal family?
Klein finally said: "I will make the corresponding preparations in the next few days, and I hope you will also make the corresponding preparations."
Hobert immediately stated: "After the gathering ends, I will immediately pray to the 'Creator' and report this matter."
Leonard also said: "I will give you an answer as soon as possible."
Klein was very satisfied with this result, and the three ended the separate communication process.
Because no one initiated a new transaction, this Tarot Gathering entered the free exchange session.
Alger was about to ask "The Emperor" some detailed questions about the previous extraordinary war, but Emlyn cleared his throat and said: "Everyone, I have encountered a problem.
"The higher-ups of the Sanguine seem to be investigating me. I only realized this after unintentionally clashing with a Sanguine.
"What should I do now?"
Alger pondered for a moment and asked: "Do you know why you are being investigated?"
"I know," Emlyn glanced at Hobert: "Because I have been the liaison between 'The Emperor' and the Sanguine twice.
"Especially after this war, the Marquis of the Sanguine, as well as the Duke who just arrived in Backlund, seem to be very interested in the power of the 'Creator.'
"And theoretically speaking, my life trajectory has no way of knowing 'The Emperor.' I think this is mainly why they want to investigate how I know 'The Emperor.'"
Everyone nodded, understanding Mr. Moon's situation. Previously, when "The Emperor" simply initiated transactions with the Sanguine, the Sanguine didn't pay much attention to the forces to which "The Emperor" belonged.
In this large-scale war, the Sanguine realized the power of the "Creator's" forces, so they began to pay attention to this force. Then, of course, they had to first investigate Mr. Moon, who had been the liaison twice, to see if Mr. Moon was reliable.
If they thought he was reliable, then Mr. Moon might be responsible for the liaison work between him and "The Emperor" in the future. If Mr. Moon was not reliable, then they might find someone else to do this.
Hobert pondered for a moment before smiling: "I think, rather than saying this is your higher-ups investigating you, it's better to say that your higher-ups want to observe my reaction to this matter."
He paused and added: "According to the 'Creator's' consistent intentions, the Sanguine have always been an alliance we can strive for, so after this war ended, I once again extended a long-term cooperation invitation to the Sanguine, but your higher-ups have not yet responded.
"They should be discussing this matter while testing you and probing us through you."
Emlyn was a little confused: "Testing you?"
"Yes." Hobert said, "First of all, I want to congratulate you. Among the Sanguine, you have become a rather special one, even regarded as a link to the 'Creator' faction, so of course, you have to be tested.
"Moreover, for the long-term cooperation between us, the Sanguine will definitely consider it carefully, so they will observe us through you.
"I think that even if you didn't discover the Sanguine who had a conflict with you, he would find a way to make you discover him actively.
"In this case, if I ignore your encounter, it means that we have no sincerity. If I kill that Sanguine, it means that we have some malice towards the Sanguine, at least not as much goodwill as we show."
Emlyn opened his mouth. Before this, he didn't know that the two sides were preparing for long-term cooperation. After "The Emperor's" analysis, he felt that it seemed to be the case.
Everyone also felt that this analysis was clear enough, sorting out the relationship clearly.
Fors complained inwardly about the Sanguine being too cautious: they don't cherish Hobert's invitation, they will regret it later.
Audrey was also a little unhappy: the Sanguine are too careful, what is there to doubt about them? If we really wanted to be detrimental to the Sanguine, we wouldn't have issued an invitation for an alliance.
Emlyn asked Hobert again: "Then what should I do?"
Hobert held out two fingers: "Two steps. The first step is for you to take the initiative to admit your mistake to the higher-ups, explaining that you had a conflict with another Sanguine unintentionally, and tell them about the process of our acquaintance…"
Emlyn was a little surprised: "You, you want us to expose the Tarot Club?"
Hobert looked at Emlyn helplessly. Emlyn was stunned for a moment before seeming to come back to his senses: "I, I remember, we have already met, so there's no need to expose the Tarot Club."
The other members immediately understood: it turned out that "The Emperor" and "The Moon" already knew each other.
Alger even suspected: "The Moon" wouldn't have joined the club through "The Emperor's" introduction, would he?
Hobert continued: "As for the second step, you must punish that Sanguine, and I can't participate. It must be other forces of the 'Creator' faction who act. Only then can we have enough buffer between us and the Sanguine."
Finally, Hobert said to Emlyn: "As for how to punish him, it's up to you."
Then he sighed inwardly: I originally thought that Fors and the others wouldn't encounter danger because they went to find Beyonder ingredients, so that punishment for the Sanguine wouldn't happen. But what I didn't expect was that the joint action of the Tarot Club became an action planned by "The Emperor."
Emlyn had considered this a bit: "I think that Sanguine was acting on orders, so there's no need to make him pay with his life."
He hesitated for a moment before saying: "I hope to be able to trick him into going to the Harvest Church and make him a believer of the Earth Mother Church."
Klein behind the gray fog almost covered his face: How vicious!
Cattleya leaned back in her chair: Perhaps Mr. Moon knows very well the psychological impact that becoming a believer of the Earth Mother would have on a Sanguine, so he would have such an idea.
Audrey smiled: "Such a punishment is very appropriate."
Then she asked Hobert: "Is this punishment easy to carry out?"
Everyone was slightly stunned. Miss Justice seemed to care about this matter too.
Only Fors narrowed her eyes slightly, looking at "Justice" and then at Hobert.
"It's not difficult." Hobert met Fors' gaze generously before continuing to smile: "I'll transfer a demigod from another place and 'distort' his thoughts a bit.
"In fact, the focus of this action is the scale. Although we want to punish that Sanguine, we can't fall out with the Sanguine, nor can we put too much pressure on them."
Cattleya and Alger nodded one after another, feeling that "The Emperor's" words had hit the nail on the head. No matter how they punish him, no matter what Mr. Moon does, it's all being done for their higher-ups to see.
And Fors, after being looked back at so generously by Hobert, instead felt that she might have guessed wrong and was a little embarrassed.
Finally, Hobert said to Emlyn: "Give me two days. I'll transfer people from Backlund. At the same time, you also need to make some preparations these two days.
"After the manpower is gathered, I will come to you and discuss the entire plan with you."
Emlyn nodded: "Okay."
Because this was a matter between the Sanguine and the "Creator" faction, everyone didn't intend to ask too much. So Alger entered the next topic: "Mr. Emperor, the extraordinary war that is happening in the Central Highlands has already spread at sea.
"It is said that after 'Vice Admiral Ailment' went to participate in the war, she has not returned until now. Her fleet is likely to be disbanded or taken over by others."
Cattleya nodded slowly, but did not say that she had also participated in the division of "Vice Admiral Ailment's" fleet.
Hobert said: "'Vice Admiral Ailment' is very likely to have died in battle, because in this war, the most witches who died were mid-sequence Beyonders. I think seven or eight tenths of their middle level should have died."
Although they knew that they had achieved a considerable victory, the other members, including "The World" and "The Moon" who participated in the war, all showed their surprise to varying degrees.
They were very clear that for such a Beyonder organization, such a blow was absolutely devastating!
Leonard thought to himself: The Church's guess is still too conservative. This war has actually achieved such a great victory! Then the Demoness Sect will hide in the dark and lick its wounds for a long time to come.
Cattleya sighed: This is the power of Beyonder warfare! One battle may determine the fate of both sides for decades, or even hundreds of years!
Klein thought: Then the strategic effect achieved by this war will also be quite huge! In addition to defeating an opponent, neither the orthodox churches nor the royal families of various countries will underestimate the "Creator's" power! Or rather, the "Creator's" influence is already not small, probably similar to the "God of Craftsmen" back then, just lacking the orthodox churches' recognition of His status as a true god.
Then he thought: But the "Creator" doesn't seem to be in a hurry about this. He doesn't really care whether the true gods recognize Him or not.
He only heard Hobert continue: "Even if she didn't die, 'Vice Admiral Ailment' wouldn't dare to appear in the public eye again, because that would inevitably attract the 'Creator' faction's search and encirclement.
Finally, he smiled and said: "After all, we are already preparing to develop forces at sea, so we might as well take this opportunity to practice by encircling and suppressing 'Vice Admiral Ailment'."
Cattleya sighed inwardly: We "pirate admirals", the strongmen recognized at sea, are not really taken seriously by "The Emperor".
Alger was also very concerned about the fact that the other party was going to develop forces at sea: Could it be that the "Creator's" forces felt that the various forces in the Forsaken Sea were very mixed, so they also wanted to infiltrate their own power here?
He was a little worried: I don't know if the power belonging to the "Creator" will conflict with the Storm Church. After all, the true ruler of the Forsaken Sea is actually the Storm Church, the "Sea King" Jahn Kottman.
Klein recalled the members of the Tony family. At that time, some members of the Tony family occasionally wore clothing with the style of the Rorsted Archipelago. He believed that that should be the main force of the "Creator" in the Forsaken Sea.
Fors roughly understood Hobert's plan. At this time, she smiled slightly, and a sense of pride filled her heart.
Audrey was also very curious about this, but now was obviously not the time to ask questions.
At this time, Emlyn asked Hobert: "Then does that mean that the biggest result of this war is the blow to the middle-level power of the Demoness Sect?"
"No." Hobert said: "The Demoness Sect has two angels in very bad condition. One of them was beaten into even worse condition. I think she should be hovering on the verge of losing control for a long time.
"The other angel in bad condition was killed by the 'Creator' and two other angels together, so the Demoness Sect's high-end combat power also suffered a lot of losses in this battle."
An angel died!
Even if it's an angel in bad condition, it's still an angel!
The other members, including Klein, felt a little unreal after hearing this news!
Last year, when they first heard about battles at the angel level, they still felt it was very high-end. At this time, they suddenly heard that an angel had died, and they always felt that such a thing was very, very far away from them, but it actually happened around them.
Klein sighed with emotion: This time, the "Creator" has made a killing! Just the Beyonder characteristic of that angel alone is a priceless trophy!
Then, he smiled helplessly: I originally thought that obtaining a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact was already a pretty rich haul, but now it seems my perspective was too limited.
Fors was a little unhappy: Hobert actually didn't tell me about this!
But then she recalled that she hadn't given Hobert a chance to talk about these things recently.
Audrey was also a little unhappy: We even attended a ball together, but Hobert didn't mention this to me.
At the same time, she also seemed to realize that a ball might not be the best place to discuss such things.
"Little Sun" asked curiously: "Mr. 'Emperor,' did the 'Creator' send out a total of two angels this time?"
"No." Hobert had long wanted to brag about this, and he smiled and said, "Both sides sent out four each."
Klein was stunned: In the battle that had just ended, there were actually eight angels participating! This… Was the thing we participated in really a war? Why do I feel like the biggest enemy we encountered was that 'Demoness of Unaging' whom Hobert sent back to the 'respawn point'?
Alger shifted uncomfortably in his seat: Judging by the number of angels, the 'Creator's' forces are strong enough to challenge the Church of Storms. Could they be planning to start a new war in the Forsaken Land of the Gods?
Cattleya was slightly stunned, once again shattering her perception of the "Creator's" power: I used to think that the "Creator's" power was similar to the Moses Ascetic Order, but now it seems that this power must be stronger than the Ascetic Order. I'm quite sure that the Ascetic Order doesn't have four angels!
Even Fors was a little surprised, feeling that the power involved in this war that had just ended exceeded her expectations.
After Hobert received a wave of surprise from everyone, he smiled and said, "However, two of the angels were invited as reinforcements."
Then he added: "The Demoness Sect also invited a reinforcement. The enemies of the 'Creator' have come together.
"At the same time, the 'Creator' also took action. Correspondingly, the 'Primordial Demoness' also descended power, but she was stopped by the 'Creator' during the process of descending power."
Everyone sighed with emotion: This is the real inside story of this battle.
Then, almost everyone believed that the reinforcement invited by the Demoness Sect was likely an angel from the "Rose School of Thought," and everyone knew that they were enemies of the "Creator."
Audrey thought of a very high-level piece of information she had obtained from Mr. Fool during the Backlund smog incident: The "Primordial Demoness's" name is Cheek.
So she asked: "How does the 'Primordial Demoness' descend power? Is her power very strong?"
"Using her own idol." Hobert didn't hide this: "According to the 'Creator,' the 'Primordial Demoness' is in very poor condition."
Klein recalled some of the information he had traded for before: Could it be that the injuries the "Primordial Demoness" suffered in the "War of the Four Emperors" have not healed even now?
The other members also recalled the "Emperor's" description of the "Primordial Demoness" in the previous deal with the Underworld Emperor, but everyone immediately had a realization: Even if she is in poor condition, she is still a god! And a god at the level of a True God!
The members who had not seen the "Creator's" image thought along these lines: The "Creator" blocked the "Primordial Demoness," so does that mean that the "Creator" is at least at the level of an King of Angels?
Alger cleared his throat and said, "Even if the reinforcements are very impressive, not everyone can invite angel-level reinforcements."
Klein suddenly realized that he could do this.
Leonard smiled slightly: There's an angel living in my body.
Emlyn was also thinking: I wonder if our Sanguine's Duke would participate in such a war at my request?
The other members didn't have such channels. The only channel they could think of was to ask Mr. Fool for help.
Alger also noticed the expressions of the three of them: "The World" can get an angel to help, I'm not surprised, but "The Star" can also get one? The new member's identity is not simple!
Audrey also noticed this: Is Mr. Star asking for help from an angel-level member of his family? He wouldn't be asking for help from an angel of the Church, would he? Mr. Moon can also invite an angel. Oh, right, he mentioned that a Sanguine angel has come to Backlund.
Finally, she smiled slightly: The forces behind the members of our Tarot Club are all very powerful!
Cattleya couldn't help but frown: When did angels become so "cheap" that half of the members can invite the help of angels?
Regarding Alger's compliment, Hobert smiled slightly: "It's not that I can do this. They mainly came for the 'Creator.'"
He didn't continue the topic about angels, but said again: "As for the Demoness Sect, the losses at the demigod level are also not small. The only ones who may not have suffered much loss are the 'low-sequence' Beyonders who participated in the war with fewer numbers.
"An undeniable fact is that the Demoness Sect has been completely defeated by us. A more direct manifestation is that most of the courtesans in the countries of the Northern Continent will disappear!
"In addition, the high-end combat power of the Theosophy Order has also been almost completely wiped out in this battle. From now on, the Theosophy Order will become a third-rate secret organization. They don't even have a Sequence 5 now!"
Audrey immediately asked: "Mr. Emperor, what is the relationship between the Theosophy Order and the Demoness Sect?"
"Originally, the Theosophy Order was an organization established by some members of the Abraham family." Hobert briefly explained: "But after the Demoness Sect's long-term infiltration, the Theosophy Order can already be considered a subordinate organization of the Demoness Sect.
"After the Theosophy Order suffered heavy losses, they became even more inseparable from the Demoness Sect. In the future, this may be a Beyonder organization mainly composed of 'low-sequence' Beyonders."
Audrey nodded slowly: So the Theosophy Order is also an evil organization!
After the description of the participation of eight angels, the other members were no longer surprised by the subsequent descriptions.
"Little Sun" saw that everyone had finished talking about this Beyonder war, and then he asked: "Everyone… Um, my ritual to advance to 'Priest of Light' is to bury my whole body in non-melting ice in pure darkness.
"Um, in City of Silver, similar ice is not difficult to find, but how can I create pure and safe darkness?"
Everyone was almost stunned: So that's what the "Priest of Light's" advancement ritual is like.
Audrey smiled slightly: "Little Sun" is really honest and simple.
Hobert immediately thought of using "tampering" or "distortion" to create a safe dark space, but he also thought that City of Silver was Klein's "private land," so he should leave it to him to solve.
Klein had already thought of a way at this time, which was to have Leonard provide a talisman of the dark domain and have "Little Sun" pray to "The Fool." Klein would mobilize the power above the gray fog to provide "Little Sun" with an "artificial darkness."
But he thought that there were too many sources of danger in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods," and he didn't know if it would work, so he had to verify it in advance. So he manipulated "The World" and said to Derrick:
"I will help you search for information and find a way, but in this process, you may need to cooperate to verify whether it is feasible."
Derrick immediately said: "No problem!"
Then he thanked: "Thank you, Mr. World!"
After this topic ended, no one started a new topic, and "The Fool" Klein said: "That's all for today."
Everyone stood up and saluted, and this Tarot Club ended.
In Green Grass Manor, Hobert and Fors returned to the real world together. The first sentence Fors said when she opened her eyes was: "I want that murloc cufflink!"

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 612: Audrey Advances to Sequence 6 (Bonus 1)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Canal Gustavo Águiar for becoming a free member]
Hobert was already prepared for Fors's request: "I know, I know, you definitely want to put the 'Murloc Cufflink' up for auction at the Longtail Island auction house you're preparing, right? After all, this mystical item is very suitable for auction at sea."
Fors was stunned: "I…"
I didn't have such thoughts!
Hobert continued seriously: "Although some preparations need to be made for the new auction house, you also need to consider the price. If the price of the goods is too high, don't buy them for the time being."
Fors suddenly didn't know how to explain: "That's not it, 'Justice' didn't…"
"I know, 'Justice' raised the price first, but didn't I help you win the 'Murloc Cufflink' in the end?" Hobert said earnestly, "Don't do such silly things in the future."
Fors suddenly felt the urge to scratch her head: Didn't Hobert call a stop because he didn't want to see me and 'Justice' compete for that mystical item? He… he thought I wanted to get that 'Murloc Cufflink' to raise funds for the new auction house?
Thinking about it this way, it makes sense. In Hobert's plan for developing the eastern port of Longtail Island, one of the key construction projects is to build an extraordinary auction house there.
And now, after several months of construction, the eastern port city is about to open to the public.
A mystical item like the "Murloc Cufflink" will definitely fetch a good price at the auction house on Longtail Island.
While Fors was considering this matter, Hobert suddenly leaned over and kissed Fors.
Fors's cheeks flushed slightly. Just as she was about to dodge, Hobert whispered in her ear: "'World' is preparing to hunt Amon's avatar. I have to discuss this with him. I won't be eating dinner here."
Fors was slightly stunned, looking at Hobert putting on his coat: "You, be careful."
The "Murloc Cufflink" was no longer her biggest concern.
Hobert smiled: "This time I'm just helping him with the liaison, not participating in the specific action."
After putting on his coat, Hobert pinched Fors's cheek: "I'm leaving. Remember to keep an eye on Conrad and the others. Make sure they do the corresponding preparatory work."
Fors nodded: "I know."
Watching Hobert leave, she suddenly felt a little lost.
Looking out the window, a gust of moist wind blew in, and it began to drizzle outside.
"It's really a good time for a nap," Fors sighed.
She lay down again, suddenly remembering that she hadn't taken a nap with Hobert for a long time.
…
Hobert returned to Backlund, pretended to pray to the "Creator" in the study, and then took out 1100 pounds in cash and sacrificed it to Mr. Fool.
Klein's two mystical items were eventually sold for 2700 pounds, but for the previous two intelligence transactions, Klein had accumulated a debt of 1600 pounds, so Hobert only needed to pay 1100 pounds.
While making the sacrifice, Hobert reported to "The Fool": "Respected Mr. Fool, please tell 'The World' that the 'Creator' is willing to take action when he needs help.
"Also, please tell him that it is best to pray to the 'Creator' at the beginning of the battle, so as not to be too late to make the corresponding request after the battle begins."
A few minutes later, Hobert received a reply from "The World": "Thank you for the 'Creator's' promise."
After resolving this matter, Hobert sat in the chair and recalled the conflict between Audrey and Fors at the Tarot meeting.
For Hobert, although the conflict between Audrey and Fors made him sweat at the time, he later realized that this conflict was equivalent to an effective communication between the two, and also a self-reconciliation.
The most frightening thing is not the conflict, but maintaining indifference even when they meet.
After this conflict, Hobert believed that they felt each other's bottom line, and would respect each other's bottom line in the future, which is pretty good.
Of course, Hobert also knew that they were both smart people and that the reasons he found could not deceive them.
But they both needed Hobert to give a reason, even if the reason was absurd.
Some things simply cannot be said too clearly!
Thinking of this, a smile crept onto Hobert's face. After this incident, the Shura field was basically over.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert looked at his pocket watch. While there was still some time, he entered the "Nation of Disorder" and found the star representing Fors.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert spread his spirituality over, and saw Fors yawning and chatting with Xio.
Hobert smiled helplessly. It could be seen that Fors wanted to take a nap, but Xio was there, so she couldn't sleep.
Because Xio had not prayed to the "Creator," she could only contact her through Fors. Fortunately, Xio knew that Fors was in a bad mood recently, and also knew that Longtail Island was still a bit dangerous, so she had been staying by Fors's side.
Hobert aimed his spirituality at Xio, and then said in the supreme voice of the "Creator": "Find these two people!"
At the same time, he "stuffed" the corresponding information into Xio's brain.
…
South Colson, in the Greenlawn Manor.
Xio was describing to Fors the shopping process she had this afternoon at the West Bank Orchard. Suddenly, a great figure appeared in her mind: "Find these two people!"
Before she could see clearly, the great figure disappeared, and then two pieces of information appeared in Xio's mind.
This information was very detailed, with portraits, their previous residences, and explanations of their strength.
Xio was slightly surprised: "I, I received a mission issued by the 'Creator'."
Fors was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "What mission? Does it need to be kept secret?"
Xio swallowed: "The 'Creator' didn't say."
"Then it doesn't need to be kept secret."
"The 'Creator' asked me to find two people." Xio found that the two pieces of information seemed to have become part of her memory. If she "recalled" it slightly, the two pieces of information could reappear in her mind: "They are two members of the Aurora Order."
Fors nodded: "That should be right. The 'Creator' regards many evil organizations as enemies."
Xio added: "They are both in Backlund."
"Then you should go back to Backlund."
Xio was a little worried: "But your safety…"
"Don't worry." Fors smiled: "Another batch of officially Beyonders who are receiving training came last week. The extraordinary power here is more abundant.
"Besides, I will be promoted to Sequence 6 next month, so I don't need protection."
…
Backlund.
Hobert issued a mission to Xio, and then took a carriage to Earl Hall's mansion.
At last week's ball, he had made an appointment with Earl Hall to have dinner together tonight.
After chatting with Earl Hall for a while, Hobert came to the studio and saw Audrey painting: "Let me see what you are painting."
Audrey, wearing a relatively loose long dress, smiled and put down her paintbrush, showing Hobert the unfinished painting, which was Hobert's manor in the suburbs.
Although it was not finished yet, Hobert noticed that the colors she used were basically warm colors, so it seemed that the previous visit to the manor had left her with good memories.
Audrey covered the painting while saying: "I want that 'Murloc Cufflink'!"
"What do you want that low-level thing for?" Hobert said: "I have already sold it to a pirate. I have brought you something better!"
When he spent 1500 pounds to buy the murloc cufflink, he didn't intend to give it to Fors, nor did he intend to give it to Audrey, nor did he intend to sell it. Its fate was destined to be left in the 'Nation of Disorder' to gather dust.
Because there was no one else in the studio, Audrey poutted unceremoniously, looking very cute.
"You don't believe me?" Hobert smiled.
He took out two wooden boxes from two different pockets: "Look for yourself."
Audrey didn't know whether to laugh or cry: "I don't disbelieve that."
Hobert seemed to understand something: "I know, you must want to go swimming with me with the 'Murloc Cufflink', right?"
He looked Audrey up and down: "I'll go and get the 'Murloc Cufflink' back from the pirate!"
Audrey was a little embarrassed to be watched, she quickly grabbed Hobert: "I don't mean that either!"
Hobert clapped his hands: "I really know this time, it must be that you miss me after not seeing me for several days, right?
"If it's not that, then it must be that you want a kiss…"
In the end, Hobert picked up Audrey and spun her around, and this topic finally ended in "giggling" laughter.
Because it was not yet dinner time, the two simply came to the laboratory.
Hobert glanced at the "Hypnotist" potion formula and helped her prepare the potion.
"Do you have time tomorrow?" Hobert asked while weighing the auxiliary Ingredients and then adding them to the beaker in turn.
"I have already told my father that I will visit the power plant with you tomorrow." Audrey watched Hobert's skillful technique from the side, smiling slightly.
"Visit the power plant at noon, and then go to 'Earl's Light' in the afternoon." Hobert finished adding the auxiliary Ingredients and began to add the main ingredient, 60 milliliters of the black hunting giant lizard's brain fluid, and a fruit of the psychedelic bell tree.
Soon, a "Hypnotist" potion was prepared.
Hobert looked at it and saw that there was no problem, and then said: "Strive to work at 'Earl's Light' this week."
He estimated that he would need to invest a lot in the Southern Continent next week.
Audrey took a deep breath: "I'll talk about it after I take the potion."
"Don't be so nervous." Hobert smiled: "You'll be fine."
Audrey picked up the potion: "What should you do if I show signs of losing control?"
Hobert glanced at Susie who came in: "I will 'give' the loss of control on you to this golden retriever."
Susie, who had just entered, was stunned for a moment, then turned around and walked out.
Audrey chuckled: "You scared Susie away."
Hobert looked a little strange: "It wouldn't understand what I said, would it?"
Audrey quickly waved her hand: "It's just a coincidence!"
"Okay, hurry up and take the potion." Hobert didn't continue this topic.
With Hobert present, Audrey was indeed much more at ease. After "comforting" herself again, she picked up the potion and drank it all in one gulp.
After drinking the potion, Audrey's eyes immediately became blank. A layer of illusory scales appeared on the surface of her body, and her eyes gradually turned into pale golden vertical pupils.
Hobert observed Audrey's mental state at all times. If there was a risk of losing control, he would immediately help Audrey "give" most of the mental pressure away.
However, even if the advancement is completed in this way, it will only avoid losing control during the advancement process. Audrey's state will still not be good after the advancement is over.
So, it's best not to interfere if the advancement process can be left alone.
Audrey's body began to swell, and the dress that looked relatively loose was stretched up, with the risk of tearing.
Her eyes gradually became sharp, but this was still within her tolerance.
After about three or four minutes, after a struggle, Audrey's body gradually began to recover and eventually became normal.
Hobert felt a little regretful, because the material of Audrey's clothes was very good and was not torn.
One or two minutes later, the phantom scales on Audrey's body disappeared, her eyes gradually regained their brilliance, and finally she breathed a sigh of relief: "That was close, I felt like I almost couldn't find my consciousness just now."
Hobert smiled: "Advancing to Sequence 6 is generally quite dangerous, quickly use meditation to restrain your spirituality."
He noticed that the color of Audrey's eyes was deeper than before, looking like a deep pool of water, very charming.
After waiting for another seven or eight minutes, Audrey opened her eyes refreshed: "Okay!"
Hobert opened his arms: "A big hug as a reward!"
Audrey smiled: "I don't want it!"
"Okay, okay." Hobert took out the two wooden boxes again: "This is the reward prepared for you.
"After you become a 'Hypnotist', you will have strong control abilities such as 'Hypnosis', so the two gifts I prepared for you are mainly mystical items that are inclined to quickly kill targets.
"I named this ring 'Priest of Light Ring'. It can use most of the abilities of 'Priest of Light', especially 'Holy Light'. Targets below Sequence 6 can be burned into charcoal with one blow.
"Even for enemies of Sequence 6 and Sequence 5, one blow can make the target burn with flames and have a 2 to 5 second trance. The attack power is at least doubled against undead creatures or dark creatures."
This mystical item was exactly the gift that Philip I of the Kingdom of Feynapotter gave to Hobert in return for obtaining a piece of "Order Crystal" from Hobert.
Hobert pointed to another wooden box: "This bracelet has most of the abilities of 'Guardian', such as 'Dawn Sword' and 'Dawn Armor', and can also use 'Dawn Barrier' to protect yourself or your companions.
"This is one sequence higher than the Sealed Artifact of the 'Warrior' pathway that I explained to Mr. Star before. I was going to give it to you at that time, so I simply didn't mention it to Mr. Star."
In fact, he had forgotten the existence of this mystical item. This was a mystical item that Christian gave to Hobert. After becoming a demigod, these mystical items had been placed in the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert had only rediscovered them a few days prior while taking stock of his sealed artifacts.
They were convenient to carry and had decent abilities, so he packed them into a wooden box to give to Audrey.
These mystical items, after being resealed by Hobert, had minimal negative effects and were considered rare finds.
Audrey, no longer a novice in the world of the extraordinary, knew that these two items were worth at least 25,000 pounds!
After thanking him, Audrey gleefully accepted the two gifts.
Hobert watched Audrey play with the items for a while before saying, "I have a 'Dreamwalker' characteristic here, but no potion formula."
Because this 'Dreamwalker' characteristic had long been shattered by him, there was no way to 'connect' to the potion formula from the characteristic.
Audrey was taken aback, then smiled and said, "I didn't expect that I wouldn't have to worry about the main ingredient right after advancing to Sequence 6."
She thought for a moment before saying, "The Psychology Alchemists should have the formula, but it definitely won't be easy to obtain."
Hobert waved his hand nonchalantly, "Leave it to me! Whatever they want or hope to achieve, leave it to me!"
Audrey exclaimed, "It's so nice to have a lover!"
"You should say boyfriend," Hobert opened his arms again, "Aren't you going to reward me?"
Audrey smiled, but didn't say anything.
Hobert understood her meaning, stepped forward, and gave Audrey a bear hug.
After hugging for a few seconds, Audrey shook her head, "Don't breathe in my ear."
Hobert leaned on Audrey's shoulder, "I have to breathe, or I'll suffocate."
Audrey struggled out of Hobert's arms and gave him an unhappy look, "You bad egg!"
Her slightly annoyed look seemed very cute to Hobert, and he wanted to pinch her cheek, but Audrey dodged him.
At this moment, someone knocked on the door, and the two immediately regained their serious expressions.
The laboratory door was opened, and it turned out to be a servant calling them to the dining room for dinner.
Hobert stretched his arms, "What a delightful dinner to look forward to!"
As they walked to the dining room, Audrey asked, "What's so delightful about it?"
"Being able to chat with Earl Hall about the current situation in Backlund is certainly delightful."
Audrey was stunned; this was different from what she had expected, "Anything else?"
Hobert smiled, "Being able to talk to Mr. Hibbert about Backlund's political topics is also delightful."
Audrey looked at Hobert, "Is that all?"
"Being able to have dinner with the most beautiful Miss Audrey," Hobert smiled, "That's the most delightful thing of all."
Audrey 'hmphed,' as if to say: You know what's good for you.
Joking around, the two arrived at the dining room.
The moment they entered the dining room, both of them put away their smiles.
After taking their seats, Earl Hall served the appetizer to Hobert first, and Hobert thanked the Hall family for their hospitality and banquet. After a simple pre-dinner exchange, dinner finally began.
At the long dining table, Hobert was at least five or six meters away from Earl Hall.
It wasn't that he was deliberately placed far away, but rather that everyone was about two meters apart. Hobert felt like they weren't eating as a family at all.
Hobert complained in his heart: Does every meal for the nobles feel like attending a banquet?
At this moment, Hibbert took a sip of his aperitif and suddenly asked, "Hobert, I've always been curious, why do you always give the workers at 'Earl's Light' such high wages and benefits?
"I heard that the salary of an ordinary worker is almost the same as that of a clerk."
In this era, being a clerk was still a very good job, not very tiring, and with an above-average salary in the factory.
Earl Hall also asked curiously, "Is this a form of charity?"
"No," Hobert said after eating a bite of escargots, "I'm creating a middle class."
"Creating a middle class?" Audrey asked curiously.
Everyone else was also very curious about this concept and put down their cutlery to look at Hobert.
Hobert also put down his cutlery and gently wiped his mouth with a lace-edged napkin before saying, "The residents of Backlund today are roughly divided into three levels: nobles and millionaires, the middle class, and the poor."
He further explained, "If you want to promote economic activity, consumption is a very important aspect.
"Although nobles and millionaires are very rich, they are few in number and cannot bear the city's main daily consumption.
"Although there are many poor people, they have no money, so it is not difficult to come to the conclusion that Backlund's main daily consumption is supported by the middle class.
"But the problem is that many current policies and regulations are not very friendly to the middle class. We see those vagrants on the streets of Backlund, and there are not many poor people among them, mostly middle class!
"In fact, in my opinion, the middle class may be more likely to go bankrupt than the poor."
Earl Hall and Audrey listened very carefully. Even though they were among the more enlightened nobles, Hobert's views were very appealing to them.
"This is a very dangerous sign," Hobert said seriously, "If the number of the middle class decreases sharply on a large scale, it will cause a phenomenon of wealth not circulating, and most of the factories and various companies will be greatly affected.
"So, in my opinion, a more important purpose of opening a factory is to create a part of the middle class and make this society look more vibrant."
Earl Hall picked up his cutlery again, "This idea is very special and very novel."
He smiled, "Backlund needs such new ideas."
Hobert spread his hands, "I think every gentleman in Backlund will recognize the importance of the middle class."
But whether they will protect the middle class and continuously create a middle class is unknown.
Following this topic, everyone talked about Backlund's economic situation, and Hobert did not hesitate to praise it.
It is indeed the most prosperous city in the world, able to plunder cheap raw materials from the colonies, and has very cheap labor. The only thing missing is a market that will never be filled.
Everyone enjoyed the meal very much. Hobert used some knowledge from his memory to show his cutting-edge ideas and "knowledge." The Hall family was very satisfied with Hobert.
At more than nine o'clock in the evening, after drinking tea and chatting for a while, Hobert got up to say goodbye.
Before leaving, Hobert glanced at Audrey. Her face was full of smiles. The approval of her family for her lover should be the happiest thing for her.
Back at the Earl's mansion, Hobert was just about to rest when a prayer came from the "Nation of Disorder."
He stretched and reluctantly locked the door and entered the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert saw that the star of Lawrence of the Balk family was expanding.
He roughly guessed the purpose of the other party's prayer, spread his spirituality over, and sure enough, he saw Lawrence and the three family members behind him.
Hobert had promised last week to bestow a 'Earl of the Fallen' characteristic to the Balk family.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 613 Great Changes on the Fog Sea (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Thanks to Satya Shivesh Penta for becoming a free member]
South Continent, upper reaches of the Hodis River.
Following the instructions of the "Favored," Hobert, Lawrence first carefully selected three outstanding Sequence 5 members from his family. Then, he arranged the altar, prayed to the "Creator," and began to loudly report the talents of these three Sequence 5 members and their contributions to the family and the "Creator."
These three Sequence 5 members, two men and one woman, had all participated in the recently concluded extraordinary war and had performed quite well.
After Lawrence finished his report, the majestic image of the "Creator" appeared above the altar. Lawrence and the other three immediately lowered their heads and knelt on one knee, not daring to look directly at the "Creator," only feeling the immense pressure emanating from the "Creator."
As the four of them performed the ritual together, they heard the "Creator" say in a deep voice, "Give it to Leon!"
The young man named Leon praised the "Creator" with joy.
The other two were somewhat disappointed, but only slightly. To them, becoming candidates and being noticed by the "Creator" was a great honor.
After Lawrence bowed and acknowledged, he began to arrange the granting ceremony and indeed received a portion of the "Earl of the Fallen"'s Beyonder characteristics.
After thanking the "Creator," the four of them looked at the Beyonder characteristics on the altar with mixed feelings. This was a Sequence 4 Beyonder characteristic! It meant that the Balk family could have four demigods in the future!
After praising the "Creator" again, Lawrence first put away the Beyonder characteristics and was about to tell Leon about the advancement ceremony when suddenly the candles on the table turned into green flames. The space in front of them became illusory, and a coffin floated out of the spirit world.
A letter flew out from the crack of the coffin and landed in Lawrence's hand.
Immediately afterward, the coffin disappeared, and the candle flames returned to normal.
Lawrence knew this was Hobert's messenger and was not surprised. He opened the letter and glanced at it: "'Favored' Hobert wants to transfer a demigod from the Balk family to Backlund to assist him in completing a task."
He said to the three family members behind him, "Immediately go and call the elders for a meeting!"
Although Lawrence was also a "Favored," and Hobert had said they were now equals, Lawrence did not dare to truly treat Hobert as an equal.
In his opinion, Hobert should be the leader among the "Favored." The "Creator" would usually give him some tasks, and then he would distribute them to other "Favored."
Therefore, Lawrence still attached great importance to Hobert's letter, treating his "request for transfer" as an order.
...
Backlund, 62 Empress Borough.
After Hobert sent the letter to Lawrence, he lay down on the bed to rest.
He first recalled his choice just now. In fact, the young man named Leon was not more outstanding than the others. All three of them were very good. Hobert didn't know who to choose, so he just pointed at random.
The choice just now was only to prove the "Creator"'s authority. He does not interfere with promotions below demigod, but when promoted to demigod, especially when using the Beyonder characteristics provided by the "Creator", then the "Creator" will designate the promoter.
And now what Hobert has to consider is how to divide the power of the Balk family in the future.
As of now, Hobert still needs to rely on the power of the Balk family to develop his forces in the Southern Continent, but he cannot always rely on this family. In the future, their demigods must be separated.
Otherwise, the country built in the Southern Continent will easily be a country led by the Balk family, not a country of the "Creator."
This can only wait for an opportunity in the future. No division actions can be taken at present.
Next, Hobert considered the transportation problem with the Southern Continent. If taking a boat, it is very inconvenient to travel back and forth between the North and South Continents.
And now Hobert can only use "Travel," taking two people back and forth between the North and South Continents.
After the previous battle, Hobert now has the Beyonder characteristics of a "Traveler" again, and he has asked the "Alchemist" Mr. Winston, who likes fishing, to make two "Traveler's Doors."
Hobert plans to use the "Traveler's Door" tomorrow to connect the traffic between Longtail Island and the Southern Continent.
However, the 'Traveler's Door' has gradually failed to meet Hobert's needs for transportation between regions. This kind of mystical item is okay for individuals, but if you want to transport goods, even a carriage cannot pass through it, and you can only use rickshaws to shuttle through the 'Traveler's Door'.
And as the transportation of goods between Longtail Island and the South Colson area, and in the future, between these two places and the Southern Continent, becomes more and more frequent, rickshaws will definitely not be able to meet the logistics needs.
It is possible to consider using "Laborers" to open up "Creator Logistics."
But this is a bit degrading, for example: The great "Creator", please help me transport thirty pounds of cabbage.
Transport or not?
For example: The great "Creator", please help me send this sock to so-and-so, he left in a hurry and forgot to bring it.
Need help or not?
Hobert sighed, "Creator Logistics" can transport high-end products, but once the 'civilian' mode is turned on, it will really become a "logistics company"!
At this time, Hobert suddenly recalled the "teleportation array" left by the civilization that once believed in "Mr. Door" on the alien planet!
That thing is easy to use! Once the "teleportation array" is opened, let alone a carriage, a small ship can drive over!
He seriously recalled that although the magic circle was complex, the principles were all based on mystical theories on Earth, which was not difficult for him.
Hobert thought for a while and felt that he could try it, so he jumped out of bed and recorded the quantity and size requirements of the diamonds and crystals he needed on a piece of paper.
Then he went to the "Nation of Disorder" and took out the pendant with the Southern Continent style that Christian gave him. After injecting spirituality into it, the space in front of Hobert became illusory, and he stepped into the void.
According to the guidance of the pendant, Hobert came to the place where Rex hid his treasure.
Under the night sky, this is a primitive forest, not to mention being sparsely populated, there are not many animals around.
Hobert put the pendant on the stone wall, and the stone wall cracked, forming an arch.
"Magnify!" Hobert magnified the hazy moonlight, making the light as bright as the morning light.
The "magnified" light was not wasted at all, and shone straight into the cave.
"Tamper!" Hobert also "tampered" with the light at the entrance of the cave to prevent the brilliance of the cave from shining outside.
In the cave, in addition to stacks of gold pounds, there were also many gold products and gems, which were Rex's trophies back then.
The corners of Hobert's mouth couldn't help but rise, and his eyes were once again dazzled by the light refracted by the gems.
Although his eyes would no longer be hurt by this, he still closed his eyes and enjoyed this wonderful moment.
Taking a deep breath, the air was filled with the smell of gold pounds and gold.
After smiling for a while, Hobert opened his eyes and began to look for suitable gems according to the list in his hand.
So half of the gems on the list were found in the cave.
Hobert looked at the list again. He still needed a lot of crystals and some large gems, so he could only go back to Backlund to buy them.
Coming out of the cave, Hobert glanced at the closed stone wall and suddenly realized that it was not a good choice to put all the loot in the "Nation of Disorder".
The risk is too high. If something goes wrong with the "Nation of Disorder" one day, all his loot will be gone.
Some Beyonder characteristics and sealed items should be placed here to hedge against risks.
But there is no time these two days, so I will talk about it in a few days when I have time.
Back in Backlund, Hobert crossed out the found gems and went to knock on Doeffis's door.
Doeffis, wearing pajamas, opened the door and looked at Hobert.
Hobert realized that it was already late at night, and he smiled and said, "Sorry, I woke you up.
"I have something I need you to do. Tomorrow morning, after you get up, go and buy some diamonds and crystals. This is the quantity and size needed."
Doeffis took the paper and looked at it: "I may have to go to the Southern Continent. Each of these large gems you want in Backlund may cost tens of thousands of pounds!
"There are many gem mines in the Southern Continent. A large rough stone like this may only cost a few hundred pounds there, but after you buy it back, you have to find someone to cut it yourself."
Hobert said, "Take the money from the safe, take as much as you need!"
Doeffis reminded, "There's not much left in the safe."
"There will be more when you go tomorrow morning." Hobert asked again, "Do you need me to provide you with a mystical item with 'travel' ability?"
"No need."
"Okay." Hobert waved his hand: "You continue to sleep."
He quickly came to the study, opened the safe and glanced at it. The gold pounds here in Backlund were indeed running out.
Recently, Hobert has hardly worried about money. The South Colson area can already be self-sufficient and can also support the construction of Longtail Island.
And most of the construction of Longtail Island comes from Hobert's investment. The 80,000 gold lire obtained from the transaction with Simpson have all been spent.
At the end of July, Hobert invested another 50,000 pounds, which can be spent for another period of time.
Similar to South Colson, Hobert plans to provide the original accumulation of Longtail Island alone.
Regarding the construction of Longtail Island, Hobert does not intend to use the money from "Earl's Light". The money from "Earl's Light" is on a separate account, which is different from Longtail Island and South Colson and other places.
And the expenses here in Backlund are a separate account, mainly Hobert's personal expenses and the daily expenses of the Earl's Mansion.
Hobert took out the last 50,000 pounds of savings from the "Nation of Disorder". He was still not panicked, because he had inherited a large amount of inheritance from Rex before, and also received a large amount of property from Christian.
These gold pounds piled up in the cave are also eating dust, so it is better to take them out and spend them.
The 180,000 pounds that were previously traded with the Tony family mainly used the money that Hobert inherited from Rex.
After taking out all the savings from the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert's total savings are still nearly 150,000 pounds, which is enough to cope with expenses for a long time.
And this is just cash. Rex left a large number of trophies, mainly gold and diamonds, which is also a considerable fortune.
...
This sea is often filled with thick fog, so it is called the "Fog Sea."
The Fog Sea is in the east of the North and South Continents, far away from the alleys of the two continents, or rather, far away from the entire human civilization circle.
But in the Fog Sea, there are many unexplored islands scattered.
Just like the island where Archibald took Hobert to hunt six-legged monsters before, it is in the depths of the Fog Sea, and even since the colonial era, no humans have ever visited it.
At dawn, the low altitude of a certain sea area in the Fog Sea suddenly became illusory, and a giant object floated down from the spirit world and fell into the sea.
Whoosh~
The sea water was separated by the giant object, creating a considerable wave.
This giant object is finally fully presented in the real world. It is the giant black ship "Black Emperor!"
At the front of the giant ship, there is a seemingly huge mottled stone chair, on which sits the huge "King of the Five Seas" Nast Solomon, wearing a black robe with silver trim and a black beard.
After getting up from the huge stone chair, Nast, who looked like a giant, changed his figure. The farther he was from the throne, the shorter he became, and finally became about 1.9 meters, only a little taller than normal people.
The crew members who had been hiding in the cabin quickly came out of the cabin and, under the command of the first mate, Bird Mustang, went to open the thick black sails and adjust the course of the "Black Emperor."
For a time, the deck became very busy.
They are sailing to an island in the Fog Sea that is not marked on the sea charts of various countries. It is the territory of the "King of the Five Seas" and his headquarters.
Nast came to the captain's room and sat on his throne-like seat.
At this time, a child of about ten years old in gorgeous clothes came with a tray carrying a bottle of wine and an empty wine glass.
Seeing this child, Nast frowned: "Child, who brought you on board?"
How could he not remember that there was such a small crew member on the "Black Emperor"?
The child, who looked a little immature, smiled slightly: "Tamara!"
Tamara made the little boy very compatible with this ship, without any imbalance, and even Nast's spirituality has not felt any danger until now.
But after hearing the name Tamara, Nast was suddenly shocked and immediately operated the "Black Emperor" to push the little boy out of the ship.
But he found that he could not control the "Black Emperor"!
"Don't you find it incredible?" The little boy smiled: "It was I who told Solomon about the existence of the West Continent, so he built this ship.
"Nast Solomon, the descendants of the 'Black Emperor', I am the real owner of this ship."
Although Nast didn't know who the little boy in front of him was, it was the first time in so many years that he had felt such despair.
But he did not hesitate at all, and immediately "distorted" the space, preparing to escape.
With a wave of the little boy's hand, Nast's "distortion" was "diluted" by the surrounding cabins.
But Nast's figure still became illusory. After all, he had possessed the "Black Emperor" for so long and had long prepared an escape plan. He just hadn't expected that one day he would actually use it.
Just as Nast's figure was about to disappear, Tamara suddenly appeared behind him. Tamara reached out and pushed Nast in the back, causing him to stagger and disrupting the balance of his escape.
Nast's figure gradually solidified again; his escape had failed.
But Nast did not panic because there was an angel present. He rushed towards the door of the cabin!
"Opening the door is forbidden here!" Tamara said calmly.
Nast turned around, staring at Tamara, who looked like a wax figure behind him. He pointed at the little boy: "Who is he?"
Tamara said in a flat tone: "You should say Him, not him."
Nast was somewhat surprised: "Why did you come to me?"
"Because your surname is Solomon." The little boy smiled, and he raised his left hand: "Everything, everything was foreshadowed in the Fourth Epoch."
Nast's spirituality only then sensed the great danger, but for some reason, the little boy's small hand seemed to have great magic, causing him to lose all his strength. This was the suppression of the Solomon bloodline: "No!"
He struggled to twist the doorknob and tried his best to 'distort' Tamara's 'prohibition'.
Finally, the door was opened, but Nast was not happy because the door only opened a small crack and could not be pushed open at all.
Bang~
The door of the captain's room closed. More than half a minute later, the door was pushed open, and a fifteen or sixteen-year-old boy came out. Judging from his appearance, he was the little boy from just now.
The boy came to the deck and raised his hand towards the sea: "Distort!"
The crew members had already felt the changes in the "Black Emperor" and jumped into the sea to escape. However, under the "distortion," many crew members who did not have time to escape, the thought of "escape" turned into "return," and they began to swim towards the "Black Emperor"!
"Hahaha~" The boy laughed loudly: "I succeeded!"
The plan for more than two thousand years has finally yielded results!
Tamara followed behind with some awe, looking like a servant.
"From today on, I am the 'King of the Five Seas'." The boy said: "What name should I take? How about Erebus?"
Tamara smiled: "A great name."
"Then next," the boy Erebus said: "'Black Emperor' changes course and heads to Longtail Island…"
"Wait a minute!" He suddenly stopped: "I 'recalled' the clues to that lamp."

Backlund.
Early Tuesday morning, Hobert dressed neatly and took a carriage to Earl Hall's mansion to pick up Audrey, who was wearing a long skirt more suitable for sports, and headed to the suburban power plant.
In the carriage, Audrey asked Hobert: "I heard from my father that several lords of the Gas Association will jointly submit a report to the parliament today."
"Don't worry about them." Hobert smiled confidently.
"Earl's Light" has so many shareholders who are parliamentarians, let them resist for a while. He doesn't plan to actively intervene in this matter immediately.
Hobert changed the subject: "Audrey, how much do you know about the Southern Continent?"
"It's a colony of various countries…" Audrey paused and smiled: "Most of my understanding of the Southern Continent comes from you."
Hobert nodded and smiled: "I have a plan to develop the Southern Continent. In the future, there is hope to bring peace there, but I need your help."
Audrey was stunned for a moment, then asked: "How can I help?"
"You'll know in a few days," Hobert smiled: "Now I just want to know, are you willing to help?"
"Of course I am!" Audrey immediately agreed: "If it can bring peace to the Southern Continent, everyone is willing to help."
Then she asked: "What are you going to do?"
Hobert said lightly: "Unify the Southern Continent."
Audrey was stunned: "Unify…"
"In terms of geographical situation," Hobert smiled: "The Southern Continent is easier to unify. First of all, its eastern part is a large area of plains, almost without any danger to defend.
"This is why the Loen colonial army was able to quickly expand its influence to the entire East Balam after occupying a certain advantage in East Balam.
"The northwest is the huge Star Plateau, which is the key to the Southern Continent. As long as this plateau is occupied, then the entire Southern Continent can be attacked wherever you want.
"The countries of the Northern Continent have been vying for control of the Star Plateau and frequent wars have broken out there."
Audrey realized that Hobert was serious: "But, but where do you get so many soldiers?"
"The population of the Southern Continent is not less than that of the Northern Continent." Hobert said: "Maybe even more, after all, big cities greatly affect the fertility rate of the Northern Continent."
Audrey still felt it was a bit unrealistic: "But, but the countries of the Northern Continent will definitely not let it go!"
"Of course I know." Hobert smiled: "Currently, I am just making preliminary preparations and then waiting for the opportunity."
Audrey didn't know how to evaluate it because this was a very unfamiliar area to her.
"Let's talk about the power plant." Hobert smiled: "In the future, the number of power plants will definitely increase, and there will even be several around each city…"
As they spoke, they arrived at the power plant. Audrey visited the huge boiler, the long steam turbine, and the generator at the rear of the steam turbine.
The power plant was prepared and sent a commentator to explain the entire process of thermal power generation to Audrey.
Audrey looked at the long steam turbine in front of her, which is a large turbine, and immediately felt a sense of industrial beauty.
Finally, they came to the cooling tower. Audrey also realized that the thick and large structure was not a large chimney, but a cooling tower.
What came out of the cooling tower was not white smoke, but water vapor.
Now Audrey finally understood why Hobert would laugh at the members of the Gas Association because they were completely wrong. The corruption generated by the power plant was not as big as imagined.
After visiting the power plant, Hobert took Audrey back to the carriage. He told her: "Don't mention the internal structure of the power plant to anyone. This is the most critical secret of 'Earl's Light'!"
Audrey nodded excitedly: "I understand!"
After visiting the huge power plant, she felt the power of "Earl's Light". It was not just a company that sells light bulbs, it also represented many high-end technologies.
Audrey asked: "Hobert, should we also invite those parliamentarians to visit the power plant? To prove that the corruption of the power plant is not that big?"
"No," Hobert said seriously: "Perhaps the purpose of the Gas Association's submission of the report is to take a look at the internal structure of the power plant.
"After all, as long as people with reason know that after the appearance of electric lights, gas lights have no competitiveness."
Audrey asked again: "Then what are you going to do?"
"Submit a report to the parliament on the air corruption caused by gas, and the dangers of storage and transportation!" Hobert smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 614: The Earl's Light in Audrey's Eyes
chapters.content:
