"First, we must understand one thing," Hobert explained to Audrey. "Whether it's gas, electric lights, or even candles, you have to choose a lighting method.
In a metropolis like Backlund, candles have long been eliminated by the middle class and nobles who have a voice. So, we can only choose between gas and electric lights.
The brightness and convenience of electric lights basically determine that they will win this battle. Safety and pollution don't really matter that much."
This is also why Hobert isn't in a hurry to counterattack. Once electricity appears, it will quickly form a wave of the times, which cannot be stopped by any individual or industry.
"If," Audrey said, "I mean, if the councilors unanimously believe that electric lights cause more pollution?"
She understood the faces of these politicians; they only cared about profit.
Hobert smiled and said, "Then don't blame me for being impolite."
To be precise, he currently doesn't plan to actively respond.
Hobert actually hoped that this matter would escalate, until the council members came to ask him to clean up the mess.
Also, it would be best if the Gas Association used some underhanded tricks, so that Hobert would have a breakthrough point for counterattack.
The two of them took a carriage to Hobert's manor in the suburbs. Of course, they wouldn't talk about such a disappointing topic during lunch.
After lunch, they took a walk in the manor and climbed the hill behind the villa along the road.
The location of this hill was very good. From here, you could see very far, even the buildings on the edge of Backlund.
But unfortunately, the gradually spreading thick fog blocked the view, making it impossible to see further.
Audrey sighed, "What a pity. Perhaps, as the butler said, it takes the blessing of the gods to see the panorama of Backlund from here."
Hobert smiled and said, "Let me try."
He stretched out his hand, and when he felt a breeze blowing forward from behind, he suddenly waved his hand: "Magnify!"
The breeze immediately turned into a violent gust of wind, whistling through the low air as it blew towards Backlund.
Hobert controlled his strength very well. The gust of wind didn't descend. It swept across the fields, forests, and suburban factories and towns.
Audrey saw from afar that the smoke coming out of the factories was quickly dispersed and swept away. Finally, the gale hit the pervasive fog, creating a huge gap in the perennial fog of Backlund.
She couldn't help but exclaim, "Wow! The fog of Backlund is like a cake that has been cut open and had a piece taken away!"
Hobert smiled slightly, "This wind can only reach that far!"
After all, he wasn't a Beyonder of the "Sailor" pathway, he had only magnified an ordinary breeze.
Audrey's analogy wasn't quite accurate. In fact, the scene in front of them was more like a stream of clear water flowing into a pool of muddy water.
The clear water created a clear area in the pool, but the power of the clear water was limited, only making a part of the muddy water clear, without changing the state of the pool.
But this was spectacular enough. Although Audrey didn't see the panorama of Backlund, she saw an incredible sight.
Because the gale was blowing from low altitude and didn't reach the streets, the fog above the roofs was blown away, but the streets were still filled with mist.
These mists gradually faded under the sunlight, looking somewhat magical. Audrey even seemed to feel the surprise shown by the pedestrians on the road.
However, before the mist on the street could be completely dissipated by the sun, it was covered by a thicker fog again. Therefore, the area blown out by the gale was gradually reoccupied by the fog.
Hobert sighed, "Backlund in summer is very uncomfortable."
Because there wasn't much wind, Backlund was shrouded in fog for almost the entire summer.
Under the fog, it was both stuffy and hot.
Unless it rained heavily, the weather would improve.
The two of them gazed at the top of the hill for a while before getting back into the carriage and returning to Backlund.
The official demigods in Backlund hadn't realized the danger, so they simply investigated the sudden change in the smog and then cursed in their hearts, "That kid is sick," and then there was no follow-up.
After Hobert's carriage entered Backlund, the fog here wasn't as dense as it looked from a distance. If you looked closely, you could still see the outline of the sun.
The carriage came all the way to Gear Avenue in the factory district, the "Earl's Light" factory.
Todd and Upton had already received the notice and were waiting at the entrance of the factory.
Here, Hobert took Audrey out of the carriage and met with the executives and worker representatives of "Earl's Light."
Everyone was stunned when they saw the beautiful Audrey. They only knew that the Earl was going to send a financial director, but they didn't expect it to be this beautiful noble lady!
After a simple welcoming ceremony, Todd and Upton got into Hobert's carriage and took Hobert and Audrey to visit several factories.
In the carriage, Hobert introduced them to each other. Todd and Upton were very polite. Currently, Hobert's relationship with Audrey had only been announced in noble circles.
Without media coverage, the spread of such information was very slow.
Although Todd and Upton didn't explicitly know the news, they also knew that the relationship between Hobert and Audrey must be extraordinary.
Under the leadership of the two executives, Hobert and Audrey successively visited the light bulb factory, the wire factory, the battery factory, and the parts factory.
The so-called parts factory refers to factories that produce crossbars, porcelain pots, and accessories for fixing wires on utility poles. Currently, this factory also assembles the main machinery for producing light bulbs.
According to Todd's report, orders for the battery factory have been increasing recently. Several factories in Backlund are already producing electric lights and wires, but they can only buy batteries from "Earl's Light" at present.
Hobert smiled and said, "Go full speed ahead with production. If that's not enough, add production workshops. We can only earn money from batteries for another half a year at most."
After half a year, many factories will definitely break through this technology.
Hobert had previously considered selling rubber at that time, continuing to manipulate the price and production capacity of batteries on raw materials.
But the sudden attack by the Gas Association made him intend to completely release the battery as a commodity, making the electric light market more active.
Finally, they visited the electrician school established by Hobert.
Although this school wasn't big, the opportunity to enroll was very rare.
In addition to the students recruited by "Earl's Light", the tuition fee was only a few pounds. Students sent by other companies were charged thousands of pounds.
In order to avoid recruiting people from other companies, each student had to sign a ten-year employment contract before entering the school. If they violated the contract, the penalty would be as high as 2,000 pounds.
For normal people, this contract was what they dreamed of. At least they would have a high-paying and well-paid job in the next ten years.
But for people from other companies, it was better to honestly pay the high tuition fees.
Even so, the opportunity to enroll was very rare. It was said that just one enrollment spot had already been saute to 300 pounds!
Audrey was somewhat surprised by this commercial phenomenon, but because she didn't quite understand the inside story of this industry, she didn't make any comments.
Now the electrician school has encountered a new problem. Many clergy from the Church of Steam and Machinery also want to enroll, and Todd doesn't know what standards to charge these clergy.
Hobert decided, "Charge them according to the normal student fee."
These clergy were more likely to be very interested in the related work of electricians. Currently, the entire Church of Steam and Machinery was still adopting a wait-and-see attitude towards the electricity industry.
First of all, it was because the rise of electricity was too fast. It had occupied a considerable share of the lighting market in just two or three months. The Church of Steam and Machinery was also worried about Hobert and the "Creator", so it didn't have any interest ties with "Earl's Light" and was still waiting and watching.
Secondly, the Steam Church had once expressed its willingness to understand "Earl's Light", but they weren't very interested in light bulbs and wanted to participate in the construction of power plants and related research work.
Hobert had "Earl's Light" politely decline. Although the power plant was facing many design and structural problems, he was more concerned about its confidentiality. The Steam Church also hadn't expressed enough sincerity later, so they hadn't cooperated for the time being.
Leaving the electrical school, Hobert smiled in the carriage, "This school can still continuously generate some income for 'Earl's Light'."
Because ordinary factories rarely set up schools, they only let experienced workers teach apprentices.
This method of training was too slow to compete with schools.
Finally, they visited the battery distribution and maintenance center, where carriages were constantly coming and going, looking even busier than the factory area.
Now "Earl's Light" had established a very complete distribution system. Especially after the middle class got off work, an "Earl's Light" carriage would always wander the streets, ready to quickly replace batteries with a wave from the window.
After Audrey finished visiting the entire "Earl's Light" industrial system, she couldn't help but sigh inwardly, "'Earl's Light' is truly a huge factory!"
Previously, "Earl's Light" was just a concept in her mind. Now she finally understood that "Earl's Light" represented production lines, workers with smiles on their faces, and galloping carriages.
Returning to the factory, Hobert convened a meeting of the "Earl's Light" senior management. At the meeting, Audrey was first appointed as the Chief Financial Officer, officially starting tomorrow or the day after.
Then, after discussing the Gas Association's matter briefly, Hobert had the company set up a three-person team to be responsible for this matter, collecting reports on the corruption caused by gas combustion and the dangers of gas storage, and then submitting them to the parliament.
Todd and the others felt that this handling seemed too understated and that the problem should be taken seriously. After all, most Backlund residents still used gas lamps for lighting, and their market share was still larger than electric lights.
However, Hobert had always been quite authoritative, and no one raised any objections.
The meeting quickly moved on to the third issue: building a factory in the Intis Republic.
"Upton is responsible for discussing this matter with the Intis Republic ambassador," Hobert said. "The conditions they offer are a three-year tax exemption and a 50% rent reduction, which sounds pretty good.
"Moreover, I heard that the Eternal Blazing Sun Church has always been very interested in electric lights. Although the Steam Church has never expressed its position, judging from their clergy's desire to enter the electrical school, they are also very interested in electricity.
"This time, we have received an invitation from the government of the Intis Republic, and almost all sectors of society in this country welcome us.
"Moreover, I have also contacted the Zaratul family of the Intis Republic. While I can't guarantee complete success, the resistance during the factory construction process should not be great. Perhaps the biggest obstacle to building a factory in Intis may come from Loen."
Finally, he said without rhyme or reason, "So we must take advantage of this opportunity of the Gas Association's protest."
Todd and Upton seemed to understand Hobert's meaning. They realized that those people from the Gas Association might be in trouble.
Most people didn't know Hobert's style of doing things very well and didn't pay much attention to Hobert's last sentence. However, they were very happy at this time, because the growth rate of "Earl's Light" completely exceeded expectations. At this rate of development, factories of "Earl's Light" would soon be all over the Northern Continent.
Next, they began to discuss the details of building a factory in the Intis Republic. Audrey realized that this was Hobert's main purpose for calling everyone to the meeting today.
After Hobert designated the main person in charge of the factory construction, the issue of funding was studied, because almost all of the massive funds previously obtained by "Earl's Light" had been spent on investments in the construction of power plants and the establishment of installation and distribution departments in other cities.
Now, the only large sum of money left on the books was the one that Hobert was preparing to misappropriate. He said it couldn't be touched, so everyone didn't mention moving the funds again.
Fortunately, light bulbs were already being prepared for sale in major cities. At that time, batteries, wires, and other commodities would still be uniformly distributed from Backlund. In other cities, only corresponding sales, installation, and distribution departments needed to be established.
It was expected that a large amount of funds would be coming in again soon, so this money could be used to build a factory in the Intis Republic.
With the funding issue resolved, Hobert instructed Upton to ensure the confidentiality of the power plant.
If the people from the Intis government wanted to visit, resolutely stop them. If they had a tough attitude, simply stop work.
The Eternal Blazing Sun Church probably wouldn't be too interested in the power plant; they might mainly be interested in the light bulbs.
The main pressure might come from the Steam Church. Hobert told Upton to explain to the Steam Church that unless their Archbishop came to talk to him, they were still prohibited from participating in the construction of the power plant.
In fact, the Steam Church's current reaction was somewhat beyond Hobert's expectations. He had previously thought that after he refused them for the first time, they would come with more sincerity to carry out a deeper level of interest binding with "Earl's Light."
But until now, they had not taken any further action.
However, Hobert estimated that it would be soon. Before, they would choose to wait and see to a certain extent, probably because they had found out that Hobert had a "Creator" background, and they must be wary of adopting deep cooperation.
But now it was different. The "Creator" had just flexed his muscles, and currently, both the Earth Mother Church and the Evernight Goddess Church held a default attitude towards the existence of the "Creator" forces.
The Storm Lord Church had only actively investigated the "Creator" but had never treated the "Creator" forces as enemies.
This should help the Steam Church make up its mind.
The meeting lasted until after four o'clock in the afternoon before it ended, and the basic tone for building a factory in the Intis Republic was set.
At the end of the meeting, Hobert told Upton to report upwards immediately when encountering problems that could not be solved, and he would rush to help as soon as possible.
Of course, Upton noticed that what Hobert said was "report upwards", that is, pray to the "Creator" and let the "Creator" notify Hobert.
Everyone sent them to the factory gate before Hobert and Audrey boarded the carriage and left.
In the carriage, Audrey was still a little excited and said, "Hobert, I didn't expect 'Earl's Light' to be so big!"
Hobert smiled, "I didn't expect such a huge enterprise with a scale of 20,000 people."
This was the truth. In his memory, he really had no concept of an enterprise with tens of thousands of people. It was only when "Earl's Light" developed to its current state that he realized what a concept a ten-thousand-person enterprise was.
Therefore, some time ago, Hobert suspended the expansion of the electric light business. One reason was that the power plants built in the major cities in the eastern part of Loen had basically been determined, and the other was to let "Earl's Light" settle down to avoid losing control if it continued to expand rapidly.
Audrey asked curiously, "Such a big factory, how big is its cash flow?"
"On your first day of work, you may have to deal with a transaction of 150,000 pounds," Hobert said with a smile.
Audrey smiled, "Praise the Lady! 150,000 pounds!"
Even Audrey, who had lived an aristocratic life since she was a child, had never seen such a large cash flow at one time because she had not been in business before.
However, although she sounded a little excited in her tone, she was not surprised.
Hobert didn't reveal it at this time, but changed the subject: "The demigod who came to support from another place will arrive tonight, and he will deal with that Sanguine with Mr. Moon tomorrow or the day after tomorrow."
When he was in the meeting just now, he had received Lawrence's prayer and gave a response on the pretext of going to the washroom, and he would pick up the demigod to Backlund tonight.
Hobert said, "Haven't you always wanted to participate in A Beyonder battle? How about participating in this operation? Try to hypnotize that Sanguine."
Audrey first said, "Okay."
Then she was a little worried: "Will I expose myself?"
"No," Hobert had already planned: "I'll give you my mask to use, so the other party can't see your appearance and it will be difficult to lock you with extraordinary means."
Audrey smiled, "I'm very willing to participate."
"After the plan is finalized, I will notify you which part of the task you are responsible for." Hobert then asked, "When do you plan to announce your advancement to the Psychology Alchemists?"
"Also tonight, and I'll also ask them for the 'Dreamwalker' potion formula."
"According to the style of most Beyonder organizations," Hobert analyzed, "If you are promoted to Sequence 6, you will definitely be reviewed by their highest level before they give you the Sequence 5 potion formula.
"When they take you for the review, call me to go with you. I don't necessarily have to eavesdrop, but as long as I'm there, even if I'm just admiring the scenery on the street, it will give them a lot of pressure."
Audrey was initially delighted, but after considering it, she quickly refused, "No!"
She said, "The Psychology Alchemists are a secretive Beyonder organization. Your appearance will scare them, and they may never contact me again."
Hobert didn't insist, "Then I'll secretly follow you."
"That won't work either." Audrey had already made her own plans and said, "Have you forgotten?"
She whispered, "I have Mr. Fool's protection!"
Hobert thought to himself: If you knew that Mr. Fool is currently only Sequence 4, you would know that I am more reliable.
He didn't insist anymore because Audrey wasn't the kind of girl who liked Hobert taking care of her meticulously. She had always been pursuing her own life and interests.
Hobert changed the subject again, "Help me tell Earl Hall that it was a pity I couldn't have dinner with him today. I still have many questions to ask him."
Audrey showed a very beautiful smile, "Mr. Hobert, when did you become so humble?"
Hobert said seriously, "In front of my father-in-law, of course, I have to appear humble enough."
Audrey's cheeks turned slightly red, and her eyes were filled with a smile, but she deliberately showed an unhappy expression: "Hmph."
Hobert laughed happily: This is so much fun.
After sending Audrey home, Hobert returned to his own Earl's mansion and, in the form of bestowing upon himself, took out a "Traveler's Door" from the "Nation of Disorder."
First, he went to Longtail Island to find a door, established the relevant connections, and then carried the door to the Southern Continent, and in a place that Lawrence considered very safe, established a connection with the door on Longtail Island.
So, on the way back, Hobert, with the demigod Chester and two Sequence 5s, first returned to Longtail Island through the established "Traveler's Door," then came to Southern Colson via Longtail Island, and finally returned to Backlund from Southern Colson.
Previously, Southern Colson had always served as a hub, but now it was different. Hobert's power was moving towards the Southern Continent. He planned that if the teleportation array could be used, he would build Longtail Island into a future hub for the North and South Continents.
Back in Backlund, Hobert first treated Chester and the others to a hearty Loen-style dinner.
While drinking tea after the meal, Hobert mentioned that the reason he had invited them was to deal with a Sanguine.
One of the Sequence 5 members of the Balk family said, "Those arrogant Sanguine are indeed quite annoying."
He might have realized that his criticism was too direct, so he changed his words, "I mean, although Sanguine have a glorious history, there's no need to always talk about it."
During the previous war, the Balk family and the Sanguine were in the same formation. Earl Rosalind realized that the Sanguine had to cooperate with the Balk family to avoid too many casualties, but the subordinates of this Sanguine earl did not realize this.
The Sanguine' performance at the time made the Balk family generally very dissatisfied.
Hobert smiled, "In the future, we may have further cooperation with the Sanguine, after all, we have a common enemy.
"Well, fortunately, although they are a little arrogant, they are not too evil, and most Sanguine are immersed in their own world and are somewhat simple."
Chester, who was in his forties and had some nasolabial folds, said, "We're just saying that, we don't mean anything else."
The Sequence 5 who had just commented on the Sanguine was also a little regretful that he had spoken his mind too quickly.
"I also think they are very boring sometimes." Hobert said, "Don't think that they are hesitating about cooperating with the 'Creator' now. If they don't seize this opportunity, they will regret it later."
The three members of the Balk family all felt much more comfortable.
After chatting for a while, Hobert asked Dophis, who had returned from the Southern Continent, to arrange accommodation for them, and then went to the study to pray to "The Fool," hoping to meet Mr. Moon alone in the Palace above the Gray Fog.
This reflects the benefits of the Sefirah Castle. Hobert's "Nation of Disorder" can only "send voice messages" and cannot temporarily create an environment for two people to communicate in real time, or rather, it cannot pull people in.
However, the "Nation of Disorder" also has its advantages. For example, when Hobert uses the stars of a certain believer to project power into the real world, he can completely skip the "Mystical Ritual" and directly project a large amount of power.
After "The Fool" Klein agreed, Hobert asked Mr. Fool to convey this meeting invitation to Mr. Moon.
Soon Hobert received Emlyn's reply, the meeting would take place at ten o'clock in the evening.
Hobert took out his pocket watch and looked at it. There was still more than an hour left, so he "recalled" the method of making talismans that he had obtained from Klein.
He planned to make a batch of talismans from the "Marauder" pathway when he had time recently.
Previously, Klein had fleeced the "Creator," and as a dependent of the "Creator," Hobert certainly had to fleece him back.
According to the information provided by Klein, a silver sheet can be used to make talismans.
So, he asked the servants to find some silver sheets, and after cutting them, he began to carve the corresponding symbols.
First, the "Pupil-less Eye" representing "The Fool," and then the corresponding mystical symbols were carved around the Pupil-less Eye.
After carving it, Hobert picked it up and took a look: "So ugly!"
I wonder if "The Fool" will be unwilling to give his talisman the corresponding power because the symbols he carved are too ugly?
Hobert smiled: "Distort!"
He distorted the ugly symbols to make them look much better. He simply threw the carving knife on the table and used the power of "Distortion" to let the carving knife carve by itself. The silver sheets carved in this way were much better-looking.
Just as Hobert was preparing to carve the third silver sheet, his vision was covered by gray fog, and he came to the Palace where the Tarot meeting was held.
This time, "Emperor" Hobert and "Moon" Emlyn did not sit on one side, but sat opposite each other.
"The Fool" Klein was still "listening in" behind the chair at the head.
This was Emlyn's first time coming here outside of the Tarot meeting, and he was still a little curious about the surroundings.
Hobert said, "This time, the Balk family has sent a demigod to support us. You should know him, it's Chester."
Klein, at the head of the bronze long table, sighed: The "Creator"'s forces are reacting quickly! They have sent a demigod to Backlund so quickly.
Emlyn nodded: "I remember him."
"Our operation can start at any time." Then Hobert asked, "What is the name of the target to be punished?"
"Ernes Boyar."
"Is there a good time to take action?" Hobert remembered this Sanguine viscount.
"He has been following me recently." Emlyn said, "And he always makes me aware of the stalking."
Hobert smiled, "That's great."
Then he asked, "Will Ernes follow you to Harvest Church?"
"No." Emlyn said, "He will stop following two or three blocks away from Rose Street."
Hobert pondered for a few seconds before saying, "First of all, our actions must be fast. We must end the battle quickly before the saints of your Sanguine can react!
"You may only have two or three seconds. Within these two or three seconds, you must get Ernes into Rose Street."
Emlyn asked, "Capture Ernes, and I'll carry him to Harvest Church?"
"Of course not." Hobert said, "I will arrange for someone to hypnotize Ernes and make him chase after you! All the way into Harvest Church."
He remembered that the members of the Tarot Club "originally" did this.
After Audrey was promoted to "Hypnotist," this was indeed the best solution.
Hobert added, "The problem now is, can you run three blocks to Rose Street in two or three seconds?"
"Of course! Don't doubt the speed of a Sanguine!" Emlyn raised his chin, but soon he became worried again: "But Ernes is Sequence 5, his speed is even faster than mine."
"That doesn't matter, you can make him not catch up with you while hypnotizing him." Then, Hobert asked: "When can you advance to Sequence 5?"
Emlyn replied: "I can advance now, um, to be precise, tonight."
Tonight is the full moon.
Then he explained: "But because Ernes has been following me, I dare not…"
"Advance boldly tonight!" Hobert said: "The higher-ups of the Sanguine will pretend they didn't see anything, and they won't even ask where the Beyonder characteristics came from."
Klein, sitting at the head of the long bronze table, also thought so: There's no need to ask, it must be from Hobert, from the power of the 'Creator'. After this matter is over, this Beyonder characteristic will be regarded as Hobert's sincerity, but this 'sincerity' needs Emlyn to pay for it.
He secretly glanced at Emlyn: Mr. Moon obviously didn't understand this point, otherwise, he could have taken the opportunity to write off the debt.
Emlyn said: "Then the Beyonder characteristic for advancement…"
"I will sacrifice it to Mr. Fool in a while." Hobert said: "Remember that 8,000 pounds of debt."
Emlyn said: "No problem!"
After determining the action time as tomorrow afternoon and discussing some action details, the two left the Tarot Club's venue.
After Hobert sacrificed a 'Scarlet Scholar' Beyonder characteristic to 'The Fool', he found Chester and explained the plan for tomorrow afternoon.
The next morning, Hobert first used 'Traveling' to come to Earl Hall's mansion, where a maid was combing Audrey's hair.
Audrey was a little surprised when she saw Hobert. She was about to give the servants around her a psychological suggestion, but found that the servants around her didn't notice Hobert at all.
In fact, Hobert had 'Distorted' their thinking, making them ignore Hobert's existence.
"The plan to deal with the Sanguine has been finalized." Hobert said: "The action will probably start at one o'clock in the afternoon. You must go to Mist Street before one o'clock to meet this person. He will arrange for you to take action at the appropriate time."
Hobert showed Audrey a portrait of Chester, and then he took out a wooden box: "Inside is a black crystal mask, which has very high anti-divination ability."
Next, Hobert told Audrey how to cooperate with Chester, how to hypnotize the target, and other details.
Audrey listened very carefully, immediately asking questions about things she didn't understand. After all, this was the first Beyonder action she participated in.
After explaining the plan clearly, Hobert smiled and said: "Good morning, beautiful lady, I won't have breakfast with you."
Audrey was a little helpless: "Shouldn't we say good morning right away?"
"Because I am the 'Assassin' of rules." Hobert smiled mysteriously, snapped his fingers, and disappeared on the spot.
Audrey smiled: Is this also a kind of acting?
The surrounding servants paused almost at the same time. Did there seem to be a man in the room just now?
They looked around, then smiled slightly, and all thought it was their own illusion.
…
Today, MI9 was going to hold a conferment ceremony for Hobert, so Hobert came to MI9 early and arrived at Georgina's office.
"You're here quite early." Georgina had already changed into the dark uniform of MI9, looking like a very majestic female general.
Likewise, Hobert was also wearing the MI9 uniform: "Not as early as the Director-General."
"Let's go." Georgina took Hobert into the carriage.
Once in the carriage, Hobert asked: "Aren't you going to confer a title on me?"
"Yes."
"The ceremony isn't being held at MI9?"
"If it's the rank of Vice Admiral, it will be held at MI9." Georgina said seriously: "You only need to invite some senior officers."
"But for the rank of General, you need to go to the Ministry of Defence…"
"General?" Hobert was stunned. Wasn't it supposed to be Vice Admiral?
But he immediately understood that this was the Loen royal family trying to win him over. Anyway, it was just a military rank, and they weren't really handing over the army to Hobert to command.
"Not only will we give you the rank of General," Georgina then told Hobert all the benefits promised by William I: "We will also give you a seat in the House of Lords."
Hobert nodded, this was very sincere.
But he considered for a while before saying: "My father is already a Member of Parliament, this conflicts with the relevant regulations of the Parliament."
Georgina said meaningfully: "No one will care about these things."
"No, no, no, I am a very law-abiding citizen." Hobert said.
Georgina thought there was something wrong with her ears.
"So, can I give this opportunity to become a Member of Parliament to someone else?" Hobert asked with a smile.
"Heh heh heh, I knew it." Georgina knew that in the Kingdom of Loen, in Backlund, no one could resist the temptation of being a Member of Parliament: "Of course you can."
Hobert nodded and said nothing more.
Of course, he would not deeply bind himself to the Kingdom of Loen, but it would be great to have his own representative in Parliament.
Arriving at the conferment hall of the Ministry of Defence, many senior generals had already arrived to observe the ceremony. Among them were many shareholders of Emlyn and others of the 'Light of Earl', as well as some colleagues of Christian, and many officers Hobert did not know.
After everyone exchanged polite greetings, the conferment ceremony officially began at around nine o'clock.
First, Minister of Defence Emlyn briefly described Hobert's military exploits. In fact, there were only a few things to say. The first was the battle record in Feynapotter City, and the second was the protection of Princess Alice, to avoid Loen Kingdom from making a fool of themselves on diplomatic occasions.
Everyone knew tacitly that this was a kind of bribery. Some people probably knew why the royal family wanted to buy off Hobert, but most people didn't know.
Then, Georgina read out the King's commendation order, as well as the order signed by the King himself, awarding Hobert the rank of General.
Finally, Prince Jevington awarded Hobert the epaulettes and chest badge. Amidst the warm applause of everyone, the conferment ceremony officially ended.
At noon, there was a small celebration reception. Such social engagements could not be refused at all. Fortunately, the reception started very early and ended at around twelve o'clock.
Then, Hobert used the excuse of being unwell and agreed with Georgina to discuss the matter of the House of Lords member at three o'clock in the afternoon.
Georgina knew that he had something to do, so she just agreed and took the carriage back alone.
Hobert was about to use 'Traveling' to return to the Earl's Mansion when he heard Emlyn's prayer from the 'Nation of Disorder'. He sped up and returned to his study. He didn't have time to build a 'Spiritual Wall', so he directly entered the 'Nation of Disorder'.
Sure enough, the star representing Emlyn was expanding.
Hobert spread his spirituality over and saw Emlyn in a public carriage, whispering a prayer to the 'Creator', asking the 'Creator' to notify Chester to prepare to start the action.
Hobert sent a signal to Chester, and then glanced behind him. Behind him was a small but exquisite private carriage. Ernes was openly following Emlyn like this. No wonder even the slow-witted Emlyn could find him.
According to Emlyn, Ernes would usually stop following at Mist Street, because it was only three intersections and half a street away from the Harvest Church.
Today was the same. Ernes ordered the coachman to turn at the intersection of Mist Street, but it was too late!
"Distort!" A Sequence 5 member of the Bale family, 'Distorted' the thinking of the coachman and horses, making them continue forward.
Almost at the same time, Chester, who was ambushing on the side of the street, brought Audrey to Ernes's carriage in an instant with a 'Distorted' distance, and sat opposite this Sanguine Viscount.

chapters.content:

Hobert oversaw the entire operation from the perspective of "True Sight". The moment Chester sat down opposite Ernest, he activated the sealed artifact Hobert had given him, which had been seized in the recent war.
One of the functions of this sealed artifact was to temporarily merge the surrounding "Mirror World" with the real world. After Chester's "exploit" and "magnification", they could enter the "Mirror World" for a few seconds.
The Sanguine marquis Nibbs Odra, who shared vision with Ernest, could only see Ernest himself, as if looking at Ernest in a mirror.
Of course, he would realize that there must be something wrong with Ernest, but he didn't know exactly what it was.
The Sanguine's support personnel would definitely arrive immediately, so Audrey and the others didn't have much time.
"Disorder!" In the carriage, Chester first plunged Ernest into "Disorder"!
At this time, Audrey, wearing a mask, had pupils that turned into a very charming light gold. Ernest, who had no reaction at all under the attack of a "Lawyer" demigod, immediately fell into Audrey's "Hypnosis"!
"Magnify!" Chester immediately "magnified" the effect of "Hypnosis", which caused Ernest to fall into a deep hypnotic state.
Audrey quickly said: "You will immediately go after Emlyn, throw away all the mystical items and wealth on your body before entering the Harvest Church, and the hypnosis will be lifted after entering the Harvest Church!"
At this time, Emlyn appeared on the street. Without thinking, Ernest immediately opened the door and got out of the car to chase Emlyn.
Almost at the same time, the Sanguine's reinforcements arrived. When they saw Emlyn and Ernest chasing each other, they immediately realized that something was wrong. While calling Ernest's name, they quickly chased after him.
In the eyes of ordinary people on the street, they only saw a figure passing by them, and some people even thought they were seeing things.
"Disorder!" Chester on the carriage caused a brief "Disorder" on the road, and then immediately left with Audrey.
As a result, many strange things happened on the road. Some pedestrians were originally walking east but suddenly turned west, and some pedestrians were originally walking forward but suddenly walked to the stores on the street.
The carriage was the same. The coachman didn't know when he turned around. In short, when he came back to his senses, he was already heading in another direction.
This kind of "Disorder" also briefly blocked the Sanguine.
Leading the Sanguine to support was Countess Rosalind. Of course, she knew that this "Disorder" was blocking them and was also telling them the identity of the attackers.
When they chased into Rose Street, they found that Ernest was about to chase into the Harvest Church. No matter how they shouted, it was useless.
Just before entering the church, Ernest began to throw away all the mystical items and wealth on his body.
A "passerby" followed behind, catching all the things he threw out one by one.
Someone had already recognized the "passerby" as a Sequence 5 member of the Balk family.
At the same time as Ernest entered the Harvest Church, the members of the Balk family also entered the Spirit World.
The whole process was smooth and flowing. Even Rosalind, who was following behind the Sanguine, had no chance to stop all of this.
They were stunned on Rose Street for a long time before Rosalind said: "Let's go back."
Otherwise? Could they go to the Harvest Church to snatch people?
Although it is said that the bishop of the Harvest Church is only Sequence 5, no one knows what will happen the moment they step into the Earth Mother's Church.
Hobert withdrew his vision. The operation to punish the Sanguine Ernest ended like this. The entire plan was very successful in less than twenty seconds.
Back in the real world, Hobert came to the living room of the Earl's Mansion. Cheers, Audrey and other members who participated in the operation returned one after another. They didn't say a word and followed Hobert to a small reception room.
The Sequence 5 who picked up the mystical items took out all the spoils, including a ring, a ring, a ribbon, a red paper figurine, and a wallet.
Hobert picked up the ring: "As far as I know, this ring is a pair. As long as you wear this one, the other one can feel the existence of this one, so I will return this ring to the Sanguine, and you can divide the other spoils."
Cheers chose first, and he chose the ribbon.
Audrey chose second, and took the ring.
The Sequence 5 who picked up the spoils chose third, and took the red paper figurine.
The Sequence 5 who only distorted the minds of the horses and coachman and left chose the wallet.
Hobert clapped his hands: "This operation is a complete success! You can choose to go back immediately, or you can play in Backlund for two days."
Cheers smiled and said: "Let's leave. The Sanguine should have recognized us."
Hobert didn't try to keep them: "Come to Backlund again if you have the chance."
After sending them into the "Traveler's Gate", Hobert returned to the reception room and asked Audrey: "How do you feel?"
At this time, Audrey showed a little excitement. She held the ring: "My first trophy!"
"Let me see what abilities it has." Hobert took the ring. Now he doesn't need to enter the "Nation of Disorder". Just by using his level, his spirituality can roughly feel the abilities of a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, and he can clearly feel the abilities of a Level 3 Sealed Artifact.
Hobert held the ring and felt it: "It can enhance spirituality and speed up the recovery of spirituality."
This ability is not very good, but it is not bad either.
Hobert returned the ring to Audrey and asked: "Are you willing to participate in similar operations?"
Audrey nodded quickly: "Yes!"
"Next time, you will have to kill people!" Hobert added: "Kill the villains of the Aurora Order!"
Audrey hesitated for a moment before asking: "Myself?"
"Because it's your first operation, I will arrange for you to be an assistant to others. When you feel confident in yourself, you can act alone."
"Okay!" Audrey immediately agreed.
Hobert sent Audrey back, and then immediately came to a clothing store opposite the Harvest Church.
The first time he traded with the Sanguine was here. This time, Emlyn repeated the same trick, renting the clothing store for the afternoon again. After hanging up the "Closed" sign, he closed the door and waited for Hobert in the clothing store.
"This operation was very successful." Hobert said as soon as he appeared.
After seeing Hobert's face, Emlyn was finally 100% sure that Hobert was the "Emperor".
Emlyn took a deep breath: "Yes, very successful."
Then he recalled the scene of Ernest listening to Bishop Utravsky explain the Life Bible, and couldn't help but smile.
Hobert handed the ring to Emlyn: "Just say that Earl Hobert found it on the road, so that the higher-ups of the Sanguine won't lose it again."
Emlyn took the ring: "Will I... will I be punished by the Sanguine?"
"No." Hobert said firmly: "They will also reward you, and the rewards they give you may even exceed your imagination!"
Emlyn couldn't help but ask: "Why?"
"Because you are of great use to the entire Sanguine race!" Hobert replied: "For example, to contact me through you! For example, to contact Mr. Fool's forces through you!"
Emlyn thought about it and felt that it made sense, so he completely relaxed.
Hobert waved to Emlyn and left. He was still very busy this afternoon.
Back at the Earl's Mansion, Hobert changed into a tailcoat and took a carriage to Lord Bradley's mansion.
Lord Bradley heard that Hobert was visiting, and quickly came out to greet him.
Hobert glanced at his pocket watch and said: "Mr. Bradley, quickly change into formal attire. We are going to the Parliament Building today."
Lord Bradley thought that Hobert was going to take him to expand his network, so he quickly changed his clothes and followed Hobert.
Then he felt a little confused all afternoon. In the carriage, he was told that he would become a member of the House of Commons, that is, the House of Representatives.
At first, Bradley thought Hobert was joking, but when they picked up Georgina, the Director-General of MI9, they really went to the Parliament Building, and really got the medal of a member of parliament and the documents to enter and exit the Parliament Building.
And under the witness of the Speaker and several members of parliament, a simple swearing-in ceremony was held.
After being sent back to his mansion by Hobert, Lord Bradley was still in a trance. The identity of a member of parliament that he had dreamed of was obtained so easily!
A title can be bought with money, but a member of parliament cannot be bought with money.
The title is now just an honorary title, and the members of parliament are the real decision-makers of this country.
Lord Bradley still doesn't know what he did that made Hobert so satisfied that he gave himself a seat in parliament.
However, he is very sure that his decision to join Earl Hobert before this was a very, very correct choice!
...
Hobert left Lord Bradley's mansion and returned to his study to wait.
At about six o'clock, he finally waited for Emlyn's prayer to the "Creator": The Sanguine marquis Nibbs hopes to meet with Hobert.
This also marks that the Sanguine have finally ended their final probing and started to talk about cooperation with Hobert.
This meeting was still at the Moon Lake Hotel. Hobert met Nibbs, the person in charge of the Sanguine in Backlund.
He looked a little old, but he was still very energetic and looked very handsome.
The tone of this negotiation had actually been discussed before. This time, it was just a reconfirmation by the high-level officials of both sides.
Their cooperation is mainly aimed at the believers of the Primordial Moon, and the spoils obtained will be divided according to the contributions made by both parties.
Because the spoils of the Primordial Moon believers are more useful to the Sanguine, in return, if the "Creator" launches a Beyonder war again, the Sanguine will send elite troops to participate in the war and be at Hobert's disposal.
The deep cooperative relationship with the Sanguine has basically been achieved according to Hobert's plan.
Neither side mentioned what happened in the afternoon, as if that thing had never happened.
The next morning, Hobert woke up and stayed in bed until about eight o'clock. He had to get up, so he reluctantly got out of bed.
Using the "Traveler's Gate", Hobert came to Longtail Island. At nine o'clock, he presided over the next stage of the work meeting on Longtail Island.
Starting this weekend, Hobert will implement a series of plans on Longtail Island. The first thing is to launch a campaign to attack the Mountain God Church.
In fact, after the extraordinary war in the Southern Colson area, Hobert has been actively preparing and deploying for this.
First of all, Angus's first team was officially reorganized into the First Beyonder Brigade. After all, this team already has more than 30 Beyonders, and it is no longer appropriate to call it a "team".
At the same time, the Special Operations Department was also reorganized into the "Special Combat Force", which currently has Angus's First Brigade, Helen's Second Regiment, and Elliott's Third Regiment.
These three troops have been transferred to Longtail Island, with nearly 90 Beyonders, ready to go into the mountains at any time to search and wipe out the members of the Mountain God Church.
In addition to these three troops, there is also the Fourth Battalion newly established by the Tony family, and the Fifth Battalion sent by the "Temperance Faction".
The "Temperance Faction" was much more straightforward than the Sanguine. Soon Sharron gave a reply. The "Temperance Faction" formed a team to serve Hobert.
At the same time, when Hobert needs it, the "Temperance Faction" will also send elites to participate in the wars he organizes.
The condition is that if the "Temperance Faction" encounters an attack by the "Indulgence Faction" angels, they will be protected by the "Creator".
Currently, these two troops are receiving training from Dunn and Daly in Southern Colson, and they are also the Beyonder forces currently guarding Southern Colson.
In addition, the military, led by Archibald and Seel, has assembled 2,000 soldiers, including an artillery battalion.
After occupying the eastern mountainous area, it will be placed under military control for a period of time.
This is the first thing, and it is the most priority thing. After basically completing the combat mission, the second and third things will be carried out.
The second thing is to carry out land reform on Longtail Island, and launch a campaign to change customs and habits, using tough measures to change some of the bad habits of the local aborigines!
The third thing is to open the eastern port.
Since he has already "confessed" to Klein, Hobert no longer makes any concealment, and simply renamed the eastern port to Tutuja Port, and has been promoting the port throughout the Berserk Sea for the past few weeks.
It is also after the war is basically over that this port, which has been under construction for several months, will be opened.
At today's meeting, after Hobert made the final deployment, whether it was Angus or Seel and others, they all began to make the final preparations.
The current plan is to officially launch the battle for the eastern mountainous area this Sunday.
And the preparation that Hobert personally has to do for this is to design his own honorific name.
Hobert is already a "Rampage Mage", and he can already have his own honorific name, and he can respond to the other party's prayers within a certain area.
This is very practical in extraordinary battles. Hobert can understand the battle situation without entering the "Nation of Disorder", and make corresponding support in time.
As for what kind of honorific name to design, Hobert thought about it. First of all, he must highlight the point that he is the favored one of the "Creator", secondly, the two regions of Longtail Island and Southern Colson must be in the honorific name, and finally is the description of himself.
Hobert thought for a while, the first sentence must be: The favored one of the Creator.
The second sentence is: The Lord of Longtail Island and Southern Colson.
But thinking that the two places are quite far apart, he will try to see if this kind of design works for a while. If it doesn't work, he will simply call it the Lord of Longtail Island.
The third sentence begins with the description of his own abilities and himself. Because he is Sequence 3, this kind of description must have at least two sentences to successfully point to Hobert.
He thought about it, and the third and fourth sentences are: A mage who spreads rampage and backstabs order; Hobert Jeffrey who brings light to the night of Backlund.
Hobert took a deep breath and called Fors to help him try the new honorific name.
Fors was a little surprised after hearing this honorific name. She didn't expect Hobert to have an honorific name.
Then she curiously helped Hobert try it. Through the newly established "Traveler's Gate", Fors came to Tutuja Port.
And found a place where no one was praying: "The favored one of the Creator!
"You are the Lord of Longtail Island and Southern Colson;
"You are a mage who spreads rampage and backstabs order;
"You are Hobert Jeffrey who brings light to the night of Backlund."
At this time, Hobert on the west coast of Longtail Island immediately had the picture of Fors praying in his mind, and her voice was clearly heard!
So he responded: "I can hear it!"
Then Fors used "Travel" to leave Longtail Island and pray on the surrounding islands.
After leaving Longtail Island, the picture of Fors's prayer began to become very blurred, and the voice also became smaller.
Hobert could hear some of the prayers, but not others.
After Fors came back, she marked the positions that Hobert could hear and the positions that he didn't hear on the sea chart.
Hobert simply drew a circle on the sea chart, and then measured it with a ruler. It was about 300 nautical miles in radius with Longtail Island as the center, and it was almost to Blue Mountain Island where Bayam is located.
Then Fors went to Southern Colson again. Sure enough, she couldn't hear the prayers from there, but when Hobert also appeared in Southern Colson, he could hear Fors's prayers again.
After doing some more tests, the distance at which prayers could be heard was about 500 kilometers around the Lord's Mansion of Southern Colson. Similarly, after Fors left Southern Colson, the picture became blurred and the voice became smaller.
After thinking about it a little, Hobert probably understood that because he is the true owner of Longtail Island and Southern Colson, he can have corresponding connections with the spirit world in these two locations, so the two geographical locations that appear in the honorific name can be connected to Hobert.
It's just that Hobert has to appear in one of the territories to respond to the prayers in that territory.
This result is acceptable to Hobert. After all, he is only Sequence 3, and the two territories are too far apart to be connected together.
In the afternoon, Hobert returned to Backlund and tried it again. Although Backlund is also in the honorific name, the range in which prayers can be heard in this city is far less than in his own territory.
In other words, the two territories of Longtail Island and Southern Colson can anchor Hobert, and the range of prayers there is increased, but Backlund cannot, after all, it is not his territory.
...
Back at about ten o'clock in the morning, Backlund.
Audrey first whispered a prayer to Mr. Fool, and then took her maid Annie and golden retriever Susie, and boarded her own carriage to the home of furniture merchant Stephen Humphrey.
The carriage had just been driving for a while when a pale white beam of light suddenly appeared in front of Audrey.
In the beam of light, an angel bathed in white light and with twelve pairs of wings slowly descended, surrounding Audrey with wings with occult symbols, and then quickly disappeared.
Audrey's vision quickly returned to normal, and she glanced at her close-fitting maid Annie and the big dog Susie. They were unaware of the scene just now.
Audrey's mouth moved slightly, and her heart became unusually determined.
In less than half an hour, they arrived at their destination. Audrey's psychology teacher Islant led Audrey to the living room on the first floor as usual, while Annie and Susie were taken to the living room to wait.
But what was different from usual was that Islant came to the door of the living room and made a gesture of invitation quite solemnly.
Audrey entered the living room a little nervously, and Islant then closed the wooden door from the outside.
After entering the door, Audrey saw an old man sitting on the single sofa in the living room. He was wearing a blue-gray suit, his hair was all white, and he had a gentle and refined temperament.
Audrey knew him. This was the royal consultant, Hvin Rambis!
Of course, this old gentleman also has another identity: a member of the Psychology Alchemists's Council!
"Are you surprised?" Hvin Rambis asked with a smile.
Then he got up and said very gentlemanly: "It's a pleasure to meet you, Miss Audrey."
Audrey did not hide her surprise, and then she said with a complicated expression: "I don't know what to call you."
Hvin smiled and said: "Just like usual."
He pointed to the sofa next to him: "Sit down and talk."
Audrey was very careful to control her micro-expressions, took a small deep breath before sitting on the sofa, keeping a distance that was neither too far nor too close from the other party.
Hvin picked up his teacup and took a sip, and said kindly: "Don't be so restrained. It's not the first time you've seen me. I still remember two years ago, we had a very in-depth discussion on philosophical topics such as pragmatism at a ball."
Audrey maintained a slight smile and said: "I just find it difficult to associate you with a member of the Psychology Alchemists's Council."
Hvin smiled and said: "It's not worth worrying about."
Audrey was about to say something when she felt her spirit suddenly a little dazed, as if she saw seven pure lights containing countless knowledge, they permeated the heights and covered everything.
This is the sky of spirituality! It is the reflection of the spirit world in the mental world!
Below the sky of spirituality is a deep and dark sea. There are several islands near the sea, one of which belongs to Audrey herself.
At this time, on Audrey's island, there was an old man with all white hair and wearing a blue-gray suit, who was Hvin Rambis.
It's just that this Rambis has a gloomy temperament and no smile at all. His eyes have turned into golden vertical pupils, and he is observing the place below the sea level on Audrey's island.
Audrey frowned: Hvin Rambis is not polite at all, he broke into other people's "home" at will without permission!
At this time, Hvin sitting on the sofa said: "Before our conversation, let's talk about another topic first."
He asked: "Did you tell your boyfriend Hobert about the Psychology Alchemists?"

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 616 Audrey becomes president of the Society
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"No!" Audrey answered firmly to Hvin's question.
While speaking, she told her inner island: Is he so worried about me? Since I decided to join a secret organization, I have the basic awareness of confidentiality.
"Very good." Hvin on the sofa said with a smile: "I'm just curious, Hobert should be able to see that you are a Beyonder, didn't he question where your potion formula came from?"
"No." Audrey said firmly again: "We value maintaining each other's privacy."
Her "Mind Island" echoed at this time: Speaking of which, Hobert seems to have asked once, but didn't ask in detail, because he has more secrets than me.
Hvin nodded with satisfaction, and then asked Audrey about the process of summarizing the "Acting Method".
Finally, Hvin smiled kindly: "You are very talented, you have actually figured out the 'Acting Method' yourself."
He paused and then said: "However, before Sequence 6, we do not advocate using this method to accelerate the digestion of potions, so we will not teach it."
"Why don't you advocate it?" Audrey asked sincerely.
Hvin took another sip of tea before saying: "This will make the Beyonder unlike themselves, and some will even be assimilated by the remaining influence in the potion."
Audrey suddenly thought of what "Little Sun" mentioned: The most important thing about the Acting Method is: remember, you are just acting.
Then she felt that what Hvin said made some sense, but not entirely, because as far as she knew, she and Hobert had digested the potion quickly, but their condition had been very good.
Hvin put down his teacup and said: "You do have the talent and qualifications to apply for the Sequence 5 'Dreamwalker' potion formula. I will give you some tasks one after another. This is both a need for fairness and an exercise of your ability."
"Understood." Audrey had no objection to this: "What is the first task?"
Hvin smiled kindly: "A simple but relatively long-term task, each of your feedback counts as a contribution."
Speaking of this, he took a deep breath: "Pay attention to Hobert's movements, including who Hobert meets, what they talk about, especially some actions of Hobert's organization, even if you only understand part of the information, report it to me immediately.
"In addition, conduct long-term observation of 'Earl's Light', try to visit the power plant, and then tell me the internal structure of the power plant.
"Of course, don't take risks when doing these things. It's best to get some news, and don't force it if you can't."
Hvin seemed to habitually pause for a moment and then said: "Don't worry, we won't hurt Hobert, we just hope to start some cooperation with the 'Creator'."
This last sentence actually has no logical support, just a promise, but as Hvin on Audrey's "Mind Island" raised his right hand and pressed his forehead, Audrey actually felt that what he said made sense!
Then Audrey quickly woke up: If we want to cooperate, we can directly go to Hobert, so secretly asking me to pay attention to Hobert is obviously asking me to collect information about the "Creator" forces!
As this idea appeared, Audrey controlled her "Mind Island" and did not show any suspicious emotions in her heart.
Then she responded: "I am very willing to promote the cooperation between the Psychology Alchemists and Hobert."
Hvin smiled with relief, his eyes suddenly became a little deeper: "Given your identity and the environment you are in, you will forget our conversation, and anything will be conveyed through Istrant and others.
"When there is something extremely important to report, you will subconsciously visit me, using the reason of asking for advice on academic knowledge."
As Hvin said these words, Hvin on Audrey's "Mind Island" also repeated them, which caused some "rocks" on the "Mind Island" to change and rapidly sink into the ocean of subconsciousness.
But Audrey remembered the conversation just now clearly. She controlled herself and got up dazedly: "Yes, sir!"
After saying that, she quickly got up and left the living room step by step.
At the moment when she closed the door, Audrey instantly felt that there were two memories with certain differences in her mind. One memory had Hvin Rambis, and the other memory did not.
These two memories instantly merged, causing Audrey to feel confused for a few seconds, but she, who had been promoted to "Hypnotist", immediately sorted out the primary and secondary and the true and false, and reorganized every detail that had happened before.
Audrey sighed: What powerful mind reading and hypnosis. Although there is the blessing of the "Fool" angel, when recalling some things just now, it still feels like looking at yellowed photos, as if many years have passed.
She was first a little proud: So the Psychology Alchemists care so much about Hobert and the "Creator"'s forces. As Hobert said before, if he came with him, just getting off the carriage and looking at the scenery on the street would give the Psychology Alchemists huge pressure.
Then Audrey's mood was not very good. She didn't expect the Council Committee of the Psychology Alchemists to despicably "hypnotize" herself and let herself collect information for them.
...
In the afternoon, Hobert was drinking tea on the terrace, enjoying a rare moment of leisure.
However, as soon as he drank two cups of tea, he saw a carriage with the Hall Earl's family emblem entering the Earl's Mansion.
Audrey, wearing a plain long dress and an ordinary hairband, but still unable to conceal her beauty and vitality, got out of the carriage, and Susie jumped down after her.
Hobert got up and smiled: "Ha, Audrey, your timing is perfect. I'm having afternoon tea. Would you like a cup too?"
Audrey downstairs smiled: "Okay."
Then, Audrey walked upstairs, and Hobert went out to greet her. The two met on the stairs.
Hobert took Audrey's hand: "How was your first day at work?"
"Not bad," Audrey replied.
The two returned to the study together. The moment the study door closed, Audrey suddenly showed some grievance: "Hobert, I encountered some unpleasant things today."
Hobert opened his arms, and this time Audrey did not refuse and threw herself into Hobert's arms.
He hugged Audrey tightly and said: "Tell me, what was unpleasant?"
Hobert's solid arms made Audrey feel very comfortable and at ease.
After the two hugged for a few seconds, Audrey took a step back and said: "I did see the Council Committee member of the Psychology Alchemists today."
Hobert took Audrey back to the terrace: "Sit down and talk slowly."
Audrey sat on the terrace and glanced at the gardener who was taking care of the lawn outside. Her meaning was self-evident: Our conversation will be heard!
Hobert smiled: "It's okay, our voices can't reach beyond the terrace."
Just "tampering" with the propagation distance of the sound waves can achieve such an effect.
Audrey nodded before saying: "I went to see Hvin Rambis this afternoon according to the previous agreement with the psychology teacher..."
She briefly described to Hobert the experience of meeting Hvin Rambis.
After Hobert finished listening, he was silent for a few seconds before saying: "Have you ever thought about being the president of the 'Psychology Alchemists'?"
"Ah?" Audrey thought she had heard wrong.
Hobert smiled: "Just kidding, I've met Hvin, he looks very kind, but I didn't expect him to be so insidious behind his back."
Then he asked: "How do you want to punish him?"
Audrey sighed: "I thought about it just now, it's actually nothing, just hypnotizing me, it's not enough to punish him for anything.
"I just think that some of the Psychology Alchemists' performances are gradually becoming different from what I imagined."
Originally, she had always thought that the Psychology Alchemists were an academic organization, concentrating on studying topics in the field of psychology, and seemed not very interested in the struggles of the extraordinary world.
But after seeing Hvin Rambis, Audrey realized that the high-level members of this organization also had a lot of utilitarianism.
Hobert didn't ask where it was different, but suddenly said: "I'm going to form a 'Witch Research Society' recently, are you interested in being the president?"
Audrey was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "I'm not a witch."
"It doesn't necessarily have to be a witch." Hobert smiled: "This position needs someone I trust very much to take it.
"I thought about it and you are the most suitable. Although you are not a witch, those witches wouldn't dare to say anything."
Audrey's appearance was already comparable to that of a high-level witch. In terms of beauty and charm, she could leave ordinary witches behind by several streets.
No witch would have any objection to such a lady serving as the president of the research society.
Of course, there is also a key reason, she is still Hobert's fiancée, this is Hobert's "identity blessing" for her.
"Sorry, Hobert." Although Audrey was very interested, she felt that she didn't have the ability: "I can't..."
Hobert raised his hand: "Don't rush to refuse, listen to my thoughts first."
Audrey nodded, looking at Hobert.
Hobert explained: "I am a favored one who is highly regarded by the 'Creator', and I handle most of the real-world affairs for the great 'Creator'.
"These jobs make me very clear that the current structure of the 'Creator' Beyonder forces has five systems, from three extraordinary families and two Beyonder organizations.
"The war that just ended made me feel that the traces between families and Beyonder organizations are too heavy, which is an uncontrollable factor in some cases.
"So the 'Creator' hopes to join them with new Beyonder forces to neutralize the traces of families and organizations."
He picked up the teapot and refilled Audrey's tea: "The 'Witch Research Society' is a very critical part of this plan. According to my observation, Helen, um, that is a witch.
"She and her companions try to bring pain to evil forces or evil people, bring pain to themselves, and bring joy to their lovers, and they can still digest the potion.
"Currently, other than their lovers having to eat more tonics, these ways of digesting the potion don't seem to have any other side effects.
"I think these methods should be popularized, which may reduce many disasters in this world.
"That's why I hope to establish the 'Witch Research Society' to cultivate Beyonder forces loyal to the 'Creator' while promoting such methods of potion digestion."
Audrey sighed: "This idea is very... very great."
"Great is out of the question." Hobert smiled: "But it will indeed make this world develop in a good direction.
"Um, I think the gods that our own witches are loyal to are not in as bad a state as the 'Primordial Demoness', which will reduce the negative impact of this pathway's potion to a certain extent, and should not embark on the old path of the Demoness Sect."
He smiled: "Back to the question just now, the problem I'm facing now is that I need someone who understands the 'Acting Method' very well and who I trust very much to be the president of this research society."
Audrey hesitated, not immediately refusing.
Hobert said: "You can think about it."
"I'm afraid I don't have the ability." Audrey said her worries.
"At first, I only planned to recruit some ordinary people to participate in this research society, at most some 'low sequence' members." Hobert already had a relatively mature idea:
"After you are promoted to Sequence 5, recruit Sequence 7 members, in short, there should always be 2 sequences between the members and you.
"In addition, if you have management problems, you can come and ask me."
Finally, Hobert said seriously: "Ability can be cultivated."
Audrey was a little tempted: "Then what are we going to study?"
"Study how to digest potions quickly and efficiently! Study the true meaning of 'Witch'!" Hobert said: "For example, the first research topic is: only women can enter this research society!
"This should reduce the distortion between Beyonders and Beyonder characteristics, and help them maintain a good state."
This topic completely moved Audrey: "When will the research society be established?"
"It will immediately enter the establishment process when you are willing to be the president."
Audrey smiled: "Then it can be established."
"Okay." Hobert smiled: "I will recruit the first batch of members for you as soon as possible, and you will recruit the subsequent members yourself.
"As for the venue, I will rent a villa first to solve the accommodation problem of the members. After there are more members, I can rent a mansion in Empress Borough."
"Okay." Audrey then said: "By the way, in my conversation with Hvin Rambis today, the 'Acting Method' was mentioned.
"He said that if the acting method is used too early, the Beyonder's potion will be digested too quickly, and it is easy to lose oneself."
She looked at Hobert: "Our potions are digested quite quickly, will this leave any hidden dangers?"
"That old man's theory is not entirely correct!" Hobert said: "He missed a very critical factor."
"What is that factor?"
"Love and emotion." Hobert smiled: "Or rather, humanity."
He looked at Audrey with tenderness in his eyes: "I have considered before that you have played a huge role in the stability of my humanity, which makes my state very stable.
"I think such a role is mutual, and I should also let your humanity be expressed, which is enough to resist the residue of Beyonder characteristics."
Audrey smiled a little sweetly and shyly: "But, but Beyonders below demigods don't have divinity, do we also need to express our humanity?"
"In my understanding, Beyonder characteristics are anti-life and anti-humanity." Hobert said: "It's too cold and full of madness.
"So below demigods, what needs to be used to fight against is Beyonder characteristics, to be precise, it is using the warmth of life to warm Beyonder characteristics."
Finally, he spread his hands: "Of course, this is just my own guess."
Audrey nodded, feeling that this idea made sense.
This topic ended, and the two looked at the Earl's Mansion's large yard together.
The "weather" today was good. Although there seemed to be some thin mist in the distance, the sun could be seen and the temperature of the sunlight could be felt.
This made all the green plants in the entire Earl's Mansion look vibrant.
After more than ten seconds, Audrey seemed to have recovered and said: "Hobert, I also encountered another thing today."
She withdrew her gaze from the distance and looked at Hobert again: "Today, 150,000 pounds of funds from 'Earl's Light' were withdrawn in the form of cash, but I noticed that not a penny was missing on the books.
"If I'm not mistaken, this fund should have been 'spent' through the previous false reports on some investments."
Hobert smiled: "This is exactly why I asked you to go to 'Earl's Light'."
"Let me make fake accounts?"
"No, let you supervise whether this money is really spent where I want it to be spent." Hobert said: "Currently, there is a total of 500,000 pounds for this money, which will be transferred in three batches."
Audrey was a little surprised, 500,000 pounds! This is more than the property she can inherit. Her dowry when she gets married in the future is estimated to be only this much.
Hobert then asked: "Are you curious about where this money is spent?"
Audrey nodded immediately.
Hobert got up and said: "Let's go to the Southern Continent."
"Southern Continent?" Audrey was a little incredulous.
"Yes, Southern Continent." Hobert smiled and stretched out his arm.
Audrey took Hobert's arm with some surprise, the space in front of the two became illusory, and after entering the spirit world, they quickly disappeared in place.
After a transfer in Bayam, the two came to the Southern Continent, the upper reaches of the Hodis River.
Audrey saw a huge plain! She could also see the distant mountains and rivers. This was a huge basin. There was nothing else in the basin, just whole pieces of crops.
It looked neat and tidy, like a harvest was about to come.
Audrey looked at the farmers working in the fields and suddenly smiled: "It's a pity I didn't bring my paintbrush and canvas."
But Hobert said: "Let's go and take a closer look, look carefully, look closely."
Audrey noticed the strangeness in Hobert's tone. She took Hobert's arm, and the two used "travel" again to come to the field.
The people around were all "distorted" by Hobert's thinking and turned a blind eye to them.
When she came to the field, Audrey immediately noticed something was wrong: the farmers in the field were too thin! And many people were still wearing shackles.
She looked again at the surrounding crops that were growing very well, and was a little incredulous!
Then, Audrey saw several people from the Northern Continent sitting there chatting and smiling in the shade of the trees. Looking at their height and appearance, they should be Feysac people.
Bang~
Suddenly there was a gunshot, followed by the laughter of the Feysac people.
Audrey noticed that a dark-skinned middle-aged man was working a little slowly, so a Feysac man shot him directly.
The middle-aged man immediately knelt down, speaking the local language, begging the Feysac people for mercy.
Bang~
But his begging was useless at all. The Feysac people began to use him to practice shooting. The middle-aged man turned his head and ran, but on the fourth shot, he hit the middle-aged man's back.
So the wailing of the middle-aged man could be heard in the surrounding fields.
Audrey wanted to save people, but Hobert stopped her: "Years of high-intensity labor and long-term malnutrition have made him very weak and he is about to reach the end of his life.
"This is also the reason why the Feysac people will kill him mercilessly, otherwise slaves are valuable property and are generally not killed easily."
Hobert paused and then said: "If you save him now, what about in the future? How will he live? What should he do when he encounters danger again?"
Audrey looked at Hobert with some surprise: "Let's save the people in front of us first..."
Hobert rarely interrupted Audrey: "Audrey, look around, the entire plain you see no longer has self-cultivating farmers. It is either a Feysac estate or a local noble's estate.
"Those working in the fields are all slaves.
"If you come again in a year, you will find that there are one-third new faces, but the number has not increased much."
Finally, Hobert said: "This is a colony! You can't save them all!"
Audrey was about to say something, but Hobert said first: "During the Great Smog Incident in Backlund, I also felt that I could save one if I could.
"Later I realized that this efficiency was too slow!
"So I have been actively promoting the extraordinary war with the Demoness Sect. One battle has left them hiding in dark corners!
"I want to see who dares to create a great smog incident!"
Hobert pointed to the distance: "It's the same here, it's useless to save one of them! I don't even know where to arrange them if I save people here?"
Audrey opened her mouth, not knowing what to say for a moment. She suddenly felt that the Hobert in front of her was a little strange.
At this time, the middle-aged man who was wailing just now had even disappeared.
"Sorry, Audrey." Hobert said seriously: "I let you see the cruel side of this world, but this cruel side has always existed.
"Think about those homeless wanderers in Backlund, think about those children with big heads in the slums.
"I think you should take a look at the cruel side of this world."
Audrey took a deep breath before saying: "You're right, I was too well protected before."
Hobert finally regained his smile: "It's this era that has a problem, not you."
He said: "I plan to spend that 150,000 pounds here. The local earth king has been controlled by our people, and these invaders will also abandon the estate under the pressure of the governor's office.
"50,000 pounds of the 150,000 pounds will be used to bribe the governor's office. Of course, this 50,000 pounds is only temporarily deposited there.
"The remaining 100,000 pounds will be used to purchase agricultural tools, build some workshops for producing building materials, etc., so that people here have houses to live in that don't leak, so that they can eat enough, and in the future they can also be allocated a piece of land.
"The current annual mortality rate here is as high as 30%, and it will not exceed 3% next year!"
Finally, Hobert said solemnly: "Audrey, in the future, we will have more money to spend in this kind of place! I want to carry out large-scale construction and investment in the Southern Continent.
"Such investment may not have a return for decades, but it can save countless lives!"
Audrey smiled slightly: "Hobert, as I said just now, what you are doing is great!"
