chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 617 Nothing else to do, just to kill you
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Watching Audrey leave in a carriage, Hobert returned to the terrace, but the tea had already gone cold.
Audrey had experienced a lot today, but the 'Spectator' pathway had one advantage: she rarely experienced emotional fluctuations or problems due to life's encounters, so there was no need to worry about her condition.
Hobert knew that he needed to give Audrey some time to figure things out for herself.
Just as he was about to ask the servant to change the tea, Hobert suddenly heard the prayer from the 'Nation of Disorder'.
He first returned to his study and entered the 'Nation of Disorder'.
In the pool in front of Hobert, there was actually an unfamiliar star shining.
However, just seeing this star, Hobert knew who it represented. He spread his spirituality over, and sure enough, it was Xio, looking a little apprehensive.
It turned out that the investigation into the two Aurora Order members was over, and Xio was submitting a report to the 'Creator' in the form of prayer.
This timing was just right.
Hobert said in a mellow voice: "Give it to Hobert!"
Then he withdrew his spirituality, and through the expanded star, he observed again. Xio was stunned for a second or two, then immediately put away the information with great initiative, put on her coat, and went out.
So Hobert returned to the real world, asked the servant to change the tea, and waited on the terrace for more than half an hour before Xio arrived.
Xio still liked to wear men's clothes, which made her movements more agile, and coupled with her somewhat immature face, she looked like a seventeen or eighteen-year-old boy.
"Don't be so restrained," Hobert smiled. "I'm still me, still that Hobert."
Xio said: "It's different. You are now a Earl, and no longer that intern lawyer who went to the East Borough to investigate cases."
"Yes, I am a Earl, so I can now help tens of thousands of vagrants solve their livelihood problems at once, and I won't be able to only help my clients like before," Hobert smiled:
"You've stayed in South Colson for a while, you should know I'm not bragging."
Xio was slightly stunned, and sat on the other side of the tea table: "You're right, you haven't changed in most places."
Then she took out the information she had investigated: "The 'Creator' asked me to give you this information."
Hobert poured her a cup of tea before picking up the information and looking through it. Xio's investigation was very professional, with not only tracking records, but also summaries of their habits.
While Hobert was looking through the information, he thought of several assassination opportunities through their daily activities.
"Very good," Hobert closed the information and smiled. "The 'Creator' asked me to be your superior. In the future, I will directly issue any tasks to you.
"As for your reward, I think you need the Sequence 6 potion formula and Beyonder characteristics the most."
"I only need Beyonder characteristics," Xio said. "I have already obtained the potion formula from the Masked Man."

Christian, who was at the front, suddenly stopped and said to Hobert, "Before you inherit those Beyonder items, you must first inherit the clues about the 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristic!"

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 618 The Whereabouts of the 7 "Duke of Entropy" Characteristics
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert felt a surge of excitement in his heart. What he most hoped to obtain were clues about the 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic.
Then, he sighed inwardly: Rex truly trusts Christian! For Christian, this is a clue to the characteristic of a neighboring pathway at Sequence 2.
Christian glanced at Brandon, who was walking at the back. Brandon spread his hands: "Have you forgotten? I was also present when Rex was talking about this matter."
Christian 'hmph-ed' and continued to Hobert, "There are two clues to the 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic. The first is with the Balk family in the Southern Continent.
"I met people from the Balk family in South Colson before. You may have guessed that this family is a descendant of the Trunsoest family who hid in the Southern Continent.
"According to Rex, this family has an Sealed Artifact that can respond to prayers, shatter characteristic, and use the abilities of 'distortion' and 'tampering' to create a 'Secret Realm'-like place of dozens of square kilometers.
"That is a 'Duke of Entropy' level Sealed Artifact, but there are many restrictions on using this Sealed Artifact.
"First of all, to shatter this Sealed Artifact and use its characteristic, there must be a God-level existence to help.
"Secondly, the family's curse must be resolved before the Sealed Artifact can be obtained with the family badge."
Hobert nodded. Of course, he remembered the 'No-existence Town' that allowed the Balk family to settle down. From the beginning, he realized that it might be a 'Black Emperor' pathway Sealed Artifact.
Christian added, "The second clue is on Longtail Island."
Hobert was stunned: "Longtail Island?"
"That's right, William I should also know about this. I wonder if He deliberately sealed you on Longtail Island? Hoping to use you to obtain this characteristic."
Christian smiled and said:
"They may have had the idea of using you before, but they won't have such an idea now, after all, you have the protection of the 'Creator'."
Hobert nodded thoughtfully, then he thought of a question: Counting it, he already knows the whereabouts of four 'Duke of Entropy' characteristics.
The first is the Balk family's Sealed Artifact, the second is the Longtail Island one that Christian is about to talk about.
The third is with the Messenger Beverly, and the fourth is in the Tamara family!
For characteristic at the Angel level, there are basically a limited number. According to the fact that most orthodox god churches only have three Angels, in the case of a True God, the entire pathway has at least three Sequence 2 characteristic.
And within the body of the True God of the pathway, there is probably at least 4 Sequence 2 level characteristic. First, there is 1 characteristic when He advanced to Sequence 2 Angel, and secondly, the 3 Sequence 1 characteristics each carry at least 1 Sequence 2 characteristic.
Then there are at least 7 Sequence 2 characteristic. Hobert roughly remembers that the Sequence 2 characteristic seems to have a maximum of no more than 9.
Although the pathway Hobert is currently on does not have a 'Black Emperor', the 3 Sequence 1 characteristic are all in the hands of the Loen royal family.
And George III's advancement does not seem to have used the 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic.
Then, theoretically speaking, there are only 6 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic outside. Hobert currently knows the whereabouts of 4 of them, which is enough for him to sort out the context of the 'high sequence' of this pathway.
Soon Hobert realized again that the 'Black Emperor' pathway is relatively special. Solomon once forcibly recovered three Sequence 1 characteristic.
He only recovered the Sequence 1 characteristic, so it is equivalent to saying that the Sequence 9 to Sequence 2 characteristic originally in the Sequence 1 characteristics were separated.
Theoretically speaking, will there be 9 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic in the Beyonder world?
And among the characteristic that Solomon recovered, 2 of the Sequence 1 characteristic came from Tudor and Trunsoest respectively.
Although They became Gods one after another, They should still have at least one 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic in Their bodies.
When They fall, these characteristic should not merge with the 'Red Priest' or 'Justiciar' characteristic.
The 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic in the body of the Blood Emperor Tudor is likely to have fallen into the hands of the Night Emperor, and the 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic in the Night Emperor Trunsoest's body is likely to be in the hands of a certain orthodox god church.
As his thoughts fluctuated, Hobert heard Christian continue: "Rex found a clue in some historical materials and notes left by the Trunsoest family.
"A Trunsoest family Angel died in battle with the Bayam Empire.
"But His characteristic has never been recovered. At that time, it was suspected that it was obtained by the Bayam Empire and made into an Sealed Artifact.
"Later, through questioning Dophis... Well, Dophis should have told you his identity, right? Yes, he is a relatively core member of the Bayam Empire's royal family and knows many family secrets.
"According to Dophis's recollection, he never remembered that there was an Sealed Artifact corresponding to the 'Duke of Entropy' in the family, not even similar legends."
Hobert was slightly stunned: This Angel died earlier, perhaps He is... Forget it, I'll just ask Trunsoest directly later.
"So Rex followed this clue to investigate," Christian said, "Finally, he found Longtail Island and discovered traces of fierce Beyonder battles that had occurred on the island."
Hobert recalled that the location where he built the factory was obviously a place where Beyonder battles had occurred. Even now, it is still a wasteland, and the fertility of the land is not even enough to grow crops.
Christian finally said: "After a series of investigations, Rex can be sure that the 'Mountain God' on Longtail Island is the spiritual remnant of that Angel after His death.
"Rex roughly found the location of the 'Mountain God', but he encountered the seal left by the Underworld Emperor there. He tried many methods, but failed to break through that seal.
"According to the information obtained from Dophis, it may require the Underworld Emperor or the descendants of the Underworld Emperor... The descendants here refer to direct descendants. Dophis's bloodline is too thin and does not count as a direct descendant."
He paused and continued: "There is no need to think about the Underworld Emperor, He has already fallen. The other two pathways are that the seal can only be lifted by the direct descendants of the Underworld Emperor or Beyonders marked by the Underworld.
"According to Dophis, only the Underworld Emperor and the Death Consul of that year had the ability to mark Beyonders with the Underworld. This path is almost impossible to take, and the direct descendants of the Underworld Emperor have long been nowhere to be found.
"This characteristic is also very difficult to obtain."
Hobert finally understood why Trunsoest would say that this characteristic was easier for him to obtain, because he was marked by the power of the Underworld by Mr. Azik, the former Death Consul. That was Mr. Azik's wedding gift to him.
However, Hobert did not mention this matter at the moment, but asked: "Why did the Underworld Emperor only seal that fallen Angel back then? Instead of taking the corresponding characteristic or Sealed Artifact to use?"
Christian smiled: "I don't know about this. I only know that because of the Underworld Emperor's seal, the spiritual remnant of that Angel can only penetrate the power of Sequence 3."
Hobert nodded and asked again: "How can I find that Sealed Artifact, or the Underworld Emperor's seal?"
"According to Rex, you need to use some of the abilities of the 'Frenzied Mage' when the 'Mountain God' actively displays power to find it," Christian replied:
"This may require a long wait, because sometimes the 'Mountain God' will not show his power for several years in a row."
Hobert immediately thought: When the "Mountain God" uses his abilities, he can try to find it with "Affinity".
Then he said in his heart: I will destroy the Mountain God Church recently, so I am not afraid that the "Mountain God" will not take action.
At this time, Brandon behind him said: "I have been looking for the descendants of the Underworld Emperor all these years, and finally found one in Tingen City, Loen. He seems to be an 'Undying', and has forgotten that he is a descendant of the Underworld Emperor."
Speaking of this, he smiled helplessly: "But the strange thing is that I can't contact him recently, and I can't divine the mark I secretly made on him."
Hobert 'oh-ed' and smiled: "Thank you."
At the same time, he thought: The one you found wouldn't be Mr. Azik, would it? He, oh, no, He is now in a deep sleep and has basically recovered his power, so your mark disappeared, right?
However, Hobert was still very grateful to Brandon, because if he started with the direct descendants of the Underworld Emperor, Mr. Azik would not be easy to find, and he might follow this direction to the Southern Continent.
Brandon must have put a lot of effort into this to find Mr. Azik.
Christian in the front said: "Okay, let's open the stone door."
Brandon took a step forward, and the two of them pushed open the stone door, one on each side.
As soon as the door opened, Hobert felt the colorful brilliance inside. The three of them entered the door together, and Hobert first saw the Beyonder characteristics that emitted various colors.
They were placed on six different stone tables. Above each stone table, some gray stones were used to form small squares. Each small square contained a Beyonder characteristic.
Hobert noticed that these stones were somewhat special and should have the characteristic of not easily fusing with Beyonder characteristics.
Beyonder characteristics below the demigod level are basically relatively stable. Only some Beyonder characteristics with strong spiritual remnants are easy to fuse with their containers.
Beyonder characteristics with less severe spiritual remnants will not experience such a situation even after hundreds of years.
However, Beyonder characteristics at the demigod level are not very stable. If they are placed in ordinary containers for a long time, there is a certain probability that some fusion phenomena will occur, turning into an Sealed Artifact with particularly severe negative effects.
If there are still spiritual remnants in the Beyonder characteristics, then the corresponding fusion will definitely occur!
Continuing forward, there were many more tables with many stone or wooden boxes on them. Hobert guessed that there might be some Sealed Artifacts inside.
But it seemed a bit too much. There were eight stone tables filled with boxes of all sizes.
There were a total of fourteen tables in the entire stone room. They were arranged in a circle, enclosing a small space in the middle of the stone room.
In the middle of the circle was a smaller stone table with only two small wooden boxes on it.
Christian stepped forward, opened one of the wooden boxes, and handed Hobert a booklet: "This is the list, check it against it."
Hobert opened the booklet and took a quick glance. He realized why there were so many wooden boxes in the stone room. It turned out that some of the things were books, notes, and royal utensils inherited from the Trunsoest family.
However, there were also many kinds of Sealed Artifacts, a total of three tables. The remaining five tables were all the Trunsoest family's legacy, all priceless antiques, but they hardly carried any Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert closed the booklet and smiled: "I'll check it later."
Brandon opened another box and took out a pure black badge that was two circles larger than a 1-pound coin. The pattern engraved on it was a crown. This was the Trunsoest family's coat of arms.
He said: "This is the family badge representing the identity of an orthodox Trunsoest member. There are at most only five left now. This one will be inherited by you.
"You can use this family badge to gain the trust of the Balk family in the Southern Continent, or any branch of the Trunsoest family."
Hobert solemnly took the family badge and suddenly felt that his spirituality had a certain connection with this badge!
The family badge emitted a faint black light, and the crown engraved in the middle became very three-dimensional.
Hobert restrained his spirituality, the faint light disappeared, and the three-dimensional crown returned to a flat pattern.
He sighed in his heart: In an unexpected situation, he did a "paternity test".
Christian smiled: "Okay, this is all the legacy Rex left you. I think it should be of great help to your career."
Hobert nodded: "Indeed."
The money he left him before played a big role.
"Check it yourself," Christian said: "We won't disturb you."
Brandon also nodded and left with Christian.
Hobert took a deep breath and smiled as he checked the list in detail. The first few pages recorded the list of antiques.
He casually opened a box and looked at it. They were all relatively easy to carry and exquisitely crafted works of art. At first glance, they were very valuable. This was the foundation of the royal family.
The Sealed Artifacts ranged from Grade 1 to 3. Because Hobert now has two Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, and both of these Sealed Artifacts can be used for 3 minutes after the seal is lifted, he now rarely uses Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts.
So he temporarily plans to let these Sealed Artifacts stay here.
In addition, there are some very high-level materials, including the blood of the Black Scale Emperor Crystal Gold Beast and the bile of the Jade Blood Emperor Crystal Gold Beast. These are auxiliary Ingredients for advancing to the 'Duke of Entropy'.
They are all sealed by special means to prevent them from losing their spirituality.
Hobert sighed in his heart: Suddenly, he had the feeling that he didn't have to work hard in the future and could just happily live off his inheritance.
Finally, there is the list of Beyonder characteristics, most of which are characteristics of the 'Corpse Collector', 'Hunter', 'Prisoner', and 'Arbiter' pathways.
The 'Corpse Collector' and 'Prisoner' pathways came from the spoils of the battles against the Bayam Empire and the Highlands Kingdom respectively.
The 'Hunter' and 'Arbiter' pathways came from the battles against the colonial armies of Intis, Feysac, and Feysac respectively.
Among them were even 3 demigod-level Beyonder characteristics. Below the demigod level, most were "low sequence" Beyonder characteristics. Except for those from the Arbiter pathway, Hobert didn't need the Beyonder characteristics from other pathways for the time being.
Hobert looked around and sighed inwardly: In terms of value alone, these mystical items were dozens, even hundreds of times more valuable than the properties he inherited last time.
After all, a very ordinary Grade 1 Sealed Artifact could easily sell for 100,000 pounds.
Then, Hobert sighed again: If I had children and knew I was going to die soon, I could leave them such a rich inheritance…
Bah!
It's property!
Hobert smiled and turned to the last page of the list.
There were a few seemingly flamboyant sentences on it, which Hobert had seen before. This was Rex's handwriting.
He immediately "modified" the brightness of the light in the stone chamber so that he could clearly see the first sentence written on it: When you see this list, I must have failed. Your mother seems to have a significant secret. She may be the key to unlocking the family curse. If she doesn't come to find you, then find her and get help from her.
Hobert took a deep breath: No wonder so many organizations chose to invest in Rex. Even if he wasn't affected by Trunsoest and his fate had changed to some extent, this keen intuition alone gave him the demeanor of a "chosen one."
What a pity! Hobert sighed: The family's misfortune limited his development.
Because Hobert had already met April, he went directly to the second sentence: All my guesses about the family curse, as well as some other speculative notes, are in Box No. 6.
The third sentence was: You can always trust Christian and Brandon.
Finally, he wrote: Dad loves you!
Suddenly, Hobert's eyes blurred. These simple words made him feel Rex's reluctance when he wrote them.
Rex certainly didn't want to do such a dangerous thing, but when he thought that his child would suffer from the family curse like him, he had to fight for that last chance of survival, no matter how reluctant he was.
Closing the list, Hobert took a deep breath. At this moment, he felt a courage and determination he had never felt before: Completely solve the family's curse and prevent such tragedies from happening again!
Adjusting his emotions, Hobert went to find the box numbered "6". After opening it, there were several notebooks inside.
He took Box No. 6, closed the stone door, took out the two crystals from the groove outside, and watched the ground close on its own.
Hobert used "Travel" to enter the spirit world, marked the location, and returned to Backlund, to his study.
He put the box containing the notebooks on the desk, built a "spiritual wall", and entered the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert beckoned and summoned Trunsoest, who was sealed in the pool, again, asking him to sit opposite him.
Trunsoest smiled and said, "What? Are you ready to accept your fate?"
"Not yet." Hobert also smiled, chatting like an old friend: "Let me ask you a question, how many independent 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristics are there?"
He knew that Trunsoest definitely wanted him to advance to Sequence 2 as soon as possible, and he would definitely not hide information in this regard.
"9 copies." Trunsoest said almost without thinking.
Hobert nodded: "Every Beyonder characteristic at this level should know its whereabouts, right?"
"Of course, but I only know the whereabouts of 7 of them." Trunsoest seemed to have a great desire to chat: "In the early Fourth Epoch, 4 of the 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristics were in Solomon's body.
"The other 3 Beyonder characteristics were in me, Tudor, and a 'Duke of Entropy' member of the Solomon family, respectively.
"After Solomon fell, Tudor and I each obtained a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic, which meant that we each had 2 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristics in our bodies.
"The 3rd Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic was taken to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' by the True Creator. There were 2 'Duke of Entropy' characteristics there. Later, when Solomon was resurrected, he only recovered the 'King of Slaughter' Beyonder characteristic.
"The 2 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristics in the hands of the True Creator should still be in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'.
"The angel of the Solomon family was killed by us because a female member of our family was his wife, so the Trunsoest family naturally inherited that Beyonder characteristic.
"Unfortunately, this family member died in the 'War of the Four Emperors', and his characteristic is still in the Berserk Sea."
Hobert then said, "Was that family member named Megali?"
"Yes." Trunsoest smiled gently: "You have indeed found relevant clues. In my opinion, you should be able to obtain this Beyonder characteristic easily."
Hobert asked, "Why didn't the Underworld Emperor take away this Beyonder characteristic back then?"
"This has to start with Megali's life." The "former emperor", who had a somewhat bookish temperament, gradually became serious:
"Although she and the angel of the Solomon family were in a political marriage, they had a good relationship.
"After witnessing her husband being killed by the orthodox gods, the seeds of hatred were deeply buried in her heart.
"After she became the 'Duke of Entropy', she had been secretly planning to trigger a battle between the orthodox gods... or rather, to subvert the orthodox churches.
"It was too late when I discovered this, and I couldn't protect her. She was sent by the six gods to the front line to resist the Balam Empire. It is said that the God of Combat or the Evernight Goddess used her as bait to plan a trap for the Underworld Emperor.
"It seems that an corruption that even the Underworld Emperor could not resist was placed on her, but during the battle, the Underworld Emperor noticed this and had the Primordial Demoness kill Megali, and then the Underworld Emperor sealed her body and Beyonder characteristics."
Hobert was stunned, and suddenly felt that the danger index of obtaining this Beyonder characteristic had increased immediately.
He asked again, "What is the specific corruption? It can even contaminate the Underworld Emperor? Then the Beyonder characteristic belonging to Megali has also been corrupted?"
"I don't know." Trunsoest showed a helpless smile for the first time: "I only know that the corruption can easily be transmitted to the Underworld Emperor, but Megali was not very corrupted."
Hobert nodded, such a level of danger was still acceptable.
After all, Trunsoest still wanted to be resurrected in his body and wouldn't make such a joke.
Trunsoest took a deep breath and said, "Anyway, this Beyonder characteristic is the easiest for you to obtain."
Hobert asked again: "Where are the other 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristics now?"
"Tudor and I each have 2 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristics in our bodies." Trunsoest continued: "After we became gods, we each discharged one."
Hobert was stunned: "There is such an operation?"
Trunsoest smiled: "Otherwise, why do you think the angels of the orthodox churches are exactly three?"

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 619: Some Speculations about the Outer Gods and the Great Old Ones
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert didn't quite understand Trunsoest's meaning. Logically, a normal god would have to go through the Sequence 2 level. At this point, He would have a Sequence 2 Beyonder characteristic in His body.
After advancing to Sequence 1, He would likely have another Sequence 2 characteristic in His body.
So, when He consumes all the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics and becomes a god, theoretically, He should have at least four Sequence 2 Beyonder characteristics in His body.
According to Trunsoest, if a god of a pathway can expel Sequence 2 characteristics, shouldn't a church have eight angels?
Of course, this is on the premise that all Sequence 2 characteristics of that pathway have been collected.
But a new problem arises. According to Hobert's observation, the orthodox god churches don't seem to have that many angels?
Hobert said with some doubt: "Assuming there are nine Sequence 2 Beyonder characteristics, if all the Sequence 2 characteristics of the entire pathway are collected, the orthodox god churches should have five to eight angels."
"If there are only three angels, is it because the orthodox gods need at least six Sequence 2 characteristics to stabilize their state?"
"Firstly, even at the level of a true god, one cannot expel whichever characteristics one wants," Trunsoest said. "Generally speaking, a true god needs to have three Sequence 2 characteristics in their body."
"This should be influenced to some extent by the Law of Beyonder Characteristic Convergence."
"Only those exceeding three can be expelled. My situation with Tudor is special, but we can only expel one 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic under our own will."
"Fewer than three would affect the god's state. At most, the body can accommodate six Sequence 2 characteristics."
Trunsoest smiled and said, "You have such a naive idea because you've overlooked one problem."
"Beyonder characteristics not only aggregate but also tend to split."
"Although the tendency is not very obvious at the Sequence 2 level, there are always some Sequence 2 characteristics that are not under the control of the orthodox god churches."
"Just like I was once a 'Justiciar', I only grasped the whereabouts of seven 'Balancer' Beyonder characteristics. I don't know where the other characteristics are."
Hobert was slightly stunned. This was a problem of thinking patterns. Below the angel level, one can hardly feel the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence. At the same time, this made him overlook the tendency of Beyonder characteristics to split.
"But theoretically speaking, as long as they operate for a period of time, the orthodox god churches can at least control seven or eight Sequence 2 characteristics," Trunsoest continued. "But after the Second Epoch, the gods will avoid having four angels of the same pathway appear at the same time!
"So the upper limit of the number of angels in the orthodox god churches is three."
When saying this, Trunsoest smiled meaningfully.
Although he didn't say it explicitly, Hobert understood what He meant: Theoretically, a god can allow up to five angels of their pathway to exist.
But in the Second Epoch, there were too many painful lessons of being betrayed by subsidiary gods.
Even with only two or three subsidiary gods of the same sequence, there was a very high probability of backstabbing the main god. If there were five angels, not only would the probability of betrayal increase, but it would also be easy for the angels to "start a group" to assassinate themselves.
Such painful lessons continued until the Fourth Epoch.
For example, the former angel of the "Black Emperor" pathway in front of Hobert betrayed Solomon with Tudor, just to advance to Sequence 1.
So here, Trunsoest didn't say it too clearly, just smiled meaningfully.
Three is just right. Relying solely on their own strength, they wouldn't pose too much of a threat to the main god and could still maximize their own strength.
Like Trunsoest and Tudor, without the support of the Six Gods, even if they were given three times the courage, they wouldn't dare to betray Solomon.
Trunsoest continued: "I gave the 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristic that I expelled to my family member Valentine."
"I heard that he was injured in an encirclement by the angels of the orthodox god churches. After escaping, he was ambushed by Tamara. This Beyonder characteristic should be in the hands of the Tamara family."
"Tudor gave the 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristic that he expelled to his daughter Beverly. This girl died in the 'War of the Four Emperors'. According to some information we obtained, this Beyonder characteristic was not extracted from Beverly's body."
Hobert hummed in agreement. He was quite clear about these two characteristics.
"After Tudor died, I obtained two 'Conqueror' Beyonder characteristics and a sealed artifact corresponding to the 'Duke of Entropy' sequence. This sealed artifact is the second 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic that Tudor didn't expel from his body. Currently, this sealed artifact is in the hands of the Balk family in the Southern Continent," Trunsoest finally said:
"After the Six Gods surrounded and killed me, a 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristic or sealed artifact should have appeared on my corpse. That was the second 'Duke of Entropy' characteristic that I didn't expel from my body."
"But it's hard to say which church obtained it."
Hobert rubbed his forehead. It was indeed difficult to guess which orthodox god church had that Beyonder characteristic, after all, there were six options.
So, to summarize, the whereabouts of the seven Sequence 2 characteristics of the "Black Emperor" pathway are clear at a glance:
Two are with the True Creator; one is on Longtail Island; one is with the Tamara family; one is with the messenger Beverly; one is in the form of a sealed artifact with the Balk family; and one is in the form of a sealed artifact with a certain orthodox god church.
Hobert asked again: "Then where are the seven 'Balancer' Beyonder characteristics you mentioned earlier?"
Trunsoest patiently replied: "Among the three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics I obtained, each contains one 'Balancer' Beyonder characteristic."
"In fact, one of the 'Hand of Order' Beyonder characteristics originally contained two 'Balancer' characteristics."
"This Sequence 1 characteristic came from Tamara. This kid was very sensible. When he learned that the Six Gods needed all the 'Hand of Order' Beyonder characteristics, he betrayed his father."
"His condition was to ask the Six Gods to shatter that 'Hand of Order' Beyonder characteristic. He hoped to obtain another 'Balancer' characteristic."
"The Six Gods agreed to his condition because Tamara also bore the infamy of killing his father, which well concealed the Six Gods' act of cleverly seizing by force."
Hobert suddenly said: "Tamara betraying his father should have been discussed between the father and son, right?"
"I think so too," Trunsoest spread his hands. "This is the Beyonder world. You must preserve your strength as much as possible."
He continued: "However, the Six Gods have also been guarding against Tamara. Just when Solomon was resurrected and the Six Gods' attention was attracted, the premeditated Tamara led his clansmen to defect."
"After joining Tudor, Tamara helped a female member of the family advance to 'Balancer', and then used this 'Balancer' to marry into the Abraham family, which is equivalent to giving Mr. Door an angel!
"From then on, Tamara gained a firm foothold in the Tudor family and became the fifth largest noble family in the Tudor Empire."
"But to everyone's surprise, in the early stages of the 'War of the Four Emperors', the Lord of Storms and the Evernight Goddess joined forces to seal Mr. Door."
"The Abraham family disintegrated at a speed that surprised everyone, and the 'Balancer' who married into the Abraham family also died in the subsequent battle, forming a sealed artifact."
"This sealed artifact was seized by the Trunsoest Empire and is currently also with the Balk family."
Hobert nodded. He remembered that Lawrence carried a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact with him. This was the whereabouts of the second characteristic.
Trunsoest leaned back in his chair: "As for the other four characteristics, two are with the Augustus family and two are with the Castiya family."
"Originally, these two families each had a 'Balancer' characteristic. After the Six Gods surrounded and killed me, in order to strengthen the power of the countries they supported, they shattered two 'Hand of Order' Beyonder characteristics."
"They gave William and Philip one 'Hand of Order' and one 'Balancer' Beyonder characteristic each, which allowed these two families to each have two angels."
"As for the third 'Hand of Order' characteristic that I analyzed, it also contains one 'Balancer' characteristic, which is currently also with a certain orthodox god church."
Hobert smiled slightly. After such sorting, the situation of the adjacent pathways was also very clear.
"Thank you for your answer. I wish you an early acquisition of the 'Duke of Entropy' Beyonder characteristic." He made a gesture of invitation. Trunsoest didn't struggle at all and was resealed in the pool at the foot of the mountain.
Hobert carefully checked Trunsoest's seal before returning to the real world.
He sat at his desk and pondered for a while, still deciding to try to find the Beyonder characteristics left by Megali first, according to the previous plan.
If that characteristic had irremovable corruption, or the acquisition was very dangerous, he would go to the Balk family and try to exchange for the sealed artifact in their hands.
But this would definitely be difficult. If he used the identity of the "Creator" to acquire or exchange for it, it would be a bit too ugly.
After all, this was a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, and it was a family heirloom. Even if the Balk family had been incorporated, the "Creator" couldn't forcibly demand it.
And if he carried Trunsoest's family emblem and used the identity of a Trunsoest member to acquire it, there would definitely be considerable obstacles.
Regarding this point, Christian had said that the family's curse needed to be lifted to acquire that sealed artifact.
Then this regulation became a bit ridiculous. To lift the curse, one must advance to Sequence 2, but to obtain that sealed artifact, one must first lift the family's curse.
Hobert smiled and then thought of a bad idea: He could fool Lawrence into advancing to Sequence 2, allowing Trunsoest to resurrect in his body, which would lift the family's curse.
But soon, this method was rejected by Hobert himself. If Trunsoest resurrected in another person's body, it would be equivalent to Hobert creating a powerful enemy for himself.
The resurrected Trunsoest would also have the "legitimacy" to enter the "Nation of Disorder", which was very dangerous for Hobert.
After rejecting his own bad idea, Hobert opened the wooden box left by Rex in front of him and began to read the notes he had left behind.
The first notebook was about the relevant speculations about the family curse. The content of the notes ranged from the clues Rex found in the investigation to the conjectures based on these clues. The logic chain was very complete and very close to the truth.
At the same time, Hobert also knew why Rex could leave him so many sealed artifacts, because in the process of investigation, he had dug up many graves of Fourth Epoch nobles, from which he had obtained many mystical items for burial.
What Hobert thought was very wasteful was that Rex hadn't taken away the antiques in those graves.
The second half of this notebook was about conjectures on how to solve the family curse. Rex had thought of many ways, but after verification, most of them were not very feasible.
For example, asking the Earth Mother Church to help him refine a body. At the moment when he advanced to Sequence 2, and Trunsoest resurrected, he could transfer his spirit body and Beyonder characteristics to that new body, leaving his original body to Trunsoest.
But later, Rex had contacted the Earth Mother Church through April's pathway and found that this could not be done.
Refining a brand-new body was not difficult, but the process of extracting the spirit body and Beyonder characteristics was very complicated and could not be completed in an instant.
If he "backed up" the spirit body in advance and created another version of himself, it could be done after paying a certain price, but the Beyonder characteristics would definitely have to be given to Trunsoest, and the refined body would have certain limitations on advancement.
In the end, Rex concluded that sacrificing himself was the best way to lift the family curse.
But his strength at the time was limited. The sealed artifact of the Balk family with the Beyonder characteristic of the 'Duke of Entropy' sequence provided the family with the final protection and could not be moved.
Moreover, even if he forcibly took it, he would be hindered by the Balk family using two Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, and there was no chance of winning.
And after many attempts, the Beyonder characteristics of Longtail Island could not be obtained.
Rex, who was already in a very bad state, had to design a false advancement ceremony to create the illusion that he briefly possessed the angel's position, tricking Trunsoest out.
The design process of this plan completely stunned Hobert. It was simply using the ability of the "Frenzied Mage" to the extreme.
But at the same time, it was a bit heartbreaking.
Hobert sighed and closed this notebook. Rex's ideas gave him a lot of inspiration.
For example, the method of asking the Earth Mother Church to help shape a new body, could he temporarily give his bloodline and curse to the new body, taking advantage of this opportunity to advance to Sequence 2, and then immediately solve Trunsoest's problem?
Rex couldn't do this method, but Hobert could ask the "Fool" to help "graft", temporarily 'fooling' fate and the curse.
He remembered that after Klein advanced to Sequence 3, his "main account" had certain "grafting" authority.
Hobert decided that after Klein advanced to Sequence 3, he would discuss with him to see if this idea was possible.
If it really didn't work, he would wait until Klein advanced to Sequence 2, at which time he could master more of the power of the Sefirah Castle and should be able to complete the corresponding "grafting".
Hobert withdrew his thoughts and went to see the second notebook. What he didn't expect was that the first half of the second notebook was a conjecture about his mother, April.
Rex noticed that April occasionally had strange habits and thoughts, such as her having referred to the "Eternal Blazing Sun" as the "Sun God" more than once, and it was strange why the "Eternal Blazing Sun's" honorific name did not describe the relevant authority of "exploiting loopholes and stealing"?
But soon, April herself would wonder why she had such thoughts?
In his notes, Rex seriously suspected that April was a test subject in some experiment by the Church of the Earth Mother, and that there might be a wisp of divinity from some hidden being within her?
Later, some of April's other behaviors seemed to confirm Rex's guess. Initially, he approached April with a purpose, but after the two truly fell in love, April's strange habits and thoughts gradually decreased until there were none left.
In Rex's view, it was as if humanity had triumphed over divinity.
Hobert leaned back in his chair, thinking: 'In Father's records, Mother clearly mistook "Eternal Blazing Sun" for "Ancient Sun God." Could it be that she had a portion of the Earth Mother's divinity within her? Could Mother be a test subject for creating a vessel for the Earth Mother's descent?'
He scratched his head, unsure if his thoughts were correct.
Continuing to read, Rex also guessed up to the "divine descent vessel" point, and then there was no more.
Hobert continued reading, looking at Rex's conjecture about another matter.
After reading the second notebook, Hobert went on to read the third. He discovered that these notes were Rex's research crystallization on mysticism and the extraordinary world.
And it was very profound. Even Hobert, who had "obtained the answer," benefited greatly.
For example, Rex raised a question: Why do the pathways related to Order seem incomplete?
He cited the core authorities of the adjacent pathways of Death, Darkness, and Twilight Giant as examples. These three pathways seem to be an interpretation of "tranquility."
The Twilight Giant represents the process of decay and loss, which is the first step towards "absolute tranquility," representing the passing of life!
Darkness represents slumber in the night, representing the stillness of life. The world is constantly moving, deviating from the trajectory of things due to stillness, thus having hidden manifestations.
Death represents returning to the realm of the dead, representing the end of life, entering "complete tranquility."
Loss, stillness, end point—this seems to be the process of a vibrant life, or rather, the dynamic world and all things, reaching the end.
This idea made Hobert's eyes light up, because he remembered that the "Hidden Space" was in a static state.
From Hobert's modern perspective, it was as if there was a space where the progress of time and the development of events were frozen, so this space was independent of reality.
Continuing to read, Rex began to describe the core authorities of "Juscitiars" and "Black Emperors."
"Justiciars" maintain order, and "Black Emperors" Exploit and distort order. One maintains, and the other slays order, but neither establishes order.
Although "Justiciars" will also establish their own order to achieve better rule, their core symbolism is "maintenance."
After all, they are "Justiciars," not "Legislators."
The "Black Emperor" is the same. No matter how much they destroy order, it is a process of establishing a new order.
For example, in order to destroy the normal architectural style, the forced advancement of asymmetrical architectural styles is actually also the process of establishing asymmetrical architectural styles.
But for the "Black Emperor," the so-called establishment of a new order is just a side effect. His core symbolism is "Order-Slaying."
These three concepts are very similar; even Hobert had not noticed this before.
In this way, the relevant authorities of Order are not complete, and the part of "establishing order" is still missing.
Seeing this, Hobert smiled: I am the "Creator," the one who "creates" order!
In his impression, before the Han Dynasty, ordinary people did not dare to call themselves "Emperor."
This represents creation and pioneering.
Hobert smiled and said to himself: My self-proclaimed "Creator" also has a bit of the meaning of "Beacon of Destiny."
But then he gradually put away his smile, because he seemed to have thought of a very important question, but for a moment, his thoughts seemed difficult to piece together.
Hobert immediately realized that this involved some of his sealed memories. He immediately entered the "Nation of Disorder." Sure enough, many memories began to flood into his mind.
He remembered Trunsoest's description of the "Uncertain Mist" ability, which had a bit of the meaning of "words becoming law." "Uncertain Mist" seemed to be the "Legislator"?
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert fell into deep thought: According to my previous guess, the "Nation of Disorder" is a relatively special origin, half in Earth and half in the "Uncertain Mist."
Originally, the "Nation of Disorder" was complete; it was the origin of the "Son of Chaos." Later, it was torn in half. Does that mean that the characteristics of the "Son of Chaos" back then had a complete pathway related to "Order"?
The "Original Creator" tore the core symbolisms of "Maintenance" and "Order-Slaying" to Earth, leaving only the core authority of "Creation" on the "Son of Chaos."
Hobert also thought of the state of the "Genie." This Sealed Artifact seemed to be fulfilling wishes in a distorted way.
First of all, the ability to "fulfill wishes" comes from the Beyonder characteristics of the "Miracle Invoker" who sealed Him. Then, distortion represents that the "Son of Chaos" has the ability to "Order-Slaying."
This is not difficult to understand. After all, the "Original Creator's" tearing did not have a "balance," and it was impossible to "tear" so precisely.
Perhaps 0.9 portions of the "Justiciar" authority and Beyonder characteristics were "torn," as well as 0.8 portions of the "Black Emperor" authority and Beyonder characteristics.
And as long as a certain threshold is reached, such as above 0.8, it can constitute the characteristics required for the level of a True God.
Along this line of thought, Hobert also thought that the "Justiciar" pathway also has the ability of mental attacks, and the "Black Emperor" pathway not only has the ability of mental attacks but also the ability of "charm."
These are clearly abilities outside the core authority. In the long years, all the Beyonder characteristics that the "Original" tore to Earth have undergone a certain balance and replenishment.
In the end, the Beyonder characteristics that were torn formed a total of 22 pathways.
It may not be only 22 pathways, but these Beyonder characteristics are enough to form the threshold for 22 gods!
Then, the mental attacks and charm in the "Justiciar" and "Black Emperor" pathways are supplements from other Beyonder characteristics.
Judging from the fact that the "supplement" of the "Black Emperor" pathway ability is more than the "supplement" of the "Justiciar," the original "Order-Slaying" Beyonder characteristics and authority of the "Son of Chaos" must still have some remaining.
And later, in the First Epoch, the "Celestial Venerable," or rather, the "Mysterious," may have mainly mixed the authority of "Creation" with the origin of the "Son of Chaos" and threw it into the cosmos, forming the "Uncertain Mist."
So, the sealed "Son of Chaos" can still perform high-end "distortion" operations.
Thinking of this, Hobert suddenly froze: If my guess is correct, then my pathway and the pathway on the "Uncertain Mist" are adjacent pathways?
Hobert understood many other questions: This can also explain why the Outer Gods are so interested in the True Gods and high-level Beyonder characteristics on Earth. For them, that is likely to be an adjacent pathway!
These conjectures surprised Hobert himself, because he did not have such relevant knowledge in his mind, but the known knowledge seemed to point to this.
Unfortunately, these conjectures cannot be proven for the time being.
Hobert finally sighed in his heart. Rex did not have the relevant concepts and knowledge of the Outer Deities. If he had this knowledge, perhaps his research and conjectures would reach a rather terrifying level.
Returning to the real world, Hobert continued to read the notes, forgetting to eat and sleep, until Audrey came to visit in the afternoon, and he put the notes away.
In the study, as soon as the two met, Audrey said, "I heard this morning that the Hvin Rambis family died in a gas explosion at their villa!"
