chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 622: Hobert's Followers
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert examined the badge in his hand. First, he was certain that this badge contained the Beyonder characteristics of the "Black Emperor" pathway.
Moreover, the level of the characteristics was not low, probably at the "Frenzied Mage" level.
Looking closely at the pattern engraved on the badge, it was a solemn throne, the family crest of the Solomon family.
Behind the family crest was engraved a name: Anthony Solomon.
Based on the family crest and the name, Hobert could easily guess that this should be the badge worn by Megali's husband during his lifetime.
He further speculated that Megali must have asked the "Artisan" to "embed" the "Frenzied Mage" characteristic from her husband's shattered characteristics into the badge, turning it into a sealed artifact.
This should not be difficult for Megali to do after becoming an angel, after all, the "God of Artisans" had been supporting the Trunsoest Empire before and after becoming a god.
Because it was her husband's relic, Megali's evil spirit existed with it as the "foundation".
The Beyonder characteristics in the badge allowed Megali to stably exert the power of Sequence 3, and by "associating" it with the Beyonder characteristics of the "Duke of Entropy", Megali had the ability to discover and exploit loopholes in the seal of the Underworld Emperor.
Otherwise, how could a mere evil spirit break through the Underworld Emperor's seal?
Even if the Underworld Emperor had fallen and the seal had loosened, the Underworld was still providing power for the seal, and as an undead creature, there was no possibility of breaking through the seal.
But with the Beyonder characteristics in this badge, it was different. It made the evil spirit very advanced from the beginning and had a stable source of power.
If it weren't in the seal, it might even have the ability to leave the "territory" from the start, and when the opportunity was right, it might be able to go back and devour the "Duke of Entropy" characteristic, returning to the angel level.
Hobert opened his hand and let the badge float, injecting the power of the "Nation of Disorder".
Sure enough, the mental remnants in the badge began to shape their own image, forming a black shadow-like female figure.
This image was a bit illusory, and the face was not clear. It seemed to be wearing a gorgeous and complicated court dress.
The difference was that the phantom in front of Hobert had mystical symbols flashing with black light, giving people a very dignified and inviolable feeling.
After extracting the "Power of Order", Hobert took the badge in his hand again and felt it. Because the badge had a high degree of compatibility with the mental remnants, and the mental remnants were relatively strong, it could be used as many as 8 times!
Hobert smiled. This "angelic thug" was more like a subordinate of the "Creator" because she was aligned with the sequence of the "Duke of Entropy".
Currently, the negative effects of this sealed artifact were very strong, but after using it 8 times, the mental remnants would be basically eliminated, and the negative effects of the sealed artifact would also be weakened.
Hobert named it "1-113" and gave it the name "Solomon Family Badge".
Looking again at the "Duke of Entropy" Beyonder characteristic that was re-condensing, Hobert felt that the purpose of this operation had been successfully achieved, and there was even such an unexpected gain as the "Solomon Family Badge".
Just as Hobert was about to leave the "Nation of Disorder", he suddenly remembered Klein's operation of using the "Sea God Scepter" to become the new Sea God.
Hobert sat back on the "Iron Throne" and took the "Solomon Family Badge" in his hand again: Can I take the faith of the "Mountain God"? How can I operate it?
He used abilities such as "Connection" and "Exploit" one after another, but they only allowed him to better use the abilities in the badge, and he did not feel the connection between the Mountain God and the believers.
Hobert held the "Badge" in his left hand and tapped the armrest of the "Iron Throne" with his right index finger. One thing he was sure of was that since the evil spirit was at the Sequence 3 level, its state was similar to that of the previous Sea God Kalvetua. The prayers of the believers must leave some traces on it.
Even if the undead had been eliminated, the faith of the believers would still point to this badge that maintained the existence of the "Mountain God".
The main problem now was, how to tamper with these connections pointing to the "Mountain God" and transfer them to the "Creator" or "Lord Hobert"?
He tried abilities such as "Tampering" and "Distortion" again, but still gained nothing.
Hobert fell into deep thought again: The key is that I can't find the place to "distort" and "tamper", or rather, I can't find the connection between the "Mountain God" and the believers.
Just as he was thinking about this, Hobert glanced at the pool in front of him, and he suddenly had an inspiration, putting the "Solomon Family Badge" into the pool.
This pool had established a connection between the "Creator" and the believers when Hobert was at Sequence 9. It should have the ability to make the connection between the "Badge" and the believers more obvious.
Going to "tamper" or "Connection" again, he could indeed feel the connection between the "Mountain God" and the believers, like silk threads.
Hobert smiled. In this way, he could use the "Solomon Family Badge" to respond to the prayers of the believers, or actively "contact" the believers.
First of all, Hobert planned to turn the faith of the "Mountain God" into faith in the "Creator".
Hobert and Klein had different problems and needed to achieve different goals.
The most fanatical believers of the "Mountain God" and the power of the Mountain God Church did not rely on Hobert as much as the Sea God Church relied on Klein.
Because Hobert had basically killed them all. There would definitely be some who slipped through the net, but without the "Mountain God", they would be difficult to become a force.
Hobert's purpose was first to consolidate his rule. Faith in the "Mountain God" greatly affected the rule of the Governor's Office! So it had to be abolished. It was the most time-saving and labor-saving operation to simply have the natives convert to the "Creator".
Just as he was about to use the "Badge" to issue a divine decree, Hobert suddenly thought that the "Creator" did not need believers at the moment, but Hobert, who had already advanced to Sequence 3, had reached the point where he needed believers to stabilize his state.
Of course, his humanity made his current state very good, but what about after advancing to Sequence 2 and Sequence 1?
Could he maintain such a good state by relying on humanity alone?
So Hobert changed his mind. He used the "Badge" to broadcast to all the believers: "Your faith is the publicity of will and spiritual food, and cannot be stopped."
"The new lord of Longtail Island is another incarnation I use to redeem you."
"From today onwards, you will begin to believe in the Blessed of the 'Creator', the great Lord of Longtail Island!"
"My honorific name has also changed. When you pray or ask me again, you must recite the new honorific name:"
"The Blessed of the Creator!"
"The Lord of Longtail Island and South Colson;"
"The mage who spreads madness and backstabs order;"
"Hobert Jeffrey, who brings light to the night in Backlund."
...
On Longtail Island, which was still raining lightly, there was silence.
Today, the land of the native chiefs and village chiefs was divided according to the population, and they lost most of their property and wives.
And they could not take back these properties because soldiers helped to guard the fields distributed to the tribesmen.
At this time, they were looking at the gloomy sky outside with worried faces, silently praying to the "Mountain God" in their hearts, hoping that the "Mountain God" could kill those soldiers and officials and restore the original system.
Suddenly, a great figure appeared in their minds: "Your faith is the publicity of will and spiritual food…"
Not only them, but also the people who had just been allocated land were very confused.
From childhood to adulthood, they had been working for the chiefs, village chiefs, or people from the Northern Continent, and getting food from them.
Although they ate almost like pig food, and were always glared at and insulted, they never worried about tomorrow.
Because tomorrow would definitely be the same as today, eating almost like pig food, and always being glared at and insulted.
Suddenly having their own land and no longer having to worry about eating, they suddenly realized that the idea of considering tomorrow was so unfamiliar!
They also looked at the sky outside blankly, silently praying to the "Mountain God", hoping to get some guidance.
Just then, a great figure appeared in their minds: "Your faith is the publicity of will and spiritual food…"
They were all full of tears, kissing the ground while praying to the new "Mountain God" in the most pious posture.
"He is not the Mountain God!" Suddenly someone shouted at this time: "That is not the Mountain God, don't pray to him, don't pray to him!"
The shout was even a bit heart-rending, but it was useless. Someone had already received a response, and the shout was instantly covered by cheers.
Over the years, the natives had prayed to the "Mountain God" so many times, but very few could get a response.
Even if they could get a response, it was only intermittent, and they didn't understand what it meant at all.
This time, the response they received was very clear. That great and tall figure, full of oppression, must be the "Mountain God"!
No, it was another incarnation of the "Mountain God", the great "Lord"!
...
Time went back a few minutes ago. After the broadcast in the "Nation of Disorder" ended, Hobert simply tore apart the "silk threads" connecting the "Badge" and the believers, completely cutting off their connection with the "Mountain God".
Then Hobert returned to the real world, ready to respond to the prayers of the Mountain God's believers, to show that the "Mountain God" was "online" with another account.
But just after returning to the real world, Hobert felt that his brain was about to explode!
One after another, hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands of voices in the local native language filled his mind, as if he was in a venue with tens of thousands of people, everyone talking at once, and Hobert didn't know which voice to listen to.
Although he was mentally prepared, Hobert did not expect that so many people praying at the same time was simply a disaster.
The believers spoke in the local native language, with various pronunciations. Even the natives on the plains and the natives in the mountains could not communicate in language.
Hobert usually couldn't understand their prayers, and he still couldn't understand them now, but he could understand what they wanted to express.
Fortunately, Hobert was in good condition. He had just digested one-third of the potion, and the injuries to his spirit body in the previous battle had also been "bestowed away.
After being stunned for a second or two, he quickly responded.
First, Hobert used the ability of "Connection" to classify some similar prayers, roughly divided into two categories. One category was the prayers of the chiefs and village chiefs. They were very dissatisfied with the current land reform and hoped that the great "Lord" would kill those officials and soldiers, take back their property, and judge the proposer of this bad system and atmosphere.
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth. This matter had always been led by him. Would he judge himself?
For this type of request, Hobert uniformly told them: Those officials and soldiers were the new envoys of God, who came to save them.
However, the process of salvation must be very painful. Hobert told them not to complain, to do their own things, cultivate the land they had obtained, educate their children, and actively face the changes on Longtail Island. A bright future was waiting for them ahead.
The other category was the natives who had just been allocated land. They were very confused and wanted to ask the great "Lord" for guidance.
In fact, in order to prevent them from adapting to the new life for a while, the grassroots officials would read the responsibilities of the citizens of Longtail Island after dividing the land.
For example, cultivate the land allocated to them, if men and women are willing to marry, they must know how to take care of each other, and they must also take care of the children assigned to them or willing to live with them.
There were also some details of life, such as not sleeping in the fields anymore, not defecating on the road or in the sleeping room, and living separately from livestock or poultry, etc.
However, the drastic changes in the past few days made them unable to listen to these regulations for a while.
For their requests, Hobert simply took out the previously drafted documents and read them out.
Similarly, Hobert used Loenese language. The natives could usually understand at most individual words. They still didn't know what the "Lord" was saying at this time, but they could understand what the "Lord" meant!
After working for more than twenty minutes, the peak of prayer passed, leaving only some sporadic prayers.
Hobert temporarily turned off the ability to hear prayers and respond to prayers, otherwise, if it suddenly came like this in the middle of the night, it would affect his rest too much.
He sat down on the chair by the desk, took a sip of tea, and breathed a sigh of relief. Then he sighed in his heart: At the Sequence 3 level, it's enough to have a few hundred believers as a gesture. Having too many believers is useless, but it will make you feel very noisy.
Hobert stretched and couldn't help but grin again: "It feels good to be a god."
At this time, Hobert's bureaucracy had reacted, and Conrad came in the rain to report the abnormality of the natives.
Hobert asked them to observe first and maintain vigilance, and wait until the next night.
After Conrad left, Angus came to report: Just now, the "Mountain God" incarnated as the "Lord" and responded to the prayers of the believers on a large scale.
Hobert directly told him: "The great 'Creator' found and eliminated the Mountain God, and bestowed the connection between the Mountain God and the believers to me."
Angus was surprised for a few seconds. The "Mountain God" was gone just like that? Or rather, the "Mountain God" was so vulnerable in front of the "Creator"?
Then he smiled: What's so suspicious about this? The "Creator" was already very powerful.
Finally, he left with some excitement: the lord was no different from the "Mountain God." I wonder if I can get a similar gift to the "Creator" after I reach Sequence 3?
Hobert looked at the clock in the study, went to the candlelit dining room, and announced the good news to Fors at the dinner table that he had found Beyonder characteristics and replaced the "Mountain God."
"Almost all the goals of this plan have been achieved," Hobert said happily. "How about we open a bottle of wine? I haven't had a drink in a long time since you hid the wine."
He hadn't had a drink for several days, but that was because he had to stay 100% sober during the war.
Besides, Hobert drank a lot in Backlund.
However, when he said this, Fors was very happy first, waved to the servant to bring a bottle of wine, and personally poured it for Hobert.
Fors was happy, and the atmosphere of their dinner was very pleasant, and Hobert was also very happy.
At night, the two naturally stayed together.
After being intimate, they cuddled together and chatted like before.
"The last item of the plan will start the day after tomorrow," Hobert said. "After a series of plans are completed, Longtail Island should be able to be self-sufficient soon. After a series of constructions are completed, there may be considerable benefits."
"It's just that the construction work seems to never be completed," Fors smiled. "Like South Colson, they are still building railways, roads, and houses."
Hobert laughed: "The income generated by South Colson must be spent. Only the money spent can play the role of money."
Fors took one of Hobert's hands and played with his fingers as if playing with a toy. They had discussed this topic a long time ago. She was more worried about another issue: "Hobert, are we really going to open the business of streetwalkers in Tortuga Harbor? I mean, we don't seem to need to earn such money."
Hobert sighed, holding Fors in his arms: "We have to leave a way out for some women."
The origin of this business came from Dennis's report to Hobert when Hobert was preparing to recruit the first batch of members of the Demoness Research Connection.
For the first batch of members, Hobert planned to recruit girls from the East Borough who had difficulties in life and wanted to change their destiny.
But soon Dennis discovered that there were too many women in the East Borough living very miserable lives.
Dennis's simple report reminded Hobert of the social status and situation of grassroots women in India.
When he had just taken over the South Colson area, Hobert planned to completely eliminate this kind of business in his territory.
But Hobert had to face a cruel fact: there were too few jobs that could be provided for women in this era.
Many factories do not have jobs for female workers, and now female workers' jobs are being largely replaced by steam engines.
Especially the most bottom-level women who have little education and no background, even no one wants to hire them as maids.
In many cases, selling their bodies is their only way out.
On one side, they are struggling on the subsistence line, or even below the subsistence line, and on the other side, opening the business of streetwalkers in a certain city, so that some of them have a certain guarantee of food and clothing.
After thinking about it again and again, Hobert couldn't help but smile: What's there to consider? Before filling your stomach, propriety, justice, integrity, and shame are all extravagant hopes.
So after Dennis recruited twenty members of the Demoness Sect, Hobert asked him to recruit a large number of women from the East Borough who had difficulty maintaining food and clothing.
When recruiting, he directly told them that they were going to be streetwalkers, but 90% of the money they earned after receiving guests was theirs, and he assured them that no one would charge them protection fees in any form.
As a result, the applicants lined up in a long queue, because in the East Borough, not every woman has the ability to be a streetwalker, because they have no place to receive guests at all!
What's more, being able to get 90% of the income is enough for them to venture out.
Because even women who are "qualified" to be streetwalkers are tools for gangs and police to make money. It is already very good to get half of the money given by the guests.
They also have no ability to protect the remaining half.
Even women who don't know what 90% means understand that it is a lot.
"But what is different from other places is that in Tortuga Harbor, I will protect the safety of their lives and property," Hobert said. "And they must meet basic hygiene conditions, and if they get sick, they will try their best to treat them."
Fors said, "But I still feel very uncomfortable."
Hobert also smiled helplessly: "I don't have a better way. The jobs they can do in Backlund, South Colson, and Longtail Island are already full.
"If we don't do this, they may not live long in Backlund."
Finally, his eyes became determined again: "Let me bear the infamy."
Then Hobert sighed: "Actually, there won't be any infamy."
Because this is a legal industry in South Continent and the Rorsted Archipelago, and it is also a gray industry in North Continent, and has never been explicitly prohibited.
Fors sighed: "Why didn't I feel before that this era is completely a tragedy."
Hobert smiled: "Because our abilities are greater."
He looked at the ceiling and took a breath: "In the past, our abilities were too small, and the people in our territory lived in poverty, so we had no energy to care about others.
"Now it's different. Both territories are thriving and have the ability to help more people, so we see the tragedy of this era.
"But we still have to do what we can and not drag down our own development process by helping others."
Fors nodded: "I understand."
"In the beginning, you have to take the initiative to handle several cases of streetwalkers encountering," Hobert said. "Having such actions, in addition to making the port staff pay attention to the demands of the streetwalkers, also represents our attitude."
"Okay."
"In addition, you should come forward to establish some training schools and allow streetwalkers who are willing to learn some simple grammar and arithmetic for free," Hobert said. "Hold some blind dates regularly and encourage them to marry local people in South Colson and natives of Longtail Island."
Fors said, "That's a good idea."
Hobert laughed: "But South Colson and Longtail Island are so big, the population carrying capacity is limited, and it is now close to the upper limit.
"After this upper limit, this method will have no effect."
Previously, women on Longtail Island were sold to Bayam and South Continent, and a large proportion of men were bought to local mines, so the ratio of men to women was somewhat unbalanced.
At this time, Longtail Island can still "digest" some women from Backlund, but when the ratio of men to women returns to balance, it will basically reach the population limit of Longtail Island.
Finally, Hobert said: "Let's talk about the future later, let's do what we have to do now."
Fors "um" and fell asleep quickly. Hobert still looked at the night sky outside through the cracks in the curtains as before in a daze.
Occasionally, he could hear cheers from a distance. Hobert, who didn't have much sleep, was bored, but now he had something to pass the time: responding to the prayers of the believers.
This night was destined to be a sleepless night for the natives of Longtail Island.
The next morning, Hobert went to the fields again to inspect the progress of land reform, and soon he had a major discovery!
Many children running and playing in the fields were no longer shouting in the local dialect, but in pure Loen language with a Backlund accent.
This surprised Hobert very much. He called them over to ask them, but found that the two sides still could not communicate.
However, Hobert noticed that the Loen language that the children were repeatedly shouting was some of the words he said yesterday in response to the believers.
In other words, yesterday's response not only made the natives understand Hobert's intentions, but also taught them those Loen words?
The word "divinely bestowed" suddenly popped into Hobert's mind. This should be the most direct influence of the gods on believers.
Hobert thought, should he use the "Longtail Island Lord" broadcasting system to read newspapers to the natives when he has nothing to do in the future? At most one or two months, the problem of language barrier will be solved.
Anyway, the "Longtail Island Lord" is not the "Creator" and needs to maintain a certain mystery and compellingness. Reading newspapers is a bit exaggerated, but some policies can be completely publicized through broadcasting.
Another change is that many natives seem to understand that the person riding on that horse is the lord of Longtail Island. They salute Hobert from a distance or show gestures of submission.
Before this, when they saw Hobert, they usually looked at the earl with indifferent eyes and expressions.
This is the first time Hobert has so clearly felt the convenience brought by the extraordinary world. In his impression, it is very difficult to establish effective rule in such a gathering place of natives.
Because of the differences in values, language, beliefs, and customs, it is very easy to have conflicts with them.
Now it's good. Hobert is their belief, and their values and language will gradually move closer to Hobert under the influence of what they see and hear in the future.
The morning inspection made Hobert very satisfied. Longtail Island has basically restored order.
Some people have already started working in the fields, while others are repairing their thatched huts. Everyone seems to know what they are going to do all of a sudden, and they are no longer as confused as yesterday.
After returning to the Governor's Mansion for lunch, Hobert was just about to go to Tortuga Harbor when he suddenly heard prayers from the "Nation of Disorder". It sounded like Klein.
So he came to the study, locked the door, and entered the "Nation of Disorder."
Sure enough, Klein's star was expanding!
Spreading his spirituality over, Klein was praying to the "Creator", and the battle with Amon's clone was about to begin.
Through Klein's star, Hobert saw Klein walking out of the lavatory at this time...
Why is it the lavatory again? Is this really his Divine Kingdom?
Hobert smiled. Under the "Real Vision", he saw Klein turn his other room's marionette, Eunice, into the appearance of Gehrman Sparrow.
Klein seemed to be directing Eunice to do something, but a brief look of astonishment appeared on his face.
Even Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" was a little astonished, because Eunice suddenly put on a monocle, and then with a confident smile distorted open the door of the room where Klein was!
Even with the experience of fighting Amon's clone once, Hobert was once again amazed by the means of the "Error" pathway: Amon's clone stole Klein's marionette.
He, or rather He, curled the corner of His mouth, looked at Klein and said, "Found you."
Then He looked into the air: "Why do I feel this gaze so familiar? It seems this is a trap aimed at me!"
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth: Knowing it's a trap, why don't you run away quickly?
Eunice, wearing a monocle, was not flustered, but took off the crystal monocle and wiped it with his cuff: "There are too many anomalies in Flora Jacob's fate..."
Flora Jacob was the demigod of the "Marauder" pathway who died in front of Klein before. At first, he hid in the mansion of Councilor Macht next door. He was Hazel's extraordinary teacher. Later, because of the scare of the Arrodes magic mirror, he fled to the manor in the suburbs.
But because he was "parasitized" in the body of a mouse, his condition became worse and worse. Finally, when Klein learned that he was about to lose control, in order to avoid accidentally hurting innocent people, he went to the suburbs to solve this Jacob family demigod.
At the last moment of the battle, Amon's clone appeared, and Klein escaped at almost the fastest speed in his current life.
"...and those anomalies all come from this street," Amon's clone continued. "It's just that I can't see the source of those anomalies at all until I came into contact with the mirror in Hazel's room, and finally found a clue."
He seemed to have a strong desire to perform, and told the process of how he found this place all the way. The poor Arrodes magic mirror was threatened and tortured by Amon, but did not reveal any information about Klein.
But this made Amon's clone more firmly believe that the source of this anomaly must be important!
Because He knew the origin of the Arrodes magic mirror, the person that this magic mirror was unwilling to betray proved the importance of this person.
In the end, Amon's clone learned about the unusualness of her neighbor Dwayne Dantes from some descriptions of Hazel, so he came over.
Maybe Klein's spirituality realized the danger, and he was just about to start his actions against Amon's clone.
After saying this, Klein said strangely: "You don't seem to be in a hurry at all?"
"Of course I'm not in a hurry," Amon's clone smiled. "Aren't you clear that Sequence 2 corresponding to my pathway is called 'Trojan Horse of Destiny'?"
"Although I'm just a clone, I can still apply some abilities initially.
"For example, tampering with your fate to make it have some errors within a certain period of time.
"Like now, no one will notice no matter how you call for help.
"Hehe, that is to say, even if you activate the Night Emblem in your hand, you will not be able to transmit the idea of asking for help.
"And the one who is watching, He will at most watch you, but dare not descend too much power."
Speaking of this, Amon's clone spread his hands: "This is Backlund, except for the orthodox gods, no god dares to descend here."
"Otherwise, the night, storm, and steam will descend together, eliminating this ill-intentioned evil god."
"As far as I know, the existence watching you has not been acknowledged by the Seven Gods and is not a true god."
Hobert also remembered that there seemed to be a similar agreement between the gods, not only in Backlund but also effective in the capitals of other countries.
So, when the corpse of the ancient death god appeared in Feynapotter City, it triggered the descent of the Earth Mother.
But Hobert thought of the time he fooled Medici when he had descended once before.
But then he shook his head, because even with the blessing of the "Nation of Disorder" at that time, he was still very weak, and he might not have disturbed the gods at all.
Finally, Amon said, "That's why I said so much just now. For an avatar, to complete the above operations, especially to prevent the one watching our conversation from saving you in a short time, it takes enough time."
Both Hobert and Klein were stunned. They had been guarding against Amon's avatar's sudden "parasitism," and Amon's topic was very attractive. Although they realized he was stalling for time, they didn't take it too seriously. As a result, they were deceived?
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" has the position of King of Angels, but that's just for bluffing.
If it were a real fight, Hobert could fight a Sequence 1 enemy for thirty or forty rounds, but battles at this level would only last a dozen seconds at most. If there was no overwhelming advantage, they would retreat, and it would be impossible to have dozens of rounds of back and forth.
Dealing with a Sequence 2 enemy is no problem at all, but it's just dealing with them, don't think about killing them.
Enemies like Amon's avatar on this path can easily see that the "Creator" is bluffing, which makes Hobert have to take it seriously even in the "Nation of Disorder."
After hearing Amon's avatar's words, Hobert was about to use "Exploit" or "Tamper" on Klein to test the truth of the avatar's words.
But as soon as he raised his hand, Hobert withdrew it, because he suddenly realized that Amon's avatar's last words were deceiving him!
This is just an avatar after all. He can sense that a certain "existence" is watching here, but he doesn't know who the other party is.
The purpose of him saying that is, first, he hopes that Hobert can take action, and he can determine which existence is watching there through observation.
Second, if Hobert takes action to test his words just now, it is equivalent to exposing that "this existence" is not confident and has no certainty of dealing with an avatar.
"Damn it!" Hobert couldn't help but praise Amon. He realized: This kid's last few words were testing me!
Hobert made up his mind not to take action for the time being.
Klein used the image of Gehrman Sparrow to coldly ask Amon's avatar: "Since you have completed the operation in the field of fate, why haven't you taken action yet?
"What are you waiting for?"
Just as he finished speaking, Leonard, using the "Leymano's Travel Notes" rented from this week's Tarot Gathering, appeared in the yard.
The old man in his body had already sensed that Amon had begun to act, so he asked Leonard to rush over quickly.
"This is what I'm waiting for." Amon's avatar grabbed at Klein, stealing Klein's own fate and life.
He had been preparing for this theft all along. The life of this "Seer" demigod was almost in his hands, and he only needed to take it at the final moment of attack.
Amon's avatar's theft was indeed successful, but in his hand was only an ordinary bone china teacup.
And Klein was sitting on the tea table in the corner of the room. He realized that the "Creator" had taken action just now, "twisting" the concept of himself and a teacup.
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" and Klein almost simultaneously thought in their hearts: As expected, he was deceiving!
In terms of position, the "Creator's" ability cannot be restricted by Amon's avatar, but it's hard to say if the main body comes.
Amon's avatar smiled and pointed at Leonard in the garden and smiled: "That was originally the person I was waiting for, but now, I've changed my mind."
While speaking, he bowed slightly in the direction of Hobert's "True Sight" and then disappeared in place!
A thought flashed through Klein's mind: Amon's avatar is going to run!
If Amon's avatar had time to ramble at this time, he would definitely say: Nonsense, of course I have to run! The one watching here is a King of Angels! Although He doesn't dare to descend openly in Backlund, just descending part of his power is enough to constantly influence the battle.
At the same time, the Night Emblem in Klein's hand suddenly became slightly hot. This was the "Creator" using the ability of "Exploit" to end Amon's avatar's influence on Klein's fate in advance. He can now use the emblem to send a signal.
While Klein injected his spirituality into the Night Emblem, he had an origami crane in his hand. The origami crane quickly burned, leaving only a little ash.
One after another silvery complex symbols jumped out of the ashes, instantly forming a huge, illusory, scaleless snake.
On the surface of this silver-white giant snake, dense patterns and symbols formed one connected wheel after another.
The giant snake rose into the air and bit its own tail above Backlund Street where Klein was located.
Suddenly, Klein's neighbors, Councilor Macht and his family and servants, all took off their monocles.
Klein's marionette Euny returned to the next room. At this time, the marionette was about to take out a crystal-like monocle from his pocket.
This is the "Restart" of the "Snake of Fate." Klein and Leonard were not affected, but the others in the neighborhood returned to a few minutes ago.
At the same time, Backlund Street seemed to be somewhat separated from the real world, and it became a "hidden" world.
Amon's avatar immediately reacted. Streams of light flew towards him, and he retracted the "Worms of Time" that had been "parasitized" into other people's bodies, gathering his strength.
Then Amon's avatar turned into a phantom, turning into a virtual ancient stone clock.
Clang!
With a bell ringing, an additional hand appeared on the mottled clock.
The hand jumped down a few grids, and Klein saw Leonard outside the window quickly aging, seeming to turn into a seventy- or eighty-year-old man with age spots all over his face in just an instant.
Klein knew that he shouldn't be much better off.
The "Creator" strikes again: "Tamper!"
Because it is in the "Concealed Space," it doesn't matter if the "Creator" projects some more power.
Klein and Leonard quickly recovered. The "Creator" had just "modified" the effect of Amon's avatar's ability.
At this time, a mottled clock also appeared behind Leonard. That was the "Old Man" Pallez in his body, but this clock looked more illusory.
"Magnify!" The "Creator" timely "magnified" Pallez's power, allowing his power to almost return to its peak state in a short time.
The ancient clock behind Leonard suddenly became clear and solid.
Clang!
The bell rang again, but this time the hand of the ancient clock behind Leonard was turning back.
The hand of the ancient clock transformed by Amon's avatar suddenly trembled. After struggling for a while, the clock quickly faded and turned into specks of light.
Some of these specks of light quickly burrowed into Leonard's body.
The light on the specks of light gradually faded, and they were strips of "Worms of Time."

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 623: Love from the Lord of Storms
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" withdrew his gaze, unable to stop himself from sighing: Amon's avatars are still so damn annoying!
The aftermath of this hunt for Amon's avatar was naturally left to Klein.
Hobert returned to the real world and used "Travel" to reach the still heavily under construction Tussock Port, inspecting the preparations there.
The port, which had already grown to the size of a small city, was bustling with people, all of whom were employees of the casinos, auction houses, brothels, and other establishments built there, essentially people working for Hobert.
In the expanded port in the distance, all kinds of ships were already docked, the vast majority of which were pirate ships, just without the pirate flags flying.
Only a few naval ships were docked here, a kind of surveillance of the pirates and observation of Tussock Port's intentions.
They didn't attack each other, only watched each other.
They were all waiting for the opening of Tussock Port tomorrow.
Hobert walked around the port and heard Klein's voice offering sacrifices to the "Creator" from the "Nation of Disorder."
He returned to the study in the Governor's Mansion, entered the "Nation of Disorder," opened the sacrificial gate, and collected the six "Worms of Time" that Klein had sacrificed, these were the spoils of war for the "Creator."
This hunt came to a very satisfactory end.
After nightfall, Hobert and Fors came to Tussock Port together to make the final preparations for tomorrow's opening.
A new week began, and the sky over Tussock Port on Longtail Island gradually brightened. As two banners were hung in the port, Tussock Port officially reopened.
The left side of the two banners read: Pirates in Tussock Port can enjoy the rights of citizens.
The right side read: Wealth deposited by pirates in Tussock Port banks and all purchased assets are legal property.
Because they were afraid that some pirates would not recognize the words, they specially found some people with loud voices to explain the meaning of the banners to the pirates.
This was a relatively explosive piece of news recently circulating on the Berserk Sea: on Longtail Island, pirates are legal citizens.
At first, the pirates thought this was a conspiracy by the navy or the Storm Church, but as more and more news about Longtail Island spread on the Berserk Sea, the pirates learned that this place had become the territory of an Earl, and knew that this Earl's territory was very different from the colonies of Loen.
Gradually, many pirates risked coming to find out, because many desperadoes at sea wanted to find a safe and stable place to fence their stolen goods.
Not all pirates, like the "Pirate Admiral," have stable channels for selling stolen goods.
They are often surrounded by the navy or deceived by unscrupulous merchants when selling stolen goods.
The wealth they desperately plunder must also be protected from being snatched or stolen by their companions.
Although these people are heinous, they also want to find a safe place to heal their wounds, and when they are old and can no longer be pirates, they can have a safe place to retire.
There are no old people among pirates, because when they get old, they can't run, swim, or kill, so they can only be killed.
The pirates did not act immediately after hearing the loud shouts from the dock, but chose to continue to watch.
It wasn't until the sun rose that a captain finally sent his subordinates to the dock. When the pirates cautiously left the dock, loudspeakers around the dock suddenly sounded:
"Notice to those landing on the island: Although you have the rights of legal citizens, it does not mean you can do whatever you want!
"Only when your life is in danger, or you are robbed, stolen from, etc., can you seek help from the port's security officers or official Beyonders!
"Those who harm others or commit illegal activities will still be subject to sanctions and punishments!
"It is equivalent to us pretending not to know the crimes you committed at sea, but you will definitely bear the corresponding responsibility for the crimes committed here!
"…"
These landing notices were very straightforward, and even pirates who had never gone to school understood what they meant.
This made the pirates who landed on the island or did not land on the island breathe a slight sigh of relief. It seemed that the news they had received before was more reliable.
Outside the dock, in front of the pirates were four neat streets, with residential areas still under construction on both sides.
The main road in the middle was first the residence of various administrative organs of the port, and after passing through the square, there were auction houses, pawnshops, banks, trading houses, and other places for selling and trading stolen goods, as well as entertainment venues such as casinos.
On the left side of the street, there were rows of bars, various flavors of gourmet restaurants, and brothels that looked big and beautiful, and even shopping areas and consumer areas such as department stores.
Because the bars had not yet opened, the first batch of pirates who landed on the island first came to the restaurants and roadside stalls, where they observed and probed.
But when the food came up, they had no time to probe each other and began to frantically shovel food into their mouths.
In fact, the food they eat at sea is very rough. Even when they are ashore on some islands, they dare not go to too high-end places because they always have to avoid being targeted by bounty hunters, so they usually settle it in bars.
The food in the bar can be imagined.
These bottom-level pirates have not eaten a decent meal for a long time.
Moreover, Hobert, having had the experience of a food street in South Colson, provides quite good quality food.
The pirates themselves did not expect that they would eat and drink in the restaurant, until they ate their stomachs round, and then leaned comfortably on the back of the chair to observe the surroundings.
They noticed that there were often staff members in security uniforms patrolling the streets.
These security officers generally consist of three people, the older one in the middle holding a gun, and the two younger ones on both sides holding knives and short sticks.
The security guards turned a blind eye to the pirates who were eating and drinking, and only caught two pirates who wanted to flirt with the waitress. Someone followed them from a distance and found that they had taken the two pirates to the court!
The pirates who followed came to the square of the "Central Avenue" and saw the lord of this place, Hobert, and the mature and beautiful lady of the lord.
At this time, there was a small high platform in the "Central Square", and a sunshade was built on the high platform. Hobert was sitting on a large chair at this time, quite majestic, like overlooking everything in the entire port. The pirates did not dare to look at him.
The lady of the lord next to him looked much more relaxed. She was sitting on a comfortable soft chair, reading a book. There was also a small table next to her, with tea and fruit on it.
At this time, the judge was already in place, and the pirates' attention returned to the court.
The courts in other colonial islands are basically just decorations, but the judge here tried the two pirates in the open air.
After listening to the waitress's accusation and the pirates pleading guilty on the spot, because the entire flirting behavior was terminated at the beginning and did not cause serious consequences, the two pirates were sentenced to one month of labor reform and compensation of 5 pounds each to the waitress.
The pirates were stunned when they saw this scene, because they had seen the trial of pirates, without exception, they were all sentenced to death!
This made them even more convinced of Tussock Port's external publicity.
Soon, several pirates who had fought were sent, and the judge successively conducted trials. Similarly, because their fights were stopped at the beginning, they were only sentenced to half a month to two months of labor reform, compensation for the economic losses of the restaurant, etc.
Because of Hobert's gaze, the pirates did not dare to stay here for long. They firmly remembered the process of the trial and returned to the previous street, and rushed into the brothel happily.
But when they entered the door, they were told that they had to take a bath before they could choose the girls here, and they were warned that they could play with affection, but they could not maliciously beat the girls here.
The pirates felt that the rules of the brothel here were very strange, but the food and trial just now had made them realize that this place was different from other islands, so they all followed the rules here and obediently went to take a bath.
Sure enough, someone ignored the staff's advice and beat the girls here, so security guards took the scantily clad pirates away again.
Some onlookers came back and said that the beautiful lady of the lord personally intervened in this case, because the girl's face was bruised, so it was determined to be intentional injury.
In addition to compensating the girl 5 pounds for medical expenses, she also had to compensate 10 pounds for lost work.
The street girl who got these 15 pounds was stunned. The judge and security guards really protected themselves. No one looked at them with contempt or obscene eyes. On the contrary, a security guard told her the direction of the hospital.
In the brothel, the pirates who were dancing and drinking with the girls didn't feel anything. They already understood that as long as they followed the rules of this port, it would be safe.
And the rules of Tussock Port will be informed to them in advance, and if they don't understand, they can go up and ask.
This gave this group of outlaws a full sense of security.
The street girls behind the brothel were crying. This place really protects them. If they are beaten, the customers will really be punished, and they can get compensation.
In Backlund, this is something they would not dare to imagine.
When it was almost noon, the first batch of pirates who landed on the island went to the business district and then came back for a big meal. Each of them touched their round bellies and returned to the port to report what they had seen and heard in Tussock Port to the captains.
The captains were not interested in how gentle the girls here were and how unique the food was. They were more concerned about the prices in Tussock Port.
Judging from the expenses of these pirates for eating, whoring, and buying daily necessities, the consumption here is not high, especially the daily necessities are very cheap!
Of course, it is very cheap in the eyes of the captains. The prices here are twice as high as Backlund and five times as high as Jeffrey City in South Colson!
For a long time, most of the industrial products of the Berserk Sea have been transported from the northern continent. The road costs and tariffs make the prices of goods very high.
But most of the daily necessities sold in Tussock Port are produced in South Colson and Longtail Island. The orders from Backlund are also transported by the "Traveler's Gate", without tariffs and very little road costs!
So the commodities that seem very cheap in the eyes of the captains are actually making a lot of money for the Longtail Island Municipal Government!
At present, all industries in Tussock Port are directly operated by the Municipal Government. After the port is reopened, it also opens up foreign investment in this place.
This is the only city in Hobert's territory that has fully opened up foreign investment business.
Like Jeffrey City, although it can currently absorb foreign investment, the industries that can be invested in are limited. First of all, it does not accept any investment in agriculture.
Now South Colson is the stable granary, vegetable, and fruit base of the entire "Creator" force. The agriculture there must be completely controlled by the Municipal Government.
Only some industrial investment and commercial investment are open. Now some institutions such as banks have settled in, but because their own volume is too small, the Municipal Government will not open up some pillar industries such as hotels.
The situation on Longtail Island is that it is not suitable to open up at present, otherwise the natives here are not the opponents of those businessmen at all and will be continuously harvested by waves of businessmen.
That's why only foreign investment in Tussock Port is fully opened on Longtail Island.
After the first batch of pirates returned to the port to report, the captains began to disembark one after another at noon.
They were more concerned about places like banks and trading houses. Similarly, when they passed through the "Central Square", they were also shocked by the majesty exuded by Hobert.
Every pirate who passed by here unconsciously saluted the Earl before heading to their destination.
Hobert was just sitting here, which was the greatest deterrent to these pirates.
The pirates first went to the bank to learn about the bank's business. Some pirates tried to deposit a sum of money, and they got a deposit slip with anti-counterfeiting design.
Then they tried to withdraw it, and they immediately withdrew it, which gave them a lot of comfort.
However, some pirates with savings still did not dare to deposit all their savings in the bank. They planned to deposit only part of the money and wait and see, and then come to withdraw it again after a while.
However, facing the bank manager's publicity, some pirates changed their minds and deposited all their property in the bank, because the bank thoughtfully launched the "Estate Return" service.
The assets in the bank can designate an heir and two alternate heirs. As long as the heir's address, name, appearance characteristics, etc. are clearly written, and no one claims it after three years beyond the withdrawal date agreed with the depositor, it will automatically enter the "Estate Return" service.
If the designated heir lives in Longtail Island and South Colson, only 5% of the deposit will be charged as a service fee.
If you live in a large city in the North and South continents, a 15% service fee will be charged on the deposit.
If you live in a remote area or the time to find the heir takes more than 1 month, a service fee of 20% to 30% of the deposit will be charged.
Many people go to sea to give their families a better life. They are bloodthirsty pirates at sea, unscrupulous villains, but many of them are also fathers and husbands.
The bank of Tussock Port has launched such a service by grasping the psychology of the pirates, which is quite popular with many pirates.
Then the pirate captains went to the trading house and listened to the staff's explanation of the details of the transaction.
The transaction service here is divided into two types. One is a public transaction, where you can hand the information of the items you want to trade to the staff in the form of a note and publish it on the information wall.
If you don't want to expose your appearance or other information, there's a small private meeting room with a secret entrance where you can negotiate. You can publish the information on the information wall after leaving for a while, or the next day.
This service costs a 3-pound service fee, and the receipt entitles you to a free 3-day stay at the Sea Breeze Inn to the left. After three days, it will cost 6 Soles per day.
If you can't find a buyer for a long time, you can choose to go to the pawnshop to trade with the city government.
Alternatively, you can entrust the trading house to find a buyer. The commission fee is 10% to 30% of the final transaction amount. The standard for charging the service fee depends on the difficulty and time of storing the traded items.
When a pirate who has chosen this service comes to Tortuga Port again, the trading house will settle the proceeds in pounds with the pirate.
Another type of transaction is private trading, which is a service prepared for large transactions.
For example, if you rob a cargo ship and the shipping company has no intention of paying a ransom, it will definitely involve the process of disposing of stolen goods.
This is a headache for some powerful pirates who have no backing: the lack of a safe environment for disposing of stolen goods.
Many pirates who are invincible in naval battles die in the process of disposing of stolen goods.
The trading house provides them with such an environment. Pirates only need to pay a 100-pound service fee each time they use the trading house's venue, and the city government can guarantee their safety in Tortuga Port.
In addition, they can simply trade with the city government, and the 100-pound service fee can be waived.
Many pirates have tried to initiate large transactions with the city government. The prices offered by the city government are definitely much lower than the market price, but the pirate captains are generally satisfied with such prices.
So, tentative transactions become real transactions.
But these transactions cannot be completed immediately, because the pirates have to sail the hidden merchant ships here.
After reaching a transaction intention, the trading house staff announced a new regulation: if none of the merchant ship's crew members die and are sent here with the merchant ship, the price will increase by 30% based on the current pricing standard.
If three or fewer crew members die, it will also increase by 20%.
If more than three crew members but less than half die, only an additional 10% will be given. If "half" is less than three people, it will be calculated as within three people.
However, if no crew member survives, the next transaction price will be 20% lower than the current standard.
This regulation stunned the captains who initiated the transaction for a long time, and they marveled at the strangeness of the rules here.
The captains also visited the auction house and the pawnshop, which was actually a split from the previous auction house. The pawnshop is responsible for collecting items, and the auction house is responsible for selling the collected items.
Outside the auction house, there is a list of today's auction items. The previous day's auction items shocked the pirates, including a "Wind Blessed" Beyonder characteristic, and the finale was a Sequence 6 mystical item, which is a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact!
This level of goods is very rare in Beyonder gatherings, especially in transactions between pirates. This level of transaction is prone to black eats black.
Everyone felt the power of Hobert in Central Square. His power is the most powerful guarantee in the transaction process. Pirates are also more at ease with transactions with the auction house, and seem to have found a new channel for advancing in the sequence.
Many pirates lamented that this seems to be a city specially designed for pirates! It's completely a pirate paradise.
But the premise is that you must abide by the rules here, otherwise it will be several months or even years of labor reform. Labor reform for more than three years involves confiscation of property, which means that after the labor reform is over, you may end up with nothing!
In the afternoon, the port gradually became lively. The pirates basically had no worries and left the pirate ships to come to the port.
Hobert, who had been sitting in the square for most of the day, yawned, took out his pocket watch and looked at it. It was already past two o'clock in the afternoon. In a while, he would return to the Governor's Mansion with Fors to attend the Tarot Gathering.
Hobert was about to pick up his teacup and take a sip when he suddenly looked at the sea.
In the low sky near Longtail Island, the space suddenly became illusory, and a giant ship floated out of it.
The pirates and all the people in the city almost simultaneously stopped talking and laughing, and looked at the sea together. Angus and Elliott immediately ran out, but soon they also looked at the sea with a few subordinates.
When the giant ship completely emerged from the spirit world, everyone felt tremendous pressure, and many people had the urge to kneel.
Hobert first used the power of "Distortion" to send Fors into the bank, and then he "Tampered" with his own gravity and the gravity acting on him, slowly flying into the mid-air of the city.
With a wave of his hand, he "Distorted" the tremendous pressure emanating from the giant ship, and the people in the port collectively breathed a sigh of relief.
Although the giant ship's flag had not yet been raised, Hobert had already realized that it should be the "Black Emperor"!
To Hobert's surprise, sitting on the huge mottled stone chair in front of the "Black Emperor" was a large teenager, who looked about fifteen or sixteen years old, with delicate features and a somewhat naive appearance.
This was Erebus, who had seized the "Black Emperor"!
Hobert didn't know about Nast's encounter, but after seeing Erebus, he basically understood what was going on.
This surprised him somewhat, after all, Erebus was only at Sequence 4 before, while Nast was a "Frenzied Mage". How did he seize the "Black Emperor"?
Hobert was almost certain that the other party must have had helpers.
The large Erebus waved his hand, and ordinary waves suddenly turned into giant waves of seven or eight meters high, crashing towards the port.
The sudden giant waves caused the pirates who remained in the port to exclaim. Such giant waves would not be too dangerous at sea, but in the port, where ships were docked so densely, being hit by the waves would be enough to cause the pirate ships to crash into each other.
But just as the waves were about to enter the port, they suddenly subsided with a "splash".
This left the exclaiming pirates unsure of how to react for a moment.
The waves were of course prematurely ended by Hobert using the ability of "Exploit". He had originally thought that the Church of the Witches or the "Rose School of Thought" would send someone to disrupt the situation today, but he didn't expect that it would be this kid who came.
Of course, Hobert wouldn't indulge him. He opened his arms: "King of the Skies;
Emperor of the Seas; Lord of the Calamity;
God of the Storms"
Hearing Hobert's devout chanting, not only was Erebus stunned, but the pirates who were watching in the port were also stunned.
Shouldn't they be rushing up to fight the enemy at this time? Why did he start chanting the honorific name of the "Lord of Storms"?
Hobert's chanting continued: "...Your devout worshiper reports to you a very important matter:
"On the sea, in your domain, there is an evil god attacking innocent people, revealing his evil nature..."
Erebus twitched the corner of his mouth: "This is a shameless slander!"
At this moment, Tortuga Port was suddenly covered with dark clouds, and the sea breeze also began to howl.
