chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 624: The Fool from the First Era
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert's idea was actually very simple. Erebus was still at sea, so if there was a problem at sea, of course, he would look for the "Lord of Storms."
Besides, as a follower of the "Lord of Reporting," if he didn't have this skill, how could he be embarrassed to participate in future Tarot Gatherings?
In addition, Hobert was quite certain about the response from the "Lord of Storms." In his previous communication with Trunsoest, he learned that the Storm Church had invested in his biological father, Rex.
It was estimated that the "Lord of Storms" should have marked Rex. Although Hobert had never prayed to the "Lord of Storms," he should be immediately noticed by the "Lord of Storms" once he prayed.
This was like Xio's prayer to the "Creator." Hobert certainly couldn't mark her before Xio had prayed to the "Creator."
But once she prayed, Hobert could immediately distinguish it because the "Creator" knew of Xio's existence, and Xio's prayer also conformed to the "Creator's" will.
Similarly, the "Lord of Storms" must also know Hobert. After all, he had invested in Rex and would not ignore Hobert.
In addition, the existence of the "Creator" made Hobert more valuable, so the "Lord of Storms" also had a certain willingness to respond to Hobert's prayer. Such a prayer would definitely immediately appear before the "Lord of Storms."
As expected, Hobert had not finished speaking when the power of the "Lord of Storms" descended upon the sea.
For a time, the enormous pressure made Hobert feel trembling, and he helplessly fell from the high altitude, honestly observing the situation at sea from the coast.
The pirates in the port, as if recalling the disasters that made them most fearful and helpless, scattered in panic like chickens encountering a natural enemy, fleeing into the buildings on both sides of the street.
The sea was filled with wind and rain, causing the "Black Emperor" to shake back and forth.
Erebus immediately reopened the spirit world to escape. Even if the "Lord of Storms" only descended part of his power, even if he had Tamara's help, he would have no chance of winning against the partial power of the "Lord of Storms" at sea.
But now he couldn't leave if he wanted to. The illusory spirit world in front of the "Black Emperor" was suddenly replaced by a very huge waterspout!
The gale raged across the entire Longtail Island, as if to overturn the island. Many roofs and large trees in Tortuga Port were swept into the sky.
Hobert was shocked by this scene because he felt that the thickness of the waterspout had exceeded his psychological endurance.
He could only see the edge of the waterspout as far as his eyes could see. Even if it wasn't as wide as Longtail Island, it was at least half as wide.
In fact, that huge waterspout was not entirely composed of water. It was a huge sea tornado, a "dragon sucking water" in Hobert's memory.
With a scalp tingling, Hobert sighed in his heart: At sea, the "Tyrant" is an invincible existence!
He really wanted to "tamper" or "Exploit" the gale to reduce the wind blowing towards the island, but his heart trembled, and he couldn't use his ability.
In the sky was the power of a god!
As a Sequence 3, he could only watch His power from afar.
The waterspout was more like a wall of water, blocking the "Black Emperor's" path.
The previous giant ship now looked as small as a grain of sand compared to the waterspout.
Erebus's face also showed a somewhat panicked expression. His emotions were affected by the "Tyrant," and he quickly ordered the "Black Emperor" to retreat.
But the huge waterspout chased after it and swallowed the "Black Emperor."
Hobert's spirituality could feel that the center of the waterspout was hollow, and lightning raged inside, splitting the "Black Emperor" into flying wood chips, and even the main mast collapsed.
But suddenly, Hobert couldn't feel the existence of the "Black Emperor" anymore.
The huge waterspout also disappeared!
A cloud of white mist appeared in the low altitude above the sea. The mist made Hobert feel very cold and strange, and the surrounding temperature dropped sharply. He exhaled white gas in his breath.
The mist slowly dissipated, and Hobert roughly saw that the "Black Emperor" was already dilapidated, but the main body was still intact.
Erebus clutched his chest in a very embarrassed manner, with many charred and hideous wounds on his body.
In his hand was a slender-necked glass bottle, its interior filled with thin, illusory mist, which now had rainbow-like colors.
Before the mist dissipated, Erebus immediately took the "Black Emperor" back to the spirit world and fled the area.
Hobert immediately understood that although the mist did not have any offensive power to the "Lord of Storms," it was very difficult to deal with and had the risk of being corrupted.
So the "Lord of Storms" did not stop Erebus from escaping.
Hobert glanced at Tortuga Port, where many roofs had been blown away. Fortunately, the "Lord of Storms's" target was the "Black Emperor," otherwise the port would have been blown away.
Taking a deep breath, Hobert said to the dark clouds in the sky: "Thank you for your help, Great Lord of Storm..."
Crack!
A lightning strike hit the ground not far in front of Hobert, scaring him. The words "fuck" almost came out.
Hobert thought: Leodero is so stingy, isn't it just using their power to deter that little brat? Is it necessary to warn me like this?
Immediately, the huge pressure from the sky disappeared, and the "Lord of Storms" left.
Whoosh~
Longtail Island was showered with heavy rain, like countless faucets being turned on, accompanied by marine life such as fish, shrimp, and crabs.
Hobert raised his hand and finally used his ability. The heavy rain avoided Tortuga Port and fell around the port.
At this time, people came out of the buildings one after another. There was still some remaining fear and loss on their faces. They always felt that they had witnessed something extraordinary, but they couldn't say exactly what they had witnessed.
The heavy rain only lasted for more than ten minutes, and the sky cleared almost immediately.
At this time, the staff of Tortuga Port also reacted and began to clean the streets and organize people to repair the roofs.
On a rainy island, not having a roof is definitely a disaster.
Hobert returned to the central square again, and the pirates showed fearful and worshipful eyes to the Earl.
People who work hard at sea, even pirates, more or less believe in the "Lord of Storms."
And the Earl had actually prayed for the help of the "Lord of Storms," which shocked them.
Hobert raised his hand and used the "Distortion" ability again. The chairs and tables on the high platform in the central square that had been blown away "stood" up again and returned to their original positions.
Then he used the "Tampering" ability to make the water stains and dirt on the tables and chairs float away from the chairs, and they became dry and clean again.
Hobert nonchalantly sat back on the wide chair, and Fors, who had come out of the bank not far away, sat next to Hobert, opened the book she had taken away, and continued reading.
The pirates once again felt the faint pressure emanating from Hobert. Official Beyonder and security officers began to patrol the streets again, and Tortuga Port quickly returned to order.
With Hobert around, it seemed that there would be no chaos here.
As the port gradually became lively again, Hobert glanced at his pocket watch. He and Fors looked at each other and disappeared together.
As soon as Hobert left, the pirates suddenly felt that there was no pressure and gradually became arrogant, deliberately violating the rules here.
This is not because they are brainless, but because the life of pirates makes them very tired of following other people's rules and can't help but break these rules.
But soon, as a captain with Sequence 6 level, and three well-known pirates with Sequence 6 or Sequence 7 level, were besieged and killed by official Beyonder, the pirates realized that there were at least 2 Sequence 5 in the official Beyonder of Tortuga Port!
If these Beyonder pirates did not resist and allowed the official Beyonder to arrest them, they would still be taken to the court for trial and would not be killed.
But how could pirates at this level not resist?
The pirates were once again shocked by the deaths of these well-known pirates. Even if Hobert was not there, they did not dare to be too presumptuous.
This also shows another characteristic of pirates. As long as they are suppressed by force, they will be very willing to abide by the rules set by the strong.
Just like they would not disobey the captain's orders unless the captain was seriously injured or seriously ill.
Soon the pirates discovered that they were actually relatively free here, and they could squander recklessly, as long as they did not violate the rules here, no one would care about them.
The key is that it is very safe here, and you don't have to worry about sudden searches by the navy, or being attacked by other pirates.
...
Hobert and Fors returned to the Governor's Mansion, and almost without any hesitation, they lay together on the couch in front of the window.
"How did you do it?" Fors asked at this time: "How could the 'Lord of Storms' respond to your prayer?"
You are clearly a follower of the "Creator"! And a member of the gathering initiated by the "Fool". With the relationship of two evil gods, why can you still get the response of the "Lord of Storms"?
Hobert smiled and said: "My father has a friendship with the 'Lord of Storms'."
Fors recalled talking to Mona, their family seems to be believers of the Evernight Goddess?
But before she had time to ask again, her vision was obscured by the gray mist. When she came back to her senses, they had already appeared above the gray mist, on both sides of the bronze long table.
In the magnificent and majestic palace, "Justice" Audrey, as usual, first lifted her skirt slightly to the head of the bronze long table and saluted: "Good afternoon, Mr. Fool."
After the greeting, this Tarot Gathering officially began.
"Hermit" Cattleya lowered her head and was about to speak to the head of the bronze long table when "The Fool" Klein suddenly smiled: "Don't worry, this pair of glasses that appears can seal your 'Secret Eye'."
Cattleya breathed a sigh of relief before raising her head: "Thank you for your help."
"Emperor" Hobert was slightly taken aback: "Hermit" has advanced to a demigod! Otherwise, she wouldn't worry about seeing things she shouldn't see.
Through the conversation between the two, the other members also understood that Ms. Hermit had advanced.
Audrey smiled slightly: The third demigod! The third demigod among the Tarot Club members. I hope I can advance soon!
"Hanged Man" Alger's sitting posture changed unconsciously, with a bit of defensiveness. At this time, he felt a little uncomfortable: "Hermit" is also a demigod, and I...
His digestion of potions has been very limited because now he only dares to sing in places where no one is around, or he has to secretly swim far away at night to sing heartily. More than once, large groups of sea fish have fainted in his singing.
But the speed of digesting potions is still too slow.
"Moon" Emlyn showed a smile: I am also a "Scarlet Scholar" now. I believe I will soon be one of the demigods.
At this time, Cattleya spoke again, in a respectful tone: "Great Mr. Fool, this time there is a page of Roselle's diary."
Klein said in a tone that could not be heard with joy or anger: "Very good, you can ask questions or requests."
Cattleya said: "Respected Mr. Fool, can this question be accumulated to the next time?"
Klein's heart was startled: Accumulated to the next time? Could it be that the "Queen Mystic" "prophesied" something?
However, in order to maintain the image of "The Fool," Klein did not ask why, but nodded lightly: "Yes."
Cattleya didn't say much, materialized the page of the diary, and then flashed to the Fool's hand.
The content of this page of the diary is not complicated. Basically, Roselle and Mr. "Door" are discussing the second "Blasphemy Slate."
The time was probably not long after Roselle read the "Blasphemy Slate." Regarding the origin of this "Blasphemy Slate," Mr. "Door" gave a definite answer: The ancient sun god fell, and the "Blasphemy Slate" was born.
Combining the information obtained from Hobert before, Klein easily understood what Mr. "Door" meant and realized that Mr. "Door" also knew many secrets.
Roselle also had similar ideas, and then they talked about the first "Blasphemy Slate" and asked Mr. "Door" about its origin.
Mr. "Door" only answered ambiguously: In the misty First Epoch, there were also some great existences.
Klein thought of everyone's previous discussion about the first "Blasphemy Slate." At that time, some members speculated that the first "Blasphemy Slate" might be the product of a powerful existence that fell long ago.
After reading this page of the diary, Klein withdrew his gaze, made the diary in his hand disappear, and then he calmly looked around and said with a smile: "You can start."
At this time, except for "Star" Leonard and Alger who had the need to advance, the other members had just completed their advancement not long ago and had no needs.
And Leonard is different from Alger. He has a high degree of loyalty to the church and does not intend to advance secretly.
Moreover, his current merits are about to reach the standard for advancing to Sequence 5, so he will not seek potion formulas at the Tarot Gathering.
And Alger still has a long way to go to completely digest the potion.
Even if he digests the potion, he will make certain preparations before advancing because advancing to a demigod means breaking with the Storm Church.
So, after a brief silence, Emlyn cleared his throat and said to "Magician" Fors: "Madam, in the next two weeks, I may need to rent that 'Leymano's Travels' once."
Fors immediately agreed: "No problem."
But she couldn't help adding, "Try not to record 'Full Moon' abilities."
Emlyn agreed.
Alger, standing beside him, asked, "Is the Sanguine's hunt for the Primordial Moon believers about to begin?"
This was a piece of news Emlyn announced at the Tarot Gathering last week: "Yes."
He said, "Once the plan is finalized, I will ask for everyone's help in providing suggestions."
Then Emlyn turned to Hobert and said, "This matter is still in the planning stages, I don't know if the Sanguine will seek your help."
Hobert nodded: "When your high-level people ask you to come and find me, we'll discuss this matter."
"Okay."
After this topic ended, at the lower end of the bronze long table, "World" Gehrman Sparrow said to Leonard, "Help me ask that person if they have seen the second 'Blasphemy Slate'?"
Blasphemy Slate?
The other members thought of the previous discussions about the "Blasphemy Slate" and looked at Leonard with some surprise and astonishment.
Cattleya thought to herself: Mr. Star is indeed not as simple as he seems! Someone he knows has actually seen that mysterious "Blasphemy Slate"! Is it some "High Sequence" existence from the Zoroast family?
Leonard himself was also taken aback, he was silent for a few seconds before saying: "Okay."
Then "World" asked Hobert: "Besides what we discussed before, do you have any new information about the first 'Blasphemy Slate'?"
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying: "Yes."
"What is it?" Klein immediately manipulated "World" to ask: "What price do I need to pay."
"I can tell you for free, tell everyone." Hobert said very generously: "Because that information is very vague, I can't guarantee whether it is completely correct."
He felt that he could reveal some information from the First Epoch.
And he could also praise "The Fool" by the way, because Hobert had used his free time during this period to carve twenty silver pieces for making charms.
Since he planned to fleece Mr. Fool, he naturally had to give some sweeteners first.
Thinking of this, Hobert added: "However, that information may offend Mr. Fool, I can only announce it after Mr. Fool approves."
The other members all looked at the head of the long table with anticipation, their thoughts were self-evident: "Emperor" has blasphemed and offended the gods more than once or twice, continue to forgive him.
Klein thought: When you said this information was free, "The Fool" had already forgiven you.
He used the character of "The Fool" to say: "You may."
"Yes." Hobert pretended to say: "I remember when we discussed the first 'Blasphemy Slate' before, we talked about whether it was formed after the fall of a powerful existence in ancient times?
"But after discussing it here, we couldn't discuss it anymore."
Everyone nodded, it was indeed discussed here, because they didn't know what conditions were needed to form the "Blasphemy Slate", and they didn't know which specific existence still had the level of the Ancient Sun God, so they only discussed it here.
Only Leonard was a little helpless: Here it comes again, it's like I'm a student who has been on sick leave for a long time and has returned to the classroom, and I don't know where the course has been taught?
Then he thought: I wonder if the old man knows these things? I can ask Him to "make up the lessons".
Hobert continued: "This information was obtained very accidentally, I accidentally heard 'The Creator' say when I was asking the great 'Creator' another question:
"In the distant First Epoch, there was not only chaos and disorder, but there were also two 'Outer Deities' at the same time."
The other members were stunned at first, then a little surprised.
Before, they spent a lot of effort to understand the level of the Ancient Sun, but they didn't expect that there were two such existences in the First Epoch?
Audrey was even thinking: Can this world accommodate the two of them at the same time?
Klein thought: Until now, why haven't I received any historical information about these two? Logically speaking, such existences should leave many traces. Even in Roselle's diary...
That's not right!
He suddenly thought: Today's diary mentioned that Mr. "Door" once said: In the misty First Epoch, some great existences also appeared. Maybe Mr. "Door" didn't know what kind of existence they were, only vaguely knew that they once existed.
At this time, "Sun" Derrick asked: "Mr. Emperor, are you saying that two Above the Sequence appeared in the First Epoch?"
"No." Hobert explained: "My understanding is that existences at the same level as the Ancient Sun God are not necessarily 'Above the Sequence'."
Alger understood Hobert's meaning: "That is to say, one of them is similar to the Ancient Sun God?"
Hobert nodded: "This is my guess, we know that the fall of the Ancient Sun God formed the second 'Blasphemy Slate', so does the one who formed the first 'Blasphemy Slate' have many similarities with the Ancient Sun God?
"In my opinion, the similarities are nothing more than two points, the first is the similarity in level, and the second is the similarity in pathways.
"If the levels are similar, that is, as long as a certain level is reached, a 'Blasphemy Slate' can be formed, then from the First Epoch to now, there are at least three existences at this level, shouldn't there be three 'Blasphemy Slates'?
"Because there have always been only two 'Blasphemy Slates' in legends, can it be said that it is not that after reaching a certain level, a 'Blasphemy Slate' can be formed?
"Relatively speaking, the second point is more reasonable. We said before that the Ancient Sun God controls five adjacent pathways. Apart from these adjacent pathways, there are no other adjacent pathways that reach five!
"Although pathways such as 'Sleepless' and 'Hunter' are also five, they seem to be different from the five pathways controlled by the Ancient Sun God.
"So can we draw such a conclusion? The pathway where the Ancient Sun God is located is relatively special. It is very likely that only the existence that controls these five pathways can form a 'Blasphemy Slate' after falling?
"From this, I reverse speculate that one of the existences in the First Epoch is very similar to the Ancient Sun God."
The other members first digested this information before sincerely admiring the "Emperor's" reasoning ability. The logic of this guess was very clear, and it was almost impossible to find a rebuttal.
Klein sighed: This should not only be a matter of ideas, but also a matter of pathways. Once the "Lawyer" masters some clues, they can start their powerful logical ability to deduce a lot of information and information, belonging to the kind of pathway that dares to pry the earth if given a lever.
Derrick asked: "Mr. Emperor, what about the other 'Great Old One' level existence? Have we traded information about Him before? Or have we exchanged any clues about Him?"
"The other existence?" Hobert smiled slightly and made a "please look" gesture towards the head of the bronze long table.
Seeing this gesture, including Klein, everyone was stunned, but then their hearts were like a volcano erupting, some with stiff backs, some with brains blank with surprise, and some almost startled!
Finally, they almost simultaneously converged into the same concept in their hearts: Mr. Fool is a "Great Old One" from the First Epoch!
The first to recover was Klein: This is too sudden, no one notified me!
He smiled helplessly, and then realized that this news was very important: This is the "Creator's" view of "The Fool"! Or rather, the view of a true god who is awakening, on "The Fool"! I had previously speculated whether Hobert's situation was similar to mine, and "The Creator" was Hobert? Now it seems that this guess is really naive.
While sighing, Klein glanced at this magnificent hall: It is very likely that it is because of this space "above the gray fog" that the "Creator" made a misjudgment. Then does that mean this space comes from the First Epoch? Originating from another mysterious "Great Old One"? Those people in front of the "Door of Light" were captured from Earth by that "Great Old One"?
The other members also gradually recovered, Alger sighed: No wonder "Emperor" said that this information would offend Mr. Fool, this is indeed blasphemy against Mr. Fool! No, Mr. Fool agreed to "Emperor" talking about this matter, that is to say, Mr. Fool is willing to let this information be made public. Let everyone understand the history of the First Epoch, and let everyone have enough understanding of Mr. Fool, this is... this must be an important part of Mr. Fool's recovery of power.
Leonard felt as if there was a layer of cold sweat on his forehead, but when he touched it, he remembered that he was currently in a spirit body state, where did the cold sweat come from: The First Epoch! The First Epoch is the mythical Chaos Epoch, it seems that the entire epoch was shrouded in mist and chaos, this is the first time I heard that there were some rational existences in that era! And now, since Mr. Fool did not correct it, does it mean that he defaulted to what "Emperor" said is true? That, that's too scary...
Cattleya sighed: I feel that my "Mystic" potion is about to be digested, is this indirectly proving the authenticity of the "Emperor's" information just now?
Derrick was uncontrollably excited after being surprised: No wonder Mr. Emperor repeatedly reminded me that only Mr. Fool can save City of Silver, it turns out that Mr. Fool is at the same level as "The Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord".
Fors sighed and said to herself: How did Hobert endure it? Such a big secret, he had never revealed it before? Could it be that... he must still know more secrets!
Emlyn was a little unbelievable: Mr. Fool is actually an existence from the First Epoch? Is this older than our ancestor? Not necessarily, maybe our ancestor also existed in the First Epoch, but became a god in the Second Epoch.
Audrey probably has the same idea: Since "The Creator" knows about Mr. Fool's information from the First Epoch, is "The Creator" also a god who fell into a deep sleep for some reason in the First Epoch, and is now beginning to wake up?
Then she thought: Hehe, I had previously guessed that Mr. Fool was the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf", I was too naive.
As everyone's associations unfolded, Klein discovered that the "Emperor's" information shocked everyone, and their attitude towards "The Fool" became more respectful and flattering.
After all, there is an essential difference between "Mr. Fool is a god" and "Mr. Fool is a Great Old One from the First Epoch".
After giving everyone about half a minute to digest the information just now, Hobert said: "I only know so much information at the moment."
He added: "The information about the First Epoch is very valuable. The reason why it is free this time is because most of it is my guess, and it is also very vague, so it is not easy to price, so it is better to share it with everyone."
Cattleya said: "If you have new information about the First Epoch, can you trade it at the Tarot Gathering again?"
Believing that after trading like this three or four times, her potion would be completely digested.
Hobert smiled and said: "It is also very difficult for me to obtain this kind of news, the next time I will definitely charge a fee, and the standard must be very high."
Audrey said at this time: "We can negotiate the price first, and if we can provide the reward you need, we will trade again."
Hobert nodded: "Okay, no problem."
At this time, Alger suddenly thought: "Mr. Emperor, I remember you seemed to say before that you got a lot of information about the Second Epoch from 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti?"
"Yes!" In fact, not much was obtained from Farbauti, but Hobert used this as a source of information, which made the information seem very reliable and reasonable.
Alger added: "Can you talk to us about more information about the Second Epoch?"
Hobert thought for a while: "How about this, I will help everyone sort out the approximate history of the Second Epoch, but information of this level is difficult to measure in pounds. If everyone is willing, pay the reward in another way."
Cattleya, who was also very concerned about this, immediately said: "What way?"
"Complete one demigod-level task I issued, or three Sequence 5 level tasks." Hobert said: "Similarly, you have the right to refuse, but a total of one or three tasks must be completed to repay the debt."
If you have to use pounds to measure the Sequence 5 level task, then it must start at 6000 pounds.
And everyone recalled the previous information transactions, the "Emperor" was priced at 800 or 1000, but this time it suddenly "increased the price".
But everyone also knows that this is a more normal price, and it is a very reasonable price.
Hobert spread his hands and added: "This 'pricing' is because I really don't have much demand for pounds. The only demand may be for personnel.
"For example, when it is inconvenient for me to come forward, or even when it is inconvenient for the power of 'The Creator' to come forward, I need a demigod or Sequence 5 to help me solve some problems.
"In addition, everyone knows the real price of information related to the Second Epoch. If I price the information at the previous price, firstly it is too cheap, and secondly, I have to trade several times before I can ask you to do a harmless help.
"This is a huge loss for me, so I want to change the form of the transaction."
Cattleya was the first to say: "I don't think there is a problem, after all, the information of the Second Epoch is not like the information of the Fourth Epoch or even the Third Epoch. There are still some traces to follow in the information of these two epochs. But except for some elf ruins, I have hardly found any information about the Second Epoch.
"This epoch is too far removed from us; the traces of its existence have long been eroded by time. This is the primary reason why this information is so valuable.
"We should differentiate it in price from the previous intelligence to reflect its true worth."
Alger also added, "Indeed, the mere fact that you are willing to trade this information with us makes it priceless."
Audrey then raised her hand, "What about those of us who haven't advanced to Sequence 5 yet?"
Hobert smiled and replied, "Wait until you advance to Sequence 5, or complete more Sequence 6-level tasks."
Other members also expressed their willingness to accept this pricing, only 'The World' spoke up belatedly.
It wasn't that Klein was unwilling to accept the pricing, but he had been contemplating something else: Hobert actually said that he 'doesn't have a great need for pounds' anymore. We're both demigods, so why do I always feel like my pounds are never enough? Could it be that Hobert only experienced this change after reaching Sequence 3?"
Klein thought to himself: This gives me a huge incentive to advance to Sequence 3.
With the price settled, Hobert said, "Then let's begin.
"According to Farbauti's description, the Second Epoch can be roughly divided into three ages, in chronological order: the Sprouting Era, the Early Era of Fire, and the Dual Era."
Everyone listened attentively to 'The Emperor's' description. This feeling was all too familiar to them, like looking at unknown history from an overhead perspective.
It wasn't like a jigsaw puzzle, where they could only glimpse a corner of history, making it difficult to see the whole picture.
"In the Sprouting Era, Beyonder creatures gradually gained intelligence." At this point, Hobert raised his hand, "I know what you're going to ask. This conflicts with the First Epoch intelligence I mentioned earlier.
"I realized this problem before, and just as I was preparing to find an opportunity to consult the great 'Creator,' it suddenly occurred to me that these two pieces of information might not be in conflict.
"Then I carefully recalled Farbauti's wording when describing this information and can confirm that he said 'Beyonder creatures.' These creatures include giants, dragons, and so on, before…"
At this moment, Emlyn suddenly reminded, "And the Sanguine!"
The other members all revealed knowing smiles.
"Yes, and the Sanguine." Hobert smiled with a hint of helplessness. "Uh, where was I?
"Oh, right, we already discussed this issue before. Beings at the level of gods are fundamentally different from mortals, so can 'Outer Deities' like the Ancient Sun God still be described as 'creatures'?"
Klein nodded: The logic is sound, but it feels like he's insulting someone, or rather, insulting 'The Fool.'
Cattleya also understood Hobert's meaning: In other words, 'Outer Deities' in the First Epoch had some intelligence, but Beyonder creatures at that time didn't necessarily have intelligence. These two pieces of information are indeed not contradictory or conflicting.
The other members also understood 'The Emperor's' meaning one after another. They once again marveled at how 'The Emperor's' thinking was always so unexpected, yet he could often find the key to the problem.
Hobert continued, "In the Sprouting Era, Beyonder creatures advanced through barbaric methods of mutual devouring. Although they possessed some intelligence, it must have been very limited.
"It wasn't until the eight ancient gods appeared one after another that this barbaric method of advancement improved slightly.
"But it was only a slight improvement, because the ancient gods contained a large number of 'high-sequence' Beyonder characteristics. The devouring and fall of 'high-sequences' were no longer as frequent.
"In my opinion, after the appearance of the ancient gods, devastating battles for the beings of the entire continent only ceased to erupt frequently.
"As for the accumulation of Beyonder characteristics within the ancient gods, I think that after reaching a certain level, the accumulation process wouldn't have many twists and turns.
"Because of the 'Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence,' they should always encounter Beyonder characteristics similar to or identical to those within themselves during the process of devouring.
"This means that the Beyonder characteristics within the eight ancient gods were supported by a main body. For example, 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti, whom we mentioned in detail before, primarily possessed the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Criminal' pathway.
"Because of the existence of such 'main body' Beyonder characteristics, the eight ancient gods were relatively crazy, but they possessed a certain degree of intelligence."
Cattleya marveled at 'The Emperor's' apt application of the 'Law of Beyonder characteristics' and how reliable his conclusions always were.
This time, Leonard no longer marveled at how detailed 'The Emperor's' information was, because he had already become accustomed to it.
Hobert continued, "The Sprouting Era lasted for an unknown number of years, and experienced countless cruel battles. After the ancient gods formed two opposing camps, the Early Era of Fire began.
"We've mentioned those two camps before, but we didn't go into enough detail at the time. This time, we'll talk about them in detail."
Everyone listened with great focus, enjoying 'The Emperor's' "detailed explanations" the most.
"The two camps are the 'Pan-Human Camp' and the 'Non-Human Camp.' The 'Pan-Human Camp' includes 'Giant King' Aurmir, 'Elf King' Soniathrym, and 'Sanguine Ancestor' Lilith.
"The 'Non-Human Camp' includes 'Dragon of Imagination' Ankewelt, 'Phoenix Ancestor' Gregrace, and 'Mutant King' Kvastir.
"In addition, 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' Flegrea and 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti did not join either camp."
Hobert changed his posture slightly and said in a serious tone, "I've discovered a problem here!
"At the time, humans were similar to present-day curly-haired baboons and were not the mainstream of the extraordinary world, or rather, the rulers of the world.
"So, the question is, why were the two camps at that time named 'Pan-Human' and 'Non-Human'?
"Just like now, with the increasingly tense situation in the Northern Continent, the Loen Kingdom and the Fösac Empire will inevitably seek allies.
"If they formed two military alliances, they wouldn't call them the 'Curly-Haired Baboon Camp' and the 'Non-Curly-Haired Baboon Camp,' would they?"
Emlyn thought to himself: 'The Emperor's' question is very strange, but for some inexplicable reason, it seems to make some sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 625 A Brief History of the Second Era
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The "Fool" Klein, behind the gray fog, thought: Before, I was still lamenting that Hobert's way of thinking was more similar to that of the "AD era" people. Now it seems that I was careless. I don't have such bizarre and abnormal ideas.
"Justice" Audrey smiled slightly: Could it be that "Lawyers" all think so strangely? But Hobert seems to have discovered many problems with such a strange way of thinking.
The other members also seemed to realize that there seemed to be some secrets hidden in this naming.
"Emperor" Hobert continued: "After my thinking, I came up with two answers. The first is that although this history is a struggle between the ancient gods, the races that later depended on the ancient gods gradually came to an end in history.
"The Sanguine have historical records left, but what about the giants, dragons, and elves? They may also have certain historical records and recordings, but it is very likely that they were destroyed together when their races faced extinction."
"Moon" Emlyn couldn't help but raise his chin again when he heard this.
Hobert didn't pause: "Since the Second Epoch, humans have gradually become the protagonists of the era and the world. So, could the existing history of the Second Epoch be written from a human perspective?
"Could Farbauti have been deeply influenced by humans over the long years, so he used human understanding of the time to explain it to me?
"This is very likely to happen. Demons were an extraordinary race in the Second Epoch, but later, with the advancement system of potions, humans could also become demons.
"In addition, in order to hide themselves, demons had to live with humans, and some intermarriage would definitely occur.
"It is possible that humans gradually influenced the demons in this way, and the demons influenced Farbauti, so the 'Devil Monarch' also has a human image when communicating with me!"
Everyone nodded slowly, feeling that the "Emperor's" guess was very convincing and had strong logic.
"Magician" Fors suddenly realized: Hobert rarely uses his ability to "forcibly persuade" others. Could it be that his ability is like now, making people feel very reasonable without realizing that they have been "forcibly persuaded"?
Then she breathed a sigh of relief: Fortunately, I have never noticed Hobert using it on me… Probably, maybe he hasn't used it on me, right?
Hobert continued: "Let's review the second era of the Second Epoch, called the 'Era of Fire'. Whose 'Fire' is it?
"After the ancient gods appeared, Beyonder creatures had already entered a relatively prosperous era. Could that still be called the Fire?
"For them, the 'Sprouting Era' was the 'Fire'.
"So I think that the Fire here refers to humans! Further speculation, naming the ancient gods' camps with 'Pan-Human' and 'Non-Human' camps is completely understandable."
"Hermit" Cattleya sighed: Maybe it won't take four times, at most two such transactions, and my potion will definitely be basically digested.
"Moon" Emlyn was a little unwilling to accept this view: In the Second Epoch, the Sanguine were one of the ruling races! Why don't we have history from the Sanguine perspective?
But thinking of the discussion between humans and Sanguine that he had with the "Emperor" before, he had to accept this fact.
"Little Sun" Derrick sighed: I have also heard descriptions of the "Pan-Human" and "Non-Human" camps, but why didn't I think of this?
Klein seemed to see the scene of humans, suffering from madness and enslavement, still not forgetting to record their own history. This was indeed something humans could do.
At this time, Hobert continued: "As for the second guess, it is too shocking. I will not announce it to everyone until I have conclusive evidence."
Hobert planned to wait until "Little Sun" and the others explored the Giant King's Court before talking about that guess.
He skipped directly to the next topic: "Let's call those two camps in a human way. After careful analysis, I found that these two camps also have two characteristics.
"One camp is characterized by being 'relatively rational'. This refers to the 'Pan-Human camp'. The 'Giant King', 'Elven King', and 'Sanguine Ancestor' only have one main pathway in their bodies.
"The 'Giant King' corresponds to the 'Warrior', the 'Elven King' corresponds to the 'Sailor', and the 'Sanguine Ancestor' corresponds to the 'Apothecary'.
"Although they must also have Beyonder characteristics of other pathways in their bodies, relatively speaking, there is a distinction between primary and secondary.
"And the other camp should be relatively more crazy, because in addition to the 'Mutant King', the other two ancient gods have two non-adjacent Beyonder characteristics in their bodies.
"The 'Phoenix Ancestor' has the characteristics of the 'Corpse Collector' pathway and the 'Apprentice' pathway, and the 'Dragon of Imagination' has the characteristics of the 'Spectator' and another pathway."
Hobert paused here and said: "Currently, I have not obtained accurate information. Which pathway is the other pathway in the 'Dragon of Imagination'?
"But I guess it should be the 'Reader' pathway. After all, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom was once a subsidiary god of the 'Dragon of Imagination'.
"And in the Third Epoch after the fall of the 'Dragon of Imagination', the God of Knowledge and Wisdom became the 'King of Angels'. It is very likely that the 'Dragon of Imagination' provided Him with all or part of the Beyonder characteristics used for advancement."
At this time, Leonard didn't think such topics were so blasphemous. He was almost used to the blasphemous remarks provided by the "Emperor".
He was just a little emotional: So the God of Knowledge and Wisdom also has such a dark history.
And Hobert had briefly mentioned this matter before, so the other members didn't feel surprised.
Hobert continued the original topic: "Considering that the Beyonder characteristics in the 'Dragon of Imagination' are adjacent pathways, then His state should be better than that of the 'Phoenix Ancestor'.
"But it shouldn't be much better, because no one knows whether He devoured the relevant Beyonder characteristics in an 'orderly' manner?
"According to my understanding, if the 'Dragon of Imagination' first possessed the relatively complete characteristics of the 'Spectator' and then devoured the 'Reader' pathway, then His state should be among the better ones among the ancient gods.
"But according to the assumptions about the Second Epoch, such 'orderly' devouring is almost impossible, so His state may only be slightly better than the 'Phoenix Ancestor'.
"Finally, let's talk about the 'Mutant King'. According to the current information, although He mainly possesses the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Prisoner' pathway.
"But we all know that Sequence 8 of this pathway is called 'Lunatic'. Through my observation of the "Rose School of Thought", if this pathway is slightly out of control, it will become irrational and tend to madness.
"And the 'Mutant King', who did not have auxiliary Ingredients, corresponding rituals, and may even have advanced by leaps and bounds, should also be very worrying in terms of rationality.
"So in my opinion, the camps of the ancient gods at that time may be two camps of ancient gods who are relatively rational against more crazy ancient gods."
Most of the members of the Tarot Club have seen the members of the "Indulgence" faction in the "Rose School of Thought", knowing that they have the ability to sacrifice rationality to gain power, and also knowing that they are very easy to lose their minds in the face of desire.
So they all expressed their approval of the "Emperor's" profound analysis.
"Let's look at the last two ancient gods." Seeing that everyone had no doubts, Hobert continued: "I think the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' didn't want to join a certain camp, because He has an antagonistic relationship with one of the members of the two camps.
"This is a speculation based on the relevant laws of Beyonder characteristics. The 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' has the Beyonder characteristics of 'Sleepless' and 'Seer' in its body.
"These two pathways are adjacent pathways to the 'Warrior' pathway possessed by the 'Giant King' in the 'Pan-Human camp' and the 'Corpse Collector' and 'Door' pathways possessed by the 'Phoenix Ancestor' in the 'Non-Human camp'.
"At this level, the mutual attraction of the 'Law of Beyonder characteristic Convergence' should already be very strong. The external manifestation is that the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' is very likely to start a war with the 'Giant King' and the 'Phoenix Ancestor'.
"So He will not join, and the other ancient gods will not invite Him to join any camp."
"Justice" Audrey recalled Hobert's previous speculation about the "Six Gods camp" and the "True Creator camp" in the Fourth Epoch: In my eyes, those "Beyonder characteristic Laws" are just laws. I didn't expect them to be used like this. But then again, laws are not decorations, they are meant to be used, it's just that I don't know how to use them very well.
Klein behind the gray fog also believed that Hobert's speculation was infinitely close to the truth: Beyonder history, to put it bluntly, is the history of Beyonder characteristics. Using the laws of Beyonder characteristics to speculate on extraordinary history is a very appropriate idea.
Hobert added: "As for the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti, He is indeed a relatively unique existence. He and the 'Mutant King' are adjacent pathways, and His pathway is inclined to 'Unwinged Angel', and seems to have good rationality.
"But I don't know why, He didn't join the 'Pan-Human camp'. Perhaps because of His cold-bloodedness, He didn't want to join any camp and have any involvement with other ancient gods.
"And it is possible that precisely because He is very rational, He realized that the emergence of the two camps is actually the fuse of frequent wars, so He did not participate in any camp."
At this time, Hobert said casually: "Of course, it may also be because the ancient gods generally believed that the demon race was not a member of the 'Pan-Human' group."
"Star" Leonard frowned: Demons are demons. Of course, in ancient times, they were two different things from humans. It was only later that some humans took the "Criminal" pathway potion that the boundary between the two races became blurred.
Then he seemed to realize that the "Emperor's" last sentence was not simple, but he didn't have any idea where the "Emperor" was specifically pointing.
Audrey and other members also noticed this, but Hobert did not explore it in depth, but continued: "In the Era of Fire, the ancient gods discharged some messy Beyonder characteristics from their bodies through reproduction and other methods.
"This allowed the ancient gods to gradually have more rationality in this era. By the time of the last era, the 'Dual Era', the ancient gods were relatively more rational than in the Sprouting Era.
"The boundary between the Era of Fire and the Dual Era is the battle between the 'Sanguine Ancestor' and the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' and the 'Mutant King'.
"We have discussed this battle in which three ancient gods fell in detail before. Although there are still some questions that have not been answered, the general situation has been straightened out."
Hobert saw Leonard's confused face and said: "In order to take care of the new members, I will briefly explain it again.
"According to the information I obtained later, this battle was a huge conspiracy. After I understand all the information, I may make another transaction on this battle…"
At this time, Emlyn opened his mouth and said: "Please collect as much information as possible about the 'Sanguine Ancestor' and the information about the people... I mean the gods who betrayed our progenitor."
"Okay." Hobert casually agreed and continued: "This battle had a far-reaching impact. The 'Giant King' and the 'Elven King' accused each other of being traitors, and the 'Pan-Human camp' disintegrated as a result.
"And the subsidiary gods of the three fallen ancient gods, the 'Beauty Goddess', defected to the Elven King, who was the later Empress of the Trunsoest Empire.
"The 'God of Spiritual Creatures' picked up the relevant characteristics in the war and advanced to the level of the King of Angels in the Third Epoch, who was the later 'God of Bound'.
"The 'God of the Dead' defected to the 'Phoenix Ancestor', who was the Death of the Fourth Epoch.
"The 'God of Wishes' has almost never appeared in people's sight after this battle.
"Antigonus and the 'Mother of the Sky', who appeared in the Northern Continent in the Fourth Epoch, were the subsidiary gods of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf'. It was also at that time that they fled to the Hornacis Mountains and established the later 'Nation of the Evernight'."
"Wait a minute." Leonard interrupted the "Emperor's" narrative here: "Sorry, are you saying that the 'Mother of the Sky' also came from the Second Epoch? Is she a subsidiary god of the ancient gods?"
As a "Red Gloves" of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, he still knew some information about the "Mother of the Sky".
And "Old Man" had mentioned the Antigonus family before. Leonard did not expect that this family could be traced back to the Second Epoch!
"Yes." Hobert replied: "Later, the 'Nation of the Evernight' was destroyed by the Church of the Evernight Goddess."
Leonard nodded: "I understand."
He knew the information that the "Nation of the Evernight" was destroyed by the Evernight Goddess.
Klein thought: Hurry up, say who the last subsidiary god is! I'm already ready to admire Leonard's surprised expression.
Hobert continued: "The one who gained the most benefit in this battle should be the 'Goddess of Misfortune'. She obtained the Uniqueness of the 'Sleepless' pathway and all Sequence 1 characteristics after the fall of the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf'…"
Leonard thought he had misheard.
"…After disappearing from the public's view for a period of time," Hobert also looked at Leonard: "She became the Evernight Goddess and returned to the public's view, and established the Church of the Evernight Goddess, which is one of the earliest organizations to protect humans."
Leonard's posture became very stiff: "The, the Evernight Goddess!"
Hobert leaned back in his chair and joked: "The Evernight Goddess can't suddenly become a god, right?"
Everyone knew that Mr. Star was from the Church of the Evernight Goddess, and they all knew that he should be very surprised at this time, especially Audrey. When she heard this news, she was so surprised that she could no longer maintain the state of a spectator.
Leonard had the word "blasphemy" on the tip of his tongue, but he swallowed it in the end, because "Emperor" was right, the Evernight Goddess always has a process of becoming a god.
He just didn't expect that he would hear about this process today, in the Second Epoch, in that dark age!
Seeing Leonard's expression, Klein suddenly felt much more balanced. The degree of surprise he felt when he heard the news was no less than Leonard's current performance.
After waiting for a dozen seconds, Leonard gradually calmed down, and Hobert continued, "After the war in which the three ancient gods fell, the 'Dual Era' arrived."
"My personal understanding of 'Dual' is that it refers to the era when ancient gods and the Ancient Sun God, Beyonder creatures and humans, jointly ruled the world."
"In the early part of this era, the ancient gods led giants, dragons, phoenixes, elves, and demons to dominate the world. In the later period, with the emergence of the Ancient Sun God, humans gradually moved to the center of the historical stage."
"But I don't know if this understanding is correct, because 'Dual' seems to still refer to 'individuals' rather than races."
"So I also inquired about another saying, 'Dual' refers to the Ancient Sun God and Hermes. In ancient times, Hermes had a very high status."
"Before the appearance of the first 'Blasphemy Slate,' He was the pioneer of humans in the Second Epoch who experimented with medicine, and drawing on Jotun and Dragon language, He invented Ancient Hermes language, providing prerequisites for human Beyonders in terms of mysticism."
"Sun" Derrick thought for a moment before saying, "Mr. Emperor, the City of Silver doesn't seem to have any records about Hermes."
"This is also the reason why this statement is not widely recognized," Hobert said, "Because you have been using Jotun, which is another language family, but this also shows that Ancient Hermes language may have only become widely circulated in the human world in the Fourth Epoch."
"Moreover, later there was Ancient Feysac language, which evolved from Jotun, which again weakened the importance of Hermes."
He said seriously, "But I believe that Hermes is a very important figure in the extraordinary history of mankind!
"He represents people's resistance to that barbaric extraordinary world. At that time, there must have been more than just Hermes who experimented with medicine. Perhaps the Beyonder creatures at that time would have found them ridiculous."
"But we must admit that they are our pioneers. Humans have stood on their shoulders to reach the stage of history."
Klein behind the gray fog sighed in his heart: I agree with this point, or rather, like Hobert, I am more willing to admire this bottom-up resistance than to revere the power of the gods! It's a pity that this is an extraordinary world, and such resistance is destined to be submerged by the torrent of history and forgotten by people.
Derrick was slightly stunned by the words of "Emperor". At this time, he felt some empathy, because the City of Silver has also been fighting against fate, although in the eyes of the gods, such resistance is ridiculous.
Others also felt something, and at the same time sighed at the weakness of human power in the face of the extraordinary.
Hobert did not continue this topic, but said, "In the early stage of the Dual Era, with the disintegration of the 'Pan-Human Camp,' some changes occurred again in the camps of the ancient gods."
"First of all, the 'Giant King' fought against both the 'Elf King' and the 'Dragon of Imagination' at the same time. Fortunately, the 'Elf King' and the 'Dragon of Imagination' are adjacent pathways and are also in a state of hostility."
"And the 'Giant King' and the 'Dragon of Imagination' are also old rivals, so it is impossible for the three of them to form any alliance, otherwise it is likely that another ancient god will fall."
"The battles in the early stage of the 'Dual Era' almost revolved around these three gods. They checked and balanced each other, were hostile to each other, and lasted for a long time."
"It is said that in order to fight against the 'Elf King,' the 'Giant King' also sent his queen and eldest son to seek cooperation from human secret organizations."
"But all of this was interrupted by the appearance of the Ancient Sun God."
The other members, especially Derrick, sat up straight, because they were more familiar with the content that followed.
Hobert paused here and said, "The Ancient Sun God should also have many secrets, but now I know too little information. When I have a complete understanding, we will trade again."
"We have talked about the things that happened later in previous transactions. With the appearance of the Ancient Sun God with the first 'Blasphemy Slate,' humans rose rapidly."
"The Ancient Sun God successively defeated or killed four ancient gods except for the 'Devil Monarch'. Those Beyonder creatures, because of the fall of their gods, became the prey for humans to obtain Beyonder characteristics or main ingredients."
"Mr. Hanged Man and I once saw related descriptions in the ruins of an elven race."
"The rise of mankind was accompanied by systematic killing and occupation. It was a very bloody history, but the ancestors of mankind did not record too much about this era."
"Let's just pretend we don't know, after all, humans were also killed and enslaved by Beyonder creatures at will in the middle and early stages of the Second Epoch."
"With the fall of the ancient gods and the rise of mankind, we ushered in the prosperous Third Epoch!"
"As for the history of the Third Epoch, we have already traded it before."
As usual, everyone first spent more than half a minute digesting the information and sighing inwardly.
So far, all the history has been connected, from the Second Epoch to the present!
Klein sighed in his heart: This is a very remarkable thing. Few organizations have such a complete history. Only ancient gods like the "Creator" who may be from the First Epoch, and "survivors" from the Second Epoch like Farbauti, know it more completely.
At this time, Cattleya suddenly asked, "Mr. Emperor, since the Ancient Sun God appeared with the first 'Blasphemy Slate,' what is His relationship with the existence that formed the first 'Blasphemy Slate'?"
Hobert spread his hands and smiled, "Currently I don't have relevant information here, but since the pathways of the two may be similar, could it be that the Ancient Sun God discovered the 'Blasphemy Slate' when He obtained the characteristics of that existence in the First Epoch?"
Cattleya nodded, which was a reasonable guess.
This round of trading ended here. After a dozen seconds, Leonard saw that the other members had not initiated a new transaction, and then said to "Emperor", "Mr. Emperor, I hope to communicate with you privately."
Hobert nodded: "Okay."
After asking Mr. Fool to establish a separate communication environment, Leonard said, "An angel hopes to obtain a way to temporarily regain the state of His prime. I wonder if you have it there?"
Hobert was stunned: The old grandpa in Leonard's body easily killed Amon's avatar under the "Creator's" "magnification". As a result, He became addicted to the state of His heydey?
