chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 628: Establishing an open connection with Dwayne Dantes
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Dantès established overt contacts.
Electric lighting had already formed a chain of interests, but unlike gas lighting, half of the shareholders in electric lighting were military personnel, so the Gas Association held more power in political circles.
Many members of the Gas Association scoffed at electric lights, finding fault with them everywhere.
They only saw that their own interests were being infringed upon and wanted to protect them.
So they disliked electric lights in every way, trying every means to create scandals for 'Earl's Light' to make an issue of it.
But the seasoned veterans in the parliament could basically see that the Gas Association's attack was just their behind-the-scenes interest groups wanting a share of the electric lighting market.
After all, in terms of the brightness of the light alone, gas lamps had no chance of winning!
Interest groups have no sentiment; they only see interests.
The Gas Association was launching attacks from the front, and as soon as Hobert was forced to the negotiating table, representatives of the interest groups would immediately appear and obtain entry tickets to the electric lighting industry by selling out the Gas Association.
This was an old trick, but very effective.
Originally, the investigation team was quite happy to see Hobert's arrival, which meant that Hobert had finally compromised, and their efforts had finally paid off.
But what did Hobert mean by saying he was going to stop the sale of electric lights? Was he retreating?
That shouldn't be the case. Both Duke Christian and Earl Hall were quite high in political status among the nobles. With their mediation, 'Earl's Light' might lose some benefits now, but it would definitely have better development in the future!
While they were still wondering, Hobert had already taken off his top hat and said, "Ladies and gentlemen, I'll take my leave first."
It wasn't until Hobert left that everyone looked at each other, seemingly asking: What should we do now?
But then they thought that even if Hobert didn't want to expand the Backlund business, the shareholders of 'Earl's Light' would definitely not agree, and Hobert would come back sooner or later.
Sitting in the carriage, Hobert glanced contemptuously at the Houses of Parliament and then went to MI9 to work.
Now Hobert was becoming more and more nonchalant about working in MI9, only coming here for a stroll when he had time.
After scrounging a lunch at MI9, he came to the East Balam Veterans Mess with Qonas in the afternoon.
General Emlyn indeed brought new business to 'Earl's Light', working with the military to study the application of generators on ships.
The military funded the technology of 'Earl's Light' to develop generators, and the research results were owned by both parties.
Although it was said that it was owned by both parties, the lighting systems used on subsequent warships would definitely be ordered from 'Earl's Light'.
And 'Earl's Light' could also take orders for lighting systems for merchant ships. For 'Earl's Light', this was a very cost-effective business.
Hobert was slightly reserved and agreed to the research topic. He was very clear that everyone saw that electric lights were so profitable, and people's investment in the power industry would definitely be huge in the next few years.
Especially after a war breaks out, some research projects will be under military control, and the investment will become very huge. The technology of high-power generators may be overcome during the war.
Then Hobert must take advantage of the first-mover advantage to accumulate some cutting-edge technology.
After talking about business, the three people chatted while playing cards. Emlyn asked Hobert, "Is the Gas Association smearing 'Earl's Light'?"
General Emlyn was the representative of the military shareholders. If Hobert needed it, they certainly had ways to put pressure on the Gas Association.
Hobert smiled, "Maybe by next year, there won't be a Gas Association organization."
Emlyn and Qonas looked at Hobert together, especially Qonas. He remembered that Hobert wasn't so arrogant when he first joined MI9.
Qonas withdrew his gaze and glanced at his cards, but then he seemed to realize something, and the hand holding the cards couldn't help but tremble.
Hobert's honorific name was announced on Longtail Island, but the current Longtail Island is relatively closed except for Tortuga Harbor, and intelligence chief Qonas has not received relevant information.
Emlyn also seemed to realize something. While releasing the huge pressure of the 'Arbiter' pathway demigod, he seemed to say very casually: "It's good that you know what to do."
Hobert blocked Emlyn's pressure without showing any signs: "If necessary, I will ask you for help."
Emlyn felt that he had not tested Hobert's strength, but this already explained the problem, but he wanted to confirm it again, so he winked at Qonas.
Qonas also wanted to verify his guess, so he also exuded the majesty of a demigod, and the momentum of the two of them combined to suppress Hobert.
Just when the invisible contest in the chess room was at its most intense, there was a knock on the door first, and then the door of the chess room was pushed open.
Unlucky Colonel Calvin and Councilor Macht were hit again. This time, Macht didn't even shout "Goddess," and fell straight to the ground, and Colonel Calvin also retreated again and again.
Standing behind the two, Klein, with the face of Dwayne Dantes, quickly caught the fallen Councilor Macht.
Klein glanced at the chess room. After seeing Hobert and Emlyn, he was stunned for a moment, and then he sighed in his heart: It's just playing cards, is it necessary?
Then he glanced at Qonas. He had been investigating Qonas before, and today he finally had the opportunity to make friends.
At the card table, Emlyn and Qonas looked at each other. They had already confirmed through the test just now that Hobert was already a 'Frenzied Mage'.
When they were playing cards in July, Hobert was just a 'Earl of the Fallen'.
This time, Hobert got up again and greeted Klein and Calvin to carry Councilor Macht to the sofa. He used a 'Healing' spell. Although Macht didn't wake up for a while, he was no longer in any danger.
After Earl introduced Dwayne Dantes to everyone, the two also sat down, obviously wanting to join the game.
Because Qonas and the others were there, Hobert pretended not to know Klein.
Hobert was thinking about 'twisting' Klein's final victory at the card table to himself later, when General Emlyn and Qonas dropped their cards and lost their interest in playing cards.
Hobert was a little regretful. He had originally planned to compete with Klein at the card table.
Klein did not realize that he had missed an opportunity to win a lot of money, and he was very grateful that the game was over, otherwise there would be four demigods at the card table, and if they released the pressure of the demigods like just now, Councilor Macht might have just woken up and fainted again.
At the moment, Qonas chatted with Klein about the situation in the Southern Continent, actually inquiring about the previous arms deal in disguise.
After learning about the situation, Qonas took a sip of the champagne handed over by the waiter and smiled at Klein: "You are a very interesting person. I am very glad to meet you."
This sentence was a polite remark, representing the end of the conversation.
"I am also very glad to meet you." Klein originally wanted to seize the opportunity to establish contact with Qonas again, but because Emlyn and Hobert were there, it seemed inappropriate to talk about other topics.
So he stood up, as if to say goodbye, and glanced at Hobert.
Hobert understood and was willing to give Klein a cover, so he said: "I heard that you just came to Backlund at the beginning of the year?"
Klein, who had just raised his butt, sat down again: "Yes."
"Are you used to living here?"
"Except for the few days of seeing the sun, I am used to everything else."
Hobert smiled: "Then you have to prepare a manor in the suburbs. In winter, the fog in Backlund will be even worse!"
Klein's eyes lit up: "I am planning to do this, and I must buy a manor with a forest farm where I can hunt."
Qonas asked casually: "Do you like hunting?"
According to the information Klein obtained, one of the hobbies of this Qonas was hunting, so as soon as he had the opportunity, he turned the topic to this.
"Yes!" Klein said smoothly: "In the Southern Continent, you can hunt in the forest at will."
The ability of the 'Faceless' made every movement of Klein so natural. At this time, the expression on his face paused, and the joy turned into helplessness: "After coming to Backlund, I haven't even touched a gun."
Hobert sighed in his heart: At the demigod level, 'Seer' is definitely the nemesis of 'Spectator'. Both expressions and body movements are managed very well.
Hobert, who knew Klein's purpose very well, sent another assist: "I am not interested in hunting and don't know where there is such a manor. These two may be able to provide relevant information."
Qonas hesitated before opening his mouth: "I do know that there is a manor that meets your requirements for sale, but I have to send someone to confirm it again. When there is definite news, send it to... well, is it Boklun Street?"
"Yes." Klein said sincerely: "Thank you very much."
After having this layer of contact, Klein got up again to say goodbye.
After Dwayne Dantes left, Qonas commented: "This is a person who knows how to seize opportunities and has wildness."
Emlyn smiled: "In Backlund, even curly-haired baboons have to abide by the rules."
"That's right." Hobert followed Emlyn's words: "In my opinion, there are many curly-haired baboons in the upper class."
The three people chuckled together and talked about other topics.
At more than three o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert returned to the Earl's Mansion and finally had some free time, but he suddenly thought that he should make some high-level talismans of the Marauder Pathway.
Such talismans often have unexpected effects when placed next to you.
He sighed, feeling that he no longer had leisurely time after being promoted to Sequence 3.
After preparing twenty carved silver pieces, he went to the 'Nation of Disorder' to fetch 20 'Worms of Time', and then began to set up the altar, praying for the power of the Fool.
After chanting the honorific name and saying his prayer, Hobert quickly seemed to see the light of the spirit world and the illusory castle above it.
Then he felt the gaze of the "Fool," but the "Fool" did not respond immediately.
Hobert estimated that the "Fool" saw the twenty semi-finished talismans neatly arranged together and wanted to curse for a while.
One or two seconds later, the "Fool" began to respond to Hobert's prayer.
Because the talisman was relatively high-level, it was not the kind of talisman below the demigod level that could be made in batches. Even after Klein became a demigod and mastered more power "above the gray fog," he could only empower three talismans with enough power at a time.
When 20 talismans were completed, the "Fool's" gaze immediately disappeared.
Hobert praised Mr. Fool. He estimated that Klein's spirituality should be almost squeezed dry: So this is how it feels to shear wool.
He checked the talismans on the altar, there were 4 "Fate Siphon Charms", 10 "Deception Charms", and 6 "Deprivation Charms".
Hobert instantly felt as if he had a "Beyonder Gatling", and there were no opponents below the angels!
Distribute the black crystal-like talismans, carry some on his body, and put some in the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert originally wanted to put them in the Earl's Mansion, but he was afraid that these talismans would attract thieves, so he might as well put them directly in the "Nation of Disorder" to feel at ease.
After resting for a while, Hobert went to Earl Hall's mansion for a banquet in the evening.
Hobert originally wanted to chat with Audrey first, but because of his speech in the Houses of Parliament today, it was completely beyond everyone's expectations.
Earl Hall kept Hobert in the living room and talked about the problem of "Earl's Light".
"I know you are very worried about 'Earl's Light'." Hobert smiled: "But please rest assured, I will solve the problem properly."
Earl Hall's eldest son, Hibbert, asked: "Has 'Earl's Light' encountered any difficulties? That's why it had to make such a compromise?"
"Hobert obviously has no intention of making any compromises or concessions." Earl Hall, an old fox, saw it clearly.
Hobert smiled: "That's right, it can only be said that the Gas Association chose the wrong opponent."
He then said seriously: "In fact, the Gas Association is not without opportunities. They have rich capital accumulation and still have most of the lighting market.
"At this time, it is completely too late for them to turn to electricity investment.
"Unfortunately, the long-term comfort has made them lose their determination to be enterprising."
Earl Hall and his son were silent for a few seconds before Hibbert said: "Do you know who your opponent is?"
Hobert smiled: "Of course I know."
He changed the subject: "But ah, they are obviously asking me for help, wanting to share our interests, and they are still so arrogant and accusatory.
"Maybe someone used to indulge them, but that was before, that was someone else, I won't indulge them.
"If you want to share a piece of the pie, you have to come to me with a smile and talk to me politely.
"Making money is not shameful."
Hibbert was about to say something, but Earl Hall raised his hand to stop him: "It's good to have such momentum."
He touched his temples with a few white hairs: "When I was young, I also had some ideas, but later, those ideas were worn away."
Hobert smiled: "These people can't wear me down."
Earl Hall did not continue to talk about this topic, but asked about the frequent contact between the senior management of "Earl's Light" and the ambassador of the Intis Republic.
This is also why the Prime Minister attaches so much importance to the "Earl's Light" issue, because it may involve the leakage of cutting-edge technology.
The fact that "Earl's Light" had contact with ambassadors from other countries is hardly a secret in Backlund. Hobert also generously admitted that "Earl's Light" would go to the Intis Republic to build power plants in the future.
He said, "The biggest problem here may be the government's obstruction. Now that there is an opportunity, the problem can be solved once and for all."
Earl Hall smiled and said, "This idea is very good."
They, father and son, are first nobles, then businessmen, and finally members of the Parliament of the Kingdom of Loen.
In their opinion, this kind of transnational business is very normal. The only thing they worry about is how much profit "Earl's Light" can make.
Hobert thought to himself: Of course, it's very good, "Plan before you move!"
They chatted for a while, and it was time for dinner.
At the dinner table, Audrey and Caitlin also talked about "Earl's Light". Hobert only told them that he would solve the problem as soon as possible so that they don't have to worry.
After dinner, when a few people were walking, Hobert finally had the opportunity to be alone with Audrey.
Audrey asked worriedly, "Hobert, are we really going to stop all business in Backlund?"
"It's a temporary suspension." Hobert smiled and said, "We took so many orders before, and it will take until the end of September to install them. We can just take this opportunity to catch up."
Before, "Earl's Light" had too few electricians, and the installation speed was too slow. So far, the orders received still need to be delayed for more than half a month to complete the installation.
The two walked in the garden, and the electric lights illuminated the entire garden very brightly.
Audrey asked again, "But, what about after half a month?"
"It won't take that long to solve the problem," Hobert said.
"You already have a solution?"
Hobert replied, "The solution is ready-made. Since they used some despicable means, then don't blame me for being impolite."
He didn't continue this topic, but whispered, "Are you ready? How about we take action tonight?"
Audrey hesitated for a moment before nodding: "Okay!"
"Your partner in this mission is Xio." Hobert said, "Because it's your first time participating in such a mission, this mission will be led by Xio, and you must obey her orders."
Since confirming her relationship with Hobert, Audrey no longer contacted Xio: "Okay."
She decided to change her appearance and figure for a while to avoid affecting the night's action.
Hobert briefly introduced the two targets, neither of which was difficult to deal with.
Finally, the two agreed that Hobert would pick up Audrey at eleven o'clock in the evening, and then they talked about other topics.
Audrey wanted to know the situation in the Southern Continent, so Hobert talked about the current progress of the Balk family. Now this family has participated in the management of three states, about the size of a county in the Kingdom of Loen.
Of course, they are only one of the forces in that land. The other forces include local nobles or generals, and colonists from the Northern Continent.
With Hobert's huge investment, the family's power has developed rapidly.
Currently, the Balk family is getting along well with the colonists. After all, the colonists also hope that their territory will have investment from the Northern Continent.
The development model for the Southern Continent is similar to that of the Southern Colson area and Longtail Island. Hobert plans to first establish a complete industrial and agricultural system, and then open up investment channels to the outside world.
This is a development method that has been proven to be highly controllable. If foreign investment channels are opened up during the initial accumulation, the country's industry and economy may not be completely controlled by the government in the future.
Talking about this aspect, Hobert had a strong desire to talk. As they talked, it was already past nine o'clock in the evening.
It was already late, and it would be a little impolite not to say goodbye.
Hobert returned to the Earl's Mansion, changed into clothes that were easy to move in, and then found Xio, told her to take action tonight, and asked her to be prepared.
At eleven o'clock, Hobert picked up Audrey and sent her to the rental carriage that Xio had found.
After a few simple instructions, Hobert pretended to leave.
In fact, he was still secretly following behind, to see if he could lure out the messenger of the Aurora Order.
However, Hobert also knew that the first assassination operation should not encounter the intervention of the Aurora Order's messenger, but would only attract their attention.
The second assassination operation might attract the support of the Aurora Order's messenger.
But this time Hobert will definitely follow them, one is to ensure Audrey's safety, and the other is to see how much Xio's progress has been after her advancement.
Hobert followed the carriage three or four kilometers behind, as if he was taking a leisurely stroll.
Soon they arrived at the residence of the first target. The carriage stopped far away. Audrey followed Xio and walked quickly in the shadows of the street.
This is an old apartment building in the Cherwood Borough. The target lives on the third floor. The tactic is for Audrey to sneak into the third floor and break in.
Xio hangs outside the window, waiting for the target to escape during the attack, or quickly jump in to support.
According to Xio's experience, the other party will definitely escape. After all, they are members of the Aurora Order and have been in hiding. After encountering an attack, they will first consider escaping.
Bang~
At the agreed time, the door was kicked open by Audrey.
As Xio expected, the target, who was already alerted by her spirituality, immediately fled to the window.
But his escape slowed down suddenly, as if he was strolling on the street, his eyes sometimes dazed, and sometimes with obvious struggles.
Looking at Audrey at the door again, her two pupils turned light gold, but because she was a little nervous, the hypnosis of "giving up any resistance" to the target was not very effective, and this Aurora Order member could break free at any time.
Xio outside noticed the opportunity, jumped nimbly, and smashed the window. The target seemed to wake up suddenly from a dream, but before he could use his Beyonder power, Xio's dagger had pierced his carotid artery.
After pulling out the dagger, Xio dodged very skillfully.
Pfft~
Blood splattered on the wall, but Xio's body was not stained with a single drop.
Audrey watched the target fall to the ground, used an "appeasement" on herself, took the quilt as planned, wrapped the still twitching body with Xio, and then quickly left from the window.
When they re-entered the shadows on the street, the residents who were awakened by the sound of the door being knocked down and the barking of dogs came to check what was going on.
Back in the rental carriage, Audrey tried to put her feet away to avoid touching the body.
Xio smiled secretly, but said nothing.
Although Audrey performed well, she didn't panic in the first action, but because she was "unfamiliar" with her, she didn't make any reminders, but talked about the situation of the second target.
The second target was a Sequence 8, and their actions were even smoother. They had completed two assassination missions by midnight.
After leaving the scene for a distance, Audrey got off the car, and Xio went to dispose of the body.
After the carriage drove away, Hobert appeared beside Audrey.
Immediately afterwards, the two entered the illusory spirit world and appeared in the study of the Earl's Mansion a few seconds later.
Audrey, wearing a black knight's uniform, took off her mask: "I, I almost vomited just now."
This tight-fitting dress showed a different kind of beauty of Audrey. The original weak girlish temperament disappeared, and every movement seemed to become more powerful.
Hobert smiled and said, "It's normal to have this reaction the first time you see someone killed."
Audrey sat on the chair and rested for a while before asking, "Why did Xio take the body away?"
"Because you are facing a Beyonder organization. For other Beyonders, the body will hide many clues." Hobert said, "Xio did a very professional job."
Audrey asked again, "Will the driver of that rental carriage call the police?"
"Backlund after dark belongs to the dark world." Hobert smiled and said, "In this big city, there are many people doing some shady work.
"I remember Xio mentioned that she has similar cooperative relationships with many drivers, and there is no need to worry about informing, because these coachmen also have some shady secrets."
Then Hobert helped Audrey review: "Next time you attack the enemy, I suggest you try to use 'Awe' or 'Madness' to affect the opponent's state first, and then go to 'Hypnosis', the effect may be better.
"In addition, after 'Hypnosis', don't always maintain the state of 'Hypnosis'. It doesn't matter if 'Hypnosis' can last for a few seconds. Use the Sealed Artifact I gave you to quickly attack the target.
"That way, even if the target immediately breaks away from the 'Hypnosis' state, you will have a certain advantage."
Audrey was stunned: "You, you were there at the time?"
Hobert smiled: "No, but I can see your battle."
He just used "distortion" and "tampering" of distance to allow his vision and hearing to appear on the battlefield, while he himself was four kilometers away.
Audrey glanced at the clock in the corner before getting up and said, "Remember to call me next time you have this kind of action."
"No problem." Hobert took Audrey's hand and sent her back.
Back in the study, Hobert waited for more than half an hour before Xio came to hand over the mission.
After taking the two Beyonder characteristics handed over by Xio, Hobert said, "When you submit the investigation information of the other three Aurora Order members, bring the advancement auxiliary Ingredients by the way, and I will immediately give you the Beyonder characteristics of 'Judge'."
Xio was stunned for a moment, feeling a little unbelievable.
Before, when she got the potion formula of "Judge", the masked man once again persuaded Xio to join "MI9", because even if she got the potion formula, it would be almost impossible to find the main ingredient of "Judge" through Beyonder gatherings or other means.
This is the channel controlled by the royal family. In the Kingdom of Loen and the Kingdom of Feynapotter, there is no circulation of materials at this level.
Not to mention the Sequence 6 level, over the years, Xio has not even seen the main ingredient of the Sequence 7 level of this pathway in Beyonder gatherings.
And now that she has completed a round of assassination missions and two rounds of investigation missions, she can actually get the Beyonder characteristics of "Judge".
Although she had realized that she would soon be able to obtain the characteristics of "Judge" when she planned to cooperate with Hobert before, she still felt a little unreal when it came to this point.
"No problem." Xio paused before saying.
Hobert took out 300 pounds in cash from his wallet: "100 pounds of which is the reward for investigating the address of Hvin Rambis before.
"The remaining 200 pounds is the investigation fee for the previous investigation of the gas storage location and the investigation fee for the new gas storage location tomorrow."
Xio said again: "Too much."
If calculated according to the bounty hunter's charging standards, the charges for these investigations add up to a maximum of 160 pounds to 180 pounds.
Hobert handed the money over: "Not much, because I have other requirements."
"What requirements?"
"Pay attention to the construction of the intelligence network." Hobert said, "This is good for both you and me.
"In addition, if you don't have a reference object in building the intelligence network, I can arrange for you to study at 'MI9'."
Xio took the money: "I am very familiar with the methods of 'MI9'."
She thought for a while and said, "The only thing I lack is loyal subordinates to operate the intelligence network."
Hobert thought that the Demoness Research Society has already started operating: "After you are promoted to Sequence 6, I will provide you with some manpower. If there are people suitable to be your subordinates, you can keep them."
Xio realized at this time that her current cooperation with Hobert is very similar to opening a company together.
Hobert provides money and people, and she provides the effort.
But this is also very good. Which bounty hunter doesn't want to have a stable and wide-ranging intelligence network?
After Xio agreed to Hobert's cooperation intention, she asked, "Why do you say it is an investigation of the new storage location of gas?"
"You will know tomorrow." Hobert smiled and said, "If you realize that you are exposed, immediately notify me by praying to the 'Creator'."
Xio realized that Hobert's counterattack was about to begin: "No problem."
Hobert opened a bottle of wine and poured a glass for himself and Xio: "Congratulations, tonight's mission was completed very successfully."
What Hobert wanted to congratulate more was Xio's recent progress.
For bounty hunters like her who fight alone, performing tasks and earning bounties is the best way to hone themselves.
And in this regard, Xio has enough experience.
After Xio left, Hobert looked at the thick fog outside, drank two more glasses of wine, and then opened the information provided by Xio before: "Let me see, where to start?"
Boom~
Two minutes later, a violent explosion came from the city of Backlund. A gas storage point suddenly exploded for some reason.
What was even more confused were the two staff members on the night shift. They didn't know if they were blown out by the air wave? Or how did they come out?
Anyway, when they came back to their senses, they had already fallen to the street.
This huge explosion woke up all the surrounding residents. Some people wanted to light the gas lamp, but even if they put in the coins, there was no gas.
Boom~
Just when people were wondering, another violent explosion occurred.
At this time, people who had electric lights at home immediately turned on the lights and looked outside.
While those still using gas lamps were plunged into darkness, forced to search for long-unused candles.
For Backlund, it was destined to be a sleepless night, as a loud explosion occurred every few minutes with remarkable regularity.
After the fifth explosion, several gas companies finally reacted and quickly dispatched people to investigate.
However, due to the lack of rapid communication, by the time the emergency response team arrived at the scene of the accident, several more explosions had already occurred.
When the eighth explosion occurred, Georgina was already in her office, and the demigod on duty at MI9 had returned after a brief investigation of three of the explosion sites.
Upon learning that the explosions occurred at gas storage locations, Georgina immediately sent someone to contact Deputy Director Hobert of the Action Division to see if he was at the Earl's residence.
Soon, the agent responsible for contacting Hobert returned and reported that the Deputy Director was at his mansion drinking and said he would complain to the city government about being woken up so late.
Georgina snorted coldly, concluding that this was Hobert's revenge, as she had received orders more than once to bribe Hobert and show goodwill towards him, without receiving any orders to stop.
Therefore, Georgina simply sent someone to report the current situation and her guess to the Sodela Palace, with no intention of meddling.
The explosions lasted for more than an hour before stopping, as all the gas storage areas had been bombed, essentially waking up most of Backlund's residents.
...
The next morning, Xio took a public carriage to a gas storage area in the Saint George district to check the situation.
Because there were many onlookers, Xio, wearing elevator shoes, did not attract the attention of others.
The gas storage area had been bombed into ruins, and the explosion also affected the buildings on both sides. One of the residences was severely damaged and collapsed. Many residents were cursing the gas company, and some onlookers suggested they seek compensation from the gas company.
In everyone's conversation, Xio learned that although the explosion was very violent, surprisingly, the blast wave had blown the people in the affected buildings out. Only some of them suffered minor injuries.
Xio smiled, then noticed that the gas company had already excavated the gas pipeline and was clearing a road leading to the pipeline.
Obviously, they wanted to quickly install some temporary gas tanks onto the gas pipeline to prevent residents from having no gas at night.
This was a result Xio had anticipated. Last night, she believed that the most economical method for the gas company would be to connect some temporary gas tanks to the original pipeline, without requiring many new storage locations.
At this time, someone finally questioned: why is there no report in today's newspaper about the many violent explosions that occurred last night?
...
The reaction of the major publications seemed to be helping the gas company cover up the accident last night, but this was actually what Hobert wanted to see most.
That morning, after making the final arrangements at the 'Earl's Light,' Hobert returned to the Earl's residence.
Then, from the study of the Earl's residence, he used 'Travel' to depart and arrived on a main road on the west side of Backlund, quickly waiting for James and his party to leave Backlund and head to a royal estate.
James, with his gray hair, was sitting in the carriage with his eyes closed, resting.
Of course, he knew that as long as he could reach the royal estate he was going to take office at, his current crisis would be over.
With his Sequence, being re-appointed was only a matter of time.
He realized someone was following him as soon as he left Sodela Palace.
However, he didn't care much because he knew his enemies best, and none of those enemies could threaten him.
The team rested under a shady tree on the roadside at around three o'clock in the afternoon because there were many ordinary people in the team.
James looked at the woods on the roadside very calmly, because he knew very well that the person following him would definitely take this opportunity to attack him.
Bang~
A gunshot from the woods caused the entourage, who had been somewhat mentally prepared, to scream and hide in the surrounding bushes and grass.
James, dressed in a dark court dress and looking quite dignified, smiled and said, "Are your eyes on your ass? You couldn't hit me from this close range?"
In fact, he had "imprisoned" the bullet.
The two assassins in the woods were obviously a little impatient and fired two more shots at James.
James waved his hand easily, about to repeat the trick and "imprison" the bullets again, but the moment he used his ability, he found that his Beyonder power had disappeared without a trace.
And the two bullets fired by the assassins accurately hit James' chest and abdomen.
Thump~ Thump~
Two muffled sounds, the bullets exploded in James' body, creating the effect of artillery shells!
Even the body of a 'Disciplinary Knight' was blown out of two palm-sized holes.
Not only was James stunned, but the two assassins in the woods were also stunned. They looked at the rifles in their hands in disbelief and confirmed again that they were guns, not cannons!
James seemed to realize something, and covered his wound with his hand: "I am willing to offer..."
He only opened his mouth for the second half of the sentence, but did not make any sound.
Tear~
The blood in his body seemed to be out of control, gushing out of his body. In just one second, all his blood, without a drop left, flowed out of his blood vessels.
Then he began to flow bone marrow, flow tissue fluid. Except for the liquid in his head that did not flow out and looked unchanged, his entire body quickly became dry and shriveled.
In just two or three seconds, the royal butler fell to the ground with a painful expression.
Until the arrival of death, he did not know where the murderer who caused all this was?
It took a full ten seconds for the two assassins to react and quickly come over to check.
James, the court butler, Sequence 5, died so strangely!

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 629: Exploding Gas Association
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Just as the two assassins were in a daze, James' Beyonder characteristics had already precipitated out in the blink of an eye.
The corpse's head was neatly severed by an invisible force, and at the same time, a key ring and a watch chain flew out of the corpse.
These four items suddenly disappeared in front of the two assassins.
One of the assassins reacted quickly and immediately bowed to the surroundings: "Thank you, thank you for helping us avenge ourselves."
Of course, they knew very well that it would be difficult for them to complete their revenge. They came today with the determination to die, but the development of the matter was completely beyond their expectations.
… …
At this time, Hobert had already collected the spoils and returned to his study.
For him, this assassination was as simple as going for a walk.
He sacrificed the Beyonder characteristics and two mystical items to the "Nation of Disorder", and casually threw them on the corresponding stone platforms.
Returning to the real world, Hobert crossed his legs, casually flipping through a book, waiting for the night to fall.
When dusk arrived, the electric lights and gas lamps in Backlund lit up almost simultaneously, but the gas supply stations in many places were still being repaired. Tonight in Backlund was not as bright as usual.
Rumble— Rumble—
At this moment, the familiar "rumbling" sound came again.
However, the explosions were very close together this time, with one occurring almost every few seconds.
And with each explosion, the gas lamps in a corresponding area would go out, making the electric lights in the city that were still bright particularly dazzling.
Hobert, who had returned to his study, smiled slightly as he looked at the mist covering Backlund outside.
This night was destined to be another sleepless night.
Soon, the Gas Association's counterattack began. First, officials from the Ministry of Commerce, on the grounds of improper business practices, raided "Earl's Light", with the intention of taking away all the information of "Earl's Light" while there were not many people at night.
But to their surprise, the office building of "Earl's Light" was brightly lit, as if all the employees were working overtime.
Seeing this scene, they knew that this errand was not as easy as they had imagined.
At the entrance of the factory, they argued with the security personnel for a while before they were able to enter the factory.
But for some reason, the horses pulling the carriages suddenly began to circle around a large flower bed in front of the office building.
No matter how the coachman shouted or whipped, they couldn't stop. The reception staff of "Earl's Light" who were waiting at the entrance of the hall were also stunned. Weren't they here to search for some documents? Why were they putting on a circling performance in the yard?
The official in charge of this investigation felt that he couldn't continue like this when he saw the people from "Earl's Light" trying hard to suppress their smiles at the entrance. So he loudly ordered everyone to jump out of the carriages.
The people on three carriages heard the order. They opened the doors and jumped down together. Seeing that they were about to fall to the ground, they even gritted their teeth, ready to have a close encounter with the ground.
But almost in an instant, they sat back in the carriages, looking at their colleagues face to face.
They were even more confused. They had clearly jumped! Could it be that they were hallucinating?
On the other side, officials from the Ministry of Industry led a team to investigate the "Earl's Light"'power plant in the suburbs. They did not dare to dispatch the police easily, because they were afraid that the shareholders of "Earl's Light" would simply use the excuse of an exercise to have the army stationed around the power plant.
Such things had really happened before when the nobles of Backlund had conflicts with the military.
If the struggle for interests really reached this point, the royal family would choose to support the military in order to maintain its prestige in the military.
And at this time, even if the parliament and the government had opinions on the royal family's actions, it would not be easy to express their views.
After all, the military swore allegiance to the royal family and the constitution, not to the parliament and the government. Continuing the opposition would not be beneficial to anyone.
So this time, only people from the industrial sector came to the suburbs. They were prepared to shut down the power plant and completely cut off the power.
They could also take a look inside the power plant.
The power plant was easy to find, because in the suburbs, only the power plant had bright lights.
But as the carriages were running, the power plant that was originally in front suddenly ended up behind everyone!
So they quickly turned around, but a strange thing happened again. The power plant was clearly in front of them, and the carriages were clearly heading towards the power plant, but for some reason, they were getting further and further away from the power plant!
Not only did the coachmen not know what to do, but even the people in the carriages didn't know why this was happening.
In the end, they could only assume that they were lost.
In the second half of the night, the carriages of the Ministry of Commerce returned to their offices first. The officials, nobles, and members of the Gas Association who were waiting here went forward to ask how many documents they had seized and why it had taken so long.
When the door opened, the pale-faced civil servant glanced at the people in front of the carriage and opened his mouth: Wah~
Having circled the flower bed for three or four hours, they were already dizzy and almost vomited out their bile.
Some nobles who were too close were sprayed all over and started vomiting as well.
The scene was a bit chaotic.
The people from the Ministry of Industry returned at dawn. The horses were a little exhausted from running, and the civil servants were shaken so badly on the roads in the suburbs that their bodies were about to fall apart.
The people waiting here had long given up hope for them.
Because the electric lights in many places in Backlund had been on all night.
But when they learned why they had gained nothing, many people almost fainted on the spot. They were lost!
There was only one road from the city to the power plant!
The civil servants almost unanimously blamed the coachmen and horses for everything.
On the Ministry of Commerce's side, a similar scene was being played out at this time.
So in the morning, many coachmen from the Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Industry were fired, and the horses that had been running all night were also to be sold.
Coincidentally, someone came to buy the horses at this time, offering a very generous price, so a deal was quickly reached.
As the horse buyer was leading the horses away, he suddenly told the civil servants: "Earl Hobert asked me to tell you all: All the employees of 'Earl's Light' will remember your 'care' yesterday!"
Only then did the civil servants know that the horse buyer was actually an employee of "Earl's Light"!
On the other side, the coachmen who had just walked to the door with a disappointed look were immediately hired away by recruiters waiting here with high salaries.
As they left, the recruiters deliberately said loudly: "'Earl's Light' welcomes you to join us!"
Those who organized the counterattack against "Earl's Light" last night gnashed their teeth in anger.
In their opinion, whether it was buying horses or hiring newly fired coachmen, Hobert was demonstrating to them.
Such an arrogant nobleman was still rare. Ordinary nobles would always leave some dignity for their opponents in order to show their demeanor.
But Hobert actually came to demonstrate after he had won!
Rumble—
Just as everyone was angry, the familiar "rumbling" sound rang again.
After a night of repairs, several storage points that had finally restored gas supply exploded again.
The members of the Gas Association in the Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Industry had a feeling of being forced into a corner, but they didn't know how to fight back.
… …
MI9.
Georgina, who had just started work and heard the explosion again, frowned, wondering if she should remind Hobert? Don't push the other party to a dead end.
At this moment, the secretary brought the order from Sodela Palace.
Georgina thought that the royal family had ordered her to intervene in this matter, but when she took the order and looked at it, it was actually an order not to interfere in the struggle between "Earl's Light" and the Gas Association.
Moreover, Georgina noticed from the issuing unit of the document that this order was not only for MI9, but also for the military and the Ministry of the Interior.
In other words, the royal family prohibited all armed forces, including the police, from participating in this matter.
Most importantly, this order was personally signed by King George III, not a secret order given by William I.
Georgina didn't quite understand: Didn't the king know that continuing to let it go might cause the situation to get out of control?
… …
Today's "Backlund Morning News" published information about the gas explosion.
According to the report in the "Morning News", several gas companies stated that they had not yet investigated the cause of the accident.
And the report emphasized: They all stored gas in accordance with relevant regulations, and there were no violations.
It would have been better if there was no emphasis on this sentence. With this emphasis, everyone who read the newspaper showed a knowing smile.
And everyone noticed a very interesting thing. Only the "Backlund Morning News" published the news of the gas explosion, as if the other newspapers had not happened this thing.
But the explosion that happened as early as yesterday morning was heard throughout Backlund!
Without Hobert's guidance, people already believed that those newspapers must have been bought by the gas companies.
Under pressure, other newspapers added extra editions at noon, making a series of reports on the gas explosion accident.
At the same time, other newspapers were secretly scolding the "Backlund Morning News" for taking money from the Gas Association and still doing such reports!
In fact, the "Backlund Morning News" was also a little helpless. Last night, the public relations personnel of "Earl's Light" brought the evidence that the "Backlund Morning News" had collected the "donations" from the Gas Association to the editor-in-chief of the "Morning News".
If they did not report according to the manuscript they provided, the evidence and the transaction between the "Morning News" and the Gas Association would be published in other newspapers.
The reason Hobert chose this newspaper was that its shareholders had little connection with the gas industry's interest groups.
To maintain the credibility of the "Morning Post," it would definitely betray the Gas Association.
For a time, the Gas Association was bombarded with questions from all sides, leaving them utterly exhausted.
That day's major evening newspapers revealed even more news.
For example, so far, the gas companies had not provided any compensation for the losses caused by the explosions.
Some newspapers also carried a striking piece of news: due to the four electrocution accidents that had occurred previously, "Earl's Light" deeply apologized. In addition to paying the victims' families a large sum in compensation, it also announced the suspension of all sales tasks until the cause of the accidents was thoroughly investigated before resuming the sale of light bulbs.
This was "Earl's Light's" first public statement regarding the four accidents, giving people the impression that it was quite responsible.
Rumble~
As everyone was reading the evening newspapers, the rumble sounded again, and the few remaining gas lamps went out again. Some gas lamp users had already started cursing.
Their homes were plunged into darkness, and they had to go buy candles. Those who went early could still get some, but those who went late couldn't even buy candles.
Many people hadn't even finished cooking dinner. Seeing the still-bright electric lights, they felt very unhappy.
...
Meanwhile, Hobert, dressed in formal attire, went to Georgina's residence for a banquet.
James's head had been "tampered with" in terms of size and placed in an easy-to-carry ring box.
His colleagues from MI9 had arrived first. Everyone joked about the Gas Association's scandalous behavior. For them, it had been many years since they had seen such a lively event.
After the royal family members arrived, everyone first had dinner together with laughter and conversation, and then, under Georgina's leadership, went to the residence's concert hall to enjoy a symphony.
Georgina's concert hall was very special. Spectator area consisted of twelve small private rooms.
Each private room had a view of the stage, as well as a set of large, luxurious sofas and a wine cabinet.
Servants led the guests to their respective private rooms. After closing the doors, the servants also left.
Sitting on the sofa, Hobert sighed. Countess Georgina was indeed "hereditary" in intelligence work. In such a private room, exchanging some secret information was too convenient!
At this time, Alice quietly pushed the door open, gently closed it, and asked, "How is the environment here?"
"It's pretty good," Hobert said, crossing his legs. "It's much better than those salons where you have to comment after enjoying the music."
Then, he said meaningfully, "The most important thing is that you can also conduct some secret transactions."
Alice sat next to Hobert: "Georgina often brings her male favorites here to enjoy music."
Hobert, who was half-lying on the sofa, twitched the corner of his mouth: The nobles really know how to have fun!
He slowly sat up: "Then what is this gathering for…"
"Don't think too much," Alice said with a smile. "This gathering doesn't have any other meaning. It's just that I asked you to come and enjoy the music. Georgina is a very principled person and won't prey on her colleagues."
Hobert nodded, but thought to himself: That sounds very unbelievable.
At this time, the music started, and the light in the private room immediately dimmed. Although it was a seemingly surging symphony, it felt very ambiguous.
Alice sat next to Hobert: "Okay, let me see your assassination results."
She had already learned about James's death in advance and had been looking forward to tonight's "symphony" for a long time.
Hobert took out the ring box and took out James's head, which had returned to its normal size.
Alice held the processed head, and she didn't know whether she was excited or sad. Her hands trembled slightly: "Finally… finally avenged Edessak."
Hobert thought: The real culprit behind the scenes is still sitting on the throne.
However, considering that Alice was a little emotional at this time, he didn't say anything.
Alice looked at the head for a full two minutes before asking Hobert to put it back in the ring box.
She smiled and asked Hobert, "Have you thought about what reward you want? Do you want me to find a way to disband the Gas Association?"
"There's no need," Hobert said with a smile. "They are no longer a threat to me."
In the past two days, Hobert had already felt signs of the potion being digested again. Of course, he hoped that the situation would continue to ferment, and perhaps he could take the opportunity to digest another wave of potion.
"Thank you," Alice said. "If I had to rely on myself, I don't know when I would be able to get revenge."
She sighed: "Perhaps I would have died in the Demoness Sect's continuous assassinations before."
As she spoke, she gradually leaned towards Hobert and leaned into his arms.
This reminded Hobert of their experience of escaping for their lives together before. He naturally put one arm around Alice and watched the performance on the stage in front of him.
Both of them were very quiet, as if enjoying this moment of being alone.
Alice had finally avenged her revenge. Her emotions were a little sad and a little excited for a while.
But after leaning in Hobert's arms, her emotions quickly calmed down. It had been a long time since she had had close contact with Hobert. At this time, hearing Hobert's powerful heartbeat again made her feel very at ease.
When the performance ended and the lights in the room gradually brightened again, Alice was still a little reluctant: "Let's go listen to the symphony again next week, okay?"
Hobert smiled: "It depends."
Alice nodded: "I will send someone to the Earl's Mansion next Monday. If you don't have time, I will send someone again on Thursday, without waiting for Georgina to send an invitation."
Hobert glanced at the very private small room again and suddenly had the illusion of arranging a secret tryst, which he thought was quite exciting: "Okay."
That night, no explosions occurred in Backlund, because the gas companies had completely given up on emergency repairs.
However, the behind-the-scenes forces of the Gas Association certainly wouldn't give up. In order to retaliate against Hobert's use of Beyonder forces last night, they sent a group of Beyonders to raid the power plant, trying to cut off the power supply by force.
Because they knew that Hobert was a demigod, they also invited a demigod to lead the team for this operation.
As soon as they climbed over the high walls of the power plant, they coughed violently.
The demigod leading the team realized something was wrong and issued an order to retreat.
But it was too late to retreat at this time. Except for the demigod, the Beyonders suddenly fell to the ground, as if there was a huge suction force pulling them on the ground.
The surrounding flowers, plants, and trees were also affected. The flowers and plants stuck to the ground, and the branches and leaves of the trees were also pulled off by the suction from the ground.
Immediately afterward, a huge downward pressure was generated above the Beyonders.
This force seemed to crush their chests, and it took all their strength to complete a breath.
And because of the invasion of the mystical virus, there seemed to be a mouthful of thick phlegm in their throats. In addition to breathing, they also had to cough, making the breathing process more difficult.
This made them feel a huge sense of fear, as if they had been hovering on the edge of drowning and being suffocated. Even Beyonders faced huge mental pressure.
This was of course the result of Hobert using the Sequence 3 level "Manipulation" to change the gravity and attraction of that area.
Sitting in the power plant office, crossing his legs, and drinking tea, Hobert waved his hand again and launched a third wave of attacks, "Manipulating" the oxygen content around the target, continuously reducing the oxygen there.
Currently, only the demigod leading the team was temporarily resisting the huge gravity and attraction with his own "Imprisonment."
But he had been coughing violently, and chest pain, fever, and other ailments had even interrupted his thinking many times, so that he had only now raised his hand and quickly said in the gap between coughing: "The spread of disease is prohibited here! Cough cough cough…"
Soon, this demigod discovered that his "Prohibition" had almost no effect.
This made him realize that the sealed artifact or mystical item that created the virus could not be changed by his "Prohibition."
So this "Imperative Mage" no longer cared about the Beyonders on the ground. He "banished" himself, hoping to escape here quickly.
As a huge thrust came, the "Imperative Mage" felt as if he was about to be thrown into the void.
At this moment, a mirror suddenly appeared in the direction he was banished.
The "Imperative Mage" was shocked and plunged into the mirror.
Immediately afterward, a mirror appeared again in the position where he had just disappeared. The "Imperative Mage", who had hoped to leave by using "Banishment", returned to the original place.
"Cough cough cough—"
The "Imperative Mage" felt that his condition suddenly worsened. Even the physique of a demigod could hardly resist it. Under the triple pressure of illness, gravity, and attraction, he also fell to the ground and could no longer stand up.
In desperation, the "Imperative Mage" "imprisoned" himself again, hoping to use Beyonder power to help him resist the "Manipulation" of the surrounding natural rules.
But this time Hobert freed his hand and immediately used the ability of "Exploit" to end the duration of "Imprisonment" in advance.
At this time, the Beyonders who participated in the operation with the "Imperative Mage" were suffocated one by one.
In fact, with their physique as Beyonders, it was impossible for them to suffocate in such a short period of time, but the gravity here was very strong, squeezing out the last bit of breath in their chests.
So a dozen Beyonders died painfully in two different directions of the power plant.
Then Hobert's only enemy was the demigod!
This demigod was also panicked. He could feel that his condition was getting worse and worse.
He tried to issue a "Law" that would normalize the surrounding gravity, but it wasn't useless. It's just that the effect would immediately revert in less than half a second, and all his resistance had little effect.
The "Imperative Mage" gradually couldn't withstand the enormous gravity, and finally lay on the ground, even moving became very difficult.
What made him even more desperate was that, until now, he didn't know where his enemy was.
The enemy that Hobert knew best was the "Imperative Mage" of the adjacent pathway. Hobert was very clear that as long as the other party couldn't find the target, many of the attacks of this sequence would have little effect.
And the attack range of Sequence 4 is about 500 to 800 meters.
That's why Hobert attacked the enemy while drinking tea in the office. One reason was to be a little "mad", and the other was that if he appeared in front of the "Imperative Mage", victory would not come so easily.
Soon the "Imperative Mage's" consciousness became blurred. A dozen seconds later, he died of illness on the cold ground of the power plant.
At this time, Hobert appeared, gathered the two corpses from different directions, and immediately extracted the Beyonder characteristics from the corpses.
After collecting the characteristics, Hobert rolled the corpses into a large ball, and took away all the blood stains on the ground, taking them to the distant wilderness and burying them five kilometers underground.
This time, the Gas Association and the interest groups behind it were completely silent.
Especially those nobles of the Gas Association, they were even a little frightened, after all, the demigods they sent out did not return!
This meant that even demigods could not protect their own safety.
Fortunately, Hobert never thought of taking their dog lives.
Time came to the third day, which was Saturday. There was still no sign of recovery of gas supply. Many gas lamp users went to buy electric lights.
The electric lamp sales shops and department store counters had a wide range of goods, and even the sales staff were there, but they just didn't sell any light bulbs.
Instead, they patiently explained to the customers that because of the previous electric shock accidents, "Earl's Light" had suspended all sales business.
Other light bulb manufacturers were very hopeful to make a fortune at this time, but "Earl's Light" suspended the supply of batteries and electricity to them. Even if they received orders, they couldn't install them, and even if they installed them, there would be no electricity.
Many gas lamp users simply went to the gas company to claim compensation.
But this night, the gas lamp users could only eat dinner in the dark again, and then admire the brightness of the electric lights not far away, regretting that they had not installed electric lights in advance.
The next day, which was Sunday, because most of the middle class were resting on this day, the city hall, the gas company, and "Earl's Light" were crowded with people early in the morning.
Especially at the gas company, the scene once got out of control. Users rushed into the company and grabbed an employee to ask when the gas supply would be restored?
The people at the city hall demanded an immediate solution to the lighting problem.
The people at "Earl's Light" asked the company to resume business as soon as possible.
Just when several group incidents were about to happen, today's morning newspapers began to be sold by newsboys in the streets and alleys.
On the front page of today's newspaper, a very shocking news was published!
The four electric shock accidents that happened before were actually conspiracies planned by the Gas Association!
The reports in the morning newspapers of various newspapers had a very detailed description of the case, including which company and which person participated in the action, and how they found people who were willing to give their lives to smear "Earl's Light", and finally even the negotiated price was exposed!
So on this morning, a demonstration against the Gas Company broke out, and by this time, it had become a large-scale parade sweeping Backlund.
The city hall also realized the seriousness of the problem at this time, and knew that it could not continue like this, so the mayor of Backlund personally went to "Earl's Light" to ask Hobert to quell the parade and chaos.
But he was told that the Earl was not in the company.
The mayor quickly took a carriage to the Earl's mansion, and was also coldly informed by the butler, Dawes: The Earl was on a business trip and was not in Backlund now.
The mayor of Backlund thought that Hobert thought he was not important enough, so he didn't show up, so he immediately found the Prime Minister.
Under the mediation of the Prime Minister, Earl Hall invited Hobert to have afternoon tea.
What everyone didn't expect was that Dawes came to report to Earl Hall that Hobert was really not in Backlund, and had gone on a business trip yesterday afternoon.
In addition, this butler, Dawes, who looked like a patient with facial paralysis, also specially reminded everyone: "According to the Earl's plan, he will not be back until next month."
This gave everyone a feeling of punching cotton. The Prime Minister was very clear that if the problem was not solved until next month, Backlund would become a laughing stock all over the world.
These old foxes were very clear that the root of the matter lay in the conflict between electric lights and gas lamps. Whether it was restoring the gas supply or "Earl's Light" resuming sales, Hobert had to nod his head at the moment.
Otherwise, even if the Gas Company transferred spare temporary gas tanks from other cities, although Hobert claimed that he was not in Backlund, those gas tanks would definitely cause new explosions.
So they went together to find Christian again, asking Christian to come forward to chase Hobert and ask him to cancel his business trip plan, come back and discuss how to solve the lighting problem in Backlund.
Because Earl Hall was there, Christian couldn't refuse, so she promised them that she would "chase" Hobert and guaranteed that Hobert would be back around the evening.
The Prime Minister immediately issued an invitation, inviting Christian, Earl Hall and Hobert to have dinner together. At the same time, he promised to invite Duke Negan, Baron Syndras and other nobles to attend the dinner.
Duke Negan and others are the supporters behind the Gas Association, the nobles who sent Beyonders to attack the power plant.
Of course, except for that "Imperative Mage", although they are very powerful nobles, but regardless of the checks and balances of the royal family, or the agreement constraints between the churches, there is no demigod power in their mansions.
The nobles promised many benefits before the "Imperative Mage" agreed to lead the team.
Duke Negan and others are important believers of the Storm Church, and they can ask the demigods of the church for help.
It's just that the church generally does not participate in this kind of interest struggle.
After inviting the demigod and sending out the Beyonders, Duke Negan and others were also mentally prepared for the failure of the attack, but what they never expected was that the "Imperative Mage" failed to escape back!
Failure and complete annihilation are completely different things.
At present, Duke Negan and others no longer launch any counterattacks against "Earl's Light", which means that the Gas Association has no follow-up power at all.
Agid was very clear about this. Now is the best time to solve the problem, because the Gas Association will definitely make concessions, which makes the problem much simpler.
...
At this time, Hobert was indeed not in Backlund, but on the shore of Full Moon Lake in South Colson, fishing with the demigod "Artisan" Winston.
Hobert looked at the motionless fishing rod, and did not use the power of "Distortion" to hook the fish: "How about I make a delicious dish with fish head tonight?"
Winston, with a wrinkled face, a clean-shaven beard, and a somewhat rigorous look, said: "I had a fish head soup in the Southern Continent once, and I remember it tasted very delicious."
"It's not soup."
Hobert recalled the taste of chopped pepper fish head, and couldn't help swallowing: "It's steamed with dried chili."
"Never had it."
Hobert said with a look of yearning: "I can't wait."
Seeing Hobert's unhurried appearance, Winston had to sigh and said, "What do you think of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery?"
Hobert smiled slightly: "Before, I knew the 'Machinery Hivemind' captain of the Steam Church in Backlund. In a case, he fulfilled his responsibilities."
Originally, Hobert came to Archibald to discuss with him about finding the city of Saint Yadrow.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he arrived at the Lord's Mansion, the butler Allen informed Hobert that Winston had come to him this morning.
Because Winston repeatedly stated that there was no urgent matter, he only asked Allen to tell Hobert when Hobert came to the Lord's Mansion.
So Allen thought that this matter was not very urgent, so he did not report to Hobert in Backlund.
When he came to the Lord's Mansion, as soon as Hobert heard that Winston had taken the initiative to find him, he knew what was going on.
Hobert was also a little speechless about the repeated weighing of the Steam Church, but he thought that the God of Steam and Machinery was not quite the same as the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother.
Hobert estimated that the former was because of the special nature of his destiny, and the latter was because of his biological father and mother.
These two gods should have noticed him long ago, but the God of Steam and Machinery is different. He has no understanding of Hobert at all, and Hobert's identity is complicated, so it is difficult to make a corresponding decision for a while.
The key is that the God of Steam and Machinery should also realize that the current Northern Continent is a powder keg that could be ignited at any time.
So He or the Steam Church should choose more carefully.
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled slightly, because the God of Steam and Machinery ultimately stood on the wrong team.
Winston was not a good speaker. When he heard Hobert's answer, he didn't react for a while.
Hobert had no choice but to say again: "Overall, it feels pretty good, but it's a bit dogmatic."
"It's all caused by those laws and formulas."
Winston smiled bitterly and said: "You also know that this pathway requires understanding many scientific laws, and a certain amount of thinking about philosophy and nature.
"These things easily make our way of thinking somewhat different from the Beyonders of other pathways."
The old gentleman paused and then said, "I heard from the church people that your research team has created a high-power generator and improved the filament of the light bulb?"
Hobert replied, "Yes."
He wasn't opposed to cooperating with the Steam Church, but the prerequisite was that the Steam Church had to show sincerity.
Having a demigod, Winston, discuss this matter was more sincere than before.
"The Church is very interested in participating in the research of generators," Winston said. "To this end, the Church is willing to form a Artisan team with me as the captain."
"As long as you need it, we can appraise the ability and negative effects of sealed items for you free of charge, and help you turn Beyonder characteristics into mystical items."
Hobert smiled: "I know you are not very good at negotiating. This may be the reason why the Steam Church asked you to talk to me, because you have helped me make a lot of mystical items before, and I will not embarrass you."
"So I will tell you my conditions, you pass them on to the Steam Church, and find someone who can make a decision to talk to me."
Winston breathed a long sigh of relief, and finally showed a more natural smile: "I will definitely convey it to the Church immediately."
Hobert gave an "Um" sound: "The Steam Church has completely gone in the wrong direction. What we need to talk about in our cooperation is the confidentiality of electrical technology and the distribution of commercial benefits."
"I can provide sufficient funds for the scientists sent by the Steam Church to conduct relevant topics and research on electricity."
"First, I have the right to decide whether and when to publish the research results. Before that, there must be no leakage, otherwise the cooperation will be terminated immediately."
"Second, all commercial income belongs to me, and the corresponding research results belong to those scientists, but how to use them and who to give them to, I must be consulted."
Winston felt that these two requirements were acceptable. The scientists he knew had no need for money. As long as the research results belonged to them, everything would be easy to discuss.
But he didn't know what the Church thought, so Winston just promised again that he would tell Hobert's request as soon as possible.
After talking about this matter, Hobert didn't have time to continue fishing.
He immediately used the "Traveler's Gate" to come to Longtail Island, found Archibald, who was in charge of military control in the mountainous area, and talked to him about exploring the city of Saint Millom.
It was finally agreed that next week, they would go to the southern coast of the Midseashire, the source of the Hornacis Mountains, to find the city of Saint Millom.
The reason why Hobert suddenly wanted to find the capital of Solomon's First Empire was because he wanted to get clues about the "Trunsoest Empire" as soon as possible.
After Erres raided Tortuga Port, Hobert realized that he needed a ship that could fight the "Black Emperor", otherwise he would have no sea control in the future!
Since there were clues to the "Empire", of course, he had to try to find this legendary giant ship.
After agreeing on the time, Hobert went to see the site for building the teleportation array.
The diamonds needed for the teleportation array have been cut and can be used for the first experiment at any time.
In the evening, Hobert was about to go to the kitchen to make chopped pepper fish head, but Dophis came from the "Traveler's Gate" and said that Christian had something urgent to see him.
Of course, Hobert knew that the nobles had found Christian, so he had to say goodbye to Fors and send Allen to tell Winston that there would be no steamed fish head to eat today.
Following Dophis back to Backlund and arriving at Christian's mansion, the "Chaos Hunter" smiled and said, "Come with me to the Prime Minister's mansion for dinner tonight."
Hobert nodded: "Is the Prime Minister going to come forward to mediate?"
"Of course, otherwise Backlund is likely to riot. For the Prime Minister, that would be his dereliction of duty," Christian analyzed to Hobert:
"The Prime Minister must pay attention to this issue. If he doesn't handle it properly, he may have to resign and apologize."
Before today, no one thought that lighting was a big problem, and no one thought that the inconspicuous gas lamps would make Backlund so chaotic.
Because it was getting late, Christian and his son immediately got into the carriage and went to the Prime Minister's mansion.
Leaving the mansion, the security of Empress Borough was not affected, but the sound of shouting slogans could be faintly heard in the distance.
Hobert smiled: "This city has accumulated too much resentment from everyone, and they have finally found a way to vent it."
Christian glanced at Hobert: "Your potion can digest a lot again, right?"
"Just a little bit," Hobert said: "It's still early before it's completely digested!"
Prime Minister himself greeted Hobert at the door and exchanged greetings with Hobert kindly before bringing Hobert to the living room to introduce him to other nobles.
At this time, it was already dark, and the dinner started soon.
When everyone was drinking aperitifs, Prime Minister Agchid went straight to the main topic: "I called everyone here today because I hope the electric lamp industry and the gas lamp industry can conduct effective consultations and immediately solve the lighting problem of the Backlund people."
Duke Negan, who looked in his twenties and had inherited the title from his deceased father for less than a year, said with an unkind expression: "It was Hobert who made the situation out of control! Several companies operating gas lamps have long wanted to restore lighting."
This was obviously a sign of softening, so everyone looked at Hobert again.
"Earl's Light" is also willing to respond to the Prime Minister's call. Unfortunately, "Earl's Light" has suffered huge losses due to the framing of some people before," Hobert said helplessly:
"This forces us to open up overseas markets. Currently, our manpower and financial resources in Backlund have been transferred overseas, but we will definitely do our best to restore lighting in Backlund, at least selling 100 light bulbs a day!"
"Cough cough cough..." The Prime Minister choked on the aperitif: When did the Prime Minister's mediation become so cheap? I personally intervened in this matter, and the result was only 100 light bulbs?
