chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 639: High-level topics at the Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"The Fool" Klein frowned slightly: Was this battle of the gods manipulated by the Outer Gods? But why would the Outer Gods do this?
"The Hermit" Cattleya realized: No wonder "The Emperor" repeatedly emphasized that this battle of the gods had far-reaching effects. It seems that it's not just that after the fall of the ancient gods, their subsidiary gods became big figures in the extraordinary world, but also that the battle itself has a profound impact on the real world.
"The Hanged Man" Alger was also pondering: During the Second Epoch, did the Outer Gods have such a great influence on the real world? Why does it seem like I can't feel any influence now?
Then he smiled and said: Maybe it's because my level is too low, so even if there is an influence, it won't affect me.
"The Moon" Emlyn simply asked: "Which Outer God influenced our 'Ancestor'?"
"The Mother Goddess of Depravity!" Hobert replied: "I mentioned it once before, 'Sanguine Ancestor' Lilith was affected by something at the time.
"But at that time, I was not very sure about the authenticity of this information. Later, I had the opportunity to ask the great 'Creator' about this matter and confirmed that Farbauti's information was basically true."
In fact, it was not very suitable to reveal too much information about the Outer Deities at that time.
"Justice" Audrey asked: "Mr. Emperor, what is the purpose of the Outer Gods? Do they just want the ancient gods to fight?"
Emlyn nodded repeatedly, feeling that Miss Justice's question was very precise.
Hobert replied: "According to my observations and guesses, their goal is to completely control the gods of the real world!"
The other members were very surprised!
Control the gods?
"The Star" Leonard: This is definitely blasphemy against the gods... Well, this level of blasphemy seems acceptable.
He thought to himself: Uh, I seem to have been led astray by "The Emperor".
"The World" then asked: "Why would the Outer Gods have such a purpose? Do they just want to create powerful puppets in the real world that are at their command?"
Hobert said: "I do have some guesses about this, but I currently lack key evidence and some key information, so I can't answer your question for the time being.
"But I can roughly talk about my guess. The purpose of the Outer Gods seems to be to obtain some of the Beyonder characteristics of the gods."
He was deliberately blurring this information because now is not a good time to explain the "Awakening of the Original Creator's will" and other issues.
This answer greatly exceeded Klein's expectations. He almost subconsciously manipulated "The World" to continue asking why, but thinking that it should be a place where Hobert could not confirm the answer yet, he restrained his desire for knowledge and did not continue to ask.
Leonard then asked: "Do the Outer Gods only want to obtain the Beyonder characteristics of the ancient gods? Or do they also want to obtain the Beyonder characteristics of the current gods?"
Hobert smiled and asked: "Is there any difference?"
Leonard showed an ugly smile. Of course, it was different for him. The ancient gods were just legendary names to him, as if they had nothing to do with him.
Since learning that the Evernight Goddess was once a subsidiary god of the ancient gods, and after Leonard accepted this point, he felt a sense of "participation" in that history.
But in his subconscious, the ancient gods and the modern gods still seemed to be different beings.
Hobert continued: "Let's continue the topic just now. We said before that the three ancient gods who participated in the battle of the gods, including 'Sanguine Ancestor', all had subsidiary gods participating in the war.
"Then this shows that this battle was not entirely an encounter, at least it went through basic mobilization.
"Even if it only mobilized to the level of subsidiary gods, it still requires preparation time. If it was completely an encounter, there would be almost no time for mobilization.
"Of course, it is also possible that after the encounter battle started, the subsidiary gods learned that the main god was fighting, so they came to support.
"But the problem is, the subsidiary gods had time to come to participate in the war, why didn't the other ancient gods have time to come?"
When everyone heard this, they understood what "The Emperor" meant: The process and result of the outbreak of this war were very strange!
Logically speaking, since the ancient gods were divided into two camps, there should be a mutual support mechanism between the camps.
However, neither "Sanguine Ancestor" nor "Mutant King" received any support.
At this time, Leonard tried to analyze: "It is also possible that it was originally a battle between two camps. The three ancient gods of the 'Pan-Humanity Camp' were fighting against the three ancient gods of the 'Non-Human Camp', so the other ancient gods had no way to support.
"The Magician" Fors reminded: "Mr. Star, you have such a guess because you don't know another piece of information."
She said: "We learned from a transaction with 'The Emperor' before that after the battle, 'Giant King' and 'Elf King' accused each other of betraying 'Sanguine Ancestor', which led to the battle where she perished together with other ancient gods.
"If it was a battle between six ancient gods, and the three ancient gods of the 'Pan-Humanity Camp' also participated, how could there be talk of betrayal?"
Leonard was slightly stunned: "I didn't know there was such a thing."
Then he also fell into contemplation. Obviously, the outbreak of this battle of the gods was indeed a bit incomprehensible.
At this time, Hobert said: "According to the information I obtained from Farbauti, and some of my guesses.
"It is very likely that the other ancient gods defaulted to the outbreak of this battle, or rather, they had no intention of stopping it.
"In addition, I believe that the battle initiated by 'Sanguine Ancestor' may have been her plan to get rid of the control of the Outer Gods."
Everyone felt more and more confused as they listened, so they stared at "The Emperor", waiting for him to explain further.
"Even for modern gods, the corruption of the Outer Gods is a difficult problem to solve." Hobert began to explain: "In terms of level, it's as simple as a god polluting an angel.
"It's just that under normal circumstances, gods will choose to directly attack angels, because injuring angels or making angels in a bad state in this way is a more cost-effective attack method.
"But the Outer Gods are different. The power they can project into the real world is very limited. Using long-term corruption to affect the gods may be their only way to deal with the gods.
"So the other ancient gods, in order to avoid being polluted, had no intention of participating in this battle.
"And the mutual accusations between 'Giant King' and 'Elf King' are likely to be accusing each other of allowing 'Sanguine Ancestor' to be polluted, not accusing that 'Sanguine Ancestor' fell into the trap of the enemy camp because of the other's betrayal.
"This question is not complicated. If the 'Non-Human Camp' had set up a trap in advance, waiting for 'Giant King' or 'Elf King' to lead 'Sanguine Ancestor' into the trap, then what 'Sanguine Ancestor' would have suffered was the ambush of the ancient gods of the 'Non-Human Camp', and 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' would never have appeared in this ambush.
"Then, after excluding other possibilities, the conclusion that other ancient gods were unwilling to participate in the war is basically established."
Cattleya smiled: Another wonderful analysis.
Hobert continued to explain: "According to other information I obtained, in the Second Epoch, the Outer Gods could not cause too much impact on the real world, or rather, the impact caused until now is very limited.
"Another piece of information is that the corruption of 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' is relatively special and difficult to remove.
"Based on these two pieces of information obtained from different places at different times, I infer that although 'Sanguine Ancestor' was affected by the Outer Gods, it was far from the point of losing her mind!
"But if she doesn't find a way to solve the corruption of 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' as soon as possible, and delays it, she will definitely lose control completely. The way she thought of may be to sacrifice the godhood in order to preserve her will from being completely polluted by the Outer Gods.
"The specific operation method has not yet obtained accurate information, but I guess that for a period of time, 'Sanguine Ancestor' should have used the uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway to exist in the real world."
In fact, it is not suitable to announce the plans and transactions between the Evernight Goddess and Lilith now. These information must be announced after the battle of the gods.
Hobert guessed that Lilith's initial plan should have been to use the death of "Sanguine Ancestor" and use some unknown methods to eliminate the corruption of "Mother Goddess of Depravity", and while holding the uniqueness, seize the opportunity to recover other Sequence 1 characteristics.
In the Era of Fire, Lilith may have had contact with the Goddess of Misfortune, that is, the Evernight Goddess, but at that time, the Ancient Sun God had not yet awakened, so in her plan, there should be no part of the Ancient Sun God.
It's just that her plan was destroyed by the "Devil Monarch" Farbauti, and the "God of Spiritual Creatures" at that time, and the later "Chained God" and other gods.
For a considerable period of time, Lilith was likely to have survived by relying on the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway. Of course, at this time, She was protected by the "Concealment" of the Goddess of Misfortune.
It was not until the return of the Evernight Goddess and the awakening of the Ancient Sun God that things ushered in a turning point.
Regarding these information, as well as the guesses about why "Annihilation Demonic Wolf" would participate in the war, Hobert plans to explain it in detail to the members a year after the end of the battle of the gods.
At this time, at the Tarot Club, Klein recalled some of the previous transaction content and his own guesses: If the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway is now with the Goddess, then can it also be considered that Lilith is also "collected" by the Goddess in the Divine Kingdom?
Similar operations of gods using death to achieve their own goals are no longer new to other members, after all, they have heard of similar cases before.
But this still made them start their own reveries. At this moment, "The Moon" Emlyn suddenly cried out loudly: "Our ancestor..."
Everyone's imagination had just begun when it was drawn away by Mr. Moon.
Only to see "Moon" wipe away tears: "Our ancestor, in order to prevent this world from being corrupted by Outer Gods, chose to sacrifice Herself! She saved this world!"
Derrick, sitting next to him as "Sun," was stunned for a long while: How did you come to that conclusion?
Audrey also fell into brief self-doubt: Could it be that I didn't completely understand Hobert's meaning? Why do I feel like it was just some scheme carried out by the 'Sanguine Ancestor' to escape his predicament? Does it have much to do with saving the world?
The other members were also momentarily unsure of what to say, and finally, everyone looked towards "Emperor."
Hobert smiled helplessly and said: "Mr. Moon, we have made some deals before. The 'Sanguine Ancestor's' situation later encountered a turning point, you don't need to be so sad."
Before Emlyn could react, he immediately said: "Let's talk about the situation of the 'Mutant King' at that time.
"According to the information provided by the 'Devil Monarch,' the 'Mutant King' was not affected by the Outer Gods at that time, but his attendant god, the 'God of Spiritual Creatures,' made a deal with the 'Mother Tree of Desire.'"
"When talking about this matter, Farbauti made a special explanation, that in the Second Epoch, there were many beings in strange states.
"Initially, the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' was not very clear that he was making a deal with an Outer God, he only thought it was a being in a strange state.
"Under the manipulation and intervention of the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' and the 'Goddess of Misfortune,' the 'Mutant King' and the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' should have made many misjudgments during the battle, resulting in the 'Sanguine Ancestor' dragging them down to die together."
"Here, Farbauti used a very appropriate analogy, for example, if three Beyonder beings of the same level were fighting, and one wanted to die together with the other two, at least one of the other two could escape.
"At that time, the 'Sanguine Ancestor' didn't have time to design a trap, and even if there was a trap, the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf,' with its strong spirituality and premonition ability, would probably not step into it.
"For Farbauti, who did not participate in the battle and only observed to a certain extent, the result of the three ancient gods dying together made him feel very strange."
Not only Farbauti felt strange, but the members of the Tarot Club also felt very strange.
Klein, behind the gray fog, even thought: Could it be that the Goddess suddenly took action at a critical moment, giving the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf" enough misfortune? After all, according to the previous deal, the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf" was only at the level of an King of Angels. As a Goddess at the Angel level, ambushing at the right time could completely make the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf" unlucky enough in a short period of time.
Cattleya was also making a similar guess: I heard that the "Prisoner" pathway's "Source of Curses" ability can not only harm the target by harming oneself, but also harm the target by deliberately suffering some Beyonder attacks. When the "Sanguine Ancestor" was preparing to fight to the death, could it be that the "Mutant King" was about to escape, but the "God of Spiritual Creatures" rushed up and held back the "Mutant King" by enduring some damage himself?
Alger thought: The "Goddess of Misfortune" could help the "Sanguine Ancestor" hold back the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf," for example, by putting the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf" into a brief slumber at the right time.
Although the other members knew a little about the Beyonder abilities of these three pathways, none of them dared to imagine at the level of gods.
Especially Leonard, who rarely sat there properly, not daring to have any blasphemous thoughts.
Hobert gave everyone a few seconds to digest before continuing: "I have always believed that the simplest way to understand some problems is to look at the relationship of interests.
"For example, in this war of gods, the 'Goddess of Misfortune' and the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' have both benefited greatly, so they must be inseparable from the fall of the three ancient gods.
"The only difference from the 'Goddess of Misfortune' is that Farbauti has been quietly watching this war of gods and taking away a Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Prisoner' pathway at the right opportunity.
"And at that time, the 'God of Spiritual Creatures,' as an Angel level being, when encountering the 'Devil Monarch' snatching the spoils, his choice must have been to escape immediately.
"It is said that after this war of gods, the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' completed the deal with the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' and sacrificed to her a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Moon' pathway.
"I guess the 'Mother Tree of Desire' should have provided the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' with some way to temporarily trap the 'Mutant King,' or to temporarily prevent the 'Mutant King' from escaping."
"According to Farbauti, what the 'Mother Tree of Desire' wanted should have been the Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Prisoner' pathway, but the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' still had to use it himself, and it was impossible to sacrifice the characteristic of this pathway to her.
"Farbauti also said that he felt the malice of the 'Mother Tree of Desire' at that time, but at that time, he did not have a very intuitive understanding of the purpose of the Outer Gods, so in order to limit the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' he sacrificed the Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Prisoner' pathway that he had obtained to the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity!'"
Hearing this, Klein's reaction was similar to Hobert's when he first heard the news: This is the balance between the gods, right?
However, Hobert then said: "This is basically Farbauti's original words, but I have not yet verified this part of the information.
"After all, deception may be a habit of a 'Demon.' Farbauti's information needs to be reconfirmed through other channels before a final conclusion can be drawn.
"However, I have already confirmed through other channels that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' does indeed have high-sequence Beyonder characteristics of the 'Moon' pathway.
"We said before when we traded information about the 'Primordial Moon' that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' also has a way to impersonate the 'Primordial Moon.' Her impersonation method should be to use a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the 'Moon' pathway!
"As for whether Farbauti sacrificed the Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Prisoner' pathway to the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity,' that is hard to say.
"At that time, there was indeed no concept of the Outer Deities, and the first 'Blasphemy Slate' had not yet appeared, and there may not have been a complete theory of adjacent pathways.
"But according to the information I obtained from other channels, the characteristic of Beyonder characteristics attracting each other, Beyonder beings can already faintly sense at the Sequence 2 level.
"Farbauti obtained a Sequence 1 characteristic of an adjacent pathway. I don't believe that he didn't sense the attraction between them. Maybe he just hid that Beyonder characteristic himself."
The other members couldn't help but smile, all feeling like the bottom line of a certain evil god had been exposed.
But soon Klein and Alger thought almost at the same time: "Emperor's" information is only announced at the Tarot Club after it has been verified to a certain extent, and this confirmation method is likely to be through the "Creator," or to make some reasonable guesses. But no matter what, this process is very reliable, so even some of his guesses are very credible.
"Let's go back to the 'God of Spiritual Creatures.'" Hobert said: "During the Second Epoch, the influence of the Outer Gods on the real world was still very weak, so his cooperation with the 'Mother Tree of Desire' did not have much impact on himself.
"Even in the Third Epoch, he even joined 'Rose Redemption.'"
"We have also said before that those who can join this organization are gods who are more trusted by the Ancient Sun God and the Evernight Goddess. If the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' had a problem at this time, the Evernight Goddess would definitely not have invited him.
"The turning point of the matter should have appeared at the end of the Fourth Epoch. Some members should have heard that the Seven Gods entered the Astral World at the end of the Fourth Epoch, and have rarely appeared in divine descents since the Fifth Epoch.
"It is said that at the end of the Fourth Epoch, the Seven Gods realized that the Outer Gods were trying to infiltrate power into the real world, so they collectively went to the Astral World to resist the Outer Gods who were peeking at the real world."
Audrey's eyes flashed with some surprise: This is the first time I've heard of such a thing!
Fors realized: If Hobert hadn't said so, I would have felt that the gods should have lived in the Astral World. But thinking about the struggles they had before the Fifth Epoch, they should have indeed stayed in the real world for a long time!
Emlyn and Derrick each expressed their surprise, while the other members knew a little more or less.
Hobert said: "After the beginning of the Fifth Epoch, due to the fall of the Underworld Emperor, the Balam Empire had a huge division around the issue of supporting a new emperor or resurrecting the Underworld Emperor.
"At this time, the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' changed his name to the 'Chained God,' established the 'Rose School,' and established the Highland Kingdom, competing with the Balam Empire for the rule of the Southern Continent.
"According to the time and place of the 'Chained God's' appearance, he should have been on the Southern Continent ever since he withdrew from the 'Rose Redemption' in the early Fourth Epoch.
"After the fall of the Underworld Emperor, he finally waited for the opportunity.
"Unfortunately, in the Fifth Epoch, the 'Mother Tree of Desire's' influence on the real world has been greatly strengthened. The 'Devil Monarch,' who had previously tried to avoid contact with the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' can still continue to stalemate with this Outer God.
"And the 'Chained God,' who had cooperated with the 'Mother Tree of Desire' before, did not have much glory in the Fifth Epoch before being completely controlled by this Outer God!"
After the hall was silent for a second or two, Klein thought: The "Mother Tree of Desire" should have begun to exert influence on the "Chained God" in the Second Epoch, and waited until the Fifth Epoch, when the time was right, to suddenly take action. No wonder Hobert would say that, after a long period of preparation, polluting at the right time is the only means of attack by the Outer Gods against the gods. It turns out that he has evidence for this statement.
Then he thought: This can further prove that the Outer Gods' influence on the real world is indeed not great.
Emlyn, on the other hand, felt a bit of lingering fear: Fortunately, our "Ancestor" noticed early on that he was being influenced and made corresponding plans and arrangements. Otherwise, we would have ended up as miserable as the "Chained God," completely controlled.
Cattleya, on the other hand, thought of another direction: The "Mother Tree of Desire" controls the Angel of Kings of this pathway, which to a certain extent controls the entire pathway!
Alger also had similar thoughts, and his conjecture went a step further: Could the indulgence and Temperance factions of the "Rose School of Thought" be the final struggle between the "Mother Tree of Desire" and the "Chained God"?
At this time, Emlyn, who proposed this transaction, asked again: "Emperor, what is the specific state of the 'Chained God' now? Has he fallen directly?"
"It doesn't seem like he has fallen directly at the moment," Hobert replied. "But to some extent, it may be worse than falling directly."
"It is said that Suah, the leader of the "Rose School of Thought" now, is the child created by the 'Mother Tree of Desire' using a Sequence 1 characteristic torn from the 'Chained God'."
Audrey frowned: Why are the similar operations of the gods always beyond my imagination? Sequence 1 characteristics can even be used to create children?
Fors also felt a little uncomfortable. After all, in her opinion, children should be conceived, not manufactured.
Among the female members of the Tarot Club, perhaps only Cattleya, who had been promoted to a demigod, didn't feel anything. This is the mystical world.
As far as she knew, high-sequence Beyonders of the "Moon" pathway can rapidly conceive life!
Klein thought to himself: This "Chained God" is really miserable. Even the Beyonder characteristics have been torn off. Being alive is worse than death.
Hobert continued: "I don't know the specific situation of the 'Chained God', but judging from the fact that only one Suah has appeared, He should still have the Uniqueness and a Sequence 1 characteristic of that pathway.
"And the power that the 'Mother Tree of Desire' can currently project into the real world is still limited. Before everyone gets specific information about Her, their perception of Her is the best proof. It seems that the power of this Outer God is only slightly stronger than the power of some wild gods.
"It is estimated that She used a relatively clever method when tearing off the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Chained God'. If She had mastered the Uniqueness of the 'Prisoner' pathway, it would have been impossible for Her to be so unknown in the real world.
"And the 'Abomination' Suah, controlled by the 'Mother Tree of Desire', obviously has no way to completely kill the 'Chained God'. Otherwise, the members of the Temperance faction would definitely be able to feel the fall of the Angel of Kings of their pathway."
Leonard nodded slightly: It is said that when the Underworld Emperor fell, the state of some Beyonders of the "Corpse Collector" pathway was not very good for a long time. The old man said that apart from the fact that this pathway is relatively special, the fall of an existence with Uniqueness in this pathway has more or less influence on many Beyonders of this pathway, at least they can sense roughly when the other party fell.
Hobert finally concluded: "Then the current state of the 'Chained God' can basically be deduced: He should be hiding in a corner, fighting the 'Mother Tree of Desire' for the last time.
"What is certain is that He has completely lost His freedom and has been severely polluted, but because He still controls the Uniqueness of the 'Prisoner' pathway, He can still make a final resistance.
"The 'Mother Tree of Desire' should need some opportunity to completely obtain all the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Chained God'. For the time being, the 'Chained God' will not fall."
Emlyn asked very carefully this time: "Emperor, can the 'Chained God' still provide some help to the 'Temperance Faction'?"
Hobert immediately replied: "He can't provide any help. It would be a blessing if He didn't affect the members of the 'Temperance Faction' and corrupt them."
Emlyn nodded: "I understand, thank you for your answer."
This transaction ended, and everyone worked hard again to digest the information they had just traded.
Klein suddenly realized: After obtaining the information of the "Chained God", the Tarot Club has already traded the information of all the "well-known" evil gods in the Beyonder world so far.
The first is the True Creator, who actually came from the Ancient Sun God! It is the evil god formed by the humanity and depraved emotions of this old being.
The second is the Primordial Demoness. It turned out that she was seriously injured at the end of the Fourth Epoch, and her state has been very bad ever since because of that injury.
The third is the Primordial Moon. This god has many believers. Some people believe that He is actually the "Sanguine Ancestor", and some people believe that He is the high-sequence Beyonder characteristics of the "Moon" pathway, and He responds to prayers on His own because of spiritual remnants. Before trading relevant information, Klein didn't expect that two Outer Gods would be competing for this "evil god vest".
The fourth is the Dark Side of the Universe. This evil god is not very "well-known", and does not appear frequently in the Beyonder world, but He has a great background. He is actually Farbauti, the "Devil Monarch" from the Second Epoch.
The fifth is the Chained God traded today, who is not very "well-known" in the Northern Continent. When Klein went to the Southern Continent, he learned that the Chained God still has many believers in the Highland Kingdom, but almost no one in the Northern Continent believes in this evil god.
They are the evil gods recognized by the major churches and the vast number of Beyonders. As for the Angel of Kings like Adam, Amon, and "Mr. Door", first of all, they are relatively low-key, or have been sealed, and there has never been a bloody sacrifice for them, so they are not recognized as evil gods in the Beyonder world, and many Beyonders don't even know of their existence.
After the hall was quiet for more than ten seconds, Hobert suddenly said: "I need to correct some information in a previous transaction."
The other members were all stunned. It was the first time they had heard of such a statement as "correcting information".
Klein thought to himself: Is this after-sales service?
Hobert said: "When trading some information about the Fourth Epoch before, the information I obtained had some errors. Last week, I obtained more accurate information, so I want to explain it to everyone."
This made everyone even more curious. Before, they felt that the information about the Fourth Epoch was very detailed and reasonable, and they didn't feel that there was anything unreasonable about it.
"Everyone should still remember my description of the True Creator's camp," Hobert further explained. "At that time, I said that the True Creator's camp had a considerable disadvantage, and that the only existences at the level of True Gods were the True Creator and Solomon.
"I just got the exact news last week that the Underworld Emperor also participated in the war at that time, and he supported the True Creator.
"As for the Angel of Kings, besides Medici and Ouroboros, there was also 'Mr. Door'.
"In terms of angels, there were also Antigonus, Zoroast, and Zaratul, among other archangels.
"Overall, their strength was actually similar to that of the Six Gods camp, especially in terms of archangels, there were as many as seven or eight, but there was a lack of power at the level of True Gods."
Everyone showed some surprise. Leonard thought to himself: No wonder the old man always spoke with a sense of pride whenever he mentioned the Solomon Empire, it turns out that the Solomon Empire in its heyday was so strong!
Klein thought: That makes sense, why the Six Gods would find Tudor and Trunsoest as internal agents. Otherwise, if they had an overwhelming advantage, they wouldn't need to use such conspiracies and tricks.
Alger suddenly smiled: It's a pity, this camp was still destroyed, because their opponent was the Six Gods.
The other members also had their own feelings, but they didn't feel much, or rather, after just talking about "high-end topics" such as the Outer Deities and the Ancient Gods, they were a little numb to this kind of news.
In the next ten seconds, because there was no new transaction, it jumped to the free exchange session.
Alger spoke first: "I saw the 'Specter Empire' in Tortuga Port!"
Cattleya was slightly stunned and then said: "Is this news true?"
When Alger arrived in Tortuga Port, she had just left there not long ago, and thought that the news she had received was wrong.
After all, that was a legendary "treasure ship". There had been no news about this ship before, but it suddenly appeared in Tortuga Port at this time.
"It's true," Alger affirmed. "I was on the dock in the harbour when the 'Specter Empire' appeared."
Everyone had more or less heard about the relevant information about this ship, and they all knew that it was one of the legendary treasures at sea.
So everyone looked at Hobert, and Audrey was somewhat unhappy: We even had lunch together at noon, but you didn't tell me about such an important thing!
"First of all, on behalf of Tortuga Port, I welcome you to come, Mr. Hanged Man," Hobert said with a smile. "And Ms. Hermit, I'm sorry, I've been busy with other things these days and haven't been able to entertain you."
Alger smiled: "I'm just very curious about what kind of harbour it is, no need to entertain me."
Ms. Hermit smiled and said nothing. She completely landed secretly, so there was even less need for entertainment.
Fors was slightly stunned: Mr. Hanged Man and Ms. Hermit have both been to Tortuga Port? I didn't know anything about it.
At this time, she didn't know whether she should entertain them if she encountered such a situation again, or not.
It would indeed be a little impolite not to entertain them, but if she did, they would most likely recognize that she was "The Magician".
Hobert continued: "As Mr. Hanged Man said, that is the 'Specter Empire'. One of our members found its clues in Santiadro City and found this giant ship in the Berserk Sea.
"Its current role is to guard against Erebus's surprise attack. Because the purpose of construction was different, the 'Specter Empire' is completely a giant warship. I believe the 'Black Emperor' would not be its opponent either."
And the attack by the 'Rose School' last week was a good verification of the 'Specter Empire's' combat power. The 'Tree of Flesh and Blood' and the pirate admiral-level fleet were completely disintegrated in less than ten minutes."
Alger thought to himself: Actually, it only took one minute. Everyone on the 'Tree of Flesh and Blood' fleet was dead. The remaining nine minutes were spent with white flames burning the pirates' corpses and turning the giant, dozens of meters long 'Tree of Flesh and Blood' into ashes.
Cattleya turned her head away, always feeling that the 'Emperor' specifically mentioned 'Pirate Admiral' as a warning to herself.
Emlyn asked curiously: "Mr. Emperor, does the 'Specter Empire' really have mountains of treasure?"
"No." Hobert said simply: "There are only a few hundred cursed people, but this ship's weapons are very special, enough to eliminate an angel."
"But the premise is that the angel stands there motionless, allowing the 'Specter Empire' to attack as much as it wants."
Audrey asked further: "Mr. Emperor, I remember you said before that you obtained some information about the 'Specter Empire' during an exploration with Mr. Hanged Man. Are they really cursed by the Underworld Emperor?"
Hobert replied: "Yes!"
Leonard, who didn't know the relevant information, was very curious and was about to ask a question, but 'The World' spoke first: "Didn't you hear clearly? Mr. Emperor said that one of his companions discovered the clues to this ship from the city of Santiadro!"
Cattleya did notice this, but at the same time, she was also considering the 'Pirate Admiral' matter mentioned by the 'Emperor', so she didn't ask any related questions.
Just now, Alger also ignored this point because he recalled the 'Emperor's' powerful attack power. At this time, he was reminded by 'The World': "I remember, that seems to be the vanished capital city of the Solomon Empire."
Hobert smiled and said: "That's right, we found this lost city based on some clues."
'The World' asked again: "In what state does this city currently exist?"
"I can't say for sure either." Hobert said truthfully: "It seems to be in the real world, but it doesn't seem to be."
Alger asked further: "What is the scene inside like?"
"Similar to the outside world." Hobert briefly introduced: "But there are many monsters affected by the battle of the gods, and the periods of dawn, noon, dusk, and night are very short."
Everyone felt very novel about this description and tried to imagine what it would be like for a day and night to pass very quickly.
Klein and Alger and Cattleya could all hear that the 'Emperor's' answer to this city was quite restrained, almost answering whatever was asked.
They guessed that perhaps some detailed information was a secret of their organization and could not be disclosed, so they no longer continued to ask.
Then everyone began to share what they had seen and heard last week. Little Sun was already preparing to set off to the camp in Afternoon Town. Their first task was to clear the monsters around the Giant King's Court. After a few days of rest, they would explore the 'Giant King's Court.'
Leonard shared his experiences at the gathering for the first time: "In the previous ten days, a huge change occurred in Backlund!"
"First of all, the gas industry used despicable means to frame 'Earl's Light' and was defeated in the subsequent struggle. Everyone generally believes that Backlund will become a world of electric lights in a few months at the latest…"
Speaking of this, Leonard felt that 'The World,' that is, Klein, was looking at him strangely.
He quickly paused for a moment and didn't find anything wrong with what he had just said.
Leonard was not very familiar with the Berserk Sea, and had no concept of Hobert's territory at all. Although Cattleya had mentioned that the port of Longtail Island had been renamed Tussock Port, he didn't take it to heart.
So at this time, Leonard had not completely equated Hobert with the 'Emperor'. He was more inclined to believe that the 'Emperor' and Hobert were colleagues, because in his contact with Hobert, Hobert had never shown a knowledgeable side.
Leonard cleared his throat and said again: "Another piece of news is that the Church has discovered that the royal family seems to be secretly carrying out something? But after investigating for several days, they have not found the secret of the royal family."
Klein smiled: These two pieces of news, one is related to Hobert, and the other is related to me.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 640: Preparations before War
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Regarding the secrets of the royal family, I happen to know a little," 'The World' said, manipulating his character at the lower end of the bronze table.
Leonard, 'The Star,' wasn't aware of this because it started when Klein began tracking Qonas. At this moment, he was still a bit puzzled: Why would Klein know the inside story?
"The royal family's secret involves excavating an ancient ruin," 'The World' said. "It seems there are some unspeakable arrangements within those ruins."
"This reminds me of the information I traded with Emperor Roselle earlier. I wonder if George III is preparing to become a god?"
Leonard almost stood up: "George… His Majesty the King wants to become a god?"
"Emperor" Hobert said, "That's right. According to the information we've obtained, he does indeed have such a plan."
Leonard frowned: "I remember there's an agreement between various countries and the Churches of the Seven Gods that the king can only advance to Sequence 5 at most. How could the Churches not notice His Majesty advancing from Sequence 5 to Sequence 1?"
"I don't know the specifics of how it's being done, but I've discovered that the King has a substitute," Hobert said. "Or perhaps a clone. But what's certain is that the King who frequently appears in public is not the real him."
"As for the advancement from Sequence 5 to Sequence 1, it seems a clever method was used. The specific details are still under investigation, and we are closely monitoring this matter."
Then he said to 'The World': "If there are any emergencies, we can inform each other and support each other."
This was also what Klein hoped for. He manipulated 'The World' to say: "No problem."
When this topic came to a close, Alger, 'The Hanged Man,' who was frequently at sea, brought up the second question that 'The Star' had mentioned earlier: "I've also heard news about electric lights. It's said they can emit light like daytime in the darkness?"
"Yes!" Leonard smiled. "Indeed, they are very bright."
He paused and then said: "Actually, I don't really like electric lights. They make the night less mysterious, but this seems to be the trend."
Hobert was slightly stunned: The poet actually said something quite poetic.
At this time, Cattleya, 'The Hermit,' also asked: "What is burned to produce the light?"
Then Audrey, 'Justice,' explained: "It's not burning anything, but using electricity."
After a slight pause, she glanced at Hobert, suddenly realizing: "I'm not very clear about the specific principles either."
"The general principle is that electricity can heat the metal filament, and the filament starts to glow after reaching a certain temperature," Hobert explained simply.
Cattleya nodded slightly. In fact, she still didn't quite understand how electricity heated the filament. She felt that she should visit the territory of 'The Creator' more often when she had time, as there seemed to be too many new things there.
Derrick, 'The Sun,' asked: "Emperor, where can we find electricity?"
Hobert explained: "It requires building large power plants. If City of Silver needs it, I can have someone modify a small generator."
"But if you want to generate electricity, you need to constantly burn coal or other fuels."
He reminded: "Unless City of Silver can mine coal, electric lighting is not very suitable for you, because it requires too much fuel, which is too extravagant for you."
"Is the coal you're talking about that black, but combustible stone?" Although there was Mr. Fool's translation, Little Sun still wanted to confirm.
City of Silver had its own coal mines, which were the main heating material.
The trees and grass around the city had been burned away more than two thousand years ago, so they had to find alternative fuels.
"If you have coal, that's easy," Hobert smiled. "I can modify a small coal-burning generator for you, but it can only meet the lighting needs of some areas."
He estimated for a moment and then said: "If you have a plaza, install a large light in the plaza, install a large light in the training ground, and then install some electric lights in the round tower where your 'Six-Member Council' is located, that should be no problem."
Klein smiled. Electric lights installed in the ancient City of Silver? It always felt a bit out of place.
Derrick still found it a bit incredible: "Emperor, can it really be as bright as daylight?"
City of Silver was too eager for daylight, even if it was just false daylight.
Hobert pinched his chin and thought for a while before saying: "This has been certified by the Eternal Blazing Sun Church. The light emitted by electric lights can even drive away relatively weak wraiths."
"Of course, it's still far from the sun."
Then he said seriously: "You must first report to your Chief, because I just thought that electric lights might make City of Silver very conspicuous in the 'Forsaken Forsaken Forsaken Land of the Gods,' and I don't know if it will attract some powerful monsters."
Derrick was stunned for a moment: "I understand. I will report to the Chief after the gathering."
Then he asked: "What reward do I need to pay for the electric light transaction?"
Hobert thought for a moment and then said: "All the essence of a Lord Tree."
This was one of the main ingredients for advancing to 'Earl of the Fallen.' Hobert had hunted six-legged goblins before in order to advance, but at that time he was trying to obtain the six-legged goblin's brain, because he had been trading for this auxiliary Ingredient for a long time without success.
As for the main ingredient, the "Complete Brain of a Six-Legged Goblin," it was still lying in the "Nation of Disorder" gathering dust, so Hobert was thinking about how to use it.
So he added: "Oh, right, please give me the entire Lord Tree, because I also need its spirituality materials."
Derrick said: "I will ask my companions to see if anyone knows the whereabouts of the Lord Tree."
In the minds of the others, images of electric lights installed in an ancient city appeared, the combination of the two making people feel a bit magical.
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, 'The World' suddenly reminded: "According to some news I've obtained, a war may break out in the Northern Continent recently."
He analyzed this from the current situation and the undercurrents of the extraordinary world.
Audrey also sighed: "The nobles have also been talking about this recently. It seems that war is inevitable."
Leonard was slightly stunned, feeling as if he didn't live in the Northern Continent. He was very strange why he hadn't received the corresponding news?
But he quickly realized that he had either been investigating cases or playing cards recently, and hadn't participated in social activities for a while, so he had no channels to obtain the corresponding information.
Emlyn was also a little surprised to hear this news. During this time, he had been taking care of his marionette and doing volunteer work at the Harvest Church.
Except for a few days ago when the Sanguine Marquis Nibbs suddenly called him to inquire about information about the 'Chained God,' he hadn't participated in the Sanguine's gatherings for a while.
So Emlyn asked: "Is it a war between Loen and the Feysac Empire or the Feynapotter Kingdom? Why would there be a war?"
These two countries were Loen's "traditional enemies."
"It may also be with the Intis Republic," Audrey said. "I heard that Loen and the Intis Republic have also had great conflicts recently."
Emlyn was a little strange: "Why has the Loen Kingdom become enemies with the other three great powers?"
In his impression, he clearly remembered that the relationship between the Loen Kingdom and the Intis Republic was still good.
"In the eyes of nobles and dignitaries, Loen monopolizes the East Balam and Rorsted Archipelago, and are both major powers that have experienced the Industrial Revolution, with very similar industries and conflicting interests," Hobert explained:
"As for the conflicts in the Beyonder world, we just talked about it. George III wants to become a god, which will greatly disrupt the balance of extraordinary power in the Northern Continent. Does everyone think the other three countries would be willing to see such a result?"
During the Backlund smog incident, Hobert had announced similar information, but it did not attract everyone's attention at the time.
Now everyone had a deep feeling about this news, and some members also recalled Mr. Fool's previous reminder: The era is changing because of this.
In a serious atmosphere, this Tarot Gathering ended.
The only member who had no worries about the war in the Northern Continent was Derrick. In the second half of the free exchange stage, his mind was full of electric lights, electric lights, and electric lights!
After returning to the real world, Derrick jumped out of bed and ran towards the round tower where the Six-Member Council was located, and soon met Chief Colin.
"Chief, I have something very important to report to you!" Derrick said straight to the point as soon as he came up.
Colin was stunned for a moment, and immediately asked another elder of the Council, as well as two subordinates, to leave the room.
"I have received an important message. There is now a method that can emit light similar to sunlight by burning coal!" At this time, Derrick was no longer as naive as before.
He knew the Chief would definitely value such news, but because of his special status, he wouldn't ask about the source. Therefore, he was very clear that he just needed to explain the matter of the electric light.
If it were in the past, he would have put a lot of effort into fabricating a reason, only to have it exposed by the Chief in a few words.
Colin indeed didn't ask about the source of the news, but was somewhat surprised: "There's such a thing?"
Then he asked, "What kind of reward is required?"
"An entire Lord Tree."
Colin pondered for a moment and then said, "Postpone the exploration mission for a few days. You gather a few members and come with me to hunt a Lord Tree!"
Derrick was also very happy with the Chief's decision, but he still reminded him dutifully, "Chief, if the light is too bright, will it attract some powerful monsters?"
"The probability is not high," Colin said. "Unless it can illuminate the entire Forsaken Land of the Gods,' there are no monsters within our exploration range that we can't handle."
Perhaps there is a slight risk, but the significance is also enormous!
Just imagine, if the patrol team outside the city could turn around and see a light source inside the city, it would be a huge encouragement to them.
Even if the exploration of the Giant King's Court fails and no exit is found, such a light source can give City of Silver the faith to persevere!
For Colin, such an opportunity should not be missed.
...
Backlund, 62 Empress Borough.
Hobert stared at the ceiling for a while, then stretched and got out of bed to carve the black iron needed for the demigod-level charm.
Just as he was about to finish carving, a scene appeared in Hobert's mind.
A tall young man, wearing simple clothing suitable for combat, prayed: "...Respected Mr. Fool, please tell Mr. Emperor that the Chief has agreed to the transaction, and we will set off tomorrow to hunt the Lord Tree."
Hobert pretended to praise the Fool, looking at the ugly charm he had carved: Fortunately, I am asking myself for power. If I asked other gods for power, they probably wouldn't pay attention to me at all.
He didn't immediately create the charm, but used 'Travel' to go to 'Earl's Light' and instructed Todd to modify a small generator.
The small power plant not far from the Empress Borough is still using small generators. The relevant departments of 'Earl's Light' are very experienced in this type of modification and can complete it in at most a week.
After dinner, Hobert prayed to himself again, completed a demigod-level charm, and sacrificed it along with a 'Order Wood' to Mr. Fool, asking him to complete the transaction with Mr. Star.
At eleven o'clock in the evening, Hobert followed the plan and took Audrey out to carry out tonight's assassination.
This time, Hobert prepared an Sequence 8 level opponent for Audrey, allowing her to complete the assassination of this target alone.
Hobert was very clear that so-called combat experience is honed through repeated battles, and there is no shortcut at all.
This time, Audrey had a new understanding of her abilities, as well as the tactics Hobert had taught her before, and formulated an assassination plan.
She began to 'hypnotize' the target at the door, causing the target to ignore her, and then suddenly distorted the doorknob and pushed the door in.
The target noticed something was wrong, but only glanced at the door, seemingly not seeing Audrey who had opened the door and entered.
Audrey nervously entered the room and used the sealed artifact to create a 'Sword of Dawn' under the target's gaze, piercing the opponent's heart with one strike.
The target only struggled for a moment before dying.
Audrey calmly handled the scene. Because she didn't create too much noise this time and attract the attention of others, she had time to deal with the traces at the scene.
She used the potion provided by Hobert, which could corrode the corpse, to dispose of the body, and then picked up the Beyonder characteristic.
Because Hobert gave Audrey a 'Crystal of Order,' she didn't need to do the corresponding anti-divination processing.
After checking the entire room again, she confirmed that she had not left any clues before quietly leaving.
Hobert, who was two or three kilometers away from the scene, did not leave, but watched Audrey while also watching the scene for a while.
Two eyes seemed to appear in the darkness, glanced at it, and immediately disappeared into the darkness.
Hobert smiled slightly. This time, the Aurora Order's reaction was much faster than last time. However, those two eyes were more like bait. Hobert would not be fooled. He wanted to continue waiting to catch bigger fish.
He took Audrey back to the study of the Lord's Mansion, and Hobert once again helped Audrey review the battle before taking the somewhat excited Audrey back.
Tomorrow, Hobert plans to let Xio continue the assassination. By that time, he will definitely be able to catch some fish!
...
Tuesday afternoon, thanks to the autumn wind, the fog was blown away, and Backlund has had a lot of sunny weather recently.
Hobert invited Alice, Georgina, and Amyrius to afternoon tea today, actually to promote the teleportation array to them, because the Loen Kingdom will definitely need it in the early stages of the war.
Around two o'clock, Hobert personally stood at the door to welcome them and invited them to have tea on the terrace.
During the chat, Amyrius mentioned the telephone that the Ministry of Defense had just installed: "That is definitely something that can change the times!"
Amyrius said seriously: "Just imagine, being able to hear the voices of relatives or friends thousands of miles away will be of great significance to ordinary people!
"Sound cannot be replaced by telegrams or letters. In my opinion, words are cold and lifeless in many cases. Only sound is warm."
Georgina, who also had military experience, said: "That's right, sometimes the voices of loved ones are faith and strength!"
She also expressed her views: "More importantly, the telephone is not like Beyonder abilities. It can be mass-produced, which is its greatest advantage."
"Both of you have seen the future prospects of the telephone," Hobert smiled. "In my opinion, the telephone also has a use: to confirm whether relatives or friends are safe."
"For example, if a company has an employee who lives far away from home and sees a fire in the direction of their home, but it takes more than an hour to rush back from the company."
"At this time, if there is a telephone at home, they can call home. If someone answers, then it's fine. If no one answers, they should rush back immediately."
"For example, if there is a time-sensitive hot news story, the reporter can call their newspaper office and dictate the news content, while the other side takes shorthand notes. This will allow them to publish the news earlier than other newspapers."
"And if it's a telegram, you need to write the telegram first, send it, and then it needs to be translated on the other side."
"In short, it speeds up the dissemination of information and makes information dissemination more convenient."
Only Alice here had not been exposed to the telephone: "There is such a thing? You can also install a few in the palace to try."
At this time, everyone had drunk two cups of tea. Hobert said: "I invited the three of you here today because I hope to invite you to see something good. How about we go to 'Earl's Light' together?"
Amyrius and Georgina were both a little strange about Hobert's purpose in finding them. Alice was a little curious about what Hobert wanted to sell to the military.
The last time they met, Hobert had said that he wanted to do a business deal with the military, and Alice helped obtain the key intelligence.
The four people took a carriage and came to 'Earl's Light'.
However, it was not the office building of 'Earl's Light', but a large warehouse.
The door of the warehouse was half open. Hobert invited the three of them to enter.
Alice first saw that there were many building materials piled up in the warehouse. Through the passage formed by these building materials, she saw movers loading building materials into empty carriages, and the loaded carriages were pulled by horses to a not very high iron frame, and neatly arranged and fixed.
Hobert's appearance caused many people to come over to say hello, and then they returned to their posts.
Alice and the other two still didn't understand what Hobert was going to do, but they didn't ask any questions and stood silently behind Hobert with great understanding.
A few minutes later, the carriage carriages were already full on the iron frame. Without Hobert's reminder, the Beyonder operating the teleportation array activated the teleportation array.
When illusory giant doors rose from the ground, Alice and the other three were stunned, and in the blink of an eye, several carriages full of building materials disappeared from everyone's sight.
Three or four seconds later, Georgina came back to her senses: "This, is this really a teleportation array? The Navy... I mean, you have set up a teleportation array at the docks of Tussock Harbor?"
A few days ago, the navy reported that a mysterious magic circle was suspected to have appeared at the docks of Tussock Port, capable of transporting personnel and goods over long distances.
Georgina didn't take it too seriously, assuming it was a way to transport some urgent supplies through sacrifices and bestowals from the "Creator."
But today, seeing those illusory doors and that they were transporting building materials and the like, Georgina knew that they were definitely not asking the "Creator" to transport things.
That's a god, how could they possibly help transport ordinary things like building materials?
So Georgina immediately thought of the teleportation array. After her reminder, Alice and Amyrius also recalled some information they had seen before.
One came from the royal family, and the other came from a noble family, and both families had relevant records of teleportation arrays.
Amyrius sighed, "In the Fifth Epoch, teleportation arrays have actually appeared!"
Hobert smiled and said, "This is what I wanted to show you all. What do you think?"
The distinguished Alice said frankly, "It's shocking!"
Amyrius quickly asked, "How much cargo can be transported at once?"
"About three train cars, or up to six large carriage cars," Hobert explained. "It can also transport people. We can go and experience it later."
Amyrius calculated that, with a squeeze, it would be enough to transport a battalion of soldiers and equipment. If commanded properly, a brigade could be transported to the front line in an hour!
This is definitely something that can change the course of the war!
At this time, the teleportation array was activated again. The returning carriages were still carriages, but they were full of tropical fruits, as well as grain and vegetables.
This time there were only four carriage cars, and several passengers came with them. They were employees of the "Earl's Light" research department.
The "Earl's Light's" research laboratory in cooperation with the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery has already begun operating on Longtail Island. Those scientists now basically travel back and forth between the two places through the teleportation array!
The next round of cargo transportation began, and this time it was still building materials being transported to Longtail Island.
Because not only has the teleportation array between Backlund and Longtail Island been opened, but the teleportation array between Longtail Island and Jeffery City in the Southern Continent has also been opened, and they need a lot of cement and steel bars there.
Gravel and bricks can be supplied by locally built workshops.
After securing the carriage cars, Hobert and the other three also stood on the iron platform. The teleportation array was activated, and Alice and the other two saw a colorful corridor appear before their eyes.
In the blink of an eye, they arrived at an unfamiliar warehouse. The porters around them changed from white-skinned to the brown-skinned natives of the Rorsted Archipelago.
They were very respectful to Hobert. Some natives even knelt down and praised him loudly in the local language.
Hobert waved to them and led Alice and the others out of the warehouse. Outside was an endless sea, and on the other side was Longtail Port with its Loen architectural style.
Alice and the other two had also seen many Beyonder abilities and felt the convenience brought by "Traveling," but this experience was different. They came to the Rorsted Archipelago with the cargo, and this cargo represented the universality of the teleportation array.
It's not like "Traveling," which requires becoming a Sequence 5 or obtaining the corresponding Sealed Artifact to use.
A Sequence 7 can manipulate it to operate continuously. The key is that it can not only transport a few people, but also transport a large amount of cargo. If it is a "Traveler," it is difficult to transport cargo, and it may take until Sequence 4 "Secrets SOrcerer" to complete this type of operation.
But letting a demigod be responsible for transporting goods all day is a huge waste, and that demigod would not be willing to do this kind of work.
Just like the telephones they talked about before, the teleportation array is something that has universality. Not only can a few people with relevant abilities use it, but ordinary people can also enjoy the convenience brought by this mysterious world.
The three of them looked at the sea with various feelings for a while. Hobert took them to a coconut grove, picked a few coconuts, returned to the Lord's mansion, and had the servants open them, drinking fresh coconut juice with straws.
They had all drunk coconut juice before, but today's drink was indeed a bit special, or rather, today's mood and atmosphere were special.
After chatting about interesting stories at sea for a while, Amyrius asked Hobert when the time was right, "Do you have any plans to sell the teleportation array?"
Hobert smiled and said, "The three of you are all good friends, and I won't keep you in suspense on this kind of matter."
He paused and then said, "The reason I invited you to visit is, of course, to find a good buyer for the teleportation array.
"However, we cannot sell it to the public for the next month or two, because we have to build the teleportation array for our own use first."
In fact, he was waiting for the opportunity to speculate and using this time to acquire gemstone mines. Only when the war starts will the demand for the teleportation array become apparent, and that will be a good time to talk about cooperation.
But whether it was Amyrius or Georgina, although they knew that the international situation was tense, they did not dare to be sure when the war would break out based on all the information they had.
Amyrius was already very satisfied with Hobert's reply, as long as this strategic thing could be sold.
Georgina was more concerned: "If other countries come to buy it…"
"Don't worry about this," Hobert smiled. "Since I am the Earl of the Loen Kingdom, I will certainly help strive for the opportunity to only sell to Loen.
"Unless you give me too low a price, making it difficult for me to explain."
Amyrius smiled and said, "The price is negotiable."
In his opinion, more money should be spent to monopolize this thing!
Georgina also breathed a sigh of relief, feeling that the preferential treatment given to Hobert these days had finally paid off.
When they returned to Backlund, it was already evening. After Alice and the other two left Hobert's Earl's mansion, they met again at Admiral Amyrius's residence to discuss the teleportation array.
For them, this thing must be equipped as soon as possible, and it will definitely play a huge role in future wars.
…
After Hobert sent the guests away, he began to prepare for tonight's action.
He first went to discuss it with Xio, and then gave her the glove "1-107", which can use all the abilities of a "Imperative Mage" within three minutes.
When midnight arrived, the assassination operation began.
Wearing a mask and height-increasing shoes, Xio first came to the location of the first assassination target, a Sequence 7. There was no need to use the ability of "1-107" at all. After she rushed into the opponent's hiding place, she immediately used imprisonment to prevent the target from escaping.
Then she rushed up and killed the opponent with her best close combat skills, ending the battle without even firing a gun.
Xio calmly wrapped the corpse in a quilt from the room, and carried the corpse down from the window in one leap.
But after walking a few steps, her spirituality sensed danger!
This point was in the plan of Hobert and Xio, she had been mentally prepared for a long time, she threw the corpse on the side of the street, and lifted the seal of "1-107": "Hiding in the shadows is forbidden here."
The shadows on the side of the street suddenly became three-dimensional, outlining two human figures. One was a "Shepherd" and the other was a "Rose Bishop", both envoys of the Aurora Order.
Under the previous guidance of Hobert, Xio immediately performed the second "Prohibition": "Grazing is forbidden here…"
Boom ~
The corpse not far from her suddenly exploded, blowing Xio away and interrupting her "Prohibition".
The flesh and blood of the corpse were blown everywhere,
Xio had to quickly change her tactics and shouted at the "Shepherd": "Imprisonment!"
This was imprisonment at the demigod level. The "Shepherd" had just finished grazing, and a "Blazing Spear" was piercing towards Xio, but the "Shepherd", along with the "Blazing Spear", were "Imprisoned" together!
Boom ~
More flesh and blood exploded, and Xio fell down along the shock wave, pulled out her gun and fired three shots at the "Rose Bishop".
The "Rose Bishop" felt that the pistol was a Sealed Artifact, but he didn't take it too seriously. His whole body seemed to suddenly turn into a pool of liquid and "melt" on the street, dodging the three bullets.
But what he didn't expect was that the three bullets clearly passed him, but flew back again.
Puff puff puff ~
All three bullets hit. The "Rose Bishop" snorted coldly. His Beyonder power had already made him unafraid of this kind of physical damage.
But in the next second, the "Rose Bishop" completely lost his mind. This was the Beyonder attack attached to the bullets, namely "Blather", "Corruption", and "Depravity".
The "Blathering" bullet immediately made the "Rose Bishop" mad, the "Corruption" bullet made his flesh and blood corrupt, and the bullet that strengthened the "Depraved" psychology caused the "Rose Bishop's" spirit to fall into a brief collapse.
Thus, the "Rose Bishop" completely lost control in an instant!
Xio, who was crawling on the ground, was slightly stunned as she looked at the revolver in her hand. She knew very well that although the enchanted bullets produced by her pistol were very useful, they definitely did not have the ability to "track" targets. Even if all three shots hit, it would be difficult to make a Sequence 6 lose control instantly.
This must be the assist from Hobert, who was hiding somewhere.
The "Shepherd" who had been "imprisoned" glanced at the revolver in Xio's hand in surprise. As soon as the "imprisonment" was lifted, he immediately switched to "herding" souls.
A gust of wind blew from the street, making Xio unable to open her eyes. The "Shepherd" was blown away like a falling leaf.
Hobert, who was hiding three kilometers away, did not pursue, because he had not used his full strength to manipulate the three bullets just now, making them look like the ability of a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact.
Even so, the "Shepherd" would definitely choose to escape, because Xio also had a demigod-level Sealed Artifact on her.
Then, after tonight, the Aurora Order's higher-ups would receive information that the person assassinating Aurora Order members had a demigod-level Sealed Artifact and a very powerful Grade 2 Sealed Artifact.
When they come to support the next assassination operation, there will be at least one demigod.
In order to quickly kill the opponent, there may even be two demigods coming.
When that time comes, it will be Hobert's turn to take action!
Xio got up from the ground and shot the remaining three bullets at the monster formed after the "Rose Bishop" lost control, killing the target.
Their Beyonder characteristics precipitated out at a speed visible to the naked eye. After Xio picked them up, she was a little worried about how to deal with the corpses.
The monster's corpse was easy to deal with, but the corpse of the Sequence 7 had been blown to pieces everywhere!
At this moment, the corpse and the flesh and blood on the ground "whooshed" and burned, and the burning process was accelerated. In just three seconds, they were all burned to ashes.
When Xio saw this scene, she knew that Hobert had taken action again, so she took the Beyonder characteristics and left immediately. At this time, a gust of wind blew from the street, blowing away the ashes on the ground, and ultimately no trace was left.
It's just that the gunshots just now woke up many residents around, and they secretly peeked out from the windows, but in the end, they naturally didn't see anything.
Xio quickly left in a carriage. In the carriage, she bandaged her wounds. These wounds were basically caused by the two "flesh and blood explosions" just now, and were all skin injuries.
She continued tonight's performance and killed another target according to plan.
Tonight's operation was a complete success. At about one o'clock in the morning, Xio came to Hobert's study, and the two discussed the next step of the operation.
Because Xio was now Hobert's intelligence officer, Hobert had told her all his plans last night.
Seeing Xio, who had suffered some minor injuries, Hobert first used the "Fork of Healing" to heal her wounds: "Then, the plan will proceed to the next step."
Xio felt that all her wounds were healed, and marveled at the wonderful use of extraordinary power.
Hobert took out four more sets of materials: "Start the third round, which is also the last round of investigation."
He said: "Acting must be realistic. Start the investigation next week, and it must look more cautious than before!
"Don't worry, next time they will definitely send demigod-level power. During your investigation, they are likely to find you!"
Xio nodded fearlessly: "No problem."
As she spoke, she took off the "1-107" that Hobert had given her from her hand.
But Hobert smiled and said, "Keep it with you first. In case you encounter a surprise attack from an Aurora Order Saint, you won't be completely defenseless."
Xio was slightly stunned, as if reminding Hobert: "This is a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact."
"Of course I know, but I also know that from today until we severely hit the Aurora Order, you are in a very dangerous situation. Giving you the Sealed Artifact is to ensure your safety."
Xio didn't refuse any more and put away "1-107".
After watching Xio leave, Hobert sat on the chair and began to consider another issue.
Just during the action just now, the image of "The Fool" appeared in his mind and told him that "The Moon" had paid the reward, which was a detailed record of "Beauty Goddess" Auernia.
At that time, Xio's action had already begun, so Hobert thanked Mr. Fool and did not immediately "read" those records in his mind.
Now that it was safe, he began to "browse" through them.
These records started from the Second Epoch, but there were very few related records at that time, only saying that after the "Progenitor of the Sanguine" fell, Auernia became the new leader of the Sanguine.
Immediately afterwards, this new leader led the Sanguine to serve the "Elven King".
After only "reading" a few sentences, Hobert immediately entered the "Nation of Disorder", because he had sealed many memories there. Some questions that he couldn't understand in the real world could often find relevant clues in the "Nation of Disorder".
Entering the "Nation of Disorder" and sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert first thought of a question: Where is the third Sequence 1 characteristic of the "Moon" pathway?
One was obtained by "Beauty Goddess" Auernia, another was sacrificed to the "Mother Tree of Desire" by the "God of Spiritual Creatures", and who did the remaining Sequence 1 characteristic fall into the hands of?
This made Hobert couldn't help but "browse" through the records provided by the Sanguine again, only saying that Auernia became the new leader of the Sanguine after Lilith fell, but did not say that Auernia was promoted after the war!
Hobert thought of a question: Could it be that Auernia was already Sequence 1 before the War of the Gods?
Previously, Hobert had always believed that this "God of Beauty" must have been promoted to Sequence 1 after the war, which was based on the consideration of gods under normal circumstances.
But the ancient gods are different. Their bodies may not necessarily have three Sequence 1 characteristics of this pathway. Perhaps Lilith only had two Sequence 1 characteristics in her body back then, and some characteristics of other pathways?
Or perhaps Lilith simply had one or two Sequence 1 characteristics of the "Mother" pathway in her body!
This can explain why the "Goddess of Harvest" Omebella harmed Lilith. Perhaps she was not at all aiming for the Sequence 1 characteristic of the "Moon" pathway in Lilith's body, but for the Sequence 1 characteristic of the "Mother" pathway in Lilith's body.
After all, before the appearance of the first "Blasphemy Slate", the concept of adjacent pathways was still very vague.
Hobert then understood another question. Then, in the War of the Gods of the "Era of Fire", Lilith's plan was not just to use her own fall to seize the opportunity to recover the Beyonder characteristics of the "Moon" pathway, so as to "wash away" the corruption.
It is also possible that Lilith used this War of the Gods to transfer the corruption in her body, and then used the uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway to maintain her consciousness. Of course, she could also use the related characteristics of the "Mother" pathway to maintain her consciousness.
This is even a way to purify the characteristics in her body!
If Lilith had the relevant characteristics of "Mother" in her body, she should have prepared a spare body for herself long ago.
Even in a bad state, she could completely survive until the Evernight Goddess returned.
By the way, she could also use the convenience of hiding in the dark to collect other Sequence 1 characteristics.
Thinking of this, Hobert nodded, once again affirming his guess, because he remembered that after stealing the fate of the "Goddess of Harvest", Lilith quickly ascended to the throne of God.
Obtaining the fate of the "Goddess of Harvest" was first to avenge, and another purpose should be to stabilize her state.
After all, the transformation from an ancient god to the Earth Mother was definitely not as simple as drinking a cup of tea. Before the Evernight Goddess returned, her state must have been very poor.
Thinking of this, Hobert's thoughts returned to the previous question: Where is the third Beyonder characteristic of "Beauty Goddess"?
