chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 641: Electric Lights Are Used in City of Silver
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert's thoughts continued: Could the third Beyonder characteristic of "Beauty Goddess" be with the Earth Mother or the Evernight Goddess?
Back then, the "God of Spiritual Creatures" snatched a Characteristic of "Beauty Goddess," but Auernia didn't become the King of Angels afterward, indicating that She either knew Lilith's plan and, even if She took action, was helping Lilith seize Beyonder characteristics and Uniqueness.
Or She didn't know the plan and was stunned at the time, failing to react in time to seize the Characteristic.
This possibility couldn't be ruled out. Antigonus and the later "Mother of the Sky" were also stunned at the time. After all, the ancient gods of their pathways had just fallen. If they weren't prepared like the "Goddess of Misfortune," their state at the time would definitely be affected.
According to the current information, only the "Goddess of Misfortune" and the "God of Spiritual Creatures" consciously seized Beyonder characteristics. Apart from Antigonus's good luck, the other deities didn't seem to gain any substantial benefits.
Another matter was that the Characteristics after Lilith's fall became a mystery. The Beyonder characteristics of the other two ancient gods were basically traceable.
The Characteristic of the "Mutant King" was seized by the "God of Spiritual Creatures" and the "Devil Monarch" Farbauti. The Characteristics and Uniqueness of the "Annihilation Demonic Wolf," including the "Darkness" portion, were obtained by the "Goddess of Misfortune."
The Characteristic and Uniqueness of the "Fool" pathway were picked up by Antigonus, who had come to his senses, or later attracted to his side.
Regarding the whereabouts of the "Moon" pathway Characteristics within Lilith, besides being very certain about the location of the Uniqueness, Hobert wasn't very clear about the whereabouts of the other Sequence 1 Characteristics, because this pathway hadn't produced a True God in the future, or rather, until now.
So, Hobert changed his approach, inferring the whereabouts of that Beyonder characteristic from the current situation.
First of all, the Uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway must be in the hands of the Evernight Goddess, and one of the Sequence 1 Characteristics is very likely in the hands of the "Mother Tree of Desire."
Otherwise, since Her pathway isn't even adjacent to the "Moon" pathway, it's impossible for Her to influence the Beyonders of this pathway.
Another point is that the Sanguine can still receive orders from their progenitor. Lilith couldn't possibly use the Earth Mother's authority to contact the Sanguine, right? That would give people the wrong impression.
The angels of the Sanguine should be able to distinguish it.
So, it's very likely that the Earth Mother has a Sequence 1 Characteristic in Her hands.
As for the third Sequence 1 Characteristic, it's indeed impossible to infer, so Hobert blindly guessed whether it might be in the hands of the Evernight Goddess?
In Hobert's view, since the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother had already cooperated in the Second Epoch, when the Evernight Goddess had the opportunity to obtain the Beyonder characteristic of "Beauty Goddess," She would definitely help the Earth Mother "keep" it for future transactions.
Based on what Hobert knew, the Evernight Goddess had two opportunities to obtain the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of the "Moon" pathway. One was during the God Wars in the Second Epoch, when She conveniently picked up a Sequence 1 Characteristic.
The second opportunity was when the six gods joined forces to destroy Trunsoest. During the distribution of spoils, the other gods knew that this was the Sequence 1 Characteristic of the Earth Mother's adjacent pathway, so they would try to avoid it being obtained by the Earth Mother.
If the Evernight Goddess proposed wanting this spoil of war, the other gods would definitely support it!
Because of the lack of sufficient evidence, Hobert stopped guessing after thinking about these things and continued to "browse" the information in his mind.
During the Third Epoch, "Beauty Goddess" Auernia led the Sanguine to become strong again and clearly told everyone: "Primordial Moon" is not the progenitor, so be vigilant against "Primordial Moon" at all times.
Hobert thought that during the Third Epoch, the Earth Mother Church was the main secret organization at the time. Obviously, Auernia had received Lilith's instructions and some help.
There are many records about this time among the Sanguine, but there aren't many valuable things, only that Auernia responded to the prayers of so-and-so, completed something, and later discovered that it was actually very beneficial to the entire Sanguine race.
Another thing is that "Primordial Moon" was influencing the Beyonders of the "Moon" pathway during the Third Epoch.
This isn't difficult to understand. If there was a Beyonder characteristic of "Beauty Goddess" in the hands of the Earth Mother, then "Primordial Moon" would hardly be able to have a great impact on the Sanguine.
However, from the end of the Second Epoch, with the appearance of the first "Blasphemy Slate," humans rapidly became Beyonders of various pathways by taking potions, and "artificial Sanguine" must have appeared at this time as well.
"Primordial Moon" should have been influencing "artificial Sanguine" since then.
In the Fourth Epoch, the Sanguine race truly ushered in a golden age of development because their "Beauty Goddess" became the empress of the Trunsoest Empire, also known as the "Blood Moon Queen" at the time.
There were indeed records about "Beauty Goddess" conducting various studies, and She once observed a large number of descendants of the Arbiter pathway and tried to tamper with the bloodline, pathway, spirit body status, and other genetic elements of a large number of Beyonder descendants.
Although the records only mentioned "Beauty Goddess's" research results, Hobert estimated that many tragedies must have occurred at that time, after all, this was human experimentation.
Obviously, these experiments were to prepare for Trunsoest to maintain the bloodline and spirit body of his descendants. After these experiments, Auernia successfully created a path for the Night Emperor to resurrect.
Hobert carefully reviewed these records and found two very valuable clues.
The first is that Auernia obviously received the Earth Mother's help in the research because many operations required the relevant abilities of the "Mother" pathway, and these operations were all completed very easily without exception.
If there was no help from the Earth Mother, this wouldn't make sense at all.
But what made Hobert curious was whether the existing Sanguine angels knew about this?
The second useful clue was that Auernia discovered a strange, incomprehensible substance in the blood of the "research subjects" during the research process.
If one wanted to help the "research subject" achieve their goal, they had to preserve those incomprehensible substances in the bloodline.
After listening to Her description, the "research subject" thought for a long time before saying that the Outer God was trying to disrupt His plan.
But because there was really no way to remove it, those substances have been preserved in the descendants' bloodline.
The consequence of this was that when the "research subject" tried to resurrect, his descendants would easily encounter the power of that Outer God and have a close connection with that Outer God's power, mutually attracting and fusing.
But because it was in the real world within the barrier, the power that the Outer God could invest was limited, so the "research subject" didn't pay much attention to this.
First of all, the "research subject" in this part of the information must be Trunsoest. According to the order of information provided by the Sanguine, Auernia had already begun experimenting on Trunsoest at this time.
In addition, ordinary research subjects couldn't involve Outer Gods!
And that Outer God, of course, was the "Uncertain Mist"!
The first time Hobert had a normal conversation with Trunsoest, He also said that the "Uncertain Mist" had noticed His plan, but because the "Uncertain Mist's" power in the real world was limited, it couldn't effectively stop it.
It really couldn't be stopped at that time, it seemed to only allow the descendants of the Trunsoest family to only choose the "Black Emperor" pathway, but the other arrangements left by the "Uncertain Mist" back then are now beginning to take effect.
Hobert also realized at this time, no wonder he inexplicably encountered the power of the "Uncertain Mist." Logically speaking, before he became an angel, the "Nation of Disorder" should have very limited attraction to Him.
Now the case is finally solved, the root cause is here!
At the same time, this clue reminded Hobert of a record he had seen in Saint Andrea City before. At that time, Trunsoest ordered his subordinates to seal the thin-necked glass bottle containing the power of the "Uncertain Mist."
Trunsoest's original words at the time were: If we don't seal this bottle, the powerful force of mutual fusion between us will easily awaken Him, and I currently have no way to prevent Him from waking up.
Without discussing who "Him" refers to here, Trunsoest also emphasized at that time that there was a "powerful force of mutual fusion" between himself and the "Uncertain Mist."
This made Hobert suddenly realize that since for unknown reasons, the Earth Mother Church couldn't replicate his body, could they replicate the body of that young Ereth, and then "transfer" the bloodline of the Trunsoest family to that body?
Then, with the bloodline and the force of mutual attraction, after Trunsoest sensed his advancement, could he be forced to enter that body?
Hobert pondered for a long time and found that he wasn't professional in this regard, but he could consult the Earth Mother!
By the way, ask what She did to him and what Her purpose was?
Of course, it would be best if She was willing to answer, but Hobert couldn't do anything if She wasn't willing to answer.
At the end of these materials, Hobert found that the Sanguine didn't even know where their "Blood Moon Queen" had fallen? In other words, the Beyonder characteristics after Auernia's fall weren't with the Sanguine!
Hobert thought about it and felt that it made sense. At that time, the entire empire had collapsed, and it was already very good for some of the Sanguine' forces to escape. They couldn't take care of their "Queen" at all.
Returning to the real world, Hobert was about to set up an altar to pray to the Earth Mother when he suddenly thought that it would be better to go to the church than to use an altar. After all, he had never prayed for power to the Earth Mother before, so it would be quite sudden to suddenly pray to Her.
Mainly because he didn't seem to be very familiar with the Earth Mother. Setting up an altar was equivalent to inviting Her to his home, and She might not be willing to come.
If I go to the church, it's like paying a visit to ask for guidance; the chances of the Earth Mother pretending not to hear will be smaller.
But at this time, the priests in the church are also off work, so I can only wait until tomorrow morning.
… …
Wednesday morning, the handsome Emlyn arrived at Rose Street by public carriage.
Since Ernes became a servant of the Harvest Church, he has been arriving at the church very early every day to clean and help believers treat illnesses.
This made Emlyn come to the church early, and for a while, the two of them even competed to see who could arrive earlier.
But the competition couldn't continue after 8:00 in the morning, because the Harvest Church didn't open until 8:00.
So now Emlyn will definitely arrive at the Harvest Church before 8:00. Today, he came to the entrance of the church, and as usual, Ernes had already arrived.
The two of them almost simultaneously raised their chins, exchanged only a perfunctory greeting, and then stopped talking, instead scrutinizing each other's servant uniforms, ready to mock any stains or wrinkles they found.
Before this, the two had even competed to see whose servant uniform was cleaner, but after a few days, they washed a set of clothes to shreds. After Bishop Utravsky had a "friendly" chat with them, their competition came to an end.
At exactly eight o'clock, the doors of the church opened, and the two stepped into the church where only Bishop Utravsky was praying, but when their feet landed, there was already a person in a trench coat beside Utravsky!
Neither Emlyn nor Ernes, both Sanguine, felt when the other party had entered the church, nor did they see any changes in the space there.
But the other party was indeed there.
At this time, Bishop Utravsky said, "You haven't come to pray for a long time."
The trench coat man smiled and said, "But I have built four Earth Mother churches, contributing my meager strength to spread the Goddess's glory."
Emlyn recognized that this was "Emperor" Hobert. He was very surprised: Why did this guy suddenly come?
Then he glanced at Ernesand saw the other's surprised expression: Hehe, you don't recognize him, do you?
Utravsky slowly nodded: "The Earth Mother will definitely see the contributions you have made."
Hobert said, "Today, I came to pray to the Earth Mother because I have some doubts in my heart, hoping to get some answers."
"Then pray to the Holy Emblem of Life," Bishop Utravsky said. "The Earth Mother will definitely hear you."
The two Sanguine at the door listened to the conversation between the two and watched their behavior, not daring to step forward to disturb them.
Emlyn saw Hobert making a praying gesture. He didn't pay much attention to it and was about to take out a rag to wipe the candlestick, but suddenly he felt that the Holy Emblem of Life on the church wall had become different!
Emlyn couldn't explain exactly where it was different. It seemed that the wooden emblem suddenly began to exude vitality, making the spirituality in the entire church different!
Immediately afterward, Emlyn felt a loving gaze from the direction of the Holy Emblem of Life. That gaze was very much like the gaze his own mother had when she looked at him.
In the next second, Emlyn's heart was filled with shock!
This was the gaze from the Earth Mother!
He and Ernes immediately made corresponding gestures, praising the Earth Mother and praying to Her devoutly.
After a while, Emlyn suddenly realized: It was Hobert's prayer! It was his prayer that attracted the Earth Mother's gaze!
… …
Time returned to a minute ago. Hobert, sitting in the front row of the Harvest Church, whispered a prayer: "O merciful Mother, You are the Source of Life;
"The Mother of All Things;
"The Propagation of the Fertile Land;
"The Symbol of the Crimson Moon and Reproduction;
"The Destination and the Starting Point of Everything.
"I have just obtained some information about the 'Uncertain Mist' and want to report it to You, hoping that You can notice here and hear my report."
After whispering the prayer twice, Hobert felt that kind gaze. Suddenly, he seemed to be in a boundless wheat field, with a solemn and gentle gaze watching him in front.
This made Hobert slightly stunned. It was not surprising that the Evernight Goddess could respond to his prayers. After all, Hobert had prayed to the Goddess many times before, and had also begged Her for power and made sacrifices.
But Hobert had never sincerely prayed to the Earth Mother, nor had he asked for Her help. This was the first time he had prayed sincerely, and the Earth Mother had cast Her gaze!
However, Hobert was not surprised. After all, he knew more than once that the Earth Mother had invested in his father, and he should also have a special mark with Her.
At the moment, Hobert began to report some of the information he had obtained about the "Uncertain Mist" and Trunsoest, estimating that Auernia should have reported this information to the Earth Mother as early as the Fourth Epoch.
However, She should not be very clear about the relevant information about Eris.
At the end of the report, Hobert asked: "Respected Earth Mother, if I use the flesh and blood of Eris, and ask the Earth Mother's Archbishop to help me refine a body, and then use the corresponding power to temporarily 'graft' my own bloodline onto that body...
"Can the power of mutual attraction between the 'Uncertain Mist' and Trunsoest, and the power of bloodline, temporarily trap Trunsoest in that body?"
In front of Hobert, a gentle voice said: "The life form I refined can do this, enough to give you time to eliminate Trunsoest."
Hobert lowered his head, his face filled with joy: "Can you please help me refine Erebus's body?"
"Yes, find him, store a trace of his spirituality in the battle with him, pray for my help at the altar of the church, and release that trace of spirituality after I notice there," the Earth Mother explained patiently.
Hobert asked: "What price should I pay?"
"You don't need to pay anything."
Hobert thought he had misheard: "Don't need…"
The Earth Mother said again: "April will repay it together later."
Hobert was slightly stunned before asking: "Respected Earth Mother, may I ask if my mother is the vessel for your descent?"
"No."
"What is the connection between her and you?"
The Earth Mother smiled slightly: "Child, it seems you have already noticed this.
"When April is promoted to an Angel, she will recover all her memories, and then she will tell you the whole story."
Only then did Hobert realize that there were not small secrets about his mother, April. He suddenly thought, could his mother be Auernia? After she fell, she was saved by the Earth Mother, who was one of the six gods at the time, and then gave her a new body?
But now is not the time to think about this. Hobert asked again: "If I defeat Trunsoest who has entered that body, will the curse on the family be completely lifted?"
"Yes. Trunsoest only has one chance to be resurrected. When he is resurrected, he needs to gather the consciousness scattered in the bloodline together, otherwise he will immediately fall into a state of madness after resurrection due to incomplete consciousness."
Hobert was completely relieved this time. He finally asked: "What arrangements have you made on me?"
"That is the last insurance, a modification of your spirituality," the Earth Mother replied: "If all your plans fail, Trunsoest will not be able to completely replace you.
"You will coexist with him in this world."
This made Hobert think of Medici. He was psychologically unwilling to become that kind of spiritual chimera, but this was indeed the last insurance. In the mystical world, as long as you are alive, there are infinite possibilities!
Hobert said very politely: "Thank you for your answer."
The Earth Mother "hmmed" and the wheat field around Hobert gradually disappeared. He seemed to have "returned" to the Harvest Church.
Utravsky glanced at Hobert: "You really received the Earth Mother's grace!"
Hobert smiled slightly: "Praise the Earth Mother."
… …
"Forsaken Land of the Gods", City of Silver.
Following the knowledge he had obtained from The Fool, Derrick installed a huge light bulb on the cold, dark square and made corresponding waterproof treatment.
This move attracted many people to watch. So far, the "Six-Member Council" has not announced the matter of electric lights, so everyone does not know what Derrick is doing.
Some people even asked: "Is this going to tie something to that ball?"
He saw the wires and thought he was going to tie something, and the so-called ball was the light bulb.
Derrick smiled at the other party, but did not answer his question.
That person didn't ask any more questions, because it meant that what Derrick was doing now might need to be kept secret, so they were happy to take a look here. After all, there was almost no entertainment in City of Silver, and they would be very satisfied if they could watch a show.
After installing the electric light, Derrick started burning coal and operating the steam engine according to the operating instructions for the small generator.
This steam engine is not a traditional steam engine, it has a small turbine structure, which can better Exploit the heat generated after combustion.
As a large amount of steam entered the turbine, there was a "whooshing" sound inside, and finally the generator at the end began to operate, and its sound was a "buzzing" sound.
At this time, more people were attracted to watch the excitement. They curiously watched the operation process of the machine in front of them.
Because no one was driving them away, it meant that the Concealment level of what Derrick was doing was not high, so they were happy to take a look here. After all, there was almost no entertainment in City of Silver, and they would be very satisfied if they could watch a show.
According to the knowledge in his mind, Derrick felt that the generator was operating normally, so he pressed the pre-connected switch to energize the electric light.
The electric light in the square immediately lit up!
The people watching the excitement seemed to have suffered a huge shock in their hearts, and turned their heads stiffly, staring blankly at the light.
They rarely saw such bright light, and their eyes were very sore. Some even felt dizzy.
However, none of them looked away. They just stared at it, unwilling to miss any glimmer of light.
Derrick in the room was also shocked by this scene: Emperor... Mr. Emperor is right. The light of the electric lamp is indeed very similar to the sunlight produced by my ability. It, it is so beautiful.
Derrick wanted to praise the light bulb, but suddenly found that he had not learned many adjectives. In the end, his heart could only repeatedly utter words such as beautiful and bright.
More and more people were attracted by the light, and soon the square was full of people.
Suddenly someone knelt on the ground: "It is the Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord! The Lord's glory is once again showering upon City of Silver! He, He has not abandoned us!"
Many people knelt on the ground and wailed, praising the "Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord."
It had been too long since they had seen light here.
Derrick came back to his senses, and suddenly felt a little uncomfortable, because it was "The Fool" and His ally "The Creator" who brought light back to City of Silver.
But at the same time, he also knew that he could not tell everyone the truth at this time.
At this time, an elder of the "Six-Member Council" first praised the "Omnipotent and Omniscient Creator" with everyone, and then explained to everyone: "This is a new technology created by Derrick based on his ability! From now on, City of Silver has light!
"This must be the Lord's guidance to us, to not give up, to continue to find a way out, and to chase after Him along His back!"
Everyone was a little disappointed, but then they thought that this must be the Lord's guidance to them, so everyone was only slightly disappointed.
At this time, Chief Colin stood on the tall round tower, watching the bright lights dispel the darkness. A trace of a smile appeared on his stern face: "This is a good sign!"
Suddenly he felt some moisture on his cheeks. He wiped it and realized it was tears.
He looked at the electric lights in the square. Many years ago, when he had to kill his granddaughter with his own hands, he felt that he would never cry again.
But now Colin found that some unfamiliar emotions seemed to erupt in his heart, and tears kept flowing: "It must be... it must be that the light of the electric lamp is too dazzling."
In the following days, the square in City of Silver was always crowded with people. The patrol members had to stay under the lights for a while after returning, the people who finished a day's work had to stay under the lights for a while, and even the people who woke up from a sleep had to stay under the lights for a while.
Originally, Derrick was going to successively connect the electric lights in the training ground and the round tower, but because it required a temporary power outage, Colin ordered it to be postponed for a while.
Using these few days, Derrick taught several companions how to use electric lights and generators, as well as the knowledge of installation and maintenance.
No one ordered him to do this, but he knew he had to do it, lest he die in the exploration of the "Giant King's Court", and then no one would know how to use the electric lights and generators.
Subsequently, the team exploring the "Giant King's Court" finally set off. After leaving City of Silver, the team members looked back and could still see the bright lights. Immediately, they all showed knowing smiles, and their steps became more firm.
Not long after the team set off, a mutated rat suddenly appeared in the corner of the square. It hid behind a stone tablet and was not noticed by anyone in the square.
The mutated rat, about the size of a cat, glanced at the electric lights, stretched out a paw, and took out a monocle made of crystal from nowhere and put it on its eye socket.
The rat's eye socket couldn't hold the monocle, but the monocle seemed to be supported by an illusory force. Obviously there was no stress point, but it always hung in front of the rat's eyes without falling.
He said: "I feel the power of the sun, and I also feel the power of thunder and lightning. These two powers can actually be converted in this way."
He sighed: "Well, the structure of that boiler reminds me of some structures of Chernobyl.
"It seems that the outside world has undergone tremendous changes!"
When the mutated rat was about to turn back to the cave, he glanced at the electric lights in the square again: "It seems that in this gamble, I am going to win. Heh, I look forward to their performance."
He bet with other Amon avatars on which city in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" could find a way out without any help from Amon and his avatars.
For them, this was a very interesting game.
...
In recent days, Hobert has been inspecting his territory, constantly checking the construction work of the territory and the Southern Continent.
In order to speed up the progress, he often used his abilities to move some building materials.
This made Lawrence and others in Jeffery City feel Hobert's urgency about these construction works, so everyone began to go to the construction site and use their abilities to do what they could.
As a result, the process of building light and heavy industrial bases has been accelerated a lot.
In the eyes of the colonists, the Balk family was crazy. That was what slaves did, but they were willing to do such hard labor?
Hobert also brought Audrey to see it once. Seeing the tall buildings rising from the ground, and then looking at the low dwellings of the locals, forming a huge contrast, Audrey felt quite a sense of accomplishment.
The false accounts for the second batch of investment have already begun to be made, and it is planned to invest another 1 million pounds in the Southern Continent from the end of this year to next year.
This investment mainly has two directions. The first investment direction is to build infrastructure and public facilities, such as paving roads, building houses, building schools, building churches, building government residences, etc.
The second investment direction is to build several armories, large-scale research and development bases, and university campuses.
At the same time, Hobert has been following up on three things. The first thing is Xio's further investigation of the Aurora Order members. Currently, it is not known whether the Aurora Order has not noticed it, or whether they are brewing some action.
In short, Xio's investigation has not encountered any obstacles.
The second thing is to find Erebus. This guy has not appeared in people's sight again after being beaten up by the Lord of Storms.
Hobert thought of using the Tamara family's clues to find Erebus.
What he is very sure of now is that in Backlund, there is a Tamara family's "Chaos Hunter".
She has been lurking in Backlund, looking for an opportunity to strike again, but Hobert has been guarding against her before and has not given her such an opportunity.
So Hobert began to create opportunities for the other party, often taking a carriage to the power plant in the suburbs in the evening, because two power plants had just been built and were about to be put into production. Such inspections seemed very normal, but it was indeed a good opportunity for assassination.
If this still couldn't attract the other party out, Hobert planned to go to the suburban villa where they met before to eat barbecue skewers a few more times. This was equivalent to a blatant provocation.
Of course, this would also easily scare the other party away.
The third thing is to let the Balk family and the Theosophy Council elect members to manage the Divine Kingdom for "The Creator".
For now, Hobert can still handle the believers' prayers to "The Creator".
However, after the South Colson Beyonder Battle and the war to wipe out the Mountain God Church, Hobert realized the importance of battlefield communication!
Even in the future, when telephones are used on a large scale for communication on the battlefield, there is still the possibility of telephone lines being cut.
So, since it is in the extraordinary world, why not use extraordinary power to establish a stable communication network?
Then it would be great to use telephones in cities and prayers in places without telephones to solve the problem of information transmission!
In addition, some confidential information can also be conveyed to the target through this communication network.
These things are very cumbersome. "The Creator" can't do it, right? The key is that "The Creator" doesn't have the time right now.
Then several "Beyonder Switchboard Operators" must be needed to work in the Divine Kingdom.
Moreover, in the future, Hobert plans to put the supervisory agency in the "Nation of Disorder". If there is corruption anywhere, it can be reported directly through prayer.
Then "Divine Soldiers Descend" to investigate.
However, these people need to be cultivated slowly. At first, let the Balk family and the Demoness of Pleasure each elect one person, cultivate two people first, and then slowly strengthen the team of the Divine Kingdom.
However, Hobert encountered a strange problem in this matter.
Elliott wrote to him and asked whether the selected girl who "serves the Creator" was going to be sacrificed to the "Creator" in the nude?
Hobert thought to himself: "The Creator" also has a wife, okay! It's not to let them solve that kind of need.
But in order to create a sense of mystery, the specific information of the "recruitment" cannot be announced at this time. He only replied: No need.
And corrected: The main job is to help manage the "Creator's" Divine Kingdom.
The implication is that it is not as dirty as you think.
In order to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings, Hobert also specifically found Jonathan, a director of the Demoness of Pleasure, and explained to him that the people going to the Divine Kingdom were going to help manage the Divine Kingdom, and they had to go neatly dressed and bring their luggage.
So on October 5th, when "The Creator" received the two employees, he saw a witch wearing sexy underwear on the altar of the Demoness of Pleasure.
Hobert was stunned for a moment: Is this "neatly dressed"? Does Jonathan have a problem with his understanding? What he did is really... too good...
Hobert sat on the "Iron Throne" and smiled. It must be said that the witch's figure was really good, curvy and with delicate skin.
Taking a deep breath, clearing his throat, Hobert reminded himself that it was important to do business.
He opened the Gate of Sacrifice, "snatching" the witch into the "Nation of Disorder," making her stay in the hall for less than a second before "tossing" her down to the town at the foot of the mountain.
Then, the woman sacrificed by the Balk family was also made to stay in the hall for a short while before being transferred to the town.
Without Hobert's approval, the "Nation of Disorder" would immediately inflict severe corruption upon them.
However, after Hobert made corresponding adjustments in the "Nation of Disorder," the essence accepted them, just as the "Sefirah Castle" wouldn't pollute Hobert and the others if Klein were willing to hold a Tarot Gathering in the "Sefirah Castle."
…
The Balk family "sacrificed" Elliott's sister, Moira. She wore a solemn Fourth Epoch asymmetrical dress, with a complex and equally asymmetrical hairstyle.
Of course, she was very nervous about going to the "Creator's" kingdom, and Elliott was also very reluctant, but because she was a devout "Creator" believer, she was the most suitable to be "sacrificed" to the "Creator."
Amidst the clan leader and others' constant prayers, and Elliott's reluctant weeping, Moira saw a illusory bronze gate. When she came back to her senses, she was already in a magnificent hall.
She had never seen the style of this hall, which looked tall, wide, and bright.
And in the depths of the hall, there was a throne cast from swords, with a majestic and sacred figure sitting on it!
That was the "Creator."
Moira had just had this thought and was about to kneel when suddenly her eyes blurred and she appeared in a small town with a peculiar architectural style.
The surrounding scenery was very mysterious, with half of the sky being day and half being night.
Because Hobert had already controlled most of the land in the "Nation of Disorder," there were no forests or grasslands in the sky. Currently, only a clock tower stood out, a place that Hobert couldn't yet control.
Then, Moira saw the majestic, exotic-style palace on the mountain, as well as the beautiful, illusory mirror-like lake, a vast grassland, and forests and high mountains in the distance.
Of course, there was also the beautiful woman in revealing lingerie in front of her.
Moira suddenly felt a little insecure, because she was far inferior to the other woman in terms of appearance and figure.
Just as the two were about to greet each other, a male voice came from the direction of the town: "Ladies, I think Lawrence and Jonathan seem to have some misunderstandings."
Hobert strolled out of the town: "The reason I invited you two here is to share some of my work, and there's no other meaning."
"Well, let's do this, we'll create a simple changing room for you first. Change into some clothes that are easy to move around in, and then we'll talk about your work."
They had both seen Hobert and knew that he was the leader of the "Favored." Seeing a "familiar face" suddenly, the tension in their hearts dissipated a lot.
Then, they thought of the clan leader and the council members' instructions, and they were all a little embarrassed. It seemed that it was completely different from what they had imagined, and at the same time, they were very curious about the work they were about to face.
With a wave of Hobert's hand, four walls rose from the ground around them, forming a relatively spacious changing room.
The two ladies smiled at each other and began to search for suitable clothes from their suitcases, chatting and changing.
This witch was called Vina. After her sexiness was covered by her clothes, Moira discovered that she was only in her twenties, and her movements and expressions still had a hint of innocence.
This made Moira sigh. If they were really here to serve the "Creator," the Balk family simply couldn't compare to the Demoness of Pleasure Council.
After changing clothes, Moira loudly told Hobert outside, and the surrounding walls were removed.
Hobert was already sitting by a stone table by the lake, and there was a pot of hot tea on the table. Hobert poured a cup for each of them: "Come, sit."
The two ladies sat opposite Hobert somewhat restrainedly, and only took a light sip of their tea.
Hobert said seriously: "First, let's clarify one thing. The 'Creator' asked us to come to help him deal with some trivial matters, so unless there is something very important, don't disturb the 'Creator' in the hall."
Moira and Vina nodded immediately, especially Vina, thinking of her attire just now, it was really too embarrassing.
Then, Hobert's tone softened a little: "We've met before, no need to introduce yourselves."
He said to Moira: "Your younger brother, Elliott, is responsible for guarding Tortuga Harbor. He is my colleague and partner. He is also the first Balk family member I came into contact with."
Moira smiled and said: "Yes, my brother often mentions you."
Hobert then said to Vina: "During the previous defense of the Dock Island and the later Battle of South Colson, I saw you. I know that you cherish the Demoness of Pleasure Council, which is free from any restrictions and exploitation."
Vina was slightly stunned before saying: "Yes."
She didn't expect that Lord Hobert actually knew about her.
"From today onwards, we are also colleagues," Hobert continued. "I will pay you salaries and arrange vacations for you. Don't mistakenly think that you will have to stay here for the rest of your lives."
"Alright, let me talk about the specific content of your work."
The two ladies were slightly stunned. At this moment, they were sure that they were really here to work!

Hobert waved his hand, and stars emerged on the lake in front of them: "These are the prayers of the 'Creator's' followers."
These prayers mainly come from the west bank of Full Moon Lake. A large number of people on the west bank of Full Moon Lake have become mentally unstable because their spiritual bodies were previously ravaged by demons or members of the Aurora Order.
Hobert used "fight poison with poison," using the "Creator's" spiritual impact to dilute the previous effects they had suffered.
Roughly after the end of the South Colson battle, Hobert announced the "Creator's" honorific name to them, so currently, a large number of people on the west bank believe in the "Creator."
The people on the east bank basically believe in the Earth Mother.
After this period, Hobert consciously influenced the spirits of these believers, and their mental states have mostly returned to normal.
As for the "Creator's" blessed, those who have been marked, and the extraordinary believers, their stars are still in the pool in front of the Iron Throne and have not been moved here by Hobert.
In other words, the stars in this big lake are all prayers that Hobert simply doesn't have time to look at.
Hobert grabbed one of the stars, and it floated to the surface of the water. A scruffy middle-aged man appeared on the surface, kneeling on the ground and praying devoutly.
He prayed that he could get a new pair of shoes because a coworker had gotten a new pair of shoes and showed them off in front of him, which made him very annoyed. He also hoped that he could have a new pair of shoes and show them off in front of his coworkers.
Hobert smiled and explained: "Many of the prayers that appear in the lake are from people who were rescued from evil organizations by the 'Creator.' Their mental states are a little abnormal.
"For prayers like this with substantial content, you should put it over there. The 'Creator' will look at it when they have time."
Hobert raised his hand, and the star and prayer went to the center of the lake.
He was already preparing to have the officials in the factory area take care of these people's living needs. These workers also have wages and can be taken shopping to buy some new clothes and shoes and get a haircut and a bath.
Moira and Vina both nodded slowly. They roughly knew some of the situations on the west bank of Full Moon Lake through their respective channels.
What they didn't expect was that the "Creator" hadn't given up on these madmen either.
"Let's look at another one." Hobert said as he "grabbed" another star.
This star came to the surface of the lake, and this time, an old man's prayer appeared. His prayer was purely a greeting.
Hobert said: "You need to use the view granted to you by this lake to check the other person's physical and spiritual condition for this kind of prayer.
"If you find any problems, you should also categorize them and send them to the center of the lake. If there are no problems, let the star sink into the water.
"For example, this old man, although the color of his etheric body is a bit dim, that's because he's old, so you don't need to worry about it and just sink the star to the bottom of the lake."
Hobert reached out and pressed down, and the star disappeared.
Then he said to the two ladies with curious faces: "You don't have the authority to reply. Your main job is to help the 'Creator' filter these prayers.
"Consider this job as practice for you. In two weeks, according to the 'Creator's' order, an internal communication system for our organization will be established. Some information will be accurately transmitted through you to speed up the spread of information.
"Of course, that's for later. You should do the work in front of you first."
The two ladies felt that they had been exposed to too many new things today and couldn't digest it all at once.
Then Hobert talked about the precautions: "First of all, your work requires confidentiality. If someone asks about your work in the 'Creator's' kingdom when you are resting, the answer should always be: managing the 'Creator's' kingdom.
"Also, your current range of activities is only that ancient city, the lakeside, and the grassland over there.
"Also, do you see that hexagonal tower? Yes, that building. The 'Creator' has sealed an evil demon inside.
"If I'm not here and you hear any sounds from over there, pretend you didn't hear anything, otherwise, you will definitely die a horrible death."
Moira and Vina nodded quickly.
Finally, Hobert said: "Oh, right, you can go out and sketch the architectural style here. In the future, this architectural style will be forcibly promoted in the 'Creator's' domain."
The architectural style of this city, after Hobert's large-scale transformation, uses the style of ancient Eastern architecture, with reasonable layout, harmonious lines, and is very beautiful.
If Klein came here, he would definitely exclaim: Isn't this just the ancient city that can be seen everywhere in scenic spots?
Hobert asked: "Is there anything else you don't understand?"
Moira asked: "What are our working hours?"
"Eight hours a day for each person. If one person is resting, the other person will work 12 hours. One day off per week. You can discuss which day to rest." Hobert said: "The salary is currently 3 pounds per week, plus 3 merits."
They each asked a few questions about the job, and after Hobert answered them one by one, he taught them how to read the prayers and how to handle them.
Finally, he took them to their residence. At this time, their permission level was very low, and they could not get any contact with the outside world.
After observing them for a period of time, if they can calm down and work here, Hobert will consider giving them some permissions to facilitate their work.
Back in the "real world," Hobert's work and life continued. Currently, telephones have begun to be sold, and there are several stores in Backlund.
However, there are only people asking about them, and not many people are installing them.
On the other hand, many government departments have discovered the convenience of telephones and have begun to purchase them in small quantities.
Currently, for them, each department only needs one or two telephones to be enough. Departments are still used to sending people to negotiate any work between them.
Simple things are only contacted by telephone.
However, the "Earl's Light's" newly launched electric bell business is widely praised.
Before the appearance of electric bells, there would be a small hole the thickness of a water pipe in the wall between the master's room and the servant's room, with a rope connected in the middle. When the master pulled the rope, the bell in the servant's room would ring.
The servant knew that the master was calling him and would rush to the master's room as soon as possible.
No matter how small the hole through which the rope passed, the master had privacy concerns.
The electric bell can completely solve this problem. This hole can be directly blocked, and as long as the power is turned on, the electric bell on the servant's side will ring when the master presses the button.
For a time, a wave of replacing bells swept among the nobles and the wealthy.
Electric bells can not only be used in residences but also in offices. For example, there is also a bell between Hobert and the secretary, and there is also a hole in the wall, which can now be removed.
After that, electric bells began to become popular in high-end hotels, restaurants, and other places.
Hobert is not worried about the sales of telephones because he knows that there will soon be a buying frenzy.
After entering October, Backlund ushered in the first cooling of the year. After the weather cooled down, it was easier to form fog, and Backlund, which had just been refreshing for a few days, was once again covered in thick fog.
Hobert, as usual, was discussing the upcoming motor business with Todd at "Earl's Light."
Yes, the motor has already been developed by them.
In fact, when electric lights began to be sold, the research and development of motors had already begun. Recently, with the participation of the Church of Steam and Machinery, the progress of many research projects has been accelerated.
This includes motors. Originally, Hobert thought that at least next year would a prototype of the motor appear. He did not expect that it had only been a little over half a month since establishing a cooperative relationship with the Steam Church, and there had already been considerable gains.
Hobert smiled and said: "With motors, industrial production will usher in a new model. At that time, three power plants in the suburbs of Backlund will not be enough."
"If there are not enough power plants, we can build more." Todd said with some worry: "But the Steam Church suggests that we sell the technology of power plants to the outside world.
"I have long heard that many Backlund tycoons have found Archbishop Haydn, requesting the Archbishop to help introduce them and establish cooperation with 'Earl's Light'.
"They are all devout believers of the Steam Church. Archbishop Haydn should not be able to withstand the pressure."
"Then sell the technology to them." Hobert smiled: "Price it higher.
"By the way, these technologies can also be sold to people from the Intis Republic."
Todd thought he had misheard: "Mr. Earl, that is our core competitiveness!"
Hobert leaned back in his chair and smiled: "Of course, I know.
"You are so surprised only because there is one thing you have not considered."
"What?"
Hobert said seriously: "The future situation in the Northern Continent…"
Speaking of this, Hobert suddenly looked at the mist outside the window: "Look, they're here!"
… …
Today in Backlund is another day shrouded in thick fog.
Everyone has long been accustomed to such a scene. Public carriages run as usual, and pedestrians appear as usual in the streets and alleys of Backlund.
Some of them are in a hurry, chased by work; some are very leisurely, discussing the clothes and accessories they just saw in the department store.
Although it is not raining, gentlemen still wear wide-brimmed hats; vagrants still wander aimlessly; newspaper boys run through the streets and alleys, shouting today's news.
Suddenly, a strange sound appeared in the sky, making everyone look up anxiously.
The sound gradually became clearer, like a sharp screech.
Rumble ~
The sudden explosion finally made everyone understand what the sound was: the sound of bombs falling!
This was followed by screams and wails. The bomb had collapsed a shop, killing and wounding many. At the explosion site, some people were crushed by collapsed walls, some had a leg blown off, and some were covered in glass shards. The scene was too horrible to bear.
The crowd on the street immediately panicked, everyone running around like headless flies, looking for what they thought was a safe place.
Rumble ~
A bomb exploded in the crowd, instantly shattering the people around it. Shrapnel and gravel scattered everywhere, dismembered limbs flying and flesh and internal organs torn apart.
The shrapnel passed through several people before landing on the ground or lodging in someone's body.
Where the shrapnel passed, a layer of bloody mist appeared first, then the injured people fell to the ground, wailing. Many people who had been howling with full vigor in the previous second fainted in the next because of the blood gushing from their bodies.
This was just a corner of Backlund. Today, such tragedies were happening everywhere in Backlund.
In the Financial District and the Commercial Area, only a squadron of airships circled around. The main bombing target was the North Borough, where government departments were concentrated, as well as the industrial district and dock area, which were full of heavy industry.
… …
Inside the 'Earl's Light'.
Amidst the continuous explosions and shouts, Hobert came out of the office building. With a wave of his hand, he 'altered' the temperature of the fog, and the fog in the sky turned into a light rain that fell to the ground.
At the same time, the scene in the air was very clear. Todd and others who followed behind took a cold breath. More than a dozen airships bearing the flag of the Feysac Empire were circling in the sky, bombing towards the 'Earl's Light'.
These behemoths were so shocking to people's minds, like giant beasts devouring lives!
The light rain created by Hobert ended quickly, and the thick fog quickly blocked everyone's sight, and the airships 'hid' again.
Hobert immediately realized that today's thick fog was unusual and that a 'Weather Warlock' might be manipulating the weather.
His first thought was: The reaction speed of the Loen's angels is too slow!
But then he thought: That's not right, they must be very happy to have such a bombing, after all, as it stands now, if the Kingdom of Loen goes to war with the Feysac Empire, Loen has a great advantage.
This bombing allows the Kingdom of Loen to declare war on the Feysac Empire in the guise of righteousness. For the upper class of the Kingdom of Loen, this is a good thing!
In the blink of an eye, the airship bombing had reached not far from the 'Earl's Light'.
With a wave of his hand, Hobert 'distorted' the direction of the force, and the falling bombs suddenly flew back, rushing towards the airships that had dropped them.
Rumble ~
A series of explosions in mid-air produced a shock wave that pushed away the mist. Hobert saw that all the bombs had been detonated prematurely and had not damaged the airships.
Immediately afterward, the airships were obscured by the mist again, dropping bombs from difficult-to-defend angles.
Hobert raised his hand and made a fist, pulling it down. He 'distorted' gravity and 'tampered' with the attraction.
A 'creaking' sound of metal being 'pulled' to its limit suddenly rang out in the air.
Hobert felt an extraordinary force pulling against him. He smiled slightly and continued to exert force, constantly 'distorting' and 'tampered'.
The airships above were about to be unable to withstand it. If the tug-of-war between the two demigods continued for another four or five seconds at most, the airships would disintegrate!
At this moment, an employee not far from Hobert suddenly raised his hand: "Psychic Pierce!"
Hobert felt as if a hand had suddenly crushed his brain.
He staggered back two steps, somewhat dazed, and fell to the ground.
In the intense ringing in his ears, Hobert saw a female employee rushing towards him, a short sword with a green glow in her hand, stabbing towards his chest.
The whole process may have only taken a second, or perhaps less than a second. Before the surrounding people could react, the short sword had already reached Hobert's face.
Almost instinctively, Hobert 'distorted' his position, but his 'distortion' seemed not to work well today, only escaping a dozen meters.
The female employee chased after him in one step and stabbed at Hobert again.
This time, Hobert's brain finally cleared up a bit. He reached into his pocket with one hand, broke the seal of the '0-71' Disaster Porcelain Doll, and a mirror suddenly appeared in front of his chest.
He knew that the other party was very familiar with the abilities of the 'Disorder' or 'Distortion', and it would be difficult to avoid her attacks if he used these abilities.
Ripples rippled on the mirror, and the female employee's short sword was 'devoured' by the mirror.
Hobert looked at the other party, his face pale, and gave an ugly smile: "Orseya Tamara!"
He was sure that this was the 'Chaos Hunter' hidden in Backlund by the Tamara family!
In the past week or so, Hobert had been intentionally creating opportunities for her to kill him, but the other party was very patient and had not taken the bait.
He didn't expect her to suddenly launch an attack during today's outbreak of war.
Hobert was sure that the other party must have a Sealed Artifact that could hide spirituality and malice, otherwise Hobert would have been able to sense the threat from her in advance, and would not have noticed the other party's attack until she raised her hand.
These thoughts flashed through Hobert's mind, and his thinking became much clearer.
But recalling the Sequence 3 level 'Mental Pierce' he had received in an unprepared state, Hobert still felt a splitting headache.
Orseya did not respond to Hobert. She continued to attack, taking advantage of her advantage, and said: "It is forbidden to connect to the 'Mirror World' here." While stabbing at Hobert again.
After using this 'prohibition', she immediately realized that she could not completely 'prohibit' the connection between the surrounding real world and the 'Mirror World', but only made the corresponding operations relatively more complicated.
Hobert also did not use any more abilities related to the 'Mirror World'. He was somewhat embarrassed and flustered, and immediately 'distorted' the direction of Orseya's thrust.
As Hobert expected, Orseya's hand shook back and forth like a snake, but in the end, it still stabbed at Hobert.
Just as Hobert was very familiar with the abilities of the 'Arbiter' pathway, Orseya was also very familiar with the abilities of the 'Lawyer' pathway. She used the ability of 'Deprivation' to temporarily deprive Hobert of the ability to 'Distort', so her hand still found the correct direction in the end.
But just as the short sword was about to stab Hobert, she suddenly retracted her sword and took a few steps back.
Hobert secretly said it was a pity. He was already holding a 'Fate Siphon' talisman in his hand. Orseya's short sword looked like it was highly poisonous, and it must be the kind that could seriously injure even Sequence 3 Beyonders.
So Hobert planned to steal and exchange fate with the other party after Orseya stabbed him.
But Orseya must have noticed something. Even though Hobert was acting very well, she did not take the bait.
Hobert put away his embarrassment and panic, which curbed the other party's offensive and gave himself a chance to turn defeat into victory.
He was about to tell Todd and others who had come to help to hide, but Orseya turned around and ran.
It was not easy to lure the other party out, how could he let her escape?
Hobert made a gesture to Todd and the others, and chased after her without even having time to say a word.
Fortunately, because of Hobert's tug-of-war just now, the Feysac Empire's airships knew that there was a demigod here, so they bypassed the 'Earl's Light' and began to bomb in other directions.
Just after chasing out of the 'Earl's Light' factory, Hobert 'distorted' Orseya's intention, turning escape into charge.
Orseya seemed to have foresight and immediately 'imprisoned' herself. She was only standing still, but she was not retreating.
Hobert used 'Distortion' to distort space and took the opportunity to catch up. Orseya had just escaped the state of 'imprisonment', and clenched her fist and waved it down: "Execution!"
Hobert immediately felt as if a phantom rope was around his neck, and then the ground under his feet caved in, creating a deep pit. Hobert suddenly had the illusion of being hanged.
He immediately 'tampered' with his own gravity, making himself as light as a feather.
But he soon discovered that this would not work either, the feeling of being strangled was still there!
During this period, Orseya did not continue to attack, but chose to continue to escape.
Hobert immediately 'distorted' space, but even if his own position was distorted, the phantom rope was still there, still trying to hang him!
He wanted to 'bestow' the rope to a frightened stray dog on the roadside, but found that this extraordinary attack was targeted and could not be 'gifted'.
Even though it was very uncomfortable, Hobert's pursuit continued, and Orseya never left his sight. When Orseya seized the opportunity to enter the spirit world, she was also stopped by Hobert's method of 'distorting' space.
This feeling of being locked around the neck lasted for four or five seconds. Hobert's tongue was pulled out, and the bones in his neck were broken several times. The phantom rope finally disappeared.
Hobert 'bestow' the discomfort and pain caused by the attack just now to a street lamp on the roadside, and the street lamp burst instantly.
Looking at Orseya again, she was already one or two kilometers away in front!
The road beneath the other party's feet seemed to be receding backward, and in the time it took to lift a foot, they had already traveled dozens of meters, a speed not slower than "Distortion."
Explosions frequently echoed around, and the workers screamed in alarm, all running outside the factory, causing chaos on the road.
Fortunately, the Feysac Empire's fleet's primary target was the factory, and they did not bomb the workers.
Although the road was chaotic, it did not affect the two Saints' pursuit; their speed was so fast that the people around could barely see them.
And today, no official demigods were destined to come and stop them, or rather, those demigods simply didn't have the time to care about them.
In order to shorten the distance between them, Hobert "exploited" Orseya's ability, so that with each step she took, she would pull Hobert forward several hundred meters as well.
It was as if Hobert was hitching a ride, taking advantage of the other party's abilities.
Coupled with the speed of Hobert's own abilities, the distance between the two quickly closed by half.
But Orseya immediately noticed this, and with a wave of her hand, she "imprisoned" Hobert in place.
Hobert immediately "distorted" the concept of himself and the other party, and when that "imprisonment" attack was about to hit Hobert, it actually "flew" back.
Orseya made a downward chopping gesture, and the "imprisonment" floated to the side of the road like a ball, "imprisoning" dozens of pedestrians in place.
At this time, Hobert used the ability of "0-71" again, summoning mirrors to surround Orseya.
Their location was already far from the "Earl's Light," so Orseya's previous "Prohibition" had lost its effect.
Orseya "banished" the mirrors in front of her, creating a gap in the encirclement of mirrors, and continued to escape forward.
Hobert plunged into a mirror; Orseya's pupils suddenly constricted, and a mirror appeared on her retina. Hobert drilled out from her eye.
"Imprison!" Orseya imprisoned Hobert outside the mirror, and Hobert, who had just drilled to the shoulder, was immediately stuck.
He didn't wait for the "imprisonment" ability to end, but immediately drilled back into the mirror.
Almost at the same time, a figure flashed past a pile of broken glass on the side of the road, and Hobert drilled out from it.
Orseya raised her hand: "Deprivation!"
She could feel that Hobert's actions in the "Mirror World" relied on a high-level sealed artifact.
So she didn't try to "deprive" Hobert of his actions in the "Mirror World," but temporarily "deprived" the reflective properties of that piece of broken glass, so that it no longer had the concept of a "mirror surface."
As a result, Hobert was stuck again. He waved his hand in the air, "tampering" with the surrounding thick fog, causing the mist to condense into light rain and fall to the ground.
At this time, Hobert chased while freezing the light rain, and every step Orseya took, she had to pull her feet out with force. After only two steps, her shoes were frozen to the road.
Barefoot, Orseya ran while considering countermeasures. Without shoes, every step she took, the soles of her feet would freeze to the ground, and each time she lifted her foot, she had to tear up a large piece of the ground, which noticeably slowed her down.
This kind of "tampering" or "distortion" of natural rules is not what the "Arbiter" pathway is good at.
"Deprivation!" She had no choice but to temporarily deprive the surrounding water of its ability to condense into ice.
But Hobert had taken advantage of this series of operations to catch up.
Hobert chanted an incantation from behind: "Deception!"
Orseya realized that he had used a spell, so she pulled out her short sword again, first crashing through a wall on the side of the road to avoid the other party's spell, then facing Hobert, looking for another opportunity to escape.
At this time, Hobert had also drawn his rapier and thrust it out. He knew that his Beyonder abilities could easily be neutralized by the other party, so he simply used the rapier to attack.
Orseya smiled slightly, and the short sword in her hand stabbed towards Hobert. She also knew that if a "Lawyer" and an "Arbiter" were to fight with extraordinary power, they could easily be busy for a long time without achieving anything.
Neither of them dodged, and the intention to exchange injuries for injuries was very obvious.
Orseya didn't think she would lose; on the contrary, she felt that this was an opportunity to kill the target.
With a soft "puff," Hobert's rapier pierced Orseya's heart, but Orseya didn't feel her short sword pierce Hobert.
At this time, the short sword in her hand suddenly deformed and turned into her belt.
It turned out that she had not been able to avoid the "Deception" spell just now. Hobert had "deceived" her spiritual perception and vision, making her mistakenly believe that the belt was her short sword.
As a result, Hobert's sword struck Orseya, but she only hit Hobert with her belt.
Orseya dropped the belt and immediately retreated. At the same time, she felt the coldness of the wound, knowing that Hobert's rapier also had a mystical effect, so she planned to "imprison" the wound immediately.
At this time, the two were in a small dessert shop, and Hobert used the second spell: "Theft!"
Hobert "stole" three of Orseya's abilities, starting from "Imprisonment," and going back to "Deprivation" and "Imprisonment."
For the next two hours, Orseya would not be able to use these abilities!
Coincidentally, because the abilities of "Imprisonment" and "Confinement" were stolen at the same time, Orseya temporarily lost the ability to control her injuries.
"Exile!" Because of her spirituality warning, the injury caused by that rapier would be very dangerous if not treated immediately, so she immediately "exiled" the injury.
Having reached the Sequence 3 level of "Arbiter," she could already exile and imprison some abstract things.
"Tampering!" Hobert immediately "tampered" with the target of Orseya's "exile," causing a box of desserts on the counter to be exiled into the void.
Similarly, Hobert was also a Sequence 3, and also had the ability to perform abstract operations.
At this time, because of the bombing, the clerks in the dessert shop had already fled, but even if they were here, they would not dare to charge Orseya or Hobert.
Now Hobert was not in a hurry, intending to wear Orseya down, because the longer it took, the more serious her injuries would become.
"Execution!" Orseya realized that she had to get away first to have a chance to control her injuries, so she used the ability of execution again.
"Exploit!" This time Hobert was prepared, and used the ability of "Exploit" to change the other party's "Execution" ability from 5 seconds to 1 second.
A phantom guillotine appeared behind Hobert's neck. When the guillotine fell and Hobert's neck was cut in half, this "Execution," which lasted only 1 second, ended.
The ability of "Execution" is flexible and changeable. If encountering Beyonders below the demigod level, the "Chaos Hunter" would choose to directly execute the other party's spirit body.
Because at that level, the spirit body has not yet undergone qualitative changes, and the spirit body of a general target will follow the "Chaos Hunter's" "judgment" and die immediately.
But for Beyonders at Hobert's level, he would refuse to accept this "judgment," so the method of "executing" the other party's spirit body is of little significance.
Only "execution" methods such as hanging and beheading can cause substantial damage to enemies at this level.
Taking advantage of Hobert's "gifting" away his injuries, Orseya finally had a chance to escape.
This time Hobert didn't rush to catch up, but instead injected spirituality into the rapier and opened his mouth in Orseya's direction.
It seemed that no sound was made, but Orseya in front suddenly stopped, her whole body becoming stiff.
Hobert used the ability of the rapier "Language of the Dead." Orseya's spirit body had been injured just now, and at this time, it was attacked by the undead Beyonder power, and the injury suddenly worsened.
Orseya took a deep breath: "Attacking the spirit body is prohibited here!"
"Magnification!" Hobert didn't attack the spirit body, but simply magnified her injuries.
Orseya's face turned pale immediately, her lips turned purple, her whole body trembled, and she couldn't continue to escape.
Hobert was not far or near from her, seemingly not in a hurry to attack: "After you die, I will perform necromancy on you, and then find the valley where Tamara is hiding, and destroy it all!"
Orseya simply stopped running, and she smiled coldly: "Then I have to thank you for destroying the gathering place of that bastard and pervert."
Hobert was slightly stunned, but he then said: "I have always been curious as to why you always wore a veil before.
"Today I suddenly realized that there is a scar on your face, or you don't want people to see something, right?
"Hehe, your face now is not your own face at all!"
Orseya was obviously a little surprised: "After I die, burn my body directly, and don't look at my face!"
Hobert laughed loudly: "I will not only look at it, but I also plan to publish the appearance on your face in the newspaper, so that everyone knows what Orseya's face looks like!"
Orseya was very angry: "Death!"
She punched Hobert, but found that her whole body was stiff and her limbs were no longer under her control.
Hobert took advantage of the opportunity when the other party was angered: "Frenzy!"
Orseya's eyes were sometimes angry and sometimes worried, and she immediately fell into a state of "madness."
So Hobert held the rapier and stabbed Orseya in the chest again.
"Arrogance!" Hobert continued his mental attack, while the rapier pierced Orseya's left eye and finally penetrated her brain.
Then Hobert quickly retreated, and Orseya, as if having a nightmare, screamed and grabbed randomly a few times, finally stiffening there and not moving, as if she had been dead for a while and had become stiff.
Hobert immediately used the ability of "Travel," took the corpse back to his study, and then immediately sacrificed the corpse to the "Nation of Disorder."
It's likely the Tamara family already knows about Orseya's death, but their family's angels don't dare enter Backlund right now.
At this time, the angels of the Loen Kingdom are not stopping the Feysac Empire's air raids, not because they are too old to lift their swords, but because they have no intention of stopping them at all.
But if other angels come to Backlund, they will definitely take action.
Even if they don't take action, coming here at this time can easily cause misunderstandings and be seen as the Tamara family defecting to the Feysac Empire.
The Tamara family doesn't control secular power right now, and offending the Augustus family would be very detrimental to them.
Hobert boldly entered the "Nation of Disorder" and summoned the Sealed Artifact "1-110", which is comparable to the "Ferryman", to communicate with Orseya.
This level of spirit communication is no longer like before, where one enters a spiritual space full of gray fog, but can directly pull the target's spirit body out of the corpse for communication.
Of course, Orseya is definitely a high-level member of the Tamara family, and her spirit body must have been treated accordingly to prevent spirit communication.
That's why Hobert simply brought her to the "Nation of Disorder", which can effectively isolate some of the Tamara family's arrangements.
When he was about to pull out the other party's spirit body, Hobert said to Orseya's corpse, "Out of respect for the dead, I won't look at your face, but you must answer my questions well."
After speaking, he pulled out Orseya's spirit body. The moment it was pulled out, her face was erased, and there was nothing on her entire face.
Hobert asked, "Where is the valley where the Tamara family is hiding?"
Orseya replied, "In the Minsk Mountains, roughly on the border between the Loen Kingdom and the Feysac Empire."
"How to find it? Or how to enter it?"
"If you look for it from the ground, it will be difficult to find, but if you look for it from the air, you can see a tree trunk on the ground that is completely black. Walk around that tree three times and you can see the valley."
Hobert nodded: "Tell me what you know about the 'Uncertain Mist'."
Orseya replied, "That is an Evil God. Our faction has always refused to believe in Him, but the 'Uncertain Mist' has corrupted many members of our faction.
"This is why our leader compromised during the civil war back then. He no longer opposed family members believing in the 'Uncertain Mist', but family members should have the right to choose whether to believe.
"The last time I saw our leader, He told me pessimistically that the 'Uncertain Mist' is about to descend on the earth."
Hobert didn't expect that there was such a faction in the Tamara family. He first considered whether to take them for his own use?
But he soon felt that he should not consider this for the time being, unless they came to him seeking shelter, otherwise it would be better to turn them into Beyonder characteristics and cultivate forces loyal to him.
Hobert thought for a while and asked again: "Do you know where Erebus is hiding?"
"I don't know."
"Besides that valley, what other important strongholds does the Tamara family have?"
Orseya's spirit body replied: "There are three on the surface, one in the Gale Basin in the middle of the Hornacis Mountains, one in…"
Hobert raised his hand, signaling her to wait a moment before continuing to answer.
Hobert stretched out his hand towards the pool, and the surface of the pool surged, revealing a map of the Northern Continent.
Hobert said: "Mark their locations."
Orseya's spirit body looked at the map and seemed to poke it with her finger, and ripples began to appear in three places.
One in the Hornacis Mountains, the part within the Loen Kingdom; one in the northern part of the Eternal Night Plain in the Feysac Empire; and one on Damil Island.
"There is also a stronghold that I learned about unintentionally," Orseya said: "That stronghold is kept secret from the members of our faction."
As she spoke, another point appeared on the map, unexpectedly in the Aurak Archipelago on the west side of the Northern Continent.
"Alright, you can go to the underworld now." Hobert waved his hand, and Orseya's spirit body disappeared.
Then Hobert glanced at the short sword she had used before. It was a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, seemingly corresponding to the Sequence 3 "Pallbearer" of the "Planter" pathway.
The main ability is to harm the target with poison. It is not necessary to stab the target. As long as it is close enough to the target, the target can be poisoned.
Even a demigod, after being poisoned, will immediately become weak and unable to even stand.
In addition, as Hobert guessed, this Sealed Artifact has the ability to control spirituality, and the ability to temporarily make all his emotions disappear.
Orseya used this method to sneak attack Hobert at close range.
Perhaps because the ability of this Sealed Artifact is relatively simple, the negative effects are not great, and it is indeed very suitable for Beyonders of the "Arbiter" pathway who are good at fighting.
As for its origin, Hobert estimated that it should have been captured by the Tamara family during the "War of the Four Emperors".
Hobert named this Sealed Artifact "1-114" and placed it on the stone platform over there.
Accelerating the speed at which Orseya's Beyonder characteristics were extracted, Hobert took the corpse out, burned it to ashes, and buried it underground in the wilderness of the Backlund suburbs.
At this time, the Feysac Empire's bombing had ended, and as Hobert was about to return to the "Earl's Light", he saw the carriage of Georgina, the Chief of the MI9, drive into the yard.
Hobert smiled: "The royal family's reaction is quite fast."
The car door opened, and Georgina got out of the carriage and said to Hobert on the terrace: "Princess Alice invites you to listen to a symphony."
