chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 649: The Creator's Bomber
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert was slightly stunned when he heard Fors' words.
Although he hadn't actively contacted Dorian, why did he always feel like he had stolen something from The Fool?
After a brief thought, Hobert said, "You can invite Dorian to Longtail Island as a guest.
I will meet with him at the Governor's Mansion."
Fors nodded, "I will send out the invitation."
Since Fors had just advanced and needed to stabilize her state, Hobert chatted with her for a while before returning to Angel.
Early the next morning, Hobert got up early and began to put on the attire of a Loen Kingdom duke.
Today, he was to meet the Local Lord and the generals, and hold a grand banquet, so he needed to be as proper as possible in terms of etiquette.
Within the Duchy of South Balam, there were a total of two Local Lords, or rather, local nobles supported by the Loen Empire, and two generals.
However, there were more than a dozen people who came to see the Duke because, for the sake of balance, the Loen Kingdom also supported some smaller nobles and warlords.
This could effectively prevent any single noble or warlord from completely controlling a region, and it was also a warning to the agents: I can replace you at any time.
They were all very excited about this audience, after all, this was the Duke of the most powerful country in the world, a person with great influence in that country.
Before this, only two or three of them had met a Loen noble, and they had always yearned for Loen's high-ranking nobles.
In addition, the place Hobert chose to establish his capital also made them breathe a sigh of relief.
Because the Saint-Sern Basin had fertile land, the Loen Kingdom did not support any nobles or warlords there, but chose to immigrate people to this area.
Choosing to establish the capital in this inland region would not harm the interests of the nobles and warlords.
Some even thought that this Duke might not have great ambitions, but such thoughts only dared to be secretly entertained in their hearts.
At ten o'clock in the morning, the ceremony officially began, with music and officials responsible for etiquette.
The only thing that might not quite match such a high-level ceremony was the place of audience, which was the courtyard of the former command post, not very large.
However, the Local Lord and the generals had already found an excuse for the Duke: This must be Duke Hobert showing his martial side! That's why he wanted to summon us in the military camp.
Subsequently, the majesty and demeanor displayed by Hobert convinced the Local Lord and the generals.
They all knelt on one knee, scrambling to pledge allegiance to the new master of this land.
Hobert, however, smiled and said, "We can talk about allegiance later.
Please rise, everyone, let's just chat for a while."
Since this was a colony of the Loen Kingdom, the official language here was rune language, and these local nobles and generals spoke rune language very fluently.
In the subsequent casual conversation, they were all somewhat flattered, because this Duke actually knew some situations in their territories, such as the approximate scale of cultivated land, the types of minerals being developed, and so on.
This was a capability that previous Loen military officers and governors did not possess.
This psychological state was like a very insecure person suddenly realizing that they were being paid attention to.
They all showed the greatest enthusiasm in discussing the topics initiated by the Duke.
Soon the banquet began, and everyone sat down in Order of their strength, then all looked at the head of the table.
According to the etiquette of the banquet, Hobert stood up and gave a speech: "Today we had a very friendly meeting, and I can feel everyone's enthusiasm.
I believe that with our joint efforts, the Duchy of South Balam will definitely have better development!"
Everyone applauded enthusiastically.
Originally, they thought that the Duke would say a few pleasantries and the speech would be over.
Up until this point, the atmosphere of the audience was very good, and many nobles and warlords were preparing to return to their territories and lavishly praise Duke Hobert's calm demeanor and broad mind.
But Hobert's next words were the key: "But I did not come to the Southern Continent to chat with everyone, but with a mission from the Loen Royal Family!
"I know that there are no places here that sell newspapers from the Loen Kingdom, so I will personally announce to everyone: The Duchy of South Balam declared war on the Feysac Empire today!
"Starting this afternoon, the soldiers stationed in Angel will launch an offensive to the west, attacking the colonies of the Feysac Empire!"
Everyone was stunned.
Through their respective intelligence, they had successively learned that war had broken out on the Northern Continent, but they always felt that the war was very far away from them.
Of course, they also knew that as agents of the Loen Kingdom's colony, it was impossible for them to be completely uninvolved in the war between the two great powers, but they always felt that the Loen Kingdom would at most increase their taxes.
They never expected to also attack the colonies of the Feysac Empire.
After all, they were very clear about the combat effectiveness of their troops; they were simply no match for the Feysac Empire's colonial army.
In previous Loen colonial army attacks on the Feysac Empire's colonies, their troops had participated as auxiliary forces, responsible for logistical support and some cover missions.
The result was that even such tasks were messed up in various ways.
Some hoarded supplies, some deserted in battle, and some even mistook the enemy and fought alongside the Feysac Empire against the Loen army.
A long time ago, the Loen colonial army reached a consensus: it was perfectly fine for them to maintain Order in the rear, there was no need to participate in the war.
But the necessary statements still had to be made.
Several warlords immediately expressed their willingness to hand over most of their troops to Hobert's command.
For them, it was just a loss of some guns and uniforms, and they could just recruit another batch.
Hobert smiled and said, "You misunderstood my meaning.
I hope you will provide some support in other areas."
Everyone was slightly stunned, and instantly understood that it was still about money and food.
Everyone in the room gave it very readily.
For them, this money and food used to go to the Governor's Mansion, but now it was just going to the Duchy of South Balam.
Hobert seemed quite satisfied with everyone's cooperation: "I'm relieved that everyone is so proactive.
"In addition, there are two more things to announce to everyone.
First, I plan to establish an Outer Cabinet, which can participate in the Duchy's decision-making discussions, and propose some suggestions to the Duchy government.
The government's policies will also consult everyone's opinions."
Hobert's words were very misleading, making people feel that this Outer Cabinet was like a simplified version of a parliament.
However, Hobert did not grant the most important legislative power, and the legitimacy of this organization was entirely bestowed by Hobert.
If he wanted to dissolve the Outer Cabinet, this organization would immediately become illegal.
The local nobles and warlords all thought that this was the Duke binding their interests with the political interests of the Duchy, and they were, of course, very willing to participate in the top-level structure of the Duchy.
So when Hobert asked who was willing to join the Outer Cabinet, everyone eagerly expressed their willingness to join.
Hobert continued with a kind smile, "Now for the second matter!
"In Order to better integrate the Duchy's forces and strike at the Feysac Empire, all land, natural resources, and population within the Duchy will be nationalized!
"All of you are now members of the Outer Cabinet, and of course, you must support this national policy of the Duchy.
"Oh, by the way, members of the Outer Cabinet must always perform their duties in Angel, and no one can leave this city, otherwise it will be considered treason."
Everyone was stunned.
After seven or eight seconds, a local nobleman finally asked, "Your Grace, does all land include our private estates?"
Hobert smiled and said, "According to the new policy, everyone in the Duchy can only own one to five mu of cultivated land, depending on the situation, and even I am no exception.
"You can calculate the amount of land you can own in the future by multiplying the number of people in your family by 5, and any excess will still be nationalized."
The nobles all understood that this was also a move against their private property, and their faces immediately turned very ugly.
A warlord then asked, "Your Grace, if we have no land and no population, how can we feed our soldiers?
How can we maintain effective rule over our territories and stably supply you with gold and grain?"
"You don't need to worry about that; I will send people to manage all the territories of the Duchy," Hobert said.
"Once you become members of the Outer Cabinet, you will no longer need to pay me gold and grain."
The implication was: I can take it myself.
He then added, "Also, your families must also move to Angel City to supplement the city's population."
Everyone's hearts sank again; this was preparing to pull out the roots!
Another warlord said, "Duke Hobert, you might not be very clear about the situation in our Balana State.
Previously, soldiers and governors of the Loen Kingdom also wanted to directly control it.
"But they encountered problems such as language barriers and different customs, and often clashed with the local people.
"It's precisely because of this…"
Hobert interrupted him, "I said, you don't need to worry about this."
As he spoke, he released a portion of his demigod pressure, instantly making everyone present afraid to breathe.
Most of these local nobles and warlords were also Beyonders, some even Sequence 5, and they certainly knew what the pressure Hobert had just displayed represented.
After all, before this, there was also a demigod governor in southern East Balam.
Hobert withdrew his pressure on everyone and then asked with a smile, "Regarding the Duchy's new policy, who is in favor?
Who is against it?"
Some were terrified, some had not yet accepted the fact, and some were already considering how to resist.
So Hobert asked again, "Are you all mute?"
Only then did everyone seem to come back to their senses and say, "I agree, I agree!"
"This good national policy must certainly be supported."
"…"
Hobert nodded in satisfaction: "After lunch, have your trusted subordinates go back and report.
Before your families move in, you can all stay in this command post.
I will arrange your food and lodging."
As he spoke, Hobert clapped his hands, and the dishes began to be served.
This meal was very rich, with beef, lamb, seafood, and vegetables that could only be eaten on the Northern Continent.
Hobert found the lunch very delicious.
However, everyone else's mood was very suppressed.
They ate quietly, and sometimes, even after chewing the food in their mouths for a long time, they couldn't taste what they were eating.
Hobert finished first.
He drained the red wine in his glass and placed the napkin on the table: "What a pleasant lunch.
"Well, gentlemen, I wish you all an enjoyable meal."
After speaking, Hobert stood up and left.
The people at the table looked at each other, and at this moment, their thoughts were surprisingly consistent: they couldn't let this Arrogance Duke succeed!
…
With the affairs of the Duchy of South Balam temporarily concluded, Hobert gave Conrad and Donna a few more instructions regarding work, then temporarily returned to Backlund.
Next, he planned to raid the valley where the Tamara Family was hiding, as well as several of their main strongholds, to see if he could find Erebus there.
The reason he waited more than half a month after Orseya's death to attack was because Hobert had previously believed that this attack might require another Beyonder war.
After all, the strength of this Beyonder family was evident: two Angels, at least one Sequence 3, and Hobert guessed there should be two to five Sequence 4s.
Although their strength was not comparable to the Demoness Sect, they still needed to be dealt with carefully.
However, inspired by the airstrike on Saint Millon, Hobert suddenly had a good idea.
As for whether Tamara Family members would flee their habitat after realizing Orseya had been killed? Hobert had considered this point and believed the probability of these family members escaping was small.
After all, they had two Angels and currently a demigod's clone; they should be quite hopeful that Hobert would bring people to their hidden valley, as there was a high probability that Erebus would take the opportunity to corrupt a large number of Beyonders.
The Tamara Family would also Use their home-field advantage to strike at The Creator's Beyonder power.
Moreover, they had no way of confirming whether Orseya had betrayed the family after her death.
Hobert believed that now was the best time for a sneak attack.
In the early morning, Hobert glanced at the mist outside the window and used Travel to arrive at a wilderness in the northern part of Backlund.
Then he prayed to himself, sitting on the Iron Throne, holding the Black Emperor card and the Sun Scepter in his hands; while possessing a position similar to that of a King of Angels, his entire body was covered in golden-yellow armor, and a handsome golden-yellow cloak appeared on his back.
Hobert used his stars to step into the real world.
With a slight lift of the scepter in his hand, he infused spirituality into it, and two magnificent horses bathed in golden light appeared, standing docilely beside Hobert.
Behind them was the sun god chariot, made of gold; the chariot was not large, with a Guard reaching his abdomen in front, and two wheels burning with golden-yellow flames.
At this moment, the entire wilderness became extremely bright, as if a sun had fallen to the ground.
Hobert leaped onto the chariot and quickly ascended into the clouds, the two majestic horses galloping vigorously.
His new idea was: to drive the chariot to beat Tamara.
Even if he couldn't win, he could certainly escape.
The scenery on the ground was rapidly receding, and people along the way were somewhat puzzled, wondering if they had just experienced a hallucination? It wasn't even sunrise yet, but it felt like a sun had just sped overhead.
Hobert circled the Minsk Mountains several times, which made the Beyonders of the God of Combat Church and the Church of the Everight Goddess, who were confronting each other at the mouth of the Minsk Mountains and Amantha Mountains, notice the anomaly.
However, they all thought it might be the opponent's conspiracy or some trap, so they only noticed that the power of the sun over there was a bit off, but did not send anyone to investigate.
Hobert searched for more than twenty minutes, and his spirituality finally found the large black tree that Orseya had mentioned.
From the air, the black tree was only the size of a normal tree, and only its trunk was black; its leaves were not entirely black, making it inconspicuous in a vast forest.
Fortunately, it seemed to have some connection with the Order Wood, which allowed Hobert's spirituality to discover it once he was close enough.
Under True Sight, Hobert saw a dense mist pervading the valley not far from the large tree, and his spirituality told him that it should be where the Tamara Family was hiding.
He realized that by using the power of the Nation of Disorder and the Sun Scepter, he should also be able to forcibly dispel these mists, so he decided that to give the Tamara Family a greater shock, he would simply and forcibly disperse the mist in the valley completely.
Hobert first used the image of The Creator to send a signal to Lawrence, then came above the black tree, raising the Sun Scepter high.
The sun that had just risen on the horizon suddenly became extremely bright, and all the dazzling sunlight gathered on the Sun Scepter!
It was Hobert's first time controlling such surging power, and he felt somewhat overwhelmed.
He took a deep breath, trying to steady his mind, and guided the bright sunlight to its target.
From the sun in the sky, a very thick beam of light shot down.
Whoosh~
When this beam of light fell on the dense fog in front of Hobert, it even rubbed against the air, emitting a 'whoosh' sound.
At this moment, Hobert was also shocked by the power he had summoned; it was a beam of light like a 'light wall', covering the entire valley.
Its high temperature caused clouds of mist to swirl around it, making it look very ethereal!
Crack~
The black tree under Hobert's feet split open in the middle and immediately burst into flames!
...
The Theosophy Council led by Lawrence and the forces of the Balk Family arrived; their mission was to clear the battlefield and encircle and kill the escaping Tamara Family members.
But when they had just arrived, either by using corresponding sealed artifacts or with the assistance of Jonathan and others, they were completely stunned by the scene before them.
The enormous pillar of light deeply shocked their hearts, and some lower-Sequence members even had the urge to kneel and praise the Sun God.
When the huge pillar of light disappeared, they immediately discovered the source of this surging power: The Creator standing on the chariot emitting golden-yellow light!
Although this was different from The Creator's usual appearance, they immediately recognized that it was The Creator!
Lawrence and others successively drew corresponding symbols on their chests, praising The Creator's great power!
After being greatly shocked, Jonathan and others exchanged glances, lamenting that the Theosophy Council had found a powerful backer!
Then Jonathan sighed, regretting deeply that when he negotiated with Hobert back then, he had not fully pledged allegiance to The Creator.
This meant that they could currently only receive some protection from The Creator and occasionally participate in some less important operations.
In fact, they also very much hoped to participate in the development of the South Balam Duchy, which meant they would have the opportunity to become official Beyonder administrators of the Duchy.
That was not just as simple as having Helen's Beyonder team being Beyonders, but being able to participate in the Duchy's Beyonder decision-making!
Jonathan sighed, currently only able to place his hopes on Vienna, who had been sacrificed to The Creator, hoping she could move The Creator to fully incorporate the Theosophy Council.
Otherwise, they would only be able to follow the path of Hobert's two wives, having more members join the Witch Research association and the Traveler Research Association.
While Jonathan was lost in thought, The Creator in the sky drove the chariot forward, beginning a new round of offensive.
...
Hobert, on the sun god chariot, took several deep breaths, feeling a huge consumption of his spirituality.
Since becoming a demigod, it was the first time he felt that his spirituality seemed somewhat insufficient.
Hobert then realized that even if the Sun Scepter only possessed a slight essence of uniqueness, it was not something that Beyonders below the Angel level could control.
Fortunately, he also held the Black Emperor card; if it weren't for this Card of Blasphemy raising his position, that huge pillar of light just now might have broken free from his control.
Steadying his mind, Hobert drove the chariot forward.
The black tree had been dried and burned, and the mist in the valley was completely dispelled; not only that, but the pillar of light just now had scorched many plants, and many people who hadn't had time to hide were also dried into jerky, with their Beyonder Characteristics falling beside them.
Although the entire valley looked lifeless, Hobert was very clear that many Beyonders were still hiding in the valley.
After all, that layer of mist had consumed most of the light pillar's power, and only a little 'afterglow' had shone in here.
The scene here was similar to the psychical results Hobert had seen from Tamara Family members long ago: many villas with Fourth Epoch architectural styles were scattered throughout the valley, and on the mountainside, there was a magnificent temple.
The only difference was that the scene Hobert had seen before was filled with birdsong and fragrant flowers, while now the flowers and plants had turned into withered grass and trees, and the birds flying in the sky had turned into roasted bird meat, fallen to the ground.
Hobert drove the chariot unhurriedly towards the temple, and the Beyonders inside the temple also realized the danger; they injected spirituality into the magic array in the temple, and a dense mist was released from the temple's windows and doors, heading straight for Hobert.
Hobert smiled slightly, strengthened his connection with the Nation of Disorder, and directly absorbed the mist around the chariot.
The mist, illuminated by the light emanating from the chariot, swirled and enveloped Hobert, making him appear extremely sacred.
The Beyonders in the temple were all stunned; it was said that these mists contained extremely powerful corruption, which even deities dared not face directly.
How could this being in the sky not only be unafraid but also easily gain control of these mists?
In fact, Tamara had once instructed them not to Use these mists if The Creator attacked, because they would be useless.
Hobert's attack here today, driving the sun god chariot, had completely bewildered them, and they had not connected him with The Creator at all.
Hobert in mid-air raised his scepter, and dozens of huge, pure spheres of light formed around him, falling towards the ground.
Four of these light spheres exploded over the temple, releasing dazzling light that seemed to eliminate all the filth and gloom inside; the Beyonders inside had their bodies ignited and screamed as they ran out of the temple.
Many people even disintegrated directly under the strong light, leaving only a pile of dust.
The ground not far from the temple suddenly cracked open, and a male in his thirties with a sallow, somewhat sickly complexion rushed out; it was Pedi Tamara.
At this moment, he was the only Angel in the valley, and he had to temporarily resist the being in the sky for a while to create an opportunity for the surviving family members to escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 650 Game between Angels
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The "Light Orbs" that Hobert projected from the chariot were individual "Heat Haze."
Although their explosions wouldn't cause violent blasts that could collapse buildings, anyone illuminated by their intense light would essentially burst into flames or simply turn into a pile of ash.
As dozens of "Sun Flares" rained down, the valley where the Tamara family resided echoed with wails of anguish. Many people, engulfed in flames, fled in all directions, igniting even more fires.
The flames on their bodies were influenced by extraordinary power, making them difficult to extinguish. Crucially, the survivors didn't have time to help them; those who hadn't been exposed to the intense light scrambled to escape through the secret passages.
Although Pedi, the "Duke of Entropy," who had been hiding underground, had emerged onto the surface, he didn't dare to confront the "Creator" directly. He only dared to "distort" the landing points of some of the "Sun Flares" on the ground.
However, this distortion had limited effect. After exploding, the light radiated in all directions, harming anyone who was exposed to it.
Immediately afterward, countless sacred rays of light appeared around Hobert. These rays gradually intensified, shining down on the ground. These intense beams seemed to refract, not only penetrating into the houses but also entering the underground through the entrances of the secret passages, as if they could turn corners.
Throughout this land, it seemed that all shadows had nowhere to hide.
These rays "caught up" with the Tamara family members who were fleeing through the secret passages, and the light immediately became scorching hot, igniting them one by one.
Pedi tried his best to "distort" these beams of light. After most of the beams were distorted and shot elsewhere, they would curve back and continue to shine in their original direction.
Realizing that none of his family members might escape, Pedi immediately used the method of "distorting" space to leave.
But when Pedi appeared dozens of kilometers away, he found that the sun was still shining brightly overhead. He looked up at the sky and saw the chariot with golden light following him, still above him.
Moreover, Pedi saw that the being in mid-air was holding a pure white spear.
He quickly "distorted" the distance again, continuing to move away. But when he reappeared, the being on the chariot was still above him, and that spear had already left his hand, shooting towards him.
Pedi knew that he couldn't avoid this strike by "distorting" the distance, so he used the power of "Chaos" to tear open the space in front of him, exposing the Spirit World. The Spirit World and the real world merged, and space fell into complete chaos.
However, that "Unshadowed Spear" was like a thin needle, "piercing" the seemingly wrinkled space, as if it hadn't been affected by the chaotic space at all.
Pedi's expression was solemn. Just as the "Unshadowed Spear" was about to pierce him, he suddenly "altered" his body, and an adult instantly turned into the size of a palm.
The "Unshadowed Spear" actively adjusted its posture, but because the distance was too close, it couldn't change its trajectory. In the end, it grazed Pedi's hair and plunged into the ground.
Boom!
The "Unshadowed Spear" cracked open, emitting dazzling rays of light that swept around.
Pedi immediately "altered" his thickness again, becoming like a palm-sized paper figure, nimbly dodging those rays, and thus avoiding being hit.
At this moment, Hobert in the sky had already launched a new attack. Seven small orbs of light surrounded his staff, which seemed to be made of gold.
The orbs of light left the staff one after another, flying towards Pedi.
Pedi's body had now returned to its normal size. He "magnified" the chaotic space from before, extending the chaotic space for dozens of kilometers, and even those orbs of light almost fell into the quagmire-like space.
But those orbs of light still broke through the chaotic space and surrounded Pedi.
Pedi immediately used his ability of "Exploit" to end the duration of these orbs of light prematurely.
The orbs of light, which could originally last for several seconds, now only lasted for one and a half seconds. They immediately emitted a scorching light, as if seven suns were surrounding Pedi, baking his body and soul.
Pedi immediately "distorted" his position with a stone on the ground. When the stone appeared in his place, it immediately turned into stone dust.
The seven "little suns" were about to continue chasing him, but halfway through, they quickly dimmed and disappeared without a trace.
Pedi stared at the place where the orbs of light disappeared for about half a second. He always felt that the opponent's attack should be more than that, but of course, he didn't know what the follow-up attacks were.
Now he couldn't care less about exploring the truth, because he also had his own plans.
Pedi "tampered" with the boundary between the real world and the Spirit World, making that chaotic area even larger!
Hobert raised his scepter and pointed it at the sun on the horizon.
The sun suddenly became huge, covering most of the sky. The intense sunlight and various harmful rays made Pedi feel like he was about to be melted by the dazzling light.
At this moment, Hobert, his chariot, Pedi, and the surrounding bright space, this area was suddenly very close to the sun, roughly the distance between Mercury and the sun.
Some faint blue flames appeared in this space. It was hydrogen in the air burning! The high temperature of the sun caused the hydrogen in the air to spontaneously combust.
The premise of this large-scale, high-intensity attack required the surrounding area to be bright enough, so Hobert's previous two rounds of attacks, while preventing Pedi from escaping, were also preparing for this ability.
"Ah!"
Feeling that his spirit body was suffering, Pedi couldn't help but shout. While altering the intensity of the sunlight, he hurriedly took out a sealed artifact from his pocket and injected spirituality into the chaotic space in front of him.
Immediately, a creature with a very hard shell appeared in the chaotic space.
It looked a bit like a giant conch, but at the tail of the conch, in addition to some crab-like, hard-shelled feet, there was also the upper body of a blood-red human.
Its appearance caused the surrounding ground to turn into a pool of mud. Bubbles emerged from this mud, and each bubble burst, emitting an evil sound, as if it were a vicious curse on the real world.
It seemed that the surrounding air immediately became evil.
This was a Beyonder from the Tamara family's "Door" pathway, accidentally discovered in the Spirit World, a guy who had suffered strange corruption.
It seemed to correspond to Sequence 2 "Ancient Bane" of the "Prisoner" pathway, but because the unknown corruption it suffered was very special, it took on the appearance of a sea monster, but it itself did not have the abilities of the "Sailor" pathway.
To summon it, a large area of chaotic space and a sealed artifact containing its blood were required.
At this time, Pedi's spirituality had realized that this mysterious being driving the golden chariot was the "Creator"!
Pedi at this level knew some information about the "Creator." He roughly knew the connection between the "Creator" and Eris, so the "Creator" was not afraid of the corruption of those mists, but he believed that the "Creator" should not have much resistance to the corruption of other pathways.
So Pedi spent so much effort to summon this "Conch."
Faced with the bright sunlight, the "Conch" quickly retracted into its shell, and then its shell sprayed black liquid in all directions.
Hobert's spirituality felt that these liquids were very dangerous, so he ended the maintenance of the giant sun and immediately climbed to a high altitude to avoid them.
The sun in the sky quickly shrank, returning to its normal size after two or three seconds.
At this time, Pedi, whose spirit body and physical body had been hurt by the scorching sunlight, used this gap to escape.
Soon Hobert's spirituality could no longer sense his existence, and the "Conch" that had been summoned, after spraying some black liquid, used the chaotic space between the real world and the Spirit World to hide back into the Spirit World.
Hobert did not stop it, because he realized that the corruption emanating from this "Conch" was something he could not solve now.
The black liquid sprayed by the "Conch" had already polluted the surrounding land. The plants that had been scorched dry grew eyes without eyelids, or tongues with sharp teeth.
Taking advantage of the fact that the chaotic space created by Pedi had not disappeared, Hobert immediately used "Distortion" to send that piece of land into the Spirit World.
Then he immediately used the ability of "Exploit" to accelerate the speed of spatial recovery. In the end, only a large pit with a diameter of more than ten kilometers and a depth of three or four kilometers was left on this battlefield.
Hobert drove the chariot to the next "bombing point," and once again used dozens of pure orbs of light to "bomb" the Tamara family's other four strongholds, including the secret stronghold provided by Orseya.
Although it wasn't bombing with bombs, the effect was better than bombs. These strongholds all turned into a sea of fire, and the casualties were heavy.
But unfortunately, Eris was not encountered in these strongholds, nor was Tamara encountered.
Somewhat disappointed, Hobert drove the chariot back to his physical body and ended the summoning.
Returning to the real world, Hobert immediately used "Travel" to rush to the valley where the Tamara family had previously hidden.
In the Spirit World, Hobert recalled the attack of the "Sun Scepter" just now. Its level and power were probably a little higher than Sequence 2, but it had not reached the level of Sequence 1.
For Hobert at the moment, this was already very good, because this was a real attack at the angel level, unlike attacks using the "Nation of Disorder," which looked very powerful, but were actually difficult to harm enemies at the angel level and above.
It was necessary to use sealed artifacts to have a good attack effect.
At this time, he arrived at the location he had just marked, left the Spirit World, and came to the real world.
The fire in the valley had been extinguished by Lawrence and others using Beyonder abilities. The Balk family was recovering Beyonder characteristics and rounding up enemies hiding in the shadows, waiting for a chance to escape.
But so far, they have not found any survivors.
The power of the "Sun Scepter" seemed to be all-pervasive, able to illuminate any dark corner, no matter where it was hidden.
Hobert inquired about the situation with Lawrence and was about to join the search party when his spirituality sensed something. He saw a simply dressed woman in a long robe, with a bark belt around her waist, and bare feet in the distance.
The appearance of this woman reminded Hobert of the scene when he was at the bottom of St. Samuel's Cathedral and was glanced at by the Evernight Goddess, after which he gradually disappeared.
It's just that at that time, he seemed to be erased by a rubber, while this woman appeared little by little.
In addition to the other party's attire, Hobert roughly guessed who the other party was, so he bowed slightly and said, "Your Eminence Ma'am Arianna?"
This woman was none other than Arianna, the Matron of the Evernight Cloister, the head of the thirteen archbishops, and the "Servant of Concealment."
He was not surprised that Hobert recognized him: "What just happened here?"
Just now, Arianna reported to the Evernight Goddess about the sudden strong light that appeared here. The goddess's response was: There is no danger.
That's why He came to check it out.
As for Hobert in front of him, Arianna often saw his name in some reports, and also knew that he was a follower of the goddess, so he didn't bother with formalities and asked his question directly.
"Your Highness." Hobert maintained sufficient politeness to an angel: "After a long period of investigation, we learned that this is the hiding place of the Tamara family.
"So the great 'Creator' launched an attack here. Now that the attack is over, we are cleaning up the battlefield."
"Just call me Madam." Arianna saw that the surroundings had basically become ruins. This seemed to be the ability of the "Sun" pathway, but He did not ask about it, but instead asked: "How was the result of the battle?"
"This raid killed a large number of middle and low sequence Beyonders on the other side." Hobert replied, "Currently, only one Beyonder characteristic at the demigod level has been seized."
The enemy's high-end combat power didn't seem to suffer much loss, but the Tamara family almost lost most of their potential, because the large number of middle-sequence Beyonders who were the backbone of the organization meant that the organization would lack stamina.
Once the high-level combat power is lost, it will be difficult to make effective supplements.
Arianna slowly nodded: "This family was not very active in the extraordinary world in the first place. From now on, I guess they will disappear for a while."
Hobert said: "Not necessarily. As far as I know, they have established a connection with an evil god. Under the influence of that evil god, they are likely to do something crazy."
Arianna said: "I have read the relevant reports you provided, and we are also paying close attention to this, but..."
But now is a state of war, and the Church of the Evernight Goddess can no longer take care of these things.
Speaking of this, Arianna waved his hand: "Good luck to you, and may you seize more items at the demigod level."
"Thank you." Hobert watched the other party leave before he thought that the Darkness pathway seemed to only have the relevant abilities of "Misfortune", right? Will the blessing of this "Servant of Concealment" really bring good luck?
Fortunately, before long, a Sealed Artifact at the demigod level was seized, which relieved Hobert.
This valley is the ancestral home of the Tamara family, and their accumulation is almost all here.
And Hobert's attack just now was so swift that it didn't give them a chance to transfer those savings at all.
So they found more than one warehouse, with many gold, gems and other valuables.
There are also many sealed items, especially level 3 sealed items. The accumulation of this kind of millennia-old family is very rich, which greatly alleviates the shortage of level 3 sealed items in the "Creator" forces.
Generally, level 3 sealed items come from various extraordinary events with not very high levels. Only organizations that have existed long enough can collect many level 3 sealed items under various coincidences.
And level 3 sealed items are applicable to the widest range of people, which can greatly improve the combat effectiveness of the bottom-level Beyonders of a Beyonder organization.
Compared with this kind of Beyonder family with a long history, the "Creator" forces still lack sufficient accumulation time.
But soon Hobert found that he couldn't find the place where they stored Beyonder characteristics.
It stands to reason that a family like this should have Beyonder characteristic reserves, and with almost no one escaping, these reserves should not have had time to be taken away.
But Hobert quickly began to calculate how to use those gems, and did not continue to consider the problem of Beyonder characteristic accumulation.
According to the information Hobert obtained, there should be a "Wanderer" from the Abraham family in the Tamara family.
These gems should have been collected by Beyonders of the "Door" pathway. It is said that they love all kinds of gems very much.
The seized gems can be used to lay out teleportation arrays, which can save a lot of costs.
Finally, the members of the Balk family separated the spoils from some of the wealth and piled them together, and then established the "Traveler's Gate" to temporarily store them on Longtail Island.
Hobert went to several other strongholds, where Angus, Elliott, Helen, and Pix's troops were already cleaning up the battlefield.
The spoils there were relatively meager, with only some Beyonder characteristics.
When Hobert heard that a lot of gold pounds stored in safes had been burned, he secretly felt sorry in his heart, but it was not easy to show it.
In this way, this raid achieved victory without a single death in the "Creator" forces.
After spending a morning cleaning up the battlefield, the various departments withdrew in an orderly manner.
Hobert was very happy. He felt that this tactic was very useful against secret organizations, and he could replicate such a battle example in the future.
But the members of the various extraordinary troops were not happy. They originally wanted to take this opportunity to earn more merits, but as a result, they just searched the battlefield.
Occasionally, they could encounter an enemy, but dozens of people besieged him alone.
Not only were the enemies desperate, but the members of the extraordinary troops were also desperate.
According to the relevant regulations of the "Creator" forces for counting merits, so many people killing one person will not amount to much merit when divided.
Hobert timely noticed that everyone's emotions were relatively low, and told everyone that there would soon be a Beyonder war in the Duchy of Southern Balam, and distributed more merits, which somewhat restored morale.
That night, after counting the spoils, there were 92 Beyonder characteristics of the "Lawyer", "Arbiter", and "Apprentice" pathways, and many sealed items of various types.
There were also a large number of wealth seizures, with the total value of gold, gems, and some antiques adding up to about 800,000 pounds.
Hobert, who was no longer worried about money, commented shamelessly in his heart: This family is very poor!
There was naturally a celebration banquet in the evening, and Hobert sat with Lawrence, Angus, and other officers of the troops.
Lawrence talked about his discoveries while cleaning up the battlefield: "I found many corpses with facial tattoos in some villas.
"This reminded me of some records I saw in the family's notes. If I guessed correctly, the Tamara family is still using some systems from the Fourth Epoch.
"They should still be raising slaves of various pathways, such as bed slaves, jesters, handymen, etc. Slave owners will tattoo some different humiliating patterns on the faces of slaves for different purposes."
This surprised everyone and made them feel that such a slave system was very novel.
Hobert also recalled some information he had seen: "In the Fourth Epoch, raising slaves was still legal. It is said that there were also some Beyonder slaves at that time, and they basically came from prisoners of war.
"In fact, raising slaves has become illegal on the surface now, but slaves have always existed, especially in the Southern Continent. I heard that in some markets, slaves are sold together with cattle and horses."
Speaking of this, Hobert suddenly recalled Orseya. She had always worn a veil, and when Hobert defeated her, she preferred to wear a human skin mask to die.
…
In the suburbs of Locklear City, in the villa where the Balk family was stationed.
Three Beyonders formed a patrol team, patrolling the courtyard and the first floor on a daily basis.
The patrol team came to the villa hall along the route, where a permanent altar dedicated to the "Creator" was built.
The four corners of the altar have exquisite patterns, and there are also marble steps, which look very solemn.
There are no sacrifices at this time, and the altar looks empty.
There is nothing to patrol around the altar, because there are basically no dead ends.
Just as the patrol team was about to go out through the back door, a violent whirlwind suddenly blew up on the altar, shaking the doors and windows violently, opening and closing constantly.
The patrol team was stunned, and then they realized that it seemed that some existence was "bestowing" something on the altar.
According to normal procedures, "Walls of Spirituality" would be built before the "bestowal" ceremony, so that the gale generated by the ceremony would not spread beyond the altar.
Just as the three Beyonders reacted and were about to blow the whistle to warn, a phantom door seemed to open above the altar, and a figure jumped out of the phantom door and landed steadily on the altar.
This figure was in his twenties, with long hair combed into a very beautiful hairstyle, and some freckles on his cheeks. It was actually Moira!
The members of the patrol team thought they had seen it wrong. Wasn't Moira dedicated to the "Creator"? How did she come back?
Before they could speak, the tall figure of Lawrence appeared on the second-floor terrace: "Moira! You… Doesn't the 'Creator' favor you?"
By the end, Lawrence's voice was trembling slightly.
During this period, due to some work-related interactions, he had contact with Helen's team of Beyonders, which made him realize the difference between Moira, who was offering sacrifices to the 'Creator,' and the witches. Because of this, he had been uneasy for days.
Now, with Moira suddenly appearing on the altar, Lawrence was instantly filled with apprehension.
"Chieftain, we were all mistaken." Moira descended from the altar, carrying a wooden box: "The 'Creator's' divine kingdom is vast. Previously, only the 'Favored,' Hobert, was managing it. Now, he doesn't have time to manage it anymore, so he asked us to help."
Lawrence opened his mouth, even more surprised than before.
Moira continued: "Today is my day off, so I came back. In the future, I'll probably have a day off every seven or eight days.
"Oh, right, the 'Favored,' Hobert, asked me to tell you that recently, a few more Beyonders might be needed to work in the 'Creator's' divine kingdom. He hopes you'll make some preparations."
Lawrence paused for two or three seconds before nodding: "Okay, okay."
To be honest, he was even a little tempted to go and see the 'Creator's' divine kingdom.
