What Hobert didn't expect was that Audrey would be promoted again so quickly.
Originally, she could have waited a bit longer to stabilize her condition, but the war gave her a considerable sense of urgency.
So, after preparing for a few days, Audrey attempted to advance to Sequence 5.
Actually, Hobert was the one mainly helping her prepare. The Beyonder characteristics used for the advancement were from Hobert's old stock, one of which was seized from Hvin Rambis, a council member of the Psychology Alchemists.
There was also a Beyonder characteristic of a "Dream Weaver." He had forgotten where he had seized it from, seemingly from Archibald, or perhaps from Adam's island.
Now, Hobert no longer keeps track of Beyonder characteristics below the demigod level. Generally, when sacrificing to the "Nation of Disorder," he casually tosses them onto the stone platform.
He can search for them again when needed. Anyway, Hobert's spirituality is very sensitive now. Even if he doesn't keep track of the Beyonder characteristics, his spirituality will give him some hints when needed, and then he can search for them in the "Nation of Disorder."
As for the auxiliary Ingredients needed for the advancement, it was easy for Hobert, who had two Beyonder auction houses, to obtain materials of that level.
Audrey realized that the only thing she could do was to ask Mr. Fool to help her stay awake in the dream.
This was the ritual for advancing to Sequence 5.
Still under Hobert's care, Audrey consumed the potion and then stood there like a stone statue, motionless, for two or three minutes. It seemed that her soul had returned to her body, with some trembling or changes in expression.
After another two or three minutes, Audrey used "Placate" and "Psychological Cue" to quickly stabilize her condition: "It's not as difficult as I imagined."
Hobert smiled and said, "That's because your potion is digesting well, and you did a lot of psychological suggestion before taking the potion."
Relatively speaking, this pathway is easier to maintain a good state.
Audrey nodded and shared the process of her advancement with Hobert: "So, the purpose of that ritual is to prevent me from getting lost in the dream."
Hobert reminded her, "Even though you are now a 'Dream Weaver,' you still need to be careful when you are in a dream. If you accidentally jump into the dream of a Beyonder being who is not in a good state, you will also be affected."
If she encountered a very dangerous dream, Audrey's spirituality should issue a warning to prevent her from entering such a dream.
The worry is about dreams that are not very dangerous but can still have an impact.
Audrey noted Hobert's reminder and then discussed her abilities with Hobert.
Hobert shared his views: "The 'Spectator' pathway's abilities are not suitable for direct combat with enemies. It is more suitable to hide and quietly influence the target's state, and then suddenly attack and kill the opponent when the time is right.
"Practice 'Hypnosis' more often, or practice 'Psychological Cue' in dreams. After all, you are a 'Dream Weaver,' and your abilities may be more effective in dreams."
Audrey nodded: "I understand."
The two discussed the issue of Beyonder abilities for a while, and then went to the restaurant together for a meal.
As with the last advancement, this time Hobert was supervising Audrey's advancement while visiting Earl Hall's mansion.
During the meal, everyone first discussed the current war situation.
Currently, the situation is still optimistic for Loen. The only thing that worries the parliament and the government is that a large number of large-caliber artillery and a huge number of heavy machine guns were used in this battle, causing a large number of casualties among the soldiers on the front line.
These weapons were not used on the battlefield for the first time, but before, they were basically used on the battlefields of the colonies.
How could the warlords and local kings of the Southern Continent be a match for the colonial army with such advanced weapons? And the battles between the colonial armies are generally not large in scale, and basically will not form the current artillery attacks.
Both sides' higher-ups were a little dazed by the current casualties.
But at the same time, they are doing their best to put more soldiers and weapons into the battlefield, hoping that the opponent will be unable to support it first.
The last time a large-scale war occurred in the Northern Continent was hundreds of years ago, when the Feysac Empire and Loen fought for Sonia Island.
At that time, there were no such powerful cannons. This war is equivalent to testing the achievements of the industrial revolution and technological development over the past 100 years.
According to incomplete statistics, the war has only been going on for about a month, and the casualties on Loen's side alone have exceeded 400,000!
The Feysac Empire, as the attacking side, must not be doing any better, but because both sides still have great war potential, the battle is still very anxious.
Earl Hall estimated that the war may last until November before the first stage of the battle can come to an end.
At that time, more than one-fifth of the soldiers on both sides will have been killed in battle, and they will need to wait for the new recruits from the rear to be sent to the front before they can launch a new offensive.
Then, of course, they talked about the situation in the Southern Continent. Earl Hall asked Hobert: "I heard that the situation in the Duchy of South Balam is a bit unstable?"
"To be precise, it is very chaotic." Hobert smiled and said, "The local kings and warlords are unwilling to hand over their territories and rule, and a civil war may break out in the Duchy of South Balam."
Hibbert asked Hobert: "Is this your plan?"
If it had been before, he would have thought Hobert was crazy, but after experiencing the commercial war in Backlund before, he realized that Hobert's way of thinking about problems was different from his own, or from most people's.
"That's right." Hobert said seriously: "If a country does not go through a war to eliminate all the original interest groups at the beginning of its establishment, then in the years that follow, the country's internal affairs will most likely only be able to compromise and shirk responsibility.
"If there is profit to be made, it doesn't matter, everyone will be very harmonious on the surface, but once the profit is not so high, in order to compete for profit, there is a high probability that a civil war will break out.
"So, in my opinion, it is better to have a civil war at the beginning of the founding of the country, so as not to complicate the situation."
Earl Hall commented: "This is a good idea, although this idea is somewhat different from some contemporary ideas."
Hibbert also nodded slowly. According to the education he had received all along and the experience he had gained from practice, politics seemed to be a process of mutual compromise.
But listening to Hobert's meaning, he didn't seem to intend to make any compromises in the Duchy of South Balam.
Hobert smiled and said: "It can only be said that the situation is different, and the way to solve the problem is also different."
This conversation ended here, because Earl Hall and Hibbert realized that the strategies emphasized in Loen's political circles were completely different from establishing a country.
After dinner, several people took a walk in the garden as usual.
Audrey asked in a low voice: "Hobert, will the civil war kill many people?"
"Some Beyonders may die." Hobert replied: "But not many ordinary people should die, after all, the combat effectiveness of those local kings and warlords' troops is hard to describe."
Audrey nodded: "I didn't expect that the world would become so turbulent at the end of this year."
But Hobert said: "When the royal family began to carry out their plan, a series of wars were destined to happen."
Of course, Audrey knew that the "royal family's plan" that Hobert was talking about was His Majesty the King's plan to become a god.
But at this time, Audrey had figured out many things, and she realized that the world was originally full of barbarism and chaos. At this time, it was just that these barbarism and chaos were put on the surface.
… …
Late at night, the northernmost part of Sonia Island.
Here, the cold wind howls, rolling up the snow on the top of the mountain, scattering it everywhere, as if there is a blizzard at all times.
On the leeward side of the snow, a small stone cave is emitting smoke, but these smoke are instantly dispersed by the strong wind, as if they never existed.
Following the passage of these smoke down a dozen meters, is a warm underground structure.
At this time, two Beyonder members of the Tamara family are roasting sea fish caught during the day with their Beyonder abilities.
In the room inside, Pedi Tamara, with a sallow face, was lying on the stone bed with his eyes closed.
Previously, in the battle with the "Creator," Pedi's spirit body was slightly injured and needed to be recuperated for a period of time before he could recover.
Suddenly, Pedi opened his eyes and looked outside. The space there suddenly became illusory. A fifteen or sixteen-year-old boy with a not very good complexion walked out of the spirit world. It was Erebus.
The injuries caused to him by the Lord of Storms before had not yet healed.
And behind him was Tamara, who seemed to be a servant.
The skin of all the family members was sallow, and it was unknown whether Tamara's condition was due to family heredity or if he was also unwell.
After the two of them appeared, the two family members who were grilling fish were about to get up, but Tamara "imprisoned" them in place.
Pedi got up from the stone bed, stood at the entrance of the stone chamber, and stared coldly at the two uninvited guests: "What are you doing here?"
Tamara retorted: "Why didn't you join us?"
Pedi smiled: "Before this, I never imagined that in order to attack us, you would even expose your hiding place of so many years to the 'Creator'."
"You should be very clear," Tamara said expressionlessly, "Your lover, Orseya, exposed our valley!
"I said long ago that she was just a slave, it's okay to play with her, but you actually developed real feelings."
Pedi laughed bitterly: "You will never understand, because you lost all humanity more than a thousand years ago!"
Then he said: "It is precisely because you have no humanity that, in order to attack us, you did not hesitate to let a demigod who supports you stay in the valley.
"Now you are happy, we are only a few people left."
Erebus suddenly said at this time: "I am very curious, why are you unwilling to believe in me?"
"Why else? Because you are an evil god."
Erebus said seriously: "Which god is not an evil god?"
Pedi looked at him coldly: "So none of us are willing to believe."
Erebus shook his head, expressing his disappointment in Pedi.
Tamara continued: "I was too indulgent with you before, of course, this is also related to the despicable Seven Gods. If they hadn't killed my father because they needed the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Hand of Order', the Tamara family would not have split.
"Over the years, I have figured out that our split is because there are two Sequence 2s within the family, which gave you the confidence to oppose me.
"If my father was still here, and there was a 'Hand of Order' in the family, you would never have dared to launch a civil war back then.
"Another reason is that the Abraham family is too strong. These fools still think that Mr. 'Door' can protect them.
"Now it's good, the 'Creator' has helped me severely damage the split forces, and I have the family's Beyonder characteristic reserves in my hand. Now I just need time to re-cultivate a batch of family members.
"From now on, the Tamara family will be a unified family, and I, as the patriarch, can command all family members, and no longer have to argue with you through the dog-shit-like council."
Pedi looked at Tamara's sallow face, and he suddenly felt that the person in front of him was a little strange.
The stone room was quiet for two or three seconds, and Pedi finally said: "In order to achieve your goal, many of your followers have also died. Do you think it's worth it?"
"Worth it!" Tamara said: "They stabilized you, preventing you from leaving the valley due to possible leaks. This is a necessary sacrifice.
"Of course, part of the reason is that we underestimated the power of the 'Creator'."
He paused and then said: "Before this, according to our speculation, the 'Creator's' position looked scary, but he even had difficulty dealing with a Sequence 2.
"What I didn't expect was that the battle ended so cleanly. Otherwise, we could have withdrawn some of the people."
Pedi also said: "Then we have discussed many times before that if the 'Creator' knew our hiding place, he would definitely organize another war as soon as possible, and we would definitely notice it.
"But from beginning to end, the 'Creator' did not carry out large-scale mobilization, which made us lose our vigilance.
"But why are you so sure that he will come? So you made so many preparations in advance."
It was Erebus who answered him: "Because if he wants to find me, the Tamara family is the only clue.
"But what I didn't expect was that the 'Creator' would attack in this way. Originally, I wanted to take the opportunity to corrupt his subordinates and fight with him again for the 'Nation of Disorder' based on the opportunity he gave his subordinates to remove the corruption.
"I didn't expect that I wouldn't be given a single chance."
Pedi nodded: "I understand."
Tamara asked: "Do you have any other questions?"
"Yes, when did you completely abandon your humanity?"
Tamara said expressionlessly: "When I had to kill my own father with my own hands."
Pedi said frankly: "I have no more questions."
Tamara said lightly: "You can die in peace."
Pedi smiled: "You wouldn't think that my conversation with you just now was really to chat with you, would you?
"You wouldn't think that since I have seen through your true colors, I wouldn't make any preparations, would you?"
As he said this, his figure became illusory: "Goodbye, you two."
Erebus smiled and watched Pedi disappear, but in the next second, Pedi reappeared in front of Erebus and Tamara.
Pedi was slightly stunned, and then asked in great surprise: "You, what did you do just now?"
"Hahahaha~" Erebus first laughed wildly a few times before saying: "You wouldn't think that you fought the 'Creator' twice, and were almost not suppressed by his position, really because of your own strength, would you?
"You wouldn't think that as long as you don't believe in me, as long as you don't have contact with those mists, you won't be polluted by me, would you?"
He commented: "What a naive young man."
"Impossible," Pedi fell into deep self-doubt: "I, why didn't I feel that I was polluted?"
"Of course you can't feel it," Erebus continued: "Because your surname is Tamara."
Pedi seemed to understand something: "My bloodline..."
Erebus smiled: "That's right, you were already my believer when you were born.
"Of course, your resistance also had some effect. Before this, I was not sure that I could kill you.
"But now, thanks to the 'Creator' for damaging your spirit body, giving me an excellent opportunity."
He imitated Pedi's tone just now: "You wouldn't think that I was listening to you talking just now because your chat content was interesting, would you?"
As he spoke, Erebus took out a thin-necked glass bottle, and the mist inside was emitting colorful light.
Erebus in front of Pedi became very stalwart, and he knelt down on one knee unconsciously.
He struggled hard, but the surrender now seemed to have been buried in his bloodline a long time ago. At this time, surrendering to Erebus was as common sense as eating and sleeping.
Tamara stepped forward, and he had a black dagger in his hand. Just gesturing at Pedi, who had no resistance, Pedi's head fell from his neck.
But Pedi was not dead yet. The head rolling on the ground was still staring at Tamara.
So Tamara reached out and patted Pedi's shoulder again, and Pedi's body collapsed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
As a "Balancer", he can restore everything around him to balance, but he can also make the target lose balance.
At this time, Pedi's body lost "balance", so it quickly collapsed, but Pedi was not dead, he just lost the normal human form.
Under the effect of Tamara's ability, the Beyonder characteristics in Pedi's body began to precipitate.
Pedi had been resisting, but Erebus had been suppressing his bloodline with the mist in his hand, and Pedi's resistance had little effect.
More than ten minutes later, the Beyonder characteristics in Pedi's body were completely precipitated, and Erebus reached out and picked up the Beyonder characteristics, letting out a long sigh of relief: "Finally got it, I was going to send you to William I in a few days, but now I can avoid you dying in Backlund due to an accident."
At this time, Pedi's body was still wriggling, and his spirit and mind would not disappear until a long time later.
During this period, he is very likely to become a wraith.
Erebus put away the Beyonder characteristics: "It's a pity that now is not a good time to advance."
Tamara did not speak, silently killing the two family members who had been grilling fish just now and had opposed him.
...
In early November, Hobert stayed in the Southern Balam Duchy for a few more days. He mainly wanted to see how chaotic it was here.
Although all the local kings and generals in the principality were imprisoned by Hobert in Angel City, Hobert did not use thunderous means to incorporate their troops and disband their bureaucratic system.
In the eyes of the local kings and generals, the Duke's behavior was very stupid!
This allowed their heirs and subordinates enough space to mobilize their own forces, connect with each other, and jointly resist the Duke's rule.
Of course, Hobert did this on purpose; he now desperately needed chaos to thoroughly digest the potion.
Although a large-scale war had broken out in the Northern Continent, Hobert found that the chaos caused by the war did not help him digest the potion at all.
On the contrary, the chaos caused by the sneak attack on Saint Millon and the launch of telephones had helped him digest the potion to some extent.
After Backlund was bombed, people who had seen the telephone installed one in their homes so they could go to work with peace of mind.
At the slightest sign of trouble, they would call home to ask about the situation.
In addition, after the war began, the faster the information spread, the better; direct verbal communication was much faster than sending telegrams, and it was also very accurate, allowing for repeated confirmation.
For a time, stores selling telephones were packed, and after experiencing the bombing of Backlund, the cloud of fear had never dissipated from their minds, and people had also become very irritable.
Many people who had queued for a day but failed to buy a telephone were momentarily enraged and beat up the telephone sales staff, and some even wanted to set fires, but they were stopped.
At the same time, conflicts were also very likely to occur between those queuing.
Although these disturbances were not large in scale, they allowed Hobert to constantly feel the feedback brought about by the chaos.
Hobert also realized that only chaos related to him or caused by him could help him digest the potion.
At the same time, because he often acted crazy, and the audience was either demigods or angels, the acting effect was very good. Currently, Hobert's condition was good, and he was only a little short of completely digesting the potion.
However, to Hobert's disappointment, after the heirs of those local kings and warlords united, even though their strength was not weak in the Southern Continent, they still sent envoys to negotiate with Hobert.
This made Hobert realize: People who are used to kneeling find it difficult to stand up again.
So he simply cut off the envoy's ear and told him to go back and tell those heirs that they were already traitors to the Southern Balam Duchy, and the Duchy's army would wipe out their entire families!
Hobert sighed. If these people continued to be cowards, then he would have to take the initiative.
But in that case, the level of chaos in the Duchy would not be very serious, and it might not be possible to completely digest the potion.
During these days in the Southern Balam Duchy, Hobert also invited Georgina to visit the Southern Balam Duchy's army from afar and "drive away" the Feysac Empire's colonial army in battle.
Georgina was very satisfied with the Duchy's speed of response, and she also finalized the deal to purchase the teleportation array blueprint with Hobert in Angel City.
Actually, there was nothing to talk about; everything that needed to be discussed had already been discussed before, and now it was just a confirmation.
Hobert had originally planned to stay in the Southern Balam Duchy for a few more days, but Dophis used the teleportation array to report that Earl Vincent had invited Hobert to attend a ball three times in succession.
Dophis had refused the first two times on the grounds that the Earl was on a business trip. The third time, Earl Vincent's youngest son, Karl, issued the invitation and stated to Dophis that many nobles in Backlund had jointly invited Duke Hobert to attend the ball.
These nobles had one thing in common: their children were either mid- to low-level officials in Hobert's current territory or managers of the "Earl's Light". They were all from the families of the noble children Hobert had recruited before.
Dophis immediately realized that these people might have formed a loose alliance, so he reported this news to Hobert.
Hobert had only recruited those few batches of noble children before, and stopped recruiting after the manpower shortage passed, for fear that these people would form cliques.
Now it seemed that Hobert's concerns at the time were very prescient. Fortunately, there were not many of them. If there were more, they might have formed a vested interest group.
After all, this was the specialty of the Backlund nobles.
After considering it, Hobert decided to attend the ball to listen to the demands of those noble children. In addition, he remembered a small matter.
Viscount Glaint had asked him twice before to help retrieve a ring from his family, but unfortunately, Hobert had not found a suitable opportunity. This ball was a good time.
So, after Hobert returned to Backlund, he first asked Viscount Glaint for a few strands of hair, and then went to Earl Vincent's mansion as promised to attend the ball.
When Hobert got out of the carriage, many Earls and Viscounts were waiting at the door, while Barons and Lords did not even have the qualifications to greet him.
Hobert exchanged pleasantries with them, and everyone entered the ballroom together.
Only then did Hobert discover that the noble children recruited several times before involved as many as seventy or eighty nobles, large and small.
Greeting them one by one and exchanging a few words took up most of an hour.
At this time, Vincent announced that the ball had officially begun. This Earl was very fond of food, and the banquet he held was also a gourmet feast.
However, this time Hobert had no time to enjoy it, and spent it all talking with the nobles.
The main people who talked to Hobert were Earl Vincent, Earl Minnis, and other Earls, while other nobles surrounded them, listening to their conversation.
Half a year ago, they never imagined that those less-favored descendants who went to Hobert to seek their own way would provide them with a very good investment environment.
After a long chat, Earl Vincent, with his golden hair, said: "Duke Hobert, first of all, thank you for taking care of the children for the past period of time.
"We have heard some information about the Southern Balam Duchy from them. In return, we are willing to help the Duchy overcome its difficulties.
"Although the Loen Kingdom's army has withdrawn from there, it does not mean that the Loen Kingdom has completely lost its influence there.
"We have more or less business dealings with those local kings and warlords and can help you persuade them to stop the internal strife and pledge allegiance to you again."
Hobert immediately understood that they wanted to use the process of persuading those local kings and warlords to make those Southern Continent agents of the Loen Kingdom become their agents.
So he smiled and said: "Three days ago, I just met with the envoys of the local kings and warlords and announced to them that they were already traitors to the Southern Balam Duchy."
The faces of several Earls were a little surprised. After a second or two of silence, Earl Minnis said: "Duke, isn't that very likely to anger them?"
Hobert was stunned for a moment before realizing that he and these nobles were not on the same channel.
The meaning of his previous sentence was: Don't worry, I will use guns to "persuade" them. When they all become corpses, the internal strife will stop.
But in the eyes of these nobles, things seemed to be getting worse and worse.
Hobert also recalled the surprised expressions of Earl Hall and his son when they heard his plan before.
The long-term peace and pampering in Backlund had made them accustomed to solving problems in the safest way.
So Hobert said again: "In my opinion, this civil war must be fought!"
He added seriously: "Sometimes being safe is not a good thing, especially for a new country, it must look a little radical.
"If it is like an old man who can't walk when it is first founded, then this country will not have any vitality."
The surrounding nobles were all stunned. The news they had obtained from their respective channels all believed that Hobert had no chance of winning in this civil war.
After all, Hobert had only taken over Longtail Island for half a year and had no time to recruit and train a large number of soldiers.
And because the confidentiality of the Beyonder forces was very high, even Georgina did not know exactly how much power Hobert had, and could only rely on the intelligence from the Southern Colson battle to guess.
The channels of these nobles could not be very clear about Hobert's extraordinary strength either. Many people believed that Hobert had become arrogant because of his great victory in the struggle with the Gas Association.
So they mistakenly judged the situation, thinking that the Southern Continent would still achieve great victories like in Backlund.
However, in the concept of the nobles, the Southern Continent was very barbaric and did not have a reliable system and moral system like Backlund. If they still used the way of solving problems in Backlund in the Southern Continent, it would easily make things uncontrollable.
Thus, they smelled a business opportunity and believed it was an excellent time to invest in the Duchy of Southern Balam.
However, Hobert's reaction far exceeded their expectations.
At this moment, a viscount couldn't help but remind Hobert: "Duke Hobert, if the civil war completely breaks out, it may require sacrificing even more benefits to keep those tribal chiefs and generals serving us."
Hobert handed the wine glass in his hand to the waiter: "Sorry, I need to go to the restroom."
His timely display of impatience seemed to suggest he disdained engaging in such debates.
Under the waiter's guidance, Hobert left the ballroom. The nobles first exchanged glances, then a "buzz" erupted as they began voicing their opinions all at once.
Hobert arrived at the restroom, thinking: 'I never imagined that one day, I would have to make use of Mr. Fool's "Divine Kingdom".'
In Earl Vincent's mansion, there would definitely be Beyonders protecting it, and Vincent himself might very well be a Sequence 5. But for the current Hobert, slightly "tampering" with the surrounding spirituality would make it completely impossible for them to detect his actions.
Next, Hobert took out a few strands of hair from Viscount Glaint and performed "Connection".
This immediately connected him to the ring's location, after all, Hobert's current operating range for various abilities had reached six or seven kilometers.
He spread his spirituality, not sensing any signs of life around the ring, but it did seem like there was a Beyonder trap.
Hobert used the "Exploit" ability to easily and temporarily disable that Beyonder trap.
Almost in the same second, Hobert used the ability to "distort" space to twist the ring, along with the container holding it, into his hand.
It was a small wooden box made of solid wood, with no extraordinary protection.
So Hobert made the space around the lock chaotic, easily allowing the copper lock to pass through the hasp and be removed.
Opening the box revealed various gemstone rings inside.
Clearly, Earl Vincent didn't know about the gemstone ring inherited by the Glaint family, so he didn't take it seriously at all.
Hobert picked up the gemstone ring that Viscount Glaint had mentioned, infused it with spirituality, and recited the incantation in ancient Feysac: "Summer of Winter County."
The surroundings of the gemstone ring suddenly became illusory, and a small illusory space appeared.
This was a small-scale space magic, utilizing the characteristics of gemstones and the "Door" pathway Beyonder powers, designed to be very concealed, no wonder Vincent had never discovered it.
Hobert took out a few notebooks from this small space, then put the ring back, closed the wooden box, and once again used the chaos of space to return the small lock to its original position.
Finally, Hobert once again avoided the Beyonder trap and sent the wooden box back.
Ending all of this, Hobert slightly waved his hand, "distorting" the air around the toilet flush, causing the air to push the switch.
Whoosh ~
Hobert smiled, after becoming Sequence 3, he was becoming increasingly lazy.
As Hobert finished washing his hands and took the towel from the servant to dry them, the restroom door was suddenly opened, and Earl Vincent's youngest son, Karl, entered from outside: "Lord Hobert."
At this time, Karl's skin was rough and dark, compared to more than a year ago, he was much steadier and more mature.
Hobert casually asked as he walked out: "How's work lately?"
"The town I'm in charge of, its grain production for this quarter ranks first among the town-level units," Karl said with a smile, following behind.
Hobert glanced at Karl: "Not bad at all."
"It's alright, it's alright," Karl said modestly: "We are all very grateful for the platform you provided for us."
Originally, they were all marginalized figures in their families and were not valued.
But in Hobert's territory, they found a way to realize their self-worth.
At this time, Karl, because of his excellent political achievements, had begun a new round of assessment, preparing to appoint him as a county magistrate of the Duchy of Southern Balam.
And another member of the "Justice Alliance", Koldath, was also not valued in her family, which even made her feel very insecure at one point.
But in an assessment hosted by Donna, she saw Koldath's patience and meticulousness, so she gave her an opportunity.
Koldath cherished that opportunity very much, and thus obtained a very crucial advancement.
Currently, Koldath is already the head of the personnel department of Longtail Island City, and is the noble descendant with the highest official position.
At this time, Karl also said: "I'm sorry, before, my father asked me some questions about Longtail Island, I really wanted them to know about the great changes happening on Longtail Island, so I answered some questions that didn't involve secrets."
"Just two days ago, my father suddenly asked me to come back, when I learned that Koldath and the others were also asked many questions about Longtail Island, I realized something was wrong."
"But at that time, I didn't even think that my father and the others were actually preparing to take advantage of this opportunity to infiltrate the Duchy of Southern Balam."
Speaking of this, the two stopped outside the ballroom.
Karl said helplessly: "They completely don't realize where their mistakes lie? They still hope to solve the problem with their methods of dealing with things in Backlund, please don't take offense, after the ball is over, I will persuade my father."
"It's okay," Hobert said with a smile: "Just consider it coming to taste the delicacies of Earl Vincent's mansion."
Originally, he thought that it was the noble descendants who asked Earl Vincent and others to fight for higher official positions for them.
From the current point of view, it's just that these nobles' problem of "speculation" has occurred, and noble descendants like Karl have not colluded with their fathers.
Although their connections are very close, they are not as tightly knit as Hobert had previously guessed.
This made Hobert very satisfied, meaning that the transformation of these noble descendants was very successful!
Returning to the ballroom again, Earl Vincent and the others still wanted to discuss with Hobert the issue of curbing the civil war in the Duchy of Southern Balam, but Hobert used the excuse of being hungry and went over to enjoy the delicacies.
After he finished eating and praised the culinary skills of the chef of Earl Vincent's mansion, he immediately bid farewell.
Although this was somewhat impolite, he was, after all, a duke of Loen, and no one had the right to stop him if he wanted to leave.
In the ballroom, the nobles once again discussed how to make Hobert aware of the seriousness of this civil strife, and at the same time, they called over their children in the corner of the ballroom to verify some news with them.
Only then did they realize that the atmosphere was a little off, or rather, the way their children looked at them was a little off.
Originally, these unvalued children were very docile when they saw them, even after having official positions under Hobert, they were still very respectful to them.
But now, they saw disdain on the faces of these children.
At this time, Karl said: "Everyone, there is one thing you have misunderstood, we have the confidence to win this civil war."
A noble sarcastically said: "War is not just about having confidence."
Karl didn't say much, just said: "Let's wait and see."
After speaking, he also left the ballroom, and the other noble descendants left one after another.
At this time, the nobles present realized that if they wanted to seize benefits in the Duchy of Southern Balam, they still had to make use of these children's channels, so they also hastily ended the gathering.
… …
After Hobert returned to the Earl's mansion, he first went to his study to take a look at the notebook that the Glaint family regarded as a treasure.
What Hobert didn't expect was that this family was actually a branch of the Tamara family.
To be precise, the source of this family was a Beyonder family that escaped from the valley where the Tamara family was hiding more than eight hundred years ago, similar to Upton's situation.
He thought: 'No wonder the incantation to open the ring is "Summer of Winter County", the valley where the Tamara family is hiding is in Winter County.'
And more than eight hundred years ago, this Beyonder family escaped from the family in the summer.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 652 The Fool Received a Whole Roselle Diary
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert continued reading the contents of the notes, which described the three factions of the Tamara family.
The first faction, represented by Tamara, worshiped evil gods, willingly becoming their servants, hoping to regain the Beyonder characteristic of the "Hand of Order" and allow the family to once again have a great angel.
Another faction, led by Pedi, strongly opposed family members worshiping evil gods, believing that it would make Beyonders cold, especially family members above the demigod level, and even become less human due to the influence of evil gods.
The internal conflict of the Tamara family mainly existed between these two factions.
According to the records in the notes, this conflict actually appeared very early on. When Old Tamara had to contribute his Beyonder characteristic to the Six Gods, Tamara began to establish contact with that evil god through the clues about evil gods obtained by the family.
Gradually, Tamara began to force family members to change their beliefs.
Before that, family members generally worshiped the angel in the family, that is, Tamara himself, so at the beginning, he easily changed the beliefs of a group of members.
However, there were still some members who might not have been so devout in their belief in "Balancer" Tamara and were always unwilling to convert.
The seeds of internal family conflict were planted at this time.
Later, Pedi Tamara escalated the family conflict until a civil war broke out.
Pedi always pretended to support Tamara and was highly trusted by Tamara, but this was all an illusion he showed in order to obtain advancement opportunities.
After the Tamara family obtained the Beyonder characteristic of the "Duke of Entropy," Pedi stood out among several candidates for advancement to angel, obtained the advancement opportunity, and then began to publicly oppose the worship of evil gods, and quickly became the leader of the opposition.
Therefore, under the condition that both sides had comparable strength, a civil war broke out.
Later, Tamara, who had a certain advantage, compromised and stated that family members had the right to choose whether or not to worship evil gods, and thus formed the family's council, which was the highest decision-making body in the family.
The cracks caused by the civil war were barely repaired.
In addition, there was another faction in the Tamara family. Initially, they were members of the Abraham family who had marriage ties with the Tamara family and came to join the Tamara family.
Some of them also left the Tamara family because they were unwilling to accept the protection of evil gods.
It is said that they later joined the "Primordial Demoness."
The person who wrote this notebook was also very strange, wondering why that part of the members switched from one evil god to another.
Hobert smiled and said to himself: Evil gods are different from evil gods.
Later, the remaining members of the Abraham family who stayed were willing to worship evil gods, and they formed a relatively loose faction, which was the third faction in the Tamara family.
They once hoped to cultivate an angel of the "Apprentice" pathway, but unfortunately, they could not complete the corresponding ritual, so this faction has always only had two or three demigods and has never had an angel.
In the subsequent continuous intermarriages, they were almost diluted by the other two factions, but they have always been the mediators of the other two factions.
Combining some of the information obtained before, Hobert basically knew the entire history of the Tamara family.
This family rose to prominence in the early Fourth Epoch, during those chaotic decades. Later, it joined the Solomon Empire and gained Solomon's trust, secretly helping Solomon contact the "Uncertain Mist" and find a way to become a Great Old One.
After the collapse of the Solomon Empire, the Six Gods took away the Tamara family's Beyonder characteristic of the "Hand of Order." In order to take revenge and restore their strength, Tamara completely leaned towards the "Uncertain Mist."
In Hobert's opinion, a family supported by hatred is difficult to last for a long time.
The Tamara family's civil war, in addition to their disagreement on the concept of treating evil gods, the fundamental reason was actually whether or not to live for hatred?
The family members led by Pedi firmly resisted the belief in the "Uncertain Mist" precisely because they did not want their lives to become sacrifices for revenge.
Hobert sighed: It's a pity that with the arrival of Erebus, the balance between the two factions of the Tamara family may be broken.
He continued to read on, Pedi, in order to protect some family members, would help them cover up their tracks and help them leave the family with their consent.
This is how the Glaint family came to be. That Beyonder family first hibernated for decades before starting to operate in the outside world again.
At this time, a series of wars broke out in the Northern Continent. The Loen Kingdom first broke out the "Twenty Years' War" with the Feysac Empire, and then the "White Rose War" with the Intis Kingdom.
The Glaint family used these two wars to obtain a title of nobility and pass it down to modern times.
Some of the later notes were unremarkable, basically recording the lives of generations of viscounts.
On the last page of the notebook, a few scribbled words were written: Remember, don't investigate the cause of my death, it is likely to attract retaliation from the royal family. Be a good viscount and continue the family! As long as there is continuation, there is hope!
Although this sentence was a bit nonsensical, but combined with Glaint's previous narration, this should be what his father wrote to him.
Hobert thought of Rex and smiled slightly: For many people, "the truth being revealed to the world" is not the most important thing.
Then he thought: Old Viscount Glaint may have known about the royal family's excavation of ancient tombs, but was unwilling to collude with the royal family, so he was murdered by the royal family.
The only difference from Xio's family is that Glaint's family was not purged, probably because Old Viscount Glaint never intended to inform the church about this matter, but was just unwilling to help the royal family.
It may also be the result of Vincent's mediation.
Judging from some previous events, Earl Vincent did provide some help to Glaint, and it is likely that he silently helped his good friend's family through the difficulties.
If Vincent had been guarding against Glaint, he would not have allowed his youngest son, Karl, to hang out with Glaint.
Of course, this is just Hobert's guess. The behavior of these nobles is often difficult to explain.
In addition to the records of the Glaint family's history, there were also two other notebooks, one of which recorded lots of knowledge and theories.
This should be the "standard configuration" of Beyonder families. With such a notebook, the descendants of their family can well understand this world.
The other one recorded much history, especially some neighboring pathways or families of the same pathway, all had relatively detailed information, and even actively conducted some investigations.
Hobert glanced at it and found that the information about these families was already outdated.
The description of Trunsoest was still stuck in "divided into two, one branch hiding somewhere in the Hornacis Mountains, and one branch relatively active, establishing a law firm in Backlund to digest potions."
Decades ago, these descriptions were correct, but now huge changes have already taken place.
Especially after the "Creator" began to systematically recruit members of the Trunsoest family, this information was basically useless.
Another reason is that Glaint chose to become an "Apothecary" in order to avoid being monitored, and this information was equivalent to information from another pathway for him.
However, if Glaint has children in the future and wants to return to the "Arbiter" pathway, this information is still useful, at least knowing which families are of the same pathway or neighboring pathways as his.
After reading these notes, Hobert sent them to Glaint.
In the study of Viscount Glaint, the young viscount was silent for a long time looking at the three leather notebooks.
He carefully stroked their surfaces, as if afraid that they would be broken because his movements were too rough.
Hobert knew that over the years, these notes had been entrusted with all of Glaint's thoughts for his father.
After a long time, Viscount Glaint choked up a little and said: "Sorry, I was just distracted."
As he spoke, he opened the secret room of the study and took out three sealed items from it: "According to the previous agreement, you can choose any one of them."
Hobert nodded and casually took one.
They were all Grade 2 Sealed Artifacts, and he currently had almost no great need for sealed items of this level.
However, the help of a demigod was more valuable than a Grade 2 Sealed Artifact, so Hobert was not polite with Glaint.
"What we have to face is the future, not the past." Hobert smiled and said: "Look forward, there is a bright future waiting for us. If we only look back, we can only be buried by helplessness and sadness, because there is nothing we can do to change the things of the past."
Glaint showed a forced smile: "Thank you."
Hobert waved his hand at him and used "Travel" to return to his study.
At this time, in his mind, like a movie playing, scenes of the past year or so flashed through his mind. He thought of the Tamara family, of his mother, of his father, of his adoptive parents, of Fors and Audrey, of Donna and Tyron, of Klein and Leonard.
All of this eventually turned into a smile: "Time flies so fast!"
That night, Hobert hardly rested. He first lamented his life, and then began to make short-term and long-term plans.
Thinking about these things easily made him excited, so he couldn't rest well.
The next morning, Hobert first went to "Earl's Light" to take a look and understand the sales of the telephone.
Preparations for the sale of telephones began a long time ago. Previously, when laying cables in some places, telephone lines were also laid at the same time.
Even in places without telephone lines, it is relatively easy to lay them as long as there are utility poles.
However, there are still many areas not covered by telephone lines, so the current constraint on telephone development is the insufficient laying of telephone lines.
This cannot be rushed and can only be done slowly.
After having lunch with Audrey, Hobert went to Longtail Island in the afternoon to attend the Tarot Gathering with Fors.
Before today, Hobert had attended the Tarot Gathering three times, but those gatherings were very brief and nothing new happened.
As usual, Hobert and Fors lay on the bed a few minutes early. Fors said, "Dorian has accepted my invitation and plans to visit Longtail Island tomorrow."
Hobert nodded: "Great, in that case, I'll stay on Longtail Island for the next two days."
Fors added: "In Tussock Harbor, some navies are recruiting pirates to participate in naval battles, promising land, official positions, and even titles."
"Let them recruit," Hobert said. "As long as it doesn't affect the order of the port, don't interfere."
After all, Longtail Island nominally belongs to the Loen Kingdom.
Fors nodded: "Okay."
Hobert then asked: "I haven't been to Longtail Island for a while. How is the construction progressing? Are the industrial areas operating normally?"
"We have repaired the most dangerous sections of the dam and built a large number of canals and ditches, virtually eliminating flood disasters." Now Fors knows everything about Longtail Island:
"With the recruitment of a large number of skilled workers from the southern coast of the Inner Sea, all factories are basically operating. The only problem is that we haven't connected with suitable buyers for the products produced by our heavy industry."
Hobert smiled and said, "It's not time yet. When the factories in the Southern Continent are also operating, we will be able to digest some of the production capacity ourselves.
"In addition, with the development of the war, maybe by next year at the latest, we will be able to export some industrial products to the Northern Continent, of course, provided we have enough for ourselves."
Just as they were discussing this, their vision was suddenly covered by a layer of gray fog. The next second, they appeared in the Great Hall, on either side of the bronze long table.
As the two were slightly dazed, "Justice" Audrey curtsied and greeted the uppermost figure: "Good afternoon, Mr. Fool~."
This crisp greeting also signaled the official start of this Tarot Gathering.
While greeting the others, Audrey habitually began to observe.
First, she noticed that the fog around Mr. Fool was denser and more agile.
Audrey was overjoyed, generally indicating that Mr. Fool's abilities had further recovered.
Hobert also noticed this. Unlike Audrey, who was polite, he directly glanced at "The Fool" Klein. "The Fool" was indeed more distant, like a shadow far away from everyone.
This made Hobert realize: Klein has advanced to Sequence 3!
Continuing to greet the other members, Audrey also noticed that Ms. Hermit's mental state and body language indicated that she was worried about something.
Audrey curiously pondered the possible reasons: Is it related to the "Queen Mystic"? Or is it another issue?
With Audrey's further advancement, she had already drawn a "psychological portrait" for Ms. Hermit through observation, believing her to be a rather contradictory Beyonder. Most of the time, she looked experienced, knowledgeable, calm, and capable, but for some reason, she was bold and reckless in some aspects, like a minor girl.
Based on the analysis of some basic information, Audrey believed that Ms. Hermit's personality should be related to the "Queen Mystic".
Meanwhile, sitting below "The Magician" Fors, "The Hermit" Cattleya's mind was filled with two questions: Why did the Queen send so many diaries at once? Is the Queen in some kind of trouble?
Finally enduring until the gathering officially began, Cattleya restrained her worries and said to "The Fool": "Great Mr. Fool, this time I have collected an entire book of Roselle's diary."
An entire book?
Hearing "The Hermit's" words, several members, including "The Hanged Man" Alger, were visibly stunned.
Even "The Sun" Derrick, who was the least concerned and most insensitive to such matters, noticed a trace of abnormality.
The other members knew that "Queen Mystic" Bernadette was the eldest daughter of Emperor Roselle, and it was normal to provide an entire diary. What was abnormal was the act of giving an entire book at once!
Cattleya didn't care about everyone's gazes and continued: "These diaries are not continuous, but they all originated from Emperor Roselle's later years."
"Very good," Klein nodded slightly, signaling "The Hermit" to begin manifesting.
Page after page of slightly yellowed diary successively took shape, soon covering an entire book.
Fortunately, Cattleya had already advanced to a demigod, and her pathway was related to knowledge, otherwise, it would have been impossible to forcibly memorize so many diaries.
After receiving the diary, Klein flipped through it casually without actually reading it, and put it down, saying to Cattleya: "You can ask your questions."
"Including the previous accumulation, a total of ten questions."
Cattleya was immediately a little headache because the "Queen Mystic" Bernadette only asked her to ask two questions this time.
She deliberated for a moment and said: "Respected Mr. Fool, can I ask in batches?"
"Yes," Klein said with a smile.
This was exactly what he thought. Answering ten questions in one breath would also be a difficult thing for "Mr. Fool".
Cattleya secretly breathed a sigh of relief and said: "There are two questions this time.
"One is, when George III attempts to become a god, will Adam Himself help George III?"
Alger and the others were stunned. According to the clues obtained from the Emperor before, George III's becoming a god was closely related to Adam, and it even seemed to be planned by him.
Then, when George III's plan is hindered, isn't it normal for Adam to help George III?
At this time, Klein said in his heart: "'Queen Mystic' and I thought of the same thing. The war has already broken out, and Adam should be waiting for the opportunity to become a god.
"Judging from some evidence, the cooperation between Adam and George III may have ended, because their respective goals have been basically achieved.
"The start of the war is equivalent to Adam having the opportunity to become a god. And George III has also obtained the opportunity to become a god because of Adam's plan.
"Theoretically speaking, they no longer have the need to continue cooperating.
"One of the evidences is that I successfully killed Qonas and found the hidden ruins of the royal family.
"Although I didn't find the specific conspiracy of the royal family in the end because of someone's betrayal, if Adam was still very concerned about George III's becoming a god, then I should have lost Qonas due to various coincidences at that time.
"There are many similar evidences. Adam should not have the mind to care about George III's affairs at this time, and will only send subordinates to help at most."
Klein believed that the "Queen Mystic" should have thought of this based on her own mystical knowledge, so she wanted to ask "The Fool" for confirmation.
Although he was quite sure of his guess, he still didn't say too much: "Based on the current situation, Adam should not provide too much help to George III."
If Adam provided a lot of help, then sorry, the situation has changed, not that "The Fool's" information is wrong.
Except for Hobert, everyone was a little confused by "The Fool's" answer.
Won't provide too much help?
Alger was the first to react and seemed to understand what The Fool meant.
The others were trying to recall information about Adam and had their own associations.
Cattleya controlled her chaotic thoughts and said again: "The second question is, where might the Emperor's undiscovered secret mausoleum be?"
Fors suddenly sat up straight: Secret mausoleum? Undiscovered? This is definitely a best-selling theme with popular elements.
Audrey keenly sensed another thing from this question: Roselle's eldest daughter may have been pursuing the traces left by Roselle, hoping to find clues to the Emperor's resurrection.
Because Hobert hadn't announced the specific process of the "Black Emperor's" resurrection before, she could only think of this step and didn't know the role of those mausoleums.
"The Star" Leonard was more concerned: Roselle left a secret mausoleum? I wonder what's inside?
Klein was prepared for this. He smiled and said: "Perhaps in the Fog Sea, on the hidden primitive island or Abyss that Roselle once discovered."
Abyss?
Alger recalled the information about the abyss he traded with "The Emperor" before: Wasn't it affected or corrupted by the unknown? Oh, right, Emperor Roselle was also corrupted by the Outer Gods. The Emperor built a mausoleum there, probably because he was affected by something.
It took Cattleya several seconds to recover, not expecting that Emperor Roselle's secret mausoleum would involve the abyss.
But after thinking carefully, she found that it was not surprising that such a level of struggle would involve anything.
For a moment, she hoped that the Queen would not pursue this matter, but in the end, she suppressed this idea, because she felt that if it were her, she would make a similar choice.
These thoughts flashed through her mind, and Cattleya said: "Thank you for your answer, I have no questions today."
Hobert looked around and smiled, saying in his heart: Looking at your expressions, I know that you have perfectly avoided the correct answer.
Regarding Cattleya's thanks, Klein nodded slightly: "You can begin."
Hobert immediately said: "I hope to communicate with Mr. World alone."
"The Fool" gently nodded, creating a space for them to communicate privately.
Hobert said to "The World": "Didn't I mention before that when the family curse is lifted, I hope to get your help?
"The development of the situation has become more complicated than before. I now need Mr. Fool's help."
For a moment, Klein suspected that Hobert had discovered his "playing an alt account" scheme. Otherwise, why wouldn't Hobert directly ask for Mr. Fool's help, instead of seeking out The World?
But considering that he hadn't made any mistakes, he asked: "Why don't you directly pray to Mr. Fool?"
Hobert was already prepared for this question: "I'm not sure to what extent Mr. Fool's power has recovered."

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 653: Free Exchange Session with Huge Amount of Information
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Of course, Klein knew that Hobert's concerns were actually meant for Mr. Fool to hear.
He thought to himself: Fortunately, I have been maintaining the illusion that Mr. Fool is awakening. Also, in this kind of matter, Hobert is still very reliable, knowing to convey his request to "The Fool" through "The World", leaving enough room for "The Fool."
So he manipulated "The World" and said, "Tell me your request, and I will convey it to Mr. Fool for you."
"Thank you."
Hobert said, "I learned from the great 'Creator' that Mr. Fool holds the authority of 'Change'."
"Can you 'graft' my bloodline onto an unfamiliar life form?"
"Well, I remember saying before that the curse on me involves the Night Emperor and the Blood Moon Queen, one is at the level of a True God, and the other is at the level of a Great Angel."
This is also why Hobert didn't go to Leonard's Old Man for help. After all, although that Old Man now has the level of Sequence 1, he is very weak, and it is difficult to deal with even Amon's Angel-level avatar, so it may be difficult to complete similar operations.
Klein had "The World" say: "I will report this matter to Mr. Fool after the gathering is over."
At the same time, he had already begun to think about this question in his heart. He first sighed: "The Creator" has a very detailed understanding of the "Seer" pathway! After I advanced, I did use this gray fog to master a similar "Grafting" ability.
Then Klein thought again: But the ability I currently master has very limited effects. The curse on Hobert probably involves the level of a True God. Even if I use the "Blasphemy Card", I can probably only exert the power of Sequence 2, and it is estimated that it will be difficult to help Hobert.
But these thoughts were not suitable to express immediately, Klein manipulated "The World" and talked about another matter: "I have already found a pair of Fulgrim hounds' eyes for you. We can complete the transaction of the 'Blasphemy Card'."
When he was looking for the main ingredient of the "Scholar of Yore" potion, as soon as he arrived not far from the Sefirah Castle, he encountered a group of Hounds of Fulgrim. They looked very docile and should have felt that he was now the owner of the Sefirah Castle.
The Hounds of Fulgrim took the initiative to contribute a pair of eyes. When Klein said a little embarrassedly that he still needed a pair.
Those Hounds of Fulgrim were slightly stunned, but there were still two different Hounds of Fulgrim, and they gave Klein another pair.
At a Tarot Gathering two or three months ago, Klein reached a deal with Hobert for the "Tyrant" card. Klein needed to use a pair of Hounds of Fulgrim' eyes in exchange for this "Blasphemy Slate."
Klein traded for this card mainly to suppress the "Sea God Scepter". Currently, the "Sea God Scepter" can only be used "above the gray fog" because the negative effects are too strong.
With the "Tyrant" card, further sealing can be done, and it can be taken to the real world for one or two minutes.
Another use is to summon yourself by using yourself, holding the "Tyrant" card in one hand and using the "Sea God Scepter" in the other, using the power of the gray fog to completely suppress the "Sea God Scepter" for a period of time.
Hobert nodded: "Okay, I will report this matter to the 'Creator' immediately after the gathering is over."
At this time, he suddenly thought of a question: My prediction may have errors! When I hold the "Black Emperor" card, I have a very high position very early on. That's because I am a Beyonder of the "Black Emperor" pathway, holding the "Black Emperor" card, and using the power of the Origin of "Nation of Disorder" corresponding to this pathway. That's why "The Creator" can have a very high position.
But Klein is different. He doesn't have the "Fool" card or the "Blasphemy Card" of the adjacent pathway. The role that the "Blasphemy Card" can play in the Sefirah Castle is limited, so it can only allow Klein to have the ability of about one Sequence higher above the gray fog!
At this time, Hobert suddenly realized that in his advancement process, "The Fool" may not be able to help much.
Although theoretically all 22 "Blasphemy Cards" are at the same level, from the point of view that different cards can attract the Beyonder characteristics of their corresponding pathways, in the hands of Beyonders of the same pathway, it often has more magical effects.
Thinking of this, Hobert couldn't help but sigh: Could it be that I have to wait until Klein advances to Sequence 2 before I can advance? By then, the war will be over!
Hobert didn't have any good ideas for this for a while, so he could only wait until the gathering was over and think about it slowly.
After the individual communication between the two people ended, "The Magician" Fors immediately said: "I hope to trade some places with strange customs or unique cultures with everyone, 50 pounds per piece of information."
She recently discovered when playing the "Scribe" that the more things that exceeded her understanding, or the more novel customs and local culture she felt, the faster she could digest the potion.
And she usually handles some affairs of Longtail Island or South Colson in the afternoon, or goes to other islands to digest the potion, and it takes too much time to find such islands with strange customs by herself in the evening.
Morning? What morning? Isn't the morning used to sleep in and laze in bed?
"The Hanged Man" Alger smiled and said: "There are too many such places. I know an island that worships a strange god, which seems to be called 'God of Sea Beasts'. The image of this god is just a head wearing a hat."
He asked: "Does this count as a strange custom?"
Fors said: "Yes, of course, please be more specific."
"That island is probably between the Fog Sea and the Berserk Sea, called Serapio Island."
Alger said: "Remember to take off your hat when you go."
"This is the local custom. The locals believe that since the gods wear hats, it is disrespectful to the gods for ordinary people to wear hats."
Then Alger said again: "There is also a cannibalistic tribe with very special customs. They also believe in a strange god, so they have many strange customs…"
He mentioned three islands with strange customs in a row, and "The Hermit" Cattleya also talked about two similar islands.
This opened the eyes of the other members, marveling that there were such strange customs.
After they completed this transaction, Hobert reminded Fors: "Don't deeply explore those gods, and don't follow and worship those gods."
Alger was slightly stunned before asking: "Are there any problems with these wild gods?"
In his opinion, these wild gods are basically demigods in bad condition, as long as you pay attention to keeping your distance, there should be no problem.
This is exactly why Hobert wanted to remind Fors at the Tarot Gathering. In fact, he was also reminding Alger and others: "I don't know, but in my opinion, these wild gods are either high-sequence Beyonders in very bad condition, or they are Outer Gods!"
"In order to avoid being affected or corrupted by the corresponding influences, it is best not to participate in local sacrifices, and do not casually approach those idols."
After hearing the word "Outer God", Alger asked with some worry: "If I just inquire about the information of those gods, will I be affected?"
Hobert said: "Probably not."
Alger secretly breathed a sigh of relief: "Thank you for your reminder."
Hobert smiled and said that it was nothing.
Fors asked: "What if I just record the stories of these gods, or the customs formed under the influence of these gods?"
This question could actually be asked in private, but Fors wanted to know the answer immediately, so she simply asked it on the spot.
Hobert replied: "It doesn't matter, but it's best not to record their images, or too specific information."
Many other members realized that Miss Magician was originally digesting the "Scribe" potion.
Alger felt the most emotional in his heart, because even "The Magician" had started to advance to Sequence 5, and he himself was still stuck at this level: "The Emperor", "The World", and "The Hermit" were already Sequence 4, and "Justice", "The Sun", "The Moon", and "The Star" were also Sequence 5, only "The Magician" had a lower Sequence than me.
Alger only felt a lump in his chest, which was difficult to eliminate, and he couldn't wait to immediately explore the ruins left by the elves with "The Emperor".
But he brought up this matter again at the last gathering, and "The Emperor" said that he was very busy recently and would have to wait a while before they could explore the ruins together.
For the sake of prudence, he could only wait a little longer.
After this transaction was reached, the hall was briefly quiet.
This also indicated that the transaction session was over, and everyone began to communicate freely.
Hobert first said: "I may issue some tasks to everyone in the near future, please be prepared accordingly."
At the previous Tarot Gathering, Klein and Cattleya each owed "The Emperor" 1 demigod-level task, while the other members owed 3 Sequence 5-level tasks.
The civil war in the Duchy of Southern Balam may break out at any time. If there are suddenly two more demigods and several Sequence 5 helpers, it will have an unexpected effect.
But the premise is that the "Rose School of Thought" wants to take the opportunity to participate in the civil strife in the Duchy of Southern Balam. Otherwise, with the Beyonder forces organized by those local kings and warlords, Hobert could eliminate them all while eating hot pot and singing.
And in Hobert's opinion, the "Rose School of Thought" will definitely participate in it, because the Highland Kingdom is adjacent to the Duchy of Southern Balam, and they can understand that if the Duchy of Southern Balam is given enough time to become stronger, they will definitely be threatened.
After all, this principality has inextricably linked with "The Creator", and the "Rose School of Thought" had a war with "The Creator" before, and they are in an antagonistic relationship.
"The Moon" Emlyn asked: "Mr. Emperor, what kind of tasks are they likely to be?"
Hobert answered, "Attacking the 'Rose School of Thought,' or carrying out assassinations in the Southern Continent."
He paused and added, "I will provide you with a way to the Southern Continent or corresponding mystical items."
The other members were slightly stunned; they were all willing to accept such a task.
Then Leonard asked, "I received some news that a civil war is about to break out in the Duchy of South Balam. Is that true?"
"Yes." Hobert smiled and said, "We need to strike at the power of the local warlords."
Both Cattleya and Alger were slightly stunned. They had heard about the Duchy of South Balam long ago. Under the contemporary political system, it was very abnormal to establish a principality.
They just didn't understand the relationship between the "Emperor" and the Duchy of South Balam for a while.
But after a little thought, they realized the reason for this abnormality: this principality was the Loen Kingdom's bribe to the "Creator's" forces!
Cattleya realized: I should have thought of it earlier! Longtail Island is Hobert's fief, and the Duchy of South Balam is the fief of Duke Hobert. Maybe Hobert is the "Emperor" himself! And Mr. Star obviously knew this, so he directly asked the "Emperor" about the situation in the Duchy of South Balam.
Alger thought to himself: Such a bribe is normal. After all, since the South Colson War, the "Creator's" power has been a force to be reckoned with in the Beyonder world. As long as this force does not side with Loen's enemies, allowing them to establish a principality in the Southern Continent is a very worthwhile deal. Currently, the Duchy of South Balam is legally subordinate to the Loen Kingdom, which is equivalent to labeling this principality.
At this time, Leonard asked again, "Are you planning to support a new batch of agents?"
"We plan to govern that land ourselves," Hobert explained. "That's why we have to eradicate all the original forces."
Leonard continued, "I don't understand politics, but I want to remind you that your actions make the Church believe that the local order is becoming chaotic, which only increases casualties."
Hobert smiled: "That's because the bishops of the Church don't know how many slaves die unnaturally every year..."
Speaking of this, he paused slightly before saying: "Ah, I understand. After the gathering is over, I will take some time to talk to the Church."
"I will build more churches of the Evernight Goddess in the Duchy of South Balam. By the way, there are also churches of the Earth Mother, the Storm Church, and the Church of Steam and Machinery."
"I believe that when I tell the bishops of the several churches about the idea of building churches, they will understand our actions."
Hobert sincerely said to Leonard, "Thank you for your reminder."
Leonard was stunned: I didn't mean that! I just wanted to remind you that the Church is paying close attention to this matter... Okay, it seems that I really don't understand politics.
At this time, "The World" asked, "Will a civil war break out?"
"It should." Hobert said.
"The World" nodded and said nothing more.
Alger was a little strange: "Why is there such a deep contradiction with the local warlords?"
In theory, those warlords in the Southern Continent should have been tamed very docile by the colonial army.
"To put it bluntly, it's a matter of ruling power," Hobert said. "Imagine that in the Storm Church, an archbishop only needs to hand in a certain amount of wealth every year, and he can do whatever he wants in his own parish, treat believers as slaves, and levy taxes on believers, etc., and the headquarters of the Storm Church has no right to intervene."
"Do you think such a thing could happen in the Storm Church?"
Alger understood the "Emperor's" meaning: "No."
He originally wanted to remind the "Emperor" that the situation in the colonies is different from that in the Northern Continent, and there is no way to effectively manage the natives and aborigines.
But he thought of what he had seen and heard on Longtail Island, and in the end, he said nothing.
At this time, Cattleya thought of another thing: "I remember that in a previous gathering, we talked about Loen's sneak attack on the capital of the Feysac Empire."
"I just got the news that the chief planner of that operation seems to be Hobert. Was that also an operation led by the 'Creator's' forces?"
In a previous gathering, they did talk about this matter once, but they only chatted for a few sentences. Hobert didn't even have time to show off the results of that battle at that time.
"That's right." Hobert smiled and said, "That was our first cooperation with the Loen royal family."
Cattleya nodded: "So, this time in the war, you are on Loen's side?"
Hobert did not make a clear statement: "We just had a cooperation with Loen."
Emlyn was more concerned about another question: "Mr. Emperor, I heard that the bombing of Saint Millon caused very serious losses to the Feysac Empire. Is this true?"
Hobert shook his head: "That's a rumor. According to the accurate information I obtained later, the Feysac Empire's losses were not great. The number of deaths was even in the single digits, and it had almost no impact on their industrial production."
Emlyn frowned: "I knew I shouldn't believe the news in the newspapers."
Then he said strangely: "But I heard that why do the newspapers of the Feysac Empire also report that this sneak attack caused them huge losses?"
Last week, a few Sanguine from the Feysac Empire happened to come to Backlund to support the assassination of the "Primordial Moon" believers, so he got some first-hand news from the Feysac Empire.
"I also heard about this matter." Hobert explained: "This should be a propaganda method of the Feysac Empire to make the soldiers and people on the front lines more hostile to Loen."
"In addition, after all, this war is the Feysac Empire attacking Loen. Their logistics supply line is longer. If the materials are not delivered in place, they can completely explain to the soldiers on the front line that it is because of Loen's bombing that materials are in short supply."
Hobert smiled: "Shifting the responsibility completely."
Emlyn was stunned for a moment: "That's very much like something politicians can do."
This sentence made the other members nod in agreement.
Alger added: "I have read Loen's newspapers, saying that there were only 24 airships in this sneak attack, and 8 of them came back, right?"
Hobert replied: "Yes."
Cattleya, like Alger, was somewhat surprised: "How did you do it?"
Even if the angels of the Feysac Empire are not in Saint Millon, they should be able to return to support within a few minutes. Could it be that the "Creator" also dispatched angel-level forces?
There was nothing to hide about this information, so Hobert said: "Although there are several demigods in the airship formation, they can only resist one round of attacks from the angels of the Feysac Empire at most."
"At a critical moment, the 'Creator' transferred the airship formation to the Midseashire, so they escaped."
Everyone was stunned, and they all felt that the "Creator" had clearly stood on Loen's side, otherwise, He would not have taken action.
Hobert smiled: "I know what you are thinking, but there is one thing you must also be clear about. Most of the Beyonder who participated in this operation are elites loyal to the 'Creator'."
Although the Tony family has not yet been incorporated, Hobert is very clear that there will be no obstacles to their incorporation.
At that time, if the "Creator" did not take action, even the demigod-level Beyonder would be very dangerous, which would be contrary to Hobert's original intention. After all, for him, a very important purpose of this operation was to allow a "Blood Knight" to complete the advancement.
In the end, all three demigods of the Tony family died, and what advancement was there? That was completely going to send Beyonder characteristics to the Feysac Empire.
But Hobert also knew that this kind of thing could not be explained clearly, and the "Creator's" action had already brought some benefits, so he simply did not make a detailed explanation.
At this time, at the Tarot Gathering, although Hobert did not say it clearly, everyone could guess that the price offered by the Loen Kingdom was rich enough, not only inviting the elites of the "Creator's" forces, but even allowing the "Creator" to take action personally.
This topic ended here, and the hall was quiet for a few seconds before Emlyn's gaze fell on Mr. Star: "If you are official Beyonder, how would you deal with a clergy member of an opposing force within your jurisdiction during the war? He hasn't done anything bad and doesn't plan to do anything bad."
The Fenebache Kingdom has not yet declared war on Loen, but everyone knows that this old opponent of the Loen Kingdom is waiting for an opportunity, and declaring war is only a matter of time.
The shadow of war made the believers and people around the Harvest Church look at Bishop Utravsky more and more wrongly.
The other members almost simultaneously thought in their hearts: Actually, Mr. Moon can remove "if."
Leonard thought for a while and said, "Protective custody."
If Emlyn hadn't mentioned this matter, he would have forgotten that there was a Harvest Church in Backlund.
Klein couldn't help but smile in his heart when he heard Leonard's answer: This answer is very spiritual, worthy of being the newly promoted captain of the "Red Gloves" team.
After hearing the answer, Emlyn just nodded slowly and said nothing.
After answering Emlyn's question, Leonard turned to mention the question he wanted to discuss: "Has anything big been lurking in Backlund recently?"
The Backlund bombing and the King's desire to become a god are both big events in Backlund, but Leonard is not very concerned about these two things.
This is a typical perspective of a clergy member, who believes that those are matters of the secular regime.
But just the day before yesterday, Pallez Zoroast in Leonard's body reminded him that there was a lurking danger in Backlund.
Leonard didn't know what the "lurking danger" was, so he planned to ask the other members at the Tarot Gathering.
Klein pondered for a few seconds before having "The World" say, "The leader of the Secret Order, a Sequence 1 Angel, Roselle Emperor's old friend, Zaratul, is currently hiding in Backlund."
Seeing that some members of the Tarot Club were still a bit bewildered, "The World" added, "The Law of Conservation of Beyonder characteristics that we often talk about usually refers to the conservation of Beyonder characteristics of adjacent pathways."
"In other words, there is also a Law of Convergence of Beyonder characteristics for adjacent pathways."
Leonard seemed to understand what the old man meant: "'Seer' and 'Marauder' are adjacent pathways?"
He thought to himself: The old man must have sensed the threat from Zaratul, so he issued a warning.
Previously, when Hobert announced the relevant information about these two adjacent pathways, Leonard had not yet joined the Tarot Club, so he was unaware of this.
"The World" frankly replied: "Yes, there is also the 'Apprentice' pathway."
At this time, Hobert reminded: "This also means that Zaratul is very likely to attract Amon's high-sequence avatar to Backlund!"
The other members were stunned, especially Leonard: "That's something I didn't think of."
He sighed in his heart: How many avatars does Amon actually have?
