chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 654 Human Skeleton Found in the Decaying Forest
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The members of the Tarot Club did not expect that although the Backlund bombing had ended, this international metropolis would become even more turbulent.
Not only did a Sequence 1 Angel of the "Seer" pathway arrive, but this Angel was also very likely to attract a clone of Amon.
"The Star" Leonard asked, "Why would the Archangel of the 'Seer' pathway appear in Backlund?"
Klein manipulated "The World" to answer, "It seems to be related to the Evernight Goddess's plan."
Leonard was even more confused: "What plan does the Goddess have?"
The other members were also stunned and curious about what plan the Evernight Goddess might have.
Among them, "Justice" Audrey suddenly realized: Unknowingly, we have become so calm when discussing gods and their plans.
"The Hanged Man" Alger realized the difference in this matter: Previously, we also exchanged information about gods, but those were basically things that happened in the last epoch or several epochs ago, but this time, we are mentioning a plan that the gods are currently carrying out.
"I'm not very clear about the specifics either." "The World" said: "But according to my observations, the Evernight Goddess seems to want to create chaos in Backlund."
Based on the previous few prayers, Klein keenly realized that the Goddess seemed unable to descend recently.
As for why she couldn't descend, he guessed that it might be to accommodate the Uniqueness of the "Death" pathway, but he wasn't sure about his guess and just felt that this idea was more reasonable.
As for the Goddess's plan, Klein guessed that the arrival of Zaratul and Amon's clone might be because the Evernight Goddess was afraid that her inability to descend would be known by her enemies, so she wanted to create chaos in Backlund, so that the Goddess's enemies' actions in Backlund would be somewhat constrained.
What Klein couldn't understand was that the Goddess seemed to have prevented Zaratul from advancing to Sequence 1 before, and the Evernight Goddess Church's attitude towards Amon's clone was also not very friendly.
Letting these two guys come would indeed cause the extraordinary world of Backlund to be somewhat chaotic, but there was also a high possibility that they would discover that the Evernight Goddess had been unable to descend for a while recently, right?
At the Tarot Club, Hobert, who had read the "script," was very clear: The Goddess now wished that the whole world knew that she couldn't descend! As for the reason why she couldn't descend, it was of course because she was "trying to accommodate the Uniqueness of the Death pathway"! It didn't matter whether others believed it or not, as long as it gave the God of Combat enough sense of urgency.
Everyone had their own guesses about "The World's" words, but they all felt that they were not getting to the point.
So they habitually looked at "The Emperor" together, and Hobert smiled and said: "Our focus has been on the Southern Continent recently, and we don't know much about the situation in Backlund."
Then he added: "Even if I were in Backlund, that would be a god's plan, how could Beyonders like us understand it?
"I suggest we wait and see for this kind of thing. When the Goddess's plan finally has a result, we will naturally be able to roughly guess the Goddess's plan through some performances of the Evernight Goddess Church."
Everyone smiled helplessly. Of course, they understood what "The Emperor" meant: This is a god's plan. As an ordinary Beyonder, do you still want to participate in the god's plan?
Soon, Alger started a new topic: "According to my observation, the Storm Church is not very active in this war."
Klein was somewhat surprised: Not very active? This doesn't fit the image of the Storm Church. Although their teachings neither advocate fighting nor promote war, they definitely emphasize treating enemies with storm-like ferocity and venting any anger on the spot.
But then he thought: The "Sailor" pathway and the "Spectator" pathway are adjacent pathways that can be exchanged at a high level, and there are huge contradictions between them. Even if the "Lord of Storms" tacitly allows George III to become the "Black Emperor," it is unlikely that he will sit idly by and watch Adam ascend to the throne of God by borrowing the "tide of the times."
Klein thought of the "Sailors" who were trying hard to restrain themselves and sighed in his heart: It's really hard for them.
Hobert responded to Alger: "This is normal. After all, the 'Sailor' cannot support the 'Spectator's' plan to become a god."
He said: "But it's hard to say in the future. Currently, either the Feysac Empire will be quickly defeated, or George III will give up becoming a god, otherwise the war may continue for a while.
"And if this war continues, anything could happen."
Alger commented: "The current situation is becoming more and more confusing."
At the same time, he thought: I also think so. Precisely because it is an adjacent pathway to the "Spectator," the Church is unwilling to see itself helping Adam realize his plan.
"Justice" Audrey, who knew some inside information, thought of the Intis's strange silence in this war and was vaguely worried.
At the same time, this was also Earl Hall's worry. In theory, it was normal for the Feynapotter Kingdom to have not yet expressed its position, after all, it was the weakest of the four countries in the Northern Continent, and the previous large-scale wars were also like this, it would not easily declare war, nor would it easily take sides.
But the Intis Republic, as the second strongest country in the Northern Continent, has not yet expressed its position, which is very strange!
"The Hermit" Cattleya also understood what "The Emperor" meant based on the corresponding mystical knowledge. She did not discuss the current situation in the Northern Continent, but talked about a question that she had always had in her heart: "According to some information I have learned, almost all pathways have adjacent pathways.
"But only the 'Monster' pathway seems to have no adjacent pathways. This phenomenon is a bit strange."
"The Magician" Fors suddenly realized that through the previous transaction with Hobert, they almost knew most of the adjacent pathways among the 22 pathways:
"Apprentice," "Seer," and "Marauder" are adjacent pathways; "Spectator," "Sailor," "Reader," "Scribe," and "Secret Suppliant" are adjacent pathways.
There are also "Warrior," "Sleepless," and "Corpse Collector" that are adjacent pathways. The rest are two adjacent pathways, "Lawyer" and "Arbiter," "Hunter" and "Assassin," "Prisoner" and "Criminal," "Savant" and "Mystery Pryer."
Fors hadn't noticed before that there was indeed only one pathway left among the 22 pathways, and it was the "Monster" pathway that they had rarely mentioned before. It seemed that they had only briefly mentioned this pathway when trading information about the King of Angels, Ouroboros.
At this time, almost all the other members understood what the Hermit meant. All pathways have adjacent pathways. Suddenly, there is such a pathway without adjacent pathways, which is strange in itself.
Hobert smiled and said: "Has everyone ever thought about a question? Many non-adjacent pathways, but there are some similar abilities between them.
"For example, the Witch's frost attack is very similar to the frost attack of the 'Prisoner' pathway, and for example, the 'Lawyer's' charm is also very similar to the Witch's charm, and there is also the 'Hunter's' fireball and the 'Criminal' pathway's fireball. There are many such examples."
This made Klein suddenly think of "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina, who mentioned a theory in "Groselle's Travels."
Since this topic has been discussed here, he shared his conversation with "Vice Admiral Iceberg" at that time: "I have heard of such a thing. A long time ago, some Beyonder creatures tried to collect the Beyonder characteristics of an element.
"For example, as 'The Emperor' said, the frost abilities of the Witch and the 'Prisoner' pathways. At that time, the Beyonder characteristics did not seem to be as stable as they are now. It would be more accurate to call them mystical elements.
"In short, those Beyonder creatures tried their best to collect frost-like elements. Their abilities did not become stronger, but they were more prone to losing control."
Klein guessed: "This makes me think of such a point of view. Could it be that our current Beyonder characteristics were originally pure Beyonder elements?
"In the random devouring of Beyonder creatures, these elements merged with each other and formed the initial Beyonder characteristics.
"In the Second Epoch, through the repeated crushing and reorganization of the ancient gods, the elements presented a state that could make creatures more stable after devouring them.
"Until the appearance of the 'Blasphemy Slate,' these combinations were completely formalized, so there are now Beyonder characteristics?"
Everyone first felt a heavy sense of history, and then felt that "The World's" idea made a lot of sense.
Cattleya thought: Theoretically, Beyonder characteristics should have an initial state. The abilities at that time should be relatively simple. For example, the "Mystery Pryer" pathway would only perform "Spellcasting," for example, the "Apprentice" would only shuttle through the spirit world. Under some coincidences, Beyonder creatures discovered that these elements with distorted characteristics could be balanced to a certain extent, so they gradually developed to the current Beyonder characteristics.
The other members also had similar ideas and felt that the formation process of Beyonder characteristics was the process of resisting the distorted characteristics of Beyonder abilities.
"This is exactly what I want to say." Hobert said: "This should also involve the issue of Beyonder characteristics becoming more and more 'warm.' The owner of each Beyonder characteristic should have left a trace of spiritual residue in the characteristic.
"This makes the Beyonder characteristics that were originally very cold and not suitable for creatures to take gradually resonate with the creatures and have an opportunity to merge with each other."
The other members realized that the opportunity "The Emperor" was talking about might be the "Acting Method."
Hobert continued: "I don't know if everyone remembers the issue of divinity that we talked about before.
"In my opinion, divinity is similar to the 'consciousness of the universe,' which are some cold abstract products for creatures.
The Beyonder characteristics derived from these products are, of course, distorted and cold to living beings.
But in my opinion, after generations of spiritual residue 'warming' them, these Beyonder characteristics should be much 'softer' than they were at the beginning.
He paused and added: "Even if there was a process of mutual fusion of Beyonder elements a long time ago, the main authority of a pathway, that is, the Uniqueness, will not change."
"So the extraordinary is still distorted to living beings, and it is still difficult to tame."
"After learning about the above guesses, let's look at the 'Monster' pathway again. Perhaps it does not have adjacent pathways, but its adjacent pathways are scattered into other pathways?"
Hobert smiled and said: "This is my guess. There is no evidence at present, but as far as I know, after the 'Sleepless' becomes a demigod, they have the ability of 'Misfortune'. This ability is to temporarily change the fate of the target, making the target very unlucky."
"Also, as we said before, Amon's ability to steal fate, it is difficult to say whether he can steal the target's fate without similar authority related to the fate pathway?"
The hall was silent for a few seconds, and everyone was digesting the "Emperor's" words.
Alger was the first to say: "It is very possible, because the main Beyonder characteristics are scattered, and the corresponding authority is also scattered, so the corresponding Uniqueness is also diluted?
"Or because there are no Beyonders in that pathway, so the Uniqueness of that pathway has returned to the state of 'Cosmic Consciousness'?"
The other members first felt that the "Hanged Man's" guess was very reasonable, and then they realized one by one that what they were discussing was the most core part of the Beyonder world.
Moreover, such discussions do not seem to have too much information that can be referred to, and it is also difficult to verify!
This is like a physics student who has been studying very hard. When he finally makes some guesses about the universe, he finds that there is no literature to refer to and no theory to support it.
At this time, he belatedly realized that his thinking was already at the forefront of physics.
Hobert added: "There is another possibility, that is, the adjacent pathways of the Fate pathway are not in the real world!"
Everyone was stunned again. At this time, most of the members could not keep up with Hobert's thinking and had to work hard to understand what he meant.
Only Klein, Alger, and Cattleya could keep up with Hobert's thinking, mainly because they were discussing with Hobert.
Cattleya asked after hearing Hobert's new point of view: "Not in the real world, is it in the spirit world?"
"Maybe it's in the spirit world." At present, Hobert has no plans to talk about the Beyonder characteristics that initially tore apart the Outer Gods, so he did not make a specific explanation: "Maybe it's in other places."
Cattleya chewed on Hobert's answer: "Other places?"
At this time, "The World" sitting at the bottom suddenly said: "For example, the cosmos."
Cattleya instantly associated it with the Outer Gods, but because of the lack of key information, some of her guesses stopped there.
Hobert suddenly clapped his hands: "I suggest that we only discuss this issue here, and continue the discussion after we have further clues."
Everyone nodded slowly, because the lack of sufficient clues made it impossible to continue the discussion.
However, the discussion just now was enough for everyone to savor, at least basically clarifying the characteristics of "Beyonder characteristics".
After spending more than ten seconds digesting the content of the discussion just now, the Tarot Club members all looked at "The Sun" Derrick.
At the Tarot Club last week, Derrick's exploration team had already arrived at the afternoon town camp and planned to rest for a day before exploring the "Giant King's Court". So at this time, their exploration should have ended.
Derrick sat up straight and said very consciously: "We have completed the first exploration of the 'Giant King's Court'. Three people died, one person was missing, and five people survived.
"We first arrived at the main entrance of the royal court and saw two 'Silver Knights' guarding there in an unknown state."
He explained very considerately: "'Silver Knight' is the name of Sequence 3 of the 'Giant' pathway."
Everyone was stunned for a moment before they realized that the "Giant" pathway was the "Warrior" pathway.
"The Moon" Emlyn, Audrey and several other members all felt almost the same in their hearts: As expected of the 'Giant King's Court', the kingdom of the ancient god, actually using two Sequence 3 demigods to guard the main entrance.
Only Hobert thought in his heart: What a waste.
This made him think that among the Beyonders in the military that he cultivated, many Beyonders in the "Warrior" pathway have already been promoted to Sequence 7. Should he find an opportunity to obtain these two "Silver Knight" Beyonder characteristics?
At this time, Derrick continued: "According to a hidden passage provided by Mr. World, we bypassed to the back of the 'Giant King's Court', and encountered many monsters mainly composed of wraiths along the way…"
Klein, who had watched the "live broadcast" with "True Sight" at the time, sighed: Little Sun is really not a storyteller.
The battles that took place along the way were very exciting, allowing Klein to see the close cooperation of the City of Silver exploration team, which is rarely seen elsewhere.
"After arriving at the 'Withered Forest', we tried to explore it." Derrick said: "Soon we discovered that the Giant King's remaining will and the power of the Divine Kingdom combined to form an evil spirit.
"It is guarding the mausoleum of its parents…"
This reminded Audrey and Leonard of their previous exploration experience with "The World" in "Groselle's Travels". According to the giant guard, the Giant King even prevented his queen and children from approaching the "Withered Forest".
Derrick stopped here, and subconsciously recalled the scene he saw at the time before continuing: "After purifying that evil spirit, we came to the tomb of the Giant King's parents.
"There was a stone tablet erected there, indicating the identity of the tomb owner, and the tomb and coffin had been opened. Inside… inside there were two human remains!"
Hearing this, Cattleya's first reaction was that the two corpses had other identities: Godfather and godmother? No, there was no religion at that time?
Then, she recalled some questions that the Queen had thought of after being inspired by Emperor Roselle: Why do even ancient literature and historical data refer to giants, elves, and Sanguine as humanoid creatures or human-like creatures?
Why not call humans giant-like, elf-like, or Sanguine-like creatures?
Then Cattleya thought of the "Emperor's" previous explanation of the "humanoid creature camp" in the Second Epoch. She remembered that there was a key point that the "Emperor" did not explain, only saying that he would explain it after he had evidence.
She suspected that the "Emperor" already had some guesses about this at that time?
Alger suspected for the first time that someone had faked the scene, but he thought that it was not as simple as just taking away the real bones and replacing them with human bones.
It is also necessary to prepare a suitable coffin so that the specifications of the tomb do not look like it belongs to a giant. The key is that this kind of forgery has no practical significance and will not have too much impact on reality.
This made Alger feel that no one should do such a boring thing.
Finally, he touched his hair and thought of his father, who was a mixed race of elves and humans.
Thinking of this, Alger was the first to accept this fact.
At this moment, Emlyn was the most surprised member, and his mind was full of thoughts of "impossible" and "this is impossible": If the ancestor of the giants is human, what about the Sanguine? Are we just monsters produced by Beyonder characteristic mutations?
Emlyn denied it again in his heart: Impossible! We were clearly created by the ancestor himself. He has the authority of "Life" and "Creation", which is completely different from the barbaric gods like the Giant King and the Elf King who only know how to fight.
But his intuition, his rationality, and his brain all told him that "The Sun" had no motivation to lie about this matter.
"This reminds me of a previous guess about the Second Epoch." Hobert said: "'The Sun's' description provides key evidence for that guess."
Cattleya: As expected.
The other members were also attracted by Hobert's words from the surprise just now and all looked in the direction of the "Emperor".
Hobert said seriously: "Do you all remember the 'humanoid creature camp' and the 'non-human creature camp' that we mentioned when we were talking about the camps of the ancient gods in the Second Epoch?
"At that time, I questioned the names of these two camps and made two guesses. The first guess was that all the existing information about the Second Epoch was written by humans, so the camps were distinguished from a human perspective."
Everyone recalled the transaction at that time, and also recalled the second guess that the "Emperor" did not explain at that time. Combined with the description of "The Sun", everyone seemed to immediately understand why the "Emperor" would have reservations at that time.
Because that guess was indeed too shocking without evidence!
Hobert continued: "My second guess is that the Giant King, the Elf King, and the Sanguine Ancestor all clearly knew that their respective races were derived from humans.
"So they all acknowledge the name 'humanoid creature camp'."
"Why?" Emlyn asked somewhat excitedly: "Mr. Emperor, why is this? I mean, I mean humans will evolve into giants, elves, and blood races?"
Hobert was not as serious as he was just now: "We just discussed this issue."
Emlyn's face was ashen: "Because of Beyonder characteristics?"
"That's right, Beyonder characteristics." Hobert said: "Beyonder characteristics are not friendly to any living being. Their appearance caused some humans to undergo drastic mutations in a short period of time."
He continued to explain, "This also explains why the Giant King and the others didn't accept the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti into their camp, because in their eyes, demons are not creatures derived from humans."
Cattleya sighed, "Many questions are now making sense."
Klein thought of another question, and he manipulated 'The World' to ask, "In other words, humans existed before Beyonder characteristics? And Beyonder characteristics seemed to appear suddenly?"
Hobert smiled and said, "I don't know."
He thought to himself, "There should be relevant clues in that stack of diaries you just put away."
This topic caused all the members to sigh inwardly for more than ten seconds. Derrick also calmed down before continuing, "After leaving the 'Withered Forest,' we entered the interior of the 'Giant's Royal Court' through the 'Barren Tunnel.'"
"The power of 'Corruption' and 'Concealment' remained along the way, and we had to respond correctly to pass through."
"Inside that palace, there were murals containing the power of 'Cycle of Fate.' We were affected by it and transformed into people attending a gathering, repeating a process."
He solemnly said, "That was the process of the 'Rose Redemption' being established!"

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 655 Mushrooms of Various Flavors
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The members were all very curious. What kind of scene would it be when "Sun" Derrick and the others were affected, replaying the scene from thousands of years ago?
At the same time, they felt the power of the King of Angels. Thousands of years had passed, and the power of "Angel of Fate " Ouroboros still remained.
But they found themselves not too surprised, because "Emperor" had already traded information about the "Rose Redemption" with them.
They were all very clear about how outrageous the first members of this organization were. Through some descriptions from "Little Sun" before, they also knew that the members of "Rose Redemption" often gathered in the "Giant King's Court."
Only "Star" Leonard listened very carefully. Although he had asked Pallez Zoroast for information about the "Rose Redemption," it was clear that the old man only knew the names of most of the first members and did not know too many details about this organization.
Derrick continued: "The two conveners of the 'Rose Redemption' are 'Dark Angel' Sasir, 'Evernight Goddess' Amanesis..."
Leonard was stunned: Goddess... the name of the Goddess...
"Participants include 'Pure White Angel' Aucuses, etc." Derrick said, "Its members are exactly the same as the information from Mr. Emperor before."
At this time, "Hanged Man" Alger said: "Actually, you can say it again."
"Hermit" Cattleya also chimed in: "Yes, we all want to hear the person involved say it again."
Hobert smiled: You just want to hear the names of these gods, right?
When he traded with everyone before, he didn't mention many of the true names of the gods, but the unsuspecting Derrick directly described what he had heard and seen.
How could these two old foxes miss such an opportunity?
Seeing "Sun's" doubts, Alger realized that under his constant guidance, the current "Sun" was no longer the original "Little Sun," so he said again: "Before this, I obtained some true names of gods, so I wanted to verify them through your description."
Derrick felt the sincerity of Mr. Hanged Man, so he said: "Okay, Mr. Hanged Man, there are also 'Wind Angel' Leodero, 'God of Combat' Badheil...'"
After saying all the honorifics and true names of the members, Leonard sighed and exclaimed: "'Rose Redemption' is really powerful and terrifying!"
Because except for Leonard, the other members did not show too much surprise, so Derrick continued: "We encountered the leader of the 'Royal Court Hunter,' 'Light Culler' Murskogan, outside the Giant King's Palace.
"He said that 'Dark Angel' Sasir was sleeping in that palace. After that, we returned, and Mr. Fool bestowed upon us the 'Silver Knight' potion formula."
"Justice" Audrey was listening with great interest, but suddenly realized that the story had ended.
"Magician" Fors laughed and thought: If I left such an ending when writing a book, I would definitely receive blades from readers.
Leonard rubbed his chest, feeling like someone had punched him in the face with such an ending.
And "Moon" Emlyn was still very conflicted, sometimes thinking that the Sanguine was just a derivative of humans, and sometimes thinking that this idea was blasphemy against the Progenitor!
Cattleya was savoring the information obtained at this Tarot meeting. She felt that when she returned to the real world, the "Mysticologist" potion should be completely digested.
The hall was quiet for a while, and Klein manipulated "World" to say to Derrick: "I recently harvested a batch of mushrooms that can grow and reproduce in the dark by devouring the flesh and blood of monsters. I wonder if your City of Silver is interested?"
Fors sighed: It can actually devour monsters? Sure enough, there are many things in the world that we have not yet understood.
Cattleya's eyes suddenly deepened a little, sitting upright, without speaking or moving, like a statue.
Derrick was overjoyed when he heard this and blurted out: "Can those mushrooms actively attack monsters?"
Klein's mouth twitched slightly: I thought "Little Sun" would be afraid of those mushrooms, but his request was even more excessive.
He manipulated "World" and said: "No, if the mushrooms can actively attack monsters, you will also become their target."
Derrick was a little ashamed and nodded quickly: "I understand, Mr. World."
"World" gave a further description: "Some of those mushrooms can be ground into flour, some can produce milk, some are rich in oil, taste like beef, and some have a texture close to fish, but without bones.
"Except for milk, which can be drunk directly, the others must be cooked by steaming, boiling, frying, grilling, etc. Otherwise, those mushrooms will absorb flesh and blood in the body, restore their activity, and turn a person into countless mushrooms from the inside out."
Audrey, Alger, and other members were listening to a novel and interesting story, but Cattleya's eyelids twitched, and she decided to have a good "talk" with Frank after returning to the real world.
She was very worried that one day when her pirate group held a crew vote, a large number of mushrooms would cast a solemn vote.
At this time, Derrick, after listening to the relevant description, asked curiously: "Mr. World, what is flour? Is it like black grass powder?
"Also, what is milk, what is beef, what is fish?"
In fact, he had seen fish, but he didn't think those fish were the same kind of creatures as "World's" description.
Not far from the southwest of City of Silver, there is a swamp with many strangely shaped, highly poisonous fish-like creatures.
In City of Silver, anyone with basic common sense knows that fish cannot be eaten unless they want to commit suicide.
Klein manipulated "World" to turn his gaze to Audrey. Describing what flour, milk, beef, and fish are in detail does not fit Gehrman Sparrow's persona.
As a senior "Spectator," Audrey instantly understood what the other party wanted to express, and she was happy to help.
Audrey considered for a moment and said: "Milk can provide a lot of nutrition and help you grow taller and stronger..."
She didn't finish her words, because the "Sun" sitting opposite her was already very burly.
So Audrey turned to explaining beef and flour and other foods.
After "Justice" explained those concepts, Derrick looked at "World" with fervent eyes: "Thank you, Mr. World, like electric lights, this is exactly what our City of Silver needs.
"After I go back, I will immediately tell the Chief, he will definitely be happy too."
Then he asked: "What do you want in exchange?"
Klein hesitated for a moment before using "World" to say: "The 'Classical Alchemist' potion formula."
No! Cattleya subconsciously wanted to open her mouth to stop him, but in the end, she restrained her impulse.
She quietly glanced at Mr. Fool, and seeing that this great existence didn't say anything, she felt a lot more at ease.
Hobert on the opposite side saw Cattleya's body language and almost laughed out loud: You don't think there's no problem with "Fool" backing you, do you? Maybe Mr. Fool feels a lot more at ease in his heart that you didn't stop him at this time.
At this time, Alger asked "Emperor": "Can electric lights be used on ships?"
He was playing the role of a pirate and saw electric lights when looting merchant ships, so he had this question.
"It is possible." Hobert came back to his senses: "But you have to bring more batteries, because the ship-borne small generator is still under development."
Alger nodded as if he understood: "Looking forward to the day when the development is successful."
At the end of the gathering, "World" looked around and said: "Everyone in Backlund, please pay close attention to whether there are any abnormalities around you."
"Okay." Audrey and Leonard nodded one after another.
Hobert realized that George III's ascension ceremony was not far away. He had been busy with the founding of the country recently and had not had a good talk with Klein.
So he said: "After the gathering, we will immediately complete the transaction."
Klein didn't think much about it and let "World" agree.
This Tarot meeting ended, and figures disappeared above the gray fog at the same time, leaving only "Fool" Klein.
He began to look through the diary in his hand:
"November 21st, because I made too many preparations in the early stage, I obtained that chaotic and terrifying Grade 0 Sealed Artifact faster than I imagined.
"Then, after a difficult contest, with some help, I finally restored it to a pure Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic..."
This page of the diary is basically Roselle's description of his process of advancing to the adjacent pathway Sequence 1 "Knowledge Emperor." The next page also contains Roselle's process of landing on the moon.
Unfortunately, the order of these diaries is a bit messy. The next page becomes the content of a conversation with Mr. "Door," or a conversation with Hermes.
Continuing to look down, Klein was pleasantly surprised to find that Roselle recorded the role of the nine mausoleums of the "Black Emperor" in his diary, as well as the location of the most secret mausoleum.
Similar to his previous guess, it was on that mysterious island he discovered during his early voyages.
After reading all the diaries, Klein's spirituality felt something, and he looked again at Roselle's description of landing on the moon, as if he had missed some important information.
…
The Berserk Sea, Longtail Island Governor's Mansion.
Hobert returned to the real world with Fors, and he immediately sat up and said: "I'm going to complete a transaction with 'Mr. World'.
"Oh, right, I will invite Mr. 'World' to be a guest recently. You let the kitchen prepare a little special cuisine."
Fors of course remembered Hobert's separate exchange with "World" at the gathering that had just ended, but she didn't expect Hobert to invite "World" to be a guest.
Immediately after, Fors was somewhat looking forward to "The World's" arrival, wanting to observe the legendary adventurer up close: "Alright, I'll instruct the kitchen."
Hobert kissed Fors on the forehead before using "Travel" to return to Backlund. First, he took out the "Tyrant" card from the "Nation of Disorder" and completed the transaction with "The World."
Immediately afterward, Hobert prayed to "The Fool": "The Fool who does not belong to this era… Respected Mr. Fool, please tell 'The World' that I invite him to dinner at the Governor's mansion on Longtail Island tomorrow night to discuss important matters."
Soon, Hobert received a reply from "The World": "Alright, I will arrive around five o'clock in the afternoon."
Having settled this matter, Hobert was about to go to the Principality of South Balam again when the butler, Dophis, suddenly came to report: "Your Grace, Mr. Leonard is here. He seems very anxious and appears to have something important to discuss with you."
Hobert was stunned. He looked at the clock in the study. Only half an hour had passed since the Tarot Gathering ended. What urgent matter could Leonard have encountered?
He hurried to the hall and indeed saw that Leonard's expression was different from usual.
Leonard, who usually exuded a carefree aura, seemed somewhat nervous and incredulous at this moment. He greeted Hobert proactively, and when he was close enough, he whispered: "Her Excellence Arianna invites you to a meeting at the cathedral."
Hobert was also stunned: "Who?"
"Her Excellence Arianna!"
Hobert, after confirming that it was the angel of the "Darkness" pathway, the head of the Evernight Goddess Church's archbishops, took a deep breath and said: "Where is she now?"
Leonard replied: "At Saint Samuel Cathedral."
Hobert could understand Leonard's feelings at this moment. Especially being asked to invite me, this guy is probably wondering if his participation in the Tarot Gathering has been discovered?
However, Hobert quickly calmed down and realized that Arianna herself or the Evernight Goddess Church was looking for him to discuss something, which was not detrimental to him. Otherwise, the entire Duke's mansion would have been pulled into the "Concealed World" by now.
Hobert simply used "Travel" to arrive at Saint Samuel Cathedral. Under Leonard's guidance, Hobert arrived at the backyard of the cathedral, an inconspicuous reception room.
Arianna, barefoot and wearing a simple robe, and Archbishop Anthony, wearing a clerical robe, were both in the reception room.
After Hobert entered, Archbishop Anthony warmly got up to greet him and exchanged pleasantries. Then, Hobert said to Arianna: "Ma'am."
Arianna showed a very kind smile: "I hope I haven't disturbed you."
She pointed to the chair opposite her: "Please sit down."
At Archbishop Anthony's prompting, Leonard left the reception room and closed the door.
Hobert immediately felt some changes in the surrounding space. At this moment, the entire room was already in a "Concealed" state.
As soon as Hobert sat down, Arianna said: "The war in Winter County is currently very fierce. Most of the God of Combat Church's elites are there, and conflicts often occur between us."
"Three days ago, we received reliable information that an angel from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church was active near the battlefield. It is said that he came to investigate the strange sunlight that appeared before."
Hearing this, Hobert smiled. He knew that the Eternal Blazing Sun Church would definitely conduct some investigations, but he didn't take it too seriously.
Because the Tamara family's hiding place was relatively sensitive, not far from the battlefield, the Eternal Blazing Sun would be very cautious when sending people to investigate.
By the time they went, Lawrence and the others would have already withdrawn, and the "Creator" had also interfered with the scene, so the Eternal Blazing Sun Church would not be able to trace it back to the "Creator" for the time being.
Even if they traced it back to the "Creator," it wouldn't matter, because Hobert's actions at the time looked like he had used a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, and they wouldn't realize that it was a high-imitation Uniqueness.
The Eternal Blazing Sun was not the Lord of Storms, and in the current situation where the Intis Republic might join the war at any time, it was impossible for them to impulsively ask the "Creator" for high-grade Sealed Artifacts of the "Sun" pathway.
Arianna continued: "The God of Combat Church seems to have promised that angel some benefits. In yesterday's conflict, that angel from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church coordinated with the God of Combat Church's actions."
"In our opinion, this is a very dangerous thing."
Hobert was slightly stunned and, of course, understood Arianna's meaning. Originally, the three angels on both sides were evenly matched in terms of demigod-level power.
Suddenly, another angel appeared. Even if this angel was only coordinating and had no intention of directly clashing with the Evernight Goddess Church, the balance had been broken.
Hobert considered for a moment before saying: "Ma'am, this angel was likely attracted by our actions, but we didn't expect him to be bought by the God of Combat Church."
He spoke very euphemistically, expressing the core meaning: We are not responsible for this!
Arianna said amiably: "We didn't expect it either."
"According to the previous frequency of battles, we will have another large-scale confrontation with the God of Combat Church in three or four days."
"We hope that the 'Creator' can dispatch an angel and several demigods to confront the angel of the Eternal Blazing Sun."
She paused and said: "We will pay a certain reward."
Hobert finally understood: No wonder she was so polite, she was asking for my help.
He pondered for a moment before asking: "May I ask what the reward is?"
Arianna said calmly: "Two 'Blasphemy Cards.'"
Hobert couldn't help but take a deep breath: "May I ask what cards?"
"'Justiciar' and 'Error.'" Arianna replied.
Hobert felt goosebumps all over his body. These two cards were exactly what he needed.
Arianna, of course, noticed Hobert's strangeness. This was the reward that the Goddess specified when she reported this matter to the Evernight Goddess.
She immediately realized that this was something that Duke Hobert, or the "Creator," greatly needed.
At the same time, Arianna had a deeper understanding of the alliance between the Evernight Goddess and the "Creator." Before, she only thought that both sides had released goodwill and had no conflicts of interest, belonging to the kind of relationship that would not be enemies.
But now it seemed that the Goddess had a very good understanding of the "Creator's" power and that it should not be as simple as a shallow cooperation.
It was precisely because the Goddess understood the "Creator's" power that this negotiation should be easily successful.
In Arianna's opinion, using two "Blasphemy Cards" to ask an angel to take action was a very cost-effective deal. After all, the Loen Kingdom gave Hobert a duchy, and the "Creator's" power stood on the side of Loen.
However, Hobert's sneak attack on Saint Millon and his enmity with the Feysac Empire did not mean that they were also willing to treat the God of Combat Church as an enemy.
Hobert took a deep breath, stabilized his emotions, and asked: "May I ask, what are the sources of these two cards respectively?"
Arianna replied: "'The Justiciar' card comes from the sacrifice of a royal family member's believer, and 'The Error' card comes from the encirclement and killing of an Amon avatar decades ago."
Hobert already had an idea in his mind, but he knew the principle of "playing the part thoroughly," so he said: "Please prepare a quiet room for me. I need to report this matter to the 'Creator.'"
Arianna nodded slowly, and Archbishop Anthony led Hobert to a room next door.
Hobert pretended to pray in the room and whispered about the transaction that Arianna had just proposed. Then, after waiting for two or three minutes, he pretended to praise the "Creator."
After getting up, Hobert, accompanied by Archbishop Anthony at the door, returned to Arianna again: "The 'Creator' has agreed to this transaction."
He paused and said: "I will also participate in the war at that time. When an angel needs to take action, give me a signal, and I will guide the target for that angel."
Arianna had read the relevant reports and knew that the state of the angel who was loyal to the "Creator" seemed to be not quite right, but they seemed to have a way to restore to their peak state in a short time.
So, Arianna did not express any doubts at the moment. The two sides agreed that Hobert would bring a few demigods to the Amanda Mountains on Wednesday afternoon to meet with the Beyonders of the Evernight Goddess Church.
Coming out of Saint Musser Cathedral, Hobert took a deep breath and sighed in his heart: With the "Error" card, "The Fool" can basically help me complete the operation of "grafting" bloodlines.
Originally, he had to think of alternative solutions, but now it seems unnecessary.
In this way, his plan has become very feasible again. Currently, there is only one step left: obtaining a trace of Erebus's spirituality.
In the evening, Hobert came to the Governor's mansion on Longtail Island and had a rare good night's sleep.
The next morning, Fors got up unusually at seven o'clock, and Dorian was brought over around eight o'clock.
Today, Hobert also specially took out most of the day to accompany Dorian to visit the factories and newly built water conservancy projects on Longtail Island.
Sitting in the carriage, Dorian, with his very broad shoulders, looked at the dams and canals and couldn't help but ask: "Is the grain yield on Longtail Island much higher than on the North Continent?"
Hobert replied with a smile: "With these water conservancy facilities, plus we have improved the seeds of wheat and rice, the current yield per mu is about four times that of the North Continent."
"The locals are not yet accustomed to the farm tools given to them. When they are proficient and have a habit of intensive cultivation, the yield per mu will definitely continue to increase, reaching about six times."
Such a terrifying increase in production is inseparable from the re-cultivation of seeds by the priests of the Earth Mother Church.
The corresponding water conservancy facilities only serve as an important auxiliary function, because the demand for water and fertilizer also increases exponentially after production increases.
Dorian added, "Even so, it should take a long time for these water conservancy facilities to recover their costs, right?"
"At least a dozen years," Hobert said with a smile. "But by that time, we will definitely need to do new reinforcement and construction."
He certainly understood what Dorian was asking: "For a power, such investment is necessary."
"Because we must ensure that we have enough food supply to avoid being coerced by some forces with food in the future."
Dorian smiled and said, "This concept is very novel, and such precautions are indeed necessary."
Fors, who was listening to the conversation between the two, showed a heartfelt smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 656: Preparations for digging the King's grave
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Fors had always respected Dorian, partly because he had indeed given Fors a lot of help, and partly because Fors had lacked paternal love since childhood.
Dorian's appearance somewhat made up for her regret of not having a father's love.
So she was very happy to see Hobert talking to Dorian so cheerfully.
The carriage moved slowly forward, and Dorian saw the clothes of the local natives again: "The dressing style here is obviously different from that of the Northern Continent. Is that a vest?"
Hobert explained: "When we first came here, the locals didn't even have the habit of wearing clothes. So, based on the local environment, we improved some of the clothes from the Northern Continent.
"Their tops are similar to vests, except that the shoulders are slightly wider, so that their skin won't be chafed when they carry burdens. We call it a 'waistcoat'.
"There's nothing to say about the pants. They're just a little shorter. They're called shorts."
Vests are not suitable for farm work, so Hobert used the 'waistcoat' from his memory.
Dorian sighed: "This is a land with an innovative atmosphere."
He smiled and said again: "If I had known there was such a place when I was young, I would definitely have moved here."
Hobert smiled: "I can prepare a house for you here and let Fors give you the corresponding pass. You can use our teleportation array with the pass to come here often to take a look.
"Especially in the winter in the Northern Continent, it is still very warm here, so you can come here to spend the winter."
Dorian was a little tempted: "Thank you!"
But he then added: "However, I cannot accept your gift, but I can buy a house."
Hobert was not polite: "Okay, I'll leave this matter to Fors."
As he spoke, he glanced at Fors. Of course, Fors understood. He would give Dorian some discounts when the time came.
Dorian then said: "Regarding the teleportation array, Fors mentioned it to me in a letter. It is said to come from a relic of a 'Door' Mr. believer, right?"
After the teleportation array was built on Longtail Island, Fors first communicated with Hobert before writing to Dorian about it.
"That's right," Hobert replied.
Dorian asked again: "Can you tell me where that relic is?"
Hobert said: "I can't tell you for the time being, because that relic is very dangerous now, and no one can go there at present."
Dorian couldn't hide his disappointment: "What a pity."
"At least the teleportation array has reappeared in the world," Hobert said with a smile.
Dorian also smiled and said: "That's right."
"Let's go, let's visit the teleportation array again!"
When Dorian saw the teleportation array operating non-stop, he was filled with emotion, recalling the records in the family's notes that the Abraham family once controlled all the teleportation arrays in the North and South Continents.
At that time, how prosperous the family was, and now look at it…
Soon it was lunchtime, and the atmosphere at the table was also very good.
While chatting, Dorian tactfully inquired about the situation of the "Creator" forces.
Hobert smiled and said: "You should be a Beyonder of the 'Apprentice' pathway, right?"
Dorian nodded: "Yes."
Hobert said casually: "Some of the original members of the Theosophy Council are now serving the 'Creator', including many Beyonders of the 'Apprentice' pathway."
Fors had previously revealed the news about the South Colson battle to Dorian. At that time, she mainly hoped that Teacher Dorian could also lead the clan to be loyal to the "Creator", so as to obtain the protection of the "Creator" and avoid continuing to suffer from the "Blood Moon Curse".
But at that time, and even until now, Dorian did not mention to Fors that he was a member of the Abraham family, only saying that he came from an organization.
Dorian was so cautious because this family currently does not have a demigod-level Beyonder, but they have Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts and much accumulations.
Their strength is not enough to protect these accumulations, so they dare not reveal their details at all.
At this time, Hobert talked about this matter, and Dorian was also filled with emotion. For him, that was news of another branch of the family members.
Dorian smiled and said: "This is one of the purposes of my visit today. I hope to learn more about them."
He finally decided to be frank and did not hide his purpose.
Hobert thought for a while before refusing: "I'm sorry, revealing too much information about them would violate our relevant regulations."
Dorian then smiled and said: "You don't need to apologize for this. I know this will make you very embarrassed. I shouldn't have made such a request, but I really want to know where their Beyonder characteristics come from?"
Hobert smiled and said: "You can let a few Beyonders of the 'Apprentice' pathway participate in the Traveler Research Association established by Fors. This research association also recruits members from the outside world.
"Many low-sequence members of the Theosophy Council have already joined this organization."
In the final analysis, Hobert did not want to recruit these Abraham family members represented by Dorian. It was not that he did not want to compete with Klein for people, but that their highest sequence was only sequence 7.
For the current "Creator" forces, there is no shortage of Beyonders at this level.
Especially after the establishment of the Traveler Research Association, Hobert will soon be able to cultivate a group of "Apprentice" pathway Beyonders who are loyal to him.
The Theosophy Council still has several demigods, but Dorian and the others are too weak.
They do have many Sealed Artifacts, but it is also impossible to sacrifice them to the "Creator".
And currently, the "Creator" does not need their sacrifices. It is only because of Fors's sake that Hobert allowed Dorian to send a few members to join the Traveler Research Association.
Regarding this point, Hobert has very clear principles. In terms of things that do not involve the interests of the organization, because of Fors's relationship, he respects Dorian very much.
But when it comes to the interests of the organization, he will not give Dorian and others too many preferential treatments.
Dorian thought about it, and this is also a way.
In fact, what Dorian wants to know most is what kind of protection the "Creator" specifically gave to the Abraham family members of the Theosophy Council?
He is very clear that if the Abraham family members want to be promoted to demigods, they must obtain the protection of the gods so that they can get rid of the "Blood Moon Curse".
Otherwise, after being promoted to sequence 6, the state will be very bad, and if there is a chance to be promoted to sequence 5, they will almost lose control after experiencing a "Blood Moon Curse"!
After evaluating the information fed back by the Theosophy Council with the main members of the family, Dorian will decide whether to reveal their cards to the "Creator" forces.
It's just that in Hobert's view, Dorian may not understand the current situation. By the time they make a decision, the day lilies will be cold.
The subsequent talks revolved around the current war in the Northern Continent, and of course, the air raid on Saint Millon was also mentioned.
Because under the vigorous publicity of the Loen Kingdom, the world has heard that the "Creator" took action at that time.
After Dorian confirmed this matter again, he sighed: "'Creator' is a benevolent god."
He is also very clear that ordinary gods are unlikely to take the risk of a war of gods to rescue a few subordinates. Of course, it cannot be ruled out that this is a kind of "team standing" performance.
The whole lunch ended in a pleasant atmosphere. They also took a walk on the beach together, and then Fors took Dorian away.
Through this half-day of observation, Dorian can be sure that Hobert's condition is very good, which proves that he has not been negatively affected by the "Creator".
Dorian decided that after returning, he would convene the main members of the Abraham family to discuss his trip to Longtail Island and discuss what attitude to take towards the "Creator" forces.
Hobert currently has no time to pay attention to the affairs of the Abraham family. He used the afternoon to go to Angers and notified several demigods that there would be an action tomorrow, so that they could prepare in advance.
Then Hobert also learned about the current trends of the Earth King and warlords. He was very pleased to find that this group of former Loen Kingdom agents had finally figured it out and had begun to threaten Angers with force.
Currently, Hobert's intelligence network in the Southern Continent is in the initial stage of creation and cannot provide too much useful information, but according to his guess, the local rulers and warlords should have received a strong aid, otherwise they would not have become tough just after hearing that Hobert was going to wanted them.
And this strong aid is likely to be the Highland Kingdom, because before the outbreak of the all-out war, there will not be too much conflict between the Intis Republic and the Feynapotter Kingdom and the Southern Balam Duchy.
This is an excellent window of opportunity. Currently, Hobert will wait a little longer. If these warlords do not openly rebel before or after George III becomes a god, he will take the initiative to attack.
The opportunity to digest the potion will come later, but this kind of strategic opportunity cannot be missed.
It was more than four o'clock in the afternoon when Hobert returned to Longtail Island and asked the servants to put up a canopy in the backyard of the Governor's Mansion, set up tables and chairs. He planned to dine here with Klein in a while.
While the servants were setting up the canopy, Fors, wearing a light sun dress, also came.
The two of them strolled and chatted on the beach in the sunset. Fors said: "I'm sorry Hobert, Teacher Dorian has experienced serious betrayal, which has made them very cautious."
"There's nothing to apologize for," Hobert said with a smile: "Because this is not your fault, this is just our treat to Dorian."
Fors sighed: "But in my opinion, this group of Abraham family members of Teacher Dorian has lost many opportunities. They should be more proactive."
Hobert said seriously, "There's one thing I hope you understand clearly: don't offer them too much help before Dorian actively requests it, otherwise it's likely to make things worse."
Fors nodded: "I know."
Just as he said this, the space on the beach suddenly became illusory. Klein, wearing the face of Gehrman Sparrow, stepped out from the spirit world and appeared in front of the two.
Hobert opened his arms and smiled warmly: "Welcome, welcome! Haha, our legendary adventurer, Mr. World!"
Then he introduced Fors to Klein. Klein had attended Hobert and Fors' wedding before, and also knew that Fors was the "Magician."
But this was the first official meeting between the two. They greeted each other, and Hobert invited Klein to the erected canopy, and they chatted while drinking fresh coconut juice.
At this time, the sun had already set on the horizon, looking less bright than during the day. Several seagulls circled over the sea, occasionally swooping down to catch fish on the surface, and then flying back into the air.
The golden waves, illuminated by the sunset, gently lapped against the beach, making a "whoosh, whoosh" sound.
The three people in the canopy saw this scene and immediately felt a sense of peace and tranquility in their hearts.
Hobert sighed with emotion: "Dusk always makes people think of some sad things."
He sighed and said again: "I just thought of the victims of the Backlund smog incident. At that time, I saw pedestrians all over the street falling to the ground."
"They struggled painfully, and may have desperately cried for help before they died, but the ruthless virus still reaped their lives."
Hobert looked at the sun on the horizon: "And now, people have forgotten this tragedy. The Air corruption Investigation Committee has become an institution for politicians to attack and compromise with each other."
"No one remembers those who died, and no one knows how fierce the struggles were of those who died in the mist before their deaths."
Fors looked at Hobert's profile. They had talked about the Backlund smog incident before, but Hobert hadn't expressed these feelings at the time.
Klein understood why Hobert would make such a sigh. It is difficult for people from a peaceful country and a peaceful era to imagine that such a tragedy could happen in a seemingly peaceful country and era.
"So, through my unremitting efforts, I have severely cracked down on the Demoness Sect and the Aurora Order." Hobert waved his fist:
"Currently, the Demoness Sect has basically disappeared in the Northern Continent. In addition, under my organization, four Saints of the Aurora Order have been killed one after another, causing huge losses to this group of lunatics."
Klein sighed: I had suspected before that Hobert was so targeted at the Demoness Sect for some other reason? Now it's clear, maybe after the Backlund smog incident, he planned to retaliate against the initiators of this tragedy!
When everyone forgot about those ordinary people who died in the smog incident, or rather, when everyone didn't care about those lives, Hobert cared very much. He never forgot the people who died in the smog!
"Currently, only the last murderer is still at large." Hobert suddenly showed a smile, and then waved his hand, "twisting" the path of sound wave propagation around him, so that people outside the gazebo could not hear their conversation.
Klein knew that Hobert was looking for him to talk about George III's ascension to godhood. He said in the cold tone belonging to Gehrman Sparrow:
"I thought that after you became a Duke of Loen and cooperated with Loen, you would not oppose George III's ascension to godhood."
Hobert smiled: "I am a Duke of Loen, and I have cooperation with Loen. What does it have to do with that George III?"
Klein almost didn't maintain his persona, and almost asked Hobert: Where is your integrity?
But thinking about it carefully, he didn't know how to refute it.
"Besides, I'm not stupid, I won't publicly oppose George III's ascension to godhood." Hobert smiled: "I will only tell the key to George III's ascension to godhood to the Feysac Empire and the Feysac Kingdom.
"In addition, I also know that you and the Queen Mystic will not sit idly by."
Klein nodded solemnly: "That's right."
The gods have all tacitly approved George III's plan to become a god, but "The Fool" opposes it, and he, Klein, also opposes it.
If a person who can sacrifice hundreds of thousands of lives in order to become a god really becomes a god, then in Klein's view, the gods would be too cheap.
For him, if he doesn't stop it, it will definitely affect his mental state in the future.
"Since our battle lines are unified, then I will announce some key information about the 'Black Emperor' ascension ritual." Hobert withdrew his gaze and looked at Klein.
Fors was slightly stunned. Only then did she realize that Hobert had invited "The World" to discuss how to stop George III from becoming a god.
Then she became a little excited: This is destined to be another great cooperation between the "Creator" and "The Fool".
Klein knew that the key information was coming, so he held his breath and listened carefully.
"According to some information provided to us by the great 'Creator,'" Hobert said: "The ritual for advancing to 'Black Emperor' is:
"To have a kingdom of one's own, to Connection one's name with the title of Emperor, to become common knowledge among the people, and, furthermore, to establish a set of strict, complex, yet contrary-to-normal rules, including architectural styles. Then, drive the people to secretly build nine pyramid-like mausoleums, and then enter one of them, in a corresponding sacrificial ritual spread across different cities in which the vast majority of the people participate, and consume the Sequence 0 potion."
Only now did Klein know the complete ritual for advancing to "Black Emperor": "The King's National Speech!"
Major newspapers have been promoting the King's national speech these days. It is said that new technology will be used to allow all squares in the country to hear the King's speech at the same time.
And the time of the speech is in ten days!
"I think so too." Hobert said: "This fits the condition of 'a sacrificial ritual in which the vast majority of the people participate'."
He paused and said again: "As for the other conditions, George III basically possesses them. First of all, he has had his own kingdom since he ascended the throne.
"And for decades, George III as King has become common knowledge among the people of Loen.
"The only thing he hasn't done well enough is to establish a set of rules that are contrary to normal circumstances. Although he has established new rules through actions such as the 'Corn Law', civil service examinations, and supporting the rise of electric lighting.
"But for the ascension ritual, he hasn't done it very well."
Klein nodded slowly, finally understanding the source of some of the turbulent factors in recent years.
Hobert said again: "The most critical thing in this ritual is the establishment of nine mausoleums.
"The royal family's excavation of ancient ruins is actually to find the nine mausoleums left by Tudor back then.
"We have said this before. Tudor made many preparations to become the 'Black Emperor', including driving the people to secretly build nine mausoleums.
"At that time, 'the Spectator' was already secretly supporting Tudor, so it is very likely that 'the Spectator' told the Loen royal family the location of the nine mausoleums..."
Klein and Fors both knew that the "Spectator" Hobert was talking about was Adam, because once he mentioned the other party, the other party would know about Hobert and might find out about their secret talk today.
So Hobert simply used "The Spectator" as a substitute.
Hobert continued: "Of course, it is also possible that the Loen royal family found it themselves. As far as I know, after becoming a 'Justiciar', one will have some kind of connection with their territory.
"One of the specific manifestations is that one can roughly sense some secret ruins in the territory.
"I believe that the Sequence 1 'Hand of Order' of this pathway should also have similar abilities, but such abilities are relatively weaker than those of a true god.
"For more than a thousand years, William I has been the 'Protector' of the Loen Kingdom. He should also have a mystical connection with his territory, and perhaps he also knows the location of the nine mausoleums."
Klein had just seen many descriptions of the nine mausoleums in the diary yesterday, but not as detailed as Hobert said. He asked: "Can destroying the mausoleums stop the King's advancement?"
"Theoretically, yes." Hobert said: "But the timing of destroying the mausoleums must be just right. If it is too early, the royal family will discover it, and then the advancement ritual will be terminated early.
"If it is too late, destroying it will be meaningless."
As he spoke, he took out a pre-prepared "Greater Backlund Area Map", on which nine red dots had already been marked: "These are the locations of the nine mausoleums."
Klein took the map and glanced at it. The locations of two of the mausoleums matched the information he had obtained, but he was still somewhat surprised: "When searching for the locations of the nine mausoleums, you weren't discovered?"
The royal family had made many defensive arrangements around those ruins.
Not only was it difficult to be discovered, but if suspicious people approached, they would also trigger some extraordinary traps.
Hobert smiled: "You may have forgotten that before the Loen royal family became the master of that land, Trunsoest was the master of that land!
"And He is also a 'Justiciar'. When Tudor was forced to Intis to become emperor during the Fourth Epoch, these mausoleums lost their corresponding protection and could not be hidden from Trunsoest."
Klein nodded slightly. He hadn't considered this aspect just now. He remembered that Hobert had mentioned that among the Beyonders serving the "Creator," there were quite a few members of the Trunsoest family.
Hobert pointed to two mausoleums in the northern suburbs of Backlund and said, "I've already told the Feysac Empire about these two locations."
To be precise, he exchanged these two locations for a colony with an area equivalent to half a county.
Then, he pointed to two locations on the west side: "I plan to tell the Feysac Kingdom about these two locations."
Klein confirmed again, "I heard that destroying two or three of the mausoleums can stop the advancement ritual. Do you need to destroy all of the mausoleums?"
Hobert smiled slightly: "To be cautious, it's better to destroy a few more."
Then, he pointed out two mausoleums in the southern part of Backlund: "We will be responsible for these two mausoleums. Which one do you plan to destroy from the remaining ones?"
Klein had no choice but to point to the two in the east: "These two, then."
He would destroy one himself, and tell Trissy about the other.
Hobert nodded: "The last one will be left for 'Queen Mystic' Bernadette. Haha, George III is really unlucky. All nine mausoleums have been claimed."
