chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 657 Take care, fellow countryman
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In the gazebo outside the Governor's mansion on Longtail Island, Hobert further explained to Klein how to enter the mausoleum: "Back then, Mr. 'Door' made some arrangements within these mausoleums."
"Originally, it was so that the Tudor family could freely travel between the nine mausoleums, or so that the power protecting the mausoleums could quickly support each other, but these arrangements became a loophole in the mausoleums."
"According to some information I obtained, the Loen Royal Family only modified the mausoleums and did not rebuild them, so Mr. 'Door's' arrangements are still there."
Klein said, "I've also heard about this."
He had once used the corresponding ritual to contact Mr. 'Door' and inquired about the way to enter the mausoleum from Him: it required the blood of 22 Pathway Beyonders.
However, Hobert's way of entering the mausoleum was simpler: "It requires the blood of a 'Door' Pathway Sequence 7 or higher Beyonder, and a talisman at the demigod level with the ability to 'Tamper'."
"Coincidentally, the Theosophy Council has recently targeted a Sequence 6 from the Demoness of Pleasure. I have already notified them that when they surround and kill that Sequence 6, they should drain his blood and preserve it."
"So I can provide the blood and the talisman. After these talismans are made in a few days, I will send them to you along with the blood."
Klein nodded: "Okay."
He also felt that this method was more convenient.
Finally, they discussed it and decided that Klein would contact "Queen Mystic."
After putting away the map, Hobert lifted the "Tampering" on the surroundings and asked the servants to start serving the dishes.
The three of them ate and chatted, talking about the Southern Balam Duchy, the adventurer industry, the future development prospects of Tussock Harbor, and the high society of Backlund.
After that, the topic became more and more relaxed, and one after another, they talked about Hobert and Fors's wedding, the Nighthawks, and Tingen City.
Listening to their conversation, Fors realized that Hobert and "The World" had known each other for a long time, and it even seemed that they had worked together to prevent the descent of an evil god when their Sequences were not high.
It had been a long time since Klein had such a leisurely chat about the past, because he wore layers of masks and couldn't talk to the people around him about his true past.
But here he could talk about it, because he knew that Hobert and Fors would not reveal these secrets.
At the same time, the delicious food arranged by the kitchen also made Klein's appetite wide open, especially when he got the Spicy Fish Head, which gave him the feeling of eating hometown dishes in a foreign country.
Unconsciously, they chatted until after eight o'clock in the evening, and he and Hobert were still somewhat unsatisfied.
So after dinner, Hobert invited Klein to take a walk by the sea.
Fors, of course, understood that they wanted to chat alone, so she said that she still had some official business to deal with and did not go with them.
In the darkness, the waves were still lapping against the shore unhurriedly. Hobert smiled and said, "I remember seeing an idea about wave power generation. I wonder if it can be realized in this world with the blessing of Beyonder abilities."
As a former keyboard warrior, Klein had of course heard of this idea: "I remember that this technology has made considerable breakthroughs, but it is not like I imagined, building power stations on the shore, but building power stations in the sea."
Hobert recalled for a moment: "Now that you mention it, I seem to remember something like that too."
Then he said, "Many of my previous memories are very vague."
"Maybe it's because these two worlds are completely different," Klein said with emotion. "I'm about to forget the taste of fried noodles and shredded pork with garlic sauce."
Before he transmigrated, these were two of his favorite dishes.
Hobert sighed: "This world has wonderful places, and it also has helpless places."
"For example, the curse I encountered is the most difficult problem I have encountered so far."
"But if I don't face it, I will either become a Lunatic or become a mental patchwork monster like Trunsoest."
Klein was slightly stunned. He was about to say that "The Fool" had not yet recovered enough authority to help.
As a result, when he heard Hobert's sigh, he suddenly didn't know how to speak.
Hobert then continued: "Oh, right, I forgot to tell you yesterday about the reward I can pay to 'The Fool'."
He didn't give Klein a chance to refuse and said directly: "'Error' card!"
Klein, who was about to tell Hobert the truth, was suddenly stunned. He asked, "'Blasphemy Card' of the Marauder Pathway."
Hobert smiled slightly: "That's right."
For him, the two cards given by the Church of the Evernight Goddess must be obtained. One is of great use to him, and the other is of great use to Klein.
Klein pondered for a moment and thought that with the "Blasphemy Card" of the adjacent pathway, he should be able to carry out more operations.
The principle of him using the "Blasphemy Card" above the "Gray Fog" is similar to that of Hobert using the "Blasphemy Card".
Both use the "Blasphemy Card" as a medium to strengthen their status and mobilize more power.
Klein had also imagined before that if he could get the "Fool" card, or the "Blasphemy Card" of the adjacent pathway, this medium would be more "intimate" with his own pathway and the power of the "Gray Fog", and he would definitely be able to mobilize more power.
He paused for a few seconds before saying, "This reward is very reasonable, but you must pay this 'Blasphemy Card' before you advance."
He told the truth: "Mr. Fool may need to do some research."
"No problem," Hobert agreed very readily: "I will sacrifice it to Mr. Fool two days before I advance."
The reason why he didn't immediately sacrifice it to "The Fool" after getting the card was because Hobert was afraid that when Amon's avatar caught Klein later, Klein might carry this card with him, which would be lively!
As for the matter of Klein being caught, Hobert didn't plan to remind him in advance. He remembered that Amon had told him many shocking secrets in order to deceive Klein.
And it was more appropriate for Amon's avatar to tell him those secrets.
Anyway, Klein eventually escaped, and now with the help of the "Creator", perhaps he could escape without dying once.
But it was best to let Klein take a trip to the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", after all, there was Chernobyl and Moon City there.
After talking about serious business, the two began to chat aimlessly again.
It wasn't until after ten o'clock, when only the lights of the Governor's mansion on the entire Longtail Island were still on, that Klein said goodbye.
Just as he was about to enter the spirit world, Hobert smiled and said, "Take care, fellow countryman."
The word "fellow countryman" deeply touched Klein, and the persona of Gehrman Sparrow collapsed instantly. He showed a bright smile: "You too, fellow countryman."
Watching Klein leave, Hobert wandered alone on the beach for another half an hour.
Thinking of the problems he had encountered, and thinking of the problems Klein would encounter later, he was filled with emotion for a while.
After Hobert calmed down, he returned to the Governor's mansion.
In the master bedroom of the mansion, Fors was still awake.
She smiled and said, "I didn't expect the famous adventurer, who looks so dangerous in the newspaper, to be so fond of food and cherish communication with friends."
Hobert took off his coat and said, "This guy is more difficult than me! Fortunately, I still have a few close people, but he is different. For some reason, he has to hide his past, so he is too lonely."
Hobert sighed as he lay on the bed: "This wonderful and messed up world!"
Fors hugged Hobert: "At least he still has you as a friend."
Hobert smiled and snapped his fingers, the switch of the electric light was "Distorted" by him, and the light went out immediately: "I hope that in the future, I can also help him."
...
On Wednesday morning, Hobert got up and began to prepare for his trip to the Amanda Mountains.
For him, this was the most important thing at the moment.
Around nine o'clock in the morning, he welcomed an unexpected but expected guest: Bernadette.
Wearing an Intis-style white shirt and a dark jacket, paired with a pair of tight jeans that looked very much like Hobert's impression, Bernadette exclaimed as soon as she came up: "I didn't expect Tussock Harbor to be so prosperous."
Obviously, she had already been to Tussock Harbor.
"It's okay," Hobert smiled and said, "I heard that next year's Pirate Conference will be held there. I believe that after the pirate world's grand event, this port will be even more prosperous."
At that time, it will definitely become a paradise for pirates.
While chatting, Hobert invited Bernadette into a reception room.
From the window here, you can see the coconut grove in the distance and a small beach.
Bernadette looked at the scenery in the distance and exclaimed: "It's been a long time since I've quietly looked at the waves."
After the servant served the tea, Hobert did not respond to Bernadette's exclamation, but "Tampered" with the surroundings to prevent their conversation from being eavesdropped.
Bernadette asked again: "I heard that Longtail Island is about to have no servants?"
"It's just that there are no more servant buying and selling transactions," Hobert said: "The new policy is that employers and servants must sign an employment contract, otherwise the employer will be severely punished.
"Some clauses in that contract will guarantee the personal safety of the servants and give them the most basic respect."
Speaking of this, he spread his hands: "Too many people in this world need the job of a servant. As their ruler, I can't let that part of the people lose their source of income."
Bernadette smiled and said, "You are a qualified ruler."
"Thank you."
She then said: "Gehrman Sparrow found me yesterday and talked about your plan."
Hobert nodded: "Do you have any questions about our plan?"
"No, my spirituality suddenly realized that that's exactly where I need your help," Bernadette said with a smile.
Previously, when Hobert launched the South Colson campaign, he asked Bernadette to lead the "Element Dawn" to participate in the war. One of Bernadette's conditions was: in the future, she might need Hobert to do a favor.
Hobert took a sip of tea: "If I were you, I wouldn't bring this up."
He put down his teacup: "Unless you have something else to talk to me about."
That's why she took the initiative to mention this matter, to show her frankness.
Bernadette held the teacup, but never drank the tea inside: "Yes, I really want to know, what is the 'Creator's' attitude towards my father?"
During the South Colson campaign, she had observed the "Creator". At that time, she was very sure that the "Creator" should be the "Black Emperor" pathway, or the adjacent pathway of the "Black Emperor".
Theoretically speaking, this should be her father's enemy, but the "Creator" and the Blessed of God, Hobert, showed enough goodwill, which is very strange.
Especially the matter of George III becoming a god, obviously the "Creator" also did not want the king to become a god, even if they seemed to have a very close cooperative relationship on the surface.
But when it comes to the competition for Beyonder characteristics, the "Creator" will never compromise.
Then the "Creator's" attitude towards her father is very crucial, which will affect how the two organizations should get along with each other in the future.
Hobert replied: "I can only say there is no malice.
"I also told you before that I would help you find Emperor Roselle."
Bernadette put down the teacup in her hand: "Why?"
Hobert replied with a smile: "I don't know the specific reason, but I guess it might be because the 'Creator' knows your father."
Bernadette was slightly taken aback: "Just because of this reason?"
"Otherwise?" Hobert asked rhetorically: "Do you think gods have many acquaintances?"
Bernadette didn't know what to say for a while. She wasn't familiar with gods either, and didn't know what gods were thinking.
But she always felt a little uneasy: Would gods have such humanized actions?
Bernadette was silent for a few seconds before saying: "Can you tell me, if my father is found, how will the 'Creator' treat him?"
Hobert smiled and said: "I don't know, but I guess it should be inclined to rescue him, or make some deals.
"After all, if you want to kill Emperor Roselle, there is no need to be so troublesome. As long as you support George III in becoming a god, after a new Black Emperor appears, your father will never have hope of resurrection."
This is also what Bernadette finds strange, and it is also where she has always felt that the "Creator" has a certain goodwill towards her father.
As Hobert said, if the "Creator" wanted to harm him, he wouldn't need to do anything.
Not only that, but the "Creator" is also preparing to find her father. In Bernadette's view, the "Creator" at least does not intend to directly harm her father.
Bernadette pondered for a few seconds. In the end, she also felt that it was more likely that the "Creator" wanted to complete certain transactions with her father.
"I understand." Bernadette took a deep breath and asked: "When do we leave?"
Hobert was stunned: "Leave to find your father?"
"Yes."
"At least after we both advance to Sequence 2." Hobert reminded: "Only the level of Sequence 2 can avoid some corruption, or avoid being affected by some influences."
Bernadette nodded: "Okay, I'll wait for you to come to me."
After speaking, she stood up and was about to leave immediately.
Hobert urged: "Take good care of that lamp, don't let Erebus take it away."
Bernadette certainly understood what Hobert meant by "that lamp". She nodded: "I know."
While speaking, a pair of illusory wings grew out of Bernadette's back, and the huge wings surrounded Bernadette.
A breeze blew by, and the pair of illusory wings dissipated like a cloud of smoke, returning to nothingness, and Bernadette in the wings also disappeared.
Hobert dispelled his "tampering" and continued to busy himself with his own affairs.
Just as the demigods of the Balk family completed their assembly and were about to set off, Allen, the butler of the South Colson Lord's Mansion, came to report: "Princess Ethel has sent an envoy, hoping to invite you to Feynapotter City for hunting tomorrow."
Previously, Ethel had invited Hobert to hunt together, but Hobert didn't take it too seriously at the time.
And this invitation is obviously something to discuss. Hobert guessed that it might also be about George III becoming a god, and he could take the opportunity to promote the location of George III's mausoleum.
So Hobert said to Allen: "Tell the envoy that I don't have time tomorrow. On Saturday morning, please ask Princess Ethel to avoid the eyes and ears and quietly come to the main hall of the Lord's Mansion to meet."
Hobert believed that Ethel must be very clear that there are many Loen spies in Feynapotter City. For Hobert, if his whereabouts are discovered, it will affect the subsequent plan.
After Allen left, Hobert set off with Lawrence and four other demigods.
All the demigods of the Balk family participated in this operation, and the Beyonder of the South Balam Duchy were temporarily handed over to Angus for control.
The group used two Sealed Artifacts with "travel" abilities to come to York City in the Amantha Mountains, which is the holy land of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, and was once the capital of the Evernight Goddess's kingdom.
Now, in addition to being used by believers for pilgrimage, this city is generally also used to receive some forces other than the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
Hobert and his party came to the city gate and saw that the city walls were all built of black stones and bricks. The structure was very simple and could be seen to have undergone many transformations.
Looking towards the Amanda Mountains from here, you can just see the headquarters of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, "Tenebrous Heaven."
That is a group of buildings that are always under the night sky. You can see tall black churches on the mountainside, as well as corresponding ancient buildings.
The starlight shines just right, making the entire building complex look very sacred!
Just as Hobert and a few others were curiously looking around, a middle-aged man in a bishop's robe of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, with thinning hair, walked towards them: "Grand Duke Hobert, and everyone, hello.
"I am ordered to receive you here."
Hobert glanced at the other person's eyes, which were not only deep, but also seemed to have a pool of black spring water slowly flowing inside.
He smiled and said: "Hello."
"You can call me Ben." The middle-aged man led the five people into the city: "Please follow me."
York City is now more like a large reception center. In the center of the city is a huge pilgrimage square. The other buildings in this city only have two functions: catering and accommodation.
There are no residential areas or factory areas. As far as the eye can see, there are restaurants and hotels, but most of them are not open at this time.
Ben introduced to everyone that it looks relatively deserted here now, but when the Winter Ritual Day comes, these rooms will not be enough to live in, and even tents will be set up outside the city.
The Winter Gifts Day is the Winter Solstice, but for the Church of the Evernight Goddess and its believers, this is a very important day.
The night is the longest on this day, and it is regarded by believers as the birthday of the Evernight Goddess.
Hobert thought to himself: This is the fanatical side of religion.
The five people were arranged in a rather luxurious reception place, which should be a residence prepared for some important believers.
After Ben introduced the location of the restaurant and bathroom, he politely asked everyone to wait in the room, and asked Hobert to go to the Cathedral of Serenity in "Tenebrous Heaven" to discuss the battle plan.
Hobert was slightly taken aback, and didn't expect to be able to take a look at the legendary Cathedral of Serenity.
While chatting with Ben, he followed Ben to the basement.
In the center of the basement built of boulders, there is a stone door made of obsidian. The center of the stone door is pitch black, flashing with starlight.
Seeing this structure of the stone door, Hobert can be sure that this is not the "Traveler's Gate".
After entering that stone door, Hobert seemed to be in the cosmos, with bright stars dotted under the huge night sky.
Following behind Ben and walking forward, he guessed that it should be a structure similar to a teleportation gate built using the astral world.
It's just that this kind of "teleportation gate" should only be used near the Divine Kingdom, because only the cosmos near the Divine Kingdom has enough connection with the real world.
After only a few steps, Ben pushed forward and opened a door in the dark cosmos, leading Hobert out of that space that looked like the cosmos.
Hobert saw that outside the door was also a huge stone structure, like another basement.
It's just that there are several obsidian doors here, and people often go in and out.
Ben greeted them, and when these priests responded to Ben, they would also look at Hobert curiously.
Through their greetings, Hobert learned that Ben turned out to be an archbishop.
Then he should be a demigod.
This is also in line with the etiquette of equal diplomatic occasions. After all, Hobert and others are also demigods, and it is normal to send a demigod to be responsible for the reception.
Going up to the ground structure through the stairs, Hobert saw a huge chapel on one side of the corridor, with patches of starlight shining in from the surrounding windows.
Hobert realized that he was now inside the Cathedral of Serenity.
They did not enter the chapel, but came to a relatively simple and very spacious room along the corridor.
Hobert found that the entire Cathedral of Serenity seemed to be very simple. The priests here either wore servant robes or bishop robes, or dressed as ascetics like Ariana.
The same is true for the few people in the stone room. Some wear bishop robes, and some dress very simply like Ariana.
However, these individuals were all of Archbishop level, and among them, Hobert even saw Archbishop Anthony.
The two had exchanged only a few pleasantries when Madam Arianna entered with a middle-aged man dressed in a full black robe.
Everyone stood up to salute, as that middle-aged man was actually the legendary Samuel.
Of course, within the Evernight Church, believers and Nighthawks all referred to Him as Saint Samuel. The cathedral in Backlund was currently named after Him!
Hobert followed everyone in saluting, then looked at the beardless man before him. He remembered that Saint Samuel was already an angel during the Fourth Epoch.
Samuel gave off a very harmonious feeling. He also looked at Hobert, and then said in a slightly hoarse voice: "Let me introduce this gentleman. This is Duke Hobert; I believe you are familiar with his name."
He paused and then added: "For tomorrow's battle, we have invited an angel of the 'Creator' to cover us on the western side of the entire battlefield."
Some Archbishops had not been informed of this plan in advance. After hearing Saint Samuel's words, they, like Arianna before them, internally re-evaluated the relationship between the Evernight Church and the 'Creator' faction.

chapters.content:

According to the brief war meeting called by Samuel, Hobert learned the real battle situation at the Amantha Mountain Pass battlefield.
Contrary to the reports in the newspapers which claimed the two sides were evenly matched, the Feysac Empire, which had been preparing for this, still held the advantage.
If the teleportation array hadn't been transporting large quantities of supplies and soldiers to the front lines, most of the positions on this defensive line would probably have been lost already.
The main reason was that the Ministry of Defense had misjudged the ammunition consumption of modern warfare. At the very beginning of the war, the ammunition reserves were quickly exhausted. The armory produced day and night for more than a month before finally meeting the needs of the battlefield, barely holding the line.
The reason why the war has slowed down slightly is that the Feysac Empire's military also misjudged the amount of ammunition they would consume, and their initial preparations are basically exhausted.
Hobert guessed that there should also be extraordinary factors involved. The high-level members of the Feysac Empire obtained key information from him about disrupting George III's apotheosis, so there was no need for the front lines to fight so fiercely.
However, the high-level members of the Feysac Empire should also have other concerns, such as what if they fail to stop George III from becoming a god?
So the war continues, otherwise the Feysac army could have waited a little longer, waited for the severe cold to further weaken the combat effectiveness of the Loen soldiers, and then launched a new offensive in the coldest season!
And the war entered a white-hot stage from the very beginning. The war between the Church of the Evernight Goddess and the Church of the God of Combat was even more intense than the extraordinary war between the two military forces.
Taking the Church of the Evernight Goddess as an example, a large number of Nighthawk members and "Red Gloves" members, as long as they had basically digested their potions, could immediately get the opportunity to be promoted, even if they didn't have enough merit.
Hobert learned from his chat with Ben just now that in the battle for the Amantha Mountain Range, the Church of the Evernight Goddess had already lost more than a dozen demigod-level Beyonders.
This is where the foundation of a true god's church is revealed. As long as the demigod's characteristics are recovered, if he died in the morning, a corresponding Sequence 5 would complete the advancement in the afternoon and become a newly promoted demigod.
The two sides had wins and losses in this battle, and some Beyonder characteristics were also taken away by each other.
Because the Beyonders of the two churches can exchange pathways, several "Demon Hunters" and "Silver Knights" appeared in the Church of the Evernight Goddess, while several "Nighthawks" and "Horror Bishops" appeared in the Church of the God of Combat.
As for what is being discussed in the meeting now, the battle tomorrow will be another large-scale extraordinary war between the two sides.
Currently, the Church of the God of Combat has occupied the northern foot of the Amantha Mountain Range, and even the Cathedral of Serenity on the southern foot of the mountain range has been attacked by them.
In tomorrow's battle, the Church of the Evernight Goddess will try to recapture the middle section of the northern foot of the Amantha Mountain Range. If the war objective can be achieved, it will be difficult for the enemy to attack the Cathedral of Serenity again.
The task of Hobert and others is to provide cover for the main battlefield on the western side of the battlefield. Samuel and others guessed that the angels of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church should also provide cover in this direction.
Whether it will be a confrontation or a battle depends on the actual situation, as long as the angels from this direction are prevented from joining the battle on the main battlefield.
Regardless of the outcome of the main battlefield, the people from the Church of the God of Combat will most likely retreat from this direction.
When their main force retreats here, Hobert and others" mission will be accomplished, and they can withdraw from the battlefield.
Of course, it is also possible that an angel of the Church of the God of Combat will come here. If that is the case, the other party will most likely not attack, and it will eventually develop into a confrontation.
The Church of the Evernight Goddess is wary of the angels of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church who suddenly joined the war, and the Church of the God of Combat must also be very wary of the angels of the "Creator" faction who suddenly joined the war.
At the war meeting, Hobert reiterated his request, if an angel needs to take action, he needs to be notified three seconds in advance.
This time, he asked the Messenger Beverly to help, because summoning and using the "Order Wood" to restore his condition takes time.
The reason why he asked Beverly to help, instead of using the spiritual residue in the "1-113" Solomon family emblem to create an angel to participate in the war, is because the created angel has limited sanity, and once it leaves the "Nation of Disorder" it has to fight.
Originally, the angels of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church did not intend to attack, but the angel 'serving" the "Creator" would give them two big slaps in the face, then congratulations to the "Creator's" forces for gaining an opponent from a true god's church.
As it stands, this is not what Hobert wants to see, after all, the cooperation between the Intis Republic and the Eternal Blazing Sun Church is very pleasant.
Many believers of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church regard electric lights as a gift from the gods, which means that the electric light business has encountered almost no resistance.
In addition, Hobert stated at the meeting that if Beverly or the demigods have any spoils, they belong to their spoils and do not have to be handed over to the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
This point was also approved by Samuel, and He formally ordered Ben to serve as a liaison and receptionist, and also to participate in the war with Hobert and others.
However, the command of the battle is in Hobert's hands.
After the brief battle meeting, Hobert returned to the reception area under Ben's leadership, and Hobert relayed the battle mission to Lawrence and others.
Although the battle sounds like it is not very risky, Hobert still took out a few high-level talismans of the Marauder Pathway: "These are "Deception" talismans and "Deprivation" talismans, even if they are used on angels, they will have a certain effect.
Each of you choose one, just in case."
Ben, who came with them, looked at the black crystal-like talismans and suddenly had the feeling that the "Creator" was very rich.
It wasn't that he was envious, after all, the true god's church had a rich accumulation of sealed artifacts. During the current war, Beyonders at Ben's level could hold a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact for a long time.
It's just that in his concept, new organizations like the "Creator's" forces, or simply secret organizations, should be relatively lacking in Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts or high-level talismans.
But Hobert took out six or seven high-level talismans at once, which surprised him a bit.
After everyone chose their talismans, Hobert talked about the precautions.
Actually, there is nothing to talk about, there are only two things, the first is: after the war between the angels starts, run as far as you can.
The Eternal Blazing Sun Church also sent several demigod-level Beyonders, and Hobert and others" goal is them.
The second thing to pay attention to is to restrain yourself and try not to be the first to attack.
After a similarly simple war meeting, Hobert talked about the internal structure of the Cathedral of Serenity, which is not a secret. Ben on the side would also give some detailed introductions.
This topic made Lawrence and others very interested, after all, that is the headquarters of a true god's church.
After eating dinner and playing cards for a while, Hobert and the others went back to their rooms to rest.
The night in York City was particularly quiet. Even Hobert and other demigods, who did not need much sleep, fell asleep quickly and did not wake up until five or six o"clock the next morning.
This was the most comfortable sleep Hobert had had in the past six months.
Under Ben's hospitality, after eating breakfast, they came to the designated battle position early in the morning, braving the cold wind.
Some Beyonders below the demigod level also arrived at the battlefield one after another, but they were all farther away from Hobert and the others. If the enemy also had Beyonders below the demigod level participating in the war, they would also participate in the war.
Hobert and the others were at the top of a small hill, from where they could see many of the surrounding snow-capped mountains and the main battlefield in the distance.
The weather today was not very good, there was no sun, and it looked like it was going to snow.
The gale howled past the high snow-capped mountains, blowing up a lot of snowflakes, and it seemed that it had already started snowing in those areas.
Hobert and the others breathed hot air and sighed, fortunately, ordinary cold had no effect on them, if ordinary people were in their current position, they would definitely be frostbitten before long.
Around nine o"clock, the colors of dusk and night appeared under the dark clouds in the direction of the main battlefield, it seemed that the battle over there had already begun.
At this time, Hobert's spirituality noticed that a very oppressive force was coming towards this side from a distance, that should be the angel they were going to stop.
So Hobert immediately recited the incantation in ancient Hermes language: "Messenger!"
The space next to him became illusory, and an ancient coffin floated out of the spirit world. In the blink of an eye, the coffin appeared directly in front of that surging power.
Immediately afterwards, the "Order Wood" rose from the ground on another mountain, quickly spreading hundreds of kilometers around.
That oppressive force stopped, and the confrontation between the angels began.
Hobert and the others also began to act, going to intercept the demigods coming from afar.
But for some reason, Hobert's heart skipped a beat twice, and he had a bad feeling.
He was a little uneasy, so he winked at Lawrence, temporarily handing over the command here to him, and then quickly came to the vicinity of the trunk of the "Order Wood" with "Distortion".
Arriving here, Hobert happened to hear the conversation between the two angels.
Not far from the trunk of the "Order Wood", a man nearly three meters tall, wearing a thick leather coat and with golden hair, suddenly roared: "Beverly! I knew you weren't dead!"
Beverly had already come out of the coffin at this time, and her tone was a little puzzled: "You are? Who are you?"
The strong man said: "I am Larrion! You didn't expect it, did you? I didn't die either, and I became the Chief Shepherd of the Church of the God of Combat."
Hearing this, Hobert thought to himself: Oops, they seem to know each other, and judging from the tone of this Chief Shepherd, it seems that he has some grievances with Beverly.
Beverly was still a little dazed: "We know each other?"
Larrion sneered, "You killed my parents and almost beat me to death. Do you think we know each other?"
"That was over a thousand years ago!" Beverly smiled helplessly. "You"re an angel now. Do you still care about that?"
Hobert had spoken to Her before. This time, the focus was on confrontation, and they should try to avoid fighting as much as possible.
"You can afford not to care!" Larrion said coldly. "But I rely entirely on hatred to maintain my humanity!"
Beverly said with a serious face, "You must be mistaken!"
"During the Fourth Epoch, the Tudor Empire rarely clashed with the Church of the God of Combat. I don't remember encountering a family of three from the Church of the God of Combat fighting together."
"Perhaps your family was killed by someone else."
This was an attempt to deny everything.
However, Hobert, hiding in the distance, nodded repeatedly. The "lawyer" saw eye to eye with him.
"That's because, at that time, our family was a viscount family of the Trunsoest Empire. Because of our faith in the God of Combat, we obtained the potion formula for this path!" Larrion's voice was no longer so cold, but somewhat excited.
This time, it was Hobert's turn to smile helplessly. The change in the other party's emotions meant that they had gone from surprise and hatred at the beginning to excitement at being able to take revenge.
Beverly also became more vigilant. "At that time, it was normal for viscount-level nobles from the four empires to disappear in battle."
A silver-white longsword appeared in Larrion's hand. "You"re right. Then please go to the underworld and explain to my parents."
After saying this, Larrion thrust his sword at Beverly.
Beverly immediately took out a "Order Wood" from her coffin to block the opponent's offensive.
He was well aware that the silver sword in the hands of someone on this path could pierce through all Beyonder abilities of the same or lower sequences.
This was the most troublesome aspect of the "Warrior" path. If Beverly used "Distortion" to distort Larrion's attack in another direction, the sword in Larrion's hand could completely "pierce" Beverly's "Distortion". The attack of this Chief Shepherd of the Church of the God of Combat would not be affected in any way.
Hobert, watching from afar, saw that Beverly's close combat skills, honed on the battlefield, were also very formidable. She was actually able to completely block the attack of a "Warrior" like Larrion with just a "Order Wood".
While fighting Larrion head-on, Beverly was also able to use abilities such as "Tamper" and "Exploit" to avoid his silver sword and attack Larrion himself.
It's just that Larrion was surrounded by twilight, and Beverly's extraordinary attacks were not very effective.
Hobert couldn't help here, and he realized that the other side must have started fighting as well, so he quickly returned to the demigod battlefield.
The "Demon Hunters" and "Silver Knights" of the Church of the God of Combat, who were originally supporting the main battlefield from this direction, had all started smoking. They also knew that the other side was an outside aid invited by the Church of the Evernight Goddess, and that they shouldn't be able to fight before there were clear orders from above.
But what they didn't expect was that, after taking only a few puffs, their spirituality sensed that the two angels confronting each other had actually started fighting!
This caught both sides" demigods off guard, but they were, after all, very experienced in combat, and they immediately entered battle mode in the next second.
The "Demon Hunters" drew their double swords, and the "Earls of the Fallen " began to create large areas of chaotic interference to confuse their opponents.
Silver-white light appeared around the "Silver Knights", and huge "Swords of Dawn" appeared in their hands.
The "Sword of Dawn" at this level was very sharp, and the blade could even tear apart a hill.
Lawrence used the ability of "Exploit" on one of the "Silver Knights", and the "Sword of Dawn", which could originally be used for a long time, could only be maintained for one minute.
Hobert returned just in time to contain another "Silver Knight".
Thus, the melee between the demigods of both sides completely erupted!
The "Silver Knight" in front of Hobert suddenly turned into a pool of liquid mercury. His speed became extremely fast, and he came to Hobert's feet in the blink of an eye.
Hobert quickly used the ability of "Tamper" to "tamper" with the state of the 'liquid mercury', causing it to show signs of coagulation, thereby slowing down the "Silver Knight".
Then, Hobert used the ability to distort space to retreat a distance, thus defusing the opponent's offensive.
"Warriors" are often good at the most direct attacks, so their attacks may seem somewhat reckless, but this is actually their way of fighting.
This was different from the enemies Hobert had encountered before, so he was somewhat flustered at first.
But Hobert quickly reacted. Since the opponent was seeking close combat with him, then he would deliberately keep his distance from the opponent.
The 'liquid mercury' also had the characteristic of being able to resist Beyonder attacks. The state that seemed to be about to solidify quickly disappeared, and he resumed chasing Hobert after returning to normal.
At this time, Hobert used the power of "Distortion" to continuously avoid the opponent's attacks.
At the same time, he drew the thin sword hidden in his cane, established a connection with the underworld. Since directly attacking this "liquid" was not very effective, he prepared to try attacking the opponent's spirit body.
Just then, Lawrence shouted, "Be careful!"
It turned out that the "Sword of Dawn" in the hand of the "Silver Knight" that he was containing had exploded, forming a "Hurricane of Light" composed of light spots!
Lawrence's abilities of "Disorder" and "Distortion" were torn apart by the "Hurricane of Light", and those light spots instantly enveloped the entire battlefield, attacking all the enemy demigods.
Fortunately, although there was no way to 'distort" the "Hurricane of Light", it was possible to avoid the attack of the "Hurricane of Light" with surprise but no danger by "tampering with" and 'distorting" the surrounding environment or space.
Rumble ~
The violent "Hurricane of Light" slammed into the mountain, causing a violent explosion and blasting many huge holes in the mountain.
At the same time, Hobert and Lawrence also had some corresponding understanding of the "Silver Knight's" abilities.
The two looked at each other from a distance and understood how to deal with such an opponent.
Hobert immediately "tampering with" the temperature around the 'liquid mercury', making it colder there.
Then he 'magnified" his "tampering", causing the local temperature to reach minus thirty or forty degrees Celsius. A layer of frost immediately appeared on Hobert's hair and eyebrows.
As expected, the 'liquid mercury' had a corresponding deceleration, and then the "Silver Knight" noticed that this deceleration was continuous, unlike Hobert's previous "tampering", which was resolved by him in less than a second.
This was because Hobert did not directly attack the opponent with Beyonder abilities, but changed the surrounding temperature, causing the opponent's liquid state to show signs of solidification.
So this time's "low-temperature offensive" could be sustained.
The "Silver Knight" realized Hobert's intention. He did not continue to chase Hobert, but fled in another direction, hoping to get rid of this slow speed state as soon as possible.
What Hobert was waiting for was this opportunity. He immediately injected his spirituality into the "0-71" disaster porcelain doll and used the ice frost ability of the angel level.
The Sequence 3 "Silver Knight" had difficulty getting rid of the frost attack in a short time, and the speed of the 'liquid mercury' became slower.
Hobert clenched the thin sword in his hand, opened his mouth towards the 'liquid mercury', and made a silent roar.
A face with a painful expression was outlined on the 'liquid mercury'.
Hobert's attack of "Language of the Dead" made the "Silver Knight" stiff all over and stopped in place.
"Language of the Dead" is a direct attack on the spirit body, which can bypass the Silver Knight's suppression of Beyonder abilities to a certain extent and attack his spirit body.
What followed was the coldness belonging to the underworld, which completely froze the opponent's movements.
Hobert certainly wouldn't miss this opportunity. While stepping forward to stab the opponent with the thin sword, he threw out a talisman in his other hand: "Deception!".
The talisman, like a black crystal, turned into complex mystical symbols, covering the silver-white light on the surface of the 'liquid mercury', and a gap appeared.
Because the level of the talisman was higher than the sequence of the "Silver Knight", the talisman had an effect.
The gap in the silver-white light indicated that the "Silver Knight's" ability to ignore Beyonder attacks to a certain extent was briefly 'deceived".
At the same time, the thin sword in Hobert's hand pierced the 'liquid mercury', and then he used the ability of 'magnification".
When the "Silver Knight" recovered from the state of "frost" and "Language of the Dead", he was already seriously injured.
The 'liquid mercury' immediately turned back into a human form. At this time, the "Silver Knight's" body surface temperature was extremely low, and his whole body was covered with a layer of frost.
But a 'silver thin sword" immediately appeared in his hand. He didn't care about his injuries at all, but instead thrust a sword at Hobert, who had finally managed to get close.
Hobert quickly used "Distortion" to distance himself from the "Silver Knight" again. He didn't have Beverly's fighting skills honed from actual combat, so he wouldn't get entangled with a "Warrior".
A gorgeous silver-white armor appeared on the "Silver Knight", and he rushed towards Hobert, even if he wasn't in the 'mercurialization" state, his speed was still very fast.
The collision and tearing of the armor with the surrounding air formed a "whooshing" sound.
Even Hobert's 'distortion" of space was affected and influenced by this.
Looking at the "Silver Knight" who seemed to have never been injured and was not greatly affected by the mystical virus, Hobert sighed: As expected of a "Warrior"!
However, because the "Silver Knight's" speed was ultimately a little slower than before, Hobert was now more composed. He would sometimes 'magnify" the power of the mystical virus, and sometimes use the ability of 'tampering" to make the air denser, hindering the "Silver Knight's" charge.
He just wouldn't give the opponent a chance to fight at close quarters!
If this continued, the injury from the foil would become more and more obvious, to the point where the "Silver Knight" could no longer ignore it.
In addition, the angel-level mystical virus would also have a greater and greater impact on the "Silver Knight," and in the end, he might cough so badly that he couldn't even hold his sword.
Hobert estimated that even if the "Silver Knight's" physique was strong, he could only last for 2 minutes at most.
After 2 minutes, he would definitely take advantage of his still basically good condition and immediately withdraw from the battlefield.
That would be when Hobert launched his attack.
But only a dozen seconds later, Hobert's spirituality sensed something. Out of the corner of his eye, he looked towards the direction of the main battlefield. The twilight there was moving towards this side, and the night sky behind it followed.
Hobert didn't expect the battle on the main battlefield to end so quickly.
Or could it be…
He looked again towards the trunk of the "Tree of Order." At some point, a raging fire had already ignited there!
This immediately made Hobert realize that Beverly's younger brother, the "Weather Warlock" Raymond, had joined the battle.
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth. Could it be that the main battlefield was moving towards this side?
