"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool~" With "Justice" Audrey's greeting, this Tarot Gathering officially began.
After the situation in this world became even more chaotic, the Tarot Gathering could still be held normally, and all the members were present, which gave Audrey some comfort and improved her mood a lot.
Because "The Fool" Klein, or rather, Mr. World, quickly got rid of Amon with the help of "The Creator," everyone did not notice Mr. Fool's abnormality.
Klein would not actively talk about the battle between him and Amon, so he smiled at "The Emperor" Hobert and said, "Let us congratulate 'The Emperor' on his successful advancement."
Apart from Audrey and Fors, the other members felt their backs were a little stiff: "The Emperor" has successfully advanced to an angel?
Because this step of advancement was very crucial, Mr. Fool's congratulations sounded reasonable.
Advancing to a demigod requires an opportunity, but advancing to an angel requires more than just an opportunity; it requires a miracle.
"The Hermit" Cattleya even speculated: Could "The Emperor's" advancement be related to George III's sudden death?
"The Hanged Man" Alger had a very unreal feeling: Sequence 2! Angel! Deity! "The Emperor's" life form has undergone a qualitative change! And I...
Thinking of this, Alger was left with only a wry smile.
Audrey smiled and thought: The first angel member of the Tarot Gathering besides Mr. Fool!
"The Sun" Derrick sighed at the speed of advancement of the Tarot Gathering members. When he joined the Tarot Gathering, Mr. Emperor was only a "low-sequence" extraordinary.
"The Star" Leonard also sighed: "The Creator's" forces have gained another angel; the strength of this force is becoming more and more terrifying.
Hobert, of course, knew the principle of "everyone carries the sedan chair," so he got up and said to "The Fool": "Thanks to your help, I was able to get through the most dangerous stage of advancement."
Audrey almost pouted unladylike: Hobert didn't even tell me what the risks of his advancement were? Why is it linked to his family's curse?
Fors also took a deep breath, sighing that Hobert had been too busy lately and they hadn't had a heart-to-heart talk in a long time.
Klein smiled slightly, indicating that it was an insignificant help: "That was just an equivalent exchange."
Alger was the first to realize: Mr. Emperor's advancement had some risks? So he prayed for Mr. Fool's help? I really want to know what price Mr. Emperor paid for it! To be able to move Mr. Fool again.
And Cattleya was a little strange: Why didn't "The Emperor" pray for "The Creator's" help?
But she quickly figured out the answer herself: Maybe some of Mr. Fool's authorities were needed to accomplish some things.
Klein then said to Cattleya, "What questions do you have this time?"
Cattleya was slightly stunned. The beginning of this Tarot Gathering had given her a huge shock, and she hadn't recovered for a while. Also, "Queen Mystic's" letter didn't raise any new questions.
After hesitating for a second or two, she decided to ask something she wanted to know first, anyway, there were still many remaining questions.
After considering for two seconds, Cattleya said, "Great Mr. Fool, I really want to know the truth about George III's 'assassination'!"
"The World" had been investigating George III recently. Before, he had reminded the members in Backlund to pay attention to the abnormalities around them. Not long after, George III was 'assassinated.' There must be some inevitable connection here.
Cattleya's question immediately made Audrey and others perk up, because this was also something they wanted to know.
The members had also recalled Mr. Fool and "The Creator's" investigation and attention to this matter, believing that George III's "assassination" was inseparable from these two deities.
Among the Tarot Gathering members, the only one who was relatively confused was "The Moon" Emlyn. His mind was full of thoughts like "what," "what happened," and so on.
Currently, he was locked behind the Chanis Gate of St. Samuel Cathedral. He couldn't even see the newspapers and didn't know that King George III had been "assassinated."
As for Derrick, he didn't care much about this matter. He tried to restrain his impatience, waiting for the Hermit to finish asking her questions so he could state his request.
Klein said in a flat tone, "George III wanted to become the 'Black Emperor,' so he excavated the Tudor ruins, trafficked people, created the Backlund smog incident, and actively started wars, allowing the Feysac Empire's airships to bomb Backlund.
"Unfortunately, his secret mausoleum was destroyed, and he failed in the final stage of the ritual."
He simply described the cause of the matter and the process of George III's failure in his usual tone.
But he didn't mention what he did at all, because it would be too demeaning for Mr. Fool to actively explain the details.
In the previous intelligence transactions, the other members more or less knew some information about George III's preparation to become a god.
Only Audrey didn't expect that the airship bombing of Backlund was also something George III did in order to become a god.
At the same time, she could somewhat understand why Mr. Fool and "The Creator" would prevent George III from becoming a god.
First of all, these two deities would definitely take the opportunity to achieve some of their own goals, but based on their consistent performance, even if their respective interests were not involved, they would not condone such a person becoming a god.
Having obtained this answer, Cattleya decided to use another question: "Respected Mr. Fool, what is the attitude of the seven gods towards this?"
Alger and Leonard couldn't help but shift their sitting positions, because even they, as members of the orthodox churches, didn't know the attitude of the seven gods towards this.
Klein once again said in a flat tone, "The seven gods all hope there will be a 'Black Emperor,' but their opinions are not unified on who should be this 'Black Emperor.'
"When George III successfully obtained that ticket through secret preparations, the seven gods, whether they agreed or not, could only acquiesce."
Alger immediately recalled some contradictory performances of the seven major churches in events such as the Backlund smog incident and George III's "assassination," and immediately understood: So that's how it is.
Immediately, the Tarot Gathering members all had a question: Since George III was ready and had reached the final step of holding the ritual, and had obtained the tacit consent of the seven gods, then why did he still fail?
Soon they thought of an answer: Because Mr. Fool and The Creator disagreed.
Based on the answers to these two questions and some information provided by Old Man, Leonard had an overall grasp of the matter: In the matter of George III's advancement to "Black Emperor" being disrupted, the church should not have seriously tried to stop it, and may have even provided some help to Mr. Fool and "The Creator's" subordinates.
Almost at the same time, Cattleya used her rich experience and knowledge to guess the truth of the matter: The seven gods acquiesced, Mr. Fool and "The Creator" opposed, so they sent people to secretly disrupt George III's godhood ritual.
But she then thought: But what does this have to do with the Queen? Why did she discover that Gehrman Sparrow was missing? Hmm, "Black Emperor"... The Queen may have participated in this action.
Finally, Cattleya realized: Mr. Fool has three angels under his command: "Snake of Fate," "Death Consul," and "Ancient Bane." The angel loyal to "The Creator" is "Duke of Entropy." No, now there are two "Dukes of Entropy," and also a "Weather Warlock," as well as two angels suspected of being from the "Mystery Pryer" and "Secrets Supplicant" pathways. With such strength, disrupting a king's godhood ritual and thwarting the plan of an King of Angels doesn't seem too difficult to understand.
The other members also had their own guesses. For a time, the Giant Palace became very quiet.
Seeing that everyone was silent, Klein said, "You can begin!"
Derrick almost immediately said, "Respected Mr. Fool, Chief hopes to receive your blessing in the advancement ritual."
City of Silver's Chief Colin is preparing to advance to Sequence 3. Before, many demigods in City of Silver had tried to advance to Sequence 3, but without exception, because they did not receive the blessing of the gods, the ritual was incomplete, and they all failed in the end.
Klein nodded slightly: "I can."
Having received the promise, Derrick smiled, not knowing how to express his gratitude for a moment.
After two seconds, he lowered his head and said very loudly, "Only believe in Mr. Fool!"
Klein just nodded lightly, indicating that he understood his gratitude.
Seeing that Mr. Fool didn't say anything else, Cattleya said to "The World," "Queen Mystic' wants to know if you are currently in an extremely dangerous situation? Do you need her help?"
Klein was slightly stunned, thinking that "Queen Mystic" was quite righteous, and even knew to look for a missing partner.
He pondered for a moment before saying, "Thank 'Queen Mystic' for me, and tell her that I am currently in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods,' and I don't need her help for the time being."
Klein plans to explore the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" and try to find an opportunity to advance here.
Derrick suddenly stood up: "Wor... Mr. World! You are in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
He was very surprised at first, but soon his emotions were overshadowed by excitement: Another member of the Tarot Gathering is in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods"!
This made Derrick feel inexplicably relieved.
"The World's" answer far exceeded Cattleya's expectations. She responded almost reflexively, and didn't know what to say for a moment.
Audrey, on the other hand, said first, "Mr. World, how did you go to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
She paused and then said, "It seems wrong to ask that. I should ask how you entered the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
At this time, "The World" looked at "The Fool" at the top, as if asking for Mr. Fool's instructions.
Hobert, who was watching the show, suddenly realized whether he should reveal to Klein that he knew "The World" was "The Fool"?
He thought: Probably when Klein becomes a Great Old One, he will know my origins. Will he complain that Hobert only knew how to watch the show and didn't care about the embarrassment after the "actor" was exposed?
But after thinking about it, Hobert decided to temporarily not say anything about this matter. Perhaps the more embarrassed Klein was at that time, the more he could suppress the revival of the Celestial Worthy.
"The Fool" at the top seemed to notice "The World's" gaze. He smiled and said, "Some time ago, I used 'The World's' body to play a game with Amon in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.'"
Every sentence he said was true, but the information that others interpreted from it would definitely be very far from the actual situation.
In this way, even if Amon spread the news that "The World" Gehrman Sparrow was equal to "The Fool," the Tarot Gathering members would only sneer in their hearts that Amon wanted to deceive again.
There was a time when "The World" was equal to "The Fool," but that doesn't mean "The World" is always equal to "The Fool."
Leonard immediately recalled a conversation with Old Man last week: Old Man guessed correctly. Mr. Fool deliberately used Klein to lure the "Blasphemer" Amon.
Thinking of this, he secretly glanced at Mr. Fool, and then looked at "The World" generously. Seeing that neither of them was wearing a monocle, he breathed a sigh of relief: Judging from the current situation, Mr. Fool has obtained a relatively satisfactory result in this struggle, and may have even made Amon suffer a loss.
Alger sensed from Mr. Fool's words that the other party had further revived and was able to gain an advantage in a direct confrontation with an King of Angels.
Cattleya roughly understood the reason for "The World" Gehrman Sparrow's disappearance. At the same time, she was surprised that an King of Angels who had disappeared from people's sight for a long time had ascended to the stage of the current era.
After being surprised for a moment, Audrey immediately noticed through observation: Why doesn't Mr. Star seem surprised by this? And he seems to know some other information?
Only Emlyn didn't quite understand what Mr. Fool meant. He even had a feeling that he had been locked behind the Chanis Gate for more than just one or two weeks, but one or two months, resulting in a serious disconnection from the current situation.
At this time, "The World" said to "The Emperor" Hobert, "Please convey my thanks to 'The Creator,' for allowing me to obtain very important information from Amon."
Everyone was stunned at first, and then immediately realized that "The Creator" had also participated in this struggle, but "The Creator" did not seem to have participated in the battle between Mr. Fool and Amon, but had helped Mr. World.
The other members then realized: Mr. World also has some actions or tasks in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods," and this task seems to be to obtain some key information.
As for why "The World" was asking "The Creator" for help instead of praying for Mr. Fool's help?
Everyone also thought of the reason: Just like "The Emperor's" advancement did not pray for "The Creator's" help, but asked Mr. Fool for help, Mr. "World's" request for "The Creator's" help should also be to use the authority that "The Creator" possesses to complete some operations.
"I will help you convey it." Hobert smiled and said, "Although I cannot make any statements on behalf of 'The Creator,' I can express my own attitude.
"In this George III incident, we were originally close allies."
Fors smiled slightly. She witnessed Hobert and "The World" discussing how to destroy George III's mausoleum.
This time Audrey didn't have the idea of ​​pouting, because Hobert had told her the general process of this action.
Alger and other members sighed: This is another cooperation between Mr. Fool and "The Creator," and it is clear that this cooperation was very successful.
Cattleya asked "Emperor," "Did the 'Creator' also participate in this operation?"
Everyone knew that this was a 'rhetorical question' because it was so obvious.
The Hermit's implication was actually: Can you tell us roughly what happened?
Because Mr. Fool's answer was too general.
"Yes," Hobert said with a smile, "But everyone must keep this a secret for me, because on the surface, we are still in a cooperative relationship with the Loen Royal Family."
Alger and Cattleya, who often dealt with pirates, didn't think there was anything wrong with this. In their view, there were many types of cooperation partners, some of whom used each other, some of whom were used unilaterally, and some of whom had common goals and had to cooperate, and so on.
Of course, different strategies should be used to deal with different partners.
Leonard, however, thought of a piece of news he had just learned. Not long ago, the Church had just conducted a cooperation with the "Creator's" forces against the Church of the God of Combat: Should I remind the Church to be careful of the "Creator's" forces backstabbing them?
But then he shook his head. This was not a problem he should be concerned about at his current level.
Cattleya immediately stated, "Of course, I will keep it a secret for you. After all, this is a secret of the Tarot Club. Unless you want to betray the Tarot Club, who would reveal such a secret."
Klein thought to himself: This is what you call an "old fox." By taking this matter to a higher level and using the Tarot Club's confidentiality rules, she is asking everyone to keep Hobert's words secret.
Audrey, on the other hand, interpreted from the Hermit's language and body language the meaning of "Tell us quickly, everyone will keep it a secret for you."
So Hobert said, "Last year, the 'Creator' realized George III's purpose and sent us to do some investigation.
"Later, according to the clues described by Mr. World, we guessed that some of George III's actions were actually preparing for a godhood ceremony, and we guessed that the Loen Royal Family was secretly transforming the mausoleum left by the Tudor family.
"Among us are members of the Tudor family and members of the Trunsoest family, who have more detailed information about this and know the location of the Tudor's secret mausoleums.
"So I cooperated with Mr. World to destroy those secret mausoleums during George III's godhood ceremony."
Alger slowly nodded: Now it can be confirmed that the "Creator" should be a god of the "Lawyer" or "Arbiter" pathway. Through certain connections of the pathway, the "Creator" knew about George III's plot very early and began to prepare to destroy the godhood ceremony.
Klein even further speculated: The "Creator" should possess the Uniqueness of the "Justiciar" pathway and a Sequence 1 of god, or only possess one of them. The two Sequence 1 characteristics of this pathway are in the hands of the Loen Royal Family and the Feynapotter Royal Family, but the whereabouts of the Uniqueness and the third Sequence 1 characteristic have never been heard of.
He believed that, theoretically, the six gods joined forces to eliminate the Night Emperor, and the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics should be in the hands of the orthodox churches, but now it seems that the "Creator" may have obtained one of them through some means and restored the corresponding power. Before the "Creator" regained his strength, He certainly did not want a true god to appear in the adjacent pathway.
Klein had such a guess because the "Creator" had successfully stopped Amon's main body before, which made him believe that the "Creator" at least had the level of Sequence 1.
But what he didn't know was that Hobert only had the confidence to face Amon's main body after seizing a Beyonder characteristic of "Prince of Abolition", otherwise the "Creator" would definitely find a way to kill Klein in order to escape Amon's pursuit.
Audrey and other members also realized that the "Creator" should be more active in stopping George III from becoming a god than Mr. Fool, after all, this is a fight for Beyonder characteristics, an unavoidable struggle.
Only Fors knew that in this action, there was actually Hobert's unwillingness to let the people of the Backlund smog incident die so unclearly.
At this time, Leonard asked, "I heard that Beyonder forces from the Feysac Empire and the Feynapotter Kingdom also appeared at that time. Is this true?"
"It's true," Hobert said with a smile, "They are also the Loen Royal Family's mortal enemies and can be used as force."
Everyone understood that it was likely that the "Emperor" had quietly notified the royal families of these two countries.
Emlyn felt that his mind was a little confused for a while: Didn't the "Creator" just attack Saint Millon, the capital of the Feysac Empire? Why did they suddenly cooperate again?
Leonard sighed, "Fortunately, I didn't get involved in politics."
Otherwise, he might be screwed to death.
Hobert smiled and said, "In addition to being a solid ally of Mr. Fool, the 'Creator' basically has a relationship of mutual use with other forces.
"Whether this relationship of interest is close or whether there is any betrayal is not determined by one party, but by the interests of both parties."
Leonard nodded. After Hobert sorted it out, the relationship became clear.
Through the "Emperor's" description, everyone basically understood the details of George III's failure. Obviously, the Feynapotter Kingdom and the Feysac Empire were used, but their surprise attacks must have achieved unexpected results.
In addition, with the "Creator" and Mr. Fool's forces taking action, it would be strange if George III could succeed without the help of gods.
There was silence in the hall for a while, and "World" said to "Fool," "Honorable Mr. Fool, I hope to communicate with Mr. Emperor alone."
Hobert guessed what Klein wanted to talk to him about and nodded in agreement to the request for a private conversation.
After the "Fool" set up a space for private conversation, Klein manipulated "World" and said, "I hope to talk to you alone in the real world."
Hobert was stunned: "Is there anything that can't be said here?"
"World" sighed: "If we talk about this topic, it may take a long time, and it is not suitable to be held at the Tarot Club."
Hobert "recalled" that Klein knew from Amon that this was Earth, and this news must have had a great impact on him.
After all, for a long time, Klein's motivation to advance and explore this extraordinary world was to "go home," but he found that he had "never left home," but his current home was not the original home.
"No problem," Hobert said. He felt that he had an obligation to try to find a new goal for Klein.
Klein asked again, "I thought of a way to temporarily return to the North and South Continent. Use Miss Magician's 'Leymano's Travels' to record three abilities to summon from the gaps in history.
"Then you summon my historical projection, and my main body enters the historical gap, so it is as if my main body has returned to the North and South Continent.
"You can 'magnify' or 'use' the ability to summon from the historical gap to extend the summoning time."
Hobert nodded: "This is a good idea."
He paused and said, "But I have to summon you in a few days, because recently I have to help the 'Creator' complete a very important task and solve the civil war in the Duchy as soon as possible."
Klein nodded: "Okay."
Then he asked, "Can you help me get a 'Worm of Star'?"
The auxiliary Ingredients for advancing to Sequence 2 require a "Worm of Time" and a "Worm of Star."
Klein has a "Worm of Time" in his hand, but he has no way to get a "Worm of Star."
He remembered that Hobert's subordinates had several demigods of the "Apprentice" pathway.
Hobert asked, "Can a 'Secrets Sorcerer' split a 'Worm of Star'?"
"Theoretically, it is possible," Klein said.
When he was in Sequence 4, he could split the "Worm of Spirit." As a demigod of the adjacent pathway, it should also be possible.
Hobert agreed very readily: "Then there is no problem."
"What reward do you need?"
Hobert couldn't say for sure: "Let's talk about it when I get the 'Worm of Star'."
It is likely that Jonathan will not want any reward, but Hobert does not plan to owe favors and still has to pay the Demoness Council some reward. The specific reward depends on the actual situation.
They ended the private conversation, and Emlyn applied to talk to Mr. Star alone.
As soon as Klein established a space for them to communicate alone, Emlyn rushed to ask, "When will you let me out?"
Leonard maintained a loose posture and said, "This is not something I can decide. My suggestion is that you find someone to contact the Sanguine's high-level officials as soon as possible and let them find a way to get you out."
Klein, who was listening, wanted to laugh a little, but he held back: These two guys have caused an accident with a simple "protective detention"?
Emlyn's expression was a little gloomy: "Is it useful to find our Sanguine's high-level officials?"
"The Goddess is the 'Lady of Crimson' and is relatively fond of you guys who belong to the 'Moon' domain," Leonard casually perfunctorily said, "Although you don't believe in Her."
What he really meant was: The Sanguine, an ancient race that has lived for several epochs, must have more or less connections with the major churches, especially since the Sanguine Queen was the Empress of the Trunsoest Empire, and the Church of the Evernight Goddess supported the Trunsoest Empire at that time.
Emlyn probably understood the meaning of "Star": "I will entrust Mr. Emperor."
After all, the "Creator's" forces and the Sanguine are "allies," but what is frustrating is that this time, the contact person between the two organizations was arrested. I don't know if the "Emperor" can find other Sanguine members?
As soon as Emlyn finished speaking, he and Leonard said almost at the same time: "No!"
'moon" Emlyn glanced at Mr. Star next to him: "Did you think of it too?"
Leonard "ha"ed: "Such a simple question."
Emlyn retorted with a sneer: "But you just suggested that I contact the Sanguine's high-level officials.
"I have been locked in the Chanis Gate for several days. They must have known it for a long time. The fact that they haven't tried to rescue me should be because they want to observe who will help me."
After all, in the eyes of the Sanguine's high-level officials, there are still many doubts about Emlyn, and they will definitely do some investigation if they have the opportunity.
Leonard seemed not to have heard Emlyn's sneer and looked elsewhere: "That's probably the case, so you can only continue to stay behind the Chanis Gate. Perhaps after waiting a few more days, they will lose patience and get you out."
Emlyn sighed with some amusement. For him, the very quiet environment behind the Chanis Gate was still bearable, but what he couldn't bear was that the internal guards gave him cow's blood, which was very difficult to drink!
The second round of private conversations ended, but Emlyn thought of the taste of cow's blood again and suddenly felt hopeless.
He looked at the head of the bronze long table: "Honorable Mr. Fool, I hope to ask you for some inspiration alone."
The Sanguine's face is still very important. Emlyn didn't want other members to know that he was still being held behind the Chanis Gate.
Klein nodded and established a space for private communication between "Fool" and Emlyn again.
Emlyn pleaded, "Can you give me a hint on how to get rid of protective custody?"
Klein, shrouded in gray-white mist, replied concisely: "This week."
His answer was very confident, but it did not come from prophecy, but from his judgment of current affairs:
The Feysac Empire and Intis are attacking Loen, Feynapotter is attacking Loen's ally Rumburg, and the three major churches in the Kingdom of Loen certainly do not want to be enemies with the Sanguine in addition to the existing enemies, so Emlyn will be released soon, and Father Utravsky will have to be detained for a while.
At the same time, the Sanguine's focus must have shifted to the world situation, and they are less motivated to continue to test the doubts about Emlyn.
Combining these two factors, it is not difficult to conclude that Emlyn will be free soon.
The only exception is that this guy is really forgotten.
Whether it is the Church of the Evernight Goddess or the Sanguine, they have forgotten that there is such a guy locked behind the Chanis Gate. If so, Klein will have Leonard remind the Church of the Evernight Goddess at the appropriate time.
Emlyn breathed a complete sigh of relief and sincerely thanked Mr. Fool.
After the private prayer, the hall fell silent again, which meant that the transaction session was over, and this Tarot Club entered the "free communication" session.
Hobert first said, "Please note, Trunsoest has been resurrected!"
The hall was quiet for a few seconds before Alger asked, "Who?"
Hobert said again, "'Night Emperor' Trunsoest!"
The hall was quiet again for a few seconds, and then everyone asked questions in rapid succession, one after another. Cattleya asked, "How did He resurrect?"
Before today, she had not heard any news about this. In her opinion, the Night Emperor's resurrection was very sudden!
Klein manipulated "World" and asked, "Did your plan fail?"
When Hobert advanced, Klein had to be careful to guard against Amon's avatar's encirclement and suppression of him, so he did not dare to stay in the Sefirah Castle for long. After seeing Hobert's successful advancement, he withdrew his gaze and returned to the "Forsaken Land of the Gods."
So Klein still does not know the news of Trunsoest's resurrection.
He probably knew that Hobert's plan was to use the method of "grafting" blood to trick Trunsoest into a refined body.
Theoretically, it would take a certain amount of time for Trunsoest to restore his status, and Hobert should be able to kill Him easily.
Klein could not be sure at this time whether Trunsoest was resurrected in that body or in Hobert's body?
Audrey asked, "Is His resurrection related to your family's curse?"
Hobert mentioned his family's curse when he first joined the Tarot Club, but only that once, and never again. Even Alger had forgotten about it, but Audrey remembered it very clearly.
Fors asked, "Will you be in danger?"
Hobert had talked to her about his family's curse, and she immediately realized that it might be related to the Trunsoest family's curse.
After everyone had asked their questions, Hobert replied, "It is indeed related to the family's curse."
But He didn't elaborate, planning to discuss it with Audrey in detail when he had time.
Then Hobert answered Fors' question: "Because of the 'Creator's' protection, I'm not in too much danger, but I have one more very troublesome competitor!"
Cattleya, Alger, and the others all heard the concern for "Emperor" in "Justice" and 'Magician's" tones. They reaffirmed that these three knew each other in the real world!
Then Hobert answered Klein's question: "The plan was basically successful, but I didn't expect Trunsoest's resurrection plan to be more complicated than expected.
"After tricking Him into that body, He summoned a sealed artifact at the 'Hand of Order' level, and within a few seconds, He possessed the level of Sequence 1."
Not only was Klein stunned, but the other members were also stunned. The Night Emperor not only resurrected, but also had the strength of Sequence 1!
This was definitely a major event. The Beyonder world suddenly had another Sequence 1!
Cattleya thought to herself: No wonder Miss Magician would ask if "Emperor" would be in danger. Even if He is an angel now, it is still quite dangerous to have a Sequence 1 as an enemy and competitor.
Immediately, Audrey and Fors realized that Hobert's advancement plan had been helped by Mr. World, so "World" probably knew his plan as well.
Finally, Hobert answered Cattleya's question: "Trunsoest began to arrange some resurrection methods not long after becoming a god in the Fourth Epoch.
"Later, with the help of 'Blood Moon Queen' Auernia, He perfected the corresponding arrangements and finally resurrected last week."
Because the specific resurrection process was very important to Him and required confidential information, He didn't explain it to Cattleya in detail.
Cattleya immediately realized that this must be a secret history from the Fourth Epoch, but "Emperor" didn't intend to explain it in detail.
Emlyn immediately reacted: 'mr. Emperor, are you saying that the Night Emperor's resurrection was helped by our Queen?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes."
Trunsoest had admitted this himself.
Emlyn asked again: "What about the 'Blood Moon Queen'? Did She resurrect together?"
"She should..." Hobert was about to say "She should not have resurrected," but then he thought that Trunsoest's resurrection arrangements were all done by Auernia. With such a good opportunity in front of Her, wouldn't She leave a way out for herself?
So Hobert immediately changed his words: "I don't know about this."
He paused and added: "I will do some corresponding research."
Theoretically, if Auernia really had resurrection arrangements, then Her resurrection should be very similar to Trunsoest's, also in a member of the Balk family, and could be resurrected after certain conditions were met.
Emlyn said excitedly: "Please be sure to tell me the results of the investigation."
Hobert nodded: "I will."
The other members were stunned by their conversation: Not only the Night Emperor resurrected, but also the Night Emperor's Queen!
Cattleya couldn't help but say: "Is it really almost the doomsday in the prophecy? So many ancient gods are waking up and resurrecting one after another!"
Except for Hobert and Klein, the other members were slightly stunned.
Audrey asked: 'ms. Hermit, what is the doomsday in the prophecy?"
Cattleya paused for a few seconds before explaining: "The Moses Ascetics have a prophecy that in the near future, doomsday will come to our world."
After being said by "Hermit", the other members recalled that they seemed to have heard rumors about doomsday, but they didn't take it seriously. After all, in the extraordinary world or occultism, there are often some vague or over-interpreted prophecies.
However, prophecies confirmed by the Moses Ascetic Order are different. After all, the "Seer" demigod has certain prophetic abilities.
Alger considered for a moment and asked: "Could what this prophecy describes be the transition of epochs?"
Answering "Hanged Man" was Klein, who had communicated with the seven lights of the spirit world. He manipulated "World" and said: "As far as I know, it shouldn't be as simple as the transition of epochs, but the specific meaning of doomsday is still very vague in the current interpretations."
The doomsday spoken by the seven lights of the spirit world is the invasion of outer gods, but such information is obviously not suitable for current communication.
"World's" answer stunned even Cattleya, because the Moses Ascetics only have the prophecy of doomsday, without any substantial revelations.
And "World" seemed to have obtained some clear revelations from Mr. Fool.
Seeing that everyone was a little depressed, Hobert smiled and said: "Everyone, we all know a very simple truth, people are born to move towards death.
"Does anyone feel depressed about this and lack the motivation to live?"
He paused and said: "On the contrary, right? People have stronger motivation to live, and those with corresponding knowledge are working hard to become gods and avoid the threat of death."
Finally, Hobert said: "The apocalypse hasn't come yet, has it?"
Everyone was slightly stunned. Just as Mr. Emperor said, there is no need to worry about things that cannot be changed. Just know that it exists and prepare in advance.
Leonard suddenly smiled and said: 'Mr. Emperor, you have become an angel and don't have to worry about the problem of death, so you say it so easily."
Everyone smiled knowingly, and the haze in their hearts was swept away by this well-timed joke.
Immediately afterwards, their free exchange continued. Audrey shared her experience of "persuading" the natives in the Southern Continent, and Fors also shared that the vegetable base on Longtail Island had harvested the first batch of cabbages.
After exchanging a few more topics, Klein announced the end of this Tarot Club.
Hobert woke up in the study of the Duke's Mansion. He stretched and prepared to enter Antas City for the second time to continue trying to seal the uniqueness.
This time, he was going to use the "large size" "Creator" to attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 669 The Way to Obtain the Black Emperor Uniqueness
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After resting for a bit, Hobert further deduced the unique abilities of the "Black Emperor" pathway and recalled Klein's process of sealing the "Trunsoest Brass Book" as a reference, quickly formulating an action plan.
This was also why Hobert didn't seek Klein's advice at the Tarot Club; He still had some ways to deal with this Uniqueness.
Using the method of distorting the real world and the spirit world, Hobert once again entered the spirit world, arriving at a deserted wilderness in the Hornacis Mountains.
After setting up a "Spirituality Wall" around the area, Hobert prayed to the "Creator" and then summoned himself, with the "Creator" holding the "Sun Scepter" appearing in the wilderness.
After confirming that there was no danger nearby, Hobert summoned a warhorse radiating holy light, as well as a golden "Sun God Chariot", driving the chariot towards the small town of Antas nearby.
This time, his idea was that if he appeared as the "Creator", he would also have the position of King of Angels. After descending on Antas, he would quickly grab the Uniqueness into the "Nation of Disorder".
However, the Uniqueness was also likely to escape, after all, the power of the "Nation of Disorder" that Hobert could currently mobilize might not necessarily be able to make the Uniqueness surrender.
If that were the case, he would first retrieve a Sequence 1 characteristic and continue to pursue the Uniqueness.
In just two seconds, Hobert arrived in the sky above Antas City.
Without any hesitation, Hobert sensed with his spirituality that the Uniqueness of the Black Emperor pathway was still behind the City Hall office building, and drove the chariot straight in.
Whoosh~
Ordinary walls couldn't stop the golden warhorses at all; they pulled Hobert and crashed into the City Hall!
Hobert saw that the hall of the City Hall was arranged like a royal court, with a black dog wearing an exquisite crown sitting on a large wooden chair.
When it saw Hobert driving the chariot in, a somewhat surprised expression appeared on the dog's face.
Hobert reached out and pushed towards the black dog, and surging power rushed towards the crown on the black dog's head.
The black dog's face showed some fear, and it immediately "distorted" its position, disappearing from the City Hall.
Hobert grinned; although the Uniqueness was a special existence, it was still half a level lower in front of the corresponding Sefirah.
At this time, the surrounding "guards" reacted, shouting: "Protect the 'Emperor'!"
Originally, Hobert didn't take them seriously at all, and was about to drive the chariot to chase the Uniqueness, but as he was about to leave the City Hall, his spirituality sensed something, and he actually saw Trunsoest and Erebus among the "guards".
Although it was only a glance, Hobert's spirituality could confirm that it was indeed the resurrected Night Emperor Trunsoest, and the Outer God's avatar, Erebus.
It seemed that they had also found this place through their respective methods.
At this time, Hobert didn't have time to think too much. According to the guidance of his spirituality, he drove the chariot out of the City Hall and continued to pursue the Uniqueness.
However, as soon as he left the City Hall, Hobert immediately found that it was pitch black outside, the kind of absolute darkness, even though the chariot emitted sun-like light, he couldn't see anything around him.
Hobert immediately realized that this was the Uniqueness "tampering" and "distorting" the light of the city.
For the Uniqueness, it couldn't directly confront the power of the "Nation of Disorder", but the "Sun God Chariot" and Hobert himself were only at the Angel level.
After realizing this, Hobert immediately drove the chariot into the sky.
But it was still a step too late. The light of the "Sun God Chariot" was quickly absorbed by the surrounding "absolute darkness", and the horses and chariot quickly became illusory, turning into light spots and disappearing before they could climb to a high altitude.
"Damn it!" Hobert realized that "the enemy is in the dark, and I am in the light", and now he was very dangerous.
Hobert didn't expect the Uniqueness to have such high intelligence, actually setting up such a clever trap!
At this time, his spirituality only knew that the Uniqueness was not far away, but his own spirituality seemed to be distorted, and he couldn't determine the specific location of the Uniqueness at all.
While he was aware of the danger, he suddenly understood: Perhaps the Uniqueness didn't have much intelligence; finding the target's weaknesses and using them might be its "nature".
The danger was already in front of him, but Hobert's eyes were still pitch black, and his spiritual senses were very dull!
Hobert hurriedly followed the conclusion he had just thought of, "using" the surrounding "absolute darkness" to assimilate himself with the surrounding environment, temporarily joining the "absolute darkness".
The extremely dangerous source stopped not far from Hobert!
This made Hobert breathe a long sigh of relief; his guess was correct. The Uniqueness didn't have much intelligence. The reason why it was so difficult to deal with was because of its own abilities.
A few seconds later, the surrounding "absolute darkness" disappeared instantly, and the entire city was bathed in the winter sun again.
Hobert saw that the black dog with the crown was standing on the roof of a residential building, staring at himself with two scarlet eyes.
Hobert's legs went weak, and he knelt down towards the black dog again.
The exquisite crown suddenly flashed with brilliant light, making Hobert very fascinated.
At this moment, a picture suddenly flashed in his mind of himself ascending the throne, becoming the emperor of this world, and everyone worshiping him.
Hobert stared at the crown with a somewhat obsessed smile.
As long as he got that crown, he could have supreme power, and he could ascend to the throne of God!
But in the next second, Hobert's chest was pierced by a black longsword.
His brain immediately regained clarity, and his neck rotated 180 degrees, looking behind him.
Just when Hobert was being influenced by the Uniqueness, the group of guards had already poured out.
Erebus, one of the "guards", held a somewhat illusory black longsword, piercing Hobert's chest.
However, Hobert was currently in a spirit body state, and this sword would only cause slight damage to his spirit body, and would not cause him too serious harm.
Erebus showed a hideous smile: "Your plan has failed!"
Hobert glanced at Erebus, and then at Trunsoest. The Night Emperor was helping them resist the influence of the Uniqueness.
Hobert probably understood: "Obviously, your plan has also failed, and you have been taken in by the Uniqueness as dogs."
Obviously, Trunsoest and Erebus were affected by the Uniqueness, unable to obtain the Uniqueness, and unable to escape from this city.
Like Trunsoest, he could only temporarily resist the influence of the Uniqueness, but he couldn't leave here.
And the Uniqueness couldn't kill these two Angels for a while, so the two sides formed a stalemate.
Hobert's intrusion gave Trunsoest and Erebus a chance to escape.
Erebus sneered, "We don't have the protection of the 'Nation of Disorder'."
Trunsoest's resistance seemed to be a bit difficult, and he almost fell to the ground several times.
Hobert no longer waited, and immediately mobilized the power of the "Nation of Disorder", forming a towering "Tree of Order" in front of him.
He also thought about using the power of the "Nation of Disorder" again to try to control the Uniqueness.
Although the power of the "Nation of Disorder" was half a level higher, it couldn't form an overwhelming advantage in an instant, and the Uniqueness had a chance to escape.
And Hobert was currently only at the Sequence 2 level. This was the place that the Uniqueness could use. It would avoid the "Nation of Disorder", avoid Hobert's level as King of Angels, and attack Hobert at Sequence 2.
After all, Hobert was not a true King of Angels. At this level, the Uniqueness of the "Lawyer" pathway, who was good at finding loopholes, had ways to attack Hobert.
Using the cover of the "Tree of Order", Hobert and the three Angels entered the spirit world almost simultaneously.
They were wary of the other two Angels, and none of them were confident in killing the other in a short time, so none of them took the initiative to attack.
Just as Erebus and Trunsoest were about to flee separately, Hobert suddenly stopped them: "We can discuss a method to seal the Uniqueness."
The reason why Hobert didn't leave by ending the summoning, but entered the spirit world with them, was to observe whether he could use them.
Trunsoest looked at Hobert in his spirit body state, and then at Erebus with a distorted face.
He smiled coldly: "You continue, I won't participate."
For him, it would be best to get the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway, but there was no need to take risks for it. After all, this was just a move to contain Hobert's actions.
At the same time, he felt that the connection between Hobert and the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway was closer, so he simply planned to watch the show "from the sidelines", and take action if there was a chance, otherwise he would just let it go.
After Trunsoest left, Erebus, with a somewhat distorted expression, asked: "How should we divide the spoils after we succeed?"
On this matter, Erebus was not as free and easy as Trunsoest. If he didn't get the Uniqueness and didn't get the Sequence 1 characteristic, then he would completely fail in this competition!
"I will hold the Uniqueness, and you take the characteristic of 'Prince of Abolition'." Hobert smiled.
Erebus nodded seriously: "This is a more reasonable distribution method."
The two people smiled at each other, each with their own ulterior motives.
Although Erebus seemed to have a strong desire to cooperate, the fact that Tamara hadn't appeared all along was already very telling.
And Hobert not only had no intention of sharing the spoils, but if he had the opportunity, he also wanted to avenge his student and obtain another "Duke of Entropy" characteristic.
The two Angels left the spirit world and discussed a method to seal the Uniqueness under a snow mountain in the Hornacis Mountains.
Erebus first described his experience of failure: "Originally, I was observing the situation in Antas City from a safe distance, but the Uniqueness noticed me. It 'magnified' its own sphere of influence, and I had no choice but to submit to it.
"After entering its sphere of influence, as long as you constantly express your submission to it, it will no longer launch direct attacks, but all order and rules can become its means of attack.
"For example, if my mental state is not good, it will find all the lunatics within its sphere of influence and use their chaotic mental bodies to affect my spirit.
"At the same time, some seemingly distorted and illogical decrees issued daily also have a certain degree of targeting, and are difficult to prevent."
He paused and then said: "Trunsoest's process of entering Antas City should be similar to mine.
"He has tried more than once to influence the Uniqueness's use and alteration of rules. Sometimes he succeeded, and sometimes he didn't.
"If he continues to influence the rules there, he will be able to escape on his own by night at the latest."
Speaking of this, he suddenly grinned: "Archangels are different after all."
Hobert noticed that Erebus's condition seemed to be worse than before, and his expression seemed to be beyond his control.
But Hobert didn't care about these things, but briefly described his two failures.
The first failure was very similar to Erebus's experience. If Hobert hadn't summoned a 'Tree of Order,' he would have been forced to submit to the Uniqueness.
Erebus concluded: "Currently, with our abilities, don't even think about directly resolving the Uniqueness."
As long as it's not a true King of Angels, in the Uniqueness's eyes, it's a leaky opponent.
Hobert asked: "What are the consequences of not following the Uniqueness's decrees?"
"I've seen some people turn into fish, some into chickens, and some into dogs," Erebus guessed. "It is estimated that the dog wearing the Uniqueness was originally a person, but the Uniqueness issued a decree targeting the 'Emperor,' so he turned into a black dog."
Hobert slowly nodded and asked again: "How did you and Trunsoest become guards?"
Erebus said: "I 'used' the selection rules for the guards. In order to get close to the Uniqueness, Trunsoest should have also 'stipulated' that all his conditions met the requirements to become a guard."
Hobert seemed to be questioning, but also questioning himself: "If the relevant rules are used well, can one become the 'Emperor'?"
As long as he can get close to the Uniqueness, as long as the Uniqueness doesn't guard against him for one or two seconds, he can use the power of the 'Nation of Disorder' to completely control the Uniqueness.
"Hahaha!" Erebus laughed wildly a few times: "This idea is very 'lawyerly'!"
He thought for a while before asking: "But how can one become an 'Emperor' recognized by the Uniqueness?"
"Precisely because there are no relevant rules, this is where it can be used," Hobert also did some thinking. "I have a plan, but I need your help."
Hobert's general plan was that they would both submit to the Uniqueness, and at the same time as submitting, Hobert would resist the rule of the 'Emperor'.
Erebus said just now that the 'Emperor' is also within the scope of the Uniqueness's punishment. Hobert believes that the Uniqueness has the authority of the Emperor, but is not the Emperor himself, that is to say, there is a difference between the Emperor and the Uniqueness.
Then Hobert can aim the spearhead at the Emperor, not at the Uniqueness.
Hobert's purpose is to use some distorted rules to approach the Emperor and approach the Uniqueness.
What Erebus has to do is to get as close to the 'Emperor' as possible and cooperate with Hobert.
After the two people discussed an action plan, it was already evening. The two angels, who didn't need to rest, prepared to enter Antas City again.
Erebus reminded Hobert: "You'd better act with your main body. In the state of a spirit body, it looks too conspicuous and is easily attacked by the Uniqueness from the spiritual level."
Hobert also had this plan: "Okay, let's act separately."
After speaking, he ended his summoning and returned to his body.
After deducing the plan again, Hobert entered the spirit world again and came outside Antas City.
Winter nights come quickly. This tourist city is now brightly lit, and the streets are still like daytime, with many pedestrians, looking very lively.
Because the place where Hobert entered the real world from the spirit world was close enough to the city, he immediately saw a pair of illusory scarlet eyes in front of him.
Feeling his legs weaken again, Hobert immediately knelt on one knee: "Greetings to His Majesty the Emperor!"
The pair of scarlet eyes looked at Hobert for a while, and then disappeared from Hobert's eyes.
The pressure that made people's legs weak disappeared immediately, and Hobert stood up and walked into the city.
Because it is not daytime now, there is no need to hold a torch when walking on the street.
When he came to the gate of the city, Hobert's spirituality felt something, and he heard the voice of an eunuch coming from the city: "The Emperor orders that only people under 1.5 meters can live in the city!"
The bustling streets just now immediately became chaotic, and adults fled from the city gate one after another.
Hobert, however, used a way to 'distort' space to cross the crowd and came to the city, and then he 'tampered' with his height, making himself 1.49 meters tall.
Walking on the empty street, Hobert smiled and said to himself: This is to experience Xio's perspective.
Soon the streets became empty, and only children and dwarves were left in the entire city, as well as people with crippled legs who could not stand up.
After waiting for a few minutes, Hobert saw that he had not been punished. He entered the city to verify whether Erebus's words were credible.
After expressing his submission, the Uniqueness did not directly attack Hobert anymore, but some seemingly absurd and illogical decrees appeared, trying to punish Hobert.
Just as Hobert was conducting a preliminary test and preparing to leave the city, two teenagers dressed as guards, both under 1.5 meters tall, came to Hobert.
One of them opened a document and announced: "The Emperor orders that because you tampered with your height and violated the relevant regulations..."
Hobert interrupted and questioned: "What regulations did I violate?"
After being interrupted by this guard, his eyes were blank, and he was slightly stunned before saying: "You violated the order issued by the Emperor ten minutes ago!"
"That is an order, not a regulation!" Hobert said, "A regulation is an order that has long-term binding force after it is announced to everyone, while an order is only temporarily binding on a specific target or group."
"Okay." The guard was "persuaded" and immediately changed his words: "You violated the relevant order..."
Hobert interrupted him again: "Are you going to punish me?"
The guard, whose face was still a little childish, looked blank again, but soon his eyes regained clarity: "Yes!"
"Your punishment has no legal basis." Hobert seemed to have regained his feeling of being a lawyer: "You are the guards of His Majesty the Emperor, and your duty is to protect the Emperor, but you have no law enforcement power!
"Now you are not fulfilling your duty to protect the Emperor, but you are enforcing the law here. This is a serious dereliction of duty and overstepping of authority!"
The guard who read the document became blank for the third time. It took a full seven or eight seconds before he said: "His Majesty the Emperor has granted me temporary law enforcement power!"
"In my opinion, the Emperor does not have such authority!" Hobert continued: "Take the main political system of the North Continent as an example, the law enforcement power is in the hands of the court!
"The separation of law, politics, and imperial power is the national framework that conforms to the current political logic, and the law enforcement power is not in the imperial power.
"If you want to enforce the law, it will be contrary to the political structure of the North Continent, and I will question the legitimacy of the Emperor! And the rationality of this country!"
This is a classic defense idea of "seeing the big from the small". The core is to confuse concepts and use some seemingly correct conceptual things to make some of the opponent's ideas become illogical or unreasonable.
The guard finally gave in: "You can leave."
As Hobert left the city, he summarized in his mind: The Uniqueness must also follow certain logic and regulations as the basis for distortion and tampering, otherwise, when all logic and rules become abnormal, there is no meaning of distortion and tampering.
This is an idea, but it is quite difficult to make the logic and rules abnormal, because once there is nothing to distort and tamper with, the Uniqueness will lose its meaning of existence.
The Uniqueness seems to have a certain self-consistent ability and the "final right of interpretation", so it should not allow this to happen.
After Hobert came outside the city, he saw a large number of people pacing blankly outside the city. Some people who did not come in time to put on their coats had already frozen with purple lips.
In the face of mystical items at the level of the Uniqueness, ordinary people have no power to resist at all.
But if he wants to seal the Uniqueness, Hobert has to use these people.
So he began to use the ability of "incitement": "The Emperor's order is ridiculous! Does living in the city have anything to do with height?
"With this absurd order, it means that the Emperor is also very absurd!
"We must unite and resist the Emperor's absurd orders! Return to our own homes!"
The core of this remark is to question the Emperor's orders and question the Emperor himself!
Hobert found the idea from the ritual of advancing to "Black Emperor". The people believe that the advanced person is the Emperor is a very important anchor point in the ritual.
Then the Emperor created by the Uniqueness in this small city, although not a real Black Emperor, is more like a puppet of the Uniqueness.
However, if the public begins to widely question the Emperor's words, it should have a significant impact on the Uniqueness.
The people's dissatisfaction with the decrees and their desire to return home made Hobert's 'incitement' very successful!
Under Hobert's influence, everyone began to shout slogans together outside the city: "Oppose the Emperor's absurd orders!"
"Let us into the city!"
"Return our homes!"
"Return our property!"
Because Hobert's ability can cover 20 kilometers, almost all the people who had just been driven out of the city were within his range!
Gradually, the slogans became: "Oppose the Emperor's dictatorship!
"An assembly must be formed!"
Hobert successfully guided everyone's opposition into questioning the 'Emperor'.
At this time, everyone heard the new decree announced by the eunuch in the city: "The Emperor orders: Those who speak loudly will turn into a loach."
Hobert said softly, "The person announcing the order is speaking loudly!"
Although his voice was not loud, because he 'tampered' with the transmission path of the sound, people within dozens of kilometers around could hear his voice.
As a result, the person dressed as a eunuch who conveyed the order immediately turned into a loach.
Hobert continued to tamper with the transmission distance of the sound waves, so although everyone's voice was not loud, people in different directions of the city could hear the sound of slogans from another direction.
So the slogans continued to 'resound' around the city.
Before long, several people dressed as guards, less than 1.5 meters tall, came out of the city. After finding Hobert, they asked softly, "Are you loyal to the Emperor?"
Hobert also replied softly, "Of course I am loyal to the Emperor."
"Then why do you question the Emperor?"
"It is precisely because I am loyal to the Emperor that I question him!" Hobert said unhurriedly, "In order to prevent the Emperor from making irreparable mistakes, I must question his orders. This is my way of being loyal."
He paused and added, "In my opinion, questioning the Emperor and advising him is true loyalty!"
The surrounding people said one after another: "We are also questioning the Emperor because we are loyal to the Emperor!"
This line of thinking obviously exceeded the scope of the Uniqueness's wisdom. The guards became dazed again.
After a while, one of the guards asked, "How can we dispel your doubts?"
Hobert immediately understood that his plan had hit the nail on the head. Although the Uniqueness had some wisdom, it seemed to have no concept of deception.
The fact that the guard asked this question meant that the Uniqueness valued the people's questioning of the Emperor very much.
So Hobert said, "The Emperor should abolish the previous order and let everyone return to the city."
Immediately, the eunuch's voice sounded in the city: "The Emperor orders: Abolish the order that only those under 1.5 meters can live in the city! Abolish the order that those who speak loudly will turn into a loach!"
The people immediately applauded and shouted: "Hail to His Majesty the Emperor!
"Long live His Majesty the Emperor!"
The guards were about to breathe a sigh of relief, but they heard Hobert say: "The Emperor has withdrawn the order, which means that the Emperor is also very clear that his order is absurd!"
"I still want to question the Emperor, questioning whether he considered the people when he issued the order?"
For a time, both inside and outside the city were silent.
The Uniqueness in the city hall was also very strange. Why was the questioning of the Emperor even more intense than before?
The guard stared at Hobert: "You are not an honest person!
"The Emperor has already withdrawn the order, why do you still question him?"
"I seriously doubt your loyalty to the Emperor!"
Hobert immediately felt the danger. If he was judged to be disloyal, the Uniqueness would directly attack Hobert again.
But Hobert, who had made many attempts and had some understanding of the Uniqueness, said calmly and solemnly: "It is precisely because I am loyal to the Emperor that I question him!
"I suggest that in order to avoid the people from questioning the Emperor again, an assembly should be established to review the orders issued by the Emperor!
"If the people question the Emperor again, the responsibility can be pushed to the assembly."
The guard shook his head: "This will affect the Emperor's authority!"
"It won't!" Hobert said: "The people support the Emperor, and the Emperor has authority.
"Only those of us who think about the Emperor and are truly loyal to the Emperor will think about the Emperor's future reputation."
The guard was silent again. He seemed to be judging the logic and truth of Hobert's words.
Hobert smiled slightly. If he were inside the city hall at this time, it might be a good opportunity to control the Uniqueness.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert's seductive voice sounded again: "Let me form the assembly. The assembly will still be loyal to the Emperor, and the power formed by the assembly will ultimately belong to the Emperor."
The guard remained silent. After a while, a person dressed as a eunuch came out and announced: "The Emperor agrees to form an assembly. At the same time, the Emperor orders: The people's anger and questioning have therefore turned into trust and loyalty to the Emperor, and the assembly members' desire for power has been magnified!"
Hobert suddenly felt that he was very impressive as the Speaker of the Assembly and began to ponder how to manipulate the other councilors.
At the same time, a rational voice in his heart said: The Uniqueness is using the ability of 'bribery', first agreeing to form an assembly, and then taking the opportunity to 'weaken' and 'tamper' with everyone's thoughts and thinking.
He also realized: Especially the 'weakening' of me is very obvious. In the next period of time, I will definitely be targeted.
Finally, Hobert judged: Although the Uniqueness can arbitrarily decide the life and death of the people, the basis of all this is that the people recognize the Emperor it supports and support the Emperor's rule. When a large number of people begin to question the Emperor, the Uniqueness's control over the people will be weakened, and it may not even be able to directly 'distort' or 'tamper' with the people's thoughts, and can only use 'bribery' to regain control of the people.
Thinking of this, he smiled: This is very similar to the real power relationship! That's right, what the Uniqueness represents is the abstract representation of certain aspects, which should represent the abstraction and conceptualization of power. Theoretically, power represents not only rule, but also the shadow of order.
Power can build a ruling system, which is reflected in the trial and legislation, which is the 'positive' side of power. Similarly, power can also be used to create some bizarre or irrational regulations, which is the 'negative' side of power.
This understanding of the Uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' pathway made Hobert's spirituality very active for a while, and the Uniqueness's 'weakening' of him was somewhat reduced.
At this time, the guard said: "Assembly members, please come with me!"
Hobert and a dozen or so people who received 'special care' from the Uniqueness followed the guard into the city.
Other people also followed into the city to continue eating or sleeping in their homes.
Because of the influence of the Uniqueness, the councilors had a very bad attitude towards Hobert, the Speaker of the Assembly. As ordinary people, their desire for power was far greater than Hobert's, so they hoped to replace Hobert as the Speaker of the Assembly.
The guard led them to the outside of the city hall: "Prepare to meet the Emperor!"
Hobert could still see the big hole that had been smashed into the wall when he rushed into the city hall last time!
Following the guard into the door, the hall was still the original structure like a royal court. The 'Dog Emperor' sat on the throne, looking at Hobert and others in a human-like manner. The gorgeous crown and light ball ornaments were still worn on his head and neck.
In addition to the guards, there were also a dozen or so 'ministers' in two rows.
Because of the previous order of 1.5 meters, these 'ministers' were generally eleven or twelve-year-old teenagers. Among them, Erebus, with a somewhat hideous smile, was very conspicuous.
He should have also 'tampered' with his height just now to be able to become a minister according to the relevant rules.
Hobert and other assembly members knelt on one knee to the 'Dog Emperor'. After everyone got up, a eunuch standing next to the throne asked: "Why does the assembly want to question the Emperor's authority?"
"The assembly was ordered to be established by the Emperor!" Hobert said with a smile: "If we question the Emperor's authority, wouldn't we also be questioning our own legitimacy?
"If the Emperor questions us, he is questioning the previous order to form an assembly!"
"So we will never question the Emperor's authority, and the Emperor should not question us!"
Erebus's mouth twitched a few times on the side, and he sighed in his heart: This line of reasoning is too bastard! Isn't this bullying the Uniqueness for not having a brain!
Immediately afterwards, he seemed to understand why his and Trunsoest's previous actions had failed, because their ability to argue was far inferior to Hobert's.
At the same time, he also knew why the 'Dog Emperor' was so 'obedient' just now, and actually agreed to let Hobert form an assembly. It was obvious that his wisdom was not enough under the pressure of Hobert's verbal attacks, and he agreed in a daze.
The eunuch next to the throne paused for a few seconds before saying: "The assembly must also obey the Emperor's orders!"
"That's for sure." Hobert said with a smile: "But we must also clarify the power of the assembly."
The eunuch said: "You have no power to review the Emperor's orders!"
"Then we won't review them, but we have legislative power!"
"You can no longer incite the people to question the Emperor."
Hobert nodded: "Then we won't incite the people, but we have judicial power."
The two people clarified their respective powers like bargaining.
The eunuch smiled sinisterly: "The Emperor orders: The assembly members are relatively special in the national system, so they must live in the water like fish!"
This is a very typical 'tampering'! Highlighting their specialness, and then tampering with their form.
Immediately, water flowed under the feet of Hobert and the dozen or so others, but only under their feet, while the feet of the others were still very dry, as if they were standing in a glass fish tank.
Apart from Hobert, the other councilors were like fish, swimming in the water.
The reason Hobert didn't swim along was because he "distorted" the order, twisting "members of the council" into "councilors."
He was the Speaker, so of course, he wasn't included.
This is also why Hobert waited until Sequence 2 before attempting to control the Uniqueness; if he were at Sequence 3, his distortion wouldn't have any effect!
Hobert said loudly, "I impeach the Emperor! Disrespecting the council, actually making councilors live in the water!
"And the most crucial point is that the Emperor is a dog! Has anyone ever heard of a dog being an Emperor?"
The eunuch beside the throne said grimly, "The Emperor's authority is unquestionable, no one can impeach him! I seriously doubt your loyalty to the Emperor!"
"Others may not have the power to impeach the Emperor, but I do!" Hobert smiled, "The council has legislative power, so the first law is that the people of the kingdom must abide by the 'Constitution,' including the Emperor!
"The Emperor has no power to control the life forms of others, no power to judge others; these powers belong to the judicial assembly!
"At the same time, the judicial assembly have the right to judge the Emperor, because the Emperor must also follow the 'Constitution'!"
The person dressed as a eunuch paused for a moment before saying, "The Emperor is the most authoritative person, no one can judge the Emperor!"
"I admit that the Emperor is the most authoritative person!" Hobert still maintained his smile, "This doesn't contradict the rule that the Emperor must also abide by the 'Constitution.'"
"As long as he follows the 'Constitution,' he is the most authoritative person, but if he violates the 'Constitution,' he must accept impeachment and judgment."
Erebus looked at Hobert expressionlessly: This guy is a "good lawyer"! Fortunately, the struggle between me and him is not a debate, but a life-and-death battle!
Then, he looked at the Uniqueness with some sympathy, whether it was the "dog Emperor" or the eunuch, they both had confused expressions!
A dozen seconds later, the person dressed as a eunuch said, "Your argument is not valid; if you can judge the Emperor, you are the most powerful person in this country."
Hobert 'mm'ed: "The moment I became the Speaker, I was the most powerful person in this country!
"This is the power the Emperor bestowed upon me, a reward for my loyalty to the Emperor!"
Erebus also said, "Your Majesty, this is indeed the power you just granted to the council! The ministers can all testify to this!"
The Uniqueness was obviously confused by the current complex power structure, and the eunuch beside the throne directly asked, "Since you are the most powerful person in this country, why aren't you the Emperor? Why aren't you sitting on the throne?"
Hobert said, "I can be the Emperor and also the Speaker, so I have both the Emperor's authority and the power to impeach the Emperor!"
He ordered, "Let that dog leave, I will be the Emperor."
A few seconds later, the eunuch said, "You are indeed the most powerful person, please ascend the throne to become the Emperor."
Hobert left the area with flowing water and walked slowly towards the throne.
And the dog also jumped down from the throne at the same time.
Hobert sat on the throne, and the gorgeous crown on the dog's head floated towards Hobert.
Hobert remained calm, sitting upright, as if waiting for the Uniqueness's coronation.
When the crown reached the top of his head, he suddenly raised his hand, firmly grasped the crown, and used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to seal this Uniqueness as quickly as possible.
At the same time, Erebus also took action, but his target was the Sequence 1 "Prince of Abolition" characteristic still worn on the dog's neck.
He pounced over like a beast, holding down the dog's head with one hand and snatching the ball of light with the other.
But the moment he got the Sequence 1 characteristic, he felt something was wrong. Glancing at it, he found that the light emitted by the light cluster in his hand seemed to be deeper.
Erebus seemed to understand something. He looked up at Hobert and saw him holding the struggling Uniqueness in one hand and pointing at the Sequence 1 characteristic in his other hand.
After Hobert initially controlled the Uniqueness, he immediately used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to mark the Beyonder characteristic in Erebus's hand!

chapters.content:
