In the city hall of Antas, Hobert sat on the throne, one hand sealing the Uniqueness, the other marking the "Prince of Abolition" characteristic in Erebus's hand.
Just then, Tamara, having received the signal from Erebus, suddenly appeared behind Hobert. With a wave of her hand, she created a kind of balance between Hobert and the dog sitting beside him, causing Hobert's spirituality to surge wildly into the body of the "Dog Emperor."
This caused an imbalance in Hobert's spirituality, which was sealing the Uniqueness. The Uniqueness began to struggle violently, and under its distortion, the hand Hobert held it with transformed, turning into a bear's paw one moment, an octopus tentacle the next, and a goat's hoof another.
The surrounding ministers appeared as youths one moment, middle-aged men the next, sometimes a dozen, sometimes dozens.
The scene outside changed from night to noon in the blink of an eye, one second raining, the next snowing.
Erebus and Tamara were both affected to varying degrees, but Hobert, protected by the "Nation of Disorder," only had the hand holding the Uniqueness constantly affected.
However, even this influence was within a controllable range. Even when Hobert's hand turned into a goat's hoof, he still used his goat toe to clamp down on the crown.
"Bestow!" Hobert bestowed all the influence of the Uniqueness that he was receiving onto Tamara.
Tamara, who was about to continue her attack, quickly used her "Imprisonment" ability to seal the negative effects Hobert had bestowed upon her in mid-air.
She didn't have the "Nation of Disorder" and couldn't withstand the close-range effects of the Uniqueness's "struggle."
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert reached out and retrieved the "1-113" Solomon family emblem from the "Nation of Disorder." Using the power of the "Nation of Disorder," he merged it with Megali's spiritual residue within the emblem, creating an assistant comparable to the "Duke of Entropy!"
It was a female shadowy figure formed from pure power, somewhat illusory, with an unreadable face, seemingly wearing a gorgeous and intricate court dress.
Mystical symbols flowed over the court dress, making it look solemn and mysterious.
After becoming an angel, Hobert could complete this operation in the real world, and because he himself possessed a certain degree of divinity, he could give simple commands to the summoned "Duke of Entropy."
The angel-level helper formed by "1-113" was the confidence Hobert had to cooperate with Erebus.
For example, attacking a certain target, or ambushing someone at a certain location, and so on.
At this moment, Hobert's command to her was to hold back Tamara.
As for Hobert himself, while trying to control the Uniqueness, he looked towards Erebus, who was preparing to snatch the Uniqueness.
Erebus glanced at the crown in Hobert's hand, hesitated slightly, and then gestured to Tamara. The two angels immediately entered the spirit world.
Although Hobert had not completely sealed the Uniqueness, if Hobert initially controlled the Uniqueness, he could use the Uniqueness as a sealed artifact.
Using the Uniqueness in this way would definitely have great negative effects, but it would definitely allow Hobert to form an overwhelming advantage. If they didn't run now, they might not have a chance to run.
Sitting on the throne, Hobert watched Erebus leave, then had the "Duke of Entropy" helper protect him while he focused on sealing the Uniqueness in his hand.
The power of the "Nation of Disorder," solidified to resemble black crystal, gradually covered the gorgeous crown, like a layer of black frost forming on the crown.
A dozen seconds later, Hobert breathed a sigh of relief, finally completely sealing the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway!
He quickly put the Uniqueness into the "Nation of Disorder." At the same time, everyone in the entire city of Antas seemed to fall into a brief daze.
Hobert used his spirituality to examine the entire city, and after seeing that the social order and natural order here had basically recovered, he prepared to leave.
At this moment, Trunsoest suddenly appeared in the hall. He glanced at the "Duke of Entropy" with the illusory black figure in front of Hobert and gave an ugly smile: "Congratulations!"
Summoning a "Tree of Order" from the "Nation of Disorder" to ensure he could escape at any time, Hobert smiled sincerely: "Thank you!"
The next second, he took the summoned helper into the spirit world and returned to Backlund, to the study in the Duke's mansion.
First, he ended the summoning of the "Duke of Entropy" and returned "1-113" to the "Nation of Disorder."
Then, Hobert sat in the chair to rest. After sitting quietly for more than ten minutes, and seeing that Trunsoest had not chased after him, Hobert breathed a sigh of relief.
The reason he immediately returned to Backlund was that he was certain that with William I stationed in Backlund, Trunsoest could not enter the capital of the Loen Kingdom.
Only then did Hobert carefully set up a "spiritual wall" and enter the "Nation of Disorder" to pick up the Uniqueness that had been sealed before the "Iron Throne."
With the Uniqueness of this pathway, Hobert had a huge advantage in the "Godhood Competition" of the "Black Emperor" pathway.
Even if Erebus obtained two Beyonder characteristics of the "Prince of Abolition," and two Angels of the same path were to appear in the future, Hobert would still be the one with the advantage.
Moreover, Hobert also marked another Beyonder characteristic of the "Prince of Abolition"!
Thinking of this, Hobert couldn't help but curl the corners of his mouth. Without the thin-necked glass bottle containing the illusory fog, Erebus could forget about removing the mark in that characteristic.
If he didn't do anything about it, when he advanced to Sequence 1, Hobert would be able to sense it, and when he advanced, he could detonate that mark, causing Erebus to completely lose control!
Erebus still had one way, which was to pray for help from the Outer Gods.
From the fact that the Seven Gods tacitly agreed that the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" was obtained by Hobert, it was not difficult to see that even though the Seven Gods had many internal contradictions, they had a unified front when facing the Outer Gods.
Erebus was also very clear about this, so he could not ask the Seven Gods for help.
Praying for the help of the Outer Gods within the barrier of Earth, or simply praying for the help of his main body, the "Uncertain Mist," required a complicated ritual.
This was an opportunity for Hobert, because he could also use the mark on the Beyonder characteristic to detect Erebus's ritual, which would be the best time to seize this Sequence 1 characteristic.
If he could get two Beyonder characteristics of the "Prince of Abolition," then for Hobert, no Beyonder being of the same Sequence would be able to hinder his becoming a god.
Not even Trunsoest, after all, he was a Sequence 1, and whether it was the Uniqueness of the "Justiciar" pathway or the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic, they were very difficult to obtain.
In terms of level, although Hobert was one Sequence lower than Trunsoest, in terms of becoming a god, Hobert was temporarily at an advantage.
Thinking of this, Hobert took a deep breath and considered how to get his hands on the "Brass Book" and completely cut off his path to becoming a god.
There was no opportunity yet, so he could only collect information in advance and immediately seize the "Brass Book" after the war ended.
But the war would not end for another half a year, so this matter was not very urgent.
Finally, Hobert looked at the gorgeous crown sealed by the "Order Crystal" in his hand. His spiritual perception told him that before accommodating the Uniqueness, even in the "Nation of Disorder," he could only briefly use its power, and when not in use, he had to keep it sealed.
Forget about the real world. Once the seal was lifted, the Uniqueness would continue to resist Hobert, and if he was not careful, it would escape again.
Putting the Uniqueness on the armrest of the "Iron Throne," Hobert was somewhat uneasy. He planned to enter the "Nation of Disorder" every two or three hours these days to check on it.
At this moment, Hobert suddenly had an idea. With a wave of his hand, he took the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring," which could previously summon the "Holy Infant King," in his hand, preparing to use it to conduct an experiment.
There was no longer any spiritual residue or Beyonder power in the "umbilical cord." It had long become an ordinary umbilical cord.
Hobert released the seal of the Uniqueness and put the gorgeous crown on his head. At the moment of putting on the crown, his spirit body immediately expanded twice in size, and his temperament and demeanor became sacred and solemn.
But Hobert's eyes also seemed to have lost all spirituality, looking very empty.
This was the most difficult place for the Uniqueness to control for the current Hobert. Even when using it in the "Nation of Disorder," the divinity in Hobert's body would be far higher than his humanity.
If used for too long, Hobert might be assimilated by the Uniqueness.
This was not a good phenomenon. Unlike fusing with the Uniqueness, this was the Uniqueness actively assimilating Hobert. In the end, Hobert would become a tool of the Uniqueness, becoming a sealed artifact with strong spiritual imprint!
30 seconds!
Hobert had an epiphany regarding the Uniqueness; 30 seconds was the safe time to use it.
Although his divinity outweighed his humanity during those 30 seconds, Hobert still possessed enough rationality to Exploit certain abilities of the Uniqueness to achieve his goals.
He focused his attention on the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring." Currently, the number of times he could summon the "Holy Infant King" was 0.
Hobert used the power of the Uniqueness to "tamper" with the 0 times, changing it to 1 time.
The "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring" immediately underwent a transformation. Hobert once again sensed the spiritual residue and spirituality it contained!
It really worked!
Hobert quickly removed the crown and resealed it.
Looking at the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring" in his hand, from this day forward, the "Creator" would truly have two, no, three subordinates! Besides the "Umbilical Cord" and the black eye that could summon the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch," there was also "1-113"!
These three were completely loyal to the "Creator," angelic-level thugs whom the "Creator" could command as He pleased.
Hobert looked at the sealed crown in his hand. This was the Uniqueness!
Then, he sighed inwardly, "Erebus was right. With the strength of Sequence 2, there's no way to defeat the Uniqueness head-on. Fortunately, the Uniqueness has no brain!"
After playing with the magnificent crown for a while and putting the "Umbilical Cord of the Evil God's Offspring" back, Hobert returned to the real world. He pondered the matters of Erebus and Trunsoest for a moment, then traveled to Angel City overnight.
Tonight, Donna and Archibald were on duty. After all, they were in a state of war, and high-ranking officials from the government and military would have someone on duty at night.
Hobert learned the current situation from them. The aftermath of the full-scale war in the Northern Continent had finally affected this place. After confirming that Loen was unable to support the Southern Balam Governorate, the rebel army of the Highland Kingdom increased their marching speed significantly.
Moreover, outside Angel City, extraordinary battles were erupting every day. The Highland Kingdom had sent a large number of spies and raiding squads.
The extraordinary units of the Southern Balam Governorate took turns fighting, while also launching raids on the rebel camps.
Both sides had erupted into a full-scale war, and they were both preparing to launch a decisive battle.
The Highland Kingdom was gathering its forces, while the Southern Balam Governorate was waiting for Hobert.
Now that Hobert had arrived, the decisive battle was about to begin.
Immediately, Archibald introduced Hobert to the military's two decisive battle plans.
Angus and Helen, and other Beyonder forces, belonged to the "Beyonder Unit." This "Creator's" force was the core extraordinary power. They usually cooperated with the government to solve extraordinary cases within their jurisdiction, but in wartime, they were also a military force.
The only constant was that they only obeyed Hobert! Seel and Archibald had no authority to mobilize them.
However, when Seel and Archibald made combat deployments, they would definitely factor in this combat power. After the battle plan was approved by Hobert, Angus and the others would execute the deployments in the plan.
One of the military's two plans was to let the enemy reach Angel City and set up an ambush in the mountains to the east in advance. When the enemy attacked the city, the ambushing troops would attack the enemy from the rear.
As for the extraordinary battle, it was focused on the defense and contest of Angel City.
The second plan was to take the initiative to meet the enemy in the hilly terrain northeast of Angel City, on the enemy's inevitable route, and fight a decisive battle with them.
The reason for choosing to fight a decisive battle in the hilly area was because the enemy's numbers were more than ten times that of their own. It was difficult to conduct large-scale troop operations in the hilly area.
This would allow them to take advantage of the Southern Balam army's refined weapons and strong individual combat capabilities.
Moreover, the hilly area had a sparse population, making it very suitable for extraordinary warfare.
Regarding the extraordinary battle with the Highland Kingdom, the military was very confident. After all, they had once defeated the Demoness Sect. The Highland Kingdom, or rather, the "Rose School of Thought," was not stronger than the Demoness Sect at its peak.
It was just that the "Rose School of Thought's" power was more concentrated, and they were more familiar with the Southern Continent, making it a home game for them.
After discussing the battle plan, Donna brought up the issue of logistical support.
Hobert originally thought they were going to talk about the logistics of military supplies, but Donna immediately said, "We have accumulated enough administrative power. As long as the civil war is won, we can control the entire Southern Balam Governorate within ten days."
During this period, the governorate government had already begun to build fish ponds in the southern part of the Saint Sern Basin, designating economic forest areas and aquaculture areas.
And they had already built a Church of the Earth Mother there at the fastest speed. Bishops, priests, and servants of God were already in place.
In order to improve efficiency, they even asked the Beyonders to "distort" the terrain and compact many earthen roads.
Among all the Beyonder forces, only the subordinates of the "Creator" worked so diligently on such tasks, because such tasks could also earn merit.
In addition, after Miss Audrey's "persuasion," the first batch of residents had already arrived there, and it was estimated that about 10,000 natives could be resettled within the year.
They not only became subjects of the Southern Balam Governorate, but also resisted the small-scale raids by the remaining natives on the north, basically solving the security risks in the Saint Sern Basin.
The large-scale immigration plan from Backlund was also in the works. The immigration training institution in Backlund had prepared 5,000 immigrants, and they would be sent over immediately after the war ended using the teleportation array.
The governorate government planned to immigrate at least 500,000 people from the entire Loen Kingdom throughout next year.
However, according to Donna and the others' estimates, due to the impact of the war, the entire immigration plan should be overfulfilled. Many people had already gone bankrupt due to the soaring prices in Backlund.
As the war continued, it was estimated that more and more people would go bankrupt as a result. At that time, without much persuasion, they would even take the initiative to join the ranks of immigrants.
The premise of all this was that the government could form effective rule over the entire governorate. To this end, after the land reform on Longtail Island ended, the governorate government had been training and mobilizing grassroots officials.
And according to the national policy formulated by Hobert, a large number of grassroots officials had also been recruited in the Saint Sern Basin.
With these grassroots workers, the governorate government was confident that it could control the entire governorate within ten days and completely end the local aristocratic and warlord proxy political system.
After understanding the current situation, Hobert couldn't help but sigh inwardly. This civil war had indeed been delayed for too long.
The main reason was that He had been too busy recently, from digging graves for the King to snatch Sequence 1 characteristics, to helping Klein get rid of Amon, to advancing to Sequence 2 and seizing the Uniqueness.
These were all things that required Him to do it personally and devote all His energy to do.
Now it was good. He had finally found the time to end the civil war. Hobert estimated that the decisive battle in the Beyonder forces could be over within a day. If they could win, the rest would be the pursuit and arrest of the Earth King and the warlords.
Hobert had already figured out how to arrange for these proxies who colluded with the Highland Kingdom: to build His mausoleum!
As soon as the war was over, the matter of building a mausoleum would have to be put on the agenda immediately.
Currently, Hobert had squeezed Erebus's advancement peak to Sequence 1, but Trunsoest was still a very strong opponent!
The key was that the Sequence 1 characteristic of the "Justiciar" pathway and the Uniqueness were not controlled by Hobert at all, but Trunsoest had a very close connection with them.
Therefore, Hobert had to make some arrangements in advance for the advancement to True God.
After understanding the current situation, Hobert asked Donna to rest first. He wanted to chat with Archibald alone for a few words.
After only Hobert and Archibald were left in the command room, He said, "Under the instruction of the 'Creator,' I have completed the transaction for the eyes of the Hound of Fulgrim. You can prepare for the advancement ceremony while accumulating merit.
"As long as the ceremony is ready, you can advance in advance, but you have to make up for the corresponding merit afterward."
Archibald was somewhat excited: "I understand!"
Then, he sincerely thanked: "Thank you, Duke, thank you, 'Creator'!"
In his long life, he had long given up hope of becoming a complete Sequence 3, until he met Hobert, the blessed of the "Creator," and he smelled the opportunity for advancement.
Just as he had expected before, after joining the "Creator," his advancement was not a very difficult thing.
This made Archibald eager to try, wishing he could go and fight the demigods of the "Rose School of Thought" now!
The battlefield was always the fastest place to gain merit.
And the reason why Hobert only mentioned this matter now was because He had already advanced to Sequence 2 and obtained the Uniqueness, and could easily handle Archibald in terms of strength.
Although Archibald's performance had been very good all along, He still had to have the most basic vigilance.
As the two chatted idly, the night faded and sunlight streamed through the window.
After having breakfast with everyone, Hobert immediately convened a war council and selected the second battle plan.
That morning, the entire city of Angel seemed to have been set in motion. Various extraordinary units and the army completed their assembly one after another and set off together towards the northeast.
Those left to guard Angel were the security forces led by Freya, and the intelligence personnel led by Xio who had come to provide support later.
At full speed, the troops were expected to reach the predetermined battlefield by this evening. According to the scouts' reports, the main force of the enemy would not arrive until tomorrow afternoon at the earliest, so the Southern Balam army would have a night and the entire morning to rest.
Hobert, dressed in military uniform and a black cloak like an ordinary officer, rode his white horse and advanced with the main force, roughly in the middle of the column.
The tall Lawrence, also on horseback, approached and said, "Duke, I would like to speak with you alone."
Knowing what he wanted to talk about, Hobert waved his hand and designated a space for a private conversation: "Speak."
"Yes," Lawrence said, "You should know that the members of the Balk family have been suffering from the torment of the curse…"
To make the conversation more efficient, Hobert took the initiative and said, "Has the family curse been lifted now?"
Lawrence was slightly stunned, but quickly concluded that the lifting of the family curse was closely related to the 'Creator', perhaps even directly helped by the 'Creator'.
"Yes," Lawrence said, "I have been thinking about it for a long time. It should be, or rather, only the 'Creator' is a deity who favors us and has provided us with some help."
Hobert did not answer "yes" or "no", but calmly asked, "Have you ever wondered why the great 'Creator' sent me to be the liaison for the Balk family?"
Lawrence was stunned again, and instantly had a guess, but this guess seemed too bold. After all, they had previously received definite news that Rex had died in the ritual to advance to an angel.
Hobert answered himself, "Because my biological father is Rex. A long time ago, the 'Creator' helped me resist the damage caused by the curse, and I offered Him my loyalty.
"With the help of the 'Creator', I finally found out the truth about the curse, which turned out to be a means for Trunsoest to be resurrected."
Hobert looked at the very surprised Lawrence and continued, "That's right, our family's tragedy for more than a thousand years was just because an emperor wanted to be resurrected.
"Also with the help of the 'Creator', I completed the Sequence 2 advancement ritual and used the advancement to lift the family's curse."
Lawrence asked somewhat panic, "Then, then Night Emperor…"
"He has also been resurrected," Hobert said coldly, "But you must be clear that you are now loyal to the 'Creator'.
"I can tell you with certainty that if you want to follow Trunsoest, the Balk family will be destroyed!"
Lawrence nodded repeatedly and quickly said, "The 'Creator' is our only faith."
Now the Balk family is deeply bound to the 'Creator's' forces. If they were to serve Trunsoest, all their efforts would be in vain.
The key is that probably not many people would be willing to follow Trunsoest.
Although He is the ancestor, although He is the Night Emperor, He has caused the family to endure more than a thousand years of pain, while the 'Creator' saved the Balk family.
The suffering brought by the curse for a long time has already made everyone feel no sense of belonging to "Trunsoest", and the "Creator" has given very generous treatment. Anyone with a normal mind would not go to join Trunsoest.
Hobert said coldly again, "If Trunsoest secretly recruits you, you can pray to the 'Creator', but remember that Trunsoest now has the level of an angel, don't try to deal with Him."
Lawrence did not ask where Trunsoest got the Beyonder characteristics, but immediately said, "If I find Trunsoest, I will immediately report to the 'Creator'!"
Then he asked, "Duke, how should we thank the 'Creator'?"
Hobert paused slightly before saying, "That depends on your ideas."
Lawrence smiled and said, "It is precisely because we don't know how to thank you that we want to ask you."
Hobert did not continue to be polite: "I suggest, sacrifice a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact."
Lawrence immediately said, "I have the same idea."
Originally, there was a reward mechanism circulating in the family: whoever can help lift the family's curse, the Balk family will offer a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
After hearing Lawrence's words, Hobert nodded and said, "Such a sacrifice is not a loss for the Balk family.
"According to the 'Creator's' usual habits, after you sacrifice the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, if the Balk family's demigod needs this Sealed Artifact, they can pray to the 'Creator' to obtain temporary usage rights."
Lawrence was slightly stunned. In that case, the Balk family would indeed not suffer a loss. They would both thank the "Creator" and be able to apply to use the sacrificed Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
"Thank you, Duke," Lawrence thought that Hobert's suggestion was to consider the Balk family and strive for the greatest benefit for the family.
At the same time, he thought: The "Creator's" level is so high, the demand for Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts should not be great. Sealed Artifacts of this level are basically for high-level believers.
Hobert only felt that the Sealed Artifact was what He deserved.
According to the description in the notes inherited from Rex, whoever helps solve the family's curse can get a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact from the Balk family.
His explanation to Lawrence was simply thinking about the subsequent "Sealed Artifact Reuse" problem.
If it is not needed, it will be gathering dust in the "Nation of Disorder", and if the Balk family's demigod prays to use that Sealed Artifact, every time they pray, they owe the "Creator" a favor.
Hobert himself did not realize that at this time, he was much colder than before. He no longer had the feelings of human emotions, only a calm way of doing things, like applying a calculation formula.
Hobert also said, "In addition, after the war, the Balk family will hold a grand ceremony.
"All family members must attend the ceremony and thank the 'Creator'.
"In everyone's voices of gratitude, you will offer the sacrifice!"
He mainly wanted to use this ceremony to observe all the members of the Balk family with "True Sight" to see if Auernia had been resurrected among the family members.
Lawrence immediately said, "Thank you for your guidance. After the war is over, we will immediately build an altar and carry out the ceremony as soon as possible."
Hobert calmly talked about the next topic: "I hope you will accumulate more merits in the upcoming war. Now that the Balk family's curse has been lifted, you can safely advance to an angel.
"As far as I know, the 'Creator' also holds a copy of the Beyonder characteristic of 'Duke of Entropy'!"
That Beyonder characteristic came from the "Prince of Abolition" characteristic that Hobert had just crushed. Originally, after Solomon was resurrected, the three Sequence 1 characteristics in His body were very pure and did not contain characteristics of other sequences.
Later, when Roselle jumped to a non-adjacent pathway, he needed three Beyonder characteristics of the "Duke of Entropy" to support his becoming a god.
Because Roselle has not completed the resurrection process so far, the three "Prince of Abolition" Beyonder characteristics each contain one or several characteristics from Sequence 2 to Sequence 9.
Of course, after becoming a god, he should be able to discharge one or two "sets" of Beyonder characteristics on his own, but it has not been heard that Roselle has subordinates of the "Duke of Entropy", presumably Roselle in a semi-mad state did not make such operations.
Hobert's advancement also only needs three Beyonder characteristics of the "Duke of Entropy" as support, because He himself has a characteristic from Sequence 2 to Sequence 9, so He can completely crush one of the "Prince of Abolition" characteristics and only use the Beyonder characteristics of the "Prince of Abolition" to make potions.
Such a potion is not a burden for Hobert and can also take out a Beyonder characteristic of the "Duke of Entropy" to cultivate an angel.
Of course, Lawrence will only have the opportunity to advance after Hobert is Sequence 1.
Without the family's curse, Lawrence has hope for advancement again: "I will work hard to accumulate merits!"
Hobert nodded and stopped talking, indicating that the conversation was over.
The entire army marched for more than an hour. During a general rest, Seer suddenly hurried over to report to Hobert: "Duke! The enemy has learned that we have left the city to meet them in battle and are using extraordinary powers to speed up their march."
"Based on the enemy's current speed, their main force could pass through the Mattog Highlands by the afternoon."
This news was relayed to Seer by scouts through the "Nation of Disorder." Because the "Mystical Switchboard Operators" were handling the specific operations, Hobert was unaware of this information.
The Highlands are the predetermined battlefield for the decisive battle and the last barrier in the northeastern part of the Saint-Sern Basin.
The surrounding people stood up one after another, came to Hobert, and discussed how to increase the marching speed.
Lawrence said to several demigods of the "Lawyer" pathway: "We can be evenly distributed in different positions of the team and use the abilities of 'Tampering' speed or 'Distorting' space together. We will definitely reach the predetermined battlefield within half an hour."
Marva, a member of the Tony family who had recently been promoted to "War Bishop," said: "There is no need for such trouble at all. I have an ability that can average the speed of everyone in the unit."
"Currently, our team, including logistics personnel, is less than 2,000 people. Everyone uses Beyonder abilities, runs as fast as they can, and I will average everyone's speed."
"We can probably reach the predetermined battlefield in ten minutes."
At this point in the discussion, everyone looked at Grand Duke Hobert.
Hobert calmly said "Oh" and then stated: "Everyone, continue to rest. We will set off again in three minutes!"
Several demigods were stunned, meaning that their suggestions had not been adopted. Were they going to abandon the original battle plan?
After another three minutes of rest, as the whistle sounded, the soldiers resting on both sides of the road immediately prepared to set off.
Hobert also mounted his white horse again. He said to the front in high spirits: "I think you have all heard, to varying degrees, that many miraculous things have happened in this battle!"
"That's right! Our battle this time has the gaze of the gods! The gaze of the great 'Creator'!"
"Because our guns are aimed at the heretics of the Southern Continent! The war you are now waging is a holy war! A holy war to liberate the people who are cruelly enslaved and tortured by the heretics!"
"The enemy has gained the power to advance rapidly through bloody sacrifices, and the war may break out ahead of schedule!"
"But we also have the blessing of the gods! It will allow us to reach the battlefield faster. Everyone, get ready!"
Hobert did not shout hard, but His words reached everyone's ears!
These words seemed to be extremely Incitement, and the soldiers were deeply convinced of Hobert's pre-war mobilization, which made their blood boil: This battle has the gaze of the gods, and this battle is a holy war!
The soldiers could not wait to start a desperate fight with the enemy!
"Depart!" As Hobert said these words, he used the ability of "Distortion" to distort space.
After becoming an angel, most of Hobert's abilities have undergone qualitative changes. Within a radius of twenty kilometers, He can carry any living beings and things inside with him to cross space.
Almost in the blink of an eye, this team of more than 1,800 people appeared on the predetermined battlefield.
Several demigods not far from Hobert were stunned: No wonder we didn't need our plan. It turned out that the Grand Duke had a faster way!
The most touched was Lawrence: This is the power of an angel. Such an ability is already a miracle.
Not only ordinary soldiers, but even the Beyonders reacted after a few seconds and began to loudly praise the "Creator."
After the sound of praise subsided, Archibald and Seer began to issue orders, set up defense lines and artillery positions, set up command posts and ammunition depots, and so on.
Hobert led Lawrence, Marva, Angus, and others to the top of a hill to look northeast.
The surrounding hills are not very high, and the view is very good. From here, it looks like one green bubble after another has appeared on the ground.
Just as they were discussing how to accurately attack the enemy's Beyonders, Lawrence suddenly stopped, and then his face changed drastically: "Everyone, Rockville City has been attacked by the enemy, and the Beyonders left there have suffered heavy casualties."
Elliott was very concerned about this: "Where did the enemy come from?"
Rockville City has always been guarded by the Balk family, and there have been heavy casualties, which means that many members of the Balk family have died!
Therefore, among the people present, Lawrence and Elliott were particularly concerned about this.
"No matter where the enemy comes from, let's support Rockville City first," Hobert said: "Lawrence, Elliott, immediately gather your subordinates, and I will pray to the 'Creator' to send you to Rockville City."
"If you need more support, ask me for help immediately!"
Lawrence and Elliott immediately agreed and immediately used the method of "distorting" space to go down the mountain to gather their subordinates.
After they had gathered almost enough, Hobert pretended to pray. His spirit body took the opportunity to enter the "Nation of Disorder," lifted the seal on uniqueness, put on the crown, and the spirit body expanded twice.
Then, using his stars, he projected power and "distorted" the positions of Lawrence and Elliott and hundreds of other Beyonders, allowing them to appear directly in Rockville City.
Not only Lawrence and others, but also Marva and others present also noticed that the "Creator's" temperament had undergone tremendous changes.
They didn't see the specific changes, because the moment the "Creator" appeared, their spirituality forced them to lower their heads.
At the same time, their legs became weak, and they knelt down on one knee unconsciously.
What is certain is that the "Creator" gave people more pressure, and correspondingly, the "Creator" must be more powerful!
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert did not immediately return to the real world, but used Lawrence's stars to observe the situation in Rockville City.
At this time, fierce extraordinary battles were breaking out on the streets of the city. The Beyonders left behind were already on the verge of collapse and were using sealed items to retreat to the Governor's Mansion in the city.
The sudden appearance of Lawrence and others made both sides a little confused. The battle was briefly favorable to the Balk family, but soon, because the enemy's power was too strong, the Balk family was forced to shrink the front again.
After observing for a while, Hobert noticed that the enemy had "Hunters" and "Bards."
Hobert had a general guess as to where the enemy came from.
Returning to the real world, Hobert wondered which part of the force to send to continue to support?
The people of the Tony family can no longer be sent there. Originally, the two main forces in this battle were the Balk family and the Tony family. Now that the Balk family has returned to support, the Tony family must stay here to resist the "Rose School of Thought."
At this time, Angus and others were discussing where the enemy that suddenly appeared came from?
"They are the Beyonder forces of the Feysac Empire and the Intis Republic," Hobert said very calmly.
Although Hobert and the angel of the Feysac Empire had destroyed George III's mausoleum together, with the sudden death of George III, their cooperative relationship ended.
The products of "Earl's Light" are very popular in the Intis Republic and have a good relationship with the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, but the Eternal Blazing Sun Church has a good relationship with "Earl's Light," not with the Duchy of Southern Byland.
Seeing that everyone's expressions were a little surprised, Hobert further explained: "On the battlefield of the Northern Continent, the Feysac Empire and the Intis Republic are jointly attacking Loen."
"This makes the Beyonders of the Feysac Empire no longer as free as they were some time ago to take care of other things, so they want to recover the two states ceded to us."
"As for the Intis Republic, after the forces of Feysac and Feynapotter successively withdrew from the southern part of the Southern Continent, only the forces of the Intis Republic are left here."
"They can understand with their butts that as long as we free up our hands, we will definitely clean them up, so it is better to take the initiative to attack our living forces."
Some people frowned, some were silent. The war, which was originally confident of victory, deviated from the original plan from the beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 671: Reinforcements from the Two Duchesses
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Soon, Elliot reported the current situation of Rockville City to Hobert in detail. As Hobert had guessed, the enemies attacking the city were indeed the Beyonders from the Feynapotter Empire and the Intis Republic.
The time Hobert spent on advancement and competing for uniqueness gave them time to transfer forces to the Southern Continent.
Even with the support of the entire Balk family, the enemy's Beyonder forces still had a huge advantage. According to Elliot's observation, there were at least eight demigods among the enemies, while the Balk family only had four.
Fortunately, the enemy has not dispatched angel-level power yet, so the Balk family is currently only shrinking their defenses and resisting near the Governor's Mansion.
This news silenced everyone again, meaning that at least four more demigods and corresponding forces had to be sent to Rockville City.
But if that were the case, the forces on the decisive battlefields here would definitely not be enough.
"Rockville City cannot be lost!" Hobert said calmly, "Our light industrial base is behind this city."
He took a deep breath and said, "Malva, go and gather all the power of the Tony family!"
Malva, with her sharp-edged face, was a little surprised, but immediately said, "Yes!"
Angus, Hobert's confidant, couldn't help but ask, "Duke, are you going to let the Tony family support Rockville City too?"
Malva and the others wanted to ask this question, but their relationship with Hobert was not as close as Angus, Helen, and Elliot, so they felt it was not appropriate for them to ask.
Hobert replied: "I just suddenly thought that the timing of this raid by Feysac and Intis is problematic. Let Malva gather people and prepare to resist the impact of the "Rose School of Thought" Beyonders."
Everyone immediately realized that this was indeed the case. They didn't attack sooner or later, but launched an attack when the Southern Balam Duchy was preparing for a decisive battle and all its forces was dispatched, which definitely had a secret cooperation or connection with the "Rose School of Thought".
Angus was slightly stunned. In the past, when encountering such situations, Hobert would explain it to everyone first, but why didn't he explain it today? Did he cause everyone to misunderstand?
After Malva and the other demigods of the Tony family left, Hobert said to Helen again: "Go and gather people, and send someone to notify Jonathan to let the Theosophy Council participate in the war.
"As long as the council members who come to intercept the "Rose School of Thought" today will be official Beyonders, but only before 2:00 PM, and the organized forces must be put into the battlefield in batches. The first batch of support must be in place within 15 minutes."
The beautiful and charming Helen was stunned for a moment, then smiled and said, "The entire Theosophy Council will participate in the war!"
The current members of the Theosophy Council dream of becoming official Beyonders, but Hobert has been restricting their joining, fearing that they will bring too many unstable factors to his forces
But now he can't take care of so much, he must first urgently recruit a group of forces.
Just after talking with Helen, Hobert suddenly looked to the northeast. With a wave of his hand, the boundary between the real world and the spirit world suddenly fell into a state of "Disorder", revealing the scene in the spirit world.
In the spirit world, a large number of "Rose School of Thought" Beyonders were exposed in front of the phalanx formed by the Tony family's Beyonders.
Seeing that their surprise attack was detected, they immediately left the spirit world and rushed towards the Tony family's Beyonders.
Hobert said to Angus: "Go and gather the members of the Tudor family and join the war immediately!"
With the participation of Angus and others, the attack of the "Rose School of Thought" was temporarily resisted.
The extraordinary melee spread across several hills, and the battle was fierce from the beginning.
Basically, everyone who could be sent out had been sent out, and only a Beyonder named Dophis remained beside Hobert.
This was the captain sent by the "Temperance Faction" to serve Hobert, but because this was a civil war in the Southern Balam Duchy, and because Hobert's forces was relatively abundant, Hobert did not intend to cooperate with the "Temperance Faction".
Hobert looked at the battlefield in front of him and asked Dophis: "Do the members of the 'Temperance Faction' hope to obtain the status of official Beyonders?"
"Now the members of the team like the status of official Beyonders very much, but it is hard to say about other members," Dophis said truthfully.
This is because the extraordinary team of the "Temperance Faction" lacks the experience of a large-scale extraordinary war.
Just like Angus and Helen's team back then, it was only after experiencing a Beyonder war that the members of the Tudor family and the Demoness of Pleasure saw the hope of advancement and the guarantee of death or injury, so they were very willing to join the official Beyonders.
Hobert thought for a while and said: "You send someone to ask Miss Sharron for help, and say that if they can send three demigods and no less than 60 Beyonders to Rockville City before 2:00 PM, I will give Sharron a 'Disciple of Silence' Beyonder characteristic."
Dophis's scalp tingled: "Disciple of Silence"! Sequence 3 characteristics! This reward is enough for three demigods to sell their lives!
"I will send someone to contact Miss Sharron immediately!" Dophis said and immediately went to assign manpower.
At this time, Helen at the foot of the mountain heard Hobert's voice in her ear: "Organize manpower to attack the enemy from the left flank!"
Helen couldn't help but look back. Hobert was still standing on the distant hill, but the voice just now seemed to be coming from a few steps behind her.
She seemed to realize that Hobert seemed to have advanced again.
After only a slight pause, Helen began to loudly order to organize the charging formation and attack the enemy's left flank.
Hobert watched the battlefield on the hill. Although the number of Beyonders on his side was small, the current battle situation was still optimistic.
This benefited from the systematic training of official Beyonders after the Southern Colson Campaign.
In that battle, a huge weakness of official Beyonders was exposed: in large-scale extraordinary wars, there was a lack of sufficient cooperation and strong command.
The Tudor family members who participated in the war at that time were a good example. When the battle went smoothly, it was okay, but once they encountered the enemy's counterattack, they fought on their own, resulting in heavy losses.
So after that, Hobert planned to train the official Beyonders in terms of command and cooperation, and the effect was very significant.
Like Angus's team, it is generally a five-person team composed of three to four members of the Arbiter pathway and two or one member of the "Lawyer" pathway.
This is the characteristic of the Tudor family. This family is mainly composed of members of the Arbiter pathway. After cooperating with Hobert, some members of the "Lawyer" pathway appeared, so this kind of team with a proportion of pathways was formed.
Generally, the members who are good at close combat rush to the front. If there is a "Bribers" in the team, they will definitely let him "bribe" and "weaken" the enemy from behind, and constantly use abilities such as "Charm" and "Arrogance" to affect the enemy.
If there is no "Bribers", there is generally a "Judge" in the rear who "imprisons" or "imprisons" a target, and then five members quickly surround it. If the enemy does not have time to support, they will kill the enemy.
If there is no "Judge", the "Interrogator's" "Mental Whip" can also well temporarily control the enemy.
The Tony family has a relatively rich extraordinary pathway. They also use a five-person team as the basic combat unit.
Most of the team members are two Beyonders of the "Hunter" pathway, two Beyonders of the "Lawyer" pathway, and one Beyonder of the Arbiter pathway.
Such a combat team has strong attack power. Two "Hunters" charge in the front, first using "Fireball" and "Fire Crow" to attack distant enemies. When they get close, they directly use knives, swords, or "Blazing White Spear" to fight the enemy in close combat.
"Lawyers" are responsible for adding negative effects such as "Weakness" to the enemy, and "Arbitrators" seize the opportunity to control the enemy.
Of course, there are not many elite teams mentioned above. Most of the team leaders are Sequence 7 or Sequence 6, and most of the team members are "low sequence".
Different levels of teams choose different levels of enemies.
A team with Sequence 7 as the leader will basically choose enemies of Sequence 7 or below, and a team with Sequence 6 as the leader will choose enemies of Sequence 6 or below.
Elite teams are generally Sequence 5 as the leader, and the members are at least Sequence 7. They will roam the battlefield and seize the opportunity to hunt down enemies at the Sequence 5 level.
Demigod members are basically commanders. They have no team and will seize the opportunity to help other teams or specifically deal with a certain demigod.
These two proven formations are very practical. The five-person team is the most basic combat unit, and the members listen to the captain's command.
The captains uniformly listen to the command of extraordinary officers such as Angus and Helen. For example, Angus and Malva's troops have more than a dozen teams, and they cannot command them at all, so they have two deputies.
At the beginning, the enemy's surprise attack and numerical advantage once gave them the initiative in the battle.
But when the five-person team mechanism started to operate and several Sequence 5 enemies were hunted down, the enemy's offensive gradually disintegrated.
The members of the "Rose School of Thought" also cooperate, but their cooperation is not as stable as that of official Beyonders, so when they fight together in groups of two or three, they are simply not opponents of the five-person team.
If they concentrate eight or nine people to besiege a five-person team, the five-person team will immediately enter a defensive state.
At this time, the role of the commander must be brought into play, either under the commander's order, two other teams come to support, or under the commander's order, other teams attack the enemy's weak points, forcing them to return to defense.
In this tactic, they often seize the opportunity of the enemy's slow reaction or the command system is not so sensitive, and work together to seize the opportunity to kill one or two enemies.
After several encounters, the effect of effective command became greater and greater. The enemy continued to suffer casualties, and the official Beyonders of the Southern Balam Duchy gradually reversed the disadvantage.
So Hobert let Helen's troops attack and attack the enemy from the side.
The Beyonders of Helen's troops are of the "Apprentice" pathway and the "Assassin" pathway, that is, the Beyonders of the "Witch" pathway. Their team's tactics are mainly guerrilla warfare.
But because the attack power of the "Witch" pathway is also very good, they can also harass the enemy and cover the main force!
While Helen was rushing to the battlefield, Hobert first prayed to "The Fool" and asked the Tarot Club members for help, and then contacted Fors and Audrey respectively, and assigned them tasks one after another.
Unfortunately, Emlyn is still under "protective custody" in the Church of the Evernight Goddess, otherwise he could call for Sanguine support.
All the forces that can be mobilized has been put into the battlefield, and Hobert has not actively contacted the "Element Dawn" support army.
He decided to wait and observe the development of the battle situation.
Just as Helen's troops were preparing to launch an attack from the flank, Hobert summoned two demigods, one was "Bull Devil Monarch" and the other was "Great Sage".
Currently, the Black Hound Spirit Beast is still on the "Trunsoest Empire", so the only "demigods" Hobert can use are them.
With the uniqueness of the "Black Emperor", these two demigod-level helpers can be used as many times as he wants, and he can use them however he wants.
Hobert "tampered with" their summoning time, changing a few minutes to a few tens of minutes. Now they can fight continuously for more than an hour.
After they disappear, summoning them again can fight for more than an hour again.
Even a real Sequence 3 is not so capable!
The only disadvantage is that their wisdom is not very high, and their use of Beyonder abilities is not detailed enough. They can entangle opponents at the Sequence 3 level, but it is difficult to harm them.
However, this time Hobert simply ordered them to attack enemies below the demigod level, and it is still very easy to kill enemies at this level.
"Bull Devil Monarch" and "Great Sage" charged from the right wing of the battlefield, ignoring a "Disciple of Silence" and a "Puppet" who greeted them, and charged and killed Sequence 5 and Sequence 6 within sight!
They are not afraid of physical attacks, nor are they afraid of possession, and they treat curses as tickles, which is very restrained by the "Prisoner" demigod's ability.
In just half a minute, they cooperated with Helen's surprise attack to disperse the enemy's formation.
Angus and Malva took the opportunity to launch a counterattack, and the "Rose School of Thought" commander immediately issued a retreat order.
At this time, the spirit world suddenly seemed to crack open, exposing itself to the real world.
The reaction caused by this process formed a violent storm, uprooting big trees and rolling huge rocks into the sky.
Hobert stretched out his hand and "tampered with" the storm into a breeze, so that the official Beyonders were not blown away by the storm.
In the spirit world, there was a figure tens of meters high. He was wearing a Southern Continent-style wizard robe and opened his hands to both sides.
That was the angel Barana of the "Rose School of Thought". It was he who "opened" the spirit world, creating a chance for the members of the "Rose School of Thought" to retreat.
Barana glanced at Hobert from a distance, and Hobert was also staring at him.
At this time, both angels were very restrained and did not immediately start an angel-level battle. After all, the main purpose of this raid was to test and delay part of the main force of the Beyonders of the Southern Balam Duchy.
Under Hobert's instruction, Angus and others did not pursue, but dragged down a small group of enemies and let the enemy's main force retreat.
When the main force of the "Rose School of Thought" all entered the spirit world, Barana's body became smaller, and he also retracted his hands that "opened" the spirit world. The boundary between the spirit world and the real world was quickly repaired by itself.
In the first stage of the extraordinary war, the Southern Balam Duchy won.
After the enemy's main force withdrew, Hobert immediately ordered Angus's troops to retreat from the battlefield.
Still standing on the hilltop, Hobert raised a hand and "bestowed all the injuries and fatigue of Angus's dozens of Beyonders to the wild grass covering the mountains.
Then, as if speaking into their ears, he said, "Immediately go and support Angel City!"
Angus, still marveling at Hobert's latest advancement, was slightly taken aback before realizing why the enemy had retreated so readily—their primary objective in the first phase of the battle was to raid Angel City!
...
Rewind to ten minutes earlier, Angel City.
The defense here was entrusted to Freya, only Sequence 7, and a few "low-sequence" Beyonders.
After the main force marched out, Hobert had transferred Xio, who had just advanced to Sequence 5 "Disciplnary Knight," and more than twenty members of the Travelers Research Society to come and support.
So, the current defending forces is Xio, wielding the "1-107" Imperative Mage Gloves, and Freya, holding the "Priest of Light Ring" that Hobert used to use.
The rest were basically Sequence 9s and Sequence 8s with little combat experience.
In the battle plan, this arrangement was more like a trap, waiting for the enemy to attack the city, and then Hobert would quickly arrange forces to support it.
But the forces that was originally supposed to support here had gone to support Rockville City!
Thus, this place became the weak point of the Southern Balam Duchy.
The enemy's surprise attack came from the Spirit World. To create a shocking effect, two demigods transformed into two "puppets" several meters tall, with horribly pale skin, empty eyes, and black liquid flowing from the corners of their eyes.
They approached the city wall step by step, putting tremendous mental pressure on the defenders on the wall. Many soldiers were cursed by the "puppets" and died amidst screams, with blood flowing from their eyes, ears, and mouths.
When the towering "puppets" reached the city wall, the soldiers finally reacted and fired at the puppets.
But their guns seemed to have a life of their own. The moment the trigger was pulled, the muzzle suddenly turned and aimed at their comrades!
The well-trained soldiers reacted immediately and released the triggers.
But the triggers still pulled themselves.
Bang, bang~
After a series of gunshots, the soldiers who had survived the curse fell into pools of blood.
The two tall "puppets" reached the city wall and pushed it down with ease.
The collapsed city wall stirred up a cloud of dust, burying many soldiers under the ruins.
The tremendous mental pressure and the impact of power caused the soldiers to collapse immediately.
During the enemy's two demigods' attack, Xio also issued the order to "abandon the city immediately!"
Xio and Freya had both participated in the previous South Colson battle, although they were both in the rear or performing battlefield cleanup tasks.
But as long as they had seen extraordinary warfare of that level, they would not panic when encountering similar situations again.
This was the case at this time as well. After seeing the enemy's offensive momentum, Xio immediately ordered a retreat.
Anyway, while the army was marching, government personnel and residents had already withdrawn to the mountainous area outside the city. There were only 300 soldiers here.
Xio realized that his primary task was to prevent excessive casualties among the members of the Travelers Research Society and the soldiers.
But because the enemy's offensive was too fierce, Xio's goal became to withdraw as many as possible.
Just as the first batch of Beyonders surged into the teleportation array, three figures appeared in the teleportation array first.
Xio was slightly stunned at first, then breathed a sigh of relief.
The three people were the beautiful and dignified Audrey, the serious Christian, and the pale-faced Dophis, who looked like a dead man.
As soon as Christian appeared, she said in a voice that everyone in Angel City could hear: "I'm here to take over the command here!
"Everyone, move closer to the headquarters, abandon the city walls, and build a defense line in the surrounding blocks!"
The "Disciple of Silence" in charge of this raid by the Rose School narrowed his eyes: "Christian!"
This used to be Rex's right-hand man, the one who always cleaned up for Rex no matter how excessive he was in the front!
In the Southern Continent, one may not know who the governor of East Balam is, but one must have heard of Rex and Christian!
With the participation of Christian and Dophis, a decent defense line was finally formed around the headquarters.
After hesitating slightly, the Rose School's raiders immediately organized their forces and launched a new attack.
The ordinary soldiers and "low-sequence" Beyonders who were holding the defense line were a little flustered when they saw the attacks of "Wraiths," "Zombies," and "Werewolves."
"The power of reality here is enhanced, and the power of the extraordinary is weakened!" Christian floated above their heads and said.
The enemy's attack suddenly slowed down. The "Wraiths" were forced to end their mirror-jumping state and could only run forward to charge. The aura of death and coldness on the "Zombies" suddenly weakened significantly, and the "Werewolves" directly returned to human form.
At the same time, Audrey inside the headquarters was constantly "soothing" the soldiers.
The soldiers were no longer so panicked and began to attack the enemy with guns and cannons. At this time, the rifles in their hands could also kill the summoned Zombies and injure the "Zombies" and "Werewolves."
Shells could also blow away the rushing Beyonders!
As the weakened "Wraiths" approached the front line, Dophis summoned a seemingly very illusory and not very terrifying "Underworld Gate," making it difficult for them to use their "possession" and "wraith transformation" abilities.
But as the enemy's demigods joined the battle, this position formed by ordinary people and "low-sequence" Beyonders was immediately breached.
At this moment, the teleportation array was activated again, and Barnett, the patriarch of the Tudor family, arrived with more than twenty Beyonders.
After the South Colson battle, this gray-haired patriarch, dressed as a gentleman, moved to Jeffrey City in South Colson at Hobert's suggestion.
Hobert's intention in doing this was: Although the Tudor family was not completely incorporated, the Tudor family members who had not become official Beyonders had to become the reserve team of official Beyonders.
Currently, the elite of the Tudor family are all in Angus's unit, but the Tudor family still has more than thirty Beyonders under Barnett's control.
This was the last bit of face Hobert left for Barnett. He couldn't possibly let this "old gentleman" become Angus's subordinate, right?
Barnett was also very satisfied with this arrangement. With the elite of the Southern Balam Duchy all out, he obeyed Hobert's arrangement and took over the defense of Longtail Island and the South Colson area.
That's why they were able to quickly complete the support for Angel.
The arrival of these Beyonders made up for the serious shortage of Beyonders in the position, and the Beyonders of the Rose School were blocked outside the headquarters.
At this time, the number of demigods on both sides was the same, both three, but the Southern Balam Duchy had two Sequence 3s, giving them a slight advantage.
This was when Audrey was really put to use. Christian also had some conflicts with Barnett, and Audrey mediated between them, so there was no situation where the enemy had not been driven away, and their own people started fighting first.
Christian would definitely give her daughter-in-law face, and Dophis would obey Christian's command.
Barnett had heard family members mention this "Duchess" from the Backlund nobles. Since she had already pledged allegiance to the "Creator," she would of course try to obey the arrangements of this Favored lady.
This was the main reason why Hobert called Audrey here. When He was not present, Audrey and Fors could represent Him to connect the scattered forces or make some decisions.
When Angus's troops appeared outside Angel City without any rest, the Rose School immediately retreated.
At this time, another angel of the Rose School, Kleist, whose eyes were full of malice and exuded an evil aura, appeared from the Spirit World.
He leaned on a long leg bone and a skull-made crutch, preparing to cover the retreat of the Rose School members.
For a time, an evil aura filled Angel City. Many people did not even see this angel, but only felt His presence, and they turned into animals or monsters covered with fangs, tongues, and eyeballs.
But in the next instant, a surging force dispelled the evil in the city, and the animals and monsters immediately returned to their original soldiers or Beyonders.
At the same time, not far from Kleist, a huge eyeball appeared. On the white of this eyeball, there were small eyes.
The eyeball clearly exuded an aura of aberration, but its body was surrounded by a holy radiance interwoven with clarity and darkness.
Aberrant yet normal, evil yet sacred!
This was the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" who reappeared in the "Creator's" power system.
Immediately afterwards, on the other side of Kleist, a phantom black force appeared, forming a female silhouette. She was a bit illusory overall, and her face could not be seen clearly. She seemed to be wearing a gorgeous and intricate court dress.
Mystical symbols flowed outside the court dress, looking solemn and mysterious.
Hobert didn't intend to let go of these Beyonders who attacked Angel City, so he sent two "angels" to stop Kleist.
The Rose School's "Ancient Evil God's" spirituality issued a strong danger warning, which made Him immediately realize that the "Creator" intended to kill Him, along with these two angels, before the Rose School could react.
The Rose School also did not intend to have a decisive battle in the surprise attack on Angel City. Currently, the main force was still on the battlefield of the decisive battle, and Barana could not quickly support.
Without any hesitation, Kleist immediately slammed his crutch, forming a phantom bronze door in front of Him, temporarily blocking the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" and the "Duke of Entropy."
The next second, the phantom door disappeared, and Kleist was nowhere to be found.
Hobert, in the "Nation of Disorder," had just lifted the seal of Uniqueness when the other party escaped.
He had to reseal the Uniqueness: The reason why angels are difficult to kill may be that they all have one or two escape skills that are difficult to stop.
Then Hobert's gaze turned to the battlefield in Angel City. Under the siege, the Rose School's forces immediately collapsed.
Hobert withdrew the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" and let the "Duke of Entropy" attack the enemy's demigods.
The "Duke of Entropy" first waved his hand, and the injuries on the three demigods were "magnified," and one of them died on the spot.
The limit of "magnification" at the angel level is no longer just a fatal injury.
Even an angel of the same level, if the "Duke of Entropy" is allowed to "magnify" continuously, can die from a minor scratch.
However, being angels, they have many ways to avoid the continuous "magnification" of injuries, which will only cause them inconvenience at most, and will not really be killed by a minor scratch.
But Beyonders below the angel level are very likely to die from their injuries under the "magnified" attack of the "Duke of Entropy."
Immediately afterwards, the "Duke of Entropy" cut off the "connection" between the remaining two demigods and the Spirit World and the "Mirror World." In the despair of the "Disciple of Silence" and the "Puppet," the "Duke of Entropy" reached out and pushed forward, and the two demigods, known for their strong physiques, were torn apart by a "chaotic" force.
The other members of the Rose School immediately gave up resistance.
Even Christian and the others were stunned for a moment, and they all sighed inwardly at the qualitative change in the ability and power of angels.
After solving the other party's demigods, the "Duke of Entropy" disappeared immediately.
The members of the Rose School expressed their willingness to surrender. These Southern Balam people were even more cruel than them. No more fighting, no more fighting!
Christian said to Angus, "You guys come and receive the prisoners."
As she spoke, she winked at Angus.
Angus understood and loudly told the members of the Rose School not to resist, and loudly ordered his subordinates to escort them to prison.
But after his subordinates controlled the prisoners, Angus immediately ordered with an icy face: "Execute them on the spot!"
The subordinates were slightly stunned, but they immediately carried out the order.
The prisoners were a little unbelievable: "We have all surrendered! Why do you still want to kill us? Aren't you official Beyonders?"
At this time, Freya, who had been fighting on the front line and was covered in dirt, said, "After killing our people, surrendering is enough? I support Captain Angus's judgment!"
"You reminded me by saying that!" Angus said, "After all, we are official Beyonders, and we must abide by relevant laws. Prisoners also have basic human rights and the right to defend themselves."
He paused and then said, "'Judges,' come forward and judge them!"
The prisoners didn't know what to say. They had to help their "judges" digest the potion before they died!
Christian, who was watching the show outside the crowd, nodded. Angus's handling method had a lot of Hobert's style.
In his opinion, there are no prisoners in Beyonder warfare. These prisoners are difficult to guard, so it is better to directly turn them into Beyonder characteristics, which can still exert their "value."
It only took a dozen minutes for the "judges" to sentence all the prisoners to death and execute them immediately.
Freya led the members of the Travelers Research Society to clean up the battlefield, and Angus's troops rested in Angel City for more than half an hour before returning to the front line to continue participating in the new round of battle.
...
At this time, in Rockville City, Lawrence was sitting wearily on the sofa in the governor's mansion living room to rest.
One wall of the living room had collapsed in half. That was the damage caused during the battle just now when the enemy almost rushed into the courtyard of the governor's mansion.
The defense war just now lasted a full forty minutes, turning the area around the Governor's mansion into ruins. Unextinguished flames and fleeing residents are everywhere in the city.
It's rare for such a long, high-intensity battle to occur in extraordinary warfare.
Lawrence considered abandoning the city several times, but fortunately, the morale of his subordinates was never extinguished. Everyone's fighting will supported the defense line.
Just when the enemy almost broke into the courtyard, Sharron and Dophis led the first batch of reinforcements, and the addition of fresh troops allowed them to repel the enemy again.
At the same time, the enemy was also very tired. They retreated in an orderly manner, giving Lawrence and the others a chance to breathe.
Lawrence learned from Dophis that reinforcements were constantly arriving.
The teleportation array is inside the Governor's mansion. As long as the Governor's mansion is not lost, Rockville City will not fall!
But Lawrence couldn't be happy at all, which meant that the battle would continue, and the casualties of the Balk family would continue to increase.
Suddenly, Lawrence's spirituality sensed something, and he suddenly sat up from the sofa: "The enemy is coming again! Defend Rockville City to the death!"
Now there is only one way, and that is to defend to the death. If they hold it, the number of demigods in the family will definitely increase again!
Sharron and other reinforcements also went out to meet the enemy. She also knew very well that if she defended this city, she would be promoted to "Disciple of Silence"!
The Beyonders resting in the courtyard took action one after another after Lawrence's reminder.
Whoosh~
Hundreds of fireballs of varying sizes fell from the sky. This is the enemy's saturation attack of "Fireball"!
These fireballs came from different Beyonders, some from demigods, and some from "Mid Sequence" Beyonders.
Sharron raised her hand and formed a white frost in the air, blocking some of the fireballs.
Lawrence immediately used the ability of "Exploit" to prolong the existence of those frosts. At the same time, a "Earl of the Fallen" used the ability of "Magnification" to make the area of the frost immediately wider and longer!
Other Beyonders also used Beyonder abilities to block the "Fireballs", but before all the fireballs could be blocked, hundreds of fire crows flew over.
Many fire crows could not be blocked, and exploded in the courtyard like whistling cannonballs, killing and wounding many Beyonders. The courtyard was full of craters and flames, as if it were in a modern army's battlefield.
Lawrence put on the "Blood-colored Crown" and said in a solemn voice: "Arson in Rockville City is a serious crime and will be severely punished."
Dozens of illusory whips appeared in Rockville City. Soon, painful wails sounded in the distance. Some enemies were beaten to death, and some were seriously injured.
But the enemy had two demigods who had already led people to the courtyard wall. One of the demigods raised his hand and a huge beam of light descended from the sky, while the other kept throwing "Blazing White Spears" into the courtyard.
Just as the beam of light was about to engulf several members of the Balk family, it was suddenly "tampered with" and changed its attack direction, turning into a right angle and shooting towards another place at low altitude.
A "Earl of the Fallen" of the Balk family came to stop this "Unshadowed."
The "Iron Blooded Knight"'s thrown "Blazing White Spear" was trapped in a series of mirrors. A lady with a rather delicate appearance and wearing a Gothic court dress suddenly appeared in the pupils of the "Iron Blooded Knight".
Sharron successfully possessed the "Iron Blooded Knight". Another "Blazing White Spear" appeared in his hand, but this time it was piercing towards his own heart.
The "Iron Blooded Knight" struggled to resist, his hand holding the "Blazing White Spear" moving forward slightly for a while, and backward slightly for a while.
At this time, a demigod in the enemy's ranks who also carried a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact held back Lawrence.
As more and more demigods from the enemy rushed over, Elliott and others, who had just been granted Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts by the "Creator", immediately went to the top.
But the defense line was still in jeopardy. A large section of the courtyard wall collapsed again, and the enemy was using their numerical advantage to launch wave after wave of attacks.
Just when the Balk family was about to be unable to resist, the second batch of reinforcements from the "Temperance Faction" arrived, once again helping them defend the Governor's mansion.
But the enemy's offensive did not weaken. Lawrence, who was entangled with the enemy, seemed to realize something and was about to order a retreat, but it was already too late.
Two spaces in the Governor's mansion courtyard suddenly became illusory, and a dozen enemies rushed out from each of them. These Beyonders were all elites who had never participated in the war before. The one rushing in the front was a demigod, and behind them were "Mid Sequence" Beyonders!
The enemy still had two demigods who had not participated in the war before!
This fresh force immediately broke through the defense line that the Balk family had been defending. Lawrence felt a sense of despair in his heart, but he immediately took a deep breath and prepared to cover the departure of Elliott and other core members in order to preserve the Balk family's bloodline.
At this moment, the teleportation array in the Governor's mansion flashed a few figures again. Fors brought three reinforcements.
The three reinforcements, one woman and two men, all wore masks. The woman wore a classic wizard robe, and the staff in her hand sparkled with dazzling brilliance.
This brilliance exploded like fireworks, forming a beautiful ball of flame.
"Mystical Reenactment: The Little Match Girl!"
One of the enemy's demigods and several enemies suddenly stopped, and a scene after scene of fascinating illusions appeared before their eyes.
This woman is the "Hermit" Cattleya.
The staff in her hand suddenly turned into a spear flowing with dark red blood. The blood was very sacred, as if it could purify all the evil in the world.
"Mystical Reenactment: Spear of Longinus!"
Cattleya threw the spear in her hand towards the demigod in the illusion. The strong sense of danger made the demigod regain some sanity and pulled one of his companions to block the spear for him.
The other two male reinforcements, one was a "Marine Singer" with blue hair and a rough appearance, and the other was a "Spirit Warlock" with black hair and a somewhat unkempt appearance.
They each held a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact and jointly blocked the enemy's other demigod.
Although Fors did not take action, her arrival gave everyone great encouragement!
This shows that reinforcements will continue to arrive in batches, otherwise Duke Hobert would not have allowed his wife to support them!
The already broken battle line was miraculously held again.
