chapters.title: Chapter 679 - 676 Arrangements for the Two Queens
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After thoroughly eliminating Erebus, Hobert lingered for a moment at Selena's grave before re-entering the spirit world.
Hobert didn't return to Backlund; instead, he went to Longtail Island.
Fors and April were having afternoon tea when Hobert smiled and said, "It seems I've arrived just in time."
Fors, dressed in a light, thin dress, was slightly taken aback when she saw Hobert's smiling face: "You…"
Hobert sat down opposite them: "What about me?"
"Nothing." Fors felt the warmth on Hobert again.
April said with a hint of criticism: "You should have come sooner!"
He should have come sooner to comfort Fors, after all, she had contributed significantly to the previous war.
"I've been a bit busy lately," Hobert lied casually, took a sip of the tea a servant handed him, and then asked Fors: "Has the Lord's Manor and the Governor's Office re-hired the servants?"
Fors smiled and said, "All the contracts have been renewed."
April, however, said: "In my opinion, Longtail Island's actions haven't changed anything at all. Although employment contracts have been signed, some employers with terrible behavior still won't respect their servants."
"Do you expect the servants to accuse their employers?"
Hobert patiently explained: "Mother, some things are difficult to change all at once.
"Moreover, the law is always a step behind; it can only exert its effect by punishing someone after they have committed a crime.
"But we must take this step. Only with corresponding laws will servants have a basis for suing their employers. As long as there is the first case, more and more such cases will gradually arise, and servants will gradually learn how to protect themselves."
Speaking of this, He leaned back in his chair and said: "What the government should do is give them basic fairness, not decide their lives."
April thought for a moment before taking a sip of tea and saying: "Fortunately, I didn't enter politics, otherwise it would likely be a disaster."
She didn't continue the topic, but said: "I'm preparing to advance to Sequence 2. The advancement may be a bit dangerous. You need to help 'tamper' with my state and 'bestow' some negative states away."
"No problem." Hobert first agreed, then asked: "You're advancing without completely digesting the potion?"
April replied: "No, the 'High Summoner' potion is digested very quickly."
To be precise, it was digested almost without any active acting.
Hobert was slightly taken aback, then asked: "Your advancement ceremony isn't well prepared?"
"The ritual is also ready." April explained: "The reason it's dangerous is because of my own reasons, and the Beyonder characteristics I'm using for advancement are a bit special."
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying: "I can help you get the 'Creator's' spare characteristic without too much spiritual imprint."
Smashing the "0-70" Creator Bracelet would do it.
April shook her head: "For now, the Beyonder characteristics I'm using for advancement are the best choice."
Hobert knew that his mother had some special circumstances, so he nodded: "Okay, I'll be there whenever you need me."
April finished her cup of tea and stood up: "I've been here for several days, it's time to go back."
She took Fors's hand and said: "Thank you for your hospitality these past few days."
The two exchanged a few polite words, and April opened two hazy doors, entered the spirit world, and left.
Hobert and Fors chatted over tea for half an afternoon, and a smile was always on Fors's face because Hobert explained to her in detail about the curse on his body, the process of advancement, and the difficulties he was currently facing.
Fors had been waiting for Hobert to take the initiative to talk about these things, and now she finally heard Hobert's description.
In the evening, the two had a pleasant dinner and took a walk on the beach.
At night, after some intimacy, they habitually talked about serious matters.
Fors told Hobert about the recent changes on Longtail Island. The factories in the industrial area have been fully operational, and industrial products from South Colson and Longtail Island have begun to be sold to the Southern Continent in large quantities.
The South Balam Duchy is a huge market that can absorb excess capacity.
In addition, with the start of the war, the number of merchant ships and passenger ships has decreased significantly, and Longtail Island's trade with pirates has decreased a lot.
However, the income of Tortuga Port has not decreased, because the pirates who earned money before basically live in this port, waiting for the war to end so they can continue to "work."
There was another thing that Fors felt was special: "'Earl's Light's' manager, Todd, and Mr. Dophis, both came to me and said that a group of Loen Air Force officers wanted to visit Longtail Island."
"Let them come." Hobert stroked Fors's smooth back and said, "And treat them well."
He took a deep breath: "It's time to show the world the reform achievements of Longtail Island and South Colson."
This reminded Hobert: "Have the kitchen prepare in advance the day after tomorrow, I want to entertain Gehrman Sparrow again."
Fors agreed: "Okay."
As they chatted, Fors fell into a deep sleep.
Hobert quietly looked at the ceiling, habitually thinking about the next plan. For him, the most important things at the moment were digesting the potion, preparing for the Sequence 1 ritual, and secretly building nine secret mausoleums.
In recent days, the potion has been giving feedback on digestion. Hobert plans to spend the next period of time in the South Balam Duchy, keeping an eye on the next step of land reform and system reform.
When the economic and political model of the South Balam Duchy begins to operate normally, it is estimated that most of the potion will be digested.
So there is no need to actively create opportunities to digest the potion for the time being.
As for the Sequence 1 ritual, it is not very difficult for Hobert.
The ritual for advancing to "Prince of Abolition" is: To subvert the rule of a country, or to establish a country through rebellion. Create a set of systems that violate the common sense of this world in the established country, and establish a culture and order that is unacceptable to everyone in the territory.
"Subverting the rule of a country" can be achieved by launching a full-scale attack on the Highland Kingdom after completing the internal reforms of the South Balam Duchy.
In the current form, Hobert is confident that he can destroy this country before the end of the "World War."
This is subverting the rule of a country in the form of force.
Even if he can't destroy the Highland Kingdom, Hobert can immediately declare the independence of the South Balam Duchy and complete the "establishment of a country through rebellion."
As for "creating" a system that violates the common sense of the world and establishing an unacceptable culture and order, the process of digesting the "Duke of Entropy" potion is equivalent to completing this aspect of the ritual.
For safety's sake, Hobert will also, like the residents of Longtail Island, force the local natives and aborigines of the South Balam Duchy to abandon their primitive lifestyles and prohibit the worship of the "Chained God" or some wild gods.
This will definitely cause huge chaos again, at which point Hobert will need to come forward and create some miracles to concentrate the worship of evil gods and wild gods on himself.
This approach has many benefits. He can use the direct influence on their spiritual bodies and astral projections to help them master the Loen language and Loen writing as soon as possible, as well as the unique values of the South Balam Duchy.
In addition, this can let them know who their king is, which is equivalent to preparing for the "Black Emperor's" advancement ceremony in advance.
Finally, Hobert began to think about building mausoleums. This sounds difficult, but the ritual does not specify the size of the mausoleums. They do not have to be built into pyramids or imperial mausoleums.
This reminded Hobert of what he had seen and heard in his previous work and the information he had read. He still had some experience in building mausoleums, after all, he used to dig them often.
The difficulty of those nine mausoleums is actually the "secret construction" aspect.
First of all, there must be anti-divination arrangements. Klein can be asked to help with this.
Secondly, it should not be noticed visually, after all, it is a large construction site and can be easily discovered.
Regarding this point, Hobert has two ideas. One is to use some of the abilities of the "Door" pathway to hide the construction site in a "Concealed space."
The second idea is to use the uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway to forcibly "tamper" and "distort" the space around the construction site to achieve the effect of concealment.
Currently, Hobert can do both of these. The first idea can be achieved by using the power of the "0-71" Box of the Great Old Ones.
However, in the end, Hobert plans to use the second idea, which is safer.
Thinking and thinking, Hobert couldn't fall asleep until late at night.
Listening to Fors's even breathing, Hobert kissed her forehead, "distorted" the air and blankets, and let them continue to embrace Fors like himself.
Hobert took the opportunity to withdraw, and "tampered" with the position and shape of the clothes, so that their position was instantly tampered from the hanger and clothes stool to being worn on his body.
Then Hobert "distorted" space to enter the spirit world and came to the South Balam Duchy, taking advantage of the night to shuttle through his kingdom at will, looking for a location to build a mausoleum.
He didn't rest in Angel City until dawn.
As soon as he entered the command room, he found Archibald drinking tea and waiting for him.
Hobert couldn't help but smile: "Dealing with a 'Seer' saves a lot of time. I was about to send guards to find you, but I didn't expect you to have already divined my actions."
Archibald stood up and said: "My spirituality just suddenly told me that coming to the command room at this time would encounter good things."
"Your spiritual perception is very accurate." Hobert sat down: "I'm going to talk to you about advancement."
Archibald first poured a cup of tea for Hobert before sitting back in his original position.
Hobert asked: "Do you know the ritual for advancing to 'Scholar of Yore'?"
"I've heard of it."
"What are your thoughts?" Hobert took a sip of tea: "After all, it's too troublesome to be separated from reality for at least 300 years to make yourself a history."
Archibald: "I hope you can help me pray to the 'Creator' for help."
Then he explained: "First of all, for someone like me, who has been a half Sequence 3 for more than a hundred years, the 'Scholar of Yore' ritual is not as important as it is for human Beyonders. It can be completed in some ingenious ways.
"My idea is to ask the 'Creator' to distort and tamper with the information corresponding to me in the spirit world, so as to deceive my own spirituality and potion.
"After the advancement is completed, after the relevant information in the spirit world is restored, I will only be in a bad state for a few days at most, and I can get through those few days carefully."
Based on Archibald's perception and observation of the "Creator" during the previous decisive battle, he believed that with the "Creator's" current strength, he could completely do this.
Hobert slowly nodded. Having a smart subordinate is a very good experience. There is no need to help him deal with difficult problems, just help him consult on his own ideas and provide help when necessary.
Then He pondered for a moment. Currently, the "Creator" can completely do this while wearing the Uniqueness.
At the same time, He believed that Archibald's idea was very good. In many cases, a person's information in the occult comes almost entirely from feedback from the spirit world.
This is the theoretical basis of divination. For example, divining a person's position is to use related powers to "query" that person's relevant information in the spirit world, so as to obtain that person's position.
However, because the spirit world does not have the concept of normal time and space, sometimes it may be possible to divine that person's future position, or past position.
The higher the level of the "Seer", the stronger the ability to avoid this information interference, and the more accurate the divination results.
Using this theory, Archibald is only over a hundred years old when he advances, and he has not left the real world. After he takes the potion, the relevant information in the spirit world cannot produce correct feedback with the potion, so the advancement is likely to fail.
But if the information about him in the spirit world is tampered with, it can form the correct feedback with the potion.
After completing the advancement, this correct feedback will immediately collapse, but Archibald is born as half an "Scholar of Yore", which is equivalent to him having already digested half of the "Scholar of Yore" potion.
This can be used to offset most of the damage the potion brings to him after the advancement.
These ideas instantly appeared in Hobert's mind. He just considered it slightly and said: "I can help you pray for the power of the 'Creator'.
"You can do some preparations for advancement."
The implication is that He is quite confident that he can invite the "Creator" to help.
Archibald immediately stood up to thank Hobert. Hobert finished the tea in his cup and stood up to leave.
Back at the Governor's Mansion on Longtail Island, Fors was indeed not awake yet.
Hobert lay back in his original position, rested for a while, and then woke Fors up.
After confirming that the other party wanted to sleep for a while, Hobert ate breakfast alone and returned to Backlund.
He didn't return to the Earl's Mansion, but went directly to the office of the financial director of "Earl's Light."
Audrey, wearing a simple dress that still highlighted her good figure, had just arrived at the office and was about to hand a document to Susie when Hobert knocked on the door and came in.
Susie immediately retracted her paw that was reaching out to receive the document, and Audrey also casually put the document back on the desk: "Hobert, why are you here?"
Hobert smiled and said: "I'll take up our beautiful financial director's time for a while, let's go out together."
Audrey looked Hobert up and down: "Okay."
She took a step forward, took Hobert's arm, and the next second the two entered the spirit world.
In the office, Susie watched the spot where the person had disappeared: "He's out playing again, leaving me here to work."
As she spoke, she stood up and "took" the document from earlier with her paw, going to the small desk Audrey had prepared for her to work.
The contents of this document were precisely the part of the work she had been responsible for.
If an employee were to come in at this moment, they would only see the golden retriever sitting there in a daze, completely ignoring the document in front of it and what it was doing.
...
In the spirit world, Hobert said to Audrey, "Close your eyes, I have a surprise for you!"
"What surprise?" Audrey asked as she obediently closed her eyes.
The next second, the two of them left the spirit world, and Hobert smiled, "The surprise is right in front of you, open your eyes, ta-da!"
Audrey opened her eyes and found herself in a field of flowers, surrounded by birds singing and the fragrance of flowers, with bees buzzing as they worked.
Because it was already winter in the Northern Continent, and Audrey didn't particularly like going to greenhouses, she hadn't seen so many vibrant flowers for a while.
She exclaimed, "It's so beautiful!"
Hobert took her hand and led her to the end of this flower-lined corridor, where there was a small pavilion. After climbing a dozen steps, Audrey's entire view was completely dominated by the sea.
The distant horizon merged with the sky, and she could see ships entering the harbor, as well as many seabirds hunting for food.
Outside the stone pavilion was a wide beach, with waves gently lapping against the sand, slowing down one's emotions and allowing one to appreciate the beautiful side of the sea.
"I really like the design of this pavilion," Hobert said with a smile. "You can't see the sea from the garden, but when you come to this pavilion, the view is suddenly wide open."
Audrey sat down on the stone bench, looking towards the sea and said, "I feel like I could sit here all day."
Hobert sat down next to her: "Then let's sit here all day."
For the next two or three minutes, Audrey enjoyed the inner peace. She took a deep breath and asked with a smile, "Is this the seaside villa you're giving me?"
Because on the other side of the garden, there was also a three-story villa, a huge front yard, and some accompanying bungalow buildings.
"Yes," Hobert said with a smile. "It's spoils of war."
This place was located in the capital of the Milherbon State, and a warlord had spent eight years building this villa.
In the capital of another State, a large number of villas and mansions were also seized. Hobert chose two seaside villas from the spoils, one for Audrey and one for Fors.
The rest were all confiscated and became the office residences of government functional departments.
Audrey did not refuse: "This is the most delightful gift I've ever received."
Hobert pointed to the front, briefly introduced the villa, and accompanied Audrey to look out for a while. He took the initiative to talk about another topic: "You should form your own work team."
Currently, Fors already had her own team, some of whose members were recruited from the territory, and some from the Travelers' Research association.
Some team members helped her observe the implementation of some government policies, some were responsible for the finances of Longtail Island and South Colson, some were responsible for material transportation, some were responsible for agriculture and industry, and some helped her manage Greenlawn Manor and other private properties that Hobert had previously given her.
They did not have any administrative power, but when Fors encountered problems in certain areas, she would ask the relevant people for the information she needed.
When working, Fors already had the air of a queen.
It's just that this queen was a bit late for work.
Hobert continued: "After the engagement, you will help me manage some of the duchy's affairs as my fiancée, and you will also continue to be the 'Earl's Light's' chief financial officer."
Such a request made Audrey very happy, managing some of the duchy's affairs meant that Hobert was actively binding her to him politically and financially.
She herself didn't care too much about these things, but it would make her parents and family members feel Hobert's sincerity.
Audrey asked curiously, "What part of the work do you plan to have me be responsible for? I'd like to have a direction when I'm forming my team."
Under the influence of the education she received in a noble family, she was very clear that it didn't matter if she lacked understanding in a certain field, she could consult relevant experts more and hire professionals in that field to provide her with advice.
"Diplomacy!" Hobert had already planned this: "In the future, you will be the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the duchy. I will assign you a capable assistant, and you can recruit the other members yourself."
In his vision, one queen would be in charge of domestic affairs, and the other would be in charge of foreign affairs.
Because Fors didn't have many relatives, letting her help observe the domestic governance would prevent the power of "outer relatives" from growing.
Audrey, on the other hand, had too many noble relatives. To prevent these nobles from influencing the Southern Balam Duchy, and to avoid making things too difficult for Audrey, he would let her be responsible for foreign affairs.
Audrey didn't think as deeply as Hobert did. She smiled and said, "I can already imagine myself easily guessing the true intentions of the representatives of other countries during negotiations."
Hobert followed Audrey's words and said, "That's what I think too. This job will allow you to use your abilities to the fullest extent."
Then he added: "After we get engaged, you need to prepare to enter work mode. The Southern Balam Duchy will be negotiating with the Eternal Blazing Sun Church soon."
"Helen is in charge of this negotiation. You will go with her at that time and feel the working atmosphere."
Audrey nodded: "Okay."
She planned to ask her father, Earl Hall, this afternoon about what issues she should pay attention to when forming her team.
Next, Hobert talked to Audrey about the course of the civil war, and the appearance of Beyonders from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church on the Roklier City battlefield.
Hobert guessed that this should be the Eternal Blazing Sun Church testing his bottom line, but overall, the two sides had the interests of the "Earl's Light" as a bond and would cooperate around the principle of "fighting without breaking."
After chatting for more than an hour, the two returned to Backlund and went back to prepare for the engagement ceremony held at noon.
Because this engagement ceremony was held during the war, to show solidarity with the kingdom, everything was kept simple and only conducted according to the normal duke-level cocktail party specifications.
Hobert couldn't wait to talk to the nobles about the topic of the civil war in the Southern Balam Duchy.

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - 677: Build This Place into a Hometown
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Although the engagement ceremony between Hobert and Audrey was simplified, none of the guests who should have come were absent.
From the royal family, the Queen and Queen Mother attended the reception together, giving Duke Christian and Earl Hall enough face.
If it weren't for the constraints of aristocratic etiquette, Jevington II would have liked to attend and lavishly praise Hobert's victory in the Southern Continent at the reception.
The nobles who attended the reception were mainly relatives of Earl Hall, or relatives of relatives of the Hall family, basically half of the nobles of the Loen Kingdom were present.
Christian's guests were simpler. He had no relatives in Backlund and didn't want to contact the Tudor family, so he invited some comrades and colleagues.
As for Hobert, his only noble relative was Christian, so he mainly invited the managers and shareholders of "Earl's Light".
As a result, those shareholders had already received invitations from Earl Hall or Christian. In the end, Hobert only invited Lord Bradley, his confidant planted in the House of Lords.
Because it was a reception, there was no need for an opening dance, and socializing began as soon as everyone arrived with their wine glasses.
Hobert and Audrey didn't need too much preparation, so they didn't arrive until about half past ten, simply changing into more formal dresses.
Today, they were definitely the protagonists of the reception, and as soon as they appeared, many nobles surrounded them.
So Hobert began to talk glibly: "...The Chief of General Staff of the Duchy of South Balam is very competent. At the beginning of the civil war, he keenly realized that although the rebels were 20 times the size of our army, their combat effectiveness was not strong.
"The General Staff's plan for the decisive battle made me very satisfied... Hey, hey, Earl Taylor, don't leave. At the previous ball, weren't you eager to talk to me about the civil war in the Duchy of South Balam?
"Ahem, let me continue to describe the excitement of this war. The battlefield was set in a hilly area, so the enemy's advantage in numbers would be difficult to display.
"On the day of the battle, I personally led the soldiers to launch charge after charge... Hey, hey, everyone, are you leaving too?
"I haven't gotten to the exciting part yet. Those agents were chased by me in a panic..."
Audrey smiled helplessly at the side, watching the nobles leave one by one with unsightly expressions.
In the end, no nobles came to chat with them for the second half of the reception.
Earl Hall in the distance was also a little helpless. If he wasn't very clear about Hobert's abilities, he wouldn't have wanted to marry his daughter to such a vengeful young man.
For young people, being vengeful shows their personality and youth.
But it's not suitable for nobles, who often have to show their magnanimity.
As the reception was about to end, Archbishop Anthony personally presided over a brief engagement ceremony for Hobert and Audrey.
In addition to exchanging rings, Hobert also gave Audrey the seal of the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Duchy of South Balam, which he had prepared.
The nobles certainly understood that this seal meant a political bond. In the future, Audrey would not only be the Duchess, but also have real power in a certain field.
However, several experienced politicians such as Earl Hall had keenly realized that Hobert did not intend to allow the nobles of Backlund to influence the internal affairs of the Duchy of South Balam.
This made Earl Hall sigh in his heart: I have seen many people who are talented in certain fields, but I have rarely seen people who are talented in politics and governance! Often this field requires constant training to find the knack, but Hobert has reached a very high level without much training!
After the ceremony, the reception basically ended.
Although everything was carried out according to the principle of simplification, the identities of the engaged parties were there, and it couldn't be too simple.
So, to celebrate the successful conclusion of the ceremony, there was also a banquet and a ball in the evening, and the social activities of the day officially ended.
At more than ten o'clock in the evening, Hobert was the last to leave Christian's mansion and returned to the Duke's mansion alone in a carriage.
Although after becoming an angel, he wouldn't feel tired unless his spirituality was exhausted, he didn't want to participate in such boring activities anymore.
It wasn't that Hobert hated receptions or balls, but that he couldn't find common ground with the nobles.
Back at the Duke's mansion, Hobert called Dophis to the study.
"I have already sent a request to the 'Creator'. The great 'Creator' has agreed to help you digest the potion as soon as possible." Hobert habitually went straight to the point when talking to the indifferent Dophis.
Dophis said expressionlessly, "Thank you."
The "Undying" potion requires dying 3 times and resurrecting 3 times to be basically digested.
Assuming that each resurrection to death takes 60 years, it will take 180 years to completely digest the potion.
However, there are some clever ways to speed up this process, such as "tampering" with the year of resurrection to bring about death earlier.
This is the same idea as Archibald's "tampering" with the ritual for advancing to "Scholar of Yore", and the effect is similar, both tampering with one's own "year".
Dophis had mentioned before that his family's records stated that if he wanted to digest the potion in advance, he either needed the "Pale Emperor's" "blessing" or asked the "Prince of Abolition" for help.
And Dophis didn't seem to belong to the faction supporting the "Pale Empress" in the Southern Continent, so he preferred to wait for Hobert to advance before helping him digest the potion.
Currently, if the "Creator" puts on the Uniqueness, he can make more thorough distortions and tampering than the "Prince of Abolition", and only needs to resurrect for 6 days each time to usher in death and resurrection.
In other words, in just 18 days, Dophis's "Undying" potion can be basically digested.
If it doesn't work, then do it again, just add 6 days.
Hobert asked again, "How is your preparation for the 'Ferryman' ritual going?"
"When I became an 'Undying', I had already asked my family to help build a mausoleum," Dophis replied. "Currently, I only need to complete the corresponding extraordinary arrangement."
Hobert nodded: "The merits you gained in the battle to defend Angel are not enough to exchange for the 'Ferryman' Beyonder characteristic, but I will help you apply for the characteristic in advance, and then make up for the merits after you advance."
Dophis said dryly, "Okay."
Hobert had long been accustomed to Dophis's way of speaking. He continued, "After becoming Sequence 3, you will work in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs."
Dophis was Hobert's helper arranged for Audrey. This arrangement was based on the consideration that Dophis was a descendant of the Underworld Emperor and a member of the Eggers family. He was very familiar with the situation of the various forces in the Southern Continent.
In the future, when the power of the Duchy of South Balam further expands to the north, it will definitely deal with the remaining forces of the Balam Empire. Dophis is the best candidate to deal with them.
Dophis was very surprised by this arrangement: "I am not good at expressing myself."
Hobert smiled: "Who said that working in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs requires being good at expressing yourself? You are mainly responsible for diplomatic strategy."
Dophis considered it before saying, "Okay."
Hobert added, "Before you go to digest the potion, first help me find a competent butler."
...
The next morning, Hobert went to Longtail Island again and asked the servants to tidy up the pavilion where Klein had been entertained before.
After preparing everything, Hobert asked the servants to leave the backyard of the Governor's Mansion, and then took out the "Leymano's Travels" and used its ability to summon "Historical Projection", successfully summoning a bewildered Gehrman Sparrow in one go.
At the same time, lightning kept winding in the air, the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" was mainly in dark black and dead silence.
In the darkness, there was a lone light, moving slowly.
That was Klein, he was moving forward alone, as if he was the only one left in this world.
But it's best not to run into anyone. Those encountered in the wilderness of the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" are either members of the True Creator's Church or Amon's avatars.
Suddenly, Klein felt something.
He realized that the time he had agreed with Hobert had arrived, so he immediately entered the historical void.
At the moment when Klein disappeared, the eyes of Gehrman Sparrow, who was far away on Longtail Island, immediately brightened.
"Please sit down." Hobert knew that Klein's consciousness had arrived: "I have just 'tampered' with and 'used' your historical projection.
"If there is no battle, this historical projection can last for 3 hours."
He waved the "Leymano's Travels" in his hand: "There are still two more abilities to summon historical projections on it, enough for you to stay here for a day."
Klein sat opposite Hobert: "It shouldn't take that long."
Hobert poured him a cup of tea: "What did you want to talk to me about at the Tarot meeting before?"
Klein's hand reaching out to take the teacup stopped. He suddenly didn't know how to start. After pausing for a full four or five seconds, he asked, "Have you... have you ever thought about going back after you came to this world?"
Hobert thought: Sure enough, he wants to talk about this.
He replied, "Of course I have, what's the problem?"
Klein organized his words and asked again: "Then have you ever thought about why this world is so similar to the world before we transmigrated? For example, a year is also 365 days, and a day is 24 hours..."
Hobert sighed pretentiously: "You know the truth."
Klein was a little surprised: "You... you realized this problem a long time ago?"
"No." Hobert told the truth: "I only knew this fact after I advanced to an angel, and it was thanks to your help."
"My help."
"Yes, you will know this later." Hobert continued: "So what you want to say to me is that this is Earth!"
Klein wanted to say something, but in the end only a sigh remained: "It seems that you don't really want to go back."
Otherwise, he wouldn't have said this so calmly.
The disappointment in Klein's heart had always been hidden in his heart and had never been shown to anyone, but he had no secrets from Hobert.
Hobert smiled: "I know that feeling, it's like a wanderer who has been wandering for a long time, always missing his hometown very much, and finally one day he can go back, but his hometown has changed.
"The green mountains and rivers in his memory are gone, the little puppy in the neighbor's house in his impression is gone, and the villagers have all become strangers."
Klein took a sip of tea, leaned back in his chair, and said very calmly: "How did you get through that period of mental torture?"
All along, Klein had not shown these negative emotions, which did not mean that he did not care about this matter.
He only had Hobert as a confidant, so only when he met Hobert would he express his disappointment and helplessness.
Every sentence of Hobert hit Klein's heart, which made him think that Hobert had also been very disappointed because he could not return to his hometown.
Hobert did not answer Klein's question, but said: "Let's go out for a walk."
Klein was stunned for a moment, not knowing what Hobert meant, but out of trust in Hobert, he immediately got up and followed him.
Coming to Longtail Port, this port has become very lively, and the bustling pedestrians greeted Hobert one after another, and some even offered Hobert the gains they had just obtained.
It was the kind of offering that was kneeling on the ground with both hands holding it up.
Hobert ordered them to stand up before accepting their Worships.
After walking through the main street, Hobert and Klein were carrying a lot of tropical fruits such as coconuts, as well as seafood such as sea fish, shrimp and crabs.
Hobert led the way, and the two came to a shady tree where no one was around. Hobert handed Klein a mango: "Try it, this is a mango improved by the Earth Mother Church. It doesn't have many tough fibers and is very sweet."
Klein took it in his hand, but did not eat it. He watched Hobert wave his hand, and a gust of wind blew, and the surrounding dry firewood was blown to the two of them.
Hobert built a fire pit on the beach, and then lit the dry firewood and began to grill the fish.
He grabbed towards the sea, grabbed a handful of salt from the sea water, sprinkled it on the fish while asking: "Don't you think the people here are a little too enthusiastic?"
Klein took a deep breath: "This is because you have governed well and protected their rights."
Then he asked: "Is it because of the people's love for you that you came out of the disappointment?"
"You misunderstood what I meant." Hobert smiled: "Most of the people in Longtail Port have only recently moved here. They have one thing in common: there must be someone in their family working as a street prostitute in Tortuga Port."
Klein was stunned, which he had not expected.
"You should have heard that I recruited a group of street prostitutes in Backlund. I have been scolded and criticized for this, and even my butler, Mr. Dophis, stopped ordering the 'Backlund Times' and the 'Loen Evening News' for a while." Hobert took a coconut and opened it with a slight twist.
He took a sip of coconut juice and said: "But every street prostitute here is grateful to me. It is said that they no longer believe in gods, but want to sculpt me and worship me as a god.
"I rarely go to Tortuga Port, but Fors often tells me that she was stopped by street prostitutes in Tortuga Port, expressing their gratitude while tearfully recounting their previous tragic experiences, and finally sending their sincere blessings.
"Starting about two months ago, the street prostitutes used the money they earned to buy houses on Longtail Island and brought their families over.
"Compared with the East Borough of Backlund, Longtail Port is heaven."
Klein smiled with some relief and said, "You are the god who can help these poor people."
"God of Poverty?"
The two first smiled at each other, then burst into laughter.
After laughing a few times, Hobert said, "Don't feel like you don't belong to this world. We have brought many, many positive things to this world.
"For example, your judgment on Capim, and your help to the Freya family.
"You have been to this world, you have done something for this world, then your existence is meaningful to this world."
Klein was stunned for a few seconds before silently picking up the mango in his hand and taking a bite: "It's so sweet!"
Hobert smiled and patted him on the shoulder: "Friend, that's because you've been bitter for too long!"
Klein suddenly stopped chewing, took a deep breath, and said, "Thank you."
Hobert didn't say anything, but pulled out the grilled fish around the fire pit: "Eat."
Klein tasted it: "It's very delicious."
"What's that saying again? Oh, yes, the most high-end ingredients often only need the simplest cooking methods."
The two smiled at each other again.
Klein had a great appetite and ate three grilled fish in a row.
Hobert extinguished the fire pit and "sent" the remaining fruits and seafood back to the Governor's Mansion in a "distorted" way, and then took Klein to stroll in the fields and told him about the current policies on Longtail Island.
Many farmers working in the fields greeted Hobert in Loen, thanks to the continuous influence of the "New Mountain God", they have now basically learned some Loen's daily language and more modern living habits.
Klein sighed: "In other words, you have developed the modern world's society here?"
"Almost, but the situation is quite different." Hobert explained: "I took advantage of the fact that the capitalists hadn't reacted yet and ruthlessly harvested a sum from them, and then used the harvested wealth to quickly complete the original accumulation."
Klein smiled sincerely: "This is the legendary perspective of a Transmigrator."
He asked again: "What are you going to do after completing the original accumulation? Continue to develop in isolation, or carry out a five-year plan?"
"In my opinion, capital is a force that can be used." Hobert also said some of his future plans and policies for the first time:
"Capital is more like an invisible potion. It looks glamorous and can make people rich and civilizations prosperous.
"But its essence is distorted and crazy. The human world needs it, but it must be controlled.
"The problem with the countries of the Northern Continent now is that they allow capital to develop barbarically, so their societies look very deformed.
"But it is also unrealistic to not need capital at all. This degree is difficult to control. Our country has made some attempts in this regard before, some were successful and some failed.
"We have all been harmed by capital, but capital has not completely lost control. Those attempts are very valuable to me.
"In addition, from the perspective of the situation, it is very beneficial to me now. I can make a fortune across the Berserk Sea like the United States in World War I.
"And artificially create the southward migration of talents and technical workers, and take the opportunity to complete industrialization."
Klein sighed: "Sure enough, everything has two sides. War is an opportunity for many people."
At this time, a group of Loen gentlemen walked towards them on the ridge of the field. They raised their hands to greet Hobert from a distance.
Klein learned from their polite remarks to Hobert that these people were some Loen Air Force officers who were invited to visit Longtail Island.
One of them, a Lord named Locker, said: "Duke, this is simply the Divine Kingdom depicted in the 'Revelation of the Night'!"
"There are no councilors who only collect money, no arrogant nobles, and no rich people, only farmers, workers, and soldiers, but there is still good order, and the people here can still become rich.
"Most of the officials here are the sons of farmers and workers, with only a few noble children, but they are also approachable and even explain to the farmers how to dry manure...
"No, they are no longer nobles, they have become integrated into this world and are competent officials."
Hobert smiled and said, "Yes, nobles are dispensable here, but when this place is rich enough, there will definitely be some rich people, but they shouldn't even think about doing whatever they want."
The other officers were also very excited, as if they had seen the ideal country they had dreamed of.
Currently, all countries in the North are facing the problem of conflicts between the military and the nobles. The nobles need the military to maintain their status, but they do not want to give the military too many benefits.
Locker and the others are the same. They hate the nobles very much, but they must support the nobles so that they are a legitimate armed force.
The relationship between the military and civilians and the relationship between the government and the military on Longtail Island opened their eyes. It turns out that soldiers can help farmers harvest crops when they put down their guns.
To express their gratitude, the people will also send some agricultural products to the soldiers, but the officers have orders not to take anything from the people.
After careful inquiries, they learned that the officers were all the sons of farmers, shoemakers, and carpenters. It is said that their commander-in-chief, Seel, used to be a crew member on a cargo ship.
The soldiers are basically the sons of miners and farmers. They basically come from Longtail Island and were slaves like livestock a year ago.
The concept of soldiers and civilians shocked Locker and the others! The officers who came to Longtail Island this time basically came from middle-class families or slightly wealthier families.
In the attack on Saint Millon, they would be sent to their deaths by the Air Force because they had no noble background.
Now the nobles of Loen have no fiefs and no armies of their own, but their influence is reflected in all aspects of the Loen countries.
Locker and the others had been complaining that the senior officials in the military were "hereditary", but they had never thought that there was another way to go.
The relationship between the military and civilians on Longtail Island showed them another way out.
After receiving permission to return to Loen to publicize what they had seen and heard on Longtail Island, Locker and others happily bid farewell to Hobert and continued to visit Longtail Island under the guidance of the Governor's Mansion's foreign affairs staff.
After they walked away, Klein smiled and said, "This reminds me of public intellectuals and those who lead the way."
"As you said, things generally have two sides. Since people who lead the way are so easy to use, why can't I use them?"
While talking and laughing, the two continued to stroll in the fields, discussing topics that only the two of them could understand.
After Hobert summoned Klein's historical projection for the second time, he took Klein to Angel City.
It looked a little noisy here. Newly arrived immigrants needed to be resettled, and the voices of many grassroots officials were hoarse.
The city walls of Angel City have been demolished. The area around this fortress is like a large construction site, with construction and repairs going on everywhere.
Hobert "distorted" space and took Klein to a high mountain in the western Saint Sern Basin. Here, Angel City was just a small dot.
"In the future, this basin, which currently does not have much population, will be inhabited by 800,000 farmers who immigrated from Loen and about 300,000 urban residents!" Hobert sketched a blueprint for the future to Klein:
"Recently, the price of food in Backlund has risen again. With the development of the war, this international metropolis will definitely have a considerable food shortage.
"I have now asked people to purchase food in the Rorsted Archipelago and the Southern Continent, and then I can use the food to attract some more immigrants.
"Loen welcomes my current immigration policy very much. In their view, these poor people are a huge burden.
"And as the Loen Kingdom's front line on the south bank is tight, I have recruited a large number of technical workers in industrial cities such as Constanta who are willing to bring their families to work in the Southern Continent."
Hobert sighed: "This is the benefit of having immigration space! It can quickly replenish some of the population I need."
Klein exclaimed: "800,000! Then there will be no homeless people in Backlund."
"No, there will definitely be!" Hobert said decisively: "It's just that there won't be as many as there are now."
Klein took a deep breath: "I neglected the Loen system."
Hobert then talked about another topic: "What's giving me the biggest headache now is the issue of reforming the local natives. This place is rich in natural resources and the conditions are suitable for crop growth, but like our time, there is no decent country.
"I can only say that the world is full of wonders." Then Hobert put away his smile: "The short-sightedness of a nation is a very terrible thing.
"The people here are very short-sighted. They are heavily exploited and live a very difficult life, but no one stands up and says: We can't go on like this, otherwise we will perish!"
Hobert said seriously: "Since they have no plans for the future, I will plan for them!
"Spread our culture here, spread our values, and build this place into what our hometown looks like! A new modern era will be rebuilt in this world.
"In the future, when you miss home, come here and take a look."
Klein felt a sense of excitement. He took several deep breaths before calming down, and finally said: "I also want to join your plan."
Hobert looked at the large plain under his feet: "I hope that in the future, a large number of Fool's Church cathedrals will be built on the territory of the Highground Kingdom!"
"No problem." Klein realized that he had misspoke, and then explained: "I mean, I will definitely report this matter to Mr. Fool seriously."
Hobert added: "This is also the idea of ​​the 'Creator', hoping to have a deeper level of cooperation with Mr. Fool."
Klein nodded slowly, also very much agreeing with such cooperation.
Hobert took a deep breath: "How is it? Do you feel better?"
"Much better!" Klein felt that he had another goal: to build a red utopia with Hobert!
"We should go eat." Hobert smiled and said, "I asked the kitchen to make a few 'Intis-style' dishes that I modified."
Klein understood instantly: "That's really something to look forward to!"
The two returned to the gazebo in the backyard of the Longtail Island Governor's Mansion, and Fors was already beckoning the servants to serve the dishes.
The so-called "Intis-style" dishes included salads with scallions, ginger, garlic, and hot oil, but they also had another name: cold dishes.
On the hot Longtail Island, it was very pleasant to drink beer and eat a few bites of cold dishes.
The second dish was meat soup with chili peppers, peppercorns, and other seasonings, and poured with hot oil and minced garlic. Of course, it also had another name: boiled sliced meat.
The next dish was fried fish with sugar and vinegar sauce drizzled on top. Its other name was sweet and sour fish.
The fourth dish was boiled tender chicken, cut into long strips, and then dipped in a sauce made with vinegar, garlic, and other seasonings. Its other name was white cut chicken.
Hobert and Klein drank beer, ate these familiar and unfamiliar delicacies, and chatted casually.
After all the dishes were served, Hobert once again asked the servants to leave the backyard.
Fors knew that they were going to talk about some secret topics again. She was originally feeling emotional about this strange way of eating all the dishes together, but at this time she perked up and straightened her back to listen carefully.
Hobert first "tampered" with the propagation path of the surrounding sound waves before saying: "Yesterday I received an important piece of information about the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' from the 'Creator'.
"Amon is looking for some clues about his father in a place called Chernobyl."
"Chernobyl?" Klein couldn't help but glance at Fors, but then he thought that even if he said the place name, she wouldn't know what it meant.
This reminded Klein of his previous attempt to seek death, using dream divination to see the Ancient Sun God seemed to be awakening from the ground, so he confirmed again: "Is that the place where the leak happened?"
Fors was very surprised at first that this conversation involved Amon and the Ancient Sun God, but when she heard Mr. World's question, she felt a little strange again: Leak? Leak what?
Hearing Klein's question, Hobert was stunned for a moment, and then immediately realized that because the "Creator" quickly rescued Klein from Amon, Amon had not had time to tell him about Chernobyl.
He first nodded and said, "It's that place."
Then He said: "According to the 'Creator', the Ancient Sun God awakened in that place!"
Fors suddenly felt a chill down her spine: Such high-level information! Am I, is it appropriate for me to be sitting here?
But having already heard this much, she wasn't willing to just leave, so she tossed the earlier self-questioning to the back of her mind and continued listening to the two people's conversation.
Klein was also very surprised; this aligned with the divination scene he had seen.
After a moment of thought, he said, "I will explore that place."
"Be careful," Hobert instructed. "There must be an Amon's avatar there, and perhaps His main body is also there."
Klein nodded, "I will be careful."
He planned to use the method of praying to himself with 'True Sight' to check after arriving in Chernobyl. If Amon's main body was there, he would definitely be able to detect it.
Then Klein asked, "When did the Ancient Sun God fall into slumber?"
"I don't know," Hobert replied. "This is also what I find very strange. Waking up from such a place, could it be that He fell into slumber a long, long time ago?"
Klein pinched his chin: A long, long time ago… The Common Era! This coincides with my previous guess.
Before, when Amon said that the Ancient Sun God described His ability as an 'Error,' he guessed that the Ancient Sun God might be a 'fellow countryman'.
Hobert originally wanted to chat with Klein about the Ancient Sun God, but it was clear that Klein didn't know much relevant information, so He changed the subject.
Klein also didn't continue to talk about this issue, just kept it in mind, and planned to continue the conversation after investigating Chernobyl.
They talked until a little after two in the afternoon. Klein's second historical projection summoning time was about to end. He was full of food and drink, and had regained his confidence, so he bid farewell to Hobert.
The two shook hands and wished each other well. The next second, Klein disappeared, leaving only a ball of air in Hobert's hand.
This suddenly made Hobert feel a little lost.
At the same time, in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods,' Klein emerged from the gaps of history.
He was still carrying the summoned lantern in his hand. At this time, the lantern's light illuminated the surrounding ground, bringing a touch of light to this dim world.
Looking at the dark space in front of him, Klein suddenly smiled.
He continued to move forward, but at this time his back was much straighter, and he looked much more determined.
...
December 1st, the southwestern end of the Minsk Mountains.
This is located on the southern coast of the Gulf of Bothnia, within the territory of Loen… at least it still belongs to Loen territory now.
In the remnants of the Minsk Mountains, there is a mountain called Pender Mountain. There is a famous winter resort hotel here, with a huge ski resort and a seal-watching project, but you have to take a sleigh north for more than an hour.
In previous years, this hotel would have been full of tourists, with carriages going up and down the mountain, very lively.
But this year it was a bit deserted. Only some guests who were very fond of skiing came here to stay as usual.
This was because, in the hotel, they could vaguely hear the sound of gunfire from the front lines.
The manager and waiters lamented that the guests must really love skiing, that they could still come to ski even though the war was about to reach here! At the same time, they were a little anxious, considering what to do if the war spread to the hotel.
There were more than twenty tourists in total. Some were very familiar with each other, chatting together at breakfast, while others sat alone in a corner to eat.
Around eight thirty, they finished breakfast and went to the ski resort one after another.
But the ski resort did not receive any tourists.
If you follow their footprints, you will find that they all tacitly entered a small path halfway, and took out a stone key in front of a rock, twisting it against the mountain.
The cliff immediately became illusory, and then they could step into the interior of the mountain.
There was a considerable space inside the mountain, with stone chairs and stone tables. The top of the space was a crystal emitting a soft light, looking like a large stone conference room.
After the twenty-odd tourists arrived here, they greeted each other, realizing that they all knew each other.
Because they had one thing in common: they all had the surname Solomon.
This was the Solomon family's annual gathering. In previous years, the family's nominal patriarch, Ryan Solomon, would appear after everyone had basically arrived, and sometimes the 'King of the Five Seas,' Nast, would also attend the gathering, but this year they were late in arriving.
Thinking of the widespread news of Nast's death, everyone had a bad feeling.
Dong~
At this time, a muffled sound suddenly came from the direction of the stone door.
Everyone immediately got up. Bunier was about to call everyone to hide in the inner stone room.
Whirr~
The stone door had been knocked open by external force. The flying stones smashed towards the crowd. Two members with low sequences didn't have time to dodge and were immediately killed by the stones.
Standing at the door was a middle-aged man with symmetrical left and right sides of his body, waxy yellow skin, looking like a wax figure, it was Tamara who had already advanced to 'Prince of Abolition'.
The members of the Solomon family were about to escape, but were shocked by the huge pressure from an angel of the same pathway, and knelt down towards Tamara one after another.
Tamara said without any emotion, "Nast has been killed by me, and now I am here to take over the Solomon family members.
"You either actively join the Tamara family, or join in the form of Beyonder characteristics, choose for yourselves."
The faces of the Solomon family members were ashen, and they were all silent.
"It seems I have to choose for you." Tamara suddenly raised a hand, and the air turned into a sharp sword, stabbing a family member to death: "He chooses to join in the form of Beyonder characteristics."
Just as several Solomon family members couldn't withstand the pressure and were about to join the Tamara family.
Tamara suddenly looked towards the direction of the door.
A handsome and energetic young man in a black windbreaker suddenly appeared at the broken stone door. He tossed and caught a stone key of the same style as the Solomon family members with one hand: "It seems this key is useless."
A sneer flashed across Tamara's face. This young man was Hobert!

chapters.content:

Hobert's spirituality had, of course, already sensed Tamara's presence, and he wasn't surprised that Tamara knew about the Solomon family gathering.
After all, "King of the Five Seas" Nast was killed by Erebus, and it was easy to see from Erebus's behavior that he had obtained some of Nast's memories.
Tamara must have learned about the Solomon family gathering from Erebus and was preparing to come here to receive this Beyonder characteristic.
Although Tamara had already advanced to Sequence 1, Hobert was not afraid of this fellow.
And Tamara was also very clear that Hobert could borrow the power of the "Nation of Disorder." She had no confidence in killing Hobert, so even after advancing, she had never gone to find Hobert to cause trouble.
Now that they suddenly encountered each other, Tamara hesitated for a moment whether to attack.
Hobert knew that he couldn't keep Tamara, and he didn't intend to take the initiative to attack.
So the two people confronted each other for a few seconds. Finally, Tamara's eyes narrowed, and she raised her hand slightly, preparing to launch a tentative offensive.
Hobert also immediately responded. He tossed the stone key into the air, grabbed left and right with both hands, and summoned the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" and the "Holy Infant King" from the "Nation of Disorder."
At the same time, the space around Hobert immediately fell into a "chaotic" vortex. He felt that his spirit and body were about to be crushed by the chaotic vortex.
All the eyes on the whites of the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" widened, "reproducing" a tall figure wearing dilapidated armor, holding a giant sword, and exuding the light of dusk.
That huge figure raised the giant sword and stabbed forward, a silver-white light flashed, piercing the chaotic vortex in front of it.
The baby in the "Holy Infant King's" womb suddenly opened its eyes and glanced at Tamara.
Tamara's shadow immediately stood up from the ground, holding a black giant sword, and slashed at Tamara.
Hobert hid behind these two angel-level tool people, prolonging the ability, allowing the aura of dusk and decay to affect Tamara.
At the same time, Hobert "magnified" the attack power of Tamara's shadow.
Pa da ~
The stone key that Hobert had just thrown out finally landed on the ground.
Tamara grabbed the black giant sword that was slashing over, and the shadow returned to its original appearance, lying obediently on the ground.
She used the "Exploit" ability to prematurely end the "Holy Infant King's" ability, making her shadow return to normal.
Immediately afterwards, Tamara stretched out a hand towards the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch." The "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" immediately fell into a state of "Frenzy," slowly turning its head and looking at Hobert.
Hobert immediately realized that this fellow was going to attack him!
He quickly "magnified" his control over the power of the "Nation of Disorder." This tool person slowly turned back again. Although it didn't intend to attack Hobert, it was also passively slacking off and unwilling to continue fighting.
This made Hobert realize that when "Frenzy" reached the Sequence 1 level, it would not only cause the target to fall into a state where it was difficult to form coherent thoughts, but it would also cause reactions such as betrayal and passive slacking.
Hobert stretched out a hand and took the "0-73" Death Domain from the "Nation of Disorder."
Tamara's spirit sensed a trace of coldness. In the next instant, the surrounding scene suddenly changed. The original stone table and stone bench turned into piles of skeletons and resentful souls.
They launched round after round of attacks on Tamara's spirit.
For Tamara, this level of attack was almost like a tickle, but being in such an environment still made Tamara feel a little stiff.
At the same time, the "Holy Infant King" also launched a "corruption" attack on Tamara, which immediately made Tamara feel that her body had produced some very depraved thoughts that were contrary to her thinking.
Tamara immediately raised a hand and "modified" the surrounding environment and the "Holy Infant King's" hostile target, temporarily making these two abilities treat Hobert as the enemy.
Hobert immediately "distorted" the attacks of the "Holy Infant King" and the undead, and sent these attacks back to Tamara.
The fight between High-Sequence "Lawyer" pathway Beyonders is like playing tennis, able to "hit back and forth" extraordinary attacks.
At the same time, Hobert took out the "Sun Scepter" from the "Nation of Disorder." A sacred golden light shone on Tamara, and the surrounding "Death Domain" trembled for it, which made Tamara's spirit simultaneously placed in scorching and cold conditions.
Tamara stared at Hobert, and suddenly "modified" her position, leaving the battlefield.
The brief exchange between the two angels allowed them to have a certain understanding of each other.
Tamara realized that even though Hobert was a Sequence 2 of the same pathway, he had the protection of the "Nation of Disorder" and could not suppress him in terms of authority. Moreover, Hobert could summon at least two angel-level helpers at any time…
Even without these two helpers, Hobert had at least two Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts in his hand, and Tamara wouldn't even think about hurting him.
As for Hobert, even if he wore the Uniqueness in the "Nation of Disorder," he couldn't kill Tamara.
In the real world, even if he could summon angel-level tool people, even if he could use several Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, he was still on the defensive in the battle with Tamara.
After all, the helpers he summoned were all at the Sequence 2 level, and the Sealed Artifacts in his hand were also at the Sequence 2 level. If the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" and the "Holy Infant King" were normal Sequence 2s, it might have been possible to hurt Tamara.
But they had no problem completing the task of entangling a Sequence 2. When facing a Sequence 1, their use of Beyonder abilities and reaction speed were not enough. The biggest role might be to block bullets.
At the moment, Hobert sent the Sealed Artifacts and tool people back to the "Nation of Disorder." Looking at the stone room again, half of the Solomon family members were already dead or injured.
Apart from the two members who were smashed to death by stones and the one who was killed by Tamara, the others died from the aftermath of the battle between the two angels.
Some died from the attacks of the undead in the "Death Domain" just now, some died from the decaying influence "reproduced" by the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch," and some died from the scorching and purification of the spirit by the sacred light just now.
The battle ended, and they were about to escape, but Hobert released the pressure of an angel again, causing them to kneel on the ground again.
Hobert used the method of "distorting" space to make the stone key appear in his palm. He smiled and said to everyone: "Ryan Solomon has been killed by me. Now I will receive the Solomon family members.
"You either actively pledge allegiance to me, or pledge allegiance in the form of Beyonder characteristics. Choose for yourselves."
Bunier and the others didn't react for a long time. Why did this sound so familiar?
But soon, they all expressed their willingness to pledge allegiance to Hobert.
After all, the battle just now had made them realize that this Duke Hobert was an angel.
Many of them had seen Hobert's portrait in the newspaper, so they recognized this Duke of Loen.
If it was just a Sequence 3, they would still choose to fight, but with an angel, no matter how hard they fought, they would have no chance of winning.
Hobert glanced at the dozen or so Solomon family members: "You are quite sensible."
In fact, he would prefer to turn these people in front of him into Beyonder characteristics, which would be easier for him to control.
However, out of respect for Ryan Solomon, Hobert decided to give them another chance.
Although he hadn't dealt with Ryan many times, Hobert still respected this kind of opponent who had his own persistence.
Hobert grabbed at Bunier and the others, grabbing a trace of spirituality from each of them: "I give you half a month to bring all the Solomon family members to the Duke's mansion in Backlund to report.
"My subordinates have 'Seer' pathway Beyonders, who can easily divine whether all of you have arrived. If one person is missing, I will kill one of you.
"Others may be able to escape, but I have already preserved your spirituality. The dozen or so of you cannot escape."
Bunier was stunned for a moment before saying: "There are many family members that we can no longer contact."
"That's your problem," Hobert said. "Who told you not to contact them earlier?"
He didn't give Bunier and the others a chance to bargain: "Today is also counted as one day. If I were you, I wouldn't bargain here, but would quickly think of ways to contact family members."
After speaking, Hobert disappeared from the stone room.
After a few seconds, the Solomon family members seemed to react and fell into deep despair. It was just attending a family gathering. Why would it bring such a disaster to the family members?
Bunier sighed a long sigh, recalling a sentence said by the patriarch Ryan: We are in a very cruel extraordinary world. If we are greedy for comfort now, there will definitely be a catastrophe in the future!
… …
South Continent, Rockville City.
Today, the Balk family held a grand sacrificial ceremony in the wilderness. The altar was very large and solemn.
The tall Lawrence presided over the sacrifice. They first washed their hands with clean water, and then placed the Worships on the altar, which was the bloodstained crown.
The other family members all knelt under the altar, praying piously.
Lawrence first sat cross-legged under the altar, abandoning distracting thoughts in a meditative way, and then, under the gaze of the clansmen, went to the altar to light the candles, first chanting the honorific name of the "Creator," and then began to recite the prayer:
"Great 'Creator,' thank you for lifting the curse of the Balk family. You are our savior, we worship you! Praise you…"
When the honorific name of the "Creator" was uttered, everyone immediately felt the gaze from the gods.
The people under the altar buried their heads even lower, and they praised loudly: "You are our savior!"
"We worship you!"
"We praise you!"
After the prayers were recited, Lawrence began to offer sacrifices to the "Creator" amidst the sounds of gratitude.
In mid-air, the bronze sacrificial gate opened, and the "Creator" took the Worships.
Amidst everyone's thanks and reverence, the "Creator" withdrew their gaze.
Under Lawrence's guidance, further thanks and prayers were offered, concluding the main part of the ritual.
Next was the slaughter of a cow, its blood sprinkled on the altar, and the raw beef cut and distributed to the crowd.
This was a gift from the deity, and everyone would usually carefully cook the beef they received and share it with their families.
After the beef was distributed, the sacrificial ritual officially ended.
One inconspicuous female family member, Stephanie, waited for her father to receive the beef before returning to their tent.
She thought to herself: the sacrifices nowadays are far too simple. If you ignore that Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, they just kill a cow? Not to mention the Second Epoch, even sacrifices in the Third Epoch required the slaughter of a hundred spiritual creatures at the start of the ritual.
Just as Stephanie was thinking this, she suddenly saw a young man in formal Loen attire appear on the road ahead.
Stephanie, or rather, Auernia, noticed that the young man's face resembled her own from the past, immediately realizing that he was a descendant of Trunsoest.
The surrounding people immediately stepped forward to pay their respects, some calling him "Favored," others addressing him as "Duke."
Hobert glanced at Stephanie out of the corner of his eye, politely greeted everyone, found Lawrence, and after a few words in a low voice, disappeared.
Auernia had a bad premonition. Sure enough, that afternoon, Lawrence found her and took her to the Angel City headquarters.
Emerging from the Angel teleportation array, she was startled by the mountains of supplies piled up outside. Everywhere was bustling with activity and chaotic crowds. It felt like she had entered a noisy market until she entered the headquarters, which was somewhat less chaotic.
Arriving at the headquarters command room, she saw Hobert discussing something with several subordinates. They immediately stopped when someone entered.
Lawrence said, "Duke, this is Stephanie."
Hobert glanced at the plain-looking Stephanie, "You may leave. I have some things to discuss with this young lady."
Once only the two of them remained in the command room, Hobert poured her a cup of tea and cut straight to the chase, "What is an easy way to kill Trunsoest?"
Auernia did not show any surprise. When participating in today's sacrificial ritual, she had suspected that she might be noticed by the "Creator."
On the contrary, she would have found it strange if she hadn't been noticed.
Before the ritual, Auernia had considered many ways to avoid this sacrifice, but further reluctance to participate in the sacrificial ritual would also arouse suspicion.
So Auernia simply stopped avoiding it. According to the information she had gathered recently, the Sanguine had cooperated with the "Creator"'s forces, and she believed that the "Creator" would not kill her casually.
Immediately, Auernia sat down gracefully, without any excuses, "The easiest way is to ask a True God for help. They can kill Him very easily."
Hobert smiled, "Perhaps I should ask, do you possess a method to kill Trunsoest?"
Auernia said, "No."
Hobert pressed, "How can Trunsoest's summoning of the pathway's Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristic be eliminated?"
"Unless Trunsoest is completely dead, there is no way to completely eliminate it. You can only use some methods to weaken Trunsoest's influence on the Beyonder characteristics, such as shattering the Beyonder characteristics, or having a True God seal the Uniqueness."
Hobert slowly nodded, pondered for a moment, and then asked, "Can the power of the 'Nation of Disorder' corrupt the resurrected Trunsoest?"
Auernia asked in return, "Was He resurrected in a descendant of the Trunsoest family?"
"No, He was resurrected in an avatar of an Outer Deity." Hobert did not hide anything, "It is the Outer Deity who corrupted Trunsoest."
Auernia replied, "It will have an impact, but not a significant one."
Hobert sat opposite Auernia, staring at her as he asked the final question, "If I threaten Trunsoest with your life, will He make some compromises or concessions?"
"That depends on what kind of compromises and concessions." Auernia did not seem to feel the threat in Hobert's tone, and still smiled, "If it is something other than life and Beyonder characteristics, He might be able to make some compromises.
"But when it comes to life and His return to the Godhood, then don't expect Him… well, I think anyone would not compromise when faced with a similar choice."
Hobert considered Auernia's answer for a moment, and then said, "Thank you for your answer."
Then, He said, "Next, you will be judged and punished by the Duchy of South Balam…"
"Please wait a moment." Auernia thought she had misheard, "You want to judge me? And punish me? Do, do you even know who I am?"
Hobert pointed at Auernia, "No matter who you are, in my opinion, you killed a member of the Balk family, and you must receive the punishment you deserve."
Auernia was stunned. How did the world become so different?
Even if you don't consider that she was once the Queen of the Night, just considering the cooperative relationship with the Sanguine, she shouldn't be punished in such an exaggerated manner, right?
She thought for a moment before asking, "Is this the 'Creator's' intention?"
"You can think of it that way."
Auernia was still a little incredulous, "Just because a member of the Balk family died?"
"Isn't that enough reason to judge you?" Hobert asked, "I don't care whether you resurrect or not.
"But resurrecting by killing others… specifically, killing your own descendants, didn't you think that such an act would be judged?"
Auernia took a deep breath, "Young man, you are too naive. This is the Beyonder world! Many deities' methods of resurrection far exceed your imagination. Are you going to judge them all?"
Hobert said seriously, "If I have the corresponding power, if they are not my allies or people close to me, I will judge them one by one!"
"Your judgment is obviously unfair!"
"This is the Beyonder world!" Hobert reminded her with Auernia's words just now, "This world is inherently full of injustice. Why should I give this world fairness?"
"Lawyers" are so biased.
Auernia suddenly smiled, "The world really has changed."
She asked, "What after judging and punishing me?"
"If you die, I will bury you with the etiquette of an ordinary Balk family member. If you don't die, I will consider handing you over to the Sanguine." Hobert said calmly.
This once again exceeded Auernia's expectations, "You actually plan to hand me over to the Sanguine?"
She was a little confused now. Are the "Creator" and the Sanguine in a cooperative relationship? Or are they enemies?
If she returns to the Sanguine, wouldn't that create conflict between the two sides?
Hobert did not answer Auernia's question, but after dispelling the "tampering" of the surrounding environment, he called Angus in to take Auernia to be judged.
And told Angus that he could apply to use the "0-73" death domain to punish the target.
… …
Helen completely lost her temper after meeting Audrey.
Initially, Helen thought that she couldn't arouse the lord's desire because of Fors's good figure, but after seeing Audrey, Helen realized that Duke Hobert had been immune to beauty for a long time because he had known Audrey for a long time.
Audrey was clearly wearing an ordinary formal suit, but her temperament and appearance made the clothes look very expensive, making even the "witches" like Helen feel a little insecure.
Especially after learning that Audrey was not a Beyonder of the "witch" pathway, Helen was completely convinced.
After Audrey took her place, the negotiation team officially set off.
The negotiation location between the Duchy of South Balam and the Eternal Blazing Sun Church was finally chosen in Fort Feynapotter.
This was Upton's suggestion. Currently, "Earl's Light" is expanding its business in the Kingdom of Feynapotter, and for now, only Feynapotter can be considered a "neutral country."
Audrey followed Helen and other members of the "Venomous Thorns Army" and used "travel" to reach a summer resort in the northern part of Fort Feynapotter.
Because it was winter, there were no other guests in the summer resort except for the two negotiating parties.
After the defense of the Rockville City ended, Hobert ordered the "Earl's Light" in the Intis Republic to suspend all sales to the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
The Eternal Blazing Sun Church then initiated this negotiation, hoping to continue to resume cooperation.
Considering that most of the business partners of the "Earl's Light" in the Intis Republic are believers of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, and that the Church has been providing a certain degree of protection for the "Earl's Light," to a certain extent avoiding the Intis Republic's liquidation of the "Earl's Light."
That's why Hobert agreed to this negotiation.
The Eternal Blazing Sun Church also sent a demigod, but Audrey, who had already advanced to Sequence 5, easily interpreted from the "Unshadowed's" expressions and body movements that the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, in addition to hoping to continue to cooperate with the "Earl's Light," also had other purposes.
Audrey immediately recalled Hobert's guess, believing that the other purpose of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church should be to retrieve the Beyonder characteristics, including an "Unshadowed".
After Audrey's reminder clarified the other party's intentions, Helen very firmly stated that the Eternal Blazing Sun Church would publicly apologize to the victims of the battle in Rockville City.
It was difficult for a true God's Church to issue such a statement. After three days of negotiations, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church finally made some concessions, stating that they would publicly express their apology and continue to cooperate with the 'Earl's Light'.
Hobert agreed to return the obtained characteristic of the 'Bard' pathway, but the Eternal Blazing Sun Church would have to exchange it for twice the amount of equivalent sequence characteristics or sealed artifacts from the 'Lawyer' or 'Judge' pathways.
After Helen and the 'Unshadowed' each reported to their respective Angels, they immediately signed the relevant agreement, and this negotiation came to a satisfactory conclusion.
Audrey had just returned to Backlund when Hobert came to visit, congratulating Audrey on completing her first diplomatic mission to the Southern Balam Duchy.
The two of them chatted about the course of the negotiation while drinking afternoon tea.
Audrey asked somewhat strangely, "Hobert, why did both sides tacitly agree not to attack each other in the future?"
"This is both sides' consideration of the current situation." Hobert explained with a smile, "The Southern Balam Duchy will definitely expand southward in the near future, and conflicts with the Intis Republic will be unavoidable at that time.
"At the same time, conflicts with the Eternal Blazing Sun Church are inevitable, but the cooperation between the two sides in the Northern Continent must continue. The absence of any agreement on the future means that both sides have defaulted to a 'battle in the Southern Continent, cooperate in the Northern Continent' model."
