Although the entire Northern Continent was in a state of war, with the New Year approaching, besides the few cities where the two armies were engaged in a stalemate, there was still a bit of a festive atmosphere.
The war on the front lines seemed to have eased slightly, and there were even rumors that the countries would temporarily cease fire during the New Year.
In Backlund's Empress Borough, there was hardly any sign of the war's impact, or rather, the lives of the nobles had never changed because of the war.
Hobert looked at the Duke's mansion, decorated with lanterns and colored hangings, but felt no sense of the New Year.
He glanced at the clock, it was already 2:50 PM, and Hobert told the servants outside not to disturb Him.
After locking the door, He lay on the bed, preparing to attend the Tarot Gathering.
Looking at the ceiling, Hobert quickly recalled the events of the past week. First, Fors had advanced to Sequence 5, "The Traveler," and because she had been recording unique customs everywhere, she had already digested part of the "Traveler" potion.
Secondly, Hobert had completely mastered the Specter Empire ship. Even if Trunsoest himself appeared, he wouldn't be able to get close to this ship.
In addition, Southern Balam had completed its land revolution. The farmers who had obtained land could still plant another season of crops. At this time, many of them were highly motivated to cultivate.
However, there were still many people who were as passive as before. They did not quite trust the Duchy government, so they were still waiting and watching.
Also, Hobert had received definite intelligence that Trunsoest had appeared in the northern city of Gurain in the Southern Continent, attacking an extraordinary stronghold of the Loen Kingdom. His intentions were currently unknown.
Hobert guessed that Trunsoest should be preparing to seize some benefits during the war, but his specific purpose was unknown.
Finally, the thousands of soldiers recruited by Longtail Island had completed all their training, and 5,000 of them had been transferred to Southern Balam.
At the same time, recruitment in Southern Balam had also begun. The Duchy government recruited 50,000 soldiers in one go, but they would not be able to complete their training and join the combat sequence until March next year.
The country's financial budget never seemed to be tight. This was because all the funds for developing this country came from Longtail Island, Southern Colson, and the "Earl's Light." Otherwise, how could such a poor and backward Duchy have so much money for infrastructure and national defense construction?
Just as He was thinking about this, His vision was covered by gray fog, and He appeared on one side of the giant's palace, at the bronze long table.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool." Audrey, "Justice," greeted, and this Tarot Gathering officially began.
After the greeting, everyone remained silent, because the recent Tarot Gatherings had added a "Question Time."
"The Fool" Klein looked at "The Hermit" Cattleya: "You have the last two questions."
Cattleya asked very respectfully: "Respected Mr. Fool, may I ask, why can't the Outer God who corrupted Emperor Roselle project too much power into the real world?"
"The Hanged Man" Alger slightly changed his sitting posture. This was exactly the question he had always had!
Why did the Outer Gods seem to have a higher level than the Seven Gods, but their influence on the real world was very weak? It even seemed that their power was not as good as "The Primordial Demoness" and "The True Creator"?
Also, the level of the Seven Gods was clearly lower than theirs, so why could they block their invasion of the real world in the Astral World?
The other members had also thought about these questions to varying degrees before, but most of them had not thought about them in depth. At this time, "The Hermit's" question made them realize this strange thing.
Klein breathed a sigh of relief in his heart. This question was not difficult for him to answer, and then he said in a flat tone: "The barrier formed by 'the Oldest One' blocked the Outer Gods."
He had heard Amon mention this before. After thinking about it for a while and verifying it through some special channels, he could be sure that "the Oldest One" had formed a barrier after falling. This barrier had been protecting the earth.
But why did "the Oldest One" fall? Why were the Outer Gods so eager for the real world? Klein only had some uncertain guesses about these questions, so in order to avoid showing his ignorance, he simply answered that one sentence.
Cattleya was stunned when she heard this answer, and then asked: "Does 'the Oldest One' refer to 'The Original Creator'?"
Klein did not answer, but instead showed some smile and asked: "Is this your second question?"
"No, no, no!" Cattleya realized how stupid her question was. If "the Oldest One" did not refer to "the Original Creator," who else could it refer to?
Because the answer given by Mr. Fool was too shocking, Cattleya made such a low-level mistake.
The other members had a similar reaction to Cattleya: First, shock! Then they began to ponder the information contained in this answer.
In the North and South Continents, the first half of all creation myths is almost the same. There is a Creator who created this world.
The difference lies in the latter part. Different religions will arrange different roles and positions for their gods. For example, the "Revelation of the Night" says that the Evernight Goddess is one of the Original Creator's eyes, representing the night.
And with some knowledge of mysticism, you will know that the God who created everything is called "the Original Creator."
This is the beginning of everything, so the myths about "the Original Creator" are very popular.
It is precisely because this story is very popular that everyone is so shocked.
In everyone's opinion, this is a god like the "background wall" of the Beyonder world. Although everyone knows of His existence, they have never heard of Him showing power or responding to anyone's prayers.
With the Seven Gods often responding to believers or Beyonders, everyone subconsciously felt that this god might have been fabricated to explain where everything originated.
Suddenly, today Mr. Fool mentioned Him and His influence on the real world, and everyone suddenly realized that this god was real.
So everyone basically had a consensus in their hearts: they couldn't feel His influence before, just because their level was too low and they didn't know of His existence.
After everyone was shocked, except for Hobert, the other members began to have some other thoughts.
Alger breathed a sigh of relief: This makes sense. The Outer Gods are limited in their influence on the real world because they are blocked by the barrier formed by "the Oldest One." The Seven Gods are able to block the Outer Gods with the help of the barrier.
"The Magician" Fors sighed in her heart: I didn't expect that this "Creator" with little sense of existence has been protecting everyone. Speaking of which, I seem to have heard Xio say that there seem to be wild Beyonders in Backlund who believe in "the Oldest One."
Audrey thought of some new questions: Where did "the Oldest One" go now? Is He the True God of that pathway... no, is He the Old One corresponding to which pathways?
The other members also had some similar thoughts and questions, but the question and answer session has always been "The Hermit" asking and Mr. Fool answering, so they can only wait for their question and answer session to end before asking "The Emperor" or Mr. Fool.
At this time, Cattleya, who had calmed down, asked again: "Great Mr. Fool, may I ask, in what way will the apocalypse in the prophecy come?"
The other members sat up straight, silently praising "The Hermit" in their hearts. This was another question they also wanted to know very much.
Klein smiled in his heart: Fortunately, Mr. Fool also happened to know the answer to this question.
He replied: "The barrier of 'the Oldest One' is broken, and the Outer Gods invade."
He had asked the Seven Lights of the Spirit World about this question and was very confident in this answer.
The palace fell into silence. Just now they praised "the Oldest One" so much in their hearts, and now they were so surprised.
And there was a feeling of "why didn't anyone notify me."
First they didn't know that the barrier of "the Oldest One" had been protecting everyone, and now they knew this information, but they were told that the barrier was about to be broken!
Immediately afterwards, Alger thought of some information he had traded before: Before, everyone was wondering why the Seven Gods suddenly went to the Astral World at the end of the Fourth Epoch? Now it is clear that the barrier may have been somewhat weak at that time, and the Seven Gods went to the Astral World in order to better resist the Outer Gods.
"The Sun" Derrick was very curious: I wonder if the destruction of the barrier will have any impact on the "Forsaken Land of the Gods"?
But because he knew that he had nothing to exchange for this answer, he did not propose the idea of asking this question.
Similarly, after being surprised, everyone began to think about the meaning contained in this answer.
"The Moon" Emlyn was a little worried: For the Beyonders in the real world, the corruption of the Outer Gods seems difficult to resist. I don't want to become a guy like the believers of "The Primordial Moon."
Fors was worried: Will the gods be able to protect the people of the real world by then? The Duchy of Southern Balam has just been established. The natives of Longtail Island and the people of the Southern Continent, as well as the poor people who immigrated to the Duchy of Southern Balam, have been poor for so long and have just begun to live a life of food and clothing.
Audrey also had similar thoughts: There are so many people living in hardship waiting for us to rescue them, and the Outer Gods are about to invade?
Only "The Star" Leonard lacked detailed information about the Outer Gods, but through observing everyone, he also discovered: It seems that the gods can hardly resist the invasion of the Outer Gods?
Klein gave everyone a few seconds to be surprised and think before saying: "You can begin."
Cattleya then breathed a sigh of relief. The ten questions accumulated in that diary had been asked, and she didn't expect the answers to the last two questions to be so amazing!
But the answers given by Mr. Fool were too general, so she asked "The Emperor": "Do you know any information about 'the Oldest One'?"
Hobert was slightly stunned. He considered it for a moment and realized that some of the initial information could be made public.
So he smiled and said, "I have indeed come into contact with some higher-level information, and some of it can be used for trading."
"The reward is a demigod-level assistance. Members who have not become demigods can wait until they become demigods to repay, or 3 assists at Sequence 5 level."
"Of course, I must remind you that this information is very general and not continuous."
When he mentioned the reward, Alger and Leonard couldn't help but shrink back. The way they had previously 'paid' Mr. Emperor's reward was to support the civil war in the Southern Balam Province and participate almost entirely in the most tragic Rockville Defense War. They never wanted to have a similar experience again in their lives.
But although they were somewhat resistant, such a reward seemed acceptable, after all, they were both clear about the value of the information to be traded.
Klein and Cattleya, as demigods, felt that such a reward was very worthwhile, because information at this level, even just knowing some general content, was priceless.
Especially Klein, who already knew some related information, might have more guesses through Hobert's description, or prove some previous guesses.
A civil war in the Southern Balam Province allowed most members to repay the rewards they owed, except for Emlyn and Derrick.
The former was because he was still behind the Chanis Gate of the Church of the Evernight Goddess at the time, and the latter was because he was in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" and could not repay.
Emlyn didn't take it seriously. He felt that his advancement to demigod was imminent. After becoming a demigod, just two assists would be easy to repay.
"Little Sun" Derrick was a little embarrassed and said, "Mr. Emperor, is there any reward that I can complete in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
Hobert smiled and said, "Don't worry, perhaps under Mr. Fool's guidance, you will soon be able to find a way to leave the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'. It won't be too late to repay then."
Derrick was a little excited and said repeatedly, "Okay, okay, okay!"
But then, he sighed long, "Thank you, Mr. Emperor."
Derrick was no longer the innocent boy. Of course, he knew that although they had Mr. Fool's help, they still needed a certain amount of opportunity and effort to find a way to leave the "Forsaken Land of the Gods."
After discussing the issue of rewards, Hobert first waved his hand at Derrick, indicating that he didn't need to thank him, and then began to say, "It is said that the awakening of the 'Original Creator' is the beginning of the First Epoch and everything!"
This description immediately gave the other members a basic understanding of the "Original Creator": Just as the myths described, that was truly the beginning of everything.
Only Klein heard another meaning: Did the "Original Creator" represent the sudden appearance of extraordinary powers? Did He cause the original civilization to disappear, and cause the creatures living in the original civilized world to mutate, turning into crazy and distorted monsters?
Hobert continued, "During the period when the 'Original Creator' existed, He was everything in this world. His existence represented the existence of this world."
Alger realized, "Is the "Original's" level higher than the Outer Deities?"
Hobert replied, "According to my understanding, no level can describe the "Original's" level."
Everyone was stunned. Cattleya understood Hobert's meaning: The "Original's" level was so high that it could not be described!
Audrey also asked the question she had just thought of, "Mr. Emperor, which pathways do the "Original Creator" correspond to in the Outer Deities?"
Hobert took a deep breath and replied, "I said, He represents everything!"
Audrey was somewhat shocked: "Does His body contain all Beyonder characteristics?"
Hobert added, "At least all the Beyonder characteristics of the real world."
For a moment, everyone's thoughts were briefly blank. They really couldn't imagine what it would be like to have all Beyonder characteristics stacked together.
After a few seconds, Klein, who was the first to react, manipulated "The World" and asked, "What is the "Original Creator's" form? Is He still a living being? Or is He purely a consciousness produced by Beyonder characteristics?"
"I'm not very clear about the specific state either." Hobert leaned back in his chair and said, "In my understanding and speculation, the "Original Creator" is somewhat similar to the "Cosmic Consciousness" I mentioned before."
"But there are also differences, because He is not the collection of all extraordinary powers and authorities in the universe."
"Perhaps the relationship between the two is like this: Divinity encompasses the "Original Creator", but the "Original Creator" does not represent all divinity."
"I personally believe that divinity represents the will of the universe, and the "Original" represents a part of the will of the universe and a part of the will of life."
"The two overlap, but there are also differences."
Finally, Hobert emphasized, "This is my personal understanding."
At this level, a lot of information looks very vague, and even the concept of "no fixed concept" may be the concept of this information.
The other members were already a bit unable to keep up with the discussion between the "Emperor" and "The World". After they completed the discussion of this question, they caught up with their train of thought.
After a few more seconds, Cattleya asked, "Then why did the Original Creator disappear? Or why did He fall?"
Hobert replied, "A more reasonable explanation is that Beyonder characteristics have a tendency to split."
Cattleya immediately understood, "The 'Original Creator' split Himself?"
"Theoretically speaking, that's how it is." Hobert asked half-jokingly, "Which existence could make Him fall?"
At this time, Emlyn asked for confirmation, "That is to say, all Beyonder characteristics come from the 'Original Creator'?"
Hobert said again, "Theoretically, that's how it is."
Emlyn asked again, "Do all lives also come from the 'Original Creator'?"
"Theoretically, that's how it is."
"What about the Sanguine?" Emlyn asked further, "Did the Sanguine, such a special race, also originate from the 'Original Creator'?"
Hobert was slightly stunned. He recalled the creation myth and said, "According to legend, the 'Original Creator's' mouth and teeth evolved into the Sanguine."
Everyone's expression was a little strange, because they suddenly noticed that the creation myth mentioned that the Original Creator's lungs evolved into elves, and His heart evolved into giants.
But there was no mention of Sanguine.
The "legend" that the "Emperor" just said had been changed. The original words of the creation myth were: "The 'Original's' mouth and teeth evolved into alien species."
Before humans used potions to become Sanguine, Sanguine and werewolves were classified as "alien species."
The reason why everyone's expression was strange was because they finally understood the reason for Mr. Moon's questioning: In the currently recognized creation myth, the Sanguine were not "independently evolved" from a certain organ of the "Original". For the very proud Mr. Moon, this was unacceptable.
Mr. Emperor understood Mr. Moon's "request", so he changed the creation myth.
Because Mr. Moon's question completely interrupted everyone's thoughts about discussing the Original Creator, this transaction came to an end.
Hobert waited for a few seconds. Seeing that no one continued to ask him questions, he said to "The Fool" at the head of the bronze long table, "Mr. Fool, I request to communicate with Mr. World alone."
"The Fool" nodded, creating a space for the two to communicate alone.
Hobert then said to "The World", "I got the 'Worm of Star'. I will sacrifice it to Mr. Fool after the gathering."
Klein manipulated "The World" and asked, "What price should I pay?"
"Let's talk about it later." Hobert had been thinking about it for a long time, but he couldn't think of anything that could be exchanged equally, and that he needed.
"Okay." Klein was also very clear that the value of the "Worm of Star" was not high or low. It was a little higher than a demigod-level auxiliary Ingredient, but it was far from a demigod-level main ingredient. It was not easy to find something that could be traded equally.
Hobert added, "Come to Longtail Island to celebrate the New Year together."
Klein was slightly stunned, then smiled and said, "Forget it, the New Year means nothing to me, and it will disturb you."
He paused and then said, "Maybe you can do me a favor and summon my historical projection once."
Klein planned to go to Backlund to see Benson and Melissa.
Hobert probably guessed Klein's thoughts: "Okay."
The two ended their private conversation. Hobert then said to Alger, "After the New Year, around the 2nd or 3rd, how about we explore the elven ruins together?"
Today, the nobles of Backlund are going to hold some dances and receptions. Hobert is bothered by it and has no intention of participating.
Alger, who also had no expectations for the New Year, immediately sat up straight: "Okay!"
Mr. Emperor finally has time. Alger had been looking forward to it for a long time. After this exploration, he would be able to determine whether he would stay in the Storm Church or prepare to become a Pirate Admiral.
After the two agreed on the exploration, the hall fell silent again.
As the members' sequences became higher and higher, there were fewer and fewer transactions about improving their own levels.
Audrey and Fors could both obtain Beyonder characteristics from Hobert to advance to demigod, and they didn't have to worry too much about the advancement ceremony.
The "Manipulator" advancement ceremony was relatively simple: In a specific occasion with at least ten thousand people, take the potion in the great resonance of their emotions.
Fors's advancement ceremony was helped by her teacher Dorian. It was said that with the help of the Abraham family, the difficulty was not great.
Alger pinned his hopes on obtaining a "Cataclysmic Interrer" characteristic in the final elven ruins. It was also unlikely that his needs could be traded at the Tarot Club.
Klein was preparing to advance to an angel, but the requirements for this level of advancement were no longer something that could be acquired through trades.
Cattleya had just advanced, and although she had mostly digested the potion, she planned to consolidate her state properly and had no intention of continuing to advance for the time being.
Leonard still intended to rely on the Church for advancement and had no need for trades.
Seeing that no one was speaking, Derrick raised his hand slightly: "I need the 'Unshadowed' potion formula and main ingredients."
Everyone was silent. Like Alger, they faced the problem that things at this level were difficult to trade for.
After a second or two of silence in the hall, Hobert finally said, "I have the potion formula."
This made the other members look sideways. Alger even wanted to ask if He had the 'Cataclysmic Interrer' characteristic there.
The reason Hobert didn't answer immediately was that he recalled that 'Little Sun' seemed to have obtained the potion formula and Beyonder characteristics to become a demigod from Klein.
But he quickly remembered that the 'Unshadowed Crucifix' was still in his hands!
So he added, "I also have a Sealed Artifact corresponding to the 'Unshadowed' level."

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 682: Trading with Mr. Moon for the "Blood Moon Queen"
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"Sun" Derrick didn't expect his request to be fulfilled so easily, and he excitedly asked, "Mr. Emperor, what reward do you need?"
Regarding the issue of rewards, Hobert fell into deep thought, because Beyonder characteristics and potion formulas at this level are only worth exchanging for corresponding demigod-level characteristics and formulas.
The "Unshadowed" potion formula was obtained by Hobert through "Connection" with the "Unshadowed" Beyonder characteristics seized from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
However, He already possesses the demigod-level potion formulas that He can currently use, or rather, has unique ways to acquire them.
And demigod-level potion formulas that are not needed are of little value even if He possesses them.
After thinking for a few seconds, Hobert said, "How about this, let's trade with demigod-level Beyonder creatures again.
"Black Mist Lord Tree, Six-Legged Sprite, or Three-Eyed Black Tree Vine, White-Tongued Albatross.
"Any three of these four Beyonder creatures, and be careful, I want a whole one."
The first two Beyonder creatures can provide the main ingredients needed to advance to "Earl of the Fallen", while the latter two can obtain the main ingredients needed to advance to "Imperative Mage".
Since there is no need, it is better to hoard some demigod-level main ingredients that will definitely be used.
Hobert converted the "Unshadowed" potion formula into a complete demigod-level Beyonder creature.
Derrick recorded the four Beyonder creatures: "I will pay you the reward you need as soon as possible."
Among them, the Black Mist Lord Tree had been hunted once before under the leadership of the chief, and clues to another Black Mist Lord Tree were found at that time, but City of Silver had no corresponding need, and continuing the hunt might be somewhat dangerous, so they did not continue searching.
He can consider searching for that Black Mist Lord Tree first. As for the other three Beyonder creatures, he plans to ask Chief Colin for advice after the gathering. Perhaps the chief has clues to these Beyonder creatures.
Hobert nodded: "I will give you the potion formula first, you can prepare for the advancement ceremony first.
"Little Sun" sincerely thanked him: "Thank you, Mr. Emperor."
With the help of "The Fool", Hobert materialized the potion formula: "Sequence 4: Unshadowed
"Main ingredient: A drop of "Sun" God's blood, or replace it with three tail feathers of an adult Sun God Bird plus a piece of Holy Radiance Stone
"Auxiliary Ingredients: 60 ml of Sun God Bird blood, 30 ml of Holy Radiance Stone symbiotic liquid, 7 drops of mutated bergamot juice, 10 grams of magma heart powder
"Ritual: Extract the strongest and most unwilling emotions to give up, then take the potion, and re-inject these emotions during the process."
As the "transaction platform", "The Fool" Klein only knew part of the "Unshadowed" potion formula before. Through this transaction, he also completed the formula.
After Derrick got the potion formula, although he knew that he could "recall" it by praying to Mr. Fool, he still carefully read it twice.
For City of Silver, which is in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" and relatively closed, this formula is very precious.
"By the way." Hobert remembered again: "The great 'Creator' once said that the sealed artifact that corresponds to 'Unshadowed' is a relic of the ancient Sun God, that is, the Lord you believe in."
The other members were stunned, never expecting that this sealed artifact had such a big background.
Derrick was first surprised, then somewhat sadly said: "Mr. Emperor, I, I will definitely hunt the Beyonder creatures you requested as soon as possible!"
Although he had known for a long time that the ancient Sun God had fallen, he couldn't help but feel sad when he suddenly learned the whereabouts of the Lord's relics.
Klein was already planning to study the sealed artifact first when it was sacrificed to him.
After this transaction ended, Hobert said to "The Moon" Emlyn: "I have two transactions to make with you, or rather, with the Sanguine."
Emlyn was slightly taken aback: "Please speak."
"I have a copy of the "Shaman King" Beyonder characteristics here." Hobert said: "This is the first transaction."
During the civil war in the Duchy of Southern Balam, many Beyonder characteristics of the "Apothecary" pathway were also seized, including a copy of the "Shaman King" characteristics.
Hobert did not intend to trade this batch of Beyonder characteristics with the Sanguine immediately, but he could first trade the demigod-level characteristics among them with the Tarot Club members.
The other members were somewhat surprised. The "Emperor" had already taken out two demigod-level items in succession. Did the angels think that demigod-level sealed artifacts and Beyonder characteristics were so easy to obtain?
Emlyn was very excited: "Shaman King!"
He thought to himself: I knew it, I will soon become a demigod.
Then Emlyn finally knew why the "Emperor" emphasized that the transaction was with the Sanguine, because he simply couldn't pay the reward at this level.
Emlyn quickly asked, "What reward do you need?"
Through the transaction with "Little Sun" just now, Hobert also had some ideas about the reward for this transaction: "Beyonder characteristics or sealed artifacts of the same level of the "Lawyer" or "Arbiter" pathway."
With the accumulation of the Sanguine, they should be able to produce sealed artifacts at this level.
Emlyn nodded: "I will report to the Marquis as soon as possible."
Hobert "hmm"ed, and then said: "The second transaction is, do you want the resurrected Auernia? What reward can the Sanguine pay?"
Emlyn stood up abruptly: "Has Her Majesty the Queen really been resurrected?"
The expressions of the other members were a bit strange. "The Hermit" Cattleya thought to herself: With the resurrection of Trunsoest before, it is not surprising that this "Blood Moon Queen" can be resurrected, but the "Emperor" wants to trade the "Blood Moon Queen" with the Sanguine, which sounds a bit strange.
Klein even suspected: Is the resurrected one really the "Blood Moon Queen"?
Then he resisted the urge to cover his face: Trading the "Blood Moon Queen" with the Sanguine, Hobert is really able to think of it.
The other members had similar ideas and watched the transaction with a mentality of watching the excitement.
Emlyn then reacted: "You want to trade the 'Blood Moon Queen' with us? We, we are allies."
"It is precisely because we are allies that I am trading with you!" Hobert said seriously: "If the 'Blood Moon Queen' has any means of resurrection, or has left any arrangements, I am very willing to notify you for free.
"But she chose to resurrect in the body of a 'Creator' believer, and being able to initiate a transaction with you is already taking into account the alliance."
In fact, Hobert didn't know whether the body occupied by Auernia was a believer of the "Creator" before, but even if it wasn't, it was a member of the Balk family.
The members of the Balk family hate the family's curse to the bone, and they definitely can't just let it go.
"The Hanged Man" Alger showed an expression of "so that's how it is": Indeed, if this kind of thing happens, there should always be an explanation to the other believers.
After hearing the "Emperor's" words, Emlyn didn't know how to refute, so he asked: "What is the Queen's situation now?"
Hobert replied: "Currently just an ordinary person, very weak."
Emlyn then asked: "Is it because she is very weakened after just being resurrected?"
"No, it's because of the punishment received from the trial."
Emlyn was very surprised, and pointed at the "Emperor" with some gaffe: "You, do you know what you are doing? That is Her Majesty the Queen!"
The other members were also somewhat surprised. Trading the "Blood Moon Queen" and giving the believers some compensation, everyone understood this.
But everyone didn't expect that after punishing the "Blood Moon Queen", they would still trade with the Sanguine?
Then everyone speculated, did the "Blood Moon Queen" resurrect in the body of an important person? Did the "Creator"'s forces suffer huge losses because of this?
However, Klein, Fors, and Audrey, who knew Hobert, knew that in Hobert's eyes, the "Blood Moon Queen" was not more noble than an ordinary believer.
Hobert said very calmly to Emlyn: "I didn't hand Auernia over to the family of the deceased for interrogation, which is already taking into account the alliance."
This was also an important reference for Angus regarding the "sentencing".
After learning about Auernia's specific situation, Angus speculated that Hobert handed Auernia over to him for trial, instead of handing her over to the Balk family, in the hope that while punishing Auernia, he would not really treat her as a murderer.
So when Angus used the "0-73" death domain to punish Auernia's spirit, he also called several important members of the Balk family to watch the execution.
This gave the Balk family an explanation, and Angus could also complete the task. As for the fact that Auernia's resurrected spirit was severely damaged and was already very weak, that was the Sanguine's business.
Anyway, Auernia wouldn't die for a while, and could completely last until she was handed over to the Sanguine.
Hobert's words made Emlyn stunned again, and he immediately calmed down: "I will report this matter to the Marquis immediately. Before that, please be kind to Her Majesty the Queen."
Hobert nodded: "Okay."
At this time, the other members felt a little strange, and couldn't figure out why the "Emperor" was doing this?
Obviously, this would cause conflicts between the "Creator"'s forces and the Sanguine. In fact, the best solution is to either return the "Blood Moon Queen" politely, or kill her secretly.
"Justice" Audrey, who already had a lot of experience in foreign affairs, keenly realized that Hobert's actions, in addition to fully respecting the lives of the "Creator"'s believers, were also a warning to the Sanguine.
Because Audrey also noticed that Hobert first conducted the transaction of the "Shaman King" Beyonder characteristics before talking about the transaction of Auernia.
This sequence is very intriguing, because the transaction of "Shaman King" characteristics seems to be an equal exchange, but the Sanguine and Hobert have different "demand levels" for the corresponding Beyonder characteristics.
After obtaining the "Shaman King" characteristics, the Sanguine can immediately use them for Mr. Moon, while Hobert has to wait for a period of time after obtaining the characteristics of the same level, perhaps until the next large-scale extraordinary battle, before he can use them in the form of meritorious service exchange or rewards.
In this state, just like the transaction with the "Sun", Hobert proposed that he wanted "whole" Beyonder creatures, which is equivalent to a premium requirement, which is the "equal exchange".
Therefore, in the "Shaman King" transaction, the Sanguine took advantage.
Audrey had even made a prediction in her heart that the Duchy of Southern Balam would soon launch high-level cooperation with the Sanguine.
Before the cooperation, give some sweetness first, and then knock the other party, which is a very common method.
After the "Emperor"'s transaction with the Sanguine ended, this Tarot Club officially entered the free exchange session.
"Star" Leonard glanced at Hobert: "Recently, the five well-known universities in Loen are preparing to move to the Duchy of Southern Balam, which has caused huge controversy in the country.
"All sectors believe that the risks brought by the war have not yet affected the safety of university teachers and students, and it should not consume so much manpower and material resources to move the university to the barbaric and backward Southern Continent.
"But the royal family is very insistent and has sent soldiers to the five universities to supervise the relocation."
Cattleya sighed: "This kind of thing only happens in a state of war. If it happened in peacetime, it would have caused marches and protests, as well as condemnation from governments around the world."
Of course, now the countries of the Northern Continent are also condemning the Kingdom of Loen's practice, but the current Loen royal family does not take these condemnations seriously.
With the outbreak of the war, the royal family, which basically controls the military, has strengthened its power, and can deal with this kind of thing in a relatively tough way.
Audrey is very clear about this, she has been responsible for the detailed negotiations in this transaction.
Fors is also very clear about this, because Hobert asked her some time ago to enclose all the remaining mansions on Longtail Island with walls, as the campus of the Ocean University among the five universities.
And several teaching buildings and laboratory buildings will be built in the suburbs of Longtail Port. Fors is also actively solving the housing problem for the faculty and staff and their families.
At the same time, Fors also funded the construction of five public grammar schools on Longtail Island and Southern Colson. Before that, there were only general schools on Longtail Island and Southern Colson.
General colleges only teach some commonly used words, arithmetic, geography, history, natural science and other knowledge.
Grammar schools are schools that benchmark universities. Now that there are universities on Longtail Island, Fors will of course not waste such good resources.
Klein manipulated "The World" to ask Hobert: "Which five universities?"
After hearing that there was Backlund Technical University, he also looked at the "Emperor".
Everyone knows that the Duchy of Southern Balam is the country of the "Creator"'s forces, and the "Emperor" should be very clear about this matter.
Hobert saw everyone's gaze and smiled: "I support the Loen royal family. The teachers and students of the university should be transferred to a safer place to create a peaceful learning environment for them."
"The World" simply asked: "Is there any transaction between you and the Loen royal family?"
Hobert glanced at him before saying: "Yes."
The other members had similar guesses before, but they were too embarrassed to ask. They didn't expect "The World" to take the initiative to ask about this.
After hearing the "Emperor"'s answer, the other members thought in their hearts: This makes sense.
But they were curious, what was the transaction between the two parties?
"The World" asked again: "Does the Duchy of Southern Balam have teaching conditions?"
"We have been building university campuses for about half a year." Hobert certainly knew why Klein cared about this, so he told the truth:
"Although not as prosperous as Backlund, there will be no shortage of living supplies, as well as the materials and instruments needed for the research institute.
"In addition, their job opportunities will certainly be more than in Backlund, after all, the entire Southern Balam Governorate is in a stage of rapid development and needs a large number of high-end talents."
Another very important thing is to carry out education reform and change the joint-stock system of universities to a public ownership system.
All expenses of the school are borne by the Governorate government, but the research direction and teaching philosophy must also meet the requirements of the Governorate.
At least some discriminatory school rules should be abolished, such as some universities prohibiting the enrollment of students from the Rorsted Archipelago or the Southern Continent.
There are also some schools that prohibit discussion of human rights issues in the colonies.
These school rules are basically some regulations made out of prejudice or for the sake of interests of some shareholders.
And for a publicly owned school, such regulations are very ridiculous.
"The World" asked further: "Can safety be guaranteed?"
"After the civil war, there are no major security risks in the Southern Balam Governorate."
Everyone's attention gradually shifted from "The Emperor" to "The World." This crazy adventurer actually cared so much about the relocation of universities. Could it be that one of them is his alma mater?
Then everyone felt that this idea seemed even more absurd. Since when did being an adventurer require a university degree?
Klein nodded after getting the answer he wanted to know and didn't continue to ask.
At this time, Leonard said again: "Recently, some people in Backlund have been promoting the system of Longtail Island, saying that it is a divine kingdom for the proletariat.
"They have listed many wonderful policies, such as officials being proficient in farming and water conservancy, and very respectful of the people at the bottom.
"For example, local general education is free, and medical care is also free.
"For example, the mayor of Longtail Island is the son of a shepherd, and many of the officers on Longtail Island are the sons of mine slaves."
Emlyn slowly nodded. They were originally going to share this news, but the transaction with the "Blood Moon Queen" just now made him lose that mood.
Alger was stunned when he heard this: "This is too exaggerated."
Then he glanced at "The Emperor": "Is someone excessively praising Longtail Island to achieve some ulterior motive?"
Cattleya also joined the discussion of this issue: "I have done some research, and these propaganda are basically true."
When investigating the teleportation array before, she had visited Longtail Island with "Vice Admiral Iceberg" Edwina and heard relevant explanations.
At that time, Cattleya was also very shocked that this island had such a unique political environment!
Later, she considered this issue many times and found that it was more than just a political environment issue. This was completely challenging the nobles and the wealthy, and giving the people in the colonies another option: they could live well without relying on nobles and congressmen.
Emlyn was somewhat surprised: "Really?"
There are also cases of low-level people becoming officials in the Northern Continent, which has always been regarded by gentlemen as a manifestation of democracy and freedom in modern society.
But it seems that all the officials on Longtail Island come from the bottom of society?
Audrey and Fors knew that those propaganda did not contain any false elements, but they also knew that their explanation was not convincing. This matter still had to be explained by Hobert, who was a member of the "Creator."
Everyone looked at "The Emperor" again.
Hobert smiled and said, "I must point out that there are inaccuracies in these propaganda."
Alger, who had struggled at the bottom, was somewhat disappointed: "Hehe, I almost believed it."
But Hobert said: "Desson, the original mayor of Longtail Island, has been transferred to the Southern Balam Governorate to be the Minister of Construction. The current mayor of Longtail Island is from the village by the South Colson Lake."
Alger was stunned: "He, no, is this new mayor a lady? And from a village?"
Hobert nodded: "That's right."
Emlyn asked curiously: "What does her father do?"
"He's just an ordinary farmer." Hobert recalled and said, "She used to be a maid in the lord's mansion. For a period of time, the town government of South Colson was short of staff, so a batch of servants were transferred to help.
"She stayed because of her good performance. Later, she went to night school. It should be noted here that night school not only teaches reading and writing, but also teaches how to deal with problems encountered at the grassroots level.
"She seemed to suddenly get the hang of it, showing very good adaptability in her work, and became the second batch of mayors in the South Colson area, and is very good at agricultural coordination."
Leonard also asked very curiously: "Why do you do this?"
"Do what?"
"Let a maid be the mayor? Is this a gimmick?"
"Who says a maid can't be the mayor?"
Leonard was slightly stunned. While speechless, he also felt a little absurd, because this formed a huge impact on his understanding.
He is an out-and-out lazy person, and even dislikes socializing very much, and is only willing to contact people in the church circle.
Although Leonard sympathizes with the people at the bottom, he also feels that the way the world is operating now is generally correct. At this time, a new way of social operation suddenly appeared, and he couldn't accept it for a while.
Of course, Hobert knew that Leonard's reaction was actually caused by the limitations of the thinking of most elites.
At present, many elites sympathize with the people at the bottom. Some want to make reforms, while others feel that if reforms are rashly made, there is too much uncertainty, which may make the lives of the people at the bottom more difficult.
What Hobert brought is not only a brand-new system, but also a brand-new concept of governance, a concept that has never appeared in this world, and of course it will cause discomfort to many people.
This is like a joke Hobert watched before he traveled through time: Exposing some videos about the strength of the army in the West will definitely cause people's resistance, because the people at the bottom do not believe that the army will protect their interests. But in the East, it will be ridiculed as "The great powers are actually myself", or "Military expenditure is still too little".
At this time, Alger asked again: "So, is education and medical care really free on Longtail Island?"
"Yes." Hobert said, "Fortunately, this is a mystical world. You can use some Beyonder means to allow people who are willing to become doctors to quickly acquire some knowledge and experience."
The cost of training doctors is very high and the cycle is too long, so the imbalance between supply and demand in medical care is the norm.
However, Beyonder power has solved this problem very well. Some people have become "Apothecaries" by taking magic potions, which is the backbone of the current medical team.
Many people also use talismans to acquire relevant knowledge of medicine and treatment in a short period of time, and then after interning with a "Apothecary" for a period of time, they can treat most of the common diseases they encounter.
They are now the main body of the medical team.
Because the training cost is not so high and the cycle is not so long, there is no need to sacrifice the interests and rights of two or three generations in medical care to achieve a balance between supply and demand in medical care.
Hobert added: "As for education, only general education is free. In the future, grammar schools and universities will still charge fees, but the standard of tuition fees is: most families in the country can afford it."
Alger recalled his childhood and said after two or three seconds: "Unimaginable."
Hobert smiled and said, "I will give each member a special pass. If you are curious, you can go to Longtail Island to see it in person."
Cattleya knew the weight of this special pass and immediately said: "Thank you!"
Then she asked: "Are these messages in Backlund self-advancement by Longtail Island?"
"As far as I know, it is not." Hobert replied, "It is the spontaneous action of the believers of the 'Creator' in the Air Force, but they asked the 'Creator' for instructions before taking action."
Not only that, but "Earl's Light" also provided some financial support.
Cattleya asked again: "Are the officials in Longtail Island, or rather in the Southern Balam Governorate, really proficient in agriculture?"
"Not all of them, some are proficient in industry and work in industrial areas." Hobert smiled and said, "This is the most basic requirement for them."
"Do they really respect the people at the bottom?"
"Yes, because they come from the bottom."
"Why?"
"Why what?"
Cattleya organized her words: "Why does the Southern Balam Governorate have such requirements?"
Hobert asked back: "Shouldn't there be such requirements?"
The other members were stunned. Among all the members, except for Audrey, the others came from the bottom of this world.
The values ​​of this world have never made them think of letting the people at the bottom govern. Hobert's question made them suddenly realize: Only the people at the bottom understand the suffering of the people at the bottom. Why not let the people at the bottom govern?
Immediately afterwards, they realized that this idea was subverting the current power system and economic system.
Thinking of this, Alger couldn't help but ask: "Can it succeed?"
Hobert replied: "There are currently no signs of failure."
At this time, "The World" suddenly said: "I will provide some necessary support and help to the Southern Balam Governorate."
The other members were stunned. "The World's" statement meant that "The Fool" also supported the Southern Balam Governorate.
Audrey took a deep breath, feeling somewhat excited, but not surprised.
Fors was also very happy because of Mr. World's statement, which meant that the Southern Balam Governorate was not fighting alone.
Cattleya and other members fell into deep thought, guessing whether this was the way the two gods who were awakening were subverting the current world pattern?
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Audrey suddenly said: "According to reliable information I have obtained, after King Jevington II's special envoy returned to Backlund, he solemnly put forward the view of 'Southern Balam Threat Theory' to the royal family and the parliament.
"But it has not been taken seriously by the royal family and the parliament. First, because the Loen Kingdom is at war, and secondly, the congressmen and the royal advisors have 'keenly' discovered that the industrial system of the Southern Balam Governorate is very backward and cannot become strong in the short term."
She had already told Hobert this news separately. At this time, she was telling her ally "The World", and also telling the other members, which was equivalent to promoting the Southern Balam Governorate again with the topic just now.
Alger heard that Miss Justice's words seemed to have ulterior motives, so he cooperated very well and asked: "Is it really as they summarized?"
"Not so." Audrey said with a smile: "It's just because they didn't take the two special envoys to visit the industrial area."
Fors slowly nodded. At this time, she understood why Hobert sent someone to specifically tell her not to let the delegation visit the industrial area.
Audrey also understood the intention of some of Hobert's requirements after learning about the reactions of the royal advisors and congressmen.
Because a large number of skilled workers were recruited in a short period of time, the only thing the Southern Balam Governorate could offer when the delegation arrived in the Southern Continent was the light and heavy industrial base that had already started on a large scale.
Originally, Audrey was also going to take them to visit the industrial base, but because of Hobert's request, the relevant schedule was cancelled.
It wasn't until Audrey heard about the experiences of Alice and Georgina that she lamented Hobert's meticulousness.
The "Southern Balam Threat Theory" proposed by Alice once received attention from the royal family and the parliament, but when asked about the industrial situation of the Southern Balam Governorate, Princess Alice and Duchess Georgina realized that they had no understanding of the industry of Southern Balam Governorate.
But what is certain is that the Southern Balam Governorate must have their industrial cities, but when asked where the industrial cities were, Georgina could only answer in Salado.
But she knew nothing about the specific scale and the industrial categories it possessed, because the main task of the intelligence personnel sent by MI9 was to collect information on the extraordinary powers of the Southern Balam Governorate.
They just heard that someone had built some factories, which did not attract attention at the time, but later Georgina analyzed that it should be Hobert's advance layout.
Georgina's answer made the advisors and congressmen feel difficult to believe.
So the royal family and the parliament determined that the fact that the Southern Balam Governorate did not have a noble class was indeed very terrible, but this was not an urgent matter.
Especially since the Southern Balam Governorate was willing to provide reinforcements, they believed that such a threat could be temporarily ignored.
Georgina was very clear about the seriousness of this matter, but what made her a little helpless was that the previous intelligence personnel had lost contact.
The last piece of intelligence they sent back was that the Southern Balam Governorate had completed the census and household registration at an alarming speed, and also registered them, the people of the Northern Continent. It was said that they were going to be conscripted to do some transcription work.
After that, no more intelligence was sent back.
Thinking of this, Audrey couldn't help but smile.
Hobert also said with a smile: "The impressions and prejudices of the congressmen and the royal advisors on the Southern Continent have helped us a lot. At least before the end of the war, we will not be targeted."
As for after the end of the war, there is no need to be afraid of their targeting.
The other members fell into deep thought. Today, they seemed to have re-acquainted themselves with the Southern Balam Governorate and re-acquainted themselves with the alliance between the "Creator" and "The Fool".
Could it be that the ideas practiced by these two gods are the way the world should be in the future?
After a moment of silence in the hall, Alger said again: "Last week, an unknown angel appeared at sea and has been secretly helping the fleet of the Intis Republic.
"According to some intelligence, I guess that might be Trunsoest."
Actually, he already believed it was Trunsoest. The clue of "an unknown angel of the 'Arbiter' pathway" almost pointed directly to Trunsoest.
"Thank you for the information. This is very important to me." Hobert paused and added, "Trunsoest's behavior isn't hard to understand. He wouldn't choose to help the Kingdom of Loen or the Feynapotter Kingdom, would he?"
In Hobert's view, it would be strange if Trunsoest didn't seize the opportunity to gain some benefits against the backdrop of a world war.
Leonard frowned slightly, "In other words, the Kingdom of Loen has another enemy."
"I don't think we need to worry too much," Hobert analyzed with a smile, "because this enemy can't be seen in the light.
"Everyone should remember, right? Trunsoest was killed by the six gods in the Fourth Epoch, so the probability of him cooperating with the orthodox churches is very small.
"It's very likely that he can only secretly cooperate with the Feysac Empire and the Feynapotter Kingdom for now."
He sighed, "Fate is truly wonderful. The former subordinates have become cooperative partners."
Leonard asked, "Will you take any action?"
"Not for the time being," Hobert said. "Currently, our main opponent is the 'Rose School.' Before we completely defeat this opponent beside the Duchy of Southern Balam, we won't put too much attention on Trunsoest."
To be precise, even if Hobert found Trunsoest now, he wouldn't be able to do anything about him.
Cattleya asked, "I saw in the newspaper that during the civil war in the Duchy of Southern Balam, the Highland Kingdom wanted to take advantage of the situation and carry out military intervention?"
Previously, she had only helped defeat the enemy's offensive once and then left, so she didn't know much about the overall picture of a normal war.
"Yes," Hobert replied. "At that time, our main enemy was the 'Rose School.'
"Especially during the decisive battle, all the angels from both sides participated, which was as intense as the battle in the Northern Continent."
Then, Leonard asked, "Can you tell me about the general course of the war?"
Because the entire Northern Continent was in fierce battle, this civil war in the Southern Continent didn't attract much attention at first. It wasn't until the Duchy of Southern Balam defeated the joint forces of the Feysac Empire and the Intis Republic, and reportedly severely damaged the Highland Kingdom, that this civil war began to be known to the public.
However, even the Church of the Evernight Goddess was not clear about the specific course of the war, because during the battle, the local Church of the Evernight Goddess's cathedrals were impacted to some extent, and they did not provide very useful information to the Silent Cathedral.
As the delegation sent by Jevington II returned, the newspapers reported some details about the civil war.
Everyone learned that the war was extremely tragic. The colonial city of Rockville was even reduced to ruins in the war, and Angel, the capital of the Duchy of Southern Balam, was also severely damaged.
But for Beyonders, the Beyonder battles in the civil war were the key, but because the Intis Republic and the Feysac Empire didn't mention it at all, everyone lacked relevant information channels.
The other members, like Leonard, were very eager to know the general course of the war, so they looked at the "Emperor" again.
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying, "I can talk about the general course."
Then he roughly described the defense of Crowlier City and the decisive battle of the Highlands.
Hobert didn't reveal too many details, mainly talking about the battle between the "Creator" and the "Abomination" Suah, and how Mr. Fool helped defend Crowlier City.
These descriptions not only showed the intensity of the battle from the side, but also didn't reveal too much information about Beyonder powers.
When everyone heard that Mr. Fool had also participated in the war, they almost all showed an expression of "as expected."
Faced with so many enemies, and with the "Creator" being held back, it seemed inevitable that "The Fool" would participate.
Cattleya even thought: With the support of these two gods, the Duchy of Southern Balam might really have the possibility of challenging the entire world order.
At this time, "The Fool" was lamenting: The "Creator" actually drove away the leader of the "Rose School"! My feeling is right, the "Creator's" power is recovering very quickly.
Then he thought: But the "Creator's" situation will be a bit awkward next. The three "Hands of Order" characteristics are in the Kingdom of Loen, the Feynapotter Kingdom, and Trunsoest's body respectively. How can the "Creator," who only has the uniqueness of the "Justiciar" pathway, become a god?
Because Klein was very clear that the uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics of the "Black Emperor" pathway were not with the "Creator" before, so he always thought that the "Creator" should only be a god with the uniqueness of the "Judgement" pathway.
Finally, Klein thought: Will the "Creator" ask me for help then?
He almost covered his face: "The Fool" is not yet at the level of the Tarot Club member "Emperor"!
In Klein's wild thoughts, Cattleya asked again, "What are you going to do with the Highland Kingdom?"
Hobert's tone was very calm: "Annihilate the country!"
The other members looked at each other in dismay. After a few seconds, Leonard reminded, "According to some records of the church, this kingdom has existed for about a thousand years. Even the previous colonial movements failed to destroy it."
Hobert nodded: "Of course I know, but the plan to destroy the country is also a plan we made from the perspective of strength."
Everyone was slightly stunned, suddenly realizing that the "Creator's" power had become so strong that it could destroy a country.
The hall fell silent again. The other members felt that the "Creator's" power seemed to have become so strong all of a sudden that they didn't recognize it anymore.
After more than half a minute, no new topic started, and Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - 683 What Amon wants to steal must be good stuff
chapters.content:
