Time returned to 4:12 PM, just as the Tarot Gathering was coming to an end, inside the command center of Angers City.
For some time now, Angus had been disguising the "0-73" Death Domain as a cane he carried with him.
However, this cane mostly appeared as a black crystal, using "Order Crystal" to isolate the negative effects of the sealed artifact.
Considering that Auernia's body did not belong to her, Hobert reminded Angus to apply for the use of sealed artifact "0-73" when handing Auernia over to Angus.
Ultimately, Angus decided to use the "0-73" Death Domain to punish Auernia's spirit.
For the past half-month, Auernia had been in a special area within the realm of death, where several special wraiths attacked her spirit.
Fortunately, Auernia had gradually regained some of her status, otherwise she would have been tortured to death.
Of course, it was also because Auernia regained a certain Sequence that Angus arranged this mild punishment; he would not let Auernia truly die in the punishment without Hobert's explicit orders.
Angus, as usual, came to the dungeon built during the previous "Angers Fortress" period, where Auernia's body was imprisoned.
Currently, Auernia was the only one in the dungeon, because the current prisoners were no longer held in prisons, but were directly sent to the construction site for labor.
There was only one guard in the dungeon now, specially assigned for Auernia. Most of the time, this guard would be called to the court to help, and he would only be here in the afternoon when Angus routinely checked on Auernia's condition.
Following the guard to the first room on the left side of the dungeon, Auernia quietly lay on a wooden plank inside an iron cage, but most of her spirit was not in her body at this time.
Angus put away the "Order Crystal" covering the Death Domain. Just as he was about to open the Death Domain, he suddenly felt his hand empty, and the bone-white cane had disappeared without a trace.
At the same time, the dungeon guard revealed a strange smile: "This cane looks like it's of good quality, I can take it back and use it as a door bolt."
As he spoke, he took out a monocle from his pocket and put it on his left eye.
This was actually an Amon avatar, who had parasitized the guard's body at some point.
Angus was stunned for a moment, but quickly reacted, throwing a talisman at the Amon avatar.
Unfortunately, the talisman appeared in the Amon avatar's palm as soon as it was taken out. He glanced at it: "This is a talisman made with "Worms of Time"!
"The avatars on the Rorsted Archipelago were indeed killed by the "Creator"."
While he was speaking, he kept stealing Angus's thoughts, which made Angus freeze in place, his eyes and expression somewhat blank.
"I'll take this too, although it feels like receiving my own ashes." The Amon avatar smiled, put the talisman in his pocket, and used the ability to steal space to leave the dungeon.
Three seconds later, Angus recovered, and the original blank expression immediately turned into surprise. He quickly prayed to the "Creator" and reported what had happened here.
After leaving the dungeon, the Amon avatar suddenly found a pretty figure wearing a blood-colored crown in front of him.
And to his right, a young man wearing a mask stained with blood and dressed in an official Beyonder uniform.
These two were Helen, temporarily holding "0-75", and Elliot, temporarily holding "0-74".
The Amon avatar looked at the cane in his hand and immediately realized: "Hobert deliberately made this sealed artifact appear in the public's view? Even punishing Auernia was just to cover up his true purpose?"
Elliot, wearing the mask, said: "Put down the cane, you can leave here."
Although he didn't recognize the Amon avatar, his spirituality could feel that the enemy in front of him was not simple.
As the Amon avatar guessed, Hobert gave the "0-73" Death Domain to Angus and secretly ordered him to expose this sealed artifact and the purpose of using it to others in a natural way.
Then, Hobert used the excuse of needing to celebrate the New Year and socialize in Backlund to not show up in Angers for about half a month.
And he sent Helen and Elliot to ambush in Angers City with Grade 0 sealed artifacts respectively.
However, they were not ambushing Amon's avatar, but the high-level members of the "Rose School".
Even for a long-standing organization like the "Rose School", a Grade 0 sealed artifact was quite important. Hobert believed that they would definitely send people to inquire about relevant information to see if there was any possibility of retrieving it.
If they could ambush the high-level members of the "Rose School", they could also capture their spies in the Southern Balam Duchy in one fell swoop, so Hobert designed this trap.
But no one expected that the one who stepped into this trap was Amon's avatar, so Elliot made the promise to 'let him leave if he put down the cane", because this was obviously not the enemy they were ambushing.
The Amon avatar smiled: "Originally, I was indeed going to put down the cane and leave, but your request made me change my mind. I refuse!"
After saying that, he injected spirituality into the "Death Domain", preparing to use the power of the underworld to leave.
The "Crown of Abraham" worn by Helen immediately emitted a bright light: "This place..."
Her next words were stolen, and only the beginning of the sealed artifact's "prohibition" was spoken.
Almost at the same time, the Amon avatar's shadow suddenly stood up to snatch the cane from the Amon avatar's hand.
The Amon avatar pointed the hand that was not holding the staff towards the top of his head. The bright light he had stolen from a certain time period appeared above his head, making the area of his shadow very small, making it difficult to snatch the cane.
Then, Amon stole the "imprisonment" used by Helen again, and then grabbed towards Elliot, causing the mask on Elliot's face to shake.
After all, this was just a clone, and not every theft of a Grade 0 sealed artifact could be successful.
In order to steal the "Death Domain" in one go, the Amon avatar sacrificed the probability of success for his own 'theft" in the next period of time.
At this time, Elliot said in a very sacred voice: "Put down the cane and leave!"
These were the Amon avatar's words just now, but only a part of that sentence. At this time, it was "intercepted" by Elliot using the "Fallen Mask", making the Amon avatar feel as if he had heard an irresistible order, and released the cane.
But in the next instant, the Amon avatar grasped the cane again, because he had 'deceived" himself, making himself hear the "holy words": Take the cane and leave.
The Amon avatar immediately stole the boundary between the real world and the spirit world in front of him, immediately entered the spirit world and left from here, but he suddenly found that the hand holding the "Death Domain" was very stiff, and he couldn't lift the bone-white cane.
It turned out that Helen had just 'deprived' the Amon avatar of the right to use the "Death Domain", which made him unable to take the cane away, and even unable to lift it.
The Amon avatar simply let go of his hand, and then kicked the "Death Domain" into the spirit world with one foot.
Although he was 'deprived' of the right to use the cane, it didn't say he couldn't kick the cane!
Just as the Amon avatar was about to disappear into the spirit world, the "Death Domain" miraculously returned to the real world.
The Amon avatar glanced at the sky for a long time. Without any hesitation, he immediately drilled into the spirit world, and stole the traces of himself in the real world to avoid being "associated" with it.
It turned out that the great image of the "Creator" had appeared in the sky.
After Hobert finished attending the Tarot Gathering and returned to the real world, just as he was about to sacrifice the "Worm of Star" to Mr. Fool, he heard Angus's prayer. The "Death Domain" was stolen by an unknown angel?
So Hobert immediately entered the "Nation of Disorder", used Angus's star, and saw the fierce battle on the edge of Angers City from afar.
Hobert was first very fortunate that this trap was set up according to the opponent of the angel level, otherwise it would definitely be succeeded by the Amon avatar.
Just as the Amon avatar kicked the "Death Domain" into the spirit world, Hobert noticed that another Amon avatar was rushing from the spirit world to meet him.
So the "Creator" immediately took action and 'distorted" the "Death Domain" back to the real world.
Just as he was preparing to deal with the Amon avatar further, that clone had taken advantage of the "Creator" regaining the "Death Domain" to enter the spirit world and leave.
Hobert still put on the Uniqueness, and 'distorted" his body far away in Backlund to outside Angers City, and then immediately returned to the real world, using the method of 'twisting" space to come to the battlefield just now.
After confirming that Angus and the other three were not injured, Hobert first gave them generous merits as rewards, and then recovered the three Grade 0 sealed artifacts.
After being disturbed by the Amon avatar, this trap had been exposed and there was no need to continue to set it up.
Then Hobert inquired in detail about the words and deeds of the Amon avatar. After receiving the answers from Angus and the other three, Hobert came to the dungeon and released Auernia's spirit in the "Death Domain".
At this time, Auernia's face instantly turned pale and her lips turned purple, like a dead person.
After she recovered for a few seconds, Hobert smiled and said, "Congratulations, you have been released after serving your sentence."
Auernia opened her mouth, but she couldn't say a word at this time.
After Hobert explained a few words to Angus and others, he took Auernia into the spirit world and returned to Backlund.
Arriving at the Duke's mansion, Hobert first handed the stiff Auernia to the butler, and asked the butler to arrange for several maids to take care of her.
Then Hobert hurried back to the study and sacrificed the "Worm of Star" to Mr. Fool.
After Mr. Fool took away the sacrifice, Hobert cleaned up the altar and began to think about the theft of "0-73" by the Amon avatar that had just happened.
To be targeted by Amon's avatar, or simply be remembered by Amon, and take action to steal, must be a very important thing!
If only one Amon avatar appeared, it was possible that he found an opportunity, so he stole it casually, but there were other Amon avatars to meet him, which shows that this was a 'deliberate theft".
Why did the Amon avatar steal this Grade 0 sealed artifact? Why steal this sealed artifact at this time?
Regarding the previous question, Hobert thought of the bronze gate he saw in the "Death Domain" before. When he first entered the "Death Domain", he noticed that there seemed to be very terrible things behind the bronze gate.
Later, after the end of the civil war, he entered the "Death Domain" again to explore. His spirituality warned him again that the things behind the door were terrible, so based on the principle of "it is better to do less than more", he did not try to open the bronze gate.
After the theft of the Amon avatar, Hobert believed that he should actively explore behind the bronze gate to understand Amon's purpose.
The second question is also very important. Why didn't the Amon avatar try to steal this sealed artifact when it was in Klein's hands?
But when it was seized by the "Creator", it was theoretically more difficult to steal, but he had to risk coming to steal it.
You must know that, as now, if their actions fail and the main body cannot rush over quickly, it will expose the fact that this sealed artifact is very simple.
The "Creator" did not pay attention to this sealed artifact before, but now he will definitely pay attention to it!
Then Amon's avatar will have no chance to steal the "Death Domain" in the future, and will expose the secrets in the "Death Domain".
However, this may also be a trap. Amon knows very well how terrible the things behind the bronze gate are, so he used this theft to attract the attention of the "Creator".
When the "Creator" opens the bronze gate, the things behind the door attack the "Creator", causing the "Creator" to be injured, or even killed.
Hobert pondered for a while, and felt that it was possible that Amon or Amon's avatar had recently obtained important information, and learned that something he needed was in "0-73", and had been following the clues to Angers City.
When he learned that the "Death Domain" was in Angus's hands, Amon's avatar felt that this was an opportunity, so he carried out the theft.
Hobert's trap was very deceptive. Angus, a demigod, holding a Grade 0 sealed artifact for a long time after the end of the war, sounds very incredible.
But after in-depth investigation, you will find the big melon of the "Blood Moon Queen's" resurrection!
It seems very reasonable to use a Grade 0 sealed artifact to deal with the "Blood Moon Queen".
If there is still doubt, you will notice that the punishment for the "Blood Moon Queen" is real, which seems very strange.
But if you check carefully, you will find that the "Blood Moon Queen" was resurrected in a member of the Balk family, which seems reasonable, after all, the Balk family is an important part of the "Creator's" power, and you always have to give them an explanation.
In short, there must be some preset information interfering with the investigators, and in the end they will gradually ignore the possibility that this is a trap.
Hobert believed that Amon's avatar should also be confused by this trap. Even if there is a Sequence in this pathway that is a "Cryptologist", he may not be able to see through all the clues preset by Hobert.
Otherwise, Angus would have been exposing the fact that he held the "Death Domain" more than ten days ago. If Amon's avatar had noticed that this was a trap, he would have tried to destroy it more than ten days ago.
Or, if today's theft is Amon's conspiracy, why did Amon's avatar wait more than ten days before taking action?
Thinking of this, Hobert shook his head, feeling that his train of thought was wrong!
Regardless of whether this was Amon's conspiracy or not, "0-73" held significant secrets.
That was the key!
Amon's avatar wanted to steal "0-73" because this sealed artifact had secrets.
Or Amon's avatar hoped to use "0-73" to kill the "Creator," which further indicated that this sealed artifact had considerable secrets.
After all, the "Creator" possessed the position of an King of Angels and was protected by the "Nation of Disorder"; even Amon's main body might not be certain of killing the "Creator."
Since Amon's avatar hoped that "0-73" could harm the "Creator," it was enough to show the power of this sealed artifact.
In this matter, the secrets on the sealed artifact were the key!
So Hobert changed his approach: no matter what, he had to explore the secrets of this sealed artifact!
However, the exploration process had to be very careful, using the "Creator" hiding in the "Nation of Disorder" to explore, rather than 'small account" Hobert.
Just as he was thinking this, there was a knock on the door.
Hobert came back to his senses: "Who is it?"
"Duke, it's me." It was the butler, Mr. Corris.
Dophis was currently accelerating the digestion of his potion, because he had to die and be resurrected three times in a row, during which he would lose most of his memory, so he would not be able to serve as butler for a while.
So before he went to digest his potion, he found a competent butler for Hobert in advance.
Corris paused slightly and then said: "A Mr. Emlyn is here to see you. He says he is your friend and has urgent business with you."
"Accompanying him is an old man who looks indifferent. Mr. Emlyn calls him Lord Nibbs."
Hobert smiled slightly: "Understood, please have them wait in the large reception room. I'll be there shortly."
He glanced at the clock. It was almost past five in the afternoon, more than an hour after the Tarot Gathering had ended.
In other words, after receiving the news, the Sanguine did not immediately send someone, but discussed it, and then Nibbs came.
Nibbs was a Marquis of the Sanguine and the person in charge of Backlund, making him the most suitable candidate for the initial negotiations.
Hobert deliberately waited for more than ten minutes before arriving at the large reception room on the first floor.
"Mr. Nibbs." As soon as Hobert entered, he smiled and said, "Your complexion is better than before."
Nibbs, with his full head of white hair, squeezed out a little smile: "So is yours."
The two shook hands, and Hobert patted Emlyn on the shoulder as a greeting. Then they sat on either side of the coffee table.
After chatting casually for a few words, and after the servants served tea and left, Nibbs got straight to the point: "I heard from Emlyn about the two deals you initiated.
"The second deal has seriously damaged our alliance. We demand that you immediately stop harming the "Blood Moon Queen" and return Her Majesty to us immediately."
"Don't make the problem so serious." Hobert smiled and said, "My handling is precisely out of consideration for the alliance.
"Currently, the "Blood Moon Queen" is restoring her position, but we all know that even if she restores her position, without the support of Beyonder characteristics, she will only have the power of Sequence 4 at most.
"So, are the high-level Sanguine willing to accept a Sequence 4 leader?
"I'm just suppressing the "Blood Moon Queen's" spirit to avoid embarrassing you."
Although Nibbs' expression was still a bit cold, his tone had improved a lot: "We Sanguine are not as boring as humans."
Emlyn, who was sitting on the side, immediately felt that his expression was at risk of getting out of control, because the reason they didn't come to the Duke's mansion immediately after receiving the news was that the high-level Sanguine were discussing what position to give Her Majesty if that was really the Queen?
But everyone's opinions had not been unified, so they decided to take the person back first and then ask the Ancestor what to do.
Hearing Nibbs' answer, Hobert leaned back in his chair and crossed his legs: "Then, what are the Sanguine willing to exchange for your Queen?"
Nibbs stared at Hobert: "The Sanguine will not hold this against you."
Hobert shook his head: "The Sanguine's handling of this is unacceptable."
"Don't destroy our alliance."
"You are the ones destroying it!" Hobert said seriously: "When you allowed your "Blood Moon Queen" to be resurrected in the body of a "Creator" believer, didn't you think about our alliance?
"Why didn't you let her be resurrected in a Sanguine's body? Resurrecting her in someone who has nothing to do with either side would not cause dissatisfaction with the Sanguine within us!"
Emlyn frowned. This was something he hadn't thought of before. It seemed that the Sanguine were the first to destroy the alliance between the two sides.
Nibbs was slightly stunned: "We didn't let Her Majesty be resurrected there."
"If it wasn't you, could it be us?" Hobert said impatiently: "Brother, I always thought you didn't want the "Blood Moon Queen" to be resurrected.
"But because of some reasons, the "Blood Moon Queen's" resurrection was a foregone conclusion, so you kicked this problem to me.
"So I used the methods of judgment and punishment to help you clean up the "Blood Moon Queen". Now that she has no temper, you are ready to return her to you.
"How could you deny it?"
Emlyn opened his mouth, feeling that Hobert's logic was very reasonable: I didn't expect that there was such a high-level plan hidden inside!
Nibbs, who had lived for hundreds of years, suddenly felt that his brain was not working: "No, it's not that complicated... No, the "Blood Moon Queen's" resurrection has nothing to do with us."
"It has nothing to do with the Sanguine? Could it have something to do with me?" Hobert looked increasingly unhappy.
Nibbs was speechless. Yes, the "Blood Moon Queen's" resurrection had nothing to do with the Sanguine, so could it have something to do with the "Creator's" follower?
He suddenly felt that he should first ask the Ancestor to see if the "Queen's" resurrection was the Ancestor's arrangement?
If it was really the Ancestor's arrangement, even if the Sanguine didn't know, they would have to grit their teeth and accept it.
Thinking of this, Nibbs asked: "What conditions do you need to release our "Queen"?"
Hobert pretended to ponder for a while before saying: "The Sanguine owe us a huge favor this time. From angels to ordinary Sanguine, they must fight for us once without compensation! To repay this favor."
Nibbs" words of refusal were already on his lips, but in the end, he didn't say anything too absolute, but said: "Let's discuss it."
Then he said: "In the meantime, please immediately stop punishing the "Queen"."
Hobert smiled and nodded: "I understand. I'll tell the "Blood Moon Queen" that she was released on parole at the Sanguine's repeated requests."
Nibbs was about to nod, but then he felt that Hobert's words seemed a little strange.
After seeing off the Sanguine's negotiating representatives, Hobert took out "0-73" from the "Nation of Disorder." He decided to study this sealed artifact tonight.

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 684: Accidentally Obtained a "Conqueror" Characteristic
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert first arrived at a deserted island and established an angel-level "Wall of Spirituality."
Then he entered the "Nation of Disorder" and reinforced the "Wall of Spirituality" again.
In this way, even if Amon's avatar came to sabotage this exploration, or if something extremely terrifying was released from the Bronze Door, the "Wall of Spirituality" could block it for a while.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert took the "0-73" Death Domain out of the "Nation of Disorder", and entered that death domain again. Immediately, the spiritual world creatures' grasping of the spirit body and the resentful spirits' "Language of the Dead" rushed towards him.
Because Hobert held "0-73", the resentful spirits and spiritual world creatures immediately screamed and fled.
Hobert came to the Bronze Door again, which had complex occult symbols on it, a circle larger than the normal "Underworld Gate", and kept emitting a terrifying aura.
He observed it in front of the door for a while, then grabbed a resentful spirit and ordered it to recite the honorific name of the "Creator" using the "Death Domain".
Hobert then exited the death domain and retreated outside the "Wall of Spirituality", protecting himself with a barrier formed by the "Order Crystal".
After this series of operations, Hobert came to the "Nation of Disorder" and, according to the prayer of the resentful spirit, allowed the "Creator" to appear in front of the two huge Bronze Doors.
Hobert first "utilized" the surrounding power of the underworld to try to open the Bronze Door in front of him.
But the Bronze Door only shook slightly, without any sign of opening.
Hobert was about to try the mark that Mr. Azik gave him, which was a mark on the spirit body, and could use the power of that mark even in the form of the "Creator".
But in the next moment, his spirituality sent a strong warning, which meant that if he used that mark, something very dangerous would happen.
Hobert pondered for a while, and since he couldn't use the convenience of the Death pathway, he could only "open the door by force."
He lifted the seal of the uniqueness and put the gorgeous crown on his head.
Hobert's spirit body immediately expanded twice, and the huge pressure it emitted caused the underworld creatures to kneel on one knee to show their submission.
He stretched out his hand towards the Bronze Door and distorted the "closed" state into "open"!
Rumble~
After a loud noise, the power that made the Bronze Door merge suddenly turned into the power that promoted the opening of the door.
The Bronze Door opened a crack, but the power of the surrounding underworld poured into the Bronze Door together. It seemed that a hand from the inside was holding the Bronze Door, and the crack became smaller and smaller.
Hobert immediately "enlarged" the crack, allowing the Bronze Door to instantly open a crack the size of a palm, and more underworld power poured into the Bronze Door like waves.
Sitting on the "Iron Throne", Hobert disconnected the Bronze Door from the "Underworld", preventing the Bronze Door from obtaining the support of the underworld power.
Clang~
Using the moment of disconnecting the "connection", Hobert slammed open the Bronze Door.
Hobert saw that inside the Bronze Door, surrounded by a layer of grayish-white mist, sat a middle-aged man wearing a black robe in the style of the Southern Continent, with typical features of the Southern Continent.
His eyes were closed, his hands were on his legs, and he was wearing a crown full of rust and blood stains on his head, sitting upright on a golden chair with patterns such as phoenixes and feathered snakes carved on the back.
Behind the golden chair was a depressing darkness, which looked like a bottomless pit, and even the "True Vision" could not see what was in the darkness.
Hobert only glanced at the middle-aged man and immediately determined that this was Underworld Emperor Salinger! Because the middle-aged man looked a bit similar to Mr. Azik.
And He is the source of that terrifying power behind the Bronze Door! He symbolizes death, symbolizes the underworld, and all creatures will fear death, which is a fear engraved in genes.
Or rather, this is a corpse with a part of Salinger's symbolisms, which is different from the corpse of the ancient death god, and is more like a "high imitation" product.
Just like Erebus, He has some characteristics of the "Uncertain Mist", but is far from the main body!
After becoming a Death, the qualitative change in the spirit body can, under certain conditions, allow Salinger's spirit body and consciousness to be resurrected in this corpse.
Yes, the moment he saw this corpse, Hobert understood: This is another arrangement for Underworld Emperor's resurrection!
The original owner of this death domain, that "Death Consul", should have been transformed by Underworld Emperor before his death. Salinger placed a seed of resurrection here and waited for the right time to resurrect.
As for what is the right time, Hobert recalled the warning of his spirituality just now. It should be that people with special marks on their spirit bodies open the Bronze Door when the time is ripe, and then some reactions should occur in the underworld, opening the process of Salinger's resurrection.
But Underworld Emperor may not have thought that after his fall, the power of the "Chained God" rose, and the "Rose School" with an King of Angels quickly established the Highland Kingdom.
In a certain battle, this "Death Consul" arranged by Underworld Emperor was killed, forming a Sealed Artifact, which has been held by Kleist, an angel of the "Rose School".
Having figured this out, Hobert looked at the crown on Salinger's head again.
The crown exudes a very sharp temperament, which is incompatible with the feeling given by Salinger and the entire underworld. Hobert's spirituality realizes that it should be the key to Underworld Emperor's resurrection!
So Hobert came to Salinger in the image of the "Creator" and reached out to grab it, but found that the crown seemed to grow on Salinger's head, and it could not be taken off no matter how much "distortion" or "disorder" was used.
However, a close observation immediately made Hobert realize that this is actually a Beyonder characteristic of "Conqueror"!
It turns out that the third Sequence 1 characteristic of the "Red Priest" pathway is here!
Hobert had always thought it was in the hands of the Loen royal family, because He remembered that there was a transaction between the Loen royal family and the Demoness Sect. The Demoness Sect helped George III become a god, and the Loen Kingdom gave them a Beyonder characteristic of "Conqueror".
However, Hobert realized that it is still unknown whether the Demoness Sect eventually obtained the "Conqueror" characteristic!
After the process of George III becoming a god failed, the Demoness Sect, which was defeated by Hobert, seemed to be abandoned by the Loen royal family, and no one knew whether they had obtained the "Conqueror" characteristic.
And a long time ago, the members of the Demoness Sect who negotiated cooperation with the Loen royal family were likely to be fooled by the Loen Kingdom.
Hobert guessed that their negotiation process must have involved the display of the "Conqueror" characteristic. The Demoness Sect members who inspected that characteristic were at most an angel. It is impossible for the Primordial Demoness to come to talk to the Loen royal family in person.
Since it was not the Primordial Demoness "inspecting the goods" in person, with Adam supporting the Loen Kingdom, the people of the Demoness Sect were easily fooled. After all, in Adam's eyes, only a little psychological suggestion was needed to get away with it.
Even if the Primordial Demoness was asked to "inspect the goods" by means of prayer, considering Her state, Hobert also thought of the process of Her descending power before, and it was also very likely to be pitted.
So the Loen royal family did not have the Beyonder characteristic of "Conqueror". It is likely that they used a characteristic of "Weather Warlock" to fool the Demoness Sect.
At present, the whereabouts of the three "Conqueror" characteristics are relatively clear. After the Night Emperor and Underworld Emperor joined forces to defeat the Blood Emperor, they divided the spoils of victory. The Night Emperor obtained two Beyonder characteristics of "Conqueror" and awarded them to the Einhorn family and the Sauron family respectively.
Now it seems that Underworld Emperor has obtained the uniqueness and another Beyonder characteristic of "Conqueror".
After Underworld Emperor fell, the uniqueness was suspected to have been obtained by the God of Knowledge and Wisdom and became a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the church.
And a Beyonder characteristic of "Conqueror" has been left behind this Bronze Door and has become an arrangement for Underworld Emperor's resurrection.
Thinking of this, Hobert frowned, a little strange about Underworld Emperor's resurrection method: Could it be that after accommodating the uniqueness of the "Red Priest" pathway, he can swallow the characteristic of "Conqueror"?
Hobert shook his head, temporarily not considering this question, and took this characteristic of "Conqueror" first.
Looking at Salinger, who still had his eyes closed, he couldn't possibly bring this guy's corpse to the "Nation of Disorder"!
Hobert immediately thought of two ways, one was to re-shatter the Beyonder characteristic of "Conqueror", and the other was to shatter Salinger's corpse.
Hobert first tried the first method, using the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to squeeze the Beyonder characteristic, but suddenly found that his squeezing was blocked by some force.
He has always been using the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to shatter Beyonder characteristics, and this is the first time he has felt that he cannot shatter it.
Thinking of Underworld Emperor creating a tributary in the "River of Eternal Darkness" in the past, Hobert suspected that Underworld Emperor should be able to mobilize the power of the "River of Eternal Darkness" to a small extent back then.
He is using the power of the Sefirah to protect this Beyonder characteristic!
That's why it is difficult to be shattered.
If Hobert accommodates the "Nation of Disorder", he can shatter the Beyonder characteristic in front of him, but he has not completed this process yet.
So Hobert began to try to shatter Salinger's corpse, and the method of shattering was very simple. Hobert used the uniqueness to attack the corpse with "entropy increase", causing it to disintegrate from the most basic unit.
But this is not a process that can be completed in a short time. After starting "entropy increase", Hobert realized that he had been wearing the uniqueness for about twenty seconds. Just as he was about to take it off and wait, he found that the head of the corpse was bleeding.
Upon closer inspection, it was not bleeding at all! But the characteristic of "Conqueror" was turning the corpse red, as if blood was left from the top of the head and flowed all the way from the top of the head to the shoulders.
Hobert immediately "tampered" with the direction in which the corpse turned red. Although he had no time to think about why this happened, he knew that he must destroy this process.
Although the process of red spreading stopped, the corpse was changing rapidly. Suddenly, he raised his hand and pushed towards Hobert. A rust-covered blood-red long sword appeared in the corpse's hand and stabbed at Hobert.
Hobert immediately took a step back to avoid it, summoned the "Sun Scepter", and suddenly dazzling sunlight filled this "death domain", and the outer spiritual world creatures and wraiths wailed and avoided it.
But Salinger's corpse was not greatly affected, the long sword became longer, and stabbed at Hobert again.
Hobert "distorted" the direction of the long sword. He noticed that the corpse's eyes had never shown any signs of opening from beginning to end.
In the next moment, He understood why the corpse had such a reaction. This corpse, because it was a "high imitation", did not have the position of the "Death", so in the process of wearing the "Conqueror" characteristic for a long time, this corpse was assimilated.
In other words, what is in front of Hobert is actually a Sealed Artifact with Salinger's appearance, but with a level equivalent to "Conqueror".
Then Salinger's resurrection arrangement can be understood. He plans to use the Uniqueness of his spirit body to control this Sealed Artifact and gradually gain a certain initiative to become a true "Conqueror".
Resurrect in this way, and restore a certain amount of power, and then find an opportunity to re-accommodate the uniqueness of the "Hunter" pathway.
This is obviously an alternative plan, after all, this plan is not as easy as resurrecting from the "Death" pathway.
But at that time, He still had a Beyonder characteristic of "Conqueror" in his hand. If he forcibly swallowed it, he might completely lose his mind. It is better to leave a way out for himself.
With this idea, Hobert was about to "magnify" the power of "Death" on the corpse to suppress the power of the "Conqueror" characteristic, but suddenly found that the chair under the corpse's butt had begun to provide the power of "Death" for the corpse.
Just now, the resurrection process of Underworld Emperor has begun!
Hobert's heart "thumped", is he going to resurrect an emperor of the Fourth Epoch again?
At this moment, His spirituality trembled, and He had been wearing the uniqueness for 30 seconds!
When Hobert prepared to continue to insist on wearing the uniqueness to prevent the resurrection of Underworld Emperor, He was inspired and returned to the "Nation of Disorder".
After taking off the uniqueness and sealing it casually, Hobert came to the "Bell of Order", pushed the clock hammer, and invested this surging power into that "Death Domain".
Boom~
As the dull bell rang, the corpse suddenly sat motionless on the chair.
The reddened part quickly returned to the original color of the corpse.
Boom~
The second bell rang, and the corpse and the seat immediately turned into dust.
Clang~
The crown-shaped "Conqueror" Beyonder characteristic fell on the black ground, making a soft sound.
The corpse had such a reaction because the previous "entropy increase attack" had been going on, and the corpse was constantly disintegrating.
However, due to the influence of the "Conqueror" characteristic and the beginning of Underworld Emperor's resurrection process, the corpse has been kept in a relatively complete state.
When the bell rang, the power of the "Conqueror" characteristic and the resurrection process of Underworld Emperor were temporarily suppressed and interrupted, so the effect of the "entropy increase attack" was displayed.
The corpse immediately turned into dust in units of atoms.
It's just that what Hobert didn't expect was that the chair behind the corpse also turned into dust. However, after thinking about it for a while, He understood that the chair should be an important item for Underworld Emperor's resurrection. It is very likely that it was the key for Underworld Emperor's spirit body to enter the "Sealed Artifact".
So after the chair was shattered, it meant that Underworld Emperor's resurrection was completely interrupted.
Hobert, standing beside the "Bell of Order," breathed a sigh of relief. If he had resurrected the Underworld Emperor again, the four emperors of the Fourth Epoch would probably have given him an award!
Single-handedly resurrecting two emperors, he could be called a "Friend of the Four Emperors"!
After joking with himself, Hobert reached out and first took the "Conqueror" characteristic to the "Nation of Disorder" for a certain degree of sealing.
Then he immediately cleaned up the scene, dispelled the "Wall of Spirituality," retrieved "0-73," and quickly left the deserted island through the spirit world.
Back in Backlund, Hobert re-entered the "Nation of Disorder," carefully sealed the Uniqueness, and then examined the Beyonder characteristic of the "Conqueror."
Hobert first thought about his subordinates in the "Hunter" pathway that he had cultivated. Currently, the highest sequence they had reached was only Sequence 6, so they wouldn't need this Beyonder characteristic for a while.
So in Hobert's hands, for a long time, this would be a Sealed Artifact with the level of Sequence 1, and after being tossed around by the Underworld Emperor, the negative effects were not small. Even Hobert, at the angel level, would be easily assimilated to a certain extent if he used it in the real world for more than a minute, becoming a new carrier for this Beyonder characteristic.
But using it in the "Nation of Disorder" wouldn't have much impact.
He named this characteristic "0-76 Death God's Sword" and then returned to the real world.
He drank a cup of tea to calm his mood, and the corners of Hobert's mouth turned up, revealing a smile.
Picking up a Sequence 1 characteristic for free, who wouldn't be happy!
Then he had time to consider: Did Amon come for this Sequence 1 characteristic? What did he want the Beyonder characteristic of the "Conqueror" for?
After thinking for a moment, Hobert "recalled": Amon was likely going to use this Sequence 1 characteristic to trade with the "Red Angel" Medici.
He "recalled" that after the end of the war, Amon cooperated with Medici to release Mr. Door, and Amon used this to become a god and obtained the Uniqueness of the "Door" pathway and a Sequence 1 characteristic.
And Medici thus obtained a Sequence 1 characteristic and became a "Conqueror" again.
Hobert smiled, unexpectedly Amon's plan was intercepted by him!
But he didn't know if Amon would turn his attention to other "Conquerors"? Or would he continue to find a way to retrieve this Sequence 1 characteristic?
Now Hobert was not afraid of Amon anymore. Even if the other party's main body came, he was confident that he could escape.
Once he advanced to Sequence 1, he wouldn't even need to run.
Thinking of this, Hobert breathed a sigh of relief, he still needed to advance as soon as possible!
...
On New Year's Day, Backlund, which had been shrouded in sadness, also showed a hint of joy.
In a very simple apartment in the Cherwood Borough, a young man with red hair and southern continent blood was lying in an easy chair, watching the people outside the window chatting happily and said: "I don't like Backlund's current atmosphere very much."
At this time, a bloody cut suddenly opened on his cheek, and the wound opened and closed: "This atmosphere won't last long, hehe, if Alexei's head isn't full of sour cheese, Feysac will definitely launch a surprise attack on New Year's Day!"
This young man was Sauron Einhorn Medici, who had regained his humanity and was getting along with each other a little more harmoniously than before.
The first Sauron to speak smiled: "Hehehe, there is no more exciting atmosphere than the shadow of war."
The bloody cut said again: "Why is Medici mute today?"
This evil spirit is currently dominated by Medici's consciousness. Generally, the mouth of this body is used by Medici, but today Medici rarely expresses his opinions.
"Two!" Medici suddenly said: "If our feelings were correct last night, and the third 'Conqueror' characteristic really appeared in some corner of this world, are you still interested in Backlund's atmosphere?"
Einhorn wanted to shrug, but found it difficult to control this body at this time, so he had to give up this plan: "Even so, what can we do? Go to the door and let others completely kill us?"
The person who can get the Sequence 1 characteristic is at least at the angel level.
Sauron said: "It may also be displayed to everyone as a mascot. After all, there is also a 'Red Angel' in our midst, haha, very collectible."
Medici shook his head: "Your two provocations are getting less and less interesting. I can feel the anxiety in your tone.
"What you were looking at just now was not the street scene of Backlund at all, but your own future in the mist."
Sauron laughed twice: "Is 'Red Angel' going to be a poet?"
He did not deny Medici's words just now.
"We come from war, we are war itself, and we only have opportunities in war." Medici ignored the other party's sarcasm and continued: "Next, we should strengthen our observation of the battlefield. I have a hunch that that Beyonder characteristic will soon appear in front of people."
The other two did not speak. Generally, no speaking means that they defaulted and also means that they have a unified view on this matter.
...
At noon, Hobert was dining at Christian's mansion and told his adoptive parents that he would go to Longtail Island to accompany Fors in the evening.
Not only because Fors was still unwilling to come to Backlund, but also because April was also a guest on Longtail Island.
Donna also came back today. Originally, she and Hobert could easily quarrel at the dinner table, which could well liven up the atmosphere of the dinner table.
But Donna, who had been tempered for a year, was much more stable at this time. She talked more with her father about the scenery of the Southern Balam Duchy, and more with Hobert about work matters.
After dinner, Tyron suddenly expressed that he wanted to talk to Hobert alone, so the two went to the garden together.
Hobert smiled and said: "You will also go to school in the Southern Balam Duchy next year. How is it? Are you happy just thinking about it."
Tyron is a student at Backlund University and will move to the southern continent with the school next year.
"It's okay." Tyron said bluntly: "I really want to go to Longtail Island to take a look. Recently, teachers and students have been discussing Longtail Island. Many students have been hoping that I can take them to Longtail Island to take a look."
Hobert was stunned: "Why didn't you tell me before?"
"Afraid… afraid it's inconvenient for you to receive them."
Hobert smiled. Tyron was still so shy and always afraid of disturbing others.
He waved his hand: "Your travel expenses, meals, etc. to Longtail Island are all on me. You can take whoever you want!
"In this way, you take the students who want to go to Longtail Island to the Duke's Mansion to find Butler Corris and let him arrange it for you."
Tyron smiled shyly: "Okay."
Then he seemed to muster up the courage to say: "Brother, there is one more thing, that, that do you still remember Mr. Benson?"
Hobert nodded: "Remember."
He said meaningfully: "Melissa's eldest brother!"
Tyron blushed a little. He cleared his throat: "Melissa will continue her studies in the Southern Balam Duchy next year, but Mr. Benson has to stay in Backlund due to work reasons, this… this will be very inconvenient…"
Hobert immediately understood what Tyron meant. He asked with a smile: "Did Melissa ask you to talk to me about this? Or is it your own idea?"
Tyron bit his lip, feeling like his brother already knew something.
He cleared his throat again before saying: "I have this idea myself."
Tyron suddenly found that he didn't seem nervous anymore: "I believe that under your and sister's and sister-in-law's governance, Longtail Island must be as prosperous and peaceful as the rumors say.
"Although Backlund looks very prosperous, I also feel the coldness of this big city.
"So I hope to live on Longtail Island in the future. That, that, it would be best if Mr. Benson could also live on Longtail Island."
Hobert slowly nodded. Although Tyron was not good at expressing himself, he was an introverted young man with a more keen eye for problems than Donna.
He considered it and then said: "Speaking of which, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is still short of a negotiation expert."
Hobert had been in contact with Benson, and this gentleman with a slightly high hairline had a high talent for negotiation.
He said: "Leave this matter to me! Mr. Benson is likely to report to the Southern Balam Duchy before Melissa."
At four o'clock in the afternoon, Hobert came to Longtail Island and chatted with his mother April and Fors.
The New Year's atmosphere here was stronger. Longtail Island was not affected by the war, and the people here seemed to have been reborn this year, suddenly living a life of food and clothing without worry, adults had stable jobs, and children could study for free.
Many people spontaneously worshiped Hobert this afternoon, because they heard the local natives say that Duke Hobert was the god of this island.
At about five o'clock, Hobert and the three of them had dinner together in a pleasant atmosphere.
Just as they finished their main course and were drinking tea and chatting, Hobert suddenly heard a prayer from the "Nation of Disorder."
It was a strange voice: "The Creator in the Shadow of Order… the great 'Creator', I am ordered to report to you that the Feysac Empire's fleet suddenly went south and miraculously crossed Sonia Island in a short period of time, appearing on the southern coast of the Northern Continent. It is expected to arrive at Pris Harbor at about eight o'clock."
This was the emergency contact method that Hobert had discussed with Georgina and the others. He took out his pocket watch and looked at it. It was already about seven ten.
"I have an urgent task." Hobert said apologetically: "I have to go out."
April sighed: "There is no way to rest well during the New Year."
"It's my duty." What Hobert said was the duty that the "Creator" had assigned to him, not the duty that he was going to fight for Loen.
Fors followed and asked: "Is it dangerous?"
"Not dangerous," Hobert smiled: "Just go to support."
Fors nodded: "Come back early."
Hobert said "Um" and disappeared into the restaurant.
Dozens of seconds later, Hobert appeared in the near-sea fleet command of Pritz Harbor and was immediately taken to the conference room by the staff.
The conference room was already full of people, and the commander-in-chief was pointing at the sea chart and deploying the combat plan.
When Hobert entered the door, everyone looked at him together, greeted him with their eyes and nods, and the commanders continued to listen to the commander's combat plan.
After listening for a while, Hobert discovered that Loen also had a considerable near-sea defense fleet.
Among the countries of the Northern Continent, the naval power of the Loen Kingdom was the strongest, so strong that it could fight two other countries at the same time.
Now the main force of the fleet was in the Rorsted Archipelago, preventing the Intis fleet from cutting off Loen's sea supply line.
Loen also had a main fleet that had been fighting the main force of the Feysac Empire fleet in the eastern sea area.
However, because the Feysac Empire royal family used the war to add another angel, the strength of the two sides was unbalanced, and as a result, Loen's second main fleet was severely damaged in the previous Enmat Harbor naval battle.
The Loen royal family then sent a visiting delegation to the Southern Balam Duchy for help.
Currently, the remaining forces of the second main fleet have been gathered in Pris Harbor recently.
Before the third angel appeared in the Loen royal family, the Feysac Empire fleet would definitely attack Pris Harbor. This was almost the consensus of the Loen high-level officials!
In this naval battle, the commander's combat plan was to block the enemy ships with the "horizontal line" tactic.
The "horizontal line" tactic is generally a common tactic used by the defending side of the sea surface forces, because the firepower on the flanks is stronger than the firepower on the bow. If the defending side's warships take the initiative to attack, they will meet the enemy ships and suddenly sail across the enemy's face when they reach the tactical position, using the superior firepower on the flanks to sink some of the warships in front of the enemy fleet.
And staggered shooting is when two fleets sailing in different directions use the entire ship's artillery to fire at each other in unison or scatter.
After briefly explaining the tactics, the commander said again: "Next, please speak, Duke Hobert."
Everyone was about to applaud, but Hobert had already raised his hand, signaling everyone to seize the time.
He first asked the commander: "How many demigods do we have?"
The commander, wearing a navy uniform of divine color, said: "4."
Hobert asked again: "The enemy has 8, right?"
"At least that many."
Hobert nodded and asked again: "The number of our warships is half that of the opponent, right?"
The commander was slightly stunned before saying: "Yes."
"Um." Hobert said immediately: "Everyone, I don't understand naval battles very well, but from the current point of view, I have to take action at the beginning to have a chance to defend this port.
"Your warships will be faster, your cannons will be able to shoot farther, the power will be greater, and they will all hit.
"So, do your best to fire more shells."
The officers were all stunned, then looked at each other and said in unison: "Yes!"
The officers who came here to attend the meeting were all captains of the fleet flagship. They knew that the royal family had invited an angel from the Southern Balam Duchy.
It was just that they did not expect that this angel was Duke Hobert.
The brief meeting ended. Because the warships had already left the port at this time, two of the officers used sealed items with "travel" abilities to send these captains back to their warships in batches.
Hobert also "distorted" his position and disappeared into the conference room.
He first appeared in the sky above Pris Harbor. The sea breeze blowing in his face made his single coat rustle. The port at his feet was brightly lit. In the alarm sound, the workers on the dock shouted loudly, unloading the goods on the ship as soon as possible. The cargo ships that had not had time to unload were busy leaving the port to avoid being blocked inside by enemy ships.
Some larger cargo ships were ordered to block the front of the harbor. If the naval battle was lost, these large cargo ships would be detonated and sunk at the entrance to prevent enemy warships from entering the port.
In the nearby sea, there was a patch of light, which was the main force of the Loen's Second Fleet.
Farther away, there was a cluster of faint lights, which was the Feysac fleet attacking the port.
Although warships were equipped with steam engines, their speed was generally around fourteen or fifteen knots. After the enemy appeared in sight, there was enough time to hold a meeting to discuss tactics before calmly engaging them.
Hobert stepped forward as if taking a leisurely stroll, arriving above the Loen fleet.
With a wave of his hand, He "magnified" the speed of all the warships.
At this time, Cartel, the commander of the Loen side, was in the captain's cabin of the flagship "Royal Oak", using a telescope to observe the cluster of lights in the distance.
Suddenly, Cartel, holding the telescope, felt a slight inertia. He was slightly stunned, put down the telescope, and found that everyone had stopped their work, looking at each other with some surprise.
"Commander! Captain!" the helmsman reported: "The warship suddenly accelerated, and our speed has reached 18 knots."
Cartel realized that this should be the acceleration promised by Duke Hobert: "Normal."
"It has accelerated to 20 knots!" the helmsman added.
Cartel still calmly said: "A god is helping us, allowing us to reach unprecedented speeds!
"Order all ships to prepare for engagement in advance!"
"Yes!" After receiving the order, the crew immediately used signal lamps to transmit the order.
"22 knots!" the helmsman continued to report.
Cartel gestured, indicating that the helmsman didn't need to report anymore. He expected the fleet to be much faster than normal. With such strong maneuverability, he could consider changing the tactics and encircling the enemy fleet.
After the naval commander issued a series of orders, he realized that they were very close to the enemy ships.
Because there were no reference points at night, he quickly asked the helmsman: "What is the current speed?"
The helmsman swallowed: "46 knots!"
This speed had long exceeded the maximum speed of the speedometer. 46 knots was a speed calculated by the helmsman based on the visual distance between the enemy and ourselves, and the distance to the port.
"What..." Cartel felt a little scalp tingling: "Why didn't you say so earlier?"
He had also used sealed artifacts to accelerate in naval battles, but adding to twenty-four or five knots was already the limit. After all, warships were behemoths, and even with Beyonder abilities, acceleration was not so easy.
Then Cartel took a deep breath and said in his heart: This is the angel of the 'Lawyer' pathway! Speed and weight are like toys in His hands.
The helmsman smiled bitterly: "It's, it's because you just..."
Cartel didn't have time to waste words with the helmsman, and immediately ordered: "Left rudder! Rapid-fire at the enemy ships in sequence!"
At this time, the Feysac fleet also realized that there was a problem with their speed. All the warships seemed to have some malfunction, with only half their usual speed.
In contrast, the warships of the Loen Kingdom were more like speedboats, moving at an astonishing speed, and every shell could accurately hit the warships of the Feysac Empire. The three leading warships were immediately sunk.
The Feysac fleet's counterattack seemed even more ridiculous, with shells only flying a dozen meters before falling into the sea.
Several demigods took action, but to no avail. At this time, the Loen fleet began to cross paths with the Feysac fleet, and the Loen ships began to fire salvos in sequence, and as before, every shell could accurately hit the Feysac warships.
Egor, the commander-in-chief of the Feysac fleet, realized that the Loen fleet had the help of an angel, so he immediately prayed to Awatoma, requesting the help of this commander of the Sonia Sea battlefield.
At this time, Hobert in mid-air saw that the attack efficiency of the Loen warships was too low. The Feysac fleet had high defense with the help of the demigods, and it took a long time to sink only eight or nine warships.
For the Loen fleet, this was already a considerable victory, but for Hobert, it was too slow. So He reached out and pressed down on the Feysac fleet.
More than two hundred Feysac warships slowed down again, and their draft suddenly deepened by dozens of centimeters!
At this time, Hobert's spirituality felt something. He looked in the direction of the port. A cold, bone-chilling hurricane was blowing towards the port, and everything it passed was covered with a layer of ice. Obviously, the angel of the Feysac Empire had also taken action.
Hobert thought for a moment and did not go to rescue, but continued to attack the Feysac fleet.
He was "tampering" with the buoyancy of the fleet's sea area. As the buoyancy decreased, the draft of the warships deepened, and seawater began to pour in from the portholes on one side.
In Hobert's view, even if the port was frozen, it could be thawed in a few days, and the port would be able to resume operation.
But if the main force of the Feysac fleet was sunk, they would not be able to sneak attack the port again in a short time.
So Hobert estimated that the enemy's angel would eventually choose to rescue their fleet, so that He could gain a preemptive advantage in the subsequent angel war.
At this time, the Feysac fleet screamed again and again, and the boilers of several warships were extinguished by the seawater poured in, and they completely lost power.
At the same time, the hurricane flying towards the port suddenly disappeared, and a layer of mist suddenly appeared on the sea, instantly engulfing the Loen fleet.
In the mist, huge and hard hailstones fell from the sky, smashing towards the warships like shells, and even the steel decks could be smashed through.
Hobert waved his hand and "distorted" the direction of the hailstones, so that they all fell into the sea, and only a small part hit the warships.
He smiled slightly: "Got you!"
Saying this, Hobert made a downward chopping gesture and "distorted" the sea water. The sea surface suddenly split open like a cut cake, separating to the left and right, exposing Awatoma, who was hiding on the seabed with a small mustache.
Even Hobert did not expect that the "Weather Warlock", who was good at manipulating flames, was hiding in the sea.
He was about to take the corresponding sealed artifact from the "Nation of Disorder" to attack the opponent, when he suddenly saw Awatoma pursing her lips and smiling. Immediately, Hobert's spirituality suddenly sent a dangerous warning!
In this instant, Hobert realized that he was too late to dodge, so he immediately used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to form a piece of armor behind him.
The armor at the back of his heart had just formed, when it was pierced by a sword with rust and blood. The power of the "Nation of Disorder" immediately dissipated.
Hobert immediately entered the spirit world. The only one who could make the angel Awatoma a bait was the first emperor of the Feysac Empire, Alexei!
