chapters.title: Chapter 693 - 689: Lilith's Human Side
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
His own biological mother was actually the "Sanguine Ancestor," Lilith!
Hobert was stunned for a long while before suddenly realizing: He'd risen in seniority again! Emlyn would have to call him ancestor when they met in the future!
He quickly accepted this fact, because it immediately explained some of the strange things he had encountered before, such as why she betrayed the Earth Mother Church, yet still had a sealed artifact with the Earth Mother's mark. Such as why the Earth Mother was so kind to him, and why the Earth Mother Church changed its prayer gestures on the day he was born!
In short, all of Hobert's previous doubts about his mother were suddenly resolved.
In his mind, the general outline of the matter was: The Earth Mother split off the personality of Audrey for unknown reasons. Perhaps under the Earth Mother's arrangement, or perhaps by chance, Audrey met Hobert's father, Rex.
Later, Hobert was born. Audrey must have betrayed the Earth Mother Church under the Earth Mother's control and began to come into contact with the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
After becoming an angel, Audrey recalled everything. The first piece of information she remembered was that she was Lilith.
Hobert took a deep breath. Fortunately, she didn't let anything slip. If she had followed up with the sentence "I am also the Earth Mother," he would have had to kill everyone here and also go to the spirit world to clean up the surrounding spirit world creatures to be at ease.
Audrey, or rather Lilith, quickly recovered from her confusion. She smiled and looked at Spike: "You have been used by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity.' The Spiritual Research Society's research will never succeed."
Spike sneered: "That's not necessarily true…"
Suddenly, he disappeared in front of Hobert and Audrey. His sneer and conversation just now were to cover up his ability to escape.
Lilith's smile remained. She suddenly waved her hand, and a hazy, illusory door suddenly opened in the center of the hall. Spike, who was traversing the spirit world, was instantly located and returned to the real world under the pressure of the hazy door.
Spike's body immediately became illusory again, and starlight appeared. He could enter the astral world in the next instant.
"Ah!"
Spike suddenly let out a scream. He raised his hand and forcefully covered his eyes. His originally illusory figure was replaced by a scarlet color until he closed the passage to the astral world, and the scarlet color on his body disappeared.
A very textured scarlet moon appeared at the top of the hall. No matter which location of the astral world Spike opened, a scarlet moon would be waiting for him.
Hobert realized that Lilith had not only regained her memory but also seemed to have regained part of the position of the "Sanguine Ancestor," which made her strength far surpass ordinary Sequence 2.
At the same time this thought appeared, Hobert used the "Death God's Sword" to shoot a "Blazing White Spear" at Spike, accurately hitting Spike's vital point.
Spike's expression was very painful as he used a certain technique to seal the flames on the "Blazing White Spear" that could burn everything.
At this time, Lilith waved her hand at Spike again, and clumps of ferns immediately grew on his body, making him look like a humanoid plant display stand.
These plants absorbed a large amount of Spike's spirituality, making his spirituality very unstable, and many abilities could not be used.
At the same time, a green head grew out of Spike's shoulder, and this head immediately began to compete with Spike for control of the body.
Spike loudly chanted in pain: "The one and only Crimson Moon…"
Hobert quickly "distorted" Spike's mouth, making it difficult for him to make any sound for the time being.
Lilith smiled and said: "You actually chanted other honorific names of the Moon in front of me!"
As she spoke, Spike's chest was torn open, and his heart and lungs jumped out of his chest cavity. They were like playful children, running around.
Hobert took the opportunity to "magnify" the power of the green head on Spike's shoulder, allowing it to basically take control of Spike.
Spike stretched out his hands, hugged his head, and then distorted it off his neck, throwing it on the ground.
Hobert used the "Blazing White Spear" again, piercing through the head on the ground. The white flames that ignited quickly burned Spike to ashes.
Then, Hobert reached out again, took out "0-73" the Death Domain, and summoned several evil spirits from the underworld to tear and devour Spike's spirit body.
Whew~
Finally, in the white flames, Spike's body was burned to ashes, leaving only a Beyonder characteristic mixed with a dark green ribbon-like substance.
With a wave of her hand, Lilith sent the Beyonder characteristic flying towards Hobert: "This is for you."
Hobert, who had just put the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact back, was about to decline when Lilith said again: "Just consider it a gift from your mother."
Only then did Hobert carefully wrap the Beyonder characteristic with the "Crystal of Order" and put it in his pocket.
"You must have many doubts, right?" Lilith asked with a smile.
"Yes."
Lilith stretched out her hand. In her palm was the "Crystal of Order" that Hobert had given her before. After injecting spirituality into it, it formed a black barrier that encompassed Lilith and Hobert.
"Our conversation may be eavesdropped on," Lilith explained. "There's no problem inside the black barrier. This crystal has a very high level."
"Mother…" Hobert said uncertainly, "Can I still call you that?"
"How else would you call me?" Lilith smiled and said, "I finally understand why my condition has stabilized so much since you called me mother!
"It turns out that it's because I have a close connection with the Earth Mother. The state of 'mother' can also stabilize my state."
Then she said: "Let me explain the whole thing clearly. Do you know about the history of the Second Epoch? Especially about the battle between me and Flegrea and Kvastir."
"I know a little."
"Great!" Lilith smiled and said, "You actually found some historical information from so long ago yourself."
Hobert resisted the urge to twitch the corner of his mouth, feeling like he was being treated like a child.
"Then you should know that one of the reasons why this battle broke out was because I wanted to get rid of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity's' corruption."
Hobert "Mm"ed: "I had such a guess."
"Unfortunately, it failed." Lilith's expression became solemn: "The 'Mother Goddess of Depravity's' corruption is eternal. It didn't disappear just because I used the method of dying once to expel the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway and two Sequence 1 characteristics from my body.
"After becoming the Earth Mother, the corruption was only within a controllable range.
"Over the long years, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity's' corruption made Lilith's personality more and more active and influenced the real world to a certain extent through the Earth Mother.
"In order to avoid being influenced by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' again and doing some very irrational things, I split Lilith's personality along with most of the corruption, forming April.
"Through such a split, the corruption on both the Earth Mother and Lilith was greatly reduced.
"But Lilith's personality still had a phenomenon of leaning towards the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity.' This was originally a very headache-inducing thing. During my relationship with Rex, many of his ideas inspired me and allowed me to formulate a new plan."
Hobert was slightly stunned: "My father's idea."
Lilith showed a gentle smile: "It is undeniable that your father was a rare genius, but unfortunately, I could hardly help him solve the difficulties he encountered back then."
Then she brought up another topic: "Have you heard of the Outer Deities?"
"I've heard of them."
Lilith was somewhat surprised: "You've even heard of this."
Then she exclaimed: "As expected of the son of me and Rex."
Hobert really wanted to tell her that he had already passed the age of encouraging education.
Lilith asked again: "Then do you know how to become a Great Old One?"
Hobert pretended that he didn't know much about it either: "I heard that it seems like you have to master the Uniqueness of different pathways."
"In addition to that, you also have to fuse the Sefirah." Lilith explained: "The Sefirah corresponding to the 'Mother' and 'Moon' pathways is the 'Brood Hive'.
"The Sefirah corresponding to the 'Lawyer' pathway is the 'Nation of Disorder.' I think you should be familiar with it."
Hobert didn't know whether his mother already knew that he was the "Creator"? He could only vaguely say: "I see."
"In the beginning, I not only had the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway and two Sequence 1 characteristics in my body, but also a Sequence 1 of the 'Mother' pathway." Lilith continued:
"Because of the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence, I unintentionally obtained the Uniqueness of the 'Mother' pathway and discovered the clues to the 'Brood Hive' with this Uniqueness!"
Hobert first recalled his previous guess. He had previously guessed that as the ancient god, the "Sanguine Ancestor," it was impossible for her to only have the Beyonder characteristics of one pathway in her body, and there was a high probability that she had some Beyonder characteristics of the "Mother" pathway.
Hobert was somewhat surprised when he heard Lilith's second sentence: "The 'Brood Hive,' which is the clues to the Sefirah?"
Could it be? Wasn't it said that it was sealed by the Celestial Worthy in the West Continent?
But he also thought of the "Nation of Disorder," the "River of Eternal Darkness," and the "City of Calamity." The Celestial Worthy's blockade of the Sefirah didn't seem as tight as he had imagined.
"Yes." Lilith replied: "Part of the concept of the 'Brood Hive' is mixed in the motherhood of living beings."
Hobert understood: That is to say, unless there is no maternal love in this world, it is impossible to completely seal away the "Brood Hive"!
"In the Second Epoch, there was only a vague concept of adjacent pathways, but not the concept of the Great Old Ones," Lilith continued. "I could feel the surging power of the 'Brood Hive' and thought that was the path to becoming stronger.
"So I thought of a way to expel the uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of the 'Moon' pathway while eliminating corruption.
"Originally, my plan was to enter a pre-refined body 'after death,' while the spirit body and psyche would be attached to that Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Mother' pathway, and then find an opportunity to become a true god of the 'Mother' pathway, thereby mastering the Sefirah.
"The reason for this plan was that I realized that 'Mother,' to some extent, was easier to approach the 'Brood Hive' than 'Moon.' At the time, I thought that the extraordinary pathway needed to be pure to master the 'Brood Hive.'
"But after the War of the Gods, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' used her influence over the 'Moon' and 'Mother' pathways to sever most of my connection with the spirit world.
"The 'Mother' pathway is not good at conducting corresponding operations in the spirit world. For a long time, I was always on the verge of losing control.
"Fortunately, the Ancient Sun God helped me steal Omebella's fate, and I recovered my state and became the Earth Mother as soon as possible."
Hobert listened intently, never expecting the true history to be like this! It was similar to the descriptions in historical materials, but also somewhat different.
"All along, I have been working hard to resist the corruption of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity,'" Lilith continued. "Until after the personality of Lilith was split off for a while, I suddenly thought, why can't I use the corruption of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' within a controllable range?"
She smiled and said, "To be precise, some of Rex's ideas inspired me.
"I have to say that when encountering difficulties that are difficult to solve for a long time, the 'Lawyer''s way of thinking is a good idea."
Hobert also showed a knowing smile.
"Originally, splitting into two personalities had many negative effects on my state. I thought I could also use these negative effects to make Lilith's personality approach the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity,'" Lilith said with a smile:
"Having fought with the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' for so long, I am very clear that she needs a vessel to descend into the real world.
"But because of the previous precautions of the Seven Gods in this regard, she has never found an opportunity.
"So I sent this opportunity to her. As I expected, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' would take advantage of Lilith's advancement to angel to transform my body.
"I made a lot of preparations for this in advance. Of course, these preparations were carried out under the guidance of the subconscious, after all, before becoming an angel, Lilith did not know her origin, nor did she know the entire plan.
"But I was still a little worried, and I couldn't let the Earth Mother provide help, so I asked you for help to stabilize my state."
Hobert smiled and said, "Fortunately, the power that the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' can project into the real world is very limited."
Otherwise, it would be a joke for two angels to try to fight against the Outer Gods.
Then Hobert glanced at the ashes left after Spike's burning: "This 'Planeswalker' doesn't seem to be very clear about the struggle just now."
"Spike was originally a character used by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' to attract the attention of the church, and he may be abandoned at any time, so he doesn't know much," Lilith said:
"The 'Spiritual Research Society' created by Spike is preparing to revive the 'Original Creator' to a certain extent, so as to use certain symbolic meanings of the 'Original Creator' to briefly open the barrier and let the Outer Gods enter the real world."
She sneered: "This idiot actually believes that he can revive the 'Original Creator' to a certain extent!"
Hobert looked at the ashes: Maybe it's not that Spike is stupid, but that Beyonders lack information about the 'Original Creator' and don't quite understand what the 'Original Creator' represents.
Theoretically speaking, there is a trace of the original consciousness in everyone's body. As long as you find a way to activate these consciousnesses, it seems that you can revive Him.
But this theory is very deceptive. It sounds like it's not difficult, but without the accumulation of Beyonder characteristics, there is no container for the original consciousness at all.
Rather than saying that Spike is stupid, it is better to say that he was fooled by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity.' After all, he is attracting the attention of the orthodox church, so just find something for him to do and make him look busy with some crazy things.
On the other hand, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' is quietly strengthening her influence on the real world by controlling wild gods such as the 'Mother of Sea Monsters.'
Thinking of this, Hobert asked with some worry: "The 'Mother Goddess of Depravity's transformation of you must also have hidden dangers, right?"
"There will indeed be considerable hidden dangers," Lilith said solemnly: "For example, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' can easily cast her gaze on me, and I am more easily influenced by her."
As she spoke, she raised the 'Order Crystal' in her hand: "However, the gift you gave me can help me block most of the influence of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity.' I can resolve the remaining small part through the authority of the moon.
"As you said, the power that the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' can project into reality is very limited at present."
Hobert then asked, "What benefits can you get from this?"
"The direct benefit is that although I am only Sequence 2 at present, I can already master part of the authority of the 'Moon,'" Lilith did not hide: "The biggest benefit, and the purpose of my plan, is that through this transformation, it will be easier to accommodate the 'Brood Hive.'
"That's right, my complete plan is to use the position of 'Sanguine Ancestor' to become 'Moon' again, and use the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' characteristic carried by Lilith at this time to try to accommodate the 'Brood Hive.'
"Now that I have been transformed, the probability of successfully accommodating the 'Brood Hive' has greatly increased. If I successfully accommodate the 'Brood Hive,' I will merge with the Earth Mother."
Hobert nodded, thinking: If everything can be successful, a new Outer Deity will be born.
He asked, "Are the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics easy to obtain?"
"In the near future, I will be able to get the Sequence 1 characteristic from the Earth Mother. I have tampered with Auernia's characteristic, and it has not been obtained by the orthodox church, and it can be obtained relatively easily," Lilith said:
"As for the Uniqueness, judging from the current situation, I will be able to get it soon."
Speaking of this, Lilith smiled mysteriously: "It's not that I'm hiding something, but this matter involves secrets. If I tell you, you may not be able to hear it."
Hobert also smiled: Actually, I know your secrets.
Then he realized a problem: "I got some information that a Beyonder characteristic of 'Beauty Goddess' seems to have been sacrificed to the 'Mother Tree of Desire'!"
Lilith changed her sitting position: "That's right."
"Then what should we do?"
Lilith looked at Hobert: "This depends on you."
"Depends on me?"
"Yes," Lilith said: "Perhaps many people are not clear that after the Beyonders of the 'Moon' pathway become 'High Summoners,' they will have the ability of 'Moon Divination.'
"This is because after becoming a 'High Summoner,' they can freely enter and exit the spirit world, and can obtain information from the spirit world relatively easily.
"The Earth Mother once used the Beyonder characteristic of 'Beauty Goddess' in her hand to divination and obtained the revelation that 'the last Beyonder characteristic will be obtained from my child.'
Hobert was stunned for a moment before asking, "Could it be the Sanguine…"
"The Sanguine was not created by me," Lilith said: "The Sanguine appeared in the First Epoch. I just helped the Sanguine members stabilize their state and become more and more rational."
She added: "Although I transformed many creatures in the Second Epoch, I did not leave any direct descendants.
"Only you are my child."
Speaking of this, Lilith took a deep breath and said: "Although it sounds a bit utilitarian, the Earth Mother also needs a child very much, but you should not question our motherly love for you."
"Okay," what else could Hobert say? Originally, there was one adoptive mother and one biological mother, and now there is another 'Godmother.'
He smiled and said, "I have indeed always regarded the 'Rose School' as a mortal enemy."
Lilith asked again, "Do you have any other questions?"
Hobert thought for a while before saying, "In the War of the Gods that happened in the Second Epoch, did Omebella betray you?"
"Yes," Lilith said: "Although I have indeed been looking for an opportunity to strip off the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Moon' pathway, that battle interrupted my plan. At that time, I had not had time to arrange how to recover the characteristics of the 'Moon' pathway.
"So in the end, except for the Uniqueness, which someone helped me pick up, two 'Beauty Goddess' characteristics escaped my control. One was picked up by the 'God of Spiritual Creatures' and sacrificed to the 'Mother Tree of Desire.'
"Another one was picked up by the 'God of the Dead,' who was the later Underworld Emperor. He dedicated this characteristic to the 'Phoenix Ancestor,' Gregrace, thereby defecting to the 'Phoenix Ancestor.' Later, that characteristic fell into the hands of the Ancient Sun God.
"At the end of the Third Epoch, I was invited to join the 'Rose Redemption' and regained this characteristic."
Hobert nodded, so Auernia was already a 'Beauty Goddess' before the War of the Gods broke out.
At the same time, he realized that Omebella's betrayal was entirely due to the competition for Beyonder characteristics. According to Lilith's description, although she only had one Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic of 'Naturewalker' in her body at the time.
But the other two Beyonder characteristics, as well as the Uniqueness of the 'Mother' pathway, should have also been mastered by her, so she had the confidence to become a true god of the 'Mother' pathway in a short time.
For Omebella, if she wanted to be promoted, she could only start with Lilith.
"The new era is about to arrive." Lilith smiled and said, "This is an opportunity for all of us."
… …
Backlund, Moon Hotel.
The third round of negotiations between the Sanguine and the Southern Balam Republic's Ministry of Foreign Affairs proceeded as scheduled.
Previously, after the Sanguine Marquis Nibbs conducted the first round of negotiations with Hobert, he immediately returned to pray to the Ancestor, asking whether the revival of the 'Blood Moon Queen' was arranged by the 'Ancestor'.
It took several days to receive a response: it was not.
At that time, the Mother Goddess of the Earth was secretly 'acting' as the 'Sanguine Ancestor' using a 'Beauty Goddess' Beyonder characteristic.
Therefore, She had to wait for a certain opportunity to respond to the Sanguine' prayers in a state of absolute Concealment, and the response process was not so timely.
After receiving the 'Ancestor's' reply, the Sanguine elders discussed it.
Because Hobert's point of view was very deceptive, they all thought that the 'Blood Moon Queen' happened to be resurrected in a Chosen of the 'Creator', causing Hobert's misunderstanding.
But no matter what, they still had to bring the Queen back first.
So the two sides started the second round of negotiations, and Hobert simply let Audrey and Dophis talk to the Sanguine.
The Sanguine were willing to send an angel and 80 members to participate in a Beyonder war against the Highlands Kingdom, but the two sides were deadlocked on the issue of spoils distribution.
The Sanguine believed that the spoils seized in battle should belong to them, but Audrey believed that since they were helping the Southern Balam Republic fight, all the spoils should be turned over.
The two sides argued endlessly, so the second negotiation made no progress.
The third negotiation began, and both sides still maintained their original demands, but as soon as the negotiation started, Hobert suddenly appeared and made a concession: "The 'Apothecary' pathway Beyonder characteristics seized by the Sanguine in battle will belong to the Sanguine, and other spoils must be turned over."
This was also the goal the Sanguine wanted to achieve, so Nibbs also agreed to Hobert's proposal, and the negotiation was successfully completed.
Nibbs smiled and said: "Duke Hobert still respects the friendship between the Sanguine."
"What friends or not." Hobert smiled and said: "We are all family, don't be so polite."
Nibbs was slightly stunned. When Hobert previously stated that the relationship between the two parties was close, he often said "We are all friends". Why did he suddenly say "We are all family" today?
While he was wondering, Dophis brought Auernia over, and Nibbs hurried over to greet the Sanguine queen, and put this matter behind him.
Still a little weak, Auernia glanced at Hobert coldly, and finally returned to the Sanguine.
When Auernia learned that Hobert had actually traded her with the Sanguine, she inevitably flew into a rage, but She suddenly returned to the Sanguine and has not fully recovered Her status, so it is not easy to command the Sanguine members at this time.
So for the time being, it's just a tantrum.
Hobert returned to the study of the Duke's Mansion with Audrey and Dophis. Audrey immediately asked: "Why did you suddenly make a concession?"
Hobert smiled and said: "Lilith is resurrected!"
He estimated that Lilith would inevitably "leak" some news of her resurrection, in order to dispel the doubts of the God of Combat, Badheil, who was already suspicious.
Hobert remembered that when Badheil fell in the battle of the gods, he immediately called out Lilith's name, indicating that He had been suspicious.
Now that Lilith has suddenly resurrected, this can at least make the God of Combat believe in the Mother Goddess of the Earth for a while longer.
Dophis only knew the "Sanguine Ancestor" and did not know who Lilith was referring to.
But Audrey, who knew the relevant information, was very surprised. First, the "Blood Moon Queen" was resurrected, and now the "Sanguine Ancestor" was resurrected again. Are the Sanguine going to return to their peak because of this?
At the same time, Audrey also understood why Hobert suddenly made a concession. Even if an ancient god like this is resurrected, even if it is difficult to restore strength for a while like Mr. Fool, the power of the Sanguine must be re-evaluated.
Hobert felt that he had just used Auernia to fish for Amon… Although the purpose at the time was not to fish for Amon, he did fish for Amon.
After all, that was Mother's subordinate. It would not be appropriate not to express anything after being punished.
Moreover, there are still many places to use the Sanguine in the future, so I plan to give them some sweetness.
After solving the Sanguine's matter, Audrey talked about the negotiations with the Feysac Empire. Currently, the negotiations between the two sides have also entered the final stage.
The two sides will withdraw the soldiers and Beyonders confronting each other on the border within the next week.
At present, the industrial base of the Southern Balam Republic has been fully operational with a large number of skilled workers, and the relocation of the university has also ended.
In addition to these two major projects involving the foundation of the country, the immigration operation has also been very organized and no longer looks as chaotic as before.
The Duchy government has also completed land reform and system reform, completely controlling the entire territory of the Duchy.
At this time, we can free up our hands to implement the next strategic plan.
… …
Monday afternoon, in the study of the Duke's Mansion, Hobert looked at the jade pendant-shaped "Order Crystal" on the desk, and showed a satisfied smile.
Recently, He has been conducting a research to give the "Order Crystal" more abilities and power in the real world.
Currently, the "Order Crystal" has many uses in Hobert's hands, such as summoning barriers, performing seals, etc.
But in the hands of others, it can only summon barriers and better maintain the state, making it less prone to loss of control.
Hobert hopes that the transformed "Order Crystal" can also have some other abilities, such as protecting the spirit body, and being able to use some of the higher-level "Lawyer" pathway abilities.
The reason for this consideration is that Hobert first eliminated the "Mother of Sea Monsters" and then helped Lilith fight against the "Mother Goddess of Depravity", which can easily attract the attention of this Outer God.
Hobert is not afraid of the power of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" with the protection of the "Nation of Disorder", but if the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" turns to influence several of His important subordinates, it will be a little difficult to defend against.
Therefore, Hobert plans to use the "Order Crystal" to enhance the ability of several important subordinates to resist the Outer Gods.
However, Hobert's attempts have not been able to achieve His goal, because the power stored in the "Order Crystal" is limited, and the excess power of the "Nation of Disorder" will quickly dissipate in the real world.
When the research reached this point, Hobert was reminded of the thin-necked glass bottle in Erebus's hand. When George III was killed, Erebus used His glass bottle to block the thin sword pierced by Hobert in order to seize a Beyonder characteristic of the "Order Usurping Prince".
As a result, the mist in the glass bottle dissipated, and this mystical item was scrapped.
Hobert felt at the time that this glass bottle might be useful in the future, so He picked it up and studied it. As expected, He found inspiration.
The newly made "Order Crystal" can store a large amount of "Power of Order" and can prevent the influence of Outer Gods for a long time.
Hobert plans to make a few pieces after attending the Tarot Club later, and bestow one to each of His four confidants, Elliot, as the "Creator".
He looked at the clock, there was still time, so He chanted the spell: "Messenger!"
With the end of the internal reforms of the Southern Balam Duchy, it is time to start expanding outwards. For this external expansion, Hobert needs Beverly and her younger brother to fight.
The space in the study became illusory, and the Messenger's heavy coffin slowly floated out.
Hobert said: "I invited you here today…"
Although it was this layer of coffin lid, His spirituality keenly noticed that this Beverly was staring at the "Order Crystal" on the desk.
A few seconds later, before the other party could react, Hobert asked: "What's wrong?"
The coffin lid of Miss Messenger opened. The Messenger, Beverly, who used to have a playful smile, pointed at the "Order Crystal" on the table with a serious expression and asked: "This seems to be different from the crystal you gave me before."
The thoughts in Hobert's mind turned several times in an instant: "This, this is something that the great 'Creator' bestowed upon a few Chosen ones to save their lives. Of course it's different."
Beverly then withdrew her gaze and asked: "How can I get it?"
Hobert asked in order to confirm His thoughts: "Why do you want to get it?"
"It's the shape of a donut!" Beverly said seriously: "I can be very sure that this is the opportunity for me to restore my state that Antigonus divined before."
In the Fourth Epoch, Antigonus once drew a circle for Beverly and told her that this thing was very important to Him.
Hobert said "Sure enough" in His heart, because He was already preparing to promote certain styles of the modern world in the Southern Balam Republic, so the new "Order Crystal" that Hobert had just made had a round jade pendant-shaped appearance.
Then He laughed a little. Miss Messenger's understanding ability was too… indescribable. How could She understand the opportunity to restore Her state as a doughnut?
However, it cannot be ruled out that Beverly likes to eat doughnuts too much, so She simply treats it as a doughnut.
Then Hobert took a deep breath and said: "Can you be loyal to the 'Creator'?"
Beverly immediately said: "Yes, Raymond and I can be loyal to the 'Creator'."
Hobert was stunned: "Can Raymond also use it to restore his state?"
"Yes." Beverly said: "I can feel how powerful its 'twisting' and 'tampering' power is. Even if it is not an angel of this pathway, it can use its power to stabilize its state."
Hobert nodded: "I will report this matter to the 'Creator'."
Then He changed the subject: "Before that, I need your and Raymond's help to assist me in launching a Beyonder war in the Southern Continent.
"Before the war starts, the 'Creator' should decide whether to accept your allegiance. We can discuss your rewards then."
Hobert planned to establish a system of merit points for obtaining the "Crystal Ring of Order," and then use those merit points as the reward for the siblings. Once they had enough merit, and he was probably close to advancing to Sequence 1, he would accept their allegiance.
After sending away the messenger, Beverly, Hobert was in a great mood.
Before this, he had been pondering how to completely subdue these two angels in the future.
Even angels in poor condition were still angels, a very scarce resource in the extraordinary world. It would be a waste not to use them.
However, Hobert always had a principle: his subordinates must be of a lower Sequence than him, as this was the safest approach.
After all, this was an extraordinary world where Sequence was paramount.
Hobert, lost in thought, put away the "Order Crystal." When the three o'clock chimes rang, Hobert's vision was covered by gray fog, and he appeared on one side of the bronze long table in the giant hall.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool." Audrey, 'Justice,' sounded as sweet as ever.
It had been a long time since anyone had offered up diaries of Emperor Roselle, and there was no reading section from Mr. Fool.
So, after the greetings, 'The Fool' Klein said to everyone, "You may begin."
Immediately afterward, Klein controlled 'The World' to ask 'The Emperor' Hobert, "Mr. Emperor, do you have any clues about the 'Miracle Invoker' Beyonder characteristic? What reward do you require from me?"
The other members were filled with emotion: Mr. World was also preparing to advance to Sequence 2.
"I have two clues here, no, one clue." Hobert had also thought of the 'Genie,' but then realized that even if Klein got the 'Genie,' he wouldn't be able to use it, so he simply changed his mind on the spot.
Then he said, "No reward is needed, because such a reward cannot be calculated, so let's just forget about it."
Beyonder characteristics at the angel level, even just related clues, could only be measured with things at the angel level, and it was difficult to have a fixed price standard.
Moreover, Hobert remembered that Klein should have already inquired about the clue he was talking about from somewhere else.
Klein didn't speculate and immediately controlled 'The World' to say, "Thank you."
Hobert waved his hand and said, "I remember that 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf' Flegrea once had a subsidiary god called the 'God of Wishes,' whose name seemed to be Kotar.
"Kotar occasionally appeared in people's sight during the Third Epoch, but since the Fourth Epoch, no one has witnessed this 'God of Wishes.'
"Many people speculate that He should be trapped in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.' You happen to be in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods,' so you can try to find Him."
Klein nodded. He had also obtained similar information from Will Auceptin, and recently he found Moon City and obtained new information.
He controlled 'The World' and asked, "If I want to deal with Kotar, can I ask for your help?"
"No problem," Hobert said.
Derrick, 'The Sun,' curiously asked at this time, "How will Mr. Emperor come to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'?"
"I can sacrifice myself," Hobert said. "Mr. World, prepare the bestowal ritual on the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' side, and please Mr. Fool send me to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.'"
Derrick opened his mouth, so it could be done this way.
Before he could say anything, Hobert added, "It is not recommended to try this below the angel level.
"Ordinary Beyonders' bodies may not be able to withstand the surging power in the kingdom of gods. Angels' bodies and spirituality have undergone qualitative changes, so I have the confidence to do so."
Derrick nodded, a little disappointed at first, but then became happy again. Soon another Tarot Club member would appear in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods.'
Klein pondered for a moment. Hobert's method was feasible, so he controlled 'The World' and asked again, "What reward do you need?"
Hobert thought for a while, "Apart from the Beyonder characteristic you need, all other spoils belong to me."
Klein immediately had 'The World' say, "No problem."
Miss Messenger wanted gold coins, and Hobert wanted spoils, then he only needed to solve the gold coins needed by Miss Messenger.
Immediately afterward, 'The World' conjured up a stack of paper: "This is some information and personality descriptions of the Demonic Wolf Kotar, as well as the analysis made by 'Miss Justice' based on this yesterday.
"I will deal with this mythical creature with Mr. Emperor and another angel. You can offer suggestions and talk about your ideas."

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - 690 Discussing Roselle's Current Situation at the Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
"The Fool" Klein hoped to gather inspiration for hunting the Demonic Wolf by receiving diverse opinions from people with different personalities and perspectives.
As for the other angel besides Hobert, Klein planned to ask Miss Messenger, Reinette Tinekerr, for help, so he also provided information about the approximate abilities of "Ancient Bane."
This mode of communication now frequently occurs during the Tarot Gathering. Currently, everyone basically lacks an urgent need for advancement, but sometimes they encounter difficulties that require everyone's help in providing ideas and solutions.
"The Hanged Man" Alger was somewhat excited after receiving the information. He didn't expect that he, only at Sequence 5, could participate in actions against mythical creatures.
"The Hermit" Cattleya, based on the information provided by "The World," was guessing which angel Mr. Fool would dispatch to help.
After everyone carefully read the information in their hands, Alger took the lead and said, "According to Miss Justice's analysis, no bait will lure that suspicious mythical creature. It will only make Him hide further away."
"Under the circumstance of seemingly possessing Sequence 1 characteristic, improving Himself is the most important thing to Him. If we want to deal with Him, we can only consider it from this aspect."
"The Moon" Emlyn, upon hearing this, also shared his views: "But this mythical creature is very cautious, leaving no clues. And intelligence shows that the location He's preparing for the Sequence 1 ritual is in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods,' where He's actually unrestricted."
The ritual for advancing to Sequence 1, "Attendant of Mysteries," is to build a town purely composed of puppets.
"Yes, there are too many monsters available for Him to use," "The Sun" Derrick affirmed Emlyn's statement.
After a second or two of silence in the hall, "The Star" Leonard thought for a moment and said, "Can we rely on the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence?"
As he spoke, he looked at "The World": "That mythical creature seems to be on the same pathway as you."
Klein had also considered this method: "Relying solely on this level of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence, wanting to find that mythical creature through 'chance encounters' might take a year, two years, or even longer."
"Moreover, for a complete mythical creature, He has the ability to interfere with this to some extent."
At that time, Klein also thought that if he added the Convergence ability of the "Sefirah Castle" to himself, he might be able to randomly move to the Demonic Wolf's front with the "Staff of the Stars" in one go.
But the problem is that, in that case, the probability of "encountering" Amon's main body would be even greater... much greater, even a standard delivery to the door.
After listening to everyone's discussion, Cattleya, based on some of the Queen's taboos, pondered and said, "Can we use the mythical creature's honorific name to establish contact?"
"The World" slowly shook his head: "With His suspicious personality, He definitely won't respond."
If the Demonic Wolf hadn't been tracked by Amon, this might not be impossible, but now, Amon must have thought of what should be thought of. Under this circumstance, the Demonic Wolf hasn't fallen, which means He must be on guard in this regard.
Hobert, who had been pondering all along, suddenly asked, "Can you obtain something related to Kotar? Such as hair, blood, um, these things may be difficult to obtain, discarded puppets are also acceptable."
"If there's anything that can establish a connection with Him, I can find Him. Moreover, this is using the ability to establish 'connection,' not divination, so it can avoid His anti-divination ability."
"As long as we act fast enough, we can catch Him."
Klein manipulated "The World" and said, "The target is very cautious and won't leave any clues."
After pondering for a moment, Hobert added, "I can apply for a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact. As long as I go to the places where Kotar once appeared, I can find some mystical clues."
The Sealed Artifact he was talking about was "0-76," the Death God's Sword. Even if the prey is more careful, some clues about the prey can be found in the eyes of a Sequence 1 "Hunter."
The other members didn't speak because the abilities of the angel and the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact were beyond their imagination.
Klein was slightly stunned before saying, "I do know the places where the Demonic Wolf once appeared."
Hobert nodded: "I will report this matter to the 'Creator.' You can directly pray to the 'Creator' to use that Sealed Artifact."
"What I want to remind you is that the usage time should not exceed 40 seconds, otherwise, it's easy to be assimilated by that Sealed Artifact."
Klein said, "Okay."
"As long as you can find relevant clues, I will immediately rush to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'…" Hobert said, "No, that's definitely too late."
Kotar's intuition is very sharp. Even if Hobert's search isn't through divination, this Demonic Wolf will definitely be able to sense danger in advance.
If Kotar can't be found within 5 seconds, this operation will definitely end in failure.
So Hobert added, "Let's still prepare according to 'immediate hunting,' and also try whether I can successfully enter the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' using the method I mentioned earlier."
That is to say, Hobert will personally operate the "Death God's Sword," and immediately "connect" after finding the clues!
Klein immediately used "The World" to say, "I will notify you immediately after I'm ready here."
Hobert gave an "Mm" sound.
Then, "The World" said to "The Magician" Fors, "Please help me contact the Abraham family. Just say that I hope to conduct a transaction with them."
Fors first nodded and then asked, "Is it convenient to reveal the content of the transaction?"
"The 'Traveler' potion formula," "The World" said in a flat tone.
This was a backup option for him.
The other members were stunned. This was the first time a potion transaction at the angel level had appeared at the Tarot Gathering.
Fors hesitated for a moment, but thought that she should also force her teacher to face the opportunity presented to them with a more proactive attitude.
So she said, "I will help you contact them."
At this point, the exchange ended.
Because no member initiated a transaction, it automatically entered the free exchange session.
Hobert asked Alger, "In the primeval forest of Sonia Island, have you found any relevant clues?"
Previously, the exploration of the Elven ruins did yield a copy of the "Sea King" Beyonder characteristic, but it was corrupted by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
Hobert then used a clue about a "Cataclysmic Interrer" Beyonder characteristic as a transaction to completely obtain that corrupted "Sea King" Beyonder characteristic.
Alger took a deep breath before saying, "After exploring the Elven ruins, I really saw 'Queen of Calamity' Cohinem in my dream."
"Justice" Audrey was slightly stunned. She already knew that the Sanguine's "Blood Moon Queen" and "Progenitor" had been resurrected one after another. Now, the Elven Queen was also about to be resurrected?
Upon hearing "Queen of Calamity," everyone straightened up and looked at "The Hanged Man."
Alger didn't hide anything: "She promised to give me a copy of the 'Cataclysmic Interrer' Beyonder characteristic, but I have to help Her take something out of the 'Book of Calamity' and, after it appears in the real world in the Western Continent, help Her send it to the Western Continent."
Even "The Fool" straightened up this time. He manipulated "The World" and asked, "The Western Continent?"
Alger confirmed, "Yes, the Western Continent."
Then, he continued, "Currently, according to the 'Queen of Calamity's' guidance, I have obtained what I need."
The other members were stunned. The Tarot Gathering was about to have another demigod!
At this time, Alger said to the head of the bronze long table, "Mr. Fool, I hope to obtain the 'Cataclysmic Interrer' potion formula from you. May I ask what reward I should pay?"
This was also the reason why he dared to publicly announce that he had obtained the Beyonder characteristic because he would soon trade with Mr. Fool, which was equivalent to having a layer of protection.
"You may," Klein had already thought about the reward for the "Cataclysmic Interrer" potion formula: "Secretly cultivate a group of Beyonders loyal to you."
"Of course, based on the principle of equivalent exchange, you can also obtain the 'Sea God Scepter' and the 'Sea King' potion formula from me in the future."
For an "Scholar of Yore," as long as he touches any Sealed Artifact of Grade 1 or below, he can use it whenever he wants in the future. He can completely use the "Sea God Scepter" to cultivate "The Hanged Man."
Alger immediately stood up and said, "I pledge allegiance to Mr. Fool!"
He had long coveted the "Sea God Scepter." Although Mr. Fool said "equivalent exchange," there was no such thing as a transaction for Beyonder characteristics at this level. Basically, they were all gifts from superiors.
Alger was very clear that from now on, he and the forces he cultivated would completely pledge allegiance to The Fool in order to obtain the subsequent Beyonder characteristics and potion formulas.
Hobert sighed from the side: The other members of the Tarot Gathering have also reached the point where they can establish their own organizations.
The other members also successively realized that from today onwards, "The Hanged Man" had completely become a subordinate of Mr. Fool. Then, the organization he would form in the future would also be Mr. Fool's organization.
Cattleya sighed: In the future, Mr. Fool will have more ways to influence the real world, and the Church of the Sea God is also Mr. Fool's organization. I wonder if Mr. Fool will formally establish a church?
After Alger sat down again, Audrey asked the still very excited "Hanged Man," "Mr. Hanged Man, you just said to send things to the 'Western Continent.' Does that mean the Western Continent is about to appear in the world?"
Alger was slightly stunned: "I don't know either."
"However, according to 'Queen of Calamity,' the seal on the Western Continent seems to be loosening."
Therefore, he planned to complete his advancement with the Beyonder characteristics provided by the "Queen of Calamity" first. Anyway, the "Queen of Calamity's" request was to return the things from the "Book of Catastrophes" after the Western Continent appeared.
"Sealed?" Cattleya keenly noticed "The Hanged Man's" wording: "Whose seal?"
Who could completely seal off a continent?
Everyone looked at Mr. Fool, but seeing that Mr. Fool did not intend to explain, they did not continue to discuss this issue.
Klein had obtained clues from the solidified mist outside Moon City and believed that the Western Continent should be sealed by the mysterious Celestial Worthy.
However, the other members believed that "The Fool" was related to the Celestial Worthy, so he felt that it would not be appropriate for him or "The World" to answer this question.
So, he simply did not give any answer.
At this time, Audrey asked again: "Mr. Hanged Man, is the Elven ruins on Sonia Island that you just mentioned the ruins you explored with Mr. Emperor before?"
Although Audrey and Hobert often met recently, they had no chance to talk about it alone.
"It's not." Alger glanced at Hobert, and seeing that he did not object to disclosing the information about that exploration, he continued: "The ruins explored before were on the west side of the Berserk Sea, already close to the Fog Sea…"
He briefly talked about the exploration experience at that time. When they heard about the deserted island and the cannibals, the feeling of maritime adventure filled everyone's minds, making the members who had no adventure experience at sea yearn for it.
But after the subsequent experience, everyone couldn't yearn for it anymore. Those cannibals turned out to be crew members of the Intis Republic! And their captain turned into a half-plant, half-human creature, which sounded strange and disgusting.
Alger was not very clear about what happened after rescuing the trapped people, so everyone looked at "The Emperor" again.
Hobert briefly talked about the subsequent experience, and finally, He concluded: "In the future, everyone should be careful when encountering such ruins. Either the Beyonder characteristics inside have already been taken away, and the person who took them away may even leave some curses or traps.
"Or they will be targeted by some hidden existences, and it is easy to be corrupted."
Leonard smiled and said: "Fortunately, there are not many such ruins."
Emlyn suddenly said: "I heard that there is an ancient ruin in the Balchis Mountains in the western part of Backlund. It is said that there is a mysterious power that can make people stronger, and there are many ancient vengeful spirits inside."
Hobert recalled that the ruins seemed to be related to the "Chaos Sea", so He said: "My suggestion is to pretend not to know and consider exploring after becoming a demigod."
Emlyn smiled: "Of course I won't go."
He said that just now to refute Mr. Star. Ever since the "protective custody" was played out by the two of them, the two would take the opportunity to ridicule each other whenever they had a chance.
Cattleya then asked "The Emperor": "Is the influence of Outer Gods on the real world already very serious?"
"With the orthodox churches present, it won't be too serious." Hobert said: "But their influence should indeed attract everyone's attention.
"As far as I know, the 'Rose School' is currently the force of the Outer God 'Mother Tree of Desire', so everyone should be careful with organizations related to the 'Mother Tree of Desire' except for the 'Temperance School'.
"Other organizations that we are familiar with seem to have nothing to do with the Outer Gods."
He paused and then said: "Another thing to pay attention to is the Boon recipients we mentioned before.
"If you encounter a suspected Boon recipient, investigate if you don't have urgent matters.
"If the investigation confirms that the other party is indeed a Boon recipient, just give me the location, and I will take care of them."
The other members realized that "The Creator" regarded the Outer Gods as huge enemies, or rather, any normal god would firmly resist the Outer Gods and their forces.
Leonard then asked "The Emperor": "What should be done with those sirens who have already believed in the Outer Gods?"
"I have already informed the Storm Church and the Eternal Blazing Sun Church about this matter, and I believe they will continue to follow up on this matter." Hobert smiled.
As a senior member of the Tarot Club, how could he not use the special skill of "reporting".
Leonard was slightly stunned, which was somewhat beyond his expectations, but considering that "The Creator" had almost no power at sea, such an operation was not difficult to understand.
Klein manipulated "The World" and asked: "The Beyonder characteristic in the 'Mother of Sea Monsters' must have been corrupted, right? How did you solve that corruption?"
"It was indeed corrupted." Hobert said: "Currently, there is no way to solve such corruption, it can only be sealed."
Klein was stunned: "'The Creator' also…"
Originally, he wanted to ask "'The Creator' also can't solve it?", but thinking that this seemed obvious, and this question sounded like he was questioning "The Creator", he stopped asking halfway.
However, Hobert took the initiative to say: "That's right, 'The Creator' also can't solve it. As far as I know, no god in the current real world can solve that corruption."
Hearing this, everyone felt a chill down their spines!
"Unsolvable corruption" sounded very terrifying.
Emlyn couldn't help but ask: "Why is this happening?"
"Because 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' is very special among the Outer Gods." Hobert explained vaguely: "Only existences at the level of Outer Deities can possibly remove Her corruption."
Although other Outer Deities corruption also have such requirements, for people like Klein and Hobert who can mobilize the power of Sefirah, the corruption outside the Pillars can be transferred to other things through some clever methods.
Although it is said that it cannot be solved, there is still a lot of room for manipulation.
The corruption of the Pillars does not even have such room for manipulation.
Cattleya suddenly said: "This suddenly reminds me of the corruption suffered by Emperor Roselle, that is to say, even if the Great Emperor is resurrected, he will still be corrupted by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity', right?"
"To be precise, unless there is help from other Outer Deities, the corruption on Roselle's body cannot be removed at all." Hobert said:
"We even speculate that Roselle may have realized that the corruption was appearing in his body again, so he did not complete the resurrection process."
Hearing this news, Cattleya was a little nervous, a little excited, and finally a little helpless.
The other members were a little surprised. They didn't expect this question to involve Emperor Roselle!
Klein manipulated "The World" and asked: "Are you suspecting that Roselle avoided being completely corrupted, so he trapped himself in the last mausoleum?"
"It is very possible." Hobert said seriously: "This is also the most reasonable explanation."
Cattleya quickly asked: "How can we help Emperor Roselle completely remove the corruption?"
"Pray!" Hobert said.
"Pray to whom?"
"Not praying to anyone." Hobert took a deep breath: "Pray that 'The Creator' or Mr. Fool will recover to their full strength as soon as possible."
Alger felt a sudden throb in his heart: That is to say, "The Creator" and "The Fool" were both previously at the level of Great Old Ones!
Although he had already guessed this, he was still a little excited to suddenly confirm his guess.
The other members had similar thoughts to Alger. At the beginning, everyone thought that Mr. Fool was a god. Ever since "The Emperor" said that Mr. Fool was the Celestial Worthy, everyone knew that Mr. Fool was originally Great Old Ones.
And the alliance between "The Creator" and Mr. Fool turned out to be a cooperation between two Great Old Ones!
Cattleya was surprised for a few seconds before taking a deep breath and saying: "I understand."
She noticed that many of the information exchanged just now could be brought to the real world.
In order to avoid misunderstandings, Cattleya asked: "Can I tell others the information just now? Um, just tell one person outside the Tarot Club."
Hobert spread his hands: "I have no objection."
The Fool at the head of the bronze table did not express his position, which meant he acquiesced.
Cattleya smiled and said: "Thank you."
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Leonard asked Hobert: "I just heard that the Duchy of Southern Balam once helped the Kingdom of Loen defend Pritz Harbor? And successively resisted three attacks by the main fleet of the Feysac Empire?"
Emlyn was slightly stunned: "Is there such a thing?"
Hobert replied: "That's right, otherwise, why do you think the Loen royal family would be willing to move those universities to the Duchy of Southern Balam?"
Because this transaction has ended, it can be announced at the Tarot Club.
The other members except Audrey and Fors understood. So this was the transaction between the Kingdom of Loen and the Duchy of Southern Balam!
Before, they were still wondering why the Loen royal family would be willing to move those first-class universities to the affiliated country when the war was still far away from Backlund?
"I understand." Leonard nodded. He had some guesses when he got this information, and today he asked to confirm it.
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Cattleya started a new topic: "I got a message that someone encountered the 'Sanguine Ancestor' on Oravi Island!"
Emlyn immediately leaned forward: "We have also received similar news. If you have a channel, please help us inquire. We will definitely reward you handsomely."
He heard that after getting this news, Duke Olmer of the Sanguine had already taken people to Oravi Island, but he has not found any clues about the "Ancestor" so far.
Cattleya nodded: "I will pay attention to it for you."
Alger said: "Could it be that someone is impersonating the 'Sanguine Ancestor'?"
He spread his hands: "Otherwise, after Her revival, why didn't She seek out the members of the Sanguine? Instead, She appeared on an island in the Berserk Sea."
Emlyn frowned. Many within the Sanguine harbored similar doubts.
"The 'Sanguine Ancestor' has indeed been resurrected," Hobert said at this moment with a very certain tone.
"Really? Mr. Emperor?" Emlyn felt a sudden jolt at this point: "The Ancestor, could it be that you've captured the Ancestor as well?"
Hobert had a 'previous record' on this issue.
"That's the 'Sanguine Ancestor.'" Hobert smiled: "How could I possibly capture Her?"
He said: "When your Ancestor was resurrected, I was by Her side, so I can tell you with certainty that She has indeed been resurrected!"
The other members were all stunned. The resurrections of both the "Blood Moon Queen" and the "Sanguine Ancestor" were encountered by the "Emperor." Could this be a coincidence?
Emlyn was also stunned for a moment before asking: "Then the Ancestor, why hasn't the Ancestor contacted our Sanguine?"
"You'll know this later." Hobert said: "In the upcoming Beyonder war, you should be able to encounter your Ancestor, because She has agreed to help me deal with the 'Rose School of Thought.'"
Emlyn stood up excitedly, then sat down, then stood up again: "I understand, I understand."
Then he asked several questions about Lilith, all of which Hobert brushed off, saying he didn't know.
After this topic ended, no new topic was started for more than ten seconds, so Klein announced the end of the gathering.
Hobert returned to the real world, sat in the chair by his desk, and just as he stretched, he heard the butler, Corliss, outside: "Duke, a Mr. Medici is looking for you and has been waiting in the living room for more than ten minutes."
Hobert thought he had misheard: "Med-what?"
