chapters.title: Chapter 695 - 691: Red Angel Medici's Art of Command
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert confirmed it again; Medici was indeed visiting him!
In that instant, Hobert wondered if Medici had contacted Adam or Amon to eliminate him.
But he quickly calmed down. Although he was well aware that Adam and Amon could easily cooperate with Medici, from Medici's perspective, the two brothers had severely betrayed him in the Fourth Epoch, making it unlikely he would proactively contact them.
Thinking of this, Hobert immediately entered the "Nation of Disorder" and used his true vision to examine the Duke's mansion, finding nothing amiss.
He then looked at the Duke's mansion's living room, where a young man with Southern Continent blood was sitting with his legs crossed, leaning on the sofa, waiting.
Apart from the red flag-like mark on his forehead, this young man looked ordinary.
Hobert recalled that Sauron Einhorn Medici seemed to be hiding within a "Gatekeeper" at this time.
Returning to the real world, Hobert fell into deep thought: Why is this guy suddenly looking for me?
It was like a well-known movie star, whom Hobert didn't know, suddenly knocking on his door—magical.
But soon, after completely calming down, Hobert understood the reason: Medici was after the "Conqueror" characteristic!
Although Medici currently only had the strength of Sequence 3 or so, because no new gods or Kings of Angels had appeared in this pathway, his position was still very high. Even as an evil spirit, he could attract the "Blasphemy Card" of the "Red Priest" pathway to him.
Such a high-ranking individual should have sensed the emergence of the "Conqueror" characteristic and followed the clues to find him.
Hobert smiled: So, Medici is looking for me, likely to engage in some kind of cooperation, or perhaps to join the "Creator"?
Thinking of this, Hobert prepared to meet this "Red Angel".
Hobert was currently at Sequence 2, capable of subduing Medici at any time. Even if Medici had found strong reinforcements, as an angel, escaping wouldn't be a problem.
So, Hobert went to the living room and smiled at Medici, "I didn't expect to meet a legendary figure today."
Medici also stood up: "Are you mocking me, that a former legendary figure has fallen to such a state?"
"You…" Hobert suddenly laughed: "You are a good 'Hunter'."
He gestured for Medici to sit down, and after sitting down himself, asked, "Let's not waste each other's time; let's get straight to the point. What brings you here to me?"
Medici crossed his legs again: "To help you destroy the Highlands Kingdom."
Hobert smiled: "Do you have such ability?"
"I just researched the three wars you initiated before and found two problems," Medici said confidently and arrogantly, "None of the 'Creator's' subordinates, including you, understand true Beyonder warfare.
"Such a good hand of cards has been repeatedly ruined by you. The reason you won the previous wars was not because you were so powerful, but because your opponents were even more trash.
"People like Katarina of the 'Demoness Sect' and Kleist of the "Rose School of Thought"—I had never even heard of these trash during the Fourth Epoch."
He sighed: "The current Beyonder warfare is as ridiculous as children playing house."
The expression of that sigh was just right. Hobert felt as if he was being mocked to his face and took a deep breath to avoid arguing with this guy.
Medici continued: "The second problem is that none of the 'Creator's' subordinates can coordinate the battle!
"You should be focused on confronting the enemy's angels with your angels, instead of having to fight angels and worry about the battle situation.
"The final result is that you didn't kill any angels and even allowed the enemy's main force to retreat calmly.
"If I were the commander of this war, I would have died of anger on the spot without anyone harming me!
"Especially the recently concluded Rockville City campaign, which you turned into a 'piecemeal tactic'. Heh heh, you guys are really great!"
Hobert glanced at Medici, this time automatically filtering out Medici's mockery, because he had also discovered this problem during the post-war review: He was exhausted on the battlefield, but the final results were unsatisfactory.
He pondered for a few seconds before saying, "Let's talk in my study."
Medici revealed a confident smile. He was very good at pinpointing the "essentials".
For the past month or so, he had been collecting information in the Southern Balam Duchy and Longtail Island, and eventually, he realized that Hobert was a very practical person.
As long as he made himself look useful, he would have the opportunity to join the 'Creator's' forces.
As for Medici's purpose, he certainly wouldn't mention it proactively.
Arriving at the study, Hobert took out a brand-new map of the south-central part of the Southern Continent: "How should we deploy the war to unify the southern part of the Southern Continent?"
"Is there even a need for deployment?" Medici sneered, "Just station two hundred Beyonders under the city of Mendosa, and the Beyonders from the Intis Republic and the Eternal Blazing Sun Church will retreat on their own."
Currently, there are still two colonies in the southern part of the Southern Balam Duchy. One is Akon Prefecture, a colony of the Intis Republic, with Mendosa as its capital.
The other is the Salto region, ruled by a noble of the Bayam Empire, a proxy supported by the Loen Kingdom.
"As for the Salto region," Medici said, "Just send one of the four elite teams under your command, plus two thousand soldiers, and you can occupy it without any war."
Speaking of this, he spread his hands: "I know that you have no intention of attacking these two colonies now. Since the end of the civil war, you have been preparing to attack the Highlands Kingdom.
"Even though you have successively sent heavy troops to confront the Intis Republic and the Feysac Empire, that's just for show, or rather, to paralyze the "Rose School of Thought".
"Your real purpose is to take advantage of their unpreparedness and eliminate the main force of the Highlands Kingdom gathered at the Longdoro Pass."
Hobert smiled and asked: "What evidence do you have for your guess?"
Medici raised his head and said: "The main force of the 'Temperance Faction' has always been placed in Angel City by you. This will definitely be the most active force in the war with the Highlands Kingdom.
"This alone is enough to prove that you plan to launch a surprise attack on Longdoro Pass when the time is right.
"If you didn't plan to do this, placing the 'Temperance Faction' in Angel City would be a huge waste. With your excellent coordination skills, you certainly wouldn't sit idly by and allow such a waste."
Hobert smiled: "Not bad."
Then, he sat on the chair and thought for two or three seconds before saying, "I know that your purpose is the Beyonder characteristic of the 'Conqueror'.
"But I have no authority to decide the use of that Beyonder characteristic, but I can report our conversation today to the 'Creator'. Whether you can impress the 'Creator' depends on your performance.
"If you think this is too demeaning for yourself, I'll pretend this conversation never happened."
Medici said relatively euphemistically: "I came here to make up for your shortcomings."
Hobert nodded: "Then tell me your thoughts on attacking the Highlands Kingdom."
"In my opinion, the war should be divided into two parts. The first part…" Speaking of war, Medici spoke eloquently.
Hobert listened and realized Medici's role: He brought the mindset of Beyonder warfare!
Although Archibald was very familiar with war, he was familiar with conventional warfare. Before the South Colson campaign, he had never commanded a purely Beyonder war.
Hobert realized this, which is why he chose to command the civil war in the Southern Balam Duchy himself, but his command level was also unsatisfactory, only able to avoid making mistakes as much as possible.
Medici's battle plan made Hobert realize that Beyonder warfare was completely different from conventional warfare, and the entire North and South Continents had not experienced large-scale Beyonder warfare for more than a thousand years, and the commanders had already forgotten how to fight extraordinary wars.
William I and the first emperor of the Feysac Empire, those old guys, should be relatively familiar with Beyonder warfare, but currently, they are fighting each other on the battlefield in the Northern Continent.
This made Hobert not encounter any decent opponents until today, so until now, the 'Creator's' team has not even had a sufficient understanding of Beyonder warfare.
After Medici finished speaking his thoughts, Hobert pondered for a moment before saying, "I will strongly recommend you to become the commander of the upcoming war."
Medici took a deep breath: "Thank you."
Then, Hobert said straightforwardly: "But before that, I want to ask you a few questions about the Third and Fourth Epochs."
Medici smiled: "You know a lot of secret information!"
He replied: "In the Third Epoch, there was only Solomon, an angel of the 'Black Emperor' pathway.
"Before he became an angel, he wasn't called Solomon. I don't even know what his name was. It was because he became an angel of this pathway that the Lord bestowed upon him the surname of Solomon."
Speaking of this, Medici explained: "In the Third Epoch, only those who had made great contributions would be granted a surname by the Lord.
"Like Abraham, like Solomon."
Hobert gave an "oh" sound. He had some impression of this matter, because Abraham and Solomon were both famous surnames in the Common Era, so these two surnames must have a great connection with the Ancient Sun God.
He sat in the chair behind his desk and asked, "What merit did He establish to be granted a surname?"
"Didn't I just say? Because He was promoted to an angel."
Hobert understood, "Because He was promoted to an angel, achieving a certain goal of the Ancient Sun God?"
"Yes." Medici sat opposite Hobert. "I'm not very clear on the specifics. I only know that it seems to have thwarted a certain conspiracy of 'The Fool'.
"Before that, these two pathways really hadn't produced any angels, but from then on, some angels of the 'Black Emperor' and 'Justiciar' pathways quickly appeared."
Hobert pinched his chin and pondered: My previous guess was in the right direction. There were no gods of the two pathways in the Third Epoch. It was an important part of Celestial Worthy's plan, but it was destroyed by the ancient Sun God…
He suddenly thought: Perhaps the ancient Sun God's destruction of this plan was also part of Celestial Worthy's plan! Otherwise, in the Fourth Epoch, Trunsoest wouldn't have been able to find and enter the 'Fallen City' so easily.
After a brief thought, Hobert asked again, "In the Fourth Epoch, were you corrupted by the 'City of Calamity'?"
This time, Medici was somewhat surprised: "How do you know about the 'City of Calamity'?"
Hobert smiled and said, "The great 'Creator' told me."
Medici suddenly became much more serious. He replied, "Yes, after I read the second 'Blasphemy Slate', I did have plans to search for the 'City of Calamity'.
"But before I had time to actively search for it, one day, the 'City of Calamity' suddenly affected me!"
Hobert asked curiously, "Why would that be?"
Regarding this point, Hobert felt that Medici's words were relatively credible. After all, the normal process is to search for the Sefirah after becoming a god. At that time, Medici was still a King of Angels, so there was no reason to actively search for the 'City of Calamity' without being certain.
Medici replied, "I did some investigation. It seems to be related to a plan of Badheil, but I didn't completely figure it out before I was killed."
"God of Combat?" Hobert was a little strange.
If the Primordial Moon was causing some trouble, he wouldn't be surprised at all, but why the God of Combat…
Hobert suddenly thought of the relationship between the "Darkness, Death, Twilight" and "Hunter, Demoness" pathways: Could it be that the God of Combat, Badheil, had ulterior motives at the time, wanting to jump to the "Hunter" or "Demoness" pathway?
Thinking about it this way, it's not impossible. After all, the adjacent pathways of the God of Combat Badheil at that time all had True Gods, and becoming a Great Old One was a distant prospect.
And the "Hunter" and "Demoness" pathways still had some room for maneuver. There was no True God in the "Hunter" pathway at that time, and the "Demoness" pathway only had a True God when the "War of the Four Emperors" reached the middle stage.
In the God of Combat's view, it was at least better than the pathway he was in at the time.
But the question is, how would He "jump"? If he directly "devoured" the Beyonder characteristics of those two pathways, it would probably be similar to how the Underworld Emperor forcibly fused with the Uniqueness of the "Hunter" pathway, at least half-mad.
"Darkness, Death, Twilight" and "Hunter, Demoness" are not strictly adjacent pathways. It seems that there is no problem in exchanging pathways before accommodating the Uniqueness of the pathway, but after accommodating the Uniqueness, the nature is different.
Medici didn't answer, but waited for Hobert to think for a few seconds before smiling, "My guess is similar to yours."
Hobert didn't continue to dwell on this issue, but asked again, "Do you know that Tudor once built nine mausoleums in order to become a 'Black Emperor'?"
"I know."
"Tell me your impression of these nine mausoleums."
"Oh? Is 'Creator' preparing to become a god?" Medici had no respect for gods.
Hobert coldly said, "When you should know, I will let you know."
"Okay." Medici recalled for a moment before saying, "At that time, Abraham mainly helped Tudor build the mausoleum. These two guys were ambitious and easily came together.
"I found two mausoleums based on some clues… Yes, some clues. Don't underestimate the ability of a 'Hunter' to find clues.
"One of them had already been built, and the feeling it gave was that it represented Tudor in a certain sense, or rather, an avatar of Him.
"I guessed that at that time, Tudor had already established a connection with the completed mausoleum, and some of the people's faith in Tudor was transferred to the mausoleum. This seemed to make the mausoleum become a huge anchor for Tudor."
Hobert slowly nodded: This is not difficult to understand, after all, the mausoleum is meant to stabilize the state in the real world during advancement.
To achieve this effect, it is necessary to establish a certain connection between oneself and the mausoleum in advance, so that the prayers of the subjects can be transmitted to oneself through the mausoleum.
This is like using the mausoleum as a "repeater tower", so that the mausoleum can accumulate enough connection with the "Black Emperor".
Hobert didn't continue to think about it. He said to Medici, "Come find me again in three days. By then, the pre-war preparations will be basically completed. We will go to the Southern Balam Duchy together."
…
Late February. For the south-central part of the Southern Continent, summer is over and the weather is starting to turn cooler.
This morning, the "Rose School of Thought" demigod Mahmosi, who was responsible for confronting the Southern Balam Duchy at the Longdoro Pass, received accurate intelligence: The Beyonder forces of the Southern Balam Duchy suddenly gathered in Angel City!
This was somewhat unexpected, after all, judging from the posture previously displayed by the Southern Balam Duchy, it seemed that they were preparing to eliminate the weaker enemies in the south first to eliminate future troubles.
This is also the best tactic, which can effectively avoid fighting on two fronts.
The higher-ups of the "Rose School of Thought" had even decided that when the main force of the Southern Balam Duchy marched south, they must go south to harass the Southern Balam Duchy and try to delay their time to unify the south.
Who knew that the main force of the Southern Balam Duchy would gather in Angel? This city is biased towards the north, and it can almost be concluded that they are going to attack the Highlands Kingdom.
Although this news was very sudden, under Mahmosi's order, several extraordinary fortresses were put on alert.
Their extraordinary defense line has been built for more than a hundred years, but it was previously to guard against the Loenese. After so many years of construction, this defense line is very strong. Even if the enemy gathers twice their strength, they may not be able to break through.
However, more than half an hour after Mahmosi and the others were on alert, they received new news that a large number of Southern Balam Duchy Beyonders had appeared in the north of the defense line!
Mahmosi was not panicked by this. They had long envisioned such a situation, where the enemy appeared behind the defense line through some means, attempting to disintegrate the defense line from another direction.
Therefore, the defense line was built with double-sided defenses, so as not to give the enemy a chance!
But after another half an hour, the new news began to make Mahmosi panic. The enemy was advancing towards the capital!
They actually ignored this unbreakable defense line and went straight to the capital!
Immediately afterwards, Mahmosi realized that he had to report to his superiors immediately, because at this time, most of the "Rose School of Thought's" power was at the Longdoro Pass. If they were allowed to ignore them, they might really capture the capital.
But if they chased now, they would have to abandon the defense line, and they did not have an advantage in the number of Beyonders.
While hesitating, Mahmosi used prayer to report the current situation to the angels of the "Rose School of Thought".
…
At this time, on the road from Longdoro Pass to the capital, Medici, riding his horse unhurriedly, shouted, "Idiots! Are there mad dogs chasing you from behind? Why are you running so fast?"
This time, Hobert gathered four units led by four trusted subordinates, Angus and others, as well as the "Temperance Faction" led by Sharron, the power of the Sanguine, and a portion of the military's Beyonders, totaling more than 380 Beyonders.
In this battle, this part of the force, from demigods to "low-sequence" Beyonders, was to be controlled by Medici.
Regarding this point, everyone had expressed different opinions at the beginning, but after Hobert introduced Medici in detail, everyone had no objections.
Even if they hadn't heard of the name "Red Angel", they knew what the former King of Angels meant.
So at this time, even if Medici's words were very harsh, everyone was just glaring at each other, but no one refuted him.
Just as the marching speed slowed down, a group of Beyonders appeared in front to block them.
Just as the "Temperance Faction" at the front was about to set up a defensive formation, Medici rode forward, "Are you blind? Can't you see the panicked expressions on the enemy's faces?
"Charge over! Idiots, aren't you planning to take the merits that are delivered to your door?"
This group of Beyonders who came to block them had obviously rushed over in a hurry after receiving orders.
After seeing so many enemies, it was certain that they were panicked.
Just as Medici said, the enemy collapsed as soon as the "Temperance Faction" charged over.
Facing the scattered and fleeing enemies, just as the Beyonders of Southern Balam were about to chase, Medici shouted again in a voice that everyone could hear, "You are the stupidest subordinates I have ever met!
"Can't you see that this is the enemy trying to disperse our strength?
"Maintain formation! Idiots! You don't need to chase, they will come to die again!"
Several werewolves and zombies of the "Temperance Faction" were so angry at Medici's words that their faces turned red. They almost lost their minds and were about to rush over and fight Medici, but they were stopped by Sharron.
Commanders at Sharron's level already understood the cleverness of Medici's operation.
It wasn't just a sudden attack; it disrupted the enemy's arrangements.
At this moment, Medici seemed to wield a magical baton, directing not only his own forces but also 'directing' the enemy.
In other words, no matter how the "Rose School of Thought" responded, the war's trajectory would favor the Beyonder forces of the Southern Balam Republic.
Before setting out, Hobert had spoken with commanders like Sharron, saying, "Although Medici is good at 'provoking,' if fewer subordinates die, it's okay to be scolded by him."
The commanders all agreed with Hobert's statement, so they were mentally prepared not to argue with Medici.
As Medici had anticipated, the fleeing enemies quickly regrouped and, together with newly arrived reinforcements, launched another suicidal charge.
This time, without Medici's reminder, Sharron immediately ordered a charge.
But Medici's voice rang in their ears again: "Are your brains in your asses? Even if the enemy is stupid, they won't use so few people to hinder us again!
Defensive formation! All demigods forward! They must have a scheme!"
Sharron, wearing a court dress, took two deep breaths to calm herself. Since becoming a 'Puppet,' this was the first time she had the urge to curse!
Just as the 'Temperance Faction' formed a defensive formation, a Sanguine demigod at the front of the line said, "There's an evil power in their bodies!"
Angus immediately shouted, "No running here!"
The "Rose School of Thought" members who were rushing over immediately slowed to a fast walk. At this point, everyone noticed that these people looked very pained, and something was indeed wrong.
Several 'Imperative Mages' worked together to 'imprison' them twenty meters away. Not long after being imprisoned, the "Rose School of Thought" members exploded one by one in place.
Their flesh and blood instantly turned into a blood mist, and the vegetation on both sides of the road was immediately cursed. Some turned black and died, some turned into powder, and some mutated into monsters.
A 'Puppet' from the 'Temperance Faction' coldly said, "Source of the curse!"
The "Rose School of Thought" demigods first cursed their own people and then planned to use their own people to spread the curse.
Fortunately, they hadn't charged forward, otherwise, the 'Temperance Faction' would have suffered heavy losses.
So everyone looked at Medici with admiration or worship.
The guy just twitched his lips and shouted, "Don't look at me with such disgusting eyes! 'Puppets' and 'Disciples of Silence' of the 'Temperance Faction,' what are you waiting for?
Don't tell me only the enemy knows 'Source of Curses'? Go to the front and eliminate the curses on the road, don't hinder the advance!"
Everyone's admiration and worship disappeared without a trace.
The extraordinary troops continued to advance. After another ten minutes or so, Medici suddenly raised his hand: "Immediately hide in the woods on the left!"
Everyone now acted like they had a conditioned reflex, immediately executing Medici's order.
Just as they entered the woods, Hobert's figure suddenly appeared on the road. He slightly raised his hand, and the barrier between the real world and the spirit world in front of him fell into chaos.
Whoosh~
The sudden appearance of the spirit world stirred up a hurricane, blowing trees and preventing everyone from opening their eyes.
"If you don't want to die, get through the battlefield of angels as soon as possible!" Medici shouted: "'Dawn Army,' don't run in the wrong direction. 'Blaze Army,' pay attention to formation. You're fighting a war, not herding sheep!"
At this time, Hobert had already used 'Distortion' to pull Kleist out of the spirit world.
Kleist's injuries from the last war hadn't healed yet, and he looked even older now. Originally, he had planned to observe the Beyonders of the Southern Balam Republic in the spirit world, but he didn't expect to be noticed by that commander on horseback, who quickly summoned Hobert.
The old man's first reaction when he saw Hobert was to run away immediately, but it was too late. The spirit world behind him was already blocked by a thick coffin.
Hobert reached out and pulled three times, summoning the 'Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch' in the shape of a giant eye, the 'Holy Infant King' in the shape of a fetus, and the 'Duke of Entropy' in the image of a shadowy woman from the 'Nation of Disorder.'
Finally, Raymond, in the shape of a fire man, arrived, and Beverly in the spirit world immediately opened the coffin lid and planted the 'Tree of Order.' The siblings immediately returned to their peak state.
Kleist was a little dumbfounded. He was actually being besieged by six angels! Was that necessary?
Raymond manifested a 'Blazing White Spear' in each of his hands and stabbed at Kleist.
Kleist barely dodged, but at the same time, the 'Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch' 'reproduced' a person sitting on a chair with Southern Continent-style carvings, wearing a golden mask with a phoenix pattern on his face.
The appearance of this image seemed to give Kleist's spirit body some kind of command, and he couldn't move.
The 'Holy Infant King' opened his mouth and let out a murmur that directly struck Kleist's spirit body.
Hobert, Beverly, and the 'Duke of Entropy' used the abilities of 'Frenzy,' 'Exploit,' and 'Magnification,' respectively.
Kleist had no room to dodge and fell into a state of 'Frenzy.'
Beverly's 'Exploit' ability was to return the 'Blazing White Spear' in Raymond's hand to him.
Raymond's 'Blazing White Spear' just now was a feint. Now, taking advantage of Kleist's 'Madness,' he thrust out the 'Blazing White Spear' and used the ability of 'Cull.'
At this time, the 'Magnification' of the 'Duke of Entropy' happened to fall on Kleist, immediately making the 'Ancient Bane's' injuries life-threatening.
At this time, the 'Masked Man' summoned by the 'Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch' waved his hand at Kleist, and Kleist's body immediately lost all vital signs.
But because this pathway has the sequence of 'Wraith,' after reaching the angel level, only the soul can survive, but it loses the opportunity to continue to advance.
Hobert and the others' second round of attacks began. Kleist's spirit body still hadn't escaped the 'Frenzy.' After Hobert and Beverly's 'Magnification' and 'Tampering,' Kleist had a hard time recovering his state for a while.
Raymond was still the first to attack. He pulled out a long sword with rust and blood stains from his chest and cut Kleist's spirit body in half with one sword.
Raymond's sword could still attack spirit bodies.
After that, everyone used the ability to attack spirit bodies. The 'Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch' 'reproduced' a phoenix, pecking and scratching Kleist's spirit body.
Large swaths of spirit body were torn from Kleist's body and dissipated in the surrounding air.
The 'Holy Infant King' opened his eyes, and a head grew out of Kleist's back. This head looked exactly like Kleist, but with a sinister smile, he lowered his head and began to tear at the spirit body.
Under their attack, Kleist's spirit body quickly fell apart.
Until the end of his life, Kleist woke up from the 'Frenzy.'
He said "No" with a face full of unwillingness, and then completely dissipated.
Hobert accelerated the extraction of the other party's Beyonder characteristics and quickly obtained the first angel-level trophy of this battle.
Then Beverly took back the 'Tree of Order,' and the siblings disappeared from the spirit world.
Hobert then ordered three angel-level tool people to return to the 'Nation of Disorder' to stand by, and he himself left the battlefield.
From Hobert's appearance to killing an angel and then everyone's retreat, the entire battle did not exceed 10 seconds!
During this period, another angel of the "Rose School of Thought" also appeared, but Barranca, wearing a Southern Continent-style wizard robe, glanced at the battlefield and immediately left.
Even if he asked the 'Abomination' Suah to take action, it would have been too late, and if he left a second later, he might have been entangled, so he simply chose to flee the battlefield.
In any case, Hobert's round of siege caught people a little off guard. At least the higher-ups of the "Rose School of Thought" hadn't reacted yet, and they had lost an angel.
After the end of this angel-level battle, under Medici's loud orders, the Beyonders began to advance towards Yason again.
"Do you have foot bindings wrapped around your feet?" Medici's annoying voice rang out again: "An eighty-year-old woman runs faster than you!
Advance quickly! Strive to eat dinner under the city of Yason!"
If it were a regular army, this request would be a bit whimsical, but this was an extraordinary force, and a day was enough for them to reach the city of Yason.
Many Beyonders wanted to ask Medici: Didn't you just say to walk slower? Why are you in such a hurry now? If you're really in such a hurry, why not pray for power from the 'Creator' and ask the Creator to send everyone to their destination?
But the officers, such as Angus, basically understood Medici's intentions.
At first, Medici wasn't in a hurry to advance because he was observing whether the extraordinary force he commanded had attracted the attention of the higher-ups of the 'Rose School.'
Since the "Rose School of Thought" had even dispatched angels, it meant that they had received the other party's high regard.
Then, speeding up the pace of advancement at this time was to give the enemy greater psychological pressure, to make them send people to stop them as soon as possible, to make them send people to chase them as soon as possible.
If they want to choose to defend to the death, then I'm very sorry, this force is enough to take down Yason City!
In any case, the initiative of the war is in their hands!
This is a very wonderful feeling. It always feels like they haven't fought any fierce battles, they've just been running on the road, but victory is in sight.
The "Rose School of Thought" was completely mobilized by Medici. Beyonder forces rushed from the surrounding areas to block them, but they were more like mantises trying to stop a chariot. They were immediately defeated in a single charge, not given any time to organize an effective resistance.
At noon, the Beyonders of the Duchy of Southern Balam even leisurely ate lunch and took turns resting before continuing their rapid march towards Yason City.
At this time, the "Rose School of Thought" finally couldn't sit still any longer and transferred their main force from the Longdoro Pass in the spirit world to block their advance.
The two sides encountered each other on a grassland, but a war did not immediately break out. The reason was that Medici immediately ordered a halt to the march and then told everyone to rest in place for twenty minutes.
Not only was the Duchy of Southern Balam stunned, but the "Rose School of Thought" was also stunned. Their defensive formation was already set up, but the enemy actually started resting right in front of them!
The commander-in-chief of this battle, Mahmosi, felt humiliated, but because of his numerical disadvantage, he could only swallow his anger and wait for the enemy to attack first.
The Duchy of Southern Balam rested for twenty minutes, and the Beyonders' physical strength basically returned to its best state.
"It's time to do something serious!" A long sword with rust and blood stains appeared in Medici's hand: "I was too cautious. I actually thought it would take twenty minutes to see through the enemy's flaws.
"It only took me twenty seconds to formulate a battle plan!"
He shouted loudly: "All Sequence 3s, concentrate behind me and follow me to kill that enemy Sequence 3.
"The 'Temperance Faction' will attack the enemy's left flank and charge towards the edge of the enemy's formation! The 'Sanguine' will attack the enemy's right flank and charge towards the middle of the right flank!
"The other four armies, follow me to attack the enemy's central-left position. Yes, that's the spot! The enemy commander is definitely an idiot, not putting enough ranged attack power in the central position!
"Charge, warriors! The enemy's wails are the most beautiful movement in this world!"
As he spoke, he charged ahead with his sword: "Let us enjoy the joy of charging, hahaha, let us break through the enemy's defenses! Charge! Charge!
"Ah hahaha! Trash, your death is here!"
At this time, Medici seemed a little crazy. It had been too long since he had enjoyed the fun of war. Seeing the enemy's frightened expressions and the enemy commander's panic, he felt as if he had returned to his prime.
Just as Medici said, the central-left position of the "Rose School of Thought's" battle formation was mainly composed of ghouls and werewolves, without enough ranged power.
Medici and his men encountered almost no obstacles and pierced through the enemy formation like a sharp knife!
The "Temperance Faction", charging towards the left flank, caused the enemy to start shrinking their battle line, and the members of the "Temperance Faction" unwittingly outflanked the enemy.
The battle on the right flank also quickly broke out. There were several "low sequence" Beyonders in the front row of the central part of the "Rose School of Thought's" right flank, which was a huge flaw. The agile Sanguine quickly broke the right flank into two parts.
After the battle began, in just over ten seconds, under Medici's command, Angus, Sharron, and Malva, four Sequence 3s, killed Mahmosi, the commander-in-chief of the "Rose School of Thought".
Medici used his long sword to pick up Mahmosi' head: "Trash, look at whose head this is! Hahaha, you are so weak that you are pathetic."
The "Rose School of Thought" immediately became chaotic, and Medici began to command the various units to encircle the enemy.
As the military Beyonders who had not received specific tasks earlier closed the last gap in the encirclement, Medici began to lead his men to traverse within the encirclement, cutting apart the enemy's forces.
At this time, the "Abomination" appeared in the air again, and Barranca also appeared in the distance, trying to rescue a group of "Rose School of Thought" members.
Angels such as Hobert appeared one by one. In addition to the Beverly siblings, Olmer, the Sanguine angel, was also called by Hobert, plus three 'tool' angels.
With the seven angels standing there, the ugly "Abomination" did not even make a move.
If the "Abomination" Suah used His vine again, the "Creator" would consider confronting Him.
And the other six angels were enough to kill Barranca.
Suah and Barranca also realized this, so they just watched for a while and left.
This immediately caused the "Rose School of Thought" members on the battlefield to lose their morale, and the subsequent ten minutes of war was more like a massacre.
The last main force of the "Rose School of Thought" was "transferred" by Medici from the Beyonder fortress and annihilated on this grassland with few casualties.

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 692: The Great Battle between the Enemy and Our Angels
chapters.content:

In the southern part of the Highland Kingdom, Elliot sat by the river, watching his subordinates laugh loudly as they washed the bloodstains from their bodies in the river, a slight daze in his eyes.
The war that ended in the afternoon was won too quickly, almost unbelievably so.
Before Medici's arrival, he had participated in formulating the battle plan to attack the Longdoro Pass, and it was foreseeable that this tough nut to crack would cause a large number of casualties among the Beyonders!
But now the main force of the Longdoro Pass had been wiped out, and Elliot's "Dawn Army" had only lost two men. The total number of deaths in the entire South Balam Duchy's Beyonder forces was less than 20.
Starting from the morning, they had eliminated at least 30 enemies on the road, and in the large-scale battle just now, they had almost annihilated the enemy. When burying the bodies, everyone counted, a total of 186!
This casualty ratio was astonishing.
Hobert emerged from the Spirit World, smiling: "Why don't you go wash up?"
"Duke!" Elliot immediately stood up: "I...I was thinking..."
Hobert followed up: "If Medici had commanded during the civil war, many fewer people would have died, right?"
Elliot took a deep breath: "Yes."
Then he explained: "I'm not saying that the previous command had problems, but after experiencing today's war, I suddenly have a completely new understanding of Beyonder warfare."
Hobert also became serious: "That's a good thing."
Immediately, He took a deep breath and said: "I know that letting Medici command this war will make my previous command look like a fool.
"But He must be allowed to do it. Just like what I said before the war, Medici is a professional at this. Archibald and I are far behind Him."
Elliot smiled: "Fortunately, the Duke is not as pedantic as the nobles of the Northern Continent."
Hobert also smiled: "Alright, prepare to execute the new mission."
He ordered: "Complete the assembly in one hour, and together with the 'Stinger Army', withdraw from the battle sequence and return to the Longdoro Pass in a way that prays for the 'Creator's' help, completely crushing the enemy's Beyonder defense line!"
"Yes!"
...
At dusk, the "Dawn Army" and the "Stinger Army", through the "Creator's" "distortion" of their position, arrived at the Beyonder fortress complex that the "Rose School" had operated for many years in the Longdoro Pass.
The Longdoro Pass is a valley with a width of only a few kilometers at its narrowest point. Passing through it allows direct access to the heart of the Highland Kingdom. If one doesn't take this main road, one must take the rugged and dangerous mountain paths, which would be inconvenient even for Beyonders.
Therefore, the Longdoro Pass became one of the important passages into the Star Highlands. The colonial army of Loen had also fought for it many times, but all ended in failure.
In addition to the regular soldiers' positions, there was also a fortress complex composed of 7 Beyonder fortresses in the pass.
Elliot and Helen's goal was to capture these 7 Beyonder fortresses.
The Beyonder forces stationed in this fortress complex had basically been transferred to participate in the blocking battle in the afternoon. Currently, there were only a few or a dozen Beyonders stationed in each fortress, and their Sequences were not high.
Even so, Hobert was very cautious and launched an attack alone one step ahead of them.
He exuded the majesty of an Angel level, using the method of "distorting" space, and instantly arrived in front of the first fortress, reaching out and touching it, "tampering" with the fortress's mechanical structure, causing this Beyonder fortress to immediately collapse.
At the moment the fortress collapsed, curses flew everywhere, which were the Beyonder traps set up inside the fortress.
These traps were like tickles to Hobert, but to Elliot and the others, they were deadly attacks.
After the first batch of cursed traps was "detonated", Hobert used the ability of "Exploit" to make the remaining traps take effect immediately. With a few "rumbling" sounds, the entire fortress collapsed into a large pit.
Hobert felt that this method was quite good, so he began to use the method of "distorting" space to appear next to other fortresses, "pulling" all the traps inside to explode, killing all the defenders inside.
The defenders were not Hobert's opponents at all. The traps in the fortress could attack "low-Sequence" Beyonders, and even had traps that could attack demigods.
But there were no traps that could harm Angels. Such traps not only required extremely high production costs, but also required extremely high maintenance costs. It was more cost-effective to send one's own Angels to fight against the enemy's Angels.
But the problem now was that the "Rose School's" Angels didn't dare to show their faces at all, so the defenders had to watch helplessly as one fortress after another collapsed.
Soon their psychological defenses were broken, and they ran out of the fortresses to escape for their lives.
Elliot and Helen, who had been waiting outside for a long time, how could they let go of this group of merits?
After the Beyonder fortresses collapsed, the regular positions of the Highland Kingdom also quickly collapsed.
Ordinary soldiers did not know what was going on, but the officers knew what the collapse of those fortresses meant. As soon as the officers ran, Archibald led the regular army to launch artillery fire on the positions, and the Highland Kingdom soldiers also ran with them.
That night, the South Balam Duchy occupied the Longdoro Pass almost without bloodshed. After resting for a night, they divided into two routes and began to occupy the southern cities of the Highland Kingdom.
The "Dawn Army" and the "Stinger Army" followed them respectively, clearing the Beyonder forces along the way.
In fact, there were not many Beyonder forces in various places, because they had all been transferred by the "Rose School" to the direction of Yason City, or rather, they had been "transferred" by Medici.
...
In the war against the main force of the enemy, Medici deliberately let go of a few soldiers, allowing them to go back and spread the news that the last elite of the "Rose School" had been completely annihilated.
Medici led everyone to find a city nearby, and unceremoniously moved into the luxurious manor of the local nobles, not only eating and drinking, but also sleeping with the nobles' women.
After resting for a night, Medici led everyone to pray to the "Creator". The next moment after reciting the prayer, they appeared under Yason City.
"Beyonders of 'Pyromaniac' and above, come forward and prepare to bombard the enemy's city walls!" Medici ordered loudly: "Fireball spell, prepare, release!"
The "Hunter" pathway can manipulate multiple fireballs at Sequence 6, and more than twenty fireballs at Sequence 5. So under Medici's command, hundreds of fireballs smashed towards the city walls of Yason City.
Medici had the corresponding ability to enhance the attacks of Beyonders on the "Hunter" pathway. In this round of attacks, even the attack distance of the Sequence 7 "Pyromaniac's" fireball was strengthened, allowing them to complete the attack on the city wall outside the range of rifles.
Without Medici's enhancement, the Sequence 7 "Fireball" would be difficult to cause limited damage after flying out more than ten meters.
The "Rose School" members who were hastily fighting back used Beyonder powers to block the fireballs in the sky, but still many fireballs smashed into the city walls, smashing out many gaps, killing and wounding many people.
Everyone was about to prepare for the next round of attack, but then Medici waved his hand: "Retreat! Take turns to rest."
The "Rose School" members on the city wall were also stunned. They weren't going to fight anymore?
But they didn't dare to be careless, because they could clearly see the enemies on the city wall resting and guarding, as if they were about to launch a new round of attack in the next second.
Soon, the first batch of Beyonders who came to support the capital arrived. Only demigods of the "Prisoner" pathway could use the Spirit World to reach distant targets.
And most of the "Rose School's" demigods had already died in the previous battles, so this batch of reinforcements was not led by demigods, but came from ordinary roads.
Medici immediately ordered the Sanguine who were guarding to attack, and told them that they could pursue, but they had to end the battle within half an hour.
At the same time, Medici also let Malva's "Gale Army" begin to guard, and soon waited for the next wave of reinforcements.
This time it was the "Gale Army" who attacked, and they were also ordered to end the battle within half an hour.
In fact, this request was a bit redundant, because the number of reinforcements was not large, and the enemy could generally be completely wiped out in ten minutes.
After three waves of reinforcements were wiped out one after another, Zachary, the only remaining "Disciple of Silence" of the "Rose School" in Yason City, realized that the enemy's main target of attack was actually the reinforcements who came to support.
So he ordered all reinforcements to stop supporting.
Half an hour later, Medici, who had been lying on the grass and looked like he had come for a picnic, got up and yawned: "Let's go, let's give them three more rounds of fireballs."
After three rounds of "Fireballs", the city wall of Yason City had been blasted to the point where it was at risk of collapsing, but there was no further attack.
Having completed the bombardment, they didn't rest. Instead, they were divided into three groups and launched surprise attacks along the three major roads leading to the capital, Asong City, quickly ambushing the reinforcements waiting on the roads.
By noon, the three squads had returned to Asong City to await further orders. In just one morning, they had easily eliminated dozens of Beyonders.
These Beyonders were all of relatively low sequence. Incredibly, none of the Beyonders from the Duchy of South Balam had died! The few members who had been injured were saved by the healing properties of Sealed Artifacts.
Zachary watched the enemies leisurely eating lunch below the city walls, feeling extremely annoyed but utterly helpless.
The entire Beyonder force of the Highlands Kingdom was rushing to provide support, but Zachary was well aware that the highest sequence among these reinforcements was only Sequence 5, and the number of 'Wraiths' was limited. Even if they entered the city, their impact would be minimal.
The key was that, currently, the enemy wasn't allowing any reinforcements to enter the city, leaving Zachary feeling somewhat resigned.
In fact, the few remaining high-level members of the 'Rose School of Thought' were already preparing to abandon Asong City.
However, both the 'Rose School of Thought' and the Highlands Kingdom had been operating here for hundreds of years, so they intended to deplete the enemy's forces as much as possible before retreating.
The problem was that the Beyonders of the Duchy of South Balam weren't seriously attacking the city. The defenders had all sorts of skills and ingenious traps within the city, but they couldn't use them!
In the afternoon, the fireball bombardment continued, regularly striking the city walls every hour.
But even when parts of the city walls collapsed, the Beyonders of the Duchy of South Balam didn't actively attack.
After nightfall, the attacks became less frequent, occurring every two hours. Having figured out the pattern, the defenders seized the gaps between attacks to rest.
However, in the latter half of the night, the attacks suddenly became erratic. Often, just as everyone went to rest, a new round of attacks would begin. Other times, they would remain on guard for two or three hours without the enemy launching any attacks.
After a night, the city walls had collapsed even further. Zachary even hesitated whether to continue repairing them.
The enemies outside the city didn't seem to care about the damage their 'fireballs' were causing to the city walls. Repairing them seemed pointless.
A new day began. The Beyonders of the Duchy of South Balam ate breakfast methodically, and even Beyonders of the 'Witch' pathway carefully washed up by the river.
Then, the offensive for the day began, still only bombarding the city walls, but without actively attacking.
This offensive lasted for four or five days, leaving Zachary completely bewildered. Each attack from the South Balam Beyonders seemed like the prelude to a full-scale assault, but each time they would only launch a few rounds of fireballs and then rest for a while.
The 'Disciple of Silence' Zachary, who was defending the city, really couldn't figure out what the people of South Balam were trying to do?
He had already gathered the reinforcements and asked the angel Barranca to send them from the Spirit World into Asong City. The Beyonders of the Duchy of South Balam could no longer ambush the reinforcements, so why weren't they attacking the city?
But Zachary didn't dare to ignore any of the enemy's attacks. If his response was even slightly careless, the entire city wall could be blown down.
It wasn't until the sixth day of the 'siege' when the 'Dawn Army' and the 'Thorn Army,' as well as the two regular armies led by Archibald and Seel, arrived beneath Asong City, that Zachary suddenly realized: He had been tricked again!
On the day Medici 'recommended' himself to the Duke's mansion, He had provided a very clear analysis of this war of annihilation.
First, the purpose of the first phase of the war was to annihilate the enemy's forces and, through the battle for Asong City, to deplete the war potential of the Highlands Kingdom and the 'Rose School of Thought'.
Asong City was, after all, the capital. The enemy couldn't possibly leave without resistance, but once they resisted, it meant concentrating all their war potential in this one city.
This was much simpler than conquering cities one by one later on. It also facilitated the occupation by regular troops and the re-establishment of Beyonder order.
Therefore, Medici's attacks on Asong City for the past four or five days had been giving them time to gather their remaining Beyonder forces into this one city.
At this time, the 'Rose School of Thought' was no match for the Beyonders of the Duchy of South Balam, so they could only defend passively. That was why Medici's siege was so half-hearted.
In fact, at this point, the focus of the war had already shifted to Archibald and Seel, but Zachary didn't have such a war sense and was still continuing to gather forces in Asong City.
Now, the first phase of the war had basically been achieved. The Duchy of South Balam had effectively controlled approximately two-thirds of the territory of the Highlands Kingdom, and Asong City was already surrounded on three sides.
The general assault on Asong City was about to begin.
When Hobert also arrived at the military camp outside Asong City, he immediately convened senior officers to make the final war deployment.
"The angels will complete the final stage of the first phase of the war." At the meeting, Medici said, "The so-called crushing of the enemy's war potential means crushing the potential of the enemy's allies as well."
"For example, during the previous civil war, the Demoness Sect supported the enemy. We have already given the 'Rose School of Thought' about a week to seek help. When the battle for Asong City enters the final stage, the Demoness Sect will definitely send reinforcements."
"Judging from the current situation, the Republic of Intis and the Feysac Empire have not actively launched offensives, indicating that the war in the Northern Continent has tied them down. They cannot gather the manpower of the civil war in a short period of time, so they can be ignored."
"However, the other two enemies, Tamara and Trunsoest, must be considered. As long as the stuff in their heads isn't dog shit, they won't sit idly by while the Duchy of South Balam occupies the Highlands Kingdom."
"These are the two enemies that should be paid attention to on the angel battlefield."
Hobert nodded: "Don't worry, I'm prepared. If the Tamara family and the Trunsoest family participate in the war, just give them a good beating."
Medici suddenly smiled: "I have indeed prepared a greeting gift for these two 'old friends'."
He glanced at the other officers: "Everyone, cheer up. This is the last good opportunity to earn merit!"
With the end of this brief war meeting, everyone went back to make the final pre-war mobilization.
And on the morning of the next day, after a night of rest, the general offensive officially began.
Hobert came to the city wall, which had been unrecognizable after the bombing in the past few days, and grabbed the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" in the form of a giant eye, and asked Him to step on the landmines.
All the eyeballs of the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" looked at the city wall, and suddenly many Beyonders screamed and turned into a stream of information composed of letters, symbols and numbers.
Zachary shouted: "Don't look at the giant eye!"
He realized that the enemy's general offensive was about to begin, but no one had expected that the Duchy of South Balam would use angels as the vanguard.
The "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" "reappeared" the tall and mighty Cyclops, carrying a giant sword and rushing towards the city wall. This was the "Giant King" in attack mode!
His attack stirred up a hurricane, blowing the trees and rocks he passed into the sky.
Just as the Cyclops rushed to the city wall, a huge mirror appeared on the city wall. The "Giant King" was covered in silver light and even broke through the illusory mirror!
But after all, this was the "Giant King" that was "reproduced". After breaking through the mirror, His huge body quickly faded and disappeared into the void.
At the same time, Barranca, wearing a Southern Continent-style wizard robe, appeared in front of the city wall as a tens of meters tall "Ancient Bane". The animals, plants, and even stones around Him were mutated or cursed, turning into monsters or black stones exuding malice.
Hobert immediately pulled the "Holy Infant King" out of the "Nation of Disorder", intending to use Him to besiege Barranca. The "Holy Infant King" in the womb suddenly turned into a rooster!
The ugly "Abomination" Suah appeared in mid-air. The color of His head and one arm was different from the color of the other skin on His body.
This was because He had been injured by the "Creator" in the previous battle and had not fully recovered. However, now that the war had reached this point, He had to take action.
When Suah's gaze turned to Hobert, the "Holy Infant King" immediately returned to His original appearance. After all, He was composed of the power of the "Nation of Disorder", and even the deformation curse of the "Abomination" level could not last long.
Then, Hobert pulled the "Duke of Entropy" out of the "Nation of Disorder" and stood in front of himself.
The "Duke of Entropy" immediately used the "Magnify" ability on Suah, which was the first choice of any "Lawyer." After all, the "Abomination" Suah almost had "My condition is not good" written all over his face!
While connecting to the spirit world to stabilize his condition, Suah entered the "Abomination" state to deal with the "Duke of Entropy" and the "Holy Infant Great King."
If it were another Sequence 1, under Hobert's command, along with these two puppets, they could only hold off the opponent.
However, facing Suah, who was not in good condition, the two of them were enough to hold off the "Abomination" for a while.
Hobert, in the rear, still didn't make a move. He said indifferently, "The second one."
Before the start of the entire war, Hobert and Archibald spent several days deducing the order in which the enemy angels would appear.
At the level of angels, the game is like playing cards. If you can guess in advance what "card" the enemy will play, or the order in which they will "play their cards," you can gain a significant advantage.
The order of the first two had already been guessed correctly, so the third one to appear should be Sherry, the angel of the "Demoness Sect," the "Demoness of Catastrophe."
Sure enough, in the next instant, a ball of black flame ignited under Hobert's feet without warning. He immediately "distorted" the flame onto Barranca over there.
In front of Hobert, two illusory doors suddenly appeared. The Sanguine Duke, Olmer, emerged from the doors. He slightly raised his hand, and the surroundings were shrouded in a crimson moonlight.
Under one of the moonlights, a blurry human figure was outlined. In the next second, two "Summoning Doors" suddenly opened under that figure's feet, and a blood basin-like mouth stretched out from the spirit world, devouring the figure.
But on the side of the big mouth, a mirror suddenly appeared. Sherry jumped out of the mirror, smiling slightly at Olmer.
This smile was indescribably charming. Olmer's eyes were a little dazed, and the big mouth stretching out from the underworld was completely lost in Sherry's beauty, allowing Sherry to freeze it into an ice lump.
While staring at Olmer, Sherry continued to use her "Charm" ability on him, and shot a crystal-like spear at him.
Just as the spear was about to hit Olmer, it suddenly turned crimson and grew four slender legs. The running of the legs diverted the spear's trajectory.
Then, the spear rushed towards Sherry like a frolicking horse.
Sherry summoned a mirror in front of herself, and the ice spear rushed into the mirror world.
Although Olmer's eyes were still a little dazed, with the blessing of the moonlight, he was not completely lost in Sherry's "Charm." He had only accidentally been preempted by Sherry.
Hobert did not deal with Sherry with Olmer, but went to attack Barranca with the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch."
The "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" was turning the battlefield between him and Barranca into a stream of information. Barranca's curses were transformed into streams of information and sunk into the "Sea of Information" by the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch."
Barranca's clothes and hair suddenly turned into streams of information. Just as he was about to further informationtize the other party, Barranca was suddenly replaced by a wooden puppet.
That puppet quickly turned into a stream of information composed of symbols and numbers, and instantly sank into the "Sea of Information."
Barranca then appeared in a place outside the Sea of Information, but suddenly, his spirituality sent out a very dangerous warning signal. He quickly recovered from the "Ancient Bane" state to his normal size.
Just now, a huge vortex of power had formed in the position of the "Ancient Bane's" head. Because Barranca's body immediately shrank, this vortex did not harm it, but compressed the surrounding air.
That was Hobert's attack just now, but it missed.
He quietly joined the battle with the "Sun Scepter" in hand. The power of sunlight had a considerable restraining effect on "Ancient Banes."
He raised the scepter and shot a ball of pure white light towards Barranca, and the entire battlefield was shrouded in pure white light.
Barranca, who was sweating profusely from being roasted by the light, took out a black heart from his pocket. After releasing the seal on its spirituality, he immediately swallowed it.
At the moment when the strong light irradiated Barranca, his body surface was covered with a layer of disgusting mucus, which actually isolated the purification of the pure sunlight!
Immediately, his skin rapidly expanded, hardened, and dried up, as if covering his body surface with a layer of rough, black, and cracked stone. His chest rose and fell as if there was a heart with surging power beating.
Only Barranca's black and white eyes still looked like human organs.
Hobert immediately felt Barranca's spirituality expand, as if he possessed even more powerful power. The pure light emitted by the "Sun Scepter" could not hurt him!
Hobert immediately changed his strategy, took out the "Box of the Great Old Ones" from the "Nation of Disorder," opened the first layer, and locked Barranca and the space around him into the silver-black jewelry box.
The "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" was stunned because he lost his attack target.
Pa~
The jewelry box that had just closed was immediately pushed open by a huge force. Barranca, whose feet had only turned into exquisite toys, raised his hands high, resisting the power of the "Box of the Great Old Ones."
Hobert put away the "Sun Scepter," clenched his palm, and the air that had been compressed by the vortex of power just now shot into the jewelry box like an arrow, hitting Barranca's forehead.
Barranca, who was about to lift his leg and step out, paused, and the jewelry box closed again.
But in the next second, the jewelry box was opened again. This time, Barranca's calves had also turned into exquisite toys, but he could still easily push up the lid of the jewelry box.
Hobert put the "Box of the Great Old Ones" on the ground in front of him and ordered the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" to continue attacking Barranca inside.
The "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" "reproduced" a tall cross that seemed to reach the sky.
The huge sense of oppression from the appearance of the cross caused Barranca to be in a trance for a moment, so the "Box of the Great Old Ones" closed again.
In the next second, the "Box of the Great Old Ones" was opened for the third time. At this time, Barranca's knees had turned into exquisite toys, and his expression was somewhat anxious.
It wasn't that he was anxious because he was becoming more and more like a toy, but that his spirituality became surging after taking the black heart, and the state of enhanced ability had a time limit. After that time, he would be weak for a while.
Hobert realized this, so he came up with this method to exhaust Barranca. Neither the "Box of the Great Old Ones" nor the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" could harm Barranca in his current state.
But Hobert's purpose was not to hurt him, but to waste time with him.
When opening the lid for the third time, Hobert "tampered with" Barranca's evil and surging spirituality, causing his spirituality to "misfire" for a moment, and the box closed again.
At this moment, Hobert's spirituality felt something. He was about to put away the "Box of the Great Old Ones," but it was too late.
The "Box of the Great Old Ones" suddenly disappeared from the ground. Tamara, who was like a wax figure, suddenly appeared not far away, and the silver-black jewelry box appeared in her raised palm.
Tamara was about to open the "Box of the Great Old Ones" to release Barranca, but Hobert immediately "used" the negative effects of the "Box of the Great Old Ones," and the first layer opened at the same time as the third layer.
Tamara's eyes suddenly condensed, and she quickly pressed down on the "Box of the Great Old Ones" with her other hand. No matter how Barranca struggled inside, she would not let go.
The third layer of the jewelry box contained corruption from the stars. Even Tamara, who had been promoted to "Prince of Abolition," could easily be corrupted.
Just as Tamara was pressing hard on the "Box of the Great Old Ones," a thick coffin suddenly "rushed" out from the spirit world and slammed into her back, causing her to stagger.
Tamara was slightly stunned, very strange what material this coffin was made of? The "Disorder" she had just used had failed to make it lose its sense of direction!
It wasn't until Beverly summoned Raymond and "planted" the "Tree of Order" that Tamara finally managed to hold down the third layer of the "Box of the Great Old Ones."
In order to avoid being "used" by others again, she quickly threw the "Box of the Great Old Ones" towards Hobert.
At this time, Raymond questioned, "Tamara, why don't you kneel and salute?" while pulling out a long sword with rust and blood stains from his chest and stabbing Tamara fiercely.
Tamara sneered, "distorted" the direction of Raymond's sword, and "tampered with" his position, causing the sword to stab Beverly.
Beverly smiled slightly, reached out her hand to let her brother pierce her palm, and then "bestowed" the injury to Tamara.
Just as Tamara was about to "bestow" the injuries on her hand, Beverly "exploited" and "tampered" with it, and in the end, He actually "bestowed" the injuries upon Himself.
When it came to using the related abilities of the "Black Emperor", Hobert most admired his father, Rex, and the second person he admired was Beverly.
Especially the cooperation that He and Raymond had honed in actual combat allowed them to deal with Sequence 1 without any problems.
Meanwhile, Hobert and the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" continued to use the "Box of the Great Old Ones" to deplete Barranca's abilities.
At this moment, Hobert's spirituality felt something again, and He smiled slightly: "The last one is here."
In the next instant, Hobert felt that the connection with the "Box of the Great Old Ones" was completely severed. Trunsoest appeared not far from the battlefield. He "deprived" Hobert of his ownership of the "Box of the Great Old Ones."
Without the power to control it, the first layer of the "Box of the Great Old Ones" was opened again. Although the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" attacked Barranca, the "Box of the Great Old Ones" did not close again. Barranca, whose body below the abdomen had turned into exquisite toys, breathed a sigh of relief and finally jumped out of the "Box of the Great Old Ones".
Trunsoest was about to attack Hobert when the sunlight suddenly turned scarlet, and everything around became unreal.
The angel Olmer of the Sanguine, as well as the Sanguine hiding in the distance, seemed to sense something. They looked towards the sky, where the newly risen sun had become very dim, and the sky was shrouded in a scarlet full moon.
Emlyn, who had become the "Shaman King" and also participated in this battle, was extremely excited for a moment: "Ancestor!"
The other Sanguine had reactions similar to Emlyn's. They were about to get up when a surge of pressure pressed down on their shoulders.
At this moment, Medici's voice came to their ears: "Did you guys drink horse urine as blood this morning? You're reeking of piss."
The Sanguine were all filled with anger, but their longing for the scarlet moon did not seem as strong as before. Reason told them that if they were to glance at the battlefield over there at this time, they would definitely lose control and turn into monsters.
The moonlight of the red moon formed a blurry figure wearing a fashionable long dress. It was Lilith, who had recently regained her memory.
The scarlet moon above Her head was not the real moon. The moon was currently occupied by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
However, the moment Lilith became an angel, she regained many authorities of the "Moon" pathway, so the moon above Her head was of symbolic significance.
But the effect was the same, making Lilith spiritually abundant, very charming, and all her abilities were improved.
He glanced at Trunsoest: "You are the curse that once tormented Hobert?"
Just as Trunsoest was about to open his mouth, a hazy door suddenly appeared in his chest, and a young man with bronze hair crawled out of it. It was Trunsoest himself.
However, this Trunsoest looked around indifferently, and finally looked up at his main body: "Flog!"
A phantom leather whip with barbs stretched out from the void, striking Trunsoest's back again and again.
What Lilith summoned was the divinity part of Trunsoest. This part had long wanted to kill its own main body and become the main consciousness of Trunsoest.
At this moment, the Sanguine's angel Olmer was about to come over to salute Lilith, but Lilith stared at Him: "You are in battle, fool! The salute can wait."
Olmer nodded quickly and said: "Yes!"
Then, as if he had taken stimulants, he attacked Sherry with all his strength, no longer with the mentality of "stalling the enemy is enough" as before.
Trunsoest's main body was about to raise his hand to "imprison" his own divinity when he suddenly felt that his hand was out of control.
Looking down, his ten fingers were arguing with the palm. They had all grown a mouth and two eyes, not only could they speak, but they even had expressions, like some normal creatures.
The thumb said: "I am the most important one. Without me, you can't hold anything."
The index finger said: "I am the most important one, because I am the most flexible."
The middle finger said: "Stop arguing, I am the most important one. I have the most strength and can use gestures to curse people!"
The ring finger said: "I have always been the one who silently contributes, and I am the most symbolic. Rings are usually worn on me. I may not be that important, but without me, the fingers would have no meaning."
The little finger said: "I admit that you are all very important, but if you don't have me, your importance will be greatly reduced. It is I who make the whole hand sensitive enough and make every movement more stable."
The palm said: "Stop arguing! If you argue again, I will throw you all down! Let's discuss how to break away from this idiot's arm! I don't want to stay with an arm like a stupid donkey for even a second!"
Trunsoest smiled: "Wonderful power."
In the next second, He imprisoned these lives one after another, and the arguing finally stopped. The divinity that appeared in his chest was also restricted again.
Trunsoest said to Lilith: "This lady has made the moonlight appear in the daytime, which seriously violates the laws of nature and should be imprisoned in the spirit world forever."
As soon as these words were spoken, even the moonlight of the full moon summoned by Lilith dimmed a lot, and an invisible cage flew towards Lilith.
But Lilith's figure suddenly became blurred, which made the "cage" mistake a ray of moonlight for Lilith, and after "imprisoning" a ray of moonlight, it entered the spirit world.
Although Lilith is currently only Sequence 2, because She has a part of the authority of the "Moon" pathway, she can completely deal with Trunsoest alone.
At this time, Hobert and the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" had gained an absolute advantage in their siege of Barranca.
Barranca was still in the "transformed" state, but because of Hobert's abilities of "Exploit" and "tampering", the parts of Him that had been turned into toys by the "Box of the Great Old Ones" still had not recovered.
This caused Barranca to move slowly like a wind-up toy, so Hobert asked the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" to "reproduce" some gods with high attack power or usable scenes.
Then, Hobert "magnified" the attacks of these scenes. The immobile Barranca withstood the giant sword of the "Giant King" once, the charge of the God of Combat once, and the claws of the "Dragon of Imagination" once. Even if all of His abilities were strengthened after swallowing the "Black Heart", He was still somewhat unable to hold on.
Fortunately, the "reproduction" of the "Hundred Eyed Devil Monarch" can only reproduce a part of the power of these gods, and even after Hobert's "magnification", it cannot reach one-third of the power of the "person involved".
Otherwise, with the full sword of the "Giant King", Barranca's body and spirit would have been divided into two.
Not far away, Raymond was still attacking and "provoking" Tamara: "I heard that your family has split, so you had to kill many of your descendants. Congratulations!"
But Tamara remained unmoved.
At this moment, Medici suddenly jumped out of the bunker and stood on a rock, saying to Raymond: "Boy, although you have realized the role of 'provocation', your means of provocation are just so-so. Let me give you a demonstration."
"Ahem!" He cleared his throat and said to Tamara: "When old Tamara was killed by the Six Gods, Stiano, who is now the God of Steam and Machinery, was also present.
"He told me that old Tamara knelt down and begged Trunsoest for mercy before he died, crying with snot and tears, and kissed the surface of Trunsoest's shoes, hoping that He would give up becoming a god..."
Like a wax figure, Tamara's forehead veins jumped when he heard this, and he rushed towards Medici with the "Black Longsword" in his hand, wanting to tear this guy's mouth apart.
Beverly and Raymond quickly attacked Tamara from the left and right wings, and immediately gained the initiative in the battle.
Medici laughed and returned to the bunker.
This was the gift He prepared for two "old friends". Of course, there were definitely exaggerated elements, but the probability of Tamara and Trunsoest cooperating in the future would definitely be greatly reduced.
