chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 693: The Chained God's Self-Rescue Attempt
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The enemies that Hobert and Archibald could think of had all been mobilized. Now, the key was to see which side could get the "First Kill" first!
Tamara and the Beverly siblings, Trunsoest and Lilith, as well as the Sanguine angel Olmer and the Demoness Sect's Sherry, were locked in a battle that would be difficult to resolve for the time being.
The key to the battle lay in the fight between the "Abomination" Suah and the "Holy Infant King" and the "Duke of Entropy", as well as Hobert and the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch"'s siege of Barana.
Initially, Hobert's side had the upper hand. Hobert and the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" had already wounded Barana.
But soon, Suah suppressed the two tool people summoned by Hobert and could help Barana, whose spirituality was becoming increasingly weak, out of the predicament.
So the battle situation became anxious again, and Hobert had to shout towards the shelter of the Beyonders: "Sharron!"
Sharron understood and immediately summoned her teacher.
The space at the edge of the battlefield suddenly became illusory. Reinette Tinekerr, wearing a complicated black dress and carrying four golden-haired, red-eyed heads, rushed from the spirit world.
His four heads stared at Suah together. A black crystal-like charm suddenly appeared in the mouth of one of the heads: "Yesterday!"
The four golden-haired, red-eyed heads returned to his neck together, making his body complete and his strength temporarily restored to its peak state.
Reinette's fingers suddenly lengthened and pierced into his chest, and blood flowed immediately.
A wound immediately appeared on Suah's chest, and a line of black, thick blood flowed out.
The "Duke of Entropy" immediately performed "Magnification", and Suah's injury immediately turned into a large hole. Even Suah in the "Abomination" state was obviously affected.
This forced Suah to withdraw his energy and concentrate on dealing with Reinette Tinekerr, as well as the two tool people, the "Holy Infant King" and the "Duke of Entropy".
Hobert took the opportunity to launch a fierce attack on Barana. Barana, whose stone-like black skin was gradually returning to normal skin, already had the intention of retreating.
The leader of the "Rose School of Thought" obviously had no way to provide him with help. Did he still expect those angels he invited to help him?
But running away at this time would only make his situation worse, so he turned into a wraith and rushed towards Hobert, hoping to find a breakthrough to escape the battlefield.
But when the illusory figure wearing a Southern Continent wizard's robe just appeared in Hobert's eyes, he "exploited" Barana's "Wraith Possession", prematurely ending the opponent's ability and instantly removing Barana from the "Wraith" state.
At the same time, Hobert's shadow appeared in Barana's eyes. The angel-level "Exploit" ability allowed him to briefly use the ability that had just been "exploited".
Normal "possession" will immediately attack oneself, exchanging injuries with the enemy, because the physical and spiritual bodies of the "Prisoner" pathway Beyonders are very strong, so they are not afraid of injury at all.
Especially after reaching "Disciple of Silence", using the ability of "Source of Curses" can only injure the enemy without injuring oneself.
Hobert did not have such an ability, so he just made Barana stand still.
That was enough, because at this time, the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" "reproduced" a tall figure. He could not see the face of this figure clearly, but could only see that he wore a very retro cross on his chest.
This huge figure opened his arms, as if embracing the sun.
Hobert quickly left Barana's body. The moment he left, he felt that his soul had been scorched to a certain extent.
Barana had just recovered when a very pure white light fell from the sky and landed on him.
"Ah—"
In Barana's scream, his physical and spiritual bodies were purified.
Unfortunately, this purification was fleeting and failed to completely eliminate Barana. His whole body was burning with pure white flames, and his physical and spiritual bodies were severely damaged.
"Magnify!" Of course, Hobert would not miss this opportunity and immediately "magnified" Barana's injuries.
Just when only the final blow was needed to kill the opponent, Suah suddenly let out a scream, which made Hobert's spirit body stagnate.
Then, Suah, enduring the attacks of Reinette and other angels, let out another scream.
His scream was a bit strange. It did not cause much damage to the spiritual bodies of the surrounding angels, it only made the spiritual bodies and bodies feel a bit separated.
But after the second scream, a space in Yason City suddenly became illusory, and a monster that looked a bit like a giant conch suddenly appeared from the spirit world.
However, at the tail of the conch, in addition to some legs like crabs and other creatures, there was also the upper body of a blood-red human being surrounded by the legs.
Its appearance caused the surrounding ground to be covered with a layer of white frost, as if the air immediately became evil.
At the same time, the residents of Yason City around the monster immediately mutated. Some turned into large trees, but human facial features grew on the trunks. Or they turned into patches of grass, and the swaying grass blades formed the shape of human facial features.
Some became similar to the monster, with the body of a sea beast but the head of a human.
They were tormented by extremely distorted spiritual bodies and wailed in pain.
Hobert "recognized" this monster! When he attacked the Tamara family's gathering place before, Pedi Tamara had summoned this monster from the spirit world to block the "Creator".
Later, Hobert thought about it and believed that this monster should have been polluted by the "Mother Tree of Desire" before it became such a creature that was neither human nor sea monster.
Now that he encountered this guy again, Hobert was slightly relieved, because with the Uniqueness, he could mobilize enough power from the "Nation of Disorder" to temporarily seal the corruption emitted by the monster.
Moreover, the corruption of the "Mother Tree of Desire" is not as impossible to remove as the corruption of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity". Hobert can "tamper" the corruption onto other objects in the "Nation of Disorder".
At this time, the spirituality of angels such as Trunsoest and Lilith felt that this monster was very dangerous, and they all tried to stay away from Yason City.
This monster is definitely the "Rose School of Thought"'s trump card, because even Reinette Tinekerr was afraid of being polluted and quickly retreated backward. Only the "Abomination" Suah was not afraid of such corruption.
Just as Hobert was about to deal with that monster, he heard Reinette say in surprise: "Chained God!"
Hobert was stunned: Could this monster be the "Chained God"? This is too weak!
Suah took advantage of the angels' retreat and showed a very ugly smile: "This is just a dying struggle of Tolzna, but it can be used to stop the 'Creator's' forces!"
At this time, the monster ignored the angels and was slowly heading towards the center of the city.
Hobert did not continue to think about Suah's words and shouted to the "Holy Infant King": "Go!"
The "Holy Infant King" immediately used the ability to "distort" space to come to the top of the monster's head. Its form became illusory and gradually extended into a black shield, slowly falling towards the "Conch Monster".
In this war, it is very likely to encounter the corruption of the "Mother Tree of Desire", so Hobert certainly made some preparations in advance.
Of course, these preparations are inseparable from the power of the "Nation of Disorder". After all, only the power of the "Nation of Disorder" can resist the corruption of the Outer Deities.
But the problem is that Hobert cannot gather massive amounts of power in the real world in a short period of time to complete a certain seal.
So he thought of this method, using three tool people angels to create the seal.
These three tool people were "charged" by Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" in advance. When they needed to appear, he pulled them out of the "Nation of Disorder".
Each tool person is equivalent to a huge energy aggregate, and they can be used to simply seal the power of the "Mother Tree of Desire".
After letting the "Holy Infant King" attack, Hobert attacked Barana again, who was only left with a "bloody skin". He "distorted" the life state of this "Ancient Bane", distorting it from "alive" to "dead".
In that instant, both the real world and the spirit world "thought" that Barana was dead, and even the weak Barana himself thought that he was dead.
Such "distortion" is only effective when the target is weak enough. If Barana's state is normal, he can use the ability of "Puppet Substitute" to avoid it.
The battle became more intense than before. Just when Hobert was about to "Exploit" the relevant rules to instantly extract Barana's Beyonder characteristics, at the same time, the "Abomination" Suah avoided the attack of the "Duke of Entropy" and was about to stop Hobert's final blow, the monster in Yason City suddenly made a cry similar to blowing a conch.
Although the shield formed by the "Holy Infant King" covered the monster, the black liquid it kept spraying out prevented the shield from completely closing. This cry suddenly made the entire Yason City silent.
Hearing this cry, the spirituality of all the angels realized that something bad was about to happen. Medici in the distance immediately ordered the extraordinary troops to hide further away.
Only Suah's face showed a very ugly smile again.
Suddenly, a large amount of black mist exploded out rom the center of Yason City, covering the entire Yason City almost instantly.
There were wails of residents of Yason City and Beyonders everywhere. As they fled to the outside of the city, they turned into strange monsters after being shrouded in black mist.
Some grew jagged cockscombs on their heads, some grew leaves with mouthparts all over their bodies, some had limbs that turned into goat's limbs, and some had heads that turned into mantis heads...
The entire Yason City became an ocean of monsters.
At the same time, almost instantly, the black mist spread around Yason City, and Hobert was also included.
Lilith was about to rush in to save people, but Hobert's voice came from the black mist: "No one come in. I have a way to block the corruption here, you..."
Just as he said this, Hobert's voice suddenly disappeared, and the black mist also stopped spreading.
Although Lilith was a little anxious, she knew that Hobert had a lot of connections with the "Nation of Disorder" and also knew that what Hobert said was true.
At this time, Medici in the distance "hehe" smiled and asked Trunsoest: "Do you also want to be a running dog of the Outer Gods like Tamara?"
Trunsoest coldly glanced at Medici, then coldly snorted. He took a step and disappeared from the angel battlefield.
Lilith looked at Tamara with displeasure: "Hobert still needs the Beyonder characteristics in your body."
Tamara felt as if a strange life was suddenly awakening within her body. She quickly "bestowed the strange life away, and then made the space around her chaotic, disappearing from the battlefield as well.
The Sanguine angel Olmer came to Lilith's side and knelt down to salute, but Lilith was in no mood to pay attention to him.
The remaining angels and the Beyonders in the distance all looked towards the black mist, many with expressions of concern or worry.
But Medici smiled calmly and naturally: "I told you, the "Rose School of Thought" must have a trap of mutual destruction in Yason City."
The surrounding people glared at him, but they had to admit in their hearts that if they rashly attacked Yason City, the consequences would be unimaginable.
… …
At this time, within the black mist, Hobert first briefly lost his vision, but soon he could clearly see things within a kilometer or two around him.
The moment the black mist appeared, Hobert covered his body with a thin layer of "Order Crystal," so he was not corrupted by the black mist at all.
Apart from his vision being like he was wearing sunglasses and difficulty breathing, this layer of "Order Crystal" had little effect on Hobert.
So Hobert "altered" the frequency of his breathing, "altering" a breath every two or three seconds into a breath every two or three hours.
At this moment, another loud noise came from within Yason City, as if a surging force was drilling out from the ground.
Following the direction in his memory, Hobert walked towards the edge of the gray mist, but after walking for more than half a minute, he still hadn't walked out of the black mist.
Hobert immediately made the "Order Crystal" around him expand, forming a relatively illusory shield. Hobert's limit was to prop up a shield with a diameter of about three kilometers.
The black mist within the shield was dispelled, and his vision returned to normal.
Through the shield, Hobert saw a layer of transparent barrier in the direction of the edge of the black mist.
He reached out and touched it. It was a "Wall of Spirituality," or it could be called a "Spirituality Barrier." Hobert felt as if he was completely isolated from the real world.
Boom~
Another loud noise came from the center of Yason City.
Hobert looked towards the center of the city, but his vision was blocked by the black mist.
After thinking for a moment about how to deal with the current situation, Hobert decided to first reunite with the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" and the "Duke of Entropy" according to his memory.
After losing their target, they were stunned in place. They were tools made of pure power, so they were not corrupted either.
It's just that Barana was no longer in place, and it was unknown where he had escaped to.
Hobert took them into the shield to protect himself, and then he tried to enter the "Nation of Disorder."
He actually failed!
But Hobert could clearly feel that he could still call upon the power from the "Nation of Disorder."
After thinking about it, Hobert roughly understood that his spirit body was locked within this "Spirituality Barrier," so he could not enter the "Nation of Disorder."
However, because the power of the "Nation of Disorder" was extremely high in level, it could find loopholes in the rules and spread the power in.
If he wanted to enter the "Nation of Disorder," he would need the help of the "Creator," and the "Creator" was currently the one who could not enter His "Divine Kingdom" and needed help.
Hobert smiled and simply started thinking of other ways.
At this time, a group of monsters rushed out of the city, but they were all blocked by Hobert outside the shield.
Hobert ignored them and directly stepped into the city.
At this time, one of the monsters asked: "Need help?"
Hobert was slightly stunned and looked at the monster. It was a monster with human legs, but with the upper body of a lobster.
The other monsters all had blank eyes, with only desire and madness remaining.
Only this "Lobster Monster's" two protruding eyes flickered with the light of wisdom.
Before figuring out the other party's situation, Hobert just looked at the other party coldly, without answering.
The "Lobster Monster" opened the mouth below its head and smiled: "We made a deal, have you forgotten?"
Hobert's eyes narrowed: "Farbauti!"
Then he quickly denied: "I have not made any deals with you!"
"I know, I know!" The Lobster Monster smiled: "But what I want to tell you is that even if you don't admit the deal between us, it's useless.
"Of course, this can indeed protect you to a certain extent, but I can still use that deal to perform many operations."
Hobert probably understood that the so-called "perform some operations" might include Farbauti being able to easily locate him when he encountered a certain specific situation.
He often entered and exited the "Nation of Disorder" and was very clear that there were no problems with his spirit body and spirituality, so he still believed that as long as he did not admit that it was a deal, he would be relatively safe.
Hobert asked: "How did you enter this huge 'Spirituality Barrier'?"
The Lobster Monster, or rather, the "Devil Monarch" Farbauti, replied: "No need to enter, I was originally in here."
Hobert was slightly stunned: "You had arrangements in Yason City long ago? The "Rose School of Thought" never noticed?"
"You misunderstood! As long as there is evil, it can carry my will."
Hobert sighed: This is a Uniqueness! Or rather, this is a god.
Immediately, Hobert thought that if he also accomodated the Uniqueness at this time, the "Spirituality Barrier" would definitely not be able to trap Him.
Hobert isolated the corruption on Farbauti's body and put Him into the shield: "Speak, what is your purpose?"
"My purpose is of course to help you."
Hobert smiled: "Think carefully before answering, I can give you another chance."
"Deception" is the nature of demons, and this clumsy lie may be for other lies.
"Young people these days are really getting more and more impolite." Farbauti said, "Guess why I came?"
Hobert didn't even think: "The Uniqueness of the 'Chained' pathway."
Farbauti smiled, which was considered a default.
Just now, Hobert was guessing whether such a big commotion in Yason City was created by the real "Chained God."
Farbauti's default confirmed his guess.
Hobert didn't expect that Tolzna, the "Chained God" who had been missing for hundreds of years, was actually hiding under the capital of the Highland Kingdom.
At the same time, Hobert realized: After the main force of the "Rose School of Thought" was completely annihilated, Suah planned to release the "Chained God" to cause huge losses to the "Creator's" forces.
Fortunately, Hobert "hired" Medici as a senior consultant in this battle. If he still followed the previous war thinking, using extraordinary troops to attack the city and forcing the other party to send out angels first, and then his own side to send out angels, then the "Creator's" forces would have suffered huge losses.
After thinking for a moment, Hobert said: "Help me kill Suah, the characteristics belong to me; the Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Chained God' also belongs to me."
Farbauti shook his head: "Without my help, you simply have no way to leave here."
"Ha!" Hobert laughed: "If I want to leave here, I can leave at any time."
This was not him bragging. As long as he prayed to "The Fool", he could easily leave here. After all, "The Fool" had authority over the spirit world and could easily solve the spiritual problems.
It's just that the "Holy Infant King" had not been recovered yet, and it was now easy to kill Barana, so it was a pity to leave like this.
In addition, Hobert was very clear that the "Chained God's" condition was very bad. If the opportunity was right, he could try to provoke a battle between Him and Suah to see if there was a chance to kill this "Abomination" here.
Because he could call upon the power of the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert's safety was basically not a problem, so he had not prayed to "The Fool" yet.
Farbauti stared at Hobert with his two protruding eyes for a while before saying: "Okay."
Hobert asked: "What is the current state of the 'Chained God'?"
"Not good."
"He has been hiding under Yason City?"
"Should be."
Hobert frowned: "What do you know?"
Farbauti smiled: "I know that the 'Conch Monster' was Tolzna's last attempt to get rid of the corruption, but He will definitely end in failure."
Hobert said: "Explain in detail."
"This process is not complicated. Tolzna was too severely corrupted and could only use the 'Spiritual Cage' to lock Himself up in order to retain the last trace of rationality." Farbauti explained:
"A long time ago, after a 'Abomination' Beyonder characteristic was torn from His body, He seemed to have found inspiration and expelled an 'Ancient Bane' Beyonder characteristic from His body, combining it with a part of His flesh to create a 'target' that attracts corruption.
"This 'target' did absorb a lot of corruption, but Tolzna was too naive. The 'target' He created had a very strong connection with Himself. The 'Mother Tree of Desire' could completely use this connection to further influence Him.
"It can be imagined that after absorbing a lot of corruption, that 'target' must have been completely controlled by the 'Mother Tree of Desire'.
"So the 'Mother Tree of Desire' used the 'target' at the right time... that is, the 'Conch Monster' to awaken the sleeping Tolzna and carry out the final corruption on Him.
"The most ironic thing is that Tolzna's resistance became the medium for Him to be completely corrupted."
Hobert slowly nodded: "We must seize the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of the 'Chained' pathway before He is completely corrupted."
Just as he finished speaking, Hobert saw the out-of-control Barana.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 694: Dividing the Characteristics of the Chained God
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Behind the rampaging Barranca was the closely pursuing "Abomination" Suah. Clearly, He had realized that Barranca was beyond saving, so He planned to retrieve the Beyonder characteristics.
Barranca, who had turned into a blood-soaked puppet more than two meters tall, resisted and fled, running right into Hobert and Farbauti, who had just entered the city.
Hobert quickly used a protective shield to encompass Barranca, but it blocked Suah.
Barranca, who was only one step away from death, seemed to have regained vitality after losing control, although his spirit body was still so weak.
Considering that Barranca had little reason after losing control, Hobert used the ability of "Charm" to make the bared-fangs and brandishing-claws Barranca lose hostility towards him and instead attack Farbauti.
Hobert glanced at the ugly Suah. This "Abomination," whose condition had never been very good, was in better condition now in the corruption of the black fog than when he was in the spirit world.
Suah looked at Hobert through the thin film-like shield, and then at Farbauti, who had the appearance of a lobster monster and was frantically dealing with Barranca.
In the end, Suah took a step back and disappeared into the black fog.
Only then did Hobert withdraw his gaze and smile at Farbauti: "With your level of skill, what help can you provide?"
Farbauti, who had a large claw foot slapped away by Barranca, fled in a disheveled manner and said, "Although the power of my descent is limited, it will have a miraculous effect against Tolzna."
Hobert smiled and used the ability of "Exploit," and Barranca's vitality rapidly weakened.
Theoretically speaking, loss of control is an uncontrollable reaction caused by a Beyonder power or Beyonder characteristic. Therefore, for Hobert, he could fundamentally disintegrate Barranca's power source by ending this reaction in advance.
After Barranca became very weak, Hobert then used the ability of "Disorder" to make the monster's state chaotic. Barranca, who had little sanity, would be normal for a while, then turn into a monster, and then turn into the process of losing control.
Just when the other party's state was slightly more normal, Hobert seized the opportunity to "magnify" the purification trauma that Barranca's spirit body had just suffered.
In a wail, Barranca's already very weak spirit body was completely shattered. His body struggled for a while before finally falling to the ground.
Hobert was about to accelerate the precipitation speed of the Beyonder characteristics when he discovered that the Beyonder characteristics had combined with Barranca's heart, forming a sealed object with the appearance of a black heart.
He first checked the negative effects of the sealed object. Because it was not sealed in the "Nation of Disorder," the negative effects were very strong. Every half minute, it could turn creatures within a dozen kilometers into sheep, and the safe usage time was only about twenty seconds.
Hobert first sealed it with an "Order Crystal" and put it in his pocket.
After picking up the spoils, they continued to move forward. Soon, they encountered a "Monster Forest."
This was a forest composed of residents who had previously turned into trees. At this time, their life forms had changed, and the facial features on the tree trunks looked very dazed.
If there were still normal lives in Yason City at this time, these monsters would definitely rush up to tear and gnaw, but there were no normal creatures in the entire city.
Hobert reduced the range of the shield, only protecting a few meters around, so as not to spend too much energy to block the surrounding monsters.
According to the location in his memory, he first went to find the "Holy Infant King," and brought the three tool people with him, so that if he encountered Suah again, he could put Him into the shield and try to besiege Him.
After walking a distance, the ground completely turned black, which was caused by the black liquid sprayed out after the appearance of the "Conch Monster."
These liquids had extremely strong corruption, turning the stone bricks on the ground black and constantly emitting curses.
Or growing out tongues with sharp teeth, one by one with malicious eyes.
The residents who were sprayed by the black liquid turned into ugly monsters. They intertwined with each other, releasing their desires on each other's bodies.
After shuttling through the bizarre monsters for a distance, Hobert finally found the "Holy Infant King" who had returned to the shape of a fetus.
Not far from it, there was also a huge conch.
This conch came from that "Conch Monster," but at this time, that monster had obviously left the conch shell that seemed like a burden.
"Ehhh haha!"
A sinister laughter came from the central location of the city. Farbauti said, "Tolzna has lifted all of his seals."
Hobert nodded, and cautiously walked towards the laughter.
After walking forward two intersections, the view suddenly opened up.
In the central location of the city, a deep and long crack had opened, and thick vines with bone-colored barbs grew out of the ground.
Many vines were covered with leaves of various colors, including golden ginkgo leaves, dark brown redwood leaves, and red maple leaves, etc., but there were no leaves that vines should have.
On the vines, the leafy parts were increasing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
There were also some vines without leaves, wriggling like pythons, entwining a middle-aged man without any hair or beard, with a very painful expression.
The vines cut wounds on the middle-aged man, and a drop of black blood flowed out, each drop of blood representing a vicious curse.
Hobert realized that this must be "Chained God" Tolzna.
The ugly Suah was attacking this Tolzna. He opened his mouth and issued a vicious curse, and several of the vines suddenly turned into noodles.
Tolzna ignored Suah, but looked forward, looking at a blood-red person.
This blood-red person was as if he had been skinned, with flesh exposed to the air, constantly flowing with disgusting mucus.
However, several crab-like walking feet grew on its legs. Hobert immediately understood that this was the guy inside the previous "Conch Monster," a monster composed of the characteristics of the "Ancient Bane" discharged by Tolzna.
At this time, this monster was also looking back at Tolzna.
Farbauti in the shield quickly said, "This is a good opportunity!
"Quickly remove the shield. There is no corruption where there is no black fog!"
This layer of shield not only blocked the corruption outside, but also prevented the Beyonder abilities inside the shield from attacking the enemies outside.
Hobert nodded: "Okay."
With a wave of his hand, he removed the shield, and with another wave, he turned the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" into the appearance of a shield, sealing Farbauti, who was missing a claw foot.
Farbauti was stunned: "The opportunity is fleeting, let me out quickly!"
"I'm afraid I can't comply." Hobert smiled: "'Dark Side of the Universe'!"
Farbauti frowned: "You're mistaken…"
Hobert said word by word: "Farbauti, would not, cooperate, with me!"
He spread his hands: "Only knows how to imitate humanity, but doesn't understand what true humanity is. This may be a congenital defect of the Outer Deities."
The other party seemed to be stunned for a moment, and stopped acting. He asked coldly: "Just because you think Farbauti wouldn't cooperate with you, you saw through my deception?"
Hobert smiled: "You exposed yourself when you took the initiative to cooperate with me.
"Farbauti is a very unsociable god. He didn't even seek cooperation when he resisted the corruption of the Outer Deities. How could he take the initiative to seek cooperation when dealing with Tolzna?
"Also, your performance was too clumsy. If it were really Farbauti, he would have agreed to my conditions without hesitation when discussing the conditions just now, because he had no intention of dividing the spoils with me.
"But you seemed to hesitate for a while before agreeing, as if you were really considering dividing the spoils with me. This is not 'devilish' at all."
The other party, or rather, the "Dark Side of the Universe," thought for a moment and said: "Let me out, I can really give you a Beyonder characteristic of a 'Abomination'."
"What do I want that thing for? As a decoration?" Hobert smiled: "But if I let you out, the 'Chained God' will be completely hopeless!"
Seeing that Hobert had already directed the topic to the confrontation between the earth gods and the Outer Deities, the "Dark Side of the Universe" knew that cooperation was hopeless, so he said coldly: "How long can you seal me?
"When I get out, I will definitely not let you go."
Hobert shook his head with a smile: "Do you think I'm afraid of an evil god? Bring it on! I just like fighting evil gods!"
If the "Dark Side of the Universe" really dared to play tricks, he would immediately pray to the seven true gods and immediately report Him!
Even if the seven true god churches are currently at war, the seven gods will never sit idly by.
Moreover, the time that the "Mother Tree of Desire" can completely dominate the actions of the Dark Side of the Universe is limited, which is destined to make it difficult for this newly promoted evil god to achieve anything.
Hobert sat on a collapsed wall more than half a meter high, with no intention of participating in the battle.
He asked the Dark Side of the Universe: "Are there living things on many planets in the universe? What kind of gods do they believe in?"
The Dark Side of the Universe snorted coldly, but he asked curiously: "Why don't you join the battle immediately?"
Hobert said: "How about this, we can answer each other's questions in a way of exchange.
"Note, it is exchange, not transaction."
If the other party was only the "Mother Tree of Desire," Hobert would certainly not communicate with the other party, but the Dark Side of the Universe is not equal to the "Mother Tree of Desire."
In Hobert's understanding, He was probably equivalent to a tool person like the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch", except that the dark side of the universe was more high-end.
He not only had a part of Farbauti's consciousness and divinity, but also generated his own consciousness and divinity because of the demons' worship of Him. The rest should be the will and knowledge of the "Mother Tree of Desire."
That's why the dark side of the universe has some characteristics of Outer Deities, but it is not as cold as Outer Deities.
"Okay." The dark side of the universe said, "Indeed, there are many planets with living beings."
"Some intelligent beings will worship the gods they create. This phenomenon is very peculiar. Obviously, the gods they create will not have any response, but they will still persist in their belief."
"Sometimes, their beliefs will also be transmitted to the gods of Earth. For example, creatures who believe in the cosmos, if there is no barrier on Earth, can establish contact with the Evernight Goddess."
"Some intelligent beings will worship the Beyonders who appear on their planets. Not every planet knows the potion formula. Some civilizations, with a very small probability, obtain relatively safe demigod potion formulas through trial and error, and will worship these powerful Beyonders."
"There are also some intelligent beings who will worship Outer Deities."
Hobert nodded: "I am not participating in the war because there is still a very important actor who has not arrived."
The dark side of the universe immediately understood: "Is Farbauti really coming?"
The dark side of the universe is Farbauti's split-off 'vest" to resist the "Mother Tree of Desire". He can use the connection with Farbauti to learn some of Farbauti's thoughts, so he replaced Farbauti in using Hobert to approach the "Chained God". After all, it is difficult for the main body of the dark side of the universe to break the "spiritual barrier" in a short time.
At this time, Hobert, inside the "spiritual barrier", is very crucial and can allow the dark side of the universe to descend part of its power very accurately.
But even though there is such a good opportunity, Farbauti has not shown up. The dark side of the universe has already determined that Farbauti will not show up.
Farbauti has always been very cautious, and Farbauti has deceived with his own ideas more than once or twice. Even the "Mother Tree of Desire" no longer takes Farbauti's ideas obtained by using the dark side of the universe seriously.
"He will definitely come." Hobert smiled, very surely.
He paused and added: "This is the answer to your second question."
The dark side of the universe was slightly stunned, always feeling like he had been tricked.
Hobert asked his second question: "Why does the 'Mother Tree of Desire' have conflicts with the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'?"
"There are some similar authorities between them, or in other words, the great 'Mother Tree of Desire' has a certain way to replace the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' if there is a chance." The dark side of the universe replied.
Hobert nodded, this felt a bit like "adjacent pathways."
However, it is different from adjacent pathways. Adjacent pathways can be interchanged, while these two Outer Deities can be "replaced."
The dark side of the universe asked: "Is the 'Creator' a god born after the 'Nation of Disorder' was activated?"
Hobert said: "I refuse to answer this question!"
The dark side of the universe was stunned for a full one or two seconds: "I have already answered your question just now."
Hobert spread his hands: "I said at the beginning that we are communicating, not trading."
"Since it is communication, if I don't want to answer, I will end the communication."
This made the dark side of the universe stunned for another two or three seconds. Just as he was about to say something, a shadow fell from the "Holy Infant King".
The shadow quickly stretched out, forming a thin, short-haired middle-aged man with a short beard on his chin. It was Farbauti's human image.
He was wearing a classical costume, looking coldly at the dark side of the universe: "You have disgraced the devil's face."
When Hobert first encountered the "Dark Side of the Universe", he only noticed that he was a little strange. The real confirmation that it was the Dark Side of the Universe was actually when he recovered the "Holy Infant King".
This tool person itself possesses this "fallen" ability and characteristic, so after Farbauti realized that the time was ripe and located Hobert, it was easier to descend power near the "Holy Infant King".
Hobert also realized that Farbauti's initiative to contact him in South Colson before was to have a chance to obtain the uniqueness of the "Chained God" pathway today.
Even if Farbauti's main body cannot come, he must have made sufficient preparations, and part of his power can also kill the "Chained God".
When Hobert noticed Farbauti on the "Holy Infant King", Farbauti did not speak out, so Hobert did not speak out either, just blocking the dark side of the universe who wanted to take action at a critical moment.
Hobert glanced at the dark side of the universe. He thought: It's just that the upper body of the dark side of the universe is a lobster, otherwise his expression must be very exciting.
While thinking, he jumped down from the broken wall, preparing to fight.
Since Farbauti is preparing to take action, it means that the situation there has reached a critical moment.
Farbauti glanced at Hobert: "You can't help."
Hobert smiled: "Who said I was going to help?"
If Farbauti can really kill the "Chained God" today, he can always grab something.
Farbauti didn't say anything, turned into a mass of black liquid, and rushed towards Tolzna, who was entangled in vines.
Hobert followed closely behind, letting the "Duke of Entropy" stand in front of him to avoid being accidentally injured.
At this time, Hobert's spirituality suddenly felt that although Farbauti was rushing towards Tolzna, he was using the power of depravity to attack the "crab-footed monster" with the characteristics of an "Ancient Bane."
Then Hobert noticed that Tolzna, who had a painful expression, suddenly showed a hint of relief after seeing Farbauti.
He suddenly closed his eyes, and the whole person immediately exploded!
This explosion caused a violent agitation of spirituality in the surrounding area. Hobert felt his spirit body being blown by a gust of wind. Just as he subconsciously covered his eyes with his hands, he found that he had appeared in a closed room.
Farbauti, Tolzna, Suah, etc. were all gone.
This room has a tall and wide bookcase standing, a messy bed, a wardrobe and a slightly messy desk.
Hobert was stunned for a moment before realizing that this was actually his single dormitory before time-traveling, except that there were no modern products such as computers and mobile phones in the room, and the original window was replaced by a wall.
He was dressed in classical-style clothes, which was out of tune with everything around him.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert looked at the only door in the room.
He didn't rush to open it, but considered why he suddenly appeared here?
Could it be that the "Chained God" has authority or ability in space? Not only must he have the ability of space, but also Transmigration… …
Hobert shook his head, which was obviously unlikely.
He sat on the edge of the bed, looked at everything around him again, and then thought of another possibility: This is a "cage" built using his own memory!
So Hobert once again focused his attention on the direction of the door. Although it was difficult to guess what was outside the door, that was the only clue to leave this "cage" at present.
Squeak~
Hobert got up and opened the door. Outside was another room, with a messy single bed, a bookshelf, and a wardrobe.
He looked back and saw that it was exactly the same as the scene behind him.
Hobert frowned: "What the hell is this ability?"
Basically, it can be ruled out as a hallucination, because the "Lawyer" pathway has a high resistance in this regard.
Hobert tried to "distort" the boundary between the spiritual world and the real world, but he couldn't find where the boundary was.
This kind of reaction is not like space magic either.
Hobert changed his thinking: Whether it is hallucination or the ability of space, it should not be the main authority of the "Chained God". We still have to start with the authority of the "Chained God". Obviously, the most important clue is "cage"!
Hobert suddenly recalled a sentence: The body is the cage of the heart, and the world is the cage of the body!
This seems to be the best description of the "Chained God's" authority!
He stood at the door, glanced at the two identical rooms on the left and right: This is very likely my "spiritual cage"!
So how do I get out of here?
Hobert pondered for a few seconds with his arms folded, and suddenly looked in the direction of the window. He quickly approached and punched out suddenly, smashing a fist-sized hole.
Hobert smiled slightly: "The 'window of the mind' can break the 'cage of the mind'!"
Obviously, the attack he suffered was an "cage" with abstract meaning, so of course the attack with abstract meaning must be cracked in an abstract way.
Immediately afterwards, he pushed hard, and the entire window was pushed open. Light shone in, and Hobert instantly returned to Asong City.
Surrounding him were houses destroyed by monsters, and monsters hiding in the corners, fearing the angels and gods.
In front of him, more and more vines grew leaves, and they were about to touch Tolzna.
But Tolzna did not explode. He just closed his eyes, and the expression on his face was still very painful.
Except for the imprisoned dark side of the universe, and the two tool people, "Holy Infant King" and "Duke of Entropy", Suah and the "crab-footed monster", even Farbauti was gone!
Hobert was stunned: Could it be that even Farbauti has a "spiritual cage"?
Although it was not Farbauti's main body that came here, he was also locked up by the "spiritual cage", which was somewhat beyond Hobert's expectations.
This made him think of the oil painting made of Farbauti's dream. Hobert was very strange at the time. A demon, a devil, why was his dream a meadow and a sea of flowers?
But now is not the time to think about this. Hobert looked at the vines that were growing leaves rapidly, which should represent the corruption of the "Mother Tree of Desire"!
Hobert raised his hand to "tamper" with the speed and direction of the corruption.
However, it had little effect, after all, the level of this corruption was too high.
So Hobert went to "distort" Tolzna's position, but was blocked by the barrier formed by this "Chained God" with spirituality, preventing the power of "distortion" from entering.
When it came to uniqueness, when it came to the level of gods, Hobert, as an angel, still felt a little powerless.
At this time, the leaves had reached Tolzna's feet, and this "Chained God" still had his eyes closed, and the painful expression was gradually easing.
The sealed dark side of the universe laughed and said, "If I had known that He would give up resistance on His own, I wouldn't have bothered to get so close to Him."
Hobert suddenly had inspiration, and waves of black tides spread out from under his feet, which was a power he rarely used after becoming an angel: "Corruption".
From the level of "Frenzied Mage", "Corruption" already had a certain entity, and at the level of angels, this ability was strengthened again.
Although not as powerful as the "Corruption" of the "Demon" pathway and the "Secrets Supplicant" pathway, it was also a very good group attack ability.
At the same time, Hobert also asked the "Holy Infant King" to use the same ability, and the black tide became even more surging.
Hobert also used the ability of "Magnification", and the surrounding power of corruption was strengthened again. Many monsters who did not have time to escape were swallowed by the black tide of corruption, and died in the double corruption of the spirit body and the physical body.
In the black tide, a bubble-like shape suddenly bulged, and this "bubble" quickly became taller, eventually outlining Farbauti's figure.
He looked at the surging power of corruption around him, then looked at Hobert, and finally took a deep breath. The surrounding "black tide of corruption" immediately surged towards him, as if he was not breathing air, but the surrounding corruption.
When Hobert realized that his power might not be able to change the situation, he thought of this method to help Farbauti escape from the "spiritual cage".
At this time, the leaves had grown to Tolzna's calf, and Farbauti's body suddenly became taller, with curved goat horns growing on his head, covered with countless illusory and mysterious patterns, and a pair of bat-winged giant wings growing from his back.
He had a blue steel fork in his hand, and his body was surrounded by crimson and light blue flames, emitting a strong smell of sulfur.
This was a god-level "demonization", with a kind of sacredness in the evil.
Hobert felt that his spirituality had been impacted to a certain extent, and many depraved thoughts arose in his heart.
At this time, Farbauti was as tall as Tolzna, who was lifted up by the vines. The huge steel fork in his hand pierced forward, piercing a big hole in Tolzna's heart!
Tolzna trembled all over, and the skin all over his body quickly turned black, rotted, and fell off his body, soon leaving only a black and strange skeleton.
In the skeleton's chest, there was a blood-red eye, a rag doll covered with blood and mysterious patterns, and a puppet image covered with thorns.
This was the uniqueness of the "Chained" pathway, and a Sequence 1 "Abomination" characteristic.
Under the feet of the "Chained God", the vines covered with barbs or leaves quickly withered, which also indicated that this "Chained God" had fallen, and the power of the "Mother Tree of Desire" had no target to continue polluting.
Farbauti stretched out his hand, and a black tide went to devour the rag doll covered with blood and the puppet with thorns.
But at this time, the body of this strange black skeleton suddenly tilted, and the uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics in the chest cavity actually fell out.
At this time, Hobert appeared opposite Farbauti and pointed to the "Abomination" characteristic.
It was he who had "tampered" with the mechanical structure of the black skeleton, causing the skeleton to skew.
The rag doll covered with blood was now crawling up by itself, jumping down from the dry vines. As time went by, the activation of uniqueness would only become more and more powerful.
Farbauti had no choice but to control the black tide to grab the uniqueness first.
And Hobert came to the front of the "Abomination" Beyonder characteristic, and while it had not been attracted by the uniqueness, he wrapped it in a layer of "Order Crystal".
Boom ~
Hobert heard an explosion originating from spirituality. The surrounding "spiritual barriers" quickly cracked, disappeared, and black mist began to spread outside the city.
Hobert first put the spoils into the "Nation of Disorder", and then immediately hid in a corner, entering the "Nation of Disorder" himself, and wearing the uniqueness on his head.
The image of the "Creator" quickly appeared in the mid-air of Yason City. He gently pulled in the void, and the black mist representing corruption quickly formed into a dense black ball, and then the black ball flew into the air.
...
The reactions of the angels outside the city were different after seeing the "Creator". Lilith seemed to understand something and showed a knowing smile.
Beverly and her brother felt the surging power of the "Creator" and bowed to the "Creator".
Medici in the distance looked at the majestic figure in the mid-air and frowned: "What is His background? How can He control even such high-level corruption?"
...
The image of the "Creator" quickly disappeared, and Hobert hurriedly "went online".
He jumped up and "magnified" his upward jumping ability, and soon caught up with the black ball composed of dense black mist.
Using the same method as last time to deal with the corruption of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity", Hobert prayed for the power of the Goddess within the barrier, asking Her to send the corruption into the cosmos.
After the ritual, Hobert hurried back to the ground, took out the "Sun Scepter" from the "Nation of Disorder", and summoned the power of the sun to purify the entire Yason City.
Most of the monsters instantly turned into ashes, and the rest, whether physical or spiritual, ignited flames, and soon fell to the ground, eventually burning to ashes as well.
Looking around, the entire Yason City had turned into ruins, and none of the residents who had lived in this city survived.
Just now, while Hobert went to deal with the corruption, Suah, who had returned to the real world from the "Spiritual Cage", and the "Ancient Bane" with crab feet took the opportunity to escape.
Even the power projected from the dark side of the universe disappeared, so Hobert immediately put away the three tool people.
Without time to do a battle summary, Hobert came outside the city and first said to Lilith: "Mother, thank you for stopping Trunsoest just now."
The Sanguine angel next to him thought he had heard wrong, and was stunned there for three seconds without recovering. At this time, his mind was full of: Hobert called the "Ancestor" mother! Hobert called the "Ancestor" mother...
Lilith smiled and said, "When I recover some more strength, I can turn Trunsoest into a Beyonder characteristic."
Then she ordered Olmer next to her: "Help Hobert destroy the Highland Kingdom!"
"Yes!" Duke Olmer of the Sanguine immediately said: "We originally planned to completely defeat the "Rose School of Thought" before leaving."
In fact, according to the previous negotiations, the Sanguine would only help fight here at most, but now with the order of the "Ancestor", it is different.
Lilith nodded in satisfaction: "Tell the Sanguine members that I will return to the Sanguine, but not now. When I return, it will also be when the Sanguine regains its former glory."
Olmer said excitedly: "Yes!"
After saying this, two illusory doors opened in front of Lilith and disappeared into the real world.
Hobert was about to go to Beverly and her brother, but Olmer asked with a humble face: "Do you have any other instructions?"
Hobert smiled: "No need to be so polite, we should just get along as before."
"Okay, Grand Duke!" Olmer's tone was still very humble.
Hobert had no choice but to say: "I may still need your help when I deal with Suah later. Before that, you can go back first, just leave the Sanguine members here to help."
With such a batch of free Beyonder labor, it would be a waste not to use it.
"Yes."
Hobert nodded and came to Beverly and her brother: "The 'Creator' saw your battle just now and agreed to start assessing you."
"The battle just now will be counted in your merits. After reaching a certain merit, we will consider rewarding you with the 'Crystal Ring of Order'.
"Of course, it is not ruled out that we will give you the jade pendant in advance and let you make up for the merits."
Then he talked about the process of the assessment, which was the same process as before when he tested Archibald.
Hobert was responsible for recording their performance and reporting it to the "Creator". After making some contributions, they would gradually become core members of the "Creator"'s forces.
After sending away the siblings, Hobert then asked Medici to arrange for Beyonder forces to enter the city to collect the spoils inside the city and search for any monsters that had not been purified.
As for Reinette Tinekerr, the leader of the "Temperance Faction", she had already left before Hobert came out of the "Spiritual Barrier".
Hobert returned to the general headquarters of Angel on the grounds that he needed to rest.
After locking himself in the room, he immediately entered the "Nation of Disorder" to check the spoils.
Now, Hobert only simply named the spoils at the level of 1st level Sealed Artifacts. Only Beyonder characteristics and Sealed Artifacts at the angel level could arouse his interest.
First, he sealed the Sealed Artifact formed by the "Ancient Bane" Barranca, and then named it "0-77" Cursed Heart.
Then Hobert looked at his angel-level Beyonder characteristics, one of which was the "Duke of Entropy" characteristic obtained by crushing the Beyonder characteristics of the "Prince of Abolition".
In addition, there were four Beyonder characteristics of angel level obtained as spoils. They were the "Duke of Entropy" Characteristic seized after killing Erebus, and the "Ancient Bane" Beyonder characteristic seized after killing the "Rose School of Thought" angel, Kleist.
There was also the "Planeswalker" Beyonder characteristic obtained after killing Sperk Antigonus, who had been corrupted by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity." The last one was the Sequence 1 "Abomination" Beyonder characteristic just obtained from the "Chained God."
Of course, this Beyonder characteristic contained the "Mother Tree of Desire's" corruption. So, Hobert repeated his old trick, using the authority of the "Nation of Disorder" to "distort" and "tamper" with the corruption onto a rock, which immediately turned into a verdant jade.
Hobert had previously possessed a similar jade, but he had used it up when exploring the second elven ruins with "Hanged Man" Alger.
Although this was a pure Sequence 1 Characteristic, it could also be used as a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
After performing a simple sealing, Hobert named it "0-78" Spiritual Wilderness.
After placing the spoils, Hobert recalled a question he had considered in Yason City: "Chained God's" fall was too quick.
Generally, at the level of King of Angels, even a god would be difficult to kill without an opportunity. How could Farbauti have killed the "Chained God" so easily?
Was it just because Farbauti was well-prepared?
Hobert supported his chin with one arm and sat on the "Iron Throne," recalling some details after Farbauti appeared.
At that time, the "Conch Monster" clearly hadn't shown any threat, so why did Farbauti attack it with the ability of "Corruption?"
Why did the "Chained God" close his eyes and give up resisting after seeing Farbauti?
Recalling one by one the details about the "Chained God," about Farbauti, about the dark side of the universe.
Hobert had a rough guess: The "Chained God" had not completely fallen!
Whether in Hobert's memory or according to the description of the dark side of the universe, the "Chained God's" state was quite bad.
Otherwise, the "Mother Tree of Desire" wouldn't have been able to seize the opportunity to tear off a Sequence 1 Characteristic from Him.
Although there was definitely a trick to it, the mere fact that such a thing happened was enough to illustrate the problem: If he had the ability to resist, how could a King of Angels allow someone to tear off a Sequence 1 Characteristic?
Through his conversation with the dark side of the universe, Hobert learned that the "Chained God" had expelled an "Ancient Bane" Beyonder characteristic himself and used it to create a clone of himself, which bore most of the corruption.
However, because this clone had a strong connection with the "Chained God," it was used by the "Mother Tree of Desire" to summon the "Chained God's" main body when the time was right today, and was preparing to completely corrupt the "Chained God."
The development of the matter also proceeded according to the "Mother Tree of Desire's" plan, except that there was a problem in the final stage. The "Chained God" was killed by Farbauti before being completely corrupted!
With just one step left, the "Mother Tree of Desire" would have obtained the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of the "Chained" pathway that He had been longing for, but at the last moment, it was divided up by Farbauti and Hobert.
All of this seemed to have no major problems, and the result was basically logical.
However, Hobert noticed through recalling the details that the "Conch Monster" did nothing when it saw the "Chained God." It just stared at the "Chained God."
Since this monster was completely controlled by the "Mother Tree of Desire," it should have been attacking the "Chained God" with all its might like Suah!
Hobert guessed that it was very likely that the "Chained God" was helping the "Conch Monster" resist the corruption, or simply that the "Chained God" was absorbing the corruption from the "Conch Monster."
That was why the leaves symbolizing the "Mother Tree of Desire's" corruption were increasing at a visible rate.
The reason why the "Chained God" wanted to absorb the corruption was because He wanted to turn the spirit body in the clone into His "main spirit body."
Tolzna had already called himself the "God of Spiritual Creatures" in the Second Epoch. Even objects could be turned into "spiritual objects," so the operation of transferring life forms was not difficult for Him.
Farbauti realized this, so he used the ability of "Corruption" to strengthen the idea of corruption, or to help the "Chained God" awaken the main consciousness in the "Conch Monster" by strengthening humanity.
After completing this exchange process, because the spirit body in the "Chained God" was already very weak, it was naturally difficult to resist the "Mother Tree of Desire's" invasion.
It looked like He had given up resisting, but in fact, He didn't have enough will to resist.
And the subsequent "Mind Cage" was to cover the escape of the "Conch Monster," or rather, Tolzna.
Hobert believed that there might be some discrepancies in his speculation process, but the result should not be much different: Tolzna had not fallen, but had been reborn at the level of "Ancient Bane." Another certainty was that the corruption in His body had been reduced to a controllable range.
