chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 695 Backlund at War
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After reaching the conclusion that "Chained God" Tolzna had been reborn, Hobert turned his attention to the matter of "Devil Monarch" Farbauti obtaining the uniqueness of the "Chained" pathway.
This god had a supreme special skill: super survivability!
Having lived from the Second Epoch to the Fifth Epoch, if nothing unexpected happened, perhaps He could continue to live on.
Throughout the long years, He should have had the opportunity to come into contact with ways to become a Great Old One and strived for it.
This should be His core plan to fight against the "Mother Tree of Desire": to become a Great Old One Himself.
Only by becoming a Great Old One could He possess the authority and ability to deal with a Great Old One.
Farbauti already possessed the uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics of the "Abyss" pathway and had now obtained the uniqueness of the "Chained" pathway.
Moreover, during the War of the Gods between "Sanguine Ancestor" Lilith and "Annihilation Demonic Wolf" and "Mutant King" in the Second Epoch, Farbauti had already obtained a portion of the Beyonder characteristics of a "Abomination," and He probably didn't truly offer it as a sacrifice to the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
Then, the preparatory work in terms of uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics had been completed. The only unknown was whether He had found clues corresponding to the origin substance "Tenebrous World" in the long years.
As long as it wasn't someone from his own pathway or an adjacent pathway wanting to become a Great Old One, Hobert would support the emergence of more Outer Deities from the Earth gods, even if this Old One symbolized evil and demons, it was acceptable.
Taking another look at the spoils of this battle, Hobert took a deep breath and left the "Nation of Disorder."
It wasn't until the next day that the Beyonders completely finished exploring and cleaning up Yason City. Indeed, some underground buildings still harbored some monsters.
In fact, they weren't originally monsters; they were just residents hiding from the flames of war in their own basements.
During yesterday's battle, it wasn't that Hobert didn't want to save people, but that He simply didn't have the ability or the time to save them.
Whether it was the "Mother Tree of Desire," the "Chained God," or the "Abomination" Suah, they didn't care about the lives of these ordinary people. Under their efforts, the people of the entire city had been turned into monsters.
After Hobert's subordinates gathered the spoils of war, the Beyonder responsible for counting the spoils noticed that three demigod-level Beyonder characteristics were missing from the expected amount, meaning that three demigods had escaped from the city yesterday.
In the hands of the official Beyonders of South Balam, there was a detailed intelligence report on the demigods of the "Rose School of Thought," which Xio had provided.
The period from the civil war in the Duchy of South Balam to the start of this war of national annihilation was Xio's main battlefield.
Xio, who had obtained the opportunity to digest her potion in advance by judging George III, was now a "Imperative Mage."
Before the war of national annihilation, she repeatedly led teams to infiltrate the Highland Kingdom, conducting on-site surveys to create a map of the Highland Kingdom, which was even more detailed than the maps used by the Highland Kingdom itself.
Upon receiving this map, Hobert suddenly lamented: "Only invaders are so enthusiastic about other countries' territories."
Archibald, who was beside him, was about to remind Hobert that they were going to liberate the people of the Highland Kingdom and shouldn't call themselves invaders.
However, he discovered that Grand Duke Hobert's emotions seemed off. He only heard Hobert say: "Fortunately, we are that invader. Fortunately, we don't adhere to the concept of 'racial evolution.' Fortunately, we are not trying to establish some bullshit co-prosperity sphere."
Archibald didn't know why the Grand Duke would express such sentiments, but he swallowed back the reminder he had prepared.
Xio had also obtained a large amount of extraordinary intelligence by bribing nobles of the Highland Kingdom, which included an information table summarizing the number and names of the existing demigods of the "Rose School of Thought."
By comparing the spoils of war with the information in this table, it was easy to find that one "Disciple of Silence" and two "Puppet" Beyonder characteristics were missing.
Perhaps these three demigods didn't flee in a panic during the chaos but knew Suah's plan, so they left immediately when that "Conch Monster" was summoned.
Hobert didn't take it too seriously because there would be opportunities to kill these demigods in the ensuing second phase of the war.
When Hobert first met Medici, Medici frankly said: "The current Beyonders are no longer clear about what national annihilation represents."
"National annihilation is not just driving away the rulers. The most difficult thing to deal with is the Beyonders of that country."
Medici's remarks afterward made Hobert realize what professionalism meant.
According to Medici's plan, after eliminating the enemy's main force in the first phase of the war, the most urgent task was to uproot the Beyonders everywhere.
To put it bluntly, the local Beyonder forces were the local nobles. They, together with the "Rose School of Thought," monopolized the resources of the Highland Kingdom. If they were not eliminated during the war, they would have to be won over after the war by making political compromises to them.
To prevent such a situation from occurring, Medici proposed the "give them time" plan, which was also the core purpose of besieging Yason City without attacking.
First, give the reinforcements composed of nobles from various places time to come to support, trying to annihilate them under Yason City.
When the local nobles no longer had Beyonders as their power support, once South Balam's current national policy was implemented after the war, it would be easier to make them lose their ruling foundation.
Medici gave the nobles of the Highland Kingdom a total of one week. The Beyonders of the nobles from various places basically gathered in the capital of the Highland Kingdom and were all wiped out in yesterday's angel war.
Secondly, during the same week, the subsequent conventional army of the Duchy of South Balam occupied the Highland Kingdom, causing the nobles from various places to flee north, and the remaining few nobles could be immediately controlled.
This completely cut off the nobles' extraordinary potential in various places.
When these small Beyonder families suddenly lost their territory and source of income, they basically had no future prospects.
This idea was like Hobert forcing the Loen proxies to rebel. The foundation of establishing a country was to eliminate all Beyonder forces within that country except for oneself.
The above was the combat mission of the first phase. Medici also prepared a "second package" for the Highland Kingdom and the "Rose School of Thought."
That was the combat plan for the second phase. Medici planned to repeatedly capture Colon City in the northern part of the Highland Kingdom in the next three to four months.
Colon City was an important hub in the north. Capturing it would divide the remaining one-third of the Highland Kingdom's territory into two.
This extraordinary war didn't need to be fought with full force. It was enough to send out two Beyonder teams.
Firstly, the main force was not needed at all. Secondly, it was to create the illusion that most of the strength was being restrained, creating a reason for the subsequent active retreat.
Moreover, the speed of the attack should be slow, and the enemy must be given enough reaction time!
After the war was launched, the next step should be taken by observing the enemy's reaction.
If the enemy concentrated the remaining forces in Colon City, it meant that they wanted to protect the last piece of territory. After all, a Beyonder organization without a base would be greatly reduced in terms of financial resources and potential.
At this time, Colon City should be attacked slowly, bit by bit. The city walls couldn't stop the Beyonders. In Medici's view, they could constantly sneak into the city, exhausting the enemy's gathered forces as much as possible.
Although the "Rose School of Thought" had been badly damaged, according to Medici's experience, such an organization with a base had enough financial resources to set up its strongholds in various countries of the Northern Continent.
Constant fighting was to force them to recall the forces in their strongholds in various countries.
In addition, the nobles of the Highland Kingdom would definitely work harder than the "Rose School of Thought" in this battle. After the "Rose School of Thought" left the Highland Kingdom, there was still Suah.
With this "Abomination" present, no matter where they went, they were an organization that other forces would not dare to underestimate.
But the nobles were very clear that they would be nothing after leaving the Highland Kingdom.
Therefore, in this war, they would contribute as much strength as they had.
Medici planned that the first attack time would be ten days. After these ten days of continuous attacks, if they could not capture Colon City, they would temporarily retreat. After resting for a few days, they would continue to attack the city with another two Beyonder teams.
If they captured the city, they would plunder it and then find a seemingly reasonable reason to withdraw, waiting for ten days or half a month before attacking again.
Medici believed that the second phase of the war would take at least three months, and Colon City would have to be captured at least five times!
After five months, it would definitely be very easy to occupy the remaining one-third of the Highland Kingdom's territory. By then, the "Rose School of Thought" would probably only have Suah Atote and some low-sequence Beyonders left, and all the nobles would have no extraordinary power to speak of.
In Medici's words: "This is a perfect war of national annihilation."
Of course, the "Rose School of Thought" must still have Beyonder forces left in the Highland Kingdom, but these forces were already very weak. When they secretly cultivated a batch of "Mid Sequence" Beyonders again, they would find that the Duchy of South Balam had already established a solid extraordinary order.
Although their strength had been somewhat restored, they still had to continue to survive secretly.
This was the most perfect plan, but if Colon City was captured once, the enemy would be unwilling to defend it when attacking Colon City for the second time.
Or if the enemy didn't plan to defend this city when the first attack occurred, then all forces should be immediately dispatched to occupy the remaining territory.
This meant that whether it was the "Rose School of Thought" or the nobles of the Highland Kingdom, they had already prepared to abandon the Highland Kingdom.
At this time, they had to race against time, occupy the remaining territory as soon as possible, and build an extraordinary order as soon as possible.
Because the members of the "Rose School of Thought" and the nobles of the Highland Kingdom will definitely establish a government-in-exile. No matter how bad the reputation of the "Rose School of Thought" was before, people will support them.
When they are settled, the first thing they will do is secretly send Beyonder forces to the Highland Kingdom to carry out sabotage and restoration operations.
At this time, if the official Beyonders have already established a foundation of rule, they will not be threatened in their rule over the Duchy of Southern Balam.
When Hobert heard Medici's entire plan, he sighed inwardly: This is what is called "He who does not plan for the whole, is not fit to plan for a part."
It was also because he heard Medici's plan that Hobert intended to try to absorb this "Red Angel". Now Hobert's team lacks this kind of war thinking.
For the second stage of the war of annihilation, Hobert intends to let Medici fight freely, but as soon as the war is over, military power must be taken back.
Outside of the war, Hobert asked Conrad and Donna to do a good job in logistics. In addition to providing sufficient materials, they also had to provide enough grassroots officials to quickly control the Highland Kingdom.
Theoretically speaking, the Duchy of Southern Balam has just completed land reform and occupied so much territory, and there are not enough people at all.
However, the universities that have been moving in since the beginning of the year have brought enough senior intellectuals to the government.
Donna then proposed a talent transition plan for college students to enter grassroots work, sending people to universities to promote national policies, and organizing them to study in various parts of the Duchy of Southern Balam, and finally recruiting graduating college students.
After seeing the national policies of the Duchy of Southern Balam, many young people will definitely be willing to devote themselves to this vigorous transformation.
Hobert was quite satisfied with this plan. At the same time, He suggested that such publicity should be normalized, and that all universities should offer relevant courses in political science, so as to continuously provide fresh blood to the government.
With the problem of officials solved, as long as one or two months are spent completing the land reform, the crippled Highland Kingdom will no longer want to take back its rule.
In addition, Hobert ordered Xio to investigate the transfer of property by the nobles of the Highland Kingdom.
In the spoils seized in Yason City, there are also massive amounts of gold and a large number of gold pounds.
Hobert didn't expect that the nobles of such a semi-colonial and semi-feudal country would be so rich!
Previously, in the first stage of the war, a large number of nobles fled north. When Medici carries out the second stage of the operation, they will definitely transfer their assets abroad as soon as possible.
The ways to transfer assets abroad are nothing more than buying land, buying mines, or exchanging gold for gold pounds.
As long as a transaction occurs, it is easy to find the process of asset transfer.
Then, after the domestic battle is over, it will be Xio's intelligence department's turn to start working.
Hobert's plan is to find these nobles and discuss with them to donate all their assets to the country. If they are willing to "donate", they can be spared their lives.
If they are unwilling to donate, then they may drown while taking a bath, or they may fall to their death while riding a horse, or they may be inexplicably beaten to death while walking on the street.
After resting for a few days, as Medici led more than one hundred Beyonders and dozens of logistics personnel to march north openly, the second stage of the war officially began.
Hobert, together with Conrad and Donna, who arrived later, discussed the matter of repairing Yason City.
This city has convenient transportation in all directions, and it will definitely be able to prosper again in the future.
However, Conrad suggested that some office spaces should be repaired first, and large-scale repairs should be carried out after there are enough people. After all, the construction of Anjal City will not be completed for more than a month, and building materials from all over the country are being transported there.
In the newly occupied areas, the priority is to solve the problems of measuring land, registering assets, and completing the land revolution as soon as possible.
Fortunately, for the Duchy government, this kind of thing is already familiar, and Hobert simply discussed a few words with them, and did not continue to ask.
In the next ten days or so, Hobert stayed in Yason City, and if he encountered tricky problems, he could quickly organize relevant personnel to solve them.
Medici's first round of attacks ended as scheduled. In the past ten days of fighting, they successfully killed two more demigods and dozens of other sequence Beyonders from the other side.
Medici did not capture Colon City, leaving it for next time.
According to his estimation, it may not take five times. As long as Colon City is attacked three times in the current mode, the extraordinary potential of the "Rose School of Thought" and the nobles of the Highland Kingdom can be squeezed dry.
Since the second round of the war went smoothly, Hobert left Yason City with peace of mind and returned to Backlund for a few days of rest.
… …
The countries of the Northern Continent have different evaluations of the Duchy of Southern Balam's capture of the capital of the Highland Kingdom in a short period of time.
First of all, the first reaction of various countries was surprise. After all, Loen, Feysac, and Intis all tried to invade the Highland Kingdom from different directions, so as to destroy this kingdom whose territory has shrunk severely compared to more than a hundred years ago.
But without exception, they all failed, because this country has the support of the "Rose School of Thought", or the support of angels, and can always hold on to a piece of territory.
Therefore, the Duchy of Southern Balam has achieved such a great victory in a short period of time. Everyone was surprised first, and then showed different reactions.
The Kingdom of Feynapotter was very fortunate that it did not respond to the call of the Feysac Empire to join the Allied Forces during the civil war in the Duchy of Southern Balam.
If they really joined the Allied Forces, they would have to face the increasingly strong Duchy of Southern Balam at this time, and before the end of the full-scale war in the Northern Continent, no country has the strength to open up a new battlefield in the Southern Continent.
The Feysac Empire breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, it had completed the peace talks with the Duchy of Southern Balam. Otherwise, if the Duchy of Southern Balam wanted to take revenge, I am afraid that the colonies in the central part of the Southern Continent would not be safe.
Now that the Duchy of Southern Balam has chosen to avenge the Highland Kingdom first, then they have enough strategic space.
According to the speculation of the Empire's Strategic Department, in the next year or two, the main force of the Duchy of Southern Balam will not be able to withdraw from the Highland Kingdom.
When the Intis Republic heard that the Duchy of Southern Balam had begun to attack the Highland Kingdom, it wanted to join forces with the Feysac Empire again to organize a counterattack from the southern colonies.
However, the news that the Duchy of Southern Balam had defeated the main force of the "Rose School of Thought" soon came out, which caused Intis's plan to be cancelled as soon as it started.
Now they also plan to negotiate peace with the Duchy of Southern Balam through the "Earl's Light".
Only the Kingdom of Loen is not optimistic about this victory, and some newspapers even commented: The Duchy of Southern Balam has used its power in the wrong direction!
The implication is, since the Duchy of Southern Balam has this strength, why not attack the colonies of the Feysac Empire and the Intis Republic? Why not come to support the battle in the Northern Continent?
The Kingdom of Loen is about to be unable to hold on.
At this time, the Church of Steam and Machinery, which has always been neutral, seems to have realized that Loen's only ally has also fallen into the quagmire of war.
So they suddenly declared that they would provide technical support for the Intis Republic's army in terms of weapons.
This is equivalent to announcing that the Steam Church has finally chosen to support the Intis Republic.
The next day, the figures of Steam Church Beyonders appeared on the western battlefield of the Kingdom of Loen.
Before long, the western front of the Kingdom of Loen, which had been holding on for more than three months, was breached, and then the army was defeated like a mountain. The Loen army was quickly driven out of the central plateau and could only concentrate its forces in the Intis Republic and quickly establish a defense line on the Tucker Plain.
But everyone knows that fighting on the plains is about the number of troops, and Loen is currently at a huge disadvantage in this regard, and this plain will soon be lost.
… …
Backlund in March has begun to warm up, and because there is wind, it can temporarily disperse the fog of this international metropolis.
In the Duke's mansion, Hobert sat on the terrace on the second floor, reading the newspaper leisurely.
There are few reports in the newspapers about the situation on the western front, only saying that the defenders will definitely be able to continue to hold their ground.
Hobert smiled slightly. In the blink of an eye, the war has been going on for half a year, and Loen has done a good job to be able to hold on until now.
Dang dang dang ~
At this time, the clock in the study rang. Hobert put down the newspaper and used "Distortion" space to come to the office of the financial director of "Earl's Light".
Audrey had already changed into relatively simple clothes and changed her appearance with sealed artifacts.
Hobert asked with a smile: "Are you ready?"
"Ready." Audrey said in a clear voice.
Today, Hobert will accompany Audrey to participate in an anti-war parade and take the "Manipulator" potion in the midst of everyone's anti-war emotions.
Hobert was about to "Distort" space, but Audrey suddenly asked: "Hobert, I heard that the Backlund night market is closed?"
"Yes." Hobert nodded: "I heard that it was forcibly closed at the beginning of the war."
Audrey said "Oh" and took Hobert's arm.
Hobert raised his hand, and they disappeared from the office in an instant, appearing the next second in the corner of a street in St. George's District, Backlund.
Not far away were crowds of people constantly shouting anti-war slogans. Hobert temporarily "Distorted" their vision so that they did not notice himself and Audrey.
Then the two naturally joined the marching team, which had enough ten thousand people from the beginning to the end of the street.
The ritual required for Audrey's advancement is: in a specific occasion with at least ten thousand people, take the potion in the great resonance of their emotions.
And now everyone's emotions have great resonance.
Hobert said: "Take the potion as soon as possible, the police may come to disperse them in a while."
Audrey nodded, took out the prepared potion, and drank it all in one gulp. In that instant, she was surrounded by intense dissatisfaction and sorrow, which also kept her consciousness very clear, and she quickly regained herself under the influence of the potion.
After only about a minute of confrontation, Audrey had controlled the overflowing spirituality.
Hobert smiled and said, "More smoothly than expected."
As He was about to leave with Audrey, Audrey suddenly looked at the crowd chanting slogans and said, "Hobert, can you help them?"
Hobert looked at the long procession and took a deep breath, saying, "Unless they are willing to immigrate to the Duchy of Southern Balam."
The people participating in the parade were the unemployed in the war and those who had lost their loved ones in the war.
The loss of the industrial zone on the southern coast of Midseashire meant that a large number of factories lacked corresponding raw materials or parts, and factories that did not involve military industry were shut down.
A large number of workers lost their jobs and could not even afford bread, and could only go to relief stations to receive some bread to fill their stomachs.
So even though the price of food in Backlund is not high at present, the number of vagrants sleeping on the streets is increasing, and the number of people suffering from hunger is also increasing.
Those who were willing to immigrate to the Southern Continent to gamble have already moved away, or are in the process of immigrating.
And there are two types of people participating in the parade today. One type is those who still have hope for this country. They are unwilling to start over in the wild Southern Continent.
The other type is those who have lost loved ones in the war. They want to vent their grief and indignation by shouting in the procession.
Hobert couldn't help them.
Audrey also understood the reason, so she didn't say anything more.
In the next second, the two disappeared from the procession without attracting anyone's attention.
At this time, a whistle came from a distance, and the police rushed over and began to rudely disperse the crowd.
Some people in the crowd also fought back, and the scene was chaotic for a while.
… …
Hobert and Audrey returned to the CFO's office, chatted briefly, and Hobert went to the general manager's office to inquire about the recent operation of "Earl's Light" from Todd.
"Everything is normal," Todd said with a smile. "Our business has not been affected in any way. With the defeat on the Western Front, I have sent people to the west to acquire the power plants and other supporting factories that were previously built, as well as cheap real estate."
When Hobert initially expanded the business of "Earl's Light", he had made corresponding arrangements and did not invest in the north and west.
Todd admired Hobert's "foresight" immensely. The war had been going on for so long, but all the businesses of "Earl's Light" had not been greatly affected.
Then he talked about the overseas business. Currently, the business in Intis and Feynapotter has also begun to make profits. "Earl's Light" has not only not been affected by the war, but has become more and more wealthy.
They talked until about five o'clock in the afternoon, when Hobert and Audrey got off work together and then took Audrey's carriage home.
They had agreed to be guests at Earl Hall's house today.
In the carriage, Hobert saw that Audrey seemed to have something on her mind, so he asked, "Are you having any problems at work?"
Usually, Audrey hides her inner thoughts very well, but this afternoon, because she had just advanced, her spirituality was not very stable, so she sometimes deviated from the "Spectator" state.
"No," Audrey took a deep breath and said, "This morning I met a vagrant. I remember she was a stall owner at the night market."
Only then did Hobert understand why Audrey had asked about the night market before.
Audrey added, "I asked her about it and found out that many of the night market stall owners have gone bankrupt due to the loss of their source of income."
"This is inevitable," Hobert comforted. "The war is affecting everyone on both sides of the conflict."
He hadn't felt this way before, but today, sitting in the carriage, he noticed that there were so many idle people on the streets. Soon, they would also become vagrants because they couldn't afford bread or pay rent.
In the grain war around the New Year, the price of grain in Backlund was almost the same as before the war. Now, more than two months have passed, and the price of grain has increased slightly again.
Before this, Hobert optimistically estimated that most of the citizens of Backlund had grain reserves, and that all the grain shops in Backlund still had a lot of grain. This international metropolis should not experience any tragedies due to lack of food.
Now Hobert realized that he had overestimated the governance ability of the Loen government.
At this time, if they don't quickly start some public welfare construction projects to absorb these unemployed vagrants, sooner or later they will become unstable factors.
Audrey added, "Why is it that the Duchy of Southern Balam has been almost unaffected even though there is also a war?"
The immigration campaign in the Duchy of Southern Balam is still continuing, and a large amount of food is being distributed every day.
The two huge construction sites are also operating normally, consuming a large amount of vegetables and bread every day.
Audrey sometimes couldn't understand how this country could operate normally while supporting hundreds of thousands of people with no source of income?
Hobert smiled and said, "Because our strategic thinking is different. I had the confidence of victory before I launched the war."
"The countries of the Northern Continent are different. The wars they launch are more like a gamble with all the bets on the table. Strategic thinking is always a bit impulsive."
"In addition, the governments of various countries are not adequately prepared for a series of reactions caused by the war. Even if they are adequately prepared, they don't take the lives and deaths of ordinary people too seriously, so they simply pretend not to see the situation on the streets."
Speaking of this, Hobert looked out the car window and said, "It's still the same sentence, unless they themselves are willing to immigrate to the Duchy of Southern Balam, I can't help them."
Audrey sighed, "Maybe I should change my thinking. Fortunately, there is still the Duchy of Southern Balam, providing survival guarantees for those who are willing to immigrate."
Hobert smiled, "The situation in the Northern Continent has developed to this point, we do need to be more optimistic."
During the conversation, the carriage arrived at Earl Hall's mansion, and Hobert was warmly welcomed by the Hall family.
During dinner, they inevitably talked about the war on the Western Front.
"The Loen military has begun to build positions in the Balchis Mountains west of Backlund," Earl Hall said to Hobert. "Pay attention to the risk of investment."
The Balchis Mountains are at the end of the Tucker Plain and are the last barrier west of Backlund.
In other words, the Loen high command has prepared to abandon the Tucker Plain.
Hobert smiled and said, "Thank you for your reminder, I will pay attention."
Earl Hall was reminding Hobert of the investment in those areas that were about to become occupied territories. In his opinion, the investment risk was too great.
Hobert continued to eat. He thought of another thing: when this international granary falls into the hands of the enemy, the price of grain in Backlund will skyrocket again.
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled and shook his head. The Duchy of Southern Balam still has a lot of things to do, and there is no time to take care of the ordinary people of Backlund.
Previously, He promoted Longtail Island on the one hand and suppressed grain prices on the other. He had done everything he could.
If the people who believed in the advancement of Longtail Island would think of immigrating to the Duchy of Southern Balam when they went bankrupt.
If the people who bought cheap grain were grateful to Hobert for providing them with affordable food, then out of basic trust, they would also think of immigrating to the Duchy of Southern Balam after accidentally going bankrupt.
And now, the people who are still unwilling to immigrate and "stick" to Backlund are those who neither believe in the advancement of Longtail Island nor appreciate Hobert's kindness.
That's why Hobert has been emphasizing to Audrey that he can only help them if they are willing to immigrate.
The following conversation revolved around the war in the Duchy of Southern Balam. Like the previous civil war, the people of the Northern Continent hardly knew the details of this war.
Of course, Hobert couldn't tell them about the battle of extraordinary powers. He lied that he had found a military genius, so the war had been very smooth from the beginning.
Audrey, who was listening, took a deep breath: The "God of Combat" is of course a military genius!
After dinner, the family took a walk in the garden as usual.
This time, Earl Hall suddenly proposed to talk to Hobert alone. Hobert was slightly stunned and had to follow, discussing some business issues of "Earl's Light" with Earl Hall.
After talking for a while, Earl Hall brought up a topic about nobles. Hobert listened for a while before realizing that the Earl was subtly reminding Him through this topic, hoping to let Him and Audrey get married in the near future.
Hobert did not immediately agree, but said that he would seriously consider it.
It's not that He deliberately made things difficult for Earl Hall, but in this kind of matter, He should tell Christian first before agreeing, both emotionally and logically.
Hobert bid farewell to the Hall family at more than nine o'clock in the evening and returned to the Duke's Mansion. Hobert continued to pick up the newspaper on the terrace, sighing as he read, "War is affecting everyone on all sides of the conflict, including me."
At this time, His vision was suddenly covered by a cosmos, and a soothing female voice came from His ear: "Get ready, complete the task owed before tomorrow."
Previously, Hobert prayed for the help of the Evernight Goddess, and the Evernight Goddess said that the reward she needed was to help Him complete a task.
I didn't expect that this task had been waiting for so long before it was issued.
Hobert nodded: "Okay. As long as it is a task that my current sequence can complete, please feel free to order."
Then He wondered in His heart: Shouldn't the Evernight Goddess be putting on a look of fully accommodating the uniqueness of the "Death" pathway at this time? How can she still have time to command me?
In the next moment, Hobert thought again: Perhaps the task the Goddess entrusted to him was very important to Her.
At this moment, the cosmos in front of Hobert disappeared, and he was stunned for a full three seconds: "What exactly is the task? Tell me!"
Hobert belatedly realized: Could it be that the preconditions I mentioned just now angered the Evernight Goddess and made Her leave?
Just then, opposite Hobert, a figure suddenly appeared, like an image projected by a malfunctioning projector, appearing bit by bit from head to toe.
He was wearing a simple robe, tied with a bark belt, and barefoot, it was Ms. Arianna.
Hobert immediately stood up and said, "Madam."
Arianna smiled and said, "I believe you have already received the Goddess's oracle."
Hobert sighed inwardly: Are all gods like this? They are unwilling to say even one extra word?
He said, "Yes, it said to give me a task."
Arianna raised her hand, and Hobert's spirituality felt the surrounding space enter a state of "Concealment."
Hobert invited Arianna to sit down, but this "Servant of Concealment" shook her head: "The task is very simple."
He said: "You need to go to the Eastern Front battlefield tomorrow and seize a Sealed Artifact from the Church of the God of Combat."
"This Sealed Artifact is in the hands of Larrion... that is, the angel of the Church of the God of Combat that you went to intercept last time."
"He has only started using that Sealed Artifact in the last few days, so be careful not to be targeted by that Sealed Artifact, otherwise you will be corrupted by the stars."
"Okay." Hobert understood that the Sealed Artifact probably had the corruption of an Outer God, but because he had the "Crystal of Order", he was generally not afraid of this kind of corruption, so the Evernight Goddess asked him to seize the Sealed Artifact.
Arianna continued: "You can go to York City tomorrow morning. Bin, who greeted you before, will be waiting for you at the city gate. He will take you to find Larrion."
Hobert nodded and asked, "Does the Church of the God of Combat value this Sealed Artifact very much? If I seize this Sealed Artifact, will it attract other angels?"
"It is considered relatively important, otherwise it would not be given to an angel to use." Arianna replied: "We will hold back the other angels, Larrion will not receive support at the angel level, you can concentrate on seizing the Sealed Artifact."
"But be quick, it is best to grab it within three minutes."
Hobert scratched his head. He would definitely have to use his lackeys. He was not confident that he could grab something from a "Glory" alone within three minutes.
Hobert asked again: "What is the shape of this Sealed Artifact? What specific abilities does it have?"
"I don't know." Arianna said: "Everyone who has seen it is dead, and Larrion has not yet used it to deal with our angels, so we don't know the specific situation."
"Only some relevant descriptions have been seen in some materials: do not be targeted by that Sealed Artifact, otherwise you will be corrupted by the stars."
Hobert opened his mouth: "This sounds very dangerous."
Arianna smiled and said, "I also brought a Curse Amulet. This was given by the Goddess before and should be able to help you."
As she spoke, he took out a dark black amulet from his pocket.
Hobert's spirituality immediately realized that this was a "God-level" amulet!
After taking the amulet, he thought to himself: Then it's stable.
After sending Arianna away, Hobert studied the amulet in his hand again. He could not feel any spiritual overflow from the amulet, nor could he feel any extraordinary power. It felt like a black stone!
But Hobert was very clear that this was definitely not a stone!
Then Hobert actually loved it a little: A "God-level" amulet, the Evernight Goddess has spent a lot of money to seize that Sealed Artifact.
You must know that a God-level amulet can only be made with God-level materials.
For example, the Evernight Goddess's hair, flesh and blood, etc. At this level, there are no corresponding Beyonder creatures, only the gods themselves!
After looking at it for a while, Hobert suddenly yawned: "The amulet actually has a sleep-aiding effect, I can sleep well tonight."
After a good night's sleep, Hobert put on his knight's uniform early the next morning and came to York City as agreed, and met Bin who was already waiting at the city gate.
Bin immediately greeted him and said, "Duke, I just received news that the target's traces have been found at the Amantha Mountain Pass!"

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 696: The Mission Given by the Goddess
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Currently, the three battle lines of the Loen Kingdom on land are as follows: the western line has been breached, the northern line is still in a stalemate in industrial cities like Constanta, and only the eastern line remains as solid as a rock, showing no signs of being captured.
This is inseparable from the fact that the headquarters of the Church of the Evernight Goddess is located in the Amantha Mountains on the eastern front. The main force of the Church of the God of Combat is also here, constantly trying to break through the eastern front, but has not succeeded.
The extraordinary war between the two sides has been very fierce. Demigod battles occur almost every day in the Amantha Mountains and at the mountain pass, and occasionally even bring about confrontations between the angels of both sides.
Just now, military personnel witnessed Larrion appearing at the Amantha Pass.
Hobert quickly got into the zone: "Let's go to the mountain pass and take a look."
As he spoke, he waved his hand, using the power of "Distortion", and the two instantly entered the spirit world.
Bin was slightly stunned, curious as to what kind of space magic this was?
Immediately afterwards, he pondered for a moment before realizing that this should be the manifestation of the "Lawyer" ability at the angel level.
In just a few seconds, the two had already arrived at the Amantha Pass.
Bin thought in his heart: It's faster than "Travel".
Of course it's faster. In Hobert's opinion, there are shortcuts everywhere in the spirit world.
Bin quickly calmed down and led Hobert to a military demigod.
"About half an hour ago, there were many non-combat attrition cases in the eastern positions. After we went to understand the situation, we speculated based on the appearance and other information described by the eyewitnesses that Larrion of the Church of the God of Combat had passed through there and entered the Minsk Mountains," the demigod in military uniform reported concisely.
Hobert was slightly stunned: "Ordinary soldiers saw Larrion?"
"Yes."
Hobert asked again: "How are those soldiers now?"
The demigod showed a helpless smile: "More than half of the entire regiment of six hundred people have died, and the remaining half are living worse than death."
The angels of the Loen royal family are very busy, constantly traveling between the western and northern fronts. The angels of the Church of the Evernight Goddess are also ready to confront the angels of the Church of the God of Combat at any time. They have no time to care about the lives and deaths of these ordinary soldiers.
Hobert said: "Take me to see."
The military demigod immediately said: "Yes!"
After the demigod pointed out a direction, Hobert immediately "distorted" their position and arrived at a trench filled with a foul stench.
The soldiers in the Trunsoest were either so old that they were unrecognizable, or covered in festering black tumors, constantly oozing pus with a foul odor. They were all waiting to die in agony.
Hobert raised his hand and "bestowed" the aging and festering caused by the influence of the Twilight power on their bodies to the rocks and trees in the distance.
Those trees instantly turned withered and yellow, and the rocks instantly cracked.
The pain on the bodies of the soldiers who were already waiting to die suddenly disappeared. Some of them couldn't believe it, repeatedly touching their rejuvenated faces, and immediately cheered.
The military demigod said to them: "Come and thank Duke Hobert. He brought the special medicine that saved you."
Previously, they had lied that these soldiers had been harmed by some kind of poison gas, which was why they had become like this.
Hobert smiled and waved, responding to the soldiers' gratitude, and then learned about the scene they had just seen from them.
After the three returned to the command post, Hobert asked the military demigod: "Does Loen have any strongholds or defense lines in the Minsk Mountains?"
The military demigod replied: "No, what we just saw is already the easternmost position."
Hobert frowned: "Then it's strange. Why would Larrion show the influence of an angel level in front of ordinary soldiers?"
"This is equivalent to telling us that He has entered the Minsk Mountains."
The military demigod was stunned for a moment before saying: "Duke, you may not understand very well, but currently, the angels and demigods on both sides will definitely pollute or influence ordinary soldiers if they have the opportunity, so as to weaken the opponent's power."
He took a deep breath: "Now, for both sides, soldiers are the most expensive strategic resource."
Positions need soldiers to attack and defend, and weapons need soldiers to use them. Now the training time for soldiers has been shortened to twenty days, but in the eyes of the higher-ups, it still takes a lot of time and resources to train a soldier who won't immediately die inexplicably on the battlefield.
Hobert was stunned for a second or two, and suddenly, as if asking himself and also asking the military demigod: "Now that the war has reached this point, what is the meaning?"
But He seemed to just ask this question and didn't intend to get an answer from here.
After sighing, Hobert said to the military demigod again: "I see."
"In other words, there's no need to pay special attention to Larrion's actions."
Just as Hobert was about to leave with Bin, the military demigod suddenly said: "Duke, I've recently heard some comments about Longtail Island. Are those...are those comments true?"
"You can go find Locker of the Air Force," Hobert said. "He has a special pass that can take you to Longtail Island for a visit."
The military demigod was slightly stunned before nodding: "Okay, I'll go take a look."
Previously, because of the sneak attack on Saint Millon, a group of "Creator" believers, led by Locker, emerged in the Air Force. Later, Hobert assisted in defending Pritz Harbor, and another group of "Creator" believers joined the Navy.
Not long ago, Hobert heard Locker say that there was also a group of officers in the Army who yearned for the Southern Balam Duchy.
This is not difficult to understand. With the death of a large number of soldiers, the officers will definitely think about the meaning of this war, and then they will find that this war is meaningless!
If there were no publicity about Longtail Island, they would still be looking for a way out in confusion. Now the "Longtail Island Model" provides them with a new idea, and of course they will do their best to learn more about it.
Hobert left the position with Bin and quickly entered the Minsk Mountains.
This place is sparsely populated, and the ice and snow in some places have not yet melted.
Hobert stopped on a ridge, in front of him was an endless primeval forest, and there was no trace of Larrion at all.
Just as Hobert was preparing to wait for an opportunity again, he found a team of Loen soldiers in the valley, searching forward very vigilantly.
Hobert brought Bin to the front of them, creating the illusion of an encounter.
Of course, encountering a Loen Duke and the Archbishop of the Church of the Evernight Goddess in this kind of place sounds a bit unbelievable.
However, Hobert used the ability of "Charm", which greatly increased their goodwill towards Hobert and did not notice this problem.
The leader of this team of soldiers was a Captain Egbert, a Sequence 7 "Interrogator". He looked to be in his twenties, very strong, and with a shrewd look on his face.
"I didn't expect to meet the Duke and Archbishop here," the young Egbert smiled. "With the blessing of the Goddess, our mission will definitely be completed smoothly this time."
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth: The Goddess used to be the "Goddess of Misfortune", I seriously doubt whether she can bless "successful completion of the mission".
Hobert looked at the other 12 team members. Their equipment was good, and they all looked like veterans. While the commander was talking to Hobert, they were constantly guarding the surroundings with a clear division of labor. In addition, there were three Beyonders among them, with Sequences 9 and 8 respectively.
He asked: "What mission do you have in the deep mountains?"
While asking, He re-examined the soldiers. His spirituality told Him that something seemed wrong here, but He couldn't say what was wrong.
Under the effect of "Charm", Captain Egbert did not hide anything and pointed to the top of the mountain over there: "There is a hidden watchtower across two mountains, responsible for watching the situation in Midseashire, and then using telegrams to report the observed information."
"This watchtower has provided a lot of valuable information for the northern battlefield, but about a month ago, the watchtower was discovered by the enemy. After several rounds of fighting with the Feysac army, we finally abandoned it five days ago."
"But just two days ago, we actually received a distress signal from the watchtower again."
"It is very likely that during the previous battle, some soldiers were forced to hide in the forest, and now they don't know that we have abandoned it."
"After we sent a retreat order via telegram, the other party sent another distress signal. We suspect that their telegraph machine may be broken and unable to receive telegrams."
"So the headquarters ordered our 12 people to bring the other party back."
Hobert felt that something was wrong again, which made Him realize that there must be a problem with this mission.
He looked at these young faces, and then thought of the soldiers who had been wailing in the Trunsoest just now.
Hobert took a deep breath and said to Bin: "Let's accompany them to the watchtower first. Tell me immediately if there is any new eyewitness news."
Generally, after there is an eyewitness report, it will first be reported to the angel of the Church of the Evernight Goddess in a prayer, and then Bin will be notified by the angel.
Bin was slightly stunned, but immediately nodded and said: "Okay."
Hobert asked Captain Egbert: "You just said, which direction is the watchtower in?"
"It's in that direction," Egbert pointed out a direction: "You have to cross two mountain peaks."
Hobert smiled: "You remembered wrong. Look, isn't the watchtower right in front of us?"
He "distorted" the surrounding space, and the scenery on both sides flashed backwards. In an instant, he "crossed" two mountain peaks and arrived in front of a watchtower with obvious traces of battle.
The soldiers were all stunned. Hobert "tampered" with their thinking, making them feel that this process was very reasonable.
"That's fast," Egbert smiled slightly: "We originally planned to arrive here in the evening, but I didn't expect to arrive in the morning."
Hobert glanced at the watchtower and suddenly waved towards it.
Bang, bang, bang~
Suddenly, several gunshots rang out from the watchtower, but without exception, the bullets fired from it were "tampered with" and flew into the sky.
Egbert gestured, and he and the soldiers immediately assumed a combat posture, cooperating very skillfully to attack the watchtower.
Hobert did not follow in, but looked at the surrounding environment. It was on a downward slope, surrounded by dense woods, making it indeed difficult to spot.
The color of the watchtower should have been specially treated, similar to the gray-green color of the surrounding leaves. There were also several military tents under the trees and a circular position.
Bin suddenly said, "Something's not right here."
Hobert smiled and said, "You feel it too?"
At this time, the battle inside ended, and Hobert and Bin entered the watchtower.
As soon as he entered the tower, Hobert first saw a corpse wearing a Feysac Empire military uniform.
Arriving on the second floor, there were two Feysac soldiers squatting on the ground, holding their heads in their hands.
Not far from them, there was another corpse of a Feysac Empire soldier.
Captain Egbert was interrogating the prisoners: "Ask them what their mission is?"
A soldier who understood Feysac was doing the translation haltingly.
When the two soldiers heard that someone understood Feysac, they immediately shouted the same sentence loudly.
Seeing the translator stunned, Egbert asked, "What are they saying?"
"They said… that there are devils among us, and told us to leave here." The translator said with some surprise.
Egbert sneered, "That's right, I am the devil of the Feysac people."
Saying this, he raised his rifle and shot another Feysac prisoner, splattering blood on the other prisoner's face.
The captain said, "Ask again, what is their mission?"
The last prisoner watched his companion die in front of him, stunned for a moment, and began to describe their mission.
It turned out that the Feysac army had also received a distress signal from here. They thought it was sent by the survivors who had been sent to attack here before, so they sent a small force to rescue them.
But after arriving here, many comrades mysteriously disappeared.
Just as they were preparing to evacuate, they encountered Egbert's team.
Egbert nodded in satisfaction. Another soldier took the prisoner to the room downstairs, and then ordered two soldiers to dispose of the corpses, and finally ordered three soldiers to search the watchtower and the surrounding positions in a triangular formation.
Hobert just watched quietly, with no intention of participating in the whole process.
After giving the order, Egbert smiled and said to Hobert, "Your Grace, the disappearance of these Feysac soldiers must have been done by the comrades hiding in the woods."
"We'll take a short rest, and then plan to divide into three teams to go around…"
"Ah~"
Suddenly, a chilling scream came from upstairs, interrupting Egbert's words.
Egbert drew his pistol and rushed upstairs. When he saw the scene upstairs, he was slightly stunned. He was clearly the first to rush up, but Duke Hobert and Bishop Bin were already checking on the soldier rolling on the ground.
He was stunned for a full second before he remembered to look downstairs. The soldiers downstairs had come to check the situation, but they did not see the Duke and Bishop.
Egbert breathed a long sigh of relief. It would have been terrifying if there was another Duke and a Bishop below.
In front of Hobert, the soldier writhing in pain was one of the three who had just performed the search mission.
The other two stood aside with terrified expressions, holding their guns helplessly. In front of them, there was also a large military telescope with a stand.
After a brief examination, Hobert determined that the soldier with a painful expression was cursed. He said to the soldiers who rushed over, "Everyone stand back!"
Saying this, he made a pulling motion towards the soldier, "gifting" the curse on him to a tree outside.
The tree actually trembled violently, making a painful "creaking" sound.
Hobert snapped his fingers and "tampered with" the ignition point of the hydrogen around the tree, causing a fire to instantly engulf the tree, ending its pain.
The soldier lying on the ground seemed to have survived a catastrophe, his eyes were straight, and he was breathing non-stop.
Hobert asked the other two soldiers, "What happened just now?"
One of the soldiers said, "Bob just looked outside with the telescope, and suddenly fell to the ground and screamed."
Bob was referring to the soldier who had just been cursed.
Hobert got up and looked around. The third floor of the watchtower was a semi-open structure, and it was almost as tall as the tall canopy, but because it was on a downward slope, the ground in front was lower, and the view towards the Inner Sea was unobstructed.
The Minsk Mountains probably run east-west. This is the northernmost end of the mountain range. The foot of the mountain where this watchtower is located is the sparkling Inner Sea.
With Hobert's eyesight, he could see the end of the Inner Sea from here. There were many Feysac Empire military supply ships traveling back and forth between the north and south banks of Midseashire.
And the entire hillside, the dense forest was in full view.
If the curse just now was ignored, this was a very good view.
At this time, the soldier named Bob had recovered. Egbert asked him, "What did you see just now?"
"I didn't see anything." Bob said with lingering fear.
Egbert frowned: "Didn't see anything?"
"Yes, it was a piece of darkness." Bob said: "It's like the telescope was covered by something."
"Covered?" A soldier was about to go to the telescope to check, because there was no obstruction in front of the telescope.
"Don't go over there!" Hobert and Egbert reminded at the same time.
Then the two looked at each other, but their eyes quickly turned away.
Egbert cleared his throat and said, "No one should approach the telescope, there…"
He was just about to say this when he saw Hobert take a step forward and stand in front of the telescope, then picked it up and looked outside.
All this happened too fast, and it was too late when Egbert wanted to stop him.
But Hobert was not cursed like Bob, but looked at it calmly for a while, and then looked forward.
The sun was shining brightly in front of him, and the lake looked sparkling in the sun.
In the telescope, however, it was pitch black, with nothing to see.
After confirming the scene in front of him, Hobert confirmed that there was no cover in front of the telescope, and then approached the telescope again, but it was still pitch black in front of him.
Just as he was about to look away, a pair of eyes suddenly appeared in the darkness, looking at Hobert.
Hobert immediately felt corruption and a curse, but he didn't take it to heart, because he had been very cautious since just now, gathering a thin layer of "Order Crystal" in front of him.
All Beyonder attacks were blocked by the "Order Crystal".
The pair of eyes stared at Hobert for about one or two seconds, and probably realized that it could not hurt Hobert, and then disappeared into the darkness.
Hobert looked away and re-examined the telescope.
The darkness may not be in front of the telescope, but may be in an unknown space.
There was a certain connection between this telescope and the darkness, so using this telescope, one could see the dark scene in an unknown location.
Hobert pondered for a while before saying to Egbert, "You're right, no one should approach this telescope… well, no one should come to the third floor."
After everyone returned to the second floor, Hobert sat in a chair and watched Egbert begin to assign soldiers to search the surrounding area.
After the soldiers left, Bin whispered, "These soldiers are also strange."
"Definitely strange." Hobert smiled and said, "If they were just here to pick up a few lost soldiers, would they send an extraordinary captain?"
Bin also said, "Should we go back now? After all, we still have important things to do."
Hobert shook his head: "I didn't even notice the curse just now."
Bin was stunned, not quite understanding what he meant.
Hobert said, "Larrion did not leave the Minsk Mountains. He may be not far from this watchtower."
As an angel, his spirituality did not even notice the curse just now, which is enough to show that the curse is not simple.
In the Minsk Mountains, Hobert's only known opponent is the angel Larrion. He believes that everything that happened in this watchtower may have something to do with Larrion.
Bin was very surprised by this conclusion, but seeing that Hobert was not joking, he chose to believe the angel's judgment.
Hobert also said to Bin, "You guard the surroundings, I will use some special methods to see if I can find the source of the curse."
Bin nodded and kept watch around as Hobert instructed.
Hobert lowered his head, pretending to think intently, and his spirit body entered the "Nation of Disorder", sitting on the "Iron Throne" and looking around with "True Vision".
Under "True Vision", he saw a faint green mist in the forest around the watchtower.
These mists did not seem to be very dangerous, but they could block "True Vision"! It also blocked the spirituality of an angel to a certain extent.
Hobert realized that unless it involved his own danger, he might not be able to have a premonition in advance.
He was about to withdraw his gaze when he suddenly noticed something was wrong, and a strange aura seemed to be spreading around.
Suddenly, he saw several corpses of Feysac soldiers covered in soil, with slight signs of decay on their faces, crawling out of the tents not far away.
The Loen soldiers should have searched those tents just now. Didn't they find these corpses?
Hobert waited for a while and discovered that the target of these corpses was the watchtower.
The soldiers guarding the prisoners downstairs had already noticed the abnormality and were shooting outside in a somewhat flustered manner.
Only then did Hobert return to the real world. At this time, Bin had already noticed the abnormality and waved his hand down from the window, "easing" the corpses of those Feysac soldiers, and they immediately fell to the ground.
Hobert got up and glanced at the corpses downstairs: "I didn't feel the power of the 'Death' pathway."
Bin frowned and said, "Me neither."
Because of the gunshots, the team that went out to explore quickly returned.
After Egbert understood the situation, he ordered everyone to return to the second floor first.
"Over there… Over there are corpses!" At this time, the last soldier to return ran back in horror and shouted.
Egbert said with a gloomy face, "Let's go upstairs and talk about it."
When they came upstairs, everyone did not avoid Hobert and Bin and began to discuss the problems they were facing.
Egbert did not ask about the corpses first, but first asked the last soldier to return: "Didn't I order you not to separate under any circumstances? Why did you leave the search team?"
The soldier said with a mournful face: "I, I just went to the toilet and found that Bruce and Sack had disappeared.
"I quickly chased after them along the footprints, but… but in a place where the ice and snow hadn't melted, I found three rows of footprints ahead.
"I was wondering at the time, why would there be three rows of footprints?
"After running a few steps, I finally found three people wearing Loen military uniforms. After catching up, I even cursed a few times, asking them why they didn't wait for me?
"But they didn't seem to hear my voice and were still searching forward seriously. I went forward and patted one of them on the shoulder before realizing something was wrong.
"His shoulder was icy cold, the kind of bone-chilling cold!
"The soldier slowly turned his head. It was a stranger. The other two also turned their heads to look at me. They were also strangers!"
Speaking of this, the last soldier to return still looked frightened, and the other soldiers also felt a chill down their spines and unconsciously moved closer to each other.
The last soldier to return took a deep breath before continuing: "Their faces were covered with frost, their eyes were full of whites, and there were some signs of decay on their cheeks!
"They… they opened their mouths together and said a word to me together…"
Speaking of this, the soldier suddenly paused.
Egbert quickly asked, "What did they say?"
"They…" The soldier's tone suddenly became a little strange, as if he had suddenly become very aloof: "They asked: Why do you want to start a war?"
Pa ~
After saying this, the soldier exploded like a rotten tomato that had been squeezed, scattering into pieces.
Everyone was so frightened by this scene that they retreated one after another, but they soon discovered that there seemed to be a transparent barrier in front of them, blocking those light green flesh and blood.
Egbert glanced at Duke Hobert behind him, only to see him raising his hand slightly at this time. He immediately understood that the Duke had protected them, and those light green flesh and blood were obviously problematic.
Everyone took a few seconds to accept the fact that a comrade had died, and the expressions on everyone's faces became very solemn.
Egbert took a deep breath before saying: "No one should touch these flesh and blood. Bob, go find some kerosene and burn these flesh and blood."
"Yes." Bob immediately went to find kerosene.
Egbert then went to question the other two subordinates: "Bruce, Sack, how could you not have noticed that a comrade had gone missing?"
Bruce took a deep breath in fear before saying: "No, Captain, Sack and I always thought that the three of us were acting together."
Sack's scalp tingled: "Yes, sir, the three of us have always been acting together."
Egbert asked: "Who is the third person?"
"It's…" Both soldiers fell into a state of confusion. They found that no matter how hard they tried to recall, they couldn't remember who the third person was.
At this time, Bob found the kerosene, poured it on the ground, and set it on fire.
Hobert, however, turned his hand and "distorted" the flesh and blood and flames on the ground to the ground outside.
Egbert suddenly realized that if these flesh and blood were burned, they might form some harmful gases.
Then he thought: Why didn't I think of such a simple question?
"Everyone, I think we should have a talk." Hobert suddenly said: "You still have some special tasks, right?"
Egbert hesitated.
Hobert looked at Egbert: "Just say it, I will help you avoid the ability of 'Concealment'."
"Yes." Egbert carefully said: "We do have a special investigation mission.
"During the battle to seize this watchtower, a seriously injured officer went back alive. He told everyone that the Feysac people released a demon here…"
Egbert discovered that he could actually smoothly say the secret mission they were carrying out, which gave him a new understanding of Duke Hobert's level.
Hobert asked: "Is this a metaphor, or a real 'demon'?"
"This is a metaphor!" Egbert obviously knew what a real demon was. He continued: "We did receive a telegram.
"The other party said that he was a survivor of the previous battle, but he was seriously injured and couldn't go back. He requested support.
"He also said that he knew the true face of the demon, which was the key to defeating the Feysac people. He asked us to send someone over.
"In order to prevent it from being a trap set by the Feysac people, we only sent a small force to explore.
"If there really is a clue to defeat the enemy, that would be great, but if it really is a trap set by the Feysac people, a small force can easily break through.
"Just now, by interrogating that prisoner, I even determined that there really is a clue to defeat the enemy here."
Hobert slowly nodded. Just now, the prisoner said that they also received a distress signal, but after they came, the team members disappeared inexplicably.
This sounded very much like the Feysac Empire had released some terrifying power here, but this terrifying power was controlled by the injured Loen soldiers.
So the Loen soldiers used that power to attack the Feysac soldiers who had occupied this place, and also sent a distress signal to their own side, and attacked the Feysac reinforcements.
That's why Egbert couldn't wait to search the surrounding area, hoping to find the injured Loen soldiers as soon as possible.
But Bob's curse, and the tragic death of this soldier just now, may mean that there are no "injured Loen soldiers" here. It was that power that tricked the Feysac reinforcements and the Loen reinforcements here.
After listening to Egbert's description, Hobert said: "I think we should call that prisoner up and re-interrogate him."
After Egbert nodded, two soldiers brought the prisoner up.
Hobert once again used the ability of "charm" to greatly increase the Feysac prisoner's favorability towards Hobert, and then he asked: "What did the Feysac people release here?"
"We didn't release anything!" The prisoner said after hearing the translation.
Egbert and others looked at each other. At this time, they realized that both the Loen army and the Feysac army had been deceived by that strange power.
Hobert slowly nodded, and then asked: "Then why did you support here?"
This time, the prisoner told the truth: "After our people completely occupied this place five days ago, we originally wanted to blow up the watchtower to prevent it from being used by the Loen people again.
"But a company of soldiers who occupied this place suddenly disappeared, and did not report whether the tower was blown up or not, nor did they return to the team.
"Just the day before yesterday, we suddenly received a distress signal, saying that a soldier saw something he shouldn't have seen with the telescope on the third floor, and needed a special investigation team to support him.
"So our team came here, but after only stationing here for one night, only 4 people were left in the team of 15."
Hobert asked: "How did they die?"
The prisoner suddenly froze for a moment: "They… some of them were already dead."
Hobert frowned, and was about to continue interrogating, when the prisoner suddenly said again: "By the way, that person asked me to ask you: Why do you want to start a war?"
Pa ~
Just like before, this prisoner exploded like a rotten tomato that had been squeezed hard.
This time, Hobert was clearly prepared, but he discovered that the power that caused the prisoner's death was without warning! He still couldn't save him!
The atmosphere in the room became even more solemn. Hobert raised his hand slightly, and the light green flesh and blood on the ground were "distorted" to the pile of flesh and blood outside that had not yet been burned.
Under Hobert's "tampering", the flames on the ground outside also began to burn the prisoner's flesh and blood.
Then, he said to Egbert and the others: "I think your mission should end early. Go back and tell your superiors that even Duke Hobert was unable to prevent their tragic deaths. I don't think your superiors will blame you."
Egbert was slightly stunned: "We…"
"Yes," Hobert said: "If your mission continues, you will definitely die a miserable death."
He said to Bin, "You leave with them too."
Bin was slightly stunned, but immediately said: "Okay."
Hobert glanced at the people in the house and smiled slightly: "Okay, 1 archbishop, 1 captain, 11 soldiers, everyone is here. I'll send you…"
"Wait a moment!" Egbert suddenly said seriously, "Your Grace, are you mistaken? When we came, there were 12 people. One died just now, so including me, there are only 11 people!"
Hobert was slightly stunned, and immediately understood why he felt something was wrong when he first encountered this team.
At that time, Egbert clearly had 12 subordinates, and with the captain, there were 13 people.
But Egbert said, "The command ordered 12 of us to bring them back," which means that in their understanding, there have always been 12 people, but this team has 13 people!
Hobert was stunned for a moment, then suddenly smiled: "Things are getting more and more interesting."
He said to Bin: "You, get behind me."
The Archbishop was a little frightened at this time and quickly came behind Hobert. He thought to himself: I can't let them go! Who knows what they will bring back?
Egbert and the others suddenly became distrustful of the people around them and unconsciously distanced themselves.
Hobert said to them: "Don't panic. Next, I will pray for the power of the Evernight Goddess to help us identify who the extra person is!"
"Everyone, pay attention to observe whether anyone is disrupting the ritual? See if anyone wants to leave suddenly!"
Without giving everyone a chance to object, Hobert immediately used the power of "Tampering" and air to "fix" all 12 people in place.
Then, at his suggestion, Bin brought a table and set up candles.
Hobert began to chant: "Evernight Goddess who stands higher than the cosmos and more eternal than eternity…"
"I encountered a problem while completing your mission, and I request your communication and help."
"Please, does everything that happened on this watchtower have anything to do with my mission?"
A peaceful force descended on the watchtower, and the hearts of the somewhat anxious soldiers also calmed down.
In a corner not far away, half a bottle of red wine suddenly flew onto the table, and the cork was opened and fell down. The red wine flowed out, forming letters, and finally spelling out a word: Yes.
Hobert nodded. His previous premonition was correct.
Then he felt a little strange. Why did the Evernight Goddess communicate with him in this way?
Clearly, in previous communications, the Evernight Goddess could already talk to him.
After thinking for a while, Hobert understood that the Evernight Goddess was doing this for others to see, possibly for Bin, or possibly for these soldiers.
Of course, it was even more likely for Larrion, who was probably hiding in the dark, to make this "Glory" realize that the Evernight Goddess was currently focused on "doing more important things," and even such an important communication could only project a small amount of power here.
Hobert asked again: "Where does that telescope connect to?"
The red wine on the table deformed again, forming a word: Cosmos.
Then more red wine poured out, forming a sentence: That sealed artifact seized the opportunity and suddenly lost effective control, ultimately leading to this crisis.
At this time, Hobert understood that his mission was not only to seize the sealed artifact, but also to resolve this crisis.
He said again: "Please help me identify which of them is the culprit of this crisis."
This time, after a pause of two or three seconds, the red wine moved again: There is a way to identify them, let them each state their name and birthday in turn.
Hobert then realized that the "Creator's" "True Vision" would be obscured by a light green mist, and the Evernight Goddess's vision might not be able to directly see who had a problem.
Moreover, even if she could see it, the Evernight Goddess would have to pretend not to see it at this time.
However, true gods are different from false gods. Even if she doesn't directly say who has a problem, she can still find a way to solve the problem through other means.
The Evernight Goddess's reminder enlightened Hobert. In mysticism, a person's name and time of birth are closely related to the spirit world.
These two pieces of information can be regarded as someone's "file number" in the spirit world.
Usually, during divination, these two pieces of information are used to "check the files" in the spirit world. Therefore, in divination, slightly more complex divination, such as horoscopes and dream divination, birthdays and names are very important information.
But if one of them has a problem, his connection with the spirit world must have a problem!
Then, when he says his name and birthday, it will automatically restore much of the altered information in the spirit world, and it is likely to find a clue to break the situation.
So, after thanking the Evernight Goddess and cleaning up the altar, Hobert said to the 12 soldiers: "You, clearly state your name and date of birth in turn! Starting from the left!"
At the same time, Hobert used the ability of "Connection" to closely monitor the connection between them and the spirit world.
The first soldier said: "Bruce Will, born on February 28, 1329."
Before Hobert could say anything, Bob said in horror: "You… Bruce is dead! He died two months ago!"
