chapters.title: Chapter 703 - 699: Talking about the Chaos Sea at the Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The war of annihilation that occurred in the Southern Continent, like the previous civil war in the Southern Balam Duchy, was not well understood by the outside world in terms of the specific war process.
However, compared to the civil war, this war of annihilation had many nobles who fled, so the outside world knew some of the war situation.
But all of that was from the perspective of the Highland Kingdom in narrating this war. In the eyes of these nobles, it was precisely because the Southern Balam Duchy had an overwhelming advantage that they were defeated so quickly.
However, many people analyzed from their descriptions that the Southern Balam Duchy fought brilliantly in this war of annihilation. The Highland Kingdom was not entirely defeated by a lack of Beyonder forces. It was just that the Southern Balam Duchy's tactics brought their advantages to the extreme.
After much inquiry, the outside world learned that the Southern Balam Duchy's army had changed to a military commander named Medici.
However, all those Beyonders who knew the "Angel Family" believed that a descendant of Medici had defected to the Southern Balam Duchy, and they were currently commanding the Beyonder forces of the Southern Balam Duchy.
"The Hermit" Cattleya also thought so, so she confirmed this matter with "The Emperor" at the Tarot Club.
Who knew that "The Emperor" Hobert would answer: "He is Medici."
The members other than "Justice" Audrey and "The Magician" Fors were stunned for a full four or five seconds before "The Moon" Emlyn said: "No wonder every word he says is so annoying."
The Sanguine and "Temperance School" who participated in this war also thought that the commander of this war was just a descendant of the Medici family. After all, Medici was a figure who only appeared in ancient documents.
"The Hanged Man" Alger also reacted: "Is it Medici himself?"
Hobert smiled and nodded: "That's right."
"The Star" Leonard also reacted at this time: "He is still alive?"
Hobert said meaningfully: "Many ancient angels are still alive, but their state is a bit strange."
Klein then manipulated "The World" to ask: "Why would he cooperate with you?"
Hobert did not hide this: "Because the great 'Creator' recently obtained a 'Conqueror' Beyonder characteristic."
Everyone suddenly understood: This makes sense.
Klein then sighed: "Creator" has good luck. When will "The Fool" also have such good luck?
At this time, Cattleya seemed to have just reacted and said: "In other words, this war of annihilation was commanded by 'Red Angel' Medici himself?"
"Yes." Hobert said seriously: "Few Beyonders today possess his kind of war-like thinking."
Leonard nodded: "After all, Beyonder wars rarely happen now, and everyone doesn't know how to fight Beyonder wars."
"And Medici's era often had Beyonder wars, so he should have accumulated a lot of war experience."
"Not to mention the 'Rose School,' I estimate that even the orthodox churches are no match for him in terms of war."
The other members nodded in agreement.
After ending this topic, "The World" suddenly said: "Honorable Mr. Fool, I would like to communicate with 'The Emperor' alone."
After Hobert expressed his agreement, "The Fool" at the head of the bronze long table nodded pretentiously, creating a separate space for the two to communicate.
"In the past few days, I explored Chernobyl." Klein manipulated "The World" to say: "There are many amazing discoveries there."
He took a deep breath and said: "Before all the extraordinary occurrences, it seems that the world suddenly ran out of oil.
"Chernobyl then had a huge, bottomless pit, where people built a research institute, conducting some kind of research.
"According to some of the written materials I found, many researchers turned into oil, and more people became crazy, with their minds undergoing mutations."
Only after hearing the other party's first sentence did Hobert understand that Klein wanted to share his exploration experience with him.
"That is the 'Chaos Sea'!" Klein continued: "Do I need to explain to you what the 'Chaos Sea' is?"
He had recently obtained a lot of high-end information.
Hobert said: "I have heard of the 'Chaos Sea.' It is said that for some pathways, it is the key to becoming a Great Old One."
Klein nodded and continued: "I don't know why, but the power of the 'Chaos Sea' suddenly expanded, turning the oil in the ground into a part of it. It seems that the oil disappeared because of this.
"I also encountered an Amon's avatar in the research institute. In order to deceive me, or rather, to contaminate me, he told me a lot of information. Later, I judged that most of the information should be true."
Hobert "Hmm"ed: "If it is determined that Amon is deceiving, then most of his words are credible."
This way, it would be easier for him to achieve his ultimate goal.
Klein obviously thought so too, and he continued: "Amon's avatar said that the 'Chaos Sea' is very large, almost filling the Earth's core.
"It is also the only 'Sephirot' that emphasizes both reality and illusion, and has a direct entrance in the real world.
"He also said that the first 'Blasphemy Slate' was conceived and produced there, and it is said that the Ancient Sun God also crawled out of there."
Hobert slowly nodded: "In other words, the Ancient Sun God was likely one of the researchers there.
"But why would he have a cross from the Common Era?"
What Hobert was talking about was the classic cross he got from a Loen royal court viscount when helping Xio investigate her father's case.
That cross obviously came from the Common Era.
Klein had studied that cross when Hobert traded with Derrick, so he knew what Hobert was referring to.
So he guessed: "Could that be an accessory he carried when he went to work?"
Westerners generally have the habit of wearing cross necklaces.
Hobert smiled: "Maybe I'm too sensitive. I always feel that the research institute and this thing are a bit... a bit mismatched."
Klein also recalled that the relationship between Christianity and the scientific community seemed to have both opposing and integrated aspects. It would be nothing to find a cross in other places, but it was indeed a bit strange for the staff of the research institute to have a cross.
"Perhaps the Ancient Sun God was not a researcher at all, but a pastor." Hobert smiled and said: "Otherwise, the Third Epoch would not be filled with so many elements about the cross."
Klein nodded: "That's right. If it involves some supernatural phenomena, maybe they will ask some religious people to help."
They did not continue to discuss this issue, but talked about the "Chaos Sea."
Hobert sighed: "I didn't expect the entrance to the 'Chaos Sea' to be in Chernobyl! Is this a coincidence? Or did the nuclear leak attract the 'Chaos Sea'?"
"If it's just because of the nuclear pollution problem, it may also appear in Japan and the United Kingdom. Why would it appear in Chernobyl?"
Klein was slightly stunned: "Japan and the United Kingdom?"
Hobert smiled: "When you traveled through time, the nuclear power plants in these two countries had not had problems yet, and they were very unethical in discharging nuclear wastewater into the sea.
"In terms of the handling process, Chernobyl's handling is simply textbook-level."
Klein recalled: "I remember the Fukushima nuclear leak."
Hobert nodded: "Yes, that nuclear leak seems to have happened a long time ago, and the problem has not been completely resolved."
The two were silent for a while, and then Klein suddenly said: "The first time! The Chernobyl accident was the first nuclear reactor accident. Could this be a sign?"
Hobert pondered for a moment: "It's possible. After all, abstraction begins at the level of Uniqueness. Higher-level Sephirot should also have certain abstract manifestations, so the first nuclear leak may have some abstract meaning."
Then he said: "The question is, what does Chernobyl represent? That seems to be an accident in the 1980s, right? Why did extraordinary elements only begin to appear twenty or thirty years later?"
The two fell silent for the second time. After a long while, Klein said: "Perhaps, that's just the beginning?"
"That's right." Hobert smiled: "The process of extraordinary awakening may take time. Indeed, we should not use the human concept of awakening to understand the extraordinary awakening."
He then added: "I suddenly recalled something just now. Before the first atomic bomb was tested, some people even worried about igniting the hydrogen in the air, thus destroying the whole world.
"This is not an ordinary person's fantasy, but a concern raised by physicists."
Hobert spread his hands and continued: "Humans have all kinds of worries and misunderstandings about the unknown.
"And the effect presented by that unknown thing may completely exceed people's imagination."
His expression gradually became solemn: "Many times I think that our understanding of Beyonder characteristics is actually too superficial. We don't even know what kind of substance this is?
"Just like before the atomic bomb exploded, people had all kinds of fantasies about it.
"Why are Beyonder characteristics different from other substances we find in the real world? Why does it give life Beyonder abilities?
"Just now when we talked about Chernobyl, I had an idea. Is what Beyonder characteristics represent the Creator?
"The entire universe is made up of various basic particles. This is the 'Creator'!
"And when nuclear energy appears, whether it is nuclear fusion or nuclear fission, lighter or heavier atoms can be artificially formed.
"Does this mean that humans already possess some of the characteristics of the 'Creator', so nuclear energy awakened the 'Original Creator'!"
Klein's scalp tingled as he listened, and after a long while, he said, "You are an excellent scholar!"
At this moment, he once again marveled at Hobert's scholarly thinking, so many scattered clues, yet he managed to connect them together.
However, Klein did not evaluate whether Hobert's conjecture was right or wrong, because with limited information, no one knew if it was correct, he could only say that this guess was very reasonable.
The two people's conversation fell into silence for the third time.
After a minute or two, Klein said again: "The appearance of the 'Chaos Sea' should mean the arrival of the extraordinary."
"It should be like this." Hobert also deduced: "After the extraordinary descends, everyone will become…"
Speaking of this, he suddenly paused: "You just said that the Chaos Sea almost fills the earth's core?"
"Amon's avatar said so."
"Could the 'Original Creator' have been sleeping in the 'Chaos Sea' during the Common Era?" Hobert had a sudden whim: "I suddenly thought of a science fiction novel I read before.
"In that novel, the entire planet is a life form.
"So, can the awakening of the 'Original Creator' be seen as the awakening of the Earth?"
Klein was stunned for a long while before saying: "This… this conjecture is very interesting."
Hobert thought seriously, in his memory, the description of the "Original Creator" awakening was also very vague.
He felt that since he had started guessing, he might as well guess boldly: "'Chaos' and 'Creation' are linked together, what is the first thing you think of?"
Klein blurted out almost immediately: "Pangu!"
Hobert smiled: "Yes, if the myths we know have a certain degree of credibility, does it mean that the 'Original Creator' has already awakened more than once?"
Klein was stunned, and once again felt that he didn't know what to say.
And Hobert remembered that this was indeed not the first time the "Original Creator" had awakened.
Because the information about the "Original Creator" was very limited, the two people could not continue the discussion here.
Klein changed the subject, he sighed: "Without oil, it means that the Second Industrial Revolution will be difficult to complete, and the development of this world in terms of technology will be very limited."
"Not necessarily." Hobert smiled: "Have you heard of 'soybean plastic'?"
Klein smiled: "Soybeans can also be made into plastic?"
"I didn't think of it before either." Hobert replied: "But in the past year, the research center I jointly established with the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery has already found a way to stabilize 'soybean plastic'.
"Unlike chemical plastics, this plastic can be completely degraded. The problem of white corruption that plagued us before has been basically solved in the absence of major raw materials."
Klein opened his mouth and sighed: "It feels like hearing about a kind of futuristic technology."
Hobert also sighed: "Yes, who would have thought that in an era where science and technology are roughly similar to World War I, there could be such a high-end technology, like… like…"
Klein thought for a while and compared: "It's like talking about braised chicken rice during the Republic of China period."
He explained: "During those years in college, I always thought that braised chicken was a way of eating that only existed in the 21st century. Later, I checked and found that it actually existed in 1927."
Hobert smiled: "As expected of you."
Then he said: "This analogy is indeed quite appropriate."
Hobert paused and then said: "This should actually be a misunderstanding of technology. We always think that the later a technology appears, the more advanced it is.
"In fact, this is not always the case. Many technologies can be traced back to a very early period. They did not become mainstream at that time, simply because people did not have the demand, or the needs designed by the inventor deviated from the needs of the user."
Klein pondered for a moment before saying: "I understand what you mean, you mean that the technology of this world may not just stop there."
"That's right." Hobert said: "However, in our opinion, the technology tree of this world in the future must be very distorted.
"But this is just our understanding. Perhaps in the eyes of an alien, the technology tree of mankind in the Common Era is also distorted, but we just can't feel it."
Klein nodded and said again: "Another point is that this world still has Beyonder power, which is also different from the Common Era."
Hobert took a deep breath: "Yes, this is destined that this world will be dominated by the extraordinary, not by technology."
The two people fell into silence for the fourth time. After a long time, Klein came back to his senses: "I am ready on my side and can hunt the Dark Demonic Wolf Kotar at any time."
Hobert nodded: "Wait for me for another two weeks, when it is mid-May, we will act again, so that the probability of success will be higher."
Klein seemed to realize something and nodded: "Okay."
Then, they indicated to Mr. Fool that the separate exchange was over.
"World" and "Emperor" both became solemn after the separate exchange, which made the atmosphere of the Tarot meeting also become solemn.
Everyone discussed the situation in the Northern Continent, and also discussed the consequences of Loen's defeat.
Hobert and Klein did not participate in the discussion of these topics until Alger shared an intelligence he had obtained, then Hobert seemed to come back to his senses and joined the exchange.
Alger said: "I got a message that a group of Beyonders in classical costumes appeared in Caesar Harbor. According to reliable sources, they are going to help Intis compete with the Loen Kingdom for the Paz River Valley in the Southern Continent."
Caesar Harbor is a famous port in the northern part of the Southern Continent. As the name suggests, it belongs to the colony of the Intis Republic.
The Paz River Valley is one of the earliest areas developed by colonists in the Northern Continent. The climate there is very suitable for planting various crops, with large plantations and abundant forest and mineral resources. It has always been the most competitive place for the four major countries in the Northern Continent to compete for colonies.
Even if the Loen Kingdom's war in the Northern Continent is tight, it is unwilling to give up its interests in the Paz River Valley. A part of the colonial army and the military's Beyonders are still stationed here.
After hearing "Beyonders in classical costumes", Hobert immediately asked: "Can you find out the details of those Beyonders?"
Alger pondered for a moment before saying: "I can try."
"Okay." Hobert said: "After there is a result, I will pay the corresponding remuneration."
After ending the discussion of this topic, everyone no longer initiated new topics. As usual, after helping "Sun" Derrick learn some ancient Feysac language and the geography of the North and South Continents, Klein announced the end of this Tarot meeting.
Hobert returned to the real world and sighed after a long silence: "Perhaps the essence of the extraordinary world is that there is no corresponding theory to completely explain the extraordinary."
He took a deep breath. Regardless of whether some problems can be understood, advancement is the most important thing at present.
After destroying the Highland Kingdom, Hobert ushered in the opportunity for advancement, and did not need to make so many preparations as when he was promoted to "Duke of Entropy".
At that time, at most Tamara, Trunsoest and other Sequence 1s of the same path and adjacent paths can feel his advancement, but if he arranges a barrier formed by "Order Crystal" in advance, he can completely block their interference.
The difficulty of this advancement may lie in the advancement itself.
After all, this is Sequence 1, and the advancement at this level is of course very dangerous.
Moreover, after the advancement, divinity must be higher than humanity again, so some preparations must be made in advance to avoid becoming the kind of gods he hates most for a long time.
In fact, Hobert had been preparing for advancement when the first round of war against the Highland Kingdom ended, and Earl Hall had done him a great favor.
Finally, prepare auxiliary Ingredients: 30 grams each of five specialties that the public can Connection with the promoter.
… …
Angel City ushered in the first snow of the year, and the newly built city suddenly became a white expanse.
Fors, wearing a thick Loen-style long skirt, looked at the snow scene in the yard and exhaled. Before that, she could hardly imagine that there were places in this world where it would snow in April.
After standing for a while, she continued to pass through the long corridor and headed to the building complex in the middle of the Duke's mansion.
Fors was a little puzzled. Why would Hobert, who had always been frugal, build such a large palace? It was even so large that she wanted to use "Blink" to walk, or use "Travel" to reach her destination.
Arriving at the central building complex, like the left building complex where Fors lived, there were a large number of buildings that were not decorated at all, and even had no doors and windows installed.
A gust of cold wind blew through, and a lot of snow even blew into the room.
Fors walked a few steps quickly and finally came to the decorated part, and quickly came to the magnificent dining room.
The waiter opened the door of the dining room, and Fors's eyes narrowed, because not only Hobert was in the dining room, but also Audrey, with golden hair and an excellent figure.
Fors knew very well that Audrey lived on the other side of the palace, but the two were very tacit and had never met in the palace.
Audrey's expression also changed when she saw Fors, but she thought of something else. Through the conversation with Hobert just now, she felt that Hobert seemed to be worried about something.
He even called Fors here, indicating that the things Hobert was worried about were difficult to solve.
"Fors, I have an important matter to discuss with you." Hobert got up and smiled: "I think you two should both be present for this matter."
Fors hesitated for a moment, but finally entered the dining room.
Dong ~
The restaurant door was closed by the waiter, and Hobert further "tampered" with the surroundings, ensuring that only the three of them could hear the following conversation.
Hobert, facing Fors, who was standing, and Audrey, who was sitting, said: "The good news is, I have obtained the opportunity to advance to Sequence 1."
Both Fors and Audrey were stunned. They exchanged glances, seeing shock in each other's eyes.
Although they often participated in the Tarot Gathering, they still felt that gods and archangels were very distant from them.
Now, Hobert suddenly said that he was going to advance to Sequence 1, which even made them feel unreal.
"The bad news is that this advancement will be another test," Hobert continued: "Last year, when I had just advanced to 'Duke of Entropy,' the divinity within me dominated for a long time.
"I estimate that after advancing to Sequence 1, a similar situation will occur again."
After these words were spoken, the restaurant suddenly fell silent.
Fors and Audrey both recalled the time when Hobert had become very cold.
After a few seconds of silence, Audrey asked: "Can anchors be used to make humanity prevail?"
"It can be done, but the process should be very long." Hobert had enough anchors. The natives of Longtail Island alone numbered in the hundreds of thousands. For a Sequence 1, these anchors were sufficient.
In addition, the "Creator's" anchors, although they had to go through the "Nation of Disorder" for "transit," were also Hobert's anchors if needed.
Moreover, Hobert had long discovered that the "Black Emperor's" anchors were very broad. As long as people acknowledged His rule, they were the "Black Emperor's" anchors.
Unlike the anchors of other orthodox gods, they did not require relatively devout faith.
Hobert smiled and said: "You don't need to worry too much. After becoming the 'Duke of Entropy,' I found a way to strengthen humanity."
Fors took a step forward, and Audrey also straightened her body. The two of them asked together: "What method?"
"It's probably an event that can cause huge fluctuations in my personal emotions," Hobert said: "It could be excitement, sadness, or some other emotion."
Audrey seemed to have guessed something, but Fors asked: "How do you plan to have us help you?"
"I believe that my wedding with Audrey soon will be of great help to me in restoring my humanity." This was the preparation Hobert had made to restore his humanity.
Or rather, this opportunity was delivered to Him by Earl Hall.
Fors paused slightly before saying: "I understand."
She had heard Xio mention this matter before and was not surprised by it: "If there's nothing else…"
"I have another matter to discuss with you," Hobert interrupted Fors: "To give you my political will."
He said: "So you both need to be present."
The restaurant fell silent again. Audrey and Fors suddenly realized that, due to some pressure, Hobert had to choose to advance as soon as possible.
However, Hobert was not confident in overcoming the negative effects of the advancement. Only now did they fully understand why Hobert had called them together to discuss this matter.
After a few more seconds, Audrey said: "Even if the wedding fails to make your humanity prevail, we will look for other ways."
Fors also said: "There's no need to be so pessimistic."
"No, we must be fully prepared for this kind of thing," Hobert said seriously.
He still couldn't tell these two people who were very close to Him: Advancing to Sequence 1 might not be very difficult, but what about advancing to True God? What if there was a chance to become a Great Old One? What if he completely lost his humanity at that time, or what if the original consciousness awakened within him?
Hobert continued: "If there really is such a day, you must help me protect the newly established Duchy of South Balam. This world needs a glimmer of hope too much."
He took a deep breath and said: "If I basically lose my humanity, I will not be very concerned about issues related to people's livelihood.
"Under the relevant laws of Beyonder characteristics, I should only be interested in other Beyonder characteristics.
"At that time, you will have to play the role of your identities and replace me as the head of this country.
"What you need to pay attention to is, don't let this country go down the wrong path because of some radical ideas.
"Including ideology, including economic and military aspects, and the requirements for the people, you can be radical, but don't be extreme!
"Even forces with obvious hostility can cooperate in some areas.
"Don't completely stand on the opposite side just because of different ways of thinking, and compete in everything.
"You must have the political determination of 'you play your cards, I play my cards'."
Fors and Audrey wanted to interrupt Hobert several times, but Hobert "distorted" their thoughts, making them listen to his political "will".
Hobert took a deep breath and finally said: "Sorry, this may be a bit selfish, but I have to consider the worst-case scenario.
"Okay, I think you're all hungry, let's enjoy dinner together."
…
After making political instructions to Audrey and Fors, Hobert began to prepare for the wedding in Backlund.
Of course, the butler could handle this kind of thing for Hobert. Hobert only needed to provide enough pounds.
On the other side, after a series of investigations and inquiries, five things that easily reminded the public of Hobert were summarized.
The thing that most easily reminded everyone of Him was, of course, light bulbs.
Very early on, "Earl's Light" was almost tied to Hobert. The planned development model, the vegetables and fruits of Longtail Island and South Colson, etc., would be things for the future.
The second thing that everyone could Connection with the Duke of South Balam was something that Hobert hadn't even thought of: a ruler for measuring land.
No matter where it was, land division seemed to be the label of Lord Hobert.
This made Hobert sigh helplessly. There were already two very unpalatable things.
Fortunately, the third and fourth things were bread and cabbage. From the beginning of building Longtail Island, Hobert had always provided sufficient food for the workers. Bread was always available in abundance, and cabbage, which had a large yield, had always been the main vegetable on the construction site.
The last thing was the current military uniform of the Duchy of South Balam.
From the beginning in the South Colson area, the army established by Hobert was very different from the army in everyone's impression. It didn't hit people or rob things, so it left a deep impression on the public.
As for the "Duke's Grain," various fruits and seafood, etc., and the laws and regulations formulated by Hobert were ranked behind.
After making these preparations, it was already early May.
On the day of the advancement, Hobert had breakfast with Audrey and Fors as usual.
He didn't tell anyone that he planned to advance today.
After breakfast, Hobert went to the office as usual, but told the waiter not to disturb him.
He took out the scales from his desk, cut 30 grams of each of the five auxiliary Ingredients, and first put them into the beaker. Of course, for things like light bulbs that were difficult to cut, Beyonder abilities had to be used.
Then, Hobert took out the "Prince of Abolition" Beyonder characteristic, which looked like a ball of light, from the "Nation of Disorder".
The Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic was suspended in the beaker and did not fall to the bottom of the cup. Instead, the five auxiliary Ingredients were sucked into the middle of the beaker, surrounding the Beyonder characteristic. The five auxiliary Ingredients gradually melted like ice cubes when heated.
After a few seconds, the potion that looked like mercury fell to the bottom of the beaker. Hobert took a small glass bottle to fill the potion and covered it with "Order Crystal" on the outside.
After putting away the potion, Hobert "distorted" the boundary between the real world and the spirit world, and stepped into the spirit world, arriving at an uninhabited island that He had surveyed through the spirit world.
Hobert unhurriedly arranged the "Wall of Spirituality" and used the abilities of "Magnification" and "Exploit" on the "Wall of Spirituality".
"Magnified" the effect of the "Wall of Spirituality" and "exploited" the Beyonder laws to extend the time it could exist.
Then, Hobert used the "Order Crystal" to create another layer of black barrier inside.
Under His prior manipulation, the "Nation of Disorder" could continuously supply power, and this barrier could exist for about 15 minutes.
After doing all this, Hobert took out the potion, first recalling the ritual for advancing to "Prince of Abolition": Overthrow the rule of a country, or establish a country through rebellion. Create a set of systems in the established country that violate the common sense of this world, and establish a culture and order that is unacceptable to everyone in the territory.
He confirmed again that the two requirements of the ritual had been met.
Not long ago, He had just overthrown the rule of the Highland Kingdom by force.
And the order He formulated for immigration, land distribution, industry and agriculture, etc., was all violating the common sense of this world.
After briefly recalling it, Hobert opened the seal on the outside of the potion and drank it in one gulp.
Unlike the previous "Duke of Entropy" potion, the "Prince of Abolition" potion seemed very heavy. Whether it was the esophagus or the stomach, it seemed like a force was pulling them down.
Then, Hobert felt as if his abdomen was about to explode, and there was a huge force pulling in his stomach.
The intense pain caused Hobert to fall to the ground. In an instant, He had appeared in a wonderful scene.
In front of him was a grassland, but it presented four different situations.
On the leftmost grassland, the weeds had just sprouted and looked vibrant.
On the second grassland, the weeds were very lush, with tall leaves and stems, swaying in the wind.
On the third grassland, the weeds had seeded, and the leaves had turned yellow.
The fourth patch of grassland had blades of grass drooping to the ground, covered with a layer of white snow.
In the sky above, another scene unfolded, with clouds drifting and swirling, thunder rumbling one moment and snow falling the next.
And in the air, there was a bizarre and dazzling cosmos, containing fixed stars, satellites, planets, and nebulae.
Looking at the scene before him, Hobert vaguely understood that it represented the laws of the universe, or rather, the laws of nature.
He seemed to sense something and turned to look behind him, revealing a different spectacle.
In a room piled high with documents, codes, and books, there were layers of people stacked like acrobats.
The people at the top were dressed in aristocratic attire or as judges and wealthy merchants.
Beneath them were figures dressed as gentlemen and ladies, using their shoulders to support the nobles above.
The next layer down consisted of people dressed as farmers, workers, small traders, and the like, struggling to support the two layers above them.
And at the very bottom were people who were gaunt and ragged, their backs bent from carrying the three layers above.
Hobert realized that these people represented the order of human society, while the surrounding documents provided the legal and ideological basis for this order.
He stepped forward and pushed against the wall made of documents, which looked precarious but turned out to be as solid as a rock!
Finally, Hobert looked down at his feet, where there were clusters of vibrant colors, distorted together in a complex and confusing manner. Hobert felt a moment of dizziness and quickly looked up, withdrawing his gaze.
Immediately, he understood that the scene beneath his feet symbolized the distorted and chaotic extraordinary, and it was also the "base color" of this world.
After seeing these scenes, Hobert realized that this advancement had made his consciousness very clear, but he was "surrounded" by rules, unable to find any clues to break the situation.
Just as Hobert was about to try to push down the stack of people, one of the nobles at the top suddenly spoke: "Why do you want to attack our Highland Kingdom?"
Then, the nobles at the highest level all looked at Hobert: "Why do you want to destroy our rule?"
"Under our rule, the Highland Kingdom is clearly a prosperous and thriving place."
"… …"
Suddenly, Hobert realized that this ritual was not like the previous ones, helping him stabilize his state, but rather, in these scenes representing abstract order, helping him find a breakthrough.
Relatively speaking, the order established by humans is easier to find flaws in than the laws of nature and the laws of Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert coldly said to the nobles: "In my opinion, your existence is the biggest unreasonableness in this world. Do I need to seek your opinion to get rid of you?"
Amidst the angry curses of the nobles, these people in gorgeous clothes disappeared one by one.
At this moment, the surrounding documents shook a few times, looking as if they were about to collapse.
And the gentlemen and ladies on the second layer began to look at Hobert one after another: "Have we committed a crime? Why do you use 'Earl's Light' and 'Duke's Grain Shop' to harvest us again and again?"
"I even sympathize with the people at the bottom and hope to do something for them, but I still feel your malice towards me."
"We are the main body of this world, we have insight, knowledge, and technology, you need us!"
"… …"
Hobert smiled and said: "Ladies and gentlemen, what I want to tell you is that you are a group that wavers back and forth."
"We can cooperate with you, but we must be wary of you!"
"Yes, although you sympathize with the lower-level people, you are also working hard to monopolize all channels of advancement, which will make you support me one moment and oppose me the next."
"You support me because I divide the interests of the nobles, and you can get a part of the nobles' interests; you oppose me because I will not let you become new nobles."
Amidst the angry curses or pleas of this group of people, their figures gradually disappeared.
The surrounding documents were already tilted very badly, but they still did not fall.
Hobert said to the remaining people: "Don't stand on the shoulders of others, unite, and I will build a country and regime that belongs to you."
"In this country, there will be no hunger, everyone can have cotton clothes for the winter, follow behind me, and I will lead you to shatter this world!"
The people dressed as farmers, workers, etc., jumped off the shoulders of others and worked together with the poorest people at the bottom to shake the surrounding documents vigorously.
With a crash, the order composed of these manuscripts was broken, and a Blink of light flashed before Hobert's eyes.
When he came back to his senses, he had once again appeared on the deserted island in the real world. Hobert's body was now slumped on the ground like a pile of mud. Outside the barrier he had previously set up were four archangels: Tamara, Trunsoest, William I, and Philip I.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 700: Promoted to Prince of Abolition
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Having initially passed through the most dangerous phase of his advancement, Hobert, separated by the barrier of the "Crystal of Order" and the previously constructed "Wall of Spirituality," gazed at the four archangels outside while diligently gathering his spirituality.
It was akin to being watched by four old men while taking a bath, yet Hobert wasn't afraid of being seen.
During this advancement, his consciousness was exceptionally clear, but his body lay on the ground like a pile of mud.
After slightly gathering his spirituality, Hobert understood that he needed to use his spirituality to "mold" his body back together.
At this moment, Tamara, looking like a wax statue, and Trunsoest, with his bronze-colored hair, were very close to the barrier, both studying the black barrier in front of them from different directions.
Meanwhile, William I, appearing quite dignified, and Philip I, with a very amiable appearance, were at a distance, quietly observing from two different directions.
Hobert began to concentrate on "molding" his body, gaining a new understanding of the "Prince of Abolition."
Although his physical body had undergone qualitative changes after advancing to Sequence 2, "Duke of Entropy," it still hadn't escaped the category of living beings.
After advancing to "Prince of Abolition," Hobert would be able to perform many operations on the aspect of order, and natural order would basically have no way to affect him.
It could also be said that he had basically escaped the category of "living beings" at this time, and was no longer bound by the universe and nature's constraints on living beings most of the time.
Consequently, Hobert's body lost all order and turned into a pile of mud.
The process of using spirituality to "mold" himself back together was equivalent to distinguishing himself from living beings in the natural world, completing the process of "disordering" himself first.
Soon, Hobert first molded his internal organs, then his head, torso, and limbs gradually took shape.
With a wave of his hand, he "tampered" with the air in front of him into crystals, forming a full-length mirror.
Hobert carefully looked at his reflection, and in terms of appearance, he looked exactly the same as before his advancement.
Then, he sat down cross-legged and began to diligently gather his spirituality.
During this advancement, his spirituality was particularly exuberant, requiring him to gradually categorize and gather it.
As time passed, after about two minutes, Tamara shook her head and quickly left the area.
Among the four archangels, she was the most dangerous. If Hobert basically controlled his spirituality, he was likely to risk killing her.
About half a minute later, Trunsoest, who also hadn't found a way to open the black barrier, also left.
He also knew very well that as soon as Hobert had a chance, he would definitely try to kill him.
And at this moment, if Hobert made a move, William I and Philip I, who were observing and wary of each other, would definitely temporarily abandon their confrontation and immediately attack.
After another half a minute or so, Hobert basically gathered his spirituality. He took a deep breath and smiled at William I and Philip I through the barrier of the "Crystal of Order."
William I forced a smile: "Congratulations on your successful advancement. I will send someone to deliver a gift later."
With that, he lifted his foot and left the area in one step.
Philip I smiled and said: "I'll chat with you again when you have time."
After speaking, he also left.
On this deserted island, only Hobert remained.
He didn't immediately remove the barrier formed by the "Crystal of Order," but first used his spirituality to feel the abilities he had gained after his advancement.
First of all, Hobert finally had an ability that could quickly subdue enemies and quickly "break defenses": the Sword of Disorder!
All along, the advantage of the "Lawyer" pathway lay in its unexpectedness, in its "best assist," and in its unique defensive means.
But even as an angel, he lacked the means to quickly harm targets of the same level.
Now that he had such means, he could use abstract order to form a weapon with the appearance of a long sword. Of course, it could also be other shapes.
This weapon could almost ignore any laws, or more specifically, it could ignore the target's defense and harm the opponent.
It could even pierce the armor of a "Warrior"!
Of course, this didn't mean that Hobert was invincible. The Twilight Greatsword in the hands of a Sequence 1 "Warrior" and the rusty and bloodstained longsword of a "Conqueror" were both weapons of the same level and could withstand the "Sword of Disorder."
But Hobert was already very satisfied. After all, before this, let alone a "Conqueror," even when encountering a longsword forged from the Beyonder abilities of a "Weather Warlock," he had to use abilities such as "Distortion" or "Tampering" to avoid it.
Now there was no need for that. He also had a similar weapon.
Other abilities had been strengthened. For example, "Tampering" could now tamper with mathematics in a short period of time.
Just like Hobert's previous operation when he first obtained the "Prince of Abolition" Beyonder characteristic, he tampered with the number of his arms from 2 to 4, so he had four arms.
But currently, he couldn't tamper with "1" or other numbers to "0," that is, tampering from existence to non-existence, or from non-existence to existence. At least, he would have to accommodate the Uniqueness before he could do this.
Not only mathematics, but he could also manipulate physical laws. For example, before, if Hobert wanted to trap an enemy with ice, he needed to "tamper" with the freezing point, "distort" the temperature, and so on to achieve his goal.
Now there was no need to be so troublesome. He could directly "distort" the temperature of a large area to minus 100 degrees Celsius, and he could reach that temperature instantly without using a constantly accumulating method.
And he could "distort" solids into liquids or gases. In short, the effects that previously required constant accumulation to achieve could now be achieved instantly.
This was a change to natural laws. After becoming the "Prince of Abolition," Hobert could also perform more operations on the abstract social order of mankind.
For example, "exploiting" the status that the Loen royal family had always held in the hearts of the people, he could make all the people of Loen believe that Hobert was their king for a certain period of time.
Or he could make the people betray their king for a certain period of time.
Finally, Hobert even discovered that he could already perform some operations on the laws of Beyonder characteristics to a certain extent.
For example, causing the opponent's Beyonder power to fall into "Disorder." The target clearly wanted to attack the enemy, but instead, they raised their hand and threw a flower at the enemy.
This made Hobert sigh: Unexpectedness is the true nature of a "Lawyer."
Immediately afterwards, Hobert realized that he had already digested a portion of his "Prince of Abolition" potion in advance.
Using his spiritual perception, Hobert suddenly understood: This was the benefit he had gained from killing George III before.
After all, at that time, Hobert was still the Duke of Loen, and as a duke, he had assassinated the king, which was very much in line with the nature of the "Black Emperor" pathway.
Following this line of thought, Hobert began to consider how to digest the remaining majority of the potion as soon as possible. In this era of transition, only by accommodating the Uniqueness could Hobert feel a little at ease.
He first thought that if the Duchy of Southern Balam became independent, it would definitely digest a large portion of the potion!
However, this point required strategic consideration. After all, he could currently only influence the world situation, but he could not deviate from the world's pattern.
Especially in terms of developing the Duchy of Southern Balam, strategy was important.
However, there were also some other means to digest the potion. For example, Hobert could promote Eastern architectural styles and Eastern ideologies.
The reason why he hadn't implemented these policies in the Duchy of Southern Balam before was because he realized that these things could not only prepare for the advancement to "Black Emperor," but also digest the "Prince of Abolition" potion!
In addition, Hobert realized that with his current abilities, he could already play the role of "Prince of Abolition" by "tampering" and "distorting" natural states or climates!
To this end, Hobert planned to make a try first.
At this time, he had completely gathered his spirituality. After removing the barrier formed by the "Crystal of Order," Hobert quickly came to the beach by "distorting" space.
Then, he stretched one hand into the water and said in a very dramatic tone: "Ice Age!"
Whoosh ~
A cold wind suddenly swept across the sea, and the seawater within sight immediately turned into white ice!
The previous sea breeze became icy and biting, and because the temperature dropped instantly, a layer of white mist formed on the ice.
On the distant sea, many freighters and passenger ships were frozen on the sea. They thought they were dreaming. Originally, it was a blue sea and sky with bright sunshine, so how did the sea suddenly freeze?
At the same time, many seabirds on the sea swooped down to hunt as usual, but instead crashed hard on the ice!
Hobert pulled his palm out of the ice. Sure enough, he felt his spirituality become lively and his state more stable.
He made the tropical sea freeze, which was "disorder!"
Then, he stood on the beach, observing the power and duration of his ability.
The low temperature of the ice lasted for two or three minutes before the tropical warm wind blew again, but even in the tropics, melting such a large area of ice would take a lot of time.
In other words, the emergence of a large area of ice was a process of "disorder," but allowing the consequences of this process to return to normal order completely followed the laws of nature.
In order to understand his abilities, Hobert didn't leave, standing on the beach watching the ice melt little by little.
By the next day, the ice on the sea had thinned, and the ships could break the ice and continue to move forward.
But immediately afterwards, these ships encountered bad weather. This wasn't Hobert experimenting with Beyonder abilities again, but the impact on the local climate caused by the melting of a large amount of ice.
It wasn't until the third day that the ice on the sea completely melted, but the impact on the local climate might take a week or even ten days to completely recover.
This made Hobert sigh: Fortunately, the gods are currently in the astral world. If they were always in the real world, miracles would probably happen every day.
Returning to Angel's palace, Hobert first went to the "Nation of Disorder" to see the changes that had occurred within it.
As soon as he sat on the "Iron Throne," the "Bell of Order" in the Clock Tower suddenly rang on its own. Hobert immediately felt that he could further use the power of the "Bell of Order."
If he were to encounter the phantom formed under the influence of the "Monarch of Decay" at this time, there would be no need to use the "Spiritual Barrier." Perhaps a few strikes of the "Bell of Order" could directly dispel it!
At the same time, he realized that if he were to ring the bell while Klein was advancing to become The Fool in the future, he could greatly help Klein stabilize his state.
And if he were to accommodate the Uniqueness and then ring the bell at that time, Klein should be able to face Amon's attack in a very good state after advancing.
However, Hobert did not gain any new abilities from this advancement.
This was also expected. After all, when Hobert advanced to "Duke of Entropy," he had completely controlled the power of the "Nation of Disorder."
In other words, before accommodating this Sefirah, the "blessing" of the "Nation of Disorder" on Hobert had reached its limit at Sequence 2.
After this advancement, Hobert only had an increased control over the "Bell of Order."
Hobert was already very satisfied with this, after all, the effect brought by the "Bell of Order" was not something any ability could compare to.
Returning to the real world, Hobert took a deep breath. Just as he was about to send someone to invite Medici, the palace steward knocked on the door outside and said, "Your Grace, is it convenient to come in?"
Since Hobert had told everyone not to disturb him three days ago, the guards outside had not let anyone in.
The steward, who had not been working for long, was afraid that something might happen to the Grand Duke in the room, so he reported the matter to Fors and Audrey.
Fors opened a "door" on the wall and, after confirming that Hobert had left for something, told everyone not to disturb the Grand Duke.
But yesterday, the special envoy of the King of Loen came and wanted to report this matter to the Grand Duke as soon as possible.
The steward's shout was actually asking if Grand Duke Hobert had returned.
Hobert said coldly, "Come in."
Only then did the guard open the door and let the steward in.
The steward was about to report the matter of the King's special envoy, but suddenly froze. This profession required a keen ability to observe words and expressions. He felt that the Duke in front of him seemed different from three days ago, but he couldn't quite put his finger on what was different.
However, the steward quickly recovered and reported the matter of the King's special envoy.
Hobert then asked the steward to invite the special envoy to his office for a meeting.
The steward was slightly stunned: "Your Grace, this doesn't seem to be in accordance with etiquette. You should..."
From the point of view of etiquette, Hobert should lead all the important officials of Angel City in the hall for receiving foreign guests to welcome the special envoy.
Even if the special envoy had already stayed in Angel for one night, there should still be a welcoming ceremony.
Hobert frowned impatiently and said, "I told you to invite her, so go invite her!"
"Yes, yes, yes!"
The King's special envoy was still the outstanding Alice. Alice had no objection to Hobert's actions that did not conform to normal etiquette.
After all, Hobert's political status was there, and the strength of the Duchy of Southern Balam was there.
When she entered the door with a smile, she was also slightly stunned.
Hobert's face was cold, giving people a very unfamiliar feeling.
Alice quickly adjusted her state and also put on a businesslike appearance.
She had two things to do this time. The first was to represent the King in granting some of the industries and rights of the Eastern Balam Company to Hobert.
Without exception, those industries were all located in the Salto region in the south of the Duchy of Southern Balam. In fact, this was equivalent to granting this colony to Hobert.
The Loen agent in the Salto region was a Balam Empire noble. Now that the rights and interests of the Eastern Balam Company had been given to the Duchy of Southern Balam, it was equivalent to that place being a colony of the Duchy of Southern Balam.
After obtaining that colony, the territory of the Duchy reached the southernmost tip of the Southern Continent.
If the colony of the Intis Republic, which was also located at the southern end, was also seized, then the entire southern part of the Southern Continent would belong to the Duchy of Southern Balam.
The second thing Alice was here to do was to grant Hobert the title of "Prince."
Currently, Loen only had two princes, both of whom were high-level Beyonders from the Loen royal family.
At this time, Loen giving Hobert the title of "Prince" had a bit of a feeling of "nothing more to grant."
However, Hobert knew that this was actually the "bestow" of advancement that William I had mentioned before.
Hobert accepted those industries and privileges of the Eastern Balam Company, but did not accept the title of "Prince."
He said with a serious face: "If I become a prince, the nobles of Backlund will definitely object. Let's just be a Grand Duke."
In fact, he was considering that if he was named "Prince," the effect of digesting the potion might not be so good when the Duchy of Southern Balam became independent in the future.
Although Alice felt that Hobert's reason was very far-fetched, she did not continue to insist because the other party's tone was unquestionable.
That night, Hobert held a grand banquet to entertain the King's special envoy, but Alice could not feel any enthusiasm.
Audrey, who attended the party, immediately understood after seeing Hobert's expression that he had completed his advancement.
Audrey quickly asked the maid Annie to inform Fors of this matter.
Before this, they had discussed that during the period from Hobert's advancement to the wedding, they would take turns staying by Hobert's side to avoid him doing anything out of line.
The next day, during the formal talks between the Duchy of Southern Balam and the King's special envoy, Alice proposed the request that the Duchy of Southern Balam support the western front of Loen. Unsurprisingly, Hobert refused on the grounds that the current Beyonder forces were all in the Highlands County and Karen County.
Alice also proposed to visit the industrial area of the Duchy of Southern Balam, but Hobert also refused on the grounds that "it is too snowy and transportation is inconvenient."
After seeing off the King's special envoy, Hobert immediately asked someone to invite Medici to his office.
Medici, with a young face with Southern Continent characteristics, quickly followed the waiter in. He glanced at Hobert and said, "Your two wives are so beautiful, but I didn't expect you to be in such a bad state."
He thought that Hobert was in a bad state, so his divinity had gained the upper hand.
"It's none of your business." Hobert frowned and said, "I have something else to ask you today."
Medici smiled and said, "Help me advance to become an angel again?"
"Yes." Hobert said, "This is a reward for your previous war."
He paused and added: "But I have one request, you must join the 'Creator's' faction."
"I know that with your qualifications, no one is qualified to lead you, so I specially applied to the 'Creator' for you to have the same status as me, but our permissions are different.
"I have no other requirements, I only ask that you act in accordance with my strategic intentions!"
Medici joked: "Do you think I'm a fool? This is the position the 'Creator' gave me, right? How did it become something you applied for?"
His smile was just right, making his words and deeds look very annoying!
"You..." Hobert took a deep breath before saying, "You should pay attention to the timing and target of 'provocation'!"
Medici said: "You should also pay attention to who you are talking to and whether you have basic morals of respecting the old and loving the young."
Hobert was immediately amused: "Okay, child, I will 'love the young'."
"In terms of seniority, Lilith has helped you a lot." Medici had been hovering around the periphery of the angelic battlefield, so he already knew that Hobert was Lilith's child: "But I am still very curious, why would Lilith have a child at this time?
"But this should be her nature, after all, her profession is having children!"
If Medici had used "She" instead of "she," Hobert wouldn't have bothered with Medici, but Medici was obviously very clear about how to poke Hobert's trachea, causing him to suddenly release the pressure of an angel: "You..."
"Okay, okay," Medici said quickly when he saw that Hobert was about to get serious, "Let's talk about business."
Hobert also understood Medici's intentions. He took a deep breath, put away the pressure of the angel level, and felt that his humanity had recovered a lot.
That's right, Medici had deliberately provoked him continuously just now to try to help Hobert restore his humanity.
When having dinner that day, Audrey was surprised to find: "Hobert, you... you seem to have overcome the divinity after the advancement yourself?"
Hobert said with emotion: "I feel much better indeed."
Fors on the other side asked: "How did you do it?"
Hobert smiled wryly: "If you have a colleague who is very good at annoying people, you can easily do this."
...
Backlund is now in chaos. A large number of people have lost their jobs and sources of income. The number of homeless people and streetwalkers on the streets has increased several times compared to usual!
And the large amount of grain that the "Duke's Grain" had previously sold in Backlund has been purchased by the military in a way that is almost "forced buying."
The speed of the collapse of the western front is faster than expected. Loen didn't have time to transport too much grain.
The loss of this large granary, coupled with the fleets of the Feysac Empire and the Intis Republic harassing Pritz Harbor in turn, has led to a shortage of military supplies.
In order to raise enough military grain, the Loen military had to "purchase" grain in this way.
At this time, the new season's grain from the Rorsted Archipelago was still about a month away from harvest, and the Loen colonial army in the Southern Continent had lost another world-class granary, the Paz River Valley, and all of its territory.
This meant that the "Duke's Grain" also didn't have much grain to sell, so the price of grain rose three times a day. Even the middle class who hadn't lost their jobs were finding it hard to afford bread.
As a result, robbery and theft became commonplace in Backlund. People not only had to find ways to get bread, but also had to be able to get the bread to their families.
At this time, scenes of people fighting violently over a loaf of bread, leaving one side seriously injured, were frequently staged on the streets of Backlund.
The police were too lazy to care, and pedestrians were already used to it.
It was under such circumstances that Hobert and Audrey's wedding was held as scheduled.
In this war, the lives of the nobles had not been greatly affected so far. They had already stockpiled enough grain to last for two or three years. They also had many manors that could continuously produce food, and the military would not "purchase" the grain in their hands.
Therefore, the nobles basically pretended not to see the current chaos in Backlund.
A few nobles did advocate that everyone donate a portion of their grain to ordinary people to prevent them from taking risks, but there was no way to fundamentally solve the current problem.
In Hobert's view, the best way now was to provide work as a form of relief, to find things for these people to do.
Hobert even had his agent in the House of Lords, Lord Bradley, propose such a bill in Parliament. The bill was passed, but the government departments did not implement it.
This was because all government departments were now serving the war effort and had no time to implement these bills.
They planned to issue guns to the police to disperse the crowds when things became uncontrollable in the future.
They believed that after dispersing them a few times, no one would dare to cause trouble again.
Hobert stopped interfering and focused on getting married.
Although it was under the shadow of war, and the wedding was held in a relatively rushed time for the nobles, the wedding was still very grand.
The wedding was held at the Saint Samuel Cathedral of the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Preparations for the venue had to begin two days in advance, and the carpets, candlesticks, and decorations were almost completely changed.
Because of the political status of Hobert, Christian, and Earl Hall, almost all the nobles of Loen and the high-ranking officers of the military would attend this wedding.
On the day of the wedding, around seven o'clock in the morning, as soon as the doors of the cathedral hall opened, nobles in full dress arrived one after another.
There were so many nobles attending the wedding today that the earliest batch of nobles were basically not qualified to sit.
They could only be arranged to stand behind the seats or by the windows.
Gradually, more and more nobles and military officers came to the church, and Hobert's butler, Corris, and others were extremely busy.
It was not until after eight o'clock that important guests arrived at the church. They were either holding important positions or were some earl or duke.
In short, as soon as they came in, some of the guests who had already sat down had to stand up and greet them honestly.
Around nine o'clock, Georgina, Alice, and other members of the royal family arrived.
Immediately afterward, Hobert, dressed in a black formal suit, entered from the back door and came to the altar at the front of the church.
At this time, the Empress Dowager, the King, and the Queen arrived one after another. Everyone present stood up to greet them, and Hobert at the altar also expressed his gratitude to the King and the other two for attending his wedding.
At this time, the entire church was already full. The last time the Loen nobles gathered so completely was at the ceremony where Christian was conferred the title of Duke.
The orchestra began to play music. Hobert heard the music mixed with the chaotic chatter of everyone and suddenly felt that getting married was really troublesome!
The sound of horses neighing rang out again outside. The bride Audrey, dressed in a white wedding dress, elegantly stretched out a hand from the carriage. Earl Hall, who had already gotten out of the carriage, held his daughter's hand and helped her out of the carriage.
Audrey's golden hair was covered by a white veil, and her stunning face was faintly visible under the thin wedding dress, adding a layer of mystery to her beauty.
Seeing Audrey walking towards him on the carpet, Hobert took a deep breath: A little trouble is fine, I guess.
Behind Audrey were the flower girls, also dressed in white dresses, and the ring bearer in a black tuxedo, followed by several bridesmaids also dressed in white dresses.
Earl Hall led Audrey to the altar and solemnly placed Audrey's hand in Hobert's hand.
The Earl's eyes were slightly red as he said, "My most beloved daughter, I will leave her to you from now on."
Hobert took Audrey's hand: "Don't worry, I will definitely live up to our feelings."
At this moment, He suddenly felt that his humanity had once again suppressed his divinity.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 701 Wedding with Audrey
chapters.content:
