Archbishop Anthony of the Church of the Evernight Goddess personally officiated the wedding for the couple. When he stood between Hobert and Audrey, the church immediately fell silent.
Dressed in magnificent archbishop's robes, Anthony said in a solemn voice, "Dear guests, we are gathered here today to witness this grand event of love.
"Groom Hobert Jeffrey, with his steadfast character and profound wisdom, has earned the admiration of countless people.
"Bride Audrey Hall, from the Hall family of East Chester County, with her noble, beautiful, and elegant temperament, and kind character, has won the love of everyone."
"At this moment, they will entrust themselves to each other, vowing with sacred marriage vows to stay together for life."
Archbishop Anthony stepped forward, paused, and then said, "Hobert Jeffrey, are you willing to enter into a marital relationship with this woman and live together?
"For the rest of your life, will you love her, comfort her, respect her, protect her, in health and in sickness, willing to Feysac all else, and be forever faithful to her?"
Hobert: "I do!"
Archbishop Anthony then turned to the other side and said, "Audrey Hall, are you willing to enter into a marital relationship with this man, facing the ups and downs of life with him, whether in good times or bad, willing to support him, understand him, and love him, forever?"
Audrey also solemnly said, "I do."
The Archbishop asked the guests, "Does anyone object to this union?"
Hobert glanced at the guests. Several young nobles seemed eager to try, but in the end, no one stood up.
Anthony held Hobert's hand and said, "Since there is no objection, the groom may recite his vows."
The guests stood up to witness Hobert's vows.
Hobert said solemnly, "I, Hobert Jeffrey, take you, Audrey Hall, to be my wife, from this day forward, for better or for worse, for richer or for poorer, in sickness and in health, to love and cherish each other.
"Before the Evernight Goddess, I make this vow to you."
The atmosphere of the wedding was heightened, and Hobert's vows sounded particularly solemn.
Anthony held Audrey's hand: "Bride, please recite your vows."
Audrey also solemnly said, "I, Audrey Hall, take you, Hobert Jeffrey, to be my husband…"
After the vow exchange, at Anthony's prompting, the ring bearer stepped forward, holding the rings beside the groom.
Anthony continued, "May the Evernight Goddess bless this ring, bless him who gives it and her who receives it, that they may be faithful to each other, and be with peace and grace, forever loving each other."
Hobert took the ring and placed it on Audrey's finger: "In the name of the gods and saints, with this ring as my witness, I take you to be my wife. With my body, I vow to respect you. Praise the Goddess!"
Listening to Hobert's vows, Audrey revealed a sweet smile behind her veil.
Anthony stood between them and said, "The Evernight Goddess, standing higher than the cosmos and more eternal than eternity, bestows upon us noble spirits and enjoys eternal life, will bless this couple.
"They will fulfill their vows, and this ring will serve as a testament, forever dwelling in peace and joy. Praise the Goddess!"
Among the guests, the Goddess's followers said together, "Praise the Lady!"
Anthony placed Hobert and Audrey's hands together: "May those whom the Goddess has joined together never be separated."
Hobert looked at Audrey in her pure white wedding dress and suddenly smiled. At that moment, satisfaction and comfort filled his heart.
The Archbishop concluded, "In as much as Hobert and Audrey have consented to enter into marriage, and have exchanged vows and rings, I now, in the name of the gods and saints, pronounce them husband and wife!"
All the guests applauded together. Amidst the thunderous applause, Hobert lifted Audrey's veil, and looking at the beautiful face before him, he still felt somewhat incredulous: I married Audrey!
Hobert took Audrey's hand, kissed the back of her hand, and then they both raised their hands, accepting the applause of the guests.
Next was the blessing ceremony. First to offer blessings were, of course, Jevington II, the Queen, and the Queen's mother, the three present royals.
Because there were so many nobles present today, those below the rank of Earl were not qualified to step forward and offer blessings.
After the blessing ceremony, the choir took the stage, blessing the bride and groom again with hymns.
Finally, Archbishop Anthony read relevant chapters from the 'Revelations of the Night' to pray for blessings, and the entire wedding ceremony finally came to an end.
Next, Christian hosted the guests at his mansion. Before the luncheon began, a certain number of guards from Angel City accepted a review by Hobert and Audrey in front of Christian's mansion.
This was the first time the people of the Northern Continent had seen the army of the Southern Balam Duchy. The soldiers were full of energy, and every movement was clean and neat, demonstrating a moving military might.
Many high-ranking military officers who attended the wedding fell silent. They seemed to see light in the eyes of these soldiers!
The officers were very clear that it was the light of faith. These soldiers were full of a sense of honor for their mission and full of a sense of honor for their identity as soldiers.
In the Kingdom of Loen, where a large number of veterans had already died in battle, no army had such a spirit anymore.
Jevington II and the royal family members were also silent. They saw loyalty in the soldiers' eyes, the kind of loyalty that was willing to die generously for Hobert and the Southern Balam Duchy at any time.
Next, several civilian formations offered blessings. The simple immigrant formations blessed and praised the two newlyweds in simple and unadorned Loen language.
Members of the Angel City formation wore Feynapotter clothing and Loen clothing. They praised Audrey for holding the duchy's capital during the civil war and sincerely blessed the two newlyweds.
The most enthusiastic were the indigenous formations. They wore exotic costumes and sincerely praised Audrey for bringing them a new life, and sincerely blessed the two newlyweds.
Behind them were the Ministry of Foreign Affairs formation, and each county also sent formations of twenty or thirty people.
Their blessings allowed the guests to see a united and diverse Southern Balam Duchy, completely different from their impression of colonies and the Southern Continent.
People in the political circles saw that the government mechanism of the Southern Balam Duchy had been perfected in a very short period of time, and even a large part of the former subjects of the Highland Kingdom were willing to submit to the rule of the duchy.
After the blessing and military parade, the belated luncheon began amidst soothing music.
The banquet was set up from the hall to the outdoor lawn. Although the dishes looked luxurious, don't expect them to taste very good.
Because the quantity was too large, it was impossible for the kitchen to make the dishes for each guest too well.
The chefs mainly ensured that the dishes for the newlyweds and important guests such as the king were exquisite enough.
The wine at the luncheon was about the same, all red wine from the year Audrey was born.
During the luncheon, Hobert and Audrey had a separate table. At this time, the two were relatively free and could enjoy the food in front of them without being disturbed.
Hobert looked at the guests and whispered, "Is that fat man your uncle?
"Now I finally believe that the family's genetics will not all be reflected in the descendants."
Audrey, who had already changed into a more convenient dress, corrected, "He is a distant uncle!"
Then she added, "His son is currently working in the Southern Balam Duchy. He is one of the noble children you recruited before. I heard that he is likely to be transferred to Corinne County as governor recently."
Hobert slowly nodded: "This uncle looks unremarkable, but his level of educating children must be very high, and he has contributed very excellent talents to the duchy."
Audrey shook her head with a smile.
After the luncheon, it was the "Groom's Ball" session. The guests moved to Hobert's Duke's Mansion to participate in a grand ball held there.
In the dressing room of the ballroom, Hobert and Audrey changed clothes under the service of the servants.
Audrey discovered from the mirror that Hobert was staring at her blankly, so she asked, "What's wrong?"
"I have never seen such…" Hobert raised his hand to describe, "…such a perfect thing!"
At this time, Audrey was only wearing a close-fitting thin dress, and her perfect figure was unintentionally revealed. In Hobert's view, it was simply like a work of art.
Audrey was somewhat shy, but she still showed a generous smile: "Hurry up and change clothes, the guests are still waiting for us."
The two people in gorgeous costumes danced the first dance of the day. They danced very attentively, bringing the guests a performance that could be called a visual and auditory feast.
After that, it was the chat session. The two people became completely busy, and they didn't even have time to drink a glass of champagne.
First, King Jevington II came to praise Hobert's achievements in the Southern Continent, and then euphemistically proposed the hope that Hobert could support Loen.
Hobert began to complain to the king about poverty, saying how difficult the internal affairs of the Southern Balam Duchy were, and also said that the duchy was currently surrounded by the other three countries in the Southern Continent, as if as long as one soldier was transferred from the country, the entire duchy might collapse.
Listening to Hobert saying that it was so crisis-ridden, Jevington II was finally moved and supported the Southern Balam Duchy with 100,000 pounds of funds.
Some well-known nobles, using their relationship with Earl Hall, hoped to attach themselves to Hobert and get some benefits in the Southern Balam Duchy.
There were also nobles who hoped to meet Hobert on such occasions. After all, the fact that the Duke raised his hand and gave Lord Bradley a seat in the House of Representatives had already spread in the noble and wealthy circles.
So they took this opportunity to try their best to show themselves, hoping that they could leave some impression on Hobert.
Thus, Hobert and Audrey were caught in a whirlwind of social engagements, from afternoon to evening balls, leaving them no time to rest.
Finally, after hosting a buffet-style dinner for the guests, the wedding finally came to an end.
Hobert and Audrey were both Beyonders with high Sequences, so their bodies didn't feel tired, but their minds were exhausted.
In the evening, Hobert and Audrey each removed their makeup, changed into pajamas, and met in the bedroom.
Hobert kissed Audrey, feeling her somewhat unskilled return kiss, then held her as they lay on the bed, feeling the softness against his chest, one hand drifting to Audrey's round, upturned bottom.
Hobert was suddenly excited, truly realizing at that moment: I have the beautiful and charming Audrey!
[T/N: I didn't get to writing this...]
…
The complexity of noble marriages exceeded Hobert's imagination. In the following half month, Hobert had to visit some noble relatives with Audrey.
This round of visits was originally supposed to take place before the wedding, as a way of introducing them to each other, but at that time, the Duchy of Southern Balam was at war, and Hobert didn't have time, so he had to arrange the visits after the wedding.
Fortunately, half of the Loen Kingdom had already fallen into enemy hands, otherwise this visit would have taken even longer.
This further delayed Hobert and Klein's hunting plan for the Dark Demonic Wolf, and it wasn't until late May that the two of them agreed on a specific time for the operation.
Hobert once again told everyone not to disturb him, and then prayed to The Fool in the study: "The Fool who does not belong to this era…"
"I will, together with Mr. World, launch a hunting operation in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'."
"For this, I will sacrifice myself. Please use this method to help me go to the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods'."
After completing the prayer, Hobert knelt on one knee in front of the altar, waiting for "The Fool's" response.
After about four or five seconds, Hobert's vision blurred, and he found himself above the seven-colored light.
The seven rays of light were the seven lights of the spirit world, and below them were clusters of knowledge, illusory figures, and scenes that were both rational and irrational.
After passing through a heavy door, Hobert arrived at a castle filled with gray fog.
The surrounding gray fog was like tentacles, reaching out as if to entangle Hobert, but a force kept them out, protecting Hobert.
Deep within the castle, a phantom figure sat in a high-backed chair, and he slightly raised his hand.
Hobert immediately felt himself being stuffed into a shining door by a force. When he came back to his senses, he was already in a space dominated by darkness.
Hobert was kneeling on one knee on an ancient altar, in front of him was Klein, also kneeling on one knee with his head lowered.
As far as the eye could see, it was a barren wilderness. Occasionally, there were one or two creatures, but they also looked obviously strange.
Retracting his gaze, Hobert looked at Klein, who was lowering his head: This action could very well conceal the fact that his spirit body had returned from the "Divine Kingdom of The Fool".
The next second, Klein raised his head: "How do you feel?"
Hobert got up and stretched before smiling and saying: "It's a little cold in Mr. Fool's Divine Kingdom."
Klein also smiled, meaning that there was no discomfort in coming to the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" in this way.
Hobert looked at the lightning-filled sky: "'Little Sun' and the others live in this kind of hellish place!"
Before Klein could say anything, Hobert took a deep breath: "Alright, we should get to work."
"Wait a moment, I'll do an experiment first."
As he spoke, he reached out and grabbed in front of him. The next second, he seemed to have grabbed something, his movements becoming somewhat sluggish, but he successfully took out the "0-76" Death God Sword from the "Nation of Disorder".
Hobert had just crushed this Sealed Artifact, preparing to use the characteristics of the "Weather Warlock" within to help Medici restore to the level of an angel.
So at this time, this Sealed Artifact only had the characteristics of a Sequence 1 Beyonder. Its appearance had not changed much, and its Beyonder abilities had not decreased, except that some abilities such as manipulating the weather had been weakened.
Immediately, Hobert explained with a smile: "The spatial magic bestowed upon me by the great 'Creator' can be used."
"We can start the operation."
Klein looked at this very convenient ability and said "Mm", pointing to a deep pit in the distance: "It's over there!"
He paused and added: "By the way, congratulations, I heard you got married again."
Hobert and Audrey's wedding was widely publicized by Loen through the media. In their view, this was a symbol of the deep binding between the Loen Kingdom and the Duchy of Southern Balam.
This made the entire Northern Continent and the Rorsted Archipelago aware of the wedding. Klein even heard about it from Danitz, rather than through a member of the Tarot Club.
"My friend, don't be so sarcastic," Hobert said with a smile. "Do you think this is a happy marriage? Do you think I married the most beautiful woman in Backlund?"
The two of them didn't use Beyonder abilities, just like they were on an outing, chatting idly as they walked forward.
Klein was slightly stunned: "That's pretty much what I think."
He had seen Miss Justice and knew how beautiful this noble lady, like a high-ranking witch, was.
But listening to Hobert's words, it seemed like there was something else hidden inside?
Hobert said seriously: "Your opinion is correct!"
Klein was stunned for a second or two before realizing that Hobert had just humblebragged in front of him.
Hobert found that after working with Medici, he was becoming less and less likely to speak in a normal way.
It was like when he asked Medici to formulate a war plan to attack Akon, Medici only needed to say "This kind of small matter doesn't need to bother me".
But this "Red Angel" said: "Do you think I'm too old to walk, so you're caring for a mentally retarded old man?"
Hobert wasn't "provoked" much, but the other officers present were "provoked", because Medici was unwilling to plan such a simple plan, and the task of formulating the war plan fell to Elliott and the others.
These commanders felt that they were young and strong, neither too old to walk nor mentally retarded old men.
Thinking of this, Hobert shook his head slightly and asked, following this topic: "Do you have any plans to get married or fall in love?"
Klein, who had just reacted, was stunned again, and then he smiled: "Essentially, the mystical world is distortion and chaos."
"Especially after reaching the 'High Sequence', there is too much uncertainty, I still don't want to implicate others."
Hobert said: "We have a saying 'Food and sex are human nature'. I personally think that these two things can enhance humanity."
"Or rather, controlling your desires is more like a person."
"If you don't have any desires at all, it's not conducive to maintaining your state."
Regarding this theory, Klein pondered for a while before saying: "I don't seem to know how to handle the relationship between men and women well."
Before the transmigration, he could talk freely in front of the computer screen, but when he really saw a woman, he felt very cramped, but it wasn't that he felt nervous, he just didn't know what to talk about, but if he didn't start a topic, he felt very embarrassed. This is a typical 'otaku syndrome'.
Hobert said seriously: "Maybe the more this is the case, the better it will be for you to maintain your humanity."
Klein realized that Hobert was actually telling him that this was a way to improve his humanity.
He seriously recalled that among the angels he knew, Mr. Azik and Hobert were in the best condition.
And a big anchor for Mr. Azik himself was his memories of his lover and family in his previous resurrections.
So Klein smiled and said: "When I return to the real world, I will try it out."
Hobert "Mm"ed, and the two of them had already arrived in front of the giant pit.
Klein described: "According to the information I obtained, more than two years ago, a mountain here suddenly turned into this giant pit."
"Soon, the Dark Demonic Wolf Kotar rushed over and took away a 'curtain'-like Beyonder item that caused this change. There should be the Sequence 1 characteristic of my pathway in that curtain."
"Later, the Dark Demonic Wolf took the 'curtain' away and left here."
Then he said: "Before the battle, we must discuss how to divide the spoils. If we only get this 'curtain', the Sequence 2 characteristic inside must belong to me."
"According to the previous agreement, the Sequence 1 characteristic inside will be given to you. I will find a way to find items of the same level for you to trade, unless our negotiations break down, otherwise, you cannot trade it to others."
Hobert nodded: "That's fine, we should help each other anyway."
"If we successfully hunt Kotar, his Beyonder characteristics will be given to you, and the 'curtain' you mentioned will belong to me."
"Afterwards, I will definitely give you a discount on the transaction of the Sequence 1 characteristic inside."
He thought to himself: You may not know that if you didn't ask me to help, although you didn't successfully hunt Kotar, that "curtain" would be yours.
So Hobert didn't intend to make overly harsh demands and would give a considerable discount.
After discussing the specific ownership of the spoils, Hobert took out the crown-shaped "Death God Sword" again: "Get ready!"
Then, Hobert injected his spirituality into this Sealed Artifact, using the "Conqueror" level ability to search for clues about Kotar.
Finding clues about the "prey" is the most basic ability of a "Hunter".
And reaching this level, one can already search through the spirit world for clues about the "prey," even finding some abstract or extraordinary clues.
However, even a "Conqueror" would find it nearly impossible to locate a Sequence 2 level Dark Demonic Wolf using clues from over two years ago.
This is where the ability of the "strongest support" comes into play. Hobert's ability can directly find Kotar through clues about Kotar.
After "searching" for the better part of a minute, Hobert pulled out a very faint thread from the illusory spirit world.
That was the "spirit body thread" that Kotar had once used here. He must have manipulated a marionette here.
At this time, it was also the safe usage time for the "Death God's Sword," and Hobert quickly put it back into the "Nation of Disorder."
He looked at the illusory "spirit body thread" in his hand and used the ability of "Connection."
The faint thread in his hand suddenly became solid, leading to the distant darkness.
Hobert immediately used the method of "distorting" space, bringing Klein from afar along the thread!
At this time, Hobert's limit of "distorting" space at once was already around 500 kilometers. After distorting three times, they arrived in front of an ancient castle in a continuous mountain range.
Giants, elves, humans, and Sanguine played the roles of servants, cooks, and guards. They would chat with each other when they met, looking very lively and spiritual.
But once they returned to their rooms, their expressions would immediately become dull, and they would be hung on the ceiling by an invisible force.
This was exactly the ritual Kotar had prepared for advancement, but at this time, he had already sensed the danger. Kotar, as huge as a small mountain, was now entering the "Historical Void."
He wore a "curtain" that looked similar to velvet on his back, resembling a unique cloak.
From the time Hobert found the clue to now, it was only about 3 seconds, but that was enough for an angel of the "Seer" pathway, who was spiritually sensitive and had the ability to foresee, to sense the danger.
Hobert had previously speculated that completing all of this within 5 seconds would allow them to "block" Kotar.
But now it seemed that it was at most 4 seconds!
If they couldn't get through in 4 seconds, Kotar would run away.
Hobert immediately stretched out his hand, causing Kotar's Beyonder abilities to fall into "Disorder!"
This was the change in the "Disorder" ability after advancing to Sequence 1. It could not only make rules and space chaotic, but even Beyonder abilities could become chaotic.
As a result, the Historical Void in front of Kotar rapidly shrank, and finally, only a gap as thick as a finger remained.
Kotar, who was four or five meters tall, huge, and had eight legs, was slightly stunned. For thousands of years, this was the first time he had encountered such a thing!
But immediately afterward, a ball of flame suddenly ignited in the distance within sight. Kotar disappeared in place. In the next second, the flame rapidly expanded, outlining Kotar's shadow.
He was about to use the ability of flame again to escape to a farther place, but suddenly felt the "curtain" on his back tightening more and more. It seemed to have received some order, and strands of spirit body threads were connected to the spirit body threads of the Dark Demonic Wolf.
This was Hobert using the ability of "Exploit," manipulating that "curtain" to attack Kotar.
At Hobert's level, as long as the target carried a sealed artifact, the ability and negative effects of that sealed artifact could be "exploited" by Hobert.
Kotar immediately exchanged positions with a marionette. In the next instant, the "curtain" turned Kotar's marionette into his own marionette.
That marionette rolled up the "curtain" and fled the battlefield.
At the beginning of the battle, Kotar realized that his enemy was very powerful, so he abandoned the "curtain" to save his life.
But Hobert didn't intend to let go of this Dark Demonic Wolf. He "tampered" with the eight legs of the other party, turning them into one.
Thump~
Kotar, who couldn't hop on one leg, suddenly fell to the ground. He simply lay on the ground, grabbing something from the void with his only remaining leg.
In the next second, Hobert took out the "0-78" Spiritual Wilderness from the "Nation of Disorder" while appearing in front of the Dark Demonic Wolf, holding the "Sword of Disorder," and stabbed Kotar with it.
Puff~
Kotar turned into a substitute. He then appeared dozens of kilometers away.
He was still grabbing something, until when he grabbed for the third time, his movements suddenly became a little sluggish, as if he had grabbed something.
Hobert was arranging "spiritual barriers" around him, while quickly causing Kotar's abilities to fall into "Disorder." As a result, Kotar's only remaining leg grabbed a piece of leftover cheese.
Kotar obviously lacked the experience of fighting with the "Prince of Abolition." This change made him slightly stunned again.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert "distorted" Kotar's sanity, causing his brain to lose all reaction ability in the next 2 seconds.
At this time, Hobert rushed up and stabbed Kotar with a sword, then slashed down, splitting this Dark Demonic Wolf in half.
At this time, Klein had just released the messenger Reinette Tinekerr from the gold coin. Reinette had just used the "Yesterday Once More" spell to restore herself to her peak state.
After seeing the tragic state of the Dark Demonic Wolf, the two were slightly stunned, feeling that they didn't seem to need to go over to help.
Hobert did not continue to attack Kotar, but continued to arrange spiritual barriers around him with the "Spiritual Wilderness."
Soon Kotar regained his sanity. After feeling that he had suffered a fatal injury, he immediately used the method of substitution to avoid the damage.
The piece of paper he used as a substitute split in half from the middle. At the same time, the injuries on his body were somewhat reduced, but after two or three seconds, the injuries returned to their original severity.
Hobert simply ignored the dying struggle of the Dark Demonic Wolf. After building a thick spiritual barrier around him, Hobert began to use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to lay a thin layer of "Order Crystals" on the outside of the spiritual barrier.
At this time, Kotar suddenly disappeared in place and exchanged positions with a marionette.
Like that piece of paper, the marionette also split in half, but the injuries on Kotar's body still did not improve.
Immediately afterward, he tried hard to use his only remaining claws to perform "damage transfer." Not only did the original wound not improve, but deep wounds that could see the bone immediately appeared in the place that was "transferred" to.
Finally, Kotar made a wish to himself: "I hope I can completely recover."
The injuries did start to improve, but in a few seconds, the injuries started to worsen again.
At this time, Kotar realized that his injuries could not be recovered. He could feel that his own order was rapidly collapsing.
Kotar's feeling was right. At this time, his essence was injured. Unless he grasped enough authority, it would be difficult to recover with just Beyonder abilities.
At the same time, the attack of the "Sword of Disorder" also had the effect of "entropy increase." Kotar's wounds began to turn into powder.
By the time Hobert built the "Order Crystal" barrier, Kotar had turned into a pile of dust.
Next was the most critical stage. Could the barrier formed by the spiritual barrier plus the "Order Crystals" block the process of Kotar's resurrection?
This guy had lived for thousands of years, and he must have made many preparations for resurrection. He would definitely resurrect in some hidden place in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods," and would not choose to "resurrect in place."
Once resurrected, Kotar could cut off contact with everything before the resurrection. If he wanted to continue hunting, it would take a long time to find him again.
If it weren't for a coincidence, it might take a year or two to find clues about him.
Wahhh~
A few seconds later, the powder of Kotar's corpse was suddenly rolled up by a strange wind. The strange wind reshaped Kotar's body. He resurrected in place.
Hobert smiled. It seemed that the barrier he had spent a lot of time building was effective.
It would definitely be effective. These spiritual barriers had the abstract meaning of "cage," and things like spiritual bodies, mental bodies, and even "light" could be "imprisoned."
The ability of "Order Crystals" could isolate all mystical things. The "Miracle Invoker's" resurrection belonged to Beyonder abilities, and theoretically, it was also within the range that could be isolated.
Building these two layers of barriers was a method that Hobert had thought of before hunting.
In addition, he could also use abilities such as "Exploit" and "Distortion" to affect Kotar's resurrection, but this was, after all, an angel-level resurrection, and Hobert did not have complete certainty.
Since Kotar couldn't escape, he had to immediately carry out the second round of attack.
However, as soon as Kotar resurrected, six of his eight legs made pulling motions together.
Hobert "distorted" part of his ability to summon historical projections, and did not have time to "distort" six times at once.
Finally, he pulled out another Dark Demonic Wolf from the Historical Void.
At this time, Reinette had turned into a huge rag doll like a castle. This rag doll had bright red eyes, mysterious patterns engraved on its body, and was entangled with evil vines.
Reinette immediately used the ability of "Deformation Curse" to turn Kotar into a sheep.
"Magnify!" Hobert magnified the effect of the curse in a timely manner, turning Kotar into a real sheep for a certain period of time.
At this time, Klein also came to the front and summoned the "Death Knell" from the Historical Void, firing two shots at the sheep, and Kotar died again.
But Hobert noticed something was wrong. The fur color and patterns of the Dark Demonic Wolf that Kotar summoned had obvious differences from his. He was definitely not summoning himself.
But strangely, the summoned Demonic Wolf stood there motionless.
Hobert raised a hand: "Disorder!"
Suddenly, it was as if a mirror had been broken before the eyes of the three of them, and another scene came into view.
The Dark Demonic Wolf that had been summoned remained standing there, unmoving. However, Kotar had not been turned into a sheep. He remained in the form of a Direwolf, using a mystical item brimming with spirituality, summoned from the crevices of history, to attempt to break the spiritual barrier.
Hobert believed that the summoned Dark Demonic Wolf should be the former "Mother of the Sky." After all, the "Goddess of Misfortune" of the past had already become the "Evernight Goddess," someone Kotar couldn't summon.
He probably wouldn't dare to summon a Sequence 1 Antigonus either. The "Half-Fool" was in such a strange state; who knew what would happen if his historical projection was summoned?
"Frenzy!" Hobert briefly plunged the historical projection of the "Mother of the Sky" into a state of "Frenzy." As a Beyonder a Sequence higher, this was easily done.
In the next instant, the three reappeared before Kotar, their main target still being this "God of Wishes."
Actually, according to Klein's idea, after obtaining the "Curtain," hunting this Dark Demonic Wolf was no longer such an urgent matter.
However, Hobert still had an "Scholar of Yore" subordinate, who definitely hoped to obtain another "Miracle Invoker" Beyonder characteristic.
Under Hobert's lead, their offensive remained sharp.
A huge doll figure suddenly appeared in Kotar's eyes. At the instant Reinette appeared before Kotar, she had already completed "Wraith Possession."
Hobert seized the opportunity to step forward and touched Kotar, "Tampering" with the structure of his body. Kotar was like a toy that suddenly fell apart, his eight legs falling off one by one.
Reinette immediately left Kotar's body. At this time, Kotar's head and tail also fell off, his entire abdomen fell apart, and all his internal organs flowed out.
Once this process reached this stage, it was difficult for Kotar to stop his own "disassembly."
At this moment, Hobert stepped forward and stabbed the head of the helpless Kotar with his sword. If he waited patiently, the process of Kotar's body falling apart would continue until the "parts" of his body were scattered beyond repair.
Only through actual combat could Hobert feel the changes between a Great Angel and an Angel.
Although it couldn't be said that a huge change had occurred again, it was still very easy for a Great Angel to deal with a Sequence 2 Angel.
It's just that Sequence 2 Angels have many ways to escape.
For example, in this battle, if Hobert didn't have the help of the "Crystal of Order," he could have killed Kotar relatively easily. After all, this "God of Wishes" was obviously very unfamiliar with the abilities at the "Lawyer" Angel level.
But if he gave the other party a chance to revive, it would be difficult to find him again, and it would be difficult to kill him completely.
With Kotar's second death, the "Mother of the Sky" he summoned also dissipated.
A few seconds later, Kotar revived for the second time. He immediately exchanged positions with his Marionette, creating distance between himself and the three.
He opened his huge mouth and said in an ancient language: "I wish to… obtain a delicious fried chicken."
During the process of Hobert and the others rushing over, Hobert "Distorted" Kotar's wish.
A fried chicken immediately appeared in front of this Dark Demonic Wolf, but this was not what he wanted!
Kotar used his Marionette to evade again. Hobert simply severed the "connection" between him and his Marionette. For the next 30 seconds, he would not be able to perform any operations on the original Marionette.
Then, with the cooperation of Hobert and Reinette, Kotar was possessed again. Hobert stepped forward and used the "Sword of Disorder" to kill this "God of Wishes."
This time, Kotar failed to revive again. Hobert accelerated the speed of Beyonder characteristic extraction. The Beyonder characteristic was really extracted, indicating that this "Miracle Invoker's" Resurrection Chances had been used up.
Following behind the two Angels, Klein couldn't help but imagine what he should do if he encountered a situation like Kotar's?
In the end, he discovered that apart from using the power of the "Sefirah Castle," there was no other way.
At the same time, Klein had a new understanding of Hobert's abilities after his advancement.
It's just that he actually had some misunderstandings. Hobert could only kill a "Miracle Invoker" so easily with a partner.
Although Miss Messenger didn't play a big role this time, this was a characteristic of the "Lawyer" pathway's abilities. If it was just Hobert himself, it definitely wouldn't have been so easy.

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 702: Three Angels Pledge Allegiance to the Creator
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert handed Klein the "Miracle Invoker" characteristic, which resembled a crystal heart that constantly spewed forth illusory bubbles. He then sealed the "Curtain," which was manipulating a marionette to carry him around erratically but hadn't managed to escape far, with the "Order Crystal." However, he didn't place it in the "Nation of Disorder."
Immediately afterward, Hobert gestured towards the ancient castle, and dozens of Beyonder characteristics flew towards him.
These were the Beyonder characteristics of Kotar, the Dark Demonic Wolf's, marionettes. Although their Sequences weren't high, for Hobert, who had a large Beyonder team, these Beyonder characteristics were an important reason why he was happy to join this hunt.
Finally, Hobert put away the "Spiritual Barrier" and "Order Crystal Barrier." Reinette once again used her "Mirror Leap" ability to return to one of Klein's gold coins.
Hobert severed all the clues left at the scene, cutting off the "connection" between them.
He used the method of "distorting" space to quickly leave the scene with Klein.
It wasn't until more than half a minute after they left that two figures approached from the darkness in different directions.
One was an Amon avatar wearing crystal-framed monocle, and the other was Steph, the "Profane Presbyter," who was over two meters tall with completely white hair.
They didn't communicate with each other, each searching for clues while being wary of the other.
Ultimately, after confirming that Kotar, the "God of Wishes," had been hunted and that the hunter hadn't left any clues, they each left in the direction they came from.
During his departure, Steph recalled the "Scholar of Yore" he had encountered when inspecting the Lord's Divine Kingdom earlier.
And Amon's avatar, who had been searching for Klein, was almost certain that this must have been done by Klein and his helpers.
…
Hobert once again used the method of sacrifice to return to the real world. He cleaned up the altar and then assumed a praying posture, entering the "Nation of Disorder."
Even if "The Fool's" gaze hadn't left yet, it didn't matter. After such an important hunting operation, he definitely had to report to the "Creator."
Hobert entered the "Nation of Disorder" mainly to use "True Sight" to confirm the state of the "Curtain."
This Beyonder characteristic was arranged by the Celestial Worthy. He didn't know if it would react with the "Nation of Disorder."
In fact, Hobert already possessed a certain degree of "True Sight" in the outside world, after all, he was already Sequence 1.
If he felt that there was no problem outside, then there was basically no problem. Although this level might not be able to solve the Celestial Worthy's arrangement, he could detect the possible reaction between the "Curtain" and the "Nation of Disorder."
Entering the "Nation of Disorder" to take a look was just to confirm it again.
After confirming that there was no problem with "True Sight," Hobert believed that there should be no inherent connection between these two arrangements of the Celestial Worthy.
Only then did he store the "Curtain" in the "Nation of Disorder" and named it "0-79" Mysterious Curtain.
Looking at these Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts in front of him, Hobert planned to use them as much as possible before and after he became a True God.
Having completed the hunting operation against Kotar, and without anything too urgent recently, Hobert then ordered Angus's "Gale Army" and Helen's 'Thorn Army," as well as five thousand regular soldiers, to advance south under the leadership of Archibald.
Although the Duchy of Southern Balam had now become a colonizer in the Sartre region, with the local nobles acting as agents, Hobert wasn't satisfied with this political model.
What he wanted was true rule!
One of the important reasons why the four countries of the Northern Continent used colonization to rule the Southern Continent was that it was difficult for the Northern Continent's forces to quickly support the colonial army in the Southern Continent.
Whether it was establishing direct rule or managing through a company, the effects were unsatisfactory.
After continuous attempts, they developed the "agent" system. The vast colony of the Loen Kingdom was established using this system.
For example, the management of a state in Eastern Balam. The top-level people must be Loenese, the middle level were the elites of Eastern Balam, and the lowest-level civil servants were basically recruited from local middle-class or small landlord families.
This way, when problems occurred, the Loenese could push the responsibility to the middle or lower levels.
Irresponsibility was their norm.
In addition, because there was a teleportation array, Hobert could quickly project enough force to where it was needed.
And the communication system established with the help of the "Nation of Disorder" could complete the process of information consolidation and dissemination in a short time, so there was no need to continue using agents to rule.
So, the Beyonder troops and regular army of the Duchy of Southern Balam went on an expedition, and news of victory came two weeks later, completely controlling the Salto region. The territory of the Duchy of Southern Balam extended to the southernmost end of this continent.
…
What puzzled the natives of the Duchy of Southern Balam was that June in previous years was probably the coldest month of the year, but this year, just entering June, the south wind actually began to warm up.
By mid-June, the earth had already begun to thaw, and there were signs of wild grass sprouting on the plains.
It was also at this time that the officials of the Duchy of Southern Balam began to organize the people to carry out spring plowing!
Because they had received a notice that this year's spring had arrived more than a month early.
In addition, all the grassroots officials also received a strange notice, requiring them to keep records of uncultivated land, saying that this year's grain output in the second half of the year would be twice that of previous years!
However, there would be no harvest in the first half of next year, but the uncultivated land would not be affected by this.
All of this, of course, was Hobert playing the role of "Prince of Abolition" and creating opportunities to digest the potion.
Changing the laws of nature was also a kind of "Abolition," but this was his own country, so he had to be careful when carrying out this kind of operation.
He had sent people to investigate and had a comprehensive understanding of the normal climate in previous years. After deducing it, Hobert believed that if the climate warmed up early, the impact would be greater the further north.
And the greatest impact on the Duchy of Southern Balam might be less rain and drought.
But this was also difficult to stop Hobert. How much rain each county's agricultural department needed, he would just give it to them.
With this deduction, Hobert stood at the southernmost end of the Southern Continent and made the cold south wind warm.
After operating continuously for a day, the weather began to warm up, and then there was no need for too much operation, just occasionally resist the cold wind blowing from Antarctica and make the sun's rays more intense.
Making the climate abnormal was "Abolition" of natural climate, which was equivalent to acting.
Then, the early spring plowing after the climate became abnormal violated the common sense of this world, which was enough for the "Prince of Abolition's" potion to be digested to a certain extent.
As for the problem that crops would double, it also came from Hobert's large-scale "tampering." He tampered with the original yield of "1" of the cultivated land to "2."
This allowed him to continue "tampering" for the next three or four months, so the yield of the new season's crops would be twice that of last year.
However, the price was that if you continued to cultivate on the original land in the first half of next year, there would be a high probability of no harvest, and it would not recover until the second half of next year.
Hobert was preparing to enter a mode of national construction after the harvest of this season's crops.
Not only to build some factories and small towns, but also to greatly change the architectural style of all residents' residences, forcibly popularizing the modern architectural style from the Modern Era.
This plan could not only continuously digest the potion, but also prepare for the advancement to "Black Emperor," killing two birds with one stone.
It's just that such an operation requires compiling a suitable reason to avoid the public from noticing the existence of Beyonder powers.
But that was a matter for the Duchy government, and Hobert didn't intend to worry about it.
When Hobert inspected the spring plowing situation in various places, he directly felt that he already possessed a certain amount of divine power.
The scene Hobert saw at the moment was like seeing people spring plowing in December.
Knowing that this spring plowing was not a problem, but it would just feel strange.
The people also had a similar reaction, feeling very uneasy about the spring plowing at this time, but the officials of the Duchy strongly demanded it, and in addition, spring also seemed to have arrived early, so they went to the fields to plow under the call in a confused manner.
In any case, the large-scale early spring plowing began just like that. Even the initiator, Hobert, found it quite miraculous: This is the power of the gods! It can change a country's climate and grain output.
In people's eyes, this is a miracle!
It's just that the miracles of this world tend to appear to most ordinary people in terrifying and bizarre ways. There are hardly any miracles that take into account the livelihood of ordinary people.
Perhaps only the miracles in the Duchy of South Balam are connected to livelihood.
After roughly inspecting the Saint-Sern region, Hobert not only inspected this year's spring plowing situation but also gained a general understanding of the execution capabilities of governments at all levels.
Hobert was generally satisfied with this bureaucratic system. Even orders that sounded as absurd as early spring plowing could be carried out, indicating that the execution was still acceptable.
Of course, in the specific implementation, there will definitely be cases involving forced execution.
But what Hobert currently needs is execution. If he wants to unite the strength of the entire country, the government's functional departments must be strong.
When everyone has enough food and clothing, and when they are protected by a true god, it will not be too late to build a relatively relaxed political atmosphere.
In addition to arranging some ways to digest potions, Hobert has recently devoted a lot of thought to the construction of Beyonder forces.
Firstly, the "Werewolf Legion" and "Hunter Legion" established in the military already have several "Werewolves" and "Pyromaniacs." According to the usual practice, these two armies already have a certain combat capability. When Beyonder wars happen again, a portion of them can be deployed to participate.
Secondly, there are two ceremonies in preparation. Under the auspices of Elliott, Beverly and Raymond will swear allegiance to the "Creator"; under the auspices of Angus, Medici will swear allegiance to the "Creator."
This is Hobert's delegation of power to the "Favored." In the future, more and more places will need the "Creator" to come forward.
The key is that there are more and more demigod-level Beyonders around Hobert. He can't always host sacrifices and similar ceremonies for himself, right?
Not only does he have to "busy himself inside and out," but there is also the risk of exposure.
Before today, Hobert had gradually handed over the task of hosting some ceremonies to Angus, Elliott, and others. Following Angus, Elliott has now been promoted to Sequence 3 and is qualified to host this swearing ceremony.
Just as the two ceremonies were in the preparation stage, Princess Ethel, the special envoy of the Kingdom of Feynapotter, visited the Duchy of South Balam.
For the Duchy of South Balam, this is another diplomatic feast because Princess Ethel is here to establish an embassy.
… …
Currently, the situation in the Northern Continent is already very clear. The Intis Republic has taken the easily defended Takerwell Plain and has begun to attack the Balchis Mountains, which are only a little over a hundred kilometers away from Backlund.
On the northern front, after five months of fierce fighting and attrition, the Feysac Empire finally defeated the main force of Loen on the Loen military defense line composed of Constant and other industrial cities.
After only a week of rest, the Feysac army began to advance south along the Tussock River.
Like the western front, the southern part of the Midseashire Industrial Zone is almost indefensible. The Feysac army has already fought all the way to Tingen City.
On the northern front, a defensive line can only be reorganized in the river valley formed by the Balchis Mountains and the Chester Mountains, two mountain ranges running north-south.
The bad news is that it is only about a hundred kilometers away from Backlund. The good news is that the Loen army's supply line has been shortened.
The strategic goals of the Intis Republic and the Feysac Empire are very clear. They intend to occupy and plunder Backlund, an international metropolis.
For Beyonder forces, it is to drive the Loen royal family out of the capital of the Loen Kingdom. Whether they go to East Bayeux or the Rosid Archipelago, after the capital is occupied, the Augustus family will almost lose the legitimacy to rule Loen.
The strategic goal of the Kingdom of Feynapotter is to recover the territory that became independent during the "Battle of the Violated Oath." Therefore, while attacking Lenburg, other than their navy, no other troops participated in the war to attack the Loen Kingdom, but instead began to attack another small country, Masin.
But this time, it was met with opposition and resolute resistance from the Church of Knowledge and Wisdom. Previously, the Church of Knowledge and Wisdom did not want the war in the Northern Continent to spread into a war that swept across the entire continent.
Therefore, their performance in Feynapotter's war of aggression against Lenburg has always been very passive, and the war there has been a long stalemate in Lenburg's capital.
But now it's different. If Masin is gone, the Church of Knowledge and Wisdom will lose half of its diocese, so they began to actively respond to the battle.
The Church of the Earth Mother, which had been prepared for a long time, immediately dispatched a large number of Beyonder forces into Lenburg and Masin to cooperate with the military in combat.
For a time, this war of aggression became very fierce, and most of the Kingdom of Feynapotter's forces were also contained in these two countries.
This time, Ethel's visit, in addition to affirming Hobert's and the Duchy of South Balam's strength, was also the Kingdom of Feynapotter looking for an opportunity to break the situation.
Seeing that the Intis Republic and the Feysac Empire were about to attack Backlund and divide Loen, they were dragged down in Lenburg and Masin, and consumed a lot of troops and energy in these two countries.
The Feynapotter royal family believes that if the war on the main battlefield ends, and the war in Masin and Lenburg has not ended, Intis and Feysac will definitely come forward to mediate in order to limit the power of the Kingdom of Feynapotter.
At that time, in this world-class war, the Kingdom of Feynapotter may not get anything, and watch Intis and Feysac divide Loen, and eventually become a second-rate country in the Northern Continent.
Since there seems to be no opportunity in the Northern Continent, come to the Southern Continent to take a look.
Coming out of the teleportation array, Ethel felt that the weather here was a bit wrong. According to the previous management experience of the colony, the Duchy of South Balam should be as cold as winter at this time. Why is a warm wind blowing in her face? And the outside looks lush and green, with no sign of winter at all.
Foreign Minister Audrey and Prime Minister Conrad greeted the Feynapotter ambassador together and held a luncheon that day to welcome her.
At Ethel's request, that afternoon, Audrey accompanied her to Asong City using the teleportation array to visit Highland County.
Everyone knows that Ethel wants to see the Duchy of South Balam's rule over the former Highland Kingdom.
So the carriage carrying the special envoy and the foreign minister went straight to the farmland outside the city, and the convoy behind followed closely.
Ethel, with her neat short hair, saw Asong City, with almost no one on the streets, from the car window: "I heard that many people in this city died in the siege at that time."
To be precise, according to the description of the Highland Kingdom nobles who fled to the Feynapotter colony, the Duchy of South Balam massacred everyone in the city after occupying it.
After many fleeing Highland Kingdom nobles died in various "accidents," such rumors were basically contained.
At this time, the first issue of the newly established "Southern Country Daily" clarified this matter. The newspaper said that the Highland Kingdom, seeing that the capital was about to fall, plundered all the wealth in the city and fled north.
Many people died in the looting process. After they fled north, the remaining people also fled the city, so it basically became an empty city.
This is of course also a lie, but it sounds a little more credible.
In the newspaper, the duchy government also elaborated on the Duchy of South Balam's need for population, in order to show that it would not do anything to reduce so many people.
At the same time, they refuted the lies of those nobles one by one. For example, at that time, only more than 3,000 troops of the Duchy of South Balam entered Asong City. How could they massacre 300,000 people in two days?
If a massacre had occurred, why didn't so many people escape at that time?
After this rebuttal, the politicians of the Northern Continent basically concluded that neither the nobles of the Highland Kingdom nor the Duchy of South Balam were telling the truth, and the matter was dropped.
In the years to come, the politicians of the Northern Continent may bring this matter up when needed to make a fuss.
The beautiful and generous Audrey said: "Grand Duke Hobert specifically instructed that Princess Ethel is our friend, and asked me to tell you the truth."
She took a deep breath and said seriously: "The "Rose School of Thought" awakened the severely polluted 'Chained God' when withdrawing from this city."
"Because of the corruption on the 'Chained God', everyone in this city turned into monsters."
"With the help of the 'Creator', the corruption here did not spread outside the city."
Ethel's expression also became solemn: "What was the 'Chained God' corrupted by? What happened to the 'Chained God' later?"
"I'm not very clear about the specifics." Audrey said, "According to Hobert's description, the 'Chained God' seems to have fallen."
Ethel was somewhat surprised. As one of the colonists of the Southern Continent, the Kingdom of Feynapotter knew some information about the "Chained God" and knew that this god had the level of "King of Angels." She didn't expect the "Creator" to kill Him.
Immediately afterwards, she realized that the people of this city had died because of the war between the gods.
Thinking of this, Ethel continued to look out the window, only feeling that the city seemed to be filled with a dignified atmosphere.
After leaving the city, it was a different scene, with spring buds and green grass, a vibrant scene.
The fields were full of farmers cultivating, looking very busy.
At this time, Ethel finally couldn't help but said: "The climate in the Southern Continent seems to be a bit abnormal this year."
"It can't be called abnormal." Audrey smiled and said, "The Paz River Valley and the Tucker Plain have been ravaged by war, and the reduction in grain production is a foregone conclusion. A worldwide famine may be triggered in the next year."
"The Duchy of South Balam doesn't have much food reserves either, so the 'Creator' asked everyone to start spring plowing in advance to avoid a famine."
"Creator…" Ethel was a little surprised: "Did the 'Creator' make the climate abnormal… I mean, did He make spring come early?"
In fact, Philip I could also use His abilities to do this, but He would not use His abilities on such "trivial matters."
Audrey smiled and said: "Yes."
In the government of the Duchy of South Balam, this is no longer a secret.
After all, a few months later, after completing the grain production task, a wave of national construction will be carried out, and the government departments will definitely make corresponding plans in advance.
Ethel was silent again, not expecting to receive so much surprising news on her first day here.
The carriage ran for a long time on the road in the fields before Ethel noticed something: "Excuse me, where are the garrisons around here?"
Audrey recalled for a moment: "There seems to be a garrison in Yason City."
Ethel was stunned: "Why didn't I see it?"
When they left the city, they didn't see any pedestrians in military uniforms.
Audrey smiled and said: "I'm not sure where the garrison camp is either, because there's only one regiment…"
Ethel interrupted: "Only one regiment?"
"Yes." This time Audrey was stunned, not knowing what was wrong.
"That used to be the capital of the Highland Kingdom." Ethel shook her head with a smile.
Even if there are not many people in the city, its symbolism will be difficult to eliminate for a while. Heavy troops should be sent to this kind of place to show the majesty of the victors and prevent the people from having any other ideas.
However, the ruling method of the Duchy of South Balam seems to be completely different from Ethel's understanding.
Audrey understood the princess's meaning: "Let me share a fun story I heard a couple of days ago."
She smiled and said: "With the support of foreign forces, a nobleman from the Highland Kingdom returned to Corwin County to secretly build a spy network, but the day after he returned to his territory, he was reported by the people in his territory."
"Reported?" Ethel thought she had misheard. It was the first time she had heard of people reporting nobles.
"Yes." Audrey continued to tell: "Because that nobleman wanted to restore the 'Glorious Highland Kingdom', but what he didn't know was that the serfs and slaves on that territory had already divided his land, farm tools, and livestock under the auspices of the government."
Ethel had also heard a little about Hobert's land distribution: "This is a brilliant move."
At this time, she suddenly realized the brilliance of this move: binding all ordinary people to the Duchy of South Balam.
Ethel could even imagine what the expression on the people's faces would be when the nobleman from the Highland Kingdom returned to his territory and quietly announced the restoration of the "Glorious Highland Kingdom."
They would definitely be thinking, the land has been divided, and the livestock have been raised for a while. If the Highland Kingdom is really restored, will they be purged?
Without any guidance, the sleepless people would immediately report to the local officials!
At this time, Ethel heard scolding from outside. She opened the curtain and saw a person wearing the uniform of the Duchy of South Balam standing on the ridge, scolding loudly.
The farmers in the field all lowered their heads and worked hard.
Ethel asked again: "Are those people in the field slaves?"
She had long heard that there were no slaves in the Duchy of South Balam.
"Those are the nobles' servants." Audrey smiled and said: "As long as the nobles' servants have not committed any crimes, we generally send them back to their place of origin.
"Those servants who are unwilling to return to their place of origin and want to continue to serve the nobles of the Duchy of South Balam are allowed to form multiple natural villages.
"Generally, the grassroots officials of the Duchy of South Balam are unwilling to work in this kind of village, because they also have to teach them how to cultivate, which is very troublesome."
Ethel slowly nodded and asked again: "Where did the Highland Kingdom nobles who didn't have time to escape go?"
"Those who have had criminal experience are imprisoned, and those who have not are moved to Angel City." Audrey replied.
In fact, they were assigned to the construction site to build Hobert's mausoleum. After all, which noble's hands were not stained with several lives? Except for children and infants, they were all assigned to the construction site.
Ethel continued to ask: "These should all be professional servants, why don't you let them serve you? Is it because you don't trust them?"
Audrey first said: "There are no nobles in the Duchy of South Balam… Well, that may not be quite right to say, it should be said that there are no nobles in the traditional sense, and there is not much demand for servants."
Ethel was slightly stunned. She did recall that among the South Balam high-level officials who greeted her, except for Audrey, there seemed to be no other nobles.
In addition, she also noticed at the time that although those officials were in high positions, they seemed to be somewhat out of place in the atmosphere of this large banquet.
At the same time, the phrase "no nobles" was deeply imprinted in Ethel's mind. She felt that this sentence was very impactful and sounded very terrible.
After turning around in the farmland for an afternoon, the day's activities ended.
The next day, Ethel was invited to watch two large-scale ceremonies. Since the Castiya family was allowed by Philip I to believe in the "Creator", Ethel, who had seen the majesty of the "Creator", had already become a shallow believer.
In addition, because of her status as an envoy, she was invited to watch the ceremony.
Of course, inviting her to watch the ceremony was also Hobert's deterrence to the Kingdom of Feynapotter.
At about eight o'clock in the morning, the people who were allowed to watch the ceremony had already arrived at a hall in the Duke's mansion, which was specially used as a priest.
The interior of the hall was very simple, and even the altar was not inlaid with gold edges, gems, or anything like that.
The people watching the ceremony stood quietly in front of the altar, watching Elliott, the chief priest of this ceremony, set up the altar.
Then, Elliott walked down the altar and first summoned Beverly and her younger brother to the simple altar next to him.
Ethel saw the heavy coffin coming out of the spirit world, and the "fire man" flying in from outside. Then, Elliott used the ring-shaped jade pendant in his hand to release a surge of majestic "power of order."
The heavy coffin opened, and the playful lady lying inside, and the humanoid composed of flames, used this power to jump out of the coffin, and one turned into a normal human appearance.
Ethel realized at this time: Could these be two angels?
Then she was shocked by her own idea, because Audrey had told her yesterday that both of today's ceremonies were ceremonies to swear allegiance to the "Creator."
Seeing the ceremony in progress, the more Ethel thought about it, the more she felt that these two should be angels, otherwise there would be no need to hold such a grand ceremony.
The allegiance of two angels is enough for any god to value, even if the state of these two angels does not seem to be very good, but they are also angels!
Before the ceremony even started, Ethel was already filled with shock and anxiety.
Previously, Feynapotter had obtained some credible information that at least two angels were loyal to the "Creator." They had appeared in the war against the "Rose School of Thought" in the Southern Continent and also in the battle of Southern Colson.
Now, two more angels are going to swear allegiance to the "Creator"?
This… such strength is simply too terrifying.
What worried Ethel was that the strength of the Duchy of Southern Balam exceeded her expectations, at least more powerful than the Feynapotter royal family.
At this time, Elliott asked Beverly and Raymond to wait a moment. He first washed his hands with purified water, then abandoned distracting thoughts through meditation, and then the ritual officially began.
Beverly and Raymond ascended the altar and knelt on it to pray to the "Creator."
Elliott stood on the side of the altar, and after sensing the gaze of the "Creator," he first saluted the direction of the altar, and then loudly stated Beverly and Raymond's request to pledge allegiance to the "Creator."
After obtaining the "Creator's" approval, he led the siblings in taking the oath.
The "Creator" was obviously satisfied with this oath, and at the end of the ritual, bestowed two circular jade pendants made of "Order Crystals."
After the ceremony, the Beyonders who attended the ceremony congratulated the two angels. Especially the members of the Tony family were very excited. After drifting for more than a thousand years, the Tudor family had found a new home.
Even though Ethel was only Sequence 5, she could feel that the two circular jade pendants were very unusual. After obtaining these two jade pendants, the state of the two angels seemed to immediately improve a lot.
Back at the hotel for foreign guests, Ethel's mood could not calm down for a long time. After pacing back and forth in the room, she suddenly thought that if the two Beyonders who swore allegiance were angels, they would not be unknown.
So, she reported the ceremony in the morning to Philip I through prayer and asked if Beverly and Raymond were angels?
Soon, Ethel received a response from Philip I: "Beverly and Raymond are both children of Tudor. They were already angels in the Fourth Epoch."
Originally, Philip I remembered that Beverly was already dead, but after hearing that she was lying in a heavy coffin, he knew that she should not be completely dead.
Ethel noticed that what Philip I said was "Beverly and Raymond are both children of Tudor," not descendants, which meant that these two were the princess and prince of the Tudor Empire back then!
She took a deep breath. The two who swore allegiance today were not only angels, but also relatively "famous" angels!
Then who will be swearing allegiance at the ceremony this afternoon?
With a curious and uneasy mood, she finally waited for the afternoon.
This time, the main celebrant of the ceremony was Angus. Similarly, after washing his hands and meditating, this time he invited a young man with obvious Southern Continent facial features to the stage.
Angus smiled and said, "Mr. Medici, according to the Duke's instructions, we have prepared a gift for you."
With a wave of his hand, four attendants carried in a wooden box the size of a coffin from the back door of the hall.
At this time, Ethel thought: This is the descendant of the Medici family!
Because of the propaganda of the nobles of the Highland Kingdom, the outside world now knows that a descendant of the Medici family has now joined the forces of the "Creator" and has been reused.
It is said that the war to destroy the Highland Kingdom was commanded by this Medici.
Medici on the altar glanced at the wooden box and smiled, "Are you afraid that my advancement will fail and prepared a coffin for me?"
Angus smiled and said nothing, waiting for the wooden box to be carried to the altar before he said, "Please take a look."
The wooden box opened, and lying inside was a handsome young man with bright fiery red hair and a conspicuous blood-red flag-shaped mark on his forehead.
His facial features were similar to those of Medici before his fall, but he was even more handsome and had a more feminine temperament.
Medici was also stunned on the spot after seeing this body.
At this time, Angus explained, "We sent people to the underground ruins of Backlund to collect the hair and bones of you three, and then asked someone to shape this body."
Medici came back to his senses at this time: "Asked 'someone'?"
Angus was slightly stunned, not quite understanding what Medici meant.
"Forget it," Medici said, "It's rare that Hobert has this intention."
The "person" who can refine the hair and bones of two great angels and an King of Angels into the same body, Medici can't think of a second existence besides the Earth Mother.
Ethel, who was watching the ceremony, noticed that this Medici directly called "Hobert" by name, but the people around him did not show any surprise or unnatural expressions.
That is to say, he usually calls Hobert by name, instead of "Duke," nor does he add honorifics such as "Duke."
Immediately afterwards, the second ceremony began. In Medici's prayer, the "Creator" once again cast his gaze, and after Medici swore allegiance, he bestowed a portion of the Beyonder characteristics of "Weather Warlock."
Under the operation of the "Creator," the body that Medici is now possessing and the body that was just refined for him had a "Disorder." In the "Disorder," Medici's spirit body was "tampered" into the new body.
Medici, who had obtained a brand new body, opened his eyes and sat up from the wooden box. He looked at his hands, first laughed heartily, and then sincerely thanked the "Creator."
Ethel didn't know if it was her illusion, but she seemed to hear two voices on this Medici's body saying, as if whispering, "This body is good."
Another voice said, "Of course it's good, there's a part of me in it."
After that, the two voices seemed to say a few words in a low voice, but Ethel didn't hear clearly.
The ceremony of bestowing ended, and Medici, in front of everyone, swallowed the Beyonder characteristics of "Weather Warlock" alive.
Amid everyone's exclamations, Medici took a deep breath and had already restrained his surging spirituality.
He first smacked his lips, as if he hadn't had enough, and then smiled and said to everyone, "Don't everyone learn from me, I just performed a similar advancement ceremony in advance and digested the potion in advance."
To be precise, he digested three rounds of potions.
It's just that Medici has not performed the ceremony to advance to "Weather Warlock," because he was born a Sequence 2, but the other two have performed the advancement ceremony, so they are not considered to be swallowing a "Weather Warlock" level potion alive.
After thanking the "Creator" who had withdrawn his gaze again towards the altar, Medici smiled again: "Tonight at the State Guest Hotel, my treat!"
Everyone congratulated him.
Although this Marshal of the Duchy of Southern Balam has a stinky mouth, after getting along for a while, everyone has become accustomed to his way of speaking.
Overall, Medici is still very experienced in dealing with people. He is always very rigorous when it comes to professional issues involving the military. He will also lend a helping hand when others need help.
He belongs to the kind of person who makes people hate him when they meet him, but after calming down, they don't think he is so hateful, but occasionally they will remember his good deeds.
Over the past few months, Medici's popularity in the extraordinary unit has been passable, so when he said he would treat, everyone expressed their willingness to go.
Hobert's interpretation of this is: Medici is using this method to tell the "Creator" that he is willing to integrate into the "Creator's" forces.
Ethel in the crowd thought: The "Creator" has three more angels that can be mobilized at once. Adding this group of demigods and Sequence 5 who came to watch the ceremony, the strength of the orthodox church is only so-so.
Back at the hotel, Ethel once again reported this afternoon's ceremony to Philip I. After Philip I heard that a new body was refined for Medici, he asked Ethel to recall Medici's appearance in his mind.
After a long while, Philip I said: "He is Medici."
Ethel was stunned for a full four or five seconds before she understood: The one who swore allegiance to the "Creator" today is the "Red Angel" Medici!
