chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 705: Things Sealed Underground in Antarctica
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
At this moment, the Kunlun Station was still fighting alone. They were now even more certain that what they encountered was an unknown virus that could be transmitted visually!
This was, of course, an unprecedented virus. In the history of human confrontation with viruses, there had never been a virus that could be transmitted visually.
Some scientists even speculated whether the virus was transmitted through a higher dimension?
That is, the source of infection and the infected person are at a certain distance in three-dimensional space, but the distance in four-dimensional space is difficult to know.
Seeing this, Hobert realized that this was a vague explanation for Beyonder corruption.
Generally speaking, Beyonder corruption is mostly achieved through the spirit world. Indeed, one can be polluted without touching the other party in the real world.
Hobert continued to read on. The crazed researchers still retained a certain amount of sanity in their madness, and they provided many key information, including the aforementioned drafts.
A large part of the files later were conversations between members of the research station and the crazed researchers.
Hobert looked very carefully at some key information.
...
Bai Han (one of the researchers who saw those blurry figures): A consciousness appeared in our minds.
Station Chief Jiang (Station Chief of Kunlun Station): Can you describe it in more detail?
Bai Han: It's like, another me appeared in my mind. He knows everything about me. He seems to be searching my memories everywhere in my mind, wanting to understand everything about the outside world. I tried to communicate with him, and easily learned where he came from, why he was here, and what his purpose was. At that moment, I was him, hahaha, he was me.
Station Chief Jiang: Can you tell me about what you learned?
Bai Han: Of course, of course, I want to tell you everything I know while I'm still awake! They come from the depths of the distant universe, and they have been in the ice for tens of thousands of years!
...
Hobert suddenly froze when he saw this: That's not right! Isn't this an Outer God? It was the awakening of the "Original Creator" that tore apart the Beyonder characteristics of the Outer Deities, and that's why the Outer Deities came to the solar system, wanting to retrieve their Beyonder characteristics!
But how could the Outer Deities be in Antarctica? How could they have been under the ice for tens of thousands of years?
At this time, Hobert suddenly had a bold guess: Could it be that these guys frozen under the ice came to Earth before the "Original Creator" woke up?
At that time, there may have been no barriers, and there may not have been strong protection on Earth. In short, they are not like the current Outer Deities, who can only look at the outside of the atmosphere with envy.
But a new question arose: Why did these Outer Deities appear on Earth? Were they attracted by the Beyonder characteristics on Earth?
And how did they end up in Antarctica? Or rather, who sealed them here?
With these questions, Hobert continued to read on.
...
Station Chief Jiang: Are you saying that they are aliens?
Bai Han: Not quite the same as the aliens we understand. They... they don't use spaceships, they can come to Earth with their own power.
Station Chief Jiang: This is a... what kind of technology is this?
Bai Han: It doesn't seem to be any technology, but a kind of supernatural ability! It seems that their own ability can help them travel through the universe, but only a very few creatures can do this. So it can't be called technology, because it doesn't have universality.
Station Chief Jiang: Why did they come to Earth?
Bai Han: This seems to involve their creation myth. It is said that after a creator created the universe, his power was scattered throughout the universe, and the creator also fell into a deep sleep. But this creator will wake up once in a while, and each time he wakes up, he will recover a part of his power. Currently, the creator has recovered most of his power. If his power is completely recovered, the universe will be destroyed and a new cycle will begin.
...
Hobert's eyes narrowed: Every time the Original Creator awakens, he will "recover", or rather, gather a part of the Beyonder characteristics that were once scattered in the universe!
He recalled the knowledge in his mind: When the Original Creator last woke up, he gathered the Beyonder characteristics of 6 pathways, namely: "Lawyer", "Arbiter", "Mother", "Moon", "Abyss", "Chained".
These are the 6 pathways that Hobert can confirm. When were the other pathways gathered?
Hobert was even more convinced of his previous guess: Under Area 3, could they be the Outer Deities who were gathered by the Original Creator? The Original Creator tore out their Beyonder characteristics and sealed their bodies in Antarctica?
This is another 6... It's not necessarily 6 complete pathways. Outer Deities are not equal to Great Old Ones. The 9 Outer Deities that Hobert is familiar with are 9 Outer Deities. In addition to having Source, they also have some high-sequence Beyonder characteristics.
Some Outer Deities may not be at the Great Old One level, or even at the True God level.
Most Sequence 2s can travel through the universe. They are also theoretically Outer Deities, below Sequence 0. If they happen to encounter the Original Creator awakening, they may also be gathered.
In short, the Original Creator ripped away the Beyonder characteristics of 6 pathways during his last awakening, which was the beginning of the First Epoch. He must have gathered many characteristics during his last awakening.
Hobert doesn't know how many Beyonder characteristics there are in the entire universe, but if its total amount remains unchanged, it will eventually be gathered together one day.
When all the Beyonder characteristics are gathered, it is a bit similar to the concept of a "singularity". All the characteristics are concentrated at one point. Just thinking about it makes one feel that it will be the end of the universe.
The good news is that there are still many Beyonder characteristics that have not been gathered. The bad news is that the speed of gathering will only get faster and faster.
Hobert took a deep breath. He suddenly thought of a question: Is there any pattern in the timing of the Original Creator's periodic awakenings?
This reminded him that during the First Epoch, two people who obtained multiple Sephirot fought, and as a result, they both fell. But in the battle, their Beyonder characteristics and Sephirot did not converge.
Either they were both avoiding mutual Convergence, or some force was preventing them from aggregating.
In short, the initial awakening seems to have no regularity in time. God and Celestial Worthy also have no initiative in this regard.
Hobert shook his head again and continued to read on.
...
Bai Han: That creator seems to be about to wake up again. The fluctuations in Earth's spirituality have created an opportunity for them. The six under the ice have joined forces to create a square to attract our attention. This is their last chance. If they are released, they can take back their power before that creator wakes up, then they can escape Earth and even have a chance to become the new masters of Earth. If the creator wakes up first, then they will never be able to retrieve their power.
Station Chief Jiang: How to release them?
Bai Han: Dig out their bodies. He said, it's just a little bit more, just a little bit more and they can come out. He also said that if we let him out, he will make us the most powerful people on this planet...
...
This record ends here. Judging from Bai Han's last answer, Hobert estimated that this researcher named Bai Han had fallen into madness again.
Obviously, the conspiracy of these Outer Deities did not succeed. The Original Creator still woke up, and they failed to retrieve their Beyonder characteristics.
To be precise, they could not have succeeded. God and Celestial Worthy would have slapped them to death.
Even if they are True Gods, without the support of Beyonder characteristics and with a strong seal, the spirit body will always dissipate one day.
Hobert estimated that these Outer Deities may not be able to wait for the next time the Original Creator wakes up.
As he flipped through the documents page by page, Hobert also found some other useful clues.
...
Zhang Xiaojun: According to my conversation with him, I learned that Antarctica is a very special continent. This continent was not originally here. In order to seal these 6 people, this continent was moved to this cold place.
Station Chief Jiang: Who moved this continent?
Zhang Xiaojun: According to the other party, it was the Creator.
Station Chief Jiang: Why seal these 6 people?
(This question is obviously to confirm whether the information obtained by Bai Han is credible)
Zhang Xiaojun: To prevent them from taking back their power.
Station Chief Jiang: What method was used to seal them?
Zhang Xiaojun: The ice of Antarctica! According to him, the Creator gave the ice of Antarctica an abstract meaning, which can seal some very powerful things. This makes this continent very stable, and even significantly different from other continents. Without external influence, it is closer to "eternity".
...
Hobert did recall a sentence he saw in Sun Zhilin's notebook: That voice said: The ice and snow of Antarctica have abstract meaning.
This information should also be credible. After the Original Creator sealed these 6 Outer Deities in Antarctica, its powerful sealing power transformed the ice and snow here.
Hobert realized that this was also the reason why information about the Outer Deities could not be reported outside of Antarctica, because the Original Creator's blockade also included a blockade in the abstract sense, a comprehensive blockade!
Therefore, information about the Outer Deities can be sent to the Changzheng Station, but cannot leave Antarctica.
The fact that Kunlun Station can be preserved so completely is also related to the seal of the Southern Continent. The materials here have also been strengthened because of this seal, so thousands or even tens of thousands of years have passed, and the main structure of the research station is still there.
Continuing to read on, the other clues mostly describe the wonderful biological characteristics of these Outer Deities, but this information is not so critical for Hobert.
There is also an investigation summary later. At this time, Kunlun Station cannot rule out that these information said by the crazed researchers are some incredible nonsense.
Assuming this is all fabricated, why do several people who had no time to communicate have so many consistent descriptions? For example, their descriptions of the "Creator" are basically the same.
Assuming this is real, it's hard to accept that the universe is completely beyond their understanding.
After repeatedly reporting upwards without success, the researchers decided to leave temporarily, sending their crazed colleague back home first.
Just then, Kunlun Station also received some obviously abnormal news from the outside world, as if some changes were really about to happen in this world.
This made them worry. If this information about the Outer Deities was true, then they couldn't ignore those guys underground.
But how to solve the problem? Everyone was at a loss.
It wasn't until the crazed staff member killed his guard and took tools to excavate the six "aliens"' bodies in that underground space that the situation completely spiraled out of control.
Many people entered that underground space in pursuit.
Although the first batch of crazed staff members were successfully killed, soon more than half of the staff at Kunlun Station went mad!
Even those who didn't go mad suffered a tremendous mental shock.
Later in the files, there was a document written by Station Chief Jiang, but judging from the handwriting and content, Station Chief Jiang's mental state was already somewhat abnormal: "At this moment, my consciousness seems to be connected to theirs..."
"This feeling is very wonderful. Their knowledge is like books placed in front of me, ready to be read at any time. Heh heh, I guess my thinking is the same for them now."
"They are tampering with some of my thoughts, making me think they are supreme and that I must obey them."
"This makes me very clear about how vicious their influence is... Uh, I'm digressing. My mind is a mess right now."
"I mainly want to write down some key information that I 'read'. The more I 'read', the deeper their influence on me will be, and I might go crazy at any time."
"Heh heh heh, I'm digressing again. I can sense that they are trying to influence me, trying to stop me from saying these things, but I insist on saying it!"
"They must not be allowed to awaken! These six come from different civilizations, but without exception, those civilizations are full of coldness, madness, and distortion!"
"This is the price of power. For humans, such a price is very inefficient, only allowing a very, very small number of people to possess distorted and strange power, sacrificing the creativity of the entire civilization."
"If they regain their power, Earth will become a replica of this cold and distorted civilization."
"Moreover, they are very cunning. I don't believe a single word of their promises! After they regain their power, they will most likely completely destroy the Earth."
"No, it seems they can't destroy it. In their concept, Earth and humans are very special. Earth is where the Creator they speak of sleeps, and it is now an aggregate of 'Prime Matter'."
"Prime Matter? A strange word."
"In short, they can't destroy Earth, but humans will also become mad and distorted, turning into another kind of creature that only worships power."
"Yes, yes, yes, I know, you don't need to remind me, the awakening of the Creator will also be a huge disaster for mankind."
"However, the relevant information you provided shows that humans will not be destroyed each time the Creator awakens."
"After a long period of time, humans will regain their sanity and restart their civilization."
"What? You ask what the difference is."
"The difference is huge! He who sees alone is called enlightened; he who hears alone is called wise!"
"What does that mean? Heh heh, figure it out yourself."
"Remember, don't be bewitched by them, and don't let them escape from the ice, otherwise humanity will lose its most precious essence!"
Hobert looked at this material for a long time without saying a word: Station Chief Jiang knew that his power was very weak compared to those Outer Deities, but this Station Chief Jiang despised the Outer Deities in his thoughts.
Hobert suddenly smiled: Yes, what's so scary about these guys? Their power is a little strong, but their spirit is terribly lacking. Perhaps it is because of their spiritual deficiency that they can only use extraordinary corruption to influence others, and the people who are influenced by them can only set off their spiritual emptiness.
Thinking of this, Hobert took a deep breath and put away this handwritten document from Station Chief Jiang. He felt that the words written on the manuscript paper were very powerful.
Then he continued to flip through the information in his hand. More and more people at the research station went crazy, and more and more bizarre things happened, such as someone suddenly committing suicide, or the corpses of colleagues suddenly reanimating, some attacking other colleagues, and some taking tools to excavate Area 3.
The people who hadn't completely gone mad tried to burn these corpses with gasoline, but the ignited corpses would rush into the snowdrifts and extinguish the flames on their bodies themselves.
Fortunately, by chance, they found a way to "subdue" these corpses.
While fighting with the corpses, a colleague in poor mental condition mistakenly poured water on the corpses instead of gasoline. In the extreme cold, the water quickly froze into ice, and the corpses just stopped moving.
At this time, the people at the research station suddenly thought: The ice and snow of Antarctica symbolize sealing!
That is to say, here, all the strangeness can be sealed in this way!
After sealing the corpses, the research station encountered another problem. People from other international research stations around them were also affected by the six "aliens" one after another, and they rushed to Area 3, wanting to dig the "aliens" out of the ice.
As time went by, those "aliens" gradually had the risk of breaking free from their seals.
If they broke free from the seals before the so-called Creator awakened, the process of them regaining their power would likely cause irreparable damage to human civilization.
They must be stopped! Because in the staff's minds, the human world has no way to resist these "aliens".
Hobert, on the other hand, felt that God Almighty and the Celestial Worthy would definitely not let these Outer Deities succeed, but the researchers here didn't know this, they still thought they were the last line of defense for humanity.
So the staff thought of using the method of sealing those corpses to reseal those "aliens", so that they would miss this opportunity and be buried in the ice forever.
This was a mission destined to be a one-way trip, so after Kunlun Station contacted Great Wall Station, Zhongshan Station, Taishan Station, and Qinling Station for the last time, all the personnel carried water into Area 3.
On the last page of the document, there was such a reminder: Be sure to fill the kettle with water. If you find yourself having uncontrollable thoughts and behaviors, you can take off your clothes and pour water on yourself. In this way, seal the guy who wants to use you to resurrect.
Hobert suddenly recalled the kettle in Sun Zhilin's hand, and finally understood that he had poured himself into an ice sculpture.
The reason why Sun Zhilin still has vital signs now is likely due to the influence of the Outer Deities on him, causing him to mutate, or that a wisp of consciousness about the Outer Deities is sealed in his body.
Thinking of this, Hobert took a deep breath, closed the folder, and then silently came to the outside of Kunlun Station.
After taking another look at the entire Kunlun Station, Hobert "distorted" the surrounding snow, causing it to cover Kunlun Station, forming a small hill.
Inside the small hill, there was a hollow structure, which avoided Kunlun Station well, like a layer of snow shell protecting it.
After being covered by ice and snow, Hobert really felt the sealing power of the ice and snow. His spirituality couldn't even sense the Kunlun Station under the ice and snow.
This was a very peculiar feeling. When using extraordinary power to manipulate these ice and snow, he couldn't feel their difference, but after the ice and snow formed a pile, they formed the power of sealing.
Hobert did this to prevent people from discovering this place when exploring Antarctica in the future, and going crazy after reading those documents, or even the consciousness of the Outer Deities might be resurrected to a certain extent in this way.
He memorized the location here, and then came to Area 3, and saw the downward ice steps.
Around here, Hobert saw many corpses frozen on the ground by the ice. Among these people, there were Caucasians, people with South American facial features, and Asians.
Entering the underground structure, he could gradually see more and more people holding kettles and pouring themselves into ice sculptures.
Some of them were moving inward, and some were walking outward. Without exception, they all had the same style of down jackets as the Chinese scientific expedition team next to their feet.
Following the guidance of his spirituality, Hobert finally found the place underground with huge blurry figures.
In the distance from this group of figures, there were large buckets placed, and directly above those blurry figures, many people had also frozen themselves into the ice, and there were also many people fighting together around them, who were also poured with water and turned into ice sculptures.
Obviously, under the influence of the Outer Deities, the process of sealing with ice and water was very difficult. Some people would rather become part of the seal than compromise with the Outer Deities.
And some people were affected and fought with other people, trying to prevent this sealing process.
Looking at the irregular icebergs in front of him, Hobert could no longer feel any spiritual fluctuations from those Outer Deities. Even if they were not completely dead, they were sealed by these man-made small icebergs.
Hobert was about to bury those exposed corpses when he suddenly realized something was wrong. There were only 5 huge blurry figures underground!
This made Hobert feel a little scalp-numbing. One of the Outer Deities had escaped!
He quickly checked carefully, but found a few lines of words on the ice wall on the other side.
These words were all carved, so they have been preserved to this day.
Among them, there was a type of writing that Hobert didn't recognize, but for some reason, after taking one look, he understood the meaning of those words.
… …
The first line was that unrecognizable script: Your spirit moves me, allowing me to once again feel the drive of life.
The second line was characters carved with a sharp tool: You cannot escape.
Unrecognized script: I am not the fellow who just ran away. My seal is more than that. He indeed cannot escape from Antarctica. Only Earth's creatures and the extraordinary can come and go freely here. Outer Deities will be trapped here forever.
Chinese characters: You are the Creator.
Unrecognized script: Someone once called me that. The spirit you display is a great help to me. I can feel the fear of those Outer Deities. Heh heh, they are usually the ones who instill fear in others.
Chinese characters: What kind of being are you?
Unrecognized script: I often wonder about that myself. I am searching for the meaning of the universe. I am searching for the meaning of life. I am about to awaken. I can merge your consciousness into my divided consciousness, which should also be a great help to them.
… …
Seeing this, Hobert choked on his own saliva: It really is the Original Creator!
He quickly continued reading.
… …
Chinese characters: Sorry, we have no such plans. I am who I am.
Unrecognized script: Do you have any last words?
Chinese characters: Please continue human civilization.
Unrecognized script: They will exist until the end of the universe.
Chinese characters: Please protect Earth.
Unrecognized script: I have also realized that the blockade of Antarctica alone is no longer enough to resist these Outer Deities. I will form a barrier to protect Earth.
Chinese characters: Thank you.
Unrecognized script: What are your plans for the last few days?
Chinese characters: We hope to return to the Great Wall Station and die quietly.
Unrecognized script: In your condition, you may not be able to return to your destination, and there is still an Outer God wandering outside.
Chinese characters: When you reach the end of the road, sit and watch the clouds rise.
… …
After seeing the last line of poetry, Hobert suddenly smiled: "I wonder if the 'Original Creator' understands the meaning of this sentence."
Then he thought: The Great Wall Station is the farthest from here, so they arrived the latest. In the end, several people, including Sun Zhilin, survived and had a conversation with the Original Creator.
Sun Zhilin and the others should have been severely corrupted here, so they couldn't return to the Great Wall Station.
It is unknown what happened on the way back. Sun Zhilin got separated from everyone. The voice he was recording at the last moment of his life was probably the voice of the Outer God who escaped.
Even now, that Outer God is likely still wandering in Antarctica, but Hobert didn't take it too seriously. That Outer God has never been able to escape the shackles of the seal and has not regained its Beyonder characteristics.
An Outer God who has lost most of its Beyonder characteristics should be the one who is afraid and should be the one hiding.
Hobert glanced again at the script used by the Original Creator. Rather than calling it a script, it was more like a mental imprint. As long as one made visual contact, or even just got close enough, one could understand the meaning of these "words."
He guessed that the "words" on the "Blasphemy Slate" should be similar to this.
Hobert pondered the words of the Original Creator in detail: The Original Creator itself has some characteristics of a life form and would be attracted to things that happen with a small probability. However, the human aspects of it were not very well-developed. It didn't send Sun Zhilin and the others back to the Great Wall Station, which showed its coldness like a machine.
At the same time, Hobert realized: The Original Creator also cared about the human part within itself, or rather, it cared deeply about the extraordinary emotions displayed by life. Why was this so? And why would it ponder the meaning of the universe? The meaning of life?
In Hobert's previous speculation, divinity should be the inherent rule of the universe's operation, which is very cold, and the Original Creator is the "collection" of this rule, so it should also be very cold!
But he didn't expect that it actually had things it needed to think about. To be precise, it actually had a confused side.
Hobert suddenly had a bold guess: Does the divine part of the Original Creator also represent the consciousness of the universe? Then, could its confusion be the confusion of this universe's consciousness?
Hobert had thought about this question before. Is the Original Creator a manifestation of the universe "coming to life"?
Thinking of this, Hobert smiled and shook his head, not continuing to think about this problem that was obviously becoming more and more difficult to understand.
Immediately, Hobert moved the ice sculptures on the ice surface outside. The ice layer underground felt different from the ice and snow outside.
The ice and snow outside could be manipulated with Beyonder powers, but the ice layer inside isolated all Beyonder powers. The corpses frozen under the ice layer couldn't be "dug" out with Beyonder powers.
So, he took as many as he could carry. Hobert brought them to the snowy ground outside, and after confirming that they were all dead and had no spiritual essence left in their bodies, he buried them in the snow.
He also found a stone from a nearby mountain, placed it in front of the cemetery, and used his Beyonder power to carve the words "Martyrs' Cemetery".
Then, Hobert began to wander in the ice and snow world of Antarctica. He prepared to "connect" with the escaped Outer God to see if he could find it.
Having reached the Sequence 1 level, just knowing the existence of the target allows one to "connect," but whether or not the target can be found depends entirely on luck.
If he encountered a Sequence 2 or higher target, they would have many ways to avoid this ability, and the probability of success would be almost zero.
But considering that the Outer God had been tortured by the Original Creator on Earth for tens of thousands of years, it should be very weak. If he was lucky, he could be connected to.
After wandering in the ice and snow for twenty or thirty minutes, Hobert indeed sensed a strange spirituality.
Following the weak clues, he searched, and suddenly a giant wall appeared in his sight, reaching straight into the clouds!
At first, Hobert thought it was a snow wall that had been blown up, but the closer he got, the more he realized that something was wrong.
It really was a tall wall, and it stretched into the endless darkness on both sides, unable to see where the ends of the high wall were.
Hobert was a little strange. Why would there be such a wall here?
His spirituality didn't sense any danger, so he cautiously approached the wall. When he came to the base of the wall that reached into the clouds, the surrounding cold wind slapped against the wall, making a mournful "buzzing" sound. These walls didn't move at all, standing firmly there.
Hobert looked up for a while, feeling somewhat shocked in his heart.
He reached out and touched the wall in front of him. It was an ice wall, all made of ice.
These ice walls were obviously man-made. Who would create such a place here?
Could it be that Outer God?
Hobert smiled and shook his head. That guy was unlikely to still have such abilities.
Then, Hobert used the method of "distorting" space to stand on top of the ice wall.
Hobert didn't know how high it was here, but the strong wind here felt like it could blow people away at any time.
Standing at the top, Hobert saw that the huge ice walls formed a circle, enclosing a large piece of land.
In the middle of the ice walls, there was a small ball of light in the air, emitting a dazzling light, shining like sunlight on the land inside the ice walls.
The ground was actually a sea of flowers! Green grass grew wildly inside, with many insects flying around. Although he was so far away, seeing this scene, Hobert seemed to hear the "buzzing" sound of bees.
"This…" Hobert smiled: "This is Antarctica!"
Immediately afterwards, he saw a humanoid statue with tentacles and something similar to ram horns on the ground. The statue was covered with vegetation, as if it had been there for a long time.
Hobert was slightly stunned. His spirituality sensed that it was the escaped Outer God!
At this moment, a voice that made Hobert feel weak all over suddenly appeared in his ears: "It's so cold outside, come down and warm up, I have sweet delicacies here, and warm and soft hugs…"
Hobert suddenly felt his blood rushing, and he wanted to go down and find out which young lady was talking to him.
After taking a deep breath of the cold air, Hobert calmed down a little. He smiled and said, "Cheek! So you've been hiding here!"
What responded to his guess was frost coming from the surface of his feet.
Hobert immediately jumped up. He knew very well that he must not be frozen by the ice and snow here, otherwise he would be sealed here.
He plunged headfirst from the high ice wall, and then used the method of "distorting" position to leave here.
But after "distorting" for a moment, Hobert found that he hadn't left far.
It turned out that the Primordial Demoness had already used the ice and snow outside to form a huge layer of snow, which basically had the characteristics of a seal.
Hobert planned to immediately enter the spirit world, but when "distorting" the boundary between the spirit world and the real world, his spirituality frantically warned him. Hobert realized that the Primordial Demoness was waiting for him in the spirit world.
Hobert immediately gave up the idea of escaping from the spirit world and took out the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway from the "Nation of Disorder" and put it on his head.
After becoming Sequence 1, Hobert could safely use the Uniqueness in the real world for about twenty seconds without negative effects.
Before the ice and snow barrier in front of him had completely formed, he used the "Disorder" ability to make a space chaotic.
To others, that was a chaotic space, and they would stay as far away as possible, but to Hobert, it was an escape route.
Having smoothly passed through the ice and snow barrier, a "Frozen Forest" appeared before Him. Enormous ice pillars rose abruptly from the ground, twisting and varying in height, surrounding Hobert.
Hobert used the method of "tampering" with His own position, sometimes appearing in mid-air and sometimes returning to the ground, trying to avoid these ice pillars, doing His best not to be trapped by the space they formed.
However, as the ice pillars became more and more numerous, only a single gap remained in front of Hobert, a chance to escape.
He struggled to leap towards it, and just as He was about to escape the encirclement of the ice pillars, a forearm of a maiden made of ice suddenly appeared, her delicate hand covering the only gap.
But the palm and the ice pillar did not completely close. In a moment of crisis, Hobert summoned the power of the "Nation of Disorder," forming a black barrier to resist the incoming hand.
Then, Hobert quickly escaped through the gap in the palm, using His Uniqueness to make the surrounding area within a hundred or two hundred kilometers "chaotic," and He took advantage of the "Disorder" to leave.
In one breath, He used the method of "distorting" position to reach the edge of Antarctica.
After confirming that the Primordial Demoness had not caught up, Hobert removed the Uniqueness, resealed it, and returned it to the "Nation of Disorder."
With His back to the sea, Hobert glanced again at the Antarctic continent in the darkness. This place was a perfect match for the "Primordial Demoness!"
The "Primordial Demoness" could freely create ice layers here and use ice layers with exits to complete a certain degree of self-sealing, in order to maintain Her own state.
Due to the special nature of the Antarctic continent, the gods outside could not sense the exact location of the "Primordial Demoness," which was a good protection for Her.
The only drawback might be that the "signal was not good" here, and the Primordial Demoness could not project too much power to the outside world.
Hobert recalled the previous experience of the Primordial Demoness's descent, and the descent process was indeed very poor!
At that time, Hobert thought it was because the Primordial Demoness's condition was too poor. Now it seemed that the Primordial Demoness's condition was not as bad as imagined. At least now She was in the mood to create Her own garden in Antarctica.
But the Primordial Demoness seemed to want everyone to think that Her condition was still very bad, so She had never truly descended on the Northern and Southern continents.
Hobert planned to report everything He saw today to the Earth Mother and the Evernight Goddess. The situation in the Northern Continent was so tense that He did not expect the gods to come and encircle the Primordial Demoness, as long as They were aware of it.
Moreover, the Seven Gods should know some information about Antarctica to some extent, so it was not certain whether They were willing to come. After all, even True Gods could be sealed by the ice layer here, and They had to consider whether this would be a trap set by other gods.
When leaving Antarctica, Hobert still used the method of "distorting" space, rather than entering the Spirit World.
It wasn't until He returned to the Southern Continent that Hobert passed through the Spirit World, changed His appearance, restrained His aura, and entered the Earth Mother's Church on Longtail Island.
He reported the matter of encountering the Primordial Demoness in Antarctica in the form of prayer and briefly described His speculation, believing that the Primordial Demoness had recovered to a certain state.
Soon, Hobert was surrounded by large fields of wheat, and in the wheat fields, there was a loving and sacred figure: "I know."
"The Primordial Demoness dares not leave there now. The most important thing for you at present is to find a suitable opportunity to intervene in the war on the Northern Continent."
Hobert bowed slightly and said, "Yes, Mother, I will consider it carefully."
The loving and sacred figure nodded with satisfaction, and the surrounding wheat fields disappeared piece by piece, and Hobert returned to the church.
After resting in the church for a while, Hobert went to the Evernight Goddess Church and also reported the matter.
But Hobert did not receive any reply.
After a little thought, Hobert understood that at this time, the Evernight Goddess was pretending to be at the critical moment of accommodating the "Death" Uniqueness. Except for the kind of prayer that could respond automatically, the Evernight Goddess would not make any reply.
Returning to Angel, Hobert replayed this Antarctic exploration in His study. Recalling the actions of the scientific expedition team, He still felt a little sad, after all, they were just ordinary people.
Then He thought of the escaped Outer God, feeling that this guy was unlucky enough. He had been sealed by the Original Creator for tens of thousands of years, and finally escaped, but could only move in the snow-covered Antarctica. He didn't know how many years ago, He was turned into a sculpture by the Primordial Demoness.
The word "miserable" seemed to be written on this guy's forehead.
Smiling and shaking His head, Hobert recalled the purpose of His trip and came to the conclusion: it was not suitable to build a mausoleum in Antarctica.
In addition to the sealing characteristics there, and the connection with oneself might not be very good, there was also a Primordial Demoness coveting that continent, not a good place to build a mausoleum.

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 706: Exploring the Giant King’s Court
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
While Hobert was chairing a meeting on immigration progress, his vision was suddenly covered by a gray mist.
Then, a tall young man wearing classical clothing appeared before him: "… Respected Mr. Fool, please tell Mr. Emperor that we will set off tomorrow to explore the Giant King's Court again.
Please have Mr. Emperor ready. We expect to reach the destination in six days, and I will summon Mr. Emperor in seven days. Please ask him to act with us."
Immediately after, the figure disappeared, and Hobert heard Conrad's report on the progress of immigration again.
Because he was still attending the meeting, Hobert did not respond immediately.
Conrad's report elaborated on the immigration situation since November of last year. As of August of this year, a total of 700,000 people have been immigrated from the Northern Continent, basically completing the previously set plan.
After the land reform was completed nationwide, new statistics came out, and the entire country had a population gap of about 1 million people.
These gaps mainly come from the Highlands County and Cullen County, as well as the newly occupied Salto area.
A single Yason City needs at least 150,000 people to fill it, and the Highlands Kingdom previously exploited its citizens quite severely, greatly limiting the population.
The Salto area is sparsely populated because of its harsh conditions.
However, according to surveys, the Salto area is rich in minerals and has a lot of arable land.
The local nobles know that mining is profitable, so they basically use manpower for mining.
The natives are unwilling to cultivate. Generally, the places with better soil do not belong to their territory. It is easy for them to cultivate the land well, and after several years of management, it finally becomes fertile land, but it is taken away by colonists or local nobles.
Even if it is fertile land, it can only grow one season of grain a year. For colonists, the initial development cost is too high, and they will not go there to build manors.
This has resulted in a large amount of land that could be used for farming not being developed.
The fact that places suitable for growing grain have not been developed makes Hobert feel very uncomfortable!
In His eyes, leaving such places idle is an unforgivable waste!
So Hobert chaired this meeting to prepare for the launch of the second round of immigration operations.
Now the war in the Northern Continent is in a stalemate. A large number of people have lost their jobs or land due to the war. Many refugees have poured into Backlund, bringing a considerable burden to this international metropolis.
In such an environment, some people are willing to immigrate, which can completely fill the population gap in the Southern Balam Duchy.
Hobert asked the county government to speed up the pace of immigration and complete the second phase of immigration work within half a year.
Because in His view, after the end of the war in the Northern Continent this winter, the diplomatic relations between the Loen Kingdom and the Southern Balam Duchy will be full of uncertainty.
During a break in the meeting, Hobert took the opportunity to go to the washroom to pray to "The Fool", telling "Little Sun" that he would adjust his time.
At the same time, Hobert realized that the City of Silver's second exploration of the Giant King's Court was ahead of schedule.
In His impression, this exploration and the battle of the gods in the Northern Continent were probably at the same time.
Now it is only August, and Loen, which has shrunk its defense line, can still hold on for a while with the supply from the east of the kingdom.
Hobert recalled that Klein's hunting of the Dark Demonic Wolf was also brought forward. Then, the residents of City of Silver and Moon City will arrive earlier.
So, after a new round of meetings began, Hobert asked about the construction of New Lanark City.
After the completion of Angel City, all construction workers went to Lanark Port to start the construction of the new city without any rest.
According to the plan, it will be basically completed in October. Hobert nodded, the time is completely sufficient.
At that time, the weather will be relatively hot, and there will be no problem living in unfinished houses. The specific decoration work can be handed over to "Little Sun" and the others to complete themselves.
The agenda of the meeting continued, and everyone discussed the bumper harvest of grain this year. This year, the Southern Balam Duchy can be described as "good weather".
If there is any need for rainfall or wind reduction, Hobert directly handed it over to Medici and Raymond. With two "Weather Warlocks" here, of course, they cannot be wasted.
Although Medici always looks impatient every time he receives such a task, officials in the areas in need say that Medici also looks happy when facing the gratitude of the people.
Raymond is generally very obedient, and he will make it rain as much as he is told. He is just short of asking how many raindrops there are.
Because of the extraordinary power, no place in the Southern Balam Duchy has suffered any natural disasters this year.
It is certain that there will be a bumper harvest with twice the yield of previous years. With so much grain produced at once, the county government must coordinate the storage work, after all, it must be enough for the entire country to eat for a year.
The last topic of this meeting was the issue of internal conflicts among the people.
At present, the Southern Balam Duchy has Loen people, East Balam people, West Balam people, Highlands Kingdom people, Longtail Island natives, Feynapotter people, and many ethnic minorities with small populations.
They have different beliefs and different lifestyles. At present, many conflicts have emerged between them in the process of communication, and these conflicts are becoming more and more frequent and intense.
Hobert immediately found the root cause of the conflict: this country does not have a dominant ethnic group!
This is obviously a big problem. In Hobert's impression, the basic condition for a general power and a strong country is to have a dominant ethnic group with a population of at least 70%.
This is more conducive to unifying the values of a country and can greatly reduce internal conflicts.
At present, the immigration plan has not ended, but the drawbacks of immigration countries are about to begin to appear.
Hobert recalled the methods of self-stabilization of various immigration countries in the AD era, and realized after a while: What's the point of recalling! In the Beyonder world, this is an opportunity!
So, after the meeting, Hobert immediately asked the county government to invite professors in sociology, folklore, and linguistics to establish a department to integrate the characteristics of domestic customs, clothing, and other aspects.
Hobert will next unify the standards of clothing, language, and weights and measures throughout the country.
The first step is to do some research, combine the clothing of all parties, and leave those parts that are more practical, more beautiful, and not very difficult to make.
Then, when the nationwide large-scale construction begins in the second half of the year, taking advantage of the semi-military control state at that time, unify the clothing and weights and measures while unifying the architectural style, and promote the same language.
As long as they wear the same clothes, use the same things, and live in the same houses, most of the conflicts will not be so intense after a long time.
As for some local customs and hairstyles, they can be retained, and they are only required to speak the same language.
In at most twenty years, when the new generation who have received new education grows up, the entire country will no longer have such sharp conflicts.
Sixty or seventy years later, when all of this becomes everyone's habit, then a brand new nation with unified values will be born.
However, Hobert is not concerned about such distant things for the time being. In the initial stage of unifying everything, it will definitely be resented and resisted by the people.
And all of this will become the basis for Hobert to digest the potion, and it will also become the key to advancing to the Black Emperor ritual.
The only thing to pay attention to is that once the people's resentment leads to mass incidents, they must be resolved quickly.
It is generally impossible to reason with them. The solution is nothing more than coercion and inducement.
Conrad and others, who have experience in governing Longtail Island, are no strangers to this, so Hobert asked Conrad to prepare several contingency plans. It doesn't matter even if they can't be resolved. He will take a trip, and with a "stir", everything will be gone.
In the midst of close planning and preparation for this matter, time passed quickly, and in a blink of an eye, it was the time agreed with "Little Sun".
Hobert roughly told Audrey and Fors about his next actions, and then locked himself in the study again.
After building the "Wall of Spirituality", Hobert sacrificed himself to "The Fool" as last time, but this time "The Fool" did not respond until after more than half a minute.
Coming to the castle full of mist again, Hobert felt that the figure in the depths of the castle seemed to be full of distortion and madness.
He immediately recalled that Klein had explored the residence of the Giant King first. His shadow was taken away by the "Dark Angel" Sasrir, and his marionette was also taken away again, so his condition was very wrong.
Hobert really wanted to step forward and ask: Is your condition okay? If not, I might as well ask "The Creator" to send me to the "Forsaken Land of the Gods".
While thinking wildly, Hobert's vision darkened, and He had already appeared in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods".
Getting up from the simple altar, in the dim light, Hobert first saw Derrick Berg with brown-yellow hair and a tall figure.
Derrick was a little excited when he saw Hobert: "Mr. Emperor… How should I address you?"
He suddenly remembered that he didn't know Mr. Emperor's name yet.
Hobert smiled slightly: "My name is Hobert."
"Little Sun" also introduced himself: "My name is Derrick."
Hobert "hmm"ed, turned his head and looked at Chief Colin Iliad, who was also tall and had gray hair, and Lovia Tiffany, who was wearing a black robe and was beautiful and generous.
Both of them were carefully looking at Hobert. Derrick had already reported that he would find two helpers. At first, Colin only planned to let Derrick call one helper, so that things would still be within a controllable range.
To be precise, if Derrick and his helper had problems, Colin and Lovia could still join forces to control the situation. If there were two helpers, it would be easy to lose balance.
But when Derrick told Colin that the second helper was an angel and could enter and exit the "Forsaken Land of the Gods" relatively freely, Colin had no objection.
The reason is very simple. If this angel-level helper had a problem, City of Silver would have been gone long ago.
Colin knew that this angel must have His purpose in actively participating in this exploration, but this was also an opportunity for City of Silver.
Elder Lovia was very worried about this, because in her opinion, the power of City of Silver had lost its balance.
While thinking wildly, Colin and Lovia put their left hands on their chests and bowed to Hobert, which was the least respect for the angel walking on the earth.
"Standing before you, I finally understand what it means to have giant blood." Hobert, who was quite a bit shorter than the three of them, waved at Colin and Lovia in response to their greeting. Then, he smiled and asked, "My Jotun isn't very good, can you understand me?"
Derrick replied, "It sounds a bit awkward, but I can understand what you mean."
Hobert nodded. "How far is the Giant King's Court from here?"
Derrick pointed behind Hobert. "It's on that mountain over there."
Hobert turned his head and glanced. A beam of light illuminated a magnificent castle built against the mountain. The style of the castle was very ancient, different from any architecture on the Northern and Southern continents.
It was very grand, with a strong sense of epic poetry, and a feeling of history coming to life.
Hobert sighed, "This is the so-called Divine Kingdom. Even after being abandoned for so long, it still gives people a sense of holiness."
He turned back. "I thought there wouldn't be any light here."
"That bright light suddenly appeared just now." Derrick said, "We don't know what's going on either."
Hobert nodded. "Then can we start exploring? You wouldn't mind if I sped things up a bit, would you?"
Before anyone else could answer, Hobert had already used the 'distortion' of space to bring them to the gate of the Giant King's Court.
Derrick praised, "Mr. Hobert, is this ability a collective 'Blink'?"
"It's 'distorting' space." Hobert said without concealment.
Colin and Lovia's eyes revealed a bit of worry. When Hobert 'accelerated' just now, they had no ability to resist at all.
Hobert looked at the castle in front of him, which had collapsed in many places. "Gehrman is late!"
"Gehrman Sparrow is never late!" As soon as Hobert finished speaking, a figure emerged from behind the collapsed tower. He was wearing a black trench coat, a silk top hat, his right face was stern and rigid, and his left face was composed of transparent, distorted, constantly crawling worms:
"Nor will he be early, he will only arrive just in time."
As he spoke, he grinned, his smile very exaggerated.
The three demigods of the City of Silver immediately adopted a defensive posture. In their eyes, the man in the strange hat and coat looked more like a monster.
Hobert smiled. "That sentence sounds very familiar, like a line from somewhere."
He paused and then said, "My friend, your condition is really too bad, let me help you."
As he spoke, Hobert 'distorted' Klein's spirit body, making his originally incomplete spirit body temporarily complete. This was equivalent to Klein's spirit body, which was originally only half complete, being 'distorted' into being complete.
Klein let out a long sigh, and the half of his face composed of worms returned to normal.
He regained his usual sternness. "With you joining, it seems that this operation will be very easy."
Derrick and the others listened carefully to the conversation between the two helpers. Seeing that Hobert had easily solved the problem, Derrick was very happy, but Colin felt that the City of Silver's power seemed to have become marginalized in this operation.
"Not necessarily." Hobert said, "Isn't the 'Dark Angel' sitting in the Giant King's residence?"
"That doesn't seem to be a complete 'Dark Angel'." Klein said, "I have already opened the gate to the Giant King's residence, which brought some surprises, causing changes in the Divine Kingdom.
"The one sitting inside is more like the 'Dark Angel's' shadow, in short, it doesn't feel like a complete 'Dark Angel'."
As he spoke, he winked at Hobert, who understood and nodded slightly.
They had previously exchanged information about the 'Dark Angel' at the Tarot Club. In Hobert's description, the 'Dark Angel' was the avatar formed by the Ancient Sun God's humanity. In the process of the Ancient Sun God 'killing himself', he returned his humanity, which was equivalent to the 'Dark Angel' losing its main consciousness.
Later, the Ancient Sun God's plan failed, and his human part immediately recovered the Sequence 1 characteristic and Beyonder characteristics of the 'Hanged Man' pathway, forming the True Creator.
So the 'Dark Angel' also lost its main Beyonder characteristics.
Klein was using his eyes to tell Hobert that his information was basically accurate.
At the same time, Klein realized that the 'Dark Angel' sitting in the main hall was more like some kind of symbolic meaning, or some kind of manifestation of divinity.
But this was just a feeling in his spirituality, he didn't see exactly what it was.
Hobert clapped his hands. "Alright, everyone's here, let's set off.
"Oh, right, the three of you from City of Silver, I think Derrick has already told you my conditions, right?"
Colin nodded. "Yes."
Hobert said meaningfully, "As long as I get my reward, I will protect your safety and let you see the sun outside."
Saying this, he strode towards the gate. "Hurry up, I really want to see what the 'Dark Angel' is doing now."
Klein realized: Hobert might also be here with a mission, like the True Creator and Amon, the 'Creator' might also want to know the current state of 'Dark Angel' Sasrir.
Ahead was a double door tens of meters high, with a gray-blue tone, and the surface was inlaid with golden nails.
Hobert really wanted to go up and see if those nails were made of real gold, but he felt that this move was not in line with the identity of an angel and would lower his price, so he could only pretend not to see it.
Inside the gate, on both sides, stood a five- or six-meter-high guard with great pressure. They were wearing exquisite and solid silver full-body armor, one holding a greatsword, one holding a giant axe, and behind the masks, there was a group of orange-red light.
Colin and the others stopped advancing within a safe distance, only Hobert was still walking forward unhurriedly.
Derrick was about to call out to Hobert to discuss a tactic, but Klein stopped him. "He can handle it himself."
He knew that Hobert had already advanced to Sequence 1, and he had acted with Hobert not long ago. At this time, Hobert could kill a 'Miracle Invoker' as easily as playing, and two Sequence 3s were nothing.
Hobert stepped forward step by step, and the huge steps in front of the door, about one person high, seemed to suddenly shrink and become the size of normal steps under his feet.
After reaching a certain distance, the two 'Silver Knights' reacted, their necks turned stiffly and looked at the intruder Hobert.
Hobert snapped his fingers very smartly and 'tampered' with the weight of the two 'Silver Knights' armor.
Their hands trembled, as if trying to pick up their weapons, but the greatsword and giant axe gradually sank into the mud under their feet.
At the same time, because the armor was too heavy, the 'Silver Knights' were pressed to one knee, as if they were welcoming Hobert.
Hobert came to the two Silver Knights and looked at them curiously: "So you can still stay here until now because your spirit body is so special.
"Was it affected when fighting the undead bird?"
"But it doesn't matter anymore, you have become history, rest in peace."
Hobert took out the 'Death Domain' of '0-73' from the 'Nation of Disorder' and stuffed their spirit bodies into the underworld.
Dong~
The giant sword fell to the ground, and the two 'Silver Knights' knelt there motionless.
Hobert snapped his fingers again, and two 'Silver Knight' Beyonder characteristics were immediately extracted.
After collecting the spoils, Hobert waved to the back: "Let's continue forward."
After a second or two, Derrick reacted. The two 'Silver Knights' who had been bothering them were actually solved just like that!
He looked at his two companions with excitement. Colin seemed to have figured it out and no longer had any doubts about it.
The chief was now very sure that the other party's strength was enough to easily destroy City of Silver, and there was no need to use any complicated means to do it.
But the other party didn't do this, which meant that at least for the time being, the other party had no malice.
Lovia's expression was very solemn, and her eyes were still full of worry.
But she was also very clear that her worry was useless.
Seeing the reactions of the two companions, Derrick also restrained his excited expression, but his heart was still very happy: I have known Mr. Emperor for two years, and I know him… no, I know Him better, otherwise a helper so powerful would suddenly appear in front of me, and I would also be suspicious.
Continuing forward, they saw a black 'lake' blocking the way.
These lakes looked very unusual. Under the 'water surface', there seemed to be invisible whirlpools, and even spirituality could be sucked into them.
Hobert pointed to a brick on the ground, and then waved his hand slightly, the brick rushed to the other side like a cannonball leaving the barrel.
But this very fast brick suddenly began to fall in the 'center of the lake', dropping into the lake in a parabola that violated the laws of mechanics and approached a right angle.
Then Hobert raised his hand and pushed forward, and a large area of space in front became chaotic, but the chaotic space also fell into the lake one after another.
Klein said: "Even Beyonder abilities can fall?"
Hobert smiled slightly: "It seems that the 'Dark Angel' has had a great influence on this castle."
He pondered for a while and said: "Get ready, we have to pass through here quickly."
Saying this, he grabbed the Uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' from the 'Nation of Disorder' and stayed on top of his head, and then made a downward chopping gesture forward.
Whoosh~
The black 'lake water' split from the middle, revealing a road that had been dyed black.
Hobert used the ability to 'tamper' with the position, 'tampering' from this side of the lake to the other side.
He put away the Uniqueness and smiled slightly: "Fortunately, the one sitting inside is not a complete 'Dark Angel'."
Derrick on the side breathed a sigh of relief and said in his heart: Fortunately, I asked Mr. Emperor to help, otherwise how could this 'lake' trap us.
Continuing forward, they saw the road composed of steps extending all the way to the most magnificent Giant King's residence.
