chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 711: The Fall of the God of Combat
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
As the war in the Northern Continent entered October and Backlund began to cool, the war situation suddenly underwent a massive change!
In recent months, the Feysac army, which hadn't launched many proactive offensives, suddenly launched a surprise attack in the southeast direction!
They bypassed the Chester Mountains blocking their path and directly launched a surprise attack towards the eastern part of Backlund.
Backlund's defenses in the east were very weak, and the hastily assembled positions were breached in a single charge by the enemy. Thus, in late October, the Feysac army and a large number of forces from the God of Combat Church appeared in the suburbs of Backlund.
Backlund had become the front line!
This sudden change caught everyone off guard. It wasn't that no one had considered this possibility, but rather that the day seemed to have come too quickly!
Since the support from the Duchy of Southern Balam had alleviated the pressure on the western front, the general expectation was that the enemy might break through the Balchis mountain defense line in the first half of next year.
If the war could be delayed until the second half of next year, then this war would ultimately be resolved at the negotiating table.
However, unexpectedly, just as winter arrived, the outer defense line was breached.
Subsequently, the Loen soldiers on the western front collapsed.
Medici realized that the hundred thousand troops in his hands could hardly withstand the hundreds of thousands of Intis troops on the main battlefield, so he quickly ordered a southward retreat, giving up the main passage of the Balchis Mountains.
Southern Balam retreated all the way to the southern part of the Backlund region, making a final observation of the war.
At this time, everyone believed that the fall of Backlund was only a matter of time.
Then, Hobert found Medici and asked him to take people to defend the southwestern positions of Backlund, and told him to put up more flags of the Duchy of Southern Balam in front of the positions.
Medici pondered this strange order for a while before immediately taking people to defend Backlund.
After the flags were planted, the Intis army only deployed a dozen divisions opposite them to contain the Duchy of Southern Balam, while their main force continued to attack the Loen army, which had already lost its morale.
The war had only lasted for three days, and a large number of deserters had inevitably appeared in the Loen army. The entire Backlund was unwilling to continue resisting.
On the last day of October, Hobert felt that the entire Backlund had reached its limit.
He sat on top of the high tower next to the Resurrection Square, overlooking this cold city.
Since the start of the war last year, they had suffered too much sadness and pain. At this moment, the enemy's artillery fire quickly destroyed the public's psychological defenses.
At this time, Hobert discovered that a team of cavalry suddenly rushed out from the direction of the palace, rampaging and disregarding the lives of the people on the streets.
The cavalry quickly headed to the Backlund port, as if they were fleeing in panic.
Hobert smiled: "A smokescreen!"
He was very sure that George III had already used the teleportation array to go to the Rorsted Archipelago, and this team of guards was only attracting the enemy's attention.
At this moment, the space around Hobert suddenly became illusory, and Fors brought Audrey over.
"You've come just in time," Hobert said with a smile. "I'll take you to see something good, but before that..."
Hobert took out two pairs of glasses made of Order Crystals: "Put these on, and remember, never take off the glasses!"
Fors and Audrey, seeing Backlund being constantly ravaged by artillery fire, seemed to understand something and nodded solemnly together.
Then, Hobert used the ability to "distort" space to bring the two ladies to a hill in the northern part of Backlund, quietly watching the distant sky.
After waiting for more than half an hour, the sky suddenly darkened. It was noon, but the northern sky turned golden, and in a short while, it presented a scene of dusk.
In the southern sky, it gradually became deep, and after only a moment, it turned into night.
Darkness and dusk intertwined, dividing the entire sky into two.
Just seeing the scene in the sky, Audrey and Fors felt a huge sense of oppression.
Hobert also took a deep breath, somewhat excitedly saying: "It's starting!"
… …
At this time, in the Rorsted Archipelago, in the "City of Generosity" Bayam.
Alger, who had just landed at the port, felt something and turned his gaze to the northwestern sky.
Wherever his eyes reached, the sky suddenly darkened, and layers of dark clouds piled up, and countless silver-white electric snakes jumped out.
Many deep blue waves surged high, forming huge water columns, heading straight into the clouds, connecting the sky and the sea.
At the junction of the sea and the sky, rays of light lit up, and they suddenly lost any color, as if composed of massive amounts of illusory things.
Alger, who had already become a demigod, immediately understood what was going on: "God... the War of the Gods has begun!"
That was the battlefield of the Lord of Storms and the God of Steam and Machinery.
… …
Near the capital of Lenburg.
Anderson Hood used "Fireball" to block the enemy's attack again. Looking at the corpses, weapons, and blood outside the bunker, he patted the dust on his hands and smiled at his deputy:
"I don't know how long we can last. Do you have anything you want to leave behind? I can help write a will."
As he wished, he saw the angry eyes of the surrounding "soldiers". At this moment, their thoughts were surprisingly consistent.
However, the "soldiers" did not make a move, but instead shifted their gazes elsewhere.
These "soldiers" were what he used to complete the advancement ritual, and they should be called teammates, but none of them were willing to admit this.
"You're not responding to my provocation," Anderson raised his eyebrows and said, "That means you're plotting a conspiracy."
Without waiting for the adjutant and the "soldiers" to respond, this "Hunter" smiled and continued: "Are you planning to surrender? To protect your relatives and friends?"
Seeing all eyes turning towards him, Anderson shook his head: "You haven't been Beyonder for long. You've only been able to become 'Hunter', 'Provoker', and 'Pyromaniac' by relying on the outbreak of war to obtain the main ingredients for potions from the enemy. But in terms of conspiracy, you are still too naive.
"I'm very curious, why don't you try to persuade me to surrender with you? I don't think I usually show much determination, and I'm not a believer in the God of Knowledge and Wisdom."
Speaking of this, Anderson looked at his adjutant thoughtfully: "Are the high-level officials on the opposite side completely angered by me and ordered not to accept my surrender?"
The adjutant was silent for a few seconds before saying: "You already know, why do you still ask?"
The nearby soldiers once again raised their palms in unison, aiming them at Anderson, appearing extremely tacit.
"If I don't ask, how can I be sure that everyone is thinking the same thing?" Anderson was not flustered at all.
He touched his stomach with his left hand and put his right hand into his pocket, not knowing what he was groping for.
At this moment, the sun in the high sky suddenly expanded, becoming extremely huge, and the scorching sunlight made it impossible for Anderson and the others to open their eyes completely, and their minds were blank, making it difficult to have any thoughts.
Immediately afterwards, a illusory high tower protruded out. Each of its layers was composed of thick books, and each book had a bronze eye. The higher the layer, the darker it was, and the more it was filled with madness and destruction.
This high tower extended to the sky, as if encircling the entire world into its interior, including the huge sun.
… …
Backlund, inside the luxurious villa of the Odora family.
All the Sanguine in this metropolis gathered here to prepare for the upcoming war results.
Emlyn put his hands in his pockets, looking at the sky outside where dusk and darkness intertwined.
Suddenly, he had a slight inspiration and turned his gaze to the garden outside the window. Clumps of withered weeds became green again and grew rapidly, becoming more than one person tall in no time.
In other parts of the city, the trees on both sides of the road frantically absorbed nutrients from unknown sources, rising section by section, and soon grew to dozens of meters high, with thick branches and umbrella-like crowns.
The giant trees connected to each other, blocking the sky of Backlund.
Many buildings were therefore crushed, or entangled by branches and vines, seemingly abandoned for decades.
In just seven or eight seconds, many places in Backlund turned into primeval forests.
… …
On the hills outside Backlund, Audrey and Fors hid in a tall canopy, looking at the distant scene with black glasses.
Just now, the northern part of the entire Backlund area was covered with roses, night-scented stocks, and other plants symbolizing tranquility and darkness, and the surrounding area had also entered the night in advance.
Suddenly, orange-red rays of light shone from the sky into this tranquil plant cluster, returning some areas to dusk, causing flowers and grass to wither one after another.
In the desolate dusk, a huge figure like a mountain peak walked out. He had long limbs, wearing silver armor full of dilapidation, his face was covered by a mask, only vaguely revealing a cluster of orange-red light.
He held an exaggerated long sword, allowing the tip to droop naturally, touching the dark "ground."
As this terrifying giant walked forward step by step, the long sword constantly dragged in the darkness, causing the ground to split and the surrounding dusk to replace tranquility and darkness.
In the depths of darkness, a similarly large figure floated out, dragging a long scythe.
She wore a layered but not complicated dark black long skirt, dotted with countless brilliances, like a starry night inlaid.
On her ribs and waist, two arms each grew out, the surface covered with dark short hair.
In Her six hands, two held the heavy black scythe, two cradled a scarlet "moon," one was empty, as if supporting something, and one tightly gripped an ancient golden ornament.
The ornament was shaped like a slender bird, surrounded by wings composed of pale flames. Within its bronze eyes, layers of light overlapped, as if forming one illusory door after another.
The giant wielding the greatsword moved forward, his pace quickening, gradually approaching a charge.
His sword, dragged through darkness and twilight, rubbed against the surroundings, sparking small, clear dawns.
At this moment, the roses and vines on the other side suddenly enlarged, growing wildly, soon becoming equivalent to trees that had survived for thousands of years in a primeval forest.
Among these trees, a figure entwined with deep green vines and adorned with various herbs and flowers stood out.
She was also as huge as a mountain peak, with a full figure, flowing robes, and cradling an illusory infant.
As soon as this figure descended, it followed the twilight giant, approaching the humanoid demon wolf wielding the jet-black scythe in a half-floating, half-flying manner.
Audrey and Fors, who were watching the battle from afar, had activated the "Order Crystal" shield due to the immense pressure of the divine war.
Although it consumed a large amount of spirituality, they were unwilling to miss everything that was happening before their eyes.
At this moment, they couldn't help but worry about the Evernight Goddess, as it was clearly a one-on-two situation.
At the same time, they didn't understand why, but they always felt that the illusory infant held by the Earth Mother was very familiar, or rather, gave them a very familiar feeling.
…
Hobert first came to Longtail Island, then carefully built a "Wall of Spirituality," and covered it with a layer of "Order Crystal" composed of a barrier.
Then He entered the "Nation of Disorder." After Hobert waited for Beverly's prayer, He first threw the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch," "Holy Infant King," and "Duke of Entropy" into the battlefield.
Then, He turned the "0-76" Death God's Sword into a circular ring and wore it on His wrist. At the same time, He held the "0-78" Spiritual Wilderness and draped the "0-79" Mysterious Curtain over His body as a cloak.
Finally, He wore the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" and held the "Sun Scepter" in His other hand, arriving in the real world as the "Creator" clad in black armor.
The "Creator" did not go to the main battlefield. He was very clear that the Evernight Goddess did not need help, and going there might be a hindrance.
He came to the sea, to the battlefield between the Lord of Storms and the God of Steam and Machinery.
During this time, Hobert had been working hard to gather intelligence, and finally determined that the Beyonder characteristic of the "Knowledge Emperor" extracted from Roselle's body had been carried by the God of Steam.
Before finding other Beyonder characteristics of the "Knowledge Emperor," only the Beyonder characteristic in the hands of the God of Steam was the key to helping "Old Huang."
And today's divine war was the only opportunity to obtain that Beyonder characteristic in recent times.
Reaching the edge of the battlefield, the "Creator" saw the lofty figure surrounded by lightning in the crest of the clouds.
The grim lightning flickered between heaven and earth, and the sea, air, and dark clouds could be scorched by clusters of lightning.
Opposite Him was an illusory figure in the light. He folded His hands together and then opened them, forming an illusory book in His hands. After the lightning encountered the illusory book, it immediately entered the book from the real world, becoming illusory, and then disappeared without a trace.
Immediately afterwards, the gale howled, and the illusory book was blown away, torn page by page in the blade-like wind, and finally returned to nothingness.
The "Creator" sighed, thinking that the Lord of Storms seemed to be a little more powerful, but it could not be ruled out that it was because the Lord of Storms's ability was more oppressive.
At this time, Hobert, wearing the Uniqueness, joined the battle in a timely manner. He "weakened" the God of Steam's next attack using the illusory scroll, making this attack seem not to originate from a true god, and the Lord of Storms easily dispersed it.
The lofty Lord of Storms and the God of Steam, who seemed to be in an illusory space, looked at the "Creator" together. They might not have understood for a while, why was this guy joining in the fun?
…
In the Minsk Mountains, the three angels of the God of Combat Church were all here, gazing into the distance, observing the divine war in the direction of Backlund.
Suddenly, their spirituality was aware, and Beverly and Raymond, wearing the same style of circular jade pendants, appeared on the distant mountain peaks.
"Glory" Larrion's eyes were immediately filled with hatred after seeing Beverly.
But before He could rush towards the enemy, the three angels of the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch" suddenly appeared near them, and immediately launched a 3-on-3 angel battle.
At this time, the Beverly siblings approached unhurriedly, and when they found the right opportunity, Beverly threw a pure black talisman at Larrion, the Archbishop of the God of Combat Church: "Misfortune!"
This was the God-level "Misfortune Talisman" that the Evernight Goddess had given to Hobert before!
Larrion, who was reaching out to take the "Trunsoest Brass Book," was about to touch the cloth bag holding the "Brass Book" when a large hole suddenly opened at the bottom of the cloth bag, and the "Brass Book" fell to the ground just like that.
It should be known that this cloth bag was also a Sealed Artifact, specially used to seal the "Brass Book," and it suddenly opened a big hole at this time.
Because Larrion was too unlucky, encountering such a small probability event.
…
Northwest of the Feynapotter Kingdom, on the Central Plateau.
Philip I was gazing at the divine war in the distance. For a Sequence 1, he could see the general situation of the Backlund divine war from here, and he could more clearly see the battle between the Eternal Blazing Sun and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom on the border between Intis and Loen.
At this moment, his spirituality was aware, and he saw a figure stepping from a distance.
The other party looked like he was in his twenties, with bronze hair, it was Trunsoest.
Philip I smiled and said: "You don't go to snatch the Uniqueness of the 'Justiciar' pathway, what are you doing here?"
As he spoke, the silver-white "Sword of Order" in his hand had already formed: "I see, you are very clear that you can't snatch it from the 'Creator' at all!"
Trunsoest smiled slightly, raised his hand slightly, and the earth under Philip I's feet and the surrounding environment lost all order, and the earth and air simultaneously turned into viscous liquid that could trap Philip I.
Philip I waved the "Sword of Order" and cut it down, and the viscous liquid immediately restored order, and returned to the state of gas and solid.
In the next instant, Philip I had already appeared in front of Trunsoest, and stabbed the emperor he had originally served with a sword.
However, Trunsoest had no intention of dodging, nor did he make any defensive moves.
Philip I frowned. At this time, his "Sword of Order" suddenly stopped, as if it had hit a hard object.
Philip I immediately retreated, and he realized that a layer of "Spiritual Barrier" had suddenly appeared in front of Trunsoest.
Two seemingly ugly hands suddenly appeared, peeling open the real world, revealing the ugly figure in the spirit world, it was actually the "Abomination" Suah.
Philip I did not satirize Trunsoest for actually colluding with Suah, he immediately used his ability to go to Oak Island in the southeast direction.
Because after seeing Suah, his spirituality immediately had a very bad premonition. At this time, going to William I was a good choice.
Although Philip I and William I had always been enemies, William I was the person in this world who was least willing to see Philip I's Beyonder characteristic being taken away by Trunsoest.
"It's too late!" Trunsoest smiled and said: "Deprive!"
Philip I discovered that his Sequence 1 level abilities had actually been "deprived"!
This made him immediately realize that the former "Justiciar" Trunsoest still had some influence on the Sequence 1 Characteristic of this pathway, or rather, the arrangement that Trunsoest left in the "Hands of Order" still had some effect.
So Philip I ran faster.
At this moment, two huge bronze doors with intricate mystical symbols appeared in front of him.
Squeak ~
The bronze door suddenly opened completely, and the spiritual bodies of all life within tens of kilometers around were sucked into the door.
A female image with a pale face, an expression as stiff as a dead person, and a bit like an illusory spirit body appeared from the underworld.
Philip I was a little surprised: "Pale Empress!"
That female figure was none other than Sia Palenqe Eggers, the current emperor of the Balam Empire!
…
On the turbulent sea.
Hobert finally found the Beyonder characteristic of the "Knowledge Emperor," which was a pure white crown, and like the "Death God's Sword," it was worn on the wrist by the God of Steam.
The space around the God of Steam was illusory. If Hobert did not wear the Uniqueness, it would be difficult to see the position of the "Knowledge Emperor" Characteristic clearly.
Now that he had found that Characteristic, it was easy to handle. Hobert immediately "used" the ability of the "Knowledge Emperor" Beyonder characteristic to turn a part of the God of Steam into a stream of information composed of symbols and numbers.
A scroll immediately appeared next to the God of Steam. This scroll recorded the helplessness and misery of human beings when facing supernatural species. The stream of information was introduced into the scroll, and the stream of information immediately became illusory, and finally merged with the scroll.
At this time, a storm suddenly appeared in the scroll, and the Lord of Storms invaded his power into this scroll!
The people and Beyonder creatures in the scroll showed fear of the sudden natural disaster and hid back in their habitats and nests.
The raindrops in the storm became illusory and powerful, piercing the scroll like sharp thorns, and began to smash towards the God of Steam.
The God of Steam released a brilliant light, a light distinct from all colors in the world. Anyone who saw it would exclaim: "This is the light of civilization!"
The light, imbued with abstract meaning, caused the sharp, stormy raindrops to revert to ordinary raindrops, falling into the sea beneath their feet.
This was why the "Creator" decided to seize the "Knowledge Emperor"'s Beyonder characteristic at this moment. Facing the God of Steam alone, He had little chance of winning. Only by using the Storm Lord's attack could He force the God of Steam to abandon that "Knowledge Emperor" Characteristic.
While the God of Steam was resisting the Storm Lord's assault, the "Creator" once again exploited the negative effects associated with the "Knowledge Emperor" Beyonder characteristic, causing the God of Steam to be momentarily dazed, lost in the glory of His contributions to human civilization.
This daze might have lasted less than half a second, but when He regained His senses, He was surrounded by enormous waves from all directions.
One painting after another reappeared in front of the waves, some recording the epic scenes of humans using themselves as experimental subjects, attempting to fuse Beyonder Materials to gain power, others bearing various inventions, books, and viewpoints.
But the layers of waves crashed down and broke through these paintings. These were not mere waves; they were tsunamis, possessing the abstract power to overcome all obstacles.
Taking advantage of the brief obstruction caused by the paintings, the God of Steam worked hard to transform the tsunamis from two directions into swift currents. He immediately hid within the currents, avoiding being "encircled" by the tsunamis.
At this moment, the God of Steam was already in a disheveled state under the joint attack of the Storm Lord and the "Creator." He was also very clear that the "Creator" wanted to seize the "Knowledge Emperor" Beyonder characteristic He carried.
After a slight hesitation, the God of Steam threw the Characteristic to the "Creator," because He realized that if He didn't, He might be injured in today's battle.
He had only recently, in the past hundred years, regained a good state. If He were to be injured at this critical moment before the arrival of the apocalypse, it would trigger catastrophic consequences.
The "Creator" distorted the "Knowledge Emperor" Beyonder characteristic into His hand, bowed slightly to the God of Steam to express gratitude, and then disappeared from the battlefield of the gods.
High above, the Storm Lord, wielding lightning, and the God of Steam in the illusory space were both somewhat puzzled. Why would the "Creator" seize the "Knowledge Emperor" Beyonder characteristic, which was not from an adjacent pathway, at such a crucial moment?
…
In the angel battlefield of the Minsk Mountains, Beverly "distorted" the position of her younger brother, Raymond, allowing him to appear in front of the "Brass Book."
The "Brass Book" was the Uniqueness of a pathway. It was difficult for the angels present to directly obtain it using their Beyonder abilities. They could only acquire this Grade 0 Sealed Artifact by physically grabbing it.
Larrion, the Chief Shepherd of the God of Combat Church, endured an attack from the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch," using the giant sword in his hand to force Raymond away. He bent down to pick up the "Brass Book," but as he bent over, his body suddenly lost balance, and he stumbled forward, stepping over the "Brass Book."
As an angel who had already undergone qualitative change, how could he make such a low-level mistake at such a crucial moment!
It was because he was too unlucky, encountering such a low-probability event!
At this time, Raymond threw a fireball next to the "Brass Book."
Boom!
An explosion blasted the "Brass Book," which was wrapped in a layer of twilight, away from Larrion.
As soon as the "Brass Book" landed, Beverly appeared next to it. Just as she was about to bend down and pick it up, her eyes suddenly narrowed, and she dodged abruptly.
In the next instant, a hazy sword appeared on the ground, piercing upwards, almost hitting Beverly.
Tamara emerged from the ground, holding the sword in one hand. She reached out with her other hand to pick up the "Brass Book."
However, two hazy, illusory doors suddenly appeared in front of her. Tamara's hand passed through the illusory doors, reaching into the spirit world.
Even though the "Brass Book" was right in front of her, it felt as if it were separated by a very, very long distance.
Under a hazy crimson moonlight, Lilith, wearing a court dress and extremely beautiful, appeared in front of the "Brass Book": "It's not Trunsoest who came!"
In Hobert's prediction, Trunsoest would definitely be the first to appear, so he asked Lilith to come specifically to deal with Trunsoest.
…
In the Central Highlands, Philip I transformed into a white, illusory giant. Inside the illusory giant's body were flashing holy codes, abstract regulations, and cases judged using these regulations and codes, along with all the evidence and conclusions presented.
He spoke in a solemn voice: "This is the real world. The power of the non-real world is greatly weakened."
The "Underworld Gate" summoned by the "Pale Empress" immediately became much more illusory. Sia, hiding in the spirit world, was also affected, and the power projected into the real world was limited.
Trunsoest then said: "This is the real world. Philip, transformed into a complete mythical creature, does not conform to the relevant rules of the real world."
Philip I's figure suddenly became very weak: "Trunsoest is dead. His resurrection violates the laws of nature."
Trunsoest immediately felt the rules of the entire world repelling him: "Philip once pledged allegiance to Trunsoest and should be punished for his betrayal!"
A noose suddenly appeared from the illusion, trapping the tall Philip I and subjecting him to hanging.
His escape was once again blocked.
At this time, Sia completely emerged from the spirit world, opening her mouth to utter a silent curse. The tall Philip I immediately turned into a huge rooster.
The "Pale Empress" then reached out to Philip I, and the power of the Underworld tore at his spirit body, making him unable to move for a short time.
Trunsoest seized the opportunity to stab the slender "Sword of Order" into Philip I's chest. When he pulled out the slender sword, he used the power of "Order" and his own affinity for the "Hand of Order" Characteristic to pull out the Beyonder characteristic from Philip I's body.
The former Night Emperor reached out and grabbed, and the "Hand of Order" Beyonder characteristic came into his hand.
The giant rooster that Philip I had transformed into quickly collapsed, turning into illusory chunks of flesh, causing obvious mutations in the surrounding plants and animals.
Trunsoest took a step and quickly left here.
Sia left from the spirit world, the "Pale Empress" entered the "Underworld Gate" and left, leaving only Philip I, who was transforming into an evil spirit, on this battlefield.
…
In the Minsk Mountains, Larrion, the Chief Shepherd of the God of Combat Church, cleaved open the crimson moonlight in front of him with a sword. Then, he thrust the "Sword of Dawn" into the ground, and the giant sword immediately exploded into clusters of orange-red light spots.
Whether it was Lilith, who was about to pick up the "Brass Book," or Tamara, who used the ability of "Connection" to retrieve her arm from the spirit world, they were both within the attack range of the light spots.
Lilith had no choice but to refrain from picking up the "Brass Book" and instead summoned two hazy doors to block the clusters of light spots.
Tamara's legs were still in the ground, so she had no choice but to make the space in front of her chaotic, crushing the light spots flying towards her.
The "Hurricane of Light" not only exploded towards the two enemies but also knocked down Larrion himself.
He was too unlucky; he had actually forgotten to control the direction of the "Hurricane of Light."
At this time, Hobert arrived from the spirit world. Because the Uniqueness had been used for more than twenty seconds, he could not use it again today, so he simply participated in the battle here with a "small account."
Hobert briefly observed the angel battlefield here, and then the "Sword of Disorder" in his hand transformed into the shape of a javelin, raising his hand and throwing it towards Tamara, who had just emerged from the ground.
Tamara immediately used the "Sword of Disorder" in her hand to deflect the "Javelin," but the javelin suddenly exploded after it was inserted into the ground, forming a chaotic area around it.
This affected Tamara's ability. Originally, she wanted to "distort" her position, but instead, the surrounding weeds bloomed into flowers.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Hobert arrived in front of the "Brass Book."
Larrion, who had been seriously injured, gasped for breath, his whole body emitting a twilight glow. He beckoned towards the "Brass Book," and the twilight light covering the "Brass Book" became even brighter, and this Sealed Artifact flew towards Larrion.
However, Larrion was one step too late, and Hobert stepped on the "Brass Book" with his foot. Larrion was really too unlucky; he had been very unsuccessful since the start of the battle.
Tamara, who had broken free from the chaotic space, "distorted" Hobert's two legs into one. The leg he used to step on the "Brass Book" became illusory.
Lilith, who was on the side, had a chance at this time, bending down to pick up the "Brass Book," but above the "Brass Book," it seemed that a layer of transparent copper walls and iron walls suddenly appeared.
Lilith raised her head and saw Sia, who only showed her upper body from the spirit world.
She sneered, opening a small summoning door on Sia's forehead, summoning an illusory shadow from there.
This shadow was in its thirties, wearing clothes in the style of the Southern Continent, looking at the surrounding battlefield with a cold expression.
Sia trembled all over, grabbed the figure, and quickly hid back into the spirit world.
What Lilith summoned just now was the "Rational Sia." Without the rational part, Sia, who was in poor condition, was in danger of losing control.
Taking advantage of the disappearance of the "Spiritual Barrier," Tamara reached out to grab the "Brass Book."
Hobert retaliated in kind, "altering" Tamara's two arms into one, and the arm Tamara used to grab the "Brass Book" immediately disappeared.
At this moment, two bronze doors suddenly appeared on the ground beneath the "Brass Book." It was a small "Underworld Gate," and surprisingly, it could open inward!
However, a beam of silver-white light suddenly struck the "Underworld Gate," destroying the gate summoned by Beyonder power, instantly placing it between reality and illusion. The "Brass Book" did not fall inside.
The silver-white light was Larrion's ability, capable of disrupting all extraordinary powers, rendering the target's abilities ineffective.
Lilith reached out for the third time, but a leather whip suddenly appeared in the void, lashing the "Brass Book" aside.
In the direction where the "Brass Book" fell, two slender hands appeared. Trunsoest was there, about to catch the "Brass Book."
The whip from before was summoned by Him, a punishment for the "Brass Book."
A very strange scene appeared at this moment: Hobert, Lilith, the "Pale Empress," Trunsoest, Tamara, the five Archangels, and "Glory" Larrion were very close to each other, even able to touch each other with a few steps forward.
But they all focused their attention on the "Brass Book," constantly using Beyonder abilities to prevent others from obtaining this Sealed Artifact.
Beverly and Raymond, who were slightly further away, couldn't "get involved."
Just as Trunsoest was about to touch the "Brass Book," His outstretched hand suddenly veered off course, perfectly missing the "Brass Book."
It was a very comical scene; Trunsoest actually failed to grab "Trunsoest's Brass Book."
It turned out that Hobert had "distorted" Trunsoest's sense of direction, turning His forward gesture into a gesture to the left.
At this moment, the Angels noticed that the twilight-colored light enveloping the "Brass Book" suddenly faded.
Everyone was slightly stunned, and after a second or two, that layer of light suddenly disappeared.
Larrion looked towards Backlund with some disbelief. The twilight-colored sky there rapidly receded, and a starry night sky covered the entire sky.
…
On the hills north of Backlund.
Audrey and Fors saw that within that dark "kingdom" filled with moonflowers and night-blooming jasmine, the Twilight Giant's longsword was cleaved onto the heavy, pitch-black scythe, frozen in mid-air.
At this moment, time seemed to stand still. Whether it was the giant draped in decaying armor, bathed in twilight, or the humanoid demon wolf wearing a starry dress, with six arms, they all seemed to become part of an oil painting, standing in place, maintaining their previous postures.
However, a dark brown wooden staff was inserted into the back of the Twilight Giant, frantically drawing the god's life, dragging the opponent back to the earth, back to the mother's embrace.
This dark brown wooden staff was held in the hand of that giant, plump lady, forming an autumn scene with the constantly withering and decaying flowers, grass, and mushrooms on Her body.
The Twilight Giant slowly turned its head, looking at the lady holding a illusory infant in one hand. At this moment, the infant in Her arms actually looked much more solid, seemingly able to see his appearance clearly.
Audrey and Fors, who were watching from afar, were stunned. That infant actually had some resemblance to Hobert!
At this moment, the Twilight Giant let out a painful sound: "Li, Lilith?"
At this time, the Evernight Goddess, wearing a starry dress and having a female human head, chuckled, letting the bird-shaped golden ornament in her hand fly out on its own, accurately inserting it into the gap in the Twilight Giant's mask.
Then, She threw the "Crimson Moon" held in Her other two hands to the plump lady.
In the next second, part of the Twilight Giant's body collapsed, and clusters of orange-red twilight penetrated the peaceful darkness, falling back into the real world.
Some of them fell on the battlefield, causing countless soldiers to die directly. Some crushed mountain peaks, creating a lake that could age all living beings. Some merged with certain lucky creatures, turning them into crazy and powerful monsters. Some enveloped the Twilight Giant Hall outside Saint Millon, causing the solidified orange-red to extinguish instantly.
…
In a small, unnoticed church in the outskirts of Backlund.
A devout priest wearing a simple white robe, with a light golden beard, opened his eyes, revealing a child-like clarity and innocence.
He calmly took out a bottle of golden potion from his arms, unscrewed the lid, and poured the liquid inside into his mouth.
…
On the Angel battlefield in the Minsk Mountains.
As the twilight color sealing the "Brass Book" faded, this Grade 0 Sealed Artifact suddenly opened on its own, and a line of text appeared on the blank page: The Trunsoest Brass Book belongs to the master of the Nation of Disorder; no one else may possess it.
A chilling smile appeared on Hobert's face.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 712: Seizing the Fruits of Victory
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Looking at the "Trunsoest Brass Book" in front of him, even Trunsoest himself was a little speechless. He didn't quite understand when Hobert had caused such serious corruption to the "Brass Book."
But there was no time to think about that now. Trunsoest and Tamara turned and left.
Hobert waved his hand at the "Brass Book," and this Grade 0 Sealed Artifact flew into his hand, obediently flipping open, as if waiting for Hobert to write.
At this moment, he really wanted to laugh out loud. With the "Brass Book" in hand, becoming a Great Old One was just around the corner!
Taking a deep breath, he steadied his mind, ignored Trunsoest, and turned the Brass Book towards Tamara, who had already escaped a short distance with half her body.
When Tamara saw the first line of words that appeared on the "Brass Book" on its own, she ran the fastest.
But when she opened the boundary between the real world and the spirit world, she "coincidentally" encountered the monster summoned by Lilith.
Among everyone present, Lilith was also very happy. The end of the War of the Gods meant that she would soon be promoted to Sequence 1 and become a King of Angels.
Tamara no longer tried to leave from the spirit world, but instead planned to escape a distance first by "distorting" space.
Raymond seized the opportunity to rush over and summoned a ball of flames to block Tamara's path. Beverly also took the opportunity to try to "distort" Tamara's thoughts.
Although she didn't succeed, she bought Hobert enough time.
Hobert's gaze turned to the "Brass Book," and a line of mercury-colored new text appeared on it: A person with very symmetrical facial features does not conform to the aesthetic characteristics of the human body and should be severely punished.
Suddenly, illusory black chains appeared behind Tamara, locking her in place. At the same time, illusory barbed whips appeared behind her, lashing fiercely at Tamara's spine.
But it only lashed twice, because Tamara "distorted" her appearance, making it less symmetrical, so she was no longer punished by the "Brass Book."
But at this time, Hobert and the others had completely surrounded Tamara.
At this moment, two "Underworld Gates" appeared under Tamara's feet. A pair of pale hands grabbed Tamara's feet and instantly disappeared into the underworld.
Hobert "distorted" the positions of the two people, bringing them from the underworld to the real world.
At this time, new words appeared on the "Brass Book": Pale-faced women should not appear in the sun, otherwise their power will be greatly weakened.
The figure of the "Pale Empress" suddenly became illusory. She immediately drew energy from the underworld to avoid becoming weak.
"The wisdom of the Sealed Artifact here is weakening, and the abilities of Beyonders are increasing!" Trunsoest, who had returned, said in a solemn voice.
Seeing Tamara trapped, he immediately rushed back to support her, not because he was so kind, but because he didn't want to see the characteristics within Tamara being taken away by Hobert.
The wisdom of the "Brass Book" was indeed weakening, and it seemed difficult to receive Hobert's requests, instead writing on its own: Anyone taller than 1.9 meters will be severely punished.
The three "Glory's" over there, who were stunned in place by the impact of the God of Combat's fall, were immediately chained by chains from the void and whipped with barbed whips.
Hobert transferred the three tool people, including the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch," and joined forces to attack Trunsoest.
He let Beverly and her brother deal with the "Pale Empress," while Hobert and his mother, Lilith, tried to keep Tamara!
Tamara knew that this was a time of crisis, so she immediately took out her trump card, a crystal ball shaped like an apple. It exploded between Hobert, Lilith, and Tamara, forming a illusory ball of light.
The three angels and the surrounding space became illusory at the same time, enveloped by the ball of light, as if they had become an oil painting with rendering effects, and the three angels were the figures in the oil painting.
Prepared in advance, Tamara reached out and opened a door in the illusion. She immediately returned to the real world and left immediately.
Hobert and Lilith also wanted to leave through that door, but they found that they were temporarily unable to use their Beyonder abilities.
Trunsoest and the "Pale Empress" also took the opportunity to escape.
Until two seconds later, the ball of light shrank, and everything around it returned to its original state. The illusory ball of light turned back into a crystal apple shape, suspended in mid-air.
Hobert took a deep breath. His enemies had finally come together.
Since he failed to keep Tamara, Hobert turned his attention to Larrion over there.
Hobert didn't think much of Tamara's escape. He planned to accommodate the Uniqueness in advance. When he successfully accommodated the Uniqueness, he could completely use the "Nation of Disorder" to find Tamara.
At that time, an King of Angels fighting an Archangel would be able to kill the opponent more easily!
At this time, this "Glory" was covered in wounds because of his bad luck. Although he was a "Warrior," he couldn't withstand so many fatal injuries.
Hobert immediately "magnified" his injuries, and the angel died on the spot.
Although Hobert was Sequence 1, his "magnification" only had a small probability of killing a Sequence 2 angel.
The reason for this result was first because Larrion had already suffered very serious injuries, and secondly because he was too unlucky to encounter something that would only happen with a very small probability.
Hobert reached out and grabbed the "Death Domain of 0-73" from the "Nation of Disorder," using the power of the underworld to send Larrion's spirit to the underworld to prevent him from becoming an evil spirit.
Who knew that as soon as the entrance to the underworld opened, Hant, who had a contract relationship with Hobert, was already waiting there.
Since Hobert became an angel, he basically no longer needed the help of Hant and had not summoned him for a long time.
The last time he summoned him, he asked Hobert to help him retrieve his Beyonder characteristics, which were said to have been taken away by Larrion.
Because he was a Beyonder of the "Death" pathway before Sequence 3, his spirit had not completely died in the underworld.
This battle was very rushed. Hobert didn't have time to summon Hant to witness all this, but he intended to give Larrion's characteristics to Hant.
He didn't intend to care whether Hant's Beyonder characteristics were taken away by Larrion or not. He only cared whether he was willing to be loyal to him.
At this time, when Hobert saw Hant, he believed that Hant really had a deep hatred with Larrion, otherwise it was impossible for him to have been paying attention to Larrion and waiting in the underworld.
When Larrion's spirit saw Hant, he was very surprised: "You, you found your bones?"
Hant laughed: "I didn't expect that you would throw my bones in the 'Mirror World,' hahaha!"
That was a long time ago. When Hobert fought the demons on the west bank of Full Moon Lake, he used a Sealed Artifact to summon a skeleton monster from the "Mirror World," which happened to be Hant's bones!
At this time, Larrion had already been controlled by Hobert with the "Death Domain" and entered the underworld. Hant had a sinister smile on his face: "Come on, come on, let me feel the enthusiasm of the underworld."
As he spoke, strange underworld creatures appeared behind Hant. They had long been salivating over the angel's spirit that had been delivered to their door.
"No." In Larrion's desperate cry, Hobert closed the connection between the underworld and the real world.
The other two "Glorys" had already taken advantage of the time just now to escape. Currently, only Hobert and his own people were left on the battlefield.
Hobert took a deep breath, first dividing the spoils of war and handing the Sealed Artifact that Tamara used to escape to Lilith: "Mother!"
Lilith did not reach out to take it, but smiled and said: "Since when does a mother need a reward for helping her son?"
After saying that, her figure became hazy and disappeared from the real world.
Hobert only realized that Lilith had helped him twice, and he had to show something, but he didn't expect her attitude to be so firm.
Then Hobert said to Beverly and Raymond: "You two played a very big role in today's battle, and I will accumulate corresponding merits for you."
"Currently, your merits have two uses. First, it is the standard for becoming the actual leader of our forces, such as becoming the actual head of the official Beyonders of Highland County and Colon County."
"The second is to obtain the temporary right to use Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, or to completely obtain that Sealed Artifact."
"I will announce the specific merit exchange standards to you two after I am done with my work."
Beverly was very interested in becoming the actual head of the Beyonders, while Raymond was obviously more interested in Sealed Artifacts. These two uses were basically designed specifically for the two siblings by Hobert.
After the two angels left, Hobert took back the three tool people and put all of today's gains into the "Nation of Disorder."
...
The war ended just like that!
If they hadn't seen it with their own eyes and felt it personally, Audrey and Fors would never have believed that it would end like this.
After the deep darkness swallowed the orange-red dusk and then subsided on its own, she saw from a distance that the Beyonders inside Feysac and Intis had fled one after another, and the army with Beyonders as its backbone collapsed uncontrollably.
However, the demigods, mid- and low-sequence Beyonders, and ordinary soldiers on the Loen side did not try to pursue, because they were also very confused, bewildered, and puzzled.
Only the Southern Balam army holding high the flag began to pursue with a clear purpose, some chasing westward and some chasing northward.
Audrey asked Fors to go back first. She wanted to go back to Backlund and take a look.
So Audrey walked directly back into the city and saw the surviving Backlund citizens walking out of the shelters and other places where they could hide themselves, staring blankly at the primeval forest-like scene.
They did not cheer, did not shout, nor did they curse and vent, but were numb in expression and dazed in their eyes, not knowing why the disaster suddenly ended.
Audrey silently examined such a scene and returned all the way to the Empress Borough and back to her villa.
She saw her father, mother, elder brother, butler, male servant, and maid all looking out the window in confusion, their expressions completely consistent with those of the citizens on the street.
For some reason, a sentence suddenly flashed in Audrey's mind: Dying without knowing who caused it, living without knowing why.
In the Southern Balam military headquarters in the western suburbs of Backlund, Medici loudly conveyed orders, methodically dividing the 100,000-strong army and hundreds of Beyonders into three parts.
The first part, consisting of 60,000 soldiers, with 40,000 led by Angus and the "Gale Army", would bypass the Balchis Mountains and trap the Intis army, which was rampaging throughout the western suburbs, within the Balchis Mountains!
The other 20,000 soldiers, under the command of Helen and the 'venom Sting Army", would pursue the Intis army into the Balchis Mountains, using the terrain to encircle hundreds of thousands of troops.
Only Medici would dare to use 60,000 soldiers to besiege 700,000.
The second part, consisting of 40,000 soldiers, would quickly head north, cross the Barchis Pass, and set up a defensive line in the Awwa County, preparing to strike a heavy blow against the Feysac army retreating from the southeast!
This army would be commanded by Malva of the "Blaze Army" and Elliot of the "Dawn Army."
Once these Feysac people retreated, the God of Combat Church would most likely merge with the Church of the Evernight Goddess, which might be the last chance to hunt Beyonders of the "Warrior" pathway.
Even the Einhorn persona, the Feysac royal ancestor within Medici, did not object to this act of kicking someone when they were down.
The third part, Sharron's unit, along with some official Beyonders who were conscripted, would be responsible for picking up the spoils of war after the battle of the gods!
At the instant the God of Combat fell and his corpse landed in the real world, over a hundred thousand soldiers died directly, including a large number of Beyonders.
While the Loen military had not yet reacted, they had to quickly collect these Beyonder characteristics and the Sealed Artifacts formed by chance.
However, this task was very risky, as the flesh and blood of a god could give birth to many monsters, so the "Temperance School", with the highest spirituality, was put in charge of this task.
Sharron's unit had three demigods and two Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, and Sharron herself could apply for Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts from the "Creator" at any time, which was enough to cope with any monsters they might encounter.
There was also a portion of Beyonder power, official Beyonders transferred from the Southern Continent, all demigods and Sequence 5, led by Archibald and Lawrence, ready to support the front lines at any time.
After arranging all this, Medici asked himself in his heart: Did the "Creator" know that the Evernight Goddess would win? Or did Hobert know? This was a pre-judgment of the outcome of the battle of the gods!
A few days ago, when Hobert found Him and, in a closed space, told Him to be ready to pursue the enemy at any time, Medici once thought that Hobert's condition was so bad that he was hallucinating?
But under Hobert's repeated instructions, and knowing that Hobert would not joke about such things, He made a war plan with a skeptical attitude and mobilized for war.
With such preparations, the Southern Balam army and Beyonder troops were able to quickly strike and reap the fruits of victory when the armies of other great powers were in a state of confusion!
Thinking of this, Medici took a deep breath. He rarely admired others in his life. The last person he admired was "Lord." Now, Medici felt that he admired the "Creator" a little.
… …
Hobert first returned to Backlund. Seeing that the Intis and Feysac armies were rapidly collapsing and that the Southern Balam army had begun an orderly pursuit, he returned to his study on Longtail Island, set up a barrier composed of "Order Crystals," and entered the "Nation of Disorder" again.
Seeing the Beyonder characteristics and Sealed Artifacts in front of the "Iron Throne," Hobert took a deep breath. Today's biggest gain was undoubtedly the Uniqueness of the "Justiciar" pathway…
Just as Hobert was counting the spoils of war, a star suddenly emerged from the pool in front of him.
Hobert was stunned. It was the star representing Princess Ethel of the Feynapotter Kingdom. Why did she suddenly pray to the "Creator"?
Covering the star with his spirituality, Hobert saw an astonishing scene. In front of Ethel was a pool of crimson blood, surrounded by large chunks of wriggling bones and muscles, and Philip I, his face distorted in pain, was losing his sanity and transforming into an evil spirit.
All the creatures around him had undergone certain mutations. Some had turned into grotesque monsters.
Some had bloomed into flowers with perfectly symmetrical left and right sides, or perfectly regular three-dimensional patterns.
Others had leaves that had turned into sheets of white paper, on which were recorded articles of regulations or writing.
Chester Castiya, another angel of the Feynapotter Kingdom, was using the ability of "Imprisonment" to control the spirit body of Philip I, but it was clear that he was about to lose control.
Combining Ethel's simple report, Hobert understood that Trunsoest had first killed Philip I before seizing the characteristic.
This made him unable to help but sigh: Fortunately, he had corrupted the "Brass Book" before, otherwise it was unknown whether he could have seized this Sealed Artifact today.
It was not surprising that Tamara could cooperate with Trunsoest, as they both had a common enemy.
It was also expected that Suah would come to help, as Trunsoest had helped this "Abomination" before.
But that the "Pale Empress" would take action was somewhat beyond Hobert's expectations. A while ago, the Southern Balam Duchy had just established diplomatic relations with the Balam Empire, and they were now discussing the exchange of ambassadors.
As a result, the "Pale Empress" made such a move!
Thinking slightly in this direction, Hobert seriously listened to Ethel's request. She hoped to get the help of the "Creator" to preserve Philip I's sanity.
Hobert roughly understood that Philip I should have prepared some arrangements for his resurrection, but the problem was that his spirit body was currently transforming into an evil spirit, making it difficult for him to use his previous arrangements.
He pondered for a moment. Of course, he had to help with this kind of thing. If handled properly, the Feynapotter royal family, with only one angel left, might lean towards the Southern Balam Duchy.
As for why she prayed to the "Creator" instead of the Earth Mother, it was not difficult to understand, as the Earth Mother was quite busy at the moment.
So Hobert, holding the "0-73" Death Domain, descended his power through Ethel's star.
He first "used" Chester's "Imprisonment" to lift the closure on Philip I's spirit body, and then deepened the connection between Philip I and the real world. The distorted expression on his face immediately calmed down a lot.
Then the "Creator" "tampered" with the state of Philip I's spirit body, allowing his spirit body to exist independently in the real world for a period of time without being affected.
The painful expression on Philip I's face disappeared, and he returned to an aura similar to usual, except that he did not look as kind as usual.
Seeing that Philip I had regained his sanity, the "Creator" withdrew his power and put the unused "Death Domain" back.
Carrying this Sealed Artifact was originally to prevent himself from achieving the desired effect on the spirit body, and to use its power.
Hobert did not care how Philip I would resurrect, but continued to look at the spoils of war he had obtained in this battle.
The Uniqueness of the "Justiciar" pathway definitely could not be called "Trunsoest Brass Book" anymore. Hobert first gave it the number "0-80" and named the "Brass Book" the Book of Law.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert went to check the other Sealed Artifacts. The Beyonder characteristic of the "Knowledge Emperor" was more like a Sealed Artifact. The negative effect was that it was easy to fall into self-intoxication and easily become interested in noble women.
Hobert could not help but laugh: This Beyonder characteristic must have come from "Old Huang", and there were even some of his mental remnants! The only thing missing might be "easily becoming interested in witches."
Then, Hobert named it "0-81" Knowledge Crown.
The third Sealed Artifact was the Sealed Artifact that Tamara threw out to escape. This Sealed Artifact was aligned with the Sequence 2 "Knowledge Magister" of the "Savant" pathway.
Hobert named it "0-82" Crystal Light Screen. The ability of this Sealed Artifact was relatively simple. It could absorb the target from reality into a virtual light screen and temporarily lose its Beyonder ability.
Even the holder would be absorbed, and when there were other people in the "Virtual Light Screen", the holder could not recover this Sealed Artifact.
This was a bit of a pitfall, because the holder could not attack the absorbed target either, and could only wait for the other party to come out and continue fighting. It was only useful when escaping.
The last spoil of war was the Beyonder characteristic of the "Glory". Hobert planned to summon Hant later, have a good talk with him, and then decide where this Beyonder characteristic would go.
After reading the spoils of war, Hobert habitually began to review.
First of all, he was still surprised by the "Pale Empress's" team. If he knew that she would help Trunsoest, then when participating in the battle of the Minerminsk Mountains, he would definitely have appeared as the "Creator."
Although the "Creator" was not as flexible as Hobert, at least his status was there.
It had to be said that the "Pale Empress's" unannounced turn to his enemy forced Hobert to adjust his future plans.
Before, it was enough to be wary of the Balam Empire, but now he had to treat this Southern Continent country as an enemy.
The second point that Hobert did not expect was that Trunsoest would prioritize seizing a characteristic of the "Hand of Order."
However, thinking about it carefully, it was not so surprising, after all, in the eyes of the outside world, the strength of the "Creator" was also very strong. Even if the four archangels joined forces, they were not confident that they could definitely seize the "0-80" Book of Law.
But killing Philip I unexpectedly was not a problem at all.
Thinking of this, Hobert took a deep breath and felt the pressure again, because Trunsoest should soon be able to become a King of Angels.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 713: The First Tarot Meeting After the War
chapters.content:
