Hobert planned to find an opportunity to accommodate the Uniqueness ahead of time after the end of the War of the Gods, and then take the opportunity to kill Tamara. He wanted to stabilize his state first, and then consider becoming a god.
This was based on the consideration of Klein's process of becoming a god. Klein's process from Sequence 1 to becoming half an Outer God was too fast, which largely led to his unstable state.
Hobert believed that if he could reach a certain degree of "reconciliation" with the Uniqueness in advance, it would be of great help in maintaining his state after becoming a god.
But now, Trunsoest was likely to become the King of Angels before him. Thinking of this, Hobert smiled helplessly, lamenting that the competition in the extraordinary world was too fierce.
Just as he was about to leave the "Nation of Disorder", Princess Ethel prayed to express her gratitude. Hobert saw that Philip I indeed had a new body and had already reached the level of Sequence 3. At this time, he was gathering his spirituality and maintaining his state.
Hobert didn't intend to interfere in this matter for the time being. As an angel who had lived for one or two thousand years, especially with the support of secular power, Philip I must have some means of resurrection.
He returned to the real world, to his office on Longtail Island.
First, he dispelled the barrier formed by the "Order Crystal". Hobert pondered for a moment before uttering the incantation in ancient Hermes: "Knight!"
Hant, whose eyes looked strange, came from the underworld to Hobert: "Thank you for letting me avenge myself."
"It's nothing," Hobert said with a smile. "I invited you here to ask if I gave you a portion of the 'Silver Knight's' characteristic, could you immediately become a Sequence 3?"
"Yes," Hant replied. "I performed the relevant rituals a long time ago. If I can have a portion of the 'Silver Knight's' characteristic, I can completely restore my state and return to the real world."
Hobert nodded: "You also know that this level of Beyonder characteristics is not something that can be given at will. I need you to pledge allegiance to me and become a member who will always support me."
Then he leaned back in his chair and asked with a smile, "Have you heard of the 'Creator'?"
The expressionless Hant said: "Before I came, I had already learned something about it and knew how powerful the 'Creator's' power is."
Then he said seriously: "I am willing to pledge allegiance to you and be forever loyal to your commands."
So Hobert got up and came to Hant. The tall knight knelt on one knee and swore allegiance.
After completing the allegiance ceremony, Hobert first said: "The god I am following already has his own kingdom, and many angels have already pledged allegiance to him."
"If you are good enough, you will also become one of the angels who are loyal to him in the future."
Overall, Hobert had fought side by side with Hant a few times and had a basic trust in him.
However, the benefits that should be promised must be promised in advance. Compared to trust, he believes more in the involvement of interests.
Then Hobert began to inquire about Hant's situation.
It turned out that Hant's family used the war of the Fourth Epoch to obtain the demigod-level potion formulas of the "Death" and "Twilight Giant" pathways, and were nobles that existed in the early days of the Loen Kingdom.
Hant's death was because in the early Fifth Epoch, by chance, he obtained a Sealed Artifact comparable to a "Glory".
This guy was also too arrogant at the time. He didn't ask for help from the Loen royal family. He planned to secretly become an angel himself, and then use his territory to become an independent country.
As a result, when he was promoted to angel, he was detected by the Church of the God of Combat. Larrion led the team and secretly eliminated Hant's entire family.
Hant was once an "Undying", and with the qualitative change of his spirit during the advancement process, he was able to survive to this day.
When Larrion discovered that Hant's spirit had escaped, he stuffed Hant's bones into the "Mirror World" to prevent him from using the power of the "Death" pathway to return to the real world.
Hobert thought to himself: This is still an ambitious person.
Then he thought again: Hant's situation is relatively special, so he can only temporarily return to the level of Sequence 3. If he wants to continue to advance, he must re-prepare the ritual to become an angel.
Of course, Hobert didn't intend to let this guy become an angel for the time being. He had to observe for a while before making a decision.
But currently, due to the need for high-end combat power, he can let the other party become Sequence 3 first.
As for whether the other party is an ambitious person, it doesn't matter to Hobert. The key is controllability.
He believes that Hant can understand from his previous experience that sometimes the opportunity to become an angel is a complete disaster.
If there is a strong backing, this is really an opportunity.
Hobert finally said: "Go back and prepare. Tomorrow I will give you the 'Silver Knight's' characteristic, and then you will go to Intis and protect the factory there with the angel I sent."
What Hobert was considering after returning to the real world was where to arrange Hant first.
Hobert planned to arrange Beverly and Raymond in Intis after the war to protect the interests of "Earl's Light" there and deter the Intis Republic.
It just so happened that Beverly could observe Hant.
After Hant left, Hobert went to find Fors, who had returned earlier.
At this time, Fors was lying on the armchair in the bedroom in a daze. After seeing Hobert, she immediately got up: "I still find it incredible now that a War of the Gods has changed the course of the war."
"It not only changed the course of the war," Hobert said with a smile, "but also changed the world pattern."
He sat next to Fors, crossed his legs and said, "South Balam has risen!"
… …
The second day after the end of the War of the Gods, the northern mountainous area of ​​Backlund.
Sharron's troops had basically picked up the Beyonder characteristics scattered in this area. Although some battles occurred and casualties occurred.
But in terms of the spoils obtained, that little casualty was nothing at all.
Sharron's spirituality felt that there was a huge trophy in the mountains. She had observed that direction in the spirit world and could not even see the specific situation there.
But her spirituality clearly felt that there was a powerful force there. She even suspected that there might be a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact there!
So she only took another demigod, each holding a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, and went to the mountains early this morning to find the trophy.
Because the trophy caused serious distortion in the spirit world, they did not dare to approach it through the spirit world or the "Mirror World", but carefully approached it using the "Mirror Jump" method.
Still far away from there, Sharron felt that the speed of her spirituality loss was a bit abnormal. She and her companion returned to the real world from a drop of dew and observed carefully again before continuing forward.
They continued to move forward while observing. After more than two hours, they finally approached their destination.
They climbed a mountain and saw the scene on the other side of the mountain.
It turned out to be a huge lake with a twilight-colored glow!
This was the essence of the blood and "Twilight Giant" authority sprayed when the God of Combat fell, forming a lake that could age all creatures.
It was clearly morning now, but around the lake, it was a twilight scene, as if this was a unique twilight in the middle of the mountains.
The surrounding trees had long since withered and rotted. Sharron and her companion clearly felt that they were aging rapidly, so they entered the "Wraith State".
Although they could still feel themselves gradually entering the twilight of their lives, they would not feel obvious aging.
After looking at the lake in front of them again, the two discussed what to do now?
If it was a Sealed Artifact, they could still try to seal it, but what should they do with a lake?
Sharron was about to pray to the "Creator" to ask for the revelation of the gods when she saw the space on the hillside suddenly become illusory, and Hobert came out of the void.
He first looked at the lake for a second or two, then waved his hand to Sharron and the others, indicating that he would solve the problem here.
But Sharron and her companion did not leave. They wanted to see how Hobert would "deal with" this lake.
Hobert stretched out his hand to "scoop" into the void, and there was a golden scepter in his hand.
He held the scepter high, and the head of the staff emitted a dazzling light, as if a small sun had fallen into the valley.
Hobert stepped forward, and the light of the scepter "peeled away" the twilight in the valley, which prevented him from being disturbed by the lake in any way.
Sharron and her companion saw a spectacle. The blazing sunlight was moving forward little by little, like a stone moving forward little by little in a stream, causing the twilight-colored "water" to separate from left to right.
The blazing sun and twilight intertwined, forming beautiful colors, making Hobert's backward figure become sacred, tall, and firm.
It seemed to form a picture full of epic sense.
Soon, Hobert came to the lake.
Whirr ~
Under the cohesion of a surging force, the lake water formed a twilight-colored giant figure. The giant's face could not be seen clearly, only its huge vertical pupils could be seen.
Ah ~
The giant opened its mouth and made an unwilling howl.
Whoosh ~
A gust of wind blew from the lake to the surroundings, and the decayed trees were broken and rolled up, blowing away.
Sharron and her companion's first thought was to leave quickly, but their body and mind, spirit, and spirit were all shocked by the surging power, and they stood there, unable to use Beyonder abilities!
Just as the gust of wind and trees were approaching, and they were preparing to withstand the impact of this surging power, their spirituality felt that the front suddenly became "chaotic", whether it was the amazing power or those trees, they all scattered in front of them.
Sharron breathed a sigh of relief, knowing that Hobert had saved them. Otherwise, being hit by this surging power, even as demigods with exceptionally solid spirit bodies for their pathway, they would have suffered serious injuries.
Just as they were about to leave, not wanting to cause Hobert any trouble, they happened to see the giant formed of lake water holding a twilight-colored greatsword, cleaving it towards Hobert.
Hobert held up a scepter in one hand, and a black longsword appeared in his other hand, deftly blocking the greatsword.
Compared to the twilight-colored greatsword, the black longsword looked like a small toy, the difference between it and a broadsword!
But the longsword was indeed able to block the greatsword.
Sharron and her companion watched with rapt attention, forgetting to leave for a moment.
At this moment, an arm suddenly sprouted from Hobert's armpit, like a bud bursting forth from a branch. He had transformed into three arms in an instant!
The third arm reached into the void and grabbed a crown with a black gemstone, placing it on Hobert's head.
In the next instant, Hobert also emanated a surging power. He continued to block the giant's attacks with the longsword in his hand, while the scepter in his other hand suddenly lengthened.
Hobert thrust the scepter, shaped like a javelin, into the giant's calf, immediately forming a massive vortex of power there. The lake visibly shrank.
Ah~
In the unwilling roar of the giant composed of lake water, the giant and the lake water were sucked into the scepter without a single drop remaining.
The scepter showed no signs of swelling, but instead transformed from its original pure gold color into an alternating pattern of orange and gold!
Everything around returned to normal. There was no twilight-colored lake water, no twilight in the mountains, and no giant composed of twilight-colored lake water.
The decaying scene within sight also became like a normal winter, with withered yellow everywhere.
Only the decaying tree stumps marked the previous anomaly.
The scepter in Hobert's hand no longer emitted intense sunlight. He slightly shook the scepter, and it immediately transformed into an exaggeratedly large twilight-colored greatsword!
Then, with another shake, the greatsword returned to its normal size, and its color became silver-white.
Hobert had obtained the power of the "Twilight Giant" essence!
Just now, he used the uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway to "tamper" with the "Sun Scepter," allowing it to gain the power of two pathways instead of one.
Thus, the "Sun Scepter" became the "Twilight Scepter."
Sharron saw Hobert wave to her and her companion with a bright smile, and then enter the spirit world and leave.
Only then did they come back to their senses. Hobert had obtained a portion of the God of Combat's power, even if it was a very small amount, it was still power from a god!
Immediately afterward, they realized that since this lake had been "taken away" by Hobert, then the task given to them by the Marshal had also been completed.
...
In the following days, Loen, Intis, and Feysac all suddenly became bewildered due to the great changes, and even their command systems experienced brief failures.
The Feynapotter Kingdom, on the other hand, became exceptionally cautious because Philip I had lost his status as a Great Angel.
Currently, only the Southern Balam army in the Northern Continent was fighting with a clear plan. On the Western Front, after Medici repeatedly adjusted his deployments, 60,000 men actually encircled more than 700,000 people!
It was indeed more than 700,000 people, but not an army of 700,000. Because their morale collapsed instantly, there was no command to speak of. Many people immediately surrendered to the Southern Balam army blocking their path.
Many people had even lost their weapons, and many others burst into tears upon seeing the Southern Balam army.
The Southern Balam army began a frenzy of capturing prisoners. In five days, 60,000 people actually captured more than 300,000 prisoners!
Sometimes, a single soldier would be watching over hundreds of prisoners. Eight teleportation arrays were urgently built, but they couldn't even send the prisoners to the Southern Continent in time.
However, the Balchis Mountains were too large. The Intis people, now fleeing in panic, bypassed the west side and escaped from the north and south sides of the Balchis Mountains.
A large number of soldiers died in the mouths of wild beasts, a large number of soldiers collapsed from hunger and cold, and many others got lost.
Even more than a year later, several Intis soldiers, dressed in rags, with messy and long hair and beards, like savages, would occasionally emerge from the Balchis Mountains.
Only after leaving the Balchis Mountains could the Intis soldiers more easily snatch food on the vast Tucker Plain. They robbed their way back to Intis like a gang of bandits.
It is said that fewer than 200,000 deserters returned to the Intis Republic!
Almost none of these 200,000 people were Beyonders. All the Beyonders in the Balchis Mountains were systematically hunted down by the Southern Balam's Beyonder forces. Few escaped the net.
The battle on the Northern Front was very fierce. The more than 400,000 Feysac soldiers retreating were met head-on by the Southern Balam army, which had prepared its positions in advance.
But after all, they were the "Fighting Nation." The defeated Feysac army was still able to maintain a certain degree of command ability, but their cannons had been abandoned in eastern Backlund.
Without heavy weapons, their charge was more like an explanation that heavy machine guns were the "King of the Battlefield!" No one could break through the firepower network composed of heavy machine guns.
Beyonders were no exception. The Southern Balam army also had Beyonders on their side, with a clear division of labor and orderly command, repeatedly defeating the attacks of the Feysac army's Beyonders.
The Feysac army had no choice but to abandon the plan to retreat from the southern shore of the Inland Sea, and instead retreated from the eastern front, avoiding the Awwa County.
Thus, a great pursuit began. In this blocking and pursuit battle, the Southern Balam army killed more than 30,000 enemy troops and captured more than 30,000 prisoners.
But because the Feysac army still had a certain degree of command ability, their more than 300,000 main forces, with basic organization, drilled into the Minsk Mountains.
At this time, a cold wave and a heavy snowfall saved the Feysac Empire's more than 300,000 main forces!
Marching and fighting in the ice and snow were the strengths of the Feysac army, and some of the Southern Balam army even came from the tropical Longtail Island. In such weather, they simply could not catch up with the Feysac army, and finally had to give up the pursuit.
However, the Southern Balam army only withdrew to Backlund and did not immediately return home.
At this point, the year-long World War finally came to an end.
The higher-ups of the other four countries gradually learned of the results of the battle of the gods. The Seven Gods had become Six Gods!
Immediately afterward, Loen began to recover lost territory, and Feysac and Intis began to receive their defeated troops.
At the same time, in Trier, the capital of Intis, the parliament issued an order to confiscate all the property of "Radiant Sunlight" (the company name of Earl's Light in the Intis Republic).
Not long after this order was issued, Beverly and her younger brother, wearing the same style of circular jade pendants, appeared in the seats of the parliament building.
Beverly asked the parliamentarians who had not yet dispersed: "I heard that you are going to illegally confiscate our property?"
The angels of the Intis military and the churches rushed over one after another, but the angels of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church and the Church of Steam and Machinery received divine decrees one after another, and they withdrew just like that.
The battle of the gods had ended. From the four-on-three advantage they had before the war, the Eternal Blazing Sun, the God of Steam, the God of Combat, and the Earth Mother against the Evernight Goddess, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
It had become the current two-on-four disadvantage, the Eternal Blazing Sun and the God of Steam against the Evernight Goddess, the Lord of Storms, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, and the Earth Mother.
Under such circumstances, they were unwilling to start any battles.
The parliamentarians of the Intis Republic finally realized the consequences of the battle of the gods, and had no choice but to withdraw the issued order. The interests of "Earl's Light" in Intis were preserved.
...
In the blink of an eye, it was Monday. In the ancient palace above the gray fog, the Tarot Club members appeared at the same time, neatly greeting Mr. Fool.
Klein looked around and suddenly felt a little emotional: "The Hanged Man" used this war to become a Cardinal Archbishop of the Storm Church, in charge of the Rorsted Archipelago Diocese.
"Miss Justice," although temporarily out of contact with the Psychology Alchemists, also has the qualifications to become a councilor. Her other identity as the wife of the Duke of Southern Balam has also brought her considerable power.
"The Sun" is an elder of the City of Silver's "Seven-Member Council"; "The Moon" is a Sanguine earl; "The Star" is a high-level deacon of the Nighthawks of the Church of the Evernight Goddess; "The Hermit" is a hidden king of the sea, one of the ten pillars of the Moses Ascetic Order.
Currently, the Tarot Club's highest sequence is "The Emperor" Hobert, who has actually reached Sequence 1 and has established his own country and a huge force.
After the exploration of the Giant King's Court ended, Klein increasingly felt that this guy should be similar to his own situation: Hobert is "The Creator"!
It's just that Klein doesn't intend to expose him now, because while exposing Hobert, it is easy for Hobert to realize that "The Fool's" situation may be similar to "The Creator's."
Klein took a deep breath. The Tarot Club members in front of him, except for "The Magician," were all demigods and angels, high-level figures in different forces in the mystical world.
The reason why "The Magician" has not become a demigod is because the previous war left her no time to advance. According to what Klein learned from the Abraham family, she actually has all the conditions to become a demigod.
The Beyonder characteristics had long been prepared for her by Hobert, and the rituals and auxiliary Ingredients were provided by the Abraham family.
That is to say, as long as "The Magician" digests the "Traveler" potion, she can complete the advancement.
While "Justice" Audrey greeted the other members, "The Fool" Klein, shrouded in gray-white fog, quickly withdrew his gaze and smiled self-deprecatingly in his heart:
Finally, it feels like a high-end, secretive organization. However, I always get the feeling that this is a negotiation meeting for various major forces…
At this moment, Audrey finished her greeting, and "The Fool" then nodded slightly to the Tarot Club members and said, "Let's begin."
"The Hanged Man" Alger heard Mr. Fool's voice, and his heart trembled inexplicably. He suddenly felt like he was praying to the "Lord of Storms" on Pasu Island.
This was a spiritual experience. Alger couldn't accurately describe it in words, but he just felt that the body wrapped in that layer of white mist contained thousands or tens of thousands of times the terror of the past. A seemingly ordinary sentence or a simple action could give people absolute suppression in terms of Sefirah.
At this time, Alger was very sure: Mr. Fool has further revived! "The World" went to the Forsaken Land of the Gods, and after bringing out City of Silver, Mr. Fool further revived.
Alger had this feeling several times before, but he was never sure. Just now, his spirituality gave him an accurate feeling.
"The Star" Leonard looked around and, seeing that the other members remained silent, tentatively opened his mouth and said:
"According to the information currently collected, a war of the gods did indeed occur previously. Among them, it is certain that 'The Evernight Goddess,' 'The God of Combat,' and 'The Earth Mother' appeared in the sky above Backlund.
"As for the result, I think everyone is very clear. What are your thoughts on this?"
"The Hermit" Cattleya did not hide her doubts: "I cannot understand why such a result would occur. 'The Earth Mother' and 'The God of Combat,' this mother and son joining forces, were actually defeated by 'The Evernight Goddess.'"
"The Magician" Fors, who had seen the course of the war of the gods from afar, said: "As far as I know, during the war of the gods, 'The Earth Mother' ambushed 'The God of Combat,' which led to the fall of 'The God of Combat.'"
The other members were very surprised. Leonard couldn't help but ask: "May I ask where your information comes from…"
"I witnessed the war of the gods with my own eyes," Fors said, "Under the protection of the gods."
In her opinion, the barrier formed by the "Order Crystal" was the "Creator's" protection for them.
This shocked the other members once again!
That was a war of the gods!
"The Magician" actually witnessed the war of the gods!
After the surprise, Alger pondered and said: "I received a piece of information that Feynapotter betrayed the alliance immediately after the war of the gods ended."
Klein behind the gray fog was slightly stunned: This operation is so familiar!
Then He realized: It can be seen that "The Earth Mother's" betrayal of "The God of Combat" was not a temporary idea! But why did such a betrayal happen?
At this time, Klein noticed that from the beginning of this topic until now, Hobert's expression had been very serious.
Klein thought to himself: He must know something.
Just then, "The Sun" Derrick raised his arm and said, "I probably know why."
As an elder of the council, Derrick had learned the secret of the divine sealed artifact in City of Silver.
"You?" "The Moon" Emlyn questioned.
After all, "The Sun" had just left the Forsaken Land of the Gods, how could he know more details about the war of the gods than everyone present?
"The Hanged Man" Alger, who knew that "Little Sun" was always honest, suppressed his curiosity and a little excitement from the bottom of his heart, and asked in a low voice, "Why?"
Derrick first looked at "The Emperor", then looked around, and said in a deep voice: "You must promise in front of Mr. Fool that you will not reveal what I am about to tell you."
Mr. Emperor asked City of Silver not to spread the secret about the divine sealed artifact. At that time, Derrick didn't quite understand why.
Now he probably knew Mr. Emperor's concerns. He had just glanced at Mr. Emperor to make sure that He didn't intend to stop him. Derrick then decided to announce this secret at the Tarot Club.
"No problem," Cattleya took the lead and said.
After everyone made a promise under the witness of "The Fool", Derrick nodded and said: "We once confirmed in a previous gathering that 'The Earth Mother' was the giant king's queen, Omebella. This information is incorrect."
That was when Derrick and the others first explored the "Giant King's Court" and announced the true name of the Earth Mother to everyone.
Later, in a certain gathering, "The Hermit" found a very reliable piece of information from ancient books: The giant king's queen was called Omebella!
At that time, everyone was very excited and found the source of another god.
From that time on, everyone knew that the "Giant King's" queen was the later Earth Mother.
Hobert, who also participated in that gathering, breathed a sigh of relief. At a Tarot Club meeting not long after Emlyn joined the Tarot Club, he once traded information about Lilith's fall.
At that time, in order to avoid bringing some uncontrollable butterfly effect, Hobert only told everyone that it was the "Giant King's" subsidiary god, "The Goddess of Harvest", who betrayed the "Sanguine Ancestor", Lilith.
At that time, he neither said the true name of this "Goddess of Harvest" nor said that she was the "Giant King's" queen.
The breath Hobert released was a sigh of relief, feeling that he had fortunately concealed something at the time. If Emlyn knew that the "Sanguine Ancestor" was killed by the "Earth Mother", this servant of the Earth Mother Church, who was already a Sanguine earl, would definitely do something unexpected.
Thinking of this, Hobert retracted his thoughts and continued to listen to "Little Sun" say: "'The Earth Mother' is not the giant queen Omebella. The real Omebella is dead, and her remains are in City of Silver."
This news was like a bomb, falling on the scene of the Tarot Club, causing all members except Hobert, Klein, and Derrick to feel a "spiritual storm".
After a long while, Leonard asked in an unbelievable tone: "Are you sure?"
As soon as he finished speaking, he began to regret asking such a question. Since City of Silver had the remains of the giant queen Omebella, it meant that the credibility of this matter was very high.
Audrey, Alger, and others all subconsciously turned their eyes to Mr. Fool at the head of the mottled long table. Mr. Fool, who had received the report from the chief of City of Silver in advance, smiled and maintained his sitting posture without any change.
This indirectly showed that He recognized the information provided by "Little Sun" just now.
Audrey said before "The Sun" answered "The Star's" question just now: "This can explain many things, but if 'The Earth Mother' is not the giant queen, then why would the 'Angel of Fate' think that was Omebella when painting the mural of the founding of 'The Rose Redemption'?
"The key is, the key is why 'The God of Combat' would want to cooperate with Her? Who exactly is She?"
Cattleya thought for a moment and said: "Perhaps that Earth Mother has been pretending to be Omebella and has deceived the 'Angel of Fate' and 'God of Combat'."
Alger retorted: "How is that possible? 'The Earth Mother,' no, I mean the giant queen and the 'God of Combat' are… are mother and son!"
Fors took a breath and said: "What a terrifying story."
At this time, "The World", who had been silent, spoke: "Nothing is impossible!
"What if 'The Evernight Goddess' and other gods helped with this concealment?"
Everyone suddenly remembered some information that they had traded with The Emperor before.
At this time, Hobert smiled and said: "Regarding this matter, I do know some definite information."
Everyone immediately looked at "The Emperor" with eager eyes.
Only Klein was a little strange while looking at Hobert: If Hobert is the "Creator", where did He get so much secret information? Isn't the "Nation of Disorder" full of information about ancient times? Then Hobert is more suitable to be an "Scholar of Yore"!
Hobert continued: "Everyone should still remember that I once said that it was 'The Goddess of Harvest', a subsidiary god of the 'Giant King', who betrayed the ancient god Lilith, which led to Lilith's fall, right?"
Of course, everyone remembered this, especially Emlyn, who, after receiving this news, searched everywhere for clues about the "Goddess of Harvest".
However, he couldn't find any relevant information about the "Goddess of Harvest" in the ancient records of the Sanguine!
"The name of 'The Goddess of Harvest' is Omebella!" Hobert announced another shocking piece of news: "The ancient god Lilith, with the help of the 'Evernight Goddess' and 'Ancient Sun God', replaced Omebella!"
After a brief shock, "Little Sun" was the first to react: "The divine sealed artifact in City of Silver is the remains of the giant queen, and the Earth Mother has always been the ancient god Lilith?"
At this time, Emlyn suddenly stood up in surprise and pointed at "The Emperor" Hobert: "Then you… you are… the Son of God!"
This was the third surprising piece of news at this gathering!
After a brief silence, Alger asked: "What do you mean?"
Audrey and Fors exchanged glances. They recalled the illusory baby in the arms of "The Earth Mother" that they saw at the end of the war of the gods, which had become somewhat like Hobert.
At that time, they thought it was an illusion!
At this time, Emlyn seemed to suddenly realize that he had misspoke. He said somewhat uneasily: "That… Your Excellency, can I say it?"
Everyone could feel Emlyn's respect for Hobert.
Audrey thought for a while. "The Moon" seemed to have been looking at Hobert strangely for some time before.
Moreover, this Sanguine earl had rarely spoken to Hobert recently, giving people the feeling that he knew some big secret.
Hobert smiled and said: "The war of the gods is over, there is no need to hide it anymore."
Eamonn calmed down slightly before saying to everyone, "The news I'm about to announce, everyone must keep secret... But actually, there's no need to keep it secret now... No, no, no, we still need to keep it secret. Your Excellency Olmer once instructed us to keep it a secret..."
Mr. Moon was somewhat incoherent. He took a few more deep breaths before saying, "... That secret is that His Majesty the Emperor is the child of the Ancestor!"
"If our Ancestor is the Earth Mother, then, then isn't His Majesty the Emperor the Divine Child of the Earth Mother?"
The huge hall fell silent again. This time, everyone's shock was unprecedented!
Even 'The Fool' almost blurted out to Hobert: Really?
Immediately after, 'The Fool' Klein quickly understood: No wonder this guy knows so many ancient secrets. So He... Right, what era is Hobert from anyway?
Klein refrained from asking, but Audrey did ask, "Your Majesty the Emperor, is this true?"
This time, Audrey didn't blame Hobert. If she had such a background, of course, she would keep it a secret when it wasn't appropriate to reveal it.
"Yes," Hobert said, "There's no need to hide it from the outside world now. My birth mother is indeed the Sanguine Ancestor.
"This matter is very complicated, and I also need to keep it a secret for Her, so there is very little information that can be made public.
"Everyone just needs to know that currently, the Earth Mother and the Sanguine Ancestor are similar to the state of the Ancient Sun God and the 'Dark Angel'."
Klein manipulated 'The World' to ask, "Then are you a modern person? Or an ancient person?"
Hobert replied, "A modern person."
Klein nodded and didn't continue with this question.
Alger then suddenly had a Blink of inspiration: Could the 'Emperor's' father be the 'Creator'? It's not impossible. Both the 'Creator' and the Sanguine Ancestor are ancient gods!
Hobert gave everyone a few more seconds to be surprised before saying, "Information about the War of the Gods of the Second Epoch can be disclosed in the Tarot Club.
"Now, let's sort out this matter together. After the Sanguine Ancestor encountered Omebella's betrayal, She fell in the War of the Gods. Fortunately, She had made some arrangements in advance, and Her consciousness and spirit body did not perish.
"Everyone should remember that I said in a previous transaction that the Goddess of Misfortune, who later became the Evernight Goddess, took away the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics of Her own pathway.
"At that time, She also took away the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway..."
Hobert believed that before that War of the Gods, the Evernight Goddess and the Sanguine Ancestor should have known each other and had a plan.
The specific content of the plan is unknown, but the Sanguine Ancestor at that time planned to use the opportunity of dying once to become a True God with only the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics of the 'Mother' pathway in Her body, in order to try to approach the 'Brood Hive'.
The "Devil Monarch" Farbauti once said that gods cannot commit suicide, so the Sanguine Ancestor could only use other ancient gods to help Herself.
At that time, the relatively crazy 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf', which had two non-adjacent pathways in its body, was a good choice.
After the Evernight Goddess noticed the Sanguine Ancestor's intention, She would of course seize this opportunity to obtain the characteristics and Uniqueness She needed.
So the two hit it off!
But in the extraordinary world, accidents are always unpredictable.
Before the Sanguine Ancestor was ready, Omebella's betrayal caused Her to fall.
After the Evernight Goddess picked up the characteristics and Uniqueness She needed, She also helped the Sanguine Ancestor pick up the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway.
Otherwise, the Evernight Goddess should have been able to pick up the Uniqueness of the 'Fool' pathway more easily at that time, but She ignored it and allowed Antigonus to 'absorb' this Uniqueness, choosing the Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway from afar.
If They had contact before, and the Evernight Goddess had a certain understanding of the Sanguine Ancestor's plan, this would be reasonable.
Hobert continued, "Before the Evernight Goddess became a god, She should have helped the Sanguine Ancestor hide Her tracks, and finally, when the time was right, She asked the 'Ancient Sun God' to steal Omebella's destiny!"

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 714 The Dark History of the God of Combat
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
After hearing Hobert's words, Derrick, "The Sun," was initially a bit confused. How did "The Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord" steal Omebella's fate?
But then he thought for a moment and understood: The Blasphemer Amon was the child of the Ancient Sun God. It is said that Amon was born with the Uniqueness of the "Error" pathway. As everyone guessed in a previous transaction, that should be the Ancient Sun God expelling Beyonder characteristics to stabilize his state by having children.
Other members also understood the meaning of "The Emperor" after a moment of consideration.
Immediately afterward, they suddenly had a very clear understanding of the difference in level between Uniqueness and Angels.
In front of the holder of Uniqueness, even an Angel's fate could be stolen! And even Omebella's relatives didn't notice!
After that, without Hobert's explanation, everyone could understand that Lilith, after obtaining Omebella's fate, existed in this world as the Giant Queen. Later, she even became the Earth Mother, and only actively exposed herself during the War of the Gods in the Fifth Epoch, which is now!
Of course, this must be because the Evernight Goddess helped to keep it secret using the power of "Concealment," so no one noticed this.
Thinking of this, Alger, "The Hanged Man," had a slightly solidified gaze: A conspiracy lasting two to three thousand years!
He instinctively shrank his body, feeling a fear of the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother that originated from his soul.
Others had similar feelings. Leonard, "The Star," said belatedly: "No wonder the Church of the Evernight Goddess stopped promoting the title 'Lady of Crimson' a few days ago and changed the prayer gesture of drawing the red moon to dotting stars!"
Cattleya, "The Hermit," speculated: "Did the 'Evernight Goddess' make a deal using the authority of the 'Moon' domain?"
But Klein thought of the truth. He manipulated "The World" and said: "The Uniqueness of the 'Moon' pathway, or a Sequence 1 characteristic, is with the Evernight Goddess!"
Several previous transactions had mentioned the whereabouts of the "Moon" pathway's Uniqueness. Every time it was mentioned, Hobert would change the subject.
Klein had long suspected, based on the Goddess's honorific name, whether the Uniqueness of the "Moon" pathway was with the Evernight Goddess.
Regarding "The World's" guess, everyone looked at "The Emperor" for confirmation.
Hobert didn't explain anything, just smiled and nodded.
Everyone immediately understood that "The World" was right.
Leonard, "The Star," asked curiously: "When did the Goddess obtain the authority of the 'Moon' pathway?"
Cattleya speculated again: "Maybe it was during the War of the Gods in the Second Epoch!"
Everyone sighed again: Could it be that they were already planning this War of the Gods in the Second Epoch?
That would be too terrifying!
Other members were more willing to believe that this was just a coincidence!
But thinking of coincidence, everyone's hearts skipped a beat, because it made them think of Adam again. If it really was a "coincidence," that would still be very terrifying.
Immediately afterward, everyone thought that the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother were both Gods, so they should have nothing to do with Adam.
Fors, "The Magician," said: "No matter what, the authority of the 'Moon' domain has returned to the Sanguine Ancestor."
More than a month ago, Audrey… no, the Sanguine Ancestor had visited Longtail Island. At that time, Fors would never have imagined that the person she warmly entertained was actually the Sanguine Ancestor!
After hearing Miss Magician's words, the other members couldn't help but look at Mr. Moon, hoping to get evidence of the authority's return from him.
But at this time, Mr. Moon still seemed to be in shock, and his expression was still a little erratic.
Among the Tarot Club members, the most shocked member after hearing those messages was Emlyn, "The Moon." At this time, his mind was still filled with: The Earth Mother is the Ancestor, and the Ancestor is the Earth Mother…
This made him take a deep breath: So, I have never changed my faith. No wonder I still like to go to the Harvest Church without the priest doing corresponding psychological hints. That's because my intuition tells me that the Earth Mother is the Ancestor!
One idea after another flashed through Emlyn's mind: So, the Ancestor favored me and made me the savior of the Sanguine!
Thinking about it, he began to believe that he was the most devout Sanguine.
Seeing that this Sanguine seemed to be coming out of shock, Fors smiled and said: "Mr. Moon, wait a little longer, and maybe you will be the Archbishop of the Earth Mother Church, no, it should be the Plenipotentiary Representative of the Earth Church stationed in the Sanguine."
Emlyn finally reacted: "Why?"
He thought that the Ancestor would keep the Sanguine in their previous state and not directly merge with the Earth Church.
Leonard smiled and said: "Since the Evernight Goddess no longer has the title of 'Lady of Crimson,' the Earth Mother will soon have a similar honorific name, which cannot be hidden from other churches."
Hobert thought to himself: That's not necessarily true.
According to the plan of the Earth Mother Lilith, they plan to let Lilith's personality become a god first, and use the influence of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" on Lilith to try to find the "Brood Hive" first.
However, he didn't intend to explain it at this time.
After hearing Mr. Star's words, Emlyn suddenly thought of such a scene: The clansmen who had previously mocked him for believing in the Earth Mother will line up and walk up to him to receive his baptism.
Thinking of this, Emlyn's mood became extremely pleasant, and he couldn't help but raise his chin slightly.
At this time, Klein manipulated "The World" and said: "I suddenly thought of a question, why did 'Goddess of Harvest' Omebella die in City of Silver? Instead of dying in the Giant King's Court, or somewhere else?"
The other members were stunned at first, but soon they also realized that this was indeed a bit strange. In theory, the Beyonder characteristics of the "Goddess of Harvest" should have been taken away by the Ancient Sun God, or in a certain place in the Giant King's Court.
Why would it be in City of Silver?
Derrick guessed: "Maybe it's because what City of Silver believed in before was the Giant Queen."
He explained: "I just learned that before believing in 'The Omnipotent and Omniscient Lord,' what City of Silver believed in was not the 'Giant King,' but the 'Giant Queen.'"
So that's how it is!
The members of the Tarot Club felt that it made sense.
"The World" nodded slightly, accepted this answer, and then looked at Hobert for confirmation.
Hobert smiled and said: "There is indeed a secret here. Of course, that's just my guess, and it should be different from the facts, but it should be something like that."
Anyway, the God of Combat has already fallen, and there is nothing to announce that information.
It had been a while since everyone had heard "The Emperor's" guess, and for a moment, everyone was very interested in the secret that Mr. Emperor said.
"And we have actually briefly mentioned this secret before," Hobert said: "We all know that after the Ancient Sun God woke up, he successively defeated the Ancient Gods except for the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti."
"But based on the Ancient Sun God's later performance, he did not recover the authority of every Ancient God."
"At least he never showed the relevant authority of the 'Giant King' and the 'Phoenix Ancestor,' but the characteristics of the 'Phoenix Ancestor' should have been taken away by the Ancient Sun God."
"Later, he bestowed those characteristics to Abraham, who is also the 'Mr. Door' we know well, and the 'God of the Dead,' who is also the 'Underworld Emperor' of the Fourth Epoch."
"But the authority of the 'Giant King' was obtained by this Ancient God's child, who was also the 'God of Dawn' at the time, and later the 'God of Combat' Badheil. This 'inheritance' is relatively special."
Of course, everyone remembered the information that "The Emperor" had mentioned before. At that time, they also guessed whether there was some dark history behind the origin of the "God of Combat."
Now it seems that there is indeed some dark history here!
At this time, the other members vaguely guessed something, but they didn't dare to think about it too much.
Hobert continued: "Before explaining this problem clearly, we must first understand another problem."
"As far as I know, the person whose fate is stolen will enter a state similar to 'Concealment.' Everyone will not be able to detect his existence, and what he says and does will not have any impact on the real world."
"Because there is no fate, he will break all connections with the real world, and the whole world will reject him, and eventually die in loneliness."
Everyone was slightly stunned and had a new understanding of Amon's abilities.
Audrey sighed: "Although it's not the first time I've heard this kind of information, every time I hear it, it makes people feel a chill down their spines."
The other members nodded in agreement.
At the same time, they also realized that "The Emperor" was explaining this point in order to make everyone understand Omebella's state.
Hobert waited for everyone to finish sighing before saying: "I don't know if the 'Giant King' can sense the existence of a fateless Omebella."
"However, if he was injured in the battle with the Ancient Sun God and his condition was not very good, it should be difficult for him to realize that his queen is already another person."
"At the same time, when Badheil returned to the Giant King's Court while the 'Giant King' was in a very bad condition after the war with the Ancient Sun God, he killed the 'Giant King' and obtained the Beyonder characteristics of this Ancient God!"
Everyone had already received too many surprises today, but this news still surprised everyone!
Especially Derrick, who always felt that the honor of the "Warrior" had been ruined by Badheil.
But everyone was mentally prepared. They were surprised, but they didn't seem surprised by this.
Alger was still saying in his heart: I said, every god has some dark history!
Hobert continued amidst everyone's surprise: "I don't know if the already swapped Giant Queen helped at that time? But what can be basically determined is that the main person who took action was Badheil!"
Omebella, in a state devoid of destiny, witnessed all of this, but there was nothing She could do.
In the end, She watched Her son replace His father as the 'God of Combat,' watched Her son recognize another person as His mother.
Under such intense blows, She wandered to the City of Silver, where Her believers resided, and amidst resentment and curses, She fell in the City of Silver, forming a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact!
Amidst a series of shocks, Derrick was the first to react: "So… so those of us who consumed Black-faced Grass must kill our own relatives with our own hands, or else our relatives will turn into evil spirits!
It turns out… this, this is the curse from the Giant Queen!"
Hobert nodded and said, "That's right."
The other members sighed inwardly: What a tragic deity.
Emlyn originally wanted to say "Serves Her right," for betraying our Ancestor.
But he also felt that this deity's ending was indeed too tragic, so he refrained from adding harsh words.
Klein, behind the gray fog, thought to himself: The Tarot Club doesn't have much other information, but the dark history of deities often appears. The Evernight Goddess once betrayed Her God, the 'Annihilation Demonic Wolf,' and the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom have also done the same thing.
Today, I learned two more pieces of dark history. Lilith replaced the Giant Queen's destiny and later became the Earth Mother.
The God of Combat became a deity by killing His father.
Currently, it is only unclear whether the God of Steam and Machinery has any dark history.
Finally, Hobert said, "Still, the process of the God of Combat becoming a god is just a guess, but it should be roughly like this."
The other members all believed that what "Emperor" said should be closer to the truth, with only some details possibly differing.
With this topic concluded, the Tarot Club was silent for twenty or thirty seconds before Alger cleared his throat and said to Hobert: "I have already investigated the background of those Beyonders wearing classical attire who appeared in Caesar Harbor before."
That was during a Tarot Club meeting when the war was relatively intense. Alger announced that a group of mysterious Beyonders had suddenly appeared in Caesar Harbor and launched attacks on the Beyonders of Loen.
Hobert nodded: "What reward do you want?"
"Hmm… the information you just announced can offset ten rewards," Alger said with a smile.
Hobert didn't continue to be polite: "Alright then."
Alger continued: "According to my extensive investigation, it has been finally determined that those Beyonders are members of the Trunsoest family!"
Everyone was stunned and looked at "Emperor" together!
They remembered that "Emperor" was a member of the Trunsoest family! Moreover, it seemed that many of "The Creator's" subordinates were also members of this family!
Hobert only said faintly: "Thank you, I understand."
He thought to himself: This group of Trunsoest members must be the batch that came out of the Holy Land of Xidro. Currently, they should be serving Trunsoest.
Thinking of this, Hobert realized that Trunsoest must have taken the opportunity to obtain many benefits during the previous war.
He decided to have Xio investigate in this direction to see if they could find out what specific benefits the Trunsoest family had obtained during the previous battle.
Seeing that "Emperor" didn't continue to discuss this topic, everyone automatically moved on to the next topic.
Alger said again in a deep voice: "The vast majority of our members are already demigods, and the advancement cycle has become very long, and we have our own forces.
The demand for Beyonder characteristics, potion formulas, and Sealed Artifacts may only occur once every few years, and the focus of the gathering may have to shift to information exchange and secret cooperation."
Audrey, Cattleya, Leonard, and others nodded in agreement with Mr. Hanged Man's words.
Immediately afterward, "The World" initiated another topic: "Everyone, I need to remind you of something."
When the Tarot Club members all looked over, Klein manipulated "The World" to say: "The apocalypse will descend in just over a decade, and everyone may be destroyed, including the gods."
He had recently obtained information about the approximate time of the apocalypse, and He felt it was necessary to remind the other members.
This was the second time the other members had heard information about the apocalypse at the Tarot Club. Mr. Fool had said before that the so-called apocalypse was the destruction of the barrier formed by the 'Original Creator,' and the invasion of Outer Deities.
But at the time, everyone didn't take it too seriously, always feeling that the apocalypse was still far away from them.
But "The World" mentioned the apocalypse again, and also gave an approximate time!
In other words, the arrival of the apocalypse had no room for slowing down and was not far from now.
After hearing this news, Audrey still felt a sense of confusion: The apocalypse is coming in just over a decade, what can I do?
Alger's first reaction was that Gehrman Sparrow was disrespectful to Mr. Fool, because Mr. Fool was also a god.
But he quickly rejected this idea. After all, "The World" was Mr. Fool's blessed, the most devout believer. The other members of the Tarot Club might accidentally blaspheme Mr. Fool in their words, but "The World" Gehrman Sparrow would never!
Based on this, Alger quickly came to another conclusion: This must be a reminder under Mr. Fool's instruction, so that we can make some preparations for the apocalypse in advance. But, even the gods will be destroyed, what can we do?
Cattleya was equally confused about the future. Besides improving herself, she didn't know which direction to work towards.
Fors decided that she would no longer delay and would prepare to advance to a demigod after the gathering! As the apocalypse approached, it seemed that only becoming an angel could see a glimmer of hope.
Derrick first felt an uncontrollable sense of frustration, because City of Silver had just left the Forsaken Land of the Gods, and had come to the world of light, but as a result, it would soon have to face a new apocalypse.
But soon, he adjusted his mentality and chose to believe in Mr. Fool.
Since this great existence could save City of Silver from the Land of the Gods, then He could also prevent the arrival of the apocalypse.
Emlyn couldn't help but frown: Although I am the savior of the Sanguine during the apocalypse, I didn't expect the apocalypse to descend so quickly. I'm just an Earl!
He suddenly had the feeling of a student who had only attended a few days of class and suddenly had to face an exam.
Of course, this also made him a little excited, after all, he would soon fulfill his mission and show his greatness in front of his clan.
Hobert realized that he should consider the plan to become a Great Old One. Only by becoming a Great Old One could he directly face the upcoming apocalypse!
Leonard had heard the apocalypse prophecy from Old Man Pallez Zoroast, but he didn't know why there would be such a development, so he asked: "Why is the apocalypse suddenly coming? There's no sign of it now."
After the trip to the South Pole, Hobert probably understood why the apocalypse would appear.
The apocalypse was bound to appear!
This seemed to be the means by which the "Original Creator" was gathering Sephirot and Beyonder characteristics.
Klein manipulated "The World" to respond to Leonard: "It's just that you haven't discovered the signs.
Do you think the War of the Gods that just ended broke out for no reason?"
Seeing that the surrounding members of the Tarot Club were shocked by these words and fell into thought, "The World" added: "You are not qualified to know the specific reasons for the time being. Just understanding them will bring irresistible corruption. Only existences above the level of angels may be able to contend with it."
Audrey was the first to realize: Mr. World seems to already know the truth. He's not afraid of being corrupted? Could it be that he… he's already an angel? Is He?
She took a deep breath: This is the second angel among the Tarot Club members!
Immediately afterward, Alger and Cattleya had similar interpretations, knowing that "The World" Gehrman Sparrow had already become an angel walking on the earth.
In ancient times, this was a god from God, a member of the gods.
"The World" looked around and said: "You can all think carefully about what you plan to do next and how you plan to prepare."
The other members nodded slightly, indicating that they understood, but at the same time felt a little confused.
"Mr. World has given me a reminder that everyone should improve themselves as soon as possible." Hobert said to Emlyn: "I have clues about the 'High Summoner' and 'Life Giver' Beyonder characteristics here. Are you interested in this?"
The clue He was talking about was the "0-70" Creation Ring. Currently, Hobert basically doesn't need this Sealed Artifact anymore, so it's better to shatter it and cultivate a "Life Giver."
"Of course I'm interested!" Emlyn said immediately.
Then he thought to himself: As expected, I am the person chosen by the Ancestor. I was just worried about the apocalypse, and I immediately had the opportunity to become an angel.
Emlyn saw the other members casting envious glances at him, praised the "Son of the Goddess" in his heart before asking: "What kind of price do I have to pay?"
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying: "I will recommend you to Mother to become the person in charge of the Loen Diocese. In the future, I need you to provide some information, protect the interests of the Southern Balam Duchy, and so on."
Everyone was stunned. Aren't Loen and Southern Balam allies?
Judging from what "Emperor" said, it seems that the relationship with Loen in the future is not very optimistic?
Audrey and Fors had already realized that Hobert was planning for the worst.
They knew very well that the Southern Balam Duchy was an oddity in today's world. They didn't feel anything when they were at war before, but now that the war is over, some contradictions that everyone knows but were covered up by the war will gradually be exposed.
Emlyn said as if he had heard some order: "I, I will try my best to do well."
Hobert nodded and then said to Leonard, "Do you have any thoughts about jumping to an adjacent pathway?"
Leonard was about to say "No" when Hobert preemptively said, "I have a clue here about the 'Death' pathway charcteristic."
He was talking about "0-73" in the Death domain. After becoming Sequence 1, the Sealed Artifact corresponding to Sequence 2 wouldn't be of much use anymore.
Everyone was a little surprised. This was already the second clue about an angel-level characteristic.
If everyone knew that Hobert had already obtained these characteristics, even Mr. Fool would probably lament: How is the difference between angels so great?
Leonard was slightly stunned before saying, "I'll consider it."
Hobert nodded, ending this round of trading.
The giant hall was silent for a full half minute. Everyone realized that the transactions initiated by "Emperor" just now had left them with no desire to continue communicating.
How much they wished "Emperor" would also ask them if they were interested in angel-level characteristics!
Unfortunately, the Emperor did not.
Seeing that everyone was no longer communicating, Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering in a timely manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 715 Backlund Peace Conference
chapters.content:
