chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 717: Conversation with Mr. Door
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In Pritz Harbor, inside a warehouse that was being rebuilt, Fors saw her teacher, Dorian.
"Are you ready?" Dorian glanced at Hobert, who was behind Fors, and asked directly.
He trusted his student Fors relatively well, but he was somewhat concerned about Hobert. Therefore, before meeting with his student, he prayed to Mr. Fool, lest Hobert seize the family's Sealed Artifact next.
Fors replied a little uncertainly, "Almost... it should meet the requirements."
Today, Dorian was preparing to help Fors advance to a demigod, or rather, to help Fors complete the ritual.
The ritual for the "Secrets Sorcerer" was: the ascendant must seal a demigod-level creature with clear hostility. The less external force used, the better the ritual's effect.
"Believe me, you'll be fine." Hobert smiled and said, "The potion has long been digested, and with Teacher Dorian's help, there won't be any problems."
In addition, He would also provide some help, such as allowing Fors to record four demigod-level abilities in the Beyonder Squad.
And in a while, Hobert was also preparing to help, and was preparing to use Fors's ritual to see if he could contact Mr. "Door".
If such preparations still failed, Hobert would have to suspect whether Fors had received the "blessing" of the Evernight Goddess?
Dorian nodded slightly and said, "Almost is fine. That ritual is really too difficult for pure Sequence 5 Beyonders. It is essential to seek help appropriately, but you must grasp the limit."
As he spoke, he handed the Grade 1 Sealed Artifact "Devil's Oil Painting" to Fors: "There are more than one terrifying creature inside, but when we were attacked by the Aurora Order, we lost a lot of data, and now I don't know what terrifying creatures are sealed inside."
This was Dorian's biggest concern: "The key is, I don't know what terrifying creatures you can release."
Fors had already thought of a countermeasure: "I will pray to Mr. Fool to release a creature that is relatively easy to control."
Dorian nodded almost imperceptibly, said nothing more, and immediately summoned his contracted creature, Malmouth, who loved music, and took out the auxiliary Ingredients he had prepared.
He also took the main ingredient of the "Secrets Sorcerer" from Hobert and prepared a "Secrets Sorcerer" potion for his student on the spot.
Fors solemnly took the potion.
"If you can successfully advance, I only have one request." Dorian said solemnly to Fors: "That is, on a full moon night, listen to what Mr. 'Door' is saying, and ask Him the reason for doing so."
The Abraham family members were eager to fully understand the truth of the whole matter.
Faced with her teacher's request, Fors agreed without hesitation: "Okay."
After the teacher and student finished talking, Hobert asked Dorian, "Do you want to watch the advancement process?"
Dorian was stunned: "Can I watch?"
He was only a Sequence 7, and could easily be hurt by a demigod-level monster, so he originally planned to leave after completing the task.
Hobert raised his hand and constructed a layer of "Disorder" space on the outside, which was completely isolated from reality.
This space was a bit like the closed space of "Nonexistent Town", and it was difficult for outside people and things to affect it.
Then He told Dorian: "Next, as long as you stand behind me, there will be no danger."
Dorian nodded and immediately came behind Hobert.
Under Hobert's encouraging gaze, Fors prayed to Mr. Fool and, after receiving a response, opened the oil painting in her hand.
It depicted one abstract pattern after another that was incomprehensible. Just looking at it for a while could make people dizzy, nauseous, and mentally weak.
According to Dorian's prior explanation, Fors took out the pre-prepared herbal powder and sprinkled it on the "Devil's Oil Painting", and then she recited a spell in Jotun to release a creature.
Silently, the fluttering herbal powder landed on the oil painting and quickly rotated around a point.
The surface of the oil painting became illusory, and suddenly, a cyan-black hand with rotten marks stretched out from inside.
Fors's body became icy cold, as if she had fallen into a frozen and cracked lake.
When the monster fully appeared, Hobert decisively took action: "Weaken."
Pfft—
The ferocious and terrifying cyan-black monster seemed to suddenly deflate, becoming thin and emaciated, like it was malnourished.
Dorian wanted to remind her, but it was too late. This was a great help to Fors!
He was about to suggest stopping the advancement ritual, but thinking that Hobert would definitely not harm Fors, he didn't speak.
"Imprison!" Fors immediately used the demigod-level ability she had recorded from Angus!
The monster, which no longer had any divinity and was equivalent to Sequence 7, was immediately "imprisoned" in place.
Then, Fors opened her mouth and let out a howl that humans could hardly make. This was the "Wraith's Shriek" that she had recorded from Sharron.
The shriek formed a cold wind, blowing the "imprisoned" monster back into the oil painting.
Fors took a deep breath and quickly closed the oil painting.
Because of the monster's influence, she was still a little cold.
Hobert took the oil painting from her hand: "You can drink the potion now."
Dorian was a little worried: "Really?"
Hobert replied very confidently: "Yes."
Fors took out the potion she had just prepared and drank it in one gulp.
At the same time, Hobert "tampered" with the connection between Fors and the Spirit World, as well as the connection between the event of sealing the monster just now and the Spirit World.
Theoretically speaking, every event that happens in the real world will have a corresponding "imprint" in the Spirit World.
The preparations for advancement are no exception. It is those "imprints" that prove that the ascendant has made corresponding preparations, and will receive corresponding help when taking the potion.
What Hobert "tampered" with was the connection between those "imprints" and Fors, "tampering" the sealing of the monster, which was just completed with Hobert's help, into a sealing that Fors completed alone!
Of course, the Spirit World has a strong self-repair ability, and such "tampering" is only temporary.
But as long as the advancement is completed and Fors stabilizes her state, such an operation will not have much impact on her. Even if there is an impact, Hobert only needs to "bestow" away her part of the bad state.
This is the "Lawyer".
If Hobert had accommodated the Uniqueness at this time, Fors would not have to do anything at all, and Hobert could "tamper" out the "imprints" needed for the ritual for her.
The moment Fors drank the potion, a night sky suddenly appeared before her eyes. In the dark night, dense and dazzling stars intertwined into a dreamlike river.
The different stars in the night sky produced invisible connections. They wriggled and distorted, like uncontrolled avatars.
Fors's thoughts became muddled, and she almost couldn't control herself from resisting those "avatars" from separating from her body.
At this moment, she felt a vague mark from the Spirit World. That mark was the imprint generated in the Spirit World by the sealing of the monster just now.
Fors, relying on instinct, extended her spirituality over.
That mark immediately released the abstract power of sealing, sealing those "avatars" back into Fors's body.
Immediately afterwards, that mark immediately turned into a layered door, Fors gradually regained her sanity, began to gather her spirituality, and gradually regained herself.
Just as the stars in front of Fors's eyes gradually faded, a gloomy darkness suddenly appeared again, with a never-ending storm and occasional flashes of lightning in the depths of the darkness.
The next second, that familiar voice stirred in Fors's ears, piercing her head, like steel nails stirring her brain.
This was the murmur of the full moon!
It took her several seconds to finally adjust her state by relying on meditation, and she clearly heard what the voice was shouting.
A cry for help!
Mr. "Door" was frantically shouting "Help" every full moon!
Suddenly, the constant cries for help turned into a ethereal voice: "You are using Beyonder characteristics from the Abraham family, and your advancement has been helped by a high sequence!"
Fors immediately felt the blood vessels on her forehead jump, she stabilized her state again, and then deliberately asked: "Who are you?"
The voice said: "You can call me Mr. 'Door', I think you should be no stranger to me."
"Are you His Royal Highness Bethel, the ancestor of the Abraham family?"
"Yes."
Fors said: "Then do you know that your 'cry for help' has plunged the entire Abraham family into a curse for more than a thousand years, and basically no one has become a 'Traveler', and it is even more difficult to know the content of your cry for help."
Mr. "Door" was silent for a moment and said: "I am exiled in eternal darkness, suffering from the constant storm, and I have no way of knowing what is happening in the real world."
Fors, who understood the relevant information, immediately made a judgment: lying.
At this time, Mr. "Door" continued: "Moreover, the cry for help during the full moon is not something I can control."
Fors was a little surprised: "Why?"
"Whenever the full moon comes, my crazy part will be strengthened, making me unable to control it, and I can only keep calling for help."
Fors nodded slightly: So that's how it is.
Then she asked: "What can I do for you? How should the Abraham family eliminate the curse?"
Mr. "Door" said in a deep voice: "Set up a ritual to help me get out of trouble, in that case the curse will no longer exist.
"There are two kinds of rituals. One is to use a demigod each from the 'Seer', 'Apprentice', and Marauder Pathways as sacrifices.
The second is to extract the blood of at least ninety-nine Beyonders from the Abraham family and use it to draw a symbol like this..."
Fors, after memorizing the symbol, said, "I will tell them."
Mr. Door smiled and said, "If I can escape because of this, I will help you become an angel."
"Hahaha." Fors's expression suddenly changed: "That sounds like a curse."
Mr. Door immediately noticed and asked, "You, who are you?"
"Fors" made a teasing expression: "Trunsoest."
But Mr. Door was silent for a few seconds before saying, "You are not Trunsoest!"
"Just treat me as Trunsoest."
Mr. Door asked, "How did you participate in our conversation?"
"I only need to strengthen the 'connection' with the advancing Beyoder, then 'tamper' and 'distort' my concept with them, and I can appear in front of you at the right time."
The current "Fors" is, of course, Hobert.
Before the ritual began, He also had the mentality of trying to see if he could contact Mr. Door.
Sensing that Fors had completed the advancement, but her consciousness had not yet returned to her body, Hobert knew that Mr. Door had taken the initiative to contact her using the advancement ritual.
In the lightning and storm, Mr. Door couldn't see His expression clearly, but it sounded like He sneered: "You are Solomon!"
"Solomon has completely fallen." Hobert made a gesture of spreading his hands using Fors's spirit body and mental body: "Let's make our conversation more efficient.
"I have received accurate information that you frequently contacted a Beyonder more than a hundred years ago, and I even know the general content of your contact.
"With that said, you don't need to hide it anymore, right?"
Mr. Door was silent, not knowing whether it was because of surprise or because his lie had been exposed.
Hobert asked, "I really want to know, can ordinary Outer Deities harm the current 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'? Is Her counterattack difficult for ordinary Outer Deities to resist?"
Previously, the corruption of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" made Him realize that he didn't have a clear concept of the "pillar", so he hoped to learn more information through communication with Mr. Door.
At this time, Hobert "distorted" his concept with Fors. Although he still used Fors's appearance, Fors couldn't hear their conversation, so there was no need to worry that Fors would be corrupted.
A few seconds later, in the darkness with storms and lightning, Mr. Door's voice sounded: "It seems you know a lot."
He paused and then said: "First of all, what I want to tell you is that I only have a very vague concept of Her, but I know that the Outer Deities can harm Her, but that's all.
I don't know Her specific strength, I only know that Her level is very high."
Then He asked: "Who exactly are you?"
Hobert smiled and said, "My surname is Trunsoest."
Mr. Door nodded: "I understand."
Then He sighed: "It seems that Roselle is also going to completely fall."
Hobert asked again: "Do you know anything about the 'Uncertain Mist'? Any information is fine."
Mr. Door replied: "I suggest you go to Tamara, or find a Sealed Artifact called 'Genie', they both have a certain understanding of the 'Uncertain Mist'."
Hobert shook his head: "Now I am already a mortal enemy with Tamara. As for the 'Genie', I will have to find it after a while, otherwise there may be some danger."
Only then did Mr. Door answer: "I heard the Lord once said that a part of the 'Uncertain Mist' has Beyonder characteristics that are very similar to the 'Black Emperor' and 'Apprentice', but it doesn't seem to conform to the concept of adjacent pathways in the general sense.
In addition, the 'Uncertain Mist' can accommodate the characteristics of the 'Black Emperor' and 'Apprentice' pathways."
Hobert nodded slowly. Mr. Door's retelling of the Ancient Sun God's words should have a certain degree of credibility, but this is not quite the same as His previous thoughts.
Mr. Door asked again: "How is Roselle's current situation?"
Hobert pondered for a moment before replying: "More than a hundred years ago, He fell in the White Maple Palace."
Then He asked: "How much do you know about 'Celestial Worthy' and 'Genie'?"
"As time goes by, 'Celestial Worthy's' spiritual imprint will weaken, until its influence on the world is very weak, but because of some unknown opportunity, He will definitely usher in the next awakening!" Mr. Door replied: "It is said that 'Genie' was sealed by 'Celestial Worthy'."
Hobert's eyes narrowed. The state of "Celestial Worthy" sounded very "familiar". The influence on the world is very weak. Isn't this similar to the state of Celestial Worthy and God Almighty before the awakening of the Original Creator in the prehistoric era?
In other words, the more you suppress the momentum of Celestial Worthy and God Almighty's revival, the easier it will be to make their state close to the sleeping Original Creator, and then a certain Convergence will occur, allowing the "Original Creator" to awaken?
Thinking about it carefully, Celestial Worthy's influence on the real world is indeed getting smaller and smaller. In the Fourth Epoch, Mr. Door did not dare to become a god.
If the process of the Ancient Sun God and Klein becoming Great Old Ones also fails, it is estimated that the influence of God and Celestial Worthy will be further weakened.
However, neither Adam nor Klein will give up the action of returning to the Great Old Ones or becoming the Great Old Ones which means that God Almighty and Celestial Worthy will have a certain degree of awakening in the future.
At this time, Mr. Door asked: "Do you have a chance to become a Great Old One?"
"Not me." Hobert said: "It is the god I serve."
He asked the fourth question: "Does Tudor have any arrangements for resurrection?"
Mr. Door was silent for a while before saying: "Before I was sealed, no."
This ancestor of the Abraham family also asked the fourth question: "Who is the god you serve?"
"The Creator in the Shadow of Order!" Hobert said piously.
Mr. Door's voice became very ethereal: "Never heard of it.
But if He really has such a chance, it would be a good thing..."
The storm and lightning seal in the darkness gradually weakened the connection between them, and finally cut it off.
Hobert immediately stopped "distorting" and "tampering". At this moment, Fors returned to the real world.
Dorian was very happy to see his student successfully advanced: "It's great that the ritual can still work."
He had been worried that Hobert's "destruction" of the ritual would affect Fors's advancement!
...
Lanagua Port New City.
A group of hired carpenters saw the "half-giant" people, said to be from the northern Feysac islands, carrying heavy, freshly baked logs.
These carpenters deal with those woods all year round and know how heavy the wood is. Usually, they can only be transported with the help of horses, gears, and machines, but the "half-giants" here are as easy as carrying toys.
Derrick easily piled the logs on his shoulders on the ground. He saw that part of the new city had been installed with doors and windows, painted, and in the recent period, they had helped the carpenters make a batch of furniture.
So he said to Candice and Leiaval: "It's time to rush back to City of Silver and tell the Chief and them about the situation here."
None of the members of the City of Silver Pathfinder team objected, and all agreed with Elder Derrick's decision with considerable excitement.
Although they haven't been here for too long, they have deeply fallen in love with the new "hometown", and they like the warmth under the sunshine, and can't wait to let their relatives and friends also enjoy these gifts of nature.
Derrick subconsciously straightened his back a little. He said to Candice, "You and I will return to City of Silver together and tell the Chief and other elders about the situation here.
Yes, Ginnod, you come too. Leyval, you are responsible for maintaining order here."
This is the City of Silver's tradition. If there are no casualties in the exploration action, or the number of survivors is more than three, three people must report the same thing separately.
After a brief explanation, Derrick led two members to a secluded place in the new city and made a wish to Mr. Fool to return to City of Silver immediately.
Silently, the scene around them first became blurred, stretched, and then fixed, and soon the line of sight became clear.
Before their eyes was the wall of City of Silver.
Candice sincerely exclaimed: "This is a miracle!"
She had envisioned many ways to return to City of Silver, but she never thought that she would come back directly like this.
Derrick breathed a sigh of relief and tried to remain serious and said: "We will immediately go to the Chief and arrange for everyone to prepare for the relocation."
After listening to their report in the round tower, an elder sighed: "Your experience is like a beautiful dream, no, I can't even dream of such a scene."
Next, make the final preparations for the relocation, and pray to Mr. Fool, asking Him to transfer the people of City of Silver out.
Soon Mr. Fool issued an oracle, notifying the time of the transfer, and told them that the ancient survivors from Moon City were coming to City of Silver to meet, and then leave the Forsaken Land of the Gods together.
When the excited crowd gathered in the training ground, Chief Colin loudly said to everyone: "The living environment in Moon City is difficult. It is said that many people have become distorted. Treat them with normal eyes!"
Everyone responded without hesitation: "Yes!"
Soon, the space on the other side of the square suddenly became blurred, and figures suddenly appeared, some ugly, some with various deformed faces.
Colin nodded towards the somewhat uneasy citizens of Moon City and asked, "Are you all ready?"
His gaze was calm and natural, showing no prejudice towards the appearances of the Moon City residents.
Nim, the High Priest of Moon City, immediately responded, "We are ready!"
Then, Colin turned his gaze to the residents of City of Silver: "Begin praying!"
A few seconds later, everyone on the City of Silver training ground disappeared.
The city fell into complete silence, and before long, it would be overgrown with corrupted weeds, and monsters would "occupy" it.
In the blink of an eye, the residents of City of Silver and Moon City arrived in front of the Giant King's palace, bathed in the light of dusk.
This was Klein's deliberate act, giving these ancient remnants of the forsaken land a ritual to bid farewell to the past.
Everyone was shocked by the grandeur and epic feel of the "Giant King's Court." They subconsciously turned their heads and looked into the distance.
There, the land was completely swallowed by darkness, and only when lightning flashed across the sky did the ancient buildings in the distance become visible.
Then they turned back and saw the golden ocean outside the gate.
Immediately afterwards, the scene changed again, and they arrived in the city center, which had exquisite buildings and plants without any distortion.
On the other side of this square, a beautiful lady smiled and said, "Hello everyone, I am Donna, an official of the Southern Balam Duchy. Grand Duke Hobert has sent me to deliver some food and daily necessities to you."
"From now on, I will be in contact with Mr. Derrick among you and be responsible for communication between the two parties. May I ask, which one is Mr. Derrick?"

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 718: Bell-Ringing Angel Amon
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Derrick was somewhat uneasy. Although he often saw Miss Justice and the others at the Tarot Gathering, they were always separated by a layer of gray fog, and he could only vaguely make out their attire.
But now, Donna, dressed neatly, with rosy lips and white teeth, and a faint fragrance, was standing right in front of him.
Previously, Derrick had dealt with "Emissary" Danitz and workers from various industries. This was his first time seeing a beautiful young woman in the outside world.
Seeing no one answer, Donna asked again, "May I ask, which one of you is Mr. Derrick?"
Hobert had told her that Mr. Derrick understood Loenese.
"I am," Derrick cleared his throat and said, "Thank you, Mr. Hobert, for the things you sent. Um, we… we have some Beyonder characteristics here that can…"
Donna smiled and interrupted him, "The Duke specifically instructed that this is a free gift to you."
She sized up the big boy in front of her, who was two heads taller than herself and had a sunny appearance: Is this the giant bloodline that Hobert mentioned? He looks like he's still growing, but he's already much taller than Tyron, the tallest of the three of us.
"Thank you," Derrick thanked her again, then he remembered to explain to Chief Colin in Jotun, "This is a follower of the 'Creator'… um, the angel who helped us open the door to the outside world.
"It was He who sent food and daily necessities. Um, the 'Creator' and Mr. Fool are allies. We are currently in the kingdom of the 'Creator', and the Church of the Fool is the main religion here."
Recently, he had only been in contact with people from the Church of the Fool, and he thought the Church of the Fool was the state religion of this country.
Colin nodded, signaling everyone not to be defensive, and asked Candice to take everyone to look around, while Derrick was responsible for continuing to communicate with this lady.
Donna introduced the two people beside her: "This is the administrative officer of Milherbon. For the next period of time, he will continue to send people to bring you daily necessities. However, we can't just give them away for free. For the things sent later, you will need to repay with future production."
"And this is the official extraordinary officer of Lanagua City. You can look for him if you have any extraordinary needs."
Derrick said again, "Thank you."
Donna made a gesture, and the two left the noisy square together: "How do you feel about this city?"
"It's very good."
"This is a city that we built for you with a lot of manpower and resources."
"Thank you, thank you."
Donna smiled slightly: "You remind me of Mr. Dophis… Um, you are not the same. Mr. Dophis is just simply not talkative, but you seem to be inarticulate."
Derrick scratched his head: "Yes, um…"
He thought for a while and then said, "When I was chatting with Mr. Hobert, oh, Duke Hobert and the others, I realized that the content of the general knowledge courses I learned almost didn't include adjectives, so my speech sounds stiff."
Donna nodded and followed up on this topic: "Next, we will send teachers to you, and you will learn our official language, Loenese."
After investigating the language composition of the Duchy of Southern Balam, Hobert finally chose Loenese as the official language of Southern Balam.
The language system of Southern Balam is very chaotic. The local people in Southern Continent speak Dutanese and Highlander. The pronunciations of these two languages are significantly different from those of Northern Continent languages.
After evolution, Dutanese has formed many dialects. People in East Balam cannot understand the Dutanese of West Balam, and vice versa.
The Dutanese of Milherbon cannot be understood by people in the Haagenti Grassland, and it is difficult to refine a universal Dutanese.
Moreover, Highlander and Dutanese are not the same language. This language is mainly used by the people of the former Highland Kingdom, now the Star Highlands.
Highland County and Colon County of the Duchy of Southern Balam use Highlander.
This language also has the problem of dialects.
Therefore, in the end, Loenese, which is easier to learn, was adopted as the official language of this country.
This is considering that the Loenese alphabet system is relatively complete, and there is already a relatively mature grammar learning system, which can be used directly.
However, Dutanese and Highlander do not have a unified pronunciation system. If one of these two languages is used as the official language, the pronunciation system must be reconstructed, and even the fonts must be unified.
Another reason for eliminating these two languages is that these two languages do not have a deep cultural heritage.
If there are a large number of poems and ideological masterpieces written in them, it can be considered to help the locals transform them, but there are only some epics, fables, etc. written in them, which can be completely replaced by Loenese.
Donna continued: "When we can basically complete the communication, adults and children will learn separately.
"We will teach your adults to use modern tools and how to cultivate the crops here. The only requirement is that, because it involves seasonal issues, you must follow our advice on how to cultivate.
"At the same time, we will also teach you fishing, hunting, and working in factories. Do you see the large buildings over there? Well, those are the factories arranged for you. The things you produce can be exchanged for our currency, and then you can use our currency to buy what you need.
"Oh, you can also try to find job opportunities in Lanagua Port. Starting tomorrow, you will be issued certificates, and you will all obtain the status of citizens of Southern Balam, but you must abide by our laws.
"The children will begin to learn the general education of the Duchy of Southern Balam. We mainly teach grammar, mathematics, geography, humanities, and science, and you can establish your own schools for other knowledge."
Derrick nodded and said, "We will."
He believes that the history of City of Silver must be written into textbooks so that future generations will know the history of struggling in the dark.
At the same time, we must also consider general education in extraordinary aspects.
Donna simply said directly: "Some fees will be charged for these construction, education, and other assistance."
Derrick breathed a sigh of relief: "How should we pay these rewards?"
If all of these are free of charge, then he will owe "Emperor" a considerable favor.
"This needs to be discussed with Duke Hobert in person," Donna smiled and said, "Okay, now that the serious business is over, what do you want to eat for your first meal here? How about I teach you how to barbecue?
"Oh, by the way, we also need to have an unobstructed way of contact. If you feel it is necessary, you can skip the local Beyonders and officials and contact me directly."
…
After arranging the immigrants from City of Silver and Moon City, Hobert, taking advantage of the fact that he had nothing to do for the next few days, came to his first mausoleum.
This mausoleum is built in a huge cave in the mountain, from which you can see the vast forest outside.
In the huge cave structure with extraordinary arrangements, there is a large pyramid-shaped building, much smaller than the mausoleum used by George III, but in the advancement ceremony, the size of the pyramid is not required, so this size is enough.
At this time, the cave was empty, with only traces of workers living there.
Outside the pyramid, there is first a layer of chaotic space, which can isolate most of the extraordinary information from the outside world, making it difficult for Beyonders to know the exact location here.
There is also a layer of "spiritual barrier" outside, which can isolate spiritual perception.
However, during the advancement, this layer of spiritual barrier must be "removed" to avoid problems with the communication between oneself and the mausoleum.
Hobert stepped into the interior of the pyramid step by step. The internal structure was very complex, and all the buildings were reinforced with extraordinary power and a certain amount of shielding.
Even if an angel comes in, it will be difficult to find the location of the "main tomb chamber" for a while.
This is the experience Hobert summed up when digging the grave for George III. At that time, the structure inside the mausoleum around Backlund was too simple, and you could see George III who was being promoted at a glance.
Hobert felt that if the structure of his mausoleum was so simple, it would be a complete disrespect for his profession in the AD era.
The mausoleum He designed is like a maze, and it can be said that Klein and Roselle would be confused if they came.
But for Hobert, there are traces to follow.
Arriving at the location of the "main tomb chamber", Hobert sat on the stone chair in the middle and used the ability of "Connection" to establish contact with the building bit by bit.
After reaching Sequence 1, even two things that have no connection can establish a connection through Beyonder abilities.
As the connection with the mausoleum deepened, Hobert felt that the mausoleum was playing a role in the sense of mysticism.
This feeling is very strange, and Hobert can't explain the principle, but after establishing enough connection, a part of his anchor is naturally connected with the mausoleum.
Moreover, the role of the mausoleum is like a "signal amplifier", making the role of the anchor stronger and more stable.
It took about two or three hours, and Hobert felt that the established connection was almost done.
He took a deep breath and rested for a while.
At this time, Hobert felt that his every move was closely related to the mausoleum, and this connection would become deeper and deeper through the role of the anchor.
However, Hobert felt that for the sake of prudence, he still had to come to "Connection" again after a while.
The second Connection will not be so troublesome, and it can be completed in half an hour at most.
After resting for a while, Hobert rushed to the next mausoleum.
The inside of the mausoleums are connected by teleportation arrays, which is to ensure that the mausoleums can support each other as soon as possible in case of an accident.
After establishing contact with the five mausoleums, Hobert's spirituality clearly realized that this could satisfy the basic conditions for accommodating the Uniqueness.
However, to accommodate the Uniqueness, a trigger was still needed.
Hobert only had a vague concept of this trigger, roughly that the probability of success would increase after his spirituality reached a certain level of compatibility with the Uniqueness.
Hobert sat on the stone chair and pondered for a moment, feeling that this trigger should be to create a "Sequence Inversion" event.
After all, the core authority of this pathway is "Shadow of Order", which is "Tampering", "Disorder", and "Distortion". If his spirit body were more aligned with the Uniqueness, it should be by placing himself in an event that disrupts order.
Hobert thought for a long time, feeling that changing the Duchy to a Kingdom would be a good trigger.
However, strategically speaking, Christian has already completed his advancement by shattering the Beyonder characteristics gained from the "0-75" Abraham Crown.
And Sharron is preparing for the advancement ritual with the help of her teacher, and it is estimated that it will take some time to complete the preparations.
To be on the safe side, Hobert also asked Archibald to prepare for advancement, which could be done by making the city of Saint Xidro reappear before people, completing the advancement ritual.
The Beyonder characteristics for advancement could be obtained by shattering the "0-79" Mysterious Curtain, gaining the "Miracle Invoker" characteristics.
However, Archibald still needs to adjust his state and also needs a period of time to prepare.
In short, before either Sharron or Archibald advances, the South Balam Duchy will not have any major movements.
Thinking of this, Hobert breathed a sigh of relief and went to his sixth mausoleum using the teleportation array. Since six had already been built, he might as well establish contact with all of them.
… …
Fog Sea, Raxia Island, Emerald Palace.
Bernadette Gustav, with her chestnut-colored long hair, finished writing a letter to Hobert.
Then, she asked the "Spirit Servant" to prepare donuts and a simple altar. Bernadette, holding the letter, began to summon Hobert's messenger: "I, in my name…"
After the incantation was completed, the candlelight suddenly turned emerald green, and the firelight also became high, opening a illusory door.
A lady wearing a classic court dress, with a circular jade pendant around her waist, and looking a little playful, walked out of the door.
Bernadette was slightly stunned: Has Hobert changed messengers?
It wasn't until Beverly reached out to her that Bernadette seemed to suddenly react, handing the letter to her.
Beverly turned around and waved at the donuts. Three donuts had already appeared in her hand. The messenger ate the donuts while returning to the spirit world through the illusory door.
It wasn't until the candlelight returned to normal that Bernadette realized: The messenger was still the same messenger, but the other party's state seemed different.
She didn't continue to dwell on the messenger's problem. After putting on a coat, she unscrewed a small silver metal bottle, smeared a little emerald green grease from inside, and applied it evenly on both hands.
Putting away the silver bottle, Bernadette grabbed forward with both palms. When her hands pulled back, it was as if she had grabbed something.
In the next second, a cluster of illusory feathers appeared in each of Bernadette's hands. She quickly disappeared in place and entered the spirit world, already riding on a spirit world creature with a long beak and two long legs.
This spirit world creature spread its illusory wings, sending Bernadette to her destination.
This is an ancient secret technique that has been lost, very simple and practical. Bernadette usually uses this method when traveling long distances.
Soon, she arrived at Tussock Harbor. Bernadette waited in a bar that she had invested in.
It was still daytime. There were not many customers in the bar. The bartender lazily mixed a cocktail for Bernadette and then went back to the corner to doze.
A minute or two later, Hobert suddenly appeared in the bar.
His sudden appearance did not attract anyone's attention.
The letter that Bernadette had just sent was to ask Hobert to meet.
Hobert sat beside Bernadette: "It's been a long time since we met. How have you been lately?"
While speaking, he "tampered" with the surrounding environment, making it impossible for the people around to hear their voices.
"Not so good."
Bernadette did not hide her anxiety: "I have been looking for an opportunity to advance, but unfortunately, I have not found it."
Hobert was slightly stunned: "Didn't we prevent George III from advancing before? Wouldn't that count as an opportunity?"
Bernadette first gave Hobert a deep look, but then felt that it was not too surprising that Hobert knew the ritual for advancing to "Sage."
"I originally thought that was an opportunity too."
Bernadette took a deep breath: "But later I found out that it wasn't."
Hobert slowly nodded, and then asked: "You called me here, do you have any ideas?"
"I'm going to look for my father's last mausoleum in advance."
After many unsuccessful attempts to advance, Bernadette finally realized that her obsession with finding her father was the biggest obstacle to advancement.
"Alright then."
Hobert took off the black crystal jade pendant he carried with him: "This is a mystical item bestowed upon me by the 'Creator'. It can effectively isolate high-level corruption. I'll lend it to you for now."
"I will also provide you with some help. As long as you inject spirituality into this mystical item, I can sense your location."
Bernadette was not polite. She put away the mystical item: "Thank you."
"According to what I know, you probably can't save your father with your current strength."
Hobert added: "So don't be reckless. Before exploring the last mausoleum, remember to notify me first."
"Even if my abilities are not enough to solve the problem, the 'Creator' will definitely provide some help, but the price is that you need to give the 'Genie' in your hand in the future."
This condition made Bernadette breathe a sigh of relief. If the "Creator" hadn't offered any conditions, she wouldn't have been very relieved: "No problem."
Hobert nodded: "Then, get ready and set off."
"Yeah."
After speaking, Hobert got up and left.
Bernadette sadly drank the cocktail in her glass before suddenly getting up and returning to her Emerald Palace to make the final preparations for the voyage.
… …
Time came to April. The "Fool" descended an oracle to the people of Moon City, notifying them that they could pray and make wishes to him at the same time, so that they could get rid of the deformities of their bodies.
All the people of Moon City cheered because of this. They guessed that Mr. Fool intended to fulfill their wishes.
After having a new life, they wanted to become a normal person too much.
So, in the morning stipulated by the "Fool", they prayed to the "Fool" and then made wishes.
Above the gray mist, Klein, sitting at the head of the long bronze table, watched the prayers of the believers turn into pure spots of light in front of him, and then slowly flow, as if becoming a galaxy.
Klein took a deep breath, sensed the anchoring effect of these prayers on him, and then began to mobilize the "Sefirah Castle". Invisible power spread rapidly like ripples on the water surface, pouring into each prayer spot and sprinkling on the people of Moon City.
Every Moon City person seemed to feel something, and they raised their hands to touch their faces. They felt that their facial features were becoming normal, and at the same time, they saw the faces of the people around them quickly become no different from normal people.
They praised Mr. Fool from the bottom of their hearts, saluting in the direction of the Fool's Cathedral with their highest level of etiquette.
Dang—
At this time, throughout the entire New Lanagua City, the melodious bell from the church was heard, as if the "Fool" was responding to their praise.
Even Hobert, who was working in the palace in Angel City, hundreds of kilometers away, heard the bell. He instantly appeared on the roof of the palace, looking out at New Lanagua City, and then he suddenly understood what was going on.
Klein, the "Fool" above the gray mist, was quite surprised and at a loss. The sudden ringing of the bell was not his pre-set process at all.
He used the light spots of the believers' prayers to see the magnificent cathedral. In the belfry at the top, there was a young man wearing a pointed soft hat and a classic black robe.
This young man was holding a black bell hammer, striking the big bell again and again.
Seeming to notice the gaze from above, the young man paused for a moment and straightened the crystal monocle on his right eye.
"I…"
Klein almost cursed.
At this time, he didn't quite understand why the "Angel of Time" Amon would suddenly appear and was still seriously ringing the bell of his church?
Klein was somewhat psychologically prepared for the appearance of Amon or Xidro.
However, because he could get Hobert's rapid support, and City of Silver also had a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Klein was not afraid of their arrival.
However, Amon's current behavior made Klein quite confused.
… …
Inside the Fool's Cathedral, Derrick, the archbishop on duty today, also looked up in astonishment: I didn't arrange for anyone to ring the bell!
As a demigod in the Sun domain, he had a keen intuition for anomalies and knew that something must have gone wrong.
While using the Beyonder power of "Unshadowed" to examine the surrounding environment, Derrick quickly thought about whether ringing the bell had any symbolic meaning in mysticism.
After excluding one possibility after another, he suddenly remembered the relevant content about ringing the bell in the Fool's Holy Book compiled by City of Silver.
That was used to describe the relationship between the "Angel of Time" Amon and Mr. Fool. Because he was the "Angel of Time", Amon was the angel who summoned the believers, announced the end of the Mass, and corrected the time.
To put it bluntly, he was the angel who rang the bell for the "Fool".
Derrick, of course, disagreed with that description, as he was quite certain that Amon and "The Fool" were in an antagonistic relationship.
However, the lies he had previously told had led the people of City of Silver to believe that the "Angel of Time" was sent by Mr. Fool to bring the initial light to the forsaken land.
And Derrick realized that if he were to explain, it would easily lead to a loss of his positive image in the eyes of the public, similar to the "social death" mentioned by Miss Justice.
In the end, he chose to delay, believing that Mr. Fool would surely send down an oracle after seeing the holy book, providing suggestions for modification.
Who knew that Mr. Fool would not express anything at all, acquiescing to the content of the holy book.
Could it be that Amon rang the bell? Derrick was momentarily dazed, feeling that this was too unbelievable.
Thinking of this, he hurriedly prayed, reporting this matter to Mr. Fool.
As soon as he finished reporting, Derrick heard another more melodious bell ringing in the air, which was also very comfortable to the body and mind.
He hurried to the outside of the church, but his spirituality warned him not to look up. Immediately afterward, his spirituality outlined such a scene in his mind: a tall figure in mid-air was hitting a bronze bell that gave people a very heavy feeling.
All the surrounding "loopholes" disappeared, and the normal order was restored instantly.
Amon, at the top of the church, curled his lips: "So what if you have the 'Bell of Order'!"
