chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 719 The most serious extraordinary case since the founding of the country
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In New Lanagua City, Amon eliminated all the loopholes created throughout the Duchy of South Balam.
The most direct manifestation was that the chimes at the top of the Church of the Fool returned to normal, audible only within New Lanagua City.
Amon instantly lost interest, dropped the hammer, pinched his monocle, and released a hurricane he had stolen at some unknown time.
Like a feather, he floated away lightly, and after leaving the range of the "Bell of Order," he stole the distance and disappeared from the sight of "The Creator" and "The Fool."
Derrick at the church entrance sincerely thanked "The Creator." He took a deep breath, believing he must once again suggest revising a portion of the scriptures.
Above the gray fog, Klein thought: If Amon's father was Roselle, and not the Ancient Sun God, then I could reasonably assume he was "sending me a clock."
Then, he used "True Vision" to inspect the believers in New Lanagua City, confirming that no one had been parasitized by Amon.
Just as Klein was about to divine Amon's actions, he noticed that the star representing "The Sun" Derrick had lit up at some point. He had been focused on Amon's movements and hadn't noticed it.
Extending his spirituality, Klein was slightly stunned: "Scriptures?"
So, with a wave of his hand, he summoned the scriptures that City of Silver had sacrificed to him from the pile of junk.
Previously, he had only flipped through a few pages before becoming too embarrassed to continue reading.
Of course, he wasn't careless and remained cautious enough, using divination within the "Sefirah Castle" to confirm that the scriptures wouldn't bring him any actual harm.
Klein took a deep breath and flipped through the scriptures page by page. The muscles on his face gradually twitched, and he flipped faster and faster.
Snap!
Klein slammed the Fool's scriptures shut and threw them back into the pile of junk: What I don't know and don't pay attention to, doesn't exist.
… …
Inside Alger's palace.
Hobert had someone bring him a copy of the Fool's scriptures. After reading only a few pages, a smile couldn't help but appear on his face: "Mr. Azik is actually an angel who attends to the "Fool's" daily life, often providing help to the blessed because he is always by the "Fool's" side. Hahaha, my fault, my fault, I shouldn't have given the "Fool" the "Death" card…"
"Miss Messenger? Let me take a look. Oh, so she runs errands for the Fool, hmm, that fits the facts."
"Snake of Fate"… uh, this description is a bit like the "Fool's" pet!
"And the Angel of Retribution? Ah, it's Gehrman Sparrow. He's the only angel who actually works."
"Hahaha, the funniest is the "Angel of Time," who actually rings the bell. Fortunately, it's the Church of the Fool, not Notre Dame Cathedral."
Reading further, Hobert's face gradually darkened: When did I become so obsequious before the "Fool"? I'm still an Archangel, but it's as if I'm delivering takeout. I deliver whatever the "Fool" orders.
Wait, when did "The Creator" request to form an alliance with the "Fool"?
Snap!
Hobert slammed the scriptures shut, took two deep breaths, and then opened them again to tear off the sections about "The Creator" and the "Prince of Abolition," and called Donna to personally deliver these two pages to Derrick to express his dissatisfaction.
… …
Above the gray fog, Klein, after hearing Derrick's report about Donna delivering two pages of the "scriptures," thought: That's a normal person's reaction. Amon's reaction was definitely abnormal.
He pondered for a moment, feeling that this matter should be explained to Hobert by him, the "Angel of Retribution," in person, to avoid misunderstandings.
But this wasn't the most urgent matter. He had more important things to do now.
Returning to the real world, Klein arrived at an uninhabited island on the western side of the Southern Continent. This island belonged to the Felix Islands, a territory of the Duchy of South Balam.
Because it wasn't on a major shipping route, no one had come to develop it yet. There weren't even any natives on the island.
This was an island that Hobert had helped Klein find some time ago for setting up a ritual. Klein could unleash his full potential here.
In the midst of a large forest, Klein chose an open space and prayed sincerely to himself: "I wish for a city suitable for five thousand people to live in here."
Immediately afterward, Klein raised his right hand and snapped his fingers.
Suddenly, this open area became extremely flat, and the surrounding forest also "receded" a lot, providing a large amount of wood, stone, and soil.
Almost simultaneously, buildings rose from the ground, their architectural style resembling that of Angers in the Duchy of South Balam.
In the next second, residential buildings, libraries, police stations, telegraph offices, city halls, small hospitals, candy factories, waterworks, parallel railways, and so on were completed one after another. The streets were paved with cement or stone bricks.
Finally, a spire church emerged from the ground, a Church of the Evernight Goddess.
"I wish for this island to have a deep-water port," Klein made his second wish to himself.
He snapped his fingers again, fulfilling his wish.
About three kilometers away from the town, a small-scale port quickly took shape, with two docks, five warehouses, a harborside hotel, and a lighthouse.
Klein admired his masterpiece and walked into the church named Saint Ariana. After a while, figures appeared, their movements initially a little awkward, but becoming smoother as they walked.
Soon, they either turned onto different streets or stopped in the square, admiring the uninteresting scenery.
After a while, rats, cockroaches, mosquitoes, and other creatures crawled or flew out from inside.
Finally, a flock of white doves flew out and landed in the center of the square.
Everyone seemed to suddenly come to life completely. Some teased the doves, some played the zither, and some chatted with friends with smiles on their faces.
At this time, the local mayor wrote the name of the city on a wooden sign in front of the city hall: Utopia.
… …
On the avenue in the suburbs of Cevas, the capital of the Balam Empire.
A deserted dirt road suddenly became illusory. When the illusion disappeared, a convoy of more than a dozen brand-new trams suddenly appeared on the road.
In the middle of the convoy, Audrey, the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Duchy of South Balam, looked through the car window at the dilapidated city not far away, and was immediately disappointed in this empire that had existed for more than a thousand years.
In fact, after the fall of the "Underworld Emperor," the forces of the Northern Continent basically had no impact on the Southern Continent because the Berserk Sea had formed, so the Balam Empire supported itself for a period of time.
However, with the rise of the Highland Kingdom in the Star Highlands, the kingdom without the protection of the gods was given a final blow.
Then, the fertile Paz River Valley and the resource-rich and vast Agate region successively became independent, which later became the Paz Kingdom and Agate State.
At this time, Balam still called itself an empire, but whether it was territory or population, it was similar to the other three kingdoms.
Fortunately, the "Chained God" soon sealed himself to avoid the "Mother Tree of Desire," giving the Balam Empire a chance to breathe.
Later, Si Er became the leader of the "Rose School of Thought," and the "Pale Empress" happened to be promoted in time, so the Balam Empire did not fully perish.
This chaotic situation continued until the arrival of the colonial era more than a hundred years ago. Loen and Intis first joined forces to destroy the Paz Kingdom, which had fertile land.
Then, they wantonly occupied the territories of the Balam Empire and the Highland Kingdom, and divided the Southern Continent into East Balam and West Balam according to the wishes of the people of the Northern Continent.
The Agate State still has a royal court, but it has completely become a puppet of the Loen people, and the nobles of this kingdom have become agents of the colonizers at all levels.
Under the attack of the colonizers, the Balam Empire and the Highland Kingdom were left with only a small piece of territory that was easy to defend and difficult to attack, struggling to survive.
Now, the Northern Continent has just finished a world war, and the extraordinary power has been severely weakened. The Balam Empire, which has not participated in the war, has gradually become the object of wooing by various countries in the Northern Continent.
They need this dying empire to help them block the rising Duchy of South Balam, so as to give the countries of the Northern Continent a chance to breathe.
It happened that Hobert was also in a stage of forbearance at this time, and completely ignored the Balam Empire's unwarranted provocations, and sent Audrey to the capital of the Balam Empire to conclude a peace treaty.
This made the Balam Empire feel that it was okay again, and the letter of credence sent to Hobert was also written very arrogantly.
Although there was a translation in Loen, Hobert pretended not to understand it and continued to implement his appeasement foreign policy.
Because at this time, he was already making the final preparations for the war, and of course he would not destroy Medici's battle plan because of this.
Outside of Cevas, Santos, the Prime Minister of the Balam Empire, who had received prior notice, was already waiting at the city gate to welcome the special envoy from the Southern Balam Duchy.
An empire and a duchy are not countries of the same level. However, while the Balam Empire was arrogant, it would not ignore the strength displayed by the Southern Balam Duchy, so they tacitly agreed to receive the special envoy as if they were from a country of the same level.
When Santos saw the neat row of trams arriving, as a Beyonder, he was initially shocked. For a moment, he didn't even know if this was advanced technology or some kind of mystical item?
The tram stopped in front of him, and Audrey, dressed in a Southern Balam-style long dress and wearing a veiled hat, stepped out, making Santos feel even more inferior.
Southern Balam-style clothing is mainly based on the Loen style, but also incorporates the characteristics of clothing from Eastern and Western Bayam and parts of the Star Highlands. It is not only beautiful and elegant, but also removes the cumbersome elements of Loen noble attire, making it very practical.
The clothing worn by Santos, a nobleman, was also simple in style and had almost no embroidery, making it look very monotonous.
In addition, the industrial systems of the two countries were also vastly different. Most of the embroidery on Audrey's clothes was done with the most exquisite embroidery machines currently available, and the fabrics were excellent and the dyes were vibrant.
The fabrics of the Balam Empire were all local homespun cloth. The fabric for Santos's clothes was bought after being dyed in the Northern Continent, but the workmanship was far inferior to Audrey's clothes.
Of course, there was also a very crucial reason: Audrey's beauty and generosity made Santos feel a little uneasy. He felt that speaking in Bayamese would be offensive to this lady, but speaking in Loenese would not conform to diplomatic conventions.
Taking a deep breath, the Prime Minister of the Empire took a few steps forward and welcomed Audrey's arrival in Loenese with a smile.
After resting for a day, the "Pale Empress," sitting on her high throne, briefly met with Audrey, and then the negotiations between the two sides officially began.
The person responsible for the talks with Audrey was Santos, the Prime Minister of the Balam Empire.
Currently, the biggest obstacle to the conclusion of a peace treaty between the two sides lies in the demarcation of the national border.
In fact, they were arguing over a few small towns. Hobert was easy to talk to in other areas, but he would not budge an inch on territorial matters, not even a village or a hill.
The Balam Empire did not value the border line that much. The reason they were still acting so aggressively was to make the Southern Balam Duchy concede.
Or rather, they valued the fact that the Southern Balam Duchy would concede to them in this negotiation.
As a result, the negotiations fell into a stalemate. After about ten days of talks, there was no progress at all.
The Balam Empire was not worried about this. They felt that the Southern Balam Duchy was gradually being isolated in Backlund and, under pressure from the countries of the Northern Continent, they could no longer afford to be enemies with the Balam Empire.
Therefore, they believed that the Southern Balam Duchy would definitely compromise.
However, what they didn't know was that the current world situation had already exceeded their understanding.
Audrey was not worried either. Before setting off, Hobert had told her that the core strategy of this negotiation was to delay, to delay as long as possible.
By the time the spring plowing was over, there would be no need for peace talks. Hobert would use the Duchy's army to negotiate with the Balam Empire.
Last year's spring plowing started in mid-June. It is said that this year the "Creator" plans to start the spring plowing at the end of May.
…
Southern Balam Duchy, Monte Senas.
This is the capital of Akon, approaching the southernmost tip of this continent.
While Audrey was negotiating with the Balam Empire, a huge blizzard swept through here. The dark clouds were very low, and the cold wind howled, as if it wanted to sweep away everything on the earth.
Governor Docker sat in his warm office, watching the harsh weather outside, and took a sip of hot coffee.
He had already received news that the weather would start to warm up in about half a month at most, that is, in mid-May, and spring plowing would begin at the end of May!
In previous years, there were four or five months of winter here, but this year's winter was reduced by half, directly turning into two and a half months.
Knock knock knock~
Someone knocked on the door.
Docker put down his coffee cup: "Come in."
The governor's secretary opened a crack in the door and said, "Governor, Mr. Gabriel is here."
Docker was slightly stunned. Gabriel was the official Beyonder officer of Monte Senas, also known internally as the "Beyonder Mayor", one level below Docker, but they did not belong to the same system.
"Quick, invite him in."
"Governor, hello." Half a minute later, Gabriel took off his hat, which still had some snow on it, and walked in: "It's really cold today."
Docker poured him a cup of hot coffee: "Yes, according to the locals, this is the coldest winter in recent years."
The two sat down in the office, and Gabriel, who had a small mustache, said: "I am here to ask you to issue a notice throughout the city."
Docker was stunned again: "What notice?"
Generally speaking, official Beyonders do not interfere with the government's administration.
Gabriel said seriously: "You must not sleep during the day. If you have to sleep, you must sleep under the supervision of at least three people. If someone talks in their sleep at night, tie them up immediately and call the police immediately."
Docker looked at Gabriel. These requirements were too strange. If Gabriel's expression wasn't so serious, he would have thought the other party was joking.
Gabriel added: "We may be under a Beyonder attack."
Officials at the governor level have undergone some Beyonder training, so Gabriel did not hide anything: "Since a few days ago, there have been more than a dozen very similar Beyonder cases intermittently.
"At first, there was only one or two cases a day. As time went on, the frequency of cases increased. Before 10 o'clock today, there have already been three cases.
"These cases are similar. The victims all die suddenly in their sleep, and their bodies turn into Zombies. The Zombies have caused dozens of casualties.
"Also because there are more victims, we have summarized the process of the victims' deaths. First, they fall asleep for no reason during the day.
"People who fall asleep alone die in their sleep, while those who are watched by three or more people successfully escape.
"Also, when resting at night, if someone suddenly starts talking in their sleep incessantly, it means that they are under some kind of Beyonder ability.
"If we can get there as soon as possible, we may still be able to save them, but if we can't get there, the other party will soon turn into a Zombie with extremely high aggressiveness."
Governor Docker frowned when he heard this. Such a way of being victimized was completely beyond his imagination.
Gabriel said seriously: "This is the biggest Beyonder case since the founding of the country. I hope the government can pay attention to it!"
"Okay, I will send someone to issue a notice throughout the city." Docker asked again: "What is the progress of the case investigation?"
"We haven't found any clues to the murderer yet." Gabriel took a deep breath: "But don't worry, the 'Overseer' of the Southern County has arrived. I believe the case will be solved by noon at the latest."
At first, Gabriel thought that this should be a case involving the "Sleepless" pathway, but as the investigation unfolded, he found that it was not quite like that, but rather like a case related to the "Death" pathway.
The victims were not forcibly put to sleep, but their spiritual bodies were severely damaged, and their bodies had sudden sleep or sleep-talking stress reactions.
Yesterday, Gabriel had asked the "Beyonder Governor" of Akron to come and help investigate the case, but that Sequence 5 governor found that he still could not find the root of the problem after investigating all night.
But the frequency of cases is still increasing, so he requested the help of the "Prefect".
The "Overseer" of the Southern County is a "Earl of the Fallen" who arrived this morning and is investigating the case.
But so far, it is still impossible to confirm whether this is a deliberate Beyonder attack? Or has a Sealed Artifact of a Beyonder hiding here lost control?
But with the help of a demigod, Gabriel believes that the case will be solved soon.
Docker nodded: "I wish you success soon!
"Time is tight, I won't keep you here for coffee."
Gabriel nodded, he didn't plan to stay any longer.
Governor Docker sent Gabriel to the door, and in front of this "Beyonder Mayor", he called the secretary in and ordered her to write a notice immediately.
The two returned to the desk, and Governor Docker relayed the content of the notice.
The secretary was a little puzzled by the content of the notice, but she still went out to write it immediately.
Docker was about to continue drinking his coffee, but found that the coffee was already cold, and he noticed that the warm office was rapidly cooling down, and he could actually exhale white mist.
He put on a coat, a bad feeling creeping over him.
Just then, Docker heard the secretary, who had just gone out, say, "Mr. Gabriel, why... why are you standing here asleep?"
Docker felt the hairs on the back of his neck stand on end. He ran outwards while shouting, "Quick, open the door, get some people to watch him!"
"Ah!"
Before he could even get out the door, he heard a scream from outside.
Docker immediately stopped and ran back, opened the second drawer, and took out the pistol inside.
Clang!
Docker looked up. The office door was wide open. The secretary who had just left was lying in a pool of blood, chest a mangled mess, convulsing.
Gabriel was nowhere to be seen.
Docker took a deep breath, released the safety on the pistol, pointed it towards the door, and rushed towards the window as fast as he could.
Creak~
Suddenly, Docker heard a strange sound behind him.
Just as he was about to turn the gun towards the back, he suddenly felt something hit him in the back. Then, something seemed to emerge from his chest.
Docker seemed to understand. He lowered his head slightly and saw a hand covered in blood protruding from his chest. The hand was emitting a faint heat, and his heart was still throbbing.
The next second, the hand and heart were withdrawn, and Docker fell to the ground, powerless.
In the last moment of his life, he saw Gabriel, who had been polite just moments before, with only the whites of his eyes showing. He was gnawing on the secretary's heart, half of his face covered in blood, while his other hand clutched Docker's heart.
This was no longer a person, but a monster.
...
The capital of the Balam Empire, Sevas City.
Yesterday, Santos, the Prime Minister of the Balam Empire, had issued harsh words, telling Audrey to go back and "reflect" on things, so negotiations did not continue today.
Audrey was leisurely reading a book in the residence arranged for her.
Suddenly, she noticed that her surroundings had become much colder. Then, her spirituality sensed something, so she got up and put down the book.
At this moment, she saw two not-very-large bronze doors appearing in front of her.
Immediately afterward, an immense pressure descended, causing Audrey to subconsciously lower her head.
At the same time, she knew who had come, so she bowed slightly and said, "Your Majesty, the Empress."
The pale-faced, expressionless "Pale Empress" Sia Palenque Eggers emerged from the two bronze doors. The "Underworld Gate" behind her immediately closed.
"This is your last chance," Sia said in a chilling voice.
Audrey paused slightly, not quite understanding what the "Pale Empress" meant, but knowing the essentials of negotiation, she did not ask.
Suah had no choice but to continue, "If you give up the entire Highland region, I will help you solve the problem."
She sneered. "This is the price you pay for your arrogance."
Only then did Audrey ask, "What problem?"
"Go investigate it yourselves."
Audrey, with her head lowered, was silent for a second or two before saying, "You're not very clear either, are you?"
Sia snorted coldly, said nothing, and left through the Underworld.
Although the room was still very cold, the immense mental pressure was gone.
Audrey smiled. It seemed she had guessed correctly. If the Balam Empire truly had some irresistible deterrent, they would have used it already.
But the fact that the "Pale Empress" personally came to remind her of this matter still indicated the special nature of the situation.
It was very likely that the higher-ups of the Balam Empire had also suddenly noticed that a major event was happening in the South Balam Duchy, and that Beyonders of the "Death" pathway could solve this problem relatively easily, which was why the "Pale Empress" had personally come to engage in strategic blackmail?
Or perhaps they had noticed what was happening long ago, but had not paid attention to it. Now, the matter was beyond their control, but fortunately, the event had broken out on the territory of the South Balam Duchy.
In any case, anything that could make a Sequence 1 personally engage in blackmail must be a major event!
With this judgment, Audrey immediately prayed to the "Creator" and reported the matter.
Two or three minutes later, the space in front of Audrey became illusory again. Beverly, wearing a circular jade pendant made of black crystal, emerged from the spirit world: "Madam, the Grand Duke has sent me to escort you back home."
Audrey immediately asked, "Has anything unusual happened at home?"
"It's not very clear yet," Beverly explained. "However, the Grand Duke judges that it should be related to a large-scale Beyonder case in the Akon region. The Grand Duke has already rushed to the scene, which is why he ordered me to escort you."
Audrey asked again, "Can Hobert solve the problem? Or rather, does this problem require a high-sequence Beyonder of a certain pathway to solve?"
Then, she briefly recounted the "Pale Empress's" threat.
Beverly suddenly smiled. "You may not have such a deep understanding of the 'Lawyer' pathway."
"As long as it is a problem that the 'Pale Empress' level can solve, the Grand Duke can definitely solve it too."
Audrey slowly nodded, but after considering it, she said, "I want to stay here."
Then, she explained to Beverly, "The Akon region is Hobert's battlefield, and this place is my battlefield.
"I want to question the Balam Empire authorities as to why they had already noticed the potential Beyonder case in advance, but did not remind us."
Beverly frowned. "They had already noticed it?"
"I can't be sure, but that's how I can question them!" Audrey, already a veteran diplomat, pursed her lips.
This was very much to Beverly's liking: "Wait a moment."
She took out a small glass bottle with a ball of red flame inside and injected spirituality into it.
Soon, two hands burning with flames tore open the real world, and Raymond came to his sister's side.
Together, these siblings dared to confront any Sequence 1.
In addition, in any faction, once they reach the level of an angel, their autonomy is very high.
Unless the "Creator" personally issues an order, they can make certain adjustments to their tasks based on their own judgment.
At this moment, Beverly thought: Hobert told me to safely escort Audrey back, but he didn't say when Audrey should go back, as long as Audrey is safe.
However, I still have to report to Hobert through prayer. If he doesn't insist, then I will follow my own ideas.
Soon, she received feedback from Hobert, expressing respect for Audrey's choice, and instructing the three of them that if there was any danger, they should leave immediately.
Then, Beverly asked Audrey, "What are we going to do next?"
Audrey said, "Accompany me to question the 'Pale Empress'."
"Haha, no problem."
...
After hearing Audrey's prayer, Hobert, of course, did not intend to let the "Pale Empress" help. He was even less likely to hand over the territory he had worked so hard to take.
If he really needed the Sequence 1 level ability of the "Death" pathway, Hobert would rather go to Bernadette and borrow the Sealed Artifact in her hand that corresponded to the "Pale Emperor."
He made some preparations and immediately rushed to the Akon region.
In the spirit world, Hobert felt the restlessness of the spirit world creatures here, which made him realize that the impact of this extraordinary event must be significant.
Just as he arrived in the suburbs of Monteson Port from the spirit world, Hobert received another prayer from Beverly, learning of Audrey's plan.
With Beverly and her brother by Audrey's side, Hobert didn't have to worry about Audrey's safety, so after giving a response, he began to observe Monteson Port from afar.
This port city in the heavy snow gave people a very cold feeling. The temperature seemed to be close to that of Antarctica.
In addition, Hobert felt the aura of death, as if the city in front of him could turn into a city of the dead at any time!
Hobert pondered for a moment, first "weakening" the ongoing, powerful blizzard.
The cold wind and heavy snow immediately disappeared, leaving only a few snowflakes still falling to the ground.
Immediately afterward, Hobert waved his hand towards the sky, and the oppressive dark clouds immediately cracked, and the sun shone on the earth, with the snowflakes reflecting a little bit of light, making the surroundings look a little dreamlike.
The temperature gradually rose, gradually becoming normal, but the aura of death did not weaken in any way.
Hobert then "distorted" the aura of death. Although he easily completed the corresponding operation, the aura of death quickly enveloped the city again.
He roughly understood that he had to find the source of the aura of death, otherwise, no matter how he "distorted" it, the aura of death would quickly replenish itself.
So, Hobert took a step, the distance being "distorted" by Him. When his raised foot touched the ground, He had already appeared in the Beyonder Affairs Bureau of this city.
Only two Beyonders remained on duty here, peering out of the hall's windows.
It had been a blizzard just moments ago, but now it suddenly cleared up, a rare sight not just for ordinary people, but for most Beyonders as well.
Hobert didn't disturb them, sitting down in the reception area of the hall.
A dozen seconds later, Ted Balk, the "Earl of the Fallen," who had received the news through the "Mystical Switchboard System" just as Hobert had set off, rushed in from outside: "Your Grace."
The two remaining Beyonders then noticed that Duke Hobert was already sitting on the sofa in the reception area, and they quickly came over to salute.
Hobert waved his hand at them and asked Ted, "How is the investigation going?"
"We have confirmed that the spiritual bodies of some people have mutated, which is why they suddenly turned into Zombies," Ted reported succinctly. "I suspect that there might be a Underworld Gate hidden in this city."
"This gate was previously sealed, but now it has been opened by some people with ulterior motives."
Hobert first praised him: "A very reasonable guess."
Then He added: "I have just learned a very important piece of information. The 'Pale Empress' of the Balam Empire seems to know the cause of this matter."
Ted, who was in his thirties, was slightly taken aback: "Did they do it?"
Hobert shook his head: "Things may not be that simple."
Then He asked, "How many people are there in this city?"
Ted looked at the two local official Beyonders next to him. One of the official Beyonders said, "About 30,000 people."
Because winter lasts about 5 months each year here, the population is not large to begin with.
After the Southern Balam Duchy occupied this place, it had not yet had time to transfer immigrants here on a large scale, so the capital of this state only had 30,000 people.
Hobert pondered for a moment and said, "Issue a notice to the state government and the city government that I am now taking over here, and let them quickly organize people to evacuate all the ordinary people here."
"The evacuation method is: gather all the people in the square, and I will send them away."
Ted was slightly stunned, suddenly realizing that the situation seemed more serious than he had imagined.
Then he reacted, telling one of the two Beyonders next to him to recall his subordinates, and the other to do the corresponding prayers and notifications.
Hobert also used the "Beyonder Communication System" to directly contact the Southern County government and the Duchy government, asking them to prepare to receive the refugees here.
Currently, the entire southern part of the Southern Balam Duchy is in a state of freezing cold. It is necessary to prepare enough food, tents, heating materials, etc., and resettle them, which requires the cooperation of higher-level governments.
After giving the orders, Hobert came to the roof, looking at the streets outside, the aura of death was getting stronger and stronger!
He took out the uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" pathway from the "Nation of Disorder" and waved it towards the ice and snow-covered city, fundamentally "altering" the concept of death in this city.
The increasingly strong aura of death was finally temporarily contained, but the negative effect of doing so was that the elderly and patients in hospitals or some homes, who were originally about to return to the Land of the Dead, could not die. They had to leave here before they could complete the process of death.
Hobert was very clear that such "tampering" could only last for a while, so it was necessary to complete the evacuation as soon as possible.
He did not participate in the action of gathering all the residents, but began to look for the connection between this place and the underworld.
In Hobert's vision, this place was only full of the aura of death, but he could not see where the entrance was?
So, He used Mr. Azik's mark and used the ability of "Connection" to search.
After using the ability of "Connection," Hobert found that the surrounding light seemed to dim a lot, which made Him frown slightly, not understanding why there would be such a reaction.
But in the next second, Hobert's eyes widened: As far as the eye could see! They were all entrances to the underworld!
Where was this an entrance? It was completely the underworld about to appear in the real world!
Then Hobert felt a little strange, why would such a thing happen?
After thinking for a while, He couldn't think of any clues.
So, He decided not to think about it for now, because at the current evacuation speed, it was too late, so He "distorted" his voice, so that people within two hundred kilometers could hear: "Take five minutes to put on your cotton clothes, bring some food and winter items! Five minutes later, I will take you away from here."
With Hobert's current ability, He could completely "distort" all creatures within such a large range to other places.
But this would definitely cause a certain degree of panic, so if the situation was not already very serious, He would not want to do this.
Fortunately, the winter population of Akon region is not large, and a large part of the population is concentrated in the city, and the people in the countryside are also nesting in their homes.
Except for individual cases of hunting or cutting trees outside, they should be able to prepare within five minutes.
Of course, some people will definitely panic, and some people will definitely not understand, but these are not important anymore, send everyone out first.
During these five minutes, Hobert confirmed two resettlement locations with the Duchy government, and then a large-scale evacuation operation began!
Hobert first "distorted" a part of the residents of Monteson Port and sent them to Rockville City, hundreds of kilometers away.
Then, He "distorted" the villagers in the surrounding villages to gather in the city square first, and then sent them to Angel City, thousands of kilometers away, together with the remaining residents of Monteson Port.
The city suddenly became quiet. Hobert once again "distorted" his voice so that the whole city could hear: "Official Beyonders, bring the corresponding sealed items, and all immediately retreat through the teleportation array!"
Hobert planned to stay alone to investigate how to prevent this change.
But He soon discovered that when the aura of living people weakened, the speed at which the underworld merged with the real world suddenly became faster, and the light in the entire city suddenly dimmed, as if night had come early.
Hobert immediately gathered all the Beyonders in the city together, but it was still one step too late. The spiritual bodies of two Beyonders were affected by the underworld and mutated, turning into Zombies on the spot.
He immediately appeared next to these official Beyonders, using his angelic aura to protect their spiritual bodies.
Then Hobert discovered that his "distortion" or "tampering" could only send them deeper into the underworld.
The underworld had already merged with the city to a certain extent!
"Go to the teleportation array!" Hobert said immediately. The next second, they appeared in front of the teleportation array.
Hobert pointed at the teleportation array, injecting spirituality into the teleportation array from the air. Although the teleportation array was activated, Hobert's spirituality sensed that this teleportation array would not be able to teleport the people behind Him to the outside world.
Theoretically speaking, the underworld is a part of the spirit world, and the teleportation array should not fail.
Then Hobert realized: The underworld had undergone some kind of change.
At this time, everyone's spirituality seemed to realize something and was about to look up, but Hobert took the first step and used "distortion" to turn their willingness to look up into looking down.
Their spiritualities realized one after another that the scene above their heads was very dangerous for them!
Hobert was the only one here who would not be seriously affected. He glanced up. The roof had become transparent at some point, and He could see the scene in the air from here.
He frowned: "That's... that's Calderon?"

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 720: The Mutated "City of the Dead" Calderon
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Appearing in mid-air was a massive city "suspended" in the void.
The city was high on all sides and low in the middle, with buildings extending in circles towards the end of the deep pit, giving the overall impression of an inverted mausoleum.
The buildings within it were of various styles, but all equally strange. Some were towering, pale stone pillars with huge stone houses carved out at the top. Others were rectangular prisms without windows, their doors on the roof. Some were built underground, with a tombstone erected at the entrance, while others were constructed from white bones, appearing quite chaotic.
The closer to the central pit, the better the buildings were preserved. The closer to the top, the more buildings had collapsed, filled with the decay and ruin brought by time.
Hobert's first reaction was that it was the "City of the Dead," Calderon, but a Calderon that had undergone some kind of mutation.
Then he glanced at the official Beyonders beside him. Apart from Ted and two Sequence 5s, most were "low-sequence" Beyonders.
If left unattended, even Ted could die here.
Hobert pondered for a moment and said to them, "Don't leave my side. Let me think of a way."
Then he pretended to think, trying to enter the "Nation of Disorder." Fortunately, it was possible to enter the "Nation of Disorder" from here.
However, even using the "Creator's" "True Sight," he couldn't see where the boundary between the Underworld and the real world was. He could only see the Underworld gradually eroding Port Monteson, with more and more of the real world being swallowed by the Underworld.
Hobert used the "Nation of Disorder" to enhance his own spirituality and also sensed that the Underworld, or rather, the Calderon above, had undergone some mutation.
Moreover, his spirituality realized that the "Creator" could transfer Ted and the others to the real world, but could only send their physical bodies out. Their spiritual bodies would still remain here, tantamount to killing them.
This made Hobert frown: The power of the "Nation of Disorder" couldn't penetrate the mutated Underworld?
Then he suddenly thought: In the deepest part of Calderon, there seemed to be a tributary of the "River of Eternal Darkness." It was very likely that the "River of Eternal Darkness" was blocking the power of the "Nation of Disorder."
Sitting on the "Iron Throne," Hobert sighed: In other words, purely using force wouldn't be able to stop the current mutation.
So he first returned to the real world and glanced at the Beyonders behind him. Many "low-sequence" Beyonders were already freezing, their lips turning purple.
With a wave of his hand, Hobert "tampered" with their state, turning them into a state of Zombies and wraiths. This way, they would temporarily no longer be harmed by the surrounding environment.
But if the "tampering" lasted too long, they might really turn into Zombies or wraiths in this environment.
The official Beyonders all breathed a sigh of relief. Although their faces were pale and their expressions were stiff at this time, making them look more like corpses, at least they didn't have to resist the surrounding aura of the dead.
"Fortunately, this port is not a Calderon in the strict sense," Hobert said with a smile.
If everyone had immediately fallen into that "City of the Dead," these Beyonders would have died in an instant.
Hobert glanced outside and found that the buildings of Port Monteson were gradually becoming dim, as if they were gradually losing their own colors.
In the gray buildings, streaks of pale white lights suddenly appeared, indicating that the city was gradually being assimilated by the Underworld.
"Now we are facing such a problem," Hobert briefly described the problems they were currently encountering, but of course, information about the Sephirot could not be revealed to them.
Hobert wanted to get everyone to help him think about this problem: "My idea is that the Spirit World suddenly descending on the real world must have a reason.
"Next, while we look for clues, help me think about what this reason might be?"
For a time, everyone was eager to try, not expecting to be able to participate in such a high-level event and serve as the Duke's advisor.
Hobert led everyone out of the building with the teleportation array and came to the streets outside.
When they first entered the street, there was nothing, but soon, there were shadows on the street, moving back and forth with dull eyes, as if imitating the residents of the city.
Gradually, they became more and more solid, one by one, rotting humans or monsters with only skeletons left.
They were no longer so dull either, suddenly stopping their wandering and looking at Hobert and the dozen or so people.
Hobert stretched out his palm, revealing the mark Mr. Azik had given him.
This seemed to be a proof of identity. The surrounding undead all bowed to Hobert, which greatly surprised Ted and the others, suddenly giving them the illusion that they were important figures in the world of the dead.
Hobert and the others walked forward, and the undead in front also bowed one after another, while the undead behind them stood up one after another.
At this time, Ted behind him suddenly said, "Duke, besides us looking for clues and reasons ourselves, do we have other ways to obtain information?"
Hobert was slightly stunned: "That's a good idea."
He had only been thinking about not asking the "Pale Empress" for help, but that didn't mean he couldn't get information from her!
"You guys wait a moment." Hobert made a praying gesture, actually entering the "Nation of Disorder" to briefly describe his situation to Audrey, to see if she had any channels to get some information?
… …
The capital of the Balam Empire, Cevas.
Audrey was waiting in a side hall of the palace, with Beverly and Raymond behind her.
She had just questioned the "Pale Empress": "Does the Beyonder event that happened in our country mean a formal declaration of war by the Balam Empire?
"You are also countries that signed the treaty. Now your actions are a sneak attack! We will file a protest with the League of Nations and condemn your behavior in the international community."
This question hit the current weak spot of the Balam Empire. The current empire values its image in the international community very much.
It's like a person who is used to being inferior suddenly realizing that someone is paying attention to him, then he will definitely care about his image.
Of course, the "Pale Empress" didn't take such questioning to heart at all, but the ministers present cared very much.
The "Pale Empress" was similar to Hobert, only concerned with the general direction of strategy, and had long since stopped asking about such routine management affairs. These affairs were basically taken care of by the ministers.
So Prime Minister Santos said that they did not know the specific situation and asked Audrey to wait a moment in the side hall. He promised to give Audrey a satisfactory answer.
Audrey was considering how to bring this matter to the current negotiations and put herself on the moral high ground when a majestic figure sitting in a thicket of swords suddenly appeared before her eyes.
Immediately afterwards, the scene in front of her turned into Hobert's figure. He briefly described the problems he was currently encountering and asked Audrey to inquire about information as much as possible.
Audrey thought for a moment, first came up with a plan, and then asked the waiter outside to invite Prime Minister Santos here.
Four or five minutes later, Santos came to the side hall: "We believe that this incident has nothing to do with us. We can provide the League of Nations with relevant evidence.
"But if you need our help, as neighbors, we will of course lend a helping hand, but the question is what kind of reward can you give."
Audrey shook her head, looking disappointed: "Is this the sense of responsibility of a great power?"
Santos smiled and said: "We have already issued a statement, severing all ties with the 'Underworld Faction,' and will not be responsible for any actions.
"This is documented and verifiable. I can bring the relevant documents."
Audrey seemed to understand something: "Doesn't the 'Underworld Faction' support your Empress?"
"Those lunatics even live in the Underworld!" Santos spread his hands and explained: "I haven't seen anyone from the 'Underworld Faction' for a long time."
Audrey observed Santos's expression and body language while using her abilities to follow up on this topic: "Okay, I have been successfully persuaded by you, because I also suspect that this may be the work of the 'Underworld Faction.'
"But I need to report this matter to the Duchy government. It's not enough for just me to believe you. You still have to provide some evidence."
"What evidence is there to provide?" Santos was unaware that he was providing Audrey with information: "The purpose of the 'Underworld Faction' is to merge the Underworld with the real world. They believe that in this way, Beyonders of the 'Death' pathway can become the masters of this world.
"So they have been researching the 'City of the Dead.'"
Audrey appropriately showed her desire for knowledge: "I am very curious about their research results."
"I am also very curious." Santos said under Audrey's subtle guidance: "I heard that they have been trying to become residents of the 'City of the Dead' while maintaining their sanity.
"I also heard that they explored a very powerful force in the 'City of the Dead,' but I don't know what that force is."
Audrey nodded and talked about another question: "In order to give the Duchy government enough reference, please tell me, if we ask for your help, how would you help us?
"You should be clear that they also need to assess your help and then make a decision."
"That's for sure." Santos turned his head and signaled his guards to close the door before whispering: "For us, this matter is not very difficult to solve, because our angels can freely walk around the periphery of Calderon City in a short period of time.
"If something unusual happens there, they can also use their abilities to help us find the people from the 'Underworld Faction' and obtain more information. This way, we can know how to stop the Underworld's encroachment on the real world."
Audrey nodded thoughtfully, "I will report this to my superiors."
"Hopefully, you can also discuss the issue of compensation while you're at it," Santos said with a smile. "We're not greedy, we only hope to obtain a portion of your Star Highlands territory."
"I think our compensation will be to demand reparations from you," Audrey's expression suddenly changed. "You and the 'Underworld Faction are both Beyonder forces of the Numinous Episcopate."
"I will temporarily refrain from making any statements about you distancing yourselves from the 'Underworld Faction,' but I'm not so sure about the attitude of the Church of the Evernight Goddess."
"I need to remind you that the God of Combat has already fallen."
"If I were you, I wouldn't be so impolite to the Southern Balam Kingdom, which has close cooperation with the Church of the Evernight Goddess."
Santos opened his mouth, not only marveling at how quickly the special envoy's face could change, but also because Audrey's words once again struck a nerve with Santos and the other ministers, or rather, the "Pale Empress's" concerns.
Previously, the Church of the Evernight Goddess allowed so many Beyonders of adjacent pathways to operate in the Southern Continent because their main enemy was the Church of the God of Combat.
The reason why the Balam Empire has been working so hard to integrate into the international social system of the Northern Continent after the war is to find opportunities to use the power of other Churches to restrain the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
This has been their core strategy for some time, but they didn't expect Audrey to reveal it so bluntly.
"Alright, please leave now. I will give you a reply later," Audrey sent off the somewhat surprised Santos and conveyed the information she had learned to Hobert through the "Mystical Switchboard System."
… …
Port Montenson.
After hearing Audrey's information, Hobert roughly understood the ins and outs of the matter.
He looked up again at the city of Calderón above him. As long as they were demigod-level Beyonders, they could operate on the edge of this city, so theoretically, the "Pale Empress" should be able to delve deeper into the city.
But if she went too deep, she would be more easily eroded by the "River of Eternal Darkness."
Now that he knew the cause, it was easy to handle. Hobert didn't even need to borrow sealed artifacts from Bernadette. He could walk unhindered there by using the "0-73" Death Domain.
Even without the "Death Domain," with the protection of the "Nation of Disorder's" power, he could even enter the very center of the "City of the Dead."
But it was meaningless for him to go there, and he suddenly thought of a better way.
Hobert smiled and said to Ted and the others, "'Many hands make light work.' Ted's reminder just now gave me another key piece of information. Now, I will find you a safe place first, and then I will go explore on my own."
Ted was a little embarrassed to be praised, and the others were happy for Ted, seeing that they were not so useless after all.
As they spoke, many heavy coffins near the core of the "City of the Dead" suddenly floated out. When they reached the middle of Calderón City and Port Montenson, the coffins made some noises like machines that had not been maintained for a long time, "creak, creak."
The coffin lids slowly opened, and phoenixs with some pale, illusory feathers flew out from inside.
The undead of Port Montenson also underwent changes. The undead wandering on the streets gradually transformed from ordinary humans into giants with a large vertical pupil on their faces, looking somewhat simple and honest; Sanguine, over two meters tall, handsome, and somewhat arrogant; and elves, who didn't look very easy to mess with, tall and sturdy.
The wandering monsters also changed from some common extraordinary monsters into huge magic wolves, demons with goat horns and wings, and werewolves whose eyes still flashed with madness.
These monsters no longer saluted Hobert, who had a special mark, and occasionally sized up the group, wondering why they were so small.
The anomalies in the "City of the Dead" seemed to be getting worse and worse.
At this time, an phoenix suddenly landed on a building on the Port Montenson side, and many illusory bricks and tiles were shattered and fell to the ground.
The phoenix with pale, illusory feathers opened its mouth and spat out a mouthful of white flames, and the surrounding undead creatures avoided it!
The white flames spread out in front of Hobert and the others, forming a not-very-high wall of fire.
Ted and the others were on high alert, ready to protect themselves when the Archduke dealt with the phoenix.
Hobert raised his hand to signal them not to be nervous. The "Tampering" of an Archangel was not so easily seen through. At this time, in the eyes of the undead creatures, they were no different from normal undead.
The phoenix turned its head to look at Hobert and asked in an ancient language that Hobert could understand in a hoarse voice, "Whose subordinates are you?"
This was the "Language of the Undead," which all creatures with souls could understand.
Hobert had a flash of inspiration: "'God of the Dead,' Salinger."
The phoenix was slightly stunned: "That feathered serpent is dead too?"
Hobert said solemnly: "Yes."
The phoenix said nothing more, and with a slight flap of its wings, the pale white wall of fire in front of Hobert and the others disappeared: "Pay attention to everything around you, I have a bad feeling."
Seeing that the other party was about to leave, Hobert quickly asked: "Your Excellency, why were we… awakened?"
He didn't know if his wording was correct, but it seemed that the "City of the Dead" had awakened some ancient souls.
The phoenix said as it took off: "Because our progenitor is about to be resurrected, rejoice! His kingdom will return!"
Hobert's eyes narrowed: The ancient Death is about to be resurrected! What kind of research did those guys from the "Underworld Faction" do here?
Without delay, Hobert immediately led Ted and the others into the nearby city hall.
At this time, inside the spacious city hall, a pale white ghost fire illuminated the surroundings, making it particularly eerie.
Several illusory shadows hid in the corners, as if they were going to settle down here.
Hobert took out a piece of "Order Crystal" and handed it to Ted, and told him how to use the barrier formed by the "Power of Order."
"Your state may change a bit later, don't panic, that's a chain reaction caused by me looking for members of the 'Underworld Faction,'" Hobert instructed. "Wait here, don't go anywhere. No matter what happens, don't open the barrier!"
Although this would consume a lot of Spirituality, Ted, as a "Earl of the Fallen," should be able to last for most of an hour.
Ted summoned a barrier, and everyone watched Hobert leave. Soon, their bodies emitted brilliant rainbow-like colors, which looked very unusual in this world dominated by pale white.
Because of Hobert's instructions, everyone didn't panic, and even joked that they seemed to have become much more sacred.
Originally, everyone just thought that they were just waiting here, but soon a naive little girl ran in from outside, opening her arms towards them: "Daddy, hug me."
"Lena!" An official Beyonder rushed over in disbelief: "Is it really you?"
"That's not your daughter!" Ted quickly used the ability to "distort" space to twist the official Beyonder back behind him: "Everyone pay attention! Without the Duke's protection! The mutated Underworld will notice us! But, no matter what, don't leave this barrier."
The official Beyonder was first suddenly drained of his strength, and sat down on the ground with a thud, crying while saying: "Daddy misses you so much."
Ted took a deep breath: "This is death…"
"Child, are you a demigod now?" A lady in her forties with a classical dress walked in from outside, with several similarities between her eyebrows and Ted.
Ted's breathing also suddenly became rapid, but in the end, he stabilized his state and tried to calmly say: "Mother, you… you haven't aged at all, just like when I buried you."
The lady asked with a kind expression: "You look much more mature, you must have experienced a lot of difficulties these years."
"Yes." Ted suddenly smiled with tears in his eyes: "Ada is already thirteen years old this year, and a few days ago he said he dreamed of grandma."
The lady's expression instantly became serious: "You, have you prepared the Beyonder characteristics for him?"
"Mother, the curse has been lifted."
"Ah, it's been lifted, that's great, that's great. Your father's spirit body was corrupted because of the curse. I searched for him in the Underworld for a long, long time, but I couldn't find him."
Ted suddenly broke down and cried like the official Beyonder just now, covering his face.
However, he still remembered his mission and kept injecting Spirituality into the "Order Crystal."
Without the protection of the Archangel, even with the barrier composed of the "Order Crystal," the spirit bodies of these official Beyonders were very small in front of the "City of the Dead."
… …
After Hobert left the city hall, he stretched out his hand and took out the "0-80" Book of Law from the "Nation of Disorder," which was the Uniqueness of the "Justiciar" pathway, the former "Trunsoest Brass Book."
He injected Spirituality into the "Book of Law." As the owner of the "Nation of Disorder," the owner of this Sealed Artifact, without needing to speak, the Brass Book understood Hobert's intention.
It opened on its own, and a line of quicksilver-colored text appeared on the new page: Here is the Underworld, any non-undead creatures, their colors are different from this pale white world.
Colorful light also radiated from Hobert's body, but he casually gifted this color to a giant undead.
However, under the 'rules' of the 'Brass Book,' his previous 'tampering' with his own state was still ineffective. The surrounding undead creatures all looked at him, sensing that he was not a creature of this world.
Immediately afterward, a second line of mercury-colored text appeared on that page of the 'Brass Book': The great 'Creator,' as the owner of the 'Nation of Disorder,' possesses noble integrity and is a unique existence, capable of escaping the constraints of many rules.
Hobert was slightly stunned: Sealed Artifacts actually flatter! It's just that the 'Brass Book' has a higher level and isn't as shameless as the magic mirror Arrodes!

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 721: Resurrection of the God of Death
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
With the help of the "Book of Law", Hobert saw many places with gorgeous colors in Calderon City, and those should all be members of the "Underworld Faction".
Hobert "tampered" with his position and instantly appeared next to a gorgeous color on the edge of Calderon.
Did the "Underworld Faction" member's body undergo a mutation, or did they simply abandon their body? In any case, from the outside, they were no different from normal undead.
He was now wondering why he was emitting light?
Hobert waved his hand at him, and the "Underworld Faction" member was immediately hit by a huge force, slammed into the wall of a building, and the force immediately followed up, pressing him firmly against the wall.
"What research is the 'Underworld Faction' conducting in the 'City of the Dead'?" Hobert asked.
The "Underworld Faction" member knew that he had encountered an enemy, his expression indifferent, with no intention of answering any questions.
Hobert didn't force it, "distorting" his remaining state of "life" into "death", and so this member really became a dead person.
Hobert "used" the power of the surrounding "City of the Dead" to drag out his soul and complete the preparations for necromancy.
He asked again: "What exactly are you researching?"
Bang~
Just as the undead was about to open his mouth, he exploded in place!
Hobert was slightly stunned. This was not a "secret keeping" ability, but rather the other party's spirit body was very fragile and could not withstand the torment of "necromancy".
This made Hobert frown: Did he have to investigate it himself?
Hobert glanced again at the undead with colorful "markings" around him. Because the city had a structure that was high in the middle and low around the edges, he could easily see the positions of the other "Underworld Faction" members.
One of the locations was very close to the center of the city.
At this time, the center of the city still looked somewhat illusory, and the specific situation could not be seen clearly.
Hobert planned to approach the center to see if he could find any clues.
The phoenixs in the air had long noticed Hobert, but Hobert's movements were too fast for them to catch up.
Just now, when Hobert was trying to perform necromancy, they finally surrounded Hobert.
The phoenix who had interrogated Hobert and the others before sneered: "My feeling was right, you really have a problem."
The pale light on their bodies became more intense, as if they were forming a closer connection with the "City of the Dead", forming an encirclement with a strong Underworld power.
On the latest page of the "Book of Law" in Hobert's hand, a line of silvery words appeared unhurriedly: There is no air in the Underworld. Flying here obviously does not conform to the relevant rules of aerodynamics.
Amidst the screams of the phoenixes, they fell to the ground one by one, and the encirclement immediately disintegrated.
Hobert glanced at the "Brass Book" in his hand: You know quite a lot!
In the next second, Hobert used the method of "distorting" space to delve deeper into the "City of the Dead".
When he came to the middle of the city, Hobert found that his Beyonder abilities were affected in some way, as if there was always an ethereal force pulling at his spirituality, and it didn't seem as flexible as when he was outside.
He guessed that this should be the influence of the "River of Eternal Darkness". The deeper he went into the center of the city, the greater this influence should be.
At this time, the "Book of Law" showed new words: "Creator" is a very special existence. He is the shadow of all rules and the shadow of death, so the influence in the "City of the Dead" will be limited.
Hobert immediately felt his spirituality return to normal and continued to walk inside. He gradually felt the surging power in the center of the city.
It seemed like the most terrifying thing in the world was hidden there, but Hobert couldn't say exactly what it was.
It was because he couldn't say it clearly that even Hobert felt fear from the bottom of his heart.
Intertwined with fear was sadness, the reluctant and helpless sadness when facing death, and the disappointment after failing to resist the power of death time and time again.
Hobert took a deep breath. If he continued to move forward, the effect of the "Book of Law" would also begin to weaken. Although it was a uniqueness with a very high rank, the center of the city belonged to the power of the Sefirah!
So he began to summon the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to form a barrier around himself.
But in this way, he could only move forward step by step and could not use extraordinary power to reach his destination quickly.
As he walked forward, Hobert looked at the streets on both sides. The buildings on both sides were very complete, but they looked a bit grim and dilapidated, like a well-preserved ancient site.
It was just that the surroundings were eerily quiet, and Hobert felt that he could even hear the sound of blood flowing through his blood vessels.
Moreover, the visibility here was limited. Even Hobert's vision was affected. He couldn't see the edge of the city, let alone Monteson Port "in the air".
It made him feel as if he was isolated in another world.
Suddenly, Hobert's inspiration stirred and he looked at a room carved out of a huge white bone.
The bone-white door opened gently, and Selena with wine-red hair walked out of it. She had a bright smile like she did when she was alive: "Teacher, long time no see."
"Long time no see." Hobert smiled: "I avenged you."
"Thank you. But more than that, I want to know how Freya and Dennis are now?"
Hobert was chatting with an old friend, walking forward and saying: "Freya is currently the Deputy Minister of the Security Department of the Duchy of South Balam.
"Dennis is currently helping me keep an eye on the research laboratory of South Balam and the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery. His specific position is the Chief of the Security Department of the Science and Technology Department."
The research laboratory cooperated by both parties has never stopped its research work even during the war and even during the direct confrontation between South Balam and Intis.
Because Hobert has been giving some strange topics, these topics were difficult for people to understand at first, but after the research results came out, they would have unexpected uses.
Selena followed behind Hobert and sighed: "I really envy them!"
If she were still alive, she would also be a high-ranking official in the Duchy of South Balam.
Hobert smiled: "I am also quite envious of them, for having such a good teacher."
"Teacher, you are still so...humorous." Selena smiled helplessly: "You don't seem to be sad about my death?"
"Selena." Hobert took a deep breath and said: "Death is a part of life. It is like the wind passing over the earth, while the earth, which symbolizes life, is always still.
"Life is the essence of the world. It is always connected to the earth and has never changed."
Selena asked curiously: "Teacher, when did you become a believer of the Church of the Earth Mother?"
"I always have been." Hobert smiled: "I was baptized by the Mother Church a long time ago."
Selina had heard of this matter. She asked in a tone of request, like she did when she was alive: "Teacher, is death really so understated to you?"
"It depends on the situation." Hobert said seriously: "For example, when I encounter an enemy, I will work hard to invite them to die!"
Selena smiled again: "I may never be able to learn this kind of freedom from my teacher."
Hobert looked at a stone statue emitting colorful light in front of him: "Okay, let's talk about it here first, I should get down to business."
After saying that, the barrier formed by the "Order Crystal" around him suddenly grew larger, encompassing the stone statue, but still isolating Selena from the outside.
Hobert came to the stone statue and shook his head: "It's really miserable. It's been eroded by the 'River of Eternal Darkness' and assimilated by this city, and finally turned into a stone statue."
"You are wrong, this is a way to gain eternal life!" Black blood flowed out of the stone statue's eyes, ears, nostrils, and corners of its mouth. It seemed to be talking to Hobert with its spirituality: "As long as I am close enough to 'death', death will completely leave me."
Hobert nodded, as if he agreed with the other party's idea: "Then let's talk about it, what did you find in this city?"
"Found the aura of the Phoenix Ancestor!" Cracks appeared on the other party's face: "As long as there is still death, he still has the possibility of resurrection!"
Hobert once again looked like he agreed with this statement very much: "I have also heard that the 'Death' is relatively special, because he himself is death, so it may be difficult to truly die."
This time he changed his strategy. While asking back, the abilities of "distortion" and "charm" quietly distorted the other party's thinking, making the other party relax their vigilance and be more willing to express their inner thoughts.
The stone statue cracked little by little, and a very handsome, but somewhat childish face appeared inside. It turned out to be Erebus, who had been killed by Hobert long ago!
Erebus smiled: "Isn't it very surprising."
Hobert smiled: "You are not Erebus, he is already dead."
"It is precisely because I am dead that I can come here."
Hobert still shook his head: "The angels I killed have no chance of survival, and they cannot be found even in the underworld."
"You are wrong." Erebus said: "As long as you have experienced death, even if your spirit body is destroyed by you, you can still leave a mark in the underworld."
"So, you are not Erebus." Hobert said: "You are just a mark!"
He raised the "Brass Book" in his hand: "If you were Erebus, you would have been staring at it and unable to take your eyes off it, but you didn't even look at it.
"An Erebus without a competitive relationship is not threatening to me at all."
"Erebus" was stunned for a second or two before saying: "Are the 'Lawyer's' ways of thinking so strange?"
Hobert, however, retorted, "Because you discovered the aura of the 'Phoenix Ancestor,' you were corrupted and want to use those auras to revive Him?
But what does this have to do with 'City of the Dead,' Calderon? Why is this city mutating?"
"Erebus" replied, "This city is a symbol of the 'Phoenix Ancestor's' existence. As long as this city is not destroyed, the 'Phoenix Ancestor' will not completely perish.
We are not corrupted. As far as our 'Underworld Faction' is concerned, as long as we can once again dominate the Southern Continent, it doesn't matter who sits in the 'Death' position.
We have been researching how to give the 'Underworld' a certain consciousness, integrate it with the real world, and provide us with a constant stream of power.
The connection between the 'City of the Dead' and the 'Phoenix Ancestor' fits our expectations very well, so we are researching in this direction.
We are not corrupted or eroded, but we have actively made some modifications to ourselves."
Whether he did it on purpose or didn't realize it at all, just now, he said twice, "We are not corrupted."
Hobert opened his mouth: "What a group of pathetic people!"
At this moment, He even speculated that the first "Underworld Faction" was very likely influenced by this city in the Underworld. With the "Underworld Emperor" fallen and no deity in this pathway, the influence they received deepened, and they became a faction of the Numinous Episcopate.
But this is not what Hobert is concerned about. He pondered for a moment before saying, "In other words, interrupting the revival process of the 'Phoenix Ancestor' can make the Underworld return to normal?"
"Erebus" smiled contemptuously: "Your idea is too naive. Although you are an Archangel, you are currently in 'City of the Dead,' Calderon! With your power, you simply cannot stop the revival of the Death."
Hobert shook his head: "In my opinion, the 'Phoenix Ancestor' cannot be revived, because She does not have the uniqueness of the 'Death' pathway."
"Erebus" said: "She is death itself. In Her Divine Kingdom, She is 'Death.'"
Hobert understood the other party's meaning. This is a bit like the relationship between the "Moon" pathway and the "Crimson Moon." The connection between them is very close, but after all, they are two different things.
One is an abstract manifestation, and the other is a truly existing thing.
In the field of mysticism, they respectively represent the authority of the "Moon," probably a relationship of equality, not a relationship of mutual subordination.
If the "Phoenix Ancestor" really revives, then She is "death" itself, or this process, while the uniqueness of the "Death" pathway in the hands of the Evernight Goddess is an abstract death.
Then, the first thing Hobert thought of was whether to ask the Evernight Goddess for help?
But He also thought that the Evernight Goddess was not very willing to contact the "River of Eternal Darkness" at this time, so she later asked Klein to help her "fetch water."
So, He planned to solve it himself first and try. If he couldn't solve it, he would pray to the Evernight Goddess to see if he could get any inspiration.
Hobert glanced at "Erebus": "You can die."
As he spoke, the "Sword of Disorder" appeared in the hand that was not holding the "Brass Book." Hobert casually slashed and stabbed "Erebus," shattering him again.
"Erebus," who fell like gravel, smiled: "It's useless."
At this time, the bone-white door of a house built of skulls next to him suddenly opened.
"Erebus" walked out from inside: "Here, no one can kill me."
He glanced at Selena: "And I can also use the symbolic meaning here to launch an attack on you. That barrier of yours is useless."
Hobert realized that this "Underworld Faction" member was different from the one he had just killed.
Since he couldn't kill the other party, He planned to continue forward, preparing to find the entrance of the "River of Eternal Darkness" in this city and try to seal it or cut off the connection between the two to see if it could solve the problem?
But in the next second, He suddenly appeared in a room with dim lights. On the sofa in front of Hobert sat a family of four, motionless like puppets, looking at Hobert with eerie smiles.
Their eyes made Hobert feel cold all over, as if awakening some terrifying memories deep in his soul.
Hobert was slightly stunned and immediately understood that this was the attack launched by "Erebus" using the "City of the Dead!"
And this scene seemed to be a scene from a horror movie he had seen before.
Suddenly, a very soothing music sounded behind Hobert, but in such a strange environment, the soothing music seemed to be attacking Hobert's spirit body, and every syllable could deepen His fear!
Hobert looked back and saw that there was a gramophone behind him, which was playing music. It turned out that the family with eerie smiles was appreciating the music of the gramophone.
He retracted his gaze, but suddenly found that the family of four with eerie smiles had stood up at some point, vaguely surrounding Hobert.
They were still standing there motionless like puppets, as if they had been standing from the beginning.
An invisible sense of fear enveloped the entire room. Hobert didn't dare to breathe, feeling that the family of four could pounce on him in the next second.
But the level of the Archangel still kept Hobert calm enough. He pondered slightly and had a good idea to break the situation.
At this moment, the music in the gramophone stopped. Although the family of four were still motionless, Hobert's spirituality felt that their faces were becoming ferocious.
He knew he couldn't wait any longer. He immediately raised his hand and "distorted" the family of four, making their stiff bodies move like puppets and dance a joyful dance.
The music in the gramophone sounded again. This time, it was no longer soothing music, but a music that seemed to hit Hobert's heart, and every syllable could evoke His terrifying memories.
Hobert looked at the gramophone, and the music suddenly changed, "distorted" by Him into a joyful tune.
The dim and unclear lights above his head also became colorful, and the haunted house became a dance hall.
Hobert looked at the dancing family of four. The eerie smiles on their faces and the ferocity they gave made their movements even more ridiculous.
"What's so scary?" Hobert said contemptuously.
The family of four suddenly merged into one person, it was "Erebus." The haunted house-like setting around him also turned into the streets of the "City of the Dead."
Hobert once again included "Erebus" in his barrier, and without saying a word, "distorted" the other party's emotions, making him laugh "haha."
"Erebus's" face was full of unwillingness, but he couldn't control his emotions at this time, laughing forward and backward, laughing and kneeling on the ground.
Only then did Hobert continue to walk forward while thinking about how to seal and how to deal with the revived Ancient Death. This time, "Erebus" and Selena did not follow.
After only a few steps forward, "Erebus's" laughter could no longer be heard, and the surroundings returned to silence, as if time had stopped here.
This gave Hobert the illusion that the things he was currently doing were not urgent at all.
Finally, Hobert came to the bottom of the city, where there was a huge, deep black palace supported by pillars.
The walls were inlaid with various skulls, and some places were covered with a layer of bloody skin of different races.
Because of the protection of the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert stepped into the palace, and what came into view was a hall filled with coffins of various styles. The coffins that had previously floated into the air, from which phoenixes struggled to emerge, should also have come from here.
As soon as Hobert was about to take the second step, the interiors of these coffins made some sounds like rusty joints being opened again.
He immediately injected spirituality into the "Book of Law," and this Sealed Artifact lived up to expectations and once again showed a line of mercury-colored text: This is the "City of the Dead," the dead should be at rest.
All the coffins suddenly fell silent.
Hobert continued to walk forward. In the depths of the hall, there was a downward passage composed of gray-white steps.
At the entrance stood a huge stone tablet. At the top of the stone tablet stood a tall, slender statue of a giant bird that seemed to be made of bronze.
There were two sentences on the stone tablet composed of "Language of the Dead": Even gods cannot escape; even death will be imprisoned.
Hobert nodded: This is the place.
He immediately mobilized the surging power from the "Nation of Disorder" to seal the downward entrance, but He found that there was an illusory force resisting the "Nation of Disorder," and it could not completely cover the entrance.
That was the power of the "River of Eternal Darkness," only a Great Old One could resist the power of a Great Old One.
Hobert frowned, feeling that he should change his thinking.
At this moment, a giant bird's head stretched out from the downward entrance!
Hobert was very familiar with the "appearance" of this head, it was the "Ancient Death" Gregrace! Hobert had used the corpse of the "Ancient Death" more than once, so he was very familiar with it!
The Ancient Death has been resurrected!
Resurrected silently!
There was not much fanfare, nor was there any surge of power, as if He had never fallen, as if He had just rested in the River of Eternal Darkness.
His eyes seemed to be cast in bronze, with layers of illusory doors inside.
Even as the Archangel, Hobert felt his spirit impacted by a single glance into the eyes of the Ancient Death.
Fortunately, the barrier formed by the power of the "Nation of Disorder" protected him; otherwise, Hobert's spirit would have been severely damaged!
Hobert, prepared for this, donned glasses made from the "Order Crystal." Now able to directly face his opponent, Hobert immediately expanded the barrier formed by the "Nation of Disorder," encompassing the resurrecting Ancient Death within it.
Simultaneously, a new rule appeared on the "Book of Law" in his hand: Death Gods are dead, which is why they are called Death Gods.
Feathers fell from the Ancient Death's head, revealing the rotten skin beneath, oozing with pale yellow pus.
