Eastern suburb of Angel City.
Trunsoest looked in the direction of the mountains for a while. As the King of Angels of the adjacent pathway, He had already felt the fluctuations in order from that direction.
Finally, Trunsoest sighed and said to everyone with some disappointment, "Let's go, let's go."
The angels left one by one. Today, their trip was more like witnessing Hobert become the King of Angels.
To prevent Trunsoest from having an accident, "Pale Empress" and Zaratul followed Him back to Caesar Port.
Now they can't be without Trunsoest, otherwise the "Pale Empress's" Balam Empire may collapse soon, and Zaratul feels that he will not dare to show his face in the future.
The angels who came to help Hobert dispersed, their mission was completed.
Among them, only Lilith and "The Fool" either knew very well, or guessed what Hobert wanted to do.
The other angels only knew that Hobert had something very important to do, but they were not very clear about what it was.
…
As soon as Hobert became the King of Angels, he quickly found Tamara and used the process of accommodating the uniqueness, the powerful suction of the "Nation of Disorder" that temporarily appeared on Beyonder characteristics, and sucked out the Beyonder characteristics of the "Prince of Abolition" in Tamara's body.
Hobert, of course, imitated Klein in this regard. After all, such a good method is here, and it would be a waste not to use it.
The Beyonder characteristic like a ball of light slowly floated towards Hobert.
Tamara, who looked a bit like a wax figure, was pale at this time. She endured the pain and said, "That Beyonder characteristic belongs to you, I am willing to join the 'Creator' camp."
Tamara is quite special. She jumped from "Balancer" to the adjacent pathway and was promoted to "Prince of Abolition", so after Hobert took away the Beyonder characteristics of the "Prince of Abolition" in Her body, She still had a copy of the Beyonder characteristics of the "Balancer" in his body.
Her current state is similar to a failed advancement.
It's just that at the angel level, She can use his own ability to help Herself maintain his state, and She will not die soon.
But Tamara's state from now on must be extremely bad, and it will never be possible to be promoted to "Prince of Abolition" again.
Hobert said seriously: "Don't talk nonsense, this Beyonder characteristic was originally mine, why does it seem like you gave it to me?"
Tamara knew that Hobert was not going to let Her go. A hint of ferociousness appeared on Her face: "You will regret it!"
Hobert took the Beyonder characteristic of the "Prince of Abolition" and put it into the "Nation of Disorder". He looked at Tamara: "Heh."
Tamara's temperament suddenly changed. Her whole body became swollen and transparent, as if She had instantly turned into a floating corpse!
Hobert's spirituality realized that a surging and familiar force descended from the altar and merged into Tamara's body.
This power is very familiar, it comes from the "Uncertain Mist".
Hobert raised his hand and used the power of "Tampering" to turn the entire altar into powder.
At the same time, this is also "Tampering" the "essence" of the altar, instantly interrupting the process of descending.
But the surrounding temperature suddenly dropped, and a layer of mist suddenly rose.
Hobert smiled and said, "I didn't expect to get a chance to try my abilities."
With that said, he raised his right hand and turned it counterclockwise. Under his "Distortion", the surrounding low temperature and mist were stirred and concentrated towards Tamara.
Then Hobert used the ability of "Magnification" to turn the low temperature into ultra-low temperature and the mist into thick fog.
This mist actually have Beyonder characteristics, and their level is not low, but at this time Hobert's position is not low under the blessing of the "Nation of Disorder".
So the thick fog with Beyonder characteristics was turned into water by the ultra-low temperature, and the swollen Tamara was instantly frozen.
The "Sword of Disorder" appeared in Hobert's hand, but it immediately turned into the shape of a long stick. Hobert gently poked the ice sculpture-like Tamara with it.
This angel from the Fourth Epoch was crushed like this.
Hobert smiled at the pool of ice: "It seems that your understanding of uniqueness is not profound. After I accommodated the uniqueness, I can easily destroy any arrangement of the 'Uncertain Mist' within the barrier.
"Rest in peace, former Tudor Empire Grand Duke!"
He accelerated the speed of precipitation of Beyonder characteristics and obtained another Beyonder characteristic of "Balancer".
This Beyonder characteristic was obviously polluted, but because it was polluted by the "Uncertain Mist", it was very easy for Hobert to solve the corruption on it.
Putting this Beyonder characteristic into the "Nation of Disorder" again, Hobert found the right direction and once again "Tampered" his position and came to Caesar Port on the northern end of the Southern Continent.
Hobert stood in mid-air and glanced at the newly rebuilt palace. With a wave of his hand, he used the ability of "Distortion", and a huge water column appeared on the sea and fell towards the palace.
Squeak~
On one side of the water column, two "Underworld Gates" that went straight into the sky appeared. The coldness of the underworld instantly froze the huge water column.
But Hobert smiled slightly. He "Tampered" the concepts of solid and liquid, so the big ice column continued to flow towards the palace like water.
The low temperature it brought seemed to completely freeze the palace in the ice.
Then Zaratul also took action, and the huge ice column suddenly turned into a huge flower!
This is a miracle!
Hobert "Tampered" with this huge flower again, causing it to grow thorns, and its smell was poisonous. Beyonders would die immediately after inhaling it.
Trunsoest had no choice but to take action, and the huge flower turned back into seawater, restoring its original order.
Crash~
The huge water column fell into the port, just like a local super flood, destroying many buildings.
Trunsoest also came into the air. He stood opposite Hobert: "You can't kill me! Even if you have the 'Nation of Disorder', you can't kill me now!"
Hobert smiled: "Of course I know."
The former "Night Emperor" said again: "The Beyonder characteristics in my body are not necessary for you.
"Why don't we join forces and fight back to the Northern Continent together."
Hobert looked at Trunsoest: "It's too late. If you had such a proposal when I first became an angel, I might have considered it."
However, the result of the consideration is likely to be: join forces first, and kill him after I am sure.
But now, Hobert is sure.
With a wave of his hand, he took out the "0-80" Book of Law from the "Nation of Disorder".
Trunsoest was a little disappointed: "You don't think that after accommodating the uniqueness, you will be fearless, right? You need my help!"
"Thank you for your concern, but I don't need you to worry about my affairs." Hobert looked at "Pale Empress" and Zaratul appearing behind Trunsoest, looking like "We have guaranteed Trunsoest."
Hobert said to Trunsoest again: "You are also an old man from the Fourth Epoch, don't you know about the betrayal of the King of Angels of the 'Above the Sequence'?"
"Don't make it look like I don't have the capacity to accommodate people, and don't pretend to be so pitiful."
After speaking, Hobert opened the "Book of Law". A line of mercury-colored words immediately appeared on the new page of this brass book: Congratulations to Hobert Jeffery for becoming the King. His specialness makes him the only true King in this world! Based on this as the legal basis, all his abilities will be enhanced when he punishes his enemies, and his enemies are all criminals, and all their abilities will be weakened!
Hobert raised his hand and made the entire mid-air "disordered". Trunsoest isolated himself from "Pale Empress" and Zaratul, as if they had appeared in another space.
…
On a road in the suburbs of Angel City.
There is a large rock on one side of the road, where children often come to climb and play after school.
At this time, Amon, wearing a soft hat and a classical mage robe, sat on the rock and quietly looked at the city in front of him.
"That person dressed as a mage!" The oldest of the three patrolling security officers said: "Are you planning to perform magic here?"
Amon was slightly stunned: "No."
Then he asked curiously, "Why do you ask?"
The older security officer said sternly: "According to the 'Resident Dress Management Regulations' of the Atlantis Kingdom, residents must wear clothing within the specified range in their daily lives.
"There is a ready-made clothing store when you enter the city from here, go and buy a set of clothes quickly."
Amon suddenly smiled: "This reminds me of some memories from a long time ago, but the law enforcement officers at that time were not as polite as you."
Then he asked: "What if I am performing magic?"
"Then you have to buy a set of clothes too." The security officer said: "According to other relevant regulations, this is not a place to perform artistic programs. When we come back from patrol later, if you haven't changed into new clothes, you will be fined and detained."
Amon asked curiously again: "Do you need to specify a location for performing artistic programs?"
The security officer re-examined Amon with some vigilance: "The road is for people and cars to walk on. Performing here will definitely affect traffic, and even if you perform here, there will be no Spectator."
He seriously suspected that the person in front of him was not a resident of the Atlantis Kingdom?
"Aren't you Spectator?" Amon got up from the stone: "I just need a few Spectator members!"
He stood on the stone and pointed to the city of Angel City not far away: "It's really a nice city."
The security officer said with some pride: "Of course."
"Such a good thing…" Amon smiled slightly: "Of course, I have to take it back and play with it for a few days."
He grabbed towards the front, and the bustling city of Angel City suddenly disappeared!
The three security guards stood there dumbfounded. The capital of the Atlantis Kingdom had disappeared!
By the time they came back to their senses, the strangely dressed magician had also disappeared.
…
In the sky above Caesar Port, Hobert, holding the "Book of Laws," faced a King of Angels and two Archangels alone, yet he remained at ease.
Their battle stirred the sky into chaos, and Caesar Port beneath them alternately turned cold and hot, with suction appearing in mid-air one moment and immense pressure the next.
The residents of Caesar Port desperately wanted to escape, but for some reason, their legs were weak. Forget running, they couldn't even stand steadily.
Suddenly, the four people engaged in battle simultaneously felt something. Amon suddenly appeared not far from them.
He smiled at Hobert and said, "Sorry, but right now I can't let you kill Trunsoest, nor can I let you destroy the newly established Paz Kingdom for the time being.
"How about we discuss this? Before I become a God, don't harm Trunsoest. After I become a God, do as you please!"
Hobert sighed inwardly: He never thought that Amon would one day negotiate with him.
Then he began to consider Amon's purpose: Did Amon support Trunsoest?
That shouldn't be!
Hobert immediately rejected his own idea. Currently, Trunsoest no longer had any hope of becoming a God. It was impossible for Amon to support him.
In addition, Hobert estimated that when he became a Great Old One, or even just accommodated the "Nation of Disorder," he should be able to sense Trunsoest's location no matter where he was for a few minutes.
Trunsoest was also aware of this, so now he was desperately seeking a way out for himself while he still had some value.
Since it wasn't for investment, then Amon's actions must be for his own sake.
These thoughts only flashed for a moment. Hobert smiled and asked Amon, "What benefits can I get?"
In fact, Hobert came to Caesar Port today to destroy the Paz Kingdom. It would be best if he could drive Trunsoest away. Even if he couldn't, he could greatly weaken the Paz Kingdom's arrogance.
"Of course, there are benefits." Amon pinched his monocle and smiled: "I'll give you something else."
Immediately afterwards, a prosperous and vast city appeared in mid-air. Hobert's eyes narrowed. It was actually Angel City.
Under the force of gravity, the entire city rapidly fell, and many residents screamed in fright.
Hobert immediately "tampered" with the city's gravity and "tampered" with the gravity of that location, causing the city to float in mid-air.
At this time, wheat and soybeans, herbs and springs appeared in the sky. A towering figure holding a phantom baby walked out of the wheat field in the distance.
Amon glanced at the towering figure and muttered, "How boring! You found me so quickly!"
After saying that, he disappeared without a trace, but his voice appeared in Hobert's ear in a way that defied logic: "You can consider it. After all, you can't protect every inch of your territory at all times."
Hobert sneered: It's not the thief you fear, but the thief who has his eye on you.
Then he bowed slightly towards the Earth Mother, completely ignoring Trunsoest and the others behind him, and "distorted" Angel City, returning to the location of the Atlantis Kingdom's capital.
The Earth Mother in the sky kept staring at Trunsoest and the others, and only turned and left after Hobert had "gone far away." The wheat, herbs, and so on also disappeared.
Trunsoest and the others looked at each other, feeling that their fate was already in the hands of others.
…
Hobert "put" Angel City back into its original position seamlessly, and then "tampered" with the memories of the entire city and the people around it.
However, for the sake of prudence, Audrey still had to give people some psychological cues.
After doing all this, Hobert came to the Church of the Earth Mother, prayed to the Earth Mother like an ordinary believer, and prepared to discuss with the Earth Mother how to deal with Amon.
Now Hobert rarely uses the Earth Mother or the Church of the Earth Mother's resources. The reason is very simple: If it is just asking the Earth Mother for help, then there is no need to worry about "repaying" the favor.
But if you use the Earth Mother's resources or the Church's resources, then you have to pay attention to the issue of "repayment." The meaning between the two is different.
Currently, Hobert also controls a vast force. If he "borrows" it, it is better to solve the problem himself. Therefore, Hobert generally only asks Lilith and "The Fool" for help.
The former is because her flexibility is strong, and there is no need to be in the astral world all the time.
The latter is because "The World" needs a Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic, so it needs "The Fool" to repay some help.
Of course, Hobert did not explicitly state such help, but only "hoped" that Klein could ask "The Fool" to help him with something.
But Amon's problem must be discussed with the Earth Mother.
In order to prevent a sensation, he "tampered" with the state of his existence.
After accommodating the Uniqueness, Hobert could "tamper" "nothingness" into "existence," and vice versa.
At this time, he "tampered" himself into a state of "nothingness," and the people around him could not feel his existence.
Of course, such "tampering" could not escape the eyes of the Gods at present. Soon Hobert reappeared in a wheat field.
But this time, the figure of the Earth Mother did not appear. Just as Hobert was feeling strange, he saw a stalk of wheat in front of him suddenly flashing with dazzling brilliance, and then the golden wheat became as bright and colorful as a rainbow.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert returned to the church. He found that the colorful wheat was in his hand.
Trying to perceive it with his spirituality, Hobert immediately realized the use of this wheat. This way, he was relieved, and it didn't matter if he let Trunsoest jump around for a while!
But then Hobert understood the Earth Mother's view of Amon, or this was the unified view of most orthodox Gods on Amon: Do not condone or actively attack.
Or rather, choose to wait and see Amon's plan to become a God and compete for the Outer Deities.
After all, in the eyes of the Gods, Amon seemed to have more advantages. Before there was a real need to take sides, the orthodox Gods should try to remain restrained.
Hobert pondered for a while and did not try to persuade the Earth Mother. After all, when it came time to take sides, the Earth Mother would not hesitate to stand on his side, on the Evernight Goddess's side.
It was not very effective to persuade her now, and it seemed like he was questioning the Earth Mother's judgment.
So Hobert, holding the wheat, said "Praise the Mother" to the Holy Emblem of Life, left the church, and came to a secluded mountain peak in the eastern mountains.
From here, he could clearly see the entire panorama of Angel City in the distance. In the twilight, the city built by himself was exceptionally beautiful in Hobert's eyes.
Hobert first thought about Amon's purpose again. Why did he want to protect Trunsoest?
After thinking for a while, Hobert seemed to understand. Amon was not protecting Trunsoest, but hoping to restrict the development of the Atlantis Kingdom, or rather, restrict the development of the "Creator" forces.
Currently, in the Beyonder world, both the "Creator" and "The Fool" were no longer hidden existences, and the alliance between the two Gods was also well known.
Amon did not want "The Fool" or "The Fool's" allies to be too strong before he became a God, so that the current "Amon chasing Klein" would turn into "Klein chasing Amon."
As of now, Amon's threat was still very useful. As he said, Hobert could not protect every inch of his territory at all times.
Then Hobert thought again, then he would not guard it. Gradually, a plan against Amon gradually took shape.
After thinking about Amon's problem, Hobert began to quietly think about the affairs of the Balam Empire, thinking about the affairs of Trunsoest.
Gradually, a brand new and larger plan appeared in his mind.
It was not until the sky was completely dark that Hobert returned to Angel City.
…
Vanity City, in the central part of the Balam Empire.
Cannons roared, and machine guns kept spitting out fire snakes.
The soldiers were attacking, not the Imperial Army, but a large number of Zombies summoned by the Balam Empire's Beyonder!
These mindless Zombies did not know what fear was. Even if the machine gun fire was dense, and their companions fell one by one, it would not affect their charge.
And in the city, under the leadership of a demigod-level Beyonder, the Empire's Beyonder had been using the convenience of the underworld to launch attacks on the city.
However, under Medici's command, it was almost as if as many Beyonder came as many could be "left behind."
At this time, three of the Atlantis Kingdom's five strongest Beyonder troops were here.
At the same time, in order to repay Hobert for providing them with cities and churches, City of Silver and Moon City also sent teams of Beyonder led by two and one demigods respectively to participate in the war.
In addition, the Sanguine also sent people to participate in the war, but their main responsibility was to rescue the wounded.
After repelling another round of enemy attacks, Medici symbolically commanded the Beyonder troops to pursue for a while, and then he saw from afar that the command post outside the city was also retreating.
Medici immediately changed his order: "Pursue! Continue to pursue! Pursue to the enemy's capital, Cevas!"
Just by observing these reactions of the enemy, Medici knew that Hobert must have achieved his goal! Although he was not very clear about what Hobert was brewing.
On the night before the war, Hobert received accurate intelligence from Xio that the countries of the Northern Continent would support Trunsoest in establishing a nation.
At the time, the restored Kingdom of Paz and the Balam Empire, if they joined forces, could still bring considerable pressure to bear on the Kingdom of Atlantis.
But it was only pressure, and it would not threaten the Kingdom of Atlantis. After all, the Kingdom of Atlantis still had the Earth Mother as its foundation, and neither the Kingdom of Paz nor the Balam Empire dared to directly invade the Kingdom of Atlantis.
Medici, who was currently directing the pursuit, recalled Hobert's original words at the time: "I think this is an opportunity."
This point benefited Medici greatly: When Hobert encountered a problem, he would first see the opportunity that the problem brought. This way of thinking was very interesting, not only considering how to solve the current problem, but also being able to solve some other problems along the way.
Thus, under Hobert's temporary strategic adjustment, the war against the Balam Empire became a feint.
Mainly to cover Hobert's plan.
In the past few days, the independence of the Southern Balam Duchy and its becoming the Kingdom of Atlantis, and the news that William I had died.
Coupled with the withdrawal of the Balam Empire's Beyonder forces, Medici realized that Hobert had already won on His "battlefield", then now was the time to reap the rewards of victory!

chapters.content:

In the following days, Medici once again staged a classic annihilation battle on the territory of the Balam Empire.
Taking advantage of the temporary retreat of the Balam Empire's Beyonders and regular forces, He pursued them closely, causing this portion of Beyonders and regular troops to collapse utterly.
In fact, the Imperial army was not in full retreat at this time; they had received orders to temporarily cease the siege of Vanity City.
They had only intended to retreat temporarily, waiting for the ministers in the capital to discuss a diplomatic stance towards the Atlantis Kingdom before making new military plans.
However, Medici used the teleportation array within Vanity City to send one brigade after another to the front lines.
As a result, the number of pursuing soldiers increased, and in just one day, nearly thirty thousand men and a large number of Beyonders were assembled, creating a strong momentum to invade Cevas.
The Balam Empire quickly mobilized its forces and even requested reinforcements from the Paz Kingdom.
After hastily setting up defenses in Cevas, they finally awaited the Atlantis army.
However, the Atlantis army only attacked once before immediately retreating.
The Imperial army thought that the previous attack by the Atlantis army was a bluff, so they pursued with all their might.
At this moment, the Atlantis armies stationed in Lanyd and Miguel City in the north and south suddenly launched an attack, initiating a pincer movement, like a large pair of pliers, cutting off the pursuing Imperial army at the waist.
The Atlantis army used to lure the enemy also turned around and began to fiercely attack the Imperial army, routing the enemy in mobile warfare.
However, after achieving a great victory, the Atlantis army suddenly plundered the nobles of the Balam Empire while fully retreating, ultimately only garrisoning the three small cities of Lanyd, Vanity, and Miguel.
It is said that most of their main force even withdrew to Ason City, leaving only three brigades like nails stuck in the territory of the Balam Empire.
The Balam Empire had to remain in a state of war, but it temporarily lacked the strength to launch too fierce an offensive, so the war entered a stalemate.
The longer the stalemate lasted, the weaker the Balam Empire became.
...
Late May, the outskirts of Ason City.
The Atlantis Kingdom's spring plowing plan was not delayed by the war; on the contrary, it was more than twenty days earlier than last year.
Like last year, the entire Atlantis Kingdom experienced an early spring, and the harvest would be like last year, with two harvests in one season.
Hobert strolled through the fields with Medici, who had been stationed in Ason City, feeling the vibrant spring atmosphere.
Eventually, the two stopped on a small mound, watching the busy spring plowing of the people in the fields.
This is the first time I've seen such strict requirements for spring plowing," Medici suddenly said, "I heard that there are strict regulations on how many seeds are used per acre, and even the usage of agricultural tools and the feeding of oxen are standardized."
He smiled and said, "The locals are not very good at using new agricultural tools, and there are also problems with feeding the oxen, so giving specifications is to improve efficiency."
Then Hobert added: "According to my idea, agricultural production should use more machinery.
"However, we still need to give the machinery factories some time to complete their transformation."
Medici shook his head: "I don't think it's necessary to put too much energy into farming."
Hobert had issued a strict order that all actions that wasted manpower should be stopped during the spring plowing period, and all labor should be invested in spring plowing.
In addition to industrial production, all construction projects were to be stopped, and officials were not even allowed to hold cocktail parties and dances. Of course, war was definitely not allowed!
Hobert replied: "Cultivation and harvest can make people feel at ease. You can think of it as a national ritual."
He didn't continue to talk about this topic: "I'm here to see you about something else."
"What is it?"
"Prepare to launch a war that will sweep across the entire Southern Continent," Hobert said seriously.
Medici nodded with great satisfaction: "You've finally figured it out! As long as you provide the corresponding angel support, I can help you destroy the Balam Empire and the Paz Kingdom within three months."
He grumbled: "To be honest, if these two opponents make it past the new year, it would be an insult to me."
In Medici's view, the situation had reversed after Hobert's coronation, and the Atlantis Kingdom could completely adopt an active offensive posture.
"It's not just about facing these two opponents," Hobert said, "but also facing the powerful countries of the Northern Continent."
Medici was a little surprised: "Are you planning to fight to the Northern Continent?"
Is the orthodox church going to abandon the countries of the Northern Continent?
Hobert smiled: "I'm responsible for making them transfer all their elites to the Southern Continent, and you are responsible for annihilating them all in the Southern Continent."
Then, a standoff across the sea, and the Atlantis Kingdom would begin to occupy the strategic initiative.
Medici's eyes lit up: "No problem!"
So, during the spring plowing period in the Atlantis Kingdom, the wording of the 'Atlantis Daily' and the 'Angel Daily' suddenly became fierce towards the countries of the Northern Continent, and for the first time, the slogan 'Fight to the Northern Continent, liberate the world' was published.
At the same time, they vehemently criticized the exploitation of the people and the indifference to life in the countries of the Northern Continent.
They criticized them for letting 4-year-old children enter factories and 24-year-olds work more than 16 hours a day!
It can be said that the sinister side of the prosperous scene and prosperity of the Northern Continent was revealed with very precise angles.
Before this, everyone knew that Hobert had 'invented' a new political model, which was significantly different from the political model of the Northern Continent and had a clear tendency to oppose it.
The countries of the Northern Continent had already sensed that the ideological wave brought about by this political model was very terrible.
To this end, they began to strictly control propaganda materials such as newspapers and periodicals in the Southern Continent, and arrested many people and members of organizations that organized strikes and promoted the Atlantis Kingdom.
However, Hobert had never made any statements that were opposed to the Northern Continent.
Because He was very clear that as long as they did not explicitly challenge the authority and interests of the nobles and members of parliament in the Northern Continent, their attitude towards the Atlantis Kingdom would always have doves and hawks.
This would make them consume each other first, and then introduce some policies for the Atlantis Kingdom that had been mutually compromised.
This gave the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Atlantis Kingdom time to operate, and the staff of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs would try their best to make the decisions of the Northern countries develop in a more favorable direction.
Many times, as long as some interests were tied together, it would be difficult for the countries of the Northern Continent to completely regard the Atlantis Kingdom as an enemy.
But now it was different. Hobert began to seriously criticize the countries of the Northern Continent, which meant that He was likely to launch large-scale military operations!
So the countries of the Northern Continent sent special envoys one after another, hoping to talk to Hobert face to face about the current international situation.
...
June 1, Monday.
Sitting in his office, Hobert briefly arranged his next work.
He planned to meet with special envoys from all countries this afternoon and evening.
Hobert looked at the clock, but before that, He had to attend today's Tarot Gathering first.
After ordering everyone not to disturb him again, Hobert came to his lounge, where Audrey was already waiting.
Now Hobert took turns attending the Tarot Gathering with them. This week he attended with Audrey, and next week he would attend with Fors.
Hobert had also discussed with them whether they could attend the Tarot Gathering together, but they were sternly rejected.
As soon as he entered the door, Audrey smiled and said, "This time Alice's visit actually brought my parents too. My father even talked to me at noon today."
The special envoy sent by Loen this time was still Alice as always.
Hobert knew that what Audrey meant was that Alice had hoped to use her, the queen, to see Hobert first through various means.
Because the special envoys had been here for three days, but Hobert had not met any of them, nor had he arranged any visits for them as usual, which made them inexplicably anxious.
Hobert smiled and said, "Since you are so embarrassed, let's meet Alice this afternoon, but she has to be second."
While chatting, the two lay on the bed, making the final preparations for attending the Tarot Gathering.
Audrey was slightly stunned by Hobert's answer: "You don't have to disrupt your own plans for me."
"Your feelings are of course more important than my plans," Hobert lied to her face, relying on the fact that he was the King of Angels and Audrey could not observe his inner thoughts.
"Your plans are still important," Audrey said, but she was quite happy in her heart.
"It's settled then," Hobert held Audrey's hand and said, "I suddenly thought of a question these two days."
"What question?"
"The question of letting you become an angel," Hobert said, "You also know that the end is coming, and becoming an angel is the only way to have basic self-protection ability."
Audrey was somewhat surprised, but then she smiled bitterly: "The Beyonder characteristics of the angel level in the pathway I am in should all be in the Twilight Hermit Order, right?"
And the Twilight Hermit Order was Adam's organization. Adam had already become a god. With the protection of a true god, it was almost impossible to obtain Beyonder characteristics at the angel level.
"I have a way," Hobert smiled and said, "If you seriously digest the potion, the opportunity for advancement may not be too far away."
In his impression, the 'Psychology Alchemists' should have come to Audrey at this time. The fact that they still had not come was probably because Audrey had become the queen and the people of the 'Psychology Alchemists' did not dare to contact her again.
Hobert planned to actively create opportunities for Audrey to contact the clues to the Beyonder characteristics of this pathway's angel level.
Audrey hummed. If she remembered correctly, this was the third 'clue about the Beyonder characteristics of angels' that Hobert had obtained.
The other two were the clues to the 'Creator' characteristics that he planned to fund Mr. 'Moon', and the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Death Consul' that he planned to fund Mr. 'Star'.
At this moment, the sight of the two was blocked by the gray fog, and in a blink of an eye, they appeared in the ancient palace, on both sides of the bronze long table.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool~," 'Justice' Audrey's greeting arrived as scheduled.
'Fool' Klein glanced at Hobert: This guy has really become a King of Angels, but sadly, Mr. Fool is still a Sequence 2.
After greeting each other and taking their seats, 'Moon' Emlyn looked around and said first: "Everyone, I would like to know if the 'Planter' and 'Moon' pathways have certain special features compared to other pathways?"
After asking the question, he did not hide it at all, and added quite frankly: "I recently learned that the internal system of the Church of the Earth Mother is different from normal churches, and is divided into two parts: the Blessed and the Favored.
"The 'Favored' is the main body of the church, basically Beyonders of the 'Planter' pathway, while the 'Blessed' are Beyonders other than the 'Planter' and 'Moon' pathways.
"The main affairs of the church are handled by the 'Favored', and the 'Blessed' have only one thing to do, which is to confirm the oracle!
"It is said that the oracle confirmed by the 'Blessed' is the real oracle."
Under the recommendation of 'Child of the Goddess' Hobert, Emlyn, who was already a Sanguine earl, easily entered the high level of the Church of the Earth Mother and was responsible for building the church and extraordinary system in Loen with two other demigods.
Recently, the Church of the Earth Mother has basically had churches in every city in Loen and has begun to preach.
Currently, Emlyn is preparing for the ceremony of advancement. When he has prepared the ceremony and obtained the Beyonder characteristics from Hobert, he will immediately advance to Sequence 3 and become an important member of the Divine Council, responsible for church affairs in the Loen Kingdom.
After listening to 'Moon's' description, the other members had their own guesses, but they were not sure of the accuracy of their guesses, so no one spoke, and 'Emperor' Hobert was not in a hurry to answer this question.
Just when Emlyn thought that this question could not be answered, 'Fool' slowly looked around and smiled and asked a question: "Where do you think the source of the twenty-two pathways is?"
Everyone was pleasantly surprised. This question had been discussed at the Tarot Gathering before. At that time, everyone expressed their opinions and formed a relatively clear answer.
However, no conclusion has been reached on the specific process of the formation of Beyonder characteristics.
Mr. Fool suddenly asked this question, which meant that He would answer Mr. Moon's question through the answer to this question.
So everyone cooperated very well and described the conclusions of the previous discussion.
'Hermit' Cattleya said first: "The essence of the world is knowledge, the essence of knowledge is number, human beings are number, and the Beyonder characteristics of the twenty-two pathways are also number. Everything is number, and it has been like this since birth."
'Star' Leonard gave a relatively official answer: "The Seven Churches all believe that Beyonder characteristics come from the 'Original Creator', who transformed into all things, including gods, humans, the sea, the land, and Beyonder characteristics."
Then he glanced at 'Moon' Emlyn and said: "The Life School of Thought believes that the world is divided into three layers: the material world, the soul world, and the absolute rational world. Beyonder characteristics are the projection of certain things in the absolute rational world in the material world and the soul world. Therefore, characteristics are immortal and will only be reorganized."
Emlyn looked back at Mr. Star and said: "As one of the masters of the Second Epoch, we Sanguine believe that Beyonder characteristics do originate from the Original Creator, and then the accumulation of different characteristics gave birth to the ancient gods, who then created different races."
He paused and added, "However, I still agree more with Mr. Emperor's view that humans were transformed into different races by Beyonder characteristics."
For a while, Emlyn had been calling Hobert "Child of the Goddess," but Hobert found the title a bit awkward, so he asked Emlyn to continue calling him "Mr. Emperor."
Audrey summarized, "In other words, there's a fairly consistent understanding that Beyonder characteristics originate from the Original Creator."
Regarding the Antarctic encounter, because it involved a prehistoric civilization's research station, Hobert didn't mention it to the two Empresses.
At this moment, "The Fool" Klein asked, "Then, where did the 'Original Creator's' Characteristics come from?"
Everyone was stunned, and after a little thought, they understood what "The Fool" meant.
"The Hanged Man" Alger tentatively asked, "Honorable Mr. Fool, isn't the Original Creator the beginning of everything?"
Recently, Klein had obtained a lot of advanced information from the Seven Lights of the spirit world, and he calmly asked again, "Does anyone know the extended theory of the Beyonder characteristics Laws?"
Cattleya opened her mouth, but she didn't answer the question, because she didn't know if the knowledge she had obtained was the answer Mr. Fool needed.
To avoid the awkward situation of "'The Fool' asking, 'The World' answering," Hobert raised his hand slightly and said, "According to the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence, the higher the level of Beyonder characteristics, the greater the tendency to converge, but after converging to a certain extent, there will be a tendency to diverge."
This is the so-called "All that convergence must diverge, and all that diverges must converge."
"The Fool" Klein nodded with satisfaction, "Currently, 'The Original Creator' is in a state of Convergence. After He awakens, He will converge more Characteristics from the cosmos."
Even Alger and Cattleya took a moment to understand what Mr. Fool meant; Audrey and Leonard were a half-beat slower.
Immediately afterward, they were shocked by Mr. Fool's words.
After a long while, Alger asked, "In other words, the Original Creator hasn't awakened for the first time?"
"The Fool" didn't answer the question, which was equivalent to tacitly acknowledging it.
Cattleya thought: This completely subverts the Beyonder world's long-standing explanations and thinking about the extraordinary! We are not the only existence? Humans didn't necessarily appear or were born in the First Epoch!
Then she thought of the information she had obtained from the "Emperor" earlier: The "Emperor" said that some Outer Deities hoped to obtain some high-sequence Beyonder characteristics from the real world, so could it be that these Characteristics originally came from those Outer Deities? Or are those considered adjacent pathways of the Outer Deities?
After a long while, "The Magician" Fors asked, "Honorable Mr. Fool, what is the relationship between this and the special nature of the 'Planter' and 'Moon' pathways?"
Everyone then came back to their senses and recalled the initial question of this topic.
Mr. Fool only smiled and didn't answer.
Alger guessed based on Mr. Fool's previous words, "Is Mr. Fool saying that these two pathways are pathways that have just been converged, and they still have a certain connection with the cosmos, which is why they caused the special nature of these two pathways?"
"The Fool" Klein slowly nodded, giving an accurate answer.
Emlyn murmured to himself, "The cosmos."
The answer to this question greatly exceeded his expectations.
The Tarot Club had already shared information about the corruption of the underground and the dangers of the cosmos. All members knew that simply understanding these two concepts would lead to erosion.
After giving everyone a few seconds to react, Klein added, "It's not just these two."
Audrey habitually raised her hand and asked, "Honorable Mr. Fool, which other pathways have been converged from the cosmos?"
"The Fool" replied, "'Prisoner,' 'Criminal,' 'Lawyer,' 'Arbiter.'
"The first two originate from the 'Mother Tree of Desire,' and the last two come from the 'Son of Chaos.'"
Audrey and Fors were almost simultaneously stunned. They both looked at Hobert, and Fors also recalled Xio.
The other members also belatedly looked at the "Emperor," and at the same time, they also thought of the "Creator."
At this time, "The Fool" Klein smiled and said, "'Arbiter' and 'Lawyer' are relatively better."
As far as he knew, the "Son of Chaos" didn't have a deep influence on the "Arbiter" and "Lawyer" pathways, and it couldn't be compared to the "Mother Goddess of Depravity"'s influence on "Moon" and "Planter," or the "Mother Tree of Desire"'s influence on "Criminal" and "Prisoner." This Outer God was as quiet as if it had disappeared.
Audrey and Fors immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
Hobert thought, "The 'Son of Chaos' was sentenced to thousands of years of life imprisonment by the 'Celestial Worthy' and is currently continuing to serve his sentence in the lamp."
Emlyn sorted out his thoughts and said, "The special nature of the 'Planter' and 'Moon' pathways comes from the 'cosmos.' Is it possible that the divine revelations perceived by the Beyonders of this pathway are a kind of corruption?"
Alger glanced at Mr. Fool at the head of the bronze long table, and seeing that He didn't intend to speak, he nodded and said, "That's probably the case."
At this time, Cattleya, who had been pondering since just now, said, "I have a question: If the Original Creator's Characteristics come from the cosmos, then why are some affected by the cosmos, and some are not?"
Everyone was slightly stunned. This was indeed a question, so everyone looked at Mr. Fool again.
But "The Fool" didn't give an explanation directly, but smiled and looked at everyone, with a "I'm testing you" expression.
He thought in his heart: Uh, I didn't ask about this!
To be precise, when discussing this issue with the Seven Lights, I didn't think of this point.
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, "Emperor" Hobert said, "Mr. Fool only said that 'The Original Creator' is currently in a state of Convergence, but He didn't say that all of His Characteristics come from the cosmos.
"I think that when 'The Original Creator' was in the splitting stage, although many Characteristics were scattered throughout the universe, He must have retained some Characteristics and Sefirah, otherwise He would not be able to trigger the Convergence of Beyonder characteristics."
Hobert believed that "The Original Creator" should always hold the eight pathways of "Omniscience and Omnipotence" and "Mysteries," as well as the two Sephirot of "Chaos Sea" and "Sefirah Castle."
These two "Sephirot" and two "Pillars" are relatively special.
Moreover, "The Original Creator" only split into the two personalities of "God Almighty" and "Celestial Worthy," which also explains the problem.
In addition to the six pathways that everyone just mentioned, and the eight pathways held by "The Original Creator," the other eight pathways may also come from Outer Deities.
The reason why they are not affected by Outer Deities is that, first, those Outer Deities may be gone, such as the ones in the "Antarctic Prison," or some may have been killed by "God Almighty" and "Celestial Worthy."
Another possibility is that the Beyonder characteristics that have been "processed" by "The Original Creator" several times may be different?
Klein, sitting at the head of the table, immediately thought in his heart after hearing Hobert's explanation: Ah, that's right!
Cattleya nodded, "I understand."
Immediately afterward, Emlyn said, "I have already mastered the names of the high-sequence potions of the 'Planter' and 'Moon' pathways, and I don't understand two of them."
Whether it was the Sanguine Earl or the Archbishop of the Church of the Earth Mother, they had given him the corresponding authority to access a lot of information that he couldn't access in the past.
Seeing that the other members of the Tarot Club were looking over, Emlyn continued, "Mr. Emperor has already announced the names of Sequence 3 and Sequence 2 of the 'Moon' pathway. Sequence 1 is called 'Beauty Goddess.'
"Sequence 3 of the 'Planter' pathway is called 'Pallbearer,' Sequence 2 is called 'Desolate Matriarch,' and Sequence 1 is called 'Naturewalker.'
"What I don't understand is that the names of the potions 'Beauty Goddess' and 'Desolate Matriarch' have a certain gender orientation. You... um, what are your opinions?"
For a moment, the other members of the Tarot Club looked at each other, and no one spoke. They successively thought of a possibility.
After a few seconds, "Justice" Audrey controlled her expression and said, "I remember that Sequence 7 of the 'Assassin' pathway is called 'Witch.' The assassins who take this potion eventually become witches."
Emlyn opened his mouth: This... this must be a test for me.
He had a certain premonition and guess when he saw the names of the potions, but he was unwilling to accept it and hoped to get another explanation at the Tarot Club.
The atmosphere of the Tarot Club was a little quiet. Leonard coughed and took the initiative to say to the "Emperor," "The high-level members of the church have given a reply and agreed to the transaction with you."
Then he said, "I am very grateful to you for giving me the opportunity to become an angel."
At a Tarot Club meeting a few months ago, Hobert had asked Leonard if he wanted to change pathways? He lied that he had clues to the "Death Consul" Beyonder characteristic.
After thinking for a week or two, Leonard decided not to change pathways for the time being. He was used to life in the church, and a true god church could not accept a high-level deacon obtaining Characteristics from forces outside the church and becoming an angel.
In other words, if he wanted to become an angel, he would have to leave the Church of the Evernight Goddess, which he didn't plan to do at the moment.
However, Leonard casually asked Hobert what reward he would have to pay in exchange for that clue?
At that time, he thought that the church might be interested in this clue.
Hobert, who was already planning to launch a war against the Balam Empire during the Backlund conference, casually said that he was going to kill an angel of the Balam Empire.
What Hobert didn't expect was that Leonard took advantage of an opportunity to report this matter to the church.
At this time, a misunderstanding occurred between the two parties. The Church of the Evernight Goddess understood it as: Hobert was preparing to eliminate an angel of the Balam Empire, but He planned to trade the Beyonder characteristic of that angel with the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
When Leonard asked Hobert again what he would use to trade that Beyonder characteristic, Hobert realized that he had shot himself in the foot, so after thinking for a while, he made a request: The condition was that Leonard become the "Horror Bishop"! And Leonard would have the opportunity to become the church's next "Servant of Concealment." To this end, Leonard would provide shelter for "Earl's Light" and help "Earl's Light" develop the Feysac Empire's market, providing corresponding protection.
Leonard was completely stunned when he heard this condition. He didn't expect that even if he didn't change pathways and didn't leave the church, he would still have the opportunity to become an angel.
If someone else had made such a transaction with the church, Leonard wouldn't even have reported it, but Hobert was different. He was once a member of the "Nighthawks," and the church wouldn't have too many doubts about him, Leonard, or this transaction.
The Church of the Evernight Goddess agreed after little discussion.
The high-level members of the church also knew that with Hobert's coronation, the differences between the countries of the Northern Continent and the Atlantis Kingdom would become greater and greater, and wars might break out later.
Although it was only to protect "Earl's Light," there must be spies and Beyonders of the Atlantis Kingdom in "Earl's Light."
However, for the Church of the Evernight Goddess, this transaction was also very worthwhile, after all, it was a Beyonder characteristic at the angel level!
Leonard continued, "After I have completely digested the potion, the church will help me advance to 'Horror Bishop.' If there is an angel-level Beyonder characteristic, my advancement opportunity will be ranked first."
Alger opened his mouth. While he was very envious, he also wanted to remind "Star" that such an opportunity might have to wait a long, long time, and there was even a high probability that he would never become an angel.
But because the "Emperor" didn't express his position, Alger didn't say anything.
Hobert and Klein both knew that in the near future, Leonard would have the opportunity to advance to an angel. At that time, one or two archangels might appear in the Church of the Evernight Goddess!
Hobert nodded after hearing the Church of the Evernight Goddess's reply, "Okay, as soon as I get that Beyonder characteristic, I will complete the transaction immediately."
The situation at this time was different from the situation when the transaction was first initiated. In the near future, the Beyonder characteristic of "Death Consul" will definitely be harvested, so there is no need to crush the sealed artifact at all.
After this transaction was completed, Leonard said again, "I will share some things."
He spoke unhurriedly about some of the deeds of the wandering magician Merlin Hermes, as well as the "Fully Automatic Wishing Machine" and "Utopia."
While narrating these things, he unreservedly glanced at "The World."
Klein let "The World" say, "I have left the southern coast of Midseashire."
To be precise, Leonard's news about the "Wandering Magician" was somewhat delayed, after all, those were mostly just rumors, but "Utopia" was different. That was a real Beyonder event, so the spread of the two pieces of news was different.
For the past half month, Klein had been staying in Utopia and had begun to gradually "receive" more outsiders.
The other members were stunned. They didn't expect that "Star's" narration was actually done by "The World." They even felt that it was already a miracle.
As a high-level deacon of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, Leonard had recently been sent to investigate Merlin Hermes.
After hearing "The World's" answer, he thought: Has he already left the southern coast of the Midseashire? Then my investigation will be much easier. I can just make up a conclusion. At worst, I can directly write that Gehrman Sparrow has become a "Miracle Invoker" and is acting... anyway, I already know what I need to know.
After this topic ended, Alger asked "Sun" Derrick, "Are you currently adapting to life outside?"
Since they all moved to the Southern Continent and renamed New Lanagua City to "New City of Silver," he hadn't heard much about their new life.
"I've basically adapted." Derrick glanced at "Emperor" and continued, "South Balam… no, the Atlantis Kingdom has sent us many teachers. Some are life skills teachers, while others teach us general knowledge of the outside world, which has helped us adapt to life outside."
Cattleya joined the conversation, asking curiously, "What is your main source of income? I remember it should still be winter in the southern part of the Southern Continent. Are you not experiencing food shortages?"
"In the beginning, the Atlantis Kingdom basically helped solve the food problem," Derrick replied. "Later, after we produced our first harvest and grew fruits and vegetables, we no longer needed the Atlantis Kingdom to continue supplying us.
"Currently, the Atlantis Kingdom has entered spring. Although I am away, I heard yesterday that the residents of New City of Silver have completed this year's spring plowing…"
Cattleya keenly noticed something was wrong: "It's only early June now; it should still be winter there."
"Spring in the Atlantis Kingdom arrived early this year," Hobert explained. "Actually, it was early last year too, but it's even earlier this year."
Cattleya and Alger, along with several other members, were a little surprised. Alger asked, "How could spring arrive early?"
"Because we need to complete spring plowing as soon as possible so we have enough manpower to do other things," Hobert replied without much emotion.
Cattleya immediately understood: "Emperor" wanted spring to arrive early, so spring arrived early. This… no wonder the ancients called angels "Subsidiary Gods," this is simply a miracle!
Alger had similar feelings, and he imagined this scene: during the coldest time of the year, people are already working in the fields! It sounds… a bit eerie.
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Derrick continued to answer "Hermit's" previous question: "Initially, most of the city's expenses were resolved with the help of the Church of the Fool.
"At the same time, we also actively went to the market to trade, selling some animal skins, and in the Atlantis Kingdom's official Beyonder market, selling some Beyonder ingredients and 'low-sequence' Beyonder characteristics."
Derrick smiled slightly as he said this, "Actually, it didn't cost much at first because the Atlantis Kingdom also provided us with a lot of living supplies."
Emlyn raised his chin when he heard this, but the other members didn't quite understand why "Moon" suddenly became so arrogant.
Leonard glanced at "Emperor" and asked, "Is it all free?"
"Some of it is free," Derrick said. "Most of it needs to be repaid at market price.
"In the beginning, the government of Lanagua Port often organized some of us to help them with some construction.
"One-third of the salary was given to the participants, and two-thirds were used to repay debts.
"Later, after we gradually became familiar with the factory's machines and production processes, we began to produce many industrial products, which the Lanagua Port government would purchase at the factory price.
"After that, the factory's output became our main source of income. Tang… um, the Atlantis Kingdom's chief liaison encouraged us to sell the products ourselves because the kingdom government would only buy them at the factory price.
"We have tried to sell products to Angel City and Rockville City. Through these opportunities, we have also seen the outside world.
"It turns out the outside world is so beautiful and peaceful, and the government officials everywhere are also very kind."
"That's the Atlantis Kingdom!" Emlyn emphasized. "Only the Atlantis Kingdom is like that. Officials in other countries are more like villains."
Derrick nodded, "That's what I've heard too."
Then He added, "In addition, the Church of the Fool also has a need for Beyonders. Some of our members have joined the church and can receive a fixed income there.
"Some have formed mercenary groups and fought alongside the Atlantis Kingdom's Beyonders. They were even commended by Marshal Medici in the 'Vanity War' that ended not long ago."
Alger and Cattleya realized from these descriptions that the City of Silver's power had been fully mobilized.
Some extraordinary powers entered the Church of the Fool, and some formed mercenary groups.
Ordinary people entered factories, worked in sales, or farmed, having their own jobs.
However, as Derrick described, everyone inevitably thought of the current tense international situation.
Alger first said to "Emperor," "I saw in the newspaper that the conflict between the Atlantis Kingdom and the Northern Continent seems to be escalating?"
In fact, he was being polite because the Loen newspapers were already denouncing Hobert and the Atlantis Kingdom's betrayal and saying they were destroying world peace.
"Yes," Hobert said seriously. "I said last week that after Loen and other Northern Continent countries joined forces to restore the Paz Kingdom, we completely lost the possibility of dialogue and negotiation.
"Everyone, if someone puts a bomb in front of your house, what would you do?
"Anyway, I would shoot at him!"
Cattleya realized, "I didn't expect a new war to break out so soon after the previous world war ended."
Leonard frowned slightly, "It shouldn't start immediately, right?"
According to his observation, the countries of the Northern Continent have not completely recovered from the decline of the war. Construction is underway everywhere, and industry and industrial production have just returned to normal.
But after Leonard finished his conclusion, he still looked at Hobert.
Hobert smiled, "That's not necessarily true."
For Him, this was an opportunity because the longer they waited, the stronger the Northern Continent countries would become.
Now it depends on whether Loen and other countries have enough strategic focus to watch Hobert unify the Southern Continent.
If they have such strategic focus, with their original foundation, they can quickly restore their national power.
But similarly, by that time, Hobert will be able to deal with the Northern Continent countries more calmly.
Klein manipulated "World" and asked, "Is there no room for reconciliation?"
Hobert suddenly recalled a sentence: "The Iron Curtain has fallen."

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 727 The Iron Curtain Has Fallen
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
To the Fool Klein's question, Emperor Hobert replied, "The Iron Curtain has fallen."
The other members all thought that the "Emperor" was describing the current international situation, as if the "Iron Curtain" had fallen and become a foregone conclusion.
Only Klein understood that Hobert meant that once this ideological struggle began, it would be a fight to the death, without any room for compromise.
This reminded him of the history of prehistoric civilizations, and he inwardly sighed that the development of the situation was always surprisingly consistent.
That once immensely large red giant with its steel torrent was also established at the end of World War I.
But the difference was that Hobert clearly understood the trajectory of historical development, first using war to seize massive amounts of wealth, and then obtaining large amounts of war reparations as a victorious nation.
Finally, there was Hobert's use of Beyonder forces. Theoretically, given the current situation, countries like Loen should have long frozen all assets of the Atlantis Kingdom in the Northern Continent.
However, according to Klein's understanding during his time in industrial cities like Constant, half of the real estate in the entire southern coast industrial area of the Inner Sea was owned by the Atlantis Kingdom, and no one had confiscated it.
Before, it was because they were still allies, but now it was because the Loen Kingdom no longer had the ability to directly confront Atlantis, so they dared not push things too far.
In terms of Beyonder power, Atlantis was already much stronger than Loen, and in terms of the orthodox churches, the Church of Mother Earth would definitely support Atlantis.
If a choice had to be made, the Church of the Evernight Goddess would most likely support Atlantis, and before a choice had to be made, the Church of the Evernight Goddess would maintain its current neutrality.
The Church of the Lord of Storms, considering the attitude of its allies, would probably also choose neutrality, or provide limited assistance to the Loen royal family, such as intervening to preserve some of the royal family's strength if Loen were to lose in the war, but don't expect them to actively provide assistance.
As for the other churches, the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom had no direct vested interests and would probably choose to stay out of it. The Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun and the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery, as the losing side, had just signed some religious agreements and would not easily take action.
So, in terms of the orthodox churches, Atlantis had a certain advantage.
With this set of "combination punches," the assets of Atlantis in the Northern Continent would not only not be frozen, but they could also continue to use those industries to continuously transfuse blood into the newborn Atlantis.
This was also different from Klein's impression of history. He believed that under Hobert's deployment, Atlantis would definitely become strong quickly!
But such strength was definitely something that the countries of the Northern Continent were unwilling to see, and even something they were very afraid of.
Hobert spread his hands and said, "Don't make it seem like we started the war. During the peace talks in Backlund, we were isolated.
"Especially Loen. They originally promised to help us obtain franchise rights in many industries throughout the Northern Continent after the war, but they went back on their word on the second day of negotiations.
"I can understand that they were forced to agree to some of our conditions when the war situation was unfavorable, but what I cannot understand is why they have no guilt about their subsequent breach of contract?"
The other members were speechless. Most of them did not want the war to continue, but the decision of whether or not to start a war was not in their hands.
After another moment of silence, Hermit Cattleya initiated a new topic: "I heard that William I, the 'Protector' of the Loen Kingdom, was killed!"
The members were all stunned. In previous exchanges, they had learned that the Archangel of the Feynapotter royal family had lost his Beyonder characteristics. Unexpectedly, now the Archangel of the Loen Kingdom had also been killed!
"Yes," Hobert gave a definite answer: "Trunsoest planned to seize William I's Beyonder characteristics, but we detected it, so we used Trunsoest's plan to kill William I."
"Ah?" Star Leonard didn't react for a moment: What kind of logic is this?
Klein also sighed: Is this the lawyer's way of thinking?
Cattleya was slightly stunned: "So, William I was killed by you?"
Hobert nodded, but did not reveal the details.
Klein also realized: This is to prevent Trunsoest from obtaining more Sequence 1 characteristics.
Hanged Man Alger said, "Could this be the reason for the current tense international situation?"
Hobert smiled: "Who told William I to push Trunsoest out to be the king of the Paz Kingdom? Perhaps Loen's victory in the previous desperate situation made them suddenly lose themselves.
"William I actually had the idea of using Trunsoest. The moment he had this idea, his fate was already sealed."
Alger and the other members all realized that they couldn't discuss the world situation with the "Emperor," otherwise all the faults would be with the "Emperor's" opponents.
This time, Klein didn't object to the war very much. He had personally seen the prosperity of Atlantis, and the common people had regained hope and confidence in life.
He also saw that the ills of the countries of the Northern Continent had not been eliminated because of the war, but only that the current demands had increased, covering up some of the ills.
In Klein's view, if this war were to break out, it would be a "righteous war."
The topic ended here, and the hall was silent again for a while before Alger asked Sun Derrick, "I heard that there were some problems with your scriptures? Have the problems been resolved now?"
The "Fool's Scripture" is basically only spread in Atlantis, and the speed of its spread is not very fast, so Alger has only now heard that some of the content of the "Scripture" is inappropriate.
Derrick subconsciously glanced at Mr. Fool shrouded in the gray-white mist: "The problem has been solved."
Cattleya asked curiously, "What problems did you encounter?"
Derrick glanced at the "Emperor" again before saying, "Some descriptions were not verified, or were too exaggerated. We have already made a revision."
Alger reminded, "Be sure to pay attention, don't promote that other churches are bad, so as not to cause conflict."
Klein, sitting at the head of the bronze long table, thought of the scriptures they had revised: It can only be said that it won't cause trouble, but some funny things will definitely still happen. For example, one day, Will Auceptin will be surprised to find when he sees the Church of the Fool's scriptures: When did I become an angel under the "Fool"?
Then, Leonard's old grandpa, the awakened Azik, and the messenger lady who was trying to recover her state followed suit: What, me too?
After exchanging information about the scriptures, Cattleya looked around, not holding too much expectation, and said, "Does anyone have the Beyonder characteristics of Sequence 3 of the 'Mystery Pryer' pathway?"
She had digested the 'Mystic' potion for a long time, but she had only obtained the 'Prophet' potion formula from the Moses Ascetic Order, and was still very, very far from obtaining the Beyonder characteristics or the main ingredients.
Although she was a member of the ten pillars of the Moses Ascetic Order, the higher the sequence pathway, the more precious the corresponding resources. Even such an ancient organization could not squander them arbitrarily.
Moreover, Cattleya came from the "Element Dawn", and was less influenced by the "Hidden Sage", and was not so trusted within the Moses Ascetic Order.
It might be a few years, or even more than ten years, before she had any hope of getting a advancement opportunity from her organization, so she had to seek help at the Tarot Gathering.
None of the other members spoke. Beyonder characteristics of this level are not like radishes on a roadside stall, everywhere.
Most of them are also worried about the characteristics and advancement of Sequence 3.
At this time, Hobert suddenly said, "Do you have any thoughts of jumping to an adjacent pathway?"
Everyone was familiar with this sentence. After thinking about it for a while, they immediately looked at Leonard.
Cattleya took a deep breath, almost without thinking, "Yes."
Hobert slowly nodded. This was the reaction of a normal person. To be honest, he really didn't expect that Leonard would be able to refuse to jump to an adjacent pathway and give up the opportunity to become an angel.
But thinking about it, such a decision was indeed in line with Leonard's personality.
"I have clues to the Beyonder characteristics of 'Arcane Scholar' and 'Knowledge Magister'," Hobert said. "I can help you solve the potion formula."
The "clues" Hobert was talking about were the "0-82" crystal light curtain obtained in the previous battle of gods, which was a sealed artifact comparable to the "Knowledge Magister".
Moreover, its ability was very weak. If it could be used to cultivate an angel, that would be great.
As for the potion formula, it was very easy for Hobert to obtain. He only needed to use "Connection" to get the corresponding formula.
Even the characteristics after being crushed can form a "Connection".
Hobert did have a copy of the Beyonder characteristics of the "Knowledge Emperor" in his hand, but there was still some of Roselle's mental residue in it, so he did not intend to crush this Beyonder characteristic.
Cattleya was excited for a while: "I, what kind of reward should I pay?"
"I have to think about this, or discuss it," Hobert said. "I can give you the potion formula first tomorrow. You can prepare the ritual first, and you can try to advance when the time is right, and then make up the reward later."
"Okay!" Cattleya took a deep breath and sincerely said, "Thank you!"
That was the opportunity to become an angel! It was the dream of many people!
At this time, Moon Emlyn suddenly sighed: "The third one!"
Everyone knew that he was talking about the fact that this was the third clue to angel-level Beyonder characteristics that the Emperor had taken out!
Magician Fors thought in her heart: What you don't know is that Hobert has prepared the Beyonder characteristics for me to advance to Sequence 3, and has also obtained clues to the "Traveler" Beyonder characteristics.
Klein also thought: So, the Beyonder characteristics for me to become an angel were also obtained with Hobert's help.
This made him once again sigh at the difference between angels and angels.
After completing this transaction, everyone did not continue to exchange information, and Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.
Hobert and Audrey, who had returned to the real world, did not get up immediately, but continued to lie on the bed. Audrey asked first, "Hobert, where did you get so many high-level Beyonder characteristic clues?"
Hobert smiled and said, "This is not the clue I obtained alone."
Then he said, "Currently, for me, as long as there are clues, I can relatively easily obtain an angel-level Beyonder characteristic.
"If we can have a few more angels who are kind to us, this is a very cost-effective business."
Audrey hummed, as if that was the case.
Hobert sat up first: "Since your parents are here, spend some time with your parents.
"Well, you haven't been back to Loen for a long time. I'll just give you a month's vacation."
Audrey was about to refuse, but Hobert said first: "In a month or two, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will definitely be very, very busy. Even if you want to rest, you won't have time then."
Audrey was moved, because she hadn't rested for a while.
"It's best not to go back to Backlund," Hobert instructed. "Your current identity is a bit special. If you go back to Backlund, you may encounter some trouble. I suggest you go to the family territory in East Chester County to relax."
Audrey sighed: "I do miss the beautiful mountains and rivers there, and the fresh air there."
Hobert smiled slightly: "Pay attention to safety. If you encounter any problems, contact me immediately with the 'Order Crystal'."
"Oh," Audrey agreed, feeling that she was a demigod anyway, and should not encounter any unsolvable problems.
Hobert stood by the bed and stretched: "Okay, I should go meet the envoys."
Audrey got up and shared a kiss with Hobert.
Back in the office, the court butler invited Princess Ethel, the envoy of the Feynapotter Kingdom, in.
When countries send envoys, it is very important to meet which one first. In the past, Hobert would definitely meet the Loen envoy first, but now it is different.
Hobert exchanged simple pleasantries with the princess, who still had short hair, and then talked about the topic. Ethel said, "No matter what the future situation is, we will firmly stand on the side of the Atlantis Kingdom."
Of course, they had to stand on this side. The Church of Mother Earth definitely supported the Atlantis Kingdom.
For the Feynapotter royal family, without the Archangel, basically the church went, and the royal family had to follow.
Moreover, the Atlantis Kingdom was already strong enough. In the previous World War, the Southern Balam Duchy could only affect the war situation. Under the pressure of the Intis and Feysac armies, their tactics could only be guerrilla warfare.
But now it was different. The war had only ended for more than half a year, and the Atlantis Kingdom already had the power to challenge the entire Northern Continent!
Ethel's statement made Hobert nod slightly, but he talked about another thing: "Actually, we don't regard the nobles as enemies, or rather, we don't regard anyone as enemies!
"We hope to let ordinary people create more wealth, so that the cake will be bigger, and everyone can get more benefits."
Ethel seemed to think for a while before saying, "We will consider introducing the political model of the Atlantis Kingdom."
Hobert smiled and said, "As a friend, I want to remind you that the sooner this process is, the better. If you wait until the end of the war, the Feynapotter Kingdom will miss the best opportunity."
Ethel nodded: "I will try to persuade the parliament as soon as possible."
Hobert suddenly jumped to another question: "Do you still want to be queen?"
Ethel was taken aback for a moment, then suppressed her excitement: "Yes, but there are still some obstacles."
Originally, with Philip I's support, she would definitely have won the battle for the throne, but the problem now is that Philip I has rapidly lost his original authority after losing the Archangel status.
Hobert hummed, "If you plan to introduce the political model of the Atlantis Kingdom, I will send an angel to send you back home."
"When you become queen, you can promote corresponding reforms. However, what is certain is that in the future, the nobles of Feynapotter will lose many rights, and the rich will not be able to do whatever they want as before."
"You have to be mentally prepared for this, and the royal family's Beyonders must also be mentally prepared."
Ethel immediately said: "I will ask the person you send to form a cabinet, and all the management work of the kingdom will be handed over to the cabinet."
Hobert was very satisfied with Ethel's promise: "I will only send people to help you form a transitional government. After the government is operating normally, we will leave at most some consultants. In the next few years, these consultants will gradually withdraw."
By then, he could use politics and economics to coerce the Feynapotter Kingdom, and it wouldn't matter whether he left consultants or not.
Ethel took a deep breath, inwardly lamenting that she should have come here earlier.
Then she asked: "Is the battle in the Balam Empire going smoothly? Do you need our support?"
The Northern Continent countries have different views on this war. Some say that the Atlantis Kingdom has gained an advantage, while others say that the Atlantis Kingdom is caught in a quagmire of war.
Because they were afraid of causing misunderstandings, Feynapotter had never sent anyone to the front line to conduct detailed investigations.
But Hobert smiled and said, "You don't need to worry about the upcoming war. My marshal once said: If the Paz Kingdom is still there in the New Year, it will be a shame to him."
Ethel's eyes narrowed, and she thought of Medici, who had once been loyal to the "Creator."
Hobert continued: "You have such worries only because the Southern Continent has long been on the edge of the civilization circle."
"But now it's different. This place will be the center of the civilization circle in the future!"
After chatting about the international situation for a few more words, Ethel said goodbye and left.
As she walked out, she suddenly recalled the scene more than two years ago, when she invited Hobert to her villa as a guest and tried to win him over, hoping to help her fight for the position of heir.
And now, Hobert already has the ability to directly send her to the position of queen.
After ending the meeting with the special envoy of the Feynapotter Kingdom, Hobert then met with Princess Alice, the special envoy of the Loen Kingdom.
The two of them also chatted casually for a few words, and Alice said helplessly: "Hobert, why has the situation developed to this point?"
Hobert didn't say anything too official, but just smiled and said, "Our differences are in all aspects, and I can't ignore the Loen's high-level hostility towards the Atlantis Kingdom."
Alice took a deep breath: "Don't you have any explanation for the death of Loen Kingdom's 'Protector'?"
But Hobert said: "A child holding a piece of gold passing through a busy city is easily robbed.
"So, is this the child's fault? Or the gold's fault? Or the robber's fault?"
Alice opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but said nothing.
It was the first time she had heard someone describe the "Protector" as a child.
Hobert continued: "William I should have firmly joined hands with me to deal with Trunsoest, instead of helping Trunsoest to deal with me.
"I know what William I was thinking at the time. He felt that I and Trunsoest were bigger enemies. If our territories were not far apart, we would definitely fight first.
"And in order not to let Trunsoest recover the Beyonder characteristics in William I's body, I would definitely continue to ally with Loen to fight against Trunsoest.
"This way, he can play both sides in the Northern Continent, watching us fight to the point of exhaustion, and then find opportunities to seize some benefits.
"This is the political model that Loen likes to use in its colonies, which is very annoying."
Alice nodded: "I understand."
Hobert said again: "The Iron Curtain has fallen. The future direction of the world can only be determined by war."
The two did not talk for too long, because Alice had clearly felt Hobert's attitude. There was no possibility of any mediation in the relationship between the two countries.
The third person Hobert met was the Intis envoy. This envoy tentatively asked: Can the Intis prisoners of war be released in advance?
According to the previous "Backlund Armistice", Hobert would release more than 320,000 Intis prisoners of war within a year.
About half a year has passed, and Hobert has only released less than 60,000 people.
These prisoners of war have greatly solved the problem of labor shortages in various places. They built houses and squares, and so far, they have basically built two small cities.
And Intis currently wants these prisoners of war back just to expand its army!
After all, these prisoners of war have undergone long-term military training and have also participated in wars, which are much stronger than newly recruited soldiers.
So Hobert offered the condition that if Intis could pay off the war reparations in advance, he would release the prisoners in advance.
The war reparations that Intis is responsible for paying to the Atlantis Kingdom are worth 1.5 billion pounds, and only 300 million pounds have been paid so far.
Including the war reparations from the Feysac Empire, the Atlantis Kingdom has only received about 600 million pounds in reparations so far.
Hobert used these reparations to build 3 large offshore docks and 2 airship assembly centers, 1 large artillery factory, and part of it was distributed to the families of the martyrs in the form of pensions.
In the end, they did not achieve any constructive results. Intis did not pay the reparations in advance, and the Atlantis Kingdom did not intend to release the prisoners in advance.
The subsequent meetings were uneventful, and everyone clearly felt Hobert's strong hostility.
After the special envoys returned to their countries, shocking news shocked the high-level officials of the Northern Continent countries: With the support of the Atlantis Kingdom, the current King Ferdinand II of Feynapotter abdicated, and Princess Ethel ascended the throne!
This gave the nobles of the Northern Continent a sense of urgency. They realized that they had to do something, otherwise their kings or emperors might also abdicate inexplicably.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 728: "Pregnant Angel" Bernadette
chapters.content:
