The international situation in the Northern and Southern continents has suddenly become perplexing. In theory, the confrontations and conflicts in this world are determined by Beyonder forces, and the opposition of secular forces should not spread worldwide.
However, the current situation is different; secular forces are now dominating the confrontation between the Northern and Southern continents.
So far, only the Church of the Earth Mother has stated that it will protect the Kingdom of Atlantis from invasion.
This means very clearly that if the war spreads to the current territory of the Kingdom of Atlantis, the Church of the Earth Mother will definitely come forward to mediate.
However, they will not interfere with the expansion of the Kingdom of Atlantis, nor will they provide assistance.
The other churches have not yet made any statements. They are not optimistic about the Paz Kingdom and Trunsoest, nor do they believe that the Balam Empire can win the war.
But they also do not strongly support the Kingdom of Atlantis, because the political model of this kingdom will cause the church to lose huge benefits.
Currently, the social model of the Northern Continent is almost based on the "church system." For example, there is a church in a community, and everyone's relationships are established through faith and the church.
This is why many social celebrities attend church receptions because they can expand their network through the church.
As for other ways to expand one's network, there are not many. Clubs generally have obvious professional or regional barriers. First, you need to have a certain network to join a club.
And the "basic network" is easiest to obtain through the church.
Overall, people's social relationships are connected through the church and the church.
However, the model of the Kingdom of Atlantis is different. Its main body is the various levels of government. Basically, the government has clear regulations on all aspects of life, and the church hardly intervenes.
The reason why Hobert attaches so much importance to the training of grassroots officials is that in the Kingdom of Atlantis, village chiefs and community leaders connect people.
During the spring plowing season, the village chief will organize people to help those in need in the village. During the harvest, the village chief will explain how to store grain.
In the city, you can find the community director, also known as the community leader, for problems in life. Some problems are solved in the community, and some problems are subdivided by the community leader and solved by relevant departments.
When villagers and citizens encounter difficulties, they first go to grassroots officials, because if the grassroots cannot solve the problem, there are also town governments, county governments, and even city or state governments, with a large number of administrative resources to help solve the problem.
This is more efficient than the church, so people gradually stop going to the church to solve problems and only go to the church for spiritual comfort.
Secondly, they do not rely on the church economically. In the Northern Continent, the church holds many assets, so it can provide many job opportunities and is an important part of the local economy.
However, the land in the Kingdom of Atlantis is state-owned, and job opportunities are created by various state-owned or private companies. The church does not play much role in the local economy.
Then, the church and the church will inevitably be marginalized. This is the main reason why the church has concerns about the Kingdom of Atlantis. Even the Church of the Earth Mother has some differences with the Kingdom of Atlantis on the issue of the religious court.
So the current situation is roughly like this: if Hobert is in danger, the Earth Mother and the Evernight Goddess will not stand idly by, but if Hobert launches a war of aggression, the church will not oppose it due to the pressure of the gods, but it will not support it either.
This gives the impression that the orthodox church is unwilling to participate in the secular society's struggle for this social model.
Therefore, the confrontation in terms of extraordinary power has basically become the confrontation of Beyonder power between the governments of various countries. The extraordinary power of the church has basically not provided support to any party.
This is actually beneficial to Hobert, because if there were no gods, the church would definitely stand on the side of the Northern Continent. With the gods, the church would choose to help neither side.
Then, for the countries of the Northern Continent, it is very important to protect the Paz Kingdom. This is their bridgehead and the last line of defense to limit the rise of the Kingdom of Atlantis!
Especially after the abdication of King Ferdinand, they couldn't wait any longer and did everything they could to help the Paz Kingdom.
In order to make the aid more efficient, the Loen Kingdom even planned to contribute the technology of the teleportation array, but the embarrassing thing is that they cannot provide teleportation capabilities for the teleportation array.
The teleportation array is divided into two key parts: one is to arrange the array using various diamonds, and the other is to need a force to activate the teleportation array, and this force must have Beyonder abilities in terms of "space."
For example, in the teleportation array of the Kingdom of Atlantis, Hobert used a Beyonder characteristic of "Secrets Sorcerer" as the power base and the power of "Nation of Disorder" as the level to give the teleportation array the ability to teleport.
The reason why Hobert can do this is that the "Lawyer's" ability of "applicability" is very strong, and the level of "Nation of Disorder" is very high, so he can use a characteristic at the "Secrets Sorcerer" level to build a teleportation array.
But the situation is different after the countries of the Northern Continent broke up with the Kingdom of Atlantis. Currently, only the Feysac Empire has an Archangel, and His ability has nothing to do with space ability, so there is no way to provide power for the teleportation array.
Just when the opposition between the Northern and Southern continents was so serious that war could break out at any time, Hobert added fuel to the fire again and set up a "Paz Kingdom Countdown" in the 'Atlantis Daily'!
He believes that this kingdom can only exist for a maximum of 4 months, and starts counting down from this day, with the headline on the front page every day saying: How many days are left until the demise of the Paz Kingdom.
This made the countries of the Northern Continent even more anxious, and the aid to the Paz Kingdom gradually included personnel assistance from the initial supplies.
...
On the Fog Sea.
After entering the sea area without safe lanes, "Queen Mystic" Bernadette seemed to have lost her sense of time. If it weren't for the precise wall clock hanging in her captain's room, she would have forgotten how many days she had been in this dangerous area.
The strong wind and heavy rain made the ship fly high and move sideways, as if experiencing an apocalypse.
Bernadette watched calmly, waiting patiently.
Finally, the storm suddenly subsided, and the outline of an island appeared in the distance.
Although Bernadette could not be sure that this was the primitive island her father had been to, her intuition as a "Clairvoyant" told her that this was likely the place she was looking for.
As the coastline gradually came into view, Bernadette saw one towering, deep green tree after another on the island. The sheer "size" of these trees gave people a huge sense of impact and oppression.
Bernadette stretched out her hand and glanced at the "Crystal of Order" Hobert had given her in her palm.
She took a deep breath and injected spirituality into the "Crystal of Order." Still a little worried, she prayed to the "Creator" before ordering the 'Dawn' to stop in the offshore area and not to go ashore. She carefully entered the spirit world and landed on the edge of the island.
Bernadette did not rush to explore further. She cautiously took out a illusory hat and put it on her head, and her figure disappeared, concealing all traces.
After walking a few steps along a road that was obviously opened up, Hobert, dressed in a knight's uniform, suddenly appeared beside her.
Bernadette was slightly stunned. She could feel that Hobert did not come from the spirit world, it was as if... as if He was already there.
Because this is Hobert's substitute. In order to prevent Roselle from affecting his Beyonder characteristics and uniqueness, Hobert's main body is hiding in the "Nation of Disorder" and only uses the substitute to contact Bernadette.
This is a unique ability of Hobert, because even the "Black Emperor" can only hide more discreetly in the "shadows," and cannot reach the safety of the main body in the "Nation of Disorder."
Hobert looked back and forth, and finally stopped his gaze at Bernadette's position: "Your stealth ability is pretty good."
In addition, He is now a genuine King of Angels. Unless facing the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," he will not be corrupted by the Outer Deities, so he dares to appear here so swaggeringly.
Bernadette was about to say something, but Hobert said first: "Only you can hear my voice and see my existence here."
He said: "Continue to walk forward, I will follow behind you."
While speaking, Hobert's substitute "distorted" his state, changing himself from a state of "existence" to a state of "non-existence."
In Bernadette's view, Hobert suddenly disappeared, and she couldn't feel His existence at all!
And she was very clear that Hobert was actually by her side.
Hobert planned to take a look at the state of this island, so he did not immediately use his ability to find Roselle's mausoleum.
With Hobert covering her back, Bernadette felt a lot more relieved. She took a deep breath and continued to move forward, entering the forest composed of huge trees.
Soon she discovered that it was too quiet here. There was no birdsong, no roars of wild beasts, and even no sound of insects crawling.
According to Bernadette's understanding, there should be many Beyonder creatures that have become extinct outside, and it should be quite lively. But now, she feels like she is walking in a deserted graveyard, and every giant tree is a tombstone.
After walking for a full half an hour, the front suddenly opened up. Bernadette slowed down and stretched out her right hand to press her brow. A pair of eyelash-less, unusually cold transparent eyes appeared in front of her.
Then, this pair of "Eyes of Mystery Prying" was taken by an invisible hand and placed on the face of a transparent person.
This transparent person is Bernadette's "Invisible Servant."
The "Invisible Servant" quickly passed through the open forest in front and arrived at the edge of a large open space, where countless creatures were crawling.
They included red dragons with fire flowing through their skin, tree men with wooden bumps as eyes, eight-legged demon wolves, long-limbed giants, huge feathered serpents with gloomy green scales, and several humans!
At this time, they were all facing one direction, crawling with their upper bodies or heads, seemingly worshiping an unknown existence, and none of them made a sound.
Bernadette adjusted the "Invisible Servant's" gaze to the humans. Her blue pupils dilated slightly, because those people were all wearing luxurious Roselle-era clothing.
Could these be the craftsmen who once built the mausoleum here?
But she immediately denied her idea, because the craftsmen would not dress so gorgeously.
Five people!
Bernadette's spirituality noticed this number, which immediately reminded her of the five knights who initially followed her father.
At this time, those creatures stood up at the same time, and the entire primitive forest seemed to come alive all of a sudden.
Seizing this opportunity, Bernadette saw clearly the appearance of the five people: "Grimm, that's Grimm who died on this island! I've only seen him in the paintings left by my father.
"That's Uncle William. I remember his appearance. He once taught me swordsmanship…
"And Uncle Poli…"
When she recognized the fourth person, Bernadette's face, which rarely showed emotional fluctuations, revealed an undisguisable astonishment.
That person is: Edwards!
In Bernadette's memory, this knight lived until her father's death, and then the whole family moved to Lenburg. He didn't die on this primitive island at all!
According to the information she got from "Vice Admiral Iceberg," Edwards lived to be nearly a hundred years old, passed away very peacefully, and was buried in a cemetery in the suburbs of Lenburg.
Bernadette realized that something was wrong here: Uncle Edwards also returned to this island? Wasn't he not corrupted?
Then she realized: Her father said that he had solved the corruption of this island, but… but why did such a mutation still happen?
Because of Bernadette's contemplation, the "Eyes of Mystery Prying" on the face of the "Invisible Servant" had been staring at the human who was suspected to be Edwards.
Suddenly, the human who was suspected to be Edwards turned his head. His face was old, his hair was all white, and he was looking at the location of the "Invisible Servant" with cold, wooden eyes.
At this moment, Bernadette was about to directly let the "Eyes of Mystery Prying" dissipate and let the "Invisible Servant" return to the spirit world.
Suddenly, the human who was suspected to be Edwards withdrew his rigid gaze.
"It can't find your 'Invisible Servant'." Hobert's voice suddenly came from behind Bernadette: "This 'island' can't find the 'Invisible Servant' either."
Bernadette first breathed a sigh of relief, and then asked: "I know that person. He is my father's subordinate. He was clearly buried in Lenburg, but why is he here?"
As if the surrounding air made Hobert's voice: "He was corrupted, and will return here after death."
Bernadette frowned: "So, my father didn't completely clean up the corruption here?"
"Obviously yes."
Bernadette asked knowingly: "Do you know where this corruption comes from?"
"Yes."
"Where from?"
In the air, Hobert's voice said again: "I can only tell you after you become an angel."
Bernadette nodded. She knew that it was some information that could be affected just by knowing it.
The two stopped talking. After a while, Bernadette carefully manipulated the "Invisible Servant" to enter the open space where the creatures had been worshiping. In the direction they had been worshiping, there was a boulder with a simple shrine made of dark red wood.
The "Invisible Servant" continued to approach cautiously, a move that was actually somewhat dangerous, but the fact that Hobert didn't stop it meant the level of danger was within an acceptable range.
Upon reaching the boulder, the "Invisible Servant" discovered that the shrine was empty, with no idol or emblem composed of symbolic signs.
Bernadette frowned: the creatures of this island seemed to worship something that didn't exist!
Unable to foresee anything from it, she had to withdraw her gaze and direct the "Invisible Servant" to continue exploring forward.
Because the "Invisible Servant" couldn't stray too far from Bernadette, she, wearing the "Invisibility Hat," quietly followed behind, passing at a moderate pace through the area where all the creatures of the island had gathered before.
The "Invisible Servant" ahead re-entered the forest and quickly noticed rows of pale corpses placed among the trees along the roadside.
Some belonged to giant dragons, some came from bird-like creatures, some had eight legs, and some were themselves strange giant trees.
Bernadette felt as if she had come to a graveyard, and the following scene emerged in her mind:
Before their deaths, those Beyonder creatures gave birth to offspring, passing on Beyonder characteristics to them, while they themselves struggled from all directions to this area of the primeval forest, seeking unoccupied places, facing a certain direction, dying quietly, gradually decaying, and eventually turning into white bones.
As a "Clairvoyant," Bernadette fully believed that the scenes that appeared in her mind were real events: what meaning did this place hold for them? Moreover, since the already deceased Grimm, William, and others seemed to still be alive in some state, there was no reason for the extraordinary or mutated creatures that had suffered more corruption to die completely.
Continuing forward, the "Invisible Servant" saw a black stone pillar, as thick as five or six people could embrace, and thirty-four meters high, suddenly appearing in the forest, giving a sense of vicissitude and desolation.
It was as if a prosperous civilization had once appeared here, and then the civilization withered, leaving only this stone pillar and the corpses beside it.
Bernadette used the "Invisible Servant" to carefully observe for a while and was certain that this stone pillar did not possess Beyonder characteristics, nor did it have any mystery; it seemed to be just a casually erected symbol.
The "Invisible Servant" looked around and found that the corpses in the area around this stone pillar were not severely decayed, and still had relatively intact flesh and skin.
Based on everything observed, Bernadette initially suspected that it wasn't that there was no extraordinary power here, but that it could only manifest at specific times.
The "Invisible Servant" searched around for a while and found no other clues. Just as the "Invisible Servant" was about to leave, Bernadette suddenly heard a "rustling" sound.
It sounded like the wind blowing through the leaves, but not a single leaf around was moving.
Instinctively, Bernadette made the "Invisible Servant" turn around and look at the black stone pillar.
She saw that around the stone pillar, the decayed parts of the corpses were falling off piece by piece, and new flesh was rapidly growing out, with intact skin covering the flesh.
This change lasted only a few seconds before stopping, and some of the corpses no longer had any traces of decay, looking as if they had just died.
The next moment, a mutated baboon with curly fur and an eight-legged demonic wolf stood up unsteadily, their fur slightly white, and their eyes very dull and indifferent.
These two creatures, originally dead, each identified a direction and left this graveyard from different places.
Bernadette raised her eyebrows slightly, seemingly understanding why the creatures on this island struggled to come here before they died: around the stone pillar, the end point of death was not connected to eternal slumber, but to a new beginning!
She asked into the air, "Have the underlying rules of the world been distorted and disordered here?"
This seemed to be related to the Beyonder abilities of the "Black Emperor" pathway at a high level.
The "air" was very quiet, and just as Bernadette was wondering if Hobert was still by her side, Hobert's voice finally came: "This is obviously a mutation of a Beyonder power."
He had only just thought of it: the "Mother" and "Moon" pathways both had the authority to mutate creatures.
However, at higher levels, the "Mother's" authority was more inclined to make life wither and grow, while the authority of mutation was basically concentrated in the "Moon" pathway, which could easily mutate life into monsters or "new species."
In theory, these were all related to the authority of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," and even higher than the authority at the level of gods. She was very likely to also possess the ability to mutate Beyonder abilities.
What was happening here might have been utilizing the characteristic of Roselle building his mausoleum here, but the resurrection of these creatures was clearly different from the resurrection of the "Black Emperor" pathway.
After accommodating the Uniqueness, Hobert could also make people "resurrect," but that was just a "distortion" of the concept of life and death; the "resurrection" process could be completed instantly, but the "person" who came back to life was just a Zombie.
Only the "Black Emperor" himself could completely escape the "rules" of life and death and complete true resurrection.
The resurrection of creatures here, however, was clearly a reversal of the direction of withering and growth for the surrounding creatures.
The authority of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" occupied the main component in this, and the relevant authority of the "Black Emperor" was more like an "additive," and obviously, some kind of mutation had occurred.
Hobert explained simply to Bernadette: "You can understand the scene before you as 'life is immortal,' rather than resurrection."
At this moment, he truly realized that "immortality" must be the core authority of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
Bernadette quickly understood Hobert's meaning, which was to say that the scene before her was "not dead," not "resurrection."
At this time, she sensed that if she continued to let the "Invisible Servant" stay there and experience another "new life tide," it might also mutate and develop some kind of consciousness.
Therefore, Bernadette directed the "Invisible Servant" to quickly leave this "graveyard." After more than ten minutes, she finally heard the occasional chirping of birds and the roars of wild animals, and this place seemed to have turned into a normal forest.
Bernadette breathed a sigh of relief, exhaling a suppressed breath from her chest and abdomen, but soon she and the "Invisible Servant" both stopped.
Because in front of the "Invisible Servant" appeared something that was relatively abrupt in the primeval island environment: a wooden house.
The "Invisible Servant" did not immediately go forward, but observed the wooden house from a distance. It was generally brown-green, no more than two and a half meters high, and seemed to be built for humans.
After observing for a while, the "Invisible Servant" continued to approach.
At this time, the door of the wooden house was open, allowing Bernadette to clearly see the situation inside. There were tables, round chairs, and a bed, and it was clear that someone lived here.
Just as the "Invisible Servant" continued to observe the details there, Hobert beside Bernadette suddenly said, "Sometimes 'complete concealment' is not a good thing. Get ready, I'm going to restore the 'Invisible Servant' to its normal state."
Before Bernadette understood what Hobert meant, she seemed to foresee something and made the "Invisible Servant" turn around. She didn't know when, but there was a person behind the "Invisible Servant."
He had completely white hair and an old appearance. It was Edwards.
At this time, Edwards stared at the "Invisible Servant" and said uncertainly, "Your Highness?"
Bernadette was silent for two seconds and responded through the "Invisible Servant": "Uncle Edwards, why are you here?"
Edwards' face was pale: "I don't know.
"I found myself back on this island when I woke up one time.
"This may be my destiny, the destiny to guard His Majesty."
He paused after each sentence, as if he hadn't spoken for a long time and his speech needed to adapt.
Without waiting for Bernadette to ask, this knight, who was famous more than a hundred years ago, added: "His Majesty's mausoleum is nearby.
"I have been guarding here, waiting for Him to resurrect.
"However, so many years have passed, and the mausoleum has never shown any signs of resurrection."
Bernadette had the "Invisible Servant" look around and then asked, "Is this wooden house where you live?"
"Yes. I built this house with the surrounding trees."
Bernadette asked again, "Are Uncle William and the others not with you?"
Edwards' cold eyes moved slightly: "They have long been polluted and have died.
"The current them, although they have come back to life, are closer to monsters than the original them.
"Your Highness, you must be wary of them and avoid them.
"Except for Benjamin and me, no one else can be trusted."
Hobert, hidden beside Bernadette, watched Edwards with his arms folded: He still retained enough sanity. This was definitely a combination of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" ability and the "Black Emperor's" ability! The "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" authority was really interesting. The "Black Emperor's" ability seemed to have gained "new life"!
Bernadette was silent for a while, then asked again, "Where is my father's mausoleum? I want to take a look."
"Okay." After saying that, Edwards led the way, saying, "It's very close. Be careful on the road."
Bernadette agreed and followed behind with the "Invisible Servant" in front and her behind.
She used the "Invisible Servant" to ask, "Uncle Edwards, what were you worshiping in that open space before?"
Edwards did not turn his head: "His Majesty."
Bernadette frowned and continued to ask, "Are Uncle William and the others worshiping him too?"
Edwards' footsteps obviously paused: "No, I don't know what they are worshiping…"
Bernadette realized that asking further might lead to changes, so she didn't continue to ask and silently followed behind Edwards.
Suddenly, the front opened up, and a mountain peak several hundred meters high appeared in front of them, but half of the mountain had been hollowed out. In the belly of the mountain, a black mausoleum stood there, looking very magnificent.
Most of this mausoleum belonged to the mountain itself, and only a small part had traces of artificial construction and polishing. This mountain was the mausoleum itself!
Whether it was the influence of the mausoleum itself or Edwards had cleaned it up, there were no weeds or vines around the artificial buildings.
Bernadette saw that on the huge stone door of the mausoleum were carved the "Civil Code" formulated and promulgated by her father, or the new social customs he created.
Hobert beside her realized: Maybe I should carve the "Atlantis Constitution" on my mausoleum as well.
Edwards in front stopped: "Don't go in.
"It will interrupt the resurrection…"
Bernadette looked at the huge mausoleum for a while before asking Edwards again, "Do you remember the years spent in Lenburg?"
Edwards seemed to be in a state of contemplation: "I remember.
"I seem, seem to be dead…"
His gaze was no longer dull, but full of unbelievable brilliance.
Until this moment, he seemed to realize that he had already died and "come back to life," no different from William, Poli, and Grimm, who needed to be guarded against.
Edwards' face suddenly distorted, and under his skin, pieces of bright red flesh quickly rotted, flowing out a stinky, light yellow liquid.
But in the next second, he suddenly froze. The flesh first stopped rotting, and then the flesh quickly became normal again, even closer to the color of living skin, no longer that pale color.
Two or three seconds later, Edwards seemed to suddenly come back to his senses: "Your Highness, what did you ask me just now?"
His speech was much clearer, and he no longer stuttered so much.
Just as Bernadette was about to say something, Edwards said again: "Yes, Your Highness, I will leave now. You can be quiet here by yourself.
"But be sure to be careful, and don't try to enter the mausoleum."
Bernadette realized that this was Hobert taking action. After Edwards walked away, she whispered, "Thank you."
This was the best way to handle it. Although Edwards' state was obviously not very normal, he would not harm others on this island. If he was not normal, then he was not normal.
Hobert in the "air" realized that after accommodating the Uniqueness, within the barrier of the "Beginning," he could not only defeat the "Uncertain Mist," but also the power projected onto the earth by other Outer Deities was not his opponent at all.
Bernadette looked at the mausoleum in the direction of the mountain again. After looking at it quietly for a while, she said, "I need your help."
"Yes." Hobert's voice came from the air: "What help?"
"I want to make a prophecy, but my power is not enough."
The next second, Hobert said, "Alright, make your prophecy."
Bernadette immediately felt that the spirituality in her body was surging, and her spirit body became stronger than ever before.
When destroying George III's ascension to godhood, Bernadette had experienced the power of the "Knowledge Emperor" level. She immediately felt that her current power had exceeded Sequence 3 and was closer to Sequence 2.
Bernadette took a deep breath to stabilize her mind and looked at the two huge stone doors in the mountain again.
Silently, she "saw" a scene: the magnificent black mausoleum shook obviously, and the heavy, tall stone doors opened.
Then, a dark and huge arm stretched out from the stone door.
The scale of this arm was close to the trees on the island. From the color and state, it was more like a thin layer of shadow filled with flesh, which looked extremely strange.
It supported the ground with its elbow, moving forward with difficulty, as if to drag out the subsequent, more massive, and more terrifying part.
Rumble!
The entire island shook.
Bernadette couldn't hold on any longer, closing her eyes as if suffering some kind of mental trauma.
The next second, all her negative conditions were 'Bestowed' to a large tree in the distance.
Boom~
The several-dozen-meter-tall tree exploded and quickly toppled over.
Hobert's voice echoed in the air: "Just like our 'guess,' your father's resurrection will be a disaster."
Bernadette was silent for a moment before saying, "This might just be some kind of symbolism..."
She didn't continue, because no matter how it was interpreted, it wasn't a good omen: "What solutions do you have?"
"It depends on your father's specific situation," Hobert said. "Our plan is to maintain the status quo if there's no danger.
"If there is danger, we will temporarily seal your father, and after the great 'Creator' and the honorable Mr. Fool further recover their strength, we will rescue him."
To avoid Bernadette misunderstanding and disagreements arising, Hobert spoke his true thoughts.
Bernadette was somewhat puzzled: "Mr. Fool is also concerned about this matter?"
Just then, Bernadette's spirituality sensed something, and she looked up at the sky. She suddenly had an unspeakable feeling, and the entire island also underwent subtle changes.
Hobert also looked at the sky. It was the first time He had truly felt how strong the barrier of the Original Creator was. In outer space, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' was trying hard to gaze at this place, but the power that could be projected in was minimal.
The 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' had been operating on this island for a very, very long time to achieve this effect. Without these operations, even the gaze of a Great Old One would only make ordinary people feel uneasy.
In that instant, Bernadette's invisibility disappeared, and her chestnut hair lengthened at a speed visible to the naked eye, quickly reaching her waist from its original shoulder length.
Bernadette was neither surprised nor panicked, but followed the instinct of a 'Clairvoyant' and the experience accumulated over a long time, taking a few steps forward and entering the open area where the 'Black Emperor' mausoleum was located.
At the same time, she sent the 'Invisible Servant' back to the spirit world.
Bernadette's hair stopped growing, but she looked at her abdomen in surprise. She could sense a fetus appearing in her womb.
The fetus was growing rapidly, and it seemed that it would soon mature, sucking dry all the nutrition and spirituality of the mother, and tear out of her abdomen.
Bernadette's spirituality sensed that the fetus's level seemed very high, beyond her ability to handle.
So she asked, "What should I do?"
Hobert observed Bernadette's abdomen and said casually, "I must state that this child is not mine."
Bernadette looked at the direction of the voice with some helplessness.
Hobert smiled and said, "Bear with it, I'll play gynecologist for once."
He first severed the 'connection' between the fetus and the sky and the island, and the fetus's growth stopped immediately.
Then He 'tampered' with the baby's state, changing the baby from the size of a watermelon to the size of a grape.
Bernadette suddenly felt a faint pain in her abdomen, as if she had lost something very important.
Finally, Hobert slowly grabbed with his hand and 'distorted' the fetus from Bernadette's abdomen to the outside, and then quickly burst the grape-sized flesh.
Where the flesh splattered, the stones and soil on the ground quickly mutated, turning into a group of bizarre monster babies. They opened their mouths one by one, but before they could cry, Hobert 'tampered' with their state again, turning them into ordinary stones and ordinary soil.
The problem of the fetus had just been resolved when the entire island shook. Huge trees waved their trunks, pulled out their roots, and were approaching Hobert and Bernadette.
They formed a sky-covering and earth-shattering tide of trees, giving the feeling that every place in the world was about to be covered by forests.
At the same time, the previous dragons, magic wolves, feathered snakes, and other creatures became restless and came towards the mausoleum.
And the mausoleum was also changing little by little, giving the feeling that it was about to 'come alive'.
Hobert said without any urgency or anxiety in his tone, "We were used by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' as an opportunity for your father's resurrection."
More precisely, it was because His appearance broke a certain balance, after all, the uniqueness of the 'Black Emperor' was in His body now.
Hobert had also anticipated this, but it didn't matter, because with the blessing of the 'Nation of Disorder,' He wasn't afraid that 'Old Huang' could seize the uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics and be resurrected instantly. On the contrary, He could more clearly observe the extent to which 'Old Huang' was affected by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'.
Bernadette recalled the 'prophecy' just now, then she looked at the mausoleum and said with a determined expression, "I want to go in and see."
"Okay," Hobert agreed. The next moment, the two had already appeared in the dark mausoleum. This place seemed unaffected, without shaking, and without hearing the sounds of all the creatures on the island converging here.
The levels of the two were very high, and they didn't need firelight to see everything inside the mausoleum clearly. It was empty inside, except for the dark walls and the high platform in the center, there was nothing else.
On the high platform, there was a seat that looked like it was for giants. It was cast entirely of black iron, and its surface was engraved with complex and distorted strange patterns.
Hobert thought: This chair doesn't look as exquisite as mine.
Just then, Hobert felt a surging 'vitality' rushing towards them.
With a wave of His hand, the space in front of the two fell into 'chaos,' and this surging 'vitality' rushed to the surrounding walls and the high platform in front of them, eventually turning into nothingness.
Bernadette breathed a sigh of relief. Her spirituality sensed that if Hobert hadn't helped to block the 'vitality' just now, it would have been very dangerous for her.
"We need to get closer to that chair," Hobert said as he stepped onto the steps leading to the top of the high platform. Bernadette immediately followed.
As soon as she stepped onto the high platform, Bernadette immediately felt a breeze blowing behind her neck. This breeze was very cold, causing Bernadette to shiver.
At this time, Bernadette discovered that Hobert was no longer in an 'invisible' state and suddenly appeared in front of her. With a wave of His hand, He grabbed a brass book from somewhere.
Opening the book, a new rule immediately appeared on a new page: This place is the real world, and the power from the cosmos is weakened.
Then a second line of quicksilver-colored text appeared: Hobert Jeffrey is a special existence, and the uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics in His body will not be affected by any existence.
There was this 'Law' because Hobert in the 'Nation of Disorder' also felt that the uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics in his body were being attracted by some force.
Hobert raised his hand and once again 'weakened' the power of the gods inside and outside the mausoleum. At this time, a shadow suddenly appeared next to the huge seat.
The shadow first looked at Hobert blankly, then his gaze froze on Bernadette: "Come a little closer, let me see what my little princess looks like now."

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 729: The Corrupted Roselle
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The black figure in front of her was blurry, but Bernadette could sense that this dark silhouette was her father, the man who called himself "Caesar," Roselle Gustav.
Her eyes were slightly red, and she took a step forward.
Roselle chuckled: "When I was making picture books, compiling textbooks, and inventing all sorts of little games for you, you were only this big. Now you've come to save your poor old father.
"I remember you loved all the dresses I designed for you when you were little. It's a pity you can't wear those cake skirts anymore now that you're grown up…"
Hobert chimed in: Emperor, the words 'invent' and 'design' should be in quotation marks.
Bernadette walked faster as she listened to her father's rambling. Suddenly, Roselle pressed his forehead with a shadowy hand: "Stop!"
His voice was filled with indescribable pain.
Bernadette was taken aback and immediately stopped.
Roselle gripped the handrail beside him tightly, saying with great pain: "Don't... come closer.
"I'm corrupted."
The sadness in Bernadette's eyes deepened. When she had received this information from Cattleya through the Tarot Club, she found it somewhat unbelievable, but later she realized it might be true.
Now that the truth was confirmed, she felt even more sorry for her father.
Roselle took a deep breath, as if he had regained some composure, and then looked at Hobert: "As for you…"
"Someone asked me to bring you a message," Hobert said with a smile.
Roselle was stunned. Why did this sentence structure sound so familiar?
Then, Hobert said in Mandarin: "I used to be an adventurer like you..."
Roselle: "...then I took an arrow to the knee… I… I swear, you are…"
Bernadette looked at the two of them in surprise. They were speaking a language she had never heard before.
At this moment, crimson cracks suddenly appeared on Roselle's face, as if there was a scarlet moon inside his body.
He took a deep breath, looked at Bernadette, and said with great difficulty: "Seal me!"
Hobert didn't expect his code word to "break" Old Huang so quickly. He immediately mobilized the surging "Power of Order" to help Roselle contain the corruption within him.
The crimson cracks on Roselle's body gradually closed, and he took a deep breath, sitting weakly on the giant chair: "How do you plan to save me?"
Of course, he could feel that the person in front of him was a King of Angels of the "Black Emperor" pathway. Since the other party had not directly advanced but chose to see him in the mausoleum, he must have found a way to save him.
This time, Roselle used Intis. Bernadette stepped back to the side, first looking at her father and then at Hobert.
She couldn't understand why the two of them had established mutual trust so quickly after each saying a sentence she couldn't understand.
She had hesitated for a long time before choosing to trust Hobert, to trust the "Creator." As Hobert said, if the "Creator" wanted to harm Roselle, he didn't need to do anything. After becoming a "Black Emperor," Roselle would completely perish.
Hobert didn't answer Roselle's question immediately but said first: "The power just now can only temporarily suppress the corruption on you. You can maintain your sanity for about half an hour, but it will be difficult after a long time."
He had already "weakened" the power of the Outer Deities on this island, so there was no need to worry about the creatures outside disturbing them.
Then Hobert said to Bernadette: "I'll talk to your father about a few key issues first. Because it will involve some corruption, you can't listen!
"After we finish talking, I'll give you time to reunite."
Bernadette hummed in agreement. What else could she say? But she was also concerned: "How do you plan to save my father?"
"As I said just now," Hobert said, "temporarily seal him, but I shouldn't seal him for too long."
Because your Uncle Klein will advance to "The Fool" before the new year and soon become a "Half-Great Old One."
Hobert paused and then said: "And you will do the sealing."
Bernadette opened her mouth, but then she seemed to understand something and nodded, indicating that she had no problem.
The "Clairvoyant's" ability made her foresee that this was the opportunity to advance. She smiled sadly, lamenting the tricks of fate.
Hobert "tampered" with Bernadette's hearing and vision. Roselle on the chair breathed a sigh of relief: "When you said that 'code word' just now, I suddenly felt like my old father's secret had been discovered by his daughter."
Hobert smiled. Their next conversation, even if it didn't involve some polluting issues such as the Great Outer Deities, was not suitable for Bernadette to hear.
The Emperor's voice sank as he asked, "You know the truth about the apocalypse?"
Hobert nodded in response: "I know."
Roselle continued asking, "You know that this is Earth?"
"Yes."
Roselle smiled self-deprecatingly upon hearing this: "You knew so early. I didn't dare to finally confirm it until I went to the moon and saw the true appearance of this planet from above."
At this point, the Emperor sighed and said, "The moon is bizarre. I clearly felt terror, but I didn't even consider the possibility of being corrupted. Then, I became more and more extreme.
"However, I did occasionally gain a certain level of clarity from the views of people around me, but I didn't dare to write it in the diary in that state. I was afraid of exposing secrets and losing my final chance.
"I eventually decided to use all the groundwork I did previously to switch to the Black Emperor pathway. Apart from the impending apocalypse with Sequence 0s being the only ones capable of protecting the people 'They' wish to protect, 'They' can hide them in other planets in the vast universe and use the corresponding authorities to rebuild a set of order for humans to survive in desolate lands. I also saw the hope of escaping my corruption, by using the Black Emperor's ability to 'resurrect.'
"As long as I became a Sequence 0 Black Emperor and was truly killed after turning half-crazy, I'd have the chance of resurrecting in the mausoleum or in the astral world. When that happened, what would return to me would be a pure Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics. I wouldn't be tainted at all, nor will I contain an uncontrollable madness.
"Speaking of which, I made use of the Eternal Blazing Sun and the God of Steam and Machinery to a certain extent back then.
"But the horror of the Great Old Ones far exceeded my imagination. Accompanying my revival was a new life of corruption… Perhaps only Great Old Ones can resist Great Old Ones.
"I could only terminate the revival process, and live such an ignoble existence in my final mausoleum to prevent the Great Old One from using my body to be born in the real world. That would've brought about a devastating disaster."
Speaking of this, Roselle paused and asked: "By the way, why did you choose the 'Black Emperor' pathway? How exactly do you plan to save me?"
"I can only choose this pathway…" Hobert briefly described his family's curse.
After listening, Roselle "hmmphed" a couple of times: "These old schemers are always very difficult to kill. But I completely killed Solomon."
Hobert added: "As for the specific plan to save you, I need to ask our other 'fellow countryman' for help…"
"Fellow countryman…" Roselle suddenly stood up from the chair: "There's… there's another one… Are transmigrators so worthless these days?"
Hobert put away the "Book of Law" and explained with a smile: "Our transmigration is because of the same being in ancient times. I'll explain this to you later.
"Let me first talk about the plan to save you. I have a few questions to ask you later."
Roselle hummed and sat back down on the chair.
Hobert continued: "Our 'fellow countryman' is a Beyonder of the 'Seer' pathway. In the near future, he will have the authority of 'Grafting' and 'Fooling,' and he also has the ability to summon 'Historical Projections.'
"And before that, I have already taken advantage of a previous War of the Gods to risk seizing the 'Knowledge Emperor' characteristic from you from the God of Steam and Machinery…"
"Wait a minute," Roselle interrupted: "The God of Steam and Machinery had a War of the Gods with someone else?"
"Yes, it was a War of the Gods that all seven Gods participated in. The God of Combat fell as a result." Because time was limited, Hobert simply said:
"I guessed your current state from your diary, so I spent a long time thinking about how to save you and actively looking for the Beyonder characteristics that were extracted from your body."
Roselle's shadowy face was unreadable. He paused for about two seconds before saying: "Thank you for thinking I can still be rescued."
He was very clear about how high the level of corruption he was suffering from was. In fact, Hobert could completely pretend not to know of his existence and then advance.
Then Roselle asked: "How much of my diary did you read?"
Hobert's mind suddenly flashed the sentence "The taste of a Demoness is not bad," but he honestly said: "Not much."
To be precise, not much of the diary he saw after coming to this world.
Roselle was silent for a few seconds before saying: "Okay, I'll just assume you really only read a few pages."
Then he returned to the topic: "Are you planning to use that 'fellow countryman's' ability to 'graft' the current me with that Beyonder characteristic and use my 'projection' of once being the 'Knowledge Emperor' to 'fool' history and reality, turning from the 'Black Emperor who is being resurrected' into the 'Knowledge Emperor'?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes, this way I can successfully advance to the 'Black Emperor,' and you can regain… well, 'rebirth' sounds more like a curse. You can also get a new life."
"Is there a problem you overlooked?" Roselle said: "'Primordial Moon' will definitely try to hinder your plan. How do you plan to stop her?
"You should know that her power may be very limited on Earth, but her status is very high."
Hobert had already planned: "Leave that to me."
After accommodating the Uniqueness, the "Bell of Order" could briefly suppress the corruption of the Great Outer Deities.
Then he added: "However, the corruption in your body cannot be completely eliminated. I can only help you suppress it to a controllable range.
"Theoretically speaking, as long as you don't continue to advance or encounter new corruption, you should be able to basically control your state.
"Then I will use a mystical item to help you suppress the corruption, and you can completely return to the real world. But you have to be careful not to pollute others."
"That's already very good," Roselle described: "It's like a paraplegic patient who can finally get out of bed and walk after treatment."
"Uh, that analogy is very down-to-earth," Hobert said: "Okay, time is limited. I have to ask you a few questions."
"Go ahead."
"I received some information." Hobert's expression became serious: "After advancing to the 'Black Emperor,' will the 'Lord of the Mysteries' awaken to some extent?"
Roselle sighed: "Your preparations are more detailed than mine were at the time.
"When I found out about this, there was no way to make some defenses."
Hobert couldn't help but frown: This problem is the biggest problem in advancement right now.
Given the special relationship between Hobert and the "Celestial Worthy," he suspected that when he advanced, the "Celestial Worthy" would not just "awaken initially."
"However, this problem is not difficult to solve." What Hobert didn't expect was that Roselle then said: "You just need to put the sealed artifact 'Genie' next to you during the advancement."
Hobert was stunned: "'Genie' can block the 'Lord of the Mysteries'? Wasn't he sealed by the 'Lord of the Mysteries'?"
"Precisely because he was sealed by the 'Lord of the Mysteries,' he can stop him," Roselle explained: "This is a characteristic of the 'Black Emperor' pathway!"
Hobert immediately understood: It was to use the "Celestial Worthy's" seal to interfere with the "Celestial Worthy's" arrangement!
Then he thought: In this world, "Genie" is the person who least wants to see the "Celestial Worthy's" plan succeed because as long as the Celestial Worthy awakens in the "Black Emperor" or "Justiciar," he will easily become the corresponding Great Old One, then "Genie" will lose everything.
Hobert also understood: No wonder Trunsoest never mentioned the problem of the "Celestial Worthy" when he advanced to "Justiciar." He previously thought that the Six Gods had helped him solve this problem, but now it seemed that he might have obtained the "Genie" at that time! Perhaps that was one of the spoils of killing Solomon.
As for Solomon, he had the help of the True Creator, so there shouldn't have been much of a problem when he advanced, and he also obtained "Genie"! Finally, the "Genie" fell into Roselle's hands!
This was definitely not a coincidence, and it might even be the "Genie" actively disrupting the "Celestial Worthy's" plan.
Now Hobert's only concern was that his situation was special, and it was not certain whether the "Genie" could help him.
At this time, Roselle said again: "As for the 'Genie's' reward, it must be to help him escape after you become a God, but I don't know what his specific purpose is because he doesn't seem to be in a hurry to escape.
"When I traded with him, I deliberately didn't promise him a time to help him escape, and he didn't care."
Hobert asked: "How exactly does he complete this operation?
"Well… to be honest, I have some doubts about his ability."
Roselle spoke without reservation: "I learned about this from 'Uncertain Mist'…"
Hobert was stunned: "You also contacted 'Uncertain Mist'?"
"He took the initiative to contact me after I became the 'Black Emperor,'" Roselle said: "The specific theory should be similar to the law of mutual attraction between adjacent pathways. After I advanced, I had a few minutes to establish contact with him.
"It's just that my mind was not very clear at the time, so I only talked to him for a few words."
Hobert slowly nodded, recalling that when he advanced to Sequence 1, Tamara and Trunsoest were able to sense it. Advancing to True God should attract onlookers from higher-level existences.
"The power that he can project onto Earth is very weak, difficult to cause corruption, you can safely chat with him for a few words," Roselle continued: "He told me at the time not to be deceived by 'Genie' and gave me a complex descent ritual. He hoped to descend to Earth to deal with 'Genie.'
"My idea is that their words are all untrustworthy, but we can use their mutual attacks to obtain some information."
"For example, I got a seemingly reliable piece of information from the 'Uncertain Mist': the 'Genie' is mostly in a sealed state, appearing to be non-aggressive, but at a specific moment, it can display power beyond that of a god!"
Hobert found it hard to believe: "How does it do that?"
Even if the 'Son of Chaos' still has the position, that's 'Celestial Worthy's' seal!
Roselle said: "I had the same question as you at the time, after all, based on my research, the 'Genie's' influence on the outside world is almost negligible usually."
"Moreover, it is sealed with an angel-level Beyonder characteristic."
Speaking of this, he spread his hands: "It's the first time I've encountered such a luxurious seal!
"However, the 'Uncertain Mist' told me that there are Beyonder characteristics inside the 'Genie', and even the 'Lord of the Mysteries' can't tear these Beyonder characteristics from it!"
Hobert suddenly thought of a sentence the 'Dark Angel' said when communicating with him before: "The 'Son of Chaos' is a life directly conceived by the 'Original Creator', closer to the 'Original Creator' than the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity!"
At that time, Hobert didn't pay much attention to this sentence, but now more than one piece of evidence proves that although the 'Son of Chaos' is not a Pillar, He is a very special Great Old One!
In that case, how many Beyonder characteristics did the original 'Son of Chaos' have? There are only two on Earth, 'Black Emperor' and 'Justiciar', the 'Uncertain Mist' seems to have some, and the 'Son of Chaos' also has characteristics!
"I think this information is basically accurate." Roselle said: "Otherwise, there would be no need to seal the 'Genie' with an angel-level Beyonder characteristic."
Hobert nodded slowly, expressing his approval of Roselle's conclusion. With the 'Celestial Worthy's' strength at the time, if the 'Son of Chaos' had no Sefirah, no Beyonder characteristics, the 'Gray Fog' of the Sefirah Castle could seal this guy somewhere, and he would never want to escape.
However, the 'Celestial Worthy' took a 'Miracle Invoker' Beyonder characteristic from himself for the seal, which shows how much He valued the 'Son of Chaos' after tearing out the 'Uncertain Mist'.
But this is good news for Hobert. Although His situation is relatively special, the 'Genie' should also be able to help Him solve the problem.
Thinking of this, Hobert asked again: "Regarding the 'Black Emperor', do you have any other instructions?"
"This pathway seems a bit special." Roselle, sitting on the iron chair, pondered and said: "I don't know if the 'Justiciar' is like this, but as far as the 'Black Emperor' is concerned, before becoming a god, the Outer Deities have almost no influence on the Beyonder of this pathway.
"But after becoming a god, both the 'Genie' and the 'Uncertain Mist' can easily influence or notice you.
"I am because I have already been polluted, so their influence and attention will not have any impact on me.
"But thinking of Solomon and Trunsoest, the probability of these two pathways being polluted seems very high!"
Hobert was slightly stunned when he heard this. He hadn't made this Connection before, but it is indeed the case. Roselle's situation is a bit special, so let's not talk about it for the time being. Solomon and Trunsoest, one counts as one, have been polluted or affected in some way.
Some of Solomon's previous performances were strange, suspected of being influenced by the 'Uncertain Mist' or the 'Genie'. Trunsoest was completely polluted by the 'Uncertain Mist' and even tried to destroy the 'Genie'.
Although they may have their own purposes, the fact that they have been influenced by the Outer Deities is undeniable.
Relatively speaking, the other four Beyonder characteristics that "just" came from the cosmos seem very dangerous, but there seems to be room for relaxation.
Currently, the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti is still fighting against the 'Mother Tree of Desire'. Lilith has been corrupted on the 'Moon' pathway. After switching to the 'Mother' pathway, the corruption has basically been suppressed.
Only the 'Black Emperor' and the 'Justiciar' seem to be able to get involved with the 'Genie' and the 'Uncertain Mist'.
Thinking of this, Hobert took a deep breath and said, "Thank you for your answer, I have no questions."
Roselle smiled and said: "Friend, your arrival has given me great hope. I hope you and that fellow countryman can work hard and rescue me quickly.
"To be honest, the feeling of being polluted by the Outer Deities is really too tormenting."
This is his most helpless side. Before this, he had never shown his weakness in front of others.
Hobert said seriously: "We will do it as soon as possible!"
Roselle took a deep breath and said again: "What you were holding just now should be the Uniqueness of the 'Justiciar' pathway, right? It seems you are already preparing to become a Great Old One.
"That must be a very difficult road. If you are tired, take a break.
"To hell with the end of the world, people from our place have too much sense of responsibility. It's okay to be a little selfish."
Hobert sighed, with a bitter smile: "I will pay attention."
Roselle paused, got up from the chair and approached Hobert a few steps, lowering his voice and asked: "Is Bernadette married?"
"No."
"Does she have a boyfriend?"
"As far as I know, it doesn't seem like it."
Roselle looked Hobert up and down: "You don't have Sanguine blood, do you?"
"Uh... a little bit."
Roselle "hmm"ed and asked again: "How did you and Bernadette meet?"
"I understand what you mean." Hobert said with a wry smile: "I already have two wives, and I love them very much."
"That's good, that's good." Roselle seemed relieved a lot, but then became vigilant again: "Two...wives?"
Hobert raised his hand and rubbed his forehead: "Well... we are of the same generation. In theory, Bernadette has to call me uncle."
"Haha." Roselle laughed twice: "You're right."
Saying this, he slowly returned to his seat: "Yes, she has to call you uncle."
"The next time is left for you father and daughter." Saying this, Hobert lifted the "tampering" on Bernadette: "I'll wait for you outside. If you need me to assist in the seal later, contact me with the 'Order Crystal'."
Bernadette "hmm"ed.
Hobert didn't eavesdrop on the conversation between the father and daughter, but came to the open space outside the mausoleum, looking at the situation on the island.
Because the power of the Outer Deities was weakened, the entire island was quiet at this time.
While waiting, Hobert pondered the information he got from Roselle. He was a little surprised that the biggest problem in advancement was solved like this.
However, for the sake of stability, before preparing for advancement, it is necessary to talk to the "Genie" first.
After about ten minutes, Hobert's spirituality received a "notification" and came to the mausoleum again.
At this time, blood-red cracks appeared on Roselle's body again. Bernadette had already put on a pale metal mask. On the mask, a series of pale lines constantly outlined an extremely complex mysterious symbol. This symbol sometimes looked like a bird with long feathers, and sometimes turned into a feathered snake coiling its body.
Under the mask, Bernadette projected a cold gaze. This gaze seemed to have substance, forming a layer of pale white brilliance, surrounding Roselle on the huge chair layer by layer.
Roselle's aura then disappeared, and the cracked bright red gaps closed one after another. He seemed to fall into peaceful sleep in an instant.
But in the next instant, several blood-red cracks grew on Roselle's body again. His aura, after decaying to the extreme, gradually renewed, fiercely resisting the pale white brilliance like thin mist around him.
Hobert immediately realized that the rank of the mask was not enough.
He immediately took action, "using" the "Pale Death" worn on Bernadette's face to tightly wrap the layer of pale white brilliance around Roselle.
And use the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to increase the rank of the seal, "magnify" the power of "Pale Death", and "tamper" with the intensity of Roselle's "rebirth".
In this way, the corruption suffered by Roselle was completely suppressed by the "Pale Death". Before it reached the point of breaking through the seal, the power of "Pale Death" would turn "rebirth" into "passing" again.
"Pale Death" will continue to provide power for this seal until Bernadette actively lifts the seal, or it fails because its state changes for some reason.
Roselle looked at Bernadette and smiled weakly: "This seal is good, I can finally have a good night's sleep."
His eyes slowly closed: "Let's go, leave here..."
In the blink of an eye, Roselle had fallen into a deep sleep.
Bernadette opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but in the blink of an eye she found herself back at the edge of the primitive island.
She stared at the mountain in the central part of the primitive island for a few seconds, then slowly turned around and walked towards the sea.
Hobert's doppelganger didn't follow, but "tampered" with his state, and waited on the beach.
After a while, Hobert heard a melodious whistle from the "Dawn" not far away. Bernadette played a gentle melody with a whistle, with a faint sadness, which could calm people's minds.
After more than a hundred years of searching, she finally found her father, but she had to seal her father.
Although Roselle repeatedly emphasized that he still had the possibility of resurrection, Bernadette didn't know why, but she always felt an unspeakable sadness in her heart.
Maybe it was more than a century of separation, without even a hug, that she still felt regret.
Maybe she was secretly regretting why she left her father back then?
Maybe...
After being silent for a while, Bernadette's eyes became clear again.
She no longer hesitated, no longer blamed herself, no longer produced various negative emotions, and firmly raised her right hand, summoning a spiritual world creature with a human upper body and a wind lower body, and took from Him the supplementary ingredients for the "Sage" potion.
The remaining parts do not need special preservation, they are in the collection room of the "Dawn".
Before long, Bernadette used the "Pale Death" to shatter the "Sage Frontlet" and prepared the potion.
She picked up the potion. At this time, her heart was full of hope to help her father get rid of the corruption and completely resurrect him. This required a higher sequence and stronger strength.
Bernadette had never been so determined as she was now. She drank the potion in one gulp, seeing her body become illusory at a speed visible to the naked eye.
She decomposed into strands of vast knowledge, transforming into the existence form of the information torrent.
Bernadette tried her best to maintain her ritual and quickly established a connection with the spiritual world information that prevented the occurrence of a high-level disaster.
That information had her distinct mark and involved a very high level, appearing exceptionally "solid".
This information prevented Bernadette from being scattered by other information in a short period of time, helping her to initially stabilize her consciousness, so she had time to gather the torrent of information of her body little by little.
Just when she was about to completely gather the vast torrent of information, strands of secret information came from nowhere, taking advantage of the opportunity for Bernadette to reorganize her body, trying to merge with her.
This was interference from the "Hidden Sage".
As a certain incarnation of knowledge and information in this world, as an approximate Sequence 0 of the "Mystery Pryer" pathway, the "Hidden Sage" can exert a certain influence on Beyonders of the same pathway who are lower than himself.
At this moment, Hobert suddenly appeared in the captain's room. He waved his hand like a conductor, "distorting" the direction and state of the "foreign information", causing them all to flow to himself.
Then Hobert casually picked up a glass bottle from the table, and the "foreign information" rushed into the glass bottle. Hobert plugged the bottle cap and built a "Wall of Spirituality" to seal this information.
While watching Bernadette make the final adjustments to her state, Hobert made a judgment: The state of the "Hidden Sage" is similar to that of the King of Angels who has accommodated the Uniqueness!
Finally, Bernadette completely reorganized her body. At this moment, she truly became Him, became the Sequence 2 angel of the "Mystery Pryer" pathway, a big shot in the mysterious world who can be called a "Hidden Existence".
Adjusting her state, she looked at Hobert and said with a strange expression: "Thank you, Hob... Uncle Hobert."
Hobert twitched the corner of his mouth: "You can still call me Hobert."
...
Utopia.
Hobert looked at this small city with a small area but complete supporting facilities, as well as several small villages in the suburbs and several pieces of reclaimed farmland.
He had planned to come long ago, but after returning from the mysterious island discovered by Roselle, he had to deal with the affairs of the Kingdom of Atlantis, and only came here now to take a look.
In the next second, Hobert appeared in Utopia's small square, listened to a young man playing the seven-stringed lyre for a while, and chatted with an old gentleman for a few words.
He "inquired" that the elven restaurant in this small city has a unique flavor and is worth a try.
The architectural style of this restaurant is a unique "Atlantis style", with smooth lines, beautiful and generous.
Entering the restaurant, inside are "Atlantis-style" tables and chairs with a rather heavy texture. Because it is not yet meal time, there are only two tables of guests inside.
Among them, by the window, sat a young man wearing a black suit, with black hair and brown eyes, and a scholarly temperament.
The young man immediately got up after seeing Hobert: "Haha, Hobert! My friend, I didn't expect to meet you here."
Dressed in a Loen-style trench coat, Hobert entered as if from another world, a warm smile on his face: "Klein, my friend, you look to be in excellent spirits."
The person before him was Klein, with Klein's appearance.
Hobert had forgotten when he last saw this face.
"Indeed," Klein said with a smile. "Utopia's fine wines and delicious food have healed the loneliness in my heart."
The two shook hands firmly before sitting down.
Hobert asked, "Have you ordered anything?"
"I ordered braised prawns in oil, sweet and sour cod, and cold spinach salad," Klein said with a smile. "This place is near the sea, and the seafood is excellent."
At this moment, the waiter handed over the menu. Hobert glanced at it and, as he expected, the so-called 'Elven cuisine' consisted of familiar dishes.
Hobert also ordered two dishes, and the two began to chat while drinking beer.
"Not long ago, I encountered Roselle, and he turned out to be one of our 'fellow countrymen'," Hobert said, not intending to hide the matter, briefly recounting his and Bernadette's exploration of that mysterious island.
He focused on Roselle's current state. Hobert did not tell Klein about the method to rescue him for the time being, as it required a good opportunity, such as after Klein advanced to Sequence 1.
Klein listened quietly, finally sighing, "If only he could sit here with us."
Hobert raised his beer glass: "Yes, then we could play poker."
"No, Texas Hold'em."
The two laughed heartily, clinked glasses, and took a few gulps.
After eating a few bites of food with the "Elven tableware," Klein said, "I've long suspected Roselle's identity."
Hobert put down his chopsticks and hummed in agreement: "When he called himself 'Caesar,' he had already completely exposed himself."
"Then what about the Elves?" Klein asked, raising the "Elven tableware" in his hand. "What's their story?"
"Perhaps they came from the Western Continent," Hobert said. "As a history researcher, I know very well that our ancestors have always attached great importance to recording history since very, very early on.
"Especially enemies who have invaded us and harmed our compatriots, we will definitely record them clearly."
"Yes, ancient history used two volumes for thousands of years," Klein said with a smile. "Modern history also used two volumes for a hundred years."
Hobert looked at the beer foam in his glass: "Then, will the people there still know their ancestral origins?"
Klein's expression gradually became serious: "Probably not, after all, there was a period of madness during the First Epoch."
Hobert hummed in agreement: "Maybe I'm overthinking it, I just… I just…"
"Missing home?"
Hobert suddenly raised his head, their eyes met, and Hobert suddenly smiled: "I originally thought that since I had a home here, I wouldn't have such feelings."
"As you said before," Klein said gently, "we are all wanderers working hard away from home, buying houses and getting married in big cities, but that doesn't mean our roots are planted there."
"I used similar words to comfort you before, but I didn't expect them to be 'returned' to me," Hobert said with a smile.
After returning from that mysterious island, Hobert's inner loneliness gradually grew, especially when he recalled Roselle saying 'To hell with the apocalypse,' a sense of sorrow appeared in Hobert's heart:
Why am I not doing my research properly, but instead fighting these monsters?
Why, when I have free time, am I not thinking about playing games, eating skewers, and drinking beer, but instead, forced by survival, having endless things to deal with, and having to think about advancement every moment?
Why do I already own a country, but it's not as fun as playing 'Minecraft'?
Why do I have to go through these things? Why can't I say 'no'?
Why…
At this moment, Hobert realized that he was actually a little tired, but he had been ignoring it.
So, after dealing with the matters at hand, he gave himself a vacation, and his first stop for relaxation was Utopia.
Klein continued, "I'm not very good at comforting people, but I always feel that our driving force is those who have helped us, or those who need our help.
"Because we are already in this world, because we have relatives and friends in this world, so we cannot retreat.
"This is our responsibility."
Hobert repeated, "Responsibility, huh?"
His mood brightened a lot: "Sorry, it's been a long time since we met, but we ended up talking about such a heavy topic.
"Let's talk about something else, um… how are the preparations for the ritual going?"
Klein looked out the window, at the people in the square and on the streets, each with their own lives, each with their own personalities, each doing their own thing.
"As you can see, it's going quite smoothly!" A smile filled Klein's face.
Hobert also followed Klein's gaze outside, and after hearing this, he said, "Let me give you another hand."
As he spoke, he strengthened the "connection" between the city and the spirit world.
For a moment, the light in the entire city dimmed a lot, but this dimness disappeared in an instant.
Looking outside again, there were still people coming and going, the square was still the same square, the church was still the same church, the city was still the same city, but it gave people a different feeling.
It was as if everything around had become more real, as if the city had a solid sense of history.
Klein took a deep breath, feeling the subtle changes in Utopia. Everyone here was different from before. Originally, they were like "unregistered residents" of this world, but now everyone's relationship with this world had become very harmonious.
The ritual that he had originally planned to complete by the end of the year had now been basically completed. In another week, at most half a month, he would be able to try to advance to "Attendant of Mysteries."
Hobert drank all the beer in front of him in one gulp: "Thank you for your hospitality. It's rare to have a few days of leisure, I want to wander around.
"Oh, right, I have a friend who needs to strengthen their humanity, and your place is a good choice."
Klein got up and said, "Then let them come."
The two shook hands again to say goodbye.
Klein saw Hobert off, sat back in his chair, and continued to enjoy the food while sighing inwardly.
Suddenly, his spirituality was touched, and he looked towards the entrance of the restaurant.
A young lady wearing a court dress, with very delicate features, like a delicate doll, appeared there.
Klein was slightly stunned before getting up: "Miss Sharron."
Then he understood: "You are the friend that Hobert mentioned just now!"
After seeing Klein's appearance, Sharron's face showed a hint of joy: "Long time no see."
