Angel City.
After school at Public Third Grammar School, Daisy walked home with a classmate, chatting and laughing. They separated at the entrance of the residential area.
When alone, Daisy quickened her pace unconsciously.
This was a habit she developed after being kidnapped. Whenever she was alone, she would go to her destination as quickly as possible, taking the main roads and avoiding the alleys.
If she had to go through an alley, she would observe it beforehand and then run through it.
If there were suspicious people in the alley or some small doors, she would rather cancel her trip than go through such a place.
Daisy quickly arrived at her doorstep, breathing a slight sigh of relief.
In fact, she knew that Angel City had very good public security, but the habit she had developed before was deeply ingrained.
After looking around and seeing no one, Daisy quickly opened the door and entered the house.
As soon as she entered, she saw King Hobert drinking tea in the living room.
He was dressed very plainly, in an Atlantis-style shirt and a pair of pants that looked to be of good quality. He wasn't wearing a top hat and had a hairstyle that looked very energetic.
Daisy certainly knew that this was the person who took her sister away back then, but later she also learned that this matter was not as she had imagined.
And now she also knew that this was the King of the Atlantis Kingdom.
This made Daisy a little at a loss, not knowing whether she should kneel down and salute immediately.
In theory, she should kneel, but her sister Freya had said several times that there was no need to kneel in the Atlantis Kingdom.
Hobert was also looking at Daisy. The little girl looked rosy, dressed appropriately, only her hair still looked a little dry, revealing her experience of malnutrition.
"Your… Your Majesty," Daisy finally spoke, calling out respectfully.
Hobert nodded with a smile: "Go to the kitchen and help your sister."
At this time, the kitchen door opened, and Dennis came out with a kitchen knife: "Ah, Daisy, you're finally back, come quickly! I'm about to be scolded to death by your sister."
Freya's voice came from the kitchen: "It's because you're too stupid, don't blame me for scolding you?"
Dennis quickly stuffed the kitchen knife to Daisy, and took off her schoolbag, before saying to the kitchen: "My Minister, my knife is not for cutting vegetables."
Daisy breathed a sigh of relief, quickly took the kitchen knife and entered the kitchen. She saw Freya's profile, filled with a happy smile.
A smile also appeared on Daisy's face unconsciously, and she skillfully helped her sister cut vegetables.
She knew that Freya was now secretly in love with Dennis. Dennis often came to their house for dinner, or took the sisters out to play.
The reason why it was a secret love was because both of them were senior officials of the kingdom, and they would not announce their relationship until they were sure they were getting married.
In the living room, Hobert and Dennis were drinking tea and chatting, and they first talked about South Colson.
Hobert said: "I just went to South Colson this afternoon. The lakeside railway there has been completed and opened to traffic. It is a good tourist transportation line."
"So fast!" Dennis sighed: "I haven't been back to see it for a long time. I heard that the power plant there is about to be completed?"
"Yes," Hobert took a sip of tea: "After the electricity is connected, it will definitely be a modern city."
South Colson currently has a developed tourism industry, abundant crop yields, and cheap daily necessities, which has attracted many Feynapotter people to immigrate and settle down. Many Feynapotter nobles have also purchased real estate there.
Then they talked about work, and Hobert asked: "I heard that many foreign spies have been caught recently?"
"That's right," Dennis said: "Our household registration system provides a lot of convenience for identifying spies.
"In contrast, the household registration systems of the countries in the Northern Continent are too crude. They still don't fully understand the internal structure of our household registration system, so the people they send are easily exposed."
At this time, Freya said while bringing out the dishes: "What is currently difficult to identify are the spies left behind when the colonists withdrew, because they were also registered when the population was registered. We can only detect and review them after discovering leaks."
Hobert pondered for a while before saying: "The living standards of the people are still too poor. Life in the Northern Continent is still attractive to them…"
Speaking of this, He shook his head: "That's not entirely true. Some people just like to listen to rumors and always feel that they are living in dire straits."
"It's already not bad," Dennis said while helping to bring out the dishes: "I used to stay in Backlund, and the lives of the middle class in Backlund were just like that.
"Especially in terms of food, it is far less abundant and convenient than that of the middle class in Angel City."
Their dinner today was beef stew with potatoes, fried small fish, vegetable salad, fruit platter, a piece of lamb chop for each person, a piece of cream cake, and a bowl of radish soup.
Because Hobert came as a guest, Freya made it a little richer. Usually they would only have one meat dish.
The diet of the middle class in Angel City is about the same as their usual level.
The four of them ate and continued the previous topic. Hobert took a sip of red wine and said: "But the number of middle class in the Atlantis Kingdom is too small.
"In a healthy society, most people should be middle class."
Daisy listened quietly to them discussing some topics that she didn't quite understand. She didn't find it boring, but felt very at ease and safe in her heart.
After discussing the topic of "middle class", Hobert suddenly asked Daisy: "I heard that you are very biased in your subjects?"
Daisy was slightly stunned before saying: "Yes."
"Why? Are you not interested in that course? Or do you not understand?" Hobert then asked.
Daisy carefully considered for a while before deciding to tell the truth: "I don't like the math teacher very much, and that teacher doesn't seem to like me very much either."
Hobert smiled: "Communication is a universal knowledge. You can't delay your studies just because you don't like a teacher.
"It's a bit like that teacher is not qualified enough and didn't make all the students like him, but you are punishing yourself because of this."
Daisy listened more and more attentively, and she felt it made a lot of sense.
Hobert added: "There are no completely fitting clothes in the world, and sometimes people have to adapt to clothes.
"But you can communicate to make the 'clothes' fit better."
Daisy nodded thoughtfully.
Freya sighed slightly, which reminded her of a casual chat with Dennis before. At that time, Dennis said that Freya and Daisy had been lacking fatherly love since they were young, so their perspective on problems would be somewhat one-sided.
At this time, Freya suddenly had a concrete feeling about this problem. Their sisters were indeed lacking in effective communication.
Hobert said to Freya again: "Take Daisy out for a walk more often when you have time, and encourage her to communicate with strangers more."
Freya nodded: "Teacher, I will pay attention to this."
This topic ended, and the three adults talked about the newly built seaside resort. Freya decided to take Daisy there to see it during her vacation.
Dennis raised his hand slightly: "I'll go too, um… mainly to protect your safety."
Hobert held up his wine glass: "Hahaha."
Daisy ate a bite of cream cake with a smile, it was fragrant and sweet.
…
June 8th, the Atlantis Kingdom issued a stern warning, condemning Loen and other countries for interfering in other countries' internal affairs, and condemning their material and manpower support to the Paz Kingdom and the Balam Empire. At the same time, Loen was warned that if it continued to support the confrontation between the countries of the Southern Continent, the Atlantis Kingdom would not rule out using force to solve the problem.
That afternoon, Loen, Intis and other countries publicly condemned the Atlantis Kingdom's war of aggression against the Balam Empire, and pointed out that the Atlantis Kingdom was the unstable factor in the Southern Continent. Unless the Atlantis Kingdom could change its existing political model and return to a normal political track, they would not stop supporting the countries of justice and freedom.
That night, the Atlantis Kingdom responded: If the Loen Kingdom withdraws its troops from East Balam and returns the rule of all territories to the Haagenti Kingdom, the Atlantis Kingdom will withdraw its troops from the Balam Empire.
From this day on, the accusations between the two sides became more and more severe, and the rhetoric of threatening to use force became more and more frequent.
…
The next day, East Chester County, a forest belonging to the Hall family.
Alfred, Hibbert and Audrey led their foxhounds, with a varying number of servants, chasing prey around the edge of the forest.
This was the first time their siblings had hunted together since they came of age.
Now Audrey's identity was a bit special, so Alfred and Hibbert were both subtly making way for Audrey and vaguely protecting her.
During the chase, they rushed out of the forest and saw a wheat field.
Audrey, dressed in hunting attire, saw the village in front and asked, "Where is that?"
This was the first time she had hunted in this forest, and she didn't know where the surrounding areas led.
Hibbert was also not very familiar with it, and turned to his attendant and said, "Ask someone."
While waiting, the three siblings talked about their harvest just now.
And the golden retriever Susie glanced at the foxhounds that wanted to approach her, and made them consciously stop and keep their distance from Susie.
As the three siblings chatted, Alfred sighed: "I'm leaving the day after tomorrow, holidays always go by so fast."
Hibbert nodded: "With the current situation, it's really not good for you to continue your vacation."
In fact, Alfred's vacation at this time was a bit of a way to avoid suspicion. After all, the military was currently assisting the Paz Kingdom in confronting the Atlantis Kingdom, but he was the brother of the Queen of the Atlantis Kingdom. It was actually difficult for the military's high-level officials to trust him.
But it was not a solution to always take a vacation like this, and he could easily be marginalized.
Audrey didn't express any opinion on this. She had also talked to Alfred about whether he was interested in joining the Atlantis army.
Although Hobert rarely allowed the two Empress Borough to touch the kingdom's politics and military, Audrey still had the confidence to arrange for her brother to enter the Atlantis army.
But Alfred said that he hoped to stay in Loen. After all, he had already established many contacts in the Loen military, and everything would have to start over after going to the Atlantis army.
Moreover, he heard that the Atlantis army didn't seem to welcome nobles very much. He also heard that the proportion of Beyonders in the Atlantis army was much higher than that in the Loen army. There, a "Disciplinary Knight" could only be a brigade commander.
At this time, Hibbert's attendant came back to report: "Lord, that village is called Hartlarkh."
Audrey felt that this name was very familiar. After thinking carefully, she finally remembered that she had heard that the Psychology Alchemists had sent people to study the customs here.
It is said that this village worships dragons, which is completely different from the mainstream beliefs of the Northern Continent.
Even more bizarrely, the members of the Psychology Alchemists went crazy shortly after arriving here!
Audrey, who already had a very solid knowledge of mysticism, immediately became vigilant. She didn't think this was a coincidence, or rather, it might indeed be a coincidence, but this coincidence had a "problem".
She took a deep breath and felt that she might be overthinking it, but for the sake of safety, it was best not to get close to that place.
At this time, Hibbert smiled: "I've heard of this village chief. I remember that the family has a manor nearby."
As he spoke, he looked up at the sky: "It's almost evening, why not stay here for the night and continue hunting tomorrow?"
Alfred had no resistance to his brother's suggestion. To him, it didn't matter which manor he stayed in tonight.
So he nodded: "Then send someone back to inform Dad and Mom."
Audrey didn't speak, but her eyes were dyed with a faint gold color that was not easily noticed. Then, her gaze swept across the faces of her two brothers in turn.
Hibbert's brows furrowed slightly. After a few seconds, he said: "Let's go back. The manor here hasn't been notified in advance, so it's definitely not ready, and it may not be able to serve so many horses, hounds and servants.
"Moreover, there is still more than an hour before evening, enough to return."
Seeing that his brother had changed his mind so quickly, Alfred subconsciously wanted to argue, but after thinking about it, he felt that what the other party said still made some sense.
Considering that his sister was also here, he "hmm" and said: "Then let's return as soon as possible."
So they turned around with a group of attendants, servants and hounds, and returned to the other side of the manor along the edge of the forest.
Audrey followed quietly behind, not expressing her opinion on the development of the matter.
When they returned to the manor, it was dinner time.
Of course, there was no shortage of discussions about the current international situation at the dinner table.
Earl Hall said: "In the afternoon, I saw yesterday's 'Backlund Evening News'. The accusations between the two sides are even more severe, and the situation in the Northern and Southern continents has become even more tense."
This place is far away from the big city, but there are special mailmen who send newspapers here, but the time will definitely be later.
For example, you can only see the morning paper in the evening, and you can only see yesterday's evening paper the next afternoon.
Earl Hall asked Audrey worriedly: "At this time, Hobert asked you to return to East Chester County for vacation, is there really no other intention?"
In connection with what happened before, the Loen special envoy went to Angel City for three days and failed to see Hobert. After Audrey went to talk to Hobert, Hobert began to summon special envoys from various countries.
Following closely behind, Audrey also returned to her home country with her parents, declaring that she would rest at their manor in East Chester County for a month.
It seemed as if Hobert was very angry with Audrey's actions and had sent her back to East Chester County.
In reality, no matter how tense the relationship between the Loen Kingdom and the Kingdom of Atlantis became, the Hall family was not in any danger. Even if war broke out, they only needed to avoid appearing in public as much as possible.
This was because whether the Kingdom of Atlantis wanted to propose peace talks in the future, or the Loen Kingdom felt the need to negotiate, both sides needed a channel, and Earl Hall was a very good channel.
He understood this very well, which was why he became low-key when relations between the two countries were strained, allowing his family to vacation at their manor in East Chester County.
The problem was that if Audrey was not by Hobert's side, Earl Hall would lose his role as a "channel."
Audrey smiled and said, "Father, it really doesn't mean anything else."
She still believed in Hobert on this point.
To reassure her father, she added, "If I want to go back, I can go back at any time.
"But you also understand the current situation. Currently, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has no other business besides issuing a 'statement of condemnation'. I believe the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will only become busy after the war starts."
Alfred joined the conversation, "Audrey, do you think the two sides will go to war?"
"It's certain," Audrey said seriously. "The momentum of confrontation between the two sides is already very obvious, and the conflicts between them cannot be resolved through negotiation."
Hibbert and Alfred said nothing more. They also opposed the Kingdom of Atlantis's policies to some extent. Theoretically, Audrey was the queen of that country, so the Hall family should be the nobles second only to the royal family there.
But the truth was that the Hall family didn't even receive many privileges when doing business in the Kingdom of Atlantis, only some policy conveniences.
Even the most open-minded nobles thought this was wrong.
In their view, some businesses were simply beyond the reach, vision, and ability of ordinary people. Nobles and wealthy people had the ability and vision to maintain the good operation of society through those businesses and industries.
Because of their contributions, they should enjoy some privileges.
Audrey certainly understood her two brothers' thoughts, but she didn't comment on them.
According to her observations, the Kingdom of Atlantis was running quite well without nobles and wealthy people. The bureaucracy was clearly more efficient than the nobles, and it could more easily concentrate wealth and manpower to better complete some construction tasks.
Of course, the bureaucracy also had its problems, such as breeding corruption and 'bureaucracy', which could make efficiency even slower than a political system dominated by nobles.
Now, the government of the Kingdom of Atlantis was still on the rise, and everyone had ideals and a thriving scene.
But what about decades or hundreds of years from now?
That would definitely be an era of 'bureaucracy', so Hobert was already taking precautions against such things from happening.
The way to prevent it was also very simple. First, mobilize the people. If they wanted to report others, they could directly pray to the 'Creator' to report them.
The staff in the 'Creator's' divine kingdom would send people from the inspection department to investigate.
Because of the existence of Beyonder abilities, the investigation process was very simple and would not affect the normal life and work of the person being reported.
Second, the supervisory agency was independent of the government, and the Ministry of Finance specifically allocated funds, with no subordinate relationship to any department.
All of the above were things Audrey heard Him talk about when she chatted with Hobert.
But she didn't want to tell her family about these things, because no matter what, nobles couldn't play any role in the Kingdom of Atlantis and wouldn't receive any extra benefits.
So the topic at the dinner table naturally turned to the interesting things that happened during the hunt today.
After Audrey returned to her room, she and Susie admired the peaceful night of the manor on the terrace. Late at night, Audrey returned to the bedroom, lifted the velvet quilt, and lay down, quickly falling asleep.
In a daze, she suddenly sat up.
Her spiritual perception made her realize that her state was not right. She looked around and saw the familiar dressing table and the entrance to the washroom, but there was no red moon or stars outside the window. It was completely dark outside.
Audrey instantly made a judgment: This is not the real world.
Soon, she came to another conclusion: This is a dream, a rather strange dream that can actively keep her awake.
Audrey immediately got out of bed to look at the 'Order Crystal' on the bedside table. Fortunately, the ornament Hobert gave her was still there. At this time, the jade pendant was emitting a soft black light, which was clearly different from its state in the real world.
Hobert had told her that if she encountered danger, she only needed to inject spirituality into the jade pendant, and Hobert would be able to sense it.
Audrey quickly went over and grabbed the jade pendant, injecting spirituality into it.
She quickly received feedback. A line of letters appeared on the jade pendant: Go out and explore.
Audrey breathed a sigh of relief. This should be Hobert's guidance.
Audrey had great confidence in Hobert's current strength. It shouldn't be a problem for Him to pull her out of the dream or directly shatter the dream.
He didn't do that, but instead told her to explore, which meant that the dream might not be dangerous, or rather, with Hobert's protection, it wouldn't be very dangerous for her.
So Audrey put on a coat, tightly grasped the 'jade pendant,' and opened the door. Outside was a dark corridor. Although there were candlesticks on the wall, the candles emitted a very abnormal dim light, giving people a feeling that ghosts might appear at any time.
Audrey followed her spiritual intuition and walked to the right, reaching the end of the corridor, which was a semi-open solarium.
Her spirituality predicted that the outside was very special, and it didn't correspond to the solarium.
But Hobert had not issued a warning, so Audrey slowly opened the door.
As she expected, the outside was not a solarium, nor was it the scene outside the villa, but an unfamiliar environment. The ground was covered with round stones and clumps of blue-black weeds.
Audrey cautiously walked in, and the door closed behind her with a "creak."
The scenery a little further away suddenly became dim, quickly outlining a huge stone pillar tens of meters high.
At the top of the stone pillar stood a huge monster with large gray-white scales, pale gold and vertical eyes, and a pair of huge wings.
This is a Mind Dragon!
Audrey recalled that the year before, she had explored the surrounding 'ocean of collective consciousness'. At that time, she had seen a Mind Dragon flying in the distance, which should be the one in front of her.
As she looked at it, the Mind Dragon was also looking at Audrey: "Have you ever been to Livseyed?"
It used Dragonese, which Audrey could understand. She was slightly stunned: How did it know?
That was last year when Audrey, together with 'The World' and 'The Star', explored a mystical item called the 'Groselle Travels' and eventually found the 'City of Miracles' Livseyed in the ocean of collective consciousness in this 'Travels'.
The Mind Dragon explained, "Every mind's consciousness is exchanging certain information with the sea of collective unconsciousness, and Livseyed is a very special existence. The imprint it forms in your mind is the same, so I can naturally sense it."
Audrey immediately realized: This Mind Dragon corresponds to Sequence 2 'Discerner'.
Immediately afterward, Audrey thought of the conversation Hobert had with her about how to continue advancing.
But she didn't dare to continue thinking about it, because that would reveal too much information and might startle the dragon.
As her thoughts swirled, Audrey asked, "What do you want to know?"
The huge dragon said, "My name is Ariehogg, one of the only three ancient dragons left."
"Hello, Ariehogg," a strange voice suddenly joined the conversation.
Hobert, wearing pajamas and slippers like Audrey, holding a golden and orange entwined scepter, and wearing a coat outside, appeared beside her.
Ariehogg's eyes narrowed, and he was about to leave immediately!
Before this, He hadn't even noticed the other party, which was enough to show the other party's power!
But in the next second, the dragon's idea of escaping was 'distorted' into the idea of 'seriously answering Hobert's questions'.
Hobert asked, "I really want to know, besides you and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, who is the other dragon? Where is it now? Is it also a Mind Dragon?"
Ariehogg seriously replied, "He is... He is, I forgot."
Hobert curled his lips: "Dealing with 'Spectators' is really troublesome."
As he spoke, the avatar in his hand became a huge twilight-colored giant sword. The next second, Hobert was already standing on the dragon's back.
The desire to survive instantly woke Ariehogg up. As Hobert's giant sword was about to swing down, He had already 'teleported' to the depths of this 'dream'.
This was His home field, and He immediately set up several barriers between Himself and Hobert, which He had prepared in advance.
Those barriers were made up of inescapable nightmares. They were not substantial in the dream space, and even archangels would only be able to detect them after contact.
But at the moment of contact, the target could be pulled into a deeper dream, giving Ariehogg time to escape.
Seeing that Hobert hadn't chased after him, Ariehogg breathed a sigh of relief and was about to hide in a secret place He had found in the ocean of the unconscious when suddenly His vertical pupils narrowed.
Because Hobert actually appeared in front of Him!
At this time, Hobert was standing on a high giant pillar, and below the giant pillar, the beautiful Audrey was still watching the battle below the stone pillar.
Ariehogg immediately changed direction, but in front of Him was still Hobert standing on the stone pillar, and Audrey watching the battle below!
After thinking about it for a while, He realized that the dream He had created had been 'tampered with'. No matter how He flew, He would fly towards the enemy standing on the stone pillar.
It was difficult to escape when encountering such an enemy, so Ariehogg had to flap His wings desperately and fan a 'plague storm' towards Hobert.
Such an attack would turn ordinary people in a large area into lunatics or die in their sleep, which would definitely attract the attention of official Beyonders.
But He couldn't care about that now. Ariehogg had to try His best to escape.
Faced with the dragon's full blow, Hobert just raised his hand slightly and used the ability of 'Disorder'.
Pfft~
This full blow turned into an ordinary gust.
The next moment, Hobert appeared beside Ariehogg, and the giant sword in his hand slashed at the dragon's neck.
Ariehogg immediately retreated, but his idea was to retreat, but his body was 'distorted', and his neck stretched out under the giant sword instead.
At the moment the giant sword touched the dragon's neck, He barely broke free from the 'distorted' state and tried to dodge.
But the giant sword still hit His huge neck.
Shila~
This giant sword had the characteristics of the 'Twilight Giant' pathway. Under Hobert's 'magnification', it was indestructible, like cutting through a thick cloth, cutting through Ariehogg's gray-white, rock-like skin and muscles.
A third of His neck was cut off from top to bottom, and golden blood spurted out.
Hobert quickly tore off a piece of his pajamas and 'distorted' it into a 'cloth bowl': "This can't be wasted."
Ariehogg turned around and fled in pain, golden dragon blood flowing down like a waterfall, but drawing an arc in the air and flowing into the cloth bowl in Hobert's hand.
This cloth bowl was only the size of a normal bowl, but it seemed to never be filled.
While Hobert was 'catching' dragon blood, he took a step forward and stood on the dragon's back again.
Ariehogg immediately turned into an illusion, but Hobert still pierced the back of the illusion's heart with the giant sword in his hand.
Pfft~
The Mind Dragon, which was originally an illusion, returned to its physical form, and Hobert pierced a large hole in its heart.
Hobert had just 'tampered with' the concept between Ariehogg's body and His 'virtual personality'. Piercing the 'virtual personality' was equal to piercing the body.
In Ariehogg's mournful wail, it fell from mid-air.
Hobert 'magnified' His injuries, and this Mind Dragon, which had survived since the Second Epoch, was already dying before landing.
He held the giant sword and stabbed it into the dragon's head, and this dragon, which had survived since the Second Epoch, died instantly.
Hobert then used the ability of 'Exploit'. The Beyonder characteristics of the dragon, which was still twitching all over, had been extracted.
It was a pale golden crystal that looked a bit like an eye, with a mass of moving golden light in the middle, which really looked like an eyeball moving back and forth.
In addition, the dragon's bones, flesh, teeth, heart, etc., were all very good Beyonder ingredients, and Hobert would certainly not waste them. Except for the Beyonder characteristics, they were all sent into the 'Nation of Disorder'.
At this time, cracks appeared around like a broken mirror, and everything became illusory.
Audrey, lying on the bed in her bedroom, suddenly opened her eyes. The 'Order Crystal' was being held in her hand, and the black light was fading away little by little.
Hobert stood on one side of the big bed, holding a scepter in one hand and the Beyonder characteristics of the angel level in the other.
The golden retriever Susie was lying at the end of the bed, looking at Audrey with some concern. Seeing Audrey wake up, she immediately opened her mouth, but as if she suddenly realized something, she distorted her tongue and shouted, "Woof!"
Hobert smiled and said, "Alright, you don't have to pretend. I can clearly sense that you are already a Sequence 5 Golden Retriever, and you should have been able to speak a long time ago."
Susie opened her mouth, a slightly embarrassed expression on her face.
Audrey sat up in bed, looking at the Beyonder characteristic in Hobert's hand: "I didn't expect to have the opportunity to advance so quickly."
Hobert also looked at the characteristic that resembled a phantom eye: "Characteristics at this level require special storage space. I will keep it for you first and help crush it when you need it."
After putting the Beyonder characteristic into the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert said to Susie: "Congratulations, you have the characteristic to advance to a demigod."
This made Susie very happy, and she tried to say as elegantly as possible: "Thank you."
Hobert also put away the "Twilight Scepter", He smiled at Audrey: "This hateful dragon disturbed our good dream, shall we continue to go to bed?"
Seeing that Audrey was fine, Susie quickly left the bedroom.
In the second half of the night, Hobert and Audrey contentedly put on their pajamas and sat down on the terrace, enjoying the beautiful scenery under the moonlight while chatting.
As they chatted, they talked about the problem of angels in the "Spectator" pathway.
Audrey said: "I didn't expect that there are still three dragons alive, um... but after today, there will only be two left."
She took Hobert's hand away: "Among the three ancient dragons, there are two Mind Dragons, plus Hermes, then there are actually three angels in this pathway!"
Hobert put his arms around Audrey and looked at the forest under the moonlight: "Perhaps this pathway also has a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact."
Audrey was stunned: "Why do you say that?"
Hobert glanced at Audrey, who was full of youthful vigor in his arms, and explained with a smile: "Generally speaking, an angel-level Beyonder characteristic in a pathway has 7 to 10 pieces.
"Take the pathway you are in as an example, 'Spectator'…"
Audrey certainly knew that the "Spectator" Hobert was talking about referred to Adam.
"…In the three Sequence 1 characteristics in 'Spectator's' body, there may be a Sequence 2 characteristic in each, because He is born with Uniqueness, and has not undergone advancement below Sequence 2, so these three Sequence 2 characteristics should be all the Sequence 2 characteristics in His body.
"Then even if we calculate according to the minimum of 7 Sequence 2 level Beyonder characteristics, in addition to the 3 from the Sequence 1 pathway, there should be 4 Sequence 2 level characteristics.
"One is in Hermes' body, one is in our hands, one is in that unknown Mind Dragon, theoretically there should be another angel, or a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of this pathway."
Audrey nodded, feeling that this algorithm was relatively reliable.
She did a simple calculation: "According to this algorithm, there are quite a few angels in this world."
"Well, this is only at the Sequence 2 level." Hobert said: "There is also the Sequence 1 level, for example, as far as I know, there is an archangel in the 'Death' pathway, who is the 'Pale Empress', and there is also a Sealed Artifact of the same level.
"There is also a Sequence 1 characteristic, which should exist in the form of a Beyonder characteristic or a Sealed Artifact.
"For example, in the 'Mystery Pryer' pathway, of which I just received relatively reliable news, there is a Sealed Artifact at the archangel level, and there is at least one Sequence 1 level Beyonder characteristic at the 'Hidden Sage''s place.
"Once there is a god in a pathway, the ownership of the Sequence 1 level is very clear, without guessing."
Audrey calculated: "If you add the two together, angels and Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts should be very common, but why do I always feel that I rarely see Beyonders or Sealed Artifacts at this level?"
Hobert smiled and said: "Of course, it's because after reaching this level, you can hide yourself very discreetly.
"For example, this Mind Dragon named Ariehogg, He has been hiding in the 'Sea of Collective Subconscious' for I don't know how many years. Unless it is a coincidence, it is difficult to find Him.
"There are also many angels in the pathway that are difficult to find, such as the Marauder Pathway. He is parasitized on a member of a orthodox god's church. Who can find Him?"
Audrey was stunned: Are you talking about Mr. Star?
She remembered that when they explored Groselle's Travels together, the descendant of Zoroast guessed that Mr. Star was parasitized.
Hobert continued: "In addition, don't underestimate those former angel families.
"For example, the Abraham family, which has already declined, still has 2 Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts in their hands. There were so many angel families back then, they must all have some 'inventory'.
"I think there are many Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts that are not in the hands of the orthodox church, but are hidden by a secret force somewhere in this world. We rarely see them.
"Another point is that each of these Sealed Artifacts is enough to destroy a city, and it is impossible to take them out for use frequently, so we rarely see them."
For example, Bernadette originally had 3 Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts in her hand, but now there are only two.
Audrey nodded: "This is the mystical world."
Hobert smiled: "Well... we are different. We also control secular power. Many hidden angels will appear in front of us as our friends or enemies."
He believed that Roselle had such a deep accumulation for this reason, and just a part of it was left to Bernadette, which was enough for her to deal with the Moses Ascetic Order for more than a hundred years.
The two of them sat on the terrace and chatted until dawn. Hobert told Audrey that He planned to rest in this scenic manor for a few days.
Audrey was of course very happy. After Hobert returned to the Southern Continent and brought some changes of clothes, she took Hobert's arm and the two of them appeared in the restaurant together.
Everyone was very surprised by Hobert's sudden appearance, and then the servants even saluted the King under the butler's scolding.
Seeing Hobert's sudden arrival, Earl Hall finally believed his daughter's words.
Audrey's two older brothers were very curious about how Hobert came, but Alfred, as a Beyonder, was not very surprised by this.
On this day, Hobert also accompanied the three siblings out hunting. As the group walked, they actually appeared not far from Hartlarkh Village again.
From afar, they heard crying coming from the village.
Seeing that King Hobert seemed very curious about this, Hibbert sent a servant to inquire about it.
Soon the servant came back to report: "Lord, all the dragon statues in the village suddenly collapsed last night, and the villagers have lost their faith, so they are crying."

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 731 A Mirror
chapters.content:

In the afternoon, at Earl Hall's estate in East Chester County, Hobert and Audrey lay on the grass under the shade of a tree, chatting idly.
Hobert listened to the cicadas and looked at the distant sky, a wave of drowsiness washing over him.
Unconsciously, Hobert fell asleep in the fragrance of wild grass.
At the level of an Archangel, there is actually no need to sleep. Sleeping is more of a psychological comfort, requiring "meditation" to enter a state of sleep.
For Hobert, this method of actively entering sleep is rare.
Hobert even had a dream while he was sleeping, something he hadn't experienced in a long time, and he quite enjoyed the process.
In the dream, a magnificent city appeared, with a gray palace hundreds of miles high in the center, surrounded by several thick stone pillars.
Hobert's remaining consciousness recognized that this should be the 'City of Miracles,' Liveseyd.
The next second, the 'City of Miracles' disappeared, and Hobert suddenly woke up.
Audrey was nowhere to be seen, and Hobert was the only one left on the grass.
Just moments ago, the sky was clear and cloudless, but now it was overcast, and the sky was gradually darkening, as if it was about to rain.
A gust of wind blew, and the leaves rustled, giving a very bad premonition.
Hobert called for Audrey to go back together, but no one responded after calling out twice.
He was slightly stunned, realizing that something was wrong. He used 'Distortion' to return to the hall of the villa, but the large three-story villa was empty!
Hobert looked at everything coldly, immediately realizing that he might still be in a dream.
Just as he was about to use his ability to shatter this dream, his spirituality suddenly made him notice the mirror in the hall.
The mirror had a classic-style frame, and although the mirror surface looked relatively new, it still gave a sense of ancient history.
At this moment, the mirror reflected everything in the hall, but the mirror did not reflect Hobert!
Hobert frowned and came to the mirror, but his reflection was still missing.
Suddenly, a snow-white hand reached out from the mirror and firmly grabbed Hobert's wrist!
The scene in the mirror changed. Hobert was not in the hall of the villa at all, but in a terrifying graveyard. Behind him were souls with strange smiles, and in front of him was a beautiful but pale-faced female ghost grabbing his wrist.
Immediately afterward, a huge force came from his wrist, and the female ghost seemed to be pulling Hobert into the mirror!
Whoosh~
Suddenly, Hobert woke up with a start. Audrey was by his side, holding his hand: "Wake up, it's going to rain."
Hobert couldn't help but smile. A dignified Archangel was startled by a nightmare.
However, the clear sky had indeed become overcast, as if it was about to rain.
Crack~
A bolt of lightning flashed, and the summer rain came as quickly as it said it would.
However, Hobert and Audrey did not use Beyonder abilities when they returned. They chased and laughed, returning to the villa together.
They must have gotten soaked, although neither of them could catch a cold, they still took a comfortable hot bath together.
While taking a bath, Audrey suddenly said: "I had a dream just now."
For a Beyonder at the demigod level, every dream is a revelation from spirituality.
Dreams at Hobert's level must also have corresponding revelations. He had already interpreted the dream himself: He would encounter something related to death next, which might be a bit dangerous, but there was no need to worry too much.
Hobert had this interpretation because neither the undead nor the female ghost would cause him too much harm.
He guessed that this might be the "Pale Empress" or the final struggle of the Numinous Episcopate.
After all, it was an ancient organization with thousands of years of accumulation, and at the moment of life and death, there must be some unexpected methods.
However, such methods are also easy to resolve: deal with it yourself if you can, and pray to the Evernight Goddess if you can't.
At this time, Audrey talked about her dream, and Hobert already had some guesses: "Did you dream of the 'City of Miracles'?"
He had also noticed that there was a clear difference between his first dream and his second dream.
Audrey was a little surprised: "You, you didn't dream about it too, did you?"
Hobert nodded and said "Yes".
Audrey frowned: "What does this mean?"
She didn't think it was unusual that she dreamed of the 'City of Miracles,' after all, she had been there and talked about it with the Mind Dragon, Ariehogg, last night.
Perhaps this had touched something symbolic, which is why she had such a dream.
However, it was a bit terrifying that Hobert, at his level, also had the same dream.
"I think that when you were exploring the 'City of Miracles,' some very subtle 'psychological cue' was planted there, or even just a symbolic symbol hidden in the ocean of the subconscious, which is very difficult to detect," Hobert "guessed."
"Yesterday when we saw that Mind Dragon, this symbol began to show some power through you, which affected our astral bodies and subconscious, so we had the same dream at the same time."
To be precise, the 'Mind Dragon' that was killed yesterday was a backhand for the 'Dragon of Imagination' to resurrect, but it was destroyed by Hobert.
At that time, Hobert also thought about whether to chat with the 'Dragon of Imagination,' but he also thought that in that case, this Beyonder characteristic might have a very obvious mental imprint of the 'Dragon of Imagination,' which would not be worth the loss.
So after Ariehogg introduced himself, Hobert immediately took action, not giving the 'Dragon of Imagination' a chance.
Audrey nodded, feeling that Hobert's explanation was very reasonable.
The two chatted about dreams and dream interpretation while being dried off by the servants and changing into clean clothes.
At this time, they saw Earl Hall and his wife, as well as Audrey's two older brothers, drinking tea and enjoying the rain in the gazebo, so they also came to the gazebo and enjoyed the leisurely rainy time together.
As they talked, they talked about the post-war reconstruction of Loen. After such a war, a large number of properties became assets of 'Earl's Light'.
Hibbert praised Hobert's investment philosophy, even if those assets were not managed, Hobert was already a real estate tycoon.
As they talked, they talked about the economic system.
"A free economy is definitely the best economic system of this era," Hibbert said. "It has extremely strong self-healing ability, a keen sense of demand, and the ability to meet demand, making this world a better place."
"The miracle of 'Earl's Light' is a demonstration of the advantages of a free economy."
Hobert smiled and said: "But there is also a significant disadvantage, what if a monopoly appears?"
"This is almost the inevitability of capital. After a certain amount of mergers and integrations, it will definitely form a monopoly like 'Earl's Light'."
"That is, the relationship between the Atlantis Kingdom and the Loen Kingdom is currently tense, otherwise 'Earl's Light' would definitely be able to influence the political direction of a region."
"Interest is a very cold thing. It will ignore humanity, ignore morality, and destroy everything we cherish."
Everyone was stunned, not expecting Hobert to evaluate 'Earl's Light' in this way.
Hibbert considered it for a moment before asking: "So the Atlantis Kingdom restricts economic development?"
"It's not restricting economic development," Hobert spread his hands, somewhat helplessly, and said: "Some economists in Loen have made very ridiculous summaries of the economic system of the Atlantis Kingdom."
"They have never seen this kind of economic system, so they used a lot of subjective guesses."
"Most of the Atlantis Kingdom has no economy to speak of. If it weren't for the industrial base I built before, it would be a purely agricultural country."
"Such a country has very few resources, of course we have to make good use of these resources, so that there is hope for the future."
"So currently, privately owned companies and factories in the Atlantis Kingdom can only play a supplementary role to the economic body."
"This also has a benefit: some industries are essential, but the profits are not very high, so it will definitely be difficult to obtain investment, and the industry will also be difficult to upgrade."
"Then we can use the power of the government to intervene and help them invest and upgrade their industries."
Hibbert was slightly stunned. At this moment, he suddenly realized that such an economic model would have huge advantages.
But it is not suitable for Loen, at least not for the current Loen.
Because the economy of this country is mainly composed of nobles and churches, and the government can hardly exert any influence on these two groups.
Immediately afterward, Hibbert felt a wave of fear coming, because he completely did not see any trace of nobles in the Atlantis Kingdom.
Since the topic has started, Alfred also asked: "Will future wars affect the Northern Continent?"
"It depends on the response of the countries in the Northern Continent," Hobert smiled. "I personally have no interest in the Northern Continent."
Earl Hall was more concerned: "Are you confident of victory?"
Hobert did not answer directly, but said: "Since the war against the Highland Kingdom last year, my commander has not fought a single defeat. I have confidence in him."
Hibbert frowned slightly, because war is not just about confidence. It is said that the Atlantis Kingdom only has 300,000 troops, and at least half of them were recruited after the previous world war.
Alfred, however, knew some inside information, knowing that the Atlantis Kingdom was not weak, and Hobert's confidence was based on strength.
This topic could only be discussed here. If they continued to talk in depth, Hobert would not reveal any detailed information.
So they talked about the cool summer rain, and Hibbert even recited a few poems to add to the fun.
For the next two days, Hobert, like an ordinary noble youth, enjoyed his leisure time in the manor.
At this time, he was more like the Earl Hall's son-in-law than a king, so everyone got along very well with each other.
Two days later, Hobert left first, and Audrey stayed at the manor to continue enjoying her hard-won vacation.
Hobert did not return to Angel, but went to Longtail Island, because the first Harvest Festival was held here today, with tourists from all over the Atlantis Kingdom participating.
Hobert had promised Fors that he would attend the opening ceremony.
It was still early in the morning when he arrived at Longtail Island. Although Fors was up, she was yawning constantly, and there was not even a trace of brilliance in her eyes.
Soon, makeup artists came to give the king and queen a simple makeover, then put on exquisite Atlantis-style dresses, and waited in Spectator for the opening ceremony.
The so-called Atlantis-style dress was created by the relevant departments previously established by Hobert, which absorbed the shapes of classical Loen costumes and the beauty of the high-ranking kingdom priests' costumes, integrating them into a very distinctive costume.
At eight o'clock in the morning, amidst cheers, the first Harvest Festival opened.
Hobert and Fors got up together to greet everyone. The scale of the Harvest Festival was much larger than the South Colson Harvest Festival, with approximately tens of thousands of people participating.
Spectator seats were not enough at all, and many people stood behind the seats to watch the excitement!
They were basically the middle class of the Atlantis Kingdom, taking transportation arrays from all over to participate in this event that they were not very clear about.
However, being able to meet the king and queen, they felt that the Harvest Festival was worth it even if it was not a new festival.
After Hobert said a few simple words, he and Fors announced the opening of the Harvest Festival.
Then, the stage first began with literary and artistic performances, including songs, dances, performances, and acrobatics. Everyone found this potpourri-like performance format very novel.
While watching the performance, Hobert was also paying attention to whether there were any suspicious people on the scene.
After all, the situation with the Northern Continent is tense now, and this kind of large-scale event can easily be attacked by the enemy.
However, the security preparations were very thorough. Hobert could see that there were many Beyonders from his side patrolling the venue.
Considering the enemy's noble plot and the fact that attacking ordinary people would not involve angels, Hobert's few worries disappeared without a trace.
In the intervals between the literary and artistic performances, the host introduced the specific process of the Harvest Festival, telling everyone how to pick fruits and vegetables in the mountainous area, there were also seafood fishing experience boats in the harbor, and coconut gardens for everyone to watch. In addition, a float parade will be held on the main street of Longtail Port tomorrow afternoon.
In addition to the Feynapotter people who came here especially, other audiences had not participated in this type of activity and found it very novel.
And they planned their itinerary for the next day or two.
At about ten o'clock in the morning, the opening ceremony ended, and everyone, according to the host's instructions, took the train to the fruit and vegetable area in the mountainous area, or came to the port to enjoy the water performance in the port.
Today, the entire Longtail Island will be a boiling day.
During lunch, Hobert met with some dignitaries who came to participate in the Harvest Festival, and in the afternoon he inspected the places providing food and accommodation for tourists.
There were no activities during dinner, so Fors invited Xio's family to visit the Governor's Mansion, and Hobert certainly would not object.
After the previous war in the Northern Continent evolved into a full-scale war, Xio brought his family to Longtail Island.
Because Fors and Xio often had dinner together, Xio's mother and younger brother were no strangers to dining at the Governor's Mansion, but Hobert's appearance today made the atmosphere at the dinner table a bit cold.
It wasn't until Hobert started talking about surfing with Xio's younger brother that everyone gradually opened up.
At night, in the bedroom, Hobert and Fors chatted as usual.
When talking about the dream a few days ago, Fors gave Hobert a more professional dream interpretation: "It should be that the Balam Empire is preparing some actions that may catch you off guard."
"The graveyard, the dead souls, and the female ghost, the indications of these three elements are already very clear."
"The only somewhat abrupt thing is the mirror. In mysticism, mirrors generally represent reflection, curses, and the unknown."
Hobert smiled: "Doesn't this mirror represent me? My ability is similar to 'reflection'."
He had already planned to have Xio investigate the Balam Empire carefully to see if they could find any clues.
At the same time, he could launch a new round of war against the Balam Empire to disrupt their plans.
The next day, Hobert issued relevant orders, and Xio had no time to watch the flower parade. He led his elite troops to the Balam Empire.
And the Atlantis Kingdom's evening newspaper that day began to publish articles about the Balam Empire's sacrificial activities.
This national-level large-scale sacrifice of the empire would slaughter tens of thousands of slaves at a time, using these undead to please the non-existent gods.
If there were not enough slaves, they would also kill civilians and nobles.
It's just that one civilian was equal to ten slaves, and nobles, according to their status, were equal to one hundred to ten thousand slaves.
Considering that the readers of the evening newspaper had no concept of such national sacrificial activities, the evening newspaper also listed folk daily sacrifices.
For example, when building a house, one slave had to be killed in each of the three steps of site selection, laying the foundation, and raising the beam to please the gods.
If they really couldn't afford slaves, they had to kill livestock, but this was disrespectful to the gods, and the houses built in this way could only be used for slaves to live in or to raise livestock.
Except for the natives in some places, the people were amazed at the brutality of the Balam Empire and believed that such a country should not exist.
This was equivalent to a pre-war mobilization. After the last wave of propaganda, the war would be restarted.
This also meant that Hobert's vacation was coming to an end, so after the harvest festival on Longtail Island, Hobert took advantage of the remaining day or two to visit his younger brother Tyron in the northwest of the kingdom.
Tyron was about to graduate from university this year, but at the end of last year, the Atlantis Kingdom mobilized the whole country to receive new territories. Tyron and Melissa responded to the call to practice in the new territories.
For Tyron, who was about to enter politics, this was an opportunity, and for Melissa, who was still in school, after two years of practice at the grassroots level and successful graduation, she would be recommended by the Atlantis Kingdom to participate in the interview at the Longtail Island Research Institute.
Now everyone who is passionate about science and invention knows that there is the most advanced research institute in the world on Longtail Island, where there are the world's top scientists, and the topics they are doing are beyond the reach of other places.
But the requirements for recruiting people in that research institute are very strict. Many well-known scientists can't get in. In Melissa's case, there may be no hope for ten years.
Just working at the grassroots level for two years to get an interview opportunity, Melissa thought this was a good opportunity.
So the two came to the countryside together. At that time, Tyron made a request, hoping to work with Melissa in neighboring villages.
Such a request would certainly not be rejected.
Generally speaking, in order to ensure the safety of college students and grassroots staff, the town government will arrange the village chiefs of several nearby villages to live together so that they can take care of each other.
In very dangerous places, security guards and even Beyonders will be sent to protect them!
So now Tyron and Melissa live together, but they live in different tents.
Hobert came to Tyron's workplace. This is a village with relatively fertile land. The spring plowing has just ended, and Tyron is teaching the children in the village to learn letters.
The first sentence he said when he saw Hobert was: "Brother, when will the school here be built?"
Hobert looked at Tyron, who was much darker and thinner, but full of energy, with light in his eyes: "Soon."
He pondered for a while and then said: "After the grain is harvested, a new round of large-scale construction will be restarted across the country. Places like this without schools will be given priority to build schools."
The children were all curiously looking at the "village chief's brother". No one here knew the king, and Hobert was spared the need to disguise himself.
Tyron sighed: "Then I may not be able to catch up."
Then he made a gesture to Hobert and continued to teach the children under the shade of the tree.
At about four o'clock, this "open-air classroom" was dismissed because the children had to go home to cook or do some farm work.
The brothers walked slowly on the path between the fields, chatting and returning to Tyron's residence.
Hobert asked: "Why did you say just now that you can't catch up with the school being built?"
"Melissa and I have both received notices." Tyron said, holding a homemade small blackboard: "Let us be ready at all times. After the army occupies the new territory, we will either go to the new territory to be the mayor or go to the current town government to work."
"Melissa and I both plan to go to the new territory to be the mayor. In that case, everything will have to start again."
Hobert smiled: "It won't be long before there will be schools in villages throughout the Southern Continent."
At this time, the village hunter chased after him. He heard that the village chief's brother had come and brought a wild rabbit and ten eggs for several neighbors, so that the village chief could entertain the guests well.
Tyron chatted with the hunter in the local language, thanked the hunter, and accepted the eggs and the wild rabbit.
Back at the residence, Melissa had just returned. She was also very happy to see Hobert. She and Tyron cooked while inquiring about her brother Benson's situation.
Hobert found two bottles of wine from the closed space that Fors helped him build, and also took out two pockets of canned food and fruit from it. These were gifts for the two of them.
Soon a simple dinner was made, rabbit meat stewed with potatoes and egg pancakes.
The three people drank wine and ate what was already considered delicious food here next to the tent.
Most of the previous immigrants had moved into self-built houses, so the Atlantis Kingdom replaced a large number of tents, and these tents were sent to the new territory to make the most of their remaining value.
Hobert asked Tyron: "When are you going to be promoted?"
At the end of last year, Tyron had secretly become a Beyonder. Like Donna, he also chose to become an "Arbiter".
And Melissa is already Sequence 8, so there is no need to avoid such topics.
Generally speaking, Beyonders have advantages whether it is advancement or opportunities to participate in learning, but Tyron and Melissa have not reported that they are Beyonders.
"No hurry." Tyron said: "I'll talk about it when I become the mayor."
Hobert nodded and asked: "What do you think about the extraordinary aspects?"
"Just be promoted like this." Tyron didn't have too high a desire for this: "I heard that the higher the sequence, the more dangerous it is."
Hobert smiled and nodded: "That's true."
He asked that just now purely to see if Tyron had the idea of becoming an angel.
When it was just getting dark, the three of them finished dinner and were cleaning up the tableware when three villagers ran over and shouted from a distance: "Village chief! Something big has happened!"
Melissa had already recognized that they were the villagers in her village, so she put down the plate in her hand and said calmly: "Don't panic, speak slowly!"
One of the villagers said: "The Mark family committed suicide! No, no, it's not suicide. Someone saw Mark's wife kill Mark, and then Mark's wife committed suicide."
Melissa was a little surprised: "Mark doesn't seem to hit his wife very much, does he?"
The villagers nodded repeatedly: "He rarely hits her."
Melissa "hmm"ed and said: "Gordon, Gorry, you two go to the town to report the crime immediately... Do you know where the town government is? Well, the security pavilion and the town government are in the same yard."
Then she said to Hobert and Tyron: "I have to go to the village to take a look."
Tyron said: "We'll go with you."
Hobert nodded in agreement, so the group quickly came to Melissa's village and quickly came to the scene of the crime.
Behind a mud house, Hobert and others saw the bodies, as well as a dozen onlookers.
Both corpses had their heads chopped open with an axe, and brains were flowing all over the ground. Tyron and Melissa, who saw this scene for the first time, felt a little nauseous.
Hobert glanced at the corpse and frowned, because the woman had obviously chopped open her own skull, and she didn't chop it open once, but several times before she killed herself.
If this couple committed suicide together because of something, this is obviously a bit unreasonable. Shouldn't the man kill the woman first, and then he commit suicide?
Hobert asked the people around: "Who saw their suicide process?"
Melissa immediately translated for Hobert.
A villager with a long beard that was not well-groomed stepped forward and said in the local language: "I... I saw it."
Hobert: "Describe it in detail."
The long-bearded villager's description was similar to that of the villager who reported the news before. He saw Mark's wife kill Mark, and then Mark's wife turned the axe and killed herself.
Hobert asked again: "Have they encountered any difficulties recently?"
"Their family is doing okay." Melissa replied: "At least they haven't been starving much since before I came."
Then she asked the surrounding villagers, and they all said that Mark's family had not had any bad things happen recently.
Hearing this, Hobert believed that Mark's death should involve certain extraordinary factors, so he used the ability of "Connection". What he didn't expect was that he saw a mirror!
Hobert was sure that the death of this couple must involve the extraordinary!
At the same time, he also thought of the fragment about the mirror in his previous dream.
Hobert asked the long-bearded villager again: "Did Mark's wife say anything strange when she was killing and committing suicide?"
The long-bearded villager shook his head immediately after hearing Melissa's translation: "She didn't say anything at the time."
Hobert ordered: "Bring all the mirrors in the village here!"
Melissa was slightly stunned, but she immediately translated this strange order. At the same time, she realized that this might be a Beyonder case.
Just as the villagers were shouting and going back to get the mirrors.
Dark clouds gradually covered the sky. With a clap of spring thunder, it started to rain.
Hobert looked at the sky, and his spirituality realized that this rain was a little abnormal.
After thinking about it, Hobert came to Mark's house and found a small mirror on the wall of the mud house.
Speaking of a mirror, it is actually a piece of glass with black paint on one side.
This should have been brought by Melissa after she came, otherwise there would be almost no industrialized things in the previous village.
Hobert walked towards the mirror. If a hand suddenly stretched out to grab him, that would be great. He would definitely give the other party a shoulder throw!
The scene in the mirror was very normal at first, but after Hobert looked at it carefully for a while, he found that there seemed to be a ball of hair floating around in the mirror very far away.
Hobert subconsciously glanced back. There was no ball of hair in the real world.
At the same time, Hobert felt that the ball of hair was cursing him, but for Hobert, the level of this curse was too low, and he could completely ignore it.
This should be the real reason for the death of Mark and his wife! Cursed by this ball of hair!
At this time, everyone brought the mirrors in the rain. Hobert said: "Throw them all in the yard."
Although the command Hobert used was "throw", everyone must be reluctant to throw them away, and even bent down to put the mirrors down.
Hobert said to Tyron and Melissa behind him: "This ball of hair should have the ability to curse, but it's not a big problem, but for safety's sake, I will 'send' the villagers to a distance."
"You two stay and watch."
He was going to let Tyron and Melissa watch the extraordinary case to avoid them being caught off guard when they encounter similar things in the future.
Of course, it's not to teach them how to deal with extraordinary cases, but to let them have a basic judgment of when to run immediately.
Tyron and Melissa's expressions became serious. This was the first time they had encountered such a Beyonder case.
They saw Hobert wave his hand, and all the villagers outside disappeared. Only the barking of dogs was left in the village.
At this time, Hobert picked up a piece of firewood on the ground and said: "For this kind of incident involving the 'mirror world', it is difficult for you to solve it, so you must immediately evacuate, withdraw, and report!"
While speaking, he stretched his hand into the mirror and poked the ball of hair with the wood. Just as he was about to use his ability to let the hair wrap around the wood, the ball of hair suddenly opened and expanded in an instant, like a tentacle, about to stretch out of the mirror.
Hobert temporarily withdrew his hand and "enlarged" the boundary between the "mirror world" and the real world.
So the ball of hair slammed hard on the mirror and failed to reach into the real world.
At the same time, the mirrors in the yard were hit by the hair and made a "thumping" sound, and even jumped up from the ground!
Obviously, the hair entered those mirrors from the "mirror world", hoping to come out through those mirrors.
Immediately afterwards, the mud house where Hobert and others were, the yard, and even the entire village quickly became cold, and even a thin layer of white frost immediately appeared on the ground.
Hobert frowned. The level of this ball of hair was higher than expected.
This was also what He found strange, that His own spirituality had actually misjudged!
At this moment, in the mirror on the wall, the black hair suddenly turned, and a pale-faced but extremely beautiful woman appeared, looking very similar to the sealed artifact "0-71" Disaster Porcelain Doll in Hobert's hand.
Mirror, beautiful female ghost!
Hobert immediately thought of Fors's interpretation of the dream, when she said that the mirror in the dream seemed a bit abrupt!
It seems that the dream also contained two layers of meaning.
This is also the most frustrating aspect of dream interpretation, because the information obtained unintentionally by spirituality is usually very vague, and it is difficult for the dream interpreter to grasp the key points.
Even at Hobert's level, He can only realize that those dreams may contain important hints, but He doesn't know what the specific hints are.
Because this is not a premonition or a prophecy, but some ethereal information that spirituality receives unintentionally. At a low level, spirituality may even ignore this vague information.
The previous "contact" allowed Hobert to determine that the beautiful woman and hair in front of Him were only at Sequence 3 level, but because the current situation was becoming more and more consistent with the previous dream, this made Him unconsciously raise His vigilance.
After all, anything that can cause Him to dream will not be so simple.
Hobert took a step back, not in a hurry to deal with the monster in the mirror, but "tampered" with the surrounding temperature, allowing the frost to disappear and the temperature to return to normal.
At the same time, He reached out and took out the "Twilight Scepter" from the "Nation of Disorder", causing the head of the staff to bloom with a bright light.
The hair and beautiful woman in the mirror showed fear and immediately retreated and dodged.
Hobert took advantage of the victory to pursue and chased into the "Mirror World".
Tyron and Melissa in front of the mirror saw that in that small mirror, Hobert was also in the mud house. The difference from the real world was that a ball of hair was entrenched on the roof, and a beautiful but lifeless woman was "hanging" on the hair.
This gives people the feeling that although they are very close, they are in different worlds.
If Klein or Roselle were present, they would definitely feel a bit like watching TV.
At this time, the light on Hobert's scepter became brighter, filling the entire mud house in the mirror. The ball of hair and the beautiful woman wanted to escape, but they seemed to be firmly bound by some force, unable to move. Under the intense sunlight, they let out a shrill cry, and then were ignited and burned down.
The entire room inside the mirror was on fire, and the fire shone on the real world, illuminating the mud house where Tyron and Melissa were.
They looked at each other and saw surprise and curiosity on each other's faces. Although they had been in contact with the extraordinary more than once before, this was the first time they had seen such a high-end extraordinary battle.
At this time, Hobert in the mirror snapped his fingers, and the fire in it disappeared immediately.
The beautiful woman had been reduced to ashes under the strong light, and the hair had also lost all its vitality, becoming gray and yellow, looking like some fine threads that had been piled up for a long time.
The scepter in Hobert's hand became longer and turned into a long stick. He stirred the ball of "fine threads" with the scepter and found a ball of black hair with some frost and broken glass in it.
The frost exuded a faint light, and they and the glass shards seemed to grow on the hair, rather than being hidden in the hair as sundries.
Hobert bent down to pick up the hair and walked out of the small mirror.
Tyron quickly went up and asked, "Is the problem solved?"
Hobert glanced at the hair in his hand: "Solved."
Melissa asked curiously, "After those hairs were destroyed, did they form a sealed artifact?"
Hobert put the hair in his hand into the "Nation of Disorder": "Yes, but the negative effects are great, otherwise I would have left it for you to defend yourself."
Then He said: "Okay, you go back. To be on the safe side, I will look around here carefully to see if there is any danger."
Hobert can be sure that there must still be danger here. The hair that He just solved is more like a vanguard rushing in front.
He has such a guess, first of all because the reminder of the dream makes Hobert pay enough attention to this matter.
Secondly, Hobert's spirituality actually made a misjudgment just now, which in itself shows that the enemy behind is very dangerous.
Tyron instantly understood: "Is the matter not over yet?"
Hobert just smiled and said nothing.
Tyron said again: "If possible, can I stay?"
The extraordinary battle just now opened his eyes, and he wanted to learn more about the effects of extraordinary power.
Hobert was about to refuse, but as if He suddenly noticed something, He looked at Tyron's eyes carefully, and then glanced at Melissa. Only then did He nod: "Okay, you stay."
Melissa raised her hand slightly: "I'll stay too."
Tyron said: "No, it's too dangerous here, you should..."
Melissa smiled bitterly: "Why do I feel that it is more dangerous to be alone at this time."
Hobert smiled slightly: "Okay, you all stay."
The rain outside was still falling, but it was much lighter. Tyron and Melissa went out in the rain and carried the two corpses to the neighboring farmhouse first, and then buried them after the town's security officer came.
Hobert did not use Beyonder abilities to help, but just carefully watched Tyron and Melissa's every move.
Then Tyron found a few benches, and then removed the door panel and placed it on the benches to form a simple bed. The three of them lay on the door panel with their clothes on to rest.
Their lying positions were: Melissa was on the innermost side, lying alone on a door panel, and Tyron and Hobert were lying on a wider door panel, with Tyron on the inside and Hobert on the outside.
Tyron talked to Hobert about the ball of hair just now, and Hobert smiled and said, "This is an opponent who escaped from me in a previous battle."
That was during the decisive battle with the Demoness Sect. At that time, an angel of the Demoness Sect escaped, and another angel used some of his own characteristics to escape at Sequence 3 level.
Hobert was not at a high sequence at the time and failed to stop it, but he obtained the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact "Disaster Porcelain Doll".
Hobert did not expect to meet the other party here and killed her easily.
While chatting, Melissa and Tyron, who had been working for a day, fell asleep one after another.
Crack~
I don't know how long it took, Tyron was awakened by the thunder.
He suddenly sat up and saw two figures walking in from outside.
A bad feeling filled his heart.
Lightning flashed across the sky again, illuminating the door. Tyron saw that the two people at the door had distorted features and huge wounds on their faces. Part of their brains were exposed. It turned out to be the dead Mark couple!

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 733: Joining forces to beat Amon's body
chapters.content:
