The "Creator" in mid-air was somewhat taken aback when he saw Gehrman Sparrow attack Klein.
Of course, He clearly remembered this famous scene, but seeing it with His own eyes, He still found it quite magical.
Moreover, as a King of Angels, His spirituality had no premonition of this attack!
Apart from the fact that Gehrman Sparrow was originally Klein, making it impossible to detect, it further illustrated that there was a certain qualitative change between a god and a King of Angels.
Almost in the same instant, pitch-black stone pillars rose from the ground on the streets of Utopia, and the buildings within the range of the stone pillars instantly turned to ashes.
These stone pillars supported a magnificent and sacred cathedral, encompassing Klein within.
This was Adam's Corpse Cathedral, the Divine Kingdom of the "Visionary."
Dong~
The "Creator" immediately rang the "Bell of Order", but the Corpse Cathedral only shook slightly, and the effect was not significant.
He landed in Utopia and came to the Corpse Cathedral, carefully observing it.
Not far from the Corpse Cathedral, Gehrman Sparrow, wearing a black trench coat, had a rather complicated expression.
Adam only gave humanity, without imagining life.
He slowly fell down, his gaze cast upon the somewhat damaged Utopia, and finally died in this city symbolizing freedom.
At this time, Zaratul, who had been stabbed by the "Sword of Disorder", finally escaped the powerful deterrent range of the "Creator", and He immediately opened the historical void to escape.
But the moment he entered the historical void, Zaratul was actually "pushed" out by the historical void and landed in front of Hobert.
The historical void "betrayed" this "Servant of Concealment", sending Him to the "Creator".
Zaratul was somewhat desperate at this time. He had seen Kings of Angels before, but this was the first time He had encountered a situation where He couldn't escape.
Hobert was able to trap Zaratul relatively easily, mainly because He was very familiar with the abilities of the "Seer" pathway.
It is difficult for some pathways that are not well understood to block the opponent's retreat so tightly.
Hobert was very clear that Klein inside was not in much danger for the time being, so He looked at Zaratul on the side.
… …
Inside the Corpse Cathedral.
Klein's feet landed, and he stood in the center of the cathedral.
He saw that each pillar and dome here was inlaid with the skulls of different races. For a time, they all stared at Klein with their hollow eyes.
On the walls, windows, and doors of the cathedral, transparent, distorted faces emerged, completely separating the interior from the outside world.
At the very front of the cathedral stood a cross hundreds of meters high.
In front of the cross, there were rows of black chairs with backs.
Adam, wearing a simple white robe, with a light golden beard, and a silver cross pendant, stood under the cross, facing rows of chairs, like a pastor preparing to preach to believers.
His expression was kind, as if he was just inviting Klein to listen to a lecture.
Klein lowered his head and looked at the wooden stake inserted in his chest, and slowly walked towards the first row of chairs, generously sitting in the middle position.
For Klein, the injury on his chest was not fatal at all. The main function of that ancient wooden stake was to seal Beyonder abilities.
Klein expressed his doubts: "It can't be that we just beat up your brother, and you came to help him fight back, right?"
"I found you through the subconscious ocean long ago." Adam said with a kind smile: "The reason why I'm only dealing with you now is mainly to control the two biggest unstable factors and attract the attention of the orthodox gods at the same time."
Klein thought for a moment and said: "Amon plans to become a god now?"
The so-called two unstable factors, of course, refer to the "Fool" and the "Creator".
Before that, Hobert had discussed with Klein that once Amon started the process of becoming a god, Klein, as the owner of the Sefirah Castle, would definitely be able to detect it.
So if there was a chance, he must disrupt Amon's process of becoming a god.
Even if he couldn't stop it, at least he had to make his state not so good after becoming a god.
As Adam and Amon, the two brothers who existed since the Third Epoch, have witnessed many processes of becoming gods, of course, they will not take chances at this critical time.
So Adam was responsible for controlling all unstable factors and attracting the attention of the gods.
And Amon immediately began the ritual of becoming a god.
… …
On a ship sailing in the Rorsted Archipelago.
Verdu Garcia, who had left the Abraham family, pondered some clues he had obtained and prepared to pray for the help of a god to help him unlock the seal on the Ancestor.
At this time, a young man wearing a pointed soft hat and a classic robe suddenly appeared beside him.
The young man straightened the monocle he was wearing on his eye socket: "Sorry, the game is going to end early.
"To be honest, your performance is very poor. You haven't even prayed to the 'god' I fabricated until now. I have to speed up the progress of the game."
Verdu Garcia took two steps back in horror: "You…"
But in the next second, he was "deceived" by Amon and became very excited: "Great 'Favored', thank you for your guidance, what should I do now?"
Amon did not answer immediately, but "stole" the distance, and the two immediately appeared in a primeval forest on a deserted island.
"Okay, you can set up the altar." He ordered.
Without thinking, Verdu Garcia immediately began to light candles and burn essential oils to set up this altar.
Finally, he took out the dagger he carried with him, separated his palm, and let his blood drip on the simple altar.
A voice seemed to suddenly appear in his mind: It is very dangerous to leave your blood on the altar!
Verdu Garcia was also very strange, why would he do such a dangerous thing?
But in the next second, he immediately dispelled his doubts, thinking that the ritual he was going to perform next was very special and should have some special steps.
Immediately afterwards, an Amon avatar appeared, and He brought a mass of translucent flesh with slippery tentacles. On the flesh, there were also distorted worms crawling around.
Almost at the same time, another Amon avatar appeared, carrying a bird with a deformed head. Each of its feathers flickered with a faint starlight.
Verdu Garcia immediately recognized it: This is a monster with the Beyonder characteristics of a "Secrets Sorcerer"!
At this moment, he seemed to not notice Amon and Amon's avatars around him at all, nor did he realize that these demigod-level things came too strangely.
He was full of joy at this time, feeling that the opportunity to unlock the seal on the Ancestor was right in front of him!
At this time, next to the flesh and the bird with the deformed head, another comatose crow appeared. Of course, it only looked like a crow. Each feather on its body was close to transparent and had circles of rings.
Verdu Garcia was ecstatic and immediately began the ritual.
At this time, his hands suddenly shook a few times, feeling a little weak. That was his spirituality's last reminder to him, making him realize that the next behavior would be very dangerous.
But he comforted himself: What I am doing is inherently risky, just like the spirituality's reminder before drinking the magic potion. Knowing that there is danger, I still have to continue.
So after checking the altar again, Verdu Garcia took a step back and solemnly chanted in Jotun: "Great Door of All Doors;
"Guide of Endless Cosmos;
"Key to All Mysterious Worlds.
"I pray for your response, pray for your descent into this world."
As soon as he finished speaking, three tight sounds of "Peng, Peng, Peng" were emitted from the altar.
The demigod-level monsters corresponding to "Bizarro Sorcerer", "Secrets Sorcerer", and "Parasite" seemed to be crushed by an invisible hand, turning into clusters of blood flashing different colors.
These flesh and blood seemed to have their own vitality. Under the guidance of some unspeakable power, they gathered in mid-air, outlining one after another evil and filthy symbol.
Countless symbols combined together, slowly forming a door whose flesh and blood were still wriggling.
The inside of the door was a darkness, not knowing where it led.
On the altar, the candle flame representing Mr. "Door" suddenly soared high, shining into the darkness.
In the darkness, one after another faint rays of starlight appeared. The starlight quickly approached the door on the altar.
When the starlight was close enough, a huge arm appeared in Verdu Garcia's vision.
That was not an arm belonging to a human. It squeezed out of the door with force, causing the entire forest and the entire island around it to shake.
Verdu Garcia watched this scene with joy, but his vision suddenly blurred.
Pa~
Something fell from his face into the grass. Verdu Garcia lowered his head subconsciously and saw that it was an eyeball with protruding blood vessels.
Immediately afterwards, his nose and his ears also fell down.
At this time, Verdu Garcia's mind was suddenly very clear, recalling some abnormalities that he had ignored since a few years ago. He unconsciously looked towards Amon's direction with his one eye.
But he only saw an ancient stone slab.
Plop~
Verdu Garcia could no longer support himself and fell to the ground, and his flesh and blood collapsed immediately.
His filthy blood immediately flowed towards Amon, but when it flowed to the front of the "Blasphemy Slate", this blood seemed to suddenly lose its target, circled around and then disappeared.
This is also the reason why Amon is not very willing to directly interfere with Verdu Garcia. In addition to being easily discovered by the orthodox gods, it is also because carrying out this ritual will be corrupted by a very high level. Once there is too obvious extraordinary intervention, this corruption can easily "find" Amon along those interventions.
So a few years ago, Amon secretly "funded" Verdu Garcia's research, just to use him to put Mr. "Door" back at the right time.
… …
Outside the Corpse Cathedral.
The "Creator" "magnified" Zaratul's injuries, allowing the previous injuries of the "Sword of Disorder" to accelerate and deteriorate.
Even if Zaratul is composed of one "Worm of Spirit" after another, the "Sword of Disorder" will also cause each of His "Worms of Spirit" to be injured.
At this time, Zaratul's whole body became translucent, and there were already signs of decomposition!
The "Creator" took action again, "tampering" with Zaratul's state, making Him weaker and easier to decompose, accelerating the speed of His collapse.
This was the method Hobert used to deal with the Gloomy Wolf Kotar before.
The space around Zaratul distorted suddenly, completely isolating himself into another space.
At the same time, He turned a "Utopia resident" in that space into His marionette. He first changed the "Spirit Body Threads" of the marionette, making the marionette's "Spirit Body Threads" very similar to His own, and used the ability of "grafting" to let this marionette replace Himself in the mystical sense.
Then, Zaratul exchanged with the Marionette and immediately severed all connections with it.
In that instant, the Marionette shattered, turning into dust, while Zaratul successfully escaped.
At this moment, Zaratul did not dare to leave the "Realm of Mysteries" he created, nor did he dare to enter the "Historical Void" again. He knew very well that he alone was definitely not a match for Hobert.
So he could only wait inside, hoping that Adam would quickly resolve Klein and then help him escape.
The "Creator" outside the "Realm of Mysteries" felt that his attack had failed. He thought to himself, "It seems that the methods to deal with a 'Miracle Invoker' cannot deal with a 'Attendant of Mysteries'."
The "Creator" summoned the "Sword of Disorder" again and stabbed it hard at the Corpse Cathedral to test it. It could only scratch a shallow mark, and soon the Corpse Cathedral could "self-heal".
The "Creator" frowned. The strength of the Divine Kingdom... or rather, Adam's Divine Kingdom was somewhat beyond His expectations. If His "Sword of Disorder" stabbed a god, it wouldn't only leave such a shallow mark.
Then, He used the "Sword of Disorder" to stab Zaratul's "Realm of Mysteries" fiercely. The "Realm of Mysteries" had a hiding effect, and it kept changing its position within a small area. If it weren't for a King of Angels like Hobert, one wouldn't be able to sense its existence at all.
With one stab, the "Sword of Disorder" went straight to the hilt.
Hobert smiled slightly: "The strength is quite different."
This made Him once again certain that Adam's Divine Kingdom should have been fortified by the power from the "Chaos Sea".
But now is not the time to consider this. Hobert immediately used the hole stabbed by the "Sword of Disorder" to intensify the damage to the "Realm of Mysteries", and Zaratul reappeared in front of Hobert.
At this time, Old Man Zaratul's face was filled with some fear. He deeply regretted letting Hobert and Klein out of "Foggy Town" back then!
But now it was useless to regret. Zaratul immediately used the Angel-level "Flame Jump" to leave.
However, before he could use the "Flame Jump", the surrounding space became "chaotic", and Zaratul directly "jumped" in front of Hobert.
His eyes became blank, and his brain suddenly fell into a state of "confusion".
Hobert snapped his fingers and "distorted" the "thoughts" of every "Worm of Spirit" on Zaratul's body, making these "Worms of Spirit" yearn for freedom.
So Zaratul suddenly turned into a human figure composed of worms. Zaratul had regained his sanity, but he found that he could not control his own worms.
So, under Hobert's influence, each of these worms flattened on the ground.
Hobert raised his foot and stomped hard. Although he didn't step on those worms, they all seemed to have suffered a heavy blow, and they were crushed and died at the same time.
But their "Spirit Threads" were still floating everywhere. As long as they encountered any creature or corpse, they could immediately turn it into their Marionette, so that they could exchange with the other party.
If they were given enough time, everything around them, such as wood and stone, could also become their Marionettes.
But the "Creator" once again "distorted" their state, making them truly become dead, or rather, making these worms with the level of an Archangel, including Zaratul himself, believe that they were completely dead.
At this time, Zaratul breathed a sigh of relief. Now, his situation would be better if he died, so he could use resurrection to escape.
Hobert, who was quite knowledgeable about "resurrection", would certainly not give Him this opportunity. He immediately used the ability of "Disorder" to wrap all the worms, temporarily preventing the transfer of their Beyonder characteristics.
At the same time, Zaratul's resurrection process also fell into "Disorder", interrupting his extraordinary resurrection ability.
Taking this opportunity, the "Creator" simply "tampered" with the state of the Beyonder characteristics, changing them from the "waiting for resurrection" state to the "immediate extraction" state.
So Zaratul's Beyonder characteristics were instantly extracted.
At this moment, Zaratul anxiously used his historical projection to pick up the Beyonder characteristics, but Hobert had already picked up the characteristics first.
In horror, Zaratul quickly merged into his historical projection. He wanted to immediately rush into the "Historical Void" and into his related arrangements.
But how could the "Creator" give Him such an opportunity? He immediately "tampered" with it, and the "Historical Void" opened by Zaratul moved from Utopia to the violent north of the Southern Continent.
Under Hobert's gaze, Zaratul's figure quickly faded, and finally disappeared without a trace in His unwillingness.
The "Creator" looked at the Beyonder characteristics in his hand and couldn't help but sigh: "The angels of this pathway are really hard to kill."
Putting away this Beyonder characteristic of the "Attendant of Mysteries", Hobert rubbed his chin and went to study the "Corpse Cathedral" again.
… …
Inside the Corpse Cathedral.
Klein and Adam were like old friends chatting casually. Klein said: "I didn't expect Zaratul to cooperate with you. Isn't he afraid of becoming Amon's 'food'?"
In his opinion, Zaratul's probability of completely defecting to the "Mother Tree of Desire" was even greater than this possibility.
Adam's eyes showed a bit of pity: "For Him, your becoming a Great Old One means that He will inevitably fall. But if Amon becomes a Great Old One, as long as He shows his loyalty, he can still retain his current position and level. The 'Lord of the Mysteries' always needs an 'Attendant of Mysteries'."
Klein frowned and asked: "You seem to be very familiar with the way to become a Great Old One."
Adam did not explain, but turned his body and pointed to a gray, rather vicissitudes-looking stone slab under the large cross.
Klein asked, half affirmatively and half doubtfully: "The second 'Blasphemy Slate'?"
This stone slab looked very similar to the first "Blasphemy Slate", but it didn't have that extraordinarily ancient feeling.
It also had the kind of text that seemed to be the source of all languages, writing one sequence name after another, and one potion formula after another.
Without waiting for Adam's answer, Klein's eyes were quickly scanning the stone slab, directly looking at the last few lines.
His intuition told him that there was very important information there.
Adam smiled gently: "Don't worry, Amon will have to wait until he completes the ritual and becomes Sequence 0 before he comes to steal your destiny. Otherwise, He will not be able to bear the identity of the 'Sefirah Castle' master."
Klein muttered in his heart: I thank you for the reminder!
At this time, he had already deciphered part of the content of the last few lines:
God Almighty, Creator, Maker, The Omnipotent and Omniscient, Lord of the Astral World: "Chaos Sea" + "Visionary" Uniqueness + "Sun" Uniqueness…
Lord of the Mysteries, King of Space-Time, Beacon of Destiny, Embodiment of Sefirah Castle, Dominator of the Spirit World: "Sefirah Castle" + "Fool" Uniqueness + "Error" Uniqueness…
Seeing this, Klein turned his head to look at Adam and asked rather puzzledly: "Why are you showing me these?"
In the eyes of this "Visionary", he should be a dead man, right?
Adam said gently: "Frankly speaking, if the other side wasn't Amon, I would be more willing to help you become the 'Dominator of the Spirit World'.
"We have too many similarities. In a sense, we are still old friends who have met once."
Speaking of this, he smiled slightly: "We meet again, Mysteries."
Klein was slightly stunned. He had only heard this title from the "True Creator" and the Ancient Sun God in history.
And in a sense, these two can be equated. Suddenly hearing Adam say this, he immediately recalled a long-ago guess.
When he was caught by Amon and heard Amon complaining about Adam, he noticed Adam's abnormality.
Later, after escaping, Klein had many guesses about Adam, one of which was that Adam might be the Ancient Sun God's backhand for resurrection.
So at this time, Klein was not so surprised, but just calmly asked: "Are you the Ancient Sun God?"
Adam maintained a warm smile: "Don't you think that among the Eight Kings of Angels, I am the most special one?"
Klein nodded: "Among the five Kings of Angels related to 'Omniscience and Omnipotence', you are the only one with a 'Uniqueness'."
When Hobert announced the relevant information, Klein felt very strange. Later, after he learned some knowledge about the Outer Deities, he felt that this point was even stranger.
It can be said that from that time on, Klein realized that Adam was somewhat abnormal.
Adam patiently explained: "The 'Visionary' has a very special characteristic.
"A normal Sequence 0 is composed of 'Uniqueness' plus three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics. Without any part, it cannot be called a True God.
"And the 'Visionary' can separate two Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics after becoming Sequence 0, and replace them with corresponding characteristics 'imagined' out.
"The two separated real Sequence 1 Characteristics can be combined with a certain identity of oneself, or a certain creature 'imagined' out, to make them become 'Authors', who act freely at ordinary times, and can be transformed into their main body through certain methods or certain media when necessary.
"And for the 'Omnipotent and Omniscient', they can 'create' a 'Uniqueness' between reality and illusion to maintain their state."
Klein immediately thought: This sounds like the relationship between the "Dragon of Imagination" Ankewelt and his child, the "Dragon of Nightmare" Alzuhod!
He asked thoughtfully: "Did you awaken when you became a 'Visionary'?"
"No." Adam said in a gentle tone: "When I fell, when 'True' was born."
Klein asked in amazement: "Has no one ever suspected it?"
"Except for 'True' who definitely knows, maybe only the Evernight Goddess suspects to some extent." Adam patiently replied.
Creak~
At this time, one of the doors of the Corpse Cathedral was suddenly pushed open, and the image of the "Creator" appeared in the sight of the two people.
The "Creator" wearing a mask said: "Sorry to bother you. I knocked on the door for a long time and no one opened it, so I had to push the door open myself."

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 735 Amon Becomes a God
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Time returns to a few minutes prior.
"The Creator" studied the Corpse Cathedral for a while, unable to find a way to enter Adam's Divine Kingdom.
At this time, He also realized that Adam's sudden appearance was likely to be covering up Amon's Godhood Ceremony.
However, Hobert was currently unable to stop Amon from becoming a God, because according to the plan He and Klein had made earlier, Klein, as the owner of the "Sefirah Castle", would definitely be able to detect the process of Amon becoming a God.
When the time came, Klein would be responsible for locating him, and the two of them would work together to disrupt Amon's Godhood Ceremony.
But now that Klein had been locked up, even if "The Creator" had some guesses, He couldn't immediately find Amon.
Just as "The Creator" was planning to try "violently breaking through" Adam's Divine Kingdom, He suddenly had an idea: Amon was replacing "Mr. Door" to become a God.
According to the memories in "The Creator's" mind, when "Mr. Door" fell, all material doors in the real world, as well as doors in the mystical sense, were opened.
"The Creator" got inspiration from this memory and tried to "magnify" the abstract concept of the two large doors of the Corpse Cathedral.
The most direct meaning of "door" is "the entrance and exit of a building." Since one can enter and exit, it must be able to be opened.
After two consecutive "amplifications," the door of the Corpse Cathedral indeed loosened, but "The Creator" immediately noticed that a force was hindering the opening of the door.
Hobert, hiding in the "shadows" of this world, immediately realized that this power was Adam's control over his own Divine Kingdom.
Thus, "The Creator" "exploited" this power, which was equivalent to temporarily taking over a small portion of the control of the Corpse Cathedral.
At this time, "The Creator" pushed the door, and one of the doors of the Corpse Cathedral was opened.
Adam seemed unsurprised by "The Creator's" actions: "Heh, Lawyer!"
Of course, He noticed that "The Creator" was trying to enter, but He didn't expect the other party to come in so quickly.
Klein breathed a sigh of relief, taking advantage of Adam's attention being drawn to "The Creator," He continued to look at the later content on the "Blasphemy Slate":
Eternal Darkness, Singularity of All, Space-Time-in-One: "River of Eternal Darkness" + "Darkness" Uniqueness + "Death" Uniqueness…
Goddess of Origin, Mother of All, Brood Hive of Filth: "Brood Hive" + "Mother" Uniqueness + "Moon" Uniqueness…
The Anarchy, Shadow of Order: "Nation of Disorder" + "Black Emperor" Uniqueness + "Justiciar" Uniqueness + 1 portion of "Prince of Abolition" Beyonder characteristics + 1 portion of "Hand of Order" Beyonder characteristics.
Calamity of Destruction, Origins of Disaster: …
Father of Devils, Lord of Deviants, Source of Curses: …
Demon of Knowledge, Madness of Arcana: …
Key of Light, Endless Disorder, Incarnation of Fate: …
After interpreting these, Klein sighed with emotion: These are the Outer Deity titles corresponding to the nine Sephirot.
While He was interpreting, "The Creator" and Adam were discussing other topics.
Under the cover of the mask, "The Creator" said in a voice that could be considered pleasant: "Long time no see, first of all, I want to thank you for some of your previous help.
"Although I know that you also have some of your own purposes, at least I should thank you in person."
Adam stretched out his hand, revealing the "Order Crystal" in his palm: "All gifts of fate have been marked with a price."
This "Order Crystal" was of great help to Him.
"The Creator" did not enter the Corpse Cathedral, He stood at the door: "Actually, the three of us are natural allies, with a mutual trust that far exceeds ordinary people."
Adam maintained a cordial smile: "I am indeed a natural ally with you."
"What if Amon dies one day?" "The Creator" said surprisingly: "Wouldn't there be no more conflicts between us?
"As far as the current situation is concerned, the development of the three of us is not bad. If we don't hinder each other, but support each other, we all have a chance to become Great Old Ones.
"In this case, Amon is the most obstructive person."
These words made Adam pause for a moment, and then He smiled: "Heh, Lawyers!"
"The Creator" had been pushing the door of the Corpse Cathedral with one hand: "If there really is such a day, I mean, if Amon has no chance to become a Great Old One, please remember that the alliance between me and Klein is always open to you."
Adam's cordial expression gradually disappeared, replaced by seriousness: "You seem very sure of this."
"The Creator" spread out His empty hand: "Now is the eve of 'World Destruction,' anything can happen."
Adam slowly nodded: "You're right."
At this time, "The Creator" got to the point: "I have a few questions I want to ask."
Adam stretched out his hand, making a "please speak" gesture.
"Can the Sephirot parts of 'Nation of Disorder' and 'Uncertain Mist' still be fused?" This was a question that had troubled Hobert for a long time.
In theory, it should be possible to re-fuse, but He had to confirm it again.
"It seems you already know a lot of high-end information." Adam's expression at this time was like a priest encouraging believers to repent:
"As you have learned, 'Nation of Disorder' was once torn apart, part in the 'Physical World' and part in the 'Cosmos.'
"The two can be re-fused, but you must be careful not to let the consciousness of 'Uncertain Mist' cover your consciousness."
"The Creator" was thoughtful, and Hobert, who was also in the "shadows" outside the Corpse Cathedral, was also thoughtful: "That is to say, if you want to fuse these two Sephirots, you must accept the fact that you will merge with 'Uncertain Mist' to some extent.
That's right, after all, it's a Great Old One. Once you become a Great Old One, before the next "Original Creator" wakes up, He will always have a certain spiritual imprint.
After the "Original Creator" wakes up, the spiritual imprints of the Great Old Ones will be covered by the "Original Creator's" imprint, or "formatted."
Before that, the only difference is whether the spiritual imprint of the Great Old One is strong or weak.
If it's too strong, you might end up making a "wedding dress" for the Great Old One after working hard for a long time.
If it's not strong, it's barely acceptable."
Thinking of these, "The Creator" asked again: "If I fuse the two Sephirot, will I become stronger? How exactly should I do it?"
At this time, Klein also finished reading the information on the "Blasphemy Slate" about becoming a Great Old One, and quietly listened to the conversation between the two.
Seeing "The Creator's" earnest expression of asking for advice, and seeing Adam's appearance of answering questions and solving doubts, Klein suddenly had the illusion that three friends were happily discussing some mystical knowledge, and were waiting for Adam's child Amon to come home for dinner.
But then Klein complained in his heart: Of course, I am that "meal"… Uh, it would be even better if the wooden stake in my chest was pulled out.
Adam opened his mouth and replied: "I'm not very clear about the specific process, but I speculate that it should be somewhat similar to accommodating 'Uniqueness.'"
He paused and said: "Under normal circumstances, Sephirot cannot be divided. Only the 'Convergence' power generated when the first Creator wakes up can tear the Sephirot and absorb some of them into our planet.
"At the beginning, the part of 'Nation of Disorder' in the real world was incomplete, but the Sephirot itself has the ability to complete itself. Currently, the two Sephirot of 'Nation of Disorder' are two Sephirot with similar authority and symbolism.
"According to some of my previous deductions, Great Old Ones can accommodate multiple Sephirot, but there is a prerequisite that the authority and meaning must be similar, such as the two parts of 'Nation of Disorder' in the cosmos and the material world.
"Currently, among the Great Old Ones waiting outside the barrier of the 'Original Creator,' the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity,' 'Mother Tree of Desire,' and 'Uncertain Mist' hope to take back their part of the Sephirot in the real world.
"After they take back the Sephirot, of course they will re-fuse it, because that way they will become stronger, and the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' can even become a 'pillar' again."
Hobert in the "shadows" was slightly stunned: That's right, this question already has an answer, I just didn't try to do a reverse deduction.
At this time, Klein asked: "Among the Outer Deities currently peeking at the earth outside the barrier, there are at least nine existences at the Great Old One level.
"In addition to the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity,' 'Mother Tree of Desire,' and 'Uncertain Mist' you just mentioned, there are also 'Primordial Hunger,' 'Circle of Inevitability,' 'Supernova Dominator,' 'High-Dimensional Overseer,' 'Monarch of Decay,' and 'Inextinguishable Ravings.'
"In addition to the three Outer Deities you just mentioned who hope to retrieve the Sephirot that once belonged to them, what do the other Great Old Ones hope to obtain?"
Adam replied unhurriedly: "They hope to obtain Sephirot or high-level Beyonder characteristics similar to their own authority."
Klein seemed to have a very bold guess: "There are nine Sephirot on Earth, and nine Outer Deities. Does that mean that the 'Sefirah' on Earth were all torn from the bodies of the Outer Deities?"
Adam did not directly answer this question: "As far as I know, the 'Chaos Sea' and the 'Sefirah Castle' have never been torn apart."
Klein gave an "Oh": That way, the numbers don't match up. Then He asked, "What are 'Pillars'?"
"Those are the apex of the Outer Deities," Adam explained in detail, like a scripture lecture: "From the beginning to the present, a total of three Pillars have been born.
"One is 'God ALmighty', the 'Omnipotent and Omniscient'; one is the 'Lord of the Mysteries', the 'King of Space-Time'; and one is the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity', the 'Origin of Evil'."
Adam paused, then added: "Originally, according to my deduction, there could only be three Pillars in the universe, but I also deduced a hidden Pillar.
"That Pillar represents the end of all things, including the Outer Deities and the universe itself. It corresponds to the two Sefirah of 'Eternal Darkness River' and 'City of Calamity'.
"At first, I thought that there were only these four Pillars in the world, but later I deduced a concept: there can only be three Pillars in the universe, but there is more than just three ways to become a Pillar."
Hobert and Klein immediately understood Adam's meaning, and both showed varying degrees of surprise.
Before this, Hobert usually surprised others at the Tarot Club. Today was the first time He felt very surprised because of some information.
He realized that, as the former "Omnipotent and Omniscient," Adam had a terrifying accumulation of knowledge.
At this time, Adam continued: "The reason why there can only be three Pillars is because this is the limit of the universe. As long as a fourth Pillar appears, regardless of whether it is 'Eternal Darkness River' + 'City of Calamity', because the Beyonder characteristics and Sefirah are too concentrated, and They do not have the level of 'Original Creator', so they cannot prevent the process of convergence.
"So, once a fourth 'Pillar' appears, either it will awaken the 'Original Creator', and the real world will be destroyed again, or the universe will usher in its doomsday."
"Creator" fully understood Adam's meaning: "In other words, I may also become a 'Pillar'?"
At this time, Hobert in the "shadows" suddenly thought of a piece of information obtained from the "Dark Side of the Universe": when the time is right, the "Mother Tree of Desire" can "replace" the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
At that time, Hobert thought that it meant the "Mother Tree of Desire" defeated the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," but now it seems that it is likely that the "Mother Tree of Desire" became a new "Pillar," thereby replacing the Pillar's status of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
After all, according to Adam's speculation, the entire universe only has three "spots" for Pillars.
Adam did not directly answer this question again, but only said: "Otherwise, why do you think those Outer Deities in the cosmos hope to accommodate Sefirah with similar authorities and symbolism?
"In addition to the 'Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence', it is also because they can also achieve a breakthrough in level."
"Creator" smiled: "That's good news."
At this time, Adam said seriously: "You need to pay attention, the 'Original Creator' is in a special situation. Only He has accommodated nine Sefirah, and some of these Sefirah do not have similar authorities or similar symbolism.
"Later, there were also two who tried to accommodate multiple Sefirah, namely 'God Almighty' in the early First Epoch, who can also be called 'Primordial One', and the 'Lord of the Mysteries' at the same time.
"As far as I can see, the results of their attempts are not very good.
"And because three Pillars have appeared, I can only deduce the fourth Pillar, so I have no way to deduce other ways to become a Pillar."
In other words, if you want to become a Pillar, you have to rely on Hobert himself to explore.
"Thank you for your reminder," "Creator" sincerely thanked: "I will be careful."
Then He asked: "I heard that the Primordial once awakened in your body? How is your current situation?"
… …
Rorsted Archipelago, on the altar of an uninhabited island.
After that huge arm squeezed into the real world, in the darkness of the "Flesh and Blood Door," storm-shaped lightning bolts fell one after another, but they were swallowed by the suddenly surging scarlet tide.
Finally, a huge figure composed of pure "light spheres" passed through the "Flesh and Blood Door."
In the next second, these "light spheres" began to collapse, seemingly to reorganize, and rifts from the void and darkness appeared in the surrounding forest.
Hurricanes of unknown origin blew out from the cracks, sweeping in all directions.
Every door in different places and different locations throughout the Rorsted Archipelago opened by itself at this moment.
This hurricane swept across the Northern and Southern continents, and everything in the entire world that could be called a door was also opened!
At this time, Medici, who was far away in the main tent of the Southern Continent military camp, suddenly saw the box containing the sealed artifact open by itself, and the previous seal disappeared without a trace.
Medici's eyes narrowed, and while resealing it, He guessed if this was the enemy's counterattack?
Fortunately, the level of that sealed artifact was not very high, and He quickly resealed it.
At this time, noisy screams and warnings came from outside. Medici immediately came outside the tent and saw that the tent where the sealed artifact was stored was undergoing a mutation.
The Beyonders guarding the sealed artifact suddenly lost control and turned into monsters. The entire tent seemed to have come to life, whipping the Beyonders who wanted to approach with its ropes. Many wraiths and Zombies crawled out of the ground and were biting the surrounding living people.
Two demigods had already arrived and were trying to reseal the sealed artifact inside.
Medici was about to go to help when He suddenly looked at the sky.
At this time, the clouds in the northern sky were rolling, as if gusts of wind were blowing from the ground to the sky, blowing the clouds in the sky in all directions.
He looked at the sky for a second or two, then glanced at the curtains of the entire military camp tent, which were opened by an invisible wind: "Abraham is back?"
… …
Inside the Corpse Cathedral.
This place was not affected by anything outside, and the three people were still talking.
Adam still maintained that kind of preaching state: "The awakening of 'Primordial' was terminated, but I am only complete when I am united with 'True'."
He seemed to be telling the story of a stranger: "Although the 'True Creator' is a negative personality, the embodiment of extreme emotions, He has inherited all my humanity because of this.
"So, He is crazy."
Klein asked the question that had been in His heart for a long time: "Does 'Red Angel' Medici know about your resurrection? If my information is correct, He has always been very loyal to you, but in the end, He was attacked by you and Amon and turned into an evil spirit."
Adam's emotions didn't change much: "It was necessary to do that at the time. It was a necessary sacrifice."
Klein frowned: "I always feel that Medici's death is not as simple as it seems on the surface."
He paused, organized His words, and then said: "The strengths of the four empires are actually very different. The Trunsoest Empire has the support of the six gods, and its strength should be the strongest. It seems that the other three empires combined are difficult to compete against the 'Judgment' plus the six gods' camp.
"Under this circumstance, why did you plan an action against the 'Red Angel'? Is it because He supports the 'True Creator'?"
Adam's gaze looked at the huge cross in front of Him: "You have such doubts because you don't know enough.
"In the Fourth Epoch, the Demoness Sect, the Moses Ascetic Order, the penetration of the Abyss, and the Balam Empire at that time were also active in the Northern and Southern continents. The situation was very complicated.
"Moreover, the conflicts between the six gods always caused huge internal friction in Trunsoest's Empire, so the four empires once maintained a delicate balance."
Klein nodded slowly. He suddenly recalled the information announced by Hobert at the Tarot Club: The war between the six gods' camp and the True Creator's camp that broke out was almost evenly matched! All the six gods used the Trunsoest and Tudor to cause Solomon's death to gain the advantage in the war.
Otherwise, if there was an overwhelming advantage, They would definitely not use some methods that might damage Their image.
Adam added calmly: "Also, you should have been to Bansy, right?"
Klein was slightly stunned, understanding Adam's meaning.
Adam continued: "In addition, after my fall at the end of the Third Epoch, the Outer Deities' erosion of the real world has obviously deepened.
"As far as I know, They seem to have successfully descended a part of their power into the real world. For example, the 'Uncertain Mist' has descended three times in the Fourth Epoch."
They were well aware that the power within the barrier was no match for the gods of the material world, so the power they sent down was quietly hidden somewhere, ready to do something important for the main body when the time was right.
Speaking of which, He suddenly looked at "The Creator": "More than one Outer God has descended power in the Southern Continent, you must be careful."
"The Creator" first seemed thoughtful, then He smiled slightly: "The good news is that the power of the 'Uncertain Mist' has been destroyed by me.
"The bad news is that I only know today that the real world has been eroded so badly."
Adam suddenly changed his usual behavior and said seriously again: "Since the end of the previous war of the gods, the erosion of the Outer Deities has become more and more serious. In the past six months, the number of Blessed has increased a lot.
"I can feel that many forces are already ready to move."
"The Creator" leaned against the door with one hand: "It seems that the extraordinary world will be very unstable even before the doomsday."
Then He smiled and said: "I am very happy to chat today, and I have also obtained a lot of useful information. I hope to have such opportunities in the future."
At this time, the illusory hurricane of Mr. "Door"'s return blew here, and the original closed door of the Corpse Cathedral also began to tremble slightly, as if it was about to be opened by some invisible force.
Adam looked outside with a warm smile: "It has already begun!"
"Yes, the six gods should have noticed the abnormality at this time, but even if the gods descend at this time, it will be too late." While speaking, "The Creator" raised his hand almost imperceptibly.
Adam turned his head sharply. Klein, who had been pierced in the chest by the wooden stakes, turned into Gehrman Sparrow, who fell not far away and had lost his life.
And Klein, who was sitting next to Adam, appeared behind "The Creator" and disappeared into the "shadows."
From the beginning, "The Creator" had been quietly establishing a connection between Klein and Gehrman Sparrow, because Gehrman "is" Klein, and as life disappeared, Gehrman lost his humanity, so Adam did not notice this in time.
When Klein felt that he was more and more like a corpse, he probably understood Hobert's intention, so he continued to discuss the problem with Adam calmly.
Until just now, Adam's attention was briefly attracted by the reaction caused by the return of Mr. "Door", "The Creator" seized the opportunity and "distorted" the concept of Klein and Gehrman.
Because there was already enough connection, this "twist" was very "smooth", and Adam didn't have time to stop it.
Of course, another reason is that Hobert accommodated the Uniqueness, which allowed for such a result. If He was only a Sequence 1, Adam would have a high probability of being able to stop His actions just now.
"The Creator" bowed slightly and said: "Thank you very much for your answer."
Adam's expression remained unchanged, with a kind smile and some pity, as if a god was watching the world.
After "The Creator" said thank you, He immediately disappeared from the entrance of the Corpse Cathedral.
In the next second, "The Creator" and Klein had already appeared on the edge of Antarctica. Although the cold wind was howling and the temperature was very low, extreme weather would no longer have any impact on the two of them.
"The Creator" took out the "Attendant of Mysteries" part of Zaratul's Beyonder characteristics that had just been shattered: "Zaratul is dead."
Klein took the characteristics: "Thank you."
While thanking Him, He "took out" the container from the historical void and began to prepare the "Attendant of Mysteries" potion.
For Klein, the eyes of the gods and high-sequence beings were now focused on Amon's apotheosis, which was also an excellent opportunity to advance to "Attendant of Mysteries."
Because he had to guard against the "Primordial Demoness" suddenly jumping out to make trouble, "The Creator" did not leave immediately, but waited aside for Klein to complete the advancement before leaving.
...
Angel City, Atlantis Palace.
Bang~
Audrey, who was working at her desk, was startled. She looked up and saw that the door of the filing cabinet suddenly opened for no reason.
Bang~ Bang~
At this moment, all the cabinet doors and room doors around were opened. Screams from outside proved that the doors of the entire palace were suddenly opened by a strange force!
Audrey quickly went out to "appease" the crowd, and at the same time prayed to Christian, who was guarding Angel City, to report this matter to Her.
Soon Christian sent someone to tell Audrey that it seemed that the doors of the entire Angel City and the surrounding area had been opened, and the seals of all sealed items had been lifted instantly.
Christian did not come because He was resealing those sealed items.
Hearing this news, Audrey was surprised. She realized that something big must have happened in the extraordinary world!
...
Bayam, Sea God Church.
A streak of lightning suddenly channeled into Alger Wilson's room, turning into a hurried voice: "Your Eminence Cardinal, most of the seals in the underground have failed! Only some items have not disappeared due to the effect of restraining the sealing method to achieve balance!"
Alger's eyebrows twitched slightly. Combined with the simultaneous opening of doors and windows in Bayam, he realized the unusualness of the problem.
So he immediately ordered: "You immediately form teams of three to take the 2nd and 3rd level sealed items that will not cause too much harm in a short period of time and have living characteristics away from the underground to avoid chain reactions."
In this way, the underground will become a no-man's land, and those dangerous sealed items will not cause casualties for the time being.
As time goes by, when the abnormality of the seal failure passes, the Punishers will be able to free up their hands to deal with these items.
Alger's orders turned into waves of electricity, forming silver-white flashes, and flew to the underground.
He seized the time to pray to the Lord of Storms, hoping to get the Lord's protection or help, and then immediately rushed to the underground, using his Beyonder abilities to try to temporarily suppress the three Grade 1 Sealed Artifacts, including the Azure Gate.
...
Rorsted Archipelago, altar on the nameless island.
There appeared a figure composed of layers of doors. He wore a robe of scarlet tide, and his form was constantly twisting and changing, reflecting different planets and different regions.
At the same time as His return, He began the process of apotheosis.
At this moment, a dazzling ray of sunlight fell from the astral world, melting everything it encountered along the way.
Outside this sunlight, an impenetrable night surged, trying to swallow Mr. "Door", who was seeking to advance to Sequence 0.
The earth suddenly cracked, and a huge force was dragging Mr. "Door", as if to drag Him into the center of the earth.
Immediately afterwards, dark clouds suddenly covered the island, and dense white lightning, like a roaring white hurricane, surrounded Mr. "Door".
The other gods were also descending.
Mr. "Door" let out a low roar, causing the scarlet robe he was wearing to rise.
This robe was connected to the evil tide surging behind the "Gate of Flesh and Blood", spreading a crimson moonlight to the surroundings.
As soon as it touched the moonlight, the impenetrable night gathered on its own and turned into a ghostly human female.
Without exception, the dazzling sunlight turned into a young man wearing flame armor; a kind figure holding a baby appeared in the huge crack in the earth; the lightning hurricane turned into a middle-aged man wearing black armor and holding a trident.
The gods' interference and obstruction of Mr. "Door" fell into chaos at the same time, giving "Door" a chance to breathe.
Seizing this opportunity, He entered the final step of apotheosis.
At this moment, the "Gate of Flesh and Blood" suddenly collapsed on its own, covering the surface of Mr. "Door", making Him seem to have become another person.
...
Bayam, underground of the Sea God Church.
Alger stretched out his hands and pressed them against the door in front of him.
The surface of this door is azure blue, with mysterious and strange reliefs on it.
It has been half-opened, and inside is a deep darkness without any light, and it is unknown where it is connected to.
At this time, a surging force was surging outward, and Alger continuously created hurricanes, rainstorms, and thunder disasters to block the force back again and again.
If he only faced this one Grade 1 Sealed Artifact, Alger would have no problem at all, and even have the spare capacity to try to seal it, but at this moment, there were two other equally dangerous items around him.
This forced him to sing loudly, using the melody that could be called death to affect the surroundings and interfere with the operation of other sealed items.
And he built layers of walls made of azure seawater around him to protect himself.
It's just that now this wall is gradually turning gray and white, as if it has turned into stone.
This trend cannot be contained and continues to spread towards Alger.
Alger, who was trying his best, said in his heart: I can only hold on for thirty seconds at most, and the Lord of Storms has not responded!
He quickly made a decision: "The Fool who doesn't belong to this era…"
…
The edge of Antarctica.
Having drunk the potion, Klein instantly lost his connection to his physical body and the "Worms of Spirit," as if he was about to collapse into abstract symbols and information.
At that moment, a certain area of the spirit world established contact with his consciousness.
That place corresponded to a town where people lived ordinary lives.
In that instant, Klein seemed to split into countless individuals, each with their own preferences, personalities, beliefs, and destinies, living in a small town called Utopia.
These people lived brief lives, awakening in rays of "light of destiny" that resembled lightning, realizing their most essential identity.
It was Zhou Mingrui, also Klein Moretti, Sherlock Moriarty, Gehrman Sparrow, Dwayne Dantès, and Merlin Hermes.
One "Worm of Spirit" after another, bits of Beyonder characteristics, and self-awareness flew from the spirit world area corresponding to Utopia, heading towards Klein's somewhat illusory body, gradually giving Him substance.
After only two seconds, the reconstruction was complete. Klein opened his eyes, having advanced to Sequence 1, becoming a "Attendant of Mysteries."
The "Creator" beside him said, "Find a secluded place yourself to stabilize your state first."
His figure immediately disappeared, preparing to see if there was still a chance to disrupt Amon's advancement ritual.
…
Gradually, Alger's body was stained with a layer of greyish-white, on the verge of petrification.
Alger wanted to give up several times, but thinking of the school and residential area not far from the church, he remained underground.
Just as Alger was preparing to hold on until the last moment, a greyish-white mist appeared before his eyes, and all the sealed artifacts calmed down.
…
After Mr. "Door" Bethel Abraham was covered by the "Door of Flesh and Blood," a familiar voice echoed in his ears: "Do you want to bring disaster back to reality?"
Bethel's movements immediately showed some hesitation.
That familiar voice continued: "Give up. I have a way to deal with it. I will let you rest in peace and get the tranquility you desire."
Mr. "Door" seemed to suddenly notice the scarlet robe covering his body, and the crimson tide connected to the "Door of Flesh and Blood."
He laboriously uttered his first sound after returning to reality: "Okay…"
Mr. "Door's" figure suddenly solidified, then he raised his right hand and reached towards his face.
The next second, Mr. "Door's" head lifted up, and a monocle made of crystal was placed on his right eye.
On this monocle, a ray of light instantly erupted, illuminating the entire world.
At this moment, all the errors of failed seals were corrected, all seemingly normal behaviors became flawed, and all clocks skipped ahead several seconds.
The light then converged, and Mr. "Door" transformed into Amon, wearing a peaked soft cap and a classic black robe.
In this "Blasphemer's" hand, he held a pure starlight-forged, ancient-style key.
Above Him, the scarlet robe fell down, about to cover Him. Behind Him, the crimson tide angrily squeezed through the wreckage of the "Door of Flesh and Blood," about to completely squeeze into this world.
In this short moment, the scarlet moonlight flourished, blocking the sun, the night, the earth, the lightning, as well as the faint azure light and the strange white tower that had just arrived.
The God of Steam and Machinery was late because His Church had too many sealed artifacts, and He had to lend a hand first.
The God of Knowledge and Wisdom was late because the sealing of "0-01" had actually failed to some extent, and He had to further seal this artifact.
Facing the Outer God's invasion, Amon's lips curled up slightly, and with a wave of his hand, he took out a mottled and extremely ancient stone slab from who knows where.

Then, He blocked the remaining gap of the "Door of Flesh and Blood" with the "Blasphemy Slate," and used it as a substitute to bear the falling scarlet robe.
The first "Blasphemy Slate" then became illusory, as if connecting to an boundless sea encompassing all colors.
The seawater surged, engulfing the scarlet robe and blocking the crimson tide from the cosmos.
The "Door of Flesh and Blood" rapidly withered and soon disappeared, leaving only an angry roar, echoing endlessly.
When the "Creator" arrived, the dark clouds in the sky had disappeared. Although it was daytime, the scarlet moon appeared, its light no less than the distant sun.

…

Hobert reappeared in the Palu Canyon of the Southern Continent. He found Medici in the main tent, who had already restored order to the military camp.
Medici had already guessed: "Amon has become a god?"
Hobert nodded: "Yes."
He took a deep breath: "The agreement between me and Amon has expired."
Medici smiled: "So, the final battle can finally begin."
"Yes!" Hobert said: "Let us end this foolish war as soon as possible!"
…
Longtail Island.
Fors, who was taking a nap, suddenly had a nightmare, dreaming that her teacher Dorian was affected by the family's sealed artifact and died in front of her.
Soon, Fors broke free from the dream and sat up, gasping for breath.
As a demigod who was once an "Astrologer," she knew that such a dream must mean that her teacher was in danger.
So, she restrained her emotions and immediately used "Teleport" to go to her teacher to confirm his safety.
A few seconds later, Fors appeared at Dorian's residence and saw her teacher sitting there, looking frightened.
Fors knew that her teacher's heart was not very good, so she carefully asked: "Do you need a potion?"
Dorian took a deep breath and shook his head: "No need."
Fors immediately breathed a sigh of relief: "Teacher, I dreamed that you were negatively affected by a sealed artifact."
Dorian looked at the open window: "Your dream is right. I almost died just now, but at the most critical moment, the seal took effect again."
Speaking of this, he suddenly got up: "Quick, take me somewhere else. I'm worried that other members will have accidents!"
Fors did not hesitate, and immediately grabbed her teacher's arm, asking for the exact location.
When they separated from the spirit world again, Fors and Dorian appeared in a study, where several other people were standing. They all had sealed artifacts that could use "Travel."
Dorian blurted out: "Vilos? Why are you here?"
Vilos and the others shook their heads at the same time, equally at a loss.
Then, at this time, countless brilliant starlight emerged from the void, and these starlight turned into one thing after another and fell to the ground.
Among them were miniature starlight doors, crystal balls formed by clusters of worms, translucent, strangely shaped keys, and quietly burning, brilliant sparks.
For some reason, the names Sequence 3 "Wanderer"… Sequence 4 "Secrets Sorcerer"… Sequence 1 "Key of Stars"… Sequence 2 "Planeswalker"… appeared in the minds of Dorian, Vilos, and others.
Moreover, these Beyonder characteristics were not single copies. Even the Sequence 1 "Key of Stars" Beyonder characteristic actually had two copies! There were also three copies of "Planeswalker," and even more characteristics of the other sequences.
Several key members of the Abraham family and Fors opened their mouths, unable to close them for a long time.
Fors, the only demigod member here, felt something and looked at the roof, feeling that someone had just "concentrated" the important members of the Abraham family together and sent these Beyonder characteristics.
