Inside the Bayam's Sea God Church.
Alger, wearing a robe embroidered with the Storm symbol, walked up from the underground with heavy steps, nodded to the 'Punishers' and priests waiting on both sides, and said, "The seal has been restored to normal in time.
"You can put the items you are supervising back.
"Yes, Your Excellency Wilson." The 'Punishers' and priest bishops breathed a sigh of relief and struck their left chests with their right fists.
Alger didn't say much, just responded to them with the same etiquette.
After returning to his room, he found a seat and sat down: "The Fool who doesn't belong to this era..."
Alger prayed to Mr. Fool almost silently, expressing his intention to leave the Church of the Lord of Storms.
The statement that the seal was restored to normal in time can only deceive lower-level church members, and cannot be concealed from the senior deacons who will investigate this matter later, let alone the Pope and the 'Lord of Storms'.
After a few seconds, Alger saw the familiar boundless gray fog and heard Mr. Fool's response: "Okay.
"Go to the Sea God Church."
Huff~
Alger let out a long breath, stood up, and took off the storm robe.
He folded the robe neatly and carefully examined it back and forth for a few seconds.
Finally, Alger withdrew his gaze, controlled the wind, and flew out of the church through the open window.
...
Early morning, a mountainous area on the western side of the Southern Continent.
The soldiers of the Paz Kingdom looked at the sun rising little by little with despair, because along with the sunlight, the artillery fire of the Atlantis army also descended on this land!
Today was the same, the crisp sound of artillery fire came as expected, and as the grassroots commanders shouted, "Take cover! Take cover!"
Everyone burrowed into the artillery shelters, and the shells fell on the position like raindrops.
The soldiers hugged their heads one by one, hiding in the narrow caves, praying that the shelling would end soon.
They didn't know why, but the battle had suddenly become fierce a few days ago, and the Atlantis army's 100,000 troops on the western front suddenly began to launch an offensive.
At this time, the main force of the Paz army had been transferred to the east, and although 100,000 people were left here, they were far behind the Atlantis army in terms of weapons and equipment.
In terms of the number of artillery alone, the western front defenders may not have even a third of the Atlantis army's artillery, and the shells were even less comparable.
At first, they tried to fight back, but the Atlantis army bombarded them for twenty minutes every hour, and the defenders only fought back for two days before the shells were almost exhausted.
In the following days, they could only hide in the Trunsoest and be bombed by the Atlantis army.
But strangely, the Atlantis army only bombarded and did not carry out any form of charge!
This shelling was the same as usual, also twenty minutes.
After the shelling ended, everyone heard some commotion on the opposite position. When the soldiers came out of the artillery shelters, they saw that the Atlantis army was deploying strange "black spots" one by one.
At this time, Heli, the commander-in-chief of the western front garrison in the command post on the top of the mountain, could see clearly with a telescope that those "black spots" were some equipment covered with black tarpaulins, but he couldn't see what the specific equipment was.
As he watched, Heli saw a familiar figure with red hair, and he couldn't help but smile: "The analysis of MI9 is correct, Medici has indeed come to the western front."
He didn't become nervous because of this, because according to the combat plan, they would launch a surprise attack on the enemy on the western front today.
If the enemy has angels intervening, the angels of the Paz Kingdom will also take action, even at the cost of triggering the angel war in advance.
Just at this moment, a soldier pointed to the distance and exclaimed, and more and more people's attention was attracted. In the northern sky, there were dark, cloud-like things like flocks of birds.
Some soldiers with good eyesight had already recognized that they were airships! Thousands of airships!
This was the hidden strength of the Paz army, and it was also the surprise attack force they planned to use to reverse the situation.
According to intelligence, although the Atlantis Kingdom had acquired the technology of airships and built airship bases, the time to obtain the technology was too short. Currently, only one or two hundred airships had been produced, and they were even being used for civilian use by the Atlantis government!
This was a huge loophole in the Atlantis army, so the countries of the Northern Continent jointly formed this airship force.
The only thing they needed to guard against was the Atlantis army's Beyonders attacking the airships, so along with the thousands of airships, there were also corps composed of Beyonders from the Paz Kingdom.
These Beyonders were not only Beyonders who served the Paz Kingdom, but most of them were Beyonders transferred from the Northern Continent.
During the previous World War, the Beyonders of the military of various countries suffered considerable losses. It has only been more than half a year, and of course they have not recovered their vitality.
But there are still many Beyonders hidden among the nobles in various countries, or the nobles themselves are Beyonders.
During the previous World War, these nobles shirked their responsibilities and were unwilling to contribute, but now it is different. The Atlantis Kingdom is obviously going to eliminate the noble class. They have changed from being bystanders to contributing as much as they can!
So, unexpectedly, a large number of Beyonders have gathered!
And the "local" Beyonders of the Paz Kingdom are mainly from the Trunsoest family, the Tamara family, and the Demoness Sect.
Now, this large-scale Beyonder corps is dispatched in full force, and it looks like they are going to fight a decisive battle.
Heli saw the sky full of airships, and the corners of his mouth gradually rose, and a smile climbed onto his face.
Looking at the Atlantis army again, his smile slowly disappeared. The ordinary soldiers of the Atlantis army did not show any panic!
This made him seriously suspect that Medici had used His ability to stabilize the situation.
As the large number of airships got closer and closer, the expected Beyonder battle did not break out.
The Paz army originally thought that after the Atlantis army realized their shortcomings, they would launch an attack with Beyonders when the airships were still far away from their positions.
At that time, the Beyonders on the Paz army's side could calmly take advantage of the enemy's attack on the airships to attack the Atlantis army's Beyonders, thereby gaining the upper hand at the beginning of the war.
So the huge airship force did not use extraordinary power to accelerate, but used their maximum speed to slowly come to the battlefield.
But to the surprise of the Paz army's high command, the Atlantis army did not mean to retreat, and did not even mean to take the initiative to meet them.
This was completely beyond their expectations, and even felt a bit strange!
Some people suggested temporarily retreating and launching an attack after investigating clearly.
However, more people felt that the surprise attack effect of the airships would only happen once and could not be abandoned.
Before the Paz army's high command had made a final decision, the sky full of airships had crossed the Paz army's positions and were making the final preparations for bombing. Their target was the Atlantis army's artillery positions.
And as far as they could see, there was not even a single anti-aircraft machine gun on the Atlantis army's positions. The only thing they needed to guard against now was the enemy's Beyonder attacks.
At this time, the Atlantis army's position finally reacted. Medici gave an order, and the gunners quickly pulled down the previous "black tarpaulins", revealing the equipment below.
Heli immediately used a telescope to carefully study it. It was a cannon with a not-so-large caliber!
But unlike ordinary cannons, its firing angle was wider and could be adjusted to above 45 degrees.
Heli immediately realized that this should be a new weapon of the Atlantis army, which gave him a bad feeling.
But thinking about the slow rate of fire and the probability of missing the target, he breathed a slight sigh of relief.
According to Heli's experience, this kind of cannon would definitely bring considerable losses to the airships, but it would still not be able to reverse the situation.
But in the next moment, Heli saw a scene he would never forget. All the "small-caliber cannons" fired into the air together.
Bang bang bang bang bang~
The muzzle flashes were regular, unhurried, and actually continuous!
Heli suddenly felt his scalp tingle. As a senior officer, he had certainly heard of the concept of rapid-firing cannons, but at the same time, he had also heard that this weapon was still under development. Why did the Atlantis Kingdom already have the relevant technology?
The research institute on Longtail Island!
Heli immediately thought of the Atlantis Kingdom's research institution!
Looking at the airship formation again, about one or two shells could destroy an airship.
Even a small shell is still a shell, and it can blow a big hole in the airship's cockpit, and there is a good chance that it can detonate the bombs on the airship. Even if it can't detonate the bombs, the airship can still lose control.
And if the shell hits the gasbag, it will be even more of a disaster! A large number of the airship's gasbags will be destroyed and ignited, and the airship will crash immediately.
Bang bang bang bang bang~
The Atlantis army's artillery fire never stopped, and all the Paz army soldiers were stunned, watching the airships they had placed their hopes on explode in the air, turn into fireballs, and slowly fall.
Or the gasbags were destroyed and they fell rapidly.
The enemy's artillery was a weapon they had never seen before, and the astonishing "bang bang" sound seemed to be the death knell sounded by the Grim Reaper.
Some of the airships immediately began to turn around, but this disrupted the formation, and many airships collided in a panic, causing them to fall even faster.
At this time, the Beyonders of the Paz army who were protecting the airships finally reacted and immediately rushed towards the Atlantis army's artillery positions, wanting to end this massacre.
Yes, this was completely a massacre!
But what greeted them was a network of fire composed of heavy machine guns!
You must know that most Sequence 5 Beyonders do not dare to face the firepower of heavy machine guns head-on, and some "low-Sequence" Beyonders who are accidentally swept by the bullets are still torn to pieces by the large, fast-moving heavy machine gun bullets.
However, Beyonders above Sequence 7 can use their abilities to effectively avoid being hit by bullets, but this also greatly affects their speed.
On the Atlantis army's side, the Beyonders stood next to the heavy machine guns, waiting for the enemy to approach before using their Beyonder abilities to attack.
Some of the enemy's Beyonders used their abilities or the Sealed Artifacts they held to simply skip the machine gun positions, and as soon as they appeared, they would be attacked by the Atlantis army's Beyonders.
Some Sequence 5s and demigods used their abilities or Sealed Artifacts to directly appear in the Atlantis army's artillery positions, but they first saw Medici sitting behind the artillery positions with his legs crossed.
And behind Medici was a row of tents, which seemed to be the Atlantis army's camp.
What greeted these Sequence 5s and demigods was the elite of the Atlantis Kingdom's Beyonder troops who had been waiting here for a long time.
The battle between Beyonders at this level was destined to be difficult to control, and some losses still occurred to the anti-aircraft guns.
The Beyonders of the Paz Kingdom breathed a sigh of relief. According to the current rate of destruction, it was enough to buy time for the airships to rush to the artillery positions.
At the same time, many demigods used their abilities to accelerate the airships' flight speed.
At this moment, Medici raised his hand.
Whoosh~
A large area of tents behind him was overturned, revealing a large number of anti-aircraft guns again.
The demigods were stunned for a full two or three seconds!
Let's retreat!
Otherwise, not a single airship will be able to return.
But how could Medici let them retreat so easily when he personally commanded this battle?
From the barracks, a large number of Beyonders rushed out again and entangled them.
These were all Beyonders who had just been transferred from the other two armies and the rear of the Atlantis Kingdom using teleportation arrays.
Bang bang bang bang bang~
The urging sound of artillery continued, and the soldiers on the Paz army's positions gradually became desperate.
At this time, the sky was a large-scale air disaster site. Many airships were exploding, or burning, or falling.
The entire sky was dyed orange-red by the flames.
A large number of airship pilots parachuted, but many of them were hit by shells in the dense artillery fire and were smashed to pieces in the air.
Some shells even "smashed" one or two of the parachuting airmen before hitting the airship without much impact.
Even if they parachuted successfully, most of them jumped to the middle of the two armies' positions and were shot down as targets before landing.
At this time, the airship formations received the order to retreat.
After another batch of airships was shot down, they finally flew out of the range of the anti-aircraft guns.
At this time, the Beyonders of the Paz Kingdom finally withdrew from the Atlantis army's positions at a certain cost.
A smile appeared on Medici's face. He stood up and said in a voice that could be heard by 100,000 troops: "Get ready! The general offensive begins!"
First of all, the general offensive's artillery fire began. This time, all the cannons fired at the same time, and the artillery fire was more intense than ever before.
Before the shelling was over, the infantry had already jumped out of the positions and launched an offensive against the enemy's positions.
When the shelling ended, the Atlantis army also rushed to a position not far from the enemy's positions.
The Paz army collapsed almost at the first touch. In just over two hours, the vanguard of the Atlantis army seized the positions and quickly launched a pursuit at Medici's request.
They pursued all day without encountering any decent resistance.
After this battle, airships officially withdrew from the stage of history.
Medici certainly knew about the Atlantis army's lack of air force. He had discussed with Hobert how to solve this shortcoming a long time ago, but Hobert told him not to worry too much about it.
At first, Medici thought Hobert was secretly building an air force, but when the anti-aircraft guns were pushed in front of Medici, he immediately realized that airships were outdated.
For Hobert, the air force he remembered consisted of fighter planes roaring through the sky, not slow-moving airships.
He originally thought that airplanes had made airships obsolete, but this world had no oil, no fuel for airplanes, so airships had remained in service with the air force.
Later, after the bombing of Saint Milon, he realized that the obsolescence of airships might not be entirely due to airplanes.
At that time, he discovered that this world had no anti-aircraft guns!
The angle of anti-aircraft machine guns was not easy to control, and the effective range was very limited, and the power was too small. Even if a dozen bullets hit the same airship, it would only damage the airship.
If an airship formation conducted high-altitude bombing, anti-aircraft machine guns would be just decorations!
But if there were anti-aircraft guns, it would be different. First, the firing height of anti-aircraft guns was enough to hit any airship, and second, the power of the shells was great enough to easily destroy airships.
So Hobert ordered the development of autocannons and anti-aircraft guns. Because cannons were already relatively mature weapons, they were quickly developed. After sufficient experiments, mass production and deployment began.
Back to the present, in the following days, the Atlantis army's western front troops took turns pursuing, and the Paz army's morale had plummeted to the bottom with the fall of the airships.
Although they had also carried out some ambushes, causing some losses to the Atlantis army, they still could not reverse the defeat.
This pursuit only ended when the Paz army fleeing in front encountered the main force coming to support them.
At this time, the Paz army of more than 400,000 troops finally gathered together, and the eastern front troops of the Atlantis army had also passed through the Palu Canyon and followed in pursuit. The two troops totaled 170,000 to 80,000 people.
The momentum for a decisive battle between the two sides had already emerged, but the Paz Kingdom's high command believed that the decisive battle was on the western front, but as they fought, they came to the hinterland of the Paz Kingdom.
At the same time, the Atlantis army still had a 100,000-strong army stationed in the Balam Empire.
The hints from Hobert's dream made him extra careful when dealing with the Balam Empire, so he only occupied the eastern part of the Balam Empire, but did not occupy the entire territory.
Subsequently, Xio also sent back accurate information that the so-called trump card of the Balam Empire was to release some monsters from the underworld.
It is said that those monsters were sealed by the Underworld Emperor in the past, and their power is very strong.
The Underworld Emperor even issued an order that no one should lift the seal on those monsters.
This can verify the strength of those monsters from the side.
But it is different now. The Balam Empire regards this as the last resort, or a bargaining chip to force the Atlantis Kingdom to negotiate.
They are now very clear that the decadent empire is no match for the Atlantis Kingdom at all.
So they only hope to negotiate with the Atlantis Kingdom, restore the territory before the war, cease the war between the two sides, and never have war again.
As long as the Atlantis Kingdom agrees, they will once again use the seal left by the Underworld Emperor to reseal those monsters into the underworld, and the Balam Empire will become an ally of the Atlantis Kingdom.
But the Paz Kingdom does not think so. They plan to completely destroy the method of sealing after the Balam Empire releases those monsters, causing huge losses to Atlantis and giving Hobert a headache.
It was precisely because of the serious differences between the two sides that Xio had the opportunity to obtain this information.
In response, Hobert's attitude is to confront the Balam Empire first, and he will try to solve the Balam Empire's problem later.
Now he has more important things to do.
...
Southern Continent, Utopia City.
Hobert was sitting in the somewhat dilapidated "Elf Restaurant". The tables and chairs here were very messy, and the glass of the windows and doors was also damaged, as if no one had lived here for a long time.
Looking out from here, the square had been destroyed by an unknown force, and large areas of houses had been razed to the ground. A sense of desolation and dilapidation came over him.
Suddenly, Klein came out of the "Historical Void" without warning: "I didn't expect you to ask me to meet here."
He looked around and sighed helplessly. This city was destroyed like this in the previous battle!
Hobert sighed: "It's rare to have such a familiar place."
He took out another Beyonder characteristic of "Attendant of Mysteries": "This is for you. You can try to digest it in advance."
"Thank you." Klein took it: "What can I do to help you?"
Hobert stretched and said, "Make two 'Elf' dishes. Let's chat while we eat."
"No problem." Klein snapped his fingers, and Utopia immediately returned to its original appearance, but there were no pedestrians outside, not even a pigeon.
However, many panicked small animals quickly fled back to the nearby jungle.
The "Elf Restaurant" was also brand new, no different from when Hobert came last time.
Then the waiter came out of the back kitchen, brought the menu, and asked the two to order.
They still ordered four dishes and a soup, and while drinking beer, Hobert said in a casual tone: "If I become the 'Black Emperor', Roselle will completely fall."
Hearing this, Klein paused with the wine glass in his hand and glanced at Hobert.
Hobert's words were equivalent to admitting that he was the "Creator".
After all, the "Creator" is currently only a god, probably at the level of a King of Angels, and how could a god's subordinate be a god of the same pathway or adjacent pathway?
Hobert ignored Klein's gaze and continued: "So I thought of a way to make Roselle no longer the 'Black Emperor', so I can advance with confidence.
"So I want to ask 'The Fool' for a favor. The specific plan is like this..."
Hobert briefly described the plan he had thought of before, "grafting" Roselle with the Beyonder characteristic of "Knowledge Emperor", and using Roselle's "projection" when he was the "Knowledge Emperor" to "fool" history and reality, from "the reviving Black Emperor" into "Knowledge Emperor".
Finally, Hobert said: "I have already acquired the 'Knowledge Emperor' Beyonder characteristic that was 'dropped' from Roselle during the previous battle of the gods.
"It can be determined that there is still Roselle's mental residue in it, which should be helpful for your 'grafting'."
Klein didn't expect Hobert to be so well prepared, even the Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic was prepared.
He pondered for a while and felt that this plan was quite feasible.
Then he realized: "You... know... know I am..."
Hobert smiled half-truthfully: "I helped get two Sequence 1 characteristics of the 'Seer' pathway, and I probably know where the Uniqueness of this pathway is, so..."
He made a gesture of spreading his hands: "Obviously, it's similar to my situation."
Klein suddenly laughed while holding the beer, and it was the kind of laugh that couldn't stop. Hobert also laughed along.
For some reason, they both found the current situation very funny.
Originally, they were two big figures in the Beyonder world, but who knew that for a long time in the past, they were all disguises!
Klein laughed: "This suddenly reminds me of our first meeting in Tingen City.
"I didn't expect that it was the first meeting between the great 'Creator' and the respected 'Mr. Fool'!"
Hobert smiled and raised his glass: "Respects to Mr. Fool."
Klein also raised his glass, trying to make himself serious: "Respects to the Creator."
The two clinked glasses, but after taking a sip, they laughed again, as if they had heard the funniest joke in the world, and they were both characters in that joke.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 737 Saving Roselle
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Then, Klein thought of another crucial question, so He said, "How did you know that I am 'The Fool'?"
"Not long ago." Hobert said, half-truthfully, "This amount of time is more like... what's that saying? Oh, right, a blink of an eye for an angel with a long lifespan!"
Indeed, 'not long ago,' only three years ago.
Hobert's answer was very deceptive, sounding as if he had discovered this secret after becoming an angel.
Klein breathed a slight sigh of relief because, before, at the Tarot Gathering, 'The Fool' and 'The World' had more than once engaged in 'double act' conversations.
Even if Hobert guessed that Klein was talking to himself for some purpose after learning that Klein was 'The Fool,'
it was still different to guess it later than knowing it at the time.
If Hobert had known it at the time, Klein would have felt extremely embarrassed.
But if Hobert guessed it later, Klein's embarrassment was still within an acceptable range.
Klein then thought, "Didn't you suspect at the time that 'The Fool' could read simplified Chinese?"
Hobert vaguely replied, "I thought it was just the mystical world."
Klein breathed a sigh of relief, not continuing to explore this embarrassing question, but jumping to another topic: "I have no objection to the plan you just mentioned, but there is one thing I am not sure about."
At this time, the waiter began to serve the dishes, and Hobert picked up his chopsticks: "Which part?"
"The 'Fooling' part." Klein said, "The range I can 'Fool' is limited, and 'Fooling' involving gods like this may take some time to complete."
He also very much wanted to complete Hobert's plan, because it could not only rescue Roselle but also basically complete the advancement ritual.
After all, this process would 'Fool' fate, history, and reality, which was much more comprehensive than the preparations made by Antigonus when accommodating the Uniqueness.
Hobert was chewing the dish in his mouth, but thinking about another thing: I only realized today that the 'Creeping Hunger' is complete, so Klein can use some of the authority of the True God level with the help of 'Creeping Hunger' when he is in Sequence 1, but I have to be after I become the King of Angels.
Then he thought: Klein's current 'Fooling' ability is a bit like the 'Shadow' ability I currently possess, which is a low-profile version of the 'Shadow' ability compared to the real 'Black Emperor'.
Hobert thought for a moment before saying: "Theoretically, there should be no problem. I will help you buy time then.
"Well... let's try it first. If it doesn't work, we'll talk about it after you become a god."
Anyway, there is more than one chance.
Klein nodded: "Okay, when are we going?"
"If there's nothing else, let's go after we finish eating."
"No problem."
The two clinked glasses again and took a few gulps.
Then they ate and started talking about new topics.
Klein said: "I plan to advance as soon as possible."
Hobert nodded: "Amon has obtained the Uniqueness and a Sequence 1 characteristic of the 'Door' pathway. Before he becomes a 'Dual Pathway True God', we had better complete the advancement.
"Relatively speaking, my situation is a little better. How is your situation?"
Hobert is already the King of Angels who has accommodated the Uniqueness, and he feels that he is 'getting along' with the Uniqueness fairly well. Currently, he only needs to wait for the 'Prince of Abolition' potion to be completely digested before he can find a good opportunity to advance.
And the digestion of the 'Prince of Abolition' potion has reached the final stage, and the ritual has been planned all the time.
Currently, all nine mausoleums have been completed and connected.
As for the other parts of the ritual: having its own kingdom, associating its name with the title of emperor, becoming common sense for the people, and, it is also necessary to establish a set of strict and complex rules that violate normal circumstances, including architectural style.
First of all, Hobert already has his own kingdom, which is relatively the easiest to achieve.
As for associating his name with the title of emperor, Hobert has been doing this all the time. One of the political tasks he gave to the grass-roots cadres is to publicize the deeds of the king.
Now Hobert being the king is already common sense in the Atlantis Kingdom.
When necessary, just change the title of 'King' to 'Emperor'. George III did just that.
Then there is a set of strict and complex rules that violate normal circumstances. The land distribution, planned economy, state-owned assets, etc. that Hobert has been carrying out are all preparing for this step.
The political and economic system of the Atlantis Kingdom is different from any other kingdom in the world. This is the abstract meaning of 'rules that violate normal circumstances'.
As for the architectural style, needless to say, Hobert has completely given a new architectural culture.
As long as the potion is well digested, Hobert can immediately make the final preparations for advancement, so he came to Klein today to talk about saving 'Old Huang'.
If everything goes well, he will then go to talk to the Genie, and basically all the preparations will be complete.
"My condition is not bad." Klein said, "There is no problem in advancing immediately."
He was not bragging about this. Hobert spent a year without completely digesting the potion, but he digested it in advance.
Under normal circumstances, Sequence 1 potions are difficult to digest, and it is normal to digest them for more than ten years.
Hobert was able to digest it so quickly because he happened to catch up with the process of building the country. The political, cognitive, and economic system on this continent was completely subverted by him, which had such an effect.
"But the problem is, Amon will definitely hinder my advancement." Klein said his concerns: "Adam must also be on Amon's side."
Hobert "hmm"ed: "Fortunately, we also have some allies. The Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother should be firmly on our side.
"They are enough to block Amon. There should also be some other opponents popping up at that time, but other gods will also begin to take sides spontaneously.
"I think, the orthodox gods should all support you to become 'Lord of the Mysteries'."
At least the Lord of Storms, the Eternal Blazing Sun, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom will definitely support Klein.
Klein took a deep breath: "One more thing, I feel that the divinity in my body is affecting some of my thoughts and judgments.
"If I rush to become a god, I don't know if it will cause some uncontrollable consequences."
Hobert smiled helplessly: "I can try to use the 'Bell of Order' to help you stabilize your state, but I'm not sure how much it will help."
After all, Klein's advancement is the main arrangement for the resurrection of 'Celestial Worthy'.
Klein looked at the braised eggplant in front of him and pondered for a while before saying: "Even if there are concerns, we must advance as soon as possible."
Otherwise, if Amon is given enough time, and his state is stable enough, if he sends a Sequence 1 level avatar to guard the ruins of the 'Nation of the Evernight', it will be very passive.
Hobert took a deep breath: "Come to me again before deciding to advance, and I'll see if I can strengthen your human nature."
"Okay." Klein paused, then continued to sigh: "If there were no such troublesome things as advancement, how wonderful it would be for two friends to get together and have a drink."
Hobert held his wine glass and looked at the square over there: "Especially in the evening, it's too suitable for skewers there."
"Hahaha." Klein also picked up his wine glass: "I'll arrange it in a few days."
The two first clinked glasses, and Hobert smiled: "If our operation is successful, let's have some skewers to welcome Roselle back."
"No problem."
After eating and drinking enough, and making preparations, Hobert first entered the 'Nation of Disorder' and contacted Bernadette, asking her to take the 'Pale Death' to seal her father's island and wait for further instructions.
Then Klein also entered the 'Creeping Hunger'.
"The Creator" and "The Fool" went online.
...
Bernadette, dressed as a captain, was a little excited after receiving the oracle from 'The Creator'. She didn't expect that it hadn't been long before 'The Creator' was going to help her father solve the corruption problem!
So she immediately took the 'Pale Death' and went to the island where her father was sealed again.
Because she had been there once before, it was very easy to come to the edge of the island this time.
Then, Bernadette felt that she was being watched by a certain existence... no, multiple existences?
While she was considering who else besides 'The Creator' was paying attention here, she received instructions from 'The Creator' again: to lift Roselle's seal.
Bernadette respectfully agreed. In her opinion, 'The Creator' must be able to notice the attention of other existences. Since 'The Creator' did not remind her of any danger, then there should be no danger.
Immediately afterwards, Bernadette actually felt a little nervous, as if she was performing something she was not very proficient in in front of many people.
She took a deep breath, stabilized her mind, turned into a stream of information, and flew quickly from mid-air to the mausoleum.
After confirming that this island had not changed like last time, Bernadette 'drilled' into the inner mausoleum.
As soon as she entered the mausoleum, Bernadette once again felt a surging 'new life' force rushing towards her, but that force disappeared immediately after it appeared, and should have been resolved by 'The Creator'.
On the high platform, a black figure was sleeping.
Roselle's sleeping did not mean that the corruption disappeared. The corruption in his body would still cause deep red cracks to appear on his body, but after these cracks expanded to a certain extent, the seal established with the 'Pale Death' would take effect, and these deep red cracks would gradually close.
Bernadette stared at Roselle on the huge iron chair for a few seconds before she seemed to suddenly come back to her senses, and looked at the air again, confirming that those existences were still watching here.
She clenched her left hand slightly, and took out the pale metal mask with her other hand and put it on.
In an instant, Bernadette no longer had the aura of any living person.
Immediately afterwards, a layer of white light appeared around the black figure. This layer of light seemed to absorb all the aura of life in the entire mausoleum, leaving only death.
This layer of light, under Bernadette's control, suddenly faded and disappeared within a second or two.
The black figure sitting on the tall iron chair woke up, yawned as if, and then saw Bernadette not far away.
Bernadette immediately called out: "Dad!"
The black figure was stunned for a moment before he came back to his senses: "Bernadette, ha, it's great to see you, you are already a big shot in the mystical world! You can come to save your poor old father."
Although Bernadette's eyes were a little red, she cautiously did not approach: "Dad, have you forgotten? We just met more than a month ago."
Roselle sat there motionless for three or four seconds before suddenly slapping the armrest: "I remember, your Uncle Hobert promised to come and save me!"
...
At this time, Hobert in the 'Nation of Disorder' was about to send the Beyonder characteristic of 'Knowledge Emperor' to the real world, and almost dropped the Beyonder characteristic into the pool in front of him after hearing the words "Uncle Hobert".
Klein in the 'Creeping Hunger' was trying hard to hold back his laughter.
"Cough cough." Hobert cleared his throat and continued to send the Beyonder characteristic to Roselle's mausoleum.
...
Bernadette also smiled awkwardly when she heard this.
At this time, a force suddenly sent her from the high platform to the entrance of the mausoleum.
Bernadette saw that a small ball of illusory light appeared on the high platform. Her spirituality realized that it was the Beyonder characteristic of 'Knowledge Emperor'.
She did not know the specific plan of "rescuing Roselle", but when she saw this ball of light, she suddenly felt that the hope of successful rescue seemed not small.
After all, even such high-level Beyonder characteristics were used.
At this time, the deep red cracks on Roselle's body began to crack again, and rays of moonlight shone out.
He tightly grasped the armrest of the iron chair, fighting against those cracks.
At the same time, a middle-aged man with chestnut hair and two delicate mustaches appeared next to the Beyonder characteristic of 'Knowledge Emperor'. It was Roselle during the 'Knowledge Emperor' period.
However, his eyes were blank, his expression was dull, and he was a historical projection.
This historical projection took the Beyonder characteristic of 'Knowledge Emperor' and swallowed it in one gulp. Suddenly, his eyes seemed to have some brilliance, and his expression seemed to have some subtle changes.
At this time, the moonlight in Roselle's body sitting on the iron throne became brighter and brighter, shining together on this historical projection, intending to pollute this historical projection as well.
Dong~
A melodious and distant bell suddenly rang in the mausoleum, echoing continuously in the tomb chamber, making everything in the tomb chamber very peaceful.
The moonlight projected from Roselle's body suddenly became dim, and the deep red cracks on his body gradually closed at this moment.
For the real world, the corruption of the Outer Deities is the existence that destroys order.
Bernadette was intoxicated in the bell for a second or two before she looked up and saw that the majestic figure of 'The Creator' appeared on the top of the mausoleum. He was hitting a seemingly very ancient and huge bronze bell.
Dong~
As the second bell rang, the deep red cracks on Roselle's body completely closed.
He slumped in the chair and breathed heavily, but now there was no time for him to rest. The mysterious and distant image of The Fool suddenly appeared on the top of the mausoleum.
Dang dang dang~
He tapped the armrest of the seat three times, and surging power poured into the real world, establishing a subtle connection between Roselle's shadow and his historical projection.
Because the Beyonder characteristics within the historical projection were highly compatible with Roselle himself, the "grafting" process was easily completed.
Then came the most crucial step. The entire space on the high platform suddenly became illusory. The shadow's facial features appeared, followed by auburn hair and a neat little mustache.
Soon, Roselle, sitting on the iron chair, was adorned in ornate Intis-style noble attire, his appearance and clothing identical to the historical projection.
Klein was "fooling" history, "fooling" reality, "fooling" truth and falsehood, gradually blurring the line between the real Roselle and the historical projection.
The more Klein "fooled," the more strained he became. At this moment, Hobert opportunely used his "magnify" ability, and Klein immediately felt his power increase, granting him continued strength.
Roselle's figure on the iron chair gradually became illusory, while the Roselle's historical projection, his eyes gradually gained brilliance.
After a full seven or eight seconds of "fooling," Roselle on the iron chair completely disappeared, leaving behind only a faintly trembling crimson moon.
This red moon, aside from being a bit small and trembling erratically, was no different from the moon in the night sky.
Its appearance within a mausoleum gave one a sudden, intensely surreal feeling.
At the same time, Roselle, opposite the iron chair, became very agile in movement and expression. He raised his hand, feeling his condition: "Heh, it's been a long time since I felt this relaxed."
From this moment on, truth and falsehood were "fooled," and Roselle's projection became the real Roselle.
History and reality were "fooled," and Roselle reverted to the time before he had consumed the "Black Emperor" potion, remaining at the "Knowledge Emperor" level.
Roselle turned his head to look at Bernadette below the high platform, a grin spreading across his face.
Bernadette, whose vision was already obscured by tears, suddenly noticed a Blink of red moonlight in her father's eyes.
This made her somewhat surprised and worried.
The corruption on Roselle had not been completely removed; it would take Hobert or Klein becoming a Great Old One to completely eliminate it.
But there was no time to ask, because the red moon on the iron chair was trembling more and more violently, clearly indicating that the chimes could only suppress it for a dozen seconds.
Roselle was taken aback, then immediately transformed into a torrent of knowledge, appearing next to Bernadette.
He was well aware that he couldn't solve such a problem.
At this moment, the "Creator" leaped down from mid-air, wielding a golden and orange scepter in his right hand and a black longsword in his left.
The "Creator" strode forward, the scepter in his hand transforming into a twilight-colored shield. Arriving before the iron chair, He pierced the crimson moon on the seat with the black longsword.
Bang~
The moon exploded like a balloon, its light cascading outwards.
The "Creator's" shield suddenly enlarged, emitting dazzling sunlight. The moonlight was blocked by the sunlight and the shield, failing to affect Roselle and Bernadette behind the "Creator."
However, the bricks illuminated by the moonlight suddenly grew legs and arms, jumping down from the walls and foolishly attacking Hobert.
Even the huge stone pillars illuminated by the moonlight suddenly moved, emitting a blood-red light, swinging themselves to smash the shield in the "Creator's" hand.
Opposite the "Creator," the iron chair suddenly deformed, displaying an attacking posture, charging towards Hobert like a steel behemoth, its momentum terrifying due to its size.
But in the next second, all the stone pillars, bricks, and the chair stood motionless, like puppets with severed strings.
In that instant, they all became the "Fool's" marionettes.
Immediately afterwards, the water column turned and once again supported the dome, and the bricks pieced themselves together, reforming into a wall.
In the dimness, a streak of red rapidly surged along the illusory "spirit body threads" towards the top of the mausoleum, towards the mysterious and distant "Fool."
The "Fool" immediately severed the connection, and the blood-red corruption was also cut off.
The "Creator's" shield transformed back into the shape of a scepter, emitting a dazzling light. The temperature in the mausoleum immediately rose, and the bricks, stone pillars, and iron chair that had been illuminated by the moonlight burned with golden flames.
These things regained life, but were quickly burned to ashes by the golden flames.
Within their "bellies," there was a small ball of crimson moonlight. Under the strong light, they lost their place to "reside" and were ultimately scattered by the light, reduced to nothing.
Within the barrier, any Outer God's power was no match for the combined efforts of the "Creator" and the "Fool."
However, one had to be wary of the Outer Deities' corruption. the corruption were of very high level, completely mismatched with the power they displayed.
Like the moonlight in the mausoleum, although it seemed to have disappeared, the corruption remained, only weaker.
Because the "Black Emperor" in this mausoleum had "disappeared," it no longer had any mystical function. Coupled with the fact that most of the walls and stone pillars had been destroyed, and most of the high platform had been burned away,
the mausoleum began to collapse.
Roselle raised his hand and said, "Thank you both."
Then he turned to signal Bernadette to leave immediately, but just as Bernadette was about to transform into a torrent of information, she noticed her father turn back and stride towards the door of the mausoleum.
Bernadette seemed to understand something, and didn't rush to leave, quietly following behind her father.
Roselle reached out and forcefully pushed open the door.
Whoosh~
Because the interior of the mausoleum was burning and in a state of severe oxygen deprivation, air rushed in through the door crack, creating a whistling sound like a strong wind.
Roselle pushed open a large crack in the door, then stepped out from inside, looking at the tall trees in front of him, as well as the mutated or Beyonder creatures in the jungle. He laughed heartily twice.
At this moment, five figures ran out of the jungle: the elderly Edwards and Benjamin, the young Green, and the middle-aged William and Poli.
The five knights immediately knelt on one knee, addressing him as "Your Majesty."
Seeing them, Roselle was initially excited, but after clearly seeing their condition, he understood what was happening: "You... you are all loyal and brave knights! Reliable companions!"
He smiled wryly with some helplessness: "However, after experiencing some things, I suddenly realized that human power is ultimately limited, and some things always feel powerless!"
"Wait here for a while and help me govern this island! After I've made preparations outside, I'll take you out."
He took a deep breath: "Be sure to guard this place well, be sure to protect yourselves. This is our secret base!"
The five knights immediately replied, "Yes, Your Majesty."
Roselle raised both hands high: "People of Intis, your emperor has returned!! The old era is over, and a new era is about to begin!"
The mountain behind Roselle collapsed, as if proclaiming his rebirth.
