chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 738 A Normal Tarot Meeting
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Roselle glanced at his "Five Knights" again, then waved his hand abruptly, turning into a torrent of information with Bernadette and leaving.
They were about to leave the island when they encountered a formless mass of light, the "Hidden Sage" who sensed the emergence of a new "Knowledge Emperor." It was composed of a stream of complex information, constantly surging in mid-air.
Roselle grinned: "Are you here to deliver the Uniqueness?"
At this moment, the gazes of the "Creator" and the "Fool" turned back to the island one after another.
Bang~
The "Hidden Sage" scrutinized Roselle, then the light on its body suddenly exploded, rapidly dimming and disappearing, leaving before the "Creator" and the "Fool" could take action.
Roselle resisted the urge to put his hands on his hips: "Haha, it feels so good to have a backer! I used to have to go around Him!"
Then, the father and daughter immediately left and arrived at Raxia Island, located in the central part of the Fog Sea.
This was a tropical island with a small city. Bernadette was the ruler of the entire archipelago.
On the other side of the city was a small palace, the Emerald Palace, Bernadette's headquarters as one of the Pirate Kings.
Roselle, with his hands behind his back, strode into the palace as if returning to his own home.
Because Roselle's portrait hung in the Emerald Palace, Bernadette's subordinates and servants immediately recognized who it was, and they rushed to kneel: "Your Majesty!"
Roselle nodded grandly and walked all the way to the main hall, discovering that the structure here was a miniature version of White Maple Palace.
This made Him sigh for a long time. After pausing in the main hall for a while, He smiled and said to Bernadette: "Child, at that time I knew I was a huge source of danger, so I had to let you leave. I hope you don't..."
"I know," Bernadette smiled. "I understand everything."
Roselle looked at his daughter and smiled: "What a beautiful and considerate princess. I wonder what lucky dog will be favored by you."
Bernadette's smile became more sincere, as if she had returned to the days in White Maple Palace, when the father and daughter had casual conversations.
Her father only said some crude but very reasonable words in front of her.
Thinking of this, Bernadette could no longer restrain herself, took two quick steps and embraced her father.
She had waited too long for this hug, so long that she had forgotten whether it had been decades or centuries.
Roselle was immediately a little flustered, but soon He calmed down: "I'm back, I'm back."
After embracing for a long time, the father and daughter sat down and continued talking.
Roselle said seriously first: "The corruption on me is still very serious. Give me a separate courtyard and try not to come..."
But after seeing his daughter's expression, He immediately changed his words: "I mean, we can have dinner together every half month."
Seeing his daughter nod, the old father secretly breathed a sigh of relief and quickly changed the subject: "What is the situation in various countries now?"
"Um... I knew it, these idiots will definitely change back to the Republic..."
"What, Intis was defeated in the World War? What about the hegemony of the past? Are they really capable?"
"The Southern Continent can also have a powerful country? A what? Atlantis? Heh."
"Ah, nothing, I'm just sighing that the name is very, very novel..."
"If I'm not mistaken, this should be the country established by Hobert, right? Don't ask why, I just know..."
"Well, if I haven't guessed wrong, the 'Creator' should have a powerful ally!"
"Yes, it's the 'Fool'!"
After roughly learning about the current international situation, Roselle said, "Get ready."
Bernadette was stunned: "Prepare for what?"
"Of course, prepare to return to White Maple Palace," Roselle smiled. "Intis will definitely be defeated miserably in this war in the Southern Continent!"
...
The capital of the Balam Empire, Cevas.
A middle-aged man dressed in Balam civilian clothes was walking quickly on an empty street in the eastern part of the city.
After looking around and seeing no one, he quickly opened a door on the side of the road, flashed in, and then quickly closed the door.
It was daytime, but the inside of the door was pitch black, and nothing could be seen. Only a blurry figure could be seen near the wall on the inside.
"Has the location been confirmed?" the figure asked.
"Confirmed," the middle-aged man said. "It's at the Death Altar outside the city."
That was a huge altar, specially used to worship the Underworld Emperor.
The reason it was so large was because a large number of slaves were slaughtered every year to please the Underworld Emperor, so a huge venue was needed.
The middle-aged man asked again, "When will we act?"
"Tomorrow afternoon, at three o'clock."
"Why at this time?"
The blurry figure said: "According to our continuous tracking of the King of Atlantis and the two Queens, we have found that they rarely show up or handle affairs at three o'clock on Monday afternoons.
After further observation and investigation, we have determined that they are unlikely to appear during this time period, which is an opportunity for us."
The middle-aged man asked, "Where did they go?"
"I don't know," the blurry figure said. "We have used many methods of divination, but we have not divined any clues."
Then the figure suddenly smiled: "You ask too many questions! You should have already betrayed us, right?"
The middle-aged man's eyes narrowed, and just as he was about to escape, he found that his vitality was rapidly draining away. The originally pitch-black room was being corroded by a pale white, receding little by little.
The angel of the Balam Empire has arrived!
At this time, the blurry figure instantly became illusory and disappeared before the pale white completely occupied the room.
The middle-aged man seemed to realize something, turned around and ran outside, shouting something.
But soon he was surprised to find that his voice was hoarse and unpleasant, more like the cry of a monster!
The next second he fell to the ground and lost his life.
At this time, a cold figure entered the room, and after just looking at the corpse on the ground, completed the process of spirit mediumship: "Monday afternoon..."
...
After Hobert rescued Roselle, he returned to the Southern Continent and learned about the battle situation.
That afternoon, he went to Longtail Island again to participate in the Tarot Gathering with Fors.
The two of them lay on the bed as usual, chatting while waiting for the start of the Tarot Gathering.
Fors said: "The Abraham family suddenly obtained a large number of Beyonder characteristics. According to my observation, there are 2 'Key of Stars', 3 'Traveler', and many demigod-level and middle-sequence Beyonder characteristics.
Teacher Dorian prayed to Mr. Fool, asking where these Beyonder characteristics came from.
Mr. Fool responded that it was the relics of Mr. 'Door'."
Hobert smiled: "I roughly know about this matter."
So he told Fors about the process of Amon becoming a god, picking out the parts that could be said.
For Fors, Amon was the enemy, and his becoming a god was definitely not a good thing.
Finally, Hobert said: "Those characteristics should have been sent by Amon and shattered by Him."
This surprised Fors a little: "He... I mean, why did He do this?"
"Maybe He also admires Mr. 'Door'," Hobert said seriously. "Being sealed for one or two thousand years, fighting against corruption and madness day and night.
Finally returned to the real world, but when He realized that he had brought the danger back to his hometown, he resolutely gave up everything."
Fors looked at the ceiling for a long time without speaking: "It's very tragic."
"Yes," Hobert said meaningfully. "This is the Beyonder world!"
Then he asked: "Dorian didn't say he wanted to give you one or two 'Key of Stars' Beyonder characteristics?"
Fors shook her head with a smile: "That's the Abraham family's, not his own. He promised that after I digest the potion, he will help me advance to 'Wanderer'."
Hobert sneered: "Tch, who cares?
"I have to tell Dorian sometime, if you can't become a King of Angels, then the Abraham family shouldn't even think about having an angel."
Fors opened her mouth: "This... this is not very good."
Hobert said again: "This is the Beyonder world."
However, immediately afterwards he was wondering how to get two Sequence 1 'Writer' Beyonder characteristics from Adam.
It can't be that between the two Queens, one is a King of Angels, and the other is an ordinary angel, right?
Fortunately, he also thought that after Adam became a god, he could 'imagine' two Sequence 1 characteristics and separate two 'Author' characteristics from his body. This was an opportunity.
When the time was right, he could kill the two 'Authors', or find something suitable to trade with Adam.
Just as he was thinking about this, the vision of the two people was covered by gray fog. This week's Tarot Gathering began.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Fool." "Justice" Audrey's greeting has become a symbol of the Tarot Gathering.
After the greeting session, "The Fool" Klein slowly said: "Let's begin."
"The Hermit" Cattleya first said to "The Hanged Man" Alger: "I would like to ask you to help me investigate a pirate imprisoned on Pasu Island in the 'Chasm of Storms'."
Alger smiled: "I have now left the Church of the Lord of Storms and joined the Sea God Church."
The other members, including Cattleya, were stunned. Then they realized that this was definitely a major event in the orthodox churches!
"The Star" Leonard frowned: "Why haven't I heard of this?"
The Evernight Goddess Church has a close cooperative relationship with the Church of the Lord of Storms. Under normal circumstances, the betrayal or dismissal of a demigod or a confidential bishop of the Church of the Lord of Storms must be notified.
"You..." "The Moon" Emlyn guessed: "You didn't discover some terrible secret, so you..."
"No, no," Alger quickly explained.
Then he looked at "The Fool" at the head of the bronze table with a very respectful gaze, before saying to everyone: "Mr. Fool came forward to make a compromise and transaction with the Lord of Storms. The Church of the Lord of Storms will not pursue my defection, but I can no longer show myself in my true form."
The other members slowly nodded, realizing that this must be a high-level transaction.
Only "The Fool" behind the gray fog was a little confused: I didn't, I just asked you to wear a mask to become the Pope of the Sea God Church. When did I make a transaction with the Lord of Storms?
Then he thought: Regarding this point, I am actually quite surprised. Originally, I thought that the Church of the Lord of Storms would at least send someone to make things difficult, right? But they didn't even issue an arrest warrant. What is their purpose?
Cattleya said: "That's a pity."
The Tarot Gathering has lost resources related to the Church of the Lord of Storms. For other members, it doesn't matter much, but for this Pirate Admiral, the hidden king, it will definitely have some impact.
At this time, "The Emperor" Hobert suddenly asked Alger: "Do you have any thoughts of jumping to an adjacent pathway?"
Alger stood up excitedly: "I... I..."
But he paused slightly and realized that he was no longer the confidential bishop of the Church of the Lord of Storms, so after swallowing a mouthful of saliva, he looked at "The Fool" at the head.
The other members felt that they seemed to have gotten used to it. The clues about becoming an angel provided by Hobert seemed commonplace, and it was difficult to excite them except for the person involved.
At this time, "The Fool" Klein said in a solemn tone: "If you cannot repay the reward at this level, you can pray to me."
Anyway, he already owed Hobert two Sequence 1 characteristics, and it didn't matter to owe another Sequence 2 characteristic.
When drinking before, Hobert said that the action to rescue Roselle, as well as the several helps provided by "The Fool" before, were equivalent to repaying a Sequence 1 level characteristic.
But Klein didn't agree. He felt that he should do his part in rescuing Roselle, and he also completed the ritual, so it shouldn't be counted as a reward.
Alger took a deep breath: "Praise Mr. Fool!"
The meaning of "The Fool" was very clear: You can agree, but you must obtain this Beyonder characteristic with the principle of equivalent exchange.
Everyone sighed: The alliance between Mr. Fool and the "Creator" is really very close! Even between two organizations with the best relationship, I have never heard of them helping each other cultivate an angel.
Alger said to "The Emperor" again: "I am willing to jump to other pathways. May I ask what pathway will I jump to? And what price should I pay?"
Hobert smiled: "'The Hanged Man' pathway!"
What he was talking about was the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact "0-74" Fallen Mask currently in his possession. This Sealed Artifact was a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact seized from the Feysac Empire during the South Balam civil war.
Because of the considerable negative effects, the "Creator" rarely bestowed it on his believers.
Giving it to Alger can be considered making the best use of it.
Currently, Hobert has already transferred 4 Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts, namely "0-73" Death Domain, which may be traded with the Evernight Goddess Church; "0-70" Creation Bracelet, which was traded with the Sanguine; "0-82" Crystal Light Screen, which was traded with "The Hermit" Cattleya; and "0-74" Fallen Mask, which was traded with "The Hanged Man" Alger today.
Audrey, sitting opposite Alger, smiled: "Congratulations, Mr. Hanged Man.
"This pathway is your code name."
She probably knew that Hobert had most likely obtained the corresponding characteristics or Sealed Artifacts before initiating the transaction.
Alger then sat down and smiled: "Thank you."
Klein, behind the gray fog, sighed: Choosing a code name back then was truly a "choice of fate." I didn't expect that Alger's seemingly casual choice of the "Hanged Man" code name would actually come true at this time!
At this moment, Alger asked "Emperor" with some concern, "After I switch to the 'Hanged Man' pathway, I wonder if I will be corrupted by the 'True Creator'?"
"As long as you haven't experienced the 'Listener' level, the impact won't be significant," Hobert replied. "Especially at the angel level, as long as you don't actively pray to the 'True Creator,' you will hardly be affected."
"Even if there is any influence, "The Fool" can easily help block it.
Alger smiled sincerely, "That's good then."
"As for the reward," Hobert thought for a moment, "I don't seem to have any needs right now. Let's talk about it when I do."
He already has a large group of demigods under his command, so he doesn't really need Alger's help.
Alger immediately said, "Okay, if you have any needs, you can always come to me."
After this transaction ended, Audrey and "Magician" Fors both looked at "Sun" Derrick.
Derrick felt a little uncomfortable being stared at. "Wha... what's wrong?"
Fors smiled and said, "I look forward to the day when Mr. Emperor can suddenly ask you: Do you have any thoughts of jumping to an adjacent pathway?"
That way, the Tarot Club could have "all members as angels" in the future.
The other members didn't quite understand what "Magician" meant, but Klein behind the gray fog immediately understood: Hobert's two Queens also have hope of advancing to angels? This... when did angels become so worthless?
At this time, Leonard asked "Emperor," "I heard that in the Southern Continent battlefield, the air forces of the Northern Continent countries were almost completely wiped out, and only one-tenth of the more than four thousand airships returned?"
"Yes," Hobert gave a definite answer?
Leonard asked again, "How did you do it?"
"How else could we do it?" Emlyn smiled. "Of course, angels took action. It's already very good that one-tenth could fly back."
Leonard said seriously, "As far as I know, there was no confrontation at the angel level at that time."
Both sides seem to be very cautious about confrontations at the angel level. At most, angels just meet each other and won't immediately clash.
Both sides are very clear that in this angel-level confrontation, it is impossible to end without the death of two or three angels.
So, before they have a certain degree of certainty, both sides are relatively restrained.
Overall, Atlantis's strength is dominant, but Hobert's main concern is still with the Balam Empire. He will launch a decisive battle at ease after he solves the hidden dangers of the Balam Empire.
The Paz Kingdom is seeking allies everywhere, striving to hold back Atlantis's angels in the decisive battle, and then get a chance to negotiate.
Emlyn heard this and said, "Then... how did you do it?"
"We invented a new type of weapon," Hobert explained with a smile. "In front of that new weapon, airships are completely like slow-moving targets!
"From now on, airships will withdraw from the army's ranks, and this type of soldier will decline as a result."
The other members were all stunned and realized the unusual nature of this matter.
Leonard asked again, "Is it convenient to reveal what kind of weapon it is?"
"Anti-aircraft guns," Hobert replied. "There's nothing to hide."
Because after the airships are gone, the anti-aircraft guns will temporarily have no use.
Klein behind the gray fog pondered for a moment and sighed: As Hobert said, in front of anti-aircraft guns, airships are really like moving targets. Well, this is an advantage that only transmigrators have.
Seeing that the other members couldn't imagine the scene, Hobert, after consulting Mr. Fool, manifested the situation on the battlefield at that time.
The sound of "Bang bang bang bang bang" resounded in the Giant Palace, and everyone gradually opened their mouths wide, seeing the vulnerability of airships in front of anti-aircraft guns.
At that time, Hobert watched the entire war from beginning to end from a distance. He only showed everyone a few wonderful scenes of anti-aircraft guns wreaking havoc.
After watching it, Emlyn sighed, "All the air forces can be cut."
"No," Hobert said seriously. "A new type of air force is about to appear. We have already developed an electric airplane."
The most surprised was Klein, but at this time he could very smoothly transfer his surprise to "World": "Airplane!"
Hobert explained, "It's a remote-controlled airplane, not a manned airplane."
With the current motor power, it is not enough to drive a manned airplane.
"World" nodded: "In other words, you directly jumped to the drone stage?"
"Not that advanced," Hobert explained again. "Without signal transmission relay, the airplane's combat radius is not large, and it relies on visual observation to strike the enemy."
So, it is also necessary to specially develop telescopes for "airplane pilots" to use.
"World" said "Oh," and Klein could roughly imagine the scene.
Standing at the highest point, the air force wearing special telescopes, manipulating remote-controlled airplanes to do "suicide" attacks, blowing up the enemy's headquarters or difficult-to-capture bunkers.
Or, the current air force can act together with the ground forces. It is not clear whether they are still considered the air force or special road combat personnel?
Except for Fors, the other members were all in a state of confusion. This was the first time they had heard the word "airplane," and of course, they had no corresponding concept in their minds.
Fors, who is often on Longtail Island, occasionally goes to visit airplane test flights, so she basically understands what it is all about.
Seeing that "Emperor" didn't explain too much, everyone looked at "World" together, wondering why "World" knew so much about airplanes?
But they immediately associated it with the alliance between the "Creator" and "The Fool," and seemed to have found the corresponding answer.
After this topic ended, of course, they discussed the previous incident where all the doors around the world opened together, and the seals of all sealed items suddenly became ineffective.
Emlyn said, "Because it happened suddenly, many members of the church died to regain control of the sealed items."
Leonard, another official extraordinary, also followed up, "Many ordinary people were also affected, and the aftermath work has not yet ended."
"The most important thing is," Alger also joined the topic, "ordinary people have felt extraordinary power because of this. According to my observation, they generally believe that the world seems to be undergoing some kind of change.
"This sense of panic will take some time to eliminate."
He took a deep breath and finally concluded, "In short, the impact of this event is still fermenting."
Cattleya asked, "Why did this happen? Or rather, what event triggered this?"
Then she said, "I have received a lot of news, such as someone seeing a scarlet moon during the day that day, and there seemed to be a huge human figure on the moon.
"People who saw that figure basically went crazy or turned into monsters, but most Beyonders were only slightly affected.
"There was also a strange incident where all the people standing on an entire island suddenly fell down together."
Cattleya spread her hands and finally said, "There are many similar messages, but it seems that none of them have grasped the key point of the matter."
Dong dong dong~
Everyone was slightly stunned and looked together at the head of the bronze long table.
It was Mr. Fool knocking on the table.
Then the members were a little excited. This was similar to what they had imagined. This kind of event that happened all over the world must be a very high-level event.
Only existences at the level of Mr. Fool and the "Creator" can come into contact with it.
Seeing that everyone was looking at him, Klein said in a relaxed tone, "That was the anomaly caused by the return of Mr. 'Door'."
The other members were slightly stunned before revealing expressions of surprise one after another.
Alger took a deep breath: The ancestor of the Abraham family, who had been sealed for more than a thousand years, has returned! No wonder, no wonder! Is this a sign of the coming doomsday?
Cattleya first thought: Mr. "Door" has accommodated the Uniqueness, so he has a certain abstract quality. He represents all the doors in the world! Because he has returned, all the doors in the world opened at that moment.
Leonard tried to calm his surprise: This level of Beyonder... no, this level of god, his every move can completely trigger a world-class reaction!
Audrey recalled: I remember, Mr. "Door" seemed to be corrupted by something.
Fors, who didn't know the whole story, thought: I forgot to ask Hobert how Mr. "Door" fell.
While the other members all had their own ideas, Audrey raised her hand slightly and said, "Mr. Fool, Mr. 'Door' should have been corrupted by an Outer God, will his return have an impact on the real world?"
"The Fool" said in a profound voice, "He has fallen."
The other members were even more surprised. Before they had time to imagine who had caused Mr. "Door" to fall, they only heard Mr. Fool say again, "Amon became a god because of this."
Ah?
Everyone's brains were a little overloaded, and they looked at "The Fool" with some dazedness.
What does the fall of Mr. "Door" have to do with Amon?
No, no, there must be a relationship! After all, they are adjacent pathways.
But what is the relationship?
But Mr. Fool, as usual, only gave hints and did not make any explanations.
Just as everyone was feeling disappointed, they found that Mr. Fool's gaze was looking at "Emperor."
Hobert had to smile and say, "I do know some details about this matter."
The other members immediately understood what Mr. Fool meant: Let "Emperor" give you a detailed explanation.
So everyone looked at "Emperor" one after another.
In fact, normally, Mr. Fool would let "World" give everyone an explanation, but when he knew that Hobert was very clear about the relationship between "World" and "The Fool," he always felt that using this method again was too embarrassing.
"Where should I start?" Hobert thought for a moment before saying, "Let's start with Amon's godhood ritual.
"As far as I know, the godhood ritual of the Amon pathway is: to take his place in someone else's godhood ritual."
For a time, the reactions of the people were different.
Alger was first a little excited: I actually know a godhood ritual!
Although this godhood ritual has nothing to do with him, just knowing such high-level information is enough to make him excited.
Audrey was a little surprised, and then smiled and commented, "This is very in line with the consistent style of this pathway."
Leonard smiled on the surface, but said in his heart: This kind of godhood method is really disgusting!
Immediately afterwards, everyone suddenly felt enlightened and probably understood what was going on.
Hobert's subsequent explanation was not obstructed: "I think Amon has been planning this for a long time. After obtaining the last Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristic, he began to plan to let Mr. 'Door' return.
"I am not very clear about the specific process, but I have heard about the outline of the ritual. It is necessary to use one 'Bizarro Sorcerer,' one 'Parasite,' and one 'Secrets Sorcerer' as sacrifices before the corresponding seal can be opened.
"As for the seal of Mr. 'Door,' everyone should remember that it was the seal of the Evernight Goddess and the Lord of Storms.
"At the same time that Mr. 'Door' returned to the real world from the seal, the corruption on his body also entered the real world. The six gods decisively took action to stop the return of Mr. 'Door'..."
Emlyn was a little surprised and said, "The six gods!... Are you saying that the six gods stopped the return of Mr. 'Door' together?"
Hobert replied, "As far as I know, the six gods did take action, but they seemed unable to stop it... well, to be precise, they were unable to stop the corruption that came to the real world with Mr. 'Door'!"
Because the rank is higher than them.
Cattleya then asked, "Could it be that the corruption has... has already made the whole world fall?"
Although this conjecture was very shocking, causing the other members to couldn't help twitching the corners of their eyes, it seemed to make sense.
The corruption that even the six gods could not stop together is entirely possible to sweep the world without people knowing or noticing!
Everyone looked at each other, could it be that everyone has been corrupted?
But then everyone relaxed again, feeling that they should be scaring themselves, because with the protection of Mr. Fool, they should not be corrupted.
But the uncertainty about the "Above the Sequence" still made them a little panic.
"Don't think wildly, everyone," Hobert said. "Listen to me continue."
The other members breathed a slight sigh of relief upon hearing this.
"After Mr. 'Door' returned, he should have completed his godhood ritual," Hobert continued. "I am not very clear about the specific ritual.
"But Mr. 'Door,' who had taken all the Sequence 1 characteristics in advance and accommodated the Uniqueness, began his godhood process after returning to the real world.
"At this time, Amon took the place of 'Door,' completed his godhood ritual, and stopped the invasion of the Outer Deities.
"Just now, the Hermit said that people on an island fell down together. That was actually the reaction that Amon's godhood brought to this world.
"Not only falling down, but it seems that all normal things in the world at that time had 'errors,' such as being asleep, but the next second finding that they were ready to go out.
"Reactions like falling down are easy to detect, and there are many 'errors' that are difficult to detect that have not been noticed by everyone."
For a moment, everyone felt their minds go blank, with a sense of, "Is this still the world I know?"
The power of the gods was displayed so "wantonly" before everyone that they felt they had always underestimated the strength of the gods.
Seeing everyone's reaction, Hobert continued, "The great 'Creator' will announce this matter to us because He praises Mr. 'Door's actions.
"The 'Creator' said that Mr. 'Door', upon realizing he had brought danger back, voluntarily gave up his position, allowing Amon to replace him."
The gloom in everyone's hearts suddenly changed, feeling somewhat tragic, and their mood became very complicated for a time.
"Everyone," Hobert said with a smile, "this world is indeed cold, but there is a warm side to human nature."
In an instant, the pressure and alienation brought by the power of the gods gradually melted away. Everyone thought of Mr. Fool, who was willing to help the Tarot Club members, and then of the "Creator," who supported the establishment of a nation to protect the rights of ordinary people, and they were filled with emotion.
After more than ten seconds of silence in the hall, Alger suddenly asked "The Fool," "Honorable Mr. Fool, can I announce the matter regarding Verdu Garcia to everyone?"
"The Fool" slowly nodded.
Only then did Alger say, "Regarding Amon's plan, I do have some guesses.
"Previously, Mr. Fool had been asking me to pay close attention to a member of the Abraham family named Verdu Garcia. He did not convert to Mr. Fool's faith and was still researching how to free their ancestor from the seal.
"But before Mr. 'Door' returned to the real world, Verdu Garcia suddenly disappeared.
"I think this matter should be related to him… Hmm, I just thought, he might have been used. After all, he is only a Sequence 7, and it is impossible for him to hunt down three demigods."
Cattleya, who had rich mystical knowledge, nodded, "That's possible. Amon is likely hoping to use him to avoid some penalties for breaking the seal or something like that."
The information provided by Alger made the context of the matter clearer: Amon used Verdu Garcia, a member of the Abraham family, to rescue Mr. "Door" from the seal, and then replaced Mr. "Door" to become a god.
At the same time, everyone realized that Mr. Fool seemed to have been paying attention to this matter for a long time.
Of course, he had to pay attention! That was Amon, Mr. Fool's enemy!
In other words, Mr. Fool had already noticed Amon's plan through Verdu Garcia, but why didn't Mr. Fool disrupt Amon's plan?
Moreover, judging from "Emperor's" tone, the "Creator" was also just watching at the time and did not seem to stop it.
Or did Amon use some means to "deceive" the two gods? By the time they realized something was wrong, it was too late?
But everyone only dared to think about such questions in their hearts and did not dare to ask.
After a few seconds of silence in the hall, Leonard asked "Hermit" Cattleya, "Someone witnessed Emperor Roselle in the Fog Sea. Is this true?"
Leonard put it very euphemistically. In fact, the spies that Intis had placed on Raxia Island heard that someone in the Emerald Palace had witnessed Emperor Roselle!
Cattleya took a deep breath, "It's true."
Her expression was a little complicated, "I just received confirmation."
Moreover, "Queen Mystic" Bernadette specifically instructed in the letter: This matter does not need to be kept secret.
The meaning was to let her spread the news as reasonably as possible.
Cattleya had very complicated feelings about Emperor Roselle. Influenced by the "Queen Mystic," Emperor Roselle had always been her spiritual leader.
She also hoped that the Emperor would be resurrected so that the "Queen Mystic" could be in a better state.
However, after Emperor Roselle was really resurrected, Cattleya felt a sense of loss somewhere in her heart, as if she would no longer be able to receive the "Queen Mystic's" attention in the future.
Audrey also joined the conversation, "The Emperor is resurrected! Oh my god, another ancient figure is resurrected!"
Then she seemed to think of something, "Has the Emperor become the 'Black Emperor' again?"
But according to her observation and speculation, the "Creator" is the god of the "Black Emperor" pathway and now seems to be seeking to become the corresponding Great Old One.
"Not really," Cattleya rubbed her forehead and said, "I don't know the specific situation, but the Emperor is not the 'Black Emperor' now."
Everyone knew the characteristic of the "Black Emperor" being able to resurrect. Alger asked curiously, "Can the 'Black Emperor' resurrect as a god of another pathway or a 'High-Sequence' Beyonder?"
"The World" suddenly said, "No."
He said in his usual hoarse voice, "It was 'The Fool' and the 'Creator' who helped Roselle temporarily get rid of the Outer God's corruption."
Some reports from the Church of the Sea God made Klein realize that Roselle did not intend to hide his resurrection. There should be some plans in this.
His resurrection process should soon no longer be a secret.
Klein believed that if this guy had any plans, he would definitely borrow the names of "The Fool" and the "Creator" to boost his own momentum.
After hearing this, the other members fell silent again.
Emlyn almost immediately thought, "That makes sense!"
The members who were each thinking were slightly stunned. Cattleya was the first to react, "What makes sense?"
Emlyn said, "When Amon became a god, Mr. Fool and the 'Creator' were rescuing Roselle!"
Everyone suddenly understood: That's right, no wonder they couldn't stop Amon from becoming a god!
"The World" then exchanged a glance with "The Emperor": Should we explain?
At this time, Alger suddenly "discovered," "I remember that the one who corrupted Mr. 'Door' and corrupted the Emperor was the same Outer God, right?"
The other members also recalled this matter and all looked like "so that's how it is": This must be the plan of Mr. Fool and the "Creator"! They used Mr. 'Door' to return to the real world, and the Outer God's attention was all on Mr. 'Door' and Amon, taking the opportunity to rescue Emperor Roselle!
After saving Emperor Roselle! Mr. Fool and the "Creator" arrived at the location where Amon became a god, but it was too late to stop him, so they just watched for a while.
After seeing everyone's expressions, Hobert roughly guessed what they were thinking. He was a little dumbfounded and glanced at "The World": Forget it.
Sometimes the truth is not important.
After this topic ended, everyone discussed the current international situation for a few more sentences, and "The Fool" Klein announced the end of this Tarot Gathering.

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 739: The Power Projected on Earth by the Outer Gods

Immediately after the Tarot Club ended, Hobert heard many prayers coming from the "Nation of Disorder", and some prayers were directed straight at him.
After listening briefly, Hobert roughly understood what was going on. While the Tarot Club was in session, the Balam Empire had released some terrifying things.
It was said that currently, more than half of the people in the western part of the entire Balam Empire had either turned into monsters or died.
These terrifying things were attacking the western Balam Empire. After Medici arrived at the scene, he immediately reported the matter to the "Creator" and King Hobert through prayer.
Since he received no response, he exercised his "Supreme Military Decision-Making Authority" and ordered the soldiers in the eastern Balam Empire to withdraw immediately.
Although they tried their best to evacuate the civilians before the retreat, because Atlantis had not yet established effective rule there, the local people didn't take it too seriously.
Medici then ordered: Regardless of the local people, the Atlantis army should retreat as quickly as possible.
At the same time, Medici had designated the eastern Balam Empire as a "buffer zone". All the angels in the kingdom had rushed to provide support after hearing the news.
Hobert didn't expect the opponent to be so good at picking a time, choosing to launch an attack during the Tarot Club meeting.
Fors, who was beside him, saw Hobert's solemn expression and asked, "What's wrong?"
"The war in the Southern Continent has changed. I need to go there quickly." Hobert got out of bed and tidied his clothes.
"Be careful," Fors said.
"Okay." Hobert stepped out, entering the "Shadow of Order", and sent his substitute ahead to the Balam Empire.
...
More than an hour ago, east of Cevas, the capital of the Balam Empire, at the Death Altar.
Although it wasn't a day for sacrifice today, it was unusually heavily guarded, with many demigod-level Beyonders patrolling.
Suddenly, the sky darkened, and an ugly arm appeared in mid-air. The surface of the arm was covered with a layer of evil mucus, from which grew skulls, eyeballs with evil gazes, and tongues with fangs.
Many people who saw this scene immediately went mad or lost control and turned into monsters.
Many Beyonders turned into goats and rabbits. Around the solemn altar, flocks of sheep and a nest of rabbits suddenly appeared.
Creak~
Not far from the arm, an "Underworld Gate" opened. The death aura from the world of the undead immediately blocked the curses and evil gazes of the "Abomination" Suah.
A middle-aged man walked out of the "Underworld Gate". His eyes seemed to have turned into two clusters of pale white flames. All the eyeballs on Suah's arm burst, leaking some disgusting liquid.
The battle here gave all the residents of the city a bad feeling. They all came out of their homes and fled in the opposite direction.
In the very center of Cevas City was the massive Death Temple. At this moment, the "Pale Empress" Sia Palenque Eggers stood before the main hall's entrance, coldly watching the battle to the east, with no intention of going to support.
"There shouldn't be infighting between us," Trunsoest stepped forward, suddenly appearing not far from Sia.
Sia, with her Southern Continent features, said coldly, "The monsters whose seals were broken aren't rampaging in the Paz Kingdom, so of course you can speak so leisurely."
Trunsoest and Sia had a serious disagreement on how to use the batch of monsters sealed by the Underworld Emperor back then.
Sia hoped to use these monsters to force the Kingdom of Atlantis back to the negotiating table. They knew they were not opponents and no longer wanted to continue fighting.
Trunsoest, however, was intent on using these monsters for a sneak attack, to at least kill one or two Atlantis angels.
Ultimately, the two sides parted ways unhappily, but Trunsoest did not give up. He continuously sent people to infiltrate the high levels of the Balam Empire to find out how to open the Underworld Emperor's seal.
"How about this," Trunsoest said upon hearing this, "When the war ends, I will compensate you with double the number of citizens!"
Sia said coldly, "When the war ends, it's still uncertain whether you'll even be alive."
"You don't need to worry about that. I've already found a way out," Trunsoest said. "I'm different from you. If I fail, I can just leave the Southern Continent. If you fail, you'll have nothing.
"Do you see Suah over there? What if he has the help of an Outer God? Without his own power and base, he still has to obey my orders.
"He said solemnly, "Now we can only fight with all our might, consuming as much of the Kingdom of Atlantis's strength as possible. Even if we fail, we will still have a place to stay.
"If we are perfunctory now, after we fail, we will be like Suah, completely worthless."
Sia's expression was cold, as if she was thinking.
Trunsoest added, "You don't really think Hobert will solve the problem through negotiation, do you?"
Sia's eyes moved. After glancing at the eastern part of the city, she said, "We tried to stop the Paz Kingdom, but failed."
Trunsoest nodded, "That's right, you tried very hard to stop me."
He glanced inside the temple, "It's almost three o'clock. Can we begin?"
Sia was startled, "You know that the key to breaking the seal isn't at the Death Altar?"
"That's obvious," Trunsoest smiled. "The process by which we obtained this information was simply too easy!"
Sia said no more but waved her hand towards the temple. Several priests opened a hidden door behind the Death statue and entered one after another.
Trunsoest, standing at the temple entrance, looked at the very tall Underworld Emperor statue and suddenly sighed, "This reminds me of the time I fought with Salinger. Haha, this world has long forgotten us."
At this moment, the "Language of the Dead" echoed from inside the hidden door, sometimes high-pitched, sometimes melancholic.
Trunsoest asked, "Do you know what monster is sealed inside?"
"I know," Sia said. "They are the favored ones of three Outer Deities from the cosmos. They broke through the barrier at a certain opportunity and came to the real world.
"Because they all descended on the Southern Continent, they were all sealed in the Underworld by the Underworld Emperor."
"I remember now! There was a period when Outer Deities frequently projected their power into the real world. It was because of this that the Seven Deities entered the Astral World to resist the Outer Deities," Trunsoest cautioned. "However, I suggest releasing only one first. That should be enough to give the Kingdom of Atlantis a headache for a while.
"If all three are released, the Orthodox Deities are likely to intervene."
Sia nodded, "Okay!"
Trunsoest asked again, "Should we hide?"
"No need," Sia said coldly. "As long as we stand within the 'sight' of the Underworld Emperor statue, the monsters that come out of the Underworld will not actively attack us. However, the negative status they generate can still affect us."
The "Language of the Dead" in the hidden door suddenly stopped. Before the Death statue, a dim space suddenly appeared.
This space became deeper and deeper, as if it was connected to some unknown space somewhere.
Suddenly, in the darkness, an eye with blue pupils appeared. Only one eye!
It looked at Trunsoest and the "Pale Empress" and blinked. A third eye immediately appeared between Trunsoest's two eyes.
Trunsoest reached out and casually grabbed at his face, as if grabbing a piece of dirt that had accidentally fallen on him. The eye that had grown between his two eyes was already in his hand.
Looking at the blinking eye, Trunsoest said, "What strange authority and ability!"
At this moment, another eye with blue pupils grew on his cheek.
The "Pale Empress" beside him suddenly said, "I forgot to tell you, you can't look directly at that eye. Otherwise, even if you are a King of Angels, you will gradually be affected by the things that eye makes you see and begin to believe in an Outer God called the 'High-Dimensional Overseer'."
Trunsoest glanced at the "Pale Empress." This emperor of the Balam Empire was indeed keeping her eyes closed.
So Trunsoest also closed his eyes, but found that he could still see the scene before him, the vision coming from the eye on his cheek.
He saw that the eye in the Underworld completely emerged from the deep space. It completely ignored the Archangel and King of Angels before it and immediately jumped to the outside world.
At the same time, the residents of the entire Cevas City and Beyonders below the demigod level suddenly stopped in their tracks.
They all seemed to see something incredibly beautiful at once, revealing satisfied smiles.
The next second, their left eyes all turned into blue pupils, and then they began to move, going to find other people to look at. As long as someone looked into their eyes, their left eye would also immediately turn a seductive blue.
The demigods within Cevas City fled in panic. At their level, as long as they were not directly gazed upon by the main body, they could still hold on for a while without being affected by the surrounding "people."
Returning to the temple in the city center, Trunsoest solemnly declared, "Eyes other than the two normal eyes violate common sense and must disappear."
What disappeared, however, was his original left eye. The eye on his cheek was still there.
Although Trunsoest's two eyes had a normal right eye, his left eye had grown on his cheek, making his face extremely strange, but he had temporarily suppressed the power of that eye.
At the same time, he realized that the monster just now had a high rank and its abilities were very strange.
At this moment, Sia raised her hand, and the sound of the "Language of the Dead" echoed from the hidden door again.
The priests who had entered the hidden door earlier now also had blue pupils in their left eyes, but they were already dead, so they were still under Sia's control for now.
The dark space before the Death statue was slowly closing. For now, they would just release that one eye.
Just then, Trunsoest suddenly raised a hand and "exiled" the dim room with the several priests, along with the magic array controlling the seal, to a space outside the world!
Sia's eyes narrowed. She immediately opened an "Underworld Gate" at the location of the exile, trying to pull the dim room back.
But because she hadn't been prepared before, she didn't have time to stop it.
Trunsoest laughed twice, saying, "Enjoy the happiness that the Outer God brings you!"
As he spoke, he took a step and disappeared with a strange face.
Sia glanced at the dark space that had become large again. A disgusting green mucus appeared inside. She hesitated slightly and immediately left the temple.
Returning to the Imperial Palace, He spent some time covering the escape of the angels and Beyonders who had not been attacked by the Outer God's favored ones.
Finally, after the entire city of Cevas had become a territory of the "Outer God's Favored," Sia opened a giant "Underworld Gate," preparing to leave through the Underworld.
However, after the "Underworld Gate" was summoned, it couldn't be opened.
Sia had a bad premonition. At the same time, the afternoon sky suddenly darkened, starlight quickly filled the air, and a surging darkness descended.
Sia's eyes narrowed. In her panic, she wanted to burrow underground to escape.
Buzz~
From the pitch blackness, a giant black scythe extended, hitting perfectly and cutting off Sia's head.
Immediately after, the head, with a surprised expression, vanished into the void.
Sia's body paused for a few seconds before collapsing to the ground.
An Archangel, and one from the "Death" pathway at that, just died like this.
The Beyonder characteristic of the "Pale Empress" rapidly precipitated, was covered by a thick layer of darkness, and disappeared from the real world.
...
When Hobert arrived in Cevas, he happened to witness the Evernight Goddess killing the "Pale Empress."
He hadn't expected the Uniqueness of the "Death" pathway could kill a Sequence 1 so easily.
However, Hobert felt that the Evernight Goddess must have made extensive preparations and only struck at the opportune moment.
Hobert said to the dense darkness, "Respected Goddess, thank you for your help."
You can't just take the Beyonder characteristic and leave. At least stay and help solve the problem.
An ethereal female voice came from the void, "The Balam Empire released three favored ones of the Outer Deities. These favored ones are from the cosmos and entered the real world with the help of the Outer Deities during the Fourth Epoch."
"Currently, I have re-sealed the Underworld. Other deities will do their best to guard the Astral World, making it difficult for the Outer Deities to respond to their return. Now, we only need to resolve those three favored ones as quickly as possible."
As she spoke, darkness spread, and instantly, more than half of the Balam Empire entered night ahead of time, and also entered the hidden world, preventing the influence brought by the favored ones from the cosmos from expanding further.
Hobert asked, "What abilities do they likely possess? Will there be any unknown corruption?"
"There are no existence at the level of deities among them," the Evernight Goddess said. "I'm not very clear about their specific abilities."
"As long as you don't get injured in battle, you won't be corrupted."
Hobert nodded. That was fine then. He was about to go into the hidden world to search for the Outer God's favored ones, but the ethereal voice in the darkness said again, "According to my observation, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' and the 'Uncertain Mist' have a tendency to join forces."
Hobert was slightly taken aback. "Thank you for the reminder."
Then He asked, "What should I be careful about?"
The Evernight Goddess wouldn't give such a baseless reminder.
The ethereal voice hidden somewhere unknown said, "Trunsoest has completely defected to the 'Uncertain Mist'. Be careful He enters the cosmos after being defeated."
"Among the three favored ones of the Outer Deities released this time, one is suspected to be a favored one of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'."
"I understand," Hobert said with a smile. "Please rest assured, I am fully confident I can keep Him in the real world."
It wasn't surprising that Trunsoest would defect to the "Uncertain Mist."
At the same time, Hobert was also very clear that unless Trunsoest was truly desperate, He would not go to the cosmos.
Because going to the cosmos would mean His Beyonder characteristic could easily be taken by the "Uncertain Mist."
As for the possibility that the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" might join forces with the "Uncertain Mist," and that the Balam Empire's release of monsters this time had influences and plans from the level of Outer Deities, this was something Hobert hadn't anticipated.
The ethereal voice in the darkness stopped speaking.
Only then did Hobert enter the city of Cevas within the "hidden world." The monsters here hadn't realized they had entered another world and were still searching everywhere for people whose eyes hadn't turned blue.
Hobert's substitute "tampered" with his state, making all the monsters here ignore Him.
Next, Hobert had the substitute "distort" the mind of a nearby monster. That monster immediately reached out and gouged out his blue left eye. The eyeball rolled wildly in his palm, not at all like a gouged-out eyeball.
Immediately after, the monster let out a scream. To be precise, he had transformed back into a human.
His scream attracted the attention of the surrounding monsters, so Hobert had that person "fill" the blue eyeball back in. Although his left eye looked very gruesome, it looked "normal," and he became a monster again.
The surrounding monsters also turned their gaze away and no longer looked in this direction.
Hobert pondered for a moment: These people could still be saved, but they would lose a left eye.
However, now was not the time to save them. Based on the aura of that blue eye just now, Hobert "linked" to the location of the main body.
Then He "distorted" space, with the substitute in front and the main body behind, arriving before the target.
That was an eye the size of a head. It also had eyelids, but it was only the eye part.
At this time, It had already realized it was in the "hidden world." The blue light flickering in its pupil was examining the space in front, as if seeking a way out.
Under its constant examination, that area of space actually became hazy and started to seem somewhat illusory.
It was as if, through its efforts, it had "stared" a hole into space.
As that small area of space became increasingly illusory, a faint image of streets seemed to appear in the haze. That was the scene from the real world.
Suddenly, the blue eye seemed to sense something and glanced in the direction of Hobert's substitute.
Although it didn't fully see Hobert's substitute, it sensed Hobert's presence, so it immediately rushed towards that hazy space, wanting to escape into the real world.
Hobert had already prepared for attack. The "Sword of Disorder" in the substitute's hand was about to thrust out when suddenly a hand reached out from the hazy space and grabbed the large eye.
Immediately after, Amon, wearing a pointed hat and a classical mage robe, extended from the real world into the "hidden world."
It was He who grabbed the giant eye.
"It seems I arrived just in time," Amon said with a smile to Hobert. "I'll help you deal with one."
As He spoke, the eyelids of that eye were gradually closing, as if it was tired and wanted to sleep.
However, the blue eye showed strong resistance and was struggling against the "drowsiness," but ultimately, with Amon's effort, it still closed.
Hobert put away the "Sword of Disorder." "What do you want it for?"
Listening to the Evernight Goddess, other deities had to guard the Astral World at this time, and only the Evernight Goddess could descend to help.
It was clearly too late to contact "The Fool" for support at this time. So, with only one deity on his side, Hobert naturally wouldn't proactively conflict with Amon.
"For deities," Amon deliberately emphasized the word "deities," "these guys are important sources of information about the cosmos."
For a moment, Hobert wasn't sure if Amon was showing off that He had become a god, or if He was reminding him of the use of these "Outer God's favored ones," implying that the remaining two shouldn't all be given to the Evernight Goddess?
Hobert didn't overthink it and asked again, "Are you doing research on Outer Deities? Was stealing Erebus's thin-necked glass bottle for researching the 'Uncertain Mist'?"
Amon smiled and said, "Something like that."
"Why are you doing this kind of research?"
"My childhood dream was to soar through the cosmos." Amon revealed a rather punchable expression of longing.
Hobert said succinctly, "I don't believe you."
Amon smiled and didn't explain further. "Evernight seems to have noticed me. Let's chat again when we have time."
After speaking, He instantly vanished, as if He had never been there.
Hobert looked again at the monsters with blue eyes all over the streets. They seemed not to have been greatly affected and were still searching around with blank expressions.
They seemed like avatars of that large eye, but there seemed to be some difference from avatars in the normal sense.
Since this "Outer God's Favored" was captured by Amon, Hobert went to look for other enemies.
He came to the top of the Death's temple to survey the surroundings. A lake outside the city quickly caught Hobert's attention. The color of that lake was light green!
When several "blue-eyed" monsters passed by the lake, they were grabbed by light green tentacles extending from within and pulled into the lake. After devouring a few monsters, not even a ripple appeared on the lake's surface.
The next second, Hobert and his substitute appeared together by the lake. The lake water was very calm and showed no intention of attacking Hobert's substitute.
The substitute laughed and said, "I don't know if you can understand our language, but what I want to tell you is that your disguise is really too clumsy."
"It's not that the color of the lake is very wrong, but that you were clearly somewhat aggressive just now, but stopped attacking because you sensed my level. This, on the contrary, shows you have high intelligence."
As soon as these words were spoken, the ground beneath the substitute's feet was suddenly pushed open by a current of water, like a geyser, and a stream of green water emerged, swallowing the substitute.
Hobert disconnected his link with the substitute. He had already gained some understanding of this monster's level. His main body appeared dozens of meters behind.
The water immediately formed two not very thick water columns, shooting out and attacking Hobert again.
Hobert once again disappeared into the "shadows," and had the substitute raise a hand. The surrounding temperature plummeted to below minus one hundred degrees Celsius. Not only did the two rushing water columns freeze into light green solid ice, but the surrounding plants, and the entire lake in front, also completely froze. The severe cold seemed to cover the aura of all life.
Crack~
A stream of heat erupted from the ice, blooming a bewitching flower on the ice surface. The colorful flower rotated clockwise, making one feel dizzy. A mirage appeared before Hobert's eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 740: Conqueror Medici
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The abilities of the "Outer God's Blessed" were somewhat unfamiliar to Hobert. He didn't have as much preparation and research as Amon, so he was very cautious when dealing with the opponent at first.
Because he had a stand-in to help him resist the opponent's attacks, Hobert wasn't in a hurry to counterattack. He wanted to see what the opponent's abilities were like.
Inside the illusion created by the enchanting flowers, there were layers upon layers, rows upon rows of huge squares stacked together. Each square seemed to contain a terrifying creature, coldly watching Hobert.
Hobert felt that his stand-in's emotions were being influenced by the monsters in these squares. He felt angry, then sad, then fearful.
So he had his stand-in wave his hand, and the monsters in the squares were immediately "tampered" into handicrafts, festive toys, and other items that had little to do with anger, sadness, or fear.
Then, the stand-in reached out and took out a pair of huge butterfly wings from the "Nation of Disorder".
This was a mystical item accidentally obtained a long time ago when dealing with the corruption of the "Uncertain Mist" on Archibald.
It didn't seem to have many Beyonder characteristics, but the patterns on the wings easily caused hallucinations after being infused with spirituality.
Later, Hobert guessed that this mystical item might have been formed due to the special nature of the Outer God's corruption.
The monster Hobert was facing now was very similar to the effect produced by the butterfly wings.
This ability was a bit different from the "Hypnosis" of the "Spectator" or the "Sleepless"'s manipulation of dreams. It was more like the hallucinations caused by taking some kind of drug.
It was difficult to directly "use" or "distort" this.
But for Beyonders at Hobert's level, this wasn't too difficult to solve.
The stand-in waved the colorful "butterfly wings" like holding two large fans, and at the same time used the abilities of "Magnification" and "Exploit". Suddenly, a hallucinatory force broke through the squares in front, like opening a door in space, creating a portal in the illusion.
Then the illusion shattered, and Hobert saw the enchanting flowers on the green ice surface again.
The flowers rotated again, but as soon as they started to turn, Hobert's stand-in snapped his fingers, and suddenly there was a huge force in the air, slamming into the flowers and shattering them.
At this time, Hobert's attack was not only a physical attack, but also an attack on the essence of the target. No matter what the structure of the flowers was, or whether they were different from creatures on Earth, they were ultimately shattered.
The "Sword of Disorder" appeared in the stand-in's hand again, and he swung it forward, splitting the entire lake's ice layer in two. Under the ice layer, which was tens of meters high, there was still a pool of dark green lake water that had not been frozen.
In these lake waters, one could vaguely see some fish that had not been completely "digested", as well as some dissolving human corpses, and even many aquatic plants.
It looked more like the stomach of some kind of omnivorous creature.
Considering that the surrounding low temperature couldn't freeze this monster, Hobert snapped his fingers, compressed the surrounding air to form a high-pressure air furnace, and then started a fire by friction, instantly raising the temperature of the flame to over a thousand degrees, and the temperature was still rising.
All the ice immediately melted and quickly evaporated, first becoming transparent, and as the temperature became higher, pure white clouds formed at the top of the huge "air furnace".
A huge lake disappeared like this, and only the dark green "Outer God's Blessed" was left at the bottom of the dried-up lake.
But it didn't seem to be afraid of the high temperature. It still burst out of the "air furnace" set up by Hobert like a paste.
The intense high temperature spewed out, igniting a fire in the surrounding field.
Hobert's stand-in had been prepared for this. On the opponent's inevitable path, he held the "Sword of Disorder" and stabbed the huge "green paste".
The "green paste" could of course sense the power of the "Sword of Disorder", and suddenly stretched out several dark green tentacles to block it, but the tentacles were "distorted" by the stand-in and stretched elsewhere.
Although the "green paste" was stabbed, the main body immediately split off a large piece of itself.
The split part was affected by the "Abolition" and immediately turned back into water, bones, dried aquatic plants, and other substances.
This didn't affect the "green paste"'s escape speed at all. There was a river not far away, and the "green paste"'s target was that river.
It would swallow any animals or plants it encountered along the way without hesitation.
Hobert, hiding in the "shadow", was very grateful that the Evernight Goddess had arrived in time and trapped all the targets here with the "Concealed World", otherwise it would be difficult to catch if this guy escaped into the groundwater.
While the stand-in used the ability of "disorder" to make the "green paste" lose its direction, Hobert recalled some novels he had read before.
The "green paste" in front of him was more like those extremely tenacious alien creatures in his memory!
Of course, you can't use conventional methods to deal with this kind of creature.
He glanced at the inside of the "green paste" and suddenly had a good idea.
As Hobert's stand-in snapped his fingers, every corpse and every tree in the "green paste"'s body was tampered with from "1" to "99".
Whoosh!
Those corpses and plants suddenly burst through the "green paste" and swelled into a "mountain of corpses" hundreds of meters high.
The "green paste" was a little dazed, as if it didn't quite understand what had just happened.
Hobert's stand-in waved his hand, preparing to distort the "green paste" that was everywhere after the explosion and seal it together.
But the "green paste" quickly reacted and "cut" itself again, running away with only about one-tenth of its body.
Hobert realized that the mass of green liquid that the stand-in "distorted" was actually lifeless.
That is to say, in that instant, the "green paste" transferred all its vitality, consciousness, and perception to that one-tenth!
This ability was indeed a bit magical.
At this time, that one-tenth of the "green paste" suddenly stopped and turned into a green plane. A thin film appeared on its surface, with brilliant colors.
The stand-in was chasing the target with the "Sword of Disorder" when suddenly the brilliant colors on the film formed a blurry figure.
Hobert's stand-in stopped immediately, and Hobert in the "shadow" immediately turned his head away, closed his eyes, and saw with his stand-in's eyes that the blurry figure gradually became clear, turning into a huge creature with some marine biological characteristics.
There were many ancient runes on its body surface, flashing with dazzling streamers, giving people a sacred and evil feeling.
Hobert immediately realized that this was the appearance of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity"'s main body. Before becoming a god, even a King of Angels would be slightly corrupted after taking a look.
Fortunately, Hobert now had a "firewall", and this shallow corruption was all on the stand-in, without affecting the main body.
For the "Mother Goddess of Depravity", this was enough, because of the characteristics of her authority, unless other Outer Deities took action, there was no way to remove such corruption.
Shallow corruption would also gradually deepen until it became severely polluted.
Hobert immediately made the space in front of the "green paste" disordered, and the light no longer propagated along normal paths, so this clear figure became blurred again.
But in the next second, this figure reappeared and became solid again. It actually skipped the propagation path of light and appeared in front of Hobert.
Hobert immediately "tampered" with his perception, making himself think that he was blind, and preventing his consciousness from accepting any visual things, and not conceiving any images in his mind.
At this time, he went to disarm the stand-in, which was obviously a bit mutated, but he found that the stand-in had "new life" and was unwilling to disappear like this!
Hobert decisively altered the stand-in from "1" to "0", and the stand-in disappeared.
The "Sword of Disorder" appeared in Hobert's hand, and it suddenly became longer, accurately piercing the "green paste", which was now like a standing curtain.
The "green paste" quickly dodged, and the picture on its body surface disappeared.
Hobert's spirituality was somewhat weakened by his own "tampering", and he only noticed the other party's changes after stabbing a few times.
He immediately used the method of compressing air to imprison the "green paste", but he still let a part of the "green paste" escape.
Hobert chased after it while ending his "tampering", using microscopic electromagnetic force to attract the "green paste".
The "green paste" was effectively controlled this time, and its speed was greatly reduced.
Hobert, who had regained his keen spirituality, realized that perhaps only the four natural forces in the universe could imprison the "green paste".
Hobert first returned to the "shadow" again, and had the new stand-in "distort" the strong interaction force in front. The soil, rocks, and even the air in front suddenly changed, and a huge pit of more than ten kilometers appeared.
This was because all the matter in a certain area was suddenly evacuated, and because of the strong interaction force, the gaps between atoms became smaller. The matter in the giant pit became a small piece of extremely hard material, as thin as a cicada's wing, and even only one molecule wide.
At this time, the "green paste" was only about the size of an ordinary pool. It was not sucked away like those materials, but stayed in the center of the giant pit, struggling and unable to go anywhere.
At this time, it abandoned its tail again to survive, but those parts that were abandoned were sucked into the thin wall with strong interaction force.
The "green paste" kept struggling, but it was tightly locked by Hobert with "force", and the strong interaction force gradually began to affect the main body of the "green paste".
So the main body kept abandoning its tail to survive, and finally only about a bucket of water was left, and the color became dark green and the shape became thicker.
At this time, Hobert's stand-in turned the "Sword of Disorder" in his hand into a javelin and threw it out, hitting the "green paste" directly.
It struggled a few more times before finally stopping completely.
Hobert didn't rush to remove the four natural forces, but first used the "Exploit" ability to accelerate the precipitation of Beyonder characteristics.
In the end, Hobert obtained a palm-sized mass of translucent liquid.
Hobert felt that it was a bit like Beyonder characteristics, but it also seemed to have some kind of living characteristics. It was more like a Sealed Artifact that had been precipitated.
At this time, a space not far from Hobert suddenly became obscure and difficult to name. A clear voice said, "Its situation is a bit special. It is more like the Beyonder characteristics themselves have produced life."
Perhaps afraid that Hobert would misunderstand, the Evernight Goddess explained, "It is not that it has activity, but that the Beyonder characteristics have produced life."
"I understand," Hobert said, "This is very consistent with some of the authorities displayed by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'."
This Great Old One likes to give some creatures and items "new life".
The Evernight Goddess continued, "Seal it carefully. It may show signs of life again after a while."
Hobert nodded: This should be the "blessing" of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity". Perhaps only after becoming a Great Old One can this Beyonder characteristic from the cosmos be completely split, and then the life inside will completely disappear.
The Evernight Goddess also said, "The people here can still be saved."
"I already had a plan to save people just now."
"I'll help you control them for a while."
Hobert smiled and said, "Thank you for your help."
The obscure and difficult-to-name space disappeared. Hobert first sealed the "green paste" with the "Order Crystal", and then glanced at the battlefield where he had just fought the "green paste".
A huge lake disappeared here, and a giant pit appeared!
Because the "air furnace" that Hobert "distorted" disappeared, the high-temperature water vapor floated into the sky and formed dark clouds, and it began to drizzle.
Hobert rose into the air and expanded his spirituality to the maximum range. Then the stand-in raised his hand and "distorted" all the left eyes of all the "blue-eyed monsters" in the entire "Concealed World" to his feet.
Whoosh~
It was like a "rain of eyeballs" falling at his feet. Finally, all the eyeballs piled up, like a small mound.
These eyeballs still had living characteristics and kept turning around. The entire "eyeball hill" was also constantly moving.
Screams rose and fell on the land of the Balam Empire.
Although people had returned to normal, they had lost an eye.
Hobert grabbed the Beyonder characteristic of the "Creator" from the "Nation of Disorder" and tried to make everyone grow their left eye again.
This Beyonder characteristic was obtained by Hobert after shattering the "Creation Bracelet". The Beyonder characteristic of "High Summoner" had already been given to Emlyn, so that he could prepare to advance to Sequence 3.
At the moment, Hobert "exploited" the characteristics of the "Creator" to allow everyone who had lost their left eye to start growing a left eye.
But he found that the left eye that grew out still had problems.
That is to say, the "green paste" had polluted the "concept" of "left eye". As long as they had a left eye, the corruption would still exist.
So Hobert terminated the idea of ​​regenerating the "left eye", and then "tampered" with everyone's injuries, turning their new injuries into old injuries that had already healed.
After this series of operations ended, the Evernight Goddess withdrew the "Concealed World", the early night disappeared, and a ray of afterglow appeared on the horizon.
Hobert raised his hand, and the "eyeball hill" under his feet immediately "decomposed", and finally turned into a pile of colorful dust.
He glanced at the bewildered and fearful civilians on the city streets, didn't linger, and used "Distortion" to travel directly north to the Atlantis army's camp.
After the Balam Empire was taken over by Atlantis, it was divided into two counties. The common people liked to call these two counties the "Left Eye County" because most people here, and even many animals, were missing their left eye.
...
In the Feynapotter Kingdom, there is a seal underwater in the center of Full Moon Lake in the South Colson region.
This seal was created by Hobert when he was the lord here, using the "Nation of Disorder" to seal the corruption beneath the lake.
Inside the deep black seal, there is a bubble-like structure, and inside the bubble is a crystal clear gemstone that still shimmers with strange colors even without light.
When sealing the bubble and the gemstone, Hobert guessed that this corruption was likely from the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
At this moment, a ghostly green shadow appeared above the gemstone in the "bubble." The ghostly green shadow flowed slowly, turning into a paste-like state.
It was very clear that it couldn't alarm the outer seal, so it quietly came to the very center of the gemstone, entrenched itself there, and waited for the right opportunity.
...
Hobert arrived at the Atlantis military camp and found Medici, who had fiery red hair: "Prepare for the final battle."
Medici revealed a creepy smile: "It seems that all the problems have been solved!"
Then He took a deep breath: "Give me half an hour to prepare!"
Hobert nodded slowly, completely handing over the command to Medici.
Soon, the sound of "Prepare for the final battle" resounded throughout the entire military camp and every trench in front of the camp.
Because there was already a specific plan for the final battle, hundreds of thousands of troops immediately began to operate in an orderly manner.
The artillerymen were the first to get busy. Freight electric cars loaded with shells were transported from the military camp to several artillery positions.
The soldiers in the trenches began to check their weapons, install bayonets on the muzzles, and distribute large amounts of bullets and hand grenades.
In the central location of the military camp, brilliant lights flashed one after another. Teams of Beyonders gathered here according to the previous plan and were divided into different combat squads, awaiting Medici's orders.
When the Beyonder forces had gathered almost completely, Medici walked out of the main tent with a solemn expression. He said loudly: "The King and the Angels have gone to Caesar Port, and the Angel War there should have already begun.
"Our battlefield is here, and our mission is to completely defeat the enemy's Beyonder forces!
"I promised the King to kill every Beyonder individual of the enemy. Remember! For Beyonders, there are no prisoners! Taking their Beyonder characteristics is the greatest respect for them!
"As long as we win the Beyonder War, this great battle of hundreds of thousands of people will be without suspense.
"Come on! Fight! This should be your last chance to easily earn military merits!
"After this battle, there will be no opponents in the entire world!"
Then Medici began to "distribute" the Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts given by the "Creator", including "0-71" Calamity Porcelain Doll and "0-72" Box of the Great Old Ones.
As well as the uncrushed "0-73" Death Domain and "0-74" Fallen Mask.
There were also "0-77" Cursed Heart and "0-78" Spiritual Wilderness, a total of 6 Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts.
Plus the "0-80" Book of Law in Hobert's hand, these are all the Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts currently held by Hobert.
The original "0-76" Sword of Death had been crushed by Hobert, and the "Weather Warlock" Beyonder characteristic inside was given to Medici for advancement. Just now, along with these Sealed Artifacts, Medici was also given a "Conqueror" Beyonder characteristic.
At this time, Medici had already prepared the potion for advancing to Sequence 1, and was just waiting to find the right opportunity to take it.
Medici glanced at the setting sun on the horizon: "Depart!"
After making the final war mobilization, under the leadership of Medici, the Beyonders quickly left the military camp and crossed the trenches.
Under Medici's loud command, the phalanx made slight adjustments and immediately charged towards the enemy's trenches.
In fact, they could have used the corresponding Sealed Artifacts to "skip" the enemy's trenches and appear directly in the enemy's military camp.
But Medici launched a frontal assault.
In the enemy's trenches , fire snakes spewed out immediately, which were the enemy's heavy machine guns.
Boom~
Medici raised his hand, and a violent explosion occurred in the position in front of them, creating a huge gap. The Beyonders broke through the enemy's defense line easily.
The Paz Allied Forces soldiers were stunned there, not knowing what to do for a while, until the Atlantis artillery began, which "woke them up."
This was Medici's purpose: to disintegrate the morale of the enemy's ordinary soldiers.
All the obstacles encountered along the way were vulnerable, and soon thousands of Beyonders arrived in front of the enemy's main military camp.
After receiving the news, the enemy's Beyonder forces had also basically completed their assembly.
Medici glanced at the enemy's camp and adjusted the formation again: "Charge! Charge! Trample the enemy's camp, these trash are destined to have One Goes Without Return!
"Hahahaha! Feel the fear brought by the Atlantis army!"
The Beyonders on the Paz Allied Forces side also simply formed a defensive formation, and several demigods holding Grade 0 Sealed Artifacts began to attack Medici with all their strength.
While dodging the attacks, Medici charged at the forefront, holding a long sword with mottled bloodstains and rust: "Trash, this sword will be the last thing you see!"
Boom~
In the dense Beyonder attacks, Medici detonated the enemy's military camp, and at the same time, a "Pure White Spear" at the Angel level pierced through His chest.
This "Pure White Spear" came from a Grade 0 Sealed Artifact of the Loen nobles. Medici pulled out the pure white spear and threw it aside as if nothing had happened, and was the first to rush into the enemy's military camp.
In front of Him were all enemies, and Beyonder attacks were flying around.
Behind Him were all His own people, and Beyonder attacks were also flying around.
He first killed an enemy demigod with a sword, and then was blown away by other Beyonder attacks.
Medici immediately got up, and once again rushed towards the enemy with vigor and vitality. After killing another demigod, a black Beyonder spear pierced His lower abdomen again.
He turned His head and killed the enemy holding the black spear.
"Hahahahaha!" Medici laughed heartily, enjoying the moment of chaos.
A great Beyonder melee kicked off. This battle caused half of the Allied Forces' military camp to be engulfed in flames, and countless ordinary soldiers who couldn't evacuate in time were killed or injured.
Soon, Atlantis, which had launched the attack after a long period of planning, gained the upper hand. Medici seized the opportunity to completely tear apart the enemy's defense line, cutting and surrounding the enemy.
The Allied Forces' Beyonders immediately began to rout. With the arrival of the victory of the Beyonder War, Medici took out the prepared potion and drank it in one gulp.
Almost without stabilizing His state, He shouted again: "Pursue! Pursue! Defeat the enemy! Conquer the Southern Continent!"
