chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 747: Judgment of "Celestial Worthy"
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert stalled Amon for almost half a minute, successfully creating an opportunity for Klein to accommodate the Uniqueness.
Now, there's only one final step before Klein becomes 'The Fool': 'Stealing' a copy of each Sequence 1 to Sequence 9 characteristic from Antigonus.
Hobert took a deep breath, he had to stall Amon for a while longer!
Klein raced against time. The illusory brand on his forehead emitted a faint, grayish-white mist. The slippery tentacles extending from his back once again began to 'steal' Antigonus's Beyonder characteristics.
Amon noticed Klein's plan. He and his avatars also began to 'steal'.
Because their 'numbers' were too great, they would definitely succeed before Klein.
So, Hobert immediately 'tampered' with the number of Amon's avatars, 'tampering' it from over a thousand avatars to '-1'. This was the capability of the Symbolism of Distortion that was enhanced by a Sefirah.
That's right, after becoming a 'Black Emperor,' Hobert could 'tamper' something into a negative number.
That large group of Amons vanished instantly, even Amon's main body disappeared along with them, because it was '-1', so Amon still 'owed' an avatar, thus his main body went to 'fill' that number.
But quickly, Amon's main body opened a door between the mathematical world and the real world, and he escaped the abstract attack of mathematics.
Hobert once again avoided his sharp edge, having himself, Klein, and Antigonus return to the astral world, leaving Amon alone in the 'shadow'.
Here, Hobert's main body would try its best to stall Amon, while a substitute of the same level as Hobert continued to protect Klein's advancement in the incomplete 'Nation of Disorder'.
Amon's main body in the distance sighed, "I must say, your Exploit of the 'Black Emperor' ability is truly eye-opening.
"I don't remember Solomon being this strong back then, hmm… even considering the 'Nation of Disorder' factor, you are more difficult to deal with."
Hobert laughed, "Thank you for the compliment, how about we find a place to sit down and have a couple of drinks?"
"Sorry, no time today." As he spoke, countless doors opened around Amon. These doors with abstract meaning could all help him leave the 'shadow'.
But almost at the same time, Hobert 'distorted' the space behind the doors into another 'shadow', after all, his ability also had the authority of abstraction.
Amon smiled, "I have an advantage you don't have, and that is: the superposition of two Uniquenesses!"
Another illusory door opened in front of him, a flaw in the 'shadow': "Black Emperors" can walk in the 'shadows' of the universe's order, but Amon is not a 'Black Emperor', so he cannot be in the 'shadow'.
Amon's figure became illusory and quickly disappeared through the illusory door.
Hobert's eyes narrowed. At this moment, with the help of the same level substitute, Klein finally 'stole' the Beyonder characteristics of the 'Seer' pathway from Sequence 1 to Sequence 9.
Under the effect of the 'Fool' Uniqueness, these characteristics instantly merged into one, becoming a 'Fool' potion.
After Amon emerged from the 'shadow', he slightly raised his hand, and the ancient first 'Blasphemy Slate' suddenly emitted a colorful light, as if a illusory sea was surging.
The surging 'illusory sea' impacted the realm that seemed to contain countless 'distortions' and 'disorder'. Hobert's incomplete 'Nation of Disorder' suddenly shook, revealing even greater flaws.
At the same time, one after another python-like black tentacles extended from somewhere in the astral world.
Each of these tentacles had an eye at the end, either closed or open. Anything seen by them would instantly turn into grayish-white stone. Everything they touched would twist and stretch out limbs and heads, turning into women, large or small, and quite good-looking women.
The Primordial Demoness seized the opportunity created by Amon and took the chance to sneak into the 'Nation of Disorder'.
For Cheek, this was the advancement of a 'Creator' ally, and the 'Creator' seemed to be helping Medici become a god recently, so if there was a chance, She had to come and sabotage it.
Amon realized that Hobert, empowered by the 'Nation of Disorder', although not at the level of 'Quasi-Great Old One', was more difficult to deal with than ordinary gods.
So, he simply stirred up the situation, letting the gods waiting outside also participate.
At the moment when the 'Primordial Demoness' rushed from the astral world, She saw a vague figure.
This figure wore a layered but not complicated long black dress, dotted with countless stars. His face seemed to be covered with a thin black veil, making it impossible to see his appearance clearly. One could only see that his eyes seemed to condense the starry night sky, making people feel peaceful while also feeling an uncontrollable fear.
It was the Evernight Goddess who had been waiting outside.
She raised a huge, deep black scythe. This scythe quickly became illusory, as if turning into a coffin made of thick black mist.
Those women transformed from the 'Primordial Demoness's' hair were touched by the 'Primordial Demoness's' hair and instantly aged, died, and disappeared. Even the 'Primordial Demoness's' tentacle-like hair was affected by the aura of 'withering', becoming listless and no longer as flamboyant and 'exploring' as before.
The 'Primordial Demoness' ignored the death of those 'Witches'. She stared at the location of Hobert and Klein, bringing a collapse-like destruction to all things, turning the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains in the direction of the giant stone ball.
At this time, clumps of wheat, flowers, and trees instantly grew on the mountain peak. They intertwined with each other, layering one on top of another, forming a natural barrier, sealing Antigonus's palace inside, no longer affected by the 'Primordial Demoness's' erosion.
In the next second, a 'light' fell straight down from a high place, hitting the natural barrier based on plants.
This light had no substance, as if composed of a stream of complex information. In an illusory posture, it penetrated the gaps between the plants like a torrent, heading straight for the hall.
It was the 'Hidden Sage'!
Whether it was the 'Creator' or the 'Fool', they both supported Roselle, which put a lot of pressure on the 'Hidden Sage'. So, like the 'Primordial Demoness', he supported Amon to become the new 'Lord of the Mysteries'.
At this moment, a hazy light burst out from the void and displayed a series of projection-like scrolls outside the natural barrier.
Some of them recorded the scenes of human beings surviving in the wilderness, some described the relevant decrees promulgated by the 'Black Emperor', forming strange and bizarre folk customs, and some were depictions of the current world, composed of huge machines spewing steam and increasingly tall buildings of various kinds.
These contents seemed very thin, but they gave people an extremely heavy feeling, because what they carried was civilization.
After the 'Hidden Sage' chose to be an enemy of Klein, the God of Steam and Machinery finally chose to support Klein's apotheosis.
The complex and terrifying torrent of information was loaded into those illusory paintings. It expanded rapidly, trying to tear apart the 'cage'.
But thousands of years of civilization were so thick and broad that it was completely enough to carry the 'Hidden Sage's' torrent of information.
Over there, the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother were besieging the 'Primordial Demoness', putting this huge Demoness into a very passive situation.
At this time, on every leaf, every flower, and every fruit in the natural barrier constructed by the Earth Mother, black spots appeared.
These black spots expanded rapidly. The wheat turned from golden yellow to black, and the flowers also turned from colorful to all black. The same was true for the trees.
In the all-black jungle, a blurry, viscous figure appeared. He seemed to symbolize all depravity and corruption. Any creature could be immediately affected by him and become an alien in nature.
This is the 'Dark Side of the Universe'!
The 'Creator' supported Farbauti, so he must stand in the opposing forces of the 'Creator'.
The black corruption began to affect the Earth Mother in reverse, but the Mother waved her hand, and all the black plants withered instantly, returning to the earth, while the life and spirituality of the 'Dark Side of the Universe' also flowed away rapidly, as if returning to the embrace of the earth.
At this time, a bottomless crack suddenly opened on the ground of the main peak. Inside the crack were clusters of viscous liquid, and these liquids seemed to be wrapped in endless evil and depravity.
The 'Dark Side of the Universe' summoned a part of the 'Abyss'!
Even the Earth Mother could feel a force of 'erosion' from the 'Abyss' was eroding herself.
But in the next instant, the dark liquid in the 'Abyss' suddenly boiled, and a huge demon 'swam out' from inside. This demon was between illusory and reality, with an illusory face, evil light flashing in his eyes, and a layer of illusory coat composed of mysterious symbols around his body.
This is the 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti!
His appearance was equivalent to formally declaring to the 'Mother Tree of Desire' that the part of the consciousness in the 'Dark Side of the Universe' belonging to Farbauti was a tool to deceive the Outer Deities.
In the same 'Dark Side of the Universe' as the black liquid, a strange branch suddenly emerged. It only had the shape of a branch, but it grew pustule-like tumors, and the leaves had different patterns with strange colors.
Some of these patterns could make people lustful, some would make people be trapped by vanity, some would make people's hearts be filled with a desire to express themselves, some would make people very greedy, and so on, in short, would make people make wrong choices because of various desires.
At this time, after the 'Dark Side of the Universe' showed this branch, it allowed the 'Mother Tree of Desire' to descend a little power here.
Farbauti's eyes narrowed, and the huge illusory demon instantly turned into a bubble.
But when he left, he also took away the 'Abyss', so that the power of the 'Dark Side of the Universe' was reduced again.
In fact, Farbauti's current state is not very good, especially after encountering the power of the 'Mother Tree of Desire', he has basically no power to resist.
But he still chose to participate in the war, more like a statement, because he urgently needs Hobert's help at this time!
As the 'Devil Monarch', he is cunning and treacherous. Perhaps because of this, he is more sober than the 'Primordial Moon' that, since you are asking for help, you must first have an attitude.
Without the state and power of a True God, don't put on the airs of a God.
With the departure of 'Farbauti', a three-on-three situation temporarily appeared outside the palace.
Inside the palace, Amon's plan to disrupt the situation failed. He did not expect that the battle outside would not even affect the inside of the palace.
Taking advantage of the opportunity that Hobert continued to stall Amon, Klein successfully used the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence and swallowed the potion in one gulp.
In the "Forsaken Land of the Gods," beneath the immense light and shadow formed by the ancient Sun God, a language written in the most ancient tongue rapidly took shape: Antigonus's attempt to advance to "The Fool" ultimately failed due to various reasons.
The reason He didn't use the name Klein Moretti was because the latter had "stolen" Antigonus's identity and destiny.
If it were in the name of Klein Moretti, what relationship would his advancement failure have with Antigonus becoming "The Fool?"
If Klein didn't abandon Antigonus's identity and destiny, then He would be confined by this sentence.
If he abandoned Antigonus's identity and destiny, then within the Uniqueness that he had just barely accommodated, the mental imprint of Antigonus and the "Celestial Worthy" mixed together, which had just calmed down, would definitely "awaken" again, starting a new tug-of-war with Klein's consciousness.
Now was the crucial moment for taking the potion, and such a tug-of-war was extremely terrifying. Even the "Bell of Order" might not be able to exert much effect.
In that case, Klein would either lose control or be in very poor condition after advancing.
Klein's situation was not quite the same as Hobert's. The mental imprint in the "Black Emperor" potion that Hobert consumed was not very deep. As long as he guarded against the momentum of the "Celestial Worthy's" revival, he wouldn't have too much mental pressure after advancing.
But the Uniqueness that Klein had just accommodated had a very strong mental imprint. Even in the best condition, he should spend some time, like Hobert, gradually accepting the "Uniqueness" before attempting to advance.
However, Klein didn't have that much time. Amon had clearly already become a "Dual Pathway True God." Unless Hobert lived in the "Sefirah Castle," Klein had to advance immediately.
Although Amon was entangled by Hobert's substitute and Hobert himself, a mottled clock suddenly appeared behind Him. The huge clock hand trembled slightly, and in the next two seconds, Amon's main body became a temporal "error," gaining double the time.
That is to say, as far as the entire universe was concerned, the next two seconds were two seconds, but for Amon, it was four seconds.
Hobert immediately realized this and, risking the "theft" of his substitute at the same level, intensified his offensive.
But Amon still gained 1 second of time. On the monocle made of crystal, the figure of Klein was reflected.
In the next second, the monocle bloomed with pure light.
This wasn't "stealing," but "returning."
Amon chose to return what He had once "stolen" from Klein! It was the thought of suicide that Klein had!
When Klein was first captured by Amon in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods," he tried to commit suicide many times but failed. At that time, the corresponding thoughts were "stolen" by the other party.
Although the divinity in Klein's body wouldn't allow Him to commit suicide, this idea would definitely make Him have the thought of giving up.
Hobert had no choice but to immediately "bestow" these "suicidal" thoughts to a huge stone pillar in the hall. The stone pillar seemed to have its own consciousness, and it distorted left and right, actually breaking itself.
At this moment, Klein's thoughts, having taken the potion, had already become chaotic, and the thought of giving up disappeared as soon as it appeared.
His advancement process had reached the most critical moment. While his thoughts were chaotic, they also spread out, as if encompassing the entire planet.
At this moment, Klein felt that he was within different believers, scattered in the fog of history, scattered in the passing time.
The experience at the level of divinity further eroded Klein's thoughts, and it seemed that only that kind of indifference overlooking all things remained.
Even this indifference was collapsing bit by bit.
Adam's "Prophecy" were taking effect. Before long, Klein would completely lose himself and be dominated by the various mental imprints within the "Fool" potion, becoming a monster in the true sense.
This overlapped with Antigonus's fate of losing control and going mad, accelerating the fate of losing control and madness.
Dong~
Seeing that Klein was at risk of collapsing, Hobert's main body immediately appeared in the "Nation of Disorder" and rang the "Bell of Order!"
The bell echoed throughout the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains. After hearing the bell, the "Primordial Demoness" shattered instantly, but in the next moment, She leaped out from a shattered mirror and reappeared in front of the other gods.
The obscurity around the Evernight Goddess also fluctuated, as if it would be unable to continue hiding in the next second and would completely expose its specific location.
The other gods were also affected by the "Bell of Order," and the battle of gods even paused for a second or two because of this.
Klein in the palace suddenly became much clearer. At this moment, He felt something uncoordinated and abnormal.
In the fog of history, there were a small number of projections twisting and unable to be combined, and there seemed to be an essential contradiction between them.
Those were the imprints generated when Klein previously "fooled" Roselle's fate, history, and reality!
Klein immediately seized this incoordination and abnormality, regained a little self-awareness, and with this little self-awareness as the core, He quickly gathered his scattered spirit.
At the same time, Amon seized the opportunity the moment the bell ended and stole Hobert's substitute at the same level as the "Black Emperor," and the "Book of Law" fell to the ground as a result.
Originally, Hobert was fighting Amon two-on-one, but now the situation changed. The substitute was instantly parasitized by Amon, turning into Amon fighting Hobert two-on-one!
Unfortunately, a considerable "error" occurred in the ability of "Shadow," and Hobert couldn't end the summoning of the substitute at all.
Dong~
Hobert could only ring the "Bell of Order" again. The "errors" in the hall were basically eliminated, and Hobert's substitute at the same level disappeared instantly.
But Amon, as the symbol of "error," wasn't greatly affected.
Or rather, at Hobert's current level, there was no way to greatly affect Amon.
Amon waited again for the bell to end before reaching out to "steal" Antigonus's sanity, and succeeded in one fell swoop.
At this time, as long as Antigonus lost his sanity, it would be equivalent to Klein losing his sanity.
Hobert hurriedly used the ability of "Distortion," and the stolen sanity of Antigonus turned into the hair on Antigonus's face.
Klein suddenly became bald, without even a single eyebrow left.
The "Book of Law" that fell on the ground began to write on its own: Theft is prohibited here!
At this time, Klein had theoretically passed the most dangerous period of advancement, but at this time, the "prophecy" of the ancient Sun God came into play again, Antigonus completely lost control and went mad, and Klein's body collapsed once again.
Without hesitation, Klein, who had regained most of his sanity, immediately Released part of the "stealing" effect, returning Antigonus's identity, fate, and self-awareness to the original owner.
On the huge stone chair in the depths of the hall, Antigonus slowly opened his eyes, looking around at everything with a blank expression.
He didn't immediately lose control, because the main reason for his loss of control and madness was that the will of the "Lord of the Mysteries" had largely revived, and now, the "Fool" Uniqueness and most of the Beyonder characteristics that carried that will were no longer in his body.
After a brief daze, Antigonus immediately seized this opportunity to use his own will to resist the tendency of madness, trying to salvage the fate of losing control.
It's just that Antigonus, who had long hair and short hairs like wolf bristles on his cheeks, suddenly became bald.
The "prophecy" of the Ancient Sun God was thus fulfilled: Antigonus indeed failed to advance to Sequence 0 "The Fool."
And after Klein lost Antigonus's identity, the imprint of the "Celestial Worthy" immediately began to erode Klein's consciousness and showed signs of revival.
A voice actually sounded in Klein's ear: "Give up…"
"Hand everything over to me…"
"This time, I will no longer accommodate other Sephirot…"
"I will not help the beings you want to protect, but I will not harm them either…"
"This place will be the forbidden area for Outer Deities…"
Whispers after whispers caused Klein to fall into a certain degree of chaos again!
"Bullshit!" Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" cursed loudly: "What do you think you are? You are just a persona of the Original Creator, and you really think of yourself as a person!"
It turned out that because of the "Celestial Worthy's" arrangement in the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar" pathways, Hobert could also hear the voice of the "Celestial Worthy."
He was very annoyed by the "Celestial Worthy's" actions, and now he finally had a chance to vent, so he cursed very harshly.
But at the same time, Hobert felt that a certain thought in his consciousness seemed to be awakening, which was the "Celestial Worthy" mental imprint that had been suppressed by using the "Genie."
So at this time, Hobert only dared to hide in the "Nation of Disorder" to curse, while also trying to resist the erosion of the "Celestial Worthy" mental imprint.
Fortunately, Amon, as the adjacent pathway to "Seer," wasn't in a good situation either, and was also affected to a certain extent.
Hobert beckoned, and the "Book of Law" returned to his hand, looking like he was reading out some document: "The 'Lord of the Mysteries' in the First Epoch seriously deviated from the expectations of the Original Creator.
"Only by promoting the brilliance and diversity of life can there be a chance to 'tame' the cold Beyonder characteristics.
"But the original 'Lord of the Mysteries' has been trying to revive, putting heavy mental pressure on the people who resist madness and distortion! They have to prioritize fighting Him!
"He is powerful and inhuman, and cannot represent the will of living beings at all, and cannot realize the ideals of the Original Creator!
"The existence of such a god is the real end of the world!
"Hereby, I announce the verdict on the 'Lord of the Mysteries' of the First Epoch: He must never truly revive!"
For a time, the power of the "Nation of Disorder" became unprecedentedly surging, and Hobert immediately realized that this was not only judging the pillar, but also the opportunity to accommodate the "Nation of Disorder"!
At this moment, Hobert is challenging a former Great Old One, one of the Pillars of the universe, challenging the seemingly cold and unchanging rules of mysticism!
At the same time, a illusory force is surrounding the "Book of Law," greatly increasing its compatibility with Hobert!

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 748: The Birth of "Half-Lord of the Mysteries"
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
In an instant, Hobert's aura became even more powerful!
The power of the "Nation of Disorder" helped Him break through the influence of the "Celestial Worthy's" whispers, and once again struck the "Bell of Order."
Dong~
In the melodious chimes, Klein's "Fool" Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics within his body temporarily became more balanced, and the corresponding madness and distortion also lessened a lot.
However, under the influence of the whispers just now, Klein had already experienced erosion of his consciousness, and his condition had become extremely poor, which was quite a terrible thing during advancement!
This was a negative impact generated by Himself, and the influence of the "Bell of Order" could only alleviate it to a certain extent, but could not completely eliminate it.
It was like a complication caused by a certain virus. Although the virus was suppressed, the complication was still there.
With Klein's current state, even if He completed the advancement, His condition would definitely be very poor in the future.
Amon had also recovered from the "Celestial Worthy's" whispers with the help of the "Bell of Order's" chimes. He immediately "deceived" Klein, making Him feel that his condition was very good, and recklessly completed the advancement.
For Amon, a "Fool" in very poor condition was better than a King of Angels of the adjacent pathway in very good condition!
Hobert immediately performed "Distortion", but it was ultimately a step too late. Klein was "deceived" by Amon for a moment. By the time He reacted, His condition had already become worse.
Klein immediately made a gesture towards Hobert. The two of them had a pre-arranged plan for such a situation.
Hobert's avatar appeared again, holding the "Sword of Disorder" and stabbing towards Klein. He wanted to kill Klein and let Him revive.
In this way, they could buy time and recover His condition.
Of course, Amon would not let the avatar succeed. With a wave of His hand, the "Sword of Disorder" in the avatar's hand had already arrived in His hand. He swung it violently, just in time to block Hobert's main body from attacking Klein.
At this moment, two more arms suddenly appeared under the armpits of the Evernight Goddess outside the palace. Those two arms held a twilight-colored giant sword and slashed towards the "Primordial Demoness."
Under the simultaneous attacks of the twilight giant sword and the giant scythe, the "Primordial Demoness" could only retreat.
The Evernight Goddess raised the giant sword again. At this time, although Hobert's main body, who was fighting Amon's main body, could not kill Klein, He still had the strength to "distort" Klein's position, allowing Him to appear under the twilight giant sword.
With a "poof", Klein was hit by the giant sword symbolizing twilight, shattered into a pool of rotten flesh, and exuded Beyonder characteristics.
Before His condition worsened and caused true uncontrolled loss, Klein died.
The next second, the Evernight Goddess put the bird-shaped golden ornament on Her head, Her body blurred and expanded, enveloping the entire main peak of the Hornacis Mountains, making Amon, Hobert, the Earth Mother, "Dark Side of the Universe", "Primordial Demoness", the God of Steam and Machinery, the "Hidden Sage", and Antigonus, all erased like sketches in an instant.
At this moment, Amon understood: No wonder the Evernight Goddess was actually held back by the "Primordial Demoness". It turned out that She was preparing to have Him take action at this critical moment!
The Ancient Sun God seemed to understand what the Evernight Goddess wanted to do, but after making two "prophecies", He could not write a third paragraph.
At this moment, a "miracle" happened. Klein returned from the fog of history.
The "Fool" Uniqueness and the three Sequence 9 to Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics that had belonged to Him just now rapidly returned to His body.
The "Book of Law" that had fallen on the ground, as if receiving a delayed command, began to write silvery-mercury words again: This place is suitable for the return of Beyonder characteristics.
Suddenly, Klein returned to the state when He drank the "Fool" potion.
But what was different from before was that after accommodating the Uniqueness, His mental state had undergone multiple tug-of-wars. Not only was He very tired, but He was also eroded by Antigonus and the "Celestial Worthy". The subsequent advancement was a bit reluctant even with the help of the "Bell of Order".
And now, that tired state was swept away, equivalent to taking the potion again with a relaxed body.
Before, He had already established a certain connection with the "Fool" Uniqueness, and the advancement process had almost no resistance.
In an instant, Klein's body split and virtualized into thin gray mist and dark black liquid.
This process was very short, less than two seconds. The gray mist and black liquid intertwined into a translucent dark cloak.
Of course, the Evernight Goddess couldn't maintain a "Concealment" so many gods for too long.
A "door" that moved quickly appeared on the surface of the "concealed" world. Amon, wearing a pointed soft hat and a classic black robe, jumped out from inside.
Just as He returned to the real world, He saw a blank, illusory mask appearing under the translucent dark cloak.
As the mask outlined Klein's appearance, which incorporated characteristics of Gehrman Sparrow, Amon felt as if His intelligence was being forcibly lowered.
At the same time, He realized: The "Fool" was born!
The gods who were "hidden" by the Evernight Goddess returned to reality one after another. Like Amon, they became a little sluggish in the shock caused by the birth of the "Fool" to this world, as if they couldn't quite react.
This influence was not limited to the gods themselves. Just like Hobert's substitute, it also fell into the same daze as the main body.
The Evernight Goddess also stopped in mid-air with a slight daze, seemingly not yet having figured out what to do next.
Inside the "Forsaken Land of the Gods", the huge light and shadow of the Ancient Sun God, which had dimmed a lot, sighed softly and spoke again: "Let there be light!"
The light in the astral world brightened again, piercing into the eyes of Amon, the "Primordial Demoness", and the "Hidden Sage", allowing them to wake up about a second earlier, and each seized the opportunity to leave!
The torrent of information left first, disappearing in an instant after rapidly brightening!
As the "Primordial Demoness" and Amon left one after another, the other gods also woke up and jointly looked at the "Dark Side of the Universe", who had not had time to escape and had not received help from the Ancient Sun God.
The "Sword of Disorder" in Hobert's avatar's hand took shape first, and instantly turned into a javelin, throwing it towards the "Dark Side of the Universe". The "Dark Side of the Universe" quickly took out the branch in its hand to block it.
At this time, as the strong light generated by the Ancient Sun God disappeared, some powerful and strange forces followed. Because all the gods in the astral world who resisted the Outer Deities had come here to participate in the war today, the Outer Deities could exert some influence here.
The gods other than Hobert and the Evernight Goddess left one after another, which also gave the "Dark Side of the Universe" a chance to leave.
Klein, who had basically regained his sanity, quickly ended the previous "grafting", and the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains returned to the ground.
At this time, Klein's body was completely revealed. He pressed the faint mask on his face with one hand, and placed the other hand on his lower abdomen, his back slightly bent, as if he was enduring unspeakable pain.
After becoming the "Fool", the "Celestial Worthy's" will within Him undoubtedly recovered further.
The crazy whispers and roars constantly echoed in Klein's ears, tearing at his spirit, and this was likely to be the norm in the future.
After all, Klein was the main arrangement for the "Celestial Worthy's" revival, and His situation was much worse than Hobert's.
It was a blessing that the "Celestial Worthy" did not completely awaken during the process of becoming the "Fool".
Dong~
As the melodious chimes rang, Klein breathed a sigh of relief, and the whispers became much quieter.
Hobert reminded: "I can only help you suppress it, but I can't completely eliminate it."
The Evernight Goddess floating above them also said: "What you need most now is to stabilize your condition. If you really can't suppress the idea of the 'Mysterious' revival, come find me again."
At that time, She would use a drop of water from the "River of Eternal Darkness" to help Klein delay for a while.
Besides suppression and delay, there was no better way. In the end, Klein could only rely on himself to defeat the "Celestial Worthy".
After the Evernight Goddess finished speaking, She also left the real world and returned to Her own Divine Kingdom.
Just as Hobert was about to leave, Klein suddenly said: "Wait a moment."
Hobert was slightly stunned and looked at Klein.
"At the moment of becoming a god, I gained many more memories." Klein's expression was a little strange. "The mental imprint that was left in the Nation of Disorder seemed to aggregate into the main mental imprint of Celestial Worthy..."
"From that mental imprint, it seems... you already knew what as going to happen. Every time you entered the Nation of Disorder, Celestial Worthy could parasitize your Astral Projection and read some of your thoughts. Did you... Did you already know the future?"
Hobert's lips curled up slightly: "That's right. I already possessed knowledge of the future, but just limited to 'a certain future.' It was a certain 'future' from your perspective."
Klein seemed to realize what Hobert meant by 'a certain future.' From the memory fragments, Hobert seemed to view this world from a "outside" perspective, almost like a book.
"If you knew the future, from my perspective..."
Klein took a deep breath: "Then... then at the previous Tarot Gathering..."
"Yes, when I saw you for the first time, I knew you were Klein." Hobert was very clear that this was a good opportunity to increase Klein's humanity, so He continued:
"Also, when I first entered the 'Sefirah Castle', I knew you were a transmigrator. Well, although you looked very mysterious and tall at the time, I was very clear that you were just a Sequence 9 at the time."
Klein couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth, his toes were so embarrassed that they were about to break through his shoes.
"Because I knew the development of 'history', I used Roselle's diary to tell you the honorific name of the 'Creator' in order to help Old Neil suppress his loss of control." Hobert continued:
"Actually, I lied before. Several times I saw you being stumped by other members of the Tarot Gathering and could only cover it up with pretense. At the time, I thought it wasn't easy for you, so I helped you out if the opportunity was right.
"Later, after 'The World' joined the Tarot Gathering, the reason why I joked with 'The World' so much was entirely because I knew you were preparing to often sing a duet, so I livened up the atmosphere."
"Cough, cough." Klein cleared his throat, feeling that his toes were about to break through the Hornacis Mountains.
But Hobert continued to say: "Actually, every time the 'Fool' is mysterious, it's a good opportunity for me to learn.
"Because I didn't have much research on how to pretend before, and I was quite panicked after becoming the 'Creator' at first, but as long as I think about the 'Fool's' pretense, I immediately understand how I should pretend to be fresh and refined, and still achieve a deterrent effect.
"The key is the use of alts..."
"Okay." Klein's old face was slightly red: "I understand, you don't need to say anymore."
His head was buzzing now, and he really didn't know how to face Hobert in the future. If possible, He didn't plan to invite Hobert to the Tarot Gathering anymore.
Hobert smiled: "By the way, remember to leave me access to enter the 'Sefirah Castle'. In case your mental state is not good, I can carry the 'Bell of Order' into there."
Klein nodded, and then asked: "What will happen to me in the future? Will I have to fight the 'Celestial Worthy' all the time?"
After becoming a god, He only "recalled" some "past events" before Hobert's transmigration. In addition, He also "recalled" that the things currently happening were already "happened" things for Hobert, so Hobert was very clear about His future state.
"I am the biggest 'variable' in this history." Hobert said: "I don't dare to tell you too much of what I know, because my appearance has already changed many things.
"For example, your advancement today was much simpler than the advancement process I knew, and your current state is also much better.
"But Amon will definitely not sit still and wait for death. Next, He will definitely try every means to sneak attack you."
In Hobert's impression, Klein couldn't even say a complete sentence when He had just completed the advancement. The "Celestial Worthy's" whispers once made His spirit collapse.
After all, Klein was the first person to become the "Fool" after the "Celestial Worthy" and "God" fell, and He Himself was the main arrangement for the "Celestial Worthy's" revival, so His state after advancing to God was very worrying.
"Oh, right, currently I can create black holes. I haven't used this ability even once before." After Hobert finished speaking, He entered the "Nation of Disorder" and rang the "Bell of Order" again.
Dong~
Hobert and the "Nation of Disorder" had already left, but the melodious chimes still echoed in the Hornacis Mountains, making the towering main peak even more magnificent.
The divinity that had been strengthened just now, after hearing the chimes again at this time, the "Celestial Worthy's" whispers became quieter again, and could even be completely ignored most of the time.
This made Klein's mental state even better. He took a deep breath and entered the interior of the "Sefirah Castle", wanting to check the authority He had obtained.
Sitting at the head of the bronze long table, in the "Fool's" position, Klein first mobilized the power of the "Sefirah Castle" and gave Hobert the corresponding access rights.
In this way, Hobert could immediately enter the "Sefirah Castle" when He needed Him, and would not be affected or corrupted by the "Sefirah Castle" in a short period of time.
Then Klein felt it and felt that His mental state was not bad, so He was not in a hurry to continue to stabilize His state, but used His spirituality to check the new authority He had obtained: Fooling!
The simplest application was to lower the enemy's IQ.
Just as Klein was planning to do further research, His spirituality sensed something: "Sefirah Castle" had been invaded!
Thinking of Hobert's reminder just now, Klein immediately realized: It was Amon!
Although He couldn't figure out how He had invaded the Sefirah Castle, Klein wasn't flustered. He first used the "Crystal of Order" in His hand to send a signal to Hobert beyond the "Sefirah Castle".
At this time, the mottled bronze long table below, the gray and white mist suddenly stirred, forming a door.
Amon, wearing a pointed soft hat and a monocle, and wearing a good classic black robe, walked in: "Surprise?"
His smile was a little crazy: "I have released the suppression of the 'Lord of the Mysteries' will in my body."
"He is the master of the 'Sefirah Castle,' which means I am also a master of the 'Sefirah Castle,' so of course I can come in.
"This is very risky. Even I didn't dare to try it before. But since you've grown to this extent, and there are other gods helping you outside, I have no choice but to take the risk.
"This is exciting, but the effect is not bad!"
While Amon was speaking, another figure entered through the door He had just opened, and a 'Sword of Disorder' pierced Amon's chest.
The newcomer was none other than the 'Creator,' Hobert, wearing black armor and a handsome cloak on his back.
Amon's head turned 180 degrees, and He carefully examined Hobert, who had followed closely behind: "I must say again, you are the best person I have ever seen at using the 'Black Emperor's' abilities.
"To actually 'use' the 'door' I opened so silently!"
Then He slightly raised a hand, 'deceiving' Himself, 'deceiving' the 'Sword of Disorder,' and 'deceiving' fate.
He changed the fate of 'being stabbed' into the fate of 'almost being stabbed'.
At the same time, He 'deceived' Himself and the 'Sword of Disorder,' making them both believe that the sword had not hit. As a result, the 'Sword of Disorder' suddenly skewed, becoming close to His classical black robe, and He had no wounds on His body, so naturally He would not be subjected to the entropy increase attack attached to the 'Sword of Disorder'.
Amon grinned and said, "I knew that 'The Fool' would definitely ask you for help, so I also thought about how to deal with you."
As He spoke, the mist in the 'Sefirah Castle' suddenly rolled, and the two masters of the 'Sefirah Castle' were fighting for control of the 'Sefirah Castle'.
Hobert was about to summon the 'Bell of Order,' but the fight was already over.
Currently, Hobert can only enter the 'Sefirah Castle' alone. After all, this is in another source of origin. The 'Nation of Disorder' cannot be brought in.
However, he can use some of the power of the 'Nation of Disorder,' but if he needs to use the 'Bell of Order,' he will have to add a summoning procedure.
The gray fog dissipated, and two identical Klein's appeared in front of Hobert, with the same appearance, figure, and even the feeling of spirituality.
Even Hobert's main body in the 'shadow' could not see any clues on the 'strings'.
At this time, Amon's voice sounded from the gray fog: "Hahaha, how is this method? You can't distinguish which is the real 'Fool,' so how can you help?"
The two Klein's simultaneously revealed a meaningful expression. They were like Hobert's main body and substitute, and any thoughts and actions of the main body could be transmitted to the substitute synchronously.
When he thought of the "Fake and Real Monkey King", he immediately had an idea, and then said the classic "password" again, speaking in Mandarin: "You want my treasure? You can have it! I left everything I gathered together in—!"
One of the Klein's was a little dumbfounded, but the other Klein, while making himself illusory to prevent his thoughts from being 'stolen,' said without hesitation: "One Piece!"
Hobert's extraordinary attack immediately attacked the somewhat dumbfounded Klein: "Distort!"
He wanted to 'distort' this Klein's appearance back to Amon's appearance.
Just as Hobert's ability was about to take effect, the gray fog once again filled the hall. When the gray fog dissipated, two Klein's appeared in front of Hobert again.
Their appearance and expression were still exactly the same, and they were both guarding against each other from 'stealing' their thoughts.
Hobert immediately said in Mandarin again: "You killed my father."
One Klein answered in fluent Mandarin: "He's still in Atlantis."
The other Klein said: "No, I am your father."
Hobert used 'disorder' on the first 'Klein'.
Didn't expect that, double encryption!
Hobert's 'chaos' ability was 'stolen,' and the surrounding area was once again filled with fog. After the fog disappeared, two more Klein's appeared who could not be distinguished from each other.
Hobert frowned: "Something's wrong!"
They could play this game all day! Amon was obviously stalling for time!
And the purpose of stalling for time is likely to be to further control the 'Sefirah Castle'?
This time, Hobert did not rush to 'match the code,' but pondered for a while before letting the substitute say: "Stay down, final warning."
At the same time, his main body summoned the 'shadow' of the 'Bell of Order.' The real 'Bell of Order' could not enter the 'Sefirah Castle,' so using its 'shadow' as a connection could allow most of the power of the 'Bell of Order' to be transmitted.
If the real 'Bell of Order' entered the 'Sefirah Castle,' perhaps some uncontrollable reactions would occur, which would outweigh the benefits.
The Klein played by Amon was obviously stunned when he heard Hobert's question. This question was difficult to answer, and he reviewed all the searches in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' but did not remember a corresponding answer.
The real Klein, while fighting for control of the 'Sefirah Castle,' answered: "I can do this all day!"
The substitute immediately 'magnified' all of Klein's abilities and spirituality. For a time, Klein gained a slight advantage in the battle for control of the 'Sefirah Castle'.
Dong~
At this time, Hobert's real body rang the 'Bell of Order,' and the bell echoed in the hall, causing the mist to roll and all 'errors' to be temporarily fixed.
One of the Klein's turned back into Amon's appearance, and in the rolling mist, there was another Amon in classical clothes walking up the steps in the corner of the hall.
Hobert and Klein immediately understood that the one who had turned into Klein's appearance to hold them back was an advanced clone of Amon, and the real Amon's goal was the door with the cyan-black light above the steps?
At this time, there was no time to think about Amon's purpose. Klein immediately changed the layout of the hall, and the rising steps became downward.
That was the road to leave the 'Sefirah Castle'.
Hobert then used the 'Distortion' ability again to distort Amon's main body's idea of 'competing for the Sefirah Castle' to 'leaving the Sefirah Castle'.
Amon's main body took a step down and instantly disappeared from the 'Sefirah Castle'.
"This is really difficult!" At this time, Amon's avatar suddenly said: "How can I take the 'Sefirah Castle' from your hands?"
A serious 'error' had just occurred. Amon's main body and avatar were confused. The one who had been sent out by Klein was the avatar, and the original avatar had become Amon's main body.
As Amon asked the question, Hobert and Klein's new round of attacks began again.
Klein 'fooled' Amon, and Hobert 'distorted' Amon's mental state, trying to make his overall state worse.
Amon raised a hand, and layers of illusory doors appeared in front of him. Some of the illusory doors were obviously dim, obviously fooled, and some of the illusory doors were 'distorted' and deformed. They bore the attacks from the two gods for Amon.
Buzzing~
A strange sound suddenly appeared around Amon, like a wounded bee, or like a high-voltage current passing through.
Suddenly, half of the hall turned into endless darkness. The darkness contained a huge suction force. The gray fog, bronze long tables and chairs, and even the bricks and stones and gas in the hall were all heading towards that dark embrace!
That was a huge black hole created by Hobert's main body. Even light particles could not escape this huge suction force.
Hobert's main body had just rang the 'Bell of Order' and left the 'Sefirah Castle' to come to the depths of the universe. By changing the corresponding physical laws, he squeezed out a black hole.
Klein used the ability of 'grafting' to graft this black hole, which had been 'modified' by Hobert, to the 'Sefirah Castle'.
If no intervention was made, the symbolic meaning of the 'Sefirah Castle' would not change in any way, but a large amount of the 'Sefirah Castle's' power would be sucked into this black hole.
After Hobert stopped controlling the black hole, there was a high probability that it would undergo considerable mutations.
What Hobert said when he left the main peak of the Hornacis Mountains was hinting to Klein that he could use the power of the universe to try to eliminate Amon!
So the two of them tacitly arranged this attack method.
At this time, the huge suction force of the black hole instantly stretched Amon's body flat and long, not only pulling his physical body, but also pulling his spirit body.
After passing through the 'event horizon,' Amon's body would completely disappear and be compressed into an extremely dense core.
At this time, a serious 'error' occurred: Amon's main body was not affected by gravity!
So Amon's body, which had been stretched into a thin sheet, began to recover.
But one or two seconds later, his body began to be pulled by the black hole again.
Because Hobert had thought of this, Hobert's main body, located somewhere in the universe, used the 'Nation of Disorder' to give the black hole some abstract abilities in advance.
Such as 'distorting' and 'tampering' with targets trying to escape!
In the entire Sefirah Castle, only the places where Klein and Hobert's substitute were located were subject to slightly less suction.
This was the result of Hobert's substitute constantly 'twisting' gravity and Klein constantly 'fooling' gravity.
They would probably be sucked into the black hole three seconds later than Amon. Within these three seconds, it would be enough for Hobert's main body to terminate the summoning of the black hole.
At that time, Amon would have been shattered by the black hole, and even if he didn't die, he should only have symbolism and authority left, and his state would become very, very bad.
But in the case that Amon had successively made himself appear 'errors' and made gravity appear 'errors' without successfully escaping, he began to 'steal' the fate of Klein and Hobert's substitute.
The first to be 'stolen' was the fate of Hobert's substitute. Amon appeared next to Klein, and Hobert's substitute was closer to the center of the black hole.
So Hobert ended the summoning of the substitute and once again let a new substitute appear next to Klein to help him deal with Amon.
At this time, their figures were simultaneously pulled into thin 'paper' by the huge gravity of the black hole.
Amon suddenly laughed loudly: "Your attack is indeed very unexpected, but there is a huge loophole. My level is half a level higher than yours. Why do you think I will be swallowed before you?"
Hobert's substitute was still working hard to 'distort' gravity to minimize the impact of gravity on himself and Klein.
Klein suddenly smiled: "It's time to settle this!"
He turned back to Hobert's substitute and said: "Thank you for your help all along.
"In fact, you don't need to participate in this battle for 'Lord of the Mysteries'!"
Hobert had a bad feeling.
Suddenly, Klein 'fooled' the distance between himself and Amon, grabbed Amon's shoulder, and jumped into the black hole!
Klein suddenly changed his past style, He laughed loudly: "At this moment, gods, authority, and Beyonder abilities are not the key to victory, the key is determination!"
He said to Amon resolutely: "I will never allow you, a god with so little humanity, to become the new 'Lord of the Mysteries'!"
"This world should not always be dominated by cold divinity!"
"You're crazy!" Amon struggled and said: "You will die!"
Klein's mood was very peaceful at this time: "There are always some things that are higher than others."
Before this, He had such determination.
The bodies of the two people were stretched flat and long, possibly less than a nanometer thick, but the length exceeded several hundred kilometers.
But this does not affect the two gods continuing to communicate. Amon said again: "The moment we are completely swallowed, the uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of the three pathways will be too close. Without our suppression, 'Celestial Worthy' will instantly wake up!"
"Then that's not something I need to care about." Klein smiled: "Are you afraid?
"Although you have always been known for pursuing excitement and daring to take risks, you have achieved your goals most of the time. Not only have you not lost anything, but you have gained a lot.
"This is a kind of deception of yours, making people think that you like to take risks, but that's not the case. Every time you carefully plan a way out for yourself.
"But now, I won't give you any way out!"
Amon sighed: "You're really crazy!"
At this moment, the two people simultaneously passed through the 'event horizon' of the black hole. After entering the 'event horizon,' even light cannot escape the huge gravity, and no means can observe the situation inside the 'event horizon'.
It seemed like a long, long time had passed, and it seemed like only an instant had passed. It felt like unbearable pain, and it felt like there was no feeling at all.
They lost all their senses, and only felt that it was so crowded now, unprecedentedly crowded!
In the next instant, they were shattered by the gravitational source of the super-large black hole, and all the atoms that made up their bodies were adsorbed to one point. The black hole's distortion of spacetime was equivalent to Hobert's "distortion."
Because Hobert gave the black hole mystical power, their spiritual bodies and mental bodies were also completely shattered, and they truly died!
Beyonder characteristics and uniqueness instantly precipitated, and as Amon said, they quickly approached, and an ancient and brand-new life seemed to be reviving and being born.
Hobert immediately terminated the maintenance of the black hole and immediately returned the power sucked from the 'Sefirah Castle'.
Because this was outside the Sefirah Castle, Hobert was immediately surrounded by the 'Nation of Disorder', and at the same time, the 'Book of Law' appeared in his hand, and a line of mercurial text immediately appeared on it: Because the 'Creator' judged the original 'Lord of the Mysteries', the momentum of the original 'Lord of the Mysteries' revival was interrupted!
The "Book of Law" immediately turned illusory, and the power of order spread across a large surrounding area.
The resurrection momentum of the original "Lord of the Mysteries," caused by the convergence of Beyonder characteristics, was suppressed by the "Book of Law."
Hobert quickly waved his hand, separating the Uniquenesses and Beyonder characteristics that were gathered together.
At the same time, Klein emerged from the "Historical Void." Because he was now the "Fool," the "Fool"'s Uniqueness and three Sequence 1 characteristics instantly returned to his body, and he remained the "Fool."
This was also why Hobert didn't continue to prevent Klein from "perishing together" with Amon, because Klein had the ability to resurrect.
However, it wasn't just Klein who resurrected; the Celestial Worthy's active spiritual imprint also revived, and the murmuring once again battered his every nerve!
On the other side, Hobert was already snatching the remaining Beyonder characteristics.
He knew that attacks of this level couldn't even kill a True God, let alone Amon, a "Dual Pathway True God."
At this moment, a huge "Error" appeared in "Death," and Amon emerged from an illusory door, returning from "Death."
However, he didn't have the ability to resurrect. This return wasn't as effortless as Klein's; it came at a great cost, so his condition was very poor!
Because he had previously given up suppressing the "Celestial Worthy"'s consciousness, the "Celestial Worthy"'s imprint within him also showed further signs of revival.
But as he returned, the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics that previously belonged to him also quickly returned to his body.
Fortunately, Hobert was quick-witted and swift-handed, snatching a Beyonder characteristic of the "Key of Stars" and a Beyonder characteristic of the "Worm of Time."
Amon had previously separated two characteristics of the "Worm of Time" in order to stabilize his condition.
Now that these two characteristics failed to return, it further affected Amon's condition, and his body immediately began to collapse!
But at this moment, another "Error" occurred. One of Amon's avatars holding the "Worm of Time" instantly appeared beside him and immediately fused with the main body.
With the "Worm of Time" characteristic and the "Error" Uniqueness as a foundation, Amon's collapse immediately stopped, and he once again formed his illusory body.
Hobert's substitute turned around to place the two Beyonder characteristics in his hand into the "Nation of Disorder," but in that instant, the substitute was "parasitized" by the "Worm of Time" characteristic, and a pair of crystal-made glasses appeared on his eye sockets, becoming an Amon avatar at the Sequence 1 level!
Hobert in the "Nation of Disorder" immediately "distorted" the "Key of Stars" characteristic in Amon's avatar's hand, allowing this characteristic to come into his possession.
But during this process, an "Error" occurred, and he only obtained the black helmet on Amon's avatar's head.
The illusory Amon beckoned, and the "Key of Stars" characteristic instantly appeared in his hand.
In the next instant, the "Key of Stars" characteristic turned into the pauldron, the same shape as Hobert's main body, wearing armor.
It turned out that Klein, not far away in space, was pressing his forehead with one hand, resisting the erosion of the "Celestial Worthy's" murmurs, and pointing at the illusory Amon with the other.
He had just "fooled" the very weak Amon, so that the Beyonder characteristic of the "Key of Stars" remained in the avatar's hand.
And at this time, Amon's avatar was in "Disorder," making it difficult to actively hand the characteristic to the main body.
Amon's main body, lacking a key Beyonder characteristic, had not entered the recovery phase.
The situation fell into a stalemate for a time, but as time went on, Amon would definitely be able to use "Errors" to temporarily restore his state without having that "Key of Stars" Beyonder characteristic.
At that time, he would always have a chance to take back that Beyonder characteristic, and even if he didn't take it back, he could steal one from the Abraham family.
If that happened, Klein and Hobert's efforts today would be in vain.
At this moment, Klein and Hobert exchanged glances in the dark and deep space, and they understood each other's intentions with great tacit understanding.
This was another "miracle"! To be able to formulate a plan through simple actions.
In the next second, the illusory mask in Klein's body reappeared. At this time, a wish appeared in his heart: to strengthen the attractiveness of his own Beyonder characteristics.
Hobert then "magnified" the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence around him, and Klein suddenly became a vortex of attraction for Beyonder characteristics.
The Beyonder characteristic of the "Key of Stars" in Amon's avatar's hand flew towards Klein.
At this time, Klein had to risk devouring a Beyonder characteristic of the "Key of Stars"! Because Hobert could use the "Bell of Order" to help stabilize his state, it was no problem to devour a Sequence 1 characteristic from an adjacent pathway.
Amon wanted to stop him, but his condition was extremely poor at this time, and with Hobert's help, Amon couldn't win at all.
Dong~
As the translucent, strangely shaped key entered Klein's body, the melodious chimes of the "Bell of Order" immediately rang out.
The distortion and madness of the Beyonder characteristics in Klein's body were suppressed again, and he successfully "devoured" that characteristic. Although this would make his condition even worse, this step was very important for killing Amon!
At this time, Amon's main body did not escape, so Klein, according to the plan, used the "Key of Stars" characteristic in his body to "graft" the "Door" pathway's Uniqueness in Amon's body.
That was Klein's goal!
Without a Sequence 1 characteristic, Amon could barely maintain his state, but without a Uniqueness, Amon, who was in extremely poor condition, would immediately collapse.
The illusory Amon suddenly laughed maniacally, "Hahaha, you're wrong. Amon has always been willing to take risks when he wants to take risks, and be steady when he wants to be steady. Being unpredictable is what Amon is all about!
Since you want Beyonder characteristics so much, then I'll give them all to you!"
Amon's illusory figure suddenly swelled. At this time, he completely released his suppression of the "Celestial Worthy." In the instant that the "Celestial Worthy" initially awakened, Amon used the authority of "Error" to expel the two Uniqueness and one "Worm of Time" characteristic from his body and "threw" them at Klein!
Klein and Hobert's eyes narrowed at the same time, and they quickly stopped "grafting" and stopped "Magnifying."
But even without Hobert's "magnification" at this time, the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence was still in effect, and the two Uniqueness and one "Worm of Time" characteristic instantly entered Klein's body!
Klein instantly became a "Quasi Great Old One," but the "Celestial Worthy" also initially awakened because of this.
