chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 749 Temporary Tarot Club
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
A black cloak reappeared on Klein's body, beneath which was a phantom form. One moment it would manifest as a phantom mask, another as phantom doors, and yet another as a phantom monocle.
He struggled painfully, doing his best to suppress the complete awakening of the Celestial Worthy.
At this moment, the 'Book of Law' in Hobert's hand became illusory once more, but the power of 'Order' was clearly no longer able to suppress the momentum of the Celestial Worthy's awakening.
Dong~
Dong~
Hobert struck the 'Bell of Order' twice in succession, and Klein's will briefly regained the upper hand, his body becoming solid again.
He immediately used the 'Error' ability on Amon's Sequence 1 avatar!
It turned out that Amon's main body had spoken as if he was going to fight to the death, but after 'throwing' the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics to Klein, he was left with only the empty shell of his main body's consciousness and thoughts. This 'empty shell' immediately pounced on that Sequence 1 avatar.
Because the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics with the Celestial Worthy's spiritual imprint were no longer within his body, Amon's state actually became normal at this time.
He planned to use this Sequence 1 level avatar to escape, and at the same time, merge with another Sequence 1 level avatar. If that were the case, he would still be a King of Angels.
But Hobert, as the 'Black Emperor' god-level 'Disorder', was still influencing that Sequence 1 level avatar, so Amon was unable to escape immediately and was struck by Klein's 'Error'.
This Amon avatar turned back into Hobert's substitute, and the 'Worm of Time' also returned to the substitute's hand.
Without the support of dependence, Amon immediately began to collapse again.
"Alright, I lost this time," Amon's body said as it became illusory: "Sometimes I really don't understand what you two are thinking. There's clearly no need to risk your lives like this. Why do you have to put yourselves in such great danger?"
"Because the rules of this universe are flawed, and we must make some changes." Hobert said coldly: "And gods like you can never risk changing those rules!"
"Only when some changes occur can the lives and destinies of our friends, relatives, and those ordinary people who never appear in your eyes undergo a complete transformation."
Regarding not allowing gods like Amon to become Outer Deities, Hobert's thoughts were completely consistent with Klein's.
Amon shook his head: "Alright, I really don't quite understand what you mean."
At this time, his body completely collapsed and became illusory, finally disappearing completely.
Hobert finally breathed a sigh of relief. Although Amon had not died, this opponent could no longer threaten them! His new true body would likely be Sequence 2 at most.
Klein on the other side still looked painful. Hobert struck the 'Bell of Order' again, but the effect was not as good as before!
Klein pinched his forehead and said: "I may need to use a drop of water from the 'River of Eternal Darkness' to put the Celestial Worthy's consciousness to sleep. At the same time, I will also fall into a period of slumber."
Hobert frowned and asked: "Will 'The World' still be able to act freely?"
After all that effort, he still hadn't changed Klein's destiny?
Was this the influence of the Celestial Worthy's 'Arranged Fate', or a manifestation of Adam's abilities?
Klein sensed his own state, and then said: "Yes, but only at the King of Angels level."
"That's good." Hobert smiled slightly, so it seemed that Klein's fate had still been forcibly changed to some extent. At least 'The World' didn't have to slumber along with him!
"He will walk in the world in my place, accumulating 'miracles' and maintaining humanity." Klein completely understood Hobert's meaning. He couldn't help but smile bitterly and say: "At this moment, I finally understand the Ancient Sun God's helplessness back then."
"Your situation is better than the Ancient Sun God's." Hobert smiled and said: "You still have friends to help you. When I become a Great Old One, I should be able to use the 'Bell of Order' to completely suppress the thought of the Celestial Worthy's resurrection in your body."
Klein slowly nodded: "I look forward to that day coming."
Then he said: "Next, I will convene an emergency Tarot Gathering."
Hobert dispelled his substitute that had just been parasitized by Amon: "Okay."
With a wave of his hand, the Beyonder characteristic of the 'Worm of Time' in the substitute's hand floated towards Klein: "This can be given to Leonard to cultivate an opponent for Amon."
Klein smiled knowingly.
Before the Outer Deities discovered them, the two immediately left the depths of space.
… …
"Forsaken Land of the Gods", in the midst of the giant cross, behind the shadow curtain.
A young man with black hair, black eyes, and a broad forehead suddenly sat up.
It was Amon!
Amon, wearing a classic black robe, reached out his left hand, trying to take out a monocle made of crystal from the 'void'.
But this time, he didn't get anything.
Amon heard Adam's voice in his ear, without any emotion: "Both of them have a persistence that is higher than life, but for you, besides yourself, there is almost nothing worth caring too much about.
"So you lost, and you lost completely."
It was precisely because Adam helped stabilize his state that Amon dared to allow the initial awakening of the Celestial Worthy's will.
Amon curled the corner of his mouth, seemingly wanting to respond with a smile, but found that he couldn't smile.
Adam's voice continued to come from the shadows: "As a born Full Mythical Creature, although you know what courage and sacrifice are, it is difficult for you to understand."
Amon's expression changed slightly. He lowered his head and remained silent for a long time before suddenly raising his head and saying: "Next, I plan to leave here and sneak into the cosmos. It must be much more exciting and stimulating than the real world!"
Adam said again: "Klein's summary of you is very thorough. It seems that you have long prepared a way out for yourself."
He paused and then said: "But it's very dangerous there. Before I succeed, I can't provide any more help."
Amon said nothing more and disappeared into the shadow curtain.
… …
Hobert had just returned to the Angel palace, rested for a while, and was pulled into the 'Sefirah Castle' again.
At this time, Klein, who had gone to the kingdom of the Evernight Goddess and brought back the Magic Mirror Arrodes, was sitting in the 'Fool's' seat, smiling as he watched the members appear one by one.
The sudden summons obviously took the members such as 'Justice' Audrey by surprise, making them a little surprised and astonished. Even the most insensitive member among them smelled an atmosphere of unease.
At this time, Klein, who was the real 'Fool', said in a somewhat hoarse voice: "This is a temporary gathering!"
Audrey keenly heard from his voice that Mr. Fool was very tired.
Then she discovered that Hobert, who was sitting in the 'Emperor's' seat opposite, also seemed very tired.
Two consecutive fierce battles, coupled with the fact that the divinity in Hobert's body was still somewhat active, even a god would be tired.
Combined with the strange celestial phenomena that had appeared before, Audrey guessed that something major must have happened in the extraordinary world.
She looked around and stood up as usual, saluting the head of the mottled long table: "Good afternoon, Mr. Fool."
After the greetings were over, Klein said in a low voice: "I will enter a slumber."
Hearing this sentence, members such as 'Hanged Man' Alger felt a sinking in their hearts, and even felt somewhat flustered, not understanding why such a thing would happen.
"This involves a war Above the Sequences." Klein explained again.
Only then did the other members breathe a sigh of relief. Alger in particular immediately thought: Could this be the war in which Mr. Fool obtained the corresponding power of 'Above the Sequence'? In this war, Mr. Fool successfully retrieved the authority, but had to rest for a period of time?
"Hermit" Cattleya suspected: Could it be that during the war, the Convergence of Beyonder characteristics caused great pressure on Mr. Fool's spirit, so he needed to slumber to relieve it?
The other members also had similar guesses, which were based on the conjectures they encountered when they were promoted.
Even at their current level, they would feel very tired when they were just promoted, let alone Mr. Fool who had regained the authority of the 'Outer Deities'.
Although they were not very clear whether this was the correct answer, their flustered emotions disappeared without a trace.
Klein looked around at the other members, and then said: "Next, there is a long-term commission issued to all members:
"Spread my name more widely, but do not conflict with the orthodox churches. This will help me wake up."
He planned to increase the number of his anchors, which might be helpful in the battle against the Celestial Worthy in dreams.
"The reward is the convenience you have enjoyed in the past, the responses you have received, and the corresponding help you will receive when you pray in the future." Klein said unhurriedly: "After I slumber, I can still respond to prayers to a certain extent."
It's just that most of the time 'The World' will respond to prayers, and the so-called 'certain extent' probably means what a King of Angels can do.
Regarding Mr. Fool's request, the Tarot Club members present did not find it difficult. Most of them were spreading the faith of 'The Fool' to varying degrees.
"Yes, Mr. Fool!"
So the Tarot Club members accepted this long-term commission without any hesitation.
"The Fool" Klein nodded slightly and turned his gaze to Cattleya: "The previous commission: collecting information from all aspects of the sudden revival of the 'Hidden Sage' is still valid.
"If key information can be collected, the reward is a wish."
Cattleya was silent for a second or two before saying: "I accept this commission."
Following this, Klein assigned tasks to the other members one by one. "The Sun" Derrick's task was to protect the new City of Silver, with the reward being to become a blessed of "The Fool."
"The Magician" Fors's task was to protect the Abraham family and prevent them from being tempted by the stars, with the reward being to help her prepare the "Traveler" ritual.
"The Moon" Emlyn's task was to establish a pharmaceutical company to research how to mass-produce potions with magical effects, and the reward was also a wish.
"The Star" Leonard's task was to create a poem praising the deeds of "The Fool," which made Leonard somewhat embarrassed, but he eventually agreed, and the reward was also a wish.
"Justice" Audrey's task was to actively approach the "Psychology Alchemists," and if the opportunity arose, she could control the organization with the help of "The Emperor," with the reward still being a wish.
"The Hanged Man" Alger's task was not specified by "The Fool." He only said, "After a while, you will know what your task is."
The reward for Alger was the "Sea God Scepter."
Finally, when it came to "The Emperor," Klein said, "Your task... Well, it can't be called a task. What you will do next is the key to whether I can wake up as soon as possible."
"Although it looks very dangerous and there will be some twists and turns, you will definitely succeed."
Hobert looked at "The Fool": "Is this a prophecy?"
"No, this is a blessing," Klein said slowly as before.
After all, both "The Fool" and "The Error" had some authority over fate. And "He" had the symbolism of the Beacon of Destiny, the guide of the tributaries of the River of Fate.
"Thank you," Hobert said.
The other members noticed that the tone of the conversation between the two was more like friends than the previous superior-subordinate relationship.
After explaining to each member, he took a deep breath and said, "After this, you can still gather here on the first Sunday afternoon of each month, but there will be no more summoners."
"My blessed 'The World' will be the host of the gathering."
"The World" immediately stood up and said, "Thank you for your trust."
"The Fool" Klein laughed and said, "Just don't be bewitched by Adam again."
"The World" Gehrman Sparrow immediately became a little frightened: "Never again!"
The other members first realized: Mr. Fool's humanity has increased before he fell asleep!
Then they were very surprised: "The World" had been bewitched by Adam before?
Alger had already begun a series of associations: More precisely, it should be that he was affected by Adam's ability, right? It must have been some mistake made by "The World" that put "The Fool" and "The Creator" in a certain passive position. After the battle ended, Mr. Fool had no choice but to enter a deep sleep.
The reason for adding "The Creator" was because Alger also noticed that "The Emperor" seemed a little tired, and it was likely that he had also participated in the battle for the Fool's authority with "The Creator."
The other members had similar guesses, but only Hobert knew that Klein was performing a conversation with his marionette in front of him to strengthen his own humanity.
At the same time, it was also a joke about the previous incident of being plotted against by Adam.
"The Fool" Klein nodded to "The World": "This gathering ends here."
The Tarot Club members couldn't help but feel a sense of inexplicable sadness, as if a grand ball had come to an end.
Klein added: "Every journey has an end. Don't be sad, but look forward to the coming of the next journey!"
The members stood up at the same time and solemnly saluted "The Fool": "Your will is our will."
Klein waited for them to finish speaking before dispelling the maintenance, watching the deep red stars disperse one by one.
Finally, only the star representing "The Emperor" did not dissipate immediately. As a True God, Hobert could delay his departure: "Friend, this is not a farewell. You are just going to rest for a while. Good luck."
Klein smiled and said, "Thank you."
Hobert waved his hand and left.
"The World" at the lower end of the bronze table also said, "Good luck."
Klein "Mmm"ed, beckoned to bring the Magic Mirror Arrodes, and climbed the steps to the strange light gate with a cyan-black light.
Arriving at the light gate, He raised his head and looked at the transparent "cocoons" hanging from the light gate.
After sensing for a moment with his eyes closed, Klein raised his right hand, and the "cocoons" shattered, turning the people inside into specks of light, flying out of the "Sefirah Castle" and falling towards some recently deceased people in the real world.
After doing this, Klein lowered his head, looked at the "Magic Mirror" in his palm, and asked, "Are you afraid?"
A pale white word was outlined on the surface of the ancient silver mirror: "Not afraid."
In the next second, Arrodes asked his own question according to the rules: "Great Master, are you afraid?"
The corners of Klein's mouth moved slightly: "I am afraid!"
After saying that, he strode forward, holding the "Magic Mirror," and walked towards the middle of the strange light gate, passing through the past.
His figure disappeared behind the door, which hid something unknown.
…
Atlantis Kingdom, Angel Palace.
Hobert got up from his lounge and returned to his office.
As he expected, the mature and lazy Fors and the youthful and beautiful Audrey came one after another. At this time, the two Queens both had solemn expressions and some doubts in their eyes.
"I know what you want to ask," Hobert said.
The two Queens did not rush to ask questions when they heard this, but sat opposite his desk according to Hobert's gestures.
"'Amon has fallen," Hobert explained.
Fors and Audrey were slightly stunned, but they were not surprised by this.
Because The Fool must have seized Amon's relevant authority before he had to enter a deep sleep.
"I'm going to rest for the next few days," Hobert said. "I will come back to attend the celebration reception!"
After unifying the Southern Continent, the entire imperial government has been operating at "saturation," and only recently have the various tasks finally not been as busy as before.
Therefore, the imperial government has launched a celebration reception for the unification of the Southern Continent and the enthronement of His Majesty the Emperor, and gave civil servants a day off to rest a little.
Audrey asked with some concern: "Did you also participate in the war?"
"Yes," Hobert said truthfully. "And I was affected a bit, so I have to find a quiet place to calm down."
Hearing this, the two Queens breathed a sigh of relief. Hobert only used the word "calm down," so the problem should not be big.
Hobert chatted with them for a few words and then left by "tampering" with his own position.
In the next second, Hobert appeared in his mausoleum when he was promoted.
All the prisoners of war, prisoners, and nobles who participated in the construction of the mausoleum have been killed, and even their spirits have been stirred up.
Only some of Hobert's confidants were "hypnotized" by Audrey and forgot that they built a mausoleum for the emperor.
Therefore, Hobert's nine mausoleums are still in a state of absolute Concealment.
In the quiet mausoleum, Hobert's somewhat impetuous mood quickly calmed down a lot. At the same time, there was also an magnification effect on the anchor here, which instantly stabilized Hobert's state.
The reason why Hobert felt tired before was because the part of divinity belonging to the "Original Creator" was originally in a dormant state and did not give Hobert any mental pressure.
Affected by the revival of "Celestial Worthy", that part of the will has become active, and even a part of it seems to have been replaced by "Celestial Worthy", and Hobert has to work hard to suppress it.
Fortunately, Hobert's condition has been very good, and he has played the role of "Black Emperor" before. With the help of the mausoleum to stabilize his condition, he quickly suppressed the will of "Celestial Worthy".
But Hobert could still feel a very serious sense of fatigue, so he had to enter a state of "meditation", forcing himself to sleep and rest.
…
At the same time, in the servant room of the Atlantis Palace.
Second-class servant Jeff suddenly sat up from his bed, and then heard the exclamations around him and the sound of someone falling.
Jeff was stunned for a second or two, and got a lot of memories about this world with only the Northern and Southern continents from the "original owner's" brain. For a moment, the corners of his mouth turned up: I have traveled through time!
"Jeff! You... how are you feeling?" A middle-aged man next to him asked with some trembling.
Jeff then realized that there were still several people standing around him, led by a middle-aged man and several young people.
Without exception, they all looked surprised. Two young people had just been frightened and fell down because Jeff suddenly sat up.
Jeff "recalled" that in the morning, a vision suddenly appeared in the sky, and the whole sky became very bright!
The "original owner" accidentally slipped and fell into a remote artificial lake because of this, and was soon drowned because he couldn't swim.
Thinking of this, Jeff coughed up a mouthful of water: "I'm fine."
The middle-aged man was stunned for a moment before he seemed to suddenly remember something, and said to a young man: "Quick, quick, go after the messenger of death, Grieg. If you can catch up, that's the best. If you can't catch up, explain it to Jeff's family."
The doctor in the palace had already confirmed that Jeff was already dead.
The middle-aged man, who was also Jeff's direct supervisor, then sent someone to report the death and prepared to have several young people send Jeff's body back.
Just as they were preparing to carry the body, Jeff suddenly sat up.
The middle-aged man patted Jeff on the shoulder: "Take a day off today and continue working tomorrow."
"Paul, you stay with Jeff, and come to me immediately if anything happens."
He was still a little unbelievable that Jeff had come back to life like this, so he asked Paul to stay with Jeff in case Jeff had any other problems.
After everyone went back to work, Jeff looked out the window at the buildings outside. "How… How does it feel like I'm living in a scenic spot?"
In his memory, this was clearly a world with a British style and the technological level of around World War I. Why are the buildings outside all such a modern style?
As more and more memories surfaced in his mind, Jeff immediately realized: I'm not the only transmigrator! The one who transmigrated earlier has already become the emperor! And he married two such beautiful empresses!
Then he thought of the name Atlantis Empire: I didn't even notice just now that this is obviously a name that a transmigrator would take! It's like England, France, America, and Intis. Intis is very abrupt among them, and Atlantis has the same abruptness in this world.
So Jeff asked Paul beside him, "How can I see the Emperor?"
Paul was stunned for a good two or three seconds before saying, "You'll have to find the head male servant for that."
The so-called head male servant was the middle-aged man from earlier. He was a senior male servant, one of the head male servants in the palace.
Without another word, Jeff found the head male servant who was busy and explained his purpose.
The head male servant, like Paul, was stunned for a moment: "Did… Did the water you drank go straight to your head? A second-class male servant wants to see His Majesty the Emperor?"

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 750: Fully Accommodating the "Nation of Disorder"
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Intis Republic, Trier.
Today, the capital of the Intis Republic is practically deserted, with almost the entire city's population flocking to the boulevards, craning their necks in anticipation.
According to reliable sources, a descendant of Emperor Roselle, "Roselle II," is being escorted back to the country by the Prime Minister of the Atlantis Empire and the Pope of the Church of the Fool.
Considering that the Atlantis Empire had previously replaced the kings of Feynapotter and Loen, people speculated that the return of "Roselle II" was another means for Atlantis to strengthen its control over the political landscape of the Northern Continent.
But the people didn't care about such things; they were more eager to catch a glimpse of Roselle II's charisma.

After this phenomenon appeared and disappeared, a huge ancient ruin emerged on the sea.
It was not a false image, but a real ruin, the Holy Land of Xidro City, the former capital of the Solomon Empire, where most of the buildings had collapsed and only a few main buildings were still intact!
The ruins, which had been buried in history for more than a thousand years, suddenly returned to the real world at this time.
In people's disbelief, it quickly sank again, and finally only the tops of a few tall, uncollapsed buildings were still exposed on the sea.
After a long while, people came back to their senses. Some boldly rowed over to check and saw that a huge group of ruins had appeared under the water of Midseashire.
At the same time, from this day on, a new profession appeared around Midseashire: underwater treasure hunters.
Along with this huge ruin, there were also a large number of antiques from the Fourth Epoch!
This was of course the result of Hobert using His ability to fuse all the divine power that maintained the secret existence of that city into His "Twilight Scepter."
After accommodating the "Nation of Disorder", Hobert could already "accommodate" all the power belonging to the essence, or rather, this was a kind of spillover of divine power.
The spillover of Beyonder abilities would appear at the demigod level, but the spillover of divine power had a long-term effect. If there was no interference from divine-level power, such a spillover would not disappear for thousands of years.
These powers were not Beyonder characteristics, but could only display certain angel-level abilities during a certain period of time, but for Hobert's "Exploit" ability, it would have a considerable bonus.
So Hobert renamed the "Twilight Scepter" to "Scepter of the Song of the Gods" and put it back into the "Nation of Disorder."
The appearance of Holy Xidro City constituted the ritual of "allowing a lost history to return to the contemporary era", and Archibald thus completed his advancement.
After Medici went to Intis, the main persons in charge of the Atlantis army became Archibald and Sheer. This was currently the first military angel.
Dophis's advancement was not so troublesome, mainly completed in his own mausoleum and the underworld.
After Hobert helped him complete the ritual, He transferred him from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the official Beyonder system.
The main reason for having Dophis in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs before was to consider his connections in the Southern Continent and his understanding of the Southern Continent.
Now that the entire Southern Continent was the territory of Atlantis, there was no need for Dophis to continue serving in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
At this point, Atlantis entered the era of "Seven Angels", namely "The Conqueror" Medici, "The Balancer" Christian, "Duke of Entropy" Beverly, "Weather Warlock" Raymond, "Ancient Bane" Sharron, "Miracle Invoker" Archibald, and "Death Consul" Dophis.

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 751: The Fall of the “Primordial Demoness”
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Just now, Mr. Fool sent down a divine oracle, telling us that the seal on the Western Continent has loosened.
Alger, dressed in papal robes and wearing a silver-black mask, suddenly understood his mission.
Soon, Emissary Danitz hurried in: "Your Holiness, the Church of the Lord of Storms has sent two gifts to congratulate you on serving as God's proxy."
As he spoke, he held a white tin box and handed it to Alger.
Alger nodded slightly, gently grabbed the box, and the box was immediately swept up by a storm and flew into his hand.
He slowly opened the container and saw a book bound in yellowish-brown parchment, with a line of words written in Elvish on the cover: The Book of Calamity!
Although he had guessed it, Alger still felt a trance.
Soon, he asked Danitz: "What is the second gift?"
"It's a ghost ship called 'Blue Avenger,' which is already docked in the harbor."
Alger was slightly stunned, and immediately came to the window, and sure enough, he saw a ship that didn't look very big and looked a little old in the harbor.
He calmly instructed Emissary Danitz: "Write a letter to the Church of the Lord of Storms for me, thanking them for their gift."
Then Alger said again: "Emissary, I have received Mr. Fool's oracle, and I will go to complete a task assigned by Him, and may not be back for a few years."
"Oracle?" Danitz was a little surprised. Why didn't he receive it?
Alger continued: "Mr. Fool is about to enter a slumber, but this will not affect you from receiving a response through prayer.
"After I leave, the affairs of the church will be transferred to Elder Derrick Berg of City of Silver.
"If there is anything you can't solve, pray to Gehrman Sparrow.
"Also, write in the scriptures that the Sea God is Mr. Fool's subordinate, so that all believers can accept it.
"Our faith is the key to Mr. Fool's awakening, and you, as His emissary, should set an example in this regard."
Everything happened so suddenly that Danitz was a little dizzy, but he quickly understood the seriousness of the matter: "Okay!"
A few days later, New City of Silver Harbor, on the crowded pier.
Alger raised his head and looked at Derrick, who was much taller than him: "The Sea God Church is entrusted to you."
Derrick subconsciously wanted to raise his hand to scratch his head again, but finally endured it: "Your Excellency Wilson, when will you be able to return?"
Alger shook his head and said: "Everything ahead is unknown, no one can say for sure."
After speaking, he turned around and was about to board the ghost ship, but suddenly froze, looking at the three-masted sailing ship and the several crew members on the deck.
Alger felt something in his heart, and looked down at himself.
He was wearing a linen shirt, a brown jacket, and wide-leg pants popular in the Rorsted Archipelago, with a special belt around his waist.
The corners of Alger's mouth turned up slightly, and he suddenly rose into the air and landed on the deck of the "Blue Avenger", looking at the endless blue sea: "Sail!"
...
On the last day of July, Hobert stood on the edge of Antarctica, gazing at this dark land.
The last time I came here, it was polar night, and this time it is still polar night.
The entire continent looks dark, with a sense of "no-go zone."
Since the end of Hobert's apotheosis ceremony, He has wanted to "visit" the "Primordial Demoness."
But because he was not sure, he did not come to Antarctica to find the "Primordial Demoness" until now, after he had accommodated the "Nation of Disorder."
Coming again to the huge ice wall building where the "Primordial Demoness" was discovered before, there is no vitality here, only the stone statue of the Outer God is still freezing in the ice and snow.
Standing on the high ice wall, Hobert spread his spirituality to the entire Antarctic. Because of the particularity of Antarctica, nothing can be found by exploring in this way.
But Hobert had a plan. He took out a Beyonder characteristic of the "Demoness of Catastrophe" from the "Nation of Disorder" and used this characteristic to form a "Connection."
Although it seems that no clues have been found for a while, Hobert is not discouraged and continues to formed "Connection."
He is very sure that with his current level, using an angel-level Beyonder characteristic, it is only a matter of time to "Connection" with the gods of this pathway.
If it was just the "Black Emperor", Hobert would not be so sure, but He is now "half a Great Old One!"
This is not doing "physical" "Connection", but doing "authority" Connection.
Unless the "Primordial Demoness" is not a true god, or She is not on the "Witch" pathway.
After associating for more than ten seconds, Hobert disappeared in place and appeared in the Astral World.
It turned out that the "Primordial Demoness" also knew that Hobert would chase Her down in his usual style, so He simply left Antarctica and hid in the Astral World.
This is more convenient for Hobert to find. There is no ice and snow in Antarctica as an obstacle, and the "Primordial Demoness" does not have much advantage here.
At first glance, the Astral World is similar to the Spirit World. It is also divided into two parts by the barrier formed by the "Original Creator".
There is the part of the earth, and the part outside the earth.
It's just that there seem to be no strange creatures in the Astral World. All directions are like a cosmos, which looks boundless and even too large to have a sense of direction.
The "Primordial Demoness" is in such a bad state that He certainly does not dare to stay in the Astral World outside the earth for a long time, otherwise His Beyonder characteristics may be snatched by the Outer Deities.
After another search, Hobert finally found only a very simple mirror.
This made Him frown, because the Beyonder characteristics in His hand have been pointing to this mirror!
This was a bit unexpected for Hobert: Is this mirror very special to the "Primordial Demoness"?
Otherwise, how could it deceive His "Connection"?
Hobert used this mirror to "Connection" with the "Primordial Demoness", but failed. This is a strange mirror that cannot be used to trace Her.
He turned around the mirror. In the dim starlight, the simple mirror reflected a little starlight, which looked like a scene from a science fiction movie Hobert had watched.
In the vast universe, there is something that does not belong to the universe, reflecting the faint light of the cosmos.
There is nothing in the simple mirror, not even Hobert's shadow.
This reminded Hobert of the dream he had a long time ago. In the dream, He also did not see himself in the mirror. As a result, he met the "Primordial Demoness" a few days later.
At that time, Hobert thought that the mirror that could not reflect himself and the beautiful female ghost were spirituality reminding him that he was about to encounter the "Primordial Demoness", who he could not deal with at the time.
But I didn't expect that the dream seemed to have other indications.
Standing in front of the simple mirror, Hobert recalled the dream again, but did not recall any clues.
Hobert stood close to the mirror, expecting the "Primordial Demoness" to reach out from the mirror and attack him.
But nothing happened. Because it was close enough, Hobert could feel the simple and heavy aura of this mirror. This aura was a bit like the "Bell of Order".
He immediately thought of the "Demoness Sect's" propaganda for Cheek: the first and last born from the Creator's body are the true successors of the Creator.
This propaganda is a bit of self-advancement. In Hobert's view, the Original Creator successors are more like the "God Almighty" and the "Lord of Mysteries", and the "Son of Chaos" is more like a successor than Cheek.
The "First and Last" may be an exaggerated description of the corresponding authority, and Hobert guessed that the so-called successor may be saying that Cheek once inherited something from the original Creator?
And the thing Cheek inherited is the mirror in front of him?
Of course, this thing must have been transformed by Cheek. After all, even the specific life form of the Original Creator is full of uncertainty, so it is impossible to use a mirror!
Thinking of this, Hobert's main body, hiding inside the "Nation of Disorder", immediately rang the "Bell of Order".
Boom~
The simple mirror in front of him immediately cracked, and completely shattered in the next second.
Hobert was slightly stunned. This mirror does not seem to have been inherited from the Original Creator! Otherwise, how could it break with one shock?
Immediately afterwards, the Beyonder characteristics in the substitute's hand began to form a "Connection" with a new target again. Before he could think about it, Hobert took the substitute to find it. From the broken mirror, strips of thick hair like pythons stretched out.
At this time, the eyes at the top of these hairs were all open, and Hobert's substitute was covered with a thin layer of gray, as if it would be petrified in the next second.
Obviously, the "Primordial Demoness" saw that his arrangement had not stopped Hobert, so he simply took the initiative to attack!
The body of Hobert's substitute immediately expanded, becoming a tall and mighty image, wearing exquisite armor, with a handsome cloak on his back.
His body was surrounded by constantly changing mystical symbols, which looked sacred and distorted.
The substitute in the mythical creature state raised his hand towards the fragments of the mirror and dragged the "Primordial Demoness" with countless python-like hairs out of the mirror.
This very beautiful god, like a tall giant, looked at the eyes of the substitute with illusory beautiful eyes.
In the eyes of the substitute, the Astral World suddenly collapsed, the gods fell from high places, and the Outer Deities invaded!
This was a scene of doomsday, which caused a serious impact on the substitute's mind, and he stood there motionless.
Hobert's main body ignored the substitute and raised his hand towards the "Primordial Demoness". The pythons on Cheek's head suddenly turned into strips of rags. Hobert "Transformed" the "Primordial Demoness's" head into a broken mop.
Cheek's whole body stiffened, standing there like a mop pole.
In the next moment, Hobert used the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to "magnify" the power of the "Sword of Disorder", turning the single "Sword of Disorder" into a rain of swords!
Boom~
The rain of swords hit Cheek, and it exploded violently! It was as if the "Sword of Disorder" had stabbed the "Primordial Demoness" and launched a more violent attack in the form of "self-destruction".
But soon, Cheek, with a mop head on his shoulder, had a response. With a "crash", he turned into a very simple mirror and was shattered by the "Sword of Disorder" Rain.
Not far away, the "Primordial Demoness's" main body, which had just appeared, also exploded immediately and turned into ashes.
It turned out that Hobert used his level to "change" the rules of the "Mirror Substitute" ability. As long as the "Mirror Substitute" was hit, it was equivalent to hitting the main body.
Looking at the "Primordial Demoness" turning into dust, Hobert couldn't help frowning, feeling that the "Primordial Demoness" was weaker than expected.
But in the next second, a simple mirror appeared above the dust, and there was a projection of Cheek in it. The "Primordial Demoness", who had already turned into ashes, immediately reformed and turned into a complete Cheek again.
At this time, "Mirror Cheek" said to Hobert without any expression: "The Seven Gods didn't kill me back then, do you think you can kill me by yourself?"
Hobert did not look at the simple mirror and fell into deep thought, while the substitute, who had just recovered his state, was fighting with the "Primordial Demoness" in the Astral World.
"Mirror Cheek" did not attack Hobert, but stared at Hobert's main body.
After about two or three seconds, Hobert suddenly said: "I understand! I understand how the Witch pathway is resurrected!
"When I killed the 'Demoness of Unaging' before, I thought that their spiritual bodies returned to arrangements such as puppets or substitute bodies to complete the resurrection process.
"Now it seems that it is not like that. They should have put a part of themselves in the 'Mirror World' connected to a mirror reflection.
"After they die, their spiritual bodies will fly into a mirror, merge with the reflection in the mirror, then return to the real world from the 'Mirror World' and complete the recovery of the Beyonder characteristics.
"And after reaching the level of the gods of this pathway, they should be completely divided into two, with the distinction between 'Mirror Cheek' and 'True Cheek'.
"Because your state is not good, the state of 'True Cheek' is not very good, but the state of 'Mirror Cheek' seems to be okay.
"This is also why some gods know that your state is very bad, while some gods know that your state is not that bad, because they are not encountering the same Cheek.
"Of course, this cannot escape the eyes of the gods, but They do not have the habit of explaining to believers or others, they will only remind: 'The state of the Primordial Demoness is not too bad.'"
He finally understood what the dream was hinting at Him: The "person in the mirror" is the key!
"Mirror Cheek", who lacked the breath of a living person, said: "What can you do even if you know? Even if you become a Great Old One, you can't completely kill me."
"No, you simply don't understand the horror of the Outer Deities." Hobert grinned: "If the 'Mirror World' is completely destroyed, 'Mirror Cheek' will be gone!"
Before "Mirror Cheek" could say anything, Hobert's main body suddenly expanded, becoming like a substitute, with a cloak and exquisite armor, as if he was in a battlefield emperor.
But unlike the substitute, a virtual fairyland appeared behind the main body. There were clouds and mist, with floating platforms, pavilions, and flowing water in the air.
In the pavilion, there was a vague ancient giant clock, which seemed to be an eye that despised everything.
With every breath Hobert took, he stirred the rules of the astral world. Around him, some rules were severely distorted, while others became ironclad laws that no deity could alter.
Breathing, Hobert, in his "Half Great Old One" mythic creature state, entered the mirror. "Mirror Cheek" turned to flee, but it was too late. Several vortices appeared on the left side of Her body, twisting it severely, many parts resembling tangled braids.
His right side became obscure and incomprehensible, as if returning to a state of utter chaos without rules.
Within the "Mirror World," Hobert was like a massive gravitational source suddenly placed in a nebula, immediately causing violent distortions, deformations, and collapses around him!
Cheek desperately wanted to escape. The snake-like hair on Her head stretched out like tentacles, striving to move in the opposite direction from Hobert.
But it was utterly useless. She was like a satellite captured by Hobert, unable to escape no matter how many mirror substitutes She used, whether turning into stone, cursing Hobert, or transforming into an abstract apocalypse!
Hobert took a small step forward, and Cheek was instantly torn to pieces by the surging power he emitted.
In that instant, a wisp of illusory black light shot out from "Mirror Cheek" and fled into the depths of the Mirror World in the blink of an eye.
Although Cheek wasn't completely dead, Her condition was extremely poor under Hobert's assault.
Hobert strode forward, quickly giving chase. Behind him, the rules of the "Mirror World" completely collapsed, and the corresponding space crumbled and fell apart, returning to nothingness!
…
Clatter~
The sudden sound of shattering startled Fors, who had just gotten out of bed. The mirror on her dressing table and the full-length mirror in the corner of her room shattered without warning, scattering glass shards all over the floor.
In mystical terms, a mirror breaking for no reason is a very ominous sign.
Just then, she heard exclamations outside. Sensing something with her spirituality, she immediately threw on a coat and used her "Blink" ability to check around. All the mirrors and glass windows in the entire palace were broken!
She went to other places to look and found that all the mirrored surfaces in Angel were broken as well!
Fors performed a divination and breathed a slight sigh of relief. According to her divination, it was indeed a very ominous sign, but the danger was not directed at the Atlantis Empire.
…
"Mirror Cheek" was gone, but Hobert was not worried.
He continued forward unhurriedly, and wherever he passed, the "Mirror World" completely collapsed, along with the symbolism of the "Mirror World." It would take a long time before it could reform under Hobert's lingering symbolism.
…
Clatter~
Sharron in Utopia Town glanced at the mirror in her room.
The mirror shattered without warning!
Then, a bad feeling arose in her spirituality. She immediately tried to enter the "Mirror World" but discovered that the "Mirror World" had disappeared!
…
Continuing forward, the "Mirror World" before Hobert became obscure and incomprehensible.
At this moment, witches rushed out of the darkness, transforming into clumps of frost, trying to freeze Hobert.
But they were shattered by pure, surging power before they could get close to Hobert, and screams rose and fell.
Hobert took out the "Scepter of the Song of the Gods" from the "Nation of Disorder." The top of the scepter, with its intertwining colors, emitted a very bright light.
The darkness was dispelled, and an enormous black mirror appeared before Hobert.
On the "Scepter of the Song of the Gods," a small sun seemed to appear, filling the dark mirror with light.
Hobert flicked the "Scepter," and the small sun floated into the air and immediately collapsed, triggering a violent "nuclear fusion" reaction.
The "Mirror World" is different from the real world; it doesn't even have air!
But Hobert "Transformed" the corresponding laws of nature, and the nuclear explosion still produced a huge impact, shattering the huge black mirror.
…
Clatter~
Saron Island, northwest of the Rorsted Archipelago, was the last stronghold of the "Demoness Sect," with a demigod and several "mid-sequence" Beyonders.
But just now, this stronghold and the entire island were instantly engulfed in flames!
The bright light in the mirror appeared without warning, igniting everything within sight!
The witches who saw that strong light were directly burned to ashes!
The last force of the "Demoness Sect" perished in this way.
…
Intis, Trier.
The residents of this city in front of mirrors saw amazing scenes.
The scenes in the mirror were different from the real world!
The residents there were fleeing in panic, as if something terrifying was chasing them, but soon, their path ahead seemed to be a dead end, and they were completely desperate.
But just then, they seemed to remember something and looked in the direction of the mirror.
The residents in front of the mirror felt their gazes and were very clear that they were preparing to escape from the mirror and come to the real world.
Clatter~
Just as the people in the real world felt their scalps tingle, the mirror shattered, and no one could escape!
At the same time, in the White Maple Palace, Roselle stood in a daze in front of a shattered full-length mirror.
Just now, he had actually seen a version of himself wearing women's clothing in the mirror!
"Female Roselle" was desperately fleeing from a long corridor to the real world, but soon, that long corridor collapsed, and the full-length mirror shattered!
However, the other's despair and dismay still allowed Roselle to feel emotional resonance.
After a long while, Roselle said, "This is really spooky!"
…
The huge black mirror shattered, and Hobert was slightly stunned by the scene before him.
Before him was a wall composed of squares, stretching out without end!
In each square sat a statue, male or female, and in some places sat a person who looked normal.
At the very top of this wall was a short-haired man who looked somewhat similar to the "Primordial Demoness." He sat there with his eyes closed, with an ancient mirror behind him.
That was Cheek!
Hobert immediately understood that each person sitting here corresponded to a "witch," or rather a "warlock" or a "witch" of a higher sequence.
Especially these men, they were the "true selves" of their transgendered "witches." When promoted to "Demoness of Unaging," the "witch" in the real world could connect with the "self" here and use the "self" here to revive again and again!
And those who had turned into statues were the "witches" who had already died, but in this extraordinary world, they still retained some imprints.
At this moment, "Male Cheek" sitting at the highest point opened his eyes, and his eyes also lacked the breath of a living person.
All the statues in the squares moved and rushed towards Hobert. Some turned into mudslides, some turned into falling meteorites, some turned into volcanic eruptions, some turned into blizzards…
All kinds of disasters swept towards Hobert, and Hobert's fingertips formed a black hole, sucking all the "disasters" into the black hole, and the endless disasters disappeared without a trace.
The next second, Hobert came before "Male Cheek": "Rest in peace!"
"Male Cheek" was very strange: "You, why, must, kill me?"
He seemed to have not spoken for a long time, and his tongue was disobedient.
Hobert said lightly: "Because you are a vicious witch."
"But, my pathway, is, chaos."
"You want to become true chaos, so you become the apocalypse." Hobert said: "Only the original creator can bring true chaos, you are not qualified!"
He stretched out his left hand and clenched his fist suddenly, the power shattering "Male Cheek," and a dark light in the ancient mirror behind him dissipated immediately.
Primordial Demoness Cheek, fallen!
(12 Chapters left)
