chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 752: Tarot Club without a Fool
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Hobert watched as the "Male Cheek" before him vanished into nothing. His spirituality sensed something: Cheek had made arrangements for resurrection!
However, after resurrection, She would likely only be at the level of an angel at most, and would require a certain trigger mechanism, so She was not worth worrying about.
Immediately afterward, Hobert looked at the ancient mirror behind Cheek. It was indeed the shape of a mirror, but it gave one the illusion that it was not a product of humanity.
He touched it with his spirituality, and streams of inspiration flowed, allowing him to perceive fragments of ancient information.
This mirror truly came from the Original Creator, or rather, it was the symbolic Reflection of the Original Creator!
If one were to understand it using the structure of the human body, it was like a piece of cartilage from the "beginning," the kind of cartilage between bones. Because it was "between bones," it formed a "mirror world" like a crevice, which was the abstract meaning of the ancient mirror.
But this structure also possessed the authority to project images. From this perspective, it was more like the "original" retina.
Hobert could thus confirm that the "Original Creator" did not possess a human form. Otherwise, the "parts" on Him would not have such vastly different dual meanings in Hobert's anthropomorphic understanding.
Of course, it was also possible that the "Original Creator" was an abstract life form. Even if it had a human form, it would be impossible to understand its internal structure.
Hobert understood this very well. After accommodating the "Nation of Disorder," his own life form could no longer be understood by human cognition.
It could only be compared to human organs, but could not be accurately described.
Hobert deactivated his Mythical Creature form and touched the ancient mirror surface. Instantly, he felt that he had obtained the authority to reconstruct the "Mirror World!"
At the same time, he also sensed that this authority was triggered by the "Black Emperor" pathway and the Sefirah "Nation of Disorder," or more directly, the Sefirah and characteristics of the "Son of Chaos."
Even the "Primordial Demoness" could only construct a secret space like a kingdom of gods in the "Mirror World." She had never completely fully controlled this mirror, otherwise she would have been invincible in the "Mirror World."
Hobert smiled. It seemed that the "Son of Chaos" had not lied in some respects. The "Disorder" indeed had the authority to "Transform," and the "Son of Chaos" had a very close connection with the "Original Creator."
Taking a deep breath, Hobert grasped the ancient mirror, and with his other hand holding the "Scepter of the Song of the Gods," the already collapsed "Mirror World" suddenly underwent a dramatic change.
...
In the one or two minutes before and after the "Primordial Demoness" fell, the whole world was plunged into panic. According to later statistics, eighty percent of the mirrors in the Northern and Southern continents suddenly shattered.
The remaining twenty percent of the mirrors no longer had any function as mirrors.
For example, rivers no longer reflected the scenery on both banks. For example, mirrors hanging on the wall showed nothing, only emptiness.
The panic of ordinary people was that it seemed that nothing in this world could see their appearance.
This would have a huge impact on ordinary people's self-awareness!
The panic of Beyonders was that all abilities related to mirrors had failed, such as "Mirror Divination," "Mirror Blink," and so on.
The Beyonder world would experience a huge gap.
Sharron, as an "Ancient Bane," gradually calmed down after the initial worry.
She could sense that the "Mirror World" had undergone a huge change, but such a change was only temporary.
According to the relevant laws of the Beyonder world, even if the "Mirror World" disappeared for some reason, it could reconstruct itself after a period of time.
However, the reconstructed "Mirror World" would definitely be full of unknowns and would be very dangerous.
Just as she thought of this, Sharron's spirituality sensed something. The "Mirror World" reopened its "doors" to Beyonders.
At the same time, the mirrors throughout the world returned to normal.
Sharron stood in front of the broken mirror for a while. Not feeling any danger from the "Mirror World," she suddenly leaped into the "Mirror World."
The scene before her eyes surprised Sharron very much!
Obviously, this place had been reconstructed by a mighty force.
Originally, most of the passages in the "Mirror World" were very narrow, and many dark and obscure places hid all kinds of dangers.
But now the "Mirror World" had become wide and bright!
It was a scene of the sky. Clouds hovered all around, whether above, below, left, or right, as if this was a world belonging to the sky!
There was no sun, no cosmos, but the sunset and starlight intertwined, which was very magnificent!
In the sky within sight, there were three huge landmasses floating in different "time periods." These landmasses were covered with floating mirrors.
According to Sharron's inspiration, the "Mirror World" under the dusk time period was absolutely safe, the "Mirror World" under the night time period had a certain degree of danger, or rather, had the probability of creating some terrifying consequences.
And the "Mirror World" under a thunderstorm cloud was very dangerous. All creatures that came to the "Mirror World" should try not to approach it.
Sharron could be sure that someone… no, a god had transformed the "Mirror World," transforming the dark and obscure, oppressive, unknown, mysterious, and dangerous "Mirror World" into a "Mirror World" with beautiful scenery where safety and danger were clear at a glance.
...
Hobert, holding the ancient mirror and the "Scepter of the Song of the Gods," stood at the top of the "Mirror World," looked at his masterpiece, and nodded with satisfaction.
Although the "Mirror World" after his transformation still had parts of madness and distortion, with his current level, he could concentrate all these madness and distortions and "pile" them together, without affecting the overall aesthetics of the "Mirror World."
Putting away the "Scepter" and this ancient mirror, Hobert suddenly thought of the meaning of his authority: to change the status quo of the extraordinary.
For example, the original "Mirror World" was purely formed spontaneously under the influence of the extraordinary, which was why it had a state where danger and safety coexisted, and distortion and normalcy were present at the same time.
But now it was different. Hobert separated the safe and normal space from the dangerous and distorted space. Danger and distortion still existed, but they were easier to avoid than before.
Leaving the "Mirror World," Hobert returned to the Astral World. The "True Cheek" who had been fighting with the substitute here had turned into a stone statue. The Beyonder characteristics and uniqueness had also been extracted, sealed, and picked up by the substitute.
After Hobert completely smashed the stone statue, he took over the uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics, and found almost no corruption or aura of "Sefirah" on the uniqueness.
This was more in line with the information he had obtained before. "City of Calamity" had begun to affect high-sequence Beyonders and the uniqueness of the "Hunter" pathway due to some experiments by the deceased "God of Combat" Badheil.
But the "Witch" pathway did not seem to be greatly affected.
Immediately afterward, Hobert had a whim: I wonder if I can transform the cosmos now?
He immediately tried, but soon found that because he did not have a medium like the ancient mirror, he could only transform a certain area of the Astral World, and it also had a time limit.
Hobert smiled and shook his head: Transforming things can also be addictive.
Putting away the uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics, Hobert returned to the Angel Palace and began planning the next hunt.
...
In the blink of an eye, it was August 3rd, the first Monday of this month.
At about 2:50 in the afternoon, Hobert came to Audrey's bedroom to attend the Tarot Gathering with her.
Audrey smiled slightly: "I'm actually a little nervous about attending this time."
She casually did a psychological analysis on herself and found that the reason she was nervous was because she was worried: What if the Tarot Gathering didn't start as scheduled after three o'clock?
Hobert patted the back of her hand: "Don't be nervous. I heard that Mr. Fool is still responding to the prayers of his main believers normally. If He says the meeting will be held on this day, it will definitely be held."
Then he talked about another topic: "Is there any progress on the Psychology Alchemists' matter?"
"Actually, I can contact them at any time." Audrey said, "But I'm still waiting for an opportunity, or rather, the opportunity and reason I'm creating is still in progress."
Before Hvin Rambis, a member of the Psychology Alchemists' Council, was killed by Hobert, Audrey could still contact those Psychology Alchemists' liaisons.
But if there was no good reason, Audrey's contact would definitely be very suspicious in the eyes of the "Spectator" pathway Beyonders.
Audrey further explained: "The collapse of the dragon statue in Hartlarkh Village is a very good entry point. I heard about it, and writing to the church is a good reason.
"But I need to use a very natural way to first spread the news that I am very curious about this issue to Backlund, and then write a letter, which will look very reasonable."
Hobert smiled: "Now when I hear the word 'reasonable' that is related to the 'Spectator,' I feel like it's a very terrifying thing."
Just as they were talking, the two people's vision was covered by gray fog, and they came to the hall that seemed to be prepared for giants, on both sides of the mottled bronze long table.
All the members subconsciously looked at the head of the bronze long table. When they saw that the seat there was empty, they couldn't hide the disappointment in their hearts.
In fact, everyone knew very well that they would not see Mr. Fool at today's Tarot Gathering, but when faced with such a fact, everyone still felt a little lost.
"Okay, let's begin." "The World" Gehrman Sparrow, who was sitting at the bottom of the table, said.
"Justice" Audrey still stood up and greeted everyone in order of when the members joined the Tarot Gathering, starting with "The Hanged Man" Alger.
Everyone also smiled and greeted this beautiful noble lady, as if they had found the feeling of attending the Tarot Gathering before.
"The Moon" Emlyn cleared his throat first and said, "I think everyone should have the same question as me. A few days ago, why did the mirrors... or rather, the mirror surfaces, all over the world, experience abnormalities?
"They either shattered themselves, or lost the function of mirrors.
"This process lasted about two minutes, and then the mirror surfaces completely returned to normal."
The other members immediately looked at "The Moon." As Emlyn said, this was a common question in everyone's heart, and it was also a question they wanted to discuss at the Tarot Gathering.
"The Hermit" Cattleya then said, "I used some 'secret techniques' to explore the 'Mirror World' that had returned to normal, and found that it was brand new and completely different from the original cramped and dark 'Mirror World.'"
"The Star" Leonard also said, "We guess that a god must have reshaped the 'Mirror World.'"
Leonard had already advanced to "Fear Bishop," an important figure in the God-foreseeing Assembly, and was very clear about the church's research on the changes in the "Mirror World."
"I happen to know some inside information." Hobert said with a smile. Everyone's reaction greatly satisfied his vanity, and he felt that his humanity had become a lot more lively.
The other members all looked at "The Emperor." They really couldn't imagine what connection "The Emperor" or "The Creator" had with the "Mirror World."
Seeing that his words had attracted everyone's attention, Hobert continued, "The reason why the 'Mirror World' changed was because 'The Creator' and 'Primordial Demoness' had a fierce battle at that time!"
Emlyn nodded: "I see."
That made sense. A god fought in the "Mirror World," which caused the abnormalities in the mirror surfaces all over the world.
Leonard sighed: The battle between gods is too terrifying. It can have a huge impact on a global scale!
Just as Alger was about to ask how the victory or defeat was, Hobert continued, "On that day, the 'Primordial Demoness' fell, and 'The Creator' transformed the 'Mirror World.'"
This news was like a thunderclap in the hall. The other members, including "The World," were so surprised that they couldn't speak for the next two or three seconds!
A god had fallen just like that!
Although the "Primordial Demoness" was an evil god, she was also a god!
She had fallen just like that?
Audrey was the first to react: "No wonder..."
On the same day, many members of the "Demoness Research Society" also experienced spiritual instability and suddenly became in very bad condition.
But after that day, everything seemed to have returned to normal.
After a few more seconds, Alger cleared his throat and asked, "Did the Primordial Demoness completely fall?"
"There should still be means of resurrection." Hobert replied, "According to the investigation these past few days, I found that in some remote islands of the Rorsted Archipelago, there are still believers in the 'Primordial Demoness.'
"However, even if the 'Primordial Demoness' successfully resurrects, she will only be at the level of an angel.
"To be honest, I'm looking forward to her resurrecting soon."
That way he could completely kill the "Primordial Demoness!"
Everyone slowly nodded. They didn't seem too surprised that gods had means of resurrection.
Cattleya then said, "Recently, the frequency of divine battles seems... seems a bit high."
Starting in October last year, there was a divine battle that affected the entire direction of the world war, and the God of Combat fell in battle.
Not long ago, Mr. Fool seized the corresponding authority, and there was also a divine battle.
Only about half a month had passed, and there was another divine battle between "The Creator" and "Primordial Demoness," and "Primordial Demoness" fell as a result.
"The World" also joined the topic: "The end is near, and the gods are also making preparations."
At this time, the external image of "The World" was Gehrman Sparrow. Only in Utopia was it Klein's image.
He has the level of a King of Angels of the "Seer" pathway and is the most loyal angel to "The Fool"! He was once an adventurer, a great detective, and a member of the Nighthawks.
Because he possesses rich humanity, when he walks among humans, he can trigger more humanity, thereby making the humanity of the main body more active.
"The World's" reminder silenced everyone. Even the gods are preparing for the apocalypse, so what can they do?
However, Hobert said, "It's not entirely about preparation. Mainly, the 'Primordial Demoness' has been our enemy for a long time. Currently, 'The Creator' has also regained some authority, so we might as well completely eliminate the leader of our enemies."
The leader of the enemies...
The other members exchanged glances, unsure of what to say about this description.
Hobert continued, "Also, when the great 'Creator' and Mr. Fool regained authority, the 'Primordial Demoness' came forward to stop them on separate occasions.
"She even supported the Paz Kingdom during the decisive battle between Atlantis and the Paz Kingdom.
"If there is an opportunity, 'The Creator' will certainly eliminate such an opponent."
"The World" was slightly taken aback: "Then the 'Hidden Sage'…"
Hobert smiled: "In my opinion, his current situation is also very dangerous."
Everyone was stunned, meaning that 'The Creator's' former enemies, or rather, those enemies at the level of gods, would be targets of 'The Creator'.
This is a hunt for evil gods!
Thinking of this, everyone instinctively trembled. That's a hunt for gods!
It sounds light, but such a thought is too blasphemous!
Since the topic turned to the "Hidden Sage," Hobert casually asked Cattleya, "I heard that the Moses Ascetic Order doesn't have a fixed headquarters?"
Cattleya was slightly stunned and hesitated before saying, "Yes.
"There are also gatherings between the ascetic orders, convened by an angel.
"We all have corresponding information avatars with that angel. Each gathering takes place in some corner of this world, operating our information avatars to participate.
"And the meeting place is sometimes at the bottom of the sea, sometimes inside a mountain, sometimes in the wilderness, without a fixed location.
"The only thing that is the same is that we all gather in front of a virtual building with several huge stone pillars. That is the sanctuary of the ascetic order, said to be the residence of a god."
The reason she spoke in such detail was that she realized that the Moses Ascetic Order might suddenly disappear one day in the future, and there was no point in keeping such things secret.
The other members were imagining the process of the Moses Ascetic Order's gathering, feeling that it was somewhat similar to the Tarot Club, but not as high-end.
After all, the information avatar must be very vague and have no feelings, far from giving the members of the Tarot Club a sense of solidity, as if they were attending the gathering in person.
Moreover, the meeting place of the Moses Ascetic Order obviously did not give people the mysterious and powerful feeling of Mr. Fool's Divine Kingdom.
Hobert nodded: "Thank you for your explanation."
Cattleya smiled helplessly: "You're welcome."
At this time, "The World" said again: "I remember that 'Dark Side of the Universe' also appeared in the battle where Mr. Fool regained authority!"
Another god, or rather, another evil god!
"That's right, but this evil god is more difficult to deal with," Hobert said. "I heard that he has completely escaped into the cosmos and is currently seeking the protection of the 'Mother Tree of Desire.'"
He indeed "heard" this news, it was information passed to him by Farbauti, which should theoretically be relatively accurate intelligence.
Therefore, Hobert would only pay attention to him after becoming a Great Old One.
Audrey voiced the question in her heart: "In this tug-of-war, did Farbauti lose? Did the 'Dark Side of the Universe' completely lean towards the 'Mother Tree of Desire'?"
"In my opinion, the 'Dark Side of the Universe' has long been dominated by the 'Mother Tree of Desire', merely constituting Farbauti's last line of defense," Hobert said. "Now Farbauti's state is still passable in the dream, but it will become very bad once he enters the real world.
"In the battle where Mr. Fool regained authority, Farbauti took the risk of expressing his stance, taking the 'Abyss' away from the battlefield of the War of the Gods. The 'Mother Tree of Desire' should be able to take this opportunity to completely seize the initiative of the 'Dark Side of the Universe'.
"That's why the 'Dark Side of the Universe' entered the cosmos."
"The Magician" Fors also joined the topic: "Did 'Devil Monarch' Farbauti completely split into two gods? Did the 'Dark Side of the Universe' take away some Beyonder characteristics of the 'Abyss' pathway?"
She also came into contact with Farbauti on the west bank of Full Moon Lake. Currently, the painting with Farbauti's dream is still under her control.
It's just that Hobert re-sealed it, and Farbauti can no longer influence Fors through that painting.
Hobert explained: "Everyone should have heard of the 'Incarnation' ability of the 'Demon' pathway, which can transform into a viscous black liquid for a certain period of time.
"It is said that high-level demons also have the ability to transform into desire, using emotions such as desire to create an incarnation similar to a shadow.
"I think that the 'Dark Side of the Universe' should have been a unique incarnation of Farbauti in the beginning.
"Because he wanted to deceive the 'Mother Tree of Desire', this incarnation was very special, and even pointed to Farbauti himself in mysticism!
"But now, this incarnation has completely betrayed Farbauti."
Hobert was already planning to help this "Devil Monarch" out, otherwise, after the "Dark Side of the Universe" completely fell into the hands of the "Mother Tree of Desire," Farbauti shouldn't be able to last long.
He continued: "There may be Beyonder characteristics in the body of the 'Dark Side of the Universe', but after killing him, these Beyonder characteristics should be recovered by Farbauti.
"So he should be safe with the 'Mother Tree of Desire'."
[T/N: ???]
Hobert paused and then explained: "In my opinion, these Beyonder characteristics are very similar to him and Farbauti using the 'Abyss' as a medium to achieve some kind of sharing. At the same time, both of them can basically reach the level of a true god by using the 'Abyss', but they are both a little weaker than the positive gods in good condition.
"To go a step further, this is an application of the abstracted authority and the actual existence of the entity on a pathway.
"Like the 'Moon' pathway, besides the uniqueness of this pathway, there is also the real moon in the night sky, and their pointers in the mystical sense are almost the same.
"And in this world, there is indeed the existence of the 'Abyss', and at the same time, the 'Abyss' also has an abstracted authority."
These were some inspirations Hobert gained after recently accommodating the "Nation of Disorder."
After accommodating the Sefirah, Hobert found that it was easier for him to find ideas when considering some abstract problems.
This proves that Hobert is also becoming more and more abstract, and his way of thinking is gradually diverging from the thinking of normal creatures.
Fortunately, Hobert's anchor is very stable, and his humanity has always maintained a good state.
Fors nodded slowly, immediately understanding the state between Farbauti and the "Dark Side of the Universe."
The other members also listened very carefully, this is very high-end information in the extraordinary world!
Talking about this, this topic also came to an end.
Everyone felt a lot of emotion about this, feeling that in the near future, they would most likely witness an era in which gods would often fall.
Thinking of these things, everyone felt a little panic: This is the end of the world, even the fall of gods may be the norm.
Hobert waited for everyone to sigh for a while before asking "The World": "Can we talk alone?"
"Yes," "The World" replied, "Mr. Fool gave me the corresponding authority."
Hobert nodded: "I want to talk to you alone."
"The World" hummed and created a communication space between the two of them through his operations.
In a space with only two people, Hobert went straight to the point: "Last week, a strange thing happened. An transmigrator actually came to me!"
He knew the answer, but at this time, he could only pretend to be confused: "Our transmigration is all the arrangement of the Outer Deities. Why are there new transmigrators now?"
"The World" smiled: "There were also quite a few souls from the Modern Era imprisoned in this castle, but before 'The Fool' entered slumber, he released them all."
Hobert took a deep breath: "About how many?"
"Thousands!"
Hobert shook his head with a smile: "This is a group transmigration!"
"The World" pondered for a moment before saying: "They were released by 'The Fool' and have been hanging out in the 'Sefirah Castle' for so long. Their fate should have established a deep connection with the Sefirah Castle, and they should meet the members of the Tarot Club one after another."
Hobert leaned back in his chair: "For me, they are very useful talents. I'm just afraid that they will think they have finally transmigrated, so their ambitions are very big and they are difficult to control."
"I'm not too worried about this," "The World" said in a hoarse voice. "After all, this world has Beyonder powers, and they should be able to recognize the facts soon.
"Since they came to join you, they should have a basic psychological preparation."
However, Hobert said: "No matter what, I have to knock them down a bit after they come. If they don't recognize the facts, I will send them to the grassroots to experience it."
Then he talked about another topic: "I told you before that the Outer God 'Son of Chaos' was sealed by 'Celestial Worthy' and became the Sealed Artifact 'Genie'.
"I recently got a definite piece of information that there is still a part of the Beyonder characteristics in the body of the 'Son of Chaos' in 'Genie'!
"Those Beyonder characteristics seem to be his core authority. I plan to try to devour 'Son of Chaos' after devouring 'Uncertain Mist' for a period of time.
"But a key question is that even 'Celestial Worthy' couldn't strip out that part of the characteristics of 'Son of Chaos' back then. I may have to devour the consciousness of 'Son of Chaos' together.
"It will definitely be very dangerous at that time. If the consciousness of 'Son of Chaos' gains the upper hand, all my previous efforts will be in vain."
Hobert paused slightly, then continued: "These two days, I suddenly thought of a way. At that time, I can ask 'The Fool' to help me 'fool' 'Son of Chaos' to see if I can get him to give up those Beyonder characteristics himself.
"'Celestial Worthy' may have tried this method too. If it doesn't work, I can lower the IQ of 'Son of Chaos', and I will devour him while he is silly."
"The World" was stunned for a moment and said, "Your idea coincides with some of the ideas of my main body."
Speaking of this, he first explained: "I can currently receive some of the ideas of the main body."
Then "The World" continued the previous topic: "My main body has also recently been considering trying to 'fool' the thinking of 'Celestial Worthy' to make 'Celestial Worthy' think that he is Klein, so as to achieve some kind of 'consensus'.
"It's just that 'Celestial Worthy' is not so easy to 'fool'. Such a 'consensus' is currently difficult to achieve."
Hobert pondered for a moment before saying: "This is a very good idea.
"I plan to devour 'Uncertain Mist' first. At that time, I can try it out first!
Then he said again: "After 'The Fool' wakes up, I can also use my authority to try to make the consciousness of 'Celestial Worthy' succumb."
"The World" suddenly smiled: "I forgot, you are the strongest support!"
Hobert also smiled and said: "I know very well that you are the best at 'fudging' people!"
The two smiled at each other, but the smiles gradually disappeared. Although they had a good idea, the road ahead still looked very difficult.
After the space for private communication was released, the hall was quiet for a while before "The Sun" Derrick said: "Mr. Emperor, Mr. World, I want to ask a question.
"When the entire sky became very bright some time ago, was it the consequence of Mr. Fool's war to regain authority?"
At that time, although most parts of the Northern and Southern continents were daytime, the brightness was very abnormal, very much like the entire sky was covered by the sun, and the original sun could not see the specific location.
Cattleya and others looked at "The World." They had such questions at the previous Tarot meeting, but that Tarot meeting was not suitable for asking such questions, so they had been hiding this question in their hearts.
Audrey and Fors had already asked Hobert for relevant information, knowing the general situation of the War of the Gods, and they were not very interested in this question.
"That's right," "The World" replied, "That dazzling light was emitted by Adam.
"The strong light that illuminated the astral world clearly is the authority that he imagined."
In response, after Klein became a god, his spirituality instantly completed the relevant divination, allowing him to roughly understand the operation of the Ancient Sun God.
But "The World" didn't intend to explain too clearly, just explained: "He and the 'True Creator' once held back the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, and the God of Knowledge and Wisdom."
Everyone was stunned, not expecting that these positive gods also participated in the war!
Immediately afterwards, Emlyn asked: "Mr. World, which gods participated in the war at that time?"
"The World" replied: "All the gods in the real world participated in the War of the Gods at that time."
The other members looked at each other in surprise. They didn't expect this War of the Gods to be so fierce!
Originally, they thought that the two sides participating in the war were "The Fool" and "The Creator" fighting against Amon. When they heard that "Primordial Demoness," "Hidden Sage," and "Dark Side of the Universe" also participated in the War of the Gods just now, they were already very surprised.
But unexpectedly, even more gods joined the battle.
Hearing "The World's" answer, Cattleya immediately thought: "The Creator" and Mr. Fool are probably mainly fighting Amon, while Adam and "True Creator" are dealing with Eternal Blazing Sun, Lord of Storms, and God of Knowledge and Wisdom.
The three evil gods mentioned by "The Emperor" and "The World" just now, "Primordial Demoness", "Hidden Sage", and "Dark Side of the Universe", are respectively dealt with by the Evernight Goddess, Mother Earth, and God of Steam and Machinery! This matches up in terms of numbers!
Emlyn then asked, "Why are all the gods participating in the war? Is it because they all hate Amon?"
This question was not suitable for "The World" to answer, so Hobert replied, "There may be such factors, but that is not the main reason.
"The gods are participating in the war because the orthodox gods all support Mr. Fool in becoming a Great Old One, while Adam and the others support Amon in becoming a Great Old One."
Similarly, Hobert did not intend to explain to everyone what a "pillar" was.
The other members were slightly stunned when they heard this answer.
Alger thought to himself: I didn't expect that even at the level of gods, they still have to take sides. That's right, after all, there is still the 'Above the Sequence'!
"Little Sun" Derrick thought to himself: In the end, Mr. Fool won, and Amon lost, which is also equivalent to the orthodox gods winning.
This question came to a temporary end here, and Hobert suddenly said to Derrick, "I have obtained a sealed artifact corresponding to 'Light Seeker'. Are you interested in becoming an angel?"
That sealed artifact was given to Hobert by the Loen Kingdom in exchange for the return of one of their angels to Loen.
Emlyn, who was next to Derrick, thought to himself: Who wouldn't be interested in this?
The other members sighed in their hearts: The distance to "Everyone is an Angel" is not far away.
They didn't know that Hobert had already prepared the characteristics to become angels for "Justice" and "Magician". If he completed the transaction with Derrick, then "Everyone an Angel" would only be a matter of time.
"Little Sun" was a little excited, but when he thought about his special status now, he used his eyes to ask "The World".
"Don't have any psychological burden," Hobert said, "Giving you this Beyonder characteristic is a transaction I personally initiated with you, and it has nothing to do with the relationship between our two forces."
Everyone was slightly stunned, realizing that this transaction seemed to be different from the previous transactions.
Although "The World" was not clear about Hobert's specific plan, he would certainly not stop him since Hobert had said so.
So he said to Derrick, "In that case, it depends on your personal thoughts, and you don't need to ask for my opinion."
"Little Sun" nodded and said to Hobert, "Mr. Emperor, of course I am willing to become an angel."
Hobert "hmm"ed and said, "Next time at the gathering, I will give you the 'Justice Tutor' potion formula. When your ritual preparations are almost complete, I will give you the Beyonder characteristic."
In Derrick's sincere thanks, this round of angel-level transactions ended.
Next, everyone shared some recent news, and when they had chatted enough, under the auspices of "The World", this Tarot Gathering ended.

chapters.content:

As a "Dream Weaver," Audrey easily guided Hobert into the dream world.
In fact, given Hobert's current level, entering the dream realm himself would be quite easy. He could simply "distort" the state and thoughts of someone nearby, causing them to fall asleep instantly and have a dream. He could then use that person's dream to "jump" into the dream world.
However, Hobert was currently trying to strengthen his humanity and interact more with those around him, especially the two Empresses, so he asked Audrey for help.
Audrey was delighted to be able to assist the "High Sequence" Hobert. This kind of feedback was "positive feedback" and helped Hobert maintain his humanity.
After entering the bizarre dream world, Hobert shouted, "Farbauti!"
With that shout, many uncoordinated and colorful areas in the dreamscape suddenly paused, then quickly retreated like mice seeing a cat.
These places were the dangers lurking in the dream world. Some were unknown fears, others were extraordinary distortions and madness manifested in dreams, and some were mental projections of terrifying entities.
Normally, they wouldn't actively influence other people's dreams, but if someone accidentally encountered them in a dream, they would usually have a nightmare, and in rare cases, it would trigger disastrous consequences.
Hobert had only shouted; he hadn't used any Beyonder abilities.
Their retreat was simply because Hobert's terrifying level made these "dangerous parts of the dream" aware of the danger, so they quickly hid themselves.
A second or two later, the dreamscape in front of Hobert was covered with thick grass, and then, not far from him, a Gothic palace rose from the ground. Farbauti's human form, a tall, thin middle-aged man, stood in front of the palace gate.
His current condition was even worse than before. Even in the dream world, he didn't dare to leave the palace.
Hobert stretched out his right hand, and a small mirror appeared in his hand. He gently tossed it towards Farbauti. The next second, the mirror was in Farbauti's hand: "I've built a secret space for you in the 'Mirror World.'"
Hobert said, "If the 'Mother Tree of Desire' sends someone to find you, hide in that secret space.
"Hide for a while longer, and I'll help you get rid of the 'Dark Side of the Universe.'"
"I believe you've already found clues to the 'Tenebrous World.' Now that the seal on the Western Continent is loosening, become a Great Old One as soon as possible and participate in the battle against the Outer Deities!"
Farbauti stroked the mirror in his hand and sighed deeply, "Thank you."
In the past few days, there had been some "strangers" in front of the palace gate. It was estimated that before long, the followers of the "Mother Tree of Desire" would be able to find him using the "Dark Side of the Universe."
"I'm not helping you for nothing," Hobert added, "In the future, you will take all the demons to live on another planet.
"I know that even if you're not there, humans still have an evil side, but at the same time, humans also have a beautiful side. Your existence will make that fragmented beautiful side even paler and weaker."
Farbauti agreed almost without thinking, "No problem!"
As he spoke, he gave Hobert a ball of his blood. This blood would allow Hobert to find the "Dark Side of the Universe" relatively easily, and of course, it could also easily locate the "Devil Monarch."
This was another expression of Farbauti's stance. From the moment Hobert appeared in the dream, he knew that he had bet correctly before.
...
September arrived in the blink of an eye.
On a mountain peak at the edge of the Star Highlands, Hobert looked at the endless plain in the distance. That was the Paz River Valley, a fertile land.
A small river flowed through the valley at the foot of Hobert's mountain. This section of the river was very steep, only a few dozen kilometers long, but the altitude drop was several hundred meters.
In the valley behind Hobert, a dam was being built.
It was the world's first hydroelectric power station. At this time, only half of the dam body had been built, and it was expected to be completed in the second half of next year.
At that time, the construction team would divert the river in front of Hobert into the completed dam.
During the previous wave of infrastructure construction, a batch of thermal power plants had already been built.
However, with the widespread use of motors, more electricity was used in factories. Currently, only towns at the administrative level in Atlantis had electricity, and most rural areas were still using candles or oil lamps.
Hobert sat on a rock, watching the people working on the construction site for more than ten minutes.
He didn't intend to speed up the construction of this hydroelectric power station, because this hydroelectric power station brought together many domestic engineers and elites from the electricity department. They also needed to accumulate experience through this hydroelectric power station, and then build hydroelectric power stations around the vast Star Highlands!
Hobert didn't intend to interfere with these construction works, because these were important but not urgent tasks that could be left to his bureaucracy to operate.
After watching for a long time, Hobert finally got up. The next second, he had arrived at the Berserk Sea amidst thunder and lightning.
This was the sea area outside the safe lanes in the Berserk Sea, and many demigods didn't dare to set foot in these dangerous sea areas.
Hobert raised his hand slightly, and the dark clouds that had been permeating the air for more than a thousand years dissipated, and the sunlight shone on these dark blue seas again.
He "Transformed" the environment of the real world here, restoring the boundary between the real world and the underworld that had collapsed due to the fall of the Underworld Emperor.
This was the root cause of why the Berserk Sea was so "violent."
While moving forward, Hobert "Transformed" the natural laws of the Berserk Sea, and took out a small glass bottle from the "Nation of Disorder."
This glass bottle contained a stream of information that was flowing, expanding, or contracting.
Previously, Bernadette had sealed her father in Roselle's tomb on the mysterious island, completing the advancement ceremony.
During the advancement process, the "Hidden Sage" wanted to mix a stream of information into Bernadette's body, but it was "intercepted" by Hobert.
Hobert had been keeping this stream of information belonging to the "Hidden Sage" in order to find the "Hidden Sage" when the time was right.
The reason why he went to seek revenge on the "Primordial Demoness" first, and then came to find the "Hidden Sage," was because the "Hidden Sage" seemed to have a certain connection with the "Knowledge Moor."
Therefore, this evil god, who was suspected of having the uniqueness activated, could have the level of a god at certain times without a copy of the "Knowledge Emperor" characteristic.
This was more difficult to deal with than a real god in certain specific environments.
The "Hidden Sage," like the "Primordial Demoness," must have realized that Hobert would come to settle the scores sooner or later, so according to Hobert's "Connection", this evil god hid in the depths of the Berserk Sea.
Because he had no physical body, the bad weather in the Berserk Sea couldn't cause substantial damage to him!
Using the connection of that stream of information, Hobert gradually went deep into the Berserk Sea. Behind him, a vast sea area had returned to normal.
These sea areas had a few scattered islands. Because they hadn't seen the sun for more than a thousand years, they looked like strange rocks. Only some plants that relied on spirituality for nourishment and extraordinary plants survived.
At the same time, those islands had long become a paradise for monsters. Some of them were Beyonder creatures, and some were Beyonders who had lost control and used some opportunities to escape here.
Hobert slowly searched forward. Finally, in the clouds ahead, he found a rolling stream of information.
But that wasn't the "Hidden Sage's" body; it was an "information group" used by the "Hidden Sage" to mislead him.
Hobert smiled slightly. Of course, he knew that evil gods at this level weren't so easy to find.
If the first plan didn't work, he had another plan.
Hobert held a glass bottle in one hand and took out a completely black eye from the "Nation of Disorder." It was the eye obtained in the operation to save Old Neil, and it was also the foundation of the "Hundred-Eyed Devil Monarch."
Hobert had previously tried to find the origin of this eye, but he saw the "Knowledge Moor," and his head was immediately blown up by the massive amount of knowledge!
At that time, Hobert realized that the "Hidden Sage" should be using some "Mystery Pryer" pathway Beyonders to test the "Knowledge Moor" or to find the "Knowledge Moor."
It was very likely that not long after that, the "Hidden Sage" had established a "connection" with the "Knowledge Moor," and the "Hidden Sage" had the power of a god.
Three years later, Hobert injected spirituality into the black eye again, and took the initiative to find the "Knowledge Moor." Suddenly, the dark clouds in the distance turned fiery red, and a virtual fiery red giant eye appeared in the clouds.
At the same time as the giant eye appeared, there appeared a virtual scene like a mirage.
The main body was an endless wilderness. In the wilderness, there was a high tower. At the top of the tower, there was a fiery red eyeball, staring at this land.
Suddenly, that eyeball seemed to sense Hobert's gaze, and it looked at Hobert.
Hobert's body suddenly swelled, and soon showed a black handsome cloak and exquisite armor, as if he were an emperor in the battlefield.
Behind him, there appeared a virtual fairyland, where clouds and mists lingered, with high platforms, pavilions, and flowing water floating in the air.
In the pavilions, there was vaguely an ancient giant clock, which seemed to be an eye that despised everything.
Between Hobert's breaths, he drove the rules of the surrounding sea areas. Around him, some rules were severely distorted, and some became iron laws, and no god could make any changes.
With the protection of the "Nation of Disorder" and the mythical creature state, Hobert stared at the giant eye without any pressure.
Soon Hobert realized that the scene in front of him was not the real "Knowledge Moor," but only the projection of that Sephirot in the real world.
Although the seal on the Western Continent was lifted, these Sephirot were obviously not truly "liberated."
But for Hobert, a phantom was enough!
He immediately let his spirituality "touch" the phantom, and at the same time, the glass bottle in his right hand shattered, and the stream of information belonging to the "Hidden Sage" was released.
With the power of the giant eye in the "Knowledge Moor," using the stream of information in his hand, Hobert's vision rapidly crossed the real world. He looked through the dark clouds of the Berserk Sea and the fog of the Fog Sea.
Finally, in the dark seabed of the Fog Sea, he found a turbulent torrent of information.
The seawater, sea fish, submarine plants, rocks, and silt were all turned into fantastic pieces of information under the action of that information torrent, and flowed into the information torrent.
This huge information torrent felt Hobert's gaze from afar and shrank suddenly.
Hobert seemed to see the other party's tension and fear!
The next second, Hobert "tampered" with his position and appeared in front of the information torrent.
In the mythical creature state of "half-disordered person," the huge twisting force distorted the surrounding seawater and seabed into a ball, and the surging force "crushed" the seawater, separating hydrogen, oxygen, and salt.
From the surface of the Fog Sea, this was a huge vortex that seemed to swallow the sky.
The seabirds flying in the sky were instantly sucked into the vortex, and their bones were gone.
The surrounding islands were as fragile as piles of sand, and were crushed from top to bottom.
The "Hidden Sage" was first shocked by Hobert's mythical creature state. When he came back to his senses, part of the information torrent had been distorted into fragmented numbers and symbols.
At this time, Hobert's attack was not limited to physical significance, but also had abstract significance.
The "Hidden Sage" did not choose to confront, but turned himself into small vortexes along the twisting force, and soon used the twisting force to "throw" the strings of characters out, and formed an information torrent again not far away.
He had no intention of fighting Hobert. The surrounding space immediately became illusory, and he was preparing to hide in the vast cosmic information torrent.
In the eyes of the high-sequence Beyonders of the "Mystery Pryer" pathway, the entire universe is composed of pieces of information. Some symbols represent air, and some symbols represent seawater.
These symbols represent the most essential knowledge, and are also abstract basic units. These seawater and air are constantly radiating the light of knowledge, but they are ignored by people.
Plus some numbers, they become large pieces of air and large pieces of seawater.
Similarly, the essence of a planet is a huge information ball, and the universe is a boundless information ocean.
They always believe that as long as they find the source of each piece of information in the universe, they can control the operation of the entire universe.
But there seems to be an infinite amount of information in this universe, and even the "Hidden Sage" can't sort it out.
But the "Hidden Sage" can escape by entering the "Information Sea." He will exist in every rock in the surrounding space, in every inch of soil, and in every piece of seawater.
This is equivalent to fusing a string of his information with the information that makes up the stone, and fusing another string of information with the information that makes up the soil. In this way, pieces of information are introduced into the surrounding things.
At that time, he will become "everywhere!"
Of course, Hobert would not let the "Hidden Sage" succeed. All the surrounding information suddenly became "chaotic," like a string of garbled codes.
The "Hidden Sage" was stunned. Normally, He wouldn't have paid attention to the "gibberish" before Him, but now He realized that if He "jumped into" these "gibberish," He would immediately lose Himself, and He would lose control because He had become gibberish.
He steeled Himself and used streams of information to create a man in a simple robe, with pointed, high-set ears and soft facial features, holding a light-electric spear!
The "Hidden Sage" recreated "Elven King" Soniathrym from information. This was a "recreation" at the level of a god. For a time, the vast sea seemed to welcome its monarch. Gales howled, waves churned, and dark clouds filled the sky with lightning and thunder!
The huge vortex formed by Hobert in the sea was immediately "taken over" by the "Hidden Sage." The torrents formed by the vortex, which could scour stones into sand, began to wash over Hobert.
Streaks of gigantic, pale lightning, like thick pythons, fell from the high sky, pierced into the water, and accurately struck Hobert.
But when these attacks reached Hobert's main body, they suddenly became "chaotic." The power that formed the torrent completely disappeared, and the thick, silver-white lightning instantly returned to nothingness before Hobert.
It was as if there was an extraordinary insulator in front of Hobert, and all extraordinary attacks would be insulated before Him.
Rumble~
The seawater suddenly surged, forming a huge tsunami on the seabed.
The tsunami was surging and magnificent, with some apocalyptic scenery.
This tsunami was indestructible, and it had an abstract meaning of "indestructible."
Hobert raised a hand and "Transformed" the direction of the tsunami.
Rumble~
The surging tsunami headed towards the sky, and huge streams of water surged into the air.
...
On Raxia Island in the Fog Sea, inside the Emerald Palace.
Bernadette came out of her palace, looking at the southern sea in a daze.
She could feel that there was a very high-level battle there, stirring up the spirituality of the entire Fog Sea.
"Captain!" Suddenly, the voice of the Second Mate of the "Dawn" rang in Bernadette's ears, but the Second Mate was not in the Emerald Palace, but in the distant port.
The Second Mate shouted in panic, "Captain! The port has suddenly dried up, and the 'Dawn' is aground in the port!"
Bernadette gave a faint "hmm." Her eyes became deep, as if leading to an unknown space.
She saw large swaths of ocean surging into the air. At this moment, heaven and earth seemed to be inverted. The sky became the seabed, and the sea became the sky.
Connecting them in the middle was a waterfall with no end in sight!
The rules of nature failed there. Water no longer flowed from high to low but began to flow from low to high.
Immediately afterward, Bernadette prophesied: huge streams of water fell back into the sea, stirring up a high wave. This wave overturned ships, swept across islands, and people trembled in this huge disaster, without even the courage or thought to pray!
Looking at these images, Bernadette immediately ordered: "Prepare to meet a super tsunami!"
...
The tsunami rushed into the sky, and the indestructible abstract attack beat against the clouds and air at high altitude.
Just as the "Hidden Sage" was trying to seize control of the tsunami, a black longsword pierced His chest.
He was slightly stunned. Although He didn't look back, He "saw" that another Hobert had appeared behind Him.
This Hobert was also in a Mythical Creature state, but there was no projection of the "Nation of Disorder" behind Him.
That was Hobert's substitute. This time, Hobert didn't use his substitute from the start, just to attack the enemy by surprise.
Stabbed by the "Sword of Disorder," the image of the "Elven King" immediately collapsed, turning back into information flow. A huge amount of "gibberish" immediately appeared in these information flows, and the surging information torrent showed signs of collapse.
At this moment, a colorful iris-like structure appeared in the information torrent, completely isolating all the gibberish, and the normal information formed a new information torrent.
However, the information torrent was only half the size it was at the beginning.
Immediately afterward, the iris disappeared, and the gibberish overflowed in all directions.
The information of the surrounding things mutated, producing a huge chaos that swept the entire world. The "parameters" of some sea fish were impacted and changed by several characters and numbers, so the palm-sized sea fish suddenly became the size of whales, but its head was still only the size of a palm.
The information flow that made up the island was impacted, and several characters and numbers were also changed. The area of the island immediately expanded more than a hundred times, forming a huge island, and this island was suspended in mid-air.
The information flow that made up the seawater was impacted...
In short, in Hobert's view, it was as if everything in front of him was "infected with a virus," and everything became stuck and disordered.
But the "Hidden Sage" was also forced into a desperate situation by Hobert and his substitute.
...
Far away in the "Berserk Sea," Cattleya's spirituality suddenly sensed something.
She quickly came to the deck, and almost as soon as she arrived on the deck, she heard the exclamations of the crew.
It turned out that Boatswain Nina had suddenly turned into an iron man!
Seeing the horrified expression frozen on Nina's face, Cattleya quickly understood the root cause of the problem: the part of Nina's composition that was made up of mystical symbols was suddenly disrupted by a symbol that drifted in from nowhere.
Nina's body structure suddenly changed from flesh and blood to steel.
For Cattleya, who had already advanced to Sequence 3 "Clairvoyant" of the neighboring pathway, this was not too difficult to solve.
Her hands became illusory, found the mystical symbol that had gone wrong, and changed it to the correct mystical character.
Nina immediately returned to normal: "Storms above! Did I just turn into an iron man?"
Cattleya didn't speak. Streams of information flowed in her eyes. She saw that "information disorder" had occurred in many places in the surrounding world. Her location should be on the edge of this "information disorder," so only some strange things would happen.
What had the center of this "information disorder" become?
Suddenly, Cattleya's heart was filled with fear and confusion. The murmur that she could hardly forget appeared in her ears, causing her a splitting headache and almost losing control!
This murmur came from the "Hidden Sage." Cattleya didn't expect that she could still hear this voice even after she jumped to the adjacent pathway.
Fortunately, this murmur was fleeting, and Cattleya's spirituality uncontrollably analyzed the murmur: Hidden Sage... is asking for help!
This reminded her of the topic they had discussed at the Tarot Gathering.
Cattleya's heart was immediately shaken!
...
The "Hidden Sage" was blocked by Hobert's main body and substitute, and streams of information from His body suddenly turned into "bricks" composed of rolling information.
These "information bricks" immediately formed an airtight wall!
This wall was an abstract wall. It was just a wall, but it blocked Hobert's main body and substitute from different directions!
The substitute tried to break through the "information wall" with the "Sword of Disorder," but couldn't break through for a while!
Hobert immediately realized that the power of the Sefirah "Knowledge Moor" was contained in this "information wall!"
The "Hidden Sage" used the power of "Knowledge Moor" very sparingly, because the more He used it, the easier it was for Him to lose Himself, and His consciousness would gradually be replaced by "Knowledge Moor."
But now He obviously couldn't care about that. Escaping was the priority.
When the "information wall" was no longer so tight and was broken through by the substitute, the main body of the "Hidden Sage" had already escaped into the information flow of the surrounding things.
Among these countless information flows, as long as one piece of information was not intercepted by Hobert, the "Hidden Sage" would not die.
Hobert took a deep breath and made a fist, and He immediately appeared in mid-air.
It wasn't that Hobert's position had changed, but that half of the Fog Sea had "disappeared," from hundreds of meters of air to hundreds of meters of underground.
At this time, gales howled above Hobert's head, because about one-tenth of the air in the unsealed area of this world was suddenly emptied, and the air from other areas flowed into this area, forming violent gales.
And under Hobert's feet were surging lava, rocks, and groundwater.
It was as if He had just peeled off this piece of skin from the earth and saw the "flesh and blood" beneath the earth.
The Outer Deities in the cosmos saw that the earth was suddenly no longer a sphere, and a huge pit appeared on the Fog Sea.
In fact, these air, seawater, etc. did not disappear, but were kneaded by Hobert into a palm-sized ball.
The outside of this ball was a layer of blue seawater, and the inside was solid parts such as rocks.
On this "small ball," a frightened face was reflected. This face suddenly protruded, trying to escape the small ball, but was "pressed" back by Hobert.
That frightened human face belonged to the "Hidden Sage." He hid in the information flow that formed this planet, and Hobert "rounded up" all the areas with the "Hidden Sage" part.
Hobert acted quickly, so he only needed to "round up" half of the Fog Sea.
At this time, the substitute came over, and the "Sword of Disorder" in his hand became the size of a dagger, and stabbed into the "small ball" in the main body's palm.
The human face on the small ball dodged in horror, wandered around, and tried its best to support itself.
So the substitute pulled out the "Sword of Disorder" and stabbed in again from another angle, and then stabbed in three times, four times.
By the fifth time, everything in the small ball had become the smallest unit that formed everything.
The "Hidden Sage" also changed from information torrents to groups of information, then to strings of information, and finally to individual characters and numbers that were trying to combine together.
At this time, Hobert's main body shot again, "Transforming" the "Hidden Sage" into the smallest unit in terms of abstract symbolisms, and "using" the laws of Beyonder characteristics to instantly precipitate the Beyonder characteristics.
As the "Hidden Sage" became the "smallest unit" in both physical and abstract terms, the Uniqueness also left the "Hidden Sage."
In a wave of unwilling emotions, the "Hidden Sage" fell!
