In Trier, the capital of Intis, at the White Maple Palace.
Roselle, sporting a neatly trimmed mustache, sat on the throne, lazily watching the performance of several bishops from the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery in the main hall.
They wanted to send Bornova Gustav back to the White Maple Palace and request Roselle to crown him as the Crown Prince.
Roselle looked at his indifferent second son, lost in thought, and after a long sigh, he said, "Come back then, but the corruption on your old father is still there, be careful not to be affected by me."
The archbishops of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery were slightly stunned, unconsciously taking a step back.
Bornova still had no expression on his face, as if the person sitting on the throne was a stranger!
Roselle continued, "More than a hundred years ago, I failed to protect you, which has always made me feel guilty, but over the years, you have never looked for me, thanks to your sister I was rescued."
He took a deep breath: "We are even, no one owes anyone anything, but you are still my son.
"Come back home."
Your old father was suffering, and you seemed to be an archbishop! Come back, but you definitely won't escape a beating!
Just then, Roselle sensed something and looked towards the south.
With a slight wave of his hand, the southern wall suddenly turned into an "information board," and amidst a series of rolling information, a huge gap suddenly appeared.
Immediately afterward, the "information board" returned to its original appearance, but a huge window appeared on the wall!
The southern sky was clear and boundless, with no anomalies visible.
At this moment, Bornova and the others seemed to realize something and also looked towards the south.
Roselle said in a voice that was neither light nor heavy, "The 'Hidden Sage' has fallen!"
… …
Lacha Island Port.
Streams of information converged on the pier, eventually forming Bernadette, dressed in a captain's uniform.
After seeing the scene before her, she was somewhat surprised.
The sea had dried up!
As far as the eye could see, the sea had basically dried up, turning into a land composed of dark-colored sand, with lakes of varying sizes scattered across it.
The seabirds in the air showed obvious confusion, apparently unable to believe that the ocean they depended on for survival had disappeared.
Bernadette looked into the distance, and in the distant deep sea, there was a huge, turbulent current flowing south, as if a huge, unfillable space had suddenly appeared there, and the seawater was pouring into that space.
… …
Southern Fog Sea.
Hobert put away the Uniqueness of the "Hermit" pathway and the two characteristics of "Knowledge Emperor."
They were slightly corrupted by the "Knowledge Moor," but it wasn't a big problem, they could be sealed.
After a little sealing, the Uniqueness became a controllable Grade 0 Sealed Artifact.
However, when Hobert tried to control the Uniqueness, he noticed some arrangements of the "Hidden Sage." Although He had not yet become a god, He was more difficult to kill than some gods.
Immediately afterward, the "water ball" in Hobert's main body's hand was slowly placed into the space beneath his feet. At this moment, He reconstructed the structure of all the atoms in the "water ball," allowing those smallest particles to re-form rocks, seawater, and life forms.
The islands and sea areas that had been rolled up earlier almost returned to their original positions.
The only difference was that the "Hidden Sage" among them was gone.
Hobert spread out his spirituality, trying not to let the torrent of seawater cause a catastrophic consequence.
After doing all this, Hobert began to destroy the arrangements for the "Hidden Sage's" resurrection.
… …
Lacha Island Port.
Bernadette also realized that the "Hidden Sage" had fallen.
Just then, the dried-up land in front of her turned back into the ocean!
This scene happened in an instant; one second there was nothing, and the next second it was filled with the ocean.
The ships that were originally stranded in the port suddenly returned to the surface of the sea, and the seabirds that were originally resting on the "land" floated confusedly to the surface of the sea.
Bernadette was slightly stunned. The super-tsunami she had predicted did not appear. Immediately, her spiritual premonition told her that it was not that the super-tsunami had disappeared, but that a great being had calmed the tsunami that might have swept the globe!
… …
On this day, almost all ships in the world deviated from their course.
The closer they were to the Fog Sea, the greater the deviation of the course.
Later, some crew members in the Fog Sea swore that they saw the sea turn into an endless, rushing "river," rolling southward.
However, there were not many shipping routes in the Fog Sea, and there was not enough evidence to prove the descriptions of those crew members.
In the end, the great changes in the Fog Sea became a legend.
… …
Half a minute before the sea surface of the Fog Sea calmed down.
North of the Northern Continent, further north of the Eternal Night Plain, this place is covered with ice and snow all year round, a forbidden zone for life.
Currently, it is daytime here, and the sun looks lazy, in a position that is neither high nor low.
On the bright snowfield, there is a illusory and magnificent giant temple.
In front of the temple, there are more than a dozen men and women dressed as ascetics, sitting quietly on the snow, contemplating.
Some of them study how to "reproduce" a moment in the mystical consciousness, while others occasionally have a rolling stream of information drill into their bodies, allowing them to better experience the mysteries of the universe and nature.
Suddenly, they first received a panicked signal, which completely interrupted their contemplation, because it was the "Hidden Sage" calling for help!
Anyone who had been instilled with knowledge by this god received this signal.
A dozen people looked at each other, and they all saw fear in each other's eyes!
Including the chief of the Moses Ascetic Order, a "Knowledge Magister."
However, no one spoke for the next dozen seconds. First of all, they were shocked. The one who could threaten their god must also be a god.
Secondly, none of them could figure out how to save them?
That was a god!
At this time, the illusory hall behind them began to shake from side to side, as if it were about to collapse.
The ascetics sensed something, and many of them shed tears. Their god had fallen!
From receiving the god's call for help to His fall, it took less than half a minute.
The illusory hall shook for a while and miraculously became stable again. Just when everyone thought that a miracle had happened, the illusory hall door slowly opened.
Everyone was a little surprised. This hall represented the existence of the god, and the two illusory doors had never been opened.
If the god had an order, a stream of information would only float out of the hall and enter their bodies.
The illusory hall door only opened a crack, and a surging sense of majesty came over them, and everyone, including the "Knowledge Magister," knelt on the ground under pressure.
At this moment, their faces pressed against the ground were very horrified, because they had realized that the one who came out of the illusory hall was not their god!
A solemn voice announced above their heads: "From today onwards, the Moses Ascetic Order will be loyal to the Emperor of Atlantis!"
The 'Creator'!
This is the 'Creator'!
The ascetics instantly understood that the "Creator" had killed their god!
But they couldn't resist at all, they couldn't even lift their heads!
Two ascetics who were not in very good condition before lost control under the huge pressure and quickly disintegrated.
The reason why they were not in good condition was because they had received too much information from the "Hidden Sage." This evil god could easily awaken in such Beyonders.
So Hobert simply eliminated these two unstable factors.
When everyone's spirituality realized that the two ascetics had directly turned into dust, they realized that if they did not pledge allegiance, then they would definitely turn into Beyonder characteristics.
So the "Knowledge Magister" said piously: "Your will is our will."
Hobert slowly nodded, and the ascetics immediately felt that the huge mental pressure had weakened a lot, and most of the ascetics collapsed on the ground, breathing heavily.
Hobert continued: "Before you truly show your loyalty to Atlantis, I will take some of the characteristics from your bodies. When the angels I send believe that you are truly loyal to Atlantis, I will restore your levels!"
The ascetics felt as if something was gently scratching their internal organs, and that feeling was unspeakably uncomfortable.
After the fleeting discomfort, everyone immediately realized that their sequence had changed, and even the "Knowledge Magister" had changed from Sequence 2 to Sequence 3 "Arcane Scholar"!
Everyone's hearts were filled with huge shock. It was the first time they had heard that even the Sequence could be taken away!
But the fact was right in front of everyone. Everyone was one sequence lower than before, and the key was that their state was almost unchanged compared to before!
This was the most shocking thing for them!
Theoretically speaking, their condition should be very, very bad at this time, even if they don't lose control.
One ascetic sincerely said, "Praise the 'Creator'!"
Faced with absolute power, other ascetics also praised the "Creator."
The next second, the mental pressure from the direction of the temple disappeared. This time, everyone sat up, looked at each other, and felt like they had been through a lifetime.
At the same time, they discovered that the door of the temple was not closed.
Inside the temple was a void space filled with mysterious information, which the "Mystery Pryers" yearned for.
At this moment, two figures appeared in the temple, wearing Atlantis-style clothing and each carrying an eye-catching black crystal jade pendant.
It was Beverly and Raymond.
Beverly stepped on a piece of ice with her right foot and said arrogantly, "The great 'Creator' sent us to take over the 'Moses Ascetic Order'.
"First of all, the location of your temple is very bad. How many members can you develop in this icy and snowy place?
"From today onwards, the temple must always be within the territory of the Atlantis Empire!"
...
After sending Beverly and Raymond, Hobert instantly reappeared in Trier's White Maple Palace.
He glanced at the few people in the hall, including several archbishops in Church of the God of Steam and Machinery bishop robes, and the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery's angel, Bornova.
After a little thought, he roughly understood what was going on.
Bornova and several archbishops felt as if a distorted force field had entered. Even though they had never seen the "Creator," they understood who this was at this moment, and bowed to the "Creator."
They didn't dare to look up at Hobert, and even if they did, they wouldn't see anything, because unless Hobert wanted to be seen, people would only see a illusory face.
Roselle immediately stood up and smiled, "My friend, it seems you've brought good news."
Several archbishops of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery were a little surprised. They all knew that the "Creator" supported Roselle's return to the country, which was why this former Intis emperor dared to return so openly.
However, in the eyes of people in the Northern Continent, this was another manipulation of the Northern Continent's political landscape by Atlantis.
Hearing Roselle call the "Creator" a friend, the archbishops were first stunned, and then realized that things might not be as simple as they thought.
Because there were outsiders present, Hobert's tone was very serious: "That's right, you can prepare for the ceremony to become a god."
The archbishops of the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery felt another jolt in their hearts. They still couldn't quite believe that the "Hidden Sage" had fallen just like that?
Immediately afterwards, they realized: Roselle was about to become a god again!
That's right, it was "again"!
Hobert's words were also meant for the archbishops present. Immediately, he simply created a "Nation of Disorder," encompassing himself and Roselle.
Roselle expressed his difficulties: "But there is still corruption in my body that has not been removed."
"It won't be long before I can completely solve the corruption in your body," Hobert said, "So, start preparing in advance."
Hobert planned to stabilize his state a little more, then accommodate the uniqueness of the "Justiciar" pathway, and devour a portion of the "Hand of Order" Beyonder characteristics, becoming "The Anarchy."
After becoming a Great Old One, Hobert could completely solve the corruption problem in Roselle's body by using the "Bell of Order."
"Thank you," Roselle said, "I will start preparing immediately."
Hobert then asked, "I heard that after you returned to Trier, besides seizing power, you were also looking for your former mistresses?"
"You still have the nerve to say that? You killed them all," Roselle shook his head with great regret.
"Back then…" Hobert smiled helplessly: "That's right, someone who can say 'The taste of a Demoness is not bad' certainly wouldn't only have one 'witch' mistress."
It can only be said that the Intis Republic is a very tolerant and friendly place for witches. Only here can they truly thrive.
Roselle suddenly became a little exasperated: "You still say you haven't read much of my diary!"
...
The Southern Continent gradually entered summer!
In the afternoon, Hobert was alone on the high platform in the Angel Palace, watching the bustling crowd on the streets.
Three years ago, this was just a small fortress-level city that could only accommodate a few thousand people at most.
After just over two years of construction, it is now a metropolis with a population of over 500,000!
Now it is the cultural, political, and technological center of Angel City, while the economic center is not here. After Atlantis unified the Southern Continent, the economic potential of Caesar Harbor was stimulated and quickly became the economic center of the entire empire!
Hobert looked at the huge city that was almost out of sight, and suddenly felt some emotion about the transformation of this land by human power.
The next second, Hobert disappeared from the high platform and came to the mausoleum in the lake in the eastern mountains.
In the mausoleum, because the effect of the anchor was magnified, Hobert felt that his entire body and mind were relaxed to a certain extent.
Although Hobert's condition had been maintained very well, he still had to constantly fight against divinity, play the role of the Emperor of Atlantis, and the husband of Audrey and Fors, but he could never find the feeling that he was Hobert.
Because he had to switch between different "roles," he also felt a little tired.
Only when he came to the mausoleum could Hobert not have to play those roles and enjoy the rare peace.
After resting for about half an hour, Hobert took out the "Book of Law" and a "Hand of Order" characteristic from the "Nation of Disorder."
Today, Hobert was preparing to take the final step towards becoming a Great Old One.
When Klein became a god, the opportunity to become a Great Old One was already there.
It's just that Hobert wasn't in such a hurry. Currently, for him, the biggest enemy, the "Uncertain Mist," was isolated outside the barrier. As long as he didn't go out and cause trouble, theoretically, he still had more than ten years to prepare, so he was very cautious in becoming a Great Old One, dividing it into "two steps."
But considering that he had to drive away the Outer Deities in advance, help Klein wake up, help Old Huang become a god, etc., it was better to become a Great Old One as soon as possible, so as to avoid any unforeseen events.
After Hobert reaffirmed his determination to become a Great Old One, he lifted the seal on the "Book of Law" and the "Hand of Order" characteristic.
Under the influence of the aura of the "Nation of Disorder," the "Book of Law" actually melted quickly and merged with the "Hand of Order" characteristic, becoming a mass of liquid, like a potion, floating in front of Hobert.
This surprised Hobert a little. He originally thought that he would have to accommodate the "Book of Law" first, and then "swallow" a Beyonder characteristic.
But what he didn't expect was that the "Justiciar" Uniqueness and the "Hand of Order" characteristic would have such a change!
Hobert did not hesitate and opened his mouth slightly.
Glug~
Like a potion, the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics could not wait to be swallowed by Hobert.
After Hobert "judged" the "Celestial Worthy," the compatibility between the "Book of Law" and Hobert's spirituality was very high. If Hobert hadn't been sealing it all the time, the "Book of Law" would have already merged with Hobert on its own!
The moment Hobert swallowed the potion-like liquid, Hobert felt himself Trance for a moment, and his perspective stretched again to the cosmos, and again to the breadth of the universe.
In a vast nebula, most of the matter was converging towards the center of the nebula, where the matter was becoming denser and denser, the temperature was rising, and the gravity and its own weight were also increasing.
According to the normal process, when gravity and weight reach a certain level, the center of the nebula will rapidly collapse due to excessive gravity, forming a high-temperature, high-density space, and eventually producing a nuclear fusion process, and a brand new star will appear.
But at this time, a sudden "cold wave" in the universe struck here, causing the temperature at the center of the nebula to plummet, and the process of forming a star was terminated.
Hobert understood that in the early days of this extraordinary universe, there were still many loopholes in the rules, and the authority of the "Justiciar" was initially used to maintain the normal evolution rules of the universe.
After the "Justiciar" authority determined that the "cold wave" was contrary to the normal evolution rules, the "cold wave" quickly disappeared, and soon, the process of star formation began again.
For a moment, the entire nebula suddenly contracted, and the center began to emit scorching light. The nuclear fusion process began, and a new star was formed!
The evolution of the galaxy continued, and the solid parts collided with each other, gradually forming planets, and the planets collided with each other, eventually forming planets one by one.
Hobert did not continue to look down, because he was not in the process of becoming a god at this time, but in the process of becoming a Great Old One, so his consciousness was absolutely clear.
At this moment, a road filled with mist appeared before Him. On both sides of the road, there were trees shrouded in the mist, their branches trembling slightly, as if they were living spirits.
The mist rolled, forming a road that looked like it would be haunted at any moment.
Hobert immediately understood: the ritual to advance to "Judge" was to judge a True God! To make His crimes known to all, and to make Him suffer the punishment He deserved! The more the revealed crimes were the dark side of that God, the more people knew of His crimes, and the more people praised the justice of the judgment and punishment, the better the effect of the ritual.
And Hobert chose to "judge" the "Celestial Worthy," which in itself exceeded the level of a God, so as long as the "Celestial Worthy" was not completely resurrected for a day, the effect of this judgment would remain.
However, Hobert did not make the crimes of the "Celestial Worthy" public, and in fact, he had no way to make them public. If he let his subjects know who the "Celestial Worthy" was, even if everyone cursed Him, it would be easier to revive Him.
Therefore, after Hobert felt the compatibility between the "Justiciar" Uniqueness and himself, he did not intend to publicize his judgment process and judgment results.
However, those who heard Hobert's "judgment" at that time were all the Gods in this world, including the already fallen "Primordial Demoness" and "Hidden Sage."
Their recognition of the judgment result was of great help to the completeness of the ritual.
In addition, Hobert was not becoming a God, but only becoming a Great Old One. His spirit body was already higher than a God, so even without this ritual, he could complete the advancement with his own power.
So Hobert did not make more preparations and began the last step to becoming a Great Old One.
At this time, the obviously very strange road in front of Hobert was the feedback he received from judging the "Celestial Worthy."
This feedback manifested after He consumed the "Justiciar" Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics.
Hobert strode onto this strange road, which was also the road to reason and becoming a Great Old One.
...
South Colson, the bottom of Moon Lake in the center.
Inside the seal, there was a bubble-like structure, and inside the bubble was a crystal clear gem, still shimmering with strange colors even without light shining on it.
At this time, in the very center of the gem, a small piece of light green viscous liquid was lying prone.
This piece of liquid was a Outer God's spawn released by the last struggling action of the destroyed Balam Empire.
Before the Evernight Goddess arrived, the clone sent by the Outer God's spawn, which looked like paste, found this place and found the gem sealed by Hobert.
At that time, in order to conceal the true purpose of the clone, the Outer God's spawn did not hesitate to let the main body be destroyed by Hobert.
At the moment when Hobert advanced to the Old One, the seal arranged by the "Nation of Disorder" suddenly produced a certain turbulence.
If it was just sealing that "gem," this seal would have been sufficient.
But there was also a clone of an Outer God's spawn dormant in the seal!
The mass of viscous liquid felt that the opportunity had come, and it immediately began to expand, frantically absorbing the surrounding lake water, so that it quickly became a huge monster composed of liquid.
The monster stretched out several tentacles, resisting the black film-like seal.
Because the "Nation of Disorder" was temporarily unable to continuously provide power to the seal, the black film-like seal gradually turned light green, and a small hole was melted out by the "liquid monster's" venom.
This hole was only the thickness of a finger, but that was enough!
After the "liquid monster" made contact with the outside world, it sacrificed the lives of the entire "underwater forest" to the gem.
Under the influence of the "gem," the plants and animals at the bottom of Moon Lake had mutated.
The aquatic plants gradually grew into an underwater forest as large as trees.
At this time, this underwater forest quickly withered, decayed, and even disappeared.
The lives of the strange creatures inhabiting the underwater forest also quickly drained away, died, and the muscles quickly decayed, eventually only leaving fish bones and shells.
Finally, the "liquid monster" sacrificed its own life!
After receiving so many sacrifices, the gem finally floated up, broke through the seal, and floated in the mid-air of Moon Lake, emitting dazzling and colorful starlight.
The people who came to South Colson for tourism, as well as the locals, saw the starlight. Everyone's attention was attracted by the sudden gorgeous colors.
The starlight gradually expanded, forming a scarlet illusory door.
A red, slender biological structure, like a tentacle, stretched out from the illusory door.
This red tentacle had translucent skin, with point-like structures flowing inside, and around it, there were also flowing mysterious symbols.
At this moment, the abdomen of all creatures in the entire South Colson area, regardless of male or female, suddenly swelled. One or two seconds later, a deformed monster tore open the belly of each animal and crawled out.
All the plants in the entire South Colson area suddenly began to grow, growing sharp mouths and tentacles like vines with thorns.
Tens of thousands of people in this area died in seconds, regardless of age or gender.
The vegetable gardens and orchards carefully managed by the locals have become a paradise for monsters.
Ugly monsters ran on the roads of the city, or gnawed on flesh and blood on the country roads, as if this resort was their territory.
The red tentacle raced against time, taking advantage of the time when the True Gods had not yet reacted, and tried to squeeze its body outward.
...
In the mausoleum in the eastern mountainous area of Angers, Hobert quickly regained his sanity and returned to the mausoleum.
Because of the sufficient preparations before, the last step of his becoming the Old One was very smooth, and he did not even experience the pain of accommodating the "Nation of Disorder" before.
He was about to check what changes had taken place in his authority when suddenly his spirituality "received" two pieces of information.
One was that as the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar," he sensed that a major change had occurred in the South Colson area of Atlantis' territory.
The other was the reminder from the "Nation of Disorder" that the seal under Moon Lake had been destroyed!
Hobert glanced in the direction of Moon Lake. His line of sight broke through the layers of obstacles in the real world and saw the situation of Moon Lake.
In the mid-air in the center of the lake, a hazy scarlet door opened, and a red creature was squeezing into the real world.
Currently, a large mass of this creature had already squeezed in, forming a blood-red figure flashing with starlight.
Although he could only see many monster characteristics and could not see the details of that figure, he knew that it was female.
That was the "Mother Goddess of Depravity"!
Just by looking at it from a "distance," Hobert could be sure that it was the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" who was using the arrangements from decades ago and was descending into the real world!
In the high sky, towering figures were appearing one after another. Some were wearing star-like long skirts and holding a giant scythe, some were high towers stacked with layers of books, some were handsome young men, some were human figures composed of hazy cyan light, and some were towering and tall figures surrounded by lightning.
Except for the Earth Mother, the other five True Gods were all working hard to stop the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
It was not that the Earth Mother was unwilling to come, but that it was easy for Her to be affected by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and become another uncertain factor once She came.
The effect of the Gods' obstruction was not very good, but only slowed down the speed of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" descent into the world.
On the shores of Moon Lake, the tourist area and agricultural area that Hobert had worked hard to create had become a paradise for monsters.
Hobert's eyes became more and more stern. He was about to appear immediately to Moon Lake, but his spirituality realized that he still had some time.
It was not that the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" still needed some time to fully descend, but that Hobert, after becoming the "Disorder," could further "tamper" with time, making himself a person "outside of time."
According to the hint of spirituality, Hobert immediately "tampered" with his own time. In the next minute, Hobert could jump out of the river of time, unaffected by the erosion and influence of time.
That is to say, Hobert gained an extra minute!
He quickly mobilized his spirituality to understand the changes in his authority. Only by fully understanding his own abilities could he perform better in the upcoming battle.
Under the exploration of spirituality, Hobert first realized that his authority had undergone a lot of changes, from the original "change" to "change and maintain."
The extra "maintain" authority added durability to his abilities, or some "changes" he made would become the natural iron law. Without the influence of the same level, these iron laws would be "maintained" until the end of the universe.
From this perspective, The Anarchy is a "changer of the universe's rules." If He wills it, all order will lose its original appearance.
At the same time, Hobert felt that the "Nation of Disorder" had undergone a certain fusion with the Uniqueness of the "Black Emperor" and the "Justiciar." The original abilities of the "Black Emperor," as well as the newly acquired abilities of the "Justiciar," had once again undergone a qualitative improvement.
For example, the "Tamper" ability that Hobert had just used allowed him to place himself "outside of time" for one minute, which was already a realm that even gods could not reach.
At the same time, the "Bell of Order" ability within Hobert's "body" was enhanced again, and Hobert's control over it was also greatly strengthened.
After gaining a basic understanding of his authority, Hobert immediately appeared in the mid-air above Full Moon Lake.
At this moment, because he was still within the one minute "outside of time," in Hobert's eyes, the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" in front of him was still, the monsters on both sides were still, and the gods in the high sky were also still!
Hobert waved his hand towards the "Mother Goddess of Depravity": "Die!"
The Anarchy sentenced the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" to death!
This Outer God's life immediately declined, and she died within one or two seconds.
But in the next instant, new vitality burst forth from within the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," and she came back to life.
Moreover, the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" noticed Hobert's arrival, and she suddenly moved as well, while the surrounding monsters and gods remained motionless!
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" did not have the ability to alter time, but she could establish a "domain" within a certain area around her based on Hobert's abilities.
Since Hobert was "outside of time," then the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" "domain" would also be "outside of time."
In that instant, Hobert felt that the avatar in front of him seemed to have "new life" and was unwilling to obey his commands anymore.
So Hobert instantly released his Mythical Creature state. Compared to his previous Mythical Creature state, his body did not expand much, and he instantly displayed a black, handsome cloak and exquisite armor.
Outside the armor, there were illusory, mysterious symbols that were constantly rolling around.
Although the size was not as large as before, it gave people a sacred and terrifying feeling, as if the world could collapse with just a flick of a finger.
The fairyland behind Hobert disappeared, replaced by a illusory and ancient bronze giant clock, which was extremely deterrent just by its existence.
Being powerful is not necessarily about being huge, but power can definitely be displayed through some details.
While Hobert's main body was changing into its Mythical Creature state, the sky above Full Moon Lake was completely enveloped by the "Nation of Disorder," even covering the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" "domain."
Theoretically speaking, as a former "Pillar," the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" "domain" should be on par with Hobert's "Nation of Disorder," but the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" had not yet fully descended, so her "domain" was also included in Hobert's "Nation of Disorder."
At this time, the gods in the high sky were the first to react.
That hazy door, and the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" who was squeezing towards the real world, were enveloped by a surging power.
This power was between order and chaos, and even the true vision of the gods could not see what was happening inside at this time.
The gods looked at each other: The Anarchy is born.
At this moment, the surrounding monsters and everything moved, and time fairly washed over every living being.
Inside the "Nation of Disorder," Hobert reconstructed the rules of this space, and "distorted" "vortexes of order" devoured all vitality within the domain, making this place even closer to the end of life than the underworld.
But Hobert and his avatar would not be affected in any way, because at this time, He was not only the modifier of the rules, but also the enforcer who could "stand aside."
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" "domain" was constantly eroded by the surrounding silence, becoming smaller and smaller.
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" also had a certain authority over "death," or rather, the authority of life "returning to the earth."
Even though she had now lost the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of the "Mother" pathway, she could still use relevant authority because she still had this level of the Outer Deities.
However, the silence created by Hobert was not only the end of life, but also seemed to be the end of the universe. Even the nuclei and electrons that made up atoms separated on their own, as if they had fallen into eternal silence.
This had a great restraining effect on the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" authority of "rebirth"!
The mystical symbols around the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" flowed faster, and the power of "rebirth" surged around her in a surging manner.
The atomic nuclei and electrons that had already split apart entangled with each other like lovers, and were about to form molecules, and then various forms of life, but the power of "silence" suppressed the power of "rebirth."
The two sides began a tug-of-war. Such a tug-of-war was beneficial to the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," because she could continue to descend while tugging.
Until she fully descended, The Anarchy in front of her could only prevent her from turning the real world into her own domain in an instant.
At that time, the battle between the two sides will definitely be protracted, and it may not end even after the barrier is broken.
Using more than ten years of battle, she would be able to occupy a large part of the real world.
But in the next second, Hobert's main body had already appeared on the back of the "hazy light gate" where the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" was descending.
It turned out that as the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" "domain" became smaller and smaller, a part of the "hazy light gate" had been revealed.
This light gate was opened in the void, one side was the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" who was descending, and the other side was nothing.
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" suddenly had a bad feeling. She saw Hobert raised his hand, and the "Bell of Order" behind him suddenly became more solid. Then, he seemed to be ordering the hazy star gate: "It is forbidden to connect the cosmos and the astral world!
"It is forbidden for Outer Deities to continue to descend!
"Cut off the connection between the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' part of the real world and the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' part of the astral world and the cosmos."
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" suddenly felt that she was about to be cut into two pieces. If she did not have her current level, but was just an ordinary god, she would definitely have been cut into two parts!
She realized the sinister intentions of The Anarchy. The Anarchy wanted to split her into two parts, so that neither part would be a match for The Anarchy.
At that time, the part of the real world will inevitably be sealed by The Anarchy, and the part of the cosmos will have to hide from The Anarchy in front of him.
Fortunately, this is just The Anarchy, not a Pillar level Great Old One, and cannot truly cut the "Mother Goddess of Depravity."
But this still made the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" feel a sense of crisis, because the "prohibition" continued to descend, so her descent was very difficult.
Hobert's new round of attacks began. He "deprived" the hazy light gate of its ability to connect different spaces, and at the same time "altered" the power of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" descent into the power to return to the cosmos.
The continuous attacks severely frustrated the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" descent, and the power of her original descent was also rapidly shrinking back into the cosmos.
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity," in an incomplete state, was no match for The Anarchy at all. She stared at The Anarchy with blood-red eyes, and simply returned to the cosmos on her own.
As the surging "vitality" disappeared, the hazy light gate suddenly shattered on its own and disappeared into the void.
After Hobert confirmed that the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" descent had failed, he lifted the "Nation of Disorder."
The gods in the high sky saw that the problem had been solved by The Anarchy!
Hobert looked at the sky: "Magnify!"
The barrier left by the original Creator suddenly became more solid, and the cracks that had already appeared disappeared one by one, immediately eliminating any chance for the Outer Deities to take advantage of and project power into the real world again.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 755: The Power of the Past
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
At the instant the barrier left by the Original Creator became more solid, all the 'Boon Recipients' in the real world looked towards the sky.
Without exception, they suddenly realized that their level had 'inexplicably' decreased, and if they were to use sequences as an analogy, they had suddenly dropped two sequence levels.
Some pathways' 'Boon Recipients' even felt that their level was three sequences lower. Although they didn't understand what was happening, they knew that something major must have occurred in the extraordinary world.
...
In the mid-air above Full Moon Lake, Hobert still wanted to use his 'Exploit' ability to extend the usage time of the barrier formed by the 'Original Creator', but he found that he could strengthen the barrier, but couldn't perform further operations.
But his actions just now were enough to make the five orthodox gods in the sky exchange glances again: This is the power of an Outer God!
The five of them transformed into human forms and nodded to Hobert, before the arrival of the end, their mission in the astral world would be much easier.
Hobert waved to the five gods, then looked at the two banks of Full Moon Lake. His efforts over the years had vanished, and the entire South Colson area had become a forbidden zone for normal creatures.
Seeing this, Hobert suddenly grinned. Before becoming a Great Old One, he could only accept this fact and rebuild it again, but after becoming a Great Old One, it was different.
Hobert still maintained the mythical creature state of the Great Old One level. He spread his spirituality, encompassing the entire South Colson area, and then 'changed' the 'result' of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity's' descent, which caused everything around to mutate.
Because of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity's' descent, everything around had mutated.
Now, The Anarchy did not accept this 'result' and 'changed' this 'result'. Thus, the surrounding monsters turned back into humans and various animals, the plants with strong attack power turned back into vegetables and fruit trees, weeds and large forests in the mountains!
Tourists looked towards the center of Full Moon Lake. They remembered that there seemed to be brilliant starlight in the mid-air. No one knew what it was, but they were sure it must be a spectacle.
But now, that spectacle was gone, and people thought it might be their illusion.
The local people who were working also looked at the mid-air. There seemed to be a revered and approachable existence.
Hobert was still in the sky above Full Moon Lake at this time, but he had 'distorted' the surrounding space, so people could not see the figures of The Anarchy and the gods.
When the locals saw nothing in the sky above Full Moon Lake, they continued to work, they all thought it might be their illusion.
Everything, everything, returned to the time when it was not affected by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity'.
Because of the blessing of the 'Justiciar' Uniqueness and the 'Hand of Order' characteristics, Hobert's 'change' here could be 'maintained' until the destruction of the universe!
It was equivalent to completely changing the 'result'.
The gods who were about to leave couldn't help but sigh again: This is the power of an Outer God!
After Hobert saw that everything was normal, he left Full Moon Lake and returned to his mausoleum.
He continued to check his own changes after becoming an Outer God.
'The Nation of Disorder' appeared in front of Hobert. He came to the 'Bell of Order' and reached out to touch the simple and ancient clock.
Just as he expected, after another qualitative change, his spirituality received ancient information again.
The Original Creator 'said': All inherent order is not the best order. It is always necessary to change the old existing order through practical considerations, so that the world can radiate new brilliance.
The Original Creator 'said': Chaos is both the beginning and a new beginning!
The Original Creator 'said': Everything, everything, is for the continuation of the universe and life.
The Original Creator 'said': The Beyonder is not everything in life, but life is everything to the Beyonder. Where there is life, the Beyonder exists; where there is no life, the Beyonder perishes.
The Original Creator 'said': Death may be the source of everything, but extraordinary can change this.
The Original Creator 'said': The meaning of life lies in continuation, and the meaning of extraordinary lies in mutation. Life can become more exciting with mutation, but too much mutation cannot continue.
The Original Creator 'said':...
Hobert used his spirituality to receive these scattered pieces of information bit by bit, and then organized them through 'meditation'.
At this time, he discovered that the information he received had a certain 'interaction' with a part of the divinity in his body!
That was the part of the divinity that belonged to 'Original Creator'.
After Hobert became a Great Old One, the 'proportion' of the 'Original Creator' part in his divinity greatly increased. Even if 'Original Creator' did not have the idea of waking up at this time, his encroachment on Hobert's consciousness also made Hobert clearly feel that he was becoming more and more indifferent.
Regarding this, Hobert had already thought of corresponding countermeasures and was going to implement them in a while.
Immediately afterwards, Hobert realized that 'Original Creator' once had great expectations for the 'Son of Chaos'! Hoping that he could make Beyonder characteristics more docile by constantly 'changing' the rules.
But the 'Son of Chaos' almost didn't work hard in this regard. At least Hobert didn't notice any effort in this regard.
When 'Original Creator' woke up last time, it may have been unintentional, or it may have been intentional. Many Beyonder characteristics and half of the origin of the 'Son of Chaos' were absorbed to Earth.
The reason why it is said that 'Original Creator' did this unintentionally is because Hobert is relatively clear that even 'Original Creator' cannot control the 'Convergence' of Beyonder characteristics at will.
The reason why it is said that 'Original Creator' did this intentionally is because he may have woken up and found that the 'Son of Chaos' had done nothing, so when the characteristics 'aggregated', he leaned slightly towards the 'Son of Chaos', so at least half of the Sefirah and half of the characteristics of the 'Son of Chaos' were aggregated to Earth.
This is why the 'Son of Chaos' tried to enter the Earth, but the characteristics and Sefirah that belonged to him were not found, and were torn apart by the 'Original Creator' avatar 'Celestial Worthy', leaving only a part of the Beyonder characteristics sealed in a lamp.
This time, even if he wanted to make some 'Transformations' according to the intentions of 'Original Creator', he had no chance.
Continuing to sort out the information, Hobert discovered that 'Original Creator' already had a high level of thinking about the universe and life.
Especially the thoughts on the relationship between extraordinary and life surprised Hobert a bit.
He also realized today the meaning of life for extraordinary.
Beyonder characteristics will cause life to mutate, which is already an indisputable fact, but if one day, all the resilience of life is exhausted by Beyonders, what will happen?
Hobert didn't know if there was such a law as 'the resilience of life'. Let's assume that there is such a law. Then, when all the life in the universe disappears, even Beyonder power can't create 'new life', what will happen to Beyonders?
It is conceivable that Beyonder characteristics will become meaningless. At that time, the entire universe will be in a state of deathly silence. What is the meaning of Beyonder characteristics constantly affecting that deathly silent environment?
At this time, Hobert suddenly realized that the relationship between Beyonder characteristics and life is definitely not as intuitive as everyone feels, that life is insignificant to Beyonder characteristics.
On the contrary, life is of great significance to Beyonder characteristics!
Thinking of this, Hobert understood why 'Original Creator', which is almost purely composed of divinity, would care so much about the meaning of life.
Because only if life continues, Beyonders will be meaningful, and 'Original Creator', as an aggregate of Beyonder characteristics, will also have meaning.
Thinking of this, Hobert took a deep breath and continued to think.
'Original Creator' also has many other plans, such as letting life use Beyonder characterstics to fight against the final deathly silence of the universe.
From the birth of the universe, the entropy value has been increasing. Theoretically speaking, after an unknown amount of time, the entire universe will become a deathly silence.
Just like the deathly silent environment that Hobert created when dealing with the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity', even atoms will eventually decompose and completely fall into eternal deathly silence.
The gods who possess Beyonder power may be able to make some changes when the entropy value reaches a certain level, so that the universe can regain its vitality.
But this move can only happen when humans become gods. Outer Deities like the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' will not care about the development of the universe or the life and death of creatures.
After pondering in the mausoleum for a while, Hobert sat on the exquisite stone chair and waved his hand slightly, using his ability to shape a special substitute.
One or two seconds later, Hobert stood up from the chair. He looked back and saw himself still sitting on the chair.
Hobert bowed slightly and said to himself on the stone chair: "Hello, great 'Creator'!"
The 'Creator' sitting on the chair nodded: "Hello, Hobert."
After the two greeted each other, Hobert left the mausoleum and returned to the palace of Angel.
The Hobert who left took away most of the humanity of the 'Creator', as well as two copies of the 'Prince of Abolition' characteristics.
With the expulsion of these two characteristics, the 'Creator' immediately felt that his mental pressure was reduced.
Sitting in the mausoleum, the 'Creator', whose state was fixed by countless magnified anchors, could still maintain his state even if much of his consciousness was taken away.
In addition, Hobert's vision, touch, thinking, etc. could all be shared with him. He saw Hobert return to the palace and meet the two Queens who were already waiting.
One of them was mature and lazy, and the other was youthful and beautiful. They were not wearing queen-style clothes, but rather long dresses with an Atlantean style.
Through Hobert's conversation with them, the 'Creator' 'recalled' that there would be a family banquet tonight, and Donna would formally introduce Derrick Berg to her family.
Today's Hobert was a little different from the previous period. He had some intimate interactions with the two Queens very naturally.
It could be seen that the two Queens were also very happy, because this meant that their husband's condition was much better than before.
The 'Creator' in the mausoleum saw that the two beautiful Queens were happy, and he felt that his emotions seemed to fluctuate as well.
Arriving at Christian's mansion, the 'Creator' saw that Christian and his wife attached great importance to this family banquet. They both wore Atlantean-style dresses and personally directed the servants to decorate the living room and dining room.
At more than five o'clock in the afternoon, Derrick followed Donna into the house with gifts.
Derrick was also dressed very solemnly today, but he was too tall, which always made people feel a little strange.
The 'Creator' guessed that Donna must have told Derrick the importance of this family banquet, otherwise, with 'Little Sun's' worrying emotional intelligence, he might not know the meaning of this meal today.
After the introduction, the family sat down in the living room first. It could be seen that Derrick was very nervous, and his voice trembled a little when he spoke.
However, the presence of the 'Emperor' seemed to make him feel a little more at ease. After answering a few of Christian's questions, his voice gradually became more natural.
After chatting for more than half an hour, Christian and his wife were quite satisfied with Derrick. He looked sunny and handsome, and was the Cardinal Bishop of the Church of the Fool at a young age, and also the Acting Pope of the Sea God Church.
The only thing that worried Christian and his wife might be that he was a little young.
When it came to dinner, with Hobert and Donna enlivening the atmosphere, and Audrey taking care of everyone's feelings, the atmosphere quickly became harmonious.
The 'Creator' in the mausoleum also showed a gratified smile.
At this moment, the 'Creator' seemed to suddenly realize something: Hobert's joy is my joy! I am the 'Creator', The Anarchy, and Hobert!
At this moment, whether it was the 'Creator' in the mausoleum or Hobert in Angel City, they both felt that the divinity in their bodies had been greatly weakened, and their state was better than ever before.
The 'Creator' took a deep breath: Since the state is so good, then it's time to work.
On the Angel side, Hobert was still enjoying the dinner with his family.
While enjoying the warmth brought by the family banquet, the 'Creator' did not affect him to stand up, and with a wave of his hand, he took out the 'Sea King' Beyonder characteristic that had been corrupted by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' from the 'Nation of Disorder'.
This was the Beyonder characteristic that Hobert and Alger obtained when they explored the last elven ruin together.
But because this characteristic was polluted by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity', it could not be used.
At this time, the 'Creator' wanted to use it to do an experiment.
Putting this characteristic on the ground of the mausoleum, the 'Creator' summoned the 'Bell of Order'.
Dong~
A melodious bell rang echoed throughout the mausoleum, making everything clearer.
The Beyonder characteristic of the 'Sea God' on the ground trembled slightly, and a small red moon 'popped out' from the characteristic, then the scarlet little moon dimmed and eventually disappeared.
The corruption of the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' as an 'Immortal' was eliminated!
The 'Creator's' spirituality perceived that ordinary Outer Deities could not do this at all, they could only completely transfer the corruption.
After the experiment was successful, the 'Creator' took a step and instantly appeared next to Roselle.
The current emperor of Intis was dating a noble lady, but the noble lady and the servants in the room could not see the 'Creator' who suddenly appeared.
After Roselle saw the 'Creator', he suddenly realized something. He was about to get up when he saw the 'Creator' summon a heavy and simple bronze bell.
Dong~
The melodious bell rang echoed throughout Trier, causing everyone in the city to be stunned, and then they were all enjoying the moment of clarity.
In the restaurant, Roselle's chest suddenly turned illusory, and a small red moon squeezed out from his chest, only to be quickly shattered by the sound of the bell.
Before Roselle could express his gratitude, the 'Creator' had already left.
Taking a deep breath, Roselle's face beamed with a sincere smile. He had forgotten when his spirit body, mental body, and physical body had last felt so relaxed.
"Your Majesty, did you hear the bell just now?" The noble lady opposite him did not notice Roselle's abnormality.
Roselle smiled and said, "Yes, it was a beautiful sound from the Divine Kingdoms of the Deities, only those with very kind and pure hearts can hear it. You must be a pure and beautiful lady."
Upon hearing this, the noble lady felt very happy, but she didn't want to show it too much, while also trying to express a shy expression.
...
There was no distinction between up, down, left, and right in the surroundings. Common sense such as distance, brightness, and temperature did not apply here.
Strange-shaped monsters lived in this domain, and for the most part, they were relatively harmonious with each other.
This was the most common sight in the Spirit World.
Suddenly, this space without direction or fixed rules rolled violently, sometimes falling into unprecedented chaos, and sometimes possessing direction and fixed rules.
The surrounding monsters fled in panic. They were very clear that a very terrifying existence was descending upon the Spirit World.
The descent of this existence immediately attracted the attention of the "Seven Lights."
The next second, the "Creator" appeared in the Spirit World, and at that moment, the entire Spirit World seemed to freeze!
A Great Old One was visiting the Spirit World!
The "Creator" looked up at the seven-colored light at the top of the Spirit World, and the strange castle above the light.
He took a step and appeared outside the "Sefirah Castle" before the "Seven Lights" could react, and summoned the "Bell of Order" again.
Dong~
Dong~
Dong~
Three consecutive, unhurried chimes caused the "Sefirah Castle" and the entire Spirit World to shake.
The "Seven Lights" emitted an even more dazzling light, and many distortions, madness, and dangers in the Spirit World disappeared! The Spirit World creatures were no longer so ignorant, as if they had found their "life goals!"
Creak~
The "Creator" saw that the gate of the "Sefirah Castle" slowly opened, and a figure appeared at the door, waving at him.
The "Creator" was somewhat disappointed, because the one at the door was "World" Gehrman Sparrow, not "Fool" Klein.
Putting away the "Bell of Order", the "Creator" also appeared at the gate of the "Sefirah Castle".
"Mr. Fool is very grateful for your help," Gehrman said. "The bell just now allowed Mr. Fool to gain an absolute advantage in the fight against the 'Celestial Worthy'.
"But the 'Celestial Worthy's' consciousness is still not to be ignored, so Mr. Fool has decided to awaken when he is more confident. While sleeping, he will also go to other time and space to eliminate more 'Celestial Worthy' and gain more advantages!"
The "Creator" nodded: "Okay."
Gehrman added: "Mr. Fool also said that thanks to your help just now, from now on, he will have three minutes of wakefulness every day.
"Although he will not leave the place of slumber, he will not be restricted by the Celestial Worthy in these three minutes, and his condition will be very good.
"As the advantage further expands, this waking time will become longer and longer."
The "Creator" said: "I understand!"
In other words, from today onwards, Klein can provide "Quasi Great Old One" level of help, but this help is limited in time, only three minutes per day.
But this is already enough, from now on Hobert will no longer fight alone!
...
During the height of summer in the Southern Continent, the "Creator" visited the Berserk Sea.
All the ships on the Berserk Sea sailed as usual, and no one noticed the arrival of the "Creator".
He was in mid-air, as if looking at the dark clouds in front of him, but in reality, he was looking at the huge gap between the real world and the Underworld.
The fall of the Underworld Emperor back then not only severed the narrow land connection between the Northern and Southern continents, but also caused a portion of the Underworld to become intertwined with a portion of the real world.
Under the influence of the Underworld, the climate on the sea changed drastically. In many places, bone-chilling hurricanes blew all year round, and many places were constantly covered in dark clouds, wind, and rain. These abnormal climates had persisted for over a thousand years!
After the Age of Exploration arrived, the countries of the Northern Continent only found three narrow, safe sea lanes connecting the Southern and Northern Continents.
Even on safe sea lanes, ships would occasionally encounter extremely bad weather, and countless ships sank in hurricanes and rainstorms.
The "Creator" entered the "Shadow of Order" to observe. The Berserk Sea was composed of chaotic strings, and one end of these messy strings was always connected to the Underworld.
By observing these strings, the "Creator" completely understood the composition of the Berserk Sea, and was very familiar with the areas under the dark clouds and in the wind, as if this sea area was created by him.
At this time, in the sky not far from the "Creator", a surging, obscure, and incomprehensible force descended, and then the power of sunlight, the power of storms, and so on descended one after another.
The Six Gods were watching the "Creator's" Outer God-level power from a distance.
The "Creator" simply waved his hand, and the chaotic and intertwined Underworld and real world were precisely separated, with no space from the Underworld remaining in the real world, and no space from the real world being taken into the Underworld.
Then, the "Creator" completely "changed" this chaos, and the boundary between the real world and the Underworld was re-established.
In an instant, the unprovoked hurricanes in the entire Berserk Sea disappeared, and the perennial dark clouds dissipated.
There was no longer any concept of safe sea lanes in the Berserk Sea, because the entire sea area was safe!
New sea lanes would no longer be defined by safety, but by factors such as ocean currents, monsoons, and easily resupplied islands.
Just as the "Creator" was about to leave, the six orthodox gods suddenly used their respective powers to project the "Creator's" figure into the sky above the Berserk Sea, so that everyone in this sea area could see it.
...
Just now, a cargo ship that had been blown out of the safe sea lane by a storm was fighting against the bad weather.
Under the dark clouds, huge waves were about to capsize the ship several times, and all the crew members did not know if they could survive the next huge wave.
All they could do now was silently pray to the gods.
In just a moment, the sky suddenly cleared! The sea surface, which had just had huge waves, calmed down in an instant, as if they had instantly returned to the safe sea lane!
This was a miracle!
This must be a miracle!
The excited crew members knelt on the deck, about to thank the "Lord of Storms", when suddenly a majestic figure appeared in the sky.
At the moment of seeing that figure, a concept suddenly appeared in the crew members' minds: This is the god who saved them!
They bowed down to that majestic figure, because another concept appeared in their minds: From today onwards, the Berserk Sea is no longer berserk!
