chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 759 Swallowing the "Uncertain Mist"
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
The "Uncertain Mist" was somewhat overwhelmed by the fluent attacks of "The Creator," mainly because He hadn't anticipated "The Creator's" intentions at all.
By the time "Uncertain Mist" reacted, it was already being pulled by the universe's largest black hole, the Nation of Disorder.
However, He didn't panic. He sent another wisp of gray mist to "The Creator," but due to the black hole's enormous suction, He only slightly loosened His control over the gray mist before most of it was sucked away.
For "Uncertain Mist," this wasn't entirely a bad thing. In the upcoming "transaction," the more He sacrificed, the more He could "trade" for.
Taking advantage of the fact that He hadn't been completely sucked into the black hole, "Uncertain Mist" once again engaged in "coercive buying and selling," "trading" with "The Creator," using those gray mists as a price to escape the black hole.
He once again used an "unfair transaction" to break free from the black hole.
At this moment, a sacred voice of judgment came from within the black hole: "This transaction is only one party's will, so it is invalid!"
Although "Uncertain Mist" had the authority to "supervise transactions" from outside the transaction, "The Creator" also had the symbolism of "judgment!"
Although "The Creator's" "judgment" didn't return "Uncertain Mist" to its original position, "Uncertain Mist" returned to within the range of gravity.
The surrounding Outer Deities and "Half Great Old Ones" were also affected by the enormous suction, and had to fight while resisting the immense gravitational pull.
"Uncertain Mist" "exchanged" the enormous suction it was subjected to with the Evernight Goddess, attempting to escape the black hole.
The Evernight Goddess was therefore no longer affected by the black hole. This was a "mistake"! It was the authority of "The Fool."
"The Fool" now began to temporarily hand over the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" to Lilith according to "The Creator's" plan. Although He knew Lilith wouldn't be able to hold on for long, "The Creator's" plan would soon come to fruition.
"The Fool" allowed the black hole's gravity to attract Him. While He was falling towards the center of the black hole, He "fooled" "Uncertain Mist."
"Uncertain Mist," who was about to use His authority again to escape the black hole's attraction, suddenly froze. His IQ instantly dropped to a worrisome level.
"The Creator's" avatar took advantage of this moment to "exile" "Uncertain Mist" towards the center of the black hole.
"Uncertain Mist" returned to the position with enormous suction once again. Because His IQ had dropped at this time, He made a foolish response: summoning His own Sefirah, "changing" the rules of gravity to give Himself a chance to escape.
The reason why this behavior was said to be extremely foolish was because the attraction of the Earth part of the Nation of Disorder to the cosmos part was no less than the suction of the black hole.
Therefore, in the previous battle, "Uncertain Mist" would use His own Divine Kingdom to fight against "The Creator," but would not use His own Sefirah to fight, in order to avoid "uncontrollably" approaching "The Creator."
"The Creator" also used the Nation of Disorder without any tacit understanding, because at that time He was not ready to devour "Uncertain Mist!"
After the appearance of "Uncertain Mist's" Sefirah, He rushed towards the center of the black hole at an even faster speed!
At this moment, the cosmos not far away suddenly became illusory. A white light cluster appeared from the illusion. In the very center of the light cluster, there was a black eye symbol.
For "The Fool" and other "Earth Outer Deities," this was a very unfamiliar symbol. Its shape was somewhat like the occult symbol of an eye, but there were obvious differences. The biggest difference was that there were two symbols representing the pupil.
This was the "High-Dimensional Overseer." He had been watching the battle from the beginning. Seeing that "Uncertain Mist" was in great danger, He decided to take action to rescue Him.
Almost at the instant He appeared, many starlight-filled polygonal crystals appeared around "Uncertain Mist." These crystals were not affected by the strong gravity!
And in the combined power of the huge gravity and Beyonder characteristics, a virtual space was formed to take "Uncertain Mist" away from the current dimension.
"The Creator" in the center of the black hole immediately made a "change" to the gravity, so that the gravity of the black hole also affected other dimensions.
Regardless of the dimension, the effect of gravity exists. The reason why those crystals were not affected by gravity at first was because they were between other dimensions and the three-dimensional world.
In three dimensions, the positions of those crystals seemed to be within the range of huge gravity, but in other dimensions, it was not certain what positions they specifically corresponded to.
It's like drawing a circle on paper. If there are two-dimensional creatures on the paper, they will not be able to escape from that circle.
But for three-dimensional beings with height, let alone drawing a circle on paper, even if you draw a thick and large circle on the ground, you can easily jump out, even if you step on the drawn line.
And what "The Creator" changed was that objects in other dimensions could also collapse towards the black hole under the effect of super-gravity.
At the same time, a dark "spring" suddenly appeared below the "High-Dimensional Overseer," but these "spring waters" were very viscous and somewhat illusory, and had no spirituality that spring water should have.
According to the plan, Farbauti now joined the battle to buy "The Creator" the last chance.
Currently, Farbauti has also found and merged with the Earth part of the "Tenebrous World." After the "Dark Side of the Universe" was killed by "The Creator," His state has become very good.
And found clues to the Earth part of the "Tenebrous World" in the Abyss.
However, the Abyss has undergone considerable changes under the influence of the "Mother Tree of Desire." "The Creator" helped Farbauti restore the normal order of the Abyss, and used the clues inside to find the entrance to the "Tenebrous World."
So now the "Devil Monarch" Farbauti is also at the level of a "Half Great Old One," but the "Mother Tree of Desire" has shown the "Tenebrous World," so Farbauti chose to use the power of the Abyss pathway to hold back the "High-Dimensional Overseer."
At this time, the "High-Dimensional Overseer" slowly fell towards the black, viscous "spring water," as if it were the origin of "corruption." As long as there is a conscious life form, there will be a tendency to fall.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, "The Creator" quickly sucked the polygonal crystals of the "High-Dimensional Overseer" around "Uncertain Mist" into the event horizon of the black hole.
The "Uncertain Mist," who had been "fooled," was finally sucked into the core part of the black hole, and His trace could not be seen from the outside.
At this time, the Outer Deities and "half" Outer Deities in the battle felt a new gaze, as if they were being targeted by a hungry monster!
Everyone realized that other Outer Deities were rushing over.
At this time, in the "Forsaken Land of the Gods," Adam walked out of the Divine Kingdom of the "True Creator." At this time, His fusion with the "True Creator" was basically completed, but the final stage was very difficult!
Behind Adam, you can still see the phantom of five heads.
When He prevented Klein from becoming a god before, He interrupted the fusion process once, and it took a long time to restart the fusion.
At this time, He interrupted the fusion process again, making it even more difficult to "completely fuse."
However, Adam once again summoned the "Chaos Sea" that seemed to have all colors and all possibilities. Standing on the sea, He once again "imagined" the authorities of "Sun," "White Tower," and "Tyrant," turning into a tall light and shadow.
He said to the cosmos: "Let there be light!"
The intense sunlight seemed to completely illuminate the entire universe. The Outer Deities who were rushing to the battle in the depths of the universe were shocked by the strong light, and the process of the Outer Deities rushing to the battlefield was interrupted.
"The Creator" inside the black hole certainly knew that the situation was very critical. The Ancient Sun God could only block those Outer Deities for a few seconds.
In addition, "The Creator" did not ask the Ancient Sun God for help. It was somewhat unexpected that He could take action at this critical moment.
But it seemed to be within expectations. As Hobert said before, the root of the conflict between "The Creator" and "The Fool" and the Ancient Sun God lies in Amon. Now that Amon is completely out of touch with the "Lord of Mysteries," the conflict between them is not so deep.
This was the last chance. "The Creator" raced against time to absorb the "Nation of Disorder" part of "Uncertain Mist."
In the next moment, the "fooling" on "Uncertain Mist" disappeared. He seemed to suddenly come back to His senses and saw that He was in a gorgeous nebula!
It turned out that inside the black hole, there was another world!
In the sacred light, there was a very majestic figure. That figure was wearing an Atlantis-style costume, with the appearance of Hobert, but it made people feel that He only had Hobert's appearance, but seemed to have no biological emotions.
In the holy light, "The Creator" wore a crown, held a scepter in one hand, and a bronze code in the other.
That sacred appearance seemed to make people can't help but hum hymns.
Even gods would marvel: Great Holy Spirit!
This was the "Ultimate Form of the Disorder" that "The Creator" had figured out after being very familiar with His own power for three years!
The process of entering the black hole just now had completely shattered "Uncertain Mist." Under the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence, and accelerated by "The Creator's" ability, the Beyonder characteristics of "Uncertain Mist" had been sealed by "The Creator."
Now was the most difficult part: extracting the Sefirah from "Uncertain Mist."
Even if the main body becomes fragmented and the Beyonder characteristics are taken away, "Uncertain Mist" can survive with the illusory, non-physical Sefirah, and live very well.
Only by using the Earth part of the Nation of Disorder to suck out the cosmos part of the Nation of Disorder can "Uncertain Mist" drop in level.
This was a feasible method that "The Creator" and "The Fool" had discussed many times.
And the method that "The Genie" said before, directly devouring "Uncertain Mist," was obviously not feasible.
In that case, even if "The Creator" becomes stronger, His consciousness will become a patchwork monster like Antigonus.
When "Uncertain Mist" came back to His senses, He found that His "Nation of Disorder" was showing up from the void under the attraction of another "Nation of Disorder," and half of it had entered the real world!
"Uncertain Mist" quickly fought for His own "Nation of Disorder," but soon He found that He lacked the support of Beyonder characteristics, just like His feet were floating in a tug-of-war, without much strength, and He couldn't beat "The Creator" at all.
Even so, He tried His best to hold on. The longer He could delay, the longer He could delay.
He was very clear that "The Creator" was more anxious than Him at this time. More and more Outer Deities were rushing over. If He waited two or three seconds, the Earth's Outer God power would definitely be besieged.
In an instant, "The Creator" made a choice. He completely released the "Nation of Disorder" part in His body. The attraction between the "Nation of Disorder" that had been torn apart suddenly increased sharply and quickly began to merge!
One second!
Two seconds!
The cosmos part of the Nation of Disorder and the Earth part of the Nation of Disorder were quickly stirred together. "The Creator" used His only remaining sanity to end the maintenance of that super-large black hole.
This was a signal to retreat!
"The Fool" and other "Half Great Old Ones" immediately used their strongest attacks to temporarily force back the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," the "Mother Tree of Desire," and the "High-Dimensional Overseer."
They left the battlefield first, and then "The Creator" was a little slower, but also successfully returned to the inside of the barrier.
And the consciousness and spirit of "Uncertain Mist" became an extremely high-level evil spirit. From then on, the non-physical form will wander in the universe until the end of the universe.
For "The Creator," it was a very crucial step to only devour the Nation of Disorder and not the spirit and consciousness part of "Uncertain Mist."
As mentioned earlier, this can effectively avoid becoming a mental patchwork monster!
Although it took a big risk, it was worth it.
"The Creator" would even rather give up the cosmos part of the Nation of Disorder than devour it together with the consciousness of "Uncertain Mist!"
In that case, the weak "Uncertain Mist" might be attacked by other Outer Deities, and from then on, the cosmos part of the Nation of Disorder would change hands!
"The Creator" will most likely completely lose the chance to get this Sefirah.
...
Back on Earth, "The Creator" didn't have time to thank His allies. He immediately returned to His mausoleum to "digest" the Sefirah He had just absorbed.
Although that was also a "Nation of Disorder," it had been split for a long time, a Sefirah close to the adjacent authority.
However, compared to the authority of the adjacent pathway, it had more affinity and belonged to the kind of Sefirah that was easy to "digest."
Even so, "The Creator's" spirit seemed to have suffered a huge impact. This feeling was like someone hitting Him on the head, making Him very dizzy, and He had to muster His energy to maintain a certain degree of sanity.
His condition only improved slightly when He returned to the mausoleum with enough stable anchors.
In fact, the best result of this operation was to suck out the cosmos part of the Nation of Disorder, but not immediately absorb it, and seal the evil spirit of "Uncertain Mist" to avoid future troubles.
But the situation was urgent at the time, so He had to suck the Sefirah first, and there was no time to deal with the evil spirit of "Uncertain Mist."
At this time, the original "Nation of Disorder" in "The Creator's" body was also greatly impacted. The previous scenery like a fairyland became fragmented. The avatars who were not "evacuated" in time had a certain degree of mutation and hoped to form a guild to obtain some rights.
At the same time, the space of the "Nation of Disorder" seemed to have doubled, but the "Creator" felt that the control over the "Nation of Disorder" had weakened significantly.
This state was very strange. It was clearly a state of containing the Sefirah, but the degree of Exploit of the Sefirah was not as good as before absorbing the part of the cosmos's "Nation of Disorder."
The "Creator" suppressed the uncontrollable parts of the "Nation of Disorder" while searching for the root of the problem.
As the "Creator's" state became more stable with the help of more and more stable anchors, His reason further recovered. Soon, He realized that the current state of the "Nation of Disorder" had only become complete in "quantity," but to truly become complete, it still needed to be reconstructed.
Otherwise, the state of the "Nation of Disorder" would always be like a stomach that hadn't eaten for a few days and then drank too much water. It would always feel very bloated, but at the same time, it would still feel very hungry.
...
In Angel City, Hobert continued to work in his office after learning that the "Creator" had successfully returned.
A few minutes later, a small commotion suddenly came from outside, along with the sound of a huge flow of water.
Hobert felt strange and glanced towards the window. Outside was actually a rushing river, and not far away, there was a huge waterfall, falling straight down.
Hobert was slightly stunned. How could a river and waterfall suddenly appear in the palace?
Because he didn't foresee any danger, Hobert unhurriedly opened the door to check. It turned out that it wasn't that a river and waterfall had appeared in the palace, but that his office, along with the corridor outside, had come to a large river and waterfall!
Hobert became even more strange. He clearly hadn't felt any extraordinary attacks, so why had he suddenly appeared here?
Then, he radiated his spirituality and realized that he was still within the Atlantis Empire.
So he "distorted" his position along with the office, preparing to return to Angel City.
But after using "Distort," he was still in the same place!
Hobert was very surprised. It felt as if he suddenly didn't have Beyonder abilities!
He took a deep breath and tried to calm himself down. He suddenly thought that it was likely that the "Creator's" actions today had caused his Beyonder abilities to mutate.
At this time, the river suddenly surged, overflowing the banks!
Hobert immediately realized that his ability was somewhat delayed, and it was only now taking effect, but it had obviously mutated. "Distorting" his position had become changing the river water from "1" to "2."
The river water immediately entered the office. Hobert didn't dare to use his abilities anymore. He prayed to "The Fool" for help, but he found that he didn't seem to have established any connection with "The Fool."
In other words, his power and spirituality had become extremely abnormal at this time. He couldn't even pray to the gods!
So Hobert said to the guards outside, "Quick, take me away from here."
The guards, of course, knew that the emperor was a follower of the "Creator," and was said to have the rank of an Archangel.
But they were only stunned for a moment, and then immediately reacted. One of the guards holding a sealed artifact with "Travel" abilities waded over to take Hobert away first.
But at this time, Hobert saw through the corridor window that there was a village not far downstream of the riverbed. The villagers didn't know that the flood was coming.
Hobert immediately changed his mind: "First, notify the villagers in the village below and tell them to leave immediately."
Then he said to the guards, "Run to higher ground."
The guard holding the sealed artifact with "Travel" abilities hesitated slightly, but followed the order and immediately took Hobert to the village.
At their calls, many villagers quickly hid in higher places. Hobert held two children who couldn't run very well, and the guard carried an elderly person with inconvenient legs, and also avoided the flood without any danger.
Arriving at a slightly higher position, Hobert looked at the destroyed village and then glanced at the village downstream, and said to the guard, "Continue to save people!"
...
Inside the "Black Emperor's" mausoleum.
The "Creator" quickly thought of a solution to the problem: use the "Bell of Order" to reconstruct the "Nation of Disorder."
Without delay, the illusory "Bell of Order" appeared in front of Him and quickly became solid.
Dong~
As the melodious bell rang in the mausoleum, the "Creator" felt His spirit become clearer and clearer. At the same time, the "Nation of Disorder" was instantly distorted into a ball by the bell, and the scene inside shattered instantly.
Like when He first accommodated the "Nation of Disorder," it became a void, and then began to reconstruct.
The reconstruction speed was very fast, and soon there were mountains, rivers, and divine kingdoms.
The avatars in the "Nation of Disorder" before were all gone, and their guilds were never formed after all.
The "Creator" carefully reorganized every corner of the "Nation of Disorder." After more than half a minute, He finally regained control of the "Nation of Disorder," making this Sefirah complete again.
Immediately, the "Creator" realized that the power of the "Nation of Disorder" had become much stronger. At the same time, He had a new ability: to restore the target to its original state, and the original state must be a state of chaos.
The theory of this ability is that it can instantly find the oldest end of the "string" about the target in the "Shadow of Order" and display it.
The external manifestation of this ability is that it can turn a person into the atoms that make them up, which is equivalent to an enhanced version of "Entropy." This is no longer tracing back to the beginning of life, but tracing back to the source of all the matter that makes up this life.
Another application is to "deprive" the target of Beyonder characteristics, or cause the target's Beyonder characteristics to become "chaotic." The former can turn the target into an ordinary person, while the latter is likely to cause the target to kill themselves.
This is because in the beginning, all Beyonder characteristics belonged to the Original Creator, so using this ability is equivalent to "depriving" the current owner of the right to use that Beyonder characteristic.
And the Beyonder characteristics at the beginning are more difficult to control than they are now, so the Beyonder characteristics will become "chaotic."
Of course, as the target's level increases, the "deprivation" time will decrease, and targets at the Oldest level can also use some means to avoid it.
This ability can be called "Restoration," or it can be called "Disorder!"
Considering the name "Son of Chaos," the "Creator" finally decided to call it "Disorder."
This is an ability that only appeared after the "Nation of Disorder" was complete, and it should also be one of the authorities of the complete "Son of Chaos."
But for the "Creator" at present, this is only an ability, not yet an authority.
The "internal structure" of this ability is still a kind of "disorder," but the external manifestation is quite different from abilities such as "Distort" and "Prohibition."
Finally, the "Creator" looked at the characteristics of the "Uncertain Mist" that He had sealed. He could feel that these characteristics had the extremely strong imprint of the "Uncertain Mist," and there was currently no corresponding ritual that could neutralize the impact when accommodating the Uniqueness.
In other words, He can only swallow it raw!
The "Creator" sighed and planned to wait until He recovered His state before taking further action.
...
Hobert, who was fighting the flood, suddenly felt something. He used his Beyonder power to "tamper" with the flood, and the river immediately returned to its original state.
Hobert also used Beyonder abilities to restore the flooded villages and fields, and he couldn't help but sigh: "Beyonder is really good!"
...
"Forsaken Land of the Gods," above the "True Creator's" divine kingdom.
The "Angel of Fate" Ouroboros, who was praying piously, suddenly raised his head. A great figure appeared above the divine kingdom without warning.
Ouroboros's eyes narrowed. It was the "Creator!"
Then the "Creator" summoned a bronze giant bell.
Dong~
The distant bell rang throughout the entire "Forsaken Land of the Gods," and once made the extraordinary order here return to normal!
In the black curtain, Adam and the "True Creator" seized this opportunity to complete the final fusion. The shadow with five heads completely merged into Adam's body!

chapters.content:

From the current experiment, this method was very practical for the Creator, but it was not as effective for The Fool.

The Creator was different. He first fooled the Uncertain Mist's spiritual imprint before fusing it, so that He could control the initiative of the process.
The Creator expressed His gratitude to The Fool. After The Fool left, He paid attention to the knowledge and ideas He had obtained from the Uncertain Mist's spiritual imprint.
Although these knowledge initially felt chaotic, the Creator's spirituality quickly categorized them and made them part of the Creator's knowledge.
The same was true for "ideas." These ideas would also become the Creator's "ideas." If there were any plans, the Creator would even try to complete them.
Among these knowledge and ideas, the Creator quickly discovered some important information, including information about the Celestial Worthy and the Uncertain Mist: back then, the Celestial Worthy had used the Uncertain Mist to conduct Sefirah and Beyonder characteristic decomposition experiments.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 761 Two Angel Queens (Bonus 2)
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
[Bonus for 100 power stones]
Currently, there are two hypotheses regarding the relationship between the "Son of Chaos," the "Genie," and the "Uncertain Mist."
The first hypothesis is that during the last awakening of the Original Creator, the "Son of Chaos," along with a portion of the "Nation of Disorder" and the characteristics of the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar," were torn to Earth.
In the First Epoch, the "Son of Chaos" was sealed by the "Celestial Worthy" into the "Genie," and part of the cosmos became the "Uncertain Mist."
The second hypothesis is that the awakening of the "Original Creator" tore off a portion of the "Son of Chaos's" Sefirah and characteristics. During the First Epoch, taking advantage of the "Original's" slumber, the "Son of Chaos" used its connection with the "Original Creator" and its own authority to enter the barrier and search for its own Sefirah and characteristics.
As a result, the "Son of Chaos" did not find its Sefirah and characteristics but was caught by the "Celestial Worthy" and sealed into the "Genie."
For the "Creator," it is difficult to distinguish which of these two hypotheses is true.
Even with the "Genie" nearby, it is still difficult to discern.
Because the "Genie" is a master of lies, and it has been proven that its words are very unreliable.
The "Creator" Hobert leans towards believing the second hypothesis because the "Original Creator," during its last awakening, absorbed a total of three ancient Sefirah and characteristics: the "Mother Goddess of Depravity," the "Mother Tree of Desire," and the "Son of Chaos."
As far as things stand, neither the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" nor the "Mother Tree of Desire" has produced a split like the "Son of Chaos" and the "Uncertain Mist," so even if the "Son of Chaos" is somewhat special, the idea that it was absorbed along with its Sefirah and characteristics is a bit far-fetched.
However, the second hypothesis also has a difficult-to-explain point: how did the "Uncertain Mist" come about?
If the "Son of Chaos" entered the barrier during the First Epoch, bringing with it the cosmos portion of the "Nation of Disorder" and two characteristics, why didn't the "Celestial Worthy" seal all the Sefirah and characteristics along with the "Son of Chaos"?
Of course, if sealing were to occur, it would most likely be divided into two parts: one part for the "Son of Chaos" and another part for the Sefirah and characteristics torn from it, or simply leaving this part of the Sefirah and characteristics on Earth would also be a good choice.
But this still does not explain how the "Uncertain Mist" came about.
Previously, the "Genie" once said that the "Celestial Worthy" wanted to resurrect using the identity of the "Uncertain Mist," so He tore off the Sefirah and a pathway from it and sent them to the cosmos, becoming the "Uncertain Mist."
As for why only one pathway was torn off, the Ancient Sun God gave the answer earlier: the "Celestial Worthy" could not completely tear off a portion of the "Son of Chaos's" characteristics.
At that time, the "Creator" Hobert believed that what the "Genie" said was basically true: the "Celestial Worthy" must have put the Sefirah and a portion of the "Son of Chaos's" characteristics back into the cosmos for some purpose.
Just today, after a portion of the knowledge and thoughts of the "Uncertain Mist" became part of the "Creator's" consciousness, it once again exposed the lies of the "Genie."
Putting the "Uncertain Mist" into the cosmos was part of the sealing of the "Son of Chaos."
Although the "Celestial Worthy" tore off the characteristics and Sefirah from the "Son of Chaos" at that time, they had a significant difference from the Sefirah and characteristics on Earth: they had not undergone the Convergence and splitting of the "Original."
This allowed the "Son of Chaos," even in a sealed state, to still influence these Sefirah and characteristics through its own authority.
So the "Celestial Worthy" thought of sending them to the cosmos, but He couldn't just let the Outer Deities waiting outside take advantage of it, so He devised a way to form the "Uncertain Mist."
A portion of the "Uncertain Mist's" consciousness came from the "Son of Chaos," but this was not enough to constitute a complete ancient spirit and spirit body. The "Celestial Worthy" then gave the spirit, thoughts, and so on of one of His "identities" to this consciousness, which formed the complete "Uncertain Mist."
This is the first reason for the appearance of the "Uncertain Mist." The second reason is that the "Celestial Worthy" conducted some experiments on it.
Regarding the "Celestial Worthy," the "Genie" also told some truths, such as the fact that the "Celestial Worthy's" consciousness did split.
One part of the consciousness believed that it was an important part of the "Original Creator," while the other part had the idea of separating.
The former part was still carrying out the will of the "Original Creator." He threw the "Uncertain Mist" into the cosmos to observe the situation of Earth and the cosmos portion of the "Nation of Disorder."
Using the complete "Sefirah Castle" to compare with the divided "Nation of Disorder," He observed the reaction after the Sefirah split. According to the "Celestial Worthy's" idea, during the "Original's" next awakening, He would divide the "Nation of Disorder" in the "Cosmos" into two again and then observe whether its corruption and distortion would be weakened?
The characteristics of the "Supreme Overseer" pathway were also sent to the cosmos to see if the pathway could be turned into a pathway with authority similar to the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar," rather than the adjacent pathway at the time, by using the split "Nation of Disorder."
In short, He was trying to reduce the connection between the Sefirah and characteristics.
And the part of the "Celestial Worthy" that hoped to form an independent consciousness did indeed lay down resurrection arrangements on the "Uncertain Mist" and the "Black Emperor" and "Justiciar" pathways.
The reason for making arrangements in these areas was that the "Son of Chaos" had a close connection with the "Original Creator," so many ancient authorities and characteristics could be regarded as similar authorities to the "Uncertain Mist."
This would allow for more possibilities in the future and could become a Pillar again.
However, over the long years, although the "Uncertain Mist" was very clear that it was an avatar of the "Celestial Worthy" and also knew that it came from the "Son of Chaos," the level of an ancient still gradually made it believe that it was an independent ancient, not an experimental product or puppet of other ancients.
Especially after the "Celestial Worthy" had fallen and the Ancient Sun God had destroyed the "Celestial Worthy's" arrangements in the Earth portion of the "Nation of Disorder," the "Uncertain Mist" had a complete self-consciousness and became no different from other Outer Deities.
The "Creator" took a deep breath: So this is the complete picture of the "Son of Chaos," the "Genie," and the "Uncertain Mist."
Fortunately, the "Genie" has been re-sealed by "The Fool" Klein, otherwise bringing the cosmos portion of the "Nation of Disorder" and the characteristics of the "Supreme Overseer" pathway to Earth would be a very risky thing.
This made the "Creator" realize a very important thing: to find the evil spirit formed by the "Uncertain Mist" and seal it.
Otherwise, after the barrier disappears, that evil spirit is likely to be attracted by the "Genie," and then the "Genie" may be able to lift the seal on its own.
Even without considering the disappearance of the barrier, when devouring the characteristics of the "Son of Chaos," He must be placed in the cosmos. If the evil spirit of the "Uncertain Mist" is not sealed in advance, it is very likely that the "Son of Chaos" will have a complete personality and have the qualifications to compete with the "Creator" for authority.
In addition, the imprint of the "Uncertain Mist" also contains some information about other ancients, which is quite important, after all, it is difficult for the "Creator" to obtain information about the cosmos before becoming an ancient.
After becoming an ancient, it is impossible to run to the cosmos every day. The channels for obtaining information are very limited.
After "browsing" through these newly acquired consciousnesses, the "Creator" then "changed" the "Supreme Overseer" pathway in His body from a similar authority pathway to an adjacent pathway.
Because it was previously an adjacent pathway, He easily completed the "Transformation."
Immediately afterward, the "Creator" once again split off His humanity, forming Hobert.
He stayed in the mausoleum to continue "digesting" the mental remnants of the "Uncertain Mist," while Hobert left the mausoleum and continued to return to being the emperor, continuously transmitting the warmth of humanity to Him.
...
A week later, accompanied by Hobert, Fors went to the cosmos for the last time to "spread" legends about herself.
This time, their destination was a planet that believed in the "Uncertain Mist." Currently, the "Uncertain Mist" has fallen, and these anchors all belong to the "Creator."
After the "Creator" completely "digested" the part of consciousness belonging to the "Uncertain Mist," He began to gradually take over the "Uncertain Mist's" anchors.
Over thousands of years, the "Uncertain Mist" has spread faith on many planets, but most of them have caused great chaos and distortion to the planet, forming distorted civilizations or simply destroying the civilization.
During this time, the "Creator" is gradually restoring these civilizations to normal, allowing the intelligent creatures there to gradually become normal anchors.
One of the planets was not greatly affected, so He accompanied Fors here to "spread" legends.
This is a planet where plants have evolved into intelligent creatures. Each creature has a flower on its head that can change shape and smell. This is the organ they use to communicate.
They do not have eye structures. The main channel for receiving external information is a cluster of organs that look somewhat like tentacles.
They probably have the intelligence of normal people, but what is very different is that their lives are long, but their actions are slow, and the pace of the entire civilization is also slow.
It is precisely because it is so slow that the distortion and chaos of the "Uncertain Mist" affected the entire civilization at a very slow rate, which gave them a certain buffer time and did not produce a distorted civilization.
Fors observed from a distance for a long time and repeatedly exclaimed "the wonderful universe."
Immediately afterward, she prayed to Mr. Fool, asking "The Fool" to help "fool" the creatures of this civilization, and soon legends about Fors were left behind.
At this moment, a violent earthquake seemed to suddenly occur in the distance. A tall mountain suddenly cracked, and the inside of the mountain collapsed, forming a considerable cavity.
Fors was stunned: "That, that is..."
"Don't worry." Hobert smiled: "The 'Creator' has taken action today."
There is another purpose for coming here today: to use these former anchors of the "Uncertain Mist" to find the evil spirit of the "Uncertain Mist" and seal it.
Soon, the "Creator," who quietly slipped out of the barrier, found the destitute "Uncertain Mist" and, after "distorting" it, sent the "Uncertain Mist" to the planet where Hobert and Fors were.
Fors on that planet saw a black shadow Blink past, sent from the cosmos into the split mountain.
Immediately afterward, the cavity in the mountain was filled with "Order Crystals," firmly sealing the black shadow.
Finally, the mountain closed, as if it had returned to normal, as if it had never cracked.
Fors, who witnessed all this, was stunned for a while before saying to Hobert: "Let's go back."
She did not ask what the "Creator" was doing just now? Because the affairs of the gods are not something that mortals can ask about.
Back on Earth, Fors immediately prepared the "Planeswalker" potion and drank it under Hobert's care.
Her body immediately became as illusory as the cosmos, with a little starlight. At this moment, her mind had already entered the cosmos to roam.
When Fors came back to her senses, she found that she was lost in the depths of the cosmos. The advancement ritual played a role at this time, becoming Fors's landmark in the cosmos.
Because the ritual was prepared more solidly, Fors completed the advancement safely in just three or four minutes.
That afternoon, another empress, Audrey, also completed the advancement under Hobert's care.
Different from Fors's advancement, during Audrey's advancement to angel, her own consciousness was easily integrated with the subconscious sea.
The previous advancement ritual was to use the psychological shadow left for the angel to distinguish which were her own consciousness and which were the subconscious sea?
At the angel level, as long as a strong psychological shadow has been left, a certain mark can be left in the subconscious sea, which becomes the key for Audrey to find herself.
It only took three or four minutes for Audrey to successfully advance to angel.
The two empresses of Atlantis have now become angels. Hobert is also thinking about whether to have two children.
Although Hobert at this time seems to be only at the level of the King of Angels, he is also the "Creator." His children must be angels from birth.
If the two empresses are only Sequence 3, the production process may still be a bit dangerous, so until now, no prince or princess has been born in the empire.
...
In the depths of the universe, a star suddenly emitted a violent and brilliant light. At this moment, all its matter was scattered throughout the universe.
The power of this moment was very terrifying. Even in the very distant outer universe, the light it emitted could be seen.
But this is its "swan song"!
This star exploded!
This astronomical phenomenon is called a supernova explosion, which happens in the universe all the time.
But the explosion of this supernova was obviously a bit different. After emitting strong light, a hole was formed in the light, as if something was bathed in the strong light and high-energy explosion.
The next second, the strong light and the huge power of the explosion disappeared instantly. At this time, the "hole" was finally seen clearly.
It was a bright white sphere, and there seemed to be a small gray shadow inside the sphere.
After absorbing the strong light and the huge explosive force just now, this bright white sphere burned with white, luminous flames, as if expressing its joy.
This is the "Supernova Dominator," one of the Great Old Dominators who hopes to enter the real world.
It just won't stay in the solar system all the time, because there are too many ancients there, which is very dangerous.
So it occasionally returns to the universe to enjoy a delicious "star meal."
At this moment, the "Supernova Dominator" seemed to realize something. Just as it was about to transform into a stream of light and fly away, a figure that wasn't very tall but gave off a sense of sacred majesty suddenly appeared before it.
The figure wore attire in the style of Atlantis and had Hobert's appearance, but at this moment, it lacked any biological emotion.
In the holy light, the crowned "Creator" had three hands: one holding a scepter, one holding a bronze-colored codex, and the third holding a tilted scale.
The "Supernova Dominator" was the target selected by the "Creator." Besides controlling gravity, this ancient authority was also a phenomenon in the universe characterized by drastic changes.
The reason for not devouring the "Son of Chaos" first was that the "Creator" intended to add some "ingredients" to the "Nation of Disorder." After all, this used to be the Sefirah of the "Son of Chaos," and after being released, this guy could easily influence this Sefirah.
If it fused with the Sefirah of other ancient beings, the "Nation of Disorder" would become different. Even if the "Son of Chaos" came to snatch the "Nation of Disorder" at that time, the "Creator" would still have some room to maneuver.
When he had just advanced to "Black Emperor" before, the "Uncertain Mist" hadn't been entirely honest. This ancient authority was "Explosion and Gravity."
This is where the advantage of the "Disorder" authority is reflected. "Density and Weight" doesn't seem to have much connection with "Transformation," but the entire explosion process is a process of drastic change, relying scientific Order to perform a Transformation. Symbolically speaking, the "Creator" can devour this ancient being.
Of course, this devouring process must be extremely dangerous. The Sefirah of the "Uncertain Mist" and the Sefirah of the "Creator" are, at least, both from the "Nation of Disorder."
Although they are called similar authorities, they are too "close."
However, the Sefirah of the "Supernova Dominator" would not be as easily fused as the cosmos portion of the "Nation of Disorder."
Another reason for choosing the "Supernova Dominator" is that this ancient being currently only has about one complete pathway.
Although no one stipulates how many pathways a "Pillar-level" Great Old One can accommodate at most, the four known "Pillars," "Omnipotent and Omniscient" and "Fourth Pillar," have five pathways, while the "Lord of the Mysteries" and the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" have less than 5 pathways.
Based on common sense, the "Creator" believes that the number of pathways it accommodates cannot exceed five. Perhaps 6 was possible, but Hobert didn't want to risk it.
Considering that the "Son of Chaos" controlled four pathways, then accommodating only one more pathway is the safest.
At this moment, the sudden appearance of the "Creator" caught the "Supernova Dominator" off guard, and it immediately transformed into a stream of light to escape.
The reason it could do this was that the Evernight Goddess helped it hide its tracks.
The "Creator" slightly raised the hand holding the scepter and "Distorted" the speed of light in the universe. For a time, the "Supernova Dominator's" light suddenly stopped moving...
Or rather, it wasn't that it wasn't moving, but that it was moving very, very slowly, about one kilometer per hour.
This scene was very strange, as if a flashlight had been turned on, but the beam of light was frozen in place a dozen centimeters in front.
The stars in the entire universe were no longer circular but had become thick lines.
This was because the speed of light was too slow. The light from the previous minute hadn't traveled far, and the light from the following minute had already appeared, so the moving stars looked like they were drawing a thick line in space.
The "Creator" easily caught up with the "Supernova Dominator" and "imprisoned" it in place.
But the next second, the "imprisonment" suddenly shattered, and the "Supernova Dominator" became agile again. At the same time, the codex in the "Creator's" hand opened, and several ancient characters flew out, instantly forming sentences: Explosions are prohibited here.
It is prohibited for "Supernova Dominator" to call for help.
It is prohibited...
Because of the "Creator's" prohibition, all the supernovae in the universe, which had just returned to normal speed of light, stopped the process of exploding.
The "Supernova Dominator" realized that it was no match at all and immediately scattered a colorful halo around it. These halos formed a cluster of stars, concealing the "Supernova Dominator's" tracks.
It was preparing to escape in other ways.
But the "Creator" first "distorted" its escape route, so that no matter how it escaped, it would return to its presence.
At the same time, the "Creator" proclaimed: "Death sentence!"
The "Supernova Dominator" was immediately severely injured. The incandescent white sphere suddenly burned with intense flames, then turned gray, and finally turned black, "scattering" the aura of death within it.
Even if it wasn't as strong as the "Creator," the level of an ancient being indicated that it was very difficult to kill.
At this moment, the image of the "Fool" appeared on the other side of the "Supernova Dominator," and the "Supernova Dominator's" fate suddenly experienced a serious "error." It suddenly expanded and instantly exploded.
This "error" was that the "Supernova Dominator" had become a supernova at the end of its life, so it exploded, scattering its spirituality and life force to the outside world and rapidly moving towards annihilation.
The "Fool" took action because even if the "Supernova Dominator" couldn't call for help, the battle between ancient beings could easily attract the attention of other ancient beings.
But the "Supernova Dominator" quickly controlled its form, stopped the process of annihilation, and used its ability to manipulate gravity to quickly reunite itself.
However, its previous explosion violated the "Creator's" decree of "forbidding explosions," so it was punished, and subsequently suffered even more serious injuries.
It was also at this moment that the "Creator" slightly raised the hand holding the tilted scale. Because the "Creator" had obtained the spirituality and life force scattered by the "Supernova Dominator," it "traded" its own and all its anchors' misfortune and negativity to the "Supernova Dominator."
For a time, the "Supernova Dominator" became very unfortunate and had no desire to resist.
And the "Creator's" anchors throughout the universe were surrounded by luck and positivity.
The "Uncertain Mist" didn't have the "Creator's" ability. This operation was the "Creator's" Exploit of multiple authorities.
At this time, the Evernight Goddess also launched an attack, giving the "Supernova Dominator" enough "misfortune."
Suddenly, the incandescent white sphere cracked open, and a strangely shaped stone statue slipped out. None of the three ancient beings on Earth had seen the appearance of this statue. Just looking at it made one feel like it was full of madness and distortion.
This was the "Supernova Dominator's" true form, and the incandescent white sphere around it was its Sefirah.
The "Supernova Dominator" was too unlucky. In the crucial battle of ancient beings, its true form and Sefirah experienced a serious disharmony, and the true form was rejected by the Sefirah. The Fool's Error, Darkness's Misfortune, and Black Emperor's Distortion could rip away the Sefirah at the level of symbolism temporarily.
And even more unfortunately, the "Supernova Dominator" was still very distorted and didn't immediately carry out effective resistance.
So, taking advantage of this opportunity, the "Creator's" Sword of Judgment and the Evernight Goddess's Twilight Greatsword pierced the strangely shaped stone statue together.
The "Creator" judged: "Destruction!"
Bang~
The stone statue cracked and turned into powder.
The "Supernova Dominator" fell!
