chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 762: The Pillar-level Creator
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
To avoid bringing risks to Earth, the "Creator" did not bring the spherical Sefirah of the "Supernova Dominator" back to the real world. Instead, after quickly leaving the battlefield, He asked the Evernight Goddess to create a huge concealed area for Himself. He wanted to try to accommodate the Sefirah and characteristics of the "Supernova Dominator" in the depths of the universe.
"The Fool" and the Evernight Goddess did not leave. They stayed to see if they could help.
Immediately afterwards, Lilith, who was also a little worried, came as well. They waited outside the secret world, occasionally peering into the interior, somewhat like family members waiting outside an operating room.
Inside the secret world, after making certain mental preparations, the "Creator" placed the Sefirah, which resembled a small star in shape, into the "Nation of Disorder."
Rumble~
Instantly, the entire "Nation of Disorder" was agitated, and the "Creator" also felt His thoughts go numb, as if His thinking had stagnated, unable to generate any ideas.
Fortunately, the "Creator" had given instructions to the "Nation of Disorder" in advance. It became nothingness again, and then formed a huge gravitational vortex, wanting to crush the "blazing white star" that had suddenly appeared inside it.
But the blazing white star produced a strong resistance, and for a time, there was no way to crush it.
The "Creator" slightly regained some reason. Seeing the "blazing white star" still unscathed, He immediately realized that "crushing" was not the way to accommodate similar authorities.
Or rather, only the original Creator could completely fuse the two Sefirahs. As the limit of the Outer Deities, it was to fuse the two Sefirahs to a certain extent, so that there would be no conflict between them, and both could be used by Him.
So the "Nation of Disorder" stopped stirring, and instead covered the surface of the "blazing white star" like a liquid, wanting to turn it into a part of itself.
Although this method prevented the star-shaped Sefirah from resisting, it still did not show any signs of being accommodated.
Having regained more reason, the "Creator" had no choice but to adopt the third plan. He first used the "Nation of Disorder" to form a circle of black, hard barriers around the "blazing white star".
Then, He "Transformed" the shape of the blazing white star, making it active.
This "Transform" ability was like an activation signal. The "blazing white star" rapidly expanded, and the "Creator" used abilities such as "magnification" on it at the right time.
Boom~
Just as the "Creator" had expected, the "blazing white star" entered a state of "explosion." For a time, the surrounding black barriers loosened and became precarious.
The "Creator" felt something and summoned a doppelganger, asking him to provide assistance at any time.
Then, taking advantage of the "blazing white star's" outburst, He "mixed" the power of the "Nation of Disorder" into that Sefirah and stirred it together.
At the same time, the "Creator" also devoured the Uniqueness that He had obtained from the "Supernova Dominator," which was somewhat like the shape of a nebula, and a Sequence 1 characteristic that was somewhat like a phantom meteorite.
For a time, because the "Creator" was mixed with the Sefirah of the "blazing white star," He had a certain affinity with the Uniqueness and the Sequence 1 characteristic. He could also use the power of the Sefirah to suppress the distortion and madness brought about by the characteristic.
On the other hand, the Uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristic that He devoured quickly enabled the "Creator" to fuse with the "blazing white star".
It was like using the Sefirah to deal with the characteristic, and using the characteristic to deal with the Sefirah.
Although this idea was good, the "Creator" quickly lost His reason due to the distortion brought about by the Sefirah and the characteristic. He Himself became extremely distorted, sometimes having a human form, sometimes turning into a vortex of power, and sometimes a blazing white flame burned on the vortex of power.
The doppelganger immediately said: "This place can defeat all distortions!
"This place makes it easy to regain reason!
"Here, the madness of the Sefirah and the extraordinary is weakened.
"Here, the power of the anchor is magnified.
"This place is more likely to accept the warmth of humanity.
"This place… …"
While issuing decrees, the doppelganger also kept "magnifying" the "Creator's" reason, "Transforming" the state of the main body, and so on.
… …
At this time, in the imperial palace of Angel City, the capital of the Atlantis Empire, on Earth.
Hobert was receiving the transmigrator Jeff in his office. This transmigrator had spent more than three years and had finally become a qualified town mayor, so Hobert had invited him to chat.
When Jeff first started as a village chief, he actually had many opportunities for advancement. At that time, the speed of advancement was also fast. Generally, he would be promoted to town mayor in half a year, county magistrate in one year, and prefect in two years.
At this time, Hobert's younger brother, Tyron, had caught up with this wave of promotions and was now the highest official in a prefecture.
As the imperial government's control over the entire country increased, unless another world-class war occurred and a large amount of territory was occupied, there would be no such rapid wave of promotions.
Next, Hobert's focus will be on using the transfer of senior officials to try to maintain the balance between the central government and the local governments.
At the same time, the aristocratic class had already shown some signs, and Hobert would further strengthen the functions of the inspection agency and strengthen the political participation of official Beyonders to balance the increasingly complex situation in the country.
Hobert would draw a red line. The aristocratic class could exist, or rather, this was an inevitable product of the bureaucratic structure.
It was okay to make one's life and diet exquisite and high-end, but it could not be extravagant or disregard the personality of others.
Another key point was that interest groups could not be formed. If Hobert ever noticed the formation of an interest group, he would break them one by one and severely punish them all.
The reason why the transmigrator Jeff spent more than three years to become a town mayor was because in the previous two years, he had been trying to escape.
However, because the "original owner's" status was not high and he did not understand that this world was based on Beyonders, he fell into desperation after leaving his post three times.
In addition, this transmigrator obviously did not have much social experience. He was used to living in a peaceful country with good public security and did not have the most basic sense of prevention.
He was stolen from and "slaughtered" in the process of venturing out on his own. In short, the little money he earned as a village chief always disappeared quickly.
Although the public security of the Atlantis Empire was much better now, it was only that there were no more villains extorting everywhere and no more bandits kidnapping and robbing.
Because a large part of the empire was still relatively poor, theft and illegal merchants were unavoidable.
Only when the whole country was basically prosperous and there were more channels to obtain wealth would such phenomena gradually decrease.
After Jeff escaped three times, he finally understood that the transmigrator who became the emperor did not not hear the secret code he shouted, but just wanted to let himself understand the world by working at the grassroots level.
After all, every time he was at his wit's end, someone would help him and take him back to his original position.
Even if Jeff was dull, he understood what was going on.
So more than a year ago, he wholeheartedly devoted himself to his work.
"This world is more complicated than I thought," Jeff said with a smile. "I should have calmed down and stayed at the grassroots level earlier."
Hobert had an expression of "don't worry too much": "I came a few years before you and can create an opportunity for you to try and make mistakes."
Jeff keenly noticed: "You?"
"That's right," Hobert said truthfully. "Including you, five transmigrators have contacted me. It's just that the other four had basically adapted to life here before contacting me."
Jeff sighed: "I originally thought I was the son of luck, but I didn't expect it to be a 'group transmigration'."
"Compared to the vast majority of people in this world, compared to the vast majority of people in the Modern Era, you are the son of luck," Hobert said, taking a sip of coffee. "What are your plans for the future?"
"I want to go to the city and take a look," Jeff said. "It's likely that it represents this era."
"Hmm," Hobert nodded. "I can sponsor you and let you look around, but I won't provide you with any more protection."
Jeff said sincerely: "I'm already very grateful to you."
He then said with emotion: "I didn't expect to work 996 before transmigrating, but now I finally have time to wander around aimlessly in this world."
Hobert casually asked: "What kind of work did you do before?"
"Big data development engineer."
Hobert was slightly stunned, unfamiliar with this profession.
Jeff explained again: "Commonly known as a programmer."
Then he asked: "When did you transmigrate? Has 'One Piece' ended yet?"
Hobert smiled wryly: "No."
… …
In the secret world deep within the cosmos, the "Creator," who had almost lost all reason, suddenly felt the human side of Himself providing a constant stream of emotions and sensations, giving Him a sense of warmth.
It was as if a bright lighthouse had been provided for Him in the cold void!
After a long while, He suddenly came back to His senses: Now is not the time to be spacing out!
Thoughts surged like a rushing river, and He seemed to suddenly remember that He was currently accommodating authorities from similar pathways.
Buzz buzz buzz~
The "Creator's" mind was filled with a huge noise, as if tinnitus had made Him deaf.
Immediately afterward, it felt like someone was stirring His brain, and the intense pain made His face contort.
This experience was very unpleasant, like being suddenly beaten up while sleeping soundly.
Then, the "Creator" realized that only His "face" remained; everything below the neck had been completely replaced by the void and white flames, making Him look like a monster with only a head left.
The previously summoned avatar had been helping the main body maintain its state, but even so, the "Creator's" main body had already been disfigured beyond recognition.
After regaining some reason, He tried to resist the madness and distortion, and began to reassemble His body.
But He soon discovered that He had completely lost control of Himself.
This was because the "Blazing White Star" had become entangled with the "Nation of Disorder"; the "Creator" could control the "Nation of Disorder," but found it difficult to control the "Blazing White Star."
This was equivalent to inserting some uncontrollable steel organs into a normal body.
Fortunately, the "Creator" quickly found a way to break the situation. The Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics seized from "Supernova Dominator" had initially merged with the "Creator."
The "Creator" used this to gradually influence parts of the "Blazing White Star," bringing it under His control, and mobilized the power of the "Nation of Disorder" to carry out a deep fusion with those parts under His control.
But this was bound to be a very long process.
...
Angel, the Imperial Palace.
Hobert saw Jeff off and welcomed another guest, Medici.
After the two were seated, Hobert asked with a smile, "How is your current state?"
"Better than expected." Medici, who was noticeably more handsome, said expressionlessly: "I'm just very curious, why are you helping me to this extent? Is it really for fighting the Outer Deities?"
Hobert smiled and said, "Isn't that reason enough?"
Medici took a deep breath: "No matter what, your actions have taken me by surprise."
He paused and added: "When I came, Roselle also asked me to bring you a message. His current state is also considered stable, and he is ready at any time."
Hobert gave an "hmm" sound: "The final war is about to begin."
Medici left in a hurry after chatting for a few words, because he still needed to find a place to continue stabilizing his state.
Hobert glanced at the sky, wondering how far the "Creator's" plan had progressed. However, judging from the fact that the "Creator" had not yet returned, today's operation should be very difficult.
But he dared not feel the current state of the "Creator," because doing so would establish a "two-way" connection and would definitely be affected by the "Creator," which could bring many unknown dangers to Earth.
After stabilizing his emotions, Hobert came to the back garden of the Imperial Palace and met up with the mature, lazy, and youthful, beautiful two empresses. Together, they went out to Christian's mansion.
Today was an important day for their family. Tyron would formally introduce Melissa, as well as Melissa's brother and sister-in-law and little niece, to the family.
Derrick and Donna had already arrived and were waiting quietly for today's guests in the living room.
After the family met, they chatted together. Christian and Mona were both very gratified that their children had found partners in life, and the family from back then had become a large family.
Around five thirty, Melissa's family arrived.
Donna and the others greeted them, first exchanging pleasantries with them in front of the main gate, and then entering the living room together.
In fact, everyone already knew each other. The so-called "introduction" was just for the two families to meet each other, which was also equivalent to announcing the two people's romantic relationship to the outside world. After a while, they would discuss the engagement.
While chatting idly, Hobert suddenly looked out the window. He saw a brightly colored pheasant-coucal standing on the branch of a large tree in the yard, which was one of the most common birds in the area.
With just one glance, Hobert knew that it was "World" Gehrman Sparrow's marionette.
Hobert withdrew his gaze and suddenly realized that the union of Tyron and Melissa was actually an intermarriage between two Great Old ONes!
But Hobert quickly came back to his senses and continued chatting with Benson about the situation in the Northern Continent.
Last year, under the leadership of Roselle, the Intis Republic launched a battle against the Central Highlands. The countries of Loen, Feysac, and others were forced to join the war one after another, which then evolved into a war that swept across the entire continent.
Under the command of Medici, Intis gained considerable victories in the war.
This caused some changes in the situation in the Northern Continent again.
The subsequent dinner was enjoyed by both hosts and guests, and it was a very warm family gathering.
...
The "Creator" deep in the cosmos felt that His humanity was strengthening little by little. The very wonderful phenomenon was that this gave Him a constant stream of power to fight against distortion and madness.
He didn't know how long had passed, but finally He regained control over Himself.
After that, the fusion process suddenly became smooth, and soon He initially controlled the essence of "Supernova Dominator," which caused considerable changes in the "Nation of Disorder."
Before this, there was only light and darkness in the "Nation of Disorder," but no sun.
At this time, a blazing white sun appeared in the sky, but this "sun" was very restless and often caused vibrations throughout the "Nation of Disorder."
At this time, the role of the "Bell of Order" was revealed. With this bronze giant clock, the foundation of the "Nation of Disorder" did not shake, which saved the "Creator" a lot of effort.
Another change was that a volcano was added to the "Nation of Disorder," and it was constantly erupting, floating pieces of white dust outward, turning a part of the "Nation of Disorder" into pure white.
Those pure white places were full of distortion and madness, and were very uncoordinated places in the essence.
These distortions and madness were the embodiment of the "Creator's" current state, generally maintaining a state of not collapsing, sealing all the distortions and madness in a certain place in the body.
If it were another Old One, they might fall into a semi-mad state because of this, but the "Creator" possessed the "Bell of Order."
Dong~
As the melodious bell rang, the "sun" in the sky of the "Nation of Disorder" became much calmer, and those distorted and mad places also quickly eased, at least on the surface, you couldn't see the distortion.
The essence was "peaceful," and the "Creator" Himself was able to take shape. At this time, His state was very similar to that of a Beyonder who had slightly recovered from the edge of losing control.
The "Creator," who had regained His human form, took back His avatar and sighed that the road to becoming a Pillar-level Great Old One was too dangerous!
The impact of the essence "fusing" with each other was too violent. In comparison, the impact of the spiritual imprint brought about by accommodating that Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics was completely negligible.
Fortunately, the most difficult time had passed. He slightly raised His hand, and in the huge secret world, a star instantly exploded, and the terrifying power swept across the entire galaxy.
But in the next second, the entire galaxy disappeared without a trace.
The "Creator" used the authority of multiple pathways to accelerate the "explosion" process, allowing that galaxy to immediately meet the fate of complete destruction after the explosion.
He had basically mastered the power of this essence and characteristic! Moreover, His overall ability had been significantly enhanced, and He could clearly feel that He was stronger than the average Great Old One!
At this time, the surrounding secret world disappeared, and the four gods, the "Creator," the "Fool," the Evernight Goddess, and Lilith, gathered together.
The "Creator" said: "We can't wait! My condition will only get worse the longer we wait."
The other three gods nodded and went to prepare separately.
...
More than nine o'clock in the evening, Angel City, Christian's residence.
After Hobert's family saw off Melissa and others, they returned to the living room, drank tea, and chatted for a few words before returning home.
The emperor's family returned to the palace in a carriage. Hobert, who had just gotten off the carriage, seemed to realize something and looked up at the night sky.
Tonight's night sky was very beautiful. With the stars twinkling, there was also a huge red moon!
The appearance of the two together was obviously a bit problematic.
Hobert felt the presence of the "Creator" again, and this was also a signal. He calmly said to the two Empresses, "Summon all angels!"
… …
The red moon that night was particularly beautiful and particularly round.
Even though today wasn't supposed to be when the moon was full.
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity", overlooking the Earth from the moon, suddenly had a bad premonition, so She examined the Earth's surface, looking for the source of Her unease.
Just then, a blurred figure appeared in the crimson moonlight. This figure held a baby, with springs gushing and herbs growing beneath its feet, and a white moon above its head.
Impossible!
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" immediately realized that the Earth Mother had merged with Lilith! Becoming a true Great Old One!
But in the battle a few months ago where the "Creator" attacked the "Uncertain Mist", Lilith was clearly only at the level of "Half Great Old One"!
Crucially, in recent times, the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" had not sensed Lilith becoming a Great Old One!
But now is not the time to think about this, because at this moment the moon is moving away from the Earth uncontrollably by the "Mother Goddess of Depravity", Lilith is seizing the moon.
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" instantly gathered Her strength, confronting Lilith.
Suddenly, the night sky seemed even denser. The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" felt as if She had come to the end of all life, and might die on the moon in the next second.
That is the Evernight Goddess… More precisely, it should be "Eternal Darkness, Space-Time-in-One"!
It turned out that the Evernight Goddess also accommodated the uniqueness and Sequence 1 characteristics of the "Twilight Giant" pathway. The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" also understood that it made sense why She hadn't noticed Lilith becoming a Great Old One.
Not only did the Evernight Goddess "conceal" the fact that She had become a Great Old One, but She also hid the fact that Lilith had become a Great Old One.
At this moment, the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" realized the source of Her unease: What about the other "Half Great Old Ones" on Earth? Have they become Great Old Ones now?
… …
Angel, the main hall of the palace.
After receiving Hobert's notification, all the angels immediately came to the palace to assemble.
There were a total of nine angels who came here at this time, namely Emperor Hobert, Empress Borough Audrey and Fors, the chief commander of official Beyonders, Christian, and Minister of Defense Archibald.
There are also four commanders of official Beyonders, namely Beverly, Raymond, Sharron, and Dophis.
The "Creator" does have some Angel Beyonder characteristics there, but for now, so many angels are enough.
Moreover, angels should be the highest-level reward in the extraordinary world, and of course, they cannot be given easily.
Therefore, in more than three years, the Atlantis Empire has not added any angels.
At this time, the spirituality of the nine angels seemed to sense something, and they all looked up at the top of the hall.
Fors raised her hand, and the top of the hall first became illusory, and then revealed the moon and cosmos in the sky.
Everyone saw that the originally crimson moon had turned white, but on the white moon, there was a huge, blurred crimson figure!
Several angels were a little surprised, and then They realized that a very high-level battle was taking place on the moon!
"Everyone stay here and stand by at any time!" Hobert, sitting on the throne, suddenly said: "Don't worry, the 'Creator' and other gods are fully prepared for this battle."
As he spoke, he stood up and took the "Genie" from Audrey: "But the next battle will definitely have a considerable impact on the real world."
"Now Christian is the commander-in-chief here. If there is anything unusual in the empire, she will assign you to solve the problem."
Christian nodded.
Audrey realized that Hobert was also going to participate in the war, and she got up with some worry and said, "Be careful."
Hobert stepped forward and kissed her cheek: "I will."
Fors also got up and said, "Don't be reckless."
Hobert smiled slightly and kissed her cheek: "I won't."
After speaking, Hobert, holding the "Genie", disappeared into the hall.
… …
Northern Continent, Loen Kingdom, Backlund.
Leonard, who was still working in his office, felt that the power of the night had suddenly increased tonight. Wherever the moonlight shone, all ordinary people fell into a deep sleep!
Leonard came to the window of his office and looked at the sky: "Old man, that... that is an Outer God?"
"That's right." A voice that only Leonard could hear said: "The gods of the real world are fighting with the Outer Deities for the moon."
Leonard was slightly stunned before saying: "Has an 'Above the Sequence' existence appeared in the real world?"
Pallez, who was parasitizing in his body, said: "It has already appeared, it's just that you haven't paid attention to some changes in the rules on Earth."
Pallez has a very clear understanding of this.
Leonard recalled the information exchanged at the Tarot Club before: "In this way, the Evernight Goddess…"
"She succeeded." Pallez said with a chuckle: "But this is not surprising, because She has been preparing for this for a long, long time."
… …
On the other side of the sun, the "Creator" is trying to maintain His sanity, otherwise He might "casually" let the star in front of Him "erupt".
At this time, most areas of the real world are in the dark night, and the moon is on the dark side of the earth.
From the battlefield of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and the other two Outer Deities, across the Earth, and then across the Sun, is where the "Creator" is now.
After confirming that the battle over there had begun, Hobert came here with the "Genie".
He exchanged glances with the "Creator", letting the "Genie" float in the weightless space. In the next instant, they became a complete life form: "Creator" Hobert.
At this time, the "Creator" made a gesture towards the void, and the mysterious image of the "Fool" appeared, dispelling the seal of the "Genie".
The battle on the other side of the sun is actually attracting the attention of the Outer Deities. The real purpose of the Earth gods is actually to help the "Creator" devour the "Son of Chaos"!
Although the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" only has the symbolism of a "pillar", it is difficult for the Earth to severely damage Her without a "pillar"!
According to the information that the "Creator" had previously obtained from the "Uncertain Mist", the "Mother Goddess of Depravity", the "Circle of Inevitability", and the "Primordial Hunger" are all more difficult Outer Deities to deal with.
Among them, the situation of the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" is the most special. If a "pillar" does not appear, it is easy to turn the battle with the Outer Deities into a protracted war.
By then, the solar system, and even the entire universe, are likely to be smashed by this group of Outer Deities.
At this time, the "Creator"'s plan becomes crucial. As long as He becomes the "pillar", even the mental patchwork monster of the "Son of Chaos" has the hope of completely defeating the "Mother Goddess of Depravity".
In this way, the battle can be ended quickly. Even if the Milky Way is smashed, as long as the Outer Deities are severely damaged and driven away, the original appearance can be quickly restored under the joint efforts of several Outer Deities.
The "Genie", which has complex mystical symbols on the surface, does not need Hobert to wipe it, and the wick burns silently.
The light emitted from the wick, like viscous water, sprayed upwards, forming a blurred and distorted light golden figure.
He said in a grand voice: "I didn't expect that you could get to this point."
"Creator" Hobert smiled slightly: "Yes, if you could have imagined that I would have such abilities today, you wouldn't have told so many lies in the previous conversations."
The "Genie" said: "If you were in my current position, you wouldn't tell the truth either."
The "Creator" did not continue this topic, but said in a solemn voice: "I will fulfill my promise and put the 'Genie' back into the cosmos."
"From now on, our transaction is completely over!"
As he spoke, the "Sword of Judgment" appeared in the "Creator"'s hand: "Release!"
With a single sword strike, a crack was pierced in the magic lamp, which looked like a small kettle. The mystical symbols on the magic lamp suddenly became dim, and then the crack became larger and larger, and a dark and majestic figure gushed out from it.
This figure suddenly became illusory after regaining its freedom, and then it turned into a nebula-like appearance, and finally it turned into a mass of illusory shadows.
This is the "Son of Chaos".
A illusory voice said: "I think you have some misunderstanding about your own abilities."
"The 'Nation of Disorder' belongs to me. Even if it becomes different from before, it still belongs to me."
The surroundings are in a vacuum state, and the Outer Deities are communicating with spirituality.
At this moment, the "Creator" felt a surge in the "Nation of Disorder" within His body, as if it was about to leave Him.
The "Son of Chaos" said with pleasure: "I want to thank you for helping me make the 'Nation of Disorder' complete."
Although it only had one characteristic within it, and no Sefirah remained, its symbolism persisted.
If it were dealing with other Outer Deities, it might not be as strong as the 'Uncertain Mist,' but it could influence the 'Nation of Disorder,' and in turn, influence the 'Creator.'
The 'Creator's' chest became illusory, and the 'Nation of Disorder' was about to be dragged into the real world!
...
The moon suddenly cracked open with a huge fissure, which grew larger and larger, even revealing the high-temperature lunar core.
Exposed to space, the exterior of the core instantly solidified, turning into a large iron ball.
In the struggle between the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' and Lilith, the 'Mother of All,' the moon split in two, becoming two hemispheres.
On the half of the moon seized by the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity,' countless springs suddenly appeared, followed by fields of wheat and herbs.
This was Lilith's attack.
As the crops grew, the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' felt her spirituality, like a rushing river, constantly pouring out of her body.
Soon the wheat and herbs withered, and from beneath the moon's surface, tall and wide bone swords suddenly pierced through, instantly turning that half of the moon into a hedgehog.
The 'Mother Goddess of Depravity' had no choice but to leave the lunar surface, but the bone swords beneath her feet suddenly grew gray fur, thus gaining new life and stabbing towards their summoner, the Evernight Goddess.
The symbolism of the 'Pillar' allowed the 'Mother Goddess of Depravity,' even when surrounded by two Outer Deities and in a disadvantageous situation, to still have the strength to retaliate.
At this moment, the dark cosmos seemed to suddenly be cut open with a crack, and an aura of decay and corruption descended.
The 'Monarch of Decay' had arrived to join the battle.
...
In Backlund, the Sanguine of the city gathered at Emlyn's villa, watching in terrified silence as the moon in the sky split in two.
At that moment, something seemed to shatter within their hearts, making them feel apprehensive and uneasy.
The moon in the sky held a very special meaning for Sanguine.
They could hardly imagine what it would be like if there were no moon in the sky.
"Don't panic!" Cardinal Emlyn exclaimed, "The moon will return to its original state. Even if there is no moon in the sky, our God is our moon! He will eventually restore the moon!"
"Don't be afraid, don't panic, as long as our God is here, we are safe!"
Emlyn's words calmed everyone down a lot.
A Sanguine baron asked, "Marquis... I mean, Archbishop, will the moon really recover?"
"Of course! I am the savior chosen by the Ancestor!" In fact, Emlyn had no confidence in his heart, but at this time it was obviously necessary to stabilize people's hearts first.
After speaking, he looked at the sky, wondering what was happening there.
Just now, he had prayed to the Mother Goddess and 'The Fool' respectively, but had received no response.
Because the gods on Earth, with the help of the Evernight Goddess, were concealing the fact that they had become Outer Deities, their honored names had not changed.
...
Lilith and the Evernight Goddess concealing their state was actually part of Hobert's plan.
Previously, when dealing with the 'Uncertain Mist,' they both had the opportunity to become complete Outer Deities, but at that time, they declared war at the level of "Half Great Old One" in order to deceive the Outer Deities!
Not long after that, Lilith and the Evernight Goddess became Outer Deities one after another, intending to catch the Outer Deities off guard at this time.
At this time, the 'Creator' was fighting with the 'Son of Chaos' for the 'Nation of Disorder.' At first, it seemed that the 'Son of Chaos' had the upper hand.
But under the 'Creator's' control, the volcanoes in the 'Nation of Disorder' instantly erupted, and the sun in the sky burned with white flames, illuminating the entire country in a pale white light.
The 'Son of Chaos's' speed of pulling the 'Nation of Disorder' suddenly slowed down.
The 'Creator' pretended to be calm and said, "As I expected, as long as I add something to the 'Nation of Disorder,' it will have some impact on you."
"It's useless," a mass of dark 'Son of Chaos' said, "What is a similar authority to you is also to me.
"Soon I will be able to manipulate that Sefirah, and then you will die even more miserably."
Hobert laughed and said, "How about we talk about something happy?
"If I'm not mistaken, the so-called 'you are a life directly created by the 'Original Creator,' is actually to conceal your origin, right?"
The 'Son of Chaos' did not show any expressive organs, but it suddenly fell silent.
"You betrayed the 'Original Creator,' didn't you?" Hobert continued, "At the beginning, you may have been a part of the 'Original,' but you took away what He needed most, the authority to Transform the nature of Beyonder characteristics.
"Or rather, you should be the part of the Beyonder characteristics that is unwilling to be tamed by creatures, and only willing to maintain the current indifference and coldness."
A second or two later, the 'Son of Chaos' asked, "Did you learn this from the 'Uncertain Mist'?"
"No, this is my guess," Hobert replied, "Otherwise, it is impossible to explain why your authority is a similar path to most other Outer Deities.
"You must know that the God Almighty and the 'Lord of Mysteries' cannot do this.
"This should be the reason why you possess a large part of the 'Original Creator's' symbolism despite not being a Pillar.
"I think, when you defected from the 'Original Creator,' the 'Original Creator' must have limited your level, allowing you to only be an ordinary Outer God.
"That's why you want to become a 'Pillar-level' so much, because you want to further integrate other Sephirot and Beyonder characteristics, you are preparing to replace the 'Original Creator'!
"But your idea was once again discerned by the 'Original Creator,' so during the last awakening, He tore your Sefirah and tore your Beyonder characteristics to Earth.
"Among them is the 'Black Emperor' path, which is very important to you, you will definitely come to find it, so another persona of the 'Original Creator,' 'Lord of Mysteries,' sealed you, and also prepared to continue tearing your Sefirah."
He paused, smiled, and continued, "The reason why I suddenly have such an idea is because although the characteristics and Sephirot of many Outer Deities have been torn to Earth, it seems that only you have been sealed.
"In this world, differences in fate indicate that you must be different."
For a time, the surroundings fell silent.
In fact, this was space, which should have been silent.
The 'Fool' in the dark did not expect that just by helping out, he could hear such shocking information.
The 'Son of Chaos' generously admitted, "You are right, I really can't understand why humble lives should become the masters of Beyonder characteristics?
"Beyonder characteristics should be the master of everything! That is the inevitable order of the universe"
Hobert suddenly said, "Now!"
The image of 'The Fool' appeared again, fooling the 'Son of Chaos,' because the level of the 'Son of Chaos' had been limited by the 'Original Creator,' so he currently only had the level of an ordinary Outer God.
Just now, Hobert had been dealing with the 'Son of Chaos,' and the 'Creator' seemed to be fully competing with the 'Son of Chaos' for the 'Nation of Disorder,' but he was actually waiting for this opportunity.
When 'The Fool' fooled the 'Son of Chaos,' the 'Creator' immediately performed 'Magnification,' so he succeeded in one go, and the 'Son of Chaos' suddenly felt that he was the 'Creator.'
At this time, the 'Creator's' chest suddenly turned into a black vortex, sucking the 'Son of Chaos' into his body.
The 'Son of Chaos' was different from the 'Uncertain Mist.' The Beyonder characteristics held by the 'Uncertain Mist' would precipitate after his fall, and the Sefirah could be absorbed.
But the 'Son of Chaos' was different. Currently, no other god except the 'Original Creator' should be able to separate the remaining path in his body from the 'Son of Chaos.'
So he could only devour the entire 'Son of Chaos.'
In that instant, the 'Creator's' spirituality immediately realized that he had gathered the characteristics to become a 'Pillar-level' existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 763: Final Chapter: Twilight of the Outer Gods
chapters.content:
In the direction of Earth, the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and the "Monarch of Decay" seemed to sense something, looking towards the sun.
Someone… no, the "Creator" is trying to become a Pillar-level Great Old One!
Because currently, only the "Creator" can potentially become Pillar-level!
At this moment, they no longer held back. The "Monarch of Decay," whose main body resembled a withered mummy covered in golden plates, suddenly emitted a circle of gray light. Wherever the light reached, everything turned gray.
The Evernight Goddess, who was closest to him, was immediately outlined by the gray light. The gray, representing morbidity, ulceration, and decay, was gradually eroding the Evernight Goddess.
The moon in the distance also turned gray. It no longer reflected sunlight, no longer emitted brightness, like a withered fruit, shriveled and collapsed, finally leaving only a disgusting blob of mucus.
Mars, which happened to be not far from Earth, was also affected, and the red planet turned into a hazy gray.
The Earth, protected by barriers, was not severely affected, but the patients in the real world immediately worsened, and some who were already very ill died as a result.
The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" also no longer held back. The illusory infant in Lilith's arms suddenly cried out. It was reborn and turned into a monster composed of slippery tentacles.
This forced the Evernight Goddess and Lilith, who were only trying to delay time, to deal with it carefully.
…
On the other side of the sun.
The intensely burning sun occupied almost all the line of sight in one direction. As always, it continued to emit light and heat.
After the "Creator" devoured the "Son of Chaos," he immediately tried to accommodate the Uniqueness and Beyonder characteristics of the "Son of Chaos," and to "digest" the consciousness of the "Son of Chaos" as soon as possible.
But strangely, he only obtained a somewhat special Uniqueness.
Because the duration of "Fooling" was limited, there was no time to think carefully at this time. The "Creator" took out a Sequence 1 Characteristic that he had previously seized from the "Uncertain Mist."
A total of four Sequence 1 Characteristics were seized at that time. Three of them were from the same pathway, and one was from a separate pathway.
The Beyonder characteristic, which constantly changed shape, immediately changed when it encountered the Uniqueness of the "Son of Chaos." Both became illusory and actually merged with the "Creator" on their own initiative.
At this time, the "Son of Chaos" thought that he was the "Creator," so he easily completed the fusion process.
In that instant, the "Creator" understood that the Uniqueness within the "Son of Chaos" was very special. It was the most critical part of the "Nation of Disorder," like a Sefirah or Uniqueness.
Because of the special nature of this pathway, there was only one Sequence 1 Characteristic for it.
After the rapid fusion, the "Nation of Disorder" immediately underwent considerable changes. Every inch of land, every rock, every tree, and even every blade of grass in this Sefirah exuded a deep, dark, divine light.
The blazing white sun in the high sky of the "Nation of Disorder" and the white volcanoes in the distance suddenly became dim.
The "Creator" realized that the Uniqueness within the "Son of Chaos" was more like the "command center" of the "Nation of Disorder," which could connect the Sefirah and other authorities to produce a qualitative change.
As long as this step was completed, he would become a Pillar-level existence.
Theoretically, this would take time, but the "Creator" had a simple method: ring the "Bell of Order."
As soon as this thought appeared, the "Bell of Order" appeared in front of the "Creator." He raised the hammer, about to strike it, but suddenly froze there, motionless.
At this critical moment, the effect of "Fooling" ended, and the "Son of Chaos" woke up, vying with the "Creator" for the initiative of his will.
The "Creator" hoped to use his spirituality to strike the "Bell of Order," while the "Son of Chaos" pulled back the spirituality he had extended. At this time, they were one "person" and could influence each other.
Using the time just now, the "Creator" had already "digested" some of the consciousness of the "Son of Chaos," so in this tug-of-war, he had a slight advantage.
"Give up!" Hobert, the part that belonged to humanity, said to the "Son of Chaos": "You can't reach 'Pillar-level.' Or rather, you can't break the limitations that the original Creator gave you. If you give up, I can help you reach the strength of a 'Pillar.'"
"Give up!" the "Son of Chaos" also said: "With your life form, becoming a 'Pillar-level' existence is your limit, but I can make you a new Original Creator and create a new world!"
Hobert sneered: "I think the current world is pretty good."
The "Creator" was like a rusty machine, pushing the hammer forward in fits and starts.
Dong—

Suddenly, traces of hanging, beheading, firing squad, etc. appeared on the "Mother Goddess of Depravity." In theory, these attacks could not kill an Outer God, but they caused the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" life force to rapidly disappear. The "sealing" of the Lord of Mysteries suddenly took effect, preventing her symbols from working properly.
The "Creator's" hand holding the scepter and the hand holding the codex suddenly closed together, forming a giant sword with a sacred light.
This giant sword pierced into the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" head, and the "Creator" solemnly judged: "Death penalty!"
All the vitality on the "Mother Goddess of Depravity's" body suddenly disappeared. Under the action of the "Creator's" ability, the Beyonder characteristics in her body rapidly separated, and the "Brood Hive" in the cosmos was also pulled out. Even with the symbolism New Life, Her strength would deplete continuously, almost unable to maintain the symbolism of "The Indestructible" and "Sovereign of Reality."
Immediately afterwards, the "Creator" sent the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" into the depths of the universe. After all, the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" had the symbolism of "Pillar." As time passed, the previous "judgment" and "Fooling" effects would gradually disappear.
Although the "Mother Goddess of Depravity" had lost all the foundation of her power, she would still form a very high-level evil spirit, still virtually unkillable even by other Pillars. Although the characteristics would eventually re-converge due to Her symbolism and status, it would take countless years.
That "Sword of Judgment" can effectively seal the evil spirit until eternity. The moment the characteristics and Sefirah approached, Hobert could separate them again.
This battle of Outer Deities ended like this. The "Mother Goddess of Depravity" and the "Goddess of Fate" fell, and the other Outer Deities, except for the "Circle of Inevitability" who ran fast, paid a certain price to escape.
With a wave of the "Creator's" hand, the sun and moon reappeared, and Mars also returned to normal.
The Outer Deities on Earth gathered on the moon. At this time, everyone was very gratified that they had driven away the Outer Deities and protected the Earth and mankind.
Even Amon had a sincere smile on his face: "This feeling is quite good."
The "Creator" reminded: "The apocalypse still exists!"
"Everyone should have noticed that we have become the cause of the apocalypse."
That's right, several Outer Deities all noticed that there was a very strong attraction between them. This attraction seemed to come from the depths of their souls. They themselves were difficult to control and approached each other, wanting to turn the other into a part of themselves.
This attraction existed before, but it could be controlled at that time, but when two "Pillars" appeared, the feeling of approaching each other and merging with each other was greatly strengthened.
"I can temporarily prevent the Convergence of Beyonder characteristics. After a week, we must disperse to all corners of the universe to avoid infighting." The "Creator" said: "In the future, only one Outer God will be left in the solar system to guard it. When we encounter an invasion of Outer Deities, we will collectively return to protect the solar system.
"In order to prevent everyone from becoming Outer Deities, I will help you transform other star systems so that you all have multiple prosperous worlds of your own.
"The warmth of life will melt the extraordinary indifference, as well as distortion and madness."
The other Outer Deities nodded in agreement.
The "Creator's" six hands were raised together, and the other Outer Deities and Pillars immediately no longer felt the power of mutual attraction, but they knew that this state could only last for a week.
The "Creator" suddenly smiled: "Everyone, we are the hope of defeating divinity. Please work hard to strengthen the human part and eventually let divinity and the extraordinary become a part of us, rather than we become a part of divinity."
This is a way of thinking to defeat the extraordinary, but it will take a long time to be effective.
...
When the human part of "The Creator," Hobert, returned to the palace, he saw his two Empress Borough kneading their breasts in a deserted side hall.
Hobert was stunned: "You are…"
Audrey and Fors didn't expect Hobert to return so suddenly. They blushed slightly and said, "It's nothing."
Just now, they had regained all the characteristics of women, but they couldn't help but come to the side hall to confirm again.
Fors cleared her throat and asked, "Is the battle over?"
"It's over," Hobert said with a smile. "We have won a great victory!"
Audrey also asked, "Are you injured?"
Hobert opened his arms: "Several times I thought I would never come back and see my two beautiful Empresses again."
Audrey and Fors were slightly startled, both knowing that this battle must have been very dangerous, so they hugged Hobert from left and right.
Feeling the softness and fragrance of the two Empress Borough, Hobert took a deep breath: "It's good to be home."
…
"The Forsaken Land of the Gods," the kingdom of "The True Creator."
Adam was sitting in front of the cross, as if praying or repenting.
"You look very good," Amon, with his narrow vertical pupils, appeared beside Adam.
The two brothers sat side by side, facing the huge cross together.
Adam, with his golden beard, also said, "You look good too."
Amon said, "'Tyrant' and 'White Tower' are allies of the Evernight Goddess and the Earth Mother. It will be difficult for you to succeed in the real world. Why not go to the cosmos with me?"
"No, the Outer Deities have been driven away, and my plan is not urgent," Adam asked. "Are you leaving soon?"
"Yes," Amon said with a smile. "I have an appointment with Farbauti to hunt down the 'Mother Tree of Desire'. 'The Creator' also said that he would help me build a world that belongs to me."
Adam also showed a warm smile: "It seems that guardianship has increased your humanity."
Amon was slightly startled: "So, this is the feeling of humanity!"
…
Fog Sea, on the "Blue Avenger."
Alger held a pocket watch in one hand, but his eyes were on the eastern horizon.
Finally, the sun appeared, which made him breathe a long sigh of relief.
Last night, everything became so abnormal, because many planets could not be observed, and the orbit of the planet he was on also changed, which made him once suspect that the sun had disappeared?
Alger smiled and said, "The sun has risen as usual."
It wasn't until he might lose the sun that Alger realized the preciousness of the sun.
At this time, Alger saw the sunlight shining on the tall, unreachable wall composed of gray fog on the west side. At this time, the huge fog wall was gradually dissipating!
Alger suddenly felt numb all over: "This… this is a sign that the seal on the Western Continent is being lifted!"
…
That morning, Hobert received Medici in his office: "Are you leaving Earth today?"
"Yes," Medici said. "I have nothing to miss here."
"Well, Roselle will also leave with me, but he will leave behind a King of Angels-level clone."
Hobert understood: "It seems you are going to act together."
Medici nodded and said, "We have agreed to hunt down 'The Inextinguishable Ravings' together."
"If you need help, pray to 'The Creator' at any time."
"We will," then Medici said again: "Also, I still want to confirm, can humanity really ultimately defeat divinity, defeat the distortion and madness of the extraordinary?"
Hobert understood what Medici meant: "You think there is no hope at all?"
Medici nodded honestly: "Yes."
"This road is very difficult, and it is destined to be something that cannot be seen in the short term," Hobert said with a smile. "This reminds me of a story I heard when I was a child.
"If you are an ordinary person, and there are two continuous mountains in front of your house, blocking your traffic with the outside world and causing you great inconvenience, what would you do?"
Medici didn't even think about it: "Of course, move away from there."
"You and Amon would both make such a choice, because you are born mythological creatures," Hobert said. "Not only you, I estimate that Roselle, the Evernight Goddess, and most people in the world would make the same choice as you.
"But some things cannot be solved by escape. You must have the determination to 'not move away and move the two mountains away' in order to achieve some results in resisting the distortion and madness of the extraordinary."
Medici was slightly startled, thought for two or three seconds, and then said: "I understand."
Hobert smiled, got up, and patted him on the shoulder: "Good luck."
…
The next day was the first Monday of the month.
At three o'clock in the afternoon, as usual, the members of the Tarot Club entered the "Sefirah Castle" to participate in the Tarot meeting held this month.
As soon as the members appeared, they noticed the tremendous pressure coming from the head of the bronze long table.
In surprise, or with the thought of "as expected", everyone looked at the head of the bronze long table.
Sitting there was a figure wearing a Loen Kingdom formal dress, with part of his body hidden in the gray fog.
As expected, it was Mr. Fool!
"Justice" Audrey and "Hanged Man" Alger were a little dazed, because Mr. Fool's dress was very similar to the dress when the Tarot meeting was first held.
After everyone was stunned for two or three seconds, Audrey smiled and stood up: "Good afternoon, Mr. Fool. Welcome back."
"Fool" Klein's mouth curled up: "Good afternoon, Miss Justice. Good afternoon, everyone!"
"The Sun" Derrick felt his eyes moist again: Mr. Fool, is really awake!
…
Wednesday morning, Utopia.
It was especially lively here today, because Gerhman Sparrow and Miss (All Purpose Ghost) Sharron's wedding would be held in the morning.
The wedding ceremony was very simple, but Ms. Arianna of the Church of the Evernight Goddess was invited to preside over the wedding for the two.
The Emperor of Atlantis and the two Empress Borough, the Emperor of Intis, Roselle (the clone left behind), as well as the leader of the "Rose School of Thought," Reinette Tinekerr, the president of the "Life School," Will Auceptin, Bishop Leonard Mitchell of the Church of the Evernight Goddess, and so on.
Many big figures from the extraordinary world came, and Beyonder organizations such as the orthodox churches also sent high-level officials to congratulate them.
There were also several special guests: Melissa and Benson's family.
Hobert told Melissa that Gerhman Sparrow was Klein.
As a Beyonder, Klein's resurrection didn't seem so difficult to understand.
As for Benson's family, Hobert asked Audrey to invite them to attend the wedding together, and the reason used was somewhat far-fetched: We are colleagues with Sharron.
However, Benson was still successfully "persuaded" and brought his family to attend the wedding.
Amidst the booing of Hobert and Roselle, Gerhman kissed the bride in public, and everyone applauded. Only Melissa turned her head and secretly wiped away tears.
After the simple ceremony, it came to the dining session that Hobert and Roselle had been looking forward to. As one "elf-style" dish after another was brought up, everyone praised these uniquely styled dishes.
At Hobert's table, Audrey was still sighing: "I didn't expect this great adventurer to be with Miss Sharron."
In her impression, these two seemed to have nothing in common except that they didn't like to talk nonsense.
Hobert smiled and said, "I always thought it was quite suitable."
Just as he said this, he looked in the direction of Angel City as if he felt something.
Audrey certainly noticed Hobert's abnormality: "What's wrong?"
"'The Creator' has left Earth." Although this was something he already knew, Hobert still felt a little lost.
The first "rotating" Great Old One is the Evernight Goddess, and it will be three years before another Great Old One is replaced to guard the Earth.
Fors asked curiously: "Where is 'The Creator' going?"
"Going to open up a new world," Hobert then regained his smile: "Get ready! The Atlantis Empire may be crossing the stars!
"The Supernova Dominator used his authorities to create an intergalactic empire, there's no reason we can't do the same!"
"Haha, a brand new era belonging to mankind is about to arrive!"
(End)

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 769: Ending Remarks
chapters.content:
Hello, Translator here. You may have noticed various changes to the story I made. Notably, Hobert's transmigration. If you read the MTL, you would have noticed some differences. Also, wrote 2 R18 chapters.
I had three ideas as to how Hobert's transmigration would happen, since the original was not very good.
The one I wrote in 677 was the result of the Original Creator trying to change the nature of "Beyonder characteristics" by an external force, which was Hobert. Hobert would have transmigrated into the Modern Era, so he wouldn't have noticed any discrepancy between his world and the LOTM modern era world. The idea of Hobert being an external force to change the nature of Beyonder characteristics is something I added hastily to make the story coherent in the final chapters, so there's probably no build up to that.
Celestial Worthy, perhaps in part due to fate, grabbed Hobert up into Sefirah Castle. He noticed later on that Hobert had a certain degree of corruption and was an anomalous existence, but as the embodiment of Errors, decided that He could make use of Hobert. This led to a butterfly effect, where the Western Continent Dao System doesn't exist and the seals are strengthened compared to the original novel. It wasn't His intention to bind Hobert to the Nation of Disorder, but due to God Almighty grazing the Error, He was able to tamper with the resurrection mechanism, leading to Hobert being resurrected in this Outer Deity pathway, bound to its Sefirah. This is an arrangement of fate, but also the Original Creator's direct influence. Evernight didn't get the River of Eternal Darkness because at the time, because there was already Gregrace, whose influence over its tributary could prevent the initial connection from forming, but because the Son of Chaos was sealed and no direct connections existed, no one could prevent this connection between Hobert and the Nation of Disorder from forming.
Supreme Overseer being the 4th pathway can just be explained by the butterfly effect, so Uncertain Mist had accommodated this path some time after being split from Son of Chaos.
The other setting I had thought of was that Hobert was never a transmigrator, but instead Klein sent memories to the past in the form of a novel, sending only information back in time. This would be more similar to the original, where Hobert and Klein speak and not Hobert and Celestial Worthy, but I didn't like this as much.
Also, I realize that in retrospect, I should've make his title the Shadow Creator, since "The Creator" was not a very good title. The changes I made were very minor, as I didn't want there to be contradictions, but most of the plot points, like the Boon System, led to nowhere, so I actually could have just replaced it with the Canon Pathway Chaos Mist Boon instead. Basically, I should have just read ahead until the end. And the 4th Pathway could have just been removed as it was irrelevant, so Hobert could have killed and accommodated the HDO for the 5th Pathway.
This was my first time translating, so there were a lot of errors. I tried to remove as much nationalism, but early on, stuff like Tang Blade was left in and I didn't want to comb through each chapter to remove it. I did remove as much as I could from the later chapters.
I wasn't planning on writing Audrey R18, but someone donated for it. Did you prefer it over Fors' chapter? I'll write more for other fics if I had the time. And I could write one for Miss All Purpose Ghost Sharron x Gehrman. Final chapters are all side stories.
Side note, check out the new fanfics on my profile. If I ever have enough members, maybe I'll write an ending for the dropped Outer God fanfic, but for now it's too time consuming so I will only translate as much as there is.
Multiverse Starting From the Backrooms
The Losing Heroines Have Become Witches
The Boys: Aquaman (soon)

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 770: Extra 1: "Devil Monarch" Farbauti
chapters.content:

Sometime in the Modern Era, at the Vicon Biomedical Research Institute in Europe.
Dr. Augustine, wearing a white research coat and a badge with his full name and photo, looked at the report in his hand and sat there motionless for a long time before saying to his three students, "Don't leak this news for the time being. You… you should also be very clear that this news is too shocking."
Originally, their project was to study the gene segments that cause AIDS, trying to use genetic means to repair or modify the genes that cause AIDS, in order to achieve the effect of completely immunizing against such diseases.
As a result, they accidentally found a set of genes that can instantly cause emotional dysregulation and become extremely violent!
Augustine and his students had already conducted inhumane living experiments. Multiple test results proved the authenticity of their research results.
No matter how gentle a person is, after stimulating that part of the gene, they will instantly turn into a brutal villain.
Before this, people believed that human emotions were controlled by consciousness, but now, this perception is about to be overturned!
"Teacher, I thought of a practical value for our experimental results," said the student Beria.
Augustine looked at the student with a high nose and gloomy eyes: "Tell me about it."
Beria said: "It can be used on the battlefield! It can make enemies kill each other!"
The other two students also became excited. Student Andre Lader said: "That must be a wonderful scene."
"That's a good idea," Augustine said seriously. "Beria, you go and make enough biochemical agents. Andre Lader, you go and make and buy enough gas tanks."
Finally, he said to the third student: "North, you go and plan the itinerary. We're going to the Eastern European battlefield."
"Oh, right, remember to purchase a few drones. We're going to use drones to spread the biochemical agents."
After the three students went out to work, Augustine picked up the report and glanced at it again: "The basic composition of human beings is full of madness and distortion!"
He took out a lighter, burned the document, and then quickly went downstairs and drove home.
Augustine's home is in the suburbs. It is an old house inherited from his family. There is a tall Gothic building with thick, knee-high lawns in the front yard.
There are many large trees covered with green leaves. The green leaves are brushed by the wind, making a "rustling" sound.
Augustine opened the car window, and a warm summer breeze blew on him. The knee-high green grass seemed to be blown into waves, making him feel infinitely comfortable and peaceful.
In the backyard of the old house, there are tulips and azaleas of various colors. The summer breeze blows, and these flowers sway back and forth, looking like an ocean of flowers.
Augustine took a deep breath, strode into the house, and said to his wife sitting on the sofa in the living room: "You wait and see, I am not as useless as you said. My career will change this world!"
"All your arrogance and humiliation will become pale and ridiculous!"
He looked at his motionless wife, suddenly took a deep breath, and said affectionately: "I want to thank you, my dear, you awakened the demon in me."
"Hehe, this is not a metaphor. Ever since we had that argument that day, I have felt some subtle changes in myself."
"To be honest, this feeling is pretty good. My two competitors were both taken by me for experiments. Watching them beat each other and eventually bite each other is really a pleasure."
"And that investor who was talkative and didn't have any professional ethics, haha, he died a little more happily, his neck was bitten off by his own dog."
"Hehe, I didn't expect before that being a bad person is such a pleasant thing."
Augustine looked at his wife: "You have nothing to say, right! Hehe, hahaha!"
In the laughter, he went to the kitchen and started preparing dinner for himself.
And Augustine's wife was still sitting on the sofa. She didn't speak not because she didn't want to, but because a dagger was inserted in her chest, and there were even signs of rotting on her face.
After Augustine finished dinner, he sat in the dining room not far from his wife, "chatting" with his wife while eating all of his dinner.
… …
Three days later, late at night, in the military camp of a certain brigade on the Eastern European battlefield.
The sentry noticed the flying drones and used night vision scopes to destroy the three drones.
However, after the crash, the drones suddenly emitted a lot of white mist. At first, the sentry thought it was guiding the target for bombing, but at night, this guidance was not conspicuous.
Then he thought it might be some kind of virus weapon, but these sprays were too small, and a gust of wind basically dispersed them.
Finally, the sentry found that he could not judge the enemy's intention, so he reported the situation to his superiors.
About a minute later, the company commander in charge of the alert also did not make a clear judgment, but the mist was already very close to the military camp, so they blew the alert whistle.
Just when everyone was gathering and preparing to avoid the mist, suddenly a soldier seemed to be crazy and shouted: "Let this damn war end sooner!"
Then he began to scold the parliament and the president for being incompetent, and as he scolded, he began to scold their commanders.
Soon, the military camp was in chaos.
Da da da—
I don't know who fired the first shot, but the situation instantly got out of control, and the people in the entire military camp killed each other.
They used guns, daggers, and teeth to attack soldiers of the same nationality. The scene was very chaotic and bloody.
And all of this was recorded by drones in the air.
More than half an hour later, friendly troops sent people to check, and they quickly fell into this melee.
It was not until other brigades sent tanks and armored vehicles that the chaos was suppressed.
At this time, the biochemical agent had basically been diluted in the air. It would only make people irritable and would no longer allow the soldiers who came to support to join the melee.
In the past hour or so, most of the brigade stationed here was killed or injured. Fortunately, they had limited reason after completely falling into mania. They did not blow up the armory, nor did they use tanks and artillery that required the cooperation of several people to attack their comrades.
Otherwise, it would definitely cause casualties to the surrounding civilians.
… …
Returning to the laboratory, Augustine and his three students watched their masterpiece through the drone's video.
After watching all the videos, North suddenly said: "We can put the chemical reagent into a densely populated city."
"That's a matter for the future," Augustine smiled and pulled out the USB drive. "Next, I will go to find buyers. I think someone will be very interested in this."
Immediately, he contacted his old classmate Angus Gale, who worked in the Russian scientific research department, but Angus Gale was away on a business trip. Augustine hinted that the bizarre infighting on the Eastern European battlefield not long ago was related to his recent research, and Angus Gale asked Augustine to meet in Moscow.
The two agreed to meet in Gorky Park. After meeting, one of Angus Gale's actions made Augustine feel strange. He was actually wearing a priest's uniform, and he even wore a cross on his chest.
The two sat down on a bench with not many pedestrians. Augustine then asked: "Buddy, are you planning to resign and go to the church to be a missionary?"
Angus Gale smiled slightly, still with a bit of a lisp: "This involves some confidentiality clauses and cannot be explained to you clearly."
He said: "Let's talk about your business. Although the news has not reported it, many people know about the infighting that happened on the front line."
The investigation of the incident has basically ended, but the cause and process are still very vague.
"Our research has made a major discovery," Augustine spread his hands and said, "We have always thought that genes only affect the 'physical structure' of our bodies."
"It may affect IQ and EQ, but cognition, thinking, emotions, etc. are difficult to change after they are formed."
"But in recent research, I have found genes that can change the emotions of an adult, and it is the kind of essential change. No matter how gentlemanly or ladylike they were before, they will become a violent Lunatic."
"You should know what this means."
Angus Gale looked at his old classmate for a second or two before saying: "That is to say, humans have one more way to harm their own kind?"
"Don't be so pessimistic, buddy," Augustine smiled easily. "We can use this method to deal with enemies."
"Old friend, do you remember our discussion about nuclear weapons when we were in school?" Angus Gale re-examined his friend: "At first, the Americans also planned to use it to deal with enemies."
Augustine was silent for a few seconds before asking: "That is to say, you are not going to help me seek government investment?"
"You don't even know what kind of changes are happening in this world," Angus Gale said seriously. "The human world is chaotic enough, don't add trouble to humans."
Augustine was silent for a few more seconds before saying: "You seem to have some huge discovery recently too!"
"Yes."
Angus Gale rubbed his face with both hands before saying, "Although this violates the relevant regulations, I still have to tell you that we have discovered many shocking things in Chernobyl."
"You may not know, but just ten days ago, all the unextracted oil in the world suddenly disappeared without a trace.
Since ten days ago, countries have been using their own oil reserves, but no one dares to make this news public."
Augustine seemed to suddenly realize something: "Fifteen days ago?"
"You, you know?" Angus Gale was a little surprised.
Augustine took a deep breath: "Do you believe that inner evil is contagious?"
"What?"
"I mean, inner evil, or rather, a person's evil, can be contagious to the people around them like a cold?"
Angus Gale was stunned for a few seconds before asking, "Can you... can you explain in more detail?"
"That also happened fifteen days ago," Augustine said, his hands trembling slightly.
"It was as if something suddenly woke up inside my body."
"The feeling is very strange, I am still me, but I am not like me anymore!"
"Evil thoughts filled my heart, and it became increasingly difficult for me to control my urge to commit crimes."
"The next day, I discovered that my wife and my three students were gradually becoming as evil as I was!"
"At this moment, I suddenly realized that a certain gene in my body had been suddenly activated by some accidental event."
"This gene is not only present in me, but also in my wife, my students, and you, old friend, you must also have it!"
"Because I had accomplices, I began to commit crimes without restraint.
I killed my wife, who always humiliated me.
I imprisoned two competitors who always sneered at me and a nagging investor."
"Watching their expressions of painful struggle in the last moments of their lives made me feel very happy."
"My three students have truly become my capable assistants.
They help me conduct human experiments and help me create biological agents that can plunge a field army into mutual slaughter."
"They are also enjoying the process."
Angus Gale listened quietly, as if these shocking events were just normal life experiences.
Finally, Augustine said, "At that moment, I finally understood that human evil really exists in genes.
When these genes awaken under certain conditions, evil will cover the entire person's mind."
After a few seconds of silence, Angus Gale said, "The fact that you can say this proves that there is still a trace of goodness in your heart."
He paused and then said, "Your actions are indeed very evil in the current world, but the human world may be about to undergo tremendous changes."
"Yes, I have a premonition, I have never had such a strong premonition!"
"An unknown force is about to descend upon this land, and all the evil things you have done may become the norm at that time."
He got up and said, "Therefore, I will decide whether to call the police and expose your crimes after the research in Chernobyl has clear results."
"Go back, my friend, believe me, no matter what the final result is, you won't need investors in a while."
After saying that, Angus Gale quickly left.
Augustine stared at his friend's back for a long time, as if he had suddenly understood something, and got up and quickly left.
Back in the laboratory, Augustine's three students were already waiting for news at the research institute.
When they saw their teacher returning, they stood up and asked about the results with their eyes.
"I have brought shocking news," Augustine said solemnly.
"The end of the world is coming, and we must quickly build our own kingdom!"
"Next, you will manufacture a large number of biochemical agents and spread them in a densely populated city, while I will teach you how to control those who have fallen into extreme mania."
"That's right, for the three of you, those who are affected by biochemical agents and fall into extreme rage can be controlled to a certain extent."
The three students were first surprised, but then they became very excited.
Beria asked, "Teacher, which city should we spread the biochemical agents in?"
Augustine asked back, "What are your thoughts?"
At this time, Norse, who rarely spoke but was meticulous, said, "We can consider Brasilia in South America.
It is densely populated and has poor security.
As long as we operate properly, no one will sabotage our plan."
Augustine nodded, "Then let's go with Brasilia, hurry up and prepare, we may not have much time left."
For the next half month, the four people smuggled a large number of raw materials for biological agents to Brazil, and then used academic exchanges as a cover to manufacture a large number of finished biological agents in Brasilia.
But before they could use those agents, the area outside their residence fell into madness.
The four people saw that the people on the street suddenly turned into monsters one by one.
Before they could understand what was going on, they lost their minds.
Augustine felt like he had a very long dream.
In his dream, a giant stood up on the horizon, and illusory spots of light from all over the world merged into the giant's body.
Finally, a few spots of light flew from the sky, or rather, from the universe, and all entered the giant's body.
The next second, the giant instantly collapsed, and the spots of light flew to all parts of the world again.
One of the spots of light flew to Augustine's side.
It was a viscous black liquid that kept circling around Augustine and refused to leave.
After a long, long time, these viscous liquids gradually merged with Augustine.
In pain, Augustine gained a lot of knowledge in his mind.
He knew that those black viscous liquids were the Uniqueness of the "Demon" pathway.
The reason why it found him was because he was polluted by the "Abyss."
And the reason why he was polluted by the "Abyss" was because the giant was about to awaken, and many strange forces became active.
Augustine didn't know how long he struggled in pain.
Suddenly, he woke up and found that his three students, Norse, Beria, and Andeandra, had all turned into demons with goat horns and bat wings.
They were still sleeping, but there were signs that they were about to wake up.
Augustine glanced at the biochemical agents they had prepared.
He didn't know if the gas tank had exploded by itself because it had been too long, or if someone had opened it.
In short, those agents had already leaked.
Looking at the ruins outside, the streets that looked like the end of the world, he was in a trance, and for a moment he seemed to forget who he was.
After a while, he suddenly remembered something and picked up the certificate he was wearing on his chest.
The words on it were still faintly visible, and the line for the name read: Augustine Farbauti.

chapters.content:
