The space-time outside the Mysteries universe.
September 12, 2030, Hainan Wenchang Space Launch Center.
According to the weather forecast, the next few hours will be a rare launch window.
As the three astronauts boarded the spacecraft in the elevator inside the "Mobile Launch Platform," which is more than 140 meters high, the lunar landing program officially entered the launch phase.
Command Center: "Now entering the launch countdown, ten, nine… three, two, one, ignite!"
Rumble—
With a loud roar, the five high-power aerospace engines at the tail of the "Shenzhou-10" carrier rocket, which is more than 100 meters high, successfully ignited. In the dazzling light, amid the cheers of people outside the launch site, the rocket quickly ascended.
The first-stage rocket accelerated to 9,300 kilometers per hour, and the engine was shut down at an altitude of 70 kilometers, and the first-stage rocket separated.
Immediately afterward, the second-stage rocket ignited, taking 6 minutes and 30 seconds to accelerate to 25,000 kilometers per hour, and separated at an altitude of 175 kilometers.
Finally, the third-stage rocket ignited, operating for only about two minutes, sending the spacecraft into Earth orbit.
At this point, Commander Yin Xuejiang reported to the command center: "The launch operation was a complete success."
Applause came from the command center in the communicator, but this was only the first step in the operation, so everyone just applauded and celebrated for a while and then remained on standby.
After the spacecraft circled the Earth three and a half times in Earth orbit, it found a suitable switching position, and the third-stage rocket ignited again, and the spacecraft left Earth orbit and headed for the moon.
At this time, the protective shield at the front end of the rocket opened, revealing the "Dream Boat" spacecraft used for this lunar landing mission. The spacecraft separated from the rocket and headed to its destination alone.
The speed of "Dream Boat" has reached about 40,000 kilometers per hour, but it still takes three days to reach the Earth's only satellite: the Moon.
On the spacecraft, the three astronauts finally breathed a sigh of relief. For the next three days, they only needed to constantly monitor the orbit and maintain contact with the command center at any time.
These tasks could be completed by one astronaut, so they could take turns to rest.
The youngest astronaut, Ma Shen, was the first to leave his seat and looked out at the space through the porthole in a state of weightlessness. He couldn't help but sigh: "It's so beautiful."
Outside was a dark cosmos, as if filled with infinite tranquility and profundity.
There is no light corruption here, and there is no obstruction from the atmosphere, so the field of vision is very clear. As long as you are not facing the sun, you can see a beautiful star sea.
It's just that this star sea seems to be immersed in a distant world, and looks very deep, which seems to be a little different from the star sea seen on Earth.
In this way, under alternating monitoring, after more than two days of travel, the moon has occupied a large part of the field of vision. At this time, through the porthole, you can even see several huge craters on the surface of the moon.
At this time, "Dream Boat" made a posture adjustment and turned 180 degrees, with the head of the spacecraft facing the Earth.
After sufficient preparation, at this time, the "Dream Boat" spacecraft with its tail in front ignited its thrusters to decelerate and successfully entered lunar orbit.
Because the gravity of the moon is small, the lunar orbit is much lower than the Earth orbit. At this time, "Dream Boat" is flying around the moon at a distance of tens of kilometers from the lunar surface.
They have to make final adjustments in lunar orbit, and then officially start the lunar landing operation.
Ma Shen, as usual, took advantage of his rest time to lie on the porthole and look at the scenery outside.
That is a desert-like planet, which looks as if there is no life at all.
Suddenly, something seemed to move in a certain crater. Ma Shen quickly adjusted his position to find the moving object.
Nothing was found.
Soon, the "Dream Boat" spacecraft circled the moon again, and Ma Shen carefully observed the crater just now, but still found nothing.
Ma Shen wondered if he had just had a hallucination?
Suddenly, a hand patted Ma Shen, scaring him.
Looking back, it was Commander Yin Xuejiang: "Boss, you scared me to death."
Yin Xuejiang smiled and said: "Are you so timid? Go to the service mod and get box No. 6."
The "Dream Boat" spacecraft is mainly composed of three mods: the lunar landing mod, the command mod, and the service mod.
A series of operations on the spacecraft are mainly completed in the command mod. The service mod is composed of two parts, one part is the aero engine and fuel tank, gain antenna, four-way thruster, oxygen tank, etc., and the other part contains some necessary materials and supplies.
When Ma Shen brought box No. 6, Commander Yin Xuejiang said to Luo Rui, another astronaut on duty: "Temporarily turn off all communicators."
Luo Rui was slightly stunned, but immediately executed the order.
After all the communicators were turned off, Yin Xuejiang said: "Before you rest, I want to relay a top-secret document to you and explain Order No. 0!"
Ma Shen and Luo Rui were slightly stunned and immediately realized that there was a secret mission in this lunar landing operation.
Yin Xuejiang began to tell: "During the 'Chang'e-3' mission, the camera captured an object moving at high speed on the surface of the moon.
Because the picture was relatively blurry and fleeting, it was uncertain whether it was an extraterrestrial civilization creature, so the news was not made public.
Therefore, in the 'Chang'e-4 and 5' missions, there were tasks to find high-speed moving objects.
In the 'Chang'e-5' mission, the relay satellite finally observed the object again, and we named it 'Lunar Moving Object'.
After a 48-second observation, it was basically determined that the object had no intelligence, but the target's destructiveness was very great. If the lunar landing spacecraft was hit by it, it would suffer very serious damage.
So, if you want to start the lunar landing operation, you must first investigate clearly what it is? And how to solve this problem.
Immediately after that, another problem appeared. People who have repeatedly watched the videos sent back by the relay satellite have experienced mental problems to varying degrees, and some even went crazy directly two weeks later.
It can be basically determined that the mental problems that appeared on them were caused by watching the video about the 'Lunar Moving Object'. The appearance of the other party may cause unknown mental harm.
Finally, the National Space Administration determined that the news and the video were not suitable for public release."
Ma Shen and Luo Rui were a little surprised. This type of cause was the first time they had heard of it.
The commander continued to tell: "At this time, the National Space Administration established contact with the US Space Agency and asked them if they had encountered similar situations during the lunar landing in the last century.
As a result, the Space Agency did not make any reply.
After we inquired many times, the Space Agency replied: Why do you think we stopped the lunar landing operation?"
Luo Rui understood: "They also encountered the same problem."
"Obviously yes." The commander said: "And obviously they failed to solve the problem, and therefore interrupted the lunar landing plan and failed to establish a temporary base on the surface of the moon.
"Then we have to solve this problem ourselves. We have launched 3 more artificial satellites to monitor the 'Lunar Moving Object' in turn and make a more detailed analysis of it.
"First of all, the researchers discovered that the 'Lunar Moving Object' actually has illusory characteristics, and often does not seem to be in the real world.
"At the same time, the satellite has also made many attempts, and conventional weapons, electromagnetic weapons, and radioactive weapons have had almost no impact on it.
"For a time, it became the biggest problem for the lunar landing operation, and we have not made any progress in our research on it."
Yin Xuejiang took a deep breath and continued: "At this time, a civilian named Zhou Mingrui said that he knew very well what it was.
Initially, the Space Administration didn't pay much attention to the other party's remarks, but because they couldn't find a solution to the problem, they invited Zhou Mingrui to join the research team.
The solution he offered was also very strange, actually launching a copy of the 'Constitution,' which we are currently using, towards the other party.
Ma Shen opened his mouth: "Is it the 'Constitution,' not scriptures?"
Luo Rui also laughed and said, "I also think that launching a Buddhist scripture seems more reliable."
Yin Xuejiang smiled: "This is indeed a strange suggestion. When no solution had been found three months after the suggestion was made, the Space Administration, with the idea of treating a dead horse as if it were still alive, carried a copy of the 'Constitution' on the experimental spacecraft while conducting other experiments.
"The result was very surprising. The same batch of weapons used for the experiment still yielded no results, but when the 'Constitution' was launched towards the other party, it clearly made a dodging motion.
"To verify the experimental results, we sent several more copies of the 'Constitution' to the moon. The 'lunar moving object' made a dodging motion every time."
This time, Ma Shen's mouth opened even wider, and Luo Rui also felt very surprised.
Yin Xuejiang said: "Only then did the Space Administration begin to pay attention to Zhou Mingrui's suggestion. The director even personally asked about the principle behind it.
"According to Zhou Mingrui's introduction, the monster on the moon is a projection of a monster from another universe."
Seeing that the two team members didn't understand what he meant, he further explained: "You should all have heard of this hypothesis.
"The universe we are currently in is actually a projection of another higher-dimensional universe.
"It's like a three-dimensional object being filmed with a camera and then displayed on a screen as a two-dimensional image.
"The monster's projection is similar to this theory.
"According to Zhou Mingrui, in another universe, this monster is on the moon, turning the moon red.
"Because it is very powerful, by chance, it left a projection on the moon in our universe.
"In another universe, the hero who defeated this monster used abilities that included the 'power of order.'
"And the 'Constitution,' which we have been using for decades, already has the abstract power of 'order,' so when the monster sees the 'Constitution,' it instinctively dodges."
The two astronauts had many questions and raised their hands to ask after the commander finished speaking.
Ma Shen asked: "Chief, is Zhou Mingrui also from another universe?"
Luo Rui then asked: "Commander, what is the other universe like?"
Yin Xuejiang said: "That belongs to a higher level of secret."
The two astronauts smiled helplessly.
The commander continued: "With Zhou Mingrui's participation, we have researched a solution to that monster.
"Because it is only a projection, it can be contained with a mirror that has a dark-colored characteristic.
"'Chang'e 7' and 'Chang'e 8' have proven that this method is indeed feasible, but because there is a signal delay between the lunar rover using the mirror and the ground, we have not been able to solve the monster after several attempts.
"However, those few experiments made us understand a fact: it is almost impossible to complete such a complex operation with intelligent robots, so that's why we have Mission Zero this time!"
Yin Xuejiang's expression became serious: "The above content is top secret!"
The two astronauts immediately stood at attention in the weightless state: "Yes!"
Then Ma Shen said: "It sounds very fantastical."
Yin Xuejiang said: "Human probes have not yet left the solar system. In fact, we are not very clear about what the universe is like."
Then he added: "The content of Mission Zero is: The most important task of this lunar landing mission is to contain the monster on the moon, laying a good foundation for us to establish a lunar base in the future."
He paused and then said: "I want to remind you that after coming into close contact with the monster, there is a high probability of going mad within two weeks.
"So you can choose whether to carry out this mission. Those who are unwilling to carry out the mission can stay in the command mod.
"Before the spacecraft launched from Earth, I had already chosen to carry out this mission, now it's your turn!"
Ma Shen smiled and said: "I was going to land on the moon anyway, count me in."
Luo Rui followed suit: "I didn't expect that I could also land on the moon to carry out a mission, then I definitely want to go."
According to the original plan, the commander and Ma Shen would board the lunar lander "Lanyue" to land on the moon and carry out a series of tasks on the lunar surface.
Luo Rui would stay in the service mod in lunar orbit, and after the lunar surface mission was completed, he would dock with the "Lanyue's" "ascent stage."
However, the docking process can also be completed with an intelligent computer. Leaving Luo Rui in near-Earth orbit is just in case. The lunar lander is not very crowded, and the fuel is enough to take three people back and forth to the lunar surface.
After confirming that the other two were willing to carry out Mission Zero, Yin Xuejiang opened Box Six and took out three small boxes from it.
Each small box contained a mirror that looked somewhat dark, and a brand new copy of the 'Constitution.'
Yin Xuejiang said: "Our spacesuits have a holder on the left chest, which is used to secure this 'Constitution.'
"As long as we have this 'Constitution,' the monster on the moon cannot harm us.
"After successfully using the mirror to contain the monster, put the mirror and the 'Constitution' back in the box. Under the effect of the 'Constitution,' this monster will be sealed in the mirror forever.
"Bring the box into lunar orbit for further processing."
Ma Shen suddenly realized a problem: "Commander, that is to say, if we hang a copy of the 'Constitution' outside our lunar landing spacecraft, our lunar landing spacecraft will not be attacked by the monster?"
"Yes."
Ma Shen was stunned for a moment and then asked: "Then, then why must we contain that monster? This task sounds very dangerous."
Yin Xuejiang smiled slightly: "How can we allow others to snore beside our bed!"
Ma Shen also smiled: "I have no questions."
So the "Mengzhou" spacecraft reopened the communication system. After the three took turns resting, the lunar lander separated from the spacecraft and began the lunar landing operation.
The "Lanyue" lander is mainly divided into two parts, the ascent stage and the descent stage.
The three astronauts operate the landing operation in the ascent stage. The main function of the descent stage is to decelerate during landing and provide a launch platform for the ascent stage.
After completing the lunar surface mission, the ascent stage and the descent stage separate. The engine of the ascent stage starts working, sending the ascent stage into lunar orbit to dock with the "Mengzhou" spacecraft under the not-so-great gravity of the moon.
Under the skillful operation of the three astronauts, "Lanyue" successfully landed.
Next, the lunar surface mission will begin. Yin Xuejiang ordered: "The three of us will be divided into two groups, one group will stay behind, and one group will carry out extravehicular activities.
"Luo Rui and I will carry out the first extravehicular activity, and Ma Shen will stay behind."
Ma Shen, who was about to put on his spacesuit, asked a little unacceptably: "Why?"
Luo Rui smiled and said: "Because you are the youngest."
Yin Xuejiang took a deep breath: "That's right, if both of us go crazy while carrying out the mission, it proves that we should have had close contact with the monster.
"Don't worry about us, retrieve the mirror containing the monster, and immediately operate the 'ascent stage' to return to near-Earth orbit. In the 'Mengzhou's' Folder 10, there is a follow-up mission outline."
Ma Shen was stunned for a second or two before saying: "Yes!"
So Yin Xuejiang and Luo Rui put on their spacesuits and carried out the first round of extravehicular missions.
The first to step off the landing gear was Yin Xuejiang. After trying to walk a few steps on the moon, he said: "After 56 years, mankind is visiting the moon again."
"This time, we will bring new surprises to the moon. After that, we will establish temporary and permanent bases in an organized manner. In the future, we will also grow vegetables on the moon."
At this moment, in the command center of the Wenchang launch site, all the staff excitedly stood up and applauded. Although they showed smiles, most of them had tears in their eyes.
Once upon a time, they could only watch others travel in space, land on the moon, and explore deep space.
Now, those who set off early are still standing still, but this Oriental dragon has caught up quickly and steadily.
After that, a series of actions such as sampling, taking photos, and preliminary geological exploration began, but no lunar monsters were encountered.
One round of extravehicular activity lasted for four hours. After returning to "Lanyue" to rest and replenish some food and water, the second round of extravehicular activity began.
When the established tasks were basically completed, the alarms worn by Yin Xuejiang and Luo Rui suddenly sounded.
Ma Shenhui reported in "Lanyue": "According to satellite monitoring, the 'lunar monster' is coming towards us, and the estimated trajectory is about eight kilometers away from you. Please move to the north immediately!"
Yin Xuejiang and Luo Rui immediately stopped their work, quickly boarded the lunar rover, and after looking at the compass and confirming the direction, immediately took action.
More than ten minutes later, the lunar rover traveled about six kilometers, and they could already see the rapidly moving shadow in the distance.
If the trajectory of the monster hadn't been calculated in advance by the satellite, unless the monster was rushing towards them, there would have been no way to encounter it.
The moment they saw that shadow, both of them felt their scalps tingle, and their spirits seemed to have been impacted.
Fortunately, this was just a projection. If they had seen the main body, the two of them would have lost control and died.
The two immediately got out of the car, and while opening the box to take out the mirrors, they moved towards the two directions to block the monster.
As for the "Constitution", they had already placed it on their chests in advance.
But soon they realized something was wrong. The monster was actually adjusting its direction.
The two immediately understood that the monster was afraid of the "Constitution", so it wanted to escape in other directions.
Astronaut Luo Rui immediately made a decision. He tried his best to throw the "Constitution" in the new direction the monster was moving, and shouted, "You little bastard, come to Grandpa here!"
The monster seemed to understand Luo Rui's humiliation and actually came towards him.
Yin Xuejiang in the other direction tried his best to rush over, but the moon's gravity was small, making it very difficult to move, and it was obviously too late.
Luo Rui held the mirror horizontally in front of him, staring at the monster in front of him.
As the monster approached, his mental activity became more and more intense, and his emotions were at risk of getting out of control, but he still held the mirror steadily in front of him!
In an instant, Luo Rui seemed to enter a dreamlike space.
He saw a huge figure representing everything standing on the horizon. Suddenly, the figure collapsed, and part of it formed the shadow in front of him.
Immediately, distorted and crazy thoughts appeared in Luo Rui's mind one after another. Finally, he tilted his head and fainted.
But he still maintained his standing posture, with the mirror steadily held in front of him.
Not far away, Yin Xuejiang, who was also under tremendous mental pressure, saw the huge shadow drill into the arm-high mirror while breathing heavily.
At this point, the huge mental pressure disappeared.
Luo Rui slowly fell to the ground.
Yin Xuejiang rushed over as quickly as possible, stumbling, picked up the mirror, and there was only a blurry black shadow in the mirror, not his reflection.
He immediately stuffed the mirror into the box, then put the "Constitution" on his chest into the box, and locked the box.
Yin Xuejiang went to check Luo Rui's condition. His face was pale, and he seemed to have stopped breathing.
At this time, Yin Xuejiang felt as if he was shedding tears and snot. When he reached out to wipe them, he realized that he couldn't wipe them through the helmet.
In fact, it was not snot and tears, but blood flowing from his nose and the corners of his eyes.
He was too close to the "lunar monster" just now, and his body and spirit had suffered irreparable damage.
Yin Xuejiang quickly went back to drive the lunar rover over, and then, with blood constantly flowing from his nostrils, the corners of his eyes, ear canals, and corners of his mouth, he put Luo Rui and the small box on the lunar rover.
When driving the lunar rover back, Yin Xuejiang felt that his spirit was a little trance, but the last trace of sanity made him operate the lunar rover to continue driving towards "Lanyue".
Suddenly, Yin Xuejiang saw a figure in front of him. Yes, there was a person there! A person who was not wearing a spacesuit, but wearing a suit of Earth clothes!
That was a young man with short hair, unremarkable facial features, and a fairly gentle appearance.
The only impressive thing was that he looked both young and experienced, which seemed a bit contradictory.
Yin Xuejiang, who was already a little trance, seemed to come back to his senses after three or four seconds: How could there be someone dressed like this here?
This is the moon! This is space! Even if the temperature here is not considered, this is also a place without oxygen and humidity. Exposure will kill you instantly and turn you into a dried corpse.
The young man slightly raised his hand, and in a trance, Yin Xuejiang's vision seemed to become a little illusory.
At this moment, their fate was "fooled", and all the mental and physical harm they suffered was "transferred" to the surrounding rocks.
When the illusion disappeared, he seemed to suddenly come back to his senses, and the physical and mental discomfort disappeared just like that.
Yin Xuejiang hurried to look for it. Where was there any young man around?
At this time, he suddenly remembered that the young man just now was Zhou Mingrui! As the commander, he had met this "civilian".
Just as Yin Xuejiang was wondering if he had just had a hallucination, Luo Rui's voice came from the communicator: "Commander, we succeeded."
Yin Xuejiang turned his head and saw through the helmet's mask that Luo Rui had woken up. His face was ruddy, and his voice was full of energy. He seemed to be fine.
"Yes, we succeeded." Yin Xuejiang still felt a little unbelievable. He had just had the determination to die and planned to get off the lunar rover after being close enough to "Lanyue" and let Ma Shen retrieve the suitcase with the mirror and the "Constitution".
At this time, he took a deep breath and said to Ma Shen through the communication system: "Start preparing to return to lunar orbit!"
There is a launcher on the "Mengzhou", which will push the box containing the monster away from the moon and eventually leave the solar system, drifting in the quiet, dark universe until forever.
More than an hour later, Zhou Mingrui, standing on the surface of the moon watching the "Mengzhou" spacecraft lift off, whispered: "Not having extraordinary power is not necessarily a bad thing."
After speaking, he disappeared from the surface of the moon, from this universe.
Four days later, the "Mengzhou" successfully returned to Earth, and China's lunar landing mission was a complete success. None of the three astronauts who carried out Order No. 0 showed signs of mental breakdown.
Later, these three astronauts witnessed the construction of the lunar base, witnessed the breakthrough in technologies such as using lunar soil to produce pure water, and also witnessed the beginning of lunar immigration.
The era of developing the solar system has begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 765 Extra 3: The Princess and Prince of the Atlantis Empire
chapters.content:

Many years after the "Creator" left Earth, in the Atlantis Empire, Anunnaki Special Zone.
Inside the city's teleportation array, a pair of handsome men and women emerged.
One was wearing an Atlantean-style long dress, and the other was wearing a similar-style long robe. Both appeared to be around twenty years old, with delicate and beautiful faces.
The woman was named Evangeline, inheriting her mother's golden hair and jewel-like eyes.
The man was named Richard, inheriting his mother's brown hair and his father's beautiful black eyes.
Stepping out of the teleportation array, he said, "My mother said this is a very nice city."
Evangeline nodded slowly, glancing at the two small suns in the sky: "The temperature is just right, neither cold nor hot."
The Anunnaki Special Zone is not on Earth but on a planet outside the Milky Way, in a stable binary star system.
The two stars are of different sizes, with the smaller star orbiting the larger one. Anunnaki Star is a planet orbiting the smaller star. The two suns in the sky are the smaller star and the larger star.
Because the larger star is farther away, it looks about the same size as the smaller star.
Although it's very, very far from the solar system, it's connected by a convenient teleportation array. Even ordinary people can travel from the solar system to here in just a few minutes.
And because it's warm like spring all year round, many people have settled here, forming a sizable city.
Evangeline and Richard, siblings who came out to travel, first sat down at a roadside drink shop, each ordering a drink, listening to people chatting, and sometimes joining in.
This was the way their father, the Emperor, taught them to obtain information about a city before their departure: listen more, look more, ask more.
Currently, more than thirty planets belong to the territory of the Atlantis Kingdom, which is already a vast interstellar empire.
And Evangeline and Richard, at the suggestion of their parents, began to travel. This is their first stop, and their goal is to travel to every planet in the empire.
Soon they heard about some very nice scenery on this planet, and the "Global Railway Line" here is famous throughout Atlantis.
But this planet seemed to be just an ordinary tourist city, with nothing particularly special.
The two finished their drinks and strolled casually down the street.
Evangeline, looking at the Atlantean-style buildings around, said, "Why did the two mothers want us to choose this as our first stop?"
"I'm also considering this question," Richard scratched his head. "If only my mother suggested it, there must be unique scenery here.
"But it's unusual that Mother Audrey, who doesn't often visit the cosmos, also made this suggestion."
Normally, Richard would call Fors "Empress," and the other Empress "Mother Audrey." Evangeline also called Fors "Mother Fors."
However, if they were outside and not attending official events, they would only call them "Mother."
Evangeline was also very aware that her mothers must have hinted at something, so she tried hard to find something different on the street.
But it was similar to Angers. There was bound to be an "Elven-style" restaurant on the street, as well as an Atlantean-style clothing store run by Loen people, an appliance store opened by Feysac people, a bar opened by Feynapotter people, and hotels and romantic restaurants opened by Intis people. There was also bound to be a snack street in the city.
If it weren't for the two suns in the sky, they wouldn't have felt like they had left Earth at all.
After searching half the street, Evangeline said impatiently, "Forget it, let's stop searching. Let's go see what's fun here first."
Richard smiled and said, "I agree."
So, both of them looked at the arcade not far away.
There was an arcade in the palace that belonged to them. Sometimes, their father, the Emperor, would even play a game with them.
Originally, they thought arcades were quite boring, until one day, they saw the lively scene in an arcade on the street in Angers and realized what arcades were really like.
But in Angel City, everyone knew them, and they were always accompanied by butlers or servants, so they didn't dare to enter the arcade.
But it was different here. Here, they were not a princess and a prince, but two ordinary tourists.
However, after entering the arcade, they quickly came out because Richard accidentally crushed the pool table into two halves while playing pool with a teenager.
Only then did they realize that the toys in the arcade in the palace had been reinforced.
So, after Evangeline paid the compensation, she quickly took her brother away amidst the surprised gazes of the people.
The two smiled helplessly and decided to just play something else. After trying some local delicacies, they prepared to embark on a global tour.
At first, they planned to take the global train, but then they thought it would be boring to stay in the carriage for so long, so they bought tents and other equipment, planning to hike around the world along the railway.
The siblings were born angels, so they didn't have to worry about food and drink, and beasts couldn't pose a threat to them. Anyway, they had plenty of time now and could travel around the world at a leisurely pace.
Even if they didn't want to walk halfway, they could use Beyonder abilities to return to this city.
The siblings set off excitedly. Although they tried to slow down, they still walked more than fifty kilometers in an hour!
Here, they could already see some indigenous villages. When they were studying history, they learned about the "Interstellar Colonization Act" promulgated by their father, the Emperor.
The act clearly stipulated that if there were intelligent life forms on the planet to be colonized, all the colonized land should be traded with the local natives reasonably and compliantly.
Unless the other party actively attacked, it was not allowed to kill the natives at will. They all had basic human rights and enjoyed the basic right to life.
At the same time, there were also regulations on the colonization process. First, an exploration team composed of Beyonders would determine whether the place had colonial value and was suitable for human habitation. If it only had colonial value but was not suitable for human survival, they would have to pray to the "Creator" to transform the place into an environment suitable for both humans and local natives.
If it were other gods, it might still be necessary to make certain trade-offs to accomplish this, but the "Creator" had no such worries at all.
Even if the air on a certain planet was poisonous or even had no atmosphere, people could still survive on this planet as they did on Earth.
After solving the environmental problem, the vanguard would also communicate with the natives and explain the principles of Atlantean colonization to them.
Only then would officials who "understood" the language of the planet move in, trade land with the natives, and build colonial cities.
Finally, the planet would be systematically incorporated into the rule of Atlantis. After long-term observation, the officials would form a report clarifying the main role of the planet.
For example, several planets had discovered oil or oil-like minerals. Currently, the Atlantis Academy of Sciences was developing high-power aerospace engines, and the manned aircraft project would soon be realized.
Next was the question of how to develop it. Generally, the local natives did not have the corresponding development technology. In such cases, they would still trade with them, help them with infrastructure construction, and then acquire local resources.
This would not only allow them to obtain resources but also dump excess domestic capacity.
Some civilizations had quite high levels of technology, and some were even developing outer space.
For such civilizations, those who dealt with them were basically Beyonders, who would sell them teleportation arrays, Beyonder potions, Beyonder treatments, etc., and obtain advanced technologies from them to effectively supplement and reference Atlantean technology.
Of course, because of different customs and different beliefs, some conflicts would inevitably occur.
At this time, it was the turn of the angels and Sequence 3s of Atlantis to appear. They would show the natives their magical abilities, and basically the natives would regard them as new gods.
This not only solved the problem but also allowed high-sequence Beyonders to obtain a certain number of anchors.
Anunnaki was similar to other planets. The natives here got along fairly well with the Atlanteans, so there was no need to worry about being attacked by the natives.
The siblings walked as they pleased, stopping to admire the nice scenery around them, and sometimes leaving the railway line to visit the mountains and lakes.
And so, they traveled, stopping and playing for four days. Both siblings were quite happy, as this kind of travel was unrestrained, allowing them to experience the taste of freedom.
On the morning of the fifth day of their journey, they set off as usual, bathed in sunlight.
They had only walked for a short while when they encountered a large train station!
The "Global Railway Line" of this planet also had stations along the way. The main reason for setting up these stations was to conduct some trade with the local natives.
Before Atlantis developed this place, the planet's technological level was not high, but this planet had many scarce minerals for Earthlings, such as gold, silver, and rare earth elements. It wasn't that they were everywhere, but almost every river had a large amount of gold dust, and silver mines could be found by simply digging a pit.
Therefore, Atlantis used industrial products to trade with the locals for gold and silver. For a time, Atlantis achieved "gold freedom."
The empire's currency was almost afraid to be tied to precious metals anymore and was preparing to be tied to the annual power generation.
However, the train stations that traded with the natives were generally small, but the station in front of them was very large.
Another strange reason was that there was no one in the station.
Why were there no staff members at such a large station built here?
Obviously, this station was the kind with confidential purposes. Most trains did not stop here at all, only a certain train with a confidential level would stop here.
Behind the station, there was also a flat road leading into the deep mountains.
The siblings became curious and walked along the road towards the deep mountains.
Both sides of the road were lined with trees characteristic of this planet, shielding both sides tightly. Walking on this road gave one the illusion that this world only had this one road.
Suddenly, a man in a white robe, barefoot, ran out of the forest. When that person saw the siblings, he first showed a surprised expression, then rushed towards them with some joy, making "Ah, ah, ee, ee" sounds.
Immediately afterward, several people in Atlantis uniforms chased up from behind and pressed the white-robed man to the ground, arresting him.
The siblings did not take action because they did not know what was going on.
The man pressed on the ground still only made "Ah, ah, ee, ee" sounds, sounding quite happy, until he was kicked hard, and then he began to whine.
The leader of the uniformed men saw that the man in the white robe was arrested before asking Evangeline and Richard, "Who are you?"
Evangeline smiled and said, "We are tourists."
The leader carefully examined the two before saying, "Don't go any further."
After speaking, they left with the white-robed man.
After they had gone far away, the siblings looked at each other, and both saw excitement in each other's eyes.
Evangeline asked, "Did you notice? Their badges are the badges of the Institute of Biological Research!"
The younger brother, Richard, nodded repeatedly: "I also noticed that there is a Beyonder among them!"
As far as they knew, as long as a research unit was equipped with Beyonder, it was basically carrying out a national-level key research project.
Without further discussion, the siblings hid their backpacks in the forest, and then used their Beyonder abilities to avoid the main road and came to a nearby mountain to look around.
On the other side of the mountain, they indeed saw a not-small complex of buildings.
In the forest, a large factory-like building was surrounded by a high wall. Inside were seven or eight buildings, large and small, as well as a tall water tower.
The siblings glanced at the tall buildings, and after confirming with their spirituality that there were no Angel-level Beyonder here, they once again used their Beyonder abilities to appear on the top floor of the building.
Next, Richard, the "Duke of Entropy," would use his abilities to continuously "distort" the sight of the people around him, causing the people here to ignore them.
So the two swaggered into the largest building. Before entering, they noticed that the building simply had the words "Sixth Research Institute" written on it, without a specific name.
This was also a bit abnormal, because the names of Atlantis research institutes generally included place names or the names of research projects, but this research institute did not have such information.
The siblings became even more curious, and they came to the building, looking everywhere for clues as to what was being researched here.
They did not intend to find a researcher to "interrogate," feeling that they could definitely find the truth on their own.
First, they found large rooms on the first floor, and those rooms were filled with men and women in white robes. They were clearly adults, but they were playing on slides and swings in the rooms. It was obvious that they were having a great time, often making childlike laughter.
It's just that they didn't seem to be able to speak, only saying "Ah, ah, ee, ee" while gesturing.
The two came to the second floor, which was for slightly younger men and women, also wearing white robes.
All the way up, they saw teenagers, children, and infants.
Finally, on the top floor, they saw embryos being cultivated in glass bottles with various tubes inserted.
The siblings looked at each other, still not understanding what kind of experiment was being conducted here.
But it was certain that human experiments were being carried out.
As far as they knew, human experiments were strictly prohibited.
At this time, they saw researchers taking a man in a white robe away from the first floor and sending him to a two-story building with almost no windows, and the walls were even reinforced with metal.
The siblings immediately followed in. They saw the researchers tying up the white-robed man with iron chains, and then a Beyonder took out a sealed artifact with very serious negative effects.
Under the effect of the negative effects, the white-robed man became emotionally unstable and began to yell hysterically, not far from madness.
At this time, the Beyonder put away the sealed artifact and poured a small bottle of medicine into the white-robed man. The surrounding researchers were carefully recording the white-robed man's reaction.
One or two minutes later, the white-robed man's emotions obviously improved. After letting him rest for a while, the second round of experiments began.
The white-robed man was still affected by the sealed artifact, but this time the effect lasted longer. The white-robed man's eyes were bloodshot, his teeth and nails grew rapidly, and small snakes seemed to be swimming quickly under his skin. There were obvious signs of turning into a monster.
Only then did they put away the sealed artifact and pour another bottle of red potion into the white-robed man.
This time, after a full ten minutes, the white-robed man miraculously recovered. Although he still looked painful, the signs of turning into a monster disappeared.
The researchers applauded together, celebrating the results of this experiment.
The white-robed man was taken to a separate room, obviously to continue to observe and continue to experiment.
The siblings looked at the white-robed man who was tortured to the point of almost losing consciousness. The two looked at each other. Their tacit understanding from childhood did not require discussion. Richard "distorted" the thinking of the guards who escorted the white-robed man away, causing them to send the white-robed man outside the building.
Evangeline solemnly said: "Rescuing is prohibited here."
"Information exchange with the outside world is prohibited here."
At the same time, Richard had "distorted" all the men and women in white robes in the previous building to the yard and prepared to send them away.
Wahhh Wahhh Wahhh—
At this time, a muffled alarm sounded suddenly in the research institute. This sound was like a magic spell that slowed down everyone's movements, including the siblings Evangeline and Richard.
At this time, they also understood that the Beyonder layout here was more advanced than they thought.
In the next second, not far from them, a hazy door opened, and the Sanguine Duke Olmer came out of the door. He was about to attack the intruders, but suddenly recognized them: "Your Highnesses, why are you here?"
Evangeline's speech rate also slowed down: "Uncle Olmer, we are touring this planet."
They often saw Olmer when they went to grandma's house to play, so they were more familiar with him.
Olmer looked at the surrounding situation and probably understood what was going on: "Nonsense!"
While speaking, he took out a switch made of "Order Crystal", and turned off the alarm first, otherwise angels would keep coming to support.
Under Olmer's command, after driving those white-robed men and women back, he invited the two "bear children" to his office.
Evangeline and Richard also knew that even angels had come forward, so the research here must be very important. Therefore, they obediently followed behind, without speaking or asking questions.
It wasn't until they sat down in the reception area of Olmer's office, and the secretary had served tea and left, that Evangeline suppressed the surrounding sounds, preventing them from reaching outside the office: "Uncle Olmer, is the Empire secretly conducting human experiments here?"
Olmer glanced at the siblings and said, "Yes!"
The siblings were both a little surprised. Evangeline said, "But, but..."
Olmer raised his hand: "Before explaining the research here, let me tell you something.
"Although you were born as angels, you must also know that each advancement for Beyonders is very dangerous, right?"
The siblings nodded, something they had heard since they were young.
Olmer continued, "In the past few decades, we have compiled statistics. Knowing the 'Acting Method' as a basis, the risks of advancing to Sequence 9, Sequence 8, and Sequence 7 are not significant.
"The success rate is about 98%. Of course, this statistic must exclude those Beyonders who have been injured or mentally corrupted and cannot advance normally.
"The probability of successfully advancing from Sequence 7 to Sequence 6 is 90%, and the success probability of advancing from Sequence 6 to Sequence 5 is 78%.
"This is the probability under the circumstances of having organizational support, knowing the 'Acting Method', and being able to consult advancement experiences and 'acting' experiences.
"And it's just the probability of successful advancement. The deterioration of the state after advancement, or the inability to continue advancement for other reasons, are not included.
"It is said that the probability of wild Beyonders advancing from Sequence 7 to Sequence 6 is less than 60%. Many Beyonders who have not digested the potion have completed the advancement process, and their probability of losing control is also very high."
The siblings roughly understood that this place must be a place to study the madness and distortion of Beyonders.
Olmer continued, "Even below the level of a demigod, Beyonders behave very uncontrollably, so His Majesty the Emperor specially ordered the establishment of this research institute.
"And using the cloning technology traded from Cevas Planet..."
Richard suddenly asked upon hearing this, "Cloning technology?"
This was a word he had never heard before.
"Yes." Olmer explained, "This is the name given to the technology by His Majesty the Emperor, meaning it can reproduce asexually and create life artificially."
He continued the previous topic: "After our Sanguine modified this technology, it has undergone fundamental changes compared to the original technology.
"First of all, if we need it, an embryo can grow into an adult in three seconds.
"But because the demand for test subjects is not that great, we basically rely on instruments for cultivation. Even so, it only takes three months from an embryo to an adult.
"Another change is that we prayed for the help of the 'Creator' and 'changed' the process of life's birth. The test subjects you see only have a virtual consciousness in their bodies, not a consciousness in the sense of life.
"It is said that this virtual consciousness was jointly developed by His Majesty the Emperor and Emperor Roselle. They also gave it a strange name, called 'Calculation System'.
"Because these consciousnesses are not formed naturally, they only give normal physiological reactions and basically do not think about self and worldview. Moreover, after the main body dies, the 'Calculation System' will disappear by itself without producing any spiritual bodies.
"So we all believe that these test subjects are not life in the general sense."
The siblings both understood why the white-robed man they met on the road was surprised and then delighted when he saw them, and why he was still happy after being caught, because in his opinion, it was just a game.
At the same time, they also understood Olmer's meaning. These test subjects were not life in the general sense, so these experiments did not violate the laws of the Empire.
Immediately afterward, Evangeline asked, "What exactly are you researching here?"
"There are currently two major research projects." Olmer told the truth: "One project is to use test subjects to find methods to suppress loss of control with drugs, or even cure loss of control.
"According to our research, a normal human body has a spiritual circulation system that tends to be balanced in a normal state and can operate on its own. Ordinary people also have this.
"The Beyonder characteristics contained in the potions taken by Beyonders will break this balance and cause temporary instability.
"If the advanced person uses meditation and other methods to return to a normal state, this spiritual circulation will also recover.
"But if this spiritual circulation is unstable for a long time, signs of loss of control will appear. This is also the internal theory of loss of control that we have researched.
"So, based on this, we have developed many drugs that can restore the spirituality to normal within a certain period, which can effectively slow down the time and degree of loss of control.
"In conjunction with meditation and other methods, even if there are signs of loss of control, it can be restored to a stable state within a certain period.
"This is now an essential drug for official Beyonders of the Atlantis Empire, but it can only delay the signs of loss of control. In the end, the problem of poor condition must be completely solved by digesting the potion.
"In addition, due to injuries or mental corruption, this drug is only suitable for first aid.
"We are now researching drugs that can effectively treat the loss of control process after it has already begun.
"Currently, we have a general idea. In addition to restoring the normal circulation of spirituality, we also need to treat the damage to the spirit and body in order to achieve the purpose of terminating or delaying loss of control."
Richard asked incredulously, "Are you saying that we are about to overcome loss of control?"
"No, it just means that we have certain means and are trying to treat loss of control as a disease." Olmer sighed and said, "In addition, these drugs have miraculous effects on low-sequence Beyonders, and the effects are also good for Sequence 7 and Sequence 6 Beyonders.
"For Sequence 5 patients, the effect is very limited, and Sequence 4 and above will not have any effect. Fortunately, at this level, you can find angels to help in a short time.
"So we have another research direction."
Olmer's expression gradually became serious: "The second research direction is: to find a method for basically controlling Beyonder characteristics."
The siblings realized that this was a process similar to searching for extraordinary pathways and exploring potion formulas in the First and Second Epochs.
Evangeline quickly asked, "Are there any results yet?"
"The current results are very limited." Olmer said helplessly, "Our main idea now is to make the Beyonder's spirit stronger through drugs and training in order to deal with extraordinary power.
"You should have also heard about this. Since last year, His Majesty the Emperor has required official Beyonders to strengthen their mental training and hold exchange meetings from time to time to exchange 'acting' experiences.
"We have not found a very good way to directly deal with the distortion and madness of Beyonder characteristics, and we don't even have a feasible idea."
The siblings fell into silence. Only now did they truly realize the distorted side of the extraordinary.
Evangeline said, "I understand why the two mothers recommended that we take this place as the first stop of our travels. They hope we can understand that the Empire is built on the foundation of the extraordinary, and the extraordinary has such great uncontrollability."
Richard nodded, indicating that he had similar thoughts.
Then he asked, "Can we find a way to completely control the extraordinary?"
"Originally, I also felt that the hope was slim." Olmer smiled and said, "But His Majesty the Emperor said that we have time. If we can't find a way in a hundred years, then we will take a thousand years. If that doesn't work, we will take ten thousand years. We will always find a practical idea.
"Just having a feasible idea can also make you a person who will be forever remembered by the extraordinary world."
Richard and Evangeline looked at each other: The story of the old man moving mountains.
Evangeline looked at the teacup in front of her: "I hope that day will come sooner."

It was the seventh year of the Guanghe era.
Within the territory of You Province, in a desolate wilderness, two large armies stood in opposition.
One side was numerous and imposing, wearing yellow turbans, but their clothes were ragged, and their weapons were mostly farm tools. This was a main force of the Yellow Turban Army.
The other side, although smaller in number, had warhorses, armor, and well-equipped weapons such as swords, spears, and powerful crossbows. This was the elite force led by Liu Yan, the governor of You Province, who had come to intercept them.
Just as Liu Yan was discussing tactics with his advisors, preparing to launch an offensive, he saw strongmen carrying a high platform from the rear of the Yellow Turban Army. On the platform stood a middle-aged man wearing black robes, holding an iron sword, and also wearing a yellow turban on his head.
He had a cold expression, and his outer robe was covered with talismans, exuding an aura of inhumanity.
As the middle-aged man was carried to the front lines, Liu Yan's subordinates recognized him as the "General of Heaven," Zhang Jiao.
Just as Liu Yan was about to issue orders to attack, the precious horse beneath him suddenly showed signs of retreating.
The governor was slightly stunned. This warhorse had followed him in battles across the north and south, never showing any signs of fear. Why was it behaving so strangely today?
In an instant, the "General of Heaven" brandished his iron sword, paced the Seven Stars Step on the high platform, shaking his head and chanting incantations.
Suddenly, the sky darkened, and a strong wind "whooshed" up.
Liu Yan and his officers all showed solemn expressions.
At this moment, they heard Zhang Jiao shout, "The Azure Sky is dead, the Yellow Sky shall rise! The year is Jiazi, great fortune to the world! Thunder God, aid me!"
Crack!
Thunder rumbled in the sky, a gale raged, and the officers were all terrified and fled in panic.
Amidst the chaos, Liu Yan looked back and saw Zhang Jiao on the high platform with a look of pain on his face, as tentacles with some white inscriptions protruded from under his clothes.
Liu Yan was slightly stunned, his eyes filled with the white inscriptions on the tentacles.
...
The sixth year of the Zhongping era.
Cao Cao failed in his assassination attempt on Dong Zhuo with a dagger, so he fled Luoyang, preparing to return to his hometown of Qiao County to recruit soldiers and join the heroes of the world in Crusade Dong Zhuo.
When passing through Zhongmu County, the county magistrate Chen Gong, moved by his righteousness, was willing to abandon his official position and follow him.
So, the two rode on fast horses, fleeing together to Cao Cao's hometown.
After traveling for three days, they reached the boundary of Chenggao, and the sky gradually darkened.
Chen Gong pointed his whip at the lights in the forest: "It seems there is a village ahead. How about we go there to rest?"
Cao Cao looked at the lights with a solemn expression: "Gongtai (Chen Gong's courtesy name) is not aware, but I once fought the Yellow Turban bandits here. The bandits, unable to withstand us, burned the village and retreated, blocking our pursuit.
"At that time, this place was already a wasteland. How could there be a new village?"
Chen Gong said, "It must be the villagers who fled have returned and rebuilt the village."
Cao Cao sighed and said, "To be honest, this place is the private property of Lü Boshe, a sworn brother of my father. When the bandits came, they slaughtered his entire family, and I had people bury them..."
He looked at the lights ahead and said, "Very well, let's go and investigate. Perhaps it is the return of Lü Gong's family."
The two arrived in front of the village. Just as they were about to dismount, the gate opened, and a person came out to greet them. Cao Cao was shocked: "Lü..."
Immediately, Cao Cao turned his shock into a smile: "Uncle is well."
As he spoke, he dismounted and bowed.
It turned out that this person was Lü Boshe!
He asked with a smile, "Why are you here, nephew?"
Cao Cao was very affectionate. After bowing, he grabbed Lü Boshe's hand, only to feel that Lü Gong's hands were icy cold, unlike those of a living person.
Mengde understood in his heart: "I came here with a friend for leisure, and would like to stay at Uncle's place for the night."
Lü Boshe opened the gate: "Please come in."
Chen Gong stood to the side, not saying a word.
The two followed Lü Boshe to a thatched cottage and sat down. Lü Boshe rode a donkey out to buy wine, leaving only Cao Cao and Chen Gong in the cottage.
Chen Gong asked in a low voice, "Is this a member of Lü Boshe's family?"
"No," Cao Cao also said softly, "This person is Lü Boshe."
Chen Gong was surprised: "This..."
Cao Cao then said, "Listen to my arrangements."
Suddenly, they heard the sound of a knife being sharpened from behind the hall. The two quietly entered the back of the thatched cottage and heard someone say, "Tie them up and kill them!"
Cao Cao sneered: "Strike first!"
So, he and Chen Gong drew their swords and entered, killing everyone regardless of gender, killing eight people in a row.
Searching the kitchen, they saw a pig tied under the stove. It turned out that Lü Boshe's family was going to kill the pig to entertain them.
Chen Gong was filled with remorse: "Alas, Mengde was too suspicious and killed good people by mistake!"
Cao Cao said, "You do not know the methods of the Yellow Turban Army, and were deceived by this scene. If we eat this pork, we will all lose our lives here and be trapped in this village forever!"
He took burning firewood from the stove and set the thatched cottage on fire: "This place is not suitable for a long stay. Let's go!"
Before they had traveled two miles, they saw Lü Boshe riding a donkey back with wine. Just as he was about to speak, Cao Cao rode forward and stabbed Lü Boshe under the donkey with his sword.
Chen Gong was shocked: "Just now, due to a misunderstanding, we killed eight members of Lü Boshe's family. Why do you want to kill Lü Boshe now?"
Cao Cao said, "I have fought Zhang Bao, the younger brother of Zhang Jiao, many times and know that he possesses demonic arts.
"Later, when I joined forces with Yuan Shao and others, they all said that the Zhang Jiao brothers could summon wind and rain and command the Thunder God. Since then, many evil arts have spread among the people."
He sighed, "Gongtai, the human world is no longer the human world it once was."
Chen Gong showed disappointment: "Mengde, to deceive me, you have actually come up with such absurd theories."
Cao Cao was silent for a moment and then said, "Gongtai, let us spend the night in the mountains tonight and come back here tomorrow to investigate, and you will know the truth."
"Enough, enough," Chen Gong cupped his hands: "I abandoned my official position for the sake of righteousness, but I never thought you would be so unjust. Farewell."
"Gongtai..." Cao Cao wanted to persuade him to stay, but Chen Gong had already ridden off.
Cao Cao silently drew his sword and stabbed Chen Gong under his horse.
Chen Gong fell to the ground, looking puzzled.
Cao Cao said coldly, "I would rather betray the people of the world than let the people of the world betray me!"
Chen Gong died and fell to the ground.
Cao Cao rode away.
A short time later, Lü Boshe, covered in blood, got up, dusted off his body, placed Chen Gong's corpse on the donkey, and carried it back to the manor.
The thatched cottage that had caught fire earlier had no flames, and Lü Boshe's family was also discussing how to kill the pig to entertain guests.
Later, Cao Cao heard that Chen Gong had appeared under Lü Bu's command. He immediately gathered a large army to wipe out Lü Bu and then killed Chen Gong at the White Gate Tower.
...
The third year of the Jian'an era.
Cao Cao killed Lü Bu at the White Gate Tower, and thus recovered Xu Province. The three brothers Liu Bei, who had assisted in the battle, followed Cao Cao's army back to court.
In Xu Chang, Liu Bei wanted to assist Emperor Xian in taking power, but he found that the mastermind of this matter, Dong Yun, was not very capable and was by no means a match for Cao Cao.
Just as Yuan Shu declared himself emperor and wanted to head north, passing through Xu Province, to join forces with Yuan Shao.
Therefore, Liu Bei, who was familiar with Xu Province, requested to lead troops to intercept him. Cao Cao sent 50,000 troops, with Liu Bei as the general, and also sent his confidants Zhu Ling and Lu Zhao as assistants.
Liu Bei arrived in Xu Province and defeated Yuan Shu, but did not return to court.
Zhu Ling and Lu Zhao, how could they be a match for the three Liu Bei brothers? They were sent back to Xu Chang by Liu Bei with a few words.
At this point, Liu Bei already showed signs of independence.
Cao Cao was furious when he heard about this and personally led a large army to attack Xu Province.
Liu Bei and Zhang Fei led troops to meet the enemy, but they were ambushed when they tried to attack Cao Cao's camp by surprise, and they were also attacked by Xiahou Dun, defeated and fled, and separated from Zhang Fei.
Liu Bei led the remnants of his army to Xiaopei first, but at this time, Xiaopei had fallen into the hands of Cao Cao's army.
Just as he was about to go to Xiapi, a team of Cao Cao's soldiers blocked his way.
At this time, Liu Bei only had twenty or thirty personal soldiers left, so he had to fight hard.
Although he successfully broke through, only Liu Bei was left, while Cao Cao's army was all over the mountains and plains.
Generals such as Xiahou Dun were overjoyed: Today, we will definitely capture Liu Bei alive!
At that moment, a violent wind suddenly arose, and a luminous portal appeared before Liu Bei. After a short while, the wind subsided, and both Liu Bei and the luminous portal vanished without a trace.
The Cao army was terrified.
Afterward, Liu Bei suffered multiple defeats, yet repeatedly managed to escape from desperate situations.
… …
In the twenty-fourth year of Jian'an.
Taking advantage of Cao Cao's defeat in Hanzhong, Guan Yu led a large army to attack Xiangyang and Fancheng.
However, Sun Quan did not wish to see Liu Bei continue to expand his war gains and realized that this might be the last opportunity to reclaim Nan Commandery.
Therefore, Lu Xun launched a sneak attack on Nan Commandery, and Guan Yu's forces lost their foundation, collapsing immediately.
In December, Guan Yu was defeated and fled to Maicheng, where he and his son Guan Ping were captured.
Sun Quan personally came to persuade him to surrender, but Guan Yu said, "Blue-eyed brat, you have betrayed your trust and ruined your reputation, yet you have only gained a few commanderies. Such a petty man! How could I surrender to you?"
Sun Quan, instead of being angry, smiled and said, "General, are you not aware that since Dong Zhuo entered the capital, trustworthiness has long vanished from the world?"
"Liu Bei is also a treacherous and faithless man. He possesses a method that allows him to travel a thousand miles a day. He could have rescued you long ago, yet you are still captured, and Liu Bei has not come to save you."
Guan Yu sneered, "There's no need for you to sow discord. I fell for a treacherous plot and am ready to die. Why say more?"
Liu Bei had mentioned this matter to him and Zhang Fei before. At the time, Liu Bei also said that each use of this method would have repercussions.
Although he did not know what the specific repercussions were, in recent years, Zhang Fei had repeatedly sent letters saying that their elder brother had long forgotten his ambition to 'restore the Han Dynasty,' and for this reason, he had many disagreements with the 'Military General' Zhuge Liang.
Guan Yu thought for a long time, believing that this must be the repercussion.
Sun Quan coldly snorted and suddenly said, "I also have a method that can turn you into a puppet, obeying my commands…"
Guan Yu narrowed his eyes, glaring at Sun Quan: "If you are not afraid of being assassinated by Guan in your sleep, you are welcome to try."
Sun Quan, intimidated by Guan Yu's might, took a slight step back.
At this moment, Guan Yu was somewhat surprised. Behind Sun Quan, there was vaguely a phantom. The phantom bore some resemblance to Sun Quan, but its eyes were sinister and its face was cold.
In an instant, Guan Yu recognized it: "Sun Ce! You are not dead!"
Sun Quan said grimly, "I cannot allow you to live."
He then ordered his men to bring him out for execution.
Fearing that Liu Bei and Cao Cao would join forces to seize Jing Province, Sun Quan sent an envoy with Guan Yu's head in a wooden box, delivering it to Cao Cao overnight.
The envoy arrived in Xuchang and presented the wooden box. Cao Cao opened the box and saw that Guan Yu's face was as it had always been. He then ordered his attendants and the envoy to withdraw.
Cao Cao, whose hair was already gray, lamented: "General Yun Chang, have you been well?"
Guan Yu's head opened its mouth and moved its eyes: "Prime Minister, have you also been well?"
Cao Cao raised his hand and gently massaged his head: "Since our parting at Huarong Road, eleven years have passed in the blink of an eye. I am already old and suffer from headaches every day."
He sighed, "If you have any last words, you may speak them."
"Sun Ce is not dead. His younger brother, Sun Quan, is merely his puppet!"
"I already knew this."
Guan Yu was slightly puzzled: "You already knew?"
Cao Cao stroked his white beard and said, "In the past, when Zhang Jiao started the rebellion, the world was in chaos, and many immortals appeared in the world, passing down many strange methods."
"The reason the imperial court was shocked by the Yellow Turban Rebellion was that no one could defeat the three Zhang brothers."
Guan Yu frowned slightly: "However, the three Zhang brothers were all executed in the first year of Zhongping."
Cao Cao nodded: "Only because at that time, there were already many heroes in the world who could defeat the three Zhang brothers."
"Yuan Shao of Hebei possessed the talent of eloquence, and many heroes of the world flocked to him, all praising him. This was a strange method."
"Dong Zhuo was cruel and inhumane, degenerate and unbearable, yet he had many followers, which was also one of the methods."
"In the past, all the heroes of the world had magical arts protecting them."
Cao Mengde narrated this secret slowly: "Now, there are not many heroes left in the world. In his early years, Sun Jian also had a strange encounter, receiving guidance from an immortal, allowing him to parasitize his consciousness into another person's body, making them his puppet."
"Your brother, Xuande, is the same. He has a method that allows him to travel a thousand miles a day, and no one can capture him."
After a long silence, Guan Yu asked, "What about the Prime Minister?"
Cao Cao replied, "My methods are unpredictable, capable of divination, changing appearances, causing illusions, and creating puppets. Zhuge Kongming also possesses this art."
He sighed again: "However, there is always a trade-off in the affairs of the world. Although we possess strange arts, we are all subject to repercussions."
"Liu Xuande no longer has the ambition to dominate the Central Plains, Sun Bofu is becoming increasingly sinister and cautious, and I am tormented by headaches every day. The three of us are all powerless to unify China."
Guan Yu asked, "Is there no way to break this?"
"Yes!" Cao Cao asked, "Have you heard the story of Zuo Ci?"
"I have heard a little," Guan Yu replied, "This man is a divine being. He can transform vegetation into weapons, create fire with a clap of his hands, and stay underwater for half a day."
"I also heard that he once met with the Prime Minister, presenting dragon liver, peonies, and perch."
Cao Cao laughed loudly: "I am Zuo Ci!"
As he spoke, Cao Cao's face and clothes changed, and the Prime Minister of the Great Han instantly transformed into a wandering Taoist.
Guan Yu understood: "Zuo Ci is your puppet. The previous presentation of dragon liver, peonies, and perch was all the Prime Minister playing tricks on the officials."
"That's right." Cao Cao returned to his appearance as Prime Minister: "Playing in the mortal world, this is the solution."
"I knew that I would be able to see Yun Chang again today, so I waited in Xuchang. After our farewell today, Cao Cao will 'die of illness' next year, but Zuo Ci will still be around."
Guan Yu worriedly said, "What about my elder brother…"
Cao Cao said, "He can no longer let go of his power."
Guan Yu was silent.
Seeing Guan Yu's expression gradually change, Cao Cao said, "General Yun Chang also possesses strange arts. You can try stroking your long beard."
Guan Yu was slightly stunned, looked down, and realized: "I only have my head."
After speaking, he closed his eyes and died.
Cao Cao lamented, "General Yun Chang, may you have a good journey."
"Someone, carve a body from dark sandalwood for Guan Yu and bury him outside the South Gate of Luoyang with the rites of a prince. All the officials in Xuchang, high and low, must attend his funeral, and I will also go to pay my respects."
The following year, Cao Cao indeed died of illness.
Later, Liu Bei sought revenge for Guan Yu, launching an army to attack Eastern Wu, but he was burned by Lu Xun at Yiling.
When the fire attack succeeded, Lu Xun said to his attendants, "This is King Wu's (Sun Quan's) art of 'stealing fire'."
… …
Regarding this magnificent period of the late Eastern Han Dynasty, a "Mysterious History" scholar left a record: Zhang Qian of the Western Han Dynasty opened up the Silk Road and later introduced the secret arts of the "Celestial Worthy" to the West, greatly shocking and frightening the followers of God.
Therefore, in the late Eastern Han Dynasty, they taught Western magic in China in the guise of immortals.
Among them, three have been verified by historical research: teaching Zhang Jiao the art of thunder, teaching Dong Zhuo the art of depravity and Charm, and teaching Yuan Shao the art of eloquence.
To suppress the flourishing of Western magic, the followers of the Celestial Worthy also taught three secret arts in the world. From the Yellow Turban Uprising to Cao Pi's claiming of the throne, those who had learned Western magic were all executed in the decades between.
After another twenty years, those with strange magical arts either retreated into seclusion or died.
These decades of magical battles are historically known as the "Third Small-Scale Revival of Mysterious Powers."
