chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 770 Extra 8: Extraordinary Sports Meeting
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Inside the broadcast booth overlooking the stadium, commentator Brooke announced: "Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the inaugural Beyonder Games! This is a competition that transcends time and space!
"I'm commentator Brooke, and beside me is today's special guest, 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' Edwina Edwards."
The 'Vice Admiral Iceberg,' with her oval face, calmly greeted: "Hello, everyone."
She was invited today as a special guest because of her extensive knowledge, capable of explaining various Beyonder abilities.
audience erupted in enthusiastic applause, including the crew of the 'Golden Dream,' who were the first to clap.
Other audiences included the official extraordinary formations of the Atlantis Empire, the orthodox Churches, secret organizations, and the 'Amon Formation,' among others.
Commentator Brooke exclaimed: "I can already feel everyone's enthusiasm and anticipation for the upcoming competition!
"The competition is about to begin! The first event is track and field, a 100-kilometer sprint!"
"Now, please welcome the contestants! We see that the first athlete to enter is 'The Seer,' Mr. Hermes!
The crowd responded with enthusiastic applause.
Brooke chuckled: "If this weren't an extraordinary competition, I'd think such an old gentleman was a referee.
"Oh, no, even the referee seems a bit old.
"Alright, the second contestant to enter is 'Profane Presbyter,' Stieff."
audience barely reacted, with only the Aurora Order audiences in the secret organization formation cheering loudly.
The commentator explained: "I imagine many people don't recognize this contestant. He is an angel of the 'True Creator Church,' who has been in the 'Forsaken Land of the Gods' since the early Fourth Epoch.
"Alright, the third contestant is here, it's the Pope of the Church of the Lord of Storms, Gaard II!"
The orthodox Churches formation applauded enthusiastically, with many Church of the Lord of Storms members even releasing lightning to cheer on the Pope.
Brooke continued to introduce the contestants: "Contestant number four is Viève, who rarely appears in public. Ms. Edwards, I'm not even sure about this contestant's background. Do you know her story?"
Edwina replied calmly: "She is recorded in the 'Holy Scripture' of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church as a 'Light Chaser.'"
Flattery already arose from audience: "As expected of the knowledgeable Captain!
The commentator smiled: "Thank you to the 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' for the explanation. Let's return to the arena. Contestant number five has already entered, oh my goodness, it's Amon!
"Hehe, this is Amon, who just failed to compete for the 'Lord of Mysteries.' Currently, he is only a 'Trojan Horse of Destiny.' Are the Amons in audience here to create a false impression?
"Oh, no, it seems my commentary has made Amon a little angry. He is doing something to me…"
The commentator's voice abruptly disappeared from the microphone. After two or three seconds, the 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' cleared her throat and said: "Mr. Amon, please return the commentator, or you will forfeit your chance to compete."
Brooke then reappeared: "Oh, my goodness, alright, I must admit that even if Amon is just a 'Trojan Horse of Destiny,' he is still a very strong contestant!
The commentator, slightly recovered, continued: "Let us continue. Contestant number six is Antigonus! After losing the 'Fool' Uniqueness and a 'Mystery Gatherer' characteristic, he has become quite normal.
"Oh, contestant number seven has also taken their place, it's Ms. Fors Wall! She is now a 'Traveler'!
audience in the Atlantis formation applauded wildly!
Brooke continued to commentate: "All the contestants are in position, and we see that the referee has also arrived.
"Now, let me briefly explain the rules. Each contestant can use their Beyonder abilities and attack each other. The first contestant to ring the bronze bell 100 kilometers away from the starting point will be the winner of this competition!
"It should be noted that the bell was provided by Emperor Hobert of Atlantis. It cannot be 'stolen,' damaged by any extraordinary power, or affected by any extraordinary power unless the contestant personally shakes the clapper in the middle, in which case it will make a sound.
"While the contestants are making their final preparations, let's invite the 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' to introduce the favorite contestants to win!
Edwina said: "There are many popular candidates to win this time. 'Light Chaser' Viève and the Pope of the Church of the Lord of Storms, also known as 'Calamity' Gaard II, one as fast as light and the other as fast as lightning, both have considerable advantages.
"Amon also has the ability to steal distance and instantly appear at the finish line, which cannot be ignored.
"Ms. Fors is even more needless to say. For an angel of this pathway, 100 kilometers is almost enough to 'teleport' to the finish line.
"I think these four contestants are all favorites to win."
She paused and then said: "Finally, let's talk about the other three contestants. Although 'The Seer' Hermes is an angel of the 'audience' pathway with bizarre abilities, he has no obvious advantage in speed.
"As for the other two contestants, 'Profane Presbyter' Stieff and 'Miracle Invoker' Antigonus, although they can both travel to their destination from the spirit world, they will definitely be a step slower than the other contestants.
"Of course, if 'Profane Presbyter' has a fast pathway among the spiritual creatures he pastures, then this contestant number two can also compete for first place.
"Finally, I want to clarify that the above is entirely based on the explanation of Beyonder abilities, and the specific results will depend on the contestants' performance on the spot."
Commentator Brooke said: "Let's thank the beautiful 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' for her wonderful explanation. We see that the contestants have made their final preparations and have arrived at their respective tracks. The competition is about to begin!
"Okay, the referee has signaled the contestants to take their positions.
"The referee raises the gun… Wait a minute, the referee clearly fired, but why didn't we hear the gunshot?
"Oh, my goodness, it's not that there was no gunshot, but the sound was stolen by Amon! He used this to interfere with the other contestants and gained a certain advantage.
"Hehe, we can only say that Amon is still Amon!
Brooke's speech became faster and faster: "However, the other contestants quickly reacted, but Amon has already taken the lead. He stole the distance first and appeared at the finish line.
"Haha, a magical scene has appeared. As soon as he appeared at the finish line, his body was covered by a illusory light gate. Oh, it turns out that Fors made a move. She sent Amon back to the starting point!
"At this time, Viève and Gaard II are evenly matched with their respective abilities, tied for first place, but we see that Fors did not compete for first place, but prioritized sending Amon back to the starting point. It seems that there are some personal grievances between them."
His speech was so fast that he didn't need to breathe, and he could say several sentences in a second, but audience could still hear clearly, obviously using some kind of Beyonder power.
Brooke continued like a machine gun: "Oh, I just realized now that Antigonus is still at the starting point!
"What is he doing? He seems to be making a wish? Is it too late to wish for first place now?
"Oh my goodness, a huge wave suddenly surged from the finish line of the arena. Who could have imagined that a tsunami would occur in a stadium with no sea around!"
"No, it was Gaard II who made a move. He easily passed through the tsunami, but the tsunami struck the other contestants.
"This tsunami is really strange! Vievienne was about to transform into a ray of light and rush into the sky to avoid the tsunami, but a huge vortex appeared in the middle of the tsunami! The vortex actually sucked her in.
"No, no, no, she wasn't sucked in. What was sucked in was a phantom of Vievienne. She transformed into a pure white ball of light and rose into the air like that.
"She's like a small sun, illuminating the entire arena. It's not just the strong light; we see that Gaard II, who was about to grab the rope below the bronze bell, suddenly stopped!
"Vievienne's strong light also has the effect of preventing people from having any thoughts!
"Ah, at this moment, Amon, who had returned to the starting point, stole Gaard II's position. Amon is now closest to the bronze bell!
"But Amon is trapped! He's trapped by his own shadow!
"We see that Stieff and Hermes from the second echelon have caught up!
"As 'Vice Admiral Iceberg' said earlier, although some abilities are faster, the contestants' on-the-spot performance is also crucial!
"The contestants in the first echelon have already engaged in fierce combat, and none of them have been able to grab the rope. At this time, the second echelon has already caught up!
"The competition has become more intense. The ball of light that Vievienne transformed into has landed. She has passed Amon and is about to grab the rope of the bronze bell.
"Wait, why is she walking elsewhere? Why is she going to shake the pillar supporting the bronze bell? According to the rules, shaking the bronze bell like that won't make it ring.
"Oh, I understand. She's been hypnotized by Mr. Hermes! She's treating the pillar as the rope of the bronze bell!
"Heavens, as Ms. Edwina said, the abilities of the 'audience' pathway are very strange…
"No, no, no, I take back what I just said, because an even stranger scene has occurred. Antigonus suddenly appeared next to the pillar supporting the bronze bell without any warning.
"Could it be that his wish just now was to appear instantly next to the bronze bell?
"We don't have time for specific speculation now. Two heads have appeared on each of 'Elder of Obscene language' Stieff's shoulders, indicating that he's going to use the ability of herding!
"The head on his left shoulder instantly became very charming. He used the ability of a witch, and Antigonus's legs turned into stone just like that, and he fell to the ground!
"We see that Antigonus is struggling to crawl towards the rope of the bronze bell, but in the end, he's still one step too slow.
"Stieff has surpassed Antigonus. He has picked up the rope. The first place is about to… wait a minute, he handed the rope to Hermes, who was right behind him?
"This, heavens, what kind of operation is this?
"Ah, I understand. Hermes hypnotized Stieff, he must have hypnotized this 'Elder of Obscene language'.
"When exactly did it happen? I know, it must have been when the two of them were in the second echelon at the same time. At that time, Hermes had already quietly invaded Stieff's spiritual world!
"Now the rope is about to be handed to Hermes. We see that three contestants have gathered next to the bronze bell, namely Stieff and Hermes, who are standing, and Antigonus, who is still crawling forward at a slightly further distance.
"To be honest, it's a bit disadvantageous for Antigonus to participate in such a competition! His abilities are more suitable for carrying out some operations in secret, rather than confronting opponents head-on!
"Just in that instant, the situation changed again. We see that a illusory door has appeared on Stieff's chest, and Fors has appeared next to the bronze bell just like that!
"Hermes was just a tiny bit away from taking the rope, but Fors snatched the rope one step ahead!
"She's waving the rope, about to ring the bronze bell…
"No, no, no, there's another change in the scene. Amon exchanged fates with Fors. At this time, half of Amon's body protruded from Stieff's chest, while Fors was trapped in the distance by her own shadow!
"Heavens, this exchange didn't end there. Fors trapped Amon and Stieff in a concealed space…
Clang—
The bronze bell was rung!
Bruce stood up excitedly: "The bronze bell has been rung. Unexpectedly, it was Antigonus who rang the bronze bell!
"Heavens, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to call this a miracle, because just now, he was still at a disadvantage, approaching the bronze bell by crawling.
"We see that at this moment, he has surpassed Hermes, firmly grasped the rope, and rang the bronze bell!
"And at this time, Fors is dealing with Amon, Hermes is dispelling Stieff's hypnosis, also hoping to use Stieff to deal with Amon, and Vievienne and Gaard II are also attacking each other.
"At such a moment, Antigonus suddenly made a move and won first place! Such a result is too unexpected!"
The commentator took a deep breath: "Ms. Edwina, from a professional point of view, what is your comment on this unexpected victory?"
"This may not be an unexpected victory." Edwina said: "I think when Antigonus made a wish, it was very likely that he was making himself more lucky.
"As you just said, Antigonus's abilities are not very good at confronting other contestants head-on. We see that the first time he made a move, it was when the other contestants were entangled together, when the front was relatively chaotic, that he appeared next to the bronze bell.
"This requires enough good luck, because a little earlier or a little later, it is easy to be affected by the attacks of other contestants.
"And the moment he grabbed the rope, he needed even more good luck. At that time, the other six contestants were attacking each other. They all thought that Antigonus, who was crawling forward with his legs petrified, would still need one or two seconds to approach the bronze bell.
"But Antigonus suddenly arrived under the bronze bell, thereby grabbing the rope.
"I think his previous crawling was just to paralyze his opponents."
The commentator exclaimed: "So you're saying he used his intelligence to win first place?"
"You could say that." Edwina said: "Of course, his strategy also has a fatal flaw. If he is seen through, then he will have no chance of winning first place.
"Amon, who has the corresponding authority over fate, is the most likely to notice Antigonus's strategy, but at the beginning, Amon rushed too hard, and because he didn't handle his interpersonal relationships well, he was targeted by several other contestants.
"So Amon was exhausted from coping and didn't notice this."
Brook then said: "I have one last question. How did Antigonus appear next to the bronze bell? I think many people thought that his wish was to appear next to the bronze bell."
Edwina smiled and said: "We can watch the replay for this. Please replay the part where he made a wish.
"Please look carefully. While he was making a wish, he also turned part of the ground he ran on into his marionette, so he reached the bronze bell by repeatedly exchanging positions with inanimate marionettes."
Brook exclaimed: "I hear the applause and cheers from audience! This wonderful competition has moved every audience member!
"The Beyonder Games are still continuing. Let's take a look at the situation in other arenas…"

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 771 Extra 9: Atlantis Military Parade
chapters.content:
join the Church of MissRaven and become a Sequence 9: Reader p atreon.com/KeyofStars for more chapters
Angel City, the capital of Atlantis, in Construction Square.
Today marks the 100th anniversary of the empire's founding. This vast empire will hold a grand military parade in the square to celebrate this special day.
Before eight o'clock in the morning, about eighty thousand people had already gathered here in an orderly fashion. Guests from various countries in the Northern Continent and representatives from various colonial planets arrived at the viewing platform one after another.
At exactly eight o'clock, the Emperor of Atlantis, Hobert, along with the two Empresses, Princes, and Princesses, dressed in full regalia, ascended the viewing platform surrounded by a group of high-ranking officials.
The crowd immediately erupted, cheering "Long live the Emperor!" to pay their respects to their Emperor.
Hobert enthusiastically responded to the cheers of the people, shouting, "Long live the motherland! Long live the people!"
The scene became even more boiling.
The originally planned concise group meeting unexpectedly lasted for ten minutes before the celebration ceremony could continue.
Amidst the stirring music, the voice of the commentator echoed from the high-quality large speakers.
The commentator, Albert, also a well-known host in Atlantis, said in a solemn voice: "Today is your birthday, my motherland, this is an extraordinary day."
Another commentator, Lancy, also a well-known host: "A hundred years of trials and hardships have forged Atlantis's unique cultural and economic system. The national flag in the square witnesses a century of glorious history."
Albert: "At this solemn moment, please play the national anthem and raise the national flag!"
The orchestra began to play, and the guard of honor escorted the national flag and raised it.
There were exactly 100 gun salutes, no more, no less.
Immediately afterward, the review ceremony officially began. Against the background music of the military parade, the voice of the host rang out again. Albert: "The Atlantis troops and officers to be reviewed have completed their formation and are preparing to accept the review of the motherland and the people."
Lancy: "This modern army, just over a hundred years ago, was merely a guard force of fewer than a hundred men armed with rifles on the west bank of Full Moon Lake! Now, it possesses the most cutting-edge fighters and tanks, making it the most powerful army in the world."
Albert: "After the empire began to develop interstellar colonies, they received new missions and challenges. Decades of combat and defense tasks have delivered a satisfactory answer sheet for us."
Lancy: "His Majesty the Great Emperor once said, 'A nation, however large, will perish if it loves war.' We have always adhered to the principle of not initiating large-scale wars proactively, only resorting to the option of war when necessary to protect our interests, and have built a unique deterrent system."
Albert: "This is precisely the classic strategic concept of 'subduing the enemy without fighting' that His Majesty the Emperor spoke of."
Lancy: "In the square, 80,000 people dressed in festive attire have also completed their assembly. After the military parade, they will form squares and pass by the viewing platform."
Albert: "A hundred years ago, our capital was just a military station, and the entire Southern Continent was a symbol of desolation and barbarism."
Lancy: "For 100 years, through our unremitting efforts, the Southern Continent has been built into a pearl of human civilization, the political, cultural, and technological center of the world, and even the entire galaxy!"
Albert: "Also participating in this military parade are delegations from various countries in the Northern Continent, as well as delegations from interstellar counties and prefectures. They represent other countries and the interstellar people of the entire Atlantis Empire, sending their sincere blessings to the motherland!"
Lancy: "Under the stirring melody, the demigod squad is marching towards us first!"
Albert: "Thanks to the unremitting efforts of the Sixth Research Institute over the past few decades, the Beyonder has become more reliable than it was a hundred years ago."
Lancy: "The Beyonder vaccine has given the national people a certain immunity to the Beyonder, and finally, information about the Beyonder can be made public to the people."
Albert: "This makes the evil forces of the Beyonder have nowhere to hide. Any superb tactics are not worth mentioning in front of the ocean of people's war."
Lancy: "The demigod squad is not large, but it is the essence of the entire empire's extraordinary power. Some are responsible for the empire's key projects, some are responsible for the defense of several counties of the empire, and some are responsible for the defense of one or several colonial planets."
Albert: "Now marching towards us is the middle-sequence squad. If the previous demigod squad is the leader of the official Beyonder, then the middle-sequence Beyonder are the backbone!"
Lancy: "A hundred years ago, this extraordinary force came from many different organizations. They shared the same dream and, under the leadership of His Majesty the Emperor, protected the newborn empire.
Albert: "For 100 years, official Beyonder have formed the largest Beyonder organization in the entire universe, with the most types of paths."
Lancy: "They not only protect the Atlantis Empire but also fight against the followers of the Evil Gods throughout the universe, protecting all people in the universe who have good expectations."
Albert: "Now marching towards us is the Beyonder military formation. The different colors of the military uniforms represent different units."
Lancy: "Those wearing blue military uniforms are the 'Gale Army,' those wearing rose-colored military uniforms are the 'Sting Army,' those wearing yellow military uniforms are the 'Bastion Army,' and those wearing red military uniforms are the 'Flame Army.'"
Albert: "Also, 100 years ago, the four most valiant Beyonder troops were awarded their designations by His Majesty the Emperor."
Lancy: "For 100 years, they have continued to carry forward their valiant fighting style and have always been the force that takes the initiative to attack throughout the empire!"
Albert: "This is a formation with many battle achievements and also many scars. Every soldier among them has experienced hundreds of battles."
Lancy: "The fourth formation, also dressed in distinct colors, is the 'Research Society' formation. The members of the Demoness Research Society wear rose-colored combat windbreakers, and the members of the Traveler Research Society wear white combat windbreakers."
Albert: "They are non-governmental organizations, but they are also an important reserve force for official Beyonder. They are led by the two Empresses respectively and send a large amount of fresh blood to the official Beyonder and Beyonder troops every year."
Lancy: "At the same time, the Traveler Research Society also shoulders the mission of discovering planets suitable for human habitation and conducting preliminary exploration."
Albert: "The Demoness Research Society shoulders the mission of safeguarding the rights and interests of vulnerable groups, ensuring that every citizen, regardless of gender, enjoys equal human rights."
Lancy: "Now marching towards us are several heroic formations, the military Beyonder formations. They also belong to the Beyonder combat troops sequence, but they are not directly under the command of His Majesty the Emperor."
Albert: "Leading the way is the 'Werewolf Legion' formation, known for their combat prowess and siege warfare, and are the most terrifying combat troops for the followers of the Outer Deities."
Lancy: "Behind the 'Werewolf Legion' is the 'Hunter Legion' formation. Their first leader was Medici, who was known as the 'Red of the Galaxy.' This unit has inherited Mr. Medici's wisdom and command art very well."
Albert: "The third reviewed troop is the 'Warrior Legion.' Among the four military Beyonder legions, they were formed the latest, but their battle achievements are equally brilliant!"
Lancy: "Finally, there's the 'Steel Legion.' This is the earliest military extraordinary force, and their first commander was none other than the current Commander-in-Chief, Steel."
Albert: "This legion has multiple pathways and is known for its flexible combat tactics, excelling in small-scale, limited-range operations."
Lancy: "These four legions, except for the 'Steel Legion,' were established after Atlantis won the Battle of Backlund. Their establishment witnessed His Majesty the Emperor's brilliant strategic deployment and Mr. Medici's outstanding command abilities."
Albert: "That was a nation-founding battle, laying a solid foundation for the subsequent Southern Continent campaign."
Lancy: "Next is the infantry phalanx. The first to march past us is the 'Central Corps' phalanx. Today's reviewed troops bear the serial number of the Third Army, a designation with a long history."
Albert: "Their predecessors participated in the Longtail Island campaign and the historically famous 'Duchy Civil War.'"
Lancy: "The second phalanx is the naval phalanx. Every planet has oceans, and wherever there are oceans, there is a need for the navy's power."
Albert: "Currently, we have a massive naval force. Besides safeguarding the Sonia Sea, the Berserk Sea, and the Fog Sea, they also protect the safety and interests of citizens residing on other planets."
